name: TranslationalTilings.wedge_zero_left
statement: theorem wedge_zero_left (v : Plane) : wedge 0 v = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [wedge]

name: TranslationalTilings.wedge_zero_right
statement: theorem wedge_zero_right (u : Plane) : wedge u 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [wedge]

name: TranslationalTilings.wedge_add_left
statement:
theorem wedge_add_left (u v w : Plane) :
    wedge (u + v) w = wedge u w + wedge v w
proof:
:= by
  simp [wedge]
  ring

name: TranslationalTilings.wedge_add_right
statement:
theorem wedge_add_right (u v w : Plane) :
    wedge u (v + w) = wedge u v + wedge u w
proof:
:= by
  simp [wedge]
  ring

name: TranslationalTilings.wedge_swap
statement: theorem wedge_swap (u v : Plane) : wedge u v = -wedge v u
proof:
:= by
  simp [wedge]
  ring

name: TranslationalTilings.wedge_zsmul_left
statement:
theorem wedge_zsmul_left (n : ℤ) (u v : Plane) :
    wedge (n • u) v = n * wedge u v
proof:
:= by
  simp [wedge]
  ring

name: TranslationalTilings.wedge_zsmul_right
statement:
theorem wedge_zsmul_right (n : ℤ) (u v : Plane) :
    wedge u (n • v) = n * wedge u v
proof:
:= by
  simp [wedge]
  ring

name: TranslationalTilings.plane_eq_zero_of_coords
statement:
private theorem plane_eq_zero_of_coords {u : Plane}
    (h0 : u 0 = 0) (h1 : u 1 = 0) : u = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> assumption

name: TranslationalTilings.commensurable_iff_wedge_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, _hb, hab⟩
    have hw : a * wedge u v = 0 := by
      calc
        a * wedge u v = wedge (a • u) v := (wedge_zsmul_left a u v).symm
        _ = wedge (b • v) v := by rw [hab]
        _ = b * wedge v v := wedge_zsmul_left b v v
        _ = 0 := by
          unfold wedge
          ring
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hw).resolve_left ha
  · intro hw
    by_cases hv0 : v 0 = 0
    · have hv1 : v 1 ≠ 0 := by
        intro hv1
        exact hv (plane_eq_zero_of_coords hv0 hv1)
      have hu0 : u 0 = 0 := by
        have huv : u 0 * v 1 = 0 := by
          rw [wedge, hv0, mul_zero, sub_zero] at hw
          exact hw
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp huv).resolve_right hv1
      have hu1 : u 1 ≠ 0 := by
        intro hu1
        exact hu (plane_eq_zero_of_coords hu0 hu1)
      refine ⟨v 1, u 1, hv1, hu1, ?_⟩
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      · simp [Pi.smul_apply, hv0, hu0]
      · simp [Pi.smul_apply]
        ring
    · have hu0 : u 0 ≠ 0 := by
        intro hu0
        have hu1 : u 1 = 0 := by
          have huv : -(u 1 * v 0) = 0 := by
            rw [wedge, hu0, zero_mul, zero_sub] at hw
            exact hw
          have huv' : u 1 * v 0 = 0 := neg_eq_zero.mp huv
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp huv').resolve_right hv0
        exact hu (plane_eq_zero_of_coords hu0 hu1)
      refine ⟨v 0, u 0, hv0, hu0, ?_⟩
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      · simp [Pi.smul_apply]
        ring
      · have heq : v 0 * u 1 = u 0 * v 1 := by
          rw [wedge] at hw
          linear_combination -hw
        simpa [Pi.smul_apply] using heq

name: TranslationalTilings.cramer_identity
statement:
theorem cramer_identity (u v x : Plane) :
    (wedge u v) • x = wedge x v • u + wedge u x • v
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [wedge] <;> ring

name: TranslationalTilings.scalarLattice_natAbs_wedge_le_generatedPair
statement:
theorem scalarLattice_natAbs_wedge_le_generatedPair (u v : Plane) :
    scalarLattice (Int.natAbs (wedge u v)) ≤ generatedPair u v
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
  have hu : u ∈ generatedPair u v := by
    exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  have hv : v ∈ generatedPair u v := by
    exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  have hdet : (wedge u v) • y ∈ generatedPair u v := by
    rw [cramer_identity]
    exact (generatedPair u v).add_mem
      ((generatedPair u v).zsmul_mem hu _)
      ((generatedPair u v).zsmul_mem hv _)
  change Int.natAbs (wedge u v) • y ∈ generatedPair u v
  rw [show Int.natAbs (wedge u v) • y =
      (Int.natAbs (wedge u v) : ℤ) • y by simp]
  rw [Int.natCast_natAbs]
  by_cases hw : 0 ≤ wedge u v
  · simpa [abs_of_nonneg hw] using hdet
  · have hw' : wedge u v ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hw
    simpa [abs_of_nonpos hw'] using (generatedPair u v).neg_mem hdet

name: TranslationalTilings.index_generatedPair
statement:
theorem index_generatedPair {u v : Plane} (hdet : wedge u v ≠ 0) :
    (generatedPair u v).index = Int.natAbs (wedge u v)
proof:
:= by
  let A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ := fun i j ↦ ![u, v] j i
  have hAdet : A.det = wedge u v := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two]
    simp [A, wedge]
    ring
  have hli : LinearIndependent ℤ (![u, v] : Fin 2 → Plane) := by
    apply Matrix.linearIndependent_cols_of_det_ne_zero (A := A)
    simpa [hAdet] using hdet
  have hspan : Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range (![u, v] : Fin 2 → Plane)) =
      (generatedPair u v).toIntSubmodule := by
    rw [generatedPair, AddSubgroup.toIntSubmodule_closure]
    congr 1
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i <;> simp
    · intro hx
      rcases hx with (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
      · exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
  let bN : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℤ (generatedPair u v).toIntSubmodule :=
    (Module.Basis.span hli).map (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hspan)
  have hbN (i : Fin 2) :
      ((bN i : (generatedPair u v).toIntSubmodule) : Plane) =
        (![u, v] : Fin 2 → Plane) i := by
    simp [bN]
  calc
    (generatedPair u v).index =
        ((Pi.basisFun ℤ (Fin 2)).det (fun i ↦ (bN i : Plane))).natAbs :=
      AddSubgroup.index_eq_natAbs_det (Pi.basisFun ℤ (Fin 2)) _ bN
    _ = Int.natAbs (wedge u v) := by
      rw [Pi.basisFun_det_apply, Matrix.det_fin_two]
      simp only [hbN]
      change Int.natAbs (u 0 * v 1 - u 1 * v 0) =
        Int.natAbs (wedge u v)
      rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.natAbs_wedge_le_l1Norm_mul_l1Norm
statement:
theorem natAbs_wedge_le_l1Norm_mul_l1Norm (u v : Plane) :
    Int.natAbs (wedge u v) ≤ l1Norm u * l1Norm v
proof:
:= by
  have htriangle := Int.natAbs_sub_le (u 0 * v 1) (u 1 * v 0)
  simp only [Int.natAbs_mul] at htriangle
  rw [wedge]
  simp only [l1Norm, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (Int.natAbs (u 0)), Nat.zero_le (Int.natAbs (u 1)),
    Nat.zero_le (Int.natAbs (v 0)), Nat.zero_le (Int.natAbs (v 1))]

name: TranslationalTilings.abs_wedge_le_euclideanNorm_mul_euclideanNorm
statement:
theorem abs_wedge_le_euclideanNorm_mul_euclideanNorm (u v : Plane) :
    |(wedge u v : ℝ)| ≤ euclideanNorm u * euclideanNorm v
proof:
:= by
  let U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i ↦ (u i : ℝ))
  let Vrot : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
    WithLp.toLp 2 ![-(v 1 : ℝ), (v 0 : ℝ)]
  have hinner : inner ℝ U Vrot = -(wedge u v : ℝ) := by
    simp [U, Vrot, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, wedge]
    ring
  have hnormrot : ‖Vrot‖ = euclideanNorm v := by
    apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
    rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
    simp [Vrot, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  simpa [hinner, hnormrot, U, euclideanNorm] using abs_real_inner_le_norm U Vrot

name: TranslationalTilings.scalarLattice_mono_dvd
statement:
theorem scalarLattice_mono_dvd {d m n : ℕ} (h : m ∣ n) :
    scalarLattice (d := d) n ≤ scalarLattice m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := h
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨c • x, ?_⟩
  simp [mul_smul]

name: TranslationalTilings.scalarLattice_index
statement:
theorem scalarLattice_index (d q : ℕ) :
    (scalarLattice (d := d) q).index = q ^ d
proof:
:= by
  simpa [scalarLattice] using
    (AddSubgroup.index_range_nsmul (M := Lattice d) q)

name: TranslationalTilings.vectorContent_pos
statement:
theorem vectorContent_pos {d : ℕ} {h : Lattice d} (hh : h ≠ 0) :
    0 < vectorContent h
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, vectorContent, Finset.gcd_ne_zero_iff]
  by_contra hx
  push Not at hx
  apply hh
  funext i
  exact Int.natAbs_eq_zero.mp (hx i (Finset.mem_univ i))

name: TranslationalTilings.vectorContent_dvd_coord
statement:
theorem vectorContent_dvd_coord {d : ℕ} (h : Lattice d) (i : Fin d) :
    (vectorContent h : ℤ) ∣ h i
proof:
:= by
  apply Int.dvd_natAbs.mp
  apply Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr
  exact Finset.gcd_dvd (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin d)))
    (f := fun j ↦ Int.natAbs (h j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: TranslationalTilings.exists_sum_mul_eq_finset_gcd_natAbs
statement:
private theorem exists_sum_mul_eq_finset_gcd_natAbs
    {d : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin d)) (v : Lattice d) :
    ∃ a : Lattice d,
      ∑ i ∈ s, a i * v i =
        ((s.gcd (fun i ↦ Int.natAbs (v i)) : ℕ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ih
      let g : ℕ := s.gcd (fun j ↦ Int.natAbs (v j))
      let b : Lattice d := fun j ↦
        if j = i then Int.gcdA (v i) (g : ℤ)
        else Int.gcdB (v i) (g : ℤ) * a j
      refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
      have hb : ∑ j ∈ s, b j * v j =
          Int.gcdB (v i) (g : ℤ) * (g : ℤ) := by
        calc
          ∑ j ∈ s, b j * v j =
              ∑ j ∈ s, (Int.gcdB (v i) (g : ℤ) * a j) * v j := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j hj
            simp [b, ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hj hi]
          _ = Int.gcdB (v i) (g : ℤ) * (∑ j ∈ s, a j * v j) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j _
            ring
          _ = Int.gcdB (v i) (g : ℤ) * (g : ℤ) := by
            rw [ha]
      rw [hb]
      simp only [b, if_pos, Finset.gcd_insert]
      change Int.gcdA (v i) (g : ℤ) * v i +
          Int.gcdB (v i) (g : ℤ) * (g : ℤ) =
        (Int.gcd (v i) (g : ℤ) : ℤ)
      rw [Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab]
      ring

name: TranslationalTilings.primitive_decomposition
statement:
theorem primitive_decomposition {d : ℕ} {h : Lattice d} (hh : h ≠ 0) :
    (vectorContent h : ℤ) • primitivePart h = h ∧
      IsPrimitive (primitivePart h)
proof:
:= by
  have hdecomp : (vectorContent h : ℤ) • primitivePart h = h := by
    funext i
    simp only [primitivePart, if_neg hh, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Int.mul_ediv_cancel_of_dvd (vectorContent_dvd_coord h i)
  refine ⟨hdecomp, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hp
    apply hh
    rw [← hdecomp, hp]
    simp
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, h i ≠ 0 := by
      apply not_forall.mp
      intro hall
      exact hh (funext hall)
    rw [vectorContent]
    simp_rw [primitivePart, if_neg hh,
      Int.natAbs_ediv_of_dvd (vectorContent_dvd_coord h _),
      Int.natAbs_natCast]
    exact Finset.gcd_div_eq_one (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin d)))
      (f := fun j ↦ Int.natAbs (h j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hi)

name: TranslationalTilings.primitive_decomposition_unique
proof:
:= by
  have hkcontent : vectorContent h = k := by
    calc
      vectorContent h = (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin d)).gcd
          (fun i ↦ Int.natAbs (((k : ℤ) • v) i)) := by rw [hdecomp]; rfl
      _ = k * vectorContent v := by
        simp [vectorContent, Int.natAbs_mul, Finset.gcd_mul_left]
      _ = k := by rw [hv.2, mul_one]
  refine ⟨hkcontent.symm, ?_⟩
  funext i
  rw [primitivePart, if_neg hh, hkcontent, hdecomp]
  simp [Nat.ne_of_gt hk]

name: TranslationalTilings.primitive_bezout
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_sum_mul_eq_finset_gcd_natAbs
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin d)) v
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  have ha' : ∑ i, a i * v i = (vectorContent v : ℤ) := by
    simpa [vectorContent] using ha
  simpa [hv.2] using ha'

name: TranslationalTilings.integer_multiple_of_primitive_of_commensurable
statement:
theorem integer_multiple_of_primitive_of_commensurable
    {d : ℕ} {u v : Lattice d} (_hu : u ≠ 0)
    (hv : IsPrimitive v) (huv : Commensurable u v) :
  ∃ z : ℤ, z ≠ 0 ∧ u = z • v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab⟩ := huv
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := primitive_bezout hv
  have hab_coord (i : Fin d) : a * u i = b * v i := by
    simpa [Pi.smul_apply] using congr_fun hab i
  have hab_dvd : a ∣ b := by
    rw [← mul_one b, ← hc, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.dvd_sum
    intro i _
    have hi : a ∣ b * v i := ⟨u i, (hab_coord i).symm⟩
    convert hi.mul_left (c i) using 1
    ring
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hab_dvd
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz0
    apply hb
    rw [hz, hz0, mul_zero]
  refine ⟨z, hz0, ?_⟩
  funext i
  have hi := hab_coord i
  rw [hz] at hi
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ ha
  linear_combination hi

name: TranslationalTilings.exists_commonMultiple_of_pairwise_commensurable
statement:
theorem exists_commonMultiple_of_pairwise_commensurable
    {d : ℕ} {C : Finset (Lattice d)} (hC : C.Nonempty)
    (hne : ∀ f ∈ C, f ≠ 0)
    (hcomm : ∀ u ∈ C, ∀ v ∈ C, Commensurable u v) :
  ∃ h : Lattice d,
    h ≠ 0 ∧
    (∀ f ∈ C, ∃ z : ℤ, z ≠ 0 ∧ h = z • f) ∧
    l1Norm h ≤ ∏ f ∈ C, l1Norm f ∧
    euclideanNorm h ≤ ∏ f ∈ C, euclideanNorm f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f0, hf0⟩ := hC
  have hf0_ne : f0 ≠ 0 := hne f0 hf0
  let v : Lattice d := primitivePart f0
  have hf0_decomp : (vectorContent f0 : ℤ) • v = f0 :=
    (primitive_decomposition hf0_ne).1
  have hv : IsPrimitive v := (primitive_decomposition hf0_ne).2
  have hcontent_ne : (vectorContent f0 : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt (vectorContent_pos hf0_ne))
  have hf_comm_v (f : Lattice d) (hf : f ∈ C) : Commensurable f v := by
    obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab⟩ := hcomm f hf f0 hf0
    refine ⟨a, b * (vectorContent f0 : ℤ), ha,
      mul_ne_zero hb hcontent_ne, ?_⟩
    calc
      a • f = b • f0 := hab
      _ = b • ((vectorContent f0 : ℤ) • v) := by rw [hf0_decomp]
      _ = (b * (vectorContent f0 : ℤ)) • v := by rw [mul_smul]
  let z : {f // f ∈ C} → ℤ := fun f ↦ Classical.choose
    (integer_multiple_of_primitive_of_commensurable
      (hne f f.property) hv (hf_comm_v f f.property))
  have hz_ne (f : {f // f ∈ C}) : z f ≠ 0 :=
    (Classical.choose_spec
      (integer_multiple_of_primitive_of_commensurable
        (hne f f.property) hv (hf_comm_v f f.property))).1
  have hz_decomp (f : {f // f ∈ C}) : (f : Lattice d) = z f • v :=
    (Classical.choose_spec
      (integer_multiple_of_primitive_of_commensurable
        (hne f f.property) hv (hf_comm_v f f.property))).2
  let L : ℕ := (Finset.univ : Finset {f // f ∈ C}).lcm fun f ↦
    Int.natAbs (z f)
  have hL_ne : L ≠ 0 := by
    intro hL
    change (Finset.univ : Finset {f // f ∈ C}).lcm
      (fun f ↦ Int.natAbs (z f)) = 0 at hL
    rw [Finset.lcm_eq_zero_iff] at hL
    obtain ⟨f, _, hf⟩ := hL
    exact Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr (hz_ne f) hf
  have hprod_pos : 0 < ∏ f : {f // f ∈ C}, Int.natAbs (z f) := by
    apply Finset.prod_pos
    intro f _
    exact Int.natAbs_pos.mpr (hz_ne f)
  have hL_le : L ≤ ∏ f : {f // f ∈ C}, Int.natAbs (z f) := by
    apply Nat.le_of_dvd hprod_pos
    exact Finset.lcm_dvd_prod (Finset.univ : Finset {f // f ∈ C})
      (fun f ↦ Int.natAbs (z f))
  let f0sub : {f // f ∈ C} := ⟨f0, hf0⟩
  have htype_nonempty : Nonempty {f // f ∈ C} := ⟨f0sub⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hcard⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero
    (ne_of_gt (Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr htype_nonempty))
  have hl1v : 1 ≤ l1Norm v := by
    apply Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    intro hvnorm
    exact hv.1 (l1Norm_eq_zero.mp hvnorm)
  have heuv : (1 : ℝ) ≤ euclideanNorm v := one_le_euclideanNorm hv.1
  have hl1pow : l1Norm v ≤ l1Norm v ^ Fintype.card {f // f ∈ C} := by
    rw [hcard]
    calc
      l1Norm v = 1 * l1Norm v := by simp
      _ ≤ l1Norm v ^ k * l1Norm v :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (one_le_pow₀ hl1v)
      _ = l1Norm v ^ (k + 1) := (pow_succ _ _).symm
  have heupow : euclideanNorm v ≤
      euclideanNorm v ^ Fintype.card {f // f ∈ C} := by
    rw [hcard]
    calc
      euclideanNorm v = 1 * euclideanNorm v := by simp
      _ ≤ euclideanNorm v ^ k * euclideanNorm v :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (one_le_pow₀ heuv) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = euclideanNorm v ^ (k + 1) := (pow_succ _ _).symm
  have hprod_l1 : (∏ f ∈ C, l1Norm f) =
      ∏ f : {f // f ∈ C}, Int.natAbs (z f) * l1Norm v := by
    rw [Finset.prod_subtype C (fun _ ↦ Iff.rfl)]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro f _
    rw [hz_decomp f, l1Norm_zsmul]
  have hprod_eu : (∏ f ∈ C, euclideanNorm f) =
      ∏ f : {f // f ∈ C},
        (Int.natAbs (z f) : ℝ) * euclideanNorm v := by
    rw [Finset.prod_subtype C (fun _ ↦ Iff.rfl)]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro f _
    rw [hz_decomp f, euclideanNorm_zsmul]
  have hh_ne : (L : ℤ) • v ≠ 0 := by
    intro hh
    have hnorm : l1Norm ((L : ℤ) • v) = 0 := by rw [hh, l1Norm_eq_zero.mpr rfl]
    rw [l1Norm_zsmul] at hnorm
    have hLabs : Int.natAbs (L : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hL_ne)
    exact (Nat.mul_ne_zero hLabs (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp hl1v)) hnorm
  refine ⟨(L : ℤ) • v, hh_ne, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro f hf
    let fs : {f // f ∈ C} := ⟨f, hf⟩
    have hdvd_nat : Int.natAbs (z fs) ∣ L := by
      exact Finset.dvd_lcm (f := fun x : {f // f ∈ C} ↦
        Int.natAbs (z x)) (Finset.mem_univ fs)
    have hdvd_int : z fs ∣ (L : ℤ) := by
      rw [← Int.natAbs_dvd]
      exact Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr hdvd_nat
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hdvd_int
    have hq_ne : q ≠ 0 := by
      intro hq0
      apply hL_ne
      have hLcast : (L : ℤ) = 0 := by rw [hq, hq0, mul_zero]
      exact_mod_cast hLcast
    refine ⟨q, hq_ne, ?_⟩
    rw [show f = z fs • v by exact hz_decomp fs, hq]
    simp [mul_smul, mul_comm]
  · rw [l1Norm_zsmul, hprod_l1]
    simp only [Int.natAbs_natCast]
    calc
      L * l1Norm v ≤
          (∏ f : {f // f ∈ C}, Int.natAbs (z f)) * l1Norm v :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hL_le
      _ ≤ (∏ f : {f // f ∈ C}, Int.natAbs (z f)) *
          l1Norm v ^ Fintype.card {f // f ∈ C} :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hl1pow
      _ = ∏ f : {f // f ∈ C}, Int.natAbs (z f) * l1Norm v := by
        simp [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  · rw [euclideanNorm_zsmul, hprod_eu]
    simp only [Int.natAbs_natCast]
    have hL_le_real : (L : ℝ) ≤
        ((∏ f : {f // f ∈ C}, Int.natAbs (z f) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hL_le
    calc
      (L : ℝ) * euclideanNorm v ≤
          ((∏ f : {f // f ∈ C}, Int.natAbs (z f) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            euclideanNorm v :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL_le_real (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = (∏ f : {f // f ∈ C}, (Int.natAbs (z f) : ℝ)) *
          euclideanNorm v := by norm_cast
      _ ≤ (∏ f : {f // f ∈ C}, (Int.natAbs (z f) : ℝ)) *
          euclideanNorm v ^ Fintype.card {f // f ∈ C} :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left heupow (Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ by positivity)
      _ = ∏ f : {f // f ∈ C},
          (Int.natAbs (z f) : ℝ) * euclideanNorm v := by
        simp [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

name: TranslationalTilings.exists_SL2Z_send_primitive_to_e0
statement:
theorem exists_SL2Z_send_primitive_to_e0 {h : Plane}
    (hh : IsPrimitive h) :
    ∃ e : Plane ≃ₗ[ℤ] Plane,
      LinearMap.det e.toLinearMap = 1 ∧ e h = ![1, 0]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := primitive_bezout hh
  have ha2 : a 0 * h 0 + a 1 * h 1 = 1 := by
    simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two] using ha
  let A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ :=
    !![a 0, a 1; -h 1, h 0]
  have hA : A.det = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two]
    simp [A]
    linear_combination ha2
  let g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ := ⟨A, hA⟩
  let e : Plane ≃ₗ[ℤ] Plane := Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toLin' g
  refine ⟨e, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change LinearMap.det (Matrix.toLin' A) = 1
    rw [LinearMap.det_toLin']
    exact hA
  · rw [show e h = Matrix.toLin' A h by rfl, Matrix.toLin'_apply]
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · simp [A, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two, ha2]
    · simp [A, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring

name: TranslationalTilings.avoidanceVector_spec
statement:
theorem avoidanceVector_spec {m : ℕ} {h : Fin m → Plane}
    (hne : ∀ i, h i ≠ 0) :
    avoidanceVector h ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ i, ¬ Commensurable (avoidanceVector h) (h i)) ∧
      l1Norm (avoidanceVector h) ≤ m + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ t : Fin (m + 1),
      ∀ i, wedge (slopeVector t.val) (h i) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hno
    push Not at hno
    let bad : Fin (m + 1) → Fin m := fun t ↦ Classical.choose (hno t)
    have hbad (t : Fin (m + 1)) :
        wedge (slopeVector t.val) (h (bad t)) = 0 :=
      Classical.choose_spec (hno t)
    have hbad_injective : Function.Injective bad := by
      intro t s hts
      have ht := hbad t
      have hs := hbad s
      rw [hts] at ht
      have hcoord0 : h (bad s) 0 ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have h1 : h (bad s) 1 = 0 := by
          simpa [wedge, slopeVector, h0] using hs
        exact hne (bad s) (plane_eq_zero_of_coords h0 h1)
      have hmul : ((t.val : ℤ) - (s.val : ℤ)) * h (bad s) 0 = 0 := by
        simp [wedge, slopeVector] at ht hs
        linear_combination hs - ht
      have hcast : (t.val : ℤ) = (s.val : ℤ) := by
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_right hcoord0)
      exact Fin.ext (Int.ofNat_inj.mp hcast)
    have hcard := Fintype.card_le_of_injective bad hbad_injective
    simp at hcard
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hex
  have ht_mem : t.val ∈ List.range (m + 1) := List.mem_range.mpr t.isLt
  have ht_bool : avoidsDirections h t.val = true := by
    simpa [avoidsDirections] using ht
  have hsome :
      ((List.range (m + 1)).find? (avoidsDirections h)).isSome = true :=
    List.find?_isSome.mpr ⟨t.val, ht_mem, ht_bool⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hsome
  have hs_bool : avoidsDirections h s = true := List.find?_some hs
  have hs_good : ∀ i, wedge (slopeVector s) (h i) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [avoidsDirections] using hs_bool
  have hs_mem : s ∈ List.range (m + 1) := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hs
  have hs_lt : s < m + 1 := List.mem_range.mp hs_mem
  have hslope : avoidanceSlope h = s := by
    simp [avoidanceSlope, hs]
  have hav_ne : avoidanceVector h ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hz0 := congr_fun hz 0
    simp [avoidanceVector, hslope, slopeVector] at hz0
  refine ⟨hav_ne, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hcomm
    have hw := (commensurable_iff_wedge_eq_zero hav_ne (hne i)).1 hcomm
    exact hs_good i (by simpa [avoidanceVector, hslope] using hw)
  · simpa [avoidanceVector, hslope, slopeVector, l1Norm, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      Nat.add_comm] using (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hs_lt)

name: TranslationalTilings.pairWedgeLCM_pos
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
  intro hzero
  rw [pairWedgeLCM, Finset.lcm_eq_zero_iff] at hzero
  obtain ⟨ij, hij, hw⟩ := hzero
  have hij_ne : ij.1 ≠ ij.2 := by
    have hp : ij.1 ≠ ij.2 ∧ ij.1 < ij.2 := by
      simpa [unorderedPairs] using hij
    exact hp.1
  have hw_ne : wedge (h ij.1) (h ij.2) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hw0
    exact hpair ij.1 ij.2 hij_ne
      ((commensurable_iff_wedge_eq_zero (hne ij.1) (hne ij.2)).2 hw0)
  exact Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hw_ne hw

name: TranslationalTilings.pairWedgeLCM_scalarLattice_le
statement:
theorem pairWedgeLCM_scalarLattice_le {m : ℕ}
    {h : Fin m → Plane} (_hne : ∀ i, h i ≠ 0)
    (_hpair : PairwiseIncommensurable h) {i j : Fin m} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    scalarLattice (pairWedgeLCM h) ≤ generatedPair (h i) (h j)
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd : Int.natAbs (wedge (h i) (h j)) ∣ pairWedgeLCM h := by
    unfold pairWedgeLCM
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hij_lt | hji_lt
    · exact Finset.dvd_lcm (f := fun ij ↦
          Int.natAbs (wedge (h ij.1) (h ij.2)))
        (show (i, j) ∈ unorderedPairs m by
          simp [unorderedPairs, hij, hij_lt])
    · have hdvd' : Int.natAbs (wedge (h j) (h i)) ∣
          (unorderedPairs m).lcm (fun ij : Fin m × Fin m ↦
            Int.natAbs (wedge (h ij.1) (h ij.2))) :=
        Finset.dvd_lcm (f := fun ij : Fin m × Fin m ↦
          Int.natAbs (wedge (h ij.1) (h ij.2)))
        (show (j, i) ∈ unorderedPairs m by
          simp [unorderedPairs, hij.symm, hji_lt])
      calc
        Int.natAbs (wedge (h i) (h j)) =
            Int.natAbs (wedge (h j) (h i)) := by
          rw [wedge_swap (h i) (h j), Int.natAbs_neg]
        _ ∣ (unorderedPairs m).lcm (fun ij : Fin m × Fin m ↦
            Int.natAbs (wedge (h ij.1) (h ij.2))) := hdvd'
  exact le_trans (scalarLattice_mono_dvd hdvd)
    (scalarLattice_natAbs_wedge_le_generatedPair (h i) (h j))

name: TranslationalTilings.pairWedgeLCM_bound
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D : Finset (Fin m × Fin m) := Finset.univ.offDiag
  let E : Finset (Fin m × Fin m) :=
    D.filter fun ij ↦ ij.1 < ij.2
  let F : Finset (Fin m × Fin m) :=
    D.filter fun ij ↦ ij.2 < ij.1
  have hE : E = unorderedPairs m := by rfl
  have hedge_ne (ij : Fin m × Fin m) (hij : ij ∈ E) :
      wedge (h ij.1) (h ij.2) ≠ 0 := by
    have hij_ne : ij.1 ≠ ij.2 := by
      have hp := Finset.mem_filter.mp hij
      exact (Finset.mem_offDiag.mp hp.1).2.2
    intro hw
    exact hpair ij.1 ij.2 hij_ne
      ((commensurable_iff_wedge_eq_zero (hne ij.1) (hne ij.2)).2 hw)
  have hdet_prod_pos :
      0 < ∏ ij ∈ E, Int.natAbs (wedge (h ij.1) (h ij.2)) := by
    apply Finset.prod_pos
    intro ij hij
    exact Int.natAbs_pos.mpr (hedge_ne ij hij)
  have hlcm_prod : pairWedgeLCM h ≤
      ∏ ij ∈ E, Int.natAbs (wedge (h ij.1) (h ij.2)) := by
    apply Nat.le_of_dvd hdet_prod_pos
    rw [pairWedgeLCM, ← hE]
    exact Finset.lcm_dvd_prod E fun ij ↦
      Int.natAbs (wedge (h ij.1) (h ij.2))
  have hdet_norm :
      (∏ ij ∈ E, Int.natAbs (wedge (h ij.1) (h ij.2))) ≤
        ∏ ij ∈ E, l1Norm (h ij.1) * l1Norm (h ij.2) := by
    apply Finset.prod_le_prod
    · intro _ _
      exact Nat.zero_le _
    · intro ij _
      exact natAbs_wedge_le_l1Norm_mul_l1Norm (h ij.1) (h ij.2)
  have hswap : (∏ ij ∈ E, l1Norm (h ij.2)) =
      ∏ ij ∈ F, l1Norm (h ij.1) := by
    apply Finset.prod_bij (fun ij _ ↦ (ij.2, ij.1))
    · intro ij hij
      have hp := Finset.mem_filter.mp hij
      apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      refine ⟨?_, hp.2⟩
      have hd := Finset.mem_offDiag.mp hp.1
      exact Finset.mem_offDiag.mpr ⟨hd.2.1, hd.1, hd.2.2.symm⟩
    · intro a₁ ha₁ a₂ ha₂ heq
      exact Prod.swap_injective heq
    · intro ij hij
      refine ⟨(ij.2, ij.1), ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hp := Finset.mem_filter.mp hij
        apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        refine ⟨?_, hp.2⟩
        have hd := Finset.mem_offDiag.mp hp.1
        exact Finset.mem_offDiag.mpr ⟨hd.2.1, hd.1, hd.2.2.symm⟩
      · rfl
    · intro _ _
      rfl
  have hdisj : Disjoint E F := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro ij hijE hijF
    have he := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hijE).2
    have hf := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hijF).2
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (le_of_lt hf)) he
  have hunion : E ∪ F = D := by
    ext ij
    constructor
    · intro hij
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hij with hij | hij
      · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hij).1
      · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hij).1
    · intro hij
      have hij_ne : ij.1 ≠ ij.2 := (Finset.mem_offDiag.mp hij).2.2
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij_ne with hlt | hgt
      · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hij, hlt⟩)
      · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hij, hgt⟩)
  have hfiber_card (i : Fin m) :
      (D.filter fun ij ↦ ij.1 = i).card = m - 1 := by
    calc
      (D.filter fun ij ↦ ij.1 = i).card =
          ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).erase i).card := by
        apply Finset.card_bij (fun ij _ ↦ ij.2)
        · intro ij hij
          have hp := Finset.mem_filter.mp hij
          have hneij := (Finset.mem_offDiag.mp hp.1).2.2
          rw [Finset.mem_erase]
          exact ⟨fun hji ↦ hneij (hp.2.trans hji.symm), Finset.mem_univ _⟩
        · intro a₁ ha₁ a₂ ha₂ heq
          apply Prod.ext
          · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha₁).2.trans
              (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha₂).2.symm
          · exact heq
        · intro j hj
          have hji : j ≠ i := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1
          refine ⟨(i, j), ?_, rfl⟩
          apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
          refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
          exact Finset.mem_offDiag.mpr
            ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, Finset.mem_univ _, hji.symm⟩
      _ = m - 1 := by
        rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i)]
        simp
  have hordered : (∏ ij ∈ D, l1Norm (h ij.1)) =
      ∏ i, l1Norm (h i) ^ (m - 1) := by
    calc
      (∏ ij ∈ D, l1Norm (h ij.1)) =
          ∏ i, ∏ ij ∈ D with ij.1 = i, l1Norm (h ij.1) :=
        (Finset.prod_fiberwise D Prod.fst
          (fun ij ↦ l1Norm (h ij.1))).symm
      _ = ∏ i, l1Norm (h i) ^ (m - 1) := by
        apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        intro i _
        calc
          (∏ ij ∈ D with ij.1 = i, l1Norm (h ij.1)) =
              l1Norm (h i) ^ (D.filter fun ij ↦ ij.1 = i).card := by
            apply Finset.prod_eq_pow_card
            intro ij hij
            rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hij).2]
          _ = l1Norm (h i) ^ (m - 1) := by rw [hfiber_card i]
  have hnorm_product :
      (∏ ij ∈ E, l1Norm (h ij.1) * l1Norm (h ij.2)) =
        ∏ i, l1Norm (h i) ^ (m - 1) := by
    calc
      (∏ ij ∈ E, l1Norm (h ij.1) * l1Norm (h ij.2)) =
          (∏ ij ∈ E, l1Norm (h ij.1)) *
            ∏ ij ∈ E, l1Norm (h ij.2) := by
        rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      _ = (∏ ij ∈ E, l1Norm (h ij.1)) *
            ∏ ij ∈ F, l1Norm (h ij.1) := by rw [hswap]
      _ = ∏ ij ∈ E ∪ F, l1Norm (h ij.1) :=
        (Finset.prod_union hdisj).symm
      _ = ∏ ij ∈ D, l1Norm (h ij.1) := by rw [hunion]
      _ = ∏ i, l1Norm (h i) ^ (m - 1) := hordered
  exact hlcm_prod.trans (hdet_norm.trans_eq hnorm_product)

name: TranslationalTilings.dilationModulus_pos
statement:
theorem dilationModulus_pos {ell oscillation tileCard : ℕ}
    (hell : 0 < ell) : 0 < dilationModulus ell oscillation tileCard
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.lcm_pos hell (primorial_pos _)

name: TranslationalTilings.ell_dvd_dilationModulus
statement:
theorem ell_dvd_dilationModulus (ell oscillation tileCard : ℕ) :
    ell ∣ dilationModulus ell oscillation tileCard
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.dvd_lcm_left ell (primorial (2 * oscillation * tileCard))

name: TranslationalTilings.prime_dvd_dilationModulus
proof:
:= by
  exact (hp.dvd_primorial_iff.mpr hpB).trans
    (Nat.dvd_lcm_right ell (primorial (2 * oscillation * tileCard)))

name: TranslationalTilings.prime_factor_gt_of_coprime_primorial
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hpB : p ≤ B := Nat.le_of_not_gt h
  have hpPrimorial : p ∣ primorial B := hp.dvd_primorial_iff.mpr hpB
  exact (Nat.Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd.mpr
    ⟨p, hp, hpr, hpPrimorial⟩) hr

name: TranslationalTilings.dilationModulus_le_explicit
statement:
theorem dilationModulus_le_explicit (ell oscillation tileCard : ℕ) :
    dilationModulus ell oscillation tileCard ≤
      ell * 4 ^ (2 * oscillation * tileCard)
proof:
:= by
  rcases ell.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hell
  · simp [dilationModulus]
  calc
    dilationModulus ell oscillation tileCard ≤
        ell * primorial (2 * oscillation * tileCard) := by
      exact Nat.lcm_le_mul hell (primorial_pos _)
    _ ≤ ell * 4 ^ (2 * oscillation * tileCard) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left ell (primorial_le_four_pow _)

name: TranslationalTilings.l1Norm_eq_zero
statement:
theorem l1Norm_eq_zero {d : ℕ} {x : Lattice d} :
    l1Norm x = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    funext i
    have hi : Int.natAbs (x i) = 0 := by
      exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
        (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _)).mp hx i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    exact Int.natAbs_eq_zero.mp hi
  · rintro rfl
    simp [l1Norm]

name: TranslationalTilings.l1Norm_neg
statement: theorem l1Norm_neg {d : ℕ} (x : Lattice d) : l1Norm (-x) = l1Norm x
proof:
:= by
  simp [l1Norm]

name: TranslationalTilings.l1Norm_add_le
statement:
theorem l1Norm_add_le {d : ℕ} (x y : Lattice d) :
    l1Norm (x + y) ≤ l1Norm x + l1Norm y
proof:
:= by
  unfold l1Norm
  calc
    ∑ i, Int.natAbs ((x + y) i) ≤
        ∑ i, (Int.natAbs (x i) + Int.natAbs (y i)) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ by
        simpa using Int.natAbs_add_le (x i) (y i)
    _ = (∑ i, Int.natAbs (x i)) + ∑ i, Int.natAbs (y i) :=
      Finset.sum_add_distrib

name: TranslationalTilings.l1Norm_sub_le
statement:
theorem l1Norm_sub_le {d : ℕ} (x y : Lattice d) :
    l1Norm (x - y) ≤ l1Norm x + l1Norm y
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, l1Norm_neg] using l1Norm_add_le x (-y)

name: TranslationalTilings.l1Norm_zsmul
statement:
theorem l1Norm_zsmul {d : ℕ} (n : ℤ) (x : Lattice d) :
    l1Norm (n • x) = Int.natAbs n * l1Norm x
proof:
:= by
  simp [l1Norm, Int.natAbs_mul, Finset.mul_sum]

name: TranslationalTilings.mem_tile_norm_le_diameter
proof:
:= by
  simpa [l1Diameter] using
    (Finset.le_sup (f := fun xy : Lattice d × Lattice d ↦
      l1Norm (xy.1 - xy.2)) (show (x, 0) ∈ F ×ˢ F by simp [hx, h0]))

name: TranslationalTilings.euclideanNorm_le_l1Norm
statement:
theorem euclideanNorm_le_l1Norm {d : ℕ} (x : Lattice d) :
    euclideanNorm x ≤ (l1Norm x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin d ↦ (x i : ℝ))
  have hsquares : ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i, |(x i : ℝ)|) ^ 2 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
    simpa [v, sq_abs] using
      (Finset.sum_sq_le_sq_sum_of_nonneg
        (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin d)))
        (f := fun i ↦ |(x i : ℝ)|) (fun _ _ ↦ abs_nonneg _))
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i, |(x i : ℝ)| :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ abs_nonneg _
  have hnorm : ‖v‖ ≤ ∑ i, |(x i : ℝ)| :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg v) hnonneg).mp hsquares
  simpa [euclideanNorm, l1Norm, v, Int.cast_abs] using hnorm

name: TranslationalTilings.euclideanNorm_zsmul
statement:
theorem euclideanNorm_zsmul {d : ℕ} (n : ℤ) (x : Lattice d) :
    euclideanNorm (n • x) = (Int.natAbs n : ℝ) * euclideanNorm x
proof:
:= by
  let v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin d ↦ (x i : ℝ))
  have hv :
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin d ↦ (((n • x) i : ℤ) : ℝ)) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) = (n : ℝ) • v := by
    ext i
    simp [v, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [euclideanNorm, hv]
  simpa [v, euclideanNorm, Real.norm_eq_abs, ← Int.cast_abs] using
    (norm_smul (n : ℝ) v)

name: TranslationalTilings.one_le_euclideanNorm
statement:
theorem one_le_euclideanNorm {d : ℕ} {x : Lattice d} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    (1 : ℝ) ≤ euclideanNorm x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, x i ≠ 0 := by
    apply not_forall.mp
    intro h
    exact hx (funext h)
  let v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j : Fin d ↦ (x j : ℝ))
  calc
    (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖(x i : ℝ)‖ := by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← Int.cast_abs, ← Int.cast_one, Int.cast_le]
      rw [← Int.natCast_natAbs]
      exact_mod_cast Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hi
    _ ≤ ‖v‖ := PiLp.norm_apply_le v i
    _ = euclideanNorm x := rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.l1Norm_le_sqrt_dim_mul_euclideanNorm
statement:
theorem l1Norm_le_sqrt_dim_mul_euclideanNorm {d : ℕ} (x : Lattice d) :
    (l1Norm x : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt d * euclideanNorm x
proof:
:= by
  let v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin d ↦ (x i : ℝ))
  have hcs := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin d)))
    (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) (fun i ↦ |(x i : ℝ)|)
  have hsquares :
      (∑ i, |(x i : ℝ)|) ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt d * ‖v‖) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg d),
      EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
    simpa [sq_abs] using hcs
  have hleft : 0 ≤ ∑ i, |(x i : ℝ)| :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ abs_nonneg _
  have hright : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt d * ‖v‖ :=
    mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hnorm : ∑ i, |(x i : ℝ)| ≤ Real.sqrt d * ‖v‖ :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ hleft hright).mp hsquares
  simpa [l1Norm, euclideanNorm, v, Int.cast_abs] using hnorm

name: TranslationalTilings.euclideanDiameter_le_l1Diameter
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : (F ×ˢ F).Nonempty
  · rw [euclideanDiameter, dif_pos h]
    refine Finset.sup'_le h _ fun xy hxy ↦ ?_
    exact (euclideanNorm_le_l1Norm (xy.1 - xy.2)).trans
      (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Finset.le_sup (f := fun zw : Lattice d × Lattice d ↦
        l1Norm (zw.1 - zw.2)) hxy))
  · simp [euclideanDiameter, h]

name: TranslationalTilings.l1Diameter_le_sqrt_dim_mul_euclideanDiameter
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : (F ×ˢ F).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨xy, hxy, hsup⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup
      (F ×ˢ F) h (fun zw ↦ l1Norm (zw.1 - zw.2))
    rw [l1Diameter, hsup, euclideanDiameter, dif_pos h]
    exact (l1Norm_le_sqrt_dim_mul_euclideanNorm (xy.1 - xy.2)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Finset.le_sup' (f := fun zw : Lattice d × Lattice d ↦
          euclideanNorm (zw.1 - zw.2)) hxy)
        (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  · have hempty : F ×ˢ F = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h
    simp [l1Diameter, euclideanDiameter, hempty]

name: TranslationalTilings.tileConv_apply
statement:
theorem tileConv_apply {G R : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommMonoid R]
    (F : Finset G) (g : G → R) (x : G) :
    tileConv F g x = ∑ f ∈ F, g (x - f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.tileConv_zero
statement:
theorem tileConv_zero {G R : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommMonoid R]
    (F : Finset G) : tileConv F (0 : G → R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp [tileConv]

name: TranslationalTilings.tileConv_add
statement:
theorem tileConv_add {G R : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommMonoid R]
    (F : Finset G) (g h : G → R) :
    tileConv F (g + h) = tileConv F g + tileConv F h
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp [tileConv, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: TranslationalTilings.tileConv_sub
statement:
theorem tileConv_sub {G R : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup R]
    (F : Finset G) (g h : G → R) :
    tileConv F (g - h) = tileConv F g - tileConv F h
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp [tileConv, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: TranslationalTilings.tileConv_smul
statement:
theorem tileConv_smul {G R S : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    [Semiring S] [AddCommMonoid R] [Module S R]
    (F : Finset G) (c : S) (g : G → R) :
    tileConv F (c • g) = c • tileConv F g
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp [tileConv, Finset.smul_sum]

name: TranslationalTilings.tileConv_translate
statement:
theorem tileConv_translate {G R : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommMonoid R]
    (F : Finset G) (g : G → R) (a : G) :
    tileConv F (fun y ↦ g (y - a)) = fun x ↦ tileConv F g (x - a)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro f _
  abel_nf

name: TranslationalTilings.tileConv_indicator_eq_card
statement:
theorem tileConv_indicator_eq_card {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (F : Finset G) (A : Set G) (x : G) :
    tileConv F (setIndicator A) x =
      ((@Finset.filter G (fun f ↦ x - f ∈ A)
        (fun _ ↦ Classical.propDecidable _) F).card : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [tileConv, setIndicator, Set.indicator, Finset.sum_boole]

name: TranslationalTilings.tilesAtLevel_iff_representation_count
statement:
theorem tilesAtLevel_iff_representation_count
    {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (F : Finset G) (A E : Set G) (k : ℕ) :
  TilesAtLevel F A E k ↔ ∀ x,
      (@Finset.filter G (fun f ↦ x - f ∈ A)
        (fun _ ↦ Classical.propDecidable _) F).card =
          @ite ℕ (x ∈ E) (Classical.propDecidable _) k 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h x
    specialize h x
    rw [tileConv_indicator_eq_card] at h
    by_cases hx : x ∈ E
    · rw [if_pos hx]
      simp only [setIndicator, Set.indicator_of_mem hx, mul_one] at h
      exact_mod_cast h
    · rw [if_neg hx]
      simp only [setIndicator, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, mul_zero] at h
      exact_mod_cast h
  · intro h x
    specialize h x
    rw [tileConv_indicator_eq_card]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ E
    · rw [if_pos hx] at h
      simp only [setIndicator, Set.indicator_of_mem hx, mul_one]
      exact_mod_cast h
    · rw [if_neg hx] at h
      simp only [setIndicator, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, mul_zero]
      exact_mod_cast h

name: TranslationalTilings.periodicOn_mono
proof:
:=
  fun h hh ↦ hf h (hHK hh)

name: TranslationalTilings.setPeriodicOn_iff_indicator
statement:
theorem setPeriodicOn_iff_indicator {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (H : AddSubgroup G) (A : Set G) :
    SetPeriodicOn H A ↔ PeriodicOn H (setIndicator A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have indicator_eq_indicator_iff (x y : G) :
      setIndicator A x = setIndicator A y ↔ (x ∈ A ↔ y ∈ A) := by
    by_cases hx : x ∈ A <;> by_cases hy : y ∈ A <;>
      simp [setIndicator, hx, hy]
  constructor
  · intro h p hp x
    exact (indicator_eq_indicator_iff (x + p) x).2 (h p hp x)
  · intro h p hp x
    exact (indicator_eq_indicator_iff (x + p) x).1 (h p hp x)

name: TranslationalTilings.setScalarPeriodic_iff_membership
statement:
theorem setScalarPeriodic_iff_membership {d : ℕ}
    (q : ℕ) (A : Set (Lattice d)) :
    SetScalarPeriodic q A ↔ ∀ x z,
      x + (q : ℤ) • z ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.finiteIndex_periodic_scalarPeriodic
statement:
theorem finiteIndex_periodic_scalarPeriodic {d : ℕ} {R : Type*}
    (H : AddSubgroup (Lattice d)) (f : Lattice d → R)
    [Finite ((Lattice d) ⧸ H)] (hf : PeriodicOn H f) :
    ScalarPeriodic H.index f
proof:
:= by
  intro x z
  apply hf
  simpa using H.nsmul_index_mem z

name: TranslationalTilings.quotientCoset_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem quotientCoset_pairwiseDisjoint {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (H : AddSubgroup G) :
    Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ (quotientCoset H)
proof:
:= by
  intro c _ d _ hcd
  change Disjoint (quotientCoset H c) (quotientCoset H d)
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxc hxd
  exact hcd (hxc.symm.trans hxd)

name: TranslationalTilings.iUnion_quotientCoset
statement:
theorem iUnion_quotientCoset {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (H : AddSubgroup G) : (⋃ c, quotientCoset H c) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [quotientCoset]

name: TranslationalTilings.weaklyPeriodic_of_cosetwise
statement:
theorem weaklyPeriodic_of_cosetwise (A : Set Plane)
    (Λ : AddSubgroup Plane) {m : ℕ} (periods : Fin m → Plane)
    [Finite (Plane ⧸ Λ)] (_hm : 0 < m)
    (hne : ∀ j, periods j ≠ 0) (hmem : ∀ j, periods j ∈ Λ)
    (hA : CosetwisePeriodic A Λ periods) : WeaklyPeriodic A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcoset : ∀ c : Plane ⧸ Λ, ∃ j, ∀ y,
      y + periods j ∈ A ∩ quotientCoset Λ c ↔
        y ∈ A ∩ quotientCoset Λ c := by
    intro c
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective Λ c
    simpa [addCoset, quotientCoset, QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem] using hA x
  let chosen : Plane ⧸ Λ → Fin m := fun c ↦ Classical.choose (hcoset c)
  let e : Fin (Nat.card (Plane ⧸ Λ)) ≃ (Plane ⧸ Λ) :=
    (Finite.equivFin (Plane ⧸ Λ)).symm
  refine ⟨{
    numberOfParts := Nat.card (Plane ⧸ Λ)
    part := fun i ↦ A ∩ quotientCoset Λ (e i)
    period := fun i ↦ periods (chosen (e i))
    period_ne_zero := fun i ↦ hne (chosen (e i))
    periodic_part := ?_
    pairwiseDisjoint := ?_
    iUnion_parts := ?_
  }⟩
  · intro i x
    let j := chosen (e i)
    have hq : x + periods j ∈ quotientCoset Λ (e i) ↔
        x ∈ quotientCoset Λ (e i) := by
      change QuotientAddGroup.mk' Λ (x + periods j) = e i ↔
        QuotientAddGroup.mk' Λ x = e i
      have hp0 : QuotientAddGroup.mk' Λ (periods j) = 0 :=
        (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff (periods j)).2 (hmem j)
      rw [map_add, hp0, add_zero]
    have hwhole := Classical.choose_spec (hcoset (e i)) x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨(hwhole.mp hx).1, hq.mp hx.2⟩
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨(hwhole.mpr hx).1, hq.mpr hx.2⟩
  · intro i _ j _ hij
    change Disjoint (A ∩ quotientCoset Λ (e i)) (A ∩ quotientCoset Λ (e j))
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxi hxj
    apply hij
    apply e.injective
    exact hxi.2.symm.trans hxj.2
  · apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      exact hxi.1
    · intro x hx
      let c : Plane ⧸ Λ := QuotientAddGroup.mk' Λ x
      let i : Fin (Nat.card (Plane ⧸ Λ)) := e.symm c
      apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨i, hx, ?_⟩
      change QuotientAddGroup.mk' Λ x = e i
      exact (e.apply_symm_apply c).symm

name: TranslationalTilings.tiles_translate_tile
statement:
theorem tiles_translate_tile {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (F : Finset G) (A E : Set G) (k : ℕ) (t : G) :
  TilesAtLevel F A E k ↔
      TilesAtLevel
        (@Finset.image G G (Classical.decEq G) (fun f ↦ f - t) F)
        (translateSet t A) E k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hconv :
      tileConv (F.image fun f ↦ f - t) (setIndicator (translateSet t A)) =
        tileConv F (setIndicator A) := by
    funext x
    simp only [tileConv]
    rw [Finset.sum_image]
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro f _
      have harg : x - (f - t) - t = x - f := by abel
      simp only [setIndicator, Set.indicator_apply, translateSet, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, harg]
    · intro a _ b _ hab
      exact sub_left_injective hab
  unfold TilesAtLevel
  rw [hconv]

name: TranslationalTilings.pairToPlane_planeToPair
statement:
private theorem pairToPlane_planeToPair (v : Plane) :
    pairToPlane (planeToPair v) = v
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.planeToPair_injective
statement: private theorem planeToPair_injective : Function.Injective planeToPair
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  rw [← pairToPlane_planeToPair u, ← pairToPlane_planeToPair v, huv]

name: TranslationalTilings.planeToPair_pairToPlane
statement:
private theorem planeToPair_pairToPlane (p : ℤ ×ₗ ℤ) :
    planeToPair (pairToPlane p) = p
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext <;> rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.orientedPrimitive_neg
proof:
:= by
  have hvcoords : v 0 ≠ 0 ∨ v 1 ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hv
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [h.1, h.2]
  have hbadneg :
      ((-v) 0 < 0 ∨ ((-v) 0 = 0 ∧ (-v) 1 < 0)) ↔
        ¬ (v 0 < 0 ∨ (v 0 = 0 ∧ v 1 < 0)) := by
    simp only [Pi.neg_apply]
    rcases hvcoords with h0 | h1 <;> omega
  by_cases hbad : v 0 < 0 ∨ (v 0 = 0 ∧ v 1 < 0)
  · have hnbad : ¬ ((-v) 0 < 0 ∨ ((-v) 0 = 0 ∧ (-v) 1 < 0)) := by
      exact fun hn ↦ (hbadneg.mp hn) hbad
    rw [if_neg hnbad, if_pos hbad]
  · have hnbad : (-v) 0 < 0 ∨ ((-v) 0 = 0 ∧ (-v) 1 < 0) :=
      hbadneg.mpr hbad
    rw [if_pos hnbad, if_neg hbad]
    simp

name: TranslationalTilings.vectorContent_zsmul
statement:
private theorem vectorContent_zsmul (z : ℤ) (v : Plane) :
    vectorContent (z • v) = Int.natAbs z * vectorContent v
proof:
:= by
  simp [vectorContent, Int.natAbs_mul, Finset.gcd_mul_left]

name: TranslationalTilings.canonicalDirection_ne_zero
statement:
theorem canonicalDirection_ne_zero {h : Plane} (hh : h ≠ 0) :
    canonicalDirection h ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp : primitivePart h ≠ 0 := (primitive_decomposition hh).2.1
  simp only [canonicalDirection]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: TranslationalTilings.tile_integer_multiple_of_canonicalDirection
statement:
theorem tile_integer_multiple_of_canonicalDirection
    {h : Plane} (hh : h ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, z ≠ 0 ∧ h = z • canonicalDirection h
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (vectorContent h : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (vectorContent_pos hh))
  have hdecomp := (primitive_decomposition hh).1
  by_cases horient :
      (primitivePart h) 0 < 0 ∨
        ((primitivePart h) 0 = 0 ∧ (primitivePart h) 1 < 0)
  · refine ⟨-(vectorContent h : ℤ), neg_ne_zero.mpr hc, ?_⟩
    rw [canonicalDirection, if_pos horient, neg_smul, smul_neg, neg_neg]
    exact hdecomp.symm
  · refine ⟨(vectorContent h : ℤ), hc, ?_⟩
    rw [canonicalDirection, if_neg horient]
    exact hdecomp.symm

name: TranslationalTilings.canonicalDirection_eq_iff_commensurable
statement:
theorem canonicalDirection_eq_iff_commensurable
    {u v : Plane} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    canonicalDirection u = canonicalDirection v ↔ Commensurable u v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hua⟩ := tile_integer_multiple_of_canonicalDirection hu
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hvb⟩ := tile_integer_multiple_of_canonicalDirection hv
    exact ⟨b, a, hb, ha, by rw [hua, hvb, heq]; module⟩
  · intro hcomm
    let pu := primitivePart u
    let pv := primitivePart v
    have hpu : IsPrimitive pu := (primitive_decomposition hu).2
    have hpv : IsPrimitive pv := (primitive_decomposition hv).2
    have huv : Commensurable pu pv := by
      obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab⟩ := hcomm
      have hcu : (vectorContent u : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (vectorContent_pos hu))
      have hcv : (vectorContent v : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (vectorContent_pos hv))
      refine ⟨a * (vectorContent u : ℤ), b * (vectorContent v : ℤ),
        mul_ne_zero ha hcu, mul_ne_zero hb hcv, ?_⟩
      dsimp [pu, pv]
      rw [mul_smul, (primitive_decomposition hu).1,
        mul_smul, (primitive_decomposition hv).1]
      exact hab
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hpuz⟩ :=
      integer_multiple_of_primitive_of_commensurable hpu.1 hpv huv
    have hzabs : Int.natAbs z = 1 := by
      have hc := congrArg vectorContent hpuz
      rw [vectorContent_zsmul, hpu.2, hpv.2, mul_one] at hc
      exact hc.symm
    have hz_cases : z = 1 ∨ z = -1 := by
      cases z with
      | ofNat n =>
          left
          change n = 1 at hzabs
          subst n
          rfl
      | negSucc n =>
          right
          change n + 1 = 1 at hzabs
          have hn : n = 0 := by omega
          subst n
          rfl
    rcases hz_cases with rfl | rfl
    · rw [canonicalDirection, canonicalDirection]
      change (if pu 0 < 0 ∨ (pu 0 = 0 ∧ pu 1 < 0) then -pu else pu) =
        if pv 0 < 0 ∨ (pv 0 = 0 ∧ pv 1 < 0) then -pv else pv
      simpa using congrArg
        (fun w : Plane ↦
          if w 0 < 0 ∨ (w 0 = 0 ∧ w 1 < 0) then -w else w) hpuz
    · have hpueq : pu = -pv := by simpa using hpuz
      rw [canonicalDirection, canonicalDirection]
      change (if pu 0 < 0 ∨ (pu 0 = 0 ∧ pu 1 < 0) then -pu else pu) =
        if pv 0 < 0 ∨ (pv 0 = 0 ∧ pv 1 < 0) then -pv else pv
      rw [hpueq]
      exact orientedPrimitive_neg hpv.1

name: TranslationalTilings.groupedDirectionCount_pos
statement:
theorem groupedDirectionCount_pos
    {F : Finset Plane} (hzero : 0 ∈ F) (hcard : 1 < F.card) :
    0 < groupedDirectionCount F
proof:
:= by
  rw [groupedDirectionCount, Finset.card_pos]
  have herase : (F.erase 0).Nonempty := by
    rw [← Finset.card_pos, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hzero]
    omega
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := herase
  exact ⟨planeToPair (canonicalDirection f),
    Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩⟩

name: TranslationalTilings.groupedDirectionCount_le_erase
statement:
theorem groupedDirectionCount_le_erase (F : Finset Plane) :
    groupedDirectionCount F ≤ (F.erase 0).card
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.card_image_le

name: TranslationalTilings.groupedDirectionCount_le
statement:
theorem groupedDirectionCount_le
    {F : Finset Plane} (hzero : 0 ∈ F) :
    groupedDirectionCount F ≤ F.card - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_erase_of_mem hzero]
  exact groupedDirectionCount_le_erase F

name: TranslationalTilings.groupedDirectionCount_singleton_ne_zero
statement:
theorem groupedDirectionCount_singleton_ne_zero
    {f : Plane} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    groupedDirectionCount {f} = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (0 : Plane) ≠ f := Ne.symm hf
  simp [groupedDirectionCount, groupedDirectionPairs, hz]

name: TranslationalTilings.groupedDirectionScale_pos_of_mem
statement:
private theorem groupedDirectionScale_pos_of_mem
    {F : Finset Plane} {v : Plane}
    (hv : planeToPair v ∈ groupedDirectionPairs F) :
    0 < groupedDirectionScale F v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hp⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
  have hfne : f ≠ 0 := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hf
  have hfv : canonicalDirection f = v := by
    apply planeToPair_injective
    exact hp
  rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
  intro hzero
  rw [groupedDirectionScale, Finset.lcm_eq_zero_iff] at hzero
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgzero⟩ := hzero
  have hgne : g ≠ 0 :=
    Finset.ne_of_mem_erase (Finset.mem_filter.mp hg).1
  exact (Nat.ne_of_gt (vectorContent_pos hgne)) hgzero

name: TranslationalTilings.groupedTileDirection_key_mem
statement:
private theorem groupedTileDirection_key_mem {F : Finset Plane}
    (j : Fin (groupedDirectionCount F)) :
    planeToPair (pairToPlane ((groupedDirectionPairs F).orderEmbOfFin rfl j)) ∈
      groupedDirectionPairs F
proof:
:= by
  rw [planeToPair_pairToPlane]
  exact Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem (groupedDirectionPairs F) rfl j

name: TranslationalTilings.groupedTileDirections_ne_zero
statement:
theorem groupedTileDirections_ne_zero
    {F : Finset Plane} (_hzero : 0 ∈ F) (_hcard : 1 < F.card) :
    ∀ j, groupedTileDirections F j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  let v := pairToPlane ((groupedDirectionPairs F).orderEmbOfFin rfl j)
  have hscale : 0 < groupedDirectionScale F v :=
    groupedDirectionScale_pos_of_mem (groupedTileDirection_key_mem j)
  have hv : v ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hp⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (groupedTileDirection_key_mem j)
    have hfne : f ≠ 0 := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hf
    have hfv : canonicalDirection f = v := planeToPair_injective hp
    rw [← hfv]
    exact canonicalDirection_ne_zero hfne
  dsimp [groupedTileDirections]
  exact smul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hscale)) hv

name: TranslationalTilings.canonicalDirection_groupedTileDirections
statement:
private theorem canonicalDirection_groupedTileDirections
    {F : Finset Plane} (hzero : 0 ∈ F) (hcard : 1 < F.card)
    (j : Fin (groupedDirectionCount F)) :
    canonicalDirection (groupedTileDirections F j) =
      pairToPlane ((groupedDirectionPairs F).orderEmbOfFin rfl j)
proof:
:= by
  let v := pairToPlane ((groupedDirectionPairs F).orderEmbOfFin rfl j)
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hp⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (groupedTileDirection_key_mem j)
  have hfne : f ≠ 0 := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hf
  have hfv : canonicalDirection f = v := planeToPair_injective hp
  have hspos : 0 < groupedDirectionScale F v :=
    groupedDirectionScale_pos_of_mem (groupedTileDirection_key_mem j)
  have hgroup : groupedTileDirections F j =
      (groupedDirectionScale F v : ℤ) • v := by rfl
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hfz⟩ := tile_integer_multiple_of_canonicalDirection hfne
  change canonicalDirection (groupedTileDirections F j) = v
  rw [← hfv]
  apply (canonicalDirection_eq_iff_commensurable
    (groupedTileDirections_ne_zero hzero hcard j) hfne).2
  refine ⟨z, (groupedDirectionScale F v : ℤ), hz,
    by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hspos), ?_⟩
  calc
    z • groupedTileDirections F j =
        z • ((groupedDirectionScale F v : ℤ) • v) := by rw [hgroup]
    _ = (groupedDirectionScale F v : ℤ) •
        (z • canonicalDirection f) := by rw [hfv]; module
    _ = (groupedDirectionScale F v : ℤ) • f :=
      congrArg ((groupedDirectionScale F v : ℤ) • ·) hfz.symm

name: TranslationalTilings.groupedTileDirections_pairwise
statement:
theorem groupedTileDirections_pairwise
    {F : Finset Plane} (hzero : 0 ∈ F) (hcard : 1 < F.card) :
    PairwiseIncommensurable (groupedTileDirections F)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij hcomm
  have hine := groupedTileDirections_ne_zero hzero hcard i
  have hjne := groupedTileDirections_ne_zero hzero hcard j
  have hcanon := (canonicalDirection_eq_iff_commensurable hine hjne).2 hcomm
  have hcani := canonicalDirection_groupedTileDirections hzero hcard i
  have hcanj := canonicalDirection_groupedTileDirections hzero hcard j
  rw [hcani, hcanj] at hcanon
  apply hij
  apply (groupedDirectionPairs F).orderEmbOfFin rfl |>.injective
  rw [← planeToPair_pairToPlane
    ((groupedDirectionPairs F).orderEmbOfFin rfl i),
    ← planeToPair_pairToPlane
      ((groupedDirectionPairs F).orderEmbOfFin rfl j), hcanon]

name: TranslationalTilings.groupedTileDirections_from_tile
statement:
theorem groupedTileDirections_from_tile
    {F : Finset Plane} (_hzero : 0 ∈ F) (_hcard : 1 < F.card) :
    ∀ j, ∃ f ∈ F, f ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ z : ℤ,
      groupedTileDirections F j = z • f
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  let v := pairToPlane ((groupedDirectionPairs F).orderEmbOfFin rfl j)
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hp⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (groupedTileDirection_key_mem j)
  have hfne : f ≠ 0 := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hf
  have hfv : canonicalDirection f = v := planeToPair_injective hp
  have hdiv : vectorContent f ∣ groupedDirectionScale F v := by
    apply Finset.dvd_lcm
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hf, hfv⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hdiv
  have hdecomp : (vectorContent f : ℤ) • primitivePart f = f :=
    (primitive_decomposition hfne).1
  have hgroup : groupedTileDirections F j =
      (groupedDirectionScale F v : ℤ) • v := by rfl
  by_cases horient :
      (primitivePart f) 0 < 0 ∨
        ((primitivePart f) 0 = 0 ∧ (primitivePart f) 1 < 0)
  · refine ⟨f, (Finset.mem_erase.mp hf).2, hfne, -(c : ℤ), ?_⟩
    calc
      groupedTileDirections F j =
          ((vectorContent f * c : ℕ) : ℤ) • (-primitivePart f) := by
        rw [hgroup, hc, ← hfv, canonicalDirection, if_pos horient]
      _ = -(c : ℤ) • ((vectorContent f : ℤ) • primitivePart f) := by
        norm_cast
        module
      _ = -(c : ℤ) • f := by rw [hdecomp]
  · refine ⟨f, (Finset.mem_erase.mp hf).2, hfne, (c : ℤ), ?_⟩
    calc
      groupedTileDirections F j =
          ((vectorContent f * c : ℕ) : ℤ) • primitivePart f := by
        rw [hgroup, hc, ← hfv, canonicalDirection, if_neg horient]
      _ = (c : ℤ) • ((vectorContent f : ℤ) • primitivePart f) := by
        norm_cast
        module
      _ = (c : ℤ) • f := by rw [hdecomp]

name: TranslationalTilings.directionAvoidanceLCM_pos
statement:
theorem directionAvoidanceLCM_pos
    {h : Fin m → Plane} (hne : ∀ j, h j ≠ 0) :
    0 < directionAvoidanceLCM h
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
  intro hzero
  rw [directionAvoidanceLCM, Finset.lcm_eq_zero_iff] at hzero
  obtain ⟨j, _hj, hw⟩ := hzero
  have hav := avoidanceVector_spec hne
  have hwne : wedge (avoidanceVector h) (h j) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hwzero
    exact hav.2.1 j
      ((commensurable_iff_wedge_eq_zero hav.1 (hne j)).2 hwzero)
  exact Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hwne hw

name: TranslationalTilings.directionAvoidanceLCM_bound
statement:
theorem directionAvoidanceLCM_bound
    {h : Fin m → Plane} (hne : ∀ j, h j ≠ 0) :
    directionAvoidanceLCM h ≤
      (m + 1) ^ m * ∏ j, l1Norm (h j)
proof:
:= by
  have hav := avoidanceVector_spec hne
  have hprodpos :
      0 < ∏ j : Fin m, Int.natAbs (wedge (avoidanceVector h) (h j)) := by
    apply Finset.prod_pos
    intro j _
    apply Int.natAbs_pos.mpr
    intro hw
    exact hav.2.1 j
      ((commensurable_iff_wedge_eq_zero hav.1 (hne j)).2 hw)
  calc
    directionAvoidanceLCM h ≤
        ∏ j : Fin m, Int.natAbs (wedge (avoidanceVector h) (h j)) := by
      apply Nat.le_of_dvd hprodpos
      exact Finset.lcm_dvd_prod Finset.univ _
    _ ≤ ∏ j : Fin m, ((m + 1) * l1Norm (h j)) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod'
      intro j _
      calc
        Int.natAbs (wedge (avoidanceVector h) (h j)) ≤
            l1Norm (avoidanceVector h) * l1Norm (h j) :=
          natAbs_wedge_le_l1Norm_mul_l1Norm _ _
        _ ≤ (m + 1) * l1Norm (h j) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hav.2.2
    _ = (m + 1) ^ m * ∏ j, l1Norm (h j) := by
      show (Finset.univ.prod fun j : Fin m ↦
        (m + 1) * l1Norm (h j)) = _
      rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      simp

name: TranslationalTilings.universalRigidityPeriod_pos'
statement:
private theorem universalRigidityPeriod_pos' (d : ℕ) :
    0 < universalRigidityPeriod d
proof:
:= by
  rw [universalRigidityPeriod, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
  intro hzero
  rw [Finset.lcm_eq_zero_iff] at hzero
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqzero⟩ := hzero
  simp only [id_eq] at hqzero
  have hqone := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hq).1
  omega

name: TranslationalTilings.weakRigidityPeriod_pos
statement:
theorem weakRigidityPeriod_pos (directionCount : ℕ) :
    0 < weakRigidityPeriod directionCount
proof:
:= by
  rw [weakRigidityPeriod, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
  intro hzero
  rw [Finset.lcm_eq_zero_iff] at hzero
  obtain ⟨d, _hd, hdzero⟩ := hzero
  exact (Nat.ne_of_gt (universalRigidityPeriod_pos' d)) hdzero

name: TranslationalTilings.universalRigidityPeriod_dvd_weak
statement:
theorem universalRigidityPeriod_dvd_weak
    {d directionCount : ℕ} (hd : d ≤ directionCount) :
    universalRigidityPeriod d ∣ weakRigidityPeriod directionCount
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.dvd_lcm
  simp
  omega

name: TranslationalTilings.weakRigidityPeriod_dvd_of_le
statement:
theorem weakRigidityPeriod_dvd_of_le
    {m c : ℕ} (hmc : m ≤ c) :
    weakRigidityPeriod m ∣ weakRigidityPeriod c
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.lcm_dvd
  intro d hd
  apply Finset.dvd_lcm
  simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hd ⊢
  omega

name: TranslationalTilings.weakQ_divisibility
statement:
theorem weakQ_divisibility {F : Finset Plane} {ell : ℕ} (_hell : 0 < ell) :
    ell ∣ weakQ F ell
proof:
:= by
  exact ell_dvd_dilationModulus ell 1 F.card

name: TranslationalTilings.weakQ_quotient_bound
statement:
theorem weakQ_quotient_bound
    {F : Finset Plane} {ell : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) :
    weakQ F ell / ell ≤ 4 ^ (2 * F.card)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := weakQ_divisibility (F := F) hell
  have hq := grouped_q_bound (ell := ell) (F := F)
  change indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card = ell * r at hr
  change indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card / ell ≤ _
  rw [hr] at hq ⊢
  simpa [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left r hell] using
    (Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hq hell)

name: TranslationalTilings.l1Diameter_pos_of_one_lt_card
statement:
private theorem l1Diameter_pos_of_one_lt_card {F : Finset Plane}
    (hcard : 1 < F.card) : 0 < l1Diameter F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp hcard
  have hnorm : 0 < l1Norm (x - y) := by
    rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
    intro hzero
    exact hxy (sub_eq_zero.mp (l1Norm_eq_zero.mp hzero))
  exact hnorm.trans_le
    (Finset.le_sup (f := fun zw : Plane × Plane ↦ l1Norm (zw.1 - zw.2))
      (show (x, y) ∈ F ×ˢ F by simp [hx, hy]))

name: TranslationalTilings.weakN_bound
statement:
theorem weakN_bound
    {F : Finset Plane} {A E : Set Plane} {ell : ℕ}
    (D : GroupedStructureDecomposition F A E ell 1) :
    weakN D.direction ≤ l1Diameter F ^ ((F.card - 1) * (F.card - 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hmle := D.number_le
  have hmpos := D.number_pos
  have hm1 : D.numberOfDirections - 1 ≤ F.card - 2 := by omega
  calc
    weakN D.direction ≤
        ∏ i, l1Norm (D.direction i) ^ (D.numberOfDirections - 1) :=
      pairWedgeLCM_bound D.direction_ne_zero D.pairwise_incommensurable
    _ = (∏ i, l1Norm (D.direction i)) ^ (D.numberOfDirections - 1) := by
      rw [Finset.prod_pow]
    _ ≤ (l1Diameter F ^ (F.card - 1)) ^
        (D.numberOfDirections - 1) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_left D.product_direction_l1_bound _
    _ = l1Diameter F ^ ((F.card - 1) * (D.numberOfDirections - 1)) := by
      rw [pow_mul]
    _ ≤ l1Diameter F ^ ((F.card - 1) * (F.card - 2)) := by
      apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right
      · apply l1Diameter_pos_of_one_lt_card
        omega
      · exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hm1

name: TranslationalTilings.weakM_bound
statement:
theorem weakM_bound
    {F : Finset Plane} {A E : Set Plane} {ell : ℕ}
    (D : GroupedStructureDecomposition F A E ell 1) :
    weakM D.direction ≤ (F.card + 1) ^ F.card *
      l1Diameter F ^ (F.card - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hmle := D.number_le
  have hmpos := D.number_pos
  have hmc : D.numberOfDirections ≤ F.card := by omega
  have hpow :
      (D.numberOfDirections + 1) ^ D.numberOfDirections ≤
        (F.card + 1) ^ F.card := by
    exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) _).trans
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by positivity) hmc)
  calc
    weakM D.direction ≤
        (D.numberOfDirections + 1) ^ D.numberOfDirections *
          ∏ j, l1Norm (D.direction j) :=
      directionAvoidanceLCM_bound D.direction_ne_zero
    _ ≤ (F.card + 1) ^ F.card * ∏ j, l1Norm (D.direction j) := by
      gcongr
    _ ≤ (F.card + 1) ^ F.card *
        l1Diameter F ^ (F.card - 1) := by
      gcongr
      exact D.product_direction_l1_bound

name: TranslationalTilings.weakLattice_le_scalar
statement:
theorem weakLattice_le_scalar
    {F : Finset Plane} {A E : Set Plane} {ell : ℕ}
    (D : GroupedStructureDecomposition F A E ell 1) (hell : 0 < ell) :
    weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos ≤ scalarLattice ell
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := weakQ_divisibility (F := F) hell
  rw [weakLattice, generatedPair]
  apply (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).2
  intro x hx
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
  rcases hx with rfl | rfl
  · refine ⟨(r * weakN D.direction) • weakAvoidance D.direction, ?_⟩
    change ell • ((r * weakN D.direction) • weakAvoidance D.direction) =
      weakSliceVector F ell D.direction
    rw [weakSliceVector, hr]
    norm_cast
    module
  · refine ⟨(r * weakN D.direction * weakM D.direction) •
      D.direction ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩, ?_⟩
    change ell • ((r * weakN D.direction * weakM D.direction) •
        D.direction ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩) =
      ((weakQ F ell * weakN D.direction * weakM D.direction : ℕ) : ℤ) •
        D.direction ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩
    rw [hr]
    norm_cast
    module

name: TranslationalTilings.weak_supremumOnePeriod_mem
statement:
private theorem weak_supremumOnePeriod_mem
    {F : Finset Plane} {A E : Set Plane} {ell : ℕ}
    (D : GroupedStructureDecomposition F A E ell 1) : ∀ j,
    ((weakM D.direction ^ 2 * weakN D.direction * weakQ F ell : ℕ) : ℤ) •
      D.direction j ∈ weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  let a := weakAvoidance D.direction
  let h0 := D.direction ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩
  let q := weakQ F ell
  let N := weakN D.direction
  let M := weakM D.direction
  have hMdivNat : Int.natAbs (wedge a h0) ∣ M := by
    change Int.natAbs (wedge a h0) ∣ directionAvoidanceLCM D.direction
    unfold directionAvoidanceLCM
    apply Finset.dvd_lcm
    exact Finset.mem_univ _
  have hMdivInt : wedge a h0 ∣ (M : ℤ) := by
    rw [← Int.natAbs_dvd]
    exact_mod_cast hMdivNat
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hMdivInt
  have ha_mem : ((q * N : ℕ) : ℤ) • a ∈
      weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos := by
    apply AddSubgroup.subset_closure
    left
    rfl
  have hh0_mem : ((q * N * M : ℕ) : ℤ) • h0 ∈
      weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos := by
    apply AddSubgroup.subset_closure
    right
    rfl
  have hid := cramer_identity a h0 (D.direction j)
  have heq :
      ((M ^ 2 * N * q : ℕ) : ℤ) • D.direction j =
        (r * (M : ℤ) * wedge (D.direction j) h0) •
            (((q * N : ℕ) : ℤ) • a) +
          (r * wedge a (D.direction j)) •
            (((q * N * M : ℕ) : ℤ) • h0) := by
    have hr' : (M : ℤ) = wedge a h0 * r := hr
    calc
      ((M ^ 2 * N * q : ℕ) : ℤ) • D.direction j =
          ((M : ℤ) * r * (N : ℤ) * (q : ℤ)) •
            (wedge a h0 • D.direction j) := by
        simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow]
        rw [hr']
        module
      _ = ((M : ℤ) * r * (N : ℤ) * (q : ℤ)) •
          (wedge (D.direction j) h0 • a +
            wedge a (D.direction j) • h0) := by rw [hid]
      _ = (r * (M : ℤ) * wedge (D.direction j) h0) •
            (((q * N : ℕ) : ℤ) • a) +
          (r * wedge a (D.direction j)) •
            (((q * N * M : ℕ) : ℤ) • h0) := by
        norm_cast
        module
  rw [heq]
  exact (weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos).add_mem
    ((weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos).zsmul_mem ha_mem _)
    ((weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos).zsmul_mem hh0_mem _)

name: TranslationalTilings.weak_rigidityBranchPeriod_mem
statement:
private theorem weak_rigidityBranchPeriod_mem
    {F : Finset Plane} {A E : Set Plane} {ell : ℕ}
    (D : GroupedStructureDecomposition F A E ell 1) :
    ((weakRigidityPeriod D.numberOfDirections * weakM D.direction *
      weakN D.direction * weakQ F ell : ℕ) : ℤ) •
        D.direction ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩ ∈
      weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos
proof:
:= by
  have hgen :
      ((weakQ F ell * weakN D.direction * weakM D.direction : ℕ) : ℤ) •
          D.direction ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩ ∈
        weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos := by
    apply AddSubgroup.subset_closure
    right
    rfl
  have hz := (weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos).zsmul_mem hgen
    (weakRigidityPeriod D.numberOfDirections : ℤ)
  convert hz using 1
  norm_cast
  module

name: TranslationalTilings.weak_advertisedPeriod_mem
statement:
private theorem weak_advertisedPeriod_mem
    {F : Finset Plane} {A E : Set Plane} {ell : ℕ}
    (D : GroupedStructureDecomposition F A E ell 1) : ∀ j,
    ((weakRigidityPeriod D.numberOfDirections * weakM D.direction ^ 2 *
      weakN D.direction * weakQ F ell : ℕ) : ℤ) • D.direction j ∈
      weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  have hz := (weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos).zsmul_mem
    (weak_supremumOnePeriod_mem D j)
    (weakRigidityPeriod D.numberOfDirections : ℤ)
  convert hz using 1
  norm_cast
  module

name: TranslationalTilings.weakMultiplier_pos
statement:
theorem weakMultiplier_pos
    {F : Finset Plane} {A E : Set Plane} {ell : ℕ}
    (D : GroupedStructureDecomposition F A E ell 1) (hell : 0 < ell) :
    0 < weakMultiplier F ell D.direction
proof:
:= by
  have hqpos : 0 < weakQ F ell := by
    simpa [weakQ, indicatorDilationModulus] using
      dilationModulus_pos (oscillation := 1) (tileCard := F.card) hell
  have hqdiv := weakQ_divisibility (F := F) hell
  have hquot : 0 < weakQ F ell / ell := by
    exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hqpos hqdiv) hell
  exact Nat.mul_pos
    (Nat.mul_pos
      (Nat.mul_pos (weakRigidityPeriod_pos D.numberOfDirections)
        (pow_pos (directionAvoidanceLCM_pos D.direction_ne_zero) _))
      (pairWedgeLCM_pos D.direction_ne_zero D.pairwise_incommensurable))
    hquot

name: TranslationalTilings.weakMultiplier_bound
statement:
theorem weakMultiplier_bound
    {F : Finset Plane} {A E : Set Plane} {ell : ℕ}
    (D : GroupedStructureDecomposition F A E ell 1) (hell : 0 < ell) :
    weakMultiplier F ell D.direction ≤
      weakPeriodMultiplierBound F.card (l1Diameter F)
proof:
:= by
  let c := F.card
  let diam := l1Diameter F
  have hmle := D.number_le
  have hmpos := D.number_pos
  have hc2 : 2 ≤ c := by omega
  have hdiam : 0 < diam := l1Diameter_pos_of_one_lt_card (by omega)
  have hQdvd : weakRigidityPeriod D.numberOfDirections ∣ weakRigidityPeriod c :=
    weakRigidityPeriod_dvd_of_le (by omega)
  have hQ : weakRigidityPeriod D.numberOfDirections ≤ weakRigidityPeriod c :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd (weakRigidityPeriod_pos c) hQdvd
  have hM := weakM_bound D
  have hN := weakN_bound D
  have hq := weakQ_quotient_bound (F := F) hell
  have hmain : weakMultiplier F ell D.direction ≤
      weakRigidityPeriod c *
        ((c + 1) ^ c * diam ^ (c - 1)) ^ 2 *
        diam ^ ((c - 1) * (c - 2)) * 4 ^ (2 * c) := by
    unfold weakMultiplier
    dsimp [c, diam] at hM hN hq ⊢
    calc
      weakRigidityPeriod D.numberOfDirections * weakM D.direction ^ 2 *
          weakN D.direction * (weakQ F ell / ell) ≤
        weakRigidityPeriod c * weakM D.direction ^ 2 *
          weakN D.direction * (weakQ F ell / ell) := by gcongr
      _ ≤ weakRigidityPeriod c *
          ((F.card + 1) ^ F.card * l1Diameter F ^ (F.card - 1)) ^ 2 *
          weakN D.direction * (weakQ F ell / ell) := by gcongr
      _ ≤ weakRigidityPeriod c *
          ((F.card + 1) ^ F.card * l1Diameter F ^ (F.card - 1)) ^ 2 *
          l1Diameter F ^ ((F.card - 1) * (F.card - 2)) *
          (weakQ F ell / ell) := by gcongr
      _ ≤ weakRigidityPeriod c *
          ((F.card + 1) ^ F.card * l1Diameter F ^ (F.card - 1)) ^ 2 *
          l1Diameter F ^ ((F.card - 1) * (F.card - 2)) *
          4 ^ (2 * F.card) := by gcongr
  calc
    weakMultiplier F ell D.direction ≤
        weakRigidityPeriod c *
          ((c + 1) ^ c * diam ^ (c - 1)) ^ 2 *
          diam ^ ((c - 1) * (c - 2)) * 4 ^ (2 * c) := hmain
    _ = weakRigidityPeriod c * (c + 1) ^ (2 * c) * 4 ^ (2 * c) *
        diam ^ (c * (c - 1)) := by
      rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul]
      have hcExp : c * 2 = 2 * c := by omega
      have hdiamPow :
          diam ^ ((c - 1) * 2) * diam ^ ((c - 1) * (c - 2)) =
            diam ^ (c * (c - 1)) := by
        rw [← pow_add]
        congr 1
        calc
          (c - 1) * 2 + (c - 1) * (c - 2) =
              (c - 1) * (2 + (c - 2)) := by ring
          _ = (c - 1) * c := by
            congr 1
            omega
          _ = c * (c - 1) := Nat.mul_comm _ _
      rw [hcExp]
      calc
        weakRigidityPeriod c *
              ((c + 1) ^ (2 * c) * diam ^ ((c - 1) * 2)) *
              diam ^ ((c - 1) * (c - 2)) * 4 ^ (2 * c) =
            weakRigidityPeriod c * (c + 1) ^ (2 * c) * 4 ^ (2 * c) *
              (diam ^ ((c - 1) * 2) *
                diam ^ ((c - 1) * (c - 2))) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hdiamPow]
    _ = weakPeriodMultiplierConstant c * diam ^ (c * (c - 1)) := by rfl
    _ ≤ weakPeriodMultiplierConstant c *
        max 1 (diam ^ (c * (c - 1))) := by
      gcongr
      exact le_max_right _ _
    _ = weakPeriodMultiplierBound F.card (l1Diameter F) := by rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.weakLattice_relativeIndex_bound
statement:
theorem weakLattice_relativeIndex_bound
    {F : Finset Plane} {A E : Set Plane} {ell : ℕ}
    (D : GroupedStructureDecomposition F A E ell 1) (hell : 0 < ell) :
    (weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos).relIndex (scalarLattice ell) ≤
      weakPeriodIndexBound F.card (l1Diameter F)
proof:
:= by
  let c := F.card
  let diam := l1Diameter F
  let q := weakQ F ell
  let N := weakN D.direction
  let M := weakM D.direction
  let a := weakAvoidance D.direction
  let h0 := D.direction ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩
  have hmle := D.number_le
  have hmpos := D.number_pos
  have hc2 : 2 ≤ c := by omega
  have hdiam : 0 < diam := l1Diameter_pos_of_one_lt_card (by omega)
  have hqpos : 0 < q := by
    simpa [q, weakQ, indicatorDilationModulus] using
      dilationModulus_pos (oscillation := 1) (tileCard := F.card) hell
  have hNpos : 0 < N :=
    pairWedgeLCM_pos D.direction_ne_zero D.pairwise_incommensurable
  have hMpos : 0 < M := directionAvoidanceLCM_pos D.direction_ne_zero
  have haSpec := avoidanceVector_spec D.direction_ne_zero
  have hw0 : wedge a h0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hw
    exact haSpec.2.1 ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩
      ((commensurable_iff_wedge_eq_zero haSpec.1
        (D.direction_ne_zero ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩)).2 hw)
  have hdet :
      wedge (weakSliceVector F ell D.direction)
        (((q * N * M : ℕ) : ℤ) • h0) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [weakSliceVector, wedge_zsmul_left, wedge_zsmul_right]
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.mul_pos hqpos hNpos)))
      (mul_ne_zero
        (by exact_mod_cast
          (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos hqpos hNpos) hMpos)))
        hw0)
  have hindex :
      (weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos).index =
        q ^ 2 * N ^ 2 * M * Int.natAbs (wedge a h0) := by
    rw [weakLattice, index_generatedPair hdet]
    simp only [weakSliceVector, wedge_zsmul_left, wedge_zsmul_right,
      Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_natCast]
    dsimp [q, N, M, a, h0]
    ring
  have hlattice := weakLattice_le_scalar D hell
  have hrelIndex := AddSubgroup.relIndex_mul_index hlattice
  rw [scalarLattice_index, hindex] at hrelIndex
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := weakQ_divisibility (F := F) hell
  change q = ell * r at hr
  have hrelEq :
      (weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos).relIndex
          (scalarLattice ell) =
        r ^ 2 * N ^ 2 * M * Int.natAbs (wedge a h0) := by
    apply Nat.mul_right_cancel (pow_pos hell 2)
    calc
      (weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos).relIndex
            (scalarLattice ell) * ell ^ 2 =
          q ^ 2 * N ^ 2 * M * Int.natAbs (wedge a h0) := hrelIndex
      _ = (r ^ 2 * N ^ 2 * M * Int.natAbs (wedge a h0)) * ell ^ 2 := by
        rw [hr, mul_pow]
        ring
  have hrBound : r ≤ 4 ^ (2 * c) := by
    have hqBound := weakQ_quotient_bound (F := F) hell
    change q / ell ≤ 4 ^ (2 * c) at hqBound
    rw [hr, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left r hell] at hqBound
    exact hqBound
  have hNBound : N ≤ diam ^ ((c - 1) * (c - 2)) := weakN_bound D
  have hMBound : M ≤ (c + 1) ^ c * diam ^ (c - 1) := weakM_bound D
  have hnorm0 : l1Norm h0 ≤ ∏ j, l1Norm (D.direction j) := by
    dsimp [h0]
    have hs := Finset.single_le_prod'
      (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin D.numberOfDirections)))
      (f := fun j ↦ l1Norm (D.direction j))
      (a := ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩) (fun j _ ↦ by
        rw [Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero]
        intro hzero
        exact D.direction_ne_zero j (l1Norm_eq_zero.mp hzero))
      (Finset.mem_univ _)
    simpa using hs
  have hwBound : Int.natAbs (wedge a h0) ≤
      (c + 1) * diam ^ (c - 1) := by
    calc
      Int.natAbs (wedge a h0) ≤ l1Norm a * l1Norm h0 :=
        natAbs_wedge_le_l1Norm_mul_l1Norm _ _
      _ ≤ (D.numberOfDirections + 1) * l1Norm h0 := by
        gcongr
        exact haSpec.2.2
      _ ≤ (c + 1) * (∏ j, l1Norm (D.direction j)) := by
        gcongr
        omega
      _ ≤ (c + 1) * diam ^ (c - 1) := by
        gcongr
        exact D.product_direction_l1_bound
  have hraw :
      (weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos).relIndex
          (scalarLattice ell) ≤
        (4 ^ (2 * c)) ^ 2 *
          (diam ^ ((c - 1) * (c - 2))) ^ 2 *
          ((c + 1) ^ c * diam ^ (c - 1)) *
          ((c + 1) * diam ^ (c - 1)) := by
    rw [hrelEq]
    gcongr
  have hconst : (4 ^ (2 * c)) ^ 2 = 4 ^ (4 * c) := by
    rw [← pow_mul]
    congr 1
    omega
  have hcconst : (c + 1) ^ c * (c + 1) = (c + 1) ^ (c + 1) := by
    rw [pow_succ]
  have hdexp :
      ((c - 1) * (c - 2)) * 2 + (c - 1) + (c - 1) =
        2 * (c - 1) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ((c - 1) * (c - 2)) * 2 + (c - 1) + (c - 1) =
          2 * (c - 1) * ((c - 2) + 1) := by ring
      _ = 2 * (c - 1) * (c - 1) := by
        congr 2
        omega
      _ = 2 * (c - 1) ^ 2 := by ring
  have hclosed :
      (4 ^ (2 * c)) ^ 2 *
          (diam ^ ((c - 1) * (c - 2))) ^ 2 *
          ((c + 1) ^ c * diam ^ (c - 1)) *
          ((c + 1) * diam ^ (c - 1)) =
        weakPeriodIndexConstant c * diam ^ (2 * (c - 1) ^ 2) := by
    rw [hconst, ← pow_mul]
    calc
      4 ^ (4 * c) * diam ^ (((c - 1) * (c - 2)) * 2) *
            ((c + 1) ^ c * diam ^ (c - 1)) *
            ((c + 1) * diam ^ (c - 1)) =
          4 ^ (4 * c) * ((c + 1) ^ c * (c + 1)) *
            (diam ^ (((c - 1) * (c - 2)) * 2) *
              diam ^ (c - 1) * diam ^ (c - 1)) := by ring
      _ = 4 ^ (4 * c) * (c + 1) ^ (c + 1) *
          diam ^ (2 * (c - 1) ^ 2) := by
        rw [hcconst, ← pow_add, ← pow_add, hdexp]
      _ = weakPeriodIndexConstant c * diam ^ (2 * (c - 1) ^ 2) := rfl
  calc
    (weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos).relIndex
        (scalarLattice ell) ≤ _ := hraw
    _ = weakPeriodIndexConstant c * diam ^ (2 * (c - 1) ^ 2) := hclosed
    _ ≤ weakPeriodIndexConstant c *
        max 1 (diam ^ (2 * (c - 1) ^ 2)) := by
      gcongr
      exact le_max_right _ _
    _ = weakPeriodIndexBound F.card (l1Diameter F) := by rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.weak_period_mem_lattice
statement:
theorem weak_period_mem_lattice
    {F : Finset Plane} {A E : Set Plane} {ell : ℕ}
    (D : GroupedStructureDecomposition F A E ell 1) (hell : 0 < ell) :
    ∀ j, ((ell * weakMultiplier F ell D.direction : ℕ) : ℤ) • D.direction j ∈
      weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  have hqdiv := weakQ_divisibility (F := F) hell
  have hfactor :
      ell * weakMultiplier F ell D.direction =
        weakRigidityPeriod D.numberOfDirections * weakM D.direction ^ 2 *
          weakN D.direction * weakQ F ell := by
    rw [weakMultiplier]
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hqdiv
    change weakQ F ell = ell * r at hr
    rw [hr, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left r hell]
    ring
  rw [hfactor]
  exact weak_advertisedPeriod_mem D j

name: TranslationalTilings.exists_weakArithmeticData
statement:
theorem exists_weakArithmeticData
    {F : Finset Plane} {A E : Set Plane} {ell : ℕ}
    (D : GroupedStructureDecomposition F A E ell 1) (hell : 0 < ell) :
    Nonempty (WeakArithmeticData F ell D.direction D.number_pos)
proof:
:= by
  have hqpos : 0 < weakQ F ell := by
    simpa [weakQ, indicatorDilationModulus] using
      dilationModulus_pos (oscillation := 1) (tileCard := F.card) hell
  have hfactor :
      ell * weakMultiplier F ell D.direction =
        weakRigidityPeriod D.numberOfDirections * weakM D.direction ^ 2 *
          weakN D.direction * weakQ F ell := by
    rw [weakMultiplier]
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := weakQ_divisibility (F := F) hell
    change weakQ F ell = ell * r at hr
    rw [hr, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left r hell]
    ring
  exact ⟨{
    lattice := weakLattice F ell D.direction D.number_pos
    multiplier := weakMultiplier F ell D.direction
    lattice_eq := rfl
    multiplier_eq := rfl
