name: TranslationalTilings.slicingAverage_mem_Icc
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (n : ℕ) :
      ((setIndicator A
        (y - f - (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀))) : ℤ) : ℝ) ∈
        Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := real_indicator_mem_Icc A _
  have hsumNonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      ((setIndicator A
        (y - f - (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀))) : ℤ) : ℝ) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun n _ ↦ (hterm n).1
  have hsumUpper : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      ((setIndicator A
        (y - f - (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀))) : ℤ) : ℝ)) ≤
      (((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    simpa using Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul (Finset.range (N + 1))
      (fun n ↦ ((setIndicator A
        (y - f - (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀))) : ℤ) : ℝ)) 1
      (fun n _ ↦ (hterm n).2)
  have hdenom : (0 : ℝ) < ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  constructor
  · exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hdenom.le) hsumNonneg
  · rw [slicingAverage]
    calc
      ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
          ((setIndicator A
            (y - f - (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀))) : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤
          ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsumUpper (inv_nonneg.mpr hdenom.le)
      _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hdenom.ne'

name: TranslationalTilings.slicingAverage_sub_shift
statement:
private theorem slicingAverage_sub_shift (q k N : ℕ) (f f₀ : Plane)
    (A : Set Plane) (y : Plane) :
    slicingAverage q k N f f₀ A
        (y + (((q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀))) -
      slicingAverage q k N f f₀ A y =
      ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        (((setIndicator A
          (y + (((q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀)) - f) : ℤ) : ℝ) -
        ((setIndicator A
          (y - f - (((N * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀))) : ℤ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let d : Plane := (((q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀))
  have hstep (n : ℕ) :
      y + d - f - ((((n + 1) * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀)) =
        y - f - (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀)) := by
    dsimp [d]
    module
  rw [slicingAverage, slicingAverage, Finset.sum_range_succ',
    Finset.sum_range_succ]
  have hstep' (n : ℕ) :
      y + (((q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀)) - f -
          ((((n + 1) * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀)) =
        y - f - (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀)) := by
    simpa [d] using hstep n
  simp_rw [hstep']
  simp only [Nat.zero_mul, Nat.cast_zero, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  dsimp [d]
  change ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
      ((∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          ((setIndicator A
            (y - f - (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀))) : ℤ) : ℝ)) +
        ((setIndicator A (y + d - f) : ℤ) : ℝ)) -
      ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
      ((∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          ((setIndicator A
            (y - f - (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀))) : ℤ) : ℝ)) +
        ((setIndicator A
          (y - f - (((N * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀))) : ℤ) : ℝ)) = _
  dsimp [d]
  ring

name: TranslationalTilings.slicingAverage_shift_bound
statement:
private theorem slicingAverage_shift_bound (q k N : ℕ) (f f₀ : Plane)
    (A : Set Plane) (y : Plane) :
    |slicingAverage q k N f f₀ A
        (y + (((q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀))) -
      slicingAverage q k N f f₀ A y| ≤ ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [slicingAverage_sub_shift]
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity))]
  have hfirst := real_indicator_mem_Icc A
    (y + (((q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀)) - f)
  have hlast := real_indicator_mem_Icc A
    (y - f - (((N * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀)))
  have habs : |(((setIndicator A
      (y + (((q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀)) - f) : ℤ) : ℝ) -
      ((setIndicator A
        (y - f - (((N * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀))) : ℤ) : ℝ))| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [hfirst.1, hfirst.2, hlast.1, hlast.2]
  simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habs
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) by positivity))

name: TranslationalTilings.tileConv_dilate_apply_slicing
proof:
:= by
  unfold tileConv dilate
  rw [Finset.sum_image]
  intro a _ b _ hab
  apply_fun fun z i ↦ z i at hab
  funext i
  have hrz : (r : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hr)
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hrz (congrFun hab i)

name: TranslationalTilings.scalar_smul_mem_generated_of_wedge_dvd
statement:
private theorem scalar_smul_mem_generated_of_wedge_dvd
    {ell q k s : ℕ} {h d : Plane} (hellq : ell ∣ q)
    (_hwedge : wedge h d ≠ 0) (hdiv : Int.natAbs (wedge h d) ∣ s)
    (z : Plane) :
    (((q * k * s : ℕ) : ℤ) • z) ∈
      generatedPair ((((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h))
        ((((q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • d))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hellq
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hdiv
  let sign : ℤ := if 0 ≤ wedge h d then 1 else -1
  have habs : (Int.natAbs (wedge h d) : ℤ) = sign * wedge h d := by
    rw [Int.natCast_natAbs]
    by_cases hw : 0 ≤ wedge h d
    · simp [sign, hw, abs_of_nonneg hw]
    · have hw' : wedge h d ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hw
      simp [sign, hw, abs_of_nonpos hw']
  have hcramer := cramer_identity h d z
  have hhmem : (((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h) ∈
      generatedPair ((((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h))
        (((ell * a * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • d) :=
    AddSubgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  have hdmem : (((ell * a * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • d) ∈
      generatedPair ((((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h))
        (((ell * a * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • d) :=
    AddSubgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  have hcomb := (generatedPair ((((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h))
      (((ell * a * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • d)).add_mem
    ((generatedPair ((((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h))
      (((ell * a * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • d)).zsmul_mem hhmem
        (a * sign * c * wedge z d))
    ((generatedPair ((((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h))
      (((ell * a * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • d)).zsmul_mem hdmem
        (sign * c * wedge h z))
  convert hcomb using 1
  funext i
  have hc := congrFun hcramer i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hc ⊢
  push_cast at *
  rw [habs]
  linear_combination (ell * a * k * sign * c) * hc

name: TranslationalTilings.mem_directionSubgroup_of_wedge_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem mem_directionSubgroup_of_wedge_eq_zero {h d : Plane}
    (hh : IsPrimitive h) (hwedge : wedge h d = 0) : d ∈ directionSubgroup h
proof:
:= by
  have hgcd : Int.gcd (h 0) (h 1) = 1 := by
    have hcontent := hh.2
    rw [vectorContent,
      show (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)) = {0, 1} by decide] at hcontent
    simp only [Finset.gcd_insert, Finset.gcd_singleton, normalize_eq,
      gcd_eq_nat_gcd] at hcontent
    simpa only [Nat.gcd_zero_left, Int.gcd_eq_natAbs] using hcontent
  have hbezout : (1 : ℤ) =
      h 0 * Int.gcdA (h 0) (h 1) + h 1 * Int.gcdB (h 0) (h 1) := by
    rw [← Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab, hgcd]
    norm_num
  let c : ℤ := d 0 * Int.gcdA (h 0) (h 1) +
    d 1 * Int.gcdB (h 0) (h 1)
  rw [directionSubgroup, AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff]
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    dsimp [c]
    simp [wedge] at hwedge
    linear_combination -d 0 * hbezout + Int.gcdB (h 0) (h 1) * hwedge
  · simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    dsimp [c]
    simp [wedge] at hwedge
    linear_combination -d 1 * hbezout - Int.gcdA (h 0) (h 1) * hwedge

name: TranslationalTilings.slicing_lemma
statement:
theorem slicing_lemma
    {F : Finset Plane} {A : Set Plane} {ell k : ℕ} {h x : Plane}
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hk : 0 < k) (hh : IsPrimitive h)
    (hAperiod : Function.Periodic (setIndicator A)
      (((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h))
    (hconvperiod : ScalarPeriodic ell (tileConv F (setIndicator A))) :
    ScalarPeriodic
      (indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card * k * slicingLCM F h)
      (tileConv (tileSlice F h x) (setIndicator A))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := tileSlice F h x
  by_cases hS : S.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀⟩ := hS
    have hf₀F : f₀ ∈ F := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hf₀).1
    let q := indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card
    let s := slicingLCM F h
    have hqpos : 0 < q := dilationModulus_pos hell
    have hspos : 0 < s := slicingLCM_pos F h
    have hellq : ell ∣ q := ell_dvd_dilationModulus ell 1 F.card
    obtain ⟨a, hqa⟩ := hellq
    have hsample (n : ℕ) (y : Plane) :
        (∑ f ∈ F, ((setIndicator A
          (y - f - (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀))) : ℤ) : ℝ)) =
        ((tileConv F (setIndicator A) y : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      let r : ℕ := 1 + n * q * k
      have hr : 0 < r := by positivity
      have hrmod : Nat.ModEq q r 1 := by
        simpa [r, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_comm] using
          (Nat.ModEq.modulus_mul_add (m := q) (a := n * k) (b := 1))
      have hdilate := congrFun
        (dilation_indicator_periodic hell hconvperiod hr hrmod)
        (y + (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • f₀))
      rw [tileConv_dilate_apply_slicing r hr] at hdilate
      have hright : tileConv F (setIndicator A)
          (y + (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • f₀)) =
          tileConv F (setIndicator A) y := by
        have hp := hconvperiod y (((n * a * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • f₀)
        have hshift : (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • f₀) =
            ((ell : ℕ) : ℤ) • (((n * a * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • f₀) := by
          rw [hqa]
          push_cast
          module
        rw [hshift]
        exact hp
      rw [hright] at hdilate
      have hleft : (∑ f ∈ F, setIndicator A
          (y + (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • f₀) - (r : ℤ) • f)) =
          ∑ f ∈ F, setIndicator A
          (y - f - (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀))) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro f _
        congr 1
        dsimp [r]
        module
      rw [hleft] at hdilate
      exact_mod_cast hdilate
    have haverageIdentity (N : ℕ) (y : Plane) :
        (∑ f ∈ F, slicingAverage q k N f f₀ A y) =
          ((tileConv F (setIndicator A) y : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [show (∑ f ∈ F, slicingAverage q k N f f₀ A y) =
          ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
            ∑ f ∈ F, ((setIndicator A
              (y - f - (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f - f₀))) : ℤ) : ℝ) by
        unfold slicingAverage
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
        congr 1
        exact Finset.sum_comm]
      simp_rw [hsample]
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    let averageState : ℕ → (f : ↥F) → Plane → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
      fun N f y ↦ ⟨slicingAverage q k N f f₀ A y,
        slicingAverage_mem_Icc q k N f f₀ A y⟩
    obtain ⟨limit, _, subsequence, hsubsequence, hlimit⟩ :=
      (SeqCompactSpace.isSeqCompact_univ.subseq_of_frequently_in
        (x := averageState) (Filter.Frequently.of_forall fun _ ↦ Set.mem_univ _))
    let φ : ↥F → Plane → ℝ := fun f y ↦ limit f y
    have havgTend (f : ↥F) (y : Plane) :
        Filter.Tendsto
          (fun N ↦ slicingAverage q k (subsequence N) f f₀ A y)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (φ f y)) := by
      have hpoint := (hlimit.apply_nhds f).apply_nhds y
      have hval := (continuous_subtype_val.tendsto (limit f y)).comp hpoint
      simpa [averageState, φ, Function.comp_def] using hval
    have hinvTend : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun N ↦ (((subsequence N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have hsucc : Filter.Tendsto (fun N ↦ subsequence N + 1)
          Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
        have hstrict : StrictMono (fun N : ℕ ↦ subsequence N + 1) :=
          fun _ _ hlt ↦ Nat.add_lt_add_right (hsubsequence hlt) 1
        exact hstrict.tendsto_atTop
      exact tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp hsucc)
    have hφdirection (f : ↥F) :
        Function.Periodic (φ f)
          (((q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • ((f : Plane) - f₀)) := by
      intro y
      have hdiffLimit := (havgTend f
        (y + (((q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • ((f : Plane) - f₀)))).sub (havgTend f y)
      have hdiffZero : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun N ↦ slicingAverage q k (subsequence N) f f₀ A
              (y + (((q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • ((f : Plane) - f₀))) -
            slicingAverage q k (subsequence N) f f₀ A y)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
        apply squeeze_zero
        · exact fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _
        · intro N
          simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
            slicingAverage_shift_bound q k (subsequence N) (f : Plane) f₀ A y
        · simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hinvTend
      have hzero := tendsto_nhds_unique hdiffLimit hdiffZero
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzero
    have hφlongitudinal (f : ↥F) :
        Function.Periodic (φ f) (((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h) := by
      intro y
      have havgEq (N : ℕ) : slicingAverage q k N f f₀ A
          (y + (((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h)) =
          slicingAverage q k N f f₀ A y := by
        unfold slicingAverage
        congr 1
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro n _
        have hp := hAperiod
          (y - (f : Plane) - (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • ((f : Plane) - f₀)))
        rw [show y + (((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h) - (f : Plane) -
              (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • ((f : Plane) - f₀)) =
            (y - (f : Plane) - (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • ((f : Plane) - f₀))) +
              (((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h) by abel]
        exact_mod_cast hp
      have htend := havgTend f (y + (((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h))
      rw [funext fun N ↦ havgEq (subsequence N)] at htend
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique htend (havgTend f y)
    have hlimitSum (y : Plane) :
        (∑ f : ↥F, φ f y) = ((tileConv F (setIndicator A) y : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      have hsumTend : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun N ↦ ∑ f : ↥F,
            slicingAverage q k (subsequence N) f f₀ A y)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (∑ f : ↥F, φ f y)) := by
        exact tendsto_finsetSum Finset.univ fun f _ ↦ havgTend f y
      have hseq (N : ℕ) : (∑ f : ↥F,
          slicingAverage q k (subsequence N) f f₀ A y) =
          ((tileConv F (setIndicator A) y : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        rw [← haverageIdentity (subsequence N) y]
        simpa [Finset.univ_eq_attach F] using
          (Finset.sum_attach F (fun f ↦ slicingAverage q k (subsequence N) f f₀ A y))
      have hconst : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun _N : ℕ ↦ ((tileConv F (setIndicator A) y : ℤ) : ℝ))
          Filter.atTop (nhds ((tileConv F (setIndicator A) y : ℤ) : ℝ)) :=
        tendsto_const_nhds
      rw [funext hseq] at hsumTend
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique hsumTend hconst
    have hφslice (f : ↥F) (hfS : (f : Plane) ∈ S) (y : Plane) :
        φ f y = ((setIndicator A (y - (f : Plane)) : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      have hfCoset := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hfS).2
      have hf₀Coset := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hf₀).2
      have hdiffMem : (f : Plane) - f₀ ∈ directionSubgroup h := by
        have := (directionSubgroup h).sub_mem hfCoset hf₀Coset
        rw [show ((f : Plane) - x) - (f₀ - x) =
            (f : Plane) - f₀ by abel] at this
        exact this
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mp hdiffMem
      have havgConst (N : ℕ) : slicingAverage q k N f f₀ A y =
          ((setIndicator A (y - (f : Plane)) : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        unfold slicingAverage
        have hterm (n : ℕ) : setIndicator A
            (y - (f : Plane) -
              (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • ((f : Plane) - f₀))) =
            setIndicator A (y - (f : Plane)) := by
          have hp := (hAperiod.zsmul (-(n * a * c)))
          have hshift : (((n * q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • ((f : Plane) - f₀)) =
              (n * a * c) • (((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h) := by
            rw [← hc, hqa]
            push_cast
            module
          rw [hshift]
          simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using hp (y - (f : Plane))
        simp_rw [hterm]
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
      have htend := havgTend f y
      rw [funext fun N ↦ havgConst (subsequence N)] at htend
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique htend tendsto_const_nhds
    have hwedgeOutside (f : ↥F) (hfS : (f : Plane) ∉ S) :
        wedge h ((f : Plane) - f₀) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hwedge
      have hdiffMem := mem_directionSubgroup_of_wedge_eq_zero hh hwedge
      apply hfS
      apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      refine ⟨f.property, ?_⟩
      have hf₀Coset := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hf₀).2
      have hmem := (directionSubgroup h).add_mem hdiffMem hf₀Coset
      change (f : Plane) - x ∈ directionSubgroup h
      rw [show ((f : Plane) - f₀) + (f₀ - x) =
          (f : Plane) - x by abel] at hmem
      exact hmem
    let M : ℕ := q * k * s
    have hφscalar (f : ↥F) (hfS : (f : Plane) ∉ S) :
        ScalarPeriodic M (φ f) := by
      intro y z
      have hwedge := hwedgeOutside f hfS
      have hdiv : Int.natAbs (wedge h ((f : Plane) - f₀)) ∣ s := by
        apply wedge_difference_dvd_slicingLCM f.property hf₀F hwedge
      have hmem := scalar_smul_mem_generated_of_wedge_dvd
        (ell := ell) (q := q) (k := k) (s := s) (h := h)
        (d := (f : Plane) - f₀) (by simp [hqa]) hwedge hdiv z
      let periods : AddSubgroup Plane := {
        carrier := {p | Function.Periodic (φ f) p}
        zero_mem' := Function.periodic_with_period_zero (φ f)
        add_mem' hp hp' := hp.add_period hp'
        neg_mem' hp := hp.neg
      }
      have hgenerated : generatedPair (((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h)
          (((q * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • ((f : Plane) - f₀)) ≤ periods := by
        rw [generatedPair, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
        intro p hp
        rcases hp with (rfl | rfl)
        · exact hφlongitudinal f
        · exact hφdirection f
      exact hgenerated hmem y
    let outside : Finset ↥F := Finset.univ.filter fun f ↦ (f : Plane) ∉ S
    let outsideSum : Plane → ℝ := fun y ↦ ∑ f ∈ outside, φ f y
    have houtsidePeriod : ScalarPeriodic M outsideSum := by
      intro y z
      unfold outsideSum
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro f hf
      exact hφscalar f (by simpa [outside] using hf) y z
    have htotalPeriod : ScalarPeriodic M
        (fun y ↦ ((tileConv F (setIndicator A) y : ℤ) : ℝ)) := by
      intro y z
      have hp := hconvperiod y (((a * k * s : ℕ) : ℤ) • z)
      change ((tileConv F (setIndicator A)
        (y + ((M : ℕ) : ℤ) • z) : ℤ) : ℝ) = _
      apply congrArg (fun t : ℤ ↦ (t : ℝ))
      have hshift : ((M : ℕ) : ℤ) • z =
          ((ell : ℕ) : ℤ) • (((a * k * s : ℕ) : ℤ) • z) := by
        dsimp [M]
        rw [hqa]
        push_cast
        module
      rw [hshift]
      exact hp
    have hsliceRelation (y : Plane) :
        ((tileConv S (setIndicator A) y : ℤ) : ℝ) =
          ((tileConv F (setIndicator A) y : ℤ) : ℝ) - outsideSum y := by
      rw [← hlimitSum y]
      unfold tileConv outsideSum outside
      push_cast
      have hpartition := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
        (Finset.univ : Finset ↥F) (fun f : ↥F ↦ (f : Plane) ∈ S) (fun f ↦ φ f y)
      rw [← hpartition, add_sub_cancel_right]
      apply Finset.sum_bij
          (fun f hf ↦ (⟨f, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hf).1⟩ : ↥F))
      · intro f hf
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        exact hf
      · intro f₁ hf₁ f₂ hf₂ heq
        exact congrArg Subtype.val heq
      · intro f hf
        refine ⟨(f : Plane), ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hf).2
        · rfl
      · intro f hf
        exact (hφslice ⟨f, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hf).1⟩ hf y).symm
    intro y z
    apply (Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ))
    change ((tileConv S (setIndicator A)
      (y + ((M : ℕ) : ℤ) • z) : ℤ) : ℝ) = _
    rw [hsliceRelation, hsliceRelation]
    have ht := htotalPeriod y z
    have ho := houtsidePeriod y z
    change ((tileConv F (setIndicator A) (y + ((M : ℕ) : ℤ) • z) : ℤ) : ℝ) =
      ((tileConv F (setIndicator A) y : ℤ) : ℝ) at ht
    change outsideSum (y + ((M : ℕ) : ℤ) • z) = outsideSum y at ho
    rw [ht, ho]
  · have hSempt : S = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hS
    rw [show tileSlice F h x = ∅ by simpa [S] using hSempt]
    intro y z
    simp [tileConv]

name: TranslationalTilings.lineOrbitBase_spec
statement:
private theorem lineOrbitBase_spec (M : ℕ) (h : Plane)
    (line : Plane ⧸ directionSubgroup h) :
    QuotientAddGroup.mk' (lineShiftSubgroup M h) (lineOrbitBase M h line) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk' (lineShiftSubgroup M h) line
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective (lineShiftSubgroup M h)
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (lineShiftSubgroup M h) line))

name: TranslationalTilings.exists_lineShift
statement:
private theorem exists_lineShift (M : ℕ) (h : Plane)
    (line : Plane ⧸ directionSubgroup h) :
    ∃ t : Plane, t ∈ scalarLattice M ∧
      lineQuotientMap h t = line - lineOrbitBase M h line
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : line - lineOrbitBase M h line ∈ lineShiftSubgroup M h := by
    exact QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.mp (lineOrbitBase_spec M h line).symm
  exact AddSubgroup.mem_map.mp (by simpa [lineShiftSubgroup] using hmem)

name: TranslationalTilings.lineShift_mem_scalarLattice
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_lineShift M h line)).1

name: TranslationalTilings.lineShift_spec
statement:
private theorem lineShift_spec (M : ℕ) (h : Plane)
    (line : Plane ⧸ directionSubgroup h) :
    lineQuotientMap h (lineShift M h line) =
      line - lineOrbitBase M h line
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_lineShift M h line)).2

name: TranslationalTilings.scalar_direction_intersection
statement:
private theorem scalar_direction_intersection {M : ℕ} {h t : Plane}
    (hh : IsPrimitive h) (htScalar : t ∈ scalarLattice M)
    (htDirection : t ∈ directionSubgroup h) :
    ∃ c : ℤ, t = c • (((M : ℕ) : ℤ) • h)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := htScalar
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mp htDirection
  have hgcd : Int.gcd (h 0) (h 1) = 1 := by
    have hcontent := hh.2
    rw [vectorContent,
      show (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)) = {0, 1} by decide] at hcontent
    simp only [Finset.gcd_insert, Finset.gcd_singleton, normalize_eq,
      gcd_eq_nat_gcd] at hcontent
    simpa only [Nat.gcd_zero_left, Int.gcd_eq_natAbs] using hcontent
  have hbezout : (1 : ℤ) =
      h 0 * Int.gcdA (h 0) (h 1) + h 1 * Int.gcdB (h 0) (h 1) := by
    rw [← Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab, hgcd]
    norm_num
  let b : ℤ := z 0 * Int.gcdA (h 0) (h 1) +
    z 1 * Int.gcdB (h 0) (h 1)
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  rw [← hc] at hz ⊢
  have hz0 := congrFun hz 0
  have hz1 := congrFun hz 1
  change (M : ℤ) * z 0 = c * h 0 at hz0
  change (M : ℤ) * z 1 = c * h 1 at hz1
  have hcb : c = (M : ℤ) * b := by
    dsimp [b]
    linear_combination c * hbezout -
      Int.gcdA (h 0) (h 1) * hz0 - Int.gcdB (h 0) (h 1) * hz1
  rw [hcb]
  module

name: TranslationalTilings.lineRepresentative_spec
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective (directionSubgroup h) line)

name: TranslationalTilings.setIndicator_eq_iff_membership
statement:
private theorem setIndicator_eq_iff_membership {G : Type*} (A : Set G) (u v : G) :
    setIndicator A u = setIndicator A v ↔ (u ∈ A ↔ v ∈ A)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hu : u ∈ A <;> by_cases hv : v ∈ A <;>
    simp [setIndicator, hu, hv]

name: TranslationalTilings.improve_onePeriodic
statement:
theorem improve_onePeriodic
    {F : Finset Plane} {A : Set Plane} {ell k : ℕ} {h : Plane}
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hk : 0 < k) (hh : IsPrimitive h)
    (hAperiod : Function.Periodic (setIndicator A)
      (((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h))
    (hconvperiod : ScalarPeriodic ell (tileConv F (setIndicator A))) :
    ∃ A' : Set Plane,
      SetScalarPeriodic
        (indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card * k * slicingLCM F h) A' ∧
      convolutionEquivalent F A A' ∧
      ∀ line : Plane ⧸ directionSubgroup h,
        convolutionEquivalent F (slicePattern h line A)
          (slicePattern h line A')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q := indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card
  let s := slicingLCM F h
  let M := q * k * s
  have hellq : ell ∣ q := ell_dvd_dilationModulus ell 1 F.card
  obtain ⟨a, hqa⟩ := hellq
  let A' := improvedSet M h A
  have hA'scalar : SetScalarPeriodic M A' := by
    intro y z
    let t : Plane := ((M : ℕ) : ℤ) • z
    let line₀ := lineQuotientMap h y
    let line₁ := lineQuotientMap h (y + t)
    have htScalar : t ∈ scalarLattice M := ⟨z, rfl⟩
    have hlineSub : line₁ - line₀ = lineQuotientMap h t := by
      simp [line₀, line₁, map_add]
    have hlineMapMem : lineQuotientMap h t ∈ lineShiftSubgroup M h := by
      exact AddSubgroup.mem_map.mpr ⟨t, htScalar, rfl⟩
    have horbitEq : QuotientAddGroup.mk' (lineShiftSubgroup M h) line₁ =
        QuotientAddGroup.mk' (lineShiftSubgroup M h) line₀ := by
      apply QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.mpr
      rw [hlineSub]
      exact hlineMapMem
    have hbaseEq : lineOrbitBase M h line₁ = lineOrbitBase M h line₀ := by
      exact congrArg (lineOrbitBaseOfClass M h) horbitEq
    let shift₀ := lineShift M h line₀
    let shift₁ := lineShift M h line₁
    let δ : Plane := shift₁ - shift₀ - t
    have hδScalar : δ ∈ scalarLattice M := by
      exact (scalarLattice M).sub_mem
        ((scalarLattice M).sub_mem
          (lineShift_mem_scalarLattice M h line₁)
          (lineShift_mem_scalarLattice M h line₀)) htScalar
    have hδDirection : δ ∈ directionSubgroup h := by
      rw [← QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff]
      change lineQuotientMap h δ = 0
      simp only [δ, map_sub]
      rw [lineShift_spec, lineShift_spec, hbaseEq, ← hlineSub]
      abel
    obtain ⟨c, hδ⟩ := scalar_direction_intersection hh hδScalar hδDirection
    have hMperiod : ((M : ℕ) : ℤ) • h =
        (a * s : ℤ) • (((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h) := by
      dsimp [M]
      rw [hqa]
      push_cast
      module
    have hδperiod : Function.Periodic (setIndicator A) δ := by
      rw [hδ, hMperiod]
      simpa only [mul_smul] using hAperiod.zsmul (c * (a * s))
    change y + ((M : ℕ) : ℤ) • z ∈ A' ↔ y ∈ A'
    change y + t - shift₁ ∈ A ↔ y - shift₀ ∈ A
    have harg : y + t - shift₁ = (y - shift₀) - δ := by
      dsimp [δ]
      abel
    rw [harg]
    exact (setIndicator_eq_iff_membership A _ _).mp
      (hδperiod.sub_eq (y - shift₀))
  have hsliceEquivalent (line : Plane ⧸ directionSubgroup h) :
      convolutionEquivalent F (slicePattern h line A) (slicePattern h line A') := by
    funext y
    let selected : Finset Plane := F.filter fun f ↦ lineQuotientMap h (y - f) = line
    let representative := lineRepresentative h line
    have hselectedTile : selected = tileSlice F h (y - representative) := by
      ext f
      simp only [selected, Finset.mem_filter, tileSlice]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hf, hline⟩
        refine ⟨hf, ?_⟩
        change f - (y - representative) ∈ directionSubgroup h
        have hquot : lineQuotientMap h (y - f) =
            lineQuotientMap h representative := by
          rw [hline, lineRepresentative_spec]
        have hmem := QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.mp hquot
        have hneg := (directionSubgroup h).neg_mem hmem
        simpa only [show f - (y - representative) =
            -(y - f - representative) by abel] using hneg
      · intro hf
        obtain ⟨hfF, hfCoset⟩ := hf
        refine ⟨hfF, ?_⟩
        rw [← lineRepresentative_spec h line]
        apply QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.mpr
        change (y - f) - representative ∈ directionSubgroup h
        have hneg := (directionSubgroup h).neg_mem hfCoset
        simpa only [show (y - f) - representative =
            -(f - (y - representative)) by abel] using hneg
    have hleft : tileConv F (setIndicator (slicePattern h line A)) y =
        tileConv selected (setIndicator A) y := by
      unfold tileConv
      dsimp only [selected]
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro f hf
      by_cases hline : lineQuotientMap h (y - f) = line
      · rw [if_pos hline]
        by_cases hmem : y - f ∈ A
        · have hslice : y - f ∈ slicePattern h line A :=
            (mem_slicePattern (y - f)).2 ⟨hmem, hline⟩
          simp only [setIndicator, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem,
            Set.indicator_of_mem hslice]
        · have hslice : y - f ∉ slicePattern h line A := fun hy ↦
            hmem ((mem_slicePattern (y - f)).1 hy).1
          simp only [setIndicator, Set.indicator_of_notMem hmem,
            Set.indicator_of_notMem hslice]
      · rw [if_neg hline]
        have hslice : y - f ∉ slicePattern h line A := fun hy ↦
          hline ((mem_slicePattern (y - f)).1 hy).2
        simp only [setIndicator, Set.indicator_of_notMem hslice]
    let t := lineShift M h line
    have htScalar := lineShift_mem_scalarLattice M h line
    obtain ⟨zt, hzt⟩ := htScalar
    have hterm (f : Plane) (hf : f ∈ selected) :
        setIndicator A' (y - f) = setIndicator A (y - t - f) := by
      have hline : lineQuotientMap h (y - f) = line :=
        (Finset.mem_filter.mp hf).2
      unfold A' improvedSet
      apply (setIndicator_eq_iff_membership A _ _).2
      change y - f - lineShift M h (lineQuotientMap h (y - f)) ∈ A ↔
        y - t - f ∈ A
      rw [hline]
      dsimp [t]
      abel_nf
    have hright : tileConv F (setIndicator (slicePattern h line A')) y =
        tileConv selected (setIndicator A) (y - t) := by
      unfold tileConv
      dsimp only [selected]
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro f hf
      by_cases hline : lineQuotientMap h (y - f) = line
      · have hfSelected : f ∈ selected := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hf, hline⟩
        rw [if_pos hline]
        have hsliceIndicator :
            setIndicator (slicePattern h line A') (y - f) =
              setIndicator A' (y - f) := by
          by_cases hmem : y - f ∈ A'
          · have hslice : y - f ∈ slicePattern h line A' :=
              (mem_slicePattern (y - f)).2 ⟨hmem, hline⟩
            simp only [setIndicator, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem,
              Set.indicator_of_mem hslice]
          · have hslice : y - f ∉ slicePattern h line A' := fun hy ↦
              hmem ((mem_slicePattern (y - f)).1 hy).1
            simp only [setIndicator, Set.indicator_of_notMem hmem,
              Set.indicator_of_notMem hslice]
        exact hsliceIndicator.trans (hterm f hfSelected)
      · rw [if_neg hline]
        have hslice : y - f ∉ slicePattern h line A' := fun hy ↦
          hline ((mem_slicePattern (y - f)).1 hy).2
        simp only [setIndicator, Set.indicator_of_notMem hslice]
    have hselectedPeriod : ScalarPeriodic M
        (tileConv selected (setIndicator A)) := by
      rw [hselectedTile]
      exact slicing_lemma hell hk hh hAperiod hconvperiod
    have hp := hselectedPeriod (y - t) zt
    have ht : ((M : ℕ) : ℤ) • zt = t := hzt
    rw [ht, sub_add_cancel] at hp
    rw [hleft, hright, hp]
  have hwholeEquivalent : convolutionEquivalent F A A' := by
    funext y
    let lines : Finset (Plane ⧸ directionSubgroup h) :=
      F.image fun f ↦ lineQuotientMap h (y - f)
    have hsumSlices (B : Set Plane) : tileConv F (setIndicator B) y =
        ∑ line ∈ lines, tileConv F (setIndicator (slicePattern h line B)) y := by
      unfold tileConv
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro f hf
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (lineQuotientMap h (y - f))]
      · have hsliceIndicator :
            setIndicator (slicePattern h (lineQuotientMap h (y - f)) B) (y - f) =
              setIndicator B (y - f) := by
          by_cases hmem : y - f ∈ B
          · have hslice : y - f ∈
                slicePattern h (lineQuotientMap h (y - f)) B :=
              (mem_slicePattern (y - f)).2 ⟨hmem, rfl⟩
            simp only [setIndicator, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem,
              Set.indicator_of_mem hslice]
          · have hslice : y - f ∉
                slicePattern h (lineQuotientMap h (y - f)) B := fun hy ↦
              hmem ((mem_slicePattern (y - f)).1 hy).1
            simp only [setIndicator, Set.indicator_of_notMem hmem,
              Set.indicator_of_notMem hslice]
        exact hsliceIndicator.symm
      · intro line hline hne
        have hnotSlice : y - f ∉ slicePattern h line B := fun hy ↦
          hne ((mem_slicePattern (y - f)).1 hy).2.symm
        simp only [setIndicator, Set.indicator_of_notMem hnotSlice]
      · intro hnot
        exact (hnot (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩)).elim
    rw [hsumSlices A, hsumSlices A']
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro line _
    exact congrFun (hsliceEquivalent line) y
  refine ⟨A', ?_, hwholeEquivalent, hsliceEquivalent⟩
  simpa [M, q, s] using hA'scalar

name: TranslationalTilings.boxPoint_natMod_add_ediv
statement:
private theorem boxPoint_natMod_add_ediv (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (x : Lattice d) :
    boxPoint (fun i ↦ ⟨(x i).natMod q, Int.natMod_lt hq.ne'⟩) +
        (q : ℤ) • (fun i ↦ x i / (q : ℤ)) = x
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp only [boxPoint, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Int.natMod, Int.toNat_of_nonneg]
  · exact Int.emod_add_mul_ediv (x i) q
  · exact Int.emod_nonneg _ (by exact_mod_cast hq.ne')

name: TranslationalTilings.PeriodicSetCode.memBool_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem PeriodicSetCode.memBool_eq_true_iff
    (C : PeriodicSetCode d) (x) :
    C.memBool x = true ↔ x ∈ C.toSet
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.PeriodicSetCode.toSet_scalarPeriodic
statement:
theorem PeriodicSetCode.toSet_scalarPeriodic (C : PeriodicSetCode d) :
    SetScalarPeriodic C.period C.toSet
proof:
:= by
  intro x z
  change C.memBool (x + (C.period : ℤ) • z) = true ↔ C.memBool x = true
  have hresidue :
      (fun i : Fin d ↦
        (⟨((x + (C.period : ℤ) • z) i).natMod C.period,
          Int.natMod_lt C.period_pos.ne'⟩ : Fin C.period)) =
      (fun i : Fin d ↦
        (⟨(x i).natMod C.period,
          Int.natMod_lt C.period_pos.ne'⟩ : Fin C.period)) := by
    funext i
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Int.natMod]
    rw [Int.add_emod]
    simp
  change C.bits _ = true ↔ C.bits _ = true
  rw [hresidue]

name: TranslationalTilings.encodePeriodicSet_toSet
statement:
theorem encodePeriodicSet_toSet
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (A : Set (Lattice d))
    (hA : SetScalarPeriodic q A) :
    (encodePeriodicSet q hq A).toSet = A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  let r : BoxResidue d q :=
    fun i ↦ ⟨(x i).natMod q, Int.natMod_lt hq.ne'⟩
  let z : Lattice d := fun i ↦ x i / (q : ℤ)
  have hx : boxPoint r + (q : ℤ) • z = x :=
    boxPoint_natMod_add_ediv q hq x
  change decide (boxPoint r ∈ A) = true ↔ x ∈ A
  rw [decide_eq_true_eq, ← hx]
  exact (hA (boxPoint r) z).symm

name: TranslationalTilings.PeriodicSetCode.pullbackTranslate_toSet
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  let r : BoxResidue d C.period :=
    fun i ↦ ⟨(x i).natMod C.period,
      Int.natMod_lt C.period_pos.ne'⟩
  let z : Lattice d := fun i ↦ x i / (C.period : ℤ)
  have hx : boxPoint r + (C.period : ℤ) • z = x :=
    boxPoint_natMod_add_ediv C.period C.period_pos x
  change boxPoint r + a ∈ C.toSet ↔ x + a ∈ C.toSet
  have hp := C.toSet_scalarPeriodic (boxPoint r + a) z
  convert hp.symm using 1
  rw [← hx]
  abel_nf

name: TranslationalTilings.LatticePeriodicSetCode.memBool_add_horizontal
statement:
private theorem LatticePeriodicSetCode.memBool_add_horizontal
    (C : LatticePeriodicSetCode) (x : Plane) :
    C.memBool (x + C.horizontalGenerator) = C.memBool x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LatticePeriodicSetCode.memBool,
    LatticePeriodicSetCode.horizontalGenerator, Pi.add_apply,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, add_zero]
  congr 2
  · simp only [Int.natMod]
    congr 1
    rw [show x 0 + (C.horizontalPeriod : ℤ) -
        x 1 / (C.verticalPeriod : ℤ) * C.shear =
      (x 0 - x 1 / (C.verticalPeriod : ℤ) * C.shear) +
        C.horizontalPeriod by ring]
    rw [Int.add_emod]
    simp

name: TranslationalTilings.LatticePeriodicSetCode.memBool_add_vertical
statement:
private theorem LatticePeriodicSetCode.memBool_add_vertical
    (C : LatticePeriodicSetCode) (x : Plane) :
    C.memBool (x + C.verticalGenerator) = C.memBool x
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (C.verticalPeriod : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast C.vertical_pos.ne'
  have hdiv :
      (x 1 + (C.verticalPeriod : ℤ)) / (C.verticalPeriod : ℤ) =
        x 1 / (C.verticalPeriod : ℤ) + 1 := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      Int.add_mul_ediv_right (x 1) 1 hc
  simp only [LatticePeriodicSetCode.memBool,
    LatticePeriodicSetCode.verticalGenerator, Pi.add_apply,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, hdiv]
  congr 2
  · simp only [Int.natMod]
    congr 1
    ring_nf
  · simp only [Int.natMod]
    congr 1
    rw [Int.add_emod]
    simp

name: TranslationalTilings.LatticePeriodicSetCode.toSet_periodic
statement:
theorem LatticePeriodicSetCode.toSet_periodic
    (C : LatticePeriodicSetCode) :
    SetPeriodicOn C.periodLattice C.toSet
proof:
:= by
  intro h hh
  change ∀ x, C.memBool (x + h) = true ↔ C.memBool x = true
  suffices hp : ∀ x, C.memBool (x + h) = C.memBool x by
    intro x
    rw [hp]
  induction hh using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem h hh =>
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hh
      rcases hh with rfl | rfl
      · exact C.memBool_add_horizontal
      · exact C.memBool_add_vertical
  | zero => simp
  | add u v _hu _hv ihu ihv =>
      intro x
      rw [show x + (u + v) = (x + u) + v by abel, ihv, ihu]
  | neg u _hu ihu =>
      intro x
      have hp := (ihu (x - u)).symm
      convert hp using 1 <;> abel_nf

name: TranslationalTilings.LatticePeriodicSetCode.scalarLattice_le
statement:
theorem LatticePeriodicSetCode.scalarLattice_le
    (C : LatticePeriodicSetCode) :
    scalarLattice C.scalarPeriod ≤ C.periodLattice
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨z, rfl⟩
  have hh : C.horizontalGenerator ∈ C.periodLattice :=
    AddSubgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  have hv : C.verticalGenerator ∈ C.periodLattice :=
    AddSubgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  have hm := C.periodLattice.add_mem
    (C.periodLattice.zsmul_mem
      hh ((C.verticalPeriod : ℤ) * z 0 - C.shear * z 1))
    (C.periodLattice.zsmul_mem hv ((C.horizontalPeriod : ℤ) * z 1))
  convert hm using 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [LatticePeriodicSetCode.scalarPeriod,
      LatticePeriodicSetCode.horizontalGenerator,
      LatticePeriodicSetCode.verticalGenerator, Pi.smul_apply,
      ] <;> ring

name: TranslationalTilings.LatticePeriodicSetCode.toScalarCode_toSet
statement:
theorem LatticePeriodicSetCode.toScalarCode_toSet
    (C : LatticePeriodicSetCode) :
    C.toScalarCode.toSet = C.toSet
proof:
:= by
  have hscalar : SetScalarPeriodic C.scalarPeriod C.toSet := by
    intro x z
    exact C.toSet_periodic _ (C.scalarLattice_le ⟨z, rfl⟩) x
  ext x
  let r : BoxResidue 2 C.scalarPeriod := fun i ↦
    ⟨(x i).natMod C.scalarPeriod,
      Int.natMod_lt (Nat.mul_pos C.horizontal_pos C.vertical_pos).ne'⟩
  let z : Plane := fun i ↦ x i / (C.scalarPeriod : ℤ)
  have hx : boxPoint r + (C.scalarPeriod : ℤ) • z = x :=
    boxPoint_natMod_add_ediv C.scalarPeriod
      (Nat.mul_pos C.horizontal_pos C.vertical_pos) x
  change C.memBool (boxPoint r) = true ↔ C.memBool x = true
  rw [← hx]
  exact (hscalar (boxPoint r) z).symm

name: TranslationalTilings.exists_latticePeriodicSetCode_of_finite_quotient
statement:
theorem exists_latticePeriodicSetCode_of_finite_quotient
    (Λ : AddSubgroup Plane) [Finite (Plane ⧸ Λ)]
    (E : Set Plane) (hE : SetPeriodicOn Λ E) :
    ∃ C : LatticePeriodicSetCode,
      C.periodLattice = Λ ∧ C.toSet = E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hindex : 0 < Λ.index := Nat.card_pos
  have hexA : ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ (![(n : ℤ), 0] : Plane) ∈ Λ := by
    refine ⟨Λ.index, hindex, ?_⟩
    simpa using
      Λ.nsmul_index_mem (![(1 : ℤ), 0] : Plane)
  let a := Nat.find hexA
  have ha : 0 < a := (Nat.find_spec hexA).1
  have hha : (![(a : ℤ), 0] : Plane) ∈ Λ := (Nat.find_spec hexA).2
  have hexC : ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧
      ∃ b : ℤ, (![b, (n : ℤ)] : Plane) ∈ Λ := by
    refine ⟨Λ.index, hindex, 0, ?_⟩
    simpa using
      Λ.nsmul_index_mem (![(0 : ℤ), 1] : Plane)
  let c := Nat.find hexC
  have hc : 0 < c := (Nat.find_spec hexC).1
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ := (Nat.find_spec hexC).2
  let b : ℤ := b₀ % (a : ℤ)
  have haZ : (0 : ℤ) < a := by exact_mod_cast ha
  have hbnonneg : 0 ≤ b := Int.emod_nonneg _ haZ.ne'
  have hblt : b < a := Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ haZ
  have hbrem : b + (a : ℤ) * (b₀ / (a : ℤ)) = b₀ := by
    exact Int.emod_add_mul_ediv b₀ (a : ℤ)
  have hhb : (![b, (c : ℤ)] : Plane) ∈ Λ := by
    have hsub := Λ.sub_mem hb₀
      (Λ.zsmul_mem hha (b₀ / (a : ℤ)))
    convert hsub using 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · change b = b₀ - (b₀ / (a : ℤ)) * a
      nlinarith [hbrem]
    · dsimp only [c]
      simp
  let C : LatticePeriodicSetCode := {
    horizontalPeriod := a
    horizontal_pos := ha
    shear := b
    shear_nonneg := hbnonneg
    shear_lt_horizontal := hblt
    verticalPeriod := c
    vertical_pos := hc
    bits := fun i j ↦ decide ((![(i : ℕ), (j : ℕ)] : Plane) ∈ E)
  }
  have hperiod : C.periodLattice = Λ := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [LatticePeriodicSetCode.periodLattice, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
      intro v hv
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hv
      rcases hv with rfl | rfl
      · simpa [C, LatticePeriodicSetCode.horizontalGenerator] using hha
      · simpa [C, LatticePeriodicSetCode.verticalGenerator] using hhb
    · intro x hx
      let qv : ℤ := x 1 / (c : ℤ)
      let rvZ : ℤ := x 1 % (c : ℤ)
      have hrvnonneg : 0 ≤ rvZ := Int.emod_nonneg _ (by exact_mod_cast hc.ne')
      have hrvltZ : rvZ < c := Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ (by exact_mod_cast hc)
      let rv : ℕ := rvZ.toNat
      have hrvcast : (rv : ℤ) = rvZ := by
        exact Int.toNat_of_nonneg hrvnonneg
      let y : Plane := x - qv • (![b, (c : ℤ)] : Plane)
      have hy : y ∈ Λ := Λ.sub_mem hx (Λ.zsmul_mem hhb qv)
      have hy1 : y 1 = rvZ := by
        change x 1 - qv * (c : ℤ) = rvZ
        dsimp only [qv, rvZ]
        have hmod := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv (x 1) (c : ℤ)
        ring_nf at hmod ⊢
        omega
      have hrvzero : rvZ = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        have hrvpos : 0 < rv := by
          rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
          intro hz
          apply hne
          rw [← hrvcast, hz]
          rfl
        have hcandidate : 0 < rv ∧
            ∃ d : ℤ, (![d, (rv : ℤ)] : Plane) ∈ Λ := by
          refine ⟨hrvpos, y 0, ?_⟩
          convert hy using 1
          funext i
          fin_cases i
          · rfl
          · change (rv : ℤ) = y 1
            rw [hrvcast, hy1]
        have hmin := Nat.find_min' hexC hcandidate
        have hrvlt : rv < c := by
          rw [← hrvcast] at hrvltZ
          exact_mod_cast hrvltZ
        exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hmin) hrvlt
      have hy1zero : y 1 = 0 := hy1.trans hrvzero
      let qh : ℤ := y 0 / (a : ℤ)
      let rhZ : ℤ := y 0 % (a : ℤ)
      have hrhnonneg : 0 ≤ rhZ := Int.emod_nonneg _ haZ.ne'
      have hrhltZ : rhZ < a := Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ haZ
      let rh : ℕ := rhZ.toNat
      have hrhcast : (rh : ℤ) = rhZ := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hrhnonneg
      let w : Plane := y - qh • (![(a : ℤ), 0] : Plane)
      have hw : w ∈ Λ := Λ.sub_mem hy (Λ.zsmul_mem hha qh)
      have hw0 : w 0 = rhZ := by
        change y 0 - qh * (a : ℤ) = rhZ
        dsimp only [qh, rhZ]
        have hmod := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv (y 0) (a : ℤ)
        ring_nf at hmod ⊢
        omega
      have hw1 : w 1 = 0 := by
        change y 1 - qh * 0 = 0
        simp only [mul_zero, sub_zero, hy1zero]
      have hrhzero : rhZ = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        have hrhpos : 0 < rh := by
          rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
          intro hz
          apply hne
          rw [← hrhcast, hz]
          rfl
        have hcandidate : 0 < rh ∧ (![(rh : ℤ), 0] : Plane) ∈ Λ := by
          refine ⟨hrhpos, ?_⟩
          convert hw using 1
          funext i
          fin_cases i
          · change (rh : ℤ) = w 0
            rw [hrhcast, hw0]
          · change (0 : ℤ) = w 1
            rw [hw1]
        have hmin := Nat.find_min' hexA hcandidate
        have hrhlt : rh < a := by
          rw [← hrhcast] at hrhltZ
          exact_mod_cast hrhltZ
        exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hmin) hrhlt
      have hwzero : w = 0 := by
        funext i
        fin_cases i
        · change w 0 = (0 : Plane) 0
          simp only [Pi.zero_apply, hw0, hrhzero]
        · change w 1 = (0 : Plane) 1
          simp only [Pi.zero_apply, hw1]
      have hydecomp : y = qh • (![(a : ℤ), 0] : Plane) := by
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa only [w] using hwzero)
      have hxsplit : x = y + qv • (![b, (c : ℤ)] : Plane) := by
        dsimp only [y]
        abel
      have hdecomp :
          x = qh • (![(a : ℤ), 0] : Plane) +
            qv • (![b, (c : ℤ)] : Plane) := by
        rw [hxsplit, hydecomp]
      rw [hdecomp]
      exact C.periodLattice.add_mem
        (C.periodLattice.zsmul_mem
          (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (by simp [C,
            LatticePeriodicSetCode.horizontalGenerator])) qh)
        (C.periodLattice.zsmul_mem
          (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (by simp [C,
            LatticePeriodicSetCode.verticalGenerator])) qv)
  refine ⟨C, hperiod, ?_⟩
  ext x
  let qv : ℤ := x 1 / (c : ℤ)
  let r1 : Fin c := ⟨(x 1).natMod c, Int.natMod_lt hc.ne'⟩
  let u : ℤ := x 0 - qv * b
  let qh : ℤ := u / (a : ℤ)
  let r0 : Fin a := ⟨u.natMod a, Int.natMod_lt ha.ne'⟩
  let y : Plane := ![(r0 : ℕ), (r1 : ℕ)]
  let shift : Plane := qh • (![(a : ℤ), 0] : Plane) +
    qv • (![b, (c : ℤ)] : Plane)
  have hxy : y + shift = x := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · change ((u.natMod a : ℕ) : ℤ) +
          (qh * (a : ℤ) + qv * b) = x 0
      rw [Int.natMod]
      rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg _ haZ.ne')]
      have hmod := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv u (a : ℤ)
      dsimp only [u, qh, qv] at hmod ⊢
      ring_nf at hmod ⊢
      omega
    · change ((x 1).natMod c : ℕ) + (qh * 0 + qv * (c : ℤ)) = x 1
      rw [Int.natMod]
      rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg
        (Int.emod_nonneg _ (by exact_mod_cast hc.ne'))]
      have hmod := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv (x 1) (c : ℤ)
      dsimp only [qv]
      ring_nf at hmod ⊢
      omega
  have hshift : shift ∈ Λ := by
    rw [← hperiod]
    exact C.periodLattice.add_mem
      (C.periodLattice.zsmul_mem
        (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (by simp [C,
          LatticePeriodicSetCode.horizontalGenerator])) qh)
      (C.periodLattice.zsmul_mem
        (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (by simp [C,
          LatticePeriodicSetCode.verticalGenerator])) qv)
  change decide (y ∈ E) = true ↔ x ∈ E
  rw [decide_eq_true_eq, ← hxy]
  exact (hE shift hshift y).symm

name: TranslationalTilings.countedAny_fst_eq_true_iff
statement:
private theorem countedAny_fst_eq_true_iff
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → Bool × ℕ) :
    (countedAny s p).1 = true ↔ ∃ x ∈ s, (p x).1 = true
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [countedAny]
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [countedAny, Finset.fold_insert ha]
      simp only [countedOr, Bool.or_eq_true]
      change (p a).1 = true ∨ (countedAny s p).1 = true ↔ _
      rw [ih]
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert]
      aesop

name: TranslationalTilings.countedAll_fst_eq_true_iff
statement:
private theorem countedAll_fst_eq_true_iff
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → Bool × ℕ) :
    (countedAll s p).1 = true ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, (p x).1 = true
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [countedAll]
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [countedAll, Finset.fold_insert ha]
      simp only [countedAnd, Bool.and_eq_true]
      change (p a).1 = true ∧ (countedAll s p).1 = true ↔ _
      rw [ih]
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert]
      aesop

name: TranslationalTilings.countedAll_cost
statement:
private theorem countedAll_cost
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → Bool × ℕ) :
    (countedAll s p).2 = 1 + ∑ x ∈ s, ((p x).2 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [countedAll]
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [countedAll, Finset.fold_insert ha]
      change (p a).2 + (countedAll s p).2 + 1 = _
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, ih]
      omega

name: TranslationalTilings.countedCount_fst
statement:
private theorem countedCount_fst
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → Bool × ℕ) :
    (countedCount s p).1 = (s.filter fun x ↦ (p x).1 = true).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [countedCount]
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [countedCount, Finset.fold_insert ha]
      change (if (p a).1 then 1 else 0) + (countedCount s p).1 = _
      rw [ih]
      by_cases hpa : (p a).1 = true
      · simp [Finset.filter_insert, hpa, ha]
        omega
      · simp [Finset.filter_insert, hpa]

name: TranslationalTilings.countedCount_cost
statement:
private theorem countedCount_cost
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → Bool × ℕ) :
    (countedCount s p).2 = 1 + ∑ x ∈ s, ((p x).2 + 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [countedCount]
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [countedCount, Finset.fold_insert ha]
      change ((p a).2 + 1) + (countedCount s p).2 + 1 = _
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, ih]
      omega

name: TranslationalTilings.finsetAnyBool_eq_true_iff
statement:
private theorem finsetAnyBool_eq_true_iff
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → Bool) :
    finsetAnyBool s p = true ↔ ∃ x ∈ s, p x = true
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa only [finsetAnyBool] using
    countedAny_fst_eq_true_iff s (fun x ↦ (p x, 0))

name: TranslationalTilings.finsetAllBool_eq_true_iff
statement:
private theorem finsetAllBool_eq_true_iff
    (s : Finset α) (p : α → Bool) :
    finsetAllBool s p = true ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, p x = true
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa only [finsetAllBool] using
    countedAll_fst_eq_true_iff s (fun x ↦ (p x, 0))

name: TranslationalTilings.commonCodePeriod_pos
statement:
theorem commonCodePeriod_pos (A E : PeriodicSetCode d) :
    0 < commonCodePeriod A E
proof:
:=
  Nat.lcm_pos A.period_pos E.period_pos

name: TranslationalTilings.PeriodicSetCode.memBool_boxPoint
statement:
private theorem PeriodicSetCode.memBool_boxPoint
    (C : PeriodicSetCode d) (r : BoxResidue d C.period) :
    C.memBool (boxPoint r) = C.bits r
proof:
:= by
  unfold PeriodicSetCode.memBool
  congr 1
  funext i
  apply Fin.ext
  simp only [boxPoint, Int.natMod]
  rw [Int.emod_eq_of_lt]
  · simp
  · exact Int.natCast_nonneg _
  · exact_mod_cast (r i).isLt

name: TranslationalTilings.setScalarPeriodic_of_dvd
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hpq
  intro x z
  have h := hA x ((m : ℤ) • z)
  simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, mul_smul] using h

name: TranslationalTilings.periodicTileCountCounted_fst
statement:
private theorem periodicTileCountCounted_fst
    (F : Finset (Lattice d)) (C : PeriodicSetCode d) (x : Lattice d) :
    (periodicTileCountCounted F C x).1 =
      (@Finset.filter _ (fun f ↦ x - f ∈ C.toSet)
        (fun _ ↦ Classical.propDecidable _) F).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold periodicTileCountCounted
  simp only [PeriodicSetCode.memCounted]
  rw [countedCount_fst]
  rw [Finset.filter_congr_decidable]
  apply congrArg Finset.card
  ext f
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
  rw [PeriodicSetCode.memBool_eq_true_iff]

name: TranslationalTilings.periodicTileCountCounted_cost_exact
statement:
private theorem periodicTileCountCounted_cost_exact
    (F : Finset (Lattice d)) (C : PeriodicSetCode d) (x : Lattice d) :
    (periodicTileCountCounted F C x).2 =
      1 + F.card * (2 * d + 3)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold periodicTileCountCounted
  rw [countedCount_cost]
  simp only [PeriodicSetCode.memCounted, Finset.sum_const,
    nsmul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  omega

name: TranslationalTilings.periodicTilingPointCounted_fst_eq_true_iff
statement:
private theorem periodicTilingPointCounted_fst_eq_true_iff
    (F : Finset (Lattice d)) (A E : PeriodicSetCode d) (x : Lattice d) :
    (periodicTilingPointCounted F A E x).1 = true ↔
      (@Finset.filter _ (fun f ↦ x - f ∈ A.toSet)
        (fun _ ↦ Classical.propDecidable _) F).card =
        @ite ℕ (x ∈ E.toSet) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold periodicTilingPointCounted
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
  rw [periodicTileCountCounted_fst]
  change _ = (if E.memBool x = true then 1 else 0) ↔ _
  by_cases hx : x ∈ E.toSet
  · have hb : E.memBool x = true := (E.memBool_eq_true_iff x).2 hx
    simp only [hb, hx, if_true]
  · have hb : E.memBool x ≠ true := fun h ↦
      hx ((E.memBool_eq_true_iff x).1 h)
    cases hbit : E.memBool x with
    | false => simp [hx]
    | true => exact (hb hbit).elim

name: TranslationalTilings.periodicTilingPointCounted_cost_exact
statement:
private theorem periodicTilingPointCounted_cost_exact
    (F : Finset (Lattice d)) (A E : PeriodicSetCode d) (x : Lattice d) :
    (periodicTilingPointCounted F A E x).2 =
      F.card * (2 * d + 3) + d + 4
proof:
:= by
  unfold periodicTilingPointCounted
  simp only [PeriodicSetCode.memCounted]
  rw [periodicTileCountCounted_cost_exact]
  omega

name: TranslationalTilings.representationCount_periodic
statement:
private theorem representationCount_periodic
    (F : Finset (Lattice d)) {q : ℕ} {A : Set (Lattice d)}
    (hA : SetScalarPeriodic q A) (x z : Lattice d) :
    (@Finset.filter _ (fun f ↦ x + (q : ℤ) • z - f ∈ A)
      (fun _ ↦ Classical.propDecidable _) F).card =
    (@Finset.filter _ (fun f ↦ x - f ∈ A)
      (fun _ ↦ Classical.propDecidable _) F).card
proof:
:= by
  apply congrArg Finset.card
  ext f
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
  have hp := hA (x - f) z
  have hp' : x + (q : ℤ) • z - f ∈ A ↔ x - f ∈ A := by
    convert hp using 1
    abel_nf
  exact and_congr Iff.rfl hp'

name: TranslationalTilings.tilesPeriodicTargetBool_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem tilesPeriodicTargetBool_eq_true_iff
    (F : Finset (Lattice d)) (A E : PeriodicSetCode d) :
    tilesPeriodicTargetBool F A E = true ↔ Tiles F A.toSet E.toSet
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q := commonCodePeriod A E
  have hAq : SetScalarPeriodic q A.toSet :=
    setScalarPeriodic_of_dvd (Nat.dvd_lcm_left A.period E.period)
      A.toSet_scalarPeriodic
  have hEq : SetScalarPeriodic q E.toSet :=
    setScalarPeriodic_of_dvd (Nat.dvd_lcm_right A.period E.period)
      E.toSet_scalarPeriodic
  rw [Tiles, tilesAtLevel_iff_representation_count]
  unfold tilesPeriodicTargetBool tilesPeriodicTargetCounted
  rw [countedAll_fst_eq_true_iff]
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, true_implies]
  constructor
  · intro h x
    let r : BoxResidue d q :=
      fun i ↦ ⟨(x i).natMod q, Int.natMod_lt (commonCodePeriod_pos A E).ne'⟩
    let z : Lattice d := fun i ↦ x i / (q : ℤ)
    have hx : boxPoint r + (q : ℤ) • z = x :=
      boxPoint_natMod_add_ediv q (commonCodePeriod_pos A E) x
    have hr := (periodicTilingPointCounted_fst_eq_true_iff F A E
      (boxPoint r)).mp (h r)
    rw [← hx, representationCount_periodic F hAq]
    simpa only [hEq (boxPoint r) z] using hr
  · intro h r
    exact (periodicTilingPointCounted_fst_eq_true_iff F A E
      (boxPoint r)).mpr (h (boxPoint r))

name: TranslationalTilings.tilesPeriodicTargetCounted_cost_exact
statement:
theorem tilesPeriodicTargetCounted_cost_exact
    (F : Finset (Lattice d)) (A E : PeriodicSetCode d) :
    (tilesPeriodicTargetCounted F A E).2 =
      periodicCandidateCheckCost d F.card (commonCodePeriod A E)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold tilesPeriodicTargetCounted
  rw [countedAll_cost]
  simp only [periodicTilingPointCounted_cost_exact, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
    periodicCandidateCheckCost]
  rw [Nat.add_comm 1]
  congr 1

name: TranslationalTilings.tilesPeriodicTargetCounted_cost
statement:
theorem tilesPeriodicTargetCounted_cost
    (F : Finset (Lattice d)) (A E : PeriodicSetCode d) :
    (tilesPeriodicTargetCounted F A E).2 ≤
      periodicCandidateCheckCost d F.card (commonCodePeriod A E)
proof:
:=
  (tilesPeriodicTargetCounted_cost_exact F A E).le

name: TranslationalTilings.PeriodicSetCode.isEmptyBool_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem PeriodicSetCode.isEmptyBool_eq_true_iff (C : PeriodicSetCode d) :
    C.isEmptyBool = true ↔ C.toSet = ∅
proof:
:= by
  unfold PeriodicSetCode.isEmptyBool
  rw [finsetAllBool_eq_true_iff]
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, true_implies]
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    intro hx
    have hr := h (fun i ↦ ⟨(x i).natMod C.period,
      Int.natMod_lt C.period_pos.ne'⟩)
    have hfalse : C.memBool x = false := by
      change C.bits _ = false
      simpa using hr
    change C.memBool x = true at hx
    rw [hfalse] at hx
    contradiction
  · intro h r
    have hr : boxPoint r ∉ C.toSet := by rw [h]; simp
    change C.memBool (boxPoint r) ≠ true at hr
    rw [C.memBool_boxPoint r] at hr
    cases hbit : C.bits r with
    | false => rfl
    | true => exact (hr hbit).elim

name: TranslationalTilings.countedAllRange_fst_eq_true_iff
statement:
private theorem countedAllRange_fst_eq_true_iff
    (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ → Bool × ℕ) :
    (countedAllRange n p).1 = true ↔
      ∀ i < n, (p i).1 = true
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [countedAllRange]
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [countedAllRange, Bool.and_eq_true, ih]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hprev, hlast⟩ i hi
        by_cases hin : i = n
        · simpa [hin] using hlast
        · exact hprev i (by omega)
      · intro h
        exact ⟨fun i hi ↦ h i (by omega), h n (by omega)⟩

name: TranslationalTilings.countedAllRange_cost
statement:
theorem countedAllRange_cost (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ → Bool × ℕ) :
    (countedAllRange n p).2 =
      1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ((p i).2 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [countedAllRange]
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [countedAllRange, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      omega

name: TranslationalTilings.searchBoolTablesCounted_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem searchBoolTablesCounted_eq_true_iff (n : ℕ)
    (check : (Fin n → Bool) → Bool × ℕ) :
    (searchBoolTablesCounted n check).1 = true ↔
      ∃ bits : Fin n → Bool, (check bits).1 = true
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp only [searchBoolTablesCounted]
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact ⟨fun i ↦ Fin.elim0 i, h⟩
      · rintro ⟨bits, h⟩
        simpa only [Subsingleton.elim bits (fun i ↦ Fin.elim0 i)] using h
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [searchBoolTablesCounted, Bool.or_eq_true]
      rw [ih, ih]
      constructor
      · rintro (⟨tail, htail⟩ | ⟨tail, htail⟩)
        · exact ⟨Fin.cases false tail, htail⟩
        · exact ⟨Fin.cases true tail, htail⟩
      · rintro ⟨bits, hbits⟩
        let tail : Fin n → Bool := fun i ↦ bits i.succ
        have hcases (b : Bool) (hb : bits 0 = b) :
            Fin.cases b tail = bits := by
          funext i
          refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j ↦ ?_) i
          · simpa using hb.symm
          · rfl
        cases hb : bits 0 with
        | false =>
            left
            exact ⟨tail, by simpa only [hcases false hb] using hbits⟩
        | true =>
            right
            exact ⟨tail, by simpa only [hcases true hb] using hbits⟩

name: TranslationalTilings.searchBoolTablesCounted_cost
statement:
theorem searchBoolTablesCounted_cost (n leafCost : ℕ)
    (check : (Fin n → Bool) → Bool × ℕ)
    (hcost : ∀ bits, (check bits).2 = leafCost) :
    (searchBoolTablesCounted n check).2 =
      boolTableSearchCost n leafCost
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp only [searchBoolTablesCounted, boolTableSearchCost]
      rw [hcost]
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [searchBoolTablesCounted, boolTableSearchCost]
      rw [ih (fun tail ↦ check (Fin.cases false tail)),
        ih (fun tail ↦ check (Fin.cases true tail))]
      · omega
      · exact fun tail ↦ hcost (Fin.cases true tail)
      · exact fun tail ↦ hcost (Fin.cases false tail)

name: TranslationalTilings.boolTableSearchCost_closed
statement:
theorem boolTableSearchCost_closed (n leafCost : ℕ) :
    boolTableSearchCost n leafCost + 1 = 2 ^ n * (leafCost + 2)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [boolTableSearchCost]
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [boolTableSearchCost, pow_succ]
      calc
        2 * boolTableSearchCost n leafCost + 1 + 1 =
            2 * (boolTableSearchCost n leafCost + 1) := by omega
        _ = 2 * (2 ^ n * (leafCost + 2)) := by rw [ih]
        _ = 2 ^ n * 2 * (leafCost + 2) := by ring

name: TranslationalTilings.searchPositivePeriodsCounted_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem searchPositivePeriodsCounted_eq_true_iff (B : ℕ)
    (check : (M : ℕ) → 0 < M → Bool × ℕ) :
    (searchPositivePeriodsCounted B check).1 = true ↔
      ∃ (M : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M), M ≤ B ∧ (check M hM).1 = true
proof:
:= by
  induction B with
  | zero => simp [searchPositivePeriodsCounted]
  | succ B ih =>
      simp only [searchPositivePeriodsCounted, Bool.or_eq_true, ih]
      constructor
      · rintro (⟨M, hM, hMB, hcheck⟩ | hlast)
        · exact ⟨M, hM, by omega, hcheck⟩
        · exact ⟨B + 1, Nat.succ_pos B, by omega, hlast⟩
      · rintro ⟨M, hM, hMB, hcheck⟩
        by_cases hlt : M ≤ B
        · left
          exact ⟨M, hM, hlt, hcheck⟩
        · right
          have hMsucc : M = B + 1 := by omega
          subst M
          simpa only [proof_irrel_heq] using hcheck

name: TranslationalTilings.searchPositivePeriodsCounted_cost
statement:
theorem searchPositivePeriodsCounted_cost (B : ℕ)
    (check : (M : ℕ) → 0 < M → Bool × ℕ)
    (leafCost : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hcost : ∀ M (hM : 0 < M), M ≤ B →
      (check M hM).2 = leafCost M) :
    (searchPositivePeriodsCounted B check).2 =
      positivePeriodSearchCost B leafCost
proof:
:= by
  induction B with
  | zero => simp [searchPositivePeriodsCounted, positivePeriodSearchCost]
  | succ B ih =>
      simp only [searchPositivePeriodsCounted, positivePeriodSearchCost]
      rw [ih (fun M hM hMB ↦ hcost M hM (by omega)),
        hcost (B + 1) (Nat.succ_pos B) (by omega)]

name: TranslationalTilings.planarShiftedMemCounted_fst

name: TranslationalTilings.planarShiftedMemCounted_snd

name: TranslationalTilings.planarTileCountCandidateCounted_fst
statement:
private theorem planarTileCountCandidateCounted_fst
    (F : Finset Plane) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (bits : Fin (q ^ 2) → Bool) (x : Plane) :
    (planarTileCountCandidateCounted F q hq bits x).1 =
      (@Finset.filter _
        (fun f ↦ x - f ∈ (planarBitsCode q hq bits).toSet)
        (fun _ ↦ Classical.propDecidable _) F).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (countedCount F (planarShiftedMemCounted q hq bits x)).1 = _
  rw [countedCount_fst, Finset.filter_congr_decidable]
  apply congrArg Finset.card
  apply Finset.filter_congr
  intro f _hf
  rw [planarShiftedMemCounted_fst,
    PeriodicSetCode.memBool_eq_true_iff]

name: TranslationalTilings.planarTileCountCandidateCounted_cost_exact
statement:
private theorem planarTileCountCandidateCounted_cost_exact

  simp [Nat.mul_comm]

name: TranslationalTilings.planarTilingPointCandidateCounted_cost_exact

name: TranslationalTilings.planarBoxPointAt_planarBoxIndex
statement:
private theorem planarBoxPointAt_planarBoxIndex
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (r : BoxResidue 2 q) :
    planarBoxPointAt q (planarBoxIndex q r) = boxPoint r
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · have hnat : (((r 0 : ℕ) * q + (r 1 : ℕ)) / q : ℕ) = (r 0 : ℕ) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_comm (r 0 : ℕ) q, Nat.add_comm]
      rw [Nat.add_mul_div_left, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (r 1).isLt]
      all_goals omega
    simpa [planarBoxPointAt, planarBoxIndex, boxPoint, hq] using
      congrArg Int.ofNat hnat
  · have hnat : (((r 0 : ℕ) * q + (r 1 : ℕ)) % q : ℕ) = (r 1 : ℕ) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_comm (r 0 : ℕ) q, Nat.add_comm]
      rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (r 1).isLt]
    simpa [planarBoxPointAt, planarBoxIndex, boxPoint, hq] using
      congrArg Int.ofNat hnat

name: TranslationalTilings.planarCandidateCheckCounted_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem planarCandidateCheckCounted_eq_true_iff
    (F : Finset Plane) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (bits : Fin (q ^ 2) → Bool) :
    (planarCandidateCheckCounted F q hq bits).1 = true ↔
      TilesUniverse F (planarBitsCode q hq bits).toSet
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let C := planarBitsCode q hq bits
  rw [TilesUniverse, Tiles, tilesAtLevel_iff_representation_count]
  simp only [Set.mem_univ, if_true]
  unfold planarCandidateCheckCounted
  rw [countedAllRange_fst_eq_true_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h x
    let r : BoxResidue 2 q :=
      fun i ↦ ⟨(x i).natMod q, Int.natMod_lt hq.ne'⟩
    let z : Plane := fun i ↦ x i / (q : ℤ)
    have hx : boxPoint r + (q : ℤ) • z = x :=
      boxPoint_natMod_add_ediv q hq x
    let i := planarBoxIndex q r
    have hi := i.isLt
    have hpoint := (planarTilingPointCandidateCounted_fst_eq_true_iff
      F q hq bits (planarBoxPointAt q i)).mp (h i hi)
    rw [planarBoxPointAt_planarBoxIndex q hq r] at hpoint
    rw [← hx]
    have hp :
        (@Finset.filter _
          (fun f ↦ boxPoint r + (q : ℤ) • z - f ∈ C.toSet)
          (fun _ ↦ Classical.propDecidable _) F).card =
        (@Finset.filter _ (fun f ↦ boxPoint r - f ∈ C.toSet)
          (fun _ ↦ Classical.propDecidable _) F).card := by
      simpa [C, planarBitsCode, PeriodicSetCode.ofBits] using
        representationCount_periodic F C.toSet_scalarPeriodic
          (boxPoint r) z
    exact hp.trans hpoint
  · intro h i hi
    exact (planarTilingPointCandidateCounted_fst_eq_true_iff
      F q hq bits (planarBoxPointAt q i)).mpr
        (h (planarBoxPointAt q i))

name: TranslationalTilings.planarCandidateCheckCounted_cost
statement:
theorem planarCandidateCheckCounted_cost
    (F : Finset Plane) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (bits : Fin (q ^ 2) → Bool) :
    (planarCandidateCheckCounted F q hq bits).2 =
      planarCandidateCheckCost F.card q
proof:
:= by
  unfold planarCandidateCheckCounted
  rw [countedAllRange_cost]
  simp only [planarTilingPointCandidateCounted_cost_exact,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul,
    planarCandidateCheckCost]
  rw [Nat.add_comm 1]
  congr 1

name: TranslationalTilings.planarTilePeriodCheckCounted_cost
statement:
theorem planarTilePeriodCheckCounted_cost
    (F : Finset Plane) (M : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) :
    (planarTilePeriodCheckCounted F M hM).2 =
      planarTilePeriodSearchCost F M
proof:
:= by
  unfold planarTilePeriodCheckCounted planarTilePeriodSearchCost
  apply searchBoolTablesCounted_cost
  exact planarCandidateCheckCounted_cost F M hM

name: TranslationalTilings.planarTileDecision_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem planarTileDecision_eq_true_iff (F : Finset Plane) :
    planarTileDecision F = true ↔ ∃ A : Set Plane, TilesUniverse F A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold planarTileDecision planarTileDecisionCounted
  rw [searchPositivePeriodsCounted_eq_true_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨M, hM, _hbound, hcheck⟩
    rw [planarTilePeriodCheckCounted,
      searchBoolTablesCounted_eq_true_iff] at hcheck
    obtain ⟨bits, hbits⟩ := hcheck
    exact ⟨(planarBitsCode M hM bits).toSet,
      (planarCandidateCheckCounted_eq_true_iff F M hM bits).mp hbits⟩
  · rintro ⟨A, htile⟩
    have hUniv : SetScalarPeriodic 1 (Set.univ : Set Plane) := by
      intro x z
      simp
    obtain ⟨C, hCbound⟩ := quantitative_periodic_tiling_l1
      (F := F) (E := Set.univ) Nat.zero_lt_one hUniv ⟨A, htile⟩
    let M := C.scalarMultiplier
    have hM : 0 < M := C.multiplier_pos
    have hperiodic : SetScalarPeriodic M C.tilingSet := by
      simpa only [one_mul] using C.periodic
    let bits : Fin (M ^ 2) → Bool := fun i ↦
      decide (planarBoxPointAt M i ∈ C.tilingSet)
    have hdecode : (planarBitsCode M hM bits).toSet = C.tilingSet := by
      ext x
      let r : BoxResidue 2 M := fun i ↦
        ⟨(x i).natMod M, Int.natMod_lt hM.ne'⟩
      let z : Plane := fun i ↦ x i / (M : ℤ)
      have hx : boxPoint r + (M : ℤ) • z = x :=
        boxPoint_natMod_add_ediv M hM x
      change bits (planarBoxIndex M r) = true ↔ x ∈ C.tilingSet
      rw [show bits (planarBoxIndex M r) =
          decide (boxPoint r ∈ C.tilingSet) by
        simp only [bits, planarBoxPointAt_planarBoxIndex M hM r]]
      rw [decide_eq_true_eq, ← hx]
      exact (hperiodic (boxPoint r) z).symm
    refine ⟨M, hM, hCbound, ?_⟩
    rw [planarTilePeriodCheckCounted,
      searchBoolTablesCounted_eq_true_iff]
    refine ⟨bits, (planarCandidateCheckCounted_eq_true_iff F M hM bits).2 ?_⟩
    simpa only [hdecode, TilesUniverse] using C.tiles

name: TranslationalTilings.planarTileDecisionCounted_cost_exact
statement:
theorem planarTileDecisionCounted_cost_exact (F : Finset Plane) :
    (planarTileDecisionCounted F).2 = planarTileSearchCost F
proof:
:= by
  unfold planarTileDecisionCounted planarTileSearchCost
  apply searchPositivePeriodsCounted_cost
  intro M hM _hMB
  exact planarTilePeriodCheckCounted_cost F M hM

name: TranslationalTilings.planarTileDecisionCounted_cost
statement:
theorem planarTileDecisionCounted_cost (F : Finset Plane) :
    (planarTileDecisionCounted F).2 ≤ planarTileSearchCost F

  (planarTileDecisionCounted_cost_exact F).le

name: TranslationalTilings.positivePeriodSearchCost_eq_sum
statement:
private theorem positivePeriodSearchCost_eq_sum (B : ℕ)
    (leafCost : ℕ → ℕ) :
    positivePeriodSearchCost B leafCost =
      1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range B, (leafCost (k + 1) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction B with
  | zero => simp [positivePeriodSearchCost]
  | succ B ih =>
      simp only [positivePeriodSearchCost, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      omega

name: TranslationalTilings.planarTileSearchCost_eq_sum
statement:
theorem planarTileSearchCost_eq_sum (F : Finset Plane) :
    let B := periodicTilingPeriodBound F.card (l1Diameter F)
    planarTileSearchCost F =
      1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range B,
        2 ^ ((k + 1) ^ 2) *
          ((k + 1) ^ 2 * (9 * F.card + 5) + 3)
proof:
:= by
  let B := periodicTilingPeriodBound F.card (l1Diameter F)
  unfold planarTileSearchCost
  rw [positivePeriodSearchCost_eq_sum]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _hk
  unfold planarTilePeriodSearchCost
  have hclosed := boolTableSearchCost_closed ((k + 1) ^ 2)
    (planarCandidateCheckCost F.card (k + 1))
  calc
    boolTableSearchCost ((k + 1) ^ 2)
          (planarCandidateCheckCost F.card (k + 1)) + 1 =
        2 ^ ((k + 1) ^ 2) *
          (planarCandidateCheckCost F.card (k + 1) + 2) := hclosed
    _ = 2 ^ ((k + 1) ^ 2) *
          ((k + 1) ^ 2 * (9 * F.card + 5) + 3) := by
      unfold planarCandidateCheckCost
      congr 1

name: TranslationalTilings.planarTileSearchCost_preclosed_bound
statement:
theorem planarTileSearchCost_preclosed_bound (F : Finset Plane) :
    let B := periodicTilingPeriodBound F.card (l1Diameter F)
    planarTileSearchCost F ≤
      1 + B * (2 ^ (B ^ 2) * (B ^ 2 * (9 * F.card + 5) + 3))
proof:
:= by
  let B := periodicTilingPeriodBound F.card (l1Diameter F)
  rw [planarTileSearchCost_eq_sum]
  apply Nat.add_le_add_left
  calc
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range B,
        2 ^ ((k + 1) ^ 2) * ((k + 1) ^ 2 * (9 * F.card + 5) + 3) ≤
        ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range B,
          2 ^ (B ^ 2) * (B ^ 2 * (9 * F.card + 5) + 3) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro k hk
      have hkB : k + 1 ≤ B :=
        Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
      have hsq : (k + 1) ^ 2 ≤ B ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hkB 2
      have hpow : 2 ^ ((k + 1) ^ 2) ≤ 2 ^ (B ^ 2) :=
        Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hsq
      have hlinear : (k + 1) ^ 2 * (9 * F.card + 5) + 3 ≤
          B ^ 2 * (9 * F.card + 5) + 3 :=
        Nat.add_le_add_right
          (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (9 * F.card + 5) hsq) 3
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul hpow hlinear
    _ = B * (2 ^ (B ^ 2) * (B ^ 2 * (9 * F.card + 5) + 3)) := by
      simp

name: TranslationalTilings.planarTileSearchCost_closed_bound
statement:
theorem planarTileSearchCost_closed_bound (F : Finset Plane) :
    planarTileSearchCost F ≤ 2 ^ planarTileSearchExponent F
proof:
:= by
  let c := F.card
  let B := periodicTilingPeriodBound F.card (l1Diameter F)
  let P := B ^ 2 * (9 * c + 5) + 3
  let s := B ^ 2 + B + P
  have hB : 1 ≤ B := by
    exact le_max_left 1
      (periodicTilingConstant F.card *
        max 1 (l1Diameter F ^ periodicTilingExponent F.card))
  have hpre := planarTileSearchCost_preclosed_bound F
  change planarTileSearchCost F ≤ 1 + B * (2 ^ (B ^ 2) * P) at hpre
  have hBpow : B ≤ 2 ^ B := Nat.le_of_lt B.lt_two_pow_self
  have hPpow : P ≤ 2 ^ P := Nat.le_of_lt P.lt_two_pow_self
  have hstep :
      1 + B * (2 ^ (B ^ 2) * P) ≤ 2 ^ (s + 1) := by
    calc
      1 + B * (2 ^ (B ^ 2) * P) ≤
          1 + 2 ^ B * (2 ^ (B ^ 2) * 2 ^ P) := by gcongr
      _ = 1 + 2 ^ s := by
        simp only [← pow_add]
        congr 2
        simp only [s]
        omega
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (s + 1) := by
        rw [pow_succ]
        have hp : 0 < 2 ^ s := pow_pos (by omega) _
        omega
  have hsbound : s + 1 ≤ (c + 2) * (B + 2) ^ 4 := by
    have hBB : B ≤ B ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hsSmall : s + 1 ≤ (9 * c + 11) * B ^ 2 := by
      dsimp only [s, P]
      nlinarith
    have hfour : 9 * B ^ 2 ≤ (B + 2) ^ 4 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (B ^ 2 - 3 * B : ℤ)]
    calc
      s + 1 ≤ (9 * c + 11) * B ^ 2 := hsSmall
      _ ≤ (c + 2) * (9 * B ^ 2) := by nlinarith
      _ ≤ (c + 2) * (B + 2) ^ 4 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hfour
  exact hpre.trans (hstep.trans
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by
      simpa only [planarTileSearchExponent, c, B] using hsbound)))

name: TranslationalTilings.planarTileSearchExponent_diameter_bound
statement:
theorem planarTileSearchExponent_diameter_bound (F : Finset Plane) :
    planarTileSearchExponent F ≤ planarTileSearchConstant F.card *
      max 1 (l1Diameter F ^ planarTileDiameterExponent F.card)
proof:
:= by
  let c := F.card
  let D := l1Diameter F
  let C := periodicTilingConstant c
  let e := periodicTilingExponent c
  let X := max 1 (D ^ e)
  have hX : 1 ≤ X := le_max_left _ _
  have hB : periodicTilingPeriodBound c D + 2 ≤ 2 * (C + 3) * X := by
    unfold periodicTilingPeriodBound
    dsimp only [C, X]
    have hmax : max 1 (C * max 1 (D ^ e)) ≤ (C + 1) * X := by
      apply max_le
      · exact hX.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left X (Nat.succ_pos C))
      · exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right (max 1 (D ^ e)) (by omega)
    have htwo : 2 ≤ 2 * X := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hX
    calc
      max 1 (C * max 1 (D ^ e)) + 2 ≤ (C + 1) * X + 2 :=
        Nat.add_le_add_right hmax 2
      _ ≤ (C + 1) * X + 2 * X := Nat.add_le_add_left htwo _
      _ = (C + 3) * X := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * ((C + 3) * X) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
      _ = 2 * (C + 3) * X := by ring
  have hpow := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hB 4
  have hXpow : X ^ 4 = max 1 (D ^ (4 * e)) := by
    dsimp only [X]
    by_cases h : 1 ≤ D ^ e
    · rw [max_eq_right h, Nat.mul_comm 4 e, pow_mul]
      rw [max_eq_right]
      exact Nat.one_le_pow 4 _ (by omega)
    · have h' : D ^ e ≤ 1 := Nat.le_of_not_ge h
      rw [max_eq_left h', one_pow, max_eq_left]
      rw [Nat.mul_comm 4 e, pow_mul]
      have hc : D ^ e = 0 ∨ D ^ e = 1 := by omega
      rcases hc with hz | ho
      · simp [hz]
      · simp [ho]
  unfold planarTileSearchExponent planarTileSearchConstant
  dsimp only [c, D, C, e] at hB hpow hXpow ⊢
  calc
    (F.card + 2) *
        (periodicTilingPeriodBound F.card (l1Diameter F) + 2) ^ 4 ≤
        (F.card + 2) *
          (2 * (periodicTilingConstant F.card + 3) *
            max 1 (l1Diameter F ^ periodicTilingExponent F.card)) ^ 4 := by
      gcongr
    _ = 16 * (F.card + 2) *
          (periodicTilingConstant F.card + 3) ^ 4 *
          max 1 (l1Diameter F ^ (4 * periodicTilingExponent F.card)) := by
      rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hXpow]
      norm_num
      ring

name: TranslationalTilings.planarTileDiameterExponent_le_quartic
statement:
theorem planarTileDiameterExponent_le_quartic (tileCard : ℕ) :
    planarTileDiameterExponent tileCard ≤ 12 * (tileCard + 1) ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  unfold planarTileDiameterExponent
  have h := periodicTilingExponent_le_quartic tileCard
  omega

name: TranslationalTilings.tileAnchor_mem
statement:
theorem tileAnchor_mem {F : Finset Plane} (hF : F.Nonempty) :
    tileAnchor F ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [tileAnchor, dif_pos hF]
  have hmin := Finset.min'_mem (F.image planeToPair) (hF.image planeToPair)
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfeq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmin
  simpa only [← hfeq, pairToPlane_planeToPair] using hf

name: TranslationalTilings.zero_mem_normalizedTile
statement:
theorem zero_mem_normalizedTile {F : Finset Plane} (hF : F.Nonempty) :
    0 ∈ normalizedTile F
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalizedTile
  apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
  exact ⟨tileAnchor F, tileAnchor_mem hF, sub_self _⟩

name: TranslationalTilings.card_normalizedTile
statement:
theorem card_normalizedTile (F : Finset Plane) :
    (normalizedTile F).card = F.card
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalizedTile
  rw [Finset.card_image_iff]
  intro x _ y _ hxy
  exact sub_left_injective hxy

name: TranslationalTilings.diameter_normalizedTile
statement:
theorem diameter_normalizedTile (F : Finset Plane) :
    l1Diameter (normalizedTile F) = l1Diameter F
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalizedTile
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · unfold l1Diameter
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro xy hxy
    have hmem := Finset.mem_product.mp hxy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxeq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem.1
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyeq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem.2
    rw [← hxeq, ← hyeq]
    simpa only [show x - tileAnchor F - (y - tileAnchor F) = x - y by abel] using
      (Finset.le_sup (f := fun uv : Plane × Plane ↦ l1Norm (uv.1 - uv.2))
        (show (x, y) ∈ F ×ˢ F by simp [hx, hy]))
  · unfold l1Diameter
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro xy hxy
    have hmem := Finset.mem_product.mp hxy
    have hx : xy.1 - tileAnchor F ∈
        F.image fun f ↦ f - tileAnchor F :=
      Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨xy.1, hmem.1, rfl⟩
    have hy : xy.2 - tileAnchor F ∈
        F.image fun f ↦ f - tileAnchor F :=
      Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨xy.2, hmem.2, rfl⟩
    simpa only [show xy.1 - tileAnchor F - (xy.2 - tileAnchor F) =
        xy.1 - xy.2 by abel] using
      (Finset.le_sup (f := fun uv : Plane × Plane ↦ l1Norm (uv.1 - uv.2))
        (show (xy.1 - tileAnchor F, xy.2 - tileAnchor F) ∈
          (F.image fun f ↦ f - tileAnchor F) ×ˢ
            (F.image fun f ↦ f - tileAnchor F) by simp [hx, hy]))

name: TranslationalTilings.tiles_normalized_iff
statement:
theorem tiles_normalized_iff (F : Finset Plane) (E : PeriodicSetCode 2)
    (A : Set Plane) :
    Tiles (normalizedTile F) A (normalizedTargetCode F E).toSet ↔
      Tiles F A E.toSet
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [normalizedTargetCode, PeriodicSetCode.pullbackTranslate_toSet]
  unfold Tiles TilesAtLevel
  let a := tileAnchor F
  have hconv (x : Plane) :
      tileConv (normalizedTile F) (setIndicator A) x =
        tileConv F (setIndicator A) (x + a) := by
    unfold normalizedTile tileConv
    rw [Finset.sum_image]
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro f _hf
      congr 1
      abel
    · intro x _hx y _hy hxy
      exact sub_left_injective hxy
  constructor
  · intro h x
    have hx := h (x - a)
    rw [hconv] at hx
    have hpull : x - a ∈ {y | y + a ∈ E.toSet} ↔ x ∈ E.toSet := by
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, sub_add_cancel]
    have hindicator :
        setIndicator {y | y + a ∈ E.toSet} (x - a) =
          setIndicator E.toSet x := by
      change ({y | y + a ∈ E.toSet} : Set Plane).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℤ))
          (x - a) = E.toSet.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℤ)) x
      by_cases hmem : x ∈ E.toSet
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (hpull.mpr hmem), Set.indicator_of_mem hmem]
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun hy ↦ hmem (hpull.mp hy)),
          Set.indicator_of_notMem hmem]
    rw [sub_add_cancel, hindicator] at hx
    exact hx
  · intro h x
    rw [hconv]
    exact h (x + a)

name: TranslationalTilings.classifierPeriod_pos
statement:
theorem classifierPeriod_pos (F : Finset Plane) (E : PeriodicSetCode 2) :
  0 < classifierPeriod F E
proof:
:=
  Nat.mul_pos E.period_pos (Nat.factorial_pos _)

name: TranslationalTilings.validRepresentativeTupleBool_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem validRepresentativeTupleBool_eq_true_iff
    {E : PeriodicSetCode 2} (T) :
    validRepresentativeTupleBool F E T = true ↔
      0 < T.weakMultiplierNat ∧
      ∀ x,
        ∑ j : Fin (classifierDirectionCount F),
          tileConv F (setIndicator (T.representativeCode j).toSet) x =
            setIndicator E.toSet x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q := classifierPeriod F E
  have hq : 0 < q := classifierPeriod_pos F E
  have hEq : SetScalarPeriodic q E.toSet :=
    setScalarPeriodic_of_dvd ⟨(classifierRepresentativeBound F).factorial,
      rfl⟩ E.toSet_scalarPeriodic
  unfold validRepresentativeTupleBool
  rw [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, finsetAllBool_eq_true_iff]
