name: TranslationalTilings.backwardDiff_add
statement:
theorem backwardDiff_add {G R : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup R]
    (h : G) (f g : G → R) :
    backwardDiff h (f + g) = backwardDiff h f + backwardDiff h g
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp only [backwardDiff, Pi.add_apply]
  abel

name: TranslationalTilings.backwardDiff_comm
statement:
theorem backwardDiff_comm {G R : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup R]
    (h k : G) (f : G → R) :
    backwardDiff h (backwardDiff k f) =
      backwardDiff k (backwardDiff h f)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp only [backwardDiff]
  rw [show x - k - h = x - h - k by abel]
  abel

name: TranslationalTilings.backwardDiff_tileConv
statement:
theorem backwardDiff_tileConv {G R : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup R]
    (h : G) (F : Finset G) (f : G → R) :
    backwardDiff h (tileConv F f) = tileConv F (backwardDiff h f)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp only [backwardDiff, tileConv, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  rw [show x - h - a = x - a - h by abel]

name: TranslationalTilings.backwardDiff_eq_zero_of_periodic
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp [backwardDiff, hf.sub_eq]

name: TranslationalTilings.backwardDiff_sub_period_eq
statement:
theorem backwardDiff_sub_period_eq {G R : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup R] (h k : G) (f : G → R)
    (hf : Function.Periodic f k) :
    backwardDiff (h + k) f = backwardDiff h f
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp only [backwardDiff]
  rw [show x - (h + k) = (x - h) - k by abel, hf.sub_eq]

name: TranslationalTilings.lineRestriction_backwardDiff
statement:
theorem lineRestriction_backwardDiff {G R : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup R] (f : G → R) (x h : G) :
    lineRestriction (backwardDiff h f) x h =
      backwardDiff 1 (lineRestriction f x h)
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  simp only [lineRestriction, backwardDiff]
  congr 1
  rw [sub_smul]
  simp
  abel_nf

name: TranslationalTilings.periodic_of_backwardDiff_one_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem periodic_of_backwardDiff_one_eq_zero
    {R : Type*} [AddCommGroup R] (f : ℤ → R)
    (hdiff : backwardDiff 1 f = 0) : Function.Periodic f 1
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  have hz := congrFun hdiff (z + 1)
  simp only [backwardDiff, Pi.zero_apply] at hz
  have : f (z + 1) = f ((z + 1) - 1) := sub_eq_zero.mp hz
  simpa using this

name: TranslationalTilings.backwardDiff_periodic
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  simp only [backwardDiff]
  rw [hf x]
  congr 1
  rw [show x + p - h = (x - h) + p by abel, hf (x - h)]

name: TranslationalTilings.periodic_backwardDiff_eq_zero_of_int_bounded
statement:
private theorem periodic_backwardDiff_eq_zero_of_int_bounded
    (f : ℤ → ℤ) (C : ℕ) (hbounded : ∀ z, Int.natAbs (f z) ≤ C)
    (hperiod : Function.Periodic (backwardDiff 1 f) 1) :
    backwardDiff 1 f = 0
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℤ := backwardDiff 1 f 0
  have hconst (z : ℤ) : backwardDiff 1 f z = c := by
    have hz := hperiod.zsmul_eq z
    simpa [c] using hz
  have hline (m : ℕ) : f (m : ℤ) = f 0 + m • c := by
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
        have hs := hconst ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
        simp only [backwardDiff] at hs
        have hsub : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1 = (m : ℤ) := by omega
        rw [hsub, ih] at hs
        rw [eq_add_of_sub_eq hs]
        simp only [add_nsmul]
        abel
  by_contra hc
  have hc' : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro hcz
    apply hc
    funext z
    simp [hconst z, hcz]
  let m : ℕ := 2 * C + 1
  have hupper : Int.natAbs (f (m : ℤ) - f 0) ≤ 2 * C := by
    calc
      Int.natAbs (f (m : ℤ) - f 0) ≤
          Int.natAbs (f (m : ℤ)) + Int.natAbs (f 0) := Int.natAbs_sub_le ..
      _ ≤ C + C := Nat.add_le_add (hbounded _) (hbounded _)
      _ = 2 * C := by omega
  have hcabs : 1 ≤ Int.natAbs c := by
    exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hc')
  have hlower : m ≤ Int.natAbs (f (m : ℤ) - f 0) := by
    rw [hline]
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_left]
    simpa [nsmul_eq_mul, Int.natAbs_mul] using
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left m hcabs
  dsimp [m] at hupper hlower
  omega

name: TranslationalTilings.periodic_backwardDiff_eq_zero_of_real_bounded
statement:
private theorem periodic_backwardDiff_eq_zero_of_real_bounded
    (f : ℤ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hbounded : ∀ z, |f z| ≤ C)
    (hperiod : Function.Periodic (backwardDiff 1 f) 1) :
    backwardDiff 1 f = 0
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := backwardDiff 1 f 0
  have hconst (z : ℤ) : backwardDiff 1 f z = c := by
    have hz := hperiod.zsmul_eq z
    simpa [c] using hz
  have hline (m : ℕ) : f (m : ℤ) = f 0 + m • c := by
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
        have hs := hconst ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
        simp only [backwardDiff] at hs
        have hsub : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1 = (m : ℤ) := by omega
        rw [hsub, ih] at hs
        rw [eq_add_of_sub_eq hs]
        simp only [add_nsmul]
        abel
  by_contra hc
  have hc' : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro hcz
    apply hc
    funext z
    simp [hconst z, hcz]
  have hcpos : 0 < |c| := abs_pos.mpr hc'
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_gt (2 * C / |c|)
  have hgrowth : 2 * C < (m : ℝ) * |c| := by
    simpa [mul_comm] using (div_lt_iff₀' hcpos).mp hm
  have hupper : |f (m : ℤ) - f 0| ≤ 2 * C := by
    calc
      |f (m : ℤ) - f 0| ≤ |f (m : ℤ)| + |f 0| := abs_sub ..
      _ ≤ C + C := add_le_add (hbounded _) (hbounded _)
      _ = 2 * C := by ring
  have hvalue : |f (m : ℤ) - f 0| = (m : ℝ) * |c| := by
    rw [hline]
    simp [nsmul_eq_mul, abs_mul]
  linarith

name: TranslationalTilings.bounded_of_backwardDiffIter_eq_zero_is_constant
statement:
theorem bounded_of_backwardDiffIter_eq_zero_is_constant
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (f : ℤ → ℤ)
    (hbounded : ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ z, Int.natAbs (f z) ≤ C)
    (hdiff : backwardDiffIter 1 n f = 0) : Function.Periodic f 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing f with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m ih =>
      let g : ℤ → ℤ := backwardDiff 1 f
      have hgdiff : backwardDiffIter 1 m g = 0 := by
        simpa only [backwardDiffIter, Function.iterate_succ_apply] using hdiff
      by_cases hm : m = 0
      · subst m
        have hgzero : g = 0 := by
          simpa only [backwardDiffIter, Function.iterate_zero, id_eq] using hgdiff
        exact periodic_of_backwardDiff_one_eq_zero f hgzero
      · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbounded
        have hgbounded : ∃ D : ℕ, ∀ z, Int.natAbs (g z) ≤ D := by
          refine ⟨2 * C, fun z ↦ ?_⟩
          calc
            Int.natAbs (g z) = Int.natAbs (f z - f (z - 1)) := by
              rfl
            _ ≤ Int.natAbs (f z) + Int.natAbs (f (z - 1)) := Int.natAbs_sub_le ..
            _ ≤ C + C := Nat.add_le_add (hC _) (hC _)
            _ = 2 * C := by omega
        have hgperiod : Function.Periodic g 1 :=
          ih (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm) g hgbounded hgdiff
        exact periodic_of_backwardDiff_one_eq_zero f
          (periodic_backwardDiff_eq_zero_of_int_bounded f C hC hgperiod)

name: TranslationalTilings.bounded_real_of_backwardDiffIter_eq_zero_is_constant
statement:
theorem bounded_real_of_backwardDiffIter_eq_zero_is_constant
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (f : ℤ → ℝ)
    (hbounded : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z, |f z| ≤ C)
    (hdiff : backwardDiffIter 1 n f = 0) : Function.Periodic f 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing f with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m ih =>
      let g : ℤ → ℝ := backwardDiff 1 f
      have hgdiff : backwardDiffIter 1 m g = 0 := by
        simpa only [backwardDiffIter, Function.iterate_succ_apply] using hdiff
      by_cases hm : m = 0
      · subst m
        have hgzero : g = 0 := by
          simpa only [backwardDiffIter, Function.iterate_zero, id_eq] using hgdiff
        exact periodic_of_backwardDiff_one_eq_zero f hgzero
      · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbounded
        have hgbounded : ∃ D : ℝ, ∀ z, |g z| ≤ D := by
          refine ⟨2 * C, fun z ↦ ?_⟩
          calc
            |g z| = |f z - f (z - 1)| := by rfl
            _ ≤ |f z| + |f (z - 1)| := abs_sub ..
            _ ≤ C + C := add_le_add (hC _) (hC _)
            _ = 2 * C := by ring
        have hgperiod : Function.Periodic g 1 :=
          ih (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm) g hgbounded hgdiff
        exact periodic_of_backwardDiff_one_eq_zero f
          (periodic_backwardDiff_eq_zero_of_real_bounded f C hC hgperiod)

name: TranslationalTilings.backwardDiff_zero
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp [backwardDiff]

name: TranslationalTilings.applyDifferences_zero
proof:
:= by
  induction directions with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons h directions ih =>
      change backwardDiff h (applyDifferences directions (0 : G → R)) = 0
      rw [ih, backwardDiff_zero]

name: TranslationalTilings.applyDifferences_add
statement:
private theorem applyDifferences_add {G R : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup R]
    (directions : List G) (f g : G → R) :
    applyDifferences directions (f + g) =
      applyDifferences directions f + applyDifferences directions g
proof:
:= by
  induction directions with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons h directions ih =>
      change backwardDiff h (applyDifferences directions (f + g)) =
        backwardDiff h (applyDifferences directions f) +
          backwardDiff h (applyDifferences directions g)
      rw [ih, backwardDiff_add]

name: TranslationalTilings.applyDifferences_finset_sum
statement:
private theorem applyDifferences_finset_sum {G R α : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup R]
    (directions : List G) (s : Finset α) (f : α → G → R) :
    applyDifferences directions (∑ i ∈ s, f i) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, applyDifferences directions (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [applyDifferences_zero]
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      simp only [Finset.sum_insert hi]
      rw [applyDifferences_add, ih]

name: TranslationalTilings.backwardDiff_applyDifferences
statement:
private theorem backwardDiff_applyDifferences {G R : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup R]
    (h : G) (directions : List G) (f : G → R) :
    backwardDiff h (applyDifferences directions f) =
      applyDifferences directions (backwardDiff h f)
proof:
:= by
  induction directions with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons k directions ih =>
      change backwardDiff h (backwardDiff k (applyDifferences directions f)) =
        backwardDiff k (applyDifferences directions (backwardDiff h f))
      rw [backwardDiff_comm, ih]

name: TranslationalTilings.applyDifferences_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
private theorem applyDifferences_eq_zero_of_mem {G R : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup R]
    (directions : List G) (h : G) (f : G → R)
    (hmem : h ∈ directions) (hzero : backwardDiff h f = 0) :
    applyDifferences directions f = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction directions with
  | nil => simp at hmem
  | cons k directions ih =>
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with rfl | hmem
      · change backwardDiff h (applyDifferences directions f) = 0
        rw [backwardDiff_applyDifferences, hzero, applyDifferences_zero]
      · change backwardDiff k (applyDifferences directions f) = 0
        rw [ih hmem, backwardDiff_zero]

name: TranslationalTilings.iterate_backwardDiff_periodic
statement:
private theorem iterate_backwardDiff_periodic {G R : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup R]
    {p : G} {f : G → R} (hf : Function.Periodic f p)
    (e : G) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Periodic (backwardDiffIter e n f) p
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [backwardDiffIter]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [backwardDiffIter, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      exact backwardDiff_periodic ih e

name: TranslationalTilings.applyDifferences_eq_iter_of_periodic
statement:
private theorem applyDifferences_eq_iter_of_periodic {G R : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup R]
    (directions : List G) (e p : G) (f : G → R)
    (hf : Function.Periodic f p)
    (hdir : ∀ d ∈ directions, ∃ b : ℤ, d = e - b • p) :
    applyDifferences directions f =
      backwardDiffIter e directions.length f
proof:
:= by
  induction directions with
  | nil => simp [applyDifferences, backwardDiffIter]
  | cons d directions ih =>
      obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hdir d (by simp)
      have htail : ∀ k ∈ directions, ∃ b : ℤ, k = e - b • p :=
        fun k hk ↦ hdir k (by simp [hk])
      have hper : Function.Periodic
          (backwardDiffIter e directions.length f) ((-b) • p) :=
        (iterate_backwardDiff_periodic hf e directions.length).zsmul (-b)
      change backwardDiff (e - b • p) (applyDifferences directions f) =
        backwardDiffIter e (directions.length + 1) f
      rw [ih htail]
      have hstep := backwardDiff_sub_period_eq e ((-b) • p)
        (backwardDiffIter e directions.length f) hper
      rw [show e - b • p = e + (-b) • p by
        rw [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_zsmul]]
      rw [hstep]
      simp only [backwardDiffIter, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: TranslationalTilings.eliminate_periodic_summands
statement:
theorem eliminate_periodic_summands
    {ι G R : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup R]
    (target : ι) (lhs : G → R) (summand : ι → G → R)
    (e : G) (period : ι → G) (targetCoefficient : ι → ℤ)
    (decomp : lhs = ∑ i, summand i)
    (hperiod : ∀ i, Function.Periodic (summand i) (period i))
    (represent : ∀ i, i ≠ target → ∃ a : ℤ,
      e = a • period i + targetCoefficient i • period target) :
    applyDifferences
        (eliminationDirections target e period targetCoefficient) lhs =
      backwardDiffIter e (Fintype.card ι - 1) (summand target)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [decomp, applyDifferences_finset_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single target]
  · have hdirs : ∀ d ∈ eliminationDirections target e period targetCoefficient,
        ∃ b : ℤ, d = e - b • period target := by
      intro d hd
      simp only [eliminationDirections, List.mem_map, Finset.mem_toList] at hd
      obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := hd
      exact ⟨targetCoefficient i, rfl⟩
    rw [applyDifferences_eq_iter_of_periodic _ e (period target)
      (summand target) (hperiod target) hdirs]
    congr 2
    simp [eliminationDirections]
  · intro i hi hne
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := represent i hne
    have hmem : e - targetCoefficient i • period target ∈
        eliminationDirections target e period targetCoefficient := by
      apply List.mem_map_of_mem
      simp [hne]
    apply applyDifferences_eq_zero_of_mem _ _ _ hmem
    apply backwardDiff_eq_zero_of_periodic
    rw [ha]
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right]
    exact (hperiod i).zsmul a
  · simp

name: TranslationalTilings.circlePhase_zsmul
statement:
private theorem circlePhase_zsmul (k : ℤ) (x : Torus) :
    circlePhase (k • x) = circlePhase x ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [circlePhase, fourier_one, circlePhase, fourier_one,
    AddCircle.toCircle_zsmul, Circle.coe_zpow]

name: TranslationalTilings.four_mul_norm_le_norm_circlePhase_sub_one
statement:
private theorem four_mul_norm_le_norm_circlePhase_sub_one (y : Torus) :
    4 * ‖y‖ ≤ ‖circlePhase y - 1‖
proof:
:= by
  induction y using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | _ x =>
      let r : ℝ := x - (round x : ℝ)
      have hr : |r| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        simpa [r, abs_sub_comm] using abs_sub_round x
      have hnorm : ‖((x : ℝ) : Torus)‖ = |r| := by
        rw [AddCircle.norm_eq]
        simp [r]
      have hcoe : ((x : ℝ) : Torus) = ((r : ℝ) : Torus) := by
        apply sub_eq_zero.mp
        rw [← AddCircle.coe_sub]
        exact (AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff (1 : ℝ)).mpr
          ⟨round x, by simp [r]⟩
      rw [hnorm, hcoe, circlePhase, fourier_one, AddCircle.toCircle_apply_mk,
        Circle.coe_exp]
      simp only [div_one]
      rw [mul_comm ((2 * π * r : ℝ) : ℂ) Complex.I]
      rw [Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal_sub_one]
      have hj := Real.mul_abs_le_abs_sin
        (x := π * r) (by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
          nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos] at hj
      have hj' : 2 * |r| ≤ |Real.sin (π * r)| := by
        calc
          2 * |r| = 2 / π * (π * |r|) := by field_simp
          _ ≤ _ := hj
      rw [show 2 * π * r / 2 = π * r by ring]
      norm_num [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      linarith

name: TranslationalTilings.sum_pairs_by_difference
statement:
private theorem sum_pairs_by_difference (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (f : ℤ → ℂ) :
    ∑ p ∈ (Finset.range N).product (Finset.range N),
        f ((p.1 : ℤ) - (p.2 : ℤ)) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (-((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ),
        ∑ _m ∈ Finset.range (N - Int.natAbs k), f k
proof:
:= by
  let toDiff : ℕ × ℕ → Sigma (fun _ : ℤ ↦ ℕ) := fun p ↦
    ⟨(p.1 : ℤ) - (p.2 : ℤ), min p.1 p.2⟩
  let fromDiff : Sigma (fun _ : ℤ ↦ ℕ) → ℕ × ℕ := fun p ↦
    if 0 ≤ p.1 then (p.2 + Int.natAbs p.1, p.2)
    else (p.2, p.2 + Int.natAbs p.1)
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma']
  apply Finset.sum_bij'
      (fun p _hp ↦ toDiff p) (fun p _hp ↦ fromDiff p)
  · rintro ⟨j, l⟩ hjl
    rcases Finset.mem_product.mp hjl with ⟨hj, hl⟩
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj hl
    simp only [toDiff, Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_Icc,
      Finset.mem_range]
    constructor
    · omega
    · by_cases hlj : l ≤ j
      · rw [min_eq_right hlj,
          Int.natAbs_natCast_sub_natCast_of_ge hlj]
        omega
      · have hjl : j ≤ l := Nat.le_of_not_ge hlj
        rw [min_eq_left hjl,
          Int.natAbs_natCast_sub_natCast_of_le hjl]
        omega
  · rintro ⟨k, m⟩ hkm
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_Icc,
      Finset.mem_range] at hkm
    rcases hkm with ⟨hk, hm⟩
    have hmadd : m + Int.natAbs k < N := by omega
    simp only [fromDiff]
    split_ifs
    · apply Finset.mem_product.mpr
      simp only [Finset.mem_range]
      exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
    · apply Finset.mem_product.mpr
      simp only [Finset.mem_range]
      exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, l⟩ hjl
    rcases Finset.mem_product.mp hjl with ⟨hj, hl⟩
    simp only [toDiff, fromDiff]
    by_cases hlj : l ≤ j
    · have hnonneg : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (j : ℤ) - (l : ℤ) := by omega
      simp only [hnonneg, if_true,
        Int.natAbs_natCast_sub_natCast_of_ge hlj]
      ext <;> omega
    · have hjl : j ≤ l := Nat.le_of_not_ge hlj
      have hneg : ¬ (0 : ℤ) ≤ (j : ℤ) - (l : ℤ) := by omega
      simp only [hneg, if_false,
        Int.natAbs_natCast_sub_natCast_of_le hjl]
      ext <;> omega
  · rintro ⟨k, m⟩ hkm
    simp only [fromDiff, toDiff]
    by_cases hk : 0 ≤ k
    · simp only [hk, if_true]
      have hab : (Int.natAbs k : ℤ) = k := by
        rw [Int.natCast_natAbs, abs_of_nonneg hk]
      ext
      · simp only [Nat.cast_add]
        rw [hab]
        omega
      · simp
    · simp only [hk, if_false]
      have hab : (Int.natAbs k : ℤ) = -k := by
        rw [Int.natCast_natAbs, abs_of_nonpos (le_of_not_ge hk)]
      ext
      · simp only [Nat.cast_add]
        rw [hab]
        omega
      · simp
  · rintro ⟨j, l⟩ hjl
    rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.nat_mul_fejerWeight
proof:
:= by
  rw [fejerWeight, if_pos hk]
  have hN : (N : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hk))
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hk.le]
  field_simp

name: TranslationalTilings.fejer_sum_eq_pair_average
statement:
private theorem fejer_sum_eq_pair_average (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (z : ℂ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (-((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ),
        (fejerWeight N k : ℂ) * z ^ k =
      (N : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ p ∈ (Finset.range N).product (Finset.range N),
          z ^ ((p.1 : ℤ) - (p.2 : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_pairs_by_difference N hN]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  have habs : Int.natAbs k < N := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hk
    have habs_le : (Int.natAbs k : ℤ) ≤ (N - 1 : ℕ) := by
      rw [Int.natCast_natAbs]
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by omega, hk.2⟩
    omega
  have hscale : (N : ℂ) * (fejerWeight N k : ℂ) =
      (N - Int.natAbs k : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast nat_mul_fejerWeight N k habs
  have hN0 : (N : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hN)
  calc
    (fejerWeight N k : ℂ) * z ^ k =
        (N : ℂ)⁻¹ * ((N : ℂ) * (fejerWeight N k : ℂ)) * z ^ k := by
          field_simp
    _ = (N : ℂ)⁻¹ * ((N - Int.natAbs k : ℕ) * z ^ k) := by
          rw [hscale]
          ring

name: TranslationalTilings.pair_phase_sum_eq_normSq
statement:
private theorem pair_phase_sum_eq_normSq (N : ℕ) (z : ℂ)
    (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) :
    ∑ p ∈ (Finset.range N).product (Finset.range N),
        z ^ ((p.1 : ℤ) - (p.2 : ℤ)) =
      (Complex.normSq (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, z ^ j) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    simp [h] at hz
  calc
    ∑ p ∈ (Finset.range N).product (Finset.range N),
        z ^ ((p.1 : ℤ) - (p.2 : ℤ)) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ l ∈ Finset.range N,
          z ^ ((j : ℤ) - (l : ℤ)) := by
            exact Finset.sum_product _ _ _
    _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ l ∈ Finset.range N,
          z ^ j * starRingEnd ℂ (z ^ l) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j hj
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro l hl
            rw [zpow_natCast_sub_natCast₀ hz0, div_eq_mul_inv,
              ← inv_pow,
              Complex.inv_eq_conj hz, map_pow]
    _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, z ^ j) *
          starRingEnd ℂ (∑ l ∈ Finset.range N, z ^ l) := by
            rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j hj
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = (Complex.normSq (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, z ^ j) : ℂ) := by
          rw [Complex.mul_conj]

name: TranslationalTilings.fejer_kernel_le_half
statement:
private theorem fejer_kernel_le_half (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (horder : 1 ≤ (N : ℝ) * (2 * eps ^ 2))
    (y : Torus) (hy : eps ≤ ‖y‖) :
    (N : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        Complex.normSq
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, circlePhase y ^ j) ≤ 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  let z : ℂ := circlePhase y
  let A : ℂ := ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, z ^ j
  have hz : ‖z‖ = 1 := by
    change ‖circlePhase y‖ = 1
    rw [circlePhase, fourier_one]
    exact Circle.norm_coe _
  have hgeom : A * (z - 1) = z ^ N - 1 := by
    simpa [A] using geom_sum_mul z N
  have hnum : ‖z ^ N - 1‖ ≤ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖z ^ N - 1‖ ≤ ‖z ^ N‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ = 2 := by rw [norm_pow, hz]; norm_num
  have hprod : ‖A‖ * ‖z - 1‖ ≤ 2 := by
    rw [← norm_mul, hgeom]
    exact hnum
  have hchord : 4 * eps ≤ ‖z - 1‖ := by
    calc
      4 * eps ≤ 4 * ‖y‖ := by nlinarith
      _ ≤ ‖z - 1‖ := by
        simpa [z] using four_mul_norm_le_norm_circlePhase_sub_one y
  have hA : 4 * eps * ‖A‖ ≤ 2 := by
    calc
      4 * eps * ‖A‖ = ‖A‖ * (4 * eps) := by ring
      _ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖z - 1‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hchord (norm_nonneg A)
      _ ≤ 2 := hprod
  have hA_nonneg : 0 ≤ 4 * eps * ‖A‖ := by positivity
  have hA_sq : (4 * eps * ‖A‖) ^ 2 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ hA_nonneg (by positivity)).mpr hA
  have hnormSq : 2 * Complex.normSq A ≤ N := by
    rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg eps, sq_nonneg ‖A‖]
  change (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * Complex.normSq A ≤ 1 / 2
  rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN)]
  nlinarith

name: TranslationalTilings.separatorOrder_pos
statement: private theorem separatorOrder_pos (eps : ℚ) : 0 < separatorOrder eps
proof:
:= by
  simp [separatorOrder]

name: TranslationalTilings.separatorOrder_scale
statement:
private theorem separatorOrder_scale (eps : ℚ) (heps : 0 < eps) :
    1 ≤ (separatorOrder eps : ℝ) * (2 * (eps : ℝ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℚ := (1 : ℚ) / (2 * eps ^ 2)
  have hden : 0 < (2 * eps ^ 2 : ℚ) := by positivity
  have hqpos : 0 < q := div_pos zero_lt_one hden
  have hceil : q ≤ (⌈q⌉ : ℚ) := Int.le_ceil q
  have hceil0 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ ⌈q⌉ := Int.ceil_nonneg hqpos.le
  have hqnat : q ≤ (Int.toNat ⌈q⌉ : ℚ) := by
    calc
      q ≤ (⌈q⌉ : ℚ) := hceil
      _ = (Int.toNat ⌈q⌉ : ℚ) := by
        norm_cast
        exact (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hceil0).symm
  have hqN : q ≤ (separatorOrder eps : ℚ) :=
    hqnat.trans (by
      exact_mod_cast (le_max_right 1 (Int.toNat ⌈q⌉)))
  have hscaleQ : (1 : ℚ) ≤
      (separatorOrder eps : ℚ) * (2 * eps ^ 2) := by
    calc
      (1 : ℚ) = q * (2 * eps ^ 2) := by
        dsimp [q]
        field_simp
      _ ≤ (separatorOrder eps : ℚ) * (2 * eps ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hqN hden.le
  exact_mod_cast hscaleQ

name: TranslationalTilings.fejerSeparatorEval_eq_kernel
statement:
private theorem fejerSeparatorEval_eq_kernel
    (c : Torus) (eps : ℚ) (x : Torus) :
    let N := separatorOrder eps
    let z := circlePhase (x - c)
    let A := ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, z ^ j
    fejerSeparatorEval c eps x =
      -2 * ((N : ℂ)⁻¹ * (Complex.normSq A : ℂ) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let N := separatorOrder eps
  let z := circlePhase (x - c)
  let s := Finset.Icc (-((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
  have hN : 0 < N := separatorOrder_pos eps
  have hdegree : separatorDegree eps = N - 1 := rfl
  have hzero : (0 : ℤ) ∈ s := by
    simp [s]
  have hz : ‖z‖ = 1 := by
    change ‖circlePhase (x - c)‖ = 1
    rw [circlePhase, fourier_one]
    exact Circle.norm_coe _
  have hterm (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
      fejerSeparatorCoeff c eps k * circlePhase (k • x) =
        -2 * (fejerWeight N k : ℂ) * z ^ k := by
    have hphase : circlePhase ((-k) • c) * circlePhase (k • x) = z ^ k := by
      calc
        circlePhase ((-k) • c) * circlePhase (k • x) =
            circlePhase ((-k) • c + k • x) :=
              (circlePhase_add _ _).symm
        _ = circlePhase (k • (x - c)) := by
              congr 1
              simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
        _ = z ^ k := by
              exact circlePhase_zsmul k (x - c)
    rw [fejerSeparatorCoeff, if_neg hk]
    rw [mul_assoc, hphase]
  have heval : fejerSeparatorEval c eps x =
      -2 * ((∑ k ∈ s, (fejerWeight N k : ℂ) * z ^ k) - 1) := by
    calc
      fejerSeparatorEval c eps x =
          ∑ k ∈ s.erase 0,
            fejerSeparatorCoeff c eps k * circlePhase (k • x) := by
              rw [fejerSeparatorEval, hdegree]
              change (∑ k ∈ s,
                fejerSeparatorCoeff c eps k * circlePhase (k • x)) = _
              rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add s
                (fun k ↦ fejerSeparatorCoeff c eps k * circlePhase (k • x)) hzero]
              simp [fejerSeparatorCoeff]
      _ = ∑ k ∈ s.erase 0,
          -2 * (fejerWeight N k : ℂ) * z ^ k := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro k hk
            exact hterm k (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hk)
      _ = -2 * ∑ k ∈ s.erase 0,
          (fejerWeight N k : ℂ) * z ^ k := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = -2 * ((∑ k ∈ s, (fejerWeight N k : ℂ) * z ^ k) - 1) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add s
              (fun k ↦ (fejerWeight N k : ℂ) * z ^ k) hzero]
            simp [fejerWeight, hN]
  rw [heval]
  have hkernel := fejer_sum_eq_pair_average N hN z
  rw [pair_phase_sum_eq_normSq N z hz] at hkernel
  rw [hkernel]

name: TranslationalTilings.fejerWeight_nonneg
statement:
private theorem fejerWeight_nonneg (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (k : ℤ) :
    0 ≤ fejerWeight N k
proof:
:= by
  rw [fejerWeight]
  split_ifs with hk
  · have hden : (0 : ℚ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
    have hratio : (Int.natAbs k : ℚ) / N ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one hden]
      exact_mod_cast hk.le
    linarith
  · exact le_rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.sum_fejerWeight
proof:
:= by
  have h := fejer_sum_eq_pair_average N hN (1 : ℂ)
  norm_num [Finset.card_product] at h
  have hN0 : (N : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hN)
  have hrhs : (N : ℂ)⁻¹ * ((N : ℂ) * (N : ℂ)) = (N : ℂ) := by
    field_simp
  rw [hrhs] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: TranslationalTilings.norm_fejerSeparatorCoeff_of_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem norm_fejerSeparatorCoeff_of_ne_zero
    (c : Torus) (eps : ℚ) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    ‖fejerSeparatorCoeff c eps k‖ =
      2 * (fejerWeight (separatorOrder eps) k : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fejerSeparatorCoeff, if_neg hk, norm_mul, norm_mul]
  have hphase : ‖circlePhase ((-k) • c)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [circlePhase, fourier_one]
    exact Circle.norm_coe _
  rw [hphase, mul_one]
  rw [Complex.norm_ratCast]
  norm_num only [norm_neg, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by
    exact_mod_cast (fejerWeight_nonneg
      (separatorOrder eps) (separatorOrder_pos eps) k))]
  norm_num

name: TranslationalTilings.fejerSeparator_l1_le
statement:
private theorem fejerSeparator_l1_le (c : Torus) (eps : ℚ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (-(separatorDegree eps : ℤ))
        (separatorDegree eps : ℤ),
      ‖fejerSeparatorCoeff c eps k‖) ≤
        (separatorL1NatBound eps : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let D := separatorDegree eps
  let s := Finset.Icc (-(D : ℤ)) (D : ℤ)
  have hzero : (0 : ℤ) ∈ s := by simp [s]
  let N := separatorOrder eps
  have hN : 0 < N := separatorOrder_pos eps
  have hdegree : D = N - 1 := rfl
  have hweights : ∑ k ∈ s.erase 0, fejerWeight N k = D := by
    have hall := sum_fejerWeight N hN
    change (∑ k ∈ s, fejerWeight N k) = N at hall
    rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add s (fejerWeight N) hzero] at hall
    simp [fejerWeight, hN, hdegree] at hall ⊢
    linarith
  have hweightsR : ∑ k ∈ s.erase 0,
      (fejerWeight N k : ℝ) = D := by
    exact_mod_cast hweights
  calc
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (-(separatorDegree eps : ℤ))
        (separatorDegree eps : ℤ),
      ‖fejerSeparatorCoeff c eps k‖) =
        ∑ k ∈ s.erase 0, ‖fejerSeparatorCoeff c eps k‖ := by
          change (∑ k ∈ s, ‖fejerSeparatorCoeff c eps k‖) = _
          rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add s
            (fun k ↦ ‖fejerSeparatorCoeff c eps k‖) hzero]
          simp [fejerSeparatorCoeff]
    _ = ∑ k ∈ s.erase 0,
          2 * (fejerWeight N k : ℝ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro k hk
          exact norm_fejerSeparatorCoeff_of_ne_zero c eps k
            (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hk)
    _ = 2 * ∑ k ∈ s.erase 0,
          (fejerWeight N k : ℝ) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = (2 * D : ℕ) := by
          rw [hweightsR]
          norm_num
    _ ≤ (separatorL1NatBound eps : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast (le_max_right 1 (2 * D))

name: TranslationalTilings.fejer_separator_spec
statement:
theorem fejer_separator_spec
    (c : Torus) (eps : ℚ) (heps : 0 < eps) (hsmall : eps < 1 / 2) :
  fejerSeparatorCoeff c eps 0 = 0 ∧
  (∀ k, separatorDegree eps < Int.natAbs k →
    fejerSeparatorCoeff c eps k = 0) ∧
  (∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c (eps : ℝ) →
    (fejerSeparatorEval c eps x).im = 0 ∧
    1 ≤ (fejerSeparatorEval c eps x).re) ∧
  (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (-(separatorDegree eps : ℤ))
      (separatorDegree eps : ℤ),
    ‖fejerSeparatorCoeff c eps k‖) ≤
      (separatorL1NatBound eps : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have _hsmall := hsmall
  have hN : 0 < separatorOrder eps := separatorOrder_pos eps
  refine ⟨by simp [fejerSeparatorCoeff], ?_, ?_,
    fejerSeparator_l1_le c eps⟩
  · intro k hk
    rw [fejerSeparatorCoeff]
    split_ifs with hk0
    · rfl
    · have hcut : separatorOrder eps ≤ Int.natAbs k := by
        rw [separatorDegree] at hk
        omega
      rw [fejerWeight, if_neg (not_lt_of_ge hcut)]
      simp
  · intro x hx
    have hy : (eps : ℝ) ≤ ‖x - c‖ := by
      simp only [Metric.mem_ball] at hx
      rw [← dist_eq_norm]
      exact le_of_not_gt hx
    have hkernel : (separatorOrder eps : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        Complex.normSq
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (separatorOrder eps),
            circlePhase (x - c) ^ j) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      exact fejer_kernel_le_half (separatorOrder eps) hN (eps : ℝ)
        (by exact_mod_cast heps) (separatorOrder_scale eps heps)
        (x - c) hy
    have heval := fejerSeparatorEval_eq_kernel c eps x
    dsimp only at heval
    rw [heval]
    constructor
    · norm_num
    · norm_num at ⊢
      nlinarith

name: TranslationalTilings.complete_exponential_sum_paper
statement:
theorem complete_exponential_sum_paper
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (P : CirclePolynomial d)
    (hrat : P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs)
    (_hnonconstant : ¬ P.CoefficientConstant) :
  ‖completeSum P P.commonDenominator‖ ≤
    (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) *
      Real.rpow (P.commonDenominator : ℝ)
        (1 - (1 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_completeSum_eq_integralPhase P hrat]
  simpa only [integralPhase_modulus] using
    integral_complete_exponential_sum_effective d hd (P.integralPhase hrat)
      (integralPhase_primitive P hrat)

name: TranslationalTilings.complete_exponential_sum_paper_functionNonconstant
statement:
theorem complete_exponential_sum_paper_functionNonconstant
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (P : CirclePolynomial d)
    (hrat : P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs)
    (hnonconstant : ¬ P.FunctionConstant) :
  ‖completeSum P P.commonDenominator‖ ≤
    (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) *
      Real.rpow (P.commonDenominator : ℝ)
        (1 - (1 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  exact complete_exponential_sum_paper d hd P hrat
    (P.not_coefficientConstant_of_not_functionConstant hnonconstant)

name: TranslationalTilings.complete_exponential_sum_paper_bigO
statement:
theorem complete_exponential_sum_paper_bigO (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ P : CirclePolynomial d,
    P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs → ¬ P.FunctionConstant →
    ‖completeSum P P.commonDenominator‖ ≤
      C * Real.rpow (P.commonDenominator : ℝ)
        (1 - (1 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨stechkinNatConstant d, Nat.cast_nonneg _, ?_⟩
  intro P hrat hnonconstant
  exact complete_exponential_sum_paper_functionNonconstant
    d hd P hrat hnonconstant

name: TranslationalTilings.rigidityPeriodBound_pos
statement:
theorem rigidityPeriodBound_pos (d : ℕ) (eps : ℚ) :
  0 < rigidityPeriodBound d eps
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rigidityPeriodBound]
  split <;> omega

name: TranslationalTilings.zsmul_eval
statement:
private theorem zsmul_eval (P : CirclePolynomial d) (k : ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    P.zsmul k n = k • P n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [CirclePolynomial.eval, CirclePolynomial.zsmul]
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: TranslationalTilings.exists_large_completeSum
statement:
private theorem exists_large_completeSum
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (c : Torus) (eps : ℚ)
    (heps : 0 < eps) (hsmall : eps < 1 / 2)
    (Q : ℕ) (hQ : 0 < Q) (havoid : P.AvoidsBall c eps) :
  ∃ k ∈ Finset.Icc (-(separatorDegree eps : ℤ))
      (separatorDegree eps : ℤ),
    k ≠ 0 ∧
    (Q : ℝ) / separatorL1NatBound eps ≤
      ‖completeSum (P.zsmul k) Q‖
proof:
:= by
  let K : Finset ℤ := Finset.Icc (-(separatorDegree eps : ℤ))
      (separatorDegree eps : ℤ)
  let a : ℤ → ℂ := fejerSeparatorCoeff c eps
  let S : ℤ → ℂ := fun k ↦ completeSum (P.zsmul k) Q
  obtain ⟨ha0, _, hpositive, hl1⟩ :=
    fejer_separator_spec c eps heps hsmall
  have hexpand :
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q, fejerSeparatorEval c eps (P n)) =
        ∑ k ∈ K, a k * S k := by
    simp only [fejerSeparatorEval, K, a, S, completeSum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro n _
    rw [zsmul_eval]
  have hQcard : (Q : ℝ) =
      ∑ _n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q, (1 : ℝ) := by
    simp [Nat.card_Icc]
  have hQre : (Q : ℝ) ≤
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q,
        fejerSeparatorEval c eps (P n)).re := by
    rw [hQcard]
    change (∑ _n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q, (1 : ℝ)) ≤
      Complex.reCLM (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q,
        fejerSeparatorEval c eps (P n))
    rw [map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro n _
    exact (hpositive (P n) (havoid n)).2
  have hweighted : (Q : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ K, ‖a k‖ * ‖S k‖ := by
    calc
      (Q : ℝ) ≤ (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q,
        fejerSeparatorEval c eps (P n)).re := hQre
      _ = (∑ k ∈ K, a k * S k).re := congrArg Complex.re hexpand
      _ ≤ ‖∑ k ∈ K, a k * S k‖ := Complex.re_le_norm _
      _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ K, ‖a k * S k‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ = ∑ k ∈ K, ‖a k‖ * ‖S k‖ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        exact norm_mul _ _
  have hLpos : 0 < separatorL1NatBound eps := by
    simp [separatorL1NatBound]
  have hLcast : 0 < (separatorL1NatBound eps : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hLpos
  have hQcast : 0 < (Q : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hQ
  have hmass : (∑ k ∈ K, ‖a k‖) ≤
      (separatorL1NatBound eps : ℝ) := by
    simpa [K, a] using hl1
  have hex : ∃ k ∈ K, a k ≠ 0 ∧
      (Q : ℝ) / separatorL1NatBound eps ≤ ‖S k‖ := by
    by_contra hnone
    push Not at hnone
    have hterm_le (k : ℤ) (hk : k ∈ K) :
        ‖a k‖ * ‖S k‖ ≤ ‖a k‖ *
          ((Q : ℝ) / separatorL1NatBound eps) := by
      rcases eq_or_ne (a k) 0 with ha | ha
      · simp [ha]
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (le_of_lt (hnone k hk ha)) (norm_nonneg _)
    have hsum_le : (∑ k ∈ K, ‖a k‖ * ‖S k‖) ≤
        ∑ k ∈ K, ‖a k‖ *
          ((Q : ℝ) / separatorL1NatBound eps) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum hterm_le
    have hright : (∑ k ∈ K, ‖a k‖ *
        ((Q : ℝ) / separatorL1NatBound eps)) ≤ Q := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      calc
        (∑ k ∈ K, ‖a k‖) *
            ((Q : ℝ) / separatorL1NatBound eps) ≤
            (separatorL1NatBound eps : ℝ) *
              ((Q : ℝ) / separatorL1NatBound eps) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmass
            (div_nonneg hQcast.le hLcast.le)
        _ = Q := by field_simp
    have hQeq : (∑ k ∈ K, ‖a k‖ * ‖S k‖) = Q :=
      le_antisymm (hsum_le.trans hright) hweighted
    have hpositiveSum : 0 < ∑ k ∈ K, ‖a k‖ * ‖S k‖ := by
      rw [hQeq]
      exact hQcast
    rw [Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg
      (fun k _ ↦ mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))] at hpositiveSum
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkpos⟩ := hpositiveSum
    have hwpos : 0 < ‖a k‖ := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (a k), norm_nonneg (S k)]
    have hak : a k ≠ 0 := by
      intro hak
      simp [hak] at hwpos
    have hstrict : ‖a k‖ * ‖S k‖ <
        ‖a k‖ * ((Q : ℝ) / separatorL1NatBound eps) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (hnone k hk hak) hwpos
    have hsum_strict : (∑ k ∈ K, ‖a k‖ * ‖S k‖) <
        ∑ k ∈ K, ‖a k‖ *
          ((Q : ℝ) / separatorL1NatBound eps) :=
      Finset.sum_lt_sum hterm_le ⟨k, hk, hstrict⟩
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hweighted) (hsum_strict.trans_le hright)
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hak, hkbound⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨k, hk, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hk0
    subst k
    exact hak ha0
  · simpa [S] using hkbound

name: TranslationalTilings.periodic_of_avoidsBall
statement:
theorem periodic_of_avoidsBall
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (c : Torus) (eps : ℚ)
    (heps : 0 < eps) (hsmall : eps < 1 / 2)
    (havoid : P.AvoidsBall c eps) :
  ∃ Q, 0 < Q ∧ Q ≤ rigidityPeriodBound d eps ∧ P.PeriodicWith Q
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne d 0 with rfl | hd0
  · have hconst : P.CoefficientConstant := by
      intro i hi
      omega
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := P.functionConstant_of_coefficientConstant hconst
    refine ⟨1, by omega, by simp [rigidityPeriodBound], ?_⟩
    intro n
    rw [hx, hx]
  · have hd : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd0
    have hrat : P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs :=
      torsion_nonconstant_coefficients_of_avoidsBall P
        (Rat.cast_pos.mpr heps) havoid
    let Q := P.commonDenominator
    have hQ : 0 < Q := commonDenominator_pos P hrat
    have hperiod : P.PeriodicWith Q := periodic_commonDenominator P hrat
    obtain ⟨k, hkK, hk0, hkLower⟩ :=
      exists_large_completeSum P c eps heps hsmall Q hQ havoid
    let Pk := P.zsmul k
    let q := Pk.commonDenominator
    have hratk : Pk.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs := by
      intro i hi
      exact (hrat i hi).zsmul
    have hq : 0 < q := commonDenominator_pos Pk hratk
    have hqdiv : q ∣ Q := commonDenominator_zsmul_dvd P hrat k
    have hperiodk : Pk.PeriodicWith q := periodic_commonDenominator Pk hratk
    have hrepeat := normalized_completeSum_repeat Pk Q q hQ hq hqdiv hperiodk
    have hrepeatNorm := congrArg norm hrepeat
    have hrepeatReal : ‖completeSum Pk Q‖ / (Q : ℝ) =
        ‖completeSum Pk q‖ / (q : ℝ) := by
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_inv,
        norm_natCast, norm_natCast] at hrepeatNorm
      simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hrepeatNorm
    have hQcast : 0 < (Q : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hQ
    have hqcast : 0 < (q : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hq
    have hLpos : 0 < separatorL1NatBound eps := by
      simp [separatorL1NatBound]
    have hLcast : 0 < (separatorL1NatBound eps : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hLpos
    have hnormalizedLower :
        (1 : ℝ) / separatorL1NatBound eps ≤
          ‖completeSum Pk q‖ / q := by
      calc
        (1 : ℝ) / separatorL1NatBound eps =
            ((Q : ℝ) / separatorL1NatBound eps) / Q := by
          field_simp
        _ ≤ ‖completeSum Pk Q‖ / Q :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hkLower hQcast.le
        _ = ‖completeSum Pk q‖ / q := hrepeatReal
    have hreverse : Q ∣ Int.natAbs k * q :=
      commonDenominator_dvd_natAbs_mul_zsmul P hrat k
    have hkabs : Int.natAbs k ≤ separatorDegree eps := by
      have hkInt : |k| ≤ (separatorDegree eps : ℤ) :=
        (abs_le).2 (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hkK)
      rw [← Nat.cast_le (α := ℤ), Int.natCast_natAbs]
      exact hkInt
    have hQ_le_mul : Q ≤ Int.natAbs k * q :=
      Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.mul_pos (Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hk0) hq) hreverse
    have hq_bound : q ≤
        (stechkinNatConstant d * separatorL1NatBound eps) ^ d := by
      rcases Classical.em Pk.CoefficientConstant with hconstant | hnonconstant
      · have hq_one : q = 1 := by
          change Pk.commonDenominator = 1
          unfold CirclePolynomial.commonDenominator
          calc
            (CirclePolynomial.nonconstantIndices d).lcm
                (fun i ↦ addOrderOf (Pk.coeff i)) =
                (CirclePolynomial.nonconstantIndices d).lcm (fun _ ↦ 1) := by
              apply Finset.lcm_congr rfl
              intro i hi
              have hi' : 0 < (i : ℕ) :=
                (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
              rw [hconstant i hi']
              simp
            _ = 1 := by
              induction CirclePolynomial.nonconstantIndices d using Finset.induction_on with
              | empty => simp
              | @insert i s _ ih => simp [ih]
        rw [hq_one]
        exact Nat.one_le_pow d _ (Nat.mul_pos
          (pow_pos (by omega) _) hLpos)
      · have hupper :=
          complete_exponential_sum_paper d hd Pk hratk hnonconstant
        have hupperDiv : ‖completeSum Pk q‖ / (q : ℝ) ≤
            (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) *
              Real.rpow (q : ℝ) (1 - (1 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) / q :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hupper hqcast.le
        have hrootpos : 0 < Real.rpow (q : ℝ) ((d : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
          Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hqcast _
        have hpowerDiv :
            Real.rpow (q : ℝ) (1 - (1 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) / q =
              (Real.rpow (q : ℝ) ((d : ℝ)⁻¹))⁻¹ := by
          rw [Real.rpow_eq_pow, Real.rpow_eq_pow, one_div]
          rw [Real.rpow_sub hqcast, Real.rpow_one]
          field_simp
        have hrootIneq :
            (1 : ℝ) / separatorL1NatBound eps ≤
              (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) /
                Real.rpow (q : ℝ) ((d : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
          calc
            (1 : ℝ) / separatorL1NatBound eps ≤
                ‖completeSum Pk q‖ / q := hnormalizedLower
            _ ≤ (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) *
                Real.rpow (q : ℝ) (1 - (1 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) / q :=
              hupperDiv
            _ = (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) /
                Real.rpow (q : ℝ) ((d : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
              calc
                (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) *
                    Real.rpow (q : ℝ) (1 - (1 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) / q =
                    (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) *
                      (Real.rpow (q : ℝ) (1 - (1 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) / q) := by
                  ring
                _ = (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) *
                    (Real.rpow (q : ℝ) ((d : ℝ)⁻¹))⁻¹ := by
                  rw [hpowerDiv]
                _ = (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) /
                    Real.rpow (q : ℝ) ((d : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
                  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
        have hrootBound : Real.rpow (q : ℝ) ((d : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
            (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) * separatorL1NatBound eps := by
          have hfirst := (le_div_iff₀ hrootpos).mp hrootIneq
          calc
            Real.rpow (q : ℝ) ((d : ℝ)⁻¹) =
                (((1 : ℝ) / separatorL1NatBound eps) *
                  Real.rpow (q : ℝ) ((d : ℝ)⁻¹)) *
                    separatorL1NatBound eps := by field_simp
            _ ≤ (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) *
                separatorL1NatBound eps :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfirst hLcast.le
        have hrootBound' : (q : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
            (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) * separatorL1NatBound eps := by
          simpa only [Real.rpow_eq_pow] using hrootBound
        have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀
          (Real.rpow_nonneg hqcast.le ((d : ℝ)⁻¹)) hrootBound' d
        have hrootpow :
            (((q : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ)⁻¹) : ℝ) ^ d) = q :=
          Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow hqcast.le hd.ne'
        rw [hrootpow] at hpow
        apply (Nat.cast_le (α := ℝ)).mp
        simpa only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_mul] using hpow
    refine ⟨Q, hQ, ?_, hperiod⟩
    simp only [rigidityPeriodBound, hd0, if_false]
    apply le_trans hQ_le_mul
    apply le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul hkabs hq_bound)
    exact Nat.le_max_right _ _

name: TranslationalTilings.halfCircle_avoidsBall
statement:
theorem halfCircle_avoidsBall
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (hhalf : P.HasHalfCircleLifts) :
  P.AvoidsBall (((3 / 4 : ℝ) : Torus)) (1 / 8 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hPt⟩ := hhalf n
  have hclosed : (t : Torus) ∈
      Metric.closedBall (((3 / 4 : ℝ) : Torus)) (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    rw [← hPt]
    exact Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr (le_of_lt (Metric.mem_ball.mp hn))
  have hpre : t ∈ (fun x : ℝ ↦ (x : Torus)) ⁻¹'
      Metric.closedBall (((3 / 4 : ℝ) : Torus)) (1 / 8 : ℝ) := hclosed
  rw [AddCircle.coe_real_preimage_closedBall_eq_iUnion] at hpre
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.dist_eq] at hpre
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hpre
  rcases eq_or_ne z 0 with rfl | hz0
  · norm_num [zsmul_eq_mul] at hz
    have hsign : t - (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by linarith [ht.2]
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hsign] at hz
    norm_num at hz
    linarith [ht.2]
  · rcases Int.cast_le_neg_one_or_one_le_cast_of_ne_zero ℝ hz0 with hzneg | hzpos
    · norm_num [zsmul_eq_mul] at hz
      have hsign : 0 ≤ t - (3 / 4 + (z : ℝ)) := by linarith [ht.1]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hsign] at hz
      linarith [ht.1]
    · norm_num [zsmul_eq_mul] at hz
      have hsign : t - (3 / 4 + (z : ℝ)) ≤ 0 := by linarith [ht.2]
      rw [abs_of_nonpos hsign] at hz
      linarith [ht.2]

name: TranslationalTilings.periodic_of_halfCircle
statement:
theorem periodic_of_halfCircle
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (hhalf : P.HasHalfCircleLifts) :
  ∃ Q, 0 < Q ∧ Q ≤ halfCirclePeriodBound d ∧ P.PeriodicWith Q
proof:
:= by
  have havoid : P.AvoidsBall (((3 / 4 : ℝ) : Torus))
      (((1 / 8 : ℚ) : ℝ)) := by
    simpa using halfCircle_avoidsBall P hhalf
  simpa only [halfCirclePeriodBound] using
    periodic_of_avoidsBall P (((3 / 4 : ℝ) : Torus)) (1 / 8 : ℚ)
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) havoid

name: TranslationalTilings.period_dvd_universalRigidityPeriod
statement:
theorem period_dvd_universalRigidityPeriod
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hbound : q ≤ halfCirclePeriodBound d) :
  q ∣ universalRigidityPeriod d
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.dvd_lcm
  exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hq, hbound⟩

name: TranslationalTilings.periodic_universalRigidityPeriod
statement:
theorem periodic_universalRigidityPeriod
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (q : ℕ)
    (hperiod : P.PeriodicWith q) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hbound : q ≤ halfCirclePeriodBound d) :
  P.PeriodicWith (universalRigidityPeriod d)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := period_dvd_universalRigidityPeriod q hq hbound
  rw [hm]
  change Function.Periodic P ((q * m : ℕ) : ℤ)
  rw [Nat.cast_mul]
  simpa [mul_comm] using hperiod.nsmul m

name: TranslationalTilings.circlePhase_add
statement:
theorem circlePhase_add (x y : Torus) :
    circlePhase (x + y) = circlePhase x * circlePhase y
proof:
:= by
  simp [circlePhase, fourier_apply, AddCircle.toCircle_add,
    Circle.coe_mul]

name: TranslationalTilings.norm_circlePhase
statement: theorem norm_circlePhase (x : Torus) : ‖circlePhase x‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [circlePhase, fourier_one]
  exact Circle.norm_coe _

name: TranslationalTilings.integral_circlePhase_zsmul
statement:
theorem integral_circlePhase_zsmul (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    ∫ x : Torus, circlePhase (k • x) ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (fourierCoeff_fourier (T := (1 : ℝ)) k) 0
  simpa [fourierCoeff, fourier_apply, circlePhase, hk] using h

name: TranslationalTilings.continuousMap_integrable
statement:
private theorem continuousMap_integrable (f : C(Torus, ℂ)) :
    MeasureTheory.Integrable f AddCircle.haarAddCircle
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [MeasureTheory.integrableOn_univ] using
    (ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_univ
      f.continuous.continuousOn)

name: TranslationalTilings.cesaroAverage_comp_add
statement:
private theorem cesaroAverage_comp_add (u : ℕ → Torus)
    (f g : C(Torus, ℂ)) (N : ℕ) :
    cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ (f + g) (u n)) N =
      cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ f (u n)) N +
        cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cesaroAverage, ContinuousMap.add_apply,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_add]

name: TranslationalTilings.cesaroAverage_comp_smul
statement:
private theorem cesaroAverage_comp_smul (u : ℕ → Torus)
    (a : ℂ) (f : C(Torus, ℂ)) (N : ℕ) :
    cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ (a • f) (u n)) N =
      a • cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ f (u n)) N
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cesaroAverage, ContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring

name: TranslationalTilings.norm_cesaroAverage_comp_sub_le
statement:
private theorem norm_cesaroAverage_comp_sub_le (u : ℕ → Torus)
    (f g : C(Torus, ℂ)) (N : ℕ) :
    ‖cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ f (u n)) N -
        cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N‖ ≤ ‖f - g‖
proof:
:= by
  have heq : cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ f (u n)) N -
      cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N =
      cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ (f - g) (u n)) N := by
    simp [cesaroAverage, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub]
  rw [heq]
  rw [cesaroAverage]
  calc
    ‖(N : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (f (u n) - g (u n))‖
        ≤ ‖(N : ℂ)⁻¹‖ *
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ‖f (u n) - g (u n)‖ := by
          exact (norm_mul_le _ _).trans
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_sum_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ ‖(N : ℂ)⁻¹‖ *
            ∑ _n ∈ Finset.range N, ‖f - g‖ := by
          gcongr with n hn
          simpa only [ContinuousMap.sub_apply] using
            ContinuousMap.norm_coe_le_norm (f - g) (u n)
    _ ≤ ‖f - g‖ := by
          by_cases hN : N = 0
          · simp [hN]
          · simp [norm_inv, hN]

name: TranslationalTilings.norm_integral_continuousMap_sub_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_sub (continuousMap_integrable f)
    (continuousMap_integrable g)]
  have h := MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
    (μ := AddCircle.haarAddCircle)
    (f := fun x ↦ f x - g x) (C := ‖f - g‖)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ by
      simpa only [ContinuousMap.sub_apply] using
        ContinuousMap.norm_coe_le_norm (f - g) x)
  simpa using h

name: TranslationalTilings.fourier_limit_implies_equidistributed
statement:
private theorem fourier_limit_implies_equidistributed
    (u : ℕ → Torus)
    (hchar : ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 0 → Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N ↦ cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ circlePhase (k • u n)) N)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Equidistributed u
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  have hspan : ∀ g : C(Torus, ℂ),
      g ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (@fourier (1 : ℝ))) →
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun N ↦ cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N)
        Filter.atTop
        (nhds (∫ x, g x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle)) := by
    intro g hg
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun g _ ↦ Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N ↦ cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (∫ x, g x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle)))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
    · intro g hg
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hg
      by_cases hk : k = 0
      · subst k
        have hev : ∀ᶠ N in Filter.atTop,
            cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ fourier 0 (u n)) N = 1 := by
          filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN
          simp [cesaroAverage, Nat.ne_of_gt hN]
        have hlim : Filter.Tendsto
            (fun N ↦ cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ fourier 0 (u n)) N)
            Filter.atTop (nhds 1) :=
          tendsto_const_nhds.congr' (hev.mono fun _ hN ↦ hN.symm)
        simpa using hlim
      · have hc := hchar k hk
        convert hc using 1
        · funext N
          congr 2
          funext n
          simp [circlePhase, fourier_apply]
        · apply congrArg nhds
          rw [← integral_circlePhase_zsmul k hk]
          apply MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards [] with x
          simp [circlePhase, fourier_apply]
    · simp [cesaroAverage]
    · intro g₁ g₂ _ _ hg₁ hg₂
      convert hg₁.add hg₂ using 1
      · funext N
        exact cesaroAverage_comp_add u g₁ g₂ N
      · apply congrArg nhds
        exact MeasureTheory.integral_add
          (continuousMap_integrable g₁) (continuousMap_integrable g₂)
    · intro a g _ hg
      convert hg.const_smul a using 1
      · funext N
        exact cesaroAverage_comp_smul u a g N
      · apply congrArg nhds
        simpa only [ContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using
          (MeasureTheory.integral_smul (μ := AddCircle.haarAddCircle)
            a (fun x ↦ g x))
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro eps heps
  have hfclosure :
      f ∈ (Submodule.span ℂ
        (Set.range (@fourier (1 : ℝ)))).topologicalClosure := by
    rw [span_fourier_closure_eq_top]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨g, hgspan, hgf⟩ :=
    (Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hfclosure) (eps / 4) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp (hspan g hgspan)
    (eps / 2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨N₀, fun N hN ↦ ?_⟩
  have havg := norm_cesaroAverage_comp_sub_le u f g N
  have hint := norm_integral_continuousMap_sub_le g f
  have hmid := hN₀ N hN
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at hgf hmid ⊢
  calc
    ‖cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ f (u n)) N -
        ∫ x, f x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle‖
        ≤ ‖cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ f (u n)) N -
              cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N‖ +
            ‖cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N -
              ∫ x, g x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle‖ +
            ‖(∫ x, g x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) -
              ∫ x, f x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle‖ := by
          calc
            _ = ‖(cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ f (u n)) N -
                    cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N) +
                  (cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N -
                    ∫ x, g x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) +
                  ((∫ x, g x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) -
                    ∫ x, f x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle)‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ _ := (norm_add_le _ _).trans
              (add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl)
    _ < eps := by
      have havg' : ‖cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ f (u n)) N -
          cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N‖ < eps / 4 :=
        havg.trans_lt hgf
      have hint' : ‖(∫ x, g x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) -
          ∫ x, f x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle‖ < eps / 4 :=
        hint.trans_lt (by simpa [norm_sub_rev] using hgf)
      linarith

name: TranslationalTilings.equidistributed_iff_characters
statement:
theorem equidistributed_iff_characters (u : ℕ → Torus) :
  Equidistributed u ↔ ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 0 → Filter.Tendsto
    (fun N ↦ cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ circlePhase (k • u n)) N)
    Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hu k hk
    have h := hu (fourier k)
    have hi := integral_circlePhase_zsmul k hk
    convert h using 1
    · funext N
      congr 2
      funext n
      simp [circlePhase, fourier_apply]
    · apply congrArg nhds
      rw [← hi]
      apply MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with x
      simp [circlePhase, fourier_apply]
  · exact fourier_limit_implies_equidistributed u

name: TranslationalTilings.symmetricCesaroAverage_comp_add
statement:
private theorem symmetricCesaroAverage_comp_add (u : ℤ → Torus)
    (f g : C(Torus, ℂ)) (N : ℕ) :
    symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ (f + g) (u n)) N =
      symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ f (u n)) N +
        symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N
proof:
:= by
  simp only [symmetricCesaroAverage, ContinuousMap.add_apply,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_add]

name: TranslationalTilings.symmetricCesaroAverage_comp_smul
statement:
private theorem symmetricCesaroAverage_comp_smul (u : ℤ → Torus)
    (a : ℂ) (f : C(Torus, ℂ)) (N : ℕ) :
    symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ (a • f) (u n)) N =
      a • symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ f (u n)) N
proof:
:= by
  simp only [symmetricCesaroAverage, ContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring

name: TranslationalTilings.norm_symmetricCesaroAverage_comp_sub_le
statement:
private theorem norm_symmetricCesaroAverage_comp_sub_le (u : ℤ → Torus)
    (f g : C(Torus, ℂ)) (N : ℕ) :
    ‖symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ f (u n)) N -
        symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N‖ ≤ ‖f - g‖
proof:
:= by
  have heq : symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ f (u n)) N -
      symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N =
      symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ (f - g) (u n)) N := by
    simp [symmetricCesaroAverage, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub]
  rw [heq, symmetricCesaroAverage]
  have hcard : (Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ)).card = 2 * N + 1 := by
    rw [Int.card_Icc]
    omega
  calc
    ‖(((2 * N + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ))⁻¹ *
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ),
          (f (u n) - g (u n))‖
        ≤ ‖(((2 * N + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ))⁻¹‖ *
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ),
              ‖f (u n) - g (u n)‖ := by
          exact (norm_mul_le _ _).trans
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_sum_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ ‖(((2 * N + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ))⁻¹‖ *
            ∑ _n ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ), ‖f - g‖ := by
          gcongr with n hn
          simpa only [ContinuousMap.sub_apply] using
            ContinuousMap.norm_coe_le_norm (f - g) (u n)
    _ ≤ ‖f - g‖ := by
          simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hcard,
            norm_inv, norm_natCast]
          push_cast
          field_simp
          exact le_rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.symmetric_fourier_limit
statement:
private theorem symmetric_fourier_limit
    (u : ℤ → Torus)
    (hchar : ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 0 → Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N ↦ symmetricCesaroAverage
        (fun n ↦ circlePhase (k • u n)) N)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (k : ℤ) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N ↦ symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ fourier k (u n)) N)
      Filter.atTop
      (nhds (∫ x : Torus, fourier k x
        ∂(AddCircle.haarAddCircle : MeasureTheory.Measure Torus)))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst k
    have heq : (fun N ↦ symmetricCesaroAverage
          (fun n ↦ fourier 0 (u n)) N) = fun _ ↦ 1 := by
      funext N
      have hcard : (Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ)).card =
          2 * N + 1 := by
        rw [Int.card_Icc]
        omega
      simp only [symmetricCesaroAverage, fourier_zero,
        Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hcard]
      push_cast
      have hd : (2 * (N : ℂ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast (show 2 * N + 1 ≠ 0 by omega)
      rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hd, one_mul]
    rw [heq]
    simp
  · have hc := hchar k hk
    convert hc using 1
    · funext N
      congr 2
      funext n
      simp [circlePhase, fourier_apply]
    · apply congrArg nhds
      rw [← integral_circlePhase_zsmul k hk]
      apply MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with x
      simp [circlePhase, fourier_apply]

name: TranslationalTilings.symmetric_fourier_span_limit
statement:
private theorem symmetric_fourier_span_limit
    (u : ℤ → Torus)
    (hchar : ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 0 → Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N ↦ symmetricCesaroAverage
        (fun n ↦ circlePhase (k • u n)) N)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (g : C(Torus, ℂ))
    (hg : g ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (@fourier (1 : ℝ)))) :
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun N ↦ symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N)
        Filter.atTop
        (nhds (∫ x, g x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle))
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (@fourier (1 : ℝ))) ≤
      symmetricLimitSubmodule u := Submodule.span_le.mpr (by
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
    change Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N ↦ symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ fourier k (u n)) N)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (∫ x, fourier k x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle))
    exact symmetric_fourier_limit u hchar k)
  exact hle hg

name: TranslationalTilings.fourier_limit_implies_equidistributedInt
statement:
private theorem fourier_limit_implies_equidistributedInt
    (u : ℤ → Torus)
    (hchar : ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 0 → Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N ↦ symmetricCesaroAverage
        (fun n ↦ circlePhase (k • u n)) N)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
    EquidistributedInt u
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro eps heps
  have hfclosure :
      f ∈ (Submodule.span ℂ
        (Set.range (@fourier (1 : ℝ)))).topologicalClosure := by
    rw [span_fourier_closure_eq_top]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨g, hgspan, hgf⟩ :=
    (Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hfclosure) (eps / 4) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp
    (symmetric_fourier_span_limit u hchar g hgspan)
    (eps / 2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨N₀, fun N hN ↦ ?_⟩
  have havg := norm_symmetricCesaroAverage_comp_sub_le u f g N
  have hint := norm_integral_continuousMap_sub_le g f
  have hmid := hN₀ N hN
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at hgf hmid ⊢
  calc
    ‖symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ f (u n)) N -
        ∫ x, f x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle‖
        ≤ ‖symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ f (u n)) N -
              symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N‖ +
            ‖symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N -
              ∫ x, g x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle‖ +
            ‖(∫ x, g x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) -
              ∫ x, f x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle‖ := by
          calc
            _ = ‖(symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ f (u n)) N -
                    symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N) +
                  (symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N -
                    ∫ x, g x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) +
                  ((∫ x, g x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) -
                    ∫ x, f x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle)‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ _ := (norm_add_le _ _).trans
              (add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl)
    _ < eps := by
      have havg' : ‖symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ f (u n)) N -
          symmetricCesaroAverage (fun n ↦ g (u n)) N‖ < eps / 4 :=
        havg.trans_lt hgf
      have hint' : ‖(∫ x, g x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) -
          ∫ x, f x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle‖ < eps / 4 :=
        hint.trans_lt (by simpa [norm_sub_rev] using hgf)
      linarith

name: TranslationalTilings.equidistributedInt_iff_characters
statement:
theorem equidistributedInt_iff_characters (u : ℤ → Torus) :

proof:
:= by

    have hi := integral_circlePhase_zsmul k hk

    · funext N
      congr 2

    · apply congrArg nhds
      rw [← hi]

name: TranslationalTilings.nontorsion_zsmul
statement:
theorem nontorsion_zsmul {a : Torus} (ha : addOrderOf a = 0)
    {k : ℤ} (hk : k ≠ 0) : addOrderOf (k • a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hpos : 0 < addOrderOf (k • a) := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne
  have hz : (addOrderOf (k • a) : ℤ) • (k • a) = 0 :=
    addOrderOf_dvd_iff_zsmul_eq_zero.mp (dvd_refl _)
  have hz' : ((addOrderOf (k • a) : ℤ) * k) • a = 0 := by
    simpa only [mul_smul] using hz
  have hdiv : (addOrderOf a : ℤ) ∣
      (addOrderOf (k • a) : ℤ) * k :=
    addOrderOf_dvd_iff_zsmul_eq_zero.mpr hz'
  rw [ha] at hdiv
  have hprod : (addOrderOf (k • a) : ℤ) * k = 0 := by
    simpa using hdiv
  exact hk (mul_eq_zero.mp hprod |>.resolve_left
    (Int.ofNat_ne_zero.mpr hpos.ne'))

name: TranslationalTilings.cesaro_powers_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem cesaro_powers_tendsto_zero (z : ℂ)
    (hz : z ≠ 1) (hnorm : ‖z‖ = 1) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun N ↦ cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ z ^ n) N)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
  have hlim : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N : ℕ ↦ (2 / ‖z - 1‖) * (1 / (N : ℝ)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using (tendsto_one_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)).const_mul
      (2 / ‖z - 1‖)
  apply squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun N ↦ norm_nonneg _)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun N ↦ ?_) hlim
  by_cases hN : N = 0
  · simp [hN, cesaroAverage]
  have hden : z - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hz
  have hsum : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, z ^ n) =
      (z ^ N - 1) / (z - 1) :=
    (eq_div_iff hden).2 (geom_sum_mul z N)
  rw [cesaroAverage, hsum, norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_div, norm_natCast]
  have hnum : ‖z ^ N - 1‖ ≤ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖z ^ N - 1‖ ≤ ‖z ^ N‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ = 2 := by rw [norm_pow, hnorm]; norm_num
  have hdpos : 0 < ‖z - 1‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hden
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hN
  rw [inv_eq_one_div]
  calc
    (1 / (N : ℝ)) * (‖z ^ N - 1‖ / ‖z - 1‖) ≤
        (1 / (N : ℝ)) * (2 / ‖z - 1‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hdpos.le) (by positivity)
    _ = (2 / ‖z - 1‖) * (1 / (N : ℝ)) := by ring

name: TranslationalTilings.irrational_linear_phase_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem irrational_linear_phase_tendsto_zero
    (a : Torus) (ha : addOrderOf a = 0) (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun N ↦ cesaroAverage
      (fun n ↦ circlePhase (k • ((n : ℤ) • a))) N)
    Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  let z := circlePhase (k • a)
  have hz : z ≠ 1 := by
    intro hz1
    have hx0 : k • a = 0 := by
      apply AddCircle.injective_toCircle one_ne_zero
      have hc : (k • a).toCircle = 1 :=
        Circle.coe_injective (by
          simpa [z, circlePhase, fourier_one] using hz1)
      simp [hc]
    have hord := nontorsion_zsmul ha hk
    rw [hx0] at hord
    simp at hord
  have hnorm : ‖z‖ = 1 := norm_circlePhase (k • a)
  convert cesaro_powers_tendsto_zero z hz hnorm using 1
  funext N
  congr 2
  funext n
  rw [show k • ((n : ℤ) • a) = n • (k • a) by
    change k • ((n : ℤ) • a) = (n : ℤ) • (k • a)
    rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm]]
  simp [z, circlePhase, AddCircle.toCircle_nsmul, Circle.coe_pow]

name: TranslationalTilings.norm_sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq_norm
statement:
private theorem norm_sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq_norm
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℂ) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ ^ 2 ≤ (s.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
  have hsq : (∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖) ^ 2 ≤
      (s.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ ^ 2 :=
    by
      simpa [mul_comm] using
        (Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq s
          (fun i ↦ ‖f i‖) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)))
  have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ ↦ norm_nonneg (f i))
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (∑ i ∈ s, f i)]

name: TranslationalTilings.block_norm_expansion
statement:
private theorem block_norm_expansion (u : ℕ → ℂ) (H N : ℕ) :
    (((∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
        ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i)‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range H,
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u (n + i)) * u (n + j)
proof:
:= by
  push_cast
  have hterm (z : ℂ) : (‖z‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 = star z * z := by
    calc
      (‖z‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 = ((‖z‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
      _ = star z * z := by
        rw [Complex.sq_norm]
        simpa only [starRingEnd_apply] using
          Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self (z := z)
  simp_rw [hterm, star_sum, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  congr 1
  funext i
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: TranslationalTilings.norm_shifted_sum_le
statement:
private theorem norm_shifted_sum_le (f : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hf : ∀ n, ‖f n‖ ≤ 1) (i N : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (n + i)‖ ≤
      ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n‖ + 2 * i
proof:
:= by
  have hshift :
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (n + i)) -
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n =
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range i, f (N + n)) -
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.range i, f n := by
    have hi := Finset.sum_range_add f i N
    have hN := Finset.sum_range_add f N i
    simp_rw [Nat.add_comm i] at hi
    linear_combination -(hi) + hN
  calc
    ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (n + i)‖ ≤
        ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n‖ +
          ‖(∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (n + i)) -
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n‖ := by
      have heq : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (n + i)) =
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n) +
            ((∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (n + i)) -
              ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n) := by ring
      calc
        ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (n + i)‖ =
            ‖(∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n) +
              ((∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (n + i)) -
                ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n)‖ := congrArg norm heq
        _ ≤ _ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n‖ +
          ‖(∑ n ∈ Finset.range i, f (N + n)) -
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.range i, f n‖ := by rw [hshift]
    _ ≤ ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n‖ +
          ((i : ℝ) + i) := by
      gcongr
      calc
        ‖(∑ n ∈ Finset.range i, f (N + n)) -
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.range i, f n‖ ≤
            ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range i, f (N + n)‖ +
              ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range i, f n‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ (∑ _n ∈ Finset.range i, (1 : ℝ)) +
              ∑ _n ∈ Finset.range i, (1 : ℝ) := by
          gcongr
          · exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans
              (Finset.sum_le_sum fun n hn ↦ hf (N + n))
          · exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans
              (Finset.sum_le_sum fun n hn ↦ hf n)
        _ = (i : ℝ) + i := by simp
    _ = ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n‖ + 2 * i := by ring

name: TranslationalTilings.norm_sum_sub_shifted_sum_le
statement:
private theorem norm_sum_sub_shifted_sum_le (f : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hf : ∀ n, ‖f n‖ ≤ 1) (i N : ℕ) :
    ‖(∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n) -
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (n + i)‖ ≤ 2 * i
proof:
:= by
  have hshift :
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n) -
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (n + i) =
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range i, f n) -
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.range i, f (N + n) := by
    have hi := Finset.sum_range_add f i N
    have hN := Finset.sum_range_add f N i
    simp_rw [Nat.add_comm i] at hi
    linear_combination hi - hN
  rw [hshift]
  calc
    ‖(∑ n ∈ Finset.range i, f n) -
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range i, f (N + n)‖ ≤
      ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range i, f n‖ +
        ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range i, f (N + n)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ (∑ _n ∈ Finset.range i, (1 : ℝ)) +
          ∑ _n ∈ Finset.range i, (1 : ℝ) := by
      gcongr
      · exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans
          (Finset.sum_le_sum fun n hn ↦ hf n)
      · exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans
          (Finset.sum_le_sum fun n hn ↦ hf (N + n))
    _ = 2 * i := by simp; ring

name: TranslationalTilings.sum_Icc_one_eq_sum_range_succ
statement:
private theorem sum_Icc_one_eq_sum_range_succ
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (H : ℕ) :
    (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1), a h) =
      ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (H - 1), a (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun q _ ↦ q + 1)
  · intro q hq
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hq
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]
    omega
  · intro q₁ hq₁ q₂ hq₂ heq
    omega
  · intro h hh
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hh
    refine ⟨h - 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Finset.mem_range]
      omega
    · omega
  · intro q hq
    rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.sum_initial_succ_le_sum_Icc
statement:
private theorem sum_initial_succ_le_sum_Icc
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ h, 0 ≤ a h)
    (H i : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H) (hi : i < H) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.range i, a (q + 1)) ≤
      ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1), a h
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_Icc_one_eq_sum_range_succ a H]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
    (Finset.range_mono (by omega))
    (fun q hq hnot ↦ ha (q + 1))

name: TranslationalTilings.correlation_norm_bound
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_mul, norm_star]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (u n), norm_nonneg (u (n + h)),
    hu n, hu (n + h)]

name: TranslationalTilings.upper_pair_re_le
statement:
private theorem upper_pair_re_le (u : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ n, ‖u n‖ ≤ 1) (N i j : ℕ) (hij : i < j) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u (n + i)) * u (n + j)).re ≤
      ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u n) * u (n + (j - i))‖ + 2 * i
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → ℂ := fun n ↦ star (u n) * u (n + (j - i))
  have hterm (n : ℕ) :
      star (u (n + i)) * u (n + j) = f (n + i) := by
    simp only [f]
    rw [show n + i + (j - i) = n + j by omega]
  rw [show (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
      star (u (n + i)) * u (n + j)) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (n + i) by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n hn
      exact hterm n]
  exact (Complex.re_le_norm _).trans
    (norm_shifted_sum_le f
      (fun n ↦ correlation_norm_bound u hu (j - i) n) i N)

name: TranslationalTilings.lower_pair_re_le
statement:
private theorem lower_pair_re_le (u : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ n, ‖u n‖ ≤ 1) (N i j : ℕ) (hji : j < i) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u (n + i)) * u (n + j)).re ≤
      ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u n) * u (n + (i - j))‖ + 2 * j
proof:
:= by
  have hconj :
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u (n + i)) * u (n + j)) =
        star (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          star (u (n + j)) * u (n + i)) := by
    rw [star_sum]
    simp_rw [star_mul, star_star]
  rw [hconj]
  change (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
    star (u (n + j)) * u (n + i)).re ≤ _
  exact upper_pair_re_le u hu N j i hji

name: TranslationalTilings.diagonal_pair_re_le
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (z : ℂ) : (star z * z).re = ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      (star z * z).re = (Complex.normSq z : ℂ).re := by
        rw [Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]
        rfl
      _ = Complex.normSq z := rfl
      _ = ‖z‖ ^ 2 := (Complex.sq_norm z).symm
  rw [← Complex.reCLM_apply, map_sum]
  simp only [Complex.reCLM_apply]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ‖u (n + i)‖ ^ 2) ≤
        ∑ _n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro n hn
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (u (n + i)), hu (n + i)]
    _ = N := by simp

name: TranslationalTilings.lower_row_re_le
statement:
private theorem lower_row_re_le (u : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ n, ‖u n‖ ≤ 1) (H N i : ℕ)
    (hH : 0 < H) (hi : i < H) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range i,
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          star (u (n + i)) * u (n + j)).re ≤
      (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1),
        ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u n) * u (n + h)‖) +
        2 * H ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun h ↦
    ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u n) * u (n + h)‖
  have hpoint (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ Finset.range i) :
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          star (u (n + i)) * u (n + j)).re ≤ a (i - j) + 2 * j := by
    exact lower_pair_re_le u hu N i j
      (by simpa only [Finset.mem_range] using hj)
  calc
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range i,
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          star (u (n + i)) * u (n + j)).re ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, (a (i - j) + 2 * j) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum hpoint
    _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, a (i - j)) +
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, (2 * j : ℝ) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ ≤ (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1), a h) + 2 * H ^ 2 := by
      apply add_le_add
      · calc
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, a (i - j)) =
              ∑ q ∈ Finset.range i, a (q + 1) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_range_reflect (fun q ↦ a (q + 1)) i]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j hj
            simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj
            congr 2
            omega
          _ ≤ ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1), a h :=
            sum_initial_succ_le_sum_Icc a (fun h ↦ norm_nonneg _) H i hH hi
      · calc
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, (2 * j : ℝ)) ≤
              ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range i, (2 * H : ℝ) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro j hj
            simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj
            norm_num
            exact_mod_cast (le_of_lt (hj.trans hi))
          _ ≤ 2 * H ^ 2 := by
            simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
            have hiR : (i : ℝ) ≤ H := by exact_mod_cast hi.le
            nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ H by positivity]
    _ = _ := rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.upper_row_re_le
statement:
private theorem upper_row_re_le (u : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ n, ‖u n‖ ≤ 1) (H N i : ℕ)
    (hH : 0 < H) (hi : i < H) :
    ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (H - i - 1),
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          star (u (n + i)) * u (n + (i + 1 + q))).re ≤
      (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1),
        ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u n) * u (n + h)‖) +
        2 * H ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun h ↦
    ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u n) * u (n + h)‖
  have hlen : H - i - 1 < H := by omega
  have hpoint (q : ℕ) (hq : q ∈ Finset.range (H - i - 1)) :
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          star (u (n + i)) * u (n + (i + 1 + q))).re ≤
        a (q + 1) + 2 * i := by
    have hij : i < i + 1 + q := by omega
    simpa only [a, show i + 1 + q - i = q + 1 by omega] using
      upper_pair_re_le u hu N i (i + 1 + q) hij
  calc
    ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (H - i - 1),
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          star (u (n + i)) * u (n + (i + 1 + q))).re ≤
        ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (H - i - 1), (a (q + 1) + 2 * i) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum hpoint
    _ = (∑ q ∈ Finset.range (H - i - 1), a (q + 1)) +
          ∑ _q ∈ Finset.range (H - i - 1), (2 * i : ℝ) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ ≤ (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1), a h) + 2 * H ^ 2 := by
      apply add_le_add
      · exact sum_initial_succ_le_sum_Icc a (fun h ↦ norm_nonneg _)
          H (H - i - 1) hH hlen
      · calc
          (∑ _q ∈ Finset.range (H - i - 1), (2 * i : ℝ)) ≤
              ∑ _q ∈ Finset.range (H - i - 1), (2 * H : ℝ) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro q hq
            norm_num
            exact_mod_cast hi.le
          _ ≤ 2 * H ^ 2 := by
            simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
            have hlenR : ((H - i - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ H := by
              exact_mod_cast (Nat.sub_le H (i + 1))
            nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ H by positivity]
    _ = _ := rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.row_re_le
statement:
private theorem row_re_le (u : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ n, ‖u n‖ ≤ 1) (H N i : ℕ)
    (hH : 0 < H) (hi : i < H) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range H,
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          star (u (n + i)) * u (n + j)).re ≤
      N + 2 * (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1),
        ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u n) * u (n + h)‖) +
        4 * H ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℕ → ℝ := fun j ↦
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
      star (u (n + i)) * u (n + j)).re
  have hsplit :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range H, F j) =
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, F j) + F i +
          ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (H - i - 1), F (i + 1 + q) := by
    calc
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range H, F j) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + (H - i)), F j := by
        congr 3
        omega
      _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, F j) +
          ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (H - i), F (i + q) :=
        Finset.sum_range_add F i (H - i)
      _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, F j) +
          (∑ q ∈ Finset.range 1, F (i + q) +
            ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (H - i - 1), F (i + (1 + q))) := by
        congr 1
        rw [← Finset.sum_range_add]
        congr 3
        omega
      _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, F j) + F i +
          ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (H - i - 1), F (i + 1 + q) := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_range_one, Nat.add_zero, add_assoc]
  rw [hsplit]
  have hlo := lower_row_re_le u hu H N i hH hi
  have hdiag := diagonal_pair_re_le u hu N i
  have hup := upper_row_re_le u hu H N i hH hi
  dsimp only [F] at hlo hdiag hup ⊢
  nlinarith

name: TranslationalTilings.block_re_le
statement:
private theorem block_re_le (u : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ n, ‖u n‖ ≤ 1) (H N : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range H,
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          star (u (n + i)) * u (n + j)).re ≤
      H * N + 2 * H * (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1),
        ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u n) * u (n + h)‖) +
        4 * H ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  calc
