    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range H,
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          star (u (n + i)) * u (n + j)).re ≤
      ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range H,
        ((N : ℝ) + 2 * (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1),
          ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u n) * u (n + h)‖) +
          4 * H ^ 2) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      exact row_re_le u hu H N i hH
        (by simpa only [Finset.mem_range] using hi)
    _ = H * N + 2 * H * (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1),
        ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u n) * u (n + h)‖) +
        4 * H ^ 3 := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
      ring

name: TranslationalTilings.block_norm_sum_le
statement:
private theorem block_norm_sum_le (u : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ n, ‖u n‖ ≤ 1) (H N : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
        ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i)‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) ≤
      H * N + 2 * H * (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1),
        ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u n) * u (n + h)‖) +
        4 * H ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hexpand := congrArg Complex.re (block_norm_expansion u H N)
  change (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
      ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i)‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) =
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range H,
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
        star (u (n + i)) * u (n + j)).re at hexpand
  rw [← Complex.reCLM_apply, map_sum] at hexpand
  simp only [Complex.reCLM_apply] at hexpand
  simp_rw [← Complex.reCLM_apply, map_sum, Complex.reCLM_apply] at hexpand
  rw [hexpand]
  have hcollapse :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range H,
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          (star (u (n + i)) * u (n + j)).re) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range H,
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
            star (u (n + i)) * u (n + j)).re := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [← Complex.reCLM_apply, map_sum]
    rfl
  rw [hcollapse]
  exact block_re_le u hu H N hH

name: TranslationalTilings.block_sum_norm_le
statement:
private theorem block_sum_norm_le (u : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ n, ‖u n‖ ≤ 1) (H N : ℕ) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i)‖ ≤
      H * N
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i)‖ ≤
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, ‖u (n + i)‖ := by
      exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans
        (Finset.sum_le_sum fun n hn ↦ norm_sum_le _ _)
    _ ≤ ∑ _n ∈ Finset.range N,
          ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range H, (1 : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro n hn
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi ↦ hu (n + i)
    _ = H * N := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
      ring

name: TranslationalTilings.mul_norm_sum_le_norm_block_sum_add
statement:
private theorem mul_norm_sum_le_norm_block_sum_add (u : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ n, ‖u n‖ ≤ 1) (H N : ℕ) :
    H * ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, u n‖ ≤
      ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i)‖ +
        2 * H ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let S : ℂ := ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, u n
  let B : ℂ := ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i)
  have hid : (H : ℂ) * S - B =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H,
        (S - ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, u (n + i)) := by
    dsimp only [S, B]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hdiff : ‖(H : ℂ) * S - B‖ ≤ 2 * H ^ 2 := by
    rw [hid]
    calc
      ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range H,
          (S - ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, u (n + i))‖ ≤
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H,
            ‖S - ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, u (n + i)‖ :=
        norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range H, (2 * H : ℝ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        exact (norm_sum_sub_shifted_sum_le u hu i N).trans
          (by
            simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi
            norm_num
            exact_mod_cast hi.le)
      _ = 2 * H ^ 2 := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
        ring
  calc
    H * ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, u n‖ = ‖(H : ℂ) * S‖ := by
      rw [norm_mul, norm_natCast]
    _ ≤ ‖B‖ + ‖(H : ℂ) * S - B‖ := by
      have heq : (H : ℂ) * S = B + ((H : ℂ) * S - B) := by ring
      calc
        ‖(H : ℂ) * S‖ = ‖B + ((H : ℂ) * S - B)‖ :=
          congrArg norm heq
        _ ≤ _ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ‖B‖ + 2 * H ^ 2 := by gcongr
    _ = _ := rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.mul_sq_norm_sum_le_sq_norm_block_sum_add
statement:
private theorem mul_sq_norm_sum_le_sq_norm_block_sum_add (u : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ n, ‖u n‖ ≤ 1) (H N : ℕ) :
    H ^ 2 * ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, u n‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i)‖ ^ 2 +
        4 * H ^ 3 * N + 4 * H ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  have hmain := mul_norm_sum_le_norm_block_sum_add u hu H N
  have hB := block_sum_norm_le u hu H N
  have hH0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ H := by positivity
  have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N := by positivity
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, u n‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i)‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ H * ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, u n‖ :=
    mul_nonneg hH0 hS0
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i)‖ + 2 * H ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hsquare := (sq_le_sq₀ hx0 hy0).2 hmain
  have hcross :
      4 * H ^ 2 * ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i)‖ ≤
        4 * H ^ 3 * N := by
    calc
      4 * H ^ 2 * ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i)‖ ≤
          4 * H ^ 2 * (H * N) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB (by positivity)
      _ = 4 * H ^ 3 * N := by ring
  nlinarith

name: TranslationalTilings.vanDerCorput_finite
statement:
private theorem vanDerCorput_finite (u : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ n, ‖u n‖ ≤ 1) (H N : ℕ)
    (hH : 0 < H) (hN : 0 < N) :
    ‖cesaroAverage u N‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (1 : ℝ) / H + (2 / H) *
        ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1),
          ‖cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ star (u n) * u (n + h)) N‖ +
        8 * H / N + 4 * H ^ 2 / N ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let S : ℂ := ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, u n
  let B : ℂ := ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i)
  let C : ℝ := ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1),
    ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u n) * u (n + h)‖
  have hmove := mul_sq_norm_sum_le_sq_norm_block_sum_add u hu H N
  have hcauchy : ‖B‖ ^ 2 ≤ N *
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
        ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i)‖ ^ 2 := by
    dsimp only [B]
    simpa only [Finset.card_range, Nat.cast_id] using
      norm_sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq_norm (Finset.range N)
        (fun n ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i))
  have hblock := block_norm_sum_le u hu H N hH
  have hblock' : (N : ℝ) *
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
        ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      N * (H * N + 2 * H * C + 4 * H ^ 3) := by
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by simpa only [C] using hblock)
      (by positivity)
  have htotal : (H : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖S‖ ^ 2 ≤
      H * N ^ 2 + 2 * H * N * C + 8 * H ^ 3 * N + 4 * H ^ 4 := by
    calc
      (H : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖S‖ ^ 2 ≤
          ‖B‖ ^ 2 + 4 * H ^ 3 * N + 4 * H ^ 4 := by
        simpa only [S, B] using hmove
      _ ≤ N * (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, u (n + i)‖ ^ 2) +
            4 * H ^ 3 * N + 4 * H ^ 4 := by gcongr
      _ ≤ N * (H * N + 2 * H * C + 4 * H ^ 3) +
            4 * H ^ 3 * N + 4 * H ^ 4 := by gcongr
      _ = H * N ^ 2 + 2 * H * N * C +
            8 * H ^ 3 * N + 4 * H ^ 4 := by ring
  have hHne : (H : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hH.ne'
  have hNne : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hN.ne'
  have havg : ‖cesaroAverage u N‖ ^ 2 = ‖S‖ ^ 2 / N ^ 2 := by
    rw [cesaroAverage]
    dsimp only [S]
    rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_natCast]
    field_simp
  have hcorr (h : ℕ) :
      ‖cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ star (u n) * u (n + h)) N‖ =
        ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, star (u n) * u (n + h)‖ / N := by
    rw [cesaroAverage, norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_natCast]
    field_simp
  have hcancel : (H : ℝ) * ‖S‖ ^ 2 ≤
      N ^ 2 + 2 * N * C + 8 * H ^ 2 * N + 4 * H ^ 3 := by
    apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ (show (0 : ℝ) < H by exact_mod_cast hH)
    calc
      (H : ℝ) * (H * ‖S‖ ^ 2) = H ^ 2 * ‖S‖ ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ H * N ^ 2 + 2 * H * N * C + 8 * H ^ 3 * N + 4 * H ^ 4 := htotal
      _ = H * (N ^ 2 + 2 * N * C + 8 * H ^ 2 * N + 4 * H ^ 3) := by ring
  rw [havg]
  simp_rw [hcorr]
  dsimp only [C] at hcancel
  rw [← Finset.sum_div] 
  field_simp
  nlinarith [hcancel]

name: TranslationalTilings.norm_cesaroAverage_le_one_vdc
statement:
private theorem norm_cesaroAverage_le_one_vdc
    (u : ℕ → ℂ) (hu : ∀ n, ‖u n‖ ≤ 1) (N : ℕ) :
    ‖cesaroAverage u N‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hN : N = 0
  · simp [hN, cesaroAverage]
  rw [cesaroAverage, norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_natCast]
  calc
    (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, u n‖ ≤
        (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ _n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 : ℝ) := by
      gcongr
      exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun n _ ↦ hu n)
    _ = 1 := by simp [hN]

name: TranslationalTilings.vanDerCorput_cesaro
statement:
theorem vanDerCorput_cesaro
    (u : ℕ → ℂ) (hu : ∀ n, ‖u n‖ ≤ 1) (H : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H) :
  Filter.limsup (fun N ↦ ‖cesaroAverage u N‖ ^ 2) Filter.atTop ≤
    (2 : ℝ) / H + (2 / H) *
      ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1),
        Filter.limsup
          (fun N ↦ ‖cesaroAverage
            (fun n ↦ star (u n) * u (n + h)) N‖)
          Filter.atTop
proof:
:= by
  let s := Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1)
  let a : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun h N ↦
    ‖cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ star (u n) * u (n + h)) N‖
  let L : ℕ → ℝ := fun h ↦ Filter.limsup (a h) Filter.atTop
  let R : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) / H + (2 / H) * ∑ h ∈ s, L h
  have huavg (N : ℕ) : ‖cesaroAverage u N‖ ≤ 1 :=
    norm_cesaroAverage_le_one_vdc u hu N
  have ha_nonneg (h N : ℕ) : 0 ≤ a h N := norm_nonneg _
  have ha_le (h N : ℕ) : a h N ≤ 1 := by
    apply norm_cesaroAverage_le_one_vdc
    intro n
    rw [norm_mul, norm_star]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (u n), norm_nonneg (u (n + h)), hu n, hu (n + h)]
  have hmain : Filter.limsup (fun N ↦ ‖cesaroAverage u N‖ ^ 2)
      Filter.atTop ≤ R := by
    apply (Filter.limsup_le_iff
      (f := Filter.atTop) (u := fun N ↦ ‖cesaroAverage u N‖ ^ 2)
      (x := R)
      (h₁ := Filter.isCoboundedUnder_le_of_le _
        (fun N ↦ sq_nonneg ‖cesaroAverage u N‖))
      (h₂ := Filter.isBoundedUnder_of_eventually_le (a := (1 : ℝ))
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun N ↦ by
          have h := huavg N
          nlinarith [norm_nonneg (cesaroAverage u N)]))).2
    intro y hy
    let gap : ℝ := y - R
    have hgap : 0 < gap := sub_pos.mpr hy
    let delta : ℝ := gap / 4
    have hdelta : 0 < delta := div_pos hgap (by norm_num)
    have ha_event (h : ℕ) : ∀ᶠ N in Filter.atTop, a h N < L h + delta := by
      exact ((Filter.limsup_le_iff
        (f := Filter.atTop) (u := a h) (x := L h)
        (h₁ := Filter.isCoboundedUnder_le_of_le _ (ha_nonneg h))
        (h₂ := Filter.isBoundedUnder_of_eventually_le (a := (1 : ℝ))
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (ha_le h)))).1 le_rfl)
        (L h + delta) (by linarith)
    have hall : ∀ᶠ N in Filter.atTop, ∀ h ∈ s, a h N ≤ L h + delta := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_all_finset]
      intro h hh
      exact (ha_event h).mono (fun N hN ↦ hN.le)
    have hinv : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ (1 : ℝ) / N)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_one_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
    have herrlim : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun N : ℕ ↦ (8 : ℝ) * H / N + 4 * H ^ 2 / N ^ 2)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have h₁ := hinv.const_mul ((8 : ℝ) * H)
      have h₂ := (hinv.mul hinv).const_mul ((4 : ℝ) * H ^ 2)
      convert h₁.add h₂ using 1
      · funext N
        simp only [one_div]
        ring
      · simp
    have herr : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
        (8 : ℝ) * H / N + 4 * H ^ 2 / N ^ 2 < gap / 4 :=
      (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp herrlim (gap / 4) hdelta) |>.mono
        (fun N hN ↦ by
          rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_lt] at hN
          exact hN.2)
    have hNpos : ∀ᶠ N in Filter.atTop, 0 < N :=
      Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1
    filter_upwards [hall, herr, hNpos] with N hallN herrN hNpos
    have hfinite := vanDerCorput_finite u hu H N hH hNpos
    have hsum : ∑ h ∈ s, a h N ≤ ∑ h ∈ s, L h + (s.card : ℝ) * delta := by
      calc
        ∑ h ∈ s, a h N ≤ ∑ h ∈ s, (L h + delta) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun h hh ↦ hallN h hh
        _ = ∑ h ∈ s, L h + (s.card : ℝ) * delta := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          simp
    have hcard : (s.card : ℝ) ≤ H := by
      have hcardNat : s.card ≤ H := by
        calc
          s.card ≤ (Finset.range H).card := Finset.card_le_card
            (show s ⊆ Finset.range H by
              intro h hh
              simp only [s, Finset.mem_Icc] at hh
              simp only [Finset.mem_range]
              omega)
          _ = H := Finset.card_range H
      exact_mod_cast hcardNat
    have hcoef : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) / H := by positivity
    have hsum' : (2 / (H : ℝ)) * ∑ h ∈ s, a h N ≤
        (2 / H) * ∑ h ∈ s, L h + gap / 2 := by
      calc
        (2 / (H : ℝ)) * ∑ h ∈ s, a h N ≤
            (2 / H) * (∑ h ∈ s, L h + (s.card : ℝ) * delta) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hcoef
        _ ≤ (2 / H) * ∑ h ∈ s, L h + 2 * delta := by
          have hHR : (0 : ℝ) < H := by exact_mod_cast hH
          have hdelta0 : 0 ≤ delta := hdelta.le
          calc
            _ = (2 / H) * ∑ h ∈ s, L h +
                ((2 / H) * (s.card : ℝ)) * delta := by ring
            _ ≤ (2 / H) * ∑ h ∈ s, L h + 2 * delta := by
              gcongr
              calc
                (2 / H) * (s.card : ℝ) ≤ (2 / H) * H :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcard (by positivity)
                _ = 2 := by field_simp
        _ = _ := by simp only [delta, gap]; ring
    have hsum'' : (2 / (H : ℝ)) * ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1),
          ‖cesaroAverage (fun n ↦ star (u n) * u (n + h)) N‖ ≤
        (2 / H) * ∑ h ∈ s, L h + gap / 2 := by
      simpa only [s, a] using hsum'
    calc
      ‖cesaroAverage u N‖ ^ 2 ≤
          (1 : ℝ) / H + (2 / H) * ∑ h ∈ s, L h + gap / 2 +
            ((8 : ℝ) * H / N + 4 * H ^ 2 / N ^ 2) := by
        linarith
      _ < y := by
        dsimp only [gap, R] at hgap herrN ⊢
        have hinvH : 0 < (1 : ℝ) / H := by positivity
        have hsplit : (2 : ℝ) / H = 1 / H + 1 / H := by ring
        rw [hsplit] at hgap herrN ⊢
        nlinarith
  simpa only [R, s, L, a] using hmain

name: TranslationalTilings.sum_range_blocks
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | zero => simp
  | succ q ih =>
      rw [Nat.mul_succ, Finset.sum_range_add, ih]
      simp_rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      congr 1
      exact (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
        (fun x ↦ f (H * q + x)) H).symm

name: TranslationalTilings.sum_range_blocks_add
statement:
private theorem sum_range_blocks_add (f : ℕ → ℂ)
    (H q b : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (H * q + b), f n) =
      (∑ a : Fin H, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range q,
        f (H * t + (a : ℕ))) +
      ∑ a ∈ Finset.range b, f (H * q + a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_add, sum_range_blocks]

name: TranslationalTilings.cesaro_term_identity
statement:
private theorem cesaro_term_identity (f : ℕ → ℂ)
    (H q a : ℕ) :
    (((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) *
        cesaroAverage (fun t ↦ f (H * t + a)) (q + 1) -
      (q : ℂ) * cesaroAverage (fun t ↦ f (H * t + a)) q) =
        f (H * q + a)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · simp [hq, cesaroAverage]
  simp only [cesaroAverage, Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.cast_add,
    Nat.cast_one]
  rw [mul_inv_cancel_left₀ (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero q),
    mul_inv_cancel_left₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hq)]
  ring

name: TranslationalTilings.residue_ratio_tendsto
statement:
private theorem residue_ratio_tendsto (H b : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun q : ℕ ↦ ((H * q + b : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * (q : ℂ))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (H : ℂ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have h := tendsto_add_mul_div_add_mul_atTop_nhds
    (0 : ℂ) b 1 (d := H) (by exact_mod_cast hH.ne')
  convert h using 1 <;> simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, add_comm]

name: TranslationalTilings.residue_ratio_succ_tendsto
statement:
private theorem residue_ratio_succ_tendsto (H b : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun q : ℕ ↦ ((H * q + b : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (H : ℂ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have h := tendsto_add_mul_div_add_mul_atTop_nhds
    (1 : ℂ) b 1 (d := H) (by exact_mod_cast hH.ne')
  convert h using 1 <;>
    simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, add_comm, Nat.cast_add]

name: TranslationalTilings.cesaro_residue_term_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem cesaro_residue_term_tendsto_zero
    (f : ℕ → ℂ) (H b : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H)
    (a : Fin H) (z : ℂ)
    (hlim : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N ↦ cesaroAverage (fun t ↦ f (H * t + (a : ℕ))) N)
      Filter.atTop (nhds z)) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun q ↦ ((H * q + b : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        f (H * q + (a : ℕ))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hlimSucc := hlim.comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hprodSucc := (residue_ratio_succ_tendsto H b hH).mul hlimSucc
  have hprod := (residue_ratio_tendsto H b hH).mul hlim
  have hsub := hprodSucc.sub hprod
  convert hsub using 1
  · funext q
    rw [← cesaro_term_identity f H q (a : ℕ)]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Nat.add_comm]
    rw [mul_sub]
    ring_nf
  · ring_nf

name: TranslationalTilings.cesaro_residue_fixed_remainder
statement:
private theorem cesaro_residue_fixed_remainder
    (f : ℕ → ℂ) (H : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H)
    (z₀ : Fin H → ℂ)
    (hlim : ∀ a : Fin H, Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N ↦ cesaroAverage (fun t ↦ f (H * t + (a : ℕ))) N)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (z₀ a)))
    (b : Fin H) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun q ↦ cesaroAverage f (H * q + (b : ℕ)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds ((H : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ a, z₀ a))
proof:
:= by
  have hsumlim : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun q ↦ ∑ a : Fin H,
        cesaroAverage (fun t ↦ f (H * t + (a : ℕ))) q)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (∑ a : Fin H, z₀ a)) := by
    simpa using tendsto_finsetSum Finset.univ
      (fun a _ ↦ hlim a)
  have hmain := (residue_ratio_tendsto H (b : ℕ) hH).mul hsumlim
  have hrem : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun q ↦ ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (b : ℕ),
        ((H * q + (b : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * f (H * q + a))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hs : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun q ↦ ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (b : ℕ),
          ((H * q + (b : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * f (H * q + a))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (∑ _a ∈ Finset.range (b : ℕ), (0 : ℂ))) := by
      apply tendsto_finsetSum (Finset.range (b : ℕ))
      intro a ha
      exact cesaro_residue_term_tendsto_zero f H (b : ℕ) hH
        ⟨a, lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp ha) b.isLt.le⟩ (z₀ ⟨a,
          lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp ha) b.isLt.le⟩)
        (hlim ⟨a, lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp ha) b.isLt.le⟩)
    simpa using hs
  have hadd := hmain.add hrem
  convert hadd using 1
  · funext q
    by_cases hq : q = 0
    · subst q
      simp only [cesaroAverage, Nat.mul_zero, zero_add, Nat.cast_zero,
        Finset.sum_range_zero]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      simp
    rw [cesaroAverage, sum_range_blocks_add]
    simp_rw [show ∀ a : Fin H,
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range q, f (H * t + (a : ℕ)) =
          (q : ℂ) * cesaroAverage
            (fun t ↦ f (H * t + (a : ℕ))) q by
      intro a
      simp [cesaroAverage, hq]]
    rw [mul_add]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    simp [mul_assoc]
  · ring_nf

name: TranslationalTilings.cesaroAverage_of_residue_classes
statement:
theorem cesaroAverage_of_residue_classes
    (f : ℕ → ℂ) (H : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H) (z₀ : Fin H → ℂ)
    (hlim : ∀ a : Fin H, Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N ↦ cesaroAverage (fun t ↦ f (H * t + (a : ℕ))) N)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (z₀ a))) :
  Filter.Tendsto (fun N ↦ cesaroAverage f N) Filter.atTop
    (nhds ((H : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ a, z₀ a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
  intro eps heps
  have hall : ∀ᶠ q in Filter.atTop, ∀ b : Fin H,
      dist (cesaroAverage f (H * q + (b : ℕ)))
        ((H : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ a, z₀ a) < eps := by
    rw [Filter.eventually_all]
    intro b
    exact (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp
      (cesaro_residue_fixed_remainder f H hH z₀ hlim b) eps heps)
  have hdiv : Filter.Tendsto (fun N ↦ N / H)
      Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := Nat.tendsto_div_const_atTop hH.ne'
  filter_upwards [hdiv.eventually hall] with N hN
  let b : Fin H := ⟨N % H, Nat.mod_lt _ hH⟩
  have hdecomp : H * (N / H) + (b : ℕ) = N := by
    dsimp [b]
    exact Nat.div_add_mod N H
  simpa [hdecomp] using hN b

name: TranslationalTilings.extended_add_pow
statement:
private theorem extended_add_pow (n h : ℤ) (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    (n + h) ^ (i : ℕ) =
      ∑ j : Fin (d + 1),
        n ^ (j : ℕ) * h ^ ((i : ℕ) - (j : ℕ)) *
          (Nat.choose (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_pow]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
    (fun j ↦ n ^ j * h ^ ((i : ℕ) - j) *
      (Nat.choose (i : ℕ) j : ℤ)) (d + 1)]
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.le_of_lt_succ i.isLt)))
  intro j hj hnot
  have hij : (i : ℕ) < j := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hnot
    omega
  rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hij]
  simp

name: TranslationalTilings.shiftDifference_eval
statement:
private theorem shiftDifference_eval (P : CirclePolynomial d) (h n : ℤ) :
    shiftDifference P h n = P (n + h) - P n
proof:
:= by
  rw [CirclePolynomial.eval, CirclePolynomial.eval, CirclePolynomial.eval]
  simp only [shiftDifference, smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.smul_sum,
    smul_smul]
  rw [sub_left_inj]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [extended_add_pow n h i, Finset.sum_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  congr 1
  ring

name: TranslationalTilings.shiftDifference_coeff_above
statement:
private theorem shiftDifference_coeff_above
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (h : ℤ) (r j : Fin (d + 1))
    (hrj : (r : ℕ) ≤ (j : ℕ))
    (habove : ∀ i : Fin (d + 1),
      (r : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → P.coeff i = 0) :
    (shiftDifference P h).coeff j = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ i : Fin (d + 1),
      ((Nat.choose (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℤ) * h ^ ((i : ℕ) - (j : ℕ))) •
        P.coeff i) - P.coeff j = 0
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro i hi hij
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hijlt | hjilt
    · rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hijlt]
      simp
    · rw [habove i (lt_of_le_of_lt hrj hjilt)]
      simp
  · simp

name: TranslationalTilings.shiftDifference_coeff_pred
statement:
private theorem shiftDifference_coeff_pred
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (h : ℤ) (r j : Fin (d + 1))
    (hrj : (r : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) + 1)
    (habove : ∀ i : Fin (d + 1),
      (r : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → P.coeff i = 0) :
    (shiftDifference P h).coeff j =
      (((r : ℕ) : ℤ) * h) • P.coeff r
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ i : Fin (d + 1),
      ((Nat.choose (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℤ) * h ^ ((i : ℕ) - (j : ℕ))) •
        P.coeff i) - P.coeff j = _
  have hrne : r ≠ j := by
    intro e
    have := congrArg Fin.val e
    omega
  have hjmem : j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (d + 1))) := Finset.mem_univ j
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ hjmem]
  have hrmem : r ∈ (Finset.univ.erase j : Finset (Fin (d + 1))) := by
    simp [hrne]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single r]
  · simp only [Nat.choose_self, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, Nat.sub_self,
      pow_zero, one_smul]
    rw [hrj, Nat.choose_succ_self_right]
    have hsub : (j : ℕ) + 1 - (j : ℕ) = 1 := by omega
    rw [hsub, pow_one]
    push_cast
    abel
  · intro i hi hir
    have hij : i ≠ j := by simpa using hi
    rcases lt_trichotomy (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ) with hijlt | hijEq | hjilt
    · rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hijlt]
      simp
    · exact (hij (Fin.ext hijEq)).elim
    · have hri : (r : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) := by
        have hne : (i : ℕ) ≠ (r : ℕ) := fun e ↦ hir (Fin.ext e)
        omega
      rw [habove i hri]
      simp
  · exact fun hnot ↦ (hnot hrmem).elim

name: TranslationalTilings.affineRestriction_eval
statement:
private theorem affineRestriction_eval
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (k H a n : ℤ) :
    affineRestriction P k H a n = k • P (H * n + a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [CirclePolynomial.eval, CirclePolynomial.eval]
  simp only [affineRestriction, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [extended_add_pow (H * n) a i, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  congr 1
  ring

name: TranslationalTilings.zsmul_eq_zero_of_base_zsmul_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem zsmul_eq_zero_of_base_zsmul_eq_zero
    (x : Torus) (H z : ℤ) (j : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j)
    (hH : H • x = 0) : (z * H ^ j) • x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show z * H ^ j = (z * H ^ (j - 1)) * H by
    rw [← pow_sub_one_mul hj.ne' H]
    ring]
  rw [mul_zsmul, hH, smul_zero]

name: TranslationalTilings.affineRestriction_coeff_above
statement:
private theorem affineRestriction_coeff_above
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (k H a : ℤ) (r j : Fin (d + 1))
    (hrpos : 0 < (r : ℕ)) (hrj : (r : ℕ) < (j : ℕ))
    (hkill : ∀ i : Fin (d + 1),
      (r : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → H • P.coeff i = 0) :
    (affineRestriction P k H a).coeff j = 0
proof:
:= by
  change ∑ i : Fin (d + 1),
      (k * (Nat.choose (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℤ) *
        H ^ (j : ℕ) * a ^ ((i : ℕ) - (j : ℕ))) • P.coeff i = 0
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i hi
  by_cases hij : (j : ℕ) ≤ (i : ℕ)
  · have hri : (r : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) := hrj.trans_le hij
    have hz := zsmul_eq_zero_of_base_zsmul_eq_zero
      (P.coeff i) H
      (k * (Nat.choose (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℤ) *
        a ^ ((i : ℕ) - (j : ℕ)))
      (j : ℕ) (hrpos.trans hrj) (hkill i hri)
    exact (congrArg (fun z : ℤ ↦ z • P.coeff i) (by ring)).trans hz
  · have hij' : (i : ℕ) < (j : ℕ) := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hij
    rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hij']
    simp

name: TranslationalTilings.affineRestriction_coeff_leading
statement:
private theorem affineRestriction_coeff_leading
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (k H a : ℤ) (r : Fin (d + 1))
    (hrpos : 0 < (r : ℕ))
    (hkill : ∀ i : Fin (d + 1),
      (r : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → H • P.coeff i = 0) :
    (affineRestriction P k H a).coeff r =
      (k * H ^ (r : ℕ)) • P.coeff r
proof:
:= by
  change ∑ i : Fin (d + 1),
      (k * (Nat.choose (i : ℕ) (r : ℕ) : ℤ) *
        H ^ (r : ℕ) * a ^ ((i : ℕ) - (r : ℕ))) • P.coeff i = _
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single r]
  · simp
  · intro i hi hir
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hir with hirlt | hrilt
    · rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hirlt]
      simp
    · have hz := zsmul_eq_zero_of_base_zsmul_eq_zero
        (P.coeff i) H
        (k * (Nat.choose (i : ℕ) (r : ℕ) : ℤ) *
          a ^ ((i : ℕ) - (r : ℕ)))
        (r : ℕ) hrpos (hkill i hrilt)
      exact (congrArg (fun z : ℤ ↦ z • P.coeff i) (by ring)).trans hz
  · simp

name: TranslationalTilings.star_circlePhase
statement:
private theorem star_circlePhase (x : Torus) :
    star (circlePhase x) = circlePhase (-x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [circlePhase, fourier_one, Complex.star_def]
  rw [← Circle.coe_inv_eq_conj]
  simp [AddCircle.toCircle_neg]

name: TranslationalTilings.norm_cesaroAverage_le_one
statement:
private theorem norm_cesaroAverage_le_one
    (u : ℕ → ℂ) (hu : ∀ n, ‖u n‖ ≤ 1) (N : ℕ) :
    ‖cesaroAverage u N‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hN : N = 0
  · simp [hN, cesaroAverage]
  rw [cesaroAverage, norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_natCast]
  calc
    (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, u n‖ ≤
        (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ _n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 : ℝ) := by
      gcongr
      exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun n _ ↦ hu n)
    _ = 1 := by
      simp [hN]

name: TranslationalTilings.circlePolynomial_eval_linear
statement:
private theorem circlePolynomial_eval_linear
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (r : Fin (d + 1))
    (hr : (r : ℕ) = 1)
    (habove : ∀ i : Fin (d + 1),
      (r : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → P.coeff i = 0)
    (n : ℤ) :
    P n = P.coeff 0 + n • P.coeff r
proof:
:= by
  rw [CirclePolynomial.eval]
  have hrne : r ≠ (0 : Fin (d + 1)) := by
    intro e
    have := congrArg Fin.val e
    simp only [Fin.val_zero] at this
    omega
  have h0mem : (0 : Fin (d + 1)) ∈
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (d + 1))) := Finset.mem_univ _
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ h0mem]
  have hrmem : r ∈
      (Finset.univ.erase (0 : Fin (d + 1)) : Finset (Fin (d + 1))) := by
    simp [hrne]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single r]
  · simp only [hr, pow_one, Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_zsmul]
    abel
  · intro i hi hir
    have hi0 : i ≠ (0 : Fin (d + 1)) := by simpa using hi
    have hri : (r : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) := by
      have hpos : 0 < (i : ℕ) := Fin.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hi0
      have hne : (i : ℕ) ≠ (r : ℕ) := fun e ↦ hir (Fin.ext e)
      omega
    rw [habove i hri, smul_zero]
  · exact fun hnot ↦ (hnot hrmem).elim

name: TranslationalTilings.polynomial_phase_leading_aux
statement:
private theorem polynomial_phase_leading_aux (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ {d : ℕ} (P : CirclePolynomial d)
      (r : Fin (d + 1)),
      (r : ℕ) = m + 1 →
      addOrderOf (P.coeff r) = 0 →
      (∀ i : Fin (d + 1),
        (r : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → P.coeff i = 0) →
      ∀ (k : ℤ), k ≠ 0 →
        Filter.Tendsto
          (fun N ↦ cesaroAverage
            (fun n ↦ circlePhase (k • P (n : ℤ))) N)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      intro d P r hr hirr habove k hk
      have hlin := irrational_linear_phase_tendsto_zero
        (P.coeff r) hirr k hk
      have hconst : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun N ↦ circlePhase (k • P.coeff 0) *
            cesaroAverage
              (fun n ↦ circlePhase (k • ((n : ℤ) • P.coeff r))) N)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using hlin.const_mul (circlePhase (k • P.coeff 0))
      convert hconst using 1
      funext N
      simp_rw [cesaroAverage, circlePolynomial_eval_linear P r (by omega) habove,
        smul_add, circlePhase_add, Finset.mul_sum]
      ring_nf
  | succ m ih =>
      intro d P r hr hirr habove k hk
      let j : Fin (d + 1) := ⟨m + 1, by
        have := r.isLt
        omega⟩
      have hrj : (r : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) + 1 := by simp [j]; omega
      let u : ℕ → ℂ := fun n ↦ circlePhase (k • P (n : ℤ))
      have hu (n : ℕ) : ‖u n‖ ≤ 1 := by
        simp [u, norm_circlePhase]
      have hcorr (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) :
          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun N ↦ cesaroAverage
              (fun n ↦ star (u n) * u (n + h)) N)
            Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        let Q := shiftDifference P (h : ℤ)
        have hqcoeff : Q.coeff j =
            (((r : ℕ) : ℤ) * (h : ℤ)) • P.coeff r := by
          exact shiftDifference_coeff_pred P h r j hrj habove
        have hscalar : (((r : ℕ) : ℤ) * (h : ℤ)) ≠ 0 := by
          exact mul_ne_zero (by omega) (by omega)
        have hqirr : addOrderOf (Q.coeff j) = 0 := by
          rw [hqcoeff]
          exact nontorsion_zsmul hirr hscalar
        have hqabove : ∀ i : Fin (d + 1),
            (j : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → Q.coeff i = 0 := by
          intro i hi
          exact shiftDifference_coeff_above P h r i (by omega) habove
        have hq := ih Q j (by simp [j]) hqirr hqabove k hk
        convert hq using 1
        funext N
        congr 2
        funext n
        simp only [u]
        rw [star_circlePhase, ← circlePhase_add]
        congr 1
        rw [shiftDifference_eval]
        push_cast
        rw [smul_sub]
        abel
      have hlimsupCorr (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) :
          Filter.limsup
              (fun N ↦ ‖cesaroAverage
                (fun n ↦ star (u n) * u (n + h)) N‖)
              Filter.atTop = 0 := by
        simpa using (hcorr h hh).norm.limsup_eq
      rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
      change Filter.Tendsto (fun N ↦ ‖cesaroAverage u N‖)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
      apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
      intro eps heps
      obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ : ∃ H : ℕ, 0 < H ∧ (2 : ℝ) / H < eps ^ 2 := by
        obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := exists_nat_gt (2 / eps ^ 2)
        have hsq : 0 < eps ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos heps
        have hHpos : 0 < H := by
          by_contra hzero
          have : H = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hzero
          subst H
          simp only [Nat.cast_zero] at hH
          have : 0 < 2 / eps ^ 2 := div_pos (by norm_num) hsq
          linarith
        refine ⟨H, hHpos, (div_lt_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast hHpos)).2 ?_⟩
        have hH' : 2 / eps ^ 2 < (H : ℝ) := hH
        simpa [mul_comm] using (div_lt_iff₀ hsq).mp hH'
      have hvdc := vanDerCorput_cesaro u hu H hH.1
      have hsumzero :
          ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H - 1),
              Filter.limsup
                (fun N ↦ ‖cesaroAverage
                  (fun n ↦ star (u n) * u (n + h)) N‖)
                Filter.atTop = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro h hh
        rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hh
        exact hlimsupCorr h (by omega)
      rw [hsumzero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hvdc
      have hev : ∀ᶠ N in Filter.atTop,
          ‖cesaroAverage u N‖ ^ 2 < eps ^ 2 :=
        ((Filter.limsup_le_iff (f := Filter.atTop)
          (u := fun N ↦ ‖cesaroAverage u N‖ ^ 2)
          (x := (2 : ℝ) / H)
          (h₁ := Filter.isCoboundedUnder_le_of_le _
            (fun N ↦ sq_nonneg ‖cesaroAverage u N‖))
          (h₂ := Filter.isBoundedUnder_of_eventually_le
            (a := (1 : ℝ)) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun N ↦ by
              have hn := norm_cesaroAverage_le_one u hu N
              nlinarith [norm_nonneg (cesaroAverage u N)]))).mp hvdc)
          (eps ^ 2) hH.2
      rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at hev
      obtain ⟨N₀, hev⟩ := hev
      refine ⟨N₀, fun N hN ↦ ?_⟩
      have hsqN := hev N hN
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ‖cesaroAverage u N‖ := norm_nonneg _
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hnonneg]
      nlinarith

name: TranslationalTilings.polynomial_phase_tendsto_zero_of_leading_nontorsion
statement:
theorem polynomial_phase_tendsto_zero_of_leading_nontorsion
    (P : CirclePolynomial d)
    (r : Fin (d + 1)) (hr : 0 < (r : ℕ))
    (hirr : addOrderOf (P.coeff r) = 0)
    (habove : ∀ i : Fin (d + 1),
      (r : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → P.coeff i = 0)
    (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun N ↦ cesaroAverage
      (fun n ↦ circlePhase (k • P (n : ℤ))) N)
    Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact polynomial_phase_leading_aux ((r : ℕ) - 1) P r
    (by omega) hirr habove k hk

name: TranslationalTilings.polynomial_phase_tendsto_zero_of_nontorsion_coeff
statement:
theorem polynomial_phase_tendsto_zero_of_nontorsion_coeff
    (P : CirclePolynomial d)
    (hcoeff : ∃ i : Fin (d + 1),
      0 < (i : ℕ) ∧ addOrderOf (P.coeff i) = 0)
    (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun N ↦ cesaroAverage
      (fun n ↦ circlePhase (k • P (n : ℤ))) N)
    Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  let s : Finset (Fin (d + 1)) := Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦
    0 < (i : ℕ) ∧ addOrderOf (P.coeff i) = 0
  have hs : s.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hirr⟩ := hcoeff
    exact ⟨i, by simp [s, hi, hirr]⟩
  let r : Fin (d + 1) := s.max' hs
  have hrmem : r ∈ s := Finset.max'_mem s hs
  have hrpos : 0 < (r : ℕ) := by
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hrmem).2.1
  have hrirr : addOrderOf (P.coeff r) = 0 := by
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hrmem).2.2
  have haboveOrder (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hri : (r : ℕ) < (i : ℕ)) :
      addOrderOf (P.coeff i) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hiirr
    have himem : i ∈ s := by simp [s, hrpos.trans hri, hiirr]
    have hir := Finset.le_max' s i himem
    exact (not_le_of_gt hri) hir
  let t : Finset (Fin (d + 1)) := Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦
    (r : ℕ) < (i : ℕ)
  let H : ℕ := ∏ i ∈ t, addOrderOf (P.coeff i)
  have hH : 0 < H := by
    apply Finset.prod_pos
    intro i hi
    have hri : (r : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) := by simpa [t] using hi
    exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (haboveOrder i hri)
  have hkill (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hri : (r : ℕ) < (i : ℕ)) :
      (H : ℤ) • P.coeff i = 0 := by
    have himem : i ∈ t := by
      simp only [t, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact hri
    have hdvd : addOrderOf (P.coeff i) ∣ H := by
      exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun i ↦ addOrderOf (P.coeff i)) himem
    apply addOrderOf_dvd_iff_zsmul_eq_zero.mp
    exact_mod_cast hdvd
  have hres (a : Fin H) : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N ↦ cesaroAverage
        (fun n ↦ circlePhase (k • P (H * n + (a : ℕ) : ℕ))) N)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    let R := affineRestriction P k (H : ℤ) (a : ℤ)
    have hrcoeff : R.coeff r =
        (k * (H : ℤ) ^ (r : ℕ)) • P.coeff r := by
      exact affineRestriction_coeff_leading P k H a r hrpos hkill
    have hscalar : k * (H : ℤ) ^ (r : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by
      apply mul_ne_zero hk
      exact pow_ne_zero _ (by exact_mod_cast hH.ne')
    have hrR : addOrderOf (R.coeff r) = 0 := by
      rw [hrcoeff]
      exact nontorsion_zsmul hrirr hscalar
    have haboveR : ∀ i : Fin (d + 1),
        (r : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → R.coeff i = 0 := by
      intro i hi
      exact affineRestriction_coeff_above P k H a r i hrpos hi hkill
    have hR := polynomial_phase_tendsto_zero_of_leading_nontorsion
      R r hrpos hrR haboveR 1 one_ne_zero
    convert hR using 1
    funext N
    congr 2
    funext n
    rw [affineRestriction_eval]
    push_cast
    simp only [one_zsmul]
  have hcombine := cesaroAverage_of_residue_classes
    (fun n ↦ circlePhase (k • P (n : ℤ))) H hH
    (fun _ ↦ (0 : ℂ)) hres
  simpa using hcombine

name: TranslationalTilings.polynomial_equidistributed_of_nontorsion_coeff
statement:
theorem polynomial_equidistributed_of_nontorsion_coeff
    (P : CirclePolynomial d)
    (hcoeff : ∃ i : Fin (d + 1),
      0 < (i : ℕ) ∧ addOrderOf (P.coeff i) = 0) :
  Equidistributed (fun n : ℕ ↦ P (n : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [equidistributed_iff_characters]
  intro k hk
  exact polynomial_phase_tendsto_zero_of_nontorsion_coeff P hcoeff k hk

name: TranslationalTilings.integral_ballBump_pos
statement:
theorem integral_ballBump_pos
    {eps : ℝ} {c : Torus} (heps : 0 < eps) :
  0 < ∫ x, ballBump c eps x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle
proof:
:= by
  have hint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (ballBump c eps)
      AddCircle.haarAddCircle := by
    simpa only [MeasureTheory.integrableOn_univ] using
      (ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_univ
        (ballBump c eps).continuous.continuousOn)
  exact MeasureTheory.integral_pos_of_integrable_nonneg_nonzero
    (x := c) (ballBump c eps).continuous hint
    (fun x ↦ le_max_left _ _) (by simpa [ballBump] using heps)

name: TranslationalTilings.not_equidistributed_of_avoidsBall
statement:
theorem not_equidistributed_of_avoidsBall
    {eps : ℝ} {c : Torus}
    (u : ℕ → Torus) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (havoid : ∀ n, u n ∉ Metric.ball c eps) :
  ¬ Equidistributed u
proof:
:= by
  intro hu
  let f : C(Torus, ℂ) :=
    ⟨fun x ↦ (ballBump c eps x : ℂ),
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (ballBump c eps).continuous⟩
  have hfzero (n : ℕ) : f (u n) = 0 := by
    have hn : eps ≤ dist (u n) c := by
      simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, not_lt] using havoid n
    simp [f, ballBump, max_eq_left (sub_nonpos.mpr hn)]
  have havgzero : (fun N : ℕ ↦
      (N : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (u n)) = fun _ ↦ 0 := by
    funext N
    simp [hfzero]
  have hlim := hu f
  rw [havgzero] at hlim
  have hintzero : (∫ x, f x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = 0 :=
    tendsto_nhds_unique hlim tendsto_const_nhds
  have hreal : (0 : ℝ) <
      ∫ x, ballBump c eps x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle :=
    integral_ballBump_pos heps
  have hcoe : (∫ x, f x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) =
      ((∫ x, ballBump c eps x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    simpa [f] using (integral_complex_ofReal
      (μ := AddCircle.haarAddCircle)
      (f := fun x ↦ ballBump c eps x))
  rw [hcoe] at hintzero
  exact hreal.ne' (Complex.ofReal_eq_zero.mp hintzero)

name: TranslationalTilings.torsion_nonconstant_coefficients_of_avoidsBall_aux
statement:
private theorem torsion_nonconstant_coefficients_of_avoidsBall_aux
    {d : ℕ} {eps : ℝ} {c : Torus}
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (havoid : P.AvoidsBall c eps) :
  P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  rw [← addOrderOf_pos_iff]
  exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun hzero ↦
    not_equidistributed_of_avoidsBall
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ P (n : ℤ)) heps (fun n ↦ havoid n)
      (polynomial_equidistributed_of_nontorsion_coeff
        P ⟨i, hi, hzero⟩))

name: TranslationalTilings.rational_nonconstant_coefficients_of_avoidsBall
statement:
theorem rational_nonconstant_coefficients_of_avoidsBall
    {d : ℕ} {eps : ℝ} {c : Torus}
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (havoid : P.AvoidsBall c eps) :
  P.HasRationalNonconstantCoeffs
proof:
:=
  (rational_iff_torsion_nonconstant P).mpr
    (torsion_nonconstant_coefficients_of_avoidsBall_aux P heps havoid)

name: TranslationalTilings.torsion_nonconstant_coefficients_of_avoidsBall
statement:
theorem torsion_nonconstant_coefficients_of_avoidsBall
    {d : ℕ} {eps : ℝ} {c : Torus}
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (havoid : P.AvoidsBall c eps) :
  P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs
proof:
:=
  torsion_nonconstant_coefficients_of_avoidsBall_aux P heps havoid

name: TranslationalTilings.CirclePolynomial.functionConstant_of_coefficientConstant
statement:
theorem CirclePolynomial.functionConstant_of_coefficientConstant
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (hP : P.CoefficientConstant) :
  P.FunctionConstant
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨P.coeff 0, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [CirclePolynomial.eval, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
  · simp
  · intro i _
    rw [hP i.succ (by simp), smul_zero]

name: TranslationalTilings.CirclePolynomial.not_coefficientConstant_of_not_functionConstant
statement:
theorem CirclePolynomial.not_coefficientConstant_of_not_functionConstant
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (hP : ¬ P.FunctionConstant) :
  ¬ P.CoefficientConstant
proof:
:= by
  exact fun hcoeff ↦ hP (P.functionConstant_of_coefficientConstant hcoeff)

name: TranslationalTilings.intFallingFactorial_succ
proof:
:= by
  simp [intFallingFactorial, Finset.prod_range_succ]

name: TranslationalTilings.intFallingFactorial_shift
statement:
private theorem intFallingFactorial_shift (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    intFallingFactorial (n + 1) (k + 1) =
      intFallingFactorial n (k + 1) +
        (k + 1 : ℕ) * intFallingFactorial n k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [intFallingFactorial]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [intFallingFactorial_succ (n + 1) (k + 1),
        intFallingFactorial_succ n (k + 1), ih,
        intFallingFactorial_succ n k]
      push_cast
      ring

name: TranslationalTilings.periodic_of_backwardDiff_one_eq_zero_torus
statement:
private theorem periodic_of_backwardDiff_one_eq_zero_torus
    (f : ℤ → Torus) (h : backwardDiff 1 f = 0) :
    Function.Periodic f 1
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  have hn := congrFun h (n + 1)
  simp only [backwardDiff, Pi.zero_apply] at hn
  simpa using sub_eq_zero.mp hn

name: TranslationalTilings.circle_newton_expansion
statement:
theorem circle_newton_expansion
    (f : ℤ → Torus) (h : backwardDiffIter 1 (d + 1) f = 0) :
  ∃ a : Fin (d + 1) → Torus, ∀ n : ℤ,
    f n = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1),
      intFallingFactorial n (i : ℕ) • a i
proof:
:= by
  induction d generalizing f with
  | zero =>
      have hdiff : backwardDiff 1 f = 0 := by
        simpa [backwardDiffIter] using h
      have hperiod := periodic_of_backwardDiff_one_eq_zero_torus f hdiff
      have hf (n : ℤ) : f n = f 0 := by
        have hn := hperiod.zsmul_eq n
        simpa using hn
      refine ⟨fun _ ↦ f 0, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
      simpa [intFallingFactorial] using hf n
  | succ d ih =>
      let g : ℤ → Torus := backwardDiff 1 f
      have hg : backwardDiffIter 1 (d + 1) g = 0 := by
        simpa only [backwardDiffIter, Function.iterate_succ_apply] using h
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ih g hg
      let c : Fin (d + 1) → Torus := fun i ↦
        DivisibleBy.div (a i) (i.val + 1 : ℤ)
      have hc (i : Fin (d + 1)) : (i.val + 1 : ℤ) • c i = a i := by
        exact DivisibleBy.div_cancel _ (by omega)
      let F : ℤ → Torus := fun n ↦
        ∑ i : Fin (d + 1),
          intFallingFactorial (n + 1) (i.val + 1) • c i
      have hF : backwardDiff 1 F = g := by
        funext n
        simp only [backwardDiff]
        change F n - F (n - 1) = g n
        rw [ha n]
        simp only [F]
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [show n - 1 + 1 = n by ring, sub_eq_add_neg, ← sub_zsmul]
        rw [show intFallingFactorial (n + 1) (i.val + 1) -
              intFallingFactorial n (i.val + 1) =
              (i.val + 1 : ℤ) * intFallingFactorial n i.val by
          rw [intFallingFactorial_shift]
          push_cast
          ring]
        rw [mul_comm, mul_zsmul, hc]
      let r : ℤ → Torus := f - F
      have hr : backwardDiff 1 r = 0 := by
        funext n
        have hFn := congrFun hF n
        change F n - F (n - 1) = g n at hFn
        simp only [backwardDiff, r, Pi.sub_apply]
        rw [show (f n - F n) - (f (n - 1) - F (n - 1)) =
            (f n - f (n - 1)) - (F n - F (n - 1)) by abel]
        change g n - (F n - F (n - 1)) = 0
        rw [hFn]
        exact sub_self _
      have hrperiod := periodic_of_backwardDiff_one_eq_zero_torus r hr
      have hrconst (n : ℤ) : r n = r 0 := by
        have hn := hrperiod.zsmul_eq n
        simpa using hn
      let b : Fin (d + 2) → Torus := fun j ↦
        Fin.cases (r 0) c j + Fin.lastCases 0 a j
      refine ⟨b, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
      have hfn : f n = r 0 + F n := by
        have hn := hrconst n
        change f n - F n = r 0 at hn
        exact eq_add_of_sub_eq hn
      rw [hfn]
      change r 0 + F n = ∑ j : Fin (d + 2),
        intFallingFactorial n j.val •
          (Fin.cases (r 0) c j + Fin.lastCases 0 a j)
      simp_rw [smul_add]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      have hfirst :
          (∑ j : Fin (d + 2),
              intFallingFactorial n j.val • Fin.cases (r 0) c j) =
            r 0 + ∑ i : Fin (d + 1),
              intFallingFactorial n (i.val + 1) • c i := by
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
        simp [intFallingFactorial]
      have hsecond :
          (∑ j : Fin (d + 2),
              intFallingFactorial n j.val • Fin.lastCases 0 a j) =
            ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), intFallingFactorial n i.val • a i := by
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
        simp
      rw [hfirst, hsecond]
      simp only [F]
      rw [add_assoc]
      congr 1
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [intFallingFactorial_shift, add_zsmul]
      congr 1
      rw [show ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (i.val + 1 : ℤ) by norm_num,
        mul_comm (i.val + 1 : ℤ) (intFallingFactorial n i.val),
        mul_zsmul, hc]

name: TranslationalTilings.fallingPolynomial_natDegree_le
statement:
private theorem fallingPolynomial_natDegree_le (k : ℕ) :
    (fallingPolynomial k).natDegree ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  unfold fallingPolynomial
  calc
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.range k,
        (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (j : ℤ))).natDegree
        ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k,
            (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (j : ℤ)).natDegree :=
      Polynomial.natDegree_prod_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range k, 1 := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun _ _ ↦ Polynomial.natDegree_X_sub_C_le _
    _ = k := by simp

name: TranslationalTilings.fallingPolynomial_eval
statement:
private theorem fallingPolynomial_eval (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    Polynomial.eval n (fallingPolynomial k) = intFallingFactorial n k
proof:
:= by
  simp [fallingPolynomial, intFallingFactorial, Polynomial.eval_prod]

name: TranslationalTilings.fallingPolynomial_eval_fin
statement:
private theorem fallingPolynomial_eval_fin
    (n : ℤ) {k d : ℕ} (hkd : k ≤ d) :
    intFallingFactorial n k =
      ∑ j : Fin (d + 1),
        (fallingPolynomial k).coeff j.val * n ^ j.val
proof:
:= by
  have hdegree : (fallingPolynomial k).natDegree < d + 1 :=
    (fallingPolynomial_natDegree_le k).trans_lt (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hkd)
  calc
    intFallingFactorial n k = Polynomial.eval n (fallingPolynomial k) :=
      (fallingPolynomial_eval n k).symm
    _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((fallingPolynomial k).natDegree + 1),
          (fallingPolynomial k).coeff j * n ^ j :=
      Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range n
    _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
          (fallingPolynomial k).coeff j * n ^ j := by
      apply Finset.sum_subset
      · exact Finset.range_mono (Nat.succ_le_succ
          (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hdegree))
      · intro j hj hjnot
        have hjdegree : (fallingPolynomial k).natDegree < j := by
          have : ¬j < (fallingPolynomial k).natDegree + 1 := by
            simpa only [Finset.mem_range] using hjnot
          omega
        rw [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt hjdegree, zero_mul]
    _ = ∑ j : Fin (d + 1),
          (fallingPolynomial k).coeff j.val * n ^ j.val := by
      exact (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
        (fun j ↦ (fallingPolynomial k).coeff j * n ^ j) (d + 1)).symm

name: TranslationalTilings.fallingFactorial_to_monomial_circle
statement:
theorem fallingFactorial_to_monomial_circle
    (a : Fin (d + 1) → Torus) :
  ∃ b : Fin (d + 1) → Torus, ∀ n : ℤ,
    (∑ i : Fin (d + 1), intFallingFactorial n (i : ℕ) • a i) =
      ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), n ^ (i : ℕ) • b i
proof:
:= by
  let b : Fin (d + 1) → Torus := fun j ↦
    ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), (fallingPolynomial i.val).coeff j.val • a i
  refine ⟨b, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  calc
    (∑ i : Fin (d + 1), intFallingFactorial n i.val • a i) =
        ∑ i : Fin (d + 1),
          (∑ j : Fin (d + 1),
            (fallingPolynomial i.val).coeff j.val * n ^ j.val) • a i := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [fallingPolynomial_eval_fin n (Nat.le_of_lt_succ i.isLt)]
    _ = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), ∑ j : Fin (d + 1),
          n ^ j.val • (fallingPolynomial i.val).coeff j.val • a i := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [show (∑ j : Fin (d + 1),
              (fallingPolynomial i.val).coeff j.val * n ^ j.val) • a i =
            ∑ j : Fin (d + 1),
              ((fallingPolynomial i.val).coeff j.val * n ^ j.val) • a i by
        exact Finset.sum_smul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [mul_comm, mul_zsmul]
    _ = ∑ j : Fin (d + 1), ∑ i : Fin (d + 1),
          n ^ j.val • (fallingPolynomial i.val).coeff j.val • a i :=
      Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ j : Fin (d + 1), n ^ j.val • b j := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      simp [b, Finset.smul_sum]

name: TranslationalTilings.exists_circlePolynomial_of_difference
statement:
theorem exists_circlePolynomial_of_difference
    (f : ℤ → Torus) (h : backwardDiffIter 1 (d + 1) f = 0) :
  ∃ P : CirclePolynomial d, ∀ n : ℤ, P n = f n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := circle_newton_expansion f h
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := fallingFactorial_to_monomial_circle a
  refine ⟨⟨b⟩, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [CirclePolynomial.eval, ← hb n, ← ha n]

name: TranslationalTilings.rational_iff_torsion_nonconstant
statement:
theorem rational_iff_torsion_nonconstant (P : CirclePolynomial d) :
    P.HasRationalNonconstantCoeffs ↔ P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hrat i hi
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hrat i hi
    rw [hq, AddCircle.isOfFinAddOrder_iff_exists_rat_eq_div]
    exact ⟨q, by norm_num⟩
  · intro htor i hi
    obtain ⟨m, _, _, hm⟩ :=
      AddCircle.exists_gcd_eq_one_of_isOfFinAddOrder (htor i hi)
    refine ⟨(m : ℚ) / addOrderOf (P.coeff i), ?_⟩
    calc
      P.coeff i =
          (((m : ℝ) / addOrderOf (P.coeff i) * 1 : ℝ) : Torus) := hm.symm
      _ = ((((m : ℚ) / addOrderOf (P.coeff i) : ℚ) : ℝ) : Torus) := by
        norm_num

name: TranslationalTilings.commonDenominator_pos
statement:
theorem commonDenominator_pos
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (hP : P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs) :
  0 < P.commonDenominator
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
  intro hzero
  rw [CirclePolynomial.commonDenominator, Finset.lcm_eq_zero_iff] at hzero
  obtain ⟨i, hi, horder⟩ := hzero
  have hi' : 0 < (i : ℕ) := by
    simpa [CirclePolynomial.nonconstantIndices] using hi
  exact (hP i hi').addOrderOf_pos.ne' horder

name: TranslationalTilings.commonDenominator_eq_zero_of_coeff_addOrderOf_eq_zero
statement:
theorem commonDenominator_eq_zero_of_coeff_addOrderOf_eq_zero
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) {i : Fin (d + 1)}
    (hi : 0 < (i : ℕ)) (horder : addOrderOf (P.coeff i) = 0) :
  P.commonDenominator = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [CirclePolynomial.commonDenominator, Finset.lcm_eq_zero_iff]
  refine ⟨i, ?_, horder⟩
  simp only [CirclePolynomial.nonconstantIndices, Finset.mem_filter,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  exact hi

name: TranslationalTilings.coeff_zsmul_commonDenominator
statement:
theorem coeff_zsmul_commonDenominator
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (_hP : P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : 0 < (i : ℕ)) :
  (P.commonDenominator : ℤ) • P.coeff i = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← addOrderOf_dvd_iff_zsmul_eq_zero,
    Int.natCast_dvd_natCast]
  exact Finset.dvd_lcm (by
    simp only [CirclePolynomial.nonconstantIndices, Finset.mem_filter,
      Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact hi)

name: TranslationalTilings.periodic_commonDenominator
statement:
theorem periodic_commonDenominator
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (hP : P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs) :
  P.PeriodicWith P.commonDenominator
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  unfold CirclePolynomial.eval
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · simp [hi]
  · have hipos : 0 < i.val := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hi
    have hmod : (n + (P.commonDenominator : ℤ)) ^ i.val ≡
        n ^ i.val [ZMOD (P.commonDenominator : ℤ)] := by
      apply Int.ModEq.pow
      rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
      exact ⟨-1, by ring⟩
    have hdiv : (P.commonDenominator : ℤ) ∣
        (n + (P.commonDenominator : ℤ)) ^ i.val - n ^ i.val := by
      rw [← Int.dvd_neg]
      simpa [Int.modEq_iff_dvd] using hmod
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, sub_eq_add_neg, ← sub_zsmul]
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hdiv
    rw [hm, mul_comm, mul_zsmul,
      coeff_zsmul_commonDenominator P hP i hipos, smul_zero]

name: TranslationalTilings.commonDenominator_zsmul_dvd
statement:
theorem commonDenominator_zsmul_dvd
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (_hP : P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs)
    (k : ℤ) :
  (P.zsmul k).commonDenominator ∣ P.commonDenominator
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.lcm_dvd
  intro i hi
  apply (addOrderOf_dvd_of_mem_zmultiples
    (AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mpr ⟨k, rfl⟩)).trans
  exact Finset.dvd_lcm (by
    simpa [CirclePolynomial.commonDenominator,
      CirclePolynomial.nonconstantIndices] using hi)

name: TranslationalTilings.commonDenominator_dvd_natAbs_mul_zsmul
statement:
theorem commonDenominator_dvd_natAbs_mul_zsmul
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (_hP : P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs)
    (k : ℤ) :
  P.commonDenominator ∣
    Int.natAbs k * (P.zsmul k).commonDenominator
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.lcm_dvd
  intro i hi
  rw [← Int.natCast_dvd_natCast,
    addOrderOf_dvd_iff_zsmul_eq_zero]
  have hi' : i ∈ CirclePolynomial.nonconstantIndices d := hi
  have horder : addOrderOf ((P.zsmul k).coeff i) ∣
      (P.zsmul k).commonDenominator := Finset.dvd_lcm hi'
  have hz : ((P.zsmul k).commonDenominator : ℤ) •
      (k • P.coeff i) = 0 := by
    rw [← addOrderOf_dvd_iff_zsmul_eq_zero,
      Int.natCast_dvd_natCast]
    exact horder
  rw [smul_smul] at hz
  by_cases hk : 0 ≤ k
  · rw [Int.natCast_mul, Int.natCast_natAbs, abs_of_nonneg hk,
      mul_comm]
    exact hz
  · rw [Int.natCast_mul, Int.natCast_natAbs,
      abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hk), neg_mul, neg_smul, mul_comm]
    simpa using congrArg Neg.neg hz

name: TranslationalTilings.sum_range_mul_period
statement:
private theorem sum_range_mul_period
    (g : ℕ → ℂ) (q m : ℕ) (hperiod : Function.Periodic g q) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (m * q), g n =
      m • ∑ n ∈ Finset.range q, g n
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
      rw [Nat.succ_mul, Finset.sum_range_add, ih, succ_nsmul]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n _
      have hn := (hperiod.nsmul m) n
      simpa [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc, mul_comm] using hn

name: TranslationalTilings.completeSum_eq_sum_range
proof:
:= by
  rw [completeSum, ← Finset.Ico_add_one_right_eq_Icc,
    Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range]
  simp [add_comm]

name: TranslationalTilings.normalized_completeSum_repeat
statement:
theorem normalized_completeSum_repeat
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (Q Q' : ℕ)
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQ' : 0 < Q') (hdiv : Q' ∣ Q)
    (hperiod : P.PeriodicWith Q') :
  (Q : ℂ)⁻¹ * completeSum P Q =
    (Q' : ℂ)⁻¹ * completeSum P Q'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hdiv
  have hm : 0 < m := by
    by_contra hm
    simp only [Nat.not_lt, Nat.le_zero] at hm
    subst m
    simp at hQ
  let g : ℕ → ℂ := fun n ↦ circlePhase (P ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
  have hg : Function.Periodic g Q' := by
    intro n
    apply congrArg circlePhase
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc, add_comm,
      add_left_comm] using hperiod (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
  rw [completeSum_eq_sum_range, completeSum_eq_sum_range]
  rw [Nat.mul_comm Q' m]
  change ((m * Q' : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (m * Q'), g n) =
    (Q' : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range Q', g n
  rw [sum_range_mul_period g Q' m hg]
  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm.ne', Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hQ'.ne']

name: TranslationalTilings.normalized_completeSum_repeat_zero_regression
statement:
theorem normalized_completeSum_repeat_zero_regression :
  let P : CirclePolynomial 0 := ⟨fun _ ↦ 0⟩
  (0 : ℂ)⁻¹ * completeSum P 0 ≠
    (1 : ℂ)⁻¹ * completeSum P 1
proof:
:= by
  let P : CirclePolynomial 0 := ⟨fun _ ↦ 0⟩
  have hzero : completeSum P 0 = 0 := by
    simp [completeSum]
  have hone : completeSum P 1 = 1 := by
    rw [completeSum, show Finset.Icc 1 1 = {1} by simp]
    simp [P, CirclePolynomial.eval, circlePhase]
  change (0 : ℂ)⁻¹ * completeSum P 0 ≠
    (1 : ℂ)⁻¹ * completeSum P 1
  rw [hzero, hone]
  norm_num

name: TranslationalTilings.exists_integralPhase
statement:
theorem exists_integralPhase
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (hP : P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs) :
  ∃ A : IntegralPolynomialPhase d,
    A.modulus = P.commonDenominator ∧ A.Primitive ∧
    ∀ n : ℤ, P n = P.coeff 0 +
      (((A.evalNumerator n : ℝ) / A.modulus : ℝ) : Torus)
proof:
:= by
  let Q := P.commonDenominator
  have hQ : 0 < Q := commonDenominator_pos P hP
  have hexists (i : Fin d) : ∃ m < Q,
      (((m : ℝ) / Q * 1 : ℝ) : Torus) = P.coeff i.succ := by
    rw [← AddCircle.nsmul_eq_zero_iff hQ]
    simpa [Q] using coeff_zsmul_commonDenominator P hP i.succ (by simp)
  let numerator : Fin d → ℕ := fun i ↦ Classical.choose (hexists i)
  have hnumerator_lt (i : Fin d) : numerator i < Q :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hexists i)).1
  have hnumerator_eq (i : Fin d) :
      ((((numerator i : ℕ) : ℝ) / Q * 1 : ℝ) : Torus) =
        P.coeff i.succ :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hexists i)).2
  let A : IntegralPolynomialPhase d :=
    { modulus := Q
      modulus_pos := hQ
      coeff := fun i ↦ (numerator i : ℤ) }
  have hprimitive : A.Primitive := by
    rw [IntegralPolynomialPhase.Primitive, Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one]
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpgcd⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hne
    have hpQ : p ∣ Q := (Nat.dvd_gcd_iff.mp hpgcd).1
    have hpg : p ∣ Finset.univ.gcd fun i : Fin d ↦
        Int.natAbs (A.coeff i) := (Nat.dvd_gcd_iff.mp hpgcd).2
    have hpnum (i : Fin d) : p ∣ numerator i := by
      have := (Finset.dvd_gcd_iff.mp hpg) i (Finset.mem_univ i)
      simpa [A, numerator] using this
    have horder_dvd (i : Fin d) :
        addOrderOf (P.coeff i.succ) ∣ Q / p := by
      rw [← hnumerator_eq i]
      apply (Nat.dvd_div_iff_mul_dvd hpQ).2
      have hpgcdnum : p ∣ (numerator i).gcd Q :=
        Nat.dvd_gcd (hpnum i) hpQ
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hpgcdnum
      refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
      have horder := AddCircle.gcd_mul_addOrderOf_div_eq
        (1 : ℝ) (numerator i) hQ
      rw [ht] at horder
      simpa [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using horder.symm
    have hQdvd : Q ∣ Q / p := by
      apply Finset.lcm_dvd
      intro i hi
      have hipos : 0 < i.val := by
        simpa only [CirclePolynomial.nonconstantIndices,
          Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using hi
      have hi0 : i ≠ 0 := by
        intro hi0
        subst i
        simp at hipos
      let j : Fin d := i.pred hi0
      rw [← Fin.succ_pred i hi0]
      exact horder_dvd j
    have hp_le_Q : p ≤ Q := Nat.le_of_dvd hQ hpQ
    have hQdivpos : 0 < Q / p := Nat.div_pos hp_le_Q hp.pos
    have hle : Q ≤ Q / p := Nat.le_of_dvd hQdivpos hQdvd
    exact (Nat.not_le_of_lt (Nat.div_lt_self hQ hp.one_lt)) hle
  refine ⟨A, rfl, hprimitive, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [CirclePolynomial.eval, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  norm_num only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_zsmul]
  congr 1
  have hterm (i : Fin d) :
      n ^ (i.val + 1) • P.coeff i.succ =
        ((((((numerator i : ℕ) : ℤ) * n ^ (i.val + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ) /
          (Q : ℝ) : ℝ) : Torus) := by
    rw [← hnumerator_eq i, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_zsmul]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    simp only [zsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    push_cast
    ring
  have hsum :
      (∑ i : Fin d, n ^ (i.succ : ℕ) • P.coeff i.succ) =
        ∑ i : Fin d,
        ((((((numerator i : ℕ) : ℤ) * n ^ (i.val + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ) /
          (Q : ℝ) : ℝ) : Torus) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simpa using hterm i
  rw [hsum]
  rw [← QuotientAddGroup.mk_sum]
  congr 1
  simp [A, IntegralPolynomialPhase.evalNumerator, div_eq_mul_inv,
    Finset.sum_mul]

name: TranslationalTilings.integralPhase_modulus
statement:
theorem integralPhase_modulus
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (hP : P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs) :
  (P.integralPhase hP).modulus = P.commonDenominator
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_integralPhase P hP)).1

name: TranslationalTilings.integralPhase_primitive
statement:
theorem integralPhase_primitive
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (hP : P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs) :
  (P.integralPhase hP).Primitive
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_integralPhase P hP)).2.1

name: TranslationalTilings.integralPhase_eval
statement:
theorem integralPhase_eval
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (hP : P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs) (n : ℤ) :
  P n = P.coeff 0 +
    ((((P.integralPhase hP).evalNumerator n : ℝ) /
      (P.integralPhase hP).modulus : ℝ) : Torus)
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_integralPhase P hP)).2.2 n

name: TranslationalTilings.norm_completeSum_eq_integralPhase
statement:
theorem norm_completeSum_eq_integralPhase
    (P : CirclePolynomial d) (hP : P.HasTorsionNonconstantCoeffs) :
  ‖completeSum P P.commonDenominator‖ =
    ‖integralCompleteSum (P.integralPhase hP)‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [completeSum, integralCompleteSum]
  have hmodulus := integralPhase_modulus P hP
  rw [← hmodulus]
  have hsum :
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (P.integralPhase hP).modulus,
          circlePhase (P n)) =
        circlePhase (P.coeff 0) *
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (P.integralPhase hP).modulus,
            circlePhase
              (((((P.integralPhase hP).evalNumerator n : ℤ) : ℝ) /
                (P.integralPhase hP).modulus : ℝ) : Torus) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro n _
    rw [integralPhase_eval, circlePhase_add]
  rw [hsum, norm_mul, norm_circlePhase, one_mul]

name: Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat_C_mul
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat_C_mul
    (u : ℤ) (f : Polynomial ℤ) :
  Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat (Polynomial.C u * f) =
    Int.natAbs u * Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f
proof:
:= by
  have hpart : Polynomial.nonconstantPart (Polynomial.C u * f) =
      Polynomial.C u * Polynomial.nonconstantPart f := by
    ext n
    simp only [Polynomial.nonconstantPart, Polynomial.coeff_sub,
      Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_C]
    split <;> simp_all
  rw [Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat, hpart,
    Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat, Polynomial.contentNat,
    Polynomial.contentNat, Polynomial.content_C_mul]
  rw [Int.natAbs_mul, ← Int.abs_eq_normalize, Int.natAbs_abs]

name: TranslationalTilings.coeff_coeffDiv
statement:
private theorem coeff_coeffDiv (f : Polynomial ℤ) (m n : ℕ) :
    (Polynomial.coeffDiv f m).coeff n = f.coeff n / (m : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [Polynomial.coeffDiv, Polynomial.sum_def, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff,
    Polynomial.coeff_monomial, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Polynomial.mem_support_iff,
    ne_eq, ite_not, ite_eq_right_iff]
  intro h
  simp [h]

name: TranslationalTilings.contentNat_dvd_coeff
statement:
private theorem contentNat_dvd_coeff (f : Polynomial ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    (Polynomial.contentNat f : ℤ) ∣ f.coeff n
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Polynomial.contentNat, Int.natCast_natAbs, Int.abs_eq_normalize,
    Polynomial.normalize_content] using Polynomial.content_dvd_coeff (p := f) n

name: TranslationalTilings.contentNat_C_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.contentNat, Polynomial.contentNat, Polynomial.content_C_mul,
    Int.natAbs_mul, ← Int.abs_eq_normalize, Int.natAbs_abs]

name: TranslationalTilings.contentNat_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem contentNat_ne_zero (f : Polynomial ℤ) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    Polynomial.contentNat f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.contentNat, Int.natAbs_ne_zero]
  exact fun h ↦ hf (Polynomial.content_eq_zero_iff.mp h)

name: TranslationalTilings.primePowOrder_dvd_coeff
statement:
private theorem primePowOrder_dvd_coeff
    (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((p ^ Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p f : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ f.coeff n
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  apply dvd_trans (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr ?_) (contentNat_dvd_coeff f n)
  exact (padicValNat_dvd_iff (Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p f)
    (Polynomial.contentNat f)).2 (Or.inr le_rfl)

name: Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime_spec
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime_spec
    (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (_hf : f ≠ 0) :
  f = Polynomial.C
      ((p ^ Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p f : ℕ) : ℤ) *
    Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime p f
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime, coeff_coeffDiv]
  exact (Int.mul_ediv_cancel_of_emod_eq_zero
    (Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero.mp (primePowOrder_dvd_coeff hp f n))).symm

name: Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime_primitive
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime_primitive
    (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
  ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.contentNat (Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime p f)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  intro hdiv
  have hcontent := congrArg Polynomial.contentNat
    (Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime_spec hp f hf)
  rw [contentNat_C_mul] at hcontent
  simp only [Nat.cast_pow, Int.natAbs_pow, Int.natAbs_natCast] at hcontent
  have hcontra : p ^ (Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p f + 1) ∣
      Polynomial.contentNat f := by
    rw [hcontent, pow_succ']
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm] using
      Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left (p ^ Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p f) hdiv
  exact (pow_succ_padicValNat_not_dvd (p := p) (contentNat_ne_zero f hf))
    (by simpa [Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder] using hcontra)

name: TranslationalTilings.primeScaleTranslate_eq_taylor_comp
statement:
private theorem primeScaleTranslate_eq_taylor_comp
    (f : Polynomial ℤ) (p : ℕ) (mu : ℤ) :
    Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate f p mu =
      (Polynomial.taylor mu f).comp (Polynomial.C (p : ℤ) * Polynomial.X)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate, Polynomial.taylor_apply,
    Polynomial.comp_assoc, Polynomial.add_comp, Polynomial.X_comp,
    Polynomial.C_comp]

name: TranslationalTilings.primeScaleTranslate_coeff
statement:
private theorem primeScaleTranslate_coeff
    (f : Polynomial ℤ) (p n : ℕ) (mu : ℤ) :
    (Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate f p mu).coeff n =
      (Polynomial.taylor mu f).coeff n * (p : ℤ) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [primeScaleTranslate_eq_taylor_comp, Polynomial.comp_C_mul_X_coeff]

name: TranslationalTilings.primeScaleTranslate_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem primeScaleTranslate_ne_zero
    (hp : p.Prime) (g : Polynomial ℤ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (mu : ℤ) :
    Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate g p mu ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [primeScaleTranslate_eq_taylor_comp]
  intro hzero
  have htaylor : Polynomial.taylor mu g = 0 :=
    (Polynomial.comp_C_mul_X_eq_zero_iff (p := Polynomial.taylor mu g)
      (by simp [hp.ne_zero])).mp hzero
  exact hg ((Polynomial.taylor_eq_zero mu g).mp htaylor)

name: TranslationalTilings.taylor_coefficient_at_rootMultiplicity_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem taylor_coefficient_at_rootMultiplicity_ne_zero
    [Fact p.Prime] (g : Polynomial ℤ) (hg : Polynomial.modPrime p g ≠ 0)
    (mu : ZMod p) :
    (Polynomial.taylor mu (Polynomial.modPrime p g)).coeff
        ((Polynomial.modPrime p g).rootMultiplicity mu) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree]
  exact Polynomial.coeff_natTrailingDegree_ne_zero.mpr
    ((Polynomial.taylor_eq_zero mu (Polynomial.modPrime p g)).not.mpr hg)

name: TranslationalTilings.integerTaylorCoefficient_at_rootMultiplicity_not_dvd
statement:
private theorem integerTaylorCoefficient_at_rootMultiplicity_not_dvd
    [Fact p.Prime] (g : Polynomial ℤ) (hg : Polynomial.modPrime p g ≠ 0)
    (mu : ZMod p) :
    ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ (Polynomial.taylor (mu.val : ℤ) g).coeff
      ((Polynomial.modPrime p g).rootMultiplicity mu)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  change ((Int.castRingHom (ZMod p))
    ((Polynomial.taylor (mu.val : ℤ) g).coeff
      ((Polynomial.modPrime p g).rootMultiplicity mu))) ≠ 0
  rw [← Polynomial.coeff_map]
  simpa [Polynomial.modPrime] using
    taylor_coefficient_at_rootMultiplicity_ne_zero g hg mu

name: TranslationalTilings.primeScaleTranslate_order_le_rootMultiplicity
statement:
private theorem primeScaleTranslate_order_le_rootMultiplicity
    [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p.Prime) (g : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hg : Polynomial.modPrime p g ≠ 0) (mu : ZMod p) :
    Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p
        (Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate g p mu.val) ≤
      (Polynomial.modPrime p g).rootMultiplicity mu
proof:
:= by
  let m := (Polynomial.modPrime p g).rootMultiplicity mu
  let u := Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p
    (Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate g p mu.val)
  by_contra hle
  have hmu : m + 1 ≤ u := Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hle)
  have horder : (((p ^ u : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∣
      (Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate g p mu.val).coeff m := by
    exact primePowOrder_dvd_coeff hp _ m
  have hpow : (((p ^ (m + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∣
      ((p ^ u : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    exact Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr (pow_dvd_pow p hmu)
  have hdiv := dvd_trans hpow horder
  have hcancel : ((p : ℤ) ^ m) * (p : ℤ) ∣
      ((p : ℤ) ^ m) * (Polynomial.taylor (mu.val : ℤ) g).coeff m := by
    simpa [primeScaleTranslate_coeff, Nat.cast_pow, pow_succ,
      mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hdiv
  have hpne : (p : ℤ) ^ m ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero)
  have hpdiv : (p : ℤ) ∣
      (Polynomial.taylor (mu.val : ℤ) g).coeff m :=
    (mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hpne).mp hcancel
  exact integerTaylorCoefficient_at_rootMultiplicity_not_dvd g hg mu hpdiv

name: Polynomial.ack_lemma_2_2_degree
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.ack_lemma_2_2_degree
    [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p.Prime) (g : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hg : Polynomial.modPrime p g ≠ 0) (mu : ZMod p)
    (_hmu : (Polynomial.modPrime p g).IsRoot mu) :
  (Polynomial.modPrime p
      (Polynomial.normalizedPrimeScaleTranslate g p mu.val)).natDegree ≤
    (Polynomial.modPrime p g).rootMultiplicity mu
proof:
:= by
  let m := (Polynomial.modPrime p g).rootMultiplicity mu
  let u := Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p
    (Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate g p mu.val)
  have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    simp [h, Polynomial.modPrime] at hg
  have htranslate : Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate g p mu.val ≠ 0 :=
    primeScaleTranslate_ne_zero hp g hg0 mu.val
  have hule : u ≤ m := primeScaleTranslate_order_le_rootMultiplicity hp g hg mu
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
  intro n hmn
  rw [Polynomial.modPrime, Polynomial.coeff_map]
  change (((Polynomial.normalizedPrimeScaleTranslate g p mu.val).coeff n : ℤ) :
    ZMod p) = 0
  rw [ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  have hun : u + 1 ≤ n := Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt hule hmn)
  have hbig : (((p ^ (u + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∣
      (Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate g p mu.val).coeff n := by
    rw [primeScaleTranslate_coeff]
    simpa [Nat.cast_pow] using
      ((pow_dvd_pow (p : ℤ) hun).mul_left
        ((Polynomial.taylor (mu.val : ℤ) g).coeff n))
  have hspec := congrArg (fun f : Polynomial ℤ ↦ f.coeff n)
    (Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime_spec hp
      (Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate g p mu.val) htranslate)
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul] at hspec
  change (Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate g p mu.val).coeff n =
    (p : ℤ) ^ u *
      (Polynomial.normalizedPrimeScaleTranslate g p mu.val).coeff n at hspec
  rw [hspec] at hbig
  have hcancel : ((p : ℤ) ^ u) * (p : ℤ) ∣
      ((p : ℤ) ^ u) *
        (Polynomial.normalizedPrimeScaleTranslate g p mu.val).coeff n := by
    simpa [Polynomial.normalizedPrimeScaleTranslate, Nat.cast_pow, pow_succ,
      mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hbig
  exact (mul_dvd_mul_iff_left
    (pow_ne_zero u (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero))).mp hcancel

name: TranslationalTilings.rootMassModPrime_le_natDegree
statement:
private theorem rootMassModPrime_le_natDegree
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (f : Polynomial ℤ) :
    Polynomial.rootMassModPrime p f ≤ (Polynomial.modPrime p f).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hf : Polynomial.modPrime p f = 0
  · simp [Polynomial.rootMassModPrime, Polynomial.rootsModPrime, hf]
  · have hroots : Polynomial.rootsModPrime p f =
        (Polynomial.modPrime p f).roots.toFinset := by
      ext x
      simp [Polynomial.rootsModPrime, Polynomial.mem_roots hf]
    rw [Polynomial.rootMassModPrime, hroots]
    calc
      ∑ x ∈ (Polynomial.modPrime p f).roots.toFinset,
          (Polynomial.modPrime p f).rootMultiplicity x =
          (Polynomial.modPrime p f).roots.card := by
            rw [← Multiset.toFinset_sum_count_eq
              (Polynomial.modPrime p f).roots]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro x _
            exact (Polynomial.count_roots (Polynomial.modPrime p f)).symm
      _ ≤ (Polynomial.modPrime p f).natDegree :=
        Polynomial.card_roots' (Polynomial.modPrime p f)

name: Polynomial.ack_lemma_2_2_rootMass
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.ack_lemma_2_2_rootMass
    [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p.Prime) (g : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hg : Polynomial.modPrime p g ≠ 0) (mu : ZMod p)
    (hmu : (Polynomial.modPrime p g).IsRoot mu) :
  Polynomial.rootMassModPrime p
      (Polynomial.normalizedPrimeScaleTranslate g p mu.val) ≤
    (Polynomial.modPrime p g).rootMultiplicity mu
proof:
:=
  (rootMassModPrime_le_natDegree p _).trans
    (Polynomial.ack_lemma_2_2_degree hp g hg mu hmu)

name: TranslationalTilings.stationaryTranslate_coeff_of_pos
statement:
private theorem stationaryTranslate_coeff_of_pos
    (f : Polynomial ℤ) (p n : ℕ) (mu : ℤ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (Polynomial.stationaryTranslate f p mu).coeff n =
      (Polynomial.taylor mu f).coeff n * (p : ℤ) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.stationaryTranslate, Polynomial.coeff_sub,
    primeScaleTranslate_coeff]
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_C]
  simp [hn.ne']

name: TranslationalTilings.stationaryTranslate_coeff_zero
statement:
private theorem stationaryTranslate_coeff_zero
    (f : Polynomial ℤ) (p : ℕ) (mu : ℤ) :
    (Polynomial.stationaryTranslate f p mu).coeff 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [Polynomial.stationaryTranslate, primeScaleTranslate_coeff,
    Polynomial.taylor_coeff_zero]

name: TranslationalTilings.stationaryTranslate_ne_zero_of_natDegree_pos
statement:
private theorem stationaryTranslate_ne_zero_of_natDegree_pos
    (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hdegree : 0 < f.natDegree) (mu : ℤ) :
    Polynomial.stationaryTranslate f p mu ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hprime : Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate f p mu ≠ 0 :=
    primeScaleTranslate_ne_zero hp f hf mu
  have hprimeDegree : (Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate f p mu).natDegree =
      f.natDegree := by
    rw [primeScaleTranslate_eq_taylor_comp, Polynomial.natDegree_comp,
      Polynomial.natDegree_taylor,
      Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_X (p : ℤ) (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero),
      Nat.mul_one]
  intro hzero
  have hdegreeZero := congrArg Polynomial.natDegree hzero
  rw [Polynomial.stationaryTranslate,
    Polynomial.natDegree_sub_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt] at hdegreeZero
  · simp [hprimeDegree, hdegree.ne'] at hdegreeZero
  · simpa [hprimeDegree] using hdegree

name: TranslationalTilings.modPrime_nonconstantPart_ne_zero_of_primitive
statement:
private theorem modPrime_nonconstantPart_ne_zero_of_primitive
    (_hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f) :
    Polynomial.modPrime p (Polynomial.nonconstantPart f) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  apply hprimitive
  rw [Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat, Polynomial.contentNat,
    ← Int.natCast_dvd]
  apply Polynomial.dvd_content_iff_C_dvd.mpr
  apply (Polynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff (p : ℤ) _).mpr
  intro n
  rw [← ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  have hn := congrArg (fun q : Polynomial (ZMod p) ↦ q.coeff n) hzero
  simpa [Polynomial.modPrime] using hn

name: TranslationalTilings.nonconstant_natDegree_pos_of_primitive
statement:
private theorem nonconstant_natDegree_pos_of_primitive
    (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f) :
    0 < f.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have hbar := modPrime_nonconstantPart_ne_zero_of_primitive hp f hprimitive
  have hdegree : (Polynomial.modPrime p (Polynomial.nonconstantPart f)).natDegree ≤
      f.natDegree := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (Polynomial.nonconstantPart f).natDegree := Polynomial.natDegree_map_le
      _ = f.natDegree := Polynomial.natDegree_sub_C
  exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hfdegree ↦ hbar <| by
    have hbarDegree :
        (Polynomial.modPrime p (Polynomial.nonconstantPart f)).natDegree ≤ 0 := by
      omega
    rw [Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_le_zero hbarDegree]
    simp [Polynomial.modPrime, Polynomial.nonconstantPart]

name: TranslationalTilings.contentOrder_le_of_coeff_factor
statement:
private theorem contentOrder_le_of_coeff_factor
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (F : Polynomial ℤ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℤ)
    (hcoeff : F.coeff n = t * (p : ℤ) ^ n)
    (ht : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ t) :
    Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p F ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  let u := Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p F
  by_contra hle
  have hnu : n + 1 ≤ u := Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hle)
  have horder : (((p ^ u : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∣ F.coeff n :=
    primePowOrder_dvd_coeff hp F n
  have hpow : (((p ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∣ ((p ^ u : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
    Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr (pow_dvd_pow p hnu)
  have hdiv := dvd_trans hpow horder
  rw [hcoeff] at hdiv
  have hcancel : ((p : ℤ) ^ n) * (p : ℤ) ∣ ((p : ℤ) ^ n) * t := by
    simpa [Nat.cast_pow, pow_succ, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hdiv
  exact ht ((mul_dvd_mul_iff_left
    (pow_ne_zero n (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero))).mp hcancel)

name: TranslationalTilings.stationaryTranslate_all_coeff_dvd
statement:
private theorem stationaryTranslate_all_coeff_dvd
    {p : ℕ} (_hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (mu : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    (p : ℤ) ∣ (Polynomial.stationaryTranslate f p mu).coeff n
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := n.eq_zero_or_pos
  · simp [stationaryTranslate_coeff_zero]
  · rw [stationaryTranslate_coeff_of_pos f p n mu hn]
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (dvd_pow_self (p : ℤ) hn.ne') _

name: TranslationalTilings.one_le_stationaryOrder
statement:
private theorem one_le_stationaryOrder
    {p : ℕ} {mu : ℤ} (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (htranslate : Polynomial.stationaryTranslate f p mu ≠ 0) :
    1 ≤ Polynomial.stationaryOrder f p mu
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  apply one_le_padicValNat_of_dvd
  · exact contentNat_ne_zero _ htranslate
  · rw [Polynomial.contentNat, ← Int.natCast_dvd]
    exact Polynomial.dvd_content_iff_C_dvd.mpr <|
      (Polynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff (p : ℤ) _).mpr
        (stationaryTranslate_all_coeff_dvd hp f mu)

name: TranslationalTilings.stationaryOrder_le_natDegree
statement:
