private theorem stationaryOrder_le_natDegree
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f) (mu : ℤ) :
    Polynomial.stationaryOrder f p mu ≤ f.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  let fbar := Polynomial.modPrime p (Polynomial.nonconstantPart f)
  let tau := fbar.natDegree
  have hfbar : fbar ≠ 0 :=
    modPrime_nonconstantPart_ne_zero_of_primitive hp f hprimitive
  have hcoeffZero : fbar.coeff 0 = 0 := by
    simp [fbar, Polynomial.modPrime, Polynomial.nonconstantPart]
  have htau : 0 < tau := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    intro htauZero
    apply hfbar
    rw [Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_le_zero (p := fbar) (by omega), hcoeffZero,
      Polynomial.C_0]
  have htauDegree : tau ≤ f.natDegree := by
    calc
      tau ≤ (Polynomial.nonconstantPart f).natDegree := Polynomial.natDegree_map_le
      _ = f.natDegree := Polynomial.natDegree_sub_C
  have htaylorBar : (Polynomial.taylor (mu : ZMod p) fbar).coeff tau ≠ 0 := by
    have htaylorNe : Polynomial.taylor (mu : ZMod p) fbar ≠ 0 :=
      (Polynomial.taylor_eq_zero (mu : ZMod p) fbar).not.mpr hfbar
    have htaylorDegree :
        (Polynomial.taylor (mu : ZMod p) fbar).natDegree = tau := by
      simp [tau]
    rw [← htaylorDegree]
    exact Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr htaylorNe
  have htaylorInt : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ (Polynomial.taylor mu f).coeff tau := by
    rw [← ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
    change ((Int.castRingHom (ZMod p)) ((Polynomial.taylor mu f).coeff tau)) ≠ 0
    rw [← Polynomial.coeff_map]
    have hmap := Polynomial.map_taylor f mu (Int.castRingHom (ZMod p))
    rw [hmap]
    have hcoeffEq : (Polynomial.taylor (mu : ZMod p) fbar).coeff tau =
        (Polynomial.taylor (mu : ZMod p) (Polynomial.modPrime p f)).coeff tau := by
      rw [show fbar = Polynomial.modPrime p f -
          Polynomial.C ((f.coeff 0 : ℤ) : ZMod p) by
        simp [fbar, Polynomial.modPrime, Polynomial.nonconstantPart]]
      simp only [map_sub, Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.taylor_C,
        Polynomial.coeff_C]
      simp [htau.ne']
    rw [hcoeffEq] at htaylorBar
    simpa [Polynomial.modPrime] using htaylorBar
  change Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p
      (Polynomial.stationaryTranslate f p mu) ≤ f.natDegree
  exact (contentOrder_le_of_coeff_factor hp _ tau _
    (stationaryTranslate_coeff_of_pos f p tau mu htau) htaylorInt).trans htauDegree

name: Polynomial.ack_lemma_2_3
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.ack_lemma_2_3
    (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hdegree : f.natDegree ≤ d)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f)
    (mu : ℤ) :
  1 ≤ Polynomial.stationaryOrder f p mu ∧
    Polynomial.stationaryOrder f p mu ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  have hdegpos := nonconstant_natDegree_pos_of_primitive hp f hprimitive
  have hf : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    subst f
    simp at hdegpos
  have htranslate := stationaryTranslate_ne_zero_of_natDegree_pos hp f hf hdegpos mu
  exact ⟨one_le_stationaryOrder hp f htranslate,
    (stationaryOrder_le_natDegree hp f hprimitive mu).trans hdegree⟩

name: TranslationalTilings.stationaryTranslate_natDegree
statement:
private theorem stationaryTranslate_natDegree
    (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hdegree : 0 < f.natDegree) (mu : ℤ) :
    (Polynomial.stationaryTranslate f p mu).natDegree = f.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have hprimeDegree : (Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate f p mu).natDegree =
      f.natDegree := by
    rw [primeScaleTranslate_eq_taylor_comp, Polynomial.natDegree_comp,
      Polynomial.natDegree_taylor,
      Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_X (p : ℤ) (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero),
      Nat.mul_one]
  rw [Polynomial.stationaryTranslate,
    Polynomial.natDegree_sub_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt]
  · exact hprimeDegree
  · calc
      (Polynomial.C (f.eval mu)).natDegree ≤ 0 := by simp
      _ < (Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate f p mu).natDegree := by
        rw [hprimeDegree]
        exact hdegree

name: TranslationalTilings.normalizeAtPrime_natDegree
statement:
private theorem normalizeAtPrime_natDegree
    (hp : p.Prime) (F : Polynomial ℤ) (hF : F ≠ 0) :
    (Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime p F).natDegree = F.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have hspec := Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime_spec hp F hF
  have hnorm : Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime p F ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero, mul_zero] at hspec
    exact hF hspec
  have hscalar :
      (((p ^ Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p F : ℕ) : ℤ)) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast pow_ne_zero (Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p F) hp.ne_zero
  have hdegree := congrArg Polynomial.natDegree hspec
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_of_mul_ne_zero
    (mul_ne_zero hscalar (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hnorm))] at hdegree
  exact hdegree.symm

name: Polynomial.stationaryChildInvariant
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.stationaryChildInvariant
    (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (hd : 0 < d)
    (_hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f)
    (mu : ℤ) :
  Polynomial.StationaryChildInvariant f p mu d
proof:
:= by
  have hf : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    exact hd.ne' (by simpa [hzero] using hdegree.symm)
  have hfdegree : 0 < f.natDegree := hdegree.symm ▸ hd
  have htranslate : Polynomial.stationaryTranslate f p mu ≠ 0 :=
    stationaryTranslate_ne_zero_of_natDegree_pos hp f hf hfdegree mu
  have hnormDegree : (Polynomial.stationaryNormalize f p mu).natDegree = d := by
    rw [Polynomial.stationaryNormalize,
      normalizeAtPrime_natDegree hp _ htranslate,
      stationaryTranslate_natDegree hp f hfdegree mu, hdegree]
  have hcoeffSpec := congrArg (fun q : Polynomial ℤ ↦ q.coeff 0)
    (Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime_spec hp
      (Polynomial.stationaryTranslate f p mu) htranslate)
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, stationaryTranslate_coeff_zero] at hcoeffSpec
  have hscalar :
      (((p ^ Polynomial.stationaryOrder f p mu : ℕ) : ℤ)) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast pow_ne_zero (Polynomial.stationaryOrder f p mu) hp.ne_zero
  have hcoeffZero : (Polynomial.stationaryNormalize f p mu).coeff 0 = 0 := by
    apply (mul_eq_zero.mp hcoeffSpec.symm).resolve_left
    simpa [Polynomial.stationaryOrder, Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder] using hscalar
  have hfullPrimitive :
      ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.contentNat (Polynomial.stationaryNormalize f p mu) := by
    exact Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime_primitive hp _ htranslate
  refine ⟨htranslate, hnormDegree, hcoeffZero, ?_⟩
  simpa [Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat, Polynomial.nonconstantPart,
    hcoeffZero] using hfullPrimitive

name: TranslationalTilings.stationaryTranslate_all_coeff_prime_sq_dvd
statement:
private theorem stationaryTranslate_all_coeff_prime_sq_dvd
    (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (mu : ZMod p)
    (hmu : (Polynomial.modPrime p f.derivative).IsRoot mu) (n : ℕ) :
    ((p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ (Polynomial.stationaryTranslate f p mu.val).coeff n
proof:
:= by
  let _ : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  obtain rfl | rfl | n := n
  · simp [stationaryTranslate_coeff_zero]
  · rw [stationaryTranslate_coeff_of_pos f p 1 mu.val Nat.zero_lt_one]
    have hderiv : (p : ℤ) ∣ f.derivative.eval mu.val := by
      rw [← ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      change (Int.castRingHom (ZMod p)) (f.derivative.eval mu.val) = 0
      rw [← Polynomial.eval_map_apply]
      simpa [Polynomial.modPrime, Polynomial.IsRoot, Int.cast_natCast,
        ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using hmu
    rw [Polynomial.taylor_coeff_one, pow_one, pow_two]
    rcases hderiv with ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    rw [hk]
    norm_num [Nat.cast_pow]
    ring
  · rw [stationaryTranslate_coeff_of_pos f p (n + 2) mu.val (by omega)]
    have hpow : (p : ℤ) ^ 2 ∣ (p : ℤ) ^ (n + 2) :=
      pow_dvd_pow (p : ℤ) (by omega)
    simpa [Nat.cast_pow] using
      hpow.mul_left ((Polynomial.taylor (mu.val : ℤ) f).coeff (n + 2))

name: Polynomial.stationaryOrder_two_le_of_isRoot
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.stationaryOrder_two_le_of_isRoot
    (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (mu : ZMod p)
    (htranslate : Polynomial.stationaryTranslate f p mu.val ≠ 0)
    (hmu : (Polynomial.modPrime p f.derivative).IsRoot mu) :
  2 ≤ Polynomial.stationaryOrder f p mu.val
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  rw [Polynomial.stationaryOrder, Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder]
  apply (padicValNat_dvd_iff_le (p := p)
    (contentNat_ne_zero _ htranslate)).mp
  rw [Polynomial.contentNat, ← Int.natCast_dvd]
  apply Polynomial.dvd_content_iff_C_dvd.mpr
  exact (Polynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff (((p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) _).mpr
    (stationaryTranslate_all_coeff_prime_sq_dvd hp f mu hmu)

name: TranslationalTilings.chen_convexity_bound
statement:
theorem chen_convexity_bound
    {I : Type*} (s : Finset I) (a : ℝ) (m : I → ℕ)
    (ha : 1 < a) (hm : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < m i) :
  ∑ i ∈ s, a ^ m i ≤
    max (((∑ i ∈ s, m i : ℕ) : ℝ) * a)
      (a ^ (∑ i ∈ s, m i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := ∑ i ∈ s, m i
  have hmK (i : I) (hi : i ∈ s) : m i ≤ K := by
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ Nat.zero_le (m j)) hi
  have hcardK : s.card ≤ K := by
    calc
      s.card = ∑ i ∈ s, 1 := by simp
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, m i :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi ↦ hm i hi
      _ = K := rfl
  by_cases hK : K ≤ 1
  · have hmOne (i : I) (hi : i ∈ s) : m i = 1 := by
      have := hm i hi
      have := hmK i hi
      omega
    have hKcard : K = s.card := by
      calc
        K = ∑ i ∈ s, m i := rfl
        _ = ∑ i ∈ s, 1 := Finset.sum_congr rfl hmOne
        _ = s.card := by simp
    calc
      ∑ i ∈ s, a ^ m i = ∑ i ∈ s, a := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [hmOne i hi, pow_one]
      _ = (s.card : ℝ) * a := by simp
      _ = (K : ℝ) * a := by rw [hKcard]
      _ ≤ max ((K : ℝ) * a) (a ^ K) := le_max_left _ _
  · have hKone : (1 : ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_of_not_ge hK
    have hKsub : (K : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hKone)
    let alpha : I → ℝ := fun i ↦ ((K : ℝ) - m i) / ((K : ℝ) - 1)
    let beta : I → ℝ := fun i ↦ ((m i : ℝ) - 1) / ((K : ℝ) - 1)
    have hchord (i : I) (hi : i ∈ s) :
        a ^ m i ≤ alpha i * a + beta i * a ^ K := by
      have hmiOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m i := by exact_mod_cast hm i hi
      have hmiK : (m i : ℝ) ≤ K := by exact_mod_cast hmK i hi
      have halpha : 0 ≤ alpha i := by
        exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hmiK) (sub_nonneg.mpr hKone.le)
      have hbeta : 0 ≤ beta i := by
        exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hmiOne) (sub_nonneg.mpr hKone.le)
      have hab : alpha i + beta i = 1 := by
        dsimp [alpha, beta]
        field_simp
        ring
      have hcombo : alpha i • (1 : ℝ) + beta i • (K : ℝ) = (m i : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [alpha, beta]
        simp only [mul_one]
        field_simp
        ring
      have hconv := (convexOn_rpow_left (lt_trans zero_lt_one ha)).2
        (Set.mem_univ (1 : ℝ)) (Set.mem_univ (K : ℝ)) halpha hbeta hab
      rw [hcombo] at hconv
      simpa [alpha, beta, Real.rpow_natCast, smul_eq_mul] using hconv
    have hsumM : ∑ i ∈ s, (m i : ℝ) = (K : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (show ∑ i ∈ s, m i = K from rfl)
    have hsumAlpha : ∑ i ∈ s, alpha i =
        ((s.card : ℝ) * K - K) / ((K : ℝ) - 1) := by
      dsimp only [alpha]
      rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hsumM]
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have hsumBeta : ∑ i ∈ s, beta i =
        ((K : ℝ) - s.card) / ((K : ℝ) - 1) := by
      dsimp only [beta]
      rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hsumM]
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      ring
    let lambda : ℝ := ((s.card : ℝ) - 1) / ((K : ℝ) - 1)
    have hlambdaZero : 0 ≤ lambda := by
      have hsnonempty : s.Nonempty := by
        by_contra hs
        have hKzero : K = 0 := by
          simp [K, Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hs]
        exact (by omega)
      exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hsnonempty.card_pos))
        (sub_nonneg.mpr hKone.le)
    have hlambdaOne : lambda ≤ 1 := by
      apply (div_le_one (sub_pos.mpr hKone)).mpr
      exact sub_le_sub_right (by exact_mod_cast hcardK) 1
    have hweighted :
        ((∑ i ∈ s, alpha i) * a +
            (∑ i ∈ s, beta i) * a ^ K) =
          lambda * ((K : ℝ) * a) + (1 - lambda) * a ^ K := by
      rw [hsumAlpha, hsumBeta]
      dsimp [lambda]
      field_simp
      ring
    calc
      ∑ i ∈ s, a ^ m i ≤
          ∑ i ∈ s, (alpha i * a + beta i * a ^ K) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hchord
      _ = (∑ i ∈ s, alpha i) * a +
          (∑ i ∈ s, beta i) * a ^ K := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = lambda * ((K : ℝ) * a) + (1 - lambda) * a ^ K := hweighted
      _ ≤ lambda * max ((K : ℝ) * a) (a ^ K) +
          (1 - lambda) * max ((K : ℝ) * a) (a ^ K) := by
        exact add_le_add
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) hlambdaZero)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right _ _) (sub_nonneg.mpr hlambdaOne))
      _ = max ((K : ℝ) * a) (a ^ K) := by ring

name: TranslationalTilings.IntegralPolynomialPhase.eval_toPolynomial
statement:
theorem IntegralPolynomialPhase.eval_toPolynomial
    (A : IntegralPolynomialPhase d) (n : ℤ) :
  A.toPolynomial.eval n = A.evalNumerator n
proof:
:= by
  simp [IntegralPolynomialPhase.toPolynomial,
    IntegralPolynomialPhase.evalNumerator, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]

name: TranslationalTilings.IntegralPolynomialPhase.eval_toPolynomial_zmod
statement:
theorem IntegralPolynomialPhase.eval_toPolynomial_zmod
    (A : IntegralPolynomialPhase d) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (n : ℤ) :
  letI : NeZero q := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt hq⟩
  Polynomial.eval (n : ZMod q)
      (A.toPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod q))) =
    (A.evalNumerator n : ZMod q)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : NeZero q := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt hq⟩
  simp [IntegralPolynomialPhase.toPolynomial,
    IntegralPolynomialPhase.evalNumerator, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]

name: TranslationalTilings.IntegralPolynomialPhase.natDegree_toPolynomial_le
statement:
theorem IntegralPolynomialPhase.natDegree_toPolynomial_le
    (A : IntegralPolynomialPhase d) :
  A.toPolynomial.natDegree ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  unfold IntegralPolynomialPhase.toPolynomial
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
  intro i _
  exact (Polynomial.natDegree_monomial_le (A.coeff i)).trans
    (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr i.isLt)

name: TranslationalTilings.IntegralPolynomialPhase.primitive_toPolynomial
statement:
theorem IntegralPolynomialPhase.primitive_toPolynomial
    (A : IntegralPolynomialPhase d) (hA : A.Primitive) :
  Nat.Coprime A.modulus
    (Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat A.toPolynomial)
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.Coprime.of_dvd_right _ hA
  rw [Finset.dvd_gcd_iff]
  intro i _
  change Int.natAbs (Polynomial.content (Polynomial.nonconstantPart A.toPolynomial)) ∣
    Int.natAbs (A.coeff i)
  rw [Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs]
  apply Polynomial.content_dvd_coeff (n := (i : ℕ) + 1)
    (p := Polynomial.nonconstantPart A.toPolynomial)
    |>.trans
  have hconstant : A.toPolynomial.coeff 0 = 0 := by
    simp [IntegralPolynomialPhase.toPolynomial]
  have hcoeff : A.toPolynomial.coeff ((i : ℕ) + 1) = A.coeff i := by
    simp only [IntegralPolynomialPhase.toPolynomial, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp
    · intro j _ hji
      have hdegree : (j : ℕ) + 1 ≠ (i : ℕ) + 1 := by
        intro h
        exact hji (Fin.ext (Nat.succ_injective h))
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, if_neg hdegree]
    · simp
  simp [Polynomial.nonconstantPart, hconstant, hcoeff]

name: TranslationalTilings.sum_Icc_cast_eq_sum_zmod
statement:
private theorem sum_Icc_cast_eq_sum_zmod
    (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (g : ZMod q → ℂ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 q, g n = ∑ x : ZMod q, g x
proof:
:= by
  have hfin (i : Fin q) : ZMod.finEquiv q i = (i.val : ZMod q) := by
    cases q with
    | zero => exact Fin.elim0 i
    | succ q =>
        exact (Fin.cast_val_eq_self i).symm
  calc
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 q, g n = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range q, g (n + 1) := by
      rw [← Finset.Ico_add_one_right_eq_Icc, Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range]
      simp [add_comm]
    _ = ∑ i : Fin q, g ((i : ℕ) + 1) := by
      simpa using
        (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun n : ℕ ↦ g (n + 1)) q).symm
    _ = ∑ x : ZMod q, g (x + 1) := by
      apply Fintype.sum_equiv (ZMod.finEquiv q).toEquiv
      intro i
      change g ((i.val : ℕ) + 1) = g (ZMod.finEquiv q i + 1)
      rw [hfin]
    _ = ∑ x : ZMod q, g x := by
      exact Fintype.sum_bijective (fun x : ZMod q ↦ x + 1)
        (AddGroup.addRight_bijective 1) _ _ (fun _ ↦ rfl)

name: TranslationalTilings.integralCompleteSum_eq_polynomialCompleteSum
statement:
theorem integralCompleteSum_eq_polynomialCompleteSum
    (A : IntegralPolynomialPhase d) :
  integralCompleteSum A =
    polynomialCompleteSum A.modulus A.modulus_pos A.toPolynomial
proof:
:= by
  let _ : NeZero A.modulus := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt A.modulus_pos⟩
  let g : ZMod A.modulus → ℂ := fun x ↦
    ZMod.stdAddChar
      (Polynomial.eval x (A.toPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom _)))
  have hphase (n : ℕ) :
      circlePhase
          ((((A.evalNumerator (n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) / A.modulus : ℝ) : Torus) =
        g n := by
    dsimp only [g]
    have hcast : (n : ZMod A.modulus) = ((n : ℤ) : ZMod A.modulus) := by
      norm_num
    rw [hcast]
    rw [A.eval_toPolynomial_zmod A.modulus A.modulus_pos (n : ℤ)]
    rw [ZMod.stdAddChar_coe]
    simp only [circlePhase, fourier_coe_apply]
    push_cast
    congr 1
    field_simp
  calc
    integralCompleteSum A = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A.modulus, g n := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n _
      exact hphase n
    _ = ∑ x : ZMod A.modulus, g x :=
      sum_Icc_cast_eq_sum_zmod A.modulus g
    _ = polynomialCompleteSum A.modulus A.modulus_pos A.toPolynomial := by
      rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.polynomialPrimeSumBound
statement: theorem polynomialPrimeSumBound : PolynomialPrimeSumBound
proof:
:= by
  intro p _ f hpos hsmall
  let _ : NeZero p := ⟨(Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero⟩
  exact polynomial_addChar_sum_prime
    (Fact.out : p.Prime) f hpos hsmall

name: TranslationalTilings.chen_prime_base
statement:
theorem chen_prime_base
    (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (hd : 3 ≤ d) (hdp : d < p)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f) :
  ‖polynomialCompleteSum p hp.pos f‖ ≤
    min (Real.rpow p ((1 : ℝ) / d))
        ((d - 1 : ℝ) *
          Real.rpow p (-(1 : ℝ) / 2 + (1 : ℝ) / d)) *
      Real.rpow p (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d)
proof:
:= by
  exact chen_prime_base_of polynomialPrimeSumBound hp f hdegree hd hdp hprimitive

name: TranslationalTilings.primePower_completeSum_bound
statement:
theorem primePower_completeSum_bound
    (hp : p.Prime) (ha : 0 < a) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f)
    (hdegree : f.natDegree = d) (hd : 3 ≤ d) :
  ‖polynomialCompleteSum (p ^ a) (pow_pos hp.pos a) f‖ ≤
    chenLocalFactor d p *
      Real.rpow (p ^ a : ℝ) (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d)
proof:
:= by
  exact primePower_completeSum_bound_of_primeBound
    polynomialPrimeSumBound hp ha f hprimitive hdegree hd

name: TranslationalTilings.ack_theorem_2_2_finiteProduct
statement:
theorem ack_theorem_2_2_finiteProduct
    (d q : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (hq : 0 < q) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (hprimitive : Nat.Coprime q (Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f)) :
  ‖polynomialCompleteSum q hq f‖ ≤
    chenGlobalFactor d * Real.rpow q (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d)
proof:
:= by
  exact ack_theorem_2_2_finiteProduct_of_primeBound
    polynomialPrimeSumBound d q hd hq f hdegree hprimitive

name: TranslationalTilings.prime_not_dvd_coeff_one_or_coeff_two
statement:
private theorem prime_not_dvd_coeff_one_or_coeff_two
    {p a : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (ha : 0 < a) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hdegree : f.natDegree ≤ 2)
    (hprimitive : Nat.Coprime (p ^ a) (Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f)) :
    ¬ p ∣ Int.natAbs (f.coeff 1) ∨
      ¬ p ∣ Int.natAbs (f.coeff 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hpcoprime : Nat.Coprime p (Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f) :=
    Nat.Coprime.of_dvd_left (dvd_pow_self p ha.ne') hprimitive
  rw [hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd] at hpcoprime
  by_contra hboth
  push Not at hboth
  apply hpcoprime
  rw [Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat, Polynomial.contentNat]
  rw [← show Int.natAbs (p : ℤ) = p by simp, Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs]
  rw [Polynomial.content]
  apply Finset.dvd_gcd
  intro i hi
  rcases hboth with ⟨hone, htwo⟩
  have honeZ : (p : ℤ) ∣ f.coeff 1 := by
    exact Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mp (by simpa using hone)
  have htwoZ : (p : ℤ) ∣ f.coeff 2 := by
    exact Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mp (by simpa using htwo)
  rcases i with _ | _ | _ | i
  · simp [Polynomial.nonconstantPart]
  · rw [Polynomial.nonconstantPart, Polynomial.coeff_sub,
      Polynomial.coeff_C_of_ne_zero (by omega), sub_zero]
    exact honeZ
  · rw [Polynomial.nonconstantPart, Polynomial.coeff_sub,
      Polynomial.coeff_C_of_ne_zero (by omega), sub_zero]
    exact htwoZ
  · have hcoeff : f.coeff (i + 3) = 0 :=
      Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)
    rw [Polynomial.nonconstantPart, Polynomial.coeff_sub, hcoeff,
      Polynomial.coeff_C_of_ne_zero (by omega), sub_zero]
    exact dvd_zero _

name: TranslationalTilings.quadratic_primePower_local_bound
statement:
private theorem quadratic_primePower_local_bound
    {p a : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (ha : 0 < a) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hdegree : f.natDegree ≤ 2)
    (hprimitive : Nat.Coprime (p ^ a) (Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f)) :
    ‖polynomialCompleteSum (p ^ a) (pow_pos hp.pos a) f‖ ≤
      if p = 2 then Real.sqrt (2 * p ^ a) else Real.sqrt (p ^ a)
proof:
:= by
  have hunit := prime_not_dvd_coeff_one_or_coeff_two hp ha f hdegree hprimitive
  by_cases hp2 : p = 2
  · subst p
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    by_cases ha1 : a = 1
    · subst a
      have hprimitiveTwo :
          Nat.Coprime 2 (Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f) := by
        simpa using hprimitive
      simpa using quadratic_mod_two_bound f hdegree hprimitiveTwo
    · have ha2 : 2 ≤ a := by omega
      by_cases hlinearDiv : 2 ∣ Int.natAbs (f.coeff 1)
      · have hquadratic : ¬ 2 ∣ Int.natAbs (f.coeff 2) :=
          hunit.resolve_left (not_not.mpr hlinearDiv)
        have hlinearEven : Even (f.coeff 1) := by
          rw [← Int.natAbs_even, even_iff_two_dvd]
          exact hlinearDiv
        have hquadraticOdd : Odd (f.coeff 2) := by
          rw [← Int.not_even_iff_odd]
          intro heven
          apply hquadratic
          rw [← even_iff_two_dvd, Int.natAbs_even]
          exact heven
        exact (quadratic_twoPower_quadratic_odd_norm ha2 f hdegree
          hlinearEven hquadraticOdd).le
      · have hlinearOdd : Odd (f.coeff 1) := by
          rw [← Int.not_even_iff_odd]
          intro heven
          apply hlinearDiv
          rw [← even_iff_two_dvd, Int.natAbs_even]
          exact heven
        rw [quadratic_twoPower_linear_odd_eq_zero ha2 f hdegree hlinearOdd,
          norm_zero]
        positivity
  · rw [if_neg hp2]
    by_cases hquadraticDiv : p ∣ Int.natAbs (f.coeff 2)
    · have hlinear : ¬ p ∣ Int.natAbs (f.coeff 1) :=
        hunit.resolve_right (not_not.mpr hquadraticDiv)
      rw [quadratic_primePower_linear_unit_eq_zero hp ha f hdegree
        hlinear hquadraticDiv, norm_zero]
      positivity
    · exact (quadratic_oddPrimePower_norm hp hp2 ha f hdegree
        hquadraticDiv).le

name: TranslationalTilings.quadratic_factorization_product_bound
statement:
private theorem quadratic_factorization_product_bound
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    (∏ p : FactorizationPrimeSupport q,
        if p.1 = 2 then
          Real.sqrt (2 * p.1 ^ q.factorization p.1)
        else Real.sqrt (p.1 ^ q.factorization p.1)) ≤
      if Even q then Real.sqrt (2 * q) else Real.sqrt q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (∏ p : FactorizationPrimeSupport q,
        if p.1 = 2 then
          Real.sqrt (2 * p.1 ^ q.factorization p.1)
        else Real.sqrt (p.1 ^ q.factorization p.1)) =
        ∏ p ∈ q.factorization.support,
          if p = 2 then Real.sqrt (2 * p ^ q.factorization p)
          else Real.sqrt (p ^ q.factorization p) := by
      exact factorizationPrimeSupport_prod_eq (fun p ↦
        if p = 2 then Real.sqrt (2 * p ^ q.factorization p)
        else Real.sqrt (p ^ q.factorization p))
    _ ≤ if Even q then Real.sqrt (2 * q) else Real.sqrt q := by
      have hlocal (p : ℕ) :
          (if p = 2 then Real.sqrt (2 * p ^ q.factorization p)
            else Real.sqrt (p ^ q.factorization p)) =
          (if p = 2 then Real.sqrt 2 else 1) *
            Real.rpow (p ^ q.factorization p : ℝ) ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by
        by_cases hp2 : p = 2
        · subst p
          rw [if_pos rfl, if_pos rfl, Real.rpow_eq_pow,
            ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
          exact Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity) _
        · simp only [if_neg hp2, one_mul, Real.rpow_eq_pow,
            ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
      simp_rw [hlocal, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      rw [factorization_rpow_product q hq]
      have htwo : 2 ∈ q.factorization.support ↔ Even q := by
        rw [Nat.support_factorization, Nat.mem_primeFactors, even_iff_two_dvd]
        constructor
        · exact fun h ↦ h.2.1
        · exact fun h ↦ ⟨Nat.prime_two, h, hq.ne'⟩
      have hextra :
          (∏ p ∈ q.factorization.support,
              if p = 2 then Real.sqrt 2 else 1) =
            if Even q then Real.sqrt 2 else 1 := by
        by_cases heven : Even q
        · rw [if_pos heven, Finset.prod_eq_single 2]
          · simp
          · intro p _hp hp2
            simp [hp2]
          · exact fun hnot ↦ (hnot (htwo.mpr heven)).elim
        · rw [if_neg heven]
          apply Finset.prod_eq_one
          intro p hp
          simp only [ite_eq_right_iff]
          intro hp2
          subst p
          exact (heven (htwo.mp hp)).elim
      rw [hextra]
      by_cases heven : Even q
      · rw [if_pos heven, if_pos heven, Real.rpow_eq_pow,
          ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
        exact (Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity) _).symm.le
      · simp only [if_neg heven, one_mul, Real.rpow_eq_pow,
          ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, le_refl]

name: TranslationalTilings.quadratic_polynomialCompleteSum_parity_bound
statement:
theorem quadratic_polynomialCompleteSum_parity_bound
    (hq : 0 < q) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (hdegree : f.natDegree ≤ 2)
    (hprimitive : Nat.Coprime q (Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f)) :
  ‖polynomialCompleteSum q hq f‖ ≤
    if Even q then Real.sqrt (2 * q) else Real.sqrt q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := exists_completeSumFactorizationData q hq f hprimitive
  rw [D.norm_eq_product]
  calc
    (∏ p : FactorizationPrimeSupport q,
        ‖factorizationLocalCompleteSum q f D.scalar p‖) ≤
        ∏ p : FactorizationPrimeSupport q,
          if p.1 = 2 then
            Real.sqrt (2 * p.1 ^ q.factorization p.1)
          else Real.sqrt (p.1 ^ q.factorization p.1) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro p _hp
        positivity
      · intro p _hp
        unfold factorizationLocalCompleteSum
        have ha : 0 < q.factorization p.1 := by
          have := p.property
          rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff] at this
          omega
        apply quadratic_primePower_local_bound
          (factorizationPrimeSupport_prime p) ha
        · rw [Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_eq f (D.scalar_ne_zero p)]
          exact hdegree
        · exact D.local_primitive p
    _ ≤ if Even q then Real.sqrt (2 * q) else Real.sqrt q :=
      quadratic_factorization_product_bound q hq

name: TranslationalTilings.quadratic_polynomialCompleteSum_bound
statement:
theorem quadratic_polynomialCompleteSum_bound
    (hq : 0 < q) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (hdegree : f.natDegree ≤ 2)
    (hprimitive : Nat.Coprime q (Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f)) :
  ‖polynomialCompleteSum q hq f‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖polynomialCompleteSum q hq f‖ ≤
        if Even q then Real.sqrt (2 * q) else Real.sqrt q :=
      quadratic_polynomialCompleteSum_parity_bound hq f hdegree hprimitive
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * q) := by
      split
      · rfl
      · apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
        have hqNonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ q := by positivity
        nlinarith

name: TranslationalTilings.chenLocalFactor_le
statement:
theorem chenLocalFactor_le (d p : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) :
    chenLocalFactor d p ≤ d ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hdR : (3 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hdOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d := by linarith
  have hdNonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d := hdOne.trans' zero_le_one
  unfold chenLocalFactor
  split
  · nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((d : ℝ) - 1)]
  split
  · calc
      Real.rpow d ((2 : ℝ) / d) ≤ Real.rpow d 2 := by
        apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hdOne
        have hdPos : (0 : ℝ) < d := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hdOne
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hdPos]
        nlinarith
      _ = (d : ℝ) ^ 2 := Real.rpow_natCast _ 2
  split
  · calc
      Real.rpow d ((3 : ℝ) / d) ≤ Real.rpow d 2 := by
        apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hdOne
        have hdPos : (0 : ℝ) < d := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hdOne
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hdPos]
        nlinarith
      _ = (d : ℝ) ^ 2 := Real.rpow_natCast _ 2
  · have hrpow : Real.rpow d ((3 : ℝ) / d) ≤ d := by
      calc
        Real.rpow d ((3 : ℝ) / d) ≤ Real.rpow d 1 := by
          apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hdOne
          have hdPos : (0 : ℝ) < d := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hdOne
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hdPos]
          simpa using hdR
        _ = d := by simp
    have hrpowNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.rpow d ((3 : ℝ) / d) :=
      Real.rpow_nonneg hdNonneg _
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hdOne) hrpowNonneg]

name: TranslationalTilings.chenExceptionalPrimes_card_le
statement:
theorem chenExceptionalPrimes_card_le (d : ℕ) :
    (chenExceptionalPrimes d).card ≤ (d + 1) ^ 6
proof:
:= by
  let N := (d + 1) ^ 6
  have hsubset : chenExceptionalPrimes d ⊆ Finset.range (N + 1) := by
    intro p hp
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
  have hne : chenExceptionalPrimes d ≠ Finset.range (N + 1) := by
    intro heq
    have hzero : 0 ∈ chenExceptionalPrimes d := by
      rw [heq]
      simp [N]
    exact Nat.not_prime_zero (Finset.mem_filter.mp hzero).2
  have hlt := Finset.card_lt_card (Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨hsubset, hne⟩)
  simp only [Finset.card_range, N] at hlt
  omega

name: TranslationalTilings.chenGlobalFactor_le_degreePow
statement:
theorem chenGlobalFactor_le_degreePow (d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) :
    chenGlobalFactor d ≤
      ((d : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ ((d + 1) ^ 6)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    chenGlobalFactor d ≤
        ((d : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ (chenExceptionalPrimes d).card := by
      rw [chenGlobalFactor]
      calc
        ∏ p ∈ chenExceptionalPrimes d, chenLocalFactor d p ≤
            ∏ _p ∈ chenExceptionalPrimes d, (d : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          apply Finset.prod_le_prod
          · intro p _hp
            exact zero_le_one.trans (one_le_chenLocalFactor d p hd)
          · intro p _hp
            exact chenLocalFactor_le d p hd
        _ = ((d : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ (chenExceptionalPrimes d).card := by simp
    _ ≤ ((d : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ ((d + 1) ^ 6) := by
      apply pow_le_pow_right₀
      · have hdOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d := by
          exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ d by omega)
        have hs : (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (d : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
          (sq_le_sq₀ zero_le_one (zero_le_one.trans hdOne)).mpr hdOne
        simpa using hs
      · exact chenExceptionalPrimes_card_le d

name: TranslationalTilings.nat_le_two_pow
statement: theorem nat_le_two_pow (d : ℕ) : d ≤ 2 ^ d
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => simp
  | succ d ih =>
      rw [pow_succ]
      have hone : 1 ≤ 2 ^ d := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
      omega

name: TranslationalTilings.chenMajorant_exponent_le
statement:
theorem chenMajorant_exponent_le (d : ℕ) :
    2 * d * (d + 1) ^ 6 ≤ 10 * (d + 1) ^ 8
proof:
:= by
  rw [show 2 * d * (d + 1) ^ 6 = (2 * d) * (d + 1) ^ 6 by ring]
  rw [show 10 * (d + 1) ^ 8 = (10 * (d + 1) ^ 2) * (d + 1) ^ 6 by ring]
  apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
  nlinarith

name: TranslationalTilings.chenDegreePow_le_natConstant
statement:
theorem chenDegreePow_le_natConstant (d : ℕ) :
    (d ^ 2) ^ ((d + 1) ^ 6) ≤ stechkinNatConstant d
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (d ^ 2) ^ ((d + 1) ^ 6) ≤
        ((2 ^ d) ^ 2) ^ ((d + 1) ^ 6) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (nat_le_two_pow d) 2) _
    _ = 2 ^ (2 * d * (d + 1) ^ 6) := by ring
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (10 * (d + 1) ^ 8) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (chenMajorant_exponent_le d)
    _ = stechkinNatConstant d := rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.chenDegreePow_cast
statement:
theorem chenDegreePow_cast (d : ℕ) :
    ((((d ^ 2) ^ ((d + 1) ^ 6) : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
      ((d : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ ((d + 1) ^ 6)
proof:
:= by
  norm_cast

name: TranslationalTilings.chenGlobalFactor_le_stechkinNatConstant
statement:
theorem chenGlobalFactor_le_stechkinNatConstant
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) :
    chenGlobalFactor d ≤ stechkinNatConstant d
proof:
:= by
  calc
    chenGlobalFactor d ≤ ((d : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ ((d + 1) ^ 6) :=
      chenGlobalFactor_le_degreePow d hd
    _ = (((d ^ 2) ^ ((d + 1) ^ 6) : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
      (chenDegreePow_cast d).symm
    _ ≤ (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast chenDegreePow_le_natConstant d

name: TranslationalTilings.stechkinNatConstant_mono
statement:
theorem stechkinNatConstant_mono {e d : ℕ} (hed : e ≤ d) :
    stechkinNatConstant e ≤ stechkinNatConstant d
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega)
  apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
  exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.add_le_add_right hed 1) 8

name: TranslationalTilings.two_le_stechkinNatConstant
statement:
private theorem two_le_stechkinNatConstant (d : ℕ) :
    2 ≤ stechkinNatConstant d
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.le_pow
  positivity

name: TranslationalTilings.two_le_stechkinNatConstant_real
statement:
private theorem two_le_stechkinNatConstant_real (d : ℕ) :
    (2 : ℝ) ≤ stechkinNatConstant d
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast two_le_stechkinNatConstant d

name: TranslationalTilings.stechkinNatConstant_cast_mono
statement:
private theorem stechkinNatConstant_cast_mono {e d : ℕ} (hed : e ≤ d) :
    (stechkinNatConstant e : ℝ) ≤ stechkinNatConstant d
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast stechkinNatConstant_mono hed

name: TranslationalTilings.polynomialCompleteSum_effective_core
statement:
private theorem polynomialCompleteSum_effective_core
    (hWeil : PolynomialPrimeSumBound)
    (d q : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hq : 0 < q) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hdegree : f.natDegree ≤ d)
    (hprimitive : Nat.Coprime q (Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f)) :
  ‖polynomialCompleteSum q hq f‖ ≤
    (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) *
      Real.rpow q (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d)
proof:
:= by
  have hqOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hq.ne')
  have hdOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d := by
    exact_mod_cast hd
  have hexponentNonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - (1 : ℝ) / d := by
    have hinv : (1 : ℝ) / d ≤ 1 / 1 :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) hdOne
    norm_num at hinv ⊢
    linarith
  have hRpowOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.rpow q (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_eq_pow]
    exact Real.one_le_rpow hqOne hexponentNonneg
  have hConstantOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ stechkinNatConstant d := by
    exact (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2).trans
      (two_le_stechkinNatConstant_real d)
  have hRhsOne :
      (1 : ℝ) ≤ (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) *
        Real.rpow q (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d) := by
    calc
      (1 : ℝ) = 1 * 1 := (mul_one 1).symm
      _ ≤ (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) *
          Real.rpow q (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d) :=
        mul_le_mul hConstantOne hRpowOne zero_le_one
          (zero_le_one.trans hConstantOne)
  by_cases hlinear : f.natDegree ≤ 1
  · exact (linear_polynomialCompleteSum_bound hq f hlinear hprimitive).trans
      hRhsOne
  by_cases hquadratic : f.natDegree ≤ 2
  · have hdTwo : 2 ≤ d :=
      (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hlinear)).trans hdegree
    have hdTwoReal : (2 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hdTwo
    have hinv : (1 : ℝ) / d ≤ 1 / 2 :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) hdTwoReal
    have hexponentHalf : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ 1 - (1 : ℝ) / d := by
      linarith
    have hsqrtQ :
        Real.sqrt q ≤ Real.rpow q (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.rpow_eq_pow]
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hqOne hexponentHalf
    have hsqrtTwo : Real.sqrt 2 ≤ (2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
    have hConstantTwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ stechkinNatConstant d := by
      exact two_le_stechkinNatConstant_real d
    calc
      ‖polynomialCompleteSum q hq f‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * q) :=
        quadratic_polynomialCompleteSum_bound hq f hquadratic hprimitive
      _ = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt q := Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num) _
      _ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt q :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsqrtTwo (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) * Real.sqrt q :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hConstantTwo (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) *
          Real.rpow q (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrtQ
          (zero_le_one.trans hConstantOne)
  · have hdegreeThree : 3 ≤ f.natDegree :=
      Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hquadratic)
    have hAck := ack_theorem_2_2_finiteProduct_of_primeBound hWeil
      f.natDegree q hdegreeThree hq f rfl hprimitive
    have hFactor :
        chenGlobalFactor f.natDegree ≤ (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) := by
      calc
        chenGlobalFactor f.natDegree ≤ stechkinNatConstant f.natDegree :=
          chenGlobalFactor_le_stechkinNatConstant f.natDegree hdegreeThree
        _ ≤ (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) := by
          exact stechkinNatConstant_cast_mono hdegree
    have hdegreePos : (0 : ℝ) < f.natDegree := by
      exact_mod_cast (show 0 < f.natDegree from
        hdegreeThree.trans' (by norm_num))
    have hdegreeReal : (f.natDegree : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hdegree
    have hinv : (1 : ℝ) / d ≤ 1 / f.natDegree :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le hdegreePos hdegreeReal
    have hexponent :
        (1 : ℝ) - 1 / f.natDegree ≤ 1 - 1 / d := by
      linarith
    have hRpow :
        Real.rpow q (1 - (1 : ℝ) / f.natDegree) ≤
          Real.rpow q (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_eq_pow, Real.rpow_eq_pow]
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hqOne hexponent
    have hLeftRpowNonneg :
        (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.rpow q (1 - (1 : ℝ) / f.natDegree) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_eq_pow]
      exact Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
    exact hAck.trans (mul_le_mul hFactor hRpow hLeftRpowNonneg
      (zero_le_one.trans hConstantOne))

name: TranslationalTilings.polynomialCompleteSum_effective
statement:
theorem polynomialCompleteSum_effective
    (d q : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hq : 0 < q) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hdegree : f.natDegree ≤ d)
    (hprimitive : Nat.Coprime q (Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f)) :
  ‖polynomialCompleteSum q hq f‖ ≤
    (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) *
      Real.rpow q (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d)
proof:
:= by
  exact polynomialCompleteSum_effective_core polynomialPrimeSumBound
    d q hd hq f hdegree hprimitive

name: TranslationalTilings.polynomialCompleteSum_effective_of_primeBound
statement:
theorem polynomialCompleteSum_effective_of_primeBound

name: TranslationalTilings.integral_complete_exponential_sum_effective
statement:
theorem integral_complete_exponential_sum_effective
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (A : IntegralPolynomialPhase d)
    (hprimitive : A.Primitive) :
  ‖integralCompleteSum A‖ ≤
    (stechkinNatConstant d : ℝ) *
      Real.rpow A.modulus (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d)
proof:
:= by

  exact polynomialCompleteSum_effective d A.modulus hd A.modulus_pos
    A.toPolynomial A.natDegree_toPolynomial_le

name: TranslationalTilings.ack_completeSum_eq_sum_residueClasses
statement:
theorem ack_completeSum_eq_sum_residueClasses
    [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p.Prime) (_ha : 0 < a)
    (f : Polynomial ℤ) :
  polynomialCompleteSum (p ^ a) (pow_pos hp.pos a) f =
    ∑ v : ZMod p, primePowerResidueClassSum p a hp f v
proof:
:= by
  let _ : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  let _ : NeZero (p ^ a) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ hp.ne_zero⟩
  simp only [polynomialCompleteSum, primePowerResidueClassSum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _hx
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ((x.val : ℕ) : ZMod p)]
  · simp
  · intro b _hb hne
    simp only [ite_eq_right_iff]
    intro h
    exfalso
    apply hne
    rw [← h]
  · simp

name: TranslationalTilings.residueClassFiber_card
statement:
private theorem residueClassFiber_card
    (hp : p.Prime) (ha : 0 < a) (v : ZMod p) :
    letI : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
    letI : NeZero (p ^ a) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ hp.ne_zero⟩
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (p ^ a))).filter
      (fun x => (x.val : ZMod p) = v)).card = p ^ (a - 1)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  let _ : NeZero (p ^ a) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ hp.ne_zero⟩
  have hpdiv : p ∣ p ^ a := dvd_pow_self p ha.ne'
  let phi : ZMod (p ^ a) →+ ZMod p :=
    (ZMod.castHom hpdiv (ZMod p)).toAddMonoidHom
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective phi := ZMod.castHom_surjective hpdiv
  have heq (w : ZMod p) :
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (p ^ a))).filter
        (fun x => phi x = w)).card =
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (p ^ a))).filter
        (fun x => phi x = v)).card := by
    exact AddMonoidHom.card_fiber_eq_of_mem_range phi
      (hsurj w) (hsurj v)
  have hpartition := Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (p ^ a))))
    (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod p))) (f := phi) (by simp)
  have hcard : p ^ a = p *
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (p ^ a))).filter
        (fun x => phi x = v)).card := by
    have hpartition' : p ^ a = ∑ w : ZMod p,
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (p ^ a))).filter
          (fun x => phi x = w)).card := by
      simpa only [Finset.card_univ, ZMod.card] using hpartition
    calc
      p ^ a = ∑ w : ZMod p,
          ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (p ^ a))).filter
            (fun x => phi x = w)).card := hpartition'
      _ = p * ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (p ^ a))).filter
            (fun x => phi x = v)).card := by
        simp_rw [heq]
        simp
  have hpow : p ^ a = p * p ^ (a - 1) := by
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero ha.ne'
    simp [pow_succ']
  have hc : ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (p ^ a))).filter
        (fun x => phi x = v)).card = p ^ (a - 1) := by
    apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hp.pos
    rw [← hcard, ← hpow]
  calc
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (p ^ a))).filter
        (fun x => (x.val : ZMod p) = v)).card =
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (p ^ a))).filter
          (fun x => phi x = v)).card := by
      congr 1
      ext x
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      simp [phi]
    _ = p ^ (a - 1) := hc

name: TranslationalTilings.ack_residueClass_trivial
statement:
theorem ack_residueClass_trivial
    (hp : p.Prime) (ha : 0 < a) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (v : ZMod p) :
  ‖primePowerResidueClassSum p a hp f v‖ ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (a - 1)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  let _ : NeZero (p ^ a) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ hp.ne_zero⟩
  rw [primePowerResidueClassSum]
  calc
    ‖∑ x : ZMod (p ^ a),
        if (x.val : ZMod p) = v then
          ZMod.stdAddChar (Polynomial.eval x (f.map (Int.castRingHom _)))
        else 0‖ ≤
        ∑ x : ZMod (p ^ a),
          ‖if (x.val : ZMod p) = v then
            ZMod.stdAddChar (Polynomial.eval x (f.map (Int.castRingHom _)))
          else 0‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = (((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (p ^ a))).filter
          (fun x => (x.val : ZMod p) = v)).card : ℝ) := by
      calc
        ∑ x : ZMod (p ^ a),
            ‖if (x.val : ZMod p) = v then
              ZMod.stdAddChar (Polynomial.eval x (f.map (Int.castRingHom _)))
            else 0‖ =
            ∑ x : ZMod (p ^ a),
              if (x.val : ZMod p) = v then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro x _hx
          split <;> simp_all [ZMod.stdAddChar_apply, Circle.norm_coe]
        _ = _ := by simp
    _ = (p : ℝ) ^ (a - 1) := by
      rw [residueClassFiber_card hp ha v]
      norm_num

name: TranslationalTilings.modPrime_nonconstantPart_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem modPrime_nonconstantPart_ne_zero
    (_hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f) :
    Polynomial.modPrime p (Polynomial.nonconstantPart f) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  apply hprimitive
  rw [Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat, Polynomial.contentNat,
    ← Int.natCast_dvd]
  apply Polynomial.dvd_content_iff_C_dvd.mpr
  apply (Polynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff (p : ℤ) _).mpr
  intro n
  rw [← ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  have hn := congrArg (fun q : Polynomial (ZMod p) => q.coeff n) hzero
  simpa [Polynomial.modPrime] using hn

name: TranslationalTilings.modPrime_natDegree_pos
statement:
private theorem modPrime_natDegree_pos
    (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f) :
    0 < (Polynomial.modPrime p f).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have hbar := modPrime_nonconstantPart_ne_zero hp f hprimitive
  by_contra h
  have hdeg : (Polynomial.modPrime p f).natDegree ≤ 0 := by omega
  have hbarEq : Polynomial.modPrime p (Polynomial.nonconstantPart f) =
      Polynomial.modPrime p f -
        Polynomial.C ((f.coeff 0 : ℤ) : ZMod p) := by
    simp [Polynomial.modPrime, Polynomial.nonconstantPart]
  rw [hbarEq, Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_le_zero hdeg] at hbar
  simp [Polynomial.modPrime] at hbar

name: TranslationalTilings.completeSum_trivial
statement:
private theorem completeSum_trivial
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (f : Polynomial ℤ) :
    ‖polynomialCompleteSum q hq f‖ ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  let _ : NeZero q := ⟨hq.ne'⟩
  rw [polynomialCompleteSum]
  calc
    ‖∑ x : ZMod q,
        ZMod.stdAddChar (Polynomial.eval x
          (f.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod q))))‖ ≤
        ∑ x : ZMod q,
          ‖ZMod.stdAddChar (Polynomial.eval x
            (f.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod q))))‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ _x : ZMod q, (1 : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x _hx
      simp [ZMod.stdAddChar_apply, Circle.norm_coe]
    _ = q := by simp

name: TranslationalTilings.chen_prime_base_of
statement:
theorem chen_prime_base_of
    (hWeil : PolynomialPrimeSumBound)
    (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (_hd : 3 ≤ d) (hdp : d < p)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f) :
  ‖polynomialCompleteSum p hp.pos f‖ ≤
    min (Real.rpow p ((1 : ℝ) / d))
        ((d - 1 : ℝ) *
          Real.rpow p (-(1 : ℝ) / 2 + (1 : ℝ) / d)) *
      Real.rpow p (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  let fbar := Polynomial.modPrime p f
  have hepos : 0 < fbar.natDegree :=
    modPrime_natDegree_pos hp f hprimitive
  have he_le : fbar.natDegree ≤ d := by
    exact Polynomial.natDegree_map_le.trans_eq hdegree
  have hep : fbar.natDegree < p := lt_of_le_of_lt he_le hdp
  have hweil := hWeil p fbar hepos hep
  have hsum : polynomialCompleteSum p hp.pos f =
      ∑ x : ZMod p, ZMod.stdAddChar (fbar.eval x) := by
    rfl
  have hweil' : ‖polynomialCompleteSum p hp.pos f‖ ≤
      (d - 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt p := by
    rw [hsum]
    calc
      ‖∑ x : ZMod p, ZMod.stdAddChar (fbar.eval x)‖ ≤
          (fbar.natDegree - 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt p := hweil
      _ ≤ (d - 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt p := by
        gcongr
  have htriv := completeSum_trivial p hp.pos f
  have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
  have hscale : 0 ≤ Real.rpow p (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d) :=
    Real.rpow_nonneg hpR.le _
  have hfirst : Real.rpow p ((1 : ℝ) / d) *
      Real.rpow p (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d) = p := by
    calc
      Real.rpow p ((1 : ℝ) / d) *
          Real.rpow p (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d) =
          Real.rpow p ((1 : ℝ) / d + (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d)) :=
        (Real.rpow_add hpR _ _).symm
      _ = p := by
        rw [show (1 : ℝ) / d + (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d) = 1 by ring]
        exact Real.rpow_one p
  have hsecond : ((d - 1 : ℝ) *
        Real.rpow p (-(1 : ℝ) / 2 + (1 : ℝ) / d)) *
      Real.rpow p (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d) =
      (d - 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt p := by
    rw [mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    calc
      Real.rpow p (-(1 : ℝ) / 2 + (1 : ℝ) / d) *
          Real.rpow p (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d) =
          Real.rpow p
            ((-(1 : ℝ) / 2 + (1 : ℝ) / d) +
              (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d)) := (Real.rpow_add hpR _ _).symm
      _ = Real.sqrt p := by
        rw [show (-(1 : ℝ) / 2 + (1 : ℝ) / d) +
            (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d) = 1 / 2 by ring]
        exact (Real.sqrt_eq_rpow p).symm
  rw [min_mul_of_nonneg _ _ hscale, hfirst, hsecond]
  exact le_min (by exact_mod_cast htriv) hweil'

name: Polynomial.stationaryOrder_two_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.stationaryOrder_two_le
    (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (_hdp : d < p)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f)
    (mu : ZMod p) (hmu : (Polynomial.modPrime p f.derivative).IsRoot mu) :
  2 ≤ Polynomial.stationaryOrder f p mu.val
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < d := by
    have horder :=
      Polynomial.ack_lemma_2_3 hp f hdegree.le hprimitive mu.val
    omega
  have hchild := Polynomial.stationaryChildInvariant hp f hdegree
    hd hprimitive mu.val
  exact Polynomial.stationaryOrder_two_le_of_isRoot hp f mu
    hchild.translate_ne_zero hmu

name: TranslationalTilings.chen_contentNat_dvd_coeff
statement:
private theorem chen_contentNat_dvd_coeff (F : Polynomial ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    (Polynomial.contentNat F : ℤ) ∣ F.coeff n
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Polynomial.contentNat, Int.natCast_natAbs, Int.abs_eq_normalize,
    Polynomial.normalize_content] using Polynomial.content_dvd_coeff (p := F) n

name: TranslationalTilings.chen_primePowOrder_dvd_coeff
statement:
private theorem chen_primePowOrder_dvd_coeff
    (hp : p.Prime) (F : Polynomial ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((p ^ Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p F : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ F.coeff n
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  apply dvd_trans (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr ?_) (chen_contentNat_dvd_coeff F n)
  exact (padicValNat_dvd_iff (Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p F)
    (Polynomial.contentNat F)).2 (Or.inr le_rfl)

name: TranslationalTilings.chen_stationaryTranslate_coeff_of_pos
statement:
private theorem chen_stationaryTranslate_coeff_of_pos
    (f : Polynomial ℤ) (p n : ℕ) (mu : ℤ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (Polynomial.stationaryTranslate f p mu).coeff n =
      (Polynomial.taylor mu f).coeff n * (p : ℤ) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.stationaryTranslate, Polynomial.coeff_sub,
    Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate]
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_C]
  simp only [hn.ne', ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
  rw [show f.comp (Polynomial.C (p : ℤ) * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C mu) =
      (Polynomial.taylor mu f).comp (Polynomial.C (p : ℤ) * Polynomial.X) by
    simp only [Polynomial.taylor_apply, Polynomial.comp_assoc,
      Polynomial.add_comp, Polynomial.X_comp, Polynomial.C_comp]]
  exact Polynomial.comp_C_mul_X_coeff

name: TranslationalTilings.chen_taylor_derivative
statement:
private theorem chen_taylor_derivative
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) :
    Polynomial.taylor r f.derivative = (Polynomial.taylor r f).derivative
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Polynomial.taylor_apply, Polynomial.derivative_comp]
  simp

name: TranslationalTilings.chen_derivative_modPrime_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem chen_derivative_modPrime_ne_zero
    [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hdegree : f.natDegree = d) (hdp : d < p)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f) :
    Polynomial.modPrime p f.derivative ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let fbar := Polynomial.modPrime p f
  let e := fbar.natDegree
  have hepos : 0 < e := modPrime_natDegree_pos hp f hprimitive
  have he_le : e ≤ d := by
    exact Polynomial.natDegree_map_le.trans_eq hdegree
  have hep : e < p := lt_of_le_of_lt he_le hdp
  have hecast : (e : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff] at he
    exact (Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt hepos hep) he
  have hfbar : fbar ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    dsimp [e] at hepos
    rw [hzero] at hepos
    simp at hepos
  have hlead : fbar.coeff e ≠ 0 := by
    rw [show e = fbar.natDegree from rfl, Polynomial.coeff_natDegree]
    exact Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hfbar
  intro hz
  have hz' : fbar.derivative = 0 := by
    simpa [fbar, Polynomial.modPrime] using hz
  have hcoeff := congrArg (fun F : Polynomial (ZMod p) ↦ F.coeff (e - 1)) hz'
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_derivative, Polynomial.coeff_zero,
    show e - 1 + 1 = e by omega] at hcoeff
  have hcast : ((e - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) + 1 = (e : ZMod p) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ e)]
    ring
  rw [hcast] at hcoeff
  exact (mul_ne_zero hlead hecast) hcoeff

name: TranslationalTilings.chen_contentOrder_le_of_coeff_factor
statement:
private theorem chen_contentOrder_le_of_coeff_factor
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (F : Polynomial ℤ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℤ)
    (hcoeff : F.coeff n = t * (p : ℤ) ^ n)
    (ht : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ t) :
    Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p F ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  let u := Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p F
  by_contra hle
  have hnu : n + 1 ≤ u := Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hle)
  have horder : (((p ^ u : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∣ F.coeff n :=
    chen_primePowOrder_dvd_coeff hp F n
  have hpow : (((p ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∣ ((p ^ u : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
    Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr (pow_dvd_pow p hnu)
  have hdiv := dvd_trans hpow horder
  rw [hcoeff] at hdiv
  have hcancel : ((p : ℤ) ^ n) * (p : ℤ) ∣ ((p : ℤ) ^ n) * t := by
    simpa [Nat.cast_pow, pow_succ, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hdiv
  exact ht ((mul_dvd_mul_iff_left
    (pow_ne_zero n (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero))).mp hcancel)

name: Polynomial.stationaryOrder_le_rootMultiplicity_succ
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.stationaryOrder_le_rootMultiplicity_succ
    [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hdegree : f.natDegree = d) (hdp : d < p)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f)
    (mu : ZMod p) (_hmu : (Polynomial.modPrime p f.derivative).IsRoot mu) :
  Polynomial.stationaryOrder f p mu.val ≤
    (Polynomial.modPrime p f.derivative).rootMultiplicity mu + 1
proof:
:= by
  let gbar := Polynomial.modPrime p f.derivative
  let m := gbar.rootMultiplicity mu
  have hgbar : gbar ≠ 0 := chen_derivative_modPrime_ne_zero hp f hdegree hdp hprimitive
  have htaylorDeriv : (Polynomial.taylor mu gbar).coeff m ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [m]
    rw [Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree]
    exact Polynomial.coeff_natTrailingDegree_ne_zero.mpr
      ((Polynomial.taylor_eq_zero mu gbar).not.mpr hgbar)
  have htaylorSucc :
      (Polynomial.taylor mu (Polynomial.modPrime p f)).coeff (m + 1) ≠ 0 := by
    have hrelation := congrArg (fun F : Polynomial (ZMod p) ↦ F.coeff m)
      (chen_taylor_derivative mu (Polynomial.modPrime p f))
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_derivative] at hrelation
    have hderivMap : (Polynomial.modPrime p f).derivative = gbar := by
      simp [gbar, Polynomial.modPrime]
    rw [hderivMap] at hrelation
    intro hzero
    apply htaylorDeriv
    rw [hrelation, hzero, zero_mul]
  have htaylorInt :
      ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ (Polynomial.taylor (mu.val : ℤ) f).coeff (m + 1) := by
    rw [← ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
    change ((Int.castRingHom (ZMod p))
      ((Polynomial.taylor (mu.val : ℤ) f).coeff (m + 1))) ≠ 0
    rw [← Polynomial.coeff_map]
    have hmap := Polynomial.map_taylor f (mu.val : ℤ) (Int.castRingHom (ZMod p))
    rw [hmap]
    simpa [Polynomial.modPrime, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using htaylorSucc
  change Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p
      (Polynomial.stationaryTranslate f p mu.val) ≤ m + 1
  exact chen_contentOrder_le_of_coeff_factor hp _ (m + 1) _
    (chen_stationaryTranslate_coeff_of_pos f p (m + 1) mu.val (by omega))
    htaylorInt

name: Polynomial.derivativeRootMass_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.derivativeRootMass_le
    [Fact p.Prime] (_hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hdegree : f.natDegree = d) (_hdp : d < p)
    (_hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f) :
  Polynomial.derivativeRootMass f p ≤ d - 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Polynomial.derivativeRootMass f p ≤
        (Polynomial.modPrime p f.derivative).natDegree :=
      rootMassModPrime_le_natDegree p _
    _ = (Polynomial.modPrime p f).derivative.natDegree := by
      simp [Polynomial.modPrime, ← Polynomial.derivative_map]
    _ ≤ (Polynomial.modPrime p f).natDegree - 1 :=
      Polynomial.natDegree_derivative_le _
    _ ≤ f.natDegree - 1 :=
      Nat.sub_le_sub_right Polynomial.natDegree_map_le 1
    _ = d - 1 := by rw [hdegree]

name: TranslationalTilings.chen_contentNat_C_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.contentNat, Polynomial.contentNat, Polynomial.content_C_mul,
    Int.natAbs_mul, ← Int.abs_eq_normalize, Int.natAbs_abs]

name: TranslationalTilings.chen_contentNat_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem chen_contentNat_ne_zero (F : Polynomial ℤ) (hF : F ≠ 0) :
    Polynomial.contentNat F ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.contentNat, Int.natAbs_ne_zero]
  exact fun h ↦ hF (Polynomial.content_eq_zero_iff.mp h)

name: TranslationalTilings.chen_stationaryNormalize_derivative_eq
statement:
private theorem chen_stationaryNormalize_derivative_eq
    [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hdegree : f.natDegree = d) (hdp : d < p)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f)
    (mu : ZMod p) (hmu : (Polynomial.modPrime p f.derivative).IsRoot mu) :
    (Polynomial.stationaryNormalize f p mu.val).derivative =
      Polynomial.normalizedPrimeScaleTranslate f.derivative p mu.val
proof:
:= by
  let A := Polynomial.stationaryTranslate f p mu.val
  let B := Polynomial.stationaryNormalize f p mu.val
  let P := Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate f.derivative p mu.val
  let u := Polynomial.stationaryOrder f p mu.val
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by
    have hbarpos := modPrime_natDegree_pos hp f hprimitive
    have hbarle : (Polynomial.modPrime p f).natDegree ≤ d :=
      Polynomial.natDegree_map_le.trans_eq hdegree
    omega
  have hchild := Polynomial.stationaryChildInvariant hp f hdegree hdpos
    hprimitive mu.val
  have hAne : A ≠ 0 := hchild.translate_ne_zero
  have hBdegree : B.natDegree = d := hchild.natDegree_eq
  have hBprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat B := hchild.primitive
  have hu2 : 2 ≤ u := Polynomial.stationaryOrder_two_le hp f hdegree hdp
    hprimitive mu hmu
  have hBderivMod : Polynomial.modPrime p B.derivative ≠ 0 :=
    chen_derivative_modPrime_ne_zero hp B hBdegree hdp hBprimitive
  have hBderiv : B.derivative ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hBderivMod
    simp [hzero, Polynomial.modPrime]
  have hBcontentPrimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.contentNat B.derivative := by
    intro hdiv
    apply hBderivMod
    ext n
    rw [Polynomial.modPrime, Polynomial.coeff_map, Polynomial.coeff_zero]
    change (((B.derivative.coeff n : ℤ) : ZMod p)) = 0
    rw [ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
    exact dvd_trans (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr hdiv)
      (chen_contentNat_dvd_coeff B.derivative n)
  have hAderiv : A.derivative = Polynomial.C (p : ℤ) * P := by
    dsimp [A, P]
    simp only [Polynomial.stationaryTranslate, map_sub, Polynomial.derivative_C,
      sub_zero, Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate, Polynomial.derivative_comp,
      Polynomial.derivative_add, Polynomial.derivative_C_mul_X,
      Polynomial.derivative_C, add_zero]
  have hspecA := Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime_spec hp A hAne
  have hspecAB : A = Polynomial.C ((p : ℤ) ^ u) * B := by
    simpa [A, B, u, Polynomial.stationaryNormalize,
      Polynomial.stationaryOrder, Nat.cast_pow] using hspecA
  have hspecDeriv := congrArg Polynomial.derivative hspecAB
  simp only [Polynomial.derivative_mul, Polynomial.derivative_C, zero_mul,
    zero_add] at hspecDeriv
  have hPB : P = Polynomial.C ((p : ℤ) ^ (u - 1)) * B.derivative := by
    apply Polynomial.ext
    intro n
    have hnA := congrArg (fun F : Polynomial ℤ ↦ F.coeff n) hAderiv
    have hnSpec := congrArg (fun F : Polynomial ℤ ↦ F.coeff n) hspecDeriv
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul] at hnA hnSpec
    have heq : (p : ℤ) ^ u * B.derivative.coeff n =
        (p : ℤ) * P.coeff n := by
      rw [← hnA, ← hnSpec]
    have hu : u - 1 + 1 = u := by omega
    rw [← hu, pow_succ] at heq
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul]
    apply (Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff
      (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero : (p : ℤ) ≠ 0)).mp
    simpa [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using heq.symm
  have hPne : P ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hPB]
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero _ (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero)))
      hBderiv
  have hPorder : Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p P = u - 1 := by
    rw [hPB, Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder, chen_contentNat_C_mul]
    simp only [Int.natAbs_pow, Int.natAbs_natCast]
    rw [padicValNat.mul (pow_ne_zero _ hp.ne_zero)
      (chen_contentNat_ne_zero B.derivative hBderiv),
      padicValNat.prime_pow,
      padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd hBcontentPrimitive, Nat.add_zero]
  have hspecP := Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime_spec hp P hPne
  change B.derivative = Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime p P
  apply Polynomial.ext
  intro n
  have hnPB := congrArg (fun F : Polynomial ℤ ↦ F.coeff n) hPB
  have hnP := congrArg (fun F : Polynomial ℤ ↦ F.coeff n) hspecP
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul] at hnPB hnP
  rw [hPorder] at hnP
  simp only [Nat.cast_pow] at hnP
  have hpowne : (p : ℤ) ^ (u - 1) ≠ 0 :=
    pow_ne_zero _ (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero)
  apply (Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff hpowne).mp
  rw [← hnPB, ← hnP]

name: Polynomial.stationaryNormalize_derivativeRootMass_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.stationaryNormalize_derivativeRootMass_le
    [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hdegree : f.natDegree = d) (hdp : d < p)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f)
    (mu : ZMod p) (hmu : (Polynomial.modPrime p f.derivative).IsRoot mu) :
  Polynomial.derivativeRootMass
      (Polynomial.stationaryNormalize f p mu.val) p ≤
    (Polynomial.modPrime p f.derivative).rootMultiplicity mu
proof:
:= by
  have hg : Polynomial.modPrime p f.derivative ≠ 0 :=
    chen_derivative_modPrime_ne_zero hp f hdegree hdp hprimitive
  change Polynomial.rootMassModPrime p
      (Polynomial.stationaryNormalize f p mu.val).derivative ≤ _
  rw [chen_stationaryNormalize_derivative_eq hp f hdegree hdp hprimitive mu hmu]
  exact Polynomial.ack_lemma_2_2_rootMass hp f.derivative hg mu hmu

name: TranslationalTilings.ack_ineq_2_9
statement:
theorem ack_ineq_2_9
    (d m p : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmd : m ≤ d - 1)
    (hp : d < p) (hpB : (p : ℝ) ≤ chenMiddlePrimeThreshold d) :
  Real.rpow p ((m : ℝ) / d) ≤
    (m : ℝ) * Real.rpow p ((1 : ℝ) / d)
proof:
:= by
  have hdR : (3 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hmR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hmdCast : (m : ℝ) ≤ ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hmd
  have hmdR : (m : ℝ) ≤ d - 1 := by
    simpa [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ d)] using hmdCast
  have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by
    exact_mod_cast (lt_trans (by omega : 0 < d) hp)
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < d - 2 := by linarith
  let theta : ℝ := ((m : ℝ) - 1) / (d - 2)
  have htheta0 : 0 ≤ theta :=
    div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hmR) hden.le
  have htheta1 : theta ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [theta]
    rw [div_le_one hden]
    linarith
  have hbern : Real.rpow (d - 1 : ℝ) theta ≤ m := by
    have hb := rpow_one_add_le_one_add_mul_self
      (s := (d : ℝ) - 2) (p := theta) (by linarith) htheta0 htheta1
    rw [show (1 : ℝ) + (d - 2) = d - 1 by ring,
      show (1 : ℝ) + theta * (d - 2) = m by
        dsimp [theta]
        field_simp
        ring] at hb
    exact hb
  let t : ℝ := ((m : ℝ) - 1) / d
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t :=
    div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hmR) (by positivity)
  have hpt : Real.rpow p t ≤ Real.rpow (chenMiddlePrimeThreshold d) t :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow hpR.le hpB ht0
  have hthreshold : Real.rpow (chenMiddlePrimeThreshold d) t =
      Real.rpow (d - 1 : ℝ) theta := by
    rw [chenMiddlePrimeThreshold]
    calc
      Real.rpow (Real.rpow (d - 1 : ℝ) ((d : ℝ) / (d - 2))) t =
          Real.rpow (d - 1 : ℝ) (((d : ℝ) / (d - 2)) * t) :=
        (Real.rpow_mul (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d - 1) _ _).symm
      _ = Real.rpow (d - 1 : ℝ) theta := by
        congr 1
        dsimp [theta, t]
        field_simp
  have hsmall : Real.rpow p t ≤ m := by
    rw [hthreshold] at hpt
    exact hpt.trans hbern
  have hsplit : (m : ℝ) / d = (1 : ℝ) / d + t := by
    dsimp [t]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hsplit]
  calc
    Real.rpow p ((1 : ℝ) / d + t) =
        Real.rpow p ((1 : ℝ) / d) * Real.rpow p t :=
      Real.rpow_add hpR _ _
    _ ≤ Real.rpow p ((1 : ℝ) / d) * m :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsmall (Real.rpow_nonneg hpR.le _)
    _ = m * Real.rpow p ((1 : ℝ) / d) := mul_comm _ _

name: TranslationalTilings.ack_ineq_2_11
statement:
theorem ack_ineq_2_11
    (d L r₁ M₁ : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (hr : 0 < r₁)
    (hL : r₁ * L ≤ M₁ + r₁) :
  (L : ℝ) ≤
    (L + 1 : ℝ) * (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d) - 1 + (2 : ℝ) / d +
      (M₁ : ℝ) / ((r₁ : ℝ) * d)
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show d ≠ 0 by omega)
  have hr0 : (r₁ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hr.ne'
  have hLR : (r₁ : ℝ) * L ≤ M₁ + r₁ := by exact_mod_cast hL
  have hnum : (0 : ℝ) ≤ M₁ + r₁ - r₁ * L := by linarith
  rw [show (L + 1 : ℝ) * (1 - (1 : ℝ) / d) - 1 + (2 : ℝ) / d +
      (M₁ : ℝ) / ((r₁ : ℝ) * d) =
      L + ((M₁ : ℝ) + r₁ - r₁ * L) / (r₁ * d) by
    field_simp [hd0, hr0]
    ring]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (div_nonneg hnum (by positivity))

name: TranslationalTilings.ack_ineq_2_12
statement:
theorem ack_ineq_2_12
    (d r₁ M₁ p : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (hr : 1 ≤ r₁)
    (hrM : r₁ ≤ M₁) (hMd : M₁ ≤ d - 1) (hp : d < p)
    (hpB : (p : ℝ) ≤ chenMiddlePrimeThreshold d) :
  (r₁ : ℝ) *
      Real.rpow p ((M₁ : ℝ) / ((r₁ : ℝ) * d)) ≤
    (M₁ : ℝ) * Real.rpow p ((1 : ℝ) / d)
proof:
:= by
  have hdR : (3 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hrR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ r₁ := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hrMR : (r₁ : ℝ) ≤ M₁ := by exact_mod_cast hrM
  have hMdCast : (M₁ : ℝ) ≤ ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hMd
  have hMdR : (M₁ : ℝ) ≤ d - 1 := by
    simpa [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ d)] using hMdCast
  have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by
    exact_mod_cast (lt_trans (by omega : 0 < d) hp)
  have hrpos : (0 : ℝ) < r₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrR
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < d - 2 := by linarith
  let x : ℝ := (M₁ : ℝ) / r₁
  have hx1 : 1 ≤ x := by
    dsimp [x]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hrpos]
    simpa using hrMR
  have hxd : x ≤ d - 1 := by
    dsimp [x]
    calc
      (M₁ : ℝ) / r₁ ≤ M₁ := div_le_self (by positivity) hrR
      _ ≤ d - 1 := hMdR
  let theta : ℝ := (x - 1) / (d - 2)
  have htheta0 : 0 ≤ theta :=
    div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx1) hden.le
  have htheta1 : theta ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [theta]
    rw [div_le_one hden]
    linarith
  have hbern : Real.rpow (d - 1 : ℝ) theta ≤ x := by
    have hb := rpow_one_add_le_one_add_mul_self
      (s := (d : ℝ) - 2) (p := theta) (by linarith) htheta0 htheta1
    rw [show (1 : ℝ) + (d - 2) = d - 1 by ring,
      show (1 : ℝ) + theta * (d - 2) = x by
        dsimp [theta]
        field_simp
        ring] at hb
    exact hb
  let t : ℝ := (x - 1) / d
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t :=
    div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx1) (by positivity)
  have hpt : Real.rpow p t ≤ Real.rpow (chenMiddlePrimeThreshold d) t :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow hpR.le hpB ht0
  have hthreshold : Real.rpow (chenMiddlePrimeThreshold d) t =
      Real.rpow (d - 1 : ℝ) theta := by
    rw [chenMiddlePrimeThreshold]
    calc
      Real.rpow (Real.rpow (d - 1 : ℝ) ((d : ℝ) / (d - 2))) t =
          Real.rpow (d - 1 : ℝ) (((d : ℝ) / (d - 2)) * t) :=
        (Real.rpow_mul (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d - 1) _ _).symm
      _ = Real.rpow (d - 1 : ℝ) theta := by
        congr 1
        dsimp [theta, t]
        field_simp
  have hsmall : Real.rpow p t ≤ x := by
    rw [hthreshold] at hpt
    exact hpt.trans hbern
  have hsplit : (M₁ : ℝ) / ((r₁ : ℝ) * d) = (1 : ℝ) / d + t := by
    dsimp [t, x]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hsplit]
  calc
    (r₁ : ℝ) * Real.rpow p ((1 : ℝ) / d + t) =
        r₁ * (Real.rpow p ((1 : ℝ) / d) * Real.rpow p t) := by
      congr 1
      exact Real.rpow_add hpR _ _
    _ ≤ r₁ * (Real.rpow p ((1 : ℝ) / d) * x) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsmall (Real.rpow_nonneg hpR.le _)
      · exact hrpos.le
    _ = M₁ * Real.rpow p ((1 : ℝ) / d) := by
      dsimp [x]
      field_simp

name: TranslationalTilings.ack_ineq_2_8
statement:
theorem ack_ineq_2_8
    (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (L : ℕ) (mu : ZMod p) :
  ‖primePowerResidueClassSum p (L + 1) hp f mu‖ ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ L
proof:
:= by
  simpa using ack_residueClass_trivial hp (by omega : 0 < L + 1) f mu

name: Polynomial.derivativeContent_pow_le_degree
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.derivativeContent_pow_le_degree
    (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f) :
  p ^ Polynomial.derivativeContentOrder f p ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have hnotC : ¬ Polynomial.C (p : ℤ) ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantPart f := by
    intro hC
    apply hprimitive
    rw [Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat, Polynomial.contentNat,
      ← Int.natCast_dvd]
    exact Polynomial.dvd_content_iff_C_dvd.mpr hC
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ,
      ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ (Polynomial.nonconstantPart f).coeff n := by
    rw [Polynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff] at hnotC
    push Not at hnotC
    exact hnotC
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hex
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by
    by_contra hn0
    have : n = 0 := by omega
    subst n
    simp [Polynomial.nonconstantPart] at hn
  have hncoeff : (Polynomial.nonconstantPart f).coeff n = f.coeff n := by
    rw [Polynomial.nonconstantPart, Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_C]
    simp [hnpos.ne']
  have hpan : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ f.coeff n := by simpa [hncoeff] using hn
  have hfn : f.coeff n ≠ 0 := fun h => hpan (by simp [h])
  have hnd : n ≤ d := by
    rw [← hdegree]
    exact Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_ne_zero hfn
  let t := Polynomial.derivativeContentOrder f p
  have hderivCoeff : f.derivative.coeff (n - 1) =
      f.coeff n * (n : ℤ) := by
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_derivative]
    have : n - 1 + 1 = n := by omega
    rw [this]
    norm_num [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ n)]
  have hpcontent : p ^ t ∣ Polynomial.contentNat f.derivative := by
    exact (padicValNat_dvd_iff t (Polynomial.contentNat f.derivative)).2
      (Or.inr le_rfl)
  have hcontentcoeff : Polynomial.contentNat f.derivative ∣
      Int.natAbs (f.derivative.coeff (n - 1)) := by
    rw [Polynomial.contentNat, Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs]
    exact Polynomial.content_dvd_coeff (p := f.derivative) (n - 1)
  have hpowprod : p ^ t ∣ n * Int.natAbs (f.coeff n) := by
    have h := hpcontent.trans hcontentcoeff
    rw [hderivCoeff, Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_natCast,
      Nat.mul_comm] at h
    exact h
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime (p ^ t) (Int.natAbs (f.coeff n)) := by
    apply Nat.Coprime.pow_left
    apply hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr
    intro hdvd
    apply hpan
    apply (Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs).mp
    simpa using hdvd
  have hpown : p ^ t ∣ n := hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hpowprod
  exact (Nat.le_of_dvd hnpos hpown).trans hnd

name: Polynomial.smallPrimeStationaryMass_le_degree
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.smallPrimeStationaryMass_le_degree
    [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f) :
  Polynomial.smallPrimeStationaryMass f p ≤ d - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by
    have horder := Polynomial.ack_lemma_2_3 hp f hdegree.le hprimitive 0
    omega
  have hfdeg : 0 < f.natDegree := hdegree.symm ▸ hdpos
  have hderiv : f.derivative ≠ 0 :=
    Polynomial.derivative_ne_zero.mpr hfdeg.ne'
  calc
    Polynomial.smallPrimeStationaryMass f p ≤
        (Polynomial.modPrime p
          (Polynomial.normalizedDerivative f p)).natDegree :=
      rootMassModPrime_le_natDegree p _
    _ ≤ (Polynomial.normalizedDerivative f p).natDegree :=
      Polynomial.natDegree_map_le
    _ = f.derivative.natDegree := by
      exact normalizeAtPrime_natDegree hp f.derivative hderiv
    _ = f.natDegree - 1 := Polynomial.natDegree_derivative f
    _ = d - 1 := by rw [hdegree]

name: TranslationalTilings.modPrime_ne_zero_of_content_primitive
statement:
private theorem modPrime_ne_zero_of_content_primitive
    [Fact p.Prime] (F : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.contentNat F) :
    Polynomial.modPrime p F ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  apply hprimitive
  rw [Polynomial.contentNat, ← Int.natCast_dvd]
  apply Polynomial.dvd_content_iff_C_dvd.mpr
  apply (Polynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff (p : ℤ) _).mpr
  intro n
  rw [← ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  have hn := congrArg (fun G : Polynomial (ZMod p) ↦ G.coeff n) hzero
  simpa [Polynomial.modPrime] using hn

name: TranslationalTilings.chen_normalizeAtPrime_C_primePow_mul
statement:
private theorem chen_normalizeAtPrime_C_primePow_mul
    (hp : p.Prime) (F : Polynomial ℤ) (hF : F ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime p (Polynomial.C ((p : ℤ) ^ k) * F) =
      Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime p F
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  let G := Polynomial.C ((p : ℤ) ^ k) * F
  have hscalar : (p : ℤ) ^ k ≠ 0 :=
    pow_ne_zero _ (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero)
  have hG : G ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr hscalar) hF
  have horder : Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p G =
      k + Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p F := by
    dsimp [G]
    rw [Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder, chen_contentNat_C_mul]
    simp only [Int.natAbs_pow, Int.natAbs_natCast]
    rw [padicValNat.mul (pow_ne_zero _ hp.ne_zero)
      (chen_contentNat_ne_zero F hF), padicValNat.prime_pow]
    rfl
  have hspecG := Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime_spec hp G hG
  have hspecF := Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime_spec hp F hF
  have hcommon : G = Polynomial.C ((p : ℤ) ^
      (k + Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p F)) *
      Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime p F := by
    calc
      G = Polynomial.C ((p : ℤ) ^ k) * F := rfl
      _ = Polynomial.C ((p : ℤ) ^ k) *
          (Polynomial.C ((p : ℤ) ^ Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p F) *
            Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime p F) := congrArg _ hspecF
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [Polynomial.C_mul, pow_add]
        ring
  apply Polynomial.ext
  intro n
  have hnG := congrArg (fun H : Polynomial ℤ ↦ H.coeff n) hspecG
  have hnCommon := congrArg (fun H : Polynomial ℤ ↦ H.coeff n) hcommon
  rw [horder] at hnG
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Nat.cast_pow] at hnG hnCommon
  have hpow : (p : ℤ) ^ (k + Polynomial.coefficientPadicOrder p F) ≠ 0 :=
    pow_ne_zero _ (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero)
  apply (Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff hpow).mp
  rw [← hnG, ← hnCommon]

name: TranslationalTilings.chen_stationaryNormalize_normalizedDerivative_eq
statement:
private theorem chen_stationaryNormalize_normalizedDerivative_eq
    [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f)
    (mu : ZMod p) :
    Polynomial.normalizedDerivative
        (Polynomial.stationaryNormalize f p mu.val) p =
      Polynomial.normalizedPrimeScaleTranslate
        (Polynomial.normalizedDerivative f p) p mu.val
proof:
:= by
  let t := Polynomial.derivativeContentOrder f p
  let D := Polynomial.normalizedDerivative f p
  let A := Polynomial.stationaryTranslate f p mu.val
  let B := Polynomial.stationaryNormalize f p mu.val
  let Pf := Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate f.derivative p mu.val
  let PD := Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate D p mu.val
  let u := Polynomial.stationaryOrder f p mu.val
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by
    have horder := Polynomial.ack_lemma_2_3 hp f hdegree.le hprimitive mu.val
    omega
  have hfderiv : f.derivative ≠ 0 := by
    apply Polynomial.derivative_ne_zero.mpr
    rw [hdegree]
    omega
  have hchild := Polynomial.stationaryChildInvariant hp f hdegree hdpos
    hprimitive mu.val
  have hAne : A ≠ 0 := hchild.translate_ne_zero
  have hBdegree : B.natDegree = d := hchild.natDegree_eq
  have hBderiv : B.derivative ≠ 0 := by
    apply Polynomial.derivative_ne_zero.mpr
    rw [hBdegree]
    omega
  have hu1 : 1 ≤ u :=
    (Polynomial.ack_lemma_2_3 hp f hdegree.le hprimitive mu.val).1
  have hspecD := Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime_spec hp f.derivative hfderiv
  have hDne : D ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    rw [show Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime p f.derivative = D from rfl,
      hzero, mul_zero] at hspecD
    exact hfderiv hspecD
  have hspecAB : A = Polynomial.C ((p : ℤ) ^ u) * B := by
    have hspecA := Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime_spec hp A hAne
    simpa [A, B, u, Polynomial.stationaryNormalize,
      Polynomial.stationaryOrder, Nat.cast_pow] using hspecA
  have hAderiv : A.derivative = Polynomial.C (p : ℤ) * Pf := by
    dsimp [A, Pf]
    simp only [Polynomial.stationaryTranslate, map_sub, Polynomial.derivative_C,
      sub_zero, Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate, Polynomial.derivative_comp,
      Polynomial.derivative_add, Polynomial.derivative_C_mul_X,
      Polynomial.derivative_C, add_zero]
  have hspecDeriv := congrArg Polynomial.derivative hspecAB
  simp only [Polynomial.derivative_mul, Polynomial.derivative_C, zero_mul,
    zero_add] at hspecDeriv
  have hPfB : Pf = Polynomial.C ((p : ℤ) ^ (u - 1)) * B.derivative := by
    apply Polynomial.ext
    intro n
    have hnA := congrArg (fun F : Polynomial ℤ ↦ F.coeff n) hAderiv
    have hnSpec := congrArg (fun F : Polynomial ℤ ↦ F.coeff n) hspecDeriv
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul] at hnA hnSpec ⊢
    have heq : (p : ℤ) ^ u * B.derivative.coeff n =
        (p : ℤ) * Pf.coeff n := by rw [← hnA, ← hnSpec]
    have hu : u - 1 + 1 = u := by omega
    rw [← hu, pow_succ] at heq
    apply (Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff
      (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero : (p : ℤ) ≠ 0)).mp
    simpa [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using heq.symm
  have hPfD : Pf = Polynomial.C ((p : ℤ) ^ t) * PD := by
    have hspecDt : f.derivative = Polynomial.C ((p : ℤ) ^ t) * D := by
      simpa [t, D, Polynomial.normalizedDerivative,
        Polynomial.derivativeContentOrder, Nat.cast_pow] using hspecD
    dsimp [Pf, PD]
    rw [hspecDt]
    simp [Polynomial.primeScaleTranslate]
  have hPfne : Pf ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hPfB]
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr
        (pow_ne_zero _ (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero))) hBderiv
  have hPDne : PD ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hPfne
    rw [hPfD, hzero, mul_zero]
  have hnormPfB : Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime p Pf =
      Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime p B.derivative := by
    rw [hPfB, chen_normalizeAtPrime_C_primePow_mul hp B.derivative hBderiv]
  have hnormPfD : Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime p Pf =
      Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime p PD := by
    rw [hPfD, chen_normalizeAtPrime_C_primePow_mul hp PD hPDne]
  change Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime p B.derivative =
    Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime p PD
  exact hnormPfB.symm.trans hnormPfD

name: Polynomial.stationaryNormalize_smallPrimeStationaryMass_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.stationaryNormalize_smallPrimeStationaryMass_le
    [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p.Prime) (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (hprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.nonconstantContentNat f)
    (mu : ZMod p) (hmu : mu ∈ Polynomial.smallPrimeStationaryRoots f p) :
  Polynomial.smallPrimeStationaryMass
      (Polynomial.stationaryNormalize f p mu.val) p ≤
    (Polynomial.modPrime p
      (Polynomial.normalizedDerivative f p)).rootMultiplicity mu
proof:
:= by
  let D := Polynomial.normalizedDerivative f p
  have hfpos : 0 < f.natDegree := by
    have horder := Polynomial.ack_lemma_2_3 hp f le_rfl hprimitive mu.val
    omega
  have hfderiv : f.derivative ≠ 0 :=
    Polynomial.derivative_ne_zero.mpr hfpos.ne'
  have hDprimitive : ¬ p ∣ Polynomial.contentNat D := by
    exact Polynomial.normalizeAtPrime_primitive hp f.derivative hfderiv
  have hDmod : Polynomial.modPrime p D ≠ 0 :=
    modPrime_ne_zero_of_content_primitive D hDprimitive
  have hmuRoot : (Polynomial.modPrime p D).IsRoot mu := by
    simpa [D, Polynomial.smallPrimeStationaryRoots,
      Polynomial.rootsModPrime] using hmu
  change Polynomial.rootMassModPrime p
