    (hlinear : ¬ p ∣ Int.natAbs (f.coeff 1))
    (hquadratic : p ∣ Int.natAbs (f.coeff 2)) :
  polynomialCompleteSum (p ^ a) (pow_pos hp.pos a) f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [f.eq_quadraticPolynomial_of_natDegree_le hdegree]
  let _ : NeZero (p ^ a) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ hp.ne_zero⟩
  rw [polynomialCompleteSum_quadratic]
  let H : ZMod (p ^ a) := ((p ^ (a - 1) : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ a))
  have hpH : (p : ZMod (p ^ a)) * H = 0 := by
    dsimp [H]
    have hpow : p * p ^ (a - 1) = p ^ a := by
      calc
        p * p ^ (a - 1) = p ^ (a - 1) * p := by rw [mul_comm]
        _ = p ^ ((a - 1) + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]
        _ = p ^ a := by congr 1; omega
    calc
      (p : ZMod (p ^ a)) * ((p ^ (a - 1) : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ a)) =
          ((p * p ^ (a - 1) : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ a)) := by norm_num
      _ = 0 := by rw [hpow, ZMod.natCast_self]
  have hAdiv : (p : ℤ) ∣ f.coeff 2 :=
    Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mp hquadratic
  rcases hAdiv with ⟨k, hk⟩
  have hAH : (f.coeff 2 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * H = 0 := by
    rw [hk]
    push_cast
    calc
      ((p : ZMod (p ^ a)) * (k : ZMod (p ^ a))) * H =
          (k : ZMod (p ^ a)) * (p * H) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hpH, mul_zero]
  have hHne : H ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [H]
    rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
    exact Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (pow_pos hp.pos _)
      (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right hp.one_lt (by omega))
  have hBunit : IsUnit (f.coeff 1 : ZMod (p ^ a)) :=
    isUnit_intCast_primePower hp _ hlinear
  have hDne : (f.coeff 1 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * H ≠ 0 := by
    rcases hBunit with ⟨u, hu⟩
    rw [← hu]
    simpa using hHne
  have hchar_ne :
      ZMod.stdAddChar ((f.coeff 1 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * H) ≠ 1 := by
    intro heq
    apply hDne
    apply ZMod.injective_stdAddChar
    simpa using heq
  have hphase (x : ZMod (p ^ a)) :
      (f.coeff 2 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * (x + H) ^ 2 +
          (f.coeff 1 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * (x + H) +
          (f.coeff 0 : ZMod (p ^ a)) =
        ((f.coeff 2 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * x ^ 2 +
          (f.coeff 1 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * x + (f.coeff 0 : ZMod (p ^ a))) +
          (f.coeff 1 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * H := by
    calc
      _ = ((f.coeff 2 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * x ^ 2 +
          (f.coeff 1 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * x + f.coeff 0) +
          (2 * x * ((f.coeff 2 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * H) +
            H * ((f.coeff 2 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * H) + f.coeff 1 * H) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hAH, mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_add, zero_add]
  have hshift :
      (∑ x : ZMod (p ^ a),
        ZMod.stdAddChar ((f.coeff 2 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * x ^ 2 +
          (f.coeff 1 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * x + (f.coeff 0 : ZMod (p ^ a)))) =
      (∑ x : ZMod (p ^ a),
        ZMod.stdAddChar ((f.coeff 2 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * x ^ 2 +
          (f.coeff 1 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * x + (f.coeff 0 : ZMod (p ^ a)))) *
        ZMod.stdAddChar ((f.coeff 1 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * H) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ x : ZMod (p ^ a),
          ZMod.stdAddChar ((f.coeff 2 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * (x + H) ^ 2 +
            (f.coeff 1 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * (x + H) +
            (f.coeff 0 : ZMod (p ^ a))) := by
        exact (Fintype.sum_bijective (fun x : ZMod (p ^ a) ↦ x + H)
          (AddGroup.addRight_bijective H) _ _ (fun _ ↦ rfl)).symm
      _ = _ := by
        simp_rw [hphase, AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  have hfactor :
      (1 - ZMod.stdAddChar ((f.coeff 1 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * H)) *
        (∑ x : ZMod (p ^ a),
          ZMod.stdAddChar ((f.coeff 2 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * x ^ 2 +
            (f.coeff 1 : ZMod (p ^ a)) * x + (f.coeff 0 : ZMod (p ^ a)))) = 0 := by
    linear_combination hshift
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hfactor).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hchar_ne.symm)

name: TranslationalTilings.not_two_dvd_natAbs_of_odd
statement:
private theorem not_two_dvd_natAbs_of_odd (A : ℤ) (hA : Odd A) :
    ¬ 2 ∣ Int.natAbs A
proof:
:= by
  intro hdiv
  have hdivInt : (2 : ℤ) ∣ A := Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mp hdiv
  rcases hA with ⟨k, hk⟩
  rcases hdivInt with ⟨j, hj⟩
  omega

name: TranslationalTilings.quadraticSum_norm_twoPower_of_odd_even
statement:
private theorem quadraticSum_norm_twoPower_of_odd_even
    (a : ℕ) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (A B : ℤ) (hA : Odd A) (hB : Even B) :
    ‖∑ x : ZMod (2 ^ a),
      ZMod.stdAddChar ((A : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * x ^ 2 + (B : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * x)‖ =
      Real.sqrt (2 * 2 ^ a)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : NeZero (2 ^ a) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ (by omega)⟩
  let H : ZMod (2 ^ a) := ((2 ^ (a - 1) : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ a))
  have htwoH : 2 * H = 0 := by
    dsimp [H]
    have hpow : (2 : ℕ) * 2 ^ (a - 1) = 2 ^ a := by
      calc
        2 * 2 ^ (a - 1) = 2 ^ (a - 1) * 2 := by rw [mul_comm]
        _ = 2 ^ ((a - 1) + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]
        _ = 2 ^ a := by congr 1; omega
    calc
      (2 : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * ((2 ^ (a - 1) : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ a)) =
          (((2 : ℕ) * 2 ^ (a - 1) : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ a)) := by norm_num
      _ = 0 := by rw [hpow, ZMod.natCast_self]
  have hHH : H ^ 2 = 0 := by
    have hdvd : 2 ^ a ∣ (2 ^ (a - 1)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← pow_mul]
      exact pow_dvd_pow 2 (by omega : a ≤ (a - 1) * 2)
    rcases hdvd with ⟨d, hd⟩
    dsimp [H]
    calc
      (((2 ^ (a - 1) : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ a))) ^ 2 =
          (((2 ^ (a - 1)) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ a)) := by norm_num
      _ = 0 := by rw [hd, Nat.cast_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul]
  have hHne : H ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [H]
    rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
    exact Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (pow_pos (by omega) _)
      (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
  have hBHzero : (B : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * H = 0 := by
    rcases hB with ⟨k, rfl⟩
    push_cast
    calc
      ((k : ZMod (2 ^ a)) + k) * H =
          (k : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * (2 * H) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [htwoH, mul_zero]
  have hAunit : IsUnit (A : ZMod (2 ^ a)) :=
    isUnit_intCast_primePower Nat.prime_two A (not_two_dvd_natAbs_of_odd A hA)
  have htwoKernel (h : ZMod (2 ^ a)) : 2 * h = 0 ↔ h = 0 ∨ h = H := by
    have hneg := ZMod.neg_eq_self_iff h
    have hval : 2 * h = 0 ↔ h = 0 ∨ 2 * h.val = 2 ^ a := by
      simpa [two_mul, neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero] using hneg
    rw [hval]
    constructor
    · rintro (hh | hh)
      · exact Or.inl hh
      · right
        have hv : h.val = 2 ^ (a - 1) := by
          have hpow : 2 ^ a = 2 * 2 ^ (a - 1) := by
            calc
              2 ^ a = 2 ^ ((a - 1) + 1) := by congr 1; omega
              _ = 2 ^ (a - 1) * 2 := by rw [pow_succ]
              _ = 2 * 2 ^ (a - 1) := by rw [mul_comm]
          omega
        calc
          h = (h.val : ZMod (2 ^ a)) := h.natCast_zmod_val.symm
          _ = H := by rw [hv]
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · right
        have hpow : 2 * (2 ^ (a - 1)) = 2 ^ a := by
          calc
            2 * 2 ^ (a - 1) = 2 ^ (a - 1) * 2 := by rw [mul_comm]
            _ = 2 ^ ((a - 1) + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]
            _ = 2 ^ a := by congr 1; omega
        dsimp [H]
        rw [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))]
        exact hpow
  have hkernel (h : ZMod (2 ^ a)) :
      2 * (A : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * h = 0 ↔ h = 0 ∨ h = H := by
    rw [show 2 * (A : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * h = (A : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * (2 * h) by ring]
    rcases hAunit with ⟨u, hu⟩
    rw [← hu]
    simpa using htwoKernel h
  have hnorm := quadraticSum_normSq (2 ^ a)
    (A : ZMod (2 ^ a)) (B : ZMod (2 ^ a))
  simp_rw [hkernel] at hnorm
  have hphaseH :
      (A : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * H ^ 2 + (B : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * H = 0 := by
    rw [hHH, mul_zero, hBHzero, zero_add]
  have hsummand (h : ZMod (2 ^ a)) :
      ZMod.stdAddChar ((A : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * h ^ 2 + (B : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * h) *
          (if h = 0 ∨ h = H then ((2 ^ a : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0) =
        if h = 0 then ((2 ^ a : ℕ) : ℂ)
        else if h = H then ((2 ^ a : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0 := by
    by_cases hzero : h = 0
    · subst h
      simp
    · by_cases hhalf : h = H
      · subst h
        simp [hHne, hphaseH]
      · simp [hzero, hhalf]
  simp_rw [hsummand] at hnorm
  have hsingle (y : ZMod (2 ^ a)) :
      (∑ x : ZMod (2 ^ a),
        if x = y then ((2 ^ a : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0) = ((2 ^ a : ℕ) : ℂ) := by
    simp
  have hsum :
      (∑ x : ZMod (2 ^ a),
        if x = 0 then ((2 ^ a : ℕ) : ℂ)
        else if x = H then ((2 ^ a : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0) =
          ((2 * 2 ^ a : ℕ) : ℂ) := by
    have hzeroH : (0 : ZMod (2 ^ a)) ≠ H := hHne.symm
    calc
      _ = (∑ x : ZMod (2 ^ a),
            if x = 0 then ((2 ^ a : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0) +
          (∑ x : ZMod (2 ^ a),
            if x = H then ((2 ^ a : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro x _
        by_cases hxzero : x = 0
        · subst x
          simp [hzeroH]
        · by_cases hxhalf : x = H
          · subst x
            simp [hHne]
          · simp [hxzero, hxhalf]
      _ = _ := by rw [hsingle, hsingle]; push_cast; ring
  rw [hsum] at hnorm
  have hnormReal :
      Complex.normSq
        (∑ x : ZMod (2 ^ a),
          ZMod.stdAddChar ((A : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * x ^ 2 +
            (B : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * x)) = 2 * 2 ^ a := by
    exact_mod_cast hnorm
  rw [Complex.norm_def, hnormReal]

name: TranslationalTilings.quadraticCompleteSum_norm_twoPower_of_odd_even
statement:
private theorem quadraticCompleteSum_norm_twoPower_of_odd_even
    (a : ℕ) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (A B C : ℤ) (hA : Odd A) (hB : Even B) :
    ‖polynomialCompleteSum (2 ^ a) (pow_pos (by omega) a)
      (quadraticPolynomial A B C)‖ = Real.sqrt (2 * 2 ^ a)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : NeZero (2 ^ a) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ (by omega)⟩
  rw [polynomialCompleteSum_quadratic]
  have hfactor :
      (∑ x : ZMod (2 ^ a),
          ZMod.stdAddChar ((A : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * x ^ 2 +
            (B : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * x + (C : ZMod (2 ^ a))) =
        (∑ x : ZMod (2 ^ a),
          ZMod.stdAddChar ((A : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * x ^ 2 +
            (B : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * x)) * ZMod.stdAddChar (C : ZMod (2 ^ a))) := by
    simp_rw [AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [hfactor, norm_mul,
    quadraticSum_norm_twoPower_of_odd_even a ha A B hA hB,
    (ZMod.stdAddChar (N := 2 ^ a)).norm_apply, mul_one]

name: TranslationalTilings.quadraticCompleteSum_two_completeSquare
statement:
theorem quadraticCompleteSum_two_completeSquare
    (A B C : ℤ) (hA : Odd A) (hB : Even B)
    (a : ℕ) (ha : 2 ≤ a) :
  ‖polynomialCompleteSum (2 ^ a) (pow_pos (by omega) _)
      (quadraticPolynomial A B C)‖ =
    ‖quadraticGaussSum (2 ^ a) (pow_pos (by omega) _) A‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadraticCompleteSum_norm_twoPower_of_odd_even a ha A B C hA hB,
    quadraticGaussSum_eq_sum]
  symm
  simpa using
    (quadraticSum_norm_twoPower_of_odd_even a ha A 0 hA (by simp))

name: TranslationalTilings.quadratic_twoPower_quadratic_odd_norm
statement:
theorem quadratic_twoPower_quadratic_odd_norm
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (f : Polynomial ℤ) (hdegree : f.natDegree ≤ 2)
    (hlinear : Even (f.coeff 1)) (hquadratic : Odd (f.coeff 2)) :
  ‖polynomialCompleteSum (2 ^ a) (pow_pos (by omega) a) f‖ =
    Real.sqrt (2 * 2 ^ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [f.eq_quadraticPolynomial_of_natDegree_le hdegree]
  exact quadraticCompleteSum_norm_twoPower_of_odd_even a ha _ _ _ hquadratic hlinear

name: TranslationalTilings.quadraticGaussSum_oddPrime_recurrence
statement:
theorem quadraticGaussSum_oddPrime_recurrence
    (hp : p.Prime) (hpodd : p ≠ 2) (A : ℤ)
    (hA : ¬ p ∣ Int.natAbs A) (a : ℕ) :
  quadraticGaussSum (p ^ (a + 2)) (pow_pos hp.pos _) A =
    (p : ℂ) * quadraticGaussSum (p ^ a) (pow_pos hp.pos _) A
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := hp.ne_zero
  let _ : NeZero p := ⟨hp0⟩
  let _ : NeZero (p ^ a) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ hp0⟩
  let _ : NeZero (p ^ (a + 1)) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ hp0⟩
  let _ : NeZero (p ^ (a + 2)) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ hp0⟩
  rw [quadraticGaussSum_eq_sum, quadraticGaussSum_eq_sum]
  have hq2 : p ^ (a + 2) = p * p ^ (a + 1) := by
    simp only [pow_add, pow_one, pow_two]
    ring
  have hq1 : p ^ (a + 1) = p ^ a * p := by
    simp only [pow_add, pow_one]
  have hq2' : p ^ (a + 2) = p ^ a * p ^ 2 := by
    simp only [pow_add]
  have hphase (y : ZMod p) (z : ZMod (p ^ (a + 1))) :
      ZMod.stdAddChar
          ((A : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) *
            ((z.val + p ^ (a + 1) * y.val : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2) =
        ZMod.stdAddChar
            ((A : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) *
              ((z.val : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2) *
          ZMod.stdAddChar
            (((2 * A * (z.val : ℤ) * (y.val : ℤ) : ℤ)) : ZMod p) := by
    have hlast :
        (((A * (p ^ (a + 1) : ℤ) ^ 2 * (y.val : ℤ) ^ 2 : ℤ)) :
          ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) = 0 := by
      rw [ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      have hdvdNat : p ^ (a + 2) ∣ (p ^ (a + 1)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← pow_mul]
        exact pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : a + 2 ≤ (a + 1) * 2)
      have hdvdInt : (p ^ (a + 2) : ℤ) ∣ (p ^ (a + 1) : ℤ) ^ 2 := by
        exact_mod_cast hdvdNat
      exact (hdvdInt.mul_left A).mul_right ((y.val : ℤ) ^ 2)
    have harg :
        (A : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) *
            ((z.val + p ^ (a + 1) * y.val : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2 =
          (A : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) *
              ((z.val : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2 +
            (((p ^ (a + 1) : ℤ) *
              (2 * A * (z.val : ℤ) * (y.val : ℤ)) : ℤ) :
                ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) := by
      push_cast
      have hlast' :
          (A : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) * (p ^ (a + 1) : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2 *
              (y.val : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2 = 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast hlast
      rw [show
        (A : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) *
            ((z.val : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) +
              (p ^ (a + 1) : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) * y.val) ^ 2 =
          (A : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) * (z.val : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2 +
            (p ^ (a + 1) : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) *
              (2 * A * z.val * y.val) +
            A * (p ^ (a + 1) : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2 * y.val ^ 2 by ring,
        hlast', add_zero]
    rw [harg, AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    convert
      (stdAddChar_mul_modulus_eq (p ^ (a + 2)) p (p ^ (a + 1)) hq2
        (2 * A * (z.val : ℤ) * (y.val : ℤ))) using 1
    all_goals norm_num
  rw [sum_zmod_eq_mul (p ^ (a + 2)) p (p ^ (a + 1)) hq2]
  simp_rw [hphase]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  have htwoAunit : IsUnit ((2 * A : ℤ) : ZMod p) := by
    rw [CharP.isUnit_intCast_iff hp]
    intro hdiv
    have hdivNat : p ∣ 2 * Int.natAbs A := by
      simpa [Int.natAbs_mul] using Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mpr hdiv
    rcases hp.dvd_mul.mp hdivNat with hpTwo | hpA
    · rcases (Nat.dvd_prime Nat.prime_two).mp hpTwo with hpone | hptwo
      · exact hp.ne_one hpone
      · exact hpodd hptwo
    · exact hA hpA
  have hcoeff (z : ZMod (p ^ (a + 1))) :
      (((2 * A * (z.val : ℤ) : ℤ)) : ZMod p) = 0 ↔
        ((z.val : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
    rcases htwoAunit with ⟨u, hu⟩
    have hcast :
        (((2 * A : ℤ)) : ZMod p) * ((z.val : ℕ) : ZMod p) =
          (((2 * A * (z.val : ℤ) : ℤ)) : ZMod p) := by norm_num
    rw [← hcast, ← hu]
    simp
  simp_rw [show ∀ z : ZMod (p ^ (a + 1)),
      (∑ y : ZMod p,
        ZMod.stdAddChar
          (((2 * A * (z.val : ℤ) * (y.val : ℤ) : ℤ)) : ZMod p)) =
        if ((z.val : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 then (p : ℂ) else 0 by
    intro z
    have hy (y : ZMod p) :
        (((2 * A * (z.val : ℤ) * (y.val : ℤ) : ℤ)) : ZMod p) =
          (((2 * A * (z.val : ℤ) : ℤ)) : ZMod p) * y := by
      have hycast : ((y.val : ℕ) : ZMod p) = y := y.natCast_zmod_val
      push_cast
      rw [hycast]
    simp_rw [hy]
    rw [sum_stdAddChar_mul]
    exact if_congr (hcoeff z) rfl rfl]
  rw [sum_zmod_eq_mul (p ^ (a + 1)) (p ^ a) p hq1]
  
  have hinner (w : ZMod (p ^ a)) :
      (∑ r : ZMod p,
        ZMod.stdAddChar
            ((A : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) *
              (((((r.val + p * w.val : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ a * p))).val : ℕ) :
                ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2) *
          (if (((((r.val + p * w.val : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ a * p))).val : ℕ) :
              ZMod p) = 0
            then (p : ℂ) else 0)) =
        (p : ℂ) *
          ZMod.stdAddChar ((A : ZMod (p ^ a)) * w ^ 2) := by
    have hval (r : ZMod p) :
        (((r.val + p * w.val : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ a * p))).val = r.val + p * w.val := by
      rw [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt]
      have hr : r.val < p := r.val_lt
      have hw : w.val < p ^ a := w.val_lt
      calc
        r.val + p * w.val < p + p * w.val := Nat.add_lt_add_right hr _
        _ = p * (w.val + 1) := by ring
        _ ≤ p * p ^ a := Nat.mul_le_mul_left p (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hw)
        _ = p ^ a * p := by rw [mul_comm]
    simp_rw [hval]
    have hlow (r : ZMod p) :
        ((r.val + p * w.val : ℕ) : ZMod p) = r := by
      rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul, add_zero,
        r.natCast_zmod_val]
    simp_rw [hlow]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
    · simp only [ZMod.val_zero, zero_add]
      rw [if_true]
      have hdesc := stdAddChar_mul_modulus_eq (p ^ (a + 2)) (p ^ a) (p ^ 2) hq2'
        (A * (w.val : ℤ) ^ 2)
      have hwcast : ((w.val : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ a)) = w := w.natCast_zmod_val
      have hdesc' :
          ZMod.stdAddChar
              ((A : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) *
                ((p * w.val : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2) =
            ZMod.stdAddChar ((A : ZMod (p ^ a)) * w ^ 2) := by
        simpa [hwcast, pow_two, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hdesc
      rw [hdesc']
      ring
    · intro r _ hr0
      rw [if_neg hr0, mul_zero]
    · simp
  calc
    _ = ∑ w : ZMod (p ^ a),
        (p : ℂ) * ZMod.stdAddChar ((A : ZMod (p ^ a)) * w ^ 2) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro w _
      exact hinner w
    _ = _ := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: TranslationalTilings.quadraticGaussSum_two_recurrence
statement:
theorem quadraticGaussSum_two_recurrence
    (A : ℤ) (hA : Odd A) (a : ℕ) (ha : 2 ≤ a) :
  quadraticGaussSum (2 ^ (a + 2)) (pow_pos (by omega) _) A =
    2 * quadraticGaussSum (2 ^ a) (pow_pos (by omega) _) A
proof:
:= by
  let _ : NeZero 2 := ⟨by omega⟩
  let _ : NeZero (2 ^ a) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ (by omega)⟩
  let _ : NeZero (2 ^ (a + 1)) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ (by omega)⟩
  let _ : NeZero (2 ^ (a + 2)) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ (by omega)⟩
  rw [quadraticGaussSum_eq_sum, quadraticGaussSum_eq_sum]
  have hq2 : 2 ^ (a + 2) = 2 ^ (a + 1) * 2 := by
    simp only [pow_add, pow_one, pow_two]
    ring
  have hq1 : 2 ^ (a + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ a := by
    simp only [pow_add, pow_one]
    ring
  have hq2scale : 2 ^ (a + 2) = 2 ^ a * 4 := by
    norm_num [pow_add, pow_two]
  rw [sum_zmod_eq_mul (2 ^ (a + 2)) (2 ^ (a + 1)) 2 hq2]
  have hsplit (y : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1))) :
      (∑ r : ZMod 2,
        ZMod.stdAddChar
          ((A : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) *
            ((r.val + 2 * y.val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2)) =
        ZMod.stdAddChar
            ((A : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) *
              ((2 * y.val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2) +
          ZMod.stdAddChar
            ((A : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) *
              ((1 + 2 * y.val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2) := by
    rw [← (ZMod.finEquiv 2).sum_comp]
    norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ, finEquiv_apply_eq_natCast]
  simp_rw [hsplit]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hevenPhase (y : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1))) :
      ZMod.stdAddChar
          ((A : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) *
            ((2 * y.val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2) =
        ZMod.stdAddChar
          ((A : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * ((y.val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ a)) ^ 2) := by
    have hdesc := stdAddChar_mul_modulus_eq
      (2 ^ (a + 2)) (2 ^ a) 4 hq2scale (A * (y.val : ℤ) ^ 2)
    have hfour : (4 : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) = 2 * 2 := by norm_num
    simpa [hfour, pow_two, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hdesc
  simp_rw [hevenPhase]
  have hevenSum :
      (∑ y : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1)),
        ZMod.stdAddChar
          ((A : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * ((y.val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ a)) ^ 2)) =
        2 * ∑ w : ZMod (2 ^ a),
          ZMod.stdAddChar ((A : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * w ^ 2) := by
    rw [sum_zmod_eq_mul (2 ^ (a + 1)) 2 (2 ^ a) hq1]
    have hinner (t : ZMod 2) :
        (∑ w : ZMod (2 ^ a),
          ZMod.stdAddChar
            ((A : ZMod (2 ^ a)) *
              (((((w.val + 2 ^ a * t.val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1)))).val : ℕ) :
                ZMod (2 ^ a)) ^ 2)) =
          ∑ w : ZMod (2 ^ a),
            ZMod.stdAddChar ((A : ZMod (2 ^ a)) * w ^ 2) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro w _
      have ht : t.val = 0 ∨ t.val = 1 := by
        have htlt := t.val_lt
        omega
      have hval :
          (((w.val + 2 ^ a * t.val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1)))).val =
            w.val + 2 ^ a * t.val := by
        rw [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt]
        rcases ht with ht | ht <;> rw [ht]
        · simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]
          exact w.val_lt.trans_le (by omega)
        · simp only [mul_one]
          have hw := w.val_lt
          omega
      rw [hval, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul,
        add_zero, w.natCast_zmod_val]
    simp_rw [hinner]
    simp [ZMod.card]
  rw [hevenSum]
  have hoddSum :
      (∑ y : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1)),
        ZMod.stdAddChar
          ((A : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) *
            ((1 + 2 * y.val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2)) = 0 := by
    let H : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1)) :=
      ((2 ^ (a - 1) : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1)))
    let K : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2)) :=
      ((2 ^ a : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2)))
    have hfourK : 4 * K = 0 := by
      dsimp [K]
      have hpow : (4 : ℕ) * 2 ^ a = 2 ^ (a + 2) := by
        norm_num [pow_add, pow_two]
        ring
      calc
        (4 : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) * ((2 ^ a : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) =
            (((4 : ℕ) * 2 ^ a : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) := by norm_num
        _ = 0 := by rw [hpow, ZMod.natCast_self]
    have hKK : K ^ 2 = 0 := by
      have hdvd : 2 ^ (a + 2) ∣ (2 ^ a) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← pow_mul]
        exact pow_dvd_pow 2 (by omega : a + 2 ≤ a * 2)
      rcases hdvd with ⟨d, hd⟩
      dsimp [K]
      calc
        (((2 ^ a : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2)))) ^ 2 =
            (((2 ^ a) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) := by norm_num
        _ = 0 := by rw [hd, Nat.cast_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul]
    have hAK : (A : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) * (2 * K) = 2 * K := by
      rcases hA with ⟨j, rfl⟩
      push_cast
      calc
        ((2 : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) * (j : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) + 1) * (2 * K) =
            (j : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) * (4 * K) + 2 * K := by ring
        _ = 2 * K := by rw [hfourK, mul_zero, zero_add]
    have hlift (y : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1))) :
        ((1 + 2 * (y + H).val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) =
          ((1 + 2 * y.val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) + K := by
      have hsmall :
          ((y.val + 2 ^ (a - 1) : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1))) = y + H := by
        dsimp [H]
        rw [Nat.cast_add, y.natCast_zmod_val]
      have hsmall' :
          (((y + H).val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1))) = y + H :=
        (y + H).natCast_zmod_val
      have hdiv :
          (2 ^ (a + 1) : ℤ) ∣
            ((y + H).val : ℤ) - ((y.val : ℤ) + 2 ^ (a - 1)) := by
        apply (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub
          ((y.val : ℤ) + 2 ^ (a - 1)) ((y + H).val : ℤ) (2 ^ (a + 1))).mp
        exact_mod_cast hsmall.trans hsmall'.symm
      have hhalfNat : 2 * 2 ^ (a - 1) = 2 ^ a := by
        calc
          2 * 2 ^ (a - 1) = 2 ^ (a - 1) * 2 := by rw [mul_comm]
          _ = 2 ^ ((a - 1) + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]
          _ = 2 ^ a := by congr 1; omega
      have hK : K = ((2 * 2 ^ (a - 1) : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) := by
        dsimp [K]
        rw [hhalfNat]
      rw [hK]
      have heqBig :
          (((1 + 2 * (y + H).val : ℕ) : ℤ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) =
            (((1 + 2 * y.val + 2 * 2 ^ (a - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) :
              ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) := by
        rw [ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub]
        rcases hdiv with ⟨d, hd⟩
        use -d
        have hpow : (2 ^ (a + 2) : ℤ) = 2 * (2 ^ (a + 1) : ℤ) := by
          norm_num [pow_add, pow_two]
          ring
        norm_num only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_ofNat,
          Nat.cast_pow] at ⊢
        rw [hpow]
        linear_combination -2 * hd
      exact_mod_cast heqBig
    have hphase (y : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1))) :
        ZMod.stdAddChar
            ((A : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) *
              ((1 + 2 * (y + H).val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2) =
          -ZMod.stdAddChar
            ((A : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) *
              ((1 + 2 * y.val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2) := by
      let X : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2)) :=
        ((1 + 2 * y.val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2)))
      have htwoXK : 2 * X * K = 2 * K := by
        dsimp [X]
        push_cast
        calc
          2 * (1 + 2 * (y.val : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2)))) * K =
              2 * K + (y.val : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) * (4 * K) := by ring
          _ = 2 * K := by rw [hfourK, mul_zero, add_zero]
      have harg : (A : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) * (X + K) ^ 2 =
          (A : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) * X ^ 2 + 2 * K := by
        calc
          _ = (A : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) * X ^ 2 +
              A * (2 * X * K) + A * K ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = _ := by rw [htwoXK, hAK, hKK, mul_zero, add_zero]
      have htwoKNat : 2 * 2 ^ a = 2 ^ (a + 1) := by
        simp only [pow_add, pow_one]
        ring
      have htwoK : 2 * K = ((2 ^ (a + 1) : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) := by
        dsimp [K]
        calc
          (2 : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) * ((2 ^ a : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) =
              (((2 : ℕ) * 2 ^ a : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) := by norm_num
          _ = _ := by rw [htwoKNat]
      have hcharTwoK : ZMod.stdAddChar (2 * K) = (-1 : ℂ) := by
        rw [htwoK]
        exact stdAddChar_twoPower_half (a + 2) (by omega)
      rw [hlift]
      change ZMod.stdAddChar ((A : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) * (X + K) ^ 2) = _
      rw [harg, AddChar.map_add_eq_mul, hcharTwoK]
      dsimp [X]
      ring
    have hshift :
        (∑ y : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1)),
          ZMod.stdAddChar
            ((A : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) *
              ((1 + 2 * y.val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2)) =
        -(∑ y : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1)),
          ZMod.stdAddChar
            ((A : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) *
              ((1 + 2 * y.val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2)) := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ y : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1)),
            ZMod.stdAddChar
              ((A : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) *
                ((1 + 2 * (y + H).val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2) := by
          exact (Fintype.sum_bijective (fun y : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1)) ↦ y + H)
            (AddGroup.addRight_bijective H) _ _ (fun _ ↦ rfl)).symm
        _ = _ := by simp_rw [hphase, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    have htwoSum :
        2 * (∑ y : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 1)),
          ZMod.stdAddChar
            ((A : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) *
              ((1 + 2 * y.val : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ (a + 2))) ^ 2)) = 0 := by
      linear_combination hshift
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp htwoSum).resolve_left (by norm_num)
  rw [hoddSum, add_zero]

name: TranslationalTilings.exists_prime_addChar_reciprocalRoots_le
statement:
theorem exists_prime_addChar_reciprocalRoots_le
    {p : ℕ} [NeZero p] (hp : p.Prime)
    (psi : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hpsi : psi ≠ 1)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hnonconst : 0 < f.natDegree)
    (hsmall : f.natDegree < p) :
    ∃ r ≤ f.natDegree - 1, ∃ alpha : Fin r → ℂ,
      (∑ x : ZMod p, psi (f.eval x)) = -∑ i, alpha i ∧
      ∀ i, ‖alpha i‖ ≤ Real.sqrt p
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  let g := eraseConstant f
  let roots := reciprocalRoots psi g
  let t := constantTwist psi f
  have hgdegree : g.natDegree = f.natDegree :=
    eraseConstant_natDegree f hnonconst
  have hgpos : 0 < g.natDegree := hgdegree.symm ▸ hnonconst
  have hgsmall : g.natDegree < p := hgdegree.symm ▸ hsmall
  have hroots : roots.card ≤ f.natDegree - 1 := by
    simpa [roots, g, hgdegree] using reciprocalRoots_card_le psi g
  have hrootSum : (∑ x : ZMod p, psi (g.eval x)) = -roots.sum := by
    calc
      (∑ x : ZMod p, psi (g.eval x)) =
          extensionExponentialSum psi g 1 :=
        (extensionExponentialSum_one_eq_primeSum psi g).symm
      _ = -((reciprocalRoots psi g).map fun omega ↦ omega ^ 1).sum :=
        artinLPolynomial_trace_identity psi hpsi g
          (eraseConstant_coeff_zero f) hgpos hgsmall one_ne_zero
      _ = -roots.sum := by simp [roots]
  have hsum :
      (∑ i : Fin roots.toList.length, t * roots.toList[i]) =
        t * roots.sum := by
    calc
      _ = (roots.toList.map fun z ↦ t * z).sum :=
        Fin.sum_univ_fun_getElem roots.toList (fun z ↦ t * z)
      _ = (roots.map fun z ↦ t * z).sum :=
        Multiset.sum_map_toList roots (fun z ↦ t * z)
      _ = _ := by
        simpa using
          (Multiset.sum_map_mul_left (a := t) (s := roots) (f := id))
  refine ⟨roots.toList.length, ?_, fun i ↦ t * roots.toList[i], ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hroots
  · calc
      (∑ x : ZMod p, psi (f.eval x)) =
          extensionExponentialSum psi f 1 :=
        (extensionExponentialSum_one_eq_primeSum psi f).symm
      _ = t ^ 1 * extensionExponentialSum psi g 1 := by
        simpa [t, g] using
          extensionExponentialSum_eraseConstant psi f one_ne_zero
      _ = t * (-roots.sum) := by
        rw [pow_one]
        rw [extensionExponentialSum_one_eq_primeSum psi g, hrootSum]
      _ = -(t * roots.sum) := by ring
      _ = -∑ i : Fin roots.toList.length, t * roots.toList[i] := by rw [hsum]
  · intro i
    rw [norm_mul, show ‖t‖ = 1 by
      simpa [t] using norm_constantTwist_of_finite psi f, one_mul]
    apply reciprocalRoots_norm_le psi hpsi g
      (eraseConstant_coeff_zero f) hgpos hgsmall
    have hi : roots.toList[i] ∈ roots.toList := List.getElem_mem i.isLt
    have hi' : roots.toList[i] ∈ roots := Multiset.mem_toList.mp hi
    simpa [roots] using hi'

name: TranslationalTilings.polynomial_addChar_sum_prime_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem polynomial_addChar_sum_prime_of_ne_one
    {p : ℕ} [NeZero p] (hp : p.Prime)
    (psi : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hpsi : psi ≠ 1)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hnonconst : 0 < f.natDegree)
    (hsmall : f.natDegree < p) :
    ‖∑ x : ZMod p, psi (f.eval x)‖ ≤
      (f.natDegree - 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, alpha, hsum, halpha⟩ :=
    exists_prime_addChar_reciprocalRoots_le
      hp psi hpsi f hnonconst hsmall
  have hr' : (r : ℝ) ≤ (f.natDegree : ℝ) - 1 := by
    calc
      (r : ℝ) ≤ ((f.natDegree - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hr
      _ = (f.natDegree : ℝ) - 1 := by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ f.natDegree by omega)]
        norm_num
  rw [hsum, norm_neg]
  calc
    ‖∑ i, alpha i‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖alpha i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _ : Fin r, Real.sqrt p :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ halpha i
    _ = (r : ℝ) * Real.sqrt p := by simp
    _ ≤ (f.natDegree - 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt p :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr' (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

name: TranslationalTilings.polynomial_addChar_sum_prime
statement:
theorem polynomial_addChar_sum_prime
    {p : ℕ} [NeZero p] (hp : p.Prime)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hnonconst : 0 < f.natDegree)
    (hsmall : f.natDegree < p) :
    ‖∑ x : ZMod p, ZMod.stdAddChar (f.eval x)‖ ≤
      (f.natDegree - 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt p
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have hstd :
      (ZMod.stdAddChar : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ) ≠ 1 := by
    have h := ZMod.isPrimitive_stdAddChar p
      (a := (1 : ZMod p)) one_ne_zero
    simpa using h
  exact polynomial_addChar_sum_prime_of_ne_one
    hp ZMod.stdAddChar hstd f hnonconst hsmall

name: TranslationalTilings.dilate_zero
statement:
theorem dilate_zero {d : ℕ} {F : Finset (Lattice d)}
    (hF : F.Nonempty) : dilate 0 F = {0}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rw [dilate, Finset.mem_image]
    rintro ⟨f, -, rfl⟩
    simp
  · intro hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
    subst x
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hF
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨f, hf, by simp⟩

name: TranslationalTilings.dilate_zero_eq_empty_iff
statement:
theorem dilate_zero_eq_empty_iff {d : ℕ} (F : Finset (Lattice d)) :
    dilate 0 F = ∅ ↔ F = ∅
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hF
    have hne : F.Nonempty := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hF
    rw [dilate_zero hne] at h
    simp at h
  · rintro rfl
    simp [dilate]

name: TranslationalTilings.dilate_one
statement: theorem dilate_one {d : ℕ} (F : Finset (Lattice d)) : dilate 1 F = F
proof:
:= by
  simp [dilate]

name: TranslationalTilings.dilate_mul
statement:
theorem dilate_mul {d r s : ℕ} (F : Finset (Lattice d)) :
    dilate r (dilate s F) = dilate (r * s) F
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [dilate, Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨f, hf, ?_⟩
    simp [mul_smul, Nat.cast_mul]
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(s : ℤ) • f, ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [mul_smul, Nat.cast_mul]

name: TranslationalTilings.card_dilate
statement:
theorem card_dilate {d r : ℕ} {F : Finset (Lattice d)} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (dilate r F).card = F.card
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.card_image_iff.mpr
  intro x _ y _ hxy
  apply_fun fun z i ↦ z i at hxy
  funext i
  have hrz : (r : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hr)
  have hi := congrFun hxy i
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hi
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hrz hi

name: TranslationalTilings.tileMonoidAlgebra_frobenius_mod_prime
statement:
theorem tileMonoidAlgebra_frobenius_mod_prime
    {d p : ℕ} (F : Finset (Lattice d)) (hp : p.Prime) :
    tileMonoidAlgebra (ZMod p) (Lattice d) F ^ p =
      tileMonoidAlgebra (ZMod p) (Lattice d) (dilate p F)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  let _ : CharP (AddMonoidAlgebra (ZMod p) (Lattice d)) p :=
    charP_of_injective_algebraMap' (ZMod p) p
  rw [tileMonoidAlgebra, sum_pow_char]
  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.single_pow, one_pow]
  rw [tileMonoidAlgebra]
  simp only [dilate]
  rw [Finset.sum_image]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro f _
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul]
    norm_cast
  · intro x _ y _ hxy
    apply_fun fun z i ↦ z i at hxy
    funext i
    have hpz : (p : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero
    have hi := congrFun hxy i
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hi
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hpz hi

name: TranslationalTilings.convolutionRepresentation_tile_apply
statement:
private theorem convolutionRepresentation_tile_apply
    {G R : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [CommRing R]
    (F : Finset G) (g : G → R) :
    convolutionRepresentation G R (tileMonoidAlgebra R G F) g = tileConv F g
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp [convolutionRepresentation, tileMonoidAlgebra,
    backwardShiftMonoidHom, backwardShift, tileConv]

name: TranslationalTilings.tileConv_const
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp [tileConv, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: TranslationalTilings.convolutionRepresentation_pow_const
statement:
private theorem convolutionRepresentation_pow_const
    {G R : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [CommRing R]
    (F : Finset G) (c : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (convolutionRepresentation G R (tileMonoidAlgebra R G F) ^ n)
        (fun _ ↦ c) = fun _ ↦ (F.card : R) ^ n * c
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, convolutionRepresentation_tile_apply,
        ih, tileConv_const]
      funext x
      ring

name: TranslationalTilings.tileConv_dilate_mod_prime
statement:
private theorem tileConv_dilate_mod_prime
    {d p : ℕ} (F : Finset (Lattice d)) (g : Lattice d → ℤ)
    (k : ℤ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hconv : tileConv F g = fun _ ↦ k)
    (hFpos : 0 < F.card) (hcard : F.card < p) :
    ∀ x, ((tileConv (dilate p F) g x : ℤ) : ZMod p) = (k : ZMod p)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  let gz : Lattice d → ZMod p := fun x ↦ (g x : ZMod p)
  let T := convolutionRepresentation (Lattice d) (ZMod p)
  have hTg : T (tileMonoidAlgebra (ZMod p) (Lattice d) F) gz = fun _ ↦ (k : ZMod p) := by
    rw [convolutionRepresentation_tile_apply]
    funext x
    simpa [tileConv, gz] using
      congrArg (fun z : ℤ ↦ (z : ZMod p)) (congrFun hconv x)
  have hcard_ne : (F.card : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
    exact Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt hFpos hcard
  have hfermat : (F.card : ZMod p) ^ (p - 1) = 1 :=
    ZMod.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one hcard_ne
  intro x
  have hfrob := tileMonoidAlgebra_frobenius_mod_prime F hp
  have hop := congrArg T hfrob
  rw [map_pow] at hop
  have happ := DFunLike.congr_fun hop gz
  have hp_pos : 0 < p := hp.pos
  have hp_eq : p = (p - 1) + 1 := by omega
  have hexp :
      (T (tileMonoidAlgebra (ZMod p) (Lattice d) F) ^ p) gz =
        (T (tileMonoidAlgebra (ZMod p) (Lattice d) F) ^ ((p - 1) + 1)) gz :=
    congrArg (fun n ↦ (T (tileMonoidAlgebra (ZMod p) (Lattice d) F) ^ n) gz) hp_eq
  have hpow :
      (T (tileMonoidAlgebra (ZMod p) (Lattice d) F) ^ p) gz =
        fun _ ↦ (k : ZMod p) := by
    rw [hexp, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, hTg,
      convolutionRepresentation_pow_const, hfermat]
    simp
  have hx := congrFun (happ.symm.trans hpow) x
  simpa [T, gz, convolutionRepresentation_tile_apply, tileConv] using hx

name: TranslationalTilings.tileConv_boundedBetween
statement:
private theorem tileConv_boundedBetween {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (F : Finset G) (g : G → ℤ) (lo hi : ℤ)
    (hbound : BoundedBetween lo hi g) (x : G) :
    (F.card : ℤ) * lo ≤ tileConv F g x ∧
      tileConv F g x ≤ (F.card : ℤ) * hi
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa [tileConv, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using
      Finset.sum_le_sum (s := F) (fun f _ ↦ (hbound (x - f)).1)
  · simpa [tileConv, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using
      Finset.sum_le_sum (s := F) (fun f _ ↦ (hbound (x - f)).2)

name: TranslationalTilings.dilation_prime
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hF : F.Nonempty
  · have hFpos : 0 < F.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hF
    by_cases hosc : oscillationBound lo hi = 0
    · have hlohi : lo = hi := by
        have : hi - lo = 0 := Int.natAbs_eq_zero.mp hosc
        omega
      have hg : g = fun _ ↦ lo := by
        funext x
        exact le_antisymm ((hbound x).2.trans_eq hlohi.symm) (hbound x).1
      rw [hg] at hconv ⊢
      funext x
      have hcard := card_dilate (F := F) hp.pos
      simpa [tileConv, nsmul_eq_mul, hcard] using congrFun hconv x
    · have hoscpos : 0 < oscillationBound lo hi := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hosc
      have hcardlt : F.card < p :=
        (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left F.card hoscpos).trans_lt hlarge
      funext x
      have hmod := tileConv_dilate_mod_prime F g k hp hconv hFpos hcardlt x
      have hpdiv : (p : ℤ) ∣ k - tileConv (dilate p F) g x :=
        (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub _ _ _).mp hmod
      have hlohi : lo ≤ hi := (hbound 0).1.trans (hbound 0).2
      have hkbound := tileConv_boundedBetween F g lo hi hbound 0
      rw [congrFun hconv 0] at hkbound
      have hdbound := tileConv_boundedBetween (dilate p F) g lo hi hbound x
      rw [card_dilate (F := F) hp.pos] at hdbound
      have habs : |k - tileConv (dilate p F) g x| ≤
          ((oscillationBound lo hi * F.card : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
        rw [abs_le]
        have hosc_cast : ((oscillationBound lo hi : ℕ) : ℤ) = hi - lo := by
          simp [oscillationBound, Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hlohi)]
        simp only [Nat.cast_mul, hosc_cast]
        constructor <;> nlinarith [hkbound.1, hkbound.2, hdbound.1, hdbound.2]
      have hnatAbs : Int.natAbs (k - tileConv (dilate p F) g x) < p := by
        have hle : Int.natAbs (k - tileConv (dilate p F) g x) ≤
            oscillationBound lo hi * F.card := by
          rw [← Int.natCast_natAbs] at habs
          exact_mod_cast habs
        exact hle.trans_lt hlarge
      have hzero : k - tileConv (dilate p F) g x = 0 := by
        apply Int.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_natAbs_lt_natAbs hpdiv
        simpa using hnatAbs
      omega
  · have hempty : F = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hF
    subst F
    simpa [dilate, tileConv] using hconv

name: TranslationalTilings.dilation_coprime
statement:
theorem dilation_coprime {d r : ℕ} {F : Finset (Lattice d)}
    {g : Lattice d → ℤ} {lo hi k : ℤ}
    (hbound : BoundedBetween lo hi g)
    (hconv : tileConv F g = fun _ ↦ k) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime r
      (primorial (oscillationBound lo hi * F.card))) :
    tileConv (dilate r F) g = fun _ ↦ k
proof:
:= by
  induction r using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing F with
  | h r ih =>
      by_cases hrone : r = 1
      · subst r
        simpa [dilate_one] using hconv
      · obtain ⟨p, hp, hpr⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hrone
        have hpbig : oscillationBound lo hi * F.card < p :=
          prime_factor_gt_of_coprime_primorial hcop hp hpr
        have hpconv : tileConv (dilate p F) g = fun _ ↦ k :=
          dilation_prime hbound hconv hp hpbig
        obtain ⟨s, hrs⟩ := hpr
        have hspos : 0 < s := by
          subst r
          exact Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left hr
        have hplt : 1 < p := hp.one_lt
        have hslt : s < r := by
          rw [hrs]
          exact lt_mul_of_one_lt_left hspos hplt
        have hsdiv : s ∣ r := by
          exact ⟨p, by simpa [mul_comm] using hrs⟩
        have hcop_s : Nat.Coprime s
            (primorial (oscillationBound lo hi * (dilate p F).card)) := by
          rw [card_dilate (F := F) hp.pos]
          exact hcop.coprime_dvd_left hsdiv
        have hsconv := ih s hslt (F := dilate p F) hpconv hspos hcop_s
        rw [dilate_mul] at hsconv
        rw [hrs, mul_comm]
        exact hsconv

name: TranslationalTilings.centeredMultipleInterval_card
statement:
private theorem centeredMultipleInterval_card {ell R : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) :
    (centeredMultipleInterval ell R).card = 2 * R + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [centeredMultipleInterval, Finset.card_image_iff.mpr]
  · rw [Int.card_Icc]
    omega
  · intro x _ y _ hxy
    have hellz : (ell : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hell)
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hellz hxy

name: TranslationalTilings.folnerBox_card
statement:
theorem folnerBox_card {d ell R : ℕ} (hell : 0 < ell) :
    (folnerBox (d := d) ell R).card = (2 * R + 1) ^ d
proof:
:= by
  rw [folnerBox, Fintype.card_piFinset]
  simp [centeredMultipleInterval_card hell]

name: TranslationalTilings.intCube_card
statement:
private theorem intCube_card {d R : ℕ} :
    (intCube (d := d) R).card = (2 * R + 1) ^ d
proof:
:= by
  rw [intCube, Fintype.card_piFinset]
  simp only [Int.card_Icc, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ]
  rw [Fintype.card_fin]
  congr 1
  omega

name: TranslationalTilings.mem_intCube_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_intCube_iff {d R : ℕ} {x : Lattice d} :
    x ∈ intCube (d := d) R ↔ ∀ i, -(R : ℤ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  simp [intCube]

name: TranslationalTilings.intCube_translate_boundary
statement:
private theorem intCube_translate_boundary {d : ℕ} (z : Lattice d) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ R,
      (intCube (d := d) R ∆
        (intCube (d := d) R).image (fun x ↦ x + z)).card * (2 * R + 1) ≤
          C * (intCube (d := d) R).card
proof:
:= by
  let M : ℕ := l1Norm z
  let C : ℕ := 2 * (2 * M + 1) +
    4 * M * d * (2 * M + 1) ^ (d - 1)
  refine ⟨C, fun R ↦ ?_⟩
  have hzM (i : Fin d) : Int.natAbs (z i) ≤ M := by
    dsimp [M, l1Norm]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ Nat.zero_le (Int.natAbs (z j)))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hzBounds (i : Fin d) : -(M : ℤ) ≤ z i ∧ z i ≤ M := by
    have habs : |z i| ≤ (M : ℤ) := by
      rw [← Int.natCast_natAbs]
      exact_mod_cast hzM i
    exact abs_le.mp habs
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · subst d
    have hz : z = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst z
    have hshift : (fun x : Lattice 0 ↦ x + 0) = id := by
      funext x
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hshift]
    simp
  have hdpos : 1 ≤ d := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hd
  rw [intCube_card]
  by_cases hRM : R < M
  · have hsymm :
        (intCube (d := d) R ∆
          (intCube (d := d) R).image (fun x ↦ x + z)).card ≤
            2 * (intCube (d := d) R).card := by
      calc
        _ ≤ (intCube (d := d) R ∪
            (intCube (d := d) R).image (fun x ↦ x + z)).card :=
          Finset.card_le_card Finset.symmDiff_subset_union
        _ ≤ (intCube (d := d) R).card +
            ((intCube (d := d) R).image (fun x ↦ x + z)).card :=
          Finset.card_union_le ..
        _ = 2 * (intCube (d := d) R).card := by
          rw [Finset.card_image_iff.mpr]
          · omega
          · exact fun _ _ _ _ h ↦ add_right_cancel h
    have hside : 2 * R + 1 ≤ 2 * M + 1 := by omega
    dsimp [C]
    calc
      _ ≤ (2 * (intCube (d := d) R).card) * (2 * R + 1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hsymm
      _ ≤ (2 * (2 * M + 1)) * (intCube (d := d) R).card := by
        calc
          (2 * (intCube (d := d) R).card) * (2 * R + 1) =
              2 * ((2 * R + 1) * (intCube (d := d) R).card) := by ac_rfl
          _ ≤ 2 * ((2 * M + 1) * (intCube (d := d) R).card) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2
              (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (intCube (d := d) R).card hside)
          _ = (2 * (2 * M + 1)) * (intCube (d := d) R).card := by ac_rfl
      _ ≤ (2 * (2 * M + 1) +
          4 * M * d * (2 * M + 1) ^ (d - 1)) *
          (intCube (d := d) R).card :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
      _ = _ := by rw [intCube_card]
  · have hMR : M ≤ R := Nat.le_of_not_gt hRM
    let outer := intCube (d := d) (R + M)
    let inner := intCube (d := d) (R - M)
    let box := intCube (d := d) R
    have hinnerBox : inner ⊆ box := by
      intro x hx
      rw [mem_intCube_iff] at hx ⊢
      intro i
      have := hx i
      constructor <;> omega
    have hinnerTranslate : inner ⊆ box.image (fun x ↦ x + z) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [mem_intCube_iff] at hx
      refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x - z, ?_, by abel⟩
      rw [mem_intCube_iff]
      intro i
      have hxi := hx i
      have hzi := hzBounds i
      constructor
      · change -(R : ℤ) ≤ x i - z i
        omega
      · change x i - z i ≤ (R : ℤ)
        omega
    have hboxOuter : box ⊆ outer := by
      intro x hx
      rw [mem_intCube_iff] at hx ⊢
      intro i
      have := hx i
      constructor <;> omega
    have htranslateOuter : box.image (fun x ↦ x + z) ⊆ outer := by
      rintro x hx
      obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
      rw [mem_intCube_iff] at hy ⊢
      intro i
      have hyi := hy i
      have hzi := hzBounds i
      constructor <;> simp only [Pi.add_apply] <;> omega
    have hsubset : box ∆ box.image (fun x ↦ x + z) ⊆ outer \ inner := by
      intro x hx
      rw [Finset.mem_symmDiff] at hx
      rw [Finset.mem_sdiff]
      constructor
      · rcases hx with hx | hx
        · exact hboxOuter hx.1
        · exact htranslateOuter hx.1
      · intro hxi
        rcases hx with hx | hx
        · exact hx.2 (hinnerTranslate hxi)
        · exact hx.2 (hinnerBox hxi)
    have hcardSubset : (box ∆ box.image (fun x ↦ x + z)).card ≤
        outer.card - inner.card := by
      calc
        _ ≤ (outer \ inner).card := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
        _ = outer.card - inner.card := Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset
          (hinnerBox.trans hboxOuter)
    have hpowBound :
        ((2 * (R + M) + 1) ^ d - (2 * (R - M) + 1) ^ d) *
            (2 * R + 1) ≤
          (4 * M * d * (2 * M + 1) ^ (d - 1)) * (2 * R + 1) ^ d := by
      have hsides : 2 * (R - M) + 1 ≤ 2 * (R + M) + 1 := by omega
      have hdiff : (2 * (R + M) + 1) ^ d - (2 * (R - M) + 1) ^ d ≤
          4 * M * d * (2 * (R + M) + 1) ^ (d - 1) := by
        grind [abs_pow_sub_pow_le (α := ℤ)
          (2 * (R + M) + 1) (2 * (R - M) + 1) d]
      have houterSide : 2 * (R + M) + 1 ≤ (2 * M + 1) * (2 * R + 1) := by
        nlinarith
      have hpowers := Nat.pow_le_pow_left houterSide (d - 1)
      calc
        _ ≤ (4 * M * d * (2 * (R + M) + 1) ^ (d - 1)) *
            (2 * R + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hdiff
        _ ≤ (4 * M * d * ((2 * M + 1) * (2 * R + 1)) ^ (d - 1)) *
            (2 * R + 1) := by gcongr
        _ = _ := by
          rw [mul_pow]
          calc
            4 * M * d * ((2 * M + 1) ^ (d - 1) * (2 * R + 1) ^ (d - 1)) *
                (2 * R + 1) =
                4 * M * d * (2 * M + 1) ^ (d - 1) *
                  ((2 * R + 1) ^ (d - 1) * (2 * R + 1)) := by ac_rfl
            _ = _ := by rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hdpos]
    dsimp [C]
    calc
      (box ∆ box.image (fun x ↦ x + z)).card * (2 * R + 1) ≤
          (outer.card - inner.card) * (2 * R + 1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hcardSubset
      _ = ((2 * (R + M) + 1) ^ d - (2 * (R - M) + 1) ^ d) *
          (2 * R + 1) := by simp [outer, inner, intCube_card]
      _ ≤ (4 * M * d * (2 * M + 1) ^ (d - 1)) * (2 * R + 1) ^ d := hpowBound
      _ ≤ (2 * (2 * M + 1) + 4 * M * d * (2 * M + 1) ^ (d - 1)) *
          (2 * R + 1) ^ d := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _)

name: TranslationalTilings.folnerBox_translate_symmDiff_ratio_bound
statement:
theorem folnerBox_translate_symmDiff_ratio_bound
    {d ell : ℕ} {v : Lattice d} (hv : v ∈ scalarLattice ell) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ R,
      (folnerBox (d := d) ell R ∆
        (folnerBox (d := d) ell R).image (fun x ↦ x + v)).card *
          (2 * R + 1) ≤ C * (folnerBox (d := d) ell R).card
proof:
:= by
  rcases ell.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hell
  · have hvzero : v = 0 := by
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hv
      simpa using hz.symm
    subst v
    refine ⟨0, fun R ↦ ?_⟩
    simp
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hv
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := intCube_translate_boundary z
    refine ⟨C, fun R ↦ ?_⟩
    let scale : Lattice d → Lattice d := fun x ↦ (ell : ℤ) • x
    have hscale : Function.Injective scale := by
      intro x y hxy
      funext i
      have hi := congrFun hxy i
      have hellz : (ell : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hell)
      simp only [scale, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hi
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ hellz hi
    have hbox : folnerBox (d := d) ell R = (intCube (d := d) R).image scale := by
      rw [folnerBox, centeredMultipleInterval, intCube,
        Fintype.piFinset_image (fun _ z ↦ (ell : ℤ) * z)]
      rfl
    have hvscale : v = scale z := by
      simpa [scale] using hz.symm
    have htranslate :
        (folnerBox (d := d) ell R).image (fun x ↦ x + v) =
          ((intCube (d := d) R).image (fun x ↦ x + z)).image scale := by
      rw [hbox, Finset.image_image, Finset.image_image]
      apply Finset.image_congr
      intro x _
      rw [hvscale]
      dsimp [scale]
      module
    rw [htranslate, hbox, ← Finset.image_symmDiff _ _ hscale,
      Finset.card_image_iff.mpr hscale.injOn,
      Finset.card_image_iff.mpr hscale.injOn]
    exact hC R

name: TranslationalTilings.periodic_of_backwardDiff_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have hx := congrFun hdiff (x + h)
  simp only [backwardDiff, Pi.zero_apply] at hx
  rw [show x + h - h = x by abel] at hx
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hx

name: TranslationalTilings.tileConv_dilate_apply
statement:
private theorem tileConv_dilate_apply {d r : ℕ}
    (F : Finset (Lattice d)) (g : Lattice d → ℤ) (x : Lattice d)
    (hr : 0 < r) :
    tileConv (dilate r F) g x = ∑ f ∈ F, g (x - (r : ℤ) • f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tileConv, dilate]
  rw [Finset.sum_image]
  intro a _ b _ hab
  apply_fun fun z i ↦ z i at hab
  funext i
  have hrz : (r : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hr)
  have hi := congrFun hab i
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hi
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hrz hi

name: TranslationalTilings.natAbs_sum_sub_sum_le_symmDiff_card
statement:
private theorem natAbs_sum_sub_sum_le_symmDiff_card
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (s t : Finset α) (φ : α → ℤ) (K : ℕ)
    (hφ : ∀ x, Int.natAbs (φ x) ≤ K) :
    Int.natAbs ((∑ x ∈ s, φ x) - ∑ x ∈ t, φ x) ≤
      2 * K * (s ∆ t).card
proof:
:= by
  have hdecomp :
      (∑ x ∈ s, φ x) - ∑ x ∈ t, φ x =
        (∑ x ∈ s \ t, φ x) - ∑ x ∈ t \ s, φ x := by
    have hs := Finset.sum_inter_add_sum_sdiff s t φ
    have ht := Finset.sum_inter_add_sum_sdiff t s φ
    rw [Finset.inter_comm] at ht
    omega
  rw [hdecomp]
  calc
    Int.natAbs ((∑ x ∈ s \ t, φ x) - ∑ x ∈ t \ s, φ x) ≤
        Int.natAbs (∑ x ∈ s \ t, φ x) +
          Int.natAbs (∑ x ∈ t \ s, φ x) := Int.natAbs_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ (∑ x ∈ s \ t, Int.natAbs (φ x)) +
          ∑ x ∈ t \ s, Int.natAbs (φ x) :=
      Nat.add_le_add (Int.natAbs_sum_le _ _) (Int.natAbs_sum_le _ _)
    _ ≤ (s \ t).card * K + (t \ s).card * K := by
      gcongr
      · simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using
          Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul (s \ t) (fun x ↦ Int.natAbs (φ x)) K
            (fun x _ ↦ hφ x)
      · simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using
          Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul (t \ s) (fun x ↦ Int.natAbs (φ x)) K
            (fun x _ ↦ hφ x)
    _ ≤ (s ∆ t).card * K + (s ∆ t).card * K := by
      gcongr
      · exact Finset.symmDiff_subset_sdiff (s := s) (t := t)
      · exact Finset.symmDiff_subset_sdiff' (s := s) (t := t)
    _ = 2 * K * (s ∆ t).card := by ring

name: TranslationalTilings.folnerBox_mem_scalarLattice
proof:
:= by
  rw [folnerBox, Fintype.mem_piFinset] at hx
  have hx' (i : Fin d) : ∃ z : ℤ,
      z ∈ Finset.Icc (-(R : ℤ)) R ∧ (ell : ℤ) * z = x i := by
    simpa only [centeredMultipleInterval, Finset.mem_image] using hx i
  choose z _ hzx using hx'
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  funext i
  simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using hzx i

name: TranslationalTilings.dilation_periodic
statement:
theorem dilation_periodic {d ell r : ℕ}
    {F : Finset (Lattice d)} {g : Lattice d → ℤ} {lo hi : ℤ}
    (hbound : BoundedBetween lo hi g) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hperiod : ScalarPeriodic ell (tileConv F g)) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hmod : Nat.ModEq
      (dilationModulus ell (oscillationBound lo hi) F.card) r 1) :
    tileConv (dilate r F) g = tileConv F g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hlohi : lo ≤ hi := (hbound 0).1.trans (hbound 0).2
  have hoscDiff :
      oscillationBound (lo - hi) (hi - lo) = 2 * oscillationBound lo hi := by
    have heq : (hi - lo) - (lo - hi) = 2 * (hi - lo) := by ring
    simp only [oscillationBound, heq, Int.natAbs_mul]
    norm_num
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime r
      (primorial (2 * oscillationBound lo hi * F.card)) := by
    have hcopMod : Nat.Coprime r
        (dilationModulus ell (oscillationBound lo hi) F.card) := by
      exact hmod.gcd_eq.trans (by simp)
    exact Nat.Coprime.of_dvd_right
      (Nat.dvd_lcm_right ell
        (primorial (2 * oscillationBound lo hi * F.card))) hcopMod
  have hdilatePeriod : ScalarPeriodic ell (tileConv (dilate r F) g) := by
    intro x z
    let lambda : Lattice d := (ell : ℤ) • z
    have hboundDiff :
        BoundedBetween (lo - hi) (hi - lo) (backwardDiff lambda g) := by
      intro y
      have hy := hbound y
      have hylambda := hbound (y - lambda)
      simp only [backwardDiff]
      constructor <;> omega
    have hconvDiff : tileConv F (backwardDiff lambda g) = fun _ ↦ 0 := by
      rw [← backwardDiff_tileConv]
      apply backwardDiff_eq_zero_of_periodic
      intro y
      exact hperiod y z
    have hcopDiff : Nat.Coprime r
        (primorial (oscillationBound (lo - hi) (hi - lo) * F.card)) := by
      simpa [hoscDiff, mul_assoc] using hcop
    have hdilateDiff :
        tileConv (dilate r F) (backwardDiff lambda g) = fun _ ↦ 0 :=
      dilation_coprime hboundDiff hconvDiff hr hcopDiff
    have hbackward :
        backwardDiff lambda (tileConv (dilate r F) g) = 0 := by
      rw [backwardDiff_tileConv, hdilateDiff]
      rfl
    exact periodic_of_backwardDiff_eq_zero lambda _ hbackward x
  let H : Lattice d → ℤ :=
    fun x ↦ tileConv (dilate r F) g x - tileConv F g x
  have hHperiod : ScalarPeriodic ell H := by
    intro x z
    dsimp [H]
    rw [hdilatePeriod x z, hperiod x z]
  have hmodEll : Nat.ModEq ell r 1 :=
    hmod.of_dvd (ell_dvd_dilationModulus ell (oscillationBound lo hi) F.card)
  have honele : 1 ≤ r := hr
  have helldvd : ell ∣ r - 1 :=
    (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' honele).mp hmodEll.symm
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := helldvd
  let shift : Lattice d → Lattice d :=
    fun f ↦ -(((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) • f)
  have hshiftLattice (f : Lattice d) : shift f ∈ scalarLattice ell := by
    refine ⟨-((q : ℤ) • f), ?_⟩
    change ell • (-((q : ℤ) • f)) = shift f
    dsimp [shift]
    rw [hq]
    module
  choose C hC using fun f : Lattice d ↦
    folnerBox_translate_symmDiff_ratio_bound (hshiftLattice f)
  let K : ℕ := Int.natAbs lo + Int.natAbs hi
  have hgAbs (y : Lattice d) : Int.natAbs (g y) ≤ K := by
    have habs : |g y| ≤ (K : ℤ) := by
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor
      · calc
          -(K : ℤ) ≤ -((Int.natAbs lo : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
            dsimp [K]
            apply neg_le_neg
            norm_cast
            exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
          _ = -|lo| := by rw [Int.natCast_natAbs]
          _ ≤ lo := neg_abs_le lo
          _ ≤ g y := (hbound y).1
      · calc
          g y ≤ hi := (hbound y).2
          _ ≤ |hi| := le_abs_self hi
          _ = ((Int.natAbs hi : ℕ) : ℤ) := by rw [Int.natCast_natAbs]
          _ ≤ (K : ℤ) := by
            dsimp [K]
            norm_cast
            exact Nat.le_add_left _ _
    rw [← Int.natCast_natAbs] at habs
    exact_mod_cast habs
  let total : ℕ := 2 * K * ∑ f ∈ F, C f
  funext x
  let R : ℕ := total
  let B : Finset (Lattice d) := folnerBox ell R
  have hBpos : 0 < B.card := by
    dsimp [B]
    rw [folnerBox_card hell]
    positivity
  have hHconst (b : Lattice d) (hb : b ∈ B) : H (x + b) = H x := by
    have hbLattice : b ∈ scalarLattice ell :=
      folnerBox_mem_scalarLattice (R := R) hb
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hbLattice
    have hp := hHperiod x z
    change (ell : ℤ) • z = b at hz
    rw [hz] at hp
    exact hp
  have haverageConst :
      (∑ b ∈ B, H (x + b)) = (B.card : ℤ) * H x := by
    calc
      (∑ b ∈ B, H (x + b)) = ∑ _b ∈ B, H x :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb ↦ hHconst b hb
      _ = (B.card : ℤ) * H x := by simp
  have hshiftSum (f : Lattice d) :
      (∑ b ∈ B, g (x + b - (r : ℤ) • f)) =
        ∑ b ∈ B.image (fun b ↦ b + shift f), g (x + b - f) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_image]
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      dsimp [shift]
      congr 1
      rw [Nat.cast_sub honele]
      module
    · intro a _ b _ hab
      exact add_right_cancel hab
  have hinnerBound (f : Lattice d) :
      Int.natAbs
          ((∑ b ∈ B, g (x + b - (r : ℤ) • f)) -
            ∑ b ∈ B, g (x + b - f)) * (2 * R + 1) ≤
        (2 * K * C f) * B.card := by
    rw [hshiftSum f]
    have hsum := natAbs_sum_sub_sum_le_symmDiff_card
      (B.image (fun b ↦ b + shift f)) B (fun b ↦ g (x + b - f)) K
      (fun b ↦ hgAbs (x + b - f))
    have hboundary := hC f R
    calc
      Int.natAbs
          ((∑ b ∈ B.image (fun b ↦ b + shift f), g (x + b - f)) -
            ∑ b ∈ B, g (x + b - f)) * (2 * R + 1) ≤
          (2 * K *
            (B.image (fun b ↦ b + shift f) ∆ B).card) * (2 * R + 1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hsum
      _ = 2 * K *
          ((B ∆ B.image (fun b ↦ b + shift f)).card * (2 * R + 1)) := by
        rw [symmDiff_comm]
        ring
      _ ≤ 2 * K * (C f * B.card) := by
        apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
        simpa [B] using hboundary
      _ = (2 * K * C f) * B.card := by ring
  have haverageExpand :
      (∑ b ∈ B, H (x + b)) =
        ∑ f ∈ F,
          ((∑ b ∈ B, g (x + b - (r : ℤ) • f)) -
            ∑ b ∈ B, g (x + b - f)) := by
    dsimp [H]
    simp_rw [tileConv_dilate_apply F g _ hr, tileConv]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    congr 1 <;> exact Finset.sum_comm
  have hsumBound :
      Int.natAbs (∑ b ∈ B, H (x + b)) * (2 * R + 1) ≤
        total * B.card := by
    rw [haverageExpand]
    calc
      Int.natAbs
          (∑ f ∈ F,
            ((∑ b ∈ B, g (x + b - (r : ℤ) • f)) -
              ∑ b ∈ B, g (x + b - f))) * (2 * R + 1) ≤
          (∑ f ∈ F,
            Int.natAbs
              ((∑ b ∈ B, g (x + b - (r : ℤ) • f)) -
                ∑ b ∈ B, g (x + b - f))) * (2 * R + 1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Int.natAbs_sum_le _ _)
      _ = ∑ f ∈ F,
          Int.natAbs
              ((∑ b ∈ B, g (x + b - (r : ℤ) • f)) -
                ∑ b ∈ B, g (x + b - f)) * (2 * R + 1) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      _ ≤ ∑ f ∈ F, (2 * K * C f) * B.card :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun f _ ↦ hinnerBound f
      _ = total * B.card := by
        dsimp [total]
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact (Finset.sum_mul F (fun f ↦ 2 * K * C f) B.card).symm
  rw [haverageConst] at hsumBound
  have hnatAbsCard :
      Int.natAbs ((B.card : ℤ) * H x) = B.card * Int.natAbs (H x) := by
    rw [Int.natAbs_mul]
    norm_num
  rw [hnatAbsCard] at hsumBound
  have hcancel : Int.natAbs (H x) * (2 * R + 1) ≤ total := by
    apply Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ hBpos
    calc
      B.card * (Int.natAbs (H x) * (2 * R + 1)) =
          (B.card * Int.natAbs (H x)) * (2 * R + 1) := by ac_rfl
      _ ≤ total * B.card := hsumBound
      _ = B.card * total := by ac_rfl
  have hHzero : H x = 0 := by
    by_contra hxne
    have hpos : 0 < Int.natAbs (H x) := Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hxne
    have hside := (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left (2 * R + 1) hpos).trans hcancel
    dsimp [R] at hside
    omega
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hHzero

name: TranslationalTilings.dilation_indicator_periodic
statement:
theorem dilation_indicator_periodic {d ell r : ℕ}
    {F : Finset (Lattice d)} {A : Set (Lattice d)}
    (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hperiod : ScalarPeriodic ell (tileConv F (setIndicator A)))
    (hr : 0 < r)
    (hmod : Nat.ModEq (indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card) r 1) :
    tileConv (dilate r F) (setIndicator A) =
      tileConv F (setIndicator A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hbound : BoundedBetween 0 1 (setIndicator A) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ A <;> simp [setIndicator, hx]
  apply dilation_periodic hbound hell hperiod hr
  simpa [indicatorDilationModulus, oscillationBound] using hmod

name: TranslationalTilings.structureApprox_mem_Icc
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hindicator (y : Lattice d) :
      (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((setIndicator A y : ℤ) : ℝ) ∧
        ((setIndicator A y : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases hy : y ∈ A <;> simp [setIndicator, hy]
  have hsum_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
        ((setIndicator A
          (x - ((1 + n * q : ℕ) : ℤ) • f) : ℤ) : ℝ) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun n _ ↦ (hindicator _).1
  have hsum_le :
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
        ((setIndicator A
          (x - ((1 + n * q : ℕ) : ℤ) • f) : ℤ) : ℝ)) ≤
          (N + 1 : ℕ) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (1 : ℝ) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun n _ ↦ (hindicator _).2
      _ = (N + 1 : ℕ) := by simp
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (N + 1 : ℕ) := by positivity
  constructor
  · exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hpos.le) hsum_nonneg
  · rw [structureApprox, inv_mul_le_iff₀ hpos]
    simpa using hsum_le

name: TranslationalTilings.tileConv_dilate_apply_real
statement:
private theorem tileConv_dilate_apply_real {d r : ℕ}
    (F : Finset (Lattice d)) (A : Set (Lattice d)) (x : Lattice d)
    (hr : 0 < r) :
    ((tileConv (dilate r F) (setIndicator A) x : ℤ) : ℝ) =
      ∑ f ∈ F,
        ((setIndicator A (x - (r : ℤ) • f) : ℤ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.cast_sum]
  congr 1
  simp only [tileConv, dilate]
  rw [Finset.sum_image]
  intro a _ b _ hab
  apply_fun fun z i ↦ z i at hab
  funext i
  have hrz : (r : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hr)
  have hi := congrFun hab i
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hi
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hrz hi

name: TranslationalTilings.structureApprox_sum
statement:
private theorem structureApprox_sum {d ell N : ℕ}
    {F : Finset (Lattice d)} {A : Set (Lattice d)}
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hzero : 0 ∈ F)
    (hperiod : ScalarPeriodic ell (tileConv F (setIndicator A)))
    (x : Lattice d) :
    ∑ f : ↥(F.erase 0),
        structureApprox (indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card) N f A x =
      ((tileConv F (setIndicator A) x : ℤ) : ℝ) -
        ((setIndicator A x : ℤ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q := indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card
  have hterm (n : ℕ) :
      (∑ f : ↥(F.erase 0),
        ((setIndicator A
          (x - ((1 + n * q : ℕ) : ℤ) • (f : Lattice d)) : ℤ) : ℝ)) =
        ((tileConv F (setIndicator A) x : ℤ) : ℝ) -
          ((setIndicator A x : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    let r := 1 + n * q
    have hr : 0 < r := by positivity
    have hmod : Nat.ModEq q r 1 := by
      simp [Nat.ModEq, r]
    have hdilate := dilation_indicator_periodic hell hperiod hr hmod
    have hx := congrFun hdilate x
    have hcast := congrArg (fun z : ℤ ↦ (z : ℝ)) hx
    rw [tileConv_dilate_apply_real F A x hr] at hcast
    have herase := Finset.sum_erase_add F
      (fun f ↦ ((setIndicator A (x - (r : ℤ) • f) : ℤ) : ℝ)) hzero
    have hsubtype :
        (∑ f ∈ F.erase 0,
          ((setIndicator A (x - (r : ℤ) • f) : ℤ) : ℝ)) =
        ∑ f : ↥(F.erase 0),
          ((setIndicator A (x - (r : ℤ) • (f : Lattice d)) : ℤ) : ℝ) :=
      Finset.sum_subtype (F.erase 0) (fun f ↦ Iff.rfl)
        (fun f ↦ ((setIndicator A (x - (r : ℤ) • f) : ℤ) : ℝ))
    simp only [smul_zero, sub_zero] at herase
    rw [hsubtype] at herase
    dsimp [r, q] at herase hcast ⊢
    linarith
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (N + 1 : ℕ) := by positivity
  simp only [structureApprox]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_comm]
  dsimp [q] at hterm
  have hterm' (n : ℕ) :
      (∑ f : ↥(F.erase 0),
        ((setIndicator A
          (x - ((1 + n * indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card : ℕ) : ℤ) •
            (f : Lattice d)) : ℤ) : ℝ)) =
        ((tileConv F (setIndicator A) x : ℤ) : ℝ) -
          ((setIndicator A x : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    convert hterm n using 1
    all_goals norm_num
  simp_rw [hterm']
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

name: TranslationalTilings.structureApprox_periodic_tendsto
statement:
private theorem structureApprox_periodic_tendsto {d q : ℕ}
    (f : Lattice d) (A : Set (Lattice d)) (x : Lattice d) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N ↦ structureApprox q N f A (x + (q : ℤ) • f) -
        structureApprox q N f A x)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦
    ((setIndicator A
      (x - ((1 + n * q : ℕ) : ℤ) • f) : ℤ) : ℝ)
  let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦
    ((setIndicator A
      (x + (q : ℤ) • f - ((1 + n * q : ℕ) : ℤ) • f) : ℤ) : ℝ)
  have hb_succ (n : ℕ) : b (n + 1) = a n := by
    dsimp [a, b]
    congr 2
    norm_cast
    module
  have hsumShift (N : ℕ) :
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), b n) =
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, a n) + b 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro n _
    exact hb_succ n
  have hdiff (N : ℕ) :
      structureApprox q N f A (x + (q : ℤ) • f) -
          structureApprox q N f A x =
        ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * (b 0 - a N) := by
    rw [structureApprox, structureApprox]
    change ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), b n) -
        ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), a n) = _
    rw [hsumShift, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    ring
  have habs (n : ℕ) : |a n| ≤ 1 ∧ |b n| ≤ 1 := by
    have hindicator (y : Lattice d) :
        |((setIndicator A y : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      by_cases hy : y ∈ A <;> simp [setIndicator, hy]
    constructor
    · exact hindicator _
    · exact hindicator _
  have hbound (N : ℕ) :
      |structureApprox q N f A (x + (q : ℤ) • f) -
          structureApprox q N f A x| ≤
        2 * (1 / ((N : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    rw [hdiff, abs_mul, abs_inv]
    have hdenom : |((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)| = (N : ℝ) + 1 := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      norm_num
    rw [hdenom]
    calc
      ((N : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ * |b 0 - a N| ≤
          ((N : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ * (|b 0| + |a N|) := by
        gcongr
        exact abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ ((N : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ * (1 + 1) := by
        gcongr
        · exact (habs 0).2
        · exact (habs N).1
      _ = 2 * (1 / ((N : ℝ) + 1)) := by ring
  rw [tendsto_zero_iff_abs_tendsto_zero]
  exact squeeze_zero (fun _ ↦ abs_nonneg _) hbound
    (by simpa using
      ((tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)).const_mul 2))

name: TranslationalTilings.exists_structureDecomposition
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q := indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card
  let X := ∀ _f : ↥(F.erase 0), Lattice d → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
  have happroxMem (N : ℕ) (f : ↥(F.erase 0)) (x : Lattice d) :
      structureApprox q N (f : Lattice d) A x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    structureApprox_mem_Icc (q := q) (N := N) (f : Lattice d) A x
  let point : ℕ → X := fun N f x ↦
    ⟨structureApprox q N (f : Lattice d) A x, happroxMem N f x⟩
  let U : Ultrafilter ℕ := Ultrafilter.of Filter.atTop
  let limitPoint : X := (U.map point).lim
  let phi : ↥(F.erase 0) → Lattice d → ℝ :=
    fun f x ↦ (limitPoint f x).1
  have hpoint : Filter.Tendsto point (U : Filter ℕ) (nhds limitPoint) := by
    exact (U.map point).le_nhds_lim
  have hUle : (U : Filter ℕ) ≤ Filter.atTop := by
    dsimp [U]
    exact Ultrafilter.of_le Filter.atTop
  have hcoord (f : ↥(F.erase 0)) (x : Lattice d) :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun N ↦ structureApprox q N f A x)
        (U : Filter ℕ) (nhds (phi f x)) := by
    have hcontinuous : Continuous (fun p : X ↦ (p f x).1) :=
      continuous_subtype_val.comp
        ((continuous_apply x).comp (continuous_apply f))
    have htend := (hcontinuous.tendsto limitPoint).comp hpoint
    refine htend.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun N ↦ ?_)
    rfl
  refine ⟨{
    phi := phi
    phi_nonneg := ?_
    phi_le_one := ?_
    phi_periodic := ?_
    decomposition := ?_ }⟩
  · intro f x
    exact (limitPoint f x).property.1
  · intro f x
    exact (limitPoint f x).property.2
  · intro f x
    have hlim := (hcoord f (x + (q : ℤ) • (f : Lattice d))).sub (hcoord f x)
    have hzero := (structureApprox_periodic_tendsto
      (q := q) (f : Lattice d) A x).mono_left hUle
    have heq := tendsto_nhds_unique hlim hzero
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp heq
  · intro x
    have hsumlim : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun N ↦ ∑ f : ↥(F.erase 0), structureApprox q N f A x)
        (U : Filter ℕ) (nhds (∑ f, phi f x)) := by
      exact tendsto_finsetSum Finset.univ fun f _ ↦ hcoord f x
    have hsumEq :
        (fun N ↦ ∑ f : ↥(F.erase 0), structureApprox q N f A x) =
          fun _ ↦ ((tileConv F (setIndicator A) x : ℤ) : ℝ) -
            ((setIndicator A x : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      funext N
      dsimp [q]
      exact structureApprox_sum hell hzero hperiod x
    rw [hsumEq] at hsumlim
    have heq := tendsto_nhds_unique hsumlim tendsto_const_nhds
    linarith

name: TranslationalTilings.commensurable_refl_nonzero
statement:
private theorem commensurable_refl_nonzero {d : ℕ} (u : NonzeroLattice d) :
    Commensurable (u : Lattice d) u
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨1, 1, one_ne_zero, one_ne_zero, by simp⟩

name: TranslationalTilings.commensurable_symm
statement:
private theorem commensurable_symm {d : ℕ} {u v : Lattice d} :
    Commensurable u v → Commensurable v u
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab⟩
  exact ⟨b, a, hb, ha, hab.symm⟩

name: TranslationalTilings.commensurable_trans_nonzero
statement:
private theorem commensurable_trans_nonzero {d : ℕ}
    {u v w : Lattice d} (_hu : u ≠ 0) (_hv : v ≠ 0) (_hw : w ≠ 0)
    (huv : Commensurable u v) (hvw : Commensurable v w) :
    Commensurable u w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab⟩ := huv
  obtain ⟨c, e, hc, he, hce⟩ := hvw
  refine ⟨c * a, b * e, mul_ne_zero hc ha, mul_ne_zero hb he, ?_⟩
  calc
    (c * a) • u = c • (a • u) := by rw [mul_smul]
    _ = c • (b • v) := by rw [hab]
    _ = (c * b) • v := by rw [mul_smul]
    _ = (b * c) • v := by rw [mul_comm]
    _ = b • (c • v) := by rw [mul_smul]
    _ = b • (e • w) := by rw [hce]
    _ = (b * e) • w := by rw [mul_smul]

name: TranslationalTilings.commensurable_of_nonzero_multiple
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨1, z, one_ne_zero, hz, by simp [hu]⟩

name: TranslationalTilings.mem_tile_euclideanNorm_le_diameter
statement:
private theorem mem_tile_euclideanNorm_le_diameter {d : ℕ}
    {F : Finset (Lattice d)} (hzero : 0 ∈ F)
    {f : Lattice d} (hf : f ∈ F) :
    euclideanNorm f ≤ euclideanDiameter F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hprod : (F ×ˢ F).Nonempty :=
    ⟨(f, 0), by simp [hf, hzero]⟩
  rw [euclideanDiameter, dif_pos hprod]
  have hle := Finset.le_sup'
    (f := fun xy : Lattice d × Lattice d ↦
      euclideanNorm (xy.1 - xy.2))
    (show (f, 0) ∈ F ×ˢ F by simp [hf, hzero])
  simpa only [sub_zero] using hle

name: TranslationalTilings.exists_groupedStructureDecomposition
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hkReal : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hEindicator : ScalarPeriodic ell (setIndicator E) := by
    intro x z
    have hm := hE x z
    by_cases hx : x ∈ E
    · have hy : x + (ell : ℤ) • z ∈ E := hm.mpr hx
      rw [setIndicator, Set.indicator_of_mem hy, Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
    · have hy : x + (ell : ℤ) • z ∉ E := fun h ↦ hx (hm.mp h)
      rw [setIndicator, Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
  have hconvperiod : ScalarPeriodic ell (tileConv F (setIndicator A)) := by
    intro x z
    rw [htile, htile, hEindicator x z]
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := exists_structureDecomposition hd hell hzero hconvperiod
  have heraseCard : (F.erase 0).card = F.card - 1 :=
    Finset.card_erase_of_mem hzero
  have heraseNonempty : (F.erase 0).Nonempty := by
    apply Finset.card_pos.mp
    rw [heraseCard]
    omega
  let nz : ↥(F.erase 0) → NonzeroLattice d := fun f ↦
    ⟨(f : Lattice d), Finset.ne_of_mem_erase f.property⟩
  let classOf : ↥(F.erase 0) → DirectionClass d := fun f ↦
    Quotient.mk _ (nz f)
  let classes : Finset (DirectionClass d) := Finset.univ.image classOf
  have hclassesNonempty : classes.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := heraseNonempty
    exact ⟨classOf ⟨f, hf⟩, by simp [classes]⟩
  let classIndex : ↥(F.erase 0) → ↥classes := fun f ↦
    ⟨classOf f, by simp [classes]⟩
  let memberSet (c : ↥classes) : Finset (Lattice d) :=
    (Finset.univ.filter fun f : ↥(F.erase 0) ↦ classIndex f = c).image
      Subtype.val
  have hmemberNonempty (c : ↥classes) : (memberSet c).Nonempty := by
    have hc := c.property
    dsimp [classes] at hc
    obtain ⟨f, _, hf⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hc
    refine ⟨f.1, ?_⟩
    dsimp [memberSet]
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨f, by
      rw [Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hf⟩, rfl⟩
  have hmemberNe (c : ↥classes) (f : Lattice d) (hf : f ∈ memberSet c) :
      f ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨fsub, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hf
    exact Finset.ne_of_mem_erase fsub.property
  have hmemberComm (c : ↥classes) (u : Lattice d) (hu : u ∈ memberSet c)
      (v : Lattice d) (hv : v ∈ memberSet c) : Commensurable u v := by
    obtain ⟨usub, husub, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu
    obtain ⟨vsub, hvsub, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
    have huc : classOf usub = c.1 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val (Finset.mem_filter.mp husub).2
    have hvc : classOf vsub = c.1 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val (Finset.mem_filter.mp hvsub).2
    have hquot : classOf usub = classOf vsub := huc.trans hvc.symm
    exact Quotient.eq_iff_equiv.mp hquot
  have hcommon (c : ↥classes) :=
    exists_commonMultiple_of_pairwise_commensurable
      (hmemberNonempty c) (hmemberNe c) (hmemberComm c)
  let common (c : ↥classes) : Lattice d := Classical.choose (hcommon c)
  have hcommonSpec (c : ↥classes) :
      common c ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ f ∈ memberSet c, ∃ z : ℤ, z ≠ 0 ∧ common c = z • f) ∧
      l1Norm (common c) ≤ ∏ f ∈ memberSet c, l1Norm f ∧
      euclideanNorm (common c) ≤
        ∏ f ∈ memberSet c, euclideanNorm f :=
    Classical.choose_spec (hcommon c)
  let equivFin := Fintype.equivFin ↥classes
  let direction : Fin (Fintype.card ↥classes) → Lattice d :=
    fun j ↦ common (equivFin.symm j)
  let groupedPhi : Fin (Fintype.card ↥classes) → Lattice d → ℝ := fun j x ↦
    ∑ f ∈ Finset.univ.filter
      (fun f : ↥(F.erase 0) ↦ classIndex f = equivFin.symm j), D.phi f x
  have hgroupSum (x : Lattice d) :
      (∑ j : Fin (Fintype.card ↥classes), groupedPhi j x) =
        ∑ f : ↥(F.erase 0), D.phi f x := by
    rw [show (∑ j : Fin (Fintype.card ↥classes), groupedPhi j x) =
        ∑ c : ↥classes,
          ∑ f ∈ Finset.univ.filter
            (fun f : ↥(F.erase 0) ↦ classIndex f = c), D.phi f x by
      apply Fintype.sum_equiv equivFin.symm
      intro c
      rfl]
    simpa using Finset.sum_fiberwise
      (Finset.univ : Finset ↥(F.erase 0))
      classIndex
      (fun f ↦ D.phi f x)
  have hsumLe (x : Lattice d) : ∑ j, groupedPhi j x ≤ k := by
    rw [hgroupSum]
    have hdecomp := D.decomposition x
    rw [htile x] at hdecomp
    simp only [Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast] at hdecomp
    have hA0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((setIndicator A x : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      by_cases hx : x ∈ A <;> simp [setIndicator, hx]
    have hE1 : ((setIndicator E x : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
      by_cases hx : x ∈ E <;> simp [setIndicator, hx]
    nlinarith [hkReal]
  refine ⟨{
    numberOfDirections := Fintype.card ↥classes
    number_pos := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨⟨_, hclassesNonempty.choose_spec⟩⟩
    number_le := by
      rw [Fintype.card_coe]
      calc
        classes.card ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset ↥(F.erase 0)).card :=
          Finset.card_image_le
        _ = (F.erase 0).card := by simp
        _ = F.card - 1 := heraseCard
    direction := direction
    direction_ne_zero := fun j ↦ (hcommonSpec (equivFin.symm j)).1
    pairwise_incommensurable := ?_
    phi := groupedPhi
    phi_nonneg := ?_
    phi_le_level := ?_
    phi_periodic := ?_
    decomposition := ?_
    sum_phi_le := hsumLe
    direction_from_tile := ?_
    product_direction_l1_bound := ?_
    product_direction_euclidean_bound := ?_ }⟩
  · intro i j hij hcomm
    let ci := equivFin.symm i
    let cj := equivFin.symm j
    obtain ⟨fi, hfi⟩ := hmemberNonempty ci
    obtain ⟨fj, hfj⟩ := hmemberNonempty cj
    obtain ⟨zi, hzi, hi⟩ := (hcommonSpec ci).2.1 fi hfi
    obtain ⟨zj, hzj, hj⟩ := (hcommonSpec cj).2.1 fj hfj
    have hcfi : Commensurable (common ci) fi :=
      commensurable_of_nonzero_multiple hzi hi
    have hcfj : Commensurable (common cj) fj :=
      commensurable_of_nonzero_multiple hzj hj
    have hfiCommonj : Commensurable fi (common cj) :=
      commensurable_trans_nonzero (hmemberNe ci fi hfi)
        (hcommonSpec ci).1 (hcommonSpec cj).1
        (commensurable_symm hcfi) hcomm
    have hfifj : Commensurable fi fj :=
      commensurable_trans_nonzero (hmemberNe ci fi hfi)
        (hcommonSpec cj).1 (hmemberNe cj fj hfj) hfiCommonj hcfj
    obtain ⟨fisub, hfisub, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hfi
    obtain ⟨fjsub, hfjsub, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hfj
    have hclass : classOf fisub = classOf fjsub :=
      Quotient.sound hfifj
    have hci : classOf fisub = ci.1 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val (Finset.mem_filter.mp hfisub).2
    have hcj : classOf fjsub = cj.1 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val (Finset.mem_filter.mp hfjsub).2
    have hcicj : ci = cj := Subtype.ext (hci ▸ hcj ▸ hclass)
    exact hij (equivFin.symm.injective hcicj)
  · intro j x
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun f _ ↦ D.phi_nonneg f x
  · intro j x
    calc
      groupedPhi j x ≤ ∑ f : ↥(F.erase 0), D.phi f x := by
        dsimp [groupedPhi]
        exact Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg fun f ↦ D.phi_nonneg f x
      _ = ∑ j, groupedPhi j x := (hgroupSum x).symm
      _ ≤ k := hsumLe x
  · intro j x
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro f hf
    let c := equivFin.symm j
    have hfclassIndex : classIndex f = c := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hf).2
    have hfclass : classOf f = c.1 := congrArg Subtype.val hfclassIndex
    have hfmem : (f : Lattice d) ∈ memberSet c := by
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨f, by simp [hfclassIndex], rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨z, _, hz⟩ := (hcommonSpec c).2.1 f hfmem
    have hp := (D.phi_periodic f).zsmul z
    have hper : z • ((indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card : ℤ) •
        (f : Lattice d)) =
        (indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card : ℤ) • common c := by
      rw [hz]
      module
    change D.phi f
      (x + (indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card : ℤ) • common c) = D.phi f x
    rw [← hper]
    exact hp x
  · intro x
    rw [hgroupSum]
    have hD := D.decomposition x
    rw [htile x] at hD
    simpa only [Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast] using hD
  · intro j
    let c := equivFin.symm j
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hmemberNonempty c
    obtain ⟨z, _, hz⟩ := (hcommonSpec c).2.1 f hf
    refine ⟨f, ?_, hmemberNe c f hf, z, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨fsub, hfsub, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hf
      exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp fsub.property).2
    · exact hz
  · have hmemberProd (c : ↥classes) :
        (∏ f ∈ memberSet c, l1Norm f) =
          ∏ f ∈ Finset.univ.filter
            (fun f : ↥(F.erase 0) ↦ classIndex f = c),
              l1Norm (f : Lattice d) := by
      dsimp [memberSet]
      rw [Finset.prod_image]
      intro a _ b _ hab
      exact Subtype.ext hab
    have hpartition :
        (∏ c : ↥classes, ∏ f ∈ memberSet c, l1Norm f) =
          ∏ f : ↥(F.erase 0), l1Norm (f : Lattice d) := by
