      simp_rw [hmemberProd]
      simpa using Finset.prod_fiberwise
        (Finset.univ : Finset ↥(F.erase 0))
        classIndex
        (fun f ↦ l1Norm (f : Lattice d))
    rw [show (∏ j : Fin (Fintype.card ↥classes), l1Norm (direction j)) =
        ∏ c : ↥classes, l1Norm (common c) by
      exact Fintype.prod_equiv equivFin.symm _ _ fun _ ↦ rfl]
    calc
      (∏ c : ↥classes, l1Norm (common c)) ≤
          ∏ c : ↥classes, ∏ f ∈ memberSet c, l1Norm f :=
        Finset.prod_le_prod' fun c _ ↦ (hcommonSpec c).2.2.1
      _ = ∏ f : ↥(F.erase 0), l1Norm (f : Lattice d) := hpartition
      _ ≤ ∏ _f : ↥(F.erase 0), l1Diameter F :=
        Finset.prod_le_prod' fun f _ ↦
          mem_tile_norm_le_diameter hzero (Finset.mem_erase.mp f.property).2
      _ = l1Diameter F ^ (F.card - 1) := by
        simp [heraseCard]
  · have hmemberProd (c : ↥classes) :
        (∏ f ∈ memberSet c, euclideanNorm f) =
          ∏ f ∈ Finset.univ.filter
            (fun f : ↥(F.erase 0) ↦ classIndex f = c),
              euclideanNorm (f : Lattice d) := by
      dsimp [memberSet]
      rw [Finset.prod_image]
      intro a _ b _ hab
      exact Subtype.ext hab
    have hpartition :
        (∏ c : ↥classes, ∏ f ∈ memberSet c, euclideanNorm f) =
          ∏ f : ↥(F.erase 0), euclideanNorm (f : Lattice d) := by
      simp_rw [hmemberProd]
      simpa using Finset.prod_fiberwise
        (Finset.univ : Finset ↥(F.erase 0))
        classIndex
        (fun f ↦ euclideanNorm (f : Lattice d))
    rw [show (∏ j : Fin (Fintype.card ↥classes), euclideanNorm (direction j)) =
        ∏ c : ↥classes, euclideanNorm (common c) by
      exact Fintype.prod_equiv equivFin.symm _ _ fun _ ↦ rfl]
    calc
      (∏ c : ↥classes, euclideanNorm (common c)) ≤
          ∏ c : ↥classes, ∏ f ∈ memberSet c, euclideanNorm f :=
        Finset.prod_le_prod
          (fun c _ ↦ norm_nonneg _)
          (fun c _ ↦ (hcommonSpec c).2.2.2)
      _ = ∏ f : ↥(F.erase 0), euclideanNorm (f : Lattice d) := hpartition
      _ ≤ ∏ _f : ↥(F.erase 0), euclideanDiameter F :=
        Finset.prod_le_prod
          (fun f _ ↦ norm_nonneg _)
          (fun f _ ↦ mem_tile_euclideanNorm_le_diameter hzero
            (Finset.mem_erase.mp f.property).2)
      _ = euclideanDiameter F ^ (F.card - 1) := by
        simp [heraseCard]

name: TranslationalTilings.grouped_q_bound
statement:
theorem grouped_q_bound {ell : ℕ} {F : Finset (Lattice d)} :
    indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card ≤ ell * 4 ^ (2 * F.card)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [indicatorDilationModulus] using
    dilationModulus_le_explicit ell 1 F.card

name: TranslationalTilings.structure_decomposition_mod_one
statement:
theorem structure_decomposition_mod_one
    {F : Finset (Lattice d)} {A E : Set (Lattice d)} {ell k : ℕ}
    (D : GroupedStructureDecomposition F A E ell k) (x : Lattice d) :
    (∑ j, ((D.phi j x) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcoe (s : Finset (Fin D.numberOfDirections)) :
      (∑ j ∈ s, ((D.phi j x) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) =
        ((∑ j ∈ s, D.phi j x : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) := by
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | @insert j s hj ih =>
        rw [Finset.sum_insert hj, Finset.sum_insert hj, ih, AddCircle.coe_add]
  change ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ, ((D.phi j x) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) = 0
  rw [hcoe]
  have hsum : ∑ j, D.phi j x =
      (k : ℝ) * ((setIndicator E x : ℤ) : ℝ) -
        ((setIndicator A x : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    linarith [D.decomposition x]
  rw [hsum]
  rw [AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff]
  refine ⟨(k : ℤ) * setIndicator E x - setIndicator A x, ?_⟩
  norm_num

name: TranslationalTilings.universal_period_one_dimensional
statement:
theorem universal_period_one_dimensional
    {F : Finset ℤ} {A : Set ℤ} {ell : ℕ}
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hzero : 0 ∈ F)
    (hperiod : Function.Periodic
      (tileConv F (setIndicator A)) (ell : ℤ)) :
    Function.Periodic (setIndicator A) (universalPeriod1D ell F : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : Lattice 1 ≃+ ℤ := AddEquiv.piUnique fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ ℤ
  let F' : Finset (Lattice 1) := F.image e.symm
  let A' : Set (Lattice 1) := e ⁻¹' A
  have hindicator (x : Lattice 1) : setIndicator A' x = setIndicator A (e x) := by
    by_cases hx : e x ∈ A <;> simp [setIndicator, A', hx]
  have hconv (x : Lattice 1) :
      tileConv F' (setIndicator A') x = tileConv F (setIndicator A) (e x) := by
    simp only [tileConv, F']
    rw [Finset.sum_image]
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro f _
      rw [hindicator]
      congr 1
    · exact fun _ _ _ _ h ↦ e.symm.injective h
  have hzero' : 0 ∈ F' := by
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨0, hzero, by simp⟩
  have hconvperiod : ScalarPeriodic ell (tileConv F' (setIndicator A')) := by
    intro x z
    rw [hconv, hconv]
    have hp := hperiod.zsmul (e z)
    rw [show e (x + (ell : ℤ) • z) =
        e x + (e z) • (ell : ℤ) by
      rw [map_add, map_zsmul]
      simp [mul_comm]]
    exact hp (e x)
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := exists_structureDecomposition (d := 1)
    Nat.zero_lt_one hell hzero' hconvperiod
  let q := indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card
  let n := (F.erase 0).lcm Int.natAbs
  let P := universalPeriod1D ell F
  have hcard : F'.card = F.card := by
    dsimp [F']
    exact Finset.card_image_iff.mpr e.symm.injective.injOn
  have hqF' : indicatorDilationModulus ell F'.card = q := by
    rw [hcard]
  have hdecomp (x : ℤ) :
      ((setIndicator A x : ℤ) : ℝ) =
        ((tileConv F (setIndicator A) x : ℤ) : ℝ) -
          ∑ f : ↥(F'.erase 0), D.phi f (e.symm x) := by
    have hD := D.decomposition (e.symm x)
    rw [hindicator, hconv] at hD
    simpa using hD
  have hP : P = q * n := by
    rfl
  have hellP : ell ∣ P := by
    rw [hP]
    exact (ell_dvd_dilationModulus ell 1 F.card).trans (dvd_mul_right q n)
  have hconvP : Function.Periodic (tileConv F (setIndicator A)) (P : ℤ) := by
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hellP
    have hp := hperiod.zsmul (t : ℤ)
    have hperiodEq : (P : ℤ) = (t : ℤ) • (ell : ℤ) := by
      rw [ht]
      simp [mul_comm]
    rw [hperiodEq]
    exact hp
  have hphiP (f' : ↥(F'.erase 0)) :
      Function.Periodic (fun x : ℤ ↦ D.phi f' (e.symm x)) (P : ℤ) := by
    have hf'F' : (f' : Lattice 1) ∈ F' := (Finset.mem_erase.mp f'.property).2
    obtain ⟨f, hfF, hff'⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hf'F'
    have hfne : f ≠ 0 := by
      intro hfzero
      subst f
      exact Finset.ne_of_mem_erase f'.property (by simpa using hff'.symm)
    have hfErase : f ∈ F.erase 0 := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hfne, hfF⟩
    have hfdvdNat : Int.natAbs f ∣ n := by
      exact Finset.dvd_lcm hfErase
    have hfdvdInt : f ∣ (n : ℤ) := by
      rw [← Int.natAbs_dvd]
      exact_mod_cast hfdvdNat
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hfdvdInt
    have hperiodF := (D.phi_periodic f').zsmul z
    have hvec : e.symm (P : ℤ) =
        z • ((indicatorDilationModulus ell F'.card : ℤ) •
          (f' : Lattice 1)) := by
      have hPz : (P : ℤ) = (q : ℤ) * (n : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hP
      have heff : e (f' : Lattice 1) = f := by
        rw [← hff']
        simp
      apply e.injective
      simp only [e.apply_symm_apply, map_zsmul]
      rw [hPz, hz, hqF', heff]
      ring
    intro x
    change D.phi f' (e.symm (x + (P : ℤ))) = D.phi f' (e.symm x)
    rw [e.symm.map_add, hvec]
    exact hperiodF (e.symm x)
  have hsumP : Function.Periodic
      (fun x : ℤ ↦ ∑ f : ↥(F'.erase 0), D.phi f (e.symm x)) (P : ℤ) := by
    intro x
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro f _
    exact hphiP f x
  intro x
  have hleft := hdecomp (x + P)
  have hright := hdecomp x
  rw [hconvP x] at hleft
  have hsumx := hsumP x
  change (∑ f : ↥(F'.erase 0), D.phi f (e.symm (x + P))) =
    ∑ f : ↥(F'.erase 0), D.phi f (e.symm x) at hsumx
  rw [hsumx] at hleft
  change setIndicator A (x + (P : ℤ)) = setIndicator A x
  have hcastEq :
      ((setIndicator A (x + (P : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℝ) =
        ((setIndicator A x : ℤ) : ℝ) := by linarith
  exact_mod_cast hcastEq

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.translationProduct_translate
statement:
theorem translationProduct_translate
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (P : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))) (gamma : ZMod p) :
    polynomialTranslate (translationProduct P) gamma = translationProduct P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [polynomialTranslate, translationProduct]
  change (Polynomial.compRingHom (X + C (C gamma)))
      (∏ beta : ZMod p, polynomialTranslate P beta) = _
  rw [map_prod]
  let e : ZMod p ≃ ZMod p := Equiv.addRight gamma
  calc
    ∏ beta : ZMod p,
        (polynomialTranslate P beta).comp (X + C (C gamma)) =
        ∏ beta : ZMod p, polynomialTranslate P (e beta) := by
          apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
          intro beta _
          unfold polynomialTranslate
          rw [Polynomial.comp_assoc]
          congr 1
          simp [e]
          ring
    _ = ∏ beta : ZMod p, polynomialTranslate P beta := e.prod_comp _

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.prime_dvd_natDegree_of_translate_one
statement:
private theorem prime_dvd_natDegree_of_translate_one
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    {F : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))} (hFpos : 0 < F.natDegree)
    (hinv : F.comp (X + C (C (1 : ZMod p))) = F) :
    p ∣ F.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  let m := F.natDegree
  have hm : m = F.natDegree := rfl
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by simpa [m] using hFpos
  have hc := congrArg (fun Q : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p)) ↦ Q.coeff (m - 1)) hinv
  rw [← Polynomial.taylor_apply] at hc
  rw [Polynomial.taylor_coeff] at hc
  have hderiv :
      (F.hasseDeriv (m - 1)).natDegree < 2 := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (Polynomial.natDegree_hasseDeriv_le F (m - 1)) ?_
    rw [hm]
    omega
  rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range' hderiv] at hc
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add, pow_zero, mul_one,
    pow_one, Polynomial.hasseDeriv_coeff] at hc
  have hchoose : m.choose (m - 1) = m := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hmpos.ne'
    rw [hk]
    simp
  have hone : 1 + (m - 1) = m := by omega
  rw [Nat.choose_self, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, hone, hchoose, hm,
    Polynomial.coeff_natDegree] at hc
  simp only [map_one, mul_one] at hc
  have hcast : (m : Polynomial (ZMod p)) = 0 := by
    have hlc : F.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr
      (Polynomial.ne_zero_of_natDegree_gt hFpos)
    apply (mul_eq_zero.mp ?_).resolve_right hlc
    linear_combination hc
  exact (CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (Polynomial (ZMod p)) p m).mp hcast

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.frobeniusVariable_translate
statement:
private theorem frobeniusVariable_translate
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (beta : ZMod p) :
    (X ^ p - X : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))).comp
        (X + C (C beta)) = X ^ p - X
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.sub_comp, Polynomial.X_pow_comp, Polynomial.X_comp]
  rw [add_pow_char]
  rw [← map_pow, ← map_pow, ZMod.pow_card]
  ring

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.exists_comp_frobeniusVariable_of_invariant
statement:
private theorem exists_comp_frobeniusVariable_of_invariant
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (F : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p)))
    (hinv : ∀ beta : ZMod p, F.comp (X + C (C beta)) = F) :
    ∃ Q : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p)),
      F = Q.comp (X ^ p - X) ∧ Q.natDegree * p ≤ F.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hm : F.natDegree using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing F with
  | h n ih =>
      by_cases hF : F = 0
      · subst F
        exact ⟨0, by simp, by simp⟩
      by_cases hn : n = 0
      · have hFnat : F.natDegree = 0 := hm.trans hn
        refine ⟨C (F.coeff 0), ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Polynomial.C_comp]
          exact Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hFnat
        · simp [hn]
      have hnpos : 0 < n := by
        exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
      have hpdvd : p ∣ n := by
        rw [← hm]
        apply prime_dvd_natDegree_of_translate_one
          (by simpa [hm] using hnpos)
        simpa using hinv 1
      rcases hpdvd with ⟨a, ha⟩
      have hp0 : 0 < p := (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos
      have hWmonic : (X ^ p - X : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))).Monic := by
        apply Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub
        simpa using (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt
      have hWdeg : (X ^ p - X : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))).natDegree = p := by
        rw [Polynomial.natDegree_sub_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt, Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow]
        simpa using (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt
      let G := F - C F.leadingCoeff * (X ^ p - X) ^ a
      have htermne : C F.leadingCoeff *
          (X ^ p - X : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))) ^ a ≠ 0 := by
        exact mul_ne_zero (Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hF))
          (hWmonic.pow a).ne_zero
      have htermdeg : (C F.leadingCoeff *
          (X ^ p - X : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))) ^ a).degree = F.degree := by
        rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree htermne, Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hF,
          Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hF),
          hWmonic.natDegree_pow, hWdeg, hm, ha, Nat.mul_comm]
      have htermlc : (C F.leadingCoeff *
          (X ^ p - X : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))) ^ a).leadingCoeff =
          F.leadingCoeff := by
        simp [hWmonic.leadingCoeff, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_pow]
      have hGdeg : G.natDegree < n := by
        by_cases hG : G = 0
        · simp [hG, hnpos]
        · rw [← hm]
          apply (Polynomial.natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hG).mpr
          simpa [G, Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hF] using
            (Polynomial.degree_sub_lt_left htermdeg.symm hF htermlc.symm)
      have hGinv : ∀ beta : ZMod p, G.comp (X + C (C beta)) = G := by
        intro beta
        simp only [G, Polynomial.sub_comp, Polynomial.mul_comp, Polynomial.C_comp,
          Polynomial.pow_comp, hinv beta, frobeniusVariable_translate beta]
      rcases ih G.natDegree hGdeg G hGinv rfl with ⟨Q₀, hQ₀, hQ₀deg⟩
      refine ⟨Q₀ + C F.leadingCoeff * X ^ a, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Polynomial.add_comp, Polynomial.mul_comp, Polynomial.C_comp,
          Polynomial.X_pow_comp]
        rw [← hQ₀]
        dsimp [G]
        ring
      · have hQ₀lt : Q₀.natDegree < a := by
          have hlt : Q₀.natDegree * p < a * p :=
            lt_of_le_of_lt hQ₀deg (by simpa [ha, Nat.mul_comm] using hGdeg)
          exact (Nat.mul_lt_mul_right hp0).mp hlt
        have hmonomialDeg : (C F.leadingCoeff * X ^ a :
            Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))).natDegree = a := by
          rw [Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hF),
            Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow]
        calc
          (Q₀ + C F.leadingCoeff * X ^ a).natDegree * p ≤
              max Q₀.natDegree
                (C F.leadingCoeff * X ^ a :
                  Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))).natDegree * p :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_right p (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _)
          _ = a * p := by rw [hmonomialDeg, max_eq_right hQ₀lt.le]
          _ = n := (Nat.mul_comm a p).trans ha.symm

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.exists_translationProductQuotient
statement:
theorem exists_translationProductQuotient
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (P : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))) (hP : P.natDegree < p) :
    ∃ Q : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p)),
      translationProduct P =
          Q.comp (Polynomial.X ^ p - Polynomial.X) ∧
        Q.natDegree ≤ p - 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hinv : ∀ beta : ZMod p,
      (translationProduct P).comp (X + C (C beta)) = translationProduct P := by
    intro beta
    exact translationProduct_translate P beta
  rcases exists_comp_frobeniusVariable_of_invariant (translationProduct P) hinv with
    ⟨Q, hQ, hQdeg⟩
  refine ⟨Q, hQ, ?_⟩
  have hprod : (translationProduct P).natDegree ≤ p * (p - 1) := by
    rw [translationProduct]
    calc
      (∏ beta : ZMod p, polynomialTranslate P beta).natDegree ≤
          ∑ beta : ZMod p, (polynomialTranslate P beta).natDegree := by
            simpa using Polynomial.natDegree_prod_le (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod p))
              (polynomialTranslate P)
      _ = p * P.natDegree := by
        simp [polynomialTranslate, ← Polynomial.taylor_apply]
      _ ≤ p * (p - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left p (Nat.le_pred_of_lt hP)
  apply Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right _ (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos
  exact hQdeg.trans (hprod.trans_eq (Nat.mul_comm p (p - 1)))

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.translationProductQuotient_spec
statement:
theorem translationProductQuotient_spec
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (P : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))) (hP : P.natDegree < p) :
    translationProduct P =
        (translationProductQuotient P).comp
          (Polynomial.X ^ p - Polynomial.X) ∧
      (translationProductQuotient P).natDegree ≤ p - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [translationProductQuotient, dif_pos hP]
  exact Classical.choose_spec (exists_translationProductQuotient P hP)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.coeff_mul_natDegree_le_add
statement:
private theorem coeff_mul_natDegree_le_add
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (A B : Polynomial (Polynomial R)) (a b n : ℕ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A.coeff i).natDegree ≤ a)
    (hB : ∀ i, (B.coeff i).natDegree ≤ b) :
    ((A * B).coeff n).natDegree ≤ a + b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_mul]
  refine Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ ?_
  intro ij hij
  exact Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans
    (Nat.add_le_add (hA ij.1) (hB ij.2))

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.polynomialTranslate_coeff_natDegree_lt
statement:
private theorem polynomialTranslate_coeff_natDegree_lt
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (P : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))) (beta : ZMod p)
    {S : ℕ} (hS : 0 < S) (hcoeff : ∀ i, (P.coeff i).natDegree < S)
    (n : ℕ) : ((polynomialTranslate P beta).coeff n).natDegree < S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [polynomialTranslate, ← Polynomial.taylor_apply, Polynomial.taylor_coeff,
    Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply, Polynomial.eval_sum, Polynomial.sum_def]
  simp_rw [Polynomial.eval_monomial]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt
    (Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le P.support
      (fun i ↦
        ((i.choose n : Polynomial (ZMod p)) * P.coeff i) *
          (Polynomial.C beta) ^ (i - n)) ?_)
    (Nat.pred_lt hS.ne')
  intro i hi
  refine Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
  calc
    ((i.choose n : Polynomial (ZMod p)) * P.coeff i).natDegree +
          ((Polynomial.C beta) ^ (i - n)).natDegree ≤
        ((i.choose n : Polynomial (ZMod p))).natDegree +
          (P.coeff i).natDegree +
            (i - n) * (Polynomial.C beta).natDegree :=
      Nat.add_le_add Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le Polynomial.natDegree_pow_le
    _ ≤ S - 1 := by
      simpa only [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one, Polynomial.natDegree_natCast, Polynomial.natDegree_C,
        zero_add, mul_zero, Nat.add_zero] using
        Nat.le_pred_of_lt (hcoeff i)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.translationProduct_coeff_natDegree_lt
statement:
private theorem translationProduct_coeff_natDegree_lt
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (P : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p)))
    {S : ℕ} (hS : 0 < S) (hcoeff : ∀ i, (P.coeff i).natDegree < S)
    (n : ℕ) : ((translationProduct P).coeff n).natDegree < p * S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hprod (s : Finset (ZMod p)) : ∀ n,
      ((∏ beta ∈ s, polynomialTranslate P beta).coeff n).natDegree ≤
        s.card * (S - 1) := by
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
        intro n
        simp only [Finset.prod_empty, Finset.card_empty, zero_mul]
        rw [Polynomial.coeff_one]
        split <;> simp
    | @insert beta s hbeta ih =>
        intro n
        rw [Finset.prod_insert hbeta]
        refine (coeff_mul_natDegree_le_add _ _ (S - 1) (s.card * (S - 1)) n
          (fun i ↦ Nat.le_pred_of_lt
            (polynomialTranslate_coeff_natDegree_lt P beta hS hcoeff i))
          (ih)).trans ?_
        rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hbeta]
        simp only [Nat.add_mul]
        omega
  rw [translationProduct]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (hprod Finset.univ n) ?_
  rw [Finset.card_univ, ZMod.card]
  exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Nat.pred_lt hS.ne') (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.coeff_natDegree_lt_of_comp_frobeniusVariable
statement:
private theorem coeff_natDegree_lt_of_comp_frobeniusVariable
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (Q : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p)))
    {B : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B)
    (hcomp : ∀ n,
      (((Q.comp (X ^ p - X)).coeff n : Polynomial (ZMod p))).natDegree < B) :
    ∀ n, (Q.coeff n).natDegree < B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let W : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p)) := X ^ p - X
  have hp0 : 0 < p := (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos
  have hp1 : 1 < p := (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt
  have hWdeg : W.natDegree = p := by
    dsimp [W]
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_sub_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt,
      Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow]
    simpa using hp1
  have hWmonic : W.Monic := by
    dsimp [W]
    apply Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub
    simpa using hp1
  induction hm : Q.natDegree using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing Q with
  | h m ih =>
      intro n
      by_cases hQ : Q = 0
      · subst Q
        simp [hB]
      have hlc : Q.leadingCoeff.natDegree < B := by
        have hc := hcomp (Q.comp W).natDegree
        rw [Polynomial.coeff_natDegree, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_comp
          (by rw [hWdeg]; exact hp0.ne'), hWmonic.leadingCoeff, one_pow, mul_one] at hc
        exact hc
      have hstrip : ∀ r, (Q.eraseLead.coeff r).natDegree < B := by
        rcases Q.eraseLead_natDegree_lt_or_eraseLead_eq_zero with hlt | hz
        · intro r
          refine ih Q.eraseLead.natDegree (by simpa [hm] using hlt) Q.eraseLead ?_ rfl r
          intro k
          have hidentity : Q.eraseLead.comp W =
              Q.comp W - C Q.leadingCoeff * W ^ Q.natDegree := by
            apply eq_sub_of_add_eq
            simpa only [Polynomial.add_comp, Polynomial.mul_comp,
              Polynomial.C_comp, Polynomial.X_pow_comp] using
              congrArg (fun R ↦ R.comp W) Q.eraseLead_add_C_mul_X_pow
          rw [hidentity, Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul]
          refine lt_of_le_of_lt (Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _) ?_
          rw [max_lt_iff]
          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · simpa [W] using hcomp k
          · refine lt_of_le_of_lt Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le ?_
            have hmap : W ^ Q.natDegree =
                ((X ^ p - X : Polynomial (ZMod p)) ^ Q.natDegree).map C := by
              simp [W]
            rw [hmap, Polynomial.coeff_map, Polynomial.natDegree_C]
            simpa using hlc
        · intro r
          rw [hz]
          simp [hB]
      rw [← Q.eraseLead_add_C_mul_X_pow, Polynomial.coeff_add]
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _) ?_
      rw [max_lt_iff]
      refine ⟨hstrip n, ?_⟩
      rw [Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
      split
      · simpa using hlc
      · simp [hB]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.translationProductQuotient_coeff_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem translationProductQuotient_coeff_natDegree_lt
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (P : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))) (hP : P.natDegree < p)
    {S : ℕ} (hS : 0 < S)
    (hcoeff : ∀ i, (P.coeff i).natDegree < S) (a : ℕ) :
    ((translationProductQuotient P).coeff a).natDegree < p * S
proof:
:= by
  apply coeff_natDegree_lt_of_comp_frobeniusVariable
    (translationProductQuotient P) (Nat.mul_pos (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos hS)
  intro n
  rw [← (translationProductQuotient_spec P hP).1]
  exact translationProduct_coeff_natDegree_lt P hS hcoeff n

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.zeroBlockNormPolynomial_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem zeroBlockNormPolynomial_natDegree_lt
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (u : ℕ)
    (P : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p)))
    (hP : P.natDegree < p) {S : ℕ} (hS : 0 < S)
    (hcoeff : ∀ i, (P.coeff i).natDegree < S) :
    (zeroBlockNormPolynomial f u P).natDegree <
      p * S + f.natDegree * p ^ u * (p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Q := translationProductQuotient P
  let V := C (f.coeff 0) - f ^ (p ^ u)
  have hT : 0 < p * S + f.natDegree * p ^ u * (p - 1) :=
    Nat.add_pos_left (Nat.mul_pos (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos hS) _
  have hV : V.natDegree ≤ f.natDegree * p ^ u := by
    dsimp [V]
    refine (Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_C, Polynomial.natDegree_pow]
    simp [Nat.mul_comm]
  rw [zeroBlockNormPolynomial, Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt
    (Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
      (Finset.range (Q.natDegree + 1))
      (fun i ↦ Q.coeff i * V ^ i) ?_)
    (Nat.pred_lt hT.ne')
  intro i hi
  apply Nat.le_pred_of_lt
  have hiQ : i ≤ Q.natDegree := by
    simpa [Finset.mem_range] using Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  have hiP : i ≤ p - 1 := hiQ.trans (translationProductQuotient_spec P hP).2
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le ?_
  refine lt_of_lt_of_le
    (Nat.add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le
      (translationProductQuotient_coeff_natDegree_lt P hP hS hcoeff i)
      Polynomial.natDegree_pow_le) ?_
  calc
    p * S + i * V.natDegree
        ≤ p * S + i * (f.natDegree * p ^ u) :=
      Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_left i hV) _
    _ ≤ p * S + (p - 1) * (f.natDegree * p ^ u) :=
      Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (f.natDegree * p ^ u) hiP) _
    _ = p * S + f.natDegree * p ^ u * (p - 1) := by ac_rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.lowerTracePolynomial_frobenius_sub_self
statement:
private theorem lowerTracePolynomial_frobenius_sub_self
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (u : ℕ) :
    (lowerTracePolynomial f u) ^ p - lowerTracePolynomial f u =
      f ^ (p ^ u) - f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction u with
  | zero => simp [lowerTracePolynomial, (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero]
  | succ u ih =>
      have ih' :
          (∑ t ∈ Finset.range u, f ^ (p ^ t)) ^ p -
              (∑ t ∈ Finset.range u, f ^ (p ^ t)) =
            f ^ (p ^ u) - f := by
        simpa [lowerTracePolynomial] using ih
      have hpow : (f ^ (p ^ u)) ^ p = f ^ (p ^ (u + 1)) := by
        rw [← pow_mul, pow_succ]
      rw [lowerTracePolynomial, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      rw [add_pow_char, hpow]
      calc
        (∑ t ∈ Finset.range u, f ^ p ^ t) ^ p + f ^ p ^ (u + 1) -
              ((∑ t ∈ Finset.range u, f ^ p ^ t) + f ^ p ^ u) =
            ((∑ t ∈ Finset.range u, f ^ p ^ t) ^ p -
              (∑ t ∈ Finset.range u, f ^ p ^ t)) +
                (f ^ p ^ (u + 1) - f ^ p ^ u) := by ring
        _ = f ^ p ^ (u + 1) - f := by rw [ih']; ring

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.upperTracePolynomial_frobenius_sub_self
statement:
private theorem upperTracePolynomial_frobenius_sub_self
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) {n u : ℕ} (hu : u ≤ n) :
    (upperTracePolynomial f n u) ^ p - upperTracePolynomial f n u =
      f ^ (p ^ n) - f ^ (p ^ u)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hupper : upperTracePolynomial f n u =
      lowerTracePolynomial f n - lowerTracePolynomial f u := by
    rw [upperTracePolynomial, lowerTracePolynomial, lowerTracePolynomial,
      Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub _ hu]
  rw [hupper, sub_pow_char]
  calc
    lowerTracePolynomial f n ^ p - lowerTracePolynomial f u ^ p -
          (lowerTracePolynomial f n - lowerTracePolynomial f u) =
        (lowerTracePolynomial f n ^ p - lowerTracePolynomial f n) -
          (lowerTracePolynomial f u ^ p - lowerTracePolynomial f u) := by ring
    _ = f ^ p ^ n - f ^ p ^ u := by
      rw [lowerTracePolynomial_frobenius_sub_self,
        lowerTracePolynomial_frobenius_sub_self]
      ring

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.X_pow_dvd_zeroBlockNormPolynomial
statement:
theorem X_pow_dvd_zeroBlockNormPolynomial
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (n u : ℕ)
    (P : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p)))
    (hP : P.natDegree < p) (hu : u ≤ n)
    (hdiv : Polynomial.X ^ (p ^ n) ∣
      P.eval (upperTracePolynomial f n u)) :
    Polynomial.X ^ (p ^ n) ∣ zeroBlockNormPolynomial f u P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Phi := upperTracePolynomial f n u
  let V := C (f.coeff 0) - f ^ (p ^ u)
  let Q := translationProductQuotient P
  have hprod : X ^ (p ^ n) ∣ (translationProduct P).eval Phi := by
    apply hdiv.trans
    rw [translationProduct, Polynomial.eval_prod]
    simpa [polynomialTranslate, Polynomial.eval_comp] using
      (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem
        (fun beta : ZMod p ↦ (polynomialTranslate P beta).eval Phi)
        (Finset.mem_univ (0 : ZMod p)))
  have hQW : X ^ (p ^ n) ∣ Q.eval (Phi ^ p - Phi) := by
    have hevalW : (X ^ p - X : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))).eval Phi =
        Phi ^ p - Phi := by simp
    rw [← hevalW, ← Polynomial.eval_comp,
      ← (translationProductQuotient_spec P hP).1]
    simpa [Phi] using hprod
  have hX : X ∣ f - C (f.coeff 0) := by
    rw [Polynomial.X_dvd_iff, Polynomial.coeff_sub]
    simp
  have hfpow : X ^ (p ^ n) ∣ f ^ (p ^ n) - C (f.coeff 0) := by
    have hpow := pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd hX (p ^ n)
    simpa [sub_pow_char_pow, ← Polynomial.C_pow, ZMod.pow_card_pow] using hpow
  have harg : X ^ (p ^ n) ∣ (Phi ^ p - Phi) - V := by
    have hid : (Phi ^ p - Phi) - V = f ^ (p ^ n) - C (f.coeff 0) := by
      dsimp [Phi, V]
      rw [upperTracePolynomial_frobenius_sub_self f hu]
      ring
    rwa [hid]
  have hdiff : X ^ (p ^ n) ∣
      Q.eval (Phi ^ p - Phi) - Q.eval V :=
    harg.trans (Polynomial.sub_dvd_eval_sub (Phi ^ p - Phi) V Q)
  have := dvd_sub hQW hdiff
  simpa [zeroBlockNormPolynomial, Q, V] using this

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.zeroBlockNormPolynomial_eq_zero
statement:
theorem zeroBlockNormPolynomial_eq_zero
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (P : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p)))
    (hP : P.natDegree < p)
    (hcoeff : ∀ i, (P.coeff i).natDegree < par.S)
    (hdiv : Polynomial.X ^ (p ^ n) ∣
      P.eval (upperTracePolynomial f n par.u)) :
    zeroBlockNormPolynomial f par.u P = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_natDegree_lt
    (X_pow_dvd_zeroBlockNormPolynomial f n par.u P hP
      (by rw [par.u_eq]; exact Nat.div_le_self n 2) hdiv)
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow]
  exact (zeroBlockNormPolynomial_natDegree_lt f par.u P hP par.S_pos hcoeff).trans
    (by simpa [hdegree] using par.norm_degree_ok)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial_translate
statement:
theorem zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial_translate
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (u : ℕ) :
    zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial f u =
      (artinSchreierRatFuncPolynomial (eraseConstant f)).comp
      (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C
          (algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p))
            (lowerTracePolynomial f u)))
proof:
:= by
  have htrace :
      (Polynomial.C (algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p))
          (lowerTracePolynomial f u)) : Polynomial (RatFunc (ZMod p))) ^ p -
        Polynomial.C (algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p))
          (lowerTracePolynomial f u)) =
      Polynomial.C (algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p)) f) ^
          (p ^ u) -
        Polynomial.C (algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p)) f) := by
    simpa only [map_sub, map_pow] using
      congrArg
        (fun g : Polynomial (ZMod p) ↦
          (Polynomial.C
            (algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p)) g) :
              Polynomial (RatFunc (ZMod p))))
        (lowerTracePolynomial_frobenius_sub_self f u)
  simp only [zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial,
    artinSchreierRatFuncPolynomial, eraseConstant, Polynomial.add_comp,
    Polynomial.sub_comp, Polynomial.X_pow_comp, Polynomial.X_comp,
    Polynomial.C_comp, add_pow_char, map_sub, map_pow]
  linear_combination -htrace

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial_irreducible
statement:
theorem zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial_irreducible
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (u : ℕ)
    (hpos : 0 < f.natDegree) (hsmall : f.natDegree < p) :
    Irreducible (zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial f u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial_translate]
  let t : RatFunc (ZMod p) :=
    algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p))
      (lowerTracePolynomial f u)
  have hirr := artinSchreierRatFuncPolynomial_irreducible
    (eraseConstant f) (by simpa [eraseConstant_natDegree f hpos] using hpos)
      (by simpa [eraseConstant_natDegree f hpos] using hsmall)
  rw [Polynomial.comp_eq_aeval]
  exact hirr.map (Polynomial.algEquivAevalXAddC t).toRingEquiv.toMulEquiv

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.zeroBlockNorm_eq_zero_implies_exists_zero_factor
statement:
theorem zeroBlockNorm_eq_zero_implies_exists_zero_factor
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (u : ℕ)
    (P : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))) (hP : P.natDegree < p)
    (hnorm : zeroBlockNormPolynomial f u P = 0) :
    ∀ {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra (RatFunc (ZMod p)) L] (z : L),
      Polynomial.aeval z (zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial f u) = 0 →
      ∃ beta : ZMod p,
        zeroBlockEval P
          (z + algebraMap (RatFunc (ZMod p)) L
            (algebraMap (ZMod p) (RatFunc (ZMod p)) beta)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro L _ _ z hz
  let phi : Polynomial (ZMod p) →+* L :=
    (algebraMap (RatFunc (ZMod p)) L).comp
      (algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p)))
  let V : Polynomial (ZMod p) := C (f.coeff 0) - f ^ (p ^ u)
  let Q := translationProductQuotient P
  have hz0 : z ^ p - z + phi (f ^ (p ^ u) - C (f.coeff 0)) = 0 := by
    simpa [zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial, Polynomial.aeval_def, phi] using hz
  have hzarg : phi V = z ^ p - z := by
    dsimp [V]
    rw [map_sub]
    rw [map_sub] at hz0
    linear_combination -hz0
  have hnormL : phi (zeroBlockNormPolynomial f u P) = 0 := by
    rw [hnorm, map_zero]
  have hQzero : Q.eval₂ phi (z ^ p - z) = 0 := by
    rw [← hzarg, Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply]
    simpa [zeroBlockNormPolynomial, Q, V] using hnormL
  have hprod : (translationProduct P).eval₂ phi z = 0 := by
    rw [(translationProductQuotient_spec P hP).1,
      Polynomial.eval₂_comp]
    simpa [Q] using hQzero
  rw [translationProduct, Polynomial.eval₂_finsetProd] at hprod
  simp only [polynomialTranslate, Polynomial.eval₂_comp,
    Polynomial.eval₂_add, Polynomial.eval₂_X, Polynomial.eval₂_C,
    phi] at hprod
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff] at hprod
  rcases hprod with ⟨beta, _, hbeta⟩
  refine ⟨beta, ?_⟩
  change P.eval₂
    ((algebraMap (RatFunc (ZMod p)) L).comp
      (algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p))))
    (z + algebraMap (RatFunc (ZMod p)) L
      (algebraMap (ZMod p) (RatFunc (ZMod p)) beta)) = 0
  simpa using hbeta

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.zeroBlock_minpoly_add_primeField
statement:
theorem zeroBlock_minpoly_add_primeField
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (u : ℕ)
    (hpos : 0 < f.natDegree) (hsmall : f.natDegree < p)
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra (RatFunc (ZMod p)) L]
    (z : L)
    (hz : Polynomial.aeval z (zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial f u) = 0)
    (beta : ZMod p) :
    minpoly (RatFunc (ZMod p))
      (z + algebraMap (RatFunc (ZMod p)) L
        (algebraMap (ZMod p) (RatFunc (ZMod p)) beta)) =
      zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial f u
proof:
:= by
  let _ : CharP L p :=
    charP_of_injective_algebraMap
      (algebraMap (RatFunc (ZMod p)) L).injective p
  let b : L := algebraMap (RatFunc (ZMod p)) L
    (algebraMap (ZMod p) (RatFunc (ZMod p)) beta)
  have hb : b ^ p = b := by
    dsimp [b]
    rw [← map_pow, ← map_pow, ZMod.pow_card]
  have hy : Polynomial.aeval (z + b)
      (zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial f u) = 0 := by
    simp only [zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial, Polynomial.aeval_def,
      Polynomial.eval₂_add, Polynomial.eval₂_sub, Polynomial.eval₂_pow,
      Polynomial.eval₂_X, Polynomial.eval₂_C] at hz ⊢
    rw [show (z + b) ^ p = z ^ p + b ^ p by exact add_pow_char z b p, hb]
    linear_combination hz
  have hmonic : (zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial f u).Monic := by
    let c := algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p))
      (f ^ (p ^ u) - C (f.coeff 0))
    have heq : zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial f u =
        artinSchreierPolynomial p (-c) := by
      simp [zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial, artinSchreierPolynomial, c]
      ring
    rw [heq]
    exact artinSchreierPolynomial_monic (-c)
  exact (minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic
    (zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial_irreducible f u hpos hsmall)
    hy hmonic).symm

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.eq_zero_of_zeroBlockEval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_zeroBlockEval_eq_zero
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (u : ℕ)
    (hpos : 0 < f.natDegree) (hsmall : f.natDegree < p)
    (P : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))) (hP : P.natDegree < p)
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra (RatFunc (ZMod p)) L]
    (z : L)
    (hz : Polynomial.aeval z (zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial f u) = 0)
    (beta : ZMod p)
    (hzero : zeroBlockEval P
      (z + algebraMap (RatFunc (ZMod p)) L
        (algebraMap (ZMod p) (RatFunc (ZMod p)) beta)) = 0) :
    P = 0
proof:
:= by
  let K := RatFunc (ZMod p)
  let amap : Polynomial (ZMod p) →+* K :=
    algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) K
  have hinj : Function.Injective amap := by
    simpa [amap, K] using RatFunc.algebraMap_injective (ZMod p)
  let y : L := z + algebraMap K L (algebraMap (ZMod p) K beta)
  let PK : Polynomial K := P.map amap
  have hroot : Polynomial.aeval y PK = 0 := by
    simpa [y, PK, amap, K, Polynomial.aeval_def, zeroBlockEval,
      Polynomial.eval₂_map] using hzero
  have hdvd : zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial f u ∣ PK := by
    have hmin := minpoly.dvd K y hroot
    rw [zeroBlock_minpoly_add_primeField f u hpos hsmall z hz beta] at hmin
    exact hmin
  have hPK : PK = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hle := Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd hdvd hne
    have hzeroDegree :
        (zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial f u).natDegree = p := by
      let c := algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p))
        (f ^ (p ^ u) - C (f.coeff 0))
      have heq : zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial f u =
          artinSchreierPolynomial p (-c) := by
        simp [zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial, artinSchreierPolynomial, c]
        ring
      rw [heq, artinSchreierPolynomial_natDegree]
    have hmapDegree : PK.natDegree = P.natDegree := by
      exact Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective hinj P
    rw [hzeroDegree, hmapDegree] at hle
    exact (not_le_of_gt hP) hle
  apply (Polynomial.map_eq_zero_iff hinj).mp
  exact hPK

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.auxiliaryBlock_natDegree_lt
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt
    (Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le Finset.univ
      (fun i : Fin p ↦ Polynomial.monomial i.1 (e.coeff i j)) ?_)
    (Nat.pred_lt (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero)
  intro i hi
  exact (Polynomial.natDegree_monomial_le _).trans (Nat.le_pred_of_lt i.2)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.auxiliaryBlock_coeff_natDegree_lt
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [auxiliaryBlock, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt
    (Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le Finset.univ
      (fun q : Fin p ↦ (Polynomial.monomial q.1 (e.coeff q j)).coeff i) ?_)
    (Nat.pred_lt par.S_pos.ne')
  intro q hq
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
  split
  · exact Nat.le_pred_of_lt (e.degree_lt q j)
  · simp

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial_eq_sum_blocks
statement:
private theorem additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial_eq_sum_blocks
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p))
    (e : AdditiveAuxiliaryCoefficients par (ZMod p)) :
    additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial par f e =
      ∑ j : Fin (par.K + 1),
        (auxiliaryBlock e j).eval (upperTracePolynomial f n par.u) *
          X ^ (p ^ n * j.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [auxiliaryBlock, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_monomial, Finset.sum_mul]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.X_pow_dvd_auxiliaryBlock_eval_of_previous_eq_zero
statement:
theorem X_pow_dvd_auxiliaryBlock_eval_of_previous_eq_zero
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p))
    (e : AdditiveAuxiliaryCoefficients par (ZMod p))
    (haux : additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial par f e = 0)
    (j : Fin (par.K + 1))
    (hprev : ∀ q : Fin (par.K + 1), q.1 < j.1 →
      auxiliaryBlock e q = 0) :
    Polynomial.X ^ (p ^ n) ∣
      (auxiliaryBlock e j).eval (upperTracePolynomial f n par.u)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let N := p ^ n
  let A := fun q : Fin (par.K + 1) ↦
    (auxiliaryBlock e q).eval (upperTracePolynomial f n par.u)
  let T := fun q : Fin (par.K + 1) ↦ A q * X ^ (N * q.1)
  have hsum : ∑ q : Fin (par.K + 1), T q = 0 := by
    rw [← additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial_eq_sum_blocks par f e]
    simpa [T, A, N] using haux
  have hother (q : Fin (par.K + 1)) (hqj : q ≠ j) :
      X ^ (N * (j.1 + 1)) ∣ T q := by
    by_cases hq : q.1 < j.1
    · have hz := hprev q hq
      simp [T, A, hz]
    · have hjq : j.1 + 1 ≤ q.1 := by
        have hne : q.1 ≠ j.1 := fun h ↦ hqj (Fin.ext h)
        omega
      have hpow : (X : Polynomial (ZMod p)) ^ (N * (j.1 + 1)) ∣
          X ^ (N * q.1) :=
        pow_dvd_pow (X : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (Nat.mul_le_mul_left N hjq)
      exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hpow (A q)
  have hrest : X ^ (N * (j.1 + 1)) ∣
      ∑ q ∈ (Finset.univ.erase j), T q := by
    apply Finset.dvd_sum
    intro q hq
    exact hother q (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hq)
  have hterm : X ^ (N * (j.1 + 1)) ∣ T j := by
    have hsplit := Finset.sum_erase_add
      (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (par.K + 1))))
      (f := T) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    have heq : T j = -(∑ q ∈ (Finset.univ.erase j), T q) := by
      rw [hsum] at hsplit
      linear_combination hsplit
    rw [heq]
    exact dvd_neg.mpr hrest
  have hcancel :
      X ^ N * X ^ (N * j.1) ∣ A j * X ^ (N * j.1) := by
    simpa [T, Nat.mul_add, pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hterm
  exact (mul_dvd_mul_iff_right
    (pow_ne_zero (N * j.1) (Polynomial.X_ne_zero :
      (X : Polynomial (ZMod p)) ≠ 0))).mp hcancel

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial_natDegree
statement:
private theorem zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial_natDegree
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (u : ℕ) :
    (zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial f u).natDegree = p
proof:
:= by
  let c := algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p))
    (f ^ (p ^ u) - C (f.coeff 0))
  have heq : zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial f u =
      artinSchreierPolynomial p (-c) := by
    simp [zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial, artinSchreierPolynomial, c]
    ring
  rw [heq, artinSchreierPolynomial_natDegree]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.auxiliaryBlock_eq_zero_of_previous_eq_zero
statement:
theorem auxiliaryBlock_eq_zero_of_previous_eq_zero
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (hpos : 0 < d) (hsmall : d < p)
    (e : AdditiveAuxiliaryCoefficients par (ZMod p))
    (haux : additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial par f e = 0)
    (j : Fin (par.K + 1))
    (hprev : ∀ q : Fin (par.K + 1), q.1 < j.1 →
      auxiliaryBlock e q = 0) :
    auxiliaryBlock e j = 0
proof:
:= by
  let P := auxiliaryBlock e j
  have hP : P.natDegree < p := auxiliaryBlock_natDegree_lt e j
  have hcoeff : ∀ i, (P.coeff i).natDegree < par.S :=
    auxiliaryBlock_coeff_natDegree_lt e j
  have hdiv : X ^ (p ^ n) ∣ P.eval (upperTracePolynomial f n par.u) :=
    X_pow_dvd_auxiliaryBlock_eval_of_previous_eq_zero par f e haux j hprev
  have hnorm : zeroBlockNormPolynomial f par.u P = 0 :=
    zeroBlockNormPolynomial_eq_zero par f hdegree P hP hcoeff hdiv
  let G := zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial f par.u
  let E := G.SplittingField
  let z : E := Polynomial.rootOfSplits
    (Polynomial.SplittingField.splits G)
    (Polynomial.degree_ne_of_natDegree_ne (by
      rw [Polynomial.natDegree_map, zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial_natDegree]
      exact (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero))
  have hz : Polynomial.aeval z G = 0 := by
    simpa [Polynomial.aeval_def, z] using
      (Polynomial.eval_rootOfSplits (Polynomial.SplittingField.splits G)
        (Polynomial.degree_ne_of_natDegree_ne (by
          rw [Polynomial.natDegree_map,
            zeroBlockArtinSchreierPolynomial_natDegree]
          exact (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero)))
  have hex := zeroBlockNorm_eq_zero_implies_exists_zero_factor
    f par.u P hP hnorm z (by simpa [G] using hz)
  rcases hex with ⟨beta, hbeta⟩
  exact eq_zero_of_zeroBlockEval_eq_zero f par.u
    (by simpa [hdegree] using hpos) (by simpa [hdegree] using hsmall)
    P hP z (by simpa [G] using hz) beta hbeta

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.all_auxiliaryBlocks_eq_zero
statement:
theorem all_auxiliaryBlocks_eq_zero
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (hpos : 0 < d) (hsmall : d < p)
    (e : AdditiveAuxiliaryCoefficients par (ZMod p))
    (haux : additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial par f e = 0) :
    ∀ j : Fin (par.K + 1), auxiliaryBlock e j = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction hj : j.1 using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing j with
  | h m ih =>
      apply auxiliaryBlock_eq_zero_of_previous_eq_zero
        par f hdegree hpos hsmall e haux j
      intro q hq
      exact ih q.1 (by simpa [hj] using hq) q rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.auxiliaryBlock_coeff_fin
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [auxiliaryBlock, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp
  · intro q hq hqi
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, if_neg]
    exact fun hval ↦ hqi (Fin.ext hval)
  · simp

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial_ne_zero_of_blocks
statement:
theorem additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial_ne_zero_of_blocks
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (hpos : 0 < d) (hsmall : d < p)
    (e : AdditiveAuxiliaryCoefficients par (ZMod p)) (he : e.Nonzero) :
    additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial par f e ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro haux
  rcases he with ⟨i, j, hij⟩
  apply hij
  have hblock := all_auxiliaryBlocks_eq_zero
    par f hdegree hpos hsmall e haux j
  have hcoeff := congrArg
    (fun P : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p)) ↦ P.coeff i.1) hblock
  rw [auxiliaryBlock_coeff_fin] at hcoeff
  simpa using hcoeff

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial_ne_zero
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (hpos : 0 < d) (hsmall : d < p)
    (e : AdditiveAuxiliaryCoefficients par (ZMod p)) (he : e.Nonzero) :
    additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial par f e ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial_ne_zero_of_blocks
    par f hdegree hpos hsmall e he

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinSchreierPolynomial_monic
statement:
theorem artinSchreierPolynomial_monic
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (c : K) : (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).Monic
proof:
:= by
  unfold artinSchreierPolynomial
  rw [sub_sub]
  apply (monic_X_pow p).sub_of_left
  calc
    (X + C c).degree ≤ 1 := by simp
    _ < (p : WithBot ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt
    _ = (X ^ p : Polynomial K).degree := by simp

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinSchreierPolynomial_natDegree
statement:
theorem artinSchreierPolynomial_natDegree
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (c : K) : (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).natDegree = p
proof:
:= by
  unfold artinSchreierPolynomial
  rw [sub_sub, natDegree_sub_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt, natDegree_X_pow]
  exact (natDegree_add_le _ _).trans_lt (by simpa using (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinSchreierPolynomial_derivative
statement:
theorem artinSchreierPolynomial_derivative
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (c : K) : (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).derivative = -1
proof:
:= by
  simp [artinSchreierPolynomial, derivative_X_pow]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinSchreierPolynomial_separable
statement:
theorem artinSchreierPolynomial_separable
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (c : K) : (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).Separable
proof:
:= by
  rw [separable_def, artinSchreierPolynomial_derivative]
  rw [IsCoprime.neg_right_iff]
  exact isCoprime_one_right

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinSchreierSplittingRoot_isRoot
statement:
theorem artinSchreierSplittingRoot_isRoot
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (c : K) :
    ((artinSchreierPolynomial p c).map
      (algebraMap K (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).SplittingField)).IsRoot
        (artinSchreierSplittingRoot c)
proof:
:= by
  exact Polynomial.eval_rootOfSplits _ _

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinSchreier_root_sub_root_mem_bot
statement:
theorem artinSchreier_root_sub_root_mem_bot
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p] [CharP L p]
    {c : K} {x y : L}
    (hx : (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).eval₂ (algebraMap K L) x = 0)
    (hy : (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).eval₂ (algebraMap K L) y = 0) :
    x - y ∈ (⊥ : Subfield L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subfield.mem_bot_iff_pow_eq_self, sub_pow_char]
  have hx' : x ^ p - x = algebraMap K L c := by
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa [artinSchreierPolynomial] using hx)
  have hy' : y ^ p - y = algebraMap K L c := by
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa [artinSchreierPolynomial] using hy)
  linear_combination hx' - hy'

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinSchreier_splittingField_adjoin_root_eq_top
statement:
theorem artinSchreier_splittingField_adjoin_root_eq_top
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (c : K) :
    IntermediateField.adjoin K {artinSchreierSplittingRoot c} =
      (⊤ : IntermediateField K
        (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).SplittingField)
proof:
:= by
  let E := (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).SplittingField
  let α : E := artinSchreierSplittingRoot c
  let F : IntermediateField K E := IntermediateField.adjoin K {α}
  have hroots : (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).rootSet E ⊆ F := by
    intro y hy
    have hy0 :
        (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).eval₂ (algebraMap K E) y = 0 := by
      simpa [aeval_def] using (Polynomial.mem_rootSet'.mp hy).2
    have hα0 :
        (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).eval₂ (algebraMap K E) α = 0 := by
      rw [← Polynomial.eval_map]
      exact artinSchreierSplittingRoot_isRoot c
    have hdiff : y - α ∈ (⊥ : Subfield E) :=
      artinSchreier_root_sub_root_mem_bot hy0 hα0
    have hdiff' : y - α ∈ (⊥ : IntermediateField K E) := by
      exact (show (⊥ : Subfield E) ≤
        (⊥ : IntermediateField K E).toSubfield from bot_le) hdiff
    have hα : α ∈ F := IntermediateField.subset_adjoin K {α} (Set.mem_singleton α)
    rw [show y = α + (y - α) by ring]
    exact F.add_mem hα ((bot_le : (⊥ : IntermediateField K E) ≤ F) hdiff')
  have hsplit :
      IntermediateField.adjoin K ((artinSchreierPolynomial p c).rootSet E) = ⊤ :=
    (isSplittingField_iff_intermediateField.mp
      (inferInstance : (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).IsSplittingField K E)).2
  change F = ⊤
  apply top_unique
  rw [← hsplit]
  exact IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr hroots

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.exists_artinSchreierAutShift
statement:
theorem exists_artinSchreierAutShift
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (c : K) :
    ∃ phi : Additive (Polynomial.Gal (artinSchreierPolynomial p c)) →+
        (⊥ : Subfield (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).SplittingField),
      (∀ sigma,
        (phi sigma : (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).SplittingField) =
          sigma (artinSchreierSplittingRoot c) -
            artinSchreierSplittingRoot c) ∧
      Function.Injective phi
proof:
:= by
  let E := (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).SplittingField
  let α : E := artinSchreierSplittingRoot c
  let G := Polynomial.Gal (artinSchreierPolynomial p c)
  have hα0 : (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).eval₂ (algebraMap K E) α = 0 := by
    rw [← Polynomial.eval_map]
    exact artinSchreierSplittingRoot_isRoot c
  have himage (sigma : G) :
      (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).eval₂ (algebraMap K E) (sigma α) = 0 := by
    have hm := (artinSchreierSplittingRoot_isRoot c).map
      (f := sigma.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)
    rw [Polynomial.map_map] at hm
    have hcomp : sigma.toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap K E) = algebraMap K E := by
      ext k
      exact sigma.commutes k
    rw [hcomp] at hm
    rw [← Polynomial.eval_map]
    exact hm
  have hdiff (sigma : Additive G) : sigma α - α ∈ (⊥ : Subfield E) :=
    artinSchreier_root_sub_root_mem_bot (himage sigma.toMul) hα0
  let phi : Additive G →+ (⊥ : Subfield E) :=
    { toFun := fun sigma ↦ ⟨sigma α - α, hdiff sigma⟩
      map_zero' := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        change α - α = 0
        exact sub_self α
      map_add' := by
        intro sigma tau
        apply Subtype.ext
        change (sigma.toMul * tau.toMul) α - α =
          (sigma.toMul α - α) + (tau.toMul α - α)
        have hdtau : tau.toMul α - α ∈ (⊥ : IntermediateField K E) := by
          exact (show (⊥ : Subfield E) ≤
            (⊥ : IntermediateField K E).toSubfield from bot_le) (hdiff tau)
        have hfix : sigma.toMul (tau.toMul α - α) = tau.toMul α - α := by
          rcases IntermediateField.mem_bot.mp hdtau with ⟨k, hk⟩
          rw [← hk]
          exact sigma.toMul.commutes k
        change sigma.toMul (tau.toMul α) - α =
          (sigma.toMul α - α) + (tau.toMul α - α)
        calc
          sigma.toMul (tau.toMul α) - α =
              (sigma.toMul α - α) + sigma.toMul (tau.toMul α - α) := by
                rw [map_sub]
                ring
          _ = (sigma.toMul α - α) + (tau.toMul α - α) := by rw [hfix] }
  refine ⟨phi, fun sigma ↦ rfl, ?_⟩
  intro sigma tau heq
  apply Additive.toMul.injective
  apply Polynomial.Gal.ext
  intro y hy
  have hy0 : (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).eval₂ (algebraMap K E) y = 0 := by
    simpa [aeval_def] using (Polynomial.mem_rootSet'.mp hy).2
  have hdy : y - α ∈ (⊥ : Subfield E) :=
    artinSchreier_root_sub_root_mem_bot hy0 hα0
  have hdy' : y - α ∈ (⊥ : IntermediateField K E) := by
    exact (show (⊥ : Subfield E) ≤
      (⊥ : IntermediateField K E).toSubfield from bot_le) hdy
  have hfix (rho : G) : rho (y - α) = y - α := by
    rcases IntermediateField.mem_bot.mp hdy' with ⟨k, hk⟩
    rw [← hk]
    exact rho.commutes k
  have hshift : sigma.toMul α - α = tau.toMul α - α :=
    congrArg Subtype.val heq
  have halpha : sigma.toMul α = tau.toMul α := by
    linear_combination hshift
  calc
    sigma.toMul y = sigma.toMul (α + (y - α)) := by
      congr 1
      ring
    _ = sigma.toMul α + (y - α) := by rw [map_add, hfix]
    _ = tau.toMul α + (y - α) := by rw [halpha]
    _ = tau.toMul (α + (y - α)) := by rw [map_add, hfix]
    _ = tau.toMul y := by
      congr 1
      ring

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinSchreierAutShift_apply
statement:
theorem artinSchreierAutShift_apply
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (c : K)
    (sigma : Additive (Polynomial.Gal (artinSchreierPolynomial p c))) :
    (artinSchreierAutShift c sigma :
      (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).SplittingField) =
        sigma (artinSchreierSplittingRoot c) -
          artinSchreierSplittingRoot c
proof:
:= by
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (exists_artinSchreierAutShift c)).1 sigma

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinSchreierAutShift_injective
statement:
theorem artinSchreierAutShift_injective
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (c : K) : Function.Injective (artinSchreierAutShift c)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (exists_artinSchreierAutShift c)).2

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinSchreier_minpoly_natDegree_dvd_prime
statement:
theorem artinSchreier_minpoly_natDegree_dvd_prime
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (c : K) :
    (minpoly K (artinSchreierSplittingRoot c)).natDegree ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  let E := (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).SplittingField
  let α : E := artinSchreierSplittingRoot c
  have hcard : Nat.card (Polynomial.Gal (artinSchreierPolynomial p c)) =
      (minpoly K α).natDegree := by
    rw [Polynomial.Gal.card_of_separable (artinSchreierPolynomial_separable c)]
    rw [← IntermediateField.finrank_top',
      ← artinSchreier_splittingField_adjoin_root_eq_top c,
      IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank (IsIntegral.of_finite K α)]
  have hdvd := AddSubgroup.card_dvd_of_injective (artinSchreierAutShift c)
    (artinSchreierAutShift_injective c)
  change Nat.card (Polynomial.Gal (artinSchreierPolynomial p c)) ∣
    Nat.card (⊥ : Subfield E) at hdvd
  rw [Subfield.card_bot E p, hcard] at hdvd
  exact hdvd

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinSchreier_minpoly_natDegree_eq_one_or_prime
statement:
theorem artinSchreier_minpoly_natDegree_eq_one_or_prime
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (c : K) :
    (minpoly K (artinSchreierSplittingRoot c)).natDegree = 1 ∨
      (minpoly K (artinSchreierSplittingRoot c)).natDegree = p
proof:
:=
  (Fact.out : p.Prime).eq_one_or_self_of_dvd _
    (artinSchreier_minpoly_natDegree_dvd_prime c)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinSchreierPolynomial_irreducible_iff_no_root
statement:
theorem artinSchreierPolynomial_irreducible_iff_no_root
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (c : K) :
    Irreducible (artinSchreierPolynomial p c) ↔
      ¬ ∃ x : K, x ^ p - x = c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hirr ⟨x, hx⟩
    apply hirr.not_isRoot_of_natDegree_ne_one
      (by rw [artinSchreierPolynomial_natDegree]; exact (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_one)
    change (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).eval x = 0
    simpa [artinSchreierPolynomial] using (sub_eq_zero.mpr hx)
  · intro hnoroot
    let E := (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).SplittingField
    let α : E := artinSchreierSplittingRoot c
    have hα0 : (artinSchreierPolynomial p c).eval₂ (algebraMap K E) α = 0 := by
      rw [← Polynomial.eval_map]
      exact artinSchreierSplittingRoot_isRoot c
    rcases artinSchreier_minpoly_natDegree_eq_one_or_prime c with hdeg | hdeg
    · exfalso
      apply hnoroot
      rcases minpoly.natDegree_eq_one_iff.mp hdeg with ⟨x, hx⟩
      refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
      have hformula : α ^ p - α - algebraMap K E c = 0 := by
        simpa [artinSchreierPolynomial] using hα0
      have hmapped : algebraMap K E (x ^ p - x - c) = 0 := by
        rw [map_sub, map_sub, map_pow, hx]
        exact hformula
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((algebraMap K E).injective (by simpa using hmapped))
    · have hdvd : minpoly K α ∣ artinSchreierPolynomial p c := by
        apply minpoly.dvd K α
        simpa [Polynomial.aeval_def] using hα0
      have heq : artinSchreierPolynomial p c = minpoly K α :=
        Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le
          (minpoly.monic (IsIntegral.of_finite K α))
          (artinSchreierPolynomial_monic c) hdvd (by
            rw [artinSchreierPolynomial_natDegree, hdeg])
      rw [heq]
      exact minpoly.irreducible (IsIntegral.of_finite K α)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.not_artinSchreierPolynomial_irreducible_iff_root
statement:
theorem not_artinSchreierPolynomial_irreducible_iff_root
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (c : K) :
    ¬ Irreducible (artinSchreierPolynomial p c) ↔
      ∃ x : K, x ^ p - x = c
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [not_not] using not_congr (artinSchreierPolynomial_irreducible_iff_no_root c)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.ratFunc_eq_algebraMap_of_pow_sub_self_eq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem ratFunc_eq_algebraMap_of_pow_sub_self_eq_algebraMap
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (h : RatFunc (ZMod p)) (g : Polynomial (ZMod p))
    (heq : h ^ p - h =
      algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p)) g) :
    ∃ A : Polynomial (ZMod p),
      h = algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p)) A
proof:
:= by
  let P : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p)) :=
    Polynomial.X ^ p - Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C g
  have hPmonic : P.Monic := by
    dsimp [P]
    rw [sub_sub]
    apply (Polynomial.monic_X_pow p).sub_of_left
    calc
      (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C g).degree ≤ 1 := by simp
      _ < (p : WithBot ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt
      _ = (Polynomial.X ^ p : Polynomial (Polynomial (ZMod p))).degree := by simp
  have hint : IsIntegral (Polynomial (ZMod p)) h := by
    refine ⟨P, hPmonic, ?_⟩
    dsimp [P]
    simpa [Polynomial.aeval_def] using (sub_eq_zero.mpr heq)
  rcases IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.mp hint with ⟨A, hA⟩
  exact ⟨A, hA.symm⟩

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.polynomial_pow_sub_self_natDegree
statement:
theorem polynomial_pow_sub_self_natDegree
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hA : 0 < A.natDegree) :
    (A ^ p - A).natDegree = p * A.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_sub_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt, Polynomial.natDegree_pow]
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_pow]
  nlinarith [(Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.no_ratFunc_artinSchreier_root
statement:
theorem no_ratFunc_artinSchreier_root
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (f : Polynomial (ZMod p))
    (hpos : 0 < f.natDegree) (hsmall : f.natDegree < p) :
    ¬ ∃ h : RatFunc (ZMod p),
      h ^ p - h =
        -algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p)) f
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨h, heq⟩
  have heq' : h ^ p - h =
      algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p)) (-f) := by
    simpa using heq
  rcases ratFunc_eq_algebraMap_of_pow_sub_self_eq_algebraMap h (-f) heq' with ⟨A, hA⟩
  have hpoly : A ^ p - A = -f := by
    apply (RatFunc.algebraMap_injective (ZMod p))
    simpa [hA] using heq'
  by_cases hA0 : A.natDegree = 0
  · have hle : (A ^ p - A).natDegree ≤ 0 := by
      calc
        (A ^ p - A).natDegree ≤ max (A ^ p).natDegree A.natDegree :=
          Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ 0 := by rw [Polynomial.natDegree_pow, hA0]; simp
    rw [hpoly, Polynomial.natDegree_neg] at hle
    omega
  · have hApos : 0 < A.natDegree := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hA0
    have hdeg := polynomial_pow_sub_self_natDegree A hApos
    rw [hpoly, Polynomial.natDegree_neg] at hdeg
    have hle : p ≤ f.natDegree := by
      rw [hdeg]
      exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right p hApos
    omega

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinSchreierRatFuncPolynomial_irreducible
statement:
theorem artinSchreierRatFuncPolynomial_irreducible
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (f : Polynomial (ZMod p))
    (hpos : 0 < f.natDegree) (hsmall : f.natDegree < p) :
    Irreducible (artinSchreierRatFuncPolynomial f)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : artinSchreierRatFuncPolynomial f =
      artinSchreierPolynomial p
        (-algebraMap (Polynomial (ZMod p)) (RatFunc (ZMod p)) f) := by
    simp [artinSchreierRatFuncPolynomial, artinSchreierPolynomial]
  rw [heq, artinSchreierPolynomial_irreducible_iff_no_root]
  exact no_ratFunc_artinSchreier_root f hpos hsmall

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.monicWeight_degree_zero
statement:
private theorem monicWeight_degree_zero
    {k : Type*} [Field k] (psi : AddChar k ℂ) (f : Polynomial k)
    (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k 0) : monicWeight psi f A = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hApoly : A.toPolynomial = 1 := by
    rw [MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial]
    simp
  have hpower : ∀ j : ℕ, monicPowerSum A j = 0 := by
    intro j
    have h := monicPowerSum_eq_sum_roots (K := k) A (by simp [hApoly]) j
    simpa [hApoly] using h
  simp [monicWeight, monicPhase, hpower]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinCoefficient_zero_aux
statement:
private theorem artinCoefficient_zero_aux
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k]
    (psi : AddChar k ℂ) (f : Polynomial k) :
    artinCoefficient psi f 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A : MonicDegreePolynomial k 0 := ⟨fun i ↦ Fin.elim0 i⟩
  rw [artinCoefficient, Fintype.sum_eq_single A]
  · exact monicWeight_degree_zero psi f A
  · intro B hBA
    exact (hBA (by
      apply congrArg MonicDegreePolynomial.mk
      funext i
      exact Fin.elim0 i)).elim

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinLPolynomial_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem artinLPolynomial_coeff_zero
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (psi : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) :
    (artinLPolynomial psi f).coeff 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [artinLPolynomial, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simpa using artinCoefficient_zero_aux psi f
  · intro n hn hn0
    simp [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, hn0]
  · simp

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinLPolynomial_constant_regression
statement:
theorem artinLPolynomial_constant_regression
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (psi : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (c : ZMod p) :
    artinLPolynomial psi (Polynomial.C c) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext n
  rw [artinLPolynomial, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst n
    simp [artinCoefficient_zero_aux]
  · simp [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, Polynomial.coeff_one, hn]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinLPolynomial_natDegree_le
statement:
theorem artinLPolynomial_natDegree_le
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (psi : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) :
    (artinLPolynomial psi f).natDegree ≤ f.natDegree - 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hd : f.natDegree = 0
  · rw [show artinLPolynomial psi f = 1 by
      ext n
      rw [artinLPolynomial, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
      by_cases hn : n = 0
      · subst n
        simp [hd, artinCoefficient_zero_aux]
      · simp [hd, Polynomial.coeff_monomial, Polynomial.coeff_one, hn]]
    simp
  have hdpos : 0 < f.natDegree := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd
  rw [artinLPolynomial, max_eq_right (by omega)]
  refine Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le (Finset.range f.natDegree)
    (fun n ↦ Polynomial.monomial n (artinCoefficient psi f n)) ?_
  intro n hn
  exact (Polynomial.natDegree_monomial_le _).trans (by
    apply Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt
    exact Finset.mem_range.mp hn)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.reciprocalRoots_card_le
statement:
theorem reciprocalRoots_card_le
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (psi : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) :
    (reciprocalRoots psi f).card ≤ f.natDegree - 1
proof:
:= by
  exact (Polynomial.card_roots' _).trans
    ((Polynomial.reverse_natDegree_le _).trans
      (artinLPolynomial_natDegree_le psi f))

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.markedFactorPolynomial_coeff_of_pos_le
statement:
private theorem markedFactorPolynomial_coeff_of_pos_le
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k]
    (psi : AddChar k ℂ) (f : Polynomial k) (cutoff : ℕ)
    {j : ℕ} (hjpos : 0 < j) (hj : j ≤ cutoff) :
    (markedFactorPolynomial psi f cutoff).coeff j =
      markedFactorSum psi f j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [markedFactorPolynomial, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff,
    Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro a _ha haj
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, if_neg haj]
  · intro hnot
    exact (hnot (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hjpos, hj⟩)).elim

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.markedFactorPolynomial_coeff_zero
statement:
private theorem markedFactorPolynomial_coeff_zero
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k]
    (psi : AddChar k ℂ) (f : Polynomial k) (cutoff : ℕ) :
    (markedFactorPolynomial psi f cutoff).coeff 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [markedFactorPolynomial, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro a ha
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, if_neg]
  exact (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one
    (Finset.mem_Icc.mp ha).1).ne'

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.EulerPrime.degree_pos
proof:
:=
  (Finset.mem_Icc.mp i.1.1.2).1

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.EulerPrime.degree_le
proof:
:=
  (Finset.mem_Icc.mp i.1.1.2).2

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.EulerPrime.toPolynomial_monic
proof:
:=
  i.encoding.toPolynomial_monic

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.EulerPrime.toPolynomial_natDegree
proof:
:=
  i.encoding.toPolynomial_natDegree

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.EulerPrime.toPolynomial_irreducible
TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_injective_fixed
statement:
private theorem MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_injective_fixed
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {n : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective
      (MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial : MonicDegreePolynomial k n → Polynomial k)
proof:
:= by
  intro A B h
  apply (monicEncodingEquiv k n).injective
  apply Subtype.ext
  simpa only [monicEncodingEquiv_apply] using h

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.MonicDegreePolynomial.heq_of_toPolynomial_eq
statement:
private theorem MonicDegreePolynomial.heq_of_toPolynomial_eq
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {n m : ℕ}
    (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n) (B : MonicDegreePolynomial k m)
    (h : A.toPolynomial = B.toPolynomial) : HEq A B
proof:
:= by
  have hnm : n = m := by
    rw [← A.toPolynomial_natDegree, ← B.toPolynomial_natDegree, h]
  subst m
  exact heq_of_eq (MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_injective_fixed h)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.EulerPrime.toPolynomial_injective
statement:
private theorem EulerPrime.toPolynomial_injective
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k] {cutoff : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (EulerPrime.toPolynomial : EulerPrime k cutoff → Polynomial k)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hdegree : i.degree = j.degree := by
    rw [← i.toPolynomial_natDegree, ← j.toPolynomial_natDegree, hij]
  apply Subtype.ext
  cases i with
  | mk i hi =>
    cases j with
    | mk j hj =>
      cases i with
      | mk ri Gi =>
        cases j with
        | mk rj Gj =>
          have hrs : ri.1 = rj.1 := hdegree
          cases ri with
          | mk r hri =>
            cases rj with
            | mk s hsj =>
              dsimp at hrs
              subst s
              have hproof : hsj = hri := Subsingleton.elim _ _
              subst hsj
              have hG : Gi = Gj :=
                MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_injective_fixed hij
              subst Gj
              rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.monic_finset_prod
statement:
private theorem monic_finset_prod
    {k ι : Type*} [Field k] (s : Finset ι) (P : ι → Polynomial k)
    (hP : ∀ i ∈ s, (P i).Monic) : (∏ i ∈ s, P i).Monic
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha]
      exact (hP a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).mul
        (ih (fun i hi => hP i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)))

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.selectionPolynomial_monic
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply monic_finset_prod
  intro i hi
  exact i.toPolynomial_monic.pow _

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.selectionPolynomial_natDegree
statement:
private theorem selectionPolynomial_natDegree
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k] {cutoff : ℕ}
    (e : EulerSelection k cutoff) :
    (selectionPolynomial e).natDegree = selectionDegree e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [selectionPolynomial, selectionDegree,
    Polynomial.natDegree_prod_of_monic]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_pow, i.toPolynomial_natDegree]
  · intro i hi
    exact i.toPolynomial_monic.pow _

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.factorization_prime
statement:
private theorem factorization_prime
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k] {cutoff : ℕ}
    (i : EulerPrime k cutoff) :
    factorization i.toPolynomial = Finsupp.single i.toPolynomial 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext P
  rw [factorization_eq_count, UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_irreducible
    i.toPolynomial_irreducible, i.toPolynomial_monic.normalize_eq_self]
  simp [Multiset.count_singleton, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.factorization_selectionPolynomial
statement:
private theorem factorization_selectionPolynomial
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k] {cutoff : ℕ}
    (e : EulerSelection k cutoff) :
    factorization (selectionPolynomial e) =
      ∑ i : EulerPrime k cutoff, (e i).1 • Finsupp.single i.toPolynomial 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [selectionPolynomial]
  induction (Finset.univ : Finset (EulerPrime k cutoff)) using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hi, factorization_mul]
      · rw [factorization_pow, factorization_prime, Finset.sum_insert hi, ih]
      · exact (i.toPolynomial_monic.pow _).ne_zero
      · exact (monic_finset_prod s _ (fun j hj => j.toPolynomial_monic.pow _)).ne_zero

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.factorization_selectionPolynomial_apply
statement:
private theorem factorization_selectionPolynomial_apply
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k] {cutoff : ℕ}
    (e : EulerSelection k cutoff) (i : EulerPrime k cutoff) :
    factorization (selectionPolynomial e) i.toPolynomial = (e i).1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [factorization_selectionPolynomial, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp
  · intro j hj hji
    rw [Finsupp.smul_single]
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, Finsupp.single_apply]
    rw [if_neg]
    intro hpoly
    exact hji (EulerPrime.toPolynomial_injective hpoly)
  · simp

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.selectionPolynomial_injective
statement:
private theorem selectionPolynomial_injective
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k] {cutoff : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (selectionPolynomial : EulerSelection k cutoff → Polynomial k)
proof:
:= by
  intro e e' he
  funext i
  apply Fin.ext
  rw [← factorization_selectionPolynomial_apply e i,
    ← factorization_selectionPolynomial_apply e' i, he]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.count_mul_le_sum_map
statement:
private theorem count_mul_le_sum_map
    {a : Type*} [DecidableEq a] (s : Multiset a) (x : a) (w : a → ℕ) :
    Multiset.count x s * w x ≤ (s.map w).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons y s ih =>
      by_cases hy : y = x
      · subst y
        simp only [Multiset.count_cons_self, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons,
          Nat.add_mul]
        omega
      · simp only [Multiset.count_cons_of_ne (fun h ↦ hy h.symm), Multiset.map_cons,
          Multiset.sum_cons]
        omega

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.factorization_mul_degree_le
statement:
private theorem factorization_mul_degree_le
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
    (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n) (P : Polynomial k) :
    factorization A.toPolynomial P * P.natDegree ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  let s := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors A.toPolynomial
  calc
    factorization A.toPolynomial P * P.natDegree =
        Multiset.count P s * P.natDegree := by
          rw [factorization_eq_count]
    _ ≤ (s.map Polynomial.natDegree).sum := count_mul_le_sum_map s P _
    _ = n := by
      rw [← Polynomial.natDegree_multiset_prod s
        (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.zero_notMem_normalizedFactors A.toPolynomial)]
      rw [UniqueFactorizationMonoid.prod_normalizedFactors_eq
        A.toPolynomial_monic.ne_zero, A.toPolynomial_monic.normalize_eq_self,
        A.toPolynomial_natDegree]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.selectionPolynomial_decodingSelection_factorization
statement:
private theorem selectionPolynomial_decodingSelection_factorization
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k] {cutoff n : ℕ}
    (hn : n ≤ cutoff) (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n) :
    factorization (selectionPolynomial (decodingSelection hn A)) =
      factorization A.toPolynomial
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext P
  by_cases hP : factorization A.toPolynomial P = 0
  · rw [hP, factorization_selectionPolynomial]
    rw [Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i hi
    rw [Finsupp.smul_single]
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs with hPi
    · subst P
      simp [decodingSelection, hP]
    · simp
  · have hcount : Multiset.count P
        (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors A.toPolynomial) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa only [factorization_eq_count] using hP
    have hPmem : P ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors A.toPolynomial :=
      Multiset.count_pos.mp (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hcount)
    have hPdata :=
      (Polynomial.mem_normalizedFactors_iff A.toPolynomial_monic.ne_zero).mp hPmem
    have hPpos : 0 < P.natDegree := (hPdata.1.natDegree_pos)
    have hPle : P.natDegree ≤ cutoff := by
      have := factorization_mul_degree_le A P
      have hfacpos : 0 < factorization A.toPolynomial P := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hP
      exact (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left P.natDegree hfacpos).trans (this.trans hn)
    let G : MonicDegreePolynomial k P.natDegree :=
      MonicDegreePolynomial.ofPolynomial P hPdata.2.1 rfl
    let i : EulerPrime k cutoff :=
      ⟨⟨⟨P.natDegree, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hPpos, hPle⟩⟩, G⟩, by
        simpa [G, MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_ofPolynomial] using hPdata.1⟩
    have hiP : i.toPolynomial = P := by
      change G.toPolynomial = P
      exact MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_ofPolynomial P hPdata.2.1 rfl
    rw [← hiP, factorization_selectionPolynomial_apply]
    rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.selectionPolynomial_decodingSelection
statement:
private theorem selectionPolynomial_decodingSelection
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k] {cutoff n : ℕ}
    (hn : n ≤ cutoff) (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n) :
    selectionPolynomial (decodingSelection hn A) = A.toPolynomial
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hassoc := associated_of_factorization_eq
    (selectionPolynomial (decodingSelection hn A)) A.toPolynomial
    (selectionPolynomial_monic _).ne_zero A.toPolynomial_monic.ne_zero
    (selectionPolynomial_decodingSelection_factorization hn A)
  have hnorm : normalize (selectionPolynomial (decodingSelection hn A)) =
      normalize A.toPolynomial := normalize_eq_normalize_iff.mpr hassoc.dvd_dvd
  rw [(selectionPolynomial_monic (decodingSelection hn A)).normalize_eq_self,
    A.toPolynomial_monic.normalize_eq_self] at hnorm
  exact hnorm

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.selectionDegree_decodingSelection
statement:
private theorem selectionDegree_decodingSelection
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k] {cutoff n : ℕ}
    (hn : n ≤ cutoff) (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n) :
    selectionDegree (decodingSelection hn A) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← selectionPolynomial_natDegree, selectionPolynomial_decodingSelection hn A,
    A.toPolynomial_natDegree]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.finset_prod_monomial
statement:
private theorem finset_prod_monomial
    {R ι : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (s : Finset ι)
    (d : ι → ℕ) (c : ι → R) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, Polynomial.monomial (d i) (c i)) =
      Polynomial.monomial (∑ i ∈ s, d i) (∏ i ∈ s, c i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha, ih,
        Polynomial.monomial_mul_monomial]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.primeEulerProduct_eq_sum_selection
statement:
private theorem primeEulerProduct_eq_sum_selection
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k] {cutoff : ℕ}
    (w : EulerPrime k cutoff → ℂ) :
    primeEulerProduct w =
      ∑ e : EulerSelection k cutoff,
        Polynomial.monomial (selectionDegree e)
          (∏ i : EulerPrime k cutoff, w i ^ (e i).1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [primeEulerProduct]
  simp_rw [primeEulerFactor]
  rw [Fintype.prod_sum]
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro e
  rw [finset_prod_monomial]
  rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.primeEulerProduct_coeff
statement:
private theorem primeEulerProduct_coeff
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k] {cutoff n : ℕ}
    (w : EulerPrime k cutoff → ℂ) :
    (primeEulerProduct w).coeff n =
