name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.upperTracePolynomial_hasseDeriv_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem upperTracePolynomial_hasseDeriv_eq_zero
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (f : Polynomial (ZMod p))
    (n u l : ℕ) (hl0 : 0 < l) (hl : l < p ^ u) :
    (upperTracePolynomial f n u).hasseDeriv l = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [upperTracePolynomial]
  simp_rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro t ht
  have hut : u ≤ t := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp ht).1
  have hp0 : 0 < p := (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos
  exact hasseDeriv_pow_char_pow_eq_zero f t l hl0
    (hl.trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hp0 hut))

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.hasseDeriv_mul_of_right_frozen
statement:
private theorem hasseDeriv_mul_of_right_frozen
    {K : Type*} [Field K] (A B : Polynomial K) (r : ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ l, 0 < l → l ≤ r → B.hasseDeriv l = 0) :
    (A * B).hasseDeriv r = A.hasseDeriv r * B
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.hasseDeriv_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (r, 0)]
  · simp
  · rintro ⟨k, l⟩ hmem hne
    have hsum : k + l = r := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hmem
    have hl0 : 0 < l := by
      by_contra hl
      have hlz : l = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hl
      subst hlz
      simp_all
    rw [hB l hl0 (by omega), mul_zero]
  · simp

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.upperTracePolynomial_power_hasseDeriv_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem upperTracePolynomial_power_hasseDeriv_eq_zero
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (f : Polynomial (ZMod p))
    (n u i l : ℕ) (hl0 : 0 < l) (hl : l < p ^ u) :
    (upperTracePolynomial f n u ^ i).hasseDeriv l = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero =>
      simpa using Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply_one (R := ZMod p) l hl0
  | succ i ih =>
      rw [pow_succ]
      rw [hasseDeriv_mul_of_right_frozen]
      · rw [ih, zero_mul]
      · intro q hq0 hql
        exact upperTracePolynomial_hasseDeriv_eq_zero f n u q hq0 (hql.trans_lt hl)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.coeffPolynomial_coeff
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeffPolynomial, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single s]
  · simp
  · intro t _ hts
    have hval : t.1 ≠ s.1 := fun h => hts (Fin.ext h)
    rw [Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, Polynomial.coeff_monomial, if_neg hval]
  · simp

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.coeffPolynomial_natDegree_lt
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hS : 0 < par.S := par.S_pos
  rw [coeffPolynomial]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt
    (Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le Finset.univ
      (fun s : Fin par.S => Polynomial.C (v i j s) * Polynomial.X ^ s.1) ?_)
    (Nat.pred_lt hS.ne')
  intro s _
  rw [Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]
  exact (Polynomial.natDegree_monomial_le (v i j s)).trans
    (Nat.le_pred_of_lt s.isLt)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.coeffPolynomial_add
proof:
:= by

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.coeffPolynomial_smul
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext q
  by_cases hq : q < par.S
  · let s : Fin par.S := ⟨q, hq⟩
    simpa [s] using congrArg (Polynomial.coeff · q)
      (show coeffPolynomial (c • v) i j = c • coeffPolynomial v i j by
        rw [← Polynomial.C_mul', coeffPolynomial, coeffPolynomial]
        simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul]
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        congr 1
        funext t
        simp [mul_assoc])
  · have hleft := coeffPolynomial_natDegree_lt (c • v) i j
    have hright := coeffPolynomial_natDegree_lt v i j
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hleft (Nat.le_of_not_gt hq))]
    simp [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
      (lt_of_lt_of_le hright (Nat.le_of_not_gt hq))]

statement:
private theorem hasseDeriv_map_eq_map_hasseDeriv
    {R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S]
    (g : R →+* S) (P : Polynomial R) (r : ℕ) :

proof:
:= by

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.coeffVectorToAuxiliary_hasseDeriv
statement:
private theorem coeffVectorToAuxiliary_hasseDeriv
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (v : AdditiveCoeffVector par)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : r < par.R) :
    (((coeffVectorToAuxiliary par f) v).hasseDeriv r) =
      ∑ i : Fin p, ∑ j : Fin (par.K + 1),
        (coeffPolynomial v i j).hasseDeriv r *
          upperTracePolynomial f n par.u ^ i.1 *
            Polynomial.X ^ (p ^ n * j.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hu : par.u ≤ n := by
    rw [par.u_eq]
    exact Nat.div_le_self n 2
  have hp0 : 0 < p := (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos
  have hrn : r < p ^ n :=
    (hr.trans par.R_lt_frobenius).trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hp0 hu)
  change (Polynomial.hasseDeriv r)
      (∑ i : Fin p, ∑ j : Fin (par.K + 1),
        coeffPolynomial v i j * upperTracePolynomial f n par.u ^ i.1 *
          Polynomial.X ^ (p ^ n * j.1)) = _
  simp_rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [hasseDeriv_mul_X_pow_pow_mul _ n j.1 r hrn]
  rw [hasseDeriv_mul_of_right_frozen]
  intro q hq0 hqr
  exact upperTracePolynomial_power_hasseDeriv_eq_zero f n par.u i.1 q hq0
    (hqr.trans_lt (hr.trans par.R_lt_frobenius))

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.lowerTracePolynomial_natDegree_le
statement:
theorem lowerTracePolynomial_natDegree_le
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d : ℕ}
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (u : ℕ) :
    (lowerTracePolynomial f u).natDegree ≤ d * p ^ (u - 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hu : u = 0
  · simp [lowerTracePolynomial, hu]
  rw [lowerTracePolynomial]
  refine Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le (Finset.range u)
    (fun t : ℕ => f ^ (p ^ t)) ?_
  intro t htmem
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_pow, hdegree]
  have htlt : t < u := Finset.mem_range.mp htmem
  have ht : t ≤ u - 1 := by omega
  have hp0 : 0 < p := (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos
  simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.mul_le_mul_left d (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hp0 ht)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.upperTracePolynomial_eval_eq_of_trace_eq
statement:
theorem upperTracePolynomial_eval_eq_of_trace_eq
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {n u : ℕ}
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hu : u ≤ n)
    (b : ZMod p) (x : GaloisField p n)
    (hx : Algebra.trace (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)
      (f.eval₂ (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)) x) = b) :
    (upperTracePolynomial f n u).eval₂
        (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)) x =
      (Polynomial.C b - lowerTracePolynomial f u).eval₂
        (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)) x
proof:
:= by
  let y : GaloisField p n :=
    f.eval₂ (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)) x
  have htrace := FiniteField.algebraMap_trace_eq_sum_pow
    (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n) y
  rw [GaloisField.finrank p hn, Nat.card_zmod, hx] at htrace
  have hsplit := Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico (fun t : ℕ => y ^ (p ^ t)) hu
  calc
    (upperTracePolynomial f n u).eval₂
        (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)) x =
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.Ico u n, y ^ (p ^ t) := by
      rw [upperTracePolynomial, Polynomial.eval₂_finsetSum]
      simp [y]
    _ = algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n) b -
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range u, y ^ (p ^ t) := by
      apply eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr
      calc
        (∑ t ∈ Finset.Ico u n, y ^ (p ^ t)) +
            ∑ t ∈ Finset.range u, y ^ (p ^ t) =
            (∑ t ∈ Finset.range u, y ^ (p ^ t)) +
              ∑ t ∈ Finset.Ico u n, y ^ (p ^ t) := add_comm _ _
        _ = ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, y ^ (p ^ t) := hsplit
        _ = algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n) b := htrace.symm
    _ = (Polynomial.C b - lowerTracePolynomial f u).eval₂
        (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)) x := by
      rw [lowerTracePolynomial, Polynomial.eval₂_sub,
        Polynomial.eval₂_C, Polynomial.eval₂_finsetSum]
      simp [y]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.reducedHassePolynomial_eval₂_eq_hasseDeriv_eval
statement:
theorem reducedHassePolynomial_eval₂_eq_hasseDeriv_eval
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (b : ZMod p)
    (v : AdditiveCoeffVector par) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < par.R)
    (x : GaloisField p n)
    (hx : Algebra.trace (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)
      (f.eval₂ (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)) x) = b) :
    (reducedHassePolynomial par f b r v).eval₂
        (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)) x =
      Polynomial.eval x
        ((((coeffVectorToAuxiliary par f) v).map
          (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n))).hasseDeriv r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn : n ≠ 0 := par.n_pos.ne'
  have hu : par.u ≤ n := by
    rw [par.u_eq]
    exact Nat.div_le_self n 2
  have hupper := upperTracePolynomial_eval_eq_of_trace_eq f hn hu b x hx
  let _ : Fintype (GaloisField p n) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hxpow := FiniteField.pow_card x
  rw [Fintype.card_eq_nat_card, GaloisField.card p n hn] at hxpow
  rw [hasseDeriv_map_eq_map_hasseDeriv,
    Polynomial.eval_map,
    coeffVectorToAuxiliary_hasseDeriv par f v r hr,
    reducedHassePolynomial]
  simp_rw [Polynomial.eval₂_finsetSum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  simp only [Polynomial.eval₂_mul, Polynomial.eval₂_pow, Polynomial.eval₂_X]
  rw [hupper, pow_mul, hxpow]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.reducedHassePolynomial_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem reducedHassePolynomial_natDegree_lt
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (b : ZMod p) (r : ℕ) (v : AdditiveCoeffVector par) :
    (reducedHassePolynomial par f b r v).natDegree <
      additiveConstraintDegree par
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := d * p ^ (par.u - 1)
  let D := additiveConstraintDegree par
  have hp0 : 0 < p := (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos
  have hS : 0 < par.S := par.S_pos
  have hD : 0 < D := by
    dsimp [D, additiveConstraintDegree]
    omega
  have hbase : (Polynomial.C b - lowerTracePolynomial f par.u).natDegree ≤ L := by
    refine (Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [max_le_iff]
    exact ⟨by simp [L], lowerTracePolynomial_natDegree_le f hdegree par.u⟩
  change (reducedHassePolynomial par f b r v).natDegree < D
  rw [reducedHassePolynomial]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt
    (Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le Finset.univ
      (fun i : Fin p => ∑ j : Fin (par.K + 1),
        (coeffPolynomial v i j).hasseDeriv r *
          (Polynomial.C b - lowerTracePolynomial f par.u) ^ i.1 *
            Polynomial.X ^ j.1) ?_)
    (Nat.pred_lt hD.ne')
  intro i _
  refine Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le Finset.univ
    (fun j : Fin (par.K + 1) =>
      (coeffPolynomial v i j).hasseDeriv r *
        (Polynomial.C b - lowerTracePolynomial f par.u) ^ i.1 *
          Polynomial.X ^ j.1) ?_
  intro j _
  apply Nat.le_pred_of_lt
  have hc : ((coeffPolynomial v i j).hasseDeriv r).natDegree < par.S :=
    ((Polynomial.natDegree_hasseDeriv_le _ _).trans (Nat.sub_le _ _)).trans_lt
      (coeffPolynomial_natDegree_lt v i j)
  have hi : i.1 ≤ p - 1 := by omega
  have hj : j.1 ≤ par.K := by omega
  have hpow :
      ((Polynomial.C b - lowerTracePolynomial f par.u) ^ i.1).natDegree ≤
        (p - 1) * L := by
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_pow]
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left i.1 hbase).trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_right L hi)
  have hterm' :
      (((coeffPolynomial v i j).hasseDeriv r *
          (Polynomial.C b - lowerTracePolynomial f par.u) ^ i.1) *
          Polynomial.X ^ j.1).natDegree ≤
        ((coeffPolynomial v i j).hasseDeriv r).natDegree +
          ((Polynomial.C b - lowerTracePolynomial f par.u) ^ i.1).natDegree + j.1 := by
    calc
      (((coeffPolynomial v i j).hasseDeriv r *
            (Polynomial.C b - lowerTracePolynomial f par.u) ^ i.1) *
            Polynomial.X ^ j.1).natDegree
          ≤ (((coeffPolynomial v i j).hasseDeriv r *
              (Polynomial.C b - lowerTracePolynomial f par.u) ^ i.1)).natDegree +
              (Polynomial.X ^ j.1 : Polynomial (ZMod p)).natDegree :=
        Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le
      _ ≤ (((coeffPolynomial v i j).hasseDeriv r).natDegree +
              ((Polynomial.C b - lowerTracePolynomial f par.u) ^ i.1).natDegree) +
              j.1 := Nat.add_le_add Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le (by simp)
  dsimp [L] at hpow
  dsimp [D, additiveConstraintDegree, L]
  calc
    (((coeffPolynomial v i j).hasseDeriv r *
          (Polynomial.C b - lowerTracePolynomial f par.u) ^ i.1) *
          Polynomial.X ^ j.1).natDegree
        ≤ ((coeffPolynomial v i j).hasseDeriv r).natDegree +
            ((Polynomial.C b - lowerTracePolynomial f par.u) ^ i.1).natDegree + j.1 := hterm'
    _ < par.S + (p - 1) * (d * p ^ (par.u - 1)) + par.K := by omega
    _ = par.S + d * (p - 1) * p ^ (par.u - 1) + par.K := by ring

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.additiveCoeffVector_finrank
statement:
theorem additiveCoeffVector_finrank
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod p) (AdditiveCoeffVector par) =
      p * par.S * (par.K + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [AdditiveCoeffVector, Module.finrank_pi_fintype]
  ac_rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.additiveConstraintTarget_finrank
statement:
theorem additiveConstraintTarget_finrank
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod p) (AdditiveConstraintTarget par) =
      par.R * additiveConstraintDegree par
proof:
:= by

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.exists_nonzero_mem_additiveConstraint_ker
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_mem_additiveConstraint_ker
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (b : ZMod p) :
    ∃ v : AdditiveCoeffVector par,
      v ≠ 0 ∧ v ∈ LinearMap.ker (additiveConstraint par f b)
proof:
:= by
  have hdim :
      Module.finrank (ZMod p) (AdditiveConstraintTarget par) <
        Module.finrank (ZMod p) (AdditiveCoeffVector par) := by
    rw [additiveConstraintTarget_finrank, additiveCoeffVector_finrank]
    exact par.dimension_ok
  have hker : LinearMap.ker (additiveConstraint par f b) ≠ ⊥ :=
    LinearMap.ker_ne_bot_of_finrank_lt hdim
  obtain ⟨v, hvker, hv0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hker
  exact ⟨v, hv0, hvker⟩

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.reducedHassePolynomial_eq_zero_of_mem_ker
statement:
theorem reducedHassePolynomial_eq_zero_of_mem_ker
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (b : ZMod p) (v : AdditiveCoeffVector par)
    (hv : v ∈ LinearMap.ker (additiveConstraint par f b))
    (r : Fin par.R) :
    reducedHassePolynomial par f b r.1 v = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.ext
  intro q
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_zero]
  by_cases hq : q < additiveConstraintDegree par
  · let q' : Fin (additiveConstraintDegree par) := ⟨q, hq⟩
    have hzero := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hv
    have hcoord := congrFun (congrFun hzero r) q'
    simpa [additiveConstraint, additiveConstraintFun, q'] using hcoord
  · exact Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
      ((reducedHassePolynomial_natDegree_lt par f hdegree b r.1 v).trans_le
        (Nat.le_of_not_gt hq))

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.coeffVectorToCoefficients_nonzero_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, j, hij⟩ rfl
    exact hij (by ext q; simp [coeffVectorToCoefficients, coeffPolynomial])
  · intro hv
    by_contra hnonzero
    simp only [AdditiveAuxiliaryCoefficients.Nonzero, not_exists] at hnonzero
    apply hv
    funext i j s
    have hz : (coeffVectorToCoefficients v).coeff i j = 0 :=
      not_ne_iff.mp (hnonzero i j)
    have hs := congrArg (fun P : Polynomial (ZMod p) => P.coeff s.1) hz
    simpa [coeffVectorToCoefficients, coeffPolynomial_coeff] using hs

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.exists_additive_stepanov_coefficients
statement:
theorem exists_additive_stepanov_coefficients
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (b : ZMod p) :
    ∃ e : AdditiveAuxiliaryCoefficients par (ZMod p), e.Nonzero ∧
      ∀ x : GaloisField p n,
        Algebra.trace (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)
            (f.eval₂ (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)) x) = b →
          VanishesToOrderAtLeast
            ((additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial par f e).map
              (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n))) x par.R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv0, hvker⟩ := exists_nonzero_mem_additiveConstraint_ker par f b
  refine ⟨coeffVectorToCoefficients v,
    (coeffVectorToCoefficients_nonzero_iff v).mpr hv0, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  change ∀ r < par.R,
    Polynomial.eval x
      (((((coeffVectorToAuxiliary par f) v).map
        (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n))).hasseDeriv r)) = 0
  intro r hr
  let r' : Fin par.R := ⟨r, hr⟩
  have hred := reducedHassePolynomial_eq_zero_of_mem_ker
    par f hdegree b v hvker r'
  have heval := reducedHassePolynomial_eval₂_eq_hasseDeriv_eval
    par f b v r hr x hx
  rw [hred, Polynomial.eval₂_zero] at heval
  exact heval.symm

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial_natDegree_le
statement:
theorem additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial_natDegree_le
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (e : AdditiveAuxiliaryCoefficients par (ZMod p)) :
    (additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial par f e).natDegree ≤
      par.S + d * (p - 1) * p ^ (n - 1) + p ^ n * par.K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial]
  refine Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le Finset.univ
    (fun i : Fin p ↦ ∑ j : Fin (par.K + 1),
      e.coeff i j * upperTracePolynomial f n par.u ^ i.1 *
        X ^ (p ^ n * j.1)) ?_
  intro i hi
  refine Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le Finset.univ
    (fun j : Fin (par.K + 1) ↦
      e.coeff i j * upperTracePolynomial f n par.u ^ i.1 *
        X ^ (p ^ n * j.1)) ?_
  intro j hj
  refine Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
  refine Nat.add_le_add ?_ ?_
  · refine Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
    refine Nat.add_le_add (Nat.le_of_lt (e.degree_lt i j)) ?_
    refine Polynomial.natDegree_pow_le.trans ?_
    have hupper : (upperTracePolynomial f n par.u).natDegree ≤
        d * p ^ (n - 1) := by
      rw [upperTracePolynomial]
      refine Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le (Finset.Ico par.u n)
        (fun t : ℕ ↦ f ^ (p ^ t)) ?_
      intro t ht
      rw [Polynomial.natDegree_pow, hdegree]
      have htn : t ≤ n - 1 := by
        have := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp ht).2
        omega
      simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.mul_le_mul_left d
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos htn)
    calc
      i.1 * (upperTracePolynomial f n par.u).natDegree
          ≤ (p - 1) * (d * p ^ (n - 1)) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_pred_of_lt i.2) hupper
      _ = d * (p - 1) * p ^ (n - 1) := by ring
  · rw [Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.le_pred_of_lt j.2)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.stepanov_traceFiberCard_upper
statement:
theorem stepanov_traceFiberCard_upper
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hdegree : f.natDegree = d)
    (hpos : 0 < d) (hsmall : d < p) (b : ZMod p) :
    (tracePhaseFiberCard f n b : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) +
      ((par.S + d * (p - 1) * p ^ (n - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / par.R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : Fintype (GaloisField p n) := Fintype.ofFinite (GaloisField p n)
  obtain ⟨e, he, hvanish⟩ :=
    exists_additive_stepanov_coefficients par f hdegree b
  let P := additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial par f e
  let PE := P.map (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n))
  let A := Finset.univ.filter fun x : GaloisField p n ↦
    Algebra.trace (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)
      (f.eval₂ (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)) x) = b
  have hP : P ≠ 0 := additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial_ne_zero
    par f hdegree hpos hsmall e he
  have hPE : PE ≠ 0 := by
    exact (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff
      (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)).injective).2 hP
  have hmul : A.card * par.R ≤ PE.natDegree := by
    apply card_mul_le_natDegree_of_vanishes hPE A
    intro x hx
    exact hvanish x (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
  have hdegreePE : PE.natDegree = P.natDegree :=
    Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective
      (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)).injective P
  have hnat : A.card * par.R ≤
      par.S + d * (p - 1) * p ^ (n - 1) + p ^ n * par.K := by
    rw [hdegreePE] at hmul
    exact hmul.trans (additiveAuxiliaryPolynomial_natDegree_le par f hdegree e)
  have hRpos : 0 < par.R := by
    rw [par.R_eq]
    exact Nat.mul_pos (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos par.K_pos
  have hnpos : 0 < n := par.n_pos
  have hreal : ((A.card * par.R : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      ((par.S + d * (p - 1) * p ^ (n - 1) + p ^ n * par.K : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have hAcard : A.card = tracePhaseFiberCard f n b := by
    rfl
  rw [hAcard] at hreal
  push_cast at hreal
  have hRreal : (0 : ℝ) < par.R := by exact_mod_cast hRpos
  have hpown : (p : ℝ) ^ n * par.K =
      (p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * par.R := by
    rw [par.R_eq]
    push_cast
    have hpowreal : (p : ℝ) ^ n = (p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * p := by
      calc
        (p : ℝ) ^ n = (p : ℝ) ^ ((n - 1) + 1) := by
          congr 1
          omega
        _ = (p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * p := by rw [pow_succ]
    calc
      (p : ℝ) ^ n * par.K =
          ((p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * p) * par.K := by
        rw [hpowreal]
      _ = (p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (p * par.K) := by ring
  have hdiff : (tracePhaseFiberCard f n b : ℝ) - (p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) ≤
      ((par.S + d * (p - 1) * p ^ (n - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / par.R := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hRreal).2
    rw [hpown] at hreal
    push_cast
    nlinarith
  nlinarith

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.sum_tracePhaseFiberCard
statement:
private theorem sum_tracePhaseFiberCard
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ∑ b : ZMod p, tracePhaseFiberCard f n b = p ^ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : Fintype (GaloisField p n) := Fintype.ofFinite (GaloisField p n)
  rw [← GaloisField.card p n hn]
  change (∑ b : ZMod p, (Finset.univ.filter fun x : GaloisField p n ↦
    Algebra.trace (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)
      (f.eval₂ (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)) x) = b).card) =
        Nat.card (GaloisField p n)
  rw [← @Fintype.card_eq_nat_card (GaloisField p n) (by infer_instance)]
  simp_rw [Finset.card_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.abs_tracePhaseFiberCard_sub_le_of_upper
statement:
private theorem abs_tracePhaseFiberCard_sub_le_of_upper
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (E : ℝ) (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hupper : ∀ b : ZMod p,
      (tracePhaseFiberCard f n b : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) + E)
    (b : ZMod p) :
    |(tracePhaseFiberCard f n b : ℝ) - (p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1)| ≤
      ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : Fintype (GaloisField p n) := Fintype.ofFinite (GaloisField p n)
  let T : Finset (ZMod p) := Finset.univ.erase b
  have hcardT : T.card = p - 1 := by
    dsimp [T]
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ b), Finset.card_univ,
      ZMod.card]
  have hrest : ∑ c ∈ T, (tracePhaseFiberCard f n c : ℝ) ≤
      ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) + E) := by
    calc
      ∑ c ∈ T, (tracePhaseFiberCard f n c : ℝ) ≤
          ∑ _c ∈ T, ((p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) + E) := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun c hc ↦ hupper c
      _ = (T.card : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) + E) := by
        simp
        ring
      _ = ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) + E) := by
        rw [hcardT]
  have hsumReal : ∑ c : ZMod p, (tracePhaseFiberCard f n c : ℝ) =
      (p : ℝ) ^ n := by
    exact_mod_cast sum_tracePhaseFiberCard f hn.ne'
  have hsplit :
      (∑ c ∈ T, (tracePhaseFiberCard f n c : ℝ)) +
          tracePhaseFiberCard f n b = (p : ℝ) ^ n := by
    rw [← hsumReal]
    exact Finset.sum_erase_add
      (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod p))
      (fun c ↦ (tracePhaseFiberCard f n c : ℝ)) (Finset.mem_univ b)
  have hpow : (p : ℝ) ^ n = (p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * p := by
    calc
      (p : ℝ) ^ n = (p : ℝ) ^ ((n - 1) + 1) := by
        congr 1
        omega
      _ = (p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * p := by rw [pow_succ]
  have hp2 : 2 ≤ p := (Fact.out : p.Prime).two_le
  have hpminus : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ p - 1)
  have hpmreal : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (p : ℝ) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ p)]
    norm_num
  rw [hpmreal] at hrest hpminus ⊢
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · rw [hpow] at hsplit
    nlinarith
  · have hb := hupper b
    nlinarith

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.stepanov_error_le_sqrt
statement:
private theorem stepanov_error_le_sqrt
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {d n : ℕ}
    (par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ((par.S + d * (p - 1) * p ^ (n - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / par.R ≤
      ((8 * d ^ 2 * p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt p) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos
  have hp1 : 1 < p := (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt
  have hn0 : 0 < n := par.n_pos
  have hR0 : 0 < par.R := by
    rw [par.R_eq]
    exact Nat.mul_pos hp0 par.K_pos
  let A := p ^ (par.u - 2)
  have hu2 : 2 ≤ par.u := by
    by_contra hu
    have huexp : par.u - 2 = 0 := by omega
    have hK := par.K_eq
    rw [huexp, pow_zero] at hK
    have hdiv : 1 / (2 * d) = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega)
    rw [hdiv] at hK
    have hKpos := par.K_pos
    omega
  have hAle : A ≤ 4 * d * par.K := by
    have hlt := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ A (by omega : 0 < 2 * d)
    have hK := par.K_eq
    dsimp [A] at hlt
    rw [← hK] at hlt
    calc
      A ≤ 2 * d * (par.K + 1) := Nat.le_of_lt hlt
      _ ≤ 4 * d * par.K := by
        nlinarith [par.two_mul_d_le_K]
  have hpowStep : p ^ n = p ^ (n - 1) * p := by
    calc
      p ^ n = p ^ ((n - 1) + 1) := by congr 1; omega
      _ = p ^ (n - 1) * p := by rw [pow_succ]
  have hSle : par.S ≤ p ^ n := by
    rw [par.S_eq]
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right hp0 (Nat.sub_le n 2)
  have hterm : d * (p - 1) * p ^ (n - 1) ≤ d * p ^ n := by
    calc
      d * (p - 1) * p ^ (n - 1) ≤ d * p * p ^ (n - 1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left d (Nat.sub_le p 1))
      _ = d * (p ^ (n - 1) * p) := by ring
      _ = d * p ^ n := by rw [hpowStep]
  have hnum : par.S + d * (p - 1) * p ^ (n - 1) ≤ 2 * d * p ^ n := by
    calc
      par.S + d * (p - 1) * p ^ (n - 1) ≤ p ^ n + d * p ^ n :=
        Nat.add_le_add hSle hterm
      _ ≤ 2 * d * p ^ n := by
        have hpowpos : 0 < p ^ n := pow_pos hp0 _
        nlinarith
  have hnle : n ≤ 2 * par.u + 1 := by
    have h := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ n (by norm_num : 0 < 2)
    rw [← par.u_eq] at h
    omega
  have hsqrt1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt p := by
    rw [Real.one_le_sqrt]
    exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_le
  have hsqrtpow : (p : ℝ) ^ par.u ≤ (Real.sqrt p) ^ n := by
    calc
      (p : ℝ) ^ par.u = (Real.sqrt p) ^ (2 * par.u) := by
        rw [pow_mul, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      _ ≤ (Real.sqrt p) ^ n := by
        apply pow_le_pow_right₀ hsqrt1
        simpa [par.u_eq, Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.div_mul_le_self n 2
  have hdecomp : p ^ (2 * par.u + 1) = p ^ 3 * A * p ^ par.u := by
    dsimp [A]
    calc
      p ^ (2 * par.u + 1) = p ^ (3 + (par.u - 2) + par.u) := by
        congr 1
        omega
      _ = p ^ 3 * p ^ (par.u - 2) * p ^ par.u := by
        simp only [pow_add]
  have hpower : (p : ℝ) ^ n ≤
      (p : ℝ) ^ 3 * A * (Real.sqrt p) ^ n := by
    calc
      (p : ℝ) ^ n ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (2 * par.u + 1) := by
        exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_le) hnle
      _ = (p : ℝ) ^ 3 * A * (p : ℝ) ^ par.u := by
        exact_mod_cast hdecomp
      _ ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ 3 * A * (Real.sqrt p) ^ n := by
        gcongr
  have hnumReal :
      ((par.S + d * (p - 1) * p ^ (n - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        (2 * d * p ^ n : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnum
  have hAleReal : (A : ℝ) ≤ (4 * d * par.K : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hAle
  have hbound :
      ((par.S + d * (p - 1) * p ^ (n - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        ((8 * d ^ 2 * p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (Real.sqrt p) ^ n * par.R := by
    calc
      ((par.S + d * (p - 1) * p ^ (n - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          (2 * d : ℕ) * (p : ℝ) ^ n := by
        simpa using hnumReal
      _ ≤ (2 * d : ℕ) *
          ((p : ℝ) ^ 3 * A * (Real.sqrt p) ^ n) := by
        gcongr
      _ ≤ (2 * d : ℕ) *
          ((p : ℝ) ^ 3 * (4 * d * par.K : ℕ) *
            (Real.sqrt p) ^ n) := by
        gcongr
      _ = ((8 * d ^ 2 * p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (Real.sqrt p) ^ n * par.R := by
        rw [par.R_eq]
        push_cast
        ring
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast hR0)).2
  simpa [mul_assoc] using hbound

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.tracePhaseFiberCard_eq_of_natDegree_one
statement:
private theorem tracePhaseFiberCard_eq_of_natDegree_one
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hfdeg : f.natDegree = 1)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (b : ZMod p) :
    tracePhaseFiberCard f n b = p ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : Fintype (GaloisField p n) := Fintype.ofFinite (GaloisField p n)
  let a := f.coeff 1
  let c := f.coeff 0
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hf
    rw [hf, Polynomial.natDegree_zero] at hfdeg
    omega
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
    have hc : f.coeff 1 = f.leadingCoeff := by
      rw [← hfdeg]
      exact Polynomial.coeff_natDegree
    dsimp [a]
    rw [hc]
    exact Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hf0
  have hf : f = C a * X + C c := by
    simpa [a, c] using Polynomial.eq_X_add_C_of_natDegree_le_one (le_of_eq hfdeg)
  let ell : GaloisField p n →ₗ[ZMod p] ZMod p :=
    (Algebra.trace (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)).comp
      (LinearMap.mulLeft (ZMod p)
        (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n) a))
  have haE : algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n) a ≠ 0 :=
    by
      intro h
      apply ha
      apply (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)).injective
      simpa using h
  have hellSurj : Function.Surjective ell := by
    have hnondeg :=
      (traceForm_nondegenerate (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)).1
        (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n) a)
    simp_rw [Algebra.traceForm_apply] at hnondeg
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y : GaloisField p n,
        Algebra.trace (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)
          (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n) a * y) ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! h
      exact haE (hnondeg h)
    have hellY : ell y ≠ 0 := by simpa [ell] using hy
    intro t
    refine ⟨(t / ell y) • y, ?_⟩
    rw [map_smul]
    change (t / ell y) * ell y = t
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ t hellY
  let target := fun r : ZMod p ↦ r -
    Algebra.trace (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)
      (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n) c)
  have heval (x : GaloisField p n) :
      Algebra.trace (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)
          (f.eval₂ (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)) x) =
        ell x + Algebra.trace (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)
          (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n) c) := by
    simp [hf, ell]
  have hphase (r : ZMod p) : tracePhaseFiberCard f n r =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun x : GaloisField p n ↦ ell x = target r).card := by
    simp only [tracePhaseFiberCard]
    apply congrArg Finset.card
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    rw [heval]
    dsimp [target]
    constructor <;> intro h
    · linear_combination h
    · linear_combination h
  have hall (r s : ZMod p) :
      tracePhaseFiberCard f n r = tracePhaseFiberCard f n s := by
    rw [hphase, hphase]
    apply AddMonoidHom.card_fiber_eq_of_mem_range ell.toAddMonoidHom
    · rcases hellSurj (target r) with ⟨x, hx⟩
      exact ⟨x, hx⟩
    · rcases hellSurj (target s) with ⟨x, hx⟩
      exact ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hsum := sum_tracePhaseFiberCard f hn.ne'
  have hsumconst : ∑ r : ZMod p, tracePhaseFiberCard f n r =
      ∑ _r : ZMod p, tracePhaseFiberCard f n b := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r hr
    exact hall r b
  rw [hsumconst] at hsum
  have heq : p * tracePhaseFiberCard f n b = p * p ^ (n - 1) := by
    simpa [ZMod.card, show p ^ n = p * p ^ (n - 1) by
      calc
        p ^ n = p ^ ((n - 1) + 1) := by congr 1; omega
        _ = p * p ^ (n - 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring] using hsum
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos heq

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.additive_stepanov_point_count
statement:
theorem additive_stepanov_point_count
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p))
    (hpos : 0 < f.natDegree) (hsmall : f.natDegree < p) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, ∀ b : ZMod p,
      |(tracePhaseFiberCard f n b : ℝ) - (p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1)| ≤
        C * (Real.sqrt p) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  let d := f.natDegree
  by_cases hd1 : d = 1
  · refine ⟨0, le_rfl, 1, ?_⟩
    intro n hn b
    have heq := tracePhaseFiberCard_eq_of_natDegree_one f
      (by simpa [d] using hd1) (n := n) (by omega) b
    rw [heq]
    push_cast
    simp
  · have hd2 : 2 ≤ d := by
      dsimp [d]
      omega
    obtain ⟨N₀, hparameters⟩ := exists_additive_stepanov_parameters
      p d (Fact.out : p.Prime) hd2 (by simpa [d] using hsmall)
    let C : ℝ := ((8 * d ^ 2 * p ^ 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    refine ⟨C, by positivity, max N₀ 1, ?_⟩
    intro n hn b
    have hnN : N₀ ≤ n := (Nat.le_max_left _ _).trans hn
    have hn0 : 0 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_lt_one.trans_le
      (Nat.le_max_right N₀ 1)) hn
    let par : AdditiveStepanovParameters p d n :=
      Classical.choice (hparameters n hnN)
    let E : ℝ :=
      ((par.S + d * (p - 1) * p ^ (n - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / par.R
    have hE : 0 ≤ E := by positivity
    have hupper : ∀ c : ZMod p,
        (tracePhaseFiberCard f n c : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) + E := by
      intro c
      exact stepanov_traceFiberCard_upper par f (by rfl)
        (by simpa [d] using hpos) (by simpa [d] using hsmall) c
    have habs := abs_tracePhaseFiberCard_sub_le_of_upper
      f hn0 E hE hupper b
    have herror : E ≤ ((8 * d ^ 2 * p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (Real.sqrt p) ^ n := stepanov_error_le_sqrt par hd2
    calc
      |(tracePhaseFiberCard f n b : ℝ) - (p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1)| ≤
          ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * E := habs
      _ ≤ ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (((8 * d ^ 2 * p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt p) ^ n) := by
        gcongr
      _ ≤ C * (Real.sqrt p) ^ n := by
        dsimp [C]
        have hpminus : p - 1 ≤ p := Nat.sub_le p 1
        have hcoef : (p - 1) * (8 * d ^ 2 * p ^ 2) ≤
            8 * d ^ 2 * p ^ 3 := by
          calc
            (p - 1) * (8 * d ^ 2 * p ^ 2) ≤
                p * (8 * d ^ 2 * p ^ 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hpminus
            _ = 8 * d ^ 2 * p ^ 3 := by ring
        calc
          ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
                (((8 * d ^ 2 * p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt p) ^ n) =
              (((p - 1) * (8 * d ^ 2 * p ^ 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
                (Real.sqrt p) ^ n := by push_cast; ring
          _ ≤ ((8 * d ^ 2 * p ^ 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
                (Real.sqrt p) ^ n := by gcongr

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.eraseConstant_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem eraseConstant_coeff_zero {k : Type*} [CommRing k]
    (f : Polynomial k) :
    (eraseConstant f).coeff 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [eraseConstant]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.eraseConstant_natDegree
statement:
theorem eraseConstant_natDegree {k : Type*} [CommRing k]
    (f : Polynomial k) (hpos : 0 < f.natDegree) :
    (eraseConstant f).natDegree = f.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_sub_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt
  simpa only [Polynomial.natDegree_C] using hpos

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.norm_constantTwist_of_finite
statement:
theorem norm_constantTwist_of_finite
    {k : Type*} [CommRing k] [Fintype k]
    (psi : AddChar k ℂ) (f : Polynomial k) :
    ‖constantTwist psi f‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  let c := f.coeff 0
  let e : ℕ := Fintype.card k
  have hcard : e • c = 0 := by
    simp [e]
  have hpow : (psi c) ^ e = 1 := by
    rw [← psi.map_nsmul_eq_pow, hcard, psi.map_zero_eq_one]
  have he : e ≠ 0 := Fintype.card_ne_zero
  simp [constantTwist, c, Complex.norm_eq_one_of_pow_eq_one hpow he]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_monic
statement:
theorem toPolynomial_monic {k : Type*} [CommRing k] {n : ℕ}
    (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n) : A.toPolynomial.Monic
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add
  exact (Polynomial.degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt <|
    (Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe n)).2 fun i _hi ↦
      (Polynomial.degree_monomial_le _ _).trans_lt <|
        WithBot.coe_lt_coe.2 (show n - 1 - i.1 < n by omega)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_natDegree
statement:
theorem toPolynomial_natDegree {k : Type*} [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k]
    {n : ℕ} (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n) :
    A.toPolynomial.natDegree = n
proof:
:= by
  have htail :
      Polynomial.degree
          (∑ i : Fin n, Polynomial.monomial (n - 1 - i.1) (A.coeff i)) < n :=
    (Polynomial.degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt <|
      (Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe n)).2 fun i _hi ↦
        (Polynomial.degree_monomial_le _ _).trans_lt <|
          WithBot.coe_lt_coe.2 (show n - 1 - i.1 < n by omega)
  rw [toPolynomial, Polynomial.natDegree_add_eq_left_of_degree_lt (by simpa using htail),
    Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.monicEncodingEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem monicEncodingEquiv_apply
    {k : Type*} [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] {n : ℕ}
    (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n) :
    (monicEncodingEquiv k n A).1 = A.toPolynomial
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp only [monicEncodingEquiv, MonicDegreePolynomial.coeffEquiv,
    reverseCoordinatesEquiv, Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv, LinearEquiv.symm_mk,
    LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, Polynomial.monicEquivDegreeLT,
    Equiv.symm_mk, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.coe_fn_mk,
    LinearEquiv.coe_toEquiv, LinearEquiv.coe_mk, Polynomial.coeff_add,
    Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff,
    MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial, add_right_inj]
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv Fin.revPerm
  intro i
  have hi : i.1 + 1 ≤ n := i.isLt
  have hrev : n - 1 - (n - (i.1 + 1)) = i.1 := by omega
  simp [Fin.val_rev, hrev]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_ofPolynomial
statement:
theorem MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_ofPolynomial
    {k : Type*} [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] {n : ℕ}
    (P : Polynomial k) (hPmonic : P.Monic)
    (hPdegree : P.natDegree = n) :
    (MonicDegreePolynomial.ofPolynomial P hPmonic hPdegree).toPolynomial = P
proof:
:= by
  rw [← monicEncodingEquiv_apply]
  exact congr_arg Subtype.val ((monicEncodingEquiv k n).apply_symm_apply
    ⟨P, hPmonic, hPdegree⟩)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.MonicDegreePolynomial.ofPolynomial_toPolynomial
statement:
theorem MonicDegreePolynomial.ofPolynomial_toPolynomial
    {k : Type*} [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] {n : ℕ}
    (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n) :
    MonicDegreePolynomial.ofPolynomial A.toPolynomial
      A.toPolynomial_monic A.toPolynomial_natDegree = A
proof:
:= by
  apply (monicEncodingEquiv k n).injective
  apply Subtype.ext
  simpa only [monicEncodingEquiv_apply] using
    MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_ofPolynomial A.toPolynomial
      A.toPolynomial_monic A.toPolynomial_natDegree

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_mul
statement:
theorem MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_mul
    {k : Type*} [CommRing k] {n m : ℕ}
    (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n) (B : MonicDegreePolynomial k m) :
    (A.mul B).toPolynomial = A.toPolynomial * B.toPolynomial
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : (0 : k) = 1
  · let _ : Subsingleton k := subsingleton_of_zero_eq_one h
    apply Subsingleton.elim
  · let _ : Nontrivial k := nontrivial_of_ne 0 1 h
    let P := A.toPolynomial * B.toPolynomial
    have hPmonic : P.Monic := A.toPolynomial_monic.mul B.toPolynomial_monic
    have hPdegree : P.natDegree = n + m := by
      simpa only [P, A.toPolynomial_natDegree, B.toPolynomial_natDegree] using
        A.toPolynomial_monic.natDegree_mul B.toPolynomial_monic
    change (A.mul B).toPolynomial = P
    rw [← MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_ofPolynomial P hPmonic hPdegree]
    congr 1
    apply congrArg MonicDegreePolynomial.mk
    funext i
    simp only [reverseCoordinatesEquiv, Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv,
      LinearEquiv.symm_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
      Polynomial.monicEquivDegreeLT, Equiv.symm_mk, Equiv.symm_trans,
      Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, LinearEquiv.coe_symm_toEquiv,
      LinearEquiv.coe_mk, Fin.val_rev, P]
    have hi : i.1 < n + m := i.isLt
    have hidx : n + m - 1 - i.1 = n + m - (i.1 + 1) := by omega
    rw [hidx, Polynomial.eraseLead_coeff_of_ne]
    simpa only [P] using (show n + m - (i.1 + 1) ≠ P.natDegree by
      rw [hPdegree]
      omega)

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.sum_antidiagonal_Ioo_eq_sum_fin
statement:
private theorem sum_antidiagonal_Ioo_eq_sum_fin
    {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (m : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) :
    (∑ a ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m with a.1 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 m, f a.1 a.2) =
      ∑ j : Fin (m - 1), f (j.1 + 1) (m - (j.1 + 1))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m - 1), f (j + 1) (m - (j + 1)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_nbij (fun a : ℕ × ℕ ↦ a.1 - 1)
      · intro a ha
        have ha' := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
        have haI : 0 < a.1 ∧ a.1 < m := ha'.2
        simp only [Finset.mem_range]
        omega
      · intro a ha b hb hab
        have ha' := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
        have hb' := Finset.mem_filter.mp hb
        have haSum : a.1 + a.2 = m := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp ha'.1
        have hbSum : b.1 + b.2 = m := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hb'.1
        have haI : 0 < a.1 ∧ a.1 < m := ha'.2
        have hbI : 0 < b.1 ∧ b.1 < m := hb'.2
        change a.1 - 1 = b.1 - 1 at hab
        apply Prod.ext
        · omega
        · omega
      · intro j hj
        have hj' : j < m - 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
        refine ⟨(j + 1, m - (j + 1)), ?_, ?_⟩
        · apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
          constructor
          · apply Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mpr
            omega
          · change 0 < j + 1 ∧ j + 1 < m
            omega
        · change (j + 1 : ℕ) - 1 = j
          omega
      · intro a ha
        have ha' := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
        have haSum : a.1 + a.2 = m := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp ha'.1
        have haI : 0 < a.1 ∧ a.1 < m := ha'.2
        congr 2 <;> omega
    _ = _ := (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
      (fun j ↦ f (j + 1) (m - (j + 1))) (m - 1)).symm

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.psum_eq_neg_waring_recurrence
statement:
private theorem psum_eq_neg_waring_recurrence
    (sigma : Type*) [Fintype sigma] (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    MvPolynomial.psum sigma R m =
      -((m : MvPolynomial sigma R) *
          ((-1) ^ m * MvPolynomial.esymm sigma R m) +
        ∑ j : Fin (m - 1),
          ((-1) ^ (j.1 + 1) * MvPolynomial.esymm sigma R (j.1 + 1)) *
            MvPolynomial.psum sigma R (m - (j.1 + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPolynomial.psum_eq_mul_esymm_sub_sum sigma R m hm,
    sum_antidiagonal_Ioo_eq_sum_fin m
      (fun a b ↦ (-1) ^ a * MvPolynomial.esymm sigma R a *
        MvPolynomial.psum sigma R b)]
  rw [pow_succ]
  ring

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.eval_waringVariable_eq
statement:
private theorem eval_waringVariable_eq
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (r u : Fin n → R)
    (hu : ∀ (j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ n),
      u ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ =
        MvPolynomial.eval r
          ((-1) ^ j * MvPolynomial.esymm (Fin n) R j))
    (j : ℕ) (hjpos : 0 < j) :
    MvPolynomial.eval u (waringVariable R n j) =
      MvPolynomial.eval r
        ((-1) ^ j * MvPolynomial.esymm (Fin n) R j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ n
  · simp [waringVariable, hj, hu j hj]
  · have hnj : n < j := by omega
    have hempty : Finset.powersetCard j (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) = ∅ :=
      Finset.powersetCard_eq_empty.mpr (by simpa using hnj)
    simp [waringVariable, hj, MvPolynomial.esymm, hempty]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.eval_waringPowerSum_eq_psum
statement:
private theorem eval_waringPowerSum_eq_psum
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (r u : Fin n → R)
    (hu : ∀ (j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ n),
      u ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ =
        MvPolynomial.eval r
          ((-1) ^ j * MvPolynomial.esymm (Fin n) R j))
    (m : ℕ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval u (waringPowerSum R n m) =
      MvPolynomial.eval r (MvPolynomial.psum (Fin n) R m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h m ih =>
      by_cases hm : m = 0
      · subst m
        simp [waringPowerSum, MvPolynomial.psum]
      · rw [waringPowerSum, dif_neg hm,
          psum_eq_neg_waring_recurrence (Fin n) R m (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm)]
        simp only [map_neg, map_add, map_mul, map_natCast, map_sum]
        congr 2
        · rw [eval_waringVariable_eq R r u hu m (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm), map_mul]
        · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _hj
          rw [eval_waringVariable_eq R r u hu (j.1 + 1) (by omega),
            ih (m - (j.1 + 1)) (by omega), map_mul]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.map_waringVariable
statement:
private theorem map_waringVariable
    {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (phi : R →+* S)
    (n j : ℕ) :
    MvPolynomial.map phi (waringVariable R n j) = waringVariable S n j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ n <;> simp [waringVariable, h]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.map_waringPowerSum
statement:
private theorem map_waringPowerSum
    {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (phi : R →+* S)
    (n m : ℕ) :
    MvPolynomial.map phi (waringPowerSum R n m) = waringPowerSum S n m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h m ih =>
      rw [waringPowerSum, waringPowerSum]
      by_cases hm : m = 0
      · simp [hm]
      · simp only [dif_neg hm, map_neg, map_add, map_mul, map_natCast, map_sum,
          map_waringVariable phi]
        congr 3
        funext j
        rw [ih (m - (j.1 + 1)) (by omega)]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_coeff_waring
statement:
private theorem MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_coeff_waring
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {n j : ℕ}
    (A : MonicDegreePolynomial R n) (hj : 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ n) :
    A.toPolynomial.coeff (n - j) = A.coeff ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial, Polynomial.coeff_add,
    Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, if_neg (by omega : n - j ≠ n), zero_add]
  rw [← Polynomial.lcoeff_apply, map_sum]
  change (∑ i : Fin n,
    (Polynomial.monomial (n - 1 - i.1) (A.coeff i)).coeff (n - j)) = _
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
  let i0 : Fin n := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
  calc
    _ = if n - 1 - i0.1 = n - j then A.coeff i0 else 0 :=
      Fintype.sum_eq_single i0 (by
        intro i hi
        exact if_neg (by
          intro heq
          apply hi
          apply Fin.ext
          dsimp [i0]
          omega))
    _ = _ := by
      rw [if_pos (by dsimp [i0]; omega)]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.eval_psum_eq_multiset_map_sum
statement:
private theorem eval_psum_eq_multiset_map_sum
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [DecidableEq R]
    {n : ℕ} (s : Multiset R) (e : Fin n ≃ s) (m : ℕ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun i ↦ (e i : R))
        (MvPolynomial.psum (Fin n) R m) =
      (s.map fun x ↦ x ^ m).sum
proof:
:= by
  have hr :
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).val.map (fun i ↦ (e i : R)) = s := by
    have he : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).map e.toEmbedding =
        (Finset.univ : Finset s) := by
      ext x
      simp
    have heval : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).val.map e.toEmbedding =
        (Finset.univ : Finset s).val := by
      simpa only [Finset.map_val] using congrArg Finset.val he
    change (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).val.map
      ((fun x : s ↦ (x : R)) ∘ e.toEmbedding) = s
    rw [← Multiset.map_map, heval, Multiset.map_univ_coe]
  simp only [MvPolynomial.psum, map_sum, map_pow, MvPolynomial.eval_X]
  change ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).val.map
    (fun i ↦ ((e i : R) ^ m))).sum = _
  have hmap :
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).val.map (fun i ↦ ((e i : R) ^ m)) =
        s.map (fun x ↦ x ^ m) := by
    change (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).val.map
      ((fun x : R ↦ x ^ m) ∘ fun i ↦ (e i : R)) = _
    rw [← Multiset.map_map, hr]
  rw [hmap]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.monicPowerSum_eq_sum_roots
statement:
theorem monicPowerSum_eq_sum_roots
    {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] {n : ℕ}
    (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n)
    (hA : (A.toPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K)).Splits) (m : ℕ) :
    algebraMap k K (monicPowerSum A m) =
      ((A.toPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K)).roots.map fun x ↦ x ^ m).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let phi : k →+* K := algebraMap k K
  let q : Polynomial K := A.toPolynomial.map phi
  have hqDegree : q.natDegree = n := by
    simpa only [q, phi, A.toPolynomial_natDegree] using
      A.toPolynomial_monic.natDegree_map phi
  have hsCard : q.roots.card = n := by
    rw [(Polynomial.splits_iff_card_roots.mp hA), hqDegree]
  let e : Fin n ≃ q.roots :=
    (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq (by simpa only [Multiset.card_coe] using hsCard)).symm
  let r : Fin n → K := fun i ↦ (e i : K)
  have hr : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).val.map r = q.roots := by
    have he : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).map e.toEmbedding =
        (Finset.univ : Finset q.roots) := by
      ext x
      simp
    have heval : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).val.map e.toEmbedding =
        (Finset.univ : Finset q.roots).val := by
      simpa only [Finset.map_val] using congrArg Finset.val he
    change (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).val.map
      ((fun x : q.roots ↦ (x : K)) ∘ e.toEmbedding) = q.roots
    rw [← Multiset.map_map, heval, Multiset.map_univ_coe]
  have hu : ∀ (j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ n),
      (phi ∘ A.coeff) ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ =
        MvPolynomial.eval r
          ((-1) ^ j * MvPolynomial.esymm (Fin n) K j) := by
    intro j hj
    have hcoeff : q.coeff (n - j) = phi (A.coeff ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩) := by
      simp only [q, Polynomial.coeff_map, A.toPolynomial_coeff_waring hj]
    have hqMonic : q.Monic := by
      simpa only [q] using A.toPolynomial_monic.map phi
    have hvieta := Polynomial.coeff_eq_esymm_roots_of_splits hA
      (show n - j ≤ q.natDegree by rw [hqDegree]; omega)
    rw [hqDegree, Nat.sub_sub_self hj.2, hqMonic.leadingCoeff, one_mul] at hvieta
    have hesymm :
        MvPolynomial.eval r (MvPolynomial.esymm (Fin n) K j) = q.roots.esymm j := by
      simpa [MvPolynomial.aeval_def, hr] using
        (MvPolynomial.aeval_esymm_eq_multiset_esymm (Fin n) K j r)
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one, hesymm]
    exact hcoeff.symm.trans hvieta
  calc
    algebraMap k K (monicPowerSum A m) =
        MvPolynomial.eval (phi ∘ A.coeff)
          (MvPolynomial.map phi (waringPowerSum k n m)) := by
      exact MvPolynomial.map_eval phi A.coeff (waringPowerSum k n m)
    _ = MvPolynomial.eval (phi ∘ A.coeff) (waringPowerSum K n m) := by
      rw [map_waringPowerSum]
    _ = MvPolynomial.eval r (MvPolynomial.psum (Fin n) K m) :=
      eval_waringPowerSum_eq_psum K r (phi ∘ A.coeff) hu m
    _ = (q.roots.map fun x ↦ x ^ m).sum :=
      eval_psum_eq_multiset_map_sum q.roots e m
    _ = _ := rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.monicPowerSum_mul_of_splits
statement:
private theorem monicPowerSum_mul_of_splits
    {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {n m : ℕ} (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n)
    (B : MonicDegreePolynomial k m)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap k K))
    (hA : (A.toPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K)).Splits)
    (hB : (B.toPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K)).Splits)
    (j : ℕ) :
    monicPowerSum (A.mul B) j = monicPowerSum A j + monicPowerSum B j
proof:
:= by
  apply hinj
  have hC : ((A.mul B).toPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K)).Splits := by
    rw [A.toPolynomial_mul B, Polynomial.map_mul]
    exact hA.mul hB
  rw [map_add]
  rw [monicPowerSum_eq_sum_roots (A.mul B) hC,
    monicPowerSum_eq_sum_roots A hA, monicPowerSum_eq_sum_roots B hB,
    A.toPolynomial_mul B, Polynomial.map_mul,
    Polynomial.roots_mul (mul_ne_zero
      (A.toPolynomial_monic.map (algebraMap k K)).ne_zero
      (B.toPolynomial_monic.map (algebraMap k K)).ne_zero),
    Multiset.map_add, Multiset.sum_add]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.monicPhase_mul
statement:
private theorem monicPhase_mul
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {n m : ℕ}
    (f : Polynomial k) (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n)
    (B : MonicDegreePolynomial k m) :
    monicPhase f (A.mul B) = monicPhase f A + monicPhase f B
proof:
:= by
  let K := AlgebraicClosure k
  let phi : k →+* K := algebraMap k K
  have hinj : Function.Injective phi := FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective k K
  have hA : (A.toPolynomial.map phi).Splits := IsAlgClosed.splits _
  have hB : (B.toPolynomial.map phi).Splits := IsAlgClosed.splits _
  simp only [monicPhase]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _hj
  rw [monicPowerSum_mul_of_splits A B hinj hA hB, mul_add]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.monicWeight_mul
statement:
theorem monicWeight_mul
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {n m : ℕ}
    (psi : AddChar k ℂ) (f : Polynomial k)
    (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n) (B : MonicDegreePolynomial k m) :
    monicWeight psi f (A.mul B) = monicWeight psi f A * monicWeight psi f B
proof:
:= by
  rw [monicWeight, monicWeight, monicWeight, monicPhase_mul,
    AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.MonicPolynomial.encoding_toPolynomial
statement:
theorem encoding_toPolynomial
    {k : Type*} [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k]
    (P : MonicPolynomial k) : P.encoding.toPolynomial = P.1
proof:
:= by
  exact MonicDegreePolynomial.toPolynomial_ofPolynomial P.1 P.2 rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.MonicPolynomial.normalizedIrreducibleFactors_irreducible
statement:
theorem normalizedIrreducibleFactors_irreducible
    {k : Type*} [Field k] (P : MonicPolynomial k)
    {G : MonicPolynomial k}
    (hG : G ∈ P.normalizedIrreducibleFactors) : Irreducible G.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold normalizedIrreducibleFactors at hG
  rw [Multiset.mem_map] at hG
  obtain ⟨H, _hH, rfl⟩ := hG
  exact ((Polynomial.mem_normalizedFactors_iff P.2.ne_zero).mp H.2).1

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.MonicPolynomial.normalizedIrreducibleFactors_prod
statement:
theorem normalizedIrreducibleFactors_prod
    {k : Type*} [Field k] (P : MonicPolynomial k) :
    (P.normalizedIrreducibleFactors.map fun G ↦ G.1).prod = P.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold normalizedIrreducibleFactors
  rw [Multiset.map_map]
  change (Multiset.map Subtype.val
    (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors P.1).attach).prod = _
  rw [Multiset.attach_map_val,
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid.prod_normalizedFactors_eq P.2.ne_zero,
    P.2.normalize_eq_self]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.MonicPolynomial.normalizedIrreducibleFactors_degree_sum
statement:
theorem normalizedIrreducibleFactors_degree_sum
    {k : Type*} [Field k] (P : MonicPolynomial k) :
    (P.normalizedIrreducibleFactors.map fun G ↦ G.1.natDegree).sum =
      P.1.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold normalizedIrreducibleFactors
  rw [Multiset.map_map]
  change (Multiset.map (Polynomial.natDegree ∘ Subtype.val)
    (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors P.1).attach).sum = _
  rw [← Multiset.map_map, Multiset.attach_map_val]
  rw [← Polynomial.natDegree_multiset_prod
    (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors P.1)
    (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.zero_notMem_normalizedFactors P.1),
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid.prod_normalizedFactors_eq P.2.ne_zero,
    P.2.normalize_eq_self]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.monicPolynomialPhase_mul
statement:
private theorem monicPolynomialPhase_mul
    {k : Type*} [Field k] (f : Polynomial k)
    (P Q : MonicPolynomial k) :
    let R : MonicPolynomial k := ⟨P.1 * Q.1, P.2.mul Q.2⟩
    monicPhase f R.encoding =
      monicPhase f P.encoding + monicPhase f Q.encoding
proof:
:= by
  let R : MonicPolynomial k := ⟨P.1 * Q.1, P.2.mul Q.2⟩
  let K := AlgebraicClosure k
  let phi : k →+* K := algebraMap k K
  have hinj : Function.Injective phi :=
    FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective k K
  have hP : (P.encoding.toPolynomial.map phi).Splits := IsAlgClosed.splits _
  have hQ : (Q.encoding.toPolynomial.map phi).Splits := IsAlgClosed.splits _
  have hR : (R.encoding.toPolynomial.map phi).Splits := IsAlgClosed.splits _
  dsimp only
  apply hinj
  rw [map_add]
  simp only [monicPhase, map_sum, map_mul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _hj
  rw [monicPowerSum_eq_sum_roots R.encoding hR,
    monicPowerSum_eq_sum_roots P.encoding hP,
    monicPowerSum_eq_sum_roots Q.encoding hQ]
  rw [MonicPolynomial.encoding_toPolynomial,
    MonicPolynomial.encoding_toPolynomial,
    MonicPolynomial.encoding_toPolynomial]
  change phi (f.coeff j) *
      ((((P.1 * Q.1).map phi).roots.map fun x ↦ x ^ j).sum) = _
  rw [Polynomial.map_mul,
    Polynomial.roots_mul (mul_ne_zero
      (P.2.map phi).ne_zero (Q.2.map phi).ne_zero),
    Multiset.map_add, Multiset.sum_add, mul_add]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.monicPolynomialWeight_mul
statement:
private theorem monicPolynomialWeight_mul
    {k : Type*} [Field k] (psi : AddChar k ℂ)
    (f : Polynomial k) (P Q : MonicPolynomial k) :
    monicPolynomialWeight psi f ⟨P.1 * Q.1, P.2.mul Q.2⟩ =
      monicPolynomialWeight psi f P * monicPolynomialWeight psi f Q
proof:
:= by
  unfold monicPolynomialWeight monicWeight
  rw [monicPolynomialPhase_mul, AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.monicPolynomialWeight_one
statement:
private theorem monicPolynomialWeight_one
    {k : Type*} [Field k] (psi : AddChar k ℂ)
    (f : Polynomial k) :
    monicPolynomialWeight psi f ⟨1, Polynomial.monic_one⟩ = 1
proof:
:= by
  let U : MonicPolynomial k := ⟨1, Polynomial.monic_one⟩
  let w : ℂ := monicPolynomialWeight psi f U
  have hUU : (⟨U.1 * U.1, U.2.mul U.2⟩ : MonicPolynomial k) = U := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [U]
  have hidem : w = w * w := by
    simpa only [w, hUU] using monicPolynomialWeight_mul psi f U U
  have hwne : w ≠ 0 := by
    unfold w monicPolynomialWeight monicWeight
    intro hw
    have hunit :
        psi (monicPhase f U.encoding) *
            psi (-(monicPhase f U.encoding)) = 1 := by
      rw [← psi.map_add_eq_mul]
      simp only [add_neg_cancel, psi.map_zero_eq_one]
    rw [hw, zero_mul] at hunit
    exact zero_ne_one hunit
  change w = 1
  exact (mul_left_cancel₀ hwne (by simpa only [mul_one] using hidem)).symm

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.monic_multiset_prod
statement:
private theorem monic_multiset_prod
    {k : Type*} [Field k] (s : Multiset (MonicPolynomial k)) :
    ((s.map fun G : MonicPolynomial k ↦ G.1).prod).Monic
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons G s ih =>
      simpa only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons] using G.2.mul ih

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.monicPolynomialWeight_multiset_prod
statement:
private theorem monicPolynomialWeight_multiset_prod
    {k : Type*} [Field k] (psi : AddChar k ℂ)
    (f : Polynomial k) (s : Multiset (MonicPolynomial k)) :
    monicPolynomialWeight psi f
        ⟨(s.map fun G : MonicPolynomial k ↦ G.1).prod,
          monic_multiset_prod s⟩ =
      (s.map (monicPolynomialWeight psi f)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      exact monicPolynomialWeight_one psi f
  | cons G s ih =>
      let Q : MonicPolynomial k :=
        ⟨(s.map (fun H : MonicPolynomial k ↦ H.1)).prod,
          monic_multiset_prod s⟩
      calc
        monicPolynomialWeight psi f
            ⟨(Multiset.map (fun H : MonicPolynomial k ↦ H.1)
                (G ::ₘ s)).prod, monic_multiset_prod (G ::ₘ s)⟩ =
            monicPolynomialWeight psi f
              ⟨G.1 * Q.1, G.2.mul Q.2⟩ := by
                apply congrArg (monicPolynomialWeight psi f)
                apply Subtype.ext
                simp [Q]
        _ = monicPolynomialWeight psi f G *
              monicPolynomialWeight psi f Q :=
            monicPolynomialWeight_mul psi f G Q
        _ = monicPolynomialWeight psi f G *
              (s.map (monicPolynomialWeight psi f)).prod := by
            exact congrArg (monicPolynomialWeight psi f G * ·) ih
        _ = ((G ::ₘ s).map (monicPolynomialWeight psi f)).prod := by
            rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.monicWeight_eq_prod_normalizedIrreducibleFactors
statement:
theorem monicWeight_eq_prod_normalizedIrreducibleFactors
    {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (psi : AddChar k ℂ) (f : Polynomial k)
    (P : MonicPolynomial k) :
    monicPolynomialWeight psi f P =
      (P.normalizedIrreducibleFactors.map
        (monicPolynomialWeight psi f)).prod
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s := P.normalizedIrreducibleFactors
  let Q : MonicPolynomial k :=
    ⟨(s.map fun G ↦ G.1).prod, monic_multiset_prod s⟩
  have hPQ : P = Q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact P.normalizedIrreducibleFactors_prod.symm
  calc
    monicPolynomialWeight psi f P = monicPolynomialWeight psi f Q :=
      congrArg (monicPolynomialWeight psi f) hPQ
    _ = (s.map (monicPolynomialWeight psi f)).prod :=
      monicPolynomialWeight_multiset_prod psi f s
    _ = _ := rfl

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.eval_waringVariable_update_lt
statement:
private theorem eval_waringVariable_update_lt
    {k : Type*} [CommRing k] {n d j : ℕ}
    (hdpos : 0 < d) (hdn : d ≤ n) (hjpos : 0 < j) (hjd : j < d)
    (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n) (u v : k) :
    MvPolynomial.eval
        (Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ u)
        (waringVariable k n j) =
      MvPolynomial.eval
        (Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ v)
        (waringVariable k n j)
proof:
:= by
  have hjn : 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ n := by omega
  let ij : Fin n := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
  let id : Fin n := ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩
  have hne : ij ≠ id := by
    intro h
    have hval := congrArg Fin.val h
    dsimp [ij, id] at hval
    omega
  simp [waringVariable, hjn, ij, id, hne]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.eval_waringVariable_update_eq
statement:
private theorem eval_waringVariable_update_eq
    {k : Type*} [CommRing k] {n d : ℕ}
    (hdpos : 0 < d) (hdn : d ≤ n)
    (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n) (u : k) :
    MvPolynomial.eval
        (Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ u)
        (waringVariable k n d) = u
proof:
:= by
  have hdn' : 1 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ n := by omega
  simp [waringVariable, hdn']

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.eval_waringPowerSum_update_lt
statement:
private theorem eval_waringPowerSum_update_lt
    {k : Type*} [CommRing k] {n d : ℕ}
    (hdpos : 0 < d) (hdn : d ≤ n)
    (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n) (u v : k)
    (m : ℕ) (hmd : m < d) :
    MvPolynomial.eval
        (Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ u)
        (waringPowerSum k n m) =
      MvPolynomial.eval
        (Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ v)
        (waringPowerSum k n m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h m ih =>
      rw [waringPowerSum]
      by_cases hm : m = 0
      · simp [hm]
      · rw [dif_neg hm]
        simp only [map_neg, map_add, map_mul, map_natCast, map_sum]
        congr 2
        · rw [eval_waringVariable_update_lt hdpos hdn
            (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm) hmd A u v]
        · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _hj
          rw [eval_waringVariable_update_lt hdpos hdn (by omega)
            (by omega) A u v,
            ih (m - (j.1 + 1)) (by omega) (by omega)]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.eval_waringPowerSum_update_eq
statement:
private theorem eval_waringPowerSum_update_eq
    {k : Type*} [CommRing k] {n d : ℕ}
    (hdpos : 0 < d) (hdn : d ≤ n)
    (A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n) (u : k) :
    MvPolynomial.eval
        (Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ u)
        (waringPowerSum k n d) =
      -(d : k) * u +
        MvPolynomial.eval
          (Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ 0)
          (waringPowerSum k n d)
proof:
:= by
  have hdne : d ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt hdpos
  rw [waringPowerSum, dif_neg hdne]
  simp only [map_neg, map_add, map_mul, map_natCast, map_sum]
  rw [eval_waringVariable_update_eq hdpos hdn A u,
    eval_waringVariable_update_eq hdpos hdn A 0]
  have hsum :
      (∑ j : Fin (d - 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval
            (Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ u)
            (waringVariable k n (j.1 + 1)) *
          MvPolynomial.eval
            (Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ u)
            (waringPowerSum k n (d - (j.1 + 1)))) =
        ∑ j : Fin (d - 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval
              (Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ 0)
              (waringVariable k n (j.1 + 1)) *
            MvPolynomial.eval
              (Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ 0)
              (waringPowerSum k n (d - (j.1 + 1))) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _hj
    rw [eval_waringVariable_update_lt hdpos hdn (by omega)
      (by omega) A u 0,
      eval_waringPowerSum_update_lt hdpos hdn A u 0
        (d - (j.1 + 1)) (by omega)]
  rw [hsum]
  ring

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.monicPhase_affine_last
statement:
theorem monicPhase_affine_last
    {k : Type*} [CommRing k] {d : ℕ}
    (f : Polynomial k) (hd : f.natDegree = d) (hdpos : 0 < d)
    (n : ℕ) (hdn : d ≤ n) :
    ∀ A : MonicDegreePolynomial k n, ∀ u : k,
      monicPhase f
          ⟨Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ u⟩ =
        -(d : k) * f.leadingCoeff * u +
          monicPhase f
            ⟨Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ 0⟩
proof:
:= by
  intro A u
  have hfne : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hf
    subst f
    simp only [Polynomial.natDegree_zero] at hd
    omega
  have hdmem : d ∈ f.support := by
    apply Polynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr
    rw [← hd, Polynomial.coeff_natDegree]
    exact Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hfne
  have hcoeff : f.coeff d = f.leadingCoeff := by
    rw [← hd, Polynomial.coeff_natDegree]
  have hterm : ∀ j ∈ f.support,
      f.coeff j *
          monicPowerSum
            (⟨Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ u⟩ :
              MonicDegreePolynomial k n) j =
        (if j = d then -(d : k) * f.leadingCoeff * u else 0) +
          f.coeff j *
            monicPowerSum
              (⟨Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ 0⟩ :
                MonicDegreePolynomial k n) j := by
    intro j hj
    have hjle : j ≤ d := by
      rw [← hd]
      exact Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_ne_zero
        (Polynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hj)
    by_cases hjd : j = d
    · subst j
      rw [if_pos rfl, hcoeff]
      unfold monicPowerSum
      rw [eval_waringPowerSum_update_eq hdpos hdn A u]
      ring
    · have hjlt : j < d := by omega
      rw [if_neg hjd, zero_add]
      unfold monicPowerSum
      exact congrArg (f.coeff j * ·)
        (eval_waringPowerSum_update_lt hdpos hdn A u 0 j hjlt)
  unfold monicPhase
  calc
    (∑ j ∈ f.support,
      f.coeff j *
        monicPowerSum
          (⟨Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ u⟩ :
            MonicDegreePolynomial k n) j) =
        ∑ j ∈ f.support,
          ((if j = d then -(d : k) * f.leadingCoeff * u else 0) +
            f.coeff j *
              monicPowerSum
                (⟨Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ 0⟩ :
                  MonicDegreePolynomial k n) j) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      exact hterm
    _ = (∑ j ∈ f.support,
          if j = d then -(d : k) * f.leadingCoeff * u else 0) +
        ∑ j ∈ f.support,
          f.coeff j *
            monicPowerSum
              (⟨Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ 0⟩ :
                MonicDegreePolynomial k n) j := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ = -(d : k) * f.leadingCoeff * u +
        ∑ j ∈ f.support,
          f.coeff j *
            monicPowerSum
              (⟨Function.update A.coeff ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ 0⟩ :
                MonicDegreePolynomial k n) j := by
      congr 1
      simpa only [if_pos] using
        (Finset.sum_eq_single (s := f.support)
          (f := fun j ↦
            if j = d then -(d : k) * f.leadingCoeff * u else 0) d
          (by
            intro j _hj hjd
            simp [hjd])
          (by
            intro hnot
            exact (hnot hdmem).elim))

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.artinCoefficient_eq_zero_of_degree_le
statement:
theorem artinCoefficient_eq_zero_of_degree_le
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (psi : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hpsi : psi ≠ 1)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hf0 : f.coeff 0 = 0)
    (hpos : 0 < f.natDegree) (hsmall : f.natDegree < p)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : f.natDegree ≤ n) :
    artinCoefficient psi f n = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  clear hf0
  let d := f.natDegree
  let i : Fin n := ⟨d - 1, by dsimp [d]; omega⟩
  let c : ZMod p := -(d : ZMod p) * f.leadingCoeff
  have hfne : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hf
    subst f
    simp at hpos
  have hdcast : (d : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hd0
    have hval := congrArg ZMod.val hd0
    rw [ZMod.val_cast_of_lt (by simpa only [d] using hsmall)] at hval
    simp only [ZMod.val_zero] at hval
    omega
  have hlc : f.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 :=
    Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hfne
  have hcne : c ≠ 0 := by
    exact mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr hdcast) hlc
  have hcunit : IsUnit c := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hcne
  have hshift : psi.mulShift c ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    apply hpsi
    exact (AddChar.mulShift_unit_eq_one_iff psi hcunit).mp h
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : ZMod p, psi (c * v) ≠ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hshift
    ext v
    simpa only [AddChar.mulShift_apply, AddChar.one_apply] using h v
  let T := coefficientTranslation i v
  have hphase : ∀ A : MonicDegreePolynomial (ZMod p) n,
      monicPhase f (T A) = c * v + monicPhase f A := by
    intro A
    have haff := monicPhase_affine_last f rfl hpos n hn
    have hzero := haff A (A.coeff i)
    have htranslated := haff A (A.coeff i + v)
    change monicPhase f
        ⟨Function.update A.coeff i (A.coeff i + v)⟩ = _
    change monicPhase f
        ⟨Function.update A.coeff i (A.coeff i + v)⟩ = _ at htranslated
    change monicPhase f
        ⟨Function.update A.coeff i (A.coeff i)⟩ = _ at hzero
    rw [Function.update_eq_self] at hzero
    rw [htranslated, hzero]
    dsimp [c, d]
    ring
  have hweight : ∀ A : MonicDegreePolynomial (ZMod p) n,
      monicWeight psi f (T A) =
        psi (c * v) * monicWeight psi f A := by
    intro A
    unfold monicWeight
    rw [hphase A, psi.map_add_eq_mul]
  let S : ℂ := ∑ A : MonicDegreePolynomial (ZMod p) n,
    monicWeight psi f A
  have hsumInvariant :
      (∑ A : MonicDegreePolynomial (ZMod p) n,
          monicWeight psi f (T A)) = S := by
    exact (T.sum_comp (monicWeight psi f)).trans rfl
  have hscaled : psi (c * v) * S = S := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    calc
      (∑ A : MonicDegreePolynomial (ZMod p) n,
        psi (c * v) * monicWeight psi f A) =
          ∑ A : MonicDegreePolynomial (ZMod p) n,
            monicWeight psi f (T A) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A _hA
        exact (hweight A).symm
      _ = S := hsumInvariant
  have hprod : (psi (c * v) - 1) * S = 0 := by
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, hscaled, sub_self]
  have hS : S = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hprod).resolve_left
    (sub_ne_zero.mpr hv)
  exact hS

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.extensionExponentialSum_bound
statement:
theorem extensionExponentialSum_bound
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (psi : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hpsi : psi ≠ 1)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p))
    (hpos : 0 < f.natDegree) (hsmall : f.natDegree < p) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N,
      ‖extensionExponentialSum psi f n‖ ≤
        C * (Real.sqrt p) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀, N₀, hcount⟩ :=
    additive_stepanov_point_count f hpos hsmall
  refine ⟨(p : ℝ) * C₀, mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hC₀,
    N₀ + 1, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have hnN : N₀ ≤ n := by omega
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  let _ : Fintype (GaloisField p n) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let t : GaloisField p n → ZMod p := fun x ↦
    Algebra.trace (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)
      (f.eval₂ (algebraMap (ZMod p) (GaloisField p n)) x)
  have hgroup :
      extensionExponentialSum psi f n =
        ∑ b : ZMod p, (tracePhaseFiberCard f n b : ℂ) * psi b := by
    rw [extensionExponentialSum]
    change (∑ x : GaloisField p n, psi (t x)) = _
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise (Finset.univ : Finset (GaloisField p n))
      t (fun x ↦ psi (t x))]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _hb
    calc
      (∑ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (GaloisField p n)) with t x = b,
          psi (t x)) =
          ∑ _x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (GaloisField p n)) with t _x = b,
            psi b := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro x hx
              rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2]
      _ = ((Finset.univ : Finset (GaloisField p n)).filter
            (fun x ↦ t x = b)).card • psi b := by
              rw [Finset.sum_const]
      _ = (tracePhaseFiberCard f n b : ℂ) * psi b := by
              simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
              congr 2
  let main : ℝ := (p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1)
  have herror :
      extensionExponentialSum psi f n =
        ∑ b : ZMod p,
          (((tracePhaseFiberCard f n b : ℝ) - main : ℝ) : ℂ) * psi b := by
    rw [hgroup]
    have hdecomp (b : ZMod p) :
        (tracePhaseFiberCard f n b : ℂ) =
          (((tracePhaseFiberCard f n b : ℝ) - main : ℝ) : ℂ) +
            (main : ℂ) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    simp_rw [hdecomp, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, AddChar.sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one hpsi]
    simp
  rw [herror]
  calc
    ‖∑ b : ZMod p,
        (((tracePhaseFiberCard f n b : ℝ) - main : ℝ) : ℂ) * psi b‖ ≤
        ∑ b : ZMod p,
          ‖(((tracePhaseFiberCard f n b : ℝ) - main : ℝ) : ℂ) * psi b‖ :=
      norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ b : ZMod p,
          |(tracePhaseFiberCard f n b : ℝ) - main| := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _hb
      rw [norm_mul, AddChar.norm_apply, mul_one, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_eq_abs]
    _ ≤ ∑ _b : ZMod p, C₀ * (Real.sqrt p) ^ n := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro b _hb
      simpa only [main] using hcount n hnN b
    _ = (p : ℝ) * C₀ * (Real.sqrt p) ^ n := by
      simp [mul_assoc]

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.exists_unbounded_aligned_powers
statement:
theorem exists_unbounded_aligned_powers
    {s : ℕ} (u : Fin s → Circle) :
    ∃ n : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono n ∧
      ∀ i, Filter.Tendsto (fun m ↦ u i ^ n m)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 1)
proof:
:= by
  let v : ℕ → Fin s → Circle := fun k i ↦ u i ^ k
  obtain ⟨a, phi, hphi, hphi_lim⟩ := CompactSpace.tendsto_subseq v
  have hreturn : ∀ B q : ℕ, ∃ e : ℕ, B < e ∧
      ∀ i, dist (u i ^ e) 1 < 1 / ((q : ℝ) + 1) := by
    intro B q
    have hshift :
        Tendsto (fun k ↦ v (phi (k + (B + 1)))) atTop (nhds a) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
        hphi_lim.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat (B + 1))
    have hquot :
        Tendsto (fun k ↦ v (phi (k + (B + 1))) * (v (phi k))⁻¹)
          atTop (nhds 1) := by
      simpa using hshift.mul hphi_lim.inv
    have hrad : 0 < 1 / ((q : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ :=
      (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hquot) (1 / ((q : ℝ) + 1)) hrad
    let e := phi (K + (B + 1)) - phi K
    refine ⟨e, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hgap : phi K + (B + 1) ≤ phi (K + (B + 1)) := by
        simpa [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_assoc] using
          hphi.add_le_nat (B + 1) K
      dsimp only [e]
      omega
    · intro i
      have hle : phi K ≤ phi (K + (B + 1)) :=
        hphi.monotone (Nat.le_add_right K (B + 1))
      have heq :
          (v (phi (K + (B + 1))) * (v (phi K))⁻¹) i = u i ^ e := by
        simp only [v, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.inv_apply]
        exact (pow_sub (u i) hle).symm
      have hdist := hK K le_rfl
      rw [dist_pi_lt_iff hrad] at hdist
      simpa only [Pi.one_apply, heq] using hdist i
  let pick : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ := fun q B ↦ Classical.choose (hreturn B q)
  have pick_gt (q B : ℕ) : B < pick q B :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hreturn B q)).1
  have pick_close (q B : ℕ) (i : Fin s) :
      dist (u i ^ pick q B) 1 < 1 / ((q : ℝ) + 1) :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hreturn B q)).2 i
  let n : ℕ → ℕ :=
    Nat.rec (pick 0 0) (fun q previous ↦ pick (q + 1) previous)
  have hn_succ (q : ℕ) : n (q + 1) = pick (q + 1) (n q) := by
    simp only [n]
  have hn_close (q : ℕ) (i : Fin s) :
      dist (u i ^ n q) 1 < 1 / ((q : ℝ) + 1) := by
    cases q with
    | zero => simpa only [n, Nat.rec_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add] using pick_close 0 0 i
    | succ q =>
        rw [hn_succ]
        exact pick_close (q + 1) (n q) i
  refine ⟨n, strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ (fun q ↦ ?_), ?_⟩
  · rw [hn_succ]
    exact pick_gt (q + 1) (n q)
  · intro i
    apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
    intro epsilon hepsilon
    have hzero :
        Tendsto (fun q : ℕ ↦ 1 / ((q : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
    have heventually :
        ∀ᶠ (q : ℕ) in atTop, 1 / ((q : ℝ) + 1) < epsilon :=
      hzero.eventually_lt_const hepsilon
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp heventually
    exact ⟨N, fun q hq ↦ (hn_close q i).trans (hN q hq)⟩

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.exists_normalized_powerSum_tendsto_maximalMultiplicity
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_powerSum_tendsto_maximalMultiplicity
    (roots : Multiset ℂ) (rho : ℝ) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hle : ∀ z ∈ roots, ‖z‖ ≤ rho)
    (_hmax : ∃ z ∈ roots, ‖z‖ = rho) :
    ∃ n : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono n ∧
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun m ↦
          (roots.map fun z ↦ z ^ n m / (rho : ℂ) ^ n m).sum)
        Filter.atTop
        (nhds (maximalRootMultiplicity roots rho : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : roots ≃ Fin roots.card := by
    simpa using Fintype.equivFin roots
  let phase : Fin roots.card → Circle := fun i ↦
    if hi : ‖((e.symm i : roots) : ℂ)‖ = rho then
      ⟨((e.symm i : roots) : ℂ) / (rho : ℂ), by
        change ((e.symm i : roots) : ℂ) / (rho : ℂ) ∈
          Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1
        rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]
        rw [norm_div, hi, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos hrho, div_self hrho.ne']⟩
    else 1
  obtain ⟨n, hn, halign⟩ := exists_unbounded_aligned_powers phase
  have hrhoC : (rho : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hrho.ne'
  have hterm (x : roots) :
      Tendsto
        (fun m ↦ ((x : ℂ) ^ n m / (rho : ℂ) ^ n m)) atTop
        (nhds (if ‖(x : ℂ)‖ = rho then 1 else 0)) := by
    by_cases hx : ‖(x : ℂ)‖ = rho
    · have hphase :
          ((phase (e x) : Circle) : ℂ) = (x : ℂ) / (rho : ℂ) := by
        simp [phase, hx]
      have hcircle := halign (e x)
      have hcomplex :
          Tendsto (fun m ↦ ((phase (e x) ^ n m : Circle) : ℂ)) atTop
            (nhds (1 : ℂ)) :=
        continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hcircle
      simp only [Circle.coe_pow, hphase, div_pow] at hcomplex
      simpa [hx] using hcomplex
    · have hxlt : ‖(x : ℂ)‖ < rho :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (hle (x : ℂ) Multiset.coe_mem) hx
      have hratio : ‖(x : ℂ)‖ / rho < 1 := by
        exact (div_lt_one hrho).mpr hxlt
      have hnormRatio : ‖(x : ℂ) / (rho : ℂ)‖ < 1 := by
        simpa [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hrho]
          using hratio
      have hzero :=
        (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_norm_lt_one hnormRatio).comp
          hn.tendsto_atTop
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, div_pow, if_neg hx] using hzero
  have hsum :
      Tendsto
        (fun m ↦ ∑ x : roots,
          (x : ℂ) ^ n m / (rho : ℂ) ^ n m) atTop
        (nhds (∑ x : roots, if ‖(x : ℂ)‖ = rho then 1 else 0)) := by
    simpa only [Finset.sum_attach] using
      tendsto_finsetSum (Finset.univ : Finset roots)
        (fun x _hx ↦ hterm x)
  have hrootSum (m : ℕ) :
      (roots.map fun z ↦ z ^ n m / (rho : ℂ) ^ n m).sum =
        ∑ x : roots, (x : ℂ) ^ n m / (rho : ℂ) ^ n m := by
    have hroots :
        (Finset.univ : Finset roots).val.map (fun x : roots ↦ (x : ℂ)) = roots := by
