      exact Multiset.map_univ_coe roots
    change (roots.map fun z ↦ z ^ n m / (rho : ℂ) ^ n m).sum =
      ((Finset.univ : Finset roots).val.map
        (fun x : roots ↦ (x : ℂ) ^ n m / (rho : ℂ) ^ n m)).sum
    change (roots.map fun z ↦ z ^ n m / (rho : ℂ) ^ n m).sum =
      ((Finset.univ : Finset roots).val.map
        ((fun z : ℂ ↦ z ^ n m / (rho : ℂ) ^ n m) ∘
          fun x : roots ↦ (x : ℂ))).sum
    rw [← Multiset.map_map, hroots]
  have hlimit :
      (∑ x : roots, if ‖(x : ℂ)‖ = rho then (1 : ℂ) else 0) =
        (maximalRootMultiplicity roots rho : ℂ) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_boole]
    norm_cast
    change ((Finset.univ : Finset roots).filter
      (fun x : roots ↦ ‖(x : ℂ)‖ = rho)).card =
        (roots.filter fun z ↦ ‖z‖ = rho).card
    have hroots :
        (Finset.univ : Finset roots).val.map (fun x : roots ↦ (x : ℂ)) = roots := by
      exact Multiset.map_univ_coe roots
    rw [Finset.card_def, Finset.filter_val]
    let p : ℂ → Prop := fun z ↦ ‖z‖ = rho
    let c : roots → ℂ := fun x ↦ (x : ℂ)
    have hfiltered := Multiset.filter_map p c (Finset.univ : Finset roots).val
    calc
      ((Finset.univ : Finset roots).val.filter
          (fun x : roots ↦ ‖(x : ℂ)‖ = rho)).card =
          (((Finset.univ : Finset roots).val.filter
            (fun x : roots ↦ ‖(x : ℂ)‖ = rho)).map c).card := by
            rw [Multiset.card_map]
      _ = (((Finset.univ : Finset roots).val.map c).filter p).card := by
            rw [hfiltered]
            simp only [p, c, Function.comp_apply]
      _ = (roots.filter fun z ↦ ‖z‖ = rho).card := by
            simp only [p, c, hroots]
  refine ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
  simpa only [hrootSum, hlimit] using hsum

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.norm_le_of_power_sum_bound
statement:
theorem norm_le_of_power_sum_bound
    (roots : Multiset ℂ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hpow : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N,
      ‖(roots.map fun z ↦ z ^ n).sum‖ ≤ C * R ^ n) :
    ∀ z ∈ roots, ‖z‖ ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C, hC, N, hbound⟩ := hpow
  intro z hz
  by_contra hzR
  have hRz : R < ‖z‖ := lt_of_not_ge hzR
  have hnonempty : roots.toFinset.Nonempty :=
    ⟨z, Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr hz⟩
  obtain ⟨zmax, hzmaxFin, hzmax⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_max_image roots.toFinset norm hnonempty
  have hzmaxMem : zmax ∈ roots := Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hzmaxFin
  let rho : ℝ := ‖zmax‖
  have hrho : 0 < rho := by
    have := hzmax z (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr hz)
    dsimp only [rho]
    linarith
  have hRrho : R < rho := by
    have := hzmax z (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr hz)
    dsimp only [rho]
    exact hRz.trans_le this
  have hle : ∀ w ∈ roots, ‖w‖ ≤ rho := by
    intro w hw
    exact hzmax w (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr hw)
  have hmax : ∃ w ∈ roots, ‖w‖ = rho := ⟨zmax, hzmaxMem, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hlimit⟩ :=
    exists_normalized_powerSum_tendsto_maximalMultiplicity
      roots rho hrho hle hmax
  let A : ℕ → ℂ := fun m ↦
    (roots.map fun w ↦ w ^ n m / (rho : ℂ) ^ n m).sum
  have hsumDiv (m : ℕ) :
      A m = (roots.map fun w ↦ w ^ n m).sum / (rho : ℂ) ^ n m := by
    simp only [A, div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [Multiset.sum_map_mul_right]
  have heventBound : ∀ᶠ m in atTop,
      ‖A m‖ ≤ C * (R / rho) ^ n m := by
    filter_upwards [hn.tendsto_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop N] with m hm
    rw [hsumDiv, norm_div, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg hrho.le]
    calc
      ‖(Multiset.map (fun w ↦ w ^ n m) roots).sum‖ / rho ^ n m ≤
          (C * R ^ n m) / rho ^ n m :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hbound (n m) hm)
          (pow_nonneg hrho.le _)
      _ = C * (R / rho) ^ n m := by
        rw [div_pow, mul_div_assoc]
  have hratioNonneg : 0 ≤ R / rho := div_nonneg hR hrho.le
  have hratioLt : R / rho < 1 := (div_lt_one hrho).mpr hRrho
  have hright :
      Tendsto (fun m ↦ C * (R / rho) ^ n m) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hbase := tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hratioNonneg hratioLt
    simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.mul (hbase.comp hn.tendsto_atTop)
  have hnormZero : Tendsto (fun m ↦ ‖A m‖) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _)
      heventBound hright
  have hzero : Tendsto A atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr hnormZero
  have hlimitA :
      Tendsto A atTop
        (nhds (maximalRootMultiplicity roots rho : ℂ)) := by
    simpa only [A] using hlimit
  have heq : (maximalRootMultiplicity roots rho : ℂ) = 0 :=
    tendsto_nhds_unique hlimitA hzero
  have hmultPos : 0 < maximalRootMultiplicity roots rho := by
    rw [maximalRootMultiplicity, Multiset.card_pos_iff_exists_mem]
    exact ⟨zmax, Multiset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hzmaxMem, rfl⟩⟩
  exact (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hmultPos)) heq

name: TranslationalTilings.Stepanov.reciprocalRoots_norm_le
statement:
theorem reciprocalRoots_norm_le
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (psi : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ) (hpsi : psi ≠ 1)
    (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)) (hf0 : f.coeff 0 = 0)
    (hpos : 0 < f.natDegree) (hsmall : f.natDegree < p) :
    ∀ omega ∈ reciprocalRoots psi f, ‖omega‖ ≤ Real.sqrt p
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_le_of_power_sum_bound
    (reciprocalRoots psi f) (Real.sqrt p) (Real.sqrt_nonneg p)
  obtain ⟨C, hC, N, hbound⟩ :=
    extensionExponentialSum_bound psi hpsi f hpos hsmall
  refine ⟨C, hC, N + 1, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have hnN : N ≤ n := by omega
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  have htrace :=
    artinLPolynomial_trace_identity psi hpsi f hf0 hpos hsmall hn0
  calc
    ‖((reciprocalRoots psi f).map fun omega ↦ omega ^ n).sum‖ =
        ‖extensionExponentialSum psi f n‖ := by
      rw [htrace, norm_neg]
    _ ≤ C * (Real.sqrt p) ^ n := hbound n hnN

name: LocallyFinite.closure_interior_iUnion_eq
statement:
theorem closure_interior_iUnion_eq (hlocal : LocallyFinite f)
    (hregular : ∀ i, closure (interior (f i)) = f i) :
    closure (interior (⋃ i, f i)) = ⋃ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  have hclosed : ∀ i, IsClosed (f i) := fun i ↦ by
    rw [← hregular i]
    exact isClosed_closure
  apply subset_antisymm
  · exact closure_minimal interior_subset (hlocal.isClosed_iUnion hclosed)
  · rw [iUnion_subset_iff]
    intro i
    rw [← hregular i]
    exact closure_mono (interior_mono (subset_iUnion f i))

name: SimpleGraph.intersectionGraph_adj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intersectionGraph_adj (s : ι → Set X) (i j : ι) :
    (intersectionGraph s).Adj i j ↔ i ≠ j ∧ (s i ∩ s j).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [intersectionGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hij, hij' | hji'⟩
    · exact ⟨hij, hij'⟩
    · exact ⟨hij, by simpa [inter_comm] using hji'⟩
  · rintro ⟨hij, hnonempty⟩
    exact ⟨hij, Or.inl hnonempty⟩

name: SimpleGraph.connected_intersectionGraph
statement:
theorem connected_intersectionGraph [ConnectedSpace X]
    (s : ι → Set X) (hs : _root_.LocallyFinite s)
    (hsc : ∀ i, IsClosed (s i)) (hsn : ∀ i, (s i).Nonempty)
    (hcover : ⋃ i, s i = Set.univ) :
    (intersectionGraph s).Connected
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G := intersectionGraph s
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty X)
  have hx : x ∈ ⋃ i, s i := by rw [hcover]; exact mem_univ x
  simp only [mem_iUnion] at hx
  obtain ⟨root, _⟩ := hx
  rw [connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
  refine ⟨root, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hj
  let I : Set ι := {i | G.Reachable root i}
  let U : Set X := ⋃ i : I, s i
  let W : Set X := ⋃ i : {i // i ∉ I}, s i
  have hUclosed : IsClosed U := by
    exact (hs.comp_injective Subtype.val_injective).isClosed_iUnion fun i ↦ hsc i
  have hWclosed : IsClosed W := by
    exact (hs.comp_injective Subtype.val_injective).isClosed_iUnion fun i ↦ hsc i
  have hUW : U ∪ W = Set.univ := by
    rw [← hcover]
    apply subset_antisymm
    · intro y hy
      rcases hy with hy | hy
      · simp only [U, mem_iUnion] at hy
        obtain ⟨i, hyi⟩ := hy
        exact mem_iUnion_of_mem i.1 hyi
      · simp only [W, mem_iUnion] at hy
        obtain ⟨i, hyi⟩ := hy
        exact mem_iUnion_of_mem i.1 hyi
    · intro y hy
      simp only [mem_iUnion] at hy
      obtain ⟨i, hyi⟩ := hy
      by_cases hi : i ∈ I
      · left
        exact mem_iUnion_of_mem ⟨i, hi⟩ hyi
      · right
        exact mem_iUnion_of_mem ⟨i, hi⟩ hyi
  have hdisj : Disjoint U W := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro y hyU hyW
    simp only [U, mem_iUnion] at hyU
    simp only [W, mem_iUnion] at hyW
    obtain ⟨i, hyi⟩ := hyU
    obtain ⟨k, hyk⟩ := hyW
    have hik : i.1 ≠ k.1 := by
      intro h
      apply k.2
      rw [← h]
      exact i.2
    have hadj : G.Adj i.1 k.1 := by
      rw [show G = intersectionGraph s from rfl, intersectionGraph_adj]
      exact ⟨hik, ⟨y, hyi, hyk⟩⟩
    exact k.2 (i.2.trans hadj.reachable)
  have hcompl : Uᶜ = W := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · intro hy
      have hy' : y ∈ U ∪ W := by rw [hUW]; exact mem_univ y
      rcases hy' with hyU | hyW
      · exact (hy hyU).elim
      · exact hyW
    · intro hyW hyU
      exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hyU hyW
  have hUopen : IsOpen U := by
    rw [← compl_compl U, hcompl]
    exact hWclosed.isOpen_compl
  have hUne : U.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hsn root
    exact ⟨y, mem_iUnion_of_mem ⟨root, Reachable.refl root⟩ hy⟩
  have hUuniv : U = Set.univ :=
    (show IsClopen U from ⟨hUclosed, hUopen⟩).eq_univ hUne
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hsn j
  have hyW : y ∈ W := mem_iUnion_of_mem ⟨j, hj⟩ hy
  have hyU : y ∈ U := by rw [hUuniv]; exact mem_univ y
  exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hyU hyW

name: Tiling.Topology.boundaryLocallyStraightAt_of_disjoint_moving_packings
statement:
theorem boundaryLocallyStraightAt_of_disjoint_moving_packings
    (K : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion)
    {U : Set Plane} {Un : ℕ → Set Plane} {x : Plane}
    (hpacking : ∀ n, IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements (Un n)))
    (hconv : LocallyFellConverges Un U)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, Disjoint (Un n) U)
    (hequal : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K (Un n) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K U)
    (hx : x ∈ frontier (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K U)) :
    BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K U) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let V := vertexSet K.support
  have hVfinite : V.Finite := K.isPolygonal.vertexSet_finite
  have heventual : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, x ∉ V + Un n := by
    have hfinite : ∀ v ∈ V, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, x - v ∉ Un n := by
      intro v hv
      by_cases hmem : x - v ∈ U
      · filter_upwards [hdisjoint] with n hdisj
        intro hxn
        exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj) hxn hmem
      · have havoid := locallyFellConverges_eventually_disjoint_compact hconv
          isCompact_singleton (by
            rw [Set.disjoint_left]
            intro z hzU hzq
            have hz : z = x - v := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hzq
            subst z
            exact hmem hzU)
        filter_upwards [havoid] with n hdisj hxn
        exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj) hxn rfl
    filter_upwards [(hVfinite.eventually_all).2 hfinite] with n hn
    intro h
    obtain ⟨v, hv, u, hu, hxu⟩ := (Set.mem_add.mp h)
    have : x - v ∈ Un n := by
      have hvu : x - v = u := by calc
        x - v = (v + u) - v := by rw [hxu]
        _ = u := by abel
      simpa [hvu] using hu
    exact hn v hv this
  by_contra hnot
  
  have hgood : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      x ∈ Tiling.Polygonal.properVertices
        (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K (Un n)) := by
    filter_upwards [hequal] with n hn
    have hproper : Tiling.Polygonal.IsProperVertex
        (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K (Un n)) x :=
      (Tiling.Polygonal.isProperVertex_iff_of_eventuallyEq hn).2 ⟨hx, hnot⟩
    simpa [Tiling.Polygonal.properVertices] using hproper
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (heventual.and hgood).exists
  rcases hn with ⟨hn, hvertex⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv, u, hu, hxu⟩ :=
    Tiling.Polygonal.properVertexProvenance (hpacking n) x hvertex
  apply hn
  apply Set.mem_add.mpr
  exact ⟨v, hv, u, hu, hxu.symm⟩

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.isPacking_of_locallyFellConverges
statement:
private theorem isPacking_of_locallyFellConverges
    {K : PolygonalRegion}
    {A : ℕ → Set Plane} {L : Set Plane}
    (hA : ∀ n, Tiling.IsPacking K.prototileFamily
      (K.placements (A n)))
    (hconv : Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges A L) :
    Tiling.IsPacking K.prototileFamily
      (K.placements L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint]
  intro s hsL t htL hst
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxs hxt
  let U : Set Plane := {c | x - c ∈ K.openCarrier}
  have hUopen : IsOpen U :=
    isOpen_interior.preimage (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)
  have hsU : s ∈ U := by
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hxs
    simp only [vadd_eq_add] at hxs
    simpa only [U, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hxs
  have htU : t ∈ U := by
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hxt
    simp only [vadd_eq_add] at hxt
    simpa only [U, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hxt
  obtain ⟨rs, hrs, hrsU⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hUopen.mem_nhds hsU)
  obtain ⟨rt, hrt, hrtU⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hUopen.mem_nhds htU)
  let epsilon := min rs (min rt (dist s t / 3))
  have hdist : 0 < dist s t := dist_pos.mpr hst
  have hepsilon : 0 < epsilon := by
    dsimp [epsilon]
    exact lt_min hrs (lt_min hrt (by positivity))
  have heps_rs : epsilon ≤ rs := min_le_left _ _
  have heps_rt : epsilon ≤ rt := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have heps_dist : epsilon ≤ dist s t / 3 :=
    (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hsEventually :=
    locallyFellConverges_eventually_exists_mem_ball hconv hsL hepsilon
  have htEventually :=
    locallyFellConverges_eventually_exists_mem_ball hconv htL hepsilon
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨s', hs'A, hs'dist⟩, ⟨t', ht'A, ht'dist⟩⟩ :=
    (hsEventually.and htEventually).exists
  have hs'U : s' ∈ U := hrsU (by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball]
    exact hs'dist.trans_le heps_rs)
  have ht'U : t' ∈ U := hrtU (by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball]
    exact ht'dist.trans_le heps_rt)
  have hs't' : s' ≠ t' := by
    intro heq
    subst t'
    have htriangle : dist s t ≤ dist s s' + dist s' t := dist_triangle _ _ _
    rw [dist_comm s s'] at htriangle
    have hsBound : dist s' s < dist s t / 3 := hs'dist.trans_le heps_dist
    have htBound : dist s' t < dist s t / 3 := ht'dist.trans_le heps_dist
    linarith
  have hdisjoint :=
    (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K (A n)).mp
      (hA n) hs'A ht'A hs't'
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint
  · rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simpa only [vadd_eq_add, U, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, sub_eq_add_neg,
      add_comm] using hs'U
  · rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simpa only [vadd_eq_add, U, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, sub_eq_add_neg,
      add_comm] using ht'U

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.tilesOn_isClosed
proof:
:= by
  have hPacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.prototileFamily
      (K.placements L) :=
    isPacking_of_locallyFellConverges (fun n ↦ (hT n).2.1) hconv
  have hLocal := packing_centres_locallyFinite hPacking
  let _ : Countable ↥L := hLocal.2.1.to_subtype
  have hBoundaryNull : MeasureTheory.volume
      (⋃ s : L, (s.1 : Plane) +ᵥ frontier K.support) = 0 := by
    apply measure_iUnion_null
    intro s
    simpa only [MeasureTheory.measure_vadd] using K.isPolygonal.volume_frontier
  have hNoBoundary : ∀ᵐ x : Plane ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
      x ∉ ⋃ s : L, (s.1 : Plane) +ᵥ frontier K.support :=
    measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hBoundaryNull
  have hEveryTarget : ∀ᵐ x : Plane ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
      ∀ n : ℕ, (x ∈ E ↔ ∃ s : T n,
        x ∈ ((s : Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)) :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr fun n ↦ (hT n).2.2
  refine ⟨hLocal.2.1, hPacking, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hEveryTarget, hNoBoundary] with x hxTarget hxBoundary
  constructor
  · intro hxE
    by_contra hxOpen
    let C : Set Plane :=
      (fun y : Plane ↦ x - y) '' K.support
    have hCcompact : IsCompact C :=
      K.isPolygonal.isCompact.image (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)
    have hLC : Disjoint L C := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro l hlL hlC
      rcases hlC with ⟨y, hyK, hyl⟩
      change x - y = l at hyl
      have hxy : x - l = y := by
        calc
          x - l = x - (x - y) := by rw [hyl]
          _ = y := sub_sub_cancel x y
      by_cases hyInterior : y ∈ interior K.support
      · apply hxOpen
        refine ⟨⟨l, hlL⟩, ?_⟩
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
        simp only [vadd_eq_add]
        rw [add_comm, ← sub_eq_add_neg, hxy]
        simpa only [PolygonalRegion.openCarrier] using hyInterior
      · have hyFrontier : y ∈ frontier K.support :=
          (mem_frontier_iff_notMem_interior hyK).mpr hyInterior
        apply hxBoundary
        rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
        refine ⟨⟨l, hlL⟩, ?_⟩
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
        simp only [vadd_eq_add]
        rw [add_comm, ← sub_eq_add_neg, hxy]
        exact hyFrontier
    have hEventually := locallyFellConverges_eventually_disjoint_compact
      hconv hCcompact hLC
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hEventually.exists
    obtain ⟨s, hsCover⟩ := (hxTarget n).mp hxE
    have hsC : (s : Plane) ∈ C := by
      refine ⟨x - (s : Plane), ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hsCover
        simp only [vadd_eq_add] at hsCover
        exact interior_subset (by
          simpa only [PolygonalRegion.openCarrier,
            sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hsCover)
      · abel_nf
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hn s.2 hsC
  · intro hxOpen
    change ∃ s : L, x ∈ (s : Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier at hxOpen
    obtain ⟨s, hsOpen⟩ := hxOpen
    let U : Set Plane := {c | x - c ∈ K.openCarrier}
    have hUopen : IsOpen U :=
      isOpen_interior.preimage (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)
    have hsU : (s : Plane) ∈ U := by
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hsOpen
      simp only [vadd_eq_add] at hsOpen
      simpa only [U, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hsOpen
    obtain ⟨epsilon, hepsilon, hballU⟩ :=
      Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hUopen.mem_nhds hsU)
    have hEventually := locallyFellConverges_eventually_exists_mem_ball
      hconv s.2 hepsilon
    obtain ⟨n, y, hyT, hydist⟩ := hEventually.exists
    apply (hxTarget n).mpr
    refine ⟨⟨y, hyT⟩, ?_⟩
    have hyU : y ∈ U := hballU (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hydist)
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simp only [vadd_eq_add]
    simpa only [U, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hyU

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.locallyFell_metrizable
statement:
theorem locallyFell_metrizable (K : PolygonalRegion) (E : Set Plane)
    (T : ℕ → TilingSpace K E) (L : TilingSpace K E) :
    Tendsto T atTop (𝓝 L) ↔
      Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
        (fun n => ((T n).centres : Set Plane)) (L.centres : Set Plane)
proof:
:= by
  let compactify : TilingSpace K E →
      TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Plane) := fun U =>
    Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification
      (U.centres : Set Plane) U.centres.isClosed
  have hcompactify : Continuous compactify := by
    exact continuous_induced_dom
  constructor
  · intro hT
    refine ⟨fun n ↦ (T n).centres.isClosed, L.centres.isClosed, ?_⟩
    have h := (hcompactify.tendsto L).comp hT
    simpa [compactify, Function.comp_def] using h
  · rintro ⟨hclosedT, hclosedL, hT⟩
    have hT' : Filter.Tendsto (compactify ∘ T) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (compactify L)) := by
      simpa [compactify, Function.comp_def] using hT
    rw [show nhds L = Filter.comap compactify (nhds (compactify L)) by
      exact nhds_induced compactify L]
    exact (Filter.tendsto_comap_iff.mpr hT')

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.tilingSpace_compact
statement:
theorem tilingSpace_compact (K : PolygonalRegion) (E : Set Plane) :
    IsCompact (univ : Set (TilingSpace K E))
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCompact_iff_isSeqCompact]
  intro U _hU
  let centres : ℕ → Set Plane := fun n ↦ (U n).centres
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hsep⟩ := exists_packingSeparation K
  obtain ⟨φ, L, hφ, hclosed, _hsepL, hconv⟩ :=
    Tiling.Topology.exists_locallyFellConvergent_subsequence δ hδ centres
      (fun n => (U n).centres.isClosed) (fun n => hsep _ (U n).tilesOn.2.1)
  let V : TilingSpace K E := ⟨⟨L, hclosed⟩,
    tilesOn_isClosed (fun n => (U (φ n)).tilesOn) hconv⟩
  refine ⟨V, Set.mem_univ V, φ, hφ, ?_⟩
  exact (locallyFell_metrizable K E (U ∘ φ) V).mpr hconv

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.translationAction_continuous
statement:
theorem translationAction_continuous (K : PolygonalRegion) (E : Set Plane) :
    Continuous (fun p : aePeriodGroup E × TilingSpace K E =>
      TilingSpace.translate p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_seqContinuous]
  intro p q hpq
  apply (locallyFell_metrizable K E _ _).mpr
  have hcentres := (locallyFell_metrizable K E (fun n => (p n).2) q.2).mp
    ((continuous_snd.tendsto q).comp hpq)
  have hperiods : Tendsto (fun n => ((p n).1 : Plane)) atTop (𝓝 (q.1 : Plane)) :=
    ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).tendsto q).comp hpq
  have h := Tiling.Topology.locallyFell_translate hcentres hperiods
  have heq (g : aePeriodGroup E) (T : TilingSpace K E) :
      (TilingSpace.translate g T).centres = (g : Plane) +ᵥ (T.centres : Set Plane) := by
    change (fun x => x + (g : Plane)) '' (T.centres : Set Plane) =
      (g : Plane) +ᵥ (T.centres : Set Plane)
    ext x
    simp only [mem_image, mem_vadd_set, vadd_eq_add]
    constructor <;> rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ <;> exact ⟨y, hy, add_comm _ _⟩
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, heq] using h

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.tilingSpace_translate_continuous
statement:
private theorem tilingSpace_translate_continuous
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {E : Set Plane} (g : aePeriodGroup E) :
    Continuous (TilingSpace.translate g : TilingSpace K E → TilingSpace K E)
proof:
:=
  (translationAction_continuous K E).comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.orbitHull_compact
statement:
theorem orbitHull_compact {K : PolygonalRegion} {E : Set Plane}
    (T : TilingSpace K E) :
    IsCompact (orbitHull T) ∧ (orbitHull T).Nonempty ∧
      ∀ g : aePeriodGroup E, TilingSpace.translate g '' orbitHull T = orbitHull T
proof:
:= by
  let G := aePeriodGroup E
  let X := TilingSpace K E
  have hcompact : IsCompact (orbitHull T) :=
    (tilingSpace_compact K E).of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure (subset_univ _)
  have hnonempty : (orbitHull T).Nonempty :=
    ⟨T, subset_closure (AddAction.mem_orbit_self T)⟩
  refine ⟨hcompact, hnonempty, fun g ↦ ?_⟩
  let e : X ≃ₜ X := {
    toFun := TilingSpace.translate g
    invFun := TilingSpace.translate (-g)
    left_inv U := by
      change (-g) +ᵥ (g +ᵥ U) = U
      rw [← add_vadd]
      simp
    right_inv U := by
      change g +ᵥ ((-g) +ᵥ U) = U
      rw [← add_vadd]
      simp
    continuous_toFun := tilingSpace_translate_continuous g
    continuous_invFun := tilingSpace_translate_continuous (-g)
  }
  change e '' closure (AddAction.orbit G T) =
    closure (AddAction.orbit G T)
  rw [e.image_closure]
  congr 1
  change g +ᵥ AddAction.orbit G T = AddAction.orbit G T
  exact AddAction.vadd_orbit g T

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.exists_minimalInvariantSubset
proof:
:= by
  let G := aePeriodGroup E
  let X := TilingSpace K E
  let H : Set X := orbitHull T
  let admissible : Set (Set X) :=
    {Y | Y ⊆ H ∧ Y.Nonempty ∧ IsClosed Y ∧
      ∀ g : G, TilingSpace.translate g '' Y = Y}
  have hHcompact : IsCompact H := orbitHull_compact T |>.1
  have hHadmissible : H ∈ admissible := by
    exact ⟨Subset.rfl, (orbitHull_compact T).2.1, isClosed_closure,
      (orbitHull_compact T).2.2⟩
  obtain ⟨Y, hYH, hYminimal⟩ := zorn_superset_nonempty admissible (by
    intro c hc hchain hcne
    refine ⟨⋂₀ c, ?_, fun S hS ↦ Set.sInter_subset_of_mem hS⟩
    have hsubset : ⋂₀ c ⊆ H := by
      obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hcne
      exact (Set.sInter_subset_of_mem hS).trans (hc hS).1
    have hnonempty : (⋂₀ c : Set X).Nonempty := by
      let _ : Nonempty ↥c := hcne.to_subtype
      rw [Set.sInter_eq_iInter]
      apply IsCompact.nonempty_iInter_of_directed_nonempty_isCompact_isClosed
      · exact DirectedOn.directed_val (IsChain.directedOn hchain.symm)
      · intro S
        exact (hc S.2).2.1
      · intro S
        exact hHcompact.of_isClosed_subset (hc S.2).2.2.1 (hc S.2).1
      · intro S
        exact (hc S.2).2.2.1
    have hclosed : IsClosed (⋂₀ c : Set X) :=
      isClosed_sInter fun S hS ↦ (hc hS).2.2.1
    have hinvariant (g : G) :
        TilingSpace.translate g '' (⋂₀ c : Set X) =
          ⋂₀ c := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · rintro _ ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩
        rw [Set.mem_sInter]
        intro S hS
        have hmem : TilingSpace.translate g U ∈
            TilingSpace.translate g '' S :=
          ⟨U, Set.mem_sInter.mp hU S hS, rfl⟩
        rwa [(hc hS).2.2.2 g] at hmem
      · intro U hU
        let V : X := TilingSpace.translate (-g) U
        have hV : V ∈ ⋂₀ c := by
          rw [Set.mem_sInter]
          intro S hS
          have hmem : TilingSpace.translate (-g) U ∈
              TilingSpace.translate (-g) '' S :=
            ⟨U, Set.mem_sInter.mp hU S hS, rfl⟩
          rwa [(hc hS).2.2.2 (-g)] at hmem
        refine ⟨V, hV, ?_⟩
        change g +ᵥ ((-g) +ᵥ U) = U
        rw [← add_vadd]
        simp
    exact ⟨hsubset, hnonempty, hclosed, hinvariant⟩) H hHadmissible
  have hYdata := (minimal_iff.mp hYminimal).1
  refine ⟨Y, hYdata.1, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨hYdata.2.1, hYdata.2.2.1, hYdata.2.2.2, ?_⟩
  intro U hUY
  let Z : Set X := orbitHull U
  have hZY : Z ⊆ Y := by
    apply closure_minimal
    · rintro V ⟨g, rfl⟩
      have hmem : TilingSpace.translate g U ∈
          TilingSpace.translate g '' Y :=
        ⟨U, hUY, rfl⟩
      rwa [hYdata.2.2.2 g] at hmem
    · exact hYdata.2.2.1
  have hZadmissible : Z ∈ admissible := by
    refine ⟨hZY.trans hYdata.1, (orbitHull_compact U).2.1,
      isClosed_closure, (orbitHull_compact U).2.2⟩
  exact ((minimal_iff.mp hYminimal).2 hZadmissible hZY).symm

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.exists_minimalTiling_in_hull
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Y, hYH, hY⟩ := exists_minimalInvariantSubset T
  obtain ⟨U, hUY⟩ := hY.1
  exact ⟨U, hYH hUY, (hY.2.2.2 U hUY) ▸ hY⟩

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.translate_centres
statement:
private theorem translate_centres {K : PolygonalRegion} {E : Set Plane}
    (g : aePeriodGroup E) (T : TilingSpace K E) :
    ((TilingSpace.translate g T).centres : Set Plane) =
      (g : Plane) +ᵥ (T.centres : Set Plane)
proof:
:= by
  change (fun x => x + (g : Plane)) '' (T.centres : Set Plane) =
    (g : Plane) +ᵥ (T.centres : Set Plane)
  ext x
  simp only [mem_image, mem_vadd_set, vadd_eq_add]
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ <;> exact ⟨y, hy, add_comm _ _⟩

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.mem_orbitHull_iff_sequence
statement:
private theorem mem_orbitHull_iff_sequence {K : PolygonalRegion} {E : Set Plane}
    (T U : TilingSpace K E) :
    U ∈ orbitHull T ↔ ∃ g : ℕ → aePeriodGroup E,
      LocallyFellConverges (fun n => (g n : Plane) +ᵥ (T.centres : Set Plane))
        (U.centres : Set Plane)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hU
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hlim⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp hU
    choose g hg using hV
    refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
    have heq : (fun n => TilingSpace.translate (g n) T) = V := by
      funext n
      exact hg n
    have h := (locallyFell_metrizable K E _ U).mp (heq.symm ▸ hlim)
    simpa only [translate_centres] using h
  · rintro ⟨g, hconv⟩
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => TilingSpace.translate (g n) T) atTop (𝓝 U) :=
      (locallyFell_metrizable K E _ U).mpr (by
        simpa only [translate_centres] using hconv)
    exact isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto hlim
      (Eventually.of_forall fun n => subset_closure ⟨g n, rfl⟩)

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.orbitHull_subset_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  apply closure_minimal
  · rintro V ⟨g, rfl⟩
    have hm : TilingSpace.translate g U ∈ TilingSpace.translate g '' orbitHull T :=
      ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩
    rwa [(orbitHull_compact T).2.2 g] at hm
  · exact isClosed_closure

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.isMinimalTiling_iff_returnSequences
statement:
theorem isMinimalTiling_iff_returnSequences
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (S E : Set Plane) (hS : TilesOn K S E) :
    IsMinimalTiling K S E ↔
      ∀ L : Set Plane, (∃ g : ℕ → aePeriodGroup E,
        Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges (fun n => (g n : Plane) +ᵥ S) L) →
        ∃ h : ℕ → aePeriodGroup E,
          Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges (fun n => (h n : Plane) +ᵥ L) S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨T, hTS, hminimal⟩ L ⟨g, hconv⟩
    have htiles : TilesOn K L E := tilesOn_isClosed
      (fun n => (TilingSpace.translate (g n) T).tilesOn) (by
        simpa only [translate_centres, hTS] using hconv)
    let U : TilingSpace K E :=
      ⟨⟨L, (packing_centres_locallyFinite htiles.2.1).2.2⟩, htiles⟩
    have hUH : U ∈ orbitHull T :=
      (mem_orbitHull_iff_sequence T U).mpr ⟨g, by simpa only [hTS, U,
        TopologicalSpace.Closeds.coe_mk] using hconv⟩
    have hTH : T ∈ orbitHull U := by
      rw [hminimal.2.2.2 U hUH]
      exact subset_closure (AddAction.mem_orbit_self T)
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := (mem_orbitHull_iff_sequence U T).mp hTH
    exact ⟨h, by simpa only [hTS, U, TopologicalSpace.Closeds.coe_mk] using hh⟩
  · intro hreturn
    let T : TilingSpace K E :=
      ⟨⟨S, (packing_centres_locallyFinite hS.2.1).2.2⟩, hS⟩
    refine ⟨T, rfl, (orbitHull_compact T).2.1, isClosed_closure,
      (orbitHull_compact T).2.2, ?_⟩
    intro U hUH
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (mem_orbitHull_iff_sequence T U).mp hUH
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hreturn (U.centres : Set Plane) ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hTH : T ∈ orbitHull U := (mem_orbitHull_iff_sequence U T).mpr ⟨h, hh⟩
    exact (orbitHull_subset_of_mem hUH).antisymm (orbitHull_subset_of_mem hTH)

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.hasFLC_of_mem_orbitHull
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hconv⟩ := (mem_orbitHull_iff_sequence T U).mp hU
  exact hT.locallyFell_limit_of_translates hconv

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.linearImage_vadd
statement:
private theorem linearImage_vadd (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (u : Plane) (S : Set Plane) :
    A '' (u +ᵥ S) = A u +ᵥ (A '' S)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_image, mem_vadd_set, vadd_eq_add]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨A y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, (map_add A u y).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨u + y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, map_add A u y⟩

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.affineImage_vadd
statement:
private theorem affineImage_vadd (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (a u : Plane) (S : Set Plane) :
    affineMap A a '' (u +ᵥ S) = A u +ᵥ (affineMap A a '' S)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_image, mem_vadd_set, vadd_eq_add]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨affineMap A a y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [affineMap, map_add]
    abel
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨u + y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [affineMap, map_add]
    abel

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.aePeriod_affine_iff
proof:
:= by
  change (A u +ᵥ (affineMap A a '' E)) =ᵐ[volume] (affineMap A a '' E) ↔
    (u +ᵥ E) =ᵐ[volume] E
  rw [← affineImage_vadd]
  have hinj : Injective (affineMap A a) := by
    intro x y h
    exact A.injective (add_left_cancel h)
  rw [← measure_symmDiff_eq_zero_iff, ← measure_symmDiff_eq_zero_iff,
    ← Set.image_symmDiff hinj]
  exact volume_affineImage_eq_zero_iff A a _

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.returnSequences_linearImage
statement:
private theorem returnSequences_linearImage
    (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (a : Plane) (S E : Set Plane)
    (hreturn : ∀ L : Set Plane, (∃ g : ℕ → aePeriodGroup E,
      LocallyFellConverges (fun n => (g n : Plane) +ᵥ S) L) →
      ∃ h : ℕ → aePeriodGroup E,
        LocallyFellConverges (fun n => (h n : Plane) +ᵥ L) S) :
    ∀ L : Set Plane, (∃ g : ℕ → aePeriodGroup (affineMap A a '' E),
      LocallyFellConverges (fun n => (g n : Plane) +ᵥ (A '' S)) L) →
      ∃ h : ℕ → aePeriodGroup (affineMap A a '' E),
        LocallyFellConverges (fun n => (h n : Plane) +ᵥ L) (A '' S)
proof:
:= by
  rintro L ⟨g, hg⟩
  let g₀ : ℕ → aePeriodGroup E := fun n =>
    ⟨A.symm (g n : Plane), (aePeriod_affine_iff A a E _).mp (by
      simpa only [A.apply_symm_apply] using (g n).property)⟩
  have hg₀ : LocallyFellConverges (fun n => (g₀ n : Plane) +ᵥ S) (A.symm '' L) := by
    have h := (locallyFell_linearImage_iff A.symm _ _).mpr hg
    simpa only [linearImage_vadd, Set.image_image, Function.comp_def,
      A.symm_apply_apply, Set.image_id', g₀] using h
  obtain ⟨h₀, hh₀⟩ := hreturn _ ⟨g₀, hg₀⟩
  let h : ℕ → aePeriodGroup (affineMap A a '' E) := fun n =>
    ⟨A (h₀ n : Plane), (aePeriod_affine_iff A a E _).mpr (h₀ n).property⟩
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  have hh := (locallyFell_linearImage_iff A _ _).mpr hh₀
  simpa only [linearImage_vadd, Set.image_image, Function.comp_def,
    A.apply_symm_apply, Set.image_id', h] using hh

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.returnSequences_linearImage_iff
statement:
private theorem returnSequences_linearImage_iff
    (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (a : Plane) (S E : Set Plane) :
    (∀ L : Set Plane, (∃ g : ℕ → aePeriodGroup (affineMap A a '' E),
      LocallyFellConverges (fun n => (g n : Plane) +ᵥ (A '' S)) L) →
      ∃ h : ℕ → aePeriodGroup (affineMap A a '' E),
        LocallyFellConverges (fun n => (h n : Plane) +ᵥ L) (A '' S)) ↔
    (∀ L : Set Plane, (∃ g : ℕ → aePeriodGroup E,
      LocallyFellConverges (fun n => (g n : Plane) +ᵥ S) L) →
      ∃ h : ℕ → aePeriodGroup E,
        LocallyFellConverges (fun n => (h n : Plane) +ᵥ L) S)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, returnSequences_linearImage A a S E⟩
  have hback := returnSequences_linearImage A.symm (-A.symm a)
    (A '' S) (affineMap A a '' E) h
  have hE : affineMap A.symm (-A.symm a) '' (affineMap A a '' E) = E := by
    rw [Set.image_image]
    have hf : affineMap A.symm (-A.symm a) ∘ affineMap A a = id := by
      funext x
      simp [affineMap, map_add]
    change (affineMap A.symm (-A.symm a) ∘ affineMap A a) '' E = E
    rw [hf, Set.image_id]
  rw [hE] at hback
  simpa only [Set.image_image, Function.comp_def,
    A.symm_apply_apply, Set.image_id'] using hback

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.isMinimalTiling_affineImage_iff
statement:
theorem isMinimalTiling_affineImage_iff
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (a : Plane) (S E : Set Plane) :
    IsMinimalTiling (affineImage K A a) (A '' S) (affineMap A a '' E) ↔
      IsMinimalTiling K S E
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hminimal
    obtain ⟨T, hTS, hm⟩ := hminimal
    have hminimal' : IsMinimalTiling (affineImage K A a) (A '' S)
        (affineMap A a '' E) := ⟨T, hTS, hm⟩
    have hS' : TilesOn (affineImage K A a) (A '' S) (affineMap A a '' E) :=
      hTS ▸ T.tilesOn
    have hS := (tilesOn_affineImage_iff K A a S E).mp hS'
    apply (isMinimalTiling_iff_returnSequences K S E hS).mpr
    exact (returnSequences_linearImage_iff A a S E).mp
      ((isMinimalTiling_iff_returnSequences _ _ _ hS').mp hminimal')
  · intro hminimal
    obtain ⟨T, hTS, hm⟩ := hminimal
    have hminimal' : IsMinimalTiling K S E := ⟨T, hTS, hm⟩
    have hS : TilesOn K S E := hTS ▸ T.tilesOn
    have hS' := (tilesOn_affineImage_iff K A a S E).mpr hS
    apply (isMinimalTiling_iff_returnSequences _ _ _ hS').mpr
    exact (returnSequences_linearImage_iff A a S E).mpr
      ((isMinimalTiling_iff_returnSequences K S E hS).mp hminimal')

name: Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.latticeRestricted_hull_limit
statement:
theorem latticeRestricted_hull_limit {K : PolygonalRegion} {E : Set Plane}
    {T : TilingSpace K E} {S : Set Plane}
    (hEopen : IsOpen E) (hEregular : interior (closure E) = E)
    (g : ℕ → aePeriodGroup E)
    (hconv : Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges (fun n => (g n : Plane) +ᵥ
      (T.centres : Set Plane)) S)
    (L : PlanarLattice) (hL : L.toAddSubgroup ≤ aePeriodGroup E) :
    ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (ℓ : ℕ → L.toAddSubgroup) (a : aePeriodGroup E),
      StrictMono φ ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => (ℓ n : Plane) - (g (φ n) : Plane)) atTop (𝓝 (a : Plane)) ∧
      Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
        (fun n => (ℓ n : Plane) +ᵥ (T.centres : Set Plane)) ((a : Plane) +ᵥ S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hrep⟩ := planarLattice_boundedCosetRepresentative L
  choose ell hell using fun n => hrep (g n : Plane)
  let d : ℕ → Plane := fun n => (ell n : Plane) - (g n : Plane)
  have hd_bound : ∀ n, d n ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Plane) R := by
    intro n
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    have h := hell n
    simpa [d, norm_sub_rev] using h.2
  obtain ⟨a, haBall, φ, hφ, hlim⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : Plane) R).tendsto_subseq hd_bound
  let dφ : ℕ → Plane := d ∘ φ
  have hlim' : Tendsto dφ atTop (𝓝 a) := by
    simpa [dφ] using hlim
  have hperiod : ∀ n, dφ n ∈ (periodGroup E : Set Plane) := by
    intro n
    change (ell (φ n) : Plane) - (g (φ n) : Plane) ∈ _
    have hellmem : (ell (φ n) : Plane) ∈ (aePeriodGroup E : Set Plane) :=
      hL (hell (φ n)).1
    have hgm : (g (φ n) : Plane) ∈ (aePeriodGroup E : Set Plane) := (g (φ n)).property
    have hdiff : (ell (φ n) : Plane) - (g (φ n) : Plane) ∈
        (aePeriodGroup E : Set Plane) := (aePeriodGroup E).sub_mem hellmem hgm
    have heq := aePeriodGroup_eq_periodGroup_of_regularOpen hEopen hEregular
    simpa [heq, dφ, d] using hdiff
  have hclosed : IsClosed (periodGroup E : Set Plane) :=
    isClosed_periodGroup_of_regularOpen hEopen hEregular
  have hamem : (a : Plane) ∈ (periodGroup E : Set Plane) :=
    hclosed.mem_of_tendsto hlim' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hperiod)
  let a' : aePeriodGroup E := ⟨a, by
    rw [aePeriodGroup_eq_periodGroup_of_regularOpen hEopen hEregular]
    exact hamem⟩
  have htranslate : Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
      (fun n => dφ n +ᵥ ((g (φ n) : Plane) +ᵥ (T.centres : Set Plane)))
      (a +ᵥ S) := by
    obtain ⟨hclosedSeq, hclosedS, hcompact⟩ := hconv
    have hconvφ : Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
        (fun n => (g (φ n) : Plane) +ᵥ (T.centres : Set Plane)) S :=
      ⟨fun n => hclosedSeq (φ n), hclosedS, hcompact.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop⟩
    exact Tiling.Topology.locallyFell_translate hconvφ hlim'
  refine ⟨φ, fun n => ⟨ell (φ n), (hell (φ n)).1⟩, a', hφ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change Tendsto (d ∘ φ) atTop (𝓝 a)
    exact hlim
  · have hseq : ∀ n,
        dφ n +ᵥ ((g (φ n) : Plane) +ᵥ (T.centres : Set Plane)) =
          (ell (φ n) : Plane) +ᵥ (T.centres : Set Plane) := by
      intro n
      simp only [dφ, d, Function.comp_apply, vadd_vadd, sub_add_cancel]
    have heqseq :
        (fun n => dφ n +ᵥ ((g (φ n) : Plane) +ᵥ (T.centres : Set Plane))) =
          (fun n => (ell (φ n) : Plane) +ᵥ (T.centres : Set Plane)) :=
      funext hseq
    rw [← heqseq]
    simpa [a'] using htranslate

name: Tiling.Topology.locallyFellConverges_eventually_exists_mem_ball
statement:
theorem locallyFellConverges_eventually_exists_mem_ball
    {A : ℕ → Set Plane} {L : Set Plane} (hconv : LocallyFellConverges A L)
    {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ L) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ y ∈ A n, dist y x < ε
proof:
:= by
  rcases hconv with ⟨hA, hL, hconv⟩
  let U : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
    (fun y : Tiling.Plane ↦ (y : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) '' Metric.ball x ε
  have hUopen : IsOpen U :=
    OnePoint.isOpen_image_coe.mpr Metric.isOpen_ball
  let V : Set (TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) :=
    {Q | ((Q : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ∩ U).Nonempty}
  have hVopen : IsOpen V :=
    TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen hUopen
  have hlimit : fellCompactification L hL ∈ V := by
    refine ⟨(x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane), ?_, ⟨x, ?_, rfl⟩⟩
    · simp [fellCompactification, hx]
    · exact Metric.mem_ball_self hε
  filter_upwards [hconv (hVopen.mem_nhds hlimit)] with n hn
  rcases hn with ⟨w, hwQ, hwU⟩
  rcases hwU with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨y, ?_, Metric.mem_ball.mp hy⟩
  simpa [fellCompactification] using hwQ

name: Tiling.Topology.locallyFellConverges_eventually_disjoint_compact
statement:
theorem locallyFellConverges_eventually_disjoint_compact
    {A : ℕ → Set Plane} {L C : Set Plane} (hconv : LocallyFellConverges A L)
    (hC : IsCompact C) (hLC : Disjoint L C) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, Disjoint (A n) C
proof:
:= by
  rcases hconv with ⟨hA, hL, hconv⟩
  let C' : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
    (fun x : Tiling.Plane ↦ (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) '' C
  have hC'closed : IsClosed C' :=
    (hC.image OnePoint.continuous_coe).isClosed
  let U : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) := C'ᶜ
  let V : Set (TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) :=
    {Q | (Q : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ⊆ U}
  have hVopen : IsOpen V :=
    TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_subsets_of_isOpen hC'closed.isOpen_compl
  have hlimit : fellCompactification L hL ∈ V := by
    intro z hzQ hzC'
    rcases hzC' with ⟨c, hcC, rfl⟩
    have hcL : c ∈ L := by
      simpa [fellCompactification] using hzQ
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hLC hcL hcC
  filter_upwards [hconv (hVopen.mem_nhds hlimit)] with n hn
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxA hxC
  have hxQ : (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane) ∈
      (fellCompactification (A n) (hA n) :
        Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) := by
    simp [fellCompactification, hxA]
  exact hn hxQ ⟨x, hxC, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.Topology.locallyFell_iff_hit_miss
statement:
theorem locallyFell_iff_hit_miss (S : ℕ → Set Plane) (L : Set Plane) :
    LocallyFellConverges S L ↔
      (∀ n, IsClosed (S n)) ∧ IsClosed L ∧
      (∀ x ∈ L, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
        ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ y ∈ S n, dist y x < ε) ∧
      (∀ C : Set Plane, IsCompact C → Disjoint L C →
        ∀ᶠ n in atTop, Disjoint (S n) C)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hS, hL, hconv⟩
    refine ⟨hS, hL, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx ε hε
      exact locallyFellConverges_eventually_exists_mem_ball
        ⟨hS, hL, hconv⟩ hx hε
    · intro C hC hLC
      exact locallyFellConverges_eventually_disjoint_compact
        ⟨hS, hL, hconv⟩ hC hLC
  · rintro ⟨hS, hL, hhit, hmiss⟩
    let Kseq : ℕ → TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
      fun n ↦ fellCompactification (S n) (hS n)
    let Klim : TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
      fellCompactification L hL
    refine ⟨hS, hL, ?_⟩
    change Filter.Tendsto Kseq Filter.atTop (nhds Klim)
    rw [Filter.tendsto_def]
    intro N hN
    obtain ⟨B, hBbasis, hKlimB, hBN⟩ :=
      TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isTopologicalBasis.mem_nhds_iff.mp hN
    rcases hBbasis with ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    rcases hu with ⟨hufinite, hunonempty, huopen⟩
    rcases hKlimB with ⟨hKsubset, hKhit⟩
    have hinftyUnion : OnePoint.infty ∈ ⋃₀ u :=
      hKsubset (by simp [Klim, fellCompactification])
    have hUnionOpen : IsOpen (⋃₀ u) := isOpen_sUnion huopen
    let C : Set Tiling.Plane :=
      (fun x : Tiling.Plane ↦ (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ⁻¹' (⋃₀ u)ᶜ
    have hCclosedCompact : IsClosed C ∧ IsCompact C := by
      have hneigh := (OnePoint.isOpen_iff_of_mem hinftyUnion).mp hUnionOpen
      simpa [C, preimage_compl] using hneigh
    have hCL : Disjoint C L := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hxC hxL
      exact hxC (hKsubset (by simp [Klim, fellCompactification, hxL]))
    have hsubsetEventually : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop,
        (Kseq n : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ⊆ ⋃₀ u := by
      filter_upwards [hmiss C hCclosedCompact.2 hCL.symm] with n havoid
      intro z hz
      induction z using OnePoint.rec with
      | infty => exact hinftyUnion
      | coe y =>
          have hyS : y ∈ S n := by simpa [Kseq, fellCompactification] using hz
          by_contra hyUnion
          have hyC : y ∈ C := hyUnion
          exact Set.disjoint_left.mp havoid hyS hyC
    have hhitEventually : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop,
        ∀ U ∈ u, ((Kseq n : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ∩ U).Nonempty := by
      rw [hufinite.eventually_all]
      intro U hU
      obtain ⟨z, hzK, hzU⟩ := hKhit U hU
      induction z using OnePoint.rec with
      | infty =>
          exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦
            ⟨OnePoint.infty, by simp [Kseq, fellCompactification], hzU⟩
      | coe x =>
          have hxL : x ∈ L := by simpa [Klim, fellCompactification] using hzK
          have hUopen : IsOpen U := huopen U hU
          let V : Set Tiling.Plane :=
            (fun y : Tiling.Plane ↦ (y : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ⁻¹' U
          have hVopen : IsOpen V := hUopen.preimage OnePoint.continuous_coe
          have hxV : x ∈ V := hzU
          obtain ⟨rho, hrho, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hVopen.mem_nhds hxV)
          filter_upwards [hhit x hxL rho hrho] with n hn
          obtain ⟨y, hyS, hy⟩ := hn
          have hyV : y ∈ V := hball (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hy)
          exact ⟨(y : OnePoint Tiling.Plane), by simp [Kseq, fellCompactification, hyS], hyV⟩
    filter_upwards [hsubsetEventually, hhitEventually] with n hsubset hhits
    apply hBN
    exact ⟨hsubset, hhits⟩

name: Tiling.Topology.mem_of_locallyFellConverges_of_tendsto_mem
statement:
theorem mem_of_locallyFellConverges_of_tendsto_mem
    {A : ℕ → Set Plane} {L : Set Plane} (hconv : LocallyFellConverges A L)
    {zseq : ℕ → Plane} {z : Plane} (hzmem : ∀ n, zseq n ∈ A n)
    (hzlim : Tendsto zseq atTop (𝓝 z)) : z ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hzL
  rcases hconv with ⟨hAclosed, hLclosed, hconv⟩
  have hcompl : Lᶜ ∈ nhds z := hLclosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hzL
  obtain ⟨epsilon, hepsilon, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hcompl
  let C : Set Tiling.Plane := Metric.closedBall z (epsilon / 2)
  have hLC : Disjoint L C := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro y hyL hyC
    apply (hball (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt
      (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hyC) (half_lt_self hepsilon)))).elim
    exact hyL
  have hdisjoint := locallyFellConverges_eventually_disjoint_compact
    ⟨hAclosed, hLclosed, hconv⟩ (isCompact_closedBall z (epsilon / 2)) hLC
  have hzC : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, zseq n ∈ C := by
    apply hzlim.eventually
    exact Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds z (half_pos hepsilon)
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hzn⟩ := (hdisjoint.and hzC).exists
  exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hn (hzmem n) hzn

name: Tiling.Topology.isDiscrete_of_uniformlySeparated
statement:
private theorem isDiscrete_of_uniformlySeparated
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) {S : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hS : IsUniformlySeparated δ S) :
    IsDiscrete S
proof:
:= by
  rw [isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isOpen]
  intro x hx
  refine ⟨Metric.ball x δ, Metric.isOpen_ball, ?_⟩
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hyball, hyS⟩
    have hyx : y = x := by
      by_contra hyx
      have hsep := hS hyS hx hyx
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hyball
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hsep) hyball
    simp [hyx]
  · rintro (rfl : y = x)
    exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hδ, hx⟩

name: Tiling.Topology.locallyFell_matchingPoints
statement:
theorem locallyFell_matchingPoints
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) {S : ℕ → Set Plane} {L : Set Plane}
    (hclosedS : ∀ n, IsClosed (S n)) (hclosedL : IsClosed L)
    (hsepS : ∀ n, IsUniformlySeparated δ (S n))
    (hsepL : IsUniformlySeparated δ L) :
    LocallyFellConverges S L ↔
      ∀ C : Set Plane, IsCompact C → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < δ / 3 →
        ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
          (∀ x ∈ L ∩ C, ∃! y : Plane, y ∈ S n ∧ dist x y < ε) ∧
          (∀ y ∈ S n ∩ C, ∃! x : Plane, x ∈ L ∧ dist x y < ε)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hconv C hC epsilon hepsilon hepsilonDelta
    have hfinite : (L ∩ C).Finite :=
      (hC.inter_left hclosedL).finite
        ((isDiscrete_of_uniformlySeparated hδ hsepL).mono inter_subset_left)
    have hforward : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
        ∀ x ∈ L ∩ C, ∃! y : Tiling.Plane,
          y ∈ S n ∧ dist x y < epsilon := by
      rw [hfinite.eventually_all]
      intro x hx
      filter_upwards [locallyFellConverges_eventually_exists_mem_ball
          hconv hx.1 hepsilon] with n hn
      obtain ⟨y, hyS, hxy⟩ := hn
      refine ⟨y, ⟨hyS, by simpa [dist_comm] using hxy⟩, ?_⟩
      intro z hz
      by_contra hzy
      have hsep := hsepS n hz.1 hyS hzy
      have htri := dist_triangle z x y
      have hzx : dist z x < epsilon := by simpa [dist_comm] using hz.2
      have hxy' : dist x y < epsilon := by simpa [dist_comm] using hxy
      have : dist z y < 2 * epsilon := lt_of_le_of_lt htri (by linarith)
      linarith
    let D : Set Tiling.Plane :=
      C ∩ (⋃ x ∈ L, Metric.ball x epsilon)ᶜ
    have hDcompact : IsCompact D := by
      apply hC.inter_right
      exact isClosed_compl_iff.mpr (isOpen_biUnion fun x _ ↦ Metric.isOpen_ball)
    have hLD : Disjoint L D := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hxL hxD
      exact hxD.2 (Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr
        ⟨x, hxL, Metric.mem_ball_self hepsilon⟩)
    have havoid := locallyFellConverges_eventually_disjoint_compact
      hconv hDcompact hLD
    filter_upwards [hforward, havoid] with n hnforward hnavoid
    refine ⟨hnforward, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    have hexists : ∃ x : Tiling.Plane, x ∈ L ∧ dist x y < epsilon := by
      by_contra hnone
      have hyD : y ∈ D := by
        refine ⟨hy.2, ?_⟩
        rw [mem_compl_iff]
        intro hyUnion
        obtain ⟨x, hxL, hxyball⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hyUnion
        apply hnone
        refine ⟨x, hxL, ?_⟩
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hxyball
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hnavoid hy.1 hyD
    obtain ⟨x, hxL, hxy⟩ := hexists
    refine ⟨x, ⟨hxL, hxy⟩, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    by_contra hzx
    have hsep := hsepL hz.1 hxL hzx
    have htri := dist_triangle z y x
    have hxy' : dist y x < epsilon := by simpa [dist_comm] using hxy
    have : dist z x < 2 * epsilon := lt_of_le_of_lt htri (by linarith)
    linarith
  · intro hmatch
    refine ⟨hclosedS, hclosedL, ?_⟩
    let Kseq : ℕ → TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
      fun n ↦ fellCompactification (S n) (hclosedS n)
    let Klim : TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
      fellCompactification L hclosedL
    rw [show (fun n ↦ fellCompactification
        (S n) (hclosedS n)) = Kseq from rfl]
    change Filter.Tendsto Kseq Filter.atTop (nhds Klim)
    rw [Filter.tendsto_def]
    intro N hN
    obtain ⟨B, hBbasis, hKlimB, hBN⟩ :=
      TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isTopologicalBasis.mem_nhds_iff.mp hN
    rcases hBbasis with ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    rcases hu with ⟨hufinite, hunonempty, huopen⟩
    rcases hKlimB with ⟨hKsubset, hKhit⟩
    have hinftyUnion : OnePoint.infty ∈ ⋃₀ u :=
      hKsubset (by simp [Klim, fellCompactification])
    have hUnionOpen : IsOpen (⋃₀ u) := isOpen_sUnion huopen
    let C : Set Tiling.Plane :=
      (fun x : Tiling.Plane ↦ (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ⁻¹' (⋃₀ u)ᶜ
    have hCclosedCompact : IsClosed C ∧ IsCompact C := by
      have := (OnePoint.isOpen_iff_of_mem hinftyUnion).mp hUnionOpen
      simpa [C, preimage_compl] using this
    have hCL : Disjoint C L := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hxC hxL
      exact hxC (hKsubset (by
        simp [Klim, fellCompactification, hxL]))
    obtain ⟨r, hrpos, hrsep⟩ :=
      Metric.exists_pos_forall_lt_edist hCclosedCompact.2 hclosedL hCL
    let epsilon : ℝ := min ((r : ℝ) / 2) (δ / 6)
    have hepsilon : 0 < epsilon := by
      dsimp [epsilon]
      exact lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
    have hepsilonDelta : epsilon < δ / 3 := by
      dsimp [epsilon]
      have := min_le_right ((r : ℝ) / 2) (δ / 6)
      linarith
    have hepsilonR : epsilon < (r : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [epsilon]
      have := min_le_left ((r : ℝ) / 2) (δ / 6)
      linarith
    have hmatchingC := hmatch C hCclosedCompact.2 epsilon hepsilon hepsilonDelta
    have hsubsetEventually : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
        (Kseq n : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ⊆ ⋃₀ u := by
      filter_upwards [hmatchingC] with n hn
      intro z hz
      induction z using OnePoint.rec with
      | infty => exact hinftyUnion
      | coe y =>
          have hyS : y ∈ S n := by
            simpa [Kseq, fellCompactification] using hz
          by_contra hyUnion
          have hyC : y ∈ C := hyUnion
          obtain ⟨x, ⟨hxL, hxy⟩, _⟩ := hn.2 y ⟨hyS, hyC⟩
          have hrxy := hrsep y hyC x hxL
          have hedist : edist y x < (r : ENNReal) := by
            rw [edist_dist, dist_comm]
            exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_coe_iff (dist_nonneg)).mpr
              (hxy.trans hepsilonR)
          exact (not_lt_of_ge hrxy.le) hedist
    have hhitEventually : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
        ∀ U ∈ u, ((Kseq n : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ∩ U).Nonempty := by
      rw [hufinite.eventually_all]
      intro U hU
      obtain ⟨z, hzK, hzU⟩ := hKhit U hU
      induction z using OnePoint.rec with
      | infty =>
          exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦
            ⟨OnePoint.infty, by simp [Kseq,
              fellCompactification], hzU⟩
      | coe x =>
          have hxL : x ∈ L := by
            simpa [Klim, fellCompactification] using hzK
          have hUopen : IsOpen U := huopen U hU
          let V : Set Tiling.Plane :=
            (fun y : Tiling.Plane ↦ (y : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ⁻¹' U
          have hVopen : IsOpen V := hUopen.preimage OnePoint.continuous_coe
          have hxV : x ∈ V := hzU
          obtain ⟨rho, hrho, hball⟩ :=
            Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hVopen.mem_nhds hxV)
          let eta : ℝ := min (rho / 2) (δ / 6)
          have heta : 0 < eta := by
            dsimp [eta]
            exact lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
          have hetaDelta : eta < δ / 3 := by
            dsimp [eta]
            have := min_le_right (rho / 2) (δ / 6)
            linarith
          have hetaRho : eta < rho := by
            dsimp [eta]
            have := min_le_left (rho / 2) (δ / 6)
            linarith
          filter_upwards [hmatch {x} isCompact_singleton eta heta hetaDelta] with n hn
          obtain ⟨y, ⟨hyS, hxy⟩, _⟩ := hn.1 x ⟨hxL, mem_singleton x⟩
          refine ⟨(y : OnePoint Tiling.Plane), ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp [Kseq, fellCompactification, hyS]
          · apply hball
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]
            exact hxy.trans hetaRho
    filter_upwards [hsubsetEventually, hhitEventually] with n hnsubset hnhit
    apply hBN
    exact ⟨hnsubset, hnhit⟩

name: Tiling.Topology.exists_locallyFellConvergent_subsequence
statement:
theorem exists_locallyFellConvergent_subsequence
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (S : ℕ → Set Plane)
    (hclosed : ∀ n, IsClosed (S n))
    (hsep : ∀ n, IsUniformlySeparated δ (S n)) :
    ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (L : Set Plane), StrictMono φ ∧ IsClosed L ∧
      IsUniformlySeparated δ L ∧ LocallyFellConverges (S ∘ φ) L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := hδ
  let e := onePointEquivSphereOfFinrankEq
    (ι := Fin 3) (V := Tiling.Plane) (by simp [Tiling.Plane])
  let _ : TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
    e.isEmbedding.metrizableSpace
  let _ : MetricSpace (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
    TopologicalSpace.metrizableSpaceMetric (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)
  let Kseq : ℕ → TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
    fun n ↦ fellCompactification (S n) (hclosed n)
  obtain ⟨K, phi, hphi, hlim⟩ := CompactSpace.tendsto_subseq Kseq
  have hinfty : OnePoint.infty ∈ (K : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) := by
    let C : Set (TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) :=
      {Q | ((Q : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ∩ {OnePoint.infty}).Nonempty}
    have hCclosed : IsClosed C :=
      TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isClosed_inter_nonempty_of_isClosed
        isClosed_singleton
    have hKC : K ∈ C := hCclosed.mem_of_tendsto hlim (by
      filter_upwards [] with n
      refine ⟨OnePoint.infty, ?_, Set.mem_singleton OnePoint.infty⟩
      simp [Kseq, fellCompactification,
        fellCompactification])
    simpa [C] using hKC
  let L : Set Tiling.Plane :=
    {x | (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane) ∈ (K : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane))}
  have hLclosed : IsClosed L := by
    exact K.isCompact.isClosed.preimage OnePoint.continuous_coe
  have hK : fellCompactification L hLclosed = K := by
    apply TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.ext
    ext z
    refine OnePoint.rec ?_ (fun x ↦ ?_) z
    · simp [fellCompactification,
        fellCompactification, hinfty]
    · simp [fellCompactification,
        fellCompactification, L]
  have hLseparated :
      IsUniformlySeparated δ L := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    by_contra hdist
    have hdist_lt : dist x y < δ := lt_of_not_ge hdist
    have hxy_dist : 0 < dist x y := dist_pos.mpr hxy
    let eps : ℝ := min ((δ - dist x y) / 4) (dist x y / 4)
    have heps : 0 < eps := by
      dsimp [eps]
      exact lt_min (by linarith [hδ_pos]) (by linarith)
    let U : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
      (fun z : Tiling.Plane ↦ (z : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) '' Metric.ball x eps
    let V : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
      (fun z : Tiling.Plane ↦ (z : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) '' Metric.ball y eps
    have hUopen : IsOpen U := by
      exact OnePoint.isOpen_image_coe.mpr Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hVopen : IsOpen V := by
      exact OnePoint.isOpen_image_coe.mpr Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hxK : (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane) ∈ (K : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) := hx
    have hyK : (y : OnePoint Tiling.Plane) ∈ (K : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) := hy
    have hKhitU : ((K : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ∩ U).Nonempty :=
      ⟨x, hxK, ⟨x, Metric.mem_ball_self heps, rfl⟩⟩
    have hKhitV : ((K : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ∩ V).Nonempty :=
      ⟨y, hyK, ⟨y, Metric.mem_ball_self heps, rfl⟩⟩
    have hEventuallyU : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop,
        (((Kseq ∘ phi) n : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ∩ U).Nonempty :=
      hlim.eventually
        ((TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen hUopen).mem_nhds
          hKhitU)
    have hEventuallyV : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop,
        (((Kseq ∘ phi) n : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ∩ V).Nonempty :=
      hlim.eventually
        ((TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen hVopen).mem_nhds
          hKhitV)
    obtain ⟨n, hnU, hnV⟩ := (hEventuallyU.and hEventuallyV).exists
    obtain ⟨zu, hzuK, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩⟩ := hnU
    obtain ⟨zv, hzvK, ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩⟩ := hnV
    have haS : a ∈ S (phi n) := by
      simpa [Kseq, fellCompactification,
        fellCompactification] using hzuK
    have hbS : b ∈ S (phi n) := by
      simpa [Kseq, fellCompactification,
        fellCompactification] using hzvK
    have hab : a ≠ b := by
      intro hab
      subst b
      have hxa : dist x a < eps := by
        rw [dist_comm]
        exact ha
      have hay : dist a y < eps := hb
      have heps_le : eps ≤ dist x y / 4 := min_le_right _ _
      have htri : dist x y ≤ dist x a + dist a y := dist_triangle _ _ _
      linarith
    have hsep := hsep (phi n) haS hbS hab
    have hax : dist a x < eps := by simpa [dist_comm] using ha
    have hyb : dist y b < eps := by simpa [dist_comm] using hb
    have heps_le : eps ≤ (δ - dist x y) / 4 := min_le_left _ _
    have hab_lt : dist a b < δ := by
      calc
        dist a b ≤ dist a x + dist x y + dist y b := dist_triangle4 _ _ _ _
        _ < eps + dist x y + eps := by linarith
        _ < δ := by linarith
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hsep) hab_lt
  refine ⟨phi, L, hphi, hLclosed, hLseparated, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨fun n ↦ hclosed (phi n), hLclosed, ?_⟩
  rw [hK]
  change Filter.Tendsto (Kseq ∘ phi) Filter.atTop (nhds K)
  exact hlim

name: Tiling.Topology.locallyFell_translate
statement:
theorem locallyFell_translate
    {S : ℕ → Set Plane} {L : Set Plane} (hconv : LocallyFellConverges S L)
    {g : ℕ → Plane} {u : Plane} (hg : Tendsto g atTop (𝓝 u)) :
    LocallyFellConverges (fun n => g n +ᵥ S n) (u +ᵥ L)
proof:
:= by
  have hsource := locallyFell_iff_hit_miss S L |>.mp hconv
  rcases hsource with ⟨hS, hL, hhit, hmiss⟩
  apply (locallyFell_iff_hit_miss (fun n => g n +ᵥ S n) (u +ᵥ L)).mpr
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n
    exact (Homeomorph.addLeft (g n)).isClosed_image.mpr (hS n)
  · exact (Homeomorph.addLeft u).isClosed_image.mpr hL
  · intro x hx ε hε
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hx
    have hnear : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, dist (g n) u < ε / 2 := by
      have := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hg) (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
      simpa [dist_comm] using this
    let l : Plane := -u + x
    filter_upwards [hnear, hhit l (by simpa [l] using hx) (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)] with n hgn hhitn
    obtain ⟨y, hyS, hyl⟩ := hhitn
    refine ⟨g n +ᵥ y, Set.mem_vadd_set.mpr ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨y, hyS, rfl⟩
    · have htri := dist_triangle (g n + y) (g n + l) x
      have hfirst : dist (g n + y) (g n + l) = dist y l := by
        simp [dist_eq_norm]
      have hsecond : dist (g n + l) x = dist (g n) u := by
        have harg : g n + l - x = g n - u := by dsimp [l]; abel
        simp [dist_eq_norm, harg]
      calc
        dist (g n + y) x ≤ dist (g n + y) (g n + l) + dist (g n + l) x := htri
        _ = dist y l + dist (g n) u := by rw [hfirst, hsecond]
        _ < ε := by linarith
  · intro C hC hCdisjoint
    let C' : Set Plane := (-u) +ᵥ C
    have hC'compact : IsCompact C' := by
      change IsCompact ((fun x : Plane => -u + x) '' C)
      exact hC.image (Homeomorph.addLeft (-u)).continuous
    have hLC' : Disjoint L C' := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro y hyL hyC'
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hyC'
      have : u +ᵥ y ∈ C := by simpa [vadd_vadd] using hyC'
      exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp hCdisjoint) (Set.mem_vadd_set.mpr ⟨y, hyL, rfl⟩) this
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrsep⟩ := Metric.exists_pos_forall_lt_edist hC'compact hL hLC'.symm
    let ρ : ℝ := (r : ℝ) / 2
    have hρ : 0 < ρ := by dsimp [ρ]; exact half_pos (by exact_mod_cast hr)
    have hρr : ρ < (r : ℝ) := by dsimp [ρ]; exact half_lt_self (by exact_mod_cast hr)
    let D : Set Plane := C' + Metric.closedBall (0 : Plane) ρ
    have hDcompact : IsCompact D := by
      dsimp [D]
      exact hC'compact.add (isCompact_closedBall 0 ρ)
    have hLD : Disjoint L D := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro y hyL hyD
      rcases Set.mem_add.mp hyD with ⟨c, hcC', v, hv, rfl⟩
      have hdist : dist c (c + v) ≤ ρ := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using
          (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hv)
      have hdistlt : dist c (c + v) < (r : ℝ) := hdist.trans_lt hρr
      have hed : edist c (c + v) < (r : ENNReal) := by
        rw [edist_dist]
        exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_coe_iff (dist_nonneg)).mpr hdistlt
      exact (lt_asymm (hrsep c hcC' (c + v) hyL) hed).elim
    have havoid := hmiss D hDcompact hLD
    have hgn : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, dist (g n) u < ρ := by
      have := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hg) ρ hρ
      simpa [dist_comm] using this
    filter_upwards [havoid, hgn] with n hnavoid hgn
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro z hzImage hzC
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hzImage
    have hy : -g n +ᵥ z ∈ S n := by simpa using hzImage
    have hyD : -g n +ᵥ z ∈ D := by
      apply Set.mem_add.mpr
      refine ⟨-u +ᵥ z, ?_, u - g n, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Set.mem_vadd_set.mpr ⟨z, hzC, rfl⟩
      · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        simpa [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hgn.le
      · change -u + z + (u - g n) = -g n + z
        abel
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hnavoid hy hyD

name: Tiling.Topology.locallyFell_linearImage_forward
statement:
private theorem locallyFell_linearImage_forward
    (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (S : ℕ → Set Plane) (L : Set Plane)
    (hconv : LocallyFellConverges S L) :
    LocallyFellConverges (fun n => A '' S n) (A '' L)
proof:
:= by
  rcases (locallyFell_iff_hit_miss S L).mp hconv with
    ⟨hS, hL, hhit, hmiss⟩
  apply (locallyFell_iff_hit_miss (fun n => A '' S n) (A '' L)).mpr
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n
    exact A.isClosed_image.mpr (hS n)
  · exact A.isClosed_image.mpr hL
  · intro x hx ε hε
    rcases hx with ⟨z, hzL, rfl⟩
    let V : Set Plane := A ⁻¹' Metric.ball (A z) ε
    have hVopen : IsOpen V := Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage A.continuous
    have hzV : z ∈ V := Metric.mem_ball_self hε
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hball⟩ :=
      Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hVopen.mem_nhds hzV)
    filter_upwards [hhit z hzL ρ hρ] with n hn
    obtain ⟨y, hyS, hy⟩ := hn
    refine ⟨A y, ⟨y, hyS, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    exact Metric.mem_ball.mp (hball (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hy))
  · intro C hC hCdisjoint
    let C' : Set Plane := A ⁻¹' C
    have hC'compact : IsCompact C' := by
      exact A.toHomeomorph.isCompact_preimage.mpr hC
    have hLC' : Disjoint L C' := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hxL hxC'
      exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp hCdisjoint)
        ⟨x, hxL, rfl⟩ hxC'
    filter_upwards [hmiss C' hC'compact hLC'] with n havoid
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro z hzImage hzC
    rcases hzImage with ⟨y, hyS, rfl⟩
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp havoid hyS hzC

name: Tiling.Topology.locallyFell_linearImage_iff
statement:
theorem locallyFell_linearImage_iff (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane)
    (S : ℕ → Set Plane) (L : Set Plane) :
    LocallyFellConverges (fun n => A '' S n) (A '' L) ↔
      LocallyFellConverges S L
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hconv
    have hback := locallyFell_linearImage_forward A.symm
      (fun n => A '' S n) (A '' L) hconv
    simpa [Function.comp_def, Set.image_image] using hback
  · exact locallyFell_linearImage_forward A S L

name: Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC.locallyFell_limit_of_translates
statement:
theorem _root_.Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC.locallyFell_limit_of_translates
    {S L : Set Plane} {u : ℕ → Plane} (hS : Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC S)
    (hconv : LocallyFellConverges (fun n => u n +ᵥ S) L) :
    Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hsep⟩ := hS.uniformlyDiscrete
  have hsepSeq : ∀ n, IsUniformlySeparated δ (u n +ᵥ S) := by
    intro n x hx y hy hxy
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_vadd_set.mp hx
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_vadd_set.mp hy
    have hab : a ≠ b := by
      intro hab
      exact hxy (by simp [hab])
    simpa only [dist_vadd_cancel_left] using hsep ha hb hab
  have hsepL : IsUniformlySeparated δ L := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    by_contra hdist
    have hdist_lt : dist x y < δ := lt_of_not_ge hdist
    have hxy_dist : 0 < dist x y := dist_pos.mpr hxy
    let ε : ℝ := min ((δ - dist x y) / 4) (dist x y / 4)
    have hε : 0 < ε := by
      dsimp [ε]
      exact lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨n, ⟨a, ha, hax⟩, ⟨b, hb, hby⟩⟩ :=
      ((locallyFellConverges_eventually_exists_mem_ball hconv hx hε).and
        (locallyFellConverges_eventually_exists_mem_ball hconv hy hε)).exists
    have hab : a ≠ b := by
      intro hab
      subst b
      have htri := dist_triangle x a y
      have heps_le : ε ≤ dist x y / 4 := min_le_right _ _
      rw [dist_comm x a] at htri
      linarith
    have hsepab := hsepSeq n ha hb hab
    have heps_le : ε ≤ (δ - dist x y) / 4 := min_le_left _ _
    have htri := dist_triangle4 a x y b
    rw [dist_comm y b] at htri
    linarith
  have hclosedL : IsClosed L := hconv.choose_spec.choose
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro Q hQ
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hQ.subset_closedBall (0 : Plane)
    have hfinite : (L ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 R).Finite :=
      ((isCompact_closedBall (0 : Plane) R).inter_left hclosedL).finite
        ((isDiscrete_of_uniformlySeparated hδ hsepL).mono inter_subset_left)
    exact hfinite.subset (inter_subset_inter_right L hR)
  · intro R hR
    let D : Set Plane := (S - S) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 (R + 1)
    have hD : D.Finite := hS.2 (R + 1) (by linarith)
    apply hD.subset
    rintro z ⟨hz, hzR⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_sub.mp hz
    apply hD.isClosed.closure_subset
    rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff]
    intro ε hε
    let η : ℝ := min (ε / 4) (1 / 4)
    have hη : 0 < η := lt_min (by positivity) (by norm_num)
    obtain ⟨n, ⟨a, ha, hax⟩, ⟨b, hb, hby⟩⟩ :=
      ((locallyFellConverges_eventually_exists_mem_ball hconv hx hη).and
        (locallyFellConverges_eventually_exists_mem_ball hconv hy hη)).exists
    obtain ⟨a', ha', rfl⟩ := Set.mem_vadd_set.mp ha
    obtain ⟨b', hb', rfl⟩ := Set.mem_vadd_set.mp hb
    have hdiff : dist (x - y) (a' - b') < 2 * η := by
      have hdist := dist_sub_sub_le x y (u n +ᵥ a') (u n +ᵥ b')
      simp only [vadd_eq_add, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub] at hdist
      simp only [vadd_eq_add] at hax hby
      rw [dist_comm x (u n + a')] at hdist
      rw [dist_comm y (u n + b')] at hdist
      linarith
    refine ⟨a' - b', ⟨Set.sub_mem_sub ha' hb', ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hzR ⊢
      have htri := dist_triangle (a' - b') (x - y) 0
      have hηle : η ≤ 1 / 4 := min_le_right _ _
      rw [dist_comm (a' - b') (x - y)] at htri
      linarith
    · have hηle : η ≤ ε / 4 := min_le_left _ _
      linarith

name: Tiling.Approximation.finiteBasisWeight_nonneg
statement:
private theorem finiteBasisWeight_nonneg {ι : Type*} (b : Basis ι ℚ ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ finiteBasisWeight b x
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ abs_nonneg _

name: Tiling.Approximation.finiteBasisError
statement:
private theorem finiteBasisError {ι : Type*} (b : Basis ι ℚ ℝ)
    (φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (x : ℝ) :
    (φ x : ℝ) - x = ∑ j ∈ (b.repr x).support,
      ((b.repr x j) : ℝ) * ((φ (b j) : ℝ) - b j)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : ∑ j ∈ (b.repr x).support, (b.repr x j) • b j = x := by
    simpa only [b.repr_symm_apply, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum] using
      b.repr.symm_apply_apply x
  have hφ : (φ x : ℝ) = ∑ j ∈ (b.repr x).support,
      ((b.repr x j) : ℝ) * (φ (b j) : ℝ) := by
    have hφrat := congrArg φ hx
    rw [← hφrat]
    simp only [map_sum, Rat.cast_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [φ.map_smul]
    simp only [Rat.smul_def, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_id]
  have hval : x = ∑ j ∈ (b.repr x).support, ((b.repr x j) : ℝ) * b j := by
    simpa only [Rat.smul_def] using hx.symm
  calc
    (φ x : ℝ) - x =
        (∑ j ∈ (b.repr x).support, ((b.repr x j) : ℝ) * (φ (b j) : ℝ)) -
        (∑ j ∈ (b.repr x).support, ((b.repr x j) : ℝ) * b j) :=
      congrArg₂ (fun a c : ℝ ↦ a - c) hφ hval
    _ = _ := by simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: Tiling.Approximation.finitePositiveGap
statement:
private theorem finitePositiveGap (F : Finset ℝ) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x ∈ F, x ≠ 0 → ε ≤ |x|
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction F using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨1, by norm_num, by simp⟩
  | @insert a F _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hbound⟩ := ih
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
      intro x hx hx0
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx
      · exact (hx0 ha).elim
      · exact hbound x hx hx0
    · refine ⟨min ε |a|, lt_min hε (abs_pos.mpr ha), ?_⟩
      intro x hx hx0
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx
      · exact min_le_right _ _
      · exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (hbound x hx hx0)

name: Tiling.Approximation.finiteSignOfError
proof:
:= by
  obtain hx | rfl | hx := lt_trichotomy x 0
  · have herr := (abs_lt.mp (herror (ne_of_lt hx))).2
    rw [abs_of_neg hx] at herr
    have himage : (φ x : ℝ) < 0 := by linarith
    rw [Real.sign_of_neg himage, Real.sign_of_neg hx]
  · simp only [map_zero, Rat.cast_zero]
  · have herr := (abs_lt.mp (herror (ne_of_gt hx))).1
    rw [abs_of_pos hx] at herr
    have himage : 0 < (φ x : ℝ) := by linarith
    rw [Real.sign_of_pos himage, Real.sign_of_pos hx]

name: Tiling.Approximation.exists_finiteApproximation
statement:
theorem exists_finiteApproximation :
  ∀ (F : Finset ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
    ∃ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro F ε hε
  
  have hlin : LinearIndepOn ℚ id ({1} : Set ℝ) :=
    (linearIndepOn_singleton_iff ℚ).mpr one_ne_zero
  let b := Basis.extend hlin
  let j₀ : hlin.extend (Set.subset_univ _) :=
    ⟨1, hlin.subset_extend _ (by simp)⟩
  have hbj₀ : b j₀ = 1 := Basis.extend_apply_self hlin j₀
  let B : ℝ := ∑ x ∈ F, finiteBasisWeight b x
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ ↦ finiteBasisWeight_nonneg b x
  let δ : ℝ := ε / (B + 1)
  have hden : 0 < B + 1 := by linarith
  have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos hε hden
  choose g hg using fun j ↦ exists_rat_near (b j) hδ
  let f : hlin.extend (Set.subset_univ _) → ℚ := fun j ↦ if b j = 1 then 1 else g j
  let φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ := b.constr ℚ f
  have hφbasis : ∀ j, |(φ (b j) : ℝ) - b j| < δ := by
    intro j
    simp only [φ, b.constr_basis]
    by_cases hj : b j = 1
    · simp only [f, if_pos hj, Rat.cast_one, hj, sub_self, abs_zero]
      exact hδ
    · simpa only [f, if_neg hj, abs_sub_comm] using hg j
  refine ⟨φ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      φ 1 = φ (b j₀) := congrArg φ hbj₀.symm
      _ = f j₀ := b.constr_basis ℚ f j₀
      _ = 1 := by simp only [f, hbj₀, if_pos]
  · intro x hx
    have hweight : finiteBasisWeight b x ≤ B :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun y _ ↦ finiteBasisWeight_nonneg b y) hx
    have hmul : finiteBasisWeight b x * δ < ε := by
      have hlt : finiteBasisWeight b x < B + 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hweight (by linarith)
      have hbound := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hlt hδ
      have heq : (B + 1) * δ = ε := by
        dsimp [δ]
        field_simp
      linarith
    rw [finiteBasisError b φ x]
    calc
      |∑ j ∈ (b.repr x).support, ((b.repr x j) : ℝ) * ((φ (b j) : ℝ) - b j)|
          ≤ ∑ j ∈ (b.repr x).support,
            |((b.repr x j) : ℝ) * ((φ (b j) : ℝ) - b j)| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ (b.repr x).support, |((b.repr x j) : ℝ)| * δ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j _
        rw [abs_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hφbasis j).le (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = finiteBasisWeight b x * δ := by
        simp only [finiteBasisWeight, Finset.sum_mul]
      _ < ε := hmul

name: Tiling.Approximation.finiteApproximation_strengthen
statement:
theorem finiteApproximation_strengthen :
  ∀ (F G : Finset ℝ) (ε δ : ℝ) (φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ),
    F ⊆ G → δ ≤ ε → IsFiniteApproximation G δ φ → IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ
proof:
:= by
  intro F G ε δ φ hFG hδε hφ
  refine ⟨hφ.1, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (hφ.2 x (hFG hx)) hδε

name: Tiling.Approximation.finiteApproximation_signAndEquality
statement:
theorem finiteApproximation_signAndEquality :
  ∀ Z : Finset ℝ, ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
    ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
      (∀ z ∈ Z, Real.sign (φ z : ℝ) = Real.sign z) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Z, ∀ w ∈ Z, φ z = φ w ↔ z = w)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro Z
  let D := (Z ×ˢ Z).image (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ p.1 - p.2)
  let F := Z ∪ D
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hbound⟩ := finitePositiveGap F
  refine ⟨F, ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ
  have hsign : ∀ x ∈ F, Real.sign (φ x : ℝ) = Real.sign x := by
    intro x hx
    apply finiteSignOfError
    intro hx0
    exact (hφ.2 x hx).trans_le (hbound x hx hx0)
  refine ⟨fun z hz ↦ hsign z (Finset.mem_union_left _ hz), ?_⟩
  intro z hz w hw
  constructor
  · intro heq
    have hdiff : z - w ∈ F := Finset.mem_union_right _
      (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(z, w), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hz, hw⟩, rfl⟩)
    have hzero : φ (z - w) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, heq, sub_self]
    have hsignzero := hsign (z - w) hdiff
    rw [hzero, Rat.cast_zero, Real.sign_zero] at hsignzero
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (Real.sign_eq_zero_iff.mp hsignzero.symm)
  · rintro rfl
    rfl

name: Tiling.Approximation.finiteRational_denominator
statement:
theorem finiteRational_denominator :
  ∀ Q : Finset ℚ, ∃ d : ℕ, 0 < d ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Q, ∃ p : ℤ, (q : ℝ) = (p : ℝ) / d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro Q
  induction Q using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨1, by norm_num, by simp⟩
  | @insert a Q _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hrepr⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨a.den * d, Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos hd, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    have haR : (a.den : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast a.den_ne_zero
    have hdR : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd.ne'
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hq with hq | hq
    · subst q
      refine ⟨a.num * (d : ℤ), ?_⟩
      rw [Rat.cast_def]
      push_cast
      field_simp
    · obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hrepr q hq
      refine ⟨p * (a.den : ℤ), ?_⟩
      rw [hp]
      push_cast
      field_simp

name: Tiling.Approximation.rationalNormal_commutes
statement:
theorem rationalNormal_commutes :
  ∀ (φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (n : RationalNormal) (z : Plane),
    normalEval n (deformPoint φ z) = (φ (normalEval n z) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro φ n z
  simp only [normalEval, deformPoint]
  have hx := map_smul φ n.x z.re
  have hy := map_smul φ n.y z.im
  simp only [Rat.smul_def] at hx hy
  calc
    (n.x : ℝ) * φ z.re + (n.y : ℝ) * φ z.im =
        (φ ((n.x : ℝ) * z.re + (n.y : ℝ) * z.im) : ℝ) := by
          rw [map_add, hx, hy]
          push_cast
          ring
    _ = (φ (normalEval n z) : ℝ) := rfl

name: Tiling.Approximation.rationalDirection_preservesCoset
statement:
theorem rationalDirection_preservesCoset :
  ∀ (φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (n : RationalNormal) (z w : Plane),
    z - w ∈ normalDirection n → deformPoint φ z - deformPoint φ w ∈ normalDirection n
proof:
:= by
  intro φ n z w h
  change normalEval n (z - w) = 0 at h
  change normalEval n (deformPoint φ z - deformPoint φ w) = 0
  have hzw : normalEval n (z - w) = normalEval n z - normalEval n w := by
    simp [normalEval, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
    ring
  have hφzw : φ (normalEval n z) - φ (normalEval n w) = 0 := by
    rw [← map_sub, ← hzw, h]
    simp
  rw [show normalEval n (deformPoint φ z - deformPoint φ w) =
      normalEval n (deformPoint φ z) - normalEval n (deformPoint φ w) by
        simp [normalEval, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]; ring]
  rw [rationalNormal_commutes, rationalNormal_commutes]
  exact_mod_cast hφzw

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap_image_rectangle
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    change (coordinateSwap w).re ∈ Set.uIcc a.im b.im ∧
      (coordinateSwap w).im ∈ Set.uIcc a.re b.re
    simpa using hw.symm
  · intro hz
    refine ⟨coordinateSwap z, ?_, coordinateSwap_apply_apply z⟩
    change (coordinateSwap z).re ∈ Set.uIcc a.re b.re ∧
      (coordinateSwap z).im ∈ Set.uIcc a.im b.im

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap_image_triangle
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, hnondeg, rfl⟩ := hs
  refine ⟨coordinateSwap a, coordinateSwap b, coordinateSwap c, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have harea : Tiling.twiceSignedArea (coordinateSwap a) (coordinateSwap b)
        (coordinateSwap c) = -Tiling.twiceSignedArea a b c := by
      simp [Tiling.twiceSignedArea]
    rw [harea]
    exact neg_ne_zero.mpr hnondeg
  · change coordinateSwap.toLinearMap '' convexHull ℝ {a, b, c} =
      convexHull ℝ {coordinateSwap a, coordinateSwap b, coordinateSwap c}
    rw [coordinateSwap.toLinearMap.image_convexHull]
    congr 1
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    aesop
