  have hInvT : IsInvariantAlong (regularSupport K T) δ := hsupport.symm ▸ invariant_univ δ
  have hInvP := component_isInvariant K δ T hδ htile.2.1 hInvT P
  have hPtile : TilesOn K P.centres P.carrier :=
    tilesOn_regularSupport_of_packing (subfamily_packing htile.2.1 (component_centres_subset P))
  obtain ⟨hPopen, hPreg⟩ := regularSupport_isRegularOpen K P.centres
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := periodStepGroup_containsLattice δ v hδ hv.1
  have hLper : L.toAddSubgroup ≤ aePeriodGroup P.carrier := by
    change L.toAddSubgroup ≤ aePeriodGroup (regularSupport K P.centres)
    rw [aePeriodGroup_eq_periodGroup_of_regularOpen hPopen hPreg]
    exact hL.trans (stepGroup_le_carrierPeriods hInvP (hv.2.2 P hP))
  obtain ⟨U, g, η, hUconv, hUtile, hη, hηboundary, hquake⟩ :=
    nonFLC_earthquakeLimit_inPrescribedLattice K P.centres P.carrier hPtile
      (regularSupport_nonempty (component_centres_nonempty P)) hPopen hPreg hnflc L hLper
  have hfulltile (n : ℕ) : TilesOn K ((g n : Plane) +ᵥ T) Set.univ := by
    simpa using tilesOn_translate htile (g n : Plane)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsep⟩ := exists_packingSeparation K
  obtain ⟨φ, S, hφ, hSclosed, hSsep, hfullconv⟩ :=
    Tiling.Topology.exists_locallyFellConvergent_subsequence ε hε
      (fun n => (g n : Plane) +ᵥ T)
      (fun n => (packing_centres_locallyFinite (hfulltile n).2.1).2.2)
      (fun n => hsep _ (hfulltile n).2.1)
  let u : ℕ → Plane := fun n => (g (φ n) : Plane)
  have hu : ∀ n, u n ∈ periodStepGroup δ v := fun n => hL (g (φ n)).2
  have hfull : Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges (fun n => u n +ᵥ T) S := hfullconv
  have hpart : Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges (fun n => u n +ᵥ P.centres) U :=
    locallyFell_subsequence hUconv hφ
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQcentres⟩ := minimal_componentLimit_isComponent K δ T S U v u
    hK hδ hboundary htile hminimal hready hdecomp hv hu hfull P hP hpart
  have hStile : TilesOn K S Set.univ := tilesOn_isClosed (fun n => hfulltile (φ n)) hfull
  have hSsupport : regularSupport K S = Set.univ :=
    regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) hStile
  have hUirreducible : IsIrreducibleDirectionalSubfamily K δ S U :=
    (irreducible_iff_component K δ S U hδ hStile.2.1
      (hSsupport.symm ▸ invariant_univ δ)).mpr ⟨Q, hQcentres⟩
  have hUcarrier : regularSupport K U = P.carrier :=
    regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn hPopen hPreg hUtile
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hAU, hAne, hAinv⟩ := hquake
  have hηδ : η = δ := invariant_subset_direction_eq hδ hη
    (regularSupport_nonempty hA)
    ((regularSupport_mono hAU).trans_eq hUcarrier) hInvP hAinv
    (noncolumn_carrier_proper htile hdecomp P hP)
  exact hAne (hUirreducible.2.2.2 A hA hAU (hηδ ▸ hAinv))

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.commonCarrierPeriod_of_actual_component_equiv
statement:
private theorem commonCarrierPeriod_of_actual_component_equiv {K : PolygonalRegion}
    {δ : Submodule ℝ Plane} {T S : Set Plane} {v : Plane}
    (e : {P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T // P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T} ≃
      {Q : EarthquakeComponent K δ S // Q ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ S})
    (hcarrier : ∀ P, (e P).1.carrier = P.1.carrier)
    (hcolumn : regularSupport K (columnPart K δ S) = regularSupport K (columnPart K δ T))
    (hperiod : IsCommonCarrierPeriod K δ T v) : IsCommonCarrierPeriod K δ S v
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hperiod.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcolumn]
    exact hperiod.2.1
  · intro Q hQ
    have h : ∀ R : {Q : EarthquakeComponent K δ S // Q ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ S},
        v ∈ periodGroup R.1.carrier := by
      intro R
      obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := e.surjective R
      rw [hcarrier P]
      exact hperiod.2.2 P.1 P.2
    exact h ⟨Q, hQ⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.step_limit_actual_component_equiv
statement:
private theorem step_limit_actual_component_equiv {K : PolygonalRegion}
    {δ : Submodule ℝ Plane} {T S : Set Plane} {v : Plane} {g : ℕ → Plane}
    (hK : HasRationalSlopes K) (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (hbδ : HasBoundaryDirection K δ)
    (htile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) (hminimal : IsMinimalTiling K T Set.univ)
    (hready : IsUniformlyReady K δ T) (hdecomp : HasNontrivialEarthquakeDecomposition K δ T)
    (hperiod : IsCommonCarrierPeriod K δ T v) (hg : ∀ n, g n ∈ periodStepGroup δ v)
    (hfull : Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges (fun n => g n +ᵥ T) S) :
    ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ)
      (e : {P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T // P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T} ≃
        {Q : EarthquakeComponent K δ S // Q ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ S}),
      StrictMono φ ∧
      (∀ P, Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
        (fun n => g (φ n) +ᵥ P.1.centres) (e P).1.centres) ∧
      (∀ P, (e P).1.carrier = P.1.carrier) ∧ IsCommonCarrierPeriod K δ S v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨φ, A, hφ, hAconv, hAcarrier, hCcarrier, hpartition⟩ :=
    actual_noncolumn_partition_limit hK hδ hbδ htile hminimal hready hdecomp hperiod hg hfull
  let JT := {P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T // P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T}
  let JS := {Q : EarthquakeComponent K δ S // Q ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ S}
  have hQ : ∀ P : JT, ∃ Q : JS, Q.1.centres = A P := by
    intro P
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, heq⟩ := minimal_componentLimit_isComponent K δ T S (A P) v
      (fun n => g (φ n)) hK hδ hbδ htile hminimal hready hdecomp hperiod
      (fun n => hg (φ n)) (locallyFell_subsequence hfull hφ) P.1 P.2 (hAconv P)
    exact ⟨⟨Q, hQ⟩, heq⟩
  choose f hf using hQ
  have hfcarrier (P : JT) : (f P).1.carrier = P.1.carrier := by
    change regularSupport K (f P).1.centres = P.1.carrier
    rw [hf P, hAcarrier P]
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro P R hPR
    by_contra hne
    have hd := regularSupport_disjoint_of_disjoint_subfamilies htile.2.1
      (component_centres_subset P.1) (component_centres_subset R.1)
      (component_centres_disjoint (fun heq => hne (Subtype.ext heq)))
    have heq : P.1.carrier = R.1.carrier :=
      (hfcarrier P).symm.trans ((congrArg (fun Q : JS => Q.1.carrier) hPR).trans (hfcarrier R))
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := regularSupport_nonempty (K := K) (component_centres_nonempty P.1)
    have hxR : x ∈ R.1.carrier := heq ▸ hx
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hd hx hxR
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro Q
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := component_centres_nonempty Q.1
    have htS := component_centres_subset Q.1 ht
    rw [← hpartition] at htS
    have htA : t ∈ ⋃ P, A P := htS.resolve_left
      (fun hc => Set.disjoint_left.mp (columnPart_disjoint_noncolumn Q.1 Q.2) hc ht)
    obtain ⟨P, htP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp htA
    have htF : t ∈ (f P).1.centres := (hf P).symm ▸ htP
    refine ⟨P, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    by_contra hne
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (component_centres_disjoint hne) htF ht
  let e : JT ≃ JS := Equiv.ofBijective f ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩
  refine ⟨φ, e, hφ, ?_, hfcarrier,
    commonCarrierPeriod_of_actual_component_equiv e hfcarrier hCcarrier hperiod⟩
  · intro P
    change Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges _ (f P).1.centres
    rw [hf P]
    exact hAconv P

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.minimal_component_limit_preserves_originalCarrier
statement:
private theorem minimal_component_limit_preserves_originalCarrier {K : PolygonalRegion}
    {δ : Submodule ℝ Plane} {T U : Set Plane} {v : Plane} {g : ℕ → Plane}
    (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (htile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (hperiod : IsCommonCarrierPeriod K δ T v) (hg : ∀ n, g n ∈ periodStepGroup δ v)
    (P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T) (hP : P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T)
    (hminimal : IsMinimalTiling K P.centres P.carrier)
    (hpart : Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges (fun n => g n +ᵥ P.centres) U) :
    IsMinimalTiling K U P.carrier
proof:
:= by
  have hTinv : IsInvariantAlong (regularSupport K T) δ := by
    rw [regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) htile]
    exact invariant_univ δ
  have hperiods := stepGroup_le_carrierPeriods
    (component_isInvariant K δ T hδ htile.2.1 hTinv P) (hperiod.2.2 P hP)
  let pg : ℕ → aePeriodGroup P.carrier := fun n =>
    ⟨g n, (AddAction.stabilizer_le_aestabilizer (G := Plane) (μ := volume) P.carrier)
      (hperiods (hg n))⟩
  exact minimal_limit_inCarrier hminimal pg hpart

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.exists_minimal_carrier_lattice_limit
statement:
private theorem exists_minimal_carrier_lattice_limit {K : PolygonalRegion}
    {T E : Set Plane} (htile : TilesOn K T E) (hEopen : IsOpen E)
    (hEreg : interior (closure E) = E) (L : PlanarLattice)
    (hL : L.toAddSubgroup ≤ aePeriodGroup E) :
    ∃ (U : Set Plane) (a : aePeriodGroup E) (ell : ℕ → L.toAddSubgroup),
      IsMinimalTiling K U E ∧
      Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges (fun n => (ell n : Plane) +ᵥ T) ((a : Plane) +ᵥ U)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let X : TilingSpace K E := ⟨⟨T, (packing_centres_locallyFinite htile.2.1).2.2⟩, htile⟩
  obtain ⟨Y, hYhull, hYminimal⟩ := exists_minimalTiling_in_hull X
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hVlim⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp hYhull
  choose g hg using hV
  have hVeq : (fun n => TilingSpace.translate (g n) X) = V := funext hg
  have hspace := hVeq.symm ▸ hVlim
  have hconv := (locallyFell_metrizable K E (fun n => TilingSpace.translate (g n) X) Y).mp hspace
  have hconv' : Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
      (fun n => (g n : Plane) +ᵥ (X.centres : Set Plane)) (Y.centres : Set Plane) := by
    simpa only [tilingSpace_translate_centres] using hconv
  obtain ⟨φ, ell, a, _, _, hlimit⟩ := latticeRestricted_hull_limit hEopen hEreg g hconv' L hL
  exact ⟨Y.centres, a, ell, ⟨Y, rfl, hYminimal⟩, hlimit⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.aePeriodGroup_vadd_eq
statement:
private theorem aePeriodGroup_vadd_eq (E : Set Plane) (a : Plane) :
    aePeriodGroup (a +ᵥ E) = aePeriodGroup E
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  change (u +ᵥ (a +ᵥ E)) =ᵐ[volume] (a +ᵥ E) ↔
    (u +ᵥ E) =ᵐ[volume] E
  constructor
  · intro hu
    have hq : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving (fun x : Plane => -(-a) + x)
        volume volume := by
      simpa using (quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left volume a)
    have h := hq.vadd_ae_eq_of_ae_eq (-a) hu
    simpa [vadd_vadd, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using h
  · intro hu
    have hq : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving (fun x : Plane => -a + x)
        volume volume := by
      simpa using (quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left volume (-a))
    have h := hq.vadd_ae_eq_of_ae_eq a hu
    simpa [vadd_vadd, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using h

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.centre_translate_minimal
statement:
private theorem centre_translate_minimal
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T E : Set Plane} (a : Plane)
    (hT : TilesOn K T E) (hminimal : IsMinimalTiling K T E) :
    IsMinimalTiling K (a +ᵥ T) (a +ᵥ E)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isMinimalTiling_iff_returnSequences K (a +ᵥ T) (a +ᵥ E)
    (tilesOn_translate hT a)).2
  intro L hL
  rcases hL with ⟨g, hg⟩
  have hgroup : aePeriodGroup (a +ᵥ E) = aePeriodGroup E :=
    aePeriodGroup_vadd_eq E a
  let g' : ℕ → aePeriodGroup E := fun n =>
    ⟨g n, by rw [← hgroup]; exact (g n).property⟩
  have hback : Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges (fun n => (g' n : Plane) +ᵥ T)
      ((-a) +ᵥ L) := by
    have h := Tiling.Topology.locallyFell_translate hg (g := fun _ : ℕ => -a)
      (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => -a) atTop (𝓝 (-a)))
    simpa [g', vadd_vadd, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using h
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ :=
    (isMinimalTiling_iff_returnSequences K T E hT).1 hminimal _ ⟨g', hback⟩
  let h' : ℕ → aePeriodGroup (a +ᵥ E) := fun n =>
    ⟨h n, by rw [hgroup]; exact (h n).property⟩
  refine ⟨h', ?_⟩
  have hfwd := Tiling.Topology.locallyFell_translate hh (g := fun _ : ℕ => a)
    (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => a) atTop (𝓝 a))
  simpa [h', vadd_vadd, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hfwd

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.minimal_translate_by_aePeriod
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, hXT, hOrbitMinimal⟩ := hminimal
  have ht : TilesOn K ((a : Plane) +ᵥ T) E := by
    simpa only [tilingSpace_translate_centres, hXT] using (TilingSpace.translate a X).tilesOn
  have hc := (packing_centres_locallyFinite ht.2.1).2.2
  have hminimalT : IsMinimalTiling K T E := ⟨X, hXT, hOrbitMinimal⟩
  exact minimal_limit_inCarrier hminimalT (fun _ => a) ⟨fun _ => hc, hc, tendsto_const_nhds⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.minimalize_one_actual_component
statement:
private theorem minimalize_one_actual_component {K : PolygonalRegion}
    {δ : Submodule ℝ Plane} {T : Set Plane} {v : Plane}
    (hK : HasRationalSlopes K) (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (hbδ : HasBoundaryDirection K δ)
    (htile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) (hminimal : IsMinimalTiling K T Set.univ)
    (hready : IsUniformlyReady K δ T) (hdecomp : HasNontrivialEarthquakeDecomposition K δ T)
    (hperiod : IsCommonCarrierPeriod K δ T v)
    (P : {P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T // P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T}) :
    ∃ (S : Set Plane) (g : ℕ → Plane)
      (e : {P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T // P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T} ≃
        {Q : EarthquakeComponent K δ S // Q ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ S}),
      (∀ n, g n ∈ periodStepGroup δ v) ∧
      Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges (fun n => g n +ᵥ T) S ∧
      (∀ R, (e R).1.carrier = R.1.carrier) ∧ IsCommonCarrierPeriod K δ S v ∧
      IsMinimalTiling K (e P).1.centres (e P).1.carrier ∧
      (∀ R, IsMinimalTiling K R.1.centres R.1.carrier →
        IsMinimalTiling K (e R).1.centres (e R).1.carrier)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hTinv : IsInvariantAlong (regularSupport K T) δ := by
    rw [regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) htile]
    exact invariant_univ δ
  have hPinv := component_isInvariant K δ T hδ htile.2.1 hTinv P.1
  have hPtile : TilesOn K P.1.centres P.1.carrier :=
    tilesOn_regularSupport_of_packing (subfamily_packing htile.2.1 (component_centres_subset P.1))
  obtain ⟨hPopen, hPreg⟩ := regularSupport_isRegularOpen K P.1.centres
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := periodStepGroup_containsLattice δ v hδ hperiod.1
  have hLper : L.toAddSubgroup ≤ aePeriodGroup P.1.carrier := by
    change L.toAddSubgroup ≤ aePeriodGroup (regularSupport K P.1.centres)
    rw [aePeriodGroup_eq_periodGroup_of_regularOpen hPopen hPreg]
    exact hL.trans (stepGroup_le_carrierPeriods hPinv (hperiod.2.2 P.1 P.2))
  obtain ⟨U, a, ell, hUminimal, hpart⟩ :=
    exists_minimal_carrier_lattice_limit hPtile hPopen hPreg L hLper
  have hpartMinimal := minimal_translate_by_aePeriod hUminimal a
  have hfulltile (n : ℕ) : TilesOn K ((ell n : Plane) +ᵥ T) Set.univ := by
    simpa using tilesOn_translate htile (ell n : Plane)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsep⟩ := exists_packingSeparation K
  obtain ⟨ψ, S, hψ, _, _, hfull⟩ :=
    Tiling.Topology.exists_locallyFellConvergent_subsequence ε hε
      (fun n => (ell n : Plane) +ᵥ T)
      (fun n => (packing_centres_locallyFinite (hfulltile n).2.1).2.2)
      (fun n => hsep _ (hfulltile n).2.1)
  let u : ℕ → Plane := fun n => (ell (ψ n) : Plane)
  have hu : ∀ n, u n ∈ periodStepGroup δ v := fun n => hL (ell (ψ n)).2
  obtain ⟨φ, e, hφ, hconv, hcarrier, hSperiod⟩ :=
    step_limit_actual_component_equiv hK hδ hbδ htile hminimal hready hdecomp hperiod hu hfull
  let g : ℕ → Plane := fun n => u (φ n)
  have hg : ∀ n, g n ∈ periodStepGroup δ v := fun n => hu (φ n)
  have hselected : (e P).1.centres = (a : Plane) +ᵥ U := by
    have hpart' := locallyFell_subsequence (locallyFell_subsequence hpart hψ) hφ
    exact Set.Subset.antisymm
      (locallyFell_limits_subset (fun _ => subset_rfl) (hconv P) hpart')
      (locallyFell_limits_subset (fun _ => subset_rfl) hpart' (hconv P))
  refine ⟨S, g, e, hg, locallyFell_subsequence hfull hφ, hcarrier, hSperiod, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hselected, hcarrier P]
    exact hpartMinimal
  · intro R hRminimal
    rw [hcarrier R]
    exact minimal_component_limit_preserves_originalCarrier hδ htile hperiod hg
      R.1 R.2 hRminimal (hconv R)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.restricted_translated_limits_transitive
statement:
private theorem restricted_translated_limits_transitive
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T S U : Set Plane}
    (hT : TilesOn K T Set.univ) (G : AddSubgroup Plane)
    (g h : ℕ → Plane) (hg : ∀ n, g n ∈ G) (hh : ∀ n, h n ∈ G)
    (hfull : Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges (fun n => g n +ᵥ T) S)
    (hlimit : Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges (fun n => h n +ᵥ S) U) :
    ∃ f : ℕ → Plane, (∀ n, f n ∈ G) ∧
      Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges (fun n => f n +ᵥ T) U
proof:
:= by
  let GOrbit : Set (TilingSpace K Set.univ) :=
    Set.range fun v : G =>
      TilingSpace.translate
        (⟨(v : Plane), plane_mem_aePeriodGroup_univ v⟩ :
          aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Plane))
        (⟨⟨T, (packing_centres_locallyFinite hT.2.1).2.2⟩, hT⟩ :
          TilingSpace K Set.univ)
  let X : TilingSpace K Set.univ :=
    ⟨⟨T, (packing_centres_locallyFinite hT.2.1).2.2⟩, hT⟩
  have hTseq : ∀ n, TilesOn K (g n +ᵥ T) Set.univ := by
    intro n
    simpa using tilesOn_translate hT (g n)
  have hS : TilesOn K S Set.univ :=
    Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.tilesOn_isClosed hTseq hfull
  have hSseq : ∀ n, TilesOn K (h n +ᵥ S) Set.univ := by
    intro n
    simpa using tilesOn_translate hS (h n)
  let Yn : ℕ → TilingSpace K Set.univ := fun n =>
    ⟨⟨h n +ᵥ S, (packing_centres_locallyFinite (hSseq n).2.1).2.2⟩,
      hSseq n⟩
  have hYn_mem : ∀ n, Yn n ∈ closure GOrbit := by
    intro n
    let kn : ℕ → aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Plane) := fun m =>
      ⟨h n + g m, plane_mem_aePeriodGroup_univ (h n + g m)⟩
    have htranslated := Tiling.Topology.locallyFell_translate hfull
      (g := fun _ : ℕ => h n)
      (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => h n) atTop (𝓝 (h n)))
    have hspace : Tendsto (fun m => TilingSpace.translate (kn m) X)
        atTop (𝓝 (Yn n)) := by
      apply (Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.locallyFell_metrizable K Set.univ
        (fun m => TilingSpace.translate (kn m) X) (Yn n)).2
      simpa only [tilingSpace_translate_centres, kn, X, Yn,
        TopologicalSpace.Closeds.coe_mk, vadd_vadd] using htranslated
    apply isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto hspace
    filter_upwards with m
    exact subset_closure ⟨⟨h n + g m, G.add_mem (hh n) (hg m)⟩, rfl⟩
  have hU : TilesOn K U Set.univ :=
    Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.tilesOn_isClosed hSseq hlimit
  let Y : TilingSpace K Set.univ :=
    ⟨⟨U, (packing_centres_locallyFinite hU.2.1).2.2⟩, hU⟩
  have hspaceLimit : Tendsto Yn atTop (𝓝 Y) := by
    apply (Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.locallyFell_metrizable K Set.univ Yn Y).2
    simpa only [Yn, Y, TopologicalSpace.Closeds.coe_mk] using hlimit
  have hYmem : Y ∈ closure GOrbit :=
    isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto hspaceLimit
      (Eventually.of_forall hYn_mem)
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hVlim⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp hYmem
  choose f hf using hV
  have hcentres : ∀ n, (V n).centres = (f n : Plane) +ᵥ T := by
    intro n
    rw [← hf n]
    exact tilingSpace_translate_centres
      ⟨(f n : Plane), plane_mem_aePeriodGroup_univ (f n : Plane)⟩ X
  have hconv := (Tiling.Polygonal.Topology.locallyFell_metrizable
    K Set.univ V Y).1 hVlim
  refine ⟨fun n => (f n : Plane), (fun n => (f n).property), ?_⟩
  simpa only [hcentres, Y, TopologicalSpace.Closeds.coe_mk] using hconv

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.finite_actual_component_minimalization
statement:
private theorem finite_actual_component_minimalization {K : PolygonalRegion}
    {δ : Submodule ℝ Plane} {T : Set Plane} {v : Plane}
    (hK : HasRationalSlopes K) (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (hbδ : HasBoundaryDirection K δ)
    (htile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) (hminimal : IsMinimalTiling K T Set.univ)
    (hready : IsUniformlyReady K δ T) (hdecomp : HasNontrivialEarthquakeDecomposition K δ T)
    (hperiod : IsCommonCarrierPeriod K δ T v)
    (F : Finset {P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T // P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T}) :
    ∃ (S : Set Plane) (g : ℕ → Plane)
      (e : {P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T // P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T} ≃
        {Q : EarthquakeComponent K δ S // Q ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ S}),
      (∀ n, g n ∈ periodStepGroup δ v) ∧
      Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges (fun n => g n +ᵥ T) S ∧
      (∀ R, (e R).1.carrier = R.1.carrier) ∧ IsCommonCarrierPeriod K δ S v ∧
      ∀ R ∈ F, IsMinimalTiling K (e R).1.centres (e R).1.carrier
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction F using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      have hc := (packing_centres_locallyFinite htile.2.1).2.2
      refine ⟨T, fun _ => 0, Equiv.refl _, fun _ => zero_mem _, ?_,
        fun _ => rfl, hperiod, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [zero_vadd] using
          (show Tiling.Topology.LocallyFellConverges (fun _ : ℕ => T) T from
            ⟨fun _ => hc, hc, tendsto_const_nhds⟩)
      · simp
  | @insert P F hPF ih =>
      obtain ⟨S, g, e, hg, hfull, hcarrier, hSperiod, hprev⟩ := ih
      have hS : TilesOn K S Set.univ := tilesOn_isClosed
        (fun n => by simpa using tilesOn_translate htile (g n)) hfull
      have hSminimal := minimal_limit_univ htile hminimal g hfull
      have hSready := uniformlyReady_closedUnderTranslatedLimits K δ T S hδ htile hready g hfull
      have hTall : T ≠ columnPart K δ T := by
        intro hall
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := component_centres_nonempty P.1
        have htC : t ∈ columnPart K δ T := hall ▸ component_centres_subset P.1 ht
        exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (columnPart_disjoint_noncolumn P.1 P.2) htC ht
      have hSdecomp := nonallColumns_limit_decomposition hδ htile hdecomp hperiod hg hfull hTall
      obtain ⟨U, h, f, hh, hlimit, hfcarrier, hUperiod, hselected, hpreserve⟩ :=
        minimalize_one_actual_component hK hδ hbδ hS hSminimal hSready hSdecomp hSperiod (e P)
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hfinal⟩ := restricted_translated_limits_transitive
        htile (periodStepGroup δ v) g h hg hh hfull hlimit
      refine ⟨U, k, e.trans f, hk, hfinal, ?_, hUperiod, ?_⟩
      · intro R
        exact (hfcarrier (e R)).trans (hcarrier R)
      · intro R hR
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hR with hRP | hRF
        · subst R
          exact hselected
        · exact hpreserve (e R) (hprev R hRF)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.minimal_noncolumnComponent_isMinimal
statement:
theorem minimal_noncolumnComponent_isMinimal :
∀ (K : PolygonalRegion) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) (T : Set Plane) (periodVec : Plane),
    HasRationalSlopes K → Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1 → HasBoundaryDirection K δ →
    TilesOn K T Set.univ → IsMinimalTiling K T Set.univ →
    IsUniformlyReady K δ T → HasNontrivialEarthquakeDecomposition K δ T →
    IsCommonCarrierPeriod K δ T periodVec →
      ∀ P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T, IsMinimalTiling K P.centres P.carrier
proof:
:= by
  intro K δ T v hK hδ hbδ htile hminimal hready hdecomp hperiod P hP
  classical
  let JT := {R : EarthquakeComponent K δ T // R ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T}
  have : Finite JT :=
    (commonCarrierPeriod_noncolumnComponents_finite K δ T v hδ htile hperiod).to_subtype
  let : Fintype JT := Fintype.ofFinite JT
  obtain ⟨S, g, e, hg, hfull, hcarrier, hSperiod, hpieces⟩ :=
    finite_actual_component_minimalization hK hδ hbδ htile hminimal hready hdecomp hperiod
      (Finset.univ : Finset JT)
  have hS : TilesOn K S Set.univ := tilesOn_isClosed
    (fun n => by simpa using tilesOn_translate htile (g n)) hfull
  have hSminimal := minimal_limit_univ htile hminimal g hfull
  have hSready := uniformlyReady_closedUnderTranslatedLimits K δ T S hδ htile hready g hfull
  have hTall : T ≠ columnPart K δ T := by
    intro hall
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := component_centres_nonempty P
    have htC : t ∈ columnPart K δ T := hall ▸ component_centres_subset P ht
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (columnPart_disjoint_noncolumn P hP) htC ht
  have hSdecomp := nonallColumns_limit_decomposition hδ htile hdecomp hperiod hg hfull hTall
  have hAllS (R : {R : EarthquakeComponent K δ S // R ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ S}) :
      IsMinimalTiling K R.1.centres R.1.carrier := by
    obtain ⟨A, rfl⟩ := e.surjective R
    exact hpieces A (Finset.mem_univ A)
  let pg : ℕ → aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Plane) :=
    fun n => ⟨g n, plane_mem_aePeriodGroup_univ (g n)⟩
  obtain ⟨h, hreturn⟩ := (isMinimalTiling_iff_returnSequences K T Set.univ htile).mp
    hminimal S ⟨pg, hfull⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := periodStepGroup_containsLattice δ v hδ hperiod.1
  have hSinv : IsInvariantAlong (regularSupport K S) δ := by
    rw [regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) hS]
    exact invariant_univ δ
  have hLcolumn : L.toAddSubgroup ≤ periodGroup (regularSupport K (columnPart K δ S)) :=
    hL.trans (stepGroup_le_carrierPeriods (columnPart_invariant hδ hS.2.1 hSinv) hSperiod.2.1)
  obtain ⟨a, _, ell, hell, _, hcorrected, _, _⟩ :=
    fixedCarrier_limit_inLattice hS columnPart_subset L hLcolumn hreturn
  have hellStep : ∀ n, ell n ∈ periodStepGroup δ v := fun n => hL (hell n)
  obtain ⟨φ, f, hφ, hpart, hfcarrier, _⟩ :=
    step_limit_actual_component_equiv hK hδ hbδ hS hSminimal hSready hSdecomp
      hSperiod hellStep hcorrected
  let z := noncolumnComponents_vadd_equiv K δ T a
  let p : JT := ⟨P, hP⟩
  let R := f.symm (z p)
  have hRminimal := hAllS R
  have hQminimal : IsMinimalTiling K (z p).1.centres (z p).1.carrier := by
    have hm : IsMinimalTiling K (f R).1.centres (f R).1.carrier := by
      rw [hfcarrier R]
      exact minimal_component_limit_preserves_originalCarrier hδ hS hSperiod
        (fun n => hellStep (φ n)) R.1 R.2 hRminimal (hpart R)
    simpa only [R, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hm
  have haT : TilesOn K (a +ᵥ T) Set.univ := by
    simpa using tilesOn_translate htile a
  have hQtile : TilesOn K (z p).1.centres (z p).1.carrier :=
    tilesOn_regularSupport_of_packing
      (subfamily_packing haT.2.1 (component_centres_subset (z p).1))
  have hback := centre_translate_minimal (-a) hQtile hQminimal
  have hzcentres : (z p).1.centres = a +ᵥ P.centres :=
    earthquakeComponent_vadd_centres K δ T a P
  have hzcarrier : (z p).1.carrier = a +ᵥ P.carrier := by
    change regularSupport K (z p).1.centres = a +ᵥ regularSupport K P.centres
    rw [hzcentres, regularSupport_vadd]
  simpa only [hzcentres, hzcarrier, vadd_vadd, neg_add_cancel, zero_vadd] using hback

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.wholePlane_structure_of_hasFLC
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let δ : Submodule ℝ Plane := Submodule.span ℝ ({(1 : Plane)} : Set Plane)
  have hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1 := finrank_span_singleton (by norm_num)
  have hrat : HasRationalDirection δ := by
    refine ⟨![1, 0], ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hz
      have h0 := congrArg (fun z : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.IntegerPlane => z 0) hz
      norm_num at h0
    · have hpoint : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint ![1, 0] = (1 : Plane) := by
        norm_num [Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint]
      rw [hpoint]
      exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton 1)
  have hsupport : regularSupport K T = Set.univ :=
    regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) htile
  have hTne : T.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    have hT : T = ∅ := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h
    rw [hT, regularSupport_empty] at hsupport
    exact Set.empty_ne_univ hsupport
  refine ⟨{
    direction := δ
    direction_oneDim := hδ
    direction_rational := hrat
    columnAggregate := ∅
    aggregate_isUnionColumns := by intro t ht; simp at ht
    numberOfPieces := 1
    piece := fun _ => T
    piece_nonempty := fun _ => hTne
    pieces_pairwiseDisjoint := ?_
    column_disjoint_piece := by intro j; simp
    centres_partition := by
      change (∅ : Set Plane) ∪ (⋃ _ : Fin 1, T) = T
      rw [Set.empty_union]
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · intro x hx
        obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
        exact hj
      · intro x hx
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(0 : Fin 1), hx⟩
    piece_hasFLC := fun _ => hflc
    piece_minimal := fun _ => hsupport.symm ▸ hminimal
    aggregate_invariant := by rw [regularSupport_empty]; intro u hu; simp
    piece_invariant := fun _ => hsupport.symm ▸ invariant_univ δ
    aggregate_carrier_periodic := by rw [regularSupport_empty]; exact empty_latticePeriodic
    piece_carrier_periodic := fun _ => hsupport.symm ▸ univ_latticePeriodic
  }⟩
  intro i hi j hj hij
  exact (hij (Subsingleton.elim i j)).elim

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.wholePlane_structure_of_allColumns
statement:
private theorem wholePlane_structure_of_allColumns {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane}
    {δ : Submodule ℝ Plane} (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1)
    (hrat : HasRationalDirection δ) (htile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (hcols : IsUnionOfColumns K δ T) : Nonempty (MinimalWholePlaneStructure K T)
proof:
:= by
  have hsupport : regularSupport K T = Set.univ :=
    regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) htile
  exact ⟨{
    direction := δ
    direction_oneDim := hδ
    direction_rational := hrat
    columnAggregate := T
    aggregate_isUnionColumns := hcols
    numberOfPieces := 0
    piece := Fin.elim0
    piece_nonempty := fun j => Fin.elim0 j
    pieces_pairwiseDisjoint := by intro i; exact Fin.elim0 i
    column_disjoint_piece := fun j => Fin.elim0 j
    centres_partition := by simp
    piece_hasFLC := fun j => Fin.elim0 j
    piece_minimal := fun j => Fin.elim0 j
    aggregate_invariant := hsupport.symm ▸ invariant_univ δ
    piece_invariant := fun j => Fin.elim0 j
    aggregate_carrier_periodic := hsupport.symm ▸ univ_latticePeriodic
    piece_carrier_periodic := fun j => Fin.elim0 j
  }⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.minimal_wholePlane_structure
statement:
theorem minimal_wholePlane_structure :
∀ (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set Plane), HasRationalSlopes K →
    TilesOn K T Set.univ → IsMinimalTiling K T Set.univ →
      Nonempty (MinimalWholePlaneStructure K T)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hK htile hminimal
  classical
  by_cases hflc : HasFLC T
  · exact wholePlane_structure_of_hasFLC htile hminimal hflc
  · obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hboundary, hrat, hready, hdecomp⟩ :=
      minimal_nonFLC_uniformlyReady K T hK htile hminimal hflc
    by_cases hcolumns : T = columnPart K δ T
    · apply wholePlane_structure_of_allColumns hδ hrat htile
      simpa only [← hcolumns] using columnPart_isUnionColumns K δ T hδ htile.2.1
    
    · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := uniformlyReady_commonCarrierPeriod K δ T
        hK hδ hboundary htile hready hdecomp
      have hfinite := commonCarrierPeriod_noncolumnComponents_finite K δ T v hδ htile hv
      let J := {P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T // P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T}
      let : Fintype J := hfinite.fintype
      let e : Fin (Fintype.card J) ≃ J := (Fintype.equivFin J).symm
      have hsupport : regularSupport K T = Set.univ :=
        regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) htile
      have hInv : IsInvariantAlong (regularSupport K T) δ :=
        hsupport ▸ invariant_univ δ
      have hcinv : IsInvariantAlong (regularSupport K (columnPart K δ T)) δ :=
        columnPart_invariant hδ htile.2.1 hInv
      have hpiece_union :
          (⋃ j : Fin (Fintype.card J), (e j).1.centres) = ⋃ P : J, P.1.centres := by
        ext x
        constructor
        · intro hx
          obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
          exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e j, hj⟩
        · intro hx
          obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
          obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := e.surjective P
          exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hP⟩
      refine ⟨{
        direction := δ
        direction_oneDim := hδ
        direction_rational := hrat
        columnAggregate := columnPart K δ T
        aggregate_isUnionColumns := columnPart_isUnionColumns K δ T hδ htile.2.1
        numberOfPieces := Fintype.card J
        piece := fun j => (e j).1.centres
        piece_nonempty := fun j => component_centres_nonempty (e j).1
        pieces_pairwiseDisjoint := ?_
        column_disjoint_piece := fun j => columnPart_disjoint_noncolumn (e j).1 (e j).2
        centres_partition := ?_
        piece_hasFLC := fun j => minimal_noncolumnComponent_hasFLC
          K δ T v hK hδ hboundary htile hminimal hready hdecomp hv (e j).1 (e j).2
        piece_minimal := fun j => minimal_noncolumnComponent_isMinimal
          K δ T v hK hδ hboundary htile hminimal hready hdecomp hv (e j).1 (e j).2
        aggregate_invariant := hcinv
        piece_invariant := fun j => component_isInvariant K δ T hδ htile.2.1 hInv (e j).1
        aggregate_carrier_periodic := carrier_latticePeriodic_of_commonPeriod hδ hv.1 hcinv hv.2.1
        piece_carrier_periodic := fun j => carrier_latticePeriodic_of_commonPeriod hδ hv.1
          (component_isInvariant K δ T hδ htile.2.1 hInv (e j).1) (hv.2.2 (e j).1 (e j).2)
      }⟩
      · intro i hi j hj hij
        apply component_centres_disjoint
        intro heq
        exact hij (e.injective (Subtype.ext heq))
      · rw [hpiece_union]
        exact components_partition K δ T

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.integer_gap_shift
statement:
private theorem integer_gap_shift (x : ℤ → ℝ) (k : ℤ)
    (hgap : ∀ i : ℤ,
      x (i + 1) - x i = x (i + k + 1) - x (i + k)) :
    ∀ i : ℤ, x (i + k) - x i = x k - x 0
proof:
:= by
  let displacement : ℤ → ℝ := fun i => x (i + k) - x i
  have hdisplacement_succ (i : ℤ) : displacement (i + 1) = displacement i := by
    dsimp [displacement]
    have hindex : i + 1 + k = i + k + 1 := by omega
    rw [hindex]
    linarith [hgap i]
  have hdisplacement (i : ℤ) : displacement i = displacement 0 := by
    refine Int.inductionOn' i 0 rfl ?_ ?_
    · intro j _hj hj
      exact (hdisplacement_succ j).trans hj
    · intro j _hj hj
      calc
        displacement (j - 1) = displacement ((j - 1) + 1) :=
          (hdisplacement_succ (j - 1)).symm
        _ = displacement j := by congr 1; omega
        _ = displacement 0 := hj
  intro i
  simpa [displacement] using hdisplacement i

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.strict_mono_surjective_int_shift
proof:
:= by
  have hstep (i : ℤ) : f (i + 1) = f i + 1 := by
    have hstrict : f i < f (i + 1) := hf (by omega)
    by_contra hne
    have hgap : f i + 1 < f (i + 1) := by omega
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hsurj (f i + 1)
    by_cases hji : j ≤ i
    · have hmono := hf.monotone hji
      rw [hj] at hmono
      omega
    · have hij : i + 1 ≤ j := by omega
      have hmono := hf.monotone hij
      rw [hj] at hmono
      omega
  let displacement : ℤ → ℤ := fun i => f i - i
  have hdisplacement_succ (i : ℤ) : displacement (i + 1) = displacement i := by
    dsimp [displacement]
    rw [hstep i]
    omega
  have hdisplacement (i : ℤ) : displacement i = displacement 0 := by
    refine Int.inductionOn' i 0 rfl ?_ ?_
    · intro j _hj hj
      exact (hdisplacement_succ j).trans hj
    · intro j _hj hj
      calc
        displacement (j - 1) = displacement ((j - 1) + 1) :=
          (hdisplacement_succ (j - 1)).symm
        _ = displacement j := by congr 1; omega
        _ = displacement 0 := hj
  intro i
  dsimp [displacement] at hdisplacement
  linarith [hdisplacement i]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.integer_chain_period_shift
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : β +ᵥ Set.range x = Set.range x := by
    change β ∈ AddAction.stabilizer ℝ (Set.range x) at hperiod
    exact AddAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp hperiod
  have hex (i : ℤ) : ∃ j : ℤ, x j = x i + β := by
    have hmem : x i + β ∈ Set.range x := by
      rw [← hshift]
      exact ⟨x i, Set.mem_range_self i, by simp only [vadd_eq_add]; ring⟩
    exact hmem
  choose f hf using hex
  have hfmono : StrictMono f := by
    intro i j hij
    apply hx.lt_iff_lt.mp
    rw [hf i, hf j]
    linarith [hx hij]
  have hfsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro j
    have hmem : x j ∈ β +ᵥ Set.range x := by rw [hshift]; exact Set.mem_range_self j
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, hi⟩ := hmem
    refine ⟨i, hx.injective ?_⟩
    rw [hf i]
    simpa only [vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hi
  have hfshift := strict_mono_surjective_int_shift f hfmono hfsurj
  refine ⟨f 0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hk
    have hh := hf 0
    rw [hk] at hh
    exact hβ (by linarith)
  · intro i
    rw [← hfshift i]
    exact hf i

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.exists_outside_direction
statement:
private theorem exists_outside_direction (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane)
    (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) : ∃ v : Plane, v ∉ δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have htop : δ = ⊤ := top_unique (fun v _ => h v)
  rw [htop, finrank_top, Complex.finrank_real_complex] at hδ
  norm_num at hδ

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.all_components_columns_of_columnPart_eq
statement:
private theorem all_components_columns_of_columnPart_eq
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {δ : Submodule ℝ Plane} {T : Set Plane}
    (hcol : T = columnPart K δ T) :
    ∀ P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T, IsCenterColumn K δ P.centres
proof:
:= by
  intro P
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := P.nonempty_supp
  have htc : (t : Plane) ∈ columnPart K δ T := by
    rw [← hcol]
    exact t.property
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp htc
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hst⟩ := hQ
  have hst' : s = t := Subtype.ext hst
  subst s
  have hPQ : P = Q.1 :=
    SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq_of_common_vertex ht hs
  simpa only [hPQ] using Q.property

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.exists_noncolumn_of_ne_columnPart
statement:
private theorem exists_noncolumn_of_ne_columnPart
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {δ : Submodule ℝ Plane} {T : Set Plane}
    (hcol : T ≠ columnPart K δ T) :
    ∃ P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T, P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcolT : columnPart K δ T ⊆ T := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp ht
    obtain ⟨s, _hs, rfl⟩ := hQ
    exact s.property
  have hnot : ¬T ⊆ columnPart K δ T := by
    intro h
    exact hcol (Set.Subset.antisymm h hcolT)
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htnot⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hnot
  let s : T := ⟨t, ht⟩
  let P := (earthquakeGraph K δ T).connectedComponentMk s
  refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
  intro hP
  apply htnot
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨P, hP⟩, ⟨s, rfl, rfl⟩⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.columnPart_eq_commonCarrierPeriod
statement:
private theorem columnPart_eq_commonCarrierPeriod
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {δ : Submodule ℝ Plane} {T : Set Plane}
    (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (htile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (hcol : T = columnPart K δ T) :
    ∃ periodVec : Plane, IsCommonCarrierPeriod K δ T periodVec
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_outside_direction δ hδ
  have hsupport : regularSupport K (columnPart K δ T) = Set.univ := by
    rw [← hcol]
    exact regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) htile
  refine ⟨v, hv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hsupport]
    simp [periodGroup]
  · intro P hP
    exact (hP : ¬IsCenterColumn K δ P.centres)
      (all_components_columns_of_columnPart_eq hcol P) |>.elim

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.invariantAlong_projection_preimage
statement:
private theorem invariantAlong_projection_preimage
    (D : Set Plane) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) (π : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hker : LinearMap.ker π = δ) (hD : IsInvariantAlong D δ) :
    π ⁻¹' (π '' D) = D
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    have hδ : x - y ∈ δ := by
      rw [← hker, LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
    rw [← hD (x - y) hδ]
    exact ⟨y, hy, by simp [vadd_eq_add]⟩
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.transverse_projection_locallyFinite
statement:
private theorem transverse_projection_locallyFinite
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) (T : Set Plane)
    (hflc : HasTransverseFLC K δ T) (π : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (hker : LinearMap.ker π.toLinearMap = δ) :
    ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q →
      ((π '' translatedVertices K T) ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓne, hℓker, hℓflc⟩ := hflc
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hπ 1
  have hformula (u : Plane) : ℓ u = π u * ℓ e := by
    have hδ : u - π u • e ∈ δ := by
      rw [← hker, LinearMap.mem_ker]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, map_sub, map_smul, he, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, sub_self]
    have hzero : ℓ (u - π u • e) = 0 := by
      exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp (hℓker.symm ▸ hδ)
    simpa only [map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, sub_eq_zero] using hzero
  have hρne : ℓ e ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hℓne
    ext u
    change ℓ u = 0
    simpa only [hzero, mul_zero] using hformula u
  intro Q hQ
  obtain ⟨R, _hR, hbound⟩ := hQ.exists_pos_norm_le
  have hfinite := hℓflc.1 (Metric.closedBall 0 (R * |ℓ e|)) Metric.isBounded_closedBall
  apply (hfinite.image (fun r : ℝ => r / ℓ e)).subset
  rintro y ⟨⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, hyQ⟩
  refine ⟨ℓ u, ⟨⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simp only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [hformula u, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound _ hyQ)
      (abs_nonneg _)
  · change ℓ u / ℓ e = π u
    rw [hformula u, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hρne]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.exists_ordered_integer_chain
statement:
private theorem exists_ordered_integer_chain
    (Y : Set ℝ) (hfinite : ∀ a b : ℝ, (Y ∩ Set.Icc a b).Finite)
    (habove : ∀ r : ℝ, ∃ a ∈ Y, r < a) (hbelow : ∀ r : ℝ, ∃ a ∈ Y, a < r) :
    ∃ y : ℤ → ℝ, Set.range y = Y ∧ StrictMono y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨y0, hy0⟩ := habove 0
  let α := {x : ℝ // x ∈ Y}
  have hIccFinite : ∀ a b : α, (Set.Icc a b).Finite := by
    intro a b
    have hreal : (Y ∩ Set.Icc (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)).Finite := hfinite _ _
    have hpre : ((fun x : α => (x : ℝ)) ⁻¹' (Y ∩ Set.Icc (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ))).Finite :=
      hreal.preimage (by
        intro x hx z hz hxz
        exact Subtype.ext hxz)
    apply hpre.subset
    intro x hx
    change a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b at hx
    change (x : ℝ) ∈ Y ∩ Set.Icc (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    exact ⟨x.2, hx⟩
  let : LocallyFiniteOrder α := LocallyFiniteOrder.ofFiniteIcc hIccFinite
  have : Nonempty α := ⟨⟨y0, hy0.1⟩⟩
  have : NoMaxOrder α := ⟨fun a => by
    obtain ⟨z, hzY, haz⟩ := habove (a : ℝ)
    exact ⟨⟨z, hzY⟩, haz⟩⟩
  have : NoMinOrder α := ⟨fun a => by
    obtain ⟨z, hzY, hza⟩ := hbelow (a : ℝ)
    exact ⟨⟨z, hzY⟩, hza⟩⟩
  let : SuccOrder α := LinearLocallyFiniteOrder.succOrder α
  let : PredOrder α := LinearLocallyFiniteOrder.predOrder α
  let e : α ≃o ℤ := orderIsoIntOfLinearSuccPredArch
  refine ⟨fun n => (e.symm n : ℝ), ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Set.eq_of_subset_of_subset
    · rintro x ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact (e.symm n).2
    · intro x hx
      let a : α := ⟨x, hx⟩
      exact ⟨e a, by simp [a, e]⟩
  · intro a b hab
    exact_mod_cast e.symm.strictMono hab

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.ep_frontier_level_has_translatedVertex
statement:
private theorem ep_frontier_level_has_translatedVertex
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (S : Set Plane)
    (hp : IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements S))
    (π : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (a e : Plane) (he : e ≠ 0) (hπe : π e = 0)
    (hline : {y | π y = π a} ⊆ frontier (regularSupport K S)) :
    ∃ v ∈ vertexSet K.support, ∃ s ∈ S, π (v + s) = π a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, hvertex⟩ :=
    Tiling.Polygonal.frontierLevel_has_bounded_intrinsicVertex K S hp π e he hπe
  obtain ⟨v, s, hv, hs, hlevel, _⟩ := hvertex a hline
  exact ⟨v, hv, s, hs, hlevel⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.invariant_carrier_boundaryLevels_subset_translatedVertices
statement:
private theorem invariant_carrier_boundaryLevels_subset_translatedVertices
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (S : Set Plane) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane)
    (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1)
    (hp : IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements S))
    (π : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hker : LinearMap.ker π = δ)
    (hD : IsInvariantAlong (regularSupport K S) δ) :
    π '' frontier (regularSupport K S) ⊆ π '' translatedVertices K S
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial δ := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_eq_succ hδ
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_ne (0 : δ)
  have he' : (e : Plane) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact he (Subtype.ext h)
  have hπe : π (e : Plane) = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp (hker.symm ▸ e.property)
  have hfront := invariantAlong_frontier (regularSupport K S) δ hD
  rintro r ⟨x, hx, hxr⟩
  have hline : {y | π y = π x} ⊆ frontier (regularSupport K S) := by
    intro y hy
    have hdiff : y - x ∈ δ := by
      rw [← hker, LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub, hy, sub_self]
    rw [← hfront (y - x) hdiff]
    exact ⟨x, hx, by simp [vadd_eq_add]⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv, s, hs, hvs⟩ :=
    ep_frontier_level_has_translatedVertex K S hp π x e he' hπe hline
  exact ⟨v + s, ⟨v, hv, s, hs, rfl⟩, hvs.trans hxr⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.invariantAlong_regularize
statement:
private theorem invariantAlong_regularize (D : Set Plane) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane)
    (hD : IsInvariantAlong D δ) : IsInvariantAlong (interior (closure D)) δ
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  rw [← interior_vadd, ← closure_vadd, hD u hu]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.invariantAlong_iUnion
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hyi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    rw [← hD i u hu]
    exact ⟨y, hyi, rfl⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    rw [← hD i u hu] at hxi
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hxi
    exact ⟨y, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hy⟩, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.periodGroup_map_eq_of_isInvariantAlong
statement:
private theorem periodGroup_map_eq_of_isInvariantAlong
    (D : Set Plane) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane)
    (π : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hker : LinearMap.ker π = δ)
    (hD : IsInvariantAlong D δ) (v : Plane) :
    v ∈ periodGroup D ↔ π v ∈ periodGroup (π '' D)
proof:
:= by
  have htranslateInvariant (u : Plane) : IsInvariantAlong (u +ᵥ D) δ := by
    intro w hw
    calc
      w +ᵥ (u +ᵥ D) = u +ᵥ (w +ᵥ D) := by
        ext p
        simp [Set.mem_vadd_set, vadd_eq_add, add_left_comm]
      _ = u +ᵥ D := by rw [hD w hw]
  have himage (u : Plane) : π '' (u +ᵥ D) = π u +ᵥ (π '' D) := by
    ext z
    simp [Set.mem_vadd_set, vadd_eq_add, map_add]
  change v ∈ AddAction.stabilizer Plane D ↔ π v ∈ AddAction.stabilizer ℝ (π '' D)
  simp only [AddAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hv
    rw [← himage v, hv]
  · intro hv
    have hpre : π ⁻¹' (π '' (v +ᵥ D)) = π ⁻¹' (π '' D) := by
      rw [himage v, hv]
    rw [invariantAlong_projection_preimage (v +ᵥ D) δ π hker (htranslateInvariant v),
      invariantAlong_projection_preimage D δ π hker hD] at hpre
    exact hpre

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.wholePlane_components_invariant
statement:
private theorem wholePlane_components_invariant
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) (T : Set Plane)
    (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (htile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    (∀ P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T, IsInvariantAlong P.carrier δ) ∧
      IsInvariantAlong (regularSupport K (columnPart K δ T)) δ
proof:
:= by
  have hsupport : regularSupport K T = Set.univ :=
    regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) htile
  have hinv : IsInvariantAlong (regularSupport K T) δ := by
    rw [hsupport]
    intro u _hu
    simp
  have hcomp := component_isInvariant K δ T hδ htile.2.1 hinv
  refine ⟨hcomp, ?_⟩
  rw [columnPart, regularSupport_iUnion]
  apply invariantAlong_regularize
  apply invariantAlong_iUnion
  intro P
  exact hcomp P.1

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.colouredCentres_subset
statement:
private theorem colouredCentres_subset (K : PolygonalRegion) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane)
    (T : Set Plane)
    (c : Option {P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T // P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T}) :
    colouredCentres K δ T c ⊆ T
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with _ | P
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨P, hxP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact component_centres_subset P.1 hxP
  · exact component_centres_subset P.1

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.colouredCarrier_invariant
statement:
private theorem colouredCarrier_invariant (K : PolygonalRegion) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane)
    (T : Set Plane) (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (htile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (c : Option {P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T // P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T}) :
    IsInvariantAlong (colouredCarrier K δ T c) δ
proof:
:= by
  have hinv := wholePlane_components_invariant K δ T hδ htile
  rcases c with _ | P
  · exact hinv.2
  · exact hinv.1 P.1

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.componentColourEquiv_centres
statement:
private theorem componentColourEquiv_centres
    {K K' : PolygonalRegion} {δ : Submodule ℝ Plane} {T T' : Set Plane}
    (e : EarthquakeComponent K δ T ≃ EarthquakeComponent K' δ T')
    (hcol : ∀ P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T,
      IsCenterColumn K δ P.centres ↔ IsCenterColumn K' δ (e P).centres)
    (d : Plane → Plane)
    (hcentres : ∀ P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T, (e P).centres = d '' P.centres)
    (hcolumn : columnPart K' δ T' = d '' columnPart K δ T)
    (c : Option {P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T // P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T}) :
    colouredCentres K' δ T' (componentColourEquiv e hcol c) = d '' colouredCentres K δ T c
proof:
:= by
  cases c with
  | none => exact hcolumn
  | some c => exact hcentres c.1

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.boundaryLevels_subset_translatedVertices
statement:
private theorem boundaryLevels_subset_translatedVertices
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) (T : Set Plane)
    (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (htile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (π : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hker : LinearMap.ker π = δ) :
    boundaryLevels K δ T π ⊆ π '' translatedVertices K T
proof:
:= by
  have hinv := wholePlane_components_invariant K δ T hδ htile
  have hcolT : columnPart K δ T ⊆ T := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨P, hxP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact component_centres_subset P.1 hxP
  rintro r hr
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hr
  rcases c with _ | P
  · obtain ⟨v, hv, hvr⟩ :=
      invariant_carrier_boundaryLevels_subset_translatedVertices
        K (columnPart K δ T) δ hδ (packing_subfamily htile.2.1 hcolT) π hker hinv.2 hc
    refine ⟨v, ?_, hvr⟩
    exact Set.add_subset_add_left hcolT hv
  · obtain ⟨v, hv, hvr⟩ :=
      invariant_carrier_boundaryLevels_subset_translatedVertices
        K P.1.centres δ hδ (packing_subfamily htile.2.1 (component_centres_subset P.1))
        π hker (hinv.1 P.1) hc
    refine ⟨v, ?_, hvr⟩
    exact Set.add_subset_add_left (component_centres_subset P.1) hv

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.boundaryLevels_locallyFinite
statement:
private theorem boundaryLevels_locallyFinite
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) (T : Set Plane)
    (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (htile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (hflc : HasTransverseFLC K δ T) (π : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (hker : LinearMap.ker π.toLinearMap = δ) :
    ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q →
      (boundaryLevels K δ T π.toLinearMap ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQ
  apply (transverse_projection_locallyFinite K δ T hflc π hπ hker Q hQ).subset
  exact Set.inter_subset_inter_left Q (boundaryLevels_subset_translatedVertices K δ T hδ htile
    π.toLinearMap hker)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.invariant_subfamily_frontier_isProperLink
statement:
private theorem invariant_subfamily_frontier_isProperLink
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) (T S : Set Plane)
    (htile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) (hST : S ⊆ T)
    (hD : IsInvariantAlong (regularSupport K S) δ)
    {a : Plane} (ha : a ∈ frontier (regularSupport K S)) : IsProperLink K δ T a
proof:
:= by
  have hp := packing_subfamily htile.2.1 hST
  have hfront := invariantAlong_frontier (regularSupport K S) δ hD
  rintro y ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
  have hy : a + u ∈ frontier (regularSupport K S) := by
    rw [← hfront u hu]
    exact ⟨a, ha, by simp [vadd_eq_add, add_comm]⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsb⟩ :=
    Tiling.Polygonal.exists_tile_frontier_of_mem_frontier_regularSupport K hp hy
  apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨⟨s, hST hs⟩, (a + u) - s, hsb, ?_⟩
  simp [vadd_eq_add]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.boundaryLevel_has_vertexLink
statement:
private theorem boundaryLevel_has_vertexLink
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) (T : Set Plane)
    (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (htile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (π : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hker : LinearMap.ker π = δ)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ boundaryLevels K δ T π) :
    ∃ v ∈ translatedVertices K T, π v = r ∧ IsProperLink K δ T v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, x, hx, hxr⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hr
  have hST := colouredCentres_subset K δ T c
  have hD := colouredCarrier_invariant K δ T hδ htile c
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvr⟩ := invariant_carrier_boundaryLevels_subset_translatedVertices
    K (colouredCentres K δ T c) δ hδ (packing_subfamily htile.2.1 hST) π hker hD ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hdiff : v - x ∈ δ := by
    rw [← hker, LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub, hvr, sub_self]
  have hvfront : v ∈ frontier (colouredCarrier K δ T c) := by
    rw [← invariantAlong_frontier _ δ hD (v - x) hdiff]
    exact ⟨x, hx, by simp [vadd_eq_add]⟩
  refine ⟨v, Set.add_subset_add_left hST hv, hvr.trans hxr, ?_⟩
  exact invariant_subfamily_frontier_isProperLink K δ T (colouredCentres K δ T c)
    htile hST hD hvfront

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.normalProjection_apply
statement:
private theorem normalProjection_apply (n : Tiling.Approximation.RationalNormal) (x : Plane) :
    normalProjection n x = Tiling.Approximation.normalEval n x
proof: := rfl

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.normalProjection_surjective
statement:
private theorem normalProjection_surjective (n : Tiling.Approximation.RationalNormal) :
    Function.Surjective (normalProjection n)
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  rcases n.nonzero with hx | hy
  · have hx' : (n.x : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hx
    refine ⟨Complex.mk (r / (n.x : ℝ)) 0, ?_⟩
    simp [normalProjection]
    field_simp
  · have hy' : (n.y : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hy
    refine ⟨Complex.mk 0 (r / (n.y : ℝ)), ?_⟩
    simp [normalProjection]
    field_simp

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.normalProjection_deformed_sub
statement:
private theorem normalProjection_deformed_sub
    (φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (n : Tiling.Approximation.RationalNormal) (a b : Plane) :
    Tiling.Approximation.normalEval n (Tiling.Approximation.deformPoint φ (a - b)) =
      (φ (normalProjection n a) : ℝ) - (φ (normalProjection n b) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Tiling.Approximation.rationalNormal_commutes]
  change (φ (normalProjection n (a - b)) : ℝ) = _
  rw [map_sub, map_sub, Rat.cast_sub]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.component_carrier_nonempty
statement:
private theorem component_carrier_nonempty {K : PolygonalRegion} {δ : Submodule ℝ Plane}
    {T : Set Plane} (P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T) : P.carrier.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := P.nonempty_supp
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := K.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty K.nonempty
  have hop : IsOpen (openUnion K P.centres) := by
    apply isOpen_iUnion
    intro s
    exact (Homeomorph.addLeft (s : Plane)).isOpenMap _ isOpen_interior
  refine ⟨(t : Plane) + x, ?_⟩
  apply interior_maximal subset_closure hop
  apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨⟨t, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩⟩, x, hx, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.component_carrier_proper_of_distinct
statement:
private theorem component_carrier_proper_of_distinct
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {δ : Submodule ℝ Plane} {T : Set Plane}
    (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (htile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (P Q : EarthquakeComponent K δ T) (hPQ : P ≠ Q) : P.carrier ≠ Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  intro hPfull
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := component_carrier_nonempty Q
  have hd := components_carriers_disjoint K δ T hδ htile.2.1
    (Set.mem_univ P) (Set.mem_univ Q) hPQ
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hd (by
    change x ∈ P.carrier
    rw [hPfull]
    exact Set.mem_univ x) hx

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.boundaryLevels_nonempty_of_noncolumn
statement:
private theorem boundaryLevels_nonempty_of_noncolumn
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) (T : Set Plane)
    (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (htile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (hnontrivial : ∃ P Q : EarthquakeComponent K δ T, P ≠ Q)
    (P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T) (hP : P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T)
    (π : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) : (boundaryLevels K δ T π).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, R, hQR⟩ := hnontrivial
  have hex : ∃ Q : EarthquakeComponent K δ T, P ≠ Q := by
    by_cases hPQ : P = Q
    · exact ⟨R, hPQ ▸ hQR⟩
    · exact ⟨Q, hPQ⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hPQ⟩ := hex
  have hfront := nonempty_frontier_iff.mpr ⟨component_carrier_nonempty P,
    component_carrier_proper_of_distinct hδ htile P Q hPQ⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hfront
  exact ⟨π x, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨some ⟨P, hP⟩, x, hx, rfl⟩⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.invariant_regularize_projection
statement:
private theorem invariant_regularize_projection
    (U : Set Plane) (hU : IsOpen U) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane)
    (π : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (hker : LinearMap.ker π.toLinearMap = δ)
    (hC : IsInvariantAlong (interior (closure U)) δ) :
    π '' interior (closure U) = interior (closure (π '' U))
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpenMap π := π.toLinearMap.isOpenMap_of_finiteDimensional hπ
  have hpre := invariantAlong_projection_preimage (interior (closure U)) δ
    π.toLinearMap hker hC
  have hUC : U ⊆ interior (closure U) := interior_maximal subset_closure hU
  have hsat : π ⁻¹' (π '' U) ⊆ interior (closure U) := by
    rw [← hpre]
    exact Set.preimage_mono (Set.image_mono hUC)
  have hclosures : closure (π ⁻¹' (π '' U)) = closure U := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact closure_minimal (hsat.trans interior_subset) isClosed_closure
    · exact closure_mono (Set.subset_preimage_image _ _)
  have heq : π ⁻¹' interior (closure (π '' U)) = interior (closure U) := by
    rw [hopen.preimage_interior_eq_interior_preimage π.continuous,
      hopen.preimage_closure_eq_closure_preimage π.continuous, hclosures]
  rw [← heq, Set.image_preimage_eq _ hπ]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.invariant_frontier_projection
statement:
private theorem invariant_frontier_projection
    (D : Set Plane) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) (π : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (hker : LinearMap.ker π.toLinearMap = δ)
    (hD : IsInvariantAlong D δ) : π '' frontier D = frontier (π '' D)
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpenMap π := π.toLinearMap.isOpenMap_of_finiteDimensional hπ
  have hpre := invariantAlong_projection_preimage D δ π.toLinearMap hker hD
  change π ⁻¹' (π '' D) = D at hpre
  have heq : π ⁻¹' frontier (π '' D) = frontier D := by
    rw [hopen.preimage_frontier_eq_frontier_preimage π.continuous, hpre]
  rw [← heq, Set.image_preimage_eq _ hπ]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.openUnion_projection_intervals
statement:
private theorem openUnion_projection_intervals
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (S : Set Plane) (π : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (I : Finset (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hI : π '' K.openCarrier = ⋃ e ∈ I, Set.Ioo e.1 e.2) :
    π '' openUnion K S = ⋃ s : S, ⋃ e ∈ I,
      Set.Ioo (π s + e.1) (π s + e.2)
proof:
:= by
  have htranslate (s : Plane) : π '' (s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) =
      (fun r : ℝ => π s + r) '' (π '' K.openCarrier) := by
    ext r
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨π x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, (map_add π s x).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨s + x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, map_add π s x⟩
  simp only [openUnion, Set.image_iUnion, htranslate, hI, Set.image_const_add_Ioo]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.invariant_carrier_projection_intervals
statement:
private theorem invariant_carrier_projection_intervals
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (S : Set Plane) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane)
    (π : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (hker : LinearMap.ker π.toLinearMap = δ)
    (hD : IsInvariantAlong (regularSupport K S) δ)
    (I : Finset (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hI : π '' K.openCarrier = ⋃ e ∈ I, Set.Ioo e.1 e.2) :
    π '' regularSupport K S = interior (closure (⋃ s : S, ⋃ e ∈ I,
      Set.Ioo (π s + e.1) (π s + e.2)))
proof:
:= by
  have hU : IsOpen (openUnion K S) := isOpen_iUnion fun s =>
    (Homeomorph.addLeft (s : Plane)).isOpenMap _ isOpen_interior
  rw [regularSupport, invariant_regularize_projection (openUnion K S) hU δ π hπ hker hD]
  have hprojection := openUnion_projection_intervals K S π.toLinearMap I hI
  change π '' openUnion K S = _ at hprojection
  rw [hprojection]
  rfl

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.deformed_openUnion_projection_intervals
statement:
private theorem deformed_openUnion_projection_intervals
    (Kφ : PolygonalRegion) (S : Set Plane) (n : Tiling.Approximation.RationalNormal)
    (φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (I : Finset (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hIφ : Tiling.Approximation.normalEval n '' Kφ.openCarrier =
      ⋃ e ∈ I, Set.Ioo (φ e.1 : ℝ) (φ e.2 : ℝ)) :
    normalProjection n '' openUnion Kφ (Tiling.Approximation.deformPoint φ '' S) =
      ⋃ s : S, ⋃ e ∈ I,
        Set.Ioo (φ (normalProjection n s + e.1) : ℝ)
          (φ (normalProjection n s + e.2) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let J : Finset (ℝ × ℝ) := I.image (fun e => ((φ e.1 : ℝ), (φ e.2 : ℝ)))
  have hJ : normalProjection n '' Kφ.openCarrier = ⋃ e ∈ J, Set.Ioo e.1 e.2 := by
    change Tiling.Approximation.normalEval n '' Kφ.openCarrier = _
    rw [hIφ]
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, J, Finset.mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨e, he, hx⟩
      exact ⟨_, ⟨e, he, rfl⟩, hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨e, he, rfl⟩, hx⟩
      exact ⟨e, he, hx⟩
  have hprojection := openUnion_projection_intervals Kφ
    (Tiling.Approximation.deformPoint φ '' S) (normalProjection n).toLinearMap J hJ
  change normalProjection n '' openUnion Kφ (Tiling.Approximation.deformPoint φ '' S) = _
    at hprojection
  rw [hprojection]
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, e, he, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hts⟩ := s.property
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
    refine ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, q, hq, ?_⟩
    have hπs : normalProjection n s = (φ (normalProjection n t) : ℝ) := by
      rw [← hts]
      exact Tiling.Approximation.rationalNormal_commutes φ n t
    change (normalProjection n).toLinearMap s = (φ (normalProjection n t) : ℝ) at hπs
    change _ < x ∧ x < _ at hx ⊢
    simpa only [hπs, map_add, Rat.cast_add] using hx
  · rintro ⟨s, e, he, hx⟩
    let t : Tiling.Approximation.deformPoint φ '' S :=
      ⟨Tiling.Approximation.deformPoint φ s, ⟨s, s.property, rfl⟩⟩
    refine ⟨t, _, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨e, he, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    have hπt : normalProjection n t = (φ (normalProjection n s) : ℝ) :=
      Tiling.Approximation.rationalNormal_commutes φ n s
    change (normalProjection n).toLinearMap t = (φ (normalProjection n s) : ℝ) at hπt
    change _ < x ∧ x < _ at hx ⊢
    simpa only [hπt, map_add, Rat.cast_add] using hx

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.commonCarrierPeriod_boundaryLevels_period
statement:
private theorem commonCarrierPeriod_boundaryLevels_period
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) (T : Set Plane)
    (π : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Plane) (hv : IsCommonCarrierPeriod K δ T v) :
    π v ∈ periodGroup (boundaryLevels K δ T π)
proof:
:= by
  have hc (c : Option {P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T // P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T}) :
      v ∈ periodGroup (colouredCarrier K δ T c) := by
    cases c with
    | none => exact hv.2.1
    | some c => exact hv.2.2 c.1 c.2
  have hf (c : Option {P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T // P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T}) :
      v +ᵥ frontier (colouredCarrier K δ T c) = frontier (colouredCarrier K δ T c) := by
    have h := (Homeomorph.addLeft v).image_frontier (colouredCarrier K δ T c)
    change v +ᵥ frontier (colouredCarrier K δ T c) =
      frontier (v +ᵥ colouredCarrier K δ T c) at h
    have hc' := hc c
    change v ∈ AddAction.stabilizer Plane (colouredCarrier K δ T c) at hc'
    rw [AddAction.mem_stabilizer_iff] at hc'
    rwa [hc'] at h
  change π v ∈ AddAction.stabilizer ℝ (boundaryLevels K δ T π)
  rw [AddAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
  have hi (c : Option {P : EarthquakeComponent K δ T // P ∈ noncolumnComponents K δ T}) :
      π v +ᵥ (π '' frontier (colouredCarrier K δ T c)) =
        π '' frontier (colouredCarrier K δ T c) := by
    calc
      π v +ᵥ (π '' frontier (colouredCarrier K δ T c)) =
          π '' (v +ᵥ frontier (colouredCarrier K δ T c)) := by
        ext r
        simp [Set.mem_vadd_set, vadd_eq_add, map_add]
      _ = π '' frontier (colouredCarrier K δ T c) := by rw [hf c]
  change π v +ᵥ (⋃ c, π '' frontier (colouredCarrier K δ T c)) = _
  calc
    π v +ᵥ (⋃ c, π '' frontier (colouredCarrier K δ T c)) =
        ⋃ c, π v +ᵥ (π '' frontier (colouredCarrier K δ T c)) := by
      ext r
      simp [Set.mem_vadd_set]
    _ = ⋃ c, π '' frontier (colouredCarrier K δ T c) := by simp_rw [hi]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.exists_relative_dense_radius_of_period
statement:
private theorem exists_relative_dense_radius_of_period
    (B : Set ℝ) (hB : B.Nonempty) (β : ℝ) (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (hperiod : β ∈ periodGroup B) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, ∃ b ∈ B, |r - b| < ρ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hB
  let ρ : ℝ := |β|
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := abs_pos.mpr hβ
  have hρperiod : ρ ∈ periodGroup B := by
    by_cases hβnonneg : 0 ≤ β
    · simpa [ρ, abs_of_nonneg hβnonneg] using hperiod
    · simpa [ρ, abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hβnonneg)] using (periodGroup B).neg_mem hperiod
  refine ⟨ρ, hρ, ?_⟩
  intro r
  let n : ℤ := ⌊(r - a) / ρ⌋
  let b : ℝ := a + (n : ℝ) * ρ
  have hnlow : (n : ℝ) ≤ (r - a) / ρ := Int.floor_le _
  have hnhigh : (r - a) / ρ < (n : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hnρ : (n : ℝ) * ρ ≤ r - a := (le_div_iff₀ hρ).mp hnlow
  have hrρ : r - a < ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ρ := (div_lt_iff₀ hρ).mp hnhigh
  have hnperiod : (n : ℝ) * ρ ∈ periodGroup B := by
    simpa only [zsmul_eq_mul] using (periodGroup B).zsmul_mem hρperiod n
  have hb : b ∈ B := by
    have hshift : (n : ℝ) * ρ +ᵥ B = B := by
      change (n : ℝ) * ρ ∈ AddAction.stabilizer ℝ B at hnperiod
      exact AddAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp hnperiod
    rw [← hshift]
    exact ⟨a, ha, by simp only [vadd_eq_add]; dsimp [b]; ring⟩
  refine ⟨b, hb, abs_lt.mpr ?_⟩
  constructor <;> dsimp [b] <;> nlinarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.finite_bounded_windows_isClosed
statement:
private theorem finite_bounded_windows_isClosed (A : Set ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (A ∩ Q).Finite) : IsClosed A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isOpen_compl_iff, isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
  intro x hx
  have hfin := hA (Metric.closedBall x 1) Metric.isBounded_closedBall
  have havoid : (A ∩ Metric.closedBall x 1)ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 x :=
    hfin.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds (fun h => hx h.1)
  filter_upwards [havoid, Metric.ball_mem_nhds x zero_lt_one] with y hy hyball
  intro hyA
  exact hy ⟨hyA, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hyball⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.coercive_image_finite_bounded_windows
statement:
private theorem coercive_image_finite_bounded_windows
    (A : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (A ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hcoercive : ∀ x ∈ A, |x - a| / 2 ≤ |f x - f a|) :
    ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → ((f '' A) ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQ
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hQ.exists_norm_le
  let R := 2 * (C + |f a|)
  have hfin := hA (Set.Icc (a - R) (a + R)) isCompact_Icc.isBounded
  apply (hfin.image f).subset
  rintro _ ⟨⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hfx⟩
  refine ⟨x, ⟨hx, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  have hnorm : |f x| ≤ C := by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC _ hfx
  have htriangle : |f x - f a| ≤ |f x| + |f a| := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_sub_le (f x) (f a)
  have hd : |x - a| ≤ R := by dsimp [R]; linarith [hcoercive x hx]
  have hh := abs_le.mp hd
  constructor <;> linarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.regularized_interval_endpoints_unbounded
statement:
private theorem regularized_interval_endpoints_unbounded
    {ι : Type*} (a b : ι → ℝ) (A : Set ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ A) (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ A)
    (hfull : interior (closure (⋃ i, Set.Ioo (a i) (b i))) = Set.univ) :
    (∀ r : ℝ, ∃ x ∈ A, r < x) ∧ (∀ r : ℝ, ∃ x ∈ A, x < r)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro r
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have hsub : (⋃ i, Set.Ioo (a i) (b i)) ⊆ Set.Iic r := by
      rintro x hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      exact hi.2.le.trans (h _ (hb i))
    have hreg := interior_subset.trans (closure_minimal hsub isClosed_Iic)
    rw [hfull] at hreg
    have hh := hreg (Set.mem_univ (r + 1))
    change r + 1 ≤ r at hh
    linarith
  · intro r
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have hsub : (⋃ i, Set.Ioo (a i) (b i)) ⊆ Set.Ici r := by
      rintro x hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      exact (h _ (ha i)).trans hi.1.le
    have hreg := interior_subset.trans (closure_minimal hsub isClosed_Ici)
    rw [hfull] at hreg
    have hh := hreg (Set.mem_univ (r - 1))
    change r ≤ r - 1 at hh
    linarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.translatedVertices_projection_unbounded
statement:
private theorem translatedVertices_projection_unbounded
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set Plane) (htile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (π : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (I : Finset (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hI : π '' K.openCarrier = ⋃ e ∈ I, Set.Ioo e.1 e.2)
    (hvertices : ∀ e ∈ I,
      (∃ v ∈ vertexSet K.support, π v = e.1) ∧
      (∃ v ∈ vertexSet K.support, π v = e.2)) :
    (∀ r : ℝ, ∃ x ∈ π '' translatedVertices K T, r < x) ∧
      (∀ r : ℝ, ∃ x ∈ π '' translatedVertices K T, x < r)
proof:
:= by
  let δ := LinearMap.ker π.toLinearMap
  have hfull : regularSupport K T = Set.univ :=
    regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) htile
  have hinv : IsInvariantAlong (regularSupport K T) δ := by
    rw [hfull]
    intro u _
    simp
  have hproj := invariant_carrier_projection_intervals K T δ π hπ rfl hinv I hI
  rw [hfull, Set.image_univ_of_surjective hπ] at hproj
  let J := T × {e : ℝ × ℝ // e ∈ I}
  let a : J → ℝ := fun j => π j.1 + j.2.1.1
  let b : J → ℝ := fun j => π j.1 + j.2.1.2
  have hindexed : (⋃ j : J, Set.Ioo (a j) (b j)) =
      ⋃ s : T, ⋃ e ∈ I, Set.Ioo (π s + e.1) (π s + e.2) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨s, e⟩, hx⟩
      exact ⟨s, e, e.property, hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨s, e, he, hx⟩
      exact ⟨⟨s, ⟨e, he⟩⟩, hx⟩
  have hA (j : J) : a j ∈ π '' translatedVertices K T := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv, he⟩ := (hvertices j.2.1 j.2.2).1
    refine ⟨v + j.1, ⟨v, hv, j.1, j.1.property, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    dsimp [a]
    rw [map_add, he, add_comm]
  have hB (j : J) : b j ∈ π '' translatedVertices K T := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv, he⟩ := (hvertices j.2.1 j.2.2).2
    refine ⟨v + j.1, ⟨v, hv, j.1, j.1.property, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    dsimp [b]
    rw [map_add, he, add_comm]
  apply regularized_interval_endpoints_unbounded a b (π '' translatedVertices K T) hA hB
  rw [hindexed]
  exact hproj.symm

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.finite_windows_no_endpoints_unbounded
statement:
private theorem finite_windows_no_endpoints_unbounded
    (B : Set ℝ) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (hfinite : ∀ a b : ℝ, (B ∩ Set.Icc a b).Finite)
    (hmax : ∀ b ∈ B, ∃ c ∈ B, b < c)
    (hmin : ∀ b ∈ B, ∃ c ∈ B, c < b) :
    (∀ r : ℝ, ∃ b ∈ B, r < b) ∧ (∀ r : ℝ, ∃ b ∈ B, b < r)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ := hB
  constructor
  · intro r
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have hb₀r := h b₀ hb₀
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hgreatest⟩ := Set.exists_max_image (B ∩ Set.Icc b₀ r) id
      (hfinite b₀ r) ⟨b₀, hb₀, le_rfl, hb₀r⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hbc⟩ := hmax b hb.1
    have hcb := hgreatest c ⟨hc, hb.2.1.trans hbc.le, h c hc⟩
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hcb) hbc
  · intro r
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have hrb₀ := h b₀ hb₀
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hleast⟩ := Set.exists_min_image (B ∩ Set.Icc r b₀) id
      (hfinite r b₀) ⟨b₀, hb₀, hrb₀, le_rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcb⟩ := hmin b hb.1
    have hbc := hleast c ⟨hc, h c hc, hcb.le.trans hb.2.2⟩
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hbc) hcb

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.iUnion_finset_reindex
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨i, e⟩, hx⟩
    exact ⟨i, e.1, e.2, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, e, he, hx⟩
    exact ⟨⟨i, ⟨e, he⟩⟩, hx⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.normal_interval_endpoints_mem_translatedVertices
statement:
private theorem normal_interval_endpoints_mem_translatedVertices
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set Plane) (π : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (I : Finset (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hvertices : ∀ e ∈ I,
      (∃ v ∈ vertexSet K.support, π v = e.1) ∧
      (∃ v ∈ vertexSet K.support, π v = e.2))
    {s : Plane} (hs : s ∈ T) {e : ℝ × ℝ} (he : e ∈ I) :
    (π s + e.1 ∈ π '' translatedVertices K T) ∧
      (π s + e.2 ∈ π '' translatedVertices K T)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨v, hv, heval⟩ := (hvertices e he).1
    refine ⟨v + s, ⟨v, hv, s, hs, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, heval, add_comm]
  · obtain ⟨v, hv, heval⟩ := (hvertices e he).2
    refine ⟨v + s, ⟨v, hv, s, hs, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, heval, add_comm]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.mem_iff_of_no_frontier_on_interval
statement:
private theorem mem_iff_of_no_frontier_on_interval
    (D : Set ℝ) (hD : IsOpen D) (x y : ℝ) (hxy : x ≤ y)
    (hno : Set.Icc x y ∩ frontier D = ∅) : x ∈ D ↔ y ∈ D
proof:
:= by
  have hinterval : IsPreconnected (Set.Icc x y) := isPreconnected_Icc
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint D (closure D)ᶜ := by
    apply disjoint_compl_right.mono_right
    intro z hz hzd
    exact hz (subset_closure hzd)
  have hnoFrontier (z : ℝ) (hz : z ∈ Set.Icc x y) : z ∉ frontier D := by
    intro hzf
    have hzmem : z ∈ Set.Icc x y ∩ frontier D := ⟨hz, hzf⟩
    rw [hno] at hzmem
    exact hzmem
  have hpartition : Set.Icc x y ⊆ D ∪ (closure D)ᶜ := by
    intro z hz
    by_cases hzd : z ∈ D
    · exact Or.inl hzd
    · right
      have hzfront := hnoFrontier z hz
      have hzcl : z ∉ closure D := by
        intro hzc
        apply hzfront
        rw [hD.frontier_eq]
        exact ⟨hzc, hzd⟩
      exact hzcl
  by_cases hxD : x ∈ D
  · have hIccD : Set.Icc x y ⊆ D :=
      hinterval.subset_left_of_subset_union hD isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl hdisjoint
        hpartition ⟨x, ⟨le_rfl, hxy⟩, hxD⟩
    constructor
    · intro _
      exact hIccD ⟨hxy, le_rfl⟩
    · intro _
      exact hxD
  · have hxcl : x ∈ (closure D)ᶜ := by
      have hxfront := hnoFrontier x ⟨le_rfl, hxy⟩
      by_contra hxc
      apply hxfront
      rw [hD.frontier_eq]
      exact ⟨by simpa using hxc, hxD⟩
    have hIccOutside : Set.Icc x y ⊆ (closure D)ᶜ :=
      hinterval.subset_right_of_subset_union hD isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl hdisjoint
        hpartition ⟨x, ⟨le_rfl, hxy⟩, hxcl⟩
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact (hxD hx).elim
    · intro hy
      have hycl : y ∈ closure D := subset_closure hy
      exact False.elim ((hIccOutside ⟨hxy, le_rfl⟩) hycl)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.integer_chain_cell_avoids_range
statement:
private theorem integer_chain_cell_avoids_range (x : ℤ → ℝ) (hx : StrictMono x)
    (i : ℤ) : Disjoint (Set.Ioo (x i) (x (i + 1))) (Set.range x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro _ hh ⟨j, rfl⟩
  have hij : i < j := hx.lt_iff_lt.mp hh.1
  have hji : j < i + 1 := hx.lt_iff_lt.mp hh.2
  omega

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.mem_iff_of_same_integer_chain_cell
statement:
private theorem mem_iff_of_same_integer_chain_cell (x : ℤ → ℝ) (hx : StrictMono x)
    (D : Set ℝ) (hD : IsOpen D) (hfront : frontier D ⊆ Set.range x)
    (i : ℤ) {r s : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Set.Ioo (x i) (x (i + 1)))
    (hs : s ∈ Set.Ioo (x i) (x (i + 1))) : r ∈ D ↔ s ∈ D
proof:
:= by
  have hno {a b : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Set.Ioo (x i) (x (i + 1)))
      (hb : b ∈ Set.Ioo (x i) (x (i + 1))) : Set.Icc a b ∩ frontier D = ∅ := by
    apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    rintro t ⟨ht, htf⟩
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (integer_chain_cell_avoids_range x hx i)
      ⟨ha.1.trans_le ht.1, ht.2.trans_lt hb.2⟩ (hfront htf)
  by_cases hrs : r ≤ s
  · exact mem_iff_of_no_frontier_on_interval D hD r s hrs (hno hr hs)
  · exact (mem_iff_of_no_frontier_on_interval D hD s r (le_of_not_ge hrs) (hno hs hr)).symm

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.outside_integer_chain_range_mem_cell
statement:
private theorem outside_integer_chain_range_mem_cell (B : Set ℝ)
    (hfinite : ∀ a b : ℝ, (B ∩ Set.Icc a b).Finite)
    (hbelow : ∀ r : ℝ, ∃ b ∈ B, b < r)
    (x : ℤ → ℝ) (hxB : Set.range x = B) (hx : StrictMono x)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∉ B) : ∃ i : ℤ, r ∈ Set.Ioo (x i) (x (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀, hb₀r⟩ := hbelow r
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hgreatest⟩ := Set.exists_max_image (B ∩ Set.Icc b₀ r) id
    (hfinite b₀ r) ⟨b₀, hb₀, le_rfl, hb₀r.le⟩
  have hbRange : b ∈ Set.range x := hxB.symm ▸ hb.1
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hbRange
  have hir : x i < r := lt_of_le_of_ne hb.2.2 (fun he => hr (he ▸ hb.1))
  refine ⟨i, hir, ?_⟩
  by_contra h
  have hnB : x (i + 1) ∈ B := hxB ▸ Set.mem_range_self (i + 1)
  have hnext := hx (show i < i + 1 by omega)
  have hh := hgreatest (x (i + 1)) ⟨hnB, hb.2.1.trans hnext.le, le_of_not_gt h⟩
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hh) hnext

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.finite_bounded_windows_dense_compl
statement:
private theorem finite_bounded_windows_dense_compl (B : Set ℝ)
    (hfinite : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (B ∩ Q).Finite) : Dense Bᶜ
proof:
:= by
  apply interior_eq_empty_iff_dense_compl.mp
  apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp isOpen_interior x hx
  have hfin := hfinite (Metric.closedBall x ε) Metric.isBounded_closedBall
  have hsub : Set.Ioo (x - ε) (x + ε) ⊆ B ∩ Metric.closedBall x ε := by
    intro y hy
    have hyball : y ∈ Metric.ball x ε := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
      apply abs_lt.mpr
      constructor <;> linarith [hy.1, hy.2]
    exact ⟨interior_subset (hball hyball), Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hyball⟩
  exact Set.Ioo_infinite (show x - ε < x + ε by linarith) (hfin.subset hsub)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.regularopen_eq_of_agree_on_dense
statement:
private theorem regularopen_eq_of_agree_on_dense
    (U V C : Set ℝ) (hC : Dense C) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hUreg : interior (closure U) = U) (hVreg : interior (closure V) = V)
    (hagree : ∀ r ∈ C, r ∈ U ↔ r ∈ V) : U = V
proof:
:= by
  have hUV : U ⊆ closure V := (hC.open_subset_closure_inter hU).trans
    (closure_mono (fun r hr => (hagree r hr.2).mp hr.1))
  have hVU : V ⊆ closure U := (hC.open_subset_closure_inter hV).trans
    (closure_mono (fun r hr => (hagree r hr.2).mpr hr.1))
  have hcl : closure U = closure V :=
    Set.Subset.antisymm (closure_minimal hUV isClosed_closure)
      (closure_minimal hVU isClosed_closure)
  rw [← hUreg, ← hVreg, hcl]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.relatively_dense_integer_chain_gap_bound
statement:
private theorem relatively_dense_integer_chain_gap_bound
    (x : ℤ → ℝ) (hx : StrictMono x) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hdense : ∀ r : ℝ, ∃ y ∈ Set.range x, |r - y| < ρ) :
    ∀ i : ℤ, x (i + 1) - x i < 2 * ρ
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨j, rfl⟩, hdist⟩ := hdense (x i + ρ)
  have hlow : x i < x j := by linarith [(abs_lt.mp hdist).2]
  have hij : i < j := hx.lt_iff_lt.mp hlow
  have hnext := hx.monotone (show i + 1 ≤ j by omega)
  have hhigh : x j < x i + 2 * ρ := by linarith [(abs_lt.mp hdist).1]
  linarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.regularopen_period_of_integer_chain_cell_shift
statement:
private theorem regularopen_period_of_integer_chain_cell_shift
    (x : ℤ → ℝ) (hx : StrictMono x)
    (hfinite : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (Set.range x ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hbelow : ∀ r : ℝ, ∃ j : ℤ, x j < r)
    (D : Set ℝ) (hD : IsOpen D) (hDreg : interior (closure D) = D)
    (k : ℤ) (β : ℝ) (hshift : ∀ i : ℤ, x (i + k) = x i + β)
    (hcell : ∀ i : ℤ, ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (x i) (x (i + 1)),
      ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (x (i + k)) (x (i + k + 1)), r ∈ D ↔ s ∈ D) :
    β ∈ periodGroup D
proof:
:= by
  have htranslatedOpen : IsOpen (β +ᵥ D) := (Homeomorph.addLeft β).isOpenMap _ hD
  have htranslatedReg : interior (closure (β +ᵥ D)) = β +ᵥ D := by
    rw [closure_vadd, interior_vadd, hDreg]
  have hagree (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ (Set.range x)ᶜ) : r ∈ β +ᵥ D ↔ r ∈ D := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := outside_integer_chain_range_mem_cell (Set.range x)
      (fun a b => hfinite _ isCompact_Icc.isBounded)
      (fun r => by obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hbelow r; exact ⟨x j, Set.mem_range_self j, hj⟩)
      x rfl hx hr
    have hindices : i - k + k = i := by omega
    have hindices' : i - k + 1 + k = i + 1 := by omega
    have hleft := hshift (i - k)
    have hright := hshift (i - k + 1)
    rw [hindices] at hleft
    rw [hindices'] at hright
    have hpre : r - β ∈ Set.Ioo (x (i - k)) (x (i - k + 1)) := by
      constructor <;> linarith [hi.1, hi.2]
    have hmem := hcell (i - k) (r - β) hpre r
      (by simpa only [hindices, add_assoc] using hi)
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hyr⟩
      have hyeq : y = r - β := by change β + y = r at hyr; linarith
      exact hmem.mp (hyeq ▸ hy)
    · intro hrD
      exact ⟨r - β, hmem.mpr hrD, by simp only [vadd_eq_add]; ring⟩
  have heq := regularopen_eq_of_agree_on_dense (β +ᵥ D) D (Set.range x)ᶜ
    (finite_bounded_windows_dense_compl _ hfinite) htranslatedOpen hD htranslatedReg hDreg hagree
  change β ∈ AddAction.stabilizer ℝ D
  exact AddAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mpr heq

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.frontier_interior_closure_union_openIntervals_subset_closedEndpoints
statement:
