  have hfseg : f t ∈ segment ℝ a b := by
    rw [segment_eq_image]
    refine ⟨t, ⟨htpos.le, htle⟩, ?_⟩
    change (1 - t) • a + t • b = t • (b - a) + a
    module
  have hc := hcross (f t) (hI ⟨lt_trans hlu.1 htpos, htlt⟩) (hseg hfseg)
  rcases hc with hr | hi
  · left
    have : t * (b - a).re = 0 := by simpa [f] using hr
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left htpos.ne'
  · right
    have : t * (b - a).im = 0 := by simpa [f] using hi
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left htpos.ne'

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.rational_direction_axis
statement:
private theorem rational_direction_axis {v : Plane} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (haxis : v.re = 0 ∨ v.im = 0) : IsRationalVectorDirection v
proof:
:= by
  apply (isRationalVectorDirection_iff v).mpr
  rcases haxis with hr | hi
  · refine ⟨![0, 1], by decide, v.im, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hz
      apply hv
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hr, hz]
    · apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint, hr]
  · refine ⟨![1, 0], by decide, v.re, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hz
      apply hv
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hi, hz]
    · apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint, hi]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.hasRationalSlopes_of_isAxisParallel
statement:
theorem hasRationalSlopes_of_isAxisParallel (K : PolygonalRegion)
    (hK : IsAxisParallel K.support) : HasRationalSlopes K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hcover⟩ := K.isPolygonal.exists_finite_intrinsic_boundarySegments
  refine ⟨F, ?_, hcover⟩
  intro e he
  obtain ⟨hne, -, -, hseg⟩ := hF e he
  exact rational_direction_axis (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne.symm)
    (segment_direction_axis hK hseg)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.hasRationalSlopes_of_isRelativelyRational
statement:
theorem hasRationalSlopes_of_isRelativelyRational (K : PolygonalRegion)
    (hK : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.IsRelativelyRational K) :
    HasRationalSlopes K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hrat⟩ := hK
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hcover⟩ := K.isPolygonal.exists_finite_intrinsic_boundarySegments
  refine ⟨F, ?_, hcover⟩
  intro e he
  obtain ⟨hne, ha, hb, -⟩ := hF e he
  obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq⟩ := hrat e.1 ha
  obtain ⟨r, s, hr, hs⟩ := hrat e.2 hb
  apply rationalPoint_isRationalVectorDirection _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne.symm)
  refine ⟨r - p, s - q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [Rat.cast_sub, Complex.sub_re] at *
    linarith
  · simp only [Rat.cast_sub, Complex.sub_im] at *
    linarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.hasRationalSlopes_iff_localDirections
statement:
theorem hasRationalSlopes_iff_localDirections (K : PolygonalRegion) :
    HasRationalSlopes K ↔
      ∀ x ∈ frontier K.support, x ∉ vertexSet K.support →
        ∃ δ : Submodule ℝ Plane, Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1 ∧ HasRationalDirection δ ∧
          ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (y ∈ frontier K.support ↔ y - x ∈ δ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨F, hrat, hcover⟩ x hx hxv
    obtain ⟨L, hxL, hdim, hlocal⟩ :=
      K.isPolygonal.boundaryLocallyStraightAt_of_not_mem_vertexSet hx hxv
    have hlocal' : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x,
        y ∈ frontier K.support ↔ y - x ∈ L.direction := by
      filter_upwards [hlocal] with y hy
      exact hy.trans (L.vsub_right_mem_direction_iff_mem hxL y).symm
    have hxcover := hx
    rw [hcover] at hxcover
    obtain ⟨e, hxe⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hxcover
    obtain ⟨heF, hxe⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hxe
    have hseg : segment ℝ e.1 e.2 ⊆ frontier K.support := by
      rw [hcover]
      exact subset_iUnion_of_subset e (subset_iUnion_of_subset heF subset_rfl)
    have hdir := segment_direction_mem_of_local hseg hxe (hlocal'.mono fun y hy => hy.mp)
    obtain ⟨hne, z, hz, hzspan⟩ := hrat e heF
    have hle : Submodule.span ℝ ({e.2 - e.1} : Set Plane) ≤ L.direction :=
      (Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).mpr hdir
    exact ⟨L.direction, hdim, ⟨z, hz, hle hzspan⟩, hlocal'⟩
  · intro hlocal
    obtain ⟨F, hF, hcover⟩ := K.isPolygonal.exists_finite_intrinsic_boundarySegments
    refine ⟨F, ?_, hcover⟩
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨hne, -, -, hseg⟩ := hF e he
    have hinf : (segment ℝ e.1 e.2).Infinite := by
      rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap]
      exact (Icc_infinite (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)).image
        (AffineMap.lineMap_injective ℝ hne).injOn
    obtain ⟨x, hxseg, hxv⟩ := hinf.exists_notMem_finite K.isPolygonal.vertexSet_finite
    obtain ⟨δ, hdim, hrat, hloc⟩ := hlocal x (hseg hxseg) hxv
    have hdir := segment_direction_mem_of_local hseg hxseg (hloc.mono fun y hy => hy.mp)
    have hdne : e.2 - e.1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hne.symm
    have heq := eq_span_singleton_of_mem_of_finrank_eq_one hdim hdir hdne
    exact ⟨hdne, heq ▸ hrat⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.IsRationalLinear.symm
statement:
theorem IsRationalLinear.symm {A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane}
    (hA : IsRationalLinear A) : IsRationalLinear A.symm
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  
  have h1 := hA 1 ⟨1, 0, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
  have hI := hA Complex.I ⟨0, 1, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
  rcases h1 with ⟨a₁, a₂, ha₁, ha₂⟩
  rcases hI with ⟨b₁, b₂, hb₁, hb₂⟩
  rcases hv with ⟨x, y, hx, hy⟩
  let a : Plane := A 1
  let b : Plane := A Complex.I
  let d : ℚ := a₁ * b₂ - b₁ * a₂
  have ha : a.re = (a₁ : ℝ) ∧ a.im = (a₂ : ℝ) := ⟨ha₁, ha₂⟩
  have hb : b.re = (b₁ : ℝ) ∧ b.im = (b₂ : ℝ) := ⟨hb₁, hb₂⟩
  have hdet : d ≠ 0 := by
    intro hd
    by_cases hzero : a₂ = 0 ∧ b₂ = 0
    · have ha0 : a₁ ≠ 0 := by
        intro ha10
        have hAone : A (1 : Plane) = 0 := by
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [a, ha.1, ha.2, ha10, hzero.1]
        exact one_ne_zero (A.injective (hAone.trans (map_zero A).symm))
      have hrel : b = ((b₁ / a₁ : ℚ) : ℝ) • a := by
        apply Complex.ext
        · simp only [Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
          rw [hb.1, ha.1]
          exact_mod_cast (div_mul_cancel₀ b₁ ha0).symm
        · simp only [Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
          rw [hb.2, ha.2]
          simp [hzero.1, hzero.2]
      have hrelA : A Complex.I = ((b₁ / a₁ : ℚ) : ℝ) • A 1 := by
        simpa [a, b] using hrel
      have hpre : (Complex.I : Plane) = ((b₁ / a₁ : ℚ) : ℝ) • (1 : Plane) :=
        A.injective (by simpa only [map_smul] using hrelA)
      have him := congrArg Complex.im hpre
      norm_num at him
    · have hlin : (b₂ : ℝ) • a - (a₂ : ℝ) • b = 0 := by
        apply Complex.ext
        · simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul, ha.1, hb.1,
            Complex.zero_re]
          have hdR : (a₁ : ℝ) * b₂ - b₁ * a₂ = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd
          nlinarith [hdR]
        · simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul, ha.2, hb.2,
            Complex.zero_im]
          ring
      have hmap : A ((b₂ : ℝ) • (1 : Plane) - (a₂ : ℝ) • Complex.I) =
          (b₂ : ℝ) • a - (a₂ : ℝ) • b := by
        rw [map_sub, map_smul, map_smul]
      have hpre : (b₂ : ℝ) • (1 : Plane) - (a₂ : ℝ) • Complex.I = 0 := by
        apply A.injective
        rw [hmap, hlin]
        simp
      have hre := congrArg Complex.re hpre
      have him := congrArg Complex.im hpre
      simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul, Complex.one_re,
        Complex.I_re, mul_one, mul_zero, sub_zero, Complex.zero_re] at hre
      simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul, Complex.one_im,
        Complex.I_im, mul_zero, mul_one, zero_sub, Complex.zero_im, neg_eq_zero] at him
      have hb20 : b₂ = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hre
      have ha20 : a₂ = 0 := by exact_mod_cast him
      exact hzero ⟨ha20, hb20⟩
  let w := A.symm v
  have hw : A w = v := A.apply_symm_apply v
  have hcoords : w.re = ((x * b₂ - b₁ * y) / d : ℚ) ∧
      w.im = ((a₁ * y - x * a₂) / d : ℚ) := by
    have hrepr : A w = w.re • a + w.im • b := by
      have hdecomp : w = w.re • (1 : Plane) + w.im • Complex.I := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp
      rw [hdecomp, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
      simp [a, b]
    have hr := congrArg Complex.re hw
    have hi := congrArg Complex.im hw
    rw [hrepr, Complex.add_re, Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_re, ha.1, hb.1] at hr
    rw [hrepr, Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_im, Complex.smul_im, ha.2, hb.2] at hi
    rw [hx] at hr
    rw [hy] at hi
    constructor
    · have heq : (d : ℝ) * w.re = ((x * b₂ - b₁ * y : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [d]
        push_cast
        linear_combination (b₂ : ℝ) * hr - (b₁ : ℝ) * hi
      have hdR : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hdet
      push_cast
      apply (eq_div_iff hdR).2
      simpa [mul_comm] using heq
    · have heq : (d : ℝ) * w.im = ((a₁ * y - x * a₂ : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [d]
        push_cast
        linear_combination (a₁ : ℝ) * hi - (a₂ : ℝ) * hr
      have hdR : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hdet
      push_cast
      apply (eq_div_iff hdR).2
      simpa [mul_comm] using heq
  exact ⟨(x * b₂ - b₁ * y) / d, (a₁ * y - x * a₂) / d,
    hcoords.1, hcoords.2⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.rational_direction_linear
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, r, hr, hv⟩ := (isRationalVectorDirection_iff v).mp hv
  have hzr : IsRationalPoint (integerPoint z) := by
    refine ⟨(z 0 : ℚ), (z 1 : ℚ), ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      simp [Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint]
  have hAz : A (integerPoint z) ≠ 0 := by
    exact fun h => integerPoint_ne_zero hz (A.injective (by simpa using h))
  obtain ⟨w, hw, s, hs, hAs⟩ := (isRationalVectorDirection_iff _).mp
    (rationalPoint_isRationalVectorDirection (hA _ hzr) hAz)
  refine (isRationalVectorDirection_iff _).mpr ⟨w, hw, r * s, mul_ne_zero hr hs, ?_⟩
  rw [hv, map_smul, hAs, smul_smul]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.rational_boundary_affineImage
statement:
private theorem rational_boundary_affineImage (D : Set Plane)
    (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (hA : IsRationalLinear A) (a : Plane)
    (hD : ∃ F : Finset (Plane × Plane),
      (∀ e ∈ F, IsRationalVectorDirection (e.2 - e.1)) ∧
        frontier D = ⋃ e ∈ F, segment ℝ e.1 e.2) :
    ∃ F : Finset (Plane × Plane),
      (∀ e ∈ F, IsRationalVectorDirection (e.2 - e.1)) ∧
        frontier (Tiling.Polygonal.affineMap A a '' D) =
          ⋃ e ∈ F, segment ℝ e.1 e.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨F, hrat, hcover⟩ := hD
  let f := Tiling.Polygonal.affineMap A a
  let h : Plane ≃ₜ Plane := A.toHomeomorph.trans (Homeomorph.addLeft a)
  have hh : (h : Plane → Plane) = f := rfl
  let φ : Plane →ᵃ[ℝ] Plane :=
    { toFun := f
      linear := A.toLinearMap
      map_vadd' := by intro p v; simp [f, Tiling.Polygonal.affineMap, add_comm, add_left_comm] }
  have hseg (p q : Plane) : f '' segment ℝ p q = segment ℝ (f p) (f q) :=
    image_segment ℝ φ p q
  refine ⟨F.image (fun e => (f e.1, f e.2)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro e he
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
    have heq : f b.2 - f b.1 = A (b.2 - b.1) := by
      simp [f, Tiling.Polygonal.affineMap, map_sub]
    rw [heq]
    exact rational_direction_linear hA (hrat b hb)
  · have hfront : frontier (Tiling.Polygonal.affineMap A a '' D) = f '' frontier D :=
      (h.image_frontier D).symm
    rw [hfront, hcover]
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
      obtain ⟨heF, hxe⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp he
      exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(f e.1, f e.2), mem_iUnion.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨e, heF, rfl⟩, hseg e.1 e.2 ▸ mem_image_of_mem f hxe⟩⟩
    · intro hy
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hy
      obtain ⟨heF, hye⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp he
      obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp heF
      rw [← hseg] at hye
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hye
      exact mem_image_of_mem f (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨b, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hb, hx⟩⟩)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.hasRationalSlopes_affineImage_iff
statement:
theorem hasRationalSlopes_affineImage_iff (K : PolygonalRegion)
    (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (hA : IsRationalLinear A) (a : Plane) :
    HasRationalSlopes (Tiling.Polygonal.affineImage K A a) ↔
      HasRationalSlopes K
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hback := rational_boundary_affineImage
      (Tiling.Polygonal.affineImage K A a).support A.symm hA.symm (-A.symm a) h
    have hcancel : Tiling.Polygonal.affineMap A.symm (-A.symm a) ''
        (Tiling.Polygonal.affineImage K A a).support = K.support := by
      change Tiling.Polygonal.affineMap A.symm (-A.symm a) ''
        (Tiling.Polygonal.affineMap A a '' K.support) = K.support
      rw [← image_comp]
      have hf : Tiling.Polygonal.affineMap A.symm (-A.symm a) ∘
          Tiling.Polygonal.affineMap A a = id := by
        funext x
        simp [Tiling.Polygonal.affineMap]
      rw [hf, image_id]
    rw [hcancel] at hback
    exact hback
  · intro h
    exact rational_boundary_affineImage K.support A hA a h

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.exists_rationalLinear_straighten
statement:
theorem exists_rationalLinear_straighten (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane)
    (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (hrat : HasRationalDirection δ) :
    ∃ A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane, IsRationalLinear A ∧
      δ.map A.toLinearMap = Submodule.span ℝ ({Complex.I} : Set Plane)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hrat with ⟨z, hz, hzm⟩
  let p : ℤ := z 0
  let q : ℤ := z 1
  have hcoord : p ≠ 0 ∨ q ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    apply hz
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [p, q, h]
  let c : ℂ := (q : ℝ) + (p : ℝ) * Complex.I
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro hc0
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re hc0
    have him := congrArg Complex.im hc0
    simp only [c, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_I_re, Complex.mul_I_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, neg_zero, add_zero, zero_add,
      Complex.zero_re, Complex.zero_im] at hre him
    rcases hcoord with hp | hq
    · exact hp (by exact_mod_cast him)
    · exact hq (by exact_mod_cast hre)
  let u : ℂˣ := Units.mk0 c hc
  let A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane :=
    (u.mulLeftLinearEquiv ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearEquivOfContinuous
      (by change Continuous (fun x : ℂ => c * x); fun_prop)
  have hA : IsRationalLinear A := by
    intro v hv
    rcases hv with ⟨x, y, hx, hy⟩
    refine ⟨(q : ℚ) * x - (p : ℚ) * y,
      (p : ℚ) * x + (q : ℚ) * y, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change (c * v).re = _
      simp [c, Complex.mul_re, hx, hy]
    · change (c * v).im = _
      simp [c, Complex.mul_im, hx, hy]
      ring
  have hspan := eq_span_singleton_of_mem_of_finrank_eq_one hδ hzm (integerPoint_ne_zero hz)
  refine ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
  rw [hspan, Submodule.map_span]
  have hAz : A (integerPoint z) = ((z 0 : ℝ) ^ 2 + (z 1 : ℝ) ^ 2) • Complex.I := by
    change c * integerPoint z = _
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp only [Complex.smul_re, Complex.I_re, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero]
      simp [c, integerPoint, p, q, Complex.mul_re]
      ring
    · simp only [Complex.smul_im, Complex.I_im, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      simp [c, integerPoint, p, q, Complex.mul_im]
      ring
  rw [Set.image_singleton]
  change ℝ ∙ A (integerPoint z) = ℝ ∙ Complex.I
  rw [hAz]
  have hscale : ((z 0 : ℝ) ^ 2 + (z 1 : ℝ) ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
    rcases hcoord with hp | hq
    · have hpR : (z 0 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp
      exact ne_of_gt (by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hpR, sq_nonneg (z 1 : ℝ)])
    · have hqR : (z 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq
      exact ne_of_gt (by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hqR, sq_nonneg (z 0 : ℝ)])
  have hu : IsUnit ((z 0 : ℝ) ^ 2 + (z 1 : ℝ) ^ 2) := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hscale
  exact Submodule.span_singleton_smul_eq hu Complex.I

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.period_iUnion
statement:
private theorem period_iUnion {ι : Type} (S : ι → Set Plane) (u : Plane)
    (h : ∀ i, u ∈ periodGroup (S i)) : u ∈ periodGroup (⋃ i, S i)
proof:
:= by
  change u +ᵥ (⋃ i, S i) = ⋃ i, S i
  rw [Set.vadd_set_iUnion]
  exact Set.iUnion_congr h

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.setPeriodicBy_of_period
statement:
private theorem setPeriodicBy_of_period {S : Set Plane} {u : Plane}
    (h : u ∈ periodGroup S) : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy S u
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : (-u) +ᵥ S = S := (periodGroup S).neg_mem h
  intro x
  have hx := congrArg (fun A : Set Plane => x ∈ A) hneg
  simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hx

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.regularization_period
statement:
private theorem regularization_period {S : Set Plane} {u : Plane}
    (h : u ∈ periodGroup S) : u ∈ periodGroup (interior (closure S))
proof:
:= by
  change u +ᵥ interior (closure S) = interior (closure S)
  rw [← interior_vadd, ← closure_vadd]
  exact congrArg (fun A : Set Plane => interior (closure A)) h

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.support_period
statement:
private theorem support_period (K : PolygonalRegion) {S : Set Plane} {u : Plane}
    (h : u ∈ periodGroup S) : u ∈ periodGroup (regularSupport K S)
proof:
:= by
  change u +ᵥ regularSupport K S = regularSupport K S
  rw [← regularSupport_vadd, h]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.regularSupport_iUnion2
statement:
private theorem regularSupport_iUnion2 (K : PolygonalRegion) {ι κ : Type}
    (S : ι → κ → Set Plane) :
    regularSupport K (⋃ a, ⋃ m, S a m) =
      interior (closure (⋃ a, ⋃ m, regularSupport K (S a m)))
proof:
:= by
  have hUnion (f : ι → κ → Set Plane) :
      (⋃ p : ι × κ, f p.1 p.2) = ⋃ a, ⋃ m, f a m := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨a, m⟩, hx⟩
      exact ⟨a, m, hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨a, m, hx⟩
      exact ⟨⟨a, m⟩, hx⟩
  rw [← hUnion S, regularSupport_iUnion]
  exact congrArg (fun A : Set Plane => interior (closure A))
    (hUnion (fun a m => regularSupport K (S a m)))

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.orbit_period
statement:
private theorem orbit_period (A : Set Plane) (γ : Plane) :
    γ ∈ periodGroup (⋃ m : ℤ, m • γ +ᵥ A)
proof:
:= by
  change γ +ᵥ (⋃ m : ℤ, m • γ +ᵥ A) = ⋃ m : ℤ, m • γ +ᵥ A
  rw [Set.vadd_set_iUnion]
  exact Set.iUnion_congr_of_surjective (fun m : ℤ => m + 1)
    (by intro n; exact ⟨n - 1, by dsimp; omega⟩)
    (fun m => by rw [add_zsmul, one_zsmul, add_comm (m • γ) γ, add_vadd])

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.iUnion_sigma_prod
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨i, a, m⟩, hx⟩
    exact ⟨i, a, m, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, a, m, hx⟩
    exact ⟨⟨i, a, m⟩, hx⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.atom_subset
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have h : x ∈ ⋃ i, ⋃ a : G.Index i, ⋃ m : ℤ, G.atom i a m :=
    Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨a, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨m, hx⟩⟩⟩
  exact G.union_eq ▸ h

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.period_vadd
statement:
private theorem period_vadd {S : Set Plane} {u : Plane} (h : u ∈ periodGroup S)
    (v : Plane) : u ∈ periodGroup (v +ᵥ S)
proof:
:= by
  change u +ᵥ (v +ᵥ S) = v +ᵥ S
  calc
    u +ᵥ (v +ᵥ S) = v +ᵥ (u +ᵥ S) := by rw [← add_vadd, add_comm, add_vadd]
    _ = v +ᵥ S := congrArg (fun A : Set Plane => v +ᵥ A) h

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.tile_subset_support
statement:
private theorem tile_subset_support (K : PolygonalRegion) {S : Set Plane}
    {s : Plane} (hs : s ∈ S) : s +ᵥ K.openCarrier ⊆ regularSupport K S
proof:
:= by
  have hOpen : IsOpen (openUnion K S) := isOpen_iUnion fun t => isOpen_interior.vadd (t : Plane)
  exact (Set.subset_iUnion (fun t : S => (t : Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ⟨s, hs⟩).trans
    hOpen.subset_interior_closure

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.commonMultiple_pos
statement:
theorem commonMultiple_pos {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane}
    (G : GoodParametrization K T) : 0 < G.commonMultiple
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => Int.natAbs_pos.mpr (G.lambdaCoefficient_ne_zero i)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.commonMultiple_divisible
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Int.dvd_natCast.mpr
  exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.weaklyPeriodic
statement:
theorem weaklyPeriodic {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane}
    (G : GoodParametrization K T) : WeaklyPeriodic T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨{
    numberOfParts := G.numberOfParts
    part := G.part
    period := fun i => G.lambdaCoefficient i • G.lattice.basis 0 +
      G.gammaCoefficient i • G.lattice.basis 1
    period_ne_zero := ?_
    periodic_part := ?_
    pairwiseDisjoint := ?_
    iUnion_parts := G.union_eq }⟩
  · intro i hzero
    have hcoeff := (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp G.lattice.independent)
      ![(G.lambdaCoefficient i : ℝ), (G.gammaCoefficient i : ℝ)]
      (by simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul] using hzero) 0
    exact G.lambdaCoefficient_ne_zero i (Int.cast_eq_zero.mp hcoeff)
  · intro i
    apply setPeriodicBy_of_period
    exact period_iUnion _ _ fun a => period_iUnion _ _ fun m => G.atom_periodic i a m
  · intro i _ j _ hij
    apply Set.disjoint_iUnion_left.mpr
    intro a
    apply Set.disjoint_iUnion_left.mpr
    intro m
    apply Set.disjoint_iUnion_right.mpr
    intro b
    apply Set.disjoint_iUnion_right.mpr
    intro n
    exact G.atoms_disjoint (x := ⟨i, a, m⟩) (y := ⟨j, b, n⟩) (by trivial) (by trivial)
      (fun heq => hij (congrArg Sigma.fst heq))

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.carriers_periodic
statement:
theorem carriers_periodic {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane}
    (G : GoodParametrization K T)
    (hp : IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements T)) :
    G.lattice.basis 1 ∈ periodGroup (regularSupport K T) ∧
      (G.commonMultiple : ℤ) • G.lattice.basis 0 ∈
        periodGroup (regularSupport K T)
proof:
:= by
  have hγ : ∀ i, G.lattice.basis 1 ∈ periodGroup (regularSupport K (G.part i)) := by
    intro i
    rw [part, regularSupport_iUnion2]
    apply regularization_period
    rw [Set.iUnion_congr fun a => Set.iUnion_congr (G.carrier_transport i a)]
    exact period_iUnion _ _ fun a => orbit_period _ _
  have hk : ∀ i, G.lambdaCoefficient i • G.lattice.basis 0 ∈
      periodGroup (regularSupport K (G.part i)) := by
    intro i
    have hw : G.lambdaCoefficient i • G.lattice.basis 0 +
        G.gammaCoefficient i • G.lattice.basis 1 ∈
        periodGroup (regularSupport K (G.part i)) :=
      support_period K (period_iUnion _ _ fun a =>
        period_iUnion _ _ fun m => G.atom_periodic i a m)
    have hsub := (periodGroup (regularSupport K (G.part i))).sub_mem hw
      ((periodGroup (regularSupport K (G.part i))).zsmul_mem (hγ i) (G.gammaCoefficient i))
    exact (show (G.lambdaCoefficient i • G.lattice.basis 0 +
        G.gammaCoefficient i • G.lattice.basis 1) -
        G.gammaCoefficient i • G.lattice.basis 1 =
        G.lambdaCoefficient i • G.lattice.basis 0 from add_sub_cancel_right _ _) ▸ hsub
  have hN : ∀ i, (G.commonMultiple : ℤ) • G.lattice.basis 0 ∈
      periodGroup (regularSupport K (G.part i)) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := G.commonMultiple_divisible i
    rw [hn, mul_comm, mul_smul]
    exact (periodGroup (regularSupport K (G.part i))).zsmul_mem (hk i) n
  have hu : (⋃ i, G.part i) = T := G.union_eq
  have heq : regularSupport K T =
      interior (closure (⋃ i, regularSupport K (G.part i))) := by
    calc
      regularSupport K T = regularSupport K (⋃ i, G.part i) := congrArg _ hu.symm
      _ = _ := regularSupport_iUnion K _
  rw [heq]
  exact ⟨regularization_period (period_iUnion _ _ hγ),
    regularization_period (period_iUnion _ _ hN)⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.periodic_replacement
statement:
theorem periodic_replacement {K : PolygonalRegion} {T E : Set Plane}
    (G : GoodParametrization K T) (hTiles : TilesOn K T E)
    (hEopen : IsOpen E) (hEregular : interior (closure E) = E) :
    TilesOn K G.replacementCentres E ∧
      IsLatticePeriodic G.replacementCentres ∧
        periodGroup G.replacementCentres ≤ periodGroup E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A := fun s : Σ i : Fin G.numberOfParts, G.Index i × ℤ =>
    G.atom s.1 s.2.1 s.2.2
  let R := fun s : Σ i : Fin G.numberOfParts, G.Index i × ℤ =>
    s.2.2 • G.lattice.basis 1 +ᵥ G.atom s.1 s.2.1 0
  have haU : (⋃ s, A s) = T := (iUnion_sigma_prod G.atom).trans G.union_eq
  have hrU : (⋃ s, R s) = G.replacementCentres :=
    iUnion_sigma_prod (fun i a m => m • G.lattice.basis 1 +ᵥ G.atom i a 0)
  have hrSupport : ∀ s, regularSupport K (R s) = regularSupport K (A s) := by
    intro s
    exact (regularSupport_vadd K _ _).trans (G.carrier_transport _ _ _).symm
  have hRS : regularSupport K G.replacementCentres = regularSupport K T := by
    calc
      regularSupport K G.replacementCentres = regularSupport K (⋃ s, R s) := congrArg _ hrU.symm
      _ = interior (closure (⋃ s, regularSupport K (R s))) := regularSupport_iUnion K R
      _ = interior (closure (⋃ s, regularSupport K (A s))) :=
        congrArg (fun B : Set Plane => interior (closure B)) (Set.iUnion_congr hrSupport)
      _ = regularSupport K (⋃ s, A s) := (regularSupport_iUnion K A).symm
      _ = regularSupport K T := congrArg _ haU
  have hAtomPack : ∀ i a m, IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements (G.atom i a m)) := by
    intro i a m
    apply (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K _).mpr
    exact ((isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K T).mp hTiles.2.1).mono (atom_subset G i a m)
  have hRPack : ∀ s, IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements (R s)) := by
    intro s
    exact (tilesOn_translate (tilesOn_regularSupport_of_packing (hAtomPack _ _ 0))
      (s.2.2 • G.lattice.basis 1)).2.1
  have hpR : IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements G.replacementCentres) := by
    apply (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K _).mpr
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hrU.symm ▸ hx)
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hrU.symm ▸ hy)
    by_cases hst : s = t
    · subst t
      exact ((isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K _).mp (hRPack s)) hs ht hxy
    · have hdisj := regularSupport_disjoint_of_disjoint_subfamilies hTiles.2.1
        (atom_subset G s.1 s.2.1 s.2.2) (atom_subset G t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2)
        (G.atoms_disjoint (by trivial) (by trivial) hst)
      rw [← hrSupport s, ← hrSupport t] at hdisj
      exact hdisj.mono (tile_subset_support K hs) (tile_subset_support K ht)
  have hTilesR : TilesOn K G.replacementCentres E := by
    have heq := hRS.trans (regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn hEopen hEregular hTiles)
    exact heq ▸ tilesOn_regularSupport_of_packing hpR
  have hγ : G.lattice.basis 1 ∈ periodGroup G.replacementCentres :=
    period_iUnion _ _ fun i => period_iUnion _ _ fun a => orbit_period _ _
  have hN : (G.commonMultiple : ℤ) • G.lattice.basis 0 ∈
      periodGroup G.replacementCentres := by
    apply period_iUnion
    intro i
    have hγi : G.lattice.basis 1 ∈
        periodGroup (⋃ a : G.Index i, ⋃ m : ℤ, m • G.lattice.basis 1 +ᵥ G.atom i a 0) :=
      period_iUnion _ _ fun a => orbit_period _ _
    have hwi : G.lambdaCoefficient i • G.lattice.basis 0 +
        G.gammaCoefficient i • G.lattice.basis 1 ∈
        periodGroup (⋃ a : G.Index i, ⋃ m : ℤ, m • G.lattice.basis 1 +ᵥ G.atom i a 0) :=
      period_iUnion _ _ fun a => period_iUnion _ _ fun m =>
        period_vadd (G.atom_periodic i a 0) _
    have hki := (periodGroup (⋃ a : G.Index i,
      ⋃ m : ℤ, m • G.lattice.basis 1 +ᵥ G.atom i a 0)).sub_mem hwi
      ((periodGroup _).zsmul_mem hγi (G.gammaCoefficient i))
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right] at hki
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := G.commonMultiple_divisible i
    rw [hn, mul_comm, mul_smul]
    exact (periodGroup _).zsmul_mem hki n
  have hIndependent : LinearIndependent ℝ
      ![(G.commonMultiple : ℤ) • G.lattice.basis 0, G.lattice.basis 1] := by
    have hbase : LinearIndependent ℝ ![G.lattice.basis 0, G.lattice.basis 1] := by
      convert G.lattice.independent using 1
      ext j; fin_cases j <;> rfl
    have hn : (G.commonMultiple : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast G.commonMultiple_pos.ne'
    have hh := (LinearIndependent.pair_smul_smul_iff (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn)
      (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0))).mpr hbase
    rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℝ, Int.cast_natCast]
    simpa only [one_smul] using hh
  have hLattice : IsLatticePeriodic G.replacementCentres := by
    refine ⟨⟨_, hIndependent⟩, ?_⟩
    change AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range
      ![(G.commonMultiple : ℤ) • G.lattice.basis 0, G.lattice.basis 1]) ≤ _
    apply (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).mpr
    rintro u ⟨j, rfl⟩
    fin_cases j
    · exact hN
    · exact hγ
  refine ⟨hTilesR, hLattice, ?_⟩
  have heq := regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn hEopen hEregular hTilesR
  intro u hu
  change u +ᵥ E = E
  rw [← heq, ← regularSupport_vadd]
  exact congrArg (regularSupport K) hu

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.rescalePhase_injective
statement:
private theorem rescalePhase_injective (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    Function.Injective (fun p : ℤ × Fin r => (r : ℤ) * p.1 + (p.2.val : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  have hrz : (r : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hr)
  have hdiv := congrArg (fun z : ℤ => z / (r : ℤ)) hpq
  have hpdiv : ((r : ℤ) * p.1 + (p.2.val : ℤ)) / (r : ℤ) = p.1 := by
    have hsmall : (p.2.val : ℤ) / (r : ℤ) = 0 :=
      Int.ediv_eq_zero_of_lt_abs (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le p.2.val)
        (by exact_mod_cast p.2.isLt)
    calc
      ((r : ℤ) * p.1 + (p.2.val : ℤ)) / (r : ℤ) =
          ((p.2.val : ℤ) + (r : ℤ) * p.1) / (r : ℤ) := by congr 1; ring
      _ = (p.2.val : ℤ) / (r : ℤ) + p.1 := Int.add_mul_ediv_left _ _ hrz
      _ = p.1 := by rw [hsmall]; simp
  have hqdiv : ((r : ℤ) * q.1 + (q.2.val : ℤ)) / (r : ℤ) = q.1 := by
    have hsmall : (q.2.val : ℤ) / (r : ℤ) = 0 :=
      Int.ediv_eq_zero_of_lt_abs (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le q.2.val)
        (by exact_mod_cast q.2.isLt)
    calc
      ((r : ℤ) * q.1 + (q.2.val : ℤ)) / (r : ℤ) =
          ((q.2.val : ℤ) + (r : ℤ) * q.1) / (r : ℤ) := by congr 1; ring
      _ = (q.2.val : ℤ) / (r : ℤ) + q.1 := Int.add_mul_ediv_left _ _ hrz
      _ = q.1 := by rw [hsmall]; simp
  have hquot : p.1 = q.1 := by rw [← hpdiv, ← hqdiv, hdiv]
  have hmod := congrArg (fun z : ℤ => z % (r : ℤ)) hpq
  change ((r : ℤ) * p.1 + (p.2.val : ℤ)) % (r : ℤ) =
    ((r : ℤ) * q.1 + (q.2.val : ℤ)) % (r : ℤ) at hmod
  have hpmod : ((r : ℤ) * p.1 + (p.2.val : ℤ)) % (r : ℤ) = p.2.val := by
    calc
      ((r : ℤ) * p.1 + (p.2.val : ℤ)) % (r : ℤ) =
          ((p.2.val : ℤ) + (r : ℤ) * p.1) % (r : ℤ) := by congr 1; ring
      _ = p.2.val % (r : ℤ) := Int.add_mul_emod_self_left _ _ _
      _ = p.2.val := Int.emod_eq_of_lt (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le p.2.val)
          (by exact_mod_cast p.2.isLt)
  have hqmod : ((r : ℤ) * q.1 + (q.2.val : ℤ)) % (r : ℤ) = q.2.val := by
    calc
      ((r : ℤ) * q.1 + (q.2.val : ℤ)) % (r : ℤ) =
          ((q.2.val : ℤ) + (r : ℤ) * q.1) % (r : ℤ) := by congr 1; ring
      _ = q.2.val % (r : ℤ) := Int.add_mul_emod_self_left _ _ _
      _ = q.2.val := Int.emod_eq_of_lt (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le q.2.val)
          (by exact_mod_cast q.2.isLt)
  have hresZ : (p.2.val : ℤ) = (q.2.val : ℤ) := by
    calc
      (p.2.val : ℤ) =
          ((r : ℤ) * p.1 + (p.2.val : ℤ)) % (r : ℤ) := hpmod.symm
      _ = ((r : ℤ) * q.1 + (q.2.val : ℤ)) % (r : ℤ) := hmod
      _ = (q.2.val : ℤ) := hqmod
  have hres : p.2.val = q.2.val := by exact_mod_cast hresZ
  apply Prod.ext hquot
  exact Fin.ext hres

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.rescalePhase_surjective
statement:
private theorem rescalePhase_surjective (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (n : ℤ) :
    ∃ p : ℤ × Fin r, (r : ℤ) * p.1 + (p.2.val : ℤ) = n
proof:
:= by
  have hrz : (r : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hr)
  have hrpos : (0 : ℤ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  let q : ℤ := n / (r : ℤ)
  let rem : ℤ := n % (r : ℤ)
  have hrem0 : 0 ≤ rem := by dsimp [rem]; exact Int.emod_nonneg _ hrz
  have hremLt : rem < (r : ℤ) := by dsimp [rem]; exact Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ hrpos
  let s : Fin r := ⟨rem.toNat, by
    exact (Int.toNat_lt_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hr)).2 (by exact_mod_cast hremLt)⟩
  refine ⟨(q, s), ?_⟩
  dsimp [q, s, rem]
  rw [Int.natCast_toNat_eq_self.mpr (Int.emod_nonneg _ hrz)]
  calc
    (r : ℤ) * (n / (r : ℤ)) + n % (r : ℤ) =
        n % (r : ℤ) + (r : ℤ) * (n / (r : ℤ)) := by ring
    _ = n := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv n (r : ℤ)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization.rescale_basis
statement:
theorem rescale_basis {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane}
    (G : GoodParametrization K T) (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ G' : GoodParametrization K T, ∀ j : Fin 2,
      G'.lattice.basis j = (r : ℤ) • G.lattice.basis j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b' : Fin 2 → Plane := fun j => (r : ℤ) • G.lattice.basis j
  have hrreal : (r : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hr)
  have hb' : LinearIndependent ℝ b' := by
    have h := G.lattice.independent.units_smul (fun _ : Fin 2 => Units.mk0 (r : ℝ) hrreal)
    have hreal : LinearIndependent ℝ (fun j => (r : ℝ) • G.lattice.basis j) := by
      convert h using 1
      ext j
      simp
    convert hreal using 1
    funext j
    change (r : ℤ) • G.lattice.basis j = (r : ℝ) • G.lattice.basis j
    exact (Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℝ _ _).symm
  let L' : PlanarLattice := ⟨b', hb'⟩
  let phase : ∀ i, G.Index i × Fin r → ℤ → ℤ :=
    fun _ p m => (r : ℤ) * m + (p.2.val : ℤ)
  let f : (Σ i : Fin G.numberOfParts, (G.Index i × Fin r) × ℤ) →
      (Σ i : Fin G.numberOfParts, G.Index i × ℤ) :=
    fun s => ⟨s.1, (s.2.1.1, phase s.1 s.2.1 s.2.2)⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro s t hst
    cases s with
    | mk i sp =>
      cases t with
      | mk j tp =>
        have hi : i = j := congrArg Sigma.fst hst
        subst j
        rcases sp with ⟨⟨a, s0⟩, m⟩
        rcases tp with ⟨⟨b, t0⟩, n⟩
        have hOld : (a, phase i (a, s0) m) = (b, phase i (b, t0) n) := by
          have hh : HEq (a, phase i (a, s0) m) (b, phase i (b, t0) n) :=
            (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp hst).2
          exact eq_of_heq hh
        have hab : a = b := congrArg Prod.fst hOld
        have hphase : phase i (a, s0) m = phase i (b, t0) n := congrArg Prod.snd hOld
        subst b
        have hpq : (m, s0) = (n, t0) :=
          @rescalePhase_injective r hr (m, s0) (n, t0) hphase
        have hm := congrArg Prod.fst hpq
        have hs := congrArg Prod.snd hpq
        change m = n at hm
        change s0 = t0 at hs
        subst n
        subst t0
        rfl
  let atom' : ∀ i, G.Index i × Fin r → ℤ → Set Plane :=
    fun i p m => G.atom i p.1 (phase i p m)
  let G' : GoodParametrization K T := {
    lattice := L'
    numberOfParts := G.numberOfParts
    Index := fun i => G.Index i × Fin r
    atom := atom'
    atom_nonempty := by
      intro i p m
      exact G.atom_nonempty i p.1 (phase i p m)
    atoms_disjoint := by
      intro s hs t ht hst
      have hfst : f s ≠ f t := by
        intro hEq
        apply hst
        exact hf hEq
      simpa [f, atom', phase] using
        (G.atoms_disjoint (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _) hfst)
    union_eq := by
      apply Eq.trans ?_ G.union_eq
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨i, hx⟩
        rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨p, hx⟩
        rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨m, hx⟩
        simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
        exact ⟨i, ⟨p.1, ⟨phase i p m, by simpa [atom'] using hx⟩⟩⟩
      · intro hx
        rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨i, hx⟩
        rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨a, hx⟩
        rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨n, hx⟩
        obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := rescalePhase_surjective r hr n
        refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, ?_⟩
        refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(a, p.2), ?_⟩
        refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨p.1, ?_⟩
        simpa [atom', phase, hp] using hx
    lambdaCoefficient := G.lambdaCoefficient
    gammaCoefficient := G.gammaCoefficient
    lambdaCoefficient_ne_zero := G.lambdaCoefficient_ne_zero
    atom_periodic := by
      intro i p m
      have h := G.atom_periodic i p.1 (phase i p m)
      have hmul := (periodGroup (G.atom i p.1 (phase i p m))).zsmul_mem h (r : ℤ)
      simpa [atom', phase, b', L', Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul,
        zsmul_add, mul_smul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hmul
    carrier_transport := by
      intro i p m
      change regularSupport K (G.atom i p.1 (phase i p m)) =
        m • L'.basis 1 +ᵥ regularSupport K (G.atom i p.1 (phase i p 0))
      rw [G.carrier_transport i p.1 (phase i p m),
        G.carrier_transport i p.1 (phase i p 0)]
      simp only [phase]
      rw [← add_vadd]
      apply congrArg (fun u : Plane => u +ᵥ regularSupport K (G.atom i p.1 0))
      module
  }
  refine ⟨G', ?_⟩
  intro j
  simp [G', L', b']

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.empty_goodParametrization
statement:
theorem empty_goodParametrization (K : PolygonalRegion) :
    Nonempty (GoodParametrization K ∅)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L : PlanarLattice := ⟨Complex.basisOneI, Complex.basisOneI.linearIndependent⟩
  refine ⟨{
    lattice := L
    numberOfParts := 0
    Index := fun i => Fin.elim0 i
    atom := fun i => Fin.elim0 i
    atom_nonempty := ?_
    atoms_disjoint := ?_
    union_eq := ?_
    lambdaCoefficient := Fin.elim0
    gammaCoefficient := Fin.elim0
    lambdaCoefficient_ne_zero := ?_
    atom_periodic := ?_
    carrier_transport := ?_ }⟩
  · intro i; exact Fin.elim0 i
  · intro s hs t ht hst; exact Fin.elim0 s.1
  · simp
  · intro i; exact Fin.elim0 i
  · intro i; exact Fin.elim0 i
  · intro i; exact Fin.elim0 i

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.centrePeriods_le_carrierPeriods
statement:
theorem centrePeriods_le_carrierPeriods
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T E : Set Plane} (hTiles : TilesOn K T E)
    (hEopen : IsOpen E) (hEregular : interior (closure E) = E) :
    periodGroup T ≤ periodGroup E
proof:
:= by
  have heq := regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn hEopen hEregular hTiles
  intro u hu
  change u +ᵥ E = E
  rw [← heq, ← regularSupport_vadd]
  exact congrArg (regularSupport K) hu

name: Tiling.Polygonal.unionColumns_goodParametrization
statement:
theorem unionColumns_goodParametrization
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T E : Set Plane} {δ : Submodule ℝ Plane}
    (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (htile : TilesOn K T E)
    (hEopen : IsOpen E) (hEregular : interior (closure E) = E)
    (hEper : IsLatticePeriodic E) (hcol : IsUnionOfColumns K δ T) :
    Nonempty (Tiling.RationalSlopes.GoodParametrization K T)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, γ, hqδ, hq0, hγδ, hqT, htransport⟩ :=
    unionColumns_has_transverseFibreTransport hδ htile hEopen hEregular hEper hcol
  let orbitSetoid : Setoid T := {
    r := fun s t => ∃ m : ℤ, (s : Plane) - t - m • γ ∈ δ
    iseqv := ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ }
  case refine_1 =>
    intro s
    exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  case refine_2 =>
    rintro s t ⟨m, hm⟩
    refine ⟨-m, ?_⟩
    convert δ.neg_mem hm using 1
    simp only [neg_smul]
    abel
  case refine_3 =>
    rintro s t u ⟨m, hm⟩ ⟨n, hn⟩
    refine ⟨m + n, ?_⟩
    convert δ.add_mem hm hn using 1
    simp only [add_zsmul]
    abel
  let Q := Quotient orbitSetoid
  let f : Q → ℤ → T := fun a m =>
    ⟨(htransport (a.out : Plane) a.out.property m).choose,
      (htransport (a.out : Plane) a.out.property m).choose_spec.1⟩
  have hf (a : Q) (m : ℤ) : (f a m : Plane) - a.out - m • γ ∈ δ ∧
      regularSupport K (lineFibre δ T (f a m)) =
        m • γ +ᵥ regularSupport K (lineFibre δ T a.out) :=
    (htransport (a.out : Plane) a.out.property m).choose_spec.2
  have hγmul (m : ℤ) (hm : m • γ ∈ δ) : m = 0 := by
    by_contra hm0
    have hc : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm0
    apply hγδ
    have hh := δ.smul_mem ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) hm
    simpa only [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℝ, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul] using hh
  have hIndices (a b : Q) (m n : ℤ) {x : Plane}
      (hx : x ∈ lineFibre δ T (f a m)) (hy : x ∈ lineFibre δ T (f b n)) :
      a = b ∧ m = n := by
    have hft : (f a m : Plane) - f b n ∈ δ := by
      convert δ.sub_mem hy.2 hx.2 using 1
      abel
    have hrel : (a.out : Plane) - b.out - (n - m) • γ ∈ δ := by
      convert δ.add_mem (δ.sub_mem hft (hf a m).1) (hf b n).1 using 1
      simp only [sub_zsmul]
      abel
    have hab : a = b := Quotient.out_equiv_out.mp ⟨n - m, hrel⟩
    subst b
    have hmn : (m - n) • γ ∈ δ := by
      convert δ.sub_mem (δ.sub_mem hft (hf a m).1) (δ.neg_mem (hf a n).1) using 1
      simp only [sub_zsmul]
      abel
    exact ⟨rfl, sub_eq_zero.mp (hγmul _ hmn)⟩
  have hqFibre (t : T) : q ∈ periodGroup (lineFibre δ T t) := by
    change q +ᵥ lineFibre δ T t = lineFibre δ T t
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact hqT ▸ (show q +ᵥ y ∈ q +ᵥ T from ⟨y, hy.1, rfl⟩)
      · convert δ.add_mem hqδ hy.2 using 1
        simp only [vadd_eq_add]
        abel
    · intro hx
      refine ⟨(-q) +ᵥ x, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, by simp⟩
      · exact (periodGroup T).neg_mem hqT ▸
          (show (-q) +ᵥ x ∈ (-q) +ᵥ T from ⟨x, hx.1, rfl⟩)
      · convert δ.add_mem (δ.neg_mem hqδ) hx.2 using 1
        simp only [vadd_eq_add]
        abel
  have hIndependent : LinearIndependent ℝ ![q, γ] := by
    apply linearIndependent_fin2.mpr
    change γ ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a : ℝ, a • γ ≠ q
    constructor
    · intro hγ0; exact hγδ (hγ0 ▸ δ.zero_mem)
    · intro a ha
      by_cases ha0 : a = 0
      · exact hq0 (by simpa [ha0] using ha.symm)
      · apply hγδ
        have hh := δ.smul_mem a⁻¹ hqδ
        rw [← ha, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha0, one_smul] at hh
        exact hh
  refine ⟨{
    lattice := ⟨![q, γ], hIndependent⟩
    numberOfParts := 1
    Index := fun _ => Q
    atom := fun _ a m => lineFibre δ T (f a m)
    atom_nonempty := ?_
    atoms_disjoint := ?_
    union_eq := ?_
    lambdaCoefficient := fun _ => 1
    gammaCoefficient := fun _ => 0
    lambdaCoefficient_ne_zero := ?_
    atom_periodic := ?_
    carrier_transport := ?_ }⟩
  · intro i a m
    exact ⟨f a m, (f a m).property, by simp⟩
  · intro s _ t _ hst
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hy
    obtain ⟨hab, hmn⟩ := hIndices s.2.1 t.2.1 s.2.2 t.2.2 hx hy
    apply hst
    have hi : s.1 = t.1 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    cases s with | mk i am =>
      cases t with | mk j bn =>
        dsimp at hi hab hmn
        subst j
        exact congrArg (Sigma.mk i) (Prod.ext hab hmn)
  · ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, a, m, hx⟩
      exact hx.1
    · intro hx
      let a : Q := Quotient.mk orbitSetoid ⟨x, hx⟩
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := orbitSetoid.symm (Quotient.mk_out ⟨x, hx⟩)
      refine ⟨0, a, m, hx, ?_⟩
      convert δ.sub_mem hm (hf a m).1 using 1
      abel
  · intro i; exact one_ne_zero
  · intro i a m
    simpa only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero]
      using hqFibre (f a m)
  · intro i a m
    have h0 := (hf a 0).2
    simp only [zero_smul, zero_vadd] at h0
    exact (hf a m).2.trans (congrArg (fun B : Set Plane => m • γ +ᵥ B) h0.symm)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_exists_ordered_successor_with_gap
statement:
private theorem cp_exists_ordered_successor_with_gap
    (Y : Set ℝ) (hfinite : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (Y ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hdense : ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ y ∈ Y, |z - y| < ρ) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Y, ∃ y' ∈ Y,
      y < y' ∧ (∀ z ∈ Y, y < z → y' ≤ z) ∧ y' - y < 2 * ρ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρdense⟩ := hdense
  refine ⟨ρ, hρ, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨z, hzY, hdist⟩ := hρdense (y + ρ)
  have hdistAbs : |(y + ρ) - z| < ρ := by simpa using hdist
  have hyz : y < z := by
    have hright := (abs_lt.mp hdistAbs).2
    linarith
  have hzy : z < y + 2 * ρ := by
    have hleft := (abs_lt.mp hdistAbs).1
    linarith
  let A : Set ℝ := Y ∩ Set.Ioc y z
  have hfiniteIcc : (Y ∩ Set.Icc y z).Finite :=
    hfinite (Set.Icc y z) (Metric.isBounded_Icc y z)
  have hfiniteA : A.Finite := by
    apply hfiniteIcc.subset
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨hx.1, ⟨le_of_lt hx.2.1, hx.2.2⟩⟩
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := ⟨z, hzY, ⟨hyz, le_rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨y', hy'A, hy'min⟩ := Set.exists_min_image A id hfiniteA hAne
  have hy'Y : y' ∈ Y := hy'A.1
  have hyy' : y < y' := hy'A.2.1
  refine ⟨y', hy'Y, hyy', ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro w hwY hyw
    by_cases hwz : w ≤ z
    · exact hy'min w ⟨hwY, ⟨hyw, hwz⟩⟩
    · exact le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (hy'min z ⟨hzY, ⟨hyz, le_rfl⟩⟩) (lt_of_not_ge hwz))
  · have hylez : y' ≤ z := hy'A.2.2
    linarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_exists_ordered_predecessor_with_gap
statement:
private theorem cp_exists_ordered_predecessor_with_gap
    (Y : Set ℝ) (hfinite : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (Y ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hdense : ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ y ∈ Y, |z - y| < ρ) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Y, ∃ y' ∈ Y,
      y' < y ∧ (∀ z ∈ Y, z < y → z ≤ y') ∧ y - y' < 2 * ρ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρdense⟩ := hdense
  refine ⟨ρ, hρ, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨z, hzY, hdist⟩ := hρdense (y - ρ)
  have hdistAbs : |(y - ρ) - z| < ρ := by simpa using hdist
  have hzy : z < y := by
    have hleft := (abs_lt.mp hdistAbs).1
    linarith
  have hyz : y - 2 * ρ < z := by
    have hright := (abs_lt.mp hdistAbs).2
    linarith
  let A : Set ℝ := Y ∩ Set.Ico z y
  have hfiniteIcc : (Y ∩ Set.Icc z y).Finite :=
    hfinite (Set.Icc z y) (Metric.isBounded_Icc z y)
  have hfiniteA : A.Finite := by
    apply hfiniteIcc.subset
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨hx.1, ⟨hx.2.1, hx.2.2.le⟩⟩
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := ⟨z, hzY, ⟨le_rfl, hzy⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨y', hy'A, hy'max⟩ := Set.exists_max_image A id hfiniteA hAne
  have hy'Y : y' ∈ Y := hy'A.1
  have hy'y : y' < y := hy'A.2.2
  refine ⟨y', hy'Y, hy'y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro w hwY hwy
    by_cases hzw : z ≤ w
    · exact hy'max w ⟨hwY, ⟨hzw, hwy⟩⟩
    · have hwz : w ≤ z := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hzw)
      have hzy' : z ≤ y' := hy'max z ⟨hzY, ⟨le_rfl, hzy⟩⟩
      exact hwz.trans hzy'
  · have hzy' : z ≤ y' := hy'A.2.1
    linarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_ordered_successor_gap_lower_bound
statement:
private theorem cp_ordered_successor_gap_lower_bound
    {Y : Set ℝ} {y y' δ : ℝ}
    (hy : y ∈ Y) (hy' : y' ∈ Y) (hyy' : y < y')
    (hsep : ∀ a ∈ Y, ∀ b ∈ Y, a ≠ b → δ ≤ |a - b|) :
    δ ≤ y' - y
proof:
:= by
  have h := hsep y hy y' hy' (ne_of_lt hyy')
  rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hyy'.le)] at h
  linarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_exists_ordered_integer_chain
statement:
private theorem cp_exists_ordered_integer_chain
    (Y : Set ℝ) (hfinite : ∀ a b : ℝ, (Y ∩ Set.Icc a b).Finite)
    (habove : ∀ r : ℝ, ∃ a ∈ Y, r < a) (hbelow : ∀ r : ℝ, ∃ a ∈ Y, a < r) :
    ∃ y : ℤ → ℝ, Set.range y = Y ∧ StrictMono y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨y0, hy0⟩ := habove 0
  let α := {x : ℝ // x ∈ Y}
  have hIccFinite : ∀ a b : α, (Set.Icc a b).Finite := by
    intro a b
    have hreal : (Y ∩ Set.Icc (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)).Finite := hfinite _ _
    have hpre : ((fun x : α => (x : ℝ)) ⁻¹' (Y ∩ Set.Icc (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ))).Finite :=
      hreal.preimage (by
        intro x hx z hz hxz
        exact Subtype.ext hxz)
    apply hpre.subset
    intro x hx
    change a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b at hx
    change (x : ℝ) ∈ Y ∩ Set.Icc (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    exact ⟨x.2, hx⟩
  letI : LocallyFiniteOrder α := LocallyFiniteOrder.ofFiniteIcc hIccFinite
  letI : Nonempty α := ⟨⟨y0, hy0.1⟩⟩
  letI : NoMaxOrder α := ⟨fun a => by
    obtain ⟨z, hzY, haz⟩ := habove (a : ℝ)
    exact ⟨⟨z, hzY⟩, haz⟩⟩
  letI : NoMinOrder α := ⟨fun a => by
    obtain ⟨z, hzY, hza⟩ := hbelow (a : ℝ)
    exact ⟨⟨z, hzY⟩, hza⟩⟩
  letI : SuccOrder α := LinearLocallyFiniteOrder.succOrder α
  letI : PredOrder α := LinearLocallyFiniteOrder.predOrder α
  let e : α ≃o ℤ := orderIsoIntOfLinearSuccPredArch
  refine ⟨fun n => (e.symm n : ℝ), ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Set.eq_of_subset_of_subset
    · rintro x ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact (e.symm n).2
    · intro x hx
      let a : α := ⟨x, hx⟩
      exact ⟨e a, by simp [a, e]⟩
  · intro a b hab
    exact_mod_cast e.symm.strictMono hab

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_exists_ordered_integer_chain_with_gap_bound
statement:
private theorem cp_exists_ordered_integer_chain_with_gap_bound
    (Y : Set ℝ) (hfinite : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (Y ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hdense : ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ y ∈ Y, |z - y| < ρ) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ y : ℤ → ℝ,
      Set.range y = Y ∧ StrictMono y ∧ ∀ n : ℤ, y n < y (n + 1) ∧ y (n + 1) - y n < 2 * ρ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρdense⟩ := hdense
  have hfiniteIcc : ∀ a b : ℝ, (Y ∩ Set.Icc a b).Finite := by
    intro a b
    exact hfinite _ (Metric.isBounded_Icc a b)
  have habove : ∀ r : ℝ, ∃ a ∈ Y, r < a := by
    intro r
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hdist⟩ := hρdense (r + 2 * ρ)
    have hlt := (abs_lt.mp hdist).2
    exact ⟨a, ha, by linarith⟩
  have hbelow : ∀ r : ℝ, ∃ a ∈ Y, a < r := by
    intro r
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hdist⟩ := hρdense (r - 2 * ρ)
    have hgt := (abs_lt.mp hdist).1
    exact ⟨a, ha, by linarith⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hrange, hstrict⟩ := cp_exists_ordered_integer_chain Y hfiniteIcc habove hbelow
  refine ⟨ρ, hρ, y, hrange, hstrict, ?_⟩
  intro n
  have hnY : y n ∈ Y := by
    rw [← hrange]
    exact ⟨n, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hzY, hdist⟩ := hρdense (y n + ρ)
  have hzn : y n < z := by
    have h := (abs_lt.mp hdist).2
    linarith
  have hzb : z < y n + 2 * ρ := by
    have h := (abs_lt.mp hdist).1
    linarith
  have hzRange : z ∈ Set.range y := hrange ▸ hzY
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_range.mp hzRange
  have hnm : n < m := hstrict.lt_iff_lt.mp hzn
  have hnnext : n + 1 ≤ m := by omega
  have hnextZ : y (n + 1) ≤ y m := hstrict.monotone hnnext
  constructor
  · exact hstrict (by omega)
  · linarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_integer_chain_gap_lower_bound
statement:
private theorem cp_integer_chain_gap_lower_bound
    {Y : Set ℝ} {y : ℤ → ℝ} (hrange : Set.range y = Y) (hstrict : StrictMono y)
    {δ : ℝ} (hsep : ∀ a ∈ Y, ∀ b ∈ Y, a ≠ b → δ ≤ |a - b|) :
    ∀ n : ℤ, δ ≤ y (n + 1) - y n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  have hleft : y n ∈ Y := by rw [← hrange]; exact ⟨n, rfl⟩
  have hright : y (n + 1) ∈ Y := by rw [← hrange]; exact ⟨n + 1, rfl⟩
  exact cp_ordered_successor_gap_lower_bound hleft hright (hstrict (by omega)) hsep

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_integer_gap_chain_covers_reals
statement:
private theorem cp_integer_gap_chain_covers_reals
    (y : ℤ → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hgap : ∀ n : ℤ, d ≤ y (n + 1) - y n) :
    StrictMono y ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, N ≤ n → z < y n) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n ≤ N → y n < z) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, ∃ n : ℤ, y n ≤ z ∧ z ≤ y (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hsucc : ∀ n : ℤ, y n < y (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    have := hgap n
    linarith
  have hmono : StrictMono y := strictMono_int_of_lt_succ hsucc
  have hiterate : ∀ (i : ℤ) (k : ℕ), y i + (k : ℝ) * d ≤ y (i + (k : ℤ)) := by
    intro i k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
        have hstep := hgap (i + (k : ℤ))
        have hindex : i + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = i + (k : ℤ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
        have hmul : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * d = (k : ℝ) * d + d := by push_cast; ring
        rw [hindex, hmul]
        linarith
  have hforward : ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ N : ℤ, z < y N := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((z - y 0) / d)
    have hN' : z - y 0 < (N : ℝ) * d := (div_lt_iff₀ hd).mp hN
    have hIter := hiterate 0 N
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    have hIter' : y 0 + (N : ℝ) * d ≤ y (N : ℤ) := by simpa using hIter
    linarith
  have hbackward : ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ N : ℤ, y N < z := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((y 0 - z) / d)
    have hN' : y 0 - z < (N : ℝ) * d := (div_lt_iff₀ hd).mp hN
    have hIter := hiterate (-(N : ℤ)) N
    refine ⟨-(N : ℤ), ?_⟩
    have hIter' : y (-(N : ℤ)) + (N : ℝ) * d ≤ y 0 := by
      simpa using hIter
    linarith
  refine ⟨hmono, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨N, hNz⟩ := hforward z
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    intro n hNn
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hNz (hmono.monotone hNn)
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨N, hNz⟩ := hbackward z
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    intro n hnN
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hmono.monotone hnN) hNz
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨N, hNhigh⟩ := hforward z
    obtain ⟨M, hMlow⟩ := hbackward z
    let S : Set ℤ := {n | y n ≤ z}
    have hSne : S.Nonempty := ⟨M, le_of_lt hMlow⟩
    have hSbdd : BddAbove S := by
      refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
      intro n hn
      by_contra hnot
      have hNn : N ≤ n := le_of_not_ge hnot
      have hle := hmono.monotone hNn
      change y n ≤ z at hn
      linarith
    obtain ⟨n, hnmax⟩ := hSbdd.exists_isGreatest_of_nonempty hSne
    refine ⟨n, hnmax.1, ?_⟩
    by_contra hn
    have hnext : n + 1 ∈ S := by
      change y (n + 1) ≤ z
      exact le_of_not_ge hn
    have hle := hnmax.2 hnext
    omega

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_finite_positive_step_alphabet_has_minimum
statement:
private theorem cp_finite_positive_step_alphabet_has_minimum
    (D : Set ℝ) (hfinite : D.Finite) (hne : D.Nonempty)
    (hpos : ∀ d ∈ D, 0 < d) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ d ∈ D, δ ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδD, hδmin⟩ := Set.exists_min_image D id hfinite hne
  exact ⟨δ, hpos δ hδD, hδmin⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_finite_positive_step_chain_covers_reals
statement:
private theorem cp_finite_positive_step_chain_covers_reals
    (y : ℤ → ℝ) (D : Set ℝ) (hfinite : D.Finite)
    (hpos : ∀ d ∈ D, 0 < d)
    (hsteps : ∀ n : ℤ, y (n + 1) - y n ∈ D) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, δ ≤ y (n + 1) - y n) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, ∃ n : ℤ, y n ≤ z ∧ z ≤ y (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hne : D.Nonempty := ⟨y 1 - y 0, hsteps 0⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδD⟩ := cp_finite_positive_step_alphabet_has_minimum D hfinite hne hpos
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n
    exact hδD _ (hsteps n)
  · exact (cp_integer_gap_chain_covers_reals y δ hδ (fun n => hδD _ (hsteps n))).2.2.2

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_ordered_affine_line
statement:
private theorem cp_ordered_affine_line (Y : Set Plane) (hY : HasFLC Y)
    (a e : Plane) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hdense : ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ t : ℝ, a + t • e ∈ Y ∧
      dist (a + z • e) (a + t • e) < ρ) :
    ∃ r : ℤ → ℝ, Set.range r = {t : ℝ | a + t • e ∈ Y} ∧ StrictMono r ∧
      ∀ n : ℤ, dist (a + r n • e) (a + r (n + 1) • e) < 2 * ρ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Z : Set ℝ := {t | a + t • e ∈ Y}
  have hene : e ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [hz, norm_zero] at he
    exact zero_ne_one he
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun t : ℝ => a + t • e) := by
    intro s t hst
    exact smul_left_injective ℝ hene (add_left_cancel hst)
  have hdist (s t : ℝ) : dist (a + s • e) (a + t • e) = |s - t| := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have hs : (a + s • e) - (a + t • e) = (s - t) • e := by module
    rw [hs, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, he, mul_one]
  have hfinite : ∀ u v : ℝ, (Z ∩ Set.Icc u v).Finite := by
    intro u v
    let R : ℝ := max |u| |v|
    have hB := hY.1 (Metric.closedBall a R) Metric.isBounded_closedBall
    have hpre : ((fun t : ℝ => a + t • e) ⁻¹' (Y ∩ Metric.closedBall a R)).Finite :=
      hB.preimage hinj.injOn
    apply hpre.subset
    rintro t ⟨htZ, ht⟩
    refine ⟨htZ, ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
    have hd : dist (a + t • e) a = |t| := by simpa using hdist t 0
    rw [hd]
    dsimp [R]
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [ht.1, neg_abs_le u, le_max_left |u| |v|],
      by linarith [ht.2, le_abs_self v, le_max_right |u| |v|]⟩
  have hzdense : ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ t ∈ Z, |z - t| < ρ := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hdt⟩ := hdense z
    exact ⟨t, ht, by rwa [hdist] at hdt⟩
  have habove : ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ t ∈ Z, z < t := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hdt⟩ := hzdense (z + ρ)
    exact ⟨t, ht, by linarith [(abs_lt.mp hdt).2]⟩
  have hbelow : ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ t ∈ Z, t < z := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hdt⟩ := hzdense (z - ρ)
    exact ⟨t, ht, by linarith [(abs_lt.mp hdt).1]⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hrange, hstrict⟩ := cp_exists_ordered_integer_chain Z hfinite habove hbelow
  refine ⟨r, hrange, hstrict, ?_⟩
  intro n
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hdt⟩ := hzdense (r n + ρ)
  have hnt : r n < t := by linarith [(abs_lt.mp hdt).2]
  have htb : t < r n + 2 * ρ := by linarith [(abs_lt.mp hdt).1]
  have htRange : t ∈ Set.range r := hrange ▸ ht
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := htRange
  have hnm : n < m := hstrict.lt_iff_lt.mp hnt
  have hnext : r (n + 1) ≤ r m := hstrict.monotone (by omega)
  rw [hdist, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr (hstrict (by omega)).le)]
  linarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_rationalNormalFunctional_eq_eval
statement:
private theorem cp_rationalNormalFunctional_eq_eval (n : RationalNormal) (z : Plane) :
    cp_rationalNormalFunctional n z = normalEval n z
proof:
:= by
  simp [cp_rationalNormalFunctional, normalEval]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_rationalNormalFunctional_ker
statement:
private theorem cp_rationalNormalFunctional_ker (n : RationalNormal) :
    LinearMap.ker (cp_rationalNormalFunctional n) = normalDirection n
proof: := rfl

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_rationalNormalFunctional_surjective
statement:
private theorem cp_rationalNormalFunctional_surjective (n : RationalNormal) :
    Function.Surjective (cp_rationalNormalFunctional n)
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  rcases n.nonzero with hx | hy
  · have hxR : (n.x : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hx
    refine ⟨⟨r / (n.x : ℝ), 0⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [cp_rationalNormalFunctional_eq_eval, normalEval]
    simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]
    field_simp [hxR]
  · have hyR : (n.y : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hy
    refine ⟨⟨0, r / (n.y : ℝ)⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [cp_rationalNormalFunctional_eq_eval, normalEval]
    field_simp [hyR] <;> ring

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_exists_unit_kernel_coordinate
statement:
private theorem cp_exists_unit_kernel_coordinate (ψ : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hker : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker ψ) = 1) :
    ∃ e : Plane, ∃ τ : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ,
      ‖e‖ = 1 ∧ ψ e = 0 ∧ τ e = 1 ∧
        ∀ v : Plane, ψ v = 0 → v = (τ v) • e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hker_nebot : LinearMap.ker ψ ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    rw [h, finrank_bot] at hker
    norm_num at hker
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff (LinearMap.ker ψ)).mp hker_nebot
  let e : Plane := (‖v‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • v
  have hvnorm : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv0
  have henorm : ‖e‖ = 1 := by
    calc
      ‖e‖ = ‖(‖v‖⁻¹ : ℝ)‖ * ‖v‖ := by simp [e]
      _ = 1 := by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hvnorm)]
        exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hvnorm)
  have heker : e ∈ LinearMap.ker ψ := by
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    have hvψ : ψ v = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hv
    change ψ ((‖v‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • v) = 0
    rw [map_smul, hvψ, smul_zero]
  have he0 : e ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have : ‖e‖ = 0 := by simp [h]
    linarith [henorm]
  let τ : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (e.re : ℝ) • Complex.reCLM.toLinearMap + (e.im : ℝ) • Complex.imCLM.toLinearMap
  have hτe : τ e = 1 := by
    have hnormsq : Complex.normSq e = 1 := by
      rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, henorm]
      norm_num
    have hdot : e.re ^ 2 + e.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have := Complex.normSq_apply e
      rw [hnormsq] at this
      nlinarith [this]
    change e.re * e.re + e.im * e.im = 1
    nlinarith [hdot]
  have heSpan := eq_span_singleton_of_mem_of_finrank_eq_one hker heker he0
  refine ⟨e, τ, henorm, ?_, hτe, ?_⟩
  · exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp heker
  · intro w hw
    have hwmem : w ∈ LinearMap.ker ψ := LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hw
    rw [heSpan] at hwmem
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hwmem
    have hτw : τ w = c := by
      calc
        τ w = τ (c • e) := by rw [hc]
        _ = c * τ e := by simpa [smul_eq_mul] using (map_smul τ c e)
        _ = c := by rw [hτe, mul_one]
    calc
      w = c • e := hc.symm
      _ = (τ w) • e := by rw [hτw]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_affine_level_eq_kernel_coordinate
statement:
private theorem cp_affine_level_eq_kernel_coordinate
    {ψ : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ} {a x e : Plane} {τ : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ}
    (hlevel : ψ x = ψ a)
    (hdecomp : ∀ v : Plane, ψ v = 0 → v = (τ v) • e) :
    x = a + (τ (x - a)) • e
proof:
:= by
  have hker : ψ (x - a) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, hlevel, sub_self]
  calc
    x = a + (x - a) := by abel
    _ = a + (τ (x - a)) • e := by congr 1; exact hdecomp (x - a) hker

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_finite_chain_gap_alphabet
statement:
private theorem cp_finite_chain_gap_alphabet (Y : Set Plane) (hY : HasFLC Y)
    (x : ℤ → Plane) (hx : ∀ n, x n ∈ Y) (R : ℝ)
    (hR : ∀ n, dist (x (n + 1)) (x n) < R) :
    ∃ D : Set Plane, D.Finite ∧ D ⊆ Y - Y ∧
      (∀ d ∈ D, ‖d‖ ≤ R) ∧ ∀ n, x (n + 1) - x n ∈ D
proof:
:= by
  let D := (Y - Y) ∩ Metric.closedBall (0 : Plane) R
  have hRpos : 0 < R := lt_of_le_of_lt dist_nonneg (hR 0)
  refine ⟨D, hY.2 R hRpos, inter_subset_left, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro d hd
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hd.2
  · intro n
    refine ⟨Set.sub_mem_sub (hx (n + 1)) (hx n), ?_⟩
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using (hR n).le

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_image_chain_dense_of_finite_alphabet
statement:
private theorem cp_image_chain_dense_of_finite_alphabet
    (f : Plane →+ Plane) (a e : Plane) (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    (τ : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hτ : τ e = 1) (r : ℤ → ℝ)
    (hline : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ u : ℝ, f (a + r n • e) = f a + u • e)
    (D : Set Plane) (hD : D.Finite)
    (hsteps : ∀ n : ℤ, (a + r (n + 1) • e) - (a + r n • e) ∈ D)
    (hpositive : ∀ d ∈ D, 0 < τ (f d))
    (M : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ d ∈ D, ‖f d‖ < M) :
    ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ n : ℤ, dist (f a + z • e) (f (a + r n • e)) < M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose u hu using hline
  have hgap (n : ℤ) : u (n + 1) - u n =
      τ (f ((a + r (n + 1) • e) - (a + r n • e))) := by
    rw [map_sub, hu (n + 1), hu n]
    have hsub : (f a + u (n + 1) • e) - (f a + u n • e) =
        (u (n + 1) - u n) • e := by module
    rw [hsub, map_smul, hτ, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  let E : Set ℝ := (fun d : Plane => τ (f d)) '' D
  have hE : E.Finite := hD.image _
  have hEpos : ∀ t ∈ E, 0 < t := by
    rintro t ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩
    exact hpositive d hd
  have hEstep : ∀ n : ℤ, u (n + 1) - u n ∈ E := by
    intro n
    exact ⟨_, hsteps n, (hgap n).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδgap, hcover⟩ :=
    cp_finite_positive_step_chain_covers_reals u E hE hEpos hEstep
  intro z
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩ := hcover z
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [hu n, dist_eq_norm]
  have hsub : (f a + z • e) - (f a + u n • e) = (z - u n) • e := by module
  rw [hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, he, mul_one, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hn)]
  have hnorm : ‖f ((a + r (n + 1) • e) - (a + r n • e))‖ =
      u (n + 1) - u n := by
    rw [map_sub, hu (n + 1), hu n]
    have hsub' : (f a + u (n + 1) • e) - (f a + u n • e) =
        (u (n + 1) - u n) • e := by module
    rw [hsub', norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, he, mul_one,
      abs_of_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le hδ (hδgap n))]
  have hM := hbound _ (hsteps n)
  rw [hnorm] at hM
  linarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_finite_vector_control
statement:
private theorem cp_finite_vector_control (D : Set Plane) (hD : D.Finite)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
        ∀ d ∈ D, ‖deformPoint φ d - d‖ < η
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : Finset ℝ := hD.toFinset.image Complex.re ∪ hD.toFinset.image Complex.im
  refine ⟨F, η / 3, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ d hd
  have hre := hφ.2 d.re (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr
    ⟨d, hD.mem_toFinset.mpr hd, rfl⟩))
  have him := hφ.2 d.im (Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr
    ⟨d, hD.mem_toFinset.mpr hd, rfl⟩))
  have hnorm := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im (deformPoint φ d - d)
  change ‖deformPoint φ d - d‖ ≤
    |(φ d.re : ℝ) - d.re| + |(φ d.im : ℝ) - d.im| at hnorm
  linarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_finite_positive_gap_control
statement:
private theorem cp_finite_positive_gap_control (D : Set Plane) (hD : D.Finite)
    (hzero : 0 ∉ D) :
    ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
        ∀ d ∈ D, ‖deformPoint φ d - d‖ < ‖d‖ ∧
          ‖deformPoint φ d‖ < ‖d‖ + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hne : D.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨d₀, hd₀, hmin⟩ := Set.exists_min_image D norm hD hne
    have hd₀pos : 0 < ‖d₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (by intro h; exact hzero (h ▸ hd₀))
    let η : ℝ := min ‖d₀‖ 1
    have hη : 0 < η := lt_min hd₀pos zero_lt_one
    obtain ⟨F, ε, hε, hctrl⟩ := cp_finite_vector_control D hD η hη
    refine ⟨F, ε, hε, ?_⟩
    intro φ hφ d hd
    have herr := hctrl φ hφ d hd
    refine ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le herr ((min_le_left _ _).trans (hmin d hd)), ?_⟩
    have htri : ‖deformPoint φ d‖ ≤ ‖deformPoint φ d - d‖ + ‖d‖ := by
      simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le (deformPoint φ d - d) d
    have hηone : η ≤ 1 := min_le_right _ _
    linarith
  · refine ⟨∅, 1, zero_lt_one, ?_⟩
    intro φ hφ d hd
    exact (hne ⟨d, hd⟩).elim

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_finite_boundary_normals
statement:
private theorem cp_finite_boundary_normals (K : PolygonalRegion)
    (hK : Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasRationalSlopes K) :
    ∃ N : Finset RationalNormal, ∀ δ : Submodule ℝ Plane,
      Tiling.Polygonal.HasBoundaryDirection K δ →
        ∃ n ∈ N, normalDirection n = δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := {δ : Submodule ℝ Plane // Tiling.Polygonal.HasBoundaryDirection K δ}
  have hB := Tiling.Polygonal.boundaryDirections_finite K
  haveI : Finite B := hB.to_subtype
  have hnormal : ∀ δ : B, ∃ n : RationalNormal, normalDirection n = δ.1 := by
    intro δ
    have hdim : Module.finrank ℝ δ.1 = 1 := by
      obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hseg, hspan⟩ := δ.2
      rw [hspan]
      exact finrank_span_singleton (sub_ne_zero.mpr hab.symm)
    exact rationalDirection_hasNormal δ.1 hdim
      (Tiling.Polygonal.hasRationalDirection_of_hasBoundaryDirection hK δ.2)
  choose ν hν using hnormal
  have hfinite : (Set.range ν).Finite := Set.finite_range ν
  refine ⟨hfinite.toFinset, ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ
  refine ⟨ν ⟨δ, hδ⟩, hfinite.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨⟨δ, hδ⟩, rfl⟩, hν ⟨δ, hδ⟩⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_deformation_bounded_gap_tests
statement:
private theorem cp_deformation_bounded_gap_tests (Y : Set Plane) (hY : HasFLC Y)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
        ∀ u ∈ Y, ∀ v ∈ Y, dist u v < R → u ≠ v →
          ‖deformPoint φ (u - v) - (u - v)‖ < ‖u - v‖ ∧
            ‖deformPoint φ (u - v)‖ < ‖u - v‖ + 1
proof:
:= by
  let D : Set Plane := ((Y - Y) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 R) \ {0}
  have hD : D.Finite := (hY.2 R hR).diff
  have hzero : 0 ∉ D := by simp [D]
  obtain ⟨F, ε, hε, hctrl⟩ := cp_finite_positive_gap_control D hD hzero
  refine ⟨F, ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ u hu v hv hdist hne
  have hnorm : ‖u - v‖ < R := by simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hdist
  have hd : u - v ∈ D := by
    refine ⟨⟨Set.sub_mem_sub hu hv, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hnorm.le
    · simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using sub_ne_zero.mpr hne
  obtain ⟨hrel, hb⟩ := hctrl φ hφ (u - v) hd
  exact ⟨hrel, hb⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_positive_image_scalar
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : t • e - s • e = (t - s) • e := by module
  rw [hsub, norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, he,
    mul_one, mul_one, abs_of_pos hs] at herr
  linarith [(abs_lt.mp herr).1]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.deformPoint_lineCloud_dense_of_gapControl
statement:
theorem deformPoint_lineCloud_dense_of_gapControl
    (Y : Set Plane) (hY : HasFLC Y) (n : RationalNormal)
    (hker : Module.finrank ℝ (normalDirection n) = 1)
    (a : Plane) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hdense : ∀ z : Plane, normalEval n z = normalEval n a →
      ∃ w ∈ Y, normalEval n w = normalEval n a ∧ dist z w < ρ)
    (φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hctrl : ∀ u ∈ Y, ∀ v ∈ Y, dist u v < 2 * ρ → u ≠ v →
      ‖deformPoint φ (u - v) - (u - v)‖ < ‖u - v‖ ∧
        ‖deformPoint φ (u - v)‖ < 2 * ρ + 1) :
    ∀ z : Plane, normalEval n z = normalEval n (deformPoint φ a) →
      ∃ w ∈ Y, normalEval n w = normalEval n a ∧
        normalEval n (deformPoint φ w) = normalEval n (deformPoint φ a) ∧
        dist z (deformPoint φ w) < 2 * ρ + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let π := cp_rationalNormalFunctional n
  let f : Plane →+ Plane := (deformPointLinear φ).toAddMonoidHom
  obtain ⟨e, τ, he, hπe, hτe, hdecomp⟩ := cp_exists_unit_kernel_coordinate π hker
  have hnormal (z : Plane) : π z = normalEval n z := cp_rationalNormalFunctional_eq_eval n z
  have hpoint (s : ℝ) : π (a + s • e) = π a := by
    rw [map_add, map_smul, hπe, smul_zero, add_zero]
  have hsource_dense : ∀ s : ℝ, ∃ t : ℝ, a + t • e ∈ Y ∧
      dist (a + s • e) (a + t • e) < ρ := by
    intro s
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwline, hdist⟩ := hdense (a + s • e)
      (by simpa only [← hnormal] using hpoint s)
    have hwcoord : w = a + τ (w - a) • e :=
      cp_affine_level_eq_kernel_coordinate (by simpa only [hnormal] using hwline) hdecomp
    exact ⟨τ (w - a), hwcoord ▸ hw, hwcoord ▸ hdist⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hrange, hstrict, hgap⟩ := cp_ordered_affine_line Y hY a e he ρ hρ hsource_dense
  let p : ℤ → Plane := fun k => a + r k • e
  have hpY : ∀ k, p k ∈ Y := by
    intro k
    have hh : r k ∈ Set.range r := ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rwa [hrange] at hh
  have hpnormal (k : ℤ) : π (p k) = π a := hpoint _
  have hfpoint (k : ℤ) : π (f (p k)) = π (f a) := by
    change normalEval n (deformPoint φ (p k)) = normalEval n (deformPoint φ a)
    rw [rationalNormal_commutes, rationalNormal_commutes]
    rw [← hnormal, ← hnormal, hpnormal]
  have hline : ∀ k : ℤ, ∃ u : ℝ, f (p k) = f a + u • e := by
    intro k
    exact ⟨τ (f (p k) - f a),
      cp_affine_level_eq_kernel_coordinate (hfpoint k) hdecomp⟩
  obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀, hD₀sub, hD₀bound, hD₀steps⟩ :=
    cp_finite_chain_gap_alphabet Y hY p hpY (2 * ρ) (fun k => by
      simpa only [dist_comm] using hgap k)
  let D : Set Plane := Set.range (fun k : ℤ => p (k + 1) - p k)
  have hD : D.Finite := hD₀.subset (by rintro d ⟨k, rfl⟩; exact hD₀steps k)
  have hctrlstep (k : ℤ) :
      ‖f (p (k + 1) - p k) - (p (k + 1) - p k)‖ < ‖p (k + 1) - p k‖ ∧
      ‖f (p (k + 1) - p k)‖ < 2 * ρ + 1 := by
    apply hctrl _ (hpY (k + 1)) _ (hpY k) (by simpa only [dist_comm] using hgap k)
    intro heq
    have he0 : e ≠ 0 := by intro h; simpa [h] using he
    have hrr : r (k + 1) = r k := smul_left_injective ℝ he0 (add_left_cancel heq)
    exact (ne_of_gt (hstrict (by omega))) hrr
  have hpositive : ∀ d ∈ D, 0 < τ (f d) := by
    rintro d ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have hzero : π (f (p (k + 1) - p k)) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, map_sub, hfpoint, hfpoint, sub_self]
    have himage := hdecomp _ hzero
    have hsource : p (k + 1) - p k = (r (k + 1) - r k) • e := by
      change (a + r (k + 1) • e) - (a + r k • e) = (r (k + 1) - r k) • e
      module
    have herr := (hctrlstep k).1
    rw [himage] at herr
    have hsource_norm : ‖p (k + 1) - p k‖ = ‖(r (k + 1) - r k) • e‖ := congrArg norm hsource
    rw [hsource_norm] at herr
    have herr' : ‖τ (f (p (k + 1) - p k)) • e - (r (k + 1) - r k) • e‖ <
        ‖(r (k + 1) - r k) • e‖ := by
      exact hsource ▸ herr
    have hpos := cp_positive_image_scalar e he (r (k + 1) - r k)
      (τ (f (p (k + 1) - p k))) (sub_pos.mpr (hstrict (by omega))) herr'
    exact hpos
  have hbound : ∀ d ∈ D, ‖f d‖ < 2 * ρ + 1 := by
    rintro d ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact (hctrlstep k).2
  have hcover := cp_image_chain_dense_of_finite_alphabet f a e he τ hτe r hline D hD
    (fun k => ⟨k, rfl⟩) hpositive (2 * ρ + 1) hbound
  intro z hz
  have hzπ : π z = π (f a) := by
    change π z = π (deformPoint φ a)
    simpa only [hnormal] using hz
  have hzcoord : z = f a + τ (z - f a) • e :=
    cp_affine_level_eq_kernel_coordinate hzπ hdecomp
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hcover (τ (z - f a))
  refine ⟨p k, hpY k, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hnormal] using hpnormal k
  · change normalEval n (f (p k)) = normalEval n (f a)
    simpa only [hnormal] using hfpoint k
  · change dist z (f (a + r k • e)) < 2 * ρ + 1
    simpa only [← hzcoord] using hk

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_lifted_chain_preserves_fibre_density
statement:
private theorem cp_lifted_chain_preserves_fibre_density
    (Y : Set Plane) (hY : HasFLC Y)
    (f : Plane →+ Plane) (π : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (e : Plane) (τ : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (v : ℤ → Plane) (u : ℤ → ℝ) (b : Plane) (M : ℝ)
    (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hπe : π e = 0) (hτe : τ e = 1)
    (hrep : ∀ w : Plane, π w = 0 → w = (τ w) • e)
    (hvY : ∀ n : ℤ, v n ∈ Y)
    (himage : ∀ n : ℤ, f (v n) = b + (u n) • e)
    (hstrict : StrictMono u)
    (himageGap : ∀ n : ℤ, dist (f (v (n + 1))) (f (v n)) < M / 2)
    (hcoarse : ∀ x ∈ Y, ∀ y ∈ Y,
      dist (f x) (f y) < M / 2 → dist x y < M)
    (hreflect : ∀ x ∈ Y, ∀ y ∈ Y,
      dist (f x) (f y) < M / 2 →
        (π (f x - f y) = 0 ↔ π (x - y) = 0))
    (hvector : ∀ x ∈ Y, ∀ y ∈ Y, x ≠ y → dist x y < M →
      ‖f (x - y) - (x - y)‖ < ‖x - y‖) :
    (∀ n : ℤ, π (v n - v 0) = 0) ∧
      ∀ z : Plane, π (z - v 0) = 0 → ∃ n : ℤ, dist z (v n) < M
proof:
:= by
  have hM : 0 < M := by
    have h := himageGap 0
    have : 0 ≤ dist (f (v (0 + 1))) (f (v 0)) := dist_nonneg
    have hpos : 0 < M / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt this h
    linarith
  have himageStep : ∀ n : ℤ,
      f (v (n + 1)) - f (v n) = (u (n + 1) - u n) • e := by
    intro n
    rw [himage, himage]
    module
  have hsourceNormalStep : ∀ n : ℤ, π (v (n + 1) - v n) = 0 := by
    intro n
    have hπimage : π (f (v (n + 1)) - f (v n)) = 0 := by
      rw [himageStep, map_smul, hπe, smul_zero]
    exact (hreflect (v (n + 1)) (hvY _) (v n) (hvY _) (himageGap n)).mp hπimage
  have hlevel : ∀ n : ℤ, π (v n) = π (v 0) := by
    intro n
    induction n using Int.induction_on with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
        have hs := hsourceNormalStep n
        rw [map_sub] at hs
        have hs' : π (v (n + 1)) = π (v n) := sub_eq_zero.mp hs
        simpa using hs'.trans ih
    | pred n ih =>
        let k : ℤ := -(n : ℤ) - 1
        have hs := hsourceNormalStep k
        have hidx : k + 1 = -(n : ℤ) := by dsimp [k]; omega
        rw [hidx, map_sub] at hs
        have hs' : π (v (-(n : ℤ))) = π (v k) := sub_eq_zero.mp hs
        exact hs'.symm.trans ih
  have hvlevel : ∀ n : ℤ, π (v n - v 0) = 0 := by
    intro n
    rw [map_sub, hlevel n, sub_self]
  let r : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => τ (v n - v 0)
  have hsourceRep : ∀ n : ℤ, v n = v 0 + (r n) • e := by
    intro n
    have hker : π (v n - v 0) = 0 := hvlevel n
    have hrepr := hrep (v n - v 0) hker
    have hrepr' : v n = v 0 + (τ (v n - v 0)) • e := by
      calc
        v n = v 0 + (v n - v 0) := by abel
        _ = v 0 + (τ (v n - v 0)) • e := congrArg (fun w : Plane => v 0 + w) hrepr
    simpa [r] using hrepr'
  have hτstep : ∀ n : ℤ, τ (v (n + 1) - v n) = r (n + 1) - r n := by
    intro n
    have hvec : v (n + 1) - v n = (v (n + 1) - v 0) - (v n - v 0) := by abel
    rw [hvec, map_sub]
  have hgap_pos : ∀ n : ℤ, 0 < r (n + 1) - r n := by
    intro n
    have himgpos : 0 < u (n + 1) - u n := sub_pos.mpr (hstrict (by omega))
    have hdist : dist (f (v (n + 1))) (f (v n)) < M / 2 := himageGap n
    have hsourceM : dist (v (n + 1)) (v n) < M :=
      hcoarse (v (n + 1)) (hvY _) (v n) (hvY _) hdist
    have hne : v (n + 1) ≠ v n := by
      intro heq
      have : f (v (n + 1)) = f (v n) := congrArg f heq
      have hzero : f (v (n + 1)) - f (v n) = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr this
      rw [himageStep] at hzero
      have hzero' := congrArg τ hzero
      rw [map_smul, hτe, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, map_zero] at hzero'
      linarith
    have hvec := hvector (v (n + 1)) (hvY _) (v n) (hvY _) hne hsourceM
    have hstep : v (n + 1) - v n = (r (n + 1) - r n) • e := by
      have hkerstep := hsourceNormalStep n
      have hrepr := hrep (v (n + 1) - v n) hkerstep
      rw [hτstep n] at hrepr
      exact hrepr
    have hdiff : f (v (n + 1) - v n) - (v (n + 1) - v n) =
        ((u (n + 1) - u n) - (r (n + 1) - r n)) • e := by
      have hfstep : f (v (n + 1) - v n) = f (v (n + 1)) - f (v n) :=
        map_sub f _ _
      rw [hfstep, himageStep, hstep]
      module
    have hnorm : ‖((u (n + 1) - u n) - (r (n + 1) - r n)) • e‖ <
        ‖(r (n + 1) - r n) • e‖ := by
      rw [← hdiff]
      rw [← hstep]
      exact hvec
    simp only [norm_smul, he, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hnorm
    by_contra hnot
    have hle : r (n + 1) - r n ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt hnot
    have hbound := (abs_lt.mp hnorm).2
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hle] at hbound
    linarith
  have hgap_bound : ∀ n : ℤ, r (n + 1) - r n < M := by
    intro n
    have hsourceM := hcoarse (v (n + 1)) (hvY _) (v n) (hvY _) (himageGap n)
    have hstep : v (n + 1) - v n = (r (n + 1) - r n) • e := by
      have hkerstep := hsourceNormalStep n
      have hrepr := hrep (v (n + 1) - v n) hkerstep
      rw [hτstep n] at hrepr
      exact hrepr
    have hdistEq : dist (v (n + 1)) (v n) = r (n + 1) - r n := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, hstep, norm_smul, he, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hgap_pos n), mul_one]
    rw [hdistEq] at hsourceM
    exact hsourceM
  let S : Set Plane := (Y - Y) ∩ Metric.closedBall (0 : Plane) M
  have hSfinite : S.Finite := hY.2 M hM
  have hdiffS : ∀ n : ℤ, v (n + 1) - v n ∈ S := by
    intro n
    constructor
    · exact ⟨v (n + 1), hvY _, v n, hvY _, rfl⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      have hsourceM := hcoarse (v (n + 1)) (hvY _) (v n) (hvY _) (himageGap n)
      simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hsourceM.le
  let D : Set ℝ := Set.range (fun n : ℤ => r (n + 1) - r n)
  have hDfinite : D.Finite := by
    apply (hSfinite.image τ).subset
    rintro d ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨v (n + 1) - v n, hdiffS n, hτstep n⟩
  have hsteps : ∀ n : ℤ, r (n + 1) - r n ∈ D := fun n => ⟨n, rfl⟩
  have hposD : ∀ d ∈ D, 0 < d := by
    rintro d ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact hgap_pos n
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδgap, hbracket⟩ :=
    cp_finite_positive_step_chain_covers_reals r D hDfinite hposD hsteps
  refine ⟨hvlevel, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  let rz : ℝ := τ (z - v 0)
  have hzrep : z = v 0 + rz • e := by
    have h := hrep (z - v 0) hz
    calc
      z = v 0 + (z - v 0) := by abel
      _ = v 0 + rz • e := by
        simpa [rz] using congrArg (fun w : Plane => v 0 + w) h
  obtain ⟨n, hnlow, hnhigh⟩ := hbracket rz
  have hdistEq : dist z (v n) = |rz - r n| := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have hkerzn : π (z - v n) = 0 := by
      have hvec : z - v n = (z - v 0) - (v n - v 0) := by abel
      rw [hvec, map_sub, hz, hvlevel n, sub_self]
    have hcoord : τ (z - v n) = rz - r n := by
      have hvec : z - v n = (z - v 0) - (v n - v 0) := by abel
      rw [hvec, map_sub]
    have hrepr := hrep (z - v n) hkerzn
    rw [hcoord] at hrepr
    rw [hrepr, norm_smul, he, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_one]
  have hgap := hgap_bound n
  have habs : |rz - r n| ≤ r (n + 1) - r n := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hnlow)]
    linarith
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [hdistEq]
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt habs hgap

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.cp_inverse_cloud_gives_source_fibre_density
statement:
private theorem cp_inverse_cloud_gives_source_fibre_density
    (Y : Set Plane) (hY : HasFLC Y)
    (φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (n : RationalNormal)
    (hker : Module.finrank ℝ (normalDirection n) = 1) (b : ℝ) (ρ M : ℝ)
    (hImageFLC : HasFLC (deformPoint φ '' Y))
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hM : 4 * ρ < M)
    (hcloud : ∀ z : Plane, normalEval n z = b →
      ∃ y ∈ deformPoint φ '' Y, normalEval n y = b ∧ dist z y < ρ)
    (hcoarse : ∀ x ∈ Y, ∀ y ∈ Y,
      dist (deformPoint φ x) (deformPoint φ y) < M / 2 → dist x y < M)
    (hreflect : ∀ x ∈ Y, ∀ y ∈ Y,
      dist (deformPoint φ x) (deformPoint φ y) < M / 2 →
        (normalEval n (deformPoint φ x - deformPoint φ y) = 0 ↔
          normalEval n (x - y) = 0))
    (hvector : ∀ x ∈ Y, ∀ y ∈ Y, x ≠ y → dist x y < M →
      ‖deformPoint φ (x - y) - (x - y)‖ < ‖x - y‖) :
    ∃ a ∈ Y, normalEval n (deformPoint φ a) = b ∧
      ∀ z : Plane, normalEval n z = normalEval n a →
        ∃ w ∈ Y, normalEval n w = normalEval n a ∧ dist z w < M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ψ := cp_rationalNormalFunctional n
  have hψeval (x : Plane) : ψ x = normalEval n x := cp_rationalNormalFunctional_eq_eval n x
  have hkerψ : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker ψ) = 1 := by
    change Module.finrank ℝ (normalDirection n) = 1
    exact hker
  obtain ⟨e, τ, he, hψe, hτe, hrep⟩ :=
    cp_exists_unit_kernel_coordinate ψ hkerψ
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := cp_rationalNormalFunctional_surjective n b
  have hx₀level : ψ x₀ = b := by simpa [ψ] using hx₀
  let B : Set Plane := {y | y ∈ deformPoint φ '' Y ∧ ψ y = b}
  let U : Set ℝ := (fun y : Plane => τ (y - x₀)) '' B
  have hUfinite : ∀ a c : ℝ, (U ∩ Set.Icc a c).Finite := by
    intro a c
    let R : ℝ := max |a| |c|
    let Q : Set Plane := Metric.closedBall x₀ (R + 1)
    have hQbounded : Bornology.IsBounded Q := Metric.isBounded_closedBall
    have hImgFinite : ((deformPoint φ '' Y) ∩ Q).Finite := hImageFLC.1 Q hQbounded
    have hcoord_image :
        (U ∩ Set.Icc a c) ⊆ (fun y : Plane => τ (y - x₀)) ''
          (B ∩ Q) := by
      rintro t ⟨⟨y, hyB, rfl⟩, hta, htc⟩
      have hycoord : y = x₀ + (τ (y - x₀)) • e := by
        apply cp_affine_level_eq_kernel_coordinate (ψ := ψ)
