:=
  denseRange_rationalPlanePoint.exists_mem_open hU hne

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.foldl_min_le_acc
statement: private theorem foldl_min_le_acc (xs : List ℤ) (a : ℤ) : xs.foldl min a ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing a with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b bs ih =>
      exact (ih (min a b)).trans (min_le_left a b)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.foldl_min_le_of_mem
statement:
private theorem foldl_min_le_of_mem {xs : List ℤ} {x : ℤ} (hx : x ∈ xs) (a : ℤ) :
    xs.foldl min a ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing a with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons b bs ih =>
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at hx
      rw [List.foldl_cons]
      rcases hx with rfl | hx
      · exact (foldl_min_le_acc bs (min a x)).trans (min_le_right a x)
      · exact ih hx (min a b)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.le_foldl_max_acc
statement: private theorem le_foldl_max_acc (xs : List ℤ) (a : ℤ) : a ≤ xs.foldl max a
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing a with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b bs ih =>
      exact (le_max_left a b).trans (ih (max a b))

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.le_foldl_max_of_mem
statement:
private theorem le_foldl_max_of_mem {xs : List ℤ} {x : ℤ} (hx : x ∈ xs) (a : ℤ) :
    x ≤ xs.foldl max a
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing a with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons b bs ih =>
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at hx
      rw [List.foldl_cons]
      rcases hx with rfl | hx
      · exact (le_max_right a x).trans (le_foldl_max_acc bs (max a x))
      · exact ih hx (max a b)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.convex_re_Icc
statement:
private theorem convex_re_Icc (lo hi : ℝ) :
    Convex ℝ {p : Plane | lo ≤ p.re ∧ p.re ≤ hi}
proof:
:= by
  rw [convex_iff_add_mem]
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  change lo ≤ x.re ∧ x.re ≤ hi at hx
  change lo ≤ y.re ∧ y.re ≤ hi at hy
  change lo ≤ (a • x + b • y).re ∧ (a • x + b • y).re ≤ hi
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
  constructor
  · calc
      lo = a * lo + b * lo := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
      _ ≤ a * x.re + b * y.re :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.1 ha) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy.1 hb)
  · calc
      a * x.re + b * y.re ≤ a * hi + b * hi :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.2 ha) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy.2 hb)
      _ = hi := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.convex_im_Icc
statement:
private theorem convex_im_Icc (lo hi : ℝ) :
    Convex ℝ {p : Plane | lo ≤ p.im ∧ p.im ≤ hi}
proof:
:= by
  rw [convex_iff_add_mem]
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  change lo ≤ x.im ∧ x.im ≤ hi at hx
  change lo ≤ y.im ∧ y.im ≤ hi at hy
  change lo ≤ (a • x + b • y).im ∧ (a • x + b • y).im ≤ hi
  simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
  constructor
  · calc
      lo = a * lo + b * lo := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
      _ ≤ a * x.im + b * y.im :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.1 ha) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy.1 hb)
  · calc
      a * x.im + b * y.im ≤ a * hi + b * hi :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.2 ha) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy.2 hb)
      _ = hi := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.ZTriangle.re_bounds_of_mem_carrier
statement:
private theorem ZTriangle.re_bounds_of_mem_carrier {t : ZTriangle} {p : Plane} {lo hi : ℤ}
    (haLo : lo ≤ t.a.x) (hbLo : lo ≤ t.b.x) (hcLo : lo ≤ t.c.x)
    (haHi : t.a.x ≤ hi) (hbHi : t.b.x ≤ hi) (hcHi : t.c.x ≤ hi)
    (hp : p ∈ t.carrier) :
    (lo : ℝ) ≤ p.re ∧ p.re ≤ (hi : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply convexHull_min _ (convex_re_Icc (lo : ℝ) (hi : ℝ)) hp
  intro q hq
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hq
  rcases hq with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · have h : (lo : ℝ) ≤ (t.a.x : ℝ) ∧ (t.a.x : ℝ) ≤ (hi : ℝ) := by
      constructor
      · exact_mod_cast haLo
      · exact_mod_cast haHi
    simpa [ZPoint.toPlane] using h
  · have h : (lo : ℝ) ≤ (t.b.x : ℝ) ∧ (t.b.x : ℝ) ≤ (hi : ℝ) := by
      constructor
      · exact_mod_cast hbLo
      · exact_mod_cast hbHi
    simpa [ZPoint.toPlane] using h
  · have h : (lo : ℝ) ≤ (t.c.x : ℝ) ∧ (t.c.x : ℝ) ≤ (hi : ℝ) := by
      constructor
      · exact_mod_cast hcLo
      · exact_mod_cast hcHi
    simpa [ZPoint.toPlane] using h

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.ZTriangle.im_bounds_of_mem_carrier
statement:
private theorem ZTriangle.im_bounds_of_mem_carrier {t : ZTriangle} {p : Plane} {lo hi : ℤ}
    (haLo : lo ≤ t.a.y) (hbLo : lo ≤ t.b.y) (hcLo : lo ≤ t.c.y)
    (haHi : t.a.y ≤ hi) (hbHi : t.b.y ≤ hi) (hcHi : t.c.y ≤ hi)
    (hp : p ∈ t.carrier) :
    (lo : ℝ) ≤ p.im ∧ p.im ≤ (hi : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply convexHull_min _ (convex_im_Icc (lo : ℝ) (hi : ℝ)) hp
  intro q hq
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hq
  rcases hq with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · have h : (lo : ℝ) ≤ (t.a.y : ℝ) ∧ (t.a.y : ℝ) ≤ (hi : ℝ) := by
      constructor
      · exact_mod_cast haLo
      · exact_mod_cast haHi
    simpa [ZPoint.toPlane] using h
  · have h : (lo : ℝ) ≤ (t.b.y : ℝ) ∧ (t.b.y : ℝ) ≤ (hi : ℝ) := by
      constructor
      · exact_mod_cast hbLo
      · exact_mod_cast hbHi
    simpa [ZPoint.toPlane] using h
  · have h : (lo : ℝ) ≤ (t.c.y : ℝ) ∧ (t.c.y : ℝ) ≤ (hi : ℝ) := by
      constructor
      · exact_mod_cast hcLo
      · exact_mod_cast hcHi
    simpa [ZPoint.toPlane] using h

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.ZTriangle.coordinate_bounds_of_mem
statement:
theorem ZTriangle.coordinate_bounds_of_mem {ts : List ZTriangle} {t : ZTriangle} {p : Plane}
    (ht : t ∈ ts) (hp : p ∈ t.carrier) :
    ((minCoord (xCoordinates ts) : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ p.re ∧
      p.re ≤ ((maxCoord (xCoordinates ts) : ℤ) : ℝ) ∧
      ((minCoord (yCoordinates ts) : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ p.im ∧
      p.im ≤ ((maxCoord (yCoordinates ts) : ℤ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hax : t.a.x ∈ xCoordinates ts := by
    simp only [xCoordinates, List.mem_flatMap]
    exact ⟨t, ht, by simp⟩
  have hbx : t.b.x ∈ xCoordinates ts := by
    simp only [xCoordinates, List.mem_flatMap]
    exact ⟨t, ht, by simp⟩
  have hcx : t.c.x ∈ xCoordinates ts := by
    simp only [xCoordinates, List.mem_flatMap]
    exact ⟨t, ht, by simp⟩
  have hay : t.a.y ∈ yCoordinates ts := by
    simp only [yCoordinates, List.mem_flatMap]
    exact ⟨t, ht, by simp⟩
  have hby : t.b.y ∈ yCoordinates ts := by
    simp only [yCoordinates, List.mem_flatMap]
    exact ⟨t, ht, by simp⟩
  have hcy : t.c.y ∈ yCoordinates ts := by
    simp only [yCoordinates, List.mem_flatMap]
    exact ⟨t, ht, by simp⟩
  have hx := ZTriangle.re_bounds_of_mem_carrier
    (foldl_min_le_of_mem hax 0) (foldl_min_le_of_mem hbx 0)
    (foldl_min_le_of_mem hcx 0) (le_foldl_max_of_mem hax 0)
    (le_foldl_max_of_mem hbx 0) (le_foldl_max_of_mem hcx 0) hp
  have hy := ZTriangle.im_bounds_of_mem_carrier
    (foldl_min_le_of_mem hay 0) (foldl_min_le_of_mem hby 0)
    (foldl_min_le_of_mem hcy 0) (le_foldl_max_of_mem hay 0)
    (le_foldl_max_of_mem hby 0) (le_foldl_max_of_mem hcy 0) hp
  exact ⟨hx.1, hx.2, hy.1, hy.2⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_offsetWindow_iff
statement:
theorem mem_offsetWindow_iff {ts : List ZTriangle} {z : ZPoint} :
    z ∈ offsetWindow ts ↔
      minCoord (xCoordinates ts) - 1 ≤ z.x ∧
      z.x ≤ maxCoord (xCoordinates ts) ∧
      minCoord (yCoordinates ts) - 1 ≤ z.y ∧
      z.y ≤ maxCoord (yCoordinates ts)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [offsetWindow, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, mem_intRange_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩
    cases hxy
    exact ⟨hx.1, hx.2, hy.1, hy.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hxLo, hxHi, hyLo, hyHi⟩
    exact ⟨z.x, ⟨hxLo, hxHi⟩, z.y, ⟨hyLo, hyHi⟩, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.intRange_nodup
statement: private theorem intRange_nodup (lo hi : ℤ) : (intRange lo hi).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intRange]
  split
  · apply List.Nodup.map _ List.nodup_range
    intro n m h
    have hcast : (n : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) := add_left_cancel h
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  · exact List.nodup_nil

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.offsetWindow_nodup
statement: theorem offsetWindow_nodup (ts : List ZTriangle) : (offsetWindow ts).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  rw [offsetWindow, List.nodup_flatMap]
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    exact (intRange_nodup _ _).map fun y y' h => by
      injection h
  · exact (intRange_nodup _ _).imp fun {x x'} hxx' p hp hp' => by
      obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hp
      obtain ⟨y', hy', hEq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hp'
      exact hxx' (congrArg ZPoint.x hEq.symm)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.add_integerPoint_toIntegerPlane_re
statement:
private theorem add_integerPoint_toIntegerPlane_re (u : Plane) (z : ZPoint) :
    (u + integerPoint z.toIntegerPlane).re = u.re + z.x
proof:
:= by
  simp [ZPoint.toIntegerPlane]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.add_integerPoint_toIntegerPlane_im
statement:
private theorem add_integerPoint_toIntegerPlane_im (u : Plane) (z : ZPoint) :
    (u + integerPoint z.toIntegerPlane).im = u.im + z.y
proof:
:= by
  simp [ZPoint.toIntegerPlane]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_offsetWindow_of_add_mem_triangleUnion
statement:
theorem mem_offsetWindow_of_add_mem_triangleUnion {ts : List ZTriangle} {u : Plane} {z : ZPoint}
    (huRe : u.re ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (huIm : u.im ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hmem : u + integerPoint z.toIntegerPlane ∈ ⋃ t ∈ ts.toFinset, t.carrier) :
    z ∈ offsetWindow ts
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hp⟩ := hmem
  have htList : t ∈ ts := by simpa only [List.mem_toFinset] using ht
  obtain ⟨hxLo, hxHi, hyLo, hyHi⟩ := ZTriangle.coordinate_bounds_of_mem htList hp
  rw [add_integerPoint_toIntegerPlane_re] at hxLo hxHi
  rw [add_integerPoint_toIntegerPlane_im] at hyLo hyHi
  rw [mem_offsetWindow_iff]
  constructor
  · have hreal : ((minCoord (xCoordinates ts) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (z.x : ℝ) := by
      rw [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_one]
      linarith [huRe.2]
    exact_mod_cast hreal
  · constructor
    · have hreal : (z.x : ℝ) ≤ (maxCoord (xCoordinates ts) : ℝ) := by
        linarith [huRe.1]
      exact_mod_cast hreal
    · constructor
      · have hreal : ((minCoord (yCoordinates ts) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (z.y : ℝ) := by
          rw [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_one]
          linarith [huIm.2]
        exact_mod_cast hreal
      · have hreal : (z.y : ℝ) ≤ (maxCoord (yCoordinates ts) : ℝ) := by
          linarith [huIm.1]
        exact_mod_cast hreal

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.add_not_mem_triangleUnion_of_not_mem_offsetWindow
statement:
theorem add_not_mem_triangleUnion_of_not_mem_offsetWindow {ts : List ZTriangle} {u : Plane}
    {z : ZPoint} (huRe : u.re ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (huIm : u.im ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hz : z ∉ offsetWindow ts) :
    u + integerPoint z.toIntegerPlane ∉ ⋃ t ∈ ts.toFinset, t.carrier
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  exact hz (mem_offsetWindow_of_add_mem_triangleUnion huRe huIm hmem)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_offsetWindow_of_add_mem_triangleUnion_closedUnitCell
statement:
theorem mem_offsetWindow_of_add_mem_triangleUnion_closedUnitCell {ts : List ZTriangle}
    {u : Plane} {z : ZPoint} (hu : u ∈ closedUnitCell)
    (hmem : u + integerPoint z.toIntegerPlane ∈ ⋃ t ∈ ts.toFinset, t.carrier) :
    z ∈ offsetWindow ts
proof:
:= by
  rw [closedUnitCell] at hu
  change (u.re, u.im) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 at hu
  exact mem_offsetWindow_of_add_mem_triangleUnion hu.1 hu.2 hmem

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.add_not_mem_triangleUnion_of_not_mem_offsetWindow_closedUnitCell
statement:
theorem add_not_mem_triangleUnion_of_not_mem_offsetWindow_closedUnitCell
    {ts : List ZTriangle} {u : Plane} {z : ZPoint} (hu : u ∈ closedUnitCell)
    (hz : z ∉ offsetWindow ts) :
    u + integerPoint z.toIntegerPlane ∉ ⋃ t ∈ ts.toFinset, t.carrier
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  exact hz (mem_offsetWindow_of_add_mem_triangleUnion_closedUnitCell hu hmem)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.normalizedRegion_support_eq_list_iUnion
statement:
theorem normalizedRegion_support_eq_list_iUnion (P : Code.Input) :

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_offsetWindow_of_add_mem_normalizedSupport
statement:
theorem mem_offsetWindow_of_add_mem_normalizedSupport (P : Code.Input) {u : Plane} {z : ZPoint}
    (huRe : u.re ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (huIm : u.im ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hmem : u + integerPoint z.toIntegerPlane ∈

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.add_not_mem_normalizedSupport_of_not_mem_offsetWindow
statement:
theorem add_not_mem_normalizedSupport_of_not_mem_offsetWindow (P : Code.Input) {u : Plane}
    {z : ZPoint} (huRe : u.re ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (huIm : u.im ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hz : z ∉ offsetWindow (normalizedTriangles P)) :

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_offsetWindow_of_add_mem_normalizedSupport_closedUnitCell
statement:
theorem mem_offsetWindow_of_add_mem_normalizedSupport_closedUnitCell (P : Code.Input)
    {u : Plane} {z : ZPoint} (hu : u ∈ closedUnitCell)
    (hmem : u + integerPoint z.toIntegerPlane ∈
      P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion.support) :

  exact mem_offsetWindow_of_add_mem_triangleUnion_closedUnitCell hu hmem

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.ZLine.volume_zeroSet
statement:
theorem ZLine.volume_zeroSet (l : ZLine) (hnonzero : l.A ≠ 0 ∨ l.B ≠ 0) :
    volume l.zeroSet = 0
proof:
:=
  volume_lineZeroSet hnonzero

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.volume_exceptionalSet
statement:
theorem volume_exceptionalSet (ls : List ZLine)
    (hnonzero : ∀ l ∈ ls, l.A ≠ 0 ∨ l.B ≠ 0) :
    volume (exceptionalSet ls) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold exceptionalSet
  apply measure_biUnion_null_iff ls.toFinset.countable_toSet |>.2
  intro l hl
  exact l.volume_zeroSet (hnonzero l (List.mem_toFinset.mp hl))

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.edgeLine_coefficients_ne_zero
statement:
theorem edgeLine_coefficients_ne_zero {z p q : ZPoint} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    (edgeLine z p q).A ≠ 0 ∨ (edgeLine z p q).B ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hpq
  cases p with
  | mk px py =>
      cases q with
      | mk qx qy =>
          simp only [edgeLine] at hpq
          congr <;> omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.isOpen_realCell
statement: theorem isOpen_realCell (qs : List StrictInequality) : IsOpen (realCell qs)
proof:
:= by
  induction qs with
  | nil => rw [realCell_nil]; exact isOpen_univ
  | cons q qs ih =>
      rw [realCell_cons]
      apply IsOpen.inter _ ih
      apply isOpen_lt
      · fun_prop
      · fun_prop

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.satisfiesPlane_sampleToPlane_iff
statement:
theorem satisfiesPlane_sampleToPlane_iff (q : StrictInequality) (p : ℚ × ℚ) :
    satisfiesPlane q (sampleToPlane p) ↔ q.Satisfies p
proof:
:= by

    StrictInequality.Satisfies]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_realCell_sampleToPlane_iff
statement:
theorem mem_realCell_sampleToPlane_iff (qs : List StrictInequality) (p : ℚ × ℚ) :
    sampleToPlane p ∈ realCell qs ↔ SatisfiesAll qs p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h q hq
    exact (satisfiesPlane_sampleToPlane_iff q p).mp (h q hq)
  · intro h q hq
    exact (satisfiesPlane_sampleToPlane_iff q p).mpr (h q hq)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.sideConstraint_true_satisfiesPlane_iff
statement:
theorem sideConstraint_true_satisfiesPlane_iff (l : ZLine) (u : Plane) :

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.sideConstraint_false_satisfiesPlane_iff

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_refineCell_cellOfSystem
statement:
private theorem mem_refineCell_cellOfSystem {l : ZLine} {parent child : SignCell}
    (hchild : child ∈ refineCell l parent) :
    cellOfSystem? (sideConstraint false l :: parent.system) = some child ∨
      cellOfSystem? (sideConstraint true l :: parent.system) = some child
proof:
:= by
  simp only [refineCell, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_cons] at hchild
  obtain ⟨o, ho, hid⟩ := hchild
  rcases ho with ho | ho
  · subst o
    exact Or.inl hid
  · rcases ho with ho | ho
    · subst o
      exact Or.inr hid
    · simp only [List.not_mem_nil] at ho

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_refineCell_sound
proof:
:= by
  rcases mem_refineCell_cellOfSystem hchild with hfalse | htrue
  · obtain ⟨hsystem, hsat⟩ := cellOfSystem_sound hfalse
    rw [hsystem]
    exact hsat
  · obtain ⟨hsystem, hsat⟩ := cellOfSystem_sound htrue
    rw [hsystem]
    exact hsat

  · rw [htrue]
    exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.controls_refineCell
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rw [List.mem_append] at hk
  rcases hk with hk | hk
  · rcases hcontrols k hk with hfalse | htrue
    · exact Or.inl (mem_system_of_mem_refineCell hchild hfalse)
    · exact Or.inr (mem_system_of_mem_refineCell hchild htrue)
  · have hkl : k = l := by simpa only [List.mem_singleton] using hk
    subst k
    exact sideConstraint_mem_of_mem_refineCell hchild

proof:
:= by
  induction todo generalizing done cells with
  | nil => simpa only [refineLines, List.foldl_nil, List.append_nil] using hcontrols
  | cons l todo ih =>
      rw [refineLines, List.foldl_cons]
      intro child hchild
      have hnext := ih (done := done ++ [l])
        (controls_refineCells (l := l) hcontrols) child hchild
      simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using hnext

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.feasibleSignCells_controls
statement:
theorem feasibleSignCells_controls {ls : List ZLine} {cell : SignCell}

proof:
:= by
  unfold feasibleSignCells at hcell
  split at hcell
  · simp only [List.not_mem_nil] at hcell
  · rename_i base hbase
    have h := refineLines_controls_aux (done := []) (todo := ls) (cells := [base])
      (by intro c hc; simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hc; subst c; intro l hl; simp at hl)
      cell hcell
    simpa only [List.nil_append] using h

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.refineCells_sound
statement:
theorem refineCells_sound {l : ZLine} {cells : List SignCell}
    : ∀ child ∈ refineCells l cells, SatisfiesAll child.system child.sample
proof:

proof:

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.feasibleSignCell_open_nonempty_measure_ne_zero
statement:
theorem feasibleSignCell_open_nonempty_measure_ne_zero {ls : List ZLine} {cell : SignCell}
    (hcell : cell ∈ feasibleSignCells ls) :
    IsOpen (realCell cell.system) ∧ (realCell cell.system).Nonempty ∧
      volume (realCell cell.system) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsample : sampleToPlane cell.sample ∈ realCell cell.system :=
    (mem_realCell_sampleToPlane_iff cell.system cell.sample).mpr
      (feasibleSignCells_sound hcell)
  have hopen := isOpen_realCell cell.system
  exact ⟨hopen, ⟨sampleToPlane cell.sample, hsample⟩,
    hopen.measure_ne_zero volume ⟨sampleToPlane cell.sample, hsample⟩⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.evalPlane_pos_iff_of_mem_realCell
proof:
:= by
  rcases feasibleSignCells_controls hcell l hl with hfalse | htrue
  · have huNeg := (sideConstraint_false_satisfiesPlane_iff l u).mp (hu _ hfalse)
    have hvNeg := (sideConstraint_false_satisfiesPlane_iff l v).mp (hv _ hfalse)
    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
  · have huPos := (sideConstraint_true_satisfiesPlane_iff l u).mp (hu _ htrue)
    have hvPos := (sideConstraint_true_satisfiesPlane_iff l v).mp (hv _ htrue)
    exact iff_of_true huPos hvPos

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.sameStrictSign_of_mem_realCell
proof:
:= by
  rcases feasibleSignCells_controls hcell l hl with hfalse | htrue
  · exact Or.inr ⟨(sideConstraint_false_satisfiesPlane_iff l u).mp (hu _ hfalse),
      (sideConstraint_false_satisfiesPlane_iff l v).mp (hv _ hfalse)⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨(sideConstraint_true_satisfiesPlane_iff l u).mp (hu _ htrue),
      (sideConstraint_true_satisfiesPlane_iff l v).mp (hv _ htrue)⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.supportedBy_refineCell
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  rcases mem_refineCell_system hchild with hfalse | htrue
  · rw [hfalse] at hq
    simp only [List.mem_cons] at hq
    rcases hq with rfl | hq
    · exact Or.inr ⟨l, by simp, Or.inl rfl⟩
    · rcases hparent q hq with hunit | ⟨k, hk, hside⟩
      · exact Or.inl hunit
      · exact Or.inr ⟨k, List.mem_append_left _ hk, hside⟩
  · rw [htrue] at hq
    simp only [List.mem_cons] at hq
    rcases hq with rfl | hq
    · exact Or.inr ⟨l, by simp, Or.inr rfl⟩
    · rcases hparent q hq with hunit | ⟨k, hk, hside⟩
      · exact Or.inl hunit
      · exact Or.inr ⟨k, List.mem_append_left _ hk, hside⟩

  | cons l todo ih =>

      intro child hchild
      have hnext := ih (done := done ++ [l]) (supportedBy_refineCells hparent) child hchild
      simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using hnext

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.feasibleSignCells_supportedBy
statement:
theorem feasibleSignCells_supportedBy {ls : List ZLine} {cell : SignCell}
    (hcell : cell ∈ feasibleSignCells ls) : SupportedBy ls cell
proof:
:= by
  unfold feasibleSignCells at hcell
  split at hcell
  · simp only [List.not_mem_nil] at hcell
  · rename_i base hbase
    have hbaseSystem := (cellOfSystem_sound hbase).1
    have h := refineLines_supportedBy_aux (done := []) (todo := ls) (cells := [base])
      (by
        intro c hc
        simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hc
        subst c
        intro q hq
        rw [hbaseSystem] at hq
        exact Or.inl hq)
      cell hcell
    simpa only [List.nil_append] using h

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_realCell_signSystemAt
statement:
theorem mem_realCell_signSystemAt {ls : List ZLine} {u : Plane}
    (hunit : u ∈ realCell openUnitSquare)
    (hoff : ∀ l ∈ ls, l.evalPlane u ≠ 0) :
    u ∈ realCell (signSystemAt ls u)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  rw [signSystemAt, List.mem_append] at hq
  rcases hq with hq | hq
  · exact hunit q hq
  · rw [List.mem_map] at hq
    obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := hq
    unfold sideConstraintAt
    by_cases hpos : 0 < l.evalPlane u
    · rw [if_pos hpos]
      exact (sideConstraint_true_satisfiesPlane_iff l u).mpr hpos
    · rw [if_neg hpos]
      apply (sideConstraint_false_satisfiesPlane_iff l u).mpr
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hoff l hl)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.exists_feasibleSignCell_containing_real_point
statement:
theorem exists_feasibleSignCell_containing_real_point {ls : List ZLine} {u : Plane}
    (hunit : u ∈ realCell openUnitSquare)
    (hoff : ∀ l ∈ ls, l.evalPlane u ≠ 0) :
    ∃ cell ∈ feasibleSignCells ls, u ∈ realCell cell.system
proof:
:= by
  have huSign : u ∈ realCell (signSystemAt ls u) :=
    mem_realCell_signSystemAt hunit hoff
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_rational_point_mem
    (isOpen_realCell (signSystemAt ls u)) ⟨u, huSign⟩
  have hsampleEq : rationalPlanePoint p = sampleToPlane p := by
    rw [rationalPlanePoint_eq]
    rfl
  rw [hsampleEq, mem_realCell_sampleToPlane_iff] at hp
  have hpunit : SatisfiesAll openUnitSquare p := by
    intro q hq
    exact hp q (by exact List.mem_append_left _ hq)
  have hpOff : ∀ l ∈ ls, l.eval p ≠ 0 := by
    intro l hl
    have hselected : sideConstraintAt u l ∈ signSystemAt ls u := by
      rw [signSystemAt, List.mem_append]
      exact Or.inr (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩)
    have hpSelected := hp _ hselected
    unfold sideConstraintAt at hpSelected
    by_cases hpos : 0 < l.evalPlane u
    · rw [if_pos hpos] at hpSelected
      exact ne_of_gt ((sideConstraint_true_satisfies_iff l p).mp hpSelected)
    · rw [if_neg hpos] at hpSelected
      exact ne_of_lt ((sideConstraint_false_satisfies_iff l p).mp hpSelected)
  obtain ⟨cell, hcell, hpCell⟩ := feasibleSignCells_complete hpunit hpOff
  refine ⟨cell, hcell, ?_⟩
  intro q hq
  rcases feasibleSignCells_supportedBy hcell q hq with hqUnit | ⟨l, hl, hside⟩
  · exact hunit q hqUnit
  · rcases hside with rfl | rfl
    · apply (sideConstraint_false_satisfiesPlane_iff l u).mpr
      have hpNeg := (sideConstraint_false_satisfies_iff l p).mp (hpCell _ hq)
      have hselected : sideConstraintAt u l ∈ signSystemAt ls u := by
        rw [signSystemAt, List.mem_append]
        exact Or.inr (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩)
      have hpSelected := hp _ hselected
      unfold sideConstraintAt at hpSelected
      by_cases hpos : 0 < l.evalPlane u
      · rw [if_pos hpos] at hpSelected
        have hpPos := (sideConstraint_true_satisfies_iff l p).mp hpSelected
        exact (lt_asymm hpNeg hpPos).elim
      · exact lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hoff l hl)
    · apply (sideConstraint_true_satisfiesPlane_iff l u).mpr
      have hpPos := (sideConstraint_true_satisfies_iff l p).mp (hpCell _ hq)
      have hselected : sideConstraintAt u l ∈ signSystemAt ls u := by
        rw [signSystemAt, List.mem_append]
        exact Or.inr (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩)
      have hpSelected := hp _ hselected
      unfold sideConstraintAt at hpSelected
      by_cases hpos : 0 < l.evalPlane u
      · exact hpos
      · rw [if_neg hpos] at hpSelected
        have hpNeg := (sideConstraint_false_satisfies_iff l p).mp hpSelected
        exact (lt_asymm hpNeg hpPos).elim

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.arrangementLine_coefficients_ne_zero
statement:
theorem arrangementLine_coefficients_ne_zero {ts : List ZTriangle}
    (harea : ∀ t ∈ ts,
      twiceAreaQ (zpointQ t.a) (zpointQ t.b) (zpointQ t.c) ≠ 0)
    {l : ZLine} (hl : l ∈ arrangementLines ts) : l.A ≠ 0 ∨ l.B ≠ 0
proof:

  obtain ⟨z, _hz, hl⟩ := hl

  obtain ⟨t, ht, hl⟩ := hl
  simp only [translatedEdgeLines, List.mem_cons] at hl
  rcases hl with rfl | hl
  · exact edgeLine_coefficients_ne_zero (first_edge_ne_of_twiceAreaQ_ne_zero (harea t ht))
  · rcases hl with rfl | hl
    · exact edgeLine_coefficients_ne_zero (second_edge_ne_of_twiceAreaQ_ne_zero (harea t ht))
    · rcases hl with rfl | hl
      · exact edgeLine_coefficients_ne_zero (third_edge_ne_of_twiceAreaQ_ne_zero (harea t ht))

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.pointInRegion_sample_iff_mem_triangleUnion
statement:
theorem pointInRegion_sample_iff_mem_triangleUnion
    {ts : List ZTriangle}
    (harea : ∀ t ∈ ts,
      twiceAreaQ (zpointQ t.a) (zpointQ t.b) (zpointQ t.c) ≠ 0)
    {cell : SignCell} (hcell : cell ∈ feasibleSignCells (arrangementLines ts))
    {u : Plane} (hu : u ∈ realCell cell.system)
    {z : ZPoint} (hz : z ∈ offsetWindow ts) :
    pointInRegion ts (addOffset cell.sample z) = true ↔
      u + integerPoint z.toIntegerPlane ∈ triangleUnion ts
proof:
:= by
  have hsample : sampleToPlane cell.sample ∈ realCell cell.system :=
    (mem_realCell_sampleToPlane_iff cell.system cell.sample).mpr
      (feasibleSignCells_sound hcell)
  rw [pointInRegion, List.any_eq_true, mem_triangleUnion_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, hpoint⟩
    refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
    apply (mem_carrier_iff_pointInTriangle_of_same_strict_edge_signs
      (harea t ht) ?_ ?_ ?_).mpr hpoint
    · have hsign := sameStrictSign_of_mem_realCell hcell hu hsample
        (edgeLine_first_mem_arrangementLines hz ht)
      rwa [ZLine.evalPlane_sampleToPlane] at hsign
    · have hsign := sameStrictSign_of_mem_realCell hcell hu hsample
        (edgeLine_second_mem_arrangementLines hz ht)
      rwa [ZLine.evalPlane_sampleToPlane] at hsign
    · have hsign := sameStrictSign_of_mem_realCell hcell hu hsample
        (edgeLine_third_mem_arrangementLines hz ht)
      rwa [ZLine.evalPlane_sampleToPlane] at hsign
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, hmem⟩
    refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
    apply (mem_carrier_iff_pointInTriangle_of_same_strict_edge_signs
      (harea t ht) ?_ ?_ ?_).mp hmem
    · have hsign := sameStrictSign_of_mem_realCell hcell hu hsample
        (edgeLine_first_mem_arrangementLines hz ht)
      rwa [ZLine.evalPlane_sampleToPlane] at hsign
    · have hsign := sameStrictSign_of_mem_realCell hcell hu hsample
        (edgeLine_second_mem_arrangementLines hz ht)
      rwa [ZLine.evalPlane_sampleToPlane] at hsign
    · have hsign := sameStrictSign_of_mem_realCell hcell hu hsample
        (edgeLine_third_mem_arrangementLines hz ht)
      rwa [ZLine.evalPlane_sampleToPlane] at hsign

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.ZPoint.toIntegerPlane_injective
statement: theorem ZPoint.toIntegerPlane_injective : Function.Injective ZPoint.toIntegerPlane
proof:
:= by
  intro p q h
  cases p with
  | mk px py =>
      cases q with
      | mk qx qy =>
          apply congrArg (fun v : IntegerPlane => (v 0, v 1)) at h
          simpa [ZPoint.toIntegerPlane] using h

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_sampleSignature_iff_mem_triangleUnion
statement:
theorem mem_sampleSignature_iff_mem_triangleUnion
    {ts : List ZTriangle}
    (harea : ∀ t ∈ ts,
      twiceAreaQ (zpointQ t.a) (zpointQ t.b) (zpointQ t.c) ≠ 0)
    {cell : SignCell} (hcell : cell ∈ feasibleSignCells (arrangementLines ts))
    {u : Plane} (hu : u ∈ realCell cell.system) {z : ZPoint} :
    z.toIntegerPlane ∈ sampleSignature ts (offsetWindow ts) cell.sample ↔
      z ∈ offsetWindow ts ∧
        u + integerPoint z.toIntegerPlane ∈ triangleUnion ts
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sampleSignature, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩
    have hwEq : w = z := ZPoint.toIntegerPlane_injective hwz
    subst w
    obtain ⟨hz, hpoint⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hw
    exact ⟨hz,
      (pointInRegion_sample_iff_mem_triangleUnion harea hcell hu hz).mp hpoint⟩
  · rintro ⟨hz, hmem⟩
    refine ⟨z, List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hz, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    exact (pointInRegion_sample_iff_mem_triangleUnion harea hcell hu hz).mpr hmem

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.openUnitSquare_subset_feasibleSignCell_system
proof:
:= by
  unfold feasibleSignCells at hcell
  split at hcell
  · simp only [List.not_mem_nil] at hcell
  · rename_i base hbase
    intro q hq
    apply refineLines_preserves_constraint (ls := ls) _ cell hcell
    intro c hc
    simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hc

    rw [(cellOfSystem_sound hbase).1]
    exact hq

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_realCell_openUnitSquare_iff
statement:
theorem mem_realCell_openUnitSquare_iff {u : Plane} :
    u ∈ realCell openUnitSquare ↔
      0 < u.re ∧ u.re < 1 ∧ 0 < u.im ∧ u.im < 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [realCell, openUnitSquare, List.mem_cons, satisfiesPlane]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using h ⟨-1, 0, 0⟩ (by simp)
    · simpa using h ⟨1, 0, 1⟩ (by simp)
    · simpa using h ⟨0, -1, 0⟩ (by simp)
    · simpa using h ⟨0, 1, 1⟩ (by simp)
  · rintro ⟨hx0, hx1, hy0, hy1⟩ q hq
    rcases hq with rfl | hq
    · norm_num
      linarith
    · rcases hq with rfl | hq
      · norm_num
        linarith
      · rcases hq with rfl | hq
        · norm_num
          linarith
        · rcases hq with rfl | hq
          · norm_num
            linarith
          · simp only [List.not_mem_nil] at hq

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.realCell_subset_closedUnitCell
statement:
theorem realCell_subset_closedUnitCell {ls : List ZLine} {cell : SignCell}
    (hcell : cell ∈ feasibleSignCells ls) : realCell cell.system ⊆ closedUnitCell
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  have hunit : u ∈ realCell openUnitSquare := by
    intro q hq
    exact hu q (openUnitSquare_subset_feasibleSignCell_system hcell q hq)
  have hb := mem_realCell_openUnitSquare_iff.mp hunit
  rw [closedUnitCell]
  change (u.re, u.im) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
  simp only [Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Icc]
  exact ⟨⟨hb.1.le, hb.2.1.le⟩, ⟨hb.2.2.1.le, hb.2.2.2.le⟩⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.normalizedTriangle_twiceAreaQ_ne_zero
statement:
theorem normalizedTriangle_twiceAreaQ_ne_zero (P : Code.Input) {t : QTriangle}
    (ht : t ∈ P.code.triangleFinset) :
    twiceAreaQ (zpointQ (P.normalizedTriangle t).a)
      (zpointQ (P.normalizedTriangle t).b)
      (zpointQ (P.normalizedTriangle t).c) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have ha := P.normalizedPoint_toPlane ht (by simp [QTriangle.vertices] : t.a ∈ t.vertices)
  have hb := P.normalizedPoint_toPlane ht (by simp [QTriangle.vertices] : t.b ∈ t.vertices)
  have hc := P.normalizedPoint_toPlane ht (by simp [QTriangle.vertices] : t.c ∈ t.vertices)
  have hD : (P.denominator : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt P.denominator_pos)
  have hscale :
      twiceSignedArea (P.normalizedPoint t.a).toPlane
        (P.normalizedPoint t.b).toPlane (P.normalizedPoint t.c).toPlane =
        (P.denominator : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          twiceSignedArea t.a.toPlane t.b.toPlane t.c.toPlane := by
    rw [ha, hb, hc]
    simp only [twiceSignedArea, Complex.smul_re, Complex.sub_re, QPoint.toPlane_re,
      Complex.smul_im, Complex.sub_im, QPoint.toPlane_im, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  intro hzero
  have hzeroReal :
      ((twiceAreaQ (zpointQ (P.normalizedTriangle t).a)
        (zpointQ (P.normalizedTriangle t).b)
        (zpointQ (P.normalizedTriangle t).c) : ℚ) : ℝ) = 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast hzero
  rw [twiceAreaQ_zpointQ_cast] at hzeroReal
  change twiceSignedArea (P.normalizedPoint t.a).toPlane
    (P.normalizedPoint t.b).toPlane (P.normalizedPoint t.c).toPlane = 0 at hzeroReal
  rw [hscale] at hzeroReal
  exact P.valid.nondegenerate t ht (by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hD)
    simpa only [mul_zero] using hzeroReal)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.normalizedTriangles_twiceAreaQ_ne_zero
statement:
theorem normalizedTriangles_twiceAreaQ_ne_zero (P : Code.Input) :
    ∀ t ∈ normalizedTriangles P,
      twiceAreaQ (zpointQ t.a) (zpointQ t.b) (zpointQ t.c) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  rw [normalizedTriangles, List.mem_map] at ht
  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := ht
  apply normalizedTriangle_twiceAreaQ_ne_zero P
  simpa only [Code.triangleFinset, List.mem_toFinset] using hq

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.normalizedRegion_support_eq_triangleUnion
statement:
theorem normalizedRegion_support_eq_triangleUnion (P : Code.Input) :

      triangleUnion (normalizedTriangles P)
proof:

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.volume_unitBoundary
statement: theorem volume_unitBoundary : volume (exceptionalSet unitBoundaryLines) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply volume_exceptionalSet
  intro l hl
  simp only [unitBoundaryLines, List.mem_cons] at hl
  rcases hl with rfl | hl
  · exact Or.inl one_ne_zero
  · rcases hl with rfl | hl
    · exact Or.inl one_ne_zero
    · rcases hl with rfl | hl
      · exact Or.inr one_ne_zero
      · rcases hl with rfl | hl
        · exact Or.inr one_ne_zero
        · simp only [List.not_mem_nil] at hl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_exceptionalSet_of_evalPlane_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold exceptionalSet
  apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨l, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨List.mem_toFinset.mpr hl, ?_⟩⟩
  change planeEval l.A l.B l.C u = 0
  simpa only [ZLine.evalPlane, planeEval] using hu

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.volume_totalExceptionalSet
statement:
theorem volume_totalExceptionalSet {ts : List ZTriangle}
    (harea : ∀ t ∈ ts,
      twiceAreaQ (zpointQ t.a) (zpointQ t.b) (zpointQ t.c) ≠ 0) :
    volume (totalExceptionalSet ts) = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact measure_union_null (volume_exceptionalSet_arrangementLines harea) volume_unitBoundary

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.exists_mem_not_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_measure_zero
statement:
theorem exists_mem_not_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_measure_zero
    {s n : Set Plane} (hs : volume s ≠ 0) (hn : volume n = 0) :
    ∃ u ∈ s, u ∉ n
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hexists
  have hsubset : s ⊆ n := by
    intro u hu
    by_contra hun
    exact hexists ⟨u, hu, hun⟩
  exact hs (measure_mono_null hsubset hn)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.sampleSignature_eq_normalizedRegion_signature
statement:
theorem sampleSignature_eq_normalizedRegion_signature
    (P : Code.Input)
    {cell : SignCell}
    (hcell : cell ∈ feasibleSignCells (arrangementLines (normalizedTriangles P)))
    {u : Plane} (hu : u ∈ realCell cell.system) :
    sampleSignature (normalizedTriangles P) (offsetWindow (normalizedTriangles P)) cell.sample =
      P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion.signature u
proof:
:= by
  let ts := normalizedTriangles P
  have harea := normalizedTriangles_twiceAreaQ_ne_zero P
  have huClosed : u ∈ closedUnitCell := realCell_subset_closedUnitCell hcell hu
  have huBounds : u.re ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ u.im ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    rw [closedUnitCell] at huClosed
    exact huClosed
  ext q
  let z : ZPoint := ⟨q 0, q 1⟩
  have hz : z.toIntegerPlane = q := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [← hz, mem_sampleSignature_iff_mem_triangleUnion harea hcell hu]
  rw [PolygonalRegion.mem_signature_iff, normalizedRegion_support_eq_triangleUnion]
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h.2
  · intro hmem
    exact ⟨mem_offsetWindow_of_add_mem_triangleUnion huBounds.1 huBounds.2 hmem, hmem⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.sampleSignature_mem_relevantSignatures
statement:
theorem sampleSignature_mem_relevantSignatures
    (P : Code.Input) {cell : SignCell}
    (hcell : cell ∈ feasibleSignCells (arrangementLines (normalizedTriangles P))) :
    sampleSignature (normalizedTriangles P) (offsetWindow (normalizedTriangles P)) cell.sample ∈
      P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion.relevantSignatures
proof:
:= by
  let K := P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion
  let F := sampleSignature (normalizedTriangles P) (offsetWindow (normalizedTriangles P))
    cell.sample
  have hdata := feasibleSignCell_open_nonempty_measure_ne_zero hcell
  have hsampleMem : sampleToPlane cell.sample ∈ realCell cell.system :=
    (mem_realCell_sampleToPlane_iff cell.system cell.sample).mpr
      (feasibleSignCells_sound hcell)
  have hsampleClosed : sampleToPlane cell.sample ∈ closedUnitCell :=
    realCell_subset_closedUnitCell hcell hsampleMem
  have hsignatureSample : K.signature (sampleToPlane cell.sample) = F := by
    symm
    exact sampleSignature_eq_normalizedRegion_signature P hcell hsampleMem
  rw [PolygonalRegion.mem_relevantSignatures_iff]
  constructor
  · change F ∈ K.candidateSignatures
    rw [← hsignatureSample]
    exact K.signature_mem_candidateSignatures hsampleClosed
  · change volume (K.signatureFiber F) ≠ 0
    intro hfiberZero
    apply hdata.2.2
    apply measure_mono_null _ hfiberZero
    intro u hu
    rw [PolygonalRegion.mem_signatureFiber_iff]
    exact ⟨realCell_subset_closedUnitCell hcell hu,
      (sampleSignature_eq_normalizedRegion_signature P hcell hu).symm⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_signatureFamily_iff_mem_relevantSignatures
statement:
theorem mem_signatureFamily_iff_mem_relevantSignatures
    (P : Code.Input) {F : Finset IntegerPlane} :
    F ∈ signatureFamily (normalizedTriangles P) ↔
      F ∈ P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion.relevantSignatures
proof:
:= by
  let ts := normalizedTriangles P
  let K := P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion
  have harea := normalizedTriangles_twiceAreaQ_ne_zero P
  constructor
  · intro hF
    simp only [signatureFamily, List.mem_eraseDups, List.mem_map] at hF
    obtain ⟨cell, hcell, hcellF⟩ := hF
    rw [← hcellF]
    exact sampleSignature_mem_relevantSignatures P hcell
  · intro hF
    have hmeasure : volume (K.signatureFiber F) ≠ 0 :=
      (PolygonalRegion.mem_relevantSignatures_iff.mp hF).2
    obtain ⟨u, huFiber, huExceptional⟩ :=
      exists_mem_not_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_measure_zero hmeasure
        (volume_totalExceptionalSet harea)
    have huClosed : u ∈ closedUnitCell :=
      (PolygonalRegion.mem_signatureFiber_iff.mp huFiber).1
    have huSignature : K.signature u = F :=
      (PolygonalRegion.mem_signatureFiber_iff.mp huFiber).2
    have huNotUnit : u ∉ exceptionalSet unitBoundaryLines := by
      intro hu
      exact huExceptional (Or.inr hu)
    have huBounds : u.re ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ u.im ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      rw [closedUnitCell] at huClosed
      exact huClosed
    have hx0 : u.re ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply huNotUnit
      apply mem_exceptionalSet_of_evalPlane_eq_zero
        (ls := unitBoundaryLines) (l := ⟨1, 0, 0⟩) (by simp [unitBoundaryLines])
      simp only [ZLine.evalPlane]
      rw [h]
      norm_num
    have hx1 : u.re ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      apply huNotUnit
      apply mem_exceptionalSet_of_evalPlane_eq_zero
        (ls := unitBoundaryLines) (l := ⟨1, 0, -1⟩) (by simp [unitBoundaryLines])
      simp only [ZLine.evalPlane]
      rw [h]
      norm_num
    have hy0 : u.im ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply huNotUnit
      apply mem_exceptionalSet_of_evalPlane_eq_zero
        (ls := unitBoundaryLines) (l := ⟨0, 1, 0⟩) (by simp [unitBoundaryLines])
      simp only [ZLine.evalPlane]
      rw [h]
      norm_num
    have hy1 : u.im ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      apply huNotUnit
      apply mem_exceptionalSet_of_evalPlane_eq_zero
        (ls := unitBoundaryLines) (l := ⟨0, 1, -1⟩) (by simp [unitBoundaryLines])
      simp only [ZLine.evalPlane]
      rw [h]
      norm_num
    have huUnit : u ∈ realCell openUnitSquare := by
      rw [mem_realCell_openUnitSquare_iff]
      exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne huBounds.1.1 hx0.symm,
        lt_of_le_of_ne huBounds.1.2 hx1,
        lt_of_le_of_ne huBounds.2.1 hy0.symm,
        lt_of_le_of_ne huBounds.2.2 hy1⟩
    have huOff : ∀ l ∈ arrangementLines ts, l.evalPlane u ≠ 0 := by
      intro l hl hzero
      apply huExceptional
      apply Or.inl
      unfold exceptionalSet
      apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨l, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨List.mem_toFinset.mpr hl, ?_⟩⟩
      change planeEval l.A l.B l.C u = 0
      simpa only [ZLine.evalPlane, planeEval] using hzero
    obtain ⟨cell, hcell, huCell⟩ :=
      exists_feasibleSignCell_containing_real_point huUnit huOff
    simp only [signatureFamily, List.mem_eraseDups, List.mem_map]
    refine ⟨cell, hcell, ?_⟩
    exact (sampleSignature_eq_normalizedRegion_signature P hcell huCell).trans huSignature

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.signatureFamily_toFinset_eq_relevantSignatures
statement:
theorem signatureFamily_toFinset_eq_relevantSignatures (P : Code.Input) :
    (signatureFamily (normalizedTriangles P)).toFinset =
      P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion.relevantSignatures
proof:
:= by
  ext F
  simpa only [List.mem_toFinset] using
    (mem_signatureFamily_iff_mem_relevantSignatures P (F := F))

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.isCompact_closedUnitCell
statement: theorem isCompact_closedUnitCell : IsCompact closedUnitCell
proof:
:= by
  exact Complex.equivRealProdCLM.toHomeomorph.isCompact_preimage.2
    (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.volume_closedUnitCell_ne_zero
statement: theorem volume_closedUnitCell_ne_zero : volume closedUnitCell ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let c : Plane := (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ + (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * Complex.I
  let ball : Set Plane := Metric.ball c (4 : ℝ)⁻¹
  have hballNonempty : ball.Nonempty := by
    exact ⟨c, Metric.mem_ball_self (by norm_num)⟩
  have hballMeasure : volume ball ≠ 0 :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.measure_ne_zero volume hballNonempty
  have hballSubset : ball ⊆ closedUnitCell := by
    intro z hz
    have hnorm : ‖z - c‖ < (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      simpa only [ball, Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq] using hz
    have hre : |z.re - (2 : ℝ)⁻¹| < (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      apply lt_of_le_of_lt _ hnorm
      simpa only [c, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul,
        sub_zero, add_zero, Complex.sub_re] using Complex.abs_re_le_norm (z - c)
    have him : |z.im - (2 : ℝ)⁻¹| < (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      apply lt_of_le_of_lt _ hnorm
      simpa only [c, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one, Complex.ofReal_re, zero_mul,
        zero_add, add_zero, Complex.sub_im] using Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z - c)
    rw [closedUnitCell]
    change (z.re, z.im) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
    rw [Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Icc, Set.mem_Icc]
    rw [abs_lt] at hre him
    constructor <;> constructor <;> norm_num at hre him ⊢ <;> linarith
  intro hcellZero
  exact hballMeasure (MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null hballSubset hcellZero)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.iUnion_translatedClosedUnitCell
statement:
theorem iUnion_translatedClosedUnitCell :
    (⋃ q : IntegerPlane, translatedClosedUnitCell q) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
  let q : IntegerPlane := ![⌊x.re⌋, ⌊x.im⌋]
  refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
  rw [translatedClosedUnitCell, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, closedUnitCell]
  change ((-integerPoint q + x).re, (-integerPoint q + x).im) ∈
    Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
  rw [Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Icc, Set.mem_Icc]
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.neg_re, integerPoint_re,
    Complex.add_im, Complex.neg_im, integerPoint_im]
  have hreLower := Int.floor_le x.re
  have hreUpper := Int.lt_floor_add_one x.re
  have himLower := Int.floor_le x.im
  have himUpper := Int.lt_floor_add_one x.im
  change (⌊x.re⌋ : ℝ) ≤ x.re at hreLower
  change x.re < (⌊x.re⌋ : ℝ) + 1 at hreUpper
  change (⌊x.im⌋ : ℝ) ≤ x.im at himLower
  change x.im < (⌊x.im⌋ : ℝ) + 1 at himUpper
  dsimp only [q, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
  constructor <;> constructor <;> linarith

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.tilesUniverse_vadd_translationSet_iff
statement:
theorem tilesUniverse_vadd_translationSet_iff {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (a : G) (F : Finset G) (T : Set G) :
    TilesUniverse F (a +ᵥ T) ↔ TilesUniverse F T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hshift
    apply tilesUniverse_of_existsUnique
    intro x
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfunique⟩ :=
      existsUnique_tile_representation hshift (a + x)
    refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨hf.1, ?_⟩
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hf
      convert hf.2 using 1
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      abel
    · intro g hg
      apply hfunique g
      refine ⟨hg.1, ?_⟩
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      convert hg.2 using 1
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      abel
  · intro hT
    apply tilesUniverse_of_existsUnique
    intro x
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfunique⟩ :=
      existsUnique_tile_representation hT (-a + x)
    refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨hf.1, ?_⟩
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      convert hf.2 using 1
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      abel
    · intro g hg
      apply hfunique g
      refine ⟨hg.1, ?_⟩
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hg
      convert hg.2 using 1
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.Tiles.ae_existsUnique_translation
statement:
theorem Tiles.ae_existsUnique_translation {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane}
    (hT : K.Tiles T) :
    ∀ᵐ x, ∃! t : Plane,
      t ∈ T ∧ x ∈ placedTile K.prototileFamily (t, ())
proof:
:= by
  let A := K.placements T
  let _ : Countable A := (Tiling.IsTiling.countable hT).to_subtype
  have hunique : ∀ᵐ x, ∀ i j : A,
      x ∈ placedTile K.prototileFamily i.1 →
      x ∈ placedTile K.prototileFamily j.1 → i = j := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro i
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp
    · rw [ae_iff]
      have hijval : i.1 ≠ j.1 := by
        intro hval
        apply hij
        exact Subtype.ext hval
      have had := hT.isPacking i.2 j.2 hijval
      change volume
        (placedTile K.prototileFamily i.1 ∩
          placedTile K.prototileFamily j.1) = 0 at had
      rw [show {x | ¬(x ∈ placedTile K.prototileFamily i.1 →
          x ∈ placedTile K.prototileFamily j.1 → i = j)} =
          placedTile K.prototileFamily i.1 ∩
            placedTile K.prototileFamily j.1 by
        ext x
        simp [hij]]
      exact had
  filter_upwards [hT.isCover, hunique] with x hxcover hxunique
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxcover
  refine ⟨i.1.1, ⟨i.2, hxi⟩, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  let j : A := ⟨(t, ()), ht.1⟩
  have hij := hxunique i j hxi ht.2
  exact congrArg (fun p : A ↦ p.1.1) hij |>.symm

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.mem_latticeSlice_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_latticeSlice_iff {K : PolygonalRegion} {u : Plane}
    {z : IntegerPlane} :
    z ∈ K.latticeSlice u ↔ u + integerPoint z ∈ K.support
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.latticeSlice_finite
statement:
theorem latticeSlice_finite (K : PolygonalRegion) (u : Plane) :
    (K.latticeSlice u).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hcompact : IsCompact (-u +ᵥ K.support) :=
    (K.isPolygonal.vadd (-u)).isCompact
  have hfinite := finite_integerPoint_preimage_of_isCompact hcompact
  apply hfinite.subset
  intro z hz
  change u + integerPoint z ∈ K.support at hz
  change integerPoint z ∈ -u +ᵥ K.support
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  convert hz using 1
  simp only [vadd_eq_add]
  abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.signatureWindow_finite
statement:
theorem signatureWindow_finite (K : PolygonalRegion) :
    K.signatureWindow.Finite
proof:
:= by
  let differences : Set Plane :=
    (fun p : Plane × Plane ↦ p.1 - p.2) ''
      (K.support ×ˢ closedUnitCell)
  have hcompact : IsCompact differences :=
    (K.isPolygonal.isCompact.prod isCompact_closedUnitCell).image continuous_sub
  have hfinite := finite_integerPoint_preimage_of_isCompact hcompact
  apply hfinite.subset
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨u, huCell, huz⟩ := hz
  change integerPoint z ∈ differences
  refine ⟨(u + integerPoint z, u), ⟨huz, huCell⟩, ?_⟩
  simp only
  abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.mem_signature_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_signature_iff {K : PolygonalRegion} {u : Plane}
    {z : IntegerPlane} :
    z ∈ K.signature u ↔ u + integerPoint z ∈ K.support
proof:
:= by
  simp only [signature, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, mem_latticeSlice_iff]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.mem_integerTranslationCarrier_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_integerTranslationCarrier_iff {K : PolygonalRegion}
    {T : Set IntegerPlane} {x : Plane} :
    x ∈ K.integerTranslationCarrier T ↔
      ∃ y ∈ K.support, ∃ t ∈ T, x = y + integerPoint t
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.locallyFinite_integerTranslates
statement:
theorem locallyFinite_integerTranslates
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set IntegerPlane) :
    LocallyFinite fun t : T ↦ integerPoint (t : IntegerPlane) +ᵥ K.support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := K.isPolygonal.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : Plane)
  intro x
  refine ⟨Metric.ball x 1, Metric.ball_mem_nhds x one_pos, ?_⟩
  let H : Set T :=
    {t | ((integerPoint (t : IntegerPlane) +ᵥ K.support) ∩ Metric.ball x 1).Nonempty}
  have himage_subset : ((fun t : T ↦ (t : IntegerPlane)) '' H) ⊆
      {z : IntegerPlane | integerPoint z ∈ Metric.closedBall x (R + 1)} := by
    rintro z ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hytranslate, hyball⟩ := ht
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hytranslate
    have hsupport := hR hytranslate
    change integerPoint (t : IntegerPlane) ∈ Metric.closedBall x (R + 1)
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hsupport ⊢
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hyball
    have hdistance :
        dist (integerPoint (t : IntegerPlane)) y =
          dist (-integerPoint (t : IntegerPlane) + y) 0 := by
      rw [dist_comm]
      simp only [dist_eq_norm, sub_zero]
      congr 1
      abel
    calc
      dist (integerPoint (t : IntegerPlane)) x ≤
          dist (integerPoint (t : IntegerPlane)) y + dist y x :=
        dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ = dist (-integerPoint (t : IntegerPlane) + y) 0 + dist y x := by
        rw [hdistance]
      _ ≤ R + 1 := add_le_add hsupport hyball.le
  have hfinite :
      {z : IntegerPlane | integerPoint z ∈ Metric.closedBall x (R + 1)}.Finite :=
    finite_integerPoint_preimage_of_isCompact (isCompact_closedBall x (R + 1))
  have himage_finite : ((fun t : T ↦ (t : IntegerPlane)) '' H).Finite :=
    hfinite.subset himage_subset
  change H.Finite
  exact himage_finite.of_finite_image (Set.injOn_of_injective Subtype.val_injective)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.integerTranslationCarrier_closure_interior
statement:
theorem integerTranslationCarrier_closure_interior
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set IntegerPlane) :
    closure (interior (K.integerTranslationCarrier T)) =
      K.integerTranslationCarrier T
proof:
:= by
  have hunion :
      (⋃ t : T, integerPoint (t : IntegerPlane) +ᵥ K.support) =
        K.integerTranslationCarrier T := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨t, hxt⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hxt
      exact ⟨-integerPoint (t : IntegerPlane) + x, hxt,
        (t : IntegerPlane), t.2, by abel⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, t, ht, rfl⟩
      apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      convert hy using 1
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      abel
  rw [← hunion]
  exact (K.locallyFinite_integerTranslates T).closure_interior_iUnion_eq fun t ↦
    (K.isPolygonal.vadd (integerPoint (t : IntegerPlane))).closure_interior

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.regularClosed_eq_of_ae_eq
statement:
private theorem regularClosed_eq_of_ae_eq
    {A B : Set Plane}
    (hA : closure (interior A) = A)
    (hB : closure (interior B) = B)
    (hAB : A =ᵐ[volume] B) : A = B
proof:
:= by
  have hAclosed : IsClosed A := by
    rw [← hA]
    exact isClosed_closure
  have hBclosed : IsClosed B := by
    rw [← hB]
    exact isClosed_closure
  have hzeroAB : volume (A \ B) = 0 := (ae_eq_set.mp hAB).1
  have hzeroBA : volume (B \ A) = 0 := (ae_eq_set.mp hAB).2
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rw [← hA]
    apply closure_minimal _ hBclosed
    intro x hxA
    by_contra hxB
    let U := interior A ∩ Bᶜ
    have hUopen : IsOpen U := isOpen_interior.inter hBclosed.isOpen_compl
    have hxU : x ∈ U := ⟨hxA, hxB⟩
    have hUzero : volume U = 0 := by
      apply measure_mono_null _ hzeroAB
      intro y hy
      exact ⟨interior_subset hy.1, hy.2⟩
    exact hUopen.measure_ne_zero volume ⟨x, hxU⟩ hUzero
  · rw [← hB]
    apply closure_minimal _ hAclosed
    intro x hxB
    by_contra hxA
    let U := interior B ∩ Aᶜ
    have hUopen : IsOpen U := isOpen_interior.inter hAclosed.isOpen_compl
    have hxU : x ∈ U := ⟨hxB, hxA⟩
    have hUzero : volume U = 0 := by
      apply measure_mono_null _ hzeroBA
      intro y hy
      exact ⟨interior_subset hy.1, hy.2⟩
    exact hUopen.measure_ne_zero volume ⟨x, hxU⟩ hUzero

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.integerTranslationCarrier_eq_of_ae_eq
statement:
theorem integerTranslationCarrier_eq_of_ae_eq
    (K : PolygonalRegion) {T₀ T₁ : Set IntegerPlane}
    (h : K.integerTranslationCarrier T₀ =ᵐ[volume]
      K.integerTranslationCarrier T₁) :
    K.integerTranslationCarrier T₀ = K.integerTranslationCarrier T₁
proof:
:= by
  exact regularClosed_eq_of_ae_eq
    (K.integerTranslationCarrier_closure_interior T₀)
    (K.integerTranslationCarrier_closure_interior T₁) h

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.mem_integerTranslationCarrier_iff_mem_discreteCarrier_signature
statement:
theorem mem_integerTranslationCarrier_iff_mem_discreteCarrier_signature
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set IntegerPlane)
    {u x : Plane} {q : IntegerPlane} (hx : x = u + integerPoint q) :
    x ∈ K.integerTranslationCarrier T ↔
      q ∈ discreteCarrier (K.signature u) T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, t, ht, hxy⟩
    let f : IntegerPlane := q - t
    have hf : f ∈ K.signature u := by
      rw [mem_signature_iff]
      rw [integerPoint_sub]
      rw [hxy] at hx
      convert hy using 1
      calc
        u + (integerPoint q - integerPoint t) =
            (u + integerPoint q) - integerPoint t := by abel
        _ = (y + integerPoint t) - integerPoint t := by rw [hx]
        _ = y := by abel
    exact mem_discreteCarrier_iff.mpr ⟨f, hf, t, ht, by dsimp only [f]; abel⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, t, ht, hq⟩
    refine ⟨u + integerPoint f, mem_signature_iff.mp hf, t, ht, ?_⟩
    rw [hx, hq, integerPoint_add]
    abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.signature_add_integerPoint
statement:
theorem signature_add_integerPoint (K : PolygonalRegion)
    (u : Plane) (q : IntegerPlane) :

proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rw [mem_signature_iff, mem_shiftFinset_iff, mem_signature_iff, integerPoint_add]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · convert h using 1
    abel
  · convert h using 1
    abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.signature_mem_candidateSignatures

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.mem_signatureFiber_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_signatureFiber_iff {K : PolygonalRegion} {F : Finset IntegerPlane}
    {u : Plane} :
    u ∈ K.signatureFiber F ↔ u ∈ closedUnitCell ∧ K.signature u = F
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.measurableSet_signature_membership
proof:
:= by
  have hcontinuous : Continuous (fun u : Plane ↦ u + integerPoint z) :=
    continuous_id.add continuous_const
  have heq : {u : Plane | z ∈ K.signature u} =
      (fun u : Plane ↦ u + integerPoint z) ⁻¹' K.support := by
    ext u
    exact mem_signature_iff
  rw [heq]
  exact K.isPolygonal.isClosed.measurableSet.preimage hcontinuous.measurable

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.measurableSet_signatureFiber
statement:
theorem measurableSet_signatureFiber (K : PolygonalRegion)
    (F : Finset IntegerPlane) :
    MeasurableSet (K.signatureFiber F)
proof:
:= by
  let condition : IntegerPlane → Set Plane := fun z ↦
    if z ∈ F then {u | z ∈ K.signature u} else {u | z ∉ K.signature u}
  have hcondition : ∀ z, MeasurableSet (condition z) := by
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ F
    · simpa only [condition, if_pos hz] using measurableSet_signature_membership K z
    · dsimp only [condition]
      rw [if_neg hz]
      change MeasurableSet ({u : Plane | z ∈ K.signature u}ᶜ)
      exact (measurableSet_signature_membership K z).compl
  have heq : {u : Plane | K.signature u = F} = ⋂ z, condition z := by
    ext u
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter]
    constructor
    · intro h z
      by_cases hz : z ∈ F
      · have hzsig : z ∈ K.signature u := by
          rw [h]
          exact hz
        dsimp only [condition]
        rw [if_pos hz]
        exact hzsig
      · have hzsig : z ∉ K.signature u := by
          rw [h]
          exact hz
        dsimp only [condition]
        rw [if_neg hz]
        exact hzsig
    · intro h
      apply Finset.ext
      intro z
      specialize h z
      by_cases hz : z ∈ F
      · have hzsig : z ∈ K.signature u := by
          dsimp only [condition] at h
          rw [if_pos hz] at h
          exact h
        exact iff_of_true hzsig hz
      · have hzsig : z ∉ K.signature u := by
          dsimp only [condition] at h
          rw [if_neg hz] at h
          exact h
        exact iff_of_false hzsig hz
  rw [signatureFiber, heq]
  exact isCompact_closedUnitCell.isClosed.measurableSet.inter
    (MeasurableSet.iInter hcondition)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.mem_relevantSignatures_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_relevantSignatures_iff {K : PolygonalRegion}
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} :
    F ∈ K.relevantSignatures ↔
      F ∈ K.candidateSignatures ∧ volume (K.signatureFiber F) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [relevantSignatures, Finset.mem_filter]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.tilesUniverse_relevantSignatures_of_ae
statement:
theorem tilesUniverse_relevantSignatures_of_ae
    (K : PolygonalRegion) {T : Set IntegerPlane}
    (hT : ∀ᵐ u, TilesUniverse (K.signature u) T) :
    ∀ F ∈ K.relevantSignatures, TilesUniverse F T
proof:
:= by
  intro F hF
  have hmeasure : volume (K.signatureFiber F) ≠ 0 :=
    (mem_relevantSignatures_iff.mp hF).2
  obtain ⟨u, huFiber, huTiles⟩ :=
    Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hmeasure (ae_restrict_of_ae hT)
  rw [mem_signatureFiber_iff] at huFiber
  rwa [huFiber.2] at huTiles

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.ae_signature_mem_relevantSignatures
statement:
theorem ae_signature_mem_relevantSignatures (K : PolygonalRegion) :
    ∀ᵐ u ∂volume.restrict closedUnitCell,
      K.signature u ∈ K.relevantSignatures
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have havoid : ∀ᵐ u ∂volume,
      ∀ F ∈ K.candidateSignatures,
        volume (K.signatureFiber F) = 0 → u ∉ K.signatureFiber F := by
    rw [eventually_all_finset]
    intro F hF
    by_cases hzero : volume (K.signatureFiber F) = 0
    · filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hzero] with u hu
      exact fun _ ↦ hu
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ h ↦ (hzero h).elim
  have hcell : MeasurableSet closedUnitCell :=
    isCompact_closedUnitCell.isClosed.measurableSet
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae havoid, ae_restrict_mem hcell]
    with u huAvoid huCell
  rw [mem_relevantSignatures_iff]
  have hcandidate := K.signature_mem_candidateSignatures huCell
  refine ⟨hcandidate, ?_⟩
  intro hzero
  exact huAvoid (K.signature u) hcandidate hzero ⟨huCell, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.relevantSignatures_nonempty
statement:
theorem relevantSignatures_nonempty (K : PolygonalRegion) :
    K.relevantSignatures.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  let _ : (ae (volume.restrict closedUnitCell)).NeBot :=
    ae_restrict_neBot.mpr volume_closedUnitCell_ne_zero
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := K.ae_signature_mem_relevantSignatures.exists
  exact ⟨K.signature u, hu⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.exists_nonempty_relevantSignature
statement:
theorem exists_nonempty_relevantSignature (K : PolygonalRegion) :
    ∃ F ∈ K.relevantSignatures, F.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  have hsupport : volume K.support ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (K.isPolygonal.volume_pos K.nonempty)
  have hunion :
      (⋃ q : IntegerPlane, K.support ∩ translatedClosedUnitCell q) = K.support := by
    rw [← Set.inter_iUnion]
    rw [iUnion_translatedClosedUnitCell]
    simp
  have hexists : ∃ q : IntegerPlane,
      volume (K.support ∩ translatedClosedUnitCell q) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hnone
    push Not at hnone
    have hzero : volume (⋃ q : IntegerPlane,
        K.support ∩ translatedClosedUnitCell q) = 0 :=
      measure_iUnion_null hnone
    rw [hunion] at hzero
    exact hsupport hzero
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hexists
  let basePart : Set Plane :=
    -integerPoint q +ᵥ (K.support ∩ translatedClosedUnitCell q)
  have hbaseMeasure : volume basePart ≠ 0 := by
    change volume (-integerPoint q +ᵥ
      (K.support ∩ translatedClosedUnitCell q)) ≠ 0
    rw [measure_vadd]
    exact hq
  have hbaseCell : basePart ⊆ closedUnitCell := by
    intro u hu
    change u ∈ -integerPoint q +ᵥ
      (K.support ∩ translatedClosedUnitCell q) at hu
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hu
    have huTranslated := hu.2
    rw [translatedClosedUnitCell, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at huTranslated
    simpa only [neg_neg, vadd_eq_add, neg_add_cancel_left] using huTranslated
  have hbaseSignature : ∀ u ∈ basePart, q ∈ K.signature u := by
    intro u hu
    change u ∈ -integerPoint q +ᵥ
      (K.support ∩ translatedClosedUnitCell q) at hu
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hu
    rw [mem_signature_iff]
    simpa only [neg_neg, vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hu.1
  have hcellMeasurable : MeasurableSet closedUnitCell :=
    isCompact_closedUnitCell.isClosed.measurableSet
  have hae : ∀ᵐ u ∂volume,
      u ∈ closedUnitCell → K.signature u ∈ K.relevantSignatures :=
    (ae_restrict_iff' hcellMeasurable).mp K.ae_signature_mem_relevantSignatures
  obtain ⟨u, huBase, huRelevant⟩ :=
    Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hbaseMeasure (ae_restrict_of_ae hae)
  have hrel : K.signature u ∈ K.relevantSignatures :=
    huRelevant (hbaseCell huBase)
  exact ⟨K.signature u, hrel, ⟨q, hbaseSignature u huBase⟩⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.ae_signature_tilesUniverse_of_relevantSignatures
statement:
theorem ae_signature_tilesUniverse_of_relevantSignatures
    (K : PolygonalRegion) {T : Set IntegerPlane}
    (hT : ∀ F ∈ K.relevantSignatures, TilesUniverse F T) :
    ∀ᵐ u, TilesUniverse (K.signature u) T
proof:
:= by
  have hcell : ∀ᵐ u ∂volume.restrict closedUnitCell,
      TilesUniverse (K.signature u) T :=
    K.ae_signature_mem_relevantSignatures.mono fun _ hu ↦ hT _ hu
  have htranslated : ∀ q : IntegerPlane,
      ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (translatedClosedUnitCell q),
        TilesUniverse (K.signature x) T := by
    intro q
    let a : Plane := integerPoint q
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun x : Plane ↦ -a + x)
        (translatedClosedUnitCell q) closedUnitCell := by
      intro x hx
      rw [translatedClosedUnitCell, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hx
      simpa only [a, vadd_eq_add] using hx
    have hpull :=
      ((quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left volume (-a)).restrict hmaps).ae hcell
    filter_upwards [hpull] with x hx
    have hpoint : (-a + x) + integerPoint q = x := by
      dsimp only [a]
      abel
    have hsignature := K.signature_add_integerPoint (-a + x) q
    rw [hpoint] at hsignature
    rw [hsignature, tilesUniverse_shiftFinset_iff]
    exact hx
  have hall : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict
      (⋃ q : IntegerPlane, translatedClosedUnitCell q),
      TilesUniverse (K.signature x) T :=
    (ae_restrict_iUnion_iff translatedClosedUnitCell
      (fun x ↦ TilesUniverse (K.signature x) T)).mpr htranslated
  simpa only [iUnion_translatedClosedUnitCell, Measure.restrict_univ] using hall

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.integerTranslationCarrier_ae_eq_of_relevantSignatures
statement:
theorem integerTranslationCarrier_ae_eq_of_relevantSignatures
    (K : PolygonalRegion) {T₀ T₁ : Set IntegerPlane}
    (hT : ∀ F ∈ K.relevantSignatures,
      discreteCarrier F T₀ = discreteCarrier F T₁) :
    K.integerTranslationCarrier T₀ =ᵐ[volume]
      K.integerTranslationCarrier T₁
proof:
:= by
  have hcell : ∀ᵐ u ∂volume.restrict closedUnitCell,
      K.signature u ∈ K.relevantSignatures :=
    K.ae_signature_mem_relevantSignatures
  have htranslated : ∀ q : IntegerPlane,
      ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (translatedClosedUnitCell q),
        x ∈ K.integerTranslationCarrier T₀ ↔
          x ∈ K.integerTranslationCarrier T₁ := by
    intro q
    let a : Plane := integerPoint q
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun x : Plane ↦ -a + x)
        (translatedClosedUnitCell q) closedUnitCell := by
      intro x hx
      rw [translatedClosedUnitCell, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hx
      simpa only [a, vadd_eq_add] using hx
    have hpull :=
      ((quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left volume (-a)).restrict hmaps).ae hcell
    filter_upwards [hpull] with x hxRelevant
    let u : Plane := -a + x
    have hcoordinate : x = u + integerPoint q := by
      dsimp only [u, a]
      abel
    rw [K.mem_integerTranslationCarrier_iff_mem_discreteCarrier_signature
      T₀ hcoordinate,
      K.mem_integerTranslationCarrier_iff_mem_discreteCarrier_signature
        T₁ hcoordinate]
    exact Set.ext_iff.mp (hT (K.signature u) hxRelevant) q
  have hall : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict
      (⋃ q : IntegerPlane, translatedClosedUnitCell q),
      x ∈ K.integerTranslationCarrier T₀ ↔
        x ∈ K.integerTranslationCarrier T₁ :=
    (ae_restrict_iUnion_iff translatedClosedUnitCell
      (fun x ↦ x ∈ K.integerTranslationCarrier T₀ ↔
        x ∈ K.integerTranslationCarrier T₁)).mpr htranslated
  have hall' : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume,
      x ∈ K.integerTranslationCarrier T₀ ↔
        x ∈ K.integerTranslationCarrier T₁ := by
    simpa only [iUnion_translatedClosedUnitCell, Measure.restrict_univ] using hall
  filter_upwards [hall'] with x hx
  exact propext hx

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.mem_placedTile_integerPoint_iff_signature
statement:
theorem mem_placedTile_integerPoint_iff_signature
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (u : Plane) (x t : IntegerPlane) :
    u + integerPoint x ∈
        placedTile K.prototileFamily (integerPoint t, ()) ↔
      x - t ∈ K.signature u
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_signature_iff]
  change u + integerPoint x ∈ integerPoint t +ᵥ K.support ↔ _
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  have heq : -integerPoint t +ᵥ (u + integerPoint x) =
      u + integerPoint (x - t) := by
    rw [show integerPoint (x - t) = integerPoint x - integerPoint t by
      exact map_sub integerPointHom x t]
    simp only [vadd_eq_add]
    abel
  rw [heq]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.signature_tilesUniverse_iff_unique_translation
statement:
theorem signature_tilesUniverse_iff_unique_translation
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (u : Plane) (T : Set IntegerPlane) :
    TilesUniverse (K.signature u) T ↔
      ∀ x : IntegerPlane, ∃! t : IntegerPlane,
        t ∈ T ∧
          u + integerPoint x ∈
            placedTile K.prototileFamily (integerPoint t, ())
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro htiles x
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfunique⟩ :=
      existsUnique_tile_representation htiles x
    let t : IntegerPlane := x - f
    refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨hf.2, ?_⟩
      rw [K.mem_placedTile_integerPoint_iff_signature]
      simpa only [t, sub_sub_cancel] using hf.1
    · intro s hs
      have hxs : x - s ∈ K.signature u :=
        (K.mem_placedTile_integerPoint_iff_signature u x s).mp hs.2
      have hchosen : f = x - s := (hfunique (x - s) ⟨hxs, by
        simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using hs.1⟩).symm
      dsimp only [t]
      rw [hchosen]
      abel
  · intro hunique
    apply tilesUniverse_of_existsUnique
    intro x
    obtain ⟨t, ht, htunique⟩ := hunique x
    let f : IntegerPlane := x - t
    refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (K.mem_placedTile_integerPoint_iff_signature u x t).mp ht.2
      · simpa only [f, sub_sub_cancel] using ht.1
    · intro g hg
      let s : IntegerPlane := x - g
      have hs : s ∈ T ∧
          u + integerPoint x ∈
            placedTile K.prototileFamily (integerPoint s, ()) := by
        refine ⟨hg.2, ?_⟩
        rw [K.mem_placedTile_integerPoint_iff_signature]
        simpa only [s, sub_sub_cancel] using hg.1
      have hst : s = t := htunique s hs
      dsimp only [f, s] at hst ⊢
      rw [← hst]
      abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.mem_integerTranslationSet_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_integerTranslationSet_iff {T : Set Plane} {z : IntegerPlane} :
    z ∈ integerTranslationSet T ↔ integerPoint z ∈ T
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.integerPoint_image_integerTranslationSet
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact hz
  · intro ht
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := mem_integerLattice_iff.mp (hT t ht)
    refine ⟨z, ?_, hz⟩
    change integerPoint z ∈ T
    rw [hz]
    exact ht

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.Tiles.ae_signature_tilesUniverse
proof:
:= by
  have hglobal := hT.ae_existsUnique_translation
  have horbits : ∀ᵐ u, ∀ x : IntegerPlane, ∃! r : Plane,
      r ∈ integerPoint '' T ∧
        u + integerPoint x ∈ placedTile K.prototileFamily (r, ()) := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro x
    have horbit :=
      (quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left volume (integerPoint x)).ae hglobal
    simpa only [add_comm] using horbit
  filter_upwards [horbits] with u hu
  apply (K.signature_tilesUniverse_iff_unique_translation u T).mpr
  intro y
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrunique⟩ := hu y
  obtain ⟨t, htT, htr⟩ := hr.1
  refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨htT, ?_⟩
    simpa only [htr] using hr.2
  · intro s hs
    have hrs : integerPoint s = r := by
      apply hrunique (integerPoint s)
      exact ⟨⟨s, hs.1, rfl⟩, hs.2⟩
    exact integerPoint_injective (hrs.trans htr.symm)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.tiles_integerPoint_image_of_ae_signature_tilesUniverse
statement:
theorem tiles_integerPoint_image_of_ae_signature_tilesUniverse
    (K : PolygonalRegion) {T : Set IntegerPlane}
    (hT : ∀ᵐ u, TilesUniverse (K.signature u) T) :
    K.Tiles (integerPoint '' T)
proof:
:= by
  have htranslations : (integerPoint '' T).Countable :=
    Set.to_countable T |>.image integerPoint
  refine ⟨placements_countable K htranslations, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp q hq hpq
    change p.1 ∈ integerPoint '' T at hp
    change q.1 ∈ integerPoint '' T at hq
    obtain ⟨t, ht, htp⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsq⟩ := hq
    change AEDisjoint volume
      (placedTile K.prototileFamily p)
      (placedTile K.prototileFamily q)
    change volume
      (placedTile K.prototileFamily p ∩
        placedTile K.prototileFamily q) = 0
    have hae : ∀ᵐ u,
        u ∉ placedTile K.prototileFamily p ∩
          placedTile K.prototileFamily q := by
      filter_upwards [hT] with u hu
      intro huinter
      obtain ⟨chosen, hchosen, hunique⟩ :=
        (K.signature_tilesUniverse_iff_unique_translation u T).mp hu 0
      have htPlaced : u + integerPoint 0 ∈
          placedTile K.prototileFamily (integerPoint t, ()) := by
        have hup := huinter.1
        change u ∈ p.1 +ᵥ K.support at hup
        change u + integerPoint 0 ∈ integerPoint t +ᵥ K.support
        simpa only [integerPoint_zero, add_zero, htp] using hup
      have hsPlaced : u + integerPoint 0 ∈
          placedTile K.prototileFamily (integerPoint s, ()) := by
        have huq := huinter.2
        change u ∈ q.1 +ᵥ K.support at huq
        change u + integerPoint 0 ∈ integerPoint s +ᵥ K.support
        simpa only [integerPoint_zero, add_zero, hsq] using huq
      have htchosen := hunique t ⟨ht, htPlaced⟩
      have hschosen := hunique s ⟨hs, hsPlaced⟩
      apply hpq
      apply Prod.ext
      · rw [← htp, ← hsq, htchosen, hschosen]
      · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simpa only [not_not, Set.ofPred_mem_eq] using (ae_iff.mp hae)
  · filter_upwards [hT] with u hu
    obtain ⟨t, ht, -⟩ :=
      (K.signature_tilesUniverse_iff_unique_translation u T).mp hu 0
    let p : Placement Plane Unit := (integerPoint t, ())
    have hp : p ∈ K.placements (integerPoint '' T) :=
      ⟨t, ht.1, rfl⟩
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa only [p, integerPoint_zero, add_zero] using ht.2

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.tiles_integerPoint_image_iff_ae_signature_tilesUniverse
statement:
theorem tiles_integerPoint_image_iff_ae_signature_tilesUniverse
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set IntegerPlane) :
    K.Tiles (integerPoint '' T) ↔
      ∀ᵐ u, TilesUniverse (K.signature u) T
proof:
:=

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.tiles_integerPoint_image_iff_relevantSignatures
statement:
theorem tiles_integerPoint_image_iff_relevantSignatures
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set IntegerPlane) :
    K.Tiles (integerPoint '' T) ↔
      ∀ F ∈ K.relevantSignatures, TilesUniverse F T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro htiles
    exact K.tilesUniverse_relevantSignatures_of_ae
      htiles.ae_signature_tilesUniverse
  · intro hsignatures
    exact K.tiles_integerPoint_image_of_ae_signature_tilesUniverse
      (K.ae_signature_tilesUniverse_of_relevantSignatures hsignatures)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.exists_integer_signature_tiling
statement:
theorem exists_integer_signature_tiling {K : PolygonalRegion}
    (hK : K.HasIntegerVertices) {T : Set Plane} (hT : K.Tiles T) :
    ∃ S : Set IntegerPlane,
      K.Tiles (integerPoint '' S) ∧
        ∀ᵐ u, TilesUniverse (K.signature u) S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T', hT'tiles, -, hT'integer⟩ := K.exists_integer_tiling hK hT
  let S := integerTranslationSet T'
  have himage : integerPoint '' S = T' :=
    integerPoint_image_integerTranslationSet hT'integer
  have htilesImage : K.Tiles (integerPoint '' S) := by
    rwa [himage]
  exact ⟨S, htilesImage, htilesImage.ae_signature_tilesUniverse⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RasterPresentation.planarTileDecisionCounted_eq

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RasterPresentation.tileable_iff_canonicalRaster
statement:
theorem tileable_iff_canonicalRaster (K : RationalPolygonalRegion) :
    (∃ T : Set Plane, K.toPolygonalRegion.Tiles T) ↔
      ∃ A : Set IntegerPlane,
        TilesUniverse K.normalizedRegion.relevantPlanarRasterTile A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨T, hT⟩
    have hnormalized := K.normalizedRegion_tiles hT
    obtain ⟨Z, hZtiles, -, hZinteger⟩ :=
      K.normalizedRegion.exists_integer_tiling
        K.normalizedRegion_hasIntegerVertices hnormalized
    let A := PolygonalRegion.integerTranslationSet Z
    have himage : integerPoint '' A = Z :=
      PolygonalRegion.integerPoint_image_integerTranslationSet hZinteger
    have hAtiles : K.normalizedRegion.Tiles (integerPoint '' A) := by
      rwa [himage]
    exact (K.normalizedRegion.exists_integer_tiling_iff_relevantPlanarRasterTile).mp
      ⟨A, hAtiles⟩
  · rintro hraster
    obtain ⟨A, hAtiles⟩ :=
      (K.normalizedRegion.exists_integer_tiling_iff_relevantPlanarRasterTile).mpr hraster
    exact ⟨K.denormalizedTranslations (integerPoint '' A),
      K.tiles_of_normalizedRegion_tiles hAtiles⟩
