name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quantitative_lattice_index_ne_zero_local
statement:
private theorem quantitative_lattice_index_ne_zero_local
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {ell : ℕ} (D : QuantitativeWeakPeriodData F ell) :
    D.lattice.index ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let q := weakQ F ell
  let N := weakN D.direction
  let M := weakM D.direction
  let a := weakAvoidance D.direction
  let h₀ := D.direction ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩
  have haSpec := avoidanceVector_spec D.direction_ne_zero
  have hw₀ : wedge a h₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hw
    exact haSpec.2.1 ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩
      ((commensurable_iff_wedge_eq_zero haSpec.1
        (D.direction_ne_zero ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩)).2 hw)
  have hdet : wedge (weakSliceVector F ell D.direction)
      (((q * N * M : ℕ) : ℤ) • h₀) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [weakSliceVector, wedge_zsmul_left, wedge_zsmul_right]
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt
        (Nat.mul_pos D.arithmetic.q_pos D.arithmetic.pairLCM_pos)))
      (mul_ne_zero
        (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.mul_pos
          (Nat.mul_pos D.arithmetic.q_pos D.arithmetic.pairLCM_pos)
          D.arithmetic.avoidanceLCM_pos))) hw₀)
  change D.arithmetic.lattice.index ≠ 0
  rw [D.arithmetic.lattice_eq, weakLattice, index_generatedPair hdet]
  exact Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hdet

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quantitative_period_mem_local
statement:
private theorem quantitative_period_mem_local
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} (D : QuantitativeWeakPeriodData F 1)
    (j : Fin D.numberOfDirections) :
    (D.multiplier : ℤ) • D.direction j ∈ D.lattice
proof:
:= by
  simpa using D.period_mem_lattice j

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quantitative_period_ne_zero_local
statement:
private theorem quantitative_period_ne_zero_local
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} (D : QuantitativeWeakPeriodData F 1)
    (j : Fin D.numberOfDirections) :
    (D.multiplier : ℤ) • D.direction j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact smul_ne_zero (Int.ofNat_ne_zero.mpr
    (Nat.ne_of_gt D.arithmetic.multiplier_pos)) (D.direction_ne_zero j)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quotientCoset_add_mem_iff_local
statement:
private theorem quotientCoset_add_mem_iff_local
    (Λ : AddSubgroup IntegerPlane) (c : IntegerPlane ⧸ Λ)
    {p : IntegerPlane} (hp : p ∈ Λ) (x : IntegerPlane) :
    x + p ∈ quotientCoset Λ c ↔ x ∈ quotientCoset Λ c
proof:
:= by
  change QuotientAddGroup.mk' Λ (x + p) = c ↔ QuotientAddGroup.mk' Λ x = c
  have hp0 : QuotientAddGroup.mk' Λ p = 0 :=
    (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff p).2 hp
  rw [map_add, hp0, add_zero]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.exists_period_on_quotientCoset
statement:
private theorem exists_period_on_quotientCoset
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {A : Set IntegerPlane}
    (D : QuantitativeWeakPeriodData F 1) (hvalid : D.ValidFor A)
    (c : IntegerPlane ⧸ D.lattice) :
    ∃ j : Fin D.numberOfDirections,
      DiscretePeriodicBy (A ∩ quotientCoset D.lattice c)
        ((D.multiplier : ℤ) • D.direction j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective D.lattice c
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hvalid x
  refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
  intro y
  simpa [addCoset, quotientCoset, QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem] using hj y

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.exists_repeated_cosetPeriod
statement:
private theorem exists_repeated_cosetPeriod
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {T : Set IntegerPlane} {v : IntegerPlane}
    (D : QuantitativeWeakPeriodData F 1) (C : QuakePlate F T v)
    (hvalid : ∀ k : Fin (D.numberOfDirections + 1),
      D.ValidFor (quakeIndexedShift D C k))
    (c : IntegerPlane ⧸ D.lattice) :
    ∃ (i j : Fin (D.numberOfDirections + 1))
        (r : Fin D.numberOfDirections),
      i.val < j.val ∧
      DiscretePeriodicBy (quakeIndexedShift D C i ∩ quotientCoset D.lattice c)
        ((D.multiplier : ℤ) • D.direction r) ∧
      DiscretePeriodicBy (quakeIndexedShift D C j ∩ quotientCoset D.lattice c)
        ((D.multiplier : ℤ) • D.direction r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let selected : Fin (D.numberOfDirections + 1) → Fin D.numberOfDirections :=
    fun k ↦ Classical.choose (exists_period_on_quotientCoset D (hvalid k) c)
  have hselected (k : Fin (D.numberOfDirections + 1)) :
      DiscretePeriodicBy (quakeIndexedShift D C k ∩ quotientCoset D.lattice c)
        ((D.multiplier : ℤ) • D.direction (selected k)) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (exists_period_on_quotientCoset D (hvalid k) c)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt selected (by simp)
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hijlt | hjilt
  · exact ⟨i, j, selected i, hijlt, hselected i, heq ▸ hselected j⟩
  · exact ⟨j, i, selected j, hjilt, hselected j, heq.symm ▸ hselected i⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeUniformPeriod_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem quakeUniformPeriod_ne_zero
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} (D : QuantitativeWeakPeriodData F 1)
    {v : IntegerPlane} (hv : v ≠ 0) : quakeUniformPeriod D v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply smul_ne_zero
  · exact Int.ofNat_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.mul_ne_zero
      (quantitative_lattice_index_ne_zero_local D) (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _))
  · exact hv

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.indexedShift_smul_mem_lattice
statement:
private theorem indexedShift_smul_mem_lattice
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} (D : QuantitativeWeakPeriodData F 1)
    (v : IntegerPlane) (k : Fin (D.numberOfDirections + 1)) :
    (((D.lattice.index * k.val : ℕ) : ℤ) • v) ∈ D.lattice
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : (D.lattice.index : ℤ) • v ∈ D.lattice := by
    simpa using D.lattice.nsmul_index_mem v
  have hk := D.lattice.zsmul_mem hbase (k.val : ℤ)
  convert hk using 1
  funext i
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Nat.cast_mul]
  ring

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.chosen_incomplete_periodic_uniform
statement:
private theorem chosen_incomplete_periodic_uniform
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {T : Set IntegerPlane} {v : IntegerPlane}
    (hzero : 0 ∈ F) (hT : TilesUniverse F T)
    (D : QuantitativeWeakPeriodData F 1) (C : QuakePlate F T v)
    (hvalid : ∀ k : Fin (D.numberOfDirections + 1),
      D.ValidFor (quakeIndexedShift D C k))
    (c : IntegerPlane ⧸ D.lattice) :
    let R := chosenQuakeCosetRepeatData D C hvalid c
    DiscretePeriodicBy
      (quakeIncompleteOrbit C D.lattice c
        ((D.multiplier : ℤ) • D.direction R.periodIndex))
      (quakeUniformPeriod D v)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let R := chosenQuakeCosetRepeatData D C hvalid c
  let p := (D.multiplier : ℤ) • D.direction R.periodIndex
  let a : ℤ := (D.lattice.index * R.lower.val : ℕ)
  let b : ℤ := (D.lattice.index * R.upper.val : ℕ)
  have hlocal : DiscretePeriodicBy
      (quakeIncompleteOrbit C D.lattice c p) ((b - a) • v) := by
    apply quakeIncompleteOrbit_periodic_of_repeated_cosetPeriod
      hzero hT C D.lattice c p
    · exact quantitative_period_mem_local D R.periodIndex
    · exact indexedShift_smul_mem_lattice D v R.lower
    · exact indexedShift_smul_mem_lattice D v R.upper
    · simpa [quakeIndexedShift, a, p] using R.lower_periodic
    · simpa [quakeIndexedShift, b, p] using R.upper_periodic
  let d := R.upper.val - R.lower.val
  have hdpos : 0 < d := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt R.lower_lt_upper
  have hdle : d ≤ D.numberOfDirections := by
    omega
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Nat.dvd_factorial hdpos hdle
  have hmultiple : quakeUniformPeriod D v = (z : ℤ) • ((b - a) • v) := by
    have hzInt : (D.numberOfDirections.factorial : ℤ) = (d : ℤ) * (z : ℤ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hz
    have hdInt : (d : ℤ) = (R.upper.val : ℤ) - (R.lower.val : ℤ) := by
      dsimp [d]
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (Nat.le_of_lt R.lower_lt_upper)]
    dsimp [quakeUniformPeriod, a, b]
    rw [hzInt, hdInt]
    rw [sub_smul, smul_sub]
    module
  rw [hmultiple]
  exact hlocal.zsmul z

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeCompletePart_periodic
statement:
private theorem quakeCompletePart_periodic
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {T : Set IntegerPlane} {v : IntegerPlane}
    (D : QuantitativeWeakPeriodData F 1) (C : QuakePlate F T v)
    (hvalid : ∀ k : Fin (D.numberOfDirections + 1),
      D.ValidFor (quakeIndexedShift D C k))
    (j : Fin D.numberOfDirections) :
    DiscretePeriodicBy (quakeCompletePart D C hvalid j)
      ((D.multiplier : ℤ) • D.direction j)
proof:
:= by
  let p := (D.multiplier : ℤ) • D.direction j
  have hp := quantitative_period_mem_local D j
  intro x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hcj, hxC, hxc, hfull⟩
    refine ⟨c, hcj, ?_, (quotientCoset_add_mem_iff_local D.lattice c hp x).mp hxc, ?_⟩
    · have hminus := hfull (-1)
      have heq : x + p + (-1 : ℤ) • p = x := by module
      rwa [heq] at hminus
    · intro n
      have hn := hfull (n - 1)
      have heq : x + p + (n - 1) • p = x + n • p := by
        rw [sub_smul]
        module
      rwa [heq] at hn
  · rintro ⟨c, hcj, hxC, hxc, hfull⟩
    have hxP : x + p ∈ quakePlateTranslations C := by
      simpa only [one_smul] using hfull 1
    refine ⟨c, hcj, hxP, (quotientCoset_add_mem_iff_local D.lattice c hp x).mpr hxc, ?_⟩
    intro n
    have hn := hfull (n + 1)
    have heq : x + p + n • p = x + (n + 1) • p := by
      rw [add_smul]
      module
    change x + p + n • p ∈ quakePlateTranslations C
    rw [heq]
    exact hn

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_quakeResidualPart_iff_exists_incomplete
statement:
private theorem mem_quakeResidualPart_iff_exists_incomplete
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {T : Set IntegerPlane} {v : IntegerPlane}
    (D : QuantitativeWeakPeriodData F 1) (C : QuakePlate F T v)
    (hvalid : ∀ k : Fin (D.numberOfDirections + 1),
      D.ValidFor (quakeIndexedShift D C k)) (x : IntegerPlane) :
    x ∈ quakeResidualPart D C hvalid ↔
      ∃ c : IntegerPlane ⧸ D.lattice,
        x ∈ quakeIncompleteOrbit C D.lattice c
          ((D.multiplier : ℤ) • D.direction
            (chosenQuakeCosetRepeatData D C hvalid c).periodIndex)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hx
    let c := QuotientAddGroup.mk' D.lattice x
    let R := chosenQuakeCosetRepeatData D C hvalid c
    refine ⟨c, hx.1, rfl, ?_⟩
    by_cases hfull : ∀ n : ℤ,
        x + n • ((D.multiplier : ℤ) • D.direction R.periodIndex) ∈
          quakePlateTranslations C
    · exfalso
      apply hx.2
      apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      exact ⟨R.periodIndex, c, rfl, hx.1, rfl, hfull⟩
    · exact not_forall.mp hfull
  · rintro ⟨c, hxC, hxc, n, hn⟩
    refine ⟨hxC, ?_⟩
    intro hxUnion
    obtain ⟨j, c', hc'j, hxC', hxc', hfull⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxUnion
    have hcc' : c = c' := hxc.symm.trans hxc'
    have hselected : (chosenQuakeCosetRepeatData D C hvalid c).periodIndex = j := by
      rw [hcc']
      exact hc'j
    apply hn
    simpa [hselected] using hfull n

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeResidualPart_periodic
statement:
private theorem quakeResidualPart_periodic
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {T : Set IntegerPlane} {v : IntegerPlane}
    (hzero : 0 ∈ F) (hT : TilesUniverse F T)
    (D : QuantitativeWeakPeriodData F 1) (C : QuakePlate F T v)
    (hvalid : ∀ k : Fin (D.numberOfDirections + 1),
      D.ValidFor (quakeIndexedShift D C k)) :
    DiscretePeriodicBy (quakeResidualPart D C hvalid) (quakeUniformPeriod D v)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  rw [mem_quakeResidualPart_iff_exists_incomplete D C hvalid,
    mem_quakeResidualPart_iff_exists_incomplete D C hvalid]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hx⟩
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    exact (chosen_incomplete_periodic_uniform hzero hT D C hvalid c x).mp hx
  · rintro ⟨c, hx⟩
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    exact (chosen_incomplete_periodic_uniform hzero hT D C hvalid c x).mpr hx

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_quakePlateTranslations_isoOfEq
statement:
private theorem mem_quakePlateTranslations_isoOfEq
    {F F' : Finset IntegerPlane} {T : Set IntegerPlane} {v t : IntegerPlane}
    (h : quakeGraph F T v = quakeGraph F' T v)
    (C : QuakePlate F T v) :
    t ∈ quakePlateTranslations ((quakeGraphIsoOfEq h).connectedComponentEquiv C) ↔
      t ∈ quakePlateTranslations C
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ht, hcomp⟩
    refine ⟨ht, ?_⟩
    change (quakeGraph F' T v).connectedComponentMk
        ((quakeGraphIsoOfEq h) (⟨t, ht⟩ : T)) =
      C.map (quakeGraphIsoOfEq h).toHom at hcomp
    exact SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.iso_image_comp_eq_map_iff_eq_comp.mp hcomp
  · rintro ⟨ht, hcomp⟩
    refine ⟨ht, ?_⟩
    change (quakeGraph F' T v).connectedComponentMk
        ((quakeGraphIsoOfEq h) (⟨t, ht⟩ : T)) =
      C.map (quakeGraphIsoOfEq h).toHom
    exact SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.iso_image_comp_eq_map_iff_eq_comp.mpr hcomp

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.rawQuakePart_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
private theorem rawQuakePart_pairwiseDisjoint
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {T : Set IntegerPlane} {v : IntegerPlane}
    (D : QuantitativeWeakPeriodData F 1) (C : QuakePlate F T v)
    (hvalid : ∀ k : Fin (D.numberOfDirections + 1),
      D.ValidFor (quakeIndexedShift D C k)) :
    Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ (rawQuakePart D C hvalid)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdisj : ∀ i j : Fin (D.numberOfDirections + 1), i ≠ j →
      Disjoint (rawQuakePart D C hvalid i) (rawQuakePart D C hvalid j) := by
    intro i
    refine Fin.cases (motive := fun i ↦ ∀ j, i ≠ j →
      Disjoint (rawQuakePart D C hvalid i) (rawQuakePart D C hvalid j)) ?_ ?_ i
    · intro j
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j _ ↦ ?_) j
      · intro hij
        exact (hij rfl).elim
      · change Disjoint (quakeResidualPart D C hvalid) (quakeCompletePart D C hvalid j)
        rw [Set.disjoint_left]
        intro x hxResidual hxComplete
        exact hxResidual.2 (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hxComplete⟩)
    · intro i j
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j hij ↦ ?_) j
      · intro _
        change Disjoint (quakeCompletePart D C hvalid i) (quakeResidualPart D C hvalid)
        rw [Set.disjoint_left]
        intro x hxComplete hxResidual
        exact hxResidual.2 (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hxComplete⟩)
      · change Disjoint (quakeCompletePart D C hvalid i) (quakeCompletePart D C hvalid j)
        rw [Set.disjoint_left]
        intro x hxi hxj
        obtain ⟨c, hci, _hxiC, hxic, _⟩ := hxi
        obtain ⟨c', hc'j, _hxjC, hxjc', _⟩ := hxj
        have hcc' : c = c' := hxic.symm.trans hxjc'
        have hij' : i = j := by
          apply Fin.ext
          have hselected :
              (chosenQuakeCosetRepeatData D C hvalid c).periodIndex = j := by
            rw [hcc']
            exact hc'j
          exact congrArg Fin.val (hci.symm.trans hselected)
        exact hij (congrArg Fin.succ hij')
  intro i _ j _ hij
  exact hdisj i j hij

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.rawQuakePart_iUnion
statement:
private theorem rawQuakePart_iUnion
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {T : Set IntegerPlane} {v : IntegerPlane}
    (D : QuantitativeWeakPeriodData F 1) (C : QuakePlate F T v)
    (hvalid : ∀ k : Fin (D.numberOfDirections + 1),
      D.ValidFor (quakeIndexedShift D C k)) :
    (⋃ j, rawQuakePart D C hvalid j) = quakePlateTranslations C
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    refine Fin.cases (motive := fun j ↦ x ∈ rawQuakePart D C hvalid j →
      x ∈ quakePlateTranslations C) ?_ (fun i hi ↦ ?_) j hxj
    · intro hresidual
      exact hresidual.1
    · obtain ⟨c, _hci, hxC, _hxc, _hfull⟩ := hi
      exact hxC
  · intro hxC
    by_cases hxComplete : x ∈ ⋃ j, quakeCompletePart D C hvalid j
    · obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxComplete
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨Fin.succ j, hxj⟩
    · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, hxC, hxComplete⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quantitative_period_pairwise_incommensurable
statement:
private theorem quantitative_period_pairwise_incommensurable
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} (D : QuantitativeWeakPeriodData F 1) :
    PairwiseIncommensurable
      (fun j ↦ (D.multiplier : ℤ) • D.direction j)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij hcomm
  have hi0 := quantitative_period_ne_zero_local D i
  have hj0 := quantitative_period_ne_zero_local D j
  have hw := (commensurable_iff_wedge_eq_zero hi0 hj0).mp hcomm
  rw [wedge_zsmul_left, wedge_zsmul_right] at hw
  have hm : (D.multiplier : ℤ) ≠ 0 :=
    Int.ofNat_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt D.arithmetic.multiplier_pos)
  have hwdirection : wedge (D.direction i) (D.direction j) = 0 := by
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hw).resolve_left hm)).resolve_left hm
  exact D.pairwise_incommensurable i j hij
    ((commensurable_iff_wedge_eq_zero (D.direction_ne_zero i)
      (D.direction_ne_zero j)).mpr hwdirection)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.commensurable_symm_local
statement:
private theorem commensurable_symm_local {u w : IntegerPlane} :
    Commensurable u w → Commensurable w u
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab⟩
  exact ⟨b, a, hb, ha, hab.symm⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.commensurable_trans_local
statement:
private theorem commensurable_trans_local {u w z : IntegerPlane} :
    Commensurable u w → Commensurable w z → Commensurable u z
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab⟩ ⟨c, d, hc, hd, hcd⟩
  refine ⟨c * a, b * d, mul_ne_zero hc ha, mul_ne_zero hb hd, ?_⟩
  calc
    (c * a) • u = c • (a • u) := by rw [mul_smul]
    _ = c • (b • w) := by rw [hab]
    _ = b • (c • w) := by rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm]
    _ = b • (d • z) := by rw [hcd]
    _ = (b * d) • z := by rw [mul_smul]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.commensurable_period_quake_of_uniformPeriod
statement:
private theorem commensurable_period_quake_of_uniformPeriod
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} (D : QuantitativeWeakPeriodData F 1)
    {v p : IntegerPlane} (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (hcomm : Commensurable (quakeUniformPeriod D v) p) :
    Commensurable p v
proof:
:= by
  have hH0 := quakeUniformPeriod_ne_zero D hv
  have hw := (commensurable_iff_wedge_eq_zero hH0 hp).mp hcomm
  rw [quakeUniformPeriod, wedge_zsmul_left] at hw
  have hc : ((D.lattice.index * D.numberOfDirections.factorial : ℕ) : ℤ) ≠ 0 :=
    Int.ofNat_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.mul_ne_zero
      (quantitative_lattice_index_ne_zero_local D) (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _))
  have hvp : wedge v p = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hw).resolve_left hc
  have hpv : wedge p v = 0 := by rw [wedge_swap, hvp, neg_zero]
  exact (commensurable_iff_wedge_eq_zero hp hv).mpr hpv

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.exists_uniformQuakePeriodicCover_normalized
statement:
theorem exists_uniformQuakePeriodicCover_normalized
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {T : Set IntegerPlane} {v : IntegerPlane}
    (hzero : 0 ∈ F) (hcard : 1 < F.card) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hT : TilesUniverse F T) : Nonempty (UniformQuakePeriodicCover F T v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := exists_quantitativeWeakPeriodData
    (F := F) (ell := 1) Nat.one_pos hzero hcard
  have huniv : SetScalarPeriodic 1 (Set.univ : Set IntegerPlane) := by
    intro x z
    simp
  let hvalid : ∀ C : QuakePlate F T v,
      ∀ k : Fin (D.numberOfDirections + 1),
        D.ValidFor (quakeIndexedShift D C k) := by
    intro C k
    apply hD Set.univ (quakeIndexedShift D C k) huniv
    exact tilesUniverse_quakeShiftedTranslations hT _
  exact ⟨rawUniformQuakePeriodicCover hzero hv hT D hvalid⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.exists_uniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition_normalized
statement:
theorem exists_uniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition_normalized
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {T : Set IntegerPlane} {v : IntegerPlane}
    (hzero : 0 ∈ F) (hcard : 1 < F.card) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hT : TilesUniverse F T) :
    Nonempty (UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition F T v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := exists_quantitativeWeakPeriodData
    (F := F) (ell := 1) Nat.one_pos hzero hcard
  have huniv : SetScalarPeriodic 1 (Set.univ : Set IntegerPlane) := by
    intro x z
    simp
  let hvalid : ∀ C : QuakePlate F T v,
      ∀ k : Fin (D.numberOfDirections + 1),
        D.ValidFor (quakeIndexedShift D C k) := by
    intro C k
    apply hD Set.univ (quakeIndexedShift D C k) huniv
    exact tilesUniverse_quakeShiftedTranslations hT _
  by_cases hparallel : ∃ j : Fin D.numberOfDirections,
      Commensurable ((D.multiplier : ℤ) • D.direction j) v
  · obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := hparallel
    exact ⟨uniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition_of_parallel
      hzero hv hT D hvalid j₀ hj₀⟩
  · have hnone : ∀ j : Fin D.numberOfDirections,
        ¬ Commensurable ((D.multiplier : ℤ) • D.direction j) v :=
      not_exists.mp hparallel
    exact ⟨uniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition_of_no_parallel
      hzero hv hT D hvalid hnone⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.exists_uniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition_singleton_zero
statement:
private theorem exists_uniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition_singleton_zero
    {T : Set IntegerPlane} {v : IntegerPlane} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hT : TilesUniverse ({0} : Finset IntegerPlane) T) :
    Nonempty (UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition ({0} : Finset IntegerPlane) T v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨{
    numberOfParts := 1
    number_pos := Nat.one_pos
    part := fun C _ ↦ quakePlateTranslations C
    period := fun _ ↦ v
    period_ne_zero := fun _ ↦ hv
    pairwise_incommensurable := ?_
    periodic_part := ?_
    pairwiseDisjoint := ?_
    iUnion_parts := ?_
  }⟩
  · intro i j hij
    exact hij (Subsingleton.elim i j) |>.elim
  · intro C _
    have hcarrier : discreteCarrier ({0} : Finset IntegerPlane)
        (quakePlateTranslations C) = quakePlateTranslations C := by
      ext x
      simp [discreteCarrier]
    rw [← hcarrier]
    exact quakePlateCarrier_periodic hT C
  · intro C i _ j _ hij
    exact hij (Subsingleton.elim i j) |>.elim
  · intro C
    ext x
    simp

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.exists_uniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition_of_zero_mem
statement:
theorem exists_uniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition_of_zero_mem
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {T : Set IntegerPlane} {v : IntegerPlane}
    (hzero : 0 ∈ F) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hT : TilesUniverse F T) :
    Nonempty (UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition F T v)
proof:
:= by
  have hFpos : 0 < F.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨0, hzero⟩
  by_cases hcard : F.card = 1
  · obtain ⟨f, hF⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard
    have hf : f = 0 := by
      rw [hF] at hzero
      have h0f : 0 = f := by simpa using hzero
      exact h0f.symm
    subst f
    subst F
    exact exists_uniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition_singleton_zero hv hT
  · exact exists_uniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition_normalized hzero (by omega) hv hT

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.exists_uniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
statement:
theorem exists_uniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {T : Set IntegerPlane} {v : IntegerPlane}
    (hF : F.Nonempty) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hT : TilesUniverse F T) :
    Nonempty (UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition F T v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hF
  let F' := shiftFinset q F
  have hzero : 0 ∈ F' := by
    rw [mem_shiftFinset_iff]
    simpa only [zero_add] using hq
  have hT' : TilesUniverse F' T :=
    (tilesUniverse_shiftFinset_iff q F T).mpr hT
  obtain ⟨D⟩ :=
    exists_uniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition_of_zero_mem hzero hv hT'
  exact ⟨D.transportGraph (quakeGraph_shiftFinset q F T v)⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerZero_mem_of_square_not_rings
statement:
private theorem markerZero_mem_of_square_not_rings {M : ℕ} {z : IntegerPlane}
    (hsquare : z ∈ markerSquare M) (hrings : z ∉ nonzeroMarkerRings M)
    (hwest : z ≠ markerWestHole) (hsouth : z ≠ markerSouthHole) :
    z ∈ markerZero M
proof:
:= by
  rw [markerZero, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase]
  exact ⟨hsouth, hwest, Finset.mem_insert.mpr <|
    Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr <| Or.inr <|
      Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hsquare, hrings⟩⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerZero_mem_of_square_y_ge_five
proof:
:= by
  apply markerZero_mem_of_square_not_rings hsquare
  · intro hz
    rw [nonzeroMarkerRings, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hz
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := hz
    split at hi
    · simp at hi
    · have hb := markerRing_bounds hi
      omega
  · intro h
    have h1 := congrFun h 1
    simp only [markerWestHole, latticePoint_apply_one] at h1
    omega
  · intro h
    have h1 := congrFun h 1
    simp only [markerSouthHole, latticePoint_apply_one] at h1
    omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerZero_mem_of_square_y_le_one
statement:
private theorem markerZero_mem_of_square_y_le_one {M : ℕ} {z : IntegerPlane}
    (hsquare : z ∈ markerSquare M) (hy : z 1 ≤ 1)
    (hwest : z ≠ markerWestHole) (hsouth : z ≠ markerSouthHole) :
    z ∈ markerZero M
proof:
:= by
  apply markerZero_mem_of_square_not_rings hsquare
  · intro hz
    rw [nonzeroMarkerRings, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hz
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := hz
    split at hi
    · simp at hi
    · have hb := markerRing_bounds hi
      omega
  · exact hwest
  · exact hsouth

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerZero_mem_of_small_target
statement:
private theorem markerZero_mem_of_small_target {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    {x y : ℤ} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hy3 : y ≤ 3)
    (hwest : ¬ (x = 0 ∧ y = 1)) (hsouth : ¬ (x = 1 ∧ y = 0)) :
    latticePoint x y ∈ markerZero M
proof:
:= by
  apply markerZero_mem_of_square_not_rings
  · rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
    simp only [latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
    omega
  · intro hz
    rw [nonzeroMarkerRings, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hz
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := hz
    split at hi
    · simp at hi
    · have hb := markerRing_bounds hi
      have hiLower : (1 : ℤ) ≤ i := by omega
      simp only [latticePoint_apply_zero] at hb
      omega
  · intro h
    apply hwest
    exact ⟨congrFun h 0, congrFun h 1⟩
  · intro h
    apply hsouth
    exact ⟨congrFun h 0, congrFun h 1⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerRing_relative_mem
statement:
private theorem markerRing_relative_mem {M : ℕ} (i : Fin M) {dx dy : ℤ}
    (hxlo : -1 ≤ dx) (hxhi : dx ≤ 1) (hylo : -1 ≤ dy) (hyhi : dy ≤ 1)
    (hne : dx ≠ 0 ∨ dy ≠ 0) :
    latticePoint (3 * (i : ℤ) + dx) (3 + dy) ∈ markerRing i
proof:
:= by
  rw [markerRing, Finset.mem_erase]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h0 := congrFun h 0
    have h1 := congrFun h 1
    simp only [markerCenter, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one] at h0 h1
    rcases hne with hne | hne
    · exact hne (by omega)
    · exact hne (by omega)
  · rw [mem_gridBox_iff]
    simp only [latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one]
    omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerRing_west_collision
proof:
:= by
  let dx : ℤ := s 0 - 3 * (i : ℤ)
  let dy : ℤ := s 1 - 3
  have hb := markerRing_bounds hs
  have hdxlo : -1 ≤ dx := by dsimp only [dx]; omega
  have hdxhi : dx ≤ 1 := by dsimp only [dx]; omega
  have hdylo : -1 ≤ dy := by dsimp only [dy]; omega
  have hdyhi : dy ≤ 1 := by dsimp only [dy]; omega
  have hcenter : dx ≠ 0 ∨ dy ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    simp only [not_or, not_not] at h
    have h0 : s 0 = 3 * (i : ℤ) := by
      dsimp only [dx] at h
      omega
    have h1 : s 1 = 3 := by
      dsimp only [dy] at h
      omega
    have hsCenter : s = markerCenter i := by
      funext k
      fin_cases k
      · change s 0 = 3 * (i : ℤ)
        exact h0
      · change s 1 = 3
        exact h1
    have hne := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hs).1
    exact hne hsCenter
  have hsEq : s = latticePoint (3 * (i : ℤ) + dx) (3 + dy) := by
    funext k
    fin_cases k
    · change s 0 = 3 * (i : ℤ) + dx
      dsimp only [dx]
      ring
    · change s 1 = 3 + dy
      dsimp only [dy]
      ring
  have hex : ∃ qx qy : ℤ,
      -1 ≤ qx ∧ qx ≤ 1 ∧ -1 ≤ qy ∧ qy ≤ 1 ∧
      (qx ≠ 0 ∨ qy ≠ 0) ∧
      0 ≤ qx - dx ∧ qx - dx ≤ 1 ∧
      0 ≤ 1 + qy - dy ∧ 1 + qy - dy ≤ 3 ∧
      ¬ (qx - dx = 0 ∧ 1 + qy - dy = 1) ∧
      ¬ (qx - dx = 1 ∧ 1 + qy - dy = 0) := by
    by_cases hdx : dx = 0
    · have hdy : dy ≠ 0 := by
        rcases hcenter with h | h
        · exact (h hdx).elim
        · exact h
      have hdyCases : dy = -1 ∨ dy = 1 := by omega
      rcases hdyCases with hdyNeg | hdyPos
      · exact ⟨0, 1, by omega⟩
      · exact ⟨1, 1, by omega⟩
    · have hdyCases : dy = -1 ∨ dy = 0 ∨ dy = 1 := by omega
      rcases hdyCases with hdyNeg | hdyZero | hdyPos
      · exact ⟨dx, 0, by omega⟩
      · exact ⟨dx, -1, by omega⟩
      · exact ⟨dx, 0, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨qx, qy, hqxlo, hqxhi, hqylo, hqyhi, hqne,
    htxlo, htxhi, htylo, htyhi, htwest, htsouth⟩ := hex
  let q := latticePoint (3 * (i : ℤ) + qx) (3 + qy)
  refine ⟨q, markerRing_relative_mem i hqxlo hqxhi hqylo hqyhi hqne, ?_⟩
  have hshift : q + (markerWestHole - s) =
      latticePoint (qx - dx) (1 + qy - dy) := by
    rw [hsEq]
    funext k
    fin_cases k
    · change 3 * (i : ℤ) + qx + (0 - (3 * (i : ℤ) + dx)) = qx - dx
      ring
    · change 3 + qy + (1 - (3 + dy)) = 1 + qy - dy
      ring
  rw [hshift]
  exact markerZero_mem_of_small_target hM htxlo htxhi htylo htyhi htwest htsouth

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.nonzeroMarkerRings_one_empty
statement: private theorem nonzeroMarkerRings_one_empty : nonzeroMarkerRings 1 = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rw [nonzeroMarkerRings, Finset.mem_biUnion]
    rintro ⟨i, -, hi⟩
    have hizero : i.val = 0 := by omega
    simp at hi
  · simp

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerZero_one_mem_of_box
statement:
private theorem markerZero_one_mem_of_box {x y : ℤ}
    (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx6 : x ≤ 6) (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hy6 : y ≤ 6)
    (hwest : ¬ (x = 0 ∧ y = 1)) (hsouth : ¬ (x = 1 ∧ y = 0)) :
    latticePoint x y ∈ markerZero 1
proof:
:= by
  apply markerZero_mem_of_square_not_rings
  · rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
    norm_num [markerSide, latticePoint]
    omega
  · rw [nonzeroMarkerRings_one_empty]
    simp
  · intro h
    apply hwest
    exact ⟨congrFun h 0, congrFun h 1⟩
  · intro h
    apply hsouth
    exact ⟨congrFun h 0, congrFun h 1⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerZero_west_filler
statement:
private theorem markerZero_west_filler {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) {s : IntegerPlane}
    (hs : s ∈ markerZero M)
    (havoid : ∀ q ∈ markerZero M,
      q + (markerWestHole - s) ∉ markerZero M) :
    s = markerEast M
proof:
:= by
  rw [markerZero, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase] at hs
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert] at hs
  obtain ⟨hsSouth, hsWest, hsNorth | hsEast | hsBase⟩ := hs
  · subst s
    exfalso
    let q := latticePoint 1 (markerSide M - 1)
    have hqSquare : q ∈ markerSquare M := by
      rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
      simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
      omega
    have hq : q ∈ markerZero M := by
      apply markerZero_mem_of_square_y_ge_five hqSquare
      simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
      omega
    apply (havoid q hq)
    have hshift : q + (markerWestHole - markerNorth M) = latticePoint 0 0 := by
      funext k
      fin_cases k
      · simp [q, markerWestHole, markerNorth, latticePoint]
      · simp [q, markerWestHole, markerNorth, latticePoint, markerSide]
    rw [hshift]
    exact markerZero_mem_of_small_target hM (by omega) (by omega)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  · exact hsEast
  · obtain ⟨hsSquare, -⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hsBase
    let x : ℤ := s 0
    let y : ℤ := s 1
    have hsBounds := (mem_gridBox_iff.mp (show s ∈ markerSquare M from hsSquare))
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by simpa only [x] using hsBounds.1
    have hxN : x ≤ (markerSide M : ℤ) - 1 := by
      simp only [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff] at hsSquare
      dsimp only [x]
      have := hsSquare.2.1
      simp only [markerSide] at this ⊢
      omega
    have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := by simpa only [y] using hsBounds.2.2.1
    have hyN : y ≤ (markerSide M : ℤ) - 1 := by
      simp only [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff] at hsSquare
      dsimp only [y]
      have := hsSquare.2.2.2
      simp only [markerSide] at this ⊢
      omega
    simp only [markerSide, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hxN hyN
    have hsEq : s = latticePoint x y := by
      funext k
      fin_cases k <;> rfl
    have hwest : ¬ (x = 0 ∧ y = 1) := by
      intro h
      apply hsWest
      rw [hsEq]
      funext k
      fin_cases k <;> simp [markerWestHole, latticePoint, h]
    have hsouth : ¬ (x = 1 ∧ y = 0) := by
      intro h
      apply hsSouth
      rw [hsEq]
      funext k
      fin_cases k <;> simp [markerSouthHole, latticePoint, h]
    rw [hsEq] at havoid
    by_cases hMone : M = 1
    · subst M
      have hx6 : x ≤ 6 := by norm_num [markerSide] at hxN ⊢; omega
      have hy6 : y ≤ 6 := by norm_num [markerSide] at hyN ⊢; omega
      by_cases hyZero : y = 0
      · let q := latticePoint x 5
        have hq : q ∈ markerZero 1 :=
          markerZero_one_mem_of_box hx0 hx6 (by omega) (by omega)
            (by omega) (by omega)
        exfalso
        apply (havoid q hq)
        have hshift : q + (markerWestHole - latticePoint x y) = latticePoint 0 6 := by
          funext k
          fin_cases k <;> simp [q, markerWestHole, latticePoint, hyZero]
        rw [hshift]
        exact markerZero_one_mem_of_box (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
          (by omega) (by omega)
      · by_cases hspecialWest : x = 0 ∧ y = 2
        · let q := latticePoint 0 3
          have hq : q ∈ markerZero 1 :=
            markerZero_one_mem_of_box (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
              (by omega) (by omega)
          exfalso
          apply (havoid q hq)
          have hshift : q + (markerWestHole - latticePoint x y) = latticePoint 0 2 := by
            funext k
            fin_cases k <;>
              simp [q, markerWestHole, latticePoint, hspecialWest.1, hspecialWest.2]
          rw [hshift]
          exact markerZero_one_mem_of_box (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
            (by omega) (by omega)
        · by_cases hspecialSouth : x = 1 ∧ y = 1
          · let q := latticePoint 1 2
            have hq : q ∈ markerZero 1 :=
              markerZero_one_mem_of_box (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
                (by omega) (by omega)
            exfalso
            apply (havoid q hq)
            have hshift : q + (markerWestHole - latticePoint x y) = latticePoint 0 2 := by
              funext k
              fin_cases k <;>
                simp [q, markerWestHole, latticePoint, hspecialSouth.1, hspecialSouth.2]
            rw [hshift]
            exact markerZero_one_mem_of_box (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
              (by omega) (by omega)
          · let q := latticePoint x (y - 1)
            have hq : q ∈ markerZero 1 :=
              markerZero_one_mem_of_box hx0 hx6 (by omega) (by omega)
                (by omega) (by omega)
            exfalso
            apply (havoid q hq)
            have hshift : q + (markerWestHole - latticePoint x y) = latticePoint 0 0 := by
              funext k
              fin_cases k <;> simp [q, markerWestHole, latticePoint]
            rw [hshift]
            exact markerZero_one_mem_of_box (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
              (by omega) (by omega)
    · have hMtwo : 2 ≤ M := by omega
      by_cases hyZero : y = 0
      · let q := latticePoint x 5
        have hqSquare : q ∈ markerSquare M := by
          rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
          simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
          omega
        have hq := markerZero_mem_of_square_y_ge_five hqSquare (by
          simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_one]; omega)
        exfalso
        apply (havoid q hq)
        have hshift : q + (markerWestHole - latticePoint x y) = latticePoint 0 6 := by
          funext k
          fin_cases k <;> simp [q, markerWestHole, latticePoint, hyZero]
        rw [hshift]
        apply markerZero_mem_of_square_y_ge_five
        · rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
          simp only [latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
          omega
        · norm_num [latticePoint]
      · by_cases hyLow : y ≤ (markerSide M : ℤ) - 5
        · let q := latticePoint x ((markerSide M : ℤ) - 1)
          have hqSquare : q ∈ markerSquare M := by
            rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
            simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
            omega
          have hq := markerZero_mem_of_square_y_ge_five hqSquare (by
            simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]; omega)
          exfalso
          apply (havoid q hq)
          have hshift : q + (markerWestHole - latticePoint x y) =
            latticePoint 0 ((markerSide M : ℤ) - y) := by
            funext k
            fin_cases k <;> simp [q, markerWestHole, latticePoint]
          rw [hshift]
          apply markerZero_mem_of_square_y_ge_five
          · rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
            simp only [latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
            omega
          · simp only [latticePoint_apply_one]
            omega
        · let q := latticePoint x (y - 1)
          simp only [markerSide, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hyLow
          have hqSquare : q ∈ markerSquare M := by
            rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
            simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
            omega
          have hq := markerZero_mem_of_square_y_ge_five hqSquare (by
            simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_one]
            omega)
          exfalso
          apply (havoid q hq)
          have hshift : q + (markerWestHole - latticePoint x y) = latticePoint 0 0 := by
            funext k
            fin_cases k <;> simp [q, markerWestHole, latticePoint]
          rw [hshift]
          exact markerZero_mem_of_small_target hM (by omega) (by omega)
            (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerBlock_west_filler
statement:
theorem markerBlock_west_filler {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    {i : Fin M} {s : IntegerPlane} (hs : s ∈ markerBlock i)
    (havoid : ∀ q ∈ markerBlock i,
      q + (markerWestHole - s) ∉ markerZero M) :
    i.val = 0 ∧ s = markerEast M
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
    apply markerZero_west_filler hM
    · rwa [markerBlock, if_pos hi] at hs
    · intro q hq
      exact havoid q (by rwa [markerBlock, if_pos hi])
  · exfalso
    have hsRing : s ∈ markerRing i := by rwa [markerBlock_of_ne_zero hi] at hs
    obtain ⟨q, hq, htarget⟩ := markerRing_west_collision hM hi hsRing
    exact (havoid q (by rwa [markerBlock_of_ne_zero hi])) htarget

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerRing_south_collision
proof:
:= by
  let dx : ℤ := s 0 - 3 * (i : ℤ)
  let dy : ℤ := s 1 - 3
  have hb := markerRing_bounds hs
  have hdxlo : -1 ≤ dx := by dsimp only [dx]; omega
  have hdxhi : dx ≤ 1 := by dsimp only [dx]; omega
  have hdylo : -1 ≤ dy := by dsimp only [dy]; omega
  have hdyhi : dy ≤ 1 := by dsimp only [dy]; omega
  have hcenter : dx ≠ 0 ∨ dy ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    simp only [not_or, not_not] at h
    have h0 : s 0 = 3 * (i : ℤ) := by dsimp only [dx] at h; omega
    have h1 : s 1 = 3 := by dsimp only [dy] at h; omega
    apply (Finset.mem_erase.mp hs).1
    funext k
    fin_cases k
    · change s 0 = 3 * (i : ℤ)
      exact h0
    · change s 1 = 3
      exact h1
  have hsEq : s = latticePoint (3 * (i : ℤ) + dx) (3 + dy) := by
    funext k
    fin_cases k
    · change s 0 = 3 * (i : ℤ) + dx
      dsimp only [dx]
      ring
    · change s 1 = 3 + dy
      dsimp only [dy]
      ring
  have hex : ∃ qx qy : ℤ,
      -1 ≤ qx ∧ qx ≤ 1 ∧ -1 ≤ qy ∧ qy ≤ 1 ∧
      (qx ≠ 0 ∨ qy ≠ 0) ∧
      0 ≤ 1 + qx - dx ∧ 1 + qx - dx ≤ 3 ∧
      0 ≤ qy - dy ∧ qy - dy ≤ 1 ∧
      ¬ (1 + qx - dx = 0 ∧ qy - dy = 1) ∧
      ¬ (1 + qx - dx = 1 ∧ qy - dy = 0) := by
    by_cases hdx : dx = 0
    · have hdy : dy ≠ 0 := by
        rcases hcenter with h | h
        · exact (h hdx).elim
        · exact h
      have hdyCases : dy = -1 ∨ dy = 1 := by omega
      rcases hdyCases with hdyNeg | hdyPos
      · exact ⟨-1, -1, by omega⟩
      · exact ⟨-1, 1, by omega⟩
    · have hdxCases : dx = -1 ∨ dx = 1 := by omega
      have hdyCases : dy = -1 ∨ dy = 0 ∨ dy = 1 := by omega
      rcases hdxCases with hdxNeg | hdxPos
      · rcases hdyCases with hdyNeg | hdyZero | hdyPos
        · exact ⟨-1, 0, by omega⟩
        · exact ⟨-1, 1, by omega⟩
        · exact ⟨0, 1, by omega⟩
      · rcases hdyCases with hdyNeg | hdyZero | hdyPos
        · exact ⟨0, -1, by omega⟩
        · exact ⟨1, 1, by omega⟩
        · exact ⟨0, 1, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨qx, qy, hqxlo, hqxhi, hqylo, hqyhi, hqne,
    htxlo, htxhi, htylo, htyhi, htwest, htsouth⟩ := hex
  let q := latticePoint (3 * (i : ℤ) + qx) (3 + qy)
  refine ⟨q, markerRing_relative_mem i hqxlo hqxhi hqylo hqyhi hqne, ?_⟩
  have hshift : q + (markerSouthHole - s) =
      latticePoint (1 + qx - dx) (qy - dy) := by
    rw [hsEq]
    funext k
    fin_cases k
    · change 3 * (i : ℤ) + qx + (1 - (3 * (i : ℤ) + dx)) = 1 + qx - dx
      ring
    · change 3 + qy + (0 - (3 + dy)) = qy - dy
      ring
  rw [hshift]
  apply markerZero_mem_of_square_y_le_one
  · rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
    simp only [latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
    omega
  · simpa only [latticePoint_apply_one] using htyhi
  · intro h
    apply htwest
    exact ⟨congrFun h 0, congrFun h 1⟩
  · intro h
    apply htsouth
    exact ⟨congrFun h 0, congrFun h 1⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerZero_south_filler
statement:
private theorem markerZero_south_filler {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) {s : IntegerPlane}
    (hs : s ∈ markerZero M)
    (havoid : ∀ q ∈ markerZero M,
      q + (markerSouthHole - s) ∉ markerZero M) :
    s = markerNorth M
proof:
:= by
  rw [markerZero, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase] at hs
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert] at hs
  obtain ⟨hsSouth, hsWest, hsNorth | hsEast | hsBase⟩ := hs
  · exact hsNorth
  · subst s
    exfalso
    let q := latticePoint ((markerSide M : ℤ) - 1) 6
    have hqSquare : q ∈ markerSquare M := by
      rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
      simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
      omega
    have hq := markerZero_mem_of_square_y_ge_five hqSquare (by
      simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_one]; omega)
    apply (havoid q hq)
    have hshift : q + (markerSouthHole - markerEast M) = latticePoint 0 5 := by
      funext k
      fin_cases k
      · simp [q, markerSouthHole, markerEast, latticePoint]
      · rfl
    rw [hshift]
    apply markerZero_mem_of_square_y_ge_five
    · rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
      simp only [latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
      omega
    · rfl
  · obtain ⟨hsSquare, -⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hsBase
    let x : ℤ := s 0
    let y : ℤ := s 1
    have hsBounds := mem_gridBox_iff.mp (show s ∈ markerSquare M from hsSquare)
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by simpa only [x] using hsBounds.1
    have hxN : x ≤ (markerSide M : ℤ) - 1 := by
      simp only [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff] at hsSquare
      dsimp only [x]
      have := hsSquare.2.1
      simp only [markerSide] at this ⊢
      omega
    have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := by simpa only [y] using hsBounds.2.2.1
    have hyN : y ≤ (markerSide M : ℤ) - 1 := by
      simp only [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff] at hsSquare
      dsimp only [y]
      have := hsSquare.2.2.2
      simp only [markerSide] at this ⊢
      omega
    simp only [markerSide, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hxN hyN
    have hsEq : s = latticePoint x y := by
      funext k
      fin_cases k <;> rfl
    have hwest : ¬ (x = 0 ∧ y = 1) := by
      intro h
      apply hsWest
      rw [hsEq]
      funext k
      fin_cases k <;> simp [markerWestHole, latticePoint, h]
    have hsouth : ¬ (x = 1 ∧ y = 0) := by
      intro h
      apply hsSouth
      rw [hsEq]
      funext k
      fin_cases k <;> simp [markerSouthHole, latticePoint, h]
    rw [hsEq] at havoid
    by_cases hyLow : y ≤ 1
    · let q := latticePoint x ((markerSide M : ℤ) - 1)
      have hqSquare : q ∈ markerSquare M := by
        rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
        simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
        omega
      have hq := markerZero_mem_of_square_y_ge_five hqSquare (by
        simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]; omega)
      exfalso
      apply (havoid q hq)
      have hshift : q + (markerSouthHole - latticePoint x y) =
          latticePoint 1 ((markerSide M : ℤ) - 1 - y) := by
        funext k
        fin_cases k
        · simp [q, markerSouthHole, latticePoint]
        · simp [q, markerSouthHole, latticePoint]
          ring
      rw [hshift]
      apply markerZero_mem_of_square_y_ge_five
      · rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
        simp only [latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
        omega
      · simp only [latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
        omega
    · by_cases hyMid : y ≤ 4
      · by_cases hxZero : x = 0
        · let q := latticePoint x 5
          have hqSquare : q ∈ markerSquare M := by
            rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
            simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
            omega
          have hq := markerZero_mem_of_square_y_ge_five hqSquare (by
            simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_one]; omega)
          exfalso
          apply (havoid q hq)
          have hshift : q + (markerSouthHole - latticePoint x y) =
              latticePoint 1 (5 - y) := by
            funext k
            fin_cases k
            · simp [q, markerSouthHole, latticePoint, hxZero]
            · simp [q, markerSouthHole, latticePoint]
              ring
          rw [hshift]
          exact markerZero_mem_of_small_target hM (by omega) (by omega)
            (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
        · by_cases hyFour : y = 4
          · let q := latticePoint x 5
            have hqSquare : q ∈ markerSquare M := by
              rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
              simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
              omega
            have hq := markerZero_mem_of_square_y_ge_five hqSquare (by
              simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_one]; omega)
            exfalso
            apply (havoid q hq)
            have hshift : q + (markerSouthHole - latticePoint x y) =
                latticePoint 1 1 := by
              funext k
              fin_cases k <;> simp [q, markerSouthHole, latticePoint, hyFour]
            rw [hshift]
            exact markerZero_mem_of_small_target hM (by omega) (by omega)
              (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
          · let q := latticePoint (x - 1) 5
            have hqSquare : q ∈ markerSquare M := by
              rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
              simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
              omega
            have hq := markerZero_mem_of_square_y_ge_five hqSquare (by
              simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_one]; omega)
            exfalso
            apply (havoid q hq)
            have hshift : q + (markerSouthHole - latticePoint x y) =
                latticePoint 0 (5 - y) := by
              funext k
              fin_cases k
              · simp [q, markerSouthHole, latticePoint]
              · simp [q, markerSouthHole, latticePoint]
                ring
            rw [hshift]
            exact markerZero_mem_of_small_target hM (by omega) (by omega)
              (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
      · by_cases hxZero : x = 0
        · let q := latticePoint 1 y
          have hqSquare : q ∈ markerSquare M := by
            rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
            simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
            omega
          have hq := markerZero_mem_of_square_y_ge_five hqSquare (by
            simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_one]; omega)
          exfalso
          apply (havoid q hq)
          have hshift : q + (markerSouthHole - latticePoint x y) = latticePoint 2 0 := by
            funext k
            fin_cases k <;> simp [q, markerSouthHole, latticePoint, hxZero]
          rw [hshift]
          apply markerZero_mem_of_square_y_le_one
          · rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
            simp only [latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
            omega
          · norm_num [latticePoint]
          · intro h
            have h0 := congrFun h 0
            norm_num [markerWestHole, latticePoint] at h0
          · intro h
            have h0 := congrFun h 0
            norm_num [markerSouthHole, latticePoint] at h0
        · let q := latticePoint (x - 1) y
          have hqSquare : q ∈ markerSquare M := by
            rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
            simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
            omega
          have hq := markerZero_mem_of_square_y_ge_five hqSquare (by
            simp only [q, latticePoint_apply_one]; omega)
          exfalso
          apply (havoid q hq)
          have hshift : q + (markerSouthHole - latticePoint x y) = latticePoint 0 0 := by
            funext k
            fin_cases k <;> simp [q, markerSouthHole, latticePoint]
          rw [hshift]
          exact markerZero_mem_of_small_target hM (by omega) (by omega)
            (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerEast_mem_markerZero
statement:
private theorem markerEast_mem_markerZero (M : ℕ) :
    markerEast M ∈ markerZero M
proof:
:= by
  rw [markerZero, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, Finset.mem_insert.mpr <| Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert_self ..⟩
  · intro h
    have h0 := congrFun h 0
    simp only [markerEast, markerSouthHole, markerSide,
      latticePoint_apply_zero] at h0
    omega
  · intro h

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerWest_decomposition
proof:
:= by
  rw [markerScale_sub]
  funext k
  fin_cases k
  · change markerScale M g 0 - markerScale M horizontalUnit 0 +
      markerEast M 0 = markerScale M g 0 + markerWestHole 0
    simp only [markerScale, markerSide, horizontalUnit, markerEast,
      markerWestHole, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, latticePoint_apply_zero]
    ring
  · change markerScale M g 1 - markerScale M horizontalUnit 1 +
      markerEast M 1 = markerScale M g 1 + markerWestHole 1
    simp only [markerScale, horizontalUnit, markerEast, markerWestHole,
      Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, latticePoint_apply_one]
    ring

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerSouth_decomposition
proof:
:= by
  rw [markerScale_sub]
  funext k
  fin_cases k
  · change markerScale M g 0 - markerScale M verticalUnit 0 +
      markerNorth M 0 = markerScale M g 0 + markerSouthHole 0
    simp only [markerScale, verticalUnit, markerNorth, markerSouthHole,
      Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, latticePoint_apply_zero]
    ring
  · change markerScale M g 1 - markerScale M verticalUnit 1 +
      markerNorth M 1 = markerScale M g 1 + markerSouthHole 1
    simp only [markerScale, markerSide, verticalUnit, markerNorth,
      markerSouthHole, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, latticePoint_apply_one]
    ring

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_zeroMarkerPlacements_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_zeroMarkerPlacements_iff {M : ℕ} {hM : 0 < M}
    {tile : Fin M → Finset IntegerPlane} {U : Set IntegerPlane} {v : IntegerPlane} :
    v ∈ zeroMarkerPlacements hM tile U ↔
      ∃ g ∈ tile ⟨0, hM⟩, ∃ t ∈ U, markerScale M g + t = v
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.zeroMarkerPlacements_west_predecessor
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, t, ht, hgt⟩ := mem_zeroMarkerPlacements_iff.mp hv
  have hzero : (⟨0, hM⟩ : Fin M).val = 0 := rfl
  let x := markerWestHole + v
  obtain ⟨r, hr, -⟩ := existsUnique_tile_representation hU x
  obtain ⟨i, f, hf, s, hs, hrEq⟩ := mem_planarRasterTile_iff.mp hr.1
  let u := x - r
  have hu : u ∈ U := by
    change x - r ∈ U
    exact hr.2
  have hxu : r + u = x := by
    dsimp only [u]
    abel
  have hworld : markerScale M f + s + u =
      markerScale M g + markerWestHole + t := by
    rw [hrEq]
    calc
      r + u = x := hxu
      _ = markerWestHole + v := rfl
      _ = markerWestHole + (markerScale M g + t) := by rw [← hgt]
      _ = markerScale M g + markerWestHole + t := by abel
  have hiS : i.val = 0 ∧ s = markerEast M := by
    by_cases hut : u = t
    · have hsModified := markerBlock_subset_modifiedMarkerSquare hM i hs
      have hEastBlock : markerEast M ∈ markerBlock (⟨0, hM⟩ : Fin M) := by
        rw [markerBlock, if_pos hzero]
        exact markerEast_mem_markerZero M
      have hEastModified := markerBlock_subset_modifiedMarkerSquare hM ⟨0, hM⟩
        hEastBlock
      have heq : s + markerScale M f =
          markerEast M + markerScale M (g - horizontalUnit) := by
        rw [hut] at hworld
        have hbase : markerScale M f + s = markerScale M g + markerWestHole := by
          apply add_right_cancel (b := t)
          simpa only [add_assoc] using hworld
        calc
          s + markerScale M f = markerScale M f + s := add_comm _ _
          _ = markerScale M g + markerWestHole := hbase
          _ = markerScale M (g - horizontalUnit) + markerEast M :=
            (markerWest_decomposition M g).symm
          _ = markerEast M + markerScale M (g - horizontalUnit) := add_comm _ _
      have hscale : markerScale M f = markerScale M (g - horizontalUnit) :=
        translation_eq_of_eq_representations
          (modifiedMarkerSquare_tiles_markerLattice M)
          hsModified (markerScale_mem_markerLattice M f)
          hEastModified (markerScale_mem_markerLattice M (g - horizontalUnit)) heq
      have hsEast : s = markerEast M := by
        rw [hscale] at heq
        exact add_right_cancel heq
      refine ⟨?_, hsEast⟩
      by_contra hi
      have hine : i ≠ (⟨0, hM⟩ : Fin M) := by
        intro hieq
        apply hi
        have hval := congrArg Fin.val hieq
        exact hval
      have hdisjoint := Finset.disjoint_left.mp (markerBlock_disjoint hine)
      exact hdisjoint hs (hsEast ▸ hEastBlock)
    · apply markerBlock_west_filler hM hs
      intro q hq htarget
      apply hut
      let a := markerScale M f + q
      let b := markerScale M g + (q + (markerWestHole - s))
      have ha : a ∈ planarRasterTile tile := by
        exact mem_planarRasterTile_iff.mpr ⟨i, f, hf, q, hq, rfl⟩
      have hb : b ∈ planarRasterTile tile := by
        exact mem_planarRasterTile_iff.mpr
          ⟨⟨0, hM⟩, g, hg, q + (markerWestHole - s),
            by rwa [markerBlock, if_pos hzero], rfl⟩
      apply translation_eq_of_eq_representations hU ha hu hb ht
      dsimp only [a, b]
      calc
        markerScale M f + q + u =
            (markerScale M f + s + u) + (q - s) := by abel
        _ = (markerScale M g + markerWestHole + t) + (q - s) := by rw [hworld]
        _ = markerScale M g + (q + (markerWestHole - s)) + t := by abel
  obtain ⟨hi, hsEast⟩ := hiS
  have hieq : i = ⟨0, hM⟩ := Fin.ext hi
  subst i
  refine mem_zeroMarkerPlacements_iff.mpr ⟨f, hf, u, hu, ?_⟩
  calc
    markerScale M f + u = x - s := by
      dsimp only [u]
      rw [← hrEq]
      abel
    _ = markerWestHole + v - markerEast M := by rw [hsEast]
    _ = v - markerScale M horizontalUnit := by
      funext k
      fin_cases k
      · change 0 + v 0 - (markerSide M : ℤ) =
          v 0 - (markerSide M : ℤ) * 1
        ring
      · change 1 + v 1 - 1 = v 1 - (markerSide M : ℤ) * 0
        ring

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.zeroMarkerPlacements_south_predecessor
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, t, ht, hgt⟩ := mem_zeroMarkerPlacements_iff.mp hv
  have hzero : (⟨0, hM⟩ : Fin M).val = 0 := rfl
  let x := markerSouthHole + v
  obtain ⟨r, hr, -⟩ := existsUnique_tile_representation hU x
  obtain ⟨i, f, hf, s, hs, hrEq⟩ := mem_planarRasterTile_iff.mp hr.1
  let u := x - r
  have hu : u ∈ U := by
    change x - r ∈ U
    exact hr.2
  have hxu : r + u = x := by
    dsimp only [u]
    abel
  have hworld : markerScale M f + s + u =
      markerScale M g + markerSouthHole + t := by
    rw [hrEq]
    calc
      r + u = x := hxu
      _ = markerSouthHole + v := rfl
      _ = markerSouthHole + (markerScale M g + t) := by rw [← hgt]
      _ = markerScale M g + markerSouthHole + t := by abel
  have hiS : i.val = 0 ∧ s = markerNorth M := by
    by_cases hut : u = t
    · have hsModified := markerBlock_subset_modifiedMarkerSquare hM i hs
      have hNorthBlock : markerNorth M ∈ markerBlock (⟨0, hM⟩ : Fin M) := by
        rw [markerBlock, if_pos hzero]
        exact markerNorth_mem_markerZero M
      have hNorthModified := markerBlock_subset_modifiedMarkerSquare hM ⟨0, hM⟩
        hNorthBlock
      have heq : s + markerScale M f =
          markerNorth M + markerScale M (g - verticalUnit) := by
        rw [hut] at hworld
        have hbase : markerScale M f + s = markerScale M g + markerSouthHole := by
          apply add_right_cancel (b := t)
          simpa only [add_assoc] using hworld
        calc
          s + markerScale M f = markerScale M f + s := add_comm _ _
          _ = markerScale M g + markerSouthHole := hbase
          _ = markerScale M (g - verticalUnit) + markerNorth M :=
            (markerSouth_decomposition M g).symm
          _ = markerNorth M + markerScale M (g - verticalUnit) := add_comm _ _
      have hscale : markerScale M f = markerScale M (g - verticalUnit) :=
        translation_eq_of_eq_representations
          (modifiedMarkerSquare_tiles_markerLattice M)
          hsModified (markerScale_mem_markerLattice M f)
          hNorthModified (markerScale_mem_markerLattice M (g - verticalUnit)) heq
      have hsNorth : s = markerNorth M := by
        rw [hscale] at heq
        exact add_right_cancel heq
      refine ⟨?_, hsNorth⟩
      by_contra hi
      have hine : i ≠ (⟨0, hM⟩ : Fin M) := by
        intro hieq
        apply hi
        have hval := congrArg Fin.val hieq
        exact hval
      have hdisjoint := Finset.disjoint_left.mp (markerBlock_disjoint hine)
      exact hdisjoint hs (hsNorth ▸ hNorthBlock)
    · apply markerBlock_south_filler hM hs
      intro q hq htarget
      apply hut
      let a := markerScale M f + q
      let b := markerScale M g + (q + (markerSouthHole - s))
      have ha : a ∈ planarRasterTile tile := by
        exact mem_planarRasterTile_iff.mpr ⟨i, f, hf, q, hq, rfl⟩
      have hb : b ∈ planarRasterTile tile := by
        exact mem_planarRasterTile_iff.mpr
          ⟨⟨0, hM⟩, g, hg, q + (markerSouthHole - s),
            by rwa [markerBlock, if_pos hzero], rfl⟩
      apply translation_eq_of_eq_representations hU ha hu hb ht
      dsimp only [a, b]
      calc
        markerScale M f + q + u =
            (markerScale M f + s + u) + (q - s) := by abel
        _ = (markerScale M g + markerSouthHole + t) + (q - s) := by rw [hworld]
        _ = markerScale M g + (q + (markerSouthHole - s)) + t := by abel
  obtain ⟨hi, hsNorth⟩ := hiS
  have hieq : i = ⟨0, hM⟩ := Fin.ext hi
  subst i
  refine mem_zeroMarkerPlacements_iff.mpr ⟨f, hf, u, hu, ?_⟩
  calc
    markerScale M f + u = x - s := by
      dsimp only [u]
      rw [← hrEq]
      abel
    _ = markerSouthHole + v - markerNorth M := by rw [hsNorth]
    _ = v - markerScale M verticalUnit := by
      funext k
      fin_cases k
      · change 1 + v 0 - 1 = v 0 - (markerSide M : ℤ) * 0
        ring
      · change 0 + v 1 - (markerSide M : ℤ) =
          v 1 - (markerSide M : ℤ) * 1
        ring

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.zeroMarkerPlacements_sub_nat_horizontal
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero => simpa
  | succ a ih =>
      have hp := zeroMarkerPlacements_west_predecessor hM tile hU ih
      convert hp using 1
      push_cast
      simp only [add_smul, one_smul]
      abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.zeroMarkerPlacements_sub_nat_pair
statement:
private theorem zeroMarkerPlacements_sub_nat_pair {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (tile : Fin M → Finset IntegerPlane) {U : Set IntegerPlane}
    (hU : TilesUniverse (planarRasterTile tile) U)
    {v : IntegerPlane} (hv : v ∈ zeroMarkerPlacements hM tile U) (a b : ℕ) :
    v - (a : ℤ) • markerScale M horizontalUnit -
        (b : ℤ) • markerScale M verticalUnit ∈
      zeroMarkerPlacements hM tile U
proof:
:= by
  have hh := zeroMarkerPlacements_sub_nat_horizontal hM tile hU hv a
  induction b with
  | zero => simpa using hh
  | succ b ih =>
      have hp := zeroMarkerPlacements_south_predecessor hM tile hU ih
      convert hp using 1
      push_cast
      simp only [add_smul, one_smul]
      abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.exists_nat_shifts_controlled
statement:
private theorem exists_nat_shifts_controlled (N a b : ℤ) (hN : 7 ≤ N) :
    ∃ ka kb : ℕ,
      -2 ≤ (a - N * (ka : ℤ)) - (b - N * (kb : ℤ)) ∧
        (a - N * (ka : ℤ)) - (b - N * (kb : ℤ)) ≤ N - 3
proof:
:= by
  let delta := a - b
  let q := delta / N
  let r := delta % N
  let c := if r ≤ N - 3 then q else q + 1
  let ka := c.toNat
  let kb := (-c).toNat
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by omega
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := by
    dsimp only [r]
    exact Int.emod_nonneg _ (by omega)
  have hrN : r < N := by
    dsimp only [r]
    exact Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ hNpos
  have hdelta : r + N * q = delta := by
    dsimp only [r, q]
    exact Int.emod_add_mul_ediv delta N
  have hdiff : (ka : ℤ) - (kb : ℤ) = c := by
    exact Int.toNat_sub_toNat_neg c
  have hvalue : (a - N * (ka : ℤ)) - (b - N * (kb : ℤ)) = delta - N * c := by
    rw [← hdiff]
    dsimp only [delta]
    ring
  refine ⟨ka, kb, ?_⟩
  dsimp only [delta] at hdelta
  by_cases hr : r ≤ N - 3
  · have hc : c = q := by simp [c, hr]
    rw [hvalue, hc]
    constructor <;> omega
  · have hc : c = q + 1 := by simp [c, hr]
    rw [hvalue, hc]
    have hmul : N * (q + 1) = N * q + N := by ring
    rw [hmul]
    constructor <;> omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerZero_mem_of_safe_row
statement:
private theorem markerZero_mem_of_safe_row {M : ℕ} {z : IntegerPlane}
    (hsquare : z ∈ markerSquare M) (hy : z 1 ≤ 1 ∨ 5 ≤ z 1)
    (hwest : z ≠ markerWestHole) (hsouth : z ≠ markerSouthHole) :
    z ∈ markerZero M
proof:
:= by
  rw [markerZero, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase]
  refine ⟨hsouth, hwest, Finset.mem_insert.mpr <| Or.inr <|
    Finset.mem_insert.mpr <| Or.inr <| Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hsquare, ?_⟩⟩
  intro hz
  rw [nonzeroMarkerRings, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hz
  obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := hz
  split at hi
  · simp at hi
  · have hb := markerRing_bounds hi
    omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerZero_one_mem_of_box_global
statement:
private theorem markerZero_one_mem_of_box_global {x y : ℤ}
    (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx6 : x ≤ 6) (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hy6 : y ≤ 6)
    (hwest : ¬ (x = 0 ∧ y = 1)) (hsouth : ¬ (x = 1 ∧ y = 0)) :
    latticePoint x y ∈ markerZero 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [markerZero, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, Finset.mem_insert.mpr <| Or.inr <|
    Finset.mem_insert.mpr <| Or.inr <| Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro h
    apply hsouth
    exact ⟨congrFun h 0, congrFun h 1⟩
  · intro h
    apply hwest
    exact ⟨congrFun h 0, congrFun h 1⟩
  · rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
    norm_num [markerSide, latticePoint]
    omega
  · rw [nonzeroMarkerRings]
    intro hz
    rw [Finset.mem_biUnion] at hz
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := hz
    have hizero : i.val = 0 := by omega
    simp at hi

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerZero_overlap_of_controlled
proof:
:= by
  have hside : (markerSide M : ℤ) = 3 * (M : ℤ) + 4 := by
    simp only [markerSide, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  have hx : ∃ qx : ℤ,
      2 ≤ qx ∧ qx ≤ (markerSide M : ℤ) - 1 ∧
      2 ≤ qx + d 0 ∧ qx + d 0 ≤ (markerSide M : ℤ) - 1 := by
    by_cases hdx : 0 ≤ d 0
    · exact ⟨2, by omega⟩
    · exact ⟨2 - d 0, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨qx, hqx0, hqxN, hqdx0, hqdxN⟩ := hx
  by_cases hMone : M = 1
  · subst M
    have hy : ∃ qy : ℤ,
        2 ≤ qy ∧ qy ≤ 6 ∧ 2 ≤ qy + d 1 ∧ qy + d 1 ≤ 6 := by
      by_cases hdy : 0 ≤ d 1
      · exact ⟨2, by norm_num [markerSide] at hdyhi; omega⟩
      · exact ⟨2 - d 1, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨qy, hqy0, hqy6, hqdy0, hqdy6⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨latticePoint qx qy, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact markerZero_one_mem_of_box_global (by omega) (by omega)
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
    · have hdEq : d = latticePoint (d 0) (d 1) := by
        funext k
        fin_cases k <;> rfl
      rw [hdEq]
      have hadd : latticePoint qx qy + latticePoint (d 0) (d 1) =
          latticePoint (qx + d 0) (qy + d 1) := by
        funext k
        fin_cases k <;> rfl
      rw [hadd]
      exact markerZero_one_mem_of_box_global (by omega) (by omega)
        (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  · have hMtwo : 2 ≤ M := by omega
    have hy : ∃ qy : ℤ,
        0 ≤ qy ∧ qy ≤ (markerSide M : ℤ) - 1 ∧
        0 ≤ qy + d 1 ∧ qy + d 1 ≤ (markerSide M : ℤ) - 1 ∧
        (qy ≤ 1 ∨ 5 ≤ qy) ∧ (qy + d 1 ≤ 1 ∨ 5 ≤ qy + d 1) := by
      by_cases hdyNeg : d 1 < 0
      · by_cases hdyOne : d 1 = -1
        · exact ⟨1, by omega⟩
        · exact ⟨7, by omega⟩
      · by_cases hdyLow : d 1 ≤ 1
        · exact ⟨0, by omega⟩
        · by_cases hdyMid : d 1 ≤ 4
          · exact ⟨5, by omega⟩
          · exact ⟨0, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨qy, hqy0, hqyN, hqdy0, hqdyN, hqySafe, hqdySafe⟩ := hy
    have hqSquare : latticePoint qx qy ∈ markerSquare M := by
      rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
      simp only [latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one]
      omega
    have hq : latticePoint qx qy ∈ markerZero M := by
      apply markerZero_mem_of_safe_row hqSquare hqySafe
      · intro h
        have h0 := congrFun h 0
        simp only [markerWestHole, latticePoint_apply_zero] at h0
        omega
      · intro h
        have h0 := congrFun h 0
        simp only [markerSouthHole, latticePoint_apply_zero] at h0
        omega
    refine ⟨latticePoint qx qy, hq, ?_⟩
    have hdEq : d = latticePoint (d 0) (d 1) := by
      funext k
      fin_cases k <;> rfl
    rw [hdEq]
    have hadd : latticePoint qx qy + latticePoint (d 0) (d 1) =
        latticePoint (qx + d 0) (qy + d 1) := by
      funext k
      fin_cases k <;> rfl
    rw [hadd]
    apply markerZero_mem_of_safe_row
    · rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
      simp only [latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one]
      omega
    · simpa only [latticePoint_apply_one] using hqdySafe
    · intro h
      have h0 := congrFun h 0
      simp only [markerWestHole, latticePoint_apply_zero] at h0
      omega
    · intro h
      have h0 := congrFun h 0
      simp only [markerSouthHole, latticePoint_apply_zero] at h0
      omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.planarRasterTile_translation_differences_mem_markerLattice
statement:
theorem planarRasterTile_translation_differences_mem_markerLattice
    {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (tile : Fin M → Finset IntegerPlane)
    (hzeroTile : (tile ⟨0, hM⟩).Nonempty)
    {U : Set IntegerPlane} (hU : TilesUniverse (planarRasterTile tile) U)
    {t u : IntegerPlane} (ht : t ∈ U) (hu : u ∈ U) :
    t - u ∈ markerLattice M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hzeroTile
  let v₀ := markerScale M g + t
  let w₀ := markerScale M g + u
  have hv₀ : v₀ ∈ zeroMarkerPlacements hM tile U :=
    mem_zeroMarkerPlacements_iff.mpr ⟨g, hg, t, ht, rfl⟩
  have hw₀ : w₀ ∈ zeroMarkerPlacements hM tile U :=
    mem_zeroMarkerPlacements_iff.mpr ⟨g, hg, u, hu, rfl⟩
  have hside : 7 ≤ (markerSide M : ℤ) := by
    simp only [markerSide, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    omega
  obtain ⟨vx, wx, hxlo, hxhi⟩ :=
    exists_nat_shifts_controlled (markerSide M : ℤ) (v₀ 0) (w₀ 0) hside
  obtain ⟨vy, wy, hylo, hyhi⟩ :=
    exists_nat_shifts_controlled (markerSide M : ℤ) (v₀ 1) (w₀ 1) hside
  let v' := v₀ - (vx : ℤ) • markerScale M horizontalUnit -
    (vy : ℤ) • markerScale M verticalUnit
  let w' := w₀ - (wx : ℤ) • markerScale M horizontalUnit -
    (wy : ℤ) • markerScale M verticalUnit
  have hv' : v' ∈ zeroMarkerPlacements hM tile U :=
    zeroMarkerPlacements_sub_nat_pair hM tile hU hv₀ vx vy
  have hw' : w' ∈ zeroMarkerPlacements hM tile U :=
    zeroMarkerPlacements_sub_nat_pair hM tile hU hw₀ wx wy
  let d := v' - w'
  have hdxlo : -2 ≤ d 0 := by
    dsimp only [d, v', w']
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, markerScale, smul_eq_mul,
      horizontalUnit, verticalUnit, latticePoint_apply_zero, mul_zero, mul_one, sub_zero]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hxlo
  have hdxhi : d 0 ≤ (markerSide M : ℤ) - 3 := by
    dsimp only [d, v', w']
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, markerScale, smul_eq_mul,
      horizontalUnit, verticalUnit, latticePoint_apply_zero, mul_zero, mul_one, sub_zero]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hxhi
  have hdylo : -2 ≤ d 1 := by
    dsimp only [d, v', w']
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, markerScale, smul_eq_mul,
      horizontalUnit, verticalUnit, latticePoint_apply_one, mul_zero, mul_one, sub_zero]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hylo
  have hdyhi : d 1 ≤ (markerSide M : ℤ) - 3 := by
    dsimp only [d, v', w']
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, markerScale, smul_eq_mul,
      horizontalUnit, verticalUnit, latticePoint_apply_one, mul_zero, mul_one, sub_zero]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hyhi
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqd⟩ :=
    markerZero_overlap_of_controlled hM hdxlo hdxhi hdylo hdyhi
  obtain ⟨gv, hgv, tv, htv, hgvEq⟩ := mem_zeroMarkerPlacements_iff.mp hv'
  obtain ⟨gw, hgw, tw, htw, hgwEq⟩ := mem_zeroMarkerPlacements_iff.mp hw'
  have hzero : (⟨0, hM⟩ : Fin M).val = 0 := rfl
  let a := markerScale M gv + q
  let b := markerScale M gw + (q + d)
  have ha : a ∈ planarRasterTile tile := by
    exact mem_planarRasterTile_iff.mpr
      ⟨⟨0, hM⟩, gv, hgv, q, by rwa [markerBlock, if_pos hzero], rfl⟩
  have hb : b ∈ planarRasterTile tile := by
    exact mem_planarRasterTile_iff.mpr
      ⟨⟨0, hM⟩, gw, hgw, q + d, by rwa [markerBlock, if_pos hzero], rfl⟩
  have hab : a + tv = b + tw := by
    dsimp only [a, b]
    calc
      markerScale M gv + q + tv = q + (markerScale M gv + tv) := by abel
      _ = q + v' := by rw [hgvEq]
      _ = (q + d) + w' := by dsimp only [d]; abel
      _ = markerScale M gw + (q + d) + tw := by rw [← hgwEq]; abel
  have htveq : tv = tw :=
    translation_eq_of_eq_representations hU ha htv hb htw hab
  have hdLattice : d ∈ markerLattice M := by
    rw [mem_markerLattice_iff]
    refine ⟨gv - gw, ?_⟩
    change markerScale M (gv - gw) = d
    rw [markerScale_sub]
    dsimp only [d]
    rw [← hgvEq, ← hgwEq, htveq]
    abel
  have hhorizontal : markerScale M horizontalUnit ∈ markerLattice M :=
    markerScale_mem_markerLattice M horizontalUnit
  have hvertical : markerScale M verticalUnit ∈ markerLattice M :=
    markerScale_mem_markerLattice M verticalUnit
  have hshift :
      (((vx : ℤ) - wx) • markerScale M horizontalUnit +
        ((vy : ℤ) - wy) • markerScale M verticalUnit) ∈ markerLattice M :=
    (markerLattice M).add_mem
      ((markerLattice M).zsmul_mem hhorizontal ((vx : ℤ) - wx))
      ((markerLattice M).zsmul_mem hvertical ((vy : ℤ) - wy))
  have hsum := (markerLattice M).add_mem hdLattice hshift
  convert hsum using 1
  dsimp only [d, v', w', v₀, w₀]
  simp only [sub_smul]
  abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.exists_family_tiling_of_planarRasterTile
statement:
theorem exists_family_tiling_of_planarRasterTile {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (tile : Fin M → Finset IntegerPlane) (hzeroTile : (tile ⟨0, hM⟩).Nonempty)
    (U : Set IntegerPlane) (hraster : TilesUniverse (planarRasterTile tile) U) :
    ∃ T : Set IntegerPlane, ∀ i, TilesUniverse (tile i) T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, -⟩ := existsUnique_tile_representation hraster 0
  let base := -r
  have hbase : base ∈ U := by
    simpa only [base, zero_sub] using hr.2
  apply exists_family_tiling_of_planarRasterTile_coset hM tile U hraster base
  intro u hu
  exact planarRasterTile_translation_differences_mem_markerLattice
    hM tile hzeroTile hraster hu hbase

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.setScalarPeriodic_vadd
proof:
:= by
  intro x z
  simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
  have h := hA (-a + x) z
  convert h using 1
  · abel_nf

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.exists_scalarPeriodic_family_tiling_of_planarRasterTile
statement:
theorem exists_scalarPeriodic_family_tiling_of_planarRasterTile
    {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (tile : Fin M → Finset IntegerPlane)
    (hzeroTile : (tile ⟨0, hM⟩).Nonempty)
    {U : Set IntegerPlane} (hraster : TilesUniverse (planarRasterTile tile) U)
    {P : ℕ} (hperiod : SetScalarPeriodic P U) :
    ∃ T : Set IntegerPlane,
      (∀ i, TilesUniverse (tile i) T) ∧ SetScalarPeriodic P T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, -⟩ := existsUnique_tile_representation hraster 0
  let base := -r
  have hbase : base ∈ U := by
    simpa only [base, zero_sub] using hr.2
  have hcoset : ∀ u ∈ U, u - base ∈ markerLattice M := by
    intro u hu
    exact planarRasterTile_translation_differences_mem_markerLattice
      hM tile hzeroTile hraster hu hbase
  let U₀ : Set IntegerPlane := -base +ᵥ U
  have hU₀ : U₀ ⊆ markerLattice M := by
    intro x hx
    have hxU : base + x ∈ U := by
      simpa only [U₀, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, neg_neg,
        vadd_eq_add] using hx
    have hmem := hcoset (base + x) hxU
    have heq : base + x - base = x := by abel
    rwa [heq] at hmem
  let T : Set IntegerPlane := markerPreimage M U₀
  have hscaled : markerTranslationSet M T = U₀ :=
    markerTranslationSet_markerPreimage_eq_of_subset hU₀
  have hraster₀ : TilesUniverse (planarRasterTile tile) U₀ := by
    exact (tilesUniverse_vadd_translationSet_iff
      (-base) (planarRasterTile tile) U).mpr hraster
  rw [← hscaled] at hraster₀
  have hfamily := family_tilesUniverse_of_planarRasterTile hM tile T hraster₀
  have hperiod₀ : SetScalarPeriodic P U₀ :=
    setScalarPeriodic_vadd (-base) hperiod
  refine ⟨T, hfamily, ?_⟩
  intro x z
  change markerScale M (x + (P : ℤ) • z) ∈ U₀ ↔ markerScale M x ∈ U₀
  have hscale : markerScale M (x + (P : ℤ) • z) =
      markerScale M x + (P : ℤ) • markerScale M z := by
    rw [markerScale_add]
    simp only [markerScale, smul_smul]
    rw [mul_comm (markerSide M : ℤ) (P : ℤ)]
  rw [hscale]
  exact hperiod₀ (markerScale M x) (markerScale M z)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.exists_integer_tiling_iff_relevantPlanarRasterTile
statement:
theorem exists_integer_tiling_iff_relevantPlanarRasterTile
    (K : PolygonalRegion) :
    (∃ T : Set IntegerPlane, K.Tiles (integerPoint '' T)) ↔
      ∃ U : Set IntegerPlane, TilesUniverse K.relevantPlanarRasterTile U
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨T, hT⟩
    refine ⟨markerTranslationSet K.relevantSignatureCount T, ?_⟩
    exact (K.tiles_integerPoint_image_iff_relevantPlanarRasterTile T).mp hT
  · rintro ⟨U, hU⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hfamily⟩ := exists_family_tiling_of_planarRasterTile
      K.relevantSignatureCount_pos K.relevantPlanarSignatureAt
      K.relevantPlanarSignatureAt_zero_nonempty U hU
    refine ⟨T, (K.tiles_integerPoint_image_iff_relevantSignatures T).mpr ?_⟩
    exact (K.relevantPlanarSignatureAt_tilesUniverse_iff T).mp hfamily

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.IntegerSlidingReduction.plateTranslations_subset

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.IntegerSlidingReduction.quakePlatePoint_mem

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.IntegerSlidingReduction.quakePlatePoint_mem_owner
statement:
theorem quakePlatePoint_mem_owner (R : IntegerSlidingReduction K T) {u : Plane}
    (C : QuakePlate (K.signature u) R.translations R.direction) :

      R.plateTranslations (R.quakePlateOwner C)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.IntegerSlidingReduction.quakePlateTranslations_subset_owner
statement:
theorem quakePlateTranslations_subset_owner
    (R : IntegerSlidingReduction K T) {u : Plane}
    (hTiles : TilesUniverse (K.signature u) R.translations)

proof:

    (R.signatureCarrier_periodic (R.quakePlateOwner C) u)
