name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.Tiles.exists_integerSlidingReduction
statement:
theorem Tiles.exists_integerSlidingReduction
    {K : PolygonalRegion} (hK : K.HasIntegerVertices)
    {T : Set Plane} (hT : K.Tiles T) : Nonempty (IntegerSlidingReduction K T)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hv, shift, hshiftedTiles, hshiftedConnected⟩ :=
    hT.exists_integer_connected_shiftedContinuousTranslations hK
  let S := K.shiftedContinuousTranslations T (integerPoint w) shift
  obtain ⟨ibase⟩ := hshiftedConnected.nonempty
  let base : Plane := ibase.1.1
  let U : Set Plane := -base +ᵥ S
  have hUinteger : ∀ t ∈ U, IsIntegerPoint t := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at ht
    let i : (K.polygonalProtoTiling S).placements :=
      ⟨(base, ()), ibase.2⟩
    let j : (K.polygonalProtoTiling S).placements :=
      ⟨(-(-base) +ᵥ t, ()), ht⟩
    have hreach : (K.polygonalProtoTiling S).SamePlate i j :=
      hshiftedConnected i j
    have hdifference := samePlate_translation_sub_mem_integerLattice hK hreach
    change t ∈ integerLattice
    convert hdifference using 1
    simp only [i, j, base, vadd_eq_add]
    abel
  let Z : Set IntegerPlane := integerTranslationSet U
  have himageZ : integerPoint '' Z = U :=
    integerPoint_image_integerTranslationSet hUinteger
  have htilesZ : K.Tiles (integerPoint '' Z) := by
    rw [himageZ]
    exact hshiftedTiles.vadd (-base)
  let P : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate → Set IntegerPlane :=
    fun C ↦ integerTranslationSet
      (-base +ᵥ K.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations T (integerPoint w) shift C)
  have hpieceSubset (C : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate) :
      K.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations T (integerPoint w) shift C ⊆ S := by
    intro x hx
    exact K.mem_shiftedContinuousTranslations_iff.mpr ⟨C, hx⟩
  have hPinteger (C : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate) :
      ∀ t ∈ -base +ᵥ
          K.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations T (integerPoint w) shift C,
        IsIntegerPoint t := by
    intro t ht
    apply hUinteger t
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at ht ⊢
    exact hpieceSubset C ht
  have himageP (C : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate) :
      integerPoint '' P C =
        -base +ᵥ K.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations T (integerPoint w) shift C :=
    integerPoint_image_integerTranslationSet (hPinteger C)
  have hpairP : Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ P := by
    intro C _ D _ hCD
    change Disjoint (P C) (P D)
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzC hzD
    have hzC' : integerPoint z ∈
        -base +ᵥ K.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations T (integerPoint w) shift C := hzC
    have hzD' : integerPoint z ∈
        -base +ᵥ K.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations T (integerPoint w) shift D := hzD
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hzC' hzD'
    exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (PolygonalRegion.IsSlidingDirection.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations_pairwiseDisjoint
        hv hT shift
          (Set.mem_univ C) (Set.mem_univ D) hCD)) hzC' hzD'
  have hunionP : (⋃ C, P C) = Z := by
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, P, Z, mem_integerTranslationSet_iff]
    change (∃ C, integerPoint z ∈
        -base +ᵥ K.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations T (integerPoint w) shift C) ↔
      integerPoint z ∈ U
    simp only [U, S, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, neg_neg,
      K.mem_shiftedContinuousTranslations_iff]
  have hperiodP (C : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate) (u : Plane) :
      DiscretePeriodicBy (discreteCarrier (K.signature u) (P C)) w := by
    apply K.signatureCarrier_periodic_of_integerTranslationCarrier
    rw [K.integerTranslationCarrier_eq_translationCarrier_image, himageP C]
    exact PolygonalRegion.IsSlidingDirection.setPeriodicBy_translatedShiftedPlateCarrier
      hv shift C
  exact ⟨{
    direction := w
    direction_ne_zero := hw
    sliding := hv
    shift := shift
    base := base
    translations := Z
    plateTranslations := P
    shifted_connected := hshiftedConnected
    image_translations := himageZ
    image_plateTranslations := himageP
    tiles := htilesZ
    plate_pairwiseDisjoint := hpairP
    iUnion_plateTranslations := hunionP
    signatureCarrier_periodic := hperiodP
  }⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.mem_continuousPlateTranslations_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_continuousPlateTranslations_iff
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane}
    {C : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate} {t : Plane} :
    t ∈ K.continuousPlateTranslations T C ↔
      ∃ ht : t ∈ T,
        (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk
          (⟨(t, ()), ht⟩ : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).placements) = C
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.mem_continuousPlateTranslations_mk
statement:
theorem mem_continuousPlateTranslations_mk
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane}
    (i : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).placements) :
    i.1.1 ∈ K.continuousPlateTranslations T
      ((K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨i.2, ?_⟩
  congr 1

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.iUnion_continuousPlateTranslations
statement:
theorem iUnion_continuousPlateTranslations
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set Plane) :
    (⋃ C : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate,
      K.continuousPlateTranslations T C) = T
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  constructor
  · rintro ht
    obtain ⟨C, htC⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp ht
    exact Classical.choose htC
  · intro ht
    let i : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).placements := ⟨(t, ()), ht⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      ⟨(K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i,
        by simpa only [i] using K.mem_continuousPlateTranslations_mk i⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.continuousPlateTranslations_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem continuousPlateTranslations_pairwiseDisjoint
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set Plane) :
    Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ
      (fun C : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate ↦
        K.continuousPlateTranslations T C)
proof:
:= by
  intro C _ D _ hCD
  change Disjoint (K.continuousPlateTranslations T C)
    (K.continuousPlateTranslations T D)
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro t htC htD
  obtain ⟨ht, hiC⟩ := htC
  obtain ⟨ht', hiD⟩ := htD
  apply hCD
  rw [← hiC, ← hiD]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.mem_translationCarrier_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_translationCarrier_iff
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {S : Set Plane} {x : Plane} :
    x ∈ K.translationCarrier S ↔
      ∃ y ∈ K.support, ∃ t ∈ S, x = y + t
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.translationCarrier_vadd
statement:
theorem translationCarrier_vadd
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (a : Plane) (S : Set Plane) :
    K.translationCarrier (a +ᵥ S) = a +ᵥ K.translationCarrier S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, t, ht, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := ht
    refine ⟨y + s, ⟨y, hy, s, hs, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [vadd_eq_add]
    abel
  · rintro ⟨z, ⟨y, hy, s, hs, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨y, hy, a + s, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [vadd_eq_add]
    abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.integerTranslationCarrier_eq_translationCarrier_image
statement:
theorem integerTranslationCarrier_eq_translationCarrier_image
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (S : Set IntegerPlane) :
    K.integerTranslationCarrier S = K.translationCarrier (integerPoint '' S)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, t, ht, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y, hy, integerPoint t, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, _, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y, hy, t, ht, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.signatureCarrier_periodic_of_integerTranslationCarrier
statement:
theorem signatureCarrier_periodic_of_integerTranslationCarrier
    (K : PolygonalRegion) {S : Set IntegerPlane} {w : IntegerPlane}
    (hperiod : SetPeriodicBy (K.integerTranslationCarrier S) (integerPoint w))
    (u : Plane) :
    DiscretePeriodicBy (discreteCarrier (K.signature u) S) w
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  rw [← K.mem_integerTranslationCarrier_iff_mem_discreteCarrier_signature S
      (u := u) (x := u + integerPoint (q + w)) (q := q + w) rfl,
    ← K.mem_integerTranslationCarrier_iff_mem_discreteCarrier_signature S
      (u := u) (x := u + integerPoint q) (q := q) rfl]
  simpa only [integerPoint_add, add_assoc] using hperiod (u + integerPoint q)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.plateCarrier_eq_translationCarrier
statement:
theorem plateCarrier_eq_translationCarrier
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set Plane)
    (C : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate) :
    (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).plateCarrier C =
      K.translationCarrier (K.continuousPlateTranslations T C)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨i, hiC, hxi⟩ :=
      (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).mem_plateCarrier_iff.mp hx
    change x ∈ i.1.1 +ᵥ K.support at hxi
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hxi
    refine ⟨-i.1.1 +ᵥ x, hxi, i.1.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨i.2, ?_⟩
      have hiCeq : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i = C :=
        (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C i).mp hiC
      rw [← hiCeq]
    · simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      abel
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, t, ⟨ht, hiC⟩, rfl⟩
    apply (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).mem_plateCarrier_iff.mpr
    let i : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).placements := ⟨(t, ()), ht⟩
    refine ⟨i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change i ∈ C.supp
      apply (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C i).mpr
      simpa only [i] using hiC
    · change y + t ∈ t +ᵥ K.support
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      convert hy using 1
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.Tiles.exists_integerSlidingDirection
statement:
theorem Tiles.exists_integerSlidingDirection
    {K : PolygonalRegion} (hK : K.HasIntegerVertices)
    {T : Set Plane} (hT : K.Tiles T) :
    ∃ w : IntegerPlane, w ≠ 0 ∧
      (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).IsSlidingDirection (integerPoint w)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A := K.polygonalProtoTiling T
  by_cases hplates : Subsingleton A.Plate
  · let w : IntegerPlane := ![1, 0]
    have hw : w ≠ 0 := by
      intro hw
      have := congrArg (fun z : IntegerPlane ↦ z 0) hw
      norm_num [w] at this
    refine ⟨w, hw, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨fun hwzero ↦
      hw (integerPoint_injective (hwzero.trans integerPoint_zero.symm)), ?_⟩
    intro C r
    have hcarrier : A.plateCarrier C = Set.univ := by
      rw [← A.iUnion_plateCarrier_eq_univ hT]
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨C, hx⟩
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨D, hxD⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
        simpa only [hplates.elim D C] using hxD
    rw [AddAction.mem_stabilizer_iff, hcarrier]
    simp
  · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := A.exists_isSlidingDirection hT
    obtain ⟨C, D, hCD, x, hxC, hxD⟩ :=
      A.exists_distinct_plate_carrier_contact hT hplates
    obtain ⟨i, t, ht, hi⟩ :=
      A.exists_placedVertex_on_invariant_contact_line hT hv hCD hxC hxD
    let x' : Plane := (t + 1) • v +ᵥ x
    have hx'C : x' ∈ A.plateCarrier C := by
      rw [← hv.vadd_plateCarrier C (t + 1)]
      exact ⟨x, hxC, rfl⟩
    have hx'D : x' ∈ A.plateCarrier D := by
      rw [← hv.vadd_plateCarrier D (t + 1)]
      exact ⟨x, hxD, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨j, s, hs, hj⟩ :=
      A.exists_placedVertex_on_invariant_contact_line hT hv hCD hx'C hx'D
    let p : Plane := t • v +ᵥ x
    let p' : Plane := s • v +ᵥ x'
    let u : Plane := -i.1.1.1 +ᵥ p
    let u' : Plane := -j.1.1.1 +ᵥ p'
    have hu : u ∈ vertexSet K.support := by
      change p ∈ A.placedVertexSet (i : A.placements) at hi
      change p ∈ i.1.1.1 +ᵥ vertexSet K.support at hi
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hi
      exact hi
    have hu' : u' ∈ vertexSet K.support := by
      change p' ∈ A.placedVertexSet (j : A.placements) at hj
      change p' ∈ j.1.1.1 +ᵥ vertexSet K.support at hj
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hj
      exact hj
    have hiComp : A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk (i : A.placements) = C :=
      (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C (i : A.placements)).mp i.2
    have hjComp : A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk (j : A.placements) = C :=
      (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C (j : A.placements)).mp j.2
    have hijPlate : A.SamePlate (i : A.placements) (j : A.placements) := by
      rw [A.samePlate_iff_component_eq]
      exact hiComp.trans hjComp.symm
    have htranslations : j.1.1.1 - i.1.1.1 ∈ integerLattice :=
      samePlate_translation_sub_mem_integerLattice hK hijPlate
    have hvertices : u' - u ∈ integerLattice :=
      AddSubgroup.sub_mem integerLattice (hK u' hu') (hK u hu)
    have hpint : p' - p ∈ integerLattice := by
      have hsum := AddSubgroup.add_mem integerLattice htranslations hvertices
      convert hsum using 1
      simp only [u, u', vadd_eq_add]
      abel
    have hpdiff : p' - p = (s + 1) • v := by
      simp only [p, p', x', vadd_eq_add, add_smul]
      module
    have hsone : s + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hpne : p' - p ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hpdiff]
      exact smul_ne_zero hsone hv.ne_zero
    obtain ⟨w, hwpoint⟩ := mem_integerLattice_iff.mp hpint
    have hw : w ≠ 0 := by
      intro hw
      apply hpne
      rw [← hwpoint, hw, integerPoint_zero]
    refine ⟨w, hw, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨fun hwzero ↦
      hw (integerPoint_injective (hwzero.trans integerPoint_zero.symm)), ?_⟩
    intro E r
    have hwparallel : integerPoint w = (s + 1) • v := hwpoint.trans hpdiff
    rw [hwparallel, smul_smul]
    exact hv.invariant E (r * (s + 1))

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.translationCarrier_shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations
statement:
theorem translationCarrier_shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set Plane) (v : Plane)
    (shift : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate → ℝ)
    (C : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate) :
    K.translationCarrier (K.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations T v shift C) =
      shift C • v +ᵥ (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).plateCarrier C
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations, K.translationCarrier_vadd,
    K.plateCarrier_eq_translationCarrier]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.IsSlidingDirection.setPeriodicBy_plateCarrier
statement:
theorem IsSlidingDirection.setPeriodicBy_plateCarrier
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane} {v : Plane}
    (hv : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).IsSlidingDirection v)
    (C : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate) :
    SetPeriodicBy ((K.polygonalProtoTiling T).plateCarrier C) v
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have hcarrier := hv.vadd_plateCarrier C 1
  have hmem := congrArg (fun S : Set Plane ↦ x + v ∈ S) hcarrier
  simp only [one_smul, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem,
    vadd_eq_add] at hmem
  have hcancel : -v + (x + v) = x := by abel
  rw [hcancel] at hmem
  exact eq_iff_iff.mp hmem.symm

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.IsSlidingDirection.setPeriodicBy_translatedShiftedPlateCarrier
statement:
theorem IsSlidingDirection.setPeriodicBy_translatedShiftedPlateCarrier
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane} {v a : Plane}
    (hv : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).IsSlidingDirection v)
    (shift : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate → ℝ)
    (C : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate) :
    SetPeriodicBy
      (K.translationCarrier
        (a +ᵥ K.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations T v shift C)) v
proof:
:= by
  rw [K.translationCarrier_vadd,
    K.translationCarrier_shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations]
  exact setPeriodicBy_vadd a
    (setPeriodicBy_vadd (shift C • v)
      (PolygonalRegion.IsSlidingDirection.setPeriodicBy_plateCarrier hv C))

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.mem_shiftedContinuousTranslations_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_shiftedContinuousTranslations_iff
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane} {v : Plane}
    {shift : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate → ℝ} {t : Plane} :
    t ∈ K.shiftedContinuousTranslations T v shift ↔
      ∃ C, t ∈ K.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations T v shift C
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shiftedContinuousTranslations, Set.mem_iUnion]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.placements_shiftedContinuousTranslations
statement:
theorem placements_shiftedContinuousTranslations
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set Plane) (v : Plane)
    (shift : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate → ℝ) :
    K.placements (K.shiftedContinuousTranslations T v shift) =
      ((K.polygonalProtoTiling T).shiftComponents v shift).placements
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨C, s, hsC, hsp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
    obtain ⟨hsT, hiC⟩ := hsC
    let i : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).placements := ⟨(s, ()), hsT⟩
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · change s + shift ((K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i) • v = p.1
      rw [show (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i = C by
        simpa only [i] using hiC]
      change shift C • v + s = p.1 at hsp
      simpa only [add_comm] using hsp
    · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨(K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i, ?_⟩
    change ((K.polygonalProtoTiling T).shiftedPlacement v shift i).1 ∈
      shift ((K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i) • v +ᵥ
        K.continuousPlateTranslations T
          ((K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i)
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    convert K.mem_continuousPlateTranslations_mk i using 1
    simp only [PolygonalProtoTiling.shiftedPlacement_translation, vadd_eq_add]
    module

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.IsSlidingDirection.tiles_shiftedContinuousTranslations
statement:
theorem IsSlidingDirection.tiles_shiftedContinuousTranslations
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane} {v : Plane}
    (hv : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).IsSlidingDirection v)
    (hT : K.Tiles T)
    (shift : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate → ℝ) :
    K.Tiles (K.shiftedContinuousTranslations T v shift)
proof:
:= by
  change IsTiling K.prototileFamily
    (K.placements (K.shiftedContinuousTranslations T v shift))
  rw [K.placements_shiftedContinuousTranslations]
  simpa using
    (PolygonalProtoTiling.IsSlidingDirection.isTiling_shiftComponents
      (K.polygonalProtoTiling T) hv hT shift)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.IsSlidingDirection.shiftedVertex_injective
statement:
theorem IsSlidingDirection.shiftedVertex_injective
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane} {v : Plane}
    (hv : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).IsSlidingDirection v)
    (hT : K.Tiles T)
    (shift : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate → ℝ) :
    Function.Injective
      ((K.polygonalProtoTiling T).shiftedVertex v shift)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  let A := K.polygonalProtoTiling T
  let C := A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i
  let D := A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk j
  by_cases hCD : C = D
  · exact A.shiftedVertex_injective_of_component_eq v shift hCD hij
  have htileEq :
      placedTile A.prototiles (A.shiftedPlacement v shift i) =
        placedTile A.prototiles (A.shiftedPlacement v shift j) := by
    congr 1
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hij
  have htileNonempty :
      (placedTile A.prototiles (A.shiftedPlacement v shift i)).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := K.nonempty
    refine ⟨(A.shiftedPlacement v shift i).1 + x, ?_⟩
    change (A.shiftedPlacement v shift i).1 + x ∈
      (A.shiftedPlacement v shift i).1 +ᵥ K.support
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simpa only [vadd_eq_add, neg_add_cancel_left] using hx
  have hinterior :
      (interior (placedTile A.prototiles
        (A.shiftedPlacement v shift i))).Nonempty :=
    (A.isPolygonal_placedTile (A.shiftedPlacement v shift i)).interior_nonempty
      htileNonempty
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hinterior
  have hsubsetC : placedTile A.prototiles (A.shiftedPlacement v shift i) ⊆
      A.plateCarrier C := by
    rw [A.placedTile_shiftedPlacement]
    intro y hy
    rw [← hv.vadd_plateCarrier C (shift C)]
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨z, A.placedTile_subset_plateCarrier i hz, rfl⟩
  have hsubsetD : placedTile A.prototiles (A.shiftedPlacement v shift i) ⊆
      A.plateCarrier D := by
    rw [htileEq, A.placedTile_shiftedPlacement]
    intro y hy
    rw [← hv.vadd_plateCarrier D (shift D)]
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨z, A.placedTile_subset_plateCarrier j hz, rfl⟩
  have hxC : x ∈ interior (A.plateCarrier C) := interior_mono hsubsetC hx
  have hxD : x ∈ interior (A.plateCarrier D) := interior_mono hsubsetD hx
  have hpositive : 0 < volume
      (interior (A.plateCarrier C) ∩ interior (A.plateCarrier D)) :=
    (isOpen_interior.inter isOpen_interior).measure_pos volume ⟨x, hxC, hxD⟩
  have hzero : volume
      (interior (A.plateCarrier C) ∩ interior (A.plateCarrier D)) = 0 :=
    measure_mono_null (Set.inter_subset_inter interior_subset interior_subset)
      (A.plateCarrier_aedisjoint hT hCD).eq
  exact (ne_of_gt hpositive hzero).elim

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.IsSlidingDirection.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem IsSlidingDirection.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations_pairwiseDisjoint
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane} {v : Plane}
    (hv : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).IsSlidingDirection v)
    (hT : K.Tiles T)
    (shift : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate → ℝ) :
    Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ
      (K.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations T v shift)
proof:
:= by
  intro C _ D _ hCD
  change Disjoint (K.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations T v shift C)
    (K.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations T v shift D)
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro t htC htD
  obtain ⟨s, ⟨hsT, hsC⟩, hsEq⟩ := htC
  obtain ⟨r, ⟨hrT, hrD⟩, hrEq⟩ := htD
  let i : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).placements := ⟨(s, ()), hsT⟩
  let j : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).placements := ⟨(r, ()), hrT⟩
  have hshifted : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).shiftedVertex v shift i =
      (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).shiftedVertex v shift j := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext
    · change s + shift ((K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i) • v =
        r + shift ((K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk j) • v
      rw [show (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i = C by
        simpa only [i] using hsC]
      rw [show (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk j = D by
        simpa only [j] using hrD]
      change shift C • v + s = t at hsEq
      change shift D • v + r = t at hrEq
      calc
        s + shift C • v = shift C • v + s := add_comm _ _
        _ = t := hsEq
        _ = shift D • v + r := hrEq.symm
        _ = r + shift D • v := add_comm _ _
    · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hij :=
    PolygonalRegion.IsSlidingDirection.shiftedVertex_injective hv hT shift hshifted
  have hcomponents :
      (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i =
        (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk j :=
    congrArg
      (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk hij
  apply hCD
  calc
    C = (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i := by
      simpa only [i] using hsC.symm
    _ = (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk j := hcomponents
    _ = D := by simpa only [j] using hrD

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.IsSlidingDirection.exists_connected_shiftedContinuousTranslations
statement:
theorem IsSlidingDirection.exists_connected_shiftedContinuousTranslations
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane} {v : Plane}
    (hv : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).IsSlidingDirection v)
    (hT : K.Tiles T) :
    ∃ shift : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).Plate → ℝ,
      K.Tiles (K.shiftedContinuousTranslations T v shift) ∧
      (K.polygonalProtoTiling
        (K.shiftedContinuousTranslations T v shift)).vertexGraph.Connected
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨shift, hshifted, hconnected⟩ :=
    PolygonalProtoTiling.IsSlidingDirection.exists_connected_component_shift
      (K.polygonalProtoTiling T) hv hT
  refine ⟨shift, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change IsTiling K.prototileFamily
      (K.placements (K.shiftedContinuousTranslations T v shift))
    rw [K.placements_shiftedContinuousTranslations]
    simpa using hshifted
  have hplacements := K.placements_shiftedContinuousTranslations T v shift
  let B := K.polygonalProtoTiling (K.shiftedContinuousTranslations T v shift)
  let B' := (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).shiftComponents v shift
  let e : B.placements ≃ B'.placements := Equiv.setCongr hplacements
  let φ : B.vertexGraph ≃g B'.vertexGraph := {
    toEquiv := e
    map_rel_iff' := by
      intro i j
      have hei : (e i : Placement Plane Unit) = (i : Placement Plane Unit) := rfl
      have hej : (e j : Placement Plane Unit) = (j : Placement Plane Unit) := rfl
      have hvertex_i : B'.placedVertexSet (e i) = B.placedVertexSet i := by
        change (e i : Placement Plane Unit).1 +ᵥ
            vertexSet (K.prototileFamily (e i : Placement Plane Unit).2).support =
          (i : Placement Plane Unit).1 +ᵥ
            vertexSet (K.prototileFamily (i : Placement Plane Unit).2).support
        rw [hei]
      have hvertex_j : B'.placedVertexSet (e j) = B.placedVertexSet j := by
        change (e j : Placement Plane Unit).1 +ᵥ
            vertexSet (K.prototileFamily (e j : Placement Plane Unit).2).support =
          (j : Placement Plane Unit).1 +ᵥ
            vertexSet (K.prototileFamily (j : Placement Plane Unit).2).support
        rw [hej]
      rw [B.vertexGraph_adj, B'.vertexGraph_adj]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hij, hvertex⟩
        refine ⟨fun heq ↦ hij (congrArg e heq), ?_⟩
        simpa only [PolygonalProtoTiling.VertexConnected,
          hvertex_i, hvertex_j] using hvertex
      · rintro ⟨hij, hvertex⟩
        refine ⟨fun heq ↦ hij (e.injective heq), ?_⟩
        simpa only [PolygonalProtoTiling.VertexConnected,
          hvertex_i, hvertex_j] using hvertex
  }
  exact φ.connected_iff.mpr hconnected

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.Tiles.exists_connected_shiftedContinuousTranslations
statement:
theorem Tiles.exists_connected_shiftedContinuousTranslations
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane} (hT : K.Tiles T) :
    ∃ (v : Plane)
        (_hv : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).IsSlidingDirection v)

        (K.shiftedContinuousTranslations T v shift)).vertexGraph.Connected
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).exists_isSlidingDirection hT
  obtain ⟨shift, htiles, hconnected⟩ :=
    PolygonalRegion.IsSlidingDirection.exists_connected_shiftedContinuousTranslations hv hT

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.Tiles.exists_integer_connected_shiftedContinuousTranslations

theorem Tiles.exists_integer_connected_shiftedContinuousTranslations
    {K : PolygonalRegion} (hK : K.HasIntegerVertices)
    {T : Set Plane} (hT : K.Tiles T) :

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint_isClosedEmbedding
statement:
theorem integerPoint_isClosedEmbedding :
    Topology.IsClosedEmbedding integerPoint
proof:
:= by
  let hcoords : IntegerPlane ≃ₜ ℤ × ℤ := Homeomorph.finTwoArrow
  have hpair : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding (Prod.map ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ) ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)) :=
    Int.isClosedEmbedding_coe_real.prodMap Int.isClosedEmbedding_coe_real
  have hrealPair : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding
      (fun z : IntegerPlane ↦ ((z 0 : ℝ), (z 1 : ℝ))) := by
    convert hpair.comp hcoords.isClosedEmbedding using 1
    funext z
    change ((z 0 : ℝ), (z 1 : ℝ)) =
      Prod.map ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ) ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ) (z 0, z 1)
    rfl
  have hcomplex :=
    Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm.toHomeomorph.isClosedEmbedding.comp hrealPair
  convert hcomplex using 1
  funext z
  change integerPoint z = Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm ((z 0 : ℝ), (z 1 : ℝ))
  rw [Complex.equivRealProdCLM_symm_apply]
  rfl

theorem mem_normalizedTranslations_iff {K : RationalPolygonalRegion}

    x ∈ K.normalizedTranslations T ↔
      ∃ t ∈ T, K.normalizedTranslation t = x
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedTranslation_injective
statement:
theorem normalizedTranslation_injective (K : RationalPolygonalRegion) :
    Function.Injective K.normalizedTranslation
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply add_left_cancel (a := K.anchor)
  exact (smul_right_injective Plane K.denominator_cast_ne_zero) hxy

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.mem_denormalizedTranslations_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_denormalizedTranslations_iff {K : RationalPolygonalRegion}
    {T : Set Plane} {x : Plane} :

proof:

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.denormalizedTranslation_normalizedTranslation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem denormalizedTranslation_normalizedTranslation
    (K : RationalPolygonalRegion) (t : Plane) :
    K.denormalizedTranslation (K.normalizedTranslation t) = t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [denormalizedTranslation, normalizedTranslation, ← mul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ K.denominator_cast_ne_zero, one_smul]
  abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedTranslation_denormalizedTranslation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedTranslation_denormalizedTranslation
    (K : RationalPolygonalRegion) (t : Plane) :
    K.normalizedTranslation (K.denormalizedTranslation t) = t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalizedTranslation, denormalizedTranslation]
  rw [show K.anchor + ((K.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ • t - K.anchor) =
      (K.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ • t by abel]
  rw [← mul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ K.denominator_cast_ne_zero, one_smul]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.denormalizedTranslation_injective
statement:
theorem denormalizedTranslation_injective (K : RationalPolygonalRegion) :
    Function.Injective K.denormalizedTranslation
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have := congrArg K.normalizedTranslation hxy
  simpa only [K.normalizedTranslation_denormalizedTranslation] using this

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.mem_denormalizedTranslations_iff_normalizedTranslation_mem
statement:
theorem mem_denormalizedTranslations_iff_normalizedTranslation_mem
    (K : RationalPolygonalRegion) {A : Set Plane} {x : Plane} :
    x ∈ K.denormalizedTranslations A ↔ K.normalizedTranslation x ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    simpa only [K.normalizedTranslation_denormalizedTranslation] using ht
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨K.normalizedTranslation x, hx,
      K.denormalizedTranslation_normalizedTranslation x⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedTranslation_add_denormalizedPeriod
statement:
theorem normalizedTranslation_add_denormalizedPeriod
    (K : RationalPolygonalRegion) (x h : Plane) :
    K.normalizedTranslation (x + (K.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ • h) =
      K.normalizedTranslation x + h
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalizedTranslation, smul_add]
  rw [← mul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ K.denominator_cast_ne_zero, one_smul]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.setPeriodicBy_denormalizedTranslations
statement:
theorem setPeriodicBy_denormalizedTranslations
    (K : RationalPolygonalRegion) {A : Set Plane} {h : Plane}
    (hA : SetPeriodicBy A h) :
    SetPeriodicBy (K.denormalizedTranslations A)
      ((K.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ • h)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  rw [K.mem_denormalizedTranslations_iff_normalizedTranslation_mem,
    K.mem_denormalizedTranslations_iff_normalizedTranslation_mem,
    K.normalizedTranslation_add_denormalizedPeriod]
  exact hA (K.normalizedTranslation x)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.weaklyPeriodic_denormalizedTranslations
statement:

proof:

  obtain ⟨D⟩ := hA

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.normalized_vertex_integral
statement:
theorem normalized_vertex_integral (K : RationalPolygonalRegion) :
    ∀ w ∈ vertexSet K.normalizedSupport, IsIntegerPoint w
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  rw [normalizedSupport, vertexSet_smul _ K.denominator_cast_ne_zero,
    vertexSet_vadd] at hw
  obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hw
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hu
  have hu' := K.vertex_integral (-(-K.anchor) +ᵥ u) hu
  convert hu' using 1
  simp only [vadd_eq_add]
  congr 1
  abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.isRelativelyRational
statement:
theorem isRelativelyRational (K : RationalPolygonalRegion) :
    IsRelativelyRational K.toPolygonalRegion
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨K.anchor, K.anchor_mem_vertex, ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := mem_integerLattice_iff.mp (K.vertex_integral w hw)
  have hn : (K.denominator : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast K.denominator_pos.ne'
  have hre : (z 0 : ℝ) = (K.denominator : ℝ) * (w - K.anchor).re := by
    simpa only [integerPoint_re, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul] using
      congrArg Complex.re hz
  have him : (z 1 : ℝ) = (K.denominator : ℝ) * (w - K.anchor).im := by
    simpa only [integerPoint_im, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul] using
      congrArg Complex.im hz
  refine ⟨(z 0 : ℚ) / K.denominator, (z 1 : ℚ) / K.denominator, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_intCast, Rat.cast_natCast,
      eq_div_iff hn]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hre.symm
  · rw [Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_intCast, Rat.cast_natCast,
      eq_div_iff hn]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using him.symm

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_integerIntervalExec_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_integerIntervalExec_iff {lo hi z : ℤ} :
    z ∈ integerIntervalExec lo hi ↔ lo ≤ z ∧ z ≤ hi
proof:
:= by
  rw [integerIntervalExec, Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk
    have hk' : (k : ℤ) < ((hi - lo + 1).toNat : ℤ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hk
    rw [Int.ofNat_toNat] at hk'
    constructor
    · exact Int.le_add_of_nonneg_right (Int.natCast_nonneg k)
    · omega
  · rintro ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
    have hdiff : 0 ≤ z - lo := by omega
    have hspan : 0 < hi - lo + 1 := by omega
    refine ⟨(z - lo).toNat, Finset.mem_range.mpr ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (Int.toNat_lt_toNat hspan).mpr (by omega)
    · rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdiff]
      omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Decision.firstNonempty_mem
statement:
theorem firstNonempty_mem {family : List (Finset IntegerPlane)}
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} (h : firstNonempty family = some F) : F ∈ family
proof:
:= by
  induction family with
  | nil => simp [firstNonempty] at h
  | cons G family ih =>
      simp only [firstNonempty] at h
      split at h
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem G (ih h)
      · simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
        subst F
        exact List.mem_cons_self

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Decision.firstNonempty_exists_of_exists_nonempty
statement:
theorem firstNonempty_exists_of_exists_nonempty {family : List (Finset IntegerPlane)}
    (h : ∃ F ∈ family, F.Nonempty) : ∃ F, firstNonempty family = some F
proof:
:= by
  induction family with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons G family ih =>
      by_cases hG : G = ∅
      · have htail : ∃ F ∈ family, F.Nonempty := by
          obtain ⟨F, hF, hFne⟩ := h
          have hFG : F ≠ G := by
            intro hEq
            subst F
            exact hFne.ne_empty hG
          exact ⟨F, (List.mem_cons.mp hF).resolve_left hFG, hFne⟩
        obtain ⟨F, hfirst⟩ := ih htail
        exact ⟨F, by simp [firstNonempty, hG, hfirst]⟩
      · exact ⟨G, by simp [firstNonempty, hG]⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Decision.forall_fin_get_iff_forall_mem
statement:
theorem forall_fin_get_iff_forall_mem {α : Type*} (a : Array α) (Q : α → Prop) :
    (∀ i : Fin a.size, Q a[i]) ↔ ∀ x ∈ a, Q x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hix⟩ := Array.mem_iff_getElem.mp hx
    subst x
    exact h ⟨i, hi⟩
  · intro h i
    exact h a[i] (Array.getElem_mem i.isLt)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Decision.mem_cons_erase_iff
statement:
theorem mem_cons_erase_iff {α : Type*} [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α]
    {a x : α} {xs : List α} (ha : a ∈ xs) :
    x ∈ a :: xs.erase a ↔ x ∈ xs
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxa : x = a
  · subst x
    constructor
    · intro _
      exact ha
    · intro _
      exact List.mem_cons_self
  · simp only [List.mem_cons, hxa, false_or, List.mem_erase_of_ne hxa]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Decision.nonemptyRasterFamily_members
proof:
:= by
  unfold nonemptyRasterFamily? at hinput
  split at hinput
  · contradiction
  · rename_i first hfirst
    have hfirstMem : first ∈ family := firstNonempty_mem hfirst
    simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hinput
    subst input
    intro F
    simpa only [List.mem_toArray] using
      (mem_cons_erase_iff (a := first) (x := F) hfirstMem)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Decision.nonemptyRasterFamily_tiles_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨T, hT⟩
    refine ⟨T, ?_⟩
    intro F hF
    apply (forall_fin_get_iff_forall_mem input.tiles
      (fun G ↦ TilesUniverse G T)).mp hT F
    exact (nonemptyRasterFamily_members hinput F).mpr hF
  · rintro ⟨T, hT⟩
    refine ⟨T, (forall_fin_get_iff_forall_mem input.tiles
      (fun G ↦ TilesUniverse G T)).mpr ?_⟩
    intro F hF
    exact hT F ((nonemptyRasterFamily_members hinput F).mp hF)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Decision.exists_planarRasterTile_tiling_iff_family
statement:
theorem exists_planarRasterTile_tiling_iff_family {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (tile : Fin M → Finset IntegerPlane) (hzero : (tile ⟨0, hM⟩).Nonempty) :
    (∃ U : Set IntegerPlane, TilesUniverse (planarRasterTile tile) U) ↔
      ∃ T : Set IntegerPlane, ∀ i, TilesUniverse (tile i) T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨U, hU⟩
    exact exists_family_tiling_of_planarRasterTile hM tile hzero U hU
  · rintro ⟨T, hT⟩
    exact ⟨markerTranslationSet M T,
      planarRasterTile_tilesUniverse_of_family hM tile T hT⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Decision.relevantSignatures_tileable_iff
statement:
theorem relevantSignatures_tileable_iff (P : Code.Input) :
    (∃ S : Set IntegerPlane,
      ∀ F ∈ P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion.relevantSignatures,
        TilesUniverse F S) ↔
      ∃ T : Set Plane, P.rationalPolygonalRegion.toPolygonalRegion.Tiles T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨S, hS⟩
    have hnormalized : P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion.Tiles
        (integerPoint '' S) :=
      (PolygonalRegion.tiles_integerPoint_image_iff_relevantSignatures
        P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion S).mpr hS
    exact ⟨P.rationalPolygonalRegion.denormalizedTranslations (integerPoint '' S),
      P.rationalPolygonalRegion.tiles_of_normalizedRegion_tiles hnormalized⟩
  · rintro ⟨T, hT⟩
    have hnormalized := P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion_tiles hT
    obtain ⟨S, hStiles, -⟩ :=
      P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion.exists_integer_signature_tiling
        P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion_hasIntegerVertices hnormalized
    exact ⟨S, (PolygonalRegion.tiles_integerPoint_image_iff_relevantSignatures
      P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion S).mp hStiles⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Decision.nonemptyRasterFamily_exists
statement:
theorem nonemptyRasterFamily_exists (P : Code.Input) (hcorrect : SignatureFamilyCorrect P) :
    ∃ input, nonemptyRasterFamily?
      (signatureFamily (normalizedTriangles P)) = some input
proof:
:= by
  let K := P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hFne⟩ := K.exists_nonempty_relevantSignature
  have hFexec : F ∈ signatureFamily (normalizedTriangles P) := by
    have : F ∈ (signatureFamily (normalizedTriangles P)).toFinset := by
      rw [hcorrect]
      exact hF
    simpa using this
  obtain ⟨first, hfirst⟩ :=
    firstNonempty_exists_of_exists_nonempty ⟨F, hFexec, hFne⟩
  unfold nonemptyRasterFamily?
  split
  · rename_i hnone
    rw [hnone] at hfirst
    contradiction
  · exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Decision.rawTileDecision_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem rawTileDecision_eq_true_iff (P : Code.Input)
    (hcorrect : SignatureFamilyCorrect P) :
    rawTileDecision P = true ↔
      ∃ T : Set Plane, P.rationalPolygonalRegion.toPolygonalRegion.Tiles T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨input, hinput⟩ := nonemptyRasterFamily_exists P hcorrect
  rw [rawTileDecision, hinput]
  rw [planarTileDecision_eq_true_iff, planarRasterTileExec_eq_planarRasterTile]
  rw [exists_planarRasterTile_tiling_iff_family input.size_pos
    (fun i : Fin input.tiles.size ↦ input.tiles[i]) input.first_nonempty]
  rw [nonemptyRasterFamily_tiles_iff hinput]
  have hfamilies :
      (∃ T : Set IntegerPlane,
          ∀ F ∈ signatureFamily (normalizedTriangles P), TilesUniverse F T) ↔
        ∃ T : Set IntegerPlane,
          ∀ F ∈ P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion.relevantSignatures,
            TilesUniverse F T := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨T, hT⟩
      refine ⟨T, ?_⟩
      intro F hF
      apply hT F
      have : F ∈ (signatureFamily (normalizedTriangles P)).toFinset := by
        rw [hcorrect]
        exact hF
      simpa using this
    · rintro ⟨T, hT⟩
      refine ⟨T, ?_⟩
      intro F hF
      apply hT F
      rw [← hcorrect]
      simpa using hF
  rw [hfamilies]
  exact relevantSignatures_tileable_iff P

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Decision.rawTileDecision_decidesRawTileability

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_intRange_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_intRange_iff {lo hi z : ℤ} :
    z ∈ intRange lo hi ↔ lo ≤ z ∧ z ≤ hi
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intRange]
  split
  · rename_i hlohi
    rw [List.mem_map]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
      have hn' := List.mem_range.mp hn
      constructor
      · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (Int.natCast_nonneg n)
      · have hcast : (n : ℤ) < hi - lo + 1 := by
          rw [← Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega : 0 ≤ hi - lo + 1)]
          exact_mod_cast hn'
        omega
    · rintro ⟨hloz, hzhi⟩
      let n := (z - lo).toNat
      refine ⟨n, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hncast : (n : ℤ) = z - lo := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
        have hbound : (n : ℤ) < hi - lo + 1 := by omega
        rw [← Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega : 0 ≤ hi - lo + 1)] at hbound
        exact List.mem_range.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hbound)
      · have hncast : (n : ℤ) = z - lo := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
        omega
  · rename_i hnot
    simp only [List.not_mem_nil, false_iff]
    omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.cellOfSystem_sound
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cellOfSystem?] at h
  cases hs : solve qs with
  | none =>
      rw [hs] at h
      cases h
  | some p =>
      rw [hs] at h
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at h
      subst cell
      exact ⟨rfl, solve_sound hs⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.refineCell_complete
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpos : 0 < l.eval p
  · let qs := sideConstraint true l :: cell.system
    have hpqs : SatisfiesAll qs p := by
      intro q hq
      have hmem : q = sideConstraint true l ∨ q ∈ cell.system := by
        simpa only [qs, List.mem_cons] using hq
      rcases hmem with hq | hq
      · subst q
        exact (sideConstraint_true_satisfies_iff l p).mpr hpos
      · exact hp q hq
    obtain ⟨sample, hsample⟩ := solve_complete ⟨p, hpqs⟩
    let child : SignCell := ⟨qs, sample⟩
    have hcell : cellOfSystem? qs = some child :=
      cellOfSystem_eq_some_of_solve hsample
    refine ⟨child, ?_, hpqs⟩
    rw [refineCell, List.mem_filterMap]
    refine ⟨some child, ?_, rfl⟩
    simp only [List.mem_cons]
    exact Or.inr (Or.inl hcell.symm)
  · have hneg : l.eval p < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hpos) hoff
    let qs := sideConstraint false l :: cell.system
    have hpqs : SatisfiesAll qs p := by
      intro q hq
      have hmem : q = sideConstraint false l ∨ q ∈ cell.system := by
        simpa only [qs, List.mem_cons] using hq
      rcases hmem with hq | hq
      · subst q
        exact (sideConstraint_false_satisfies_iff l p).mpr hneg
      · exact hp q hq
    obtain ⟨sample, hsample⟩ := solve_complete ⟨p, hpqs⟩
    let child : SignCell := ⟨qs, sample⟩
    have hcell : cellOfSystem? qs = some child :=
      cellOfSystem_eq_some_of_solve hsample
    refine ⟨child, ?_, hpqs⟩
    rw [refineCell, List.mem_filterMap]
    refine ⟨some child, ?_, rfl⟩
    simp only [List.mem_cons]
    exact Or.inl hcell.symm

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.refineCells_complete
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨cell, hcell, hsat⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨child, hchild, hchildSat⟩ := refineCell_complete hsat hoff
  refine ⟨child, ?_, hchildSat⟩
  simp only [refineCells, List.mem_flatMap]
  exact ⟨cell, hcell, hchild⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.refineLines_complete
statement:
theorem refineLines_complete {cells : List SignCell} {ls : List ZLine} {p : ℚ × ℚ}
    (hp : ∃ cell ∈ cells, SatisfiesAll cell.system p)
    (hoff : ∀ l ∈ ls, l.eval p ≠ 0) :
    ∃ child ∈ refineLines cells ls, SatisfiesAll child.system p
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing cells with
  | nil =>
      simpa only [refineLines, List.foldl_nil] using hp
  | cons l ls ih =>
      rw [refineLines, List.foldl_cons]
      apply ih
      · exact refineCells_complete hp (hoff l (by simp))
      · intro l' hl'
        exact hoff l' (by simp only [List.mem_cons]; exact Or.inr hl')

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.feasibleSignCells_complete
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sample, hsample⟩ := solve_complete ⟨p, hunit⟩
  let base : SignCell := ⟨openUnitSquare, sample⟩
  have hbase : cellOfSystem? openUnitSquare = some base :=
    cellOfSystem_eq_some_of_solve hsample
  rw [feasibleSignCells, hbase]
  apply refineLines_complete
  · exact ⟨base, by simp, hunit⟩
  · exact hoff

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_refineCell_valid
statement:
theorem mem_refineCell_valid {l : ZLine} {cell child : SignCell}
    (hchild : child ∈ refineCell l cell) : SatisfiesAll child.system child.sample
proof:
:= by
  rw [refineCell, List.mem_filterMap] at hchild
  obtain ⟨o, ho, hid⟩ := hchild
  have ho' : o = cellOfSystem? (sideConstraint false l :: cell.system) ∨
      o = cellOfSystem? (sideConstraint true l :: cell.system) := by
    simpa only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] using ho
  change o = some child at hid
  rcases ho' with ho' | ho'
  · rw [ho'] at hid
    have hs := cellOfSystem_sound hid
    rw [hs.1]
    exact hs.2
  · rw [ho'] at hid
    have hs := cellOfSystem_sound hid
    rw [hs.1]
    exact hs.2

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_refineCells_valid
statement:
theorem mem_refineCells_valid {l : ZLine} {cells : List SignCell} {child : SignCell}
    (hchild : child ∈ refineCells l cells) : SatisfiesAll child.system child.sample
proof:
:= by
  simp only [refineCells, List.mem_flatMap] at hchild
  obtain ⟨cell, _, hc⟩ := hchild
  exact mem_refineCell_valid hc

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_refineLines_valid
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing cells with
  | nil =>
      simp only [refineLines, List.foldl_nil] at hchild
      exact hvalid child hchild
  | cons l ls ih =>
      rw [refineLines, List.foldl_cons] at hchild
      exact ih (fun cell hcell ↦ mem_refineCells_valid hcell) hchild

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.feasibleSignCells_sound
statement:
theorem feasibleSignCells_sound {ls : List ZLine} {cell : SignCell}
    (hcell : cell ∈ feasibleSignCells ls) : SatisfiesAll cell.system cell.sample
proof:
:= by
  unfold feasibleSignCells at hcell
  cases hbase : cellOfSystem? openUnitSquare with
  | none => simp [hbase] at hcell
  | some base =>
      rw [hbase] at hcell
      apply mem_refineLines_valid (child := cell) _ hcell
      intro c hc
      have hc' : c = base := by simpa using hc
      subst c
      have hs := cellOfSystem_sound hbase
      rw [hs.1]
      exact hs.2

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_refineCell_system
statement:
theorem mem_refineCell_system {l : ZLine} {cell child : SignCell}
    (hchild : child ∈ refineCell l cell) :
    child.system = sideConstraint false l :: cell.system ∨
      child.system = sideConstraint true l :: cell.system
proof:
:= by
  rw [refineCell, List.mem_filterMap] at hchild
  obtain ⟨o, ho, hid⟩ := hchild
  have ho' : o = cellOfSystem? (sideConstraint false l :: cell.system) ∨
      o = cellOfSystem? (sideConstraint true l :: cell.system) := by
    simpa only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] using ho
  change o = some child at hid
  rcases ho' with ho' | ho'
  · rw [ho'] at hid
    exact Or.inl (cellOfSystem_sound hid).1
  · rw [ho'] at hid
    exact Or.inr (cellOfSystem_sound hid).1

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_refineCell_covers
proof:
:= by
  rcases mem_refineCell_system hchild with hsys | hsys
  · rw [hsys]
    intro k hk
    have hk' : k = l ∨ k ∈ covered := by simpa only [List.mem_cons] using hk
    rcases hk' with rfl | hk
    · exact Or.inl (by simp)
    · rcases hcovered k hk with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (by simp only [List.mem_cons]; exact Or.inr h)
      · exact Or.inr (by simp only [List.mem_cons]; exact Or.inr h)
  · rw [hsys]
    intro k hk
    have hk' : k = l ∨ k ∈ covered := by simpa only [List.mem_cons] using hk
    rcases hk' with rfl | hk
    · exact Or.inr (by simp)
    · rcases hcovered k hk with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (by simp only [List.mem_cons]; exact Or.inr h)
      · exact Or.inr (by simp only [List.mem_cons]; exact Or.inr h)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_refineCells_covers
proof:
:= by
  simp only [refineCells, List.mem_flatMap] at hchild
  obtain ⟨cell, hcell, hc⟩ := hchild
  exact mem_refineCell_covers (hcovered cell hcell) hc

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_refineLines_covers
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing covered cells with
  | nil =>
      simp only [refineLines, List.foldl_nil] at hchild
      simpa using hcovered child hchild
  | cons l ls ih =>
      rw [refineLines, List.foldl_cons] at hchild
      have h := ih (covered := l :: covered)
        (fun cell hcell ↦ mem_refineCells_covers hcovered hcell) hchild
      simpa [List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc] using h

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.feasibleSignCells_covers
statement:
theorem feasibleSignCells_covers {ls : List ZLine} {cell : SignCell}
    (hcell : cell ∈ feasibleSignCells ls) : Covers ls cell.system
proof:
:= by
  unfold feasibleSignCells at hcell
  cases hbase : cellOfSystem? openUnitSquare with
  | none => simp [hbase] at hcell
  | some base =>
      rw [hbase] at hcell
      have h := mem_refineLines_covers (covered := [])
        (fun _ _ ↦ by intro l hl; simp at hl) hcell
      intro l hl
      apply h l
      simpa using hl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.firstNonempty_nonempty
statement:
theorem firstNonempty_nonempty {family : List (Finset IntegerPlane)}
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} (h : firstNonempty family = some F) : F.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  induction family with
  | nil => simp [firstNonempty] at h
  | cons G family ih =>
      simp only [firstNonempty] at h
      split at h
      · exact ih h
      · rename_i hG
        simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
        subst F
        exact Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hG

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.twiceSignedArea_cyclic
statement:
private theorem twiceSignedArea_cyclic (a b c : Plane) :
    twiceSignedArea b c a = twiceSignedArea a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twiceSignedArea]
  ring

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.twiceSignedArea_cyclic'
statement:
private theorem twiceSignedArea_cyclic' (a b c : Plane) :
    twiceSignedArea c a b = twiceSignedArea a b c
proof:
:= by
  rw [twiceSignedArea_cyclic, twiceSignedArea_cyclic]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.convex_twiceSignedArea_nonneg
statement:
private theorem convex_twiceSignedArea_nonneg (a b : Plane) :
    Convex ℝ {p : Plane | 0 ≤ twiceSignedArea a b p}
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy u v hu hv huv
  change 0 ≤ twiceSignedArea a b x at hx
  change 0 ≤ twiceSignedArea a b y at hy
  change 0 ≤ twiceSignedArea a b (u • x + v • y)
  have hformula :
      twiceSignedArea a b (u • x + v • y) =
        u * twiceSignedArea a b x + v * twiceSignedArea a b y := by
    simp only [twiceSignedArea, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_re,
      Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
    have hv_eq : v = 1 - u := by linarith
    rw [hv_eq]
    ring
  rw [hformula]
  exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hu hx) (mul_nonneg hv hy)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.convex_twiceSignedArea_nonpos
statement:
private theorem convex_twiceSignedArea_nonpos (a b : Plane) :
    Convex ℝ {p : Plane | twiceSignedArea a b p ≤ 0}
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy u v hu hv huv
  change twiceSignedArea a b x ≤ 0 at hx
  change twiceSignedArea a b y ≤ 0 at hy
  change twiceSignedArea a b (u • x + v • y) ≤ 0
  have hformula :
      twiceSignedArea a b (u • x + v • y) =
        u * twiceSignedArea a b x + v * twiceSignedArea a b y := by
    simp only [twiceSignedArea, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_re,
      Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
    have hv_eq : v = 1 - u := by linarith
    rw [hv_eq]
    ring
  rw [hformula]
  exact add_nonpos (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hu hx)
    (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hv hy)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.twiceSignedArea_nonneg_on_convexHull
proof:
:= by
  apply convexHull_min
  · intro p hp
    change 0 ≤ twiceSignedArea a b p
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · simp [twiceSignedArea]
    · simp only [twiceSignedArea]
      ring_nf
      exact le_rfl
    · exact harea
  · exact convex_twiceSignedArea_nonneg a b

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.twiceSignedArea_nonpos_on_convexHull
proof:
:= by
  apply convexHull_min
  · intro p hp
    change twiceSignedArea a b p ≤ 0
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · simp [twiceSignedArea]
    · simp only [twiceSignedArea]
      ring_nf
      exact le_rfl
    · exact harea
  · exact convex_twiceSignedArea_nonpos a b

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_convexHull_three_signs_of_mem
statement:
private theorem mem_convexHull_three_signs_of_mem {a b c p : Plane}
    (hp : p ∈ convexHull ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set Plane)) :
    (0 ≤ twiceSignedArea a b p ∧ 0 ≤ twiceSignedArea b c p ∧
        0 ≤ twiceSignedArea c a p) ∨
      (twiceSignedArea a b p ≤ 0 ∧ twiceSignedArea b c p ≤ 0 ∧
        twiceSignedArea c a p ≤ 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases harea : 0 ≤ twiceSignedArea a b c
  · left
    have hcyclic₁ : ({b, c, a} : Set Plane) = {a, b, c} := by
      ext x
      simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff]
      tauto
    have hcyclic₂ : ({c, a, b} : Set Plane) = {a, b, c} := by
      ext x
      simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff]
      tauto
    exact ⟨twiceSignedArea_nonneg_on_convexHull a b c harea p hp,
      twiceSignedArea_nonneg_on_convexHull b c a
        (by rwa [twiceSignedArea_cyclic]) p (by rwa [hcyclic₁]),
      twiceSignedArea_nonneg_on_convexHull c a b
        (by rwa [twiceSignedArea_cyclic']) p (by rwa [hcyclic₂])⟩
  · right
    have harea' : twiceSignedArea a b c ≤ 0 := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge harea)
    have hcyclic₁ : ({b, c, a} : Set Plane) = {a, b, c} := by
      ext x
      simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff]
      tauto
    have hcyclic₂ : ({c, a, b} : Set Plane) = {a, b, c} := by
      ext x
      simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff]
      tauto
    exact ⟨twiceSignedArea_nonpos_on_convexHull a b c harea' p hp,
      twiceSignedArea_nonpos_on_convexHull b c a
        (by rwa [twiceSignedArea_cyclic]) p (by rwa [hcyclic₁]),
      twiceSignedArea_nonpos_on_convexHull c a b
        (by rwa [twiceSignedArea_cyclic']) p (by rwa [hcyclic₂])⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_convexHull_three_of_signs
statement:
private theorem mem_convexHull_three_of_signs {a b c p : Plane}
    (harea : twiceSignedArea a b c ≠ 0)
    (hsigns :
      (0 ≤ twiceSignedArea a b p ∧ 0 ≤ twiceSignedArea b c p ∧
          0 ≤ twiceSignedArea c a p) ∨
        (twiceSignedArea a b p ≤ 0 ∧ twiceSignedArea b c p ≤ 0 ∧
          twiceSignedArea c a p ≤ 0)) :
    p ∈ convexHull ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set Plane)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      twiceSignedArea a b p + twiceSignedArea b c p + twiceSignedArea c a p =
        twiceSignedArea a b c := by
    simp only [twiceSignedArea]
    ring
  rcases hsigns with hnonneg | hnonpos
  · have harea_pos : 0 < twiceSignedArea a b c := by
      have harea_nonneg : 0 ≤ twiceSignedArea a b c := by linarith
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne harea_nonneg harea.symm
    let w : Fin 3 → ℝ := ![
      twiceSignedArea b c p / twiceSignedArea a b c,
      twiceSignedArea c a p / twiceSignedArea a b c,
      twiceSignedArea a b p / twiceSignedArea a b c]
    let z : Fin 3 → Plane := ![a, b, c]
    refine mem_convexHull_of_exists_fintype w z ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact div_nonneg hnonneg.2.1 harea_pos.le
      · exact div_nonneg hnonneg.2.2 harea_pos.le
      · exact div_nonneg hnonneg.1 harea_pos.le
    · rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      simp only [Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val, w]
      rw [← add_div, ← add_div]
      have hsum' :
          twiceSignedArea b c p + twiceSignedArea c a p + twiceSignedArea a b p =
            twiceSignedArea a b c := by linarith [hsum]
      rw [hsum', div_self harea]
    · intro i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [z]
    · apply Complex.ext
      · rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        simp [w, z, Complex.add_re]
        field_simp [harea]
        simp only [twiceSignedArea]
        ring
      · rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        simp [w, z, Complex.add_im]
        field_simp [harea]
        simp only [twiceSignedArea]
        ring
  · have harea_neg : twiceSignedArea a b c < 0 := by
      have harea_nonpos : twiceSignedArea a b c ≤ 0 := by linarith
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne harea_nonpos harea
    let w : Fin 3 → ℝ := ![
      twiceSignedArea b c p / twiceSignedArea a b c,
      twiceSignedArea c a p / twiceSignedArea a b c,
      twiceSignedArea a b p / twiceSignedArea a b c]
    let z : Fin 3 → Plane := ![a, b, c]
    refine mem_convexHull_of_exists_fintype w z ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact div_nonneg_of_nonpos hnonpos.2.1 harea_neg.le
      · exact div_nonneg_of_nonpos hnonpos.2.2 harea_neg.le
      · exact div_nonneg_of_nonpos hnonpos.1 harea_neg.le
    · rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      simp only [Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val, w]
      rw [← add_div, ← add_div]
      have hsum' :
          twiceSignedArea b c p + twiceSignedArea c a p + twiceSignedArea a b p =
            twiceSignedArea a b c := by linarith [hsum]
      rw [hsum', div_self harea]
    · intro i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [z]
    · apply Complex.ext
      · rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        simp [w, z, Complex.add_re]
        field_simp [harea]
        simp only [twiceSignedArea]
        ring
      · rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        simp [w, z, Complex.add_im]
        field_simp [harea]
        simp only [twiceSignedArea]
        ring

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_convexHull_three_iff_signs
statement:
theorem mem_convexHull_three_iff_signs {a b c p : Plane}
    (harea : twiceSignedArea a b c ≠ 0) :
    p ∈ convexHull ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set Plane) ↔
      (0 ≤ twiceSignedArea a b p ∧ 0 ≤ twiceSignedArea b c p ∧
          0 ≤ twiceSignedArea c a p) ∨
        (twiceSignedArea a b p ≤ 0 ∧ twiceSignedArea b c p ≤ 0 ∧
          twiceSignedArea c a p ≤ 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact mem_convexHull_three_signs_of_mem
  · exact mem_convexHull_three_of_signs harea

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.sampleToPlane_zpointQ
statement:

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.twiceAreaQ_cast
statement:
theorem twiceAreaQ_cast (a b p : ℚ × ℚ) :
    (twiceAreaQ a b p : ℝ) =
      twiceSignedArea (sampleToPlane a) (sampleToPlane b) (sampleToPlane p)
proof:

  rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.twiceAreaQ_zpointQ_cast

      twiceSignedArea a.toPlane b.toPlane (sampleToPlane p)
