name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.pointInTriangle_eq_true_iff_mem_carrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [ZTriangle.carrier, mem_convexHull_three_iff_signs]
  · simp only [pointInTriangle]
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    rw [← twiceAreaQ_zpointQ_cast, ← twiceAreaQ_zpointQ_cast,
      ← twiceAreaQ_zpointQ_cast]
    norm_cast
  · rw [← sampleToPlane_zpointQ t.c, ← twiceAreaQ_zpointQ_cast]
    exact_mod_cast harea

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.weak_signs_iff_strict_signs_of_ne
statement:
theorem weak_signs_iff_strict_signs_of_ne {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [Zero α]
    {s₀ s₁ s₂ : α} (h₀ : s₀ ≠ 0) (h₁ : s₁ ≠ 0) (h₂ : s₂ ≠ 0) :
    ((0 ≤ s₀ ∧ 0 ≤ s₁ ∧ 0 ≤ s₂) ∨ (s₀ ≤ 0 ∧ s₁ ≤ 0 ∧ s₂ ≤ 0)) ↔
      ((0 < s₀ ∧ 0 < s₁ ∧ 0 < s₂) ∨ (s₀ < 0 ∧ s₁ < 0 ∧ s₂ < 0))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro (hpos | hneg)
    · left
      exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hpos.1 h₀.symm,
        lt_of_le_of_ne hpos.2.1 h₁.symm, lt_of_le_of_ne hpos.2.2 h₂.symm⟩
    · right
      exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hneg.1 h₀,
        lt_of_le_of_ne hneg.2.1 h₁, lt_of_le_of_ne hneg.2.2 h₂⟩
  · rintro (hpos | hneg)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hpos.1.le, hpos.2.1.le, hpos.2.2.le⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hneg.1.le, hneg.2.1.le, hneg.2.2.le⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.pointInTriangle_eq_true_iff_strict_signs
statement:
theorem pointInTriangle_eq_true_iff_strict_signs {p : ℚ × ℚ} {t : ZTriangle}
    (h₀ : twiceAreaQ (zpointQ t.a) (zpointQ t.b) p ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : twiceAreaQ (zpointQ t.b) (zpointQ t.c) p ≠ 0)
    (h₂ : twiceAreaQ (zpointQ t.c) (zpointQ t.a) p ≠ 0) :
    pointInTriangle p t = true ↔
      ((0 < twiceAreaQ (zpointQ t.a) (zpointQ t.b) p ∧
          0 < twiceAreaQ (zpointQ t.b) (zpointQ t.c) p ∧
          0 < twiceAreaQ (zpointQ t.c) (zpointQ t.a) p) ∨
        (twiceAreaQ (zpointQ t.a) (zpointQ t.b) p < 0 ∧
          twiceAreaQ (zpointQ t.b) (zpointQ t.c) p < 0 ∧
          twiceAreaQ (zpointQ t.c) (zpointQ t.a) p < 0))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pointInTriangle, decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact weak_signs_iff_strict_signs_of_ne h₀ h₁ h₂

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.edgeLine_eval_eq_neg_twiceAreaQ
statement:
theorem edgeLine_eval_eq_neg_twiceAreaQ (z a b : ZPoint) (p : ℚ × ℚ) :
    (edgeLine z a b).eval p =
      -twiceAreaQ (zpointQ a) (zpointQ b) (addOffset p z)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [edgeLine, ZLine.eval, twiceAreaQ, zpointQ, addOffset]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.ZLine.evalPlane_sampleToPlane
statement:
theorem ZLine.evalPlane_sampleToPlane (l : ZLine) (p : ℚ × ℚ) :
    l.evalPlane (sampleToPlane p) = (l.eval p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ZLine.evalPlane, ZLine.eval, sampleToPlane_re, sampleToPlane_im]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.edgeLine_evalPlane_eq_neg_twiceSignedArea
statement:
theorem edgeLine_evalPlane_eq_neg_twiceSignedArea (z a b : ZPoint) (p : Plane) :
    (edgeLine z a b).evalPlane p =
      -twiceSignedArea a.toPlane b.toPlane (p + integerPoint z.toIntegerPlane)
proof:
:= by
  rw [z.integerPoint_toIntegerPlane]
  simp [ZLine.evalPlane, edgeLine, twiceSignedArea, ZPoint.toPlane]
  ring

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.SameStrictSign.left_ne
statement: theorem left_ne {x y : ℝ} (h : SameStrictSign x y) : x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact ne_of_gt h.1
  · exact ne_of_lt h.1

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.SameStrictSign.right_ne
statement: theorem right_ne {x y : ℝ} (h : SameStrictSign x y) : y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact ne_of_gt h.2
  · exact ne_of_lt h.2

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.SameStrictSign.pos_iff
statement: theorem pos_iff {x y : ℝ} (h : SameStrictSign x y) : 0 < x ↔ 0 < y
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact iff_of_true h.1 h.2
  · constructor <;> intro hpos <;> linarith

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.SameStrictSign.neg_iff
statement: theorem neg_iff {x y : ℝ} (h : SameStrictSign x y) : x < 0 ↔ y < 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h
  · constructor <;> intro hneg <;> linarith
  · exact iff_of_true h.1 h.2

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.SameStrictSign.neg_iff_neg
statement:
theorem neg_iff_neg {x y : ℝ} :
    SameStrictSign (-x) (-y) ↔ SameStrictSign x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [SameStrictSign, neg_pos, neg_lt_zero]
  tauto

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.sameStrictSign_eval_of_satisfies
statement:
theorem sameStrictSign_eval_of_satisfies {ls : List ZLine}
    {qs : List StrictInequality} {p q : ℚ × ℚ} (hcover : Covers ls qs)
    (hp : SatisfiesAll qs p) (hq : SatisfiesAll qs q) {l : ZLine} (hl : l ∈ ls) :
    SameStrictSign (l.eval p : ℝ) (l.eval q : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcover l hl with hneg | hpos
  · right
    have hpneg := (sideConstraint_false_satisfies_iff l p).mp (hp _ hneg)
    have hqneg := (sideConstraint_false_satisfies_iff l q).mp (hq _ hneg)
    exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast hpneg, by exact_mod_cast hqneg⟩
  · left
    have hppos := (sideConstraint_true_satisfies_iff l p).mp (hp _ hpos)
    have hqpos := (sideConstraint_true_satisfies_iff l q).mp (hq _ hpos)
    exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast hppos, by exact_mod_cast hqpos⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.sameStrictSign_eval_of_cell_system
statement:
theorem sameStrictSign_eval_of_cell_system {ls : List ZLine} {cell : SignCell}
    {p q : ℚ × ℚ} (hcell : cell ∈ feasibleSignCells ls)
    (hp : SatisfiesAll cell.system p) (hq : SatisfiesAll cell.system q)
    {l : ZLine} (hl : l ∈ ls) :
    SameStrictSign (l.eval p : ℝ) (l.eval q : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  sameStrictSign_eval_of_satisfies (feasibleSignCells_covers hcell) hp hq hl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.sameStrictSign_sample_of_cell
statement:
theorem sameStrictSign_sample_of_cell {ls : List ZLine} {cell : SignCell}
    {p : ℚ × ℚ} (hcell : cell ∈ feasibleSignCells ls)
    (hp : SatisfiesAll cell.system p) {l : ZLine} (hl : l ∈ ls) :
    SameStrictSign (l.eval cell.sample : ℝ) (l.eval p : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  sameStrictSign_eval_of_cell_system hcell (feasibleSignCells_sound hcell) hp hl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_convexHull_three_iff_of_sameStrictSign
statement:
theorem mem_convexHull_three_iff_of_sameStrictSign {a b c u v : Plane}
    (harea : twiceSignedArea a b c ≠ 0)
    (h₀ : SameStrictSign (twiceSignedArea a b u) (twiceSignedArea a b v))
    (h₁ : SameStrictSign (twiceSignedArea b c u) (twiceSignedArea b c v))
    (h₂ : SameStrictSign (twiceSignedArea c a u) (twiceSignedArea c a v)) :
    u ∈ convexHull ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set Plane) ↔
      v ∈ convexHull ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set Plane)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_convexHull_three_iff_signs harea, mem_convexHull_three_iff_signs harea,
    weak_signs_iff_strict_signs_of_ne h₀.left_ne h₁.left_ne h₂.left_ne,
    weak_signs_iff_strict_signs_of_ne h₀.right_ne h₁.right_ne h₂.right_ne,
    h₀.pos_iff, h₁.pos_iff, h₂.pos_iff, h₀.neg_iff, h₁.neg_iff, h₂.neg_iff]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Compiler.mem_carrier_iff_pointInTriangle_of_same_strict_edge_signs
statement:
theorem mem_carrier_iff_pointInTriangle_of_same_strict_edge_signs
    {u : Plane} {p : ℚ × ℚ} {z : ZPoint} {t : ZTriangle}
    (harea : twiceAreaQ (zpointQ t.a) (zpointQ t.b) (zpointQ t.c) ≠ 0)
    (h₀ : SameStrictSign ((edgeLine z t.a t.b).evalPlane u)
      ((edgeLine z t.a t.b).eval p : ℝ))
    (h₁ : SameStrictSign ((edgeLine z t.b t.c).evalPlane u)
      ((edgeLine z t.b t.c).eval p : ℝ))
    (h₂ : SameStrictSign ((edgeLine z t.c t.a).evalPlane u)
      ((edgeLine z t.c t.a).eval p : ℝ)) :
    u + integerPoint z.toIntegerPlane ∈ t.carrier ↔
      pointInTriangle (addOffset p z) t = true
proof:
:= by
  have harea_real : twiceSignedArea t.a.toPlane t.b.toPlane t.c.toPlane ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← sampleToPlane_zpointQ t.c, ← twiceAreaQ_zpointQ_cast]
    exact_mod_cast harea
  have hedge₀u := edgeLine_evalPlane_eq_neg_twiceSignedArea z t.a t.b u
  have hedge₁u := edgeLine_evalPlane_eq_neg_twiceSignedArea z t.b t.c u
  have hedge₂u := edgeLine_evalPlane_eq_neg_twiceSignedArea z t.c t.a u
  have hedge₀p := edgeLine_evalPlane_eq_neg_twiceSignedArea z t.a t.b (sampleToPlane p)
  have hedge₁p := edgeLine_evalPlane_eq_neg_twiceSignedArea z t.b t.c (sampleToPlane p)
  have hedge₂p := edgeLine_evalPlane_eq_neg_twiceSignedArea z t.c t.a (sampleToPlane p)
  rw [← sampleToPlane_addOffset] at hedge₀p hedge₁p hedge₂p
  have h₀' : SameStrictSign
      (twiceSignedArea t.a.toPlane t.b.toPlane (u + integerPoint z.toIntegerPlane))
      (twiceSignedArea t.a.toPlane t.b.toPlane (sampleToPlane (addOffset p z))) := by
    rw [← SameStrictSign.neg_iff_neg]
    rw [← hedge₀u, ← hedge₀p, ZLine.evalPlane_sampleToPlane]
    exact h₀
  have h₁' : SameStrictSign
      (twiceSignedArea t.b.toPlane t.c.toPlane (u + integerPoint z.toIntegerPlane))
      (twiceSignedArea t.b.toPlane t.c.toPlane (sampleToPlane (addOffset p z))) := by
    rw [← SameStrictSign.neg_iff_neg]
    rw [← hedge₁u, ← hedge₁p, ZLine.evalPlane_sampleToPlane]
    exact h₁
  have h₂' : SameStrictSign
      (twiceSignedArea t.c.toPlane t.a.toPlane (u + integerPoint z.toIntegerPlane))
      (twiceSignedArea t.c.toPlane t.a.toPlane (sampleToPlane (addOffset p z))) := by
    rw [← SameStrictSign.neg_iff_neg]
    rw [← hedge₂u, ← hedge₂p, ZLine.evalPlane_sampleToPlane]
    exact h₂
  calc
    u + integerPoint z.toIntegerPlane ∈ t.carrier ↔
        sampleToPlane (addOffset p z) ∈ t.carrier := by
      exact mem_convexHull_three_iff_of_sameStrictSign harea_real h₀' h₁' h₂'
    _ ↔ pointInTriangle (addOffset p z) t = true :=
      (pointInTriangle_eq_true_iff_mem_carrier harea).symm

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.setPeriodicBy_integerPoint_image
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hax⟩
    have ha' : a - w ∈ A := by
      apply (hA (a - w)).mp
      simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using ha
    refine ⟨a - w, ha', ?_⟩
    rw [integerPoint_sub, hax]
    abel
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    have ha' : a + w ∈ A := (hA a).mpr ha
    exact ⟨a + w, ha', integerPoint_add a w⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.setPeriodicBy_iUnion
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hxi⟩
    exact ⟨i, (hA i x).mp hxi⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hxi⟩
    exact ⟨i, (hA i x).mpr hxi⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.weaklyPeriodic_integerPoint_image
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := hA
  exact ⟨integerPointWeakPeriodicDecomposition D⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.Tiles.weaklyPeriodic_of_integerPoint_image
statement:
theorem Tiles.weaklyPeriodic_of_integerPoint_image
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set IntegerPlane}
    (hT : K.Tiles (integerPoint '' T)) :
    WeaklyPeriodic (integerPoint '' T)
proof:
:= by
  have hsignatures := hT.ae_signature_tilesUniverse
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hsignatures.exists
  obtain ⟨f, hf, -⟩ := existsUnique_tile_representation hu 0
  exact weaklyPeriodic_integerPoint_image
    (tilesUniverse_weaklyPeriodic ⟨f, hf.1⟩ hu)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.IntegerSlidingReduction.unshiftedQuakePart_subset_owner
statement:
theorem unshiftedQuakePart_subset_owner
    (R : IntegerSlidingReduction K T) {u : Plane}
    (hTiles : TilesUniverse (K.signature u) R.translations)
    (D : UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
      (K.signature u) R.translations R.direction)
    (C : QuakePlate (K.signature u) R.translations R.direction)
    (j : Fin D.numberOfParts) :
    R.unshiftedQuakePart D C j ⊆
      K.continuousPlateTranslations T (R.quakePlateOwner C)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [unshiftedQuakePart, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hx
  obtain ⟨z, hzPart, hzEq⟩ := hx
  have hzQuake : z ∈ quakePlateTranslations C := by
    rw [← D.iUnion_parts C]
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hzPart⟩
  have hzOwner := R.quakePlateTranslations_subset_owner hTiles C hzQuake
  have hzImage : integerPoint z ∈
      -R.base +ᵥ K.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations T
        (integerPoint R.direction) R.shift (R.quakePlateOwner C) := by
    rw [← R.image_plateTranslations]
    exact ⟨z, hzOwner, rfl⟩
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hzImage
  change -(-R.base) + integerPoint z ∈
    R.shift (R.quakePlateOwner C) • integerPoint R.direction +ᵥ
      K.continuousPlateTranslations T (R.quakePlateOwner C) at hzImage
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hzImage
  convert hzImage using 1
  simp only [vadd_eq_add] at hzEq ⊢
  rw [hzEq]
  module

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.IntegerSlidingReduction.assembledQuakePart_periodic
statement:
theorem assembledQuakePart_periodic
    (R : IntegerSlidingReduction K T) {u : Plane}
    (D : UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
      (K.signature u) R.translations R.direction)
    (j : Fin D.numberOfParts) :
    SetPeriodicBy (R.assembledQuakePart D j) (integerPoint (D.period j))
proof:
:= by
  apply setPeriodicBy_iUnion
  intro C
  exact setPeriodicBy_vadd
    (R.base - R.shift (R.quakePlateOwner C) • integerPoint R.direction)
    (setPeriodicBy_integerPoint_image (D.periodic_part C j))

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.IntegerSlidingReduction.assembledQuakePart_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem assembledQuakePart_pairwiseDisjoint
    (R : IntegerSlidingReduction K T) {u : Plane}
    (hTiles : TilesUniverse (K.signature u) R.translations)
    (D : UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
      (K.signature u) R.translations R.direction) :
    Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ (R.assembledQuakePart D)
proof:
:= by
  intro i _ j _ hij
  change Disjoint (R.assembledQuakePart D i) (R.assembledQuakePart D j)
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxi hxj
  obtain ⟨C, hxCi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxi
  obtain ⟨E, hxEj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxj
  have hxOwnerC := R.unshiftedQuakePart_subset_owner hTiles D C i hxCi
  have hxOwnerE := R.unshiftedQuakePart_subset_owner hTiles D E j hxEj
  have howner : R.quakePlateOwner C = R.quakePlateOwner E := by
    by_contra hne
    exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (K.continuousPlateTranslations_pairwiseDisjoint T
        (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _) hne)) hxOwnerC hxOwnerE
  rw [unshiftedQuakePart, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hxCi hxEj
  obtain ⟨z, hzi, hzEq⟩ := hxCi
  obtain ⟨r, hrj, hrEq⟩ := hxEj
  have hzrReal : integerPoint z = integerPoint r := by
    calc
      integerPoint z =
          -(R.base - R.shift (R.quakePlateOwner C) • integerPoint R.direction) + x := hzEq
      _ = -(R.base - R.shift (R.quakePlateOwner E) • integerPoint R.direction) + x := by
        rw [howner]
      _ = integerPoint r := hrEq.symm
  have hzr : z = r := integerPoint_injective hzrReal
  subst r
  have hzC : z ∈ quakePlateTranslations C := by
    rw [← D.iUnion_parts C]
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hzi⟩
  have hzE : z ∈ quakePlateTranslations E := by
    rw [← D.iUnion_parts E]
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hrj⟩
  have hCE : C = E := by
    by_contra hne
    exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (quakePlateTranslations_pairwiseDisjoint
        (Set.mem_univ C) (Set.mem_univ E) hne)) hzC hzE
  subst E
  exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp
    (D.pairwiseDisjoint C (Set.mem_univ i) (Set.mem_univ j) hij)) hzi hrj

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.IntegerSlidingReduction.iUnion_assembledQuakePart
statement:
theorem iUnion_assembledQuakePart
    (R : IntegerSlidingReduction K T) {u : Plane}
    (hTiles : TilesUniverse (K.signature u) R.translations)
    (D : UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
      (K.signature u) R.translations R.direction) :
    (⋃ j, R.assembledQuakePart D j) = T
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    obtain ⟨C, hxC⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxj
    exact (R.unshiftedQuakePart_subset_owner hTiles D C j hxC).1
  · intro x hxT
    rw [← K.iUnion_continuousPlateTranslations T] at hxT
    obtain ⟨A, hxA⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxT
    let y : Plane := -R.base +
      (R.shift A • integerPoint R.direction + x)
    have hyBased : y ∈ -R.base +ᵥ
        K.shiftedContinuousPlateTranslations T (integerPoint R.direction) R.shift A := by
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      change -(-R.base) + y ∈
        R.shift A • integerPoint R.direction +ᵥ
          K.continuousPlateTranslations T A
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      convert hxA using 1
      simp only [y, vadd_eq_add]
      module
    have hyImage : y ∈ integerPoint '' R.plateTranslations A := by
      rw [R.image_plateTranslations]
      exact hyBased
    obtain ⟨z, hzA, hzEq⟩ := hyImage
    have hzZ : z ∈ R.translations := R.plateTranslations_subset A hzA
    let C : QuakePlate (K.signature u) R.translations R.direction :=
      (quakeGraph (K.signature u) R.translations R.direction).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨z, hzZ⟩
    have hzC : z ∈ quakePlateTranslations C :=
      mem_quakePlateTranslations_mk ⟨z, hzZ⟩
    have hzOwner := R.quakePlateTranslations_subset_owner hTiles C hzC
    have howner : R.quakePlateOwner C = A := by
      by_contra hne
      exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp
        (R.plate_pairwiseDisjoint (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _) hne)) hzOwner hzA
    rw [← D.iUnion_parts C] at hzC
    obtain ⟨j, hzj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hzC
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨j, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨C, ?_⟩⟩
    refine ⟨integerPoint z, ⟨z, hzj, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [howner, hzEq]
    simp only [y, vadd_eq_add]
    abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.Tiles.weaklyPeriodic_of_integerVertices
statement:
theorem Tiles.weaklyPeriodic_of_integerVertices
    {K : PolygonalRegion} (hK : K.HasIntegerVertices)
    {T : Set Plane} (hT : K.Tiles T) : WeaklyPeriodic T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := hT.exists_integerSlidingReduction hK
  have hsignatures := R.tiles.ae_signature_tilesUniverse
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hsignatures.exists
  obtain ⟨f, hf, -⟩ := existsUnique_tile_representation hu 0
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := exists_uniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
    (F := K.signature u) ⟨f, hf.1⟩ R.direction_ne_zero hu
  exact ⟨R.weakPeriodicDecomposition hu D⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.denormalizedTranslations_normalizedTranslations
statement:
theorem denormalizedTranslations_normalizedTranslations
    (K : RationalPolygonalRegion) (T : Set Plane) :
    K.denormalizedTranslations (K.normalizedTranslations T) = T
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [K.mem_denormalizedTranslations_iff_normalizedTranslation_mem]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, htx⟩
    exact (K.normalizedTranslation_injective htx).symm ▸ ht
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.Tiles.weaklyPeriodic
proof:
:= by
  have hnormalized := K.normalizedRegion_tiles hT
  have hweakNormalized := hnormalized.weaklyPeriodic_of_integerVertices
    K.normalizedRegion_hasIntegerVertices
  have hweakDenormalized :=
    K.weaklyPeriodic_denormalizedTranslations hweakNormalized
  rwa [K.denormalizedTranslations_normalizedTranslations] at hweakDenormalized

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.satisfies1_of_pos
statement:
private theorem satisfies1_of_pos {q : StrictInequality1} (ha : 0 < q.a) (x : ℚ) :
    q.Satisfies x ↔ x < q.c / q.a
proof:
:= by
  simpa [StrictInequality1.Satisfies, mul_comm] using (lt_div_iff₀ ha).symm

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.satisfies1_of_neg
statement:
private theorem satisfies1_of_neg {q : StrictInequality1} (ha : q.a < 0) (x : ℚ) :
    q.Satisfies x ↔ q.c / q.a < x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [show q.c / q.a = (-q.c) / (-q.a) by ring,
      div_lt_iff₀ (neg_pos.mpr ha)]
    simp only [StrictInequality1.Satisfies] at h
    ring_nf at h ⊢
    linarith
  · intro h
    rw [show q.c / q.a = (-q.c) / (-q.a) by ring,
      div_lt_iff₀ (neg_pos.mpr ha)] at h
    simp only [StrictInequality1.Satisfies]
    ring_nf at h ⊢
    linarith

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.satisfies1_of_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem satisfies1_of_eq_zero {q : StrictInequality1} (ha : q.a = 0) (x : ℚ) :
    q.Satisfies x ↔ 0 < q.c
proof:
:= by
  simp [StrictInequality1.Satisfies, ha]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.mem_lowerBounds_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_lowerBounds_iff {qs : List StrictInequality1} {l : ℚ} :
    l ∈ lowerBounds qs ↔ ∃ q ∈ qs, q.a < 0 ∧ q.c / q.a = l
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lowerBounds, List.mem_filterMap, lowerBound?]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, h⟩
    split at h
    · exact ⟨q, hq, ‹q.a < 0›, Option.some.inj h⟩
    · contradiction
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, ha, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨q, hq, by simp [ha]⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.mem_upperBounds_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_upperBounds_iff {qs : List StrictInequality1} {u : ℚ} :
    u ∈ upperBounds qs ↔ ∃ q ∈ qs, 0 < q.a ∧ q.c / q.a = u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [upperBounds, List.mem_filterMap, upperBound?]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, h⟩
    split at h
    · exact ⟨q, hq, ‹0 < q.a›, Option.some.inj h⟩
    · contradiction
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, ha, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨q, hq, by simp [ha]⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.all_constantValid_iff
statement:
private theorem all_constantValid_iff {qs : List StrictInequality1} :
    qs.all constantValid ↔ ∀ q ∈ qs, q.a = 0 → 0 < q.c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [List.all_eq_true, constantValid, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h q hq ha
    exact (h q hq).resolve_left (fun hne => hne ha)
  · intro h q hq
    by_cases ha : q.a = 0
    · exact Or.inr (h q hq ha)
    · exact Or.inl ha

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.satisfiesAll1_iff_bounds
statement:
private theorem satisfiesAll1_iff_bounds {qs : List StrictInequality1} {x : ℚ} :
    SatisfiesAll1 qs x ↔
      (∀ l ∈ lowerBounds qs, l < x) ∧
      (∀ u ∈ upperBounds qs, x < u) ∧
      qs.all constantValid
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, all_constantValid_iff.mpr ?_⟩
    · intro l hl
      obtain ⟨q, hq, ha, rfl⟩ := mem_lowerBounds_iff.mp hl
      exact (satisfies1_of_neg ha x).mp (h q hq)
    · intro u hu
      obtain ⟨q, hq, ha, rfl⟩ := mem_upperBounds_iff.mp hu
      exact (satisfies1_of_pos ha x).mp (h q hq)
    · intro q hq ha
      exact (satisfies1_of_eq_zero ha x).mp (h q hq)
  · rintro ⟨hlower, hupper, hconstant⟩ q hq
    rcases lt_trichotomy q.a 0 with ha | ha | ha
    · apply (satisfies1_of_neg ha x).mpr
      apply hlower (q.c / q.a)
      exact mem_lowerBounds_iff.mpr ⟨q, hq, ha, rfl⟩
    · apply (satisfies1_of_eq_zero ha x).mpr
      exact all_constantValid_iff.mp hconstant q hq ha
    · apply (satisfies1_of_pos ha x).mpr
      apply hupper (q.c / q.a)
      exact mem_upperBounds_iff.mpr ⟨q, hq, ha, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.midpoint_gt
statement: private theorem midpoint_gt {l u : ℚ} (h : l < u) : l < (l + u) / 2
proof:
:= by
  linarith

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.midpoint_lt
statement: private theorem midpoint_lt {l u : ℚ} (h : l < u) : (l + u) / 2 < u
proof:
:= by
  linarith

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.chooseBetween_sound
proof:
:= by
  unfold chooseBetween at h
  cases hmax : ls.max? with
  | none =>
      have hls : ls = [] := List.min?_eq_none_iff.mp (by simpa using hmax)
      cases hmin : us.min? with
      | none =>
          have hus : us = [] := List.min?_eq_none_iff.mp hmin
          simp [hls, hus] at h ⊢
      | some u =>
          have hx : u - 1 = x := by
            simpa only [hmax, hmin, Option.some.injEq] using h
          subst x
          refine ⟨by simp [hls], ?_⟩
          intro v hv
          have huv : u ≤ v := (List.min?_eq_some_iff.mp hmin).2 v hv
          linarith
  | some l =>
      cases hmin : us.min? with
      | none =>
          have hus : us = [] := List.min?_eq_none_iff.mp hmin
          have hx : l + 1 = x := by
            simpa only [hmax, hmin, Option.some.injEq] using h
          subst x
          refine ⟨?_, by simp [hus]⟩
          intro v hv
          have hvl : v ≤ l := (List.max?_eq_some_iff.mp hmax).2 v hv
          linarith
      | some u =>
          by_cases hlu : l < u
          · have hx : (l + u) / 2 = x := by
              simpa only [hmax, hmin, if_pos hlu, Option.some.injEq] using h
            subst x
            refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
            · intro v hv
              have hvl : v ≤ l := (List.max?_eq_some_iff.mp hmax).2 v hv
              exact lt_of_le_of_lt hvl (midpoint_gt hlu)
            · intro v hv
              have huv : u ≤ v := (List.min?_eq_some_iff.mp hmin).2 v hv
              exact lt_of_lt_of_le (midpoint_lt hlu) huv
          · simp [hmax, hmin, hlu] at h

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.chooseBetween_complete
proof:
:= by
  unfold chooseBetween
  cases hmax : ls.max? with
  | none =>
      cases hmin : us.min? with
      | none => exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
      | some u => exact ⟨u - 1, rfl⟩
  | some l =>
      cases hmin : us.min? with
      | none => exact ⟨l + 1, rfl⟩
      | some u =>
          have hlmem : l ∈ ls := List.max?_mem hmax
          have humem : u ∈ us := List.min?_mem hmin
          have hlu : l < u := lt_trans (hlower l hlmem) (hupper u humem)
          simp [hlu]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.solve1D_sound
statement:
theorem solve1D_sound {qs : List StrictInequality1} {x : ℚ}
    (h : solve1D qs = some x) : SatisfiesAll1 qs x
proof:
:= by
  unfold solve1D at h
  split at h
  · obtain ⟨hlower, hupper⟩ := chooseBetween_sound h
    exact satisfiesAll1_iff_bounds.mpr ⟨hlower, hupper, ‹qs.all constantValid›⟩
  · contradiction

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.solve1D_complete
statement:
theorem solve1D_complete {qs : List StrictInequality1}
    (h : ∃ x, SatisfiesAll1 qs x) : ∃ x, solve1D qs = some x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hlower, hupper, hconstant⟩ := satisfiesAll1_iff_bounds.mp hz
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := chooseBetween_complete hlower hupper
  exact ⟨x, by simp [solve1D, hconstant, hx]⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.solve1D_isSome_iff
statement:
theorem solve1D_isSome_iff {qs : List StrictInequality1} :
    (∃ x, solve1D qs = some x) ↔ ∃ x, SatisfiesAll1 qs x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => ⟨x, solve1D_sound hx⟩, solve1D_complete⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.satisfies_of_pos
statement:
private theorem satisfies_of_pos {q : StrictInequality} (hb : 0 < q.b) (x y : ℚ) :
    q.Satisfies (x, y) ↔ y < verticalBound q x
proof:
:= by
  rw [verticalBound, lt_div_iff₀ hb]
  simp only [StrictInequality.Satisfies]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.satisfies_of_neg
statement:
private theorem satisfies_of_neg {q : StrictInequality} (hb : q.b < 0) (x y : ℚ) :
    q.Satisfies (x, y) ↔ verticalBound q x < y
proof:
:= by
  rw [verticalBound, show (q.c - q.a * x) / q.b =
    (-(q.c - q.a * x)) / (-q.b) by ring, div_lt_iff₀ (neg_pos.mpr hb)]
  simp only [StrictInequality.Satisfies]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> ring_nf at h ⊢ <;> linarith

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.satisfies_of_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem satisfies_of_eq_zero {q : StrictInequality} (hb : q.b = 0) (x y : ℚ) :
    q.Satisfies (x, y) ↔ q.a * x < q.c
proof:
:= by
  simp [StrictInequality.Satisfies, hb]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.pairProjection_satisfies
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pairProjection, StrictInequality1.Satisfies, verticalBound]
  rw [show (l.c - l.a * x) / l.b = (-(l.c - l.a * x)) / (-l.b) by ring,
    div_lt_div_iff₀ (neg_pos.mpr hl) hu]
  ring_nf
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.zeroProjection_satisfies
statement:
private theorem zeroProjection_satisfies (q : StrictInequality) (x : ℚ) :
    (zeroProjection q).Satisfies x ↔ q.a * x < q.c
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.mem_negativeY_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_negativeY_iff {qs : List StrictInequality} {q : StrictInequality} :
    q ∈ negativeY qs ↔ q ∈ qs ∧ q.b < 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [negativeY]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.mem_positiveY_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_positiveY_iff {qs : List StrictInequality} {q : StrictInequality} :
    q ∈ positiveY qs ↔ q ∈ qs ∧ 0 < q.b
proof:
:= by
  simp [positiveY]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.mem_zeroY_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_zeroY_iff {qs : List StrictInequality} {q : StrictInequality} :
    q ∈ zeroY qs ↔ q ∈ qs ∧ q.b = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [zeroY]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.eliminateY_spec
statement:
theorem eliminateY_spec {qs : List StrictInequality} {x : ℚ} :
    SatisfiesAll1 (eliminateY qs) x ↔
      (∀ q ∈ qs, q.b = 0 → q.a * x < q.c) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ qs, ∀ u ∈ qs, l.b < 0 → 0 < u.b →
        verticalBound l x < verticalBound u x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [SatisfiesAll1, eliminateY, List.mem_append, List.mem_map,
    List.mem_flatMap]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro q hq hb
      exact (zeroProjection_satisfies q x).mp
        (h (zeroProjection q) (Or.inl ⟨q, mem_zeroY_iff.mpr ⟨hq, hb⟩, rfl⟩))
    · intro l hl u hu hbl hbu
      exact (pairProjection_satisfies hbl hbu x).mp
        (h (pairProjection l u) (Or.inr
          ⟨l, mem_negativeY_iff.mpr ⟨hl, hbl⟩,
            u, mem_positiveY_iff.mpr ⟨hu, hbu⟩, rfl⟩))
  · rintro ⟨hzero, hpairs⟩ q hq
    rcases hq with ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ | ⟨l, hl, u, hu, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨hr, hbr⟩ := mem_zeroY_iff.mp hr
      exact (zeroProjection_satisfies r x).mpr (hzero r hr hbr)
    · obtain ⟨hl, hbl⟩ := mem_negativeY_iff.mp hl
      obtain ⟨hu, hbu⟩ := mem_positiveY_iff.mp hu
      exact (pairProjection_satisfies hbl hbu x).mpr (hpairs l hl u hu hbl hbu)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.mem_yLowerBounds_iff
proof:
:= by
  simp only [yLowerBounds, List.mem_filterMap, yLowerBound?]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, h⟩
    split at h
    · exact ⟨q, hq, ‹q.b < 0›, Option.some.inj h⟩
    · contradiction
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, hb, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨q, hq, by simp [hb]⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.mem_yUpperBounds_iff
proof:
:= by
  simp only [yUpperBounds, List.mem_filterMap, yUpperBound?]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, h⟩
    split at h
    · exact ⟨q, hq, ‹0 < q.b›, Option.some.inj h⟩
    · contradiction
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, hb, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨q, hq, by simp [hb]⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.chooseBetween_complete_of_pairwise
proof:
:= by
  unfold chooseBetween
  cases hmax : ls.max? with
  | none =>
      cases hmin : us.min? with
      | none => exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
      | some u => exact ⟨u - 1, rfl⟩
  | some l =>
      cases hmin : us.min? with
      | none => exact ⟨l + 1, rfl⟩
      | some u =>
          have hlu := hpair l (List.max?_mem hmax) u (List.min?_mem hmin)
          simp [hlu]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.eliminateY_of_satisfiesAll
statement:
private theorem eliminateY_of_satisfiesAll {qs : List StrictInequality} {x y : ℚ}
    (h : SatisfiesAll qs (x, y)) : SatisfiesAll1 (eliminateY qs) x
proof:
:= by
  apply eliminateY_spec.mpr
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro q hq hb
    exact (satisfies_of_eq_zero hb x y).mp (h q hq)
  · intro l hl u hu hbl hbu
    exact lt_trans ((satisfies_of_neg hbl x y).mp (h l hl))
      ((satisfies_of_pos hbu x y).mp (h u hu))

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.solveY_sound
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hlower, hupper⟩ := chooseBetween_sound hy
  obtain ⟨hzero, _hpairs⟩ := eliminateY_spec.mp hx
  intro q hq
  rcases lt_trichotomy q.b 0 with hb | hb | hb
  · apply (satisfies_of_neg hb x y).mpr
    apply hlower (verticalBound q x)
    exact mem_yLowerBounds_iff.mpr ⟨q, hq, hb, rfl⟩
  · exact (satisfies_of_eq_zero hb x y).mpr (hzero q hq hb)
  · apply (satisfies_of_pos hb x y).mpr
    apply hupper (verticalBound q x)
    exact mem_yUpperBounds_iff.mpr ⟨q, hq, hb, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.solveY_complete
statement:
theorem solveY_complete {qs : List StrictInequality} {x : ℚ}
    (hx : SatisfiesAll1 (eliminateY qs) x) : ∃ y, solveY qs x = some y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_hzero, hpairs⟩ := eliminateY_spec.mp hx
  apply chooseBetween_complete_of_pairwise
  intro l hl u hu
  obtain ⟨ql, hql, hbl, rfl⟩ := mem_yLowerBounds_iff.mp hl
  obtain ⟨qu, hqu, hbu, rfl⟩ := mem_yUpperBounds_iff.mp hu
  exact hpairs ql hql qu hqu hbl hbu

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.exists_y_satisfiesAll_iff_eliminateY
statement:
theorem exists_y_satisfiesAll_iff_eliminateY {qs : List StrictInequality} {x : ℚ} :
    (∃ y, SatisfiesAll qs (x, y)) ↔ SatisfiesAll1 (eliminateY qs) x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun ⟨y, hy⟩ => eliminateY_of_satisfiesAll hy
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := solveY_complete hx
    exact ⟨y, solveY_sound hx hy⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.solve_sound
statement:
theorem solve_sound {qs : List StrictInequality} {p : ℚ × ℚ}
    (h : solve qs = some p) : SatisfiesAll qs p
proof:
:= by
  unfold solve at h
  cases hx : solve1D (eliminateY qs) with
  | none =>
      simp only [hx] at h
      contradiction
  | some x =>
      cases hy : solveY qs x with
      | none =>
          simp only [hx, hy, Option.map_none] at h
          contradiction
      | some y =>
          have hp : (x, y) = p := by
            simpa only [hx, hy, Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] using h
          subst p
          exact solveY_sound (solve1D_sound hx) hy

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.solve_complete
statement:
theorem solve_complete {qs : List StrictInequality}
    (h : ∃ p, SatisfiesAll qs p) : ∃ p, solve qs = some p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨x, y⟩, hxy⟩ := h
  have hx : SatisfiesAll1 (eliminateY qs) x := eliminateY_of_satisfiesAll hxy
  obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := solve1D_complete ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hx'sat : SatisfiesAll1 (eliminateY qs) x' := solve1D_sound hx'
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := solveY_complete hx'sat
  exact ⟨(x', y'), by simp [solve, hx', hy']⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.solve_isSome_iff
statement:
theorem solve_isSome_iff {qs : List StrictInequality} :
    (∃ p, solve qs = some p) ↔ ∃ p, SatisfiesAll qs p
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨p, hp⟩ => ⟨p, solve_sound hp⟩, solve_complete⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.isFeasible_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem isFeasible_eq_true_iff {qs : List StrictInequality} :
    isFeasible qs = true ↔ ∃ p, SatisfiesAll qs p
proof:
:= by
  rw [isFeasible, Option.isSome_iff_exists, solve_isSome_iff]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.LinearFeasibility.solve_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem solve_eq_none_iff {qs : List StrictInequality} :
    solve qs = none ↔ ¬∃ p, SatisfiesAll qs p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hnone hfeasible
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := solve_complete hfeasible
    rw [hnone] at hp
    contradiction
  · intro hfeasible
    cases hsolve : solve qs with
    | none => rfl
    | some p => exact False.elim (hfeasible ⟨p, solve_sound hsolve⟩)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_discreteCarrier_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_discreteCarrier_iff {F : Finset G} {T : Set G} {x : G} :
    x ∈ discreteCarrier F T ↔ ∃ f ∈ F, ∃ t ∈ T, x = f + t
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.tileConv_indicator_eq_indicator_discreteCarrier
statement:
theorem tileConv_indicator_eq_indicator_discreteCarrier
    {F : Finset G}
    {A E B : Set G}
    (hTile : Tiles F A E) (hBA : B ⊆ A) :
    tileConv F (setIndicator B) =
      setIndicator
        (discreteCarrier F B)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext x
  rw [tileConv_indicator_eq_card]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ discreteCarrier F B
  · have hxCarrier := hx
    obtain ⟨f, hfF, b, hbB, hxfb⟩ := hx
    have hfb : x - f ∈ B := by
      rw [hxfb]
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using hbB
    have hfilterNonempty :
        (F.filter fun q ↦ x - q ∈ B).Nonempty :=
      ⟨f, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hfF, hfb⟩⟩
    have hfilterMono :
        F.filter (fun q ↦ x - q ∈ B) ⊆
          F.filter (fun q ↦ x - q ∈ A) := by
      intro q hq
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).1, hBA (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2⟩
    have hcardA : (F.filter fun q ↦ x - q ∈ A).card ≤ 1 := by
      have ht := hTile x
      rw [tileConv_indicator_eq_card] at ht
      have ht' : ((F.filter fun q ↦ x - q ∈ A).card : ℤ) =
          setIndicator E x := by
        simpa only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul] using ht
      by_cases hxE : x ∈ E
      · have hindicator : setIndicator E x = 1 := by
          simp [setIndicator, hxE]
        rw [hindicator] at ht'
        omega
      · have hindicator : setIndicator E x = 0 := by
          simp [setIndicator, hxE]
        rw [hindicator] at ht'
        omega
    have hcardB_le : (F.filter fun q ↦ x - q ∈ B).card ≤ 1 :=
      (Finset.card_le_card hfilterMono).trans hcardA
    have hcardB_pos : 0 < (F.filter fun q ↦ x - q ∈ B).card :=
      Finset.card_pos.mpr hfilterNonempty
    have hcardB : (F.filter fun q ↦ x - q ∈ B).card = 1 := by omega
    rw [hcardB]
    simp [setIndicator, hxCarrier]
  · have hfilterEmpty : F.filter (fun q ↦ x - q ∈ B) = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp
      intro hnonempty
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hnonempty
      apply hx
      have hdata := Finset.mem_filter.mp hf
      exact ⟨f, hdata.1, x - f, hdata.2, by abel⟩
    rw [hfilterEmpty]
    simp [setIndicator, hx]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.existsUnique_tile_representation
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcard : (F.filter fun f ↦ x - f ∈ T).card = 1 := by
    have hcount :=
      (tilesAtLevel_iff_representation_count F T Set.univ 1).mp hT x
    simpa using hcount
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard
  refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : f ∈ F.filter fun g ↦ x - g ∈ T := by simp [hf]
    simpa using this
  · intro g hg
    have hgm : g ∈ F.filter fun f ↦ x - f ∈ T := by simpa using hg
    simpa [hf] using hgm

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.tilesUniverse_of_existsUnique
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (tilesAtLevel_iff_representation_count F T Set.univ 1).mpr
  intro x
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hunique⟩ := hrep x
  have hfilter : (F.filter fun g ↦ x - g ∈ T) = {f} := by
    ext g
    constructor
    · intro hg
      have hg' : g ∈ F ∧ x - g ∈ T := by simpa using hg
      simpa only [Finset.mem_singleton] using hunique g hg'
    · intro hg
      have hgf : g = f := by simpa only [Finset.mem_singleton] using hg
      subst g
      simpa using hf
  rw [hfilter]
  simp

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_shiftFinset_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_shiftFinset_iff {q z : G} {F : Finset G} :
    z ∈ shiftFinset q F ↔ z + q ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hz
    rw [shiftFinset, Finset.mem_image] at hz
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfz⟩ := hz
    rw [← hfz]
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hf
  · intro hz
    rw [shiftFinset, Finset.mem_image]
    exact ⟨z + q, hz, by simp only [add_sub_cancel_right]⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.tilesUniverse_shiftFinset_iff
statement:
theorem tilesUniverse_shiftFinset_iff (q : G) (F : Finset G) (T : Set G) :
    TilesUniverse (shiftFinset q F) T ↔ TilesUniverse F T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hshift
    apply tilesUniverse_of_existsUnique
    intro x
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hgunique⟩ :=
      existsUnique_tile_representation hshift (x - q)
    let f := g + q
    refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
    · constructor
      · exact mem_shiftFinset_iff.mp hg.1
      · dsimp only [f]
        convert hg.2 using 1
        abel
    · intro f' hf'
      have hcandidate : f' - q ∈ shiftFinset q F ∧
          x - q - (f' - q) ∈ T := by
        constructor
        · exact mem_shiftFinset_iff.mpr (by simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hf'.1)
        · convert hf'.2 using 1
          abel
      have heq := hgunique (f' - q) hcandidate
      dsimp only [f]
      rw [← heq]
      abel
  · intro hF
    apply tilesUniverse_of_existsUnique
    intro x
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfunique⟩ :=
      existsUnique_tile_representation hF (x + q)
    let g := f - q
    refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
    · constructor
      · exact mem_shiftFinset_iff.mpr (by simpa only [g, sub_add_cancel] using hf.1)
      · dsimp only [g]
        convert hf.2 using 1
        abel
    · intro g' hg'
      have hcandidate : g' + q ∈ F ∧
          x + q - (g' + q) ∈ T := by
        constructor
        · exact mem_shiftFinset_iff.mp hg'.1
        · convert hg'.2 using 1
          abel
      have heq := hfunique (g' + q) hcandidate
      dsimp only [g]
      rw [← heq]
      abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.translation_eq_of_eq_representations
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨chosen, hchosen, hunique⟩ := existsUnique_tile_representation hT (f + t)
  have hfrep : f ∈ F ∧ f + t - f ∈ T := by
    refine ⟨hf, ?_⟩
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using ht
  have hgrep : g ∈ F ∧ f + t - g ∈ T := by
    refine ⟨hg, ?_⟩
    rw [heq]
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using hs
  have hfg : f = g := (hunique f hfrep).trans (hunique g hgrep).symm
  rw [hfg] at heq
  exact add_left_cancel heq

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy.zsmul
proof:
:= by
  have hperiodic : Function.Periodic (fun x ↦ x ∈ A) v :=
    fun x ↦ propext (hA x)
  exact fun x ↦ eq_iff_iff.mp (hperiodic.zsmul n x)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.normalized_placedTile
statement:
theorem normalized_placedTile (K : RationalPolygonalRegion) (t : Plane) :
    placedTile K.normalizedRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.normalizedTranslation t, ()) =
      (K.denominator : ℝ) •
        placedTile K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily (t, ())
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    change x ∈ K.normalizedTranslation t +ᵥ K.normalizedSupport at hx
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hx
    change -K.normalizedTranslation t +ᵥ x ∈
      (K.denominator : ℝ) • (-K.anchor +ᵥ K.support) at hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hx
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hy
    refine ⟨t + K.anchor + y, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change t + K.anchor + y ∈ t +ᵥ K.support
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      convert hy using 1
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      abel
    · have hx_eq : x = K.normalizedTranslation t +
          (K.denominator : ℝ) • y := by
        change (K.denominator : ℝ) • y =
          -K.normalizedTranslation t + x at hyx
        rw [hyx]
        abel
      rw [hx_eq]
      simp only [RationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedTranslation, smul_add]
      module
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    change (K.denominator : ℝ) • y ∈
      K.normalizedTranslation t +ᵥ K.normalizedSupport
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    change y ∈ t +ᵥ K.support at hy
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hy
    refine ⟨-K.anchor + y - t, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      convert hy using 1
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      abel
    · simp only [RationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedTranslation, vadd_eq_add,
        smul_add, smul_sub]
      module

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedRegion_tiles
proof:
:= by
  have hnormalized_countable : (K.normalizedTranslations T).Countable :=
    hT.countable.image K.normalizedTranslation
  refine ⟨PolygonalRegion.placements_countable K.normalizedRegion
    hnormalized_countable, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro p hp q hq hpq
    change p.1 ∈ K.normalizedTranslations T at hp
    change q.1 ∈ K.normalizedTranslations T at hq
    obtain ⟨t, ht, htp⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsq⟩ := hq
    let p₀ : Placement Plane Unit := (t, ())
    let q₀ : Placement Plane Unit := (s, ())
    have hp₀ : p₀ ∈ K.toPolygonalRegion.placements T := ht
    have hq₀ : q₀ ∈ K.toPolygonalRegion.placements T := hs
    have hts : t ≠ s := by
      intro hts
      apply hpq
      apply Prod.ext
      · rw [← htp, ← hsq, hts]
      · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    have hpq₀ : p₀ ≠ q₀ := by
      intro hpq₀
      apply hts
      exact congrArg Prod.fst hpq₀
    have had := hT.isPacking hp₀ hq₀ hpq₀
    change AEDisjoint volume
      (placedTile K.normalizedRegion.prototileFamily p)
      (placedTile K.normalizedRegion.prototileFamily q)
    have hpTile : placedTile K.normalizedRegion.prototileFamily p =
        (K.denominator : ℝ) •
          placedTile K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily p₀ := by
      change p.1 +ᵥ K.normalizedSupport =
        (K.denominator : ℝ) • (t +ᵥ K.support)
      rw [← htp]
      exact K.normalized_placedTile t
    have hqTile : placedTile K.normalizedRegion.prototileFamily q =
        (K.denominator : ℝ) •
          placedTile K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily q₀ := by
      change q.1 +ᵥ K.normalizedSupport =
        (K.denominator : ℝ) • (s +ᵥ K.support)
      rw [← hsq]
      exact K.normalized_placedTile s
    rw [hpTile, hqTile]
    exact aedisjoint_smul K.denominator K.denominator_cast_ne_zero had
  · have hcover :=
      (volume.quasiMeasurePreserving_smul
        (inv_ne_zero K.denominator_cast_ne_zero)).ae hT.isCover
    filter_upwards [hcover] with x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    let j : Placement Plane Unit := (K.normalizedTranslation i.1.1, ())
    have hj : j ∈ K.normalizedRegion.placements (K.normalizedTranslations T) := by
      exact ⟨i.1.1, i.2, rfl⟩
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, ?_⟩
    change x ∈ placedTile K.normalizedRegion.prototileFamily j
    rw [show placedTile K.normalizedRegion.prototileFamily j =
        (K.denominator : ℝ) •
          placedTile K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily i.1 by
      simpa only [j] using K.normalized_placedTile i.1.1]
    refine ⟨(K.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ • x, hxi, ?_⟩
    change (K.denominator : ℝ) • ((K.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ • x) = x
    rw [← mul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ K.denominator_cast_ne_zero, one_smul]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.denormalized_placedTile
statement:
theorem denormalized_placedTile (K : RationalPolygonalRegion) (t : Plane) :
    placedTile K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.denormalizedTranslation t, ()) =
      (K.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ •
        placedTile K.normalizedRegion.prototileFamily (t, ())
proof:
:= by
  have h := K.normalized_placedTile (K.denormalizedTranslation t)
  rw [K.normalizedTranslation_denormalizedTranslation] at h
  have hscaled := congrArg
    (fun A : Set Plane ↦ (K.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ • A) h
  simpa [smul_smul, K.denominator_cast_ne_zero] using hscaled.symm

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.tiles_of_normalizedRegion_tiles
statement:
theorem tiles_of_normalizedRegion_tiles
    (K : RationalPolygonalRegion) {T : Set Plane}
    (hT : K.normalizedRegion.Tiles T) :
    K.toPolygonalRegion.Tiles (K.denormalizedTranslations T)
proof:
:= by
  have hdenormalized_countable : (K.denormalizedTranslations T).Countable :=
    hT.countable.image K.denormalizedTranslation
  refine ⟨PolygonalRegion.placements_countable K.toPolygonalRegion
    hdenormalized_countable, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro p hp q hq hpq
    change p.1 ∈ K.denormalizedTranslations T at hp
    change q.1 ∈ K.denormalizedTranslations T at hq
    obtain ⟨t, ht, htp⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsq⟩ := hq
    let p₀ : Placement Plane Unit := (t, ())
    let q₀ : Placement Plane Unit := (s, ())
    have hp₀ : p₀ ∈ K.normalizedRegion.placements T := ht
    have hq₀ : q₀ ∈ K.normalizedRegion.placements T := hs
    have hts : t ≠ s := by
      intro hts
      apply hpq
      apply Prod.ext
      · rw [← htp, ← hsq, hts]
      · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    have hpq₀ : p₀ ≠ q₀ := by
      intro hpq₀
      apply hts
      exact congrArg Prod.fst hpq₀
    have had := hT.isPacking hp₀ hq₀ hpq₀
    change AEDisjoint volume
      (placedTile K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily p)
      (placedTile K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily q)
    have hpTile : placedTile K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily p =
        (K.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ •
          placedTile K.normalizedRegion.prototileFamily p₀ := by
      change p.1 +ᵥ K.support =
        (K.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ • (t +ᵥ K.normalizedSupport)
      rw [← htp]
      exact K.denormalized_placedTile t
    have hqTile : placedTile K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily q =
        (K.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ •
          placedTile K.normalizedRegion.prototileFamily q₀ := by
      change q.1 +ᵥ K.support =
        (K.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ • (s +ᵥ K.normalizedSupport)
      rw [← hsq]
      exact K.denormalized_placedTile s
    rw [hpTile, hqTile]
    exact aedisjoint_smul (K.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹
      (inv_ne_zero K.denominator_cast_ne_zero) had
  · have hcover :=
      (volume.quasiMeasurePreserving_smul K.denominator_cast_ne_zero).ae hT.isCover
    filter_upwards [hcover] with x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    let j : Placement Plane Unit := (K.denormalizedTranslation i.1.1, ())
    have hj : j ∈ K.toPolygonalRegion.placements
        (K.denormalizedTranslations T) := by
      exact ⟨i.1.1, i.2, rfl⟩
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, ?_⟩
    change x ∈ placedTile K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily j
    rw [show placedTile K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily j =
        (K.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ •
          placedTile K.normalizedRegion.prototileFamily i.1 by
      simpa only [j] using K.denormalized_placedTile i.1.1]
    refine ⟨(K.denominator : ℝ) • x, hxi, ?_⟩
    change (K.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹ • ((K.denominator : ℝ) • x) = x
    rw [← mul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ K.denominator_cast_ne_zero, one_smul]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.Tiles.vadd
proof:
:= by
  have hTcountable : T.Countable := hT.countable
  have htranslated_countable : (a +ᵥ T).Countable := by
    have heq : a +ᵥ T = (fun t ↦ a + t) '' T := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        refine ⟨-a + x, ?_, by abel_nf⟩
        simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using hx
      · rintro ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
        simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
          neg_add_cancel_left] using ht
    rw [heq]
    exact hTcountable.image _
  refine ⟨placements_countable K htranslated_countable, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp q hq hpq
    change p.1 ∈ a +ᵥ T at hp
    change q.1 ∈ a +ᵥ T at hq
    have hpT : -a + p.1 ∈ T := by
      simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using hp
    have hqT : -a + q.1 ∈ T := by
      simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using hq
    let p₀ : Placement Plane Unit := (-a + p.1, ())
    let q₀ : Placement Plane Unit := (-a + q.1, ())
    have hp₀T : p₀ ∈ K.placements T := hpT
    have hq₀T : q₀ ∈ K.placements T := hqT
    have hpq₀ : p₀ ≠ q₀ := by
      intro hpq₀
      apply hpq
      apply Prod.ext
      · have := congrArg Prod.fst hpq₀
        dsimp only [p₀, q₀] at this
        exact add_left_cancel this
      · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    have had := hT.isPacking hp₀T hq₀T hpq₀
    have hpTile : placedTile K.prototileFamily p =
        a +ᵥ placedTile K.prototileFamily p₀ := by
      ext x
      simp only [placedTile_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, p₀, vadd_eq_add]
      constructor <;> intro hx
      · convert hx using 1
        abel
      · convert hx using 1
        abel
    have hqTile : placedTile K.prototileFamily q =
        a +ᵥ placedTile K.prototileFamily q₀ := by
      ext x
      simp only [placedTile_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, q₀, vadd_eq_add]
      constructor <;> intro hx
      · convert hx using 1
        abel
      · convert hx using 1
        abel
    change AEDisjoint volume (placedTile K.prototileFamily p)
      (placedTile K.prototileFamily q)
    rw [hpTile, hqTile]
    exact aedisjoint_vadd a had
  · have hcover := (quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left volume (-a)).ae hT.isCover
    filter_upwards [hcover] with x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    let j : Placement Plane Unit := (a + i.1.1, ())
    have hj : j ∈ K.placements (a +ᵥ T) := by
      simpa only [placements, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem,
        j, vadd_eq_add, neg_add_cancel_left] using i.2
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, ?_⟩
    change x ∈ (a + i.1.1) +ᵥ K.support
    change -a + x ∈ i.1.1 +ᵥ K.support at hxi
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hxi ⊢
    convert hxi using 1
    simp only [vadd_eq_add]
    abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.vertexGraph_adj_translation_sub_mem_integerLattice
statement:
private theorem vertexGraph_adj_translation_sub_mem_integerLattice
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane} (hK : K.HasIntegerVertices)
    {i j : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).placements}
    (hij : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.Adj i j) :
    j.1.1 - i.1.1 ∈ integerLattice
proof:
:= by
  let A := K.polygonalProtoTiling T
  have hconnected : A.VertexConnected i j := (A.vertexGraph_adj i j).mp hij |>.2
  obtain ⟨x, hxi, hxj⟩ := hconnected
  change x ∈ i.1.1 +ᵥ vertexSet K.support at hxi
  change x ∈ j.1.1 +ᵥ vertexSet K.support at hxj
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hxi hxj
  have hi := hK (-i.1.1 +ᵥ x) hxi
  have hj := hK (-j.1.1 +ᵥ x) hxj
  change -i.1.1 +ᵥ x ∈ integerLattice at hi
  change -j.1.1 +ᵥ x ∈ integerLattice at hj
  have hdifference := AddSubgroup.sub_mem integerLattice hi hj
  convert hdifference using 1
  simp only [vadd_eq_add]
  abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.walk_translation_sub_mem_integerLattice
statement:
private theorem walk_translation_sub_mem_integerLattice
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane} (hK : K.HasIntegerVertices)
    {i j : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).placements}
    (p : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.Walk i j) :
    j.1.1 - i.1.1 ∈ integerLattice
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | @cons u v w huv p ih =>
      have huv' := vertexGraph_adj_translation_sub_mem_integerLattice hK huv
      change v.1.1 - u.1.1 ∈ integerLattice at huv'
      have hsum := AddSubgroup.add_mem integerLattice huv' ih
      convert hsum using 1
      abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.samePlate_translation_sub_mem_integerLattice
statement:
theorem samePlate_translation_sub_mem_integerLattice
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane} (hK : K.HasIntegerVertices)
    {i j : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).placements}
    (hij : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).SamePlate i j) :
    j.1.1 - i.1.1 ∈ integerLattice
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := hij
  exact walk_translation_sub_mem_integerLattice hK p

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.translations_integer_of_connected
statement:
theorem translations_integer_of_connected
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane} (hK : K.HasIntegerVertices)
    (hzero : 0 ∈ T) (hconnected : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).vertexGraph.Connected) :
    ∀ t ∈ T, IsIntegerPoint t
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  let i : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).placements := ⟨(0, ()), hzero⟩
  let j : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).placements := ⟨(t, ()), ht⟩
  have hreach : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T).SamePlate i j := hconnected i j
  change t ∈ integerLattice
  simpa only [i, j, sub_zero] using samePlate_translation_sub_mem_integerLattice hK hreach

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.exists_connected_tiling
statement:
theorem exists_connected_tiling {K : PolygonalRegion} {T : Set Plane}
    (hT : K.Tiles T) :
    ∃ T' : Set Plane,
      K.Tiles T' ∧ (K.polygonalProtoTiling T').vertexGraph.Connected
proof:
:= by
  let A := K.polygonalProtoTiling T
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hconnected⟩ := A.exists_connected_tiling hT
  let T' : Set Plane := Prod.fst '' S
  have hplacements : K.placements T' = S := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · intro hp
      obtain ⟨q, hqS, hqp⟩ := hp
      have hqp' : q = p := by
        apply Prod.ext hqp
        exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simpa only [hqp'] using hqS
    · intro hp
      exact ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  rw [← hplacements] at hS hconnected
  refine ⟨T', hS, ?_⟩
  simpa only [polygonalProtoTiling, PolygonalProtoTiling.withPlacements, A] using hconnected

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.exists_integer_tiling
statement:
theorem exists_integer_tiling {K : PolygonalRegion} (hK : K.HasIntegerVertices)
    {T : Set Plane} (hT : K.Tiles T) :
    ∃ T' : Set Plane,
      K.Tiles T' ∧ 0 ∈ T' ∧ ∀ t ∈ T', IsIntegerPoint t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T₀, hT₀, hconnected⟩ := exists_connected_tiling hT
  obtain ⟨i⟩ := hconnected.nonempty
  let base : Plane := i.1.1
  let T' : Set Plane := -base +ᵥ T₀
  have hibase : base ∈ T₀ := by
    change i.1.1 ∈ T₀
    exact i.2
  have hzero : 0 ∈ T' := by
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simpa only [neg_neg, vadd_eq_add, add_zero] using hibase
  have hinteger : ∀ t ∈ T', IsIntegerPoint t := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at ht
    let ibase : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T₀).placements := ⟨(base, ()), i.2⟩
    let it : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T₀).placements := ⟨(-(-base) +ᵥ t, ()), ht⟩
    have hreach : (K.polygonalProtoTiling T₀).SamePlate ibase it :=
      hconnected ibase it
    have hdifference := samePlate_translation_sub_mem_integerLattice hK hreach
    change t ∈ integerLattice
    convert hdifference using 1
    simp only [ibase, it, vadd_eq_add]
    abel
  exact ⟨T', hT₀.vadd (-base), hzero, hinteger⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.doublyPeriodic_integerPoint_image_of_setScalarPeriodic
statement:
theorem doublyPeriodic_integerPoint_image_of_setScalarPeriodic
    {A : Set IntegerPlane} {P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P)
    (hA : SetScalarPeriodic P A) :
    DoublyPeriodic (integerPoint '' A)
proof:
:= by
  let v₁ : IntegerPlane := (P : ℤ) • horizontalUnit
  let v₂ : IntegerPlane := (P : ℤ) • verticalUnit
  let h₁ := integerPoint v₁
  let h₂ := integerPoint v₂
  have hperiod₁ : SetPeriodicBy (integerPoint '' A) h₁ := by
    apply setPeriodicBy_integerPoint_image
    intro x
    exact hA x horizontalUnit
  have hperiod₂ : SetPeriodicBy (integerPoint '' A) h₂ := by
    apply setPeriodicBy_integerPoint_image
    intro x
    exact hA x verticalUnit
  refine ⟨h₁, h₂, ?_, hperiod₁, hperiod₂⟩
  rw [linearIndependent_fin2]
  change h₂ ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a : ℝ, a • h₂ ≠ h₁
  constructor
  · intro hzero
    have hvzero : v₂ = 0 := by
      apply integerPoint_injective
      simpa only [h₂, integerPoint_zero] using hzero
    have him := congrFun hvzero 1
    change (P : ℤ) * 1 = 0 at him
    omega
  · intro a ha
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re ha
    simp [h₁, h₂, v₁, v₂, integerPoint, horizontalUnit,
      verticalUnit, latticePoint] at hre
    have hPReal : (P : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hP.ne'
    exact hPReal hre.symm

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.exists_doublyPeriodic_integer_tiling_of_tileable_raster
statement:
theorem exists_doublyPeriodic_integer_tiling_of_tileable_raster
    (K : PolygonalRegion)
    (hraster : ∃ U : Set IntegerPlane,
      TilesUniverse K.relevantPlanarRasterTile U) :
    ∃ T : Set IntegerPlane,
      K.Tiles (integerPoint '' T) ∧ DoublyPeriodic (integerPoint '' T)
proof:
:= by
  have htarget : SetScalarPeriodic 1 (Set.univ : Set IntegerPlane) := by
    intro x z
    simp
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := hraster
  obtain ⟨U', P, hP, hU', hperiod, -⟩ :=
    TranslationalTilings.theorem_1_5 (F := K.relevantPlanarRasterTile)
      (E := Set.univ) (ell := 1) (by omega) htarget ⟨U, hU⟩
  have hperiod' : SetScalarPeriodic P U' := by simpa using hperiod
  obtain ⟨T, hfamily, hTperiod⟩ :=
    exists_scalarPeriodic_family_tiling_of_planarRasterTile
      K.relevantSignatureCount_pos K.relevantPlanarSignatureAt
      K.relevantPlanarSignatureAt_zero_nonempty hU' hperiod'
  refine ⟨T, ?_, doublyPeriodic_integerPoint_image_of_setScalarPeriodic hP hTperiod⟩
  apply (K.tiles_integerPoint_image_iff_relevantSignatures T).mpr
  exact (K.relevantPlanarSignatureAt_tilesUniverse_iff T).mp hfamily

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.doublyPeriodic_denormalizedTranslations
statement:
theorem doublyPeriodic_denormalizedTranslations
    (K : RationalPolygonalRegion) {A : Set Plane}
    (hA : DoublyPeriodic A) :
    DoublyPeriodic (K.denormalizedTranslations A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, hlinear, hperiod₁, hperiod₂⟩ := hA
  let c : ℝ := (K.denominator : ℝ)⁻¹
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero K.denominator_cast_ne_zero
  refine ⟨c • h₁, c • h₂, ?_,
    K.setPeriodicBy_denormalizedTranslations hperiod₁,
    K.setPeriodicBy_denormalizedTranslations hperiod₂⟩
  exact (LinearIndependent.pair_smul_iff hc).mpr hlinear

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.RationalPolygonalRegion.exists_doublyPeriodic_tiling
statement:
theorem exists_doublyPeriodic_tiling (K : RationalPolygonalRegion)
    {T : Set Plane} (hT : K.toPolygonalRegion.Tiles T) :
    ∃ S : Set Plane,
      K.toPolygonalRegion.Tiles S ∧ DoublyPeriodic S
proof:
:= by
  have hnormalized := K.normalizedRegion_tiles hT
  obtain ⟨Z, hZtiles, -⟩ := K.normalizedRegion.exists_integer_signature_tiling
    K.normalizedRegion_hasIntegerVertices hnormalized
  have hraster : ∃ U : Set IntegerPlane,
      TilesUniverse K.normalizedRegion.relevantPlanarRasterTile U :=
    (K.normalizedRegion.exists_integer_tiling_iff_relevantPlanarRasterTile).mp
      ⟨Z, hZtiles⟩
  obtain ⟨Z', hZ'tiles, hZ'periodic⟩ :=
    K.normalizedRegion.exists_doublyPeriodic_integer_tiling_of_tileable_raster hraster
  refine ⟨K.denormalizedTranslations (integerPoint '' Z'),
    K.tiles_of_normalizedRegion_tiles hZ'tiles, ?_⟩
  exact K.doublyPeriodic_denormalizedTranslations hZ'periodic

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.planeTransfer_component_eq_of_transfer
statement:
private theorem planeTransfer_component_eq_of_transfer
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {T : Set IntegerPlane} {v : IntegerPlane}
    {t t' : T} (hv : v = horizontalUnit ∨ v = verticalUnit)
    (h : quakeTransfer F T v t t') :
    (planeTransferGraph F T).connectedComponentMk t =
      (planeTransferGraph F T).connectedComponentMk t'
proof:
:= by
  by_cases htt : t = t'
  · exact congrArg _ htt
  apply SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj
  rw [planeTransferGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj]

  rcases hv with rfl | rfl
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr h

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.planeTransferComponentCarrier_periodic
statement:
theorem planeTransferComponentCarrier_periodic
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {T : Set IntegerPlane}
    (hT : TilesUniverse F T)
    (C : (planeTransferGraph F T).ConnectedComponent) {v : IntegerPlane}
    (hv : v = horizontalUnit ∨ v = verticalUnit) :
    DiscretePeriodicBy
      (discreteCarrier F (planeTransferComponentTranslations C)) v
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, t, htC, hxt⟩
    obtain ⟨htT, htcomp⟩ := htC
    obtain ⟨f', hf'T, -⟩ := existsUnique_tile_representation hT x
    let t' : IntegerPlane := x - f'
    have ht'T : t' ∈ T := hf'T.2
    have hrepresentation : x = f' + t' := by
      dsimp only [t']
      abel
    let ts : T := ⟨t, htT⟩
    let ts' : T := ⟨t', ht'T⟩
    have htransfer : quakeTransfer F T v ts' ts := by
      refine ⟨f', hf'T.1, f, hf, ?_⟩
      rw [← hxt, hrepresentation]
    have hcomp' : (planeTransferGraph F T).connectedComponentMk ts' = C := by
      rw [← htcomp]
      exact planeTransfer_component_eq_of_transfer hv htransfer
    exact ⟨f', hf'T.1, t', ⟨ht'T, hcomp'⟩, hrepresentation⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, t, htC, hxt⟩
    obtain ⟨htT, htcomp⟩ := htC
    obtain ⟨f', hf'T, -⟩ := existsUnique_tile_representation hT (x + v)
    let t' : IntegerPlane := x + v - f'
    have ht'T : t' ∈ T := hf'T.2
    have hrepresentation : x + v = f' + t' := by
      dsimp only [t']
      abel
    let ts : T := ⟨t, htT⟩
    let ts' : T := ⟨t', ht'T⟩
    have htransfer : quakeTransfer F T v ts ts' := by
      refine ⟨f, hf, f', hf'T.1, ?_⟩
      rw [← hrepresentation, hxt]
    have hcomp' : (planeTransferGraph F T).connectedComponentMk ts' = C := by
      rw [← htcomp]
      exact (planeTransfer_component_eq_of_transfer hv htransfer).symm
    exact ⟨f', hf'T.1, t', ⟨ht'T, hcomp'⟩, hrepresentation⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.planeTransferGraph_connected
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀, hf₀Unique⟩ := existsUnique_tile_representation hT 0
  let t₀ : T := ⟨-f₀, by simpa only [zero_sub] using hf₀.2⟩
  have hF : f₀ ∈ F := hf₀.1
  rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, ⟨t₀⟩⟩
  intro a b
  let C := (planeTransferGraph F T).connectedComponentMk a
  have hbase : f₀ + (a : IntegerPlane) ∈
      discreteCarrier F (planeTransferComponentTranslations C) := by
    refine ⟨f₀, hF, a, ⟨a.2, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have hh := planeTransferComponentCarrier_periodic hT C
    (v := horizontalUnit) (Or.inl rfl)
  have hv := planeTransferComponentCarrier_periodic hT C
    (v := verticalUnit) (Or.inr rfl)
  let dx : ℤ := (f₀ + (b : IntegerPlane)) 0 - (f₀ + (a : IntegerPlane)) 0
  let dy : ℤ := (f₀ + (b : IntegerPlane)) 1 - (f₀ + (a : IntegerPlane)) 1
  have hhorizontal := (hh.zsmul dx (f₀ + (a : IntegerPlane))).2 hbase
  have hboth := (hv.zsmul dy
    (f₀ + (a : IntegerPlane) + dx • horizontalUnit)).2 hhorizontal
  have hpoint : f₀ + (a : IntegerPlane) + dx • horizontalUnit + dy • verticalUnit =
      f₀ + (b : IntegerPlane) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · change f₀ 0 + (a : IntegerPlane) 0 + dx * 1 + dy * 0 =
        f₀ 0 + (b : IntegerPlane) 0
      dsimp only [dx, dy]
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
      ring
    · change f₀ 1 + (a : IntegerPlane) 1 + dx * 0 + dy * 1 =
        f₀ 1 + (b : IntegerPlane) 1
      dsimp only [dx, dy]
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
      ring
  rw [hpoint] at hboth
  obtain ⟨g, hg, s, hsC, heq⟩ := mem_discreteCarrier_iff.mp hboth
  obtain ⟨hsT, hscomp⟩ := hsC
  have hbs : (b : IntegerPlane) = s := by
    exact translation_eq_of_eq_representations hT hF b.2 hg hsT heq
  have hcomp : (planeTransferGraph F T).connectedComponentMk b = C := by
    have hbsSubtype : b = (⟨s, hsT⟩ : T) := Subtype.ext hbs
    rw [hbsSubtype]
    exact hscomp
  exact SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq.mp hcomp.symm

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.planeTransfer_walk_sub_mem_addSubgroup
statement:
private theorem planeTransfer_walk_sub_mem_addSubgroup
    (H : AddSubgroup IntegerPlane)
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {T : Set IntegerPlane}
    (hedge : ∀ {v : IntegerPlane} (_hv : v = horizontalUnit ∨ v = verticalUnit)
      {t t' : T}, quakeTransfer F T v t t' →
        (t' : IntegerPlane) - (t : IntegerPlane) ∈ H)
    {t t' : T} (p : (planeTransferGraph F T).Walk t t') :
    (t' : IntegerPlane) - (t : IntegerPlane) ∈ H
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | @cons u v w huv p ih =>
      rw [planeTransferGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj] at huv
      rcases huv.2 with hforward | hbackward
      · rcases hforward with hh | hv
        · have huvMem := hedge (Or.inl rfl) hh
          have hsum := AddSubgroup.add_mem H huvMem ih
          convert hsum using 1
          abel
        · have huvMem := hedge (Or.inr rfl) hv
          have hsum := AddSubgroup.add_mem H huvMem ih
          convert hsum using 1
          abel
      · rcases hbackward with hh | hv
        · have huvMem := AddSubgroup.neg_mem H
            (hedge (Or.inl rfl) hh)
          have hsum := AddSubgroup.add_mem H huvMem ih
          convert hsum using 1
          abel
        · have huvMem := AddSubgroup.neg_mem H
            (hedge (Or.inr rfl) hv)
          have hsum := AddSubgroup.add_mem H huvMem ih
          convert hsum using 1
          abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.translations_mem_coset_of_transfer
statement:
theorem translations_mem_coset_of_transfer
    (H : AddSubgroup IntegerPlane)
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} {T : Set IntegerPlane}
    (hT : TilesUniverse F T) {base : IntegerPlane} (hbase : base ∈ T)
    (hedge : ∀ {v : IntegerPlane} (_hv : v = horizontalUnit ∨ v = verticalUnit)
      {t t' : T}, quakeTransfer F T v t t' →
        (t' : IntegerPlane) - (t : IntegerPlane) ∈ H) :
    ∀ t ∈ T, t - base ∈ H
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  let b : T := ⟨base, hbase⟩
  let s : T := ⟨t, ht⟩
  have hconnected := planeTransferGraph_connected hT
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := hconnected b s
  exact planeTransfer_walk_sub_mem_addSubgroup H hedge p

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_gridBox_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_gridBox_iff {x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ : ℤ} {z : IntegerPlane} :
    z ∈ gridBox x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ ↔
      x₀ ≤ z 0 ∧ z 0 ≤ x₁ ∧ y₀ ≤ z 1 ∧ z 1 ≤ y₁
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hz
    rw [gridBox, Finset.mem_image] at hz
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpz⟩ := hz
    have hp' : p.1 ∈ Finset.Icc x₀ x₁ ∧ p.2 ∈ Finset.Icc y₀ y₁ := by
      exact Finset.mem_product.mp hp
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Icc] at hp'
    obtain ⟨hp₀, hp₁⟩ := hp'
    subst z
    simpa only [latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one] using
      ⟨hp₀.1, hp₀.2, hp₁.1, hp₁.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx₀, hx₁, hy₀, hy₁⟩
    rw [gridBox, Finset.mem_image]
    refine ⟨(z 0, z 1), Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hx₀, hx₁⟩,
        Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hy₀, hy₁⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerCenter_mem_markerSquare
statement:
theorem markerCenter_mem_markerSquare {M : ℕ} {i : Fin M} (hi : i.val ≠ 0) :
    markerCenter i ∈ markerSquare M
proof:
:= by
  rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
  simp only [markerCenter, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one,
    markerSide, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  have hiLower : (1 : ℤ) ≤ i := by
    omega
  have hiUpper : (i : ℤ) < M := by
    exact_mod_cast i.isLt
  constructor
  · omega
  constructor
  · omega
  constructor <;> omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerRing_card
statement:
theorem markerRing_card {M : ℕ} (i : Fin M) :
    (markerRing i).card = 8
proof:
:= by
  rw [markerRing, Finset.card_erase_of_mem]
  · rw [gridBox]
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective]
    · have hproduct := Finset.card_product
        (Finset.Icc (3 * (i : ℤ) - 1) (3 * (i : ℤ) + 1))
        (Finset.Icc (2 : ℤ) 4)
      rw [hproduct, Int.card_Icc, Int.card_Icc]
      have hx : 3 * (i : ℤ) + 1 + 1 - (3 * (i : ℤ) - 1) = 3 := by
        ring
      rw [hx]
      decide
    · intro p q hpq
      apply Prod.ext
      · exact congrFun hpq 0
      · exact congrFun hpq 1
  · rw [mem_gridBox_iff]
    simp [markerCenter]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerRing_bounds
statement:
theorem markerRing_bounds {M : ℕ} {i : Fin M} {z : IntegerPlane}
    (hz : z ∈ markerRing i) :
    3 * (i : ℤ) - 1 ≤ z 0 ∧ z 0 ≤ 3 * (i : ℤ) + 1 ∧
      2 ≤ z 1 ∧ z 1 ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  exact mem_gridBox_iff.mp (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hz)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerRing_disjoint
statement:
theorem markerRing_disjoint {M : ℕ} {i j : Fin M} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Disjoint (markerRing i) (markerRing j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro z hzi hzj
  have hi := markerRing_bounds hzi
  have hj := markerRing_bounds hzj
  have hval : i.val ≠ j.val := by
    intro h
    exact hij (Fin.ext h)
  omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerRing_subset_markerSquare
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
  have hb := markerRing_bounds hz
  have hiLower : (1 : ℤ) ≤ i := by omega
  have hiUpper : (i : ℤ) < M := by exact_mod_cast i.isLt
  simp only [markerSide, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerRing_subset_nonzeroMarkerRings
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rw [nonzeroMarkerRings, Finset.mem_biUnion]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.protrusions_not_mem_markerRing
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hb := markerRing_bounds h
    simp only [markerEast, latticePoint_apply_one] at hb
    omega
  · intro h
    have hb := markerRing_bounds h
    have hiLower : (1 : ℤ) ≤ i := by omega
    simp only [markerNorth, latticePoint_apply_zero] at hb
    omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerZero_disjoint_markerRing
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro z hz0 hzi
  have hz0' := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hz0).2
  have hz0'' := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hz0').2
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert] at hz0''
  rcases hz0'' with hNorth | hEast | hbase
  · subst z
    exact (protrusions_not_mem_markerRing hi).2 hzi
  · subst z
    exact (protrusions_not_mem_markerRing hi).1 hzi
  · have hznot : z ∉ nonzeroMarkerRings M := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hbase).2
    exact hznot (markerRing_subset_nonzeroMarkerRings hi hzi)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerBlock_disjoint
statement:
theorem markerBlock_disjoint {M : ℕ} {i j : Fin M} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Disjoint (markerBlock i) (markerBlock j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · have hj : j.val ≠ 0 := by
      intro hj0
      apply hij
      apply Fin.ext
      omega
    rw [markerBlock, if_pos hi, markerBlock_of_ne_zero hj]
    exact markerZero_disjoint_markerRing hj
  · by_cases hj : j.val = 0
    · rw [markerBlock_of_ne_zero hi, markerBlock, if_pos hj]
      exact (markerZero_disjoint_markerRing hi).symm
    · rw [markerBlock_of_ne_zero hi, markerBlock_of_ne_zero hj]
      exact markerRing_disjoint hij

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerZero_subset_modifiedMarkerSquare
statement:
private theorem markerZero_subset_modifiedMarkerSquare (M : ℕ) :
    markerZero M ⊆ modifiedMarkerSquare M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro z hz
  rw [markerZero, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase] at hz
  obtain ⟨hsouth, hwest, hbase⟩ := hz
  rw [modifiedMarkerSquare, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase]
  refine ⟨hsouth, hwest, ?_⟩
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hbase with hNorth | hrest
  · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl hNorth)
  · rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hrest with hEast | hbase'
    · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr
        (Or.inr (Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl hEast)))
    · have hsquare : z ∈ markerSquare M := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hbase').1
      have hinner : z ∈ insert (markerEast M) (markerSquare M) :=
        Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr hsquare)
      exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr hinner)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerRing_subset_modifiedMarkerSquare
statement:
private theorem markerRing_subset_modifiedMarkerSquare {M : ℕ} {i : Fin M}
    (hi : i.val ≠ 0) : markerRing i ⊆ modifiedMarkerSquare M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro z hz
  have hsquare := markerRing_subset_markerSquare hi hz
  have hsouth : z ≠ markerSouthHole := by
    intro hzSouth
    subst z
    have hb := markerRing_bounds hz
    simp only [markerSouthHole, latticePoint_apply_one] at hb
    omega
  have hwest : z ≠ markerWestHole := by
    intro hzWest
    subst z
    have hb := markerRing_bounds hz
    simp only [markerWestHole, latticePoint_apply_one] at hb
    omega
  rw [modifiedMarkerSquare, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase]
  exact ⟨hsouth, hwest, Finset.mem_insert.mpr <|
    Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr <| Or.inr hsquare⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerUnion_subset_modifiedMarkerSquare
statement:
private theorem markerUnion_subset_modifiedMarkerSquare {M : ℕ} :
    markerUnion M ⊆ modifiedMarkerSquare M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro z hz
  rw [markerUnion, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hz
  obtain ⟨i, -, hzi⟩ := hz
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · rw [markerBlock, if_pos hi] at hzi
    exact markerZero_subset_modifiedMarkerSquare M hzi
  · rw [markerBlock_of_ne_zero hi] at hzi
    exact markerRing_subset_modifiedMarkerSquare hi hzi

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.modifiedMarkerSquare_subset_markerUnion
statement:
private theorem modifiedMarkerSquare_subset_markerUnion {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) :
    modifiedMarkerSquare M ⊆ markerUnion M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro z hz
  rw [modifiedMarkerSquare, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase] at hz
  obtain ⟨hsouth, hwest, hmodified⟩ := hz
  rw [markerUnion, Finset.mem_biUnion]
  by_cases hrings : z ∈ nonzeroMarkerRings M
  · rw [nonzeroMarkerRings, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hrings
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := hrings
    split at hi
    · simp at hi
    · refine ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, ?_⟩
      rw [markerBlock_of_ne_zero (by assumption)]
      exact hi
  · let zero : Fin M := ⟨0, hM⟩
    refine ⟨zero, Finset.mem_univ zero, ?_⟩
    rw [markerBlock_zero hM, markerZero, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase]
    refine ⟨hsouth, hwest, ?_⟩
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hmodified with hNorth | hrest
    · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl hNorth)
    · rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hrest with hEast | hsquare
      · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr <| Or.inl hEast)
      · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr <|
          Or.inr (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hsquare, hrings⟩))

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerUnion_eq_modifiedMarkerSquare
statement:
theorem markerUnion_eq_modifiedMarkerSquare {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) :
    markerUnion M = modifiedMarkerSquare M
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.Subset.antisymm
  · exact markerUnion_subset_modifiedMarkerSquare
  · exact modifiedMarkerSquare_subset_markerUnion hM

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_markerLattice_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_markerLattice_iff {M : ℕ} {x : IntegerPlane} :
    x ∈ markerLattice M ↔
      ∃ q : IntegerPlane, (markerSide M : ℤ) • q = x
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerSquare_tiles_markerLattice
statement:
theorem markerSquare_tiles_markerLattice (M : ℕ) :
    TilesUniverse (markerSquare M) (markerLattice M : Set IntegerPlane)
proof:
:= by
  apply tilesUniverse_of_existsUnique
  intro x
  let n : ℤ := markerSide M
  have hn : 0 < n := by
    dsimp only [n, markerSide]
    omega
  let q : IntegerPlane := ![x 0 / n, x 1 / n]
  let f : IntegerPlane := latticePoint (x 0 % n) (x 1 % n)
  have hfBounds : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i ∧ f i < n := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact ⟨Int.emod_nonneg _ hn.ne', Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ hn⟩
    · exact ⟨Int.emod_nonneg _ hn.ne', Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ hn⟩
  refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
      have h0 := hfBounds 0
      have h1 := hfBounds 1
      dsimp only [n] at h0 h1
      constructor
      · exact h0.1
      constructor
      · omega
      constructor
      · exact h1.1
      · omega
    · change x - f ∈ markerLattice M
      rw [mem_markerLattice_iff]
      refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      · change (markerSide M : ℤ) * (x 0 / (markerSide M : ℤ)) =
          x 0 - x 0 % (markerSide M : ℤ)
        linarith [Int.emod_add_mul_ediv (x 0) (markerSide M : ℤ)]
      · change (markerSide M : ℤ) * (x 1 / (markerSide M : ℤ)) =
          x 1 - x 1 % (markerSide M : ℤ)
        linarith [Int.emod_add_mul_ediv (x 1) (markerSide M : ℤ)]
  · intro g hg
    rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff] at hg
    obtain ⟨q', hq'⟩ := mem_markerLattice_iff.mp hg.2
    have hcoord : ∀ i, x i % n = g i := by
      intro i
      have hbounds : 0 ≤ g i ∧ g i < n := by
        fin_cases i
        · change 0 ≤ g 0 ∧ g 0 < n
          dsimp only [n]
          omega
        · change 0 ≤ g 1 ∧ g 1 < n
          dsimp only [n]
          omega
      have heq : g i + n * q' i = x i := by
        have h := congrFun hq' i
        simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h
        change (markerSide M : ℤ) * q' i = x i - g i at h
        dsimp only [n]
        linarith
      exact ((Int.ediv_emod_unique hn).mpr
        ⟨heq, hbounds.1, hbounds.2⟩).2
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact (hcoord 0).symm
    · exact (hcoord 1).symm

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerWestHole_mem_markerSquare
statement:
private theorem markerWestHole_mem_markerSquare (M : ℕ) :
    markerWestHole ∈ markerSquare M
proof:
:= by
  rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
  simp only [markerWestHole, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
  omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerSouthHole_mem_markerSquare
statement:
private theorem markerSouthHole_mem_markerSquare (M : ℕ) :

proof:
:= by

  simp only [markerSouthHole, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerEast_not_mem_markerSquare
statement:
private theorem markerEast_not_mem_markerSquare (M : ℕ) :
    markerEast M ∉ markerSquare M
proof:
:= by
  rw [markerSquare, mem_gridBox_iff]
  simp only [markerEast, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerNorth_not_mem_markerSquare
statement:
private theorem markerNorth_not_mem_markerSquare (M : ℕ) :
    markerNorth M ∉ markerSquare M
proof:

  simp only [markerNorth, latticePoint_apply_zero, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide]
