name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerEast_ne_markerNorth
statement:
private theorem markerEast_ne_markerNorth (M : ℕ) :
    markerEast M ≠ markerNorth M
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h0 := congrFun h 0
  simp only [markerEast, markerNorth, latticePoint_apply_zero, markerSide] at h0
  omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerWestHole_ne_markerSouthHole
statement:
private theorem markerWestHole_ne_markerSouthHole :
    markerWestHole ≠ markerSouthHole
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h0 := congrFun h 0
  simp only [markerWestHole, markerSouthHole, latticePoint_apply_zero] at h0
  omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerEast_ne_markerWestHole
statement:
private theorem markerEast_ne_markerWestHole (M : ℕ) :
    markerEast M ≠ markerWestHole
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h0 := congrFun h 0
  simp only [markerEast, markerWestHole, latticePoint_apply_zero, markerSide] at h0
  omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerEast_ne_markerSouthHole
statement:
private theorem markerEast_ne_markerSouthHole (M : ℕ) :
    markerEast M ≠ markerSouthHole
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h0 := congrFun h 0
  simp only [markerEast, markerSouthHole, latticePoint_apply_zero, markerSide] at h0
  omega

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerNorth_ne_markerWestHole
statement:
private theorem markerNorth_ne_markerWestHole (M : ℕ) :
    markerNorth M ≠ markerWestHole
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 := congrFun h 1
  simp only [markerNorth, markerWestHole, latticePoint_apply_one, markerSide] at h1

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerNorth_ne_markerSouthHole
statement:
private theorem markerNorth_ne_markerSouthHole (M : ℕ) :

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerSquareReplacement_west
statement:
private theorem markerSquareReplacement_west (M : ℕ) :
    markerSquareReplacement M markerWestHole = markerEast M
proof:
:= by
  rw [markerSquareReplacement, if_pos rfl]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerSquareReplacement_south
statement:
private theorem markerSquareReplacement_south (M : ℕ) :
    markerSquareReplacement M markerSouthHole = markerNorth M
proof:
:= by
  rw [markerSquareReplacement, if_neg markerWestHole_ne_markerSouthHole.symm, if_pos rfl]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerSquareReplacement_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  rw [markerSquareReplacement, if_neg hwest, if_neg hsouth]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerEast_mem_modifiedMarkerSquare
statement:
private theorem markerEast_mem_modifiedMarkerSquare (M : ℕ) :
    markerEast M ∈ modifiedMarkerSquare M
proof:
:= by
  rw [modifiedMarkerSquare, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase]
  exact ⟨markerEast_ne_markerSouthHole M, markerEast_ne_markerWestHole M,
    Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr (Finset.mem_insert_self ..))⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerNorth_mem_modifiedMarkerSquare
statement:
private theorem markerNorth_mem_modifiedMarkerSquare (M : ℕ) :
    markerNorth M ∈ modifiedMarkerSquare M
proof:
:= by
  rw [modifiedMarkerSquare, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase]
  exact ⟨markerNorth_ne_markerSouthHole M, markerNorth_ne_markerWestHole M,
    Finset.mem_insert_self ..⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerSquareReplacement_injectiveOn
statement:
private theorem markerSquareReplacement_injectiveOn (M : ℕ) :
    Set.InjOn (markerSquareReplacement M) (markerSquare M)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  by_cases hxWest : x = markerWestHole
  · subst x
    by_cases hyWest : y = markerWestHole
    · exact hyWest.symm
    · by_cases hySouth : y = markerSouthHole
      · subst y
        rw [markerSquareReplacement_west, markerSquareReplacement_south] at hxy
        exact (markerEast_ne_markerNorth M hxy).elim
      · rw [markerSquareReplacement_west,
          markerSquareReplacement_of_ne M hyWest hySouth] at hxy
        exfalso
        apply markerEast_not_mem_markerSquare M
        rw [hxy]
        exact hy
  · by_cases hxSouth : x = markerSouthHole
    · subst x
      by_cases hyWest : y = markerWestHole
      · subst y
        rw [markerSquareReplacement_south, markerSquareReplacement_west] at hxy
        exact (markerEast_ne_markerNorth M hxy.symm).elim
      · by_cases hySouth : y = markerSouthHole
        · exact hySouth.symm
        · rw [markerSquareReplacement_south,
            markerSquareReplacement_of_ne M hyWest hySouth] at hxy
          exfalso
          apply markerNorth_not_mem_markerSquare M
          rw [hxy]
          exact hy
    · by_cases hyWest : y = markerWestHole
      · subst y
        rw [markerSquareReplacement_of_ne M hxWest hxSouth,
          markerSquareReplacement_west] at hxy
        exfalso
        apply markerEast_not_mem_markerSquare M
        rw [← hxy]
        exact hx
      · by_cases hySouth : y = markerSouthHole
        · subst y
          rw [markerSquareReplacement_of_ne M hxWest hxSouth,
            markerSquareReplacement_south] at hxy
          exfalso
          apply markerNorth_not_mem_markerSquare M
          rw [← hxy]
          exact hx
        · rw [markerSquareReplacement_of_ne M hxWest hxSouth,
            markerSquareReplacement_of_ne M hyWest hySouth] at hxy
          exact hxy

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.image_markerSquareReplacement
statement:
private theorem image_markerSquareReplacement (M : ℕ) :
    (markerSquare M).image (markerSquareReplacement M) = modifiedMarkerSquare M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hz
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hz
    by_cases hxWest : x = markerWestHole
    · subst x
      rw [markerSquareReplacement_west]
      exact markerEast_mem_modifiedMarkerSquare M
    · by_cases hxSouth : x = markerSouthHole
      · subst x
        rw [markerSquareReplacement_south]
        exact markerNorth_mem_modifiedMarkerSquare M
      · rw [markerSquareReplacement_of_ne M hxWest hxSouth]
        rw [modifiedMarkerSquare, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase]
        exact ⟨hxSouth, hxWest, Finset.mem_insert.mpr <|
          Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr <| Or.inr hx⟩
  · intro hz
    rw [modifiedMarkerSquare, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase] at hz
    obtain ⟨hzSouth, hzWest, hz⟩ := hz
    rw [Finset.mem_image]
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hz with hNorth | hz
    · refine ⟨markerSouthHole, markerSouthHole_mem_markerSquare M, ?_⟩
      rw [markerSquareReplacement_south, hNorth]
    · rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hz with hEast | hzSquare
      · refine ⟨markerWestHole, markerWestHole_mem_markerSquare M, ?_⟩
        rw [markerSquareReplacement_west, hEast]
      · refine ⟨z, hzSquare, ?_⟩
        exact markerSquareReplacement_of_ne M hzWest hzSouth

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerSquareReplacement_sub_mem_markerLattice
statement:
private theorem markerSquareReplacement_sub_mem_markerLattice
    (M : ℕ) {z : IntegerPlane} (hz : z ∈ markerSquare M) :
    markerSquareReplacement M z - z ∈ markerLattice M
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_markerLattice_iff]
  by_cases hzWest : z = markerWestHole
  · subst z
    refine ⟨latticePoint 1 0, ?_⟩
    rw [markerSquareReplacement_west]
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [markerWestHole, markerEast, markerSide, latticePoint, Pi.smul_apply]
  · by_cases hzSouth : z = markerSouthHole
    · subst z
      refine ⟨latticePoint 0 1, ?_⟩
      rw [markerSquareReplacement_south]
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;>
        simp [markerSouthHole, markerNorth, markerSide, latticePoint, Pi.smul_apply]
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rw [markerSquareReplacement_of_ne M hzWest hzSouth]
      simp only [smul_zero, sub_self]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.tilesUniverse_image_of_sub_mem_periods
statement:
private theorem tilesUniverse_image_of_sub_mem_periods
    {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [DecidableEq G] (H : AddSubgroup G)
    (F : Finset G) (e : G → G)
    (hdiff : ∀ f ∈ F, e f - f ∈ H)
    (hF : TilesUniverse F (H : Set G)) :
    TilesUniverse (F.image e) (H : Set G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply tilesUniverse_of_existsUnique
  intro x
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfunique⟩ := existsUnique_tile_representation hF x
  refine ⟨e f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨f, hf.1, rfl⟩
    · have hneg : f - e f ∈ H := by
        simpa only [neg_sub] using (H.neg_mem (hdiff f hf.1))
      have hadd := H.add_mem hf.2 hneg
      change x - e f ∈ H
      convert hadd using 1
      abel
  · intro g hg
    obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀F, hg₀g⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hg.1
    have hsourceTranslation : x - g₀ ∈ H := by
      have hadd := H.add_mem hg.2 (hdiff g₀ hg₀F)
      rw [← hg₀g] at hadd
      convert hadd using 1
      abel
    have hg₀f := hfunique g₀ ⟨hg₀F, hsourceTranslation⟩
    rw [← hg₀g, hg₀f]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.modifiedMarkerSquare_tiles_markerLattice
statement:
theorem modifiedMarkerSquare_tiles_markerLattice (M : ℕ) :
    TilesUniverse (modifiedMarkerSquare M) (markerLattice M : Set IntegerPlane)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← image_markerSquareReplacement M]
  exact tilesUniverse_image_of_sub_mem_periods (markerLattice M) (markerSquare M)
    (markerSquareReplacement M)
    (fun f hf ↦ markerSquareReplacement_sub_mem_markerLattice M hf)
    (markerSquare_tiles_markerLattice M)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerScale_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem markerScale_zero (M : ℕ) : markerScale M 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [markerScale]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerScale_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem markerScale_add (M : ℕ) (x y : IntegerPlane) :
    markerScale M (x + y) = markerScale M x + markerScale M y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [markerScale, smul_add]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerScale_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem markerScale_sub (M : ℕ) (x y : IntegerPlane) :
    markerScale M (x - y) = markerScale M x - markerScale M y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [markerScale, smul_sub]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerScale_injective
statement: theorem markerScale_injective (M : ℕ) : Function.Injective (markerScale M)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  funext i
  have hi := congrFun hxy i
  simp only [markerScale, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hi
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (show (markerSide M : ℤ) ≠ 0 by
    simp only [markerSide]
    omega)
  exact hi

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_markerTranslationSet_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_markerTranslationSet_iff {M : ℕ} {T : Set IntegerPlane}
    {x : IntegerPlane} :
    x ∈ markerTranslationSet M T ↔ ∃ t ∈ T, markerScale M t = x
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_markerPreimage_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_markerPreimage_iff {M : ℕ} {U : Set IntegerPlane}
    {q : IntegerPlane} :
    q ∈ markerPreimage M U ↔ markerScale M q ∈ U
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerTranslationSet_markerPreimage_eq_of_subset
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
    exact hq
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := mem_markerLattice_iff.mp (hU hx)
    have hq' : markerScale M q = x := hq
    refine ⟨q, ?_, hq'⟩
    change markerScale M q ∈ U
    rw [hq']
    exact hx

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_planarRasterTile_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_planarRasterTile_iff {M : ℕ}
    {tile : Fin M → Finset IntegerPlane} {x : IntegerPlane} :
    x ∈ planarRasterTile tile ↔
      ∃ i : Fin M, ∃ f ∈ tile i, ∃ s ∈ markerBlock i,
        markerScale M f + s = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [planarRasterTile, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
    Finset.mem_image]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.existsUnique_markerBlock
proof:
:= by
  have hsUnion : s ∈ markerUnion M := by
    rw [markerUnion_eq_modifiedMarkerSquare hM]
    exact hs
  rw [markerUnion, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hsUnion
  obtain ⟨i, -, hsi⟩ := hsUnion
  refine ⟨i, hsi, ?_⟩
  intro j hsj
  by_contra hij
  have hij' : i ≠ j := Ne.symm hij
  have hnot : s ∉ markerBlock j :=
    (Finset.disjoint_left.mp (markerBlock_disjoint hij')) hsi
  exact hnot hsj

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.markerBlock_nonempty
statement:
theorem markerBlock_nonempty {M : ℕ} (_hM : 0 < M) (i : Fin M) :
    (markerBlock i).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · refine ⟨markerEast M, ?_⟩
    rw [markerBlock, if_pos hi, markerZero, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase]
    exact ⟨markerEast_ne_markerSouthHole M, markerEast_ne_markerWestHole M,
      Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr (Finset.mem_insert_self ..))⟩
  · rw [markerBlock_of_ne_zero hi, Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    intro hempty
    have hcard := markerRing_card i
    rw [hempty] at hcard
    simp at hcard

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.planarRasterTile_tilesUniverse_of_family
statement:
theorem planarRasterTile_tilesUniverse_of_family {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (tile : Fin M → Finset IntegerPlane) (T : Set IntegerPlane)
    (hfamily : ∀ i, TilesUniverse (tile i) T) :
    TilesUniverse (planarRasterTile tile) (markerTranslationSet M T)
proof:
:= by
  apply tilesUniverse_of_existsUnique
  intro x
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsUnique⟩ :=
    existsUnique_tile_representation (modifiedMarkerSquare_tiles_markerLattice M) x
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := mem_markerLattice_iff.mp hs.2
  change markerScale M q = x - s at hq
  obtain ⟨i, hsi, hiUnique⟩ := existsUnique_markerBlock hM hs.1
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfUnique⟩ := existsUnique_tile_representation (hfamily i) q
  let r : IntegerPlane := markerScale M f + s
  refine ⟨r, ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · exact mem_planarRasterTile_iff.mpr ⟨i, f, hf.1, s, hsi, rfl⟩
    · rw [mem_markerTranslationSet_iff]
      refine ⟨q - f, hf.2, ?_⟩
      rw [markerScale_sub, hq]
      dsimp only [r]
      abel
  · intro r' hr'
    obtain ⟨j, g, hgj, s', hs'j, hr'Eq⟩ := mem_planarRasterTile_iff.mp hr'.1
    obtain ⟨t, htT, htEq⟩ := mem_markerTranslationSet_iff.mp hr'.2
    have hs'Modified : s' ∈ modifiedMarkerSquare M := by
      rw [← markerUnion_eq_modifiedMarkerSquare hM, markerUnion,
        Finset.mem_biUnion]
      exact ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, hs'j⟩
    have hxSubS' : x - s' ∈ markerLattice M := by
      rw [mem_markerLattice_iff]
      refine ⟨g + t, ?_⟩
      change markerScale M (g + t) = x - s'
      rw [markerScale_add, htEq, ← hr'Eq]
      abel
    have hs's : s' = s := hsUnique s' ⟨hs'Modified, hxSubS'⟩
    have hji : j = i := by
      apply hiUnique j
      rwa [hs's] at hs'j
    subst j
    have hqg : q - g ∈ T := by
      have hscaled : markerScale M (q - g) = markerScale M t := by
        rw [markerScale_sub, hq, htEq, ← hr'Eq, hs's]
        abel
      have : q - g = t := markerScale_injective M hscaled
      rwa [this]
    have hgf : g = f := hfUnique g ⟨hgj, hqg⟩
    rw [← hr'Eq, hgf, hs's]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.family_tilesUniverse_of_planarRasterTile
statement:
theorem family_tilesUniverse_of_planarRasterTile {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (tile : Fin M → Finset IntegerPlane) (T : Set IntegerPlane)
    (hraster : TilesUniverse (planarRasterTile tile) (markerTranslationSet M T)) :
    ∀ i, TilesUniverse (tile i) T
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  apply tilesUniverse_of_existsUnique
  intro x
  obtain ⟨s, hsi⟩ := markerBlock_nonempty hM i
  let X : IntegerPlane := markerScale M x + s
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrUnique⟩ := existsUnique_tile_representation hraster X
  obtain ⟨j, g, hgj, s', hs'j, hrEq⟩ := mem_planarRasterTile_iff.mp hr.1
  obtain ⟨t, htT, htEq⟩ := mem_markerTranslationSet_iff.mp hr.2
  have hsModified : s ∈ modifiedMarkerSquare M := by
    rw [← markerUnion_eq_modifiedMarkerSquare hM, markerUnion, Finset.mem_biUnion]
    exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, hsi⟩
  have hs'Modified : s' ∈ modifiedMarkerSquare M := by
    rw [← markerUnion_eq_modifiedMarkerSquare hM, markerUnion, Finset.mem_biUnion]
    exact ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, hs'j⟩
  have hXSubS : X - s ∈ markerLattice M := by
    rw [mem_markerLattice_iff]
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    dsimp only [X]
    abel
  have hXSubS' : X - s' ∈ markerLattice M := by
    rw [mem_markerLattice_iff]
    refine ⟨g + t, ?_⟩
    change markerScale M (g + t) = X - s'
    rw [markerScale_add, htEq, ← hrEq]
    abel
  obtain ⟨chosen, hchosen, hchosenUnique⟩ :=
    existsUnique_tile_representation (modifiedMarkerSquare_tiles_markerLattice M) X
  have hss' : s = s' :=
    (hchosenUnique s ⟨hsModified, hXSubS⟩).trans
      (hchosenUnique s' ⟨hs'Modified, hXSubS'⟩).symm
  have hij : i = j := by
    by_contra hij
    have hnot : s ∉ markerBlock j :=
      Finset.disjoint_left.mp (markerBlock_disjoint hij) hsi
    exact hnot (hss' ▸ hs'j)
  subst j
  have hxgt : x - g = t := by
    apply markerScale_injective M
    rw [markerScale_sub]
    calc
      markerScale M x - markerScale M g =
          (markerScale M x + s) - (markerScale M g + s') := by
            rw [hss']
            abel
      _ = X - r := by rw [hrEq]
      _ = markerScale M t := htEq.symm
  refine ⟨g, ⟨hgj, hxgt ▸ htT⟩, ?_⟩
  intro g' hg'
  let r' : IntegerPlane := markerScale M g' + s
  have hr'Tile : r' ∈ planarRasterTile tile := by
    exact mem_planarRasterTile_iff.mpr ⟨i, g', hg'.1, s, hsi, rfl⟩
  have hr'Translation : X - r' ∈ markerTranslationSet M T := by
    rw [mem_markerTranslationSet_iff]
    refine ⟨x - g', hg'.2, ?_⟩
    rw [markerScale_sub]
    dsimp only [X, r']
    abel
  have hr'r : r' = r := hrUnique r' ⟨hr'Tile, hr'Translation⟩
  apply markerScale_injective M
  dsimp only [r'] at hr'r
  have hrbase : r = markerScale M g + s := by
    rw [← hrEq, hss']
  rw [hrbase] at hr'r
  exact add_right_cancel hr'r

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.planarRasterTile_tilesUniverse_iff_family
statement:
theorem planarRasterTile_tilesUniverse_iff_family {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (tile : Fin M → Finset IntegerPlane) (T : Set IntegerPlane) :
    TilesUniverse (planarRasterTile tile) (markerTranslationSet M T) ↔
      ∀ i, TilesUniverse (tile i) T
proof:
:=
  ⟨family_tilesUniverse_of_planarRasterTile hM tile T,
    planarRasterTile_tilesUniverse_of_family hM tile T⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.exists_family_tiling_of_planarRasterTile_coset
statement:
theorem exists_family_tiling_of_planarRasterTile_coset {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (tile : Fin M → Finset IntegerPlane) (U : Set IntegerPlane)
    (hraster : TilesUniverse (planarRasterTile tile) U)
    (base : IntegerPlane)
    (hcoset : ∀ u ∈ U, u - base ∈ markerLattice M) :
    ∃ T : Set IntegerPlane, ∀ i, TilesUniverse (tile i) T
proof:
:= by
  let U₀ : Set IntegerPlane := -base +ᵥ U
  have hU₀ : U₀ ⊆ markerLattice M := by
    intro x hx
    have hxU : base + x ∈ U := by
      simpa only [U₀, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, neg_neg,
        vadd_eq_add] using hx
    have hmem := hcoset (base + x) hxU
    have heq : base + x - base = x := by abel
    rw [heq] at hmem
    exact hmem
  let T : Set IntegerPlane := markerPreimage M U₀
  have hscaled : markerTranslationSet M T = U₀ :=
    markerTranslationSet_markerPreimage_eq_of_subset hU₀
  have hraster₀ : TilesUniverse (planarRasterTile tile) U₀ := by
    exact (tilesUniverse_vadd_translationSet_iff
      (-base) (planarRasterTile tile) U).mpr hraster
  rw [← hscaled] at hraster₀
  exact ⟨T, family_tilesUniverse_of_planarRasterTile hM tile T hraster₀⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier_planarRaster_eq_iff
statement:
theorem discreteCarrier_planarRaster_eq_iff {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (tile : Fin M → Finset IntegerPlane) (T₀ T₁ : Set IntegerPlane) :
    discreteCarrier (planarRasterTile tile) (markerTranslationSet M T₀) =
        discreteCarrier (planarRasterTile tile) (markerTranslationSet M T₁) ↔
      ∀ i, discreteCarrier (tile i) T₀ = discreteCarrier (tile i) T₁
proof:
:= by
  have decode (A B : Set IntegerPlane)
      (hcarrier : discreteCarrier (planarRasterTile tile) (markerTranslationSet M A) ⊆
        discreteCarrier (planarRasterTile tile) (markerTranslationSet M B)) :
      ∀ i, discreteCarrier (tile i) A ⊆ discreteCarrier (tile i) B := by
    intro i x hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg, t, ht, hxEq⟩ := mem_discreteCarrier_iff.mp hx
    obtain ⟨s, hsi⟩ := markerBlock_nonempty hM i
    let X : IntegerPlane := markerScale M x + s
    have hX₀ : X ∈
        discreteCarrier (planarRasterTile tile) (markerTranslationSet M A) := by
      refine ⟨markerScale M g + s,
        mem_planarRasterTile_iff.mpr ⟨i, g, hg, s, hsi, rfl⟩,
        markerScale M t, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      dsimp only [X]
      rw [hxEq, markerScale_add]
      abel
    obtain ⟨r, hr, u, hu, hXEq⟩ :=
      mem_discreteCarrier_iff.mp (hcarrier hX₀)
    obtain ⟨j, g', hg', s', hs'j, hrEq⟩ :=
      mem_planarRasterTile_iff.mp hr
    obtain ⟨t', ht', ht'Eq⟩ := mem_markerTranslationSet_iff.mp hu
    have hsModified : s ∈ modifiedMarkerSquare M := by
      rw [← markerUnion_eq_modifiedMarkerSquare hM, markerUnion,
        Finset.mem_biUnion]
      exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, hsi⟩
    have hs'Modified : s' ∈ modifiedMarkerSquare M := by
      rw [← markerUnion_eq_modifiedMarkerSquare hM, markerUnion,
        Finset.mem_biUnion]
      exact ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, hs'j⟩
    have hXSubS : X - s ∈ markerLattice M := by
      rw [mem_markerLattice_iff]
      exact ⟨x, by dsimp only [X]; abel⟩
    have hXSubS' : X - s' ∈ markerLattice M := by
      rw [mem_markerLattice_iff]
      refine ⟨g' + t', ?_⟩
      change markerScale M (g' + t') = X - s'
      rw [markerScale_add, ht'Eq]
      calc
        markerScale M g' + u = (markerScale M g' + s') + u - s' := by abel
        _ = r + u - s' := by rw [hrEq]
        _ = X - s' := by rw [← hXEq]
    obtain ⟨chosen, hchosen, hchosenUnique⟩ :=
      existsUnique_tile_representation (modifiedMarkerSquare_tiles_markerLattice M) X
    have hss' : s = s' :=
      (hchosenUnique s ⟨hsModified, hXSubS⟩).trans
        (hchosenUnique s' ⟨hs'Modified, hXSubS'⟩).symm
    have hij : i = j := by
      by_contra hij
      have hnot : s ∉ markerBlock j :=
        Finset.disjoint_left.mp (markerBlock_disjoint hij) hsi
      exact hnot (hss' ▸ hs'j)
    subst j
    have hxEq' : x = g' + t' := by
      apply markerScale_injective M
      calc
        markerScale M x = X - s := by dsimp only [X]; abel
        _ = X - s' := by rw [hss']
        _ = markerScale M (g' + t') := by
          rw [markerScale_add, ht'Eq]
          calc
            X - s' = r + u - s' := by rw [hXEq]
            _ = (markerScale M g' + s') + u - s' := by rw [hrEq]
            _ = markerScale M g' + u := by abel
    exact mem_discreteCarrier_iff.mpr ⟨g', hg', t', ht', hxEq'⟩
  have encode (A B : Set IntegerPlane)
      (hfamily : ∀ i, discreteCarrier (tile i) A ⊆ discreteCarrier (tile i) B) :
      discreteCarrier (planarRasterTile tile) (markerTranslationSet M A) ⊆
        discreteCarrier (planarRasterTile tile) (markerTranslationSet M B) := by
    intro X hX
    obtain ⟨r, hr, u, hu, hXEq⟩ := mem_discreteCarrier_iff.mp hX
    obtain ⟨i, g, hg, s, hsi, hrEq⟩ := mem_planarRasterTile_iff.mp hr
    obtain ⟨t, ht, htEq⟩ := mem_markerTranslationSet_iff.mp hu
    have hgt₀ : g + t ∈ discreteCarrier (tile i) A :=
      ⟨g, hg, t, ht, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨g', hg', t', ht', hgtEq⟩ :=
      mem_discreteCarrier_iff.mp (hfamily i hgt₀)
    refine ⟨markerScale M g' + s,
      mem_planarRasterTile_iff.mpr ⟨i, g', hg', s, hsi, rfl⟩,
      markerScale M t', ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    calc
      X = r + u := hXEq
      _ = (markerScale M g + s) + markerScale M t := by rw [hrEq, htEq]
      _ = markerScale M (g + t) + s := by rw [markerScale_add]; abel
      _ = markerScale M (g' + t') + s := by rw [hgtEq]
      _ = (markerScale M g' + s) + markerScale M t' := by
        rw [markerScale_add]
        abel
  constructor
  · intro hcarrier i
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact decode T₀ T₁ (by rw [hcarrier]) i
    · exact decode T₁ T₀ (by rw [hcarrier]) i
  · intro hfamily
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact encode T₀ T₁ (fun i ↦ by rw [hfamily i])
    · exact encode T₁ T₀ (fun i ↦ by rw [hfamily i])

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_coloredRasterTile_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_coloredRasterTile_iff {M : ℕ}
    {tile : Fin M → Finset IntegerPlane} {p : IntegerPlane × ZMod M} :
    p ∈ coloredRasterTile tile ↔
      ∃ i : Fin M, p.1 ∈ tile i ∧ (i : ZMod M) = p.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [coloredRasterTile, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
    Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, z, hz, hzp⟩
    exact ⟨i, hzp ▸ hz, congrArg Prod.snd hzp⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, hcolor⟩
    exact ⟨i, p.1, hi, Prod.ext rfl hcolor⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_coloredTranslations_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_coloredTranslations_iff {M : ℕ} {T : Set IntegerPlane}
    {p : IntegerPlane × ZMod M} :
    p ∈ coloredTranslations (M := M) T ↔
      ∃ t ∈ T, (t, 0) = p
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.fin_cast_zmod_injective
statement:
theorem fin_cast_zmod_injective {M : ℕ} [NeZero M] :
    Function.Injective (fun i : Fin M ↦ (i : ZMod M))
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  apply Fin.ext
  have hval := congrArg ZMod.val hij
  simpa [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt i.isLt,
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt j.isLt] using hval

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.coloredRasterTile_tilesUniverse_iff
statement:
theorem coloredRasterTile_tilesUniverse_iff {M : ℕ} [NeZero M]
    (tile : Fin M → Finset IntegerPlane) (T : Set IntegerPlane) :
    TilesUniverse (coloredRasterTile tile) (coloredTranslations (M := M) T) ↔
      ∀ i, TilesUniverse (tile i) T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hcolored i
    apply tilesUniverse_of_existsUnique
    intro x
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfunique⟩ :=
      existsUnique_tile_representation hcolored (x, (i : ZMod M))
    obtain ⟨j, hjtile, hjcolor⟩ := mem_coloredRasterTile_iff.mp hf.1
    obtain ⟨t, htT, htEq⟩ := hf.2
    have hsecond : (i : ZMod M) - f.2 = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg Prod.snd htEq.symm
      change (i : ZMod M) - f.2 = 0 at h
      exact h
    have hfcolor : f.2 = (i : ZMod M) := (sub_eq_zero.mp hsecond).symm
    have hji : j = i := fin_cast_zmod_injective (hjcolor.trans hfcolor)
    subst j
    refine ⟨f.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨hjtile, ?_⟩
      have hfirst : x - f.1 = t := by
        have h := congrArg Prod.fst htEq.symm
        change x - f.1 = t at h
        exact h
      rwa [hfirst]
    · intro g hg
      let candidate : IntegerPlane × ZMod M := (g, (i : ZMod M))
      have hcTile : candidate ∈ coloredRasterTile tile := by
        exact mem_coloredRasterTile_iff.mpr ⟨i, hg.1, rfl⟩
      have hcTranslation : (x, (i : ZMod M)) - candidate ∈
          coloredTranslations (M := M) T := by
        refine ⟨x - g, hg.2, ?_⟩
        ext
        · rfl
        · simp [candidate]
      have hcf : candidate = f := hfunique candidate ⟨hcTile, hcTranslation⟩
      exact congrArg Prod.fst hcf
  · intro hfamily
    apply tilesUniverse_of_existsUnique
    rintro ⟨x, c⟩
    let i : Fin M := ⟨c.val, ZMod.val_lt c⟩
    have hic : (i : ZMod M) = c := by
      simpa only [i] using ZMod.natCast_zmod_val c
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzunique⟩ :=
      existsUnique_tile_representation (hfamily i) x
    let f : IntegerPlane × ZMod M := (z, c)
    refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
    · constructor
      · exact mem_coloredRasterTile_iff.mpr ⟨i, hz.1, hic⟩
      · refine ⟨x - z, hz.2, ?_⟩
        ext
        · rfl
        · simp [f]
    · intro g hg
      obtain ⟨j, hgtile, hjcolor⟩ := mem_coloredRasterTile_iff.mp hg.1
      obtain ⟨t, htT, htEq⟩ := hg.2
      have hgcolor : g.2 = c := by
        have : c - g.2 = 0 := by
          have h := congrArg Prod.snd htEq.symm
          change c - g.2 = 0 at h
          exact h
        exact (sub_eq_zero.mp this).symm
      have hji : j = i := by
        apply fin_cast_zmod_injective
        exact hjcolor.trans (hgcolor.trans hic.symm)
      subst j
      have hfirst : x - g.1 = t := by
        have h := congrArg Prod.fst htEq.symm
        change x - g.1 = t at h
        exact h
      have hgz : g.1 = z := by
        apply hzunique g.1
        exact ⟨hgtile, hfirst ▸ htT⟩
      apply Prod.ext
      · exact hgz
      · exact hgcolor

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.relevantSignatureAt_mem
statement:
theorem relevantSignatureAt_mem (K : PolygonalRegion)
    (i : Fin K.relevantSignatureCount) :
    K.relevantSignatureAt i ∈ K.relevantSignatures
proof:
:=
  ((K.relevantSignatures.equivFin).symm i).2

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.exists_relevantSignatureAt_eq
statement:
theorem exists_relevantSignatureAt_eq (K : PolygonalRegion)
    {F : Finset IntegerPlane} (hF : F ∈ K.relevantSignatures) :
    ∃ i, K.relevantSignatureAt i = F
proof:
:= by
  let s : K.relevantSignatures := ⟨F, hF⟩
  refine ⟨K.relevantSignatures.equivFin s, ?_⟩
  change ((K.relevantSignatures.equivFin).symm
    (K.relevantSignatures.equivFin s)).1 = F
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.relevantSignatureCount_pos
statement:
theorem relevantSignatureCount_pos (K : PolygonalRegion) :
    0 < K.relevantSignatureCount
proof:
:= by
  rw [relevantSignatureCount, Finset.card_pos]
  exact K.relevantSignatures_nonempty

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.distinguishedRelevantSignature_nonempty
statement:
theorem distinguishedRelevantSignature_nonempty (K : PolygonalRegion) :
    (K.distinguishedRelevantSignature : Finset IntegerPlane).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec K.exists_nonempty_relevantSignature).2

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.relevantSignatureAt_distinguishedRelevantIndex
statement:
theorem relevantSignatureAt_distinguishedRelevantIndex (K : PolygonalRegion) :
    K.relevantSignatureAt K.distinguishedRelevantIndex =
      K.distinguishedRelevantSignature
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec
    (K.exists_relevantSignatureAt_eq K.distinguishedRelevantSignature.property)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.relevantPlanarSignatureAt_zero_nonempty
statement:
theorem relevantPlanarSignatureAt_zero_nonempty (K : PolygonalRegion) :
    (K.relevantPlanarSignatureAt K.relevantSignatureZero).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [relevantPlanarSignatureAt, relevantPlanarSignaturePermutation]
  simp only [Equiv.swap_apply_left]
  rw [K.relevantSignatureAt_distinguishedRelevantIndex]
  exact K.distinguishedRelevantSignature_nonempty

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.relevantPlanarSignatureAt_tilesUniverse_iff
statement:
theorem relevantPlanarSignatureAt_tilesUniverse_iff
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set IntegerPlane) :
    (∀ i, TilesUniverse (K.relevantPlanarSignatureAt i) T) ↔
      ∀ F ∈ K.relevantSignatures, TilesUniverse F T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h F hF
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := K.exists_relevantSignatureAt_eq hF
    let i := K.relevantPlanarSignaturePermutation.symm j
    have hperm : K.relevantPlanarSignaturePermutation i = j := by
      exact K.relevantPlanarSignaturePermutation.apply_symm_apply j
    rw [← hj, ← hperm]
    exact h i
  · intro h i
    exact h (K.relevantPlanarSignatureAt i)
      (K.relevantSignatureAt_mem (K.relevantPlanarSignaturePermutation i))

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.relevantPlanarSignatureAt_discreteCarrier_eq_iff
statement:
theorem relevantPlanarSignatureAt_discreteCarrier_eq_iff
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T₀ T₁ : Set IntegerPlane) :
    (∀ i, discreteCarrier (K.relevantPlanarSignatureAt i) T₀ =
        discreteCarrier (K.relevantPlanarSignatureAt i) T₁) ↔
      ∀ F ∈ K.relevantSignatures,
        discreteCarrier F T₀ = discreteCarrier F T₁
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h F hF
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := K.exists_relevantSignatureAt_eq hF
    let i := K.relevantPlanarSignaturePermutation.symm j
    have hperm : K.relevantPlanarSignaturePermutation i = j :=
      K.relevantPlanarSignaturePermutation.apply_symm_apply j
    rw [← hj, ← hperm]
    exact h i
  · intro h i
    exact h (K.relevantPlanarSignatureAt i)
      (K.relevantSignatureAt_mem (K.relevantPlanarSignaturePermutation i))

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.relevantSignatureAt_tilesUniverse_iff
statement:
theorem relevantSignatureAt_tilesUniverse_iff
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set IntegerPlane) :
    (∀ i, TilesUniverse (K.relevantSignatureAt i) T) ↔
      ∀ F ∈ K.relevantSignatures, TilesUniverse F T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h F hF
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := K.exists_relevantSignatureAt_eq hF
    rw [← hi]
    exact h i
  · intro h i
    exact h (K.relevantSignatureAt i) (K.relevantSignatureAt_mem i)

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.relevantColoredRasterTile_tilesUniverse_iff
statement:
theorem relevantColoredRasterTile_tilesUniverse_iff
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set IntegerPlane) :
    TilesUniverse K.relevantColoredRasterTile
        (coloredTranslations (M := K.relevantSignatureCount) T) ↔
      ∀ F ∈ K.relevantSignatures, TilesUniverse F T
proof:
:= by
  let _ : NeZero K.relevantSignatureCount :=
    ⟨(K.relevantSignatureCount_pos).ne'⟩
  rw [relevantColoredRasterTile, coloredRasterTile_tilesUniverse_iff]
  exact K.relevantSignatureAt_tilesUniverse_iff T

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.relevantPlanarRasterTile_tilesUniverse_iff
statement:
theorem relevantPlanarRasterTile_tilesUniverse_iff
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set IntegerPlane) :
    TilesUniverse K.relevantPlanarRasterTile
        (markerTranslationSet K.relevantSignatureCount T) ↔
      ∀ F ∈ K.relevantSignatures, TilesUniverse F T
proof:
:= by
  rw [relevantPlanarRasterTile,
    planarRasterTile_tilesUniverse_iff_family K.relevantSignatureCount_pos]
  exact K.relevantPlanarSignatureAt_tilesUniverse_iff T

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.relevantPlanarRasterTile_discreteCarrier_eq_iff
statement:
theorem relevantPlanarRasterTile_discreteCarrier_eq_iff
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T₀ T₁ : Set IntegerPlane) :
    discreteCarrier K.relevantPlanarRasterTile
        (markerTranslationSet K.relevantSignatureCount T₀) =
      discreteCarrier K.relevantPlanarRasterTile
        (markerTranslationSet K.relevantSignatureCount T₁) ↔
      ∀ F ∈ K.relevantSignatures,
        discreteCarrier F T₀ = discreteCarrier F T₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [relevantPlanarRasterTile,
    discreteCarrier_planarRaster_eq_iff K.relevantSignatureCount_pos]
  exact K.relevantPlanarSignatureAt_discreteCarrier_eq_iff T₀ T₁

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.tiles_integerPoint_image_iff_relevantColoredRasterTile
statement:

statement:
theorem tiles_integerPoint_image_iff_relevantPlanarRasterTile

      TilesUniverse K.relevantPlanarRasterTile
        (markerTranslationSet K.relevantSignatureCount T)
proof:

    K.relevantPlanarRasterTile_tilesUniverse_iff]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.integerTranslationCarrier_ae_eq_of_relevantPlanarRasterTile
statement:
theorem integerTranslationCarrier_ae_eq_of_relevantPlanarRasterTile
    (K : PolygonalRegion) {T₀ T₁ : Set IntegerPlane}
    (hcarrier :
      discreteCarrier K.relevantPlanarRasterTile
          (markerTranslationSet K.relevantSignatureCount T₀) =
        discreteCarrier K.relevantPlanarRasterTile
          (markerTranslationSet K.relevantSignatureCount T₁)) :
    K.integerTranslationCarrier T₀ =ᵐ[volume]
      K.integerTranslationCarrier T₁
proof:
:= by
  apply K.integerTranslationCarrier_ae_eq_of_relevantSignatures
  exact (K.relevantPlanarRasterTile_discreteCarrier_eq_iff T₀ T₁).mp hcarrier

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.relevantPlanarRasterTile_carrier_eq_iff
statement:
theorem relevantPlanarRasterTile_carrier_eq_iff
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (T₀ T₁ : Set IntegerPlane) :
    discreteCarrier K.relevantPlanarRasterTile
        (markerTranslationSet K.relevantSignatureCount T₀) =
      discreteCarrier K.relevantPlanarRasterTile
        (markerTranslationSet K.relevantSignatureCount T₁) ↔
      K.integerTranslationCarrier T₀ = K.integerTranslationCarrier T₁
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hraster
    apply K.integerTranslationCarrier_eq_of_ae_eq
    exact K.integerTranslationCarrier_ae_eq_of_relevantPlanarRasterTile hraster
  · intro hcontinuous
    apply (K.relevantPlanarRasterTile_discreteCarrier_eq_iff T₀ T₁).mpr
    intro F hF
    have hmeasure : volume (K.signatureFiber F) ≠ 0 :=
      (K.mem_relevantSignatures_iff.mp hF).2
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := nonempty_of_measure_ne_zero hmeasure
    have husignature : K.signature u = F :=
      (K.mem_signatureFiber_iff.mp hu).2
    rw [← husignature]
    ext q
    rw [← K.mem_integerTranslationCarrier_iff_mem_discreteCarrier_signature
          T₀ (x := u + integerPoint q) (q := q) rfl,
      ← K.mem_integerTranslationCarrier_iff_mem_discreteCarrier_signature
          T₁ (x := u + integerPoint q) (q := q) rfl,
      hcontinuous]

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.scaledCoordinate_cast
statement:
theorem scaledCoordinate_cast {D : ℕ} {q : ℚ} (hdiv : q.den ∣ D) :
    (scaledCoordinate D q : ℝ) = (D : ℝ) * (q : ℝ)
proof:
:= by

  rw [scaledCoordinate, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left k q.den_pos, Rat.cast_def]

  field_simp

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Code.Input.normalizedPoint_toPlane
statement:
theorem normalizedPoint_toPlane {P : Input} {t : QTriangle} (ht : t ∈ P.code.triangleFinset)
    {p : QPoint} (hp : p ∈ t.vertices) :
    (P.normalizedPoint p).toPlane =
      (P.denominator : ℝ) • (p.toPlane - P.anchor.toPlane)
proof:
:= by
  have hpdiv := P.point_den_dvd ht hp
  have hadiv := P.anchor_den_dvd
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp only [ZPoint.toPlane, normalizedPoint, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im, mul_one, Complex.smul_re,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.sub_re, QPoint.toPlane_re, Int.cast_sub]
    rw [scaledCoordinate_cast hpdiv.1, scaledCoordinate_cast hadiv.1]
    ring
  · simp only [ZPoint.toPlane, normalizedPoint, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im,
      Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one, Complex.smul_im,
      Complex.sub_im, QPoint.toPlane_im, Int.cast_sub]
    rw [scaledCoordinate_cast hpdiv.2, scaledCoordinate_cast hadiv.2]
    ring

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Code.Input.normalizedTriangle_carrier
statement:
theorem normalizedTriangle_carrier {P : Input} {t : QTriangle}
    (ht : t ∈ P.code.triangleFinset) :
    (P.denominator : ℝ) • (-P.anchor.toPlane +ᵥ t.carrier) =
      (P.normalizedTriangle t).carrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [QTriangle.carrier, ← convexHull_vadd, ← convexHull_smul]
  apply congrArg (convexHull ℝ)
  ext x
  simp only [mem_smul_set, mem_vadd_set, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
    normalizedTriangle]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨z, (rfl | rfl | rfl), rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    · left
      rw [normalizedPoint_toPlane ht (by simp [QTriangle.vertices])]
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      congr 1
      abel
    · right; left
      rw [normalizedPoint_toPlane ht (by simp [QTriangle.vertices])]
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      congr 1
      abel
    · right; right
      rw [normalizedPoint_toPlane ht (by simp [QTriangle.vertices])]
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      congr 1
      abel
  · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · refine ⟨-P.anchor.toPlane +ᵥ t.a.toPlane, ⟨t.a.toPlane, by simp, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [normalizedPoint_toPlane ht (by simp [QTriangle.vertices])]
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      congr 1
      abel
    · refine ⟨-P.anchor.toPlane +ᵥ t.b.toPlane, ⟨t.b.toPlane, by simp, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [normalizedPoint_toPlane ht (by simp [QTriangle.vertices])]
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      congr 1
      abel
    · refine ⟨-P.anchor.toPlane +ᵥ t.c.toPlane, ⟨t.c.toPlane, by simp, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [normalizedPoint_toPlane ht (by simp [QTriangle.vertices])]
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      congr 1
      abel

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Code.Input.normalizedPoint_isInteger

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Code.Input.vertexSet_subset_encodedVertices
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hxs⟩ := hx P.triangulation
  change s ∈ P.code.triangleFinset.image QTriangle.carrier at hs
  simp only [Finset.mem_image] at hs
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hs
  have hxvertices : x ∈ ({t.a.toPlane, t.b.toPlane, t.c.toPlane} : Set Plane) :=
    extremePoints_convexHull_subset hxs
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hxvertices
  rcases hxvertices with hxa | hxb | hxc
  · exact ⟨t, ht, t.a, by simp [QTriangle.vertices], hxa.symm⟩
  · exact ⟨t, ht, t.b, by simp [QTriangle.vertices], hxb.symm⟩
  · exact ⟨t, ht, t.c, by simp [QTriangle.vertices], hxc.symm⟩

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Code.Input.normalizedSupport_eq_iUnion
statement:
theorem normalizedSupport_eq_iUnion (P : Input) :
    P.rationalPolygonalRegion.normalizedSupport =
      ⋃ t ∈ P.code.triangleFinset, (P.normalizedTriangle t).carrier
proof:
:= by
  change (P.denominator : ℝ) • (-P.anchor.toPlane +ᵥ P.code.support) = _
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hy
    have hy' : P.anchor.toPlane + y ∈ P.code.support := by
      simpa only [vadd_eq_add, neg_neg, add_assoc, neg_add_cancel_left] using hy
    simp only [Code.support, mem_iUnion] at hy'
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hyt⟩ := hy'
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨t, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨ht, ?_⟩⟩
    rw [← P.normalizedTriangle_carrier ht]
    refine ⟨y, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simpa only [vadd_eq_add, neg_neg, add_assoc, neg_add_cancel_left] using hyt
  · simp only [mem_iUnion]
    rintro ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩
    rw [← P.normalizedTriangle_carrier ht] at hxt
    obtain ⟨y, hyt, rfl⟩ := hxt
    refine ⟨y, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hyt ⊢
    simp only [Code.support, mem_iUnion]
    refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
    simpa only [vadd_eq_add, neg_neg, add_assoc, neg_add_cancel_left] using hyt

name: Tiling.RationalPolygonal.Raw.Code.Input.normalizedSupport_eq_normalizedCodeSupport

proof:

  rw [P.normalizedSupport_eq_iUnion]
  ext x
  simp [normalizedCodeSupport, normalizedCode]

name: Tiling.Combinatorics.FiniteSetPartitions.enumerate_mem
statement:

    enumerate parts i ∈ parts
proof:
:=
  (parts.equivFin.symm i).property

name: Tiling.Combinatorics.FiniteSetPartitions.enumerate_injective
statement:

    Function.Injective (enumerate parts)
proof:

  intro i j h
  exact parts.equivFin.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h)

name: Tiling.Combinatorics.FiniteSetPartitions.iUnion_enumerate
statement:
theorem iUnion_enumerate (parts : Finset (Set α)) :
    (⋃ i, enumerate parts i) = ⋃₀ parts
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, hx⟩
    exact Set.mem_sUnion.mpr ⟨enumerate parts i, enumerate_mem parts i, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨S, hS, hx⟩
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨parts.equivFin ⟨S, hS⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa [enumerate] using hx

name: Tiling.Combinatorics.FiniteSetPartitions.mem_nonemptyPieces
statement:
theorem mem_nonemptyPieces {n : ℕ} (part : Fin n → Set α) (S : Set α) :
    S ∈ nonemptyPieces part ↔ (∃ i, part i = S) ∧ S.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [nonemptyPieces]

name: Tiling.Combinatorics.FiniteSetPartitions.sUnion_nonemptyPieces
statement:
theorem sUnion_nonemptyPieces {n : ℕ} (part : Fin n → Set α) :
    ⋃₀ (nonemptyPieces part) = ⋃ i, part i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨S, hS, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨i, rfl⟩, _⟩ := (mem_nonemptyPieces part S).mp hS
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hx⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact Set.mem_sUnion.mpr ⟨part i,
      (mem_nonemptyPieces part (part i)).mpr ⟨⟨i, rfl⟩, ⟨x, hxi⟩⟩, hxi⟩

name: Tiling.Combinatorics.FiniteSetPartitions.pairwiseDisjoint_nonemptyPieces
statement:
theorem pairwiseDisjoint_nonemptyPieces {n : ℕ} (part : Fin n → Set α)
    (hdis : Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ part) :
    (nonemptyPieces part : Set (Set α)).PairwiseDisjoint id
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro S hS U hU hne
  obtain ⟨⟨i, rfl⟩, _⟩ := (mem_nonemptyPieces part S).mp hS
  obtain ⟨⟨j, rfl⟩, _⟩ := (mem_nonemptyPieces part U).mp hU
  exact hdis (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _) (fun hij => hne (congrArg part hij))

name: Tiling.Combinatorics.FiniteSetPartitions.sup_nonemptyPieces
statement:
theorem sup_nonemptyPieces {A : Set α} {n : ℕ} (part : Fin n → Set α)
    (hcover : (⋃ i, part i) = A) :
    (nonemptyPieces part).sup id = A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (nonemptyPieces part).sup id = ⋃₀ (nonemptyPieces part) :=
      Finset.sup_id_set_eq_sUnion _
    _ = ⋃ i, part i := sUnion_nonemptyPieces part
    _ = A := hcover

name: Tiling.Combinatorics.FiniteSetPartitions.finpartitionOfIndexed_parts
statement:
theorem finpartitionOfIndexed_parts {A : Set α} {n : ℕ}
    (part : Fin n → Set α) (hdis : Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ part)
    (hcover : (⋃ i, part i) = A) :
    (finpartitionOfIndexed part hdis hcover).parts = nonemptyPieces part
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [finpartitionOfIndexed, Finpartition.ofPairwiseDisjoint,
    Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem, mem_nonemptyPieces]

name: Tiling.Combinatorics.FiniteSetPartitions.finpartitionParts_nonempty

proof:
:= by
  exact Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (P.ne_bot hS)

name: Tiling.Measure.pi_count

name: Tiling.volume_piFin_int_eq_count

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.finite_label_meets_ball
statement:
private theorem finite_label_meets_ball
    (hpacking : IsPacking A.prototiles A.placements)
    (p : P) (c : Plane) {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hball : Metric.ball c r ⊆ (A.prototiles p).support)
    (hsupport : (A.prototiles p).support ⊆ Metric.closedBall c R)
    (x : Plane) :
    {i : A.placements | i.1.2 = p ∧
      (placedTile A.prototiles i.1 ∩ Metric.ball x 1).Nonempty}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  let H : Set A.placements :=
    {i | i.1.2 = p ∧ (placedTile A.prototiles i.1 ∩ Metric.ball x 1).Nonempty}
  let anchor : A.placements → Plane := fun i ↦ i.1.1 + c
  have ball_subset_placed (i : A.placements) (hi : i ∈ H) :
      Metric.ball (anchor i) r ⊆ placedTile A.prototiles i.1 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [placedTile, mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    apply hi.1.symm ▸ hball
    simpa [anchor, dist_eq_norm_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc]
      using hz
  have placed_subset_closedBall (i : A.placements) (hi : i ∈ H) :
      placedTile A.prototiles i.1 ⊆ Metric.closedBall (anchor i) R := by
    intro z hz
    rw [placedTile, mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hz
    rw [hi.1] at hz
    have hz' := hsupport hz
    simpa [anchor, dist_eq_norm_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc]
      using hz'
  have anchor_dist {i j : A.placements} (hi : i ∈ H) (hj : j ∈ H) (hij : i ≠ j) :
      r + r ≤ dist (anchor i) (anchor j) := by
    apply (disjoint_ball_ball_iff hr hr).mp
    by_contra hdisj
    have hnonempty :
        (Metric.ball (anchor i) r ∩ Metric.ball (anchor j) r).Nonempty :=
      Set.not_disjoint_iff.mp hdisj
    have hne : volume (Metric.ball (anchor i) r ∩ Metric.ball (anchor j) r) ≠ 0 :=
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball).measure_ne_zero volume hnonempty
    exact hne ((hpacking i.2 j.2 (fun h ↦ hij (Subtype.ext h))).mono
      (ball_subset_placed i hi) (ball_subset_placed j hj))
  have hsep : (anchor '' H).Pairwise fun a b ↦ r + r ≤ dist a b := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ _ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ hne
    exact anchor_dist hi hj (fun hij ↦ hne (congrArg anchor hij))
  have hclosed : IsClosed (anchor '' H) :=
    Metric.isClosed_of_pairwise_le_dist (add_pos hr hr) hsep
  have hdiscrete : IsDiscrete (anchor '' H) := by
    rw [isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isOpen]
    intro a ha
    refine ⟨Metric.ball a r, Metric.isOpen_ball, ?_⟩
    ext b
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hba, hb⟩
      by_cases hab : b = a
      · simp [hab]
      · have hd := hsep hb ha hab
        simp only [Metric.mem_ball] at hba
        rw [dist_comm] at hba
        change r + r ≤ dist b a at hd
        rw [dist_comm b a] at hd
        exfalso
        linarith
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hr, ha⟩
  have himage_bounded : Bornology.IsBounded (anchor '' H) := by
    apply (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x := x) (r := R + 1)).subset
    rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hyplaced, hyball⟩ := hi.2
    have hyclosed := placed_subset_closedBall i hi hyplaced
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hyclosed ⊢
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hyball
    calc
      dist (anchor i) x ≤ dist (anchor i) y + dist y x := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ ≤ R + 1 := add_le_add (by simpa [dist_comm] using hyclosed) hyball.le
  have himage_finite : (anchor '' H).Finite :=
    (Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded hclosed himage_bounded).finite hdiscrete
  have hinj : Set.InjOn anchor H := by
    intro i hi j hj hij
    by_contra hne
    have hd := anchor_dist hi hj hne
    rw [hij, dist_self] at hd
    linarith
  exact himage_finite.of_finite_image hinj

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.locallyFinite_placedTile_of_uniform_geometry
statement:
private theorem locallyFinite_placedTile_of_uniform_geometry [Finite P]
    (hpacking : IsPacking A.prototiles A.placements)
    (center : P → Plane) (radius bound : P → ℝ)
    (hradius : ∀ p, 0 < radius p)
    (hball : ∀ p, Metric.ball (center p) (radius p) ⊆ (A.prototiles p).support)
    (hsupport : ∀ p, (A.prototiles p).support ⊆
      Metric.closedBall (center p) (bound p)) :
    LocallyFinite fun i : A.placements ↦ placedTile A.prototiles i.1
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  refine ⟨Metric.ball x 1, Metric.ball_mem_nhds x one_pos, ?_⟩
  let S : P → Set A.placements := fun p ↦
    {i | i.1.2 = p ∧ (placedTile A.prototiles i.1 ∩ Metric.ball x 1).Nonempty}
  have hS (p : P) : (S p).Finite := by
    apply finite_label_meets_ball A hpacking p (center p) (hradius p)
      (hball p) (hsupport p) x
  apply (Set.finite_iUnion hS).subset
  intro i hi
  rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
  exact ⟨i.1.2, rfl, hi⟩

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.locallyFinite_placedTile
statement:
theorem locallyFinite_placedTile [Finite P]
    (hpacking : IsPacking A.prototiles A.placements) :
    LocallyFinite fun i : A.placements ↦ placedTile A.prototiles i.1
proof:
:= by
  have hinterior : ∀ p, (interior (A.prototiles p).support).Nonempty := fun p ↦
    (A.isPolygonal p).interior_nonempty (A.prototiles p).nonempty_support
  choose center hcenter using hinterior
  have hnhds (p : P) : (A.prototiles p).support ∈ 𝓝 (center p) :=
    mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mp (hcenter p)
  choose radius hradius hball using fun p ↦ Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hnhds p)
  choose bound hbound using fun p ↦ (A.isPolygonal p).isBounded.subset_closedBall (center p)
  exact A.locallyFinite_placedTile_of_uniform_geometry hpacking center radius bound
    hradius hball hbound

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.isClosed_placedTile
statement:
theorem isClosed_placedTile (i : Placement Plane P) :
    IsClosed (placedTile A.prototiles i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [placedTile]
  simpa only [Homeomorph.coe_addLeft, ← vadd_eq_add, Set.image_vadd] using
    ((Homeomorph.addLeft i.1).isClosed_image.mpr (A.isPolygonal i.2).isClosed)

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.closure_interior_placedTile
statement:
theorem closure_interior_placedTile (i : Placement Plane P) :
    closure (interior (placedTile A.prototiles i)) = placedTile A.prototiles i
proof:
:= by
  rw [placedTile, interior_vadd, closure_vadd, (A.isPolygonal i.2).closure_interior]

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.interior_placedTile_disjoint
statement:
theorem interior_placedTile_disjoint
    (hpacking : IsPacking A.prototiles A.placements)
    {i j : A.placements} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Disjoint (interior (placedTile A.prototiles i.1))
      (interior (placedTile A.prototiles j.1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxi hxj
  have hne :
      volume (interior (placedTile A.prototiles i.1) ∩
        interior (placedTile A.prototiles j.1)) ≠ 0 :=
    (isOpen_interior.inter isOpen_interior).measure_ne_zero volume ⟨x, hxi, hxj⟩
  exact hne (measure_mono_null
    (Set.inter_subset_inter interior_subset interior_subset)
    (hpacking i.2 j.2 fun h ↦ hij (Subtype.ext h)))

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.placementCarrier_isClosed
statement:
theorem placementCarrier_isClosed [Finite P]
    (hpacking : IsPacking A.prototiles A.placements) (S : Set A.placements) :
    IsClosed (A.placementCarrier S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [placementCarrier]
  exact ((A.locallyFinite_placedTile hpacking).comp_injective
    Subtype.val_injective).isClosed_iUnion fun i ↦ A.isClosed_placedTile i.1.1

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.placementCarrier_closure_interior
statement:
theorem placementCarrier_closure_interior [Finite P]
    (hpacking : IsPacking A.prototiles A.placements) (S : Set A.placements) :
    closure (interior (A.placementCarrier S)) = A.placementCarrier S
proof:
:= by
  rw [placementCarrier]
  exact ((A.locallyFinite_placedTile hpacking).comp_injective
    Subtype.val_injective).closure_interior_iUnion_eq fun i ↦
      A.closure_interior_placedTile i.1.1

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.iUnion_placedTile_eq_univ
statement:
theorem iUnion_placedTile_eq_univ [Finite P]
    (hA : IsTiling A.prototiles A.placements) :
    (⋃ i : A.placements, placedTile A.prototiles i.1) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set Plane := ⋃ i : A.placements, placedTile A.prototiles i.1
  have hclosed : IsClosed U :=
    (A.locallyFinite_placedTile hA.isPacking).isClosed_iUnion fun i ↦
      A.isClosed_placedTile i.1
  have hcover : ∀ᵐ x, x ∈ U := by
    filter_upwards [hA.isCover] with x hx
    exact hx
  apply (hclosed.ae_eq_univ_iff_eq (μ := volume)).mp
  filter_upwards [hcover] with x hx
  change (x ∈ U) = (x ∈ (Set.univ : Set Plane))
  simp [hx]

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.locallyFinite_plateCarrier
statement:
theorem locallyFinite_plateCarrier [Finite P]
    (hpacking : IsPacking A.prototiles A.placements) :
    LocallyFinite fun C : A.Plate ↦ A.plateCarrier C
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨t, htx, ht⟩ := A.locallyFinite_placedTile hpacking x
  refine ⟨t, htx, (ht.image fun i ↦ A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i).subset ?_⟩
  intro C hC
  obtain ⟨y, hyC, hyt⟩ := hC
  obtain ⟨i, hiC, hyi⟩ := A.mem_plateCarrier_iff.mp hyC
  exact ⟨i, ⟨y, hyi, hyt⟩, hiC⟩

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.plateCarrier_isClosed
statement:
theorem plateCarrier_isClosed [Finite P]
    (hpacking : IsPacking A.prototiles A.placements) (C : A.Plate) :
    IsClosed (A.plateCarrier C)
proof:
:=
  A.placementCarrier_isClosed hpacking C

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.plateCarrier_closure_interior
statement:
theorem plateCarrier_closure_interior [Finite P]
    (hpacking : IsPacking A.prototiles A.placements) (C : A.Plate) :
    closure (interior (A.plateCarrier C)) = A.plateCarrier C
proof:
:=
  A.placementCarrier_closure_interior hpacking C

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.iUnion_plateCarrier_eq_univ
statement:
theorem iUnion_plateCarrier_eq_univ [Finite P]
    (hA : IsTiling A.prototiles A.placements) :
    (⋃ C : A.Plate, A.plateCarrier C) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← A.iUnion_placedTile_eq_univ hA]
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro x hx
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hx ⊢
    obtain ⟨C, hxC⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨i, _, hxi⟩ := A.mem_plateCarrier_iff.mp hxC
    exact ⟨i, hxi⟩
  · intro x hx
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hx ⊢
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i,
      A.placedTile_subset_plateCarrier i hxi⟩

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.placementCarrier_aedisjoint
statement:
theorem placementCarrier_aedisjoint (hA : IsTiling A.prototiles A.placements)
    {S R : Set A.placements} (hSR : Disjoint S R) :
    AEDisjoint volume (A.placementCarrier S) (A.placementCarrier R)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Countable A.placements := hA.countable.to_subtype
  rw [placementCarrier, AEDisjoint.iUnion_left_iff]
  intro i
  rw [placementCarrier, AEDisjoint.iUnion_right_iff]
  intro j
  apply hA.isPacking i.1.2 j.1.2
  intro hij
  apply Set.disjoint_left.1 hSR i.2
  have hsub : (i.1 : A.placements) = j.1 := Subtype.ext hij
  simpa only [hsub] using j.2

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.plateCarrier_aedisjoint
statement:
theorem plateCarrier_aedisjoint (hA : IsTiling A.prototiles A.placements)
    {C D : A.Plate} (hCD : C ≠ D) :
    AEDisjoint volume (A.plateCarrier C) (A.plateCarrier D)
proof:
:= by
  apply A.placementCarrier_aedisjoint hA
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro i hiC hiD
  exact hCD (hiC.symm.trans hiD)

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.disjoint_regular_left_interior_of_aedisjoint
statement:
private theorem disjoint_regular_left_interior_of_aedisjoint
    {s t : Set Plane} (hregular : closure (interior s) = s)
    (had : AEDisjoint volume s t) : Disjoint s (interior t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxs hxt
  rw [← hregular] at hxs
  obtain ⟨y, hyt, hys⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hxs (interior t) isOpen_interior hxt
  have hne : volume (interior s ∩ interior t) ≠ 0 :=
    (isOpen_interior.inter isOpen_interior).measure_ne_zero volume ⟨y, hys, hyt⟩
  exact hne (measure_mono_null
    (Set.inter_subset_inter interior_subset interior_subset) had)

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.exists_small_lineMap
statement:
private theorem exists_small_lineMap (x z : Plane) {r q : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      (AffineMap.lineMap x z) δ ∈ Metric.ball x r ∩ Metric.ball x q ∧
      (AffineMap.lineMap x z) (-δ) ∈ Metric.ball x r ∩ Metric.ball x q
proof:
:= by
  let ρ := min r q
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := lt_min hr hq
  let n := ‖z - x‖
  have hn : 0 ≤ n := norm_nonneg _
  let δ := ρ / (2 * (n + 1))
  have hden : 0 < 2 * (n + 1) := by positivity
  have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos hρ hden
  have hδn : δ * n < ρ := by
    change (ρ / (2 * (n + 1))) * n < ρ
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ hden]
    nlinarith
  have hdist_pos : dist ((AffineMap.lineMap x z) δ) x = δ * n := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module']
    simp [dist_eq_norm, n, abs_of_pos hδ]
  have hdist_neg : dist ((AffineMap.lineMap x z) (-δ)) x = δ * n := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module']
    simp [dist_eq_norm, n, abs_of_pos hδ]
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [Metric.mem_ball, hdist_pos]
    exact hδn.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  · rw [Metric.mem_ball, hdist_pos]
    exact hδn.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  · rw [Metric.mem_ball, hdist_neg]
    exact hδn.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  · rw [Metric.mem_ball, hdist_neg]
    exact hδn.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.locallyStraight_lines_eq_of_aedisjoint
statement:
private theorem locallyStraight_lines_eq_of_aedisjoint
    {s t : Set Plane} {x : Plane}
    (hsregular : closure (interior s) = s)
    (htregular : closure (interior t) = t)
    (had : AEDisjoint volume s t)
    (hxt : x ∈ frontier t)
    {Ls Lt : AffineSubspace ℝ Plane}
    (hxLs : x ∈ Ls) (hLsdim : Module.finrank ℝ Ls.direction = 1)
    (hsline : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (y ∈ frontier s ↔ y ∈ (Ls : Set Plane)))
    (hxLt : x ∈ Lt) (hLtdim : Module.finrank ℝ Lt.direction = 1)
    (htline : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (y ∈ frontier t ↔ y ∈ (Lt : Set Plane))) :
    Ls = Lt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rs, hrs, hsball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hsline
  obtain ⟨rt, hrt, htball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp htline
  obtain ⟨ψt, hψt⟩ :=
    Tiling.AffineSubspace.exists_levelSet_coordinate Lt x hxLt hLtdim
  have htboundary (y : Plane) (hy : y ∈ Metric.ball x rt) :
      y ∈ frontier t ↔ ψt y = ψt x :=
    (htball hy).trans (hψt y)
  have htclass := Tiling.local_levelSet_dichotomy ψt hrt htregular hxt htboundary
  dsimp only at htclass
  by_contra hne
  have hz : ∃ z, z ∈ Ls ∧ z ∉ Lt := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have hle : Ls ≤ Lt := fun z hz ↦ h z hz
    have hdir : Ls.direction = Lt.direction :=
      Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq (AffineSubspace.direction_le hle)
        (hLsdim.trans hLtdim.symm)
    exact hne
      (AffineSubspace.eq_of_direction_eq_of_nonempty_of_le hdir ⟨x, hxLs⟩ hle)
  obtain ⟨z, hzLs, hzLt⟩ := hz
  have hzψ : ψt z ≠ ψt x := fun h ↦ hzLt ((hψt z).2 h)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hyposBalls, hynegBalls⟩ := exists_small_lineMap x z hrs hrt
  let ypos := (AffineMap.lineMap x z) δ
  let yneg := (AffineMap.lineMap x z) (-δ)
  have hyposLs : ypos ∈ Ls := AffineMap.lineMap_mem δ hxLs hzLs
  have hynegLs : yneg ∈ Ls := AffineMap.lineMap_mem (-δ) hxLs hzLs
  have hψline (r : ℝ) :
      ψt ((AffineMap.lineMap x z) r) = ψt x + r * (ψt z - ψt x) := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module']
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, map_sub]
    ring
  have hsclosed : IsClosed s := by rw [← hsregular]; exact isClosed_closure
  have hdisj : Disjoint s (interior t) :=
    disjoint_regular_left_interior_of_aedisjoint hsregular had
  have contradict (y : Plane) (hyball : y ∈ Metric.ball x rs)
      (hyLs : y ∈ Ls) (hyt : y ∈ interior t) : False := by
    apply Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (hsclosed.frontier_subset ((hsball hyball).2 hyLs)) hyt
  rcases htclass with htpos | htneg
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hzψ with hzneg | hzpos
    · have hynegPos : ψt x < ψt yneg := by
        dsimp only [yneg]
        rw [hψline]
        nlinarith
      exact contradict yneg hynegBalls.1 hynegLs
        (htpos.1 ⟨hynegBalls.2, hynegPos⟩)
    · have hyposPos : ψt x < ψt ypos := by
        dsimp only [ypos]
        rw [hψline]
        nlinarith
      exact contradict ypos hyposBalls.1 hyposLs
        (htpos.1 ⟨hyposBalls.2, hyposPos⟩)
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hzψ with hzneg | hzpos
    · have hyposNeg : ψt ypos < ψt x := by
        dsimp only [ypos]
        rw [hψline]
        nlinarith
      exact contradict ypos hyposBalls.1 hyposLs
        (htneg.2 ⟨hyposBalls.2, hyposNeg⟩)
    · have hynegNeg : ψt yneg < ψt x := by
        dsimp only [yneg]
        rw [hψline]
        nlinarith
      exact contradict yneg hynegBalls.1 hynegLs
        (htneg.2 ⟨hynegBalls.2, hynegNeg⟩)

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.union_mem_nhds_of_regular_of_aedisjoint_of_locallyStraight
statement:
private theorem union_mem_nhds_of_regular_of_aedisjoint_of_locallyStraight
    {s t : Set Plane} {x : Plane}
    (hsregular : closure (interior s) = s)
    (htregular : closure (interior t) = t)
    (had : AEDisjoint volume s t)
    (hxs : x ∈ frontier s) (hxt : x ∈ frontier t)
    (hsstraight : BoundaryLocallyStraightAt s x)
    (htstraight : BoundaryLocallyStraightAt t x) :
    s ∪ t ∈ 𝓝 x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Ls, hxLs, hLsdim, hsline⟩ := hsstraight
  obtain ⟨Lt, hxLt, hLtdim, htline⟩ := htstraight
  have hlines : Ls = Lt :=
    locallyStraight_lines_eq_of_aedisjoint hsregular htregular had hxt
      hxLs hLsdim hsline hxLt hLtdim htline
  subst Lt
  obtain ⟨rs, hrs, hsball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hsline
  obtain ⟨rt, hrt, htball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp htline
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ :=
    Tiling.AffineSubspace.exists_levelSet_coordinate Ls x hxLs hLsdim
  have hsboundary (y : Plane) (hy : y ∈ Metric.ball x rs) :
      y ∈ frontier s ↔ ψ y = ψ x :=
    (hsball hy).trans (hψ y)
  have htboundary (y : Plane) (hy : y ∈ Metric.ball x rt) :
      y ∈ frontier t ↔ ψ y = ψ x :=
    (htball hy).trans (hψ y)
  have hsclass := Tiling.local_levelSet_dichotomy ψ hrs hsregular hxs hsboundary
  have htclass := Tiling.local_levelSet_dichotomy ψ hrt htregular hxt htboundary
  dsimp only at hsclass htclass
  let ρ := min rs rt
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := lt_min hrs hrt
  have hρs : ρ ≤ rs := min_le_left _ _
  have hρt : ρ ≤ rt := min_le_right _ _
  have hsclosed : IsClosed s := by rw [← hsregular]; exact isClosed_closure
  have hxsin : x ∈ closure (interior s) := by
    rw [hsregular]
    exact hsclosed.frontier_subset hxs
  obtain ⟨u, huball, huin⟩ :=
    mem_closure_iff.mp hxsin (Metric.ball x ρ) Metric.isOpen_ball
      (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ)
  have huballs : u ∈ Metric.ball x rs :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball hρs huball
  have huballt : u ∈ Metric.ball x rt :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball hρt huball
  have huψ : ψ u ≠ ψ x := by
    intro heq
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 disjoint_interior_frontier huin
      ((hsboundary u huballs).2 heq)
  have hdisj : Disjoint s (interior t) :=
    disjoint_regular_left_interior_of_aedisjoint hsregular had
  have orientations :
      ((Metric.ball x rs ∩ {y | ψ x < ψ y} ⊆ interior s ∧
          Metric.ball x rs ∩ {y | ψ y < ψ x} ⊆ interior sᶜ) ∧
        (Metric.ball x rt ∩ {y | ψ x < ψ y} ⊆ interior tᶜ ∧
          Metric.ball x rt ∩ {y | ψ y < ψ x} ⊆ interior t)) ∨
      ((Metric.ball x rs ∩ {y | ψ x < ψ y} ⊆ interior sᶜ ∧
          Metric.ball x rs ∩ {y | ψ y < ψ x} ⊆ interior s) ∧
        (Metric.ball x rt ∩ {y | ψ x < ψ y} ⊆ interior t ∧
          Metric.ball x rt ∩ {y | ψ y < ψ x} ⊆ interior tᶜ)) := by
    rcases hsclass with hspos | hsneg <;> rcases htclass with htpos | htneg
    · exfalso
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne huψ with huneg | hupos
      · exact (interior_subset (hspos.2 ⟨huballs, huneg⟩))
          (interior_subset huin)
      · exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (interior_subset huin)
          (htpos.1 ⟨huballt, hupos⟩)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hspos, htneg⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hsneg, htpos⟩
    · exfalso
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne huψ with huneg | hupos
      · exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (interior_subset huin)
          (htneg.2 ⟨huballt, huneg⟩)
      · exact (interior_subset (hsneg.1 ⟨huballs, hupos⟩))
          (interior_subset huin)
  apply mem_of_superset (Metric.ball_mem_nhds x hρ)
  intro y hyball
  have hyballs : y ∈ Metric.ball x rs := Metric.ball_subset_ball hρs hyball
  have hyballt : y ∈ Metric.ball x rt := Metric.ball_subset_ball hρt hyball
  rcases lt_trichotomy (ψ y) (ψ x) with hyneg | hyeq | hypos
  · rcases orientations with h | h
    · exact Or.inr (interior_subset (h.2.2 ⟨hyballt, hyneg⟩))
    · exact Or.inl (interior_subset (h.1.2 ⟨hyballs, hyneg⟩))
  · exact Or.inl (hsclosed.frontier_subset ((hsboundary y hyballs).2 hyeq))
  · rcases orientations with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (interior_subset (h.1.1 ⟨hyballs, hypos⟩))
    · exact Or.inr (interior_subset (h.2.1 ⟨hyballt, hypos⟩))

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.frontier_eventuallyEq_of_eventuallyEq_of_isClosed
statement:
private theorem frontier_eventuallyEq_of_eventuallyEq_of_isClosed
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {s t : Set X} {x : X}
    (hs : IsClosed s) (ht : IsClosed t) (hst : s =ᶠ[𝓝 x] t) :
    frontier s =ᶠ[𝓝 x] frontier t
proof:
:= by
  have hst_nhds : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, s =ᶠ[𝓝 y] t := hst.eventually_nhds
  filter_upwards [hst, hst_nhds] with y hy hynhds
  rw [hs.frontier_eq, ht.frontier_eq]
  ext
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hys, hyint⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change s y at hys
      change t y
      exact Eq.mp hy hys
    · exact fun hytint ↦ hyint ((hynhds.mem_interior_iff).2 hytint)
  · rintro ⟨hyt, hyint⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change t y at hyt
      change s y
      exact Eq.mpr hy hyt
    · exact fun hysint ↦ hyint ((hynhds.mem_interior_iff).1 hysint)

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.frontier_placementCarrier_compl
statement:
theorem frontier_placementCarrier_compl [Finite P]
    (hA : IsTiling A.prototiles A.placements) (S : Set A.placements) :
    frontier (A.placementCarrier S) = frontier (A.placementCarrier Sᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  let C := A.placementCarrier S
  let D := A.placementCarrier Sᶜ
  have hCregular : closure (interior C) = C :=
    A.placementCarrier_closure_interior hA.isPacking S
  have hDregular : closure (interior D) = D :=
    A.placementCarrier_closure_interior hA.isPacking Sᶜ
  have hAD : AEDisjoint volume C D :=
    A.placementCarrier_aedisjoint hA disjoint_compl_right
  have hcover : C ∪ D = Set.univ := by
    rw [← A.iUnion_placedTile_eq_univ hA]
    ext x
    simp only [C, D, A.mem_placementCarrier_iff, mem_union, mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨i, _, hxi⟩ | ⟨i, _, hxi⟩)
      · exact ⟨i, hxi⟩
      · exact ⟨i, hxi⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hxi⟩
      by_cases hi : i ∈ S
      · exact Or.inl ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩
  have hCcompl : Cᶜ = interior D := by
    apply subset_antisymm
    · apply interior_maximal
      · intro x hx
        have hx' : x ∈ C ∪ D := by rw [hcover]; exact mem_univ x
        exact hx'.resolve_left hx
      · exact (A.placementCarrier_isClosed hA.isPacking S).isOpen_compl
    · exact (disjoint_regular_left_interior_of_aedisjoint hCregular hAD).subset_compl_left
  have hDcompl : Dᶜ = interior C := by
    apply subset_antisymm
    · apply interior_maximal
      · intro x hx
        have hx' : x ∈ C ∪ D := by rw [hcover]; exact mem_univ x
        exact hx'.resolve_right hx
      · exact (A.placementCarrier_isClosed hA.isPacking Sᶜ).isOpen_compl
    · exact Disjoint.subset_compl_left
        (disjoint_regular_left_interior_of_aedisjoint hDregular hAD.symm)
  rw [frontier_eq_closure_inter_closure, frontier_eq_closure_inter_closure,
    (A.placementCarrier_isClosed hA.isPacking S).closure_eq,
    (A.placementCarrier_isClosed hA.isPacking Sᶜ).closure_eq,
    hCcompl, hDcompl, hCregular, hDregular, inter_comm]

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.isPolygonal_placedTile

      i.1 +ᵥ vertexSet (A.prototiles i.2).support

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.vertexSet_placedTile'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vertexSet_placedTile' (i : A.placements) :
    vertexSet (placedTile A.prototiles i.1) = A.placedVertexSet i

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.placedTile_boundaryLocallyStraightAt_of_not_mem_placedVertexSet
statement:
theorem placedTile_boundaryLocallyStraightAt_of_not_mem_placedVertexSet
    (i : A.placements) {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ frontier (placedTile A.prototiles i.1))
    (hxv : x ∉ A.placedVertexSet i) :
    BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (placedTile A.prototiles i.1) x
proof:
:= by
