  simpa only [A.vertexSet_placedTile'] using hxv

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.exists_vertex_of_local_tile_geometry
statement:
theorem exists_vertex_of_local_tile_geometry [Finite P]
    (hlocal : ∀ (i : A.placements) {y : Plane},
      y ∈ frontier (placedTile A.prototiles i.1) →
      y ∉ A.placedVertexSet i →
      BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (placedTile A.prototiles i.1) y)
    (hpacking : IsPacking A.prototiles A.placements) (S : Set A.placements) {x : Plane}
    (hx : x ∈ frontier (A.placementCarrier S))
    (hproper : ¬BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (A.placementCarrier S) x) :
    ∃ i : A.placements, i ∈ S ∧ x ∈ A.placedVertexSet i
proof:
:= by
  have find_vertex (R : Set A.placements)
      (hxR : x ∈ frontier (A.placementCarrier R))
      (hproperR : ¬BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (A.placementCarrier R) x) :
      ∃ i : A.placements, i ∈ R ∧ x ∈ A.placedVertexSet i := by
    by_contra hnone
    push Not at hnone
    have hRclosed : IsClosed (A.placementCarrier R) :=
      A.placementCarrier_isClosed hpacking R
    have hxRmem : x ∈ A.placementCarrier R := hRclosed.frontier_subset hxR
    obtain ⟨i, hiR, hxi⟩ := A.mem_placementCarrier_iff.mp hxRmem
    have tile_subset_carrier {k : A.placements} (hkR : k ∈ R) :
        placedTile A.prototiles k.1 ⊆ A.placementCarrier R := by
      intro y hy
      exact A.mem_placementCarrier_iff.mpr ⟨k, hkR, hy⟩
    have tile_frontier {k : A.placements} (hkR : k ∈ R)
        (hxk : x ∈ placedTile A.prototiles k.1) :
        x ∈ frontier (placedTile A.prototiles k.1) := by
      rw [(A.isClosed_placedTile k.1).frontier_eq]
      refine ⟨hxk, ?_⟩
      intro hxint
      exact Set.disjoint_left.1 disjoint_interior_frontier
        (interior_mono (tile_subset_carrier hkR) hxint) hxR
    have hxiFrontier : x ∈ frontier (placedTile A.prototiles i.1) :=
      tile_frontier hiR hxi
    have hiStraight := hlocal i hxiFrontier (hnone i hiR)
    have unique_incident (k : A.placements) (hkR : k ∈ R)
        (hxk : x ∈ placedTile A.prototiles k.1) : k = i := by
      by_contra hki
      have hxkFrontier : x ∈ frontier (placedTile A.prototiles k.1) :=
        tile_frontier hkR hxk
      have hkStraight := hlocal k hxkFrontier (hnone k hkR)
      have hik : i ≠ k := Ne.symm hki
      have haed : AEDisjoint volume (placedTile A.prototiles i.1)
          (placedTile A.prototiles k.1) :=
        hpacking i.2 k.2 (fun h ↦ hik (Subtype.ext h))
      have hunion :
          placedTile A.prototiles i.1 ∪ placedTile A.prototiles k.1 ∈ 𝓝 x :=
        union_mem_nhds_of_regular_of_aedisjoint_of_locallyStraight
          (A.closure_interior_placedTile i.1)
          (A.closure_interior_placedTile k.1) haed hxiFrontier hxkFrontier
          hiStraight hkStraight
      have hcarrier : A.placementCarrier R ∈ 𝓝 x :=
        mem_of_superset hunion (union_subset
          (tile_subset_carrier hiR) (tile_subset_carrier hkR))
      have hxint : x ∈ interior (A.placementCarrier R) :=
        mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr hcarrier
      exact Set.disjoint_left.1 disjoint_interior_frontier hxint hxR
    have hfinite : LocallyFinite fun k : R ↦ placedTile A.prototiles k.1.1 :=
      (A.locallyFinite_placedTile hpacking).comp_injective Subtype.val_injective
    have hevent := hfinite.eventually_subset
      (fun k : R ↦ A.isClosed_placedTile k.1.1) x
    have hcarrier_tile :
        A.placementCarrier R =ᶠ[𝓝 x] placedTile A.prototiles i.1 := by
      filter_upwards [hevent] with y hy
      apply propext
      constructor
      · intro hycarrier
        obtain ⟨k, hkR, hyk⟩ := A.mem_placementCarrier_iff.mp hycarrier
        have hxk : x ∈ placedTile A.prototiles k.1 :=
          hy (a := ⟨k, hkR⟩)
            (show y ∈ placedTile A.prototiles (⟨k, hkR⟩ : R).1.1 from hyk)
        have hki : k = i := unique_incident k hkR hxk
        change placedTile A.prototiles k.1 y at hyk
        change placedTile A.prototiles i.1 y
        simpa only [hki] using hyk
      · intro hyi
        exact A.mem_placementCarrier_iff.mpr ⟨i, hiR, hyi⟩
    have hfrontier := frontier_eventuallyEq_of_eventuallyEq_of_isClosed
      hRclosed (A.isClosed_placedTile i.1) hcarrier_tile
    obtain ⟨L, hxL, hLdim, htileLine⟩ := hiStraight
    apply hproperR
    refine ⟨L, hxL, hLdim, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hfrontier, htileLine] with y hyfront hyline
    constructor
    · intro hy
      exact hyline.1 (Eq.mp hyfront hy)
    · intro hy
      exact Eq.mpr hyfront (hyline.2 hy)
  exact find_vertex S hx hproper

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.exists_vertex_of_not_boundaryLocallyStraightAt
statement:
theorem exists_vertex_of_not_boundaryLocallyStraightAt [Finite P]
    (hpacking : IsPacking A.prototiles A.placements) (S : Set A.placements) {x : Plane}
    (hx : x ∈ frontier (A.placementCarrier S))
    (hproper : ¬BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (A.placementCarrier S) x) :
    ∃ i : A.placements, i ∈ S ∧ x ∈ A.placedVertexSet i
proof:
:= by
  exact A.exists_vertex_of_local_tile_geometry
    (fun i _ hxfrontier hxvertex ↦
      A.placedTile_boundaryLocallyStraightAt_of_not_mem_placedVertexSet
        i hxfrontier hxvertex)
    hpacking S hx hproper

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.exists_vertices_across_of_local_tile_geometry
statement:
theorem exists_vertices_across_of_local_tile_geometry [Finite P]
    (hlocal : ∀ (i : A.placements) {y : Plane},
      y ∈ frontier (placedTile A.prototiles i.1) →
      y ∉ A.placedVertexSet i →
      BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (placedTile A.prototiles i.1) y)
    (hA : IsTiling A.prototiles A.placements) (S : Set A.placements) {x : Plane}
    (hx : x ∈ frontier (A.placementCarrier S))
    (hproper : ¬BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (A.placementCarrier S) x) :
    ∃ i j : A.placements,
      i ∈ S ∧ j ∉ S ∧ x ∈ A.placedVertexSet i ∧ x ∈ A.placedVertexSet j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hiS, hxi⟩ :=
    A.exists_vertex_of_local_tile_geometry hlocal hA.isPacking S hx hproper
  have hxcompl : x ∈ frontier (A.placementCarrier Sᶜ) := by
    rw [← A.frontier_placementCarrier_compl hA S]
    exact hx
  have hproperCompl : ¬BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (A.placementCarrier Sᶜ) x := by
    rintro ⟨L, hxL, hLdim, hline⟩
    apply hproper
    refine ⟨L, hxL, hLdim, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hline] with y hy
    rw [A.frontier_placementCarrier_compl hA S]
    exact hy
  obtain ⟨j, hjS, hxj⟩ :=
    A.exists_vertex_of_local_tile_geometry hlocal hA.isPacking Sᶜ hxcompl hproperCompl
  exact ⟨i, j, hiS, hjS, hxi, hxj⟩

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.exists_vertices_across_of_not_boundaryLocallyStraightAt
statement:
theorem exists_vertices_across_of_not_boundaryLocallyStraightAt [Finite P]
    (hA : IsTiling A.prototiles A.placements) (S : Set A.placements) {x : Plane}
    (hx : x ∈ frontier (A.placementCarrier S))
    (hproper : ¬BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (A.placementCarrier S) x) :
    ∃ i j : A.placements,
      i ∈ S ∧ j ∉ S ∧ x ∈ A.placedVertexSet i ∧ x ∈ A.placedVertexSet j
proof:
:= by
  exact A.exists_vertices_across_of_local_tile_geometry
    (fun i _ hxfrontier hxvertex ↦
      A.placedTile_boundaryLocallyStraightAt_of_not_mem_placedVertexSet
        i hxfrontier hxvertex)
    hA S hx hproper

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.plateCarrier_boundaryLocallyStraightAt
statement:
theorem plateCarrier_boundaryLocallyStraightAt [Finite P]
    (hA : IsTiling A.prototiles A.placements) (C : A.Plate) {x : Plane}
    (hx : x ∈ frontier (A.plateCarrier C)) :
    BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (A.plateCarrier C) x
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hproper
  obtain ⟨i, j, hiC, hjC, hxi, hxj⟩ :=
    A.exists_vertices_across_of_not_boundaryLocallyStraightAt hA C hx hproper
  have hij : i ≠ j := fun h ↦ hjC (h ▸ hiC)
  have hadj : A.vertexGraph.Adj i j := by
    rw [A.vertexGraph_adj]
    exact ⟨hij, ⟨x, hxi, hxj⟩⟩
  apply hjC
  calc
    A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk j = A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i :=
      (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj hadj).symm
    _ = C := hiC

name: Tiling.affine_line_subset_frontier_of_locally_straight
statement:
private theorem affine_line_subset_frontier_of_locally_straight
    {t : Set Plane} {x : Plane} {L : AffineSubspace ℝ Plane}
    (hxL : x ∈ L) (hLdim : Module.finrank ℝ L.direction = 1)
    (hxlocal : ∀ᶠ y in nhds x, (y ∈ frontier t ↔ y ∈ (L : Set Plane)))
    (hstraight : ∀ y, y ∈ frontier t → BoundaryLocallyStraightAt t y) :
    (L : Set Plane) ⊆ frontier t
proof:
:= by
  have hdirection : L.direction ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hbot
    have : Module.finrank ℝ L.direction = 0 := by rw [hbot]; simp
    omega
  obtain ⟨v, hvL, hv⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff L.direction).mp hdirection
  let f : ℝ → Plane := fun r ↦ r • v +ᵥ x
  have hf_continuous : Continuous f := by fun_prop
  have hfL : ∀ r, f r ∈ L := by
    intro r
    exact L.vadd_mem_of_mem_direction (L.direction.smul_mem r hvL) hxL
  let a : Set ℝ := f ⁻¹' frontier t
  have ha_closed : IsClosed a :=
    (isClosed_frontier : IsClosed (frontier t)).preimage hf_continuous
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ interior a := by
    rw [mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds]
    have htendsto : Filter.Tendsto f (nhds (0 : ℝ)) (nhds x) := by
      have htendsto' : Filter.Tendsto f (nhds (0 : ℝ)) (nhds (f 0)) :=
        hf_continuous.continuousAt
      simpa only [f, zero_smul, zero_vadd] using htendsto'
    have hpull : ∀ᶠ r in nhds (0 : ℝ), f r ∈ frontier t ↔ f r ∈ (L : Set Plane) :=
      htendsto.eventually hxlocal
    filter_upwards [hpull] with r hr
    exact hr.mpr (hfL r)
  have hinterior_closed : IsClosed (interior a) := by
    rw [← closure_subset_iff_isClosed]
    intro r hr
    have hra : r ∈ a := ha_closed.closure_subset (closure_mono interior_subset hr)
    obtain ⟨L', hfrL', hL'dim, hlocal⟩ := hstraight (f r) hra
    by_cases hrint : r ∈ interior a
    · exact hrint
    have hpull : ∀ᶠ q in nhds r, (f q ∈ frontier t ↔ f q ∈ (L' : Set Plane)) :=
      hf_continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.eventually hlocal
    obtain ⟨U, hUsub, hUopen, hrU⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hpull
    obtain ⟨q, hqU, hqint⟩ := (mem_closure_iff.mp hr U hUopen hrU)
    have hqr : q ≠ r := fun h ↦ hrint (h ▸ hqint)
    have hqa : q ∈ a := interior_subset hqint
    have hfqfrontier : f q ∈ frontier t := hqa
    have hfqL' : f q ∈ L' := (hUsub hqU).mp hfqfrontier
    have hscaled : (q - r) • v ∈ L'.direction := by
      have := L'.vsub_mem_direction hfqL' hfrL'
      simpa only [f, vadd_eq_add, vsub_eq_sub, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, sub_smul] using this
    have hvL' : v ∈ L'.direction := by
      have := L'.direction.smul_mem (q - r)⁻¹ hscaled
      simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hqr), one_smul] using this
    rw [mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds]
    refine Filter.mem_of_superset hpull ?_
    intro q hq
    apply hq.mpr
    have hdelta : (q - r) • v ∈ L'.direction := L'.direction.smul_mem _ hvL'
    have := L'.vadd_mem_of_mem_direction hdelta hfrL'
    have heq : (q - r) • v +ᵥ f r = f q := by
      simp only [f, vadd_eq_add, sub_smul]
      abel
    rw [heq] at this
    exact this
  have hinterior_univ : interior a = univ :=
    IsClopen.eq_univ ⟨hinterior_closed, isOpen_interior⟩ ⟨0, hzero⟩
  intro y hyL
  have hvsub : y -ᵥ x ∈ L.direction := L.vsub_mem_direction hyL hxL
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_smul_eq_of_finrank_eq_one hLdim
    (show (⟨v, hvL⟩ : L.direction) ≠ 0 by exact Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mp hv)
    (⟨y -ᵥ x, hvsub⟩ : L.direction)
  have hr' : r • v = y -ᵥ x := congrArg Subtype.val hr
  have hyf : f r = y := by
    simp only [f, hr', vsub_vadd]
  have : r ∈ a := interior_subset (hinterior_univ.symm ▸ mem_univ r)
  simpa only [a, mem_preimage, hyf] using this

name: Tiling.affine_line_direction_le_local_direction
statement:
private theorem affine_line_direction_le_local_direction
    {t : Set Plane} {p : Plane} {L N : AffineSubspace ℝ Plane}
    (hpL : p ∈ L) (hpN : p ∈ N) (hLfrontier : (L : Set Plane) ⊆ frontier t)
    (hlocal : ∀ᶠ y in nhds p, (y ∈ frontier t ↔ y ∈ (N : Set Plane))) :
    L.direction ≤ N.direction
proof:
:= by
  intro v hvL
  by_cases hv : v = 0
  · simpa only [hv] using N.direction.zero_mem
  let f : ℝ → Plane := fun r ↦ r • v +ᵥ p
  have hf_continuous : Continuous f := by fun_prop
  have htendsto : Filter.Tendsto f (nhds (0 : ℝ)) (nhds p) := by
    have htendsto' : Filter.Tendsto f (nhds (0 : ℝ)) (nhds (f 0)) :=
      hf_continuous.continuousAt
    simpa only [f, zero_smul, zero_vadd] using htendsto'
  have hpull : ∀ᶠ r in nhds (0 : ℝ), f r ∈ frontier t ↔ f r ∈ (N : Set Plane) :=
    htendsto.eventually hlocal
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hIoo⟩ := mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset.mp hpull
  let r : ℝ := b / 2
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by dsimp only [r]; linarith [hab.2]
  have hrIoo : r ∈ Ioo a b := by
    constructor
    · exact lt_trans hab.1 hrpos
    · dsimp only [r]
      linarith [hab.2]
  have hfrL : f r ∈ L := L.vadd_mem_of_mem_direction (L.direction.smul_mem r hvL) hpL
  have hfrN : f r ∈ N := (hIoo hrIoo).mp (hLfrontier hfrL)
  have hscaled : r • v ∈ N.direction := by
    have := N.vsub_mem_direction hfrN hpN
    simpa only [f, vadd_vsub] using this
  have := N.direction.smul_mem r⁻¹ hscaled
  simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hrpos.ne', one_smul] using this

name: Tiling.affine_lines_in_locally_straight_frontier_parallel
statement:
private theorem affine_lines_in_locally_straight_frontier_parallel
    {t : Set Plane} {L M : AffineSubspace ℝ Plane}
    (hLne : (L : Set Plane).Nonempty) (hMne : (M : Set Plane).Nonempty)
    (hLdim : Module.finrank ℝ L.direction = 1)
    (hMdim : Module.finrank ℝ M.direction = 1)
    (hLfrontier : (L : Set Plane) ⊆ frontier t)
    (hMfrontier : (M : Set Plane) ⊆ frontier t)
    (hstraight : ∀ y, y ∈ frontier t → BoundaryLocallyStraightAt t y) :
    L.direction = M.direction
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hdirections
  have hinf : L.direction ⊓ M.direction = ⊥ := by
    apply (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mpr
    intro z hz
    by_contra hz0
    have hspanL := eq_span_singleton_of_mem_of_finrank_eq_one hLdim hz.1 hz0
    have hspanM := eq_span_singleton_of_mem_of_finrank_eq_one hMdim hz.2 hz0
    exact hdirections (hspanL.trans hspanM.symm)
  have hsupdim : Module.finrank ℝ ↑(L.direction ⊔ M.direction) = 2 := by
    have hdim := Submodule.finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq L.direction M.direction
    rw [hinf] at hdim
    rw [finrank_bot] at hdim
    simp only [hLdim, hMdim] at hdim
    omega
  have hsup : L.direction ⊔ M.direction = ⊤ := by
    apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
    simpa only [Complex.finrank_real_complex] using hsupdim
  obtain ⟨p, hpL, hpM⟩ :=
    AffineSubspace.inter_nonempty_of_nonempty_of_sup_direction_eq_top hLne hMne hsup
  obtain ⟨N, hpN, hNdim, hlocal⟩ := hstraight p (hLfrontier hpL)
  have hLN : L.direction ≤ N.direction :=
    affine_line_direction_le_local_direction hpL hpN hLfrontier hlocal
  have hMN : M.direction ≤ N.direction :=
    affine_line_direction_le_local_direction hpM hpN hMfrontier hlocal
  have hsupN : L.direction ⊔ M.direction ≤ N.direction := sup_le hLN hMN
  rw [hsup] at hsupN
  have hNtop : N.direction = ⊤ := top_unique hsupN
  have : Module.finrank ℝ N.direction = 2 := by
    rw [hNtop, finrank_top, Complex.finrank_real_complex]
  omega

name: Tiling.affine_line_direction_mem_stabilizer
statement:
private theorem affine_line_direction_mem_stabilizer
    {t : Set Plane} {L : AffineSubspace ℝ Plane}
    (htclosed : IsClosed t) (hLne : (L : Set Plane).Nonempty)
    (hLdim : Module.finrank ℝ L.direction = 1)
    (hLfrontier : (L : Set Plane) ⊆ frontier t)
    (hstraight : ∀ y, y ∈ frontier t → BoundaryLocallyStraightAt t y)
    {v : Plane} (hvL : v ∈ L.direction) :
    v ∈ AddAction.stabilizer Plane t
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
  by_cases hv : v = 0
  · simp only [hv, zero_vadd]
  ext y
  rw [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  let f : ℝ → Plane := fun r ↦ r • v +ᵥ y
  have hf_continuous : Continuous f := by fun_prop
  have hmembership : ∀ r, f r ∈ t ↔ f 0 ∈ t := by
    by_cases hhit : ∃ q, f q ∈ frontier t
    · obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hhit
      obtain ⟨M, hfqM, hMdim, hlocal⟩ := hstraight (f q) hq
      have hMfrontier : (M : Set Plane) ⊆ frontier t :=
        affine_line_subset_frontier_of_locally_straight hfqM hMdim hlocal hstraight
      have hdirections : L.direction = M.direction :=
        affine_lines_in_locally_straight_frontier_parallel hLne ⟨f q, hfqM⟩
          hLdim hMdim hLfrontier hMfrontier hstraight
      have hvM : v ∈ M.direction := hdirections ▸ hvL
      have horbit_frontier : ∀ r, f r ∈ frontier t := by
        intro r
        apply hMfrontier
        have hdelta : (r - q) • v ∈ M.direction := M.direction.smul_mem _ hvM
        have hmem := M.vadd_mem_of_mem_direction hdelta hfqM
        have heq : (r - q) • v +ᵥ f q = f r := by
          simp only [f, vadd_eq_add, sub_smul]
          abel
        rwa [heq] at hmem
      intro r
      constructor <;> intro
      · exact htclosed.closure_eq ▸ frontier_subset_closure (horbit_frontier 0)
      · exact htclosed.closure_eq ▸ frontier_subset_closure (horbit_frontier r)
    · have hpre_frontier : frontier (f ⁻¹' t) = ∅ := by
        ext r
        constructor
        · intro hr
          exact (hhit ⟨r, hf_continuous.frontier_preimage_subset t hr⟩).elim
        · intro hr
          exact hr.elim
      rcases frontier_eq_empty_iff.mp hpre_frontier with hempty | huniv
      · have hnone : ∀ r, f r ∉ t := by
          intro r hr
          have : r ∈ f ⁻¹' t := hr
          rw [hempty] at this
          exact this
        intro r
        exact ⟨fun hr ↦ (hnone r hr).elim, fun hzero ↦ (hnone 0 hzero).elim⟩
      · have hall : ∀ r, f r ∈ t := by
          intro r
          have : r ∈ f ⁻¹' t := by rw [huniv]; exact mem_univ r
          exact this
        intro r
        exact ⟨fun _ ↦ hall 0, fun _ ↦ hall r⟩
  simpa only [f, neg_one_smul, zero_smul, zero_vadd] using hmembership (-1)

name: Tiling.interior_nonempty_of_regular_closed_nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hinterior
  rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hinterior, closure_empty] at hregular
  exact hne.ne_empty hregular.symm

name: Tiling.directions_eq_of_aedisjoint
statement:
private theorem directions_eq_of_aedisjoint
    {s t : Set Plane} {L M : AffineSubspace ℝ Plane}
    (hsinterior : (interior s).Nonempty) (htinterior : (interior t).Nonempty)
    (had : AEDisjoint volume s t)
    (hLdim : Module.finrank ℝ L.direction = 1)
    (hMdim : Module.finrank ℝ M.direction = 1)
    (hLs : ∀ v ∈ L.direction, v ∈ AddAction.stabilizer Plane s)
    (hMt : ∀ v ∈ M.direction, v ∈ AddAction.stabilizer Plane t) :
    L.direction = M.direction
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hdirections
  have hinf : L.direction ⊓ M.direction = ⊥ := by
    apply (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mpr
    intro z hz
    by_contra hz0
    have hspanL := eq_span_singleton_of_mem_of_finrank_eq_one hLdim hz.1 hz0
    have hspanM := eq_span_singleton_of_mem_of_finrank_eq_one hMdim hz.2 hz0
    exact hdirections (hspanL.trans hspanM.symm)
  have hsupdim : Module.finrank ℝ ↑(L.direction ⊔ M.direction) = 2 := by
    have hdim := Submodule.finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq L.direction M.direction
    rw [hinf, finrank_bot] at hdim
    simp only [hLdim, hMdim] at hdim
    omega
  have hsup : L.direction ⊔ M.direction = ⊤ := by
    apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
    simpa only [Complex.finrank_real_complex] using hsupdim
  obtain ⟨xs, hxs⟩ := hsinterior
  obtain ⟨xt, hxt⟩ := htinterior
  have hdelta : xt -ᵥ xs ∈ L.direction ⊔ M.direction := by
    rw [hsup]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨v, hvL, w, hwM, hvw⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hdelta
  let p : Plane := v +ᵥ xs
  have hp_eq : p = -w +ᵥ xt := by
    dsimp only [p]
    rw [vadd_eq_add, vadd_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub]
    rw [vsub_eq_sub] at hvw
    calc
      v + xs = (v + w) + xs - w := by abel
      _ = (xt - xs) + xs - w := by rw [hvw]
      _ = xt - w := by abel
  have hvstabilizer : v +ᵥ s = s := AddAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp (hLs v hvL)
  have hwstabilizer : -w +ᵥ t = t :=
    AddAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp (hMt (-w) (M.direction.neg_mem hwM))
  have hp_s : p ∈ interior s := by
    rw [← hvstabilizer, interior_vadd]
    exact ⟨xs, hxs, by simp only [p]⟩
  have hp_t : p ∈ interior t := by
    rw [hp_eq, ← hwstabilizer, interior_vadd]
    exact ⟨xt, hxt, rfl⟩
  have hpositive : 0 < volume (interior s ∩ interior t) :=
    (isOpen_interior.inter isOpen_interior).measure_pos volume ⟨p, hp_s, hp_t⟩
  have hzero : volume (interior s ∩ interior t) = 0 :=
    measure_mono_null (inter_subset_inter interior_subset interior_subset) had.eq
  exact (ne_of_gt hpositive) hzero

name: Tiling.exists_common_stabilizer_direction
statement:
theorem exists_common_stabilizer_direction {ι : Type*} (s : ι → Set Plane)
    (hne : ∀ i, (s i).Nonempty)
    (hregular : ∀ i, closure (interior (s i)) = s i)
    (had : ∀ ⦃i j⦄, i ≠ j → AEDisjoint volume (s i) (s j))
    (hstraight : ∀ i x, x ∈ frontier (s i) → BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (s i) x) :
    ∃ v : Plane, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i (r : ℝ),
      r • v ∈ AddAction.stabilizer Plane (s i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hindex : ∃ i : ι, True
  · obtain ⟨i, -⟩ := hindex
    have hiinterior : (interior (s i)).Nonempty :=
      interior_nonempty_of_regular_closed_nonempty (hne i) (hregular i)
    have hiclosed : IsClosed (s i) := by
      rw [← hregular i]
      exact isClosed_closure
    by_cases hifrontier : frontier (s i) = ∅
    · have hiuniv : s i = univ := by
        rcases frontier_eq_empty_iff.mp hifrontier with hiempty | hiuniv
        · exact ((hne i).ne_empty hiempty).elim
        · exact hiuniv
      refine ⟨1, one_ne_zero, ?_⟩
      intro j r
      have hji : j = i := by
        by_contra hji
        have hjinterior : (interior (s j)).Nonempty :=
          interior_nonempty_of_regular_closed_nonempty (hne j) (hregular j)
        have hsjzero : volume (s j) = 0 := by
          have hz := (had (i := i) (j := j) (Ne.symm hji)).eq
          simpa only [hiuniv, univ_inter] using hz
        have hinteriorzero : volume (interior (s j)) = 0 :=
          measure_mono_null interior_subset hsjzero
        exact (ne_of_gt (isOpen_interior.measure_pos volume hjinterior)) hinteriorzero
      subst j
      rw [AddAction.mem_stabilizer_iff, hiuniv]
      simp
    · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hifrontier
      obtain ⟨L, hxL, hLdim, hxlocal⟩ := hstraight i x hx
      have hLfrontier : (L : Set Plane) ⊆ frontier (s i) :=
        affine_line_subset_frontier_of_locally_straight hxL hLdim hxlocal (hstraight i)
      have hLne : (L : Set Plane).Nonempty := ⟨x, hxL⟩
      have hdirection : L.direction ≠ ⊥ := by
        intro hbot
        have : Module.finrank ℝ L.direction = 0 := by rw [hbot]; simp
        omega
      obtain ⟨v, hvL, hv⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff L.direction).mp hdirection
      have histabilizer : ∀ z ∈ L.direction,
          z ∈ AddAction.stabilizer Plane (s i) := by
        intro z hz
        exact affine_line_direction_mem_stabilizer hiclosed hLne hLdim hLfrontier
          (hstraight i) hz
      refine ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩
      intro j r
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst j
        exact histabilizer (r • v) (L.direction.smul_mem r hvL)
      have hjinterior : (interior (s j)).Nonempty :=
        interior_nonempty_of_regular_closed_nonempty (hne j) (hregular j)
      have hjclosed : IsClosed (s j) := by
        rw [← hregular j]
        exact isClosed_closure
      have hjfrontier : frontier (s j) ≠ ∅ := by
        intro hjfrontier
        have hjuniv : s j = univ := by
          rcases frontier_eq_empty_iff.mp hjfrontier with hjempty | hjuniv
          · exact ((hne j).ne_empty hjempty).elim
          · exact hjuniv
        have hsizero : volume (s i) = 0 := by
          have hz := (had (i := i) (j := j) (Ne.symm hji)).eq
          simpa only [hjuniv, inter_univ] using hz
        have hinteriorzero : volume (interior (s i)) = 0 :=
          measure_mono_null interior_subset hsizero
        exact (ne_of_gt (isOpen_interior.measure_pos volume hiinterior)) hinteriorzero
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hjfrontier
      obtain ⟨M, hyM, hMdim, hylocal⟩ := hstraight j y hy
      have hMfrontier : (M : Set Plane) ⊆ frontier (s j) :=
        affine_line_subset_frontier_of_locally_straight hyM hMdim hylocal (hstraight j)
      have hMne : (M : Set Plane).Nonempty := ⟨y, hyM⟩
      have hjstabilizer : ∀ z ∈ M.direction,
          z ∈ AddAction.stabilizer Plane (s j) := by
        intro z hz
        exact affine_line_direction_mem_stabilizer hjclosed hMne hMdim hMfrontier
          (hstraight j) hz
      have hdirections : L.direction = M.direction :=
        directions_eq_of_aedisjoint hiinterior hjinterior (had (Ne.symm hji))
          hLdim hMdim histabilizer hjstabilizer
      apply hjstabilizer
      rw [← hdirections]
      exact L.direction.smul_mem r hvL
  · refine ⟨1, one_ne_zero, ?_⟩
    intro i
    exact (hindex ⟨i, trivial⟩).elim

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.shiftedPlacement_translation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftedPlacement_translation (v : Plane) (shift : A.Plate → ℝ) (i : A.placements) :

:=

theorem mem_shiftComponents_placements_iff {v : Plane} {shift : A.Plate → ℝ}

proof:

statement:

proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨_, i, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.placedTile_shiftedPlacement
statement:
theorem placedTile_shiftedPlacement (v : Plane) (shift : A.Plate → ℝ)
    (i : A.placements) :
    placedTile A.prototiles (A.shiftedPlacement v shift i) =
      shift (A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i) • v +ᵥ
        placedTile A.prototiles i.1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [placedTile, shiftedPlacement]
  rw [vadd_vadd, add_comm]

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.placedVertexSet_shiftedVertex
statement:
theorem placedVertexSet_shiftedVertex (v : Plane) (shift : A.Plate → ℝ)
    (i : A.placements) :
    (A.shiftComponents v shift).placedVertexSet (A.shiftedVertex v shift i) =
      shift (A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i) • v +ᵥ A.placedVertexSet i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [placedVertexSet, shiftComponents_prototiles, shiftedVertex_val, shiftedPlacement]
  rw [vadd_vadd, add_comm]

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.shiftedVertex_injective_of_component_eq
statement:
theorem shiftedVertex_injective_of_component_eq (v : Plane) (shift : A.Plate → ℝ)
    {i j : A.placements}
    (hcomponent : A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i =
      A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk j)
    (hshifted : A.shiftedVertex v shift i = A.shiftedVertex v shift j) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hval := congrArg (fun k : (A.shiftComponents v shift).placements ↦ k.1) hshifted
  apply Prod.ext
  · dsimp only [shiftedVertex, shiftedPlacement] at hval ⊢
    rw [hcomponent] at hval
    exact add_right_cancel (congrArg Prod.fst hval)
  · simpa only [shiftedVertex, shiftedPlacement] using congrArg Prod.snd hval

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.shiftComponents_zero_placements
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftComponents_zero_placements (v : Plane) :
    (A.shiftComponents v 0).placements = A.placements
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
    simp [shiftedPlacement, j.2]
  · intro hi
    exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, by simp [shiftedPlacement]⟩

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.IsSlidingDirection.vadd_plateCarrier
statement:
theorem vadd_plateCarrier (hv : A.IsSlidingDirection v) (C : A.Plate) (r : ℝ) :
    r • v +ᵥ A.plateCarrier C = A.plateCarrier C
proof:
:=
  AddAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp (hv.invariant C r)

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.vadd_subset_vadd
statement:
private theorem vadd_subset_vadd {s t : Set Plane} (a : Plane) (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    a +ᵥ s ⊆ a +ᵥ t
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  simpa only [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] using hst
    (by simpa only [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] using hx)

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.IsSlidingDirection.isTiling_shiftComponents
statement:
theorem IsSlidingDirection.isTiling_shiftComponents {v : Plane}
    (hv : A.IsSlidingDirection v) (hA : IsTiling A.prototiles A.placements)
    (shift : A.Plate → ℝ) :
    IsTiling (A.shiftComponents v shift).prototiles
      (A.shiftComponents v shift).placements
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Countable A.placements := hA.countable.to_subtype
  rw [shiftComponents_prototiles]
  refine ⟨Set.countable_range _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩ _ ⟨j, rfl⟩ hij
    change AEDisjoint volume
      (placedTile A.prototiles (A.shiftedPlacement v shift i))
      (placedTile A.prototiles (A.shiftedPlacement v shift j))
    rw [A.placedTile_shiftedPlacement, A.placedTile_shiftedPlacement]
    by_cases hcomponent : A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i =
        A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk j
    · rw [hcomponent]
      apply aedisjoint_vadd
      apply hA.isPacking i.2 j.2
      intro h
      exact hij (congrArg (A.shiftedPlacement v shift) (Subtype.ext h))
    · apply (A.plateCarrier_aedisjoint hA hcomponent).mono
      · rw [← hv.vadd_plateCarrier (A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i)
          (shift (A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i))]
        exact vadd_subset_vadd _ (A.placedTile_subset_plateCarrier i)
      · rw [← hv.vadd_plateCarrier (A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk j)
          (shift (A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk j))]
        exact vadd_subset_vadd _ (A.placedTile_subset_plateCarrier j)
  · filter_upwards [hA.isCover] with x hx
    rw [mem_iUnion] at hx ⊢
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hx
    let C := A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk i
    have hxC : x ∈ A.plateCarrier C := A.placedTile_subset_plateCarrier i hxi
    have hxshiftedCarrier : x ∈ shift C • v +ᵥ A.plateCarrier C := by
      rw [hv.vadd_plateCarrier]
      exact hxC
    rw [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hxshiftedCarrier
    obtain ⟨j, hjC, hxj⟩ := A.mem_plateCarrier_iff.mp hxshiftedCarrier
    have hcomponent : A.vertexGraph.connectedComponentMk j = C := hjC
    refine ⟨A.shiftedVertex v shift j, ?_⟩
    change x ∈ placedTile A.prototiles (A.shiftedPlacement v shift j)
    rw [A.placedTile_shiftedPlacement]
    rw [hcomponent, mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    exact hxj

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.isTiling_shiftComponents_zero
statement:
theorem isTiling_shiftComponents_zero
    (hA : IsTiling A.prototiles A.placements) (v : Plane) :
    IsTiling (A.shiftComponents v 0).prototiles (A.shiftComponents v 0).placements
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftComponents_prototiles, shiftComponents_zero_placements]
  exact hA

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.exists_isSlidingDirection
statement:
theorem exists_isSlidingDirection [Finite P]
    (hA : IsTiling A.prototiles A.placements) :
    ∃ v : Plane, A.IsSlidingDirection v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hinvariant⟩ := exists_common_stabilizer_direction A.plateCarrier
    A.plateCarrier_nonempty
    (A.plateCarrier_closure_interior hA.isPacking)
    (fun _ _ hCD ↦ A.plateCarrier_aedisjoint hA hCD)
    (fun C x hx ↦ A.plateCarrier_boundaryLocallyStraightAt hA C hx)
  exact ⟨v, ⟨hv, hinvariant⟩⟩

name: Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.exists_sliding_direction
statement:
theorem exists_sliding_direction [Finite P]
    (hA : IsTiling A.prototiles A.placements) :
    ∃ v : Plane, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ shift : A.Plate → ℝ,
      IsTiling (A.shiftComponents v shift).prototiles
        (A.shiftComponents v shift).placements
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := A.exists_isSlidingDirection hA
  exact ⟨v, hv.ne_zero, fun shift ↦
    IsSlidingDirection.isTiling_shiftComponents A hv hA shift⟩

name: Tiling.mem_positiveSide
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_positiveSide {a v z : Plane} :
    z ∈ positiveSide a v ↔ 0 < signedSide a v z

  change planarCross v a < planarCross v z ↔ 0 < planarCross v z - planarCross v a

name: Tiling.signedSide_self
statement: @[simp] theorem signedSide_self (a v : Plane) : signedSide a v a = 0
proof:
:= by

name: Tiling.signedSide_vadd_smul
statement:
theorem signedSide_vadd_smul (a v : Plane) (r : ℝ) :
    signedSide a v (a + r • v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [signedSide, planarCross]
  ring

name: Tiling.mem_affineLine_self
statement: theorem mem_affineLine_self (a v : Plane) : a ∈ affineLine a v
proof:

  simp [affineLine]

name: Tiling.vadd_smul_mem_affineLine
statement:
theorem vadd_smul_mem_affineLine (a v : Plane) (r : ℝ) :
    a + r • v ∈ affineLine a v
proof:
:= by
  change signedSide a v (a + r • v) = 0
  exact signedSide_vadd_smul a v r

name: Tiling.mem_affineLine_iff_exists_smul
statement:
theorem mem_affineLine_iff_exists_smul {a v z : Plane} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    z ∈ affineLine a v ↔ ∃ t : ℝ, z = a + t • v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hcross : planarCross v z - planarCross v a = 0 := mem_affineLine.1 hz
    by_cases hvre : v.re = 0
    · have hvim : v.im ≠ 0 := by
        intro hvim
        apply hv
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hvre, hvim]
      refine ⟨(z.im - a.im) / v.im, ?_⟩
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
        have hre : z.re = a.re := by
          simp only [planarCross, hvre, zero_mul, zero_sub, neg_sub_neg] at hcross
          exact (mul_left_cancel₀ hvim) (by linarith)
        simp [hre, hvre]
      · simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        ring
    · refine ⟨(z.re - a.re) / v.re, ?_⟩
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        ring
      · simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
        have him : z.im = a.im + (z.re - a.re) / v.re * v.im := by
          simp only [planarCross] at hcross
          field_simp
          linear_combination hcross
        exact him
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact vadd_smul_mem_affineLine a v t

name: Tiling.affineLine_eq_range
statement:
theorem affineLine_eq_range (a : Plane) {v : Plane} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    affineLine a v = Set.range fun t : ℝ ↦ a + t • v
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rw [mem_affineLine_iff_exists_smul hv]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨t, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    exact ⟨t, ht.symm⟩

name: Tiling.AffineSubspace.exists_affineLine_eq
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Nontrivial L.direction := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_eq_succ hdim
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_ne (0 : L.direction)
  let v : Plane := w.1
  have hv : v ≠ 0 := by
    intro hv
    apply hw
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hv
  have hvL : v ∈ L.direction := w.2
  have hdir : L.direction = ℝ ∙ v :=
    eq_span_singleton_of_mem_of_finrank_eq_one hdim hvL hv
  refine ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hzdir : z - a ∈ L.direction := L.vsub_mem_direction hz ha
    rw [hdir, Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hzdir
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hzdir
    apply (mem_affineLine_iff_exists_smul hv).2
    refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
    calc
      z = (z - a) + a := by abel
      _ = t • v + a := by rw [← ht]
      _ = a + t • v := add_comm _ _
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := (mem_affineLine_iff_exists_smul hv).1 hz
    rw [show a + t • v = t • v +ᵥ a by simp [vadd_eq_add, add_comm]]
    exact L.vadd_mem_of_mem_direction (hdir.symm ▸ Submodule.smul_mem _ t
      (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self v)) ha

name: Tiling.AffineSubspace.exists_ball_frontier_iff_affineLine
statement:
theorem AffineSubspace.exists_ball_frontier_iff_affineLine
    {s : Set Plane} {L : AffineSubspace ℝ Plane} {a : Plane}
    (ha : a ∈ L) (hdim : Module.finrank ℝ L.direction = 1)
    (hlocal : ∀ᶠ z in nhds a, (z ∈ frontier s ↔ z ∈ (L : Set Plane))) :
    ∃ v : Plane, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ r > 0,
      ∀ z ∈ ball a r, (z ∈ frontier s ↔ z ∈ affineLine a v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hL⟩ := Tiling.AffineSubspace.exists_affineLine_eq ha hdim
  have hlocal' : ∀ᶠ z in nhds a, (z ∈ frontier s ↔ z ∈ affineLine a v) := by
    simpa only [hL] using hlocal
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.1 hlocal'
  exact ⟨v, hv, r, hr, hball⟩

name: Tiling.AffineSubspace.exists_levelSet_coordinate
statement:
theorem AffineSubspace.exists_levelSet_coordinate
    (L : AffineSubspace ℝ Plane) (a : Plane) (ha : a ∈ L)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℝ L.direction = 1) :
    ∃ ψ : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ z, (z ∈ L ↔ ψ z = ψ a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, _hv, hL⟩ := Tiling.AffineSubspace.exists_affineLine_eq ha hdim
  refine ⟨planarCrossCLM v, fun z ↦ ?_⟩
  change z ∈ (L : Set Plane) ↔ planarCross v z = planarCross v a
  rw [hL]
  simp only [mem_affineLine, signedSide, sub_eq_zero]

name: Tiling.positiveHalfPlane_eq_positiveSide_union_line
statement:
theorem positiveHalfPlane_eq_positiveSide_union_line (a v : Plane) :
    positiveHalfPlane a v = positiveSide a v ∪ affineLine a v
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [mem_positiveHalfPlane, mem_union, mem_positiveSide, mem_affineLine]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le h with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h.symm
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact h.le
    · exact h.ge

name: Tiling.negativeHalfPlane_eq_negativeSide_union_line
statement:
theorem negativeHalfPlane_eq_negativeSide_union_line (a v : Plane) :
    negativeHalfPlane a v = negativeSide a v ∪ affineLine a v
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [mem_negativeHalfPlane, mem_union, mem_negativeSide, mem_affineLine]
  exact (le_iff_lt_or_eq :
    signedSide a v z ≤ 0 ↔ signedSide a v z < 0 ∨ signedSide a v z = 0)

    (positiveHalfPlane a v)ᶜ = negativeSide a v

name: Tiling.compl_negativeHalfPlane

name: Tiling.IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier
statement:
theorem IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {c s : Set X} (hc : IsPreconnected c)
    (hdisj : Disjoint c (frontier s)) :
    c ⊆ interior s ∨ c ⊆ interior sᶜ
proof:
:= by
  apply hc.subset_or_subset isOpen_interior isOpen_interior
  · exact disjoint_of_subset interior_subset interior_subset disjoint_compl_right
  · intro x hx
    rw [← compl_frontier_eq_union_interior]
    exact Set.mem_compl (Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hx)

name: Tiling.IsPreconnected.subset_interior_of_disjoint_frontier_of_mem
statement:
theorem IsPreconnected.subset_interior_of_disjoint_frontier_of_mem
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {c s : Set X} (hc : IsPreconnected c)
    (hdisj : Disjoint c (frontier s)) {x : X} (hxc : x ∈ c) (hxs : x ∈ s) :
    c ⊆ interior s
proof:
:= by
  rcases IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier hc hdisj with
    h | h
  · exact h
  · exact False.elim ((interior_subset (h hxc)) hxs)

name: Tiling.local_levelSet_dichotomy
statement:
theorem local_levelSet_dichotomy (psi : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    {s : Set Plane} {x : Plane} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hregular : closure (interior s) = s) (hx : x ∈ frontier s)
    (hboundary : ∀ y ∈ ball x r, (y ∈ frontier s ↔ psi y = psi x)) :
    let positive := ball x r ∩ {y | psi x < psi y}
    let negative := ball x r ∩ {y | psi y < psi x}
    (positive ⊆ interior s ∧ negative ⊆ interior sᶜ) ∨
      (positive ⊆ interior sᶜ ∧ negative ⊆ interior s)
proof:
:= by
  let positive : Set Plane := ball x r ∩ {y | psi x < psi y}
  let negative : Set Plane := ball x r ∩ {y | psi y < psi x}
  have hsClosed : IsClosed s := by
    rw [← hregular]
    exact isClosed_closure
  have hxs : x ∈ s := hsClosed.frontier_subset hx
  have hxClosure : x ∈ closure (interior s) := by simpa only [hregular] using hxs
  obtain ⟨u, huBall, hu⟩ :=
    mem_closure_iff.mp hxClosure (ball x r) isOpen_ball (mem_ball_self hr)
  have hxc : x ∈ frontier sᶜ := by simpa using hx
  have hxcClosure : x ∈ closure sᶜ := frontier_subset_closure hxc
  obtain ⟨w, hwBall, hwc⟩ :=
    mem_closure_iff.mp hxcClosure (ball x r) isOpen_ball (mem_ball_self hr)
  have hw : w ∈ interior sᶜ := by
    rw [hsClosed.isOpen_compl.interior_eq]
    exact hwc
  have huNe : psi u ≠ psi x := by
    intro heq
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 disjoint_interior_frontier hu
      ((hboundary u huBall).2 heq)
  have hwNe : psi w ≠ psi x := by
    intro heq
    have hwf : w ∈ frontier sᶜ := by simpa using (hboundary w hwBall).2 heq
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 disjoint_interior_frontier hw hwf
  have hposPre : IsPreconnected positive :=
    ((convex_ball x r).inter
      (convex_halfSpace_gt psi.toLinearMap.isLinear (psi x))).isPreconnected
  have hnegPre : IsPreconnected negative :=
    ((convex_ball x r).inter
      (convex_halfSpace_lt psi.toLinearMap.isLinear (psi x))).isPreconnected
  have hposDisjoint : Disjoint positive (frontier s) := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.2 fun y hy hyf ↦ ?_
    have hypos : psi x < psi y := hy.2
    exact (ne_of_gt hypos) ((hboundary y hy.1).1 hyf)
  have hnegDisjoint : Disjoint negative (frontier s) := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.2 fun y hy hyf ↦ ?_
    have hyneg : psi y < psi x := hy.2
    exact (ne_of_lt hyneg) ((hboundary y hy.1).1 hyf)
  have hposCases :=
    IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier
      hposPre hposDisjoint
  have hnegCases :=
    IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier
      hnegPre hnegDisjoint
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne huNe with huNeg | huPos
  · have huIn : u ∈ negative := ⟨huBall, huNeg⟩
    have hnegIn : negative ⊆ interior s := hnegCases.resolve_right fun h ↦
      (interior_subset (h huIn)) (interior_subset hu)
    have hwPos : psi x < psi w := by
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hwNe with hwNeg | hwPos
      · exact False.elim ((interior_subset hw) (interior_subset (hnegIn ⟨hwBall, hwNeg⟩)))
      · exact hwPos
    have hposOut : positive ⊆ interior sᶜ := hposCases.resolve_left fun h ↦
      (interior_subset hw) (interior_subset (h ⟨hwBall, hwPos⟩))
    exact Or.inr ⟨hposOut, hnegIn⟩
  · have huIn : u ∈ positive := ⟨huBall, huPos⟩
    have hposIn : positive ⊆ interior s := hposCases.resolve_right fun h ↦
      (interior_subset (h huIn)) (interior_subset hu)
    have hwNeg : psi w < psi x := by
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hwNe with hwNeg | hwPos
      · exact hwNeg
      · exact False.elim ((interior_subset hw) (interior_subset (hposIn ⟨hwBall, hwPos⟩)))
    have hnegOut : negative ⊆ interior sᶜ := hnegCases.resolve_left fun h ↦
      (interior_subset hw) (interior_subset (h ⟨hwBall, hwNeg⟩))
    exact Or.inl ⟨hposIn, hnegOut⟩

name: Tiling.local_eq_closedHalfPlane
statement:
theorem local_eq_closedHalfPlane
    {s : Set Plane} {a v : Plane} {r : ℝ} (_hv : v ≠ 0) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hregular : closure (interior s) = s)
    (hfrontier : ∀ z ∈ ball a r, (z ∈ frontier s ↔ z ∈ affineLine a v)) :
    s ∩ ball a r = positiveHalfPlane a v ∩ ball a r ∨
      s ∩ ball a r = negativeHalfPlane a v ∩ ball a r
proof:
:= by
  have haBall : a ∈ ball a r := by simpa using hr
  have haFrontier : a ∈ frontier s :=
    (hfrontier a haBall).2 (mem_affineLine_self a v)
  have hsClosed : IsClosed s := by
    rw [← hregular]
    exact isClosed_closure
  have hlineS {z : Plane} (hzBall : z ∈ ball a r) (hzLine : z ∈ affineLine a v) :
      z ∈ s :=
    hsClosed.frontier_subset ((hfrontier z hzBall).2 hzLine)
  have hposDisjoint : Disjoint (ball a r ∩ positiveSide a v) (frontier s) := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.2 fun z hz hzs ↦ ?_
    have hzLine := (hfrontier z hz.1).1 hzs
    exact (ne_of_gt (mem_positiveSide.1 hz.2)) (mem_affineLine.1 hzLine)
  have hnegDisjoint : Disjoint (ball a r ∩ negativeSide a v) (frontier s) := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.2 fun z hz hzs ↦ ?_
    have hzLine := (hfrontier z hz.1).1 hzs
    exact (ne_of_lt (mem_negativeSide.1 hz.2)) (mem_affineLine.1 hzLine)
  have hpos :=
    IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier
      (isPreconnected_ball_inter_positiveSide a v r) hposDisjoint
  have hneg :=
    IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier
      (isPreconnected_ball_inter_negativeSide a v r) hnegDisjoint
  rcases hpos with hposIn | hposOut <;> rcases hneg with hnegIn | hnegOut
  · exfalso
    have hballS : ball a r ⊆ s := by
      intro z hzBall
      rcases lt_trichotomy (signedSide a v z) 0 with hzNeg | hzZero | hzPos
      · exact interior_subset (hnegIn ⟨hzBall, mem_negativeSide.2 hzNeg⟩)
      · exact hlineS hzBall (mem_affineLine.2 hzZero)
      · exact interior_subset (hposIn ⟨hzBall, mem_positiveSide.2 hzPos⟩)
    have haInterior : a ∈ interior s :=
      interior_maximal hballS isOpen_ball haBall
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 disjoint_interior_frontier haInterior haFrontier
  · left
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hzS, hzBall⟩
      refine ⟨mem_positiveHalfPlane.2 ?_, hzBall⟩
      by_contra hz
      have hzNeg : signedSide a v z < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hz
      exact (interior_subset (hnegOut ⟨hzBall, mem_negativeSide.2 hzNeg⟩)) hzS
    · rintro ⟨hzHalf, hzBall⟩
      refine ⟨?_, hzBall⟩
      rcases (mem_positiveHalfPlane.1 hzHalf).eq_or_lt with hzZero | hzPos
      · exact hlineS hzBall (mem_affineLine.2 hzZero.symm)
      · exact interior_subset (hposIn ⟨hzBall, mem_positiveSide.2 hzPos⟩)
  · right
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hzS, hzBall⟩
      refine ⟨mem_negativeHalfPlane.2 ?_, hzBall⟩
      by_contra hz
      have hzPos : 0 < signedSide a v z := lt_of_not_ge hz
      exact (interior_subset (hposOut ⟨hzBall, mem_positiveSide.2 hzPos⟩)) hzS
    · rintro ⟨hzHalf, hzBall⟩
      refine ⟨?_, hzBall⟩
      rcases (mem_negativeHalfPlane.1 hzHalf).eq_or_lt with hzZero | hzNeg
      · exact hlineS hzBall (mem_affineLine.2 hzZero)
      · exact interior_subset (hnegIn ⟨hzBall, mem_negativeSide.2 hzNeg⟩)
  · exfalso
    have haS : a ∈ s := hsClosed.frontier_subset haFrontier
    have haClosure : a ∈ closure (interior s) := by
      rw [hregular]
      exact haS
    obtain ⟨z, hzInterior, hzDist⟩ := (Metric.mem_closure_iff.1 haClosure) r hr
    have hzBall : z ∈ ball a r := by simpa [dist_comm] using hzDist
    have hinterDisjoint : Disjoint (interior s) (interior sᶜ) :=
      disjoint_of_subset interior_subset interior_subset disjoint_compl_right
    rcases lt_trichotomy (signedSide a v z) 0 with hzNeg | hzZero | hzPos
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hinterDisjoint hzInterior
        (hnegOut ⟨hzBall, mem_negativeSide.2 hzNeg⟩)
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.1 disjoint_interior_frontier hzInterior
        ((hfrontier z hzBall).2 (mem_affineLine.2 hzZero))
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hinterDisjoint hzInterior
        (hposOut ⟨hzBall, mem_positiveSide.2 hzPos⟩)

name: Tiling.exists_local_eq_closedHalfPlane_of_affineSubspace
statement:
theorem exists_local_eq_closedHalfPlane_of_affineSubspace
    {s : Set Plane} {L : AffineSubspace ℝ Plane} {a : Plane}
    (hregular : closure (interior s) = s) (ha : a ∈ L)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℝ L.direction = 1)
    (hlocal : ∀ᶠ z in nhds a, (z ∈ frontier s ↔ z ∈ (L : Set Plane))) :
    ∃ v : Plane, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ r > 0,
      (s ∩ ball a r = positiveHalfPlane a v ∩ ball a r ∨
        s ∩ ball a r = negativeHalfPlane a v ∩ ball a r)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, r, hr, hfrontier⟩ :=
    Tiling.AffineSubspace.exists_ball_frontier_iff_affineLine ha hdim hlocal
  exact ⟨v, hv, r, hr, local_eq_closedHalfPlane hv hr hregular hfrontier⟩

name: Tiling.volume_convexHull_pair_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem volume_convexHull_pair_eq_zero (a b : Plane) :
    volume (convexHull ℝ {a, b}) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply measure_mono_null (convexHull_subset_affineSpan {a, b})
  apply Measure.addHaar_affineSubspace
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst b
    intro htop
    have htop' : affineSpan ℝ ({a} : Set Plane) = ⊤ := by simpa using htop
    have hmem : a + 1 ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({a} : Set Plane) := by rw [htop']; simp
    have ha := (AffineSubspace.mem_affineSpan_singleton ℝ Plane).mp hmem
    have : (1 : Plane) = 0 := by linear_combination ha
    exact one_ne_zero this
  · intro htop
    have hdim := congrArg (fun s : AffineSubspace ℝ Plane ↦ Module.finrank ℝ s.direction) htop
    rw [direction_affineSpan, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vsub_eq_sub,
      finrank_span_singleton (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hab)), AffineSubspace.direction_top,
      finrank_top, Complex.finrank_real_complex] at hdim
    omega

name: Tiling.rectangle_eq_union_triangles
proof:
:= by
  let c : Plane := a.re + b.im * Complex.I
  let d : Plane := b.re + a.im * Complex.I
  change Complex.Rectangle a b = convexHull ℝ {a, c, b} ∪ convexHull ℝ {a, d, b}
  by_cases hre : a.re = b.re
  · have hc : c = b := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [c, hre]
    have hd : d = a := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [d, hre]
    rw [Complex.rectangle_eq_convexHull]
    change convexHull ℝ {a, c, d, b} = convexHull ℝ {a, c, b} ∪ convexHull ℝ {a, d, b}
    simp [hc, hd]
  by_cases him : a.im = b.im
  · have hc : c = a := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [c, him]
    have hd : d = b := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [d, him]
    rw [Complex.rectangle_eq_convexHull]
    change convexHull ℝ {a, c, d, b} = convexHull ℝ {a, c, b} ∪ convexHull ℝ {a, d, b}
    simp [hc, hd]
  have hac : a ≠ c := by
    intro h
    apply him
    simpa [c] using congrArg Complex.im h
  have had : a ≠ d := by
    intro h
    apply hre
    simpa [d] using congrArg Complex.re h
  have hab : a ≠ b := fun h ↦ hre (congrArg Complex.re h)
  have hca : c ≠ a := hac.symm
  have hcd : c ≠ d := by
    intro h
    apply hre
    simpa [c, d] using congrArg Complex.re h
  have hcb : c ≠ b := by
    intro h
    apply hre
    simpa [c] using congrArg Complex.re h
  have hda : d ≠ a := had.symm
  have hdc : d ≠ c := hcd.symm
  have hdb : d ≠ b := by
    intro h
    apply him
    simpa [d] using congrArg Complex.im h
  have hba : b ≠ a := hab.symm
  have hbc : b ≠ c := hcb.symm
  have hbd : b ≠ d := hdb.symm
  rw [Complex.rectangle_eq_convexHull]
  change convexHull ℝ {a, c, d, b} = convexHull ℝ {a, c, b} ∪ convexHull ℝ {a, d, b}
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ convexHull ℝ (↑({a, c, d, b} : Finset Plane) : Set Plane) := by
      simpa using hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw_nonneg, hw_sum, hwx⟩ := Finset.mem_convexHull'.mp hx'
    have hw_sum' : w a + w c + w d + w b = 1 := by
      simpa [hac, had, hab, hca, hcd, hcb, hda, hdc, hdb, hba, hbc, hbd, add_assoc] using hw_sum
    have hwx' : w a • a + w c • c + w d • d + w b • b = x := by
      simpa [hac, had, hab, hca, hcd, hcb, hda, hdc, hdb, hba, hbc, hbd, add_assoc] using hwx
    have hwa : 0 ≤ w a := hw_nonneg a (by simp)
    have hwc : 0 ≤ w c := hw_nonneg c (by simp)
    have hwd : 0 ≤ w d := hw_nonneg d (by simp)
    have hwb : 0 ≤ w b := hw_nonneg b (by simp)
    have hcorners : a + b = c + d := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [c, d, add_comm]
    rcases le_total (w c) (w d) with hcdw | hdcw
    · right
      apply mem_convexHull_of_exists_fintype (R := ℝ) ![w a + w c, w d - w c, w b + w c]
        ![a, d, b]
      · intro i
        fin_cases i <;> simp <;> linarith
      · simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        linarith [hw_sum']
      · intro i
        fin_cases i <;> simp
      · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
          Matrix.cons_val_two]
        calc
          (w a + w c) • a + (w d - w c) • d + (w b + w c) • b =
              w a • a + w c • c + w d • d + w b • b := by
            linear_combination (norm := module) w c • hcorners
          _ = x := hwx'
    · left
      apply mem_convexHull_of_exists_fintype (R := ℝ) ![w a + w d, w c - w d, w b + w d]
        ![a, c, b]
      · intro i
        fin_cases i <;> simp <;> linarith
      · simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        linarith [hw_sum']
      · intro i
        fin_cases i <;> simp
      · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
          Matrix.cons_val_two]
        calc
          (w a + w d) • a + (w c - w d) • c + (w b + w d) • b =
              w a • a + w c • c + w d • d + w b • b := by
            linear_combination (norm := module) w d • hcorners
          _ = x := hwx'
  · apply Set.union_subset
    · exact convexHull_mono (by aesop)
    · exact convexHull_mono (by aesop)

name: Tiling.diagonal_triangles_aedisjoint
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c : Plane := a.re + b.im * Complex.I
  let d : Plane := b.re + a.im * Complex.I
  change AEDisjoint volume (convexHull ℝ {a, c, b}) (convexHull ℝ {a, d, b})
  by_cases hre : a.re = b.re
  · have hc : c = b := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [c, hre]
    have hd : d = a := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [d, hre]
    simp [hc, hd, AEDisjoint]
    simpa only [convexHull_pair] using volume_convexHull_pair_eq_zero a b
  by_cases him : a.im = b.im
  · have hc : c = a := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [c, him]
    have hd : d = b := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [d, him]
    simp [hc, hd, AEDisjoint]
    simpa only [convexHull_pair] using volume_convexHull_pair_eq_zero a b
  have hac : a ≠ c := by
    intro h
    apply him
    simpa [c] using congrArg Complex.im h
  have had : a ≠ d := by
    intro h
    apply hre
    simpa [d] using congrArg Complex.re h
  have hab : a ≠ b := fun h ↦ hre (congrArg Complex.re h)
  have hca : c ≠ a := hac.symm
  have hcb : c ≠ b := by
    intro h
    apply hre
    simpa [c] using congrArg Complex.re h
  have hda : d ≠ a := had.symm
  have hdb : d ≠ b := by
    intro h
    apply him
    simpa [d] using congrArg Complex.im h
  have hba : b ≠ a := hab.symm
  have hbc : b ≠ c := hcb.symm
  have hbd : b ≠ d := hdb.symm
  rw [AEDisjoint]
  apply measure_mono_null ?_ (volume_convexHull_pair_eq_zero a b)
  rintro x ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩
  have hx₁' : x ∈ convexHull ℝ (↑({a, c, b} : Finset Plane) : Set Plane) := by
    simpa using hx₁
  have hx₂' : x ∈ convexHull ℝ (↑({a, d, b} : Finset Plane) : Set Plane) := by
    simpa using hx₂
  obtain ⟨u, hu_nonneg, hu_sum, hux⟩ := Finset.mem_convexHull'.mp hx₁'
  obtain ⟨v, hv_nonneg, hv_sum, hvx⟩ := Finset.mem_convexHull'.mp hx₂'
  have hu_sum' : u a + u c + u b = 1 := by
    simpa [hac, hab, hca, hcb, hba, hbc, add_assoc] using hu_sum
  have hv_sum' : v a + v d + v b = 1 := by
    simpa [had, hab, hda, hdb, hba, hbd, add_assoc] using hv_sum
  have hux' : u a • a + u c • c + u b • b = x := by
    simpa [hac, hab, hca, hcb, hba, hbc, add_assoc] using hux
  have hvx' : v a • a + v d • d + v b • b = x := by
    simpa [had, hab, hda, hdb, hba, hbd, add_assoc] using hvx
  have hux_re : u a * a.re + u c * a.re + u b * b.re = x.re := by
    simpa [c] using congrArg Complex.re hux'
  have hvx_re : v a * a.re + v d * b.re + v b * b.re = x.re := by
    simpa [d] using congrArg Complex.re hvx'
  have hux_im : u a * a.im + u c * b.im + u b * b.im = x.im := by
    simpa [c] using congrArg Complex.im hux'
  have hvx_im : v a * a.im + v d * a.im + v b * b.im = x.im := by
    simpa [d] using congrArg Complex.im hvx'
  have hub : u b = v d + v b := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hre))
    linear_combination hux_re - hvx_re - a.re * hu_sum' + a.re * hv_sum'
  have hucub : u c + u b = v b := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm him))
    linear_combination hux_im - hvx_im - a.im * hu_sum' + a.im * hv_sum'
  have huc : 0 ≤ u c := hu_nonneg c (by simp)
  have hvd : 0 ≤ v d := hv_nonneg d (by simp)
  have huc_zero : u c = 0 := by linarith
  apply mem_convexHull_of_exists_fintype (R := ℝ) ![u a, u b] ![a, b]
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · change 0 ≤ u a
      exact hu_nonneg a (by simp)
    · change 0 ≤ u b
      exact hu_nonneg b (by simp)
  · simp [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    linarith [hu_sum']
  · intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  · simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two, huc_zero] using hux'

name: Tiling.rectangleDiagonalTriangulation_pieces
statement:
@[simp] theorem rectangleDiagonalTriangulation_pieces (a b : Plane)
    (hre : a.re ≠ b.re) (him : a.im ≠ b.im) :
    (rectangleDiagonalTriangulation a b hre him).pieces =
      {convexHull ℝ {a, a.re + b.im * Complex.I, b},
        convexHull ℝ {a, b.re + a.im * Complex.I, b}}
proof: := rfl

name: Tiling.IsRectangle.isPolygonal
statement: theorem IsRectangle.isPolygonal {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsRectangle s) : IsPolygonal s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hre, him, rfl⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨rectangleDiagonalTriangulation a b hre him⟩

name: Tiling.Polygonal.finite_inter_of_bounded_of_pairwise_le_dist
statement:
private theorem finite_inter_of_bounded_of_pairwise_le_dist
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    {S Q : Set E} {delta : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hS : S.Pairwise fun x y ↦ delta ≤ dist x y)
    (hQ : Bornology.IsBounded Q) : (S ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hSclosed : IsClosed S := Metric.isClosed_of_pairwise_le_dist hdelta hS
  have hSdiscrete : IsDiscrete S := by
    rw [isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isOpen]
    intro s hs
    refine ⟨Metric.ball s delta, Metric.isOpen_ball, ?_⟩
    ext t
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨htball, htS⟩
      by_cases hts : t = s
      · simp [hts]
      · have hsep := hS htS hs hts
        simp only [Metric.mem_ball] at htball
        exfalso
        linarith
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hdelta, hs⟩
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hQ.subset_closedBall (0 : E)
  have hcompact : IsCompact (S ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 R) :=
    Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
      (hSclosed.inter Metric.isClosed_closedBall)
      (Metric.isBounded_closedBall.subset inter_subset_right)
  apply (hcompact.finite (hSdiscrete.mono inter_subset_left)).subset
  exact inter_subset_inter_right S hR

name: Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport_vadd
statement:
theorem regularSupport_vadd (K : PolygonalRegion) (S : Set Plane) (u : Plane) :
    regularSupport K (u +ᵥ S) = u +ᵥ regularSupport K S
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : openUnion K (u +ᵥ S) = u +ᵥ openUnion K S := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rw [openUnion, Set.mem_iUnion]
      rintro ⟨s, hx⟩
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hst⟩ := s.2
      rw [← hst] at hx
      obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hx
      refine ⟨t + k, ?_, by simp [vadd_eq_add, add_assoc]⟩
      rw [openUnion, Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, k, hk, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      rw [openUnion, Set.mem_iUnion] at hy ⊢
      obtain ⟨t, k, hk, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨⟨u + t, ⟨t, t.2, rfl⟩⟩, k, hk, by
        simp only [vadd_eq_add]
        abel⟩
  rw [regularSupport, regularSupport, hopen, closure_vadd, interior_vadd]

name: Tiling.Polygonal.frontier_vadd_eq
statement:
private theorem frontier_vadd_eq
    (u : Tiling.Plane) (D : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    frontier (u +ᵥ D) = u +ᵥ frontier D
proof:
:= by
  rw [frontier, closure_vadd, interior_vadd]
  ext z
  simp only [frontier, Set.mem_sdiff, mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]

name: Tiling.Polygonal.boundaryLocallyStraightAt_vadd_iff
statement:
private theorem boundaryLocallyStraightAt_vadd_iff
    (u : Tiling.Plane) (D : Set Tiling.Plane) (x : Tiling.Plane) :
    Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (u +ᵥ D) (u + x) ↔
      Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt D x
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ (v : Tiling.Plane) (E : Set Tiling.Plane) (y : Tiling.Plane),
      Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt E y →
        Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (v +ᵥ E) (v + y) by
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h' := this (-u) (u +ᵥ D) (u + x) h
      simpa only [neg_add_cancel_left, neg_vadd_vadd] using h'
    · exact this u D x
  intro v E y h
  obtain ⟨L, hyL, hdim, hlocal⟩ := h
  let L' : AffineSubspace ℝ Tiling.Plane := AffineSubspace.mk' (v + y) L.direction
  refine ⟨L', AffineSubspace.self_mem_mk' _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp only [L']
    rw [AffineSubspace.direction_mk']
    exact hdim
  · obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hlocal
    apply Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mpr
    refine ⟨r, hr, fun z hz ↦ ?_⟩
    let z' : Tiling.Plane := z - v
    have hz' : dist z' y < r := by
      have hzEq : z' - y = z - (v + y) := by dsimp only [z']; abel
      simpa only [dist_eq_norm, hzEq] using hz
    have hsource := hball hz'
    rw [frontier_vadd_eq]
    change (z ∈ v +ᵥ frontier E) ↔ z ∈ L'
    have hfrontier : z ∈ v +ᵥ frontier E ↔ z' ∈ frontier E := by
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩
        have : w = z' := by
          change v + w = z at hwz
          dsimp only [z']
          rw [← hwz]
          abel
        simpa only [this] using hw
      · intro hz'E
        refine ⟨z', hz'E, ?_⟩
        change v + z' = z
        dsimp only [z']
        abel
    rw [hfrontier, hsource]
    rw [show L = AffineSubspace.mk' y L.direction from
      (AffineSubspace.mk'_eq hyL).symm]
    simp only [L', AffineSubspace.mem_mk']
    change z' - y ∈ L.direction ↔ z - (v + y) ∈ L.direction
    have hzEq : z' - y = z - (v + y) := by
      dsimp only [z']
      abel
    rw [hzEq]

name: Tiling.Polygonal.properVertices_vadd
statement:
theorem properVertices_vadd (D : Set Plane) (u : Plane) :
    properVertices (u +ᵥ D) = u +ᵥ properVertices D
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  let y : Tiling.Plane := -u + x
  have hxy : u + y = x := by dsimp [y]; abel
  change IsProperVertex (u +ᵥ D) x ↔ x ∈ u +ᵥ properVertices D
  rw [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  change IsProperVertex (u +ᵥ D) x ↔ IsProperVertex D y
  change (x ∈ frontier (u +ᵥ D) ∧
      ¬Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (u +ᵥ D) x) ↔
    y ∈ frontier D ∧ ¬Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt D y
  rw [frontier_vadd_eq]
  have hfrontier : x ∈ u +ᵥ frontier D ↔ y ∈ frontier D := by
    rw [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    rfl
  rw [hfrontier]
  have hstraight := boundaryLocallyStraightAt_vadd_iff u D y
  rw [hxy] at hstraight
  exact and_congr_right fun _ ↦ not_congr hstraight

name: Tiling.Polygonal.interior_closure_iUnion_interior_closure
statement:
private theorem interior_closure_iUnion_interior_closure
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {I : Type*}
    (U : I → Set X) (hU : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) :
    interior (closure (⋃ i, U i)) =
      interior (closure (⋃ i, interior (closure (U i))))
proof:
:= by
  have hforward : (⋃ i, U i) ⊆ ⋃ i, interior (closure (U i)) := by
    apply Set.iUnion_mono
    intro i
    exact (hU i).subset_interior_closure
  have hbackward : (⋃ i, interior (closure (U i))) ⊆ closure (⋃ i, U i) := by
    apply Set.iUnion_subset
    intro i
    exact interior_subset.trans
      (closure_mono (Set.subset_iUnion U i))
  have hclosure : closure (⋃ i, U i) =
      closure (⋃ i, interior (closure (U i))) := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact closure_mono hforward
    · exact closure_minimal hbackward isClosed_closure
  rw [hclosure]

name: Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion_iUnion
statement:
private theorem openUnion_iUnion
    {I : Type*} (K : PolygonalRegion) (S : I → Set Tiling.Plane) :
    openUnion K (⋃ i, S i) = ⋃ i, openUnion K (S i)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [openUnion, Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hsi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp s.2
    exact ⟨i, ⟨⟨s.1, hsi⟩, hs⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, s, hs⟩
    exact ⟨⟨s.1, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, s.2⟩⟩, hs⟩

name: Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport_iUnion
statement:
theorem regularSupport_iUnion (K : PolygonalRegion) {ι : Type} (S : ι → Set Plane) :
    regularSupport K (⋃ i, S i) = interior (closure (⋃ i, regularSupport K (S i)))
proof:
:= by
  have hopen (i : ι) : IsOpen (openUnion K (S i)) := by
    apply isOpen_iUnion
    intro s
    change IsOpen ((Homeomorph.addLeft (s : Tiling.Plane)) '' K.openCarrier)
    exact (Homeomorph.addLeft (s : Tiling.Plane)).isOpenMap _ isOpen_interior
  rw [regularSupport, openUnion_iUnion]
  exact interior_closure_iUnion_interior_closure
    (fun i ↦ openUnion K (S i)) hopen

name: Tiling.Polygonal.regularOpen_disjoint_complement
statement:
theorem regularOpen_disjoint_complement
    {A B E : Set Plane} (hAopen : IsOpen A) (hAreg : interior (closure A) = A)
    (hBopen : IsOpen B) (hBreg : interior (closure B) = B)
    (hdisj : Disjoint A B) (hE : E = interior (closure (A ∪ B))) :
    A = E \ closure B ∧ B = E \ closure A
proof:
:= by
  have one {U V : Set Plane} (hU : IsOpen U) (hUreg : interior (closure U) = U)
      (hdis : Disjoint U V) :
      U = interior (closure (U ∪ V)) \ closure V := by
    apply Subset.antisymm
    · intro x hx
      exact ⟨interior_mono (closure_mono subset_union_left)
        (hU.subset_interior_closure hx), disjoint_left.mp (hdis.closure_right hU) hx⟩
    · have hopen : IsOpen (interior (closure (U ∪ V)) \ closure V) :=
        isOpen_interior.sdiff isClosed_closure
      have hsub : interior (closure (U ∪ V)) \ closure V ⊆ closure U := by
        intro x hx
        have hcl := interior_subset hx.1
        rw [closure_union] at hcl
        exact hcl.resolve_right hx.2
      have hi := interior_mono hsub
      rw [hopen.interior_eq, hUreg] at hi
      exact hi
  subst E
  exact ⟨one hAopen hAreg hdisj, by simpa [union_comm] using one hBopen hBreg hdisj.symm⟩

name: Tiling.Polygonal.tilesOn_univ_iff_tiles
statement:
theorem tilesOn_univ_iff_tiles (K : PolygonalRegion) (S : Set Plane) :
    TilesOn K S univ ↔ K.Tiles S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine {
      countable := K.placements_countable h.1
      isPacking := h.2.1
      isCover := ?_ }
    filter_upwards [h.2.2] with x hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hx.mp (Set.mem_univ x)
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
    refine ⟨⟨(s.1, ()), s.2⟩, ?_⟩
    change x ∈ s.1 +ᵥ K.support
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hs ⊢
    exact interior_subset hs
  · intro h
    let P := genericProtoTiling K S
    let _ : Countable P.placements :=
      (K.placements_countable h.countable).to_subtype
    have hEq :
        (⋃ i : P.placements, interior (Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i.1))
          =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume]
        (⋃ i : P.placements, Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i.1) :=
      Filter.EventuallyEq.countable_iUnion fun i ↦
        (P.isPolygonal_placedTile i.1).interior_ae_eq
    refine ⟨h.countable, h.isPacking, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [h.isCover, hEq] with x hx hxeq
    constructor
    · intro _
      have hxopen : x ∈ ⋃ i : P.placements,
          interior (Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i.1) := hxeq.mpr hx
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxopen
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hxopen
      refine ⟨⟨i.1.1, i.2⟩, ?_⟩
      change x ∈ interior (i.1.1 +ᵥ K.support) at hi
      rw [interior_vadd] at hi
      exact hi
    · intro _
      exact Set.mem_univ x

name: Tiling.Polygonal.isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint
statement:
theorem isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint (K : PolygonalRegion) (S : Set Plane) :
    IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements S) ↔
      S.Pairwise (fun s t => Disjoint (s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (t +ᵥ K.openCarrier))
proof:
:= by
  let P := genericProtoTiling K S
  constructor
  · intro hpacking s hs t ht hst
    let i : P.placements := ⟨(s, ()), hs⟩
    let j : P.placements := ⟨(t, ()), ht⟩
    have hij : i ≠ j := by
      intro hij
      exact hst (congrArg (fun q : P.placements ↦ q.1.1) hij)
    have hd := P.interior_placedTile_disjoint hpacking hij
    change Disjoint (interior (s +ᵥ K.support))
      (interior (t +ᵥ K.support)) at hd
    change Disjoint (s +ᵥ interior K.support) (t +ᵥ interior K.support)
    simpa only [interior_vadd] using hd
  · intro hdisjoint i hi j hj hij
    have hcent : i.1 ≠ j.1 := by
      intro hcent
      apply hij
      cases i
      cases j
      simp_all
    have hopenDisjoint := hdisjoint hi hj hcent
    let P := genericProtoTiling K S
    have hinterior : Disjoint
        (interior (Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i))
        (interior (Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles j)) := by
      change Disjoint (i.1 +ᵥ interior K.support)
        (j.1 +ᵥ interior K.support) at hopenDisjoint
      change Disjoint (interior (i.1 +ᵥ K.support))
        (interior (j.1 +ᵥ K.support))
      simpa only [interior_vadd] using hopenDisjoint
    have hsubset :
        Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i ∩ Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles j ⊆
          frontier (Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i) ∪
            frontier (Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles j) := by
      rintro x ⟨hxi, hxj⟩
      by_cases hxi' : x ∈ interior (Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i)
      · right
        apply (mem_frontier_iff_notMem_interior hxj).2
        intro hxj'
        exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hinterior hxi' hxj'
      · left
        exact (mem_frontier_iff_notMem_interior hxi).2 hxi'
    apply measure_mono_null hsubset
    rw [measure_union_null]
    · exact (P.isPolygonal_placedTile i).volume_frontier
    · exact (P.isPolygonal_placedTile j).volume_frontier

name: Tiling.Polygonal.exists_packingSeparation
statement:
theorem exists_packingSeparation (K : PolygonalRegion) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ S : Set Plane,
      IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements S) →
        S.Pairwise (fun s t => δ ≤ dist s t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := K.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty K.nonempty
  change c ∈ K.openCarrier at hc
  have hnhds : K.openCarrier ∈ 𝓝 c :=
    isOpen_interior.mem_nhds hc
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnhds
  refine ⟨r + r, add_pos hr hr, ?_⟩
  intro S hpacking s hs t ht hst
  have hdisjoint :=
    (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K S).mp hpacking hs ht hst
  have ball_subset (a : Tiling.Plane) :
      Metric.ball (a + c) r ⊆ a +ᵥ K.openCarrier := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    apply hball
    simpa [dist_eq_norm_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc]
      using hz
  have hballs : Disjoint (Metric.ball (s + c) r) (Metric.ball (t + c) r) :=
    hdisjoint.mono (ball_subset s) (ball_subset t)
  have hdist := (disjoint_ball_ball_iff hr hr).mp hballs
  rw [show dist (s + c) (t + c) = dist s t by
    simp only [dist_eq_norm]
    congr 1
    abel] at hdist
  exact hdist

name: Tiling.Polygonal.packing_centres_locallyFinite
statement:
theorem packing_centres_locallyFinite
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {S : Set Plane}
    (hpacking : IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements S)) :
    (∀ Q : Set Plane, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (S ∩ Q).Finite) ∧
      S.Countable ∧ IsClosed S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨delta, hdelta, hsep⟩ := exists_packingSeparation K
  have hpairwise : S.Pairwise fun x y ↦ delta ≤ dist x y :=
    hsep S hpacking
  have hfinite : ∀ Q : Set Tiling.Plane, Bornology.IsBounded Q →
      (S ∩ Q).Finite := fun Q hQ ↦
    finite_inter_of_bounded_of_pairwise_le_dist hdelta hpairwise hQ
  refine ⟨hfinite, ?_, Metric.isClosed_of_pairwise_le_dist hdelta hpairwise⟩
  have hcover : S ⊆ ⋃ n : ℕ, S ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 n := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨n : ℕ, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt ‖x‖
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
    refine ⟨n, hx, ?_⟩
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hn.le
  exact (Set.countable_iUnion fun n : ℕ ↦
    (hfinite (Metric.closedBall 0 (n : ℝ))
      Metric.isBounded_closedBall).countable).mono hcover

name: Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport_isRegularOpen
statement:
theorem regularSupport_isRegularOpen (K : PolygonalRegion) (S : Set Plane) :
    IsOpen (regularSupport K S) ∧
      interior (closure (regularSupport K S)) = regularSupport K S
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isOpen_interior, ?_⟩
  simp [regularSupport]

name: Tiling.Polygonal.closure_openUnion_eq_iUnion_support
statement:
theorem closure_openUnion_eq_iUnion_support
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {S : Set Plane}
    (hpacking : IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements S)) :
    closure (openUnion K S) = ⋃ s : S, (s : Plane) +ᵥ K.support
proof:
:= by
  let P := genericProtoTiling K S
  let toPlacement : S → P.placements := fun s => ⟨(s, ()), s.2⟩
  have htoPlacement : Function.Injective toPlacement := by
    intro s t hst
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun i : P.placements ↦ i.1.1) hst)
  have hloc : LocallyFinite (fun s : S ↦ (s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support) := by
    exact (P.locallyFinite_placedTile hpacking).comp_injective htoPlacement
  have hopen : LocallyFinite (fun s : S ↦ (s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) :=
    hloc.subset fun s => vadd_set_mono interior_subset
  rw [openUnion, hopen.closure_iUnion]
  apply iUnion_congr
  intro s
  rw [closure_vadd]
  rw [show closure K.openCarrier = K.support from K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]

name: Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport
statement:
theorem openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {S : Set Plane}
    (hpacking : IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements S)) :
    openUnion K S =ᵐ[volume] regularSupport K S
proof:
:= by
  let P := genericProtoTiling K S
  let C : Set Tiling.Plane :=
    ⋃ i : P.placements, Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i.1
  have hU : openUnion K S =
      ⋃ i : P.placements, interior (Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i.1) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rw [openUnion, Set.mem_iUnion]
      rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      refine ⟨⟨(s.1, ()), s.2⟩, ?_⟩
      change x ∈ interior (s.1 +ᵥ K.support)
      rw [interior_vadd]
      exact hs
    · rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      rw [openUnion, Set.mem_iUnion]
      refine ⟨⟨i.1.1, i.2⟩, ?_⟩
      change x ∈ interior (i.1.1 +ᵥ K.support) at hi
      rw [interior_vadd] at hi
      exact hi
  have hC : C = ⋃ s : S, (s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨⟨i.1.1, i.2⟩, hi⟩
    · rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨⟨(s.1, ()), s.2⟩, hs⟩
  have hclosure : closure (openUnion K S) = C := by
    exact (closure_openUnion_eq_iUnion_support hpacking).trans hC.symm
  have hUC : openUnion K S ⊆ C := by
    rw [hU]
    exact iUnion_mono fun i ↦ interior_subset
  have hSCountable := (packing_centres_locallyFinite hpacking).2.1
  let _ : Countable P.placements :=
    (K.placements_countable hSCountable).to_subtype
  have hAE : openUnion K S =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] C := by
    rw [hU]
    exact Filter.EventuallyEq.countable_iUnion fun i ↦
      (P.isPolygonal_placedTile i.1).interior_ae_eq
  have hUInterior : openUnion K S ⊆ interior C := by
    have hUOpen : IsOpen (openUnion K S) := by
      rw [hU]
      exact isOpen_iUnion fun _ ↦ isOpen_interior
    rw [← hUOpen.interior_eq]
    exact interior_mono hUC
  rw [regularSupport, hclosure]
  filter_upwards [hAE] with x hx
  apply propext
  constructor
  · intro hxU
    exact hUInterior hxU
  · intro hxint
    rw [hx]
    exact (interior_subset : interior C ⊆ C) hxint

name: Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport_disjoint_of_disjoint_subfamilies
statement:
theorem regularSupport_disjoint_of_disjoint_subfamilies
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {T A B : Set Plane}
    (hp : IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements T))
    (hAT : A ⊆ T) (hBT : B ⊆ T) (hdisj : Disjoint A B) :
    Disjoint (regularSupport K A) (regularSupport K B)
proof:
:= by
  have hpackA : IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements A) :=
    fun _ hs _ ht hst => hp (hAT hs) (hAT ht) hst
  have hpackB : IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements B) :=
    fun _ hs _ ht hst => hp (hBT hs) (hBT ht) hst
  have hopenDisjoint : Disjoint (openUnion K A) (openUnion K B) := by
    rw [disjoint_left]
    intro x hxA hxB
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hxA
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hxB
    have hst : (s : Plane) ≠ (t : Plane) := by
      intro heq
      exact disjoint_left.mp hdisj s.2 (heq.symm ▸ t.2)
    exact disjoint_left.mp ((isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K T).mp hp
      (hAT s.2) (hBT t.2) hst) hs ht
  have hzero : volume (regularSupport K A ∩ regularSupport K B) = 0 := by
    apply measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
    filter_upwards [openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport hpackA,
      openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport hpackB] with x hxA hxB
    intro hx
    exact disjoint_left.mp hopenDisjoint (Eq.mpr hxA hx.1) (Eq.mpr hxB hx.2)
  rw [disjoint_left]
  intro x hxA hxB
  exact ((regularSupport_isRegularOpen K A).1.inter
    (regularSupport_isRegularOpen K B).1).measure_ne_zero volume ⟨x, hxA, hxB⟩ hzero

name: Tiling.Polygonal.tilesOn_regularSupport_of_packing
statement:
theorem tilesOn_regularSupport_of_packing
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {S : Set Plane}
    (hpacking : IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements S)) :
    TilesOn K S (regularSupport K S)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(packing_centres_locallyFinite hpacking).2.1, hpacking, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport hpacking] with x hx
  change (x ∈ openUnion K S) = (x ∈ regularSupport K S) at hx
  rw [← hx]
  exact mem_iUnion

name: Tiling.Polygonal.properVertexProvenance
statement:
theorem properVertexProvenance
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {S : Set Plane}
    (hpacking : IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements S)) :
    ∀ x ∈ properVertices (regularSupport K S),
      ∃ v ∈ vertexSet K.support, ∃ s ∈ S, x = v + s
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  let A := genericProtoTiling K S
  have hpack : Tiling.IsPacking A.prototiles A.placements := by
    intro i hi j hj hij
    apply hpacking
    · exact hi
    · exact hj
    · exact hij
  have hcarrier : A.placementCarrier Set.univ =
      closure (openUnion K S) := by
    rw [Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.placementCarrier]
    rw [closure_openUnion_eq_iUnion_support hpack]
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hz
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hz
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨⟨i.1.1.1, i.1.2⟩, hi⟩
    · intro hz
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hz
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hz
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      let i : A.placements := ⟨((s : Tiling.Plane), ()), s.2⟩
      refine ⟨⟨i, trivial⟩, ?_⟩
      exact hs
  have hfrontier_eq :
      frontier (A.placementCarrier Set.univ) =
        frontier (regularSupport K S) := by
    rw [regularSupport, ← hcarrier]
    simp [frontier, A.placementCarrier_closure_interior hpack Set.univ,
      (A.placementCarrier_isClosed hpack Set.univ).closure_eq]
  have hxfrontier : x ∈ frontier (A.placementCarrier Set.univ) := by
    rw [hfrontier_eq]
    exact hx.1
  have hxnotstraight : ¬Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt
      (A.placementCarrier Set.univ) x := by
    intro hstraight
    apply hx.2
    simpa only [Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt, hfrontier_eq] using hstraight
  obtain ⟨i, hiQ, hxi⟩ :=
    A.exists_vertex_of_not_boundaryLocallyStraightAt hpack Set.univ
      hxfrontier hxnotstraight
  have hcenterS : i.1.1 ∈ S := i.2
  have hplaced : x ∈ i.1.1 +ᵥ vertexSet K.support := by
    exact hxi
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvx⟩ := Set.mem_vadd_set.mp hplaced
  refine ⟨v, hv, i.1.1, hcenterS, ?_⟩
  simpa [vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hvx.symm

name: Tiling.Polygonal.frontier_eventuallyEq_of_eventuallyEq
statement:
theorem frontier_eventuallyEq_of_eventuallyEq
    {D E : Set Plane} {x : Plane} (hDE : D =ᶠ[𝓝 x] E) :
    frontier D =ᶠ[𝓝 x] frontier E
proof:
:= by
  have hnhds : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, D =ᶠ[𝓝 y] E := hDE.eventually_nhds
  filter_upwards [hnhds] with y hy
  apply propext
  have closureIff (A B : Set Tiling.Plane)
      (hAB : A =ᶠ[nhds y] B) :
      y ∈ closure A ↔ y ∈ closure B := by
    rw [mem_closure_iff_frequently, mem_closure_iff_frequently]
    constructor
    · intro hA
      exact (hA.and_eventually hAB).mono fun z hz ↦ Eq.mp hz.2 hz.1
    · intro hB
      exact (hB.and_eventually hAB).mono fun z hz ↦ Eq.mpr hz.2 hz.1
  have hyCompl : Dᶜ =ᶠ[nhds y] Eᶜ :=
    hy.mono fun z hz ↦ congrArg Not hz
  change y ∈ frontier D ↔ y ∈ frontier E
  rw [frontier_eq_closure_inter_closure,
    frontier_eq_closure_inter_closure, mem_inter_iff, mem_inter_iff,
    closureIff D E hy, closureIff Dᶜ Eᶜ hyCompl]

name: Tiling.Polygonal.isProperVertex_iff_of_eventuallyEq
statement:
theorem isProperVertex_iff_of_eventuallyEq
    {D E : Set Plane} {x : Plane} (hDE : D =ᶠ[𝓝 x] E) :
    IsProperVertex D x ↔ IsProperVertex E x
proof:
:= by
  have hfront := frontier_eventuallyEq_of_eventuallyEq hDE
  have hfrontx : x ∈ frontier D ↔ x ∈ frontier E :=
    Iff.of_eq hfront.self_of_nhds
  have hstraight :
      Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt D x ↔
        Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt E x := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨L, hxL, hdim, hline⟩
      refine ⟨L, hxL, hdim, ?_⟩
      filter_upwards [hfront, hline] with y hyfront hyline
      exact (Iff.of_eq hyfront).symm.trans hyline
    · rintro ⟨L, hxL, hdim, hline⟩
      refine ⟨L, hxL, hdim, ?_⟩
      filter_upwards [hfront, hline] with y hyfront hyline
      exact (Iff.of_eq hyfront).trans hyline
  exact and_congr hfrontx (not_congr hstraight)

name: Tiling.Polygonal.regularOpen_eq_of_aeEq
statement:
theorem regularOpen_eq_of_aeEq {D E : Set Plane}
    (hDopen : IsOpen D) (hDreg : interior (closure D) = D)
    (hEopen : IsOpen E) (hEreg : interior (closure E) = E)
    (hDE : D =ᵐ[volume] E) : D = E
proof:
:= by
  have closure_mono_of_ae {A B : Set Tiling.Plane}
      (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B)
      (hAB : A =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] B) : A ⊆ closure B := by
    intro x hxA
    by_contra hxB
    let W := A ∩ (closure B)ᶜ
    have hWopen : IsOpen W := hA.inter isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl
