    have hxW : x ∈ W := ⟨hxA, hxB⟩
    have hWzero : MeasureTheory.volume W = 0 :=
      measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr (hAB.mono fun y hy hyW ↦ by
        have hyB : y ∈ B := Eq.mp hy hyW.1
        exact hyW.2 (subset_closure hyB))
    exact hWopen.measure_ne_zero MeasureTheory.volume ⟨x, hxW⟩ hWzero
  have hclosure : closure D = closure E := Set.Subset.antisymm
    (closure_minimal (closure_mono_of_ae hDopen hEopen hDE) isClosed_closure)
    (closure_minimal (closure_mono_of_ae hEopen hDopen hDE.symm) isClosed_closure)
  calc
    D = interior (closure D) := hDreg.symm
    _ = interior (closure E) := congrArg interior hclosure
    _ = E := hEreg

name: Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn
statement:
theorem regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn
    {K : PolygonalRegion} {S D : Set Plane}
    (hopen : IsOpen D) (hregular : interior (closure D) = D)
    (htile : TilesOn K S D) : regularSupport K S = D
proof:
:= by
  have hAE : regularSupport K S =ᵐ[volume] D := by
    filter_upwards [openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport htile.2.1, htile.2.2] with x hx hu
    apply propext
    change (x ∈ openUnion K S) = (x ∈ regularSupport K S) at hx
    change x ∈ regularSupport K S ↔ x ∈ D
    rw [← hx]
    simpa only [openUnion, mem_iUnion] using hu.symm
  obtain ⟨hsopen, hsreg⟩ := regularSupport_isRegularOpen K S
  exact regularOpen_eq_of_aeEq hsopen hsreg hopen hregular hAE

name: Tiling.Polygonal.aePeriodGroup_eq_periodGroup_of_regularOpen
statement:
theorem aePeriodGroup_eq_periodGroup_of_regularOpen
    {S : Set Plane} (hopen : IsOpen S) (hregular : interior (closure S) = S) :
    aePeriodGroup S = periodGroup S
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  change (u +ᵥ S =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] S) ↔ u +ᵥ S = S
  constructor
  · intro hu
    apply regularOpen_eq_of_aeEq (hopen.vadd u) _ hopen hregular hu
    rw [closure_vadd, interior_vadd, hregular]
  · intro hu
    rw [hu]
    exact Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl

name: Tiling.Polygonal.isClosed_periodGroup_of_regularOpen
proof:
:= by
  have _hopen := hopen
  apply isClosed_of_closure_subset
  intro u hu
  have hfix {v : Plane} (hv : v ∈ periodGroup S) :
      v +ᵥ closure S = closure S := by
    change v +ᵥ S = S at hv
    rw [← closure_vadd, hv]
  have hmap (x : Plane) (hx : x ∈ closure S) :
      u + x ∈ closure S ∧ -u + x ∈ closure S := by
    constructor
    · have hf : Continuous (fun v : Plane => v + x) := continuous_id.add continuous_const
      apply closure_minimal (t := closure S) ?_ isClosed_closure
        (image_closure_subset_closure_image hf ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩)
      rintro y ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      rw [← hfix hv]
      exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    · have hf : Continuous (fun v : Plane => -v + x) := continuous_id.neg.add continuous_const
      apply closure_minimal (t := closure S) ?_ isClosed_closure
        (image_closure_subset_closure_image hf ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩)
      rintro y ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      rw [← hfix ((periodGroup S).neg_mem hv)]
      exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hc : u +ᵥ closure S = closure S := by
    apply Subset.antisymm
    · rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact (hmap x hx).1
    · intro x hx
      exact ⟨-u + x, (hmap x hx).2, by simp [vadd_eq_add]⟩
  change u +ᵥ S = S
  rw [← hregular, ← interior_vadd, hc]

name: Tiling.Polygonal.tilesOn_translate
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hset : u +ᵥ S = (fun s : Tiling.Plane ↦ u + s) '' S := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        exact ⟨-u + x, by
          simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using hx,
          by simp⟩
      · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
        simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
          neg_add_cancel_left] using hs
    rw [hset]
    exact htile.1.image _
  · intro i hi j hj hij
    let i₀ : Tiling.Placement Tiling.Plane Unit := (-u + i.1, ())
    let j₀ : Tiling.Placement Tiling.Plane Unit := (-u + j.1, ())
    have hi₀ : i₀ ∈ K.placements S := by
      change -u + i.1 ∈ S
      change i.1 ∈ u +ᵥ S at hi
      simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using hi
    have hj₀ : j₀ ∈ K.placements S := by
      change -u + j.1 ∈ S
      change j.1 ∈ u +ᵥ S at hj
      simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using hj
    have hij₀ : i₀ ≠ j₀ := by
      intro heq
      apply hij
      apply Prod.ext
      · have heq' := congrArg Prod.fst heq
        dsimp only [i₀, j₀] at heq'
        have := congrArg (fun z : Tiling.Plane ↦ u + z) heq'
        simpa only [add_assoc, add_neg_cancel_left] using this
      · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    have hd := htile.2.1 hi₀ hj₀ hij₀
    have hd' := Tiling.aedisjoint_vadd u hd
    have hiTile : u +ᵥ ((-u + i.1) +ᵥ K.support) = i.1 +ᵥ K.support := by
      rw [vadd_vadd]
      congr 1
      abel
    have hjTile : u +ᵥ ((-u + j.1) +ᵥ K.support) = j.1 +ᵥ K.support := by
      rw [vadd_vadd]
      congr 1
      abel
    change MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint MeasureTheory.volume
      (i.1 +ᵥ K.support) (j.1 +ᵥ K.support)
    rw [← hiTile, ← hjTile]
    exact hd'
  · have hpull :=
      (MeasureTheory.quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left MeasureTheory.volume (-u)).ae htile.2.2
    filter_upwards [hpull] with x hx
    have htarget : x ∈ u +ᵥ D ↔ -u + x ∈ D := by
      simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
    have hunion :
        (∃ s : u +ᵥ S, x ∈ ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)) ↔
          ∃ s : S, -u + x ∈ ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) := by
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨s, hsx⟩
        let s₀ : S := ⟨-u + s.1, by
          simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using s.2⟩
        refine ⟨s₀, ?_⟩
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hsx ⊢
        convert hsx using 1
        all_goals simp only [s₀, vadd_eq_add]
        all_goals abel
      · rintro ⟨s, hsx⟩
        let s' : u +ᵥ S := ⟨u + s.1, by
          simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
            neg_add_cancel_left] using s.2⟩
        refine ⟨s', ?_⟩
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hsx ⊢
        convert hsx using 1
        all_goals simp only [s', vadd_eq_add]
        all_goals abel
    exact htarget.trans (hx.trans hunion.symm)

name: Tiling.Polygonal.affineMap_injective
statement:
private theorem affineMap_injective (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (a : Plane) :
    Injective (affineMap A a)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  exact A.injective (add_left_cancel h)

name: Tiling.Polygonal.affineMap_vadd
statement:
private theorem affineMap_vadd (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (a u : Plane) (S : Set Plane) :
    affineMap A a '' (u +ᵥ S) = A u +ᵥ (affineMap A a '' S)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨affineMap A a z, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, by
      simp [affineMap, map_add, vadd_eq_add, add_left_comm]⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨u + z, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, by
      simp [affineMap, map_add, vadd_eq_add, add_left_comm]⟩

name: Tiling.Polygonal.affineMap_inverse
statement:
private theorem affineMap_inverse (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (a : Plane) (S : Set Plane) :
    affineMap A.symm (-A.symm a) '' (affineMap A a '' S) = S
proof:
:= by
  rw [image_image]
  have hfun : affineMap A.symm (-A.symm a) ∘ affineMap A a = id := by
    funext x
    simp [affineMap]
  change (affineMap A.symm (-A.symm a) ∘ affineMap A a) '' S = S
  rw [hfun, image_id]

name: Tiling.Polygonal.volume_affineImage_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem volume_affineImage_eq_zero_iff (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane)
    (a : Plane) (s : Set Plane) :
    volume (affineMap A a '' s) = 0 ↔ volume s = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_image_continuousLinearEquiv
    (μ := volume) A s
  change volume ((fun x : Plane => a + A x) '' s) = 0 ↔ volume s = 0
  rw [show (fun x : Plane => a + A x) = (fun y : Plane => a + y) ∘ A by rfl,
    Set.image_comp, image_add_left, measure_preimage_add, h]
  have hdet : ENNReal.ofReal |LinearMap.det (A : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] Plane)| ≠ 0 := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_ne_zero_iff]
    apply abs_pos.mpr
    intro hzero
    have hmul := LinearEquiv.det_mul_det_symm A.toLinearEquiv
    rw [hzero, zero_mul] at hmul
    norm_num at hmul
  simp [hdet]

name: Tiling.Polygonal.det_realPlane_formula
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix Complex.basisOneI, Matrix.det_fin_two]
  simp only [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Complex.coe_basisOneI, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    Complex.coe_basisOneI_repr]
  simp

name: Tiling.Polygonal.det_realPlane_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem det_realPlane_ne_zero (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) :
    LinearMap.det (A : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] Plane) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hmul := LinearEquiv.det_mul_det_symm A.toLinearEquiv
  rw [hzero, zero_mul] at hmul
  norm_num at hmul

name: Tiling.Polygonal.twiceSignedArea_linearImage
statement:
private theorem twiceSignedArea_linearImage (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane)
    (p q r : Plane) :
    Tiling.twiceSignedArea (A p) (A q) (A r) =
      LinearMap.det (A : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] Plane) * Tiling.twiceSignedArea p q r
proof:
:= by
  have hA (z : Plane) : A z = z.re • A 1 + z.im • A Complex.I := by
    have hz : z = z.re • (1 : Plane) + z.im • Complex.I := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp
    calc
      A z = A (z.re • (1 : Plane) + z.im • Complex.I) := congrArg A hz
      _ = z.re • A 1 + z.im • A Complex.I := by rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
  have hq : A q - A p = (q.re - p.re) • A 1 + (q.im - p.im) • A Complex.I := by
    calc
      A q - A p = A (q - p) := (map_sub A q p).symm
      _ = (q.re - p.re) • A 1 + (q.im - p.im) • A Complex.I := by
        rw [hA]
        simp
  have hr : A r - A p = (r.re - p.re) • A 1 + (r.im - p.im) • A Complex.I := by
    calc
      A r - A p = A (r - p) := (map_sub A r p).symm
      _ = (r.re - p.re) • A 1 + (r.im - p.im) • A Complex.I := by
        rw [hA]
        simp
  have hqre : (A q).re - (A p).re =
      (q.re - p.re) * (A 1).re + (q.im - p.im) * (A Complex.I).re := by
    simpa only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul] using
      congrArg Complex.re hq
  have hqim : (A q).im - (A p).im =
      (q.re - p.re) * (A 1).im + (q.im - p.im) * (A Complex.I).im := by
    simpa only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul] using
      congrArg Complex.im hq
  have hrre : (A r).re - (A p).re =
      (r.re - p.re) * (A 1).re + (r.im - p.im) * (A Complex.I).re := by
    simpa only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul] using
      congrArg Complex.re hr
  have hrim : (A r).im - (A p).im =
      (r.re - p.re) * (A 1).im + (r.im - p.im) * (A Complex.I).im := by
    simpa only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul] using
      congrArg Complex.im hr
  rw [Tiling.twiceSignedArea, Tiling.twiceSignedArea]
  rw [hqre, hqim, hrre, hrim]
  rw [det_realPlane_formula]
  ring

name: Tiling.Polygonal.affineMap_ae_iff
statement:
private theorem affineMap_ae_iff (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (a : Plane) (p : Plane → Prop) :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂volume, p (affineMap A a x)) ↔ ∀ᵐ y ∂volume, p y
proof:
:= by
  rw [ae_iff, ae_iff, ← volume_affineImage_eq_zero_iff A a]
  change volume (affineMap A a '' (affineMap A a ⁻¹' {y | ¬p y})) = 0 ↔ _
  let h : Plane ≃ₜ Plane := A.toHomeomorph.trans (Homeomorph.addLeft a)
  change volume (h '' (h ⁻¹' {y | ¬p y})) = 0 ↔ _
  rw [image_preimage_eq _ h.surjective]

name: Tiling.Polygonal.isPolygonal_affineImage
statement:
theorem isPolygonal_affineImage {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsPolygonal s)
    (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (a : Plane) :
    IsPolygonal (affineMap A a '' s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨mappedTriangulation T A a⟩

name: Tiling.Polygonal.affineImage_openCarrier
statement:
theorem affineImage_openCarrier (K : PolygonalRegion) (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane)
    (a : Plane) :
    (affineImage K A a).openCarrier = affineMap A a '' K.openCarrier

name: Tiling.Polygonal.extremePoints_vadd
statement:
private theorem extremePoints_vadd (a : Plane) (s : Set Plane) :
    (a +ᵥ s).extremePoints ℝ = a +ᵥ s.extremePoints ℝ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_extremePoints_iff_left, mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem,
    mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, mem_extremePoints_iff_left]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxs, hxext⟩
    refine ⟨hxs, ?_⟩
    intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ hseg
    have hseg' : x ∈ openSegment ℝ (a +ᵥ y₁) (a +ᵥ y₂) := by
      rw [← vadd_openSegment ℝ]
      exact ⟨-a +ᵥ x, hseg, by simp⟩
    have heq := hxext (a +ᵥ y₁)
      (by simpa only [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, neg_vadd_vadd] using hy₁)
      (a +ᵥ y₂)
      (by simpa only [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, neg_vadd_vadd] using hy₂) hseg'
    exact vadd_left_cancel a (heq.trans (vadd_neg_vadd a x).symm)
  · rintro ⟨hxs, hxext⟩
    refine ⟨hxs, ?_⟩
    intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ hseg
    have hz₁' : -a +ᵥ z₁ ∈ s := by
      simpa only [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] using hz₁
    have hz₂' : -a +ᵥ z₂ ∈ s := by
      simpa only [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] using hz₂
    have hseg' : -a +ᵥ x ∈ openSegment ℝ (-a +ᵥ z₁) (-a +ᵥ z₂) := by
      rw [← vadd_openSegment ℝ]
      exact ⟨x, hseg, by simp⟩
    have heq := hxext (-a +ᵥ z₁) hz₁' (-a +ᵥ z₂) hz₂' hseg'
    exact vadd_left_cancel (-a) heq

name: Tiling.Polygonal.affineMap_image
statement:
private theorem affineMap_image (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (a : Plane) (s : Set Plane) :
    affineMap A a '' s = a +ᵥ (A '' s)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨A y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.Polygonal.extremePoints_affineImage
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineMap_image, extremePoints_vadd, ← image_extremePoints A, affineMap_image]

name: Tiling.Polygonal.vertexSet_affineImage
statement:
theorem vertexSet_affineImage (K : PolygonalRegion) (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane)
    (a : Plane) :
    vertexSet (affineImage K A a).support = affineMap A a '' vertexSet K.support
proof:
:= by
  have forward (B : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (b : Plane) (s : Set Plane) :
      vertexSet (affineMap B b '' s) ⊆ affineMap B b '' vertexSet s := by
    intro x hx
    let h : Plane ≃ₜ Plane := B.toHomeomorph.trans (Homeomorph.addLeft b)
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := h.surjective x
    refine ⟨y, ?_, rfl⟩
    change ∀ T : Triangulation s, ∃ t ∈ T.pieces, y ∈ t.extremePoints ℝ
    intro T
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := hx (mappedTriangulation T B b)
    simp only [mappedTriangulation, Finset.mem_image] at ht
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := ht
    refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
    rw [extremePoints_affineImage] at hxt
    exact (affineMap_injective B b).mem_set_image.mp hxt
  apply Subset.antisymm
  · exact forward A a K.support
  · rintro x ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have hi := forward A.symm (-A.symm a) (affineMap A a '' K.support)
    rw [affineMap_inverse] at hi
    obtain ⟨z, hz, heq⟩ := hi hy
    have hpoint : affineMap A a y = z := by
      rw [← heq]
      simp [affineMap]
    rwa [hpoint]

name: Tiling.Polygonal.boundaryLocallyStraightAt_affineImage_iff
statement:
theorem boundaryLocallyStraightAt_affineImage_iff
    (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (a : Plane) (D : Set Plane) (x : Plane) :
    BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (affineMap A a '' D) (affineMap A a x) ↔
      BoundaryLocallyStraightAt D x
proof:
:= by
  have forward (B : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (b : Plane) (E : Set Plane) (y : Plane)
      (hs : BoundaryLocallyStraightAt E y) :
      BoundaryLocallyStraightAt (affineMap B b '' E) (affineMap B b y) := by
    obtain ⟨L, hy, hdim, hlocal⟩ := hs
    let f : Plane ≃ᵃ[ℝ] Plane :=
      B.toLinearEquiv.toAffineEquiv.trans (AffineEquiv.constVAdd ℝ Plane b)
    let h : Plane ≃ₜ Plane := B.toHomeomorph.trans (Homeomorph.addLeft b)
    refine ⟨L.map f.toAffineMap, AffineSubspace.mem_map_of_mem f.toAffineMap hy, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [AffineSubspace.map_direction]
      change Module.finrank ℝ (L.direction.map B.toLinearMap) = 1
      rw [B.toLinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq, hdim]
    · have ht : Tendsto h.symm (𝓝 (h y)) (𝓝 y) := by
        simpa only [h.symm_apply_apply] using h.symm.continuous.tendsto (h y)
      have hevent := ht.eventually hlocal
      filter_upwards [hevent] with z hz
      have hzfront : z ∈ frontier (affineMap B b '' E) ↔ h.symm z ∈ frontier E := by
        change z ∈ frontier (h '' E) ↔ h.symm z ∈ frontier E
        rw [← h.image_frontier, h.image_eq_preimage_symm]
        rfl
      have hzL : z ∈ L.map f.toAffineMap ↔ h.symm z ∈ L := by
        change z ∈ f '' (L : Set Plane) ↔ h.symm z ∈ L
        change z ∈ h '' (L : Set Plane) ↔ h.symm z ∈ L
        rw [h.image_eq_preimage_symm]
        rfl
      exact hzfront.trans (hz.trans hzL.symm)
  constructor
  · intro hs
    have hi := forward A.symm (-A.symm a) _ _ hs
    rw [affineMap_inverse] at hi
    simpa [affineMap] using hi
  · exact forward A a D x

name: Tiling.Polygonal.tilesOn_affineImage_iff
statement:
theorem tilesOn_affineImage_iff
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (a : Plane) (S D : Set Plane) :
    TilesOn (affineImage K A a) (A '' S) (affineMap A a '' D) ↔
      TilesOn K S D
proof:
:= by
  have tileOpen (L : PolygonalRegion) (B : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (b v : Plane) :
      B v +ᵥ (affineImage L B b).openCarrier =
        affineMap B b '' (v +ᵥ L.openCarrier) := by
    rw [affineImage_openCarrier, affineMap_vadd]
  have forward (L : PolygonalRegion) (B : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (b : Plane)
      (T E : Set Plane) (hT : TilesOn L T E) :
      TilesOn (affineImage L B b) (B '' T) (affineMap B b '' E) := by
    refine ⟨hT.1.image B, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint _ _).mpr
      rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ hvw
      rw [tileOpen, tileOpen]
      apply disjoint_image_of_injective (affineMap_injective B b)
      exact (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint L T).mp hT.2.1 hv hw
        (fun h => hvw (congrArg B h))
    · apply (affineMap_ae_iff B b _).mp
      filter_upwards [hT.2.2] with x hx
      rw [(affineMap_injective B b).mem_set_image]
      have hunion :
          (∃ t : B '' T, affineMap B b x ∈
            (t : Plane) +ᵥ (affineImage L B b).openCarrier) ↔
          ∃ v : T, x ∈ (v : Plane) +ᵥ L.openCarrier := by
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
          obtain ⟨v, hv, heq⟩ := t.2
          have ht' : affineMap B b x ∈ B v +ᵥ (affineImage L B b).openCarrier :=
            heq.symm ▸ ht
          rw [tileOpen, (affineMap_injective B b).mem_set_image] at ht'
          exact ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, ht'⟩
        · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
          refine ⟨⟨B v, ⟨v, v.2, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
          change affineMap B b x ∈ B v +ᵥ (affineImage L B b).openCarrier
          rw [tileOpen, (affineMap_injective B b).mem_set_image]
          exact hv
      exact hx.trans hunion.symm
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hi := forward (affineImage K A a) A.symm (-A.symm a)
      (A '' S) (affineMap A a '' D) h
    have hk : affineImage (affineImage K A a) A.symm (-A.symm a) = K := by
      have hs : (affineImage (affineImage K A a) A.symm (-A.symm a)).support =
          K.support := affineMap_inverse A a K.support
      exact polygonalRegion_eq_of_support_eq hs
    rw [hk, affineMap_inverse] at hi
    simpa only [image_image, A.symm_apply_apply, image_id'] using hi
  · exact forward K A a S D

name: Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC.linearImage_iff
statement:
theorem HasFLC.linearImage_iff (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (S : Set Plane) :
    HasFLC (A '' S) ↔ HasFLC S
proof:
:= by
  have forward (B : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) {T : Set Plane} (hT : HasFLC T) :
      HasFLC (B '' T) := by
    have localImage {U : Set Plane}
        (hU : ∀ Q : Set Plane, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (U ∩ Q).Finite) :
        ∀ Q : Set Plane, Bornology.IsBounded Q → ((B '' U) ∩ Q).Finite := by
      intro Q hQ
      have hf := hU (B.symm '' Q) (B.symm.lipschitz.isBounded_image hQ)
      apply (hf.image B).subset
      rintro x ⟨⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hQy⟩
      exact ⟨y, ⟨hy, ⟨B y, hQy, B.symm_apply_apply y⟩⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨localImage hT.1, ?_⟩
    have hdiff : ∀ Q : Set Plane, Bornology.IsBounded Q → ((T - T) ∩ Q).Finite := by
      intro Q hQ
      obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hQ.subset_closedBall (0 : Plane)
      exact (hT.2 (max R 1) (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right R 1))).subset
        (inter_subset_inter_right _ (hR.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall
          (le_max_left R 1))))
    have heq : B '' (T - T) = (B '' T) - (B '' T) := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, ⟨v, hv, w, hw, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨B v, ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩, B w, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, (map_sub B v w).symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨y, ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩, z, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨v - w, ⟨v, hv, w, hw, rfl⟩, map_sub B v w⟩
    intro R _
    rw [← heq]
    exact localImage hdiff _ Metric.isBounded_closedBall
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := forward A.symm h
    simpa only [image_image, A.symm_apply_apply, image_id'] using this
  · exact forward A

name: Tiling.Polygonal.periodGroup_affineImage
statement:
theorem periodGroup_affineImage (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (a : Plane)
    (S : Set Plane) :
    periodGroup (affineMap A a '' S) =
      (periodGroup S).map A.toLinearEquiv.toAddEquiv.toAddMonoidHom
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := A.surjective u
  change (A v +ᵥ (affineMap A a '' S) = affineMap A a '' S) ↔
    ∃ w, w ∈ periodGroup S ∧ A w = A v
  rw [← affineMap_vadd]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨v, (affineMap_injective A a).image_injective h, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, h⟩
    have := A.injective h
    subst w
    change v +ᵥ S = S at hw
    rw [hw]

name: Tiling.Polygonal.isLatticePeriodic_affineImage_iff
statement:
theorem isLatticePeriodic_affineImage_iff (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (a : Plane)
    (S : Set Plane) :
    IsLatticePeriodic (affineMap A a '' S) ↔ IsLatticePeriodic S
proof:
:= by
  have forward (B : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (b : Plane) {T : Set Plane}
      (hT : IsLatticePeriodic T) : IsLatticePeriodic (affineMap B b '' T) := by
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hT
    let M : PlanarLattice := ⟨B ∘ L.basis,
      L.independent.map' B.toLinearMap (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr B.injective)⟩
    refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
    have hm : M.toAddSubgroup = L.toAddSubgroup.map
        B.toLinearEquiv.toAddEquiv.toAddMonoidHom := by
      unfold PlanarLattice.toAddSubgroup
      rw [AddMonoidHom.map_closure, ← range_comp]
      rfl
    rw [hm, periodGroup_affineImage]
    rintro x ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y, hL hy, rfl⟩
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := forward A.symm (-A.symm a) h
    rwa [affineMap_inverse] at this
  · exact forward A a

name: Tiling.Polygonal.weaklyPeriodic_affineImage_iff
statement:
theorem weaklyPeriodic_affineImage_iff (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (a : Plane)
    (S : Set Plane) :
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.WeaklyPeriodic (affineMap A a '' S) ↔
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.WeaklyPeriodic S
proof:
:= by
  have forward (B : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane) (b : Plane) {T : Set Plane}
      (hT : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.WeaklyPeriodic T) :
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.WeaklyPeriodic (affineMap B b '' T) := by
    obtain ⟨D⟩ := hT
    refine ⟨{
      numberOfParts := D.numberOfParts
      part := fun i => affineMap B b '' D.part i
      period := fun i => B (D.period i)
      period_ne_zero := fun i hz => D.period_ne_zero i (B.injective (by simpa using hz))
      periodic_part := ?_
      pairwiseDisjoint := ?_
      iUnion_parts := ?_ }⟩
    · intro i x
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (Homeomorph.addLeft b).surjective x
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := B.surjective y
      have hmem (w : Plane) : affineMap B b w ∈ affineMap B b '' D.part i ↔
          w ∈ D.part i := (affineMap_injective B b).mem_set_image
      change b + B z + B (D.period i) ∈ affineMap B b '' D.part i ↔
        b + B z ∈ affineMap B b '' D.part i
      rw [show b + B z + B (D.period i) = affineMap B b (z + D.period i) by
        simp [affineMap, map_add, add_assoc]]
      exact (hmem _).trans ((D.periodic_part i z).trans (hmem _).symm)
    · intro i _ j _ hij
      change Disjoint (affineMap B b '' D.part i) (affineMap B b '' D.part j)
      rw [disjoint_left]
      rintro x ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ ⟨z, hz, heq⟩
      have heq' := affineMap_injective B b heq
      subst z
      exact disjoint_left.mp (D.pairwiseDisjoint (mem_univ i) (mem_univ j) hij) hy hz
    · rw [← image_iUnion, D.iUnion_parts]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := forward A.symm (-A.symm a) h
    rwa [affineMap_inverse] at this
  · exact forward A a

name: Tiling.Polygonal.exists_tile_frontier_of_mem_frontier_regularSupport
proof:
:= by
  have hop : IsOpen (openUnion K S) := by
    apply isOpen_iUnion
    intro t
    exact (Homeomorph.addLeft (t : Plane)).isOpenMap _ isOpen_interior
  have hsub : openUnion K S ⊆ regularSupport K S :=
    interior_maximal subset_closure hop
  have hxcl := frontier_subset_closure hx
  change x ∈ closure (interior (closure (openUnion K S))) at hxcl
  have hxcl' := closure_mono (s := interior (closure (openUnion K S)))
    (t := closure (openUnion K S)) interior_subset hxcl
  rw [closure_closure, closure_openUnion_eq_iUnion_support hp] at hxcl'
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxcl'
  have hxnot : x ∉ regularSupport K S := by
    exact fun h => Set.disjoint_left.mp disjoint_interior_frontier
      (by simpa only [regularSupport, interior_interior] using h) hx
  have hxs : x - (s : Plane) ∈ K.support := by
    simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hs
  refine ⟨s, s.2, K.isPolygonal.isClosed.frontier_eq ▸ ⟨hxs, ?_⟩⟩
  intro hi
  apply hxnot
  apply hsub
  apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨x - (s : Plane), hi, ?_⟩
  simp [vadd_eq_add]

name: Tiling.Polygonal.frontierLevel_segmentTwoPoints
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image ℝ] at hx hy
  obtain ⟨s, _, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨t, _, rfl⟩ := hy
  have hst : s ≠ t := by
    intro he
    exact hxy (by rw [he])
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hπx hπy
  have he : (s - t) * (π b - π a) = 0 := by nlinarith
  have hab : π b = π a := sub_eq_zero.mp
    ((mul_eq_zero.mp he).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hst))
  rw [hab] at hπx
  have ha : π a = c := by nlinarith
  exact ⟨ha, hab.trans ha⟩

name: Tiling.Polygonal.frontierLevel_segmentFinite
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subsingleton.finite
  intro x hx y hy
  by_contra hxy
  exact h (frontierLevel_segmentTwoPoints π c hx.1 hy.1 hx.2 hy.2 hxy)

name: Tiling.Polygonal.frontierLevel_finiteCoverCoincident
statement:
private theorem frontierLevel_finiteCoverCoincident (π : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (F : Finset (Plane × Plane)) {C : Set Plane} (hC : C.Infinite)
    (hlevel : C ⊆ {x | π x = c})
    (hcover : C ⊆ ⋃ e ∈ F, segment ℝ e.1 e.2) :
    ∃ e ∈ F, π e.1 = c ∧ π e.2 = c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hf : (⋃ e ∈ F, segment ℝ e.1 e.2 ∩ {x | π x = c}).Finite :=
    F.finite_toSet.biUnion fun e he => frontierLevel_segmentFinite π c e.1 e.2
      (by intro hh; exact h e he hh.1 hh.2)
  apply hC
  apply hf.subset
  intro x hx
  have hh := hcover hx
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hh
  obtain ⟨e, heF, hseg⟩ := hh
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨heF, ⟨hseg, hlevel hx⟩⟩⟩

name: Tiling.Polygonal.frontierLevel_has_intrinsicVertex_of_supportBound
statement:
theorem frontierLevel_has_intrinsicVertex_of_supportBound
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (S : Set Plane)
    (hp : IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements S))
    (π : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (e : Plane) (he : e ≠ 0) (hπe : π e = 0)
    (B : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ z ∈ K.support, ‖z‖ ≤ B) :
    ∀ x : Plane,
      ({y | π y = π x} ⊆ frontier (regularSupport K S)) →
        ∃ v q : Plane, v ∈ vertexSet K.support ∧ q ∈ S ∧
          π (v + q) = π x ∧ dist q x ≤ B + ‖e‖ + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hfront⟩ := K.isPolygonal.exists_finite_intrinsic_boundarySegments
  let R : ℝ := B + ‖e‖ + 1
  intro x hline
  let Q : Set Plane := S ∩ Metric.closedBall x R
  have hQ : Q.Finite := (packing_centres_locallyFinite hp).1 _ Metric.isBounded_closedBall
  let H : Finset (Plane × Plane) :=
    (hQ.toFinset ×ˢ F).image (fun q => (q.1 + q.2.1, q.1 + q.2.2))
  let C : Set Plane := (fun t : ℝ => x + t • e) '' Set.Icc 0 1
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun t : ℝ => x + t • e) := by
    intro s t hst
    exact smul_left_injective ℝ he (add_left_cancel hst)
  have hC : C.Infinite :=
    Set.Icc_infinite (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num) |>.image hinj.injOn
  have hlevel : C ⊆ {y | π y = π x} := by
    rintro y ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    change π (x + t • e) = π x
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, hπe, smul_zero, add_zero]
  have hcover : C ⊆ ⋃ q ∈ H, segment ℝ q.1 q.2 := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hy
    have hdist : dist (x + t • e) x ≤ ‖e‖ := by
      simp only [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg e) ht.2
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsb⟩ := exists_tile_frontier_of_mem_frontier_regularSupport K hp
      (hline (hlevel ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩))
    have hsbSupport := K.isPolygonal.isClosed.frontier_subset hsb
    have hdistys : dist (x + t • e) s ≤ B := by
      simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hbound _ hsbSupport
    have hsQ : s ∈ Q := by
      refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
      change dist s x ≤ R
      have hd := dist_triangle s (x + t • e) x
      rw [dist_comm s (x + t • e)] at hd
      dsimp [R]
      linarith
    rw [hfront] at hsb
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hsb
    obtain ⟨hqF, hseg⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hq
    have hqH : (s + q.1, s + q.2) ∈ H := by
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(s, q), Finset.mem_product.mpr
        ⟨hQ.mem_toFinset.mpr hsQ, hqF⟩, rfl⟩
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨(s + q.1, s + q.2), Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hqH, ?_⟩⟩
    have hh := (mem_segment_translate ℝ s).mpr hseg
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using hh
  obtain ⟨q, hqH, hqπ⟩ := frontierLevel_finiteCoverCoincident π (π x) H hC hlevel hcover
  obtain ⟨⟨s, p⟩, hpH, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hqH
  obtain ⟨hsQ, hpF⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hpH
  have hs := hQ.mem_toFinset.mp hsQ
  have hpV := (hF p hpF).2.1
  have hpSupport : p.1 ∈ K.support := K.isPolygonal.isClosed.frontier_subset
    ((hF p hpF).2.2.2 (left_mem_segment ℝ p.1 p.2))
  refine ⟨p.1, s, hpV, hs.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [add_comm] using hqπ.1
  · exact Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hs.2

name: Tiling.Polygonal.frontierLevel_has_bounded_intrinsicVertex
statement:
theorem frontierLevel_has_bounded_intrinsicVertex
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (S : Set Plane)
    (hp : IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements S))
    (π : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (e : Plane) (he : e ≠ 0) (hπe : π e = 0) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x : Plane,
      ({y | π y = π x} ⊆ frontier (regularSupport K S)) →
        ∃ v q : Plane, v ∈ vertexSet K.support ∧ q ∈ S ∧
          π (v + q) = π x ∧ dist q x ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hbound⟩ := K.isPolygonal.isCompact.isBounded.exists_pos_norm_le
  exact ⟨B + ‖e‖ + 1, by positivity,
    frontierLevel_has_intrinsicVertex_of_supportBound K S hp π e he hπe B hbound⟩

name: Tiling.Polygonal.hasPatchFLC_iff_hasFLC
statement:
theorem hasPatchFLC_iff_hasFLC
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E] {S : Set E}
    (hlocal : ∀ Q : Set E, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (S ∩ Q).Finite) :
    HasPatchFLC S ↔ HasFLC S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hpatch
    refine ⟨hlocal, ?_⟩
    intro R hR
    let Q : Set E := Metric.ball 0 (R + 1)
    let P : Set (Set E) := Set.range fun s : S => ((-(s : E)) +ᵥ S) ∩ Q
    have hP : P.Finite := hpatch Q Metric.isOpen_ball Metric.isBounded_ball
    have heach : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Finite := by
      rintro p ⟨s, rfl⟩
      have hfin := hlocal ((s : E) +ᵥ Q) (Metric.isBounded_ball.vadd (s : E))
      apply (hfin.image fun x => -(s : E) + x).subset
      rintro x ⟨⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hxQ⟩
      refine ⟨y, ⟨hy, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨-(s : E) +ᵥ y, hxQ, by simp [vadd_eq_add]⟩
    apply (hP.sUnion heach).subset
    rintro x ⟨⟨s, hs, t, ht, rfl⟩, hball⟩
    refine Set.mem_sUnion.mpr ⟨((-(t : E)) +ᵥ S) ∩ Q,
      ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨⟨s, hs, by simp [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]⟩, ?_⟩
    exact Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) hball
  · intro hS Q _hQopen hQ
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hQ.subset_closedBall (0 : E)
    let R' := max R 0 + 1
    have hR' : 0 < R' := by dsimp [R']; linarith [le_max_right R 0]
    let D := (S - S) ∩ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R'
    have hD : D.Finite := hS.2 R' hR'
    apply hD.finite_subsets.subset
    rintro p ⟨s, rfl⟩ x ⟨hxS, hxQ⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hxS
    refine ⟨⟨t, ht, s, s.2, by simp [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]⟩, ?_⟩
    exact Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by
      dsimp [R']; linarith [le_max_left R 0]) (hR hxQ)

name: Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC.vadd
statement:
theorem HasFLC.vadd
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    {S : Set E} (hS : HasFLC S) (u : E) : HasFLC (u +ᵥ S)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro Q hQ
    have hfinite := hS.1 ((-u) +ᵥ Q) (hQ.vadd (-u))
    apply (hfinite.image fun s ↦ u + s).subset
    rintro x ⟨hxS, hxQ⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hxS
    refine ⟨s, ⟨hs, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simpa [vadd_eq_add] using hxQ
  · have hdif : (u +ᵥ S) - (u +ᵥ S) = S - S := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨a, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, b, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨s, hs, t, ht, by
          change s - t = (u + s) - (u + t)
          abel⟩
      · rintro ⟨s, hs, t, ht, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨u + s, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, u + t, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, by
          change (u + s) - (u + t) = s - t
          abel⟩
    rw [hdif]
    exact hS.2

name: Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC.mono
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun Q hQ => (hT.1 Q hQ).subset (Set.inter_subset_inter_left Q hST), ?_⟩
  intro R hR
  exact (hT.2 R hR).subset (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ (Set.sub_subset_sub hST hST))

name: Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC.differences_locallyFinite
statement:
theorem HasFLC.differences_locallyFinite
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    {S : Set E} (hS : HasFLC S) :
    ∀ Q : Set E, Bornology.IsBounded Q → ((S - S) ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQ
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hQ.subset_closedBall (0 : E)
  let R' := max R 0 + 1
  have hR' : 0 < R' := by dsimp [R']; linarith [le_max_right R 0]
  apply (hS.2 R' hR').subset
  exact inter_subset_inter_right _
    (hR.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by
      dsimp [R']
      linarith [le_max_left R 0])))

name: Tiling.Polygonal.finite_inter_add_finset
statement:
private theorem finite_inter_add_finset
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    {A : Set E}
    (hA : ∀ Q : Set E, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (A ∩ Q).Finite)
    (F : Finset E) (Q : Set E) (hQ : Bornology.IsBounded Q) :
    ((A + (F : Set E)) ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hadd : A + (F : Set E) = ⋃ f : (F : Set E), (f : E) +ᵥ A := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, f, hf, rfl⟩
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, a, ha, by simp [vadd_eq_add, add_comm]⟩
    · rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      rintro ⟨f, a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨a, ha, f, f.2, by simp [vadd_eq_add, add_comm]⟩
  rw [hadd, iUnion_inter]
  apply Set.finite_iUnion
  intro f
  have hfinite := hA ((-(f : E)) +ᵥ Q) (hQ.vadd (-(f : E)))
  apply (hfinite.image fun a ↦ (f : E) + a).subset
  rintro x ⟨⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, hxaQ⟩
  refine ⟨a, ⟨ha, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  simpa [vadd_eq_add] using hxaQ

name: Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC.add_finset
statement:
theorem HasFLC.add_finset
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    {S : Set E} (hS : HasFLC S) (F : Finset E) :
    HasFLC (S + (F : Set E))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun Q hQ ↦ finite_inter_add_finset hS.1 F Q hQ, ?_⟩
  intro R hR
  let G : Finset E := F.image₂ (· - ·) F
  have hsubset :
      (S + (F : Set E)) - (S + (F : Set E)) ⊆ (S - S) + (G : Set E) := by
    rintro x ⟨a, ⟨s, hs, f, hf, rfl⟩, b, ⟨t, ht, g, hg, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨s - t, ⟨s, hs, t, ht, rfl⟩, f - g, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_image₂.mpr ⟨f, hf, g, hg, rfl⟩
    · change (s - t) + (f - g) = (s + f) - (t + g)
      abel
  apply (finite_inter_add_finset
    (hS.differences_locallyFinite) G (Metric.closedBall 0 R)
      Metric.isBounded_closedBall).subset
  exact inter_subset_inter_left _ hsubset

name: Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC.uniformlyDiscrete
statement:
theorem HasFLC.uniformlyDiscrete
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    {S : Set E} (hS : HasFLC S) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ S.Pairwise (fun s t => δ ≤ dist s t)
proof:
:= by
  let D : Set E := ((S - S) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 1) \ {0}
  have hDfinite : D.Finite := (hS.2 1 one_pos).subset sdiff_subset
  have h0D : (0 : E) ∉ D := by simp [D]
  have hnhds : Dᶜ ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E) :=
    hDfinite.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds h0D
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnhds
  let δ := min r 1
  have hδ : 0 < δ := lt_min hr one_pos
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro s hs t ht hst
  by_contra hdist
  have hdist_lt : dist s t < δ := lt_of_not_ge hdist
  let d := s - t
  have hdne : d ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hst
  have hdmem : d ∈ S - S := ⟨s, hs, t, ht, rfl⟩
  have hdnorm : ‖d‖ = dist s t := by simp [d, dist_eq_norm]
  have hdclosed : d ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) 1 := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, hdnorm]
    exact hdist_lt.le.trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hdD : d ∈ D := ⟨⟨hdmem, hdclosed⟩, by simpa using hdne⟩
  have hdball : d ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hdnorm]
    exact hdist_lt.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  exact (hball hdball) hdD

name: Tiling.Polygonal.rankTwo_of_flcCoset_and_independentRationalImages
statement:
theorem rankTwo_of_flcCoset_and_independentRationalImages
    {P V : Set Plane} {lambda gamma : Plane} (hP : HasFLC P) (hV : V.Finite)
    (f : Plane →ₗ[ℚ] Plane) (hfind : LinearIndependent ℚ ![f lambda, f gamma])
    (hcoset : ∃ v : Plane,
      {x : Plane | ∃ m n : ℤ, x = v + m • lambda + n • gamma} ⊆ V + P) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ ![lambda, gamma]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hQ : HasFLC (V + P) := by
    simpa [hV.coe_toFinset, add_comm] using hP.add_finset hV.toFinset
  obtain ⟨delta, hdelta, hsep⟩ := hQ.uniformlyDiscrete
  have hlambda : lambda ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hfzero : f lambda = 0 := by simp [hzero]
    have hbad := hfind.eq_zero_of_pair (s := (1 : ℚ)) (t := (0 : ℚ))
      (by simp [hfzero])
    exact one_ne_zero hbad.1
  by_contra hli
  have hrel_data : ∃ (a b : ℝ),
      (a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) ∧ a • lambda + b • gamma = 0 := by
    have hdep : ∃ g : Fin 2 → ℝ,
        (∑ i, g i • ![lambda, gamma] i = 0) ∧ ∃ i, g i ≠ 0 :=
      (Fintype.not_linearIndependent_iff (v := ![lambda, gamma])).mp hli
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hgzero⟩ := hdep
    have hrel' : g 0 • lambda + g 1 • gamma = 0 := by
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two] using hg
    have hab' : g 0 ≠ 0 ∨ g 1 ≠ 0 := by
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hgzero
      fin_cases i
      · exact Or.inl hi
      · exact Or.inr hi
    exact ⟨g 0, g 1, hab', hrel'⟩
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hrel⟩ := hrel_data
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hb
    have hal : a • lambda = 0 := by simpa [hb] using hrel
    have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
      intro ha
      exact hab.elim (fun h => h ha) (fun h => h hb)
    exact hlambda ((smul_eq_zero.mp hal).resolve_left ha)
  let r : ℝ := -a / b
  have hratio : gamma = r • lambda := by
    have hbg : b • gamma = -(a • lambda) :=
      eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (by simpa [add_comm] using hrel)
    calc
      gamma = (1 : ℝ) • gamma := by simp
      _ = (b⁻¹ * b) • gamma := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hb]
      _ = b⁻¹ • (b • gamma) := by rw [mul_smul]
      _ = b⁻¹ • (-(a • lambda)) := by rw [hbg]
      _ = r • lambda := by
        dsimp [r]
        simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_comm]
  have hri : Irrational r := by
    rw [irrational_iff_ne_rational]
    intro a b hb hq
    let q : ℚ := a / b
    have hqreal : r = (q : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [q]
      simpa using hq
    have hqrel : gamma = q • lambda := by
      calc
        gamma = r • lambda := hratio
        _ = (q : ℝ) • lambda := by rw [hqreal]
        _ = q • lambda := Rat.cast_smul_eq_qsmul ℝ q lambda
    have hfq : f gamma = (q : ℚ) • f lambda := by
      rw [hqrel, map_smul]
    have hzero : (q : ℚ) • f lambda + (-1 : ℚ) • f gamma = 0 := by
      rw [hfq]
      module
    have hbad := hfind.eq_zero_of_pair hzero
    norm_num at hbad
  have hnormlambda : 0 < ‖lambda‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hlambda
  
  have hdense : Dense (AddSubgroup.closure ({r, 1} : Set ℝ) : Set ℝ) :=
    dense_addSubgroupClosure_pair_iff.mpr (by simpa using hri)
  obtain ⟨z, hzmem, hz⟩ := hdense.exists_mem_open isOpen_Ioo
    (Set.nonempty_Ioo.mpr (div_pos hdelta hnormlambda))
  obtain ⟨n, m, hnm⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_closure_pair.mp hzmem
  have hzcomb : (n : ℝ) * r + (m : ℝ) = z := by
    simpa [zsmul_eq_mul] using hnm
  let c : Plane := m • lambda + n • gamma
  have hcomb_eq : c = z • lambda := by
    dsimp [c]
    rw [hratio, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℝ, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℝ,
      smul_smul, ← add_smul]
    congr 1
    linarith [hzcomb]
  have hcomb_ne : c ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hcomb_eq]
    exact smul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hz.1) hlambda
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hcoset
  let x : Plane := c + v
  have hxQ : x ∈ V + P := by
    apply hv
    refine ⟨m, n, ?_⟩
    dsimp [x, c]
    ac_rfl
  have hvQ : v ∈ V + P := hv ⟨0, 0, by simp⟩
  have hxne : x ≠ v := by
    intro hxeq
    apply hcomb_ne
    exact add_right_cancel (show c + v = 0 + v by simpa [x] using hxeq)
  have hdist : dist x v < delta := by
    change dist (c + v) v < delta
    rw [← vadd_eq_add, dist_vadd_left, hcomb_eq, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos hz.1]
    exact (lt_div_iff₀ hnormlambda).mp hz.2
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hsep hxQ hvQ hxne)) hdist

name: Tiling.Polygonal.planarLattice_boundedCosetRepresentative
statement:
theorem planarLattice_boundedCosetRepresentative (L : PlanarLattice) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∀ x : Plane,
      ∃ g ∈ L.toAddSubgroup, ‖x - g‖ ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℝ Plane :=
    basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank L.independent
      (by simp [Complex.finrank_real_complex])
  have hb : (b : Fin 2 → Plane) = L.basis :=
    coe_basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank _ _
  let R : ℝ := 1 + ∑ i : Fin 2, ‖L.basis i‖
  refine ⟨R, by
    dsimp [R]
    linarith [Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i (_hi : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2))) =>
      norm_nonneg (L.basis i))], ?_⟩
  intro x
  let c : Fin 2 → ℝ := b.repr x
  let g : Plane := ∑ i : Fin 2, (Int.floor (c i) : ℝ) • L.basis i
  have hg : g ∈ L.toAddSubgroup := by
    apply L.toAddSubgroup.sum_mem
    intro i _
    rw [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
    apply AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem
    exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self i)
  refine ⟨g, hg, ?_⟩
  have hx : x = ∑ i : Fin 2, c i • L.basis i := by
    rw [← hb]
    exact (b.sum_repr x).symm
  change ‖x - ∑ i : Fin 2, (Int.floor (c i) : ℝ) • L.basis i‖ ≤ R
  rw [hx, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp only [← sub_smul]
  calc
    ‖∑ i : Fin 2, (c i - (Int.floor (c i) : ℝ)) • L.basis i‖
        ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ‖(c i - (Int.floor (c i) : ℝ)) • L.basis i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ‖L.basis i‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have hlo := Int.floor_le (c i)
      have hhi := Int.lt_floor_add_one (c i)
      have habs : |c i - (Int.floor (c i) : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
        rw [abs_le]
        constructor <;> linarith
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) habs
    _ ≤ R := by dsimp [R]; linarith

name: Tiling.Polygonal.periodicOpen_inclusion_commensurable
statement:
theorem periodicOpen_inclusion_commensurable :
∀ (A B : Set ℝ) (β γ : ℝ), IsOpen A → A.Nonempty → IsOpen B →
    B ≠ Set.univ → A ⊆ B → 0 < β → 0 < γ →
    β ∈ periodGroup B → γ ∈ periodGroup A →
      ∃ m n : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ 0 < n ∧ (m : ℝ) * β = (n : ℝ) * γ
proof:
:= by
  intro A B β γ hA hAn hB hBproper hAB hβ hγ hβper hγper
  by_contra hcomm
  have hratio : Irrational (γ / β) := by
    intro hnrat
    change γ / β ∈ Set.range ((↑) : ℚ → ℝ) at hnrat
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hnrat
    have hqpos : 0 < (q : ℝ) := by
      rw [hq]
      exact div_pos hγ hβ
    have hqpos' : 0 < q := by exact_mod_cast hqpos
    have hnumpos : 0 < q.num := Rat.num_pos.mpr hqpos'
    have hmpos : 0 < q.num.natAbs := Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hnumpos.ne'
    have hnpos : 0 < q.den := q.den_pos
    have hnumcast : ((q.num.natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) = (q.num : ℝ) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_natAbs, abs_of_nonneg hnumpos.le]
    have hqrepr : (q : ℝ) = (q.num : ℝ) / (q.den : ℝ) := by
      simp [Rat.cast_def]
    have hratio' : γ / β = (q.num : ℝ) / (q.den : ℝ) := by
      rw [hq.symm, hqrepr]
    have hmul : (q.den : ℝ) * γ = (q.num : ℝ) * β := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hβ, Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hnpos.ne'] at hratio'
      nlinarith [hratio']
    apply hcomm
    refine ⟨q.num.natAbs, q.den, hmpos, hnpos, ?_⟩
    simpa [hnumcast] using hmul.symm
  have hdense : Dense (AddSubgroup.closure ({γ, β} : Set ℝ) : Set ℝ) :=
    (dense_addSubgroupClosure_pair_iff (a := γ) (b := β)).mpr hratio
  have hBuniv : B = Set.univ := by
    apply Set.eq_univ_iff_forall.mpr
    intro y
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hAn
    let U : Set ℝ := {x | y - x ∈ A}
    have hUopen : IsOpen U := by
      dsimp [U]
      exact hA.preimage (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)
    have hUnonempty : U.Nonempty := ⟨y - a, by simp [U, ha]⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hxH, hxU⟩ := hdense.exists_mem_open hUopen hUnonempty
    have hxA : y - x ∈ A := hxU
    have hxB : x +ᵥ A ⊆ B := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨m, n, hmn⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_closure_pair.mp hxH
      have hmA : m • γ ∈ periodGroup A := (periodGroup A).zsmul_mem hγper m
      have hnB : n • β ∈ periodGroup B := (periodGroup B).zsmul_mem hβper n
      have hmA' : (m • γ) +ᵥ A = A := by
        simpa [periodGroup] using hmA
      have hnB' : (n • β) +ᵥ B = B := by
        simpa [periodGroup] using hnB
      change ∃ a ∈ A, x + a = z at hz
      obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hz
      have hma : m • γ + a ∈ A := by
        have : m • γ +ᵥ a ∈ (m • γ) +ᵥ A := ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        rw [hmA'] at this
        simpa using this
      have hna : n • β + (m • γ + a) ∈ B := by
        have : m • γ + a ∈ B := hAB hma
        have ht : n • β +ᵥ (m • γ + a) ∈ (n • β) +ᵥ B := ⟨_, this, rfl⟩
        rw [hnB'] at ht
        simpa using ht
      rw [← hmn]
      simpa [add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using hna
    have hyB : y ∈ B := by
      have : x + (y - x) ∈ B := hxB ⟨y - x, hxA, rfl⟩
      simpa using this
    exact hyB
  exact hBproper hBuniv

name: Tiling.Polygonal.periodicRegularOpen_translatedContainment
statement:
theorem periodicRegularOpen_translatedContainment :
∀ (D : Set Plane), IsOpen D → interior (closure D) = D → IsLatticePeriodic D →
    ∀ a : Plane, a +ᵥ D ⊆ D → a +ᵥ D = D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro D hDopen hDreg hDperiod a ha
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hDperiod
  have hp (u : Plane) (hu : u ∈ L.toAddSubgroup) : u +ᵥ D = D :=
    AddAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp (hL hu)
  have hn (n : ℕ) : ∀ x ∈ D, n • a + x ∈ D := by
    induction n with
    | zero => intro x hx; simpa only [zero_nsmul, zero_add] using hx
    | succ n ih =>
      intro x hx
      have hm : a + (n • a + x) ∈ D := ha ⟨n • a + x, ih x hx, rfl⟩
      simpa only [succ_nsmul, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using hm
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hrep⟩ := planarLattice_boundedCosetRepresentative L
  
  choose g hg hgbound using fun n : ℕ => hrep (n • a)
  let r : ℕ → Plane := fun n => n • a - g n
  have hrbound : ∀ n, r n ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Plane) R := by
    intro n
    simpa [r, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hgbound n
  obtain ⟨z, _hz, φ, hφ, hlim⟩ :=
    (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall (0 : Plane) R).tendsto_subseq hrbound
  have hnext : Tendsto (fun n => r (φ (n + 1))) atTop (𝓝 z) :=
    hlim.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hdiff : Tendsto (fun n => r (φ (n + 1)) - r (φ n) - a)
      atTop (𝓝 (-a)) := by
    simpa using (hnext.sub hlim).sub_const a
  have hsub : -a +ᵥ D ⊆ closure D := by
    rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    apply mem_closure_of_tendsto (hdiff.add_const x)
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro n
    let k : ℕ := φ (n + 1) - φ n - 1
    have hk : φ (n + 1) = φ n + k + 1 := by
      have hstep : φ n < φ (n + 1) := hφ (by omega)
      dsimp [k]
      omega
    have hshift : r (φ (n + 1)) - r (φ n) - a =
        (g (φ n) - g (φ (n + 1))) + k • a := by
      dsimp [r]
      rw [hk, add_nsmul, add_nsmul, one_nsmul]
      abel
    rw [hshift, add_assoc]
    rw [← hp (g (φ n) - g (φ (n + 1))) (L.toAddSubgroup.sub_mem (hg _) (hg _))]
    exact ⟨k • a + x, hn k x hx, rfl⟩
  have hneg : -a +ᵥ D ⊆ D := by
    simpa only [hDreg] using (hDopen.vadd (-a)).subset_interior_iff.mpr hsub
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm ha
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨-a + x, hneg ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, by simp [vadd_eq_add]⟩

name: Tiling.Polygonal.locallyFinite_of_finite_differences
statement:
theorem locallyFinite_of_finite_differences
    {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] {T : Set V}
    (hT : ∀ B : Set V, IsBounded B → ((T - T) ∩ B).Finite) (B : Set V) (hB : IsBounded B) :
    (T ∩ B).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hnonempty : T.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hnonempty
    have hfinite := hT ((-t) +ᵥ B) (hB.vadd (-t))
    apply (hfinite.image fun d : V => d + t).subset
    rintro x ⟨hxT, hxB⟩
    refine ⟨x - t, ⟨⟨x, hxT, t, ht, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, sub_add_cancel x t⟩
    refine ⟨x, hxB, ?_⟩
    change -t + x = x - t
    abel
  · rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hnonempty, Set.empty_inter]
    exact Set.finite_empty

name: Tiling.Polygonal.hasFLC_iff_finite_differences_on_bounded
statement:
theorem hasFLC_iff_finite_differences_on_bounded
    {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] {T : Set V} :
    HasFLC T ↔ ∀ B : Set V, IsBounded B → ((T - T) ∩ B).Finite
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact HasFLC.differences_locallyFinite
  · intro hT
    exact ⟨locallyFinite_of_finite_differences hT,
      fun R _ => hT _ Metric.isBounded_closedBall⟩

name: Tiling.LinearMap.ker_finrank_of_exists_valueOne
statement:
private theorem LinearMap.ker_finrank_of_exists_valueOne (f : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (h : ∃ u, f u = 1) : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker f) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := h
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro r
    refine ⟨r • u, ?_⟩
    rw [map_smul, hu, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have hrank := f.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj, finrank_top, Module.finrank_self,
    Complex.finrank_real_complex] at hrank
  omega

name: Tiling.LinearMap.ker_le_ker_of_not_exists_pos_pos
statement:
private theorem LinearMap.ker_le_ker_of_not_exists_pos_pos
    (f g : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (u : Plane) (hfu : f u = 1)
    (hdisj : ¬∃ z, 0 < f z ∧ 0 < g z) : LinearMap.ker f ≤ LinearMap.ker g
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hz ⊢
  by_contra hgz
  have produces_common_positive {w : Plane} (hfw : f w = 0) (hgw : 0 < g w) : False := by
    let r : ℝ := (|g u| + 1) / g w
    have hgw_ne : g w ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hgw
    apply hdisj
    refine ⟨r • w + u, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [map_add, map_smul, hfw, hfu, smul_zero, zero_add]
      norm_num
    · simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hgw_ne]
      linarith [neg_abs_le (g u)]
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hgz with hgz_neg | hgz_pos
  · exact produces_common_positive (w := -z) (by simp [hz]) (by simpa using hgz_neg)
  · exact produces_common_positive hz hgz_pos

name: Tiling.LinearMap.eq_neg_smul_of_not_exists_pos_pos
statement:
private theorem LinearMap.eq_neg_smul_of_not_exists_pos_pos
    (f g : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (u v : Plane) (hfu : f u = 1) (hgv : g v = 1)
    (hdisj : ¬∃ z, 0 < f z ∧ 0 < g z) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, c < 0 ∧ g = c • f
proof:
:= by
  have hker := LinearMap.ker_le_ker_of_not_exists_pos_pos f g u hfu hdisj
  let c := g u
  have hgf : g = c • f := by
    ext z
    have hzker : z - f z • u ∈ LinearMap.ker f := by
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      rw [map_sub, map_smul, hfu, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, sub_self]
    have hzero := hker hzker
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hzero
    simp only [map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hzero
    change g z = c * f z
    dsimp only [c]
    linarith
  refine ⟨c, ?_, hgf⟩
  have hc_nonpos : c ≤ 0 := by
    by_contra hc
    exact hdisj ⟨u, by simp [hfu], by simpa [c] using lt_of_not_ge hc⟩
  have hc_ne : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro hc
    have : g = 0 := by simpa [hc] using hgf
    rw [this, LinearMap.zero_apply] at hgv
    exact zero_ne_one hgv
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hc_nonpos hc_ne

name: Tiling.not_exists_pos_pos_of_aedisjoint
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨z, hfz, hgz⟩
  let ray : ℝ → Plane := fun r ↦ r • z + x
  have hray : Tendsto ray (𝓝 0) (𝓝 x) := by
    have : Continuous ray := by fun_prop
    have hzero : ContinuousAt ray (0 : ℝ) := this.continuousAt
    have hray_zero : ray 0 = x := by simp [ray]
    rw [← hray_zero]
    exact hzero
  have hlocal : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ),
      (ray r ∈ interior t ↔ 0 < f (ray r - x)) ∧
      (ray r ∈ interior u ↔ 0 < g (ray r - x)) :=
    hray.eventually (ht.and hu)
  have hlocal_mem : {r : ℝ |
      (ray r ∈ interior t ↔ 0 < f (ray r - x)) ∧
      (ray r ∈ interior u ↔ 0 < g (ray r - x))} ∈ 𝓝 0 := hlocal
  rw [Metric.mem_nhds_iff] at hlocal_mem
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := hlocal_mem
  let r := ε / 2
  have hr : 0 < r := div_pos hε (by norm_num)
  have hrball : r ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) ε := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hr]
    dsimp only [r]
    linarith
  have hlocal_r := hball hrball
  have hray_sub : ray r - x = r • z := by simp [ray]
  have hft : 0 < f (ray r - x) := by
    rw [hray_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_pos hr hfz
  have hgu : 0 < g (ray r - x) := by
    rw [hray_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_pos hr hgz
  have hinter : (interior t ∩ interior u).Nonempty :=
    ⟨ray r, hlocal_r.1.mpr hft, hlocal_r.2.mpr hgu⟩
  have hne : volume (interior t ∩ interior u) ≠ 0 :=
    (isOpen_interior.inter isOpen_interior).measure_ne_zero volume hinter
  exact hne (measure_mono_null
    (Set.inter_subset_inter interior_subset interior_subset) hdisj)

name: Tiling.affineIndependent_of_twiceSignedArea_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem affineIndependent_of_twiceSignedArea_ne_zero (a b c : Plane)
    (harea : twiceSignedArea a b c ≠ 0) : AffineIndependent ℝ ![a, b, c]
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineIndependent_iff_linearIndependent_vsub ℝ ![a, b, c] 0]
  rw [← linearIndependent_equiv (finSuccAboveEquiv (0 : Fin 3))]
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg i
  have hg' : g 0 • (b - a) + g 1 • (c - a) = 0 := by
    simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two, finSuccAboveEquiv] using hg
  have hgre := congrArg Complex.re hg'
  have hgim := congrArg Complex.im hg'
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.smul_re, Complex.sub_re, Complex.zero_re,
    smul_eq_mul] at hgre
  simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_im, Complex.sub_im, Complex.zero_im,
    smul_eq_mul] at hgim
  have hg0 : g 0 = 0 := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ harea
    rw [twiceSignedArea]
    linear_combination (c.im - a.im) * hgre - (c.re - a.re) * hgim
  have hg1 : g 1 = 0 := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ harea
    rw [twiceSignedArea]
    linear_combination -(b.im - a.im) * hgre + (b.re - a.re) * hgim
  fin_cases i
  · exact hg0
  · exact hg1

name: Tiling.range_triangleAffineBasis
proof:
:= by
  change Set.range ![a, b, c] = {a, b, c}
  ext z
  simp only [Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty, Set.singleton_union,
    Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, or_false]

name: Tiling.AffineBasis.point_mem_extremePoints_convexHull_range
statement:
private theorem AffineBasis.point_mem_extremePoints_convexHull_range
    (b : AffineBasis (Fin 3) ℝ Plane) (i : Fin 3) :
    b i ∈ (convexHull ℝ (Set.range b)).extremePoints ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_extremePoints_iff_left]
  refine ⟨subset_convexHull ℝ _ (Set.mem_range_self i), ?_⟩
  intro y hy z hz hsegment
  have hycoord : ∀ j, 0 ≤ b.coord j y := by
    rw [b.convexHull_eq_nonneg_coord] at hy
    exact hy
  have hzcoord : ∀ j, 0 ≤ b.coord j z := by
    rw [b.convexHull_eq_nonneg_coord] at hz
    exact hz
  have hycoord_le_one : b.coord i y ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      b.coord i y ≤ ∑ j, b.coord j y :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ hycoord j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      _ = 1 := b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one y
  have hzcoord_le_one : b.coord i z ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      b.coord i z ≤ ∑ j, b.coord j z :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ hzcoord j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      _ = 1 := b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one z
  rw [openSegment_eq_image_lineMap] at hsegment
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrline⟩ := hsegment
  have hcoordline := congrArg (b.coord i) hrline
  rw [AffineMap.apply_lineMap, b.coord_apply_eq, AffineMap.lineMap_apply_ring] at hcoordline
  have hyi : b.coord i y = 1 := by
    nlinarith [hr.1, hr.2]
  apply b.ext_elem
  intro j
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    simp [hyi]
  · rw [b.coord_apply_ne hji]
    have hsum_erase : Finset.sum (Finset.univ.erase i) (fun k ↦ b.coord k y) = 0 := by
      have hsum := b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one y
      rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i), hyi] at hsum
      linarith
    exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun k _ ↦ hycoord k).mp hsum_erase j (by simp [hji])

name: Tiling.AffineBasis.eq_point_of_two_coord_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem AffineBasis.eq_point_of_two_coord_eq_zero
    (b : AffineBasis (Fin 3) ℝ Plane) {x : Plane} {i j : Fin 3}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (hi : b.coord i x = 0) (hj : b.coord j x = 0) :
    ∃ k, x = b k
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := b.sum_coord_apply_eq_one x
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hsum
  fin_cases i
  · fin_cases j
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
    · refine ⟨2, ?_⟩
      apply b.ext_elem
      intro n
      fin_cases n <;> simp_all
    · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      apply b.ext_elem
      intro n
      fin_cases n <;> simp_all
  · fin_cases j
    · refine ⟨2, ?_⟩
      apply b.ext_elem
      intro n
      fin_cases n <;> simp_all
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      apply b.ext_elem
      intro n
      fin_cases n <;> simp_all
  · fin_cases j
    · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      apply b.ext_elem
      intro n
      fin_cases n <;> simp_all
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      apply b.ext_elem
      intro n
      fin_cases n <;> simp_all
    · exact (hij rfl).elim

name: Tiling.IsTriangle.boundaryGerm
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, harea, rfl⟩ := ht
  let B := triangleAffineBasis a b c harea
  have hrange : Set.range B = {a, b, c} := range_triangleAffineBasis a b c harea
  rw [← hrange] at hx hxextreme ⊢
  have hclosed : IsClosed (convexHull ℝ (Set.range B)) :=
    (Set.toFinite (Set.range B)).isCompact_convexHull ℝ |>.isClosed
  rw [hclosed.frontier_eq] at hx
  have hxcoord_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ B.coord i x := by
    rw [B.convexHull_eq_nonneg_coord] at hx
    exact hx.1
  have hxnotint : x ∉ interior (convexHull ℝ (Set.range B)) := hx.2
  rw [B.interior_convexHull] at hxnotint
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_forall] at hxnotint
  obtain ⟨k, hk_nonpos⟩ := hxnotint
  have hk : B.coord k x = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hk_nonpos) (hxcoord_nonneg k)
  have hother : ∀ j, j ≠ k → 0 < B.coord j x := by
    intro j hjk
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne (hxcoord_nonneg j)
    intro hj
    obtain ⟨m, hxm⟩ := AffineBasis.eq_point_of_two_coord_eq_zero B hjk hj.symm hk
    apply hxextreme
    rw [hxm]
    exact AffineBasis.point_mem_extremePoints_convexHull_range B m
  let f : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ := (B.coord k).linear
  have hcoord (y : Plane) : B.coord k y = f (y - x) := by
    calc
      B.coord k y = B.coord k y - B.coord k x := by rw [hk, sub_zero]
      _ = f (y - x) := ((B.coord k).linearMap_vsub y x).symm
  have hevent_other : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ j, j ≠ k → 0 < B.coord j y := by
    rw [Filter.eventually_all]
    intro j
    by_cases hjk : j = k
    · filter_upwards [] with y
      exact fun h ↦ (h hjk).elim
    · exact ((continuous_barycentric_coord B j).continuousAt.eventually
        (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds (hother j hjk))).mono fun _ hy _ ↦ hy
  have hmem : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x,
      (y ∈ convexHull ℝ (Set.range B) ↔ 0 ≤ f (y - x)) := by
    filter_upwards [hevent_other] with y hy
    rw [B.convexHull_eq_nonneg_coord]
    constructor
    · intro h
      simpa only [← hcoord] using h k
    · intro hk' j
      by_cases hjk : j = k
      · simpa only [hjk, hcoord] using hk'
      · exact (hy j hjk).le
  have hinterior : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x,
      (y ∈ interior (convexHull ℝ (Set.range B)) ↔ 0 < f (y - x)) := by
    filter_upwards [hevent_other] with y hy
    rw [B.interior_convexHull]
    constructor
    · intro h
      simpa only [← hcoord] using h k
    · intro hk' j
      by_cases hjk : j = k
      · simpa only [hjk, hcoord] using hk'
      · exact hy j hjk
  refine ⟨f, ?_, hmem, hinterior, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨B k - x, ?_⟩
    calc
      f (B k - x) = B.coord k (B k) - B.coord k x :=
        (B.coord k).linearMap_vsub (B k) x
      _ = 1 := by rw [B.coord_apply_eq, hk, sub_zero]
  · filter_upwards [hmem, hinterior] with y hymem hyinterior
    rw [hclosed.frontier_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hyt, hyi⟩
      have hnonneg := hymem.mp hyt
      have hnotpos : ¬0 < f (y - x) := fun hpos ↦ hyi (hyinterior.mpr hpos)
      exact le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hnotpos) hnonneg
    · intro hyzero
      refine ⟨hymem.mpr hyzero.symm.le, ?_⟩
      intro hyi
      exact (hyinterior.mp hyi).ne' hyzero

name: Tiling.IsTriangle.interior_nonempty
statement:
theorem IsTriangle.interior_nonempty {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsTriangle s) :
    (interior s).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, harea, rfl⟩ := hs
  rw [interior_convexHull_nonempty_iff_affineSpan_eq_top]
  rw [show ({a, b, c} : Set Plane) = Set.range ![a, b, c] by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Matrix.range_cons,
      Matrix.range_empty, Set.singleton_union]
    aesop]
  apply (AffineIndependent.affineSpan_eq_top_iff_card_eq_finrank_add_one
    (affineIndependent_of_twiceSignedArea_ne_zero a b c harea)).mpr
  simp [Complex.finrank_real_complex]

name: Tiling.IsTriangle.isCompact
statement: theorem IsTriangle.isCompact {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsTriangle s) : IsCompact s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, _, rfl⟩ := hs
  exact Set.toFinite {a, b, c} |>.isCompact_convexHull ℝ

name: Tiling.IsTriangle.closure_interior
statement:
theorem IsTriangle.closure_interior {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsTriangle s) :
    closure (interior s) = s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, harea, rfl⟩ := hs
  exact Convex.closure_interior_eq_closure_of_nonempty_interior
      (convex_convexHull ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set Plane))
      (IsTriangle.interior_nonempty ⟨a, b, c, harea, rfl⟩) |>.trans
        ((Set.toFinite {a, b, c}).isCompact_convexHull ℝ).isClosed.closure_eq

name: Tiling.IsPolygonal.isCompact
statement: theorem IsPolygonal.isCompact {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsPolygonal s) : IsCompact s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨triangulation⟩ := hs
  rw [← triangulation.sUnion_eq]
  exact triangulation.pieces.finite_toSet.isCompact_sUnion fun t ht ↦
    (triangulation.isTriangle t ht).isCompact

name: Tiling.IsPolygonal.isClosed
statement: theorem IsPolygonal.isClosed {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsPolygonal s) : IsClosed s
proof:
:=
  hs.isCompact.isClosed

name: Tiling.IsPolygonal.isBounded
statement:
theorem IsPolygonal.isBounded {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsPolygonal s) :
    Bornology.IsBounded s
proof:
:=
  hs.isCompact.isBounded

name: Tiling.IsPolygonal.closure_interior
statement:
theorem IsPolygonal.closure_interior {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsPolygonal s) :
    closure (interior s) = s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨triangulation⟩ := hs
  let f : {t // t ∈ triangulation.pieces} → Set Plane := fun t ↦ t.1
  have hregular : ∀ t, closure (interior (f t)) = f t := fun t ↦
    (triangulation.isTriangle t.1 t.2).closure_interior
  have hunion : ⋃ t, f t = s := calc
    ⋃ t, f t = ⋃₀ (triangulation.pieces : Set (Set Plane)) := by ext x; simp [f]
    _ = s := triangulation.sUnion_eq
  rw [← hunion]
  exact (locallyFinite_of_finite f).closure_interior_iUnion_eq hregular

name: Tiling.frontier_sUnion_subset_biUnion
statement:
private theorem frontier_sUnion_subset_biUnion (F : Finset (Set Plane)) :
    frontier (⋃₀ (F : Set (Set Plane))) ⊆ ⋃ s ∈ F, frontier s
proof:
:= by
  induction F using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert s F hs ih =>
      rw [Finset.coe_insert, sUnion_insert, Finset.set_biUnion_insert]
      exact (frontier_union_subset s (⋃₀ (F : Set (Set Plane)))).trans <|
        (Set.union_subset_union inter_subset_left inter_subset_right).trans <|
          Set.union_subset_union Subset.rfl ih

name: Tiling.IsPolygonal.volume_frontier
statement:
theorem IsPolygonal.volume_frontier {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsPolygonal s) :
    volume (frontier s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨triangulation⟩ := hs
  rw [← triangulation.sUnion_eq]
  apply measure_mono_null (frontier_sUnion_subset_biUnion triangulation.pieces)
  apply (measure_biUnion_null_iff triangulation.pieces.countable_toSet).2
  intro t ht
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, _, rfl⟩ := triangulation.isTriangle t ht
  exact (convex_convexHull ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set Plane)).addHaar_frontier volume

name: Tiling.IsPolygonal.interior_ae_eq
statement:
theorem IsPolygonal.interior_ae_eq {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsPolygonal s) :
    interior s =ᵐ[volume] s
proof:
:=
  interior_ae_eq_of_null_frontier hs.volume_frontier

name: Tiling.IsPolygonal.interior_nonempty
statement:
theorem IsPolygonal.interior_nonempty {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsPolygonal s)
    (hne : s.Nonempty) : (interior s).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr
  intro hinter
  apply hne.ne_empty
  rw [← hs.closure_interior, hinter, closure_empty]

name: Tiling.IsPolygonal.volume_pos
statement:
theorem IsPolygonal.volume_pos {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsPolygonal s)
    (hne : s.Nonempty) : 0 < volume s
proof:
:=
  (isOpen_interior.measure_pos volume (hs.interior_nonempty hne)).trans_le
    (measure_mono interior_subset)

name: Tiling.IsTriangle.extremePoints_finite
statement:
private theorem IsTriangle.extremePoints_finite {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsTriangle s) :
    (s.extremePoints ℝ).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, _, rfl⟩ := hs
  exact (Set.toFinite {a, b, c}).subset extremePoints_convexHull_subset

name: Tiling.IsPolygonal.vertexSet_finite
statement:
theorem IsPolygonal.vertexSet_finite {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsPolygonal s) :
    (vertexSet s).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨triangulation⟩ := hs
  apply (triangulation.pieces.finite_toSet.biUnion fun t ht ↦
    (triangulation.isTriangle t ht).extremePoints_finite).subset
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := hx triangulation
  exact mem_biUnion ht hxt

name: Tiling.IsTriangle.vadd
statement:
theorem IsTriangle.vadd {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsTriangle s) (a : Plane) :
    IsTriangle (a +ᵥ s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, r, harea, rfl⟩ := hs
  refine ⟨a +ᵥ p, a +ᵥ q, a +ᵥ r, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [twiceSignedArea] using harea
  · rw [← convexHull_vadd]
    congr 1
    ext x
    simp only [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, Set.mem_insert_iff,
      Set.mem_singleton_iff, vadd_eq_add]
    constructor
    · rintro (h | h | h)
      · left; rw [← h]; abel
      · right; left; rw [← h]; abel
      · right; right; rw [← h]; abel
    · rintro (h | h | h)
      · left; rw [h]; abel
      · right; left; rw [h]; abel
      · right; right; rw [h]; abel

name: Tiling.aedisjoint_vadd
statement:
theorem aedisjoint_vadd {s t : Set Plane} (a : Plane)
    (h : AEDisjoint volume s t) : AEDisjoint volume (a +ᵥ s) (a +ᵥ t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AEDisjoint]
  have hinter : (a +ᵥ s) ∩ (a +ᵥ t) = a +ᵥ (s ∩ t) := by
    ext x
    simp [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  rw [hinter]
  have hpreimage : a +ᵥ (s ∩ t) = (fun x : Plane ↦ -a + x) ⁻¹' (s ∩ t) := by
    ext x
    simp [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  rw [hpreimage, measure_preimage_add]
  exact h

name: Tiling.IsPolygonal.vadd
statement:
theorem IsPolygonal.vadd {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsPolygonal s) (a : Plane) :
    IsPolygonal (a +ᵥ s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨T.vadd a⟩

name: Tiling.IsTriangle.smul
statement:
theorem IsTriangle.smul {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsTriangle s) (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    IsTriangle (r • s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, harea, rfl⟩ := hs
  refine ⟨r • a, r • b, r • c, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have heq : twiceSignedArea (r • a) (r • b) (r • c) =
        r ^ 2 * twiceSignedArea a b c := by
      simp only [twiceSignedArea, Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [heq]
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hr) harea
  · rw [← convexHull_smul]
    congr 1
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, (rfl | rfl | rfl), rfl⟩ <;> simp
    · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨a, by simp, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨b, by simp, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨c, by simp, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.aedisjoint_smul
statement:
theorem aedisjoint_smul {s t : Set Plane} (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (h : AEDisjoint volume s t) : AEDisjoint volume (r • s) (r • t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AEDisjoint]
  have hinter : (r • s) ∩ (r • t) = r • (s ∩ t) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, ⟨z, hz, heq⟩⟩
      have hyz : y = z := (smul_right_injective Plane hr) heq.symm
      subst z
      exact ⟨y, ⟨hy, hz⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hy, hz⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, ⟨y, hz, rfl⟩⟩
  rw [hinter, Measure.addHaar_smul volume, h]
  simp

name: Tiling.IsPolygonal.smul
statement:
theorem IsPolygonal.smul {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsPolygonal s) (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    IsPolygonal (r • s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨T.smul r hr⟩

name: Tiling.extremePoints_smul
statement:
private theorem extremePoints_smul (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (s : Set Plane) :
    (r • s).extremePoints ℝ = r • s.extremePoints ℝ
proof:
:= by
  have h := image_extremePoints (scalarLinearEquiv r hr) s
  change (fun x : Plane ↦ r • x) '' extremePoints ℝ s =
    extremePoints ℝ ((fun x : Plane ↦ r • x) '' s) at h
  simpa only [Set.image_smul] using h.symm

name: Tiling.extremePoints_vadd
statement:
private theorem extremePoints_vadd (a : Plane) (s : Set Plane) :
    (a +ᵥ s).extremePoints ℝ = a +ᵥ s.extremePoints ℝ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_extremePoints_iff_left, mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem,
    mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, mem_extremePoints_iff_left]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxs, hxext⟩
    refine ⟨hxs, ?_⟩
    intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ hseg
    have hseg' : x ∈ openSegment ℝ (a +ᵥ y₁) (a +ᵥ y₂) := by
      rw [← vadd_openSegment ℝ]
      exact ⟨-a +ᵥ x, hseg, by simp⟩
    have heq := hxext (a +ᵥ y₁)
      (by simpa only [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, neg_vadd_vadd] using hy₁)
      (a +ᵥ y₂)
      (by simpa only [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, neg_vadd_vadd] using hy₂) hseg'
    exact vadd_left_cancel a (heq.trans (vadd_neg_vadd a x).symm)
  · rintro ⟨hxs, hxext⟩
    refine ⟨hxs, ?_⟩
    intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ hseg
    have hz₁' : -a +ᵥ z₁ ∈ s := by
      simpa only [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] using hz₁
    have hz₂' : -a +ᵥ z₂ ∈ s := by
      simpa only [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] using hz₂
    have hseg' : -a +ᵥ x ∈ openSegment ℝ (-a +ᵥ z₁) (-a +ᵥ z₂) := by
      rw [← vadd_openSegment ℝ]
      exact ⟨x, hseg, by simp⟩
    have heq := hxext (-a +ᵥ z₁) hz₁' (-a +ᵥ z₂) hz₂' hseg'
    exact vadd_left_cancel (-a) heq

name: Tiling.Triangulation.cast_pieces
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem Triangulation.cast_pieces {s t : Set Plane} (h : s = t)
    (T : Triangulation s) :
    (T.cast h).pieces = T.pieces
proof:
:= by
  subst t
  rfl

name: Tiling.vertexSet_vadd
statement:
theorem vertexSet_vadd (a : Plane) (s : Set Plane) :
    vertexSet (a +ᵥ s) = a +ᵥ vertexSet s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    change ∀ T : Triangulation s,
      ∃ t ∈ T.pieces, -a +ᵥ x ∈ t.extremePoints ℝ
    intro T
    change ∀ T' : Triangulation (a +ᵥ s),
      ∃ t ∈ T'.pieces, x ∈ t.extremePoints ℝ at hx
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := hx (T.vadd a)
    simp only [Triangulation.vadd, Finset.mem_image] at ht
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := ht
    refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
    rw [extremePoints_vadd] at hxt
    simpa only [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] using hxt
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hx
    change ∀ T : Triangulation s,
      ∃ t ∈ T.pieces, -a +ᵥ x ∈ t.extremePoints ℝ at hx
    change ∀ T' : Triangulation (a +ᵥ s),
      ∃ t ∈ T'.pieces, x ∈ t.extremePoints ℝ
    intro T'
    have hcancel : -a +ᵥ (a +ᵥ s) = s := by
      ext y
      simp only [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_vadd]
      have hz : -(-a + a) = (0 : Plane) := by abel
      rw [hz, zero_vadd]
    let U₀ : Triangulation (-a +ᵥ (a +ᵥ s)) := T'.vadd (-a)
    let U : Triangulation s := U₀.cast hcancel
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hxu⟩ := hx U
    have hu₀ : u ∈ U₀.pieces := by
      change u ∈ (U₀.cast hcancel).pieces at hu
      simpa only [Triangulation.cast_pieces] using hu
    simp only [U₀, Triangulation.vadd, Finset.mem_image] at hu₀
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hu₀
    refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
    have hxtranslated : x ∈ a +ᵥ (-a +ᵥ t).extremePoints ℝ := by
      rw [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      exact hxu
    rw [← extremePoints_vadd] at hxtranslated
    simpa only [vadd_vadd, add_neg_cancel, zero_vadd] using hxtranslated

name: Tiling.vertexSet_smul
statement:
theorem vertexSet_smul (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (s : Set Plane) :
    vertexSet (r • s) = r • vertexSet s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨r⁻¹ • x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change ∀ T : Triangulation s,
        ∃ t ∈ T.pieces, r⁻¹ • x ∈ t.extremePoints ℝ
      intro T
      change ∀ T' : Triangulation (r • s),
        ∃ t ∈ T'.pieces, x ∈ t.extremePoints ℝ at hx
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := hx (T.smul r hr)
      simp only [Triangulation.smul, Finset.mem_image] at ht
      obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := ht
      rw [extremePoints_smul r hr u] at hxt
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hxt
      refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
      have hy_eq : y = r⁻¹ • x := by
        calc
          y = r⁻¹ • (r • y) := by simp [hr]
          _ = r⁻¹ • x := congrArg (fun z : Plane ↦ r⁻¹ • z) hyx
      simpa only [← hy_eq] using hy
    · simp [hr]
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    change ∀ T' : Triangulation (r • s),
      ∃ t ∈ T'.pieces, r • y ∈ t.extremePoints ℝ
    intro T'
    have hcancel : r⁻¹ • (r • s) = s := by
      simp [smul_smul, hr]
    let U₀ : Triangulation (r⁻¹ • (r • s)) :=
      T'.smul r⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero hr)
    let U : Triangulation s := U₀.cast hcancel
    change ∀ T : Triangulation s,
      ∃ t ∈ T.pieces, y ∈ t.extremePoints ℝ at hy
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hyu⟩ := hy U
    have hu₀ : u ∈ U₀.pieces := by
      change u ∈ (U₀.cast hcancel).pieces at hu
      simpa only [Triangulation.cast_pieces] using hu
    simp only [U₀, Triangulation.smul, Finset.mem_image] at hu₀
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hu₀
    refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
    rw [extremePoints_smul r⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero hr) t] at hyu
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := hyu
    have hz_eq : z = r • y := by
      calc
        z = r • (r⁻¹ • z) := by simp [hr]
        _ = r • y := congrArg (fun w : Plane ↦ r • w) hzy
    simpa only [← hz_eq] using hz

name: Tiling.IsPolygonal.boundaryLocallyStraightAt_of_not_mem_vertexSet
statement:
theorem IsPolygonal.boundaryLocallyStraightAt_of_not_mem_vertexSet
    {s : Set Plane} (hs : IsPolygonal s) {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ frontier s)
    (hxv : x ∉ vertexSet s) : BoundaryLocallyStraightAt s x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [vertexSet, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hxv
  push Not at hxv
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := hxv
  have hxs : x ∈ s := by
    have := frontier_subset_closure hx
    rwa [hs.isClosed.closure_eq] at this
  have hxnotint : x ∉ interior s := by
    rw [hs.isClosed.frontier_eq] at hx
    exact hx.2
  have hxsUnion : x ∈ ⋃₀ (T.pieces : Set (Set Plane)) := by
    rwa [T.sUnion_eq]
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, hxt₀⟩ := Set.mem_sUnion.mp hxsUnion
  have ht₀' : t₀ ∈ T.pieces := ht₀
  have piece_subset {t : Set Plane} (ht : t ∈ T.pieces) : t ⊆ s := by
    rw [← T.sUnion_eq]
    exact Set.subset_sUnion_of_mem ht
  have ht₀closed : IsClosed t₀ := (T.isTriangle t₀ ht₀').isCompact.isClosed
  have hxfrontier₀ : x ∈ frontier t₀ := by
    rw [ht₀closed.frontier_eq]
    exact ⟨hxt₀, fun hxi ↦ hxnotint (interior_mono (piece_subset ht₀') hxi)⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hfvalue, hfmem, hfinterior, hffrontier⟩ :=
    IsTriangle.boundaryGerm (T.isTriangle t₀ ht₀') hxfrontier₀ (hT t₀ ht₀')
  have unique_piece_at_x : ∀ t ∈ T.pieces, x ∈ t → t = t₀ := by
    intro t ht hxt
    by_contra hne
    have htclosed : IsClosed t := (T.isTriangle t ht).isCompact.isClosed
    have hxfrontier : x ∈ frontier t := by
      rw [htclosed.frontier_eq]
      exact ⟨hxt, fun hxi ↦ hxnotint (interior_mono (piece_subset ht) hxi)⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hgvalue, hgmem, hginterior, _⟩ :=
      IsTriangle.boundaryGerm (T.isTriangle t ht) hxfrontier (hT t ht)
    have haed : AEDisjoint volume t₀ t :=
      T.pairwiseAEDisjoint ht₀' ht (Ne.symm hne)
    have hnopos : ¬∃ z, 0 < f z ∧ 0 < g z :=
      not_exists_pos_pos_of_aedisjoint hfinterior hginterior haed
    obtain ⟨uf, huf⟩ := hfvalue
    obtain ⟨ug, hug⟩ := hgvalue
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hgf⟩ :=
      LinearMap.eq_neg_smul_of_not_exists_pos_pos f g uf ug huf hug hnopos
    have hunion_mem : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, y ∈ t₀ ∪ t := by
      filter_upwards [hfmem, hgmem] with y hyf hyg
      by_cases hfy : 0 ≤ f (y - x)
      · exact Or.inl (hyf.mpr hfy)
      · right
        have hgy : 0 ≤ g (y - x) := by
          rw [hgf]
          simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          exact (mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hc (lt_of_not_ge hfy)).le
        exact hyg.mpr hgy
    have hxinterior_union : x ∈ interior (t₀ ∪ t) :=
      mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr hunion_mem
    apply hxnotint
    exact interior_mono (union_subset (piece_subset ht₀') (piece_subset ht)) hxinterior_union
  let U : Set Plane := ⋂ t ∈ T.pieces.erase t₀, tᶜ
  have hUopen : IsOpen U := by
    apply isOpen_biInter_finset
    intro t ht
    exact ((T.isTriangle t (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase ht)).isCompact.isClosed).isOpen_compl
  have hxU : x ∈ U := by
    simp only [U, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_compl_iff]
    intro t ht hxt
    exact (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase ht) (unique_piece_at_x t (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase ht) hxt)
  have hsets_on : Set.EqOn (· ∈ s) (· ∈ t₀) U := by
    intro y hyU
    apply propext
    constructor
    · intro hys
      have hys' : y ∈ ⋃₀ (T.pieces : Set (Set Plane)) := by rwa [T.sUnion_eq]
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hyt⟩ := Set.mem_sUnion.mp hys'
      have ht' : t ∈ T.pieces := ht
      by_cases h : t = t₀
      · simpa [h] using hyt
      · have htErase : t ∈ T.pieces.erase t₀ := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨h, ht'⟩
        have hytc : y ∈ tᶜ := Set.mem_iInter.mp (Set.mem_iInter.mp hyU t) htErase
        exact (hytc hyt).elim
    · exact fun hyt ↦ piece_subset ht₀' hyt
  have hfrontiers : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (y ∈ frontier s ↔ y ∈ frontier t₀) := by
    filter_upwards [hUopen.eventually_mem hxU] with y hyU
    have heq : s =ᶠ[𝓝 y] t₀ :=
      hsets_on.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUopen.mem_nhds hyU)
    rw [hs.isClosed.frontier_eq, ht₀closed.frontier_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hys, hysi⟩
      exact ⟨Eq.mp (hsets_on hyU) hys, fun hyti ↦ hysi (heq.mem_interior_iff.mpr hyti)⟩
    · rintro ⟨hyt, hyti⟩
      exact ⟨Eq.mpr (hsets_on hyU) hyt, fun hysi ↦ hyti (heq.mem_interior_iff.mp hysi)⟩
  let L : AffineSubspace ℝ Plane := AffineSubspace.mk' x (LinearMap.ker f)
  refine ⟨L, AffineSubspace.self_mem_mk' x (LinearMap.ker f), ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp only [L]
    rw [AffineSubspace.direction_mk']
    exact LinearMap.ker_finrank_of_exists_valueOne f hfvalue
  · filter_upwards [hfrontiers, hffrontier] with y hys hyt
    rw [hys, hyt]
    change f (y - x) = 0 ↔ y - x ∈ LinearMap.ker f
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]

name: Tiling.IsPolygonal.exists_vertex_along_vertical_ray
statement:
private theorem IsPolygonal.exists_vertex_along_vertical_ray
    {D : Set Tiling.Plane} (hD : Tiling.IsPolygonal D) {p v : Tiling.Plane}
    (hp : p ∈ frontier D) (hvne : v ≠ 0) (hvre : v.re = 0)
    (hgerm : ∀ᶠ z in nhds p, z ∈ frontier D ↔ z.re = p.re) :
    ∃ b : ℝ, 0 < b ∧ p + b • v ∈ Tiling.vertexSet D ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) b, p + t • v ∈ frontier D
proof:
:= by
  let φ : ℝ → Tiling.Plane := fun t ↦ p + t • v
  have hφ : Continuous φ := by fun_prop
  let F : Set ℝ := φ ⁻¹' frontier D
  have hFclosed : IsClosed F := isClosed_frontier.preimage hφ
  have hzeroF : (0 : ℝ) ∈ F := by simpa [F, φ] using hp
  have hF_bddAbove : BddAbove F := by
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hD.isBounded.subset_closedBall p
    refine ⟨R / ‖v‖, fun t ht ↦ ?_⟩
