theorem computable_list_foldr [Primcodable α] [Primcodable β]
    {f : β → α → α} (hf : Computable₂ f) :
    Computable₂ (fun (xs : List β) (state : α) => xs.foldr f state)
proof:
:= by
  have hflip : Computable₂ (fun a b => f b a) :=
    (hf.comp Computable.snd Computable.fst).to₂
  have hfold := computable_list_foldl hflip
  refine (hfold.comp (Computable.list_reverse.comp Computable.fst)
    Computable.snd).to₂.of_eq ?_
  rintro ⟨xs, state⟩
  exact List.foldl_reverse

name: Tiling.Computability.List.computable_list_foldr_param
proof:
:= by
  let step : β → γ × α → γ × α :=
    fun b state => (state.1, combine state.1 (b, state.2))
  have hstep : Computable₂ step :=
    (Computable.pair (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd)
      (hcombine.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd)
        (Computable.pair Computable.fst (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)))).to₂
  have hfold := computable_list_foldr hstep
  refine (Computable.snd.comp
    (hfold.comp hxs (Computable.pair Computable.id hinitial))).of_eq ?_
  intro input
  have hsem : (xs input).foldr step (input, initial input) =
      (input, (xs input).foldr (fun b state => combine input (b, state)) (initial input)) := by
    induction xs input with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons b bs ih => simp only [List.foldr_cons, ih, step]
  exact congrArg Prod.snd hsem

name: Tiling.Computability.List.computable_list_map
statement:
theorem computable_list_map {γ : Type*} [Primcodable β] [Primcodable γ]
    {f : β → γ} (hf : Computable f) : Computable (List.map f)
proof:
:= by
  have hstep : Computable₂ (fun b (xs : List γ) => f b :: xs) :=
    (Computable.list_cons.comp (hf.comp Computable.fst) Computable.snd).to₂
  refine ((computable_list_foldr hstep).comp Computable.id (Computable.const [])).of_eq ?_
  intro xs
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b bs _ => simp

proof:

name: Tiling.Computability.totalSearch_mem_rfindOpt
statement:
theorem totalSearch_mem_rfindOpt (valid : α → Bool) (bounded : α → ℕ → Option Bool)
    (halts : BoundedSearchHalts valid bounded) (a : α) (hv : valid a = true) :
    totalSearch valid bounded halts a ∈ Nat.rfindOpt (bounded a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [totalSearch, dif_pos hv]
  exact Part.get_mem _

name: Tiling.Computability.totalSearch_sound
statement:
theorem totalSearch_sound (valid : α → Bool) (bounded : α → ℕ → Option Bool)
    (halts : BoundedSearchHalts valid bounded) (a : α) (hv : valid a = true) :
    ∃ n, totalSearch valid bounded halts a ∈ bounded a n
proof:
:=
  Nat.rfindOpt_spec (totalSearch_mem_rfindOpt valid bounded halts a hv)

name: Tiling.Computability.computable_totalSearch
statement:
theorem computable_totalSearch (valid : α → Bool) (bounded : α → ℕ → Option Bool)
    (hvalid : Computable valid) (hbounded : Computable₂ bounded)
    (halts : BoundedSearchHalts valid bounded) :
    Computable (totalSearch valid bounded halts)
proof:
:= by
  have hsearch : Partrec fun a : α => Nat.rfindOpt (bounded a) :=
    Partrec.rfindOpt hbounded
  have hdefault : Partrec fun _ : α => Part.some false := Partrec.const' (Part.some false)
  have hpartial : Partrec (totalSearchPart valid bounded) :=
    (Partrec.cond hvalid hsearch hdefault).of_eq fun a => by
      simp [totalSearchPart]
  apply Partrec.of_eq_tot hpartial
  intro a
  by_cases hv : valid a = true
  · have hm := totalSearch_mem_rfindOpt valid bounded halts a hv
    simpa [totalSearchPart, totalSearch, hv] using hm
  · simp [totalSearchPart, totalSearch, hv]

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.gcdStep_primrec
statement: private theorem gcdStep_primrec : Primrec gcdStep
proof:
:=
  Primrec.ite (Primrec.eq.comp Primrec.snd (Primrec.const 0)) Primrec.id
    (Primrec.pair Primrec.snd (Primrec.nat_mod.comp Primrec.fst Primrec.snd))

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.gcdStep_iterate
statement:
private theorem gcdStep_iterate (fuel a b : ℕ) (hb : b < fuel) :
    gcdStep^[fuel] (a, b) = (Nat.gcd a b, 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing a b with
  | zero => omega
  | succ fuel ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
    by_cases h : b = 0
    · subst b
      simp only [gcdStep, Nat.gcd_zero_right]
      exact Function.iterate_fixed (by simp [gcdStep]) _
    · rw [gcdStep, if_neg h]
      rw [ih b (a % b) (lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h))
        (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hb))]
      exact congrArg (fun g => (g, 0)) ((Nat.gcd_comm b (a % b)).trans
        ((Nat.gcd_rec b a).symm.trans (Nat.gcd_comm b a)))

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.nat_gcd_primrec
statement: theorem nat_gcd_primrec : Primrec₂ Nat.gcd
proof:
:= by
  have hit : Primrec (fun x : (ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ => gcdStep^[x.2] x.1) := by
    have hrec : Primrec (fun x : (ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ =>
        Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => ℕ × ℕ) x.1 (fun _ p => gcdStep p) x.2) :=
      Primrec.nat_rec Primrec.id
        (gcdStep_primrec.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂
    refine hrec.of_eq ?_
    rintro ⟨p, n⟩
    induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      change gcdStep (Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => ℕ × ℕ) p (fun _ p => gcdStep p) n) = _
      rw [ih, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
  refine (Primrec.fst.comp (hit.comp
    (Primrec.pair Primrec.id (Primrec.succ.comp Primrec.snd)))).to₂.of_eq ?_
  intro a b
  change (gcdStep^[b + 1] (a, b)).1 = Nat.gcd a b
  rw [gcdStep_iterate (b + 1) a b (Nat.lt_succ_self b)]

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.int_natAbs_primrec
statement: theorem int_natAbs_primrec : Primrec Int.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  refine (Primrec.nat_add.comp
    (Primrec.nat_div.comp Primrec.encode (Primrec.const 2))
    (Primrec.nat_mod.comp Primrec.encode (Primrec.const 2))).of_eq ?_
  intro z
  cases z with
  | ofNat n =>
    change (2 * n) / 2 + (2 * n) % 2 = n
    omega
  | negSucc n =>
    change (2 * n + 1) / 2 + (2 * n + 1) % 2 = n + 1
    omega

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.canonicalPair_primrec
statement:
private theorem canonicalPair_primrec :
    PrimrecPred (fun p : ℤ × ℕ => 0 < p.2 ∧ p.1.natAbs.Coprime p.2)
proof:
:= by
  refine (PrimrecPred.and (Primrec.nat_lt.comp (Primrec.const 0) Primrec.snd)
    (Primrec.eq.comp (nat_gcd_primrec.comp
      (int_natAbs_primrec.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd) (Primrec.const 1))).of_eq ?_
  intro p
  rw [Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one]

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.encodable_ext
proof:
:= by
  cases e₁ with
  | mk e₁ d₁ h₁ =>
    cases e₂ with
    | mk e₂ d₂ h₂ =>
      have he' : e₁ = e₂ := funext he
      have hd' : d₁ = d₂ := funext hd
      cases he'
      cases hd'
      rfl

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.sparseRat_encoding_eq
statement:
theorem sparseRat_encoding_eq (q : ℚ) :
    Encodable.encode (SparseRat.mk q) = @Encodable.encode ℚ Rat.instEncodable q
proof: := rfl

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.sparseRat_decode_eq
statement:
theorem sparseRat_decode_eq (n : ℕ) :
    Encodable.decode (α := SparseRat) n =
      (@Encodable.decode ℚ Rat.instEncodable n).map SparseRat.mk
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Encodable.decode_ofEquiv, Option.map_map]
  change (Encodable.decodeSubtype n : Option CanonicalPair).map sparseRatPair.symm =
    (Encodable.decodeSigma n : Option (Σ z : ℤ, {d : ℕ // 0 < d ∧ z.natAbs.Coprime d})).map
      (SparseRat.mk ∘ rationalSigma.symm)
  simp only [Encodable.decodeSubtype, Encodable.decodeSigma, Encodable.decode_prod_val,
    Option.map_bind, Option.bind_assoc]
  apply congrArg (fun f => (Encodable.decode n.unpair.1 : Option ℤ).bind f)
  funext z
  simp only [Function.comp_def, Option.bind_map, Option.map_map]
  change _ = (Encodable.decodeSubtype n.unpair.2 :
    Option {d : ℕ // 0 < d ∧ z.natAbs.Coprime d}).map _
  simp only [Encodable.decodeSubtype, Option.map_bind]
  simp only [Encodable.decode_nat, Option.bind_some]
  by_cases h : 0 < n.unpair.2 ∧ z.natAbs.Coprime n.unpair.2
  · simp only [Function.comp_apply, Option.map_dif]
    split
    · congr 1
      apply congrArg SparseRat.mk
      apply rationalSigma.injective
      change (⟨z, n.unpair.2, h.1, h.2⟩ : Σ z : ℤ, {d : ℕ // 0 < d ∧ z.natAbs.Coprime d}) = _
      rw [rationalSigma.apply_symm_apply]
    · rename_i hn
      exact (hn h).elim
  · simp [h]

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.denseRank_primrec
statement: private theorem denseRank_primrec : Primrec denseRank
proof:
:= by
  refine (Primrec.list_length.comp
    ((Primrec.listFilter (Primcodable.mem_range_encode (α := SparseRat))).comp
      Primrec.list_range)).of_eq ?_
  intro n
  exact List.countP_eq_length_filter.symm

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.native_rat_encoding_eq
statement:
private theorem native_rat_encoding_eq (q : ℚ) :
    Encodable.encode q = denseRank (Encodable.encode (SparseRat.mk q))
proof:
:= by
  let : DecidablePred (fun k => k ∈ Set.range (@Encodable.encode ℚ Rat.instEncodable)) :=
    @Encodable.decidableRangeEncode ℚ Rat.instEncodable
  change (List.range (@Encodable.encode ℚ Rat.instEncodable q)).countP
    (fun k => decide (k ∈ Set.range (@Encodable.encode ℚ Rat.instEncodable))) = _
  unfold denseRank
  apply congrArg (fun p => (List.range (@Encodable.encode ℚ Rat.instEncodable q)).countP p)
  funext k
  apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x⟩, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨x⟩, hx⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx⟩

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.sparseRat_value_primrec
statement: theorem sparseRat_value_primrec : Primrec SparseRat.value
proof:
:= by
  apply Primrec.encode_iff.mp
  exact (denseRank_primrec.comp Primrec.encode).of_eq
    (fun q => (native_rat_encoding_eq q.value).symm)

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.nativeSparseCode_exists
statement:
private theorem nativeSparseCode_exists (q : ℚ) :
    ∃ n, n ∈ Set.range (Encodable.encode : SparseRat → ℕ) ∧ denseRank n = Encodable.encode q
proof:
:=
  ⟨Encodable.encode (SparseRat.mk q), Set.mem_range_self _, (native_rat_encoding_eq q).symm⟩

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.nativeSparseCode_computable
statement: private theorem nativeSparseCode_computable : Computable nativeSparseCode
proof:
:= by
  apply Computable.find
  have hp : PrimrecPred (fun x : ℚ × ℕ =>
      x.2 ∈ Set.range (Encodable.encode : SparseRat → ℕ) ∧ denseRank x.2 = Encodable.encode x.1) :=
    PrimrecPred.and ((Primcodable.mem_range_encode (α := SparseRat)).comp Primrec.snd)
    (Primrec.eq.comp (denseRank_primrec.comp Primrec.snd)
      (Primrec.encode.comp Primrec.fst))
  exact ⟨inferInstance, hp.decide.to_comp⟩

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.sparseRat_mk_computable
statement: theorem sparseRat_mk_computable : Computable SparseRat.mk
proof:
:= by
  have h : Computable (fun q : ℚ =>
      (Encodable.decode (α := SparseRat) (nativeSparseCode q)).getD ⟨0⟩) :=
    Computable.option_getD (Primrec.decode.to_comp.comp nativeSparseCode_computable)
      (Computable.const (⟨0⟩ : SparseRat))
  refine h.of_eq ?_
  intro q
  obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hrank⟩ := Nat.find_spec (nativeSparseCode_exists q)
  have hxq : x.value = q := by
    apply Encodable.encode_injective
    rw [native_rat_encoding_eq x.value]
    exact hx.symm ▸ hrank
  have hxmk : x = SparseRat.mk q := by cases x; congr
  rw [nativeSparseCode, ← hx, Encodable.encodek, Option.getD_some, hxmk]

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.rat_num_computable
statement: theorem rat_num_computable : Computable Rat.num
proof:
:=
  sparseRat_num_primrec.to_comp.comp sparseRat_mk_computable

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.rat_den_computable
statement: theorem rat_den_computable : Computable Rat.den
proof:
:=
  sparseRat_den_primrec.to_comp.comp sparseRat_mk_computable

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.int_ofNat_primrec
statement: theorem int_ofNat_primrec : Primrec Int.ofNat
proof:
:= by
  apply Primrec.encode_iff.mp
  exact (Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2) Primrec.id).of_eq (fun _ => rfl)

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.int_negSucc_primrec
statement: private theorem int_negSucc_primrec : Primrec Int.negSucc
proof:
:= by
  apply Primrec.encode_iff.mp
  exact (Primrec.succ.comp
    (Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2) Primrec.id)).of_eq (fun _ => rfl)

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.int_toNat_primrec
statement: theorem int_toNat_primrec : Primrec Int.toNat
proof:
:= by
  refine (Primrec.cond
    (Primrec.beq.comp (Primrec.nat_mod.comp Primrec.encode (Primrec.const 2))
      (Primrec.const 0))
    (Primrec.nat_div.comp Primrec.encode (Primrec.const 2)) (Primrec.const 0)).of_eq ?_
  intro z
  cases z with
  | ofNat n =>
    change (bif (2 * n) % 2 == 0 then (2 * n) / 2 else 0) = n
    simp
  | negSucc n =>
    change (bif (2 * n + 1) % 2 == 0 then (2 * n + 1) / 2 else 0) = 0
    simp

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.negativeMagnitude_primrec
statement: private theorem negativeMagnitude_primrec : Primrec negativeMagnitude
proof:
:=
  Primrec.nat_sub.comp int_natAbs_primrec int_toNat_primrec

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.integer_magnitudes
statement:
private theorem integer_magnitudes (z : ℤ) :
    z = (z.toNat : ℤ) - (negativeMagnitude z : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  cases z with
  | ofNat n => simp [negativeMagnitude]
  | negSucc n =>
    change Int.negSucc n = (0 : ℤ) - ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
    rw [Int.negSucc_eq]
    simp

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.int_subNatNat_primrec
statement: theorem int_subNatNat_primrec : Primrec₂ Int.subNatNat
proof:
:= by
  refine (Primrec.nat_casesOn (Primrec.nat_sub.comp Primrec.snd Primrec.fst)
    (int_ofNat_primrec.comp (Primrec.nat_sub.comp Primrec.fst Primrec.snd))
    (int_negSucc_primrec.comp Primrec.snd).to₂).to₂.of_eq ?_
  intro m n
  change Nat.casesOn (n - m) (Int.ofNat (m - n)) Int.negSucc = Int.subNatNat m n
  unfold Int.subNatNat
  cases n - m <;> rfl

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.int_add_primrec
statement: theorem int_add_primrec : Primrec₂ (fun x y : ℤ => x + y)
proof:
:= by
  refine (int_subNatNat_primrec.comp
    (Primrec.nat_add.comp (int_toNat_primrec.comp Primrec.fst)
      (int_toNat_primrec.comp Primrec.snd))
    (Primrec.nat_add.comp (negativeMagnitude_primrec.comp Primrec.fst)
      (negativeMagnitude_primrec.comp Primrec.snd))).to₂.of_eq ?_
  intro x y
  rw [Int.subNatNat_eq_coe, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_add]
  conv_rhs => rw [integer_magnitudes x, integer_magnitudes y]
  ring

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.int_neg_primrec
statement: theorem int_neg_primrec : Primrec (fun x : ℤ => -x)
proof:
:= by
  refine (int_subNatNat_primrec.comp negativeMagnitude_primrec int_toNat_primrec).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  rw [Int.subNatNat_eq_coe]
  conv_rhs => rw [integer_magnitudes x]
  ring

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.int_mul_primrec
statement: theorem int_mul_primrec : Primrec₂ (fun x y : ℤ => x * y)
proof:
:= by
  refine (int_subNatNat_primrec.comp
    (Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.nat_mul.comp (int_toNat_primrec.comp Primrec.fst)
        (int_toNat_primrec.comp Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.nat_mul.comp (negativeMagnitude_primrec.comp Primrec.fst)
        (negativeMagnitude_primrec.comp Primrec.snd)))
    (Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.nat_mul.comp (int_toNat_primrec.comp Primrec.fst)
        (negativeMagnitude_primrec.comp Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.nat_mul.comp (negativeMagnitude_primrec.comp Primrec.fst)
        (int_toNat_primrec.comp Primrec.snd)))).to₂.of_eq ?_
  intro x y
  rw [Int.subNatNat_eq_coe, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_add]
  simp only [Nat.cast_mul]
  conv_rhs => rw [integer_magnitudes x, integer_magnitudes y]
  ring

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.int_le_primrec
statement: theorem int_le_primrec : PrimrecRel (fun x y : ℤ => x ≤ y)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Primrec.nat_le.comp
    (Primrec.nat_add.comp (int_toNat_primrec.comp Primrec.fst)
      (negativeMagnitude_primrec.comp Primrec.snd))
    (Primrec.nat_add.comp (int_toNat_primrec.comp Primrec.snd)
      (negativeMagnitude_primrec.comp Primrec.fst))).of_eq ?_
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩
  change (x.toNat + negativeMagnitude y ≤ y.toNat + negativeMagnitude x) ↔ x ≤ y
  have hx := integer_magnitudes x
  have hy := integer_magnitudes y
  omega

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.int_lt_primrec
statement: theorem int_lt_primrec : PrimrecRel (fun x y : ℤ => x < y)
proof:
:=
  (int_le_primrec.swap.not).of_eq (fun _ _ => not_le)

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.int_add_computable
statement: theorem int_add_computable : Computable₂ (fun x y : ℤ => x + y)
proof: := int_add_primrec.to_comp

proof: := int_neg_primrec.to_comp

statement: theorem int_natAbs_computable : Computable Int.natAbs

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.int_le_computable
statement: theorem int_le_computable : Computable₂ (fun x y : ℤ => decide (x ≤ y))

  int_le_primrec.decide.to_comp

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.int_lt_computable
statement: theorem int_lt_computable : Computable₂ (fun x y : ℤ => decide (x < y))

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.computable_of_graph
statement:
theorem computable_of_graph {α β : Type*} [Primcodable α] [Denumerable β] [DecidableEq β]
    {f : α → β} (hgraph : Computable (fun p : α × β => decide (f p.1 = p.2))) :
    Computable f
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∀ a : α, ∃ n, f a = Denumerable.ofNat β n :=
    fun a => ⟨Encodable.encode (f a), (Denumerable.ofNat_encode (f a)).symm⟩
  have hp : ComputablePred (fun p : α × ℕ => f p.1 = Denumerable.ofNat β p.2) :=
    ⟨inferInstance, hgraph.comp
      (Computable.pair Computable.fst ((Primrec.ofNat β).to_comp.comp Computable.snd))⟩
  exact ((Primrec.ofNat β).to_comp.comp (Computable.find hp hex)).of_eq
    (fun a => (Nat.find_spec (hex a)).symm)

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.rat_divInt_computable
statement: theorem rat_divInt_computable : Computable₂ Rat.divInt
proof:
:= by
  apply computable_of_graph
  have hn : Computable (fun x : (ℤ × ℤ) × ℚ => x.1.1) :=
    Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst
  have hd : Computable (fun x : (ℤ × ℤ) × ℚ => x.1.2) :=
    Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst
  have hnum : Computable (fun x : (ℤ × ℤ) × ℚ => x.2.num) :=
    rat_num_computable.comp Computable.snd
  have hden : Computable (fun x : (ℤ × ℤ) × ℚ => (x.2.den : ℤ)) :=
    int_ofNat_computable.comp (rat_den_computable.comp Computable.snd)
  have hzero : Computable (fun x : (ℤ × ℤ) × ℚ => decide (x.1.2 = 0)) :=
    (Primrec.eq.decide : Primrec₂ (fun n m : ℤ => decide (n = m))).to_comp.comp
      hd (Computable.const 0)
  have hqzero : Computable (fun x : (ℤ × ℤ) × ℚ => decide (x.2 = 0)) :=
    (Primrec.eq.decide : Primrec₂ (fun q r : ℚ => decide (q = r))).to_comp.comp
      Computable.snd (Computable.const 0)
  have hcross : Computable (fun x : (ℤ × ℤ) × ℚ =>
      decide (x.1.1 * (x.2.den : ℤ) = x.2.num * x.1.2)) :=
    (Primrec.eq.decide : Primrec₂ (fun n m : ℤ => decide (n = m))).to_comp.comp
      (int_mul_computable.comp hn hden) (int_mul_computable.comp hnum hd)
  refine (Computable.cond hzero hqzero hcross).of_eq ?_
  rintro ⟨⟨n, d⟩, q⟩
  change (bif decide (d = 0) then decide (q = 0) else
    decide (n * (q.den : ℤ) = q.num * d)) = decide (Rat.divInt n d = q)
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · simp [hd, eq_comm]
  · simp only [hd, decide_false, Bool.cond_false]
    apply Bool.decide_congr
    exact (Rat.divInt_eq_divInt_iff hd (Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr q.den_nz)).symm.trans
      (by rw [Rat.num_divInt_den])

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.rat_mkRat_computable
statement: theorem rat_mkRat_computable : Computable₂ mkRat
proof:
:= by
  have h : Computable (fun p : ℤ × ℕ => Rat.divInt p.1 (Int.ofNat p.2)) :=
    rat_divInt_computable.comp Computable.fst
      (int_ofNat_computable.comp Computable.snd)
  exact h.of_eq (fun p => (Rat.mkRat_eq_divInt p.1 p.2).symm)

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.int_rat_computable
statement: theorem int_rat_computable : Computable (fun n : ℤ => (n : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  exact (rat_divInt_computable.comp Computable.id (Computable.const 1)).of_eq
    (fun n => (Rat.intCast_eq_divInt n).symm)

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.nat_rat_computable
statement: theorem nat_rat_computable : Computable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℚ))
proof:
:=
  int_rat_computable.comp int_ofNat_computable

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.rat_neg_computable
statement: theorem rat_neg_computable : Computable (fun q : ℚ => -q)
proof:
:= by
  refine (rat_divInt_computable.comp (int_neg_computable.comp rat_num_computable)
    (int_ofNat_computable.comp rat_den_computable)).of_eq ?_
  intro q
  exact (Rat.neg_def q).symm

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.rat_add_computable
statement: theorem rat_add_computable : Computable₂ (fun q r : ℚ => q + r)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : Computable (fun x : ℚ × ℚ => x.1.num) :=
    rat_num_computable.comp Computable.fst
  have hm : Computable (fun x : ℚ × ℚ => x.2.num) :=
    rat_num_computable.comp Computable.snd
  have hd : Computable (fun x : ℚ × ℚ => x.1.den) :=
    rat_den_computable.comp Computable.fst
  have he : Computable (fun x : ℚ × ℚ => x.2.den) :=
    rat_den_computable.comp Computable.snd
  refine (rat_mkRat_computable.comp
    (int_add_computable.comp
      (int_mul_computable.comp hn (int_ofNat_computable.comp he))
      (int_mul_computable.comp hm (int_ofNat_computable.comp hd)))
    (Primrec.nat_mul.to_comp.comp hd he)).to₂.of_eq ?_
  rintro ⟨q, r⟩
  exact (Rat.add_def' q r).symm

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.rat_mul_computable
statement: theorem rat_mul_computable : Computable₂ (fun q r : ℚ => q * r)
proof:
:= by
  refine (rat_mkRat_computable.comp
    (int_mul_computable.comp (rat_num_computable.comp Computable.fst)
      (rat_num_computable.comp Computable.snd))
    (Primrec.nat_mul.to_comp.comp (rat_den_computable.comp Computable.fst)
      (rat_den_computable.comp Computable.snd))).to₂.of_eq ?_
  rintro ⟨q, r⟩
  exact (Rat.mul_def' q r).symm

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.rat_le_computable
statement: theorem rat_le_computable : Computable₂ (fun q r : ℚ => decide (q ≤ r))
proof:
:= by
  refine (int_le_computable.comp
    (int_mul_computable.comp (rat_num_computable.comp Computable.fst)
      (int_ofNat_computable.comp (rat_den_computable.comp Computable.snd)))
    (int_mul_computable.comp (rat_num_computable.comp Computable.snd)
      (int_ofNat_computable.comp (rat_den_computable.comp Computable.fst)))).to₂.of_eq ?_
  rintro ⟨q, r⟩
  exact Bool.decide_congr (Rat.le_iff q r).symm

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.rat_lt_computable
statement: theorem rat_lt_computable : Computable₂ (fun q r : ℚ => decide (q < r))
proof:
:= by
  refine (int_lt_computable.comp
    (int_mul_computable.comp (rat_num_computable.comp Computable.fst)
      (int_ofNat_computable.comp (rat_den_computable.comp Computable.snd)))
    (int_mul_computable.comp (rat_num_computable.comp Computable.snd)
      (int_ofNat_computable.comp (rat_den_computable.comp Computable.fst)))).to₂.of_eq ?_
  rintro ⟨q, r⟩
  exact Bool.decide_congr (Rat.lt_iff q r).symm

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.int_sub_primrec
statement: theorem int_sub_primrec : Primrec₂ (fun x y : ℤ => x - y)
proof:
:= by

    (fun x y => (sub_eq_add_neg x y).symm)

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.int_sub_computable
statement: theorem int_sub_computable : Computable₂ (fun x y : ℤ => x - y)

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.rat_sub_computable

    (rat_neg_computable.comp Computable.snd)).of_eq
      (fun p : ℚ × ℚ => (sub_eq_add_neg p.1 p.2).symm)

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.rat_inv_computable
statement: theorem rat_inv_computable : Computable (fun q : ℚ => q⁻¹)
proof:
:=
  (rat_divInt_computable.comp (int_ofNat_computable.comp rat_den_computable)
    rat_num_computable).of_eq (fun q => (Rat.inv_def q).symm)

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.rat_div_computable

proof:
:=
  (rat_mul_computable.comp Computable.fst
    (rat_inv_computable.comp Computable.snd)).of_eq
      (fun p : ℚ × ℚ => (div_eq_mul_inv p.1 p.2).symm)

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.monoid_pow_primrec
statement:
theorem monoid_pow_primrec {α : Type*} [Primcodable α] [Monoid α]
    (hmul : Primrec₂ (fun x y : α => x * y)) : Primrec₂ (fun x : α => (x ^ · : ℕ → α))
proof:
:= by
  have hrec : Primrec (fun p : α × ℕ =>
      Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => α) 1 (fun _ r => r * p.1) p.2) :=
    Primrec.nat_rec (Primrec.const 1)
      (hmul.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd) Primrec.fst).to₂
  refine hrec.to₂.of_eq ?_
  intro x n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact (pow_zero x).symm
  | succ n ih =>
    change Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => α) 1 (fun _ r => r * x) n * x = x ^ (n + 1)
    rw [ih, pow_succ]

name: Tiling.Computability.Rational.monoid_pow_computable
statement:
theorem monoid_pow_computable {α : Type*} [Primcodable α] [Monoid α]
    (hmul : Computable₂ (fun x y : α => x * y)) :
    Computable₂ (fun x : α => (x ^ · : ℕ → α))
proof:
:= by
  have hrec : Computable (fun p : α × ℕ =>
      Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => α) 1 (fun _ r => r * p.1) p.2) :=
    Computable.nat_rec Computable.snd (Computable.const 1)
      (hmul.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)
        (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst)).to₂
  refine hrec.of_eq ?_
  rintro ⟨x, n⟩
  induction n with
  | zero => exact (pow_zero x).symm
  | succ n ih =>
    change Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => α) 1 (fun _ r => r * x) n * x = x ^ (n + 1)
    rw [ih, pow_succ]

statement: theorem nat_pow_primrec : Primrec₂ (fun x : ℕ => (x ^ · : ℕ → ℕ))
proof:
:=
  monoid_pow_primrec Primrec.nat_mul

statement: theorem int_pow_primrec : Primrec₂ (fun x : ℤ => (x ^ · : ℕ → ℤ))

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.boundedSteps_generate
statement:
theorem boundedSteps_generate :
  ∀ Y : Set Plane, Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC Y → RelativeDense Y →
    ∀ y₀ ∈ Y, ∃ steps : Finset Plane, (steps : Set Plane) ⊆ Y - Y ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Y, y - y₀ ∈ AddSubgroup.closure (steps : Set Plane)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro Y hYFLC ⟨rho, hrho, hYdense⟩ y0 hy0
  let stepSet := (Y - Y) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 (3 * rho)
  have hstepFinite : stepSet.Finite := hYFLC.2 (3 * rho) (by linarith)
  let steps := hstepFinite.toFinset
  refine ⟨steps, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro d hd
    have hdSet : d ∈ stepSet :=
      hstepFinite.mem_toFinset.mp (show d ∈ hstepFinite.toFinset from hd)
    exact hdSet.1
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨n : ℕ, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (dist y y0 / rho)
    have hratioNonneg : 0 ≤ dist y y0 / rho := div_nonneg dist_nonneg hrho.le
    have hnRealPos : 0 < (n : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt hratioNonneg hn
    have hnPos : 0 < n := by exact_mod_cast hnRealPos
    have hsmall : dist y y0 / (n : ℝ) < rho := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hnRealPos]
      have := (div_lt_iff₀ hrho).mp hn
      nlinarith
    let c : Fin (n + 1) → Plane := fun i ↦
      y0 + ((i : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)) • (y - y0)
    choose q hqY hqDist using fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ hYdense (c i)
    let p : Fin (n + 1) → Plane := fun i ↦
      if i = 0 then y0 else if i = Fin.last n then y else q i
    have hpY : ∀ i, p i ∈ Y := by
      intro i
      simp only [p]
      split
      · exact hy0
      · split
        · exact hy
        · exact hqY i
    have hcZero : c 0 = y0 := by simp [c]
    have hcLast : c (Fin.last n) = y := by
      change y0 + ((n : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)) • (y - y0) = y
      rw [div_self (ne_of_gt hnRealPos), one_smul]
      abel
    have hpClose : ∀ i, dist (p i) (c i) < rho := by
      intro i
      by_cases hi0 : i = 0
      · subst i
        rw [hcZero]
        simp [p, hrho]
      · by_cases hiLast : i = Fin.last n
        · subst i
          rw [hcLast]
          have hlast0 : Fin.last n ≠ (0 : Fin (n + 1)) := by
            intro h
            have := congrArg Fin.val h
            simp only [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_zero] at this
            omega
          simp [p, hlast0, hrho]
        · simpa only [p, hi0, hiLast, if_false, dist_comm] using hqDist i
    have hcStep : ∀ i : Fin n,
        dist (c i.succ) (c i.castSucc) = dist y y0 / (n : ℝ) := by
      intro i
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      change ‖(y0 + (((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)) • (y - y0)) -
          (y0 + ((i.val : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)) • (y - y0))‖ =
        dist y y0 / (n : ℝ)
      rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← sub_smul]
      have hcoef :
          ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) - (i.val : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) =
            ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
        push_cast
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [hcoef, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hnRealPos),
        dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev, div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring
    have hpStep : ∀ i : Fin n, dist (p i.succ) (p i.castSucc) < 3 * rho := by
      intro i
      have h₁ := dist_triangle (p i.succ) (c i.succ) (p i.castSucc)
      have h₂ := dist_triangle (c i.succ) (c i.castSucc) (p i.castSucc)
      rw [hcStep i] at h₂
      have hclose₁ := hpClose i.succ
      have hclose₂ := hpClose i.castSucc
      rw [dist_comm (p i.castSucc)] at hclose₂
      linarith
    have hstepMem : ∀ i : Fin n, p i.succ - p i.castSucc ∈ steps := by
      intro i
      apply hstepFinite.mem_toFinset.mpr
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact ⟨p i.succ, hpY i.succ, p i.castSucc, hpY i.castSucc, rfl⟩
      · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero]
        simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using (hpStep i).le
    let pNat : ℕ → Plane := fun k ↦
      if hk : k < n + 1 then p ⟨k, hk⟩ else 0
    have hsum :
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (pNat (k + 1) - pNat k) ∈
          AddSubgroup.closure (steps : Set Plane) := by
      apply AddSubgroup.sum_mem
      intro k hk
      have hkn : k < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
      have hk1 : k + 1 < n + 1 := by omega
      have hk0 : k < n + 1 := by omega
      have hmem := hstepMem (⟨k, hkn⟩ : Fin n)
      apply AddSubgroup.subset_closure
      simp only [pNat, dif_pos hk1, dif_pos hk0]
      change p ⟨k + 1, hk1⟩ - p ⟨k, hk0⟩ ∈ steps
      simpa using hmem
    rw [Finset.sum_range_sub] at hsum
    have hpNatLast : pNat n = y := by
      have hnlt : n < n + 1 := by omega
      simp only [pNat, dif_pos hnlt]
      have hfin : (⟨n, hnlt⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) = Fin.last n := by ext; rfl
      rw [hfin]
      have hlast0 : Fin.last n ≠ (0 : Fin (n + 1)) := by
        intro h
        have := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp only [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_zero] at this
        omega
      simp only [p, if_neg hlast0, if_pos]
    have hpNatZero : pNat 0 = y0 := by
      have hzero : 0 < n + 1 := by omega
      simp only [pNat, dif_pos hzero]
      simp [p]
    rwa [hpNatLast, hpNatZero] at hsum

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.commonMesh_of_finiteZGeneration
statement:
theorem commonMesh_of_finiteZGeneration :
  ∀ (steps : Finset Plane) (φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ), ∃ d : ℕ, 0 < d ∧
    deformPoint φ '' (AddSubgroup.closure (steps : Set Plane) : Set Plane) ⊆ RationalMesh d
proof:
:= by
  intro steps φ
  classical
  let coords : Finset ℚ :=
    (steps.image (fun z : Plane => φ z.re)) ∪
      (steps.image (fun z : Plane => φ z.im))
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hcoord⟩ := finiteRational_denominator coords
  refine ⟨d, hd, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  rcases hz with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hclosed : ∀ w ∈ (AddSubgroup.closure (steps : Set Plane) : Set Plane),
      deformPoint φ w ∈
        {z | ∃ p q : ℤ, z = Complex.mk ((p : ℝ) / d) ((q : ℝ) / d)} := by
    
    
    let mesh : AddSubgroup Plane := {
      carrier := {w | ∃ p q : ℤ, w = Complex.mk ((p : ℝ) / d) ((q : ℝ) / d)}
      zero_mem' := by
        refine ⟨0, 0, ?_⟩
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp
      add_mem' := by
        intro a b ha hb
        rcases ha with ⟨pa, qa, rfl⟩
        rcases hb with ⟨pb, qb, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨pa + pb, qa + qb, ?_⟩
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Int.cast_add, add_div]
      neg_mem' := by
        intro a ha
        rcases ha with ⟨p, q, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨-p, -q, ?_⟩
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Int.cast_neg, neg_div]
    }
    intro w hw
    change deformPoint φ w ∈ (mesh : Set Plane)
    induction hw using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem u hu =>
        rcases hcoord (φ u.re)
          (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩))) with ⟨p, hp⟩
        rcases hcoord (φ u.im)
          (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩))) with ⟨q, hq⟩
        exact ⟨p, q, by simp [deformPoint, hp, hq]⟩
    | zero => exact ⟨0, 0, by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [deformPoint]⟩
    | add a b ha hb iha ihb =>
        change deformPointLinear φ (a + b) ∈ (mesh : Set Plane)
        rw [map_add]
        exact mesh.add_mem iha ihb
    | neg a ha iha =>
        change deformPointLinear φ (-a) ∈ (mesh : Set Plane)
        rw [map_neg]
        exact mesh.neg_mem iha
  exact hclosed x hx

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.flcApproximation_commonMesh
statement:
theorem flcApproximation_commonMesh :
  ∀ (T : Set Plane) (V : Finset Plane), 0 ∈ T →
    Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC T → RelativeDense T →
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, ∃ d : ℕ, 0 < d ∧
        deformPoint φ '' (T ∪ (V : Set Plane)) ⊆ RationalMesh d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro T V hzero hT hdense φ
  obtain ⟨steps, hsub, hgenerated⟩ := boundedSteps_generate T hT hdense 0 hzero
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hmesh⟩ := commonMesh_of_finiteZGeneration (steps ∪ V) φ
  refine ⟨d, hd, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  apply hmesh
  refine ⟨z, ?_, rfl⟩
  rcases hz with hz | hz
  · have hclosure : AddSubgroup.closure (steps : Set Plane) ≤
        AddSubgroup.closure ((steps ∪ V : Finset Plane) : Set Plane) :=
      AddSubgroup.closure_mono (by intro x hx; exact Finset.mem_union_left _ hx)
    exact hclosure (by simpa only [sub_zero] using hgenerated z hz)
  · exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Finset.mem_union_right _ hz)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.denseSegmentChain
statement:
private theorem denseSegmentChain
    (Y : Set Plane) (rho L R : ℝ) (hrho : 0 < rho) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hLR : L + 2 * rho < R)
    (a b : ↥Y)
    (hdense : ∀ s : ℝ, ∃ y ∈ Y, dist ((a : Plane) + s • ((b : Plane) - a)) y < rho)
    (hLab : L < dist (a : Plane) b) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ∃ point : Fin (N + 1) → ↥Y,
      point 0 = a ∧ point (Fin.last N) = b ∧
      (∀ i : Fin N, dist (point i.castSucc : Plane) (point i.succ) < R) ∧
      (N : ℝ) ≤ dist (a : Plane) b / L + 1
proof:
:= by
  let D := dist (a : Plane) b
  let N := Nat.ceil (D / L)
  have hDL : 1 < D / L := by
    apply (lt_div_iff₀ hL).2
    simpa [D] using hLab
  have hNpos : 0 < N := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (lt_trans zero_lt_one hDL)
  have hNreal : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hNpos
  have hstepLe : D / (N : ℝ) ≤ L := by
    have hceil : D / L ≤ (N : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hNreal]
    have := (div_le_iff₀ hL).mp hceil
    nlinarith
  have hNle : (N : ℝ) ≤ D / L + 1 :=
    le_of_lt (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (div_nonneg (by simp [D]) hL.le))
  let c : Fin (N + 1) → Plane := fun i ↦
    (a : Plane) + ((i : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) •
      ((b : Plane) - (a : Plane))
  choose q hqY hqdist using fun i : Fin (N + 1) ↦ hdense ((i : ℝ) / (N : ℝ))
  let p : Fin (N + 1) → Plane := fun i ↦
    if i = 0 then a else if i = Fin.last N then b else q i
  have hpY (i : Fin (N + 1)) : p i ∈ Y := by
    simp only [p]
    split
    · exact a.2
    · split
      · exact b.2
      · exact hqY i
  have hcZero : c 0 = a := by simp [c]
  have hcLast : c (Fin.last N) = b := by
    change (a : Plane) + ((N : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) •
      ((b : Plane) - (a : Plane)) = b
    rw [div_self (ne_of_gt hNreal), one_smul]
    abel
  have hpClose (i : Fin (N + 1)) : dist (p i) (c i) < rho := by
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0
    · subst i
      rw [hcZero]
      simp [p, hrho]
    · by_cases hilast : i = Fin.last N
      · subst i
        rw [hcLast]
        have hlast0 : Fin.last N ≠ (0 : Fin (N + 1)) := by
          intro h
          have := congrArg Fin.val h
          simp only [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_zero] at this
          omega
        simp [p, hlast0, hrho]
      · simpa [p, c, hi0, hilast, dist_comm] using hqdist i
  have hcStep (i : Fin N) :
      dist (c i.succ) (c i.castSucc) = D / (N : ℝ) := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    change ‖((a : Plane) + (((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) •
        ((b : Plane) - (a : Plane))) -
      ((a : Plane) + ((i.val : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) •
        ((b : Plane) - (a : Plane)))‖ = D / (N : ℝ)
    rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← sub_smul]
    have hcoef : (((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) -
        (i.val : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) = (N : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      push_cast
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hcoef, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hNreal),
      show ‖(b : Plane) - (a : Plane)‖ = D by
        rw [norm_sub_rev]
        simp [D, dist_eq_norm], div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  have hpStep (i : Fin N) :
      dist (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ) < R := by
    calc
      dist (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ) ≤
          dist (p i.castSucc) (c i.castSucc) +
            dist (c i.castSucc) (c i.succ) + dist (c i.succ) (p i.succ) :=
        dist_triangle4 _ _ _ _
      _ < rho + (D / (N : ℝ)) + rho := by
        rw [dist_comm (c i.castSucc) (c i.succ), hcStep]
        have hlast := hpClose i.succ
        rw [dist_comm] at hlast
        linarith [hpClose i.castSucc, hlast]
      _ ≤ rho + L + rho := by linarith
      _ < R := by linarith
  let point : Fin (N + 1) → ↥Y := fun i ↦ ⟨p i, hpY i⟩
  refine ⟨N, hNpos, point, ?_, ?_, ?_, hNle⟩
  · apply Subtype.ext
    simp [point, p]
  · apply Subtype.ext
    have hlast0 : Fin.last N ≠ (0 : Fin (N + 1)) := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp only [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_zero] at this
      omega
    simp [point, p, hlast0]
  · exact hpStep

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.deformPoint_sub
statement:
private theorem deformPoint_sub (φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (a b : Plane) :
    deformPoint φ (a - b) = deformPoint φ a - deformPoint φ b
proof:
:=
  (deformPointLinear φ).map_sub a b

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.finitePointControl
statement:
private theorem finitePointControl (D : Finset Plane) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
        ∀ d ∈ D, ‖deformPoint φ d - d‖ < η
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨D.image Complex.re ∪ D.image Complex.im, η / 2, half_pos hη, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ d hd
  have hre := hφ.2 d.re (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩))
  have him := hφ.2 d.im (Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩))
  have hn : ‖deformPoint φ d - d‖ ≤ |(φ d.re : ℝ) - d.re| + |(φ d.im : ℝ) - d.im| :=
    Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im (deformPoint φ d - d)
  linarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.globalRelativeError_of_segmentDensity
statement:
private theorem globalRelativeError_of_segmentDensity
    (Y : Set Plane) (hY : Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC Y) (rho : ℝ) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hdense : ∀ a ∈ Y, ∀ b ∈ Y, ∀ s : ℝ, ∃ y ∈ Y, dist (a + s • (b - a)) y < rho) :
    ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → c < 1 → ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
        ∀ a ∈ Y, ∀ b ∈ Y,
          ‖deformPoint φ (a - b) - (a - b)‖ ≤ c * dist a b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro c hc _
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hsep⟩ := hY.uniformlyDiscrete
  let S := (Y - Y) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 (4 * rho)
  have hS : S.Finite := hY.2 (4 * rho) (by linarith)
  let D := hS.toFinset
  let η := min (c * δ) (c * rho / 2)
  have hη : 0 < η := lt_min (mul_pos hc hδ) (half_pos (mul_pos hc hrho))
  obtain ⟨F, ε, hε, hcontrol⟩ := finitePointControl D η hη
  refine ⟨F, ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ a ha b hb
  let e : Plane →+ Plane := (deformPointLinear φ).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id Plane
  have he (z : Plane) : e z = deformPoint φ z - z := rfl
  have hstep (x : Plane) (hx : x ∈ Y) (y : Plane) (hy : y ∈ Y)
      (hxy : dist x y < 4 * rho) : ‖e (x - y)‖ < η := by
    apply hcontrol φ hφ (x - y)
    apply hS.mem_toFinset.mpr
    refine ⟨⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, ← dist_eq_norm] using hxy.le
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst b
    change ‖e (a - a)‖ ≤ c * dist a a
    simp
  by_cases hshort : dist a b ≤ rho
  · have hdist : dist a b < 4 * rho := by linarith
    have hδab : δ ≤ dist a b := hsep ha hb hab
    calc
      ‖deformPoint φ (a - b) - (a - b)‖ ≤ η := (hstep a ha b hb hdist).le
      _ ≤ c * δ := min_le_left _ _
      _ ≤ c * dist a b := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδab hc.le
  · have hlong : rho < dist b a := by simpa only [dist_comm] using lt_of_not_ge hshort
    obtain ⟨N, hN, p, hp0, hpN, hpstep, hcount⟩ :=
      denseSegmentChain Y rho rho (4 * rho) hrho hrho (by linarith)
        ⟨b, hb⟩ ⟨a, ha⟩ (hdense b hb a ha) hlong
    let pNat : ℕ → Plane := fun k ↦ if hk : k < N + 1 then p ⟨k, hk⟩ else 0
    have hpNat0 : pNat 0 = b := by
      simp only [pNat, dif_pos (by omega : 0 < N + 1)]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val hp0
    have hpNatN : pNat N = a := by
      simp only [pNat, dif_pos (by omega : N < N + 1)]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val hpN
    have hbound (k : ℕ) (hk : k ∈ Finset.range N) :
        ‖e (pNat (k + 1) - pNat k)‖ ≤ η := by
      have hkn := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
      have hk1 : k + 1 < N + 1 := by omega
      have hk0 : k < N + 1 := by omega
      simp only [pNat, dif_pos hk1, dif_pos hk0]
      exact (hstep _ (p ⟨k + 1, hk1⟩).2 _ (p ⟨k, hk0⟩).2
        (by simpa [dist_comm] using hpstep (⟨k, hkn⟩ : Fin N))).le
    have hsum : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, e (pNat (k + 1) - pNat k) = e (a - b) := by
      rw [← map_sum, Finset.sum_range_sub, hpNat0, hpNatN]
    have hNnonneg : 0 ≤ (N : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg N
    have hηle : η ≤ c * rho / 2 := min_le_right _ _
    have hcountMul : (N : ℝ) * rho ≤ dist a b + rho := by
      have hh := (le_div_iff₀ hrho).mp (show (N : ℝ) ≤ (dist b a + rho) / rho by
        calc
          (N : ℝ) ≤ dist b a / rho + 1 := hcount
          _ = (dist b a + rho) / rho := by field_simp)
      simpa only [dist_comm] using hh
    calc
      ‖deformPoint φ (a - b) - (a - b)‖ = ‖e (a - b)‖ := rfl
      _ = ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, e (pNat (k + 1) - pNat k)‖ := by rw [hsum]
      _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, ‖e (pNat (k + 1) - pNat k)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range N, η := Finset.sum_le_sum hbound
      _ = (N : ℝ) * η := by simp
      _ ≤ c * dist a b := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hηle hNnonneg
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcountMul hc.le]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.approximation_globalRelativeError
statement:
theorem approximation_globalRelativeError :
  ∀ Y : Set Plane, Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC Y → RelativeDense Y →
    ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → c < 1 → ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
        ∀ a ∈ Y, ∀ b ∈ Y,
          ‖deformPoint φ (a - b) - (a - b)‖ ≤ c * dist a b
proof:
:= by
  intro Y hY ⟨rho, hrho, hdense⟩
  exact globalRelativeError_of_segmentDensity Y hY rho hrho
    (fun _ _ _ _ s ↦ hdense _)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.deformation_lowerBound
proof:
:= by
  have htriangle : dist a b ≤ ‖deformPoint φ (a - b) - (a - b)‖ +
      dist (deformPoint φ a) (deformPoint φ b) := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, ← deformPoint_sub]
    calc
      ‖a - b‖ = ‖((a - b) - deformPoint φ (a - b)) + deformPoint φ (a - b)‖ := by
        congr 1
        abel
      _ ≤ ‖(a - b) - deformPoint φ (a - b)‖ + ‖deformPoint φ (a - b)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [norm_sub_rev]
  nlinarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.finiteScalarReflection
statement:
private theorem finiteScalarReflection (Z : Finset ℝ) :
    ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
        ∀ z ∈ Z, (φ z : ℝ) = 0 ↔ z = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨F, ε, hε, hreflect⟩ := finiteApproximation_signAndEquality (insert 0 Z)
  refine ⟨F, ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ z hz
  have heq := (hreflect φ hφ).2 z (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hz) 0 (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  simpa only [map_zero, Rat.cast_eq_zero] using heq

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.boundedDifference_mem
statement:
private theorem boundedDifference_mem {Y : Set Plane} {M : ℝ}
    (hfinite : ((Y - Y) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 M).Finite)
    {a b : Plane} (ha : a ∈ Y) (hb : b ∈ Y) (hab : dist a b < M) :
    a - b ∈ hfinite.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  apply hfinite.mem_toFinset.mpr
  exact ⟨⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩, by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hab.le⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.approximation_boundedMetricAndRelationControl
statement:
theorem approximation_boundedMetricAndRelationControl :
  ∀ Y : Set Plane, Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC Y → RelativeDense Y →
    ∀ (M η : ℝ) (normals : Finset RationalNormal), 0 < M → 0 < η →
      ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
        ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
          Set.InjOn (deformPoint φ) Y ∧
          (∀ a ∈ Y, ∀ b ∈ Y, dist a b < M →
            dist (deformPoint φ a - deformPoint φ b) (a - b) < η) ∧
          (∀ a ∈ Y, ∀ b ∈ Y,
            dist (deformPoint φ a) (deformPoint φ b) < M / 2 → dist a b < M) ∧
          (∀ a ∈ Y, ∀ b ∈ Y,
            dist (deformPoint φ a) (deformPoint φ b) < M / 2 →
              ∀ n ∈ normals,
                normalEval n (deformPoint φ a - deformPoint φ b) = 0 ↔
                  normalEval n (a - b) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro Y hY hdense M η normals hM hη
  obtain ⟨F0, ε0, hε0, hglobal⟩ := approximation_globalRelativeError Y hY hdense
    (1 / 4) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hfinite := hY.2 M hM
  let D := hfinite.toFinset
  obtain ⟨F1, ε1, hε1, hlocal⟩ := finitePointControl D η hη
  let Z := (D.product normals).image (fun p ↦ normalEval p.2 p.1)
  obtain ⟨F2, ε2, hε2, hreflect⟩ := finiteScalarReflection Z
  let F := F0 ∪ (F1 ∪ F2)
  let ε := min ε0 (min ε1 ε2)
  refine ⟨F, ε, lt_min hε0 (lt_min hε1 hε2), ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ
  have hφ0 : IsFiniteApproximation F0 ε0 φ := finiteApproximation_strengthen F0 F ε0 ε φ
    (by intro x hx; exact Finset.mem_union_left _ hx) (min_le_left _ _) hφ
  have hφ1 : IsFiniteApproximation F1 ε1 φ := finiteApproximation_strengthen F1 F ε1 ε φ
    (by intro x hx; exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ hx))
    (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) hφ
  have hφ2 : IsFiniteApproximation F2 ε2 φ := finiteApproximation_strengthen F2 F ε2 ε φ
    (by intro x hx; exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_union_right _ hx))
    (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)) hφ
  have hlower (a : Plane) (ha : a ∈ Y) (b : Plane) (hb : b ∈ Y) :
      (1 - 1 / 4) * dist a b ≤ dist (deformPoint φ a) (deformPoint φ b) :=
    deformation_lowerBound φ a b _ (hglobal φ hφ0 a ha b hb)
  have hinverse (a : Plane) (ha : a ∈ Y) (b : Plane) (hb : b ∈ Y)
      (hab : dist (deformPoint φ a) (deformPoint φ b) < M / 2) : dist a b < M := by
    have := hlower a ha b hb
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, hinverse, ?_⟩
  · intro a ha b hb hab
    have := hlower a ha b hb
    rw [hab, dist_self] at this
    exact dist_eq_zero.mp (by nlinarith [dist_nonneg (x := a) (y := b)])
  · intro a ha b hb hab
    rw [← deformPoint_sub, dist_eq_norm]
    exact hlocal φ hφ1 (a - b) (boundedDifference_mem hfinite ha hb hab)
  · intro a ha b hb hab n hn
    have hd : a - b ∈ D := boundedDifference_mem hfinite ha hb (hinverse a ha b hb hab)
    have hz : normalEval n (a - b) ∈ Z :=
      Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(a - b, n), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hd, hn⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [← deformPoint_sub, rationalNormal_commutes]
    exact hreflect φ hφ2 _ hz

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.approximation_reflectsBoundedDisplacement
statement:
theorem approximation_reflectsBoundedDisplacement :
  ∀ Y : Set Plane, Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC Y → RelativeDense Y →
    ∀ M : ℝ, 0 < M → ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
        ∀ a ∈ Y, ∀ b ∈ Y, ∀ c ∈ Y, ∀ d ∈ Y,
          dist (deformPoint φ a) (deformPoint φ b) < M / 2 →
          dist (deformPoint φ c) (deformPoint φ d) < M / 2 →
            (((deformPoint φ a - deformPoint φ b).re =
                (deformPoint φ c - deformPoint φ d).re) ↔ (a - b).re = (c - d).re) ∧
            (((deformPoint φ a - deformPoint φ b).im =
                (deformPoint φ c - deformPoint φ d).im) ↔ (a - b).im = (c - d).im) ∧
            ((deformPoint φ a - deformPoint φ b = deformPoint φ c - deformPoint φ d) ↔
              a - b = c - d)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro Y hY hdense M hM
  obtain ⟨F0, ε0, hε0, hmetric⟩ := approximation_boundedMetricAndRelationControl Y hY hdense
    M 1 ∅ hM zero_lt_one
  have hfinite := hY.2 M hM
  let D := hfinite.toFinset
  let Z := D.image Complex.re ∪ D.image Complex.im
  obtain ⟨F1, ε1, hε1, hequality⟩ := finiteApproximation_signAndEquality Z
  refine ⟨F0 ∪ F1, min ε0 ε1, lt_min hε0 hε1, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ a ha b hb c hc d hd hab hcd
  have hφ0 : IsFiniteApproximation F0 ε0 φ := finiteApproximation_strengthen _ _ _ _ _
    (by intro x hx; exact Finset.mem_union_left _ hx) (min_le_left _ _) hφ
  have hφ1 : IsFiniteApproximation F1 ε1 φ := finiteApproximation_strengthen _ _ _ _ _
    (by intro x hx; exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hx) (min_le_right _ _) hφ
  have hdab : a - b ∈ D := boundedDifference_mem hfinite ha hb ((hmetric φ hφ0).2.2.1 a ha b hb hab)
  have hdcd : c - d ∈ D := boundedDifference_mem hfinite hc hd ((hmetric φ hφ0).2.2.1 c hc d hd hcd)
  have hre : (deformPoint φ a - deformPoint φ b).re =
      (deformPoint φ c - deformPoint φ d).re ↔ (a - b).re = (c - d).re := by
    rw [← deformPoint_sub, ← deformPoint_sub]
    change (φ (a - b).re : ℝ) = (φ (c - d).re : ℝ) ↔ (a - b).re = (c - d).re
    rw [Rat.cast_inj]
    exact (hequality φ hφ1).2 _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨_, hdab, rfl⟩))
      _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨_, hdcd, rfl⟩))
  have him : (deformPoint φ a - deformPoint φ b).im =
      (deformPoint φ c - deformPoint φ d).im ↔ (a - b).im = (c - d).im := by
    rw [← deformPoint_sub, ← deformPoint_sub]
    change (φ (a - b).im : ℝ) = (φ (c - d).im : ℝ) ↔ (a - b).im = (c - d).im
    rw [Rat.cast_inj]
    exact (hequality φ hφ1).2 _ (Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨_, hdab, rfl⟩))
      _ (Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨_, hdcd, rfl⟩))
  refine ⟨hre, him, ?_⟩
  rw [Complex.ext_iff, Complex.ext_iff, hre, him]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.hasFLC_image_of_coarseBound
statement:
private theorem hasFLC_image_of_coarseBound
    (Y : Set Plane) (hY : Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC Y)
    (f : Plane →+ Plane)
    (hlower : ∀ a ∈ Y, ∀ b ∈ Y,
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * dist a b ≤ dist (f a) (f b)) :
    Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC (f '' Y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro Q hQ
    by_cases hne : Y.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ := hne
      obtain ⟨R, hQR⟩ := hQ.subset_closedBall (0 : Plane)
      let S : Set Plane := Y ∩ Metric.closedBall y₀ (2 * (R + dist (f y₀) 0))
      have hSfinite : S.Finite := by
        exact hY.1 _ Metric.isBounded_closedBall
      apply (hSfinite.image f).subset
      rintro z ⟨⟨x, hxY, rfl⟩, hzQ⟩
      refine ⟨x, ⟨hxY, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      have hfxR : dist (f x) 0 ≤ R := hQR hzQ
      have himage : dist (f x) (f y₀) ≤ R + dist (f y₀) 0 := by
        calc
          dist (f x) (f y₀) ≤ dist (f x) 0 + dist 0 (f y₀) := dist_triangle _ _ _
          _ = dist (f x) 0 + dist (f y₀) 0 := by rw [dist_comm 0 (f y₀)]
          _ ≤ R + dist (f y₀) 0 := by nlinarith [hfxR]
      have hsource := hlower x hxY y₀ hy₀
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
      nlinarith
    · have hempty : f '' Y = ∅ := Set.image_eq_empty.mpr (Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne)
      simp [hempty]
  · intro R hR
    let D : Set Plane := (Y - Y) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 (2 * R)
    have hDfinite : D.Finite := hY.2 (2 * R) (by positivity)
    apply (hDfinite.image f).subset
    rintro z ⟨⟨fa, hfa, fb, hfb, hzEq⟩, hz⟩
    rcases hfa with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    rcases hfb with ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨a - b, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
      have hsource := hlower a ha b hb
      have himage : dist (f a - f b) 0 = dist (f a) (f b) := by simp [dist_eq_norm]
      have hab : dist (a - b) 0 = dist a b := by simp [dist_eq_norm]
      rw [hab]
      have hz' : dist (f a - f b) 0 ≤ R := by simpa [hzEq] using hz
      rw [himage] at hz'
      nlinarith
    · simpa [map_sub] using hzEq

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.approximation_preservesFLC
statement:
theorem approximation_preservesFLC :
  ∀ Y : Set Plane, Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC Y → RelativeDense Y →
    ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
        Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC (deformPoint φ '' Y)
proof:
:= by
  intro Y hY hdense
  obtain ⟨F, ε, hε, hglobal⟩ := approximation_globalRelativeError Y hY hdense
    (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨F, ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ
  apply hasFLC_image_of_coarseBound Y hY (deformPointLinear φ).toAddMonoidHom
  intro a ha b hb
  change (1 / 2 : ℝ) * dist a b ≤ dist (deformPoint φ a) (deformPoint φ b)
  simpa only [show (1 : ℝ) - 1 / 2 = 1 / 2 by norm_num] using
    deformation_lowerBound φ a b (1 / 2) (hglobal φ hφ a ha b hb)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.approximation_uniformImageDensity
statement:
theorem approximation_uniformImageDensity :
  ∀ Y : Set Plane, Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC Y → RelativeDense Y →
    ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε ρ : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < ρ ∧
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
        ∀ z : Plane, ∃ y ∈ deformPoint φ '' Y, dist z y < ρ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro Y hY hdense
  obtain ⟨F, ε, hε, hglobal⟩ := approximation_globalRelativeError Y hY hdense
    (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨rho, hrho, hsource⟩ := hdense
  refine ⟨F, ε, 6 * rho, hε, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ z
  let f := deformPointLinear φ
  let e : Plane →+ Plane := f.toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id Plane
  have he (x : Plane) : e x = deformPoint φ x - x := rfl
  have hlip (x : Plane) (hx : x ∈ Y) (y : Plane) (hy : y ∈ Y) :
      dist (e x) (e y) ≤ (1 / 2) * dist x y := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, ← map_sub]
    exact hglobal φ hφ x hx y hy
  have hnext (p : Plane) (hp : p ∈ Y) :
      ∃ q ∈ Y, dist (f q) z < 3 * rho / 2 + dist (f p) z / 2 := by
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqclose⟩ := hsource (z - e p)
    have hqnear : dist q (z - e p) < rho := by simpa only [dist_comm] using hqclose
    have hcenter : dist (z - e p) p = dist (f p) z := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev (f p)]
      congr 1
      dsimp [e, f, deformPointLinear]
      abel
    have hqp : dist q p < rho + dist (f p) z := by
      have := dist_triangle q (z - e p) p
      rw [hcenter] at this
      linarith
    have hvector : f q - z = (q - (z - e p)) + (e q - e p) := by
      dsimp [e, f, deformPointLinear]
      abel
    have herror : dist (f q) z ≤ dist q (z - e p) + dist (e q) (e p) := by
      simp only [dist_eq_norm]
      rw [hvector]
      exact norm_add_le (q - (z - e p)) (e q - e p)
    refine ⟨q, hq, ?_⟩
    have hg := hlip q hq p hp
    linarith
  obtain ⟨p0, hp0, _⟩ := hsource 0
  let E0 := dist (f p0) z
  have hiter : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ p ∈ Y,
      dist (f p) z ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k * E0 + 3 * rho := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        refine ⟨p0, hp0, ?_⟩
        simp only [pow_zero, one_mul]
        dsimp [E0]
        linarith
    | succ k ih =>
        obtain ⟨p, hp, he⟩ := ih
        obtain ⟨q, hq, hqerror⟩ := hnext p hp
        refine ⟨q, hq, ?_⟩
        rw [pow_succ]
        nlinarith
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ E0 := dist_nonneg
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one (div_pos hrho (by linarith : 0 < E0 + 1))
    (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hsmall : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N * E0 < rho := by
    have hmul := (lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < E0 + 1)).mp hN
    have hpow := pow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) N
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨p, hp, herror⟩ := hiter N
  refine ⟨f p, ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [dist_comm]
  linarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.approximation_lineRelativeError
statement:
theorem approximation_lineRelativeError :
  ∀ (T : Set Plane) (W : Finset Plane) (n : RationalNormal) (a : Plane),
    W.Nonempty → Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC T →
    (∀ t ∈ T, normalEval n (t - a) = 0) →
    (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ z : Plane, normalEval n (z - a) = 0 →
      ∃ t ∈ T, dist z t < ρ) →
      ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → c < 1 → ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
        ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
          ∀ x ∈ (W : Set Plane) + T, ∀ y ∈ (W : Set Plane) + T,
            ‖deformPoint φ (x - y) - (x - y)‖ ≤ c * dist x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro T W n a _ hT hsupport ⟨rho, hrho, hlineDense⟩ c hc hc1
  have hsegmentDense : ∀ t ∈ T, ∀ u ∈ T, ∀ s : ℝ,
      ∃ q ∈ T, dist (t + s • (u - t)) q < rho := by
    intro t ht u hu s
    apply hlineDense
    have htline := hsupport t ht
    have huline := hsupport u hu
    simp only [normalEval, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im] at htline huline
    simp only [normalEval, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_re,
      Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
    linear_combination (1 - s) * htline + s * huline
  obtain ⟨F0, ε0, hε0, hTerror⟩ := globalRelativeError_of_segmentDensity T hT rho hrho
    hsegmentDense (c / 4) (by positivity) (by linarith)
  let cloud := (W : Set Plane) + T
  have hcloud : Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC cloud := by
    simpa only [cloud, add_comm] using hT.add_finset W
  let offsets : Finset Plane := W - W
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := offsets.finite_toSet.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : Plane)
  let L := max 1 R
  have hL : 0 < L := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_left _ _)
  have hoffsetBound (z : Plane) (hz : z ∈ offsets) : ‖z‖ ≤ L := by
    have hzR := hR hz
    have hn : ‖z‖ ≤ R := by simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hzR
    exact hn.trans (le_max_right _ _)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hsep⟩ := hcloud.uniformlyDiscrete
  have hfinite := hcloud.2 L hL
  let D := hfinite.toFinset
  obtain ⟨F1, ε1, hε1, hoffset⟩ := finitePointControl offsets (c * L / 4) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨F2, ε2, hε2, hshortError⟩ := finitePointControl D (c * δ) (mul_pos hc hδ)
  let F := F0 ∪ (F1 ∪ F2)
  let ε := min ε0 (min ε1 ε2)
  refine ⟨F, ε, lt_min hε0 (lt_min hε1 hε2), ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ x hx y hy
  have hφ0 : IsFiniteApproximation F0 ε0 φ := finiteApproximation_strengthen F0 F ε0 ε φ
    (by intro z hz; exact Finset.mem_union_left _ hz) (min_le_left _ _) hφ
  have hφ1 : IsFiniteApproximation F1 ε1 φ := finiteApproximation_strengthen F1 F ε1 ε φ
    (by intro z hz; exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ hz))
    (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) hφ
  have hφ2 : IsFiniteApproximation F2 ε2 φ := finiteApproximation_strengthen F2 F ε2 ε φ
    (by intro z hz; exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_union_right _ hz))
    (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)) hφ
  let e : Plane →+ Plane := (deformPointLinear φ).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id Plane
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst y
    change ‖e (x - x)‖ ≤ c * dist x x
    simp
  by_cases hsmall : dist x y < L
  · have hdiff : x - y ∈ D := boundedDifference_mem hfinite hx hy hsmall
    have hδxy : δ ≤ dist x y := hsep hx hy hxy
    exact (hshortError φ hφ2 _ hdiff).le.trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδxy hc.le)
  · have hlarge : L ≤ dist x y := le_of_not_gt hsmall
    rcases hx with ⟨w, hw, t, ht, rfl⟩
    rcases hy with ⟨v, hv, s, hs, rfl⟩
    have hdiff : w - v ∈ offsets := Finset.mem_sub.mpr ⟨w, hw, v, hv, rfl⟩
    have hnorm := hoffsetBound _ hdiff
    have hTS : dist t s ≤ dist (w + t) (v + s) + L := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
      calc
        ‖t - s‖ = ‖((w + t) - (v + s)) - (w - v)‖ := by congr 1; abel
        _ ≤ ‖(w + t) - (v + s)‖ + ‖w - v‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖(w + t) - (v + s)‖ + L := by linarith
    have hdecomp : (w + t) - (v + s) = (t - s) + (w - v) := by abel
    have hdecError : ‖e (w - v)‖ ≤ c * L / 4 := (hoffset φ hφ1 _ hdiff).le
    have hlineError : ‖e (t - s)‖ ≤ c / 4 * dist t s := hTerror φ hφ0 t ht s hs
    change ‖e ((w + t) - (v + s))‖ ≤ c * dist (w + t) (v + s)
    rw [hdecomp, map_add]
    calc
      ‖e (t - s) + e (w - v)‖ ≤ ‖e (t - s)‖ + ‖e (w - v)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ c * dist (w + t) (v + s) := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hTS hc.le,
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlarge hc.le]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.normalEval_sub
statement:
private theorem normalEval_sub (n : RationalNormal) (x y : Plane) :
    normalEval n (x - y) = normalEval n x - normalEval n y
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalEval, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
  ring

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.normalDirection_mem_iff
statement:
private theorem normalDirection_mem_iff (n : RationalNormal) (z : Plane) :
    z ∈ normalDirection n ↔ normalEval n z = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (((n.x : ℝ) • Complex.reCLM + (n.y : ℝ) • Complex.imCLM).toLinearMap) z = 0 ↔ _
  simp [normalEval]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.list_sum_deformation_bounds
statement:
private theorem list_sum_deformation_bounds
    (φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (G : List ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ r ∈ G, r / 2 ≤ (φ r : ℝ) ∧ (φ r : ℝ) ≤ 2 * r) :
    G.sum / 2 ≤ (φ G.sum : ℝ) ∧ (φ G.sum : ℝ) ≤ 2 * G.sum
proof:
:= by
  induction G with
  | nil => simp
  | cons r G ih =>
      have hr := hG r (by simp)
      have htail : ∀ q ∈ G, q / 2 ≤ (φ q : ℝ) ∧ (φ q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * q :=
        fun q hq => hG q (by simp [hq])
      have hsum := ih htail
      have hmap : (φ (r + G.sum) : ℝ) = (φ r : ℝ) + (φ G.sum : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (map_add φ r G.sum)
      rw [List.sum_cons, hmap]
      constructor <;> nlinarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.signed_deformation_bounds
statement:
private theorem signed_deformation_bounds (φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (x : ℝ)
    (hbounds : |x| / 2 ≤ (φ |x| : ℝ) ∧ (φ |x| : ℝ) ≤ 2 * |x|) :
    Real.sign (φ x : ℝ) = Real.sign x ∧
      |x| / 2 ≤ |(φ x : ℝ)| ∧ |(φ x : ℝ)| ≤ 2 * |x|
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy x 0 with hneg | rfl | hpos
  · have hmap : (φ |x| : ℝ) = -(φ x : ℝ) := by simp [abs_of_neg hneg]
    have hφneg : (φ x : ℝ) < 0 := by rw [hmap] at hbounds; rw [abs_of_neg hneg] at hbounds; linarith
    refine ⟨by rw [Real.sign_of_neg hφneg, Real.sign_of_neg hneg], ?_⟩
    simpa [abs_of_neg hφneg, hmap] using hbounds
  · simp
  · have hφpos : 0 < (φ x : ℝ) := by rw [abs_of_pos hpos] at hbounds; linarith
    refine ⟨by rw [Real.sign_of_pos hφpos, Real.sign_of_pos hpos], ?_⟩
    simpa [abs_of_pos hφpos, abs_of_pos hpos] using hbounds

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.originalIndexedCopies_locallyFinite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hbound⟩ := K.isPolygonal.isBounded.exists_pos_norm_le
  intro x
  let A : Set Plane := T ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 (‖x‖ + 1 + R)
  have hA : A.Finite := (Tiling.Polygonal.packing_centres_locallyFinite hpack).1 _
    Metric.isBounded_closedBall
  have hfinite : {t : T | t.1 ∈ A}.Finite := hA.preimage Subtype.val_injective.injOn
  refine ⟨Metric.ball x 1, Metric.ball_mem_nhds x (by norm_num), hfinite.subset ?_⟩
  rintro t ⟨y, hyt, hyx⟩
  have hz : (-t.1 +ᵥ y) ∈ K.support := Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem.mp hyt
  have hnormy : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + 1 := by
    have hd : ‖y - x‖ < 1 := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hyx
    have htriangle : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖y - x‖ + ‖x‖ := by simpa using norm_add_le (y - x) x
    linarith
  have hnormt : ‖t.1‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + 1 + R := by
    have heq : t.1 = y - (-t.1 +ᵥ y) := by change t.1 = y - (-t.1 + y); abel
    rw [heq]
    exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add hnormy (hbound _ hz))
  exact ⟨t.2, by simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero] using hnormt⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.intrinsicVertex_mem_support
statement:
private theorem intrinsicVertex_mem_support (K : PolygonalRegion)
    {v : Plane} (hv : v ∈ Tiling.vertexSet K.support) : v ∈ K.support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := K.isPolygonal
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hvC⟩ := hv A
  rw [← A.sUnion_eq]
  exact Set.mem_sUnion.mpr ⟨C, hC, extremePoints_subset hvC⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.originalVertexStar_finite
proof:
:= by
  apply ((originalIndexedCopies_locallyFinite K T hpack).point_finite v).subset
  intro t ht
  apply Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem.mpr
  exact intrinsicVertex_mem_support K (Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem.mp ht)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.originalClosedCopies_coverPlane
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Tiling.Polygonal.closure_openUnion_eq_iUnion_support htile.2.1]
  have hfull := Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) htile
  have hsubset : Set.univ ⊆ closure (Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion K T) := by
    rw [← hfull]
    exact interior_subset
  exact Set.eq_univ_of_univ_subset hsubset

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.originalClosedStar_localCover
statement:
private theorem originalClosedStar_localCover (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set Plane)
    (htile : Tiling.Polygonal.TilesOn K T Set.univ) (v : Plane) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball v r,
      ∃ t ∈ T, v ∈ t +ᵥ K.support ∧ x ∈ t +ᵥ K.support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E : T → Set Plane := fun t =>
    if v ∈ (t : Plane) +ᵥ K.support then ∅ else (t : Plane) +ᵥ K.support
  have hEsub (t : T) : E t ⊆ (t : Plane) +ᵥ K.support := by
    dsimp [E]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hElf := (originalIndexedCopies_locallyFinite K T htile.2.1).subset hEsub
  have hEclosed : IsClosed (⋃ t, E t) := hElf.isClosed_iUnion (fun t => by
    dsimp [E]
    split_ifs
    · exact isClosed_empty
    · exact K.isPolygonal.isClosed.vadd _)
  have hv : v ∈ (⋃ t, E t)ᶜ := by
    intro hv
    obtain ⟨t, hvt⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hv
    dsimp [E] at hvt
    split_ifs at hvt with hvtile
    · exact hvt
    · exact hvtile hvt
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hEclosed.isOpen_compl v hv
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hxcover : x ∈ ⋃ t : T, (t : Plane) +ᵥ K.support := by
    rw [originalClosedCopies_coverPlane K T htile]
    exact Set.mem_univ _
  obtain ⟨t, hxt⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxcover
  refine ⟨t, t.2, ?_, hxt⟩
  by_contra hvnot
  apply hball hx
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨t, by simpa [E, hvnot] using hxt⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.original_openCarrier_disjoint_otherSupport
statement:
private theorem original_openCarrier_disjoint_otherSupport (K : PolygonalRegion)
    (T : Set Plane) (hpack : Tiling.IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements T))
    {s t : Plane} (hs : s ∈ T) (ht : t ∈ T) (hst : s ≠ t) :
    Disjoint (s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (t +ᵥ K.support)
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj := (Tiling.Polygonal.isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K T).mp hpack hs ht hst
  have h := hdisj.closure_right (isOpen_interior.vadd s)
  rw [closure_vadd] at h
  simpa only [PolygonalRegion.openCarrier, K.isPolygonal.closure_interior] using h

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.originalVertex_otherLabels_noninterior
statement:
private theorem originalVertex_otherLabels_noninterior (K : PolygonalRegion)
    (T : Set Plane) (hpack : Tiling.IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements T))
    {s t v : Plane} (hs : s ∈ T) (ht : t ∈ T) (hst : s ≠ t)
    (hv : v ∈ t +ᵥ Tiling.vertexSet K.support) : v ∉ s +ᵥ K.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  intro hvs
  have hvt : v ∈ t +ᵥ K.support := Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem.mpr
    (intrinsicVertex_mem_support K (Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem.mp hv))
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (original_openCarrier_disjoint_otherSupport K T hpack hs ht hst) hvs hvt

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.originalNonvertexStar_localHalfPlane
statement:
private theorem originalNonvertexStar_localHalfPlane (K : PolygonalRegion)
    (T : Set Plane) (hpack : Tiling.IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements T))
    {s t v : Plane} (hs : s ∈ T) (ht : t ∈ T)
    (hvt : v ∈ t +ᵥ Tiling.vertexSet K.support)
    (hvs : v ∈ s +ᵥ K.support) (hvnot : v ∉ s +ᵥ Tiling.vertexSet K.support) :
    ∃ u : Plane, u ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ r > 0,
      ((s +ᵥ K.support) ∩ Metric.ball v r = Tiling.positiveHalfPlane v u ∩ Metric.ball v r ∨
        (s +ᵥ K.support) ∩ Metric.ball v r = Tiling.negativeHalfPlane v u ∩ Metric.ball v r)
proof:
:= by
  have hst : s ≠ t := by
    intro heq
    subst t
    exact hvnot hvt
  have hvint := originalVertex_otherLabels_noninterior K T hpack hs ht hst hvt
  have hvfrontier : v ∈ frontier (s +ᵥ K.support) := by
    rw [(K.isPolygonal.isClosed.vadd s).frontier_eq, interior_vadd]
    exact ⟨hvs, hvint⟩
  have hpolygonal : Tiling.IsPolygonal (s +ᵥ K.support) := K.isPolygonal.vadd s
  have hvnot' : v ∉ Tiling.vertexSet (s +ᵥ K.support) := by
    simpa only [Tiling.vertexSet_vadd] using hvnot
  obtain ⟨L, hvL, hdim, hlocal⟩ :=
    hpolygonal.boundaryLocallyStraightAt_of_not_mem_vertexSet hvfrontier hvnot'
  apply Tiling.exists_local_eq_closedHalfPlane_of_affineSubspace _ hvL hdim hlocal
  rw [interior_vadd, closure_vadd, K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.no_third_regularClosed_incident_to_two_halfPlaneGerms
statement:
private theorem no_third_regularClosed_incident_to_two_halfPlaneGerms
    (A B C : Set Plane) (p : Plane)
    (f g : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (rA rB : ℝ) (hrA : 0 < rA) (hrB : 0 < rB)
    (hA : ∀ q, dist q p < rA → (q ∈ A ↔ 0 ≤ f (q - p)))
    (hB : ∀ q, dist q p < rB → (q ∈ B ↔ 0 ≤ g (q - p)))
    (hAB : Disjoint (interior A) B)
    (hCA : Disjoint (interior C) A)
    (hCB : Disjoint (interior C) B)
    (hpC : p ∈ C)
    (hCreg : C ⊆ closure (interior C)) : False
proof:
:= by
  let ε : ℝ := min rA rB
  have hε : 0 < ε := lt_min hrA hrB
  have hnotBoth : ∀ w : Plane, ¬ (0 < f w ∧ 0 < g w) := by
    intro w hw
    have hwne : w ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      subst w
      simp at hw
    have hwNorm : 0 < ‖w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hwne
    obtain ⟨t, ht0, htbound⟩ := exists_between (show 0 < ε / ‖w‖ by positivity)
    let q : Plane := p + t • w
    have hqp : q - p = t • w := by simp [q]
    have hdist : dist q p < ε := by
      rw [show q = p + t • w by rfl, dist_eq_norm]
      simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht0]
      calc
        t * ‖w‖ < (ε / ‖w‖) * ‖w‖ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right htbound hwNorm
        _ = ε := by field_simp
    have hfq : 0 < f (q - p) := by
      rw [hqp, map_smul]
      exact mul_pos ht0 hw.1
    have hgq : 0 < g (q - p) := by
      rw [hqp, map_smul]
      exact mul_pos ht0 hw.2
    have hqballA : dist q p < rA := lt_of_lt_of_le hdist (min_le_left _ _)
    have hqballB : dist q p < rB := lt_of_lt_of_le hdist (min_le_right _ _)
    have hqA : q ∈ A := (hA q hqballA).2 (le_of_lt hfq)
    have hqB : q ∈ B := (hB q hqballB).2 (le_of_lt hgq)
    have hOopen : IsOpen (Metric.ball p rA ∩ {z | 0 < f (z - p)}) := by
      exact IsOpen.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
        (IsOpen.preimage (f.continuous.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)) isOpen_Ioi)
    have hOsub : Metric.ball p rA ∩ {z | 0 < f (z - p)} ⊆ A := by
      intro z hz
      exact (hA z hz.1).2 (le_of_lt hz.2)
    have hqO : q ∈ Metric.ball p rA ∩ {z | 0 < f (z - p)} := ⟨hqballA, hfq⟩
    have hqInterior : q ∈ interior A := interior_maximal hOsub hOopen hqO
    exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp hAB) hqInterior hqB
  have hcover : ∀ q, dist q p < ε → q ∈ A ∪ B := by
    intro q hq
    by_cases hqf : 0 ≤ f (q - p)
    · exact Or.inl ((hA q (lt_of_lt_of_le hq (min_le_left _ _))).2 hqf)
    · have hqg : 0 ≤ g (q - p) := by
        by_contra hqg
        have hqfneg : f (q - p) < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hqf
        have hqgneg : g (q - p) < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hqg
        have hpos := hnotBoth (-(q - p))
        apply hpos
        constructor
        · rw [map_neg]
          linarith
        · rw [map_neg]
          linarith
      exact Or.inr ((hB q (lt_of_lt_of_le hq (min_le_right _ _))).2 hqg)
  have hpClosure : p ∈ closure (interior C) := hCreg hpC
  obtain ⟨q, hqInterior, hdistPQ⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hpClosure ε hε
  have hqdist : dist q p < ε := by simpa [dist_comm] using hdistPQ
  have hqAB := hcover q hqdist
  rcases hqAB with hqA | hqB
  · exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp hCA) hqInterior hqA
  · exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp hCB) hqInterior hqB

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.localHalfPlane_to_linearGerm
statement:
private theorem localHalfPlane_to_linearGerm
    (A : Set Plane) (p : Plane)
    (hloc : ∃ v : Plane, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧
      (A ∩ Metric.ball p r = Tiling.positiveHalfPlane p v ∩ Metric.ball p r ∨
       A ∩ Metric.ball p r = Tiling.negativeHalfPlane p v ∩ Metric.ball p r)) :
    ∃ f : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧
      ∀ q, dist q p < r → (q ∈ A ↔ 0 ≤ f (q - p))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, r, hr, hcase⟩ := hloc
  have hside (q : Plane) : Tiling.signedSide p v q =
      Tiling.planarCrossCLM v (q - p) := by
    rw [Tiling.planarCrossCLM_apply]
    simp [Tiling.signedSide, Tiling.planarCross, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
    ring
  rcases hcase with hpos | hneg
  · refine ⟨Tiling.planarCrossCLM v, r, hr, ?_⟩
    intro q hqp
    have hball : q ∈ Metric.ball p r := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hqp
    have hmem : q ∈ A ↔ q ∈ Tiling.positiveHalfPlane p v := by
      have hEq := congrArg (fun S : Set Plane => q ∈ S) hpos
      simpa [Set.mem_inter_iff, hball] using hEq
    rw [hmem, Tiling.mem_positiveHalfPlane, hside]
  · refine ⟨-Tiling.planarCrossCLM v, r, hr, ?_⟩
    intro q hqp
    have hball : q ∈ Metric.ball p r := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hqp
    have hmem : q ∈ A ↔ q ∈ Tiling.negativeHalfPlane p v := by
      have hEq := congrArg (fun S : Set Plane => q ∈ S) hneg
      simpa [Set.mem_inter_iff, hball] using hEq
    rw [hmem, Tiling.mem_negativeHalfPlane, hside]
    simp [map_neg]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.no_third_regularClosed_incident_to_two_localHalfPlanes
statement:
private theorem no_third_regularClosed_incident_to_two_localHalfPlanes
    (A B C : Set Plane) (p : Plane)
    (hAline : ∃ v : Plane, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧
      (A ∩ Metric.ball p r = Tiling.positiveHalfPlane p v ∩ Metric.ball p r ∨
       A ∩ Metric.ball p r = Tiling.negativeHalfPlane p v ∩ Metric.ball p r))
    (hBline : ∃ v : Plane, v ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧
      (B ∩ Metric.ball p r = Tiling.positiveHalfPlane p v ∩ Metric.ball p r ∨
       B ∩ Metric.ball p r = Tiling.negativeHalfPlane p v ∩ Metric.ball p r))
    (hAB : Disjoint (interior A) B)
    (hCA : Disjoint (interior C) A)
    (hCB : Disjoint (interior C) B)
    (hpC : p ∈ C)
    (hCreg : C ⊆ closure (interior C)) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rA, hrA, hAgerm⟩ := localHalfPlane_to_linearGerm A p hAline
  obtain ⟨g, rB, hrB, hBgerm⟩ := localHalfPlane_to_linearGerm B p hBline
  exact no_third_regularClosed_incident_to_two_halfPlaneGerms
    A B C p f g rA rB hrA hrB hAgerm hBgerm hAB hCA hCB hpC hCreg

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.originalVertexStar_atMostOneSmoothLabel
statement:
private theorem originalVertexStar_atMostOneSmoothLabel (K : PolygonalRegion)
    (T : Set Plane) (hpack : Tiling.IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements T))
    (p t : Plane) (ht : t ∈ T) (hpt : p ∈ t +ᵥ Tiling.vertexSet K.support)
    (s u : Plane) (hs : s ∈ T) (hu : u ∈ T)
    (hps : p ∈ s +ᵥ K.support) (hpu : p ∈ u +ᵥ K.support)
    (hpsnot : p ∉ s +ᵥ Tiling.vertexSet K.support)
    (hpunot : p ∉ u +ᵥ Tiling.vertexSet K.support) : s = u
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hsu
  have hts : t ≠ s := by
    intro heq
    apply hpsnot
    rwa [← heq]
  have htu : t ≠ u := by
    intro heq
    apply hpunot
    rwa [← heq]
  apply no_third_regularClosed_incident_to_two_localHalfPlanes
    (s +ᵥ K.support) (u +ᵥ K.support) (t +ᵥ K.support) p
    (originalNonvertexStar_localHalfPlane K T hpack hs ht hpt hps hpsnot)
    (originalNonvertexStar_localHalfPlane K T hpack hu ht hpt hpu hpunot)
  · rw [interior_vadd]
    exact original_openCarrier_disjoint_otherSupport K T hpack hs hu hsu
  · rw [interior_vadd]
    exact original_openCarrier_disjoint_otherSupport K T hpack ht hs hts
  · rw [interior_vadd]
    exact original_openCarrier_disjoint_otherSupport K T hpack ht hu htu
  · exact Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem.mpr
      (intrinsicVertex_mem_support K (Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem.mp hpt))
  · rw [interior_vadd, closure_vadd, K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.normalCLM_apply
statement:
private theorem normalCLM_apply (n : RationalNormal) (z : Plane) :
    normalCLM n z = normalEval n z
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalCLM, normalEval]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.normalCLM_ne_zero
statement: private theorem normalCLM_ne_zero (n : RationalNormal) : normalCLM n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hx : (n.x : ℝ) = 0 := by
    simpa [normalCLM] using congrArg (fun f : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ => f 1) h
  have hy : (n.y : ℝ) = 0 := by
    simpa [normalCLM] using congrArg (fun f : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ => f Complex.I) h
  rcases n.nonzero with hnx | hny
  · exact hnx (by exact_mod_cast hx)
  · exact hny (by exact_mod_cast hy)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.component_normalProjection
statement:
private theorem component_normalProjection (K : PolygonalRegion) (n : RationalNormal)
    (O : Set Plane) (hO : O ∈ Tiling.interiorComponents K.support) :
    ∃ a b : Plane, a ∈ Tiling.vertexSet K.support ∧ b ∈ Tiling.vertexSet K.support ∧
      a ∈ closure O ∧ b ∈ closure O ∧
      normalEval n a < normalEval n b ∧
      normalEval n '' O = Set.Ioo (normalEval n a) (normalEval n b)
proof:
:= by
  let ℓ := normalCLM n
  have hℓ : ℓ.toLinearMap ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply normalCLM_ne_zero n
    ext z
    exact congrArg (fun f : Plane →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ => f z) h
  obtain ⟨a, haV, haO, _, ha⟩ :=
    K.isPolygonal.exists_interiorComponent_min_vertex hO ℓ.toLinearMap hℓ
  obtain ⟨b, hbV, hbO, _, hb⟩ :=
    K.isPolygonal.exists_interiorComponent_max_vertex hO ℓ.toLinearMap hℓ
  have hconnected := (Tiling.interiorComponent_basic hO).2.1
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hconnected.nonempty
  refine ⟨a, b, haV, hbV, haO, hbO, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, ℓ, normalCLM_apply] using (ha z hz).trans (hb z hz)
  · haveI : NeBot (𝓝[O] a) := mem_closure_iff_nhdsWithin_neBot.mp haO
    haveI : NeBot (𝓝[O] b) := mem_closure_iff_nhdsWithin_neBot.mp hbO
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · rintro r ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨by simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, ℓ, normalCLM_apply] using ha w hw,
        by simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, ℓ, normalCLM_apply] using hb w hw⟩
    · have hbetween := hconnected.isPreconnected.intermediate_value_Ioo
        (l₁ := 𝓝[O] a) (l₂ := 𝓝[O] b)
        (inf_le_right : 𝓝[O] a ≤ 𝓟 O)
        (inf_le_right : 𝓝[O] b ≤ 𝓟 O) ℓ.continuous.continuousOn
        (ℓ.continuous.tendsto a |>.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds)
        (ℓ.continuous.tendsto b |>.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds)
      simpa only [ℓ, normalCLM_apply] using hbetween

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.openNormalProjection_finiteIntervals
statement:
theorem openNormalProjection_finiteIntervals :
  ∀ (K : PolygonalRegion) (n : RationalNormal), ∃ I : Finset (ℝ × ℝ),
    normalEval n '' K.openCarrier = ⋃ e ∈ I, Set.Ioo e.1 e.2 ∧
    ∀ e ∈ I, e.1 < e.2 ∧
      (∃ v ∈ Tiling.vertexSet K.support, normalEval n v = e.1) ∧
      (∃ v ∈ Tiling.vertexSet K.support, normalEval n v = e.2)
proof:
:= by
  intro K n
  classical
  let C := Tiling.interiorComponents K.support
  have hfinite : C.Finite := K.isPolygonal.interiorComponents_finite
  letI : Fintype C := hfinite.fintype
  have hex (O : C) := component_normalProjection K n O.1 O.2
  choose a b ha hb haO hbO hab himage using hex
  let e : C → ℝ × ℝ := fun O => (normalEval n (a O), normalEval n (b O))
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.image e, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext r
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      let O : C := ⟨connectedComponentIn K.openCarrier z, z, hz, rfl⟩
      have hzO : z ∈ (O : Set Plane) := mem_connectedComponentIn hz
      have he : normalEval n z ∈ Set.Ioo (e O).1 (e O).2 := by
        rw [← himage O]
        exact ⟨z, hzO, rfl⟩
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e O, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨O, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩, he⟩⟩
    · intro hr
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hr
      obtain ⟨hpI, hrp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
      obtain ⟨O, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpI
      rw [← himage O] at hrp
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzr⟩ := hrp
      exact ⟨z, (Tiling.interiorComponent_basic O.2).2.2 hz, hzr⟩
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨O, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
    exact ⟨hab O, ⟨a O, ha O, rfl⟩, ⟨b O, hb O, rfl⟩⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.sign_eq_iff_nonpos
statement:
private theorem sign_eq_iff_nonpos {x y : ℝ} (h : Real.sign x = Real.sign y) :
