          have hu : (q.1 + q.2) / 2 ∈ Ioo q.1 q.2 := by
            constructor <;> linarith [hq.1.1]
          have hu' : (q'.1 + q'.2) / 2 ∈ Ioo q'.1 q'.2 := by
            constructor <;> linarith [hq'.1.1]
          have hgerm : positiveEdgeGerm (t +ᵥ K.support) (packingSol_rationalTangent n) p := by
            change positiveEdgeGerm (t +ᵥ K.support) (packingSol_rationalTangent n)
              (t + AffineMap.lineMap e.1 e.2 (1 / 2 : ℝ))
            rw [packingSol_occurrence_midpoint t e a (packingSol_rationalTangent n) q hcoords]
            exact hsource _ hu
          have hgerm' : positiveEdgeGerm (t +ᵥ K.support)
              (-packingSol_rationalTangent n) p := by
            rw [← packingSol_oppositeNormal_rationalTangent]
            change positiveEdgeGerm (t +ᵥ K.support)
              (packingSol_rationalTangent (packingSol_oppositeNormal n))
              (t + AffineMap.lineMap e.1 e.2 (1 / 2 : ℝ))
            rw [packingSol_occurrence_midpoint t e b (packingSol_rationalTangent (packingSol_oppositeNormal n))
                q' hcoords']
            exact hsource' _ hu'
          exact False.elim (positive_negative_edgeGerms_disjoint
            (packingSol_rationalTangent_ne_zero n) hgerm
            ((orientedEdgeGerms_negativeDirection (t +ᵥ K.support) p
              (packingSol_rationalTangent n)).1.mp hgerm'))

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.packingSol_uniformActualNegativeMappedOccurrence
statement:
private theorem packingSol_uniformActualNegativeMappedOccurrence
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (P : PolyhedralCode) (T : Set Plane)
    (hP : polyhedralSupport P = K.support)
    (htile : Tiling.Polygonal.TilesOn K T Set.univ) (E : Finset (Plane × Plane))
    (hE : ∀ e ∈ E, e.1 ≠ e.2 ∧ e.1 ∈ Tiling.vertexSet K.support ∧
      e.2 ∈ Tiling.vertexSet K.support ∧ segment ℝ e.1 e.2 ⊆ frontier K.support ∧
      (∀ z ∈ openSegment ℝ e.1 e.2, z ∉ Tiling.vertexSet K.support) ∧
      ((∀ z ∈ openSegment ℝ e.1 e.2, positiveEdgeGerm K.support (e.2 - e.1) z) ∨
        (∀ z ∈ openSegment ℝ e.1 e.2, negativeEdgeGerm K.support (e.2 - e.1) z)))
    (hrat : ∀ e ∈ E, Tiling.RationalSlopes.IsRationalVectorDirection (e.2 - e.1))
    (hcover : frontier K.support = ⋃ e ∈ E, segment ℝ e.1 e.2) :
    ∃ N : Finset RationalNormal, ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
      ∀ Kφ : PolygonalRegion, Kφ.support = deformedPolyhedralSupport P φ →
      ∀ c ∈ T, ∀ p ∈ frontier (deformPoint φ c +ᵥ Kφ.support),
      p ∉ deformPoint φ c +ᵥ (deformPoint φ '' Tiling.vertexSet K.support) →
      ∃ n ∈ N, ∃ e ∈ E, ∃ (a : Plane) (q : ℝ × ℝ),
        q ∈ signedCarrierComponentIntervals K T E a (packingSol_rationalTangent n) 0 false ∧
        ((c + e.1 = a + q.1 • packingSol_rationalTangent n ∧
          c + e.2 = a + q.2 • packingSol_rationalTangent n) ∨
         (c + e.2 = a + q.1 • packingSol_rationalTangent n ∧
          c + e.1 = a + q.2 • packingSol_rationalTangent n)) ∧
        (∀ u ∈ Ioo q.1 q.2, negativeEdgeGerm (c +ᵥ K.support)
          (packingSol_rationalTangent n) (a + u • packingSol_rationalTangent n)) ∧
        (φ q.1 : ℝ) < (φ q.2 : ℝ) ∧
        ∃ u ∈ Ioo (φ q.1 : ℝ) (φ q.2 : ℝ),
          p = deformPoint φ a + u • packingSol_rationalTangent n ∧
          negativeEdgeGerm (deformPoint φ c +ᵥ Kφ.support) (packingSol_rationalTangent n) p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := packingSol_finiteSourceNormals E hrat
  choose Fq εq hεq hquery using
    (fun n : RationalNormal => packingSol_uniformActualMappedPrimitiveQuery
      K P T hP htile E hE hrat hcover n)
  obtain ⟨Fn, εn, hεn, hnormal⟩ := packingSol_finiteNormal_controls N
    (fun n φ => IsFiniteApproximation (Fq n) (εq n) φ)
    (fun n _ => ⟨Fq n, εq n, hεq n, fun _ h => h⟩)
  have hprimitive : ∀ e ∈ E, e.1 ≠ e.2 ∧ e.1 ∈ Tiling.vertexSet K.support ∧
      e.2 ∈ Tiling.vertexSet K.support ∧ segment ℝ e.1 e.2 ⊆ frontier K.support ∧
      ∀ z ∈ openSegment ℝ e.1 e.2, z ∉ Tiling.vertexSet K.support :=
    fun e he => ⟨(hE e he).1, (hE e he).2.1, (hE e he).2.2.1,
      (hE e he).2.2.2.1, (hE e he).2.2.2.2.1⟩
  obtain ⟨Fs, εs, _, hεs, _, htransport⟩ :=
    rationalPrimitiveEdges_uniformSameSide_transport K P hP E hrat hprimitive hcover
  refine ⟨N, Fn ∪ Fs, min εn εs, lt_min hεn hεs, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ Kφ hKφ c hc p hpfront hpnot
  have hφn : IsFiniteApproximation Fn εn φ := finiteApproximation_strengthen _ _ _ _ φ
    Finset.subset_union_left (min_le_left _ _) hφ
  have hφs : IsFiniteApproximation Fs εs φ := finiteApproximation_strengthen _ _ _ _ φ
    Finset.subset_union_right (min_le_right _ _) hφ
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hfront, _⟩ := htransport φ hφs Kφ hKφ
  have hfrontier : frontier (deformPoint φ c +ᵥ Kφ.support) =
      ⋃ e ∈ E, segment ℝ (deformPoint φ c + deformPoint φ e.1)
        (deformPoint φ c + deformPoint φ e.2) := by
    rw [← sourceRay_link_frontier_vadd, hfront, Set.vadd_set_iUnion]
    simp only [Set.vadd_set_iUnion, vadd_segment, vadd_eq_add]
  obtain ⟨e, he, hpseg⟩ : ∃ e ∈ E, p ∈ segment ℝ
      (deformPoint φ c + deformPoint φ e.1) (deformPoint φ c + deformPoint φ e.2) := by
    rw [hfrontier] at hpfront
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hpfront
    obtain ⟨heE, hpseg⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp he
    exact ⟨e, heE, hpseg⟩
  have endpointNot (v : Plane) (hv : v ∈ Tiling.vertexSet K.support) :
      deformPoint φ c + deformPoint φ v ≠ p := by
    intro heq
    apply hpnot
    exact Set.mem_vadd_set.mpr ⟨deformPoint φ v, ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩, by
      simpa only [vadd_eq_add] using heq⟩
  have hpopen := mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right
    (endpointNot e.1 (hE e he).2.1) (endpointNot e.2 (hE e he).2.2.1) hpseg
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hnOpp, hndir⟩ := hN e he
  have hparallel : normalEval n (e.2 - e.1) = 0 := by
    apply (normalDirection_mem_iff n _).mp
    rw [hndir]
    exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
  have hsimple : ∀ e ∈ E, e.1 ≠ e.2 ∧ segment ℝ e.1 e.2 ⊆ frontier K.support ∧
      ((∀ z ∈ openSegment ℝ e.1 e.2, positiveEdgeGerm K.support (e.2 - e.1) z) ∨
        (∀ z ∈ openSegment ℝ e.1 e.2, negativeEdgeGerm K.support (e.2 - e.1) z)) :=
    fun e he => ⟨(hE e he).1, (hE e he).2.2.2.1, (hE e he).2.2.2.2.2⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmparallel, a₀, q₀, hq₀, hcoords₀, hnegative₀⟩ :=
    packingSol_finiteNormal_negativeSourceOccurrence K T E hsimple N n hn hnOpp
      c hc e he hparallel
  obtain ⟨a, q, positive, hq, hcoords, hsource, horder, hparameters, htarget⟩ :=
    hquery m φ (hnormal φ hφn m hm) Kφ hKφ c hc e he hmparallel
  have hfalse : positive = false := by
    cases positive with
    | false => rfl
    | true =>
        have hu : (q.1 + q.2) / 2 ∈ Ioo q.1 q.2 := by
          constructor <;> linarith [hq.1.1]
        have hu₀ : (q₀.1 + q₀.2) / 2 ∈ Ioo q₀.1 q₀.2 := by
          constructor <;> linarith [hq₀.1.1]
        have hpos := hsource _ hu
        have hneg := hnegative₀ _ hu₀
        rw [← packingSol_occurrence_midpoint c e a (packingSol_rationalTangent m) q hcoords] at hpos
        rw [← packingSol_occurrence_midpoint c e a₀ (packingSol_rationalTangent m) q₀ hcoords₀] at hneg
        exact False.elim (positive_negative_edgeGerms_disjoint
          (packingSol_rationalTangent_ne_zero m) hpos hneg)
  subst positive
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hpu⟩ := hparameters p hpopen
  exact ⟨m, hm, e, he, a, q, hq, hcoords, hsource, horder, u, hu, hpu,
    hpu.symm ▸ htarget u hu⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.packingSol_oneLink_denseSingle
statement:
private theorem packingSol_oneLink_denseSingle
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (P : PolyhedralCode) (T : Set Plane) (n₀ : RationalNormal)
    (hP : polyhedralSupport P = K.support)
    (hrat : Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasRationalSlopes K)
    (htile : Tiling.Polygonal.TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (a₀ : Plane) (hproper : Tiling.RationalSlopes.IsProperLink K (normalDirection n₀) T a₀) :
    ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
      ∀ Kφ : PolygonalRegion, Kφ.support = deformedPolyhedralSupport P φ →
        Dense (packingSol_singleOpenUnion Kφ T φ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨E, hEraw, hcover, _⟩ := rationalIntrinsicPrimitiveEdges K hrat
  have hE : ∀ e ∈ E, e.1 ≠ e.2 ∧ e.1 ∈ Tiling.vertexSet K.support ∧
      e.2 ∈ Tiling.vertexSet K.support ∧ segment ℝ e.1 e.2 ⊆ frontier K.support ∧
      (∀ z ∈ openSegment ℝ e.1 e.2, z ∉ Tiling.vertexSet K.support) ∧
      ((∀ z ∈ openSegment ℝ e.1 e.2, positiveEdgeGerm K.support (e.2 - e.1) z) ∨
        (∀ z ∈ openSegment ℝ e.1 e.2, negativeEdgeGerm K.support (e.2 - e.1) z)) :=
    fun e he => ⟨(hEraw e he).1, (hEraw e he).2.1, (hEraw e he).2.2.1,
      (hEraw e he).2.2.2.1, (hEraw e he).2.2.2.2.1, (hEraw e he).2.2.2.2.2.2⟩
  have hratE : ∀ e ∈ E, Tiling.RationalSlopes.IsRationalVectorDirection (e.2 - e.1) :=
    fun e he => (hEraw e he).2.2.2.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨N, Fo, εo, hεo, hnegative⟩ :=
    packingSol_uniformActualNegativeMappedOccurrence K P T hP htile E hE hratE hcover
  choose Fp εp hεp hpaired using
    (fun n : RationalNormal => packingSol_uniformActualPairedSourcePatch
      K P T hP htile E hE hratE hcover n)
  choose Fx εx hεx hexclusive using
    (fun n : RationalNormal => packingSol_uniformActualLocalExclusiveClosedWitness
      K P T hP htile E hE hratE hcover n)
  obtain ⟨Fn, εn, hεn, hnormal⟩ := packingSol_finiteNormal_controls N
    (fun n φ => IsFiniteApproximation (Fp n) (εp n) φ ∧ IsFiniteApproximation (Fx n) (εx n) φ)
    (by
      intro n hn
      refine ⟨Fp n ∪ Fx n, min (εp n) (εx n), lt_min (hεp n) (hεx n), ?_⟩
      intro φ hφ
      exact ⟨finiteApproximation_strengthen _ _ _ _ φ Finset.subset_union_left
        (min_le_left _ _) hφ, finiteApproximation_strengthen _ _ _ _ φ
        Finset.subset_union_right (min_le_right _ _) hφ⟩)
  obtain ⟨Fa, εa, hεa, hanchor⟩ :=
    packingSol_selectedProperLine_actualSingleComponent K P T n₀ hP hrat htile a₀ hproper
  obtain ⟨Fs, εs, hεs, hsingleWitness⟩ :=
    packingSol_exclusiveClosedWitness_singleComponent K P T hP hrat htile
  obtain ⟨Fv, εv, hεv, hvertexBall⟩ :=
    packingSol_uniformRealInterval_vertexFreeBall K T n₀ hrat htile a₀ hproper
  let F := Fa ∪ (Fo ∪ (Fn ∪ (Fs ∪ Fv)))
  let ε := min εa (min εo (min εn (min εs εv)))
  refine ⟨F, ε, lt_min hεa (lt_min hεo (lt_min hεn (lt_min hεs hεv))), ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ Kφ hKφ
  have approx (A : Finset ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (hA : A ⊆ F) (hδ : ε ≤ δ) :
      IsFiniteApproximation A δ φ := finiteApproximation_strengthen A F δ ε φ hA hδ hφ
  have hφa : IsFiniteApproximation Fa εa φ := approx _ _
    (by intro z hz; simp only [F, Finset.mem_union]; tauto) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hφo : IsFiniteApproximation Fo εo φ := approx _ _
    (by intro z hz; simp only [F, Finset.mem_union]; tauto)
    ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
  have hφn : IsFiniteApproximation Fn εn φ := approx _ _
    (by intro z hz; simp only [F, Finset.mem_union]; tauto)
    ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)))
  have hφs : IsFiniteApproximation Fs εs φ := approx _ _
    (by intro z hz; simp only [F, Finset.mem_union]; tauto)
    ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))))
  have hφv : IsFiniteApproximation Fv εv φ := approx _ _
    (by intro z hz; simp only [F, Finset.mem_union]; tauto)
    ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))))
  obtain ⟨t, ht, x₀, hx₀, _, hsingle₀⟩ := hanchor φ hφa Kφ hKφ
  by_contra hnotDense
  obtain ⟨i, p, hpUnion, hpComponent, hpFull, hpNot, hstraight⟩ :=
    packingSol_notDense_actualSingleBoundary Kφ T φ t ht x₀ hx₀ hsingle₀ hnotDense
  let c : Plane := i.1.1
  have hc : c ∈ T := i.1.1.2
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hpActual, hsingle⟩ :=
    packingSol_singleIndex_actualBoundaryComponent Kφ T (deformPoint φ) i p hpComponent
  let V := (fun v : Plane => deformPoint φ c + deformPoint φ v) '' Tiling.vertexSet K.support
  have hV : V.Finite := K.isPolygonal.vertexSet_finite.image _
  obtain ⟨q, hqComponent, hqUnion, hqFull, hqNot, hqEq⟩ :=
    packingSol_actualSingleBoundary_genericPoint Kφ T φ c hc x hx hsingle p hpUnion
      hpActual hpFull hpNot hstraight V hV
  have hqNotOld : q ∉ deformPoint φ c +ᵥ (deformPoint φ '' Tiling.vertexSet K.support) := by
    intro hbad
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvq⟩ := Set.mem_vadd_set.mp hbad
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hv
    exact hqNot ⟨w, hw, by simpa only [vadd_eq_add] using hvq⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn, eC, heC, a, qC, hqC, hcoordsC, hsourceC, _, u₀, hu₀, hpoint, _⟩ :=
    hnegative φ hφo Kφ hKφ c hc q hqFull hqNotOld
  let d := packingSol_rationalTangent n
  have hd : d ≠ 0 := packingSol_rationalTangent_ne_zero n
  rw [hpoint] at hqComponent hqEq
  obtain ⟨hφp, hφx⟩ := hnormal φ hφn n hn
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hframe, hown, hunion, b, hb, _, eB, heB, qB, hqB,
      hcoordsB, hsourceB, L, H, hLH, hsubC, hsubB, hball, hpatch⟩ :=
    hpaired n φ hφp Kφ hKφ a 0 c hc eC heC qC hqC hcoordsC hsourceC x hx
      hsingle u₀ hu₀ hqComponent hqEq
  obtain ⟨z, hz, Rv, hRv, hfree⟩ :=
    hvertexBall φ hφv (deformPoint φ a) d hd L H hLH hpatch
  obtain ⟨r, hr, _, _, hframe', hown', hunion'⟩ :=
    packingSol_negativeFrame_recenter
      (connectedComponentIn (deformPoint φ c +ᵥ Kφ.openCarrier) x)
      (deformPoint φ c +ᵥ Kφ.support)
      (PackingSolSingleFamily.singleClosedUnion Kφ T (deformPoint φ))
      (deformPoint φ a + u₀ • d) (deformPoint φ a + z • d) d R hR (hball z hz)
      (vertexExclusionSol_sameCarrier_side (deformPoint φ a) d u₀ z)
      hframe hown hunion
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyball, hypositive, hyexclusive⟩ :=
    hexclusive n φ hφx Kφ hKφ a 0 c hc b hb eC heC eB heB qC hqC qB hqB
      hcoordsC hcoordsB hsourceB x hx hsingle z r hr hframe' hown'
      (hsubC hz) (hsubB hz) Rv hRv hfree
  have hsingleB := hsingleWitness φ hφs Kφ hKφ b hb y hy hyexclusive
  exact packingSol_singleComponent_point_contradicts_unionNegative Kφ T φ b hb y hy
    hsingleB (deformPoint φ a + z • d) d r hyball hypositive hunion'

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.oneLink_labelledPacking
statement:
theorem oneLink_labelledPacking :
  ∀ (K : PolygonalRegion) (P : PolyhedralCode) (T : Set Plane) (n : RationalNormal),
    polyhedralSupport P = K.support → Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasRationalSlopes K →
    Tiling.Polygonal.TilesOn K T Set.univ →
    Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasProperLink K (normalDirection n) T →
      ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
        ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
          ∀ Kφ : PolygonalRegion, Kφ.support = deformedPolyhedralSupport P φ →
            ∀ s ∈ T, ∀ t ∈ T, s ≠ t →
              Disjoint (deformPoint φ s +ᵥ Kφ.openCarrier)
                (deformPoint φ t +ᵥ Kφ.openCarrier)
proof:
:= by
  intro K P T n hP hrat htile hproper
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hproper
  obtain ⟨F, ε, hε, hdense⟩ := packingSol_oneLink_denseSingle K P T n hP hrat htile a ha
  exact ⟨F, ε, hε, fun φ hφ Kφ hKφ =>
    packingSol_denseSingle_forces_labelledDisjoint Kφ T φ (hdense φ hφ Kφ hKφ)⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.oneLink_indexedLocalFiniteness
statement:
theorem oneLink_indexedLocalFiniteness :
  ∀ (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set Plane) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane),
    Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1 → Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasRationalDirection δ →
    Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasRationalSlopes K → Tiling.Polygonal.TilesOn K T Set.univ →
    Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasProperLink K δ T →
      ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
        ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
          ∀ Q : Set Plane, Bornology.IsBounded Q →
            {t | t ∈ T ∧ deformPoint φ t ∈ Q}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  intro K T δ hdim hδ hrat htile hlink
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := rationalDirection_hasNormal δ hdim hδ
  obtain ⟨P, hP, W, hW, hzero, F₀, ε₀, hε₀, hconstruct⟩ := rationalPolygon_construction K hrat
  obtain ⟨F₁, ε₁, hε₁, hpacking⟩ :=
    oneLink_labelledPacking K P T n hP hrat htile (by simpa only [hn] using hlink)
  refine ⟨F₀ ∪ F₁, min ε₀ ε₁, lt_min hε₀ hε₁, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ
  have hφ₀ := finiteApproximation_strengthen F₀ (F₀ ∪ F₁) ε₀ (min ε₀ ε₁) φ
    Finset.subset_union_left (min_le_left _ _) hφ
  have hφ₁ := finiteApproximation_strengthen F₁ (F₀ ∪ F₁) ε₁ (min ε₀ ε₁) φ
    Finset.subset_union_right (min_le_right _ _) hφ
  obtain ⟨Kφ, hKφ, _⟩ := hconstruct φ hφ₀
  exact labelledPacking_indexedLF Kφ T (deformPoint φ) (hpacking φ hφ₁ Kφ hKφ)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.oneLinkRationalDeformation
statement:
theorem oneLinkRationalDeformation :
  ∀ (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set Plane) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane),
    Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1 → Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasRationalDirection δ →
    Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasRationalSlopes K → Tiling.Polygonal.TilesOn K T Set.univ →
    Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasProperLink K δ T →
      ∃ P : PolyhedralCode, polyhedralSupport P = K.support ∧
        ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
          ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
            ∃ Kφ : PolygonalRegion, Kφ.support = deformedPolyhedralSupport P φ ∧
              Tiling.IsRational Kφ.support ∧ Set.InjOn (deformPoint φ) T ∧
              Tiling.Polygonal.TilesOn Kφ (deformPoint φ '' T) Set.univ ∧
              (∀ S ⊆ T, Tiling.Polygonal.IsInvariantAlong (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K S) δ →
                Tiling.Polygonal.IsInvariantAlong
                  (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport Kφ (deformPoint φ '' S)) δ) ∧
              (∀ S ⊆ T, Tiling.Polygonal.IsCenterColumn K δ S →
                Tiling.Polygonal.IsCenterColumn Kφ δ (deformPoint φ '' S))
proof:
:= by
  intro K T δ hdim hδ hrat htile hlink
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := rationalDirection_hasNormal δ hdim hδ
  have hlinkn : Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasProperLink K (normalDirection n) T := by
    simpa only [hn] using hlink
  obtain ⟨P, hP, W, _, _, F₀, ε₀, hε₀, hconstruct⟩ := rationalPolygon_construction K hrat
  obtain ⟨F₁, ε₁, hε₁, hcover⟩ := deformation_closedCopies_coverPlane K P T hP hrat htile
  obtain ⟨F₂, ε₂, hε₂, hpack⟩ := oneLink_labelledPacking K P T n hP hrat htile hlinkn
  obtain ⟨F₃, ε₃, hε₃, hsat⟩ := saturatedSubfamily_forwardTransport K P T n hP hrat htile hlinkn
  refine ⟨P, hP, F₀ ∪ F₁ ∪ F₂ ∪ F₃, min ε₀ (min ε₁ (min ε₂ ε₃)),
    lt_min hε₀ (lt_min hε₁ (lt_min hε₂ hε₃)), ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ
  have hφ₀ : IsFiniteApproximation F₀ ε₀ φ := by
    apply finiteApproximation_strengthen F₀ (F₀ ∪ F₁ ∪ F₂ ∪ F₃) ε₀ _ φ _ (min_le_left _ _) hφ
    intro x hx; simp [hx]
  have hφ₁ : IsFiniteApproximation F₁ ε₁ φ := by
    apply finiteApproximation_strengthen F₁ (F₀ ∪ F₁ ∪ F₂ ∪ F₃) ε₁ _ φ _
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)) hφ
    intro x hx; simp [hx]
  have hφ₂ : IsFiniteApproximation F₂ ε₂ φ := by
    apply finiteApproximation_strengthen F₂ (F₀ ∪ F₁ ∪ F₂ ∪ F₃) ε₂ _ φ _
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))) hφ
    intro x hx; simp [hx]
  have hφ₃ : IsFiniteApproximation F₃ ε₃ φ := by
    apply finiteApproximation_strengthen F₃ (F₀ ∪ F₁ ∪ F₂ ∪ F₃) ε₃ _ φ _
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))) hφ
    intro x hx; simp [hx]
  obtain ⟨Kφ, hKφ, hKrational, _⟩ := hconstruct φ hφ₀
  have hpacking := hpack φ hφ₂ Kφ hKφ
  have hinj := labelledPacking_injOn Kφ T (deformPoint φ) hpacking
  have hp := labelledPacking_image_isPacking Kφ T (deformPoint φ) hpacking
  have hcoverφ : (⋃ t : deformPoint φ '' T, (t : Plane) +ᵥ Kφ.support) = Set.univ := by
    rw [closedCopies_image_eq]
    exact hcover φ hφ₁ Kφ hKφ
  have hfull : Tiling.Polygonal.TilesOn Kφ (deformPoint φ '' T) Set.univ := by
    have h := Tiling.Polygonal.tilesOn_regularSupport_of_packing hp
    change Tiling.Polygonal.TilesOn Kφ (deformPoint φ '' T)
      (interior (closure (Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion Kφ (deformPoint φ '' T)))) at h
    rw [Tiling.Polygonal.closure_openUnion_eq_iUnion_support hp, hcoverφ, interior_univ] at h
    exact h
  have hforward : ∀ S ⊆ T, Tiling.Polygonal.IsInvariantAlong (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K S) δ →
      Tiling.Polygonal.IsInvariantAlong
        (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport Kφ (deformPoint φ '' S)) δ := by
    simpa only [hn] using hsat φ hφ₃ Kφ hKφ hfull
  refine ⟨Kφ, hKφ, hKrational, hinj, hfull, hforward, ?_⟩
  intro S hST hcol
  refine ⟨labelledPacking_image_isPacking Kφ S (deformPoint φ)
    (fun s hs t ht => hpacking s (hST hs) t (hST ht)), hcol.2.1.image _, ?_, hforward S hST hcol.2.2.2⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hcol.2.2.1
  refine ⟨deformPoint φ a, ?_⟩
  rintro w ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
  rw [← hn]
  apply rationalDirection_preservesCoset φ n
  simpa only [hn] using ha s hs

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.invariant_regularSupport_iUnion
statement:
private theorem invariant_regularSupport_iUnion (K : PolygonalRegion) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane)
    {ι : Type} (S : ι → Set Plane)
    (hinv : ∀ i, Tiling.Polygonal.IsInvariantAlong (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K (S i)) δ) :
    Tiling.Polygonal.IsInvariantAlong (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K (⋃ i, S i)) δ
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  rw [Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport_iUnion]
  rw [← interior_vadd, ← closure_vadd]
  have hunion : u +ᵥ (⋃ i, Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K (S i)) =
      ⋃ i, u +ᵥ Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K (S i) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, Set.mem_iUnion]
  rw [hunion]
  congr 2
  apply Set.iUnion_congr
  intro i
  exact hinv i u hu

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.invariantSubfamily_iff_componentClosed
statement:
private theorem invariantSubfamily_iff_componentClosed (K : PolygonalRegion)
    (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) (T S : Set Plane)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (htile : Tiling.Polygonal.TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (hST : S ⊆ T) :
    Tiling.Polygonal.IsInvariantAlong (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K S) δ ↔
      ∀ C : Tiling.RationalSlopes.EarthquakeComponent K δ T,
        Disjoint C.centres S ∨ C.centres ⊆ S
proof:
:= by
  have hfull : Tiling.Polygonal.IsInvariantAlong (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K T) δ := by
    rw [Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) htile]
    intro u hu
    simp
  constructor
  · intro hS
    exact Tiling.RationalSlopes.invariantSubfamily_isUnionComponents K δ T S
      hdim htile.2.1 hfull hST hS
  · intro hclosed
    let I := {C : Tiling.RationalSlopes.EarthquakeComponent K δ T // C.centres ⊆ S}
    have hS : S = ⋃ C : I, C.1.centres := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        let t : T := ⟨x, hST hx⟩
        let C : Tiling.RationalSlopes.EarthquakeComponent K δ T :=
          (Tiling.RationalSlopes.earthquakeGraph K δ T).connectedComponentMk t
        have hxC : x ∈ C.centres := ⟨t, rfl, rfl⟩
        have hCS : C.centres ⊆ S := by
          rcases hclosed C with hdisj | hsubset
          · exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hxC hx).elim
          · exact hsubset
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨C, hCS⟩, hxC⟩
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨C, hxC⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
        exact C.2 hxC
    rw [hS]
    apply invariant_regularSupport_iUnion
    intro C
    exact Tiling.RationalSlopes.component_isInvariant K δ T hdim htile.2.1 hfull C.1

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.earthquakeComponent_centres_transport
statement:
private theorem earthquakeComponent_centres_transport
    (K Kφ : PolygonalRegion) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) (T : Set Plane)
    (f : Plane → Plane) (hinj : Set.InjOn f T)
    (hadj : ∀ s ∈ T, ∀ t ∈ T,
      Tiling.RationalSlopes.DirectionalOverlap K δ s t ↔
        Tiling.RationalSlopes.DirectionalOverlap Kφ δ (f s) (f t)) :
    ∃ e : Tiling.RationalSlopes.EarthquakeComponent K δ T ≃
        Tiling.RationalSlopes.EarthquakeComponent Kφ δ (f '' T),
      ∀ C, (e C).centres = f '' C.centres
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E : (T : Set Plane) ≃ (f '' T) := Equiv.Set.imageOfInjOn f T hinj
  let hgraph : Tiling.RationalSlopes.earthquakeGraph K δ T ≃g
      Tiling.RationalSlopes.earthquakeGraph Kφ δ (f '' T) := by
    refine ⟨E, ?_⟩
    intro s t
    change (E s ≠ E t ∧
        (Tiling.RationalSlopes.DirectionalOverlap Kφ δ (f s.1) (f t.1) ∨
          Tiling.RationalSlopes.DirectionalOverlap Kφ δ (f t.1) (f s.1))) ↔
      (s ≠ t ∧ (Tiling.RationalSlopes.DirectionalOverlap K δ s.1 t.1 ∨
        Tiling.RationalSlopes.DirectionalOverlap K δ t.1 s.1))
    rw [E.injective.ne_iff]
    exact and_congr Iff.rfl
      (or_congr (hadj s.1 s.2 t.1 t.2).symm (hadj t.1 t.2 s.1 s.2).symm)
  let e := hgraph.connectedComponentEquiv
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  intro C
  change (Subtype.val '' (e C).supp) = f '' (Subtype.val '' C.supp)
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    let y' : (e C).supp := ⟨y, hy⟩
    let x' : C.supp := (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.isoEquivSupp hgraph C).symm y'
    have hval := congrArg (fun q : (e C).supp => (q.1.1 : Plane))
      ((SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.isoEquivSupp hgraph C).apply_symm_apply y')
    refine ⟨x'.1, ⟨x'.1, x'.2, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    exact hval
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    let z' : C.supp := ⟨z, hz⟩
    let w' : (e C).supp := SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.isoEquivSupp hgraph C z'
    refine ⟨w'.1, w'.2, ?_⟩
    rfl

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.transverseFLC_oneLinkComponentCorrespondence
statement:
theorem transverseFLC_oneLinkComponentCorrespondence :
  ∀ (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set Plane) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane),
    Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1 → Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasRationalDirection δ →
    Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasRationalSlopes K → Tiling.Polygonal.TilesOn K T Set.univ →
    Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasProperLink K δ T →
    Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasTransverseFLC K δ T →
      ∃ P : PolyhedralCode, polyhedralSupport P = K.support ∧
        ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
          ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
            ∃ Kφ : PolygonalRegion, Kφ.support = deformedPolyhedralSupport P φ ∧
              Set.InjOn (deformPoint φ) T ∧
              Tiling.Polygonal.TilesOn Kφ (deformPoint φ '' T) Set.univ ∧
              (∀ S ⊆ T,
                Tiling.Polygonal.IsInvariantAlong (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K S) δ ↔
                  Tiling.Polygonal.IsInvariantAlong
                    (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport Kφ (deformPoint φ '' S)) δ) ∧
              ∃ e : Tiling.RationalSlopes.EarthquakeComponent K δ T ≃
                Tiling.RationalSlopes.EarthquakeComponent Kφ δ (deformPoint φ '' T),
                ∀ C : Tiling.RationalSlopes.EarthquakeComponent K δ T,
                  (e C).centres = deformPoint φ '' C.centres ∧
                  (Tiling.Polygonal.IsCenterColumn K δ C.centres ↔
                    Tiling.Polygonal.IsCenterColumn Kφ δ (e C).centres)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T δ hdim hδ hrat htile hlink hflc
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := rationalDirection_hasNormal δ hdim hδ
  obtain ⟨P, hP, F₀, ε₀, hε₀, hdeform⟩ :=
    oneLinkRationalDeformation K T δ hdim hδ hrat htile hlink
  have hflcn : Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasTransverseFLC K (normalDirection n) T := by
    simpa only [hn] using hflc
  obtain ⟨F₁, ε₁, hε₁, hoverlap⟩ :=
    transverseFLC_directionalOverlapReflection K P T n hP hrat htile hflcn
  obtain ⟨F₂, ε₂, hε₂, horder⟩ :=
    transverseFLC_globalOrderAndBoundedGapReflection K T n hrat htile hflcn 1 (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨P, hP, F₀ ∪ F₁ ∪ F₂, min ε₀ (min ε₁ ε₂),
    lt_min hε₀ (lt_min hε₁ hε₂), ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ
  have hφ₀ : IsFiniteApproximation F₀ ε₀ φ := by
    apply finiteApproximation_strengthen F₀ (F₀ ∪ F₁ ∪ F₂) ε₀ _ φ _ (min_le_left _ _) hφ
    intro x hx; simp [hx]
  have hφ₁ : IsFiniteApproximation F₁ ε₁ φ := by
    apply finiteApproximation_strengthen F₁ (F₀ ∪ F₁ ∪ F₂) ε₁ _ φ _
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)) hφ
    intro x hx; simp [hx]
  have hφ₂ : IsFiniteApproximation F₂ ε₂ φ := by
    apply finiteApproximation_strengthen F₂ (F₀ ∪ F₁ ∪ F₂) ε₂ _ φ _
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)) hφ
    intro x hx; simp [hx]
  obtain ⟨Kφ, hKφ, _, hinj, htileφ, hforward, hcolumns⟩ := hdeform φ hφ₀
  have hadj : ∀ s ∈ T, ∀ t ∈ T,
      Tiling.RationalSlopes.DirectionalOverlap K δ s t ↔
        Tiling.RationalSlopes.DirectionalOverlap Kφ δ (deformPoint φ s) (deformPoint φ t) := by
    simpa only [hn] using hoverlap φ hφ₁ Kφ hKφ
  obtain ⟨e, hcentres⟩ := earthquakeComponent_centres_transport K Kφ δ T (deformPoint φ) hinj hadj
  have hCT (C : Tiling.RationalSlopes.EarthquakeComponent K δ T) : C.centres ⊆ T := by
    rintro x ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact v.property
  have hdisj (A B : Set Plane) (hAT : A ⊆ T) (hBT : B ⊆ T) :
      Disjoint (deformPoint φ '' A) (deformPoint φ '' B) ↔ Disjoint A B := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [Set.disjoint_left] at h ⊢
      intro x hxA hxB
      exact h (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hxA) (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hxB)
    · intro h
      rw [Set.disjoint_left] at h ⊢
      rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ ⟨b, hb, hab⟩
      have : b = a := hinj (hBT hb) (hAT ha) hab
      exact h ha (this ▸ hb)
  have hinvariant : ∀ S ⊆ T,
      Tiling.Polygonal.IsInvariantAlong (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K S) δ ↔
        Tiling.Polygonal.IsInvariantAlong
          (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport Kφ (deformPoint φ '' S)) δ := by
    intro S hST
    rw [invariantSubfamily_iff_componentClosed K δ T S hdim htile hST,
      invariantSubfamily_iff_componentClosed Kφ δ (deformPoint φ '' T)
        (deformPoint φ '' S) hdim htileφ (Set.image_mono hST)]
    constructor
    · intro h Cφ
      obtain ⟨C, rfl⟩ := e.surjective Cφ
      rw [hcentres]
      rcases h C with hd | hs
      · exact Or.inl ((hdisj C.centres S (hCT C) hST).mpr hd)
      · exact Or.inr (Set.image_mono hs)
    · intro h C
      have hc := h (e C)
      rw [hcentres C] at hc
      rcases hc with hd | hs
      · exact Or.inl ((hdisj C.centres S (hCT C) hST).mp hd)
      · exact Or.inr ((hinj.image_subset_image_iff (hCT C) hST).mp hs)
  have hcompare : ∀ s ∈ T, ∀ t ∈ T,
      normalEval n s < normalEval n t ↔
        normalEval n (deformPoint φ s) < normalEval n (deformPoint φ t) := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := K.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty K.nonempty
    let O : Set Plane := connectedComponentIn K.openCarrier z
    have hO : O ∈ Tiling.interiorComponents K.support := ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨u, _, hu, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := component_normalProjection K n O hO
    intro s hs t ht
    have hc := (horder φ hφ₂).1 (u + s) (Set.add_mem_add hu hs)
      (u + t) (Set.add_mem_add hu ht)
    simpa only [normalEval_add, rationalNormal_commutes, map_add,
      Rat.cast_add, add_lt_add_iff_left] using hc
  have hreflect (s : Plane) (hs : s ∈ T) (t : Plane) (ht : t ∈ T)
      (heq : normalEval n (deformPoint φ s) = normalEval n (deformPoint φ t)) :
      normalEval n s = normalEval n t := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy (normalEval n s) (normalEval n t) with hlt | he | hgt
    · have := (hcompare s hs t ht).mp hlt
      exact (not_lt_of_ge heq.ge this).elim
    · exact he
    · have := (hcompare t ht s hs).mp hgt
      exact (not_lt_of_ge heq.le this).elim
  refine ⟨Kφ, hKφ, hinj, htileφ, hinvariant, e, ?_⟩
  intro C
  refine ⟨hcentres C, ?_⟩
  rw [hcentres C]
  constructor
  · exact hcolumns C.centres (hCT C)
  · intro hcol
    have hCne : C.centres.Nonempty := C.nonempty_supp.image Subtype.val
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := C.nonempty_supp.image Subtype.val
    have hline : Tiling.Polygonal.IsLineSupported C.centres δ := by
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hcol.2.2.1
      refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
      intro s hs
      have hst : deformPoint φ s - deformPoint φ t ∈ normalDirection n := by
        rw [hn]
        simpa only [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right] using
          δ.sub_mem (ha _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hs)) (ha _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ ht))
      have heqφ : normalEval n (deformPoint φ s) = normalEval n (deformPoint φ t) := by
        have hz := (normalDirection_mem_iff n _).mp hst
        rw [normalEval_sub] at hz
        linarith
      rw [← hn]
      apply (normalDirection_mem_iff n _).mpr
      rw [normalEval_sub, hreflect s (hCT C hs) t (hCT C ht) heqφ]
      ring
    have hpack : Tiling.IsPacking K.prototileFamily (K.placements C.centres) := by
      apply (Tiling.Polygonal.isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K C.centres).mpr
      intro s hs t ht hst
      exact (Tiling.Polygonal.isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K T).mp htile.2.1
        (hCT C hs) (hCT C ht) hst
    exact ⟨hpack, hCne, hline, (hinvariant C.centres (hCT C)).mpr hcol.2.2.2⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.normalKernel_eq_span_perpendicular
statement:
private theorem normalKernel_eq_span_perpendicular (x y : ℝ)
    (hne : x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.ker ((x • Complex.reCLM + y • Complex.imCLM).toLinearMap) =
      Submodule.span ℝ ({perpendicularVector x y} : Set Plane)
proof:
:= by
  let v := perpendicularVector x y
  have hv : v ≠ 0 := by
    intro hv
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re hv
    have him := congrArg Complex.im hv
    simp [v, perpendicularVector] at hre him
    rcases hne with hx | hy
    · exact hx him
    · exact hy hre
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hz
    change x * z.re + y * z.im = 0 at hz
    rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton]
    rcases hne with hx | hy
    · refine ⟨z.im / x, ?_⟩
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp [perpendicularVector]
        field_simp
        nlinarith [hz]
      · simp [perpendicularVector]
        field_simp
    · have hy' : y ≠ 0 := hy
      refine ⟨-z.re / y, ?_⟩
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp [perpendicularVector]
        field_simp
      · simp [perpendicularVector]
        field_simp
        nlinarith [hz]
  · rw [Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    change x * (perpendicularVector x y).re +
      y * (perpendicularVector x y).im = 0
    simp [perpendicularVector]
    ring

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.normalDirection_rational
statement:
theorem normalDirection_rational :
  ∀ n : RationalNormal, Module.finrank ℝ (normalDirection n) = 1 ∧
    Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasRationalDirection (normalDirection n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  let v := perpendicularVector (n.x : ℝ) (n.y : ℝ)
  have hn : (n.x : ℝ) ≠ 0 ∨ (n.y : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    rcases n.nonzero with hx | hy
    · exact Or.inl (by exact_mod_cast hx)
    · exact Or.inr (by exact_mod_cast hy)
  have hv : v ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have him := congrArg Complex.im h
    simp [v, perpendicularVector] at him
    rcases hn with hx | hy
    · exact hx (by exact_mod_cast him)
    · have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
      simp [v, perpendicularVector] at hre
      exact hy (by exact_mod_cast hre)
  have hker : normalDirection n = Submodule.span ℝ ({v} : Set Plane) := by
    simpa [normalDirection, v] using
      (normalKernel_eq_span_perpendicular (n.x : ℝ) (n.y : ℝ) hn)
  constructor
  · rw [hker, finrank_span_singleton]
    simp [hv]
  · let p : IntegerPlane := ![-n.y.num * n.x.den, n.x.num * n.y.den]
    have hp : p ≠ 0 := by
      intro hp
      have he : -n.y.num * n.x.den = 0 := by simpa [p] using congrFun hp 0
      have hd : n.x.num * n.y.den = 0 := by simpa [p] using congrFun hp 1
      rcases n.nonzero with hx | hy
      · have hnum : n.x.num = 0 := by
          have hden : (n.y.den : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast n.y.den_nz
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hd).resolve_right hden
        exact hx (Rat.num_eq_zero.mp hnum)
      · have hnum : n.y.num = 0 := by
          have hden : (n.x.den : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast n.x.den_nz
          have : n.y.num * n.x.den = 0 := by nlinarith
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hden
        exact hy (Rat.num_eq_zero.mp hnum)
    have hpv : integerPoint p = ((n.x.den : ℝ) * n.y.den) • v := by
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp [p, v, perpendicularVector, integerPoint, Rat.cast_def]
        field_simp
      · simp [p, v, perpendicularVector, integerPoint, Rat.cast_def]
        field_simp
    refine ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩
    rw [hker]
    rw [hpv]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (by simp))

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.rationalDirection_hasNormal
statement:
theorem rationalDirection_hasNormal :
  ∀ δ : Submodule ℝ Plane, Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1 →
    Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasRationalDirection δ →
      ∃ n : RationalNormal, normalDirection n = δ
proof:
:= by
  intro δ hdim ⟨p, hp, hpδ⟩
  let z : Plane := integerPoint p
  let n : RationalNormal := ⟨p 1, -(p 0), by
    by_cases h0 : p 0 = 0
    · left
      intro h1
      have hp1 : p 1 = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h1
      apply hp
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [h0, hp1]
    · right
      intro h1
      have hp0 : p 0 = 0 := by
        have : -(p 0 : ℚ) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h1
        exact_mod_cast (neg_eq_zero.mp this)
      exact h0 hp0⟩
  have hz : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hp
    exact integerPoint_injective (by simpa [z] using hz)
  have hspan : δ = Submodule.span ℝ ({z} : Set Plane) := by
    symm
    apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq
    · exact Submodule.span_le.mpr (by simpa [z] using hpδ)
    · have hrank : Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ ({z} : Set Plane)) = 1 :=
        finrank_span_singleton hz
      rw [hrank, hdim]
  have hnormal : normalDirection n = Submodule.span ℝ ({z} : Set Plane) := by
    have hx : (n.x : ℝ) = z.im := by simp [n, z, integerPoint]
    have hy : (n.y : ℝ) = -z.re := by simp [n, z, integerPoint]
    have hkernel := normalKernel_eq_span_perpendicular (n.x : ℝ) (n.y : ℝ) (by
      rcases n.nonzero with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (by exact_mod_cast h)
      · exact Or.inr (by exact_mod_cast h))
    have hv : perpendicularVector z.im (-z.re) = z := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [perpendicularVector]
    simpa [normalDirection, hx, hy, hv] using hkernel
  exact ⟨n, hnormal.trans hspan.symm⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.rationalLine_pairIntersection
statement:
theorem rationalLine_pairIntersection :
  ∀ l m : RationalLine,
    l.normal.x * m.normal.y - l.normal.y * m.normal.x ≠ 0 →
      ∃ z : Plane, l.eval z = 0 ∧ m.eval z = 0 ∧
        (∀ w : Plane, l.eval w = 0 → m.eval w = 0 → w = z) ∧
        ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ,
          (deformLine φ l).eval (deformPoint φ z) = 0 ∧
            (deformLine φ m).eval (deformPoint φ z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro l m hdet
  let d : ℝ := (l.normal.x : ℝ) * (m.normal.y : ℝ) -
    (l.normal.y : ℝ) * (m.normal.x : ℝ)
  have hd : d ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [d]
    exact_mod_cast hdet
  let z : Plane := Complex.mk
    ((l.offset * (m.normal.y : ℝ) - (l.normal.y : ℝ) * m.offset) / d)
    (((l.normal.x : ℝ) * m.offset - l.offset * (m.normal.x : ℝ)) / d)
  have hl : l.eval z = 0 := by
    dsimp [RationalLine.eval, normalEval, z]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hm : m.eval z = 0 := by
    dsimp [RationalLine.eval, normalEval, z]
    field_simp
    ring
  refine ⟨z, hl, hm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro w hlw hmw
    dsimp [RationalLine.eval, normalEval] at hlw hmw
    apply Complex.ext
    · change w.re = (l.offset * (m.normal.y : ℝ) -
        (l.normal.y : ℝ) * m.offset) / d
      apply (eq_div_iff hd).2
      dsimp [d]
      linear_combination (m.normal.y : ℝ) * hlw - (l.normal.y : ℝ) * hmw
    · change w.im = ((l.normal.x : ℝ) * m.offset -
        l.offset * (m.normal.x : ℝ)) / d
      apply (eq_div_iff hd).2
      dsimp [d]
      linear_combination (l.normal.x : ℝ) * hmw - (m.normal.x : ℝ) * hlw
  · intro φ
    have commute (n : RationalNormal) (w : Plane) :
        normalEval n (deformPoint φ w) = (φ (normalEval n w) : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [normalEval, deformPoint]
      have hx := φ.map_smul n.x w.re
      have hy := φ.map_smul n.y w.im
      simp only [Rat.smul_def] at hx hy
      rw [map_add, hx, hy]
      push_cast
      rfl
    constructor
    · change normalEval l.normal (deformPoint φ z) - (φ l.offset : ℝ) = 0
      rw [commute, sub_eq_zero.mp hl, sub_self]
    · change normalEval m.normal (deformPoint φ z) - (φ m.offset : ℝ) = 0
      rw [commute, sub_eq_zero.mp hm, sub_self]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.lineEval_continuous
statement: private theorem lineEval_continuous (l : RationalLine) : Continuous l.eval
proof:
:= by
  change Continuous (fun z : Plane =>
    (l.normal.x : ℝ) * z.re + (l.normal.y : ℝ) * z.im - l.offset)
  fun_prop

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.closedCell_isClosed
statement:
private theorem closedCell_isClosed (cell : List RationalLine) :
    IsClosed (closedCell cell)
proof:
:= by
  change IsClosed {z | ∀ l, ∀ (_ : l ∈ cell), l.eval z ≤ 0}
  simp only [ofPred_forall]
  exact isClosed_iInter fun l => isClosed_iInter fun _ =>
    isClosed_le (lineEval_continuous l) continuous_const

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.openCell_isOpen
statement: private theorem openCell_isOpen (cell : List RationalLine) : IsOpen (openCell cell)
proof:
:= by
  induction cell with
  | nil => simp [openCell]
  | cons l cell ih =>
    have heq : openCell (l :: cell) = {z | l.eval z < 0} ∩ openCell cell := by
      ext z
      simp [openCell]
    rw [heq]
    exact (isOpen_lt (lineEval_continuous l) continuous_const).inter ih

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.normalEval_isLinear
statement:
private theorem normalEval_isLinear (n : RationalNormal) :
    IsLinearMap ℝ (normalEval n)
proof:
:= by
  change IsLinearMap ℝ
    (((n.x : ℝ) • Complex.reCLM + (n.y : ℝ) • Complex.imCLM).toLinearMap)
  exact LinearMap.isLinear _

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.closedCell_convex
statement: private theorem closedCell_convex (cell : List RationalLine) : Convex ℝ (closedCell cell)
proof:
:= by
  induction cell with
  | nil => simpa [closedCell] using convex_univ (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := Plane)
  | cons l cell ih =>
    have heq : closedCell (l :: cell) =
        {z | normalEval l.normal z ≤ l.offset} ∩ closedCell cell := by
      ext z
      simp [closedCell, RationalLine.eval]
    rw [heq]
    exact (convex_halfSpace_le (normalEval_isLinear l.normal) l.offset).inter ih

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.closedCell_eq_convexHull_extremePoints
statement:
private theorem closedCell_eq_convexHull_extremePoints (cell : List RationalLine)
    (hcompact : IsCompact (closedCell cell))
    (hfinite : ((closedCell cell).extremePoints ℝ).Finite) :
    closedCell cell = convexHull ℝ ((closedCell cell).extremePoints ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hKM := closure_convexHull_extremePoints hcompact (closedCell_convex cell)
  rw [hfinite.isClosed_convexHull ℝ |>.closure_eq] at hKM
  exact hKM.symm

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.openCell_convex
statement: private theorem openCell_convex (cell : List RationalLine) : Convex ℝ (openCell cell)
proof:
:= by
  induction cell with
  | nil => simpa [openCell] using convex_univ (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := Plane)
  | cons l cell ih =>
    have heq : openCell (l :: cell) =
        {z | normalEval l.normal z < l.offset} ∩ openCell cell := by
      ext z
      simp [openCell, RationalLine.eval]
    rw [heq]
    exact (convex_halfSpace_lt (normalEval_isLinear l.normal) l.offset).inter ih

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.lineEval_combo
statement:
private theorem lineEval_combo (l : RationalLine) (x y : Plane) (a b : ℝ)
    (hab : a + b = 1) : l.eval (a • x + b • y) = a * l.eval x + b * l.eval y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [RationalLine.eval, normalEval, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
    Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination l.offset * hab

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.normal_tangent_ext
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : n.x * (tangentNormal n).y - n.y * (tangentNormal n).x ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [tangentNormal]
    rcases n.nonzero with hx | hy
    · nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hx, sq_nonneg n.y]
    · nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hy, sq_nonneg n.x]
  let l : RationalLine := ⟨n, normalEval n z⟩
  let m : RationalLine := ⟨tangentNormal n, normalEval (tangentNormal n) z⟩
  obtain ⟨x, _, _, huniq, _⟩ := rationalLine_pairIntersection l m hdet
  have hz : z = x := huniq z (by simp [l, RationalLine.eval])
    (by simp [m, RationalLine.eval])
  have hw : w = x := huniq w (by simp [l, RationalLine.eval, hn])
    (by simp [m, RationalLine.eval, ht])
  exact hz.trans hw.symm

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.normalEval_combo
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [RationalLine.eval, sub_zero] using
    lineEval_combo (⟨n, 0⟩ : RationalLine) x y a b hab

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.cellFace_eq_segment
proof:
:= by
  let t := tangentNormal l.normal
  have hfaceCompact : IsCompact (cellFace cell l) :=
    hcompact.inter_right (isClosed_eq (lineEval_continuous l) continuous_const)
  have htcont : Continuous (normalEval t) := by
    change Continuous (fun z : Plane => (t.x : ℝ) * z.re + (t.y : ℝ) * z.im)
    fun_prop
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hmin⟩ := hfaceCompact.exists_isMinOn hne htcont.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hmax⟩ := hfaceCompact.exists_isMaxOn hne htcont.continuousOn
  have hfaceConvex : Convex ℝ (cellFace cell l) := by
    have heq : cellFace cell l =
        closedCell cell ∩ {z | normalEval l.normal z = l.offset} := by
      ext z
      simp [cellFace, RationalLine.eval, sub_eq_zero]
    rw [heq]
    exact (closedCell_convex cell).inter
      (convex_hyperplane (normalEval_isLinear l.normal) l.offset)
  refine ⟨a, b, subset_antisymm ?_ (hfaceConvex.segment_subset ha hb)⟩
  intro z hz
  have han : normalEval l.normal a = l.offset := sub_eq_zero.mp ha.2
  have hbn : normalEval l.normal b = l.offset := sub_eq_zero.mp hb.2
  have hzn : normalEval l.normal z = l.offset := sub_eq_zero.mp hz.2
  have haz : normalEval t a ≤ normalEval t z := hmin hz
  have hzb : normalEval t z ≤ normalEval t b := hmax hz
  by_cases heq : normalEval t b = normalEval t a
  · have hza : z = a := normal_tangent_ext l.normal z a
      (hzn.trans han.symm) (le_antisymm (heq ▸ hzb) haz)
    exact hza.symm ▸ left_mem_segment ℝ a b
  · have hden : 0 < normalEval t b - normalEval t a := by
      have hab := hmin hb
      exact sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne hab (Ne.symm heq))
    let r : ℝ := (normalEval t z - normalEval t a) /
      (normalEval t b - normalEval t a)
    have hr : 0 ≤ r := div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr haz) hden.le
    have hr1 : r ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hden).mpr (by linarith)
    have hcombo : (1 - r) • a + r • b = z := by
      apply normal_tangent_ext l.normal
      · rw [normalEval_combo l.normal a b (1-r) r (by ring), han, hbn, hzn]
        ring
      · change normalEval t ((1-r) • a + r • b) = normalEval t z
        rw [normalEval_combo t a b (1-r) r (by ring)]
        dsimp [r]
        field_simp
        ring
    exact ⟨1-r, r, sub_nonneg.mpr hr1, hr, by ring, hcombo⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.perturb_normalEval_add
statement:
private theorem perturb_normalEval_add (n : RationalNormal) (z w : Plane) :
    normalEval n (z + w) = normalEval n z + normalEval n w
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalEval, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im]
  ring

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.perturb_normalEval_sub
statement:
private theorem perturb_normalEval_sub (n : RationalNormal) (z w : Plane) :
    normalEval n (z - w) = normalEval n z - normalEval n w
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalEval, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
  ring

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.line_perturb_formula
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp only [RationalLine.eval, perturb_normalEval_add, normalEval_smul]
    ring
  · simp only [RationalLine.eval, perturb_normalEval_sub, normalEval_smul]
    ring

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.line_perturb_nonpos_eventually
statement:
private theorem line_perturb_nonpos_eventually (l : RationalLine) (x u : Plane)
    (hle : l.eval x ≤ 0)
    (hactive : l.eval x = 0 → normalEval l.normal u = 0) :
    ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ),
      l.eval (x + t • u) ≤ 0 ∧ l.eval (x - t • u) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : l.eval x = 0
  · have hu : normalEval l.normal u = 0 := hactive hzero
    filter_upwards [] with t
    have hformula := line_perturb_formula l x u t
    rw [hzero, hu] at hformula
    constructor
    · have hval : l.eval (x + t • u) = 0 := by simpa using hformula.1
      rw [hval]
    · have hval : l.eval (x - t • u) = 0 := by simpa using hformula.2
      rw [hval]
  · have hneg : l.eval x < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne hle hzero
    have hplus : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), l.eval (x + t • u) < 0 := by
      have hcont : Continuous fun t : ℝ => l.eval (x + t • u) := by
        fun_prop [RationalLine.eval, normalEval]
      have hmem : l.eval (x + (0 : ℝ) • u) ∈ Set.Iio (0 : ℝ) := by
        simpa using hneg
      exact hcont.continuousAt.eventually (isOpen_Iio.mem_nhds hmem)
    have hminus : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), l.eval (x - t • u) < 0 := by
      have hcont : Continuous fun t : ℝ => l.eval (x - t • u) := by
        fun_prop [RationalLine.eval, normalEval]
      have hmem : l.eval (x - (0 : ℝ) • u) ∈ Set.Iio (0 : ℝ) := by
        simpa using hneg
      exact hcont.continuousAt.eventually (isOpen_Iio.mem_nhds hmem)
    filter_upwards [hplus.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds,
      hminus.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds] with t htplus htminus
    exact ⟨htplus.le, htminus.le⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.all_lines_perturb_eventually
statement:
private theorem all_lines_perturb_eventually (cell : List RationalLine) (x u : Plane)
    (hbase : ∀ l ∈ cell, l.eval x ≤ 0)
    (hactive : ∀ l ∈ cell, l.eval x = 0 → normalEval l.normal u = 0) :
    ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ),
      (∀ l ∈ cell, l.eval (x + t • u) ≤ 0) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ cell, l.eval (x - t • u) ≤ 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction cell with
  | nil =>
      filter_upwards [] with t
      simp
  | cons l cell ih =>
      have hl := line_perturb_nonpos_eventually l x u (hbase l (by simp))
        (hactive l (by simp))
      have htail := ih (by
        intro k hk
        exact hbase k (by simp [hk])) (by
        intro k hk hkx
        exact hactive k (by simp [hk]) hkx)
      filter_upwards [hl, htail] with t hlt htail
      constructor
      · intro k hk
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hk with rfl | hk
        · exact hlt.1
        · exact htail.1 k hk
      · intro k hk
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hk with rfl | hk
        · exact hlt.2
        · exact htail.2 k hk

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.tangentToNormal_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem tangentToNormal_ne_zero (n : RationalNormal) :
    tangentToNormal n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
  have him := congrArg Complex.im h
  have hy : n.y = 0 := by
    have : (n.y : ℝ) = 0 := by simpa [tangentToNormal] using hre
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hx : n.x = 0 := by
    have : (n.x : ℝ) = 0 := by simpa [tangentToNormal] using him
    exact_mod_cast this
  rcases n.nonzero with h | h
  · exact h hx
  · exact h hy

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.closedCell_extreme_has_active_nonparallel
statement:
private theorem closedCell_extreme_has_active_nonparallel
    (cell : List RationalLine) (x : Plane)
    (hx : x ∈ (closedCell cell).extremePoints ℝ) :
    ∃ l ∈ cell, ∃ m ∈ cell,
      l.normal.x * m.normal.y - l.normal.y * m.normal.x ≠ 0 ∧
      l.eval x = 0 ∧ m.eval x = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hno
  have hno' : ¬ ∃ l ∈ cell, ∃ m ∈ cell,
      l.normal.x * m.normal.y - l.normal.y * m.normal.x ≠ 0 ∧
      l.eval x = 0 ∧ m.eval x = 0 := by simpa using hno
  by_cases hactive : ∃ l ∈ cell, l.eval x = 0
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, hkx⟩ := hactive
    let u := tangentToNormal k.normal
    have hu : u ≠ 0 := tangentToNormal_ne_zero k.normal
    have horth : ∀ l ∈ cell, l.eval x = 0 → normalEval l.normal u = 0 := by
      intro l hl hlx
      have hdet : l.normal.x * k.normal.y - l.normal.y * k.normal.x = 0 := by
        by_contra hdet
        exact hno' ⟨l, hl, k, hk, hdet, hlx, hkx⟩
      have hdetR : (l.normal.x : ℝ) * k.normal.y -
          (l.normal.y : ℝ) * k.normal.x = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hdet
      change normalEval l.normal (tangentToNormal k.normal) = 0
      simp [normalEval, tangentToNormal]
      nlinarith [hdetR]
    have hpert := all_lines_perturb_eventually cell x u hx.1 horth
    have hpos : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), 0 < t := eventually_mem_nhdsWithin
    obtain ⟨t, ⟨htcell, htpos⟩⟩ := (hpert.and hpos).exists
    have hplus : x + t • u ∈ closedCell cell := htcell.1
    have hminus : x - t • u ∈ closedCell cell := htcell.2
    have hmid := (mem_extremePoints_iff_left.mp hx).2
      (x - t • u) hminus (x + t • u) hplus
      (mem_openSegment_sub_add x (t • u))
    have htu : t • u ≠ 0 := smul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt htpos) hu
    have : x - t • u ≠ x := by
      intro h
      have hneg : -(t • u) = 0 := by
        calc
          -(t • u) = (x - t • u) - x := by abel
          _ = x - x := congrArg (fun z : Plane => z - x) h
          _ = 0 := by simp
      have hzero : t • u = 0 := neg_eq_zero.mp hneg
      exact htu hzero
    exact this hmid
  · let u : Plane := 1
    have hu : u ≠ 0 := one_ne_zero
    have horth : ∀ l ∈ cell, l.eval x = 0 → normalEval l.normal u = 0 := by
      intro l hl hlx
      exact (hactive ⟨l, hl, hlx⟩).elim
    have hpert := all_lines_perturb_eventually cell x u hx.1 horth
    have hpos : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), 0 < t := eventually_mem_nhdsWithin
    obtain ⟨t, ⟨htcell, htpos⟩⟩ := (hpert.and hpos).exists
    have hplus : x + t • u ∈ closedCell cell := htcell.1
    have hminus : x - t • u ∈ closedCell cell := htcell.2
    have hmid := (mem_extremePoints_iff_left.mp hx).2
      (x - t • u) hminus (x + t • u) hplus
      (mem_openSegment_sub_add x (t • u))
    have htu : t • u ≠ 0 := smul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt htpos) hu
    have : x - t • u ≠ x := by
      intro h
      have hneg : -(t • u) = 0 := by
        calc
          -(t • u) = (x - t • u) - x := by abel
          _ = x - x := congrArg (fun z : Plane => z - x) h
          _ = 0 := by simp
      have hzero : t • u = 0 := neg_eq_zero.mp hneg
      exact htu hzero
    exact this hmid

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.closedCell_pairPoint_extreme
statement:
private theorem closedCell_pairPoint_extreme (cell : List RationalLine)
    (l m : RationalLine) (hl : l ∈ cell) (hm : m ∈ cell)
    (hdet : l.normal.x * m.normal.y - l.normal.y * m.normal.x ≠ 0)
    (x : Plane) (hx : x ∈ closedCell cell) (hlx : l.eval x = 0) (hmx : m.eval x = 0) :
    x ∈ (closedCell cell).extremePoints ℝ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
  intro a ha b hb hab
  obtain ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, hsum, heq⟩ := hab
  have hlcombo := lineEval_combo l a b α β hsum
  have hmcombo := lineEval_combo m a b α β hsum
  rw [heq, hlx] at hlcombo
  rw [heq, hmx] at hmcombo
  have hla : l.eval a = 0 := by
    have hnb := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hβ.le (hb l hl)
    nlinarith [ha l hl]
  have hma : m.eval a = 0 := by
    have hnb := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hβ.le (hb m hm)
    nlinarith [ha m hm]
  obtain ⟨p, _, _, huniq, _⟩ := rationalLine_pairIntersection l m hdet
  exact (huniq a hla hma).trans (huniq x hlx hmx).symm

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.closedCell_extremePoints_finite
statement:
private theorem closedCell_extremePoints_finite (cell : List RationalLine) :
    ((closedCell cell).extremePoints ℝ).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A : Finset RationalLine := cell.toFinset
  let pairs : Finset (RationalLine × RationalLine) := (A ×ˢ A).filter fun p =>
    p.1.normal.x * p.2.normal.y - p.1.normal.y * p.2.normal.x ≠ 0
  let point (p : {p // p ∈ pairs}) : Plane := Classical.choose
    (rationalLine_pairIntersection p.1.1 p.1.2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp p.2).2)
  apply (Set.finite_range point).subset
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨l, hl, m, hm, hdet, hlx, hmx⟩ :=
    closedCell_extreme_has_active_nonparallel cell x hx
  have hp : (l, m) ∈ pairs := Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨List.mem_toFinset.mpr hl, List.mem_toFinset.mpr hm⟩,
      hdet⟩
  refine ⟨⟨(l, m), hp⟩, ?_⟩
  symm
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (rationalLine_pairIntersection l m
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2)).2.2.1 x hlx hmx

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.openCell_closure
statement:
private theorem openCell_closure (cell : List RationalLine) (hne : (openCell cell).Nonempty) :
    closure (openCell cell) = closedCell cell
proof:
:= by
  apply subset_antisymm
  · apply closure_minimal _ (closedCell_isClosed cell)
    intro z hz l hl
    exact (hz l hl).le
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hne
    have hsegment : openSegment ℝ w x ⊆ openCell cell := by
      rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩ l hl
      rw [lineEval_combo l w x a b hab]
      exact add_neg_of_neg_of_nonpos (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg ha (hw l hl))
        (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hb.le (hx l hl))
    exact closure_mono hsegment
      (segment_subset_closure_openSegment (right_mem_segment ℝ w x))

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.openCell_subset_interior
statement:
private theorem openCell_subset_interior (cell : List RationalLine) :
    openCell cell ⊆ interior (closedCell cell)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  apply mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
  apply Filter.mem_of_superset ((openCell_isOpen cell).mem_nhds hz)
  intro w hw l hl
  exact (hw l hl).le

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.closedCell_frontier_lines
statement:
private theorem closedCell_frontier_lines (cell : List RationalLine) :
    ∀ z ∈ frontier (closedCell cell), ∃ l ∈ cell, l.eval z = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hzclosed : z ∈ closedCell cell :=
    (closedCell_isClosed cell).closure_eq ▸ frontier_subset_closure hz
  by_contra hzero
  push Not at hzero
  have hzopen : z ∈ openCell cell := by
    intro l hl
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hzclosed l hl) (hzero l hl)
  exact hz.2 (openCell_subset_interior cell hzopen)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.closedCell_radial_boundary
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → Plane := fun r => c + r • (x-c)
  have hu : x-c ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hxc
  have hf : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding f :=
    (Homeomorph.addLeft c).isClosedEmbedding.comp (isClosedEmbedding_smul_left hu)
  have hpre : IsCompact (f ⁻¹' closedCell cell) := hf.isCompact_preimage hcompact
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ∈ f ⁻¹' closedCell cell := by simpa [f] using hx
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hmax⟩ := hpre.exists_isMaxOn ⟨1, h1⟩ continuous_id.continuousOn
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := hmax h1
  have hrpos : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hr1
  have hyfront : f r ∈ frontier (closedCell cell) := by
    have hrCell : f r ∈ closedCell cell := hr
    apply (mem_frontier_iff_notMem_interior hrCell).mpr
    intro hint
    have hnear : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] r, f s ∈ interior (closedCell cell) :=
      (hf.continuous.continuousAt.eventually (isOpen_interior.mem_nhds hint)).filter_mono
        nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have hgt : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] r, r < s := eventually_mem_nhdsWithin
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hrs⟩ := (hnear.and hgt).exists
    have hsCell : s ∈ f ⁻¹' closedCell cell := by
      change f s ∈ closedCell cell
      exact interior_subset hs
    have hsr : s ≤ r := hmax hsCell
    exact (not_le_of_gt hrs) hsr
  refine ⟨f r, hyfront, ?_⟩
  have hinv : 0 ≤ 1/r := div_nonneg zero_le_one hrpos.le
  have hinv1 : 1/r ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hrpos).mpr hr1
  refine ⟨1-(1/r), 1/r, sub_nonneg.mpr hinv1, hinv, by ring, ?_⟩
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [f, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im,
      Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul] <;>
    field_simp <;> ring

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.fanTriangle_area_ne
proof:
:= by
  intro harea
  let v : Plane := a-c
  let w : Plane := b-c
  have hv : normalEval l.normal v ≠ 0 := by
    rw [perturb_normalEval_sub, sub_eq_zero.mp ha]
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm (ne_of_lt (sub_neg.mp hc)))
  have hn : normalEval l.normal w = normalEval l.normal v := by
    simp only [v, w, perturb_normalEval_sub]
    rw [sub_eq_zero.mp ha, sub_eq_zero.mp hb]
  have hdet : v.re * w.im - v.im * w.re = 0 := harea
  have hwv : w = v := by
    by_cases hvr : v.re = 0
    · have hvi : v.im ≠ 0 := by
        intro hvi
        apply hv
        simp [normalEval, hvr, hvi]
      have hscale : w = (w.im/v.im) • v := by
        apply Complex.ext
        · simp only [Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul, hvr, mul_zero]
          have hprod : v.im * w.re = 0 := by simpa [hvr] using hdet
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hprod).resolve_left hvi
        · simp only [Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
      have hr : w.im/v.im = 1 := by
        rw [hscale, normalEval_smul] at hn
        apply (mul_right_cancel₀ hv)
        simpa using hn
      rw [hscale, hr, one_smul]
    · have hscale : w = (w.re/v.re) • v := by
        apply Complex.ext
        · simp only [Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
        · simp only [Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
          nlinarith [hdet]
      have hr : w.re/v.re = 1 := by
        rw [hscale, normalEval_smul] at hn
        apply (mul_right_cancel₀ hv)
        simpa using hn
      rw [hscale, hr, one_smul]
  apply hab
  exact (sub_left_inj.mp hwv).symm

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.volume_segment_zero
statement: private theorem volume_segment_zero (a b : Plane) : volume (segment ℝ a b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← convexHull_pair]
  apply measure_mono_null (convexHull_subset_affineSpan {a, b})
  apply Measure.addHaar_affineSubspace
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst b
    intro htop
    have htop' : affineSpan ℝ ({a} : Set Plane) = ⊤ := by simpa using htop
    have hmem : a + 1 ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({a} : Set Plane) := by rw [htop']; simp
    have ha := (AffineSubspace.mem_affineSpan_singleton ℝ Plane).mp hmem
    have : (1 : Plane) = 0 := by linear_combination ha
    exact one_ne_zero this
  · intro htop
    have hdim := congrArg (fun s : AffineSubspace ℝ Plane => Module.finrank ℝ s.direction) htop
    rw [direction_affineSpan, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vsub_eq_sub,
      finrank_span_singleton (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hab)), AffineSubspace.direction_top,
      finrank_top, Complex.finrank_real_complex] at hdim
    omega

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.dense_compl_of_volume_zero
statement: private theorem dense_compl_of_volume_zero (s : Set Plane) (hs : volume s = 0) : Dense sᶜ
proof:
:= by
  apply interior_eq_empty_iff_dense_compl.mp
  apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro x hx
  have hpos := isOpen_interior.measure_pos volume (show (interior s).Nonempty from ⟨x, hx⟩)
  have hzero : volume (interior s) = 0 := measure_mono_null interior_subset hs
  exact (ne_of_gt hpos) hzero

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.fanTriangle_isTriangle
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨c, a, b, fanTriangle_area_ne l c a b hc ha hb hab, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.continuous_normalEval
statement:
private theorem continuous_normalEval (n : RationalNormal) :
    Continuous fun z : Plane => normalEval n z
proof:
:= by
  fun_prop [normalEval]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.continuous_listMaxEval
statement:
private theorem continuous_listMaxEval (cell : List RationalLine) :
    Continuous (listMaxEval cell)
proof:
:= by
  induction cell with
  | nil =>
      change Continuous (fun _ : Plane => (0 : ℝ))
      exact continuous_const
  | cons l cell ih =>
      change Continuous (fun z => max (normalEval l.normal z) (listMaxEval cell z))
      exact (continuous_normalEval l.normal).max ih

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.eval_le_listMaxEval
statement:
private theorem eval_le_listMaxEval (cell : List RationalLine) (z : Plane) :
    ∀ l ∈ cell, normalEval l.normal z ≤ listMaxEval cell z
proof:
:= by
  induction cell with
  | nil => simp
  | cons k cell ih =>
      intro l hl
      simp only [listMaxEval, List.foldr_cons]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hl with h | h
      · subst l
        exact le_max_left _ _
      · exact (ih l h).trans (le_max_right _ _)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.listMaxEval_le
proof:
:= by
  induction cell with
  | nil => simpa [listMaxEval] using hB
  | cons l cell ih =>
      simp only [listMaxEval, List.foldr_cons]
      apply max_le
      · exact h l (by simp)
      · apply ih
        intro k hk
        exact h k (by simp [hk])

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.listMaxOffset_nonneg
statement:
private theorem listMaxOffset_nonneg (cell : List RationalLine)
    (offsets : RationalLine → ℝ) : 0 ≤ listMaxOffset cell offsets
proof:
:= by
  induction cell with
  | nil => simp [listMaxOffset]
  | cons l cell ih =>
      simp only [listMaxOffset, List.foldr_cons]
      exact ih.trans (le_max_right _ _)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.offset_le_listMaxOffset
proof:
:= by
  induction cell with
  | nil => simp
  | cons k cell ih =>
      intro l hl
      simp only [listMaxOffset, List.foldr_cons]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hl with h | h
      · subst l
        exact le_max_left _ _
      · exact (ih l h).trans (le_max_right _ _)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.compact_cell_excludes_recession
statement:
private theorem compact_cell_excludes_recession
    (cell : List RationalLine) (hcompact : IsCompact (closedCell cell))
    (hne : (closedCell cell).Nonempty) (u : Plane) (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    ∃ l ∈ cell, 0 < normalEval l.normal u
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hpos
  push Not at hpos
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hne
  obtain ⟨R, hball⟩ := (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_ball (0 : Plane)).mp hcompact.isBounded
  have hUnorm : ‖u‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hu
  have hUpos : 0 < ‖u‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hu
  let t : ℝ := (|R| + ‖c‖ + 1) / ‖u‖
  have ht : 0 < t := by dsimp [t]; positivity
  have htmul : t * ‖u‖ = |R| + ‖c‖ + 1 := by
    dsimp [t]
    field_simp
  let y : Plane := c + t • u
  have hy : y ∈ closedCell cell := by
    intro l hl
    have hform : l.eval y = l.eval c + t * normalEval l.normal u := by
      change normalEval l.normal (c + t • u) - l.offset =
        (normalEval l.normal c - l.offset) + t * normalEval l.normal u
      rw [perturb_normalEval_add, normalEval_smul]
      ring
    rw [hform]
    have := hc l hl
    have := hpos l hl
    nlinarith
  have hyball := hball hy
  have hylength : ‖y‖ < R := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hyball
  have hyminus : y - c = t • u := by dsimp [y]; module
  have hnorm : t * ‖u‖ ≤ ‖y‖ + ‖c‖ := by
    calc
      t * ‖u‖ = ‖t • u‖ := by rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht]
      _ = ‖y - c‖ := by rw [hyminus]
      _ ≤ ‖y‖ + ‖c‖ := norm_sub_le y c
  rw [htmul] at hnorm
  have hRabs : R ≤ |R| := le_abs_self R
  have := abs_nonneg R
  linarith

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.shiftedCell_isClosed
statement:
private theorem shiftedCell_isClosed (cell : List RationalLine)
    (offsets : RationalLine → ℝ) : IsClosed (shiftedCell cell offsets)
proof:
:= by
  induction cell with
  | nil => simp [shiftedCell]
  | cons l cell ih =>
      have heq : shiftedCell (l :: cell) offsets =
          {z | normalEval l.normal z ≤ offsets l} ∩ shiftedCell cell offsets := by
        ext z
        simp [shiftedCell]
      rw [heq]
      exact (isClosed_le (continuous_normalEval l.normal) continuous_const).inter ih

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.shiftedCell_isCompact_of_compact_same_normals
statement:
private theorem shiftedCell_isCompact_of_compact_same_normals
    (cell : List RationalLine) (hcompact : IsCompact (closedCell cell))
    (hne : (closedCell cell).Nonempty) (offsets : RationalLine → ℝ) :
    IsCompact (shiftedCell cell offsets)
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set Plane := Metric.sphere (0 : Plane) 1
  have hScompact : IsCompact S := isCompact_sphere _ _
  have hSnonempty : S.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    simp [S, Metric.sphere, dist_eq_norm]
  obtain ⟨u, huS, huMin⟩ := hScompact.exists_isMinOn hSnonempty
    (continuous_listMaxEval cell).continuousOn
  have huNorm : ‖u‖ = 1 := by simpa [S, Metric.sphere, dist_eq_norm] using huS
  have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    subst u
    simp at huNorm
  obtain ⟨l₀, hl₀, hl₀pos⟩ := compact_cell_excludes_recession cell hcompact hne u hu0
  have hεpos : 0 < listMaxEval cell u := by
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hl₀pos (eval_le_listMaxEval cell u l₀ hl₀)
  let ε : ℝ := listMaxEval cell u
  have hε : 0 < ε := by simpa [ε] using hεpos
  have hmin : ∀ v ∈ S, ε ≤ listMaxEval cell v := by
    intro v hv
    exact huMin hv
  let B : ℝ := listMaxOffset cell offsets
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := by dsimp [B]; exact listMaxOffset_nonneg cell offsets
  have hbound : shiftedCell cell offsets ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : Plane) (B / ε) := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hx0 : x = 0
    · subst x
      simpa using div_nonneg hB hε.le
    · have hxnorm : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hx0
      let v : Plane := (‖x‖⁻¹) • x
      have hvnorm : ‖v‖ = 1 := by
        change ‖(‖x‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • x‖ = 1
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hxnorm)]
        simp [ne_of_gt hxnorm]
      have hvS : v ∈ S := by simpa [S, Metric.sphere, dist_eq_norm] using hvnorm
      have hinv : 0 ≤ ‖x‖⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hxnorm.le
      have hlin : ∀ l ∈ cell, normalEval l.normal v ≤ B / ‖x‖ := by
        intro l hl
        have hscale := normalEval_smul l.normal (‖x‖⁻¹) x
        have hpoint := hx l hl
        have hoff := offset_le_listMaxOffset cell offsets l hl
        calc
          normalEval l.normal v = ‖x‖⁻¹ * normalEval l.normal x := by
            dsimp [v]
            exact hscale
          _ ≤ ‖x‖⁻¹ * offsets l := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoint hinv
          _ ≤ ‖x‖⁻¹ * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hoff hinv
          _ = B / ‖x‖ := by ring
      have hfbound : listMaxEval cell v ≤ B / ‖x‖ :=
        listMaxEval_le cell v (B / ‖x‖) (div_nonneg hB hxnorm.le) hlin
      have hεbound : ε ≤ B / ‖x‖ := (hmin v hvS).trans hfbound
      have hprod : ε * ‖x‖ ≤ B := (le_div_iff₀ hxnorm).mp hεbound
      have hnorm : ‖x‖ ≤ B / ε := by
        apply (le_div_iff₀ hε).2
        nlinarith [hprod]
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hnorm
  have hbounded : Bornology.IsBounded (shiftedCell cell offsets) :=
    (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall (0 : Plane)).2 ⟨B / ε, hbound⟩
  exact Metric.isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded.mpr
    ⟨shiftedCell_isClosed cell offsets, hbounded⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.lineEval_affine
statement:
private theorem lineEval_affine (l : RationalLine) (x y : Plane) (r s : ℝ) :
    l.eval (r • x + s • y) = r * l.eval x + s * l.eval y + (r+s-1)*l.offset
proof:
:= by
  simp only [RationalLine.eval, perturb_normalEval_add, normalEval_smul]
  ring

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.weighted_triangle_factors
statement:
private theorem weighted_triangle_factors (c a b z : Plane) (wc wa wb : ℝ)
    (hwc : 0 ≤ wc) (hwa : 0 ≤ wa) (hwb : 0 ≤ wb)
    (hsum : wc + wa + wb = 1) (hxyz : wc • c + wa • a + wb • b = z)
    (hedge : wa + wb ≠ 0) :
    ∃ p ∈ segment ℝ a b, z ∈ segment ℝ c p
proof:
:= by
  let s : ℝ := wa + wb
  have hs : s ≠ 0 := hedge
  have hspos : 0 < s := lt_of_le_of_ne (add_nonneg hwa hwb) (Ne.symm hs)
  let p : Plane := (wa/s) • a + (wb/s) • b
  have hp : p ∈ segment ℝ a b := by
    refine ⟨wa/s, wb/s, div_nonneg hwa hspos.le, div_nonneg hwb hspos.le, ?_, rfl⟩
    dsimp [s]
    field_simp
  refine ⟨p, hp, wc, s, hwc, add_nonneg hwa hwb, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [s]
    linarith [hsum]
  · have ha : s * (wa/s) = wa := by field_simp
    have hb : s * (wb/s) = wb := by field_simp
    calc
      wc • c + s • p = wc • c + (s * (wa/s)) • a + (s * (wb/s)) • b := by
        simp [p, smul_add, add_assoc]
        ring
      _ = wc • c + wa • a + wb • b := by rw [ha, hb]
      _ = z := hxyz

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.triangle_hull_factors
statement:
private theorem triangle_hull_factors (c a b z : Plane)
    (hca : c ≠ a) (hcb : c ≠ b) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hz : z ∈ convexHull ℝ {c, a, b}) (hzc : z ≠ c) :
    ∃ p ∈ segment ℝ a b, z ∈ segment ℝ c p
proof:
:= by
  have hz' : z ∈ convexHull ℝ (↑({c, a, b} : Finset Plane) : Set Plane) := by
    simpa using hz
  obtain ⟨w, hw_nonneg, hw_sum, hwz⟩ := Finset.mem_convexHull'.mp hz'
  have hw_sum' : w c + w a + w b = 1 := by
    simpa [hca, hcb, hab, hca.symm, hcb.symm, hab.symm, add_assoc] using hw_sum
  have hwz' : w c • c + w a • a + w b • b = z := by
    simpa [hca, hcb, hab, hca.symm, hcb.symm, hab.symm, add_assoc] using hwz
  have hwc : 0 ≤ w c := hw_nonneg c (by simp)
  have hwa : 0 ≤ w a := hw_nonneg a (by simp)
  have hwb : 0 ≤ w b := hw_nonneg b (by simp)
  have hedge : w a + w b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hs
    have ha0 : w a = 0 := by nlinarith
    have hb0 : w b = 0 := by nlinarith
    have hc1 : w c = 1 := by rw [ha0, hb0] at hw_sum'; linarith
    have hzc' : z = c := by
      simpa [ha0, hb0, hc1] using hwz'.symm
    exact hzc hzc'
  exact weighted_triangle_factors c a b z (w c) (w a) (w b)
    hwc hwa hwb hw_sum' hwz' hedge

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.volume_convexHull_pair_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem volume_convexHull_pair_eq_zero (a b : Plane) :
    volume (convexHull ℝ {a, b}) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [convexHull_pair]
  exact volume_segment_zero a b

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.segment_decomp
statement:
private theorem segment_decomp (x y z : Plane) (hz : z ∈ segment ℝ x y) :
    ∃ α β : ℝ, 0 ≤ α ∧ 0 ≤ β ∧ α + β = 1 ∧ α • x + β • y = z
proof: := hz

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.segment_ray_eq_of_strict_cell
statement:
private theorem segment_ray_eq_of_strict_cell
    (cell : List RationalLine) (c p q z : Plane) (l m : RationalLine)
    (hlmem : l ∈ cell) (hmmem : m ∈ cell)
    (hc : ∀ k ∈ cell, k.eval c < 0)
    (hp : p ∈ closedCell cell) (hq : q ∈ closedCell cell)
    (hlp : l.eval p = 0) (hmq : m.eval q = 0)
    (hzc : z ≠ c) (hzp : z ∈ segment ℝ c p) (hzq : z ∈ segment ℝ c q) :
    p = q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, hsum, hz1⟩ := segment_decomp c p z hzp
  obtain ⟨γ, δ, hγ, hδ, hsum', hz2⟩ := segment_decomp c q z hzq
  have hlz₁ : l.eval z = α * l.eval c := by
    have he := lineEval_affine l c p α β
    rw [hz1, hlp, show α + β - 1 = 0 by linarith] at he
    simpa using he
  have hlz₂ : l.eval z = γ * l.eval c + δ * l.eval q := by
    have he := lineEval_affine l c q γ δ
    rw [hz2, show γ + δ - 1 = 0 by linarith] at he
    simpa using he
  have hmz₁ : m.eval z = α * m.eval c + β * m.eval p := by
    have he := lineEval_affine m c p α β
    rw [hz1, show α + β - 1 = 0 by linarith] at he
    simpa using he
  have hmz₂ : m.eval z = γ * m.eval c := by
    have he := lineEval_affine m c q γ δ
    rw [hz2, hmq, show γ + δ - 1 = 0 by linarith] at he
    simpa using he
  have hle₁ : α * l.eval c ≤ γ * l.eval c := by
    have hqle := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hδ (hq l hlmem)
    linarith [hlz₁, hlz₂]
  have hle₂ : γ * m.eval c ≤ α * m.eval c := by
    have hple := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hβ (hp m hmmem)
    linarith [hmz₁, hmz₂]
  have hαeq : α = γ := le_antisymm
    ((mul_le_mul_right_of_neg (hc m hmmem)).mp hle₂)
    ((mul_le_mul_right_of_neg (hc l hlmem)).mp hle₁)
  have hβeq : β = δ := by linarith [hsum, hsum', hαeq]
  have hp_eq : α • c + β • p = α • c + β • q := by
    calc
      α • c + β • p = z := hz1
      _ = γ • c + δ • q := hz2.symm
      _ = α • c + β • q := by rw [← hαeq, ← hβeq]
  have hp_sm : β • p = β • q := add_left_cancel hp_eq
  have hβne : β ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzβ
    have heq : α = 1 := by linarith
    have : z = c := by simpa [heq, hzβ] using hz1.symm
    exact hzc this
  have hinv := congrArg (fun x : Plane => β⁻¹ • x) hp_sm
  simpa [smul_smul, hβne] using hinv

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.lineEval_parallel_eq
statement:
private theorem lineEval_parallel_eq (l m : RationalLine)
    (hdet : l.normal.x * m.normal.y - l.normal.y * m.normal.x = 0)
    (p : Plane) (hlp : l.eval p = 0) (hmp : m.eval p = 0) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, r ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ z, m.eval z = r * l.eval z
proof:
:= by
  let lx : ℝ := l.normal.x
  let ly : ℝ := l.normal.y
  let mx : ℝ := m.normal.x
  let my : ℝ := m.normal.y
  have hdetR : lx * my - ly * mx = 0 := by
    dsimp [lx, ly, mx, my]
    exact_mod_cast hdet
  have hlne : lx ≠ 0 ∨ ly ≠ 0 := by
    rcases l.normal.nonzero with hx | hy
    · exact Or.inl (by dsimp [lx]; exact_mod_cast hx)
    · exact Or.inr (by dsimp [ly]; exact_mod_cast hy)
  have hmne : mx ≠ 0 ∨ my ≠ 0 := by
    rcases m.normal.nonzero with hx | hy
    · exact Or.inl (by dsimp [mx]; exact_mod_cast hx)
    · exact Or.inr (by dsimp [my]; exact_mod_cast hy)
  let r : ℝ := if lx ≠ 0 then mx/lx else my/ly
  have hmx : mx = r * lx := by
    by_cases hx : lx = 0
    · have hy : ly ≠ 0 := hlne.resolve_left (not_not.mpr hx)
      have hmzero : mx = 0 := by
        have hzero : ly * mx = 0 := by rw [hx] at hdetR; linarith
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left hy
      simp [r, hx, hmzero]
    · dsimp only [r]
      rw [if_pos hx]
      field_simp
  have hmy : my = r * ly := by
    by_cases hx : lx = 0
    · have hy : ly ≠ 0 := hlne.resolve_left (not_not.mpr hx)
      dsimp only [r]
      rw [if_neg (not_not.mpr hx)]
      field_simp
    · dsimp only [r]
      rw [if_pos hx]
      field_simp
      nlinarith [hdetR]
  have hr : r ≠ 0 := by
    intro hr0
    rcases hmne with hmx0 | hmy0
    · apply hmx0
      rw [hmx, hr0]
      simp
    · apply hmy0
      rw [hmy, hr0]
      simp
  have hnormal (z : Plane) : normalEval m.normal z = r * normalEval l.normal z := by
    change mx * z.re + my * z.im = r * (lx * z.re + ly * z.im)
    rw [hmx, hmy]
    ring
  have hl0 : normalEval l.normal p = l.offset := sub_eq_zero.mp hlp
  have hm0 : normalEval m.normal p = m.offset := sub_eq_zero.mp hmp
  have hoff : m.offset = r * l.offset := by rw [← hm0, hnormal p, hl0]
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  intro z
  change normalEval m.normal z - m.offset = r * (normalEval l.normal z - l.offset)
  rw [hoff, hnormal z]
  ring

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.common_zero_unique
statement:
private theorem common_zero_unique (l m : RationalLine)
    (hdet : l.normal.x * m.normal.y - l.normal.y * m.normal.x ≠ 0)
    (p q : Plane) (hlp : l.eval p = 0) (hlq : l.eval q = 0)
    (hmp : m.eval p = 0) (hmq : m.eval q = 0) : p = q
proof:
:= by
  let lx : ℝ := l.normal.x
  let ly : ℝ := l.normal.y
  let mx : ℝ := m.normal.x
  let my : ℝ := m.normal.y
  let D : ℝ := lx * my - ly * mx
  have hD : D ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [D, lx, ly, mx, my]
    exact_mod_cast hdet
  have hLp : lx * p.re + ly * p.im = l.offset := by
    simpa [normalEval, lx, ly] using (sub_eq_zero.mp hlp)
  have hLq : lx * q.re + ly * q.im = l.offset := by
    simpa [normalEval, lx, ly] using (sub_eq_zero.mp hlq)
  have hMp : mx * p.re + my * p.im = m.offset := by
    simpa [normalEval, mx, my] using (sub_eq_zero.mp hmp)
  have hMq : mx * q.re + my * q.im = m.offset := by
    simpa [normalEval, mx, my] using (sub_eq_zero.mp hmq)
  have hre : D * (p.re - q.re) = 0 := by
    dsimp [D]
    linear_combination my * (hLp - hLq) - ly * (hMp - hMq)
  have him : D * (p.im - q.im) = 0 := by
    dsimp [D]
    linear_combination lx * (hMp - hMq) - mx * (hLp - hLq)
  have hre0 : p.re = q.re := by
    have h := (mul_eq_zero.mp hre).resolve_left hD
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
  have him0 : p.im = q.im := by
    have h := (mul_eq_zero.mp him).resolve_left hD
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
  exact Complex.ext hre0 him0

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.triple_hulls_eq_of_segment_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hsub₁ : {c, a, b} ⊆ convexHull ℝ {c, d, e} := by
    intro x hx
    rcases (by simpa only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hx) with hx | hx | hx
    · rw [hx]
      exact subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by simp)
    · rw [hx]
      have ha : a ∈ segment ℝ d e := by
        rw [← hseg]
        exact left_mem_segment ℝ a b
      exact segment_subset_convexHull (by simp) (by simp) ha
    · rw [hx]
      have hb : b ∈ segment ℝ d e := by
        rw [← hseg]
        exact right_mem_segment ℝ a b
      exact segment_subset_convexHull (by simp) (by simp) hb
  have hsub₂ : {c, d, e} ⊆ convexHull ℝ {c, a, b} := by
    intro x hx
    rcases (by simpa only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hx) with hx | hx | hx
    · rw [hx]
      exact subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by simp)
    · rw [hx]
      have hd : d ∈ segment ℝ a b := by
        rw [hseg]
        exact left_mem_segment ℝ d e
      exact segment_subset_convexHull (by simp) (by simp) hd
    · rw [hx]
      have he : e ∈ segment ℝ a b := by
        rw [hseg]
        exact right_mem_segment ℝ d e
      exact segment_subset_convexHull (by simp) (by simp) he
  exact le_antisymm (convexHull_min hsub₁ (convex_convexHull _ _))
    (convexHull_min hsub₂ (convex_convexHull _ _))

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.distinct_fan_triangles_aedisjoint
statement:
private theorem distinct_fan_triangles_aedisjoint
    (cell : List RationalLine) (c a b d e : Plane) (l m : RationalLine)
