    apply hdense (deformPoint φ s₀) ⟨s₀, hs₀, rfl⟩
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using δ.smul_mem r hdiff
  obtain ⟨N, _, p, hp₀, hpN, hpstep, _⟩ := column_denseSegmentChain
    (deformPoint φ '' S) ρ ρ R hρ hρ (by linarith)
    ⟨deformPoint φ s₀, ⟨s₀, hs₀, rfl⟩⟩ ⟨deformPoint φ s, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩⟩
    hsegmentDense hlong
  choose q hqS hqmap using fun i : Fin (N + 1) => (p i).2
  have hq₀ : q 0 = s₀ := by
    apply hinj (hST (hqS 0)) (hST hs₀)
    rw [hqmap]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hp₀
  have hqN : q (Fin.last N) = s := by
    apply hinj (hST (hqS (Fin.last N))) (hST hs)
    rw [hqmap]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hpN
  have hqδ : ∀ i : Fin (N + 1), q i - s₀ ∈ δ := by
    intro i
    refine Fin.induction ?_ ?_ i
    · rw [hq₀, sub_self]
      exact δ.zero_mem
    · intro j hj
      have hlocal : q j.succ - q j.castSucc ∈ δ := by
        apply hstep _ (hqS j.succ) _ (hqS j.castSucc)
        rw [hqmap, hqmap, dist_comm]
        exact hpstep j
      have heq : q j.succ - s₀ = (q j.succ - q j.castSucc) + (q j.castSucc - s₀) := by abel
      rw [heq]
      exact δ.add_mem hlocal hj
  simpa only [hqN] using hqδ (Fin.last N)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.rationalLineSupported_image
statement:
private theorem rationalLineSupported_image
    (S : Set Plane) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) (φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (hrat : Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasRationalDirection δ)
    (hline : Tiling.Polygonal.IsLineSupported S δ) :
    Tiling.Polygonal.IsLineSupported (deformPoint φ '' S) δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := rationalDirection_hasNormal δ hδ hrat
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hline
  refine ⟨deformPoint φ a, ?_⟩
  rintro z ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
  rw [← hn]
  apply rationalDirection_preservesCoset φ n s a
  rw [hn]
  exact ha s hs

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.column_forward_of_properVertices
statement:
private theorem column_forward_of_properVertices
    (K Kφ : PolygonalRegion) (S : Set Plane) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) (φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (hrat : Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasRationalDirection δ)
    (hpφ : Tiling.IsPacking Kφ.prototileFamily (Kφ.placements (deformPoint φ '' S)))
    (hproper : Tiling.Polygonal.properVertices
      (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport Kφ (deformPoint φ '' S)) =
        deformPoint φ '' Tiling.Polygonal.properVertices (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K S))
    (hcol : Tiling.Polygonal.IsCenterColumn K δ S) :
    Tiling.Polygonal.IsCenterColumn Kφ δ (deformPoint φ '' S)
proof:
:= by
  have hnone := (Tiling.Polygonal.lineCarrier_noProperVertices_iff_column
    hδ hcol.2.1 hcol.1 hcol.2.2.1).mpr hcol
  apply (Tiling.Polygonal.lineCarrier_noProperVertices_iff_column
    hδ (hcol.2.1.image _) hpφ (rationalLineSupported_image S δ φ hδ hrat hcol.2.2.1)).mp
  rw [hproper, hnone, Set.image_empty]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.column_lineRelativeDense
statement:
private theorem column_lineRelativeDense
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (S : Set Plane) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) (B : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ z ∈ K.support, ‖z‖ ≤ B)
    (hcol : Tiling.Polygonal.IsCenterColumn K δ S) :
    ∀ s₀ ∈ S, ∀ z : Plane, z - s₀ ∈ δ →
      ∃ s ∈ S, dist z s < 2 * B + 1
proof:
:= by
  intro s₀ hs₀ z hz
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := K.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty K.nonempty
  have hreg := regularSupport_eq_interior_supportUnion K S hcol.1
  have hsubset : s₀ +ᵥ K.support ⊆ supportUnion K S := by
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨s₀, hs₀, ?_⟩
    simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub] using hx
  have hstart : s₀ + k ∈ Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K S := by
    rw [hreg]
    apply interior_mono hsubset
    rw [interior_vadd]
    exact Set.mem_vadd_set.mpr ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
  have hcover : z + k ∈ Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K S := by
    rw [← hcol.2.2.2 (z - s₀) hz]
    apply Set.mem_vadd_set.mpr
    refine ⟨s₀ + k, hstart, ?_⟩
    change z - s₀ + (s₀ + k) = z + k
    abel
  rw [hreg] at hcover
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hks⟩ := interior_subset hcover
  refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
  have heq : z - s = (z + k - s) - k := by abel
  rw [dist_eq_norm, heq]
  have hkB := hbound k (interior_subset hk)
  have hksB := hbound (z + k - s) hks
  linarith [norm_sub_le (z + k - s) k]

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.boundaryDirection_of_column
statement:
private theorem boundaryDirection_of_column
    (K : PolygonalRegion) (S : Set Plane) (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane)
    (hδ : Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1) (hcol : Tiling.Polygonal.IsCenterColumn K δ S) :
    Tiling.Polygonal.HasBoundaryDirection K δ
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hboundary
  obtain ⟨A, _, hnear⟩ := Tiling.Polygonal.lineCarrier_nonboundary_nearProperVertex K
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hcol.2.1
  obtain ⟨v, hv, _⟩ := hnear δ hδ hboundary S hcol.1 hcol.2.2.1 s hs
  have hnone := (Tiling.Polygonal.lineCarrier_noProperVertices_iff_column
    hδ hcol.2.1 hcol.1 hcol.2.2.1).mpr hcol
  rw [hnone] at hv
  exact hv

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.boundaryDirection_normals
statement:
private theorem boundaryDirection_normals (K : PolygonalRegion)
    (hK : Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasRationalSlopes K) :
    ∃ normals : Finset RationalNormal,
      ∀ δ : Submodule ℝ Plane, Tiling.Polygonal.HasBoundaryDirection K δ →
        ∃ n ∈ normals, normalDirection n = δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Δ := {δ : Submodule ℝ Plane | Tiling.Polygonal.HasBoundaryDirection K δ}
  have hΔ : Δ.Finite := Tiling.Polygonal.boundaryDirections_finite K
  let := hΔ.fintype
  have hex (δ : Δ) : ∃ n : RationalNormal, normalDirection n = (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) := by
    have hdim : Module.finrank ℝ (δ : Submodule ℝ Plane) = 1 := by
      obtain ⟨a, b, hab, _, heq⟩ := δ.2
      rw [heq]
      exact finrank_span_singleton (sub_ne_zero.mpr hab.symm)
    exact rationalDirection_hasNormal δ hdim
      (Tiling.Polygonal.hasRationalDirection_of_hasBoundaryDirection hK δ.2)
  choose n hn using hex
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.image n, ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ
  refine ⟨n ⟨δ, hδ⟩, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨δ, hδ⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩, hn _⟩

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.polygonalRegion_eq_of_support
statement:
private theorem polygonalRegion_eq_of_support {K L : PolygonalRegion}
    (h : K.support = L.support) : K = L
proof:
:= by
  cases K
  cases L
  cases h
  rfl

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.flcDeformation_preservesColumns
statement:
theorem flcDeformation_preservesColumns :
  ∀ (K : PolygonalRegion) (T : Set Plane), Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasRationalSlopes K →
    Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC T → RelativeDense T →
    Tiling.Polygonal.TilesOn K T (Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport K T) →
      ∃ P : PolyhedralCode, polyhedralSupport P = K.support ∧
        ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
          ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
            ∃ Kφ : PolygonalRegion, Kφ.support = deformedPolyhedralSupport P φ ∧
              ∀ S ⊆ T, ∀ δ : Submodule ℝ Plane, Module.finrank ℝ δ = 1 →
                Tiling.RationalSlopes.HasRationalDirection δ →
                  (Tiling.Polygonal.IsCenterColumn K δ S ↔
                    Tiling.Polygonal.IsCenterColumn Kφ δ (deformPoint φ '' S))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro K T hK hT hdense htile
  obtain ⟨P₁, hP₁, W, _, hzero, F₁, ε₁, hε₁, hdeform⟩ :=
    flcRationalDeformation K T hK hT hdense htile
  obtain ⟨P₂, hP₂, _, _, _, B, L, hB, _, F₂, ε₂, hε₂, hboundary⟩ :=
    rationalPolygon_uniformBoundaryControl K hK
  obtain ⟨F₃, ε₃, hε₃, hcode⟩ := polyhedralDeformation_independentOfCode K P₁ P₂ hP₁ hP₂
  obtain ⟨normals, hnormals⟩ := boundaryDirection_normals K hK
  let ρ := 2 * B + 1
  let R := 4 * ρ
  let M := 2 * R
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := by dsimp [ρ]; linarith
  have hM : 0 < M := by dsimp [M, R]; positivity
  obtain ⟨F₄, ε₄, hε₄, hmetric⟩ := approximation_boundedMetricAndRelationControl
    T hT hdense M 1 normals hM (by norm_num)
  let F := F₁ ∪ F₂ ∪ F₃ ∪ F₄
  let ε := min ε₁ (min ε₂ (min ε₃ ε₄))
  have hε : 0 < ε := by dsimp [ε]; positivity
  refine ⟨P₁, hP₁, F, ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ
  have hφ₁ : IsFiniteApproximation F₁ ε₁ φ :=
    finiteApproximation_strengthen F₁ F ε₁ ε φ
      (by dsimp [F]; intro x hx; simp only [Finset.mem_union]; tauto)
      (min_le_left _ _) hφ
  have hφ₂ : IsFiniteApproximation F₂ ε₂ φ :=
    finiteApproximation_strengthen F₂ F ε₂ ε φ
      (by dsimp [F]; intro x hx; simp only [Finset.mem_union]; tauto)
      (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) hφ
  have hφ₃ : IsFiniteApproximation F₃ ε₃ φ :=
    finiteApproximation_strengthen F₃ F ε₃ ε φ
      (by dsimp [F]; intro x hx; simp only [Finset.mem_union]; tauto)
      (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))) hφ
  have hφ₄ : IsFiniteApproximation F₄ ε₄ φ :=
    finiteApproximation_strengthen F₄ F ε₄ ε φ
      (by dsimp [F]; intro x hx; simp only [Finset.mem_union]; tauto)
      (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))) hφ
  obtain ⟨Kφ, hKφ, _, _, _, _, htileφ, _, _, hproper⟩ := hdeform φ hφ₁
  obtain ⟨Kψ, hKψ, hbound, _, hdirections⟩ := hboundary φ hφ₂
  have hsame : Kφ = Kψ := polygonalRegion_eq_of_support
    (hKφ.trans ((hcode φ hφ₃).trans hKψ.symm))
  subst Kψ
  obtain ⟨hinj, _, _, hreflect⟩ := hmetric φ hφ₄
  refine ⟨Kφ, hKφ, ?_⟩
  intro S hST δ hδ hrat
  have hpφ := packing_subfamily htileφ.2.1 (Set.image_mono hST)
  constructor
  · exact column_forward_of_properVertices K Kφ S δ φ hδ hrat hpφ (hproper S hST)
  · intro hcol
    have hS : S.Nonempty := (Set.image_nonempty.mp hcol.2.1)
    have hsourceDirection := (hdirections δ).mp (boundaryDirection_of_column Kφ _ δ hδ hcol)
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hnδ⟩ := hnormals δ hsourceDirection
    have hKnorm : ∀ z ∈ Kφ.support, ‖z‖ ≤ B := by
      simpa only [Set.subset_def, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hbound
    have hline : Tiling.Polygonal.IsLineSupported S δ := by
      apply lineSupported_reflects_shortSteps T S δ φ ρ R hρ
        (by dsimp [R]; linarith) hST hS hinj hcol.2.2.1
        (column_lineRelativeDense Kφ _ δ B hKnorm hcol)
      intro s hs t ht hdist
      have hshort : dist (deformPoint φ s) (deformPoint φ t) < M / 2 := by
        dsimp [M]
        linarith
      have himage : deformPoint φ s - deformPoint φ t ∈ δ := by
        obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hcol.2.2.1
        have hsδ := ha (deformPoint φ s) ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
        have htδ := ha (deformPoint φ t) ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
        have heq : deformPoint φ s - deformPoint φ t =
            (deformPoint φ s - a) - (deformPoint φ t - a) := by abel
        rw [heq]
        exact δ.sub_mem hsδ htδ
      have himageN : normalEval n (deformPoint φ s - deformPoint φ t) = 0 := by
        rw [← hnδ] at himage
        simpa [normalDirection, normalEval, LinearMap.mem_ker] using himage
      have hsourceN := (hreflect s (hST hs) t (hST ht) hshort n hn).mp himageN
      rw [← hnδ]
      simpa [normalDirection, normalEval, LinearMap.mem_ker] using hsourceN
    have hp := packing_subfamily htile.2.1 hST
    apply (Tiling.Polygonal.lineCarrier_noProperVertices_iff_column hδ hS hp hline).mp
    have hnone := (Tiling.Polygonal.lineCarrier_noProperVertices_iff_column
      hδ hcol.2.1 hcol.1 hcol.2.2.1).mpr hcol
    have heq := hproper S hST
    rw [hnone] at heq
    exact Set.image_eq_empty.mp heq.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.coveredRegion_openCarrier
statement:
theorem coveredRegion_openCarrier (K : Region) (S : Set Plane) :
    coveredRegion K.openCarrier S = regularSupport K S
proof:
:= by
  apply congrArg interior
  apply congrArg closure
  change S +ᵥ K.openCarrier = ⋃ s : S, (s : Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set, Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, u, hu, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, u, hu, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, u, hu, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨t, t.2, u, hu, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.lineFibre_vertical
statement:
theorem lineFibre_vertical (T : Set Plane) (t : Plane) :
    lineFibre Complex.I T t = T ∩ {z | z.re = t.re}
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [lineFibre, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_vadd_set]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hz, w, hw, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨hz, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hw
    simp [Complex.add_re]
  · rintro ⟨hz, hreal⟩
    change z.re = t.re at hreal
    refine ⟨hz, z - t, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mpr
      refine ⟨z.im - t.im, ?_⟩
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hreal]
    · simp [vadd_eq_add]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.invariant_vertical_iff
statement:
theorem invariant_vertical_iff (D : Set Plane) :
    IsInvariantAlong D Complex.I ↔ ∀ a : ℝ, ((a : ℂ) * Complex.I) +ᵥ D = D
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsInvariantAlong, IsPeriod, Complex.real_smul]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.invariant_iff_verticalSlab
statement:
theorem invariant_iff_verticalSlab (K : Region) (S : Set Plane) :
    IsInvariantAlong (coveredRegion K.openCarrier S) Complex.I ↔
      ∃ X : Set ℝ, X = interior (closure X) ∧
        regularSupport K S = Complex.re ⁻¹' X
proof:
:= by
  rw [coveredRegion_openCarrier, invariant_vertical_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := (verticalInvariant_iff_product (regularSupport K S)).mp h
    refine ⟨X, ?_, hX⟩
    have hr := (regularSupport_isRegularOpen K S).2
    rw [hX] at hr
    change interior (closure (Complex.re ⁻¹' X)) = Complex.re ⁻¹' X at hr
    rw [Complex.closure_preimage_re, Complex.interior_preimage_re] at hr
    exact ((Set.preimage_injective.mpr Complex.re_surjective) hr).symm
  · rintro ⟨X, _, hX⟩
    exact (verticalInvariant_iff_product (regularSupport K S)).mpr ⟨X, hX⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.component_iff_minimalSlab
statement:
theorem component_iff_minimalSlab (K : Region) (T S : Set Plane) :
    IsEarthquakeComponent K.openCarrier Complex.I T S ↔
      IsMinimalVerticalSlabSubfamily K T S
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsEarthquakeComponent, IsMinimalVerticalSlabSubfamily,
    invariant_iff_verticalSlab]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.plate_centres_nonempty
statement:
private theorem plate_centres_nonempty {K : Region} {T : Set Plane}
    (P : VerticalPlate K T) : P.centres.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := P.nonempty_supp
  exact ⟨p, p, hp, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.plate_centres_subset
statement:
private theorem plate_centres_subset {K : Region} {T : Set Plane}
    (P : VerticalPlate K T) : P.centres ⊆ T
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨p, _, rfl⟩
  exact p.2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.packing_subfamily
statement:
private theorem packing_subfamily {K : Region} {T E A : Set Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T E) (hA : A ⊆ T) :
    Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements A)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K A).mpr
  intro s hs t ht hst
  exact (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K T).mp hTile.2.1 (hA hs) (hA ht) hst

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.centre_tile_subset_support
statement:
private theorem centre_tile_subset_support (K : Region) {A : Set Plane}
    {t : Plane} (ht : t ∈ A) : t +ᵥ K.openCarrier ⊆ regularSupport K A
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen (openUnion K A) :=
    isOpen_iUnion fun s : A => K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd (s : Plane)
  apply Set.Subset.trans _ hopen.subset_interior_closure
  exact Set.subset_iUnion_of_subset ⟨t, ht⟩ Set.Subset.rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.centres_subset_of_support_subset
proof:
:= by
  intro t htA
  by_contra htB
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint (t +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (openUnion K B) := by
    change Disjoint (t +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (⋃ b : B, (b : Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
    apply Set.disjoint_iUnion_right.mpr
    intro b
    apply (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K T).mp hTile.2.1 (hA htA) (hB b.2)
    intro htb
    exact htB (htb.symm ▸ b.2)
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := K.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty K.nonempty
  have htuA : t + u ∈ regularSupport K A :=
    centre_tile_subset_support K htA ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
  have htuB : t + u ∈ closure (openUnion K B) := interior_subset (hsupport htuA)
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
    (hdisjoint.closure_right (K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd t)) ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ htuB

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.centerColumn_of_invariant
statement:
private theorem centerColumn_of_invariant {K : Region} {T E C : Set Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T E) (hCT : C ⊆ T) (hCnonempty : C.Nonempty)
    (x : ℝ) (hcoord : ∀ z ∈ C, z.re = x)
    (hinvariant : IsInvariantAlong (coveredRegion K.openCarrier C) Complex.I) :
    IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical K C
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨packing_subfamily hTile hCT, hCnonempty, ⟨x, hcoord⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [coveredRegion_openCarrier, invariant_vertical_iff] at hinvariant
  exact hinvariant

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.centerColumn_support_at
statement:
private theorem centerColumn_support_at {K : Region} {C : Set Plane}
    (hC : IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical K C)
    (x : ℝ) (hcoord : ∀ z ∈ C, z.re = x) :
    regularSupport K C = Complex.re ⁻¹'
      interior (closure (x +ᵥ (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, hne, ha, hs⟩ := centerColumn_regularSupport hC
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hne
  have hax : a = x := (ha z hz).symm.trans (hcoord z hz)
  change regularSupport K C =
    {z : Plane | z.re ∈ interior (closure (x +ᵥ (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier)))}
  simpa only [Axis.transverseCoord, hax] using hs

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.complete_lineFibre_minimal
statement:
theorem complete_lineFibre_minimal {K : Region} {T E : Set Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T E) {t : Plane} (ht : t ∈ T)
    (hinvariant : IsInvariantAlong
      (coveredRegion K.openCarrier (lineFibre Complex.I T t)) Complex.I) :
    IsEarthquakeComponent K.openCarrier Complex.I T (lineFibre Complex.I T t)
proof:
:= by
  let C := lineFibre Complex.I T t
  have hCT : C ⊆ T := Set.inter_subset_left
  have htC : t ∈ C := by
    change t ∈ lineFibre Complex.I T t
    rw [lineFibre_vertical]
    exact ⟨ht, rfl⟩
  have hcoord : ∀ z ∈ C, z.re = t.re := by
    intro z hz
    change z ∈ lineFibre Complex.I T t at hz
    rw [lineFibre_vertical] at hz
    exact hz.2
  have hC := centerColumn_of_invariant hTile hCT ⟨t, htC⟩ t.re hcoord hinvariant
  have hsC := centerColumn_support_at hC t.re hcoord
  refine ⟨⟨t, htC⟩, hCT, hinvariant, ?_⟩
  intro R hRne hRC hRinv
  have hcoordR : ∀ z ∈ R, z.re = t.re := fun z hz => hcoord z (hRC hz)
  have hR := centerColumn_of_invariant hTile (hRC.trans hCT) hRne t.re hcoordR hRinv
  have hsR := centerColumn_support_at hR t.re hcoordR
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm hRC
  apply centres_subset_of_support_subset hTile hCT (hRC.trans hCT)
  rw [hsC, hsR]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.column_plate_eq_lineFibre
statement:
theorem column_plate_eq_lineFibre {K : Region} {T E : Set Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T E) (P : VerticalPlate K T)
    (hPslab : P.base = interior (closure P.base) ∧
      P.support = Complex.re ⁻¹' P.base)
    (hPcolumn : IsVerticalColumn P) {t : Plane} (htP : t ∈ P.centres) :
    P.centres = lineFibre Complex.I T t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hPcolumn
  have htx : t.re = x := hx htP
  have hPcoord : ∀ z ∈ P.centres, z.re = x := fun z hz => hx hz
  have hPInv : IsInvariantAlong (coveredRegion K.openCarrier P.centres) Complex.I := by
    apply (invariant_iff_verticalSlab K P.centres).mpr
    exact ⟨P.base, hPslab.1, hPslab.2⟩
  have hP := centerColumn_of_invariant hTile (plate_centres_subset P)
    (plate_centres_nonempty P) x hPcoord hPInv
  have hPsupport := centerColumn_support_at hP x hPcoord
  have hFsub : lineFibre Complex.I T t ⊆ T := Set.inter_subset_left
  have hFsupport : regularSupport K (lineFibre Complex.I T t) ⊆ regularSupport K P.centres := by
    have hraw : openUnion K (lineFibre Complex.I T t) ⊆ regularSupport K P.centres := by
      intro z hz
      rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, Set.mem_iUnion] at hz
      obtain ⟨q, u, hu, rfl⟩ := hz
      have hqx : (q : Plane).re = x :=
        ((Set.ext_iff.mp (lineFibre_vertical T t) q.1).mp q.2).2.trans htx
      rw [hPsupport]
      apply (Complex.isOpenMap_re K.openCarrier K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1).vadd x
        |>.subset_interior_closure
      exact ⟨u.re, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, by simp [Complex.add_re, hqx]⟩
    change interior (closure (openUnion K (lineFibre Complex.I T t))) ⊆ _
    rw [← (regularSupport_isRegularOpen K P.centres).2]
    exact interior_mono (closure_mono hraw)
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro z hz
    rw [lineFibre_vertical]
    exact ⟨plate_centres_subset P hz, (hPcoord z hz).trans htx.symm⟩
  · exact centres_subset_of_support_subset hTile hFsub (plate_centres_subset P) hFsupport

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.cylinder_plate_facts
proof:
:= by
  have hboundary := hTile.verticalCylinder_frontier_locallyFinite
    (isRegularOpen_isOpen hX) hX
  have hplates := relativeCarrier_verticalPlates hTile rfl hX.symm
    (fun a b => by simpa only [Set.inter_comm] using hboundary _ isCompact_Icc)
  exact ⟨hplates.1, hplates.2.2.1⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.components_eq_range_relative
statement:
theorem components_eq_range_relative {K : Region} {T : Set Plane} {X : Set ℝ}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T (Complex.re ⁻¹' X)) (hX : IsRegularOpen X) :
    {S | IsEarthquakeComponent K.openCarrier Complex.I T S} =
      Set.range (@VerticalPlate.centres K T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(cylinder_plate_facts hTile hX).2]
  ext S
  exact component_iff_minimalSlab K T S

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.columnPart_eq_verticalColumnCentres_relative
statement:
theorem columnPart_eq_verticalColumnCentres_relative
    {K : Region} {T : Set Plane} {X : Set ℝ}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T (Complex.re ⁻¹' X)) (hX : IsRegularOpen X) :
    columnPart K.openCarrier Complex.I T = verticalColumnCentres K T
proof:
:= by
  have hplates := cylinder_plate_facts hTile hX
  ext t
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ht, hInv⟩
    have hminimal := (component_iff_minimalSlab K T _).mp
      (complete_lineFibre_minimal hTile ht hInv)
    have hF : lineFibre Complex.I T t ∈ Set.range (@VerticalPlate.centres K T) :=
      hplates.2.symm ▸ hminimal
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hF
    have hcol : IsVerticalColumn P := by
      refine ⟨t.re, ?_⟩
      rw [hP, lineFibre_vertical]
      exact Set.inter_subset_right
    rw [verticalColumnCentres, Set.mem_iUnion]
    refine ⟨⟨P, hcol⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hP, lineFibre_vertical]
    exact ⟨ht, rfl⟩
  · intro ht
    rw [verticalColumnCentres, Set.mem_iUnion] at ht
    obtain ⟨P, htP⟩ := ht
    refine ⟨plate_centres_subset P.1 htP, ?_⟩
    rw [← column_plate_eq_lineFibre hTile P.1 (hplates.1 P.1) P.2 htP]
    apply (invariant_iff_verticalSlab K P.1.centres).mpr
    exact ⟨P.1.base, (hplates.1 P.1).1, (hplates.1 P.1).2⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.tectonicPlates_eq_nonColumn_relative
statement:
theorem tectonicPlates_eq_nonColumn_relative
    {K : Region} {T : Set Plane} {X : Set ℝ}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T (Complex.re ⁻¹' X)) (hX : IsRegularOpen X) :
    tectonicPlates K.openCarrier Complex.I T =
      (@VerticalPlate.centres K T) '' nonColumnVerticalPlates K T
proof:
:= by
  have hcomponents := components_eq_range_relative hTile hX
  have hcolumns := columnPart_eq_verticalColumnCentres_relative hTile hX
  ext S
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hS, hSoutside⟩
    have hSr : S ∈ Set.range (@VerticalPlate.centres K T) := hcomponents ▸ hS
    obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := hSr
    refine ⟨P, ?_, rfl⟩
    intro hPcolumn
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := plate_centres_nonempty P
    have htcolumn : t ∈ columnPart K.openCarrier Complex.I T := by
      rw [hcolumns, verticalColumnCentres, Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨⟨P, hPcolumn⟩, ht⟩
    exact (hSoutside ht).2 htcolumn
  · rintro ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(Set.ext_iff.mp hcomponents P.centres).mpr ⟨P, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro t htP
    refine ⟨plate_centres_subset P htP, ?_⟩
    intro htcol
    rw [hcolumns, verticalColumnCentres, Set.mem_iUnion] at htcol
    obtain ⟨Q, htQ⟩ := htcol
    have hPQ : P ≠ Q.1 := fun heq => hP (heq ▸ Q.2)
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (verticalPlateCentres_pairwiseDisjoint K T
      (Set.mem_univ P) (Set.mem_univ Q.1) hPQ) htP htQ

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.vertical_decomposition_relative
statement:
theorem vertical_decomposition_relative
    {K : Region} {T : Set Plane} {X : Set ℝ}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T (Complex.re ⁻¹' X)) (hX : IsRegularOpen X) :
    columnPart K.openCarrier Complex.I T ∪
        ⋃₀ tectonicPlates K.openCarrier Complex.I T = T ∧
      Disjoint (columnPart K.openCarrier Complex.I T)
        (⋃₀ tectonicPlates K.openCarrier Complex.I T) ∧
      (tectonicPlates K.openCarrier Complex.I T).Pairwise Disjoint
proof:
:= by
  have hcolumns := columnPart_eq_verticalColumnCentres_relative hTile hX
  have htectonic := tectonicPlates_eq_nonColumn_relative hTile hX
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · rintro t (ht | ht)
      · exact ht.1
      · obtain ⟨S, hS, htS⟩ := ht
        exact hS.1.2.1 htS
    · intro t ht
      have htUnion : t ∈ ⋃ P : VerticalPlate K T, P.centres :=
        (iUnion_verticalPlateCentres K T).symm ▸ ht
      obtain ⟨P, htP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp htUnion
      by_cases hPcolumn : IsVerticalColumn P
      · left
        rw [hcolumns, verticalColumnCentres, Set.mem_iUnion]
        exact ⟨⟨P, hPcolumn⟩, htP⟩
      · right
        exact ⟨P.centres, htectonic.symm ▸
          (show P.centres ∈ (@VerticalPlate.centres K T) ''
            nonColumnVerticalPlates K T from ⟨P, hPcolumn, rfl⟩), htP⟩
  · apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro t htcol ⟨S, hS, htS⟩
    exact (hS.2 htS).2 htcol
  · intro S hS R hR hSR
    rw [htectonic] at hS hR
    obtain ⟨P, _, rfl⟩ := hS
    obtain ⟨Q, _, rfl⟩ := hR
    exact verticalPlateCentres_pairwiseDisjoint K T
      (Set.mem_univ P) (Set.mem_univ Q) (fun heq => hSR (congrArg VerticalPlate.centres heq))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.columnPart_eq_verticalColumnCentres
proof:
:= by
  apply columnPart_eq_verticalColumnCentres_relative (X := Set.univ)
  · simpa using hTile
  · simp [IsRegularOpen]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.tectonicPlates_eq_nonColumn
statement:
theorem tectonicPlates_eq_nonColumn {K : Region} {T : Set Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    tectonicPlates K.openCarrier Complex.I T =
      (@VerticalPlate.centres K T) '' nonColumnVerticalPlates K T
proof:
:= by
  apply tectonicPlates_eq_nonColumn_relative (X := Set.univ)
  · simpa using hTile
  · simp [IsRegularOpen]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.vertical_decomposition
statement:
theorem vertical_decomposition {K : Region} {T : Set Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    columnPart K.openCarrier Complex.I T ∪
        ⋃₀ tectonicPlates K.openCarrier Complex.I T = T ∧
      Disjoint (columnPart K.openCarrier Complex.I T)
        (⋃₀ tectonicPlates K.openCarrier Complex.I T) ∧
      (tectonicPlates K.openCarrier Complex.I T).Pairwise Disjoint
proof:
:= by
  apply vertical_decomposition_relative (X := Set.univ)
  · simpa using hTile
  · simp [IsRegularOpen]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.coveredRegion_coordinateSwap
statement:
theorem coveredRegion_coordinateSwap (K : Region) (S : Set Plane) :
    coveredRegion K.coordinateSwap.openCarrier (coordinateSwap '' S) =
      coordinateSwap '' coveredRegion K.openCarrier S
proof:
:= by
  rw [coveredRegion_openCarrier, coveredRegion_openCarrier, regularSupport_coordinateSwap]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.invariant_coordinateSwap
statement:
theorem invariant_coordinateSwap (D : Set Plane) (v : Plane) :
    IsInvariantAlong D v ↔
      IsInvariantAlong (coordinateSwap '' D) (coordinateSwap v)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h r
    change (r • coordinateSwap v) +ᵥ (coordinateSwap '' D) = coordinateSwap '' D
    rw [← coordinateSwap.map_smul, ← coordinateSwap_image_vadd]
    exact congrArg (Set.image coordinateSwap) (h r)
  · intro h r
    apply coordinateSwap.injective.image_injective
    rw [coordinateSwap_image_vadd, coordinateSwap.map_smul]
    exact h r

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.coveredRegion_invariant_coordinateSwap
statement:
theorem coveredRegion_invariant_coordinateSwap (K : Region) (S : Set Plane) (v : Plane) :
    IsInvariantAlong (coveredRegion K.openCarrier S) v ↔
      IsInvariantAlong (coveredRegion K.coordinateSwap.openCarrier (coordinateSwap '' S))
        (coordinateSwap v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coveredRegion_coordinateSwap]
  exact invariant_coordinateSwap _ _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.coordinateSwap_image_image
statement:
private theorem coordinateSwap_image_image (S : Set Plane) :
    coordinateSwap '' (coordinateSwap '' S) = S
proof:
:= by
  simp [Set.image_image]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.coordinateSwap_one
statement: private theorem coordinateSwap_one : coordinateSwap (1 : Plane) = Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.component_coordinateSwap_forward
statement:
private theorem component_coordinateSwap_forward (K : Region) (T S : Set Plane)
    (v : Plane) (hS : IsEarthquakeComponent K.openCarrier v T S) :
    IsEarthquakeComponent K.coordinateSwap.openCarrier (coordinateSwap v)
      (coordinateSwap '' T) (coordinateSwap '' S)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hS.1.image _, Set.image_mono hS.2.1,
    (coveredRegion_invariant_coordinateSwap K S v).mp hS.2.2.1, ?_⟩
  intro R hRnonempty hRsub hRinv
  have hRsubOriginal : coordinateSwap '' R ⊆ S := by
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsz⟩ := hRsub hz
    simpa only [← hsz, coordinateSwap_apply_apply] using hs
  have hRinvOriginal : IsInvariantAlong (coveredRegion K.openCarrier (coordinateSwap '' R)) v := by
    have h :=
      (coveredRegion_invariant_coordinateSwap K.coordinateSwap R (coordinateSwap v)).mp hRinv
    simpa only [Region.coordinateSwap_involutive, coordinateSwap_apply_apply] using h
  have hEq := hS.2.2.2 (coordinateSwap '' R) (hRnonempty.image _)
    hRsubOriginal hRinvOriginal
  have hImageEq := congrArg (Set.image coordinateSwap) hEq
  simpa only [coordinateSwap_image_image] using hImageEq

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.component_coordinateSwap
statement:
theorem component_coordinateSwap (K : Region) (T S : Set Plane) (v : Plane) :
    IsEarthquakeComponent K.openCarrier v T S ↔
      IsEarthquakeComponent K.coordinateSwap.openCarrier (coordinateSwap v)
        (coordinateSwap '' T) (coordinateSwap '' S)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact component_coordinateSwap_forward K T S v
  · intro h
    have hback := component_coordinateSwap_forward K.coordinateSwap
      (coordinateSwap '' T) (coordinateSwap '' S) (coordinateSwap v) h
    simpa only [Region.coordinateSwap_involutive, coordinateSwap_image_image,
      coordinateSwap_apply_apply] using hback

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.lineFibre_horizontal
statement:
theorem lineFibre_horizontal (T : Set Plane) (t : Plane) :
    lineFibre (1 : Plane) T t = T ∩ {z | z.im = t.im}
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [lineFibre, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_vadd_set]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hz, w, hw, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨hz, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hw
    simp [Complex.add_im]
  · rintro ⟨hz, himag⟩
    change z.im = t.im at himag
    refine ⟨hz, z - t, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mpr
      refine ⟨z.re - t.re, ?_⟩
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [himag]
    · simp [vadd_eq_add]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.lineFibre_coordinateSwap_horizontal
statement:
theorem lineFibre_coordinateSwap_horizontal (T : Set Plane) (t : Plane) :
    lineFibre Complex.I (coordinateSwap '' T) (coordinateSwap t) =
      coordinateSwap '' lineFibre (1 : Plane) T t
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineFibre_vertical, lineFibre_horizontal]
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, hcoord⟩
    exact ⟨s, ⟨hs, hcoord⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, ⟨hs, hcoord⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, hcoord⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.columnPart_coordinateSwap_horizontal
statement:
theorem columnPart_coordinateSwap_horizontal (K : Region) (T : Set Plane) :
    columnPart K.coordinateSwap.openCarrier Complex.I (coordinateSwap '' T) =
      coordinateSwap '' columnPart K.openCarrier (1 : Plane) T
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, hInv⟩
    refine ⟨t, ⟨ht, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [lineFibre_coordinateSwap_horizontal] at hInv
    apply (coveredRegion_invariant_coordinateSwap K (lineFibre (1 : Plane) T t) 1).mpr
    simpa only [coordinateSwap_one] using hInv
  · rintro ⟨t, ⟨ht, hInv⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [lineFibre_coordinateSwap_horizontal]
    have h := (coveredRegion_invariant_coordinateSwap K (lineFibre (1 : Plane) T t) 1).mp hInv
    simpa only [coordinateSwap_one] using h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.tectonic_mem_coordinateSwap_horizontal
statement:
theorem tectonic_mem_coordinateSwap_horizontal (K : Region) (T S : Set Plane) :
    S ∈ tectonicPlates K.openCarrier (1 : Plane) T ↔
      coordinateSwap '' S ∈
        tectonicPlates K.coordinateSwap.openCarrier Complex.I (coordinateSwap '' T)
proof:
:= by
  change (IsEarthquakeComponent K.openCarrier 1 T S ∧
    S ⊆ T \ columnPart K.openCarrier 1 T) ↔ _
  change _ ↔ (IsEarthquakeComponent K.coordinateSwap.openCarrier Complex.I
    (coordinateSwap '' T) (coordinateSwap '' S) ∧
      coordinateSwap '' S ⊆ coordinateSwap '' T \
        columnPart K.coordinateSwap.openCarrier Complex.I (coordinateSwap '' T))
  rw [columnPart_coordinateSwap_horizontal, ← Set.image_sdiff coordinateSwap.injective,
    Set.image_subset_image_iff coordinateSwap.injective]
  have hcomponent := component_coordinateSwap K T S 1
  simpa only [coordinateSwap_one] using and_congr hcomponent Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.tectonicPlates_coordinateSwap_horizontal
statement:
theorem tectonicPlates_coordinateSwap_horizontal (K : Region) (T : Set Plane) :
    tectonicPlates K.coordinateSwap.openCarrier Complex.I (coordinateSwap '' T) =
      (Set.image coordinateSwap) '' tectonicPlates K.openCarrier (1 : Plane) T
proof:
:= by
  ext S
  constructor
  · intro hS
    refine ⟨coordinateSwap '' S, ?_, coordinateSwap_image_image S⟩
    apply (tectonic_mem_coordinateSwap_horizontal K T (coordinateSwap '' S)).mpr
    simpa only [coordinateSwap_image_image] using hS
  · rintro ⟨R, hR, rfl⟩
    exact (tectonic_mem_coordinateSwap_horizontal K T R).mp hR

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.horizontal_decomposition
statement:
theorem horizontal_decomposition {K : Region} {T : Set Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    columnPart K.openCarrier (1 : Plane) T ∪
        ⋃₀ tectonicPlates K.openCarrier (1 : Plane) T = T ∧
      Disjoint (columnPart K.openCarrier (1 : Plane) T)
        (⋃₀ tectonicPlates K.openCarrier (1 : Plane) T) ∧
      (tectonicPlates K.openCarrier (1 : Plane) T).Pairwise Disjoint
proof:
:= by
  have hTileSwap : TilesOn K.coordinateSwap (coordinateSwap '' T) Set.univ := by
    simpa only [Set.image_univ_of_surjective coordinateSwap.surjective] using
      tilesOn_coordinateSwap hTile
  have hD := vertical_decomposition hTileSwap
  have hcolumns := columnPart_coordinateSwap_horizontal K T
  have htectonic := tectonicPlates_coordinateSwap_horizontal K T
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply coordinateSwap.injective.image_injective
    rw [Set.image_union, Set.image_sUnion, ← hcolumns, ← htectonic]
    exact hD.1
  · apply Disjoint.of_image (f := coordinateSwap)
    rw [Set.image_sUnion, ← hcolumns, ← htectonic]
    exact hD.2.1
  · intro S hS R hR hSR
    apply Disjoint.of_image (f := coordinateSwap)
    have hSswap := (tectonic_mem_coordinateSwap_horizontal K T S).mp hS
    have hRswap := (tectonic_mem_coordinateSwap_horizontal K T R).mp hR
    exact hD.2.2 hSswap hRswap
      (fun heq => hSR (coordinateSwap.injective.image_injective heq))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.vertical_tectonicPlates_finite
proof:
:= by
  rw [tectonicPlates_eq_nonColumn hTile]
  exact (Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.noncolumnVerticalPlates_finite hTile).1.image _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Columns.horizontal_tectonicPlates_finite
proof:
:= by
  have hTileSwap : TilesOn K.coordinateSwap (coordinateSwap '' T) Set.univ := by
    simpa only [Set.image_univ_of_surjective coordinateSwap.surjective] using
      tilesOn_coordinateSwap hTile
  have hfinite := vertical_tectonicPlates_finite hTileSwap
  rw [tectonicPlates_coordinateSwap_horizontal] at hfinite
  exact hfinite.of_finite_image coordinateSwap.injective.image_injective.injOn

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.tilesOn_centres_isClosed
statement:
theorem tilesOn_centres_isClosed {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {E T : Set Plane}
    (hT : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T E) : IsClosed T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨delta, hdelta, hsep⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.tilesOn_uniformlySeparated K
  exact Metric.isClosed_of_pairwise_le_dist hdelta (hsep E T hT)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.native_fell_topology
statement:
theorem native_fell_topology :
    fellTopology = TopologicalSpace.induced compactifiedCentres
      (TopologicalSpace.vietoris (OnePoint Plane))
proof:
:= by
  let : TopologicalSpace (Set (OnePoint Plane)) :=
    TopologicalSpace.vietoris (OnePoint Plane)
  let : TopologicalSpace (TopologicalSpace.Closeds Plane) := fellTopology
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [TopologicalSpace.vietoris, induced_generateFrom_eq]
    apply TopologicalSpace.le_generateFrom_iff_subset_isOpen.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩
    rcases hU with ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩ | ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩
    · by_cases hinfty : OnePoint.infty ∈ V
      · have hQ : IsCompact (((↑) : Plane → OnePoint Plane) ⁻¹' V)ᶜ :=
          ((OnePoint.isOpen_iff_of_mem hinfty).mp hV).2
        have heq : compactifiedCentres ⁻¹' V.powerset =
            {F : TopologicalSpace.Closeds Plane |
              Disjoint (F : Set Plane) (((↑) : Plane → OnePoint Plane) ⁻¹' V)ᶜ} := by
          ext F
          simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_powerset_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
            compactifiedCentres, Set.union_subset_iff,
            Set.image_subset_iff, Set.singleton_subset_iff, hinfty, and_true,
            Set.disjoint_compl_right_iff_subset]
        rw [heq]
        exact TopologicalSpace.isOpen_generateFrom_of_mem (Or.inr ⟨_, hQ, rfl⟩)
      · have heq : compactifiedCentres ⁻¹' V.powerset = ∅ := by
          apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
          intro F hF
          exact hinfty (hF (Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_singleton _)))
        rw [heq]
        exact @isOpen_empty _ fellTopology
    · by_cases hinfty : OnePoint.infty ∈ V
      · have heq : compactifiedCentres ⁻¹'
              {s : Set (OnePoint Plane) | (s ∩ V).Nonempty} = Set.univ := by
          ext F
          simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
          exact ⟨OnePoint.infty,
            Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_singleton _), hinfty⟩
        rw [heq]
        exact @isOpen_univ _ fellTopology
      · have hopen : IsOpen (((↑) : Plane → OnePoint Plane) ⁻¹' V) :=
          hV.preimage OnePoint.continuous_coe
        have heq : compactifiedCentres ⁻¹'
              {s : Set (OnePoint Plane) | (s ∩ V).Nonempty} =
            {F : TopologicalSpace.Closeds Plane |
              ((F : Set Plane) ∩ (((↑) : Plane → OnePoint Plane) ⁻¹' V)).Nonempty} := by
          ext F
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨z, hz, hzV⟩
            rcases hz with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ | hz
            · exact ⟨x, hx, hzV⟩
            · exact (hinfty (by simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz] using hzV)).elim
          · rintro ⟨x, hx, hxV⟩
            exact ⟨(x : OnePoint Plane), Or.inl ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hxV⟩
        rw [heq]
        exact TopologicalSpace.isOpen_generateFrom_of_mem (Or.inl ⟨_, hopen, rfl⟩)
  · apply TopologicalSpace.le_generateFrom_iff_subset_isOpen.mpr
    rintro U (⟨V, hV, rfl⟩ | ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩)
    · apply isOpen_induced_iff.mpr
      refine ⟨{s : Set (OnePoint Plane) |
        (s ∩ (((↑) : Plane → OnePoint Plane) '' V)).Nonempty},
        TopologicalSpace.vietoris.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen
          (OnePoint.isOpen_image_coe.mpr hV), ?_⟩
      ext F
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨z, hzF, x, hx, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨x, ?_, hx⟩
        simpa [compactifiedCentres] using hzF
      · rintro ⟨x, hx, hxV⟩
        exact ⟨(x : OnePoint Plane), Or.inl ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, ⟨x, hxV, rfl⟩⟩
    · apply isOpen_induced_iff.mpr
      refine ⟨((((↑) : Plane → OnePoint Plane) '' Q)ᶜ).powerset,
        IsOpen.powerset_vietoris
          (OnePoint.isOpen_compl_image_coe.mpr ⟨hQ.isClosed, hQ⟩), ?_⟩
      ext F
      change ((((↑) : Plane → OnePoint Plane) '' (F : Set Plane)) ∪
        {OnePoint.infty} ⊆ (((↑) : Plane → OnePoint Plane) '' Q)ᶜ) ↔
        Disjoint (F : Set Plane) Q
      simp [Set.subset_def, Set.disjoint_left]
      aesop

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.compactifyClosed_inducing
statement: private theorem compactifyClosed_inducing : Topology.IsInducing compactifyClosed
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  change fellTopology = TopologicalSpace.induced compactifyClosed
    (TopologicalSpace.induced
      ((↑) : TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Plane) → Set (OnePoint Plane))
      (TopologicalSpace.vietoris (OnePoint Plane)))
  simp only [induced_compose]
  exact native_fell_topology

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.compactifyClosed_embedding
statement:
private theorem compactifyClosed_embedding : Topology.IsEmbedding compactifyClosed where
  __
proof:
:= compactifyClosed_inducing
  injective := by
    intro F G h
    apply TopologicalSpace.Closeds.ext
    ext x
    have hx := congrArg
      (fun C : TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Plane) =>
        (x : OnePoint Plane) ∈ (C : Set (OnePoint Plane))) h
    simpa [compactifyClosed, Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification] using hx

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.centres_embedding
statement:
theorem centres_embedding (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region) (E : Set Plane) :
    Topology.IsEmbedding
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.centres (K := K) (E := E)) where
  eq_induced
proof:
:= by
    let : MetricSpace (OnePoint Plane) := by
      let e : OnePoint Plane ≃ₜ Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) 1 :=
        onePointEquivSphereOfFinrankEq (ι := Fin 3) (V := Plane) (by
          norm_num [Plane, Complex.finrank_real_complex])
      exact e.isEmbedding.comapMetricSpace
    change TopologicalSpace.induced
      (fun T : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K E =>
        Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification
          (T.centres : Set Plane) T.centres.isClosed)
      (TopologicalSpace.induced
        ((↑) : TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Plane) → Set (OnePoint Plane))
        (TopologicalSpace.vietoris (OnePoint Plane))) =
      TopologicalSpace.induced Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.centres fellTopology
    rw [native_fell_topology]
    simp only [induced_compose]
    rfl
  injective := by
    intro U V h
    cases U
    cases V
    cases h
    rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.centres_closedEmbedding
statement:
theorem centres_closedEmbedding (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region)
    (E : Set Plane) :
    Topology.IsClosedEmbedding
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.centres (K := K) (E := E)) where
  __
proof:
:= centres_embedding K E
  isClosed_range := by
    have hcompact := (Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.tilingSpace_compact K E).image
      (centres_embedding K E).continuous
    simpa only [Set.image_univ] using hcompact.isClosed

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.period_bridge
proof:
:= by
  rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.aePeriodGroup_eq_periodGroup_of_regularOpen hopen hregular]
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.centres_translation
statement:
theorem centres_translation {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {E : Set Plane}
    (p : Tiling.AxisParallel.aePeriodGroup E)
    (U : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K E) :
    ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate p U).centres : Set Plane) =
      (p : Plane) +ᵥ (U.centres : Set Plane)
proof:
:= by
  change (fun x => x + (p : Plane)) '' (U.centres : Set Plane) = _
  ext x
  simp only [mem_image, mem_vadd_set, vadd_eq_add]
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ <;> exact ⟨y, hy, add_comm _ _⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.ambient_orbit_eq_image
statement:
theorem ambient_orbit_eq_image {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {E : Set Plane}
    (hopen : IsOpen E) (hregular : interior (closure E) = E)
    (U : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K E) :
    {S : TopologicalSpace.Closeds Plane |
      ∃ p ∈ {p : Plane | IsPeriod E p},
        (S : Set Plane) = p +ᵥ (U.centres : Set Plane)} =
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.centres ''
      AddAction.orbit (Tiling.AxisParallel.aePeriodGroup E) U
proof:
:= by
  ext S
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, hS⟩
    let g : Tiling.AxisParallel.aePeriodGroup E := ⟨p, (period_bridge hopen hregular p).mpr hp⟩
    refine ⟨Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate g U,
      AddAction.mem_orbit_iff.mpr ⟨g, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    apply TopologicalSpace.Closeds.ext
    exact (centres_translation g U).trans hS.symm
  · rintro ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := AddAction.mem_orbit_iff.mp hV
    exact ⟨g, (period_bridge hopen hregular g).mp g.property, centres_translation g U⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.production_hull_eq_preimage
statement:
theorem production_hull_eq_preimage {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region}
    {E : Set Plane} (hopen : IsOpen E) (hregular : interior (closure E) = E)
    (U : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K E) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull U =
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.centres ⁻¹' orbitHull E (U.centres : Set Plane)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull,
    (centres_embedding K E).isInducing.closure_eq_preimage_closure_image,
    orbitHull, orbitHullUnder, ambient_orbit_eq_image hopen hregular]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.ambient_hull_eq_image
statement:
theorem ambient_hull_eq_image {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region}
    {E : Set Plane} (hopen : IsOpen E) (hregular : interior (closure E) = E)
    (U : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K E) :
    orbitHull E (U.centres : Set Plane) =
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.centres ''
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull U
proof:
:= by
  have hc := (centres_embedding K E).continuous
  have hclosed : IsClosed
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.centres ''
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull U) :=
    ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.orbitHull_compact U).1.image hc).isClosed
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rw [orbitHull, orbitHullUnder, ambient_orbit_eq_image hopen hregular]
    apply closure_minimal _ hclosed
    exact Set.image_mono subset_closure
  · change Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.centres '' _ ⊆ _
    rw [production_hull_eq_preimage hopen hregular]
    exact Set.image_preimage_subset _ _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.ambient_hull_points_tile
statement:
theorem ambient_hull_points_tile {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region}
    {E : Set Plane} (hopen : IsOpen E) (hregular : interior (closure E) = E)
    (U : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K E)
    {S : TopologicalSpace.Closeds Plane} (hS : S ∈ orbitHull E (U.centres : Set Plane)) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K (S : Set Plane) E
proof:
:= by
  rw [ambient_hull_eq_image hopen hregular U] at hS
  obtain ⟨V, _, rfl⟩ := hS
  exact V.tilesOn

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.minimal_bridge
statement:
theorem minimal_bridge {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {E : Set Plane}
    (hopen : IsOpen E) (hregular : IsRegularOpen E)
    (U : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K E) :
    IsMinimal E (U.centres : Set Plane) ↔
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.IsTopologicallyMinimal
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull U)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_hclosed, hminimal⟩
    obtain ⟨_, hnonempty, hinvariant⟩ :=
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.orbitHull_compact U
    refine ⟨hnonempty, isClosed_closure, hinvariant, ?_⟩
    intro V hV
    have hambient : V.centres ∈ orbitHull E (U.centres : Set Plane) := by
      rw [production_hull_eq_preimage hopen hregular U] at hV
      exact hV
    change Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull V =
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull U
    rw [production_hull_eq_preimage hopen hregular V,
      hminimal V.centres hambient]
    exact (production_hull_eq_preimage hopen hregular U).symm
  · intro hminimal
    refine ⟨U.centres.isClosed, ?_⟩
    intro S hS
    rw [ambient_hull_eq_image hopen hregular U] at hS
    obtain ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩ := hS
    have hVhull : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull V =
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull U := hminimal.2.2.2 V hV
    rw [ambient_hull_eq_image hopen hregular V, hVhull,
      ← ambient_hull_eq_image hopen hregular U]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.minimal_iff
statement:
theorem minimal_iff {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {E : Set Plane}
    (hregular : IsRegularOpen E)
    (U : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K E) :
    IsMinimal E (U.centres : Set Plane) ↔
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.IsTopologicallyMinimal
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull U)
proof:
:=
  minimal_bridge (isRegularOpen_isOpen hregular) hregular U

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.locallyFellConverges_iff_tendsto
statement:
theorem locallyFellConverges_iff_tendsto
    (A : ℕ → TopologicalSpace.Closeds Plane) (L : TopologicalSpace.Closeds Plane) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
      (fun n => (A n : Set Plane)) (L : Set Plane) ↔
      Filter.Tendsto A Filter.atTop (nhds L)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hA, hL, hconv⟩
    apply compactifyClosed_inducing.tendsto_nhds_iff.mpr
    exact hconv
  · intro hconv
    refine ⟨fun n => (A n).isClosed, L.isClosed, ?_⟩
    exact compactifyClosed_inducing.tendsto_nhds_iff.mp hconv

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.mem_orbitHullUnder_of_locallyFellConverges
statement:
theorem mem_orbitHullUnder_of_locallyFellConverges
    {G T : Set Plane} (g : ℕ → Plane) (hg : ∀ n, g n ∈ G)
    (L : TopologicalSpace.Closeds Plane)
    (hconv : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
      (fun n => g n +ᵥ T) (L : Set Plane)) : L ∈ orbitHullUnder G T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA, hL, hconv⟩ := hconv
  let A : ℕ → TopologicalSpace.Closeds Plane := fun n => ⟨g n +ᵥ T, hA n⟩
  have hFell : Filter.Tendsto A Filter.atTop (nhds L) := by
    apply (locallyFellConverges_iff_tendsto A L).mp
    exact ⟨hA, hL, hconv⟩
  exact mem_closure_of_tendsto hFell
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ⟨g n, hg n, rfl⟩)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.Fell.exists_minimal_hull_point
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_hull_point {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {E : Set Plane}
    (hregular : IsRegularOpen E)
    (U : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K E) :
    ∃ V : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K E,
      V.centres ∈ orbitHull E (U.centres : Set Plane) ∧
        IsMinimal E (V.centres : Set Plane)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Y, hYHull, hYnonempty, _, _, hYminimal⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.exists_minimalInvariantSubset U
  obtain ⟨V, hVY⟩ := hYnonempty
  have hVhull : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull V = Y :=
    hYminimal.2.2.2 V hVY
  refine ⟨V, ?_, (minimal_iff hregular V).mpr ?_⟩
  · rw [ambient_hull_eq_image (isRegularOpen_isOpen hregular) hregular U]
    exact ⟨V, hYHull hVY, rfl⟩
  · rw [hVhull]
    exact hYminimal

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.isRegularOpen_isOpen
statement:
theorem isRegularOpen_isOpen {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {U : Set X} (hU : IsRegularOpen U) : IsOpen U
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hU]
  exact isOpen_interior

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.isPeriod_iff_mem_periodGroup
statement:
theorem isPeriod_iff_mem_periodGroup (A : Set Plane) (p : Plane) :
    IsPeriod A p ↔ p ∈ Tiling.Polygonal.periodGroup A
proof:
:= by
  exact AddAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.isPeriod_iff_membership
statement:
theorem isPeriod_iff_membership (A : Set Plane) (p : Plane) :
    IsPeriod A p ↔ ∀ x, x + p ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp x
    have hmem := congrArg (fun S : Set Plane => p + x ∈ S) hp
    simpa [IsPeriod, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
      add_comm] using hmem.symm
  · intro hp
    apply Set.ext
    intro x
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simpa [vadd_eq_add] using (hp (-p + x)).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.hasFiniteLocalComplexity_iff_hasFLC
statement:
theorem hasFiniteLocalComplexity_iff_hasFLC
    {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] {T : Set V} :
    HasFiniteLocalComplexity T ↔ Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC T
proof:
:=
  Tiling.Polygonal.hasFLC_iff_finite_differences_on_bounded.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.hasFiniteLocalComplexity_mono
statement:
theorem hasFiniteLocalComplexity_mono
    {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] {S T : Set V}
    (hT : HasFiniteLocalComplexity T) (hST : S ⊆ T) :
  HasFiniteLocalComplexity S
proof:
:= by
  intro B hB
  exact (hT B hB).subset
    (inter_subset_inter_left B (Set.sub_subset_sub hST hST))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.exists_radius_avoiding_levels
statement:
private theorem exists_radius_avoiding_levels (s : Finset ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∀ y ∈ s, dist y x < ε → y = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let t := s.erase x
  have hx : x ∈ ((t : Finset ℝ) : Set ℝ)ᶜ := by simp [t]
  have hopen : IsOpen (((t : Finset ℝ) : Set ℝ)ᶜ) :=
    t.finite_toSet.isClosed.isOpen_compl
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen x hx
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro y hy hdist
  by_contra hyx
  have hyt : y ∈ t := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hyx, hy⟩
  exact hball hdist hyt

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.dist_re_le_norm_sub
statement:
private theorem dist_re_le_norm_sub (z v : Plane) :
    dist z.re v.re ≤ ‖z - v‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  calc
    |z.re - v.re| = |(z - v).re| := by simp
    _ ≤ ‖z - v‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.dist_im_le_norm_sub
statement:
private theorem dist_im_le_norm_sub (z v : Plane) :
    dist z.im v.im ≤ ‖z - v‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  calc
    |z.im - v.im| = |(z - v).im| := by simp
    _ ≤ ‖z - v‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.no_level_strictly_between
statement:
private theorem no_level_strictly_between
    {s : Finset ℝ} {v z : ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (havoid : ∀ y ∈ s, dist y v < ε → y = v)
    (hz : dist z v < ε) (hneq : z ≠ v) :
    ∀ y ∈ s, ¬ (min z v < y ∧ y < max z v)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy hybetween
  have hyDist : dist y v < ε := by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hneq with h | h
    · have hybetween' : z < y ∧ y < v := by
        simpa [min_eq_left h.le, max_eq_right h.le] using hybetween
      have hsmall : dist y v < dist z v := by
        rw [Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq,
          abs_of_nonpos (by linarith : y - v ≤ 0),
          abs_of_nonpos (by linarith : z - v ≤ 0)]
        linarith
      exact hsmall.trans hz
    · have hybetween' : v < y ∧ y < z := by
        simpa [min_eq_right h.le, max_eq_left h.le] using hybetween
      have hsmall : dist y v < dist z v := by
        rw [Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq,
          abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ y - v),
          abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ z - v)]
        linarith
      exact hsmall.trans hz
  have hEq := havoid y hy hyDist
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hneq with h | h
  · have hybetween' : z < y ∧ y < v := by
      simpa [min_eq_left h.le, max_eq_right h.le] using hybetween
    linarith
  · have hybetween' : v < y ∧ y < z := by
      simpa [min_eq_right h.le, max_eq_left h.le] using hybetween
    linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.closedInterval_reachesWest
statement:
private theorem closedInterval_reachesWest {x v lo hi : ℝ}
    (hxv : x < v) (hxhi : x ≠ hi)
    (hnoLo : ¬ (x < lo ∧ lo < v)) (hnoHi : ¬ (x < hi ∧ hi < v)) :
    (lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi) ↔ (lo < v ∧ v ≤ hi)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
    refine ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt hlo hxv, ?_⟩
    by_contra hnot
    have hvhi : hi < v := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    exact hnoHi ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hhi hxhi, hvhi⟩
  · rintro ⟨hlov, hvhi⟩
    refine ⟨?_, le_trans hxv.le hvhi⟩
    by_contra hnot
    have hxlo' : x < lo := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    exact hnoLo ⟨hxlo', hlov⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.closedInterval_reachesEast
statement:
private theorem closedInterval_reachesEast {x v lo hi : ℝ}
    (hvx : v < x) (hxlo : x ≠ lo)
    (hnoLo : ¬ (v < lo ∧ lo < x)) (hnoHi : ¬ (v < hi ∧ hi < x)) :
    (lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi) ↔ (lo ≤ v ∧ v < hi)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
    refine ⟨?_, lt_of_lt_of_le hvx hhi⟩
    by_contra hnot
    have hvlo : v < lo := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    exact hnoLo ⟨hvlo, lt_of_le_of_ne hlo (Ne.symm hxlo)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hlov, hvhi⟩
    refine ⟨le_trans hlov hvx.le, ?_⟩
    by_contra hnot
    have hxhi' : hi < x := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    exact hnoHi ⟨hvhi, hxhi'⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.rectangle_mem_iff_quadrantOccupied_local
statement:
private theorem rectangle_mem_iff_quadrantOccupied_local
    {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane} (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (v z : Plane) (west south : Bool) {ε : ℝ}
    (havoidRe : ∀ y ∈ rectangleRealLevels R, dist y v.re < ε → y = v.re)
    (havoidIm : ∀ y ∈ rectangleImagLevels R, dist y v.im < ε → y = v.im)
    (hzball : z ∈ Metric.ball v ε)
    (hzquad : z ∈ quadrantAt (rectangleQuadrant west south) v) :
    z ∈ Ω ↔ quadrantOccupied R v west south
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnorm : ‖z - v‖ < ε := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hzball
  have hdistRe : dist z.re v.re < ε := (dist_re_le_norm_sub z v).trans_lt hnorm
  have hdistIm : dist z.im v.im < ε := (dist_im_le_norm_sub z v).trans_lt hnorm
  have hzReNe : z.re ≠ v.re := by
    intro h
    have hz := hzquad
    cases west <;> cases south <;>
      simp [rectangleQuadrant, quadrantAt, h] at hz
  have hzImNe : z.im ≠ v.im := by
    intro h
    have hz := hzquad
    cases west <;> cases south <;>
      simp [rectangleQuadrant, quadrantAt, h] at hz
  have hNoRe := no_level_strictly_between havoidRe hdistRe hzReNe
  have hNoIm := no_level_strictly_between havoidIm hdistIm hzImNe
  have hzSides :
      (if west then z.re < v.re else v.re < z.re) ∧
      (if south then z.im < v.im else v.im < z.im) := by
    cases west <;> cases south <;>
      simpa [rectangleQuadrant, quadrantAt] using hzquad
  have hcoordinate : ∀ r : Plane × Plane, r ∈ R →
      (z ∈ rectangle r.1 r.2 ↔ rectangleReachesQuadrant r v west south) := by
    intro r hr
    have hlevelsA : r.1.re ∈ rectangleRealLevels R := by
      change r.1.re ∈ (R.toFinset.image (fun q => q.1.re)) ∪ _
      exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨r,
        List.mem_toFinset.mpr hr, rfl⟩)
    have hlevelsB : r.2.re ∈ rectangleRealLevels R := by
      change r.2.re ∈ _ ∪ (R.toFinset.image (fun q => q.2.re))
      exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨r,
        List.mem_toFinset.mpr hr, rfl⟩)
    have hlevelsC : r.1.im ∈ rectangleImagLevels R := by
      change r.1.im ∈ (R.toFinset.image (fun q => q.1.im)) ∪ _
      exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨r,
        List.mem_toFinset.mpr hr, rfl⟩)
    have hlevelsD : r.2.im ∈ rectangleImagLevels R := by
      change r.2.im ∈ _ ∪ (R.toFinset.image (fun q => q.2.im))
      exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨r,
        List.mem_toFinset.mpr hr, rfl⟩)
    have hneqA : z.re ≠ r.1.re := by
      intro heq
      have hclose := havoidRe r.1.re hlevelsA (by simpa [heq] using hdistRe)
      exact hzReNe (heq.trans hclose)
    have hneqB : z.re ≠ r.2.re := by
      intro heq
      have hclose := havoidRe r.2.re hlevelsB (by simpa [heq] using hdistRe)
      exact hzReNe (heq.trans hclose)
    have hneqC : z.im ≠ r.1.im := by
      intro heq
      have hclose := havoidIm r.1.im hlevelsC (by simpa [heq] using hdistIm)
      exact hzImNe (heq.trans hclose)
    have hneqD : z.im ≠ r.2.im := by
      intro heq
      have hclose := havoidIm r.2.im hlevelsD (by simpa [heq] using hdistIm)
      exact hzImNe (heq.trans hclose)
    have hnoA : ¬ (if west then z.re < r.1.re ∧ r.1.re < v.re
        else v.re < r.1.re ∧ r.1.re < z.re) := by
      cases west
      · simpa [min_eq_right hzSides.1.le, max_eq_left hzSides.1.le] using
          hNoRe r.1.re hlevelsA
      · simpa [min_eq_left hzSides.1.le, max_eq_right hzSides.1.le] using
          hNoRe r.1.re hlevelsA
    have hnoB : ¬ (if west then z.re < r.2.re ∧ r.2.re < v.re
        else v.re < r.2.re ∧ r.2.re < z.re) := by
      cases west
      · simpa [min_eq_right hzSides.1.le, max_eq_left hzSides.1.le] using
          hNoRe r.2.re hlevelsB
      · simpa [min_eq_left hzSides.1.le, max_eq_right hzSides.1.le] using
          hNoRe r.2.re hlevelsB
    have hnoC : ¬ (if south then z.im < r.1.im ∧ r.1.im < v.im
        else v.im < r.1.im ∧ r.1.im < z.im) := by
      cases south
      · simpa [min_eq_right hzSides.2.le, max_eq_left hzSides.2.le] using
          hNoIm r.1.im hlevelsC
      · simpa [min_eq_left hzSides.2.le, max_eq_right hzSides.2.le] using
          hNoIm r.1.im hlevelsC
    have hnoD : ¬ (if south then z.im < r.2.im ∧ r.2.im < v.im
        else v.im < r.2.im ∧ r.2.im < z.im) := by
      cases south
      · simpa [min_eq_right hzSides.2.le, max_eq_left hzSides.2.le] using
          hNoIm r.2.im hlevelsD
      · simpa [min_eq_left hzSides.2.le, max_eq_right hzSides.2.le] using
          hNoIm r.2.im hlevelsD
    have hRe : z.re ∈ Set.Icc r.1.re r.2.re ↔
        (if west then r.1.re < v.re ∧ v.re ≤ r.2.re
          else r.1.re ≤ v.re ∧ v.re < r.2.re) := by
      cases west
      · simpa using closedInterval_reachesEast hzSides.1 hneqA hnoA hnoB
      · simpa using closedInterval_reachesWest hzSides.1 hneqB hnoA hnoB
    have hIm : z.im ∈ Set.Icc r.1.im r.2.im ↔
        (if south then r.1.im < v.im ∧ v.im ≤ r.2.im
          else r.1.im ≤ v.im ∧ v.im < r.2.im) := by
      cases south
      · simpa using closedInterval_reachesEast hzSides.2 hneqC hnoC hnoD
      · simpa using closedInterval_reachesWest hzSides.2 hneqD hnoC hnoD
    have hcoordRect : z ∈ rectangle r.1 r.2 ↔
        z.re ∈ Set.Icc r.1.re r.2.re ∧ z.im ∈ Set.Icc r.1.im r.2.im := by
      simp [rectangle, p₁, p₂]
    rw [hcoordRect, hRe, hIm]
    rfl
  constructor
  · intro hzΩ
    rw [hR.2] at hzΩ
    have hzu : z ∈ ⋃ r ∈ R, rectangle r.1 r.2 := interior_subset hzΩ
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hzu
    obtain ⟨hr, hzrect⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hr
    exact ⟨r, hr, (hcoordinate r hr).mp hzrect⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, hreach⟩
    rw [hR.2]
    have hzrect : z ∈ rectangle r.1 r.2 := (hcoordinate r hr).mpr hreach
    have hcoordRect : z ∈ rectangle r.1 r.2 ↔
        z.re ∈ Set.Icc r.1.re r.2.re ∧ z.im ∈ Set.Icc r.1.im r.2.im := by
      simp [rectangle, p₁, p₂]
    have hlevelsA : r.1.re ∈ rectangleRealLevels R := by
      change r.1.re ∈ (R.toFinset.image (fun q => q.1.re)) ∪ _
      exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨r,
        List.mem_toFinset.mpr hr, rfl⟩)
    have hlevelsB : r.2.re ∈ rectangleRealLevels R := by
      change r.2.re ∈ _ ∪ (R.toFinset.image (fun q => q.2.re))
      exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨r,
        List.mem_toFinset.mpr hr, rfl⟩)
    have hlevelsC : r.1.im ∈ rectangleImagLevels R := by
      change r.1.im ∈ (R.toFinset.image (fun q => q.1.im)) ∪ _
      exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨r,
        List.mem_toFinset.mpr hr, rfl⟩)
    have hlevelsD : r.2.im ∈ rectangleImagLevels R := by
      change r.2.im ∈ _ ∪ (R.toFinset.image (fun q => q.2.im))
      exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨r,
        List.mem_toFinset.mpr hr, rfl⟩)
    have hneqA : z.re ≠ r.1.re := by
      intro heq
      have hclose := havoidRe r.1.re hlevelsA (by simpa [heq] using hdistRe)
      exact hzReNe (heq.trans hclose)
    have hneqB : z.re ≠ r.2.re := by
      intro heq
      have hclose := havoidRe r.2.re hlevelsB (by simpa [heq] using hdistRe)
      exact hzReNe (heq.trans hclose)
    have hneqC : z.im ≠ r.1.im := by
      intro heq
      have hclose := havoidIm r.1.im hlevelsC (by simpa [heq] using hdistIm)
      exact hzImNe (heq.trans hclose)
    have hneqD : z.im ≠ r.2.im := by
      intro heq
      have hclose := havoidIm r.2.im hlevelsD (by simpa [heq] using hdistIm)
      exact hzImNe (heq.trans hclose)
    have hinterior : z ∈ interior (rectangle r.1 r.2) := by
      have hstrict : z.re ∈ Set.Ioo r.1.re r.2.re ∧ z.im ∈ Set.Ioo r.1.im r.2.im := by
        have hclosed' : z.re ∈ Set.Icc r.1.re r.2.re ∧
            z.im ∈ Set.Icc r.1.im r.2.im := hcoordRect.mp hzrect
        rcases hclosed' with ⟨⟨hxl, hxu⟩, ⟨hyl, hyu⟩⟩
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp only [Set.mem_Ioo]
        · exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hxl (Ne.symm hneqA), lt_of_le_of_ne hxu hneqB⟩
        · exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hyl (Ne.symm hneqC), lt_of_le_of_ne hyu hneqD⟩
      change z ∈ interior
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.box (r.1.re, r.2.re) (r.1.im, r.2.im))
      rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.interior_box]
      change z.re ∈ Set.Ioo r.1.re r.2.re ∧ z.im ∈ Set.Ioo r.1.im r.2.im
      exact hstrict
    have hsub : rectangle r.1 r.2 ⊆ ⋃ q ∈ R, rectangle q.1 q.2 := by
      intro x hx
      exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨r, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hr, hx⟩⟩
    exact interior_mono hsub hinterior

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.quadrantOccupied_iff_setOccupiesQuadrant
statement:
theorem quadrantOccupied_iff_setOccupiesQuadrant
    {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane} (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (v : Plane) (west south : Bool) :
    quadrantOccupied R v west south ↔
      SetOccupiesQuadrant Ω v (rectangleQuadrant west south)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨εre, hεre, havoidRe⟩ :=
    exists_radius_avoiding_levels (rectangleRealLevels R) v.re
  obtain ⟨εim, hεim, havoidIm⟩ :=
    exists_radius_avoiding_levels (rectangleImagLevels R) v.im
  let ε := min εre εim
  have hε : 0 < ε := lt_min hεre hεim
  have havoidRe' : ∀ y ∈ rectangleRealLevels R, dist y v.re < ε → y = v.re := by
    intro y hy hyε
    exact havoidRe y hy (hyε.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))
  have havoidIm' : ∀ y ∈ rectangleImagLevels R, dist y v.im < ε → y = v.im := by
    intro y hy hyε
    exact havoidIm y hy (hyε.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, hreach⟩
    refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
    rintro z ⟨hzball, hzquad⟩
    exact (rectangle_mem_iff_quadrantOccupied_local hR v z west south
      havoidRe' havoidIm' hzball hzquad).2 ⟨r, hr, hreach⟩
  · intro hocc
    by_contra hnot
    have hnot' : ¬ quadrantOccupied R v west south := hnot
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hlocal⟩ := hocc
    let ρ' := min ρ ε
    have hρ' : 0 < ρ' := lt_min hρ hε
    obtain ⟨z, hzρ⟩ := quadrant_ball_nonempty hρ' (rectangleQuadrant west south)
    have hzball : z ∈ Metric.ball v ε :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right ρ ε) hzρ.1
    have hzquad : z ∈ quadrantAt (rectangleQuadrant west south) v := hzρ.2
    have hzΩ : z ∈ Ω := hlocal ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left ρ ε) hzρ.1,
      hzquad⟩
    exact hnot' ((rectangle_mem_iff_quadrantOccupied_local hR v z west south
      havoidRe' havoidIm' hzball hzquad).mp hzΩ)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.different_iff_bool_ne
proof:
:= by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [quadrantDifferent, hP, hQ]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.nonstraightPattern_iff_both_axis_changes
statement:
private theorem nonstraightPattern_iff_both_axis_changes (p : QuadrantPattern) :
    nonstraightPattern p ↔
      (p .northwest ≠ p .southwest ∨ p .northeast ≠ p .southeast) ∧
        (p .northwest ≠ p .northeast ∨ p .southwest ≠ p .southeast)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact nonstraightPattern_has_both_axis_changes p
  · intro h
    by_contra hnon
    have hstraight : straightPattern p := by
      simpa [nonstraightPattern] using hnon
    rcases hstraight with ⟨hSWSE, hNWNE⟩ | ⟨hSWNW, hSENE⟩
    · rcases h.2 with hNWNE' | hSWSE'
      · exact hNWNE' hNWNE
      · exact hSWSE' hSWSE
    · rcases h.1 with hNWSW | hNES
      · exact hNWSW hSWNW.symm
      · exact hNES hSENE.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.realizesRectangles_isAxisParallelTile
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨hR.1, R.toFinset, ?_⟩
  rw [hR.2]
  congr 1
  ext z
  simp [List.mem_toFinset]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.finite_segments_locallyAxisParallelPolygonal
statement:
private theorem finite_segments_locallyAxisParallelPolygonal
    {D : Set Plane}
    (E : Set (Plane × Plane)) (hE : E.Finite)
    (hshape : ∀ e ∈ E, e.1 ≠ e.2 ∧ (e.1.re = e.2.re ∨ e.1.im = e.2.im))
    (hfront : frontier D = ⋃ e ∈ E, segment ℝ e.1 e.2)
    (hopen : IsOpen D) (hregular : interior (closure D) = D) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.IsLocallyAxisParallelPolygonal D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G : Set (Set Plane) := (fun e : Plane × Plane => segment ℝ e.1 e.2) '' E
  have hGfinite : G.Finite := hE.image _
  have hsegments : ∀ g ∈ G, ∃ a b : Plane,
      a ≠ b ∧ (a.re = b.re ∨ a.im = b.im) ∧ g = segment ℝ a b := by
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := (Set.mem_image _ _ _).mp hg
    exact ⟨e.1, e.2, (hshape e he).1, (hshape e he).2, rfl⟩
  have hcover : frontier D = ⋃₀ G := by
    rw [hfront]
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨e, hz⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
      obtain ⟨he, hz⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
      exact Set.mem_sUnion.mpr ⟨segment ℝ e.1 e.2,
        (Set.mem_image _ _ _).mpr ⟨e, he, rfl⟩, hz⟩
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨g, hg, hzg⟩ := Set.mem_sUnion.mp hz
      obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := (Set.mem_image _ _ _).mp hg
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨he, hzg⟩⟩
  refine ⟨hopen, hregular, G, hsegments, hcover, ?_⟩
  intro Q _
  apply hGfinite.subset
  intro g hg
  exact hg.1

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.mem_vertices_iff_quadrantChanges
statement:
theorem mem_vertices_iff_quadrantChanges
    {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω) (v : Plane) :
    v ∈ vertices Ω ↔ hasBothAxisQuadrantChanges R v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hΩtile := realizesRectangles_isAxisParallelTile hR
  let K := regionOfTile Ω hΩtile
  let E := K.intrinsicBoundaryEdges
  have hE : E.Finite := K.intrinsicBoundaryEdges_finite
  have hshape : ∀ e ∈ E,
      e.1 ≠ e.2 ∧ (e.1.re = e.2.re ∨ e.1.im = e.2.im) :=
    fun e he => ⟨he.2.2.1, he.2.2.2.1⟩
  have hfront : frontier Ω = ⋃ e ∈ E, segment ℝ e.1 e.2 := by
    calc
      frontier Ω = frontier K.openCarrier := by simp [K, regionOfTile_openCarrier]
      _ = frontier K.support := K.frontier_openCarrier_eq_frontier_support
      _ = ⋃ e ∈ E, segment ℝ e.1 e.2 := K.frontier_eq_intrinsicBoundaryEdges
  have hpolygonal : Tiling.AxisParallel.IsLocallyAxisParallelPolygonal Ω :=
    finite_segments_locallyAxisParallelPolygonal E hE hshape hfront
      hΩtile.isOpen hΩtile.isRegularOpen
  have hvertices : v ∈ vertices Ω ↔ Tiling.AxisParallel.IsProperVertex Ω v := by
    rw [vertices_eq_native Ω hΩtile]
    rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.region_vertices_eq_nonStraightBoundary K]
    simp [K, regionOfTile_openCarrier, Tiling.AxisParallel.IsProperVertex,
      Tiling.Polygonal.IsProperVertex]
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, p, hgerm, hoccupies⟩ :=
    exists_quadrantPattern_germ hΩtile.isOpen hΩtile.isRegularOpen hpolygonal v
  have hproper := properVertex_iff_nonstraightPattern
    hΩtile.isOpen hΩtile.isRegularOpen hρ p hgerm
  have hOcc (west south : Bool) :
      p (rectangleQuadrant west south) = true ↔ quadrantOccupied R v west south := by
    rw [hoccupies]
    exact (quadrantOccupied_iff_setOccupiesQuadrant hR v west south).symm
  have hchanges : hasBothAxisQuadrantChanges R v ↔
      (p .northwest ≠ p .southwest ∨ p .northeast ≠ p .southeast) ∧
        (p .northwest ≠ p .northeast ∨ p .southwest ≠ p .southeast) := by
    unfold hasBothAxisQuadrantChanges
    exact and_congr
      (or_congr
        (by simpa [rectangleQuadrant] using
          different_iff_bool_ne (hOcc true false).symm (hOcc true true).symm)
        (by simpa [rectangleQuadrant] using
          different_iff_bool_ne (hOcc false false).symm (hOcc false true).symm))
      (or_congr
        (by simpa [rectangleQuadrant] using
          different_iff_bool_ne (hOcc true false).symm (hOcc false false).symm)
        (by simpa [rectangleQuadrant] using
          different_iff_bool_ne (hOcc true true).symm (hOcc false true).symm))
  calc
    v ∈ vertices Ω ↔ Tiling.AxisParallel.IsProperVertex Ω v := hvertices
    _ ↔ nonstraightPattern p := hproper
    _ ↔ (p .northwest ≠ p .southwest ∨ p .northeast ≠ p .southeast) ∧
        (p .northwest ≠ p .northeast ∨ p .southwest ≠ p .southeast) :=
      nonstraightPattern_iff_both_axis_changes p
    _ ↔ hasBothAxisQuadrantChanges R v := hchanges.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.vertex_real_coordinate_mem_rectangleLevels
statement:
theorem vertex_real_coordinate_mem_rectangleLevels
    {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω) {v : Plane} (hv : v ∈ vertices Ω) :
    v.re ∈ rectangleRealLevels R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [mem_vertices_iff_quadrantChanges hR] at hv
  by_contra hnot
  have hneqLo (r : Plane × Plane) (hr : r ∈ R) : r.1.re ≠ v.re := by
    intro heq
    have hmem : r.1.re ∈ rectangleRealLevels R := by
      change r.1.re ∈ (R.toFinset.image (fun q => q.1.re)) ∪ _
      exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨r,
        List.mem_toFinset.mpr hr, rfl⟩)
    apply hnot
    rw [← heq]
    exact hmem
  have hneqHi (r : Plane × Plane) (hr : r ∈ R) : r.2.re ≠ v.re := by
    intro heq
    have hmem : r.2.re ∈ rectangleRealLevels R := by
      change r.2.re ∈ _ ∪ (R.toFinset.image (fun q => q.2.re))
      exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨r,
        List.mem_toFinset.mpr hr, rfl⟩)
    apply hnot
    rw [← heq]
    exact hmem
  have hsame (south : Bool) :
      quadrantOccupied R v true south = quadrantOccupied R v false south := by
    apply propext
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨r, hr, hreach⟩
      cases south <;> simp only [rectangleReachesQuadrant, Bool.false_eq_true,
        ↓reduceIte] at hreach ⊢
      · rcases hreach with ⟨⟨hlo, hhi⟩, hy⟩
        exact ⟨r, hr, ⟨⟨hlo.le, lt_of_le_of_ne hhi (hneqHi r hr).symm⟩, hy⟩⟩
      · rcases hreach with ⟨⟨hlo, hhi⟩, hy⟩
        exact ⟨r, hr, ⟨⟨hlo.le, lt_of_le_of_ne hhi (hneqHi r hr).symm⟩, hy⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨r, hr, hreach⟩
      cases south <;> simp only [rectangleReachesQuadrant, Bool.false_eq_true,
        ↓reduceIte] at hreach ⊢
      · rcases hreach with ⟨⟨hlo, hhi⟩, hy⟩
        exact ⟨r, hr, ⟨⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hlo (hneqLo r hr), hhi.le⟩, hy⟩⟩
      · rcases hreach with ⟨⟨hlo, hhi⟩, hy⟩
        exact ⟨r, hr, ⟨⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hlo (hneqLo r hr), hhi.le⟩, hy⟩⟩
  have hNWNE : quadrantOccupied R v true false =
      quadrantOccupied R v false false := hsame false
  have hSWSE : quadrantOccupied R v true true =
      quadrantOccupied R v false true := hsame true
  rcases hv.2 with hNW | hSW
  · simp [quadrantDifferent, hNWNE] at hNW
  · simp [quadrantDifferent, hSWSE] at hSW

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.isRectangleTile_of_axis_parallel_boundary
statement:
theorem isRectangleTile_of_axis_parallel_boundary
    (Ω : Set Plane) (hne : Ω.Nonempty) (hbounded : IsBounded Ω)
    (hregular : IsRegularOpen Ω) (edges : Finset (Plane × Plane))
    (hedge : ∀ e ∈ edges, p₁ e.1 = p₁ e.2 ∨ p₂ e.1 = p₂ e.2)
    (hfront : frontier Ω = ⋃ e ∈ edges, segment ℝ e.1 e.2) :
    IsRectangleTile Ω
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s := edges.image fun e => e.1.re
  let t := edges.image fun e => e.1.im
  have hlines : ∀ z ∈ frontier Ω, z.re ∈ s ∨ z.im ∈ t := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hfront] at hz
    obtain ⟨e, hz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
    obtain ⟨he, hz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
    rcases hedge e he with hre | him
    · have hzre : z.re = e.1.re :=
        (convex_hyperplane Complex.reLm.isLinear e.1.re).segment_subset
          rfl hre.symm hz
      exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨e, he, hzre.symm⟩)
    · have hzim : z.im = e.1.im :=
        (convex_hyperplane Complex.imLm.isLinear e.1.im).segment_subset
          rfl him.symm hz
      exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨e, he, hzim.symm⟩)
  have hopen : IsOpen Ω := hregular ▸ isOpen_interior
  have haxis := Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.rectangulation_of_grid
    hopen hbounded s t hlines
  let K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region := {
    support := closure Ω
    isPolygonal := Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.isPolygonal_of_isAxisParallel haxis
    nonempty := hne.mono subset_closure
    isAxisParallel := haxis }
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.region_rectangle_presentation K
  exact ⟨hne, F, hregular.symm.trans (congrArg interior hF)⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.e₁_eq_one
statement: private theorem e₁_eq_one : e₁ = (1 : Plane)
proof:
:= by

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.e₂_eq_I
statement: private theorem e₂_eq_I : e₂ = Complex.I
proof:
