name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.cylinder_regularOpen
statement:
private theorem cylinder_regularOpen {X : Set ℝ} (hX : IsRegularOpen X) :
    IsRegularOpen (p₁ ⁻¹' X)
proof:
:= by
  change interior (closure (Complex.re ⁻¹' X)) = Complex.re ⁻¹' X
  rw [Complex.closure_preimage_re, Complex.interior_preimage_re, hX]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.native_support_period
statement:
private theorem native_support_period (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region)
    (S : Set Plane) (β : ℝ)
    (hperiod : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport K S) (β : Plane)) :
    IsPeriod (coveredRegion K.openCarrier S) (β • e₁)
proof:
:= by
  have hvector : β • e₁ = (β : Plane) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [e₁]
  rw [Columns.coveredRegion_openCarrier, hvector, isPeriod_iff_membership]
  exact hperiod

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.exists_minimal_tiling_in_hull
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_tiling_in_hull
    (Ω : Set Plane) (hΩ : IsRectangleTile Ω)
    (X : Set ℝ) (_hX : X.Nonempty) (hXregular : IsRegularOpen X)
    (β : ℝ) (_hβ : 0 < β) (_hperiod : β +ᵥ X = X)
    (T : Set Plane) (hT : TilingOn (p₁ ⁻¹' X) Ω T) :
    ∃ S ∈ orbitHull (p₁ ⁻¹' X) T,
      TilingOn (p₁ ⁻¹' X) Ω S ∧
      IsMinimal (p₁ ⁻¹' X) S
proof:
:= by
  let K := regionOfTile Ω hΩ
  have hNative : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T (p₁ ⁻¹' X) :=
    (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ _ T).mp hT
  let U : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K (p₁ ⁻¹' X) :=
    ⟨⟨T, Fell.tilesOn_centres_isClosed hNative⟩, hNative⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hHull, hMinimal⟩ := Fell.exists_minimal_hull_point
    (cylinder_regularOpen hXregular) U
  exact ⟨V.centres, hHull, (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ _ _).mpr V.tilesOn, hMinimal⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.earthquake_decomposition
statement:
theorem earthquake_decomposition
    (Ω : Set Plane) (hΩ : IsRectangleTile Ω)
    (T : Set Plane) (hT : Tiles Ω T)
    (v : Plane) (hv : v ∈ ({e₁, e₂} : Set Plane)) :
    columnPart Ω v T ∪ ⋃₀ tectonicPlates Ω v T = T ∧
      Disjoint (columnPart Ω v T) (⋃₀ tectonicPlates Ω v T) ∧
      (tectonicPlates Ω v T).Pairwise Disjoint
proof:
:= by
  have hNative := (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ Set.univ T).mp hT
  rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hv with hv | hv
  · subst v
    simpa only [regionOfTile_openCarrier, e₁_eq_one, e₂_eq_I] using
      Columns.horizontal_decomposition hNative
  · have hv := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hv
    subst v
    simpa only [regionOfTile_openCarrier, e₁_eq_one, e₂_eq_I] using
      Columns.vertical_decomposition hNative

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.finitely_many_tectonic_plates
statement:
theorem finitely_many_tectonic_plates
    (Ω : Set Plane) (hΩ : IsRectangleTile Ω)
    (T : Set Plane) (hT : Tiles Ω T)
    (v : Plane) (hv : v ∈ ({e₁, e₂} : Set Plane)) :
    (tectonicPlates Ω v T).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hNative := (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ Set.univ T).mp hT
  rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hv with hv | hv
  · subst v
    simpa only [regionOfTile_openCarrier, e₁_eq_one, e₂_eq_I] using
      Columns.horizontal_tectonicPlates_finite hNative
  · have hv := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hv
    subst v
    simpa only [regionOfTile_openCarrier, e₁_eq_one, e₂_eq_I] using
      Columns.vertical_tectonicPlates_finite hNative

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.earthquake_slabs_periodic
statement:
theorem earthquake_slabs_periodic
    (Ω : Set Plane) (hΩ : IsRectangleTile Ω)
    (X : Set ℝ) (hX : X.Nonempty) (hXregular : IsRegularOpen X)
    (β₀ : ℝ) (hβ₀ : 0 < β₀) (hperiod : β₀ +ᵥ X = X)
    (T : Set Plane) (hT : TilingOn (p₁ ⁻¹' X) Ω T)
    (hcomplexity : HasFiniteLocalComplexity (p₁ '' T)) :
    ∃ β : ℝ, 0 < β ∧
      IsPeriod (coveredRegion Ω (columnPart Ω e₂ T)) (β • e₁) ∧
      ∀ P ∈ tectonicPlates Ω e₂ T, IsPeriod (coveredRegion Ω P) (β • e₁)
proof:
:= by
  let K := regionOfTile Ω hΩ
  let Y := periodicCarrier X hX hXregular β₀ hβ₀ hperiod
  have hNative : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T Y.carrier :=
    (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ _ T).mp hT
  have hFHC : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity T :=
    hasFiniteLocalComplexity_iff_hasFLC.mp hcomplexity
  obtain ⟨β, hβ, hPlates, hColumns⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.continuousPeriodicCarrierPlate_periodic Y hNative hFHC
  have hColumnEq : columnPart Ω e₂ T =
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalColumnCentres K T := by
    simpa only [K, regionOfTile_openCarrier, e₁_eq_one, e₂_eq_I] using
      Columns.columnPart_eq_verticalColumnCentres_relative hNative hXregular
  have hPlateEq : tectonicPlates Ω e₂ T =
      (@Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate.centres K T) ''
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.nonColumnVerticalPlates K T := by
    simpa only [K, regionOfTile_openCarrier, e₁_eq_one, e₂_eq_I] using
      Columns.tectonicPlates_eq_nonColumn_relative hNative hXregular
  refine ⟨β, hβ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hColumnEq]
    simpa only [K, regionOfTile_openCarrier, e₁_eq_one, e₂_eq_I] using
      native_support_period K _ β hColumns
  · intro P hP
    rw [hPlateEq] at hP
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩ := hP
    simpa only [K, regionOfTile_openCarrier, e₁_eq_one, e₂_eq_I] using
      native_support_period K Q.centres β (hPlates Q hQ)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.proper_cylinder_finite_horizontal_complexity
statement:
theorem proper_cylinder_finite_horizontal_complexity
    (Ω : Set Plane) (hΩ : IsRectangleTile Ω)
    (X : Set ℝ) (hX : X.Nonempty) (hXregular : IsRegularOpen X) (hproper : X ≠ univ)
    (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) (hperiod : β +ᵥ X = X)
    (T : Set Plane) (hT : TilingOn (p₁ ⁻¹' X) Ω T) :
    HasFiniteLocalComplexity (p₁ '' T)
proof:
:= by
  let K := regionOfTile Ω hΩ
  let Y := periodicCarrier X hX hXregular β hβ hperiod
  have hNative : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T Y.carrier :=
    (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ _ T).mp hT
  exact hasFiniteLocalComplexity_iff_hasFLC.mpr
    (Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.properCarrier_hasFiniteHorizontalComplexity Y hproper hNative)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.base_period_membership
statement:
private theorem base_period_membership {X : Set ℝ} {β : ℝ}
    (hperiod : β +ᵥ X = X) : ∀ x : ℝ, x + β ∈ X ↔ x ∈ X
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have hmem := congrArg (fun S : Set ℝ => β + x ∈ S) hperiod
  simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hmem.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.split_adapter
proof:
:= by
  cases ho : D.orientation with
  | vertical =>
    refine ⟨e₂, by simp, D.persistent, D.transient, fun _ => rfl,
      hp, ht, D.disjoint, D.union_eq, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [e₂_eq_I, Columns.invariant_iff_verticalSlab]
      exact ⟨D.persistentBase, D.persistentBase_regular.symm,
        D.persistentSupport_vertical ho⟩
    · rw [e₂_eq_I, Columns.invariant_iff_verticalSlab]
      exact ⟨D.transientBase, D.transientBase_regular.symm,
        D.transientSupport_vertical ho⟩
  | horizontal =>
    refine ⟨e₁, by simp, D.persistent, D.transient, ?_,
      hp, ht, D.disjoint, D.union_eq, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hproper
      exact (hproper (D.horizontal_requires_plane ho)).elim
    · rw [Columns.coveredRegion_openCarrier]
      have hinv := (Tiling.AxisParallel.horizontalInvariant_iff_product
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport K D.persistent)).mpr
          ⟨D.persistentBase, D.persistentSupport_horizontal ho⟩
      simpa only [IsInvariantAlong, IsPeriod, e₁_eq_one, Complex.real_smul,
        mul_one] using hinv
    · rw [Columns.coveredRegion_openCarrier]
      have hinv := (Tiling.AxisParallel.horizontalInvariant_iff_product
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport K D.transient)).mpr
          ⟨D.transientBase, D.transientSupport_horizontal ho⟩
      simpa only [IsInvariantAlong, IsPeriod, e₁_eq_one, Complex.real_smul,
        mul_one] using hinv

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.non_flc_earthquake_limit
statement:
theorem non_flc_earthquake_limit
    (Ω : Set Plane) (hΩ : IsRectangleTile Ω)
    (X : Set ℝ) (hX : X.Nonempty) (hXregular : IsRegularOpen X)
    (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) (hperiod : β +ᵥ X = X)
    (T : Set Plane) (hT : TilingOn (p₁ ⁻¹' X) Ω T)
    (hFLC : ¬ HasFiniteLocalComplexity T) :
    ∃ S ∈ orbitHull (p₁ ⁻¹' X) T,
      TilingOn (p₁ ⁻¹' X) Ω S ∧
      ∃ v ∈ ({e₁, e₂} : Set Plane), ∃ S₀ S₁,
        (X ≠ univ → v = e₂) ∧ IsEarthquakeSplit Ω S S₀ S₁ v
proof:
:= by
  let K := regionOfTile Ω hΩ
  have hNative : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T (p₁ ⁻¹' X) :=
    (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ _ T).mp hT
  let U : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K (p₁ ⁻¹' X) :=
    ⟨⟨T, Fell.tilesOn_centres_isClosed hNative⟩, hNative⟩
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.exists_nontrivialEarthquakeOrbitLimit
    hX (isRegularOpen_isOpen hXregular) hXregular hβ (base_period_membership hperiod)
    U (fun h => hFLC (hasFiniteLocalComplexity_iff_hasFLC.mpr h))
  have hHull := D.limit_mem_hull
  rw [Fell.production_hull_eq_preimage
    (isRegularOpen_isOpen (cylinder_regularOpen hXregular))
    (cylinder_regularOpen hXregular) U] at hHull
  refine ⟨D.limit.centres, hHull, (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ _ _).mpr D.limit.tilesOn, ?_⟩
  simpa only [K, regionOfTile_openCarrier] using
    split_adapter D.split D.persistent_nonempty D.transient_nonempty

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.non_flc_earthquake_limit_in_lattice
statement:
theorem non_flc_earthquake_limit_in_lattice
    (Ω : Set Plane) (hΩ : IsRectangleTile Ω)
    (X : Set ℝ) (hX : X.Nonempty) (hXregular : IsRegularOpen X)
    (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) (hperiod : β +ᵥ X = X)
    (T : Set Plane) (hT : TilingOn (p₁ ⁻¹' X) Ω T)
    (hFLC : ¬ HasFiniteLocalComplexity T)
    (p q : Plane) (hpq : LinearIndependent ℝ ![p, q])
    (hp : IsPeriod (p₁ ⁻¹' X) p) (hq : IsPeriod (p₁ ⁻¹' X) q) :
    ∃ S ∈ orbitHullUnder (span ℤ {p, q} : Set Plane) T,
      TilingOn (p₁ ⁻¹' X) Ω S ∧
      ∃ v ∈ ({e₁, e₂} : Set Plane), ∃ S₀ S₁,
        (X ≠ univ → v = e₂) ∧ IsEarthquakeSplit Ω S S₀ S₁ v
proof:
:= by
  let K := regionOfTile Ω hΩ
  have hNative : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T (p₁ ⁻¹' X) :=
    (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ _ T).mp hT
  let U : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K (p₁ ⁻¹' X) :=
    ⟨⟨T, Fell.tilesOn_centres_isClosed hNative⟩, hNative⟩
  let L : Tiling.AxisParallel.PlanarLattice := ⟨![p, q], hpq⟩
  have hRange : Set.range L.basis = ({p, q} : Set Plane) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i <;> simp [L]
    · intro hz
      rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hz with hz | hz
      · exact ⟨0, hz.symm⟩
      · exact ⟨1, (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz).symm⟩
  have hLattice : L.toAddSubgroup = (span ℤ {p, q}).toAddSubgroup := by
    rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.PlanarLattice.toAddSubgroup,
      Tiling.Polygonal.PlanarLattice.toAddSubgroup, hRange,
      Submodule.span_int_eq_addSubgroupClosure]
  have hL : L.toAddSubgroup ≤ Tiling.AxisParallel.aePeriodGroup (p₁ ⁻¹' X) := by
    apply (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).mpr
    rintro z ⟨i, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i
    · exact (Fell.period_bridge
        (isRegularOpen_isOpen (cylinder_regularOpen hXregular))
        (cylinder_regularOpen hXregular) p).mpr hp
    · exact (Fell.period_bridge
        (isRegularOpen_isOpen (cylinder_regularOpen hXregular))
        (cylinder_regularOpen hXregular) q).mpr hq
  obtain ⟨D, lambda, gamma, D', hlambda, _hHull, hconv, hp', ht'⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.exists_nontrivialEarthquakeOrbitLimit_latticeTranslations
      hX (isRegularOpen_isOpen hXregular) hXregular hβ (base_period_membership hperiod)
      U (fun h => hFLC (hasFiniteLocalComplexity_iff_hasFLC.mpr h)) L hL
  let V := Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate gamma D.limit
  have hseq : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.centresSequence
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translateSequence lambda U) =
        (fun n => (lambda n : Plane) +ᵥ T) := by
    funext n
    exact Fell.centres_translation (lambda n) U
  rw [hseq] at hconv
  have hHull := Fell.mem_orbitHullUnder_of_locallyFellConverges
    (G := (span ℤ {p, q} : Set Plane)) (T := T)
    (fun n => (lambda n : Plane))
    (fun n => by
      change (lambda n : Plane) ∈ (span ℤ {p, q}).toAddSubgroup
      rw [← hLattice]
      exact hlambda n) V.centres hconv
  refine ⟨V.centres, hHull, (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ _ _).mpr V.tilesOn, ?_⟩
  simpa only [K, regionOfTile_openCarrier] using split_adapter D' hp' ht'

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.non_flc_finite_horizontal_complexity_limit
statement:
theorem non_flc_finite_horizontal_complexity_limit
    (Ω : Set Plane) (hΩ : IsRectangleTile Ω)
    (T : Set Plane) (hT : Tiles Ω T) (hFLC : ¬ HasFiniteLocalComplexity T) :
    ∃ S ∈ orbitHull univ T,
      Tiles Ω S ∧
      ((HasFiniteLocalComplexity (p₁ '' S) ∧
          (S : Set Plane) ∉ tectonicPlates Ω e₂ S) ∨
       (HasFiniteLocalComplexity (p₂ '' S) ∧
          (S : Set Plane) ∉ tectonicPlates Ω e₁ S))
proof:
:= by
  let K := regionOfTile Ω hΩ
  have hNative : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T Set.univ :=
    (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ _ T).mp hT
  let U : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ :=
    ⟨⟨T, Fell.tilesOn_centres_isClosed hNative⟩, hNative⟩
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.exists_finiteHorizontalComplexityTrichotomy
    U (fun h => hFLC (hasFiniteLocalComplexity_iff_hasFLC.mpr h))
  have hHull := D.limit_mem_hull
  rw [Fell.production_hull_eq_preimage isOpen_univ
    (by simp : interior (closure (Set.univ : Set Plane)) = Set.univ) U] at hHull
  refine ⟨D.limit.centres, hHull, (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ _ _).mpr D.limit.tilesOn, ?_⟩
  cases ho : D.orientation with
  | vertical =>
    refine Or.inl ⟨hasFiniteLocalComplexity_iff_hasFLC.mpr
      (D.finiteHorizontal_original ho), ?_⟩
    intro hmem
    have hEq := Columns.tectonicPlates_eq_nonColumn D.limit.tilesOn
    have hmem' : (D.limit.centres : Set Plane) ∈
        tectonicPlates K.openCarrier Complex.I D.limit.centres := by
      simpa only [K, regionOfTile_openCarrier, e₂_eq_I] using hmem
    rw [hEq] at hmem'
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hPcentres⟩ := hmem'
    exact D.nontrivialVertical_original ho ⟨P, hP, hPcentres⟩
  | horizontal =>
    have hproj : Complex.re '' (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap ''
        (D.limit.centres : Set Plane)) = p₂ '' (D.limit.centres : Set Plane) := by
      rw [Set.image_image]
      rfl
    have hFHC := D.finiteHorizontal_swapped ho
    change Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC (Complex.re ''
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' (D.limit.centres : Set Plane))) at hFHC
    rw [hproj] at hFHC
    refine Or.inr ⟨hasFiniteLocalComplexity_iff_hasFLC.mpr hFHC, ?_⟩
    intro hmem
    have hmem' : (D.limit.centres : Set Plane) ∈
        tectonicPlates K.openCarrier 1 D.limit.centres := by
      simpa only [K, regionOfTile_openCarrier, e₁_eq_one] using hmem
    have hswap := (Columns.tectonic_mem_coordinateSwap_horizontal K
      D.limit.centres D.limit.centres).mp hmem'
    rw [Columns.tectonicPlates_eq_nonColumn (D.swapped_tilesOn ho)] at hswap
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hPcentres⟩ := hswap
    exact D.nontrivialVertical_swapped ho ⟨P, hP, hPcentres⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.packing_openCarrier_iff
statement:
theorem packing_openCarrier_iff (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region) (T : Set Plane) :
    Packing K.openCarrier T ↔
      Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint]
  constructor
  · intro h s hs t ht hst
    apply Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mpr
    apply Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp
    intro hne
    have hopen := ((K.openCarrier_regularOpen).1.vadd s).inter
      ((K.openCarrier_regularOpen).1.vadd t)
    exact hopen.measure_ne_zero volume hne (h hs ht hst)
  · intro h s hs t ht hst
    change volume ((s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ (t +ᵥ K.openCarrier)) = 0
    rw [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp (h hs ht hst), measure_empty]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.tilingOn_openCarrier_iff
statement:
theorem tilingOn_openCarrier_iff (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region) (E T : Set Plane) :
    TilingOn E K.openCarrier T ↔ Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T E
proof:
:= by
  rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.tilesOn_iff_multiplicity]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hc, hp, he⟩
    refine ⟨hc, (packing_openCarrier_iff K T).mp hp, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [he] with z hz
    change (z ∈ E) = (z ∈ T +ᵥ K.openCarrier) at hz
    rw [hz]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, ht, u, hu, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, u, hu, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨t, u, hu, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨t, t.2, u, hu, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hc, hp, he⟩
    refine ⟨hc, (packing_openCarrier_iff K T).mpr hp, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [he] with z hz
    apply propext
    change z ∈ E ↔ z ∈ T +ᵥ K.openCarrier
    rw [hz]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, u, hu, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨t, t.2, u, hu, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨t, ht, u, hu, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, u, hu, rfl⟩

    TilingOn E Ω T ↔ Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn (regionOfTile Ω hΩ) T E
proof:
:= by
  simpa using tilingOn_openCarrier_iff (regionOfTile Ω hΩ) E T

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.close_vertex_edge
statement:
private theorem close_vertex_edge (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region)
    (axis : Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis) {v : Plane} (hv : v ∈ K.vertices)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ z ∈ frontier K.openCarrier ∩ Metric.ball v ε,
      axis.coord z ≠ axis.coord v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hne, halign, hseg⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.intrinsicVertex_incident_axisEdge K axis ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hvcl : v ∈ closure (openSegment ℝ v w.1) := by
    rw [closure_openSegment]
    exact left_mem_segment ℝ _ _
  obtain ⟨z, hzball, hzseg⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hvcl
    (Metric.ball v ε) Metric.isOpen_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hε)
  have hzfront : z ∈ frontier K.openCarrier := by
    rw [K.frontier_openCarrier_eq_frontier_support]
    exact (hseg hzseg).1
  have hzv : z ≠ v := by
    intro heq
    rw [heq] at hzseg
    exact hne (left_mem_openSegment_iff.mp hzseg).symm
  refine ⟨z, ⟨hzfront, hzball⟩, ?_⟩
  cases axis with
  | horizontal =>
    have him : z.im = v.im :=
      (convex_hyperplane Complex.imLm.isLinear v.im).segment_subset
        rfl halign (openSegment_subset_segment ℝ _ _ hzseg)
    exact fun hre => hzv (Complex.ext hre him)
  | vertical =>
    have hre : z.re = v.re :=
      (convex_hyperplane Complex.reLm.isLinear v.re).segment_subset
        rfl halign (openSegment_subset_segment ℝ _ _ hzseg)
    exact fun him => hzv (Complex.ext hre him)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.vertices_openCarrier_eq
statement:
theorem vertices_openCarrier_eq (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region) :
    vertices K.openCarrier = K.vertices
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hvfront, hvε⟩
    by_contra hv
    have hvfront' : v ∈ frontier K.support :=
      K.frontier_openCarrier_eq_frontier_support ▸ hvfront
    obtain ⟨L, hvL, hdim, hlocal⟩ :=
      K.isPolygonal.boundaryLocallyStraightAt_of_not_mem_vertexSet hvfront' hv
    obtain ⟨d, hd, r, hr, hline⟩ :=
      Tiling.AffineSubspace.exists_ball_frontier_iff_affineLine hvL hdim hlocal
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hcross⟩ := K.isAxisParallel.localBoundaryCross v
    obtain ⟨⟨a, ⟨hafront, haball⟩, hare⟩, ⟨b, ⟨hbfront, hbball⟩, hbim⟩⟩ :=
      hvε (min r q) (lt_min hr hq)
    have har := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left r q) haball
    have haq := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right r q) haball
    have hbr := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left r q) hbball
    have hbq := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right r q) hbball
    have hafront' : a ∈ frontier K.support :=
      K.frontier_openCarrier_eq_frontier_support ▸ hafront
    have hbfront' : b ∈ frontier K.support :=
      K.frontier_openCarrier_eq_frontier_support ▸ hbfront
    have haim := (hcross a haq hafront').resolve_left hare
    have hbre := (hcross b hbq hbfront').resolve_right hbim
    have haL := Tiling.mem_affineLine.mp ((hline a har).mp hafront')
    have hbL := Tiling.mem_affineLine.mp ((hline b hbr).mp hbfront')
    have hdmul : d.im * (a.re - v.re) = 0 := by
      dsimp [Tiling.signedSide, Tiling.planarCross] at haL
      rw [haim] at haL
      linarith
    have hdimmul : d.re * (b.im - v.im) = 0 := by
      dsimp [Tiling.signedSide, Tiling.planarCross] at hbL
      rw [hbre] at hbL
      linarith
    have hdimzero : d.im = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp hdmul).resolve_right (sub_ne_zero.mpr hare)
    have hdrezero : d.re = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp hdimmul).resolve_right (sub_ne_zero.mpr hbim)
    exact hd (Complex.ext hdrezero hdimzero)
  · intro hv
    refine ⟨Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.region_vertices_subset_frontier K hv, ?_⟩
    intro ε hε
    exact ⟨close_vertex_edge K .horizontal hv hε, close_vertex_edge K .vertical hv hε⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.vertices_eq_native
statement:
theorem vertices_eq_native (Ω : Set Plane) (hΩ : IsRectangleTile Ω) :
    vertices Ω = (regionOfTile Ω hΩ).vertices
proof:
:= by
  simpa using vertices_openCarrier_eq (regionOfTile Ω hΩ)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.isDoublyPeriodic_iff_isLatticePeriodic
statement:
theorem isDoublyPeriodic_iff_isLatticePeriodic (A : Set Plane) :
    IsDoublyPeriodic A ↔ Tiling.Polygonal.IsLatticePeriodic A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, q, hind, hp, hq⟩
    let L : Tiling.Polygonal.PlanarLattice := ⟨![p, q], hind⟩
    refine ⟨L, ?_⟩
    apply (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).mpr
    rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i
    · exact (isPeriod_iff_mem_periodGroup A p).mp hp
    · exact (isPeriod_iff_mem_periodGroup A q).mp hq
  · rintro ⟨L, hL⟩
    have hbasis : ![L.basis 0, L.basis 1] = L.basis := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    refine ⟨L.basis 0, L.basis 1, hbasis.symm ▸ L.independent, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (isPeriod_iff_mem_periodGroup A _).mpr
        (hL (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self 0)))
    · exact (isPeriod_iff_mem_periodGroup A _).mpr
        (hL (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self 1)))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.isPeriod_iff_setPeriodicBy
statement:
theorem isPeriod_iff_setPeriodicBy (A : Set Plane) (p : Plane) :
    IsPeriod A p ↔ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy A p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp x
    have hmem := congrArg (fun S : Set Plane => p + x ∈ S) hp
    simpa [IsPeriod, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
      add_comm] using hmem.symm
  · intro hp
    apply Set.ext
    intro x
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simpa [vadd_eq_add] using (hp (-p + x)).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.weaklyPeriodic_iff_production
statement:
theorem weaklyPeriodic_iff_production (A : Set Plane) :
    WeaklyPeriodic A ↔ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.WeaklyPeriodic A
proof:
:= by
  rw [WeaklyPeriodic]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P, hperiod⟩
    classical
    let part : Fin P.parts.card → Set Plane := enumerate P.parts
    have hmem : ∀ i, part i ∈ P.parts := fun i => enumerate_mem P.parts i
    have hnonempty : ∀ i, (part i).Nonempty := fun i =>
      finpartitionParts_nonempty P (part i) (hmem i)
    have hdis : Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ part := by
      intro i _ j _ hij
      exact P.disjoint (hmem i) (hmem j) (fun heq => hij (enumerate_injective P.parts heq))
    have hcover : (⋃ i, part i) = A := by
      rw [iUnion_enumerate]
      simpa only [Finset.sup_id_set_eq_sUnion] using P.sup_parts
    choose period hne hp using fun i => hperiod (part i) (hmem i)
    refine ⟨⟨P.parts.card, part, period, hne, ?_, hdis, hcover⟩⟩
    intro i
    exact (isPeriod_iff_setPeriodicBy (part i) (period i)).mp (hp i)
  · rintro ⟨D⟩
    refine ⟨finpartitionOfIndexed D.part D.pairwiseDisjoint D.iUnion_parts, ?_⟩
    intro S hS
    classical
    have hS' : S ∈ nonemptyPieces D.part := by
      rw [← finpartitionOfIndexed_parts D.part D.pairwiseDisjoint D.iUnion_parts]
      exact hS
    obtain ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, _⟩ := (mem_nonemptyPieces D.part S).mp hS'
    subst S
    exact ⟨D.period i, D.period_ne_zero i,
      (isPeriod_iff_setPeriodicBy (D.part i) (D.period i)).mpr (D.periodic_part i)⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.quasiPeriodic_iff_production
statement:
theorem quasiPeriodic_iff_production (A : Set Plane) :
    QuasiPeriodic A ↔ Tiling.Polygonal.IsQuasiPeriodic A
proof:
:= by
  rw [QuasiPeriodic]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P, hperiod⟩
    classical
    let part : Fin P.parts.card → Set Plane := enumerate P.parts
    have hmem : ∀ i, part i ∈ P.parts := fun i => enumerate_mem P.parts i
    have hnonempty : ∀ i, (part i).Nonempty := fun i =>
      finpartitionParts_nonempty P (part i) (hmem i)
    have hdis : Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ part := by
      intro i _ j _ hij
      exact P.disjoint (hmem i) (hmem j) (fun heq => hij (enumerate_injective P.parts heq))
    have hcover : (⋃ i, part i) = A := by
      rw [iUnion_enumerate]
      simpa only [Finset.sup_id_set_eq_sUnion] using P.sup_parts
    refine ⟨P.parts.card, part, ?_, hdis, hcover⟩
    intro i
    exact ⟨hnonempty i,
      (isDoublyPeriodic_iff_isLatticePeriodic _).mp (hperiod (part i) (hmem i))⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, part, hperiod, hdis, hcover⟩
    refine ⟨finpartitionOfIndexed part hdis hcover, ?_⟩
    intro S hS
    classical
    have hS' : S ∈ nonemptyPieces part := by
      rw [← finpartitionOfIndexed_parts part hdis hcover]
      exact hS
    obtain ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, _⟩ := (mem_nonemptyPieces part S).mp hS'
    subst S
    exact (isDoublyPeriodic_iff_isLatticePeriodic _).mpr (hperiod i).2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.real_period_membership
statement:
private theorem real_period_membership {X : Set ℝ} {β : ℝ}
    (hperiod : β +ᵥ X = X) : ∀ x, x + β ∈ X ↔ x ∈ X
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have hmem := congrArg (fun A : Set ℝ => β + x ∈ A) hperiod
  simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hmem.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.structure_of_indexed
statement:
private theorem structure_of_indexed (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region) (T C : Set Plane)
    {n : ℕ} (part : Fin n → Set Plane)
    (hC : C = columnPart K.openCarrier Complex.I T)
    (hcover : C ∪ (⋃ i, part i) = T)
    (hdis : Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ part)
    (hCdis : ∀ i, Disjoint C (part i))
    (hCperiod : Tiling.AxisParallel.IsLatticePeriodic (Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport K C))
    (hFLC : ∀ i, Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC (part i))
    (hperiod : ∀ i, Tiling.AxisParallel.IsLatticePeriodic
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport K (part i)))
    (hInv : ∀ i, IsInvariantAlong (Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport K (part i)) Complex.I) :
    StructureAlong K.openCarrier T Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpartsCover : (⋃ i, part i) = T \ columnPart K.openCarrier Complex.I T := by
    rw [← hC, ← hcover]
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      refine ⟨Or.inr hz, ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
      exact fun hzC => Set.disjoint_left.mp (hCdis i) hzC hi
    · rintro ⟨hzC | hz, hnC⟩
      · exact (hnC hzC).elim
      · exact hz
  refine ⟨finpartitionOfIndexed part hdis hpartsCover, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Columns.coveredRegion_openCarrier, ← hC]
    exact (isDoublyPeriodic_iff_isLatticePeriodic _).mpr hCperiod
  · intro S hS
    rw [finpartitionOfIndexed_parts] at hS
    obtain ⟨⟨i, rfl⟩, _⟩ := (mem_nonemptyPieces part S).mp hS
    rw [Columns.coveredRegion_openCarrier]
    exact ⟨hasFiniteLocalComplexity_iff_hasFLC.mpr (hFLC i),
      (isDoublyPeriodic_iff_isLatticePeriodic _).mpr (hperiod i), hInv i⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.cylinder_periodic
proof:
:= by
  apply (Tiling.AxisParallel.isLatticePeriodic_iff_doublyPeriodic _).mpr
  refine ⟨(β : Plane), Complex.I, ?_, hperiod, ?_⟩
  · rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
    intro g hg i
    fin_cases i
    · have hreal := congrArg Complex.re hg
      rcases (by simpa using hreal) with hzero | hzero
      · simpa using hzero
      · exact ((ne_of_gt hβ) hzero).elim
    · have himag := congrArg Complex.im hg
      simpa using himag
  · intro z
    simp [Complex.add_re]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.cylinder_invariant
statement:
private theorem cylinder_invariant (X : Set ℝ) :
    IsInvariantAlong (Complex.re ⁻¹' X) Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  rw [Columns.invariant_vertical_iff]
  exact (Tiling.AxisParallel.verticalInvariant_iff_product _).mpr ⟨X, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.vertical_structure_flc
proof:
:= by
  let X : Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.PeriodicVerticalCarrier := {
    base := univ
    base_open := isOpen_univ
    base_regular := by simp
    base_nonnull := by simp
    period := 1
    period_pos := zero_lt_one
    base_periodic := by simp }
  have hTX : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T X.carrier := by
    simpa [X, Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.PeriodicVerticalCarrier.carrier] using hT
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_periodicCarrierSlabDecomposition
    X hTX (Or.inr hFLC)
  apply structure_of_indexed K T D.columnCentres (fun i => (D.nonColumnPlate i).centres)
    (D.columnCentres_eq.trans (Columns.columnPart_eq_verticalColumnCentres hT).symm)
    D.centres_partition D.nonColumnCentres_pairwise D.column_nonColumn_disjoint
  · rw [D.columnSupport_eq]
    apply cylinder_periodic D.commonSupportPeriod_pos
    rw [← D.columnSupport_eq]
    exact D.columnSupport_periodic
  · intro i
    apply Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC.mono hFLC
    rintro z ⟨q, _, rfl⟩
    exact q.2
  · intro i
    obtain ⟨_, hsupp⟩ :=
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hT (D.nonColumnPlate i)
    change Tiling.AxisParallel.IsLatticePeriodic (D.nonColumnPlate i).support
    rw [hsupp]
    apply cylinder_periodic D.commonSupportPeriod_pos
    rw [← hsupp]
    exact D.nonColumnSupport_periodic i
  · intro i
    obtain ⟨_, hsupp⟩ :=
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hT (D.nonColumnPlate i)
    change IsInvariantAlong (D.nonColumnPlate i).support Complex.I
    rw [hsupp]
    exact cylinder_invariant _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.vertical_structure_nonflc
statement:
private theorem vertical_structure_nonflc
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region}
    {U : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K univ}
    (D : Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.MinimalTilingStructureData K U)
    (hFLC : ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Plane)) :
    StructureAlong D.selectedRegion.openCarrier
      (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Plane) Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  apply structure_of_indexed D.selectedRegion D.selectedTiling.centres D.columnPart D.piece
    ((D.nonFLC_components hFLC).1.trans
      (Columns.columnPart_eq_verticalColumnCentres D.selectedTiling.tilesOn).symm)
    D.centres_partition D.pieces_pairwiseDisjoint D.column_disjoint_piece
    D.columnSupport_latticePeriodic D.piece_hasFLC D.pieceSupport_latticePeriodic
  intro i
  rw [D.pieceSupport_eq]
  exact cylinder_invariant _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.doubly_periodic_swap_iff
statement:
private theorem doubly_periodic_swap_iff (A : Set Plane) :
    IsDoublyPeriodic (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' A) ↔ IsDoublyPeriodic A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hnative := Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap_latticePeriodic
      ((isDoublyPeriodic_iff_isLatticePeriodic _).mp h)
    rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.coordinateSwap_image_image] at hnative
    exact (isDoublyPeriodic_iff_isLatticePeriodic _).mpr hnative
  · intro h
    exact (isDoublyPeriodic_iff_isLatticePeriodic _).mpr
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap_latticePeriodic
        ((isDoublyPeriodic_iff_isLatticePeriodic _).mp h))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.structure_swap_horizontal
statement:
private theorem structure_swap_horizontal (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region) (T : Set Plane)
    (hstructure : StructureAlong K.coordinateSwap.openCarrier
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T) Complex.I) :
    StructureAlong K.openCarrier T (1 : Plane)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P, hcolumn, hparts⟩ := hstructure
  let part := fun i : Fin P.parts.card =>
    Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' enumerate P.parts i
  have henum : (⋃ i, enumerate P.parts i) =
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T) \
        columnPart K.coordinateSwap.openCarrier Complex.I
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T) := by
    rw [iUnion_enumerate]
    simpa only [Finset.sup_id_set_eq_sUnion] using P.sup_parts
  have hcover : (⋃ i, part i) = T \ columnPart K.openCarrier (1 : Plane) T := by
    rw [show (⋃ i, part i) = Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' (⋃ i, enumerate P.parts i)
      from Set.image_iUnion.symm, henum]
    rw [Set.image_sdiff Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap.injective,
      Columns.columnPart_coordinateSwap_horizontal,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.coordinateSwap_image_image,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.coordinateSwap_image_image]
  have hdis : Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ part := by
    intro i _ j _ hij
    have hd := P.disjoint (enumerate_mem P.parts i) (enumerate_mem P.parts j)
      (fun heq => hij (enumerate_injective P.parts heq))
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro z ⟨a, ha, haz⟩ ⟨b, hb, hbz⟩
    have hab : a = b := Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap.injective (haz.trans hbz.symm)
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hd ha (hab.symm ▸ hb)
  refine ⟨finpartitionOfIndexed part hdis hcover, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Columns.columnPart_coordinateSwap_horizontal,
      Columns.coveredRegion_coordinateSwap] at hcolumn
    exact (doubly_periodic_swap_iff _).mp hcolumn
  · intro S hS
    rw [finpartitionOfIndexed_parts] at hS
    obtain ⟨⟨i, rfl⟩, _⟩ := (mem_nonemptyPieces part S).mp hS
    have hi := hparts (enumerate P.parts i) (enumerate_mem P.parts i)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply hasFiniteLocalComplexity_iff_hasFLC.mpr
      exact (Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC.linearImage_iff Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap _).mpr
        (hasFiniteLocalComplexity_iff_hasFLC.mp hi.1)
    · have hcov := Columns.coveredRegion_coordinateSwap K.coordinateSwap (enumerate P.parts i)
      simp only [Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.coordinateSwap_involutive] at hcov
      change IsDoublyPeriodic
        (coveredRegion K.openCarrier (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' enumerate P.parts i))
      rw [hcov]
      exact (doubly_periodic_swap_iff _).mpr hi.2.1
    · have hinv := (Columns.coveredRegion_invariant_coordinateSwap K.coordinateSwap
        (enumerate P.parts i) Complex.I).mp hi.2.2
      have hswapI : Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap Complex.I = (1 : Plane) := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp
      simpa only [Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.coordinateSwap_involutive, hswapI] using hinv

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.flc_tiling_weakly_periodic
statement:
theorem flc_tiling_weakly_periodic
    (Ω : Set Plane) (hΩ : IsRectangleTile Ω)
    (X : Set ℝ) (hX : X.Nonempty) (hXregular : IsRegularOpen X)
    (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) (hperiod : β +ᵥ X = X)
    (T : Set Plane) (hT : TilingOn (p₁ ⁻¹' X) Ω T)
    (hFLC : HasFiniteLocalComplexity T) : WeaklyPeriodic T
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hX
  apply (weaklyPeriodic_iff_production T).mpr
  exact Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.flcTiling_weaklyPeriodic
    (isRegularOpen_isOpen hXregular) hβ (real_period_membership hperiod)
    ((tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ _ T).mp hT)
    (hasFiniteLocalComplexity_iff_hasFLC.mp hFLC)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.periodic_tiling_of_flc
statement:
theorem periodic_tiling_of_flc
    (Ω : Set Plane) (hΩ : IsRectangleTile Ω)
    (X : Set ℝ) (hX : X.Nonempty) (hXregular : IsRegularOpen X)
    (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) (hperiod : β +ᵥ X = X) :
    (∃ T, TilingOn (p₁ ⁻¹' X) Ω T ∧ HasFiniteLocalComplexity T) →
      ∃ S, TilingOn (p₁ ⁻¹' X) Ω S ∧ IsDoublyPeriodic S
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hX
  rintro ⟨T, hT, hFLC⟩
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_flcPeriodicReplacement
    (isRegularOpen_isOpen hXregular) hβ (real_period_membership hperiod)
    ((tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ _ T).mp hT)
    (hasFiniteLocalComplexity_iff_hasFLC.mp hFLC)
  exact ⟨P.centres, (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ _ _).mpr P.tiles,
    (isDoublyPeriodic_iff_isLatticePeriodic _).mpr ⟨P.lattice, P.lattice_periods⟩⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.minimal_tiling_structure
statement:
theorem minimal_tiling_structure
    (Ω : Set Plane) (hΩ : IsRectangleTile Ω)
    (T : Set Plane) (hT : Tiles Ω T) (hminimal : IsMinimal univ T) :
    ∃ v ∈ ({e₁, e₂} : Set Plane),
      ∃ P : Finpartition (T \ columnPart Ω v T),
        IsDoublyPeriodic (coveredRegion Ω (columnPart Ω v T)) ∧
        ∀ S ∈ P.parts,
          HasFiniteLocalComplexity S ∧
          IsDoublyPeriodic (coveredRegion Ω S) ∧ IsInvariantAlong (coveredRegion Ω S) v
proof:
:= by
  change ∃ v ∈ ({e₁, e₂} : Set Plane), StructureAlong Ω T v
  let K := regionOfTile Ω hΩ
  have hcarrier : K.openCarrier = Ω := regionOfTile_openCarrier Ω hΩ
  have hnative : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T univ :=
    (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ univ T).mp hT
  by_cases hFLC : Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC T
  · refine ⟨e₂, by simp, ?_⟩
    simpa only [hcarrier, e₂, Complex.I] using vertical_structure_flc K T hnative hFLC
  · let U : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K univ := ⟨⟨T, hminimal.1⟩, hnative⟩
    have hUcentres : (U.centres : Set Plane) = T := rfl
    have hmin := (Fell.minimal_bridge isOpen_univ (by simp [IsRegularOpen]) U).mp hminimal
    obtain ⟨D⟩ := Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.exists_minimalTilingStructureData U hmin
    have hselectedNonFLC : ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC
        (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Plane) := by
      intro hf
      rcases D.orientation_spec with ⟨_, _, hcentres⟩ | ⟨_, _, hcentres⟩
      · rw [hcentres] at hf
        exact hFLC hf
      · rw [hcentres] at hf
        exact hFLC ((Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC.linearImage_iff
          Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap _).mp hf)
    have hs := vertical_structure_nonflc D hselectedNonFLC
    rcases D.orientation_spec with ⟨_, hregion, hcentres⟩ | ⟨_, hregion, hcentres⟩
    · refine ⟨e₂, by simp, ?_⟩
      rw [hcentres, hregion] at hs
      simpa only [hcarrier, e₂, Complex.I, hUcentres] using hs
    · refine ⟨e₁, by simp, ?_⟩
      rw [hcentres, hregion] at hs
      have hone : (1 : Plane) = e₁ := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp
      simpa only [hcarrier, hone] using structure_swap_horizontal K T hs

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.minimal_tiling_weakly_periodic
statement:
theorem minimal_tiling_weakly_periodic
    (Ω : Set Plane) (hΩ : IsRectangleTile Ω)
    (T : Set Plane) (hT : Tiles Ω T) (hminimal : IsMinimal univ T) :
    WeaklyPeriodic T
proof:
:= by
  let U : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace (regionOfTile Ω hΩ) univ :=
    ⟨⟨T, hminimal.1⟩, (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ univ T).mp hT⟩
  have hmin := (Fell.minimal_bridge isOpen_univ (by simp [IsRegularOpen]) U).mp hminimal
  exact (weaklyPeriodic_iff_production T).mpr
    (Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.topologicallyMinimalTiling_weaklyPeriodic U hmin)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.quasi_periodic_tiling_with_common_period
statement:
theorem quasi_periodic_tiling_with_common_period
    (Ω : Set Plane) (hΩ : IsRectangleTile Ω) :
    (∃ T, Tiles Ω T) →
      ∃ S, Tiles Ω S ∧ QuasiPeriodic S ∧ ∃ p, p ≠ 0 ∧ IsPeriod S p
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨T, hT⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hquasi, p, hp, hperiod⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_quasiPeriodicTiling_commonPeriod
      (regionOfTile Ω hΩ) ⟨T, (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ univ T).mp hT⟩
  exact ⟨S, (tilingOn_iff_native Ω hΩ univ S).mpr hS,
    (quasiPeriodic_iff_production S).mpr hquasi, p, hp,
    (isPeriod_iff_mem_periodGroup S p).mpr hperiod⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.locallyFellConverges_eventually_exists_mem_ball
statement:
theorem locallyFellConverges_eventually_exists_mem_ball
    {A : ℕ → Set Tiling.Plane} {L : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hconv : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges A L)
    {x : Tiling.Plane} (hx : x ∈ L) {epsilon : ℝ} (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ∃ y ∈ A n, dist y x < epsilon
proof:
:= by
  rcases hconv with ⟨hA, hL, hconv⟩
  let U : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
    (fun y : Tiling.Plane ↦ (y : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) '' Metric.ball x epsilon
  have hUopen : IsOpen U :=
    OnePoint.isOpen_image_coe.mpr Metric.isOpen_ball
  let V : Set (TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) :=
    {Q | ((Q : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ∩ U).Nonempty}
  have hVopen : IsOpen V :=
    TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen hUopen
  have hlimit : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification L hL ∈ V := by
    refine ⟨(x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane), ?_, ⟨x, ?_, rfl⟩⟩
    · simp [Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
        Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification, hx]
    · exact Metric.mem_ball_self hepsilon
  filter_upwards [hconv (hVopen.mem_nhds hlimit)] with n hn
  rcases hn with ⟨w, hwQ, hwU⟩
  rcases hwU with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨y, ?_, Metric.mem_ball.mp hy⟩
  simpa [Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
    Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification] using hwQ

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.locallyFellConverges_eventually_disjoint_compact
statement:
theorem locallyFellConverges_eventually_disjoint_compact
    {A : ℕ → Set Tiling.Plane} {L C : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hconv : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges A L)
    (hC : IsCompact C) (hLC : Disjoint L C) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, Disjoint (A n) C
proof:
:= by
  rcases hconv with ⟨hA, hL, hconv⟩
  let C' : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
    (fun x : Tiling.Plane ↦ (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) '' C
  have hC'closed : IsClosed C' :=
    (hC.image OnePoint.continuous_coe).isClosed
  let U : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) := C'ᶜ
  let V : Set (TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) :=
    {Q | (Q : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ⊆ U}
  have hVopen : IsOpen V :=
    TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_subsets_of_isOpen hC'closed.isOpen_compl
  have hlimit : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification L hL ∈ V := by
    intro z hzQ hzC'
    rcases hzC' with ⟨c, hcC, rfl⟩
    have hcL : c ∈ L := by
      simpa [Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
        Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification] using hzQ
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hLC hcL hcC
  filter_upwards [hconv (hVopen.mem_nhds hlimit)] with n hn
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxA hxC
  have hxQ : (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane) ∈
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification (A n) (hA n) :
        Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) := by
    simp [Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
      Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification, hxA]
  exact hn hxQ ⟨x, hxC, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.mem_of_locallyFellConverges_of_tendsto_mem
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hzL
  rcases hconv with ⟨hAclosed, hLclosed, hconv⟩
  have hcompl : Lᶜ ∈ nhds z := hLclosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hzL
  obtain ⟨epsilon, hepsilon, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hcompl
  let C : Set Tiling.Plane := Metric.closedBall z (epsilon / 2)
  have hLC : Disjoint L C := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro y hyL hyC
    apply (hball (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt
      (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hyC) (half_lt_self hepsilon)))).elim
    exact hyL
  have hdisjoint := locallyFellConverges_eventually_disjoint_compact
    ⟨hAclosed, hLclosed, hconv⟩ (isCompact_closedBall z (epsilon / 2)) hLC
  have hzC : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, zseq n ∈ C := by
    apply hzlim.eventually
    exact Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds z (half_pos hepsilon)
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hzn⟩ := (hdisjoint.and hzC).exists
  exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hn (hzmem n) hzn

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.isDiscrete_of_uniformlySeparated
statement:
theorem isDiscrete_of_uniformlySeparated
    {delta : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 < delta) {S : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hS : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.IsUniformlySeparated delta S) :
    IsDiscrete S
proof:
:= by
  rw [isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isOpen]
  intro x hx
  refine ⟨Metric.ball x delta, Metric.isOpen_ball, ?_⟩
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hyball, hyS⟩
    have hyx : y = x := by
      by_contra hyx
      have hsep := hS hyS hx hyx
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hyball
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hsep) hyball
    simp [hyx]
  · rintro (rfl : y = x)
    exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hdelta, hx⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.locallyFell_matchingPoints
statement:
theorem locallyFell_matchingPoints
    {delta : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    {S : ℕ → Set Tiling.Plane} {L : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hclosedS : ∀ n : ℕ, IsClosed (S n)) (hclosedL : IsClosed L)
    (hsepS : ∀ n : ℕ,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.IsUniformlySeparated delta (S n))
    (hsepL : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.IsUniformlySeparated delta L) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges S L ↔
      ∀ (C : Set Tiling.Plane), IsCompact C →
        ∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon → epsilon < delta / 3 →
          ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
            (∀ x ∈ L ∩ C, ∃! y : Tiling.Plane,
              y ∈ S n ∧ dist x y < epsilon) ∧
            (∀ y ∈ S n ∩ C, ∃! x : Tiling.Plane,
              x ∈ L ∧ dist x y < epsilon)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hconv C hC epsilon hepsilon hepsilonDelta
    have hfinite : (L ∩ C).Finite :=
      (hC.inter_left hclosedL).finite
        ((isDiscrete_of_uniformlySeparated hdelta hsepL).mono inter_subset_left)
    have hforward : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
        ∀ x ∈ L ∩ C, ∃! y : Tiling.Plane,
          y ∈ S n ∧ dist x y < epsilon := by
      rw [hfinite.eventually_all]
      intro x hx
      filter_upwards [locallyFellConverges_eventually_exists_mem_ball
          hconv hx.1 hepsilon] with n hn
      obtain ⟨y, hyS, hxy⟩ := hn
      refine ⟨y, ⟨hyS, by simpa [dist_comm] using hxy⟩, ?_⟩
      intro z hz
      by_contra hzy
      have hsep := hsepS n hz.1 hyS hzy
      have htri := dist_triangle z x y
      have hzx : dist z x < epsilon := by simpa [dist_comm] using hz.2
      have hxy' : dist x y < epsilon := by simpa [dist_comm] using hxy
      have : dist z y < 2 * epsilon := lt_of_le_of_lt htri (by linarith)
      linarith
    let D : Set Tiling.Plane :=
      C ∩ (⋃ x ∈ L, Metric.ball x epsilon)ᶜ
    have hDcompact : IsCompact D := by
      apply hC.inter_right
      exact isClosed_compl_iff.mpr (isOpen_biUnion fun x _ ↦ Metric.isOpen_ball)
    have hLD : Disjoint L D := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hxL hxD
      exact hxD.2 (Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr
        ⟨x, hxL, Metric.mem_ball_self hepsilon⟩)
    have havoid := locallyFellConverges_eventually_disjoint_compact
      hconv hDcompact hLD
    filter_upwards [hforward, havoid] with n hnforward hnavoid
    refine ⟨hnforward, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    have hexists : ∃ x : Tiling.Plane, x ∈ L ∧ dist x y < epsilon := by
      by_contra hnone
      have hyD : y ∈ D := by
        refine ⟨hy.2, ?_⟩
        rw [mem_compl_iff]
        intro hyUnion
        obtain ⟨x, hxL, hxyball⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hyUnion
        apply hnone
        refine ⟨x, hxL, ?_⟩
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hxyball
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hnavoid hy.1 hyD
    obtain ⟨x, hxL, hxy⟩ := hexists
    refine ⟨x, ⟨hxL, hxy⟩, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    by_contra hzx
    have hsep := hsepL hz.1 hxL hzx
    have htri := dist_triangle z y x
    have hxy' : dist y x < epsilon := by simpa [dist_comm] using hxy
    have : dist z x < 2 * epsilon := lt_of_le_of_lt htri (by linarith)
    linarith
  · intro hmatch
    refine ⟨hclosedS, hclosedL, ?_⟩
    let Kseq : ℕ → TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
      fun n ↦ Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification (S n) (hclosedS n)
    let Klim : TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification L hclosedL
    rw [show (fun n ↦ Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification
        (S n) (hclosedS n)) = Kseq from rfl]
    change Filter.Tendsto Kseq Filter.atTop (nhds Klim)
    rw [Filter.tendsto_def]
    intro N hN
    obtain ⟨B, hBbasis, hKlimB, hBN⟩ :=
      TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isTopologicalBasis.mem_nhds_iff.mp hN
    rcases hBbasis with ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    rcases hu with ⟨hufinite, hunonempty, huopen⟩
    rcases hKlimB with ⟨hKsubset, hKhit⟩
    have hinftyUnion : OnePoint.infty ∈ ⋃₀ u :=
      hKsubset (by simp [Klim, Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
        Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification])
    have hUnionOpen : IsOpen (⋃₀ u) := isOpen_sUnion huopen
    let C : Set Tiling.Plane :=
      (fun x : Tiling.Plane ↦ (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ⁻¹' (⋃₀ u)ᶜ
    have hCclosedCompact : IsClosed C ∧ IsCompact C := by
      have := (OnePoint.isOpen_iff_of_mem hinftyUnion).mp hUnionOpen
      simpa [C, preimage_compl] using this
    have hCL : Disjoint C L := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hxC hxL
      exact hxC (hKsubset (by
        simp [Klim, Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
          Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification, hxL]))
    obtain ⟨r, hrpos, hrsep⟩ :=
      Metric.exists_pos_forall_lt_edist hCclosedCompact.2 hclosedL hCL
    let epsilon : ℝ := min ((r : ℝ) / 2) (delta / 6)
    have hepsilon : 0 < epsilon := by
      dsimp [epsilon]
      exact lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
    have hepsilonDelta : epsilon < delta / 3 := by
      dsimp [epsilon]
      have := min_le_right ((r : ℝ) / 2) (delta / 6)
      linarith
    have hepsilonR : epsilon < (r : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [epsilon]
      have := min_le_left ((r : ℝ) / 2) (delta / 6)
      linarith
    have hmatchingC := hmatch C hCclosedCompact.2 epsilon hepsilon hepsilonDelta
    have hsubsetEventually : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
        (Kseq n : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ⊆ ⋃₀ u := by
      filter_upwards [hmatchingC] with n hn
      intro z hz
      induction z using OnePoint.rec with
      | infty => exact hinftyUnion
      | coe y =>
          have hyS : y ∈ S n := by
            simpa [Kseq, Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
              Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification] using hz
          by_contra hyUnion
          have hyC : y ∈ C := hyUnion
          obtain ⟨x, ⟨hxL, hxy⟩, _⟩ := hn.2 y ⟨hyS, hyC⟩
          have hrxy := hrsep y hyC x hxL
          have hedist : edist y x < (r : ENNReal) := by
            rw [edist_dist, dist_comm]
            exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_coe_iff (dist_nonneg)).mpr
              (hxy.trans hepsilonR)
          exact (not_lt_of_ge hrxy.le) hedist
    have hhitEventually : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
        ∀ U ∈ u, ((Kseq n : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ∩ U).Nonempty := by
      rw [hufinite.eventually_all]
      intro U hU
      obtain ⟨z, hzK, hzU⟩ := hKhit U hU
      induction z using OnePoint.rec with
      | infty =>
          exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦
            ⟨OnePoint.infty, by simp [Kseq,
              Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
              Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification], hzU⟩
      | coe x =>
          have hxL : x ∈ L := by
            simpa [Klim, Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
              Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification] using hzK
          have hUopen : IsOpen U := huopen U hU
          let V : Set Tiling.Plane :=
            (fun y : Tiling.Plane ↦ (y : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ⁻¹' U
          have hVopen : IsOpen V := hUopen.preimage OnePoint.continuous_coe
          have hxV : x ∈ V := hzU
          obtain ⟨rho, hrho, hball⟩ :=
            Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hVopen.mem_nhds hxV)
          let eta : ℝ := min (rho / 2) (delta / 6)
          have heta : 0 < eta := by
            dsimp [eta]
            exact lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
          have hetaDelta : eta < delta / 3 := by
            dsimp [eta]
            have := min_le_right (rho / 2) (delta / 6)
            linarith
          have hetaRho : eta < rho := by
            dsimp [eta]
            have := min_le_left (rho / 2) (delta / 6)
            linarith
          filter_upwards [hmatch {x} isCompact_singleton eta heta hetaDelta] with n hn
          obtain ⟨y, ⟨hyS, hxy⟩, _⟩ := hn.1 x ⟨hxL, mem_singleton x⟩
          refine ⟨(y : OnePoint Tiling.Plane), ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp [Kseq, Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
              Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification, hyS]
          · apply hball
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]
            exact hxy.trans hetaRho
    filter_upwards [hsubsetEventually, hhitEventually] with n hnsubset hnhit
    apply hBN
    exact ⟨hnsubset, hnhit⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.deformation_preserves_verticalPlateColumn
statement:
theorem deformation_preserves_verticalPlateColumn
    {C : ApproximationContext} (P : FLCControlPackage C)
    (hScale : 10 * (Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier + 1) < P.scale)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hphi : IsEpsilonApproximation C P.threshold phi)
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C phi)
    (Tphi : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane)
    (hTphi : ∀ t : ↥C.centres,
      Tphi t = mapPoint phi (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2))
    (S : Set ↥C.centres)
    (Psource : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region C.centres)
    (Ptarget : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate
      D.deformedRegion (deformedCenterCarrier Tphi))
    (hsource : Psource.centres = Set.image Subtype.val S)
    (htarget : Ptarget.centres = deformedCenterCarrierOn Tphi S)
    (hColumn : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsVerticalColumn Psource) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsVerticalColumn Ptarget
proof:
:= by
  have _hScale := hScale
  have _hphi := hphi
  rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsVerticalColumn] at hColumn ⊢
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hColumn
  by_cases hS : S.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩ := hS
    refine ⟨(Tphi s₀).re, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    rw [htarget] at hz
    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hz
    have hsSource : (s : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Psource.centres := by
      rw [hsource]
      exact ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    have hs₀Source : (s₀ : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Psource.centres := by
      rw [hsource]
      exact ⟨s₀, hs₀, rfl⟩
    have hre : (s : Tiling.Plane).re = (s₀ : Tiling.Plane).re :=
      (hx hsSource).trans (hx hs₀Source).symm
    change (Tphi s).re = (Tphi s₀).re
    rw [hTphi s, hTphi s₀]
    simp only [mapPoint, Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero,
      add_zero, mapScalar]
    congr 2
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hre
  · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    rw [htarget, deformedCenterCarrierOn] at hz
    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact (hS ⟨s, hs⟩).elim

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.finite_closed_supports_separation
statement:
private theorem finite_closed_supports_separation
    {α β : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace α]
    (p : α) (B : Finset β) (F : β → Set α)
    (hclosed : ∀ t ∈ B, IsClosed (F t))
    (hnot : ∀ t ∈ B, p ∉ F t) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ t ∈ B, Disjoint (Metric.ball p r) (F t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction B using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      refine ⟨1, one_pos, le_rfl, ?_⟩
      simp
  | @insert t B hnotmem ih =>
      have htclosed := hclosed t (Finset.mem_insert_self t B)
      have htp : p ∈ (F t)ᶜ := hnot t (Finset.mem_insert_self t B)
      obtain ⟨rt, hrt, hrtball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
        (htclosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds htp)
      have hclosedB : ∀ s ∈ B, IsClosed (F s) := by
        intro s hs
        exact hclosed s (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hs)
      have hnotB : ∀ s ∈ B, p ∉ F s := by
        intro s hs
        exact hnot s (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hs)
      obtain ⟨rB, hrB, hrB1, hB⟩ := ih hclosedB hnotB
      refine ⟨min rt (min rB 1), lt_min hrt (lt_min hrB one_pos),
        min_le_right _ _ |>.trans (min_le_right _ _), ?_⟩
      intro s hs
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert] at hs
      rcases hs with rfl | hs
      · apply Set.disjoint_left.2
        intro z hz hzF
        exact (hrtball (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz)) hzF
      · have hmin : min rt (min rB 1) ≤ rB :=
          (min_le_right rt (min rB 1)).trans (min_le_left rB 1)
        exact (hB s hs).mono_left (Metric.ball_subset_ball hmin)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.openSegment_axisAligned_local
statement:
private theorem openSegment_axisAligned_local
    {K : Region} {a b : Tiling.Plane} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hfront : openSegment ℝ a b ⊆ frontier K.support) :
    a.re = b.re ∨ a.im = b.im
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  have hneRe : a.re ≠ b.re := by
    intro h
    exact hnot (Or.inl h)
  have hneIm : a.im ≠ b.im := by
    intro h
    exact hnot (Or.inr h)
  let p : Tiling.Plane := AffineMap.lineMap a b (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hpseg : p ∈ openSegment ℝ a b := by
    exact lineMap_mem_openSegment ℝ a b (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hcross⟩ := K.isAxisParallel.localBoundaryCross p
  let delta : ℝ := min ((1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ)) / 2) (r / (2 * dist a b))
  have habDist : 0 < dist a b := dist_pos.mpr hab
  have hdelta : 0 < delta := by
    dsimp [delta]
    exact lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos hr (mul_pos zero_lt_two habDist))
  have hthetaDelta : (1 / 2 : ℝ) + delta ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    refine ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩
    have hdeltaLe : delta ≤ (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ)) / 2 := min_le_left _ _
    linarith
  let q : Tiling.Plane := AffineMap.lineMap a b ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + delta)
  have hqseg : q ∈ openSegment ℝ a b :=
    lineMap_mem_openSegment ℝ a b hthetaDelta
  have hqne : q ≠ p := by
    intro heq
    have hparam := AffineMap.lineMap_injective ℝ hab (by simpa [q, p] using heq)
    linarith
  have hqball : q ∈ Metric.ball p r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    have hdiff : AffineMap.lineMap a b ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + delta) -
        AffineMap.lineMap a b (1 / 2 : ℝ) = delta • (b - a) := by
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module]
      module
    rw [show q = AffineMap.lineMap a b ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + delta) by rfl,
      show p = AffineMap.lineMap a b (1 / 2 : ℝ) by rfl, hdiff,
      norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hdelta]
    have hnorm : ‖b - a‖ = dist a b := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      simpa only [norm_neg] using congrArg norm (by abel : b - a = -(a - b))
    rw [hnorm]
    have hdeltaLe : delta ≤ r / (2 * dist a b) := min_le_right _ _
    calc
      delta * dist a b ≤ (r / (2 * dist a b)) * dist a b :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdeltaLe habDist.le
      _ = r / 2 := by field_simp
      _ < r := half_lt_self hr
  have hqfront : q ∈ frontier K.support := hfront hqseg
  have hcrossq := hcross q hqball hqfront
  rcases hcrossq with hqre | hqim
  · exfalso
    have hcoord : delta * (b.re - a.re) = 0 := by
      have hi := hqre
      dsimp [q, p] at hi
      simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, Complex.add_re,
        Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul] at hi
      linarith
    exact hneRe (sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hcoord).resolve_left hdelta.ne')).symm
  · exfalso
    have hcoord : delta * (b.im - a.im) = 0 := by
      have hr' := hqim
      dsimp [q, p] at hr'
      simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, Complex.add_im,
        Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul] at hr'
      linarith
    exact hneIm (sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hcoord).resolve_left hdelta.ne')).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mem_segment_horizontal_local
statement:
private theorem mem_segment_horizontal_local
    {a b p : Tiling.Plane} (hab : a ≠ b) (him : a.im = b.im) :
    p ∈ segment ℝ a b ↔ p.im = a.im ∧ p.re ∈ uIcc a.re b.re
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap] at *
    rintro ⟨θ, hθ, rfl⟩
    constructor
    · simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, Complex.add_im,
        Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [him]
      ring
    · simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, Complex.add_re,
        Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
      rcases le_total a.re b.re with hle | hge
      · rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hle]
        have h₁ : 0 ≤ θ * (b.re - a.re) :=
          mul_nonneg hθ.1 (sub_nonneg.mpr hle)
        have h₂ : θ * (b.re - a.re) ≤ b.re - a.re := by
          rw [← one_mul (b.re - a.re)]
          simpa only [one_mul] using
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hθ.2 (sub_nonneg.mpr hle))
        rw [show (1 - θ) * a.re + θ * b.re =
          a.re + θ * (b.re - a.re) by ring]
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge hge]
        have h₁ : 0 ≤ (1 - θ) * (a.re - b.re) :=
          mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hθ.2) (sub_nonneg.mpr hge)
        have h₂ : (1 - θ) * (a.re - b.re) ≤ a.re - b.re := by
          rw [← one_mul (a.re - b.re)]
          simpa only [one_mul] using
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (sub_le_self 1 hθ.1)
              (sub_nonneg.mpr hge))
        rw [show (1 - θ) * a.re + θ * b.re =
          b.re + (1 - θ) * (a.re - b.re) by ring]
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨hpim, hpre⟩
    rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap]
    rcases le_total a.re b.re with hle | hge
    · have hne : a.re ≠ b.re := by
        intro h
        apply hab
        exact Complex.ext h him
      have hθ : (p.re - a.re) / (b.re - a.re) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
        rw [Set.mem_Icc]
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hle] at hpre
        have hlt : a.re < b.re := lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne
        constructor
        · exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hpre.1) (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hlt))
        · exact (div_le_one (sub_pos.mpr hlt)).2 (sub_le_sub_right hpre.2 a.re)
      refine ⟨(p.re - a.re) / (b.re - a.re), hθ, ?_⟩
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, Complex.add_re,
          Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        ring
      · simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, Complex.add_im,
          Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [show (1 - (p.re - a.re) / (b.re - a.re)) * a.im +
            (p.re - a.re) / (b.re - a.re) * b.im = a.im by
              rw [him]
              ring]
        simpa using hpim.symm
    · have hne : b.re ≠ a.re := by
        intro h
        apply hab
        exact Complex.ext h.symm him
      have hθ : (p.re - b.re) / (a.re - b.re) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
        rw [Set.mem_Icc]
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge hge] at hpre
        have hlt : b.re < a.re := lt_of_le_of_ne hge hne
        constructor
        · exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hpre.1) (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hlt))
        · exact (div_le_one (sub_pos.mpr hlt)).2 (sub_le_sub_right hpre.2 b.re)
      refine ⟨1 - (p.re - b.re) / (a.re - b.re), ?_, ?_⟩
      · constructor <;> linarith [hθ.1, hθ.2]
      · apply Complex.ext
        · simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, Complex.add_re,
            Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
          ring
        · simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, Complex.add_im,
            Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
          rw [← him, ← hpim]
          ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mem_segment_vertical_local
statement:
private theorem mem_segment_vertical_local
    {a b p : Tiling.Plane} (hab : a ≠ b) (hre : a.re = b.re) :
    p ∈ segment ℝ a b ↔ p.re = a.re ∧ p.im ∈ uIcc a.im b.im
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap] at *
    rintro ⟨θ, hθ, rfl⟩
    constructor
    · simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, Complex.add_re,
        Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hre]
      ring
    · simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, Complex.add_im,
        Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
      rcases le_total a.im b.im with hle | hge
      · rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hle]
        have h₁ : 0 ≤ θ * (b.im - a.im) :=
          mul_nonneg hθ.1 (sub_nonneg.mpr hle)
        have h₂ : θ * (b.im - a.im) ≤ b.im - a.im := by
          rw [← one_mul (b.im - a.im)]
          simpa only [one_mul] using
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hθ.2 (sub_nonneg.mpr hle))
        rw [show (1 - θ) * a.im + θ * b.im =
          a.im + θ * (b.im - a.im) by ring]
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge hge]
        have h₁ : 0 ≤ (1 - θ) * (a.im - b.im) :=
          mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hθ.2) (sub_nonneg.mpr hge)
        have h₂ : (1 - θ) * (a.im - b.im) ≤ a.im - b.im := by
          rw [← one_mul (a.im - b.im)]
          simpa only [one_mul] using
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (sub_le_self 1 hθ.1)
              (sub_nonneg.mpr hge))
        rw [show (1 - θ) * a.im + θ * b.im =
          b.im + (1 - θ) * (a.im - b.im) by ring]
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨hpre, hpim⟩
    rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap]
    rcases le_total a.im b.im with hle | hge
    · have hne : a.im ≠ b.im := by
        intro h
        apply hab
        exact Complex.ext hre h
      have hθ : (p.im - a.im) / (b.im - a.im) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
        rw [Set.mem_Icc]
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hle] at hpim
        have hlt : a.im < b.im := lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne
        constructor
        · exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hpim.1) (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hlt))
        · exact (div_le_one (sub_pos.mpr hlt)).2 (sub_le_sub_right hpim.2 a.im)
      refine ⟨(p.im - a.im) / (b.im - a.im), hθ, ?_⟩
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, Complex.add_re,
          Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [show (1 - (p.im - a.im) / (b.im - a.im)) * a.re +
            (p.im - a.im) / (b.im - a.im) * b.re = a.re by
              rw [hre]
              ring]
        simpa using hpre.symm
      · simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, Complex.add_im,
          Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        ring
    · have hne : b.im ≠ a.im := by
        intro h
        apply hab
        exact Complex.ext hre h.symm
      have hθ : (p.im - b.im) / (a.im - b.im) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
        rw [Set.mem_Icc]
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge hge] at hpim
        have hlt : b.im < a.im := lt_of_le_of_ne hge hne
        constructor
        · exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hpim.1) (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hlt))
        · exact (div_le_one (sub_pos.mpr hlt)).2 (sub_le_sub_right hpim.2 b.im)
      refine ⟨1 - (p.im - b.im) / (a.im - b.im), ?_, ?_⟩
      · constructor <;> linarith [hθ.1, hθ.2]
      · apply Complex.ext
        · simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, Complex.add_re,
            Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
          rw [← hre, ← hpre]
          ring
        · simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, Complex.add_im,
            Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
          ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.dist_le_dist_of_mem_segment_local
statement:
private theorem dist_le_dist_of_mem_segment_local
    {a b p : Tiling.Plane} (hp : p ∈ segment ℝ a b) :
    dist p a ≤ dist b a ∧ dist p b ≤ dist b a
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap] at hp
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ, rfl⟩ := hp
  have hpa : AffineMap.lineMap a b θ - a = θ • (b - a) := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module]
    module
  have hpb : AffineMap.lineMap a b θ - b = (1 - θ) • (a - b) := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module]
    module
  constructor
  · rw [dist_eq_norm, hpa, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg hθ.1]
    have hnorm : ‖b - a‖ = dist b a := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
    rw [hnorm]
    simpa [mul_comm] using
      (mul_le_of_le_one_right (dist_nonneg) hθ.2 :
        dist b a * θ ≤ dist b a)
  · rw [dist_eq_norm, hpb, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hθ.2)]
    have hnorm : ‖a - b‖ = dist b a := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      simpa only [norm_neg] using congrArg norm (by abel : a - b = -(b - a))
    rw [hnorm]
    simpa [mul_comm] using
      (mul_le_of_le_one_right (dist_nonneg) (sub_le_self 1 hθ.1) :
        dist b a * (1 - θ) ≤ dist b a)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint_add_indexed_local
statement:
private theorem mapPoint_add_indexed_local
    {C : ApproximationContext}
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (x y : {z : Tiling.Plane // z.re ∈ C.coordinateSpace ∧ z.im ∈ C.coordinateSpace}) :
    mapPoint phi
      ⟨x.1 + y.1, C.coordinateSpace.add_mem x.2.1 y.2.1,
        C.coordinateSpace.add_mem x.2.2 y.2.2⟩ =
      mapPoint phi x + mapPoint phi y
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp only [mapPoint, mapScalar, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, add_zero]
    have hxy : (⟨(x.1).re + (y.1).re,
        C.coordinateSpace.add_mem x.2.1 y.2.1⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) =
        ⟨(x.1).re, x.2.1⟩ + ⟨(y.1).re, y.2.1⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rfl
    rw [hxy, map_add]
    norm_num
  · simp only [mapPoint, mapScalar, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im,
      Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      mul_zero, mul_one, zero_add, add_zero]
    have hxy : (⟨(x.1).im + (y.1).im,
        C.coordinateSpace.add_mem x.2.2 y.2.2⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) =
        ⟨(x.1).im, x.2.2⟩ + ⟨(y.1).im, y.2.2⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rfl
    rw [hxy, map_add]
    norm_num

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapTranslatedVertex_add_local
statement:
private theorem mapTranslatedVertex_add_local
    {C : ApproximationContext}
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (v : C.region.vertices) (s : C.centres) :
    ∃ x : ↥C.translatedVertices,
      (x : Tiling.Plane) = (v : Tiling.Plane) + (s : Tiling.Plane) ∧
      mapTranslatedVertex phi x =
        mapPoint phi (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) +
          mapPoint phi (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2)
proof:
:= by
  let x : ↥C.translatedVertices := ⟨(v : Tiling.Plane) + (s : Tiling.Plane),
    ⟨v, v.2, s, s.2, rfl⟩⟩
  refine ⟨x, rfl, ?_⟩
  change mapPoint phi (C.translatedVertexPoint x) = _
  have hx : C.translatedVertexPoint x =
      ⟨(v : Tiling.Plane) + (s : Tiling.Plane),
        C.coordinateSpace.add_mem (C.vertex_re_mem v.1 v.2)
          (C.centre_re_mem s.1 s.2),
        C.coordinateSpace.add_mem (C.vertex_im_mem v.1 v.2)
          (C.centre_im_mem s.1 s.2)⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  rw [hx]
  convert (mapPoint_add_indexed_local phi
    (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2)) using 1
  apply congrArg (mapPoint phi)
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.diam_support_eq_openCarrier_local
statement:
private theorem diam_support_eq_openCarrier_local (K : Region) :
    Metric.diam K.support = Metric.diam K.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  change Metric.diam K.support = Metric.diam (interior K.support)
  nth_rewrite 1 [← K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]
  exact Metric.diam_closure _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.vertex_mem_support_local
statement:
private theorem vertex_mem_support_local {K : Region}
    {v : Tiling.Plane} (hv : v ∈ K.vertices) : v ∈ K.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [← K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]
  exact frontier_subset_closure (IntrinsicVertices.region_vertices_subset_frontier K hv)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.translated_endpoint_mem_support_local
statement:
private theorem translated_endpoint_mem_support_local
    {K : Region} {a b t : Tiling.Plane}
    (ha : a ∈ K.vertices) (hb : b ∈ K.vertices) :
    a + t ∈ t +ᵥ K.support ∧ b + t ∈ t +ᵥ K.support
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [show a + t = t +ᵥ a by simp [vadd_eq_add, add_comm]]
    exact ⟨a, vertex_mem_support_local ha, rfl⟩
  · rw [show b + t = t +ᵥ b by simp [vadd_eq_add, add_comm]]
    exact ⟨b, vertex_mem_support_local hb, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.translated_edge_endpoint_dist_le_diam_local
statement:
private theorem translated_edge_endpoint_dist_le_diam_local
    {K : Region} {a b t : Tiling.Plane}
    (ha : a ∈ K.vertices) (hb : b ∈ K.vertices) :
    dist (a + t) (b + t) ≤ Metric.diam K.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  have haSupport := vertex_mem_support_local ha
  have hbSupport := vertex_mem_support_local hb
  have hdiam := Metric.dist_le_diam_of_mem K.isPolygonal.isBounded haSupport hbSupport
  rw [diam_support_eq_openCarrier_local K] at hdiam
  simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hdiam

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.segment_translated_pair_lt_control_local
statement:
private theorem segment_translated_pair_lt_control_local
    {C : ApproximationContext} (P : FLCControlPackage C)
    (hScale : 10 * (Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier + 1) < P.scale)
    {a b v : C.region.vertices} {s t : C.centres}
    (hp : (v : Tiling.Plane) + (s : Tiling.Plane) ∈
      segment ℝ ((a : Tiling.Plane) + (t : Tiling.Plane))
        ((b : Tiling.Plane) + (t : Tiling.Plane))) :
    dist ((v : Tiling.Plane) + (s : Tiling.Plane))
        ((a : Tiling.Plane) + (t : Tiling.Plane)) < P.controlRadius ∧
      dist ((v : Tiling.Plane) + (s : Tiling.Plane))
        ((b : Tiling.Plane) + (t : Tiling.Plane)) < P.controlRadius
proof:
:= by
  have hdist := dist_le_dist_of_mem_segment_local hp
  have hedge := translated_edge_endpoint_dist_le_diam_local
    (K := C.region) (t := (t : Tiling.Plane)) a.2 b.2
  have hdiam : Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier < P.controlRadius := by
    exact (by nlinarith [hScale, P.scale_pos] :
      Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier < P.scale).trans
      P.scale_lt_controlRadius
  have hedge' : dist ((b : Tiling.Plane) + (t : Tiling.Plane))
      ((a : Tiling.Plane) + (t : Tiling.Plane)) ≤
      Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier := by
    simpa [dist_comm] using hedge
  constructor
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hdist.1.trans hedge') hdiam
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hdist.2.trans hedge') hdiam

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.le_zero_of_sign_eq_local
statement:
private theorem le_zero_of_sign_eq_local
    {x y : ℝ} (hs : Real.sign x = Real.sign y) (hx : x ≤ 0) : y ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hy
  have hypos : 0 < y := lt_of_not_ge hy
  have hsy : Real.sign y = 1 := Real.sign_of_pos hypos
  have hsx : Real.sign x = -1 ∨ Real.sign x = 0 := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hx with hzero | hneg
    · exact Or.inr (Real.sign_eq_zero_iff.mpr hzero)
    · exact Or.inl (Real.sign_of_neg hneg)
  rcases hsx with hsx | hsx
  · linarith [hs, hsx, hsy]
  · linarith [hs, hsx, hsy]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.nonneg_of_sign_eq_local
statement:
private theorem nonneg_of_sign_eq_local
    {x y : ℝ} (hs : Real.sign x = Real.sign y) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hy
  have hyneg : y < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hy
  have hsy : Real.sign y = -1 := Real.sign_of_neg hyneg
  have hsx : Real.sign x = 1 ∨ Real.sign x = 0 := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hx with hzero | hpos
    · exact Or.inr (Real.sign_eq_zero_iff.mpr hzero.symm)
    · exact Or.inl (Real.sign_of_pos hpos)
  rcases hsx with hsx | hsx <;> linarith [hs, hsx, hsy]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.translated_edge_image_dist_lt_half_local
statement:
private theorem translated_edge_image_dist_lt_half_local
    {C : ApproximationContext} (P : FLCControlPackage C)
    (hScale : 10 * (Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier + 1) < P.scale)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hphi : IsEpsilonApproximation C P.threshold phi)
    {a b : ↥C.region.vertices} {t : ↥C.centres}
    (y z : ↥C.translatedVertices)
    (hyval : (y : Tiling.Plane) = (a : Tiling.Plane) + (t : Tiling.Plane))
    (hzval : (z : Tiling.Plane) = (b : Tiling.Plane) + (t : Tiling.Plane)) :
    dist (mapTranslatedVertex phi y) (mapTranslatedVertex phi z) < P.scale / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsource : dist (y : Tiling.Plane) (z : Tiling.Plane) < P.scale := by
    rw [hyval, hzval]
    have hedge := translated_edge_endpoint_dist_le_diam_local
      (K := C.region) (t := (t : Tiling.Plane)) a.2 b.2
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hedge (by
      nlinarith [hScale, (Metric.diam_nonneg : 0 ≤ Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier)])
  have hlocal := deformation_localAccuracy P phi hphi y z hsource
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  calc
    ‖mapTranslatedVertex phi y - mapTranslatedVertex phi z‖ =
        ‖(mapTranslatedVertex phi y - mapTranslatedVertex phi z) -
            ((y : Tiling.Plane) - (z : Tiling.Plane)) +
            ((y : Tiling.Plane) - (z : Tiling.Plane))‖ := by
      congr 1
      abel
    _ ≤ ‖(mapTranslatedVertex phi y - mapTranslatedVertex phi z) -
          ((y : Tiling.Plane) - (z : Tiling.Plane))‖ +
          ‖(y : Tiling.Plane) - (z : Tiling.Plane)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ < P.localError + Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier := by
      have hdiam := translated_edge_endpoint_dist_le_diam_local
        (K := C.region) (t := (t : Tiling.Plane)) a.2 b.2
      have hnorm : ‖(y : Tiling.Plane) - (z : Tiling.Plane)‖ ≤
          Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm, hyval, hzval] using hdiam
      have hlocal' : ‖mapTranslatedVertex phi y - mapTranslatedVertex phi z -
          ((y : Tiling.Plane) - (z : Tiling.Plane))‖ < P.localError := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hlocal
      exact add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le hlocal' hnorm
    _ < P.scale / 2 := by
      rw [P.localError_eq]
      have hscale10 : 10 < P.scale := by
        nlinarith [hScale, (Metric.diam_nonneg : 0 ≤ Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier)]
      have hinv : P.scale⁻¹ < (10 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        simpa [one_div] using one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by norm_num) hscale10
      have hdiamnonneg : 0 ≤ Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier :=
        Metric.diam_nonneg
      nlinarith [hinv, hScale]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.translated_edge_image_dist_lt_quarter_local
statement:
private theorem translated_edge_image_dist_lt_quarter_local
    {C : ApproximationContext} (P : FLCControlPackage C)
    (hScale : 10 * (Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier + 1) < P.scale)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hphi : IsEpsilonApproximation C P.threshold phi)
    {a b : ↥C.region.vertices} {t : ↥C.centres}
    (y z : ↥C.translatedVertices)
    (hyval : (y : Tiling.Plane) = (a : Tiling.Plane) + (t : Tiling.Plane))
    (hzval : (z : Tiling.Plane) = (b : Tiling.Plane) + (t : Tiling.Plane)) :
    dist (mapTranslatedVertex phi y) (mapTranslatedVertex phi z) < P.scale / 4
proof:
:= by
  have hsource : dist (y : Tiling.Plane) (z : Tiling.Plane) < P.scale := by
    rw [hyval, hzval]
    have hedge := translated_edge_endpoint_dist_le_diam_local
      (K := C.region) (t := (t : Tiling.Plane)) a.2 b.2
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hedge (by
      nlinarith [hScale, (Metric.diam_nonneg : 0 ≤ Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier)])
  have hlocal := deformation_localAccuracy P phi hphi y z hsource
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  calc
    ‖mapTranslatedVertex phi y - mapTranslatedVertex phi z‖ =
        ‖(mapTranslatedVertex phi y - mapTranslatedVertex phi z) -
            ((y : Tiling.Plane) - (z : Tiling.Plane)) +
            ((y : Tiling.Plane) - (z : Tiling.Plane))‖ := by
      congr 1; abel
    _ ≤ ‖(mapTranslatedVertex phi y - mapTranslatedVertex phi z) -
          ((y : Tiling.Plane) - (z : Tiling.Plane))‖ +
          ‖(y : Tiling.Plane) - (z : Tiling.Plane)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ < P.localError + Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier := by
      have hdiam := translated_edge_endpoint_dist_le_diam_local
        (K := C.region) (t := (t : Tiling.Plane)) a.2 b.2
      have hnorm : ‖(y : Tiling.Plane) - (z : Tiling.Plane)‖ ≤
          Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm, hyval, hzval] using hdiam
      have hlocal' : ‖mapTranslatedVertex phi y - mapTranslatedVertex phi z -
          ((y : Tiling.Plane) - (z : Tiling.Plane))‖ < P.localError := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hlocal
      exact add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le hlocal' hnorm
    _ < P.scale / 4 := by
      rw [P.localError_eq]
      have hscale10 : 10 < P.scale := by
        nlinarith [hScale, (Metric.diam_nonneg : 0 ≤ Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier)]
      have hinv : P.scale⁻¹ < (10 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        simpa [one_div] using one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by norm_num) hscale10
      have hdiamnonneg : 0 ≤ Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier := Metric.diam_nonneg
      nlinarith [hinv, hScale]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.vertexOnEdgeTransport
statement:
private theorem vertexOnEdgeTransport
    : ∀ {C : ApproximationContext} (P : FLCControlPackage C)
      (_hScale : 10 * (Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier + 1) < P.scale)
      (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
