name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondStage_sourceSliceChain_transport_impl
statement:
private theorem secondStage_sourceSliceChain_transport_impl :
    ∀ {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {P : PeriodicBandData C}
      (ε : ℝ) (_hFine : IsPeriodicBandFineness P ε)
      (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
      (_hφ : IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ)
      (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (T₁ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane)
      (_hT₁ : ∀ t, T₁ t = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2))
      (q : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
      (yLift : Fin (n + 1) → C.coordinateSpace)
      (owner : Fin n → ↥C.centres),
      IsSecondStageBandSliceChain C φ D T₁ q y yLift owner →
      StrictMono (fun i ↦ mapScalar φ (yLift i)) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin n,
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = q ∧
          z.im ∈ Ioo (mapScalar φ (yLift i.castSucc))
            (mapScalar φ (yLift i.succ))} ⊆
          mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint (owner i).1 (owner i).2) +ᵥ
            D.deformedRegion.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  intro C P ε hFine φ hφ D T₁ hT₁ q n y yLift owner hchain
  rcases hchain with ⟨hLift, hmono, hsteps⟩
  constructor
  · apply Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.mpr
    intro i
    obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, hleft, hright, hpositive, hinside⟩ := hsteps i
    have hvw : v.im < w.im := by
      have hpositive' : 0 < w.im - v.im := by simpa using hpositive
      linarith
    rw [second_endpoint_formula D v hv (owner i) (y i.castSucc)
      (yLift i.castSucc) (hLift i.castSucc) hleft,
      second_endpoint_formula D w hw (owner i) (y i.succ)
        (yLift i.succ) (hLift i.succ) hright]
    simpa [add_comm] using
      (add_lt_add_right (D.secondHomeomorph_strictMono hvw)
        (mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint (owner i).1 (owner i).2)).im)
  · intro i
    obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, hleft, hright, hpositive, hinside⟩ := hsteps i
    let t := owner i
    let c₁ : Tiling.Plane := T₁ t
    let c₂ : Tiling.Plane := mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)
    have hc₁ : c₁ = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) := hT₁ t
    have hc₁_re : c₁.re = mapScalar φ ⟨t.1.re, C.centre_re_mem t.1 t.2⟩ := by
      rw [hc₁]
      simp [mapFirstPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint]
    have hc₁_im : c₁.im = t.1.im := by
      rw [hc₁]
      simp [mapFirstPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint]
    have hc₂_re : c₂.re = c₁.re := by
      rw [hc₁]
      simp [c₂, mapPoint, mapFirstPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint]
    have hc₂_im : c₂.im = mapScalar φ
        ⟨t.1.im, C.centre_im_mem t.1 t.2⟩ := by
      simp [c₂, mapPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint]
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, D.deformedRegion_openCarrier]
    let r : ℝ := D.secondHomeomorph.symm (z.im - c₂.im)
    let p : Tiling.Plane := ((q - c₁.re : ℝ) : ℂ) +
      (r : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hend₀ := second_endpoint_formula D v hv t (y i.castSucc)
      (yLift i.castSucc) (hLift i.castSucc) hleft
    have hend₁ := second_endpoint_formula D w hw t (y i.succ)
      (yLift i.succ) (hLift i.succ) hright
    have hvr : v.im < r := by
      apply D.secondHomeomorph_strictMono.lt_iff_lt.mp
      rw [D.secondHomeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
      have hzre := hz.2.1
      have hzlo := hz.2.1
      linarith [hend₀]
    have hrw : r < w.im := by
      apply D.secondHomeomorph_strictMono.lt_iff_lt.mp
      rw [D.secondHomeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
      have hzre := hz.2.1
      have hzhi := hz.2.2
      linarith [hend₁]
    have hleft' : y i.castSucc = v.im + t.1.im := by
      simpa using hleft
    have hright' : y i.succ = w.im + t.1.im := by
      simpa using hright
    have hsource : c₁ + p ∈
        {u : Tiling.Plane | u.re = q ∧
          u.im ∈ Ioo (y i.castSucc) (y i.succ)} := by
      constructor
      · simp [p]
      · simp only [p, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_im,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul]
        rw [hc₁_im]
        constructor <;> linarith [hleft', hright']
    have hsource' := hinside hsource
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, D.firstRegion_openCarrier] at hsource'
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkmap⟩ := hsource'
    refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
    apply Complex.ext
    · rw [D.planarHomeomorph_apply]
      have hkreal : D.firstHomeomorph k.re = q - c₁.re := by
        have h := congrArg Complex.re hkmap
        rw [D.firstPlanarHomeomorph_apply] at h
        simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im,
          zero_mul, sub_zero, vadd_eq_add] at h
        convert h using 1 <;> simp [p]
        ring
      simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.I_re, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im,
        mul_one, sub_self, add_zero, vadd_eq_add, Complex.neg_re]
      rw [hkreal]
      rw [hz.1, hc₂_re]
      ring
    · rw [D.planarHomeomorph_apply]
      have hkim : k.im = r := by
        have h := congrArg Complex.im hkmap
        rw [D.firstPlanarHomeomorph_apply] at h
        simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_im,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one, Complex.ofReal_im,
          zero_mul, vadd_eq_add] at h
        convert h using 1 <;> simp [p]
        ring
      simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one, Complex.I_re,
        mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add, vadd_eq_add, Complex.neg_im]
      rw [hkim]
      dsimp [r]
      rw [D.secondHomeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
      ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondStage_sourceSliceChain_transport
statement:
private theorem secondStage_sourceSliceChain_transport :
    ∀ {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {P : PeriodicBandData C}
      (ε : ℝ) (_hFine : IsPeriodicBandFineness P ε)
      (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
      (_hφ : IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ)
      (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (T₁ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane)
      (_hT₁ : ∀ t, T₁ t = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2))
      (q : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
      (yLift : Fin (n + 1) → C.coordinateSpace)
      (owner : Fin n → ↥C.centres),
      IsSecondStageBandSliceChain C φ D T₁ q y yLift owner →
      StrictMono (fun i ↦ mapScalar φ (yLift i)) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin n,
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = q ∧
          z.im ∈ Ioo (mapScalar φ (yLift i.castSucc))
            (mapScalar φ (yLift i.succ))} ⊆
          mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint (owner i).1 (owner i).2) +ᵥ
            D.deformedRegion.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  exact secondStage_sourceSliceChain_transport_impl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondStage_targetExhaustingSliceChains
statement:
private theorem secondStage_targetExhaustingSliceChains :
    ∀ {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {P : PeriodicBandData C}
      (ε : ℝ) (_hFine : IsPeriodicBandFineness P ε)
      (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
      (_hφ : IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ)
      (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (T₁ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane)
      (_hT₁ : ∀ t, T₁ t = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2))
      (_hTiles : TilesOn D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁)
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ}),
      ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume, q ∈ deformedBandBase P φ →
        ∀ a b : ℝ, a < b →
          ∃ (n : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
            (yLift : Fin (n + 1) → C.coordinateSpace)
            (owner : Fin n → ↥C.centres),
            mapScalar φ (yLift 0) ≤ a ∧
              b ≤ mapScalar φ (yLift (Fin.last n)) ∧
              IsSecondStageBandSliceChain C φ D T₁ q y yLift owner
proof:
:= by
  intro C P ε _hFine φ _hφ D T₁ _hT₁ _hTiles
  filter_upwards [
    secondStage_vertical_fibre_ae D T₁ _hTiles,
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints_of_local_ae
      D.firstRegion
      (deformedCenterCarrier T₁) _hTiles.2.1 Axis.vertical,
    secondStage_mappedEndpointCofinality_local D T₁ _hT₁ _hTiles] with
      q hfull hbetween hcofinal
  intro hq a b hab
  have hfull' := hfull hq
  let E : Set ℝ := sliceEndpointSet D.firstRegion
    (deformedCenterCarrier T₁) Axis.vertical q
  have hcover : ∀ c d : ℝ, c < d →
      ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ Ioo c d →
        slicePoint Axis.vertical q x ∈
          openUnion D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁) := by
    intro c d hcd
    filter_upwards [hfull'] with x hx hxI
    exact hx.mpr (Set.mem_univ x)
  obtain ⟨lift, hlift, hmono, hunboundedAbove, hunboundedBelow⟩ := hcofinal hq
  obtain ⟨l, hlE, hla⟩ := not_bddBelow_iff.mp hunboundedBelow a
  obtain ⟨r, hrE, hbr⟩ := not_bddAbove_iff.mp hunboundedAbove b
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hlE
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hrE
  have hlr : l.1 < r.1 := by
    have hll : mapScalar φ (lift l) < mapScalar φ (lift r) :=
      lt_trans hla (lt_trans hab hbr)
    exact (hmono.lt_iff_lt).mp hll
  have hlocal : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ Ioo l.1 r.1 →
      slicePoint Axis.vertical q x ∈
        openUnion D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁) :=
    hcover l.1 r.1 hlr
  obtain ⟨n, hn, y, ownerA, hy0, hylast, hchain, _hendpoints⟩ :=
    hbetween l l.property r r.property hlr hlocal
  obtain ⟨yLift, owner, hylift, hsource⟩ :=
    secondStage_chain_of_exact_indexed D T₁ _hT₁ _hTiles hn y ownerA hchain
  refine ⟨n, hn, y, yLift, owner, ?_, ?_, hsource⟩
  · have hmap0 : mapScalar φ (yLift 0) = mapScalar φ (lift l) := by
      apply congrArg (mapScalar φ)
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (hylift 0).trans (hy0.trans (hlift l).symm)
    rw [hmap0]
    exact hla.le
  · have hmaplast : mapScalar φ (yLift (Fin.last n)) =
        mapScalar φ (lift r) := by
      apply congrArg (mapScalar φ)
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (hylift (Fin.last n)).trans (hylast.trans (hlift r).symm)
    rw [hmaplast]
    exact hbr.le

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondStage_globalGenericSliceOrder
statement:
private theorem secondStage_globalGenericSliceOrder :
    ∀ {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {P : PeriodicBandData C}
      (ε : ℝ) (_hFine : IsPeriodicBandFineness P ε)
      (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
      (_hφ : IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ)
      (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (T₁ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane)
      (_hT₁ : ∀ t, T₁ t = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2))
      (_hTiles : TilesOn D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁)
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ}),
      ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume, q ∈ deformedBandBase P φ →
        ∀ s t : ↥C.centres, ∀ x y : ℝ,
          x ∈ placedAxisSlice D.firstRegion (T₁ s) Axis.vertical q →
          y ∈ placedAxisSlice D.firstRegion (T₁ t) Axis.vertical q →
          x < y →
            secondStageRunningMap φ D s x < secondStageRunningMap φ D t y
proof:
:= by
  exact secondStage_globalGenericSliceOrder_impl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondStage_vertical_perturbation_local
statement:
private theorem secondStage_vertical_perturbation_local
    {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ}
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (c p : Tiling.Plane)
    (_hp : p ∈ D.firstRegion.openCarrier) {q : ℝ}
    (δ : ℝ) (_hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hball : Metric.ball (c + p) δ ⊆ c +ᵥ D.firstRegion.openCarrier)
    (hq : |q - (c.re + p.re)| < δ) :
    c.im + p.im ∈ placedAxisSlice D.firstRegion c Axis.vertical q
proof:
:= by
  change slicePoint Axis.vertical q (c.im + p.im) ∈ c +ᵥ D.firstRegion.openCarrier
  have hclose : dist (slicePoint Axis.vertical q (c.im + p.im)) (c + p) < δ := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have heq : slicePoint Axis.vertical q (c.im + p.im) - (c + p) =
        ((q - (c.re + p.re) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [slicePoint]
    rw [heq]
    simp only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hq
  exact hball hclose

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondStage_good_base_real_interval
statement:
private theorem secondStage_good_base_real_interval
    {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {P : PeriodicBandData C}
    {φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ}
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (T₁ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane)
    (hTiles : TilesOn D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁)
      {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ})
    (c : Tiling.Plane) (hc : c ∈ deformedCenterCarrier T₁)
    (p : Tiling.Plane) (_hp : p ∈ D.firstRegion.openCarrier)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hball : Metric.ball (c + p) δ ⊆ c +ᵥ D.firstRegion.openCarrier) :
    ∃ q : ℝ, q ∈ deformedBandBase P φ ∧
      q ∈ Ioo (c.re + p.re - δ / 4) (c.re + p.re + δ / 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hAE : ∀ᵐ z : Tiling.Plane ∂volume,
      z ∈ openUnion D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁) →
        z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ := by
    filter_upwards [hTiles.2.2] with z hz
    intro hzU
    apply hz.mpr
    simpa only [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier.eq_def, Set.mem_iUnion] using hzU
  have hdense : Dense {z : Tiling.Plane |
      z ∈ openUnion D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁) →
      z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ} := Measure.dense_of_ae hAE
  let V : Set Tiling.Plane := Metric.ball (c + p) δ ∩
      {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ Ioo (c.re + p.re - δ / 4) (c.re + p.re + δ / 4)}
  have hVopen : IsOpen V := by
    exact Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.continuous_re)
  have hVne : V.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨c + p, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ, ?_⟩
    change c.re + p.re ∈ Ioo (c.re + p.re - δ / 4) (c.re + p.re + δ / 4)
    constructor <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨z, hzgood, hzV⟩ := hdense.exists_mem_open hVopen hVne
  have hzopen : z ∈ openUnion D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁) := by
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    exact ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, hball hzV.1⟩
  have hzbase := hzgood hzopen
  exact ⟨z.re, hzbase, hzV.2⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondStage_exists_mem_Ioo_of_ae_real
proof:
:= by
  have hμ : volume.restrict (Ioo a b) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have : volume (Ioo a b) = 0 := by
      rw [← Measure.restrict_apply_univ (Ioo a b), hz]
      simp
    rw [Real.volume_Ioo] at this
    simp [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero, not_le.mpr (sub_pos.mpr hab)] at this
  let hne : (ae (volume.restrict (Ioo a b))).NeBot := ae_neBot.mpr hμ
  have hp' : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume.restrict (Ioo a b), P x :=
    hP.filter_mono ae_restrict_le
  rcases @Filter.Eventually.exists ℝ _ (ae (volume.restrict (Ioo a b))) hne
      (hp'.and (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo)) with ⟨x, hp, hx⟩
  exact ⟨x, hx, hp⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondStageCentreMap_injective
statement:
private theorem secondStageCentreMap_injective
    : ∀ {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {P : PeriodicBandData C}
      (ε : ℝ) (_hFine : IsPeriodicBandFineness P ε)
      (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
      (_hφ : IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ)
      (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (T₁ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane)
      (_hT₁ : ∀ t, T₁ t = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2))
      (_hTiles : TilesOn D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁)
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ}),
      Function.Injective
        (fun t : ↥C.centres => mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2))
proof:
:= by
  intro C P ε hFine φ hφ D T₁ hT₁ hTiles s t heq
  by_contra hst
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := D.firstRegion.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty D.firstRegion.nonempty
  obtain ⟨Hopen, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ :=
    deformedBandBase_geometry P ε hFine φ hφ
  obtain ⟨δs, hδs, hballs⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1
    (D.firstRegion.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd (T₁ s))
    (T₁ s + p) ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨δt, hδt, hballt⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1
    (D.firstRegion.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd (T₁ t))
    (T₁ t + p) ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  have hTreal : (T₁ s).re = (T₁ t).re := by
    rw [hT₁ s, hT₁ t]
    simpa [mapPoint, mapFirstPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint] using
      congrArg Complex.re heq
  have himap : mapScalar φ ⟨s.1.im, C.centre_im_mem s.1 s.2⟩ =
      mapScalar φ ⟨t.1.im, C.centre_im_mem t.1 t.2⟩ := by
    simpa [mapPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint] using congrArg Complex.im heq
  have hTsim : (T₁ s).im = s.1.im := by
    simp [hT₁, mapFirstPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint]
  have hTtim : (T₁ t).im = t.1.im := by
    simp [hT₁, mapFirstPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint]
  have himne : s.1.im ≠ t.1.im := by
    intro him
    apply hst
    apply T₁.injective
    apply Complex.ext
    · exact hTreal
    · simp [hT₁, mapFirstPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint, him]
  let δ : ℝ := min δs δt
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by
    dsimp [δ]
    exact lt_min hδs hδt
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne himne with hst_im | hts_im
  · obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀base, hq₀I⟩ := secondStage_good_base_real_interval
      D T₁ hTiles (T₁ s) ⟨s, rfl⟩ p hp hδ
        (fun z hz => by
          apply hballs
          change dist z (T₁ s + p) < δs
          change dist z (T₁ s + p) < δ at hz
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_left _ _))
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hηball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 Hopen q₀ hq₀base
    let ρ : ℝ := min (η / 2) (min (δs / 4) (δt / 4))
    have hρ : 0 < ρ := by
      dsimp [ρ]
      exact lt_min (by linarith) (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith))
    obtain ⟨q, hqI, hqgood⟩ := secondStage_exists_mem_Ioo_of_ae_real
      (by linarith : q₀ - ρ < q₀ + ρ)
      (secondStage_globalGenericSliceOrder
        (C := C) (P := P) ε hFine φ hφ D T₁ hT₁ hTiles)
    have hqbase : q ∈ deformedBandBase P φ := by
      apply hηball
      change dist q q₀ < η
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith [hqI.1, hqI.2,
        show ρ ≤ η / 2 from min_le_left _ _]
    let x : ℝ := (T₁ s).im + p.im
    let y : ℝ := (T₁ t).im + p.im
    have hqs : |q - ((T₁ s).re + p.re)| < δs := by
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith [hqI.1, hqI.2, hq₀I.1, hq₀I.2,
        show ρ ≤ δs / 4 from le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _),
        show δ ≤ δs from min_le_left _ _]
    have hqt : |q - ((T₁ t).re + p.re)| < δt := by
      rw [← hTreal]
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith [hqI.1, hqI.2, hq₀I.1, hq₀I.2,
        show ρ ≤ δt / 4 from le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _),
        show δ ≤ δt from min_le_right _ _]
    have hx : x ∈ placedAxisSlice D.firstRegion (T₁ s) Axis.vertical q := by
      dsimp [x]
      exact secondStage_vertical_perturbation_local (q := q) D (T₁ s) p hp δs hδs hballs hqs
    have hy : y ∈ placedAxisSlice D.firstRegion (T₁ t) Axis.vertical q := by
      dsimp [y]
      exact secondStage_vertical_perturbation_local (q := q) D (T₁ t) p hp δt hδt hballt hqt
    have hlt := hqgood hqbase s t x y hx hy (by
      dsimp [x, y]
      rw [hTsim, hTtim]
      linarith)
    have hEqRun : secondStageRunningMap φ D s x =
        secondStageRunningMap φ D t y := by
      dsimp [secondStageRunningMap, x, y]
      rw [hTsim, hTtim]
      rw [himap]
      congr 1; ring_nf
    exact (ne_of_lt hlt) hEqRun
  · obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀base, hq₀I⟩ := secondStage_good_base_real_interval
      D T₁ hTiles (T₁ t) ⟨t, rfl⟩ p hp hδ
        (fun z hz => by
          apply hballt
          change dist z (T₁ t + p) < δt
          change dist z (T₁ t + p) < δ at hz
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_right _ _))
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hηball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 Hopen q₀ hq₀base
    let ρ : ℝ := min (η / 2) (min (δs / 4) (δt / 4))
    have hρ : 0 < ρ := by
      dsimp [ρ]
      exact lt_min (by linarith) (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith))
    obtain ⟨q, hqI, hqgood⟩ := secondStage_exists_mem_Ioo_of_ae_real
      (by linarith : q₀ - ρ < q₀ + ρ)
      (secondStage_globalGenericSliceOrder
        (C := C) (P := P) ε hFine φ hφ D T₁ hT₁ hTiles)
    have hqbase : q ∈ deformedBandBase P φ := by
      apply hηball
      change dist q q₀ < η
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith [hqI.1, hqI.2,
        show ρ ≤ η / 2 from min_le_left _ _]
    let x : ℝ := (T₁ t).im + p.im
    let y : ℝ := (T₁ s).im + p.im
    have hqt : |q - ((T₁ t).re + p.re)| < δt := by
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith [hqI.1, hqI.2, hq₀I.1, hq₀I.2,
        show ρ ≤ δt / 4 from le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _),
        show δ ≤ δt from min_le_right _ _]
    have hqs : |q - ((T₁ s).re + p.re)| < δs := by
      rw [hTreal]
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith [hqI.1, hqI.2, hq₀I.1, hq₀I.2,
        show ρ ≤ δs / 4 from le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _),
        show δ ≤ δs from min_le_left _ _]
    have hx : x ∈ placedAxisSlice D.firstRegion (T₁ t) Axis.vertical q := by
      dsimp [x]
      exact secondStage_vertical_perturbation_local (q := q) D (T₁ t) p hp δt hδt hballt hqt
    have hy : y ∈ placedAxisSlice D.firstRegion (T₁ s) Axis.vertical q := by
      dsimp [y]
      exact secondStage_vertical_perturbation_local (q := q) D (T₁ s) p hp δs hδs hballs hqs
    have hlt := hqgood hqbase t s x y hx hy (by
      dsimp [x, y]
      rw [hTtim, hTsim]
      linarith)
    have hEqRun : secondStageRunningMap φ D t x =
        secondStageRunningMap φ D s y := by
      dsimp [secondStageRunningMap, x, y]
      rw [hTtim, hTsim]
      rw [himap]
      congr 1; ring_nf
    exact (ne_of_lt hlt) hEqRun

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondStagePlanarHomeomorphLocal_apply
statement:
private theorem secondStagePlanarHomeomorphLocal_apply
    {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ}
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (z : Tiling.Plane) :
    secondStagePlanarHomeomorphLocal D z =
      z.re + D.secondHomeomorph z.im * Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  rw [secondStagePlanarHomeomorphLocal]
  change Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm
    (z.re, D.secondHomeomorph z.im) = _
  rw [Complex.equivRealProdCLM_symm_apply]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondStageRegionImageLocal
statement:
private theorem secondStageRegionImageLocal
    {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ}
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) :
    D.deformedRegion.openCarrier =
      secondStagePlanarHomeomorphLocal D '' D.firstRegion.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.deformedRegion_openCarrier, D.firstRegion_openCarrier, Set.image_image]
  congr 1
  funext z
  rw [secondStagePlanarHomeomorphLocal_apply,
    D.firstPlanarHomeomorph_apply, D.planarHomeomorph_apply]
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondStage_fullTile_enclosure_local
statement:
private theorem secondStage_fullTile_enclosure_local
    {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {P : PeriodicBandData C}
    {φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ}
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (T₁ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane)
    (hT₁ : ∀ t, T₁ t = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2))
    (hTiles : TilesOn D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁)
      {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ})
    (hBaseOpen : IsOpen (deformedBandBase P φ))
    (hBaseRegular : interior (closure (deformedBandBase P φ)) =
      deformedBandBase P φ) (t : ↥C.centres) :
    mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +ᵥ D.deformedRegion.openCarrier ⊆
      {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ}
proof:
:= by
  have hcarrierOpen : IsOpen {z : Tiling.Plane |
      z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ} :=
    hBaseOpen.preimage Complex.continuous_re
  have hcarrierRegular : interior (closure {z : Tiling.Plane |
      z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ}) =
      {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ} := by
    change interior (closure (Complex.re ⁻¹' deformedBandBase P φ)) =
      Complex.re ⁻¹' deformedBandBase P φ
    rw [Complex.closure_preimage_re, Complex.interior_preimage_re, hBaseRegular]
  have hsupport : regularSupport D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁) =
      {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ} :=
    regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn hcarrierOpen hcarrierRegular hTiles
  have hopenUnion : IsOpen (openUnion D.firstRegion
      (deformedCenterCarrier T₁)) :=
    isOpen_iUnion fun s : deformedCenterCarrier T₁ ↦
      D.firstRegion.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd (s : Tiling.Plane)
  have hopenSubset : openUnion D.firstRegion
      (deformedCenterCarrier T₁) ⊆
      regularSupport D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁) := by
    rw [regularSupport]
    intro x hx
    have hxint : x ∈ interior (openUnion D.firstRegion
        (deformedCenterCarrier T₁)) := by
      simpa [hopenUnion.interior_eq] using hx
    exact interior_mono subset_closure hxint
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hzk⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwk⟩ := (secondStageRegionImageLocal D) ▸ hk
  have hfirst : T₁ t + w ∈ openUnion D.firstRegion
      (deformedCenterCarrier T₁) := by
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
    refine ⟨⟨T₁ t, ⟨t, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
  have hbase : (T₁ t + w).re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ := by
    have h := hopenSubset hfirst
    rw [hsupport] at h
    exact h
  have hcentre :
      (mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)).re = (T₁ t).re := by
    rw [hT₁ t]
    simp [mapPoint, mapFirstPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint]
  have hsecondre :
      (secondStagePlanarHomeomorphLocal D w).re = w.re := by
    rw [secondStagePlanarHomeomorphLocal_apply]
    simp
  have hreal : z.re = (T₁ t + w).re := by
    change mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +ᵥ k = z at hzk
    rw [vadd_eq_add] at hzk
    calc
      z.re = (mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) + k).re := by rw [hzk]
      _ = (mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)).re + k.re := by simp
      _ = (T₁ t).re + w.re := by rw [hcentre, ← hwk, hsecondre]
      _ = (T₁ t + w).re := by simp
  change z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ
  rw [hreal]
  exact hbase

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondStage_sourceSliceChain_transport_local
statement:
private theorem secondStage_sourceSliceChain_transport_local
    {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {P : PeriodicBandData C}
    (ε : ℝ) (_hFine : IsPeriodicBandFineness P ε)
    (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (_hφ : IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ)
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (T₁ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane)
    (hT₁ : ∀ t, T₁ t = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2))
    (q : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (yLift : Fin (n + 1) → C.coordinateSpace)
    (owner : Fin n → ↥C.centres)
    (hchain : IsSecondStageBandSliceChain C φ D T₁ q y yLift owner) :
    StrictMono (fun i ↦ mapScalar φ (yLift i)) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin n,
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = q ∧
          z.im ∈ Ioo (mapScalar φ (yLift i.castSucc))
            (mapScalar φ (yLift i.succ))} ⊆
          mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint (owner i).1 (owner i).2) +ᵥ
            D.deformedRegion.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  rcases hchain with ⟨hLift, hmono, hsteps⟩
  constructor
  · apply Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.mpr
    intro i
    obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, hleft, hright, hpositive, _⟩ := hsteps i
    have hvw : v.im < w.im := by simpa [Complex.sub_im] using hpositive
    rw [secondStage_endpoint_formula D v hv (owner i) (y i.castSucc)
      (yLift i.castSucc) (hLift i.castSucc) hleft,
      secondStage_endpoint_formula D w hw (owner i) (y i.succ)
        (yLift i.succ) (hLift i.succ) hright]
    simpa [add_comm] using
      add_lt_add_right (D.secondHomeomorph_strictMono hvw)
        (mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint (owner i).1 (owner i).2)).im
  · intro i z hz
    obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, hleft, hright, hpositive, hinside⟩ := hsteps i
    let t := owner i
    let c₁ : Tiling.Plane := T₁ t
    let c₂ : Tiling.Plane := mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)
    have hc₁ : c₁ = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) := hT₁ t
    have hc₁_re : c₁.re = mapScalar φ ⟨t.1.re, C.centre_re_mem t.1 t.2⟩ := by
      rw [hc₁]
      simp [mapFirstPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint]
    have hc₁_im : c₁.im = t.1.im := by
      rw [hc₁]
      simp [mapFirstPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint]
    have hc₂_re : c₂.re = c₁.re := by
      rw [hc₁]
      simp [c₂, mapPoint, mapFirstPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint]
    have hc₂_im : c₂.im = mapScalar φ
        ⟨t.1.im, C.centre_im_mem t.1 t.2⟩ := by
      simp [c₂, mapPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint]
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, D.deformedRegion_openCarrier]
    let r : ℝ := D.secondHomeomorph.symm (z.im - c₂.im)
    let p : Tiling.Plane := ((q - c₁.re : ℝ) : ℂ) + (r : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hend₀ := secondStage_endpoint_formula D v hv t (y i.castSucc)
      (yLift i.castSucc) (hLift i.castSucc) hleft
    have hend₁ := secondStage_endpoint_formula D w hw t (y i.succ)
      (yLift i.succ) (hLift i.succ) hright
    have hvr : v.im < r := by
      apply D.secondHomeomorph_strictMono.lt_iff_lt.mp
      rw [D.secondHomeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
      linarith [hz.2.1, hend₀]
    have hrw : r < w.im := by
      apply D.secondHomeomorph_strictMono.lt_iff_lt.mp
      rw [D.secondHomeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
      linarith [hz.2.2, hend₁]
    have hsource : c₁ + p ∈ {u : Tiling.Plane | u.re = q ∧
        u.im ∈ Ioo (y i.castSucc) (y i.succ)} := by
      constructor
      · simp [p]
      · simp only [p, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
          Complex.I_im, mul_one, Complex.ofReal_re, zero_mul]
        rw [hc₁_im]
        have hleft' : y i.castSucc = v.im + t.1.im := by
          simpa using hleft
        have hright' : y i.succ = w.im + t.1.im := by
          simpa using hright
        constructor <;> linarith
    have hsource' := hinside hsource
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, D.firstRegion_openCarrier] at hsource'
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkmap⟩ := hsource'
    refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
    apply Complex.ext
    · rw [D.planarHomeomorph_apply]
      have hkreal : D.firstHomeomorph k.re = q - c₁.re := by
        have h := congrArg Complex.re hkmap
        rw [D.firstPlanarHomeomorph_apply] at h
        simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im,
          zero_mul, sub_zero, vadd_eq_add] at h
        convert h using 1 <;> (simp [p] <;> ring)
      simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.I_re, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im,
        mul_one, sub_self, add_zero, vadd_eq_add, Complex.neg_re]
      rw [hkreal, hz.1, hc₂_re]
      ring
    · rw [D.planarHomeomorph_apply]
      have hkim : k.im = r := by
        have h := congrArg Complex.im hkmap
        rw [D.firstPlanarHomeomorph_apply] at h
        simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_im,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one, Complex.ofReal_im,
          zero_mul, vadd_eq_add] at h
        convert h using 1 <;> (simp [p] <;> ring)
      simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one, Complex.I_re,
        mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add, vadd_eq_add, Complex.neg_im]
      rw [hkim]
      dsimp [r]
      rw [D.secondHomeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
      ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondStage_target_fibre_ae_local
statement:
private theorem secondStage_target_fibre_ae_local
    {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {P : PeriodicBandData C}
    (ε : ℝ) (hFine : IsPeriodicBandFineness P ε)
    (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hφ : IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ)
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (T₁ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane)
    (hT₁ : ∀ t, T₁ t = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2))
    (hTiles : TilesOn D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁)
      {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ}) :
    ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume, q ∈ deformedBandBase P φ →
      ∀ᵐ y : ℝ ∂volume, ∃ t : ↥C.centres,
        slicePoint Axis.vertical q y ∈
          mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +ᵥ D.deformedRegion.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [secondStage_mappedEndpointCofinality_local D T₁ hT₁ hTiles,
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints_of_local_ae
      D.firstRegion
      (deformedCenterCarrier T₁) hTiles.2.1 Axis.vertical,
    secondStage_vertical_fibre_ae D T₁ hTiles] with q hends hbetween hfull
  intro hq
  obtain ⟨lift, hlift, hmono, habove, hbelow⟩ := hends hq
  let E : Set ℝ := sliceEndpointSet D.firstRegion
    (deformedCenterCarrier T₁) Axis.vertical q
  have hcover : ∀ a b : ℝ, a < b →
      ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ Ioo a b →
        slicePoint Axis.vertical q x ∈
          openUnion D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁) := by
    intro a b hab
    filter_upwards [hfull hq] with x hx hxI
    exact hx.mpr (Set.mem_univ x)
  have hbetween' : ∀ a ∈ E, ∀ b ∈ E, a < b →
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
        (ownerA : Fin n → ↥(deformedCenterCarrier T₁)),
        x 0 = a ∧ x (Fin.last n) = b ∧
          IsFilledIndexedSliceChain D.firstRegion
            (deformedCenterCarrier T₁) Axis.vertical q x ownerA ∧
          (∀ i, x i ∈ E) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    exact hbetween a ha b hb hab (hcover a b hab)
  have hmapCountable : (Set.range (mapScalar φ)).Countable := by
    apply (Set.countable_range (fun r : ℚ => (r : ℝ))).mono
    rintro z ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨φ x, rfl⟩
  filter_upwards [hmapCountable.ae_notMem volume] with y hy
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, hay⟩ := not_bddBelow_iff.mp hbelow y
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨b, rfl⟩, hby⟩ := not_bddAbove_iff.mp habove y
  have hab : a.1 < b.1 := hmono.lt_iff_lt.mp (hay.trans hby)
  obtain ⟨n, hn, x, ownerA, hx0, hxlast, hchain, hendpoints⟩ :=
    hbetween' a.1 a.2 b.1 b.2 hab
  obtain ⟨yLift, owner, hylift, hsource⟩ :=
    secondStage_chain_of_exact_indexed D T₁ hT₁ hTiles hn x ownerA hchain
  have h0 : yLift 0 = lift a := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    calc
      (yLift 0 : ℝ) = x 0 := hylift 0
      _ = a := hx0
      _ = (lift a : ℝ) := (hlift a).symm
  have hlast : yLift (Fin.last n) = lift b := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    calc
      (yLift (Fin.last n) : ℝ) = x (Fin.last n) := hylift (Fin.last n)
      _ = b := hxlast
      _ = (lift b : ℝ) := (hlift b).symm
  have hleft : mapScalar φ (yLift 0) < y := by
    simpa [h0] using hay
  have hright : y < mapScalar φ (yLift (Fin.last n)) := by
    simpa [hlast] using hby
  have hyne : ∀ k, y ≠ mapScalar φ (yLift k) := by
    intro k heq
    exact hy ⟨yLift k, heq.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := strictMono_exists_gap_local
    (fun k => mapScalar φ (yLift k))
    (secondStage_sourceSliceChain_transport_local ε hFine φ hφ D T₁ hT₁
      q x yLift owner hsource).1 hleft hright hyne
  have htransport := secondStage_sourceSliceChain_transport_local ε hFine φ hφ
    D T₁ hT₁ q x yLift owner hsource
  refine ⟨owner i, htransport.2 i ?_⟩
  exact ⟨by simp [slicePoint], by simpa [slicePoint] using hi⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondSourcePointLocal_re
statement:
private theorem secondSourcePointLocal_re
    {C : ApproximationContext} {φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ}
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (t : ↥C.centres) (z : Tiling.Plane) :
    (secondSourcePointLocal D t z).re = z.re
proof:
:= by
  simp [secondSourcePointLocal]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondStageRunningMap_sourcePointLocal_im
statement:
private theorem secondStageRunningMap_sourcePointLocal_im
    {C : ApproximationContext} {φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ}
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (t : ↥C.centres) (z : Tiling.Plane) :
    secondStageRunningMap φ D t (secondSourcePointLocal D t z).im = z.im
proof:
:= by
  simp [secondStageRunningMap, secondSourcePointLocal, mapPoint,
    ApproximationContext.centrePoint]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondSourcePointLocal_mem
statement:
private theorem secondSourcePointLocal_mem
    {C : ApproximationContext} {φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ}
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (T₁ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane)
    (hT₁ : ∀ t, T₁ t = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2))
    (t : ↥C.centres) (z : Tiling.Plane)
    (hz : z ∈ mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +ᵥ
      D.deformedRegion.openCarrier) :
    secondSourcePointLocal D t z ∈
      T₁ t +ᵥ D.firstRegion.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, secondStageRegionImageLocal D] at hz
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpz⟩ := hz
  have hc₁ : T₁ t = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) := hT₁ t
  have hpre : secondStagePlanarHomeomorphLocal D
      (-mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +
        secondSourcePointLocal D t z) =
      -mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) + z := by
    rw [secondStagePlanarHomeomorphLocal_apply]
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp [secondSourcePointLocal, mapFirstPoint, mapPoint,
        ApproximationContext.centrePoint]
    · simp [secondSourcePointLocal, mapFirstPoint, mapPoint,
        ApproximationContext.centrePoint]
      ring
  have heq := (secondStagePlanarHomeomorphLocal D).injective (hpre.trans hpz.symm)
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  change -T₁ t + secondSourcePointLocal D t z ∈ D.firstRegion.openCarrier
  rw [hc₁, heq]
  exact hp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondStage_target_tiles_disjoint_local
statement:
private theorem secondStage_target_tiles_disjoint_local
    {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {P : PeriodicBandData C}
    (ε : ℝ) (_hFine : IsPeriodicBandFineness P ε)
    (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (_hφ : IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ)
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (T₁ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane)
    (hT₁ : ∀ t, T₁ t = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2))
    (hTiles : TilesOn D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁)
      {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ})
    (_hBaseOpen : IsOpen (deformedBandBase P φ))
    (hEnclose : ∀ t : ↥C.centres,
      mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +ᵥ D.deformedRegion.openCarrier ⊆
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ}) :
    ∀ s t : ↥C.centres, s ≠ t →
      Disjoint
        (mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2) +ᵥ D.deformedRegion.openCarrier)
        (mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +ᵥ D.deformedRegion.openCarrier)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t hst
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro z hzs hzt
  let O :=
    (mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2) +ᵥ D.deformedRegion.openCarrier) ∩
      (mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +ᵥ D.deformedRegion.openCarrier)
  have hOopen : IsOpen O :=
    (D.deformedRegion.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd _).inter
      (D.deformedRegion.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd _)
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hOopen z ⟨hzs, hzt⟩
  obtain ⟨Hopen, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ :=
    deformedBandBase_geometry P ε _hFine φ _hφ
  have hzbase : z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ := hEnclose s hzs
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 Hopen z.re hzbase
  let ρ : ℝ := min (η / 4) (δ / 2)
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := by
    dsimp [ρ]
    exact lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨q, hqI, hqgood⟩ := secondStage_exists_mem_Ioo_of_ae_real
    (by linarith : z.re - ρ < z.re + ρ)
    (secondStage_globalGenericSliceOrder
      (C := C) (P := P) ε _hFine φ _hφ D T₁ hT₁ hTiles)
  have hqbase : q ∈ deformedBandBase P φ := by
    apply hδball
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith [hqI.1, hqI.2, show ρ ≤ δ / 2 from min_le_right _ _]
  let w : Tiling.Plane := slicePoint Axis.vertical q z.im
  have hwball : w ∈ Metric.ball z η := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, show w - z =
      ((q - z.re : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((z.im - z.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [w, slicePoint]]
    have habs : |q - z.re| < η := by
      exact (abs_lt.2 ⟨by linarith [hqI.1, show ρ ≤ η / 4 from min_le_left _ _],
        by linarith [hqI.2, show ρ ≤ η / 4 from min_le_left _ _]⟩)
    simp only [sub_self, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
    change ‖((q - z.re : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ < η
    simpa [← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] using habs
  have hwo : w ∈ O := hball hwball
  have hws := secondSourcePointLocal_mem D T₁ hT₁ s w hwo.1
  have hwt := secondSourcePointLocal_mem D T₁ hT₁ t w hwo.2
  let rs := (secondSourcePointLocal D s w).im
  let rt := (secondSourcePointLocal D t w).im
  have hrs : rs ∈ placedAxisSlice D.firstRegion (T₁ s) Axis.vertical q := by
    change slicePoint Axis.vertical q rs ∈ T₁ s +ᵥ D.firstRegion.openCarrier
    rw [show slicePoint Axis.vertical q rs = secondSourcePointLocal D s w by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [rs, secondSourcePointLocal, w, slicePoint]]
    exact hws
  have hrt : rt ∈ placedAxisSlice D.firstRegion (T₁ t) Axis.vertical q := by
    change slicePoint Axis.vertical q rt ∈ T₁ t +ᵥ D.firstRegion.openCarrier
    rw [show slicePoint Axis.vertical q rt = secondSourcePointLocal D t w by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [rt, secondSourcePointLocal, w, slicePoint]]
    exact hwt
  have hrun_s : secondStageRunningMap φ D s rs = w.im := by
    simpa [rs] using secondStageRunningMap_sourcePointLocal_im D s w
  have hrun_t : secondStageRunningMap φ D t rt = w.im := by
    simpa [rt] using secondStageRunningMap_sourcePointLocal_im D t w
  rcases lt_trichotomy rs rt with hrslt | hrseq | hrtlt
  · have := hqgood hqbase s t rs rt hrs hrt hrslt
    linarith [hrun_s, hrun_t]
  · have hsourdisj := (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint D.firstRegion
      (deformedCenterCarrier T₁)).mp hTiles.2.1
      (show T₁ s ∈ deformedCenterCarrier T₁ from ⟨s, rfl⟩)
      (show T₁ t ∈ deformedCenterCarrier T₁ from ⟨t, rfl⟩) (by
        intro heq
        exact hst (T₁.injective heq))
    rw [← hrseq] at hrt
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hsourdisj hrs hrt
  · have := hqgood hqbase t s rt rs hrt hrs hrtlt
    linarith [hrun_s, hrun_t]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.secondStage_properCylinderSlices
statement:
private theorem secondStage_properCylinderSlices :
    ∀ {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {P : PeriodicBandData C}
      (ε : ℝ) (_hFine : IsPeriodicBandFineness P ε)
      (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
      (_hφ : IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ)
      (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (T₁ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane)
      (_hT₁ : ∀ t, T₁ t = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2))
      (_hTiles : TilesOn D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁)
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ}),
      (∀ t : ↥C.centres,
        mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +ᵥ D.deformedRegion.openCarrier ⊆
          {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ}) ∧
      (∀ s t : ↥C.centres, s ≠ t →
        Disjoint
          (mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2) +ᵥ D.deformedRegion.openCarrier)
          (mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +ᵥ D.deformedRegion.openCarrier)) ∧
      (∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume,
        (q ∈ deformedBandBase P φ → ∀ᵐ y : ℝ ∂volume,
          ∃ t : ↥C.centres,
            slicePoint Axis.vertical q y ∈
              mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +ᵥ
                D.deformedRegion.openCarrier) ∧
        (q ∉ deformedBandBase P φ → ∀ y : ℝ,
          ¬ ∃ t : ↥C.centres,
            slicePoint Axis.vertical q y ∈
              mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +ᵥ
                D.deformedRegion.openCarrier))
proof:
:= by
  intro C P ε hFine φ hφ D T₁ hT₁ hTiles
  obtain ⟨hBaseOpen, hBaseRegular, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ :=
    deformedBandBase_geometry P ε hFine φ hφ
  have henclose : ∀ t : ↥C.centres,
      mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +ᵥ D.deformedRegion.openCarrier ⊆
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ} := by
    intro t
    exact secondStage_fullTile_enclosure_local D T₁ hT₁ hTiles
      hBaseOpen hBaseRegular t
  have hdisj := secondStage_target_tiles_disjoint_local ε hFine φ hφ D T₁
    hT₁ hTiles hBaseOpen henclose
  have hcover := secondStage_target_fibre_ae_local ε hFine φ hφ D T₁ hT₁ hTiles
  refine ⟨henclose, hdisj, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hcover] with q hq
  constructor
  · intro hqbase
    exact hq hqbase
  · intro hqnot y hex
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hex
    apply hqnot
    simpa [slicePoint] using henclose t ht

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.periodicBand_secondStageTilesOn_of_properCylinderSlices
statement:
private theorem periodicBand_secondStageTilesOn_of_properCylinderSlices
    (hBaseOpen :
      ∀ {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {P : PeriodicBandData C}
        (ε : ℝ) (_hFine : IsPeriodicBandFineness P ε)
        (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
        (_hφ : IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ),
        IsOpen (deformedBandBase P φ))
    (hInjective :
      ∀ {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {P : PeriodicBandData C}
        (ε : ℝ) (_hFine : IsPeriodicBandFineness P ε)
        (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
        (_hφ : IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ)
        (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (T₁ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane),
        (∀ t, T₁ t = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)) →
        TilesOn D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁)
          {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ} →
        Function.Injective
          (fun t : ↥C.centres => mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)))
    (hProper :
      ∀ {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {P : PeriodicBandData C}
        (ε : ℝ) (_hFine : IsPeriodicBandFineness P ε)
        (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
        (_hφ : IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ)
        (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (T₁ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane),
        (∀ t, T₁ t = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)) →
        TilesOn D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁)
          {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ} →
        (∀ t : ↥C.centres,
          mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +ᵥ D.deformedRegion.openCarrier ⊆
            {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ}) ∧
        (∀ s t : ↥C.centres, s ≠ t →
          Disjoint
            (mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2) +ᵥ D.deformedRegion.openCarrier)
            (mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +ᵥ D.deformedRegion.openCarrier)) ∧
        (∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume,
          (q ∈ deformedBandBase P φ → ∀ᵐ y : ℝ ∂volume,
            ∃ t : ↥C.centres,
              slicePoint Axis.vertical q y ∈
                mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +ᵥ
                  D.deformedRegion.openCarrier) ∧
          (q ∉ deformedBandBase P φ → ∀ y : ℝ,
            ¬ ∃ t : ↥C.centres,
              slicePoint Axis.vertical q y ∈
                mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2) +ᵥ
                  D.deformedRegion.openCarrier))) :
    ∀ {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {P : PeriodicBandData C}
      (ε : ℝ) (_hFine : IsPeriodicBandFineness P ε)
      (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
      (_hφ : IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ)
      (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (T₁ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane),
      (∀ t, T₁ t = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)) →
      TilesOn D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁)
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ} →
      ∃ Tφ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane,
        (∀ t, Tφ t = mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)) ∧
        TilesOn D.deformedRegion (deformedCenterCarrier Tφ)
          {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ}
proof:
:= by
  intro C P ε hFine φ hφ D T₁ hT₁ hTiles
  let Tφ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane :=
    ⟨fun t => mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2),
      hInjective ε hFine φ hφ D T₁ hT₁ hTiles⟩
  obtain ⟨_henclose, hdisjoint, hslice⟩ :=
    hProper ε hFine φ hφ D T₁ hT₁ hTiles
  let _ : Countable ↥C.centres := P.source_tilesOn.1.to_subtype
  have hcount : (deformedCenterCarrier Tφ).Countable := by
    exact Set.countable_range Tφ
  have hpack : Set.Pairwise (deformedCenterCarrier Tφ)
      (Disjoint on ((· +ᵥ D.deformedRegion.openCarrier) :
        Tiling.Plane → Set Tiling.Plane)) := by
    intro s hs t ht hst
    obtain ⟨s', rfl⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ := ht
    by_cases heq : s' = t'
    · subst heq
      exact False.elim (hst rfl)
    · exact hdisjoint s' t' heq
  have hDmeas : MeasurableSet {z : Tiling.Plane |
      z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ} :=
    (hBaseOpen ε hFine φ hφ).measurableSet.preimage Complex.continuous_re.measurable
  have hslice' : ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume, ∀ᵐ y : ℝ ∂volume,
      (slicePoint Axis.vertical q y ∈
          {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ} ↔
        ∃ s : ↥(deformedCenterCarrier Tφ),
          slicePoint Axis.vertical q y ∈
            (s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ D.deformedRegion.openCarrier) := by
    filter_upwards [hslice] with q hq
    by_cases hqbase : q ∈ deformedBandBase P φ
    · filter_upwards [hq.1 hqbase] with y hy
      constructor
      · intro _
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hy
        exact ⟨⟨Tφ t, ⟨t, rfl⟩⟩, by simpa [Tφ] using ht⟩
      · intro _
        simp [slicePoint, hqbase]
    · filter_upwards [] with y
      constructor
      · intro hz
        exfalso
        apply hqbase
        simpa [slicePoint] using hz
      · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := s.property
        rw [← ht] at hs
        exact False.elim ((hq.2 hqbase y) ⟨t, by simpa [Tφ] using hs⟩)
  have hTile := tilesOn_of_axisSlices D.deformedRegion
    (deformedCenterCarrier Tφ)
    {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ} Axis.vertical
    hDmeas hcount hpack hslice'
  refine ⟨Tφ, ?_, hTile⟩
  intro t
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.periodicBand_secondStageTilesOn
statement:
private theorem periodicBand_secondStageTilesOn :
    ∀ {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} (P : PeriodicBandData C)
      (ε : ℝ) (_hFine : IsPeriodicBandFineness P ε)
      (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
      (_hφ : IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ)
      (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ)
      (T₁ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane),
      (∀ t, T₁ t = mapFirstPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)) →
      TilesOn D.firstRegion (deformedCenterCarrier T₁)
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ} →
      ∃ Tφ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane,
        (∀ t, Tφ t = mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)) ∧
        TilesOn D.deformedRegion (deformedCenterCarrier Tφ)
          {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ deformedBandBase P φ}
proof:
:= by
  intro C P ε hFine φ hφ D T₁ hT₁ hTiles
  exact periodicBand_secondStageTilesOn_of_properCylinderSlices
    (fun {C' : ApproximationContext.{u}} {P' : PeriodicBandData C'}
        (ε' : ℝ) (hFine' : IsPeriodicBandFineness P' ε')
        (φ' : C'.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
        (hφ' : IsEpsilonApproximation C' ε' φ') =>
      (deformedBandBase_geometry P' ε' hFine' φ' hφ').1)
    secondStageCentreMap_injective secondStage_properCylinderSlices
    ε hFine φ hφ D T₁ hT₁ hTiles

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.periodicBandDeformation
statement:
theorem periodicBandDeformation :
    ∀ {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} (P : PeriodicBandData C)
      (ε : ℝ) (_hFine : IsPeriodicBandFineness P ε)
      (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
      (_hφ : IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ)
      (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ),
      ∃ (Tφ : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane) (Xφ : Set ℝ) (αφ : ℝ),
        (∀ t : ↥C.centres, Tφ t = mapPoint φ (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)) ∧
        IsOpen Xφ ∧ interior (closure Xφ) = Xφ ∧ Xφ.Nonempty ∧
        Xφ ≠ Set.univ ∧
        αφ = mapScalar φ ⟨P.period, P.period_mem_coordinateSpace⟩ ∧
        0 < αφ ∧ αφ +ᵥ Xφ = Xφ ∧
        frontier Xφ = Set.range (P.deformedBoundary φ) ∧
        (∀ j : ℤ, P.occupied j = true ↔
          Ioo (P.deformedBoundary φ j) (P.deformedBoundary φ (j + 1)) ⊆ Xφ) ∧
        TilesOn D.deformedRegion (deformedCenterCarrier Tφ)
          {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ Xφ} ∧
        regularSupport D.deformedRegion (deformedCenterCarrier Tφ) =
          {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ Xφ}
proof:
:= by
  intro C P ε hFine φ hφ D
  obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁, hFirstTiles⟩ :=
    periodicBand_firstStageTilesOn P ε hFine φ hφ D
  obtain ⟨Tφ, hTφ, hFullTiles⟩ :=
    periodicBand_secondStageTilesOn P ε hFine φ hφ D T₁ hT₁ hFirstTiles
  obtain ⟨hopen, hregular, hnonempty, hproper, hperiodpos, hperiodic,
      hfrontier, hchamber⟩ := deformedBandBase_geometry P ε hFine φ hφ
  let Xφ : Set ℝ := deformedBandBase P φ
  let αφ : ℝ := mapScalar φ ⟨P.period, P.period_mem_coordinateSpace⟩
  have hopenPlane : IsOpen {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ Xφ} :=
    hopen.preimage Complex.continuous_re
  have hregularPlane : interior (closure {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ Xφ}) =
      {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ Xφ} := by
    change interior (closure (Complex.re ⁻¹' Xφ)) = Complex.re ⁻¹' Xφ
    rw [Complex.closure_preimage_re, Complex.interior_preimage_re, hregular]
  have hsupp := regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn hopenPlane hregularPlane hFullTiles
  refine ⟨Tφ, Xφ, αφ, hTφ, hopen, hregular, hnonempty, hproper, rfl,
    hperiodpos, hperiodic, hfrontier, hchamber, hFullTiles, ?_⟩
  simpa [Xφ] using hsupp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.coe_projectedVertexPairLengthScalar
statement:
private theorem coe_projectedVertexPairLengthScalar (C : ApproximationContext)
    (axis : Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis)
    (e : ↑C.region.vertices × ↑C.region.vertices) :
    (projectedVertexPairLengthScalar C axis e : ℝ) =
      projectedVertexPairLength C axis e
proof:
:= by
  simp only [projectedVertexPairLengthScalar, projectedVertexPairLength]
  split <;> cases axis <;> rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.negative_of_same_sign
statement:
private theorem negative_of_same_sign {x y : ℝ}
    (h : Real.sign x = Real.sign y) (hy : y < 0) : x < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.sign_of_neg hy] at h
  rcases lt_trichotomy x 0 with hx | rfl | hx
  · exact hx
  · simp at h
  · rw [Real.sign_of_pos hx] at h
    norm_num at h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.map_projectedVertexPairLengthScalar
statement:
private theorem map_projectedVertexPairLengthScalar
    {C : ApproximationContext} (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hgood : IsGoodApproximation C phi) (axis : Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis)
    (e : ↑C.region.vertices × ↑C.region.vertices) :
    mapScalar phi (projectedVertexPairLengthScalar C axis e) =
      mappedProjectedVertexPairLength phi axis e
proof:
:= by
  let d := projectedVertexDifferenceScalar C axis e
  let md := Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord axis
    (mapPoint phi (C.vertexPoint e.2.1 e.2.2) -
      mapPoint phi (C.vertexPoint e.1.1 e.1.2))
  have hdval : (d : ℝ) = Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord axis
      ((e.2 : Tiling.Plane) - (e.1 : Tiling.Plane)) := by cases axis <;> rfl
  have hmap : mapScalar phi d = md := by
    cases axis <;>
      simp only [d, projectedVertexDifferenceScalar, md, mapPoint, mapScalar,
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im,
        Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
        mul_zero, mul_one, sub_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
    all_goals
      norm_cast
      rw [← map_sub]
      rfl
  have hsign : Real.sign md = Real.sign (d : ℝ) := by
    rw [hdval]
    exact hgood.preservesVertexCoordinateSign axis e.2 e.1 e.2.2 e.1.2
  change mapScalar phi (projectedVertexPairLengthScalar C axis e) = |md|
  by_cases hd : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ)
  · rw [show projectedVertexPairLengthScalar C axis e = d by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [projectedVertexPairLengthScalar, d, hd, abs_of_nonneg hd]]
    rw [hmap]
    rcases hd.eq_or_lt with hd0 | hdpos
    · have hmd0 : md = 0 := by
        apply Real.sign_eq_zero_iff.mp
        rw [hsign, ← hd0, Real.sign_zero]
      rw [hmd0, abs_zero]
    · rw [abs_of_pos (positive_of_same_sign hsign hdpos)]
  · have hdneg := lt_of_not_ge hd
    rw [show projectedVertexPairLengthScalar C axis e = -d by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [projectedVertexPairLengthScalar, d, hd, abs_of_neg hdneg]]
    simp only [mapScalar, map_neg, Rat.cast_neg]
    change -mapScalar phi d = |md|
    rw [hmap, abs_of_neg (negative_of_same_sign hsign hdneg)]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.deformation_injectiveOnCentres
statement:
theorem deformation_injectiveOnCentres
    {C : ApproximationContext} (P : FLCControlPackage C)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hphi : IsEpsilonApproximation C P.threshold phi) :
    Function.Injective
      (fun t : ↑C.centres ↦ mapPoint phi (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2))
proof:
:= by
  intro s t hst
  let a : ↑C.translatedVertices := ⟨s.1, by
    exact ⟨0, C.zero_mem_vertices, s.1, s.2, zero_add s.1⟩⟩
  let b : ↑C.translatedVertices := ⟨t.1, by
    exact ⟨0, C.zero_mem_vertices, t.1, t.2, zero_add t.1⟩⟩
  have haPoint : C.translatedVertexPoint a = C.centrePoint s.1 s.2 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  have hbPoint : C.translatedVertexPoint b = C.centrePoint t.1 t.2 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  have hab : mapTranslatedVertex phi a = mapTranslatedVertex phi b := by
    rw [mapTranslatedVertex, mapTranslatedVertex, haPoint, hbPoint]
    exact hst
  have := deformation_injectiveOnTranslatedVertices P phi hphi hab
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrArg (fun x : ↑C.translatedVertices ↦ (x : Tiling.Plane)) this

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.deformation_reflectsAxisCoset
statement:
theorem deformation_reflectsAxisCoset
    {C : ApproximationContext} (P : FLCControlPackage C)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hphi : IsEpsilonApproximation C P.threshold phi)
    (axis : Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis)
    (v w : ↑C.translatedVertices)
    (hvw : dist (mapTranslatedVertex phi v)
      (mapTranslatedVertex phi w) < P.scale / 2) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.transverseCoord axis
        ((v : Tiling.Plane) - (w : Tiling.Plane)) = 0 ↔
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.transverseCoord axis
        (mapTranslatedVertex phi v - mapTranslatedVertex phi w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsource := deformation_coarselyProper P phi hphi v w hvw
  have hcontrol : dist (v : Tiling.Plane) w < P.controlRadius :=
    lt_trans hsource P.scale_lt_controlRadius
  cases axis with
  | horizontal =>
      exact (deformation_reflectsFiniteValues P phi hphi
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.vertical v w v w hcontrol hcontrol).2.1.symm
  | vertical =>
      exact (deformation_reflectsFiniteValues P phi hphi
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.horizontal v w v w hcontrol hcontrol).2.1.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.deformation_reflectsBoundedCoordinateDisplacement
statement:
theorem deformation_reflectsBoundedCoordinateDisplacement
    {C : ApproximationContext} (P : FLCControlPackage C)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hphi : IsEpsilonApproximation C P.threshold phi)
    (axis : Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis)
    (v0 w0 v1 w1 : ↑C.translatedVertices)
    (h0 : dist (mapTranslatedVertex phi w0)
      (mapTranslatedVertex phi v0) < P.scale / 2)
    (h1 : dist (mapTranslatedVertex phi w1)
      (mapTranslatedVertex phi v1) < P.scale / 2)
    (hImage :
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord axis
          (mapTranslatedVertex phi w0 - mapTranslatedVertex phi v0) =
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord axis
          (mapTranslatedVertex phi w1 - mapTranslatedVertex phi v1)) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord axis
        ((w0 : Tiling.Plane) - (v0 : Tiling.Plane)) =
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord axis
        ((w1 : Tiling.Plane) - (v1 : Tiling.Plane))
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 := deformation_coarselyProper P phi hphi w0 v0 h0
  have hs1 := deformation_coarselyProper P phi hphi w1 v1 h1
  exact (deformation_reflectsFiniteValues P phi hphi axis w0 v0 w1 v1
    (lt_trans hs0 P.scale_lt_controlRadius)
    (lt_trans hs1 P.scale_lt_controlRadius)).2.2 hImage

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.deformation_reflectsShortProjectedEdgeSum
statement:
theorem deformation_reflectsShortProjectedEdgeSum
    {C : ApproximationContext} (P : FLCControlPackage C)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hphi : IsEpsilonApproximation C P.threshold phi)
    (axis : Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis)
    (n m : ℕ)
    (hn : (n : ℝ) < P.scale) (hm : (m : ℝ) < P.scale)
    (e : Fin n → (↑C.region.vertices × ↑C.region.vertices))
    (f : Fin m → (↑C.region.vertices × ↑C.region.vertices))
    (he : ∀ j : Fin n,
      (e j).1 ≠ (e j).2 ∧
        openSegment ℝ ((e j).1 : Tiling.Plane)
            ((e j).2 : Tiling.Plane) ⊆ frontier C.region.openCarrier ∧
        ∀ u : ↑C.region.vertices,
          (u : Tiling.Plane) ∉
            openSegment ℝ ((e j).1 : Tiling.Plane)
              ((e j).2 : Tiling.Plane))
    (hf : ∀ j : Fin m,
      (f j).1 ≠ (f j).2 ∧
        openSegment ℝ ((f j).1 : Tiling.Plane)
            ((f j).2 : Tiling.Plane) ⊆ frontier C.region.openCarrier ∧
        ∀ u : ↑C.region.vertices,
          (u : Tiling.Plane) ∉
            openSegment ℝ ((f j).1 : Tiling.Plane)
              ((f j).2 : Tiling.Plane))
    (hImage :
      Finset.univ.sum
          (mappedProjectedVertexPairLength phi axis ∘ e) =
        Finset.univ.sum
          (mappedProjectedVertexPairLength phi axis ∘ f)) :
    Finset.univ.sum (projectedVertexPairLength C axis ∘ e) =
      Finset.univ.sum (projectedVertexPairLength C axis ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  let se : C.coordinateSpace :=
    ∑ j : Fin n, projectedVertexPairLengthScalar C axis (e j)
  let sf : C.coordinateSpace :=
    ∑ j : Fin m, projectedVertexPairLengthScalar C axis (f j)
  let z : C.coordinateSpace := se - sf
  have hseVal : (se : ℝ) =
      Finset.univ.sum (projectedVertexPairLength C axis ∘ e) := by
    simp only [se, Submodule.coe_sum, Function.comp_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    exact coe_projectedVertexPairLengthScalar C axis (e j)
  have hsfVal : (sf : ℝ) =
      Finset.univ.sum (projectedVertexPairLength C axis ∘ f) := by
    simp only [sf, Submodule.coe_sum, Function.comp_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    exact coe_projectedVertexPairLengthScalar C axis (f j)
  have hzShort : z ∈ shortProjectedEdgeSumDifferences C P.scale := by
    refine ⟨axis, n, m, hn, hm, e, f, he, hf, ?_⟩
    change (se : ℝ) - (sf : ℝ) = _
    rw [hseVal, hsfVal]
  have hzEdge : z ∈ P.edgeSumAlphabet := by
    have hzSet : z ∈ (P.edgeSumAlphabet : Set C.coordinateSpace) := by
      rw [P.edgeSumAlphabet_exact]
      exact hzShort
    exact hzSet
  have hzControl : z ∈ P.scalarAlphabet ∪ P.edgeSumAlphabet :=
    Finset.mem_union_right _ hzEdge
  have hmapSe : mapScalar phi se =
      Finset.univ.sum (mappedProjectedVertexPairLength phi axis ∘ e) := by
    simp only [se, mapScalar, map_sum, Rat.cast_sum, Function.comp_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    exact map_projectedVertexPairLengthScalar phi (P.forces_good phi hphi) axis (e j)
  have hmapSf : mapScalar phi sf =
      Finset.univ.sum (mappedProjectedVertexPairLength phi axis ∘ f) := by
    simp only [sf, mapScalar, map_sum, Rat.cast_sum, Function.comp_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    exact map_projectedVertexPairLengthScalar phi (P.forces_good phi hphi) axis (f j)
  have hmapZero : mapScalar phi z = 0 := by
    simp only [z, mapScalar, map_sub, Rat.cast_sub]
    change mapScalar phi se - mapScalar phi sf = 0
    rw [hmapSe, hmapSf, sub_eq_zero]
    exact hImage
  have hzZero : (z : ℝ) = 0 :=
    (P.scalar_zero_iff phi hphi z hzControl).mp hmapZero
  change (se : ℝ) - (sf : ℝ) = 0 at hzZero
  rw [hseVal, hsfVal, sub_eq_zero] at hzZero
  exact hzZero

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.sub_mem_uIcc_iff
statement:
private theorem sub_mem_uIcc_iff (a x p q : ℝ) :
    -a + x ∈ Set.uIcc p q ↔ x ∈ Set.uIcc (a + p) (a + q)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Set.mem_uIcc]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h)
    · left; constructor <;> linarith
    · right; constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro (h | h)
    · left; constructor <;> linarith
    · right; constructor <;> linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.vadd_rectangle
statement:
private theorem vadd_rectangle (a p q : Tiling.Plane) :
    a +ᵥ Complex.Rectangle p q = Complex.Rectangle (a + p) (a + q)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [Complex.Rectangle, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem,
    Complex.mem_reProdIm, vadd_eq_add, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
    Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im, sub_mem_uIcc_iff]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Region.vadd_openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  change interior (a +ᵥ K.support) = a +ᵥ interior K.support
  rw [interior_vadd]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Region.vadd_vertices
proof:
:= by

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Region.eq_of_support_eq
statement:
private theorem Region.eq_of_support_eq {K L : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region}
    (h : K.support = L.support) : K = L
proof:
:= by
  cases K with
  | mk K hK =>
    cases L with
    | mk L hL =>
      simp only [Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.mk.injEq]
      cases K with
      | mk Ks Kp Kn =>
        cases L with
        | mk Ls Lp Ln =>
          simpa only [Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.mk.injEq] using h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.vadd_neg_vadd_set
statement:
private theorem vadd_neg_vadd_set (a : Tiling.Plane) (S : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    (-a) +ᵥ (a +ᵥ S) = S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, neg_neg, vadd_eq_add]
  constructor <;> intro hx
  · convert hx using 1
    all_goals abel
  · convert hx using 1
    all_goals abel

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.add_vadd_set
statement:
private theorem add_vadd_set (a b : Tiling.Plane) (S : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    a +ᵥ (b +ᵥ S) = (a + b) +ᵥ S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
  constructor <;> intro hx
  · convert hx using 1
    all_goals abel
  · convert hx using 1
    all_goals abel

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.vaddRegion_neg_vadd
statement:
private theorem vaddRegion_neg_vadd (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region)
    (a : Tiling.Plane) : vaddRegion (vaddRegion K a) (-a) = K
proof:
:= by
  apply Region.eq_of_support_eq
  exact vadd_neg_vadd_set a K.support

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.tilesOn_vadd
statement:
private theorem tilesOn_vadd
    (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region) (S D : Set Tiling.Plane)
    (a b : Tiling.Plane) (h : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K S D) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn (vaddRegion K a) (b +ᵥ S) ((a + b) +ᵥ D)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hset : b +ᵥ S = (fun s : Tiling.Plane ↦ b + s) '' S := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        exact ⟨-b + x, by
          simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using hx,
          by abel_nf⟩
      · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
        simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
          neg_add_cancel_left] using hs
    rw [hset]
    exact h.1.image _
  · intro i hi j hj hij
    let i₀ : Tiling.Placement Tiling.Plane Unit := (-b + i.1, ())
    let j₀ : Tiling.Placement Tiling.Plane Unit := (-b + j.1, ())
    have hi₀ : i₀ ∈ K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S := by
      change -b + i.1 ∈ S
      change i.1 ∈ b +ᵥ S at hi
      simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using hi
    have hj₀ : j₀ ∈ K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S := by
      change -b + j.1 ∈ S
      change j.1 ∈ b +ᵥ S at hj
      simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using hj
    have hij₀ : i₀ ≠ j₀ := by
      intro heq
      apply hij
      apply Prod.ext
      · have := congrArg Prod.fst heq
        dsimp only [i₀, j₀] at this
        linear_combination this
      · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    have hd := h.2.1 hi₀ hj₀ hij₀
    have hd' := Tiling.aedisjoint_vadd (a + b) hd
    have hiTile :
        (a + b) +ᵥ ((-b + i.1) +ᵥ K.support) =
          i.1 +ᵥ (a +ᵥ K.support) := by
      rw [add_vadd_set, add_vadd_set]
      congr 1
      abel
    have hjTile :
        (a + b) +ᵥ ((-b + j.1) +ᵥ K.support) =
          j.1 +ᵥ (a +ᵥ K.support) := by
      rw [add_vadd_set, add_vadd_set]
      congr 1
      abel
    change MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint MeasureTheory.volume
      (i.1 +ᵥ (a +ᵥ K.support)) (j.1 +ᵥ (a +ᵥ K.support))
    rw [← hiTile, ← hjTile]
    exact hd'
  · have hpull :=
      (MeasureTheory.quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left MeasureTheory.volume (-(a + b))).ae h.2.2
    filter_upwards [hpull] with x hx
    have htarget : x ∈ (a + b) +ᵥ D ↔ -(a + b) + x ∈ D := by
      simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
    have hunion :
        (∃ s : b +ᵥ S,
            x ∈ ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ (vaddRegion K a).openCarrier)) ↔
          ∃ s : S, -(a + b) + x ∈ ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) := by
      rw [Region.vadd_openCarrier]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨s, hsx⟩
        let s₀ : S := ⟨-b + s.1, by
          simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using s.2⟩
        refine ⟨s₀, ?_⟩
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hsx ⊢
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hsx
        convert hsx using 1
        all_goals
          simp only [s₀, vadd_eq_add]
          abel
      · rintro ⟨s, hsx⟩
        let s' : b +ᵥ S := ⟨b + s.1, by
          simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
            neg_add_cancel_left] using s.2⟩
        refine ⟨s', ?_⟩
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hsx ⊢
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
        convert hsx using 1
        all_goals
          simp only [s', vadd_eq_add]
          abel
    exact htarget.trans (hx.trans hunion.symm)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.tilesOn_vadd_iff
statement:
private theorem tilesOn_vadd_iff
    (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region) (S D : Set Tiling.Plane)
    (a b : Tiling.Plane) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K S D ↔
      Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn (vaddRegion K a) (b +ᵥ S) ((a + b) +ᵥ D)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact tilesOn_vadd K S D a b
  · intro h
    have hback := tilesOn_vadd (vaddRegion K a) (b +ᵥ S) ((a + b) +ᵥ D)
      (-a) (-b) h
    rw [vaddRegion_neg_vadd, vadd_neg_vadd_set, add_vadd_set,
      show -a + -b + (a + b) = 0 by abel, zero_vadd] at hback
    exact hback

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.normalizeApproximationContext
statement:
theorem normalizeApproximationContext.{u}
    (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region) (T E : Set Tiling.Plane)
    (v₀ : Tiling.Plane) (hv₀ : v₀ ∈ K.vertices)
    (t₀ : Tiling.Plane) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ T) :
    ∃ C : ApproximationContext.{u},
      C.region.openCarrier = (-v₀) +ᵥ K.openCarrier ∧
      C.centres = (-t₀) +ᵥ T ∧
      C.target = (-(v₀ + t₀)) +ᵥ E ∧
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T E ↔
        Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn C.region C.centres C.target)
proof:
:= by
  let K' := vaddRegion K (-v₀)
  let T' := (-t₀) +ᵥ T
  let E' := (-(v₀ + t₀)) +ᵥ E
  have hzeroVertices : (0 : Tiling.Plane) ∈ K'.vertices := by
    rw [show K'.vertices = (-v₀) +ᵥ K.vertices by
      exact Region.vadd_vertices K (-v₀)]
    simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, neg_neg, zero_vadd,
      vadd_eq_add, add_zero] using hv₀
  have hzeroCentres : (0 : Tiling.Plane) ∈ T' := by
    simpa only [T', Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, neg_neg, zero_vadd,
      vadd_eq_add, add_zero] using ht₀
  let V : Submodule ℚ ℝ := Submodule.span ℚ
    {r : ℝ | ∃ (axis : Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis) (a b : Tiling.Plane),
      (∃ v ∈ K'.vertices, ∃ t ∈ T', a = v + t) ∧
      (∃ v ∈ K'.vertices, ∃ t ∈ T', b = v + t) ∧
      r = Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord axis (a - b)}
  have vertex_re_mem : ∀ v ∈ K'.vertices, v.re ∈ V := by
    intro v hv
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    refine ⟨Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.horizontal, v, 0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨v, hv, 0, hzeroCentres, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨0, hzeroVertices, 0, hzeroCentres, by simp⟩
    · simp [Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord]
  have vertex_im_mem : ∀ v ∈ K'.vertices, v.im ∈ V := by
    intro v hv
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    refine ⟨Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.vertical, v, 0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨v, hv, 0, hzeroCentres, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨0, hzeroVertices, 0, hzeroCentres, by simp⟩
    · simp [Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord]
  have centre_re_mem : ∀ t ∈ T', t.re ∈ V := by
    intro t ht
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    refine ⟨Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.horizontal, t, 0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨0, hzeroVertices, t, ht, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨0, hzeroVertices, 0, hzeroCentres, by simp⟩
    · simp [Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord]
  have centre_im_mem : ∀ t ∈ T', t.im ∈ V := by
    intro t ht
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    refine ⟨Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.vertical, t, 0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨0, hzeroVertices, t, ht, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨0, hzeroVertices, 0, hzeroCentres, by simp⟩
    · simp [Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord]
  let C : ApproximationContext.{u} := {
    region := K'
    centres := T'
    target := E'
    zero_mem_vertices := hzeroVertices
    zero_mem_centres := hzeroCentres
    coordinateSpace := V
    basisIndex := ULift.{u} (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℚ V)
    basis := (Module.Free.chooseBasis ℚ V).reindex Equiv.ulift.symm
    coordinateSpace_eq_span := rfl
    vertex_re_mem := vertex_re_mem
    vertex_im_mem := vertex_im_mem
    centre_re_mem := centre_re_mem
    centre_im_mem := centre_im_mem }
  refine ⟨C, ?_, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  · exact Region.vadd_openCarrier K (-v₀)
  · have h := tilesOn_vadd_iff K T E (-v₀) (-t₀)
    have hab : -v₀ + -t₀ = -(v₀ + t₀) := by abel
    simpa only [C, K', T', E', hab] using h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.basisWeight_nonneg
statement:
private theorem basisWeight_nonneg (C : ApproximationContext) (z : C.coordinateSpace) :
    0 ≤ basisWeight C z
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ abs_nonneg _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar_sub_eq_sum
statement:
private theorem mapScalar_sub_eq_sum
    (C : ApproximationContext) (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (z : C.coordinateSpace) :
    mapScalar φ z - (z : ℝ) =
      ∑ j ∈ (C.basis.repr z).support,
        ((C.basis.repr z j) : ℝ) *
          (mapScalar φ (C.basis j) - ((C.basis j : C.coordinateSpace) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hz :
      ∑ j ∈ (C.basis.repr z).support, (C.basis.repr z j) • C.basis j = z := by
    simpa only [C.basis.repr_symm_apply, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum] using
      C.basis.repr.symm_apply_apply z
  have hφrat := congrArg φ hz
  have hcoe := congrArg (fun w : C.coordinateSpace ↦ (w : ℝ)) hz
  have hφ :
      ((φ z) : ℝ) = ∑ j ∈ (C.basis.repr z).support,
        ((C.basis.repr z j) : ℝ) * ((φ (C.basis j)) : ℝ) := by
    rw [← hφrat]
    simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, Rat.smul_def, Rat.cast_sum,
      Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_id]
  have hval :
      (z : ℝ) = ∑ j ∈ (C.basis.repr z).support,
        ((C.basis.repr z j) : ℝ) * ((C.basis j : C.coordinateSpace) : ℝ) := by
    rw [← hcoe]
    simp only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower, Rat.smul_def]
  simp only [mapScalar]
  rw [hφ, hval]
  simp_rw [mul_sub]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.exists_epsilonApproximation_of_one_not_mem
statement:
private theorem exists_epsilonApproximation_of_one_not_mem
    (C : ApproximationContext) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hone : (1 : ℝ) ∉ C.coordinateSpace) :
    ∃ φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ
proof:
:= by
  choose f hf using fun j : C.basisIndex ↦
    exists_rat_near (((C.basis j : C.coordinateSpace) : ℝ)) hε
  let φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ := C.basis.constr ℚ f
  refine ⟨φ, ⟨hε, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro q hq
    by_cases hq0 : q = 0
    · subst q
      have hzero : (⟨(((0 : ℚ) : ℝ)), hq⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) = 0 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        norm_num
      rw [hzero]
      exact map_zero φ
    · exfalso
      apply hone
      have hscaled := C.coordinateSpace.smul_mem q⁻¹ hq
      simpa [Rat.smul_def, hq0] using hscaled
  · intro j
    simpa only [φ, C.basis.constr_basis, abs_sub_comm] using hf j

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.exists_epsilonApproximation
statement:
theorem exists_epsilonApproximation (C : ApproximationContext) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsEpsilonApproximation C ε φ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hone : (1 : ℝ) ∈ C.coordinateSpace
  · let one : C.coordinateSpace := ⟨1, hone⟩
    let r := C.basis.repr one
    have hone0 : one ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg Subtype.val h
      norm_num [one] at this
    have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hone0
      apply C.basis.repr.injective
      simpa only [r, map_zero] using h
    have hrsupp : r.support.Nonempty := Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff.mpr hr0
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := hrsupp
    have hc : r j₀ ≠ 0 := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hj₀
    let S : ℝ := ∑ j ∈ r.support.erase j₀, |((r j) : ℝ)|
    have hS : 0 ≤ S := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ abs_nonneg _
    let R : ℝ := ε * |((r j₀) : ℝ)| / (S + 1)
    let δ : ℝ := min ε R / 2
    have hcR : ((r j₀ : ℚ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hc
    have hR : 0 < R := by
      exact div_pos (mul_pos hε (abs_pos.mpr hcR)) (by linarith)
    have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos (lt_min hε hR) (by norm_num)
    choose g hg using fun j : C.basisIndex ↦
      exists_rat_near (((C.basis j : C.coordinateSpace) : ℝ)) hδ
    let A : ℚ := ∑ j ∈ r.support.erase j₀, r j * g j
    let f : C.basisIndex → ℚ := fun j ↦
      if j = j₀ then (r j₀)⁻¹ * (1 - A) else g j
    let φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ := C.basis.constr ℚ f
    have hφone : φ one = 1 := by
      simp only [φ, C.basis.constr_apply, Finsupp.sum]
      change ∑ x ∈ r.support, r x * f x = 1
      rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ hj₀]
      have herase : ∑ x ∈ r.support.erase j₀, r x * f x = A := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro x hx
        have hxne : x ≠ j₀ := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hx).1
        simp only [f, if_neg hxne, A]
      rw [herase]
      simp only [f, if_pos]
      have hinv : r j₀ * (r j₀)⁻¹ = 1 := by exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hc
      calc
        A + r j₀ * ((r j₀)⁻¹ * (1 - A)) =
            A + (r j₀ * (r j₀)⁻¹) * (1 - A) := by ring
        _ = 1 := by rw [hinv]; ring
    refine ⟨φ, ⟨hε, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · intro q hq
      have hqeq : (⟨(q : ℝ), hq⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) = q • one := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp [one, Rat.smul_def]
      rw [hqeq, map_smul, hφone]
      simp
    · intro j
      simp only [φ, C.basis.constr_basis]
      by_cases hj : j = j₀
      · subst j
        simp only [f, if_pos]
        have honeExpansion :
            (1 : ℝ) = ∑ j ∈ r.support,
              ((r j) : ℝ) * ((C.basis j : C.coordinateSpace) : ℝ) := by
          have hrrepr :
              ∑ j ∈ r.support, (r j) • C.basis j = one := by
            simpa only [r, C.basis.repr_symm_apply, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,
              Finsupp.sum] using C.basis.repr.symm_apply_apply one
          have := congrArg (fun z : C.coordinateSpace ↦ (z : ℝ)) hrrepr
          simpa only [one, Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower,
            Rat.smul_def] using this.symm
        have honeSplit :
            (1 : ℝ) = ((r j₀) : ℝ) * ((C.basis j₀ : C.coordinateSpace) : ℝ) +
              ∑ j ∈ r.support.erase j₀,
                ((r j) : ℝ) * ((C.basis j : C.coordinateSpace) : ℝ) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ hj₀] at honeExpansion
          linarith
        let B : ℝ := ∑ j ∈ r.support.erase j₀,
          ((r j) : ℝ) * ((C.basis j : C.coordinateSpace) : ℝ)
        let G : ℝ := ∑ j ∈ r.support.erase j₀,
          ((r j) : ℝ) * ((g j) : ℝ)
        change (1 : ℝ) = ((r j₀) : ℝ) *
          ((C.basis j₀ : C.coordinateSpace) : ℝ) + B at honeSplit
        have hcastA : ((A : ℚ) : ℝ) = G := by
          simp only [A, G, Rat.cast_sum, Rat.cast_mul]
        have hpivot :
            (((r j₀)⁻¹ * (1 - A) : ℚ) : ℝ) -
                ((C.basis j₀ : C.coordinateSpace) : ℝ) =
              (((r j₀ : ℚ) : ℝ))⁻¹ * (B - G) := by
          rw [Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_inv, Rat.cast_sub, Rat.cast_one, hcastA]
          field_simp [hcR]
          nlinarith
        rw [hpivot, abs_mul]
        have hsum : |B - G| ≤ S * δ := by
          have hBG : B - G = ∑ j ∈ r.support.erase j₀,
              ((r j) : ℝ) *
                (((C.basis j : C.coordinateSpace) : ℝ) - ((g j) : ℝ)) := by
            simp only [B, G]
            simp_rw [mul_sub]
            rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
          rw [hBG]
          calc
            |∑ j ∈ r.support.erase j₀,
                ((r j) : ℝ) *
                  (((C.basis j : C.coordinateSpace) : ℝ) - ((g j) : ℝ))|
