  by_cases hy : y ∈ t
  · let Y : ↑t := ⟨y, hy⟩
    refine ⟨(sourceKnot s f Y).1, ?_⟩
    rw [finiteExtension_at_knot]
    exact sourceKnot_value s f Y
  by_cases hl : ∃ v ∈ t, v < y
  · by_cases hr : ∃ v ∈ t, y < v
    · let P : ↑t := ⟨leftKnot t y hl, (leftKnot_spec t y hl).1⟩
      let Q : ↑t := ⟨rightKnot t y hr, (rightKnot_spec t y hr).1⟩
      have hPy : P.1 < y := (leftKnot_spec t y hl).2.1
      have hyQ : y < Q.1 := (rightKnot_spec t y hr).2.1
      have hPQ : ConsecutiveKnots P Q := by
        constructor
        · exact hPy.trans hyQ
        · intro R hR
          rcases lt_trichotomy R.1 y with hRy | hEq | hyR
          · exact (not_le_of_gt hR.1) ((leftKnot_spec t y hl).2.2 R.1 R.2 hRy)
          · exact hy (hEq ▸ R.2)
          · exact (not_le_of_gt hR.2) ((rightKnot_spec t y hr).2.2 R.1 R.2 hyR)
      let p := sourceKnot s f P
      let q := sourceKnot s f Q
      have hpq : ConsecutiveKnots p q :=
        source_consecutive_of_target_consecutive s f hf P Q hPQ
      let x := p.1 + ((q.1 - p.1) / (Q.1 - P.1)) * (y - P.1)
      have hden : 0 < Q.1 - P.1 := sub_pos.mpr hPQ.1
      have hsden : 0 < q.1 - p.1 := sub_pos.mpr hpq.1
      have hm : 0 < (q.1 - p.1) / (Q.1 - P.1) := div_pos hsden hden
      have hmul : ((q.1 - p.1) / (Q.1 - P.1)) * (Q.1 - P.1) = q.1 - p.1 :=
        div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hden)
      have hpx : p.1 ≤ x := by
        dsimp [x]
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg hm.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hPy.le))
      have hxq : x ≤ q.1 := by
        dsimp [x]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hm.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hyQ.le)]
      refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
      rw [finiteExtension_on_gap s f p q hpq x ⟨hpx, hxq⟩]
      rw [sourceKnot_value s f P, sourceKnot_value s f Q]
      dsimp [x]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hden, ne_of_gt hsden]
      ring
    · let P : ↑t := ⟨leftKnot t y hl, (leftKnot_spec t y hl).1⟩
      let p := sourceKnot s f P
      have hPmax : ∀ R : ↑t, R.1 ≤ P.1 := by
        intro R
        by_contra h
        have hPR : P.1 < R.1 := lt_of_not_ge h
        have hnotRy : ¬ R.1 < y := fun hRy ↦
          (not_le_of_gt hPR) ((leftKnot_spec t y hl).2.2 R.1 R.2 hRy)
        have hyR : y < R.1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hnotRy)
          (fun hEq ↦ hy (hEq ▸ R.2))
        exact hr ⟨R.1, R.2, hyR⟩
      have hpmax := source_maximum_of_target_maximum s f hf P hPmax
      let x := p.1 + (y - P.1)
      have hpx : p.1 ≤ x := by dsimp [x]; linarith [(leftKnot_spec t y hl).2.1]
      refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
      rw [finiteExtension_right s f p hpmax x hpx, sourceKnot_value s f P]
      dsimp [x]
      ring
  · by_cases hr : ∃ v ∈ t, y < v
    · let Q : ↑t := ⟨rightKnot t y hr, (rightKnot_spec t y hr).1⟩
      let q := sourceKnot s f Q
      have hQmin : ∀ R : ↑t, Q.1 ≤ R.1 := by
        intro R
        by_contra h
        have hRQ : R.1 < Q.1 := lt_of_not_ge h
        have hnotyR : ¬ y < R.1 := fun hyR ↦
          (not_le_of_gt hRQ) ((rightKnot_spec t y hr).2.2 R.1 R.2 hyR)
        have hRy : R.1 < y := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hnotyR)
          (fun hEq ↦ hy (hEq.symm ▸ R.2))
        exact hl ⟨R.1, R.2, hRy⟩
      have hqmin := source_minimum_of_target_minimum s f hf Q hQmin
      let x := q.1 + (y - Q.1)
      have hxq : x ≤ q.1 := by dsimp [x]; linarith [(rightKnot_spec t y hr).2.1]
      refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
      rw [finiteExtension_left s f q hqmin x hxq, sourceKnot_value s f Q]
      dsimp [x]
      ring
    · have hs : s = ∅ := by
        by_contra hs
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hs
        have htarget : f ⟨x, hx⟩ ∈ t := target_mem s f ⟨x, hx⟩
        rcases lt_trichotomy (f ⟨x, hx⟩) y with hxy | hxy | hyx
        · exact hl ⟨f ⟨x, hx⟩, htarget, hxy⟩
        · exact hy (hxy ▸ htarget)
        · exact hr ⟨f ⟨x, hx⟩, htarget, hyx⟩
      refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
      rw [finiteExtension]
      simp [hs]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.exists_slopeOnePiecewiseAffineExtension
statement:
theorem exists_slopeOnePiecewiseAffineExtension
    (s : Finset ℝ) (f : ↑s → ℝ) (hf : StrictMono f) :
    ∃ h : ℝ → ℝ,
      IsFinitePiecewiseAffineExtension s f h ∧ StrictMono h ∧
        Function.Surjective h
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨finiteExtension s f, ?_, finiteExtension_strictMono s f hf,
    finiteExtension_surjective s f hf⟩
  refine ⟨finiteExtension_at_knot s f, finiteExtension_on_gap s f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact finiteExtension_left s f
  · exact finiteExtension_right s f

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.exists_strictMonoHomeomorph_extension
statement:
theorem exists_strictMonoHomeomorph_extension
    (s : Finset ℝ) (f : ↑s → ℝ) (hf : StrictMono f) :
    ∃ h : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ, StrictMono h ∧ ∀ x : ↑s, h x = f x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hspec, hmono, hsurj⟩ :=
    exists_slopeOnePiecewiseAffineExtension s f hf
  let e : ℝ ≃o ℝ :=
    { toEquiv := Equiv.ofBijective h ⟨hmono.injective, hsurj⟩
      map_rel_iff' := hmono.le_iff_le }
  refine ⟨e.toHomeomorph, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact e.strictMono
  · intro x
    change h x = f x
    exact hspec.1 x

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.periodic_shift_iterate
proof:
:= by
  induction q using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | @succ q ih =>
      rw [show j + (q + 1) * Int.ofNat n =
        (j + q * Int.ofNat n) + Int.ofNat n by ring,
        hshift (j + q * Int.ofNat n), ih]
      push_cast
      ring_nf
  | @pred q ih =>
      have hprev := hshift (j + (-(q : ℤ) - 1) * Int.ofNat n)
      have hprev' : f (j + (-(q : ℤ) - 1) * Int.ofNat n) =
          f (j + (-(q : ℤ)) * Int.ofNat n) - p := by
        rw [show j + (-(q : ℤ) - 1) * Int.ofNat n + Int.ofNat n =
          j + (-(q : ℤ)) * Int.ofNat n by ring] at hprev
        linarith
      rw [show j + (-(q : ℤ) - (1 : ℤ)) * Int.ofNat n =
        j + (-(q : ℤ) - 1) * Int.ofNat n by ring, hprev']
      rw [ih]
      push_cast
      ring_nf

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.periodicAffineInterpolation_core
statement:
private theorem periodicAffineInterpolation_core :
    periodicAffineInterpolationSpec
proof:
:= by
  intro n p q x y _hn _hp hq hx hy hxp hyp hxc hyc
  let N : ℤ := Int.ofNat n
  let S : Finset ℝ := Finset.univ.image (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => x (i : ℤ))
  have hxi : Function.Injective (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => x (i : ℤ)) := by
    intro i j hij
    by_contra hne
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
    · exact (ne_of_lt (hx (show (i : ℤ) < j by exact_mod_cast hlt))) hij
    · exact (ne_of_gt (hx (show (j : ℤ) < i by exact_mod_cast hgt))) hij
  have hScard : S.card = n + 1 := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hxi, Finset.card_univ]
    simp
  let index : ↥S → Fin (n + 1) := fun z =>
    Classical.choose (Finset.mem_image.mp z.property)
  have index_spec (z : ↥S) : x (index z : ℤ) = z :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.mem_image.mp z.property)).2
  let f : ↥S → ℝ := fun z => y (index z : ℤ)
  have hf : StrictMono f := by
    intro a b hab
    have hindex_le : index a ≤ index b := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hgt : index b < index a := lt_of_not_ge hnot
      have hba : b < a := by
        change (b : ℝ) < (a : ℝ)
        rw [← index_spec b, ← index_spec a]
        exact hx (by exact_mod_cast hgt)
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hab.le) hba
    have hindex_ne : index a ≠ index b := by
      intro heq
      apply hab.ne
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [← index_spec a, ← index_spec b, heq]
    have hindex_lt : index a < index b := lt_of_le_of_ne hindex_le hindex_ne
    exact hy (by exact_mod_cast hindex_lt)
  obtain ⟨g, hgm, hge⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.exists_strictMonoHomeomorph_extension S f hf
  have hge' (i : Fin (n + 1)) : g (x (i : ℤ)) = y (i : ℤ) := by
    have hmem : x (i : ℤ) ∈ S := by
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    let z : ↥S := ⟨x (i : ℤ), hmem⟩
    rw [hge z]
    have hi : index z = i := by
      apply hxi
      change x (index z : ℤ) = x (i : ℤ)
      rw [index_spec z]
    change y (index z : ℤ) = y (i : ℤ)
    rw [hi]
  have hgn (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
      g (x (i : ℤ)) = y (i : ℤ) := hge' i
  have hleft : g (x 0) = y 0 := by simpa using hgn 0
  have hright : g (x N) = y N := by
    have hi : (n : ℤ) = N := by rfl
    simpa [hi] using hgn ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩
  have hxN : x N = x 0 + p := by
    simpa [N] using hxp 0
  have hyN : y N = y 0 + q := by
    simpa [N] using hyp 0
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun z =>
    let k : ℤ := ⌊(z - x 0) / p⌋
    let r : ℝ := z - (k : ℝ) * p
    g r + (k : ℝ) * q
  have F_period (z : ℝ) : F (z + p) = F z + q := by
    have hfloor :
        ⌊((z + p - x 0) / p : ℝ)⌋ =
          ⌊((z - x 0) / p : ℝ)⌋ + 1 := by
      rw [show (z + p - x 0) / p = (z - x 0) / p + 1 by
        field_simp
        ring, Int.floor_add_one]
    simp only [F]
    rw [hfloor]
    push_cast
    ring_nf
  have F_shift (k : ℤ) (z : ℝ) :
      F (z + (k : ℝ) * p) = F z + (k : ℝ) * q := by
    induction k using Int.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | @succ k ih =>
        push_cast at ih ⊢
        calc
          F (z + (k + 1 : ℝ) * p) =
              F ((z + (k : ℝ) * p) + p) := by ring_nf
          _ = F (z + (k : ℝ) * p) + q := F_period _
          _ = F z + (k + 1 : ℝ) * q := by rw [ih]; ring
    | @pred k ih =>
        push_cast at ih ⊢
        calc
          F (z + (-k - 1 : ℝ) * p) =
              F ((z + (-k - 1 : ℝ) * p) + p) - q := by
                rw [F_period]
                ring_nf
          _ = F (z + (-k : ℝ) * p) - q := by congr 1; ring_nf
          _ = F z + (-k - 1 : ℝ) * q := by rw [ih]; ring_nf
  have F_knots (j : ℤ) : F (x j) = y j := by
    let r : ℤ := j % N
    let k : ℤ := j / N
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := by
      dsimp [r]
      exact Int.emod_nonneg _ (by
        dsimp [N]
        exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt _hn))
    have hrN : r < N := by
      dsimp [r]
      exact Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ (by
        dsimp [N]
        exact_mod_cast _hn)
    let i : Fin n := ⟨r.toNat, by
      have : r.toNat < N.toNat := (Int.toNat_lt hr0).2 hrN
      simpa [N] using this⟩
    have hir : (i : ℤ) = r := by
      change (r.toNat : ℤ) = r
      exact Int.toNat_of_nonneg hr0
    have hj : j = (i : ℤ) + k * N := by
      have hd : r + N * k = j := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv j N
      rw [← hd, ← hir]
      ring_nf
    have hxshift : x j = x (i : ℤ) + (k : ℝ) * p := by
      rw [hj]
      simpa [N] using periodic_shift_iterate (f := x) (n := n) hxp k (i : ℤ)
    have hyshift : y j = y (i : ℤ) + (k : ℝ) * q := by
      rw [hj]
      simpa [N] using periodic_shift_iterate (f := y) (n := n) hyp k (i : ℤ)
    have hxi0 : x 0 ≤ x (i : ℤ) := by
      apply hx.monotone
      exact_mod_cast i.1.zero_le
    have hxin : x (i : ℤ) < x N := by
      apply hx
      dsimp [N]
      exact_mod_cast i.2
    have hfloor : ⌊((x (i : ℤ) - x 0) / p : ℝ)⌋ = 0 := by
      apply (Int.floor_eq_iff).2
      constructor
      · simpa using (div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hxi0) _hp.le)
      · simpa using (div_lt_one _hp).2 (by linarith [hxin, hxN])
    have hFfund : F (x (i : ℤ)) = y (i : ℤ) := by
      simp only [F]
      rw [hfloor]
      simp only [Int.cast_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, add_zero]
      exact hgn ⟨i.1, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.2⟩
    rw [hxshift, F_shift, hFfund, hyshift]
  have F_strictMono : StrictMono F := by
    intro z w hzw
    let kz : ℤ := ⌊(z - x 0) / p⌋
    let kw : ℤ := ⌊(w - x 0) / p⌋
    let rz : ℝ := z - (kz : ℝ) * p
    let rw : ℝ := w - (kw : ℝ) * p
    have hFz : F z = g rz + (kz : ℝ) * q := by simp [F, kz, rz]
    have hFw : F w = g rw + (kw : ℝ) * q := by simp [F, kw, rw]
    have hk : kz ≤ kw := by
      apply Int.floor_mono
      gcongr
    have hrzlo : x 0 ≤ rz := by
      dsimp [rz, kz]
      have h := Int.floor_le ((z - x 0) / p)
      have h' := (le_div_iff₀ _hp).mp h
      linarith
    have hrzhi : rz < x 0 + p := by
      dsimp [rz, kz]
      have h := Int.lt_floor_add_one ((z - x 0) / p)
      have h' := (div_lt_iff₀ _hp).mp h
      linarith
    have hrwlo : x 0 ≤ rw := by
      dsimp [rw, kw]
      have h := Int.floor_le ((w - x 0) / p)
      have h' := (le_div_iff₀ _hp).mp h
      linarith
    have hrwhi : rw < x 0 + p := by
      dsimp [rw, kw]
      have h := Int.lt_floor_add_one ((w - x 0) / p)
      have h' := (div_lt_iff₀ _hp).mp h
      linarith
    by_cases hkeq : kz = kw
    · have hr : rz < rw := by
        dsimp [rz, rw]
        rw [hkeq]
        linarith
      rw [hFz, hFw]
      rw [hkeq]
      exact add_lt_add_left (hgm hr) _
    · have hkl : kz < kw := lt_of_le_of_ne hk hkeq
      have hgz : g rz < y 0 + q := by
        calc
          g rz < g (x N) := hgm (hrzhi.trans_eq hxN.symm)
          _ = y 0 + q := by rw [hright, hyN]
      have hgw : y 0 ≤ g rw := by
        rw [← hleft]
        apply hgm.monotone
        exact hrwlo
      rw [hFz, hFw]
      calc
        g rz + (kz : ℝ) * q < (y 0 + q) + (kz : ℝ) * q :=
          by simpa [add_assoc] using add_lt_add_left hgz ((kz : ℝ) * q)
        _ ≤ y 0 + (kw : ℝ) * q := by
          have hstep : kz + 1 ≤ kw := by omega
          have hcast : (kz + 1 : ℤ) ≤ kw := hstep
          have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (show (kz + 1 : ℝ) ≤ kw by exact_mod_cast hcast) hq.le
          linarith
        _ ≤ g rw + (kw : ℝ) * q := by
          exact add_le_add_left hgw _
  have F_surj : Function.Surjective F := by
    let G : ℝ ≃o ℝ := hgm.orderIsoOfSurjective g g.surjective
    intro w
    let k : ℤ := ⌊(w - y 0) / q⌋
    let s : ℝ := w - (k : ℝ) * q
    have hslo : y 0 ≤ s := by
      dsimp [s, k]
      have h := Int.floor_le ((w - y 0) / q)
      have h' := (le_div_iff₀ hq).mp h
      linarith
    have hshi : s < y 0 + q := by
      dsimp [s, k]
      have h := Int.lt_floor_add_one ((w - y 0) / q)
      have h' := (div_lt_iff₀ hq).mp h
      linarith
    let t : ℝ := G.symm s
    have hGleft : G (x 0) = y 0 := hleft
    have hGright : G (x N) = y N := hright
    have htlo : x 0 ≤ t := by
      dsimp [t]
      have h := G.symm.monotone (show G (x 0) ≤ s by simpa [hGleft] using hslo)
      simpa using h
    have hthi : t < x N := by
      dsimp [t]
      have h := G.symm.strictMono (show s < G (x N) by
        simpa [hGright, hyN] using hshi)
      simpa using h
    have htfloor : ⌊((t - x 0) / p : ℝ)⌋ = 0 := by
      apply (Int.floor_eq_iff).2
      constructor
      · simpa using (div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr htlo) _hp.le)
      · simpa using (div_lt_one _hp).2 (by linarith [hthi, hxN])
    have hfloor :
        ⌊(((t + (k : ℝ) * p) - x 0) / p : ℝ)⌋ = k := by
      rw [show ((t + (k : ℝ) * p) - x 0) / p =
        (t - x 0) / p + (k : ℝ) by field_simp; ring_nf]
      rw [Int.floor_add_intCast, htfloor]
      simp
    have hgt : g t = s := by
      change G t = s
      exact G.apply_symm_apply s
    refine ⟨t + (k : ℝ) * p, ?_⟩
    simp only [F]
    rw [hfloor]
    rw [show t + (k : ℝ) * p - (k : ℝ) * p = t by ring_nf, hgt]
    dsimp [s]
    ring_nf
  let E : ℝ ≃o ℝ := F_strictMono.orderIsoOfSurjective F F_surj
  refine ⟨E.toHomeomorph, E.strictMono, F_knots, ?_⟩
  simpa [E] using F_period

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.periodicAffineInterpolation_proof
statement:
private theorem periodicAffineInterpolation_proof :
    periodicAffineInterpolationSpec
proof: := periodicAffineInterpolation_core

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.exists_periodic_strictMonoHomeomorph_extension
statement:
theorem exists_periodic_strictMonoHomeomorph_extension
    (n : ℕ) (p q : ℝ) (x y : ℤ → ℝ)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hx : StrictMono x) (hy : StrictMono y)
    (hxp : ∀ j : ℤ, x (j + Int.ofNat n) = x j + p)
    (hyp : ∀ j : ℤ, y (j + Int.ofNat n) = y j + q)
    (hxc : ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ j : ℤ, x j ≤ z ∧ z < x (j + 1))
    (hyc : ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ j : ℤ, y j ≤ z ∧ z < y (j + 1)) :
    ∃ H : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ,
      StrictMono H ∧
      (∀ j : ℤ, H (x j) = y j) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, H (z + p) = H z + q)
proof:
:=
  periodicAffineInterpolation_core n p q x y hn hp hq hx hy hxp hyp hxc hyc

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.CoordinateDeformation.vertexEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem CoordinateDeformation.vertexEquiv_apply
    {C : ApproximationContext} {φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ}
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ)
    (v : {v : Tiling.Plane // v ∈ C.region.vertices}) :
    (D.vertexEquiv v : Tiling.Plane) = D.planarHomeomorph v
proof: := rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.CoordinateDeformation.frontier_image
statement:
theorem CoordinateDeformation.frontier_image
    {C : ApproximationContext} {φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ}
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) :
    frontier D.deformedRegion.openCarrier =
      D.planarHomeomorph '' frontier C.region.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.deformedRegion_openCarrier]
  exact (D.planarHomeomorph.image_frontier C.region.openCarrier).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.Region.openCarrier_regular
statement:
private theorem Region.openCarrier_regular (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region) :
    interior (closure K.openCarrier) = K.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  change interior (closure (interior K.support)) = interior K.support
  rw [K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.regularOpen_eq_of_eqOn_dense
statement:
private theorem regularOpen_eq_of_eqOn_dense
    {s t d : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hsOpen : IsOpen s) (hsRegular : interior (closure s) = s)
    (htOpen : IsOpen t) (htRegular : interior (closure t) = t)
    (hd : Dense d) (hEq : ∀ z ∈ d, z ∈ s ↔ z ∈ t) : s = t
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rw [← htRegular]
    apply interior_maximal _ hsOpen
    intro z hz
    have hzClosure : z ∈ closure (s ∩ d) := hd.open_subset_closure_inter hsOpen hz
    apply closure_mono _ hzClosure
    rintro x ⟨hxs, hxd⟩
    exact (hEq x hxd).mp hxs
  · rw [← hsRegular]
    apply interior_maximal _ htOpen
    intro z hz
    have hzClosure : z ∈ closure (t ∩ d) := hd.open_subset_closure_inter htOpen hz
    apply closure_mono _ hzClosure
    rintro x ⟨hxt, hxd⟩
    exact (hEq x hxd).mpr hxt

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.region_eq_of_gridCellCode_eq
statement:
theorem region_eq_of_gridCellCode_eq
    (K L : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region) (H : Tiling.Plane ≃ₜ Tiling.Plane)
    (hcell : ∀ z : Tiling.Plane,
      (∀ v ∈ K.vertices, z.re ≠ v.re ∧ z.im ≠ v.im) →
      (z ∈ K.openCarrier ↔ H z ∈ L.openCarrier)) :
    H '' K.openCarrier = L.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  let A : Set ℝ := Complex.re '' K.vertices
  let B : Set ℝ := Complex.im '' K.vertices
  let d : Set Tiling.Plane := Complex.re ⁻¹' Aᶜ ∩ Complex.im ⁻¹' Bᶜ
  have hAfin : A.Finite := by
    apply (K.isPolygonal.vertexSet_finite.image Complex.re)
  have hBfin : B.Finite := by
    apply (K.isPolygonal.vertexSet_finite.image Complex.im)
  have hAcomp : Dense Aᶜ := by
    have heq : (Set.univ : Set ℝ) \ A = Aᶜ := by ext; simp
    rw [← heq]
    exact dense_univ.sdiff_finite hAfin
  have hBcomp : Dense Bᶜ := by
    have heq : (Set.univ : Set ℝ) \ B = Bᶜ := by ext; simp
    rw [← heq]
    exact dense_univ.sdiff_finite hBfin
  have hdre : Dense (Complex.re ⁻¹' Aᶜ) :=
    hAcomp.preimage Complex.isOpenMap_re
  have hdim : Dense (Complex.im ⁻¹' Bᶜ) :=
    hBcomp.preimage Complex.isOpenMap_im
  have hdreOpen : IsOpen (Complex.re ⁻¹' Aᶜ) :=
    hAfin.isClosed.isOpen_compl.preimage Complex.continuous_re
  have hd : Dense d := hdre.inter_of_isOpen_left hdim hdreOpen
  have hpreOpen : IsOpen (H ⁻¹' L.openCarrier) :=
    isOpen_interior.preimage H.continuous
  have hpreRegular :
      interior (closure (H ⁻¹' L.openCarrier)) = H ⁻¹' L.openCarrier := by
    rw [← H.preimage_closure, ← H.preimage_interior, Region.openCarrier_regular]
  have hagree : ∀ z ∈ d, z ∈ K.openCarrier ↔ z ∈ H ⁻¹' L.openCarrier := by
    intro z hz
    apply hcell z
    intro v hv
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hzv
      exact hz.1 ⟨v, hv, hzv.symm⟩
    · intro hzv
      exact hz.2 ⟨v, hv, hzv.symm⟩
  have hpre : K.openCarrier = H ⁻¹' L.openCarrier :=
    regularOpen_eq_of_eqOn_dense isOpen_interior (Region.openCarrier_regular K)
      hpreOpen hpreRegular hd hagree
  exact (H.toEquiv.eq_preimage_iff_image_eq K.openCarrier L.openCarrier).mp hpre

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.openSegment_self_real
statement: private theorem openSegment_self_real (x : ℝ) : openSegment ℝ x x = {x}
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩
    change z = x
    rw [← hz]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
  · intro hz
    have hz' : z = x := by simpa using hz
    subst z
    refine ⟨1 / 2, 1 / 2, by norm_num, by norm_num, by norm_num, ?_⟩
    ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.strictMono_image_openSegment
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst y
    rw [openSegment_self_real, openSegment_self_real]
    simp
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hxy with hxy | hyx
    · rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo hxy, openSegment_eq_Ioo (hh hxy)]
      exact h.continuous.image_Ioo_of_strictMono hh
    · rw [openSegment_symm ℝ x y, openSegment_symm ℝ (h x) (h y),
        openSegment_eq_Ioo hyx, openSegment_eq_Ioo (hh hyx)]
      exact h.continuous.image_Ioo_of_strictMono hh

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.openSegment_eq_vertical
statement:
private theorem openSegment_eq_vertical (v w : Tiling.Plane) (h : v.re = w.re) :
    openSegment ℝ v w =
      (fun y : ℝ ↦ (v.re : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
        openSegment ℝ v.im w.im
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩
    refine ⟨z.im, ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hz]
      simp
    · rw [← hz]
      have hweighted (r : ℝ) : a * r + b * r = r := by
        rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [h, hweighted]
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hy⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, ?_⟩
    have hweighted (r : ℝ) : a * r + b * r = r := by
      rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp [h, hweighted]
    · simpa using hy

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.openSegment_eq_horizontal
statement:
private theorem openSegment_eq_horizontal (v w : Tiling.Plane) (h : v.im = w.im) :
    openSegment ℝ v w =
      (fun x : ℝ ↦ (x : ℂ) + (v.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
        openSegment ℝ v.re w.re
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩
    refine ⟨z.re, ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hz]
      simp
    · rw [← hz]
      have hweighted (r : ℝ) : a * r + b * r = r := by
        rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [h, hweighted]
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, ?_⟩
    have hweighted (r : ℝ) : a * r + b * r = r := by
      rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
    apply Complex.ext
    · simpa using hx
    · simp [h, hweighted]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.CoordinateDeformation.image_openSegment_of_axisAligned
statement:
theorem CoordinateDeformation.image_openSegment_of_axisAligned
    {C : ApproximationContext} {φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ}
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (v w : Tiling.Plane)
    (haxis : v.re = w.re ∨ v.im = w.im) :
    D.planarHomeomorph '' openSegment ℝ v w =
      openSegment ℝ (D.planarHomeomorph v) (D.planarHomeomorph w)
proof:
:= by
  rcases haxis with hre | him
  · have hre' : (D.planarHomeomorph v).re = (D.planarHomeomorph w).re := by
      rw [D.planarHomeomorph_apply, D.planarHomeomorph_apply]
      simp [hre]
    rw [openSegment_eq_vertical v w hre,
      openSegment_eq_vertical (D.planarHomeomorph v) (D.planarHomeomorph w) hre',
      Set.image_image]
    calc
      (D.planarHomeomorph ∘ fun y : ℝ ↦ (v.re : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
          openSegment ℝ v.im w.im =
          (fun y : ℝ ↦ (D.firstHomeomorph v.re : ℂ) +
            (D.secondHomeomorph y : ℂ) * Complex.I) '' openSegment ℝ v.im w.im := by
            congr 1
            funext y
            rw [Function.comp_apply, D.planarHomeomorph_apply]
            apply Complex.ext <;> simp
      _ = (fun y : ℝ ↦ (D.firstHomeomorph v.re : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
          (D.secondHomeomorph '' openSegment ℝ v.im w.im) := by
            rw [Set.image_image]
      _ = (fun y : ℝ ↦ (D.firstHomeomorph v.re : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
          openSegment ℝ (D.secondHomeomorph v.im) (D.secondHomeomorph w.im) := by
            rw [strictMono_image_openSegment D.secondHomeomorph
              D.secondHomeomorph_strictMono]
      _ = (fun y : ℝ ↦ ((D.planarHomeomorph v).re : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
          openSegment ℝ (D.planarHomeomorph v).im (D.planarHomeomorph w).im := by
            congr 1
            · funext y
              rw [D.planarHomeomorph_apply]
              simp
            · congr 2 <;> rw [D.planarHomeomorph_apply] <;> simp
  · have him' : (D.planarHomeomorph v).im = (D.planarHomeomorph w).im := by
      rw [D.planarHomeomorph_apply, D.planarHomeomorph_apply]
      simp [him]
    rw [openSegment_eq_horizontal v w him,
      openSegment_eq_horizontal (D.planarHomeomorph v) (D.planarHomeomorph w) him',
      Set.image_image]
    calc
      (D.planarHomeomorph ∘ fun x : ℝ ↦ (x : ℂ) + (v.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
          openSegment ℝ v.re w.re =
          (fun x : ℝ ↦ (D.firstHomeomorph x : ℂ) +
            (D.secondHomeomorph v.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) '' openSegment ℝ v.re w.re := by
            congr 1
            funext x
            rw [Function.comp_apply, D.planarHomeomorph_apply]
            apply Complex.ext <;> simp
      _ = (fun x : ℝ ↦ (x : ℂ) +
          (D.secondHomeomorph v.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
          (D.firstHomeomorph '' openSegment ℝ v.re w.re) := by
            rw [Set.image_image]
      _ = (fun x : ℝ ↦ (x : ℂ) +
          (D.secondHomeomorph v.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
          openSegment ℝ (D.firstHomeomorph v.re) (D.firstHomeomorph w.re) := by
            rw [strictMono_image_openSegment D.firstHomeomorph
              D.firstHomeomorph_strictMono]
      _ = (fun x : ℝ ↦ (x : ℂ) +
          ((D.planarHomeomorph v).im : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
          openSegment ℝ (D.planarHomeomorph v).re (D.planarHomeomorph w).re := by
            congr 1
            · funext x
              rw [D.planarHomeomorph_apply]
              simp
            · congr 2 <;> rw [D.planarHomeomorph_apply] <;> simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mappedCoord_sub
statement:
private theorem mappedCoord_sub
    {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (axis : Axis) (v w : Tiling.Plane) (hv : v ∈ C.region.vertices)
    (hw : w ∈ C.region.vertices) :
    Axis.coord axis
        (mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint v hv) - mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint w hw)) =
      Axis.coord axis (mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint v hv)) -
        Axis.coord axis (mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint w hw))
proof:
:= by
  cases axis <;> simp [Axis.coord]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.sourceCoord_sub
statement:
private theorem sourceCoord_sub (axis : Axis) (v w : Tiling.Plane) :
    Axis.coord axis (v - w) = Axis.coord axis v - Axis.coord axis w
proof:
:= by
  cases axis <;> simp [Axis.coord]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.exists_strictMono_vertexCoordinateMap
statement:
private theorem exists_strictMono_vertexCoordinateMap
    (C : ApproximationContext.{u}) (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hφ : IsGoodApproximation C φ) (axis : Axis) :
    ∃ f : ↥(coordinateLevels C.region axis) → ℝ,
      StrictMono f ∧ ∀ v : ↥C.region.vertices,
        f (vertexCoordinateLevel C.region axis v) =
          Axis.coord axis (mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let repVal : ↥(coordinateLevels C.region axis) → Tiling.Plane := fun x =>
    Classical.choose (Finset.mem_image.mp x.2)
  have repVal_mem (x) : repVal x ∈ C.region.vertexFinset :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.mem_image.mp x.2)).1
  let rep : ↥(coordinateLevels C.region axis) → ↥C.region.vertices := fun x =>
    ⟨repVal x, by
      rw [← C.region.coe_vertexFinset]
      exact repVal_mem x⟩
  let f : ↥(coordinateLevels C.region axis) → ℝ := fun x =>
    Axis.coord axis (mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint (rep x).1 (rep x).2))
  have hrep (x) : Axis.coord axis (rep x).1 = x.1 := by
    dsimp [rep]
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.mem_image.mp x.2)).2
  have hind (v w : ↥C.region.vertices)
      (hvw : Axis.coord axis v.1 = Axis.coord axis w.1) :
      Axis.coord axis (mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2)) =
        Axis.coord axis (mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2)) := by
    have hs := hφ.preservesVertexCoordinateSign axis v.1 w.1 v.2 w.2
    rw [mappedCoord_sub, sourceCoord_sub, hvw, sub_self, Real.sign_zero] at hs
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (Real.sign_eq_zero_iff.mp hs)
  refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    have hs := hφ.preservesVertexCoordinateSign axis (rep y).1 (rep x).1
      (rep y).2 (rep x).2
    rw [mappedCoord_sub, sourceCoord_sub, hrep y, hrep x,
      Real.sign_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hxy)] at hs
    have hs' : Real.sign (f y - f x) = Real.sign (1 : ℝ) := by
      simpa [f] using hs
    change f x < f y
    exact sub_pos.mp (positive_of_same_sign hs' zero_lt_one)
  · intro v
    apply hind (rep (vertexCoordinateLevel C.region axis v)) v
    exact hrep _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.exists_increasingCoordinateExtension
statement:
theorem exists_increasingCoordinateExtension
    (C : ApproximationContext.{u}) (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hφ : IsGoodApproximation C φ) (axis : Axis) :
    ∃ h : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ, StrictMono h ∧ ∀ (v : Tiling.Plane) (hv : v ∈ C.region.vertices),
      h (Axis.coord axis v) = Axis.coord axis (mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint v hv))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfv⟩ := exists_strictMono_vertexCoordinateMap C φ hφ axis
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hext⟩ := exists_strictMonoHomeomorph_extension
    (coordinateLevels C.region axis) f hf
  refine ⟨h, hh, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  simpa [vertexCoordinateLevel] using
    (hext (vertexCoordinateLevel C.region axis ⟨v, hv⟩)).trans (hfv ⟨v, hv⟩)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.exists_rationalPolygonDeformation
statement:
theorem exists_rationalPolygonDeformation
    (C : ApproximationContext.{u}) (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (hφ : IsGoodApproximation C φ) : Nonempty (CoordinateDeformation C φ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hx, hhx, hxv⟩ := exists_increasingCoordinateExtension C φ hφ .horizontal
  obtain ⟨hy, hhy, hyv⟩ := exists_increasingCoordinateExtension C φ hφ .vertical
  let H₁ := coordinateProductHomeomorph hx (Homeomorph.refl ℝ)
  let H := coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy
  obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁support, hK₁open, hK₁vertices⟩ :=
    exists_coordinateProductImageRegion C.region hx (Homeomorph.refl ℝ) hhx strictMono_id
  obtain ⟨K, hKsupport, hKopen, hKvertices⟩ :=
    exists_coordinateProductImageRegion C.region hx hy hhx hhy
  have hH₁ (z : Tiling.Plane) : H₁ z = hx z.re + z.im * Complex.I := by
    change coordinateProductHomeomorph hx (Homeomorph.refl ℝ) z = _
    rw [coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply]
    rfl
  have hH (z : Tiling.Plane) : H z = hx z.re + hy z.im * Complex.I :=
    coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply hx hy z
  have hagree₁ (v : Tiling.Plane) (hv : v ∈ C.region.vertices) :
      H₁ v = mapFirstPoint φ (C.vertexPoint v hv) := by
    rw [hH₁]
    apply Complex.ext
    · convert hxv v hv using 1 <;>
        simp [Axis.coord, mapPoint, mapFirstPoint, ApproximationContext.vertexPoint]
    · simp [mapFirstPoint, ApproximationContext.vertexPoint]
  have hagree (v : Tiling.Plane) (hv : v ∈ C.region.vertices) :
      H v = mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint v hv) := by
    rw [hH]
    apply Complex.ext
    · simpa [Axis.coord, mapPoint, ApproximationContext.vertexPoint] using hxv v hv
    · simpa [Axis.coord, mapPoint, ApproximationContext.vertexPoint] using hyv v hv
  have hcomp : ConnectedComponents ↥C.region.openCarrier ≃
      ConnectedComponents ↥K.openCarrier := by
    let e := Classical.choice (connectedComponents_equiv_image H C.region.openCarrier)
    rw [hKopen]
    exact e
  have hcompc : ConnectedComponents ↥(C.region.openCarrier)ᶜ ≃
      ConnectedComponents ↥(K.openCarrier)ᶜ := by
    let e := Classical.choice (connectedComponents_equiv_image H (C.region.openCarrier)ᶜ)
    have heq : H '' (C.region.openCarrier)ᶜ = (H '' C.region.openCarrier)ᶜ :=
      H.image_compl _
    rw [hKopen]
    rw [← heq]
    exact e
  refine ⟨{
    source_good := hφ
    firstHomeomorph := hx
    firstHomeomorph_strictMono := hhx
    secondHomeomorph := hy
    secondHomeomorph_strictMono := hhy
    firstPlanarHomeomorph := H₁
    firstPlanarHomeomorph_apply := hH₁
    planarHomeomorph := H
    planarHomeomorph_apply := hH
    firstRegion := K₁
    deformedRegion := K
    firstRegion_openCarrier := hK₁open
    deformedRegion_openCarrier := hKopen
    first_vertex_agreement := hagree₁
    vertex_agreement := hagree
    vertices_image := hKvertices
    componentEquiv := hcomp
    complementComponentEquiv := hcompc
    rational_vertices := ?_ }⟩
  intro w hw
  rw [hKvertices] at hw
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := hw
  rw [hagree v hv]
  refine ⟨φ ⟨v.re, C.vertex_re_mem v hv⟩,
    φ ⟨v.im, C.vertex_im_mem v hv⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [mapPoint, mapScalar, ApproximationContext.vertexPoint]
  · simp [mapPoint, mapScalar, ApproximationContext.vertexPoint]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.boundaryLocallyStraightAt_iff
statement:
theorem boundaryLocallyStraightAt_iff
    {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ}
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) (x : Tiling.Plane) :
    Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt C.region.openCarrier x ↔
      Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt D.deformedRegion.openCarrier
        (D.planarHomeomorph x)
proof:
:= by
  have hD : D.planarHomeomorph =
      coordinateProductHomeomorph D.firstHomeomorph D.secondHomeomorph := by
    apply Homeomorph.ext
    intro z
    rw [D.planarHomeomorph_apply,
      coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply D.firstHomeomorph D.secondHomeomorph z]
  rw [hD]
  have hopen := D.deformedRegion_openCarrier
  rw [hD] at hopen
  exact boundaryLocallyStraightAt_coordinateProduct_iff C.region D.deformedRegion
    D.firstHomeomorph D.secondHomeomorph D.firstHomeomorph_strictMono
    D.secondHomeomorph_strictMono hopen x

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.rationalPolygonDeformation_wellDefined
proof:
:= by
  have hD₁ : D₁.planarHomeomorph =
      coordinateProductHomeomorph D₁.firstHomeomorph D₁.secondHomeomorph := by
    apply Homeomorph.ext
    intro z
    rw [D₁.planarHomeomorph_apply,
      coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply D₁.firstHomeomorph D₁.secondHomeomorph z]
  have hD₂ : D₂.planarHomeomorph =
      coordinateProductHomeomorph D₂.firstHomeomorph D₂.secondHomeomorph := by
    apply Homeomorph.ext
    intro z
    rw [D₂.planarHomeomorph_apply,
      coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply D₂.firstHomeomorph D₂.secondHomeomorph z]
  apply region_ext_openCarrier
  rw [D₁.deformedRegion_openCarrier, D₂.deformedRegion_openCarrier]
  rw [hD₁, hD₂]
  apply coordinateProductImage_openCarrier_unique C.region
    D₁.firstHomeomorph D₁.secondHomeomorph D₂.firstHomeomorph D₂.secondHomeomorph
    D₁.firstHomeomorph_strictMono D₁.secondHomeomorph_strictMono
    D₂.firstHomeomorph_strictMono D₂.secondHomeomorph_strictMono
  · intro v hv
    have h := D₁.vertex_agreement v hv
    have h' := D₂.vertex_agreement v hv
    rw [D₁.planarHomeomorph_apply] at h
    rw [D₂.planarHomeomorph_apply] at h'
    simpa using congrArg Complex.re (h.trans h'.symm)
  · intro v hv
    have h := D₁.vertex_agreement v hv
    have h' := D₂.vertex_agreement v hv
    rw [D₁.planarHomeomorph_apply] at h
    rw [D₂.planarHomeomorph_apply] at h'
    simpa using congrArg Complex.im (h.trans h'.symm)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.rationalPolygonDeformation_preservesBoundaryData
statement:
theorem rationalPolygonDeformation_preservesBoundaryData
    {C : ApproximationContext.{u}} {φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ}
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C φ) :
    (∀ v : {v : Tiling.Plane // v ∈ C.region.vertices},
      (D.vertexEquiv v : Tiling.Plane) = mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2)) ∧
    D.deformedRegion.vertices = D.planarHomeomorph '' C.region.vertices ∧
    frontier D.deformedRegion.openCarrier =
      D.planarHomeomorph '' frontier C.region.openCarrier ∧
    (∀ v w : Tiling.Plane, v.re = w.re ∨ v.im = w.im →
      D.planarHomeomorph '' openSegment ℝ v w =
        openSegment ℝ (D.planarHomeomorph v) (D.planarHomeomorph w)) ∧
    (∀ x : Tiling.Plane, Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt C.region.openCarrier x ↔
      Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt D.deformedRegion.openCarrier
        (D.planarHomeomorph x)) ∧
    ∀ v ∈ D.deformedRegion.vertices, Tiling.IsRationalPoint v
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun v => D.vertexEquiv_apply v |>.trans (D.vertex_agreement v.1 v.2),
    D.vertices_image, D.frontier_image, D.image_openSegment_of_axisAligned,
    boundaryLocallyStraightAt_iff D, D.rational_vertices⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.epsilonApproximation_of_le
proof:
:= hφ.epsilon_pos.trans_le hεδ
  fixesRational := hφ.fixesRational
  basis_close j := (hφ.basis_close j).trans_le hεδ

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.rationalPolygonDeformation_uniformlyClose
statement:
theorem rationalPolygonDeformation_uniformlyClose
    (C : ApproximationContext.{u}) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ∀ (φ : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ),
      IsEpsilonApproximation C ε₀ φ → ∀ D : CoordinateDeformation C φ,
        (∀ (v : Tiling.Plane) (hv : v ∈ C.region.vertices),
          dist (mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint v hv)) v < η) ∧
        Metric.diam D.deformedRegion.openCarrier ≤
          2 * Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let d := Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier
  have hd : 0 < d := region_openCarrier_diam_pos C.region
  let τ := min (η / 2) (d / 4)
  have hτ : 0 < τ := lt_min (half_pos hη) (div_pos hd (by norm_num))
  let V := C.region.vertexFinset.attach
  let Zr : Finset C.coordinateSpace := V.image fun v =>
    ⟨v.1.re, C.vertex_re_mem v.1 (by
      rw [← C.region.coe_vertexFinset]
      exact v.2)⟩
  let Zi : Finset C.coordinateSpace := V.image fun v =>
    ⟨v.1.im, C.vertex_im_mem v.1 (by
      rw [← C.region.coe_vertexFinset]
      exact v.2)⟩
  obtain ⟨εr, hεr, hr⟩ := approximation_uniformOn_finset C Zr τ hτ
  obtain ⟨εi, hεi, hi⟩ := approximation_uniformOn_finset C Zi τ hτ
  obtain ⟨εg, hεg, hg⟩ := isGoodApproximation_of_sufficientlyFine C
  let ε₀ := min εg (min εr εi)
  have hε₀ : 0 < ε₀ := lt_min hεg (lt_min hεr hεi)
  refine ⟨ε₀, hε₀, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ D
  have hφg := epsilonApproximation_of_le hφ (min_le_left _ _)
  have hφr := epsilonApproximation_of_le hφ
    ((min_le_right εg (min εr εi)).trans (min_le_left _ _))
  have hφi := epsilonApproximation_of_le hφ
    ((min_le_right εg (min εr εi)).trans (min_le_right _ _))
  have hverr (v : Tiling.Plane) (hv : v ∈ C.region.vertices) :
      |mapScalar φ ⟨v.re, C.vertex_re_mem v hv⟩ - v.re| < τ := by
    apply hr φ hφr
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨⟨v, ?_⟩, by simp [V], rfl⟩
    change v ∈ (C.region.vertexFinset : Set Tiling.Plane)
    rw [C.region.coe_vertexFinset]
    exact hv
  have hveri (v : Tiling.Plane) (hv : v ∈ C.region.vertices) :
      |mapScalar φ ⟨v.im, C.vertex_im_mem v hv⟩ - v.im| < τ := by
    apply hi φ hφi
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨⟨v, ?_⟩, by simp [V], rfl⟩
    change v ∈ (C.region.vertexFinset : Set Tiling.Plane)
    rw [C.region.coe_vertexFinset]
    exact hv
  have hdist (v : Tiling.Plane) (hv : v ∈ C.region.vertices) :
      dist (mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint v hv)) v < η ∧
      dist (D.planarHomeomorph v) v ≤ d / 2 := by
    have hre := hverr v hv
    have him := hveri v hv
    have hnorm : dist (mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint v hv)) v < 2 * τ := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      calc
        ‖mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint v hv) - v‖ ≤
            |(mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint v hv) - v).re| +
              |(mapPoint φ (C.vertexPoint v hv) - v).im| :=
          Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im _
        _ < τ + τ := by
          gcongr <;> simpa [mapPoint, mapScalar, ApproximationContext.vertexPoint]
        _ = 2 * τ := by ring
    constructor
    · exact hnorm.trans_le (by dsimp [τ]; exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (min_le_left _ _) (by norm_num)).trans_eq (by ring))
    · rw [D.vertex_agreement v hv]
      exact hnorm.le.trans (by
        dsimp [τ, d]
        have := min_le_right (η / 2) (Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier / 4)
        linarith)
  refine ⟨fun v hv => (hdist v hv).1, ?_⟩
  have hsupp : D.deformedRegion.support =
      D.planarHomeomorph '' C.region.support :=
    region_support_image_of_openCarrier_image C.region D.deformedRegion
      D.planarHomeomorph D.deformedRegion_openCarrier
  have hdiam := coordinateProductImage_diam_le C.region D.deformedRegion
    D.planarHomeomorph (d / 2) (le_of_lt (half_pos hd)) hsupp D.vertices_image
    (fun v hv => (hdist v hv).2)
  dsimp [d] at hdiam ⊢
  linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply
    (hx hy : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ) (z : Tiling.Plane) :
    coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy z = hx z.re + hy z.im * Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [coordinateProductHomeomorph]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.strictMono_image_uIcc
statement:
private theorem strictMono_image_uIcc (h : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ) (hh : StrictMono h)
    (a b : ℝ) : h '' Set.uIcc a b = Set.uIcc (h a) (h b)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
  · rw [uIcc_of_le hab, uIcc_of_le (hh.monotone hab)]
    exact h.continuous.image_Icc_of_strictMono hh
  · rw [uIcc_of_ge hba, uIcc_of_ge (hh.monotone hba)]
    exact h.continuous.image_Icc_of_strictMono hh

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.coordinateProductHomeomorph_image_rectangle
statement:
private theorem coordinateProductHomeomorph_image_rectangle
    (hx hy : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ) (hhx : StrictMono hx) (hhy : StrictMono hy)
    (a b : Tiling.Plane) :
    coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy '' Complex.Rectangle a b =
      Complex.Rectangle (coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy a)
        (coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy b)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_image]
  change (∃ w : Tiling.Plane,
    (w.re ∈ Set.uIcc a.re b.re ∧ w.im ∈ Set.uIcc a.im b.im) ∧ _) ↔ _
  change _ ↔ (z.re ∈ Set.uIcc _ _ ∧ z.im ∈ Set.uIcc _ _)
  rw [coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply,
    coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply]
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re,
    mul_zero, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_im,
    zero_add, mul_one]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, ⟨hwre, hwim⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply]
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re,
      mul_zero, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_im,
      zero_add, mul_one]
    constructor
    · simpa using (Set.ext_iff.mp (strictMono_image_uIcc hx hhx a.re b.re) _).mp
        ⟨w.re, hwre, rfl⟩
    · simpa using (Set.ext_iff.mp (strictMono_image_uIcc hy hhy a.im b.im) _).mp
        ⟨w.im, hwim, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hzre, hzim⟩
    have hzre' : z.re ∈ hx '' Set.uIcc a.re b.re := by
      rw [strictMono_image_uIcc hx hhx]
      simpa using hzre
    have hzim' : z.im ∈ hy '' Set.uIcc a.im b.im := by
      rw [strictMono_image_uIcc hy hhy]
      simpa using hzim
    obtain ⟨x, hxmem, hxz⟩ := hzre'
    obtain ⟨y, hymem, hyz⟩ := hzim'
    let w : Tiling.Plane := x + y * Complex.I
    refine ⟨w, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · simpa [w] using hxmem
    · simpa [w] using hymem
    · rw [coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply]
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [w, hxz, hyz]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.region_ext_openCarrier
statement:
theorem region_ext_openCarrier (K L : Region)
    (h : K.openCarrier = L.openCarrier) : K = L
proof:
:= by
  have hs : K.support = L.support := by
    rw [← K.isPolygonal.closure_interior, ← L.isPolygonal.closure_interior]
    exact congrArg closure h
  cases K with
  | mk K hK =>
    cases L with
    | mk L hL =>
      rw [Region.mk.injEq, Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.mk.injEq]
      exact hs

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.region_support_image_of_openCarrier_image
statement:
theorem region_support_image_of_openCarrier_image
    (K L : Region) (H : Tiling.Plane ≃ₜ Tiling.Plane)
    (h : L.openCarrier = H '' K.openCarrier) : L.support = H '' K.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [← L.isPolygonal.closure_interior, ← K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]
  change closure L.openCarrier = H '' closure K.openCarrier
  rw [h, H.image_closure]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.connectedComponents_equiv_image
statement:
theorem connectedComponents_equiv_image
    (H : Tiling.Plane ≃ₜ Tiling.Plane) (s : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    Nonempty (ConnectedComponents ↥s ≃ ConnectedComponents ↥(H '' s))
proof:
:= by
  let e : ↥s ≃ₜ ↥(H '' s) :=
    { toFun := fun x => ⟨H x, ⟨x, x.2, rfl⟩⟩
      invFun := fun y => ⟨H.symm y, by
        obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := y.2
        simpa [← hxy] using hx⟩
      left_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext (H.symm_apply_apply x)
      right_inv := fun y => Subtype.ext (H.apply_symm_apply y)
      continuous_toFun := (H.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk
        (fun x => ⟨x, x.2, rfl⟩)
      continuous_invFun := (H.symm.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk
        (fun y => by
          obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := y.2
          simpa [← hxy] using hx) }
  let he := e.isQuotientMap.isCoinducing
  exact ⟨(he.connectedComponentsHomeomorph (fun y => by
    have hfibre : e ⁻¹' ({y} : Set _) = {e.symm y} := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      exact e.eq_symm_apply.symm
    rw [hfibre]
    exact isConnected_singleton)).toEquiv⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.coordinateProductHomeomorph_symm_re
statement:
private theorem coordinateProductHomeomorph_symm_re
    (hx hy : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ) (z : Tiling.Plane) :
    ((coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy).symm z).re = hx.symm z.re
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Complex.re
    (coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply hx hy
      ((coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy).symm z))
  have hcoord : z.re = hx ((coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy).symm z).re := by
    simpa using h
  apply hx.injective
  rw [hx.apply_symm_apply]
  exact hcoord.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.coordinateProductHomeomorph_symm_im
statement:
private theorem coordinateProductHomeomorph_symm_im
    (hx hy : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ) (z : Tiling.Plane) :
    ((coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy).symm z).im = hy.symm z.im
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Complex.im
    (coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply hx hy
      ((coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy).symm z))
  have hcoord : z.im = hy ((coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy).symm z).im := by
    simpa using h
  apply hy.injective
  rw [hy.apply_symm_apply]
  exact hcoord.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.inverse_preserves_vertexGridComparisons
statement:
private theorem inverse_preserves_vertexGridComparisons
    (K : Region) (hx₁ hy₁ hx₂ hy₂ : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ)
    (hmx₁ : StrictMono hx₁) (hmy₁ : StrictMono hy₁)
    (hmx₂ : StrictMono hx₂) (hmy₂ : StrictMono hy₂)
    (hex : ∀ v ∈ K.vertices, hx₁ v.re = hx₂ v.re)
    (hey : ∀ v ∈ K.vertices, hy₁ v.im = hy₂ v.im)
    (z : Tiling.Plane) :
    (∀ v ∈ K.vertices,
      (((coordinateProductHomeomorph hx₁ hy₁).symm z).re < v.re ↔
        ((coordinateProductHomeomorph hx₂ hy₂).symm z).re < v.re)) ∧
    ∀ v ∈ K.vertices,
      (((coordinateProductHomeomorph hx₁ hy₁).symm z).im < v.im ↔
        ((coordinateProductHomeomorph hx₂ hy₂).symm z).im < v.im)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro v hv
    rw [coordinateProductHomeomorph_symm_re, coordinateProductHomeomorph_symm_re]
    calc
      hx₁.symm z.re < v.re ↔ z.re < hx₁ v.re := by
        simpa using (hmx₁.lt_iff_lt (a := hx₁.symm z.re) (b := v.re)).symm
      _ ↔ z.re < hx₂ v.re := by rw [hex v hv]
      _ ↔ hx₂.symm z.re < v.re := by
        simpa using hmx₂.lt_iff_lt (a := hx₂.symm z.re) (b := v.re)
  · intro v hv
    rw [coordinateProductHomeomorph_symm_im, coordinateProductHomeomorph_symm_im]
    calc
      hy₁.symm z.im < v.im ↔ z.im < hy₁ v.im := by
        simpa using (hmy₁.lt_iff_lt (a := hy₁.symm z.im) (b := v.im)).symm
      _ ↔ z.im < hy₂ v.im := by rw [hey v hv]
      _ ↔ hy₂.symm z.im < v.im := by
        simpa using hmy₂.lt_iff_lt (a := hy₂.symm z.im) (b := v.im)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.inverse_offVertexGrid_of_target_offGrid
statement:
private theorem inverse_offVertexGrid_of_target_offGrid
    (K : Region) (hx₁ hy₁ hx₂ hy₂ : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ)
    (_hmx₁ : StrictMono hx₁) (_hmy₁ : StrictMono hy₁)
    (_hmx₂ : StrictMono hx₂) (_hmy₂ : StrictMono hy₂)
    (hex : ∀ v ∈ K.vertices, hx₁ v.re = hx₂ v.re)
    (hey : ∀ v ∈ K.vertices, hy₁ v.im = hy₂ v.im)
    (z : Tiling.Plane)
    (hoff : ∀ v ∈ K.vertices, z.re ≠ hx₁ v.re ∧ z.im ≠ hy₁ v.im) :
    (∀ v ∈ K.vertices,
      ((coordinateProductHomeomorph hx₁ hy₁).symm z).re ≠ v.re ∧
      ((coordinateProductHomeomorph hx₁ hy₁).symm z).im ≠ v.im) ∧
    ∀ v ∈ K.vertices,
      ((coordinateProductHomeomorph hx₂ hy₂).symm z).re ≠ v.re ∧
      ((coordinateProductHomeomorph hx₂ hy₂).symm z).im ≠ v.im
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro v hv
    rw [coordinateProductHomeomorph_symm_re, coordinateProductHomeomorph_symm_im]
    exact ⟨fun h => (hoff v hv).1 (calc
        z.re = hx₁ (hx₁.symm z.re) := (hx₁.apply_symm_apply z.re).symm
        _ = hx₁ v.re := congrArg hx₁ h),
      fun h => (hoff v hv).2 (calc
        z.im = hy₁ (hy₁.symm z.im) := (hy₁.apply_symm_apply z.im).symm
        _ = hy₁ v.im := congrArg hy₁ h)⟩
  · intro v hv
    rw [coordinateProductHomeomorph_symm_re, coordinateProductHomeomorph_symm_im]
    exact ⟨fun h => (hoff v hv).1 (by
        calc
          z.re = hx₂ (hx₂.symm z.re) := (hx₂.apply_symm_apply z.re).symm
          _ = hx₂ v.re := congrArg hx₂ h
          _ = hx₁ v.re := (hex v hv).symm),
      fun h => (hoff v hv).2 (by
        calc
          z.im = hy₂ (hy₂.symm z.im) := (hy₂.apply_symm_apply z.im).symm
          _ = hy₂ v.im := congrArg hy₂ h
          _ = hy₁ v.im := (hey v hv).symm)⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.coordinateProductHomeomorph_rectangulation
statement:
private theorem coordinateProductHomeomorph_rectangulation
    {s : Set Tiling.Plane} (R : Tiling.Rectangulation s)
    (hx hy : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ) (hhx : StrictMono hx) (hhy : StrictMono hy) :
    ∃ R' : Tiling.Rectangulation (coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy '' s),
      R'.pieces = R.pieces.image
        (fun r : Set Tiling.Plane => coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy '' r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H := coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy
  let pieces := R.pieces.image (fun r : Set Tiling.Plane => H '' r)
  have himage_inj : Function.Injective (fun r : Set Tiling.Plane => H '' r) := by
    intro r t h
    change H '' r = H '' t at h
    ext x
    constructor <;> intro hx
    · have : H x ∈ H '' r := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      rw [h] at this
      obtain ⟨y, hy, heq⟩ := this
      exact H.injective heq ▸ hy
    · have : H x ∈ H '' t := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      rw [← h] at this
      obtain ⟨y, hy, heq⟩ := this
      exact H.injective heq ▸ hy
  have hrect (u : Set Tiling.Plane) (hu : u ∈ pieces) : Tiling.IsRectangle u := by
    obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu
    obtain ⟨a, b, hre, him, rfl⟩ := R.isRectangle r hr
    refine ⟨H a, H b, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [H, coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply, Complex.add_re,
        Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re, mul_zero]
      simpa using hhx.injective.ne hre
    · simp only [H, coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply, Complex.add_im,
        Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_im, zero_add, mul_one]
      simpa using hhy.injective.ne him
    · exact coordinateProductHomeomorph_image_rectangle hx hy hhx hhy a b
  have hpair : ((pieces : Finset (Set Tiling.Plane)) : Set (Set Tiling.Plane)).Pairwise
      (AEDisjoint volume) := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hru⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu
    obtain ⟨t, ht, htv⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
    subst u
    subst v
    have hrt : r ≠ t := fun h => huv (h ▸ rfl)
    have hae := R.pairwiseAEDisjoint hr ht hrt
    have hinter : Disjoint (interior r) (interior t) := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hxr hxt
      have hopen : IsOpen (interior r ∩ interior t) := isOpen_interior.inter isOpen_interior
      have hpos := hopen.measure_pos volume ⟨x, hxr, hxt⟩
      have hle : volume (interior r ∩ interior t) ≤ volume (r ∩ t) :=
        measure_mono (inter_subset_inter interior_subset interior_subset)
      rw [hae] at hle
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hle) hpos
    have hsub : (H '' r) ∩ (H '' t) ⊆ frontier (H '' r) ∪ frontier (H '' t) := by
      intro x hxin
      by_contra hn
      simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or] at hn
      have hxri : x ∈ interior (H '' r) := (mem_interior_iff_notMem_frontier hxin.1).2 hn.1
      have hxti : x ∈ interior (H '' t) := (mem_interior_iff_notMem_frontier hxin.2).2 hn.2
      rw [← H.image_interior] at hxri hxti
      obtain ⟨xr, hxr, hx⟩ := hxri
      obtain ⟨xt, hxt, hx'⟩ := hxti
      have : xr = xt := H.injective (hx.trans hx'.symm)
      exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp hinter) hxr (this ▸ hxt)
    apply measure_mono_null hsub
    rw [measure_union_null]
    · exact (hrect (H '' r) (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)).isPolygonal.volume_frontier
    · exact (hrect (H '' t) (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩)).isPolygonal.volume_frontier
  refine ⟨{
    pieces := pieces
    isRectangle := hrect
    pairwiseAEDisjoint := hpair
    sUnion_eq := ?_ }, rfl⟩
  change ⋃₀ (pieces : Set (Set Tiling.Plane)) = H '' s
  rw [show (pieces : Set (Set Tiling.Plane)) =
      (fun r : Set Tiling.Plane => H '' r) '' (R.pieces : Set (Set Tiling.Plane)) by
        exact Finset.coe_image]
  rw [← Set.image_sUnion, R.sUnion_eq]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.coordinateProductImage_diam_le
statement:
theorem coordinateProductImage_diam_le
    (K L : Region) (H : Tiling.Plane ≃ₜ Tiling.Plane) (δ : ℝ)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (_hsupport : L.support = H '' K.support)
    (hvertices : L.vertices = H '' K.vertices)
    (hmove : ∀ v ∈ K.vertices, dist (H v) v ≤ δ) :
    Metric.diam L.openCarrier ≤ Metric.diam K.openCarrier + 2 * δ
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.diam_le_of_forall_dist_le (add_nonneg Metric.diam_nonneg (mul_nonneg zero_le_two hδ))
  intro x hx y hy
  have hxS : x ∈ L.support := interior_subset hx
  have hyS : y ∈ L.support := interior_subset hy
  obtain ⟨v, hv, w, hw, hxy⟩ := exists_vertices_controlling_distance L x y hxS hyS
  rw [hvertices] at hv hw
  obtain ⟨v0, hv0, rfl⟩ := hv
  obtain ⟨w0, hw0, rfl⟩ := hw
  calc
    dist x y ≤ dist (H v0) (H w0) := hxy
    dist (H v0) (H w0) ≤ dist v0 w0 + dist (H v0) v0 + dist (H w0) w0 := by
      calc
        dist (H v0) (H w0) ≤ dist (H v0) v0 + dist v0 w0 + dist w0 (H w0) := by
          exact (dist_triangle4 (H v0) v0 w0 (H w0))
        _ = _ := by rw [dist_comm w0]; ring
    _ ≤ Metric.diam K.support + δ + δ := by
      gcongr
      · apply Metric.dist_le_diam_of_mem K.isPolygonal.isBounded
        · rw [← K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]
          exact frontier_subset_closure (region_vertices_subset_frontier K hv0)
        · rw [← K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]
          exact frontier_subset_closure (region_vertices_subset_frontier K hw0)
      · exact hmove v0 hv0
      · exact hmove w0 hw0
    _ = Metric.diam K.openCarrier + 2 * δ := by
      have hd : Metric.diam K.support = Metric.diam K.openCarrier := by
        change Metric.diam K.support = Metric.diam (interior K.support)
        nth_rewrite 1 [← K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]
        exact Metric.diam_closure _
      rw [hd]
      ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.region_openCarrier_diam_pos
statement:
theorem region_openCarrier_diam_pos (K : Region) :
    0 < Metric.diam K.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T⟩ := K.isPolygonal
  obtain ⟨x, hxK⟩ := K.nonempty
  rw [← T.sUnion_eq] at hxK
  obtain ⟨t, htT, hxt⟩ := Set.mem_sUnion.mp hxK
  have htFin : t ∈ T.pieces := htT
  have htSub : t ⊆ K.support := by
    rw [← T.sUnion_eq]
    exact Set.subset_sUnion_of_mem htT
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (T.isTriangle t htFin).interior_nonempty
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp isOpen_interior p hp
  let q : Tiling.Plane := p + (r / 2 : ℝ)
  have hqball : q ∈ Metric.ball p r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    simp [q, abs_of_pos hr]
    linarith
  have hpK : p ∈ K.openCarrier := interior_mono htSub hp
  have hqK : q ∈ K.openCarrier := interior_mono htSub (hball hqball)
  have hpq : p ≠ q := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Complex.re h
    simp [q] at this
    linarith
  exact Metric.diam_pos ⟨p, hpK, q, hqK, hpq⟩
    (K.isPolygonal.isBounded.subset interior_subset)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.region_openCarrier_regular
statement:
private theorem region_openCarrier_regular (K : Region) :
    interior (closure K.openCarrier) = K.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  change interior (closure (interior K.support)) = interior K.support
  rw [K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.frontier_openCarrier_eq_support
statement:
private theorem frontier_openCarrier_eq_support (K : Region) :
    frontier K.openCarrier = frontier K.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [frontier, frontier]
  change closure (interior K.support) \ interior (interior K.support) =
    closure K.support \ interior K.support
  rw [K.isPolygonal.closure_interior, interior_interior,
    K.isPolygonal.isClosed.closure_eq]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.affineLine_eq_horizontal
proof:
:= by
  have hvre : v.re ≠ 0 := by
    intro hvre
    apply hv
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hvre, hvim]
  ext z
  simp only [Tiling.mem_affineLine, Tiling.signedSide, Tiling.planarCross,
    mem_ofPred_eq, hvim, zero_mul, sub_zero]
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hvre)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.affineLine_eq_vertical
proof:

    intro hvim

    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hvre, hvim]
  ext z
  simp only [Tiling.mem_affineLine, Tiling.signedSide, Tiling.planarCross,
