name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.boundaryStraight_axisGerm
statement:
private theorem boundaryStraight_axisGerm (K : Region) (x : Tiling.Plane)
    (hstraight : Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt K.openCarrier x) :
    (∀ᶠ z in nhds x, z ∈ frontier K.openCarrier ↔ z.re = x.re) ∨
      (∀ᶠ z in nhds x, z ∈ frontier K.openCarrier ↔ z.im = x.im)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hxL, hdim, hlocal⟩ := hstraight
  obtain ⟨v, hv, r, hr, hline⟩ :=
    Tiling.AffineSubspace.exists_ball_frontier_iff_affineLine hxL hdim hlocal
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hcross⟩ := K.isAxisParallel.localBoundaryCross x
  have hcross' : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x s, z ∈ frontier K.openCarrier →
      z.re = x.re ∨ z.im = x.im := by
    intro z hz hzfront
    apply hcross z hz
    rw [← frontier_openCarrier_eq_support K]
    exact hzfront
  let t : ℝ := min r s / (2 * (‖v‖ + 1))
  have ht : 0 < t := by dsimp only [t]; positivity
  have htNorm : t * ‖v‖ < min r s := by
    dsimp only [t]
    have hvnorm : 0 ≤ ‖v‖ := norm_nonneg v
    have hmin : 0 < min r s := lt_min hr hs
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * (‖v‖ + 1))).2
    nlinarith
  let z : Tiling.Plane := x + t • v
  have hzDist : dist z x = t * ‖v‖ := by
    simp only [z, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos ht]
  have hzR : z ∈ Metric.ball x r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, hzDist]
    exact htNorm.trans_le (min_le_left r s)
  have hzS : z ∈ Metric.ball x s := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, hzDist]
    exact htNorm.trans_le (min_le_right r s)
  have hzFront : z ∈ frontier K.openCarrier :=
    (hline z hzR).2 (Tiling.vadd_smul_mem_affineLine x v t)
  have hvCoord : v.re = 0 ∨ v.im = 0 := by
    rcases hcross' z hzS hzFront with hzre | hzim
    · left
      have : t * v.re = 0 := by
        simpa only [z, Complex.add_re, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul,
          add_eq_left] using hzre
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left ht.ne'
    · right
      have : t * v.im = 0 := by
        simpa only [z, Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul,
          add_eq_left] using hzim
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left ht.ne'
  rcases hvCoord with hvre | hvim
  · left
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds x (lt_min hr hs)] with w hw
    have hwR := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left r s) hw
    simpa only [affineLine_eq_vertical hv hvre, mem_ofPred_eq] using hline w hwR
  · right
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds x (lt_min hr hs)] with w hw
    have hwR := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left r s) hw
    simpa only [affineLine_eq_horizontal hv hvim, mem_ofPred_eq] using hline w hwR

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.boundaryLocallyStraightAt_coordinateProduct_iff
statement:
theorem boundaryLocallyStraightAt_coordinateProduct_iff
    (K L : Region) (hx hy : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ) (hhx : StrictMono hx) (hhy : StrictMono hy)
    (hopen : L.openCarrier = coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy '' K.openCarrier)
    (x : Tiling.Plane) :
    Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt K.openCarrier x ↔
      Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt L.openCarrier
        (coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy x)
proof:
:= by
  let H := coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy
  have transport (K L : Region) (hx hy : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ)
      (hhx : StrictMono hx) (hhy : StrictMono hy)
      (hopen : L.openCarrier = coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy '' K.openCarrier)
      (x : Tiling.Plane) (hstraight : Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt K.openCarrier x) :
      Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt L.openCarrier
        (coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy x) := by
    let H := coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy
    change Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt L.openCarrier (H x)
    rcases boundaryStraight_axisGerm K x hstraight with hg | hg
    · let M : AffineSubspace ℝ Tiling.Plane :=
        AffineSubspace.mk' (H x) (ℝ ∙ Complex.I)
      refine ⟨M, AffineSubspace.self_mem_mk' _ _, by
        rw [AffineSubspace.direction_mk']
        exact finrank_span_singleton Complex.I_ne_zero, ?_⟩
      have ht : Filter.Tendsto H.symm (nhds (H x)) (nhds x) :=
        by
          have ht0 := H.symm.continuous.continuousAt (x := H x)
          change Filter.Tendsto H.symm (nhds (H x)) (nhds (H.symm (H x))) at ht0
          rwa [H.symm_apply_apply] at ht0
      filter_upwards [ht.eventually hg] with z hz
      have hfront : z ∈ frontier L.openCarrier ↔ H.symm z ∈ frontier K.openCarrier := by
        rw [hopen, ← H.image_frontier]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨y, hyf, hyz⟩
          simpa [← hyz] using hyf
        · intro hyf
          exact ⟨H.symm z, hyf, H.apply_symm_apply z⟩
      rw [hfront, hz]
      change (H.symm z).re = x.re ↔ z ∈ M
      rw [coordinateProductHomeomorph_symm_re]
      change hx.symm z.re = x.re ↔ z - H x ∈ ℝ ∙ Complex.I
      rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton]
      constructor
      · intro hre
        refine ⟨z.im - (H x).im, ?_⟩
        apply Complex.ext
        · have := congrArg hx hre
          simp only [hx.apply_symm_apply] at this
          simp [H, coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply]
          linarith
        · simp
      · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
        have hzre : z.re = (H x).re := by
          have := congrArg Complex.re ha
          simp at this
          linarith
        apply hx.injective
        simpa [H, coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply] using hzre
    · let M : AffineSubspace ℝ Tiling.Plane :=
        AffineSubspace.mk' (H x) (ℝ ∙ (1 : Tiling.Plane))
      refine ⟨M, AffineSubspace.self_mem_mk' _ _, by
        rw [AffineSubspace.direction_mk']
        exact finrank_span_singleton one_ne_zero, ?_⟩
      have ht : Filter.Tendsto H.symm (nhds (H x)) (nhds x) :=
        by
          have ht0 := H.symm.continuous.continuousAt (x := H x)
          change Filter.Tendsto H.symm (nhds (H x)) (nhds (H.symm (H x))) at ht0
          rwa [H.symm_apply_apply] at ht0
      filter_upwards [ht.eventually hg] with z hz
      have hfront : z ∈ frontier L.openCarrier ↔ H.symm z ∈ frontier K.openCarrier := by
        rw [hopen, ← H.image_frontier]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨y, hyf, hyz⟩
          simpa [← hyz] using hyf
        · intro hyf
          exact ⟨H.symm z, hyf, H.apply_symm_apply z⟩
      rw [hfront, hz]
      change (H.symm z).im = x.im ↔ z ∈ M
      rw [coordinateProductHomeomorph_symm_im]
      change hy.symm z.im = x.im ↔ z - H x ∈ ℝ ∙ (1 : Tiling.Plane)
      rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton]
      constructor
      · intro him
        refine ⟨z.re - (H x).re, ?_⟩
        apply Complex.ext
        · simp
        · have := congrArg hy him
          simp only [hy.apply_symm_apply] at this
          simp [H, coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply]
          linarith
      · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
        have hzim : z.im = (H x).im := by
          have := congrArg Complex.im ha
          simp at this
          linarith
        apply hy.injective
        simpa [H, coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply] using hzim
  constructor
  · exact transport K L hx hy hhx hhy hopen x
  · intro h
    have hInv : coordinateProductHomeomorph hx.symm hy.symm = H.symm := by
      apply Homeomorph.ext
      intro z
      apply H.injective
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [H, coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply]
    have hinv : K.openCarrier =
        coordinateProductHomeomorph hx.symm hy.symm '' L.openCarrier := by
      rw [hInv, hopen]
      exact (H.symm_image_image K.openCarrier).symm
    have hhx' : StrictMono hx.symm := by
      intro a b hab
      apply (hhx.lt_iff_lt).mp
      simpa using hab
    have hhy' : StrictMono hy.symm := by
      intro a b hab
      apply (hhy.lt_iff_lt).mp
      simpa using hab
    have hback := transport L K hx.symm hy.symm hhx' hhy'
      hinv (H x) h
    rw [hInv] at hback
    simpa [H] using hback

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.exists_coordinateProductImageRegion
statement:
theorem exists_coordinateProductImageRegion
    (K : Region) (hx hy : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ) (hhx : StrictMono hx) (hhy : StrictMono hy) :
    ∃ L : Region,
      L.support = coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy '' K.support ∧
      L.openCarrier = coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy '' K.openCarrier ∧
      L.vertices = coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy '' K.vertices
proof:
:= by
  let H := coordinateProductHomeomorph hx hy
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := K.isAxisParallel
  obtain ⟨R', hR'⟩ := coordinateProductHomeomorph_rectangulation R hx hy hhx hhy
  let L : Region := {
    support := H '' K.support
    isPolygonal := isPolygonal_of_isAxisParallel ⟨R'⟩
    nonempty := K.nonempty.image H
    isAxisParallel := ⟨R'⟩ }
  have hopen : L.openCarrier = H '' K.openCarrier := by
    change interior (H '' K.support) = H '' interior K.support
    exact (H.image_interior K.support).symm
  refine ⟨L, rfl, hopen, ?_⟩
  rw [region_vertices_eq_nonStraightBoundary L,
    region_vertices_eq_nonStraightBoundary K]
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hzfront, hznot⟩
    have hzfront' : z ∈ H '' frontier K.openCarrier := by
      rw [H.image_frontier, ← hopen]
      exact hzfront
    obtain ⟨x, hxfront, rfl⟩ := hzfront'
    refine ⟨x, ⟨hxfront, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    intro hs
    exact hznot ((boundaryLocallyStraightAt_coordinateProduct_iff
      K L hx hy hhx hhy hopen x).mp hs)
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨hxfront, hxnot⟩, rfl⟩
    constructor
    · change H x ∈ frontier L.openCarrier
      rw [hopen, ← H.image_frontier]
      exact ⟨x, hxfront, rfl⟩
    · intro hs
      exact hxnot ((boundaryLocallyStraightAt_coordinateProduct_iff
        K L hx hy hhx hhy hopen x).mpr hs)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.coordinateProductImage_openCarrier_unique
statement:
theorem coordinateProductImage_openCarrier_unique
    (K : Region) (hx₁ hy₁ hx₂ hy₂ : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ)
    (hmx₁ : StrictMono hx₁) (hmy₁ : StrictMono hy₁)
    (hmx₂ : StrictMono hx₂) (hmy₂ : StrictMono hy₂)
    (hex : ∀ v ∈ K.vertices, hx₁ v.re = hx₂ v.re)
    (hey : ∀ v ∈ K.vertices, hy₁ v.im = hy₂ v.im) :
    coordinateProductHomeomorph hx₁ hy₁ '' K.openCarrier =
      coordinateProductHomeomorph hx₂ hy₂ '' K.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  let H1 := coordinateProductHomeomorph hx₁ hy₁
  let H2 := coordinateProductHomeomorph hx₂ hy₂
  let A : Set ℝ := hx₁ '' (Complex.re '' K.vertices)
  let B : Set ℝ := hy₁ '' (Complex.im '' K.vertices)
  let d : Set Tiling.Plane := Complex.re ⁻¹' Aᶜ ∩ Complex.im ⁻¹' Bᶜ
  have hAfin : A.Finite := (K.isPolygonal.vertexSet_finite.image Complex.re).image hx₁
  have hBfin : B.Finite := (K.isPolygonal.vertexSet_finite.image Complex.im).image hy₁
  have hAcomp : Dense Aᶜ := by
    rw [← show (Set.univ : Set ℝ) \ A = Aᶜ by ext; simp]
    exact dense_univ.sdiff_finite hAfin
  have hBcomp : Dense Bᶜ := by
    rw [← show (Set.univ : Set ℝ) \ B = Bᶜ by ext; simp]
    exact dense_univ.sdiff_finite hBfin
  have hdre : Dense (Complex.re ⁻¹' Aᶜ) := hAcomp.preimage Complex.isOpenMap_re
  have hdim : Dense (Complex.im ⁻¹' Bᶜ) := hBcomp.preimage Complex.isOpenMap_im
  have hdreOpen : IsOpen (Complex.re ⁻¹' Aᶜ) :=
    hAfin.isClosed.isOpen_compl.preimage Complex.continuous_re
  have hd : Dense d := hdre.inter_of_isOpen_left hdim hdreOpen
  have hopen1 : IsOpen (H1 '' K.openCarrier) := H1.isOpenMap _ isOpen_interior
  have hopen2 : IsOpen (H2 '' K.openCarrier) := H2.isOpenMap _ isOpen_interior
  have hreg1 : interior (closure (H1 '' K.openCarrier)) = H1 '' K.openCarrier := by
    rw [← H1.image_closure, ← H1.image_interior, region_openCarrier_regular]
  have hreg2 : interior (closure (H2 '' K.openCarrier)) = H2 '' K.openCarrier := by
    rw [← H2.image_closure, ← H2.image_interior, region_openCarrier_regular]
  apply regularOpen_eq_of_eqOn_dense hopen1 hreg1 hopen2 hreg2 hd
  intro z hz
  have hoff : ∀ v ∈ K.vertices, z.re ≠ hx₁ v.re ∧ z.im ≠ hy₁ v.im := by
    intro v hv
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact hz.1 ⟨v.re, ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩, h.symm⟩
    · intro h
      exact hz.2 ⟨v.im, ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩, h.symm⟩
  have hoffinv := inverse_offVertexGrid_of_target_offGrid K hx₁ hy₁ hx₂ hy₂
    hmx₁ hmy₁ hmx₂ hmy₂ hex hey z hoff
  have hsame := inverse_preserves_vertexGridComparisons K hx₁ hy₁ hx₂ hy₂
    hmx₁ hmy₁ hmx₂ hmy₂ hex hey z
  have hmem := sameVertexGridCell_openCarrier_iff K (H1.symm z) (H2.symm z)
    hoffinv.1 hoffinv.2 hsame
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hxz⟩
    have hxinv : H1.symm z ∈ K.openCarrier := by
      rw [← hxz, H1.symm_apply_apply]
      exact hx
    exact ⟨H2.symm z, hmem.mp hxinv, H2.apply_symm_apply z⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hxz⟩
    have hxinv : H2.symm z ∈ K.openCarrier := by
      rw [← hxz, H2.symm_apply_apply]
      exact hx
    exact ⟨H1.symm z, hmem.mpr hxinv, H1.apply_symm_apply z⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.periodic_mem_of_vadd_eq
statement:
private theorem periodic_mem_of_vadd_eq {S : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ}
    (h : a +ᵥ S = S) : Function.Periodic (fun x => x ∈ S) a
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  apply propext
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hx' : a + x ∈ S := by simpa [add_comm] using hx
    rw [← h] at hx'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hay⟩ := hx'
    have : y = x := by simpa using hay
    simpa [this] using hy
  · intro hx
    have hx' : a + x ∈ a +ᵥ S := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [h] at hx'
    simpa [add_comm] using hx'

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.periodicIntEnumeration_exists
statement:
theorem periodicIntEnumeration_exists
    (E : Set ℝ) (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hE : E.Nonempty)
    (hlocal : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (E ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hperiod : p +ᵥ E = E) : Nonempty (PeriodicIntEnumeration E p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : Set ℝ := E ∩ Ico 0 p
  have hFfin : F.Finite := hlocal (Ico 0 p) (Metric.isBounded_Ico 0 p)
  have hFnonempty : F.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hE
    let q : ℤ := Int.floor (x / p)
    let r : ℝ := x - (q : ℝ) * p
    have hr_eq : r = p * Int.fract (x / p) := by
      dsimp [r, q]
      rw [Int.fract]
      field_simp [hp.ne']
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := by
      rw [hr_eq]
      exact mul_nonneg hp.le (Int.fract_nonneg _)
    have hrp : r < p := by
      rw [hr_eq]
      nlinarith [Int.fract_lt_one (x / p)]
    have hrE : r ∈ E := by
      have hfun := (periodic_mem_of_vadd_eq hperiod).zsmul (-q)
      have hmem := (hfun x).mpr hx
      simpa [r, q, zsmul_eq_mul, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm,
        add_assoc] using hmem
    exact ⟨r, hrE, hr0, hrp⟩
  let A : Finset ℝ := hFfin.toFinset
  have hAco : (A : Set ℝ) = F := hFfin.coe_toFinset
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hFnonempty
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    change x ∈ (A : Set ℝ)
    exact hAco.symm ▸ hx
  have hApos : 0 < A.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hAne
  let n : ℕ := A.card
  have hn : 0 < n := hApos
  have hsort : n = A.card := rfl
  let e : Fin n ≃o A := Finset.orderIsoOfFin A hsort.symm
  let f : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => (e i : ℝ)
  have hf_strict : StrictMono f := by
    intro i j hij
    exact e.strictMono hij
  have hf_mem (i : Fin n) : f i ∈ E ∧ 0 ≤ f i ∧ f i < p := by
    have hiA : f i ∈ (A : Set ℝ) := (e i).property
    have hiF : f i ∈ F := hAco ▸ hiA
    exact hiF
  let nn : ℤ := Int.ofNat n
  have hnn : 0 < nn := by
    change (0 : ℤ) < (n : ℤ)
    exact_mod_cast hn
  have hnn_ne : nn ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hnn
  let rem (j : ℤ) : Fin n :=
    ⟨(j % nn).toNat, by
      apply (Int.toNat_lt (Int.emod_nonneg _ hnn_ne)).2
      simpa [nn] using (Int.emod_lt_of_pos j hnn)
    ⟩
  let quot (j : ℤ) : ℤ := j / nn
  let point (j : ℤ) : ℝ := f (rem j) + (quot j : ℝ) * p
  have hrem_nonneg (j : ℤ) : 0 ≤ j % nn := Int.emod_nonneg _ hnn_ne
  have hrem_lt (j : ℤ) : j % nn < nn := Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ hnn
  have hdecomp (j : ℤ) : j % nn + nn * (j / nn) = j :=
    Int.emod_add_mul_ediv j nn
  have hpoint_mem (j : ℤ) : point j ∈ E := by
    have hbase : f (rem j) ∈ E := (hf_mem _).1
    have hfun := (periodic_mem_of_vadd_eq hperiod).zsmul (quot j)
    have hmem := (hfun (f (rem j))).mpr hbase
    simpa [point, quot, zsmul_eq_mul, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hmem
  have hpoint_succ (j : ℤ) : point j < point (j + 1) := by
    let r := j % nn
    let q := j / nn
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := hrem_nonneg j
    have hrlt : r < nn := hrem_lt j
    have hcases : r + 1 < nn ∨ r + 1 = nn := by omega
    rcases hcases with hlt | heq
    · have hqr : (j + 1) / nn = q ∧ (j + 1) % nn = r + 1 := by
        apply (Int.ediv_emod_unique hnn).2
        constructor
        · rw [show j + 1 = (r + 1) + nn * q by
            have hj : j = r + nn * q := by
              dsimp [r, q]
              exact (hdecomp j).symm
            rw [hj]
            ring]
        · exact ⟨by omega, hlt⟩
      have hrem_lt' : rem j < rem (j + 1) := by
        apply Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr
        rw [hqr.2]
        change r.toNat < (r + 1).toNat
        exact (Int.toNat_lt_toNat (by omega : 0 < r + 1)).2 (by omega)
      dsimp [point, quot]
      rw [hqr.1]
      have hfi := hf_strict hrem_lt'
      linarith
    · have hqr : (j + 1) / nn = q + 1 ∧ (j + 1) % nn = 0 := by
        apply (Int.ediv_emod_unique hnn).2
        constructor
        · have hj : j = r + nn * q := by
            dsimp [r, q]
            exact (hdecomp j).symm
          calc
            0 + nn * (q + 1) = nn * (q + 1) := by simp
            _ = nn + nn * q := by ring
            _ = (r + 1) + nn * q := by rw [heq]
            _ = j + 1 := by rw [hj]; ring
        · exact ⟨le_refl _, by omega⟩
      have hrem_eq : rem (j + 1) = ⟨0, hn⟩ := by
        apply Fin.ext
        dsimp [rem]
        rw [hqr.2, Int.toNat_zero]
      have hcross : f (rem j) < f (⟨0, hn⟩) + p := by
        have hlast := (hf_mem (rem j)).2.2
        have hzero := (hf_mem (⟨0, hn⟩)).2.1
        linarith
      dsimp [point, quot]
      rw [hqr.1, hrem_eq]
      rw [show j / nn = q by rfl]
      change f (rem j) + (q : ℝ) * p <
        f (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) + ((q + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * p
      push_cast
      linarith
  have hpoint_strict : StrictMono point := strictMono_int_of_lt_succ hpoint_succ
  have hpoint_period (j : ℤ) : point (j + Int.ofNat n) = point j + p := by
    change point (j + nn) = point j + p
    have hqr : (j + nn) / nn = j / nn + 1 ∧ (j + nn) % nn = j % nn := by
      constructor
      · rw [show j + nn = j + 1 * nn by ring, Int.add_mul_ediv_right _ _ hnn_ne]
      · exact Int.add_emod_right _ _
    have hrem_eq : rem (j + nn) = rem j := by
      apply Fin.ext
      dsimp [rem]
      rw [hqr.2]
    dsimp [point, quot]
    rw [hqr.1, hrem_eq]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hpoint_nat (i : Fin n) : point (Int.ofNat i) = f i := by
    have hi0 : 0 ≤ (Int.ofNat i : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg _
    have hin : (Int.ofNat i : ℤ) < nn := by
      dsimp [nn]
      exact_mod_cast i.isLt
    have hq : (Int.ofNat i : ℤ) / nn = 0 := Int.ediv_eq_zero_of_lt hi0 hin
    have hr : (Int.ofNat i : ℤ) % nn = (Int.ofNat i : ℤ) :=
      Int.emod_eq_of_lt hi0 hin
    have hrem : rem (Int.ofNat i) = i := by
      apply Fin.ext
      dsimp [rem]
      change ((Int.ofNat (i : ℕ) % nn).toNat = (i : ℕ))
      rw [hr]
      simp
    change f (rem (Int.ofNat i)) +
      (((Int.ofNat i : ℤ) / nn : ℤ) : ℝ) * p = f i
    rw [hq, hrem]
    simp
  have hpoint_range : Set.range point = E := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · rintro y ⟨j, rfl⟩
      exact hpoint_mem j
    · intro y hy
      let q : ℤ := Int.floor (y / p)
      let r : ℝ := y - (q : ℝ) * p
      have hr_eq : r = p * Int.fract (y / p) := by
        dsimp [r, q]
        rw [Int.fract]
        field_simp [hp.ne']
      have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := by
        rw [hr_eq]
        exact mul_nonneg hp.le (Int.fract_nonneg _)
      have hrp : r < p := by
        rw [hr_eq]
        nlinarith [Int.fract_lt_one (y / p)]
      have hrE : r ∈ E := by
        have hfun := (periodic_mem_of_vadd_eq hperiod).zsmul (-q)
        have hmem := (hfun y).mpr hy
        simpa [r, q, zsmul_eq_mul, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm,
          add_assoc] using hmem
      have hi : ∃ i : Fin n, f i = r := by
        have hrA : r ∈ (A : Set ℝ) := hAco ▸ ⟨hrE, hr0, hrp⟩
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.surjective ⟨r, hrA⟩
        exact ⟨i, congrArg Subtype.val hi⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hiEq⟩ := hi
      let iZ : ℤ := Int.ofNat i
      let j : ℤ := iZ + nn * q
      have hi0 : 0 ≤ iZ := by
        dsimp [iZ]
        exact Int.natCast_nonneg _
      have hin : iZ < nn := by
        dsimp [iZ, nn]
        exact_mod_cast i.isLt
      have hjqr : j / nn = q ∧ j % nn = iZ := by
        apply (Int.ediv_emod_unique hnn).2
        constructor
        · dsimp [j]
        · exact ⟨hi0, hin⟩
      have hremj : rem j = i := by
        apply Fin.ext
        dsimp [rem]
        rw [hjqr.2]
        dsimp [iZ]
      refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
      dsimp [point, quot]
      rw [hjqr.1, hremj]
      rw [hiEq]
      dsimp [r, q]
      ring
  have hfund : E ∩ Ico 0 p = Set.range (fun i : Fin n ↦ point (Int.ofNat i)) := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · rintro y ⟨hy, hy0, hyp⟩
      have hrA : y ∈ (A : Set ℝ) := by
        exact hAco.symm ▸ ⟨hy, hy0, hyp⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.surjective ⟨y, hrA⟩
      refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
      have hiEq : f i = y := congrArg Subtype.val hi
      exact (hpoint_nat i).trans hiEq
    · intro y
      rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      rw [← hi]
      change point (Int.ofNat i) ∈ E ∩ Ico 0 p
      rw [hpoint_nat i]
      exact ⟨(hf_mem i).1, (hf_mem i).2⟩
  exact ⟨⟨n, hn, point, hpoint_strict, hpoint_range, hpoint_period, hfund⟩⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.verticalSlice_eq_generic
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  change (r + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ K.openCarrier) ↔
    Complex.mk r y ∈ K.openCarrier
  have heq : (r : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I = Complex.mk r y := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  rw [heq]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.finiteClosedIntervals_interior_isFiniteIntervalRegion
statement:
theorem finiteClosedIntervals_interior_isFiniteIntervalRegion :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n → ℝ),
      IsFiniteIntervalRegion (interior (⋃ i, Set.Icc (a i) (b i)))
proof:
:= by
  intro n a b
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.finiteClosedIntervals_merge a b
  exact ⟨P.n, P.left, P.right, P.lt, P.union_eq⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.verticalSlice_closedRectangulationPresentation
statement:
private theorem verticalSlice_closedRectangulationPresentation :
    ∀ (K : Region) {r : ℝ}, r ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re →
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (a b : Fin n → ℝ),
        closure (verticalSlice K r) = ⋃ i, Set.Icc (a i) (b i) ∧
        verticalSlice K r = interior (⋃ i, Set.Icc (a i) (b i))
proof:
:= by
  intro K r hr
  rw [verticalSlice_eq_generic]
  exact Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.verticalSlice_closedIntervals K hr

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.verticalSlice_locallyConstant_offVertexLevels
statement:
private theorem verticalSlice_locallyConstant_offVertexLevels :
    ∀ (K : Region) {r : ℝ},
      r ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re →
      ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, |s - r| < ε →
        verticalSlice K s = verticalSlice K r
proof:
:= by
  intro K r hr
  simpa only [verticalSlice_eq_generic] using
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.verticalSlice_locallyConstant K hr

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.verticalSlice_finiteIntervals_proof
statement:
private theorem verticalSlice_finiteIntervals_proof :
    ∀ (K : Region) {r : ℝ},
      r ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re →
      IsFiniteIntervalRegion (verticalSlice K r) ∧
      ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, |s - r| < ε →
        verticalSlice K s = verticalSlice K r
proof:
:= by
  intro K r hr
  constructor
  · rw [verticalSlice_eq_generic]
    exact Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.verticalSlice_isFiniteIntervalRegion K hr
  · exact verticalSlice_locallyConstant_offVertexLevels K hr

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.columnPacking_iff_slicePacking
statement:
private theorem columnPacking_iff_slicePacking :
    ∀ {K : Region} {c : ℝ} {Y : Set ℝ},
      Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
          (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements
            {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y}) ↔
      ∀ r : ℝ, Set.Pairwise Y
        (MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint volume on
          ((· +ᵥ verticalSlice K r) : ℝ → Set ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  intro K c Y
  rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint]
  constructor
  · intro hpacking r y hyY y' hy'Y hyy'
    apply Disjoint.aedisjoint
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxy hxy'
    let sy : Tiling.Plane := (c : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let sy' : Tiling.Plane := (c : ℂ) + (y' : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hsy : sy ∈ {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y} := by
      exact ⟨by simp [sy], by simpa [sy] using hyY⟩
    have hsy' : sy' ∈ {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y} := by
      exact ⟨by simp [sy'], by simpa [sy'] using hy'Y⟩
    have hsysy' : sy ≠ sy' := by
      intro heq
      apply hyy'
      simpa [sy, sy'] using congrArg Complex.im heq
    have hd : Disjoint (sy +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (sy' +ᵥ K.openCarrier) :=
      hpacking hsy hsy' hsysy'
    rw [Set.disjoint_left] at hd
    refine hd (a := (((c + r : ℝ) : ℂ) + (x : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ?_ ?_
    · change x ∈ y +ᵥ verticalSlice K r at hxy
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hxy
      rw [verticalSlice] at hxy
      change r + ((-y + x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ K.openCarrier at hxy
      have heq : -sy + (((c + r : ℝ) : ℂ) + (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
          r + ((-y + x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sy]
      change -sy + (((c + r : ℝ) : ℂ) + (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ K.openCarrier
      rwa [heq]
    · change x ∈ y' +ᵥ verticalSlice K r at hxy'
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hxy'
      rw [verticalSlice] at hxy'
      change r + ((-y' + x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ K.openCarrier at hxy'
      have heq : -sy' + (((c + r : ℝ) : ℂ) + (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
          r + ((-y' + x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sy']
      change -sy' + (((c + r : ℝ) : ℂ) + (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ K.openCarrier
      rwa [heq]
  · intro hslices s hs t ht hst
    change Disjoint (s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (t +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzs hzt
    obtain ⟨hsre, hsY⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨htre, htY⟩ := ht
    have hsimne : s.im ≠ t.im := by
      intro him
      apply hst
      exact Complex.ext (hsre.trans htre.symm) him
    let r : ℝ := z.re - c
    let x : ℝ := z.im
    have hxs : x ∈ s.im +ᵥ verticalSlice K r := by
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      rw [verticalSlice]
      change r + ((-s.im + x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ K.openCarrier
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hzs
      convert hzs using 1
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp [r, x, hsre]
        ring
      · simp [r, x]
    have hxt : x ∈ t.im +ᵥ verticalSlice K r := by
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      rw [verticalSlice]
      change r + ((-t.im + x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ K.openCarrier
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hzt
      convert hzt using 1
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp [r, x, htre]
        ring
      · simp [r, x]
    have hopenSlice : IsOpen (verticalSlice K r) := by
      apply K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.preimage
      fun_prop
    have hopenInter : IsOpen
        ((s.im +ᵥ verticalSlice K r) ∩ (t.im +ᵥ verticalSlice K r)) :=
      (hopenSlice.vadd s.im).inter (hopenSlice.vadd t.im)
    have hzero := (hslices r hsY htY hsimne).eq
    exact (ne_of_gt (hopenInter.measure_pos volume ⟨x, hxs, hxt⟩)) hzero

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.periodicPacking_multiplicity_le_one
statement:
private theorem periodicPacking_multiplicity_le_one :
    ∀ {B' Y : Set ℝ},
      Set.Pairwise Y
        (MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint volume on ((· +ᵥ B') : ℝ → Set ℝ)) →
      Y.Countable → ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, lineMultiplicity B' Y x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro B' Y hpacking hcountable
  let _ : Countable Y := hcountable
  have hover : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ∀ y z : Y, y ≠ z →
      ¬ (x ∈ y.1 +ᵥ B' ∧ x ∈ z.1 +ᵥ B') := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro y
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro z
    by_cases hyz : y = z
    · filter_upwards [] with x
      simp [hyz]
    · have hz : volume ((y.1 +ᵥ B') ∩ (z.1 +ᵥ B')) = 0 :=
        hpacking y.2 z.2 (fun h ↦ hyz (Subtype.ext h))
      filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hz] with x hx
      intro _
      simpa only [mem_inter_iff, not_and] using hx
  filter_upwards [hover] with x hx
  rw [lineMultiplicity]
  by_cases hnone : ∀ y : Y, x ∉ y.1 +ᵥ B'
  · simp [hnone]
  · have hex : ∃ y : Y, x ∈ y.1 +ᵥ B' := by
      simpa only [not_not] using not_forall.mp hnone
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hex
    rw [tsum_eq_single y]
    · simp [hy]
    · intro z hzy
      have hz : x ∉ z.1 +ᵥ B' := fun hz ↦ hx y z (Ne.symm hzy) ⟨hy, hz⟩
      simp [hz]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.mem_openUnion_column_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_openUnion_column_iff
    (K : Region) (c r y : ℝ) (Y : Set ℝ) :
    ((c + r : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
        openUnion K {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y} ↔
      ∃ t : Y, y ∈ t.1 +ᵥ verticalSlice K r
proof:
:= by
  rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier]
  constructor
  · rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
    rintro ⟨⟨z, hzre, hzY⟩, hz⟩
    refine ⟨⟨z.im, hzY⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, verticalSlice]
    change r + ((-z.im + y : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ K.openCarrier
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hz
    convert hz using 1
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp [hzre]
    · simp
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    let z : Tiling.Plane := (c : ℂ) + (t.1 : ℂ) * Complex.I
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
    refine ⟨⟨z, by simp [z], by simp [z, t.2]⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, verticalSlice] at ht
    change -z + (((c + r : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ K.openCarrier
    change r + ((-t.1 + y : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ K.openCarrier at ht
    convert ht using 1
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [z]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.openUnion_column_fubini
statement:
private theorem openUnion_column_fubini
    {K : Region} {c : ℝ} {Y : Set ℝ}
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y})) :
    ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, ∀ᵐ y : ℝ ∂volume,
      ((((x : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
          openUnion K {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y}) ↔
        (((x : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
          regularSupport K {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y}))
proof:
:= by
  have hae := Tiling.AxisParallel.openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport hpacking
  have hpull :=
    Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.symm.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hae
  have hprod : ∀ᵐ p : ℝ × ℝ ∂volume.prod volume,
      (((p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
          openUnion K {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y}) ↔
        ((p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
          regularSupport K {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y})) := by
    filter_upwards [hpull] with p hp
    have heq : ({ re := p.1, im := p.2 } : ℂ) =
        (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp
    change (({ re := p.1, im := p.2 } : ℂ) ∈
      openUnion K {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y}) =
      (({ re := p.1, im := p.2 } : ℂ) ∈
        regularSupport K {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y}) at hp
    rw [heq] at hp
    exact Iff.of_eq hp
  exact MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod hprod

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.column_centres_countable
statement:
private theorem column_centres_countable
    {K : Region} {c : ℝ} {Y : Set ℝ}
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y})) : Y.Countable
proof:
:= by
  let Q : Set Tiling.Plane := {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y}
  let P := K.polygonalProtoTiling Q
  let F : Q → Set Tiling.Plane := fun q ↦ (q : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support
  let placementOf : Q → P.placements := fun q ↦ ⟨((q : Tiling.Plane), ()), q.2⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective placementOf := by
    intro a b hab
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun i : P.placements ↦ i.1.1) hab)
  have hloc : LocallyFinite F := by
    have h := (P.locallyFinite_placedTile hpacking).comp_injective hinj
    change LocallyFinite F at h
    exact h
  have hne : ∀ q : Q, (F q).Nonempty := by
    intro q
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := K.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty K.nonempty
    exact ⟨q.1 + x, ⟨x, interior_subset hx, rfl⟩⟩
  let _ : Countable Q := Set.countable_univ_iff.mp (hloc.countable_univ hne)
  let e : Y → Q := fun y ↦
    ⟨(c : ℂ) + (y.1 : ℂ) * Complex.I, by simp [Q, y.2]⟩
  have he : Function.Injective e := by
    intro y z hyz
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa [e] using congrArg (fun w : Q ↦ w.1.im) hyz
  let _ : Countable Y := he.countable
  exact Set.countable_coe_iff.mp inferInstance

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.genericSliceTilings_of_completeColumn
statement:
theorem genericSliceTilings_of_completeColumn :
    ∀ {K : Region} {c : ℝ} {Y : Set ℝ}, Y.Nonempty →
      IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical K
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y} →
      ∀ r : ℝ, r ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re →
        (verticalSlice K r).Nonempty → LineTiles (verticalSlice K r) Y
proof:
:= by
  intro K c Y hY hC r hr hBr
  let C : Set Tiling.Plane := {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y}
  have hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements C) := hC.1
  have hpair := (columnPacking_iff_slicePacking (K := K) (c := c) (Y := Y)).mp hpacking
  have hcount : Y.Countable := column_centres_countable hpacking
  have hopenB : IsOpen (verticalSlice K r) := by
    apply K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.preimage
    fun_prop
  refine ⟨hopenB.measurableSet, MeasurableSet.univ, hcount, hpair r, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hconst⟩ :=
    verticalSlice_locallyConstant_offVertexLevels K hr
  have hfub := openUnion_column_fubini hpacking
  have hdense : Dense {x : ℝ | ∀ᵐ y : ℝ ∂volume,
      ((((x : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ openUnion K C) ↔
        (((x : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ regularSupport K C))} :=
    volume.dense_of_ae hfub
  have hopenI : IsOpen (Set.Ioo (c + r - ε) (c + r + ε)) := isOpen_Ioo
  have hneI : (Set.Ioo (c + r - ε) (c + r + ε)).Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨c + r, ?_⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_Ioo]
    constructor <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨x, hxgood, hxI⟩ := hdense.exists_mem_open hopenI hneI
  let s := x - c
  have hsclose : |s - r| < ε := by
    rw [abs_lt]
    change -ε < x - c - r ∧ x - c - r < ε
    simp only [Set.mem_Ioo] at hxI
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hslice : verticalSlice K s = verticalSlice K r := hconst s hsclose
  have hBs : (verticalSlice K s).Nonempty := hslice.symm ▸ hBr
  have hsupport : ∀ y : ℝ,
      ((x : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ regularSupport K C := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨t, htY⟩ := hY
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hBs
    let y₀ := t + b
    have hopenmem : ((c + s : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ openUnion K C :=
      (mem_openUnion_column_iff K c s y₀ Y).2 ⟨⟨t, htY⟩, by
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
        simpa [y₀] using hb⟩
    have hseed : ((c + s : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
        regularSupport K C := by
      change _ ∈ interior (closure (openUnion K C))
      have hopenU : IsOpen (openUnion K C) :=
        isOpen_iUnion fun q ↦ K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd q.1
      have hint : ((c + s : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
          interior (openUnion K C) := by
        rw [hopenU.interior_eq]
        exact hopenmem
      exact interior_mono subset_closure hint
    have hinv := hC.2.2.2 (y - y₀)
    have hv : ((y - y₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I +ᵥ
        (((c + s : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈
          ((y - y₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I +ᵥ regularSupport K C :=
      ⟨_, hseed, rfl⟩
    rw [hinv] at hv
    convert hv using 1
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [s]
  filter_upwards [hxgood] with y hy
  simp only [Set.mem_univ, true_iff]
  have hopenmem : ((x : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ openUnion K C :=
    hy.mpr (hsupport y)
  have h := (mem_openUnion_column_iff K c s y Y).1 (by
    convert hopenmem using 1
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [s])
  simpa only [hslice] using h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.openUnion_column_vertical_vadd_ae
statement:
private theorem openUnion_column_vertical_vadd_ae
    {K : Region} {c a : ℝ} {Y : Set ℝ}
    (_hYcount : Y.Countable)
    (htiles : ∀ r : ℝ, r ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re →
      (verticalSlice K r).Nonempty → LineTiles (verticalSlice K r) Y) :
    (((a : ℂ) * Complex.I) +ᵥ
        openUnion K {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y}) =ᵐ[volume]
      openUnion K {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y}
proof:
:= by
  let C : Set Tiling.Plane := {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y}
  let E : Set ℝ := c +ᵥ (K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re : Set ℝ)
  have hEfinite : E.Finite := by
    have hfin : ((K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re : Finset ℝ) : Set ℝ).Finite :=
      (K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re).finite_toSet
    have h := hfin.image (fun t : ℝ ↦ c + t)
    convert h using 1
    ext x
    change x ∈ c +ᵥ (K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re : Set ℝ) ↔ _
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    change (-c + x ∈ (K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re : Set ℝ)) ↔
      x ∈ (fun t : ℝ ↦ c + t) '' (K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re : Set ℝ)
    constructor
    · intro hv
      exact ⟨-c + x, hv, by linarith⟩
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, hvx⟩
      convert hv using 1
      linarith
  have hgeneric : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume,
      x - c ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re := by
    filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp (hEfinite.measure_zero volume)] with x hx
    intro hbad
    apply hx
    refine ⟨x - c, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using hbad
    · simp
  have hiter : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, ∀ᵐ y : ℝ ∂volume,
      (((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ ((a : ℂ) * Complex.I) +ᵥ openUnion K C) ↔
        ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ openUnion K C)) := by
    filter_upwards [hgeneric] with x hxgen
    let r := x - c
    by_cases hB : (verticalSlice K r).Nonempty
    · have ht := htiles r hxgen hB
      have hcov : ∀ᵐ y : ℝ ∂volume, ∃ t : Y, y ∈ t.1 +ᵥ verticalSlice K r := by
        filter_upwards [ht.2.2.2.2] with y hy
        exact hy.mp (Set.mem_univ y)
      have hcovShift := (quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left volume (-a)).ae hcov
      filter_upwards [hcov, hcovShift] with y hy hyshift
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      change (-((a : ℂ) * Complex.I) +
          ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ openUnion K C) ↔ _
      have hx : x = c + r := by simp [r]
      rw [show -((a : ℂ) * Complex.I) + ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
          (x : ℂ) + ((y - a : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp
        ring]
      constructor
      · intro _
        rw [hx]
        exact (mem_openUnion_column_iff K c r y Y).2 hy
      · intro _
        rw [hx]
        apply (mem_openUnion_column_iff K c r (y - a) Y).2
        simpa only [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hyshift
    · filter_upwards [] with y
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      change (-((a : ℂ) * Complex.I) +
          ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ openUnion K C) ↔ _
      have hx : x = c + r := by simp [r]
      rw [show -((a : ℂ) * Complex.I) + ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
          (x : ℂ) + ((y - a : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp
        ring]
      rw [hx, mem_openUnion_column_iff K c r (y - a) Y,
        mem_openUnion_column_iff K c r y Y]
      simp [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hB]
  have hmeas : MeasurableSet {p : ℝ × ℝ |
      (((p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ ((a : ℂ) * Complex.I) +ᵥ openUnion K C) ↔
        ((p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ openUnion K C))} := by
    let f : ℝ × ℝ → Tiling.Plane := fun p ↦
      (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hf : Measurable f := by fun_prop
    apply MeasurableSet.iff
    · exact (((isOpen_iUnion fun q : C ↦
          K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd q.1).vadd _).measurableSet.preimage hf)
    · exact ((isOpen_iUnion fun q : C ↦
          K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd q.1).measurableSet.preimage hf)
  have hprod := (MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae hmeas).2 hiter
  have hpull := Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hprod
  filter_upwards [hpull] with z hz
  change (z ∈ ((a : ℂ) * Complex.I) +ᵥ openUnion K C) = (z ∈ openUnion K C)
  have heq : ((Complex.measurableEquivRealProd z).1 : ℂ) +
      ((Complex.measurableEquivRealProd z).2 : ℂ) * Complex.I = z := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  rw [heq] at hz
  exact propext hz

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.completeColumn_of_genericSliceTilings
statement:
private theorem completeColumn_of_genericSliceTilings :
    ∀ {K : Region} {c : ℝ} {Y : Set ℝ}, Y.Nonempty →
      Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements
          {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y}) →
      (∀ r : ℝ, r ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re →
        (verticalSlice K r).Nonempty → LineTiles (verticalSlice K r) Y) →
      IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical K
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y}
proof:
:= by
  intro K c Y hY hpacking htiles
  let C : Set Tiling.Plane := {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y}
  have hcount : Y.Countable := column_centres_countable hpacking
  refine ⟨hpacking, ?_, ⟨c, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hY
    exact ⟨(c : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I, by simp [hy]⟩
  · intro z hz
    exact hz.1
  · intro a
    let v : Tiling.Plane := (a : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hraw : v +ᵥ openUnion K C =ᵐ[volume] openUnion K C :=
      openUnion_column_vertical_vadd_ae hcount htiles
    have hUR : openUnion K C =ᵐ[volume] regularSupport K C :=
      Tiling.AxisParallel.openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport hpacking
    have hshift :=
      (quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left volume (-v)).vadd_ae_eq_of_ae_eq v hUR
    have hae : v +ᵥ regularSupport K C =ᵐ[volume] regularSupport K C :=
      hshift.symm.trans (hraw.trans hUR)
    have hopenL : IsOpen (v +ᵥ regularSupport K C) :=
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport_isRegularOpen K C).1.vadd v
    have hregL : interior (closure (v +ᵥ regularSupport K C)) =
        v +ᵥ regularSupport K C := by
      rw [closure_vadd, interior_vadd,
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport_isRegularOpen K C).2]
    have heq := Tiling.AxisParallel.regularOpen_eq_of_aeEq hopenL hregL
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport_isRegularOpen K C).1
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport_isRegularOpen K C).2 hae
    simpa only [v, C] using heq

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.centerColumn_iff_genericSlices_proof
statement:
private theorem centerColumn_iff_genericSlices_proof :
    ∀ {K : Region} {C : Set Tiling.Plane} {c : ℝ} {Y : Set ℝ},
      C = {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y} → Y.Nonempty →
      Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements C) →
      (IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical K C ↔
        ∀ r : ℝ, r ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re →
          (verticalSlice K r).Nonempty → LineTiles (verticalSlice K r) Y)
proof:
:= by
  intro K C c Y hC hY hpacking
  subst C
  constructor
  · exact genericSliceTilings_of_completeColumn hY
  · exact completeColumn_of_genericSliceTilings hY hpacking

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.finiteIntervalRegion_measurable_bounded
statement:
theorem finiteIntervalRegion_measurable_bounded
    {B : Set ℝ} (hB : IsFiniteIntervalRegion B) :
    IsOpen B ∧ MeasurableSet B ∧ Bornology.IsBounded B
proof:
:= by
  rcases hB with ⟨n, left, right, _hlt, rfl⟩
  have hopen : IsOpen (⋃ i, Set.Ioo (left i) (right i)) :=
    isOpen_iUnion fun _ ↦ isOpen_Ioo
  exact ⟨hopen, hopen.measurableSet,
    Bornology.isBounded_iUnion.mpr fun i ↦ Metric.isBounded_Ioo (left i) (right i)⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.finiteIntervalRegion_volume_toReal_pos
statement:
theorem finiteIntervalRegion_volume_toReal_pos
    {B : Set ℝ} (hB : IsFiniteIntervalRegion B) (hBne : B.Nonempty) :
    0 < (volume B).toReal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hBopen, _hBmeas, hBbounded⟩ := finiteIntervalRegion_measurable_bounded hB
  apply ENNReal.toReal_pos
  · exact hBopen.measure_ne_zero volume hBne
  · exact hBbounded.measure_lt_top.ne

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.centerColumn_literal_reconstruction
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hC.2.2.1
  let Y : Set ℝ := {y : ℝ | (c : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ C}
  have hCY : C = {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y} := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have hzre : z.re = c := by
        simpa [Axis.transverseCoord] using hc z hz
      refine ⟨hzre, ?_⟩
      change (c : ℂ) + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ C
      convert hz using 1
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hzre]
    · rintro ⟨hzre, hzim⟩
      change (c : ℂ) + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ C at hzim
      convert hzim using 1
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hzre]
  have hY : Y.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hC.2.1
    exact ⟨z.im, hCY.subset hz |>.2⟩
  exact ⟨c, Y, hY, hCY⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.genericSlice_exists_positivePeriod
statement:
private theorem genericSlice_exists_positivePeriod :
    ∀ {K : Region} {C : Set Tiling.Plane},
      IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical K C →
      ∀ {r : ℝ}, r ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re →
        (verticalSlice K r).Nonempty →
        ∃ (Y : Set ℝ) (p : ℝ), 0 < p ∧ p +ᵥ Y = Y ∧
          LineTiles (verticalSlice K r) Y ∧
          ∀ s : ℝ, s ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re →
            (verticalSlice K s).Nonempty → LineTiles (verticalSlice K s) Y
proof:
:= by
  intro K C hC r hr hBr
  obtain ⟨c, Y, hY, hCY⟩ := centerColumn_literal_reconstruction hC
  have hall := genericSliceTilings_of_completeColumn hY (hCY ▸ hC)
  have htile := hall r hr hBr
  have hBfinite := verticalSlice_finiteIntervals_proof K hr |>.1
  have hBpos := finiteIntervalRegion_volume_toReal_pos hBfinite hBr
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hperiod⟩ := exists_positiveLinePeriod hBfinite hBpos htile
  exact ⟨Y, p, hp, hperiod, htile, hall⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.centerColumn_genericSlice_measure_eq_proof
statement:
private theorem centerColumn_genericSlice_measure_eq_proof :
    ∀ {K : Region} {C : Set Tiling.Plane},
      IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical K C →
      ∀ {r s : ℝ}, r ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re →
        s ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re →
        (verticalSlice K r).Nonempty → (verticalSlice K s).Nonempty →
        (volume (verticalSlice K r)).toReal =
          (volume (verticalSlice K s)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  intro K C hC r s hr hs hBr hBs
  obtain ⟨c, Y, hY, hCY⟩ := centerColumn_literal_reconstruction hC
  have hall := genericSliceTilings_of_completeColumn hY (hCY ▸ hC)
  have htr := hall r hr hBr
  have hts := hall s hs hBs
  have hfr := verticalSlice_finiteIntervals_proof K hr |>.1
  have hfs := verticalSlice_finiteIntervals_proof K hs |>.1
  have hpr := finiteIntervalRegion_volume_toReal_pos hfr hBr
  have hps := finiteIntervalRegion_volume_toReal_pos hfs hBs
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hperiod⟩ := exists_positiveLinePeriod hfr hpr htr
  have hmr := Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.linePeriod_mass
    (finiteIntervalRegion_measurable_bounded hfr).2.2 hpr htr hp hperiod
  have hms := Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.linePeriod_mass
    (finiteIntervalRegion_measurable_bounded hfs).2.2 hps hts hp hperiod
  have hnpos : 0 < (Set.ncard (Y ∩ Set.Ico 0 p) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Set.ncard_pos hmr.1).mpr hmr.2.1
  nlinarith [hmr.2.2, hms.2.2]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.finite_inter_bounded_of_separated
statement:
private theorem finite_inter_bounded_of_separated
    {S Q : Set ℝ} {delta : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hS : S.Pairwise fun x y ↦ delta ≤ dist x y)
    (hQ : Bornology.IsBounded Q) : (S ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hSclosed : IsClosed S := Metric.isClosed_of_pairwise_le_dist hdelta hS
  have hSdiscrete : IsDiscrete S := by
    rw [isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isOpen]
    intro s hs
    refine ⟨Metric.ball s delta, Metric.isOpen_ball, ?_⟩
    ext t
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨htball, htS⟩
      by_cases hts : t = s
      · simp [hts]
      · simp only [Metric.mem_ball] at htball
        exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge (by simpa [dist_comm] using hS htS hs hts)) htball)
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hdelta, hs⟩
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hQ.subset_closedBall (0 : ℝ)
  have hcompact : IsCompact (S ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 R) :=
    Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
      (hSclosed.inter Metric.isClosed_closedBall)
      (Metric.isBounded_closedBall.subset inter_subset_right)
  exact (hcompact.finite (hSdiscrete.mono inter_subset_left)).subset
    (inter_subset_inter_right S hR)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.periodicPacking_residues_finite
statement:
private theorem periodicPacking_residues_finite :
    ∀ {B' Y : Set ℝ} {p : ℝ}, IsFiniteIntervalRegion B' →
      0 < (volume B').toReal → 0 < p →
      p +ᵥ Y = Y →
      Set.Pairwise Y (MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint volume on ((· +ᵥ B') : ℝ → Set ℝ)) →
      (Y ∩ Set.Ico 0 p).Finite
proof:
:= by
  intro B' Y p hB hBpos hp _hperiod hpack
  obtain ⟨a, _b, eta, _etaR, _hab, heta, _hetaR, _hbound, hcollar, _⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IsFiniteIntervalRegion.extremeCollars
      hB hBpos
  have hsep : Y.Pairwise fun y z ↦ eta ≤ dist y z := by
    intro y hy z hz hyz
    by_contra hlt
    have hyzdist : dist y z < eta := lt_of_not_ge hlt
    let lo := max (y + a) (z + a)
    let hi := min (y + a + eta) (z + a + eta)
    have hlohi : lo < hi := by
      simp only [lo, hi, max_lt_iff, lt_min_iff]
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at hyzdist
      have habs := abs_lt.mp hyzdist
      constructor <;> constructor <;> linarith [habs.1, habs.2]
    have hsub : Set.Ioo lo hi ⊆ (y +ᵥ B') ∩ (z +ᵥ B') := by
      intro x hx
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
      apply And.intro <;> apply hcollar <;> simp only [Set.mem_Ioo] at hx ⊢
      · constructor <;> linarith [le_max_left (y + a) (z + a), min_le_left
          (y + a + eta) (z + a + eta)]
      · constructor <;> linarith [le_max_right (y + a) (z + a), min_le_right
          (y + a + eta) (z + a + eta)]
    have hpos : 0 < volume ((y +ᵥ B') ∩ (z +ᵥ B')) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (by rw [Real.volume_Ioo]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (sub_pos.mpr hlohi))
        (measure_mono hsub)
    exact hpos.ne' (hpack hy hz hyz)
  exact finite_inter_bounded_of_separated heta hsep (Metric.isBounded_Ico 0 p)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.periodicPacking_cellIntegral
statement:
private theorem periodicPacking_cellIntegral :
    ∀ {B' Y : Set ℝ} {p : ℝ}, IsFiniteIntervalRegion B' → 0 < p →
      p +ᵥ Y = Y → (Y ∩ Set.Ico 0 p).Finite →
      ∫⁻ x in Set.Ico 0 p, lineMultiplicity B' Y x ∂volume =
        Set.ncard (Y ∩ Set.Ico 0 p) * volume B'
proof:
:= by
  intro B' Y p hB hp hperiod hfinite
  simpa only [lineMultiplicity] using
    (periodicMultiplicity_cellIntegral
      (finiteIntervalRegion_measurable_bounded hB).2.1 hp hperiod hfinite)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.lineTiles_multiplicity_eq_one
statement:
private theorem lineTiles_multiplicity_eq_one
    {B Y : Set ℝ} (hTile : LineTiles B Y) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, lineMultiplicity B Y x = 1
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Countable Y := hTile.2.2.1
  have hover : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ∀ y z : Y, y ≠ z →
      ¬ (x ∈ y.1 +ᵥ B ∧ x ∈ z.1 +ᵥ B) := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro y
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro z
    by_cases hyz : y = z
    · filter_upwards [] with x
      simp [hyz]
    · have hz := hTile.2.2.2.1 y.2 z.2 (fun h ↦ hyz (Subtype.ext h))
      filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hz] with x hx
      intro _
      simpa only [Set.mem_inter_iff, not_and] using hx
  filter_upwards [hTile.2.2.2.2, hover] with x hcover hdisj
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hcover.mp (Set.mem_univ x)
  rw [lineMultiplicity, tsum_eq_single y]
  · simp [hy]
  · intro z hzy
    have hz : x ∉ z.1 +ᵥ B := fun hz ↦ hdisj y z (Ne.symm hzy) ⟨hy, hz⟩
    simp [hz]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.lineMultiplicity_aemeasurable
statement:
private theorem lineMultiplicity_aemeasurable
    {B Y : Set ℝ} (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hY : Y.Countable) :
    AEMeasurable (lineMultiplicity B Y) volume
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Countable Y := hY.to_subtype
  apply AEMeasurable.tsum
  intro y
  apply AEMeasurable.indicator aemeasurable_const
  have hm := hB.preimage
    (show Measurable (fun x : ℝ ↦ x - y.1) from measurable_id.sub measurable_const)
  have heq : y.1 +ᵥ B = (fun x : ℝ ↦ x - y.1) ⁻¹' B := by
    ext x
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    change (-y.1 + x ∈ B) ↔ (x - y.1 ∈ B)
    ring_nf
  rw [heq]
  exact hm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.lineMultiplicity_add_period
statement:
private theorem lineMultiplicity_add_period
    {B Y : Set ℝ} {q : ℝ} (hq : q +ᵥ Y = Y) (x : ℝ) :
    lineMultiplicity B Y (x + q) = lineMultiplicity B Y x
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (-q) +ᵥ Y = Y := (periodGroup Y).neg_mem hq
  let e : Y ≃ Y := {
    toFun := fun y ↦ ⟨q + y.1, by
      have : q + y.1 ∈ q +ᵥ Y := ⟨y.1, y.2, rfl⟩
      rwa [hq] at this⟩
    invFun := fun y ↦ ⟨-q + y.1, by
      have : -q + y.1 ∈ (-q) +ᵥ Y := ⟨y.1, y.2, rfl⟩
      rwa [hn] at this⟩
    left_inv := by intro y; apply Subtype.ext; simp
    right_inv := by intro y; apply Subtype.ext; simp }
  rw [lineMultiplicity, lineMultiplicity, ← e.tsum_eq]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro y
  change ((q + y.1) +ᵥ B).indicator (1 : ℝ → ENNReal) (x + q) =
    (y.1 +ᵥ B).indicator (1 : ℝ → ENNReal) x
  by_cases hy : x ∈ y.1 +ᵥ B
  · have hy' : x + q ∈ (q + y.1) +ᵥ B := by
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hy ⊢
      convert hy using 1
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      ring_nf
    simp [hy, hy']
  · have hy' : x + q ∉ (q + y.1) +ᵥ B := by
      intro h
      apply hy
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at h ⊢
      convert h using 1
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      ring_nf
    simp [hy, hy']

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.periodicPacking_tiles_of_measure_eq_proof
statement:
private theorem periodicPacking_tiles_of_measure_eq_proof :
    ∀ {B B' Y : Set ℝ} {p : ℝ},
      IsFiniteIntervalRegion B → IsFiniteIntervalRegion B' →
      LineTiles B Y → 0 < p → p +ᵥ Y = Y →
      Set.Pairwise Y (MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint volume on ((· +ᵥ B') : ℝ → Set ℝ)) →
      (volume B').toReal = (volume B).toReal → LineTiles B' Y
proof:
:= by
  intro B B' Y p hB hB' hTile hp hperiod hpack hmass
  obtain ⟨hBopen, hBmeas, hBbounded⟩ := finiteIntervalRegion_measurable_bounded hB
  obtain ⟨hB'open, hB'meas, hB'bounded⟩ := finiteIntervalRegion_measurable_bounded hB'
  have hBpos : 0 < (volume B).toReal := by
    have hBne : B.Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hTile.2.2.2.2.exists
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (hx.mp (Set.mem_univ x))
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hy
      exact ⟨_, hy⟩
    exact finiteIntervalRegion_volume_toReal_pos hB hBne
  have hB'pos : 0 < (volume B').toReal := hmass.symm ▸ hBpos
  have hFmass := Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.linePeriod_mass
    hBbounded hBpos hTile hp hperiod
  have hF : (Y ∩ Set.Ico 0 p).Finite :=
    periodicPacking_residues_finite hB' hB'pos hp hperiod hpack
  have hcellB := periodicPacking_cellIntegral hB hp hperiod hFmass.1
  have hcellB' := periodicPacking_cellIntegral hB' hp hperiod hF
  have hvol : volume B' = volume B := by
    apply (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' hB'bounded.measure_lt_top.ne
      hBbounded.measure_lt_top.ne).mp
    exact hmass
  have hintegral :
      (∫⁻ x in Set.Ico 0 p, lineMultiplicity B' Y x ∂volume) =
        ∫⁻ x in Set.Ico 0 p, (1 : ENNReal) ∂volume := by
    rw [hcellB', hvol, ← hcellB]
    apply setLIntegral_congr_fun_ae measurableSet_Ico
    filter_upwards [lineTiles_multiplicity_eq_one hTile] with x hx
    intro _
    exact hx
  have hle := periodicPacking_multiplicity_le_one hpack hTile.2.2.1
  have hleCell : lineMultiplicity B' Y ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Set.Ico 0 p)] 1 :=
    ae_restrict_of_ae hle
  have hmAE := lineMultiplicity_aemeasurable hB'meas hTile.2.2.1
  have hfiniteIntegral :
      (∫⁻ x, lineMultiplicity B' Y x ∂volume.restrict (Set.Ico 0 p)) ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [hintegral, MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_one]
    exact (Metric.isBounded_Ico 0 p).measure_lt_top.ne
  have hcellOne : lineMultiplicity B' Y =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Set.Ico 0 p)] 1 :=
    ae_eq_of_ae_le_of_lintegral_le hleCell hfiniteIntegral
      aemeasurable_const hintegral.ge
  have hbase : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume,
      x ∈ Set.Ico 0 p → lineMultiplicity B' Y x = 1 :=
    (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ico).mp hcellOne
  have hallCells : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ∀ n : ℤ,
      x ∈ ((n : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ Set.Ico 0 p → lineMultiplicity B' Y x = 1 := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro n
    let q : ℝ := (n : ℝ) * p
    have hq : ((n : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ Y = Y := by
      simpa only [periodGroup_isAddSubgroup, zsmul_eq_mul] using
        (periodGroup Y).zsmul_mem hperiod n
    have htranslated := (quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left volume (-q)).ae hbase
    filter_upwards [htranslated] with x hx
    intro hxcell
    have hx0 : -q + x ∈ Set.Ico 0 p := by
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hxcell
      exact hxcell
    have hm := hx hx0
    rw [← hm]
    have hh := lineMultiplicity_add_period (B := B') hq (-q + x)
    have heq : -q + x + q = x := by ring
    rw [heq] at hh
    exact hh
  have hglobal : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, lineMultiplicity B' Y x = 1 := by
    filter_upwards [hallCells] with x hx
    let n : ℤ := Int.floor (x / p)
    apply hx n
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, Set.mem_Ico]
    have hlo := Int.floor_le (x / p)
    have hhi := Int.lt_floor_add_one (x / p)
    have hlo' := (le_div_iff₀ hp).mp hlo
    have hhi' := (div_lt_iff₀ hp).mp hhi
    dsimp [n]
    constructor <;> linarith
  refine ⟨hB'meas, MeasurableSet.univ, hTile.2.2.1, hpack, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hglobal] with x hx
  simp only [Set.mem_univ, true_iff]
  by_contra hnone
  have hz : lineMultiplicity B' Y x = 0 := by
    rw [lineMultiplicity]
    have hf : (fun y : Y ↦ (y.1 +ᵥ B').indicator (1 : ℝ → ENNReal) x) = 0 := by
      funext y
      simp only [Set.indicator, Pi.one_apply]
      split_ifs with hy
      · exact False.elim (hnone ⟨y, hy⟩)
      · rfl
    rw [hf]
    simp
  rw [hz] at hx
  exact zero_ne_one hx

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.verticalSlice_finiteIntervals
statement:
theorem verticalSlice_finiteIntervals
    (K : Region) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re) :
    OneDimensional.IsFiniteIntervalRegion
        (OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.verticalSlice K r) ∧
      ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, |s - r| < ε →
        OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.verticalSlice K s =
          OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.verticalSlice K r
proof:
:=
  OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.verticalSlice_finiteIntervals_proof K hr

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.centerColumn_iff_genericSlices
statement:
theorem centerColumn_iff_genericSlices :
    ∀ {K : Region} {C : Set Tiling.Plane} {c : ℝ} {Y : Set ℝ},
      C = {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c ∧ z.im ∈ Y} → Y.Nonempty →
      Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements C) →
      (IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical K C ↔
        ∀ r : ℝ, r ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re →
          (OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.verticalSlice K r).Nonempty →
            OneDimensional.LineTiles
              (OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.verticalSlice K r) Y)
proof:
:=
  OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.centerColumn_iff_genericSlices_proof

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.centerColumn_genericSlice_measure_eq
statement:
theorem centerColumn_genericSlice_measure_eq :
    ∀ {K : Region} {C : Set Tiling.Plane},
      IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical K C →
      ∀ {r s : ℝ}, r ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re →
        s ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re →
        (OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.verticalSlice K r).Nonempty →
        (OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.verticalSlice K s).Nonempty →
        (volume (OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.verticalSlice K r)).toReal =
          (volume (OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.verticalSlice K s)).toReal
proof:
:=
  OneDimensional.ColumnSlices.centerColumn_genericSlice_measure_eq_proof

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.periodicPacking_tiles_of_measure_eq

theorem periodicPacking_tiles_of_measure_eq :

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.indicator_eq_iff_membership
statement:
private theorem indicator_eq_iff_membership {G : Type*}
    (S : Set G) (x y : G) :
    TranslationalTilings.setIndicator S x =
        TranslationalTilings.setIndicator S y ↔ (x ∈ S ↔ y ∈ S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : x ∈ S <;> by_cases hy : y ∈ S <;>

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.shiftedFirstLayer_periodic
statement:
private theorem shiftedFirstLayer_periodic
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {k : ℕ}
    (D : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin D.numberOfParts))
    (shift : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit → ℤ)
    (hfirst : D.period (order ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩) =
      (k : ℤ) • verticalDiscreteUnit) :
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy
      (shiftedDirectionalLayerCentres D order shift
        ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩)
      ((k : ℤ) • verticalDiscreteUnit)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  simp only [shiftedDirectionalLayerCentres, Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P, hxP⟩
    refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
    have hp := (quakeShift_preservesDirectionalDecomposition D order shift P).2.2
      ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩ x
    rw [hfirst] at hp
    exact hp.mp hxP
  · rintro ⟨P, hxP⟩
    refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
    have hp := (quakeShift_preservesDirectionalDecomposition D order shift P).2.2
      ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩ x
    rw [hfirst] at hp
    exact hp.mpr hxP

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.shiftedFirstLayer_subset_quakeShifted
statement:
private theorem shiftedFirstLayer_subset_quakeShifted
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (D : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin D.numberOfParts))
    (shift : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit → ℤ) :
    shiftedDirectionalLayerCentres D order shift
        ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩ ⊆
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeShiftedTranslations shift
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨P, hxP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
  have hxPlate : x ∈ TranslationalTilings.translateSet
      ((shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit)
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P) := by
    rw [← (quakeShift_preservesDirectionalDecomposition D order shift P).2.1]
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨0, D.number_pos⟩, hxP⟩
  change x - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit ∈
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P at hxPlate
  obtain ⟨haA, haComp⟩ := hxPlate
  let a : A := ⟨x - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit, haA⟩
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  have hP :
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph F A verticalDiscreteUnit).connectedComponentMk a =
        P := haComp
  change shift
      ((Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph F A verticalDiscreteUnit).connectedComponentMk a) •
        verticalDiscreteUnit + (a : TranslationalTilings.Plane) = x
  rw [hP]
  dsimp only [a]
  abel

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.exists_uniformVerticalSliceTransport
statement:
theorem exists_uniformVerticalSliceTransport
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A E : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {ell k M : ℕ}
    (hF : F.Nonempty) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hEVertical : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy
      E verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (hEPeriodic : TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic ell E)
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A E)
    (D : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin D.numberOfParts))
    (hk : 0 < k)
    (hfirst : D.period (order ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩) =
      (k : ℤ) • verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (hM : 0 < M)
    (hShiftedFirst : ∀ shift : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate
        F A verticalDiscreteUnit → ℤ,
      TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic M
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (shiftedDirectionalLayerCentres D order shift
            ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩))) :
    ∃ K : ℕ,
      K = TranslationalTilings.indicatorDilationModulus M F.card * k *
        TranslationalTilings.slicingLCM F verticalDiscreteUnit ∧
      0 < K ∧
      ∀ (shift : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate
          F A verticalDiscreteUnit → ℤ)
        (x d : ℤ),
        TranslationalTilings.translateSet
            ((d * (K : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
            (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
              (shiftedDirectionalLayerCentres D order shift
                  ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩ ∩ verticalDiscreteFibre x)) =
          Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
            (shiftedDirectionalLayerCentres D order shift
                ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩ ∩
              verticalDiscreteFibre (x + d * (K : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  let K := TranslationalTilings.indicatorDilationModulus M F.card * k *
    TranslationalTilings.slicingLCM F verticalDiscreteUnit
  refine ⟨K, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp only [K]
    exact Nat.mul_pos
      (Nat.mul_pos
        (by simpa [TranslationalTilings.indicatorDilationModulus] using
          (TranslationalTilings.dilationModulus_pos
            (oscillation := 1) (tileCard := F.card) hM))
        hk)
      (TranslationalTilings.slicingLCM_pos F verticalDiscreteUnit)
  · intro shift x d
    let C := shiftedDirectionalLayerCentres D order shift ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩
    have hCperiod : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy C
        ((k : ℤ) • verticalDiscreteUnit) :=
      shiftedFirstLayer_periodic D order shift hfirst
    have hCperiodMk : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy C
        (((M * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • verticalDiscreteUnit) := by
      convert hCperiod.zsmul (M : ℤ) using 1
      push_cast
      module
    have hCindicator : Function.Periodic
        (TranslationalTilings.setIndicator C)
        (((M * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • verticalDiscreteUnit) := by
      intro z
      apply (indicator_eq_iff_membership C _ _).2
      exact hCperiodMk z
    have hShiftTile := tilesOn_quakeShiftedTranslations hF hTile hEVertical shift
    have hCsubset : C ⊆ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeShiftedTranslations shift :=
      shiftedFirstLayer_subset_quakeShifted D order shift
    have hconv : TranslationalTilings.ScalarPeriodic M
        (TranslationalTilings.tileConv F
          (TranslationalTilings.setIndicator C)) := by
      rw [Tiling.RationalPolygonal.tileConv_indicator_eq_indicator_discreteCarrier
        hShiftTile hCsubset]
      intro z v
      apply (indicator_eq_iff_membership
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F C) _ _).2
      exact hShiftedFirst shift z v
    have htransport := Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.gtSliceTransport
      hM hk (h := verticalDiscreteUnit) (by
        constructor
        · intro hv
          have := congrFun hv 1
          simp at this
        · decide)
      hCindicator hconv
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup verticalDiscreteUnit)
        (x • horizontalDiscreteUnit))
      (d • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
    have hslice (y : ℤ) :
        TranslationalTilings.slicePattern verticalDiscreteUnit
            (QuotientAddGroup.mk'
              (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup verticalDiscreteUnit)
              (y • horizontalDiscreteUnit)) C =
          C ∩ verticalDiscreteFibre y := by
      have hcoset : TranslationalTilings.quotientCoset
          (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup verticalDiscreteUnit)
          (QuotientAddGroup.mk'
            (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup verticalDiscreteUnit)
            (y • horizontalDiscreteUnit)) =
          TranslationalTilings.addCoset
            (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup verticalDiscreteUnit)
            (y • horizontalDiscreteUnit) := by
        ext z
        exact QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem
      rw [TranslationalTilings.slicePattern, hcoset]
      rfl
    have hline :
        QuotientAddGroup.mk'
              (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup verticalDiscreteUnit)
              (x • horizontalDiscreteUnit) +
            QuotientAddGroup.mk'
              (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup verticalDiscreteUnit)
              (((TranslationalTilings.indicatorDilationModulus M F.card * k *
                  TranslationalTilings.slicingLCM F verticalDiscreteUnit : ℕ) : ℤ) •
                (d • horizontalDiscreteUnit)) =
          QuotientAddGroup.mk'
            (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup verticalDiscreteUnit)
            ((x + d * (K : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit) := by
      rw [← map_add]
      congr 1
      dsimp only [K]
      push_cast
      module
    rw [hline, hslice x, hslice (x + d * (K : ℤ))] at htransport
    have hvector :
        (((TranslationalTilings.indicatorDilationModulus M F.card * k *
              TranslationalTilings.slicingLCM F verticalDiscreteUnit : ℕ) : ℤ) •
            (d • horizontalDiscreteUnit)) =
          (d * (K : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit := by
      dsimp only [K]
      push_cast
      module
    rw [hvector] at htransport
    simpa only [C] using htransport

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.verticalSliceOrbit_scalarPeriodic
statement:
theorem verticalSliceOrbit_scalarPeriodic
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {k K L : ℕ}
    (D : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin D.numberOfParts))
    (hk : 0 < k)
    (hfirst : D.period (order ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩) =
      (k : ℤ) • verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (shift : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit → ℤ)
    (hK : 0 < K)
    (hTransport : ∀ (x d : ℤ),
      TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((d * (K : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
            (shiftedDirectionalLayerCentres D order shift
                ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩ ∩ verticalDiscreteFibre x)) =
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (shiftedDirectionalLayerCentres D order shift
              ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩ ∩
            verticalDiscreteFibre (x + d * (K : ℤ))))
    (hL : 0 < L) (hKL : K ∣ L) (hkL : k ∣ L) (x : ℤ) :
    TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic L
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
        (shiftedDirectionalLayerCentres D order shift
            ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩ ∩
          verticalDiscreteCongruenceClass x L))
proof:
:= by
  let C := shiftedDirectionalLayerCentres D order shift ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩
  let S := Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
    (C ∩ verticalDiscreteCongruenceClass x L)
  have hCperiod : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy C
      ((k : ℤ) • verticalDiscreteUnit) :=
    shiftedFirstLayer_periodic D order shift hfirst
  obtain ⟨qK, hqK⟩ := hKL
  obtain ⟨qk, hqk⟩ := hkL
  have hHorizontalForward (z : TranslationalTilings.Plane) (u : ℤ)
      (hz : z ∈ S) :
      z + (u * (L : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈ S := by
    obtain ⟨f, hfF, a, ⟨haC, haClass⟩, hzfa⟩ := hz
    obtain ⟨n, han⟩ := (mem_verticalDiscreteCongruenceClass_iff a x L).mp haClass
    have haFibre : a ∈ verticalDiscreteFibre (x + n * (L : ℤ)) :=
      (mem_verticalDiscreteFibre_iff a _).mpr han
    have hzSlice : z ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
        (C ∩ verticalDiscreteFibre (x + n * (L : ℤ))) :=
      ⟨f, hfF, a, ⟨haC, haFibre⟩, hzfa⟩
    let d : ℤ := u * (qK : ℤ)
    have hzTranslated : z + (d * (K : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈
        TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((d * (K : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
            (C ∩ verticalDiscreteFibre (x + n * (L : ℤ))) ) := by
      change z + (d * (K : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit -
          (d * (K : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (C ∩ verticalDiscreteFibre (x + n * (L : ℤ)))
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hzSlice
    rw [hTransport (x + n * (L : ℤ)) d] at hzTranslated
    have hindex : x + n * (L : ℤ) + d * (K : ℤ) =
        x + (n + u) * (L : ℤ) := by
      dsimp only [d]
      rw [hqK]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hindex] at hzTranslated
    obtain ⟨g, hgF, b, ⟨hbC, hbFibre⟩, hzg⟩ := hzTranslated
    refine ⟨g, hgF, b, ⟨hbC, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · apply (mem_verticalDiscreteCongruenceClass_iff b x L).mpr
      exact ⟨n + u, (mem_verticalDiscreteFibre_iff b _).mp hbFibre⟩
    · rw [← hzg]
      congr 1
      dsimp only [d]
      rw [hqK]
      push_cast
      module
  have hHorizontal (z : TranslationalTilings.Plane) (u : ℤ) :
      z + (u * (L : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈ S ↔ z ∈ S := by
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have := hHorizontalForward
        (z + (u * (L : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit) (-u) hz
      convert this using 1
      module
    · exact hHorizontalForward z u
  have hVerticalForward (z : TranslationalTilings.Plane) (u : ℤ)
      (hz : z ∈ S) :
      z + (u * (L : ℤ)) • verticalDiscreteUnit ∈ S := by
    obtain ⟨f, hfF, a, ⟨haC, haClass⟩, hzfa⟩ := hz
    have hCmultiple : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy C
        ((u * (qk : ℤ)) • ((k : ℤ) • verticalDiscreteUnit)) :=
      hCperiod.zsmul (u * (qk : ℤ))
    have haC' : a + (u * (L : ℤ)) • verticalDiscreteUnit ∈ C := by
      have hperiodVector :
          (u * (qk : ℤ)) • ((k : ℤ) • verticalDiscreteUnit) =
            (u * (L : ℤ)) • verticalDiscreteUnit := by
        rw [hqk]
        push_cast
        module
      rw [← hperiodVector]
      exact (hCmultiple a).2 haC
    have haClass' : a + (u * (L : ℤ)) • verticalDiscreteUnit ∈
        verticalDiscreteCongruenceClass x L := by
      apply (mem_verticalDiscreteCongruenceClass_iff _ x L).mpr
      obtain ⟨n, han⟩ :=
        (mem_verticalDiscreteCongruenceClass_iff a x L).mp haClass
      refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
      simpa [firstDiscreteCoordinate, verticalDiscreteUnit] using han
    refine ⟨f, hfF, a + (u * (L : ℤ)) • verticalDiscreteUnit,
      ⟨haC', haClass'⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hzfa]
    abel
  have hVertical (z : TranslationalTilings.Plane) (u : ℤ) :
      z + (u * (L : ℤ)) • verticalDiscreteUnit ∈ S ↔ z ∈ S := by
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have := hVerticalForward
        (z + (u * (L : ℤ)) • verticalDiscreteUnit) (-u) hz
      convert this using 1
      module
    · exact hVerticalForward z u
  intro z v
  change z + (L : ℤ) • v ∈ S ↔ z ∈ S
  have hvectors : z + (L : ℤ) • v =
      (z + (v 0 * (L : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit) +
        (v 1 * (L : ℤ)) • verticalDiscreteUnit := by
    ext i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply]
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [horizontalDiscreteUnit, verticalDiscreteUnit] <;> ring
  rw [hvectors, hVertical, hHorizontal]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.scalarPeriodic_of_dvd
statement:
private theorem scalarPeriodic_of_dvd
    {d p q : ℕ} {S : Set (TranslationalTilings.Lattice d)}
    (hpq : p ∣ q) (hS : TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic p S) :
    TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic q S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hpq
  intro x z
  simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, mul_smul] using hS x ((m : ℤ) • z)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.centre_eq_of_representations
statement:
private theorem centre_eq_of_representations
    {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] {F : Finset G} {A E : Set G}
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A E)
    {f g a b : G} (hf : f ∈ F) (ha : a ∈ A) (hg : g ∈ F) (hb : b ∈ A)
    (heq : f + a = g + b) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcount := (TranslationalTilings.tilesAtLevel_iff_representation_count F A E 1).mp hTile
  have hxE : f + a ∈ E := by
    by_contra hx
    have hz : (F.filter fun q => f + a - q ∈ A).card = 0 := by simpa [hx] using hcount (f + a)
    have hm : f ∈ F.filter fun q => f + a - q ∈ A := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, hf, true_and]
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using ha
    rw [Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hz] at hm
    simp at hm
  have hc : (F.filter fun q => f + a - q ∈ A).card = 1 := by simpa [hxE] using hcount (f + a)
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hc
  have hfm : f ∈ F.filter fun q => f + a - q ∈ A := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, hf, true_and]
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using ha
  have hgm : g ∈ F.filter fun q => f + a - q ∈ A := by
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hg, ?_⟩
    rw [heq]
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using hb
  have hfq : f = q := by simpa [hq] using hfm
  have hgq : g = q := by simpa [hq] using hgm
  have hfg : f = g := hfq.trans hgq.symm
  rw [hfg] at heq
  exact add_left_cancel heq

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.same_firstCoordinate_vertical_shift
statement:
private theorem same_firstCoordinate_vertical_shift
    {x y : TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (h : firstDiscreteCoordinate x = firstDiscreteCoordinate y) :
    ∃ n : ℤ, x + n • verticalDiscreteUnit = y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨y 1 - x 1, ?_⟩
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · change x 0 + (y 1 - x 1) * 0 = y 0
    change x 0 = y 0 at h
    omega
  · change x 1 + (y 1 - x 1) * 1 = y 1
    ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.nonfirstUnion_subset
statement:
private theorem nonfirstUnion_subset
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane} {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (D : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin D.numberOfParts))
    (P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit) :
    (⋃ j : {j : Fin D.numberOfParts // j ≠ ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩},
      orderedPlateLayer D order P j.1) ⊆ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
  rw [← D.iUnion_parts P]
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨order j.1, hxj⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.nonfirstUnion_periodic
statement:
private theorem nonfirstUnion_periodic
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane} {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {L : ℕ}
    (D : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin D.numberOfParts))
    (P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (hLayer : ∀ j : Fin D.numberOfParts, j ≠ ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩ →
      TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic L
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F (orderedPlateLayer D order P j))) :
    TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic L
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
        (⋃ j : {j : Fin D.numberOfParts // j ≠ ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩},
          orderedPlateLayer D order P j.1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [discreteCarrier_iUnion]
  intro x z
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
    exact ⟨j, (hLayer j.1 j.2 x z).mp hj⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
    exact ⟨j, (hLayer j.1 j.2 x z).mpr hj⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.propagatedCentres_zero
statement:
private theorem propagatedCentres_zero
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane} {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (D : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin D.numberOfParts))
    (P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (r : ℕ ≃ {x // x ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P)})
