name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.discreteCarrier_sdiff
statement:
theorem discreteCarrier_sdiff
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A E C D : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A E)
    (hC : C ⊆ A) (hD : D ⊆ A) :
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F (C \ D) =
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F C \
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F D
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, c, ⟨hcC, hcD⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨f, hf, c, hcC, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨g, hg, d, hdD, heq⟩
    have hcd : c = d :=
      translation_eq_of_eq_representations hTile hf (hC hcC) hg (hD hdD) heq
    exact hcD (hcd ▸ hdD)
  · rintro ⟨⟨f, hf, c, hcC, rfl⟩, hnotD⟩
    refine ⟨f, hf, c, ⟨hcC, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    intro hcD
    exact hnotD ⟨f, hf, c, hcD, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.periodicOn_iUnion
proof:
:= by
  intro h hh x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hxi⟩
    exact ⟨i, (hS i h hh x).mp hxi⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hxi⟩
    exact ⟨i, (hS i h hh x).mpr hxi⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.periodicOn_sdiff
proof:
:= by
  intro h hh x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxE, hxS⟩
    refine ⟨(hE h hh x).mp hxE, ?_⟩
    intro hx
    exact hxS ((hS h hh x).mpr hx)
  · rintro ⟨hxE, hxS⟩
    refine ⟨(hE h hh x).mpr hxE, ?_⟩
    intro hx
    exact hxS ((hS h hh x).mp hx)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.tilesOn_quakeShiftedTranslations
statement:
theorem tilesOn_quakeShiftedTranslations
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A E : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A E)
    (hEVertical : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy E verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (shift : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit → ℤ) :
    TranslationalTilings.Tiles F
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeShiftedTranslations shift) E
proof:
:= by
  apply tiles_of_existsUnique_on_target
  · intro x hxE
    obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀, -⟩ := existsUnique_representation_of_mem hTile hxE
    let a₀ : A := ⟨x - f₀, hf₀.2⟩
    let P₀ : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit :=
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph
        F A verticalDiscreteUnit).connectedComponentMk a₀
    have hxP₀ : x ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P₀) := by
      refine ⟨f₀, hf₀.1, a₀,
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_quakePlateTranslations_mk a₀, ?_⟩
      dsimp only [a₀]
      abel
    have hperiod₀ :=
      (verticalPlateCarrier_periodic hF hTile hEVertical P₀).zsmul (-(shift P₀))
    have hback : x + (-(shift P₀)) • verticalDiscreteUnit ∈
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P₀) :=
      (hperiod₀ x).2 hxP₀
    obtain ⟨f, hf, a, haP₀, hrep⟩ := hback
    obtain ⟨haA, hacomp⟩ := haP₀
    let as : A := ⟨a, haA⟩
    have hnewTranslation : shift P₀ • verticalDiscreteUnit + a ∈
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeShiftedTranslations shift := by
      refine ⟨as, ?_⟩
      simp only [as, hacomp]
    have hxrep : x - f = shift P₀ • verticalDiscreteUnit + a := by
      have hx : x = f + a + shift P₀ • verticalDiscreteUnit := by
        rw [← hrep]
        simp only [neg_smul]
        abel
      rw [hx]
      abel
    refine ⟨f, ⟨hf, hxrep ▸ hnewTranslation⟩, ?_⟩
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨s, hsnew⟩ := hg.2
    let Q : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit :=
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph
        F A verticalDiscreteUnit).connectedComponentMk s
    have hxQ : x ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations Q) := by
      have hcarrier := shifted_representation_mem_plateCarrier
        hF hTile hEVertical hg.1 s shift
      have hxeq : x = g +
          (shift ((Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph
            F A verticalDiscreteUnit).connectedComponentMk s) • verticalDiscreteUnit +
              (s : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) := by
        calc
          x = g + (x - g) := by abel
          _ = g + (shift ((Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph
              F A verticalDiscreteUnit).connectedComponentMk s) • verticalDiscreteUnit +
                (s : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) := by rw [← hsnew]
      rwa [← hxeq] at hcarrier
    have hQP : Q = P₀ := by
      by_contra hne
      exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (verticalPlateCarriers_disjoint hTile hne)) hxQ hxP₀
    have hsameShift : shift Q = shift P₀ := congrArg shift hQP
    have hgOriginal : g + (s : TranslationalTilings.Plane) = f + a := by
      have hxg : x = g + (shift Q • verticalDiscreteUnit +
          (s : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) := by
        calc
          x = g + (x - g) := by abel
          _ = g + (shift Q • verticalDiscreteUnit +
              (s : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) := by rw [← hsnew]
      rw [hsameShift] at hxg
      have hxf : x = f + (shift P₀ • verticalDiscreteUnit + a) := by
        calc
          x = f + (x - f) := by abel
          _ = f + (shift P₀ • verticalDiscreteUnit + a) := by rw [hxrep]
      rw [hxg] at hxf
      apply add_left_cancel (a := shift P₀ • verticalDiscreteUnit)
      simpa only [add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hxf
    have hsa : (s : TranslationalTilings.Plane) = a :=
      translation_eq_of_eq_representations
        hTile hg.1 s.2 hf haA hgOriginal
    have hgf : g = f := by
      rw [hsa] at hgOriginal
      exact add_right_cancel hgOriginal
    exact hgf
  · intro x hxE f hf hxshift
    obtain ⟨a, hnew⟩ := hxshift
    have hcarrier := shifted_representation_mem_plateCarrier
      hF hTile hEVertical hf a shift
    have hxeq : x = f +
        (shift ((Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph
          F A verticalDiscreteUnit).connectedComponentMk a) • verticalDiscreteUnit +
            (a : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) := by
      calc
        x = f + (x - f) := by abel
        _ = f + (shift ((Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph
            F A verticalDiscreteUnit).connectedComponentMk a) • verticalDiscreteUnit +
              (a : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) := by rw [← hnew]
    rw [← hxeq] at hcarrier
    obtain ⟨g, hg, b, hbP, hgb⟩ := hcarrier
    exact hxE (hgb ▸ add_mem_target_of_tiles hTile hg (Classical.choose hbP))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.exists_verticalPlateEnumeration
statement:
theorem exists_verticalPlateEnumeration
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A E : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A E)
    (hEVertical : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy E verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (a₀ : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ ≃ {x // x ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P)})
      (tilePoint centre : ℕ → TranslationalTilings.Plane),
      (∀ n, tilePoint n ∈ F) ∧
      (∀ n, centre n ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P) ∧
      (∀ n, (r n : TranslationalTilings.Plane) = tilePoint n + centre n) ∧
      centre 0 = a₀ ∧
      ∀ n, 0 < n → ∃ m, m < n ∧ ∃ g ∈ F,
        firstDiscreteCoordinate (r n : TranslationalTilings.Plane) =
          firstDiscreteCoordinate (g + centre m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀⟩ := hF
  let Tile := {f // f ∈ F}
  let Centre :=
    {a // a ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P}
  let Carrier :=
    {x // x ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P)}
  let X := Tile × Centre
  let fRoot : Tile := ⟨f₀, hf₀⟩
  let aRoot : Centre := ⟨a₀, a₀.2⟩
  let root : X := (fRoot, aRoot)
  let repMap : X → Carrier := fun x =>
    ⟨(x.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) +
        (x.2 : TranslationalTilings.Plane),
      ⟨x.1, x.1.2, x.2, x.2.2, rfl⟩⟩
  have hrepInj : Function.Injective repMap := by
    intro x y hxy
    have hadd :
        (x.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) +
            (x.2 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) =
          (y.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) +
            (y.2 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) :=
      congrArg Subtype.val hxy
    have hcentre : (x.2 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) = y.2 :=
      translation_eq_of_eq_representations hTile
        x.1.2 x.2.2.1 y.1.2 y.2.2.1 hadd
    have htile : (x.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) = y.1 := by
      rw [hcentre] at hadd
      exact add_right_cancel hadd
    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext htile) (Subtype.ext hcentre)
  have hrepSurj : Function.Surjective repMap := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨f, hf, a, ha, hza⟩ := z.2
    refine ⟨(⟨f, hf⟩, ⟨a, ha⟩), ?_⟩
    exact Subtype.ext hza.symm
  let repEquiv : X ≃ Carrier :=
    Equiv.ofBijective repMap ⟨hrepInj, hrepSurj⟩
                                                                                              
                                                            
  let base : Carrier := repMap root
  let verticalLine : ℤ → Carrier := fun n =>
    ⟨(base : TranslationalTilings.Plane) + n • verticalDiscreteUnit,
      ((verticalPlateCarrier_periodic ⟨f₀, hf₀⟩ hTile hEVertical P).zsmul n base).2
        base.2⟩
  have hlineInj : Function.Injective verticalLine := by
    intro m n hmn
    have hcoord :=
      congrArg (fun z : Carrier => (z : TranslationalTilings.Plane) 1) hmn
    change ((base : TranslationalTilings.Plane) + m • verticalDiscreteUnit) 1 =
      ((base : TranslationalTilings.Plane) + n • verticalDiscreteUnit) 1 at hcoord
    simpa [verticalDiscreteUnit] using hcoord
  let _ : Infinite Carrier := Infinite.of_injective verticalLine hlineInj
  let _ : Infinite X := Infinite.of_injective repEquiv.symm repEquiv.symm.injective
  let graph := Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph F A verticalDiscreteUnit
  let toVertex : Centre → A := fun a => ⟨a, a.2.1⟩
  have htoVertex : Function.Injective toVertex := by
    intro a b hab
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (fun z : A => (z : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) hab
  let rootVertex : A := toVertex aRoot
  have hreachable (a : Centre) : graph.Reachable rootVertex (toVertex a) := by
    apply SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.exact
    change (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph F A verticalDiscreteUnit).connectedComponentMk
        (toVertex aRoot) =
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph F A verticalDiscreteUnit).connectedComponentMk
        (toVertex a)
    exact aRoot.2.2.trans a.2.2.symm
  have hcentrePred (a : Centre) (ha : a ≠ aRoot) :
      ∃ b : Centre, graph.Adj (toVertex b) (toVertex a) ∧
        graph.dist rootVertex (toVertex b) < graph.dist rootVertex (toVertex a) := by
    have hvne : toVertex aRoot ≠ toVertex a := fun h => ha (htoVertex h).symm
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (hreachable a).exists_walk_length_eq_dist
    have hpPos : 0 < p.length := by
      rw [hp]
      exact (hreachable a).pos_dist_of_ne hvne
    have hpNotNil : ¬p.Nil := SimpleGraph.Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length.mpr hpPos
    have hbcomp :
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph F A verticalDiscreteUnit).connectedComponentMk
            p.penultimate = P :=
      (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj
        (p.adj_penultimate hpNotNil)).trans a.2.2
    let b : Centre := ⟨p.penultimate, ⟨p.penultimate.2, hbcomp⟩⟩
    refine ⟨b, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [graph, toVertex, b] using p.adj_penultimate hpNotNil
    · have hle :=
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph F A verticalDiscreteUnit).dist_le p.dropLast
      have hlength := p.length_dropLast_add_one hpNotNil
      change graph.dist rootVertex p.penultimate ≤ p.dropLast.length at hle
      change graph.dist rootVertex p.penultimate < graph.dist rootVertex (toVertex a)
      omega
  have hprojectionWitness (a b : Centre)
      (hab : graph.Adj (toVertex b) (toVertex a)) :
      ∃ f : Tile, ∃ g : Tile,
        firstDiscreteCoordinate ((f : TranslationalTilings.Plane) + a) =
          firstDiscreteCoordinate ((g : TranslationalTilings.Plane) + b) := by
    change (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph F A verticalDiscreteUnit).Adj
      (toVertex b) (toVertex a) at hab
    rw [Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj] at hab
    rcases hab.2 with htransfer | htransfer
    · obtain ⟨g, hg, f, hf, heq⟩ := htransfer
      refine ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, ⟨g, hg⟩, ?_⟩
      have hcoord := congrFun heq 0
      change g 0 + b.1 0 + 0 = f 0 + a.1 0 at hcoord
      simpa [firstDiscreteCoordinate, add_comm] using hcoord.symm
    · obtain ⟨f, hf, g, hg, heq⟩ := htransfer
      refine ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, ⟨g, hg⟩, ?_⟩
      have hcoord := congrFun heq 0
      change f 0 + a.1 0 + 0 = g 0 + b.1 0 at hcoord
      simpa [firstDiscreteCoordinate] using hcoord
  have hstep (a : Centre) (ha : a ≠ aRoot) :
      ∃ w : Centre × Tile × Tile,
        graph.Adj (toVertex w.1) (toVertex a) ∧
        graph.dist rootVertex (toVertex w.1) < graph.dist rootVertex (toVertex a) ∧
        firstDiscreteCoordinate ((w.2.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) + a) =
          firstDiscreteCoordinate ((w.2.2 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) + w.1) := by
    obtain ⟨b, hab, hdist⟩ := hcentrePred a ha
    obtain ⟨f, g, hcoord⟩ := hprojectionWitness a b hab
    exact ⟨(b, f, g), hab, hdist, hcoord⟩
  let step (a : Centre) (ha : a ≠ aRoot) : Centre × Tile × Tile :=
    Classical.choose (hstep a ha)
  have hstepSpec (a : Centre) (ha : a ≠ aRoot) :
      graph.Adj (toVertex (step a ha).1) (toVertex a) ∧
      graph.dist rootVertex (toVertex (step a ha).1) <
        graph.dist rootVertex (toVertex a) ∧
      firstDiscreteCoordinate
          (((step a ha).2.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) + a) =
        firstDiscreteCoordinate
          (((step a ha).2.2 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) + (step a ha).1) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (hstep a ha)
  let centreParent : Centre → Centre := fun a =>
    if ha : a = aRoot then aRoot else (step a ha).1
  let anchor : Centre → Tile := fun a =>
    if ha : a = aRoot then fRoot else (step a ha).2.1
  have hcentreParent_ne (a : Centre) (ha : a ≠ aRoot) :
      centreParent a = (step a ha).1 := by
    simp [centreParent, ha]
  have hanchor_ne (a : Centre) (ha : a ≠ aRoot) :
      anchor a = (step a ha).2.1 := by
    simp [anchor, ha]
  have hanchor_root : anchor aRoot = fRoot := by
    simp [anchor]
  let centreDepth : Centre → ℕ := fun a => graph.dist rootVertex (toVertex a)
  let height : X → ℕ := fun x =>
    2 * centreDepth x.2 + if x.1 = anchor x.2 then 0 else 1
  let parent : X → X := fun x =>
    if x.1 = anchor x.2 then (fRoot, centreParent x.2) else (anchor x.2, x.2)
  have hparentHeight (x : X) (hx : x ≠ root) : height (parent x) < height x := by
    by_cases hfa : x.1 = anchor x.2
    · have hac : x.2 ≠ aRoot := by
        intro hca
        have htile : x.1 = fRoot := by
          rw [hfa, hca, hanchor_root]
        apply hx
        exact Prod.ext htile hca
      have hdist := (hstepSpec x.2 hac).2.1
      rw [← hcentreParent_ne x.2 hac] at hdist
      simp only [parent, hfa, if_pos, height]
      change 2 * centreDepth (centreParent x.2) +
          (if fRoot = anchor (centreParent x.2) then 0 else 1) <
        2 * centreDepth x.2
      change graph.dist rootVertex (toVertex (centreParent x.2)) <
        graph.dist rootVertex (toVertex x.2) at hdist
      dsimp only [centreDepth]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    · simp only [parent, hfa, height]
      simp
  let R : X → X → Prop := fun x y =>
    ∃ g ∈ F,
      firstDiscreteCoordinate (repMap x : TranslationalTilings.Plane) =
        firstDiscreteCoordinate (g + (y.2 : TranslationalTilings.Plane))
  have hparentR (x : X) (hx : x ≠ root) : R x (parent x) := by
    by_cases hfa : x.1 = anchor x.2
    · have hac : x.2 ≠ aRoot := by
        intro hca
        have htile : x.1 = fRoot := by
          rw [hfa, hca, hanchor_root]
        apply hx
        exact Prod.ext htile hca
      have hspec := (hstepSpec x.2 hac).2.2
      rw [← hanchor_ne x.2 hac, ← hcentreParent_ne x.2 hac] at hspec
      refine ⟨(step x.2 hac).2.2, (step x.2 hac).2.2.2, ?_⟩
      change firstDiscreteCoordinate
          ((x.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) + (x.2 : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) =
        firstDiscreteCoordinate
          (((step x.2 hac).2.2 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) +
            ((parent x).2 : TranslationalTilings.Plane))
      rw [hfa]
      simpa [parent, hfa] using hspec
    · refine ⟨x.1, x.1.2, ?_⟩
      change firstDiscreteCoordinate
          ((x.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) + (x.2 : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) =
        firstDiscreteCoordinate
          ((x.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) +
            ((parent x).2 : TranslationalTilings.Plane))
      simp [parent, hfa]
  obtain ⟨enum, henumZero, henumParent⟩ :=
    exists_rootedEnumeration root parent height hparentHeight R hparentR
  let r : ℕ ≃ Carrier := enum.trans repEquiv
  let tilePoint : ℕ → TranslationalTilings.Plane := fun n => enum n |>.1
  let centre : ℕ → TranslationalTilings.Plane := fun n => enum n |>.2
  refine ⟨r, tilePoint, centre, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n
    exact (enum n).1.2
  · intro n
    exact (enum n).2.2
  · intro n
    rfl
  · have := congrArg (fun x : X => (x.2 : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) henumZero
    exact this
  · intro n hn
    obtain ⟨m, hmn, g, hg, hcoord⟩ := henumParent n hn
    exact ⟨m, hmn, g, hg, hcoord⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.setScalarPeriodic_of_dvd
statement:
private theorem setScalarPeriodic_of_dvd
    {d p q : ℕ} {S : Set (TranslationalTilings.Lattice d)}
    (hpq : p ∣ q) (hS : TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic p S) :
    TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic q S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hpq
  intro x z
  have h := hS x ((m : ℤ) • z)
  simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, mul_smul] using h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.directionalLayerCentres_periodic
statement:
private theorem directionalLayerCentres_periodic
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (D : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin D.numberOfParts))
    (j : Fin D.numberOfParts) :
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy
      (directionalLayerCentres D order j) (D.period (order j))
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  simp only [directionalLayerCentres, Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P, hxP⟩
    exact ⟨P, (D.periodic_part P (order j) x).mp hxP⟩
  · rintro ⟨P, hxP⟩
    exact ⟨P, (D.periodic_part P (order j) x).mpr hxP⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.carrier_periodic_of_centres
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, a, ha, hxa⟩
    refine ⟨f, hf, a - v, (hS (a - v)).mp ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using ha
    · calc
        x = (f + a) - v := by rw [← hxa]; abel
        _ = f + (a - v) := by abel
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, a, ha, hxa⟩
    refine ⟨f, hf, a + v, (hS a).mpr ha, ?_⟩
    rw [hxa]
    abel

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.orderedPlateLayerCarrier_eq_inter
statement:
private theorem orderedPlateLayerCarrier_eq_inter
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A E : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A E)
    (D : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin D.numberOfParts))
    (P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (j : Fin D.numberOfParts) :
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F (orderedPlateLayer D order P j) =
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F (directionalLayerCentres D order j) ∩
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨f, hf, a, ha, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨f, hf, a, ?_, rfl⟩, ⟨f, hf, a, ?_, rfl⟩⟩
    · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨P, ha⟩
    · rw [← D.iUnion_parts P]
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨order j, ha⟩
  · rintro x ⟨⟨f, hf, a, haGlobal, hxfa⟩, ⟨g, hg, b, hbP, hxgb⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨Q, haQ⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp haGlobal
    have haPlate : a ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations Q := by
      rw [← D.iUnion_parts Q]
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨order j, haQ⟩
    have hab : a = b := translation_eq_of_eq_representations hTile hf
      (Classical.choose haPlate) hg (Classical.choose hbP) (hxfa.symm.trans hxgb)
    have hQP : Q = P := by
      by_contra hne
      exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp
        (verticalPlateCentres_pairwiseDisjoint F A hne)) haPlate (hab ▸ hbP)
    subst Q
    exact ⟨f, hf, a, haQ, hxfa⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.discreteCarrier_translateSet
statement:
private theorem discreteCarrier_translateSet
    (F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane)
    (t : TranslationalTilings.Plane) (S : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane) :
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet t S) =
      TranslationalTilings.translateSet t
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F S)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, a, ha, rfl⟩
    change f + a - t ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F S
    exact ⟨f, hf, a - t, ha, by abel⟩
  · intro hx
    change x - t ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F S at hx
    obtain ⟨f, hf, a, ha, hxa⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨f, hf, a + t, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change a + t - t ∈ S
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using ha
    · calc
        x = (x - t) + t := by abel
        _ = (f + a) + t := by rw [hxa]
        _ = f + (a + t) := by abel

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.setScalarPeriodic_translateSet
statement:
private theorem setScalarPeriodic_translateSet
    {q : ℕ} {S : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (hS : TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic q S)
    (t : TranslationalTilings.Plane) :
    TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic q
      (TranslationalTilings.translateSet t S)
proof:
:= by
  intro x z
  change x + (q : ℤ) • z - t ∈ S ↔ x - t ∈ S
  convert hS (x - t) z using 1
  all_goals abel

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.plateCarriers_disjoint
statement:
private theorem plateCarriers_disjoint
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A E : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A E)
    {P Q : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit}
    (hPQ : P ≠ Q) :
    Disjoint
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P))
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations Q))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxP hxQ
  obtain ⟨f, hf, a, haP, hxfa⟩ := hxP
  obtain ⟨g, hg, b, hbQ, hxgb⟩ := hxQ
  have hab : a = b := translation_eq_of_eq_representations hTile hf
    (Classical.choose haP) hg (Classical.choose hbQ) (hxfa.symm.trans hxgb)
  exact hPQ ((Classical.choose_spec haP).symm.trans (hab ▸ Classical.choose_spec hbQ))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.discreteCarrier_eq_target_of_tiles
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, a, ha, rfl⟩
    by_contra hnot
    have hcount :=
      (TranslationalTilings.tilesAtLevel_iff_representation_count F A E 1).mp
        hTile (f + a)
    have hzero : (F.filter fun q ↦ f + a - q ∈ A).card = 0 := by
      simpa [hnot] using hcount
    have hmem : f ∈ F.filter fun q ↦ f + a - q ∈ A := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, hf, true_and]
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using ha
    rw [Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hzero] at hmem
    simp at hmem
  · intro hxE
    have hcount :=
      (TranslationalTilings.tilesAtLevel_iff_representation_count F A E 1).mp hTile x
    have hcard : (F.filter fun f ↦ x - f ∈ A).card = 1 := by
      simpa [hxE] using hcount
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < (F.filter fun f ↦ x - f ∈ A).card)
    have hdata := Finset.mem_filter.mp hf
    exact ⟨f, hdata.1, x - f, hdata.2, by abel⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.shiftedPlateLayer_subset_quakeShifted
statement:
private theorem shiftedPlateLayer_subset_quakeShifted
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (D : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin D.numberOfParts))
    (shift : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit → ℤ)
    (P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (j : Fin D.numberOfParts) :
    shiftedPlateLayer D order shift P j ⊆
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeShiftedTranslations shift
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxPlate : x ∈ TranslationalTilings.translateSet
      ((shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit)
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P) := by
    change x - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit ∈
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P
    rw [← D.iUnion_parts P]
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨order j, hx⟩
  change x - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit ∈
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P at hxPlate
  obtain ⟨haA, haComp⟩ := hxPlate
  let a : A := ⟨x - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit, haA⟩
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  change shift
      ((Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph F A verticalDiscreteUnit).connectedComponentMk a) •
        verticalDiscreteUnit + (a : TranslationalTilings.Plane) = x
  rw [show
    (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph F A verticalDiscreteUnit).connectedComponentMk a =
      P from haComp]
  dsimp only [a]
  abel

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.exists_commonDirectionalCarrierScalarPeriod
statement:
theorem exists_commonDirectionalCarrierScalarPeriod
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A E : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {ell : ℕ}
    (_hF : F.Nonempty) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (_hEVertical : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy
      E verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (hEPeriodic : TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic ell E)
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A E)
    (D : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin D.numberOfParts)) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ell ∣ N ∧ ∀ j,
      TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic N
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (directionalLayerCentres D order j))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G : TranslationalTilings.DirectionalTilingDecomposition F A E ell := {
    numberOfParts := D.numberOfParts
    number_pos := D.number_pos
    part := directionalLayerCentres D order
    direction := fun j ↦ D.period (order j)
    direction_ne_zero := fun j ↦ D.period_ne_zero (order j)
    pairwise_incommensurable := by
      intro i j hij
      exact D.pairwise_incommensurable (order i) (order j) (order.injective.ne hij)
    periodic_part := by
      intro j x
      apply (indicator_eq_iff_membership (directionalLayerCentres D order j) _ _).2
      have hp := (directionalLayerCentres_periodic D order j).zsmul (ell : ℤ)
      convert hp x using 1
    pairwiseDisjoint := by
      intro i _ j _ hij
      change Disjoint (directionalLayerCentres D order i)
        (directionalLayerCentres D order j)
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hxi hxj
      obtain ⟨P, hxPi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxi
      obtain ⟨Q, hxQj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxj
      by_cases hPQ : P = Q
      · subst Q
        exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp
          (D.pairwiseDisjoint P (Set.mem_univ (order i))
            (Set.mem_univ (order j)) (order.injective.ne hij))) hxPi hxQj
      · have hxP : x ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P := by
          rw [← D.iUnion_parts P]
          exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨order i, hxPi⟩
        have hxQ : x ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations Q := by
          rw [← D.iUnion_parts Q]
          exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨order j, hxQj⟩
        exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp
          (verticalPlateCentres_pairwiseDisjoint F A hPQ)) hxP hxQ
    union_parts := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · intro x hx
        obtain ⟨j, P, hxPj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hx
        rw [← iUnion_verticalPlateCentres F A]
        apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
        refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
        rw [← D.iUnion_parts P]
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨order j, hxPj⟩
      · intro x hx
        rw [← iUnion_verticalPlateCentres F A] at hx
        obtain ⟨P, hxP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
        rw [← D.iUnion_parts P] at hxP
        obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxP
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨order.symm i,
          Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨P, by
            change x ∈ D.part P (order (order.symm i))
            simpa only [order.apply_symm_apply] using hxi⟩⟩
    target_periodic := hEPeriodic
    tiles := hTile
  }
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hperiod⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.gtCommonDirectionalCarrierPeriod G hell
  refine ⟨ell * N, Nat.mul_pos hell hN, ⟨N, rfl⟩, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  apply setScalarPeriodic_of_dvd (hS := hperiod j)
  exact ⟨ell, (Nat.mul_comm N ell).symm⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.exists_commonNonverticalPlateLayerScalarPeriod
statement:
theorem exists_commonNonverticalPlateLayerScalarPeriod
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A E : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {ell N k : ℕ}
    (hF : F.Nonempty) (_hell : 0 < ell)
    (hEVertical : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy
      E verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (_hEPeriodic : TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic ell E)
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A E)
    (D : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin D.numberOfParts))
    (hk : 0 < k)
    (hfirst : D.period (order ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩) =
      (k : ℤ) • verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hellN : ell ∣ N)
    (hGlobal : ∀ j, TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic N
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
        (directionalLayerCentres D order j))) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, 0 < M ∧ N ∣ M ∧ ell ∣ M ∧ k ∣ M ∧
      (∀ (P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate
          F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
        (j : Fin D.numberOfParts),
        j ≠ ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩ →
          TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic M
            (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
              (orderedPlateLayer D order P j))) ∧
      TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic M
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (directionalLayerCentres D order ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let first : Fin D.numberOfParts := ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩
  let J := {j : Fin D.numberOfParts // j ≠ first}
  let width : J → ℕ := fun j ↦ Int.natAbs (D.period (order j.1) 0)
  have hcoord (j : Fin D.numberOfParts) (hj : j ≠ first) :
      D.period (order j) 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hj0
    have hj1 : D.period (order j) 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hj1
      apply D.period_ne_zero (order j)
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> assumption
    have hcomm : TranslationalTilings.Commensurable
        (D.period (order first)) (D.period (order j)) := by
      refine ⟨D.period (order j) 1, (k : ℤ), hj1,
        by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hk), ?_⟩
      rw [hfirst]
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      · change D.period (order j) 1 * (k * 0) = k * D.period (order j) 0
        rw [hj0]
        ring
      · change D.period (order j) 1 * (k * 1) = k * D.period (order j) 1
        ring
    exact (D.pairwise_incommensurable (order first) (order j)
      (order.injective.ne hj.symm)) hcomm
  have hwidth (j : J) : 0 < width j := by
    exact Int.natAbs_pos.mpr (hcoord j.1 j.2)
  let Q : ℕ := ∏ j : J, width j
  have hQ : 0 < Q := by
    dsimp only [Q]
    exact Finset.prod_pos fun j _ ↦ hwidth j
  let M := N * k * Q
  refine ⟨M, Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos hN hk) hQ, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨k * Q, by simp [M, Nat.mul_assoc]⟩
  · exact dvd_trans hellN ⟨k * Q, by simp [M, Nat.mul_assoc]⟩
  · exact ⟨N * Q, by simp [M, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]⟩
  · intro P j hj
    let v := D.period (order j)
    let S := Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F (orderedPlateLayer D order P j)
    have hRank : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy S v :=
      carrier_periodic_of_centres (D.periodic_part P (order j))
    have hInter := orderedPlateLayerCarrier_eq_inter hTile D order P j
    have hVerticalN : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy S
        ((N : ℤ) • verticalDiscreteUnit) := by
      dsimp only [S]
      rw [hInter]
      intro z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hzG, hzP⟩
        exact ⟨(hGlobal j z verticalDiscreteUnit).mp hzG,
          ((verticalPlateCarrier_periodic hF hTile hEVertical P).zsmul (N : ℤ) z).mp hzP⟩
      · rintro ⟨hzG, hzP⟩
        exact ⟨(hGlobal j z verticalDiscreteUnit).mpr hzG,
          ((verticalPlateCarrier_periodic hF hTile hEVertical P).zsmul (N : ℤ) z).mpr hzP⟩
    have hHorizontal : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy S
        (((N * Int.natAbs (v 0) : ℕ) : ℤ) • horizontalDiscreteUnit) := by
      let r : ℤ := (N : ℤ) * Int.sign (v 0)
      let s : ℤ := -(Int.sign (v 0) * v 1)
      have hrank := hRank.zsmul r
      have hvert := hVerticalN.zsmul s
      intro z
      have hcombined := (hvert (z + r • v)).trans (hrank z)
      have hpoint :
          z + (((N * Int.natAbs (v 0) : ℕ) : ℤ) • horizontalDiscreteUnit) =
            (z + r • v) + s • ((N : ℤ) • verticalDiscreteUnit) := by
        funext i
        fin_cases i
        · change z 0 + (N * Int.natAbs (v 0) : ℕ) * 1 =
          (z 0 + r * v 0) + s * (N * 0)
          dsimp only [r, s]
          push_cast
          rw [← Int.sign_mul_self_eq_abs]
          ring
        · change z 1 + (N * Int.natAbs (v 0) : ℕ) * 0 =
            (z 1 + r * v 1) + s * (N * 1)
          dsimp only [r, s]
          push_cast
          ring
      rw [hpoint]
      exact hcombined
    have hScalar : TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic
        (N * Int.natAbs (v 0)) S := by
      intro z w
      have hh := hHorizontal.zsmul (w 0)
      have hv := hVerticalN.zsmul ((Int.natAbs (v 0) : ℤ) * w 1)
      have hcombined := (hv
        (z + (w 0) • (((N * Int.natAbs (v 0) : ℕ) : ℤ) •
          horizontalDiscreteUnit))).trans (hh z)
      have hpoint : z + (((N * Int.natAbs (v 0) : ℕ) : ℤ) • w) =
          (z + (w 0) • (((N * Int.natAbs (v 0) : ℕ) : ℤ) •
            horizontalDiscreteUnit)) +
            ((Int.natAbs (v 0) : ℤ) * w 1) •
              ((N : ℤ) • verticalDiscreteUnit) := by
        ext i
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply]
        fin_cases i
        · simp [horizontalDiscreteUnit, verticalDiscreteUnit]
          ring
        · simp [horizontalDiscreteUnit, verticalDiscreteUnit]
          ring
      rw [hpoint]
      exact hcombined
    apply setScalarPeriodic_of_dvd (hS := hScalar)
    let jj : J := ⟨j, hj⟩
    have hwidthQ : width jj ∣ Q := by
      exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem width (Finset.mem_univ jj)
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hwidthQ
    refine ⟨k * t, ?_⟩
    dsimp only [M] at ⊢
    have hw : Int.natAbs (v 0) = width jj := rfl
    rw [hw, ht]
    ring
  · apply setScalarPeriodic_of_dvd
      (hS := hGlobal first)
    exact ⟨k * Q, by simp [M, Nat.mul_assoc]⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.quakeShift_preservesDirectionalDecomposition
statement:
theorem quakeShift_preservesDirectionalDecomposition
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (D : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin D.numberOfParts))
    (shift : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit → ℤ)
    (P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit) :
    Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ (shiftedPlateLayer D order shift P) ∧
      (⋃ j, shiftedPlateLayer D order shift P j) =
        TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit)
          (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P) ∧
      ∀ j, Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy
        (shiftedPlateLayer D order shift P j) (D.period (order j))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i _ j _ hij
    change Disjoint (shiftedPlateLayer D order shift P i)
      (shiftedPlateLayer D order shift P j)
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxi hxj
    have hbasei : x - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit ∈
        D.part P (order i) := hxi
    have hbasej : x - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit ∈
        D.part P (order j) := hxj
    exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (D.pairwiseDisjoint P (Set.mem_univ (order i))
        (Set.mem_univ (order j)) (order.injective.ne hij))) hbasei hbasej
  · ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      change x - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit ∈
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P
      rw [← D.iUnion_parts P]
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨order j, hxj⟩
    · intro hx
      change x - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit ∈
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P at hx
      rw [← D.iUnion_parts P] at hx
      obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨order.symm i, ?_⟩
      change x - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit ∈
        D.part P (order (order.symm i))
      simpa only [order.apply_symm_apply] using hxi
  · intro j x
    change
      x + D.period (order j) - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit ∈
          D.part P (order j) ↔
        x - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit ∈ D.part P (order j)
    convert D.periodic_part P (order j)
      (x - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit) using 1
    all_goals abel

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.quakeShift_directionalCarriers_scalarPeriodic
statement:
theorem quakeShift_directionalCarriers_scalarPeriodic
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A E : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {ell k M : ℕ}
    (hF : F.Nonempty) (_hell : 0 < ell)
    (hEVertical : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy
      E verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (hEPeriodic : TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic ell E)
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A E)
    (D : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.UniformQuakePeriodicDecomposition
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (order : Equiv.Perm (Fin D.numberOfParts))
    (_hk : 0 < k)
    (_hfirst : D.period (order ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩) =
      (k : ℤ) • verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (_hM : 0 < M) (hellM : ell ∣ M) (_hkM : k ∣ M)
    (hPlate : ∀ (P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate
        F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
      (j : Fin D.numberOfParts),
      j ≠ ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩ →
        TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic M
          (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
            (orderedPlateLayer D order P j)))
    (shift : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit → ℤ) :
    (∀ (P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate
        F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
      (j : Fin D.numberOfParts),
      j ≠ ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩ →
        TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic M
          (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
            (shiftedPlateLayer D order shift P j))) ∧
      TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic M
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (shiftedDirectionalLayerCentres D order shift
            ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let first : Fin D.numberOfParts := ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩
  let J := {j : Fin D.numberOfParts // j ≠ first}
  let B := Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeShiftedTranslations shift
  let C := shiftedDirectionalLayerCentres D order shift first
  let R : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane :=
    ⋃ P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit,
      ⋃ j : J, shiftedPlateLayer D order shift P j.1
  have hNonfirst (P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate
      F A verticalDiscreteUnit) (j : Fin D.numberOfParts) (hj : j ≠ first) :
      TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic M
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (shiftedPlateLayer D order shift P j)) := by
    change TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic M
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet ((shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit)
          (orderedPlateLayer D order P j)))
    rw [discreteCarrier_translateSet]
    exact setScalarPeriodic_translateSet (hPlate P j hj)
      ((shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit)
  have hCsubset : C ⊆ B := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨P, hxP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact shiftedPlateLayer_subset_quakeShifted D order shift P first hxP
  have hRsubset : R ⊆ B := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨P, j, hxPj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hx
    exact shiftedPlateLayer_subset_quakeShifted D order shift P j.1 hxPj
  have hCover : C ∪ R = B := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro x hx
      rcases hx with hxC | hxR
      · exact hCsubset hxC
      · exact hRsubset hxR
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨a, hxa⟩ := hx
      let P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit :=
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph F A verticalDiscreteUnit).connectedComponentMk a
      have hxPlate : x ∈ TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit)
          (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P) := by
        change x - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit ∈
          Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P
        have haP := Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_quakePlateTranslations_mk
          (F := F) (v := verticalDiscreteUnit) a
        rw [← hxa]
        dsimp only [P]
        simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using haP
      rw [← (quakeShift_preservesDirectionalDecomposition D order shift P).2.1] at hxPlate
      obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxPlate
      by_cases hj : j = first
      · left
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨P, hj ▸ hxj⟩
      · right
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨P,
          Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, hxj⟩⟩
  have hDisjoint : Disjoint C R := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxC hxR
    obtain ⟨P, hxP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxC
    obtain ⟨Q, j, hxQ⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hxR
    obtain ⟨f, hfF⟩ := hF
    have hxCarrierP : f + x ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P) := by
      have hbase : f + (x - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit) ∈
          Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
            (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P) := by
        refine ⟨f, hfF, x - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit, ?_, rfl⟩
        rw [← D.iUnion_parts P]
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨order first, hxP⟩
      have hp := ((verticalPlateCarrier_periodic ⟨f, hfF⟩ hTile hEVertical P).zsmul
        (shift P) (f + (x - (shift P) • verticalDiscreteUnit))).2 hbase
      convert hp using 1
      all_goals abel
    have hxCarrierQ : f + x ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations Q) := by
      have hbase : f + (x - (shift Q) • verticalDiscreteUnit) ∈
          Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
            (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations Q) := by
        refine ⟨f, hfF, x - (shift Q) • verticalDiscreteUnit, ?_, rfl⟩
        rw [← D.iUnion_parts Q]
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨order j.1, hxQ⟩
      have hp := ((verticalPlateCarrier_periodic ⟨f, hfF⟩ hTile hEVertical Q).zsmul
        (shift Q) (f + (x - (shift Q) • verticalDiscreteUnit))).2 hbase
      convert hp using 1
      all_goals abel
    have hPQ : P = Q := by
      by_contra hne
      exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (plateCarriers_disjoint hTile hne))
        hxCarrierP hxCarrierQ
    subst Q
    exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (D.pairwiseDisjoint P (Set.mem_univ (order first))
        (Set.mem_univ (order j.1)) (order.injective.ne j.2.symm))) hxP hxQ
  have hCeq : C = B \ R := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro x hx
      exact ⟨hCsubset hx, fun hxR ↦ (Set.disjoint_left.mp hDisjoint) hx hxR⟩
    · rintro x ⟨hxB, hxR⟩
      have hx := hCover.symm ▸ hxB
      rcases hx with hxC | hxR'
      · exact hxC
      · exact False.elim (hxR hxR')
  have hRperiod : TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic M
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F R) := by
    dsimp only [R]
    rw [discreteCarrier_iUnion]
    simp_rw [discreteCarrier_iUnion]
    intro x z
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨P, j, hx⟩
      exact ⟨P, j, (hNonfirst P j.1 j.2 x z).mp hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨P, j, hx⟩
      exact ⟨P, j, (hNonfirst P j.1 j.2 x z).mpr hx⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro P j hj
    exact hNonfirst P j hj
  · have hShiftTile := tilesOn_quakeShiftedTranslations hF hTile hEVertical shift
    have hcarrierB : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F B = E :=
      discreteCarrier_eq_target_of_tiles hShiftTile
    rw [show shiftedDirectionalLayerCentres D order shift ⟨0, D.number_pos⟩ = C from rfl,
      hCeq,
      discreteCarrier_sdiff hShiftTile (Set.Subset.rfl : B ⊆ B) hRsubset,
      hcarrierB]
    have hEperiodM := setScalarPeriodic_of_dvd hellM hEPeriodic
    intro x z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxE, hxR⟩
      refine ⟨(hEperiodM x z).mp hxE, ?_⟩
      intro hx
      exact hxR ((hRperiod x z).mpr hx)
    · rintro ⟨hxE, hxR⟩
      refine ⟨(hEperiodM x z).mpr hxE, ?_⟩
      intro hx
      exact hxR ((hRperiod x z).mp hx)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.bandCopyVertexEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem bandCopyVertexEquiv_apply
    {B : Set ℤ} {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {R : ℕ}
    (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A (verticalDiscreteCylinder B))
    (hCopies : ∀ p : ℤ × ℤ, p.1 ≠ p.2 →
      Disjoint
        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((p.1 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder B))
        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((p.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder B)))
    (x : A × ℤ) :
    ((bandCopyVertexEquiv hF hTile hCopies x :
      ↑(periodizedBandCentres A R)) : TranslationalTilings.Plane) =
      (x.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit +
        (x.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.bandCopyQuakeTransfer_iff
statement:
private theorem bandCopyQuakeTransfer_iff
    {B : Set ℤ} {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {R : ℕ}
    (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A (verticalDiscreteCylinder B))
    (hCopies : ∀ p : ℤ × ℤ, p.1 ≠ p.2 →
      Disjoint
        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((p.1 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder B))
        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((p.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder B)))
    (x y : A × ℤ) :
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeTransfer F (periodizedBandCentres A R)
        verticalDiscreteUnit
        (bandCopyVertexEquiv hF hTile hCopies x)
        (bandCopyVertexEquiv hF hTile hCopies y) ↔
      x.2 = y.2 ∧
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeTransfer F A verticalDiscreteUnit x.1 y.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, g, hg, heq⟩
    have hfa := add_mem_target_of_tiles hTile hf x.1.2
    have hfb := add_mem_target_of_tiles hTile hg y.1.2
    have hfav := (verticalDiscreteCylinder_periodic B (f + x.1)).2 hfa
    have hxCopy :
        f + (bandCopyVertexEquiv hF hTile hCopies x :
          TranslationalTilings.Plane) + verticalDiscreteUnit ∈
          TranslationalTilings.translateSet
            ((x.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
            (verticalDiscreteCylinder B) := by
      rw [bandCopyVertexEquiv_apply]
      change f + ((x.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit +
          (x.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) + verticalDiscreteUnit -
          (x.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈
        verticalDiscreteCylinder B
      convert hfav using 1
      all_goals abel
    have hyCopy :
        f + (bandCopyVertexEquiv hF hTile hCopies x :
          TranslationalTilings.Plane) + verticalDiscreteUnit ∈
          TranslationalTilings.translateSet
            ((y.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
            (verticalDiscreteCylinder B) := by
      rw [heq, bandCopyVertexEquiv_apply]
      change g + ((y.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit +
          (y.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) -
          (y.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈
        verticalDiscreteCylinder B
      convert hfb using 1
      all_goals abel
    have hxy : x.2 = y.2 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hCopies (x.2, y.2) hne)) hxCopy hyCopy
    refine ⟨hxy, f, hf, g, hg, ?_⟩
    rw [bandCopyVertexEquiv_apply, bandCopyVertexEquiv_apply] at heq
    rw [hxy] at heq
    let shift := (y.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit
    apply add_left_cancel (a := shift)
    calc
      shift + (f + (x.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) + verticalDiscreteUnit) =
          f + (shift + (x.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) + verticalDiscreteUnit := by
            abel
      _ = g + (shift + (y.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) := heq
      _ = shift + (g + (y.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) := by abel
  · rintro ⟨hxy, f, hf, g, hg, heq⟩
    refine ⟨f, hf, g, hg, ?_⟩
    rw [bandCopyVertexEquiv_apply, bandCopyVertexEquiv_apply, hxy]
    calc
      f + ((y.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit +
          (x.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) + verticalDiscreteUnit =
        (y.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit +
          (f + (x.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) + verticalDiscreteUnit) := by abel
      _ = (y.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit +
          (g + (y.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) := congrArg _ heq
      _ = g + ((y.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit +
          (y.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) := by abel

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.periodizedBandPlateEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem periodizedBandPlateEquiv_mk
    {B : Set ℤ} {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {R : ℕ}
    (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A (verticalDiscreteCylinder B))
    (hCopies : ∀ p : ℤ × ℤ, p.1 ≠ p.2 →
      Disjoint
        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((p.1 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder B))
        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((p.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder B)))
    (a : A) (d : ℤ) :
    periodizedBandPlateEquiv hF hTile hCopies
        ((Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph F A verticalDiscreteUnit).connectedComponentMk a,
          d) =
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph F (periodizedBandCentres A R)
        verticalDiscreteUnit).connectedComponentMk
          (bandCopyVertexEquiv hF hTile hCopies (a, d))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.periodizedBandPlateEquiv_translations
statement:
private theorem periodizedBandPlateEquiv_translations
    {B : Set ℤ} {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {R : ℕ}
    (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A (verticalDiscreteCylinder B))
    (hCopies : ∀ p : ℤ × ℤ, p.1 ≠ p.2 →
      Disjoint
        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((p.1 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder B))
        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((p.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder B)))
    (P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
    (d : ℤ) :
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations
        (periodizedBandPlateEquiv hF hTile hCopies (P, d)) =
      TranslationalTilings.translateSet
        ((d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hzUnion, hzComponent⟩
    let q : ↑(periodizedBandCentres A R) := ⟨z, hzUnion⟩
    let x : A × ℤ := (bandCopyVertexEquiv hF hTile hCopies).symm q
    have hxVertex : bandCopyVertexEquiv hF hTile hCopies x = q :=
      (bandCopyVertexEquiv hF hTile hCopies).apply_symm_apply q
    have hxComponent :
        periodizedBandPlateEquiv hF hTile hCopies
            ((Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph F A verticalDiscreteUnit
              ).connectedComponentMk x.1, x.2) =
          periodizedBandPlateEquiv hF hTile hCopies (P, d) := by
      rw [periodizedBandPlateEquiv_mk]
      rw [hxVertex]
      exact hzComponent
    have hxPair := (periodizedBandPlateEquiv hF hTile hCopies).injective hxComponent
    have hxPlate :
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph F A verticalDiscreteUnit
          ).connectedComponentMk x.1 = P :=
      congrArg Prod.fst hxPair
    have hxIndex : x.2 = d := congrArg Prod.snd hxPair
    change z - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P
    have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hxVertex
    rw [bandCopyVertexEquiv_apply] at hval
    dsimp only [q] at hval
    rw [hxIndex] at hval
    have hxPoint : z - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit =
        (x.1 : TranslationalTilings.Plane) := by
      rw [← hval]
      abel
    have hzA : z - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈ A := by
      rw [hxPoint]
      exact x.1.2
    refine ⟨hzA, ?_⟩
    have hsubtype :
        (⟨z - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit, hzA⟩ : A) = x.1 :=
      Subtype.ext hxPoint
    rw [hsubtype]
    exact hxPlate
  · intro hz
    change z - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P at hz
    let a : A :=
      ⟨z - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit,
        Classical.choose hz⟩
    have haComponent :
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakeGraph F A verticalDiscreteUnit
          ).connectedComponentMk a = P := by
      exact Classical.choose_spec hz
    have hzUnion : z ∈ periodizedBandCentres A R := by
      apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
      exact Classical.choose hz
    refine ⟨hzUnion, ?_⟩
    rw [← haComponent, periodizedBandPlateEquiv_mk]
    apply congrArg
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [bandCopyVertexEquiv_apply]
    dsimp only [a]
    abel

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.periodizeFiniteBand_tiles_general
statement:
theorem periodizeFiniteBand_tiles_general
    {B : Finset ℤ} {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {R : ℕ}
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A
      (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)))
    (_hR : 0 < R)
    (hCopies : ∀ p : ℤ × ℤ, p.1 ≠ p.2 →
      Disjoint
        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((p.1 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)))
        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((p.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)))) :
    TranslationalTilings.Tiles F
        (⋃ d : ℤ, TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit) A)
        (⋃ d : ℤ, TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ))) ∧
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy
        (⋃ d : ℤ, TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)))
        verticalDiscreteUnit ∧
      TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic R
        (⋃ d : ℤ, TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let centreUnion : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane :=
    ⋃ d : ℤ, TranslationalTilings.translateSet
      ((d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit) A
  let targetUnion : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane :=
    ⋃ d : ℤ, TranslationalTilings.translateSet
      ((d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
      (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ))
  have hperiodized : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F centreUnion targetUnion := by
    apply tiles_of_existsUnique_on_target
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨d, hxd⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      have hxBase : x - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈
          verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ) := hxd
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfunique⟩ := existsUnique_representation_of_mem hTile hxBase
      refine ⟨f, ⟨hf.1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
        refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
        change x - f - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈ A
        convert hf.2 using 1
        all_goals abel
      · intro g hg
        obtain ⟨e, hge⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hg.2
        have hxBaseE : x - (e * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈
            verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ) := by
          have hsum := add_mem_target_of_tiles hTile hg.1 hge
          convert hsum using 1
          all_goals abel
        have hxCopyE : x ∈ TranslationalTilings.translateSet
            ((e * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
            (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)) := hxBaseE
        have hed : e = d := by
          by_contra hne
          exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hCopies (e, d) hne)) hxCopyE hxd
        subst e
        apply hfunique g
        refine ⟨hg.1, ?_⟩
        change x - g - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈ A at hge
        change x - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit - g ∈ A
        convert hge using 1
        all_goals abel
    · intro x hx f hf hxf
      obtain ⟨d, hxfd⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxf
      apply hx
      apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
      change x - f - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈ A at hxfd
      have hsum := add_mem_target_of_tiles hTile hf hxfd
      change x - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈
        verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)
      convert hsum using 1
      all_goals abel
  refine ⟨hperiodized, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨d, hzd⟩
      refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
      apply (mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff _ _).mpr
      have hcoord := (mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff
        (z + verticalDiscreteUnit - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
        (B : Set ℤ)).mp hzd
      simpa [firstDiscreteCoordinate, horizontalDiscreteUnit, verticalDiscreteUnit,
        Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail] using hcoord
    · rintro ⟨d, hzd⟩
      refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
      apply (mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff _ _).mpr
      have hcoord := (mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff
        (z - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
        (B : Set ℤ)).mp hzd
      simpa [firstDiscreteCoordinate, horizontalDiscreteUnit, verticalDiscreteUnit,
        Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail] using hcoord
  · intro z w
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨d, hzd⟩
      refine ⟨d - w 0, ?_⟩
      apply (mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff _ _).mpr
      have hcoord := (mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff
        (z + (R : ℤ) • w - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
        (B : Set ℤ)).mp hzd
      have hcoord' : z 0 + (R : ℤ) * w 0 - d * (R : ℤ) ∈ (B : Set ℤ) := by
        simpa [firstDiscreteCoordinate, horizontalDiscreteUnit, Matrix.vecHead,
          Matrix.vecTail] using hcoord
      have heq : z 0 - (d - w 0) * (R : ℤ) =
          z 0 + (R : ℤ) * w 0 - d * (R : ℤ) := by ring
      simpa [firstDiscreteCoordinate, horizontalDiscreteUnit, Matrix.vecHead,
        Matrix.vecTail, heq] using hcoord'
    · rintro ⟨d, hzd⟩
      refine ⟨d + w 0, ?_⟩
      apply (mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff _ _).mpr
      have hcoord := (mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff
        (z - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
        (B : Set ℤ)).mp hzd
      have hcoord' : z 0 - d * (R : ℤ) ∈ (B : Set ℤ) := by
        simpa [firstDiscreteCoordinate, horizontalDiscreteUnit, Matrix.vecHead,
          Matrix.vecTail] using hcoord
      have heq : z 0 + (R : ℤ) * w 0 - (d + w 0) * (R : ℤ) =
          z 0 - d * (R : ℤ) := by ring
      simpa [firstDiscreteCoordinate, horizontalDiscreteUnit, Matrix.vecHead,
        Matrix.vecTail, heq] using hcoord'

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.periodizeFiniteBand_tiles
statement:
theorem periodizeFiniteBand_tiles
    {B : Finset ℤ} {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {R : ℕ}
    (_hF : F.Nonempty)
    (_hFB : (F : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane) ⊆
      verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ))
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A
      (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)))
    (hR : 0 < R)
    (hCopies : ∀ p : ℤ × ℤ, p.1 ≠ p.2 →
      Disjoint
        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((p.1 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)))
        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((p.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)))) :
    TranslationalTilings.Tiles F
        (⋃ d : ℤ, TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit) A)
        (⋃ d : ℤ, TranslationalTilings.translateSet

        (⋃ d : ℤ, TranslationalTilings.translateSet

proof:

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.periodizeFiniteBand_verticalPlates_general
statement:
theorem periodizeFiniteBand_verticalPlates_general
    {B : Finset ℤ} {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {R : ℕ}
    (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A
      (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)))
    (hR : 0 < R)
    (hCopies : ∀ p : ℤ × ℤ, p.1 ≠ p.2 →
      Disjoint
        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((p.1 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)))
        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((p.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)))) :
    ∃ plateEquiv :
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit × ℤ) ≃
          Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F
            (⋃ d : ℤ, TranslationalTilings.translateSet
              ((d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit) A)
            verticalDiscreteUnit,
      ∀ (P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit)
          (d : ℤ),
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations
            (plateEquiv (P, d)) =
          TranslationalTilings.translateSet
            ((d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
            (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P) ∧
          (IsDiscreteVerticalColumn (plateEquiv (P, d)) ↔
            IsDiscreteVerticalColumn P)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have _hPeriodized := periodizeFiniteBand_tiles_general hTile hR hCopies
  let plateEquiv :
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit × ℤ) ≃
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F
          (⋃ d : ℤ, TranslationalTilings.translateSet
            ((d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit) A)
          verticalDiscreteUnit :=
    periodizedBandPlateEquiv hF hTile hCopies
  refine ⟨plateEquiv, ?_⟩
  intro P d
  have hTranslations :
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations (plateEquiv (P, d)) =
        TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          ((d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
          (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P) := by
    dsimp only [plateEquiv]
    exact periodizedBandPlateEquiv_translations hF hTile hCopies P d
  refine ⟨hTranslations, ?_⟩
  have hImage :
      firstDiscreteCoordinate ''
          Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations (plateEquiv (P, d)) =
        (fun c : ℤ ↦ d * (R : ℤ) + c) ''
          (firstDiscreteCoordinate ''
            Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P) := by
    ext c
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      rw [hTranslations] at hz
      refine ⟨firstDiscreteCoordinate
          (z - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit), ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨z - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit, hz, rfl⟩
      · simp [firstDiscreteCoordinate, horizontalDiscreteUnit]
    · rintro ⟨c, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit + z, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hTranslations]
        change (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit + z -
            (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈
          Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P
        simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using hz
      · simp [firstDiscreteCoordinate, horizontalDiscreteUnit]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨c - d * (R : ℤ), ?_⟩
    ext u
    constructor
    · intro hu
      have huk : d * (R : ℤ) + u ∈
          firstDiscreteCoordinate ''
            Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations (plateEquiv (P, d)) := by
        rw [hImage]
        exact ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      rw [hc] at huk
      have : d * (R : ℤ) + u = c := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp huk
      exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr (by omega)
    · intro hu
      have hcImage : c ∈
          firstDiscreteCoordinate ''
            Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations (plateEquiv (P, d)) := by
        rw [hc]
        exact Set.mem_singleton c
      rw [hImage] at hcImage
      obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := hcImage
      have huEq : u = d * (R : ℤ) + v - d * (R : ℤ) :=
        Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hu
      have huv : u = v := by omega
      rwa [huv]
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨d * (R : ℤ) + c, ?_⟩
    rw [hImage, hc]
    ext u
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, rfl, rfl⟩
      rfl
    · intro hu
      exact ⟨c, rfl, hu.symm⟩

theorem periodizeFiniteBand_verticalPlates
    {B : Finset ℤ} {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}

        (TranslationalTilings.translateSet

    ∃ plateEquiv :

        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations
