name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.exists_bandSpacing
statement:
theorem exists_bandSpacing
    (B : Finset ℤ) (hB : B.Nonempty) :
      ∃ R : ℕ, 0 < R ∧
        ∀ p : ℤ × ℤ, p.1 ≠ p.2 →
          Disjoint
            (TranslationalTilings.translateSet
              ((p.1 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
              (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)))
            (TranslationalTilings.translateSet
              ((p.2 * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
              (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R : ℕ := Int.natAbs (B.max' hB - B.min' hB) + 1
  refine ⟨R, by omega, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨d, e⟩ hde
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro z hzd hze
  have hdB := (mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff
    (z - (d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit) (B : Set ℤ)).mp hzd
  have heB := (mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff
    (z - (e * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit) (B : Set ℤ)).mp hze
  have hcoordd : firstDiscreteCoordinate z - d * (R : ℤ) ∈ (B : Set ℤ) := by
    simpa [firstDiscreteCoordinate, horizontalDiscreteUnit, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail]
      using hdB
  have hcoorde : firstDiscreteCoordinate z - e * (R : ℤ) ∈ (B : Set ℤ) := by
    simpa [firstDiscreteCoordinate, horizontalDiscreteUnit, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail]
      using heB
  have hdmin := B.min'_le _ hcoordd
  have hdmax := B.le_max' _ hcoordd
  have hemin := B.min'_le _ hcoorde
  have hemax := B.le_max' _ hcoorde
  have hR : (R : ℤ) = B.max' hB - B.min' hB + 1 := by
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ B.max' hB - B.min' hB :=
      sub_nonneg.mpr (B.min'_le (B.max' hB) (B.max'_mem hB))
    simp [R, Int.natAbs_of_nonneg hnonneg]
  have hgap : |d - e| * (R : ℤ) ≤ B.max' hB - B.min' hB := by
    have hdiff : (d - e) * (R : ℤ) =
        (firstDiscreteCoordinate z - e * (R : ℤ)) -
          (firstDiscreteCoordinate z - d * (R : ℤ)) := by ring
    have habs : |(firstDiscreteCoordinate z - e * (R : ℤ)) -
          (firstDiscreteCoordinate z - d * (R : ℤ))| ≤
        B.max' hB - B.min' hB := by
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> omega
    calc
      |d - e| * (R : ℤ) = |(d - e) * (R : ℤ)| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg R)]
      _ = |(firstDiscreteCoordinate z - e * (R : ℤ)) -
          (firstDiscreteCoordinate z - d * (R : ℤ))| := by rw [hdiff]
      _ ≤ _ := habs
  have hdeabs : 1 ≤ |d - e| := by
    apply Int.one_le_abs
    omega
  have habsnonneg : 0 ≤ |d - e| := abs_nonneg _
  have hRnonneg : 0 ≤ (R : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg R
  nlinarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.discreteCarrier_subset_target
statement:
theorem discreteCarrier_subset_target
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane} {A E : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A E) :
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F A ⊆ E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rintro x ⟨f, hf, a, ha, rfl⟩
  by_contra hnot
  have hc := (TranslationalTilings.tilesAtLevel_iff_representation_count F A E 1).mp
    hTile (f + a)
  have hz : (F.filter fun g => f + a - g ∈ A).card = 0 := by
    simpa [hnot] using hc
  have hm : f ∈ F.filter fun g => f + a - g ∈ A := by
    simp [hf, ha]
  rw [Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hz] at hm
  simp at hm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.centre_eq_of_eq_representations
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have htarget := discreteCarrier_subset_target hTile ⟨f, hf, a, ha, rfl⟩
  have hc := (TranslationalTilings.tilesAtLevel_iff_representation_count F A E 1).mp
    hTile (f + a)
  have hcard : (F.filter fun q => f + a - q ∈ A).card = 1 := by
    simpa [htarget] using hc
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard
  have hfm : f ∈ F.filter fun q => f + a - q ∈ A := by simp [hf, ha]
  have hgm : g ∈ F.filter fun q => f + a - q ∈ A := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, hg, true_and]
    rw [heq]
    simpa using hb
  rw [hq] at hfm hgm
  have hfq : f = q := by simpa using hfm
  have hgq : g = q := by simpa using hgm
  have hfg : f = g := hfq.trans hgq.symm
  rw [hfg] at heq
  exact add_left_cancel heq

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.finiteBand_allVerticalColumns_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem finiteBand_allVerticalColumns_of_nonempty
    {B : Finset ℤ} {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A
      (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ))) :
    (∀ P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit,
      IsDiscreteVerticalColumn P) ∧ A = discreteColumnUnion F A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f0 := Classical.choose hF
  have hf0 : f0 ∈ F := Classical.choose_spec hF
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hCopies⟩ := exists_bandSpacing B hB
  let A' : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane :=
    ⋃ d : ℤ, TranslationalTilings.translateSet
      ((d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit) A
  let E' : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane :=
    ⋃ d : ℤ, TranslationalTilings.translateSet
      ((d * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit)
      (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ))
  have hperiodized := periodizeFiniteBand_tiles_general hTile hR hCopies
  have hTile' : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A' E' := hperiodized.1
  have hVert : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy E' verticalDiscreteUnit :=
    hperiodized.2.1
  have hScalar : TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic R E' := hperiodized.2.2
  obtain ⟨plateEquiv, hplate⟩ :=
    periodizeFiniteBand_verticalPlates_general hF hTile hR hCopies
  have hall : ∀ P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit,
      IsDiscreteVerticalColumn P := by
    intro P
    by_contra hnon
    let Q := plateEquiv (P, (0 : ℤ))
    have hQnon : ¬ IsDiscreteVerticalColumn Q := by
      exact fun h => hnon ((hplate P 0).2.mp h)
    obtain ⟨L, hL, _hRL, hperiod, _⟩ :=
      exists_discretePlatePeriodicity hF hR hVert hScalar hTile'
    have hQP : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations Q =
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P := by
      rw [(hplate P 0).1]
      ext z
      change z - ((0 : ℤ) * (R : ℤ)) • horizontalDiscreteUnit ∈
          Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P ↔ _
      simp
    obtain ⟨t, htP⟩ :
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P).Nonempty := by
      refine P.ind ?_
      intro a
      exact ⟨a, Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_quakePlateTranslations_mk a⟩
    let x : TranslationalTilings.Plane := f0 + t
    have hxcarrier : x ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations Q) := by
      exact ⟨f0, hf0, t, hQP ▸ htP, rfl⟩
    let n : ℕ := Int.natAbs (B.max' hB - firstDiscreteCoordinate x) + 1
    let w : TranslationalTilings.Plane := (n : ℤ) • horizontalDiscreteUnit
    have hxshift : x + (L : ℤ) • w ∈
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations Q) :=
      (hperiod Q hQnon x w).2 hxcarrier
    have hxbaseCarrier : x + (L : ℤ) • w ∈
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F A := by
      rcases hxshift with ⟨f, hf, a, ha, heq⟩
      exact ⟨f, hf, a, (hQP ▸ ha).1, heq⟩
    have hxband := discreteCarrier_subset_target hTile hxbaseCarrier
    have hxcoord := (mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff
      (x + (L : ℤ) • w) (B : Set ℤ)).mp hxband
    have hxle := B.le_max' _ hxcoord
    have hdiffnonneg : 0 ≤ |B.max' hB - firstDiscreteCoordinate x| := abs_nonneg _
    have hn : (n : ℤ) = |B.max' hB - firstDiscreteCoordinate x| + 1 := by
      simp [n]
    have hLabs : 1 ≤ (L : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hL
    have hcoordEq : firstDiscreteCoordinate (x + (L : ℤ) • w) =
        firstDiscreteCoordinate x + (L : ℤ) * (n : ℤ) := by
      simp [w, firstDiscreteCoordinate]
    have hxle' : firstDiscreteCoordinate x + (L : ℤ) * (n : ℤ) ≤ B.max' hB :=
      hcoordEq ▸ hxle
    have habsbound : B.max' hB - firstDiscreteCoordinate x ≤
        |B.max' hB - firstDiscreteCoordinate x| := le_abs_self _
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨hall, ?_⟩
  calc
    A = ⋃ P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit,
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P :=
      (iUnion_verticalPlateCentres F A).symm
    _ = discreteColumnUnion F A := by
      simp [discreteColumnUnion, hall]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.finiteBand_allVerticalColumns_general
statement:
theorem finiteBand_allVerticalColumns_general
    {B : Finset ℤ} {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A
      (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ))) :
    (∀ P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit,
      IsDiscreteVerticalColumn P) ∧ A = discreteColumnUnion F A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hB : B.Nonempty
  · exact finiteBand_allVerticalColumns_of_nonempty hF hB hTile
  · have hA : A = ∅ := by
      ext a
      constructor
      · intro ha
        let f0 := Classical.choose hF
        have hf0 : f0 ∈ F := Classical.choose_spec hF
        have hx : f0 + a ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F A :=
          ⟨f0, hf0, a, ha, rfl⟩
        have hxTarget := discreteCarrier_subset_target hTile hx
        exact (hB ⟨firstDiscreteCoordinate (f0 + a),
          (mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff (f0 + a) (B : Set ℤ)).mp hxTarget⟩).elim
      · simp
    constructor
    · intro P
      obtain ⟨a, _ha⟩ := P.nonempty_supp
      have : False := by
        have ha := a.property
        have he := congrArg (fun S : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane => a.val ∈ S) hA
        exact he.mp ha
      exact this.elim
    · rw [hA]
      simp [discreteColumnUnion]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.finiteBand_allVerticalColumns
statement:
theorem finiteBand_allVerticalColumns
    {B : Finset ℤ} {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (_hFB : (F : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane) ⊆
      verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ))
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A
      (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ))) :
    (∀ P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit,
      IsDiscreteVerticalColumn P) ∧ A = discreteColumnUnion F A
proof:
:=
  finiteBand_allVerticalColumns_general hF hTile

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.finiteBand_projectedTiling
statement:
theorem finiteBand_projectedTiling
    {B : Finset ℤ} {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (hFB : (F : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane) ⊆
      verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ))
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A
      (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ))) :
    ∃ C : Finset ℤ,
      TranslationalTilings.Tiles
        (F.image firstDiscreteCoordinate) (C : Set ℤ) (B : Set ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hall := (finiteBand_allVerticalColumns hF hFB hTile).1
  let axis : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A verticalDiscreteUnit → ℤ :=
    fun P => Classical.choose (hall P)
  have haxis : ∀ P, firstDiscreteCoordinate ''
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P = {axis P} :=
    fun P => Classical.choose_spec (hall P)
  let Cset : Set ℤ := Set.range axis
  let f0 := Classical.choose hF
  have hf0 : f0 ∈ F := Classical.choose_spec hF
  have hCfinite : Cset.Finite := by
    apply Set.Finite.subset (B.image fun b => b - firstDiscreteCoordinate f0).finite_toSet
    rintro c ⟨P, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ :
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P).Nonempty := by
      refine P.ind ?_
      intro a
      exact ⟨a, Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_quakePlateTranslations_mk a⟩
    have htc : firstDiscreteCoordinate t = axis P := by
      have : firstDiscreteCoordinate t ∈ ({axis P} : Set ℤ) := haxis P ▸ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
      simpa using this
    have hcar : f0 + t ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F A :=
      ⟨f0, hf0, t, ht.1, rfl⟩
    have hband := discreteCarrier_subset_target hTile hcar
    have hb := (mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff (f0 + t) (B : Set ℤ)).mp hband
    apply Finset.mem_coe.mpr
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨firstDiscreteCoordinate (f0 + t), hb, ?_⟩
    simpa [firstDiscreteCoordinate] using htc
  let C : Finset ℤ := hCfinite.toFinset
  refine ⟨C, tiles_of_existsUnique_on_target ?_ ?_⟩
  · intro x hxB
    let z : TranslationalTilings.Plane := ![x, 0]
    have hzB : z ∈ verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ) := by
      apply (mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff z (B : Set ℤ)).mpr
      simpa [z, firstDiscreteCoordinate]
    have hc := (TranslationalTilings.tilesAtLevel_iff_representation_count F A
      (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)) 1).mp hTile z
    have hcard : (F.filter fun f => z - f ∈ A).card = 1 := by simpa [hzB] using hc
    obtain ⟨f, hfilter⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard
    have hfA : f ∈ F ∧ z - f ∈ A := by
      have : f ∈ F.filter fun g => z - g ∈ A := by simp [hfilter]
      simpa using this
    have haUnion : z - f ∈ ⋃ P : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.QuakePlate F A
        verticalDiscreteUnit, Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P := by
      rw [iUnion_verticalPlateCentres F A]
      exact hfA.2
    obtain ⟨P, haP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp haUnion
    have hac : firstDiscreteCoordinate (z - f) = axis P := by
      have : firstDiscreteCoordinate (z - f) ∈ ({axis P} : Set ℤ) :=
        haxis P ▸ ⟨z - f, haP, rfl⟩
      simpa using this
    refine ⟨firstDiscreteCoordinate f, ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨f, hfA.1, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · change x - firstDiscreteCoordinate f ∈ (C : Set ℤ)
      have heq : x - firstDiscreteCoordinate f = axis P := by
        simpa [z, firstDiscreteCoordinate] using hac
      rw [heq]
      exact hCfinite.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨P, rfl⟩
    · intro u hu
      obtain ⟨g, hgF, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu.1
      have haxisQ : x - firstDiscreteCoordinate g ∈ Cset := by
        exact hCfinite.mem_toFinset.mp hu.2
      obtain ⟨Q, hQeq⟩ := haxisQ
      have hsumP : x ∈ integerSumset
          (firstDiscreteCoordinate '' (F : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane))
          (firstDiscreteCoordinate '' Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P) := by
        refine ⟨firstDiscreteCoordinate f, ⟨f, hfA.1, rfl⟩,
          axis P, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [haxis P]
          exact Set.mem_singleton _
        · rw [← hac]
          simp [z, firstDiscreteCoordinate]
      have hsumQ : x ∈ integerSumset
          (firstDiscreteCoordinate '' (F : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane))
          (firstDiscreteCoordinate '' Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations Q) := by
        refine ⟨firstDiscreteCoordinate g, ⟨g, hgF, rfl⟩, axis Q, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [haxis Q]
          exact Set.mem_singleton _
        · calc
            firstDiscreteCoordinate g + axis Q = axis Q + firstDiscreteCoordinate g :=
              add_comm _ _
            _ = x := (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hQeq.symm).symm
      have hVert : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy
          (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)) verticalDiscreteUnit := by
        intro q
        rw [mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff, mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff]
        simp [firstDiscreteCoordinate, verticalDiscreteUnit]
      have hzP : z ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P) := by
        rw [verticalPlateCarrier_eq_projectionProduct hF hTile hVert P,
          mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff]
        simpa [z, firstDiscreteCoordinate] using hsumP
      have hzQ : z ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations Q) := by
        rw [verticalPlateCarrier_eq_projectionProduct hF hTile hVert Q,
          mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff]
        simpa [z, firstDiscreteCoordinate] using hsumQ
      have hPQ : P = Q := by
        by_contra hne
        exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp
          (plateCarriers_disjoint hTile hne)) hzP hzQ
      subst Q
      have hfaxis : x - firstDiscreteCoordinate f = axis P := by
        simpa [z, firstDiscreteCoordinate] using hac
      omega
  · intro x hxB u huF huC
    obtain ⟨f, hfF, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp huF
    have hcset : x - firstDiscreteCoordinate f ∈ Cset := hCfinite.mem_toFinset.mp huC
    obtain ⟨P, hPeq⟩ := hcset
    let z : TranslationalTilings.Plane := ![x, 0]
    have hsum : x ∈ integerSumset
        (firstDiscreteCoordinate '' (F : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane))
        (firstDiscreteCoordinate '' Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P) := by
      refine ⟨firstDiscreteCoordinate f, ⟨f, hfF, rfl⟩, axis P, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [haxis P]
        exact Set.mem_singleton _
      · calc
          firstDiscreteCoordinate f + axis P = axis P + firstDiscreteCoordinate f :=
            add_comm _ _
          _ = x := (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hPeq.symm).symm
    have hVert : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy
        (verticalDiscreteCylinder (B : Set ℤ)) verticalDiscreteUnit := by
      intro q
      rw [mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff, mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff]
      simp [firstDiscreteCoordinate, verticalDiscreteUnit]
    have hzcar : z ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P) := by
      rw [verticalPlateCarrier_eq_projectionProduct hF hTile hVert P,
        mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff]
      simpa [z, firstDiscreteCoordinate] using hsum
    have hzA : z ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F A := by
      rcases hzcar with ⟨g, hg, a, ha, heq⟩
      exact ⟨g, hg, a, ha.1, heq⟩
    have hzband := discreteCarrier_subset_target hTile hzA
    apply hxB
    have := (mem_verticalDiscreteCylinder_iff z (B : Set ℤ)).mp hzband
    simpa [z, firstDiscreteCoordinate] using this

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.flcDifferencesInterFinite
statement:
private theorem flcDifferencesInterFinite
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    {Y Q : Set E} (hY : Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC Y)
    (hQ : Bornology.IsBounded Q) : ((Y - Y) ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hQR⟩ := (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall (0 : E)).mp hQ
  let R' : ℝ := max R 1
  have hR' : 0 < R' := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right R 1)
  refine (hY.2 R' hR').subset ?_
  rintro x ⟨hxDiff, hxQ⟩
  exact ⟨hxDiff, Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (le_max_left R 1) (hQR hxQ)⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.lattice_quotientImage_finite
statement:
private theorem lattice_quotientImage_finite
    {Y : Set Tiling.Plane} (hY : Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC Y)
    (v : Tiling.Plane) (L : Tiling.AxisParallel.PlanarLattice)
    (hCoset : v +ᵥ (L.toAddSubgroup : Set Tiling.Plane) ⊆ Y) :
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk' L.toAddSubgroup '' Y).Finite
proof:
:= by
  let b := L.realBasis
  let H : AddSubgroup Tiling.Plane :=
    (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range b)).toAddSubgroup
  have hHL : H = L.toAddSubgroup := L.span_realBasis_toAddSubgroup
  rw [← hHL] at hCoset ⊢
  have hD : ((Y - Y) ∩ ZSpan.fundamentalDomain b).Finite :=
    flcDifferencesInterFinite hY (ZSpan.fundamentalDomain_isBounded b)
  refine (hD.image (fun d => QuotientAddGroup.mk' H (v + d))).subset ?_
  rintro q ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  let d : Tiling.Plane := ZSpan.fract b (y - v)
  have hbase : v + (ZSpan.floor b (y - v) : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Y := by
    apply hCoset
    exact ⟨(ZSpan.floor b (y - v) : Tiling.Plane),
      (ZSpan.floor b (y - v)).property, rfl⟩
  have hdDiff : d ∈ Y - Y := by
    refine ⟨y, hy, v + (ZSpan.floor b (y - v) : Tiling.Plane), hbase, ?_⟩
    dsimp only [d]
    rw [ZSpan.fract_apply]
    abel_nf
  have hdFund : d ∈ ZSpan.fundamentalDomain b :=
    ZSpan.fract_mem_fundamentalDomain b (y - v)
  refine ⟨d, ⟨hdDiff, hdFund⟩, ?_⟩
  apply (QuotientAddGroup.mk'_eq_mk' H).2
  refine ⟨(ZSpan.floor b (y - v) : Tiling.Plane), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (ZSpan.floor b (y - v)).property
  · dsimp only [d]
    rw [ZSpan.fract_apply]
    abel_nf

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.finiteIndex_commonIntersection
statement:
private theorem finiteIndex_commonIntersection
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {Y : Set Tiling.Plane} (hY : Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC Y)
    (v : Fin n → Tiling.Plane)
    (L : Fin n → Tiling.AxisParallel.PlanarLattice)
    (hCoset : ∀ i : Fin n,
      v i +ᵥ ((L i).toAddSubgroup : Set Tiling.Plane) ⊆ Y) :
    let i₀ : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩
    let H₀ := (L i₀).toAddSubgroup
    ((⨅ i : Fin n, (L i).toAddSubgroup).addSubgroupOf H₀).FiniteIndex
proof:
:= by
  let i₀ : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩
  let H₀ := (L i₀).toAddSubgroup
  have hEach : ∀ i : Fin n, ((L i).toAddSubgroup.addSubgroupOf H₀).FiniteIndex := by
    intro i
    let f : H₀ →+ Tiling.Plane ⧸ (L i).toAddSubgroup :=
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (L i).toAddSubgroup).comp H₀.subtype
    have hImage :
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (L i).toAddSubgroup '' Y).Finite :=
      lattice_quotientImage_finite hY (v i) (L i) (hCoset i)
    have hRange : (f.range : Set (Tiling.Plane ⧸ (L i).toAddSubgroup)).Finite := by
      refine (hImage.image fun q =>
        q - QuotientAddGroup.mk' (L i).toAddSubgroup (v i₀)).subset ?_
      rintro q ⟨x, rfl⟩
      have hxY : v i₀ + (x : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Y := by
        apply hCoset i₀
        exact ⟨x, x.property, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨QuotientAddGroup.mk' (L i).toAddSubgroup
        (v i₀ + (x : Tiling.Plane)), ⟨_, hxY, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      simp [f]
    let _ : Fintype f.range := hRange.fintype
    have hKer : f.ker.FiniteIndex := AddSubgroup.finiteIndex_ker f
    have hKerEq : f.ker = (L i).toAddSubgroup.addSubgroupOf H₀ := by
      ext x
      simp [f, AddSubgroup.mem_addSubgroupOf]
    rw [← hKerEq]
    exact hKer
  change ((⨅ i : Fin n, (L i).toAddSubgroup).addSubgroupOf H₀).FiniteIndex
  rw [show (⨅ i : Fin n, (L i).toAddSubgroup).addSubgroupOf H₀ =
      ⨅ i : Fin n, (L i).toAddSubgroup.addSubgroupOf H₀ by
    ext x
    change ((x : Tiling.Plane) ∈ ⨅ i : Fin n, (L i).toAddSubgroup) ↔
      x ∈ ⨅ i : Fin n, (L i).toAddSubgroup.addSubgroupOf H₀
    rw [AddSubgroup.mem_iInf, AddSubgroup.mem_iInf]
    rfl]
  exact AddSubgroup.finiteIndex_iInf hEach

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.span_toIntSubmodule_eq_top_of_finiteIndex_in_zspan
statement:
private theorem span_toIntSubmodule_eq_top_of_finiteIndex_in_zspan
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℝ Tiling.Plane)
    (H : AddSubgroup Tiling.Plane)
    [((H.addSubgroupOf
      (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range b)).toAddSubgroup)).FiniteIndex] :
    Submodule.span ℝ (H.toIntSubmodule : Set Tiling.Plane) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  rw [← b.span_eq]
  apply Submodule.span_le.2
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  let H₀ : AddSubgroup Tiling.Plane :=
    (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range b)).toAddSubgroup
  let A : AddSubgroup H₀ := H.addSubgroupOf H₀
  let x₀ : H₀ := ⟨b i, by
    change b i ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range b)
    exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩
  have hxA : A.index • x₀ ∈ A := A.nsmul_index_mem x₀
  have hxH : A.index • b i ∈ H := by
    exact hxA
  have hxSpan : (A.index : ℝ) • b i ∈
      Submodule.span ℝ (H.toIntSubmodule : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    simpa using hxH
  have hIndex : (A.index : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (inferInstance : A.FiniteIndex).index_ne_zero
  rw [show b i = (A.index : ℝ)⁻¹ • ((A.index : ℝ) • b i) by
    rw [← mul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hIndex, one_smul]]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hxSpan

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.finitePlanarLattices_commonSublattice_of_cosets_subset_flc
statement:
theorem finitePlanarLattices_commonSublattice_of_cosets_subset_flc
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {Y : Set Tiling.Plane} (hY : Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC Y)
    (v : Fin n → Tiling.Plane)
    (L : Fin n → Tiling.AxisParallel.PlanarLattice)
    (hCoset : ∀ i : Fin n,
      v i +ᵥ ((L i).toAddSubgroup : Set Tiling.Plane) ⊆ Y) :
    ∃ Lcommon : Tiling.AxisParallel.PlanarLattice,
      Lcommon.toAddSubgroup = ⨅ i : Fin n, (L i).toAddSubgroup
proof:
:= by
  let i₀ : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩
  let H : AddSubgroup Tiling.Plane := ⨅ i : Fin n, (L i).toAddSubgroup
  let b₀ : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℝ Tiling.Plane := (L i₀).realBasis
  let Z₀ : Submodule ℤ Tiling.Plane := Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range b₀)
  have hZ₀ : Z₀.toAddSubgroup = (L i₀).toAddSubgroup := by
    simpa [Z₀, b₀] using (L i₀).span_realBasis_toAddSubgroup
  have hHZ₀ : H ≤ Z₀.toAddSubgroup := by
    intro x hx
    have hx₀ : x ∈ (L i₀).toAddSubgroup := by
      exact (AddSubgroup.mem_iInf.mp hx) i₀
    rw [hZ₀]
    exact hx₀
  have hFiniteIndex : (H.addSubgroupOf Z₀.toAddSubgroup).FiniteIndex := by
    have h := finiteIndex_commonIntersection hn hY v L hCoset
    change (H.addSubgroupOf (L i₀).toAddSubgroup).FiniteIndex at h
    rwa [hZ₀]
  let _ : (H.addSubgroupOf Z₀.toAddSubgroup).FiniteIndex := hFiniteIndex
  let inclusion : H.toIntSubmodule → Z₀ := fun x => ⟨x, hHZ₀ x.property⟩
  have inclusion_continuous : Continuous inclusion := by
    exact Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_subtype_val _
  have inclusion_injective : Function.Injective inclusion := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa [inclusion] using congrArg Subtype.val hxy
  let _ : DiscreteTopology H.toIntSubmodule :=
    DiscreteTopology.of_continuous_injective inclusion_continuous inclusion_injective
  have hSpan : Submodule.span ℝ (H.toIntSubmodule : Set Tiling.Plane) = ⊤ := by
    exact span_toIntSubmodule_eq_top_of_finiteIndex_in_zspan b₀ H
  let _ : IsZLattice ℝ H.toIntSubmodule := ⟨hSpan⟩
  let _ : Module.Finite ℤ H.toIntSubmodule :=
    ZLattice.module_finite ℝ H.toIntSubmodule
  let _ : Module.Free ℤ H.toIntSubmodule :=
    ZLattice.module_free ℝ H.toIntSubmodule
  have hCard : Fintype.card (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ H.toIntSubmodule) =
      Fintype.card (Fin 2) := by
    rw [← Module.finrank_eq_card_chooseBasisIndex, ZLattice.rank ℝ H.toIntSubmodule]
    exact Complex.finrank_real_complex
  let e : Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ H.toIntSubmodule ≃ Fin 2 :=
    Fintype.equivOfCardEq hCard
  let bℤ : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℤ H.toIntSubmodule :=
    (Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ H.toIntSubmodule).reindex e
  let bℝ : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℝ Tiling.Plane :=
    bℤ.ofZLatticeBasis ℝ H.toIntSubmodule
  let Lcommon : Tiling.AxisParallel.PlanarLattice :=
    { basis := bℝ
      independent := bℝ.linearIndependent }
  refine ⟨Lcommon, ?_⟩
  change AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range bℝ) = H
  rw [← Submodule.span_int_eq_addSubgroupClosure,
    bℤ.ofZLatticeBasis_span ℝ, AddSubgroup.toIntSubmodule_toAddSubgroup]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.HasFLC.add_finite
statement:
private theorem HasFLC.add_finite
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    {T V : Set E} (hT : Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC T) (hV : V.Finite) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC (V + T)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hT with ⟨hTlocal, hTdiff⟩
  constructor
  · intro Q hQ
    have hQV : Bornology.IsBounded (Q - V) :=
      Bornology.IsBounded.sub hQ hV.isBounded
    have hTQ : (T ∩ (Q - V)).Finite := hTlocal (Q - V) hQV
    refine (hV.add hTQ).subset ?_
    rintro z ⟨hzVT, hzQ⟩
    rcases hzVT with ⟨v, hv, t, ht, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨v, hv, t, ⟨ht, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨v + t, hzQ, v, hv, by abel_nf⟩
  · intro R hR
    have hVV : (V - V).Finite := hV.sub hV
    have hbounded : Bornology.IsBounded (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R - (V - V)) :=
      Bornology.IsBounded.sub Metric.isBounded_closedBall hVV.isBounded
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
      (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall (0 : E)).mp hbounded
    let C' : ℝ := max C 1
    have hC' : 0 < C' := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right C 1)
    have hCC' : Metric.closedBall (0 : E) C ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 C' :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (le_max_left C 1)
    have hTfinite : ((T - T) ∩ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) C').Finite :=
      hTdiff C' hC'
    refine (hVV.add hTfinite).subset ?_
    rintro z ⟨hzDiff, hzBall⟩
    rcases hzDiff with ⟨x, hxVT, y, hyVT, rfl⟩
    rcases hxVT with ⟨v, hv, t, ht, rfl⟩
    rcases hyVT with ⟨w, hw, s, hs, rfl⟩
    have hvw : v - w ∈ V - V := ⟨v, hv, w, hw, rfl⟩
    have htsBounded : t - s ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) C' := by
      apply hCC'
      apply hC
      refine ⟨(v + t) - (w + s), hzBall, v - w, hvw, ?_⟩
      abel_nf
    refine ⟨v - w, hvw, t - s, ⟨⟨t, ht, s, hs, rfl⟩, htsBounded⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_add_rev]
    ac_rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC.add_vertexOffsets
statement:
theorem _root_.Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC.add_vertexOffsets

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.rationalScale_zsmul
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd n z
  have hadd := Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.rationalScale_add (d := d) hd
  have hzero : Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.rationalScale d 0 = 0 := by
    have hzero' := hadd 0 0
    rw [zero_add] at hzero'
    have hz :
        Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.rationalScale d 0 + 0 =
          Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.rationalScale d 0 +
            Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.rationalScale d 0 := by
      simpa using hzero'.symm
    exact (add_left_cancel hz).symm
  have hneg (x : ZPlane) :
      Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.rationalScale d (-x) =
        -Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.rationalScale d x := by
    have h := hadd (-x) x
    have hz :
        Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.rationalScale d (-x) +
            Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.rationalScale d x = 0 := by
      rw [← h]
      simp [hzero]
    exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hz
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero =>
      simp [hzero]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [show (↑n + 1 : ℤ) • z = (↑n : ℤ) • z + z by simp [add_smul]]
      rw [hadd, ih]
      simp [add_smul]
  | pred n ih =>
      rw [show (-↑n - 1 : ℤ) • z = (-↑n : ℤ) • z + (-z) by module]
      rw [hadd, ih]
      rw [hneg]
      module
