  obtain ⟨Tφ, Xφ, αφ, hTφ, _hOpen, _hRegular, _hNonempty, _hProper,
      _hAlphaEq, _hAlphaPos, _hPeriod, _hFrontier, _hOccupied, hTiles,
      _hSupport⟩ := periodicBandDeformation B P.threshold hFine phi hphi D
  have hEmb : Tφ = Tphi := by
    ext t
    exact (hTφ t).trans (hTphi t).symm
  have hImagePacking : Tiling.IsPacking
      D.deformedRegion.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (D.deformedRegion.toPolygonalRegion.placements (Set.range Tphi)) := by
    rw [hEmb] at hTiles
    exact hTiles.2.1
  exact hTransport P hScale phi hphi D Tphi hTphi hImagePacking Dcmp
    originalSlice hPreimage i hHorizontal Q hNoGap hNoColumn

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC.subset
statement:
theorem _root_.Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC.subset
    {S T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hT : Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC T) (hST : S ⊆ T) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC S
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro Q hQ
    apply (hT.1 Q hQ).subset
    rintro x ⟨hxS, hxQ⟩
    exact ⟨hST hxS, hxQ⟩
  · intro R hR
    apply (hT.2 R hR).subset
    rintro x ⟨hxDiff, hxBall⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs, t, ht, rfl⟩ := hxDiff
    exact ⟨⟨s, hST hs, t, hST ht, rfl⟩, hxBall⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.tilesOn_regularSupport_of_subset
statement:
private theorem tilesOn_regularSupport_of_subset
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {S T E : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hST : S ⊆ T) (hTile : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T E) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K S
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport K S)
proof:
:= by
  have hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S) := by
    intro s hs t ht hst
    exact hTile.2.1 (hST hs) (hST ht) hst
  refine ⟨hTile.1.mono hST, hpacking, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [Tiling.AxisParallel.openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport hpacking] with x hx
  exact (Iff.of_eq hx.symm).trans (by
    change x ∈ (⋃ s : S, (s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ↔
      ∃ s : S, x ∈ (s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier
    exact Set.mem_iUnion)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.regularSupport_disjointSubfamilies
statement:
theorem regularSupport_disjointSubfamilies
    {I : Type*} [Countable I]
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {T E : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (S : I → Set Tiling.Plane)
    (hparts : Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ S)
    (hsub : ∀ i, S i ⊆ T)
    (hTile : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T E) :
    Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ
        (fun i ↦ Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport K (S i)) ∧
      (∀ i, Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K (S i)
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport K (S i))) ∧
      Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport K (⋃ i, S i) =
        interior (closure
          (⋃ i, Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport K (S i)))
proof:
:= by
  have hsubUnion : (⋃ i, S i) ⊆ T := by
    exact Set.iUnion_subset hsub
  have hUnionTile := tilesOn_regularSupport_of_subset hsubUnion hTile
  have hdisjoint :=
    (Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport_pairwiseDisjoint
      S hparts rfl hUnionTile).1
  exact ⟨hdisjoint, fun i ↦ tilesOn_regularSupport_of_subset (hsub i) hTile,
    regularSupport_iUnion S⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.finiteAggregateSupport
statement:
theorem finiteAggregateSupport
    {n : ℕ} {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region}
    (S : Fin n → Set Tiling.Plane) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport K (⋃ i, S i) =
      interior (closure
        (⋃ i, Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport K (S i)))
proof:
:=
  regularSupport_iUnion S

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.hasFLC_coordinateSwap_to_original_t12
statement:
private theorem hasFLC_coordinateSwap_to_original_t12
    (S : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' S) →
      Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC S
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  constructor
  · intro Q hQ
    have hQ' : Bornology.IsBounded
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' Q) :=
      coordinateSwapIsometry_t12.lipschitz.isBounded_image hQ
    have hfinite := h.1 (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' Q) hQ'
    refine Set.Finite.of_finite_image (s := S ∩ Q)
      (f := Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap) ?_
      Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap.injective.injOn
    rw [Set.image_inter Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap.injective]
    exact hfinite
  · intro R hR
    let A : Set Tiling.Plane :=
      (S - S) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 R
    refine Set.Finite.of_finite_image (s := A)
      (f := Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap) ?_
      Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap.injective.injOn
    apply (h.2 R hR).subset
    rintro d ⟨d₀, ⟨hd, hdR⟩, rfl⟩
    rcases hd with ⟨b, hb, a, ha, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap b,
        ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap a, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · simp only [map_sub]
    · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      have hnorm : ‖Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap (b - a)‖ = ‖b - a‖ := by
        change ‖coordinateSwapIsometry_t12 (b - a)‖ = ‖b - a‖
        exact coordinateSwapIsometry_t12.norm_map _
      rw [hnorm]
      simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hdR

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.hasFLC_coordinateSwap
statement:
private theorem hasFLC_coordinateSwap :
    ∀ {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC T →
        Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T)
proof:
:= by
  intro T h
  have h' := hasFLC_coordinateSwap_to_original_t12
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T)
      (by
        simpa [Set.image_image,
          Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap_apply_apply] using h)
  simpa [Set.image_image,
    Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap_apply_apply] using h'

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.properCarrier_nonColumnBase_ne_univ
proof:
:= by
  intro hX i hbase
  apply hX
  apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
  intro x
  let P := D.nonColumnPlate i
  have hcarrierOpen : IsOpen X.carrier :=
    X.base_open.preimage Complex.continuous_re
  have hcarrierRegular : interior (closure X.carrier) = X.carrier := by
    change interior (closure (Complex.re ⁻¹' X.base)) = Complex.re ⁻¹' X.base
    rw [Complex.closure_preimage_re, Complex.interior_preimage_re,
      X.base_regular]
  have hsourceSupport :
      Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport K T = X.carrier :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn
      hcarrierOpen hcarrierRegular D.source_tiles
  have hopenUnion : Tiling.AxisParallel.openUnion K T ⊆ X.carrier := by
    rw [← hsourceSupport]
    have hopen : IsOpen (Tiling.AxisParallel.openUnion K T) := by
      apply isOpen_iUnion
      intro t
      exact isOpen_interior.vadd t.1
    exact hopen.subset_interior_closure
  have hPsubset : P.centres ⊆ T := by
    rintro p ⟨q, _hq, rfl⟩
    exact q.2
  have hPopen : Tiling.AxisParallel.openUnion K P.centres ⊆
      Tiling.AxisParallel.openUnion K T := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion,
      ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion] at hz ⊢
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hz
    refine ⟨⟨p.1, hPsubset p.2⟩, ?_⟩
    exact hp
  have hPsupport : P.support ⊆ X.carrier := by
    change Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport K P.centres ⊆ X.carrier
    rw [← hcarrierRegular]
    exact interior_mono (closure_mono (hPopen.trans hopenUnion))
  have hxbase : x ∈ P.base := by
    rw [hbase]
    trivial
  change x ∈ Complex.re '' P.support at hxbase
  rcases hxbase with ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  exact hPsupport hz

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.nontrivialPlanePlate_hasProperBase
statement:
theorem nontrivialPlanePlate_hasProperBase
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (hNoFull : ¬ ∃ P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
      ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧ P.centres = T)
    (P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate K T)
    (hPnotcol : ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P) :
    P.base ≠ Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  intro hbase
  obtain ⟨_hbaseRegular, hsupport⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile P
  have hPsupport : P.support = Set.univ := by
    rw [hsupport, hbase]
    exact Set.preimage_univ
  have hcentres : P.centres = T :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.plate_centres_eq_of_support_eq_univ hTile P hPsupport
  exact hNoFull ⟨P, hPnotcol, hcentres⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.properPlate_propagationIrreducible
statement:
private theorem properPlate_propagationIrreducible
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate K T)
    (hminimal :
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsMinimalVerticalSlabSubfamily
        K T P.centres)
    (_hPnotcol : ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P)
    (hproper : P.base ≠ Set.univ) :
    IsPropagationIrreducible K T P.centres P.base
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro Q hQnonempty hQsub hQslab
    exact hminimal.2.2.2 Q hQnonempty hQsub hQslab
  · intro hfull _Q _hQnonempty _hQsub _hQslab
    exact (hproper hfull).elim

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.plate_base_nonempty_local
statement:
private theorem plate_base_nonempty_local
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) :
    P.base.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := P.nonempty_supp
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := K.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty K.nonempty
  rw [P.base_eq]
  refine ⟨(t.1 + u).re, ⟨t.1 + u, ?_, rfl⟩⟩
  rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_eq_regularSupport]
  unfold Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport
  have hopen : IsOpen (Tiling.AxisParallel.openUnion K P.centres) := by
    rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier]
    exact isOpen_iUnion fun s : P.centres ↦ isOpen_interior.vadd s.1
  apply hopen.subset_interior_closure
  rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion,
    ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
  refine ⟨⟨t.1, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  have hu' : u ∈ K.openCarrier := by
    rw [← K.openCarrier_regularOpen.2,
      show closure K.openCarrier = K.support from K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]
    exact hu
  simpa only [vadd_eq_add, neg_add_cancel_left] using hu'

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.plate_base_periodic_local
statement:
private theorem plate_base_periodic_local
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate K T)
    {beta : ℝ}
    (hsupport : P.support = Complex.re ⁻¹' P.base)
    (hperiod : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy P.support ((beta : ℂ))) :
    beta +ᵥ P.base = P.base
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have hperiod' : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy
      (Complex.re ⁻¹' P.base) ((beta : ℂ)) := by
    rw [← hsupport]
    exact hperiod
  simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm,
    add_left_comm, add_assoc, Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy,
    Complex.add_re] using (hperiod' ((x - beta : ℝ) : ℂ)).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.columnCentres_subset_local
statement:
private theorem columnCentres_subset_local
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalColumnCentres K T ⊆ T
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  change z ∈ ⋃ P : {P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate K T //
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P}, P.1.centres at hz
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hz
  obtain ⟨P, t, ht, rfl⟩ := hz
  exact t.2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.verticalRegion_fields
statement:
private theorem verticalRegion_fields
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    {X : PeriodicVerticalCarrier}
    (hFLC : Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC T)
    (D : PeriodicCarrierSlabDecomposition K T X)
    (hproper : ∀ i, (D.nonColumnPlate i).base ≠ Set.univ)
    (i : Fin D.numberOfNonColumnPlates) :
    (verticalTerminalRegion hFLC D hproper i).orientation = Axis.vertical ∧
    (verticalTerminalRegion hFLC D hproper i).selectedRegion = K ∧
    (verticalTerminalRegion hFLC D hproper i).selectedAmbientCentres = T ∧
    (verticalTerminalRegion hFLC D hproper i).selectedCentres =
      (D.nonColumnPlate i).centres ∧
    (verticalTerminalRegion hFLC D hproper i).supportPeriod = D.commonSupportPeriod

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.verticalColumn_region_disjoint
statement:
private theorem verticalColumn_region_disjoint
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    {X : PeriodicVerticalCarrier}
    (hFLC : Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC T)
    (D : PeriodicCarrierSlabDecomposition K T X)
    (hproper : ∀ i, (D.nonColumnPlate i).base ≠ Set.univ) :
    ∀ i, Disjoint D.columnCentres
      (verticalTerminalRegion hFLC D hproper i).centres
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  change Disjoint D.columnCentres (D.nonColumnPlate i).centres
  exact D.column_nonColumn_disjoint i

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.verticalSlabs_to_terminalDecomposition
statement:
private theorem verticalSlabs_to_terminalDecomposition
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (X : PeriodicVerticalCarrier)
    (hFLC : Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC T)
    (D : PeriodicCarrierSlabDecomposition K T X)
    (hproper : ∀ i, (D.nonColumnPlate i).base ≠ Set.univ) :
    ∃ R : TerminalRegionDecomposition K T X,
      R.orientation = Axis.vertical ∧
      R.slabs.numberOfNonColumnPlates = D.numberOfNonColumnPlates ∧
      R.columnCentres = D.columnCentres
proof:
:= by
  let region : Fin D.numberOfNonColumnPlates → TerminalRegion K T :=
    fun i ↦ verticalTerminalRegion hFLC D hproper i
  let R : TerminalRegionDecomposition K T X := {
    orientation := Axis.vertical
    selectedRegion := K
    selectedRegion_vertical := by intro; rfl
    selectedRegion_horizontal := by intro h; cases h
    selectedCentres := T
    selectedCentres_vertical := by intro; rfl
    selectedCentres_horizontal := by intro h; cases h
    selectedCarrier := X
    selectedCarrier_vertical := by intro; rfl
    selectedCarrier_horizontal := by intro h; cases h
    selected_tiles := D.source_tiles
    selected_flc := hFLC
    slabs := D
    region := region
    region_orientation := by
      intro i
      exact (verticalRegion_fields hFLC D hproper i).1
    region_selectedRegion := by
      intro i
      exact (verticalRegion_fields hFLC D hproper i).2.1
    region_selectedAmbientCentres := by
      intro i
      exact (verticalRegion_fields hFLC D hproper i).2.2.1
    region_selectedCentres := by
      intro i
      exact (verticalRegion_fields hFLC D hproper i).2.2.2.1
    region_period := by
      intro i
      exact (verticalRegion_fields hFLC D hproper i).2.2.2.2
    columnCentres := D.columnCentres
    selectedColumnCentres := D.columnCentres
    selectedColumnCentres_vertical := by intro; rfl
    selectedColumnCentres_horizontal := by intro h; cases h
    selectedColumnCentres_eq_slabs := rfl
    column_flc := hFLC.subset (by
      rw [D.columnCentres_eq]
      exact columnCentres_subset_local)
    selectedColumn_flc := hFLC.subset (by
      rw [D.columnCentres_eq]
      exact columnCentres_subset_local)
    parts_pairwise := by
      intro i _ j _ hij
      change Disjoint (region i).centres (region j).centres
      change Disjoint (D.nonColumnPlate i).centres (D.nonColumnPlate j).centres
      exact D.nonColumnCentres_pairwise (by simp) (by simp) hij
    column_region_disjoint := by
      intro i
      exact verticalColumn_region_disjoint hFLC D hproper i
    parts_union := by
      have hEq : (⋃ i, (region i).centres) =
          ⋃ i, (D.nonColumnPlate i).centres := by
        apply Set.iUnion_congr
        intro i
        rfl
      rw [hEq]
      exact D.centres_partition
    fullBase_only_bothTrivial := by
      intro i hi
      change (D.nonColumnPlate i).base = Set.univ at hi
      exact (hproper i hi).elim }
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.swap_subset_original_local
statement:
private theorem swap_subset_original_local
    {T S : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hS : S ⊆ Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' S ⊆ T
proof:
:= by
  rintro z ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hS hy
  simpa only [Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap_apply_apply] using ht

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.swap_disjoint_image_local
statement:
private theorem swap_disjoint_image_local
    {A B : Set Tiling.Plane} (h : Disjoint A B) :
    Disjoint (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' A)
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro z ⟨a, ha, haz⟩ ⟨b, hb, hbz⟩
  have hab : a = b := Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap.injective
    (haz.trans hbz.symm)
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp h ha (hab ▸ hb)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.swap_iUnion_image_local
statement:
private theorem swap_iUnion_image_local
    {ι : Type*} (A : ι → Set Tiling.Plane) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' (⋃ i, A i) =
      ⋃ i, Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' A i
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hai⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp ha
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, ⟨a, hai, rfl⟩⟩
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨i, a, hai, hza⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
    exact ⟨a, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hai⟩, hza⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.horizontalSlabs_to_terminalDecomposition
statement:
private theorem horizontalSlabs_to_terminalDecomposition
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (X Xswap : PeriodicVerticalCarrier)
    (hPlane : X.base = Set.univ)
    (hSwapPlane : Xswap.base = Set.univ ∧ Xswap.carrier = Set.univ)
    (hFLC : Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC T)
    (D : PeriodicCarrierSlabDecomposition K.coordinateSwap
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T) Xswap)
    (hproper : ∀ i, (D.nonColumnPlate i).base ≠ Set.univ) :
    ∃ R : TerminalRegionDecomposition K T X,
      R.orientation = Axis.horizontal ∧
      R.slabs.numberOfNonColumnPlates = D.numberOfNonColumnPlates ∧
      R.selectedColumnCentres = D.columnCentres
proof:
:= by
  let region : Fin D.numberOfNonColumnPlates → TerminalRegion K T :=
    fun i ↦ horizontalTerminalRegion hFLC D hproper i
  let originalColumn := Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' D.columnCentres
  have hDcol : D.columnCentres ⊆ Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T := by
    rw [D.columnCentres_eq]
    exact columnCentres_subset_local
  have hOrigCol : originalColumn ⊆ T := swap_subset_original_local hDcol
  let R : TerminalRegionDecomposition K T X := {
    orientation := Axis.horizontal
    selectedRegion := K.coordinateSwap
    selectedRegion_vertical := by intro h; cases h
    selectedRegion_horizontal := by intro; rfl
    selectedCentres := Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T
    selectedCentres_vertical := by intro h; cases h
    selectedCentres_horizontal := by intro; rfl
    selectedCarrier := Xswap
    selectedCarrier_vertical := by intro h; cases h
    selectedCarrier_horizontal := by intro; exact ⟨hPlane, hSwapPlane.1, hSwapPlane.2⟩
    selected_tiles := D.source_tiles
    selected_flc := hasFLC_coordinateSwap hFLC
    slabs := D
    region := region
    region_orientation := by intro i; rfl
    region_selectedRegion := by intro i; rfl
    region_selectedAmbientCentres := by intro i; rfl
    region_selectedCentres := by intro i; rfl
    region_period := by intro i; rfl
    columnCentres := originalColumn
    selectedColumnCentres := D.columnCentres
    selectedColumnCentres_vertical := by intro h; cases h
    selectedColumnCentres_horizontal := by
      intro
      exact (IntrinsicVertices.coordinateSwap_image_image D.columnCentres).symm
    selectedColumnCentres_eq_slabs := rfl
    column_flc := hFLC.subset hOrigCol
    selectedColumn_flc := (hasFLC_coordinateSwap hFLC).subset hDcol
    parts_pairwise := by
      intro i _ j _ hij
      change Disjoint (region i).centres (region j).centres
      change Disjoint (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap ''
        (D.nonColumnPlate i).centres)
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap ''
          (D.nonColumnPlate j).centres)
      exact swap_disjoint_image_local
        (D.nonColumnCentres_pairwise (by simp) (by simp) hij)
    column_region_disjoint := by
      intro i
      change Disjoint (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' D.columnCentres)
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' (D.nonColumnPlate i).centres)
      exact swap_disjoint_image_local (D.column_nonColumn_disjoint i)
    parts_union := by
      rw [show (⋃ i, (region i).centres) =
          Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap ''
            (⋃ i, (D.nonColumnPlate i).centres) by
        rw [swap_iUnion_image_local]
        rfl, ← Set.image_union]
      rw [D.centres_partition]
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hw
        simpa only [Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap_apply_apply] using ht
      · intro hz
        exact ⟨Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap z,
          ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩,
          Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap_apply_apply z⟩
    fullBase_only_bothTrivial := by
      intro i hi
      change (D.nonColumnPlate i).base = Set.univ at hi
      exact (hproper i hi).elim }
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.coordinateSwap_image_preimage_im
statement:
private theorem coordinateSwap_image_preimage_im
    (Y : Set ℝ) :
    coordinateSwap '' (Complex.im ⁻¹' Y) = Complex.re ⁻¹' Y
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact hw
  · intro hz
    refine ⟨coordinateSwap z, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hz
    · exact coordinateSwap_apply_apply z

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.bothTrivial_propagation
statement:
private theorem bothTrivial_propagation
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (hP : VerticalPlate K T)
    (hPcentres : hP.centres = T)
    (hSwap : VerticalPlate K.coordinateSwap (coordinateSwap '' T))
    (hSwapCentres : hSwap.centres = coordinateSwap '' T) :
    IsPropagationIrreducible K T hP.centres Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  have hminimal : IsMinimalVerticalSlabSubfamily K T hP.centres :=
    VerticalPlate.minimal hTile hP
  have hSwapTile :
      TilesOn K.coordinateSwap (coordinateSwap '' T) Set.univ := by
    have hswapUniv : coordinateSwap '' (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane) = Set.univ :=
      Set.image_univ.trans coordinateSwap.surjective.range_eq
    simpa [hswapUniv] using
      (tilesOn_coordinateSwap hTile)
  have hSwapMinimal :
      IsMinimalVerticalSlabSubfamily K.coordinateSwap
        (coordinateSwap '' T) (coordinateSwap '' T) := by
    simpa [hSwapCentres] using VerticalPlate.minimal hSwapTile hSwap
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro Q hQnonempty hQsub hQslab
    exact hminimal.2.2.2 Q hQnonempty hQsub hQslab
  · intro _hfull Q hQnonempty hQsub hQslab
    obtain ⟨Y, hYregular, hQsupport⟩ := hQslab
    have hSwapQsupport :
        regularSupport K.coordinateSwap (coordinateSwap '' Q) =
          Complex.re ⁻¹' Y := by
      rw [regularSupport_coordinateSwap, hQsupport,
        coordinateSwap_image_preimage_im]
    have hQsubT : Q ⊆ T := by
      simpa only [hPcentres] using hQsub
    have hSwapQeq : coordinateSwap '' Q = coordinateSwap '' T :=
      hSwapMinimal.2.2.2 (coordinateSwap '' Q)
        (hQnonempty.image coordinateSwap)
        (Set.image_mono hQsubT)
        ⟨Y, hYregular, hSwapQsupport⟩
    have hQeqT : Q = T := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · intro z hz
        have hz' : coordinateSwap z ∈ coordinateSwap '' Q :=
          ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
        rw [hSwapQeq] at hz'
        obtain ⟨t, ht, hzt⟩ := hz'
        have hzt' : z = t := coordinateSwap.injective hzt.symm
        simpa [hzt'] using ht
      · intro z hz
        have hz' : coordinateSwap z ∈ coordinateSwap '' T :=
          ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
        rw [← hSwapQeq] at hz'
        obtain ⟨t, ht, hzt⟩ := hz'
        have hzt' : z = t := coordinateSwap.injective hzt.symm
        simpa [hzt'] using ht
    rw [hPcentres]
    exact hQeqT

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.bothTrivialPlaneCase
statement:
theorem bothTrivialPlaneCase
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (hFLC : HasFLC T)
    (hOriginal : ∃ P : VerticalPlate K T,
      ¬ IsVerticalColumn P ∧ P.centres = T)
    (hSwapped : ∃ P : VerticalPlate K.coordinateSwap (coordinateSwap '' T),
      ¬ IsVerticalColumn P ∧ P.centres = coordinateSwap '' T) :
    ∃ R : TerminalRegion K T,
      R.orientation = Axis.vertical ∧ R.centres = T ∧ R.base = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hPnoncolumn, hPcentres⟩ := hOriginal
  obtain ⟨Pswap, _hPswapNoncolumn, hPswapCentres⟩ := hSwapped
  have hPsupport : P.support = Set.univ := by
    rw [P.support_eq_regularSupport, hPcentres,
      regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) hTile]
  have hPslab : P.support = Complex.re ⁻¹' P.base := by
    exact (VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile P).2
  have hPbase : P.base = Set.univ := by
    apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro x
    have hxSupport : (x : Tiling.Plane) ∈ P.support := by
      rw [hPsupport]
      trivial
    have hxBase : (x : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Complex.re ⁻¹' P.base := by
      rw [← hPslab]
      exact hxSupport
    simpa using hxBase
  have hPprop : IsPropagationIrreducible K T P.centres Set.univ :=
    bothTrivial_propagation hTile P hPcentres Pswap hPswapCentres
  have hPtiles : TilesOn K P.centres (Complex.re ⁻¹' Set.univ) := by
    simpa [Set.preimage_univ, hPcentres] using hTile
  have hPbaseNonnull : MeasureTheory.volume (Set.univ : Set ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    simp
  let R : TerminalRegion K T := {
    orientation := Axis.vertical
    centres := T
    centres_nonempty := by
      rw [← hPcentres]
      exact P.nonempty_supp.image (fun q => q.1)
    centres_subset := Subset.rfl
    selectedRegion := K
    selectedRegion_vertical := by intro; rfl
    selectedRegion_horizontal := by intro h; cases h
    selectedAmbientCentres := T
    selectedAmbientCentres_vertical := by intro; rfl
    selectedAmbientCentres_horizontal := by intro h; cases h
    selectedCentres := T
    selectedCentres_vertical := by intro; rfl
    selectedCentres_horizontal := by intro h; cases h
    plate := P
    selectedCentres_eq_plate := hPcentres.symm
    plate_noncolumn := hPnoncolumn
    base := Set.univ
    base_open := isOpen_univ
    base_regular := by simp
    base_nonnull := hPbaseNonnull
    support_eq := by
      rw [← hPcentres, ← P.support_eq_regularSupport]
      rw [hPsupport]
      simp
    tiles := by simpa [Set.preimage_univ] using hTile
    flc := hFLC
    selected_flc := hFLC
    supportPeriod := 1
    supportPeriod_pos := by norm_num
    support_periodic := by simp
    propagationIrreducible := by
      simpa only [hPcentres] using hPprop }
  refine ⟨R, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.plate_eq_of_full_centres
statement:
private theorem plate_eq_of_full_centres
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    {P : VerticalPlate K T} (hPcentres : P.centres = T)
    (Q : VerticalPlate K T) : P = Q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Q.nonempty_supp
  have hqT : q.1 ∈ T := q.2
  have hqP : q.1 ∈ P.centres := by
    rw [hPcentres]
    exact hqT
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpq⟩ := hqP
  have hqp : q = p := Subtype.ext hpq.symm
  have hqPcomp : q ∈ P.supp := by
    rw [hqp]
    exact hp
  have hQeq : (verticalPlateGraph K T).connectedComponentMk q = Q :=
    (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff Q q).mp hq
  have hPeq : (verticalPlateGraph K T).connectedComponentMk q = P :=
    (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff P q).mp hqPcomp
  exact hPeq.symm.trans hQeq

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.bothTrivialPlane_decomposition
statement:
private theorem bothTrivialPlane_decomposition
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (X : PeriodicVerticalCarrier)
    (hX : X.base = Set.univ)
    (hTile : TilesOn K T X.carrier)
    (hFLC : HasFLC T)
    (hOriginal : ∃ P : VerticalPlate K T,
      ¬ IsVerticalColumn P ∧ P.centres = T)
    (hSwapped : ∃ P : VerticalPlate K.coordinateSwap (coordinateSwap '' T),
      ¬ IsVerticalColumn P ∧ P.centres = coordinateSwap '' T) :
    ∃ D : TerminalRegionDecomposition K T X,
      D.orientation = Axis.vertical ∧
      D.slabs.numberOfNonColumnPlates = 1 ∧
      D.columnCentres = ∅ ∧
      ∀ i, (D.region i).centres = T ∧ (D.region i).base = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  have hTilePlane : TilesOn K T Set.univ := by
    simpa [PeriodicVerticalCarrier.carrier, hX] using hTile
  obtain ⟨P, hPnoncolumn, hPcentres⟩ := hOriginal
  have hPsupport : P.support = Set.univ := by
    rw [P.support_eq_regularSupport, hPcentres,
      regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) hTilePlane]
  obtain ⟨R, hRorientation, hRcentres, hRbase⟩ :=
    bothTrivialPlaneCase hTilePlane hFLC ⟨P, hPnoncolumn, hPcentres⟩ hSwapped
  have hRplateMinimal :
      IsMinimalVerticalSlabSubfamily K T P.centres := by
    exact VerticalPlate.minimal hTilePlane P
  have hRplateEq : ∀ Q : VerticalPlate K T, P = Q := by
    intro Q
    exact plate_eq_of_full_centres hPcentres Q
  have hColumnEmpty : Continuous.verticalColumnCentres K T = ∅ := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rw [Continuous.verticalColumnCentres, Set.mem_iUnion] at hz
      obtain ⟨Q, _hQz⟩ := hz
      have hPQ : P = Q.1 := plate_eq_of_full_centres hPcentres Q.1
      exact (hPnoncolumn (hPQ ▸ Q.2)).elim
    · intro hz
      exact hz.elim
  have hregEmpty : regularSupport K (∅ : Set Tiling.Plane) = ∅ := by
    simp [regularSupport, Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion]
  have iUnion_fin_one (A : Set Tiling.Plane) :
      (⋃ _ : Fin 1, A) = A := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      exact hi
    · intro hx
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, hx⟩
  have iUnion_fin_one_univ :
      (⋃ _ : Fin 1, (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane)) = Set.univ :=
    iUnion_fin_one Set.univ
  let slabs : PeriodicCarrierSlabDecomposition K T X := {
    source_tiles := hTile
    numberOfNonColumnPlates := 1
    nonColumnPlate := fun _ => P
    nonColumnPlate_noncolumn := fun _ => hPnoncolumn
    nonColumnPlate_injective := by
      intro i j _
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    nonColumnPlate_complete := by
      intro Q hQ
      refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      exact hRplateEq Q
    columnCentres := ∅
    columnCentres_eq := by
      exact hColumnEmpty.symm
    centres_partition := by
      change ∅ ∪ ⋃ _ : Fin 1, P.centres = T
      rw [iUnion_fin_one, empty_union, hPcentres]
    nonColumnCentres_pairwise := by
      intro i _ j _ hij
      exact (hij (Subsingleton.elim _ _)).elim
    column_nonColumn_disjoint := by simp
    commonSupportPeriod := R.supportPeriod
    commonSupportPeriod_pos := R.supportPeriod_pos
    nonColumnSupport_periodic := by
      intro i
      rw [hPsupport]
      intro z
      simp
    columnBase := ∅
    columnBase_regular := by simp
    columnSupport_eq := by
      rw [hregEmpty]
      simp
    columnSupport_periodic := by
      rw [hregEmpty]
      intro z
      simp
    nonColumnSupports_pairwise := by
      intro i _ j _ hij
      exact (hij (Subsingleton.elim _ _)).elim
    column_nonColumnSupport_disjoint := by
      rw [hregEmpty]
      simp
    supports_cover := by
      rw [hregEmpty]
      change interior (closure (∅ ∪ ⋃ _ : Fin 1, P.support)) = X.carrier
      rw [iUnion_fin_one, hPsupport]
      simp [PeriodicVerticalCarrier.carrier, hX]
    nonColumn_minimal := by
      intro i
      simpa only [show (fun _ : Fin 1 => P.centres) i = P.centres by rfl]
        using hRplateMinimal
    columnAxes := ∅
    columnFibre := fun _ => ∅
    columnCentres_formula := by simp
    columnInterface := by
      intro h
      rcases h with ⟨x, hx⟩
      exact hx.elim
    }
  let D : TerminalRegionDecomposition K T X := {
    orientation := Axis.vertical
    selectedRegion := K
    selectedRegion_vertical := by intro; rfl
    selectedRegion_horizontal := by intro h; cases h
    selectedCentres := T
    selectedCentres_vertical := by intro; rfl
    selectedCentres_horizontal := by intro h; cases h
    selectedCarrier := X
    selectedCarrier_vertical := by intro; rfl
    selectedCarrier_horizontal := by intro h; cases h
    selected_tiles := hTile
    selected_flc := hFLC
    slabs := slabs
    region := fun _ => R
    region_orientation := by intro; exact hRorientation
    region_selectedRegion := by intro; exact R.selectedRegion_vertical hRorientation
    region_selectedAmbientCentres := by intro; exact R.selectedAmbientCentres_vertical hRorientation
    region_selectedCentres := by
      intro i
      exact (R.selectedCentres_vertical hRorientation).trans
        (hRcentres.trans hPcentres.symm)
    region_period := by intro; rfl
    columnCentres := ∅
    selectedColumnCentres := ∅
    selectedColumnCentres_vertical := by intro; rfl
    selectedColumnCentres_horizontal := by intro h; cases h
    selectedColumnCentres_eq_slabs := rfl
    column_flc := hFLC.subset (Set.empty_subset T)
    selectedColumn_flc := hFLC.subset (Set.empty_subset T)
    parts_pairwise := by
      intro i _ j _ hij
      exact (hij (Subsingleton.elim _ _)).elim
    column_region_disjoint := by simp
    parts_union := by
      change ∅ ∪ ⋃ _ : Fin 1, R.centres = T
      rw [iUnion_fin_one, empty_union, hRcentres]
    fullBase_only_bothTrivial := by
      intro i hi
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl, hRcentres⟩ }
  refine ⟨D, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · intro i
    exact ⟨hRcentres, hRbase⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.terminalOrientation_fourCases
statement:
private theorem terminalOrientation_fourCases
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (X : PeriodicVerticalCarrier)
    (_hTile : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T X.carrier) :
    X.base ≠ Set.univ ∨
    (X.base = Set.univ ∧
      ¬ ∃ P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
        ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧ P.centres = T) ∨
    (X.base = Set.univ ∧
      (∃ P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
        ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧ P.centres = T) ∧
      ¬ ∃ P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate
          K.coordinateSwap (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T),
        ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧
          P.centres = Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T) ∨
    (X.base = Set.univ ∧
      (∃ P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
        ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧ P.centres = T) ∧
      (∃ P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate
          K.coordinateSwap (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T),
        ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧
          P.centres = Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hX : X.base = Set.univ
  · by_cases hP : ∃ P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
        ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧ P.centres = T
    · by_cases hPswap : ∃ P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate
          K.coordinateSwap (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T),
          ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧
            P.centres = Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hX, hP, hPswap⟩))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hX, hP, hPswap⟩))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hX, hP⟩)
  · exact Or.inl hX

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_terminalRegionDecomposition
statement:
theorem exists_terminalRegionDecomposition
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (X : PeriodicVerticalCarrier)
    (hTile : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T X.carrier)
    (hFLC : Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC T) :
    Nonempty (TerminalRegionDecomposition K T X)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases terminalOrientation_fourCases X hTile with
    hProper | ⟨hWhole, hNoFull⟩ | ⟨hWhole, hFull, hNoSwapFull⟩ |
    ⟨hWhole, hFull, hSwapFull⟩
  · let D := Classical.choice
      (exists_periodicCarrierSlabDecomposition X hTile (Or.inl hProper))
    have hproper : ∀ i, (D.nonColumnPlate i).base ≠ Set.univ :=
      properCarrier_nonColumnBase_ne_univ D hProper
    obtain ⟨R, _, _, _⟩ :=
      verticalSlabs_to_terminalDecomposition X hFLC D hproper
    exact ⟨R⟩
  · have hTilePlane : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T Set.univ := by
      simpa [PeriodicVerticalCarrier.carrier, hWhole] using hTile
    let D := Classical.choice
      (exists_periodicCarrierSlabDecomposition X hTile (Or.inr hFLC))
    have hproper : ∀ i, (D.nonColumnPlate i).base ≠ Set.univ := by
      intro i
      exact nontrivialPlanePlate_hasProperBase hTilePlane hNoFull (D.nonColumnPlate i)
        (D.nonColumnPlate_noncolumn i)
    obtain ⟨R, _, _, _⟩ :=
      verticalSlabs_to_terminalDecomposition X hFLC D hproper
    exact ⟨R⟩
  · have hTilePlane : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T Set.univ := by
      simpa [PeriodicVerticalCarrier.carrier, hWhole] using hTile
    have hSwapTile :
        Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K.coordinateSwap
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T) Set.univ := by
      have hswapUniv :
          Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane) = Set.univ :=
        Set.image_univ.trans Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap.surjective.range_eq
      simpa [hswapUniv] using
        Tiling.AxisParallel.tilesOn_coordinateSwap hTilePlane
    let Xswap : PeriodicVerticalCarrier := {
      base := Set.univ
      base_open := isOpen_univ
      base_regular := by simp
      base_nonnull := by simp
      period := 1
      period_pos := by norm_num
      base_periodic := by simp }
    have hFLCswap : Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.coordinateSwap '' T) :=
      hasFLC_coordinateSwap hFLC
    let D := Classical.choice
      (exists_periodicCarrierSlabDecomposition Xswap hSwapTile (Or.inr hFLCswap))
    have hproper : ∀ i, (D.nonColumnPlate i).base ≠ Set.univ := by
      intro i
      exact nontrivialPlanePlate_hasProperBase hSwapTile hNoSwapFull
        (D.nonColumnPlate i) (D.nonColumnPlate_noncolumn i)
    obtain ⟨R, _, _, _⟩ :=
      horizontalSlabs_to_terminalDecomposition X Xswap hWhole
        ⟨rfl, by simp [Xswap, PeriodicVerticalCarrier.carrier]⟩ hFLC D hproper
    exact ⟨R⟩
  · obtain ⟨D, _, _, _, _⟩ :=
      bothTrivialPlane_decomposition X hWhole hTile hFLC hFull hSwapFull
    exact ⟨D⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_positive_common_multiple
statement:
private theorem exists_positive_common_multiple
    {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hcomm : ∃ q : ℚ, y = (q : ℝ) * x) :
    ∃ m n : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ 0 < n ∧ (m : ℝ) * x = (n : ℝ) * y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hcomm
  have hqreal : 0 < (q : ℝ) := (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right hx).mp hy
  have hq : 0 < q := Rat.cast_pos.mp hqreal
  let m : ℕ := q.num.natAbs
  let n : ℕ := q.den
  have hnum : 0 < q.num := Rat.num_pos.mpr hq
  have hm : 0 < m := by
    simpa only [m, Int.natAbs_pos] using hnum.ne'
  have hn : 0 < n := q.pos
  refine ⟨m, n, hm, hn, ?_⟩
  dsimp only [m, n]
  have hcast : (q.num.natAbs : ℝ) = (q.num : ℝ) := by
    simp only [Nat.cast_natAbs, Int.cast_abs,
      abs_of_pos (Int.cast_pos.mpr hnum)]
  rw [hcast, Rat.cast_def]
  field_simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.triangularPlanarLattice_toAddSubgroup
statement:
private theorem triangularPlanarLattice_toAddSubgroup
    (alpha beta shear : ℝ) (halpha : 0 < alpha) (hbeta : 0 < beta) :
    (triangularPlanarLattice alpha beta shear halpha hbeta).toAddSubgroup =
      triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.PlanarLattice.toAddSubgroup,
      Tiling.Polygonal.PlanarLattice.toAddSubgroup, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
    rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change ![verticalPeriodVector alpha, skewPeriodVector beta shear] i ∈
      triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear
    fin_cases i
    · exact ⟨1, 0, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨0, 1, by simp⟩
  · intro x hx
    rcases hx with ⟨m, n, rfl⟩
    apply add_mem
    · apply AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ?_) m
      exact ⟨0, by simp [triangularPlanarLattice]⟩
    · apply AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ?_) n
      exact ⟨1, by simp [triangularPlanarLattice]⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.triangularPeriodSubgroup_mem_iff
statement:
theorem triangularPeriodSubgroup_mem_iff
    {alpha beta shear : ℝ} {v : Tiling.Plane} :
    v ∈ triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear ↔
      ∃ m n : ℤ,
        v = m • verticalPeriodVector alpha +
          n • skewPeriodVector beta shear
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_freeShear_commonSublattice
statement:
theorem exists_freeShear_commonSublattice
    {Lambda : Tiling.AxisParallel.PlanarLattice}
    (F : VerticalSlabLatticeForm Lambda)
    {alphaColumn betaColumn : ℝ}
    (halphaColumn : 0 < alphaColumn) (hbetaColumn : 0 < betaColumn)
    (hvertical : ∃ q : ℚ,
      alphaColumn = (q : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod)
    (hhorizontal : ∃ q : ℚ,
      betaColumn = (q : ℝ) * F.horizontalPeriod) :
    ∃ (shear : ℝ) (common : Tiling.AxisParallel.PlanarLattice),
      0 < shear ∧
      common.toAddSubgroup ≤ Lambda.toAddSubgroup ∧
      common.toAddSubgroup ≤
        triangularPeriodSubgroup alphaColumn betaColumn shear
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨mv, nv, hmv, hnv, hvcommon⟩ :=
    exists_positive_common_multiple F.verticalPeriod_pos halphaColumn hvertical
  obtain ⟨mh, nh, hmh, hnh, hhcommon⟩ :=
    exists_positive_common_multiple F.horizontalPeriod_pos hbetaColumn hhorizontal
  obtain ⟨j : ℕ, hj⟩ :=
    exists_nat_gt (-((mh : ℝ) * F.shear) / F.verticalPeriod)
  have hnumerator :
      0 < (mh : ℝ) * F.shear + (j : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod := by
    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hj F.verticalPeriod_pos
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ F.verticalPeriod_pos.ne'] at hmul
    nlinarith
  let shear : ℝ :=
    ((mh : ℝ) * F.shear + (j : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod) / (nh : ℝ)
  have hshear : 0 < shear :=
    div_pos hnumerator (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hnh)
  have hcommonVertical : 0 < (mv : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod :=
    mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hmv) F.verticalPeriod_pos
  have hcommonHorizontal : 0 < (mh : ℝ) * F.horizontalPeriod :=
    mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hmh) F.horizontalPeriod_pos
  let common := triangularPlanarLattice
    ((mv : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod)
    ((mh : ℝ) * F.horizontalPeriod)
    ((mh : ℝ) * F.shear + (j : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod)
    hcommonVertical hcommonHorizontal
  refine ⟨shear, common, hshear, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [show common.toAddSubgroup =
        triangularPeriodSubgroup
          ((mv : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod)
          ((mh : ℝ) * F.horizontalPeriod)
          ((mh : ℝ) * F.shear + (j : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod) by
      exact triangularPlanarLattice_toAddSubgroup _ _ _ _ _]
    have hV : verticalPeriodVector ((mv : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod) ∈
        Lambda.toAddSubgroup := by
      rw [F.subgroup_eq]
      have heq : verticalPeriodVector ((mv : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod) =
          (mv : ℤ) • verticalPeriodVector F.verticalPeriod := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> norm_num [verticalPeriodVector]
      rw [heq]
      exact AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _
        (show verticalPeriodVector F.verticalPeriod ∈
          triangularPeriodSubgroup F.verticalPeriod F.horizontalPeriod F.shear from
          ⟨1, 0, by simp⟩) (mv : ℤ)
    have hH : skewPeriodVector
        ((mh : ℝ) * F.horizontalPeriod)
        ((mh : ℝ) * F.shear + (j : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod) ∈
        Lambda.toAddSubgroup := by
      rw [F.subgroup_eq]
      have hvbase : verticalPeriodVector F.verticalPeriod ∈
          triangularPeriodSubgroup F.verticalPeriod F.horizontalPeriod F.shear :=
        ⟨1, 0, by simp⟩
      have hhbase : skewPeriodVector F.horizontalPeriod F.shear ∈
          triangularPeriodSubgroup F.verticalPeriod F.horizontalPeriod F.shear :=
        ⟨0, 1, by simp⟩
      have heq : skewPeriodVector
          ((mh : ℝ) * F.horizontalPeriod)
          ((mh : ℝ) * F.shear + (j : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod) =
          (mh : ℤ) • skewPeriodVector F.horizontalPeriod F.shear +
            (j : ℤ) • verticalPeriodVector F.verticalPeriod := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> norm_num [verticalPeriodVector, skewPeriodVector]
      rw [heq]
      exact AddSubgroup.add_mem _
        (AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ hhbase (mh : ℤ))
        (AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ hvbase (j : ℤ))
    rintro x ⟨p, q, rfl⟩
    exact AddSubgroup.add_mem _
      (AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ hV p) (AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ hH q)
  · rw [show common.toAddSubgroup =
        triangularPeriodSubgroup
          ((mv : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod)
          ((mh : ℝ) * F.horizontalPeriod)
          ((mh : ℝ) * F.shear + (j : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod) by
      exact triangularPlanarLattice_toAddSubgroup _ _ _ _ _]
    have hV : verticalPeriodVector ((mv : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod) ∈
        triangularPeriodSubgroup alphaColumn betaColumn shear := by
      have hveq : verticalPeriodVector ((mv : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod) =
          (nv : ℤ) • verticalPeriodVector alphaColumn := by
        apply Complex.ext
        · norm_num [verticalPeriodVector]
        · norm_num [verticalPeriodVector] at hvcommon ⊢
          exact hvcommon
      rw [hveq]
      exact AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _
        (show verticalPeriodVector alphaColumn ∈
          triangularPeriodSubgroup alphaColumn betaColumn shear from
          ⟨1, 0, by simp⟩) (nv : ℤ)
    have hH : skewPeriodVector
        ((mh : ℝ) * F.horizontalPeriod)
        ((mh : ℝ) * F.shear + (j : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod) ∈
        triangularPeriodSubgroup alphaColumn betaColumn shear := by
      have hheq : skewPeriodVector
          ((mh : ℝ) * F.horizontalPeriod)
          ((mh : ℝ) * F.shear + (j : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod) =
          (nh : ℤ) • skewPeriodVector betaColumn shear := by
        have hshearEq : (nh : ℝ) * shear =
            (mh : ℝ) * F.shear + (j : ℝ) * F.verticalPeriod := by
          dsimp only [shear]
          field_simp
        apply Complex.ext
        · norm_num [skewPeriodVector] at hhcommon ⊢
          exact hhcommon
        · norm_num [skewPeriodVector] at hshearEq ⊢
          exact hshearEq.symm
      rw [hheq]
      exact AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _
        (show skewPeriodVector betaColumn shear ∈
          triangularPeriodSubgroup alphaColumn betaColumn shear from
          ⟨0, 1, by simp⟩) (nh : ℤ)
    rintro x ⟨p, q, rfl⟩
    exact AddSubgroup.add_mem _
      (AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ hV p) (AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ hH q)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.ae_comp_re
statement:
private theorem ae_comp_re {p : ℝ → Prop} (h : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, p x) :
    ∀ᵐ z : Tiling.Plane ∂volume, p z.re
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ × ℝ ∂volume, p z.1 :=
    Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae h
  have hc := Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hp
  simpa only [Complex.measurableEquivRealProd_apply] using hc

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.ae_eq_cylinder
statement:
private theorem ae_eq_cylinder {X Y : Set ℝ} (h : X =ᵐ[volume] Y) :
    {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X} =ᵐ[volume] {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ Y}
proof:
:=
  ae_comp_re h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.tilesOn_finite_iUnion_of_aePartition
proof:
:= by
  have hcount : (⋃ i, S i).Countable := Set.countable_iUnion fun i => (hTile i).1
  have hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements (⋃ i, S i)) := by
    rw [isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint]
    intro s hs t ht hst
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hs ht
    obtain ⟨i, hsi⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨j, htj⟩ := ht
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      exact (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K (S i)).mp (hTile i).2.1 hsi htj hst
    · change Disjoint (s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (t +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hxs hxt
      have haeBase : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume, r ∉ X i ∩ X j :=
        measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp (hDisjoint i j hij)
      have haeNot : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume,
          z ∉ (s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ (t +ᵥ K.openCarrier) := by
        filter_upwards [(hTile i).2.2, (hTile j).2.2,
          ae_comp_re haeBase]
          with z hxi hxj hd
        intro hz
        have hi : z.re ∈ X i := hxi.mpr ⟨⟨s, hsi⟩, hz.1⟩
        have hj : z.re ∈ X j := hxj.mpr ⟨⟨t, htj⟩, hz.2⟩
        exact hd ⟨hi, hj⟩
      have hzero : volume
          ((s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ (t +ᵥ K.openCarrier)) = 0 :=
        measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr haeNot
      have hpos := ((isOpen_interior.vadd s).inter
        (isOpen_interior.vadd t)).measure_pos volume ⟨x, hxs, hxt⟩
      change 0 < volume ((s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ (t +ᵥ K.openCarrier)) at hpos
      rw [hzero] at hpos
      exact (lt_irrefl 0 hpos).elim
  refine ⟨hcount, hpacking, ?_⟩
  have hAll : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ∀ i, (x ∈ {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X i} ↔
      ∃ s : S i, x ∈ (s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr fun i => (hTile i).2.2
  filter_upwards [ae_eq_cylinder hCover, hAll] with x hxY hx
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have hu : x.re ∈ ⋃ i, X i := (iff_of_eq hxY.symm).mp hy
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hu
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hu
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (hx i).mp hxi
    exact ⟨⟨s, Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem i s.2⟩, hs⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hsi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp s.2
    have hu : x.re ∈ ⋃ i, X i :=
      Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem i ((hx i).mpr ⟨⟨s.1, hsi⟩, hs⟩)
    exact (iff_of_eq hxY).mp hu

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.iUnion_periodGroup_of_common_subgroup
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [periodGroup_isAddSubgroup]
  rw [Set.vadd_set_iUnion]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact (periodGroup_isAddSubgroup (S i) v).mp (h i hv)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.rational_commensurable_symm
statement:
theorem rational_commensurable_symm
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (h : ∃ q : ℚ, a = (q : ℝ) * b) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, b = (q : ℝ) * a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := h
  have hq : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hq
    simp [hq] at ha
  refine ⟨q⁻¹, ?_⟩
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.tilesOn_congr_cylinder_ae
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.1, h.2.1, by
    filter_upwards [h.2.2, ae_eq_cylinder hXY] with z hz hzy
    exact (iff_of_eq hzy.symm).trans hz ⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.triangular_periods
statement:
private theorem triangular_periods
    {S : Set Tiling.Plane} {alpha beta shear : ℝ}
    (hv : verticalPeriodVector alpha ∈ periodGroup S)
    (hh : skewPeriodVector beta shear ∈ periodGroup S) :
    triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear ≤ periodGroup S
proof:
:= by
  rintro v ⟨m, n, rfl⟩
  exact AddSubgroup.add_mem _ (AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ hv m)
    (AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ hh n)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.tilesOn_union
proof:
:= by
  let SS : Fin 2 → Set Tiling.Plane := ![S, T]
  let XX : Fin 2 → Set ℝ := ![X, Z]
  have ht : ∀ i, TilesOn K (SS i) {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ XX i} := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> assumption
  have hd : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → AEDisjoint volume (XX i) (XX j) := by
    intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
    · exact hdis
    · exact hdis.symm
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
  have hXX : (⋃ i, XX i) = Set.union X Z := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro hx
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx
      fin_cases i
      · exact Or.inl hi
      · exact Or.inr hi
    · rintro (hx | hx)
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem 0 hx
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem 1 hx
  have hSS : (⋃ i, SS i) = Set.union S T := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro hx
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx
      fin_cases i
      · exact Or.inl hi
      · exact Or.inr hi
    · rintro (hx | hx)
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem 0 hx
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem 1 hx
  have hc : (⋃ i, XX i) =ᵐ[volume] Y := hXX ▸ hcover
  rw [show S ∪ T = ⋃ i, SS i from hSS.symm]
  exact tilesOn_finite_iUnion_of_aePartition ht hd hc

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.periodicAssembly_empty
statement:
theorem periodicAssembly_empty (K : Region) :
    Nonempty (PeriodicAssembly K ∅)
proof:
:= by
  let A : PeriodicAssembly K ∅ := {
    centres := ∅
    tiles := by
      refine ⟨Set.countable_empty, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint]
        intro s hs
        simp at hs
      · filter_upwards [] with x
        simp
    lattice := emptyAssemblyLattice
    lattice_periods := by
      intro v hv
      rw [periodGroup_isAddSubgroup]
      simp }
  exact ⟨A⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_completeCommonPeriodAssembly
proof:
:= by
  let N : Set Tiling.Plane := ⋃ i, D.nonColumnCentres i
  let X : Set ℝ := ⋃ i, D.nonColumnBase i
  by_cases hn : D.numberOfNonColumnPieces = 0
  · by_cases hc : D.column = none
    · have hXempty : X = ∅ := by
        ext x
        simp only [X, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
        rintro ⟨i, -⟩
        exact Fin.elim0 (hn ▸ i)
      have hY : Y =ᵐ[volume] (∅ : Set ℝ) := by
        have h := D.bases_cover.symm
        change Y =ᵐ[volume]
          Set.union X ({x : ℝ | ∃ C, D.column = some C ∧ x ∈ C.base} : Set ℝ) at h
        have hcol : ({x : ℝ | ∃ C, D.column = some C ∧ x ∈ C.base} : Set ℝ) = ∅ := by
          ext x
          simp [hc]
        filter_upwards [h] with x hx
        have he : X.union
            {x : ℝ | ∃ C, D.column = some C ∧ x ∈ C.base} = (∅ : Set ℝ) := by
          rw [hXempty, hcol]
          exact Set.empty_union ∅
        exact hx.trans (congrFun he x)
      obtain ⟨A⟩ := periodicAssembly_empty K
      exact ⟨{ A with tiles := tilesOn_congr_cylinder_ae A.tiles hY.symm }⟩
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hc
      have hXempty : X = ∅ := by
        ext x
        simp only [X, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
        rintro ⟨i, -⟩
        exact Fin.elim0 (hn ▸ i)
      have hcover : C.base =ᵐ[volume] Y := by
        have h := D.bases_cover
        change Set.union X
          ({x : ℝ | ∃ C, D.column = some C ∧ x ∈ C.base} : Set ℝ) =ᵐ[volume] Y at h
        have hcol : ({x : ℝ | ∃ C', D.column = some C' ∧ x ∈ C'.base} : Set ℝ) =
            C.base := by
          ext x
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨C', hC', hx⟩
            have : C' = C := Option.some.inj (hC'.symm.trans hC)
            simpa [this] using hx
          · exact fun hx => ⟨C, hC, hx⟩
        filter_upwards [h] with x hx
        have he : X.union
            {x : ℝ | ∃ C, D.column = some C ∧ x ∈ C.base} = C.base := by
          rw [hXempty, hcol]
          exact Set.empty_union C.base
        exact (congrFun he x).symm.trans hx
      let L := triangularPlanarLattice C.verticalPeriod C.axisPeriod 0
        C.verticalPeriod_pos C.axisPeriod_pos
      refine ⟨{
        centres := C.replacement 0
        tiles := tilesOn_congr_cylinder_ae (C.replacement_tiles 0) hcover
        lattice := L
        lattice_periods := ?_ }⟩
      rw [show L.toAddSubgroup = triangularPeriodSubgroup
          C.verticalPeriod C.axisPeriod 0 by
        exact triangularPlanarLattice_toAddSubgroup _ _ _ _ _]
      exact triangular_periods (C.replacement_verticalPeriod 0)
        (C.replacement_axisPeriod 0)
  · have hnpos : 0 < D.numberOfNonColumnPieces := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
    obtain ⟨Lambda, hLambda⟩ : ∃ Lambda, D.commonNonColumnLattice = some Lambda := by
      exact Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp
        (D.commonNonColumnLattice_isSome_iff.mpr hnpos)
    have hNTiles : TilesOn K N {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X} := by
      apply tilesOn_finite_iUnion_of_aePartition D.nonColumn_tiles
        D.bases_pairwise_aeDisjoint.1
      exact Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl
    have hNperiod : Lambda.toAddSubgroup ≤ periodGroup N := by
      apply iUnion_periodGroup_of_common_subgroup
      intro i
      exact fun v hv => D.nonColumn_periodic i
        (D.commonNonColumnLattice_le Lambda hLambda i hv)
    by_cases hc : D.column = none
    · have hcover : X =ᵐ[volume] Y := by
        have h := D.bases_cover
        change Set.union X
          ({x : ℝ | ∃ C, D.column = some C ∧ x ∈ C.base} : Set ℝ) =ᵐ[volume] Y at h
        have hcol : ({x : ℝ | ∃ C, D.column = some C ∧ x ∈ C.base} : Set ℝ) = ∅ := by
          ext x
          simp [hc]
        filter_upwards [h] with x hx
        have he : X.union
            {x : ℝ | ∃ C, D.column = some C ∧ x ∈ C.base} = X := by
          rw [hcol]
          exact Set.union_empty X
        exact (congrFun he x).symm.trans hx
      exact ⟨{
        centres := N
        tiles := tilesOn_congr_cylinder_ae hNTiles hcover
        lattice := Lambda
        lattice_periods := hNperiod }⟩
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hc
      have hdis : AEDisjoint volume X C.base := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint, iUnion_inter]
        exact measure_iUnion_null fun i => D.bases_pairwise_aeDisjoint.2 C hC i
      obtain ⟨IN, hINbounded, hINpos⟩ := D.mixed_nonColumnBase_positive hnpos hc
      have hXne : volume X ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzero
        have hz : volume (X ∩ IN) = 0 := measure_mono_null inter_subset_left hzero
        rw [hz] at hINpos
        simp at hINpos
      obtain ⟨IC, hICbounded, hICpos⟩ := D.mixed_columnBase_positive hnpos C hC
      have hCne : volume C.base ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzero
        have hz : volume (C.base ∩ IC) = 0 := measure_mono_null inter_subset_left hzero
        rw [hz] at hICpos
        simp at hICpos
      have hXcompl : volume Xᶜ ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzero
        have hae : C.base ≤ᵐ[volume] Xᶜ := by
          filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hdis] with x hx hxc
          exact fun hxX => hx ⟨hxX, hxc⟩
        exact hCne (measure_mono_null_ae hae hzero)
      have hLambdaAE : Lambda.toAddSubgroup ≤
          aePeriodGroup {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X} := by
        intro v hv
        exact slab_aePeriod_iff_re_aePeriod.mpr
          (support_aePeriod_of_centrePeriod
            (MeasurableSet.iUnion D.nonColumnBase_measurable) hNTiles (hNperiod hv))
      obtain ⟨F⟩ := exists_verticalSlabNormalForm
        (MeasurableSet.iUnion D.nonColumnBase_measurable) hXne hXcompl hLambdaAE
      have hhN : skewPeriodVector F.horizontalPeriod F.shear ∈ periodGroup N := by
        apply hNperiod
        rw [F.subgroup_eq]
        exact ⟨0, 1, by simp⟩
      have hhorizontal := disjointPeriodicLineSets_periods_commensurable
        (MeasurableSet.iUnion D.nonColumnBase_measurable) C.base_measurable
        ⟨IN, hINbounded, hINpos⟩ ⟨IC, hICbounded, hICpos⟩ hdis
        F.horizontalPeriod_pos C.axisPeriod_pos
        (by
          simpa [skewPeriodVector] using
            support_aePeriod_of_centrePeriod
              (MeasurableSet.iUnion D.nonColumnBase_measurable) hNTiles
              hhN)
        (by
          simpa [skewPeriodVector] using
            support_aePeriod_of_centrePeriod C.base_measurable
              (C.replacement_tiles 0) (C.replacement_axisPeriod 0))
      have hh' : ∃ q : ℚ, C.axisPeriod = (q : ℝ) * F.horizontalPeriod :=
        rational_commensurable_symm F.horizontalPeriod_pos C.axisPeriod_pos hhorizontal
      obtain ⟨mh, nh, hmh, hnh, hB⟩ := exists_positive_common_multiple
        F.horizontalPeriod_pos C.axisPeriod_pos hh'
      let B := (mh : ℝ) * F.horizontalPeriod
      have hBpos : 0 < B := mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hmh) F.horizontalPeriod_pos
      obtain ⟨R⟩ := D.mixed_rationalization Lambda C hLambda hC F B hBpos
        ⟨mh, hmh, rfl⟩ ⟨nh, hnh, hB⟩
      have hv := verticalPeriods_commensurable_of_rationalMasses R
        F.verticalPeriod_pos C.verticalPeriod_pos
      have hv' := rational_commensurable_symm F.verticalPeriod_pos
        C.verticalPeriod_pos hv
      obtain ⟨shear, common, _hshear, hcommonN, hcommonC⟩ :=
        exists_freeShear_commonSublattice F C.verticalPeriod_pos C.axisPeriod_pos hv' hh'
      have hcover : Set.union X C.base =ᵐ[volume] Y := by
        have h := D.bases_cover
        change Set.union X
          ({x : ℝ | ∃ C, D.column = some C ∧ x ∈ C.base} : Set ℝ) =ᵐ[volume] Y at h
        filter_upwards [h] with x hx
        simpa [hC] using hx
      refine ⟨{
        centres := N ∪ C.replacement shear
        tiles := tilesOn_union hNTiles (C.replacement_tiles shear) hdis hcover
        lattice := common
        lattice_periods := ?_ }⟩
      intro v hvv
      rw [periodGroup_isAddSubgroup, Set.vadd_set_union]
      congr 1
      · exact (periodGroup_isAddSubgroup N v).mp (hNperiod (hcommonN hvv))
      · exact (periodGroup_isAddSubgroup (C.replacement shear) v).mp
          (triangular_periods (C.replacement_verticalPeriod shear)
            (C.replacement_axisPeriod shear) (hcommonC hvv))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.LocalPackingCompactness.uniformSeparation_of_packings
statement:
private theorem uniformSeparation_of_packings (K : Region) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ S : Set Tiling.Plane,
      Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S) → IsUniformlySeparated δ S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hsep⟩ := exists_packingSeparation K
  exact ⟨δ, hδ, hsep⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.LocalPackingCompactness.contributingCentres_bounded
statement:
private theorem contributingCentres_bounded (K : Region) (Q : Set Tiling.Plane)
    (hQ : Bornology.IsBounded Q) :
    ∃ Q' : Set Tiling.Plane, Bornology.IsBounded Q' ∧
      ∀ (S : Set Tiling.Plane) (s : Tiling.Plane),
        s ∈ S → volume ((s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ Q) ≠ 0 → s ∈ Q'
proof:
:= by
  let Q' : Set Tiling.Plane := Q - K.support
  refine ⟨Q', hQ.sub (K.isPolygonal.isCompact.isBounded), ?_⟩
  intro S s _hs hvolume
  have hne : ((s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ Q).Nonempty := by
    exact nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr fun hempty ↦ hvolume (hempty ▸ measure_empty)
  obtain ⟨z, hzTile, hzQ⟩ := hne
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hzTile
  have hzTile' : z - s ∈ K.openCarrier := by
    simpa only [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hzTile
  refine ⟨z, hzQ, z - s, interior_subset hzTile', ?_⟩
  abel_nf

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.LocalPackingCompactness.locallyFell_eventually_exists_mem_ball
statement:
private theorem locallyFell_eventually_exists_mem_ball
    {S : ℕ → Set Tiling.Plane} {L : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hconv : LocallyFellConverges S L) {x : Tiling.Plane} (hx : x ∈ L)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∃ y ∈ S n, dist y x < ε
proof:
:= by
  rcases hconv with ⟨hS, hL, hconv⟩
  let U : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
    (fun y : Tiling.Plane ↦ (y : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) '' Metric.ball x ε
  have hUopen : IsOpen U := OnePoint.isOpen_image_coe.mpr Metric.isOpen_ball
  let V : Set (TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) :=
    {Q | ((Q : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ∩ U).Nonempty}
  have hVopen : IsOpen V :=
    TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen hUopen
  have hlimit : fellCompactification L hL ∈ V := by
    refine ⟨(x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane), ?_, ⟨x, ?_, rfl⟩⟩
    · simp [fellCompactification, Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification, hx]
    · exact Metric.mem_ball_self hε
  filter_upwards [hconv (hVopen.mem_nhds hlimit)] with n hn
  rcases hn with ⟨w, hwQ, hwU⟩
  rcases hwU with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨y, ?_, Metric.mem_ball.mp hy⟩
  simpa [fellCompactification, Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification] using hwQ

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.LocalPackingCompactness.locallyFell_eventually_disjoint_compact
statement:
private theorem locallyFell_eventually_disjoint_compact
    {S : ℕ → Set Tiling.Plane} {L C : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hconv : LocallyFellConverges S L) (hC : IsCompact C)
    (hLC : Disjoint L C) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, Disjoint (S n) C
proof:
:= by
  rcases hconv with ⟨hS, hL, hconv⟩
  let C' : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
    (fun x : Tiling.Plane ↦ (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) '' C
  have hC'closed : IsClosed C' := (hC.image OnePoint.continuous_coe).isClosed
  let U : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) := C'ᶜ
  let V : Set (TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) :=
    {Q | (Q : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ⊆ U}
  have hVopen : IsOpen V :=
    TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_subsets_of_isOpen hC'closed.isOpen_compl
  have hlimit : fellCompactification L hL ∈ V := by
    intro z hzQ hzC'
    rcases hzC' with ⟨c, hcC, rfl⟩
    have hcL : c ∈ L := by
      simpa [fellCompactification, Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification] using hzQ
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hLC hcL hcC
  filter_upwards [hconv (hVopen.mem_nhds hlimit)] with n hn
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxS hxC
  have hxQ : (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane) ∈
      (fellCompactification (S n) (hS n) : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) := by
    simp [fellCompactification, Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification, hxS]
  exact hn hxQ ⟨x, hxC, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.LocalPackingCompactness.finite_inter_compact_of_uniformlySeparated
statement:
private theorem finite_inter_compact_of_uniformlySeparated
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) {S C : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hS : IsUniformlySeparated δ S) (hC : IsCompact C) :
    (S ∩ C).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hSclosed : IsClosed S := Metric.isClosed_of_pairwise_le_dist hδ hS
  have hSdiscrete : IsDiscrete S := by
    rw [isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isOpen]
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨Metric.ball x δ, Metric.isOpen_ball, ?_⟩
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hyball, hyS⟩
      have hyx : y = x := by
        by_contra hyx
        exact (not_lt_of_ge (hS hyS hx hyx)) (Metric.mem_ball.mp hyball)
      simp [hyx]
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hδ, hx⟩
  exact (hC.inter_left hSclosed).finite (hSdiscrete.mono inter_subset_left)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.LocalPackingCompactness.fell_matching_on_compact
statement:
private theorem fell_matching_on_compact (K : Region) {δ : ℝ}
    {S : ℕ → Set Tiling.Plane} {L : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hS : ∀ n, IsClosed (S n) ∧ IsUniformlySeparated δ (S n))
    (_hLclosed : IsClosed L) (hLsep : IsUniformlySeparated δ L)
    (hconv : LocallyFellConverges S L)
    (Q Q' : Set Tiling.Plane) (_hQ : IsCompact Q) (hQ' : IsCompact Q')
    (_hcontribL : ∀ s ∈ L, volume ((s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ Q) ≠ 0 → s ∈ Q')
    (hcontribS : ∀ n s, s ∈ S n →
      volume ((s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ Q) ≠ 0 → s ∈ Q') :
    ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ∃ e : ↥(L ∩ Q') ↪ ↥(S n),
      (∀ s, dist (e s).1 s.1 < δ / 3) ∧
      ∀ s, s ∈ S n → volume ((s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ Q) ≠ 0 →
        ∃ a : ↥(L ∩ Q'), (e a).1 = s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hAfinite : (L ∩ Q').Finite :=
    finite_inter_compact_of_uniformlySeparated hδ hLsep hQ'
  let A := ↥(L ∩ Q')
  let _ : Fintype A := hAfinite.fintype
  have hδthird : 0 < δ / 3 := by positivity
  have hforward : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ a : A, ∃! y : ↥(S n), dist y.1 a.1 < δ / 3 := by
    rw [eventually_all]
    intro a
    filter_upwards [locallyFell_eventually_exists_mem_ball hconv a.2.1 hδthird]
      with n hn
    obtain ⟨y, hyS, hya⟩ := hn
    refine ⟨⟨y, hyS⟩, hya, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    apply Subtype.ext
    by_contra hzy
    have hsep := (hS n).2 z.2 hyS hzy
    have htri : dist z.1 y ≤ dist z.1 a.1 + dist a.1 y := dist_triangle _ _ _
    have hza : dist z.1 a.1 < δ / 3 := hz
    have hay : dist a.1 y < δ / 3 := by simpa [dist_comm] using hya
    linarith
  let D : Set Tiling.Plane :=
    Q' ∩ (⋃ a : A, Metric.ball a.1 (δ / 3))ᶜ
  have hDcompact : IsCompact D := by
    apply hQ'.inter_right
    exact isClosed_compl_iff.mpr (isOpen_iUnion fun a ↦ Metric.isOpen_ball)
  have hLD : Disjoint L D := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxL hxD
    have hxA : x ∈ L ∩ Q' := ⟨hxL, hxD.1⟩
    exact hxD.2 (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      ⟨⟨x, hxA⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self hδthird⟩)
  have hmiss : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, Disjoint (S n) D :=
    locallyFell_eventually_disjoint_compact hconv hDcompact hLD
  have hboth := hforward.and hmiss
  rw [eventually_atTop] at hboth
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hboth
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hmatch, havoid⟩ := hN n hn
  let eFn : A → ↥(S n) := fun a ↦ Classical.choose (hmatch a)
  have eFn_spec (a : A) : dist (eFn a).1 a.1 < δ / 3 :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hmatch a)).1
  have eFn_injective : Function.Injective eFn := by
    intro a b hab
    apply Subtype.ext
    by_contra habSource
    have hsep := hLsep a.2.1 b.2.1 habSource
    have htri : dist a.1 b.1 ≤ dist a.1 (eFn a).1 + dist (eFn a).1 b.1 :=
      dist_triangle _ _ _
    have hae : dist a.1 (eFn a).1 < δ / 3 := by
      simpa [dist_comm] using eFn_spec a
    have heb : dist (eFn a).1 b.1 < δ / 3 := by
      rw [hab]
      exact eFn_spec b
    linarith
  let e : A ↪ ↥(S n) := ⟨eFn, eFn_injective⟩
  refine ⟨e, fun a ↦ eFn_spec a, ?_⟩
  intro s hsS hsvolume
  have hsQ' : s ∈ Q' := hcontribS n s hsS hsvolume
  have hsNotD : s ∉ D := fun hsD ↦ Set.disjoint_left.mp havoid hsS hsD
  have hsUnion : s ∈ ⋃ a : A, Metric.ball a.1 (δ / 3) := by
    by_contra hs
    exact hsNotD ⟨hsQ', hs⟩
  obtain ⟨a, hsa⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hsUnion
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  change (eFn a).1 = s
  exact (congrArg Subtype.val ((Classical.choose_spec (hmatch a)).2
    ⟨s, hsS⟩ (Metric.mem_ball.mp hsa))).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.LocalPackingCompactness.indicator_vadd_tendsto_L1
statement:
private theorem indicator_vadd_tendsto_L1 (K : Region)
    {t : ℕ → Tiling.Plane} {a : Tiling.Plane}
    (ht : Tendsto t atTop (nhds a)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ z, |indicator (t n +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
        (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z -
      indicator (a +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z|)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  let f : C(Tiling.Plane, C(Tiling.Plane, Tiling.Plane)) :=
    ContinuousMap.curry ⟨fun p ↦ -p.1 + p.2, by fun_prop⟩
  have hft : Tendsto (fun n ↦ f (t n)) atTop (nhds (f a)) :=
    (f.continuous.tendsto a).comp ht
  have hpres (u : Tiling.Plane) :
      MeasurePreserving (f u) volume volume := by
    change MeasurePreserving (fun z : Tiling.Plane ↦ -u + z) volume volume
    exact measurePreserving_add_left volume (-u)
  have hcarrierMeas : MeasurableSet K.openCarrier := K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.measurableSet
  have hcarrierFinite : volume K.openCarrier ≠ ⊤ := by
    exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top K.isPolygonal.isCompact.measure_lt_top.ne
      (measure_mono interior_subset)
  have hmeasure := tendsto_measure_symmDiff_preimage_nhds_zero hft
    (Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ hpres (t n)) (hpres a)
      hcarrierMeas.nullMeasurableSet hcarrierFinite
  have hreal := (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal ENNReal.zero_ne_top).comp hmeasure
  have hpreimage (u : Tiling.Plane) : f u ⁻¹' K.openCarrier = u +ᵥ K.openCarrier := by
    ext z
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    change -u + z ∈ K.openCarrier ↔ -u +ᵥ z ∈ K.openCarrier
    simp only [vadd_eq_add]
  have hintegral (u : Tiling.Plane) :
      (∫ z, |indicator (u +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z -
        indicator (a +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z|) =
      (volume ((f u ⁻¹' K.openCarrier) ∆ (f a ⁻¹' K.openCarrier))).toReal := by
    rw [hpreimage u, hpreimage a]
    have hmeasU : MeasurableSet (u +ᵥ K.openCarrier) :=
      K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd u |>.measurableSet
    have hmeasA : MeasurableSet (a +ᵥ K.openCarrier) :=
      K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd a |>.measurableSet
    calc
      (∫ z, |indicator (u +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z -
          indicator (a +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z|) =
          ∫ z, indicator ((u +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∆ (a +ᵥ K.openCarrier))
            (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z := by
              apply integral_congr_ae
              filter_upwards [] with z
              by_cases hzu : z ∈ u +ᵥ K.openCarrier <;>
                by_cases hza : z ∈ a +ᵥ K.openCarrier <;>
                simp [hzu, hza, Set.mem_symmDiff]
      _ = volume.real ((u +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∆ (a +ᵥ K.openCarrier)) :=
        integral_indicator_one (hmeasU.symmDiff hmeasA)
      _ = (volume ((u +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∆ (a +ᵥ K.openCarrier))).toReal :=
        measureReal_def volume _
  have hreal' : Tendsto (fun n ↦
      (volume ((f (t n) ⁻¹' K.openCarrier) ∆ (f a ⁻¹' K.openCarrier))).toReal)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using hreal
  simpa only [hintegral] using hreal'

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.LocalPackingCompactness.multiplicity_eq_finite_sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A : Set Tiling.Plane := {s | s ∈ S ∧ z ∈ s +ᵥ K.openCarrier}
  have hAfinite : A.Finite := hfinite.subset fun s hs ↦
    ⟨hs.1, hcontained s hs.1 hs.2⟩
  have hfilter : hfinite.toFinset.filter
      (fun s ↦ z ∈ s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) = hAfinite.toFinset := by
    ext s
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, hfinite.mem_toFinset, hAfinite.mem_toFinset, A,
      Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hsS, _hsQ'⟩, hz⟩
      exact ⟨hsS, hz⟩
    · rintro ⟨hsS, hz⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hsS, hcontained s hsS hz⟩, hz⟩
  calc
    (multiplicity K S z : ℝ) = (hAfinite.toFinset.card : ℝ) := by
      rw [multiplicity, show {s : Tiling.Plane | s ∈ S ∧
        z ∈ s +ᵥ K.openCarrier} = A from rfl,
        Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card A hAfinite]
    _ = ∑ s ∈ hfinite.toFinset, indicator (s +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
        (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z := by
      rw [← hfilter]
      simp only [indicator_apply]
      simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.LocalPackingCompactness.multiplicity_eq_matched_sum_ae
statement:
private theorem multiplicity_eq_matched_sum_ae (K : Region)
    {S Q Q' : Set Tiling.Plane} {A : Type*} [Fintype A]
    (e : A ↪ ↥S) (hfinite : (S ∩ Q').Finite)
    (hcontained : ∀ z ∈ Q, ∀ s ∈ S,
      z ∈ s +ᵥ K.openCarrier → s ∈ Q')
    (hsurj : ∀ s ∈ S, volume ((s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ Q) ≠ 0 →
      ∃ a : A, (e a).1 = s) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, z ∈ Q →
      (multiplicity K S z : ℝ) =
        ∑ a : A, indicator ((e a).1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
          (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hgood : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, ∀ s ∈ hfinite.toFinset,
      z ∈ Q → z ∈ s +ᵥ K.openCarrier →
        volume ((s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ Q) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [eventually_all_finset]
    intro s hs
    by_cases hmeasure : volume ((s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ Q) = 0
    · rw [ae_iff]
      have hset : {z : Tiling.Plane | ¬ (z ∈ Q →
          z ∈ s +ᵥ K.openCarrier →
            volume ((s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ Q) ≠ 0)} =
          (s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ Q := by
        ext z
        simp [hmeasure, and_comm]
      rw [hset, hmeasure]
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ _ _ ↦ hmeasure
  filter_upwards [hgood] with z hz zQ
  let C : Set Tiling.Plane := {s | s ∈ S ∧ z ∈ s +ᵥ K.openCarrier}
  let I : Set A := {a | z ∈ (e a).1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier}
  have hcard : I.ncard = C.ncard := Set.ncard_congr
    (fun a (_ha : a ∈ I) ↦ (e a).1)
    (fun a ha ↦ ⟨(e a).2, ha⟩)
    (fun a b _ _ hab ↦ e.injective (Subtype.ext hab))
    (by
      intro s hs
      have hsQ' : s ∈ Q' := hcontained z zQ s hs.1 hs.2
      have hsFin : s ∈ hfinite.toFinset := hfinite.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨hs.1, hsQ'⟩
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hsurj s hs.1 (hz s hsFin zQ hs.2)
      refine ⟨a, ?_, ha⟩
      change z ∈ (e a).1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier
      rw [ha]
      exact hs.2)
  calc
    (multiplicity K S z : ℝ) = (C.ncard : ℝ) := rfl
    _ = (I.ncard : ℝ) := by rw [hcard]
    _ = ∑ a : A, indicator ((e a).1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
        (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z := by
      rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card I (Set.toFinite I)]
      simp only [I, indicator_apply]
      norm_cast
      rw [Set.Finite.toFinset_ofPred]
      simp only [Pi.one_apply]
      exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_filter
        (fun a : A ↦ z ∈ (e a).1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier) Finset.univ)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.LocalPackingCompactness.locallyFell_multiplicity_tendsto
statement:
private theorem locallyFell_multiplicity_tendsto (K : Region) {δ : ℝ}
    {S : ℕ → Set Tiling.Plane} {L : Set Tiling.Plane} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hS : ∀ n, IsClosed (S n) ∧ IsUniformlySeparated δ (S n))
    (hLclosed : IsClosed L) (hLsep : IsUniformlySeparated δ L)
    (hconv : LocallyFellConverges S L) (Q : Set Tiling.Plane)
    (hQ : IsCompact Q) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ z in Q, |(multiplicity K (S n) z : ℝ) -
      (multiplicity K L z : ℝ)|) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Q' : Set Tiling.Plane := Q - K.support
  have hQ' : IsCompact Q' := by
    simpa [Q', sub_eq_add_neg] using hQ.add K.isPolygonal.isCompact.neg
  have hcontained (z : Tiling.Plane) (hzQ : z ∈ Q) (T : Set Tiling.Plane)
      (s : Tiling.Plane) (_hs : s ∈ T) (hzs : z ∈ s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) :
      s ∈ Q' := by
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hzs
    have hzK : z - s ∈ K.support := by
      have hzs' : z - s ∈ K.openCarrier := by
        simpa only [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hzs
      exact interior_subset hzs'
    refine ⟨z, hzQ, z - s, hzK, ?_⟩
    abel_nf
  have hcontrib (T : Set Tiling.Plane) (s : Tiling.Plane) (hs : s ∈ T)
      (hvol : volume ((s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ Q) ≠ 0) : s ∈ Q' := by
    have hne : ((s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ Q).Nonempty :=
      nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr fun hempty ↦ hvol (hempty ▸ measure_empty)
    obtain ⟨z, hzs, hzQ⟩ := hne
    exact hcontained z hzQ T s hs hzs
  obtain ⟨N, hmatch⟩ := fell_matching_on_compact K hδ hS hLclosed hLsep
    hconv Q Q' hQ hQ' (hcontrib L) (fun n ↦ hcontrib (S n))
  have hAfinite : (L ∩ Q').Finite :=
    finite_inter_compact_of_uniformlySeparated hδ hLsep hQ'
  let A := ↥(L ∩ Q')
  let _ : Fintype A := hAfinite.fintype
  have hN (n : ℕ) : N ≤ n + N := by omega
  let e (n : ℕ) : A ↪ ↥(S (n + N)) := Classical.choose (hmatch (n + N) (hN n))
  have heclose (n : ℕ) (a : A) : dist (e n a).1 a.1 < δ / 3 :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hmatch (n + N) (hN n))).1 a
  have hesurj (n : ℕ) (s : Tiling.Plane) (hs : s ∈ S (n + N))
      (hvol : volume ((s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ Q) ≠ 0) :
      ∃ a : A, (e n a).1 = s :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hmatch (n + N) (hN n))).2 s hs hvol
  have hetend (a : A) : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (e n a).1) atTop (nhds a.1) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    let r : ℝ := min ε (δ / 4)
    have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hε (by positivity)
    have hhit := locallyFell_eventually_exists_mem_ball hconv a.2.1 hr
    rw [eventually_atTop] at hhit
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hhit
    refine ⟨M, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨u, huS, hua⟩ := hM (n + N) (hn.trans (Nat.le_add_right n N))
    have hue : u = (e n a).1 := by
      by_contra hne
      have hsep := (hS (n + N)).2 huS (e n a).2 hne
      have htri : dist u (e n a).1 ≤ dist u a.1 + dist a.1 (e n a).1 :=
        dist_triangle _ _ _
      have hua' : dist u a.1 < δ / 4 := hua.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
      have hae : dist a.1 (e n a).1 < δ / 3 := by
        simpa [dist_comm] using heclose n a
      linarith
    rw [← hue]
    exact hua.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  let eL : A ↪ ↥L :=
    ⟨fun a ↦ ⟨a.1, a.2.1⟩, by
      intro a b hab
      apply Subtype.ext
      simpa using congrArg Subtype.val hab⟩
  have hlimitAE : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, z ∈ Q →
      (multiplicity K L z : ℝ) =
        ∑ a : A, indicator (a.1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
          (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z := by
    have h := multiplicity_eq_matched_sum_ae K eL hAfinite
      (fun z hzQ s hs hzs ↦ hcontained z hzQ L s hs hzs)
      (fun s hs _ ↦ ⟨⟨s, hs, hcontrib L s hs (by assumption)⟩, rfl⟩)
    dsimp [eL] at h
    exact h
  have hseqAE (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, z ∈ Q →
      (multiplicity K (S (n + N)) z : ℝ) =
        ∑ a : A, indicator ((e n a).1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
          (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z := by
    have hfinite : (S (n + N) ∩ Q').Finite :=
      finite_inter_compact_of_uniformlySeparated hδ (hS (n + N)).2 hQ'
    exact multiplicity_eq_matched_sum_ae K (e n) hfinite
      (fun z hzQ s hs hzs ↦ hcontained z hzQ (S (n + N)) s hs hzs)
      (hesurj n)
  have htileIntegrable (u : Tiling.Plane) :
      Integrable (indicator (u +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
        (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ)) := by
    rw [integrable_indicator_iff
      (K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd u).measurableSet]
    exact integrableOn_const
      (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (K.isPolygonal.isCompact.vadd u).measure_lt_top.ne
        (measure_mono (vadd_set_mono interior_subset))) (by simp)
  let g (n : ℕ) (a : A) (z : Tiling.Plane) : ℝ :=
