    |indicator ((e n a).1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z -
      indicator (a.1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z|
  have hgIntegrable (n : ℕ) (a : A) : Integrable (g n a) :=
    (htileIntegrable (e n a).1).sub (htileIntegrable a.1) |>.abs
  have hbound (n : ℕ) :
      ∫ z in Q, |(multiplicity K (S (n + N)) z : ℝ) -
          (multiplicity K L z : ℝ)| ≤
        ∑ a : A, ∫ z, g n a z := by
    calc
      ∫ z in Q, |(multiplicity K (S (n + N)) z : ℝ) -
          (multiplicity K L z : ℝ)| =
          ∫ z in Q, |∑ a : A,
            (indicator ((e n a).1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z -
            indicator (a.1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z)| := by
            apply integral_congr_ae
            filter_upwards [(ae_restrict_iff' hQ.measurableSet).2 (hseqAE n),
              (ae_restrict_iff' hQ.measurableSet).2 hlimitAE] with z hsz hlz
            rw [hsz, hlz, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      _ ≤ ∫ z in Q, ∑ a : A, g n a z := by
        apply setIntegral_mono_ae_restrict
        · exact ((integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun a _ ↦
            (htileIntegrable (e n a).1).sub (htileIntegrable a.1))).norm.integrableOn
        · exact (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun a _ ↦
            hgIntegrable n a).integrableOn
        · exact Eventually.of_forall fun z ↦ Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ = ∑ a : A, ∫ z in Q, g n a z := by
        rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ fun a _ ↦ (hgIntegrable n a).integrableOn]
      _ ≤ ∑ a : A, ∫ z, g n a z := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro a _
        exact setIntegral_le_integral (hgIntegrable n a)
          (Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ abs_nonneg _)
  have hsum : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∑ a : A, ∫ z, g n a z) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [Finset.sum_const_zero] using
      (tendsto_finsetSum Finset.univ fun a _ ↦
        indicator_vadd_tendsto_L1 K (hetend a))
  have hshift : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ z in Q,
      |(multiplicity K (S (n + N)) z : ℝ) - (multiplicity K L z : ℝ)|)
      atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le'
        tendsto_const_nhds hsum
        (Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ integral_nonneg fun _ ↦ abs_nonneg _)
        (Eventually.of_forall hbound)
  exact (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat N).mp hshift

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.LocalPackingCompactness.packing_closed_under_locallyFell
statement:
private theorem packing_closed_under_locallyFell (K : Region) {δ : ℝ}
    {S : ℕ → Set Tiling.Plane} {L : Set Tiling.Plane} (_hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hS : ∀ n, IsClosed (S n) ∧ IsUniformlySeparated δ (S n) ∧
      Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements (S n)))
    (_hLclosed : IsClosed L) (_hLsep : IsUniformlySeparated δ L)
    (hconv : LocallyFellConverges S L) :
    Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint]
  intro s hsL t htL hst
  change Disjoint (s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (t +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxs hxt
  let U : Set Tiling.Plane := {c | x - c ∈ K.openCarrier}
  have hUopen : IsOpen U :=
    K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.preimage (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)
  have hsU : s ∈ U := by
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hxs
    simp only [vadd_eq_add] at hxs
    simpa only [U, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hxs
  have htU : t ∈ U := by
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hxt
    simp only [vadd_eq_add] at hxt
    simpa only [U, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hxt
  obtain ⟨rs, hrs, hrsU⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hUopen.mem_nhds hsU)
  obtain ⟨rt, hrt, hrtU⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hUopen.mem_nhds htU)
  let ε := min rs (min rt (dist s t / 3))
  have hdist : 0 < dist s t := dist_pos.mpr hst
  have hε : 0 < ε := by
    dsimp [ε]
    exact lt_min hrs (lt_min hrt (by positivity))
  have hεrs : ε ≤ rs := min_le_left _ _
  have hεrt : ε ≤ rt := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hεdist : ε ≤ dist s t / 3 :=
    (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hsEventually := locallyFell_eventually_exists_mem_ball hconv hsL hε
  have htEventually := locallyFell_eventually_exists_mem_ball hconv htL hε
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨s', hs'S, hs'dist⟩, ⟨t', ht'S, ht'dist⟩⟩ :=
    (hsEventually.and htEventually).exists
  have hs'U : s' ∈ U := hrsU (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (hs'dist.trans_le hεrs))
  have ht'U : t' ∈ U := hrtU (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (ht'dist.trans_le hεrt))
  have hs't' : s' ≠ t' := by
    intro heq
    subst t'
    have htriangle : dist s t ≤ dist s s' + dist s' t := dist_triangle _ _ _
    rw [dist_comm s s'] at htriangle
    have hsBound : dist s' s < dist s t / 3 := hs'dist.trans_le hεdist
    have htBound : dist s' t < dist s t / 3 := ht'dist.trans_le hεdist
    linarith
  have hdisjoint := (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K (S n)).mp
    (hS n).2.2 hs'S ht'S hs't'
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint
  · rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simpa only [vadd_eq_add, U, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
      using hs'U
  · rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simpa only [vadd_eq_add, U, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
      using ht'U

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.LocalPackingCompactness.multiplicity_discrepancy_integrableOn
statement:
private theorem multiplicity_discrepancy_integrableOn (K : Region) {δ : ℝ}
    {L : Set Tiling.Plane} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hLsep : IsUniformlySeparated δ L)
    (Q : Set Tiling.Plane) (hQ : IsCompact Q) :
    IntegrableOn (fun z => |(multiplicity K L z : ℝ) - 1|) Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Q' : Set Tiling.Plane := Q - K.support
  have hQ' : IsCompact Q' := by
    simpa [Q', sub_eq_add_neg] using hQ.add K.isPolygonal.isCompact.neg
  have hfinite : (L ∩ Q').Finite :=
    finite_inter_compact_of_uniformlySeparated hδ hLsep hQ'
  have hcontained (z : Tiling.Plane) (hzQ : z ∈ Q) (s : Tiling.Plane)
      (hs : s ∈ L) (hzs : z ∈ s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) : s ∈ Q' := by
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hzs
    have hzs' : z - s ∈ K.openCarrier := by
      simpa only [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hzs
    refine ⟨z, hzQ, z - s, interior_subset hzs', ?_⟩
    abel_nf
  let f : Tiling.Plane → ℝ := fun z ↦
    ∑ s ∈ hfinite.toFinset,
      indicator (s +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ) z
  have htileIntegrable (u : Tiling.Plane) :
      Integrable (indicator (u +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
        (1 : Tiling.Plane → ℝ)) := by
    rw [integrable_indicator_iff
      (K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd u).measurableSet]
    exact integrableOn_const
      (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (K.isPolygonal.isCompact.vadd u).measure_lt_top.ne
        (measure_mono (vadd_set_mono interior_subset))) (by simp)
  have hf : Integrable f := by
    exact integrable_finsetSum hfinite.toFinset fun s _ ↦ htileIntegrable s
  have hbase : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ |f z - 1|) Q := by
    exact (hf.integrableOn.sub
      (integrableOn_const hQ.measure_lt_top.ne (by simp))).abs
  apply hbase.congr_fun
  · intro z hzQ
    change |f z - 1| = |(multiplicity K L z : ℝ) - 1|
    rw [multiplicity_eq_finite_sum K hfinite
      (fun s hs hzs ↦ hcontained z hzQ s hs hzs)]
  · exact hQ.measurableSet

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.LocalPackingCompactness.boxCoverage_closed_under_limit
statement:
private theorem boxCoverage_closed_under_limit (K : Region) {δ : ℝ}
    {S : ℕ → Set Tiling.Plane} {L : Set Tiling.Plane} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hLsep : IsUniformlySeparated δ L) (_hconv : LocallyFellConverges S L)
    (N : Nat)
    (hmult : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ z in Metric.closedBall 0 N,
      |(multiplicity K (S n) z : ℝ) - (multiplicity K L z : ℝ)|)
      atTop (nhds 0))
    (hcover : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ z ∂volume,
      z ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 N → multiplicity K (S n) z = 1) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, z ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 N → multiplicity K L z = 1
proof:
:= by
  let Q : Set Tiling.Plane := Metric.closedBall 0 N
  have hQ : IsCompact Q := isCompact_closedBall 0 N
  have hfint : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ |(multiplicity K L z : ℝ) - 1|) Q :=
    multiplicity_discrepancy_integrableOn K hδ hLsep Q hQ
  have heq (n : ℕ) :
      (∫ z in Q, |(multiplicity K (S n) z : ℝ) -
        (multiplicity K L z : ℝ)|) =
      ∫ z in Q, |(multiplicity K L z : ℝ) - 1| := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    have hn : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume.restrict Q, multiplicity K (S n) z = 1 :=
      (ae_restrict_iff' hQ.measurableSet).2 (hcover n)
    filter_upwards [hn] with z hz
    rw [hz]
    rw [abs_sub_comm]
    norm_num
  have htendConst : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦
      ∫ z in Q, |(multiplicity K L z : ℝ) - 1|) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    exact hmult.congr' (Eventually.of_forall heq)
  have hintegral : (∫ z in Q, |(multiplicity K L z : ℝ) - 1|) = 0 :=
    tendsto_nhds_unique tendsto_const_nhds htendConst
  have hfzero : (fun z ↦ |(multiplicity K L z : ℝ) - 1|) =ᵐ[
      volume.restrict Q] 0 :=
    (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
      (fun _ ↦ abs_nonneg _) hfint).mp hintegral
  apply (ae_restrict_iff' hQ.measurableSet).mp
  filter_upwards [hfzero] with z hz
  have : (multiplicity K L z : ℝ) = 1 := by
    have habs : |(multiplicity K L z : ℝ) - 1| = 0 := by simpa using hz
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp habs)
  exact_mod_cast this

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.LocalPackingCompactness.localCoverings_compactness
statement:
theorem localCoverings_compactness (K : Region)
    (hlocal : ∀ N : Nat, 0 < N → ∃ S : Set Tiling.Plane,
      Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S) ∧
      ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, z ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 N → multiplicity K S z = 1) :
    ∃ L : Set Tiling.Plane, TilesOn K L univ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose S hSpacking hScover using fun n : ℕ ↦ hlocal (n + 1) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hseparated⟩ := uniformSeparation_of_packings K
  have hSsep (n : ℕ) : IsUniformlySeparated δ (S n) :=
    hseparated (S n) (hSpacking n)
  have hSclosed (n : ℕ) : IsClosed (S n) :=
    Metric.isClosed_of_pairwise_le_dist hδ (hSsep n)
  obtain ⟨φ, L, hφmono, hLclosed, hLsep, hconv⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.exists_locallyFellConvergent_subsequence
      δ hδ S hSclosed hSsep
  have hlimitPacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements L) :=
    packing_closed_under_locallyFell K hδ
      (fun n ↦ ⟨hSclosed (φ n), hSsep (φ n), hSpacking (φ n)⟩)
      hLclosed hLsep hconv
  have hbox (N : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume,
      z ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 N → multiplicity K L z = 1 := by
    let T : ℕ → Set Tiling.Plane := fun n ↦ S (φ (n + N))
    have hTclosedSep (n : ℕ) :
        IsClosed (T n) ∧ IsUniformlySeparated δ (T n) :=
      ⟨hSclosed _, hSsep _⟩
    have hTconv : LocallyFellConverges T L := by
      rcases hconv with ⟨hclosed, hclosedL, htend⟩
      refine ⟨fun n ↦ hclosed (n + N), hclosedL, ?_⟩
      convert htend.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat N) using 1
      funext n
      apply TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.ext
      rfl
    have hmult : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ z in Metric.closedBall 0 N,
        |(multiplicity K (T n) z : ℝ) - (multiplicity K L z : ℝ)|)
        atTop (nhds 0) :=
      locallyFell_multiplicity_tendsto K hδ hTclosedSep hLclosed hLsep
        hTconv (Metric.closedBall 0 N) (isCompact_closedBall 0 N)
    have hTcover (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume,
        z ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 N → multiplicity K (T n) z = 1 := by
      filter_upwards [hScover (φ (n + N))] with z hz hzN
      apply hz
      have hindices : N ≤ φ (n + N) + 1 := by
        have := hφmono.id_le (n + N)
        dsimp [id] at this
        omega
      exact Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (mod_cast hindices) hzN
    exact boxCoverage_closed_under_limit K hδ hLsep hTconv N hmult hTcover
  have hglobalMultiplicity : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, multiplicity K L z = 1 := by
    have hall : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, ∀ N : ℕ,
        z ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 N → multiplicity K L z = 1 :=
      ae_all_iff.mpr hbox
    filter_upwards [hall] with z hz
    have hzmem : z ∈ ⋃ N : ℕ, Metric.closedBall 0 N := by
      rw [Metric.iUnion_closedBall_nat]
      exact Set.mem_univ z
    obtain ⟨N, hzN⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hzmem
    exact hz N hzN
  refine ⟨L, (tilesOn_iff_multiplicity K L univ).2 ⟨
    (IsPacking.locallyFinite_centres hlimitPacking).2, hlimitPacking, ?_⟩⟩
  filter_upwards [hglobalMultiplicity] with z hz
  simp only [Set.mem_univ, true_iff]
  have hcard : {s : Tiling.Plane | s ∈ L ∧ z ∈ s +ᵥ K.openCarrier}.ncard = 1 := by
    simpa only [multiplicity] using hz
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Set.ncard_eq_one.mp hcard
  have hsMem : s ∈ {t : Tiling.Plane | t ∈ L ∧ z ∈ t +ᵥ K.openCarrier} := by
    rw [hs]
    exact Set.mem_singleton s
  exact ⟨⟨s, hsMem.1⟩, hsMem.2⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.sub_mem_uIcc_iff
statement:
private theorem sub_mem_uIcc_iff (a x p q : ℝ) :
    -a + x ∈ Set.uIcc p q ↔ x ∈ Set.uIcc (a + p) (a + q)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Set.mem_uIcc]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h)
    · left; constructor <;> linarith
    · right; constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro (h | h)
    · left; constructor <;> linarith
    · right; constructor <;> linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.vadd_rectangle
statement:
private theorem vadd_rectangle (a p q : Tiling.Plane) :
    a +ᵥ Complex.Rectangle p q = Complex.Rectangle (a + p) (a + q)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [Complex.Rectangle, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem,
    Complex.mem_reProdIm, vadd_eq_add, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
    Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im, sub_mem_uIcc_iff]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.vaddRegion_openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  change interior (a +ᵥ K.support) = a +ᵥ interior K.support
  rw [interior_vadd]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.vaddRegion_vertices
proof:
:= by
  exact Tiling.vertexSet_vadd a K.support

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.add_vadd_set
statement:
private theorem add_vadd_set (a b : Tiling.Plane) (S : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    a +ᵥ (b +ᵥ S) = (a + b) +ᵥ S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
  constructor <;> intro hx <;> convert hx using 1 <;> abel

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.vadd_neg_vadd_set
statement:
private theorem vadd_neg_vadd_set (a : Tiling.Plane) (S : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    (-a) +ᵥ (a +ᵥ S) = S
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_vadd_set, neg_add_cancel, zero_vadd]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.vaddRegion_neg_vadd
statement:
private theorem vaddRegion_neg_vadd (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region)
    (a : Tiling.Plane) : vaddRegion (vaddRegion K a) (-a) = K
proof:
:= by
  cases K with
  | mk K hK =>
      cases K with
      | mk Ks Kp Kn =>
          simp only [vaddRegion, Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.mk.injEq,
            Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.mk.injEq]
          exact vadd_neg_vadd_set a Ks

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.tilesOn_vadd
statement:
private theorem tilesOn_vadd
    (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region) (S D : Set Tiling.Plane)
    (a b : Tiling.Plane) (h : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K S D) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn (vaddRegion K a) (b +ᵥ S) ((a + b) +ᵥ D)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hset : b +ᵥ S = (fun s : Tiling.Plane ↦ b + s) '' S := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        exact ⟨-b + x, by
          simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using hx,
          by abel_nf⟩
      · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
        simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
          neg_add_cancel_left] using hs
    rw [hset]
    exact h.1.image _
  · intro i hi j hj hij
    let i₀ : Tiling.Placement Tiling.Plane Unit := (-b + i.1, ())
    let j₀ : Tiling.Placement Tiling.Plane Unit := (-b + j.1, ())
    have hi₀ : i₀ ∈ K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S := by
      change -b + i.1 ∈ S
      change i.1 ∈ b +ᵥ S at hi
      simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using hi
    have hj₀ : j₀ ∈ K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S := by
      change -b + j.1 ∈ S
      change j.1 ∈ b +ᵥ S at hj
      simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using hj
    have hij₀ : i₀ ≠ j₀ := by
      intro heq
      apply hij
      apply Prod.ext
      · have := congrArg Prod.fst heq
        dsimp only [i₀, j₀] at this
        linear_combination this
      · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    have hd := h.2.1 hi₀ hj₀ hij₀
    have hd' := Tiling.aedisjoint_vadd (a + b) hd
    have hiTile :
        (a + b) +ᵥ ((-b + i.1) +ᵥ K.support) =
          i.1 +ᵥ (a +ᵥ K.support) := by
      rw [add_vadd_set, add_vadd_set]
      congr 1
      abel
    have hjTile :
        (a + b) +ᵥ ((-b + j.1) +ᵥ K.support) =
          j.1 +ᵥ (a +ᵥ K.support) := by
      rw [add_vadd_set, add_vadd_set]
      congr 1
      abel
    change MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint MeasureTheory.volume
      (i.1 +ᵥ (a +ᵥ K.support)) (j.1 +ᵥ (a +ᵥ K.support))
    rw [← hiTile, ← hjTile]
    exact hd'
  · have hpull :=
      (MeasureTheory.quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left MeasureTheory.volume (-(a + b))).ae h.2.2
    filter_upwards [hpull] with x hx
    have htarget : x ∈ (a + b) +ᵥ D ↔ -(a + b) + x ∈ D := by
      simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
    have hunion :
        (∃ s : b +ᵥ S, x ∈ ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ (vaddRegion K a).openCarrier)) ↔
          ∃ s : S, -(a + b) + x ∈ ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) := by
      rw [vaddRegion_openCarrier]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨s, hsx⟩
        let s₀ : S := ⟨-b + s.1, by
          simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using s.2⟩
        refine ⟨s₀, ?_⟩
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hsx ⊢
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hsx
        convert hsx using 1
        simp only [s₀, vadd_eq_add]
        abel
      · rintro ⟨s, hsx⟩
        let s' : b +ᵥ S := ⟨b + s.1, by
          simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
            neg_add_cancel_left] using s.2⟩
        refine ⟨s', ?_⟩
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hsx ⊢
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
        convert hsx using 1
        simp only [s', vadd_eq_add]
        abel
    exact htarget.trans (hx.trans hunion.symm)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.tilesOn_vadd_iff
statement:
private theorem tilesOn_vadd_iff
    (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region) (S D : Set Tiling.Plane)
    (a b : Tiling.Plane) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K S D ↔
      Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn (vaddRegion K a) (b +ᵥ S) ((a + b) +ᵥ D)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact tilesOn_vadd K S D a b
  · intro h
    have hback := tilesOn_vadd (vaddRegion K a) (b +ᵥ S) ((a + b) +ᵥ D)
      (-a) (-b) h
    rw [vaddRegion_neg_vadd, vadd_neg_vadd_set, add_vadd_set,
      show -a + -b + (a + b) = 0 by abel, zero_vadd] at hback
    exact hback

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.cellPiece_mem
statement:
private theorem cellPiece_mem {s : Set Tiling.Plane} (R : Tiling.Rectangulation s)
    (e : Fin R.pieces.card) : cellPiece R e ∈ R.pieces
proof:
:=
  (R.pieces.equivFin.symm e).2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.interior_closedAxisBox'
statement:
private theorem interior_closedAxisBox'
    {a b c d : ℝ} (_hab : a < b) (_hcd : c < d) :
    interior (closedAxisBox a b c d) =
      {z : Tiling.Plane | a < z.re ∧ z.re < b ∧ c < z.im ∧ z.im < d}
proof:
:= by
  change interior (Icc a b ×ℂ Icc c d) = _
  rw [Complex.interior_reProdIm, interior_Icc, interior_Icc]
  ext z
  simp only [Complex.mem_reProdIm, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_Ioo]
  tauto

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.cellPiece_iUnion
statement:
private theorem cellPiece_iUnion {s : Set Tiling.Plane} (R : Tiling.Rectangulation s) :
    (⋃ e, cellPiece R e) = ⋃ r ∈ (R.pieces : Set (Set Tiling.Plane)), r
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
    rintro ⟨e, he⟩
    exact Set.mem_biUnion (cellPiece_mem R e) he
  · intro hx
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
    obtain ⟨r, hx⟩ := hx
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
    obtain ⟨hr, hxr⟩ := hx
    let e := R.pieces.equivFin ⟨r, hr⟩
    refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
    change x ∈ (R.pieces.equivFin.symm e).1
    simpa only [e, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using hxr

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.interior_cellPiece_iUnion_ae
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : (⋃ e, interior (cellPiece R e)) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume]
      ⋃ e, cellPiece R e :=
    Filter.EventuallyEq.countable_iUnion fun e =>
      (R.isRectangle (cellPiece R e) (cellPiece_mem R e)).isPolygonal.interior_ae_eq
  have hset : (⋃ e, cellPiece R e) = s := by
    rw [cellPiece_iUnion, ← Set.sUnion_eq_biUnion, R.sUnion_eq]
  have h₂ : (⋃ e, cellPiece R e) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] s :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => congrFun hset x
  exact h₁.trans h₂

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.interior_cellPiece_pairwiseDisjoint
proof:
:= by
  intro e _ f _ hef
  change Disjoint (interior (cellPiece R e)) (interior (cellPiece R f))
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxe hxf
  have hpiece : cellPiece R e ≠ cellPiece R f := by
    intro h
    apply hef
    exact R.pieces.equivFin.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h)
  have hnull := (R.pairwiseAEDisjoint (cellPiece_mem R e) (cellPiece_mem R f) hpiece).mono
    interior_subset interior_subset
  have hpos := (isOpen_interior.inter isOpen_interior).measure_pos MeasureTheory.volume
    ⟨x, hxe, hxf⟩
  exact (ne_of_gt hpos) hnull

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.existsRegionNormalization
statement:
theorem existsRegionNormalization (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region) :
    Nonempty (RegionNormalization K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨anchor, hanchor, _⟩ := exists_intrinsicDiameterPair K
  let NK := vaddRegion K (-anchor)
  have hzero : 0 ∈ NK.vertices := by
    change 0 ∈ (vaddRegion K (-anchor)).vertices
    rw [vaddRegion_vertices]
    exact ⟨anchor, hanchor, by simp only [vadd_eq_add]; abel⟩
  obtain ⟨R, _hRpieces, hRintrinsic⟩ := exists_intrinsicGridRectangulation NK
  let V := intrinsicVertexEnumeration NK
  let origin : Fin NK.vertexFinset.card := V.symm ⟨0, hzero⟩
  let code := regionCodeOfRectangulation NK R hRintrinsic origin
  let vertex : Fin code.vertexCount → Tiling.Plane := fun i => (V i).1
  have hRnonempty : R.pieces.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    have hempty : R.pieces = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := NK.nonempty
    have : x ∈ ⋃₀ (R.pieces : Set (Set Tiling.Plane)) := by
      rw [R.sUnion_eq]
      exact hx
    apply (Set.mem_empty_iff_false x).mp
    simpa only [hempty, Finset.coe_empty, Set.sUnion_empty] using this
  have hleft (e : Fin code.cellCount) :
      vertex (code.leftVertex e) =
        (intrinsicRectangleData
          (hRintrinsic (cellPiece R e) (cellPiece_mem R e))).leftVertex.1 := by
    simp only [vertex, code, regionCodeOfRectangulation, V, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hright (e : Fin code.cellCount) :
      vertex (code.rightVertex e) =
        (intrinsicRectangleData
          (hRintrinsic (cellPiece R e) (cellPiece_mem R e))).rightVertex.1 := by
    simp only [vertex, code, regionCodeOfRectangulation, V, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hbottom (e : Fin code.cellCount) :
      vertex (code.bottomVertex e) =
        (intrinsicRectangleData
          (hRintrinsic (cellPiece R e) (cellPiece_mem R e))).bottomVertex.1 := by
    simp only [vertex, code, regionCodeOfRectangulation, V, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have htop (e : Fin code.cellCount) :
      vertex (code.topVertex e) =
        (intrinsicRectangleData
          (hRintrinsic (cellPiece R e) (cellPiece_mem R e))).topVertex.1 := by
    simp only [vertex, code, regionCodeOfRectangulation, V, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hopenCell (e : Fin code.cellCount) :
      {z : Tiling.Plane |
        (vertex (code.leftVertex e)).re < z.re ∧
        z.re < (vertex (code.rightVertex e)).re ∧
        (vertex (code.bottomVertex e)).im < z.im ∧
        z.im < (vertex (code.topVertex e)).im} =
        interior (cellPiece R e) := by
    let d := intrinsicRectangleData
      (hRintrinsic (cellPiece R e) (cellPiece_mem R e))
    calc
      _ = {z : Tiling.Plane |
          d.x₀ < z.re ∧ z.re < d.x₁ ∧ d.y₀ < z.im ∧ z.im < d.y₁} := by
        rw [hleft, hright, hbottom, htop, d.left_value, d.right_value,
          d.bottom_value, d.top_value]
      _ = interior (closedAxisBox d.x₀ d.x₁ d.y₀ d.y₁) :=
        (interior_closedAxisBox' d.x_lt d.y_lt).symm
      _ = interior (cellPiece R e) := congrArg interior d.box_eq.symm
  let normalized : Realization code :=
    { region := NK
      vertex := vertex
      vertex_injective := by
        intro i j hij
        exact V.injective (Subtype.ext hij)
      vertex_range := by
        ext x
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
          exact (V i).2
        · intro hx
          obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := V.surjective ⟨x, hx⟩
          exact ⟨i, congrArg Subtype.val hi⟩
      wellFormed := by
        simp only [code, regionCodeOfRectangulation, RegionCode.wellFormed,
          decide_eq_true_eq]
        exact Finset.card_pos.mpr hRnonempty
      origin_eq_zero := by
        simp only [vertex, code, regionCodeOfRectangulation, origin, V,
          Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      left_lt_right := by
        intro e
        rw [hleft, hright]
        let d := intrinsicRectangleData
          (hRintrinsic (cellPiece R e) (cellPiece_mem R e))
        rw [d.left_value, d.right_value]
        exact d.x_lt
      bottom_lt_top := by
        intro e
        rw [hbottom, htop]
        let d := intrinsicRectangleData
          (hRintrinsic (cellPiece R e) (cellPiece_mem R e))
        rw [d.bottom_value, d.top_value]
        exact d.y_lt
      cells_pairwiseDisjoint := by
        intro e _ f _ hef
        change Disjoint
          {z : Tiling.Plane |
            (vertex (code.leftVertex e)).re < z.re ∧
            z.re < (vertex (code.rightVertex e)).re ∧
            (vertex (code.bottomVertex e)).im < z.im ∧
            z.im < (vertex (code.topVertex e)).im}
          {z : Tiling.Plane |
            (vertex (code.leftVertex f)).re < z.re ∧
            z.re < (vertex (code.rightVertex f)).re ∧
            (vertex (code.bottomVertex f)).im < z.im ∧
            z.im < (vertex (code.topVertex f)).im}
        rw [hopenCell e, hopenCell f]
        exact interior_cellPiece_pairwiseDisjoint R (Set.mem_univ e) (Set.mem_univ f) hef
      presentation_correct := by
        change (⋃ e, {z : Tiling.Plane |
          (vertex (code.leftVertex e)).re < z.re ∧
          z.re < (vertex (code.rightVertex e)).re ∧
          (vertex (code.bottomVertex e)).im < z.im ∧
          z.im < (vertex (code.topVertex e)).im}) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume]
            interior NK.support
        simp_rw [hopenCell]
        exact (interior_cellPiece_iUnion_ae R).trans NK.isPolygonal.interior_ae_eq.symm }
  let originalEquiv := V.trans (untranslateVertexEquiv K anchor)
  let originalVertex : Fin code.vertexCount → Tiling.Plane := fun i => (originalEquiv i).1
  have horiginal_formula (i : Fin code.vertexCount) : originalVertex i = vertex i + anchor := by
    rfl
  have hclosedCell (e : Fin code.cellCount) :
      realizationClosedCell normalized e = cellPiece R e := by
    let d := intrinsicRectangleData
      (hRintrinsic (cellPiece R e) (cellPiece_mem R e))
    change closedAxisBox
      (vertex (code.leftVertex e)).re (vertex (code.rightVertex e)).re
      (vertex (code.bottomVertex e)).im (vertex (code.topVertex e)).im = cellPiece R e
    rw [hleft, hright, hbottom, htop, d.left_value, d.right_value,
      d.bottom_value, d.top_value]
    exact d.box_eq.symm
  refine ⟨{
    anchor := anchor
    anchor_mem := hanchor
    code := code
    normalized := normalized
    originalVertex := originalVertex
    originalVertex_injective := by
      intro i j hij
      exact originalEquiv.injective (Subtype.ext hij)
    originalVertex_range := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
        exact (originalEquiv i).2
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := originalEquiv.surjective ⟨x, hx⟩
        exact ⟨i, congrArg Subtype.val hi⟩
    origin_originalVertex := by
      rw [horiginal_formula]
      have hv0 := normalized.origin_eq_zero
      change vertex code.originVertex = 0 at hv0
      rw [hv0, zero_add]
    normalizedVertex_formula := by
      intro i
      change vertex i = originalVertex i - anchor
      rw [horiginal_formula]
      exact (add_sub_cancel_right (vertex i) anchor).symm
    normalized_support := rfl
    normalized_openCarrier := by
      exact vaddRegion_openCarrier K (-anchor)
    normalized_vertices := by
      exact vaddRegion_vertices K (-anchor)
    intrinsicVertexEquiv := originalEquiv
    intrinsicVertexEquiv_value := by
      intro i
      rfl
    closedCell_intrinsic := by
      intro e
      rw [hclosedCell]
      exact hRintrinsic (cellPiece R e) (cellPiece_mem R e)
    closedCells_cover := by
      simp_rw [hclosedCell]
      change (⋃ e : Fin R.pieces.card, cellPiece R e) = NK.support
      rw [cellPiece_iUnion, ← Set.sUnion_eq_biUnion, R.sUnion_eq]
    closedCells_pairwiseIntersection_volume_zero := by
      intro e f hef
      rw [hclosedCell, hclosedCell]
      have hpiece : cellPiece R e ≠ cellPiece R f := by
        intro h
        apply hef
        exact R.pieces.equivFin.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h)
      exact R.pairwiseAEDisjoint (cellPiece_mem R e) (cellPiece_mem R f) hpiece
    tilesOn_translate := by
      intro S
      simpa only [NK, neg_add_cancel, zero_vadd] using
        (tilesOn_vadd_iff K S Set.univ (-anchor) anchor) }⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.evalCoeffAgainstRebaseCoeff
statement:
theorem evalCoeffAgainstRebaseCoeff {C : RegionCode}
    (vertex : Fin C.vertexCount → Tiling.Plane) (origin : Fin C.vertexCount)
    (s : CoordSort) (a : Coeff C) :
    evalCoeffAgainst vertex s (RuntimeRebase.rebaseCoeff origin a) =
      ∑ i, (a i : Real) * s.axis.coord (vertex i - vertex origin)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [evalCoeffAgainst, RuntimeRebase.rebaseCoeff, Coeff.sub, Coeff.single,
    Int.cast_sub, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp only [Int.cast_ite, Int.cast_sum, Int.cast_zero, ite_mul, zero_mul,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  cases s <;>
    simp only [CoordSort.axis, Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord, Complex.sub_re,
      Complex.sub_im, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_mul]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.normalizedEvalEqOriginalRebased
statement:
theorem normalizedEvalEqOriginalRebased {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region}
    (N : RegionNormalization K) (s : CoordSort) (a : Coeff N.code) :
    evalCoeff N.normalized s a =
      evalCoeffAgainst N.originalVertex s
        (RuntimeRebase.rebaseCoeff N.code.originVertex a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalCoeffAgainstRebaseCoeff]
  simp only [evalCoeff]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [N.normalizedVertex_formula, N.origin_originalVertex]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.rebaseOracleCorrect
statement:
theorem rebaseOracleCorrect {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region}
    (N : RegionNormalization K) (O : Oracle N.code)
    (hO : CorrectOriginalOracle N.originalVertex O) :
    ∃ CO : CorrectOracle N.code N.normalized,
      CO.toOracle = RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle N.code.originVertex O
proof:
:= by
  let CO : CorrectOracle N.code N.normalized :=
    { answer := (RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle N.code.originVertex O).answer
      correct := by
        intro q
        change O.answer (RuntimeRebase.rebaseQuery N.code.originVertex q) = true ↔ _
        rw [hO (RuntimeRebase.rebaseQuery N.code.originVertex q)]
        change evalCoeffAgainst N.originalVertex q.sort
            (RuntimeRebase.rebaseCoeff N.code.originVertex q.lhs) ≤
          evalCoeffAgainst N.originalVertex q.sort
            (RuntimeRebase.rebaseCoeff N.code.originVertex q.rhs) ↔ _
        rw [← normalizedEvalEqOriginalRebased, ← normalizedEvalEqOriginalRebased] }
  exact ⟨CO, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.tileableNormalizedIff
statement:
theorem tileableNormalizedIff {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region}
    (N : RegionNormalization K) :
    (∃ S : Set Tiling.Plane,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn N.normalized.region S Set.univ) ↔
      ∃ S : Set Tiling.Plane, Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K S Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨S, hS⟩
    refine ⟨(-N.anchor) +ᵥ S, ?_⟩
    apply (N.tilesOn_translate ((-N.anchor) +ᵥ S)).2
    convert hS using 1
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
    constructor <;> intro hx <;> convert hx using 1 <;> abel
  · rintro ⟨S, hS⟩
    exact ⟨N.anchor +ᵥ S, (N.tilesOn_translate S).1 hS⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.legacyAdapter_exists
statement:
theorem legacyAdapter_exists (E : EncodedAxisParallelRegion)
    (N : RegionNormalization E.region) : Nonempty (LegacyNormalizationAdapter E N)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let vertexSetEquiv : ↥E.region.vertices ≃ ↥E.region.vertexFinset :=
    { toFun := fun v => ⟨v, by
          change v.1 ∈ (E.region.vertexFinset : Set Tiling.Plane)
          rw [E.region.coe_vertexFinset]
          exact v.2⟩
      invFun := fun v => ⟨v, by
          rw [← E.region.coe_vertexFinset]
          exact v.2⟩
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  let vertexEquiv := N.intrinsicVertexEquiv.trans vertexSetEquiv
  exact ⟨{
    vertexEquiv := vertexEquiv
    intrinsic_compat := by intro i; rfl
    vertexEquiv_value := by intro i; exact N.intrinsicVertexEquiv_value i }⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.eval_toLegacyCoeff
statement:
private theorem eval_toLegacyCoeff {E : EncodedAxisParallelRegion}
    {N : RegionNormalization E.region} (A : LegacyNormalizationAdapter E N)
    (s : CoordSort) (a : Coeff N.code) :
    evalCoordExpr E s.axis (toLegacyCoeff A a) = evalCoeffAgainst N.originalVertex s a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [evalCoordExpr, toLegacyCoeff]
  rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (fun _ => by simp)]
  change (∑ i : ↥E.region.vertexFinset,
    (a (A.vertexEquiv.symm i) : Real) * s.axis.coord (i : Tiling.Plane)) = _
  calc
    _ = ∑ i : Fin N.code.vertexCount,
        (a (A.vertexEquiv.symm (A.vertexEquiv i)) : Real) *
          s.axis.coord (A.vertexEquiv i : Tiling.Plane) :=
      (Equiv.sum_comp A.vertexEquiv _).symm
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, A.vertexEquiv_value, evalCoeffAgainst]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Semantics.legacyQuery_answer
statement:
theorem legacyQuery_answer (E : EncodedAxisParallelRegion)
    (O : SelectedCoordinateOracles E) (N : RegionNormalization E.region)
    (A : LegacyNormalizationAdapter E N) :
    ∃ originalOracle : Oracle N.code,
      CorrectOriginalOracle N.originalVertex originalOracle ∧
      ∀ q, originalOracle.answer q = O.answer (toLegacyQuery A q)
proof:
:= by
  let originalOracle : Oracle N.code := ⟨fun q => O.answer (toLegacyQuery A q)⟩
  refine ⟨originalOracle, ?_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  rintro ⟨s, lhs, rhs⟩
  cases s
  · change O.horizontal.answer (toLegacyCoeff A lhs) (toLegacyCoeff A rhs) = true ↔ _
    rw [O.horizontal.correct]
    change evalCoordExpr E CoordSort.horizontal.axis (toLegacyCoeff A lhs) ≤
      evalCoordExpr E CoordSort.horizontal.axis (toLegacyCoeff A rhs) ↔ _
    rw [eval_toLegacyCoeff, eval_toLegacyCoeff]
  · change O.vertical.answer (toLegacyCoeff A lhs) (toLegacyCoeff A rhs) = true ↔ _
    rw [O.vertical.correct]
    change evalCoordExpr E CoordSort.vertical.axis (toLegacyCoeff A lhs) ≤
      evalCoordExpr E CoordSort.vertical.axis (toLegacyCoeff A rhs) ↔ _
    rw [eval_toLegacyCoeff, eval_toLegacyCoeff]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.noGapPhaseGeometry_exists
statement: private theorem noGapPhaseGeometry_exists : noGapPhaseGeometry_existsStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro C P phi D Tphi hImageTiles Dcmp originalSlice hPreimage i Q G hQ
  have hphase : Q ∈ (Dcmp.orbit i).phases := hQ.1
  have hnotGap : ¬IsGappedSlice G (originalSlice i Q) := by
    intro hgap
    exact hQ.2 ⟨hphase, hgap⟩
  let S := indexedPreimage Tphi (Q.centres (Dcmp.part i))
  have hpart : Dcmp.part i ⊆ Set.range Tphi := by
    intro z hz
    rw [← Dcmp.parts_union]
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hz⟩
  have hImage : deformedCenterCarrierOn Tphi S = Q.centres (Dcmp.part i) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
      exact ht
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hpart hz.1
      exact ⟨t, hz, rfl⟩
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ((Dcmp.orbit i).phase_iff_nonempty Q).mp hphase
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hpart hz.1
    exact ⟨t, hz⟩
  have hSource : originalSlice i Q = Subtype.val '' S := hPreimage i Q hphase
  have hLinked : Linked G (Subtype.val '' S) := by
    refine ⟨hSne.image Subtype.val, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy
    let R : Tiling.Plane → Tiling.Plane → Prop :=
      fun a b ↦ a ∈ Subtype.val '' S ∧ b ∈ Subtype.val '' S ∧ dist a b < G
    let : Std.Symm R := ⟨by
      intro a b hab
      exact ⟨hab.2.1, hab.1, by simpa only [dist_comm] using hab.2.2⟩⟩
    have hpath : Relation.EqvGen R x y := by
      by_contra hnot
      apply hnotGap
      rw [hSource]
      exact ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hnot⟩
    rwa [Relation.EqvGen.eqvGen_eq_reflTransGen] at hpath
  have hSourceSub : Subtype.val '' S ⊆ C.centres := by
    rintro z ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    exact t.2
  have hSourcePack : Tiling.IsPacking C.region.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (C.region.toPolygonalRegion.placements (Subtype.val '' S)) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    exact P.source_tilesOn.2.1 (hSourceSub ha) (hSourceSub hb) hab
  have hImageSub : deformedCenterCarrierOn Tphi S ⊆ Set.range Tphi := by
    rintro z ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨t, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hTiles⟩ := hImageTiles
  have hImagePack : Tiling.IsPacking D.deformedRegion.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (D.deformedRegion.toPolygonalRegion.placements (deformedCenterCarrierOn Tphi S)) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    exact hTiles.2.1 (hImageSub ha) (hImageSub hb) hab
  have hLine : deformedCenterCarrierOn Tphi S ⊆ Q.carrier := by
    rw [hImage]
    exact Set.inter_subset_right
  have hPeriod : (Dcmp.direction i).toPlane +ᵥ deformedCenterCarrierOn Tphi S =
      deformedCenterCarrierOn Tphi S := by
    rw [hImage]
    exact (setPeriodicBy_iff_vadd_eq _ _).mp ((Dcmp.orbit i).slice_periodic Q hphase)
  exact ⟨⟨S, rfl, hSource, hImage, hphase, hSne, hLinked, hSourcePack,
    hImagePack, hLine, hPeriod⟩⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.obliqueLine_coordinateInjective
statement:
private theorem obliqueLine_coordinateInjective
    (u : RationalDirection) (Q : RationalSlice u)
    (hu : u.toPlane.re * u.toPlane.im ≠ 0) :
    Set.InjOn Complex.re Q.carrier ∧ Set.InjOn Complex.im Q.carrier
proof:
:= by
  have hcoords := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hu
  have hdiff : ∀ {x y : Tiling.Plane}, x ∈ Q.carrier → y ∈ Q.carrier →
      ∃ r : ℝ, x - y = r • u.toPlane := by
    intro x y hx hy
    change QuotientAddGroup.mk' (realDirectionSubgroup u) x = Q at hx
    change QuotientAddGroup.mk' (realDirectionSubgroup u) y = Q at hy
    exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.mp (hx.trans hy.symm))
  constructor
  · intro x hx y hy hxy
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hdiff hx hy
    have hrre := congrArg Complex.re hr
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul, hxy, sub_self] at hrre
    have hrzero : r = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hrre.symm).resolve_right hcoords.1
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    simpa only [hrzero, zero_smul] using hr
  · intro x hx y hy hxy
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hdiff hx hy
    have hrim := congrArg Complex.im hr
    simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul, hxy, sub_self] at hrim
    have hrzero : r = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hrim.symm).resolve_right hcoords.2
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    simpa only [hrzero, zero_smul] using hr

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.mapped_transverseCoord_eq
statement:
private theorem mapped_transverseCoord_eq
    {C : ApproximationContext.{0}}
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (Tphi : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane)
    (hTphi : ∀ t, Tphi t = mapPoint phi (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2))
    (axis : Axis) (s t : ↥C.centres)
    (hst : axis.transverseCoord s.1 = axis.transverseCoord t.1) :
    axis.transverseCoord (Tphi s) = axis.transverseCoord (Tphi t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hTphi s, hTphi t]
  cases axis with
  | horizontal =>
    have hs : (⟨s.1.im, C.centre_im_mem s.1 s.2⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) =
        ⟨t.1.im, C.centre_im_mem t.1 t.2⟩ := Subtype.ext hst
    simpa [mapPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint, Axis.transverseCoord] using
      congrArg (mapScalar phi) hs
  | vertical =>
    have hs : (⟨s.1.re, C.centre_re_mem s.1 s.2⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) =
        ⟨t.1.re, C.centre_re_mem t.1 t.2⟩ := Subtype.ext hst
    simpa [mapPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint, Axis.transverseCoord] using
      congrArg (mapScalar phi) hs

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.obliqueAxisLine_segmentCopies_finite
statement:
private theorem obliqueAxisLine_segmentCopies_finite
    {C : ApproximationContext.{0}}
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C phi) (Tphi : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane)
    (hTphi : ∀ t, Tphi t = mapPoint phi (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2))
    (u : RationalDirection) (Q : RationalSlice u) (S : Set ↥C.centres)
    (hu : u.toPlane.re * u.toPlane.im ≠ 0)
    (hline : deformedCenterCarrierOn Tphi S ⊆ Q.carrier)
    (axis : Axis) (level : ℝ) :
    (sourceSegmentsOnAxisLine axis level : Set (LabelledTileSegment C S)).Finite ∧
      (imageSegmentsOnAxisLine (S := S) D Tphi axis level).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hvertices : C.region.vertices.Finite := C.region.isPolygonal.vertexSet_finite
  have := hvertices.to_subtype
  have htrans : Set.InjOn axis.transverseCoord Q.carrier := by
    obtain ⟨hre, him⟩ := obliqueLine_coordinateInjective u Q hu
    cases axis
    · exact him
    · exact hre
  have hmem (t : S) : Tphi t.1 ∈ Q.carrier := hline ⟨t.1, t.2, rfl⟩
  let labels : LabelledTileSegment C S → ↥C.region.vertices × ↥C.region.vertices :=
    fun e => (e.vertex₀, e.vertex₁)
  constructor
  · apply Set.Finite.of_injOn (f := labels) (t := Set.univ)
      (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
    · intro e he f hf hef
      have h₀ : e.vertex₀ = f.vertex₀ := congrArg Prod.fst hef
      have h₁ : e.vertex₁ = f.vertex₁ := congrArg Prod.snd hef
      have he₀ : axis.transverseCoord (e.vertex₀.1 + e.center.1.1) = level :=
        he (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _)
      have hf₀ : axis.transverseCoord (f.vertex₀.1 + f.center.1.1) = level :=
        hf (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _)
      have hc : axis.transverseCoord e.center.1.1 =
          axis.transverseCoord f.center.1.1 := by
        rw [h₀] at he₀
        cases axis <;>
          simp only [Axis.transverseCoord, Complex.add_im, Complex.add_re] at he₀ hf₀ ⊢ <;>
          linarith
      have hmap := mapped_transverseCoord_eq phi Tphi hTphi axis e.center.1 f.center.1 hc
      have hc' : e.center = f.center :=
        Subtype.ext (Tphi.injective (htrans (hmem e.center) (hmem f.center) hmap))
      exact labelledTileSegment_eq h₀ h₁ hc'
    · exact Set.finite_univ
  · apply Set.Finite.of_injOn (f := labels) (t := Set.univ)
      (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
    · intro e he f hf hef
      have h₀ : e.vertex₀ = f.vertex₀ := congrArg Prod.fst hef
      have h₁ : e.vertex₁ = f.vertex₁ := congrArg Prod.snd hef
      have he₀ : axis.transverseCoord
          (D.planarHomeomorph e.vertex₀.1 + Tphi e.center.1) = level :=
        he (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _)
      have hf₀ : axis.transverseCoord
          (D.planarHomeomorph f.vertex₀.1 + Tphi f.center.1) = level :=
        hf (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _)
      have hc : axis.transverseCoord (Tphi e.center.1) =
          axis.transverseCoord (Tphi f.center.1) := by
        rw [h₀] at he₀
        cases axis <;>
          simp only [Axis.transverseCoord, Complex.add_im, Complex.add_re] at he₀ hf₀ ⊢ <;>
          linarith
      have hc' : e.center = f.center :=
        Subtype.ext (Tphi.injective (htrans (hmem e.center) (hmem f.center) hc))
      exact labelledTileSegment_eq h₀ h₁ hc'
    · exact Set.finite_univ

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.obliqueProperVertices_tightlyLinked
statement:
private theorem obliqueProperVertices_tightlyLinked
    {C : ApproximationContext.{0}}
    {phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ}
    {D : CoordinateDeformation C phi} {Tphi : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane}
    {S : Set ↥C.centres} {G : ℝ}
    (hSource : IsLocallyAxisParallelPolygonal
      (regularSupport C.region (Subtype.val '' S)))
    (hTarget : IsLocallyAxisParallelPolygonal
      (regularSupport D.deformedRegion (deformedCenterCarrierOn Tphi S)))
    (B : ObliqueProperVertexTransport C phi D Tphi S hSource hTarget)
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hG : 0 < G) (hLinked : Linked G (Subtype.val '' S))
    (hExpose : ∀ t : S, ∃ v : ↥C.region.vertices,
      v.1 + t.1.1 ∈ properVertices
        (regularSupport C.region (Subtype.val '' S))) :
    Linked (G + 2 * Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier) (properVertices
      (regularSupport C.region (Subtype.val '' S)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let V := properVertices (regularSupport C.region (Subtype.val '' S))
  let d := Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := Metric.diam_nonneg
  have hvertexDist (v w : ↥C.region.vertices) : dist v.1 w.1 ≤ d := by
    have hv : v.1 ∈ closure C.region.openCarrier :=
      frontier_subset_closure (IntrinsicVertices.region_vertices_subset_frontier C.region v.2)
    have hw : w.1 ∈ closure C.region.openCarrier :=
      frontier_subset_closure (IntrinsicVertices.region_vertices_subset_frontier C.region w.2)
    have hbounded : Bornology.IsBounded (closure C.region.openCarrier) := by
      change Bornology.IsBounded (closure (interior C.region.support))
      rw [C.region.isPolygonal.closure_interior]
      exact C.region.isPolygonal.isBounded
    simpa only [Metric.diam_closure] using Metric.dist_le_diam_of_mem hbounded hv hw
  have hexposed : ∀ z ∈ Subtype.val '' S, ∃ v : ↥C.region.vertices, v.1 + z ∈ V := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact hExpose ⟨t, ht⟩
  choose chosenVertex hchosenVertex using hexposed
  let vertex (z : Tiling.Plane) : ↥C.region.vertices :=
    if hz : z ∈ Subtype.val '' S then chosenVertex z hz else ⟨0, C.zero_mem_vertices⟩
  let f (z : Tiling.Plane) : Tiling.Plane := (vertex z).1 + z
  have hf {z : Tiling.Plane} (hz : z ∈ Subtype.val '' S) : f z ∈ V := by
    simpa only [f, vertex, dif_pos hz] using hchosenVertex z hz
  have hlabelMove (v : ↥C.region.vertices) (z : Tiling.Plane) :
      dist (v.1 + z) (f z) < G + 2 * d := by
    have hdist : dist (v.1 + z) (f z) ≤ d := by
      simpa only [f, dist_add_right] using hvertexDist v (vertex z)
    linarith
  let R : Tiling.Plane → Tiling.Plane → Prop :=
    fun a b => a ∈ V ∧ b ∈ V ∧ dist a b < G + 2 * d
  have hlift : (fun a b : Tiling.Plane =>
      a ∈ Subtype.val '' S ∧ b ∈ Subtype.val '' S ∧ dist a b < G) ≤ (R on f) := by
    intro a b hab
    refine ⟨hf hab.1, hf hab.2.1, ?_⟩
    have hdist : dist (f a) (f b) ≤ d + dist a b := by
      apply (dist_add_add_le _ _ _ _).trans
      gcongr
      exact hvertexDist (vertex a) (vertex b)
    linarith [hab.2.2]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hS
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hExpose ⟨t, ht⟩
    exact ⟨v.1 + t.1, hv⟩
  · intro x hx y hy
    obtain ⟨vx, tx, hxlabel⟩ := B.source_label ⟨x, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨vy, ty, hylabel⟩ := B.source_label ⟨y, hy⟩
    change x = vx.1 + tx.1.1 at hxlabel
    change y = vy.1 + ty.1.1 at hylabel
    have htx : tx.1.1 ∈ Subtype.val '' S := ⟨tx.1, tx.2, rfl⟩
    have hty : ty.1.1 ∈ Subtype.val '' S := ⟨ty.1, ty.2, rfl⟩
    have hpath := Relation.ReflTransGen.lift f hlift _ _
      (hLinked.2 tx.1.1 htx ty.1.1 hty)
    have hxstep : Relation.ReflTransGen R x (f tx.1.1) :=
      Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨hx, hf htx, by
        rw [hxlabel]
        exact hlabelMove vx tx.1.1⟩
    have hystep : Relation.ReflTransGen R (f ty.1.1) y :=
      Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨hf hty, hy, by
        rw [dist_comm, hylabel]
        exact hlabelMove vy ty.1.1⟩
    exact hxstep.trans (hpath.trans hystep)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.properVertex_of_oblique_exposure
statement:
private theorem properVertex_of_oblique_exposure
    {F : Set Tiling.Plane} {x n : Tiling.Plane}
    (hnre : n.re ≠ 0) (hnim : n.im ≠ 0)
    (hx : x ∈ frontier F)
    (hhalf : ∀ z ∈ frontier F, obliqueNormalValue n z ≤ obliqueNormalValue n x)
    (hcross : ∃ q > 0, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x q, z ∈ frontier F →
      z.re = x.re ∨ z.im = x.im) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.IsProperVertex F x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨L, hxL, hdim, hlocal⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv, r, hr, hline⟩ :=
    Tiling.AffineSubspace.exists_ball_frontier_iff_affineLine hxL hdim hlocal
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hcrossq⟩ := hcross
  let epsilon : ℝ := min r q / (2 * (‖v‖ + 1))
  have hmin : 0 < min r q := lt_min hr hq
  have hepsilon : 0 < epsilon := by
    dsimp only [epsilon]
    exact div_pos hmin (by positivity)
  have hstep : epsilon * ‖v‖ < min r q := by
    calc
      epsilon * ‖v‖ < epsilon * (‖v‖ + 1) := by
        exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by linarith) hepsilon
      _ = min r q / 2 := by
        dsimp only [epsilon]
        field_simp
      _ < min r q := half_lt_self hmin
  have hplusdist : dist (x + epsilon • v) x < min r q := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have heq : x + epsilon • v - x = epsilon • v := by abel
    rw [heq, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hepsilon]
    exact hstep
  have hminusdist : dist (x + (-epsilon) • v) x < min r q := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have heq : x + (-epsilon) • v - x = -(epsilon • v) := by
      rw [neg_smul]
      abel
    rw [heq, norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hepsilon]
    exact hstep
  have hplus : x + epsilon • v ∈ frontier F :=
    (hline _ (Metric.mem_ball.mpr
      (hplusdist.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)))).2
      (Tiling.vadd_smul_mem_affineLine x v epsilon)
  have hminus : x + (-epsilon) • v ∈ frontier F :=
    (hline _ (Metric.mem_ball.mpr
      (hminusdist.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)))).2
      (Tiling.vadd_smul_mem_affineLine x v (-epsilon))
  have haxis : v.re = 0 ∨ v.im = 0 := by
    rcases hcrossq _ (Metric.mem_ball.mpr
      (hplusdist.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))) hplus with h | h
    · left
      have hmul : epsilon * v.re = 0 := by
        simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul] at h
        linarith
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left hepsilon.ne'
    · right
      have hmul : epsilon * v.im = 0 := by
        simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul] at h
        linarith
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left hepsilon.ne'
  have hnormal : obliqueNormalValue n v = 0 := by
    have hp := hhalf _ hplus
    have hm := hhalf _ hminus
    simp only [obliqueNormalValue, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
      Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul] at hp hm ⊢
    have hproduct : epsilon * (n.re * v.re + n.im * v.im) = 0 := by
      nlinarith
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hproduct).resolve_left hepsilon.ne'
  apply hv
  apply Complex.ext
  · rcases haxis with hre | him
    · exact hre
    · have hmul : n.re * v.re = 0 := by
        simpa only [obliqueNormalValue, him, mul_zero, add_zero] using hnormal
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left hnre
  · rcases haxis with hre | him
    · have hmul : n.im * v.im = 0 := by
        simpa only [obliqueNormalValue, hre, mul_zero, zero_add] using hnormal
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left hnim
    · exact him

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_normal_max_vertex
statement:
private theorem exists_normal_max_vertex (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region)
    (n : Tiling.Plane) (hnre : n.re ≠ 0) (hnim : n.im ≠ 0) :
    ∃ v : ↥K.vertices, ∀ z ∈ K.support,
      obliqueNormalValue n z ≤ obliqueNormalValue n v.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ := K.isPolygonal.isCompact.exists_isMaxOn
    K.nonempty (show ContinuousOn (obliqueNormalValue n) K.support by
      unfold obliqueNormalValue
      fun_prop)
  have hxnot : x ∉ K.openCarrier := by
    intro hxopen
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier_regularOpen K).1 x hxopen
    let epsilon : ℝ := r / (2 * (‖n‖ + 1))
    have hepsilon : 0 < epsilon := by
      dsimp only [epsilon]
      exact div_pos hr (by positivity)
    have hstep : epsilon * ‖n‖ < r := by
      calc
        epsilon * ‖n‖ < epsilon * (‖n‖ + 1) := by
          exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by linarith) hepsilon
        _ = r / 2 := by
          dsimp only [epsilon]
          field_simp
        _ < r := half_lt_self hr
    have hdist : dist (x + epsilon • n) x < r := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      have heq : x + epsilon • n - x = epsilon • n := by abel
      rw [heq, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hepsilon]
      exact hstep
    have hy : x + epsilon • n ∈ K.support :=
      interior_subset (hball (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hdist))
    have hvalue := hmax hy
    change obliqueNormalValue n (x + epsilon • n) ≤ obliqueNormalValue n x at hvalue
    simp only [obliqueNormalValue, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
      Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul] at hvalue
    have hsq : 0 < n.re ^ 2 + n.im ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hnre, sq_nonneg n.im]
    nlinarith
  have hclosure : closure K.openCarrier = K.support :=
    K.isPolygonal.closure_interior
  have hxfront : x ∈ frontier K.openCarrier := by
    rw [frontier, hclosure,
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier_regularOpen K).1.interior_eq]
    exact ⟨hx, hxnot⟩
  have hhalf : ∀ z ∈ frontier K.openCarrier,
      obliqueNormalValue n z ≤ obliqueNormalValue n x := by
    intro z hz
    apply hmax
    rw [frontier, hclosure] at hz
    exact hz.1
  have hcross : ∃ q > 0, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x q,
      z ∈ frontier K.openCarrier → z.re = x.re ∨ z.im = x.im := by
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hball⟩ := K.isAxisParallel.localBoundaryCross x
    refine ⟨q, hq, ?_⟩
    intro z hz hzfront
    apply hball z hz
    rwa [← Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.frontier_openCarrier_eq_frontier_support K]
  have hxproper := properVertex_of_oblique_exposure hnre hnim hxfront hhalf hcross
  have hxvertex : x ∈ K.vertices := by
    rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.region_vertices_eq_nonStraightBoundary]
    exact hxproper
  exact ⟨⟨x, hxvertex⟩, fun z hz => hmax hz⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.controlledMap_add
statement:
private theorem controlledMap_add
    {C : ApproximationContext.{0}} (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (x y : ControlledPlane C) :
    mapPoint phi ⟨x.1 + y.1, C.coordinateSpace.add_mem x.2.1 y.2.1,
      C.coordinateSpace.add_mem x.2.2 y.2.2⟩ =
      mapPoint phi x + mapPoint phi y
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp only [mapPoint, mapScalar, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      mul_zero, mul_one, sub_zero, add_zero]
    exact_mod_cast (map_add phi
      (⟨x.1.re, x.2.1⟩ : C.coordinateSpace)
      (⟨y.1.re, y.2.1⟩ : C.coordinateSpace))
  · simp only [mapPoint, mapScalar, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      mul_zero, mul_one, add_zero, zero_add]
    exact_mod_cast (map_add phi
      (⟨x.1.im, x.2.2⟩ : C.coordinateSpace)
      (⟨y.1.im, y.2.2⟩ : C.coordinateSpace))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.controlledMap_sub
statement:
private theorem controlledMap_sub
    {C : ApproximationContext.{0}} (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (x y : ControlledPlane C) :
    mapPoint phi ⟨x.1 - y.1, C.coordinateSpace.sub_mem x.2.1 y.2.1,
      C.coordinateSpace.sub_mem x.2.2 y.2.2⟩ =
      mapPoint phi x - mapPoint phi y
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp only [mapPoint, mapScalar, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_re,
      Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re,
      Complex.I_im, mul_zero, mul_one, sub_zero, add_zero]
    exact_mod_cast (map_sub phi
      (⟨x.1.re, x.2.1⟩ : C.coordinateSpace)
      (⟨y.1.re, y.2.1⟩ : C.coordinateSpace))
  · simp only [mapPoint, mapScalar, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im,
      Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re,
      Complex.I_im, mul_zero, mul_one, add_zero, zero_add]
    exact_mod_cast (map_sub phi
      (⟨x.1.im, x.2.2⟩ : C.coordinateSpace)
      (⟨y.1.im, y.2.2⟩ : C.coordinateSpace))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.transport_mapTranslatedVertex
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, t, hxt⟩ := B.source_label x
  rw [B.target_formula x v t hxt, D.vertex_agreement v.1 v.2, hTphi t.1]
  rw [← controlledMap_add]
