name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.LocalCoverSearch.coverageFormula_of_ae_cover
statement:
private theorem coverageFormula_of_ae_cover {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C)
    (B : LocalBoundCode C) (N m : Nat) (x y : Fin m → Real)
    (hcover : ∀ᵐ z ∂MeasureTheory.volume, z ∈ semanticLocalBox R B N →
      ∃ i : Fin m,
        z ∈ (((x i : ℂ) + (y i : ℂ) * Complex.I) +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier)) :
    (coverageFormula C B N m).Holds R x y
proof:
:= by
  let c : Fin m → Tiling.Plane := fun i => (x i : ℂ) + (y i : ℂ) * Complex.I
  let F : Set Tiling.Plane := ⋃ i : Fin m, ⋃ e : Fin C.cellCount,
    c i +ᵥ closedRealizedCell R e
  have hFclosed : IsClosed F := by
    rw [show F = ⋃ i ∈ Set.univ, ⋃ e ∈ Set.univ,
        c i +ᵥ closedRealizedCell R e by simp [F]]
    apply Set.Finite.isClosed_biUnion (Set.toFinite Set.univ)
    intro i _
    apply Set.Finite.isClosed_biUnion (Set.toFinite Set.univ)
    intro e _
    exact (isClosed_closedRealizedCell R e).vadd _
  have hopenToCells :
      (⋃ i : Fin m, c i +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume]
        ⋃ i : Fin m, ⋃ e : Fin C.cellCount, c i +ᵥ realizedCell R e := by
    apply Filter.EventuallyEq.iUnion
    intro i
    exact translatedRegion_ae_cells R (c i)
  have hboxF : ∀ᵐ z ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
      z ∈ semanticLocalBox R B N → z ∈ F := by
    filter_upwards [hcover, hopenToCells] with z hzcover hzEq
    intro hzbox
    have hzCells := hzEq.mp (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨_, hzcover hzbox |>.choose_spec⟩)
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hzCells
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hi
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := he
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, w,
      ⟨le_of_lt hw.1, le_of_lt hw.2.1, le_of_lt hw.2.2.1, le_of_lt hw.2.2.2⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  rw [coverageFormula, Formula.Holds]
  rintro ⟨u, v, huv⟩
  rw [uncoveredPointBody_holds] at huv
  rcases huv with ⟨hbox, hout⟩
  let z : Tiling.Plane := (u : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hzbox : z ∈ semanticLocalBox R B N := by
    simpa [z, semanticLocalBox] using hbox
  have hznotF : z ∉ F := by
    intro hzF
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hzF
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hi
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hzw⟩ := he
    have hcoords : w.re = u - x i ∧ w.im = v - y i := by
      have hre := congrArg Complex.re hzw
      have him := congrArg Complex.im hzw
      dsimp [c, z] at hre him
      simp at hre him
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    exact hout i e (by
      dsimp [closedRealizedCell] at hw
      rcases hw with ⟨hl, hr, hb, ht⟩
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩)
  have hnonempty : (semanticLocalBox R B N \ F).Nonempty := ⟨z, hzbox, hznotF⟩
  have hzero : MeasureTheory.volume (semanticLocalBox R B N \ F) = 0 := by
    have hnull := MeasureTheory.ae_iff.mp hboxF
    rw [show semanticLocalBox R B N \ F =
      {q | ¬(q ∈ semanticLocalBox R B N → q ∈ F)} by ext q; simp]
    exact hnull
  exact (semanticLocalBox_isOpen R B N).sdiff hFclosed |>.measure_ne_zero
    MeasureTheory.volume hnonempty hzero

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.LocalCoverSearch.packing_adequate
statement:
theorem packing_adequate {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C) (m : Nat) x y :
    (packingFormula C m).Holds R x y ↔
      ∀ i j : Fin m, i ≠ j →
        MeasureTheory.volume
          ((((x i : ℂ) + (y i : ℂ) * Complex.I) +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier) ∩
           (((x j : ℂ) + (y j : ℂ) * Complex.I) +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [packingFormula, listAnd_holds]
  simp only [List.mem_flatten, List.mem_ofFn]
  constructor
  · intro h i j hij
    rw [translatedRegions_inter_null_iff_cells]
    intro e f
    rw [translatedCells_inter_null_iff]
    have hp := h (centrePairPacking C m i j)
      ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨j, rfl⟩⟩
    simp only [centrePairPacking, if_neg hij, Formula.Holds] at hp
    have hs := hp.2
    rw [cellPairsSeparated, listAnd_holds] at hs
    have hef := hs (cellPairSeparated C m i j e f)
      (List.mem_flatten.mpr ⟨_, List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨e, rfl⟩,
        List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨f, rfl⟩⟩)
    rw [cellPairSeparated, listOr_holds] at hef
    simpa [cellPairSeparated, horizontalLe, verticalLe, Formula.Holds,
      evalAffine_variableExpr, evalAffine_translatedExpr,
      Coeff.cellLeft, Coeff.cellRight, Coeff.cellBottom, Coeff.cellTop,
      evalCoeff, Coeff.single, sum_indicator, CoordSort.axis,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord] using hef
  · intro h f hf
    obtain ⟨row, ⟨i, rfl⟩, hf⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hf
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp [centrePairPacking, Formula.Holds]
    · simp only [centrePairPacking, if_neg hij, Formula.Holds]
      constructor
      · rw [distinctCentres, listOr_holds]
        have hxy : x i ≠ x j ∨ y i ≠ y j := by
          by_contra hn
          push Not at hn
          have hz := h i j hij
          have hcentres : (x i : ℂ) + (y i : ℂ) * Complex.I =
              (x j : ℂ) + (y j : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
            apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hn.1, hn.2]
          rw [hcentres, Set.inter_self] at hz
          rw [MeasureTheory.measure_vadd] at hz
          have hne := (R.region.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty R.region.nonempty)
          exact (isOpen_interior.measure_ne_zero MeasureTheory.volume hne) hz
        rcases hxy with hx | hy
        · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hx with hlt | hgt
          · refine ⟨horizontalLt (variableExpr C m i) (variableExpr C m j), by simp, ?_⟩
            simpa [horizontalLt, Formula.Holds, evalAffine_variableExpr]
          · refine ⟨horizontalLt (variableExpr C m j) (variableExpr C m i), by simp, ?_⟩
            simpa [horizontalLt, Formula.Holds, evalAffine_variableExpr] using hgt
        · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hy with hlt | hgt
          · refine ⟨verticalLt (variableExpr C m i) (variableExpr C m j), by simp, ?_⟩
            simpa [verticalLt, Formula.Holds, evalAffine_variableExpr]
          · refine ⟨verticalLt (variableExpr C m j) (variableExpr C m i), by simp, ?_⟩
            simpa [verticalLt, Formula.Holds, evalAffine_variableExpr] using hgt
      · rw [cellPairsSeparated, listAnd_holds]
        intro g hg
        obtain ⟨row, he, hg⟩ := List.mem_flatten.mp hg
        obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp he
        obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hg
        rw [cellPairSeparated, listOr_holds]
        have hc := (translatedRegions_inter_null_iff_cells R
          ((x i : ℂ) + (y i : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          ((x j : ℂ) + (y j : ℂ) * Complex.I)).mp (h i j hij) e f
        rw [translatedCells_inter_null_iff] at hc
        simpa [cellPairSeparated, horizontalLe, verticalLe, Formula.Holds,
          evalAffine_variableExpr, evalAffine_translatedExpr,
          Coeff.cellLeft, Coeff.cellRight, Coeff.cellBottom, Coeff.cellTop,
          evalCoeff, Coeff.single, sum_indicator, CoordSort.axis,
          Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord] using hc

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.LocalCoverSearch.contributor_coordinate_bounds
statement:
private theorem contributor_coordinate_bounds {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C)
    (O : CorrectOracle C R) (B : LocalBoundCode C)
    (hB : buildLocalBound C O.toOracle = some B) (N : Nat) (s : Tiling.Plane)
    (hs : MeasureTheory.volume
      ((s +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier) ∩ semanticLocalBox R B N) ≠ 0) :
    -(N + 1) * evalCoeff R .horizontal B.horizontalDiameter ≤ s.re ∧
    s.re ≤ (N + 1) * evalCoeff R .horizontal B.horizontalDiameter ∧
    -(N + 1) * evalCoeff R .vertical B.verticalDiameter ≤ s.im ∧
    s.im ≤ (N + 1) * evalCoeff R .vertical B.verticalDiameter
proof:
:= by
  have hae := (translatedRegion_ae_cells R s).inter
    (Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl : semanticLocalBox R B N =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume]
      semanticLocalBox R B N)
  have hunion : MeasureTheory.volume
      (((⋃ e, s +ᵥ realizedCell R e) ∩ semanticLocalBox R B N)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact hs (hae.measure_eq.trans hz)
  have hex : ∃ e, MeasureTheory.volume
      ((s +ᵥ realizedCell R e) ∩ semanticLocalBox R B N) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    push Not at hn
    apply hunion
    rw [Set.iUnion_inter]
    exact MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion_null hn
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hex
  have hne : ((s +ᵥ realizedCell R e) ∩ semanticLocalBox R B N).Nonempty :=
    Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr fun hempty => he (by simp [hempty])
  obtain ⟨z, ⟨k, hk, hzk⟩, hzbox⟩ := hne
  have hdiam := buildLocalBound_adequate R O B hB
  have hkReLo := hdiam.1 (C.leftVertex e) C.originVertex
  have hkReHi := hdiam.1 (C.rightVertex e) C.originVertex
  have hkImLo := hdiam.2.1 (C.bottomVertex e) C.originVertex
  have hkImHi := hdiam.2.1 (C.topVertex e) C.originVertex
  rw [R.origin_eq_zero] at hkReLo hkReHi hkImLo hkImHi
  simp only [Complex.zero_re, Complex.zero_im, sub_zero, abs_le] at hkReLo hkReHi hkImLo hkImHi
  have hcoords : z.re = s.re + k.re ∧ z.im = s.im + k.im := by
    subst z
    simp [vadd_eq_add]
  rcases hk with ⟨hkl, hkr, hkb, hkt⟩
  dsimp [semanticLocalBox] at hzbox
  constructor
  · linarith [hkReHi.1, hkReLo.1]
  constructor
  · linarith [hkReHi.2, hkReLo.2]
  constructor
  · linarith [hkImHi.1, hkImLo.1]
  · linarith [hkImHi.2, hkImLo.2]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.LocalCoverSearch.ae_coveredByContributors
statement:
private theorem ae_coveredByContributors {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C)
    (B : LocalBoundCode C) (N : Nat) (S : Set Tiling.Plane)
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking R.region.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (R.region.toPolygonalRegion.placements S))
    (hmult : ∀ᵐ z ∂MeasureTheory.volume, z ∈ semanticLocalBox R B N →
      Set.ncard {s : Tiling.Plane | s ∈ S ∧ z ∈ s +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier} = 1) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂MeasureTheory.volume, z ∈ semanticLocalBox R B N →
      ∃ s, s ∈ S ∧
        MeasureTheory.volume ((s +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier) ∩ semanticLocalBox R B N) ≠ 0 ∧
        z ∈ s +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  let F : Set Tiling.Plane := {s | s ∈ S ∧
    MeasureTheory.volume ((s +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier) ∩ semanticLocalBox R B N) ≠ 0}
  let D : Set Tiling.Plane := S \ F
  have hDcount : D.Countable :=
    (Tiling.AxisParallel.IsPacking.locallyFinite_centres hpacking).2.mono Set.sdiff_subset
  let _ : Encodable D := hDcount.toEncodable
  let U : Set Tiling.Plane := ⋃ d : D,
    ((d.1 +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier) ∩ semanticLocalBox R B N)
  have hUzero : MeasureTheory.volume U = 0 := by
    apply MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion_null
    intro d
    by_contra hd
    exact d.2.2 ⟨d.2.1, hd⟩
  have havoid : ∀ᵐ z ∂MeasureTheory.volume, z ∉ U :=
    MeasureTheory.ae_iff.mpr (by simpa only [not_not, Set.ofPred_mem_eq] using hUzero)
  filter_upwards [hmult, havoid] with z hzmult hzavoid
  intro hzbox
  obtain ⟨s, hsone⟩ := Set.ncard_eq_one.mp (hzmult hzbox)
  have hsMem : s ∈ {s : Tiling.Plane | s ∈ S ∧
      z ∈ s +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier} := hsone.symm ▸ Set.mem_singleton s
  rcases hsMem with ⟨hsS, hzs⟩
  refine ⟨s, hsS, ?_, hzs⟩
  by_contra hsnull
  have hsnotF : s ∉ F := by
    intro hsF
    exact hsF.2 hsnull
  exact hzavoid (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨s, hsS, hsnotF⟩, hzs, hzbox⟩)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.LocalCoverSearch.relevanceFormula_of_coordinate_bounds
statement:
private theorem relevanceFormula_of_coordinate_bounds {C : RegionCode}
    (R : Realization C) (B : LocalBoundCode C) (N m : Nat)
    (x y : Fin m → Real)
    (h : ∀ i,
      -(N + 1) * evalCoeff R .horizontal B.horizontalDiameter ≤ x i ∧
      x i ≤ (N + 1) * evalCoeff R .horizontal B.horizontalDiameter ∧
      -(N + 1) * evalCoeff R .vertical B.verticalDiameter ≤ y i ∧
      y i ≤ (N + 1) * evalCoeff R .vertical B.verticalDiameter) :
    (relevanceFormula C B N m).Holds R x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [relevanceFormula, listAnd_holds]
  intro f hf
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hf
  simp only [withinBoundHorizontal, withinBoundVertical, Formula.Holds,
    horizontalLe, verticalLe, evalAffine_constantExpr, evalAffine_variableExpr,
    evalCoeff_neg, evalCoeff_nsmul]
  rcases h i with ⟨hxl, hxr, hyl, hyr⟩
  norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hxl hxr hyl hyr ⊢
  constructor
  · constructor <;> linarith
  · constructor <;> linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.LocalCoverSearch.semanticLocalPacking_formulaWitness
statement:
theorem semanticLocalPacking_formulaWitness {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C)
    (O : CorrectOracle C R) (B : LocalBoundCode C)
    (hB : buildLocalBound C O.toOracle = some B) (N : Nat) (S : Set Tiling.Plane)
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking R.region.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (R.region.toPolygonalRegion.placements S))
    (hmult : ∀ᵐ z ∂MeasureTheory.volume, z ∈ semanticLocalBox R B N →
      Set.ncard {s : Tiling.Plane | s ∈ S ∧ z ∈ s +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier} = 1) :
    ∃ (m : Nat) (x y : Fin m → Real),
      (packingFormula C m).Holds R x y ∧
      (relevanceFormula C B N m).Holds R x y ∧
      (coverageFormula C B N m).Holds R x y
proof:
:= by
  let F : Set Tiling.Plane := {s | s ∈ S ∧
    MeasureTheory.volume ((s +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier) ∩ semanticLocalBox R B N) ≠ 0}
  have hFfinite : F.Finite := contributingCentres_finite R O B hB N S hpacking
  let _ : Fintype F := hFfinite.fintype
  let m := Fintype.card F
  let e : Fin m ≃ F := (Fintype.equivFin F).symm
  let x : Fin m → Real := fun i => (e i : Tiling.Plane).re
  let y : Fin m → Real := fun i => (e i : Tiling.Plane).im
  refine ⟨m, x, y, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [packing_adequate]
    intro i j hij
    have heij : (e i : Tiling.Plane) ≠ e j := fun h => hij (e.injective (Subtype.ext h))
    have hd := (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint R.region S).mp hpacking
      (e i).2.1 (e j).2.1 heij
    have hempty : ((e i : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier) ∩
        ((e j : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier) = ∅ := Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp hd
    simpa [x, y, Complex.ext_iff] using congrArg MeasureTheory.volume hempty
  · apply relevanceFormula_of_coordinate_bounds
    intro i
    simpa [x, y] using contributor_coordinate_bounds R O B hB N (e i) (e i).2.2
  · apply coverageFormula_of_ae_cover
    filter_upwards [ae_coveredByContributors R B N S hpacking hmult] with z hz
    intro hzbox
    obtain ⟨s, hsS, hsvol, hzs⟩ := hz hzbox
    have hsF : s ∈ F := ⟨hsS, hsvol⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.surjective ⟨s, hsF⟩
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    have hcenter : (e i : Tiling.Plane) = s := congrArg Subtype.val hi
    simpa [x, y, Complex.ext_iff, hcenter] using hzs

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.LocalCoverSearch.subdivisionIndex_eq_implies_sub_lt
statement:
private theorem subdivisionIndex_eq_implies_sub_lt (q : Nat) (A w x y : Real)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hw : 0 < w) (hspan : 2 * A < q * w)
    (hx : -A ≤ x ∧ x ≤ A) (hy : -A ≤ y ∧ y ≤ A)
    (heq : subdivisionIndex q A w x hq hw hspan hx =
      subdivisionIndex q A w y hq hw hspan hy) : |x - y| < w
proof:
:= by
  have hfx : 0 ≤ ⌊(x + A) / w⌋ := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr
    (div_nonneg (by linarith) (le_of_lt hw))
  have hfy : 0 ≤ ⌊(y + A) / w⌋ := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr
    (div_nonneg (by linarith) (le_of_lt hw))
  have hnat : Int.toNat ⌊(x + A) / w⌋ = Int.toNat ⌊(y + A) / w⌋ :=
    congrArg Fin.val heq
  have hfloor : ⌊(x + A) / w⌋ = ⌊(y + A) / w⌋ := by
    rw [← Int.toNat_of_nonneg hfx, ← Int.toNat_of_nonneg hfy, hnat]
  have hxl := Int.floor_le ((x + A) / w)
  have hxu := Int.lt_floor_add_one ((x + A) / w)
  have hyl := Int.floor_le ((y + A) / w)
  have hyu := Int.lt_floor_add_one ((y + A) / w)
  rw [hfloor] at hxl hxu
  rw [abs_lt]
  constructor <;> (rw [div_lt_iff₀ hw] at hxu hyu; rw [le_div_iff₀ hw] at hxl hyl) <;>
    linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.LocalCoverSearch.coordinate_bounds_of_relevanceFormula
statement:
private theorem coordinate_bounds_of_relevanceFormula {C : RegionCode}
    (R : Realization C) (B : LocalBoundCode C) (N m : Nat)
    (x y : Fin m → Real) (h : (relevanceFormula C B N m).Holds R x y) :
    ∀ i,
      -(N + 1) * evalCoeff R .horizontal B.horizontalDiameter ≤ x i ∧
      x i ≤ (N + 1) * evalCoeff R .horizontal B.horizontalDiameter ∧
      -(N + 1) * evalCoeff R .vertical B.verticalDiameter ≤ y i ∧
      y i ≤ (N + 1) * evalCoeff R .vertical B.verticalDiameter
proof:
:= by
  rw [relevanceFormula, listAnd_holds] at h
  intro i
  have hi := h _ (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  simp only [withinBoundHorizontal, withinBoundVertical, Formula.Holds,
    horizontalLe, verticalLe, evalAffine_constantExpr, evalAffine_variableExpr,
    evalCoeff_neg, evalCoeff_nsmul] at hi
  rcases hi with ⟨⟨hxl, hxr⟩, hyl, hyr⟩
  norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hxl hxr hyl hyr ⊢
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.LocalCoverSearch.relevantPacking_cardinality
statement:
theorem relevantPacking_cardinality {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C)
    (O : CorrectOracle C R) (B : LocalBoundCode C)
    (hB : buildLocalBound C O.toOracle = some B) (c : RawNegativeCode)
    (hc : subdivisionWellFormed c = true)
    (hsub : (positiveSubdivisionFormula C B c).Holds R Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0)
    {m : Nat} (x y : Fin m → Real)
    (hpack : (packingFormula C m).Holds R x y)
    (hrel : (relevanceFormula C B c.boxIndex m).Holds R x y) :
    m ≤ localCardinalityBound c
proof:
:= by
  have hcpos : 0 < c.boxIndex ∧ 0 < c.horizontalSubdivisions ∧
      0 < c.verticalSubdivisions := by
    have h := (by simpa [subdivisionWellFormed, Bool.and_eq_true] using hc :
      (0 < c.boxIndex ∧ 0 < c.horizontalSubdivisions) ∧ 0 < c.verticalSubdivisions)
    exact ⟨h.1.1, h.1.2, h.2⟩
  have hs := (positiveSubdivision_adequate R B c).mp hsub
  have hb := buildLocalBound_adequate R O B hB
  let wx := evalCoeff R .horizontal B.horizontalWidth
  let wy := evalCoeff R .vertical B.verticalWidth
  let Ax := (c.boxIndex + 1) * evalCoeff R .horizontal B.horizontalDiameter
  let Ay := (c.boxIndex + 1) * evalCoeff R .vertical B.verticalDiameter
  have hwx : 0 < wx := by
    dsimp [wx]
    rw [hb.2.2.1]
    linarith [R.left_lt_right B.widthCell]
  have hwy : 0 < wy := by
    dsimp [wy]
    rw [hb.2.2.2]
    linarith [R.bottom_lt_top B.widthCell]
  have hsx : 2 * Ax < c.horizontalSubdivisions * wx := by
    dsimp [Ax, wx]
    nlinarith [hs.1]
  have hsy : 2 * Ay < c.verticalSubdivisions * wy := by
    dsimp [Ay, wy]
    nlinarith [hs.2]
  have hbounds := coordinate_bounds_of_relevanceFormula R B c.boxIndex m x y hrel
  have hxbound : ∀ i, -Ax ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ Ax := by
    intro i
    dsimp [Ax]
    rcases hbounds i with ⟨hxl, hxr, -⟩
    norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hxl hxr ⊢
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hybound : ∀ i, -Ay ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ Ay := by
    intro i
    dsimp [Ay]
    rcases hbounds i with ⟨-, -, hyl, hyr⟩
    norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hyl hyr ⊢
    constructor <;> linarith
  let f : Fin m → Fin c.horizontalSubdivisions × Fin c.verticalSubdivisions := fun i =>
    (subdivisionIndex c.horizontalSubdivisions Ax wx (x i) hcpos.2.1 hwx hsx
      (hxbound i),
     subdivisionIndex c.verticalSubdivisions Ay wy (y i) hcpos.2.2 hwy hsy
      (hybound i))
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro i j hij
    by_contra hne
    have hxclose := subdivisionIndex_eq_implies_sub_lt
      c.horizontalSubdivisions Ax wx (x i) (x j) hcpos.2.1 hwx hsx
      (hxbound i) (hxbound j)
      (congrArg Prod.fst hij)
    have hyclose := subdivisionIndex_eq_implies_sub_lt
      c.verticalSubdivisions Ay wy (y i) (y j) hcpos.2.2 hwy hsy
      (hybound i) (hybound j) (congrArg Prod.snd hij)
    have hp := (packing_adequate R m x y).mp hpack i j hne
    have hcell := (translatedRegions_inter_null_iff_cells R
      ((x i : ℂ) + (y i : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      ((x j : ℂ) + (y j : ℂ) * Complex.I)).mp hp
      B.widthCell B.widthCell
    rw [translatedCells_inter_null_iff] at hcell
    rcases hcell with hsep | hsep | hsep | hsep
    all_goals rw [abs_lt] at hxclose hyclose
    · dsimp [wx] at hwx hxclose
      rw [hb.2.2.1] at hxclose
      linarith
    · dsimp [wx] at hwx hxclose
      rw [hb.2.2.1] at hxclose
      linarith
    · dsimp [wy] at hwy hyclose
      rw [hb.2.2.2] at hyclose
      linarith
    · dsimp [wy] at hwy hyclose
      rw [hb.2.2.2] at hyclose
      linarith
  change m ≤ c.horizontalSubdivisions * c.verticalSubdivisions
  simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.LocalCoverSearch.localCoverFormula_sound
statement:
theorem localCoverFormula_sound {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C)
    (B : LocalBoundCode C) (N m : Nat)
    (hformula : (localCoverFormula C B N m).Holds R Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0) :
    ∃ S : Set Tiling.Plane, S.Finite ∧
      Tiling.IsPacking R.region.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (R.region.toPolygonalRegion.placements S) ∧
      (∀ᵐ z ∂volume, z ∈ semanticLocalBox R B N →
        ∃ s ∈ S, z ∈ s +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hpack, _hrel, hcoverage⟩ :=
    localCover_adequate R B N m |>.mp hformula
  change ¬ ∃ u v : Real, _ at hcoverage
  let centre : Fin m → Tiling.Plane := fun i =>
    (x i : ℂ) + (y i : ℂ) * Complex.I
  let S : Set Tiling.Plane := Set.range centre
  have hfinite : S.Finite := Set.finite_range centre
  have hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking R.region.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (R.region.toPolygonalRegion.placements S) := by
    apply (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint R.region S).mpr
    intro s hs t ht hst
    rcases hs with ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rcases ht with ⟨j, rfl⟩
    have hij : i ≠ j := by
      intro hij
      apply hst
      simp [hij]
    have hvol := (packing_adequate R m x y).mp hpack i j hij
    apply Set.disjoint_left.2
    intro z hzi hzj
    have hopen : IsOpen ((centre i +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier) ∩
        (centre j +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier)) :=
      (R.region.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd _).inter
        (R.region.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd _)
    have hne : ((centre i +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier) ∩
        (centre j +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier)).Nonempty := ⟨z, hzi, hzj⟩
    exact (hopen.measure_ne_zero volume hne) (by simpa [centre] using hvol)
  have hclosed : ∀ z ∈ semanticLocalBox R B N, ∃ i : Fin m, ∃ e : Fin C.cellCount,
      z ∈ centre i +ᵥ closedRealizedCell R e := by
    intro z hz
    by_contra hnone
    apply hcoverage
    refine ⟨z.re, z.im, ?_⟩
    apply (uncoveredPointBody_holds R B N m x y z.re z.im).mpr
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [semanticLocalBox] using hz
    · intro i e hcell
      apply hnone
      refine ⟨i, e, ?_⟩
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      simpa [centre, closedRealizedCell, vadd_eq_add] using hcell
  have volume_re_eq_zero_local (a : ℝ) :
      volume {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = a} = 0 := by
    let H : Set Tiling.Plane := {z | z.re = a}
    have hclosedH : IsClosed H := isClosed_eq Complex.continuous_re continuous_const
    have hinter : interior H = ∅ := by
      apply Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp
      rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
      obtain ⟨ε, hε, hwε⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp isOpen_interior w hw
      have hw' := hwε (show w + (ε / 2 : ℝ) ∈ Metric.ball w ε by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq]
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε] using half_lt_self hε)
      have hwmem : w ∈ H := interior_subset hw
      have hw'mem : w + (ε / 2 : ℝ) ∈ H := interior_subset hw'
      have hwre : w.re = a := hwmem
      have hw're : (w + (ε / 2 : ℝ)).re = a := hw'mem
      simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re] at hw're
      linarith
    have hfrontier : frontier H = H := by
      rw [frontier, hclosedH.closure_eq, hinter, sdiff_empty]
    change volume H = 0
    rw [← hfrontier]
    exact (convex_hyperplane Complex.reLm.isLinear a).addHaar_frontier volume
  have volume_im_eq_zero_local (a : ℝ) :
      volume {z : Tiling.Plane | z.im = a} = 0 := by
    let H : Set Tiling.Plane := {z | z.im = a}
    have hclosedH : IsClosed H := isClosed_eq Complex.continuous_im continuous_const
    have hinter : interior H = ∅ := by
      apply Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp
      rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
      obtain ⟨ε, hε, hwε⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp isOpen_interior w hw
      have hw' := hwε (show w + (ε / 2 : ℝ) * Complex.I ∈ Metric.ball w ε by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq]
        simpa [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε] using half_lt_self hε)
      have hwmem : w ∈ H := interior_subset hw
      have hw'mem : w + (ε / 2 : ℝ) * Complex.I ∈ H := interior_subset hw'
      have hwim : w.im = a := hwmem
      have hw'im : (w + (ε / 2 : ℝ) * Complex.I).im = a := hw'mem
      simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im,
        Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, mul_one, zero_mul, add_zero] at hw'im
      linarith
    have hfrontier : frontier H = H := by
      rw [frontier, hclosedH.closure_eq, hinter, sdiff_empty]
    change volume H = 0
    rw [← hfrontier]
    exact (convex_hyperplane Complex.imLm.isLinear a).addHaar_frontier volume
  let U : Set Tiling.Plane := ⋃ i : Fin m, ⋃ e : Fin C.cellCount,
      centre i +ᵥ realizedCell R e
  let V : Set Tiling.Plane := ⋃ i : Fin m, ⋃ e : Fin C.cellCount,
    ({z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = (centre i).re +
        (R.vertex (C.leftVertex e)).re} ∪
      ({z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = (centre i).re +
        (R.vertex (C.rightVertex e)).re} ∪
        ({z : Tiling.Plane | z.im = (centre i).im +
          (R.vertex (C.bottomVertex e)).im} ∪
          {z : Tiling.Plane | z.im = (centre i).im +
            (R.vertex (C.topVertex e)).im})))
  have hboundary : volume (semanticLocalBox R B N \ U) = 0 := by
    refine measure_mono_null (s := semanticLocalBox R B N \ U) (t := V) ?_ ?_
    · intro z hz
      change z ∈ ⋃ i : Fin m, ⋃ e : Fin C.cellCount, _
      obtain ⟨i, e, hzc⟩ := hclosed z hz.1
      have hnotopen : z ∉ centre i +ᵥ realizedCell R e := by
        intro hopen
        exact hz.2 (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, hopen⟩⟩)
      obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hzc
      have hwclosed : w ∈ closedRealizedCell R e := hw
      have hboundary' :
          w.re = (R.vertex (C.leftVertex e)).re ∨
          w.re = (R.vertex (C.rightVertex e)).re ∨
          w.im = (R.vertex (C.bottomVertex e)).im ∨
          w.im = (R.vertex (C.topVertex e)).im := by
        by_contra hnb
        push Not at hnb
        have hwopen : w ∈ realizedCell R e := by
          dsimp [realizedCell, openRectangle]
          exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hwclosed.1 hnb.1.symm,
            lt_of_le_of_ne hwclosed.2.1 hnb.2.1,
            lt_of_le_of_ne hwclosed.2.2.1 hnb.2.2.1.symm,
            lt_of_le_of_ne hwclosed.2.2.2 hnb.2.2.2⟩
        exact hnotopen ⟨w, hwopen, rfl⟩
      rcases hboundary' with h | h | h | h
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e,
          Or.inl (by simpa [centre, vadd_eq_add] using h)⟩⟩
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e,
          Or.inr (Or.inl (by simpa [centre, vadd_eq_add] using h))⟩⟩
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e,
          Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (by simpa [centre, vadd_eq_add] using h)))⟩⟩
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e,
          Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (by simpa [centre, vadd_eq_add] using h)))⟩⟩
    · dsimp [V]
      apply measure_iUnion_null
      intro i
      apply measure_iUnion_null
      intro e
      apply measure_union_null
      · exact volume_re_eq_zero_local _
      · apply measure_union_null
        · exact volume_re_eq_zero_local _
        · apply measure_union_null
          · exact volume_im_eq_zero_local _
          · exact volume_im_eq_zero_local _
  have hEq : (⋃ i : Fin m, centre i +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier) =ᵐ[volume] U := by
    apply Filter.EventuallyEq.iUnion
    intro i
    exact translatedRegion_ae_cells R (centre i)
  have hnot : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, z ∉ semanticLocalBox R B N \ U :=
    MeasureTheory.ae_iff.mpr (by simpa only [not_not, Set.ofPred_mem_eq] using hboundary)
  refine ⟨S, hfinite, hpacking, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hnot, hEq] with z hznot hzEq hzbox
  have hzU : z ∈ U := by
    by_contra hzU
    exact hznot ⟨hzbox, hzU⟩
  have hzopen : z ∈ ⋃ i : Fin m, centre i +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier := hzEq.mpr hzU
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hzopen
  exact ⟨centre i, Set.mem_range.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩, hi⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.positiveStageProgram_evaluate
statement:
theorem positiveStageProgram_evaluate : ∀ (C : RegionCode) (O : Oracle C) n,
    OracleProgram.evaluate O.answer (positiveStageProgram C n) = positiveStage C O n
proof:
:= by
  intro C O n
  cases h : wellFormedPositiveStage n with
  | none =>
      simp only [positiveStageProgram, h, OracleProgram.evaluate]
      rw [positiveStage, verifyPositiveStage, h]
  | some code =>
      rw [positiveStageProgram, h]
      simpa [positiveStage, verifyPositiveStage, h] using
        (PositiveVerification.verifyPositiveProgram_evaluate C O code)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.negativeStageProgram_evaluate
statement:
theorem negativeStageProgram_evaluate : ∀ (C : RegionCode) (O : Oracle C) n,
    OracleProgram.evaluate O.answer (negativeStageProgram C n) = negativeStage C O n
proof:
:= by
  intro C O n
  rw [negativeStageProgram, OracleProgram.evaluate_bind,
    LocalCoverSearch.buildLocalBoundProgram_evaluate]
  cases hbound : buildLocalBound C O with
  | none =>
      simp only [OracleProgram.evaluate]
      simp [negativeStage, hbound]
  | some B =>
      cases hcode : wellFormedNegativeStage n with
      | none =>
          simp only [OracleProgram.evaluate]
          simp [negativeStage, hbound, hcode]
      | some code =>
          rw [LocalCoverSearch.negativeVerifierProgram_evaluate]
          simp [negativeStage, hbound, hcode]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.dovetailStepProgram_evaluate
proof:
:= by
  rw [dovetailStepProgram, OracleProgram.evaluate_bind,
    positiveStageProgram_evaluate]
  by_cases hp : positiveStage C O n
  · simp [dovetailStep, hp, OracleProgram.evaluate]
  · simp only [hp, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [OracleProgram.evaluate_bind, negativeStageProgram_evaluate]
    simp [dovetailStep, hp, OracleProgram.evaluate]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.decisionThroughProgram_evaluate
statement:
theorem decisionThroughProgram_evaluate : ∀ (C : RegionCode) (O : Oracle C) fuel,
    OracleProgram.evaluate O.answer (decisionThroughProgram C fuel) =
      decisionThrough C O fuel
proof:
:= by
  intro C O fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
      exact dovetailStepProgram_evaluate C O 0
  | succ fuel ih =>
      rw [decisionThroughProgram, OracleProgram.evaluate_bind, ih]
      cases h : decisionThrough C O fuel with
      | some answer =>
          have hrun : runThrough (positiveStage C O) (negativeStage C O) fuel =
              some answer := by simpa [decisionThrough] using h
          rw [decisionThrough]
          simp [runThrough, hrun, OracleProgram.evaluate]
      | none =>
          rw [dovetailStepProgram_evaluate]
          have hrun : runThrough (positiveStage C O) (negativeStage C O) fuel = none := by
            simpa [decisionThrough] using h
          rw [decisionThrough]
          simp [runThrough, hrun]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.runThrough_none_iff
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
      constructor
      · intro h n hn
        have hn0 : n = 0 := by omega
        subst n
        simpa [runThrough] using h
      · intro h
        simpa [runThrough] using h 0 (by omega)
  | succ fuel ih =>
      constructor
      · intro h n hn
        cases hrun : runThrough positive negative fuel with
        | some answer => simp [runThrough, hrun] at h
        | none =>
            by_cases hlast : n = fuel + 1
            · subst n
              simpa [runThrough, hrun] using h
            · have hnold : n ≤ fuel := by omega
              exact (ih.mp hrun) n hnold
      · intro h
        have hold : runThrough positive negative fuel = none :=
          ih.mpr (fun n hn => h n (by omega))
        have hlast : dovetailStep positive negative (fuel + 1) = none :=
          h (fuel + 1) (by omega)
        simp [runThrough, hold, hlast]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.runThrough_some_iff
statement:
private theorem runThrough_some_iff :
    ∀ (positive negative : Nat → Bool) fuel answer,
    runThrough positive negative fuel = some answer ↔
      ∃ n ≤ fuel, dovetailStep positive negative n = some answer ∧
        ∀ k < n, dovetailStep positive negative k = none
proof:
:= by
  intro positive negative fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
      intro answer
      constructor
      · intro h
        refine ⟨0, by omega, h, ?_⟩
        intro k hk
        omega
      · rintro ⟨n, hn, hstep, hnone⟩
        have hn0 : n = 0 := by omega
        subst n
        simpa [runThrough] using hstep
  | succ fuel ih =>
      intro answer
      constructor
      · intro h
        cases hrun : runThrough positive negative fuel with
        | some earlier =>
            have hearlier : earlier = answer := by
              simpa [runThrough, hrun] using h
            subst earlier
            obtain ⟨n, hn, hstep, hnone⟩ := (ih answer).mp hrun
            exact ⟨n, by omega, hstep, hnone⟩
        | none =>
            have hstep : dovetailStep positive negative (fuel + 1) = some answer := by
              simpa [runThrough, hrun] using h
            refine ⟨fuel + 1, by omega, hstep, ?_⟩
            intro k hk
            exact (runThrough_none_iff positive negative fuel).mp hrun k (by omega)
      · rintro ⟨n, hn, hstep, hnone⟩
        by_cases hnold : n ≤ fuel
        · have hrun : runThrough positive negative fuel = some answer :=
            (ih answer).mpr ⟨n, hnold, hstep, hnone⟩
          simp [runThrough, hrun]
        · have hnlast : n = fuel + 1 := by omega
          subst n
          have hrun : runThrough positive negative fuel = none :=
            (runThrough_none_iff positive negative fuel).mpr (fun k hk => hnone k (by omega))
          simp [runThrough, hrun, hstep]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.tilesOn_multiplicity_one
proof:
:= by
  intro K S htiles
  rcases htiles with ⟨hcount, hpack, hcover⟩
  have hdisj := (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K S).mp hpack
  filter_upwards [hcover] with z hz
  have hex : ∃ s : S, z ∈ (s.1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier) := hz.mp (Set.mem_univ z)
  have hcard : {s : Tiling.Plane | s ∈ S ∧ z ∈ s +ᵥ K.openCarrier}.ncard = 1 := by
    apply Set.ncard_eq_one.mpr
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hex
    refine ⟨s.1, ?_⟩
    ext t
    constructor
    · intro ht
      by_cases hst : t = s.1
      · simp [hst]
      · exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdisj ht.1 s.2 hst) ht.2 hs).elim
    · intro ht
      subst t
      exact ⟨s.2, hs⟩
  simpa [LocalPackingCompactness.multiplicity] using hcard

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.negativeStage_sound
statement:
theorem negativeStage_sound :
    ∀ {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C) (O : CorrectOracle C R) n,
      negativeStage C O.toOracle n = true → ¬realizationPlaneTileable R
proof:
:= by
  intro C R O n hstage htile
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := htile
  have hmult : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, multiplicity R.region S z = 1 :=
    tilesOn_multiplicity_one hS
  unfold negativeStage at hstage
  cases hB : buildLocalBound C O.toOracle with
  | none => simp [hB] at hstage
  | some B =>
      cases hc : wellFormedNegativeStage n with
      | none => simp [hB, hc] at hstage
      | some c =>
          simp only [hB, hc] at hstage
          simp only [negativeVerifier, Bool.and_eq_true] at hstage
          have hcheck := hstage.1
          change
            (decide (0 < c.boxIndex && 0 < c.horizontalSubdivisions &&
                0 < c.verticalSubdivisions) &&
                AffineCompiler.decideFormula O.toOracle _) = true at hcheck
          have hparts := hcheck
          simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hparts
          have hsubdiv := hparts.1
          have hsub :=
            (AffineCompiler.decideFormula_correct R O _).mp hparts.2
          have hfail := hstage.2
          change
            (List.range (c.horizontalSubdivisions * c.verticalSubdivisions + 1)).all
              (fun m => !(AffineCompiler.decideFormula O.toOracle
                (localCoverFormula C B c.boxIndex m))) = true at hfail
          obtain ⟨m, x, y, hpack, hrel, hcover⟩ :=
            semanticLocalPacking_formulaWitness R O B hB c.boxIndex S hS.2.1 (by
              filter_upwards [hmult] with z hz hzbox
              simpa [LocalPackingCompactness.multiplicity] using hz)
          have hmle := relevantPacking_cardinality R O B hB c (by
            change decide (0 < c.boxIndex && 0 < c.horizontalSubdivisions &&
              0 < c.verticalSubdivisions) = true
            simpa only [Bool.and_eq_true] using hsubdiv) hsub x y hpack hrel
          have hmle' : m ≤ c.horizontalSubdivisions * c.verticalSubdivisions := hmle
          have hlocal : (localCoverFormula C B c.boxIndex m).Holds R Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 :=
            (localCover_adequate R B c.boxIndex m).2 ⟨x, y, hpack, hrel, hcover⟩
          have hlocalTrue : AffineCompiler.decideFormula O.toOracle
              (localCoverFormula C B c.boxIndex m) = true :=
            (AffineCompiler.decideFormula_correct R O _).mpr hlocal
          have hmemb : m ∈ List.range (c.horizontalSubdivisions * c.verticalSubdivisions + 1) := by
            simp only [List.mem_range]
            omega
          have hnot := (List.all_eq_true.mp hfail) m hmemb
          simp [hlocalTrue] at hnot

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.buildLocalBound_exists
proof:
:= by
  have hcell : 0 < C.cellCount := by
    simpa [RegionCode.wellFormed] using R.wellFormed
  simp [buildLocalBound, hcell]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.localBound_diameters_pos
statement:
private theorem localBound_diameters_pos {C : RegionCode}
    (R : Realization C) (O : CorrectOracle C R) (B : LocalBoundCode C)
    (hB : buildLocalBound C O.toOracle = some B) :
    0 < evalCoeff R .horizontal B.horizontalDiameter ∧
      0 < evalCoeff R .vertical B.verticalDiameter
proof:
:= by
  have hA := buildLocalBound_adequate R O B hB
  have hw : 0 < evalCoeff R .horizontal B.horizontalWidth := by
    rw [hA.2.2.1]
    exact sub_pos.mpr (R.left_lt_right B.widthCell)
  have hv : 0 < evalCoeff R .vertical B.verticalWidth := by
    rw [hA.2.2.2]
    exact sub_pos.mpr (R.bottom_lt_top B.widthCell)
  have hx := hA.1 (C.rightVertex B.widthCell) (C.leftVertex B.widthCell)
  have hy := hA.2.1 (C.topVertex B.widthCell) (C.bottomVertex B.widthCell)
  rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr (R.left_lt_right B.widthCell))] at hx
  rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr (R.bottom_lt_top B.widthCell))] at hy
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.closedBall_subset_semanticLocalBox
statement:
private theorem closedBall_subset_semanticLocalBox {C : RegionCode}
    (R : Realization C) (O : CorrectOracle C R) (B : LocalBoundCode C)
    (hB : buildLocalBound C O.toOracle = some B) :
    ∀ ballRadius : Nat, ∃ boxIndex : Nat, 0 < boxIndex ∧
      Metric.closedBall (0 : Tiling.Plane) ballRadius ⊆
        semanticLocalBox R B boxIndex
proof:
:= by
  intro ballRadius
  have hpos := localBound_diameters_pos R O B hB
  let dh := evalCoeff R .horizontal B.horizontalDiameter
  let dv := evalCoeff R .vertical B.verticalDiameter
  obtain ⟨boxIndex, hbox⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((ballRadius : ℝ) / min dh dv)
  have hmin : 0 < min dh dv := lt_min hpos.1 hpos.2
  have hball : (ballRadius : ℝ) < boxIndex * min dh dv := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hmin] at hbox
    simpa [Nat.cast_mul] using hbox
  refine ⟨boxIndex + 1, Nat.succ_pos _, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hzdist : ‖z‖ ≤ (ballRadius : ℝ) := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz
  have hre : |z.re| ≤ (ballRadius : ℝ) :=
    (Complex.abs_re_le_norm z).trans hzdist
  have him : |z.im| ≤ (ballRadius : ℝ) :=
    (Complex.abs_im_le_norm z).trans hzdist
  dsimp [semanticLocalBox, dh, dv]
  have hmulh : (ballRadius : ℝ) < (boxIndex + 1) * dh := by
    have hm : min dh dv ≤ dh := min_le_left _ _
    have hb' : (ballRadius : ℝ) < (boxIndex : ℝ) * min dh dv := hball
    have hn : (boxIndex : ℝ) ≤ (boxIndex + 1 : Nat) := by norm_num
    nlinarith
  have hmulv : (ballRadius : ℝ) < (boxIndex + 1) * dv := by
    have hm : min dh dv ≤ dv := min_le_right _ _
    have hb' : (ballRadius : ℝ) < (boxIndex : ℝ) * min dh dv := hball
    have hn : (boxIndex : ℝ) ≤ (boxIndex + 1 : Nat) := by norm_num
    nlinarith
  have hre_lo : -((boxIndex + 1 : ℝ) * dh) < z.re :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (neg_lt_neg hmulh) (neg_le_of_abs_le hre)
  have hre_hi : z.re < (boxIndex + 1) * dh :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self z.re |>.trans hre) hmulh
  have him_lo : -((boxIndex + 1 : ℝ) * dv) < z.im :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (neg_lt_neg hmulv) (neg_le_of_abs_le him)
  have him_hi : z.im < (boxIndex + 1) * dv :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self z.im |>.trans him) hmulv
  simpa [dh, dv, Nat.cast_add] using (show
    -((boxIndex + 1 : ℝ) * dh) < z.re ∧
      z.re < (boxIndex + 1 : ℝ) * dh ∧
      -((boxIndex + 1 : ℝ) * dv) < z.im ∧
      z.im < (boxIndex + 1 : ℝ) * dv from
    ⟨hre_lo, hre_hi, him_lo, him_hi⟩)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.localCoverFormula_to_semanticPacking
statement:
private theorem localCoverFormula_to_semanticPacking {C : RegionCode}
    (R : Realization C) (B : LocalBoundCode C) N m
    (hformula : (localCoverFormula C B N m).Holds R Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0) :
    ∃ S : Set Tiling.Plane,
      Tiling.IsPacking R.region.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (R.region.toPolygonalRegion.placements S) ∧
      ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, z ∈ semanticLocalBox R B N →
        multiplicity R.region S z = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, _hfinite, hpacking, hcover⟩ :=
    localCoverFormula_sound R B N m hformula
  have hdisj := (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint R.region S).mp hpacking
  refine ⟨S, hpacking, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hcover] with z hz
  intro hzbox
  obtain ⟨s, hsS, hzs⟩ := hz hzbox
  have hcard : {t : Tiling.Plane | t ∈ S ∧ z ∈ t +ᵥ R.region.openCarrier}.ncard = 1 := by
    apply Set.ncard_eq_one.mpr
    refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
    ext t
    constructor
    · intro ht
      by_cases hst : t = s
      · simp [hst]
      · exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdisj ht.1 hsS hst) ht.2 hzs).elim
    · intro ht
      subst t
      exact ⟨hsS, hzs⟩
  simpa [LocalPackingCompactness.multiplicity] using hcard

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.semanticBoxCover_restrict_closedBall
statement:
private theorem semanticBoxCover_restrict_closedBall :
    ∀ {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane} {box : Set Tiling.Plane} {N : Nat},
    Metric.closedBall (0 : Tiling.Plane) N ⊆ box →
    (∀ᵐ z ∂volume, z ∈ box → multiplicity K S z = 1) →
      ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Tiling.Plane) N →
        multiplicity K S z = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro K S box N hsubset hmult
  filter_upwards [hmult] with z hzbox hzball
  exact hzbox (hsubset hzball)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.negativeStage_complete
statement:
theorem negativeStage_complete :
    ∀ {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C) (O : CorrectOracle C R),
      ¬realizationPlaneTileable R → ∃ n, negativeStage C O.toOracle n = true
proof:
:= by
  intro C R O hnotile
  have hex : ∃ N : Nat, 0 < N ∧
      ¬ ∃ S : Set Tiling.Plane,
        Tiling.IsPacking R.region.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
          (R.region.toPolygonalRegion.placements S) ∧
        ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Tiling.Plane) N →
          multiplicity R.region S z = 1 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hnotile
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := localCoverings_compactness R.region (fun N hN => h N hN)
    exact ⟨L, hL⟩
  obtain ⟨ballRadius, hballRadius, hnocover⟩ := hex
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := buildLocalBound_exists R O
  obtain ⟨boxIndex, hboxIndex, hballsubset⟩ :=
    closedBall_subset_semanticLocalBox R O B hB ballRadius
  obtain ⟨q₁, q₂, hq₁, hq₂, hsubh, hsubv⟩ :=
    subdivision_exists R O B hB boxIndex hboxIndex
  let c : RawNegativeCode :=
    { boxIndex := boxIndex
      horizontalSubdivisions := q₁
      verticalSubdivisions := q₂ }
  have hc : c.wellFormed = true := by
    simp [c, RawNegativeCode.wellFormed, hboxIndex, hq₁, hq₂]
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := wellFormedNegativeStage_complete c hc
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  unfold negativeStage
  rw [hB, hn]
  simp only [negativeVerifier, Bool.and_eq_true]
  constructor
  · change
      (decide (0 < c.boxIndex && 0 < c.horizontalSubdivisions &&
        0 < c.verticalSubdivisions) &&
        AffineCompiler.decideFormula O.toOracle _) = true
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true]
    constructor
    · simpa [c, RawNegativeCode.wellFormed] using hc
    · apply (AffineCompiler.decideFormula_correct R O _).mpr
      exact (positiveSubdivision_adequate R B c).mpr ⟨hsubh, hsubv⟩
  · change
      (List.range (c.horizontalSubdivisions * c.verticalSubdivisions + 1)).all
        (fun m => !(AffineCompiler.decideFormula O.toOracle
          (localCoverFormula C B c.boxIndex m))) = true
    apply List.all_eq_true.mpr
    intro m hm
    by_cases hlocal : AffineCompiler.decideFormula O.toOracle
        (localCoverFormula C B c.boxIndex m) = true
    · have hformula := (AffineCompiler.decideFormula_correct R O _).mp hlocal
      obtain ⟨S, hpacking, hmult⟩ :=
        localCoverFormula_to_semanticPacking R B c.boxIndex m hformula
      have hballmult : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Tiling.Plane) ballRadius →
          multiplicity R.region S z = 1 := by
        exact semanticBoxCover_restrict_closedBall hballsubset hmult
      exact (hnocover ⟨S, hpacking, hballmult⟩).elim
    · simp [hlocal]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.originalRegionPrograms_evaluate
statement:
theorem originalRegionPrograms_evaluate :
    ∀ {K : Region} (N : RegionNormalization K) (O : Oracle N.code),
      (∀ stage,
        OracleProgram.evaluate O.answer (originalRegionPositiveProgram N stage) =
          positiveStage N.code
            (RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle N.code.originVertex O) stage) ∧
      (∀ stage,
        OracleProgram.evaluate O.answer (originalRegionNegativeProgram N stage) =
          negativeStage N.code
            (RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle N.code.originVertex O) stage) ∧
      (∀ fuel,
        OracleProgram.evaluate O.answer (originalRegionDecisionProgram N fuel) =
          decisionThrough N.code
            (RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle N.code.originVertex O) fuel)
proof:
:= by
  intro K N O
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro stage
    rw [originalRegionPositiveProgram, OracleProgram.evaluate_mapQuery]
    simpa [RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle] using
      (positiveStageProgram_evaluate N.code
        (RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle N.code.originVertex O) stage)
  · intro stage
    rw [originalRegionNegativeProgram, OracleProgram.evaluate_mapQuery]
    simpa [RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle] using
      (negativeStageProgram_evaluate N.code
        (RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle N.code.originVertex O) stage)
  · intro fuel
    rw [originalRegionDecisionProgram, OracleProgram.evaluate_mapQuery]
    simpa [RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle] using
      (decisionThroughProgram_evaluate N.code
        (RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle N.code.originVertex O) fuel)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.originalProgram_evaluate
statement:
theorem originalProgram_evaluate :
    ∀ (E : EncodedAxisParallelRegion) (O : SelectedCoordinateOracles E)
      (N : RegionNormalization E.region) (A : LegacyNormalizationAdapter E N)
      (originalOracle : Oracle N.code),
    (∀ q, originalOracle.answer q = O.answer (toLegacyQuery A q)) →
    ∀ fuel,
      OracleProgram.evaluate O.answer (originalProgram N A fuel) =
        decisionThrough N.code
          (RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle N.code.originVertex originalOracle) fuel
proof:
:= by
  intro E O N A originalOracle hO fuel
  rw [originalProgram, OracleProgram.evaluate_mapQuery]
  have hanswer :
      (fun q : Query N.code => O.answer (toLegacyQuery A
        (RuntimeRebase.rebaseQuery N.code.originVertex q))) =
        (RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle N.code.originVertex originalOracle).answer := by
    funext q
    exact (hO (RuntimeRebase.rebaseQuery N.code.originVertex q)).symm
  rw [hanswer]
  exact decisionThroughProgram_evaluate N.code
    (RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle N.code.originVertex originalOracle) fuel

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.originalStagePrograms_evaluate
statement:
theorem originalStagePrograms_evaluate :
    ∀ (E : EncodedAxisParallelRegion) (O : SelectedCoordinateOracles E)
      (N : RegionNormalization E.region) (A : LegacyNormalizationAdapter E N)
      (originalOracle : Oracle N.code),
    (∀ q, originalOracle.answer q = O.answer (toLegacyQuery A q)) →
    (∀ stage,
      OracleProgram.evaluate O.answer (originalPositiveProgram N A stage) =
        positiveStage N.code
          (RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle N.code.originVertex originalOracle) stage) ∧
    (∀ stage,
      OracleProgram.evaluate O.answer (originalNegativeProgram N A stage) =
        negativeStage N.code
          (RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle N.code.originVertex originalOracle) stage)
proof:
:= by
  intro E O N A originalOracle hO
  have hanswer :
      (fun q : Query N.code => O.answer (toLegacyQuery A
        (RuntimeRebase.rebaseQuery N.code.originVertex q))) =
        (RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle N.code.originVertex originalOracle).answer := by
    funext q
    exact (hO (RuntimeRebase.rebaseQuery N.code.originVertex q)).symm
  constructor
  · intro stage
    rw [originalPositiveProgram, OracleProgram.evaluate_mapQuery, hanswer]
    exact positiveStageProgram_evaluate N.code
      (RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle N.code.originVertex originalOracle) stage
  · intro stage
    rw [originalNegativeProgram, OracleProgram.evaluate_mapQuery, hanswer]
    exact negativeStageProgram_evaluate N.code
      (RuntimeRebase.rebaseOracle N.code.originVertex originalOracle) stage

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.originalTileable_iff_normalized
statement:
theorem originalTileable_iff_normalized :
    ∀ (E : EncodedAxisParallelRegion) (N : RegionNormalization E.region),
      isPlaneTileable E ↔ realizationPlaneTileable N.normalized
proof:
:= by
  intro E N
  change (∃ S : Set Tiling.Plane, Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn E.region S Set.univ) ↔
    ∃ S : Set Tiling.Plane,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn N.normalized.region S Set.univ
  exact (tileableNormalizedIff N).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.decisionThrough_sound
statement:
theorem decisionThrough_sound :
    ∀ {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C) (O : CorrectOracle C R) fuel answer,
      decisionThrough C O.toOracle fuel = some answer →
        (answer = true ↔ realizationPlaneTileable R)
proof:
:= by
  intro C R O fuel answer hdecision
  have hrun : runThrough (positiveStage C O.toOracle) (negativeStage C O.toOracle) fuel =
      some answer := by
    simpa [decisionThrough] using hdecision
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hstep, hnone⟩ :=
    (runThrough_some_iff (positiveStage C O.toOracle) (negativeStage C O.toOracle)
      fuel answer).mp hrun
  by_cases hp : positiveStage C O.toOracle n
  · have hanswer : answer = true := by
      simpa [dovetailStep, hp] using hstep
    subst answer
    constructor
    · intro _
      exact PositiveVerification.verifyPositiveStage_sound R O n (by
        simpa [positiveStage] using hp)
    · intro _
      trivial
  · have hnneg : negativeStage C O.toOracle n := by
      have hstep' := hstep
      simp [dovetailStep, hp] at hstep'
      by_cases hnneg' : negativeStage C O.toOracle n
      · exact hnneg'
      · simp [hnneg'] at hstep'
    have hanswer : answer = false := by
      simpa [dovetailStep, hp, hnneg] using hstep
    subst answer
    constructor
    · intro hfalse
      simp at hfalse
    · intro htile
      exact False.elim (negativeStage_sound R O n hnneg htile)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.decisionThrough_halts
statement:
theorem decisionThrough_halts :
    ∀ {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C) (O : CorrectOracle C R),
      ∃ fuel answer, decisionThrough C O.toOracle fuel = some answer
proof:
:= by
  intro C R O
  have hstage : ∃ n, dovetailStep (positiveStage C O.toOracle)
      (negativeStage C O.toOracle) n ≠ none := by
    by_cases htile : realizationPlaneTileable R
    · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := PositiveCertificateCompleteness.positiveStage_complete R O htile
      refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
      simp [dovetailStep, positiveStage, hn]
    · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := negativeStage_complete R O htile
      refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
      by_cases hp : positiveStage C O.toOracle n
      · simp [dovetailStep, hp]
      · simp [dovetailStep, hp, hn]
  obtain ⟨fuel, hstage⟩ := hstage
  cases hrun : runThrough (positiveStage C O.toOracle) (negativeStage C O.toOracle) fuel with
  | none =>
      exact (hstage ((runThrough_none_iff (positiveStage C O.toOracle)
        (negativeStage C O.toOracle) fuel).mp hrun fuel (Nat.le_refl fuel))).elim
  | some answer =>
      exact ⟨fuel, answer, hrun⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.decisionThroughProgram_correct
statement:
theorem decisionThroughProgram_correct :
    ∀ {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C) (O : CorrectOracle C R),
      (∃ fuel answer, OracleProgram.evaluate O.toOracle.answer
        (decisionThroughProgram C fuel) = some answer) ∧
      ∀ fuel answer, OracleProgram.evaluate O.toOracle.answer
        (decisionThroughProgram C fuel) = some answer →
          (answer = true ↔ realizationPlaneTileable R)
proof:
:= by
  intro C R O
  simp_rw [decisionThroughProgram_evaluate]
  exact ⟨decisionThrough_halts R O, decisionThrough_sound R O⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.computedDecision_iff
statement:
theorem computedDecision_iff :
    ∀ {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C) (O : CorrectOracle C R),
      (∃ fuel, ResolvesBy C O.toOracle fuel) ∧
      ∀ fuel, ResolvesBy C O.toOracle fuel →
        (computedDecisionAtFuel C O.toOracle fuel = true ↔ realizationPlaneTileable R)
proof:
:= by
  intro C R O
  obtain ⟨fuel, answer, hdecision⟩ := decisionThrough_halts R O
  refine ⟨⟨fuel, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simp [ResolvesBy, hdecision]
  · intro fuel hresolved
    cases hdecision : decisionThrough C O.toOracle fuel with
    | none =>
        simp [ResolvesBy, hdecision] at hresolved
    | some answer =>
        simpa [computedDecisionAtFuel, hdecision] using
          decisionThrough_sound R O fuel answer hdecision

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.normalizedProgramPackage
statement:
theorem normalizedProgramPackage :
    ∀ {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C) (O : CorrectOracle C R),
      Nonempty (NormalizedProgramPackage R O)
proof:
:= by
  intro C R O
  let positive : RelativeSemidecision (Query C) O.toOracle.answer
      (realizationPlaneTileable R) :=
    { program := positiveStageProgram C
      sound := fun stage h => PositiveVerification.verifyPositiveStage_sound R O stage (by
        rw [positiveStageProgram_evaluate] at h
        exact h)
      complete := fun h => by
        obtain ⟨stage, hstage⟩ := PositiveCertificateCompleteness.positiveStage_complete R O h
        refine ⟨stage, ?_⟩
        rw [positiveStageProgram_evaluate]
        exact hstage }
  let negative : RelativeSemidecision (Query C) O.toOracle.answer
      (¬realizationPlaneTileable R) :=
    { program := negativeStageProgram C
      sound := fun stage h => negativeStage_sound R O stage (by
        rw [negativeStageProgram_evaluate] at h
        exact h)
      complete := fun h => by
        obtain ⟨stage, hstage⟩ := negativeStage_complete R O h
        refine ⟨stage, ?_⟩
        rw [negativeStageProgram_evaluate]
        exact hstage }
  let decision : RelativeDecision (Query C) O.toOracle.answer
      (realizationPlaneTileable R) :=
    { positive := positive
      negative := negative
      decisionProgram := decisionThroughProgram C
      true_sound := fun fuel h => by
        rw [decisionThroughProgram_evaluate] at h
        exact (decisionThrough_sound R O fuel true h).mp rfl
      false_sound := fun fuel h htile => by
        rw [decisionThroughProgram_evaluate] at h
        exact Bool.false_ne_true ((decisionThrough_sound R O fuel false h).mpr htile)
      halts := by
        obtain ⟨fuel, answer, hanswer⟩ := decisionThrough_halts R O
        refine ⟨fuel, answer, ?_⟩
        rw [decisionThroughProgram_evaluate]
        exact hanswer }
  exact ⟨{ decision := decision
           positive_program := rfl
           negative_program := rfl
           decision_program := rfl }⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.arbitraryRegionRelativeDecision
statement:
theorem arbitraryRegionRelativeDecision :
    ∀ (K : Region) (N : RegionNormalization K) (O : Oracle N.code),
      CorrectOriginalOracle N.originalVertex O →
        Nonempty (OriginalRegionProgramPackage K N O)
proof:
:= by
  intro K N O hO
  obtain ⟨CO, hCO⟩ := rebaseOracleCorrect N O hO
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := normalizedProgramPackage N.normalized CO
  have htileiff : realizationPlaneTileable N.normalized ↔
      ∃ S : Set Tiling.Plane, TilesOn K S Set.univ :=
    tileableNormalizedIff N
  have heval := originalRegionPrograms_evaluate N O
  have hpositive (stage : Nat) :
      OracleProgram.evaluate O.answer (originalRegionPositiveProgram N stage) =
        OracleProgram.evaluate CO.toOracle.answer (P.decision.positive.program stage) := by
    rw [P.positive_program, positiveStageProgram_evaluate, hCO]
    exact heval.1 stage
  have hnegative (stage : Nat) :
      OracleProgram.evaluate O.answer (originalRegionNegativeProgram N stage) =
        OracleProgram.evaluate CO.toOracle.answer (P.decision.negative.program stage) := by
    rw [P.negative_program, negativeStageProgram_evaluate, hCO]
    exact heval.2.1 stage
  have hdecision (fuel : Nat) :
      OracleProgram.evaluate O.answer (originalRegionDecisionProgram N fuel) =
        OracleProgram.evaluate CO.toOracle.answer (P.decision.decisionProgram fuel) := by
    rw [P.decision_program, decisionThroughProgram_evaluate, hCO]
    exact heval.2.2 fuel
  let positive : RelativeSemidecision (Query N.code) O.answer
      (∃ S : Set Tiling.Plane, TilesOn K S Set.univ) :=
    { program := originalRegionPositiveProgram N
      sound := fun stage hrun =>
        htileiff.mp (P.decision.positive.sound stage (by
          rw [← hpositive stage]
          exact hrun))
      complete := fun htile => by
        obtain ⟨stage, hstage⟩ := P.decision.positive.complete (htileiff.mpr htile)
        exact ⟨stage, by rw [hpositive stage]; exact hstage⟩ }
  let negative : RelativeSemidecision (Query N.code) O.answer
      (¬ ∃ S : Set Tiling.Plane, TilesOn K S Set.univ) :=
    { program := originalRegionNegativeProgram N
      sound := fun stage hrun htile =>
        P.decision.negative.sound stage (by
          rw [← hnegative stage]
          exact hrun) (htileiff.mpr htile)
      complete := fun hnotile => by
        obtain ⟨stage, hstage⟩ := P.decision.negative.complete
          (fun htile => hnotile (htileiff.mp htile))
        exact ⟨stage, by rw [hnegative stage]; exact hstage⟩ }
  let decision : RelativeDecision (Query N.code) O.answer
      (∃ S : Set Tiling.Plane, TilesOn K S Set.univ) :=
    { positive := positive
      negative := negative
      decisionProgram := originalRegionDecisionProgram N
      true_sound := fun fuel hrun =>
        htileiff.mp (P.decision.true_sound fuel (by
          rw [← hdecision fuel]
          exact hrun))
      false_sound := fun fuel hrun htile =>
        P.decision.false_sound fuel (by
          rw [← hdecision fuel]
          exact hrun) (htileiff.mpr htile)
      halts := by
        obtain ⟨fuel, answer, hrun⟩ := P.decision.halts
        exact ⟨fuel, answer, by rw [hdecision fuel]; exact hrun⟩ }
  exact ⟨{
    decision := decision
    positive_program := rfl
    negative_program := rfl
    decision_program := rfl }⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.originalProgramPackage
statement:
theorem originalProgramPackage :
    ∀ (E : EncodedAxisParallelRegion) (O : SelectedCoordinateOracles E),
      ∃ (N : RegionNormalization E.region) (A : LegacyNormalizationAdapter E N),
        Nonempty (OriginalProgramPackage E O N A)
proof:
:= by
  intro E O
  obtain ⟨N⟩ := existsRegionNormalization E.region
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := legacyAdapter_exists E N
  obtain ⟨originalOracle, hOriginal, hanswer⟩ := legacyQuery_answer E O N A
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := arbitraryRegionRelativeDecision E.region N originalOracle hOriginal
  have positiveEval : ∀ stage,
      OracleProgram.evaluate O.answer (originalPositiveProgram N A stage) =
        OracleProgram.evaluate originalOracle.answer
          (originalRegionPositiveProgram N stage) := by
    intro stage
    exact ((originalStagePrograms_evaluate E O N A originalOracle hanswer).1 stage).trans
      ((originalRegionPrograms_evaluate N originalOracle).1 stage).symm
  have negativeEval : ∀ stage,
      OracleProgram.evaluate O.answer (originalNegativeProgram N A stage) =
        OracleProgram.evaluate originalOracle.answer
          (originalRegionNegativeProgram N stage) := by
    intro stage
    exact ((originalStagePrograms_evaluate E O N A originalOracle hanswer).2 stage).trans
      ((originalRegionPrograms_evaluate N originalOracle).2.1 stage).symm
  have decisionEval : ∀ fuel,
      OracleProgram.evaluate O.answer (originalProgram N A fuel) =
        OracleProgram.evaluate originalOracle.answer
          (originalRegionDecisionProgram N fuel) := by
    intro fuel
    exact (originalProgram_evaluate E O N A originalOracle hanswer fuel).trans
      ((originalRegionPrograms_evaluate N originalOracle).2.2 fuel).symm
  let positive : RelativeSemidecision (CoordQuery E) O.answer (isPlaneTileable E) :=
    { program := originalPositiveProgram N A
      sound := by
        intro stage hrun
        apply P.decision.positive.sound stage
        rw [P.positive_program, ← positiveEval stage]
        exact hrun
      complete := by
        intro htile
        obtain ⟨stage, hstage⟩ := P.decision.positive.complete htile
        refine ⟨stage, ?_⟩
        rw [positiveEval stage, ← P.positive_program]
        exact hstage }
  let negative : RelativeSemidecision (CoordQuery E) O.answer (¬isPlaneTileable E) :=
    { program := originalNegativeProgram N A
      sound := by
        intro stage hrun
        apply P.decision.negative.sound stage
        rw [P.negative_program, ← negativeEval stage]
        exact hrun
      complete := by
        intro hnotile
        obtain ⟨stage, hstage⟩ := P.decision.negative.complete hnotile
        refine ⟨stage, ?_⟩
        rw [negativeEval stage, ← P.negative_program]
        exact hstage }
  let decision : RelativeDecision (CoordQuery E) O.answer (isPlaneTileable E) :=
    { positive := positive
      negative := negative
      decisionProgram := originalProgram N A
      true_sound := by
        intro fuel hrun
        apply P.decision.true_sound fuel
        rw [P.decision_program, ← decisionEval fuel]
        exact hrun
      false_sound := by
        intro fuel hrun
        apply P.decision.false_sound fuel
        rw [P.decision_program, ← decisionEval fuel]
        exact hrun
      halts := by
        obtain ⟨fuel, answer, hrun⟩ := P.decision.halts
        refine ⟨fuel, answer, ?_⟩
        rw [decisionEval fuel, ← P.decision_program]
        exact hrun }
  exact ⟨N, A, ⟨{ decision := decision
                  positive_program := rfl
                  negative_program := rfl
                  decision_program := rfl }⟩⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.tilingSpace_of_tilesOn
statement:
private theorem tilingSpace_of_tilesOn :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T Set.univ →
        ∃ S : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ,
          (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) = T
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hT
  obtain ⟨delta, hdelta, hsep⟩ := exists_packingSeparation K
  have hpairwise : T.Pairwise (fun x y ↦ delta ≤ dist x y) := hsep T hT.2.1
  have hclosed : IsClosed T := Metric.isClosed_of_pairwise_le_dist hdelta hpairwise
  let c : TopologicalSpace.Closeds Tiling.Plane := ⟨T, hclosed⟩
  exact ⟨{ centres := c, tilesOn := hT }, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_positive_common_multiple_local
statement:
private theorem exists_positive_common_multiple_local
    {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hcomm : ∃ q : ℚ, y = (q : ℝ) * x) :
    ∃ m n : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ 0 < n ∧ (m : ℝ) * x = (n : ℝ) * y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hcomm
  have hqreal : 0 < (q : ℝ) := (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right hx).mp hy
  have hq : 0 < q := Rat.cast_pos.mp hqreal
  let m : ℕ := q.num.natAbs
  let n : ℕ := q.den
  have hnum : 0 < q.num := Rat.num_pos.mpr hq
  have hm : 0 < m := by
    simpa only [m, Int.natAbs_pos] using hnum.ne'
  have hn : 0 < n := q.pos
  refine ⟨m, n, hm, hn, ?_⟩
  dsimp only [m, n]
  have hcast : (q.num.natAbs : ℝ) = (q.num : ℝ) := by
    simp only [Nat.cast_natAbs, Int.cast_abs,
      abs_of_pos (Int.cast_pos.mpr hnum)]
  rw [hcast, Rat.cast_def]
  field_simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_commonPositiveNatMultiple_aux
statement:
private theorem exists_commonPositiveNatMultiple_aux :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (a : Fin n → ℝ), 0 < n → (∀ i, 0 < a i) →
      (∀ i j, ∃ q : ℚ, a i = (q : ℝ) * a j) →
        ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ m : Fin n → ℕ,
          (∀ i, 0 < m i) ∧ ∀ i, A = (m i : ℝ) * a i
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro a hn
      omega
  | succ n ih =>
      intro a hn ha hcomm
      cases n with
      | zero =>
          refine ⟨a 0, ha 0, (fun _ => 1), (by intro i; simp), ?_⟩
          intro i
          fin_cases i
          simp
      | succ n =>
          let b : Fin (Nat.succ n) → ℝ := fun i => a i.succ
          have hb : ∀ i, 0 < b i := by
            intro i
            exact ha i.succ
          have hbcomm : ∀ i j, ∃ q : ℚ, b i = (q : ℝ) * b j := by
            intro i j
            exact hcomm i.succ j.succ
          obtain ⟨B, hB, m, hm, hBm⟩ := ih b (by omega) hb hbcomm
          have hq0 : ∃ q : ℚ, b 0 = (q : ℝ) * a 0 := by
            obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hcomm 0 (Fin.succ 0)
            obtain ⟨q', hq'⟩ := rational_commensurable_symm (ha 0) (hb 0) ⟨q, hq⟩
            exact ⟨q', hq'⟩
          obtain ⟨qB, hqB⟩ : ∃ q : ℚ, B = (q : ℝ) * a 0 := by
            obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hq0
            refine ⟨(m 0 : ℚ) * q, ?_⟩
            rw [hBm 0, hq]
            push_cast
            ring
          obtain ⟨r, s, hr, hs, hrs⟩ :=
            exists_positive_common_multiple_local (ha 0) hB ⟨qB, hqB⟩
          let A : ℝ := (r : ℝ) * a 0
          let M : Fin (Nat.succ (Nat.succ n)) → ℕ :=
            Fin.cases r (fun i => s * m i)
          refine ⟨A, ?_, M, ?_, ?_⟩
          · dsimp [A]
            exact mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hr) (ha 0)
          · intro i
            refine Fin.cases (by exact hr) (fun j => ?_) i
            exact Nat.mul_pos hs (hm j)
          · intro i
            refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
            · simp [A, M]
            · dsimp [A, M]
              calc
                (r : ℝ) * a 0 = (s : ℝ) * B := hrs
                _ = (s : ℝ) * ((m j : ℝ) * b j) := by rw [hBm j]
                _ = ((s * m j : ℕ) : ℝ) * a j.succ := by
                  dsimp [b]
                  push_cast
                  ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_commonPositiveNatMultiple
statement:
private theorem exists_commonPositiveNatMultiple
    {n : ℕ} {a : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i)
    (hcomm : ∀ i j, ∃ q : ℚ, a i = (q : ℝ) * a j) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ m : Fin n → ℕ,
      (∀ i, 0 < m i) ∧ ∀ i, A = (m i : ℝ) * a i
proof:
:=
  exists_commonPositiveNatMultiple_aux n a hn ha hcomm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.normalizeShear_mod_verticalPeriod
statement:
private theorem normalizeShear_mod_verticalPeriod
    {alpha beta shear : ℝ} (halpha : 0 < alpha) :
    ∃ shear0 : ℝ, 0 ≤ shear0 ∧ shear0 < alpha ∧
      triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear =
        triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear0
proof:
:= by
  let k : ℤ := Int.floor (shear / alpha)
  let shear0 : ℝ := shear - (k : ℝ) * alpha
  have hlo : (k : ℝ) ≤ shear / alpha := by
    exact_mod_cast (Int.floor_le (shear / alpha))
  have hhi : shear / alpha < (k : ℝ) + 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Int.lt_floor_add_one (shear / alpha))
  have hmul : (shear / alpha) * alpha = shear := by
    field_simp
  have h0 : 0 ≤ shear0 := by
    dsimp [shear0]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlo (le_of_lt halpha)
    rw [hmul] at h
    linarith
  have hlt : shear0 < alpha := by
    dsimp [shear0]
    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hhi halpha
    rw [hmul] at h
    linarith
  refine ⟨shear0, h0, hlt, ?_⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro v hv
    rw [triangularPeriodSubgroup_mem_iff] at hv ⊢
    obtain ⟨m, n, rfl⟩ := hv
    refine ⟨m + n * k, n, ?_⟩
    apply Complex.ext <;> (simp [verticalPeriodVector, skewPeriodVector, shear0] <;> ring)
  · intro v hv
    rw [triangularPeriodSubgroup_mem_iff] at hv ⊢
    obtain ⟨m, n, rfl⟩ := hv
    refine ⟨m - n * k, n, ?_⟩
    apply Complex.ext <;> (simp [verticalPeriodVector, skewPeriodVector, shear0] <;> ring)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.ae_comp_re_local
statement:

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.singletonSelectedPiece_wholePlaneLattice
statement:
private theorem singletonSelectedPiece_wholePlaneLattice
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane} {X : Set ℝ}
    (hTile : TilesOn K S (Complex.re ⁻¹' X))
    (hX : X =ᵐ[volume] Set.univ)
    (hS : IsLatticePeriodic S) :
    Nonempty (PeriodicReplacement K Set.univ)
proof:
:= by
