name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.periodicTilingNormalForm_to_quasiPeriodic
statement:
private theorem periodicTilingNormalForm_to_quasiPeriodic
    {K : Region} (P : PeriodicTilingNormalForm K) :
    ∃ S : Set Tiling.Plane,
      TilesOn K S Set.univ ∧ IsQuasiPeriodic S ∧
      ∃ p : Tiling.Plane, p ≠ 0 ∧ p ∈ periodGroup S
proof:
:= by
  cases P with
  | wholePlaneLattice P =>
      have hne : P.centres.Nonempty := by
        by_contra hempty
        have hS : P.centres = ∅ := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hempty
        have hfalse : ∀ᵐ z : Tiling.Plane ∂volume, False := by
          filter_upwards [P.tiles.2.2] with z hz
          have hz' := hz.mp (Set.mem_univ z)
          obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hz'
          exact hempty ⟨s, s.property⟩
        obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Filter.Eventually.exists hfalse
        exact hz.elim
      let p := P.lattice.basis 0
      have hp : p ≠ 0 := P.lattice.independent.ne_zero 0
      refine ⟨P.centres, P.tiles, ?_, p, hp, ?_⟩
      · refine ⟨1, (fun _ => P.centres), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro i
          exact ⟨hne, ⟨P.lattice, P.lattice_periods⟩⟩
        · rw [Set.pairwiseDisjoint_iff]
          intro i hi j hj hinter
          exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
        · simp only [Set.iUnion_const]
      · exact P.lattice_periods (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self 0))
  | orientedSlabs C =>
      let S := C.originalCentres
      have hpieces : ∀ j, (C.originalPiece j).Nonempty ∧
          IsLatticePeriodic (C.originalPiece j) := by
        intro j
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [C.originalPiece_eq j]
          by_cases h : C.orientation
          · rw [if_pos h]
            exact (C.selectedPiece_nonempty j).image coordinateSwap
          · rw [if_neg h]
            exact C.selectedPiece_nonempty j
        · let v : Tiling.Plane := if C.orientation then
              coordinateSwap (verticalPeriodVector C.commonVerticalPeriod)
            else verticalPeriodVector C.commonVerticalPeriod
          let w : Tiling.Plane := if C.orientation then
              coordinateSwap (skewPeriodVector C.commonHorizontalPeriod (C.normalizedShear j))
            else skewPeriodVector C.commonHorizontalPeriod (C.normalizedShear j)
          have hv : v ∈ periodGroup (C.originalPiece j) := by
            simpa [v] using C.original_verticalPeriod j
          have hw : w ∈ periodGroup (C.originalPiece j) := by
            simpa [w] using C.original_skewPeriod j
          refine ⟨{ basis := ![v, w], independent := ?_ }, ?_⟩
          · rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iffₛ]
            intro a b c d hab
            have hre := congrArg Complex.re hab
            have him := congrArg Complex.im hab
            by_cases h : C.orientation
            · simp [v, w, h, verticalPeriodVector, skewPeriodVector] at hre him
              have hbd : b = d := him.resolve_right
                (ne_of_gt C.commonHorizontalPeriod_pos)
              subst d
              constructor
              · nlinarith [hre, C.commonVerticalPeriod_pos]
              · rfl
            · simp [v, w, h, verticalPeriodVector, skewPeriodVector] at hre him
              have hbd : b = d := hre.resolve_right
                (ne_of_gt C.commonHorizontalPeriod_pos)
              subst d
              constructor
              · nlinarith [him, C.commonVerticalPeriod_pos]
              · rfl
          · rw [Tiling.Polygonal.PlanarLattice.toAddSubgroup]
            apply (AddSubgroup.closure_le (periodGroup (C.originalPiece j))).mpr
            rintro v ⟨i, rfl⟩
            fin_cases i
            · exact hv
            · exact hw
      refine ⟨S, C.original_tiles, ?_, ?_⟩
      · refine ⟨C.numberOfPieces, C.originalPiece, hpieces, ?_, C.originalPieces_union⟩
        intro i hi j hj hij
        change Disjoint (C.originalPiece i) (C.originalPiece j)
        by_cases h : C.orientation
        · rw [C.originalPiece_eq i, C.originalPiece_eq j, if_pos h, if_pos h]
          exact (Set.disjoint_image_iff coordinateSwap.injective).mpr
            (C.selectedPiece_pairwiseDisjoint hi hj hij)
        · rw [C.originalPiece_eq i, C.originalPiece_eq j, if_neg h, if_neg h]
          exact C.selectedPiece_pairwiseDisjoint hi hj hij
      · let v : Tiling.Plane := if C.orientation then
              coordinateSwap (verticalPeriodVector C.commonVerticalPeriod)
            else verticalPeriodVector C.commonVerticalPeriod
        refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have hv0 : verticalPeriodVector C.commonVerticalPeriod ≠ 0 := by
            intro hz
            have := congrArg Complex.im hz
            norm_num [verticalPeriodVector] at this
            exact (ne_of_gt C.commonVerticalPeriod_pos) this
          by_cases h : C.orientation
          · intro hz
            apply hv0
            apply coordinateSwap.injective
            simpa [v, h] using hz
          · simpa [v, h] using hv0
        · simpa [v] using C.original_commonPeriod

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.minimalStructure_pieceReplacement
statement:
private theorem minimalStructure_pieceReplacement
    {K : Region} {T : Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    (D : Structure.MinimalTilingStructureData K T) (j : Fin D.numberOfPieces) :
    Nonempty (PeriodicReplacement D.selectedRegion (Complex.re ⁻¹' D.base j))
proof:
:= by
  exact exists_flcPeriodicReplacement
    (D.base_open j) D.horizontalPeriod_pos
    (D.base_periodic j) (D.piece_tiles j) (D.piece_hasFLC j)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.minimalStructure_columnReplacementFamily
statement:
private theorem minimalStructure_columnReplacementFamily
    {K : Region} {T : Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    (D : Structure.MinimalTilingStructureData K T) (hcolumn : D.columnPart.Nonempty) :
    Nonempty (MinimalColumnReplacement D)
proof:
:= by
  have hNonFLC : ¬ HasFLC (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
    intro hFLC
    rw [(D.finiteComplexity_normalForm hFLC).1] at hcolumn
    exact Set.not_nonempty_empty hcolumn
  have hcolumnEq := (D.nonFLC_components hNonFLC).1
  let X : PeriodicVerticalCarrier := {
    base := Set.univ
    base_open := isOpen_univ
    base_regular := by simp
    base_nonnull := by simp
    period := 1
    period_pos := by norm_num
    base_periodic := by simp }
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, alpha, beta, halpha, hbeta, _, _, hfree⟩ :=
    periodicColumnBase_freeShear X (by simpa [X, PeriodicVerticalCarrier.carrier]
      using D.selectedTiling.tilesOn)
      (hcolumnEq ▸ hcolumn) D.horizontalPeriod_pos
      (by simpa only [← hcolumnEq] using D.columnSupport_periodic)
  let replacement : ℝ → Set Tiling.Plane := fun w ↦ Classical.choose (hfree w)
  have hspec (w : ℝ) := Classical.choose_spec (hfree w)
  have htiles (w : ℝ) :
      TilesOn D.selectedRegion (replacement w) (Complex.re ⁻¹' D.columnBase) := by
    have hpack := (hspec w).1
    refine ⟨(IsPacking.locallyFinite_centres hpack).2, hpack, ?_⟩
    have hsupport : regularSupport D.selectedRegion (replacement w) =
        Complex.re ⁻¹' D.columnBase :=
      (hspec w).2.1.trans ((congrArg (regularSupport D.selectedRegion) hcolumnEq).symm.trans
        D.columnSupport_eq)
    filter_upwards [openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport hpack] with z hz
    change (z ∈ Complex.re ⁻¹' D.columnBase ↔
      ∃ s : replacement w, z ∈ ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ D.selectedRegion.openCarrier))
    rw [← hsupport]
    exact (Iff.of_eq hz.symm).trans (by rw [openUnion]; exact Set.mem_iUnion)
  refine ⟨⟨{
    base := D.columnBase
    base_measurable := D.columnBase_open.measurableSet
    sourceCentres := D.columnPart
    source_nonempty := hcolumn
    source_tiles := D.column_tiles
    verticalPeriod := alpha
    axisPeriod := beta
    verticalPeriod_pos := halpha
    axisPeriod_pos := hbeta
    replacement := replacement
    replacement_tiles := htiles
    replacement_verticalPeriod := ?_
    replacement_axisPeriod := ?_ }, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  · intro w
    exact (setPeriodicBy_iff_vadd_eq _ _).mp (hspec w).2.2.1
  · intro w
    exact (setPeriodicBy_iff_vadd_eq _ _).mp (hspec w).2.2.2.1

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.weaklyPeriodic_finite_iUnion_local
statement:
private theorem weaklyPeriodic_finite_iUnion_local
    {I : Type} [Finite I] {S : I → Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hweak : ∀ i, Tiling.RationalPolygonal.WeaklyPeriodic (S i))
    (hdisj : Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ S) :
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.WeaklyPeriodic (⋃ i, S i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  let D (i : I) : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.WeakPeriodicDecomposition (S i) :=
    Classical.choice (hweak i)
  let J := (i : I) × Fin (D i).numberOfParts
  let e : J ≃ Fin (Fintype.card J) := Fintype.equivFin J
  have hpartSub (i : I) (j : Fin (D i).numberOfParts) : (D i).part j ⊆ S i := by
    intro z hz
    exact (D i).iUnion_parts ▸ Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hz⟩
  have hpartsDisj (a b : J) (hab : a ≠ b) :
      Disjoint ((D a.1).part a.2) ((D b.1).part b.2) := by
    rcases a with ⟨i, j⟩
    rcases b with ⟨i', j'⟩
    by_cases hii : i = i'
    · subst i'
      exact (D i).pairwiseDisjoint (Set.mem_univ j) (Set.mem_univ j')
        (fun hjj ↦ hab (by cases hjj; rfl))
    · exact (hdisj (Set.mem_univ i) (Set.mem_univ i') hii).mono
        (hpartSub i j) (hpartSub i' j')
  refine ⟨{
    numberOfParts := Fintype.card J
    part := fun j ↦ (D (e.symm j).1).part (e.symm j).2
    period := fun j ↦ (D (e.symm j).1).period (e.symm j).2
    period_ne_zero := fun j ↦ (D (e.symm j).1).period_ne_zero (e.symm j).2
    periodic_part := fun j ↦ (D (e.symm j).1).periodic_part (e.symm j).2
    pairwiseDisjoint := fun i _ j _ hij ↦ hpartsDisj (e.symm i) (e.symm j)
      (fun h ↦ hij (e.symm.injective h))
    iUnion_parts := ?_ }⟩
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
    exact ⟨(e.symm j).1, hpartSub _ _ hj⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    rw [← (D i).iUnion_parts] at hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hi
    refine ⟨e ⟨i, j⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
    exact hj

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.minimalStructure_weaklyPeriodic
statement:
private theorem minimalStructure_weaklyPeriodic
    {K : Region} {T : Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    (D : Structure.MinimalTilingStructureData K T) :
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.WeaklyPeriodic (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) ∧
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.WeaklyPeriodic (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpieces (j : Fin D.numberOfPieces) :
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.WeaklyPeriodic (D.piece j) :=
    flcTiling_weaklyPeriodic (D.base_open j) D.horizontalPeriod_pos
      (D.base_periodic j) (D.piece_tiles j) (D.piece_hasFLC j)
  have hcolumn : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.WeaklyPeriodic D.columnPart := by
    by_cases hne : D.columnPart.Nonempty
    · have hNonFLC : ¬ HasFLC (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
        intro hFLC
        rw [(D.finiteComplexity_normalForm hFLC).1] at hne
        exact Set.not_nonempty_empty hne
      have hcolumnEq := (D.nonFLC_components hNonFLC).1
      let X : PeriodicVerticalCarrier := {
        base := Set.univ
        base_open := isOpen_univ
        base_regular := by simp
        base_nonnull := by simp
        period := 1
        period_pos := by norm_num
        base_periodic := by simp }
      obtain ⟨H, Y, _, hformula, alpha, _, halpha, _, _, hfibre, _⟩ :=
        periodicColumnBase_freeShear X (by simpa [X, PeriodicVerticalCarrier.carrier]
          using D.selectedTiling.tilesOn) (hcolumnEq ▸ hne) D.horizontalPeriod_pos
          (by simpa only [← hcolumnEq] using D.columnSupport_periodic)
      have hperiod : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy D.columnPart
          (verticalPeriodVector alpha) := by
        rw [hcolumnEq, hformula]
        intro z
        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
          verticalPeriodVector, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
          Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero,
          sub_zero, mul_one, add_zero]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨h, hh, hz, hy⟩
          refine ⟨h, hh, hz, ?_⟩
          have hy' : z.im + alpha ∈ alpha +ᵥ Y h := by
            rw [hfibre h hh]
            exact hy
          simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] using hy'
        · rintro ⟨h, hh, hz, hy⟩
          refine ⟨h, hh, hz, ?_⟩
          rw [← hfibre h hh]
          exact ⟨z.im, hy, by simp [add_comm]⟩
      have hzero : verticalPeriodVector alpha ≠ 0 := by
        intro hz
        have hh := congrArg Complex.im hz
        apply halpha.ne'
        simpa [verticalPeriodVector] using hh
      refine ⟨{
        numberOfParts := 1
        part := fun _ ↦ D.columnPart
        period := fun _ ↦ verticalPeriodVector alpha
        period_ne_zero := fun _ ↦ hzero
        periodic_part := fun _ ↦ hperiod
        pairwiseDisjoint := ?_
        iUnion_parts := by simp only [Set.iUnion_const] }⟩
      intro i _ j _ hij
      exact (hij (Subsingleton.elim i j)).elim
    · rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne]
      exact ⟨{
        numberOfParts := 0
        part := Fin.elim0
        period := Fin.elim0
        period_ne_zero := fun i ↦ Fin.elim0 i
        periodic_part := fun i ↦ Fin.elim0 i
        pairwiseDisjoint := by intro i; exact Fin.elim0 i
        iUnion_parts := by simp }⟩
  let part : Option (Fin D.numberOfPieces) → Set Tiling.Plane :=
    fun i ↦ i.elim D.columnPart D.piece
  have hselected : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.WeaklyPeriodic
      (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
    have hdisj : Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ part := by
      intro i _ j _ hij
      cases i with
      | none =>
        cases j with
        | none => exact (hij rfl).elim
        | some j => exact D.column_disjoint_piece j
      | some i =>
        cases j with
        | none => exact (D.column_disjoint_piece i).symm
        | some j =>
          exact D.pieces_pairwiseDisjoint (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _)
            (fun h ↦ hij (congrArg some h))
    have hw := weaklyPeriodic_finite_iUnion_local
      (S := part) (fun i ↦ by cases i with | none => exact hcolumn | some j => exact hpieces j)
      hdisj
    have hunion : (⋃ i, part i) = D.columnPart ∪ ⋃ j, D.piece j := by
      ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_union]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        cases i with
        | none => exact Or.inl hi
        | some j => exact Or.inr ⟨j, hi⟩
      · rintro (hz | ⟨j, hz⟩)
        · exact ⟨none, hz⟩
        · exact ⟨some j, hz⟩
    rw [hunion, D.centres_partition] at hw
    exact hw
  refine ⟨hselected, ?_⟩
  rcases D.orientation_spec with ⟨_, _, hcentres⟩ | ⟨_, _, hcentres⟩
  · rwa [hcentres] at hselected
  · have hw := coordinateSwap_weaklyPeriodic hselected
    have hswap : coordinateSwap '' (coordinateSwap '' (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) =
        (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        simpa only [coordinateSwap_apply_apply] using hx
      · intro hz
        refine ⟨coordinateSwap z, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        exact coordinateSwap_apply_apply z
    rwa [hcentres, hswap] at hw

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.topologicallyMinimalTiling_weaklyPeriodic
statement:
theorem topologicallyMinimalTiling_weaklyPeriodic
    {K : Region} (T : Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ)
    (hminimal : Topology.IsTopologicallyMinimal (Topology.orbitHull T)) :
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.WeaklyPeriodic (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := Structure.exists_minimalTilingStructureData T hminimal
  exact (minimalStructure_weaklyPeriodic D).2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.minimalTiling_weaklyPeriodic
statement:
theorem minimalTiling_weaklyPeriodic (K : Region)
    (htileable : ∃ T : Set Tiling.Plane, TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    ∃ T : Set Tiling.Plane, TilesOn K T Set.univ ∧
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.WeaklyPeriodic T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := htileable
  obtain ⟨S, _⟩ := tilingSpace_of_tilesOn hT
  obtain ⟨M, _, hM⟩ := Structure.exists_topologicallyMinimalOrbitPoint S
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := Structure.exists_minimalTilingStructureData M hM
  exact ⟨M.centres, M.tilesOn, (minimalStructure_weaklyPeriodic D).2⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.triangularPeriods_replacement
statement:
private theorem triangularPeriods_replacement
    {K : Region} {X : Set ℝ} {S : Set Tiling.Plane} {alpha beta shear : ℝ}
    (hTiles : TilesOn K S (Complex.re ⁻¹' X)) (ha : 0 < alpha) (hb : 0 < beta)
    (hv : verticalPeriodVector alpha ∈ periodGroup S)
    (hw : skewPeriodVector beta shear ∈ periodGroup S) :
    Nonempty (PeriodicReplacement K (Complex.re ⁻¹' X))
proof:
:= by
  let L : PlanarLattice := {
    basis := ![verticalPeriodVector alpha, skewPeriodVector beta shear]
    independent := by
      rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iffₛ]
      intro a b c d hab
      have hre := congrArg Complex.re hab
      have him := congrArg Complex.im hab
      simp [verticalPeriodVector, skewPeriodVector] at hre him
      have hbd : b = d := hre.resolve_right (ne_of_gt hb)
      subst d
      constructor
      · nlinarith [him, ha]
      · rfl }
  refine ⟨{ centres := S, tiles := hTiles, lattice := L, lattice_periods := ?_ }⟩
  rw [PlanarLattice.toAddSubgroup]
  apply (AddSubgroup.closure_le (periodGroup S)).mpr
  rintro v ⟨i, rfl⟩
  fin_cases i
  · exact hv
  · exact hw

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.minimalStructure_replacementSlabFamily
statement:
private theorem minimalStructure_replacementSlabFamily
    {K : Region} {T : Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    (D : Structure.MinimalTilingStructureData K T)
    (hsurvivors : (D.columnPart.Nonempty ∧ 0 < D.numberOfPieces) ∨
      2 ≤ D.numberOfPieces) : Nonempty (ReplacementSlabFamily D.selectedRegion)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R (j : Fin D.numberOfPieces) :=
    Classical.choice (minimalStructure_pieceReplacement D j)
  by_cases hcolumn : D.columnPart.Nonempty
  · have hn : 0 < D.numberOfPieces := by
      rcases hsurvivors with h | h
      · exact h.2
      · omega
    obtain ⟨C⟩ := minimalStructure_columnReplacementFamily D hcolumn
    obtain ⟨Rcolumn⟩ := triangularPeriods_replacement
      (C.family.replacement_tiles 0) C.family.verticalPeriod_pos C.family.axisPeriod_pos
      (C.family.replacement_verticalPeriod 0) (C.family.replacement_axisPeriod 0)
    let X : Fin (D.numberOfPieces + 1) → Set ℝ := Fin.cases D.columnBase D.base
    let P : ∀ j, PeriodicReplacement D.selectedRegion (Complex.re ⁻¹' X j) :=
      Fin.cases (by simpa only [X, Fin.cases_zero, C.family_base] using Rcolumn) R
    have hdisj : Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ X := by
      intro i _ j _
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i' ↦ ?_) i
      · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j' ↦ ?_) j
        · intro hij
          exact (hij rfl).elim
        · intro _
          exact D.columnBase_disjoint_base j'
      · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j' ↦ ?_) j
        · intro _
          exact (D.columnBase_disjoint_base i').symm
        · intro hij
          exact D.bases_pairwiseDisjoint (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _)
            (fun h ↦ hij (congrArg Fin.succ h))
    have hcover : (⋃ j, X j) =ᵐ[volume] Set.univ := by
      have hX : (⋃ j, X j) = D.columnBase ∪ ⋃ j, D.base j := by
        ext x
        simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_union]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
          refine Fin.cases (fun h ↦ Or.inl h) (fun j' h ↦ Or.inr ⟨j', h⟩) j hj
        · rintro (h | ⟨j, hj⟩)
          · exact ⟨0, h⟩
          · exact ⟨j.succ, hj⟩
      rw [hX]
      exact D.bases_cover
    refine ⟨{ numberOfPieces := D.numberOfPieces + 1, atLeastTwoPieces := by omega
              base := X, base_nonempty := ?_, base_proper := ?_, base_open := ?_
              base_regular := ?_, base_periodic := ?_, bases_pairwiseDisjoint := hdisj
              bases_cover := hcover, replacement := P }⟩
    · intro j
      exact Fin.cases (D.columnBase_nonempty_iff.mpr hcolumn) D.base_nonempty j
    · intro j
      exact Fin.cases (D.columnBase_proper_of_piece ⟨⟨0, hn⟩⟩)
        (fun j' ↦ D.base_proper_of_multiple j' (Or.inl hcolumn)) j
    · intro j
      exact Fin.cases D.columnBase_open D.base_open j
    · intro j
      exact Fin.cases D.columnBase_regular D.base_regular j
    · intro j
      refine ⟨D.horizontalPeriod, D.horizontalPeriod_pos, ?_⟩
      exact Fin.cases D.columnBase_periodic D.base_periodic j
  · have hn : 2 ≤ D.numberOfPieces := hsurvivors.resolve_left (fun h ↦ hcolumn h.1)
    have hbase : D.columnBase = ∅ :=
      Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp (fun h ↦ hcolumn (D.columnBase_nonempty_iff.mp h))
    refine ⟨{ numberOfPieces := D.numberOfPieces, atLeastTwoPieces := hn
              base := D.base, base_nonempty := D.base_nonempty
              base_proper := fun j ↦ D.base_proper_of_multiple j (Or.inr hn)
              base_open := D.base_open, base_regular := D.base_regular
              base_periodic := fun j ↦ ⟨D.horizontalPeriod, D.horizontalPeriod_pos,
                D.base_periodic j⟩
              bases_pairwiseDisjoint := D.bases_pairwiseDisjoint
              bases_cover := ?_, replacement := R }⟩
    simpa only [hbase, Set.empty_union] using D.bases_cover

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.regularOpen_proper_complement_nonnull
statement:
private theorem regularOpen_proper_complement_nonnull
    {X : Set ℝ} (hregular : interior (closure X) = X) (hproper : X ≠ Set.univ) :
    volume Xᶜ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hclosure : closure X ≠ Set.univ := by
    intro h
    apply hproper
    rw [← hregular, h, interior_univ]
  have hne : (closure X)ᶜ.Nonempty := Set.nonempty_compl.mpr hclosure
  have hpos := isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl.measure_pos volume hne
  exact ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le hpos (measure_mono (Set.compl_subset_compl.mpr subset_closure)))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.triangularSubgroup_le_periodGroup
statement:
private theorem triangularSubgroup_le_periodGroup
    {S : Set Tiling.Plane} {alpha beta shear : ℝ}
    (hv : verticalPeriodVector alpha ∈ periodGroup S)
    (hw : skewPeriodVector beta shear ∈ periodGroup S) :
    triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear ≤ periodGroup S
proof:
:= by
  rintro v ⟨m, n, rfl⟩
  exact (periodGroup S).add_mem ((periodGroup S).zsmul_mem hv m)
    ((periodGroup S).zsmul_mem hw n)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.replacementSlabFamily_certificate
statement:
private theorem replacementSlabFamily_certificate
    {K Kselected : Region} (F : ReplacementSlabFamily Kselected)
    (orientation : Bool) (hregion : Kselected = if orientation then K.coordinateSwap else K) :
    Nonempty (SlabCertificate K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Fin F.numberOfPieces → Set Tiling.Plane := fun j ↦ (F.replacement j).centres
  have hFpos : 0 < F.numberOfPieces := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 0 < 2) F.atLeastTwoPieces
  have htiles (j) : TilesOn Kselected (S j) (Complex.re ⁻¹' F.base j) :=
    (F.replacement j).tiles
  have hsupport (j) : regularSupport Kselected (S j) = Complex.re ⁻¹' F.base j := by
    apply regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn ((F.base_open j).preimage Complex.continuous_re)
      _ (htiles j)
    rw [Complex.closure_preimage_re, Complex.interior_preimage_re, F.base_regular j]
  have hnonempty (j) : (S j).Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    have hS := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := F.base_nonempty j
    have hz : (x : ℂ) ∈ regularSupport Kselected (S j) := by
      rw [hsupport j]
      simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, Complex.ofReal_re] using hx
    rw [hS, regularSupport, Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport,
      Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion] at hz
    simp at hz
  have hpieceDisj : Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ S := by
    intro i hi j hj hij
    change Disjoint (S i) (S j)
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro s hsi hsj
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Kselected.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty Kselected.nonempty
    have hmem (a) (hsa : s ∈ S a) : (s + u).re ∈ F.base a := by
      have hopen : IsOpen (openUnion Kselected (S a)) := by
        rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier]
        exact isOpen_iUnion fun t ↦ isOpen_interior.vadd (t : Tiling.Plane)
      have hz : s + u ∈ regularSupport Kselected (S a) := by
        apply hopen.subset_interior_closure
        rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
        exact ⟨⟨s, hsa⟩, Set.mem_vadd_set.mpr ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩⟩
      rwa [hsupport a] at hz
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (F.bases_pairwiseDisjoint hi hj hij)
      (hmem i hsi) (hmem j hsj)
  let L (j) := (F.replacement j).lattice
  have hnormal (j) : Nonempty (VerticalSlabLatticeForm (L j)) := by
    apply exists_verticalSlabNormalForm (F.base_open j).measurableSet
      ((F.base_open j).measure_pos volume (F.base_nonempty j)).ne'
      (regularOpen_proper_complement_nonnull (F.base_regular j) (F.base_proper j))
    intro v hv
    have hvS := (F.replacement j).lattice_periods hv
    have hperiod := support_aePeriod_of_centrePeriod (F.base_open j).measurableSet
      (htiles j) hvS
    exact slab_aePeriod_iff_re_aePeriod.mpr hperiod
  let N (j) := Classical.choice (hnormal j)
  have htriangular (j) : triangularPeriodSubgroup (N j).verticalPeriod
      (N j).horizontalPeriod (N j).shear ≤ periodGroup (S j) := by
    rw [← (N j).subgroup_eq]
    exact (F.replacement j).lattice_periods
  have hv (j) : verticalPeriodVector (N j).verticalPeriod ∈ periodGroup (S j) :=
    htriangular j ⟨1, 0, by simp⟩
  have hw (j) : skewPeriodVector (N j).horizontalPeriod (N j).shear ∈ periodGroup (S j) :=
    htriangular j ⟨0, 1, by simp⟩
  have hbasePeriod (j) : (N j).horizontalPeriod +ᵥ F.base j =ᵐ[volume] F.base j := by
    simpa [skewPeriodVector] using
      support_aePeriod_of_centrePeriod (F.base_open j).measurableSet (htiles j) (hw j)
  have hpositive (j) : ∃ I : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded I ∧
      0 < (volume (F.base j ∩ I)).toReal := by
    obtain ⟨A, _, hAbounded, hA, hApos⟩ := exists_boundedPositive_measurable_subset
      (F.base_open j).measurableSet ((F.base_open j).measure_pos volume (F.base_nonempty j)).ne'
    exact ⟨A, hAbounded, by rwa [Set.inter_eq_right.mpr hA]⟩
  have hhorizontalComm (i j) : ∃ q : ℚ,
      (N i).horizontalPeriod = (q : ℝ) * (N j).horizontalPeriod := by
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
    · exact disjointPeriodicLineSets_periods_commensurable
        (F.base_open i).measurableSet (F.base_open j).measurableSet (hpositive i) (hpositive j)
        (F.bases_pairwiseDisjoint (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _) hij).aedisjoint
        (N i).horizontalPeriod_pos (N j).horizontalPeriod_pos (hbasePeriod i) (hbasePeriod j)
  obtain ⟨B, hB, m, hm, hBm⟩ := exists_commonPositiveNatMultiple
    hFpos (fun j ↦ (N j).horizontalPeriod_pos) hhorizontalComm
  let shearB (j) : ℝ := (m j : ℝ) * (N j).shear
  have hwB (j) : skewPeriodVector B (shearB j) ∈ periodGroup (S j) := by
    have h := (periodGroup (S j)).nsmul_mem (hw j) (m j)
    have heq : (m j) • skewPeriodVector (N j).horizontalPeriod (N j).shear =
        skewPeriodVector B (shearB j) := by
      rw [hBm j]
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [skewPeriodVector, shearB, nsmul_eq_mul]
    rwa [heq] at h
  have hselectedTiles : TilesOn Kselected (⋃ j, S j) Set.univ := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_univ, Set.ofPred_true] using tilesOn_finite_iUnion_of_aePartition
      htiles (fun i j hij ↦
        (F.bases_pairwiseDisjoint (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _) hij).aedisjoint) F.bases_cover
  have hmeasureDisj : Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ
      (fun j ↦ volume.restrict (F.base j)) := by
    intro i hi j hj hij
    apply Measure.MutuallySingular.disjoint
    refine ⟨(F.base i)ᶜ, (F.base_open i).measurableSet.compl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Measure.restrict_apply (F.base_open i).measurableSet.compl,
        Set.compl_inter_self, measure_empty]
    · rw [compl_compl, Measure.restrict_apply (F.base_open i).measurableSet,
        Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp (F.bases_pairwiseDisjoint hi hj hij), measure_empty]
  let P : FiniteSlabPartition Kselected (⋃ j, S j) := {
    carrierBase := Set.univ
    carrierBase_open := isOpen_univ
    carrierBase_regular := by simp
    carrierBase_nonnull := by simp
    source_tiles := by simpa only [Set.preimage_univ] using hselectedTiles
    numberOfParts := F.numberOfPieces
    numberOfParts_pos := hFpos
    partCentres := S
    partCentres_nonempty := hnonempty
    partCentres_pairwise := hpieceDisj
    partCentres_union := rfl
    partBase := F.base
    partBase_open := F.base_open
    partBase_regular := F.base_regular
    partBase_ae_disjoint := hmeasureDisj
    partBase_ae_partition := by
      rw [← Measure.restrict_congr_set F.bases_cover,
        Measure.restrict_iUnion
          (fun i j hij ↦ F.bases_pairwiseDisjoint (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _) hij)
          (fun j ↦ (F.base_open j).measurableSet), Measure.sum_fintype]
    part_tiles := htiles
    commonPeriod := B
    commonPeriod_pos := hB
    carrierBase_periodic := by simp
    verticalPeriod := fun j ↦ (N j).verticalPeriod
    verticalPeriod_pos := fun j ↦ (N j).verticalPeriod_pos
    shear := shearB
    part_vertical_period := hv
    part_skew_period := hwB }
  
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := exists_simultaneousSlabRationalization P
  have hverticalComm (i j) : ∃ q : ℚ,
      (N i).verticalPeriod = (q : ℝ) * (N j).verticalPeriod := by
    
    let M : MixedRationalizationDatum (N i).verticalPeriod (N j).verticalPeriod B := {
      deformedRegion := R.deformation.firstRegion
      nonColumnCentres := R.deformedPartCentres i
      columnCentres := R.deformedPartCentres j
      nonColumnBase := R.deformedPartBase i
      columnBase := R.deformedPartBase j
      nonColumnBase_measurable := (R.deformedPartBase_open i).measurableSet
      columnBase_measurable := (R.deformedPartBase_open j).measurableSet
      rationalHorizontalPeriod := (R.rationalHorizontalPeriod : ℝ)
      nonColumnShear := shearB i
      columnShear := shearB j
      sourceCommonPeriod_pos := hB
      rationalHorizontalPeriod_pos := by exact_mod_cast R.rationalHorizontalPeriod_pos
      nonColumnTiles := R.deformed_part_tiles i
      columnTiles := R.deformed_part_tiles j
      nonColumnVerticalPeriod := R.deformed_part_vertical_period i
      nonColumnHorizontalPeriod := R.deformed_part_skew_period i
      columnVerticalPeriod := R.deformed_part_vertical_period j
      columnHorizontalPeriod := R.deformed_part_skew_period j
      nonColumnMass := R.rationalMass i
      columnMass := R.rationalMass j
      nonColumnMass_pos := R.rationalMass_pos i
      columnMass_pos := R.rationalMass_pos j
      nonColumnMass_eq := R.rationalMass_eq i
      columnMass_eq := R.rationalMass_eq j }
    exact verticalPeriods_commensurable_of_rationalMasses M
      (N i).verticalPeriod_pos (N j).verticalPeriod_pos
  obtain ⟨A, hA, n, hn, hAn⟩ := exists_commonPositiveNatMultiple
    hFpos (fun j ↦ (N j).verticalPeriod_pos) hverticalComm
  have hvA (j) : verticalPeriodVector A ∈ periodGroup (S j) := by
    have h := (periodGroup (S j)).nsmul_mem (hv j) (n j)
    have heq : (n j) • verticalPeriodVector (N j).verticalPeriod = verticalPeriodVector A := by
      rw [hAn j]
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [verticalPeriodVector, nsmul_eq_mul]
    rwa [heq] at h
  have hnormalize (j) := normalizeShear_mod_verticalPeriod (beta := B) (shear := shearB j) hA
  let shear0 (j) : ℝ := Classical.choose (hnormalize j)
  have hshear0 (j) := Classical.choose_spec (hnormalize j)
  have hw0 (j) : skewPeriodVector B (shear0 j) ∈ periodGroup (S j) := by
    have hsub := triangularSubgroup_le_periodGroup (hvA j) (hwB j)
    rw [(hshear0 j).2.2] at hsub
    exact hsub ⟨0, 1, by simp [shear0]⟩
  have hselectedCommon : verticalPeriodVector A ∈ periodGroup (⋃ j, S j) := by
    rw [periodGroup_isAddSubgroup, Set.vadd_set_iUnion]
    congr 1
    funext j
    exact (periodGroup_isAddSubgroup _ _).mp (hvA j)
  let originalPiece (j) : Set Tiling.Plane := if orientation then coordinateSwap '' S j else S j
  let originalCentres : Set Tiling.Plane := if orientation then coordinateSwap '' (⋃ j, S j)
    else ⋃ j, S j
  have horiginalUnion : (⋃ j, originalPiece j) = originalCentres := by
    cases orientation <;> simp only [originalPiece, originalCentres, Bool.false_eq_true,
      ↓reduceIte, Set.image_iUnion]
  have horiginalTiles : TilesOn K originalCentres Set.univ := by
    cases orientation with
    | false =>
      simpa only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, originalCentres, hregion] using hselectedTiles
    | true =>
      have h := tilesOn_coordinateSwap hselectedTiles
      simpa only [hregion, Region.coordinateSwap_involutive,
        Set.image_univ_of_surjective coordinateSwap.surjective, originalCentres, ↓reduceIte] using h
  have horiginalPieceTiles (j) : TilesOn K (originalPiece j)
      (if orientation then {z : Tiling.Plane | z.im ∈ F.base j}
        else {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ F.base j}) := by
    cases orientation with
    | false => simpa only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, originalPiece, hregion,
        Set.preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using htiles j
    | true =>
      have himage : coordinateSwap '' (Complex.re ⁻¹' F.base j) =
          {z : Tiling.Plane | z.im ∈ F.base j} := by
        ext z
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
          simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, coordinateSwap_im] using hw
        · intro hz
          exact ⟨coordinateSwap z, by simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
            coordinateSwap_re] using hz,
            coordinateSwap_apply_apply z⟩
      have h := tilesOn_coordinateSwap (htiles j)
      simpa only [hregion, Region.coordinateSwap_involutive, originalPiece, ↓reduceIte,
        himage] using h
  refine ⟨{
    orientation := orientation
    selectedRegion := Kselected
    selectedRegion_eq := hregion
    numberOfPieces := F.numberOfPieces
    atLeastTwoPieces := F.atLeastTwoPieces
    selectedCentres := ⋃ j, S j
    selectedPiece := S
    selectedPiece_nonempty := hnonempty
    selectedPiece_pairwiseDisjoint := hpieceDisj
    selectedPieces_union := rfl
    selected_tiles := hselectedTiles
    base := F.base
    base_nonempty := F.base_nonempty
    base_proper := F.base_proper
    base_open := F.base_open
    base_regular := F.base_regular
    base_periodic := F.base_periodic
    piece_tiles := htiles
    bases_pairwise_aeDisjoint := F.bases_pairwiseDisjoint.aedisjoint
    bases_cover := F.bases_cover
    verticalPeriod := fun j ↦ (N j).verticalPeriod
    horizontalPeriod := fun j ↦ (N j).horizontalPeriod
    shear := fun j ↦ (N j).shear
    verticalPeriod_pos := fun j ↦ (N j).verticalPeriod_pos
    horizontalPeriod_pos := fun j ↦ (N j).horizontalPeriod_pos
    individual_verticalPeriod := hv
    individual_skewPeriod := hw
    vertical_commensurable := hverticalComm
    horizontal_commensurable := hhorizontalComm
    commonVerticalPeriod := A
    commonHorizontalPeriod := B
    commonVerticalPeriod_pos := hA
    commonHorizontalPeriod_pos := hB
    verticalMultiplier := n
    horizontalMultiplier := m
    verticalMultiplier_pos := hn
    horizontalMultiplier_pos := hm
    commonVerticalPeriod_eq := hAn
    commonHorizontalPeriod_eq := hBm
    normalizedShear := shear0
    normalizedShear_nonnegative := fun j ↦ (hshear0 j).1
    normalizedShear_lt := fun j ↦ (hshear0 j).2.1
    common_verticalPeriod := hvA
    common_skewPeriod := hw0
    selected_commonPeriod := hselectedCommon
    originalCentres := originalCentres
    originalPiece := originalPiece
    originalCentres_eq := rfl
    originalPiece_eq := fun _ ↦ rfl
    originalPieces_union := horiginalUnion
    original_tiles := horiginalTiles
    originalPiece_tiles := horiginalPieceTiles
    original_verticalPeriod := ?_
    original_skewPeriod := ?_
    original_commonPeriod := ?_ }⟩
  · intro j
    cases orientation with
    | false => exact hvA j
    | true => exact coordinateSwap_periodGroup (hvA j)
  · intro j
    cases orientation with
    | false => exact hw0 j
    | true => exact coordinateSwap_periodGroup (hw0 j)
  · cases orientation with
    | false => exact hselectedCommon
    | true => exact coordinateSwap_periodGroup hselectedCommon

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.minimalStructure_slabCertificate
statement:
private theorem minimalStructure_slabCertificate
    {K : Region} {T : Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    (D : Structure.MinimalTilingStructureData K T) :
    ¬ HasFLC (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) →
    ((D.columnPart.Nonempty ∧ 0 < D.numberOfPieces) ∨ 2 ≤ D.numberOfPieces) →
    Nonempty (SlabCertificate K)
proof:
:= by
  intro _ hsurvivors
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := minimalStructure_replacementSlabFamily D hsurvivors
  rcases D.orientation_spec with ⟨_, hregion, _⟩ | ⟨_, hregion, _⟩
  · exact replacementSlabFamily_certificate F false hregion
  · exact replacementSlabFamily_certificate F true hregion

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.minimalStructure_periodicTilingNormalForm
statement:
private theorem minimalStructure_periodicTilingNormalForm
    {K : Region} {T : Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    (D : Structure.MinimalTilingStructureData K T) :
    Nonempty (PeriodicTilingNormalForm K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hslab :
      (D.columnPart.Nonempty ∧ 0 < D.numberOfPieces) ∨ 2 ≤ D.numberOfPieces
  · have hNonFLC : ¬ HasFLC (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
      intro hFLC
      obtain ⟨hcolumn, hnumber, _⟩ := D.finiteComplexity_normalForm hFLC
      rcases hslab with ⟨hcolumnNonempty, _⟩ | htwo
      · rw [hcolumn] at hcolumnNonempty
        exact Set.not_nonempty_empty hcolumnNonempty
      · omega
    obtain ⟨C⟩ := minimalStructure_slabCertificate
      D hNonFLC hslab
    exact ⟨PeriodicTilingNormalForm.orientedSlabs C⟩
  have hselected : Nonempty (PeriodicReplacement D.selectedRegion Set.univ) := by
    by_cases hzero : D.numberOfPieces = 0
    · have hcolumn : D.columnPart.Nonempty := by
        rcases D.somePart_nonempty with hcolumn | hj
        · exact hcolumn
        · obtain ⟨j⟩ := hj
          exact Fin.elim0 (hzero ▸ j)
      obtain ⟨C⟩ := minimalStructure_columnReplacementFamily D hcolumn
      have hbaseUnion : (⋃ j, D.base j) = ∅ := by
        ext x
        simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
        rintro ⟨j, _⟩
        exact Fin.elim0 (hzero ▸ j)
      have hcover : C.family.base =ᵐ[volume] Set.univ := by
        rw [C.family_base]
        simpa only [hbaseUnion, Set.union_empty] using D.bases_cover
      obtain ⟨P⟩ := triangularPeriods_replacement
        (C.family.replacement_tiles 0) C.family.verticalPeriod_pos C.family.axisPeriod_pos
        (C.family.replacement_verticalPeriod 0) (C.family.replacement_axisPeriod 0)
      exact singletonSelectedPiece_wholePlaneLattice P.tiles hcover
        ⟨P.lattice, P.lattice_periods⟩
    · have hpos : 0 < D.numberOfPieces := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
      have hcolumn : D.columnPart = ∅ := by
        apply Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp
        intro hcolumn
        exact hslab (Or.inl ⟨hcolumn, hpos⟩)
      have hone : D.numberOfPieces = 1 := by
        have hnotTwo : ¬ 2 ≤ D.numberOfPieces := fun htwo ↦ hslab (Or.inr htwo)
        omega
      let j : Fin D.numberOfPieces := ⟨0, hpos⟩
      have hbaseUnion : (⋃ k, D.base k) = D.base j := by
        let : Nonempty (Fin D.numberOfPieces) := ⟨j⟩
        have hindex : ∀ k : Fin D.numberOfPieces, k = j := by
          intro k
          apply Fin.ext
          have hk := k.isLt
          dsimp only [j]
          omega
        simp only [hindex, Set.iUnion_const]
      have hcolumnBase : D.columnBase = ∅ := by
        apply Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp
        intro hne
        have hc := D.columnBase_nonempty_iff.mp hne
        rw [hcolumn] at hc
        exact Set.not_nonempty_empty hc
      have hcover : D.base j =ᵐ[volume] Set.univ := by
        simpa only [hcolumnBase, hbaseUnion, Set.empty_union] using D.bases_cover
      obtain ⟨P⟩ := minimalStructure_pieceReplacement D j
      exact ⟨{ P with tiles := tilesOn_congr_cylinder_ae_local P.tiles hcover }⟩
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := hselected
  rcases D.orientation_spec with ⟨_, hregion, _⟩ | ⟨_, hregion, _⟩
  · exact ⟨PeriodicTilingNormalForm.wholePlaneLattice (hregion ▸ P)⟩
  · let L : PlanarLattice := {
      basis := fun i ↦ coordinateSwap (P.lattice.basis i)
      independent := P.lattice.independent.map' coordinateSwap.toLinearMap
        coordinateSwap.ker }
    refine ⟨PeriodicTilingNormalForm.wholePlaneLattice {
      centres := coordinateSwap '' P.centres
      tiles := ?_
      lattice := L
      lattice_periods := ?_ }⟩
    · have htiles := tilesOn_coordinateSwap P.tiles
      simpa only [hregion, Region.coordinateSwap_involutive,
        Set.image_univ, coordinateSwap.surjective.range_eq] using htiles
    · rw [PlanarLattice.toAddSubgroup]
      apply (AddSubgroup.closure_le (periodGroup (coordinateSwap '' P.centres))).mpr
      rintro v ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact coordinateSwap_periodGroup
        (P.lattice_periods (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self i)))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_periodicTilingNormalForm
statement:
theorem exists_periodicTilingNormalForm (K : Region) :
    (∃ T : Set Tiling.Plane, TilesOn K T Set.univ) →
      Nonempty (PeriodicTilingNormalForm K)
proof:
:= by
  intro htileable
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := htileable
  obtain ⟨S, _⟩ := tilingSpace_of_tilesOn hT
  obtain ⟨M, _, hM⟩ := Structure.exists_topologicallyMinimalOrbitPoint S
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := Structure.exists_minimalTilingStructureData M hM
  exact minimalStructure_periodicTilingNormalForm D

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_quasiPeriodicTiling_commonPeriod
statement:
theorem exists_quasiPeriodicTiling_commonPeriod (K : Region) :
    (∃ T : Set Tiling.Plane, TilesOn K T Set.univ) →
      ∃ S : Set Tiling.Plane, TilesOn K S Set.univ ∧ IsQuasiPeriodic S ∧
        ∃ p : Tiling.Plane, p ≠ 0 ∧ p ∈ periodGroup S
proof:
:= by
  intro htileable
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := exists_periodicTilingNormalForm K htileable
  exact periodicTilingNormalForm_to_quasiPeriodic P

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.OracleProgram.evaluate_bind
statement:
theorem evaluate_bind {Q α β : Type} (answer : Q → Bool)
    (p : OracleProgram Q α) (k : α → OracleProgram Q β) :
    OracleProgram.evaluate answer (bind p k) =
      OracleProgram.evaluate answer
        (k (OracleProgram.evaluate answer p))
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | pure a => rfl
  | query q next ih =>
      simpa only [bind, OracleProgram.evaluate] using ih (answer q)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.OracleProgram.evaluate_map
statement:
theorem evaluate_map {Q α β : Type} (answer : Q → Bool)
    (f : α → β) (p : OracleProgram Q α) :
    OracleProgram.evaluate answer (map f p) =
      f (OracleProgram.evaluate answer p)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map, OracleProgram.evaluate] using
    evaluate_bind answer p (fun a => .pure (f a))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.OracleProgram.evaluate_mapQuery
statement:
theorem evaluate_mapQuery {Q Q' α : Type} (answer : Q' → Bool)
    (f : Q → Q') (p : OracleProgram Q α) :
    OracleProgram.evaluate answer (mapQuery f p) =
      OracleProgram.evaluate (fun q => answer (f q)) p
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | pure a => rfl
  | query q next ih =>
      simpa only [mapQuery, OracleProgram.evaluate] using ih (answer (f q))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.indicator_eq_iff_membership
statement:
private theorem indicator_eq_iff_membership {G : Type*}
    (S : Set G) (x y : G) :
    TranslationalTilings.setIndicator S x =
        TranslationalTilings.setIndicator S y ↔ (x ∈ S ↔ y ∈ S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : x ∈ S <;> by_cases hy : y ∈ S <;>
    simp [TranslationalTilings.setIndicator, hx, hy]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.wedge_quarterTurn_self_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem wedge_quarterTurn_self_ne_zero
    {v : TranslationalTilings.Plane} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    TranslationalTilings.wedge (quarterTurn v) v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hw
  have hw' : -(v 1 * v 1) - v 0 * v 0 = 0 := by
    simpa [TranslationalTilings.wedge, quarterTurn] using hw
  have hv0 : v 0 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v 0), sq_nonneg (v 1)]
  have hv1 : v 1 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v 0), sq_nonneg (v 1)]
  apply hv
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> assumption

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.wedge_coordinate_identity
statement:
private theorem wedge_coordinate_identity
    (h g u : TranslationalTilings.Plane) :
    TranslationalTilings.wedge u g • h +
        TranslationalTilings.wedge h u • g =
      TranslationalTilings.wedge h g • u
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [TranslationalTilings.wedge] <;> ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_discreteFinerStructure_of_directional
statement:
private theorem exists_discreteFinerStructure_of_directional
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A E : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {ell base : ℕ}
    (hF : F.Nonempty) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hE : TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic ell E)
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A E)
    (D : TranslationalTilings.DirectionalTilingDecomposition F A E base)
    (hbase : 0 < base) (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    Nonempty (DiscreteFinerStructureData F A E ell)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Active := {j : Fin D.numberOfParts // (D.part j).Nonempty}
  let m := Fintype.card Active
  let activeEquiv : Active ≃ Fin m := Fintype.equivFin Active
  let index : Fin m → Fin D.numberOfParts := fun i ↦ (activeEquiv.symm i).1
  let part : Fin m → Set TranslationalTilings.Plane := fun i ↦ D.part (index i)
  have hpartNonempty (i : Fin m) : (part i).Nonempty :=
    (activeEquiv.symm i).2
  have hpartSubset (i : Fin m) : part i ⊆ A := by
    intro x hx
    rw [← D.union_parts]
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨index i, hx⟩
  have hindexInjective : Function.Injective index := by
    intro i j hij
    apply activeEquiv.symm.injective
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hij
  have hpartsDisjoint : Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ part := by
    intro i _hi j _hj hij
    exact D.pairwiseDisjoint (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _)
      (hindexInjective.ne hij)
  have hpartsUnion : (⋃ i, part i) = A := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      exact hpartSubset i hxi
    · intro x hx
      rw [← D.union_parts] at hx
      obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      have hjNonempty : (D.part j).Nonempty := ⟨x, hxj⟩
      let a : Active := ⟨j, hjNonempty⟩
      let i : Fin m := activeEquiv a
      have hindex : index i = j := by
        change (activeEquiv.symm (activeEquiv a)).1 = j
        simp [a]
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, by simpa [part, hindex] using hxj⟩
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hA
    rw [← hpartsUnion] at hx
    obtain ⟨i, _hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hm ↦ Fin.elim0 (hm ▸ i)
  let u : Fin m → TranslationalTilings.Plane := fun i ↦
    TranslationalTilings.primitivePart (D.direction (index i))
  let content : Fin m → ℕ := fun i ↦
    TranslationalTilings.vectorContent (D.direction (index i))
  have huPrimitive (i : Fin m) : TranslationalTilings.IsPrimitive (u i) :=
    (TranslationalTilings.primitive_decomposition
      (D.direction_ne_zero (index i))).2
  have huNe (i : Fin m) : u i ≠ 0 := (huPrimitive i).1
  have hcontentPos (i : Fin m) : 0 < content i :=
    TranslationalTilings.vectorContent_pos (D.direction_ne_zero (index i))
  have hdirection (i : Fin m) :
      (content i : ℤ) • u i = D.direction (index i) :=
    (TranslationalTilings.primitive_decomposition
      (D.direction_ne_zero (index i))).1
  obtain ⟨N, hNpos, hcarrierPeriodic⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.gtCommonDirectionalCarrierPeriod D hbase
  let k : Fin m → ℕ := fun i ↦ base * content i
  have hkPos (i : Fin m) : 0 < k i :=
    Nat.mul_pos hbase (hcontentPos i)
  have hpartPeriodic (i : Fin m) :
      Function.Periodic (TranslationalTilings.setIndicator (part i))
        (((N * k i : ℕ) : ℤ) • u i) := by
    have hp := (D.periodic_part (index i)).zsmul (N : ℤ)
    have hshift : (((N * k i : ℕ) : ℤ) • u i) =
        (N : ℤ) • ((base : ℤ) • D.direction (index i)) := by
      rw [← hdirection i]
      dsimp [k]
      module
    simpa only [part, hshift] using hp
  have hconvPeriodic (i : Fin m) :
      TranslationalTilings.ScalarPeriodic N
        (TranslationalTilings.tileConv F
          (TranslationalTilings.setIndicator (part i))) := by
    rw [Tiling.RationalPolygonal.tileConv_indicator_eq_indicator_discreteCarrier
      hTile (hpartSubset i)]
    intro x z
    apply (indicator_eq_iff_membership
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F (part i)) _ _).2
    exact hcarrierPeriodic (index i) x z
  let modulus : Fin m → ℕ := fun i ↦
    TranslationalTilings.indicatorDilationModulus N F.card * k i *
      TranslationalTilings.slicingLCM F (u i)
  have hmodulusPos (i : Fin m) : 0 < modulus i := by
    exact Nat.mul_pos
      (Nat.mul_pos
        (by simpa [TranslationalTilings.indicatorDilationModulus] using
          (TranslationalTilings.dilationModulus_pos
            (oscillation := 1) (tileCard := F.card) hNpos))
        (hkPos i))
      (TranslationalTilings.slicingLCM_pos F (u i))
  let scale : ℕ := ∏ i : Fin m, modulus i
  have hscalePos : 0 < scale := by
    dsimp [scale]
    exact Finset.prod_pos fun i _ ↦ hmodulusPos i
  have hmodulusDvdScale (i : Fin m) : modulus i ∣ scale := by
    simpa [scale] using
      (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem modulus (Finset.mem_univ i))
  let v : TranslationalTilings.Plane := TranslationalTilings.avoidanceVector u
  have hvSpec := TranslationalTilings.avoidanceVector_spec huNe
  have hvNe : v ≠ 0 := hvSpec.1
  let h : TranslationalTilings.Plane := quarterTurn v
  let g : TranslationalTilings.Plane := (scale : ℤ) • v
  have hgNe : g ≠ 0 := by
    exact smul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hscalePos)) hvNe
  have hhg : TranslationalTilings.wedge h g ≠ 0 := by
    rw [show g = (scale : ℤ) • v by rfl,
      TranslationalTilings.wedge_zsmul_right]
    exact mul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hscalePos))
      (wedge_quarterTurn_self_ne_zero hvNe)
  have huWedgeG (i : Fin m) :
      TranslationalTilings.wedge (u i) g ≠ 0 := by
    rw [show g = (scale : ℤ) • v by rfl,
      TranslationalTilings.wedge_zsmul_right]
    refine mul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hscalePos)) ?_
    rw [TranslationalTilings.wedge_swap]
    exact neg_ne_zero.mpr fun hw ↦ hvSpec.2.1 i
      ((TranslationalTilings.commensurable_iff_wedge_eq_zero hvNe (huNe i)).2 hw)
  let direction : Fin m → DiscreteDirection h g := fun i ↦ {
    primitiveVector := u i
    primitive := huPrimitive i
    hCoefficient := TranslationalTilings.wedge (u i) g
    gCoefficient := TranslationalTilings.wedge h (u i)
    hCoefficient_ne_zero := huWedgeG i
    multiple := TranslationalTilings.wedge h g
    multiple_ne_zero := hhg
    period_eq := wedge_coordinate_identity h g (u i)
  }
  have hNkDvdScale (i : Fin m) : N * k i ∣ scale := by
    apply dvd_trans ?_ (hmodulusDvdScale i)
    apply dvd_mul_of_dvd_left _ (TranslationalTilings.slicingLCM F (u i))
    apply Nat.mul_dvd_mul_right
      (show N ∣ TranslationalTilings.indicatorDilationModulus N F.card by
        exact TranslationalTilings.ell_dvd_dilationModulus N 1 F.card)
  have hwithinPeriodic (i : Fin m) (Q : TranslationalTilings.Plane ⧸
      TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup (u i)) :
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy
        (DiscreteSlice (u i) Q (part i)) (direction i).period := by
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hNkDvdScale i
    have hdet : TranslationalTilings.wedge h g =
        ((q : ℤ) * TranslationalTilings.wedge h v) *
          ((N * k i : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      rw [show g = (scale : ℤ) • v by rfl,
        TranslationalTilings.wedge_zsmul_right]
      have hscale : scale = N * k i * q := hq
      rw [hscale]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hp : Function.Periodic
        (TranslationalTilings.setIndicator (part i)) (direction i).period := by
      have hp' := (hpartPeriodic i).zsmul
        ((q : ℤ) * TranslationalTilings.wedge h v)
      have hshift : (direction i).period =
          ((q : ℤ) * TranslationalTilings.wedge h v) •
            (((N * k i : ℕ) : ℤ) • u i) := by
        rw [show (direction i).period =
          TranslationalTilings.wedge h g • u i from (direction i).period_eq, hdet]
        module
      rw [hshift]
      exact hp'
    have hpMem : (direction i).period ∈
        TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup (u i) := by
      rw [show (direction i).period =
        TranslationalTilings.wedge h g • u i from (direction i).period_eq]
      change _ ∈ AddSubgroup.zmultiples (u i)
      exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hquot (x : TranslationalTilings.Plane) :
        QuotientAddGroup.mk' (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup (u i))
            (x + (direction i).period) =
          QuotientAddGroup.mk' (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup (u i)) x := by
      apply QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.mpr
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using hpMem
    intro x
    change x + (direction i).period ∈ part i ∩
        TranslationalTilings.quotientCoset
          (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup (u i)) Q ↔
      x ∈ part i ∩ TranslationalTilings.quotientCoset
        (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup (u i)) Q
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxpart, hxQ⟩
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact ((indicator_eq_iff_membership (part i) _ _).1
          (hp x)).mp hxpart
      · change QuotientAddGroup.mk'
          (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup (u i)) x = Q
        change QuotientAddGroup.mk'
          (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup (u i))
            (x + (direction i).period) = Q at hxQ
        rw [hquot x] at hxQ
        exact hxQ
    · rintro ⟨hxpart, hxQ⟩
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact ((indicator_eq_iff_membership (part i) _ _).1
          (hp x)).mpr hxpart
      · change QuotientAddGroup.mk'
          (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup (u i))
            (x + (direction i).period) = Q
        rw [hquot x]
        exact hxQ
  have horbit (i : Fin m) :
      DiscreteSliceOrbit F (part i) (u i) (direction i).period g := by
    let phases : Set (TranslationalTilings.Plane ⧸
        TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup (u i)) :=
      {Q | (DiscreteSlice (u i) Q (part i)).Nonempty}
    have hphasesNonempty : phases.Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hpartNonempty i
      let Q := QuotientAddGroup.mk'
        (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup (u i)) x
      refine ⟨Q, x, hx, ?_⟩
      change QuotientAddGroup.mk'
        (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup (u i)) x = Q
      rfl
    have htransport (Q : TranslationalTilings.Plane ⧸
        TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup (u i)) (n : ℤ) :
        TranslationalTilings.translateSet (n • g)
            (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
              (DiscreteSlice (u i) Q (part i))) =
          Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
            (DiscreteSlice (u i)
              (Q + QuotientAddGroup.mk'
                (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup (u i)) (n • g))
              (part i)) := by
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hmodulusDvdScale i
      have ht := Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.gtSliceTransport
        (F := F) (A := part i) (ell := N) (k := k i)
        hNpos (hkPos i) (huPrimitive i) (hpartPeriodic i)
        (hconvPeriodic i) Q ((n * (q : ℤ)) • v)
      have hshift : n • g =
          ((modulus i : ℕ) : ℤ) • ((n * (q : ℤ)) • v) := by
        dsimp [g]
        rw [show scale = modulus i * q from hq]
        push_cast
        module
      simpa only [DiscreteSlice, modulus, hshift] using ht
    refine {
      phases := phases
      phase_iff_nonempty := fun Q ↦ Iff.rfl
      phases_nonempty := hphasesNonempty
      within_ne_zero := by
        rw [show (direction i).period =
          TranslationalTilings.wedge h g • u i from (direction i).period_eq]
        exact smul_ne_zero hhg (huNe i)
      within_parallel := by
        rw [show (direction i).period =
          TranslationalTilings.wedge h g • u i from (direction i).period_eq]
        exact ⟨1, TranslationalTilings.wedge h g, one_ne_zero, hhg, by module⟩
      slice_periodic := fun Q _hQ ↦ hwithinPeriodic i Q
      phase_translate_mem := ?_
      carrier_transport := fun Q _hQ n ↦ htransport Q n
    }
    intro Q hQ n
    change (DiscreteSlice (u i)
      (Q + QuotientAddGroup.mk'
        (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup (u i)) (n • g))
      (part i)).Nonempty
    obtain ⟨x, hxSlice⟩ := hQ
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hF
    have hxCarrier : f + x ∈
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (DiscreteSlice (u i) Q (part i)) :=
      ⟨f, hf, x, hxSlice, rfl⟩
    have hxTranslated : n • g + (f + x) ∈
        TranslationalTilings.translateSet (n • g)
          (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
            (DiscreteSlice (u i) Q (part i))) := by
      simpa [TranslationalTilings.translateSet] using hxCarrier
    rw [htransport Q n] at hxTranslated
    obtain ⟨_f, _hf, y, hy, _hxy⟩ := hxTranslated
    exact ⟨y, hy⟩
  refine ⟨{
    tile_nonempty := hF
    ell_pos := hell
    target_periodic := hE
    tiles := hTile
    h := h
    g := g
    independent := hhg
    numberOfParts := m
    number_zero_iff := ?_
    part := part
    part_nonempty := hpartNonempty
    pairwiseDisjoint := hpartsDisjoint
    iUnion_parts := hpartsUnion
    direction := direction
    sliceOrbit := horbit
  }⟩
  constructor
  · intro hm
    exact (Nat.ne_of_gt hmpos hm).elim
  · intro hAempty
    exact (Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mp hA hAempty).elim

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_discreteFinerStructure
statement:
theorem exists_discreteFinerStructure
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A E : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {ell : ℕ}
    (hF : F.Nonempty) (hell : 0 < ell)
    (hE : TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic ell E)
    (hTile : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A E) :
    Nonempty (DiscreteFinerStructureData F A E ell)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hAempty : A = ∅
  · let h : TranslationalTilings.Plane := ![(1 : ℤ), 0]
    let g : TranslationalTilings.Plane := ![(0 : ℤ), 1]
    refine ⟨{
      tile_nonempty := hF
      ell_pos := hell
      target_periodic := hE
      tiles := hTile
      h := h
      g := g
      independent := by simp [h, g, TranslationalTilings.wedge]
      numberOfParts := 0
      number_zero_iff := by simp [hAempty]
      part := Fin.elim0
      part_nonempty := fun i ↦ Fin.elim0 i
      pairwiseDisjoint := by intro i; exact Fin.elim0 i
      iUnion_parts := by simp [hAempty]
      direction := Fin.elim0
      sliceOrbit := fun i ↦ Fin.elim0 i
    }⟩
  have hA : A.Nonempty := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hAempty
  by_cases hcardOne : F.card = 1
  · obtain ⟨f, hFsingleton⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcardOne
    let e0 : TranslationalTilings.Plane := ![(1 : ℤ), 0]
    have he0 : e0 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      have := congrFun hz 0
      norm_num [e0] at this
    have htileEq (x : TranslationalTilings.Plane) :
        TranslationalTilings.setIndicator A (x - f) =
          TranslationalTilings.setIndicator E x := by
      simpa [TranslationalTilings.Tiles, TranslationalTilings.TilesAtLevel,
        TranslationalTilings.tileConv, hFsingleton] using hTile x
    have hperiodA : Function.Periodic
        (TranslationalTilings.setIndicator A) ((ell : ℤ) • e0) := by
      intro x
      calc
        TranslationalTilings.setIndicator A (x + (ell : ℤ) • e0) =
            TranslationalTilings.setIndicator E
              ((x + (ell : ℤ) • e0) + f) := by
          simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using
            htileEq ((x + (ell : ℤ) • e0) + f)
        _ = TranslationalTilings.setIndicator E (x + f) := by
          apply (indicator_eq_iff_membership E _ _).2
          have hp := hE (x + f) e0
          simpa only [add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hp
        _ = TranslationalTilings.setIndicator A x := by
          symm
          simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using htileEq (x + f)
    let D : TranslationalTilings.DirectionalTilingDecomposition F A E ell := {
      numberOfParts := 1
      number_pos := Nat.zero_lt_one
      part := fun _ ↦ A
      direction := fun _ ↦ e0
      direction_ne_zero := fun _ ↦ he0
      pairwise_incommensurable := by
        intro i j hij
        exact (hij (Subsingleton.elim i j)).elim
      periodic_part := fun _ ↦ hperiodA
      pairwiseDisjoint := by
        intro i _hi j _hj hij
        exact (hij (Subsingleton.elim i j)).elim
      union_parts := by
        apply Set.Subset.antisymm
        · intro x hx
          obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
          exact hxi
        · intro x hx
          exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, hx⟩
      target_periodic := hE
      tiles := hTile
    }
    exact exists_discreteFinerStructure_of_directional
      hF hell hE hTile D hell hA
  · have hcard : 1 < F.card := by
      have hcardPos : 0 < F.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hF
      omega
    obtain ⟨t, htF⟩ := hF
    let F₀ : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane := F.image fun f ↦ f - t
    let A₀ : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane :=
      TranslationalTilings.translateSet t A
    have hzero : 0 ∈ F₀ :=
      Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨t, htF, sub_self t⟩
    have hcardEq : F₀.card = F.card :=
      Finset.card_image_iff.mpr
        (Set.injOn_of_injective (sub_left_injective :
          Function.Injective fun f : TranslationalTilings.Plane ↦ f - t))
    have htile₀ : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F₀ A₀ E := by
      have ht := (TranslationalTilings.tiles_translate_tile F A E 1 t).mp hTile
      have himage :
          @Finset.image TranslationalTilings.Plane TranslationalTilings.Plane
            (Classical.decEq TranslationalTilings.Plane)
            (fun f ↦ f - t) F = F₀ := by
        ext x
        simp only [F₀, Finset.mem_image]
      rw [himage] at ht
      exact ht
    obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ :=
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.gtUniformCosetwiseDirections
        (F := F₀) (E := E) hell hzero (by simpa [hcardEq] using hcard) hE
    have hvalid := hW A₀ htile₀
    obtain ⟨D₀, _hnum, _hdirections⟩ :=
      TranslationalTilings.exists_directionalTilingDecomposition_of_quantitativeData
        hell hE htile₀ W hvalid
    have hbase : 0 < ell * W.multiplier :=
      Nat.mul_pos hell W.arithmetic.multiplier_pos
    let part : Fin D₀.numberOfParts → Set TranslationalTilings.Plane :=
      fun i ↦ TranslationalTilings.translateSet (-t) (D₀.part i)
    have hpartsUnion : (⋃ i, part i) = A := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
        change x - -t ∈ D₀.part i at hxi
        have hxA₀ : x - -t ∈ A₀ := by
          rw [← D₀.union_parts]
          exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hxi⟩
        change x - -t - t ∈ A at hxA₀
        simpa only [sub_neg_eq_add, add_sub_cancel_right] using hxA₀
      · intro hx
        have hxA₀ : x + t ∈ A₀ := by
          change x + t - t ∈ A
          simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hx
        rw [← D₀.union_parts] at hxA₀
        obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxA₀
        refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, ?_⟩
        change x - -t ∈ D₀.part i
        simpa only [sub_neg_eq_add] using hxi
    let D : TranslationalTilings.DirectionalTilingDecomposition F A E
        (ell * W.multiplier) := {
      numberOfParts := D₀.numberOfParts
      number_pos := D₀.number_pos
      part := part
      direction := D₀.direction
      direction_ne_zero := D₀.direction_ne_zero
      pairwise_incommensurable := D₀.pairwise_incommensurable
      periodic_part := by
        intro i x
        change TranslationalTilings.setIndicator (D₀.part i)
            (x + ((ell * W.multiplier : ℕ) : ℤ) • D₀.direction i - -t) =
          TranslationalTilings.setIndicator (D₀.part i) (x - -t)
        simpa only [sub_neg_eq_add, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using
          D₀.periodic_part i (x + t)
      pairwiseDisjoint := by
        intro i _hi j _hj hij
        change Disjoint (part i) (part j)
        rw [Set.disjoint_left]
        intro x hxi hxj
        exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
          (D₀.pairwiseDisjoint (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _) hij)
          (by simpa [part, TranslationalTilings.translateSet] using hxi)
          (by simpa [part, TranslationalTilings.translateSet] using hxj)
      union_parts := hpartsUnion
      target_periodic := D₀.target_periodic
      tiles := hTile
    }
    exact exists_discreteFinerStructure_of_directional
      ⟨t, htF⟩ hell hE hTile D hbase hA

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.discretePeriod_liftsContinuous
proof:
:= by
  let A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane :=
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier I.integerTile S
  change TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic L A at hperiod
  let e₀ : TranslationalTilings.Plane := ![1, 0]
  let U : Set Tiling.Plane := {z : Tiling.Plane | ∃ q ∈ A,
    (q 0 : ℝ) < z.re ∧ z.re < (q 0 : ℝ) + 1 ∧
    (q 1 : ℝ) < z.im ∧ z.im < (q 1 : ℝ) + 1}
  have hUperiod (z : Tiling.Plane) : z + (L : ℂ) ∈ U ↔ z ∈ U := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q, hq, hq₀, hz₀, hq₁, hz₁⟩
      let q' := q - (L : ℤ) • e₀
      have hq' : q' ∈ A := by
        apply (hperiod q' e₀).mp
        simpa only [q', sub_add_cancel] using hq
      refine ⟨q', hq', ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · dsimp [q', e₀]
        norm_num at ⊢
        norm_num at hq₀
        linarith
      · dsimp [q', e₀]
        norm_num at ⊢
        norm_num at hz₀
        linarith
      · dsimp [q', e₀]
        simpa using hq₁
      · dsimp [q', e₀]
        simpa using hz₁
    · rintro ⟨q, hq, hq₀, hz₀, hq₁, hz₁⟩
      let q' := q + (L : ℤ) • e₀
      have hq' : q' ∈ A := (hperiod q e₀).mpr hq
      refine ⟨q', hq', ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · dsimp [q', e₀]
        norm_num at ⊢
        linarith
      · dsimp [q', e₀]
        norm_num at ⊢
        linarith
      · dsimp [q', e₀]
        simpa using hq₁
      · dsimp [q', e₀]
        simpa using hz₁
  have hUshift : ((L : ℂ) +ᵥ U) = U := by
    ext z
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simpa [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc]
      using (hUperiod (z - (L : ℂ))).symm
  have hRshift : ((L : ℂ) +ᵥ interior (closure U)) = interior (closure U) := by
    calc
      (L : ℂ) +ᵥ interior (closure U) = interior ((L : ℂ) +ᵥ closure U) := by
        rw [interior_vadd]
      _ = interior (closure ((L : ℂ) +ᵥ U)) := by
        rw [closure_vadd]
      _ = interior (closure U) := by rw [hUshift]
  intro z
  change z + (L : ℂ) ∈ interior (closure U) ↔ z ∈ interior (closure U)
  have hz := Set.ext_iff.mp hRshift (z + (L : ℂ))
  simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg,
    add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hz.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.relativePlateEquiv_preservesColumns
statement:
theorem relativePlateEquiv_preservesColumns
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    {base : Set ℝ}
    (I : RelativePlateIntegerization K T base) :
    ∀ P,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.IsDiscreteVerticalColumn P ↔
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsVerticalColumn
          (I.plateEquiv P)
proof:
:= by
  have graphEquiv_re (z : I.integerCentres) :
      ((I.graphEquiv z : T) : Tiling.Plane).re = (z.1 0 : ℝ) := by
    have h := congrArg Complex.re (I.centre_apply z)
    simpa [Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint] using h
  intro P
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨(c : ℝ), ?_⟩
    rintro y ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    let z : I.integerCentres := I.graphEquiv.symm t
    have hzt : I.graphEquiv z = t := I.graphEquiv.apply_symm_apply t
    have hzPlate : z.1 ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P := by
      apply (I.plateEquiv_mem P z).mpr
      rw [hzt]
      exact ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    have hzImage :
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.firstDiscreteCoordinate z.1 ∈
          Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.firstDiscreteCoordinate ''
            Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P :=
      ⟨z.1, hzPlate, rfl⟩
    rw [hc] at hzImage
    have hzc : z.1 0 = c := by
      simpa [Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.firstDiscreteCoordinate] using hzImage
    change (t : Tiling.Plane).re = (c : ℝ)
    rw [← hzt, graphEquiv_re z, hzc]
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀Supp⟩ := P.nonempty_supp
    have hz₀Plate : z₀.1 ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P :=
      ⟨z₀.2, (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff P z₀).mp hz₀Supp⟩
    have hz₀Continuous :
        ((I.graphEquiv z₀ : T) : Tiling.Plane) ∈ (I.plateEquiv P).centres :=
      (I.plateEquiv_mem P z₀).mp hz₀Plate
    refine ⟨z₀.1 0, ?_⟩
    ext c
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨zRaw, ⟨hzMem, hzComponent⟩, rfl⟩
      let z : I.integerCentres := ⟨zRaw, hzMem⟩
      have hzPlate : z.1 ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations P :=
        ⟨hzMem, hzComponent⟩
      have hzContinuous :
          ((I.graphEquiv z : T) : Tiling.Plane) ∈ (I.plateEquiv P).centres :=
        (I.plateEquiv_mem P z).mp hzPlate
      have hzReal : (z.1 0 : ℝ) = x := (graphEquiv_re z).symm.trans (hx hzContinuous)
      have hz₀Real : (z₀.1 0 : ℝ) = x :=
        (graphEquiv_re z₀).symm.trans (hx hz₀Continuous)
      have hcast : (zRaw 0 : ℝ) = (z₀.1 0 : ℝ) :=
        hzReal.trans hz₀Real.symm
      have hint : zRaw 0 = z₀.1 0 := by exact_mod_cast hcast
      simp [Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.firstDiscreteCoordinate, hint]
    · intro hc
      have hc' : c = z₀.1 0 := by simpa using hc
      subst c
      exact ⟨z₀.1, hz₀Plate, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.carrierComponent_periodTranslate
statement:
private theorem carrierComponent_periodTranslate :
  ∀ (X : PeriodicVerticalCarrier) {a b : ℝ},
    IsCarrierComponent X a b → ∀ n : ℤ,
      IsCarrierComponent X
        (a + (n : ℝ) * X.period) (b + (n : ℝ) * X.period)
proof:
:= by
  intro X a b hab n
  rcases hab with ⟨hablt, haf, hbf, habase, hdisj⟩
  let d : ℝ := (n : ℝ) * X.period
  have hbase_fun : Function.Periodic (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ∈ X.base) X.period := by
    intro x
    apply propext
    have hm : x + X.period ∈ X.period +ᵥ X.base ↔ x + X.period ∈ X.base := by
      rw [X.base_periodic]
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hm
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hm.symm
  have hbase_shift (x : ℝ) : x + d ∈ X.base ↔ x ∈ X.base := by
    have h := (hbase_fun.int_mul n) x
    simpa [d, zsmul_eq_mul] using h
  have hfront : d +ᵥ frontier X.base = frontier X.base := by
    exact Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.frontier_periodic_zsmul
      X.base_periodic n
  have hfront_shift (x : ℝ) : x + d ∈ frontier X.base ↔ x ∈ frontier X.base := by
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hx' : x + d ∈ d +ᵥ frontier X.base := by
        rw [hfront]
        exact hx
      simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, sub_eq_add_neg,
        add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hx'
    · intro hx
      have hx' : d + x ∈ d +ᵥ frontier X.base := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      have hx'' : d + x ∈ frontier X.base := by
        rw [← hfront]
        exact hx'
      simpa [add_comm] using hx''
  have haf' : a + d ∈ frontier X.base := (hfront_shift a).mpr haf
  have hbf' : b + d ∈ frontier X.base := (hfront_shift b).mpr hbf
  have hablt' : a + d < b + d := by linarith
  have habase' : Ioo (a + d) (b + d) ⊆ X.base := by
    intro x hx
    have hy : x - d ∈ Ioo a b := by
      constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2]
    have hybase : x - d ∈ X.base := habase hy
    have hshifted := (hbase_shift (x - d)).mpr hybase
    simpa [sub_add_cancel] using hshifted
  have hdisj' : Ioo (a + d) (b + d) ∩ frontier X.base = ∅ := by
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    intro x hx
    have hy : x - d ∈ Ioo a b := by
      constructor <;> linarith [hx.1.1, hx.1.2]
    have hyfront : x - d ∈ frontier X.base := (hfront_shift (x - d)).mp (by
      simpa [sub_add_cancel] using hx.2)
    have hcontra : x - d ∈ Ioo a b ∩ frontier X.base := ⟨hy, hyfront⟩
    rw [hdisj] at hcontra
    exact hcontra
  exact ⟨hablt', haf', hbf', habase', hdisj'⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.sameIntegerPhase_equivalence
statement: private theorem sameIntegerPhase_equivalence : Equivalence SameIntegerPhase
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    exact ⟨0, by norm_num⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    rcases hxy with ⟨n, hn⟩
    refine ⟨-n, ?_⟩
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at hn ⊢
    rw [hn]
    norm_num
  · intro x y z hxy hyz
    rcases hxy with ⟨m, hm⟩
    rcases hyz with ⟨n, hn⟩
    refine ⟨m + n, ?_⟩
    calc
      x - z = (x - y) + (y - z) := by ring
      _ = (m : ℝ) + (n : ℝ) := by rw [hm, hn]
      _ = ((m + n : ℤ) : ℝ) := by norm_num

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.tilesOn_openUnion_subset_regularTarget
statement:
private theorem tilesOn_openUnion_subset_regularTarget
    {K : Region} {S D : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hDopen : IsOpen D) (hDregular : interior (closure D) = D)
    (hTile : TilesOn K S D) :
    openUnion K S ⊆ D
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : regularSupport K S = D :=
    regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn hDopen hDregular hTile
  rw [← hsupp]
  have hopen : IsOpen (openUnion K S) := by
    apply isOpen_iUnion
    intro s
    change IsOpen ((Homeomorph.addLeft (s : Tiling.Plane)) '' K.openCarrier)
    exact (Homeomorph.addLeft (s : Tiling.Plane)).isOpenMap _ isOpen_interior
  exact hopen.subset_interior_closure

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.carrier_openUnion_subset
statement:
private theorem carrier_openUnion_subset
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (X : PeriodicVerticalCarrier)
    (hTile : TilesOn K T X.carrier) :
    openUnion K T ⊆ X.carrier
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen X.carrier := X.base_open.preimage Complex.continuous_re
  have hregular : interior (closure X.carrier) = X.carrier := by
    change interior (closure (Complex.re ⁻¹' X.base)) = Complex.re ⁻¹' X.base
    rw [Complex.closure_preimage_re, Complex.interior_preimage_re,
      X.base_regular]
  have hsupp : regularSupport K T = X.carrier :=
    regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn hopen hregular hTile
  have hopenUnion : IsOpen (openUnion K T) := by
    apply isOpen_iUnion
    intro t
    exact isOpen_interior.vadd t.1
  rw [← hsupp]
  exact hopenUnion.subset_interior_closure

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.eventually_carrier_horizontal_slice
statement:
private theorem eventually_carrier_horizontal_slice
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (X : PeriodicVerticalCarrier)
    (hTile : TilesOn K T X.carrier) :
    ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume,
      x ∈ X.base → slicePoint Axis.horizontal q x ∈ openUnion K T
proof:
:= by
  have hplane : ∀ᵐ z : Tiling.Plane ∂volume,
      z ∈ X.carrier → z ∈ openUnion K T := by
    filter_upwards [hTile.2.2] with z hz
    exact fun hcarrier => by
      rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion,
        ← Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact hz.mp hcarrier
  have hpull :=
    Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.symm.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
      hplane
  have hswap := Measure.measurePreserving_swap.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hpull
  have hslices := Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod (μ := volume) (ν := volume) hswap
  filter_upwards [hslices] with q hq
  filter_upwards [hq] with x hx
  have heq : slicePoint Axis.horizontal q x =
      Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm (q, x).swap := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [slicePoint]
  rw [heq]
  exact hx

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_mem_Ioo_of_ae_real
proof:
:= by
  have hμ : volume.restrict (Ioo a b) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hz' : volume (Ioo a b) = 0 := by
      rw [← Measure.restrict_apply_univ (Ioo a b), hz]
      simp
    rw [Real.volume_Ioo] at hz'
    simp [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero, not_le.mpr (sub_pos.mpr hab)] at hz'
  let hne : (ae (volume.restrict (Ioo a b))).NeBot := ae_neBot.mpr hμ
  have hp' : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (Ioo a b), P x :=
    hP.filter_mono ae_restrict_le
  rcases @Filter.Eventually.exists ℝ _ (ae (volume.restrict (Ioo a b))) hne
      (hp'.and (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo)) with ⟨x, hp, hx⟩
  exact ⟨x, hx, hp⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.interval_subset_closure_of_local_ae
statement:
private theorem interval_subset_closure_of_local_ae
    {U : Set ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hfull : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ Ioo a b → x ∈ U) :
    Ioo a b ⊆ closure U
proof:
:= by
  have hdense : Dense {x : ℝ | x ∈ Ioo a b → x ∈ U} :=
    volume.dense_of_ae hfull
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_closure_iff]
  intro V hVopen hxV
  have hVOopen : IsOpen (V ∩ Ioo a b) := hVopen.inter isOpen_Ioo
  have hVOne : (V ∩ Ioo a b).Nonempty := ⟨x, hxV, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyVO⟩ := hdense.exists_mem_open hVOopen hVOne
  exact ⟨y, hyVO.1, hy hyVO.2⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.endpoint_mem_frontier_of_local_ae
statement:
private theorem endpoint_mem_frontier_of_local_ae
    {U : Set ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (X : PeriodicVerticalCarrier) (hab : a < b)
    (hfull : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ Ioo a b → x ∈ U)
    (hUsub : U ⊆ X.base) (ha : a ∈ frontier X.base) :
    a ∈ frontier U
proof:
:= by
  have hcl : Ioo a b ⊆ closure U :=
    interval_subset_closure_of_local_ae hfull
  have haI : a ∈ closure (Ioo a b) := by
    rw [closure_Ioo (ne_of_lt hab)]
    exact left_mem_Icc.mpr (le_of_lt hab)
  have haClosure : a ∈ closure U :=
    (closure_minimal hcl isClosed_closure) haI
  have haNotBase : a ∉ X.base := by
    intro haBase
    have haInterior : a ∈ interior X.base := by
      rw [X.base_open.interior_eq]
      exact haBase
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp disjoint_interior_frontier haInterior ha
  have haNotU : a ∉ U := fun haU => haNotBase (hUsub haU)
  rw [frontier]
  exact ⟨haClosure, fun haInt => haNotU (interior_subset haInt)⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.filledChain_vertex_re_integer
statement:
private theorem filledChain_vertex_re_integer
    {K : Region}
    (hIntegral : ∀ v ∈ K.vertices, ∃ m n : ℤ,
      v = (m : ℝ) + (n : ℝ) * Complex.I) :
    ∀ v : K.vertices, ∃ z : ℤ, v.1.re = z
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  obtain ⟨m, n, hv⟩ := hIntegral v.1 v.2
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  simpa using congrArg Complex.re hv

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.filledChain_prefix_integer
proof:
:= by
  have hVertexRe := filledChain_vertex_re_integer hIntegral
  obtain ⟨_hmono, hsteps⟩ := hchain
  have hstep (i : Fin n) : ∃ z : ℤ,
      x i.succ - x i.castSucc = z := by
    obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, hleft, hright, _hpos, _hgap⟩ := hsteps i
    obtain ⟨zv, hzv⟩ := hVertexRe ⟨v, hv⟩
    obtain ⟨zw, hzw⟩ := hVertexRe ⟨w, hw⟩
    refine ⟨zw - zv, ?_⟩
    simp only [Axis.coord, Complex.add_re] at hleft hright
    rw [Int.cast_sub]
    linarith
  intro k
  refine Fin.induction ?_ (fun k ih ↦ ?_) k
  · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hstep k
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨p + e, ?_⟩
    calc
      x k.succ - x 0 = (x k.castSucc - x 0) +
          (x k.succ - x k.castSucc) := by ring
      _ = (p : ℝ) + (e : ℝ) := by rw [hp, he]
      _ = (p + e : ℤ) := by exact (Int.cast_add p e).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.filledChain_difference_integer
proof:
:=
  filledChain_prefix_integer hIntegral hchain (Fin.last n)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.chain_endpoint_difference_integer
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := filledChain_difference_integer hIntegral hchain
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  simpa [hfirst, hlast] using hz

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.chain_endpoint_positive_nat
statement:
private theorem chain_endpoint_positive_nat
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (hz : ∃ z : ℤ, b - a = z) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ b - a = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hz
  have hzpos : 0 < z := by
    have hzpos' : (0 : ℝ) < (z : ℝ) := by
      rw [← hz]
      linarith
    exact_mod_cast hzpos'
  have hzcast : (z.toNat : ℤ) = z := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hzpos)
  have hzNatPos : 0 < z.toNat := by
    by_contra hn
    have hn0 : z.toNat = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hn
    have hz0 : z = 0 := by simpa [hn0] using hzcast.symm
    linarith
  refine ⟨z.toNat, hzNatPos, ?_⟩
  have hzcastR : (z.toNat : ℝ) = (z : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hzcast
  exact hz.trans hzcastR.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.strictMono_exists_gap
statement:
private theorem strictMono_exists_gap {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hx : StrictMono x) {u : ℝ} (hleft : x 0 < u)
    (hright : u < x (Fin.last n)) (hne : ∀ k, u ≠ x k) :
