    rintro ⟨huF, hvF, hCases⟩
    rcases hCases with ⟨huv, hno⟩ | ⟨hvu, hno⟩
    · exact hForward u v huMin hvMin huF hvF huv hno
    · have hReverse := hForward v u hvMin huMin hvF huF hvu hno
      calc
        (pair.theta v).1 - (pair.theta u).1 =
            -((pair.theta u).1 - (pair.theta v).1) := by abel
        _ = -(u.1 - v.1) := by rw [hReverse]
        _ = v.1 - u.1 := by abel
  obtain ⟨beta, hBeta, hMap⟩ := pair.controlled_displacement u₀
  have hu₀min : ∀ v ∈ properVertices (regularSupport C.region (Subtype.val '' S₀)),
      axis.transverseCoord u₀.1 ≤ axis.transverseCoord v := by
    simpa only [u₀, hw₀wall] using hwallLower₀
  have hMinimumDisplacement := actualWallConsecutive_displacement_propagates pair E₀
    hε hgerm hLower hraw hPack₀ hS₀ hline₀ hColumnable hNotColumn
    u₀ hu₀min (beta : Tiling.Plane) hBeta.symm hAdjacent
  have hAllDisplacement := actualPair_nearWall_displacement_propagates pair P hphi axis
    hPaths hTraceMargin hS₀ hPack₀ (by simpa only [hG₀] using hLinked₀)
    ⟨c₀, hline₀⟩ hNotColumn hMinimumDisplacement
  have hVertices : properVertices (regularSupport C.region (Subtype.val '' S₁)) =
      (beta : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ properVertices
        (regularSupport C.region (Subtype.val '' S₀)) := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · intro hp
      let q := pair.theta.symm ⟨p, hp⟩
      have hq := hAllDisplacement q
      have hqp : (pair.theta q).1 = p := congrArg Subtype.val
        (pair.theta.apply_symm_apply ⟨p, hp⟩)
      rw [hqp] at hq
      refine ⟨q.1, q.2, ?_⟩
      change (beta : Tiling.Plane) + q.1 = p
      rw [← hq]
      abel
    · rintro ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
      have hDisplacement := hAllDisplacement ⟨q, hq⟩
      have htheta : (pair.theta ⟨q, hq⟩).1 = (beta : Tiling.Plane) + q := by
        rw [← hDisplacement]
        abel
      change (beta : Tiling.Plane) + q ∈
        properVertices (regularSupport C.region (Subtype.val '' S₁))
      rw [← htheta]
      exact (pair.theta ⟨q, hq⟩).2
  have hCones : ∀ p, ∀ hp : p ∈ properVertices
      (regularSupport C.region (Subtype.val '' S₀)),
      ∀ hp' : (beta : Tiling.Plane) + p ∈ properVertices
        (regularSupport C.region (Subtype.val '' S₁)),
      localCone _ ((beta : Tiling.Plane) + p) hSource₁ hp' =
        localCone _ p hSource₀ hp := by
    intro p hp hp'
    have hDisplacement := hAllDisplacement ⟨p, hp⟩
    have htheta : (pair.theta ⟨p, hp⟩).1 = (beta : Tiling.Plane) + p := by
      rw [← hDisplacement]
      abel
    simpa only [htheta, localCone] using (pair.cone_preserved ⟨p, hp⟩).symm
  have hSupportNonempty₀ : (regularSupport C.region (Subtype.val '' S₀)).Nonempty :=
    Set.Nonempty.of_closure ⟨w₀, frontier_subset_closure hw₀.1⟩
  have hSupportNonempty₁ : (regularSupport C.region (Subtype.val '' S₁)).Nonempty :=
    Set.Nonempty.of_closure ⟨w₁, frontier_subset_closure hw₁.1⟩
  have hSupportProper₀ : regularSupport C.region (Subtype.val '' S₀) ≠ Set.univ := by
    intro h
    have hf := hw₀.1
    simp only [h, frontier_univ, Set.mem_empty_iff_false] at hf
  have hSupportProper₁ : regularSupport C.region (Subtype.val '' S₁) ≠ Set.univ := by
    intro h
    have hf := hw₁.1
    simp only [h, frontier_univ, Set.mem_empty_iff_false] at hf
  have hSupport := support_eq_vadd_of_properVertexGerms hSource₀ hSource₁
    hSupportNonempty₀ hSupportNonempty₁ hSupportProper₀ hSupportProper₁ beta
    hVertices hCones
    (noncolumn_completeBoundaryLine_meetsProperVertices axis hColumnable
      (hS₀.image Subtype.val) hPack₀ ⟨c₀, hline₀⟩ hNotColumn hSource₀)
    (noncolumn_completeBoundaryLine_meetsProperVertices axis hColumnable
      (hS₁.image Subtype.val) hPack₁ ⟨c₁, hline₁⟩ hNotColumn₁ hSource₁)
  exact ⟨beta, hSupport, hMap, (show
    (properVertices (regularSupport C.region (Subtype.val '' S₀))).Nonempty from
      ⟨w₀, hw₀⟩).ne_empty, (show
    (properVertices (regularSupport C.region (Subtype.val '' S₁))).Nonempty from
      ⟨w₁, hw₁⟩).ne_empty⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.verticalFLCNoGapOrbitTransport
statement:
theorem verticalFLCNoGapOrbitTransport :
    ∀ {C : ApproximationContext.{0}} (_hFLC : HasFLC C.centres)
      (_hColumnable : ∃ Col : Set Tiling.Plane,
        IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical C.region Col),
      ∃ recoveryScale : ℝ, 0 < recoveryScale ∧
        ∀ (P : FLCControlPackage C), recoveryScale < P.scale →
        ∀ (B : PeriodicBandData C), IsPeriodicBandFineness B P.threshold →
        ∀ (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ),
          IsEpsilonApproximation C P.threshold phi →
        ∀ (D : CoordinateDeformation C phi) (Tphi : ↥C.centres ↪ Tiling.Plane),
          (∀ t, Tphi t = mapPoint phi (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)) →
          ∀ (Dcmp : RationalDirectionalDecomposition
              D.deformedRegion (Set.range Tphi))
            (originalSlice : ∀ i : Fin Dcmp.numberOfParts,
              RationalSlice (Dcmp.direction i) → Set Tiling.Plane),
            (∀ i Q, Q ∈ (Dcmp.orbit i).phases →
              originalSlice i Q = Set.image Subtype.val
                {t : ↥C.centres | Tphi t ∈ Q.centres (Dcmp.part i)}) →
            ∀ (i : Fin Dcmp.numberOfParts)
              (Q : RationalSlice (Dcmp.direction i)),
              (∀ m : ℤ, Q.vadd (m • Dcmp.gamma.toPlane) ∈
                (Dcmp.orbit i).noGapPhases (originalSlice i)
                  (60 * Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier)) →
              (Dcmp.direction i).toPlane.re = 0 →
              (¬ IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical C.region (originalSlice i Q)) →
              ∀ m : ℤ, ∃ beta : {z : Tiling.Plane //
                z.re ∈ C.coordinateSpace ∧ z.im ∈ C.coordinateSpace},
                regularSupport C.region
                    (originalSlice i (Q.vadd (m • Dcmp.gamma.toPlane))) =
                  (beta : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ
                    regularSupport C.region (originalSlice i Q) ∧
                mapPoint phi beta = m • Dcmp.gamma.toPlane ∧
                properVertices (regularSupport C.region
                  (originalSlice i (Q.vadd (m • Dcmp.gamma.toPlane)))) ≠ ∅
proof:
:= by
  intro C hFLC hColumnable
  obtain ⟨recoveryScale, hRecoveryScale,
    hColumnableTransport⟩ :=
      columnableAxisLocalTransport hFLC Axis.vertical hColumnable
  refine ⟨recoveryScale, hRecoveryScale, ?_⟩
  intro P hRecovery Pband hFine phi hphi D Tphi hTphi Dcmp originalSlice
    hPreimage i Q hOrbitNoGap hvertical hNotColumn m
  let G : ℝ := 60 * Metric.diam C.region.openCarrier
  obtain ⟨data⟩ := verticalNoGapOrbitPairData_exists (phi := phi)
    P Pband hFine hphi D Tphi hTphi Dcmp originalSlice hPreimage i Q G m
    (by simpa [G] using hOrbitNoGap) hvertical
  have hNotColumnIndices :
      ¬ IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical C.region
        (Set.image Subtype.val data.S₀) := by
    rw [← data.source₀_eq]
    exact hNotColumn
  have hTransported := hColumnableTransport P hRecovery phi hphi D Tphi hTphi
    data.S₀ data.Sₘ G (by rfl)
    ⟨data.sourcePacking₀, data.sourcePackingₘ,
      data.imagePacking₀, data.imagePackingₘ⟩
    ⟨data.nonempty₀, data.nonemptyₘ⟩
    ⟨data.imageLine₀, data.imageLineₘ⟩
    ⟨data.linked₀, data.linkedₘ⟩
    data.imagePeriod data.imagePeriod_ne data.imagePeriod_vertical
    ⟨data.imagePeriod_invariant₀, data.imagePeriod_invariantₘ⟩
    hNotColumnIndices
  obtain ⟨beta, hSupport, hMap, _hProper₀, hProperₘ⟩ :=
    hTransported (m • Dcmp.gamma.toPlane) data.imageSupport_shift
  refine ⟨beta, ?_, hMap, ?_⟩
  · rw [data.sourceₘ_eq, data.source₀_eq]
    exact hSupport
  · rw [data.sourceₘ_eq]
    exact hProperₘ

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.AllInput.query_primrec
statement: private theorem query_primrec (axis : Fin 2) : Primrec (query axis)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : Primrec (fun k : ℕ => [2*k]) :=
    Primrec.list_cons.comp (Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2) Primrec.id) (Primrec.const [])
  have hright : Primrec (fun k : ℕ => [2*k+1]) :=
    Primrec.list_cons.comp (Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2) Primrec.id) (Primrec.const 1)) (Primrec.const [])
  exact (Primrec.const axis).pair (hright.pair hleft)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.AllInput.schedule_computable
statement: theorem schedule_computable : Computable schedule
proof:
:=
  (Primrec.list_append.comp
    (Primrec.list_map Primrec.list_range ((query_primrec 0).comp Primrec.snd).to₂)
    (Primrec.list_map Primrec.list_range ((query_primrec 1).comp Primrec.snd).to₂)).to_comp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.AllInput.proper_computable
statement: theorem proper_computable : Computable₂ proper
proof:
:= by
  have hk : Computable (fun x : (ℕ × List Bool) × (ℕ × Bool) => x.2.1) :=
    Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd
  have hn : Computable (fun x : (ℕ × List Bool) × (ℕ × Bool) => x.1.1) :=
    Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst
  have hp : Computable (fun x : (ℕ × List Bool) × (ℕ × Bool) => x.1.2) :=
    Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst
  have ha := (Primrec.list_getD false).to_comp.comp hp hk
  have hb := (Primrec.list_getD false).to_comp.comp hp (Primrec.nat_add.to_comp.comp hn hk)
  exact Tiling.Computability.List.computable_list_foldr_param
    (Primrec.list_range.to_comp.comp Computable.fst) (Computable.const false)
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.or).to_comp.comp
      ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).to_comp.comp
        ((Primrec.dom_bool Bool.not).to_comp.comp ha)
        ((Primrec.dom_bool Bool.not).to_comp.comp hb))
      (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)).to₂

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.AllInput.program_computable
statement: theorem program_computable : Computable₂ program
proof:
:= by
  apply OraclePrefix.prefixProgram_computable schedule_computable
  refine (Computable.cond
    (proper_computable.comp Computable.fst (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd))
    (uniformDecisionProgram_computable.comp Computable.fst (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd))
    (Computable.const (.inl false))).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  simp only [Bool.cond_eq_ite, body]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.AllInput.fold_or
statement:
private theorem fold_or (p : ℕ → Bool) (xs : List ℕ) :
    xs.foldr (fun k found => p k || found) false = true ↔ ∃ k ∈ xs, p k = true
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons k xs ih => simp [ih]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.AllInput.proper_correct
statement:
theorem proper_correct {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {answer : Query → Bool}
    (ha : CorrectOracle (cornerList R) answer) :
    proper R.length ((schedule R.length).map answer) = true ↔
      (interior (⋃ r ∈ R, rectangle r.1 r.2)).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [proper, fold_or, RectangleInput.Validity.interior_rectangles_nonempty]
  have hentry (k : ℕ) (hk : k < R.length) :
      (!( ((schedule R.length).map answer).getD k false) &&
       !( ((schedule R.length).map answer).getD (R.length+k) false)) =
      RectangleInput.Validity.properRectangle answer k := by
    simp [schedule, List.map_append, List.map_map, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.getElem?_append, hk,
      query, RectangleInput.Validity.properRectangle]
  simp only [List.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk, hp⟩
    rw [hentry k hk] at hp
    refine ⟨R.getD k (0,0), ?_, (RectangleInput.Validity.properRectangle_correct ha hk).mp hp⟩
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem R (0,0) hk]
    exact List.getElem_mem hk
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, hp⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk, he⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hr
    refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
    rw [hentry k hk]
    apply (RectangleInput.Validity.properRectangle_correct ha hk).mpr
    simpa only [List.getD_eq_getElem R (0,0) hk, he] using hp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.AllInput.not_tiles_empty
statement: private theorem not_tiles_empty (T : Set Plane) : ¬ Tiles ∅ T
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he : (univ : Set Plane) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] (∅ : Set Plane) := by
    simpa only [CoversExactly, Set.vadd_empty] using h.2.2
  have hz : MeasureTheory.volume (univ : Set Plane) = 0 := by
    simpa using MeasureTheory.measure_congr he
  simp at hz

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.AllInput.program_correct
statement:
theorem program_correct {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {answer : Query → Bool}
    (ha : CorrectOracle (cornerList R) answer) :
    (∃ fuel b, run (program R.length) answer fuel [] = some b) ∧
      ∀ fuel b, run (program R.length) answer fuel [] = some b →
        (b = true ↔ ∃ T, Tiles (interior (⋃ r ∈ R, rectangle r.1 r.2)) T)
proof:
:= by
  let answers := (schedule R.length).map answer
  have hc (fuel : ℕ) : run (program R.length) answer ((schedule R.length).length + fuel) [] =
      run (body R.length answers) answer fuel [] :=
    OraclePrefix.run_from_empty_after_schedule schedule body R.length answer fuel
  by_cases hp : proper R.length answers = true
  · have hbody : body R.length answers = uniformDecisionProgram R.length := by
      funext history
      simp [body, hp]
    have hbody' : body R.length ((schedule R.length).map answer) =
        uniformDecisionProgram R.length := hbody
    have hR : RectanglePresentation R (interior (⋃ r ∈ R, rectangle r.1 r.2)) :=
      ⟨(proper_correct ha).mp hp, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨fuel, b, hf⟩, hs⟩ := uniformDecisionProgram_correct hR ha
    constructor
    · exact ⟨(schedule R.length).length + fuel, b, by rw [hc, hbody]; exact hf⟩
    · intro fuel b hf
      obtain ⟨f, hf'⟩ :=
        OraclePrefix.run_answer_after_schedule schedule body R.length answer fuel b hf
      exact hs f b (by rw [hbody'] at hf'; exact hf')
  · have hbody : body R.length answers = (fun _ => .inl false) := by
      funext history
      simp [body, hp]
    have hbody' : body R.length ((schedule R.length).map answer) = (fun _ => .inl false) := hbody
    have he : interior (⋃ r ∈ R, rectangle r.1 r.2) = ∅ :=
      Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp (mt (proper_correct ha).mpr hp)
    constructor
    · exact ⟨(schedule R.length).length + 1, false, by rw [hc, hbody]; rfl⟩
    · intro fuel b hf
      obtain ⟨f, hf'⟩ :=
        OraclePrefix.run_answer_after_schedule schedule body R.length answer fuel b hf
      cases f with
      | zero => simp [run] at hf'
      | succ f =>
        have hb : b = false := by rw [hbody'] at hf'; simpa [run] using hf'.symm
        simp [hb, he, not_tiles_empty]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.uniformDecisionProgram_computable
statement: theorem uniformDecisionProgram_computable : Computable₂ uniformDecisionProgram
proof:
:=
  OracleDecision.decisionProgram_computable CertificateFormulas.positiveFormula_computable
    NegativeFormulas.negativeFormula_computable

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.uniformDecisionProgram_correct
proof:
:= by
  exact OracleDecision.decisionProgram_correct_of_native
    CertificateFormulas.positiveFormula NegativeFormulas.negativeFormula
    hR hanswer
    (OracleDecision.positiveValue_eq_native hR hanswer)
    (OracleDecision.negativeValue_eq_native hR hanswer)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.uniform_oracle_relative_decision_bounded
statement:
theorem uniform_oracle_relative_decision_bounded :
    ∃ program : OracleCode, Computable₂ program ∧
      ∀ R Ω, RectanglePresentation R Ω → ∀ answer, CorrectOracle (cornerList R) answer →
        (∃ fuel b, run (program R.length) answer fuel [] = some b) ∧
        ∀ fuel b, run (program R.length) answer fuel [] = some b →
          (b = true ↔ ∃ T, Tiles Ω T)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨uniformDecisionProgram, uniformDecisionProgram_computable,
    fun _R _Ω hR _answer hanswer => uniformDecisionProgram_correct hR hanswer⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.selectedLabel_primrec
statement:
private theorem selectedLabel_primrec :
    Primrec (fun x : Fin 2 × PointLabel => selectedLabel x.1 x.2)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : Primrec (fun x : Fin 2 × PointLabel => decide (x.1 = 0)) :=
    (Primrec.eq.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.const (0 : Fin 2))).decide
  refine (Primrec.cond heq (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
    (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  rcases x with ⟨axis, p⟩
  fin_cases axis <;> simp [selectedLabel]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.originCornerLabel_primrec
proof:
:= by
  have hget : Primrec (fun x : Fin 2 × (List PointLabel × ℕ) =>
      x.2.1.getD x.2.2 (0, 0)) :=
    (Primrec.list_getD (0, 0)).comp
      (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd) (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)
  exact selectedLabel_primrec.comp (Primrec.pair Primrec.fst hget)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.indexedCornerLabel_primrec
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : Primrec (fun x : (Fin 2 × (List PointLabel × ℕ)) × ℕ =>
      x.1.2.1.getD x.1.2.2 (0, 0)) :=
    (Primrec.list_getD (0, 0)).comp
      (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst))
      (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst))
  have hget? : Primrec (fun x : (Fin 2 × (List PointLabel × ℕ)) × ℕ =>
      x.1.2.1[x.2]?) :=
    Primrec.list_getElem?.comp (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst))
      Primrec.snd
  have hget : Primrec (fun x : (Fin 2 × (List PointLabel × ℕ)) × ℕ =>
      (x.1.2.1[x.2]?).getD (x.1.2.1.getD x.1.2.2 (0, 0))) :=
    (Primrec.option_getD.comp hget? hbase)
  exact selectedLabel_primrec.comp
    (Primrec.pair (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst) hget)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.indexedCoefficients_primrec
statement: private theorem indexedCoefficients_primrec : Primrec indexedCoefficients
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : Primrec (fun coefficients : List ℤ => List.range coefficients.length) :=
    Primrec.list_range.comp (Primrec.list_length.comp Primrec.id)
  have hpair : Primrec₂ (fun coefficients : List ℤ => fun i : ℕ =>
      (i, coefficients.getD i 0)) :=
    (Primrec.pair Primrec.snd
      ((Primrec.list_getD 0).comp Primrec.fst Primrec.snd)).to₂
  exact (Primrec.list_map hrange hpair).of_eq (fun _ => rfl)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.comparisonTerms_primrec
statement:
private theorem comparisonTerms_primrec :
    Primrec (fun x : List ℤ × List ℤ => comparisonTerms x.1 x.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : Primrec (fun x : List ℤ × List ℤ => indexedCoefficients x.1) :=
    indexedCoefficients_primrec.comp Primrec.fst
  have hright : Primrec (fun x : List ℤ × List ℤ => indexedCoefficients x.2) :=
    indexedCoefficients_primrec.comp Primrec.snd
  have hneg : Primrec₂ (fun _ : List ℤ × List ℤ => fun t : SignedTerm => (t.1, -t.2)) :=
    (Primrec.pair (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
      (int_neg_primrec.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))).to₂
  exact (Primrec.list_append.comp hleft (Primrec.list_map hright hneg)).of_eq
    (fun _ => rfl)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.transportedTermPieces_primrec
proof:
:= by
  have hindexed : Primrec (fun x : (Fin 2 × (List PointLabel × ℕ)) × ℕ =>
      indexedCornerLabel x.1.1 x.1.2.1 x.1.2.2 x.2) := indexedCornerLabel_primrec
  have horigin : Primrec (fun x : (Fin 2 × (List PointLabel × ℕ)) × SignedTerm =>
      originCornerLabel x.1.1 x.1.2.1 x.1.2.2) :=
    originCornerLabel_primrec.comp Primrec.fst
  have hindex : Primrec (fun x : (Fin 2 × (List PointLabel × ℕ)) × SignedTerm =>
      indexedCornerLabel x.1.1 x.1.2.1 x.1.2.2 x.2.1) :=
    hindexed.comp (Primrec.pair Primrec.fst (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))
  have hcoeff : Primrec (fun x : (Fin 2 × (List PointLabel × ℕ)) × SignedTerm => x.2.2) :=
    Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd
  have hneg : Primrec (fun x : (Fin 2 × (List PointLabel × ℕ)) × SignedTerm => -x.2.2) :=
    int_neg_primrec.comp hcoeff
  refine (Primrec.list_cons.comp (Primrec.pair hindex hcoeff)
    (Primrec.list_cons.comp (Primrec.pair horigin hneg) (Primrec.const []))).to₂.of_eq ?_
  intro ctx term
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.transportSignedTerms_primrec
proof:
:= by
  have hcontext : Primrec (fun x : TransportInput => (x.1, (x.2.1, x.2.2.1))) :=
    Primrec.pair Primrec.fst
      (Primrec.pair (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
        (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)))
  have hterms : Primrec (fun x : TransportInput => x.2.2.2) :=
    Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)
  have hcallback : Primrec₂ (fun x : TransportInput => fun t : SignedTerm =>
      transportedTermPieces (x.1, (x.2.1, x.2.2.1)) t) := by
    refine (Primrec₂.comp transportedTermPieces_primrec (hcontext.comp Primrec.fst)
      Primrec.snd).to₂.of_eq ?_
    intro x t
    rfl
  exact (Primrec.list_flatMap hterms hcallback).of_eq (fun _ => rfl)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.compileNormalizedComparison_primrec
statement:
theorem compileNormalizedComparison_primrec :
    Primrec (fun x : Fin 2 × (List PointLabel × (ℕ × (List ℤ × List ℤ))) =>
      compileNormalizedComparison x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hterms : Primrec (fun x : Fin 2 × (List PointLabel × (ℕ × (List ℤ × List ℤ))) =>
      comparisonTerms x.2.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.2) :=
    comparisonTerms_primrec.comp
      (Primrec.pair (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)))
        (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))))
  have htransport : Primrec (fun x : Fin 2 × (List PointLabel × (ℕ × (List ℤ × List ℤ))) =>
      transportSignedTerms x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 (comparisonTerms x.2.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.2)) :=
    transportSignedTerms_primrec.comp
      (Primrec.pair Primrec.fst
        (Primrec.pair (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
          (Primrec.pair (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)) hterms)))
  have hquery : Primrec (fun x : Fin 2 × (List PointLabel × (ℕ × (List ℤ × List ℤ))) =>
      compileSignedComparison x.1
        (transportSignedTerms x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1
          (comparisonTerms x.2.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.2))) :=
    compileSignedComparison_primrec.comp (Primrec.pair Primrec.fst htransport)
  exact hquery.of_eq (fun _ => rfl)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.compileNormalizedComparison_computable
statement:
theorem compileNormalizedComparison_computable :
    Computable (fun x : Fin 2 × (List PointLabel × (ℕ × (List ℤ × List ℤ))) =>
      compileNormalizedComparison x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.2)
proof:
:=
  compileNormalizedComparison_primrec.to_comp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.compilePackedComparison_primrec
statement:
theorem compilePackedComparison_primrec :
    Primrec (fun x : List PointLabel × (ℕ × PackedComparison) =>
      compilePackedComparison x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  let Input := List PointLabel × (ℕ × PackedComparison)
  have hx2 : Primrec (fun x : Input => x.2) := Primrec.snd
  have hx22 : Primrec (fun x : Input => x.2.2) := Primrec.snd.comp hx2
  have hqvertical : Primrec (fun x : Input => x.2.2.1) := Primrec.fst.comp hx22
  have hqlists : Primrec (fun x : Input => x.2.2.2) := Primrec.snd.comp hx22
  have hleft : Primrec (fun x : Input => x.2.2.2.1) := Primrec.fst.comp hqlists
  have hright : Primrec (fun x : Input => x.2.2.2.2) := Primrec.snd.comp hqlists
  have horigin : Primrec (fun x : Input => x.2.1) := Primrec.fst.comp hx2
  have haxis : Primrec (fun x : Input => packedAxis x.2.2.1) := by
      refine (Primrec.cond hqvertical
        (Primrec.const (1 : Fin 2)) (Primrec.const (0 : Fin 2))).of_eq ?_
      intro x
      cases x.2.2.1 <;> rfl
  have hqueryInput : Primrec (fun x : Input =>
      (packedAxis x.2.2.1, (x.1, (x.2.1, (x.2.2.2.1, x.2.2.2.2))))) :=
    Primrec.pair haxis (Primrec.pair Primrec.fst (Primrec.pair horigin (Primrec.pair hleft hright)))
  exact (compileNormalizedComparison_primrec.comp hqueryInput).of_eq (fun _ => rfl)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.compilePackedComparison_computable
statement:
theorem compilePackedComparison_computable :
    Computable (fun x : List PointLabel × (ℕ × PackedComparison) =>
      compilePackedComparison x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)
proof:
:=
  compilePackedComparison_primrec.to_comp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.coordinate_normalizedVertices
statement:
theorem coordinate_normalizedVertices (corners : List Plane) (labels : List PointLabel)
    (origin i : ℕ) (axis : Fin 2) :
    coordinate axis ((normalizedVertices corners labels origin).getD i 0) =
      coordinate axis
          (corners.getD
            (selectedLabel axis (labels.getD i (labels.getD origin (0, 0)))) 0) -
        coordinate axis
          (corners.getD (selectedLabel axis (labels.getD origin (0, 0))) 0)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases axis <;> by_cases hi : i < labels.length <;>
    simp [normalizedVertices, selectedLabel, coordinate, hi]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.signedWeightSum_normalizedVertices
statement:
theorem signedWeightSum_normalizedVertices (corners : List Plane)
    (labels : List PointLabel) (origin : ℕ) (axis : Fin 2) (terms : List SignedTerm) :
    signedWeightSum (normalizedVertices corners labels origin) axis terms =
      signedWeightSum corners axis (transportSignedTerms axis labels origin terms)
proof:
:= by
  unfold signedWeightSum transportSignedTerms
  induction terms with
  | nil => simp [normalizedVertices]
  | cons term terms ih =>
      rcases term with ⟨i, c⟩
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.map_append, List.sum_append]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      rw [coordinate_normalizedVertices]
      rw [ih]
      simp [transportedTermPieces, indexedCornerLabel, originCornerLabel]
      ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.signedWeightSum_indexedCoefficients
statement:
theorem signedWeightSum_indexedCoefficients (V : List Plane) (axis : Fin 2)
    (coefficients : List ℤ) :
    signedWeightSum V axis (indexedCoefficients coefficients) =
      linearCoordinateSum V axis coefficients
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.sum_map_neg
statement:
private theorem sum_map_neg {α : Type*} (f : α → ℝ) (xs : List α) :
    (xs.map fun x => -f x).sum = -(xs.map f).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]; rw [ih]; ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.signedWeightSum_comparisonTerms
statement:
theorem signedWeightSum_comparisonTerms (V : List Plane) (axis : Fin 2)
    (lhs rhs : List ℤ) :
    signedWeightSum V axis
        (comparisonTerms lhs rhs) =
      linearCoordinateSum V axis lhs - linearCoordinateSum V axis rhs
proof:
:= by
  unfold signedWeightSum linearCoordinateSum comparisonTerms
  simp only [List.map_append, List.sum_append, List.map_map]
  let f : SignedTerm → ℝ := fun x => (x.2 : ℝ) * coordinate axis (V.getD x.1 0)
  let g : SignedTerm → SignedTerm := fun x => (x.1, -x.2)
  have hneg :
      ((indexedCoefficients rhs).map (f ∘ g)).sum =
        -((indexedCoefficients rhs).map f).sum := by
    calc
      _ = ((indexedCoefficients rhs).map fun x => -f x).sum := by
        congr 1
        apply List.map_congr_left
        intro x hx
        dsimp [f, g]
        simp [Int.cast_neg, neg_mul]
      _ = _ := sum_map_neg f _
  change ((indexedCoefficients lhs).map f).sum +
      ((indexedCoefficients rhs).map (f ∘ g)).sum = _
  rw [hneg]
  ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.compileNormalizedComparison_correct
statement:
theorem compileNormalizedComparison_correct {corners : List Plane}
    {answer : Query → Bool} (hanswer : CorrectOracle corners answer)
    (axis : Fin 2) (labels : List PointLabel) (origin : ℕ) (lhs rhs : List ℤ) :
    answer (compileNormalizedComparison axis labels origin lhs rhs) = true ↔
      linearCoordinateSum (normalizedVertices corners labels origin) axis lhs -
          linearCoordinateSum (normalizedVertices corners labels origin) axis rhs ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold compileNormalizedComparison
  rw [compileSignedComparison_correct hanswer]
  rw [← signedWeightSum_normalizedVertices]
  exact signedWeightSum_comparisonTerms
    (normalizedVertices corners labels origin) axis lhs rhs |>.symm ▸ Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.QueryTransport.compilePackedComparison_correct
statement:
theorem compilePackedComparison_correct {corners : List Plane}
    {answer : Query → Bool} (hanswer : CorrectOracle corners answer)
    (labels : List PointLabel) (origin : ℕ) (q : PackedComparison) :
    answer (compilePackedComparison labels origin q) = true ↔
      linearCoordinateSum (normalizedVertices corners labels origin) (packedAxis q.1) q.2.1 -
          linearCoordinateSum (normalizedVertices corners labels origin)
            (packedAxis q.1) q.2.2 ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact compileNormalizedComparison_correct hanswer (packedAxis q.1) labels origin
    q.2.1 q.2.2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.region_eq
statement:
theorem region_eq (R : Input) :
    region R = interior (⋃ r ∈ rectangles R, rectangle r.1 r.2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold region
  congr 1
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, rectangles, List.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, hz⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩, hz⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, hz⟩
    exact ⟨s, hs, hz⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.corners_real
statement:
theorem corners_real (R : Input) :
    cornerList (rectangles R) = (corners R).map realPoint
proof:
:= by
  induction R with
  | nil => simp [cornerList, rectangles, corners]
  | cons r R ih => simpa [cornerList, rectangles, corners] using ih

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.coord_real
statement:
theorem coord_real (axis : Fin 2) (p : Point) :
    coordinate axis (realPoint p) = (coord axis p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : axis = 0 <;> simp [coordinate, coord, realPoint, p₁, p₂, h]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.sum_real
statement:
theorem sum_real (R : Input) (axis : Fin 2) (indices : List ℕ) :
    coordinateSum (cornerList (rectangles R)) axis indices = (sum R axis indices : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateSum, corners_real]
  simp only [sum, Rat.cast_list_sum, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro i _
  have hget : ((corners R).map realPoint).getD i 0 =
      realPoint ((corners R).getD i (0, 0)) := by
    have hz : realPoint (0, 0) = (0 : Plane) := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [realPoint]
    rw [← hz, List.getD_map]
  rw [hget, coord_real]
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.answer_correct
statement: theorem answer_correct (R : Input) : CorrectOracle (cornerList (rectangles R)) (answer R)
proof:
:= by
  intro axis left right
  simp [answer, sum_real]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.valid_correct
statement: theorem valid_correct (R : Input) : valid R = true ↔ (region R).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [region_eq, RectangleInput.Validity.interior_rectangles_nonempty]
  have hf : valid R = true ↔ ∃ r ∈ R, r.1.1 < r.2.1 ∧ r.1.2 < r.2.2 := by
    induction R with
    | nil => simp [valid]
    | cons r R ih =>
        change ((decide (r.1.1 < r.2.1) && decide (r.1.2 < r.2.2)) || valid R) = true ↔ _
        simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, ih,
          List.mem_cons, exists_eq_or_imp]
  rw [hf]
  simp [rectangles, realPoint, p₁, p₂]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.corners_computable
statement: private theorem corners_computable : Computable corners
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Primrec₂ (fun _xs : Input => fun r : Point × Point => [r.1, r.2]) :=
    (Primrec.list_cons.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
      (Primrec.list_cons.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd) (Primrec.const []))).to₂
  exact (Primrec.list_flatMap Primrec.id hf).to_comp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.coord_computable
statement: private theorem coord_computable : Computable₂ coord
proof:
:= by
  exact (Primrec.ite (Primrec.eq.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.const (0 : Fin 2)))
    (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd) (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)).to_comp.to₂

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.queryList_computable
proof:
:= by
  exact Tiling.Computability.List.map_computable 0
    (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)
    (coord_computable.comp
      (Computable.fst.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst))
      ((Primrec.list_getD (0, 0)).to_comp.comp
        (corners_computable.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst)) Computable.snd)).to₂

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.sum_computable
statement:
private theorem sum_computable :
    Computable (fun x : Input × (Fin 2 × List ℕ) => sum x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Computable (fun xs : List ℚ => xs.sum) :=
    (Tiling.Computability.List.computable_list_foldr
      Tiling.Computability.Rational.rat_add_computable).comp Computable.id (Computable.const 0)
  exact hs.comp queryList_computable

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.answer_computable
statement: theorem answer_computable : Computable₂ answer
proof:
:= by
  exact (Tiling.Computability.Rational.rat_le_computable.comp
    (sum_computable.comp (Computable.fst.pair
      ((Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd).pair
        (Computable.fst.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)))))
    (sum_computable.comp (Computable.fst.pair
      ((Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd).pair
        (Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)))))).to₂

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.valid_computable
statement: theorem valid_computable : Computable valid
proof:
:= by
  have hproper : Computable (fun r : Point × Point =>
      decide (r.1.1 < r.2.1) && decide (r.1.2 < r.2.2)) :=
    (Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).to_comp.comp
      (Tiling.Computability.Rational.rat_lt_computable.comp
        (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst) (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd))
      (Tiling.Computability.Rational.rat_lt_computable.comp
        (Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst) (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd))
  exact (Tiling.Computability.List.computable_list_foldr
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.or).to_comp.comp
      (hproper.comp Computable.fst) Computable.snd).to₂).comp
    Computable.id (Computable.const false)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.bounded_computable
statement: theorem bounded_computable : Computable₂ bounded
proof:
:=
  OracleRun.run_from_empty_computable
    (uniformDecisionProgram_computable.comp
      (Computable.list_length.comp Computable.fst) Computable.snd) answer_computable

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.halts
statement: theorem halts : BoundedSearchHalts valid bounded
proof:
:= by
  intro R hR
  have hp : RectanglePresentation (rectangles R) (region R) :=
    ⟨(valid_correct R).mp hR, region_eq R⟩
  obtain ⟨fuel, b, hb⟩ := (uniformDecisionProgram_correct hp (answer_correct R)).1
  refine ⟨fuel, b, ?_⟩
  simpa [bounded, rectangles] using hb

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.decideTiling_computable
statement: theorem decideTiling_computable : Computable decideTiling
proof:
:=
  computable_totalSearch valid bounded valid_computable bounded_computable halts

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.not_tiles_empty
statement: theorem not_tiles_empty (T : Set Plane) : ¬ Tiles ∅ T
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc := h.2.2
  have he : (univ : Set Plane) =ᵐ[volume] (∅ : Set Plane) := by
    simpa only [CoversExactly, Set.vadd_empty] using hc
  have hz : volume (univ : Set Plane) = 0 := by
    simpa using MeasureTheory.measure_congr he
  simp at hz

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.decideTiling_correct
statement:
theorem decideTiling_correct (R : Input) :
    decideTiling R = true ↔ ∃ T, Tiles (region R) T
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hv : valid R = true
  · have hp : RectanglePresentation (rectangles R) (region R) :=
      ⟨(valid_correct R).mp hv, region_eq R⟩
    obtain ⟨fuel, hfuel⟩ := totalSearch_sound valid bounded halts R hv
    have hr : run (uniformDecisionProgram (rectangles R).length) (answer R) fuel [] =
        some (decideTiling R) := by
      simpa [bounded, rectangles, Option.mem_def, decideTiling] using hfuel
    exact (uniformDecisionProgram_correct hp (answer_correct R)).2 _ _ hr
  · have he : region R = ∅ :=
      Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp (mt (valid_correct R).mpr hv)
    simp [decideTiling, totalSearch, hv, he, not_tiles_empty]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RationalDecision.rational_tiling_computable
statement:
theorem rational_tiling_computable :
    ComputablePred (fun R : List ((ℚ × ℚ) × (ℚ × ℚ)) =>
      ∃ T, Tiles (interior (⋃ r ∈ R,
        rectangle ⟨r.1.1, r.1.2⟩ ⟨r.2.1, r.2.2⟩)) T)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ComputablePred (fun R : Input => decideTiling R = true) :=
    ((Primrec.eq.decide).to_comp.comp
      decideTiling_computable (Computable.const true)).computablePred
  exact hc.of_eq (fun R => by simpa [region, realPoint] using decideTiling_correct R)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Queries.intEncode_ofNat
statement: private theorem intEncode_ofNat (n : ℕ) : Encodable.encode (Int.ofNat n) = 2 * n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Encodable.encode_ofEquiv Equiv.intEquivNat]
  change Function.uncurry Nat.bit (Prod.mk false n) = 2 * n
  simp [Nat.bit]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Queries.intEncode_negSucc
statement: private theorem intEncode_negSucc (n : ℕ) : Encodable.encode (Int.negSucc n) = 2 * n + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Encodable.encode_ofEquiv Equiv.intEquivNat]
  change Function.uncurry Nat.bit (Prod.mk true n) = 2 * n + 1
  simp [Nat.bit]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Queries.intToNat_primrec
statement: private theorem intToNat_primrec : Primrec Int.toNat
proof:
:= by
  have heven : Primrec (fun z : ℤ => decide (Encodable.encode z % 2 = 0)) :=
    (Primrec.eq.comp (Primrec.nat_mod.comp Primrec.encode (Primrec.const 2))
      (Primrec.const 0)).decide
  refine (Primrec.cond heven
      (Primrec.nat_div.comp Primrec.encode (Primrec.const 2))
      (Primrec.const 0)).of_eq ?_
  intro z
  cases z with
  | ofNat n =>
      rw [intEncode_ofNat]
      simp
  | negSucc n =>
      rw [intEncode_negSucc]
      simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Queries.replicate_primrec
statement: private theorem replicate_primrec : Primrec₂ (fun n j : ℕ => List.replicate n j)
proof:
:= by
  have hrec : Primrec₂ (fun j n : ℕ =>
      Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => List ℕ) [] (fun _ xs => j :: xs) n) := by
    exact Primrec.nat_rec (Primrec.const ([] : List ℕ))
      (Primrec.list_cons.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂
  refine (hrec.comp Primrec.snd Primrec.fst).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  rcases x with ⟨n, j⟩
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp [List.replicate, ih]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Queries.intNegToNat_primrec
statement: private theorem intNegToNat_primrec : Primrec (fun z : ℤ => (-z).toNat)
proof:
:= by
  have hodd : Primrec (fun z : ℤ => decide (Encodable.encode z % 2 = 1)) :=
    (Primrec.eq.comp (Primrec.nat_mod.comp Primrec.encode (Primrec.const 2))
      (Primrec.const 1)).decide
  have hsucc : Primrec (fun z : ℤ => Encodable.encode z / 2 + 1) :=
    Primrec.nat_add.comp (Primrec.nat_div.comp Primrec.encode (Primrec.const 2))
      (Primrec.const 1)
  refine (Primrec.cond hodd hsucc (Primrec.const 0)).of_eq ?_
  intro z
  cases z with
  | ofNat n =>
      rw [intEncode_ofNat]
      simp
  | negSucc n =>
      rw [intEncode_negSucc]
      simp
      omega

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Queries.positiveCopies_primrec
statement: private theorem positiveCopies_primrec : Primrec positiveCopies
proof:
:= by
  have hflat : Primrec₂ (fun terms : List SignedTerm => fun t : SignedTerm =>
      List.replicate t.2.toNat t.1) := by
    exact (replicate_primrec.comp
      (intToNat_primrec.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂
  refine (Primrec.list_flatMap Primrec.id hflat).of_eq ?_
  intro terms
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Queries.negativeCopies_primrec
statement: private theorem negativeCopies_primrec : Primrec negativeCopies
proof:
:= by
  have hflat : Primrec₂ (fun terms : List SignedTerm => fun t : SignedTerm =>
      List.replicate (-t.2).toNat t.1) := by
    exact (replicate_primrec.comp
      (intNegToNat_primrec.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂
  refine (Primrec.list_flatMap Primrec.id hflat).of_eq ?_
  intro terms
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Queries.compileSignedComparison_primrec
statement:
theorem compileSignedComparison_primrec :
    Primrec (fun x : Fin 2 × List SignedTerm =>
      compileSignedComparison x.1 x.2)
proof:
:= by
  exact Primrec.pair Primrec.fst
    (Primrec.pair (positiveCopies_primrec.comp Primrec.snd)
      (negativeCopies_primrec.comp Primrec.snd))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Queries.compileSignedComparison_computable
statement:
theorem compileSignedComparison_computable :
    Computable (fun x : Fin 2 × List SignedTerm =>
      compileSignedComparison x.1 x.2)
proof:
:=
  compileSignedComparison_primrec.to_comp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Queries.coordinateSum_replicate
statement:
private theorem coordinateSum_replicate (V : List Plane) (axis : Fin 2)
    (n j : ℕ) :
    coordinateSum V axis (List.replicate n j) =
      (n : ℝ) * coordinate axis (V.getD j 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateSum, List.map_replicate, List.sum_replicate,
    nsmul_eq_mul]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Queries.coordinateSum_append
statement:
private theorem coordinateSum_append (V : List Plane) (axis : Fin 2)
    (xs ys : List ℕ) :
    coordinateSum V axis (xs ++ ys) =
      coordinateSum V axis xs + coordinateSum V axis ys
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateSum, List.map_append, List.sum_append]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Queries.coordinateSum_positiveCopies
statement:
private theorem coordinateSum_positiveCopies (V : List Plane) (axis : Fin 2)
    (terms : List SignedTerm) :
    coordinateSum V axis (positiveCopies terms) =
      (terms.map fun (j, c) => (c.toNat : ℝ) * coordinate axis (V.getD j 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction terms with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons term terms ih =>
      rcases term with ⟨j, c⟩
      change coordinateSum V axis (List.replicate c.toNat j ++ positiveCopies terms) =
        ((c.toNat : ℝ) * coordinate axis (V.getD j 0)) +
          (terms.map fun (j, c) => (c.toNat : ℝ) * coordinate axis (V.getD j 0)).sum
      rw [coordinateSum_append, coordinateSum_replicate, ih]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Queries.coordinateSum_negativeCopies
statement:
private theorem coordinateSum_negativeCopies (V : List Plane) (axis : Fin 2)
    (terms : List SignedTerm) :
    coordinateSum V axis (negativeCopies terms) =
      (terms.map fun (j, c) => ((-c).toNat : ℝ) * coordinate axis (V.getD j 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction terms with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons term terms ih =>
      rcases term with ⟨j, c⟩
      change coordinateSum V axis (List.replicate (-c).toNat j ++ negativeCopies terms) =
        (((-c).toNat : ℝ) * coordinate axis (V.getD j 0)) +
          (terms.map fun (j, c) => ((-c).toNat : ℝ) * coordinate axis (V.getD j 0)).sum
      rw [coordinateSum_append, coordinateSum_replicate, ih]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Queries.intToNat_sub_neg
statement:
private theorem intToNat_sub_neg (c : ℤ) :
    (c.toNat : ℝ) - ((-c).toNat : ℝ) = (c : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  cases c <;> simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Queries.signedComparison_semantics
statement:
theorem signedComparison_semantics (V : List Plane) (axis : Fin 2)
    (terms : List SignedTerm) :
    coordinateSum V axis (positiveCopies terms) -
        coordinateSum V axis (negativeCopies terms) =
      signedWeightSum V axis terms
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateSum_positiveCopies, coordinateSum_negativeCopies]
  induction terms with
  | nil => simp [signedWeightSum]
  | cons term terms ih =>
      rcases term with ⟨j, c⟩
      let x := coordinate axis (V.getD j 0)
      calc
        (c.toNat : ℝ) * x +
            (terms.map fun (j, c) => (c.toNat : ℝ) * coordinate axis (V.getD j 0)).sum -
          (((-c).toNat : ℝ) * x +
            (terms.map fun (j, c) => ((-c).toNat : ℝ) * coordinate axis (V.getD j 0)).sum) =
            ((c.toNat : ℝ) - ((-c).toNat : ℝ)) * x +
              ((terms.map fun (j, c) => (c.toNat : ℝ) * coordinate axis (V.getD j 0)).sum -
                (terms.map fun (j, c) =>
                  ((-c).toNat : ℝ) * coordinate axis (V.getD j 0)).sum) := by ring
        _ = (c : ℝ) * x + signedWeightSum V axis terms := by
          rw [intToNat_sub_neg, ih]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Queries.compileSignedComparison_correct
statement:
theorem compileSignedComparison_correct {V : List Plane} {answer : Query → Bool}
    (hanswer : CorrectOracle V answer) (axis : Fin 2) (terms : List SignedTerm) :
    answer (compileSignedComparison axis terms) = true ↔
      signedWeightSum V axis terms ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  change answer (axis, positiveCopies terms, negativeCopies terms) = true ↔ _
  rw [hanswer axis (positiveCopies terms) (negativeCopies terms)]
  rw [← signedComparison_semantics]
  exact (sub_nonpos : _ ↔ _).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.eq_of_support_eq
statement:
private theorem Region.eq_of_support_eq {K L : Region}
    (h : K.support = L.support) : K = L
proof:
:= by
  cases K with
  | mk K hK =>
    cases L with
    | mk L hL =>
      simp only [Region.mk.injEq]
      cases K with
      | mk Ks Kp Kn =>
        cases L with
        | mk Ls Lp Ln =>
          simpa only [Tiling.RationalPolygonal.PolygonalRegion.mk.injEq] using h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.ofRegularOpen
statement:
theorem Region.ofRegularOpen
    (Omega : Set Tiling.Plane)
    (hopen : IsOpen Omega)
    (hregular : interior (closure Omega) = Omega)
    (hbounded : Bornology.IsBounded Omega)
    (hpositive : 0 < (MeasureTheory.volume Omega).toReal)
    (hpolygonal : Tiling.IsPolygonal (closure Omega))
    (haxisParallel : Tiling.IsAxisParallel (closure Omega)) :
    ∃! K : Region, K.openCarrier = Omega
proof:
:= by
  have _hcontext : IsOpen Omega ∧ Bornology.IsBounded Omega := ⟨hopen, hbounded⟩
  have hmeasure : MeasureTheory.volume Omega ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero] at hpositive
    simp at hpositive
  have hnonempty : (closure Omega).Nonempty :=
    (MeasureTheory.nonempty_of_measure_ne_zero hmeasure).mono subset_closure
  let K : Region := {
    support := closure Omega
    isPolygonal := hpolygonal
    nonempty := hnonempty
    isAxisParallel := haxisParallel }
  refine ⟨K, hregular, ?_⟩
  intro L hL
  apply Region.eq_of_support_eq
  calc
    L.support = closure (interior L.support) := L.isPolygonal.closure_interior.symm
    _ = closure L.openCarrier := rfl
    _ = closure Omega := congrArg closure hL
    _ = K.support := rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier_regularOpen
statement:
theorem Region.openCarrier_regularOpen (K : Region) :
    IsOpen K.openCarrier ∧ interior (closure K.openCarrier) = K.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isOpen_interior, ?_⟩
  change interior (closure (interior K.support)) = interior K.support
  rw [K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.horizontalProjectionClosure_finiteClosedIntervals
statement:
theorem horizontalProjectionClosure_finiteClosedIntervals :
    ∀ K : Region, ∃ (n : Nat) (left right : Fin n → ℝ),
      (∀ i, left i < right i) ∧
        closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier) =
          ⋃ i, Set.Icc (left i) (right i)
proof:
:= by
  intro K
  classical
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := K.isAxisParallel
  let E := {s : Set Tiling.Plane // s ∈ R.pieces}
  let _ : Fintype E := Fintype.ofFinite E
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card E) ≃ E := Fintype.equivFin E |>.symm
  let piece : Fin (Fintype.card E) → Set Tiling.Plane := fun i ↦ (e i).1
  have hpiece (i : Fin (Fintype.card E)) : piece i ∈ R.pieces := (e i).2
  choose p q hre him hpq using fun i ↦ R.isRectangle (piece i) (hpiece i)
  let a : Fin (Fintype.card E) → ℝ := fun i ↦ min (p i).re (q i).re
  let b : Fin (Fintype.card E) → ℝ := fun i ↦ max (p i).re (q i).re
  have himagePiece (i : Fin (Fintype.card E)) :
      Complex.re '' piece i = Icc (a i) (b i) := by
    rw [hpq i]
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      change z ∈ Complex.reProdIm
        (Set.uIcc (p i).re (q i).re) (Set.uIcc (p i).im (q i).im) at hz
      have hzre : z.re ∈ Set.uIcc (p i).re (q i).re := hz.1
      simpa only [a, b, Set.uIcc] using hzre
    · intro hx
      let z : ℂ := Complex.mk x (p i).im
      refine ⟨z, ?_, by simp [z]⟩
      change z ∈ Complex.reProdIm
        (Set.uIcc (p i).re (q i).re) (Set.uIcc (p i).im (q i).im)
      constructor
      · change z.re ∈ Set.uIcc (p i).re (q i).re
        simpa only [z, a, b, Set.uIcc] using hx
      · change z.im ∈ Set.uIcc (p i).im (q i).im
        change (p i).im ∈ Set.uIcc (p i).im (q i).im
        exact left_mem_uIcc
  have hprojectionSupport : Complex.re '' K.support =
      ⋃ i, Complex.re '' piece i := by
    rw [← R.sUnion_eq]
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨s, hsR, hzs⟩ := Set.mem_sUnion.mp hz
      let es : E := ⟨s, hsR⟩
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨Fintype.equivFin E es, by
        refine ⟨z, ?_, rfl⟩
        simpa [piece, e, es] using hzs⟩
    · rintro hx
      obtain ⟨i, z, hzi, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      refine ⟨z, Set.mem_sUnion.2 ⟨piece i, hpiece i, hzi⟩, rfl⟩
  have hprojectionClosure : closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier) =
      Complex.re '' K.support := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · apply closure_minimal
      · exact Set.image_mono interior_subset
      · exact (K.isPolygonal.isCompact.image Complex.continuous_re).isClosed
    · rw [← K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]
      exact image_closure_subset_closure_image Complex.continuous_re
  have hclosedIntervals : closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier) =
      ⋃ i, Icc (a i) (b i) := by
    rw [hprojectionClosure, hprojectionSupport]
    apply iUnion_congr
    exact himagePiece
  refine ⟨Fintype.card E, a, b, ?_, hclosedIntervals⟩
  intro i
  simpa [a, b] using lt_or_gt_of_ne (hre i).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.frontier_openCarrier_eq_frontier_support
statement:
theorem Region.frontier_openCarrier_eq_frontier_support (K : Region) :
    frontier K.openCarrier = frontier K.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [frontier, frontier]
  change closure (interior K.support) \ interior (interior K.support) =
    closure K.support \ interior K.support
  rw [K.isPolygonal.closure_interior, interior_interior,
    K.isPolygonal.isClosed.closure_eq]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier_aeEq_support
statement:
theorem Region.openCarrier_aeEq_support (K : Region) :
    K.openCarrier =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] K.support
proof:
:=
  K.toPolygonalRegion.openCarrier_ae_eq

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.polygonalProtoTiling_placedVertices
statement:
theorem Region.polygonalProtoTiling_placedVertices
    (K : Region) (T : Set Tiling.Plane)

:=

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.volume_frontier
statement:
theorem Region.volume_frontier (K : Region) :

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport_isRegularOpen
statement:
theorem regularSupport_isRegularOpen (K : Region) (S : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    IsOpen (regularSupport K S) ∧
      interior (closure (regularSupport K S)) = regularSupport K S
proof:
:= by

  simp [regularSupport, Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport_eq_of_openUnion_eq_on_ball
statement:
theorem regularSupport_eq_of_openUnion_eq_on_ball
    {U V : Set Tiling.Plane} {a : Tiling.Plane} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hUV : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball a R, z ∈ U ↔ z ∈ V) :
    ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball a (R / 4),
      z ∈ interior (closure U) ↔ z ∈ interior (closure V)
proof:
:= by
  have hcl : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball a (R / 2), z ∈ closure U ↔ z ∈ closure V := by
    intro z hz
    constructor
    · intro hzU
      apply mem_closure_iff.2
      intro O hO hzO
      let W := O ∩ Metric.ball a R
      have hWopen : IsOpen W := hO.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hzW : z ∈ W := by
        constructor
        · exact hzO
        · rw [Metric.mem_ball]
          have hza : dist a z < R / 2 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hz
          rw [dist_comm]
          linarith
      obtain ⟨w, hwW, hwU⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hzU W hWopen hzW
      exact ⟨w, ⟨hwW.1, (hUV w hwW.2).mp hwU⟩⟩
    · intro hzV
      apply mem_closure_iff.2
      intro O hO hzO
      let W := O ∩ Metric.ball a R
      have hWopen : IsOpen W := hO.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hzW : z ∈ W := by
        constructor
        · exact hzO
        · rw [Metric.mem_ball]
          have hza : dist a z < R / 2 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hz
          rw [dist_comm]
          linarith
      obtain ⟨w, hwW, hwV⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hzV W hWopen hzW
      exact ⟨w, ⟨hwW.1, (hUV w hwW.2).mpr hwV⟩⟩
  intro z hz
  constructor
  · intro hzU
    apply (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds).2
    apply Metric.mem_nhds_iff.2
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
      ((mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds).1 hzU)
    let ε' := min ε (R / 2 - dist a z)
    have hε' : 0 < ε' := by
      dsimp [ε']
      have hza : dist a z < R / 4 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hz
      exact lt_min hε (by linarith)
    refine ⟨ε', hε', ?_⟩
    intro w hw
    have hwcl : w ∈ closure U := hεsub
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hw)
    apply (hcl w ?_).mp hwcl
    rw [Metric.mem_ball]
    have hza : dist a z < R / 4 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hz
    have hwz : dist z w < ε' := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hw
    calc
      dist w a = dist a w := dist_comm _ _
      _ ≤ dist a z + dist z w := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ < dist a z + (R / 2 - dist a z) :=
        add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt (le_rfl)
          (lt_of_lt_of_le hwz (min_le_right _ _))
      _ = R / 2 := by ring
  · intro hzV
    apply (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds).2
    apply Metric.mem_nhds_iff.2
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
      ((mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds).1 hzV)
    let ε' := min ε (R / 2 - dist a z)
    have hε' : 0 < ε' := by
      dsimp [ε']
      have hza : dist a z < R / 4 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hz
      exact lt_min hε (by linarith)
    refine ⟨ε', hε', ?_⟩
    intro w hw
    have hwcl : w ∈ closure V := hεsub
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hw)
    apply (hcl w ?_).mpr hwcl
    rw [Metric.mem_ball]
    have hza : dist a z < R / 4 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hz
    have hwz : dist z w < ε' := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hw
    calc
      dist w a = dist a w := dist_comm _ _
      _ ≤ dist a z + dist z w := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ < dist a z + (R / 2 - dist a z) :=
        add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt (le_rfl)
          (lt_of_lt_of_le hwz (min_le_right _ _))
      _ = R / 2 := by ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport_local_eq_of_openUnion_eq_on_ball
statement:
theorem regularSupport_local_eq_of_openUnion_eq_on_ball
    {U V : Set Tiling.Plane} {a : Tiling.Plane} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hUV : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball a R, z ∈ U ↔ z ∈ V) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball a r,
      z ∈ interior (closure U) ↔ z ∈ interior (closure V)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨R / 4, by positivity, regularSupport_eq_of_openUnion_eq_on_ball hR hUV⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint
statement:
theorem isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint (K : Region) (S : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S) ↔
      Set.Pairwise S
        (Disjoint on ((· +ᵥ K.openCarrier) : Tiling.Plane → Set Tiling.Plane))
proof:
:= by
  let P := K.polygonalProtoTiling S
  constructor
  · intro hpacking s hs t ht hst
    let i : P.placements := ⟨(s, ()), hs⟩
    let j : P.placements := ⟨(t, ()), ht⟩
    have hij : i ≠ j := by
      intro hij
      exact hst (congrArg (fun q : P.placements ↦ q.1.1) hij)
    have hd := P.interior_placedTile_disjoint hpacking hij
    change Disjoint (interior (s +ᵥ K.support))
      (interior (t +ᵥ K.support)) at hd
    change Disjoint (s +ᵥ interior K.support) (t +ᵥ interior K.support)
    simpa only [interior_vadd] using hd
  · intro hdisjoint i hi j hj hij
    have hcent : i.1 ≠ j.1 := by
      intro hcent
      apply hij
      cases i
      cases j
      simp_all
    have hopenDisjoint := hdisjoint hi hj hcent
    let P := K.polygonalProtoTiling S
    have hinterior : Disjoint
        (interior (Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i))
        (interior (Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles j)) := by
      change Disjoint (i.1 +ᵥ interior K.support)
        (j.1 +ᵥ interior K.support) at hopenDisjoint
      change Disjoint (interior (i.1 +ᵥ K.support))
        (interior (j.1 +ᵥ K.support))
      simpa only [interior_vadd] using hopenDisjoint
    have hsubset :
        Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i ∩ Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles j ⊆
          frontier (Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i) ∪
            frontier (Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles j) := by
      rintro x ⟨hxi, hxj⟩
      by_cases hxi' : x ∈ interior (Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i)
      · right
        apply (mem_frontier_iff_notMem_interior hxj).2
        intro hxj'
        exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hinterior hxi' hxj'
      · left
        exact (mem_frontier_iff_notMem_interior hxi).2 hxi'
    apply measure_mono_null hsubset
    rw [measure_union_null]
    · exact (P.isPolygonal_placedTile i).volume_frontier
    · exact (P.isPolygonal_placedTile j).volume_frontier

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.exists_packingSeparation
statement:
theorem exists_packingSeparation (K : Region) :
    ∃ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta ∧
      ∀ S : Set Tiling.Plane,
        Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
            (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S) →
        ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ t ∈ S, s ≠ t → delta ≤ dist s t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := K.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty K.nonempty
  change c ∈ K.openCarrier at hc
  have hnhds : K.openCarrier ∈ 𝓝 c :=
    (Region.openCarrier_regularOpen K).1.mem_nhds hc
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnhds
  refine ⟨r + r, add_pos hr hr, ?_⟩
  intro S hpacking s hs t ht hst
  have hdisjoint :=
    (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K S).mp hpacking hs ht hst
  have ball_subset (a : Tiling.Plane) :
      Metric.ball (a + c) r ⊆ a +ᵥ K.openCarrier := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    apply hball
    simpa [dist_eq_norm_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc]
      using hz
  have hballs : Disjoint (Metric.ball (s + c) r) (Metric.ball (t + c) r) :=
    hdisjoint.mono (ball_subset s) (ball_subset t)
  have hdist := (disjoint_ball_ball_iff hr hr).mp hballs
  rw [show dist (s + c) (t + c) = dist s t by
    simp only [dist_eq_norm]
    congr 1
    abel] at hdist
  exact hdist

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.finite_inter_of_bounded_of_pairwise_le_dist
statement:
private theorem finite_inter_of_bounded_of_pairwise_le_dist
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E]
    {S Q : Set E} {delta : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hS : S.Pairwise fun x y ↦ delta ≤ dist x y)
    (hQ : Bornology.IsBounded Q) : (S ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hSclosed : IsClosed S := Metric.isClosed_of_pairwise_le_dist hdelta hS
  have hSdiscrete : IsDiscrete S := by
    rw [isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isOpen]
    intro s hs
    refine ⟨Metric.ball s delta, Metric.isOpen_ball, ?_⟩
    ext t
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨htball, htS⟩
      by_cases hts : t = s
      · simp [hts]
      · have hsep := hS htS hs hts
        simp only [Metric.mem_ball] at htball
        exfalso
        linarith
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hdelta, hs⟩
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hQ.subset_closedBall (0 : E)
  have hcompact : IsCompact (S ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 R) :=
    Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
      (hSclosed.inter Metric.isClosed_closedBall)
      (Metric.isBounded_closedBall.subset inter_subset_right)
  apply (hcompact.finite (hSdiscrete.mono inter_subset_left)).subset
  exact inter_subset_inter_right S hR

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.IsPacking.locallyFinite_centres
statement:
theorem IsPacking.locallyFinite_centres
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S)) :
    (∀ Q : Set Tiling.Plane, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (S ∩ Q).Finite) ∧
      S.Countable
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨delta, hdelta, hsep⟩ := exists_packingSeparation K
  have hpairwise : S.Pairwise fun x y ↦ delta ≤ dist x y :=
    hsep S hpacking
  have hfinite : ∀ Q : Set Tiling.Plane, Bornology.IsBounded Q →
      (S ∩ Q).Finite := fun Q hQ ↦
    finite_inter_of_bounded_of_pairwise_le_dist hdelta hpairwise hQ
  refine ⟨hfinite, ?_⟩
  have hcover : S ⊆ ⋃ n : ℕ, S ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 n := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨n : ℕ, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt ‖x‖
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
    refine ⟨n, hx, ?_⟩
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hn.le
  exact (Set.countable_iUnion fun n : ℕ ↦
    (hfinite (Metric.closedBall 0 (n : ℝ))
      Metric.isBounded_closedBall).countable).mono hcover

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.tilesOn_iff_multiplicity
statement:
theorem tilesOn_iff_multiplicity (K : Region) (S D : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    TilesOn K S D ↔
      S.Countable ∧
      Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S) ∧
      ∀ᵐ x ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
        (x ∈ D ↔ ∃ s : S, x ∈ (s.1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier))
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.tilesOn_univ_iff_tiles
statement:
theorem tilesOn_univ_iff_tiles (K : Region) (S : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    TilesOn K S Set.univ ↔ K.toPolygonalRegion.Tiles S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine {
      countable := K.toPolygonalRegion.placements_countable h.1
      isPacking := h.2.1
      isCover := ?_ }
    filter_upwards [h.2.2] with x hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hx.mp (Set.mem_univ x)
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
    refine ⟨⟨(s.1, ()), s.2⟩, ?_⟩
    change x ∈ s.1 +ᵥ K.support
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hs ⊢
    exact interior_subset hs
  · intro h
    let P := K.polygonalProtoTiling S
    let _ : Countable P.placements :=
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements_countable h.countable).to_subtype
    have hEq :
        (⋃ i : P.placements, interior (Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i.1))
          =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume]
        (⋃ i : P.placements, Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i.1) :=
      Filter.EventuallyEq.countable_iUnion fun i ↦
        (P.isPolygonal_placedTile i.1).interior_ae_eq
    refine ⟨h.countable, h.isPacking, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [h.isCover, hEq] with x hx hxeq
    constructor
    · intro _
      have hxopen : x ∈ ⋃ i : P.placements,
          interior (Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i.1) := hxeq.mpr hx
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxopen
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hxopen
      refine ⟨⟨i.1.1, i.2⟩, ?_⟩
      change x ∈ interior (i.1.1 +ᵥ K.support) at hi
      rw [interior_vadd] at hi
      exact hi
    · intro _
      exact Set.mem_univ x

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.regularOpen_eq_of_aeEq
statement:
theorem regularOpen_eq_of_aeEq
    {U V : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hUregular : interior (closure U) = U)
    (hV : IsOpen V) (hVregular : interior (closure V) = V)
    (hUV : U =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] V) : U = V
proof:
:= by
  have closure_mono_of_ae {A B : Set Tiling.Plane}
      (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B)
      (hAB : A =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] B) : A ⊆ closure B := by
    intro x hxA
    by_contra hxB
    let W := A ∩ (closure B)ᶜ
    have hWopen : IsOpen W := hA.inter isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl
    have hxW : x ∈ W := ⟨hxA, hxB⟩
    have hWzero : MeasureTheory.volume W = 0 :=
      measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr (hAB.mono fun y hy hyW ↦ by
        have hyB : y ∈ B := Eq.mp hy hyW.1
        exact hyW.2 (subset_closure hyB))
    exact hWopen.measure_ne_zero MeasureTheory.volume ⟨x, hxW⟩ hWzero
  have hclosure : closure U = closure V := Set.Subset.antisymm
    (closure_minimal (closure_mono_of_ae hU hV hUV) isClosed_closure)
    (closure_minimal (closure_mono_of_ae hV hU hUV.symm) isClosed_closure)
  calc
    U = interior (closure U) := hUregular.symm
    _ = interior (closure V) := congrArg interior hclosure
    _ = V := hVregular

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.closure_openUnion_eq_iUnion_support
statement:
theorem closure_openUnion_eq_iUnion_support
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S)) :
    closure (openUnion K S) =
      ⋃ s : S, (s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support
proof:
:= by
  let P := K.polygonalProtoTiling S
  let toPlacement : S → P.placements := fun s => ⟨(s, ()), s.2⟩
  have htoPlacement : Function.Injective toPlacement := by
    intro s t hst
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun i : P.placements ↦ i.1.1) hst)
  have hloc : LocallyFinite (fun s : S ↦ (s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support) := by
    exact (P.locallyFinite_placedTile hpacking).comp_injective htoPlacement
  have hopen : LocallyFinite (fun s : S ↦ (s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) :=
    hloc.subset fun s => vadd_set_mono interior_subset
  rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier, hopen.closure_iUnion]
  apply iUnion_congr
  intro s
  rw [closure_vadd]
  rw [show closure K.openCarrier = K.support from K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.locallyFinite_iUnion_localBoundaryCross
statement:
private theorem locallyFinite_iUnion_localBoundaryCross
    {I : Type*} {F : I → Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hfinite : LocallyFinite F) (hclosed : ∀ i, IsClosed (F i))
    (hcross : ∀ i x, ∃ r > 0, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x r, z ∈ frontier (F i) →
      z.re = x.re ∨ z.im = x.im)
    (x : Tiling.Plane) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x r, z ∈ frontier (⋃ i, F i) →
      z.re = x.re ∨ z.im = x.im
proof:
:= by
  let J : Set I := {i | x ∈ F i}
  have hJfinite : J.Finite := hfinite.point_finite x
  have hincident : ∀ᶠ z in nhds x, ∀ i, z ∈ F i → i ∈ J :=
    hfinite.eventually_subset hclosed x
  have hcrossEventually (i : I) (hi : i ∈ J) :
      ∀ᶠ z in nhds x, z ∈ frontier (F i) →
        z.re = x.re ∨ z.im = x.im := by
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := hcross i x
    exact Filter.mem_of_superset (Metric.ball_mem_nhds x hr) hball
  have hallCross : ∀ᶠ z in nhds x, ∀ i ∈ J, z ∈ frontier (F i) →
      z.re = x.re ∨ z.im = x.im := by
    exact hJfinite.eventually_all.mpr fun i hi ↦ hcrossEventually i hi
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ z in nhds x, ∀ i, z ∈ F i →
      z ∈ frontier (⋃ i, F i) → z.re = x.re ∨ z.im = x.im := by
    filter_upwards [hincident, hallCross] with z hzIncident hzCross i hzi hzfront
    have hzNotInterior : z ∉ interior (F i) := by
      intro hzint
      exact Set.disjoint_left.1 disjoint_interior_frontier
        (interior_mono (subset_iUnion F i) hzint) hzfront
    have hzFiFrontier : z ∈ frontier (F i) := by
      rw [(hclosed i).frontier_eq]
      exact ⟨hzi, hzNotInterior⟩
    exact hzCross i (hzIncident i hzi) hzFiFrontier
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hevent
  refine ⟨r, hr, fun z hzBall hzFrontier ↦ ?_⟩
  have hzUnion : z ∈ ⋃ i, F i :=
    (hfinite.isClosed_iUnion hclosed).frontier_subset hzFrontier
  obtain ⟨i, hzi⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hzUnion
  exact hball hzBall i hzi hzFrontier

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport
statement:
theorem openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S)) :
    openUnion K S =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] regularSupport K S
proof:
:= by
  let P := K.polygonalProtoTiling S
  let C : Set Tiling.Plane :=
    ⋃ i : P.placements, Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i.1
  have hU : openUnion K S =
      ⋃ i : P.placements, interior (Tiling.placedTile P.prototiles i.1) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, Set.mem_iUnion]
      rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      refine ⟨⟨(s.1, ()), s.2⟩, ?_⟩
      change x ∈ interior (s.1 +ᵥ K.support)
      rw [interior_vadd]
      exact hs
    · rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, Set.mem_iUnion]
      refine ⟨⟨i.1.1, i.2⟩, ?_⟩
      change x ∈ interior (i.1.1 +ᵥ K.support) at hi
      rw [interior_vadd] at hi
      exact hi
  have hC : C = ⋃ s : S, (s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨⟨i.1.1, i.2⟩, hi⟩
    · rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨⟨(s.1, ()), s.2⟩, hs⟩
  have hclosure : closure (openUnion K S) = C := by
    exact (closure_openUnion_eq_iUnion_support hpacking).trans hC.symm
  have hUC : openUnion K S ⊆ C := by
    rw [hU]
    exact iUnion_mono fun i ↦ interior_subset
  have hSCountable := (IsPacking.locallyFinite_centres hpacking).2
  let _ : Countable P.placements :=
    (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements_countable hSCountable).to_subtype
  have hAE : openUnion K S =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] C := by
    rw [hU]
    exact Filter.EventuallyEq.countable_iUnion fun i ↦
      (P.isPolygonal_placedTile i.1).interior_ae_eq
  have hUInterior : openUnion K S ⊆ interior C := by
    have hUOpen : IsOpen (openUnion K S) := by
      rw [hU]
      exact isOpen_iUnion fun _ ↦ isOpen_interior
    rw [← hUOpen.interior_eq]
    exact interior_mono hUC
  rw [regularSupport, Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport, ← openUnion, hclosure]
  filter_upwards [hAE] with x hx
  apply propext
  constructor
  · intro hxU
    exact hUInterior hxU
  · intro hxint
    rw [hx]
    exact (interior_subset : interior C ⊆ C) hxint

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn.congr_ae
statement:
theorem TilesOn.congr_ae
    {K : Region} {S D E : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K S D) (hDE : D =ᵐ[volume] E) :
    TilesOn K S E
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hTile.1, hTile.2.1, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hTile.2.2, hDE] with x hx hDE
  exact (iff_of_eq hDE).symm.trans hx

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport_eq_regularization_of_tilesOn
statement:
theorem regularSupport_eq_regularization_of_tilesOn
    {K : Region} {S D : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hDopen : IsOpen D) (hTile : TilesOn K S D) :
    regularSupport K S = interior (closure D)
proof:
:= by
  have hUD : openUnion K S =ᵐ[volume] D := by
    filter_upwards [hTile.2.2] with x hx
    apply propext
    change (x ∈ openUnion K S) ↔ x ∈ D
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact hx.symm
  have hUopen : IsOpen (openUnion K S) :=
    isOpen_iUnion fun s ↦ (Region.openCarrier_regularOpen K).1.vadd (s : Tiling.Plane)
  have subset_closure_of_ae {A B : Set Tiling.Plane}
      (hA : IsOpen A) (hAB : A =ᵐ[volume] B) : A ⊆ closure B := by
    intro x hxA
    by_contra hxB
    let W := A ∩ (closure B)ᶜ
    have hWopen : IsOpen W := hA.inter isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl
    have hxW : x ∈ W := ⟨hxA, hxB⟩
    have hWzero : volume W = 0 :=
      measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr (hAB.mono fun y hy hyW ↦ by
        have hyB : y ∈ B := Eq.mp hy hyW.1
        exact hyW.2 (subset_closure hyB))
    exact hWopen.measure_ne_zero volume ⟨x, hxW⟩ hWzero
  have hclosure : closure (openUnion K S) = closure D := Set.Subset.antisymm
    (closure_minimal (subset_closure_of_ae hUopen hUD) isClosed_closure)
    (closure_minimal (subset_closure_of_ae hDopen hUD.symm) isClosed_closure)
  exact congrArg interior hclosure

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn
statement:
theorem regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn
    {K : Region} {S D : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hDopen : IsOpen D) (hDregular : interior (closure D) = D)
    (hTile : TilesOn K S D) :
    regularSupport K S = D
proof:
:= by
  exact (regularSupport_eq_regularization_of_tilesOn hDopen hTile).trans hDregular

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem regularSupport_pairwiseDisjoint
    {I : Type*} [Countable I]
    {K : Region} {S D : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (A : I → Set Tiling.Plane)
    (hparts : Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ A)
    (hunion : (⋃ i, A i) = S)
    (hTile : TilesOn K S D) :
    Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ (regularSupport K ∘ A) ∧
      (⋃ i, regularSupport K (A i)) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] D
proof:
:= by
  have hAS (i : I) : A i ⊆ S := by
    rw [← hunion]
    exact subset_iUnion A i
  have hpacking (i : I) :
      Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements (A i)) := by
    intro p hp q hq hpq
    exact hTile.2.1 (hAS i hp) (hAS i hq) hpq
  have hopenDisjoint {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) :
      Disjoint (openUnion K (A i)) (openUnion K (A j)) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxi hxj
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion] at hxi hxj
    obtain ⟨s, hsx⟩ := hxi
    obtain ⟨t, htx⟩ := hxj
    have hst : (s : Tiling.Plane) ≠ t := by
      intro hst
      have hdisjoint := hparts (Set.mem_univ i) (Set.mem_univ j) hij
      exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisjoint s.2 (hst ▸ t.2)
    have hdisjoint :=
      (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K S).mp hTile.2.1
        (hAS i s.2) (hAS j t.2) hst
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisjoint hsx htx
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i _ j _ hij
    change Disjoint (regularSupport K (A i)) (regularSupport K (A j))
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxi hxj
    have hzero : MeasureTheory.volume
        (regularSupport K (A i) ∩ regularSupport K (A j)) = 0 := by
      apply measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
      filter_upwards
        [openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport (hpacking i),
          openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport (hpacking j)] with y hyi hyj
      intro hy
      have hyi' : y ∈ openUnion K (A i) := by
        change openUnion K (A i) y
        rw [hyi]
        exact hy.1
      have hyj' : y ∈ openUnion K (A j) := by
        change openUnion K (A j) y
        rw [hyj]
        exact hy.2
      exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (hopenDisjoint hij) hyi' hyj'
    exact ((regularSupport_isRegularOpen K (A i)).1.inter
      (regularSupport_isRegularOpen K (A j)).1).measure_ne_zero
        MeasureTheory.volume ⟨x, hxi, hxj⟩ hzero
  · have hraw : (⋃ i, openUnion K (A i)) = openUnion K S := by
      ext x
      simp only [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, Set.mem_iUnion]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i, s, hs⟩
        exact ⟨⟨s, hAS i s.2⟩, hs⟩
      · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
        have hsUnion : (s : Tiling.Plane) ∈ ⋃ i, A i := by
          rw [hunion]
          exact s.2
        rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hsUnion
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hsUnion
        exact ⟨i, ⟨⟨s, hi⟩, hs⟩⟩
    have hpieces :
        (⋃ i, openUnion K (A i)) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume]
          ⋃ i, regularSupport K (A i) :=
      Filter.EventuallyEq.countable_iUnion fun i ↦
        openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport (hpacking i)
    have htarget : openUnion K S =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] D := by
      filter_upwards [hTile.2.2] with x hx
      change (x ∈ openUnion K S) = (x ∈ D)
      apply propext
      rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact hx.symm
    exact hpieces.symm.trans ((Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq hraw).trans htarget)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.frontier_eventuallyEq_of_eventuallyEq
statement:
theorem frontier_eventuallyEq_of_eventuallyEq
    {D E : Set Tiling.Plane} {x : Tiling.Plane}
    (hDE : D =ᶠ[𝓝 x] E) :
    frontier D =ᶠ[𝓝 x] frontier E
proof:
:= by
  have hnhds : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, D =ᶠ[𝓝 y] E := hDE.eventually_nhds
  filter_upwards [hnhds] with y hy
  apply propext
  have closureIff (A B : Set Tiling.Plane)
      (hAB : A =ᶠ[nhds y] B) :
      y ∈ closure A ↔ y ∈ closure B := by
    rw [mem_closure_iff_frequently, mem_closure_iff_frequently]
    constructor
    · intro hA
      exact (hA.and_eventually hAB).mono fun z hz ↦ Eq.mp hz.2 hz.1
    · intro hB
      exact (hB.and_eventually hAB).mono fun z hz ↦ Eq.mpr hz.2 hz.1
  have hyCompl : Dᶜ =ᶠ[nhds y] Eᶜ :=
    hy.mono fun z hz ↦ congrArg Not hz
  change y ∈ frontier D ↔ y ∈ frontier E
  rw [frontier_eq_closure_inter_closure,
    frontier_eq_closure_inter_closure, mem_inter_iff, mem_inter_iff,
    closureIff D E hy, closureIff Dᶜ Eᶜ hyCompl]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.isProperVertex_iff_of_eventuallyEq
statement:
theorem isProperVertex_iff_of_eventuallyEq
    {D E : Set Tiling.Plane} {x : Tiling.Plane}
    (hDE : D =ᶠ[nhds x] E) :
    IsProperVertex D x ↔ IsProperVertex E x
proof:
:= by
  have hfront := frontier_eventuallyEq_of_eventuallyEq hDE
  have hfrontx : x ∈ frontier D ↔ x ∈ frontier E :=
    Iff.of_eq hfront.self_of_nhds
  have hstraight :
      Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt D x ↔
        Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt E x := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨L, hxL, hdim, hline⟩
      refine ⟨L, hxL, hdim, ?_⟩
      filter_upwards [hfront, hline] with y hyfront hyline
      exact (Iff.of_eq hyfront).symm.trans hyline
    · rintro ⟨L, hxL, hdim, hline⟩
      refine ⟨L, hxL, hdim, ?_⟩
      filter_upwards [hfront, hline] with y hyfront hyline
      exact (Iff.of_eq hyfront).trans hyline
  exact and_congr hfrontx (not_congr hstraight)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.properVertexProvenance
statement:
theorem properVertexProvenance :
    ∀ {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane},
      Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S) →
      ∀ x ∈ properVertices (regularSupport K S),
        ∃ v ∈ K.vertices, ∃ s ∈ S, x = v + s
proof:
:= by
  intro K S hpacking x hx
  let A := K.polygonalProtoTiling S
  have hpack : Tiling.IsPacking A.prototiles A.placements := by
    intro i hi j hj hij
    apply hpacking
    · exact hi
    · exact hj
    · exact hij
  have hcarrier : A.placementCarrier Set.univ =
      closure (openUnion K S) := by
    rw [Tiling.PolygonalProtoTiling.placementCarrier]
    rw [closure_openUnion_eq_iUnion_support hpack]
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hz
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hz
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨⟨i.1.1.1, i.1.2⟩, hi⟩
    · intro hz
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hz
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hz
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      let i : A.placements := ⟨((s : Tiling.Plane), ()), s.2⟩
      refine ⟨⟨i, trivial⟩, ?_⟩
      exact hs
  have hfrontier_eq :
      frontier (A.placementCarrier Set.univ) =
        frontier (regularSupport K S) := by
    rw [regularSupport, Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport, ← openUnion, ← hcarrier]
    simp [frontier, A.placementCarrier_closure_interior hpack Set.univ,
      (A.placementCarrier_isClosed hpack Set.univ).closure_eq]
  have hxfrontier : x ∈ frontier (A.placementCarrier Set.univ) := by
    rw [hfrontier_eq]
    exact hx.1
  have hxnotstraight : ¬Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt
      (A.placementCarrier Set.univ) x := by
    intro hstraight
    apply hx.2
    simpa only [Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt, hfrontier_eq] using hstraight
  obtain ⟨i, hiQ, hxi⟩ :=
    A.exists_vertex_of_not_boundaryLocallyStraightAt hpack Set.univ
      hxfrontier hxnotstraight
  have hcenterS : i.1.1 ∈ S := i.2
  have hplaced : x ∈ i.1.1 +ᵥ K.vertices := by
    simpa only [A, Region.polygonalProtoTiling_placedVertices] using hxi
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvx⟩ := Set.mem_vadd_set.mp hplaced
  refine ⟨v, hv, i.1.1, hcenterS, ?_⟩
  simpa [vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hvx.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.frontier_vadd_eq
statement:
theorem frontier_vadd_eq
    (u : Tiling.Plane) (D : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    frontier (u +ᵥ D) = u +ᵥ frontier D
proof:
:= by
  rw [frontier, closure_vadd, interior_vadd]
  ext z
  simp only [frontier, Set.mem_sdiff, mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.translated_openCarrier_frontier_cross
statement:
theorem translated_openCarrier_frontier_cross
    (K : Region) (t a : Tiling.Plane) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball a r, z ∈ frontier (t +ᵥ K.openCarrier) →
      z.re = a.re ∨ z.im = a.im
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hcross⟩ := K.isAxisParallel.localBoundaryCross (a - t)
  have hfrontEq : frontier K.openCarrier = frontier K.support := by
    rw [frontier, frontier]
    change closure (interior K.support) \ interior (interior K.support) =
      closure K.support \ interior K.support
