    obtain ⟨s, hzs⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp (hFcover hz)
    have hzG := hGcover s ⟨hz, hTileIn s hzs⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hzg⟩ := mem_sUnion.mp hzG
    exact mem_sUnion.mpr ⟨g, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨s, hg⟩, hzg⟩
  have hGtotalEq : frontier D = ⋃₀ Gtotal :=
    Subset.antisymm hGtotalCover hGtotalSub
  refine ⟨(regularSupport_isRegularOpen K S).1,
    (regularSupport_isRegularOpen K S).2,
    Gtotal, hGtotalShape, hGtotalEq, ?_⟩
  intro W hW
  let B : Set Tiling.Plane := IntrinsicVertices.closedAxisBox (-r) r (-r) r
  have hBbounded : Bornology.IsBounded B :=
    (Metric.isBounded_Icc _ _).reProdIm (Metric.isBounded_Icc _ _)
  let A : Set S := {s | ∃ g ∈ G s, (g ∩ W).Nonempty}
  have hAsub : Subtype.val '' A ⊆ S ∩ (W - B) := by
    rintro t ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg, z, hzg, hzW⟩ := hs
    have hzbox : z ∈ Q s := hGbox s g hg hzg
    have hzB : z - s.1 ∈ B := by
      change (z - s.1).re ∈ Icc (-r) r ∧
        (z - s.1).im ∈ Icc (-r) r
      change z.re ∈ Icc (s.1.re - r) (s.1.re + r) ∧
        z.im ∈ Icc (s.1.im - r) (s.1.im + r) at hzbox
      simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, mem_Icc] at hzbox ⊢
      constructor <;> constructor <;> linarith [hzbox.1.1, hzbox.1.2,
        hzbox.2.1, hzbox.2.2]
    refine ⟨s.2, ?_⟩
    have hsSub : z - (z - s.1) ∈ W - B := Set.sub_mem_sub hzW hzB
    have heq : z - (z - s.1) = s.1 := by ring
    simpa only [heq] using hsSub
  have hAfin : A.Finite := by
    apply Set.Finite.of_injOn (f := Subtype.val)
      (t := S ∩ (W - B))
    · intro s hs
      exact hAsub ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    · intro s _ t _ h
      exact Subtype.ext h
    · exact (IsPacking.locallyFinite_centres hpacking).1 _
        (hW.sub hBbounded)
  have hfiniteUnion : (⋃ s ∈ A, G s).Finite :=
    hAfin.biUnion fun s _ => hGfinite s
  apply hfiniteUnion.subset
  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨hgG, hmeet⟩ := hg
  obtain ⟨s, hgs⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hgG
  exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨s, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨g, hgs, hmeet⟩, hgs⟩⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.exists_finiteOrbitRepresentatives_of_planarLattice
statement:
theorem exists_finiteOrbitRepresentatives_of_planarLattice
    {S : Set Plane} (L : PlanarLattice)
    (hlocal : ∀ Q, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (S ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hperiod : L.toAddSubgroup ≤ periodGroup S) :
    ∃ R : Finset Plane,
      (R : Set Plane) ⊆ S ∧
      QuotientAddGroup.mk' L.toAddSubgroup '' (R : Set Plane) =
        QuotientAddGroup.mk' L.toAddSubgroup '' S ∧
      Set.InjOn (QuotientAddGroup.mk' L.toAddSubgroup) (R : Set Plane)
proof:
:= by
  let b := L.realBasis
  let F : Set Plane := ZSpan.fundamentalDomain b
  have hfin : (S ∩ F).Finite := hlocal F (ZSpan.fundamentalDomain_isBounded b)
  let R : Finset Plane := hfin.toFinset
  have hRset : (R : Set Plane) = S ∩ F := by
    ext x
    simp [R]
  have hsub : (R : Set Plane) ⊆ S := by
    rw [hRset]
    exact inter_subset_left
  have hfractS (s : Plane) (hs : s ∈ S) : ZSpan.fract b s ∈ S := by
    rw [ZSpan.fract_apply]
    have hfloor : (ZSpan.floor b s : Plane) ∈ periodGroup S := by
      apply hperiod
      rw [← L.span_realBasis_toAddSubgroup]
      exact (ZSpan.floor b s).property
    have hneg : -(ZSpan.floor b s : Plane) +ᵥ S = S :=
      (periodGroup_isAddSubgroup S _).mp (neg_mem hfloor)
    have hmem : -(ZSpan.floor b s : Plane) + s ∈
        -(ZSpan.floor b s : Plane) +ᵥ S := ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    rw [hneg] at hmem
    simpa [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hmem
  have hsurj :
      QuotientAddGroup.mk' L.toAddSubgroup '' (R : Set Plane) =
        QuotientAddGroup.mk' L.toAddSubgroup '' S := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact image_mono hsub
    · rintro q ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      let r := ZSpan.fract b s
      have hrS : r ∈ S := hfractS s hs
      have hrF : r ∈ F := ZSpan.fract_mem_fundamentalDomain b s
      refine ⟨r, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hRset]
        exact ⟨hrS, hrF⟩
      · apply (QuotientAddGroup.mk'_eq_mk' _).2
        refine ⟨(ZSpan.floor b s : Plane), ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← L.span_realBasis_toAddSubgroup]
          exact (ZSpan.floor b s).property
        · dsimp only [r]
          rw [ZSpan.fract_apply]
          abel
  refine ⟨R, hsub, hsurj, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy hq
  have hxF : x ∈ F := (hRset ▸ hx).2
  have hyF : y ∈ F := (hRset ▸ hy).2
  have hdiff : -x + y ∈ L.toAddSubgroup := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hxy⟩ := (QuotientAddGroup.mk'_eq_mk' _).mp hq
    rw [← hxy]
    simpa using hz
  have hfract : ZSpan.fract b x = ZSpan.fract b y := by
    rw [ZSpan.fract_eq_fract]
    have hz : -x + y ∈
        (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range b)).toAddSubgroup := by
      rw [L.span_realBasis_toAddSubgroup]
      exact hdiff
    exact hz
  rw [ZSpan.fract_eq_self.mpr hxF, ZSpan.fract_eq_self.mpr hyF] at hfract
  exact hfract

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.rationalScale_re_eq
statement:
private theorem rationalScale_re_eq (d : ℕ) (z : ZPlane) :
    (rationalScale d z).re = (z 0 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [rationalScale]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.rationalScale_im_eq
statement:
private theorem rationalScale_im_eq (d : ℕ) (z : ZPlane) :
    (rationalScale d z).im = (z 1 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [rationalScale]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.floor_re_eq_of_mem_meshCell
proof:
:= by
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  rcases hx with ⟨hxlo, hxhi, _, _⟩
  rw [rationalScale_re_eq] at hxlo hxhi
  have hlo : (z 0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) * x.re := by
    have := (div_lt_iff₀ hdR).mp hxlo
    simpa [mul_comm] using this
  have hhi : (d : ℝ) * x.re < (z 0 : ℝ) + 1 := by
    have hxhi' : x.re < ((z 0 : ℝ) + 1) / (d : ℝ) := by
      rw [add_div]
      simpa using hxhi
    have := (lt_div_iff₀ hdR).mp hxhi'
    simpa [mul_comm] using this
  exact Int.floor_eq_iff.mpr ⟨hlo.le, hhi⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.floor_im_eq_of_mem_meshCell
proof:
:= by
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  rcases hx with ⟨_, _, hxlo, hxhi⟩
  rw [rationalScale_im_eq] at hxlo hxhi
  have hlo : (z 1 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) * x.im := by
    have := (div_lt_iff₀ hdR).mp hxlo
    simpa [mul_comm] using this
  have hhi : (d : ℝ) * x.im < (z 1 : ℝ) + 1 := by
    have hxhi' : x.im < ((z 1 : ℝ) + 1) / (d : ℝ) := by
      rw [add_div]
      simpa using hxhi
    have := (lt_div_iff₀ hdR).mp hxhi'
    simpa [mul_comm] using this
  exact Int.floor_eq_iff.mpr ⟨hlo.le, hhi⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.rationalScale_injective
statement:
theorem rationalScale_injective :
  ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → Function.Injective (rationalScale d)
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd z w hzw
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · have h := congrArg Complex.re hzw
    simp only [rationalScale] at h
    change (((z 0 : ℤ) : ℚ) / (d : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      (((w 0 : ℤ) : ℚ) / (d : ℚ) : ℝ) at h
    have hdr : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hd)
    field_simp [hdr] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  · have h := congrArg Complex.im hzw
    simp only [rationalScale] at h
    change (((z 1 : ℤ) : ℚ) / (d : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      (((w 1 : ℤ) : ℚ) / (d : ℚ) : ℝ) at h
    have hdr : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hd)
    field_simp [hdr] at h
    exact_mod_cast h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.rationalScale_add
statement:
theorem rationalScale_add :
  ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → ∀ z a : ZPlane,
    rationalScale d (z + a) = rationalScale d z + rationalScale d a
proof:
:= by
  intro d _hd z a
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp only [rationalScale, Pi.add_apply, Complex.add_re]
    push_cast
    ring
  · simp only [rationalScale, Pi.add_apply, Complex.add_im]
    push_cast
    ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.meshCell_nonempty
statement:
theorem meshCell_nonempty :
  ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → ∀ z : ZPlane, (meshCell d z).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd z
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hw : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / d := one_div_pos.mpr hdR
  refine ⟨Complex.mk ((rationalScale d z).re + (1 / d : ℝ) / 2)
    ((rationalScale d z).im + (1 / d : ℝ) / 2), ?_⟩
  change (rationalScale d z).re < (rationalScale d z).re + (1 / d : ℝ) / 2 ∧
    (rationalScale d z).re + (1 / d : ℝ) / 2 <
      (rationalScale d z).re + (1 / d : ℝ) ∧
    (rationalScale d z).im < (rationalScale d z).im + (1 / d : ℝ) / 2 ∧
    (rationalScale d z).im + (1 / d : ℝ) / 2 <
      (rationalScale d z).im + (1 / d : ℝ)
  constructor
  · linarith
  constructor
  · linarith
  constructor <;> linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.meshCell_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem meshCell_pairwiseDisjoint :
  ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ (meshCell d)
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd z _hz w _hw hzw
  change Disjoint (meshCell d z) (meshCell d w)
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxz hxw
  apply hzw
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · exact (floor_re_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hxz).symm.trans
      (floor_re_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hxw)
  · exact (floor_im_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hxz).symm.trans
      (floor_im_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hxw)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.meshCell_add
statement:
theorem meshCell_add :
  ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → ∀ z a : ZPlane,
    meshCell d (z + a) = rationalScale d a +ᵥ meshCell d z
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd z a
  ext x
  simp only [meshCell, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem,
    vadd_eq_add, Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im]
  rw [rationalScale_add hd]
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄⟩
    constructor
    · linarith
    constructor
    · linarith
    constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄⟩
    constructor
    · linarith
    constructor
    · linarith
    constructor <;> linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.offMesh_existsUnique_meshCell
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd x hx
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hxre : ∀ n : ℤ, x.re ≠ (((n : ℚ) / (d : ℚ)) : ℝ) := by
    intro n hn
    apply hx
    exact Or.inl ⟨n, hn⟩
  have hxim : ∀ n : ℤ, x.im ≠ (((n : ℚ) / (d : ℚ)) : ℝ) := by
    intro n hn
    apply hx
    exact Or.inr ⟨n, hn⟩
  let z : ZPlane := fun i =>
    if i = 0 then ⌊(d : ℝ) * x.re⌋ else ⌊(d : ℝ) * x.im⌋
  have hz0 : z 0 = ⌊(d : ℝ) * x.re⌋ := by simp [z]
  have hz1 : z 1 = ⌊(d : ℝ) * x.im⌋ := by simp [z]
  have hrelo_le : (z 0 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) ≤ x.re := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hdR).2
    rw [hz0]
    simpa [mul_comm] using (Int.floor_le ((d : ℝ) * x.re))
  have hrelo : (z 0 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) < x.re := by
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne hrelo_le
    intro heq
    apply hxre (z 0)
    rw [← heq]
    norm_num
  have hrehi : x.re < (z 0 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) + 1 / (d : ℝ) := by
    rw [← add_div]
    apply (lt_div_iff₀ hdR).2
    rw [hz0]
    simp [mul_comm]
  have himlo_le : (z 1 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) ≤ x.im := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hdR).2
    rw [hz1]
    simpa [mul_comm] using (Int.floor_le ((d : ℝ) * x.im))
  have himlo : (z 1 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) < x.im := by
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne himlo_le
    intro heq
    apply hxim (z 1)
    rw [← heq]
    norm_num
  have himhi : x.im < (z 1 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) + 1 / (d : ℝ) := by
    rw [← add_div]
    apply (lt_div_iff₀ hdR).2
    rw [hz1]
    simp [mul_comm]
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (rationalScale d z).re < x.re ∧
      x.re < (rationalScale d z).re + (1 / d : ℝ) ∧
      (rationalScale d z).im < x.im ∧
      x.im < (rationalScale d z).im + (1 / d : ℝ)
    rw [rationalScale_re_eq, rationalScale_im_eq]
    exact ⟨hrelo, hrehi, himlo, himhi⟩
  · intro w hw
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [hz0] using (floor_re_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hw).symm
    · simpa [hz1] using (floor_im_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hw).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.volume_re_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem volume_re_eq_zero (c : ℝ) :
    volume {x : Tiling.Plane | x.re = c} = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {x : Tiling.Plane | x.re = c} =
      Complex.measurableEquivRealProd ⁻¹' ({c} ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hset, Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.measure_preimage]
  · rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod, Measure.prod_prod]
    simp
  · exact ((measurableSet_singleton c).prod MeasurableSet.univ).nullMeasurableSet

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.volume_im_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem volume_im_eq_zero (c : ℝ) :
    volume {x : Tiling.Plane | x.im = c} = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {x : Tiling.Plane | x.im = c} =
      Complex.measurableEquivRealProd ⁻¹' ((Set.univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ {c}) := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hset, Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.measure_preimage]
  · rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod, Measure.prod_prod]
    simp
  · exact (MeasurableSet.univ.prod (measurableSet_singleton c)).nullMeasurableSet

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.meshLines_volume_zero
statement:
private theorem meshLines_volume_zero :
  ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → volume (meshLines d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro d _hd
  have hlines : meshLines d =
      (⋃ n : ℤ, {x : Tiling.Plane | x.re = (((n : ℚ) / (d : ℚ)) : ℝ)}) ∪
        (⋃ n : ℤ, {x : Tiling.Plane | x.im = (((n : ℚ) / (d : ℚ)) : ℝ)}) := by
    ext x
    simp [meshLines]
  rw [hlines]
  rw [measure_union_null]
  · exact measure_iUnion_null fun n ↦ volume_re_eq_zero _
  · exact measure_iUnion_null fun n ↦ volume_im_eq_zero _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.isOpen_meshCell
statement: theorem isOpen_meshCell (d : ℕ) (z : ZPlane) : IsOpen (meshCell d z)
proof:
:= by
  exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
    ((isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.isOpen_rawCellUnion
statement:
private theorem isOpen_rawCellUnion (d : ℕ) (A : Set ZPlane) :
    IsOpen (⋃ z : A, meshCell d z.1)
proof:
:= by
  exact isOpen_iUnion fun z ↦ isOpen_meshCell d z.1

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.offMesh_mem_regularizedCellUnion_iff
statement:
private theorem offMesh_mem_regularizedCellUnion_iff :
  ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → ∀ (A : Set ZPlane) (x : Tiling.Plane),
    x ∉ meshLines d →
      (x ∈ regularizedCellUnion d A ↔
        ∃ z ∈ A, x ∈ meshCell d z)
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd A x hx
  let U : Set Tiling.Plane := ⋃ z : A, meshCell d z.1
  have hUopen : IsOpen U := isOpen_rawCellUnion d A
  constructor
  · intro hxreg
    rcases offMesh_existsUnique_meshCell hd x hx with ⟨z, hxz, _hzuniq⟩
    refine ⟨z, ?_, hxz⟩
    by_contra hzA
    have hxcl : x ∈ closure U := interior_subset hxreg
    rcases (mem_closure_iff.mp hxcl) (meshCell d z) (isOpen_meshCell d z) hxz with
      ⟨y, hyz, hyU⟩
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hyU with ⟨w, hyw⟩
    have hzw : z = w.1 := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      · exact (floor_re_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hyz).symm.trans
          (floor_re_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hyw)
      · exact (floor_im_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hyz).symm.trans
          (floor_im_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hyw)
    exact hzA (hzw ▸ w.2)
  · rintro ⟨z, hzA, hxz⟩
    change x ∈ interior (closure U)
    apply (hUopen.subset_interior_iff.mpr subset_closure)
    exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem ⟨z, hzA⟩ hxz

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.meshCell_disjoint_meshLines
proof:
:= by
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  intro hline
  rcases hline with ⟨n, hn⟩ | ⟨n, hn⟩
  · have hn' : x.re = (n : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) := by
      norm_num at hn ⊢
      exact hn
    rcases hx with ⟨hxlo, hxhi, _, _⟩
    rw [rationalScale_re_eq, hn'] at hxlo hxhi
    have hxhi' : (n : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) < ((z 0 : ℝ) + 1) / (d : ℝ) := by
      rw [add_div]
      exact hxhi
    have hloR : (z 0 : ℝ) < n := (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hdR).mp hxlo
    have hhiR : (n : ℝ) < (z 0 : ℝ) + 1 :=
      (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hdR).mp hxhi'
    have hlo : z 0 < n := by exact_mod_cast hloR
    have hhi : n < z 0 + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hhiR
    omega
  · have hn' : x.im = (n : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) := by
      norm_num at hn ⊢
      exact hn
    rcases hx with ⟨_, _, hxlo, hxhi⟩
    rw [rationalScale_im_eq, hn'] at hxlo hxhi
    have hxhi' : (n : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) < ((z 1 : ℝ) + 1) / (d : ℝ) := by
      rw [add_div]
      exact hxhi
    have hloR : (z 1 : ℝ) < n := (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hdR).mp hxlo
    have hhiR : (n : ℝ) < (z 1 : ℝ) + 1 :=
      (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hdR).mp hxhi'
    have hlo : z 1 < n := by exact_mod_cast hloR
    have hhi : n < z 1 + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hhiR
    omega

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.meshCell_subset_regularizedCellUnion_iff
statement:
theorem meshCell_subset_regularizedCellUnion_iff :
  ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → ∀ (A : Set ZPlane) (z : ZPlane),
    meshCell d z ⊆ regularizedCellUnion d A ↔ z ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd A z
  constructor
  · intro hsubset
    rcases meshCell_nonempty hd z with ⟨x, hxz⟩
    have hxoff := meshCell_disjoint_meshLines hd hxz
    rcases (offMesh_mem_regularizedCellUnion_iff hd A x hxoff).mp
      (hsubset hxz) with ⟨w, hwA, hxw⟩
    have hzw : z = w := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      · exact (floor_re_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hxz).symm.trans
          (floor_re_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hxw)
      · exact (floor_im_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hxz).symm.trans
          (floor_im_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hxw)
    exact hzw ▸ hwA
  · intro hzA x hxz
    exact (offMesh_mem_regularizedCellUnion_iff hd A x
      (meshCell_disjoint_meshLines hd hxz)).mpr ⟨z, hzA, hxz⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.rawCellUnion_aeEq_regularizedCellUnion
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd A
  apply ae_iff.mpr
  apply measure_mono_null _ (meshLines_volume_zero hd)
  intro x hx
  by_contra hxline
  apply hx
  apply propext
  change (x ∈ ⋃ z : A, meshCell d z.1) ↔ x ∈ regularizedCellUnion d A
  rw [offMesh_mem_regularizedCellUnion_iff hd A x hxline]
  simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.region_frontier_subset_meshLines
statement:
private theorem region_frontier_subset_meshLines :
  ∀ {K : Region} {d : ℕ}, 0 < d →
    OnRationalMesh d K.vertices →
      frontier K.openCarrier ⊆ meshLines d
proof:
:= by
  intro K d _hd hmesh x hx
  rw [K.frontier_openCarrier_eq_frontier_support] at hx
  rcases Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.frontier_subset_vertexCoordinateGrid K hx with
    ⟨v, hv, hxv⟩ | ⟨v, hv, hxv⟩
  · rcases hmesh hv with ⟨z, hz⟩
    left
    refine ⟨z 0, ?_⟩
    calc
      x.re = v.re := hxv
      _ = (rationalScale d z).re := congrArg Complex.re hz.symm
      _ = _ := rfl
  · rcases hmesh hv with ⟨z, hz⟩
    right
    refine ⟨z 1, ?_⟩
    calc
      x.im = v.im := hxv
      _ = (rationalScale d z).im := congrArg Complex.im hz.symm
      _ = _ := rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.tiledTarget_frontier_subset_meshLines
statement:
private theorem tiledTarget_frontier_subset_meshLines :
  ∀ {K : Region} {T E : Set Tiling.Plane} {d : ℕ},
    0 < d → OnRationalMesh d K.vertices → OnRationalMesh d T →
    IsOpen E → interior (closure E) = E → TilesOn K T E →
      frontier E ⊆ meshLines d
proof:
:= by
  intro K T E d hd hK hT hEopen hEregular htiles x hx
  have hsupport : regularSupport K T = E :=
    regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn hEopen hEregular htiles
  rw [← hsupport] at hx
  have hxfrontClosure : x ∈ frontier (closure (openUnion K T)) :=
    frontier_interior_subset hx
  have hclosure := closure_openUnion_eq_iUnion_support htiles.2.1
  let C : Set Tiling.Plane := ⋃ t : T, (t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support
  have hCclosed : IsClosed C := by
    change IsClosed (⋃ t : T, (t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support)
    rw [← hclosure]
    exact isClosed_closure
  have hxfrontC : x ∈ frontier C := by
    simpa only [C, hclosure] using hxfrontClosure
  have hxC : x ∈ C := hCclosed.frontier_subset hxfrontC
  rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxC with ⟨t, hxt⟩
  have hxnotInteriorC : x ∉ interior C :=
    (mem_frontier_iff_notMem_interior hxC).mp hxfrontC
  have hxfrontTile : x ∈ frontier ((t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support) := by
    apply (mem_frontier_iff_notMem_interior hxt).mpr
    intro hxint
    apply hxnotInteriorC
    exact interior_mono (Set.subset_iUnion (fun t : T ↦
      (t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support) t) hxint
  rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.frontier_vadd_eq] at hxfrontTile
  have hxsource : x - (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ frontier K.openCarrier := by
    rw [K.frontier_openCarrier_eq_frontier_support]
    simpa only [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
      neg_add_eq_sub] using hxfrontTile
  have hxsourceLine := region_frontier_subset_meshLines hd hK hxsource
  rcases hT t.2 with ⟨a, ha⟩
  rcases hxsourceLine with ⟨n, hn⟩ | ⟨n, hn⟩
  · left
    refine ⟨n + a 0, ?_⟩
    have htre : (t : Tiling.Plane).re = (a 0 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) := by
      calc
        (t : Tiling.Plane).re = (rationalScale d a).re :=
          congrArg Complex.re ha.symm
        _ = _ := rationalScale_re_eq d a
    have hn' : (x - (t : Tiling.Plane)).re = (n : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) := by
      norm_num at hn ⊢
      exact hn
    norm_num at ⊢
    simp only [Complex.sub_re] at hn'
    have hdne : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hd)
    field_simp [hdne] at htre hn' ⊢
    linarith
  · right
    refine ⟨n + a 1, ?_⟩
    have htim : (t : Tiling.Plane).im = (a 1 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) := by
      calc
        (t : Tiling.Plane).im = (rationalScale d a).im :=
          congrArg Complex.im ha.symm
        _ = _ := rationalScale_im_eq d a
    have hn' : (x - (t : Tiling.Plane)).im = (n : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) := by
      norm_num at hn ⊢
      exact hn
    norm_num at ⊢
    simp only [Complex.sub_im] at hn'
    have hdne : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hd)
    field_simp [hdne] at htim hn' ⊢
    linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.frontier_regularizedCellUnion_subset_meshLines
statement:
theorem frontier_regularizedCellUnion_subset_meshLines :
  ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → ∀ A : Set ZPlane,
    frontier (regularizedCellUnion d A) ⊆ meshLines d
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd A x hxfront
  by_contra hxoff
  rcases offMesh_existsUnique_meshCell hd x hxoff with ⟨z, hxz, _⟩
  by_cases hzA : z ∈ A
  · have hxreg : x ∈ regularizedCellUnion d A :=
      (meshCell_subset_regularizedCellUnion_iff hd A z).mpr hzA hxz
    have hxint : x ∈ interior (regularizedCellUnion d A) :=
      (subset_interior_iff_isOpen.mpr isOpen_interior) hxreg
    exact hxfront.2 hxint
  · have hxcl : x ∈ closure (regularizedCellUnion d A) := hxfront.1
    rcases (mem_closure_iff.mp hxcl) (meshCell d z) (isOpen_meshCell d z) hxz with
      ⟨y, hyz, hyreg⟩
    have hyoff := meshCell_disjoint_meshLines hd hyz
    rcases (offMesh_mem_regularizedCellUnion_iff hd A y hyoff).mp hyreg with
      ⟨w, hwA, hyw⟩
    have hzw : z = w := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      · exact (floor_re_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hyz).symm.trans
          (floor_re_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hyw)
      · exact (floor_im_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hyz).symm.trans
          (floor_im_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hyw)
    exact hzA (hzw ▸ hwA)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.convex_meshCell
statement:
private theorem convex_meshCell (d : ℕ) (z : ZPlane) :
    Convex ℝ (meshCell d z)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  rcases hx with ⟨hx₁, hx₂, hx₃, hx₄⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨hy₁, hy₂, hy₃, hy₄⟩
  by_cases ha0 : a = 0
  · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
    subst a
    subst b
    simpa using ⟨hy₁, hy₂, hy₃, hy₄⟩
  have ha' : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm ha0)
  change (rationalScale d z).re < (a • x + b • y).re ∧
    (a • x + b • y).re < (rationalScale d z).re + 1 / (d : ℝ) ∧
    (rationalScale d z).im < (a • x + b • y).im ∧
    (a • x + b • y).im < (rationalScale d z).im + 1 / (d : ℝ)
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im,
    smul_eq_mul]
  constructor
  · have h := add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le
      (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx₁ ha')
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy₁.le hb)
    simpa [← add_mul, hab] using h
  constructor
  · have h := add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le
      (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx₂ ha')
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy₂.le hb)
    simpa [← add_mul, hab] using h
  constructor
  · have h := add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le
      (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx₃ ha')
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy₃.le hb)
    simpa [← add_mul, hab] using h
  · have h := add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le
      (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx₄ ha')
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy₄.le hb)
    simpa [← add_mul, hab] using h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.target_cells_constant
statement:
theorem target_cells_constant :
  ∀ {K : Region} {T E : Set Tiling.Plane} {d : ℕ},
    0 < d → OnRationalMesh d K.vertices → OnRationalMesh d T →
    IsOpen E → interior (closure E) = E → TilesOn K T E →
    ∀ z : ZPlane, meshCell d z ⊆ E ∨ Disjoint (meshCell d z) E
proof:
:= by
  intro K T E d hd hK hT hEopen hEregular htiles z
  have hfront : frontier E ⊆ meshLines d :=
    tiledTarget_frontier_subset_meshLines hd hK hT
      hEopen hEregular htiles
  have hcover : meshCell d z ⊆ E ∪ (closure E)ᶜ := by
    intro x hxcell
    have hxnotFrontier : x ∉ frontier E := by
      intro hxfront
      exact meshCell_disjoint_meshLines hd hxcell (hfront hxfront)
    by_cases hxcl : x ∈ closure E
    · left
      have hxint : x ∈ interior E := by
        by_contra hxnotint
        exact hxnotFrontier ⟨hxcl, hxnotint⟩
      simpa only [hEopen.interior_eq] using hxint
    · exact Or.inr hxcl
  rcases (convex_meshCell d z).isPreconnected.subset_or_subset
      hEopen isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl
      (disjoint_compl_right.mono_left subset_closure) hcover with
    hsub | hsub
  · exact Or.inl hsub
  · right
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxcell hxE
    exact hsub hxcell (subset_closure hxE)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.target_eq_regularizedRaster
statement:
theorem target_eq_regularizedRaster :
  ∀ {K : Region} {T E : Set Tiling.Plane} {d : ℕ},
    0 < d → OnRationalMesh d K.vertices → OnRationalMesh d T →
    IsOpen E → interior (closure E) = E → TilesOn K T E →
    E = regularizedCellUnion d (rasterCells d E)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T E d hd hK hT hEopen hEregular htiles
  let A : Set ZPlane := rasterCells d E
  let U : Set Tiling.Plane := ⋃ z : A, meshCell d z.1
  have hconstant := target_cells_constant hd hK hT
    hEopen hEregular htiles
  have hUE : U =ᵐ[volume] E := by
    apply ae_iff.mpr
    apply measure_mono_null _ (meshLines_volume_zero hd)
    intro x hxneq
    by_contra hxline
    apply hxneq
    apply propext
    change (x ∈ U) ↔ x ∈ E
    constructor
    · intro hxU
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxU with ⟨z, hxz⟩
      exact z.2 hxz
    · intro hxE
      rcases offMesh_existsUnique_meshCell hd x hxline with ⟨z, hxz, _⟩
      have hzsubset : meshCell d z ⊆ E := by
        rcases hconstant z with hsub | hdisj
        · exact hsub
        · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hxz hxE)
      exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem ⟨z, hzsubset⟩ hxz
  have hUreg : U =ᵐ[volume] regularizedCellUnion d A :=
    rawCellUnion_aeEq_regularizedCellUnion hd A
  apply regularOpen_eq_of_aeEq hEopen hEregular isOpen_interior
  · simp
  · exact hUE.symm.trans hUreg

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.rasterCells_finite
statement:
private theorem rasterCells_finite {K : Region} {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    (rasterCells d K.openCarrier).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hdne : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hdR
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := K.isPolygonal.isCompact.isBounded.exists_norm_le
  obtain ⟨N : ℕ, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((d : ℝ) * C + 1)
  let B : Set (ℤ × ℤ) := Set.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ) ×ˢ
    Set.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ)
  have hBfinite : B.Finite := (Set.finite_Icc _ _).prod (Set.finite_Icc _ _)
  let e : ZPlane → ℤ × ℤ := fun z ↦ (z 0, z 1)
  have he : Function.Injective e := by
    intro z w hzw
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact congrArg Prod.fst hzw
    · exact congrArg Prod.snd hzw
  apply (hBfinite.preimage he.injOn).subset
  intro z hz
  let x : Tiling.Plane := Complex.mk
    ((rationalScale d z).re + (1 / d : ℝ) / 2)
    ((rationalScale d z).im + (1 / d : ℝ) / 2)
  have hw : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / d := one_div_pos.mpr hdR
  have hxcell : x ∈ meshCell d z := by
    change (rationalScale d z).re < (rationalScale d z).re + (1 / d : ℝ) / 2 ∧
      (rationalScale d z).re + (1 / d : ℝ) / 2 <
        (rationalScale d z).re + (1 / d : ℝ) ∧
      (rationalScale d z).im < (rationalScale d z).im + (1 / d : ℝ) / 2 ∧
      (rationalScale d z).im + (1 / d : ℝ) / 2 <
        (rationalScale d z).im + (1 / d : ℝ)
    constructor
    · linarith
    constructor
    · linarith
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hxsupport : x ∈ K.support := interior_subset (hz hxcell)
  have hxnorm : ‖x‖ ≤ C := hC x hxsupport
  have hre := abs_le.mp (Complex.abs_re_le_norm x |>.trans hxnorm)
  have him := abs_le.mp (Complex.abs_im_le_norm x |>.trans hxnorm)
  have hxre : x.re = (z 0 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) + 1 / (d : ℝ) / 2 := by
    simp only [x, rationalScale_re_eq]
  have hxim : x.im = (z 1 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) + 1 / (d : ℝ) / 2 := by
    simp only [x, rationalScale_im_eq]
  have hzre : (z 0 : ℝ) = (d : ℝ) * x.re - 1 / 2 := by
    rw [hxre]
    field_simp [hdne]
    ring
  have hzim : (z 1 : ℝ) = (d : ℝ) * x.im - 1 / 2 := by
    rw [hxim]
    field_simp [hdne]
    ring
  have hz0loR : (-(N : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (z 0 : ℝ) := by
    norm_num
    rw [hzre]
    nlinarith
  have hz0hiR : (z 0 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℕ) := by
    rw [hzre]
    nlinarith
  have hz1loR : (-(N : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (z 1 : ℝ) := by
    norm_num
    rw [hzim]
    nlinarith
  have hz1hiR : (z 1 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℕ) := by
    rw [hzim]
    nlinarith
  change e z ∈ B
  exact ⟨⟨by exact_mod_cast hz0loR, by exact_mod_cast hz0hiR⟩,
    ⟨by exact_mod_cast hz1loR, by exact_mod_cast hz1hiR⟩⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.openSet_meshCell_constant
proof:
:= by
  have hcover : meshCell d z ⊆ E ∪ (closure E)ᶜ := by
    intro x hxcell
    have hxnotFrontier : x ∉ frontier E := by
      intro hxfront
      exact meshCell_disjoint_meshLines hd hxcell (hfront hxfront)
    by_cases hxcl : x ∈ closure E
    · left
      have hxint : x ∈ interior E := by
        by_contra hxnotint
        exact hxnotFrontier ⟨hxcl, hxnotint⟩
      simpa only [hEopen.interior_eq] using hxint
    · exact Or.inr hxcl
  rcases (convex_meshCell d z).isPreconnected.subset_or_subset
      hEopen isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl
      (disjoint_compl_right.mono_left subset_closure) hcover with
    hsub | hsub
  · exact Or.inl hsub
  · right
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxcell hxE
    exact hsub hxcell (subset_closure hxE)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.exists_regionRaster
statement:
theorem exists_regionRaster :
  ∀ {K : Region} {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → OnRationalMesh d K.vertices →
    ∃ F : Finset ZPlane,
      F.Nonempty ∧
      (F : Set ZPlane) = rasterCells d K.openCarrier ∧
      K.openCarrier =ᵐ[volume] ⋃ f : F, meshCell d f.1 ∧
      K.openCarrier = regularizedCellUnion d F
proof:
:= by
  intro K d hd hmesh
  let A : Set ZPlane := rasterCells d K.openCarrier
  have hAfin : A.Finite := rasterCells_finite hd
  let F : Finset ZPlane := hAfin.toFinset
  have hFA : (F : Set ZPlane) = A := by
    simp [F]
  have hfront : frontier K.openCarrier ⊆ meshLines d :=
    region_frontier_subset_meshLines hd hmesh
  have hconstant : ∀ z : ZPlane,
      meshCell d z ⊆ K.openCarrier ∨ Disjoint (meshCell d z) K.openCarrier :=
    openSet_meshCell_constant hd K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1 hfront
  let U : Set Tiling.Plane := ⋃ z : A, meshCell d z.1
  have hUE : U =ᵐ[volume] K.openCarrier := by
    apply ae_iff.mpr
    apply measure_mono_null _ (meshLines_volume_zero hd)
    intro x hxneq
    by_contra hxline
    apply hxneq
    apply propext
    change (x ∈ U) ↔ x ∈ K.openCarrier
    constructor
    · intro hxU
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxU with ⟨z, hxz⟩
      exact z.2 hxz
    · intro hxK
      rcases offMesh_existsUnique_meshCell hd x hxline with ⟨z, hxz, _⟩
      have hzsubset : meshCell d z ⊆ K.openCarrier := by
        rcases hconstant z with hsub | hdisj
        · exact hsub
        · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hxz hxK)
      exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem ⟨z, hzsubset⟩ hxz
  have hUreg : U =ᵐ[volume] regularizedCellUnion d A :=
    rawCellUnion_aeEq_regularizedCellUnion hd A
  have hregular : K.openCarrier = regularizedCellUnion d A := by
    apply regularOpen_eq_of_aeEq K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1
      K.openCarrier_regularOpen.2 isOpen_interior
    · simp
    · exact hUE.symm.trans hUreg
  have hAnonempty : A.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨x, hxK⟩ := K.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty K.nonempty
    change x ∈ K.openCarrier at hxK
    have hopenNe : volume K.openCarrier ≠ 0 :=
      K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.measure_ne_zero volume ⟨x, hxK⟩
    have hex : ∃ y ∈ K.openCarrier, y ∉ meshLines d := by
      by_contra hnone
      push Not at hnone
      have hsub : K.openCarrier ⊆ meshLines d := fun y hy ↦ hnone y hy
      exact hopenNe (nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp
        ((measure_mono hsub).trans_eq (meshLines_volume_zero hd)))
    rcases hex with ⟨y, hyK, hyoff⟩
    rcases offMesh_existsUnique_meshCell hd y hyoff with ⟨z, hyz, _⟩
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    rcases hconstant z with hsub | hdisj
    · exact hsub
    · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hyz hyK)
  refine ⟨F, ?_, hFA, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [F] using hAnonempty
  · have hUF : (⋃ f : F, meshCell d f.1) = U := by
      ext x
      simp [U, F]
    rw [hUF]
    exact hUE.symm
  · rw [hFA]
    exact hregular

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.translatedRaster_rawSandwich
statement:
private theorem translatedRaster_rawSandwich :
  ∀ {K : Region} {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → OnRationalMesh d K.vertices →
    ∀ (F : Finset ZPlane),
      (F : Set ZPlane) = rasterCells d K.openCarrier →
    ∀ A : Set ZPlane,
      (⋃ q : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F A, meshCell d q.1) ⊆
        openUnion K (rationalScale d '' A) ∧
      openUnion K (rationalScale d '' A) ⊆
        closure (⋃ q : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F A,
          meshCell d q.1)
proof:
:= by
  intro K d hd hmesh F hF A
  let U : Set Tiling.Plane :=
    ⋃ q : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F A, meshCell d q.1
  constructor
  · intro x hxU
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxU with ⟨q, hxq⟩
    rcases Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_discreteCarrier_iff.mp q.2 with
      ⟨f, hfF, a, haA, hq⟩
    rw [hq, meshCell_add hd] at hxq
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
    refine ⟨⟨rationalScale d a, ⟨a, haA, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hxq ⊢
    have hfRaster : f ∈ rasterCells d K.openCarrier := by
      rw [← hF]
      exact hfF
    exact hfRaster hxq
  · rcases exists_regionRaster hd hmesh with
      ⟨G, _hGne, hG, _hKae, hKreg⟩
    have hGF : G = F := Finset.coe_injective (hG.trans hF.symm)
    subst G
    let V : Set Tiling.Plane := ⋃ f : F, meshCell d f.1
    have hKcl : K.openCarrier ⊆ closure V := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hKreg] at hy
      exact interior_subset hy
    intro x hxOpen
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion] at hxOpen
    rcases hxOpen with ⟨s, hxs⟩
    rcases s.2 with ⟨a, haA, hsa⟩
    have hxTranslatedClosure :
        x ∈ closure (rationalScale d a +ᵥ V) := by
      rw [closure_vadd]
      rw [← hsa] at hxs
      exact Set.vadd_set_mono hKcl hxs
    apply closure_mono _ hxTranslatedClosure
    intro y hy
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hy
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy with ⟨f, hyf⟩
    have hyCell : y ∈ meshCell d (f.1 + a) := by
      rw [meshCell_add hd]
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      exact hyf
    have hcarrier : f.1 + a ∈
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F A :=
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_discreteCarrier_iff.mpr
        ⟨f.1, f.2, a, haA, rfl⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem ⟨f.1 + a, hcarrier⟩ hyCell

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.regularSupport_rationalScale_image
statement:
theorem regularSupport_rationalScale_image :
  ∀ {K : Region} {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → OnRationalMesh d K.vertices →
    ∀ (F : Finset ZPlane),
      (F : Set ZPlane) = rasterCells d K.openCarrier →
    ∀ A : Set ZPlane,
      regularSupport K (rationalScale d '' A) =
        regularizedCellUnion d (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F A)
proof:
:= by
  intro K d hd hmesh F hF A
  let D : Set ZPlane := Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F A
  let U : Set Tiling.Plane := ⋃ q : D, meshCell d q.1
  rcases translatedRaster_rawSandwich hd hmesh F hF A with
    ⟨hUopen, hopenU⟩
  have hclosure : closure (openUnion K (rationalScale d '' A)) = closure U := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact closure_minimal hopenU isClosed_closure
    · exact closure_mono hUopen
  change interior (closure (openUnion K (rationalScale d '' A))) =
    interior (closure U)
  rw [hclosure]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.offMesh_sub_rationalScale
proof:
:= by
  intro hline
  have hdne : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hd)
  rcases hline with ⟨n, hn⟩ | ⟨n, hn⟩
  · apply hy
    left
    refine ⟨n + a 0, ?_⟩
    have hn' : y.re - (a 0 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) =
        (n : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) := by
      norm_num at hn ⊢
      simpa only [Complex.sub_re, rationalScale_re_eq] using hn
    norm_num at ⊢
    field_simp [hdne] at hn' ⊢
    linarith
  · apply hy
    right
    refine ⟨n + a 1, ?_⟩
    have hn' : y.im - (a 1 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) =
        (n : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) := by
      norm_num at hn ⊢
      simpa only [Complex.sub_im, rationalScale_im_eq] using hn
    norm_num at ⊢
    field_simp [hdne] at hn' ⊢
    linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.discreteCarrier_eq_target_of_tiles
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcount := (TranslationalTilings.tilesAtLevel_iff_representation_count
    F A R 1).mp htiles
  ext q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    rcases Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_discreteCarrier_iff.mp hq with
      ⟨f, hfF, a, haA, hqeq⟩
    by_contra hqR
    have hc := hcount q
    rw [if_neg hqR] at hc
    have hfmem : f ∈ F.filter fun g ↦ q - g ∈ A := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, hfF, true_and]
      rw [hqeq]
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using haA
    have hpos : 0 < (F.filter fun g ↦ q - g ∈ A).card :=
      Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨f, hfmem⟩
    omega
  · intro hqR
    have hc := hcount q
    rw [if_pos hqR] at hc
    have hne : (F.filter fun f ↦ q - f ∈ A).Nonempty := by
      rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
      intro hempty
      rw [hempty] at hc
      simp at hc
    rcases hne with ⟨f, hf⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hf
    exact Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_discreteCarrier_iff.mpr
      ⟨f, hf.1, q - f, hf.2, by abel⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.tile_representation_unique
statement:
private theorem tile_representation_unique {F : Finset ZPlane}
    {A R : Set ZPlane} (htiles : TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A R)
    {q f g : ZPlane} (hfF : f ∈ F) (hfA : q - f ∈ A)
    (hgF : g ∈ F) (hgA : q - g ∈ A) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcount := (TranslationalTilings.tilesAtLevel_iff_representation_count
    F A R 1).mp htiles q
  have hqR : q ∈ R := by
    rw [← discreteCarrier_eq_target_of_tiles htiles]
    exact Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_discreteCarrier_iff.mpr
      ⟨f, hfF, q - f, hfA, by abel⟩
  rw [if_pos hqR] at hcount
  rcases Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcount with ⟨u, hu⟩
  have hfmem : f ∈ F.filter fun u ↦ q - u ∈ A := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, hfF, hfA, and_self]
  have hgmem : g ∈ F.filter fun u ↦ q - u ∈ A := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, hgF, hgA, and_self]
  rw [hu] at hfmem hgmem
  simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hfmem hgmem
  exact hfmem.trans hgmem.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.packing_representation_unique
statement:
private theorem packing_representation_unique {K : Region} {d : ℕ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (F : Finset ZPlane)
    (hF : (F : Set ZPlane) = rasterCells d K.openCarrier)
    (A : Set ZPlane)
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements (rationalScale d '' A)))
    {q f g : ZPlane} (hfF : f ∈ F) (hfA : q - f ∈ A)
    (hgF : g ∈ F) (hgA : q - g ∈ A) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hfg
  let a : ZPlane := q - f
  let b : ZPlane := q - g
  have hab : a ≠ b := by
    intro hab
    apply hfg
    dsimp only [a, b] at hab
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg] at hab
    exact neg_injective (add_left_cancel hab)
  have hcent : rationalScale d a ≠ rationalScale d b :=
    (rationalScale_injective hd).ne hab
  have hdisj := (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K
    (rationalScale d '' A)).mp hpacking
    (show rationalScale d a ∈ rationalScale d '' A from ⟨a, hfA, rfl⟩)
    (show rationalScale d b ∈ rationalScale d '' A from ⟨b, hgA, rfl⟩)
    hcent
  rcases meshCell_nonempty hd q with ⟨x, hxq⟩
  have hfa : f + a = q := by simp [a]
  have hgb : g + b = q := by simp [b]
  have hxfa : x ∈ rationalScale d a +ᵥ meshCell d f := by
    rw [← meshCell_add hd, hfa]
    exact hxq
  have hxgb : x ∈ rationalScale d b +ᵥ meshCell d g := by
    rw [← meshCell_add hd, hgb]
    exact hxq
  have hfRaster : f ∈ rasterCells d K.openCarrier := by
    rw [← hF]
    exact hfF
  have hgRaster : g ∈ rasterCells d K.openCarrier := by
    rw [← hF]
    exact hgF
  have hxKfa : x ∈ rationalScale d a +ᵥ K.openCarrier :=
    Set.vadd_set_mono hfRaster hxfa
  have hxKgb : x ∈ rationalScale d b +ᵥ K.openCarrier :=
    Set.vadd_set_mono hgRaster hxgb
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hxKfa hxKgb

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.tilesOn_rationalScale_image_iff_raster
statement:
theorem tilesOn_rationalScale_image_iff_raster :
  ∀ {K : Region} {A : Set ZPlane} {E : Set Tiling.Plane} {d : ℕ},
    0 < d → OnRationalMesh d K.vertices →
    IsOpen E → interior (closure E) = E →
    E = regularizedCellUnion d (rasterCells d E) →
    ∃ F : Finset ZPlane,
      F.Nonempty ∧ (F : Set ZPlane) = rasterCells d K.openCarrier ∧
      (TilesOn K (rationalScale d '' A) E ↔
        TranslationalTilings.Tiles F A (rasterCells d E))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro K A E d hd hmesh hEopen hEregular hEraster
  rcases exists_regionRaster hd hmesh with
    ⟨F, hFne, hF, _hKae, hKreg⟩
  refine ⟨F, hFne, hF, ?_⟩
  let R : Set ZPlane := rasterCells d E
  let D : Set ZPlane := Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F A
  constructor
  · intro hcontinuous
    have hsupportE : regularSupport K (rationalScale d '' A) = E :=
      regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn hEopen hEregular hcontinuous
    have hsupportD : regularSupport K (rationalScale d '' A) =
        regularizedCellUnion d D :=
      regularSupport_rationalScale_image hd hmesh F hF A
    have hregEq : regularizedCellUnion d D = regularizedCellUnion d R := by
      calc
        regularizedCellUnion d D = regularSupport K (rationalScale d '' A) :=
          hsupportD.symm
        _ = E := hsupportE
        _ = regularizedCellUnion d R := hEraster
    have hDR : D = R := by
      ext q
      constructor
      · intro hqD
        have hsub :=
          (meshCell_subset_regularizedCellUnion_iff hd D q).mpr hqD
        rw [hregEq] at hsub
        exact (meshCell_subset_regularizedCellUnion_iff hd R q).mp hsub
      · intro hqR
        have hsub :=
          (meshCell_subset_regularizedCellUnion_iff hd R q).mpr hqR
        rw [← hregEq] at hsub
        exact (meshCell_subset_regularizedCellUnion_iff hd D q).mp hsub
    apply (TranslationalTilings.tilesAtLevel_iff_representation_count
      F A R 1).mpr
    intro q
    by_cases hqR : q ∈ R
    · rw [if_pos hqR]
      have hqD : q ∈ D := by rwa [hDR]
      rcases Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_discreteCarrier_iff.mp hqD with
        ⟨f, hfF, a, haA, hq⟩
      have hfA : q - f ∈ A := by
        rw [hq]
        simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using haA
      have hfilter : (F.filter fun g ↦ q - g ∈ A) = {f} := by
        ext g
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_singleton]
        constructor
        · intro hg
          exact packing_representation_unique hd F hF A hcontinuous.2.1
            hg.1 hg.2 hfF hfA
        · rintro rfl
          exact ⟨hfF, hfA⟩
      rw [hfilter]
      simp
    · rw [if_neg hqR]
      have hfilter : (F.filter fun f ↦ q - f ∈ A) = ∅ := by
        ext f
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.notMem_empty, iff_false, not_and]
        intro hfF hfA
        apply hqR
        rw [← hDR]
        exact Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_discreteCarrier_iff.mpr
          ⟨f, hfF, q - f, hfA, by abel⟩
      rw [hfilter]
      simp
  · intro hdiscrete
    have hDR : D = R := discreteCarrier_eq_target_of_tiles hdiscrete
    have hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements (rationalScale d '' A)) := by
      rw [isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint]
      intro s hs t ht hst
      rcases hs with ⟨a, haA, rfl⟩
      rcases ht with ⟨b, hbA, rfl⟩
      change Disjoint (rationalScale d a +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
        (rationalScale d b +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hxa hxb
      let O : Set Tiling.Plane :=
        (rationalScale d a +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩
          (rationalScale d b +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
      have hOopen : IsOpen O :=
        (K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd (rationalScale d a)).inter
          (K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1.vadd (rationalScale d b))
      have hOne : O.Nonempty := ⟨x, hxa, hxb⟩
      have hOmeasure : volume O ≠ 0 := hOopen.measure_ne_zero volume hOne
      have hyexists : ∃ y ∈ O, y ∉ meshLines d := by
        by_contra hnone
        push Not at hnone
        have hsub : O ⊆ meshLines d := fun y hy ↦ hnone y hy
        exact hOmeasure (nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp
          ((measure_mono hsub).trans_eq (meshLines_volume_zero hd)))
      rcases hyexists with ⟨y, hya, hyoff⟩
      have hyaK : y - rationalScale d a ∈ K.openCarrier := by
        simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
          neg_add_eq_sub] using hya.1
      have hybK : y - rationalScale d b ∈ K.openCarrier := by
        simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
          neg_add_eq_sub] using hya.2
      have hyaoff := offMesh_sub_rationalScale hd hyoff a
      have hyboff := offMesh_sub_rationalScale hd hyoff b
      rcases offMesh_existsUnique_meshCell hd _ hyaoff with
        ⟨f, hyaf, _⟩
      rcases offMesh_existsUnique_meshCell hd _ hyboff with
        ⟨g, hybg, _⟩
      have hfRaster : f ∈ rasterCells d K.openCarrier := by
        rcases openSet_meshCell_constant hd K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1
            (region_frontier_subset_meshLines hd hmesh) f with
          hf | hf
        · exact hf
        · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp hf hyaf hyaK)
      have hgRaster : g ∈ rasterCells d K.openCarrier := by
        rcases openSet_meshCell_constant hd K.openCarrier_regularOpen.1
            (region_frontier_subset_meshLines hd hmesh) g with
          hg | hg
        · exact hg
        · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp hg hybg hybK)
      have hfF : f ∈ F := by
        change f ∈ (F : Set ZPlane)
        rw [hF]
        exact hfRaster
      have hgF : g ∈ F := by
        change g ∈ (F : Set ZPlane)
        rw [hF]
        exact hgRaster
      have hyfa : y ∈ meshCell d (f + a) := by
        rw [meshCell_add hd]
        simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
          neg_add_eq_sub] using hyaf
      have hygb : y ∈ meshCell d (g + b) := by
        rw [meshCell_add hd]
        simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
          neg_add_eq_sub] using hybg
      have hindex : f + a = g + b := by
        funext i
        fin_cases i
        · exact (floor_re_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hyfa).symm.trans
            (floor_re_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hygb)
        · exact (floor_im_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hyfa).symm.trans
            (floor_im_eq_of_mem_meshCell hd hygb)
      have hfg : f = g := tile_representation_unique hdiscrete
        hfF (show f + a - f ∈ A by simpa using haA)
        hgF (show f + a - g ∈ A by rw [hindex]; simpa using hbA)
      have hab : a = b := by
        rw [hfg] at hindex
        exact add_left_cancel hindex
      exact hst (congrArg (rationalScale d) hab)
    have hcountable : (rationalScale d '' A).Countable :=
      (Set.countable_univ.mono (Set.subset_univ A)).image (rationalScale d)
    refine ⟨hcountable, hpacking, ?_⟩
    have hopenAE := openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport hpacking
    have hsupport : regularSupport K (rationalScale d '' A) = E := by
      calc
        regularSupport K (rationalScale d '' A) =
            regularizedCellUnion d D :=
          regularSupport_rationalScale_image hd hmesh F hF A
        _ = regularizedCellUnion d R := congrArg (regularizedCellUnion d) hDR
        _ = E := hEraster.symm
    filter_upwards [hopenAE] with x hx
    rw [← Set.mem_iUnion]
    change x ∈ E ↔ x ∈ openUnion K (rationalScale d '' A)
    rw [← hsupport]
    change regularSupport K (rationalScale d '' A) x ↔
      openUnion K (rationalScale d '' A) x
    exact iff_of_eq hx.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.mem_discreteCarrier_iff_tileConv_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem mem_discreteCarrier_iff_tileConv_ne_zero
    {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] (F : Finset G) (A : Set G) (x : G) :
    x ∈ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F A ↔
      TranslationalTilings.tileConv F (TranslationalTilings.setIndicator A) x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [TranslationalTilings.tileConv_indicator_eq_card]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hfF, a, haA, rfl⟩
    have hf : f ∈ F.filter fun q ↦ f + a - q ∈ A := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, hfF, true_and]
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using haA
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨f, hf⟩).ne'
  · intro hne
    have hcard : 0 < (F.filter fun f ↦ x - f ∈ A).card := by
      exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hne)
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hcard
    have hf' := Finset.mem_filter.mp hf
    exact ⟨f, hf'.1, x - f, hf'.2, by abel⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.discreteCarrier_congr_of_convolutionEquivalent
statement:
private theorem discreteCarrier_congr_of_convolutionEquivalent
    {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] (F : Finset G) {A B : Set G}
    (h : TranslationalTilings.tileConv F (TranslationalTilings.setIndicator A) =
      TranslationalTilings.tileConv F (TranslationalTilings.setIndicator B)) :
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F A =
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F B
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_discreteCarrier_iff_tileConv_ne_zero,
    mem_discreteCarrier_iff_tileConv_ne_zero, h]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.translate_discreteCarrier_slice_of_setScalarPeriodic
statement:
private theorem translate_discreteCarrier_slice_of_setScalarPeriodic
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {M : ℕ}
    (hA : TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic M A)
    (h : TranslationalTilings.Plane)
    (line : TranslationalTilings.Plane ⧸ TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup h)
    (v : TranslationalTilings.Plane) :
    TranslationalTilings.translateSet (((M : ℕ) : ℤ) • v)
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (TranslationalTilings.slicePattern h line A)) =
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
        (TranslationalTilings.slicePattern h
          (line + QuotientAddGroup.mk'
            (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup h) (((M : ℕ) : ℤ) • v)) A)
proof:
:= by
  let p : TranslationalTilings.Plane := ((M : ℕ) : ℤ) • v
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hfF, t, ht, hxt⟩
    have ht' := (TranslationalTilings.mem_slicePattern t).1 ht
    refine ⟨f, hfF, t + p, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply (TranslationalTilings.mem_slicePattern (t + p)).2
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (hA t v).2 ht'.1
      · simpa only [map_add, p] using congrArg
          (fun q ↦ q + QuotientAddGroup.mk'
            (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup h) p) ht'.2
    · change x - p = f + t at hxt
      calc
        x = (x - p) + p := by abel
        _ = (f + t) + p := by rw [hxt]
        _ = f + (t + p) := by abel
  · rintro ⟨f, hfF, t, ht, hxt⟩
    have ht' := (TranslationalTilings.mem_slicePattern t).1 ht
    refine ⟨f, hfF, t - p, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply (TranslationalTilings.mem_slicePattern (t - p)).2
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · apply (hA (t - p) v).1
        simpa only [p, sub_add_cancel]
          using ht'.1
      · rw [map_sub, ht'.2]
        simp [p]
    · change x - p = f + (t - p)
      rw [hxt]
      abel

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.setScalarPeriodic_of_dvd
statement:
private theorem setScalarPeriodic_of_dvd
    {d p q : ℕ} {A : Set (TranslationalTilings.Lattice d)}

proof:
:= by

  intro x z
  have h := hA x ((m : ℤ) • z)
  simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, mul_smul] using h

private theorem carrier_setScalarPeriodic_of_convolution_scalarPeriodic

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.discreteCarrier_eq_target_of_tiles

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.gtSliceTransport
statement:
theorem gtSliceTransport
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {ell k : ℕ}
    {h : TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hh : TranslationalTilings.IsPrimitive h)
    (hA : Function.Periodic (TranslationalTilings.setIndicator A)
      (((ell * k : ℕ) : ℤ) • h))
    (hConv : TranslationalTilings.ScalarPeriodic ell
      (TranslationalTilings.tileConv F
        (TranslationalTilings.setIndicator A))) :
    ∀ (line : TranslationalTilings.Plane ⧸
        TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup h)
      (v : TranslationalTilings.Plane),
      TranslationalTilings.translateSet
          (((TranslationalTilings.indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card * k *
              TranslationalTilings.slicingLCM F h : ℕ) : ℤ) • v)
          (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
            (TranslationalTilings.slicePattern h line A)) =
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (TranslationalTilings.slicePattern h
            (line + QuotientAddGroup.mk'
              (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup h)
              (((TranslationalTilings.indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card * k *
                  TranslationalTilings.slicingLCM F h : ℕ) : ℤ) • v)) A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A', hA'periodic, _, hslice⟩ :=
    TranslationalTilings.improve_onePeriodic hell hk hh hA hConv
  intro line v
  let M := TranslationalTilings.indicatorDilationModulus ell F.card * k *
    TranslationalTilings.slicingLCM F h
  let p : TranslationalTilings.Plane := ((M : ℕ) : ℤ) • v
  have hcarrier (q : TranslationalTilings.Plane ⧸
      TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup h) :
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (TranslationalTilings.slicePattern h q A) =
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F
          (TranslationalTilings.slicePattern h q A') :=
    discreteCarrier_congr_of_convolutionEquivalent F (hslice q)
  rw [hcarrier line]
  have htransport := translate_discreteCarrier_slice_of_setScalarPeriodic
    (F := F) hA'periodic h line v
  rw [htransport]
  exact (hcarrier
    (line + QuotientAddGroup.mk'
      (TranslationalTilings.directionSubgroup h) p)).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.gtCommonDirectionalCarrierPeriod
statement:
theorem gtCommonDirectionalCarrierPeriod
    {F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    {A E : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {ell : ℕ}
    (D : TranslationalTilings.DirectionalTilingDecomposition F A E ell)
    (hell : 0 < ell) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ∀ j,
      TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic N
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F (D.part j))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hm : 2 ≤ D.numberOfParts
  · let p : Fin D.numberOfParts → ℕ := fun j ↦
      ell * TranslationalTilings.completionConvolutionMultiplier D j
    let N : ℕ := ∏ j, p j
    have hp_pos (j : Fin D.numberOfParts) : 0 < p j :=
      Nat.mul_pos hell
        (TranslationalTilings.convolution_part_scalarPeriodic D hm j).1
    have hNpos : 0 < N := by
      apply Finset.prod_pos
      intro j _
      exact hp_pos j
    refine ⟨N, hNpos, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
    have hp : TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic (p j)
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F (D.part j)) :=
      carrier_setScalarPeriodic_of_convolution_scalarPeriodic
        (TranslationalTilings.convolution_part_scalarPeriodic D hm j).2.2
    apply setScalarPeriodic_of_dvd (hA := hp)
    exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun i ↦ p i) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  · have hm_le : D.numberOfParts ≤ 1 := by omega
    have hm_pos : 0 < D.numberOfParts := D.number_pos
    have hm_eq : D.numberOfParts = 1 := by omega
    have hpart (j : Fin D.numberOfParts) : D.part j = A := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · intro x hx
        rw [← D.union_parts]
        exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem j hx
      · intro x hx
        rw [← D.union_parts] at hx
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
        have hij : i = j := Fin.ext (by omega)
        simpa only [hij] using hi
    have hcarrier : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier F A = E :=
      discreteCarrier_eq_target_of_tiles D.tiles
    refine ⟨ell, hell, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [hpart j, hcarrier]
    exact D.target_periodic

    {F : Finset Tiling.RationalPolygonal.IntegerPlane}

      F T (![0, 1] : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.IntegerPlane))

:= by

    have := congrFun h 1

statement:

:=

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.exists_locallyFellConvergent_subsequence
statement:
theorem exists_locallyFellConvergent_subsequence
    (delta : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (S : ℕ → Set Tiling.Plane) (hclosed : ∀ n, IsClosed (S n))
    (hseparated : ∀ n,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.IsUniformlySeparated delta (S n)) :
    ∃ (phi : ℕ → ℕ) (L : Set Tiling.Plane),
      StrictMono phi ∧ IsClosed L ∧
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.IsUniformlySeparated delta L ∧
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges (S ∘ phi) L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdelta_pos : 0 < delta := hdelta
  let e := onePointEquivSphereOfFinrankEq
    (ι := Fin 3) (V := Tiling.Plane) (by simp [Tiling.Plane])
  let _ : TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
    e.isEmbedding.metrizableSpace
  let _ : MetricSpace (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
    TopologicalSpace.metrizableSpaceMetric (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)
  let Kseq : ℕ → TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
    fun n ↦ Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification (S n) (hclosed n)
  obtain ⟨K, phi, hphi, hlim⟩ := CompactSpace.tendsto_subseq Kseq
  have hinfty : OnePoint.infty ∈ (K : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) := by
    let C : Set (TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) :=
      {Q | ((Q : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ∩ {OnePoint.infty}).Nonempty}
    have hCclosed : IsClosed C :=
      TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isClosed_inter_nonempty_of_isClosed
        isClosed_singleton
    have hKC : K ∈ C := hCclosed.mem_of_tendsto hlim (by
      filter_upwards [] with n
      refine ⟨OnePoint.infty, ?_, Set.mem_singleton OnePoint.infty⟩
      simp [Kseq, Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
        Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification])
    simpa [C] using hKC
  let L : Set Tiling.Plane :=
    {x | (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane) ∈ (K : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane))}
  have hLclosed : IsClosed L := by
    exact K.isCompact.isClosed.preimage OnePoint.continuous_coe
  have hK : Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification L hLclosed = K := by
    apply TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.ext
    ext z
    refine OnePoint.rec ?_ (fun x ↦ ?_) z
    · simp [Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
        Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification, hinfty]
    · simp [Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
        Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification, L]
  have hLseparated :
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.IsUniformlySeparated delta L := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    by_contra hdist
    have hdist_lt : dist x y < delta := lt_of_not_ge hdist
    have hxy_dist : 0 < dist x y := dist_pos.mpr hxy
    let eps : ℝ := min ((delta - dist x y) / 4) (dist x y / 4)
    have heps : 0 < eps := by
      dsimp [eps]
      exact lt_min (by linarith [hdelta_pos]) (by linarith)
    let U : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
      (fun z : Tiling.Plane ↦ (z : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) '' Metric.ball x eps
    let V : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
      (fun z : Tiling.Plane ↦ (z : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) '' Metric.ball y eps
    have hUopen : IsOpen U := by
      exact OnePoint.isOpen_image_coe.mpr Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hVopen : IsOpen V := by
      exact OnePoint.isOpen_image_coe.mpr Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hxK : (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane) ∈ (K : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) := hx
    have hyK : (y : OnePoint Tiling.Plane) ∈ (K : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) := hy
    have hKhitU : ((K : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ∩ U).Nonempty :=
      ⟨x, hxK, ⟨x, Metric.mem_ball_self heps, rfl⟩⟩
    have hKhitV : ((K : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ∩ V).Nonempty :=
      ⟨y, hyK, ⟨y, Metric.mem_ball_self heps, rfl⟩⟩
    have hEventuallyU : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop,
        (((Kseq ∘ phi) n : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ∩ U).Nonempty :=
      hlim.eventually
        ((TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen hUopen).mem_nhds
          hKhitU)
    have hEventuallyV : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop,
        (((Kseq ∘ phi) n : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ∩ V).Nonempty :=
      hlim.eventually
        ((TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen hVopen).mem_nhds
          hKhitV)
    obtain ⟨n, hnU, hnV⟩ := (hEventuallyU.and hEventuallyV).exists
    obtain ⟨zu, hzuK, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩⟩ := hnU
    obtain ⟨zv, hzvK, ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩⟩ := hnV
    have haS : a ∈ S (phi n) := by
      simpa [Kseq, Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
        Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification] using hzuK
    have hbS : b ∈ S (phi n) := by
      simpa [Kseq, Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
        Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification] using hzvK
    have hab : a ≠ b := by
      intro hab
      subst b
      have hxa : dist x a < eps := by
        rw [dist_comm]
        exact ha
      have hay : dist a y < eps := hb
      have heps_le : eps ≤ dist x y / 4 := min_le_right _ _
      have htri : dist x y ≤ dist x a + dist a y := dist_triangle _ _ _
      linarith
    have hsep := hseparated (phi n) haS hbS hab
    have hax : dist a x < eps := by simpa [dist_comm] using ha
    have hyb : dist y b < eps := by simpa [dist_comm] using hb
    have heps_le : eps ≤ (delta - dist x y) / 4 := min_le_left _ _
    have hab_lt : dist a b < delta := by
      calc
        dist a b ≤ dist a x + dist x y + dist y b := dist_triangle4 _ _ _ _
        _ < eps + dist x y + eps := by linarith
        _ < delta := by linarith
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hsep) hab_lt
  refine ⟨phi, L, hphi, hLclosed, hLseparated, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨fun n ↦ hclosed (phi n), hLclosed, ?_⟩
  rw [hK]
  change Filter.Tendsto (Kseq ∘ phi) Filter.atTop (nhds K)
  exact hlim

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.translatedVertexLevels_countable
statement:
private theorem translatedVertexLevels_countable
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S)) (axis : Axis) :
    (translatedVertexLevels K S axis).Countable
proof:
:= by
  have hS : S.Countable := (IsPacking.locallyFinite_centres hpacking).2
  have hV : K.vertices.Countable := by
    rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]
    exact K.vertexFinset.finite_toSet.countable
  let _ : Countable S := hS.to_subtype
  let _ : Countable ↥K.vertices := hV.to_subtype
  exact Set.countable_range _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.eventually_avoids_translatedVertexLevels
statement:
private theorem eventually_avoids_translatedVertexLevels
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S)) (axis : Axis) :
    ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume, q ∉ translatedVertexLevels K S axis
proof:
:= by
  exact (translatedVertexLevels_countable hpacking axis).ae_notMem volume

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.continuous_slicePoint
statement:
private theorem continuous_slicePoint (axis : Axis) (q : ℝ) :
    Continuous (slicePoint axis q)
proof:
:= by
  cases axis <;> unfold slicePoint <;> fun_prop

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.locallyFinite_placedSupportSlice
statement:
private theorem locallyFinite_placedSupportSlice
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S)) (axis : Axis) (q : ℝ) :
    LocallyFinite (fun t : S ↦ placedSupportSlice K axis q t.1)
proof:
:= by
  let P := K.polygonalProtoTiling S
  let toPlacement : S → P.placements := fun s => ⟨(s, ()), s.2⟩
  have htoPlacement : Function.Injective toPlacement := by
    intro s t hst
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun i : P.placements ↦ i.1.1) hst)
  have hloc : LocallyFinite (fun s : S ↦ (s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support) := by
    exact (P.locallyFinite_placedTile hpacking).comp_injective htoPlacement
  exact hloc.preimage_continuous (continuous_slicePoint axis q)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.locallyFinite_placedOpenSlice
statement:
private theorem locallyFinite_placedOpenSlice
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S)) (axis : Axis) (q : ℝ) :
    LocallyFinite (fun t : S ↦ placedOpenSlice K axis q t.1)
proof:
:= by
  exact (locallyFinite_placedSupportSlice hpacking axis q).subset fun t =>
    preimage_mono (vadd_set_mono interior_subset)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.frontier_iUnion_subset_iUnion_frontier
statement:
theorem frontier_iUnion_subset_iUnion_frontier
    {ι X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {f : ι → Set X}
    (hloc : LocallyFinite f) :
    frontier (⋃ i, f i) ⊆ ⋃ i, frontier (f i)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxcl : x ∈ closure (⋃ i, f i) := frontier_subset_closure hx
  rw [hloc.closure_iUnion] at hxcl
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxcl
  apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  rw [frontier]
  refine ⟨hxi, ?_⟩
  intro hxint
  exact disjoint_interior_frontier.le_bot ⟨interior_mono (subset_iUnion f i) hxint, hx⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.sliceFiber_eq_iUnion_placedOpenSlice
statement:
private theorem sliceFiber_eq_iUnion_placedOpenSlice
    (K : Region) (S : Set Tiling.Plane) (axis : Axis) (q : ℝ) :
    {x : ℝ | slicePoint axis q x ∈ openUnion K S} =
      ⋃ t : S, placedOpenSlice K axis q t.1
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier.eq_def,
    Set.mem_iUnion, placedOpenSlice, Set.mem_preimage]
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.sliceEndpointSet_subset_tileFrontiers
statement:
private theorem sliceEndpointSet_subset_tileFrontiers
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S)) (axis : Axis) (q : ℝ) :
    sliceEndpointSet K S axis q ⊆
      ⋃ t : S, frontier (placedOpenSlice K axis q t.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sliceEndpointSet, sliceFiber_eq_iUnion_placedOpenSlice]
  exact frontier_iUnion_subset_iUnion_frontier
    (locallyFinite_placedOpenSlice hpacking axis q)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.frontier_finite_of_finiteIntervalRegion
statement:
private theorem frontier_finite_of_finiteIntervalRegion
    {B : Set ℝ} (hB : Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.IsFiniteIntervalRegion B) :
    (frontier B).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, a, b, hab, rfl⟩ := hB
  apply (Set.finite_iUnion fun i : Fin n => Set.toFinite {a i, b i}).subset
  intro x hx
  have hx' := frontier_iUnion_subset_iUnion_frontier
    (locallyFinite_of_finite fun i : Fin n => Ioo (a i) (b i)) hx
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx'
  apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  rw [frontier_Ioo (hab i)] at hxi
  exact hxi

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.isFiniteIntervalRegion_vadd
statement:
private theorem isFiniteIntervalRegion_vadd
    {B : Set ℝ} (hB : Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.IsFiniteIntervalRegion B)
    (c : ℝ) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.IsFiniteIntervalRegion (c +ᵥ B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, a, b, hab, rfl⟩ := hB
  refine ⟨n, fun i => c + a i, fun i => c + b i,
    fun i => add_lt_add_right (hab i) c, ?_⟩
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add, Set.mem_iUnion,
    Set.mem_Ioo]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨i, by constructor <;> linarith [hi.1, hi.2]⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨i, by constructor <;> linarith [hi.1, hi.2]⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.isFiniteIntervalRegion_isBounded
statement:
private theorem isFiniteIntervalRegion_isBounded
    {B : Set ℝ} (hB : Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.IsFiniteIntervalRegion B) :
    Bornology.IsBounded B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, a, b, _, rfl⟩ := hB
  rw [Bornology.isBounded_iUnion]
  exact fun i => Metric.isBounded_Ioo (a i) (b i)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.placedOpenSlice_frontier_finite
statement:
private theorem placedOpenSlice_frontier_finite
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane} {axis : Axis} {q : ℝ}
    (hq : q ∉ translatedVertexLevels K S axis) (t : S) :
    (frontier (placedOpenSlice K axis q t.1)).Finite
proof:
:= by
  cases axis with
  | horizontal =>
      have hgeneric : q - t.1.im ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.im := by
        intro h
        obtain ⟨v, hv, hvq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
        apply hq
        rw [translatedVertexLevels]
        refine ⟨(t, ⟨v, ?_⟩), ?_⟩
        · rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]
          exact hv
        · simp only [Axis.transverseCoord, Complex.add_im]
          linarith [hvq]
      have hfinite := horizontalSlice_isFiniteIntervalRegion K hgeneric
      have heq : placedOpenSlice K Axis.horizontal q t.1 =
          t.1.re +ᵥ
            horizontalSlice K
              (q - t.1.im) := by
        ext x
        simp only [placedOpenSlice, slicePoint, Set.mem_preimage,
          horizontalSlice,
          Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
        constructor <;> intro hx
        · convert hx using 1
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
        · convert hx using 1
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
      rw [heq]
      exact frontier_finite_of_finiteIntervalRegion
        (isFiniteIntervalRegion_vadd hfinite t.1.re)
  | vertical =>
      have hgeneric : q - t.1.re ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re := by
        intro h
        obtain ⟨v, hv, hvq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
        apply hq
        rw [translatedVertexLevels]
        refine ⟨(t, ⟨v, ?_⟩), ?_⟩
        · rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]
          exact hv
        · simp only [Axis.transverseCoord, Complex.add_re]
          linarith [hvq]
      have hfinite := verticalSlice_isFiniteIntervalRegion K hgeneric
      have heq : placedOpenSlice K Axis.vertical q t.1 =
          t.1.im +ᵥ
            verticalSlice K
              (q - t.1.re) := by
        ext x
        simp only [placedOpenSlice, slicePoint, Set.mem_preimage,
          verticalSlice,
          Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
        constructor <;> intro hx
        · convert hx using 1
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
        · convert hx using 1
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
      rw [heq]
      exact frontier_finite_of_finiteIntervalRegion
        (isFiniteIntervalRegion_vadd hfinite t.1.im)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.frontier_placedOpenSlice_subset_support
statement:
private theorem frontier_placedOpenSlice_subset_support
    (K : Region) (axis : Axis) (q : ℝ) (t : Tiling.Plane) :
    frontier (placedOpenSlice K axis q t) ⊆ placedSupportSlice K axis q t
proof:
:= by
  apply frontier_subset_closure.trans
  apply closure_minimal
  · exact preimage_mono (vadd_set_mono interior_subset)
  · exact ((K.isPolygonal.isClosed.vadd t).preimage
      (continuous_slicePoint axis q))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.genericSliceEndpointSet_locallyFinite
statement:
theorem genericSliceEndpointSet_locallyFinite :
    ∀ (K : Region) (S : Set Tiling.Plane), TilesOn K S univ →
      ∀ axis : Axis, ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume,
        ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q →
          (sliceEndpointSet K S axis q ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  intro K S hTile axis
  filter_upwards [eventually_avoids_translatedVertexLevels hTile.2.1 axis] with q hq
  intro Q hQ
  obtain ⟨R, hQR⟩ := hQ.subset_closedBall (0 : ℝ)
  let C : Set ℝ := Metric.closedBall 0 R
  have hCcompact : IsCompact C := isCompact_closedBall 0 R
  have hloc := locallyFinite_placedSupportSlice hTile.2.1 axis q
  let active : Set S :=
    {t | (placedSupportSlice K axis q t.1 ∩ C).Nonempty}
  have hactive : active.Finite := by
    exact hloc.finite_nonempty_inter_compact hCcompact
  apply (hactive.biUnion fun t _ =>
    placedOpenSlice_frontier_finite hq t).subset
  rintro x ⟨hxEndpoint, hxQ⟩
  have hxTiles := sliceEndpointSet_subset_tileFrontiers hTile.2.1 axis q hxEndpoint
  obtain ⟨t, hxt⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxTiles
  refine Set.mem_biUnion ?_ hxt
  have hxSupport := frontier_placedOpenSlice_subset_support K axis q t.1 hxt
  exact ⟨x, hxSupport, hQR hxQ⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.eventually_sliceFiber_ae_univ
statement:
private theorem eventually_sliceFiber_ae_univ
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K S univ)
    (axis : Axis) :
    ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume,
      {x : ℝ | slicePoint axis q x ∈ openUnion K S} =ᵐ[volume] univ
proof:
:= by
  have hplane : ∀ᵐ z : Tiling.Plane ∂volume, z ∈ openUnion K S := by
    filter_upwards [hTile.2.2] with z hz
    change z ∈ (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane) ↔ ∃ t : S,
      z ∈ (t.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier at hz
    simpa only [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier.eq_def,
      Set.mem_iUnion] using hz.mp (Set.mem_univ z)
  have hpull :=
    Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.symm.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hplane
  cases axis with
  | vertical =>
      have hslices := MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod
        (μ := volume) (ν := volume) hpull
      filter_upwards [hslices] with q hq
      filter_upwards [hq] with x hx
      apply propext
      constructor
      · intro _
        exact Set.mem_univ x
      · intro _
        change slicePoint Axis.vertical q x ∈ openUnion K S
        have heq : slicePoint Axis.vertical q x =
            Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm (q, x) := by
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [slicePoint]
        rw [heq]
        exact hx
  | horizontal =>
      have hswap :=
        MeasureTheory.Measure.measurePreserving_swap.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hpull
      have hslices := MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod
        (μ := volume) (ν := volume) hswap
      filter_upwards [hslices] with q hq
      filter_upwards [hq] with x hx
      apply propext
      constructor
      · intro _
        exact Set.mem_univ x
      · intro _
        change slicePoint Axis.horizontal q x ∈ openUnion K S
        have heq : slicePoint Axis.horizontal q x =
            Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm (q, x).swap := by
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [slicePoint]
        rw [heq]
        exact hx

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.frontier_not_bddAbove_of_bounded_disjoint_openCover
statement:
private theorem frontier_not_bddAbove_of_bounded_disjoint_openCover
    {ι : Type*} {U : Set ℝ} {f : ι → Set ℝ}
    (hUae : U =ᵐ[volume] univ) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (f i))
    (hbdd : ∀ i, Bornology.IsBounded (f i))
    (hpair : Set.Pairwise Set.univ (Disjoint on f)) (hU : U = ⋃ i, f i) :
    ¬ BddAbove (frontier U)
proof:
:= by
  intro hfront
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hfront
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Ioi c) (frontier U) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxc hxf
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hc hxf)) hxc
  have htailCases :=
    Tiling.IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier
      isPreconnected_Ioi hdisj
  have htail : Ioi c ⊆ U := by
    rcases htailCases with hinside | houtside
    · exact hinside.trans interior_subset
    · exfalso
      have hcomp0 : volume Uᶜ = 0 := ae_eq_univ.mp hUae
      have hIoi0 : volume (Ioi c) = 0 := measure_mono_null
        (houtside.trans interior_subset) hcomp0
      exact (isOpen_Ioi.measure_ne_zero volume ⟨c + 1, by simp⟩) hIoi0
  have hxU : c + 1 ∈ U := htail (by simp)
  rw [hU, Set.mem_iUnion] at hxU
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxU
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (hbdd i).bddAbove
  let y := max c d + 1
  have hyTail : y ∈ Ioi c := by
    change c < y
    dsimp [y]
    linarith [le_max_left c d]
  have hyNot : y ∉ f i := by
    intro hy
    dsimp [y] at hyTail ⊢
    linarith [hd hy, le_max_right c d]
  let V : Set ℝ := ⋃ j : {j : ι // j ≠ i}, f j.1
  have hVopen : IsOpen V := isOpen_iUnion fun j => hopen j.1
  have hiV : Disjoint (f i) V := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzi hzV
    obtain ⟨j, hzj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hzV
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hpair (Set.mem_univ i) (Set.mem_univ j.1) j.2.symm) hzi hzj
  have htailCover : Ioi c ⊆ f i ∪ V := by
    intro z hz
    have hzU := htail hz
    rw [hU, Set.mem_iUnion] at hzU
    obtain ⟨j, hzj⟩ := hzU
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · exact Or.inl (hji ▸ hzj)
    · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨j, hji⟩, hzj⟩)
  rcases isPreconnected_Ioi.subset_or_subset (hopen i) hVopen hiV htailCover with hi | hV
  · exact hyNot (hi hyTail)
  · have hxNotV : c + 1 ∉ V := by
      intro hxV
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hiV hxi hxV
    exact hxNotV (hV (by simp))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.frontier_not_bddBelow_of_bounded_disjoint_openCover
statement:
private theorem frontier_not_bddBelow_of_bounded_disjoint_openCover
    {ι : Type*} {U : Set ℝ} {f : ι → Set ℝ}
    (hUae : U =ᵐ[volume] univ) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (f i))
    (hbdd : ∀ i, Bornology.IsBounded (f i))
    (hpair : Set.Pairwise Set.univ (Disjoint on f)) (hU : U = ⋃ i, f i) :
    ¬ BddBelow (frontier U)
proof:
:= by
  intro hbelow
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hbelow
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Iio c) (frontier U) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxc hxf
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hc hxf)) hxc
  have htailCases :=
    Tiling.IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier
      isPreconnected_Iio hdisj
  have htail : Iio c ⊆ U := by
    rcases htailCases with hinside | houtside
    · exact hinside.trans interior_subset
    · exfalso
      have hcomp0 : volume Uᶜ = 0 := ae_eq_univ.mp hUae
      have hIio0 : volume (Iio c) = 0 := measure_mono_null
        (houtside.trans interior_subset) hcomp0
      exact (isOpen_Iio.measure_ne_zero volume ⟨c - 1, by simp⟩) hIio0
  have hxU : c - 1 ∈ U := htail (by simp)
  rw [hU, Set.mem_iUnion] at hxU
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxU
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (hbdd i).bddBelow
  let y := min c d - 1
  have hyTail : y ∈ Iio c := by
    change y < c
    dsimp [y]
    linarith [min_le_left c d]
  have hyNot : y ∉ f i := by
    intro hy
    have hdy : d ≤ y := hd hy
    dsimp [y] at hdy
    linarith [min_le_right c d]
  let V : Set ℝ := ⋃ j : {j : ι // j ≠ i}, f j.1
  have hVopen : IsOpen V := isOpen_iUnion fun j => hopen j.1
  have hiV : Disjoint (f i) V := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzi hzV
    obtain ⟨j, hzj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hzV
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hpair (Set.mem_univ i) (Set.mem_univ j.1) j.2.symm) hzi hzj
  have htailCover : Iio c ⊆ f i ∪ V := by
    intro z hz
    have hzU := htail hz
    rw [hU, Set.mem_iUnion] at hzU
    obtain ⟨j, hzj⟩ := hzU
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · exact Or.inl (hji ▸ hzj)
    · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨j, hji⟩, hzj⟩)
  rcases isPreconnected_Iio.subset_or_subset (hopen i) hVopen hiV htailCover with hi | hV
  · exact hyNot (hi hyTail)
  · have hxNotV : c - 1 ∉ V := by
      intro hxV
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hiV hxi hxV
    exact hxNotV (hV (by simp))
