name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.genericSliceEndpointSet_unbounded
statement:
theorem genericSliceEndpointSet_unbounded :
    ∀ (K : Region) (S : Set Tiling.Plane), TilesOn K S univ →
      ∀ axis : Axis, ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume,
        ¬ BddAbove (sliceEndpointSet K S axis q) ∧
          ¬ BddBelow (sliceEndpointSet K S axis q)
proof:
:= by
  intro K S hTile axis
  filter_upwards [eventually_avoids_translatedVertexLevels hTile.2.1 axis,
    eventually_sliceFiber_ae_univ hTile axis] with q hq hfull
  let U : Set ℝ := {x | slicePoint axis q x ∈ openUnion K S}
  let f : S → Set ℝ := fun t => placedOpenSlice K axis q t.1
  have hU : U = ⋃ t, f t := sliceFiber_eq_iUnion_placedOpenSlice K S axis q
  have hopen : ∀ t, IsOpen (f t) := fun t =>
    (isOpen_interior.vadd t.1).preimage (continuous_slicePoint axis q)
  have hbdd : ∀ t, Bornology.IsBounded (f t) := fun t => by
    exact isFiniteIntervalRegion_isBounded
      (by
        cases axis with
        | horizontal =>
            have hgeneric : q - t.1.im ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.im := by
              intro h
              obtain ⟨v, hv, hvq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
              apply hq
              rw [translatedVertexLevels]
              refine ⟨(t, ⟨v, ?_⟩), ?_⟩
              · rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]
                exact hv
              · simp only [Axis.transverseCoord, Complex.add_im]
                linarith [hvq]
            have hfinite := horizontalSlice_isFiniteIntervalRegion K hgeneric
            have heq : f t = t.1.re +ᵥ
                horizontalSlice K
                  (q - t.1.im) := by
              change placedOpenSlice K Axis.horizontal q t.1 = _
              ext x
              simp only [placedOpenSlice, slicePoint, Set.mem_preimage,
                horizontalSlice,
                Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
              constructor <;> intro hx
              · convert hx using 1
                apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
              · convert hx using 1
                apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
            rw [heq]
            exact isFiniteIntervalRegion_vadd hfinite t.1.re
        | vertical =>
            have hgeneric : q - t.1.re ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re := by
              intro h
              obtain ⟨v, hv, hvq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
              apply hq
              rw [translatedVertexLevels]
              refine ⟨(t, ⟨v, ?_⟩), ?_⟩
              · rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]
                exact hv
              · simp only [Axis.transverseCoord, Complex.add_re]
                linarith [hvq]
            have hfinite := verticalSlice_isFiniteIntervalRegion K hgeneric
            have heq : f t = t.1.im +ᵥ
                verticalSlice K
                  (q - t.1.re) := by
              change placedOpenSlice K Axis.vertical q t.1 = _
              ext x
              simp only [placedOpenSlice, slicePoint, Set.mem_preimage,
                verticalSlice,
                Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
              constructor <;> intro hx
              · convert hx using 1
                apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
              · convert hx using 1
                apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
            rw [heq]
            exact isFiniteIntervalRegion_vadd hfinite t.1.im)
  have hpair : Set.Pairwise Set.univ (Disjoint on f) := by
    intro s _ t _ hst
    change Disjoint (f s) (f t)
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxs hxt
    have hp := (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K S).mp hTile.2.1
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mp (hp s.2 t.2 (fun h => hst (Subtype.ext h)))
    · exact hxs
    · exact hxt
  change ¬ BddAbove (frontier U) ∧ ¬ BddBelow (frontier U)
  exact ⟨frontier_not_bddAbove_of_bounded_disjoint_openCover
      hfull hopen hbdd hpair hU,
    frontier_not_bddBelow_of_bounded_disjoint_openCover
      hfull hopen hbdd hpair hU⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.openInterval_subset_of_ae_univ_of_disjoint_frontier
statement:
private theorem openInterval_subset_of_ae_univ_of_disjoint_frontier
    {U : Set ℝ} {l r : ℝ} (hlr : l < r) (hfull : U =ᵐ[volume] univ)
    (hdisj : Disjoint (Ioo l r) (frontier U)) : Ioo l r ⊆ U
proof:
:= by
  rcases Tiling.IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier
      isPreconnected_Ioo hdisj with hin | hout
  · exact hin.trans interior_subset
  · exfalso
    have hcomp0 : volume Uᶜ = 0 := ae_eq_univ.mp hfull
    have hIoo0 : volume (Ioo l r) = 0 :=
      measure_mono_null (hout.trans interior_subset) hcomp0
    exact (isOpen_Ioo.measure_ne_zero volume
      ⟨(l + r) / 2, by constructor <;> linarith⟩) hIoo0

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.one_member_contains_openInterval
statement:
private theorem one_member_contains_openInterval
    {I : Type*} {f : I → Set ℝ} {l r : ℝ} (hlr : l < r)
    (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (f i))
    (hpair : Set.Pairwise Set.univ (Disjoint on f))
    (hcover : Ioo l r ⊆ ⋃ i, f i) :
    ∃ i, Ioo l r ⊆ f i
proof:
:= by
  let m := (l + r) / 2
  have hm : m ∈ Ioo l r := by dsimp [m]; constructor <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨i, hmi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hcover hm)
  let V : Set ℝ := ⋃ j : {j : I // j ≠ i}, f j.1
  have hVopen : IsOpen V := isOpen_iUnion fun j => hopen j.1
  have hiV : Disjoint (f i) V := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzi hzV
    obtain ⟨j, hzj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hzV
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (hpair (Set.mem_univ i) (Set.mem_univ j.1) j.2.symm) hzi hzj
  have hcover' : Ioo l r ⊆ f i ∪ V := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨j, hzj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hcover hz)
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · exact Or.inl (hji ▸ hzj)
    · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨j, hji⟩, hzj⟩)
  rcases isPreconnected_Ioo.subset_or_subset (hopen i) hVopen hiV hcover' with hi | hV
  · exact ⟨i, hi⟩
  · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp hiV hmi (hV hm))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.endpoints_mem_frontier_of_interval_subset
statement:
private theorem endpoints_mem_frontier_of_interval_subset
    {U F : Set ℝ} {l r : ℝ} (hlr : l < r)
    (hl : l ∈ frontier U) (hr : r ∈ frontier U)
    (hFU : F ⊆ U) (hgap : Ioo l r ⊆ F) :
    l ∈ frontier F ∧ r ∈ frontier F
proof:
:= by
  have hcl : closure (Ioo l r) ⊆ closure F := closure_mono hgap
  have hends : Icc l r ⊆ closure F := by
    rwa [closure_Ioo (ne_of_lt hlr)] at hcl
  constructor <;> rw [frontier] <;> constructor
  · exact hends (left_mem_Icc.mpr (le_of_lt hlr))
  · intro hli
    exact disjoint_interior_frontier.le_bot
      ⟨interior_mono hFU hli, hl⟩
  · exact hends (right_mem_Icc.mpr (le_of_lt hlr))
  · intro hri
    exact disjoint_interior_frontier.le_bot
      ⟨interior_mono hFU hri, hr⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.filledGap
statement:
private theorem filledGap
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K S univ)
    {axis : Axis} {q l r : ℝ}
    (hq : q ∉ translatedVertexLevels K S axis)
    (hfull : {x : ℝ | slicePoint axis q x ∈ openUnion K S} =ᵐ[volume] univ)
    (hl : l ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q)
    (hr : r ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q) (hlr : l < r)
    (hnone : Disjoint (sliceEndpointSet K S axis q) (Ioo l r)) :
    ∃ t : S, ∃ v w : Tiling.Plane, v ∈ K.vertices ∧ w ∈ K.vertices ∧
      l = axis.coord (v + t.1) ∧ r = axis.coord (w + t.1) ∧
      0 < axis.coord (w - v) ∧ axisInterval axis q l r ⊆ t.1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set ℝ := {x | slicePoint axis q x ∈ openUnion K S}
  let f : S → Set ℝ := fun t => placedOpenSlice K axis q t.1
  have hU : U = ⋃ t, f t := sliceFiber_eq_iUnion_placedOpenSlice K S axis q
  have hopen : ∀ t, IsOpen (f t) := fun t =>
    (isOpen_interior.vadd t.1).preimage (continuous_slicePoint axis q)
  have hpair : Set.Pairwise Set.univ (Disjoint on f) := by
    intro s _ t _ hst
    change Disjoint (f s) (f t)
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxs hxt
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
      ((isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K S).mp hTile.2.1 s.2 t.2
        (fun h => hst (Subtype.ext h))) hxs hxt
  have hgapU : Ioo l r ⊆ U :=
    openInterval_subset_of_ae_univ_of_disjoint_frontier hlr hfull (by
      simpa [sliceEndpointSet, U] using hnone.symm)
  obtain ⟨t, hgap⟩ := one_member_contains_openInterval hlr hopen hpair
    (hgapU.trans_eq hU)
  have hfront : l ∈ frontier (f t) ∧ r ∈ frontier (f t) :=
    endpoints_mem_frontier_of_interval_subset hlr hl hr
      (by
        intro x hx
        change x ∈ U
        rw [hU]
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨t, hx⟩) hgap
  cases axis with
  | horizontal =>
      have hgeneric : q - t.1.im ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.im := by
        intro h
        obtain ⟨v, hv, hvq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
        apply hq
        refine ⟨(t, ⟨v, ?_⟩), ?_⟩
        · rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]; exact hv
        · simp only [Axis.transverseCoord, Complex.add_im]
          linarith [hvq]
      have heq : f t = t.1.re +ᵥ
          horizontalSlice K (q - t.1.im) := by
        ext x
        simp only [f, placedOpenSlice, slicePoint, Set.mem_preimage,
          horizontalSlice,
          Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
        constructor <;> intro hx
        · convert hx using 1; apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
        · convert hx using 1; apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
      have hgap' : Ioo (l - t.1.re) (r - t.1.re) ⊆
          horizontalSlice K (q - t.1.im) := by
        intro x hx
        have := hgap (show x + t.1.re ∈ Ioo l r by constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2])
        rw [heq] at this
        simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using this
      have hf' : l - t.1.re ∈ frontier
            (horizontalSlice K (q - t.1.im)) ∧
          r - t.1.re ∈ frontier
            (horizontalSlice K (q - t.1.im)) := by
        rw [heq] at hfront
        have htranslate := (Homeomorph.addLeft t.1.re).image_frontier
          (horizontalSlice K (q - t.1.im))
        simp only [Homeomorph.coe_addLeft, ← vadd_eq_add, Set.image_vadd] at htranslate
        rw [← htranslate] at hfront
        simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg,
          add_comm] using hfront
      obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw⟩ := horizontalSlice_componentEndpoints K hgeneric
        (by linarith) hgap' hf'.1 hf'.2
      refine ⟨t, v.1, w.1, v.2, w.2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [Axis.coord, Complex.add_re]; linarith [hv]
      · simp only [Axis.coord, Complex.add_re]; linarith [hw]
      · simp only [Axis.coord, Complex.sub_re]; linarith [hv, hw, hlr]
      · intro z hz
        have := hgap hz.2
        change slicePoint Axis.horizontal q z.re ∈ t.1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier at this
        convert this using 1
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [slicePoint, hz.1]
  | vertical =>
      have hgeneric : q - t.1.re ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re := by
        intro h
        obtain ⟨v, hv, hvq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
        apply hq
        refine ⟨(t, ⟨v, ?_⟩), ?_⟩
        · rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]; exact hv
        · simp only [Axis.transverseCoord, Complex.add_re]
          linarith [hvq]
      have heq : f t = t.1.im +ᵥ
          verticalSlice K (q - t.1.re) := by
        ext x
        simp only [f, placedOpenSlice, slicePoint, Set.mem_preimage,
          verticalSlice,
          Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
        constructor <;> intro hx
        · convert hx using 1; apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
        · convert hx using 1; apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
      have hgap' : Ioo (l - t.1.im) (r - t.1.im) ⊆
          verticalSlice K (q - t.1.re) := by
        intro x hx
        have := hgap (show x + t.1.im ∈ Ioo l r by constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2])
        rw [heq] at this
        simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using this
      have hf' : l - t.1.im ∈ frontier
            (verticalSlice K (q - t.1.re)) ∧
          r - t.1.im ∈ frontier
            (verticalSlice K (q - t.1.re)) := by
        rw [heq] at hfront
        have htranslate := (Homeomorph.addLeft t.1.im).image_frontier
          (verticalSlice K (q - t.1.re))
        simp only [Homeomorph.coe_addLeft, ← vadd_eq_add, Set.image_vadd] at htranslate
        rw [← htranslate] at hfront
        simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg,
          add_comm] using hfront
      obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw⟩ := verticalSlice_componentEndpoints K hgeneric
        (by linarith) hgap' hf'.1 hf'.2
      refine ⟨t, v.1, w.1, v.2, w.2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [Axis.coord, Complex.add_im]; linarith [hv]
      · simp only [Axis.coord, Complex.add_im]; linarith [hw]
      · simp only [Axis.coord, Complex.sub_im]; linarith [hv, hw, hlr]
      · intro z hz
        have := hgap hz.2
        change slicePoint Axis.vertical q z.im ∈ t.1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier at this
        convert this using 1
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [slicePoint, hz.1]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints_with_endpoints
statement:
theorem genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints_with_endpoints :
    ∀ (K : Region) (S : Set Tiling.Plane), TilesOn K S univ →
      ∀ axis : Axis, ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume,
        ∀ a ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q,
          ∀ b ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q, a < b →
            ∃ (n : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
              (owner : Fin n → S), x 0 = a ∧ x (Fin.last n) = b ∧
                IsFilledIndexedSliceChain K S axis q x owner ∧
                (∀ i, x i ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro K S hTile axis
  filter_upwards [eventually_avoids_translatedVertexLevels hTile.2.1 axis,
    eventually_sliceFiber_ae_univ hTile axis,
    genericSliceEndpointSet_locallyFinite K S hTile axis] with q hq hfull hlocal
  intro a ha b hb hab
  let E := sliceEndpointSet K S axis q
  let endpoints : Finset ℝ :=
    (hlocal (Icc a b) (Metric.isBounded_Icc a b)).toFinset
  have haS : a ∈ endpoints := by simp [endpoints, ha, hab.le]
  have hbS : b ∈ endpoints := by simp [endpoints, hb, hab.le]
  have hcard : 0 < endpoints.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨a, haS⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hncard⟩ : ∃ n, endpoints.card = n + 1 :=
    ⟨endpoints.card - 1, (Nat.sub_add_cancel hcard).symm⟩
  let e : Fin (n + 1) ≃o endpoints := Finset.orderIsoOfFin endpoints hncard
  let x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun i => (e i : ℝ)
  have hxmem (i : Fin (n + 1)) : x i ∈ endpoints := (e i).property
  have hxE (i : Fin (n + 1)) : x i ∈ E := by
    exact (show x i ∈ E ∩ Icc a b by simpa [endpoints] using hxmem i).1
  have hfirst : x 0 = a := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.surjective ⟨a, haS⟩
      have hei : (e i : ℝ) = a := congrArg Subtype.val hi
      rw [← hei]
      exact_mod_cast e.monotone (Fin.zero_le i)
    · exact (show x 0 ∈ E ∩ Icc a b by simpa [endpoints] using hxmem 0).2.1
  have hlast : x (Fin.last n) = b := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact (show x (Fin.last n) ∈ E ∩ Icc a b by
        simpa [endpoints] using hxmem (Fin.last n)).2.2
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.surjective ⟨b, hbS⟩
      have hei : (e i : ℝ) = b := congrArg Subtype.val hi
      rw [← hei]
      exact_mod_cast e.monotone (Fin.le_last i)
  have hn : 0 < n := by
    by_contra hn0
    have hnz : n = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hn0
    subst n
    have hz : (0 : Fin 1) = Fin.last 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    linarith [hfirst, hlast, congrArg x hz]
  have hlt (i : Fin n) : x i.castSucc < x i.succ :=
    e.strictMono Fin.castSucc_lt_succ
  have hnone (i : Fin n) : Disjoint E (Ioo (x i.castSucc) (x i.succ)) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzE hzI
    have hzS : z ∈ endpoints := by
      simp only [endpoints, Finite.mem_toFinset]
      refine ⟨hzE, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · exact le_trans
          (show a ≤ x i.castSucc from
            (show x i.castSucc ∈ E ∩ Icc a b by
              simpa [endpoints] using hxmem i.castSucc).2.1) hzI.1.le
      · exact le_trans hzI.2.le
          (show x i.succ ≤ b from
            (show x i.succ ∈ E ∩ Icc a b by
              simpa [endpoints] using hxmem i.succ).2.2)
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := e.surjective ⟨z, hzS⟩
    have hij : i.castSucc < j := (e.lt_iff_lt).mp (by
      change (e i.castSucc : ℝ) < (e j : ℝ)
      simpa [hj] using hzI.1)
    have hji : j < i.succ := (e.lt_iff_lt).mp (by
      change (e j : ℝ) < (e i.succ : ℝ)
      simpa [hj] using hzI.2)
    have hij' : i.val < j.val := by exact_mod_cast hij
    have hji' : j.val < i.val + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hji
    omega
  have hfilled (i : Fin n) := filledGap hTile hq hfull
    (hxE i.castSucc) (hxE i.succ) (hlt i) (hnone i)
  let owner : Fin n → S := fun i => (hfilled i).choose
  refine ⟨n, hn, x, owner, hfirst, hlast, ⟨e.strictMono, ?_⟩, hxE⟩
  intro i
  simpa only [owner] using (hfilled i).choose_spec

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints
statement:
theorem genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints :
    ∀ (K : Region) (S : Set Tiling.Plane), TilesOn K S univ →
      ∀ axis : Axis, ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume,
        ∀ a ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q,
          ∀ b ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q, a < b →
            ∃ (n : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
              (owner : Fin n → S), x 0 = a ∧ x (Fin.last n) = b ∧
                IsFilledIndexedSliceChain K S axis q x owner
proof:
:= by
  intro K S hTile axis
  filter_upwards [genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints_with_endpoints K S hTile axis]
    with q hq
  intro a ha b hb hab
  obtain ⟨n, hn, x, owner, hfirst, hlast, hchain, _hendpoints⟩ :=
    hq a ha b hb hab
  exact ⟨n, hn, x, owner, hfirst, hlast, hchain⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.genericIndexedSliceChain_with_endpoints
statement:
theorem genericIndexedSliceChain_with_endpoints :
    ∀ (K : Region) (S : Set Tiling.Plane), TilesOn K S univ →
      ∀ axis : Axis, ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume,
        ∀ a b : ℝ, a < b →
          ∃ (n : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
            (owner : Fin n → S),
            x 0 ≤ a ∧ b ≤ x (Fin.last n) ∧
              IsFilledIndexedSliceChain K S axis q x owner ∧
              (∀ i, x i ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q)
proof:
:= by
  intro K S hTile axis
  filter_upwards [genericSliceEndpointSet_unbounded K S hTile axis,
    genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints_with_endpoints K S hTile axis]
      with q hunbounded hbetween
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨l, hlE, hla⟩ := not_bddBelow_iff.mp hunbounded.2 a
  obtain ⟨r, hrE, hbr⟩ := not_bddAbove_iff.mp hunbounded.1 b
  obtain ⟨n, hn, x, owner, hx0, hxlast, hchain, hendpoints⟩ :=
    hbetween l hlE r hrE (lt_trans hla (lt_trans hab hbr))
  refine ⟨n, hn, x, owner, ?_, ?_, hchain, hendpoints⟩
  · rw [hx0]
    exact hla.le
  · rw [hxlast]
    exact hbr.le

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.genericIndexedSliceChain
statement:
theorem genericIndexedSliceChain :
    ∀ (K : Region) (S : Set Tiling.Plane), TilesOn K S univ →
      ∀ axis : Axis, ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume,
        ∀ a b : ℝ, a < b →
          ∃ (n : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
            (owner : Fin n → S),
            x 0 ≤ a ∧ b ≤ x (Fin.last n) ∧
              IsFilledIndexedSliceChain K S axis q x owner
proof:
:= by
  intro K S hTile axis
  filter_upwards [genericIndexedSliceChain_with_endpoints K S hTile axis] with q hq
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨n, hn, x, owner, hleft, hright, hchain, _hendpoints⟩ := hq a b hab
  exact ⟨n, hn, x, owner, hleft, hright, hchain⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.genericSliceEndpointSet_locallyFinite_fixed
statement:
theorem genericSliceEndpointSet_locallyFinite_fixed
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane} {axis : Axis} {q : ℝ}
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S))
    (hq : q ∉ translatedVertexLevels K S axis) :
    ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q →
      (sliceEndpointSet K S axis q ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQ
  obtain ⟨R, hQR⟩ := hQ.subset_closedBall (0 : ℝ)
  let C : Set ℝ := Metric.closedBall 0 R
  have hCcompact : IsCompact C := isCompact_closedBall 0 R
  have hloc := locallyFinite_placedSupportSlice hpacking axis q
  let active : Set S :=
    {t | (placedSupportSlice K axis q t.1 ∩ C).Nonempty}
  have hactive : active.Finite := by
    exact hloc.finite_nonempty_inter_compact hCcompact
  apply (hactive.biUnion fun t _ => placedOpenSlice_frontier_finite hq t).subset
  rintro x ⟨hxEndpoint, hxQ⟩
  have hxTiles := sliceEndpointSet_subset_tileFrontiers hpacking axis q hxEndpoint
  obtain ⟨t, hxt⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxTiles
  refine Set.mem_biUnion ?_ hxt
  have hxSupport := frontier_placedOpenSlice_subset_support K axis q t.1 hxt
  exact ⟨x, hxSupport, hQR hxQ⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.genericSliceEndpointSet_locallyFinite_of_packing
statement:
private theorem genericSliceEndpointSet_locallyFinite_of_packing
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S)) (axis : Axis) :
    ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume,
      ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q →
        (sliceEndpointSet K S axis q ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_avoids_translatedVertexLevels hpacking axis] with q hq
  exact genericSliceEndpointSet_locallyFinite_fixed hpacking hq

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.exists_mem_Ioo_of_ae_real
proof:
:= by
  have hμ : volume.restrict (Ioo a b) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have : volume (Ioo a b) = 0 := by
      rw [← Measure.restrict_apply_univ (Ioo a b), hz]
      simp
    rw [Real.volume_Ioo] at this
    simp [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero, not_le.mpr (sub_pos.mpr hab)] at this
  let hne : (ae (volume.restrict (Ioo a b))).NeBot := ae_neBot.mpr hμ
  have hp' : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (Ioo a b), P x :=
    hP.filter_mono ae_restrict_le
  rcases @Filter.Eventually.exists ℝ _ (ae (volume.restrict (Ioo a b))) hne
      (hp'.and (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo)) with ⟨x, hp, hx⟩
  exact ⟨x, hx, hp⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.openInterval_subset_of_local_ae
statement:
private theorem openInterval_subset_of_local_ae
    {U : Set ℝ} {l r : ℝ} (hlr : l < r)
    (hfull : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ Ioo l r → x ∈ U)
    (hdisj : Disjoint (Ioo l r) (frontier U)) : Ioo l r ⊆ U
proof:
:= by
  rcases Tiling.IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier
      isPreconnected_Ioo hdisj with hin | hout
  · exact hin.trans interior_subset
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hUx⟩ := exists_mem_Ioo_of_ae_real hlr hfull
    exact False.elim ((interior_subset (hout hx)) (hUx hx))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.filledGap_of_local_ae
statement:
theorem filledGap_of_local_ae
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S)) {axis : Axis} {q l r : ℝ}
    (hq : q ∉ translatedVertexLevels K S axis)
    (hfull : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume,
      x ∈ Ioo l r → slicePoint axis q x ∈ openUnion K S)
    (hl : l ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q)
    (hr : r ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q) (hlr : l < r)
    (hnone : Disjoint (sliceEndpointSet K S axis q) (Ioo l r)) :
    ∃ t : S, ∃ v w : Tiling.Plane, v ∈ K.vertices ∧ w ∈ K.vertices ∧
      l = axis.coord (v + t.1) ∧ r = axis.coord (w + t.1) ∧
      0 < axis.coord (w - v) ∧
      axisInterval axis q l r ⊆ t.1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set ℝ := {x | slicePoint axis q x ∈ openUnion K S}
  let f : S → Set ℝ := fun t => placedOpenSlice K axis q t.1
  have hU : U = ⋃ t, f t := sliceFiber_eq_iUnion_placedOpenSlice K S axis q
  have hopen : ∀ t, IsOpen (f t) := fun t =>
    (isOpen_interior.vadd t.1).preimage (continuous_slicePoint axis q)
  have hpair : Set.Pairwise Set.univ (Disjoint on f) := by
    intro s _ t _ hst
    change Disjoint (f s) (f t)
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxs hxt
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
      ((isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K S).mp
        hpacking s.2 t.2 (fun h => hst (Subtype.ext h))) hxs hxt
  have hgapU : Ioo l r ⊆ U := by
    apply openInterval_subset_of_local_ae hlr
      (by simpa [U] using hfull)
    simpa [sliceEndpointSet, U] using hnone.symm
  obtain ⟨t, hgap⟩ := one_member_contains_openInterval hlr hopen hpair
    (hgapU.trans_eq hU)
  have hfront : l ∈ frontier (f t) ∧ r ∈ frontier (f t) :=
    endpoints_mem_frontier_of_interval_subset hlr hl hr
      (by
        intro x hx
        change x ∈ U
        rw [hU]
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨t, hx⟩) hgap
  cases axis with
  | horizontal =>
      have hgeneric : q - t.1.im ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.im := by
        intro h
        obtain ⟨v, hv, hvq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
        apply hq
        refine ⟨(t, ⟨v, ?_⟩), ?_⟩
        · rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]; exact hv
        · simp only [Axis.transverseCoord, Complex.add_im]
          linarith [hvq]
      have heq : f t = t.1.re +ᵥ horizontalSlice K (q - t.1.im) := by
        ext x
        simp only [f, placedOpenSlice, slicePoint, Set.mem_preimage,
          horizontalSlice, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
          Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
        constructor <;> intro hx
        · convert hx using 1
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
        · convert hx using 1
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
      have hgap' : Ioo (l - t.1.re) (r - t.1.re) ⊆
          horizontalSlice K (q - t.1.im) := by
        intro x hx
        have hx' := hgap (show x + t.1.re ∈ Ioo l r by
          constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2])
        rw [heq] at hx'
        simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hx'
      have hf' : l - t.1.re ∈ frontier
            (horizontalSlice K (q - t.1.im)) ∧
          r - t.1.re ∈ frontier (horizontalSlice K (q - t.1.im)) := by
        rw [heq] at hfront
        have htranslate := (Homeomorph.addLeft t.1.re).image_frontier
          (horizontalSlice K (q - t.1.im))
        simp only [Homeomorph.coe_addLeft, ← vadd_eq_add, Set.image_vadd] at htranslate
        rw [← htranslate] at hfront
        simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
          sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hfront
      obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw⟩ := horizontalSlice_componentEndpoints K hgeneric
        (by linarith) hgap' hf'.1 hf'.2
      refine ⟨t, v.1, w.1, v.2, w.2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [Axis.coord, Complex.add_re]; linarith [hv]
      · simp only [Axis.coord, Complex.add_re]; linarith [hw]
      · simp only [Axis.coord, Complex.sub_re]; linarith [hv, hw, hlr]
      · intro z hz
        have hz' := hgap hz.2
        change slicePoint Axis.horizontal q z.re ∈ t.1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier at hz'
        convert hz' using 1
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [slicePoint, hz.1]
  | vertical =>
      have hgeneric : q - t.1.re ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re := by
        intro h
        obtain ⟨v, hv, hvq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
        apply hq
        refine ⟨(t, ⟨v, ?_⟩), ?_⟩
        · rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]; exact hv
        · simp only [Axis.transverseCoord, Complex.add_re]
          linarith [hvq]
      have heq : f t = t.1.im +ᵥ verticalSlice K (q - t.1.re) := by
        ext x
        simp only [f, placedOpenSlice, slicePoint, Set.mem_preimage,
          verticalSlice, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
          Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
        constructor <;> intro hx
        · convert hx using 1
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
        · convert hx using 1
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
      have hgap' : Ioo (l - t.1.im) (r - t.1.im) ⊆
          verticalSlice K (q - t.1.re) := by
        intro x hx
        have hx' := hgap (show x + t.1.im ∈ Ioo l r by
          constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2])
        rw [heq] at hx'
        simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hx'
      have hf' : l - t.1.im ∈ frontier
            (verticalSlice K (q - t.1.re)) ∧
          r - t.1.im ∈ frontier (verticalSlice K (q - t.1.re)) := by
        rw [heq] at hfront
        have htranslate := (Homeomorph.addLeft t.1.im).image_frontier
          (verticalSlice K (q - t.1.re))
        simp only [Homeomorph.coe_addLeft, ← vadd_eq_add, Set.image_vadd] at htranslate
        rw [← htranslate] at hfront
        simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
          sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hfront
      obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw⟩ := verticalSlice_componentEndpoints K hgeneric
        (by linarith) hgap' hf'.1 hf'.2
      refine ⟨t, v.1, w.1, v.2, w.2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [Axis.coord, Complex.add_im]; linarith [hv]
      · simp only [Axis.coord, Complex.add_im]; linarith [hw]
      · simp only [Axis.coord, Complex.sub_im]; linarith [hv, hw, hlr]
      · intro z hz
        have hz' := hgap hz.2
        change slicePoint Axis.vertical q z.im ∈ t.1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier at hz'
        convert hz' using 1
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [slicePoint, hz.1]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints_fixed_of_local_ae
statement:
theorem genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints_fixed_of_local_ae
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane} {axis : Axis} {q : ℝ}
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S))
    (hq : q ∉ translatedVertexLevels K S axis)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q)
    (hb : b ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q) (hab : a < b)
    (hfull : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume,
      x ∈ Ioo a b → slicePoint axis q x ∈ openUnion K S) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
      (owner : Fin n → S), x 0 = a ∧ x (Fin.last n) = b ∧
        IsFilledIndexedSliceChain K S axis q x owner ∧
        (∀ i, x i ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q)
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal := genericSliceEndpointSet_locallyFinite_fixed hpacking hq
  let E := sliceEndpointSet K S axis q
  let endpoints : Finset ℝ :=
    (hlocal (Icc a b) (Metric.isBounded_Icc a b)).toFinset
  have haS : a ∈ endpoints := by simp [endpoints, ha, hab.le]
  have hbS : b ∈ endpoints := by simp [endpoints, hb, hab.le]
  have hcard : 0 < endpoints.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨a, haS⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hncard⟩ : ∃ n, endpoints.card = n + 1 :=
    ⟨endpoints.card - 1, (Nat.sub_add_cancel hcard).symm⟩
  let e : Fin (n + 1) ≃o endpoints := Finset.orderIsoOfFin endpoints hncard
  let x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun i => (e i : ℝ)
  have hxmem (i : Fin (n + 1)) : x i ∈ endpoints := (e i).property
  have hxE (i : Fin (n + 1)) : x i ∈ E := by
    exact (show x i ∈ E ∩ Icc a b by simpa [endpoints] using hxmem i).1
  have hfirst : x 0 = a := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.surjective ⟨a, haS⟩
      have hei : (e i : ℝ) = a := congrArg Subtype.val hi
      rw [← hei]
      exact_mod_cast e.monotone (Fin.zero_le i)
    · exact (show x 0 ∈ E ∩ Icc a b by simpa [endpoints] using hxmem 0).2.1
  have hlast : x (Fin.last n) = b := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact (show x (Fin.last n) ∈ E ∩ Icc a b by
        simpa [endpoints] using hxmem (Fin.last n)).2.2
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.surjective ⟨b, hbS⟩
      have hei : (e i : ℝ) = b := congrArg Subtype.val hi
      rw [← hei]
      exact_mod_cast e.monotone (Fin.le_last i)
  have hn : 0 < n := by
    by_contra hn0
    have hnz : n = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hn0
    subst n
    have hz : (0 : Fin 1) = Fin.last 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    linarith [hfirst, hlast, congrArg x hz]
  have hlt (i : Fin n) : x i.castSucc < x i.succ :=
    e.strictMono Fin.castSucc_lt_succ
  have hnone (i : Fin n) : Disjoint E (Ioo (x i.castSucc) (x i.succ)) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzE hzI
    have hzS : z ∈ endpoints := by
      simp only [endpoints, Finite.mem_toFinset]
      refine ⟨hzE, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · exact le_trans
          (show a ≤ x i.castSucc from
            (show x i.castSucc ∈ E ∩ Icc a b by
              simpa [endpoints] using hxmem i.castSucc).2.1) hzI.1.le
      · exact le_trans hzI.2.le
          (show x i.succ ≤ b from
            (show x i.succ ∈ E ∩ Icc a b by
              simpa [endpoints] using hxmem i.succ).2.2)
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := e.surjective ⟨z, hzS⟩
    have hij : i.castSucc < j := (e.lt_iff_lt).mp (by
      change (e i.castSucc : ℝ) < (e j : ℝ)
      simpa [hj] using hzI.1)
    have hji : j < i.succ := (e.lt_iff_lt).mp (by
      change (e j : ℝ) < (e i.succ : ℝ)
      simpa [hj] using hzI.2)
    have hij' : i.val < j.val := by exact_mod_cast hij
    have hji' : j.val < i.val + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hji
    omega
  have hfilled (i : Fin n) := filledGap_of_local_ae hpacking hq
    (by
      filter_upwards [hfull] with y hy
      intro hyI
      apply hy
      have hxi : x i.castSucc ≤ y := le_of_lt hyI.1
      have hxs : y ≤ x i.succ := le_of_lt hyI.2
      exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt
          ((show x i.castSucc ∈ E ∩ Icc a b by
            simpa [endpoints] using hxmem i.castSucc).2.1) hyI.1,
        lt_of_lt_of_le hyI.2
          ((show x i.succ ∈ E ∩ Icc a b by
            simpa [endpoints] using hxmem i.succ).2.2)⟩)
      (hxE i.castSucc) (hxE i.succ) (hlt i) (hnone i)
  let owner : Fin n → S := fun i => (hfilled i).choose
  refine ⟨n, hn, x, owner, hfirst, hlast, ⟨e.strictMono, ?_⟩, hxE⟩
  intro i
  simpa only [owner] using (hfilled i).choose_spec

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints_of_local_ae
statement:
theorem genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints_of_local_ae :
    ∀ (K : Region) (S : Set Tiling.Plane),
      Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S) →
      ∀ axis : Axis, ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume,
        ∀ a ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q,
          ∀ b ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q, a < b →
            (∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume,
              x ∈ Ioo a b → slicePoint axis q x ∈ openUnion K S) →
            ∃ (n : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
              (owner : Fin n → S), x 0 = a ∧ x (Fin.last n) = b ∧
                IsFilledIndexedSliceChain K S axis q x owner ∧
                (∀ i, x i ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q)
proof:
:= by
  intro K S hpacking axis
  filter_upwards [eventually_avoids_translatedVertexLevels hpacking axis] with q hq
  intro a ha b hb hab hfull
  exact genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints_fixed_of_local_ae hpacking hq ha hb hab hfull

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.frontier_unbounded_of_ae_univ
statement:
theorem frontier_unbounded_of_ae_univ
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane} {axis : Axis} {q : ℝ}
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S))
    (hq : q ∉ translatedVertexLevels K S axis)
    (hfull : {x : ℝ | slicePoint axis q x ∈ openUnion K S} =ᵐ[volume] univ) :
    ¬ BddAbove (sliceEndpointSet K S axis q) ∧
      ¬ BddBelow (sliceEndpointSet K S axis q)
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set ℝ := {x : ℝ | slicePoint axis q x ∈ openUnion K S}
  let f : S → Set ℝ := fun t => placedOpenSlice K axis q t.1
  have hU : U = ⋃ t, f t := sliceFiber_eq_iUnion_placedOpenSlice K S axis q
  have hopen : ∀ t, IsOpen (f t) := fun t =>
    (isOpen_interior.vadd t.1).preimage (continuous_slicePoint axis q)
  have hbdd : ∀ t, Bornology.IsBounded (f t) := fun t => by
    cases axis with
    | horizontal =>
        have hgeneric : q - t.1.im ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.im := by
          intro h
          obtain ⟨v, hv, hvq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
          apply hq
          rw [translatedVertexLevels]
          refine ⟨(t, ⟨v, ?_⟩), ?_⟩
          · rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]
            exact hv
          · simp only [Axis.transverseCoord, Complex.add_im]
            linarith [hvq]
        have hfinite := horizontalSlice_isFiniteIntervalRegion K hgeneric
        have heq : f t = t.1.re +ᵥ horizontalSlice K (q - t.1.im) := by
          change placedOpenSlice K Axis.horizontal q t.1 = _
          ext x
          simp only [placedOpenSlice, slicePoint, Set.mem_preimage,
            horizontalSlice, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
            Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
          constructor <;> intro hx
          · convert hx using 1
            apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
          · convert hx using 1
            apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
        rw [heq]
        exact isFiniteIntervalRegion_isBounded
          (isFiniteIntervalRegion_vadd hfinite t.1.re)
    | vertical =>
        have hgeneric : q - t.1.re ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re := by
          intro h
          obtain ⟨v, hv, hvq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
          apply hq
          rw [translatedVertexLevels]
          refine ⟨(t, ⟨v, ?_⟩), ?_⟩
          · rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]
            exact hv
          · simp only [Axis.transverseCoord, Complex.add_re]
            linarith [hvq]
        have hfinite := verticalSlice_isFiniteIntervalRegion K hgeneric
        have heq : f t = t.1.im +ᵥ verticalSlice K (q - t.1.re) := by
          change placedOpenSlice K Axis.vertical q t.1 = _
          ext x
          simp only [placedOpenSlice, slicePoint, Set.mem_preimage,
            verticalSlice, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
            Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
          constructor <;> intro hx
          · convert hx using 1
            apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
          · convert hx using 1
            apply Complex.ext <;> simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
        rw [heq]
        exact isFiniteIntervalRegion_isBounded
          (isFiniteIntervalRegion_vadd hfinite t.1.im)
  have hpair : Set.Pairwise Set.univ (Disjoint on f) := by
    intro s _ t _ hst
    change Disjoint (f s) (f t)
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxs hxt
    have hp := (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K S).mp hpacking
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mp (hp s.2 t.2 (fun h => hst (Subtype.ext h)))
    · exact hxs
    · exact hxt
  change ¬ BddAbove (frontier U) ∧ ¬ BddBelow (frontier U)
  exact ⟨frontier_not_bddAbove_of_bounded_disjoint_openCover
      hfull hopen hbdd hpair hU,
    frontier_not_bddBelow_of_bounded_disjoint_openCover
      hfull hopen hbdd hpair hU⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.genericIndexedSliceChain_of_ae_univ
statement:
theorem genericIndexedSliceChain_of_ae_univ :
    ∀ (K : Region) (S : Set Tiling.Plane),
      Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S) →
      ∀ axis : Axis, ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume,
        ({x : ℝ | slicePoint axis q x ∈ openUnion K S} =ᵐ[volume] univ) →
        ∀ a b : ℝ, a < b →
          ∃ (n : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
            (owner : Fin n → S),
            x 0 ≤ a ∧ b ≤ x (Fin.last n) ∧
              IsFilledIndexedSliceChain K S axis q x owner ∧
              (∀ i, x i ∈ sliceEndpointSet K S axis q)
proof:
:= by
  intro K S hpacking axis
  filter_upwards [
    genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints_of_local_ae K S hpacking axis,
    eventually_avoids_translatedVertexLevels hpacking axis] with q hbetween hq
  intro hfull a b hab
  obtain ⟨hunbddAbove, hunbddBelow⟩ :=
    frontier_unbounded_of_ae_univ hpacking hq hfull
  obtain ⟨l, hlE, hla⟩ := not_bddBelow_iff.mp hunbddBelow a
  obtain ⟨r, hrE, hbr⟩ := not_bddAbove_iff.mp hunbddAbove b
  obtain ⟨n, hn, x, owner, hx0, hxlast, hchain, hendpoints⟩ :=
    hbetween l hlE r hrE (lt_trans hla (lt_trans hab hbr)) (by
      filter_upwards [hfull] with y hy
      intro hyI
      exact hy.mpr (Set.mem_univ y))
  refine ⟨n, hn, x, owner, ?_, ?_, hchain, hendpoints⟩
  · rw [hx0]
    exact hla.le
  · rw [hxlast]
    exact hbr.le

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.preimage_add_left
statement:
private theorem preimage_add_left (u : ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) :
    (fun x : ℝ ↦ -u + x) ⁻¹' S = u +ᵥ S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.finite_inter_bounded_of_uniformlySeparated
statement:
private theorem finite_inter_bounded_of_uniformlySeparated
    {S Q : Set ℝ} {delta : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hS : S.Pairwise fun x y ↦ delta ≤ dist x y)
    (hQ : Bornology.IsBounded Q) : (S ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hSclosed : IsClosed S := Metric.isClosed_of_pairwise_le_dist hdelta hS
  have hSdiscrete : IsDiscrete S := by
    rw [isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isOpen]
    intro s hs
    refine ⟨Metric.ball s delta, Metric.isOpen_ball, ?_⟩
    ext t
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨htball, htS⟩
      by_cases hts : t = s
      · simp [hts]
      · have hsep := hS htS hs hts
        simp only [Metric.mem_ball] at htball
        exfalso
        exact (not_lt_of_ge (by simpa [dist_comm] using hsep)) htball
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hdelta, hs⟩
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hQ.subset_closedBall (0 : ℝ)
  have hcompact : IsCompact (S ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 R) :=
    Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
      (hSclosed.inter Metric.isClosed_closedBall)
      (Metric.isBounded_closedBall.subset inter_subset_right)
  apply (hcompact.finite (hSdiscrete.mono inter_subset_left)).subset
  exact inter_subset_inter_right S hR

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.linePacking_uniformlySeparated
statement:
theorem linePacking_uniformlySeparated
    {B L X : Set ℝ}
    (hTile : LineTilesOn B L X)
    (hBfinite : MeasureTheory.volume B ≠ ⊤)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (MeasureTheory.volume B).toReal) :
    ∃ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta ∧
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.IsUniformlySeparated delta L ∧
      IsClosed L ∧
      (∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (L ∩ Q).Finite) ∧
      L.Countable
proof:
:= by
  have hBpos : 0 < MeasureTheory.volume B :=
    (ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff.mp hBpositive).1
  obtain ⟨K, hKB, hKcompact, hKpos⟩ :=
    hTile.1.exists_lt_isCompact_of_ne_top hBfinite hBpos
  have hKne : MeasureTheory.volume K ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hKpos
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ d : ℝ in 𝓝 0,
      MeasureTheory.volume ((d +ᵥ K) \ K) < MeasureTheory.volume K :=
    MeasureTheory.eventually_nhds_zero_measure_vadd_sdiff_lt
      hKcompact hKcompact.isClosed hKne
  obtain ⟨delta, hdelta, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hevent
  have hoverlap {d : ℝ} (hd : |d| < delta) :
      MeasureTheory.volume ((d +ᵥ K) ∩ K) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hdiff : MeasureTheory.volume ((d +ᵥ K) \ K) =
        MeasureTheory.volume (d +ᵥ K) := measure_sdiff_null' hzero
    have hlt := hball (by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hd)
    change MeasureTheory.volume ((d +ᵥ K) \ K) < MeasureTheory.volume K at hlt
    rw [hdiff, measure_vadd] at hlt
    exact (lt_irrefl (MeasureTheory.volume K)) hlt
  have hsep : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.IsUniformlySeparated delta L := by
    intro s hs t ht hst
    by_contra hdist
    have hdist' : dist s t < delta := lt_of_not_ge hdist
    have hov := hoverlap (d := s - t)
      (by simpa [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] using hdist')
    have hsub : t +ᵥ (((s - t) +ᵥ K) ∩ K) ⊆
        (s +ᵥ B) ∩ (t +ᵥ B) := by
      rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hy₁, hy₂⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hy₁
      constructor
      · refine ⟨k, hKB hk, ?_⟩
        simp only [vadd_eq_add]
        ring
      · refine ⟨(s - t) + k, hKB ?_, rfl⟩
        exact hy₂
    have htranslated :
        MeasureTheory.volume (t +ᵥ (((s - t) +ᵥ K) ∩ K)) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [measure_vadd]
      exact hov
    exact htranslated
      (measure_mono_null hsub (hTile.2.2.2.1 hs ht hst))
  have hclosed : IsClosed L :=
    Metric.isClosed_of_pairwise_le_dist hdelta hsep
  have hfinite : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (L ∩ Q).Finite :=
    fun Q hQ ↦ finite_inter_bounded_of_uniformlySeparated hdelta hsep hQ
  exact ⟨delta, hdelta, hsep, hclosed, hfinite, hTile.2.2.1⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.lineTilesOn_translate
statement:
theorem lineTilesOn_translate
    {B L X : Set ℝ} (hTile : LineTilesOn B L X) (u : ℝ) :
    LineTilesOn B (u +ᵥ L) (u +ᵥ X)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hTile.1, hTile.2.1.const_vadd u, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have heq : u +ᵥ L = (fun l : ℝ ↦ u + l) '' L := by
      ext x
      simp [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, add_comm]
    rw [heq]
    exact hTile.2.2.1.image _
  · intro l hl m hm hlm
    obtain ⟨l₀, hl₀, rfl⟩ := hl
    obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀, rfl⟩ := hm
    have hlm₀ : l₀ ≠ m₀ := by
      intro heq
      exact hlm (by simp [heq])
    have hd := hTile.2.2.2.1 hl₀ hm₀ hlm₀
    have hd' := hd.preimage
      (MeasureTheory.quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left MeasureTheory.volume (-u))
    rw [preimage_add_left, preimage_add_left] at hd'
    simpa [← add_vadd, add_comm] using hd'
  · have hpull :=
      (MeasureTheory.quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left MeasureTheory.volume (-u)).ae
        hTile.2.2.2.2
    filter_upwards [hpull] with x hx
    constructor
    · intro hxTarget
      have hxTarget' : -u + x ∈ X := by
        simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using hxTarget
      obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hx.mp hxTarget'
      let l' : u +ᵥ L := ⟨u + l.1, by
        simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
          neg_add_cancel_left] using l.2⟩
      refine ⟨l', ?_⟩
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hl ⊢
      convert hl using 1
      dsimp only [l']
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      ring
    · rintro ⟨l, hl⟩
      let l₀ : L := ⟨-u + l.1, by
        simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using l.2⟩
      have hxUnion : -u + x ∈ (l₀.1 +ᵥ B) := by
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hl ⊢
        convert hl using 1
        dsimp only [l₀]
        simp only [vadd_eq_add]
        ring
      have hxTarget := hx.mpr ⟨l₀, hxUnion⟩
      simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using hxTarget

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.lineTilesOn_congr_ae
statement:
theorem lineTilesOn_congr_ae
    {B B' L X : Set ℝ}
    (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hB' : MeasurableSet B')
    (hBB' : B =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] B') :
    LineTilesOn B L X ↔ LineTilesOn B' L X
proof:
:= by
  have forward {A A' : Set ℝ}
      (hA' : MeasurableSet A') (hAA' : A =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] A')
      (hTile : LineTilesOn A L X) : LineTilesOn A' L X := by
    let _ : Countable L := hTile.2.2.1.to_subtype
    have hUnion :
        (⋃ l : L, (l.1 : ℝ) +ᵥ A) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume]
          ⋃ l : L, (l.1 : ℝ) +ᵥ A' :=
      Filter.EventuallyEq.countable_iUnion fun l ↦
        (MeasureTheory.vadd_set_ae_eq l.1).mpr hAA'
    refine ⟨hA', hTile.2.1, hTile.2.2.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro l hl m hm hlm
      exact (hTile.2.2.2.1 hl hm hlm).congr
        ((MeasureTheory.vadd_set_ae_eq l).mpr hAA').symm
        ((MeasureTheory.vadd_set_ae_eq m).mpr hAA').symm
    · filter_upwards [hTile.2.2.2.2, hUnion] with x hx hxu
      have hx' : x ∈ X ↔ x ∈ ⋃ l : L, (l.1 : ℝ) +ᵥ A := by
        simpa only [Set.mem_iUnion] using hx
      have hx'' : x ∈ X ↔ x ∈ ⋃ l : L, (l.1 : ℝ) +ᵥ A' :=
        hx'.trans (Iff.of_eq hxu)
      simpa only [Set.mem_iUnion] using hx''
  exact ⟨forward hB' hBB', forward hB hBB'.symm⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.finiteIntervalRegion_measurable_bounded_aeClosure
statement:
private theorem finiteIntervalRegion_measurable_bounded_aeClosure
    {B : Set ℝ} (hB : IsFiniteIntervalRegion B) :
    MeasurableSet B ∧ Bornology.IsBounded B ∧ B =ᵐ[volume] closure B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, a, b, hab, rfl⟩ := hB
  have hmeas : MeasurableSet (⋃ i, Set.Ioo (a i) (b i)) :=
    MeasurableSet.iUnion fun _ ↦ measurableSet_Ioo
  have hbounded : Bornology.IsBounded (⋃ i, Set.Ioo (a i) (b i)) :=
    (Bornology.isBounded_iUnion).2 fun i ↦ Metric.isBounded_Ioo (a i) (b i)
  have hae : (⋃ i, Set.Ioo (a i) (b i)) =ᵐ[volume]
      ⋃ i, Set.Icc (a i) (b i) :=
    Filter.EventuallyEq.countable_iUnion fun _ ↦ MeasureTheory.Ioo_ae_eq_Icc
  have hclosure : closure (⋃ i, Set.Ioo (a i) (b i)) =
      ⋃ i, Set.Icc (a i) (b i) := by
    rw [closure_iUnion_of_finite]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact closure_Ioo (ne_of_lt (hab i))
  exact ⟨hmeas, hbounded, hclosure.symm ▸ hae⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.locallyFinite_closedTranslates
statement:
private theorem locallyFinite_closedTranslates
    {B L : Set ℝ} (hBbounded : Bornology.IsBounded B)
    (hL : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (L ∩ Q).Finite) :
    LocallyFinite (fun l : L ↦ (l.1 : ℝ) +ᵥ closure B)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  refine ⟨Metric.ball x 1, Metric.ball_mem_nhds x zero_lt_one, ?_⟩
  let C : Set ℝ := Metric.ball x 1 - closure B
  have hCbounded : Bornology.IsBounded C :=
    isBounded_sub Metric.isBounded_ball hBbounded.closure
  have hfinite : (L ∩ C).Finite := hL C hCbounded
  apply (Finite.preimage Subtype.val_injective.injOn hfinite).subset
  intro l hl
  change (l.1 : ℝ) ∈ L ∩ C
  refine ⟨l.2, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hztranslate, hzball⟩ := hl
  obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hztranslate
  exact ⟨l.1 + b, hzball, b, hb, by simp⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.countable_of_locallyFinite_inter
statement:
theorem countable_of_locallyFinite_inter
    {L : Set ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (L ∩ Q).Finite) :
    L.Countable
proof:
:= by
  have hcount : (⋃ n : ℕ, L ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 n).Countable :=
    Set.countable_iUnion fun n ↦ (hL _ Metric.isBounded_closedBall).countable
  apply hcount.mono
  intro x hx
  rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt |x|
  refine ⟨n, hx, ?_⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.dist_eq]
  simpa using le_of_lt hn

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.finiteOpenIntervals_source_iff_ae
statement:
theorem finiteOpenIntervals_source_iff_ae
    {B L : Set ℝ}
    (hB : IsFiniteIntervalRegion B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) :
    LineTiles B L ↔
      (∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (L ∩ Q).Finite) ∧
      Set.Pairwise L
        (AEDisjoint volume on ((· +ᵥ closure B) : ℝ → Set ℝ)) ∧
      (⋃ l : L, l.1 +ᵥ closure B) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hBmeas, hBbounded, hBclosure⟩ :=
    finiteIntervalRegion_measurable_bounded_aeClosure hB
  have hClosureMeas : MeasurableSet (closure B) := isClosed_closure.measurableSet
  constructor
  · intro hTile
    have hBfinite : volume B ≠ ⊤ := hBbounded.measure_lt_top.ne
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hlocal, _⟩ :=
      linePacking_uniformlySeparated hTile hBfinite hBpositive
    have hClosureTile : LineTiles (closure B) L :=
      (lineTilesOn_congr_ae hBmeas hClosureMeas hBclosure).mp hTile
    refine ⟨hlocal, hClosureTile.2.2.2.1, ?_⟩
    have hfamily := locallyFinite_closedTranslates hBbounded hlocal
    have hclosedUnion : IsClosed (⋃ l : L, l.1 +ᵥ closure B) :=
      hfamily.isClosed_iUnion fun _ ↦ isClosed_closure.vadd _
    have hfull : (⋃ l : L, l.1 +ᵥ closure B) =ᵐ[volume] Set.univ := by
      filter_upwards [hClosureTile.2.2.2.2] with x hx
      apply propext
      constructor
      · intro _
        exact Set.mem_univ x
      · intro _
        change x ∈ ⋃ l : L, l.1 +ᵥ closure B
        rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
        exact hx.mp (Set.mem_univ x)
    exact hclosedUnion.ae_eq_univ_iff_eq.mp hfull
  · rintro ⟨hlocal, hdisjoint, hcover⟩
    have hcount : L.Countable := countable_of_locallyFinite_inter hlocal
    have hClosureTile : LineTiles (closure B) L := by
      refine ⟨hClosureMeas, MeasurableSet.univ, hcount, hdisjoint, ?_⟩
      filter_upwards [] with x
      simp only [Set.mem_univ, true_iff]
      have hx : x ∈ ⋃ l : L, l.1 +ᵥ closure B := hcover.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ x
      simpa only [Set.mem_iUnion] using hx
    exact (lineTilesOn_congr_ae hBmeas hClosureMeas hBclosure).mpr hClosureTile

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.tilesOn_fubiniSlices
statement:
theorem tilesOn_fubiniSlices
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {T D : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T D) :
    ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume,
      ∀ᵐ y : ℝ ∂volume,
        ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ D ↔
          ∃! t : T,
            y - t.1.im ∈
              {v : ℝ |
                ((x - t.1.re : ℝ) : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
                  K.openCarrier})
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Countable T := hTile.1.to_subtype
  have hunique : ∀ᵐ z : Tiling.Plane ∂volume,
      ∀ s t : T, z ∈ s.1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier →
        z ∈ t.1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier → s = t := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro s
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro t
    by_cases hst : s = t
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ _ _ ↦ hst
    · let i : Tiling.Placement Tiling.Plane Unit := (s.1, ())
      let j : Tiling.Placement Tiling.Plane Unit := (t.1, ())
      have hi : i ∈ K.toPolygonalRegion.placements T := s.2
      have hj : j ∈ K.toPolygonalRegion.placements T := t.2
      have hij : i ≠ j := by
        intro hij
        apply hst
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact congrArg Prod.fst hij
      have hd := hTile.2.1 hi hj hij
      have hnot : ∀ᵐ z : Tiling.Plane ∂volume,
          z ∉ (s.1 +ᵥ K.support) ∩ (t.1 +ᵥ K.support) :=
        measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hd
      filter_upwards [hnot] with z hz hs ht
      exfalso
      apply hz
      exact ⟨Set.vadd_set_mono interior_subset hs,
        Set.vadd_set_mono interior_subset ht⟩
  have hplane : ∀ᵐ z : Tiling.Plane ∂volume,
      (z ∈ D ↔ ∃! t : T,
        z.im - t.1.im ∈
          {v : ℝ |
            ((z.re - t.1.re : ℝ) : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
              K.openCarrier}) := by
    filter_upwards [hTile.2.2, hunique] with z hcover huniq
    have hslice (t : T) :
        z.im - t.1.im ∈
            {v : ℝ |
              ((z.re - t.1.re : ℝ) : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
                K.openCarrier} ↔
          z ∈ t.1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier := by
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
      rw [show -t.1 + z =
          ((z.re - t.1.re : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((z.im - t.1.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp <;> ring]
    constructor
    · intro hzD
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hcover.mp hzD
      refine ⟨t, (hslice t).mpr ht, ?_⟩
      intro s hs
      exact huniq s t ((hslice s).mp hs) ht
    · rintro ⟨t, ht, _⟩
      exact hcover.mpr ⟨t, (hslice t).mp ht⟩
  have hprod : ∀ᵐ p : ℝ × ℝ ∂volume.prod volume,
      (((p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ D ↔
        ∃! t : T,
          p.2 - t.1.im ∈
            {v : ℝ |
              ((p.1 - t.1.re : ℝ) : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
                K.openCarrier}) := by
    have hpull := Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.symm.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hplane
    filter_upwards [hpull] with p hp
    have heq : ({ re := p.1, im := p.2 } : ℂ) =
        (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp
    rw [← heq]
    exact hp
  exact MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod hprod

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.normalizeLineTiling_spec
statement:
theorem normalizeLineTiling_spec
    {B L : Set ℝ}
    (hTile : LineTiles B L)
    {l0 : ℝ} (hl0 : l0 ∈ L) :
    ∃ N : NormalizedLineTiling B,
      N.centres = normalizeLineTiling L l0 ∧
      ∀ p : ℝ, (p +ᵥ N.centres = N.centres ↔ p +ᵥ L = L)
proof:
:= by
  have hnormalized : LineTiles B (normalizeLineTiling L l0) := by
    have htranslated := lineTilesOn_translate hTile (-l0)
    simpa [Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.LineTiles,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.normalizeLineTiling] using htranslated
  let N : NormalizedLineTiling B := {
    centres := normalizeLineTiling L l0
    tiles := hnormalized
    zero_mem := by
      change 0 ∈ (-l0) +ᵥ L
      simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, neg_neg, vadd_eq_add,
        zero_add, add_zero] using hl0 }
  refine ⟨N, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro p
  change (p +ᵥ ((-l0) +ᵥ L) = (-l0) +ᵥ L) ↔ p +ᵥ L = L
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have hp' := congrArg (fun A : Set ℝ ↦ l0 +ᵥ A) hp
    rw [← add_vadd, ← add_vadd, ← add_vadd,
      add_neg_cancel, zero_vadd] at hp'
    have hscalar : l0 + p + -l0 = p := by ring
    rw [hscalar] at hp'
    exact hp'
  · intro hp
    calc
      p +ᵥ (-l0 +ᵥ L) = (-l0) +ᵥ (p +ᵥ L) := by
        rw [← add_vadd, ← add_vadd]
        congr 1
        ring
      _ = (-l0) +ᵥ L := congrArg ((-l0) +ᵥ ·) hp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.lineTilesOn_target_congr
statement:
private theorem lineTilesOn_target_congr
    {B L X X' : Set ℝ}
    (hX' : MeasurableSet X') (hXX' : X =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] X')
    (hTile : LineTilesOn B L X) : LineTilesOn B L X'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hTile.1, hX', hTile.2.2.1, hTile.2.2.2.1, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hTile.2.2.2.2, hXX'] with x hx hxx
  exact (Iff.of_eq hxx).symm.trans hx

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.lineTilesOn_periodic_of_finiteOrbit
statement:
theorem lineTilesOn_periodic_of_finiteOrbit
    {B H X : Set ℝ} {p : ℝ}
    (_hp : 0 < p)
    (hperiod : X =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] p +ᵥ X)
    (hfinite : Set.Finite {L : Set ℝ | LineTilesOn B L X})
    (hTile : LineTilesOn B H X) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧
      n ≤ Set.ncard {L : Set ℝ | LineTilesOn B L X} ∧
      ((n : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ H = H
proof:
:= by
  let A : Set (Set ℝ) := {L : Set ℝ | LineTilesOn B L X}
  have hstep {L : Set ℝ} (hL : LineTilesOn B L X) :
      LineTilesOn B (p +ᵥ L) X :=
    lineTilesOn_target_congr hL.2.1 hperiod.symm (lineTilesOn_translate hL p)
  have hiter : ∀ n : ℕ, LineTilesOn B (((n : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ H) X := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa using hTile
    | succ n ih =>
      have hs := hstep ih
      convert hs using 1
      rw [← add_vadd]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
  let F : ℕ → Set ℝ := fun n ↦ ((n : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ H
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo F (Finset.range (A.ncard + 1) : Set ℕ) A := by
    intro n _
    exact hiter n
  have hmaps' : Set.MapsTo F (Finset.range (A.ncard + 1) : Set ℕ)
      (hfinite.toFinset : Set (Set ℝ)) := by
    intro n hn
    apply (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset hfinite).mpr
    exact hmaps hn
  have hcard : hfinite.toFinset.card < (Finset.range (A.ncard + 1)).card := by
    simp [A, Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hfinite]
  obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, hij, heq⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to hcard hmaps'
  have hi' : i < A.ncard + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
  have hj' : j < A.ncard + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hijlt | hjilt
  · let n := j - i
    have hn : 0 < n := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hijlt
    have hnle : n ≤ A.ncard := by omega
    refine ⟨n, hn, hnle, ?_⟩
    have hcancel := congrArg (fun S : Set ℝ ↦ (-(i : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ S) heq
    dsimp only [F] at hcancel
    rw [← add_vadd, ← add_vadd] at hcancel
    have hleft : -(i : ℝ) * p + (i : ℝ) * p = 0 := by ring
    have hright : -(i : ℝ) * p + (j : ℝ) * p = (n : ℝ) * p := by
      dsimp only [n]
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (Nat.le_of_lt hijlt)]
      ring
    rw [hleft, zero_vadd, hright] at hcancel
    exact hcancel.symm
  · let n := i - j
    have hn : 0 < n := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hjilt
    have hnle : n ≤ A.ncard := by omega
    refine ⟨n, hn, hnle, ?_⟩
    have hcancel := congrArg (fun S : Set ℝ ↦ (-(j : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ S) heq.symm
    dsimp only [F] at hcancel
    rw [← add_vadd, ← add_vadd] at hcancel
    have hleft : -(j : ℝ) * p + (j : ℝ) * p = 0 := by ring
    have hright : -(j : ℝ) * p + (i : ℝ) * p = (n : ℝ) * p := by
      dsimp only [n]
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (Nat.le_of_lt hjilt)]
      ring
    rw [hleft, zero_vadd, hright] at hcancel
    exact hcancel.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.verticalEmbedding_isClosedEmbedding
statement:
private theorem verticalEmbedding_isClosedEmbedding :
    Topology.IsClosedEmbedding verticalEmbedding
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding (Prod.mk (0 : ℝ) : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ) := by
    refine ⟨isEmbedding_prodMkRight (0 : ℝ), ?_⟩
    have hrange : Set.range (Prod.mk (0 : ℝ) : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ) =
        ({0} : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Set.univ := by
      ext p
      simp [eq_comm, Prod.ext_iff]
    rw [hrange]
    exact isClosed_singleton.prod isClosed_univ
  unfold verticalEmbedding
  exact Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm.toHomeomorph.isClosedEmbedding.comp hp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.verticalEmbedding_tendsto_coclosedCompact
statement:
private theorem verticalEmbedding_tendsto_coclosedCompact :
    Tendsto verticalEmbedding (coclosedCompact ℝ) (coclosedCompact ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasBasis_coclosedCompact.tendsto_right_iff]
  rintro K ⟨hKclosed, hKcompact⟩
  change verticalEmbedding ⁻¹' Kᶜ ∈ coclosedCompact ℝ
  rw [preimage_compl]
  exact hasBasis_coclosedCompact.mem_of_mem ⟨
    hKclosed.preimage verticalEmbedding_isClosedEmbedding.continuous,
    verticalEmbedding_isClosedEmbedding.isProperMap.isCompact_preimage hKcompact⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.verticalEmbedding_onePoint_continuous
statement:
private theorem verticalEmbedding_onePoint_continuous :
    Continuous (OnePoint.map verticalEmbedding)
proof:
:=
  OnePoint.continuous_map verticalEmbedding_isClosedEmbedding.continuous
    verticalEmbedding_tendsto_coclosedCompact

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.verticalEmbedding_onePoint_isClosedEmbedding
statement:
private theorem verticalEmbedding_onePoint_isClosedEmbedding :
    Topology.IsClosedEmbedding (OnePoint.map verticalEmbedding)
proof:
:=
  verticalEmbedding_onePoint_continuous.isClosedEmbedding (by
    intro x y hxy
    induction x using OnePoint.rec with
    | infty =>
        induction y using OnePoint.rec with
        | infty => rfl
        | coe y => simp at hxy
    | coe x =>
        induction y using OnePoint.rec with
        | infty => simp at hxy
        | coe y =>
            simp only [OnePoint.map_some, OnePoint.coe_eq_coe] at hxy
            exact congrArg some (verticalEmbedding_isClosedEmbedding.injective hxy))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.verticalImage_eq
statement:
private theorem verticalImage_eq (S : Set ℝ) :
    Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm '' Set.prod {0} S = verticalEmbedding '' S
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, y⟩, ⟨hx, hy⟩, rfl⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    subst x
    exact ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(0, y), ⟨Set.mem_singleton 0, hy⟩, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.verticalImage_isClosed
statement:
private theorem verticalImage_isClosed (S : Set ℝ) (hS : IsClosed S) :
    IsClosed (Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm '' Set.prod {0} S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [verticalImage_eq]
  exact verticalEmbedding_isClosedEmbedding.isClosedMap S hS

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.fellCompactification_verticalImage
statement:
private theorem fellCompactification_verticalImage
    (S : Set ℝ) (hS : IsClosed S) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification
        (Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm '' Set.prod {0} S)
        (verticalImage_isClosed S hS) =
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification S hS).map
        (OnePoint.map verticalEmbedding) verticalEmbedding_onePoint_continuous
proof:
:= by
  apply TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.ext
  ext z
  induction z using OnePoint.rec with
  | infty => simp [Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
      Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification]
  | coe z =>
      simp [Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
        Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification, verticalImage_eq,
        verticalEmbedding]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.verticalEmbedding_locallyFellConverges_iff
statement:
theorem verticalEmbedding_locallyFellConverges_iff
    (S : ℕ → Set ℝ) (L : Set ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ n, IsClosed (S n)) (hL : IsClosed L) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges S L ↔
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
        (Set.image Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm ∘ Set.prod {0} ∘ S)
        (Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm '' Set.prod {0} L)
proof:
:= by
  let F := TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.map (OnePoint.map verticalEmbedding)
    verticalEmbedding_onePoint_continuous
  have hF : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding F := by
    dsimp only [F]
    exact verticalEmbedding_onePoint_isClosedEmbedding.nonemptyCompacts_map
  rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges,
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, _, hconv⟩
    refine ⟨fun n ↦ verticalImage_isClosed (S n) (hS n),
      verticalImage_isClosed L hL, ?_⟩
    have hsource : Tendsto
        (fun n ↦ Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification (S n) (hS n)) atTop
        (nhds (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification L hL)) := by
      simpa only using hconv
    have hmapped := (hF.tendsto_nhds_iff (g := fun n ↦
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification (S n) (hS n))).mp hsource
    simpa [F, Function.comp_def, fellCompactification_verticalImage] using hmapped
  · rintro ⟨_, _, hconv⟩
    refine ⟨hS, hL, ?_⟩
    have hmapped : Tendsto
        (F ∘ fun n ↦ Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification (S n) (hS n)) atTop
        (nhds (F (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification L hL))) := by
      simpa [F, Function.comp_def, fellCompactification_verticalImage] using hconv
    exact (hF.tendsto_nhds_iff (g := fun n ↦
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification (S n) (hS n))).mpr hmapped

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.lineSubtilings_unique
statement:
private theorem lineSubtilings_unique
    {B L A H X : Set ℝ}
    (hBpositive : 0 < (MeasureTheory.volume B).toReal)
    (hWhole : LineTiles B L)
    (hA : A ⊆ L) (hH : H ⊆ L)
    (hATile : LineTilesOn B A X) (hHTile : LineTilesOn B H X) :
    A = H
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro a ha
    by_contra haH
    let _ : Countable H := hHTile.2.2.1.to_subtype
    let HU : Set ℝ := ⋃ h : H, (h : ℝ) +ᵥ B
    have hdisjoint : MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint MeasureTheory.volume
        (a +ᵥ B) HU := by
      dsimp only [HU]
      rw [MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint.iUnion_right_iff]
      intro h
      apply hWhole.2.2.2.1 (hA ha) (hH h.2)
      intro hah
      apply haH
      simpa only [← hah] using h.2
    have hsubset : ∀ᵐ x ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
        x ∈ a +ᵥ B → x ∈ HU := by
      filter_upwards [hATile.2.2.2.2, hHTile.2.2.2.2] with x hxA hxH
      intro hxa
      have hxX : x ∈ X := hxA.mpr ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, hxa⟩
      obtain ⟨h, hxh⟩ := hxH.mp hxX
      change x ∈ ⋃ h : H, (h : ℝ) +ᵥ B
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨h, hxh⟩
    have hinter : (a +ᵥ B) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume]
        Set.inter (a +ᵥ B) HU := by
      filter_upwards [hsubset] with x hx
      apply propext
      exact ⟨fun hxa ↦ ⟨hxa, hx hxa⟩, fun hxi ↦ hxi.1⟩
    have hzero : MeasureTheory.volume (a +ᵥ B) = 0 := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.measure_congr hinter]
      exact hdisjoint
    have hBzero : MeasureTheory.volume B = 0 := by
      simpa only [MeasureTheory.measure_vadd] using hzero
    rw [hBzero] at hBpositive
    simp at hBpositive
  · intro h hh
    by_contra hhA
    let _ : Countable A := hATile.2.2.1.to_subtype
    let AU : Set ℝ := ⋃ a : A, (a : ℝ) +ᵥ B
    have hdisjoint : MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint MeasureTheory.volume
        (h +ᵥ B) AU := by
      dsimp only [AU]
      rw [MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint.iUnion_right_iff]
      intro a
      apply hWhole.2.2.2.1 (hH hh) (hA a.2)
      intro hha
      apply hhA
      simpa only [← hha] using a.2
    have hsubset : ∀ᵐ x ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
        x ∈ h +ᵥ B → x ∈ AU := by
      filter_upwards [hHTile.2.2.2.2, hATile.2.2.2.2] with x hxH hxA
      intro hxh
      have hxX : x ∈ X := hxH.mpr ⟨⟨h, hh⟩, hxh⟩
      obtain ⟨a, hxa⟩ := hxA.mp hxX
      change x ∈ ⋃ a : A, (a : ℝ) +ᵥ B
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨a, hxa⟩
    have hinter : (h +ᵥ B) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume]
        Set.inter (h +ᵥ B) AU := by
      filter_upwards [hsubset] with x hx
      apply propext
      exact ⟨fun hxh ↦ ⟨hxh, hx hxh⟩, fun hxi ↦ hxi.1⟩
    have hzero : MeasureTheory.volume (h +ᵥ B) = 0 := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.measure_congr hinter]
      exact hdisjoint
    have hBzero : MeasureTheory.volume B = 0 := by
      simpa only [MeasureTheory.measure_vadd] using hzero
    rw [hBzero] at hBpositive
    simp at hBpositive

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.lineSubtiling_periodic_of_commonPeriod
statement:
theorem lineSubtiling_periodic_of_commonPeriod
    {B L H X : Set ℝ} {q : ℝ}
    (hBfinite : MeasureTheory.volume B ≠ ⊤)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (MeasureTheory.volume B).toReal)
    (hWhole : LineTiles B L)
    (hsub : H ⊆ L)
    (hTarget : LineTilesOn B H X)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hLperiod : q +ᵥ L = L)
    (hXperiod : X =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] q +ᵥ X) :
    q +ᵥ H = H
proof:
:= by
  have hShiftTile : LineTilesOn B (q +ᵥ H) X :=
    lineTilesOn_target_congr hTarget.2.1 hXperiod.symm
      (lineTilesOn_translate hTarget q)
  have hShiftSub : q +ᵥ H ⊆ L := by
    intro x hx
    have hxL : x ∈ q +ᵥ L := by
      obtain ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact ⟨h, hsub hh, rfl⟩
    rwa [hLperiod] at hxL
  exact (lineSubtilings_unique hBpositive hWhole hShiftSub hsub
    hShiftTile hTarget)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.quadrantAt_convex
statement:
private theorem quadrantAt_convex (q : Quadrant) (a : Tiling.Plane) :
    Convex ℝ (quadrantAt q a)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy α β hα hβ hαβ
  have hlt : ∀ {u v c : ℝ}, u < c → v < c → α * u + β * v < c := by
    intro u v c hu hv
    by_cases hα0 : α = 0
    · have hβ1 : β = 1 := by linarith
      simp [hα0, hβ1, hv]
    · have hαpos : 0 < α := lt_of_le_of_ne hα (Ne.symm hα0)
      have hu' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hu hαpos
      have hv' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hv) hβ
      have hsum : α * c + β * c = c := by
        calc
          α * c + β * c = (α + β) * c := by ring
          _ = 1 * c := by rw [hαβ]
          _ = c := by ring
      nlinarith [hαβ, hsum]
  have hgt : ∀ {u v c : ℝ}, c < u → c < v → c < α * u + β * v := by
    intro u v c hu hv
    by_cases hα0 : α = 0
    · have hβ1 : β = 1 := by linarith
      simp [hα0, hβ1, hv]
    · have hαpos : 0 < α := lt_of_le_of_ne hα (Ne.symm hα0)
      have hu' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hu hαpos
      have hv' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hv) hβ
      have hsum : α * c + β * c = c := by
        calc
          α * c + β * c = (α + β) * c := by ring
          _ = 1 * c := by rw [hαβ]
          _ = c := by ring
      nlinarith [hαβ, hsum]
  cases q
  · dsimp [quadrantAt] at hx ⊢
    constructor
    · simpa using hlt hx.1 hy.1
    · simpa using hlt hx.2 hy.2
  · dsimp [quadrantAt] at hx ⊢
    constructor
    · simpa using hgt hx.1 hy.1
    · simpa using hlt hx.2 hy.2
  · dsimp [quadrantAt] at hx ⊢
    constructor
    · simpa using hlt hx.1 hy.1
    · simpa using hgt hx.2 hy.2
  · dsimp [quadrantAt] at hx ⊢
    constructor
    · simpa using hgt hx.1 hy.1
    · simpa using hgt hx.2 hy.2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.quadrant_constancy_of_frontier_cross
statement:
private theorem quadrant_constancy_of_frontier_cross
    {D : Set Tiling.Plane} {a : Tiling.Plane} (q : Quadrant)
    (hopen : IsOpen D)
    (hcross : ∃ r > 0, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball a r, z ∈ frontier D →
      z.re = a.re ∨ z.im = a.im) :
    ∃ r > 0,
      (Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a ⊆ D ∨
        Disjoint (Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a) D)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, hcross₀⟩ := hcross
  let r := r₀ / 2
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  let Q : Set Tiling.Plane := Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a
  have hQopen : IsOpen Q := by
    apply Metric.isOpen_ball.inter
    cases q
    · exact (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)
    · exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)
    · exact (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const).inter
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im)
    · exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im)
  have hQpre : IsPreconnected Q := by
    apply (convex_ball a r).inter (quadrantAt_convex q a) |>.isPreconnected
  let U : Set Tiling.Plane := D ∩ Q
  let V : Set Tiling.Plane := (closure D)ᶜ ∩ Q
  have hUopen : IsOpen U := hopen.inter hQopen
  have hVopen : IsOpen V := (isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl).inter hQopen
  have hUVdisj : Disjoint U V := by
    apply Set.disjoint_left.2
    intro z hzU hzV
    exact hzV.1 (subset_closure hzU.1)
  have hQsub : Q ⊆ U ∪ V := by
    intro z hzQ
    by_cases hzD : z ∈ D
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hzD, hzQ⟩
    · right
      refine ⟨?_, hzQ⟩
      intro hzcl
      have hzfront : z ∈ frontier D := by
        change z ∈ closure D \ interior D
        exact ⟨hzcl, by simpa [hopen.interior_eq] using hzD⟩
      have hzaxis : z.re ≠ a.re ∧ z.im ≠ a.im := by
        cases q <;> dsimp [quadrantAt] at hzQ ⊢ <;>
          constructor <;> linarith [hzQ.2.1, hzQ.2.2]
      have hznear : z ∈ Metric.ball a r₀ :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (by dsimp [r]; linarith) hzQ.1
      obtain hzre | hzim := hcross₀ z hznear hzfront
      · exact hzaxis.1 hzre
      · exact hzaxis.2 hzim
  obtain hleft | hright := hQpre.subset_or_subset hUopen hVopen hUVdisj hQsub
  · refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
    exact Or.inl (fun z hz => (hleft hz).1)
  · refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
    exact Or.inr (by
      apply Set.disjoint_left.2
      intro z hzQ hzD
      exact (hright hzQ).1 (subset_closure hzD))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.quadrant_ball_nonempty
statement:
theorem quadrant_ball_nonempty
    {a : Tiling.Plane} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (q : Quadrant) :
    (Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  let d : ℝ := r / 4
  have hdist (sgnRe sgnIm : ℝ) (hre : sgnRe = 1 ∨ sgnRe = -1)
      (him : sgnIm = 1 ∨ sgnIm = -1) :
      dist a (a + sgnRe * (d : ℂ) + sgnIm * (d : ℂ) * Complex.I) < r := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, Complex.norm_def, Real.sqrt_lt' hr]
    have hnorm : Complex.normSq
        (sgnRe * (d : ℂ) + sgnIm * (d : ℂ) * Complex.I) = 2 * d ^ 2 := by
      rcases hre with rfl | rfl <;> rcases him with rfl | rfl <;>
        norm_num [Complex.normSq_apply] <;> ring_nf
    rw [show a - (a + sgnRe * (d : ℂ) + sgnIm * (d : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
      -(sgnRe * (d : ℂ) + sgnIm * (d : ℂ) * Complex.I) by ring,
      Complex.normSq_neg, hnorm]
    dsimp [d]
    nlinarith
  cases q
  · refine ⟨a - (d : ℂ) - (d : ℂ) * Complex.I, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]
      have heq : a - (d : ℂ) - (d : ℂ) * Complex.I =
          a + (-1 : ℝ) * (d : ℂ) + (-1 : ℝ) * (d : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        norm_num; ring
      rw [heq]
      exact hdist (-1) (-1) (Or.inr rfl) (Or.inr rfl)
    · constructor <;> simp [d, hr]
  · refine ⟨a + (d : ℂ) - (d : ℂ) * Complex.I, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]
      have heq : a + (d : ℂ) - (d : ℂ) * Complex.I =
          a + (1 : ℝ) * (d : ℂ) + (-1 : ℝ) * (d : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        norm_num; ring
      rw [heq]
      exact hdist 1 (-1) (Or.inl rfl) (Or.inr rfl)
    · constructor <;> simp [d, hr]
  · refine ⟨a - (d : ℂ) + (d : ℂ) * Complex.I, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]
      have heq : a - (d : ℂ) + (d : ℂ) * Complex.I =
          a + (-1 : ℝ) * (d : ℂ) + (1 : ℝ) * (d : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        norm_num; ring
      rw [heq]
      exact hdist (-1) 1 (Or.inr rfl) (Or.inl rfl)
    · constructor <;> simp [d, hr]
  · refine ⟨a + (d : ℂ) + (d : ℂ) * Complex.I, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]
      have heq : a + (d : ℂ) + (d : ℂ) * Complex.I =
          a + (1 : ℝ) * (d : ℂ) + (1 : ℝ) * (d : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        norm_num
      rw [heq]
      exact hdist 1 1 (Or.inl rfl) (Or.inl rfl)
    · constructor <;> simp [d, hr]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.quadrant_mem_closure_of_weak
statement:
private theorem quadrant_mem_closure_of_weak
    (q : Quadrant) (a x : Tiling.Plane) :
    (match q with
      | .southwest => x.re ≤ a.re ∧ x.im ≤ a.im
      | .southeast => a.re ≤ x.re ∧ x.im ≤ a.im
      | .northwest => x.re ≤ a.re ∧ a.im ≤ x.im
      | .northeast => a.re ≤ x.re ∧ a.im ≤ x.im) →
      x ∈ closure (quadrantAt q a)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply Metric.mem_closure_iff.2
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨y, ⟨hyball, hyq⟩⟩ := quadrant_ball_nonempty hε q
  refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · cases q <;> dsimp [quadrantAt] at hyq ⊢
    · exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hyq.1 h.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hyq.2 h.2⟩
    · exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt h.1 hyq.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hyq.2 h.2⟩
    · exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hyq.1 h.1, lt_of_le_of_lt h.2 hyq.2⟩
    · exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt h.1 hyq.1, lt_of_le_of_lt h.2 hyq.2⟩
  · simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hyball

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.localQuadrantConstancy
statement:
private theorem localQuadrantConstancy
    {F : Set Tiling.Plane} {a : Tiling.Plane} (hopen : IsOpen F)
    (hcross : ∃ r > 0, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball a r, z ∈ frontier F →
      z.re = a.re ∨ z.im = a.im) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∀ q : Quadrant,
      (Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a ⊆ F ∨
        Disjoint (Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a) F)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, h₀⟩ := quadrant_constancy_of_frontier_cross .southwest hopen hcross
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, h₁⟩ := quadrant_constancy_of_frontier_cross .southeast hopen hcross
  obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, h₂⟩ := quadrant_constancy_of_frontier_cross .northwest hopen hcross
  obtain ⟨r₃, hr₃, h₃⟩ := quadrant_constancy_of_frontier_cross .northeast hopen hcross
  let r := min r₀ (min r₁ (min r₂ r₃))
  refine ⟨r, lt_min hr₀ (lt_min hr₁ (lt_min hr₂ hr₃)), ?_⟩
  have hr₀' : r ≤ r₀ := min_le_left _ _
  have hr₁' : r ≤ r₁ := (min_le_right r₀ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hr₂' : r ≤ r₂ := (min_le_right r₀ _).trans
    ((min_le_right r₁ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
  have hr₃' : r ≤ r₃ := (min_le_right r₀ _).trans
    ((min_le_right r₁ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
  intro q
  cases q
  · rcases h₀ with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (fun z hz => h (inter_subset_inter
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₀') Set.Subset.rfl hz))
    · exact Or.inr (h.mono_left (inter_subset_inter
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₀') Set.Subset.rfl))
  · rcases h₁ with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (fun z hz => h (inter_subset_inter
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₁')
          Set.Subset.rfl hz))
    · exact Or.inr (h.mono_left (inter_subset_inter
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₁')
          Set.Subset.rfl))
  · rcases h₂ with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (fun z hz => h (inter_subset_inter
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₂') Set.Subset.rfl hz))
    · exact Or.inr (h.mono_left (inter_subset_inter
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₂') Set.Subset.rfl))
  · rcases h₃ with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (fun z hz => h (inter_subset_inter
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₃')
          Set.Subset.rfl hz))
    · exact Or.inr (h.mono_left (inter_subset_inter
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₃')
          Set.Subset.rfl))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.localQuadrantOccupies_iff_full
statement:
private theorem localQuadrantOccupies_iff_full
    {F : Set Tiling.Plane} {a : Tiling.Plane} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hconst : ∀ q : Quadrant,
      (Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a ⊆ F ∨
        Disjoint (Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a) F)) (q : Quadrant) :
    SetOccupiesQuadrant F a q ↔ Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a ⊆ F
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hocc
    rcases hconst q with hfull | hdisj
    · exact hfull
    · rcases hocc with ⟨s, hs, hsub⟩
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := quadrant_ball_nonempty (lt_min hr hs) q
      have hzsmall : z ∈ Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a :=
        inter_subset_inter (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
          Set.Subset.rfl hz
      have hzocc : z ∈ F := hsub (inter_subset_inter
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)) Set.Subset.rfl hz)
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hzsmall hzocc
  · intro hfull
    exact ⟨r, hr, hfull⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.localOffAxis_membership
statement:
private theorem localOffAxis_membership
    {F : Set Tiling.Plane} {a : Tiling.Plane} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r)
    (hconst : ∀ q : Quadrant,
      (Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a ⊆ F ∨
        Disjoint (Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a) F))
    {x : Tiling.Plane} (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball a r)
