    (hxa : x.re ≠ a.re) (hya : x.im ≠ a.im) :
    ∃ q : Quadrant, x ∈ quadrantAt q a ∧
      (x ∈ F ↔ SetOccupiesQuadrant F a q)
proof:
:= by
  have hbranch (q : Quadrant) (hq : x ∈ quadrantAt q a) :
      x ∈ F ↔ SetOccupiesQuadrant F a q := by
    rcases hconst q with hfull | hdisj
    · constructor
      · intro _
        exact ⟨r, hr, hfull⟩
      · intro _
        exact hfull ⟨hx, hq⟩
    · constructor
      · intro hxf
        exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj ⟨hx, hq⟩ hxf)
      · intro hocc
        rcases hocc with ⟨s, hs, hsub⟩
        obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := quadrant_ball_nonempty (lt_min hr hs) q
        have hzsmall : z ∈ Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a :=
          inter_subset_inter (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
            Set.Subset.rfl hz
        have hzocc := hsub (inter_subset_inter
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)) Set.Subset.rfl hz)
        exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hzsmall hzocc)
  cases lt_or_gt_of_ne hxa with
  | inl hre =>
    cases lt_or_gt_of_ne hya with
    | inl him => exact ⟨.southwest, by dsimp [quadrantAt]; exact ⟨hre, him⟩,
        hbranch .southwest ⟨hre, him⟩⟩
    | inr him => exact ⟨.northwest, by dsimp [quadrantAt]; exact ⟨hre, him⟩,
        hbranch .northwest ⟨hre, him⟩⟩
  | inr hre =>
    cases lt_or_gt_of_ne hya with
    | inl him => exact ⟨.southeast, by dsimp [quadrantAt]; exact ⟨hre, him⟩,
        hbranch .southeast ⟨hre, him⟩⟩
    | inr him => exact ⟨.northeast, by dsimp [quadrantAt]; exact ⟨hre, him⟩,
        hbranch .northeast ⟨hre, him⟩⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.closure_inter_open_of_mem_closure
statement:
private theorem closure_inter_open_of_mem_closure
    {S U : Set Tiling.Plane} {x : Tiling.Plane}
    (hxS : x ∈ closure S) (hU : IsOpen U) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
    x ∈ closure (S ∩ U)
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_closure_iff.2
  intro V hV hxV
  obtain ⟨y, hyV, hyS⟩ := mem_closure_iff.1 hxS
    (V ∩ U) (hV.inter hU) ⟨hxV, hxU⟩
  exact ⟨y, hyV.1, ⟨hyS, hyV.2⟩⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.frontier_of_quadrant_change
statement:
private theorem frontier_of_quadrant_change
    {D : Set Tiling.Plane} {a x : Tiling.Plane} {r : ℝ}
    (p : QuadrantPattern)
    {q₁ q₂ : Quadrant}
    (hchange : p q₁ ≠ p q₂)
    (hpattern : ∀ q z, z ∈ Metric.ball a r → z ∈ quadrantAt q a →
      (z ∈ D ↔ p q = true))
    (hxball : x ∈ Metric.ball a r)
    (hxq₁ : x ∈ closure (quadrantAt q₁ a))
    (hxq₂ : x ∈ closure (quadrantAt q₂ a)) :
    x ∈ frontier D
proof:
:= by
  have hfull (q : Quadrant) (hq : p q = true) :
      Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a ⊆ D := by
    intro z hz
    exact (hpattern q z hz.1 hz.2).mpr hq
  have hempty (q : Quadrant) (hq : p q ≠ true) :
      Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a ⊆ Dᶜ := by
    intro z hz hzd
    exact hq ((hpattern q z hz.1 hz.2).mp hzd)
  rw [frontier_eq_closure_inter_closure]
  by_cases hq₁' : p q₁ = true
  · have hq₂' : p q₂ ≠ true := by
      intro hq₂'
      exact hchange (hq₁'.trans hq₂'.symm)
    exact ⟨closure_mono (hfull q₁ hq₁')
        (by simpa only [inter_comm] using
          closure_inter_open_of_mem_closure hxq₁ Metric.isOpen_ball hxball),
      closure_mono (hempty q₂ hq₂')
        (by simpa only [inter_comm] using
          closure_inter_open_of_mem_closure hxq₂ Metric.isOpen_ball hxball)⟩
  · have hq₁'' : p q₁ = false := by
      rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (p q₁) with h | h
      · exact False.elim (hq₁' h)
      · exact h
    have hq₂' : p q₂ = true := by
      rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (p q₂) with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact False.elim (hchange (hq₁''.trans h.symm))
    exact ⟨closure_mono (hfull q₂ hq₂')
        (by simpa only [inter_comm] using
          closure_inter_open_of_mem_closure hxq₂ Metric.isOpen_ball hxball),
      closure_mono (hempty q₁ (by
          intro h; rw [hq₁''] at h; cases h))
        (by simpa only [inter_comm] using
          closure_inter_open_of_mem_closure hxq₁ Metric.isOpen_ball hxball)⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.exists_quadrantPattern_germ_of_localBoundaryCross
statement:
theorem exists_quadrantPattern_germ_of_localBoundaryCross
    {D : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hopen : IsOpen D)
    (_hregular : interior (closure D) = D)
    (a : Tiling.Plane)
    (hcross : ∃ r > 0, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball a r, z ∈ frontier D →
      z.re = a.re ∨ z.im = a.im) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∃ p : QuadrantPattern,
      QuadrantGermOccupancy D a r p ∧
        ∀ q, (p q = true ↔ SetOccupiesQuadrant D a q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hconst⟩ := localQuadrantConstancy hopen hcross
  let p : QuadrantPattern := fun q =>
    if SetOccupiesQuadrant D a q then true else false
  refine ⟨r, hr, p, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro q z hz hq
    by_cases hocc : SetOccupiesQuadrant D a q
    · have hfull : Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a ⊆ D :=
        (localQuadrantOccupies_iff_full hr hconst q).mp hocc
      have hp : p q = true := by
        dsimp [p]
        rw [if_pos hocc]
      rw [hp]
      constructor
      · intro _
        rfl
      · intro _
        exact hfull ⟨hz, hq⟩
    · have hdisj : Disjoint (Metric.ball a r ∩ quadrantAt q a) D := by
        rcases hconst q with hfull | hdisj
        · exact False.elim (hocc ((localQuadrantOccupies_iff_full hr hconst q).mpr hfull))
        · exact hdisj
      have hp : p q = false := by
        dsimp [p]
        rw [if_neg hocc]
      rw [hp]
      constructor
      · intro hzd
        exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj ⟨hz, hq⟩ hzd)
      · intro hfalse
        cases hfalse
  · intro q
    simp [p]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.exists_quadrantPattern_germ
statement:
theorem exists_quadrantPattern_germ
    {D : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hopen : IsOpen D)
    (_hregular : interior (closure D) = D)
    (hpolygonal : Tiling.AxisParallel.IsLocallyAxisParallelPolygonal D)
    (a : Tiling.Plane) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∃ p : QuadrantPattern,
      QuadrantGermOccupancy D a r p ∧
        ∀ q, (p q = true ↔ SetOccupiesQuadrant D a q)
proof:
:= by
  exact exists_quadrantPattern_germ_of_localBoundaryCross hopen _hregular a
    (Tiling.AxisParallel.exists_ball_frontier_subset_axisCross hpolygonal a)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.nonstraightPattern_classification
statement:
theorem nonstraightPattern_classification (p : QuadrantPattern)
    (h : nonstraightPattern p) :
    oneOrThreePattern p ∨ oppositePairPattern p
proof:
:= by
  rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (p .southwest) with hsw | hsw <;>
    rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (p .southeast) with hse | hse <;>
    rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (p .northwest) with hnw | hnw <;>
    rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (p .northeast) with hne | hne <;>
    simp [nonstraightPattern, straightPattern, oneOrThreePattern,
      oppositePairPattern, hsw, hse, hnw, hne] at h ⊢

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.nonstraightPattern_has_both_axis_changes
statement:
theorem nonstraightPattern_has_both_axis_changes (p : QuadrantPattern)
    (hnon : nonstraightPattern p) :
    (p .northwest ≠ p .southwest ∨ p .northeast ≠ p .southeast) ∧
      (p .northwest ≠ p .northeast ∨ p .southwest ≠ p .southeast)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hnon (Or.inr ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.symm⟩)
  · by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hnon (Or.inl ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.exists_signedAxisFrontier_of_nonstraightPattern
statement:
private theorem exists_signedAxisFrontier_of_nonstraightPattern
    {D : Set Tiling.Plane} {a : Tiling.Plane} {r : ℝ}
    (_hr : 0 < r) (p : QuadrantPattern)
    (hg : QuadrantGermOccupancy D a r p)
    (hnon : nonstraightPattern p) :
    SignedAxisFrontierGerm D a (r / 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hreal, himag⟩ := nonstraightPattern_has_both_axis_changes p hnon
  have hballRPos (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (htr : t < r / 2) :
      a + (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Metric.ball a r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq]
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos ht]
    linarith
  have hballRNeg (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (htr : t < r / 2) :
      a - (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Metric.ball a r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq]
    rw [show a - (t : Tiling.Plane) - a = -(t : Tiling.Plane) by ring]
    simp only [norm_neg, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht]
    linarith
  have hballIPos (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (htr : t < r / 2) :
      a + (t : Tiling.Plane) * Complex.I ∈ Metric.ball a r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq]
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
    linarith
  have hballINeg (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (htr : t < r / 2) :
      a - (t : Tiling.Plane) * Complex.I ∈ Metric.ball a r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq]
    rw [show a - (t : Tiling.Plane) * Complex.I - a =
      -((t : Tiling.Plane) * Complex.I) by ring]
    simp only [norm_neg, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
    linarith
  have hreal' : ∃ sx : ℝ, (sx = 1 ∨ sx = -1) ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r / 2 →
        a + sx * (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ frontier D := by
    rcases hreal with h | h
    · refine ⟨-1, Or.inr rfl, ?_⟩
      intro t ht htr
      have hf := frontier_of_quadrant_change p h hg (hballRNeg t ht htr)
        (by
          apply quadrant_mem_closure_of_weak .northwest a
          dsimp
          constructor
          · linarith
          · linarith)
        (by
          apply quadrant_mem_closure_of_weak .southwest a
          dsimp
          constructor
          · linarith
          · linarith)
      convert hf using 1
      norm_num [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
      ring
    · refine ⟨1, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
      intro t ht htr
      have hf := frontier_of_quadrant_change p h hg (hballRPos t ht htr)
        (by
          apply quadrant_mem_closure_of_weak .northeast a
          dsimp
          constructor
          · linarith
          · linarith)
        (by
          apply quadrant_mem_closure_of_weak .southeast a
          dsimp
          constructor
          · linarith
          · linarith)
      convert hf using 1
      norm_num [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
  have himag' : ∃ sy : ℝ, (sy = 1 ∨ sy = -1) ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r / 2 →
        a + sy * (t : Tiling.Plane) * Complex.I ∈ frontier D := by
    rcases himag with h | h
    · refine ⟨1, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
      intro t ht htr
      have hf := frontier_of_quadrant_change p h hg (hballIPos t ht htr)
        (by
          apply quadrant_mem_closure_of_weak .northwest a
          dsimp
          constructor
          · norm_num [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
          · norm_num [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
            linarith)
        (by
          apply quadrant_mem_closure_of_weak .northeast a
          dsimp
          constructor
          · norm_num [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
          · norm_num [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
            linarith)
      convert hf using 1
      norm_num [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
    · refine ⟨-1, Or.inr rfl, ?_⟩
      intro t ht htr
      have hf := frontier_of_quadrant_change p h hg (hballINeg t ht htr)
        (by
          apply quadrant_mem_closure_of_weak .southwest a
          dsimp
          constructor
          · norm_num [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
          · have him : ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = t := by norm_num
            rw [him]
            linarith)
        (by
          apply quadrant_mem_closure_of_weak .southeast a
          dsimp
          constructor
          · norm_num [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
          · have him : ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = t := by norm_num
            rw [him]
            linarith)
      convert hf using 1
      norm_num [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
      ring
  obtain ⟨sx, hsx, hsxfront⟩ := hreal'
  obtain ⟨sy, hsy, hsyfront⟩ := himag'
  exact ⟨sx, sy, hsx, hsy, fun t ht htr => ⟨hsxfront t ht htr, hsyfront t ht htr⟩⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.not_boundaryLocallyStraight_of_signedAxisFrontier
statement:
private theorem not_boundaryLocallyStraight_of_signedAxisFrontier
    {D : Set Tiling.Plane} {a : Tiling.Plane} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hfront : SignedAxisFrontierGerm D a r) :
    ¬Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt D a
proof:
:= by
  intro hstraight
  obtain ⟨L, haL, hdim, hlocal⟩ := hstraight
  obtain ⟨sx, sy, hsx, hsy, hfront⟩ := hfront
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hlocal
  let t : ℝ := min (r / 2) (ε / 2)
  have ht : 0 < t := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact lt_min (half_pos hr) (half_pos hε)
  have htR : t < r := by
    dsimp [t]
    linarith [min_le_left (r / 2) (ε / 2)]
  have htε : t < ε := by
    dsimp [t]
    linarith [min_le_right (r / 2) (ε / 2)]
  have hballR : a + (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Metric.ball a ε := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq]
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht]
    exact htε
  have hballI : a + (t : Tiling.Plane) * Complex.I ∈ Metric.ball a ε := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq]
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos ht, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
    exact htε
  have hxL : a + (sx : Tiling.Plane) * (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ L := by
    have hdist : dist (a + (sx : Tiling.Plane) * (t : Tiling.Plane)) a < ε := by
      rcases hsx with rfl | rfl
      · simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hballR
      · have hballRneg : a - (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Metric.ball a ε := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq]
          rw [show a - (t : Tiling.Plane) - a = -(t : Tiling.Plane) by ring]
          simp only [norm_neg, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht]
          exact htε
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hballRneg
    exact (hεball hdist).mp (hfront t ht htR |>.1)
  have hyL : a + (sy : Tiling.Plane) * (t : Tiling.Plane) * Complex.I ∈ L := by
    have hdist : dist (a + (sy : Tiling.Plane) * (t : Tiling.Plane) * Complex.I) a < ε := by
      rcases hsy with rfl | rfl
      · simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hballI
      · have hballIneg : a - (t : Tiling.Plane) * Complex.I ∈ Metric.ball a ε := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq]
          rw [show a - (t : Tiling.Plane) * Complex.I - a =
            -((t : Tiling.Plane) * Complex.I) by ring]
          simp only [norm_neg, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
            abs_of_pos ht, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
          exact htε
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hballIneg
    exact (hεball hdist).mp (hfront t ht htR |>.2)
  have hxdir : (sx : Tiling.Plane) * (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ L.direction := by
    have h := L.vsub_mem_direction hxL haL
    rw [vsub_eq_sub] at h
    convert h using 1
    all_goals abel
  have hydir : (sy : Tiling.Plane) * (t : Tiling.Plane) * Complex.I ∈ L.direction := by
    have h := L.vsub_mem_direction hyL haL
    rw [vsub_eq_sub] at h
    convert h using 1
    all_goals abel
  have h1 : (1 : Tiling.Plane) ∈ L.direction := by
    rcases hsx with rfl | rfl
    · have h := L.direction.smul_mem (t⁻¹) hxdir
      convert h using 1
      all_goals apply Complex.ext
      all_goals norm_num
      all_goals field_simp
    · have h := L.direction.smul_mem (-t⁻¹) hxdir
      convert h using 1
      all_goals apply Complex.ext
      all_goals norm_num
      all_goals field_simp
  have hI : Complex.I ∈ L.direction := by
    rcases hsy with rfl | rfl
    · have h := L.direction.smul_mem (t⁻¹) hydir
      convert h using 1
      all_goals apply Complex.ext
      all_goals norm_num
      all_goals field_simp
    · have h := L.direction.smul_mem (-t⁻¹) hydir
      convert h using 1
      all_goals apply Complex.ext
      all_goals norm_num
      all_goals field_simp
  have htop : L.direction = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← Complex.basisOneI.span_eq]
    apply Submodule.span_le.2
    intro v hv
    rcases hv with ⟨i, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [Complex.coe_basisOneI] using h1
    · simpa [Complex.coe_basisOneI] using hI
  have : Module.finrank ℝ L.direction = 2 := by
    rw [htop, finrank_top, Complex.finrank_real_complex]
  omega

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.anchor_mem_frontier_of_nonstraightPattern
statement:
private theorem anchor_mem_frontier_of_nonstraightPattern
    {D : Set Tiling.Plane} {a : Tiling.Plane} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (p : QuadrantPattern)
    (hg : QuadrantGermOccupancy D a r p)
    (hnon : nonstraightPattern p) :
    a ∈ frontier D
proof:
:= by
  have htrue : ∃ q, p q = true := by
    by_contra hnone
    have hfalse (q : Quadrant) : p q = false := by
      rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (p q) with h | h
      · exact False.elim (hnone ⟨q, h⟩)
      · exact h
    exact hnon (Or.inl ⟨hfalse .southwest |>.trans (hfalse .southeast).symm,
      hfalse .northwest |>.trans (hfalse .northeast).symm⟩)
  have hfalse : ∃ q, p q ≠ true := by
    by_cases h : ∃ q, p q ≠ true
    · exact h
    · have hall (q : Quadrant) : p q = true := by
        by_contra hq
        exact h ⟨q, hq⟩
      exact False.elim (hnon (Or.inl ⟨hall .southwest |>.trans (hall .southeast).symm,
        hall .northwest |>.trans (hall .northeast).symm⟩))
  have hcl : a ∈ closure D := by
    apply Metric.mem_closure_iff.2
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := htrue
    let δ : ℝ := min ε r
    have hδ : 0 < δ := lt_min hε hr
    obtain ⟨z, hzball, hzq⟩ := quadrant_ball_nonempty hδ q
    have hzballR : z ∈ Metric.ball a r :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right ε r) hzball
    refine ⟨z, (hg q z hzballR hzq).mpr hq, ?_⟩
    have hdist : dist z a < δ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hzball
    simpa [dist_comm] using hdist.trans_le (min_le_left ε r)
  have hclc : a ∈ closure Dᶜ := by
    apply Metric.mem_closure_iff.2
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hfalse
    let δ : ℝ := min ε r
    have hδ : 0 < δ := lt_min hε hr
    obtain ⟨z, hzball, hzq⟩ := quadrant_ball_nonempty hδ q
    have hzballR : z ∈ Metric.ball a r :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right ε r) hzball
    have hznot : z ∉ D := by
      intro hz
      exact hq ((hg q z hzballR hzq).mp hz)
    refine ⟨z, hznot, ?_⟩
    have hdist : dist z a < δ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hzball
    simpa [dist_comm] using hdist.trans_le (min_le_left ε r)
  rw [frontier_eq_closure_inter_closure]
  exact ⟨hcl, hclc⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.properVertex_of_nonstraightPattern
statement:
theorem properVertex_of_nonstraightPattern
    {D : Set Tiling.Plane} {a : Tiling.Plane} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (p : QuadrantPattern)
    (hg : QuadrantGermOccupancy D a r p)
    (hnon : nonstraightPattern p) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.IsProperVertex D a
proof:
:= by
  have hfront : SignedAxisFrontierGerm D a (r / 2) :=
    exists_signedAxisFrontier_of_nonstraightPattern hr p hg hnon
  refine ⟨anchor_mem_frontier_of_nonstraightPattern hr p hg hnon, ?_⟩
  exact not_boundaryLocallyStraight_of_signedAxisFrontier (half_pos hr) hfront

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.dense_ne_coordinates
statement:
private theorem dense_ne_coordinates (p : Tiling.Plane) :
    Dense {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ≠ p.re ∧ z.im ≠ p.im}
proof:
:= by
  rw [dense_iff_inter_open]
  intro U hU hUNonempty
  obtain ⟨w, hwU⟩ := hUNonempty
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU w hwU
  by_cases hre : p.re ≤ w.re
  · by_cases him : p.im ≤ w.im
    · obtain ⟨z, hzBall, hzQ⟩ := quadrant_ball_nonempty hr .northeast
      refine ⟨z, hball hzBall, ?_⟩
      dsimp [quadrantAt] at hzQ ⊢
      exact ⟨ne_of_gt (hre.trans_lt hzQ.1), ne_of_gt (him.trans_lt hzQ.2)⟩
    · obtain ⟨z, hzBall, hzQ⟩ := quadrant_ball_nonempty hr .southeast
      refine ⟨z, hball hzBall, ?_⟩
      dsimp [quadrantAt] at hzQ ⊢
      have hwim : w.im < p.im := lt_of_not_ge him
      exact ⟨ne_of_gt (hre.trans_lt hzQ.1), ne_of_lt (hzQ.2.trans hwim)⟩
  · have hwre : w.re < p.re := lt_of_not_ge hre
    by_cases him : p.im ≤ w.im
    · obtain ⟨z, hzBall, hzQ⟩ := quadrant_ball_nonempty hr .northwest
      refine ⟨z, hball hzBall, ?_⟩
      dsimp [quadrantAt] at hzQ ⊢
      exact ⟨ne_of_lt (hzQ.1.trans hwre), ne_of_gt (him.trans_lt hzQ.2)⟩
    · obtain ⟨z, hzBall, hzQ⟩ := quadrant_ball_nonempty hr .southwest
      refine ⟨z, hball hzBall, ?_⟩
      dsimp [quadrantAt] at hzQ ⊢
      have hwim : w.im < p.im := lt_of_not_ge him
      exact ⟨ne_of_lt (hzQ.1.trans hwre), ne_of_lt (hzQ.2.trans hwim)⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.eventually_mem_iff_of_regularOpen_of_off_cross
statement:
theorem eventually_mem_iff_of_regularOpen_of_off_cross
    {S T : Set Tiling.Plane} {p : Tiling.Plane}
    (hSOpen : IsOpen S) (hTOpen : IsOpen T)
    (hSRegular : interior (closure S) = S)
    (hTRegular : interior (closure T) = T)
    (hOffCross : ∀ᶠ z in nhds p,
      z.re ≠ p.re ∧ z.im ≠ p.im → (z ∈ S ↔ z ∈ T)) :
    ∀ᶠ z in nhds p, (z ∈ S ↔ z ∈ T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hOffCross
  have oneDirection
      {A B : Set Tiling.Plane}
      (hAOpen : IsOpen A)
      (hBRegular : interior (closure B) = B)
      (hLocal : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p R,
        z.re ≠ p.re ∧ z.im ≠ p.im → (z ∈ A → z ∈ B)) :
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p (R / 2), z ∈ A → z ∈ B := by
    intro z hzBall hzA
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεA⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hAOpen z hzA
    have hzR : dist z p < R := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hzBall
      linarith
    let δ : ℝ := min (ε / 2) ((R - dist z p) / 2)
    have hδ : 0 < δ := by
      dsimp only [δ]
      exact lt_min (half_pos hε) (half_pos (sub_pos.mpr hzR))
    have hBallClosure : Metric.ball z δ ⊆ closure B := by
      intro w hwBall
      rw [mem_closure_iff]
      intro U hU hwU
      have hVOpen : IsOpen (U ∩ Metric.ball z δ) := hU.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hVNonempty : (U ∩ Metric.ball z δ).Nonempty := ⟨w, hwU, hwBall⟩
      obtain ⟨y, hyCoord, hyU, hyBall⟩ :=
        (dense_ne_coordinates p).exists_mem_open hVOpen hVNonempty
      refine ⟨y, hyU, ?_⟩
      apply hLocal y
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hyBall ⊢
        calc
          dist y p ≤ dist y z + dist z p := dist_triangle _ _ _
          _ < δ + dist z p := by linarith
          _ ≤ (R - dist z p) / 2 + dist z p := by
            gcongr
            exact min_le_right _ _
          _ < R := by linarith
      · exact hyCoord
      · apply hεA
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hyBall ⊢
        calc
          dist y z < δ := hyBall
          _ ≤ ε / 2 := min_le_left _ _
          _ < ε := half_lt_self hε
    rw [← hBRegular]
    exact interior_maximal hBallClosure Metric.isOpen_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)
  filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds p (half_pos hR)] with z hzBall
  constructor
  · exact oneDirection hSOpen hTRegular (fun w hwR hwD =>
      (hball (by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball] using hwR) hwD).mp) z hzBall
  · exact oneDirection hTOpen hSRegular (fun w hwR hwD =>
      (hball (by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball] using hwR) hwD).mpr) z hzBall

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.mem_frontier_iff_of_eventually_mem_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_frontier_iff_of_eventually_mem_iff
    {S T : Set Tiling.Plane} {x : Tiling.Plane}
    (h : ∀ᶠ z in nhds x, (z ∈ S ↔ z ∈ T)) :
    x ∈ frontier S ↔ x ∈ frontier T
proof:
:= by
  have closureIff (A B : Set Tiling.Plane)
      (hAB : ∀ᶠ z in nhds x, (z ∈ A ↔ z ∈ B)) :
      x ∈ closure A ↔ x ∈ closure B := by
    rw [mem_closure_iff_frequently, mem_closure_iff_frequently]
    constructor
    · intro hA
      exact (hA.and_eventually hAB).mono fun z hz => hz.2.mp hz.1
    · intro hB
      exact (hB.and_eventually hAB).mono fun z hz => hz.2.mpr hz.1
  rw [frontier_eq_closure_inter_closure,
    frontier_eq_closure_inter_closure, mem_inter_iff, mem_inter_iff,
    closureIff S T h, closureIff Sᶜ Tᶜ (h.mono fun _ hz => not_congr hz)]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.eventually_frontier_iff_of_eventually_mem_iff
statement:
private theorem eventually_frontier_iff_of_eventually_mem_iff
    {S T : Set Tiling.Plane} {x : Tiling.Plane}
    (h : ∀ᶠ z in nhds x, (z ∈ S ↔ z ∈ T)) :
    ∀ᶠ y in nhds x, (y ∈ frontier S ↔ y ∈ frontier T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hUsub, hUOpen, hxU⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp h
  filter_upwards [hUOpen.mem_nhds hxU] with y hyU
  apply mem_frontier_iff_of_eventually_mem_iff
  exact Filter.mem_of_superset (hUOpen.mem_nhds hyU) hUsub

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.boundaryLocallyStraight_im_gt
statement:
private theorem boundaryLocallyStraight_im_gt (a : Tiling.Plane) :
    Tiling.BoundaryLocallyStraightAt {z : Tiling.Plane | a.im < z.im} a
proof:
:= by
  let H : Set Tiling.Plane := {z : Tiling.Plane | a.im < z.im}
  have hmem (z : Tiling.Plane) :
      z ∈ (AffineSubspace.mk' a (ℝ ∙ (1 : Tiling.Plane)) : Set Tiling.Plane) ↔
        z.im = a.im := by
    change z -ᵥ a ∈ (ℝ ∙ (1 : Tiling.Plane)) ↔ z.im = a.im
    rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
      have h := congrArg Complex.im hc
      simp only [vsub_eq_sub, Complex.sub_im, Complex.smul_im, Complex.one_im,
        smul_eq_mul, mul_zero] at h
      linarith
    · intro h
      refine ⟨z.re - a.re, ?_⟩
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp only [vsub_eq_sub, Complex.sub_re, Complex.smul_re, Complex.one_re,
          smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      · simp only [vsub_eq_sub, Complex.sub_im, Complex.smul_im, Complex.one_im,
          smul_eq_mul, mul_zero]
        linarith
  refine ⟨AffineSubspace.mk' a (ℝ ∙ (1 : Tiling.Plane)), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact AffineSubspace.self_mem_mk' a _
  · rw [AffineSubspace.direction_mk']
    exact finrank_span_singleton one_ne_zero
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => by
      rw [show frontier H = {z : Tiling.Plane | z.im = a.im} by
        ext y
        simp [H, Complex.frontier_setOfPred_lt_im]]
      simpa only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using (hmem z).symm)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.not_properVertex_of_horizontal_upper_germ
statement:
private theorem not_properVertex_of_horizontal_upper_germ
    {D : Set Tiling.Plane} {a : Tiling.Plane} {r : ℝ}
    (hopen : IsOpen D) (hregular : interior (closure D) = D)
    (hr : 0 < r) (p : QuadrantPattern)
    (hg : QuadrantGermOccupancy D a r p)
    (hsw : p .southwest = false) (hnw : p .northwest = true)
    (hrow : p .southwest = p .southeast ∧ p .northwest = p .northeast) :
    ¬Tiling.AxisParallel.IsProperVertex D a
proof:
:= by
  have hoff : ∀ᶠ z in nhds a,
      z.re ≠ a.re ∧ z.im ≠ a.im →
        (z ∈ D ↔ z ∈ {w : Tiling.Plane | a.im < w.im}) := by
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds a hr] with z hz hzoff
    obtain ⟨q, hzq⟩ : ∃ q : Quadrant, z ∈ quadrantAt q a := by
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hzoff.1 with hre | hre <;>
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hzoff.2 with him | him
      · exact ⟨.southwest, by dsimp [quadrantAt]; exact ⟨hre, him⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨.northwest, by dsimp [quadrantAt]; exact ⟨hre, him⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨.southeast, by dsimp [quadrantAt]; exact ⟨hre, him⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨.northeast, by dsimp [quadrantAt]; exact ⟨hre, him⟩⟩
    have hD := hg q z hz hzq
    have hse : p .southeast = false := by rw [← hrow.1]; exact hsw
    have hne : p .northeast = true := by rw [← hrow.2]; exact hnw
    cases q
    all_goals simp only [quadrantAt] at hzq
    · have hnot : ¬ a.im < z.im := not_lt_of_ge (le_of_lt hzq.2)
      simpa [hsw, hnot] using hD
    · have hnot : ¬ a.im < z.im := not_lt_of_ge (le_of_lt hzq.2)
      simpa [hse, hnot] using hD
    · have hyes : a.im < z.im := hzq.2
      simpa [hnw, hyes] using hD
    · have hyes : a.im < z.im := hzq.2
      simpa [hne, hyes] using hD
  have hmodelOpen : IsOpen {w : Tiling.Plane | a.im < w.im} :=
    isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im
  have hmodelRegular : interior (closure {w : Tiling.Plane | a.im < w.im}) =
      {w : Tiling.Plane | a.im < w.im} := by
    let H : Set Tiling.Plane := {w : Tiling.Plane | a.im < w.im}
    have hconv : Convex ℝ H := by
      dsimp [H]
      exact convex_halfSpace_gt Complex.imLm.isLinear a.im
    have hopenH : IsOpen H := by
      dsimp [H]
      exact isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im
    have hnonempty : (interior H).Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨a + Complex.I, ?_⟩
      exact mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr (hopenH.mem_nhds (by simp [H]))
    rw [hconv.interior_closure_eq_interior_of_nonempty_interior hnonempty]
    exact hopenH.interior_eq
  have hmem := eventually_mem_iff_of_regularOpen_of_off_cross hopen hmodelOpen
    hregular hmodelRegular hoff
  exact fun hproper => hproper.2
    (boundaryLocallyStraight_of_eventually_eq_im_gt hmem)

    (hr : 0 < r) (p : QuadrantPattern)
    (hg : QuadrantGermOccupancy D a r p) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.IsProperVertex D a ↔ nonstraightPattern p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hproper
    change ¬straightPattern p
    intro hstraight
    rcases hstraight with hrow | hcol
    · exact not_properVertex_of_horizontal_straight_germ
        hopen hregular hr p hg hrow hproper
    · exact not_properVertex_of_vertical_straight_germ
        hopen hregular hr p hg hcol hproper
  · exact properVertex_of_nonstraightPattern hr p hg

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.segment_subset_frontier_of_openSegment
statement:
private theorem segment_subset_frontier_of_openSegment
    {K : Region} {a b : Plane}
    (h : openSegment ℝ a b ⊆ frontier K.support) :
    segment ℝ a b ⊆ frontier K.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [← closure_openSegment a b]
  exact closure_minimal h isClosed_frontier

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.intrinsicBoundaryEdges_finite
statement:
theorem intrinsicBoundaryEdges_finite (K : Region) :
    (intrinsicBoundaryEdges K).Finite
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Finite.subset
    (K.isPolygonal.vertexSet_finite.prod K.isPolygonal.vertexSet_finite)
  intro e he
  exact ⟨he.1, he.2.1⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.frontier_eq_intrinsicBoundaryEdges
statement:
theorem frontier_eq_intrinsicBoundaryEdges (K : Region) :
    frontier K.support = ⋃ e ∈ intrinsicBoundaryEdges K, segment ℝ e.1 e.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    by_cases hv : x ∈ K.vertices
    · obtain ⟨w, hne, halign, hopen⟩ :=
        Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.intrinsicVertex_incident_axisEdge
          K .horizontal ⟨x, hv⟩
      have hopen' : openSegment ℝ x w.1 ⊆ frontier K.support :=
        fun z hz => (hopen hz).1
      have hseg := segment_subset_frontier_of_openSegment hopen'
      have hmem : (x, w.1) ∈ intrinsicBoundaryEdges K := by
        refine ⟨hv, w.2, (fun h => hne h.symm), ?_, hseg⟩
        exact Or.inr (by simpa [Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.transverseCoord] using halign.symm)
      exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(x, w.1), mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hmem, left_mem_segment ℝ _ _⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨axis, v, w, hne, halign, hxseg, hopen⟩ :=
        Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.nonvertexFrontier_mem_intrinsicEdge
          K x hx hv
      have hopen' : openSegment ℝ v.1 w.1 ⊆ frontier K.support :=
        fun z hz => (hopen hz).1
      have hseg := segment_subset_frontier_of_openSegment hopen'
      have hmem : (v.1, w.1) ∈ intrinsicBoundaryEdges K := by
        refine ⟨v.2, w.2, hne, ?_, hseg⟩
        cases axis with
        | horizontal => exact Or.inr halign
        | vertical => exact Or.inl halign
      exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(v.1, w.1), mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hmem,
        openSegment_subset_segment ℝ _ _ hxseg⟩⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨e, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    obtain ⟨he, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact he.2.2.2.2 hx

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.positiveSimilarityHomeomorph_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveSimilarityHomeomorph_apply
    (s : ℝ) (b z : Tiling.Plane) (hs : 0 < s) :
    positiveSimilarityHomeomorph s b hs z = positiveSimilarity s b z
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.positiveSimilarity_injective
statement:
theorem positiveSimilarity_injective
    {s : ℝ} {b : Tiling.Plane} (hs : 0 < s) :
    Function.Injective (positiveSimilarity s b)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  exact (positiveSimilarityHomeomorph s b hs).injective hxy

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.positiveSimilarity_surjective
statement:
theorem positiveSimilarity_surjective
    {s : ℝ} {b : Tiling.Plane} (hs : 0 < s) :
    Function.Surjective (positiveSimilarity s b)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  exact ⟨(positiveSimilarityHomeomorph s b hs).symm z,
    (positiveSimilarityHomeomorph s b hs).apply_symm_apply z⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul
statement:
theorem positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul
    {U : Set Tiling.Plane} {s : ℝ} {b : Tiling.Plane} :
    positiveSimilarity s b '' U = b +ᵥ (s • U)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    refine Set.mem_vadd_set.mpr ⟨s • y,
      Set.mem_smul_set.mpr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add]
    abel
  · rintro hx
    rcases Set.mem_vadd_set.mp hx with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rcases Set.mem_smul_set.mp hy with ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
    simp only [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add]
    abel

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.positiveSimilarity_vadd_image_of_carrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [hcarrier]
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    rcases hz with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨t + y, Set.mem_vadd_set.mpr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add, smul_add]
    abel
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    rcases Set.mem_vadd_set.mp hz with ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    refine Set.mem_vadd_set.mpr ⟨positiveSimilarity s r w,
      ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add, smul_add]
    abel

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.positiveSimilarity_openUnion_image
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, Set.mem_iUnion]
    rintro ⟨q, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hqt⟩ := q.2
    rw [hqt.symm] at hx
    change x ∈ positiveSimilarity s c t +ᵥ R.openCarrier at hx
    rw [positiveSimilarity_vadd_image_of_carrier (t := t) hcarrier] at hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨y, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, Set.mem_iUnion] at hy
    obtain ⟨q, hy⟩ := hy
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, Set.mem_iUnion]
    refine ⟨⟨positiveSimilarity s c q.1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨q, q.2, rfl⟩
    · change positiveSimilarity s (r + c) y ∈
        positiveSimilarity s c q.1 +ᵥ R.openCarrier
      rw [positiveSimilarity_vadd_image_of_carrier (t := q.1) hcarrier]
      exact ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.positiveSimilarity_support_image
statement:
theorem positiveSimilarity_support_image
    {K R : Region} {s : ℝ} {r : Tiling.Plane} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hcarrier : R.openCarrier = positiveSimilarity s r '' K.openCarrier) :
    R.support = positiveSimilarity s r '' K.support
proof:
:= by
  let H := positiveSimilarityHomeomorph s r hs
  have hopen : R.openCarrier = H '' K.openCarrier := by
    change R.openCarrier = positiveSimilarity s r '' K.openCarrier
    exact hcarrier
  rw [← R.isPolygonal.closure_interior, ← K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]
  change closure R.openCarrier = H '' closure K.openCarrier
  rw [hopen, H.image_closure]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.positiveSimilarity_regularSupport_image
statement:
theorem positiveSimilarity_regularSupport_image
    {K R : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane} {s : ℝ}
    {r c : Tiling.Plane} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hcarrier : R.openCarrier = positiveSimilarity s r '' K.openCarrier) :
    regularSupport R (positiveSimilarity s c '' S) =
      positiveSimilarity s (r + c) '' regularSupport K S
proof:
:= by
  rw [regularSupport, regularSupport, Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport,
    Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport]
  change interior (closure (openUnion R (positiveSimilarity s c '' S))) =
    positiveSimilarity s (r + c) '' interior (closure (openUnion K S))
  rw [positiveSimilarity_openUnion_image hcarrier]
  let H := positiveSimilarityHomeomorph s (r + c) hs
  change interior (closure (H '' openUnion K S)) =
    H '' interior (closure (openUnion K S))
  rw [H.image_interior, H.image_closure]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.positiveSimilarity_vertices_image
statement:
theorem positiveSimilarity_vertices_image
    {K R : Region} {s : ℝ} {r : Tiling.Plane} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hcarrier : R.openCarrier = positiveSimilarity s r '' K.openCarrier) :
    R.vertices = positiveSimilarity s r '' K.vertices
proof:
:= by
  calc
    R.vertices = Tiling.vertexSet R.support := R.vertices_eq_vertexSet
    _ = Tiling.vertexSet (positiveSimilarity s r '' K.support) := by
      rw [positiveSimilarity_support_image hs hcarrier]
    _ = Tiling.vertexSet (r +ᵥ (s • K.support)) := by
      rw [positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul]
    _ = r +ᵥ Tiling.vertexSet (s • K.support) :=
      Tiling.vertexSet_vadd r (s • K.support)
    _ = r +ᵥ (s • Tiling.vertexSet K.support) := by
      rw [Tiling.vertexSet_smul s (ne_of_gt hs) K.support]
    _ = positiveSimilarity s r '' K.vertices := by
      rw [positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul, K.vertices_eq_vertexSet]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.positiveSimilarity_quasiMeasurePreserving
statement:
private theorem positiveSimilarity_quasiMeasurePreserving
    {s : ℝ} {b : Tiling.Plane} (hs : 0 < s) :
    Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving (positiveSimilarity s b)
      MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume
proof:
:= by
  convert
    (MeasureTheory.quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left MeasureTheory.volume b).comp
      (MeasureTheory.volume.quasiMeasurePreserving_smul (ne_of_gt hs)) using 1
  funext z
  simp [positiveSimilarity, add_comm]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.positiveSimilarity_aedisjoint_image
statement:
private theorem positiveSimilarity_aedisjoint_image
    {A B : Set Tiling.Plane} {s : ℝ} {b : Tiling.Plane} (hs : 0 < s) :
    MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint MeasureTheory.volume
        (positiveSimilarity s b '' A) (positiveSimilarity s b '' B) ↔
      MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint MeasureTheory.volume A B
proof:
:= by
  let H := positiveSimilarityHomeomorph s b hs
  have hqi : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving H.symm
      MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume := by
    
    have hs' : 0 < s⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hs
    let b' : Tiling.Plane := -(s⁻¹ • b)
    have hform : (fun z : Tiling.Plane => s⁻¹ • z + b') = H.symm := by
      funext z
      apply H.injective
      rw [H.apply_symm_apply]
      change positiveSimilarity s b (s⁻¹ • z + b') = z
      have hsb : s • (s⁻¹ • b) = b := by
        rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hs), one_smul]
      have hsz : s • (s⁻¹ • z) = z := by
        rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hs), one_smul]
      simp only [positiveSimilarity, b', smul_add]
      simp only [smul_neg]
      rw [hsz, hsb]
      simp
    rw [← hform]
    exact positiveSimilarity_quasiMeasurePreserving hs'
  constructor
  · intro h
    change MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint MeasureTheory.volume (H '' A) (H '' B) at h
    have hqH : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving H
        MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume := by
      change Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving (positiveSimilarity s b)
        MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume
      exact positiveSimilarity_quasiMeasurePreserving hs
    have hp := h.preimage hqH
    simpa only [H.preimage_image] using hp
  · intro h
    have hp := h.preimage hqi
    change MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint MeasureTheory.volume (H '' A) (H '' B)
    simpa only [H.preimage_symm] using hp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.positiveSimilarity_isPacking_iff
statement:
private theorem positiveSimilarity_isPacking_iff
    {K R : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane} {s : ℝ}
    {r c : Tiling.Plane} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hcarrier : R.openCarrier = positiveSimilarity s r '' K.openCarrier) :
    Tiling.IsPacking R.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (R.toPolygonalRegion.placements (positiveSimilarity s c '' S)) ↔
      Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
        (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hpack
    change (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S).Pairwise
      (MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint MeasureTheory.volume on
        Tiling.placedTile K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily)
    intro i hi j hj hij
    change i.1 ∈ S at hi
    change j.1 ∈ S at hj
    let i' : R.toPolygonalRegion.placements (positiveSimilarity s c '' S) :=
      ⟨(positiveSimilarity s c i.1, ()), ⟨i.1, hi, rfl⟩⟩
    let j' : R.toPolygonalRegion.placements (positiveSimilarity s c '' S) :=
      ⟨(positiveSimilarity s c j.1, ()), ⟨j.1, hj, rfl⟩⟩
    have hij' : i' ≠ j' := by
      intro heq
      apply hij
      apply Prod.ext
      · have hcentres := congrArg
          (fun p : Tiling.Placement Tiling.Plane Unit => p.1)
          (congrArg Subtype.val heq)
        exact positiveSimilarity_injective hs (by simpa [i', j'] using hcentres)
      · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    have hij'raw : (i'.1 : Tiling.Placement Tiling.Plane Unit) ≠ j'.1 := by
      intro heq
      exact hij' (Subtype.ext heq)
    have h' := hpack i'.2 j'.2 hij'raw
    have hiTile :
        Tiling.placedTile R.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily i' =
          positiveSimilarity s (r + c) ''
            Tiling.placedTile K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily i := by
      change (positiveSimilarity s c i.1) +ᵥ R.support = _
      rw [positiveSimilarity_support_image hs hcarrier]
      rw [positiveSimilarity_vadd_image_of_carrier
        (t := i.1) (U := K.support) (V := positiveSimilarity s r '' K.support) rfl]
      rfl
    have hjTile :
        Tiling.placedTile R.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily j' =
          positiveSimilarity s (r + c) ''
            Tiling.placedTile K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily j := by
      change (positiveSimilarity s c j.1) +ᵥ R.support = _
      rw [positiveSimilarity_support_image hs hcarrier]
      rw [positiveSimilarity_vadd_image_of_carrier
        (t := j.1) (U := K.support) (V := positiveSimilarity s r '' K.support) rfl]
      rfl
    change MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint MeasureTheory.volume
      (Tiling.placedTile R.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily i')
      (Tiling.placedTile R.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily j') at h'
    rw [hiTile, hjTile] at h'
    exact (positiveSimilarity_aedisjoint_image hs).mp h'
  · intro hpack
    change (R.toPolygonalRegion.placements (positiveSimilarity s c '' S)).Pairwise
      (MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint MeasureTheory.volume on
        Tiling.placedTile R.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily)
    intro i hi j hj hij
    change i.1 ∈ positiveSimilarity s c '' S at hi
    change j.1 ∈ positiveSimilarity s c '' S at hj
    have hiS : i.1 ∈ positiveSimilarity s c '' S := hi
    have hjS : j.1 ∈ positiveSimilarity s c '' S := hj
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hia⟩ := hiS
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hjb⟩ := hjS
    let i₀ : K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S := ⟨(a, ()), ha⟩
    let j₀ : K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S := ⟨(b, ()), hb⟩
    have hij₀ : i₀ ≠ j₀ := by
      intro heq
      apply hij
      apply Prod.ext
      · have heq' := congrArg (fun p : Tiling.Placement Tiling.Plane Unit => p.1)
          (congrArg Subtype.val heq)
        rw [← hia, ← hjb]
        exact congrArg (positiveSimilarity s c) (by simpa [i₀, j₀] using heq')
      · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    have hij₀raw : (i₀.1 : Tiling.Placement Tiling.Plane Unit) ≠ j₀.1 := by
      intro heq
      exact hij₀ (Subtype.ext heq)
    have h' := hpack i₀.2 j₀.2 hij₀raw
    have hiTile :
        Tiling.placedTile R.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily i =
          positiveSimilarity s (r + c) ''
            Tiling.placedTile K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily i₀ := by
      change i.1 +ᵥ R.support = _
      rw [positiveSimilarity_support_image hs hcarrier]
      rw [← hia, positiveSimilarity_vadd_image_of_carrier
        (t := a) (U := K.support) (V := positiveSimilarity s r '' K.support) rfl]
      rfl
    have hjTile :
        Tiling.placedTile R.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily j =
          positiveSimilarity s (r + c) ''
            Tiling.placedTile K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily j₀ := by
      change j.1 +ᵥ R.support = _
      rw [positiveSimilarity_support_image hs hcarrier]
      rw [← hjb, positiveSimilarity_vadd_image_of_carrier
        (t := b) (U := K.support) (V := positiveSimilarity s r '' K.support) rfl]
      rfl
    change MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint MeasureTheory.volume
      (Tiling.placedTile R.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily i)
      (Tiling.placedTile R.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily j)
    rw [hiTile, hjTile]
    exact (positiveSimilarity_aedisjoint_image hs).mpr h'

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.tilesOn_positiveSimilarity_iff
statement:
theorem tilesOn_positiveSimilarity_iff
    {K R : Region} {S D : Set Tiling.Plane} {s : ℝ}
    {r c : Tiling.Plane} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hcarrier : R.openCarrier = positiveSimilarity s r '' K.openCarrier) :
    TilesOn R (positiveSimilarity s c '' S)
        (positiveSimilarity s (r + c) '' D) ↔
      TilesOn K S D
proof:
:= by
  let H := positiveSimilarityHomeomorph s (r + c) hs
  have hpoint (y : Tiling.Plane) (U : Set Tiling.Plane) :
      H y ∈ H '' U ↔ y ∈ U := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩
      have hzy' : z = y := H.injective hzy
      rw [hzy'] at hz
      exact hz
    · intro hy
      exact ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  have htile (y t : Tiling.Plane) :
      H y ∈ positiveSimilarity s c t +ᵥ R.openCarrier ↔
        y ∈ t +ᵥ K.openCarrier := by
    rw [positiveSimilarity_vadd_image_of_carrier (t := t) hcarrier]
    exact hpoint y _
  have hqi : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving H.symm
      MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume := by
    have hs' : 0 < s⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hs
    let b' : Tiling.Plane := -(s⁻¹ • (r + c))
    have hform : (fun z : Tiling.Plane => s⁻¹ • z + b') = H.symm := by
      funext z
      apply H.injective
      rw [H.apply_symm_apply]
      change positiveSimilarity s (r + c) (s⁻¹ • z + b') = z
      have hsb : s • (s⁻¹ • (r + c)) = r + c := by
        rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hs), one_smul]
      have hsz : s • (s⁻¹ • z) = z := by
        rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hs), one_smul]
      have hsum : s • (s⁻¹ • r) + s • (s⁻¹ • c) = r + c := by
        rw [← smul_add, ← smul_add, smul_smul,
          mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hs), one_smul]
      simp only [positiveSimilarity, b', smul_add, smul_neg]
      rw [hsz, hsum]
      abel
    rw [← hform]
    exact positiveSimilarity_quasiMeasurePreserving hs'
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Set.countable_of_injective_of_countable_image
        (positiveSimilarity_injective hs).injOn h.1
    · exact (positiveSimilarity_isPacking_iff hs hcarrier).mp h.2.1
    · have hcov :=
        (positiveSimilarity_quasiMeasurePreserving (b := r + c) hs).ae h.2.2
      filter_upwards [hcov] with y hy
      change (y ∈ D ↔ ∃ t : S, y ∈ (t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
      constructor
      · intro hyD
        have hFy : H y ∈ H '' D := ⟨y, hyD, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hy.mp hFy
        obtain ⟨t, ht, hqt⟩ := q.2
        refine ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, ?_⟩
        apply (htile y t).mp
        change H y ∈ (q : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ R.openCarrier at hq
        simpa [hqt] using hq
      · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
        apply (hpoint y D).mp
        apply hy.mpr
        refine ⟨⟨positiveSimilarity s c t,
          ⟨t, t.2, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
        change H y ∈ _
        exact (htile y t).mpr ht
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact h.1.image (positiveSimilarity s c)
    · exact (positiveSimilarity_isPacking_iff hs hcarrier).mpr h.2.1
    · have hcov := hqi.ae h.2.2
      filter_upwards [hcov] with y hy
      constructor
      · intro hDy
        have hyD : H.symm y ∈ D := by
          apply (hpoint (H.symm y) D).mp
          change y ∈ H '' D at hDy
          simpa only [H.apply_symm_apply] using hDy
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hy.mp hyD
        refine ⟨⟨positiveSimilarity s c t,
          ⟨t, t.2, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
        simpa only [H.apply_symm_apply, Region.openCarrier] using (htile (H.symm y) t).mpr ht
      · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
        obtain ⟨t, ht, hqt⟩ := q.2
        have hpre : H.symm y ∈ D := by
          apply hy.mpr
          refine ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, ?_⟩
          apply (htile (H.symm y) t).mp
          have hq' : H (H.symm y) ∈
              (q : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ R.openCarrier := by
            simpa only [H.apply_symm_apply, Region.openCarrier] using hq
          simpa [hqt] using hq'
        change y ∈ H '' D
        exact ⟨H.symm y, hpre, H.apply_symm_apply y⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.frontier_finset_union_subset
statement:
theorem frontier_finset_union_subset {ι : Type*} (F : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → Set Plane) :
    frontier (⋃ i ∈ F, f i) ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ F, frontier (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction F using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i F hi ih =>
    simp only [Finset.set_biUnion_insert]
    exact (frontier_union_subset _ _).trans
      (Set.union_subset_union inter_subset_left (inter_subset_right.trans ih))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.interior_isRegularOpen_of_isClosed
statement:
theorem interior_isRegularOpen_of_isClosed {U : Set Plane} (hU : IsClosed U) :
    interior (closure (interior U)) = interior U
proof:
:= by
  apply subset_antisymm
  · exact interior_mono (closure_minimal interior_subset hU)
  · exact isOpen_interior.subset_interior_closure

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.box_frontier_axes
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p.1 ≤ p.2
  · by_cases hq : q.1 ≤ q.2
    · rw [box, Complex.frontier_reProdIm] at hz
      rcases hz with hz | hz
      · have hy : z.im = q.1 ∨ z.im = q.2 := by
          simpa [frontier_Icc hq] using hz.2
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr hy)
      · have hx : z.re = p.1 ∨ z.re = p.2 := by
          simpa [frontier_Icc hp] using hz.1
        exact hx.imp_right (fun h => Or.inl h)
    · simp [box, Icc_eq_empty_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hq), Complex.reProdIm] at hz
  · simp [box, Icc_eq_empty_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hp), Complex.reProdIm] at hz

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_data
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa [consecutiveLevelPairs] using
    (show p.1 ∈ s ∧ p.2 ∈ s ∧ p.1 < p.2 from by
      rw [consecutiveLevelPairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp
      exact ⟨hp.1.1, hp.1.2, hp.2.1⟩)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.box_isRectangle
statement:
theorem box_isRectangle {p q : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p.1 < p.2) (hq : q.1 < q.2) :
    Tiling.IsRectangle (box p q)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Complex.mk p.1 q.1, Complex.mk p.2 q.2, ne_of_lt hp, ne_of_lt hq, ?_⟩
  simp [box, Complex.Rectangle, uIcc_of_le hp.le, uIcc_of_le hq.le]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.interior_box
statement: theorem interior_box (p q : ℝ × ℝ) : interior (box p q) = cell p q
proof:
:= by
  simp [box, cell, Complex.interior_reProdIm, interior_Icc]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.closure_cell
statement:
theorem closure_cell {p q : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p.1 < p.2) (hq : q.1 < q.2) :
    closure (cell p q) = box p q
proof:
:= by
  simp [box, cell, Complex.closure_reProdIm, closure_Ioo hp.ne, closure_Ioo hq.ne]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.cell_preconnected
statement: theorem cell_preconnected (p q : ℝ × ℝ) : IsPreconnected (cell p q)
proof:
:= by
  have hconv : Convex ℝ (cell p q) :=
    (convex_Ioo p.1 p.2).linear_preimage Complex.reLm |>.inter
      ((convex_Ioo q.1 q.2).linear_preimage Complex.imLm)
  exact hconv.isPreconnected

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_around
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L : Set ℝ := {a | a ∈ s ∧ a < x}
  let U : Set ℝ := {b | b ∈ s ∧ x < b}
  have hLfin : L.Finite := s.finite_toSet.subset (by intro z hz; exact hz.1)
  have hUfin : U.Finite := s.finite_toSet.subset (by intro z hz; exact hz.1)
  obtain ⟨a, haL, hamax⟩ := Set.exists_max_image L id hLfin hl
  obtain ⟨b, hbU, hbmin⟩ := Set.exists_min_image U id hUfin hu
  refine ⟨a, b, ?_, haL.2, hbU.2⟩
  rw [consecutiveLevelPairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
  refine ⟨⟨haL.1, hbU.1⟩, haL.2.trans hbU.2, ?_⟩
  intro z hzs hzbetween
  by_cases hzx : z < x
  · exact (not_lt_of_ge (hamax z ⟨hzs, hzx⟩)) hzbetween.1
  · have hxz : x < z := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hzx) (Ne.symm (by
      intro h; apply hx; simpa [h] using hzs))
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hbmin z ⟨hzs, hxz⟩)) hzbetween.2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_avoids_levels
statement:
theorem pair_avoids_levels {s : Finset ℝ} {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ consecutiveLevelPairs s) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Ioo p.1 p.2) : x ∉ s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [consecutiveLevelPairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp
  exact fun hxs => hp.2.2 x hxs hx

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_intervals_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [consecutiveLevelPairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp hq
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro z hzp hzq
  have hleft : p.1 = q.1 := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy p.1 q.1 with h | h | h
    · exact (hp.2.2 q.1 hq.1.1 ⟨h, hzq.1.trans hzp.2⟩).elim
    · exact h
    · exact (hq.2.2 p.1 hp.1.1 ⟨h, hzp.1.trans hzq.2⟩).elim
  have hright : p.2 = q.2 := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy p.2 q.2 with h | h | h
    · exact (hq.2.2 p.2 hp.1.2 ⟨hzq.1.trans hzp.2, h⟩).elim
    · exact h
    · exact (hp.2.2 q.2 hq.1.2 ⟨hzp.1.trans hzq.2, h⟩).elim
  exact hpq (Prod.ext hleft hright)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.offGrid_dense
statement: theorem offGrid_dense (s t : Finset ℝ) : Dense (offGrid s t)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (s.finite_toSet.countable.dense_compl ℝ).preimage Complex.isOpenMap_re
  have ht := (t.finite_toSet.countable.dense_compl ℝ).preimage Complex.isOpenMap_im
  have htop : IsOpen (Complex.im ⁻¹' (↑t : Set ℝ)ᶜ) :=
    t.finite_toSet.isClosed.isOpen_compl.preimage Complex.continuous_im
  exact hs.inter_of_isOpen_right ht htop

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.cell_inside_of_meets
statement:
theorem cell_inside_of_meets {Ω : Set Plane} (hopen : IsOpen Ω)
    (s t : Finset ℝ) (hfront : ∀ z ∈ frontier Ω, z.re ∈ s ∨ z.im ∈ t)
    {p q : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ consecutiveLevelPairs s)
    (hq : q ∈ consecutiveLevelPairs t) (hne : (cell p q ∩ Ω).Nonempty) :
    cell p q ⊆ Ω
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj : Disjoint (cell p q) (frontier Ω) := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun z hz hzf => ?_
    rcases hfront z hzf with hx | hy
    · exact pair_avoids_levels hp hz.1 hx
    · exact pair_avoids_levels hq hz.2 hy
  rcases Tiling.IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier
      (cell_preconnected p q) hdisj with hin | hout
  · simpa [hopen.interior_eq] using hin
  · obtain ⟨z, hz, hzΩ⟩ := hne
    exact (interior_subset (hout hz) hzΩ).elim

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.boxes_aedisjoint
statement:
theorem boxes_aedisjoint {p q p' q' : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hp : p.1 < p.2) (hq : q.1 < q.2)
    (hp' : p'.1 < p'.2) (hq' : q'.1 < q'.2)
    (hdisj : Disjoint (cell p q) (cell p' q')) :
    AEDisjoint volume (box p q) (box p' q')
proof:
:= by
  change volume (box p q ∩ box p' q') = 0
  apply measure_mono_null ?_
    (measure_union_null (box_isRectangle hp hq).isPolygonal.volume_frontier
      (box_isRectangle hp' hq').isPolygonal.volume_frontier)
  intro z hz
  by_cases hzint : z ∈ interior (box p q)
  · right
    rw [(box_isRectangle hp' hq').isPolygonal.isClosed.frontier_eq]
    refine ⟨hz.2, ?_⟩
    intro hzint'
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj
      (by simpa [interior_box] using hzint)
      (by simpa [interior_box] using hzint')
  · left
    rw [(box_isRectangle hp hq).isPolygonal.isClosed.frontier_eq]
    exact ⟨hz.1, hzint⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.rectangulation_of_grid
statement:
theorem rectangulation_of_grid {Ω : Set Plane} (hopen : IsOpen Ω)
    (hbounded : IsBounded Ω) (s t : Finset ℝ)
    (hfront : ∀ z ∈ frontier Ω, z.re ∈ s ∨ z.im ∈ t) :
    Tiling.IsAxisParallel (closure Ω)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hbounded.subset_closedBall (0 : Plane)
  let B := |R| + 1
  have hbounds (z : Plane) (hz : z ∈ Ω) :
      -B < z.re ∧ z.re < B ∧ -B < z.im ∧ z.im < B := by
    have hn : ‖z‖ ≤ R := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using hR hz
    have hre := (Complex.abs_re_le_norm z).trans hn
    have him := (Complex.abs_im_le_norm z).trans hn
    have habs := le_abs_self R
    dsimp [B]
    rcases abs_le.mp hre with ⟨hrel, hrer⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp him with ⟨himl, himr⟩
    constructor
    · linarith
    constructor
    · linarith
    constructor <;> linarith
  let s' := insert (-B) (insert B s)
  let t' := insert (-B) (insert B t)
  have hs : s ⊆ s' := by intro a ha; simp [s', ha]
  have ht : t ⊆ t' := by intro a ha; simp [t', ha]
  have hfront' : ∀ z ∈ frontier Ω, z.re ∈ s' ∨ z.im ∈ t' := by
    intro z hz
    exact (hfront z hz).imp (fun h => hs h) (fun h => ht h)
  let P := ((consecutiveLevelPairs s' ×ˢ consecutiveLevelPairs t').filter
    fun pq => (cell pq.1 pq.2 ∩ Ω).Nonempty)
  let pieces := P.image fun pq => box pq.1 pq.2
  have hdata {pq : (ℝ × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ)} (hpq : pq ∈ P) :
      pq.1 ∈ consecutiveLevelPairs s' ∧ pq.2 ∈ consecutiveLevelPairs t' ∧
        (cell pq.1 pq.2 ∩ Ω).Nonempty := by
    simpa only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, and_assoc] using hpq
  have hrect {pq : (ℝ × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ)} (hpq : pq ∈ P) :
      Tiling.IsRectangle (box pq.1 pq.2) :=
    box_isRectangle (pair_data (hdata hpq).1).2.2 (pair_data (hdata hpq).2.1).2.2
  have hsub {pq : (ℝ × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ)} (hpq : pq ∈ P) :
      box pq.1 pq.2 ⊆ closure Ω := by
    obtain ⟨hp, hq, hne⟩ := hdata hpq
    rw [← closure_cell (pair_data hp).2.2 (pair_data hq).2.2]
    exact closure_mono (cell_inside_of_meets hopen s' t' hfront' hp hq hne)
  have hclosed : IsClosed (⋃ pq ∈ P, box pq.1 pq.2) :=
    P.finite_toSet.isClosed_biUnion fun pq hpq => (hrect hpq).isPolygonal.isClosed
  have hoff : Ω ∩ offGrid s' t' ⊆ ⋃ pq ∈ P, box pq.1 pq.2 := by
    rintro z ⟨hz, hx, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨xa, xb, hxp, hxmem⟩ := pair_around hx
      ⟨-B, by simp [s'], (hbounds z hz).1⟩
      ⟨B, by simp [s'], (hbounds z hz).2.1⟩
    obtain ⟨ya, yb, hyp, hymem⟩ := pair_around hy
      ⟨-B, by simp [t'], (hbounds z hz).2.2.1⟩
      ⟨B, by simp [t'], (hbounds z hz).2.2.2⟩
    refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨((xa, xb), (ya, yb)), mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
      exact ⟨⟨hxp, hyp⟩, z, ⟨hxmem, hymem⟩, hz⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨hxmem.1.le, hxmem.2.le⟩, hymem.1.le, hymem.2.le⟩
  have hΩsub : Ω ⊆ ⋃ pq ∈ P, box pq.1 pq.2 :=
    ((offGrid_dense s' t').open_subset_closure_inter hopen).trans
      (closure_minimal hoff hclosed)
  have hunion : (⋃ pq ∈ P, box pq.1 pq.2) = closure Ω := by
    apply subset_antisymm
    · intro z hz
      obtain ⟨pq, hpq⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
      obtain ⟨hpq, hzbox⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hpq
      exact hsub hpq hzbox
    · exact closure_minimal hΩsub hclosed
  refine ⟨{ pieces := pieces
            isRectangle := ?_
            pairwiseAEDisjoint := ?_
            sUnion_eq := ?_ }⟩
  · intro r hr
    obtain ⟨pq, hpq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hr
    exact hrect hpq
  · intro r hr u hu hru
    obtain ⟨pq, hpq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hr
    obtain ⟨pq', hpq', rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu
    obtain ⟨hp, hq, _⟩ := hdata hpq
    obtain ⟨hp', hq', _⟩ := hdata hpq'
    apply boxes_aedisjoint (pair_data hp).2.2 (pair_data hq).2.2
      (pair_data hp').2.2 (pair_data hq').2.2
    have hpqne : pq ≠ pq' := fun h => hru (congrArg (fun v => box v.1 v.2) h)
    by_cases hpeq : pq.1 = pq'.1
    · have hqne : pq.2 ≠ pq'.2 := fun h => hpqne (Prod.ext hpeq h)
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun z hz hz' =>
        Set.disjoint_left.mp (pair_intervals_disjoint hq hq' hqne) hz.2 hz'.2
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun z hz hz' =>
        Set.disjoint_left.mp (pair_intervals_disjoint hp hp' hpeq) hz.1 hz'.1
  · rw [← hunion]
    ext z
    simp only [pieces, Set.mem_sUnion, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_image, mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨r, ⟨pq, hpq, rfl⟩, hz⟩
      exact ⟨pq, hpq, hz⟩
    · rintro ⟨pq, hpq, hz⟩
      exact ⟨box pq.1 pq.2, ⟨pq, hpq, rfl⟩, hz⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.orderedBox_isClosed
statement: theorem orderedBox_isClosed (a b : Plane) : IsClosed (orderedBox a b)
proof:
:=
  isClosed_Icc.reProdIm isClosed_Icc

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.orderedBox_isBounded
statement: theorem orderedBox_isBounded (a b : Plane) : IsBounded (orderedBox a b)
proof:
:=
  isCompact_Icc.isBounded.reProdIm isCompact_Icc.isBounded

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.finite_boxes_frontier_axisLines
statement:
theorem finite_boxes_frontier_axisLines (F : Finset (Plane × Plane)) :
    ∃ s t : Finset ℝ, ∀ z ∈ frontier (⋃ r ∈ F, orderedBox r.1 r.2),
      z.re ∈ s ∨ z.im ∈ t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s := F.biUnion fun r => {r.1.re, r.2.re}
  let t := F.biUnion fun r => {r.1.im, r.2.im}
  refine ⟨s, t, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hz' := frontier_finset_union_subset F (fun r => orderedBox r.1 r.2) hz
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz'
  obtain ⟨hr, hzr⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hr
  rcases box_frontier_axes hzr with hx | hx | hy | hy
  · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨r, hr, by simp [hx]⟩)
  · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨r, hr, by simp [hx]⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨r, hr, by simp [hy]⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨r, hr, by simp [hy]⟩)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.finite_boxes_union_isClosed
statement:
theorem finite_boxes_union_isClosed (F : Finset (Plane × Plane)) :
    IsClosed (⋃ r ∈ F, orderedBox r.1 r.2)
proof:
:=
  F.finite_toSet.isClosed_biUnion fun r _ => orderedBox_isClosed r.1 r.2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.finite_boxes_union_isBounded
statement:
theorem finite_boxes_union_isBounded (F : Finset (Plane × Plane)) :
    IsBounded (⋃ r ∈ F, orderedBox r.1 r.2)
proof:
:=
  (isBounded_biUnion_finset F).mpr fun r _ => orderedBox_isBounded r.1 r.2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.finite_boxes_carrier_axisLines
statement:
theorem finite_boxes_carrier_axisLines (F : Finset (Plane × Plane)) :
    ∃ s t : Finset ℝ, ∀ z ∈ frontier (interior (⋃ r ∈ F, orderedBox r.1 r.2)),
      z.re ∈ s ∨ z.im ∈ t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, t, hfront⟩ := finite_boxes_frontier_axisLines F
  exact ⟨s, t, fun z hz => hfront z (frontier_interior_subset hz)⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.finite_boxes_carrier_rectangulated
statement:
theorem finite_boxes_carrier_rectangulated (F : Finset (Plane × Plane)) :
    Tiling.IsAxisParallel (closure (interior (⋃ r ∈ F, orderedBox r.1 r.2)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, t, hfront⟩ := finite_boxes_carrier_axisLines F
  exact rectangulation_of_grid isOpen_interior
    ((finite_boxes_union_isBounded F).subset interior_subset) s t hfront

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.region_rectangle_presentation
statement:
theorem region_rectangle_presentation (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region) :
    ∃ F : Finset (Plane × Plane), K.support = ⋃ r ∈ F, orderedBox r.1 r.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := K.isAxisParallel
  choose a b hre him heq using fun r : ↥R.pieces => R.isRectangle r.1 r.2
  let lower (r : ↥R.pieces) : Plane :=
    ⟨min (a r).re (b r).re, min (a r).im (b r).im⟩
  let upper (r : ↥R.pieces) : Plane :=
    ⟨max (a r).re (b r).re, max (a r).im (b r).im⟩
  let F := Finset.univ.image fun r : ↥R.pieces => (lower r, upper r)
  have hbox (r : ↥R.pieces) : orderedBox (lower r) (upper r) = r.1 := by
    rw [heq r]
    rfl
  refine ⟨F, ?_⟩
  rw [← R.sUnion_eq]
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, hzr⟩
    refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(lower ⟨r, hr⟩, upper ⟨r, hr⟩), mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨r, hr⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    · simpa only [hbox] using hzr
  · rintro hz
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
    obtain ⟨hr, hzr⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hr
    obtain ⟨r', _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hr
    exact ⟨r'.1, r'.2, (hbox r') ▸ hzr⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.region_finite_axis_boundary
statement:
theorem region_finite_axis_boundary (K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region) :
    ∃ edges : Set (Plane × Plane), edges.Finite ∧
      (∀ e ∈ edges, e.1 ≠ e.2 ∧ (e.1.re = e.2.re ∨ e.1.im = e.2.im)) ∧
      frontier K.openCarrier = ⋃ e ∈ edges, segment ℝ e.1 e.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hsegments, hcover⟩ := K.exists_finite_frontier_intrinsicSegments
  let : Fintype ↥G := hG.fintype
  choose a b hne halign heq hsub using fun g : ↥G => hsegments g.1 g.2
  let E := (fun g : ↥G => (a g, b g)) '' univ
  have hfront : frontier K.openCarrier = ⋃₀ G := by
    exact K.frontier_openCarrier_eq_frontier_support.trans hcover
  refine ⟨E, (Set.finite_univ.image _), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro e ⟨g, _, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hne g, halign g⟩
  · rw [hfront]
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨g, hg, hz⟩
      refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(a ⟨g, hg⟩, b ⟨g, hg⟩), mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, mem_univ _, rfl⟩
      · rwa [← heq ⟨g, hg⟩]
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
      obtain ⟨⟨g, _, rfl⟩, hz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp he
      exact ⟨g.1, g.2, (heq g).symm ▸ hz⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.finite_rectangle_presentation_iff_boundary
statement:
theorem finite_rectangle_presentation_iff_boundary (Ω : Set Plane) (hne : Ω.Nonempty) :
    (∃ F : Finset (Plane × Plane), Ω = interior (⋃ r ∈ F, orderedBox r.1 r.2)) ↔
      interior (closure Ω) = Ω ∧ IsBounded Ω ∧
        ∃ edges : Set (Plane × Plane), edges.Finite ∧
          (∀ e ∈ edges, e.1 ≠ e.2 ∧ (e.1.re = e.2.re ∨ e.1.im = e.2.im)) ∧
          frontier Ω = ⋃ e ∈ edges, segment ℝ e.1 e.2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨F, rfl⟩
    have hregular := interior_isRegularOpen_of_isClosed (finite_boxes_union_isClosed F)
    have haxis := finite_boxes_carrier_rectangulated F
    let K : Region := {
      support := closure (interior (⋃ r ∈ F, orderedBox r.1 r.2))
      isPolygonal := IntrinsicVertices.isPolygonal_of_isAxisParallel haxis
      nonempty := hne.mono subset_closure
      isAxisParallel := haxis }
    refine ⟨hregular, (finite_boxes_union_isBounded F).subset interior_subset, ?_⟩
    have hcarrier : K.openCarrier = interior (⋃ r ∈ F, orderedBox r.1 r.2) := hregular
    simpa only [hcarrier] using region_finite_axis_boundary K
  · rintro ⟨hregular, hbounded, E, hE, hedge, hfront⟩
    classical
    let s := hE.toFinset.image fun e => e.1.re
    let t := hE.toFinset.image fun e => e.1.im
    have hlines : ∀ z ∈ frontier Ω, z.re ∈ s ∨ z.im ∈ t := by
      intro z hz
      rw [hfront] at hz
      obtain ⟨e, hz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
      obtain ⟨he, hz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
      rcases (hedge e he).2 with hre | him
      · have hzre : z.re = e.1.re :=
          (convex_hyperplane Complex.reLm.isLinear e.1.re).segment_subset
            rfl hre.symm hz
        exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨e, hE.mem_toFinset.mpr he, hzre.symm⟩)
      · have hzim : z.im = e.1.im :=
          (convex_hyperplane Complex.imLm.isLinear e.1.im).segment_subset
            rfl him.symm hz
        exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨e, hE.mem_toFinset.mpr he, hzim.symm⟩)
    have hopen : IsOpen Ω := hregular ▸ isOpen_interior
    have haxis := rectangulation_of_grid hopen hbounded s t hlines
    let K : Region := {
      support := closure Ω
      isPolygonal := IntrinsicVertices.isPolygonal_of_isAxisParallel haxis
      nonempty := hne.mono subset_closure
      isAxisParallel := haxis }
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := region_rectangle_presentation K
    exact ⟨F, hregular.symm.trans (congrArg interior hF)⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.normSq_affineCombination_identity
statement:
private theorem normSq_affineCombination_identity
    (a b w : Tiling.Plane) (t : ℝ) :
    Complex.normSq (((1 - t) • a + t • b) - w) =
      (1 - t) * Complex.normSq (a - w) +
        t * Complex.normSq (b - w) -
          t * (1 - t) * Complex.normSq (a - b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_re,
    Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.exists_globalDistanceMaximizers
statement:
theorem exists_globalDistanceMaximizers
    {s : Set Tiling.Plane} (hs : IsCompact s) (hne : s.Nonempty) :
    ∃ p ∈ s, ∃ q ∈ s,
      (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, dist x y ≤ dist p q) ∧
      Metric.diam s = dist p q
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : IsCompact (s ×ˢ s) := hs.prod hs
  have hprodne : (s ×ˢ s).Nonempty := hne.prod hne
  obtain ⟨pq, hpq, hmax⟩ := hprod.exists_isMaxOn hprodne continuous_dist.continuousOn
  refine ⟨pq.1, hpq.1, pq.2, hpq.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx y hy
    exact hmax (show (x, y) ∈ s ×ˢ s from ⟨hx, hy⟩)
  · apply le_antisymm
    · exact Metric.diam_le_of_forall_dist_le dist_nonneg
        (fun x hx y hy => hmax (show (x, y) ∈ s ×ˢ s from ⟨hx, hy⟩))
    · exact Metric.dist_le_diam_of_mem hs.isBounded hpq.1 hpq.2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.triangle_extremePoint_of_globalDistanceMax
statement:
private theorem triangle_extremePoint_of_globalDistanceMax
    {s t : Set Tiling.Plane} (_ht : Tiling.IsTriangle t) (hts : t ⊆ s)
    {p w : Tiling.Plane} (hpt : p ∈ t)
    (hmax : ∀ x ∈ s, dist x w ≤ dist p w) :
    p ∈ t.extremePoints ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_extremePoints_iff_left]
  refine ⟨hpt, ?_⟩
  intro a hat b hbt hpopen
  by_contra hap
  rcases hpopen with ⟨u, v, hu, hv, huv, huvp⟩
  have hab : a ≠ b := by
    intro hab
    subst b
    have : p = a := by
      rw [← huvp]
      rw [← add_smul, huv, one_smul]
    exact hap this.symm
  have hta := hts hat
  have htb := hts hbt
  have hpa := hmax a hta
  have hpb := hmax b htb
  have hnorma : ‖a - w‖ ≤ ‖p - w‖ := by
    simpa [Complex.dist_eq] using hpa
  have hnormb : ‖b - w‖ ≤ ‖p - w‖ := by
    simpa [Complex.dist_eq] using hpb
  have hsqa : Complex.normSq (a - w) ≤ Complex.normSq (p - w) := by
    rw [← Complex.sq_norm, ← Complex.sq_norm]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (a - w), norm_nonneg (p - w)]
  have hsqb : Complex.normSq (b - w) ≤ Complex.normSq (p - w) := by
    rw [← Complex.sq_norm, ← Complex.sq_norm]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (b - w), norm_nonneg (p - w)]
  have hvlt : v < 1 := by linarith
  have huvform : p = (1 - v) • a + v • b := by
    rw [show u = 1 - v by linarith] at huvp
    exact huvp.symm
  have hid := normSq_affineCombination_identity a b w v
  rw [← huvform] at hid
  have hpos : 0 < v * (1 - v) * Complex.normSq (a - b) := by
    exact mul_pos (mul_pos hv (sub_pos.mpr hvlt))
      (Complex.normSq_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hab))
  nlinarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.globalDistanceMaximizers_mem_vertexSet
statement:
private theorem globalDistanceMaximizers_mem_vertexSet
    {s : Set Tiling.Plane} (_hs : Tiling.IsPolygonal s)
    {p q : Tiling.Plane} (hp : p ∈ s) (hq : q ∈ s)
    (hmax : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, dist x y ≤ dist p q) :
    p ∈ Tiling.vertexSet s ∧ q ∈ Tiling.vertexSet s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro triangulation
    have hp' : p ∈ ⋃₀ (triangulation.pieces : Set (Set Tiling.Plane)) := by
      rw [triangulation.sUnion_eq]
      exact hp
    rcases hp' with ⟨t, ht, hpt⟩
    refine ⟨t, ht, triangle_extremePoint_of_globalDistanceMax
      (s := s) (w := q) (triangulation.isTriangle t ht) ?_ hpt ?_⟩
    · intro x hxt
      rw [← triangulation.sUnion_eq]
      exact ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩
    · intro x hxs
      exact hmax x hxs q hq
  · intro triangulation
    have hq' : q ∈ ⋃₀ (triangulation.pieces : Set (Set Tiling.Plane)) := by
      rw [triangulation.sUnion_eq]
      exact hq
    rcases hq' with ⟨t, ht, hqt⟩
    refine ⟨t, ht, triangle_extremePoint_of_globalDistanceMax
      (s := s) (w := p) (triangulation.isTriangle t ht) ?_ hqt ?_⟩
    · intro x hxt
      rw [← triangulation.sUnion_eq]
      exact ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩
    · intro x hxs
      simpa only [dist_comm q p] using hmax x hxs p hp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.exists_intrinsicDiameterPair
statement:
theorem exists_intrinsicDiameterPair (K : Region) :
    ∃ v ∈ K.vertices, ∃ w ∈ K.vertices,
      (∀ x ∈ K.support, ∀ y ∈ K.support, dist x y ≤ dist v w) ∧
      Metric.diam K.support = dist v w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, q, hq, hmax, hdiam⟩ :=
    exists_globalDistanceMaximizers K.isPolygonal.isCompact K.nonempty
  have hpq := globalDistanceMaximizers_mem_vertexSet K.isPolygonal hp hq hmax
  exact ⟨p, hpq.1, q, hpq.2, hmax, hdiam⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.exists_vertices_controlling_distance
statement:
theorem exists_vertices_controlling_distance
    (K : Region) (x y : Tiling.Plane) (hx : x ∈ K.support) (hy : y ∈ K.support) :
    ∃ v ∈ K.vertices, ∃ w ∈ K.vertices, dist x y ≤ dist v w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, w, hw, hmax, _⟩ := exists_intrinsicDiameterPair K
  exact ⟨v, hv, w, hw, hmax x hx y hy⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.localReplacement_isRectangle
statement:
private theorem localReplacement_isRectangle
    {s : Set Tiling.Plane} (R : Tiling.Rectangulation s)
    (x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ : ℝ) (q : Set Tiling.Plane)
    (hq : Tiling.IsRectangle q) :
    ∀ r ∈ localReplacementPieces R x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ q,
      Tiling.IsRectangle r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro r hr
  rw [localReplacementPieces, Finset.mem_insert] at hr
  rcases hr with rfl | hr
  · exact hq
  · rw [clippedOuterPieces, Finset.mem_image] at hr
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hr
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.localReplacement_avoids
statement:
private theorem localReplacement_avoids
    {s : Set Tiling.Plane} (R : Tiling.Rectangulation s)
    (x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ : ℝ) (q : Set Tiling.Plane) (v : Tiling.Plane)
    (hx₀ : x₀ < v.re) (hx₁ : v.re < x₁)
    (hy₀ : y₀ < v.im) (hy₁ : v.im < y₁)
    (hqv : v ∉ q.extremePoints ℝ) :
    ∀ r ∈ localReplacementPieces R x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ q,
      v ∉ r.extremePoints ℝ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro r hr hvr
  rw [localReplacementPieces, Finset.mem_insert] at hr
  rcases hr with rfl | hr
  · exact hqv hvr
  · rw [clippedOuterPieces, Finset.mem_image] at hr
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hr
    have hvinter : v ∈ p.1 ∩ p.2 := extremePoints_subset hvr
    have hpProd : p ∈ R.pieces ×ˢ outerMasterCells x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
    have hpouter : p.2 ∈ outerMasterCells x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ :=
      (Finset.mem_product.mp hpProd).2
    rw [outerMasterCells, Finset.mem_image] at hpouter
    obtain ⟨ij, hij, hp2⟩ := hpouter
    have hijne := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hij).2
    have hvcell : v ∈ masterGridCell x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ ij.1 ij.2 := by
      simpa [hp2] using hvinter.2
    rcases ij with ⟨i, j⟩
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [masterGridCell, masterBandSet] at hvcell hijne <;> linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.volume_re_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem volume_re_eq_zero (a : ℝ) :
    volume {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = a} = 0
proof:
:= by
  let H : Set Tiling.Plane := {z | z.re = a}
  have hclosed : IsClosed H := isClosed_eq Complex.continuous_re continuous_const
  have hinter : interior H = ∅ := by
    apply Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp
    rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hzε⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp isOpen_interior z hz
    have hw := hzε (show z + (ε / 2 : ℝ) ∈ Metric.ball z ε by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq]
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε] using half_lt_self hε)
    have hzmem : z ∈ H := interior_subset hz
    have hwmem : z + (ε / 2 : ℝ) ∈ H := interior_subset hw
    have hzH : z.re = a := hzmem
    have hwH : (z + (ε / 2 : ℝ)).re = a := hwmem
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re] at hwH
    linarith
  have hfrontier : frontier H = H := by
    rw [frontier, hclosed.closure_eq, hinter, sdiff_empty]
  change volume H = 0
  rw [← hfrontier]
  exact (convex_hyperplane Complex.reLm.isLinear a).addHaar_frontier volume

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.volume_im_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem volume_im_eq_zero (a : ℝ) :
    volume {z : Tiling.Plane | z.im = a} = 0
proof:
:= by
  let H : Set Tiling.Plane := {z | z.im = a}
  have hclosed : IsClosed H := isClosed_eq Complex.continuous_im continuous_const
  have hinter : interior H = ∅ := by
    apply Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp
    rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hzε⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp isOpen_interior z hz
    have hw := hzε (show z + (ε / 2 : ℝ) * Complex.I ∈ Metric.ball z ε by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq]
      simpa [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε] using half_lt_self hε)
    have hzmem : z ∈ H := interior_subset hz
    have hwmem : z + (ε / 2 : ℝ) * Complex.I ∈ H := interior_subset hw
    have hzH : z.im = a := hzmem
    have hwH : (z + (ε / 2 : ℝ) * Complex.I).im = a := hwmem
    simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im,
      Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, mul_one, zero_mul, add_zero] at hwH
    linarith
  have hfrontier : frontier H = H := by
    rw [frontier, hclosed.closure_eq, hinter, sdiff_empty]
  change volume H = 0
  rw [← hfrontier]
  exact (convex_hyperplane Complex.imLm.isLinear a).addHaar_frontier volume

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.masterBand_inter_subset_singleton
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases k
  all_goals
    first
    | exact (hne rfl).elim
    | refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
      intro z hz
      simp [masterBandSet] at hz ⊢
      linarith
    | refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
      intro z hz
      simp [masterBandSet] at hz ⊢
      linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.masterGridCell_aedisjoint_of_ne
statement:
private theorem masterGridCell_aedisjoint_of_ne
    (x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ : ℝ) (hx : x₀ < x₁) (hy : y₀ < y₁)
    (i j k l : MasterBand) (hne : (i, j) ≠ (k, l)) :
    AEDisjoint volume (masterGridCell x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ i j)
      (masterGridCell x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ k l)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord : i ≠ k ∨ j ≠ l := by
    by_contra hc
    simp only [not_or, Classical.not_not] at hc
    exact hne (Prod.ext hc.1 hc.2)
  rcases hcoord with hik | hjl
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := masterBand_inter_subset_singleton x₀ x₁ hx i k hik
    change volume (masterGridCell x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ i j ∩
      masterGridCell x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ k l) = 0
    apply measure_mono_null ?_ (volume_re_eq_zero c)
    intro z hz
    exact hc ⟨hz.1.1, hz.2.1⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := masterBand_inter_subset_singleton y₀ y₁ hy j l hjl
    change volume (masterGridCell x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ i j ∩
      masterGridCell x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ k l) = 0
    apply measure_mono_null ?_ (volume_im_eq_zero c)
    intro z hz
    exact hc ⟨hz.1.2, hz.2.2⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.mem_clippedOuterPieces
statement:
private theorem mem_clippedOuterPieces
    {s : Set Tiling.Plane} (R : Tiling.Rectangulation s)
    (x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ : ℝ) {r : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hr : r ∈ clippedOuterPieces R x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁) :
    ∃ old ∈ R.pieces, ∃ i j : MasterBand,
      (i, j) ≠ (MasterBand.middle, MasterBand.middle) ∧
      r = old ∩ masterGridCell x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [clippedOuterPieces, Finset.mem_image] at hr
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hr
  have hpProd := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
  obtain ⟨hold, hcell⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hpProd
  rw [outerMasterCells, Finset.mem_image] at hcell
  obtain ⟨ij, hij, hcellEq⟩ := hcell
  exact ⟨p.1, hold, ij.1, ij.2, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hij).2,
    congrArg (p.1 ∩ ·) hcellEq.symm⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.localReplacement_pairwiseAEDisjoint
statement:
private theorem localReplacement_pairwiseAEDisjoint
    {s : Set Tiling.Plane} (R : Tiling.Rectangulation s)
    (x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ : ℝ) (q : Set Tiling.Plane)
    (hx : x₀ < x₁) (hy : y₀ < y₁)
    (hq : q ⊆ closedAxisBox x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁) :
    ((localReplacementPieces R x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ q :
      Finset (Set Tiling.Plane)) : Set (Set Tiling.Plane)).Pairwise
      (AEDisjoint volume)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro a ha b hb hab
  change a ∈ localReplacementPieces R x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ q at ha
  change b ∈ localReplacementPieces R x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ q at hb
  rw [localReplacementPieces, Finset.mem_insert] at ha hb
  rcases ha with rfl | ha
  · rcases hb with rfl | hb
    · exact (hab rfl).elim
    · obtain ⟨old, hold, i, j, hij, rfl⟩ :=
        mem_clippedOuterPieces R x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ hb
      apply (masterGridCell_aedisjoint_of_ne x₀ x₁ y₀ y₁ hx hy
        .middle .middle i j ?_).mono hq inter_subset_right
      intro heq
      exact hij heq.symm
  · rcases hb with rfl | hb
    · obtain ⟨old, hold, i, j, hij, rfl⟩ :=
