    rw [vadd_vadd, add_comm]
    rw [← vadd_vadd, hInv]
  have hNcolumn : IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical K N := by
    refine ⟨hNpacking, hNnonempty, ?_, hNinvariant⟩
    exact ⟨0, by intro z hz; exact hNaxis hz⟩
  refine ⟨φ, N, hφ, ?_, hNnonempty, hNzero, hNaxis, hNcolumn⟩
  intro n
  exact hNexact n

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.onePointTranslate'_continuous
statement:
private theorem onePointTranslate'_continuous :
    Continuous onePointTranslate'
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  rintro ⟨g, z⟩
  induction z using OnePoint.rec with
  | coe x =>
      rw [continuousAt_def]
      intro A hA
      obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀A, hA₀open, hxgA₀⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hA
      let B : Set Tiling.Plane :=
        (fun y : Tiling.Plane ↦ (y : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ⁻¹' A₀
      have hBopen : IsOpen B := hA₀open.preimage OnePoint.continuous_coe
      have hxgB : x + g ∈ B := hxgA₀
      let H : Set (Tiling.Plane × Tiling.Plane) :=
        (fun p ↦ p.2 + p.1) ⁻¹' B
      have hHnhds : H ∈ nhds (g, x) :=
        (continuous_snd.add continuous_fst).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
          (hBopen.mem_nhds hxgB)
      obtain ⟨U, hU, V, hV, hUV⟩ := mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp hHnhds
      let V' : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
        (fun y : Tiling.Plane ↦ (y : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) '' V
      have hV' : V' ∈ nhds (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane) := by
        rw [OnePoint.nhds_coe_eq]
        exact Filter.image_mem_map hV
      apply Filter.mem_of_superset (prod_mem_nhds hU hV')
      rintro ⟨g', z'⟩ ⟨hg', hz'⟩
      rcases hz' with ⟨x', hx', rfl⟩
      apply hA₀A
      exact hUV (show (g', x') ∈ U ×ˢ V from ⟨hg', hx'⟩)
  | infty =>
      rw [continuousAt_def]
      intro A hA
      obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀A, hA₀open, hinftyA₀⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hA
      let C : Set Tiling.Plane :=
        ((fun y : Tiling.Plane ↦ (y : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ⁻¹' A₀)ᶜ
      have hC : IsClosed C ∧ IsCompact C :=
        (OnePoint.isOpen_iff_of_mem hinftyA₀).mp hA₀open
      let U : Set Tiling.Plane := Metric.ball g 1
      let D : Set Tiling.Plane :=
        (fun p : Tiling.Plane × Tiling.Plane ↦ p.1 - p.2) ''
          (C ×ˢ Metric.closedBall g 1)
      have hDcompact : IsCompact D :=
        (hC.2.prod (isCompact_closedBall g 1)).image
          (continuous_fst.sub continuous_snd)
      have hDclosed : IsClosed D := hDcompact.isClosed
      let V : Set (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
        (fun y : Tiling.Plane ↦ (y : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) '' Dᶜ ∪
          {OnePoint.infty}
      have hV : V ∈ nhds (OnePoint.infty : OnePoint Tiling.Plane) := by
        exact OnePoint.hasBasis_nhds_infty.mem_iff.mpr
          ⟨D, ⟨hDclosed, hDcompact⟩, Subset.rfl⟩
      have hU : U ∈ nhds g := Metric.ball_mem_nhds g zero_lt_one
      apply Filter.mem_of_superset (prod_mem_nhds hU hV)
      rintro ⟨g', z'⟩ ⟨hg', hz'⟩
      apply hA₀A
      induction z' using OnePoint.rec with
      | infty => exact hinftyA₀
      | coe x =>
          have hxD : x ∉ D := by
            simpa [V] using hz'
          have hxgC : x + g' ∉ C := by
            intro hxgC
            apply hxD
            refine ⟨(x + g', g'), ⟨hxgC, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
            · exact Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr
                (le_of_lt (Metric.mem_ball.mp (show g' ∈ U from hg')))
            · simp only
              abel
          exact not_not.mp hxgC

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.fellCompactification_translate'
statement:
private theorem fellCompactification_translate'
    {N : Set Tiling.Plane} (hN : IsClosed N) (a : Tiling.Plane) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification
        (a +ᵥ N) (hN.vadd a) =
      TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.map
        ((Homeomorph.addRight a).onePointCongr)
        ((Homeomorph.addRight a).onePointCongr.continuous)
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification N hN)
proof:
:= by
  apply TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.ext
  change
    ((fun x : Tiling.Plane ↦ (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) '' (a +ᵥ N) ∪
        {OnePoint.infty}) =
      ((Homeomorph.addRight a).onePointCongr ''
        (((fun x : Tiling.Plane ↦ (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) '' N) ∪
          {OnePoint.infty}))
  ext z
  induction z using OnePoint.rec with
  | infty => simp
  | coe x =>
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
        OnePoint.coe_ne_infty, or_false, Homeomorph.onePointCongr]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, ⟨t, ht, hty⟩, hyx⟩
        subst y
        refine ⟨(t : OnePoint Tiling.Plane), Or.inl ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        simpa [vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hyx
      · rintro ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩
        rcases hz with ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ | rfl
        · exact ⟨a + t, ⟨t, ht, by simp [vadd_eq_add]⟩,
            by simpa [vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hzx⟩
        · simp at hzx

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.translate_fixed_closed_locallyFellConverges
statement:
private theorem translate_fixed_closed_locallyFellConverges
    (N : Set Tiling.Plane) (_hN : IsClosed N)
    (anchor : ℕ → Tiling.Plane) (limitAnchor : Tiling.Plane)
    (hanchor : Tendsto anchor atTop (nhds limitAnchor)) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
      (fun n ↦ anchor n +ᵥ N) (limitAnchor +ᵥ N)
proof:
:= by
  let K₀ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification N _hN
  let mapCompact :
      Tiling.Plane × TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) →
        TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint Tiling.Plane) :=
    fun p ↦ TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.map
      (fun z ↦ onePointTranslate' (p.1, z))
      (onePointTranslate'_continuous.comp
        (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))
      K₀
  have hmap : Continuous mapCompact := by
    apply Continuous.nonemptyCompacts_map'
    · exact continuous_const
    · apply onePointTranslate'_continuous.comp
      exact ((continuous_fst.comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd)
  have hinput : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (anchor n, K₀)) atTop
      (nhds (limitAnchor, K₀)) :=
    hanchor.prodMk_nhds (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ K₀) atTop (nhds K₀))
  have hmapped := (hmap.tendsto (limitAnchor, K₀)).comp hinput
  refine ⟨fun n ↦ _hN.vadd (anchor n), _hN.vadd limitAnchor, ?_⟩
  have heq (a : Tiling.Plane) :
      mapCompact (a, K₀) =
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification
          (a +ᵥ N) (_hN.vadd a) := by
    symm
    have hfun :
        (fun z : OnePoint Tiling.Plane ↦ onePointTranslate' (a, z)) =
          (Homeomorph.addRight a).onePointCongr := by
      funext z
      induction z using OnePoint.rec with
      | infty => rfl
      | coe x => simp [onePointTranslate', Homeomorph.onePointCongr]
    have hmapeq :
        TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.map
            (fun z ↦ onePointTranslate' (a, z))
            (onePointTranslate'_continuous.comp
              (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)) K₀ =
          TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.map
            ((Homeomorph.addRight a).onePointCongr)
            ((Homeomorph.addRight a).onePointCongr.continuous) K₀ := by
      congr 1
    calc
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification
          (a +ᵥ N) (_hN.vadd a) =
          TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.map
            ((Homeomorph.addRight a).onePointCongr)
            ((Homeomorph.addRight a).onePointCongr.continuous) K₀ :=
        fellCompactification_translate' _hN a
      _ = TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.map
            (fun z ↦ onePointTranslate' (a, z))
            (onePointTranslate'_continuous.comp
              (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)) K₀ := hmapeq.symm
      _ = mapCompact (a, K₀) := rfl
  convert hmapped using 1
  · funext n
    exact (heq (anchor n)).symm
  · exact congrArg nhds (heq limitAnchor).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.isCenterColumn_vadd_vertical
statement:
private theorem isCenterColumn_vadd_vertical
    {K : Region} {N : Set Tiling.Plane} (u : Tiling.Plane)
    (hN : IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical K N)
    (haxis : N ⊆ {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = 0}) :
    IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical K (u +ᵥ N)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K (u +ᵥ N)).mpr
    intro s hs t ht hst
    rcases hs with ⟨s₀, hs₀, rfl⟩
    rcases ht with ⟨t₀, ht₀, rfl⟩
    have hdisj := (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K N).mp hN.1 hs₀ ht₀
      (by intro heq; exact hst (by rw [heq]))
    change Disjoint (s₀ +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (t₀ +ᵥ K.openCarrier) at hdisj
    change Disjoint ((u + s₀) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ((u + t₀) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
    rw [Set.disjoint_left] at hdisj ⊢
    intro z hzS hzT
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hzS hzT
    apply hdisj (a := -u + z)
    · rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using hzS
    · rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using hzT
  · rcases hN.2.1 with ⟨z, hz⟩
    exact ⟨u + z, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩⟩
  · refine ⟨u.re, ?_⟩
    rintro z ⟨z₀, hz₀, rfl⟩
    change (u + z₀).re = u.re
    have hzre : z₀.re = 0 := haxis hz₀
    simp [hzre]
  · intro a
    change (((a : ℂ) * Complex.I) +ᵥ regularSupport K (u +ᵥ N)) =
      regularSupport K (u +ᵥ N)
    rw [regularSupport_vadd]
    calc
      ((a : ℂ) * Complex.I) +ᵥ (u +ᵥ regularSupport K N) =
          (((a : ℂ) * Complex.I) + u) +ᵥ regularSupport K N := by
            rw [vadd_vadd]
      _ = (u + (a : ℂ) * Complex.I) +ᵥ regularSupport K N := by
            rw [add_comm]
      _ = u +ᵥ (((a : ℂ) * Complex.I) +ᵥ regularSupport K N) := by
            rw [vadd_vadd]
      _ = u +ᵥ regularSupport K N := by rw [hN.2.2.2 a]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.exists_normalizedVerticalColumnLimitData_of_normalization
statement:
private theorem exists_normalizedVerticalColumnLimitData_of_normalization
    {K : Region}
    (T : ℕ → Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ)
    (S : Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ)
    (C : (n : ℕ) → Continuous.VerticalPlate K ((T n).centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
    (_hC : ∀ n : ℕ, Continuous.IsVerticalColumn (C n))
    (anchor : ℕ → Tiling.Plane)
    (_hanchor : ∀ n : ℕ, anchor n ∈ (C n).centres)
    (limitAnchor : Tiling.Plane)
    (hanchor_converges : Tendsto anchor atTop (nhds limitAnchor))
    (hconverges : Topology.LocallyFellConverges
      (Topology.TilingSpace.centresSequence T) (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
    (hnormalize : ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (N : Set Tiling.Plane),
      StrictMono φ ∧
        (∀ n, (-anchor (φ n)) +ᵥ (C (φ n)).centres = N) ∧
        N.Nonempty ∧ 0 ∈ N ∧
        N ⊆ {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = 0} ∧
        IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical K N)
    :
    Nonempty (NormalizedVerticalColumnLimitData T S C anchor limitAnchor)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases hnormalize with ⟨φ, N, hφ, hexact, hNne, hNzero, hNaxis, hNcolumn⟩
  have hNclosed : IsClosed N := isClosed_of_isCenterColumn hNcolumn
  have hambientSub := locallyFellConverges_comp_strictMono
    (fun n ↦ ((T n).centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
    φ hφ hconverges
  have hsubset : ∀ n, anchor (φ n) +ᵥ N ⊆
      ((T (φ n)).centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
    intro n
    have heq : anchor (φ n) +ᵥ N = (C (φ n)).centres := by
      rw [← hexact n, vadd_vadd]
      simp
    rw [heq]
    exact verticalPlate_centres_subset (C (φ n))
  have hlimitSubset : limitAnchor +ᵥ N ⊆ (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
    apply translated_normalized_subset_ambientLimit
      (fun n ↦ T (φ n)) S N (fun n ↦ anchor (φ n)) limitAnchor hsubset
      (hanchor_converges.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) hambientSub
  have hlimitColumn' := isCenterColumn_vadd_vertical limitAnchor hNcolumn hNaxis
  have hlimitMem : limitAnchor ∈ limitAnchor +ᵥ N := by
    exact ⟨0, hNzero, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hPcolumn, hPmem, hPeq⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.completeColumn_eq_verticalPlateThrough
      S.tilesOn hlimitColumn' hlimitSubset hlimitMem
  have hcolumnConverges : Topology.LocallyFellConverges
      (fun n ↦ (C (φ n)).centres) P.centres := by
    rw [hPeq]
    have htranslated :=
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.translate_fixed_closed_locallyFellConverges
        N hNclosed (fun n ↦ anchor (φ n)) limitAnchor
        (hanchor_converges.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
    have hseq : (fun n ↦ (C (φ n)).centres) =
        (fun n ↦ anchor (φ n) +ᵥ N) := by
      funext n
      exact (show anchor (φ n) +ᵥ N = (C (φ n)).centres from by
        rw [← hexact n, vadd_vadd]
        simp).symm
    rw [hseq]
    exact htranslated
  refine ⟨{
    subsequence := φ
    subsequence_strictMono := hφ
    ambient_converges := hambientSub
    normalizedCentres := N
    normalized_closed := hNclosed
    normalized_nonempty := hNne
    zero_mem_normalized := hNzero
    normalized_on_verticalAxis := hNaxis
    normalized_isCenterColumn := hNcolumn
    normalization_exact := hexact
    limitPlate := P
    limitPlate_isColumn := hPcolumn
    limitAnchor_mem := hPmem
    column_converges := hcolumnConverges
    limitCentres_eq := hPeq
  }⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.verticalColumn_survives_anchoredLimit_of_normalization
statement:
private theorem verticalColumn_survives_anchoredLimit_of_normalization
    {K : Region}
    (T : ℕ → Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ)
    (S : Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ)
    (C : (n : ℕ) → Continuous.VerticalPlate K ((T n).centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
    (hC : ∀ n : ℕ, Continuous.IsVerticalColumn (C n))
    (anchor : ℕ → Tiling.Plane)
    (hanchor : ∀ n : ℕ, anchor n ∈ (C n).centres)
    (limitAnchor : Tiling.Plane)
    (hanchor_converges : Tendsto anchor atTop (nhds limitAnchor))
    (hconverges : Topology.LocallyFellConverges
      (Topology.TilingSpace.centresSequence T) (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
    (hnormalize : ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (N : Set Tiling.Plane),
      StrictMono φ ∧
        (∀ n, (-anchor (φ n)) +ᵥ (C (φ n)).centres = N) ∧
        N.Nonempty ∧ 0 ∈ N ∧
        N ⊆ {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = 0} ∧
        IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical K N)
    :
    ∃ P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane),
      Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧ limitAnchor ∈ P.centres
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_normalizedVerticalColumnLimitData_of_normalization
    T S C hC anchor hanchor limitAnchor hanchor_converges hconverges hnormalize
    with ⟨D⟩
  exact ⟨D.limitPlate, D.limitPlate_isColumn, D.limitAnchor_mem⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.exists_normalizedVerticalColumnLimitData
statement:
theorem exists_normalizedVerticalColumnLimitData
    {K : Region}
    (T : ℕ → Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ)
    (S : Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ)
    (C : (n : ℕ) → Continuous.VerticalPlate K ((T n).centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
    (hC : ∀ n : ℕ, Continuous.IsVerticalColumn (C n))
    (anchor : ℕ → Tiling.Plane)
    (hanchor : ∀ n, anchor n ∈ (C n).centres)
    (limitAnchor : Tiling.Plane)
    (hanchor_converges : Filter.Tendsto anchor Filter.atTop (nhds limitAnchor))
    (hconverges : Topology.LocallyFellConverges
      (Topology.TilingSpace.centresSequence T) (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) :
    Nonempty (NormalizedVerticalColumnLimitData T S C anchor limitAnchor)
proof:
:= by
  have hCcent : ∀ n, IsCenterColumn Axis.vertical K ((C n).centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
    intro n
    exact verticalPlate_isCenterColumn_of_isVerticalColumn (T n).tilesOn (C n) (hC n)
  have hnormalize := exists_strictMono_normalization_exact
    (K := K) (fun n => (C n).centres) hCcent anchor hanchor
  exact exists_normalizedVerticalColumnLimitData_of_normalization
    T S C hC anchor hanchor limitAnchor hanchor_converges hconverges hnormalize

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.verticalColumn_survives_anchoredLimit
statement:
theorem verticalColumn_survives_anchoredLimit
    {K : Region}
    (T : ℕ → Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ)
    (S : Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ)
    (C : (n : ℕ) → Continuous.VerticalPlate K ((T n).centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
    (hC : ∀ n, Continuous.IsVerticalColumn (C n))
    (anchor : ℕ → Tiling.Plane)
    (hanchor : ∀ n, anchor n ∈ (C n).centres)
    (limitAnchor : Tiling.Plane)
    (hanchor_converges : Filter.Tendsto anchor Filter.atTop (nhds limitAnchor))
    (hconverges : Topology.LocallyFellConverges
      (Topology.TilingSpace.centresSequence T) (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) :
    ∃ P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane),
      Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧ limitAnchor ∈ P.centres
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := exists_normalizedVerticalColumnLimitData
    T S C hC anchor hanchor limitAnchor hanchor_converges hconverges
  exact ⟨D.limitPlate, D.limitPlate_isColumn, D.limitAnchor_mem⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.coordinateSwapTiling_exists
statement:
private theorem coordinateSwapTiling_exists
    {K : Region} (T : TilingSpace K Set.univ) :
    ∃ Tσ : TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ,
      IsCoordinateSwapTiling T Tσ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Tσ, hTσ⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.exists_coordinateSwapTiling T
  exact ⟨Tσ, hTσ⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.coordinateSwapTiling_unique
statement:
private theorem coordinateSwapTiling_unique
    {K : Region} {T : TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    {Tσ Uσ : TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ} :
    IsCoordinateSwapTiling T Tσ → IsCoordinateSwapTiling T Uσ → Tσ = Uσ
proof:
:= by
  intro hTσ hUσ
  cases Tσ with
  | mk cσ hσ =>
    cases Uσ with
    | mk cυ hυ =>
      congr 1
      apply TopologicalSpace.Closeds.ext
      exact hTσ.trans hUσ.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.coordinateSwapTiling_involutive
statement:
private theorem coordinateSwapTiling_involutive
    {K : Region} {T : TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    {Tσ : TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ} :
    IsCoordinateSwapTiling T Tσ →
      ∃ U : TilingSpace K Set.univ,
        (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) = (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) ∧
        (coordinateSwap '' (Tσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) =
          (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
proof:
:= by
  intro hTσ
  refine ⟨T, rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [hTσ]
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    simpa using hu
  · intro hz
    exact ⟨coordinateSwap z, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, coordinateSwap_apply_apply z⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.coordinateSwap_orbitHull_iff
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [IsCoordinateSwapTiling] using
    (Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.coordinateSwap_orbitHull_iff
      (T := T) (S := S) (Tσ := Tσ) (Sσ := Sσ) hTσ hSσ)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.coordinateSwap_nontrivial_iff
statement:
private theorem coordinateSwap_nontrivial_iff
    {K : Region} {T : TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    {Tσ : TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ} :
    IsCoordinateSwapTiling T Tσ →
    (NontrivialVerticalDecomposition K (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) ↔
      NontrivialVerticalDecomposition K.coordinateSwap.coordinateSwap
        (coordinateSwap '' (Tσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)))
proof:
:= by
  intro hTσ
  have himage :
      coordinateSwap '' (coordinateSwap '' (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) =
        (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      simpa using hu
    · intro hz
      exact ⟨coordinateSwap z, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, coordinateSwap_apply_apply z⟩
  rw [hTσ, Region.coordinateSwap_involutive K, himage]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.orbitHull_transitive
statement:
private theorem orbitHull_transitive
    {K : Region} {T S U : TilingSpace K Set.univ} :
    S ∈ orbitHull T → U ∈ orbitHull S → U ∈ orbitHull T
proof:
:= by
  intro hST hUS
  let H : Set (TilingSpace K Set.univ) := orbitHull T
  have hclosed : IsClosed H := isClosed_closure
  apply (closure_minimal ?_ hclosed) hUS
  intro V hV
  rcases hV with ⟨g, rfl⟩
  have himage : TilingSpace.translate g '' H = H :=
    (orbitHull_compact T).2.2 g
  exact (Set.ext_iff.mp himage _).mp ⟨S, hST, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.planeNontrivialEarthquake_exists
statement:
private theorem planeNontrivialEarthquake_exists :
    ∀ {K : Region} (T : TilingSpace K Set.univ),
      (¬ HasFLC (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) →
        Nonempty (NontrivialEarthquakeLimitData K Set.univ T)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hT
  exact exists_nontrivialEarthquakeOrbitLimit Set.univ_nonempty isOpen_univ
    (by simp) (beta0 := (1 : ℝ)) (by norm_num) (by simp) T hT

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.verticalEarthquakeSplit_nontrivial
proof:
:= by
  intro K T E hor hbad
  obtain ⟨P, _hPcolumn, hPcentres⟩ := hbad
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := E.persistent_nonempty
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := E.transient_nonempty
  have hpLimit : p ∈ (E.limit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) :=
    E.split.persistent_subset hp
  have hqLimit : q ∈ (E.limit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) :=
    E.split.transient_subset hq
  have hpP : p ∈ P.centres := by
    rw [hPcentres]
    exact hpLimit
  have hqP : q ∈ P.centres := by
    rw [hPcentres]
    exact hqLimit
  have hmeet : (P.centres ∩ E.split.persistent).Nonempty := ⟨p, hpP, hp⟩
  have hsat := E.split.verticalPersistent_plateSaturated hor P hmeet
  exact (Set.disjoint_left.1 E.split.disjoint) (hsat hqP) hq

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.horizontalEarthquakeSplit_nontrivial
statement:
private theorem horizontalEarthquakeSplit_nontrivial :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : TilingSpace K Set.univ}
      (E : NontrivialEarthquakeLimitData K Set.univ T)
      (Eσ : TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ),
      IsCoordinateSwapTiling E.limit Eσ →
      E.split.orientation = Axis.horizontal →
        NontrivialVerticalDecomposition K.coordinateSwap
          (Eσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T E Eσ hswap hor
  change (Eσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
    coordinateSwap '' (E.limit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) at hswap
  rw [hswap]
  intro hbad
  obtain ⟨P, _hPcolumn, hPcentres⟩ := hbad
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := E.persistent_nonempty
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := E.transient_nonempty
  have hpLimit : p ∈ (E.limit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) :=
    E.split.persistent_subset hp
  have hqLimit : q ∈ (E.limit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) :=
    E.split.transient_subset hq
  have hpP : coordinateSwap p ∈ P.centres := by
    rw [hPcentres]
    exact ⟨p, hpLimit, rfl⟩
  have hqP : coordinateSwap q ∈ P.centres := by
    rw [hPcentres]
    exact ⟨q, hqLimit, rfl⟩
  have hmeet : (P.centres ∩ (coordinateSwap '' E.split.persistent)).Nonempty :=
    ⟨coordinateSwap p, hpP, ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩⟩
  have hsat := E.split.horizontalPersistent_plateSaturated hor P hmeet
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hreq⟩ := hsat hqP
  have hrq : r = q := coordinateSwap.injective hreq
  exact (Set.disjoint_left.1 E.split.disjoint) (hrq ▸ hr) hq

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.trichotomyData_vertical_of
statement:
private theorem trichotomyData_vertical_of :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T S : TilingSpace K Set.univ},
      S ∈ orbitHull T →
      HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) →
      NontrivialVerticalDecomposition K (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) →
        Nonempty (FiniteHorizontalComplexityTrichotomyData K T)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T S hHull hFinite hNontrivial
  exact ⟨{
    orientation := Axis.vertical
    limit := S
    limit_mem_hull := hHull
    swapped_tilesOn := by intro h; cases h
    finiteHorizontal_original := by intro h; exact hFinite
    finiteHorizontal_swapped := by intro h; cases h
    nontrivialVertical_original := by intro h; exact hNontrivial
    nontrivialVertical_swapped := by intro h; cases h }⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.trichotomyData_horizontal_of
statement:
private theorem trichotomyData_horizontal_of :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T S : TilingSpace K Set.univ}
      (Sσ : TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ),
      IsCoordinateSwapTiling S Sσ → S ∈ orbitHull T →
      HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity (Sσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) →
      NontrivialVerticalDecomposition K.coordinateSwap
        (Sσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) →
      Nonempty (FiniteHorizontalComplexityTrichotomyData K T)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T S Sσ hswap hHull hFinite hNontrivial
  exact ⟨{
    orientation := Axis.horizontal
    limit := S
    limit_mem_hull := hHull
    swapped_tilesOn := by
      intro _
      rw [← hswap]
      exact Sσ.tilesOn
    finiteHorizontal_original := by intro h; cases h
    finiteHorizontal_swapped := by intro h; rw [← hswap]; exact hFinite
    nontrivialVertical_original := by intro h; cases h
    nontrivialVertical_swapped := by intro h; rw [← hswap]; exact hNontrivial }⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.swappedCrossAxisFiniteBranch
statement:
private theorem swappedCrossAxisFiniteBranch
    {K : Region} {T S₀ : TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    (S₀σ : TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ)
    (hS₀σ : IsCoordinateSwapTiling S₀ S₀σ)
    (hS₀T : S₀ ∈ orbitHull T)
    (S₁ : TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ)
    (hS₁ : S₁ ∈ orbitHull S₀σ)
    (hNontrivial : NontrivialVerticalDecomposition K.coordinateSwap.coordinateSwap
      (coordinateSwap '' (S₁.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)))
    (hFinite : HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity
      (coordinateSwap '' (S₁.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))) :
    ∃ U : TilingSpace K Set.univ,
      (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
          coordinateSwap '' (S₁.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) ∧
      U ∈ orbitHull T ∧
      NontrivialVerticalDecomposition K (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) ∧
      HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U₀, hU₀⟩ := coordinateSwapTiling_exists S₁
  have hK : K.coordinateSwap.coordinateSwap = K :=
    Region.coordinateSwap_involutive K
  let U : TilingSpace K Set.univ :=
    { centres := U₀.centres
      tilesOn := Eq.mp
        (congrArg (fun R : Region =>
          TilesOn R (U₀.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) Set.univ) hK)
        U₀.tilesOn }
  have hUcent : (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
      coordinateSwap '' (S₁.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
    simpa only [U, IsCoordinateSwapTiling] using hU₀
  have hUσ : IsCoordinateSwapTiling U S₁ := by
    change (S₁.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
      coordinateSwap '' (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
    rw [hUcent]
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      exact ⟨coordinateSwap z, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, coordinateSwap_apply_apply z⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      simpa using hu
  have hUS₀ : U ∈ orbitHull S₀ := by
    apply (coordinateSwap_orbitHull_iff hS₀σ hUσ).mpr
    exact hS₁
  have hUT : U ∈ orbitHull T :=
    orbitHull_transitive hS₀T hUS₀
  have hNontrivialU : NontrivialVerticalDecomposition K
      (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) :=
    (coordinateSwap_nontrivial_iff hUσ).mpr hNontrivial
  refine ⟨U, hUcent, hUT, hNontrivialU, ?_⟩
  rw [hUcent]
  exact hFinite

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.normalizedPersistentBranch_exists
proof:
:= by
  intro K source limit A hA
  cases A with
  | finiteVerticalComplexity finite => exact False.elim hA
  | persistentHorizontalColumn anchor anchor_mem movingCentre movingCentre_mem
      translations translations_eq converges fibre fibre_eq anchor_mem_fibre
      horizontalPlate horizontalPlate_isColumn horizontalPlate_centres persistent_pullback =>
    obtain ⟨vertexAnchor, vertexAnchor_mem, _vertexB, _vertexB_mem, _hdiam, _hdist⟩ :=
      Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.exists_intrinsicDiameterPair K
    obtain ⟨C : ApproximationContext.{u}, hCregion, hCcentres, hCtarget, hCtiles⟩ :=
      normalizeApproximationContext K (source.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) Set.univ
        vertexAnchor vertexAnchor_mem anchor anchor_mem
    have htarget : C.target = Set.univ := by
      simpa using hCtarget
    have hsourceTiles : TilesOn C.region C.centres Set.univ := by
      have h := hCtiles.mp source.tilesOn
      simpa [htarget] using h
    have hCclosed : IsClosed C.centres := by
      rw [hCcentres]
      have himage : (-anchor) +ᵥ (source.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
          Homeomorph.addRight (-anchor) '' (source.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
        ext z
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨y, hy, by simp [vadd_eq_add, add_comm]⟩
        · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨y, hy, by simp [vadd_eq_add, add_comm]⟩
      rw [himage]
      exact (Homeomorph.addRight (-anchor)).isClosed_image.mpr source.centres.isClosed
    let normalizedSource : TilingSpace C.region Set.univ :=
      ⟨⟨C.centres, hCclosed⟩, hsourceTiles⟩
    have hcarrier : C.region.openCarrier =
        positiveSimilarity 1 (-vertexAnchor) '' K.openCarrier := by
      rw [hCregion]
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨w, hw, by
          simp [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add]
          abel⟩
      · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨w, hw, by
          simp [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add]
          abel⟩
    have hlimitTiles : TilesOn C.region
        (positiveSimilarity 1 (-anchor) '' (limit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) Set.univ := by
      have hscale : (0 : ℝ) < 1 := by norm_num
      have h := (tilesOn_positiveSimilarity_iff (s := 1) (r := -vertexAnchor)
        (c := -anchor) hscale hcarrier).mpr limit.tilesOn
      have himage : positiveSimilarity 1 (-vertexAnchor + -anchor) ''
          (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane) = Set.univ := by
        rw [Set.image_univ, Set.range_eq_univ.mpr (positiveSimilarity_surjective hscale)]
      rw [himage] at h
      exact h
    have hlimitClosed : IsClosed
        (positiveSimilarity 1 (-anchor) '' (limit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) := by
      have himage : positiveSimilarity 1 (-anchor) '' (limit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
          Homeomorph.addRight (-anchor) '' (limit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
        ext z
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨y, hy, by simp [positiveSimilarity]⟩
        · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨y, hy, by simp [positiveSimilarity]⟩
      rw [himage]
      exact (Homeomorph.addRight (-anchor)).isClosed_image.mpr limit.centres.isClosed
    let normalizedLimit : TilingSpace C.region Set.univ :=
      ⟨⟨positiveSimilarity 1 (-anchor) '' (limit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane),
        hlimitClosed⟩, hlimitTiles⟩
    let b : aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane) :=
      ⟨-anchor, by
        rw [aePeriodGroup, Tiling.Polygonal.aePeriodGroup, AddAction.aestabilizer_univ]
        exact AddSubgroup.mem_top (-anchor)⟩
    have hOldTendsto : Tendsto
        (TilingSpace.translateSequence translations source) atTop (nhds limit) :=
      ((locallyFell_metrizable K Set.univ).2 _ limit).mpr converges
    have hTranslateContinuous : Continuous (fun U : TilingSpace K Set.univ =>
        TilingSpace.translate b U) := by
      exact (translationAction_continuous K Set.univ).comp
        (Continuous.prodMk continuous_const continuous_id)
    have hTranslatedTendsto : Tendsto
        (fun n => TilingSpace.translate b
          (TilingSpace.translate (translations n) source)) atTop
        (nhds (TilingSpace.translate b limit)) :=
      (hTranslateContinuous.tendsto limit).comp hOldTendsto
    have hTranslatedConverges : LocallyFellConverges
        (fun n => ((TilingSpace.translate b
          (TilingSpace.translate (translations n) source)).centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
        ((TilingSpace.translate b limit).centres : Set Tiling.Plane) :=
      ((locallyFell_metrizable K Set.univ).2 _ (TilingSpace.translate b limit)).mp
        hTranslatedTendsto
    have hSeqCentres :
        TilingSpace.centresSequence
            (TilingSpace.translateSequence translations normalizedSource) =
          (fun n => ((TilingSpace.translate b
            (TilingSpace.translate (translations n) source)).centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) := by
      funext n
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        rcases hz with ⟨x, hx, hzx⟩
        change x ∈ C.centres at hx
        rw [hCcentres] at hx
        rcases hx with ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
        have hy' : y + (translations n : Tiling.Plane) ∈
            ((TilingSpace.translate (translations n) source).centres : Set Tiling.Plane) :=
          ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨y + (translations n : Tiling.Plane), hy', ?_⟩
        rw [← hxy] at hzx
        simpa [b, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hzx
      · intro hz
        rcases hz with ⟨y, hy, hzy⟩
        change y ∈ (fun x : Tiling.Plane => x + (translations n : Tiling.Plane)) ''
          (source.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) at hy
        rcases hy with ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨y₀ - anchor, ?_, ?_⟩
        · change y₀ - anchor ∈ C.centres
          rw [hCcentres]
          exact ⟨y₀, hy₀, by
            simp only [vadd_eq_add]
            abel⟩
        · change (y₀ - anchor) + (translations n : Tiling.Plane) = z
          rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
          simpa [b, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using hzy
    have hLimitCentres :
        (normalizedLimit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
          ((TilingSpace.translate b limit).centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨y, hy, by simp [b, positiveSimilarity]⟩
      · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨y, hy, by simp [b, positiveSimilarity]⟩
    have hNormalizedConverges : LocallyFellConverges
        (TilingSpace.centresSequence
          (TilingSpace.translateSequence translations normalizedSource))
        (normalizedLimit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
      rw [hSeqCentres, hLimitCentres]
      exact hTranslatedConverges
    have hNormalizedTendsto : Tendsto
        (TilingSpace.translateSequence translations normalizedSource) atTop
        (nhds normalizedLimit) :=
      ((locallyFell_metrizable C.region Set.univ).2 _ normalizedLimit).mpr
        hNormalizedConverges
    have hLimitHull : normalizedLimit ∈ orbitHull normalizedSource := by
      apply mem_closure_of_tendsto hNormalizedTendsto
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => AddAction.mem_orbit _ (translations n)
    have hsimVadd (u : Tiling.Plane) (S : Set Tiling.Plane) :
        positiveSimilarity 1 u '' S = u +ᵥ S := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨y, hy, by
          simp [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add]
          abel⟩
      · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨y, hy, by
          simp [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add]
          abel⟩
    have hswapVadd (u : Tiling.Plane) (S : Set Tiling.Plane) :
        coordinateSwap '' (u +ᵥ S) = coordinateSwap u +ᵥ (coordinateSwap '' S) := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨w, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨coordinateSwap y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, coordinateSwap.map_add u y⟩
      · rintro ⟨w, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨u + y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, coordinateSwap.map_add u y⟩
    have hswapOpen (R : Region) :
        R.coordinateSwap.openCarrier = coordinateSwap '' R.openCarrier := by
      change interior (coordinateSwap '' R.support) = coordinateSwap '' interior R.support
      exact (coordinateSwap.toHomeomorph.image_interior R.support).symm
    have hcarrierSwap : C.region.coordinateSwap.openCarrier =
        positiveSimilarity 1 (coordinateSwap (-vertexAnchor)) ''
          K.coordinateSwap.openCarrier := by
      rw [hswapOpen C.region, hCregion, hswapVadd, hswapOpen K]
      ext z
      constructor <;> rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ <;>
        exact ⟨y, hy, by
          simp [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add]
          abel⟩
    let normalizedFibre : Set Tiling.Plane := (-anchor) +ᵥ fibre
    have hFibreEq : normalizedFibre =
        (normalizedLimit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) ∩
          {z : Tiling.Plane | z.im = (0 : Tiling.Plane).im} := by
      dsimp [normalizedFibre]
      rw [fibre_eq]
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨s, ⟨hsLimit, hsLine⟩, rfl⟩
        change s.im = anchor.im at hsLine
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · exact ⟨s, hsLimit, by
            simp [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add]
            abel⟩
        · change (-anchor + s).im = (0 : Tiling.Plane).im
          rw [Complex.add_im, Complex.neg_im, hsLine]
          simp
      · rintro ⟨hz, hzLine⟩
        rcases hz with ⟨s, hsLimit, hzs⟩
        have hsLine : s.im = anchor.im := by
          change z.im = (0 : Tiling.Plane).im at hzLine
          rw [← hzs] at hzLine
          simp [positiveSimilarity] at hzLine
          linarith
        refine ⟨s, ⟨hsLimit, hsLine⟩, ?_⟩
        simpa [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hzs
    have hzeroContext : (0 : Tiling.Plane) ∈ C.centres := by
      rw [hCcentres]
      exact ⟨anchor, anchor_mem, by simp [vadd_eq_add]⟩
    have hmovingContext (n : ℕ) : movingCentre n - anchor ∈ C.centres := by
      rw [hCcentres]
      exact ⟨movingCentre n, movingCentre_mem n, by
        simp only [vadd_eq_add]
        abel⟩
    have hzeroFibre : (0 : Tiling.Plane) ∈ normalizedFibre := by
      exact ⟨anchor, anchor_mem_fibre, by simp [vadd_eq_add]⟩
    have hMovingFibre (s : Tiling.Plane) (hs : s ∈ normalizedFibre) :
        ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, s - (translations n : Tiling.Plane) ∈ C.centres := by
      rcases hs with ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
      filter_upwards [persistent_pullback t ht] with n hn
      rw [hCcentres]
      exact ⟨t - (translations n : Tiling.Plane), hn, by
        simp only [vadd_eq_add]
        abel⟩
    have hswapLimit : coordinateSwap '' (normalizedLimit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
        positiveSimilarity 1 (coordinateSwap (-anchor)) ''
          (coordinateSwap '' (limit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) := by
      rw [show (normalizedLimit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
        positiveSimilarity 1 (-anchor) '' (limit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) by rfl]
      rw [hsimVadd, hswapVadd, hsimVadd]
    let plateEquiv :
        VerticalPlate K.coordinateSwap
            (coordinateSwap '' (limit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) ≃
          VerticalPlate C.region.coordinateSwap
            (positiveSimilarity 1 (coordinateSwap (-anchor)) ''
              (coordinateSwap '' (limit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))) :=
      verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv
        (by norm_num) hcarrierSwap (coordinateSwap (-anchor))
    let plateRaw := plateEquiv horizontalPlate
    have transportColumn {T U : Set Tiling.Plane} (h : T = U)
        (P : VerticalPlate C.region.coordinateSwap T) :
        IsVerticalColumn P → IsVerticalColumn (h ▸ P) := by
      intro hP
      cases h
      exact hP
    have transportCentres {T U : Set Tiling.Plane} (h : T = U)
        (P : VerticalPlate C.region.coordinateSwap T) (Q : Set Tiling.Plane)
        (hP : P.centres = Q) : (h ▸ P).centres = Q := by
      cases h
      exact hP
    let plate : VerticalPlate C.region.coordinateSwap
        (coordinateSwap '' (normalizedLimit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) :=
      hswapLimit.symm ▸ plateRaw
    have hplateColumn : IsVerticalColumn plate := by
      have hplateRawColumn : IsVerticalColumn plateRaw :=
        (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_isVerticalColumn
          (by norm_num) hcarrierSwap (coordinateSwap (-anchor)) horizontalPlate).mp
          horizontalPlate_isColumn
      exact transportColumn hswapLimit.symm plateRaw hplateRawColumn
    have hplateCentres : plate.centres = coordinateSwap '' normalizedFibre := by
      have hraw : plateRaw.centres =
          positiveSimilarity 1 (coordinateSwap (-anchor)) ''
            horizontalPlate.centres := by
        exact verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_centres_image
          (by norm_num) hcarrierSwap (coordinateSwap (-anchor)) horizontalPlate
      have hraw' : plateRaw.centres =
          positiveSimilarity 1 (coordinateSwap (-anchor)) ''
            (coordinateSwap '' fibre) := by
        calc
          plateRaw.centres = positiveSimilarity 1 (coordinateSwap (-anchor)) ''
              horizontalPlate.centres := hraw
          _ = positiveSimilarity 1 (coordinateSwap (-anchor)) ''
              (coordinateSwap '' fibre) := by rw [horizontalPlate_centres]
      have himage : positiveSimilarity 1 (coordinateSwap (-anchor)) ''
          (coordinateSwap '' fibre) = coordinateSwap '' normalizedFibre := by
        calc
          positiveSimilarity 1 (coordinateSwap (-anchor)) ''
              (coordinateSwap '' fibre) =
              coordinateSwap (-anchor) +ᵥ (coordinateSwap '' fibre) :=
                hsimVadd _ _
          _ = coordinateSwap '' ((-anchor) +ᵥ fibre) :=
            (hswapVadd (-anchor) fibre).symm
          _ = coordinateSwap '' normalizedFibre := by rfl
      have hraw'' : plateRaw.centres = coordinateSwap '' normalizedFibre :=
        hraw'.trans himage
      exact transportCentres hswapLimit.symm plateRaw _ hraw''
    let normalizedFibreData : PersistentHorizontalFibreData C normalizedSource := {
      source_centres_eq := by rfl
      limit := normalizedLimit
      limit_mem_hull := hLimitHull
      translations := translations
      converges := hNormalizedConverges
      anchor := 0
      anchor_mem_context := hzeroContext
      movingCentre := fun n => movingCentre n - anchor
      movingCentre_mem_context := hmovingContext
      translations_eq := by
        intro n
        rw [translations_eq]
        simp only [zero_sub]
        abel
      fibre := normalizedFibre
      fibre_eq := hFibreEq
      anchor_mem_fibre := hzeroFibre
      horizontalPlate := plate
      horizontalPlate_isColumn := hplateColumn
      horizontalPlate_centres := hplateCentres
      persistent_pullback := hMovingFibre }
    refine ⟨{
      vertexAnchor := vertexAnchor
      vertexAnchor_mem := vertexAnchor_mem
      centreAnchor := anchor
      centreAnchor_mem := anchor_mem
      context := C
      normalizedSource := normalizedSource
      context_region := hCregion
      context_centres := hCcentres
      context_target := htarget
      normalizedSource_centres := by rfl
      fibre := normalizedFibreData }⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.normalization_preserves_nontrivial
proof:
:= by
  intro K source N hSource hBad
  have hscale : (0 : ℝ) < 1 := by norm_num
  have hcarrier : N.context.region.openCarrier =
      positiveSimilarity 1 (-N.vertexAnchor) '' K.openCarrier := by
    rw [N.context_region]
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨w, hw, by
        simp [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add]
        abel⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨w, hw, by
        simp [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add]
        abel⟩
  have himage : N.context.centres =
      positiveSimilarity 1 (-N.centreAnchor) ''
        (source.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
    rw [N.context_centres]
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨w, hw, by
        simp [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add]
        abel⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨w, hw, by
        simp [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add]
        abel⟩
  have hBad' : ∃ P : VerticalPlate N.context.region
      (positiveSimilarity 1 (-N.centreAnchor) ''
        (source.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)),
      ¬ IsVerticalColumn P ∧
        P.centres = positiveSimilarity 1 (-N.centreAnchor) ''
          (source.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
    exact himage ▸ hBad
  rcases hBad' with ⟨P, hPnot, hPcentres⟩
  let P' : VerticalPlate N.context.region
      (positiveSimilarity 1 (-N.centreAnchor) ''
        (source.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) := P
  let e : VerticalPlate K (source.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) ≃
      VerticalPlate N.context.region
        (positiveSimilarity 1 (-N.centreAnchor) ''
          (source.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) :=
    verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hscale hcarrier (-N.centreAnchor)
  let Q : VerticalPlate K (source.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := e.symm P'
  have heq : e Q = P' := e.apply_symm_apply P'
  have hQcentres : Q.centres = (source.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
    have heq : e Q = P' := e.apply_symm_apply P'
    have hP'image : P'.centres = positiveSimilarity 1 (-N.centreAnchor) '' Q.centres := by
      rw [← heq]
      exact verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_centres_image
        hscale hcarrier (-N.centreAnchor) Q
    have hP'centres : P'.centres = N.context.centres := by
      exact hPcentres.trans himage.symm
    rw [hP'centres] at hP'image
    exact (Set.image_eq_image (positiveSimilarity_injective hscale)).mp
      (hP'image.symm.trans himage)
  have hQnot : ¬ IsVerticalColumn Q := by
    intro hQcol
    apply hPnot
    have hiff := verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_isVerticalColumn
      hscale hcarrier (-N.centreAnchor) Q
    have : IsVerticalColumn (e Q) := hiff.mp hQcol
    have hP'col : IsVerticalColumn P' := by
      rw [← heq]
      exact this
    exact hP'col
  exact hSource ⟨Q, hQnot, hQcentres⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.realProjection_vadd
statement:
private theorem realProjection_vadd (u : Tiling.Plane) (S : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    Complex.re '' (u +ᵥ S) = u.re +ᵥ (Complex.re '' S)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨y.re, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [vadd_eq_add]
  · rintro ⟨x₀, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨u + y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [vadd_eq_add]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.imaginaryProjection_vadd
statement:
private theorem imaginaryProjection_vadd (u : Tiling.Plane) (S : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    Complex.im '' (u +ᵥ S) = u.im +ᵥ (Complex.im '' S)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨y.im, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [vadd_eq_add]
  · rintro ⟨x₀, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨u + y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [vadd_eq_add]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.horizontalCentreProjection_vadd
statement:
private theorem horizontalCentreProjection_vadd (u : Tiling.Plane)
    (S : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    horizontalCentreProjection (u +ᵥ S) =
      u.re +ᵥ horizontalCentreProjection S
proof:
:= by
  exact realProjection_vadd u S

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.normalization_preserves_infiniteHorizontal
proof:
:= by
  intro K source N hSource hContext
  have hContextFLC : HasFLC (horizontalCentreProjection N.context.centres) :=
    hContext
  rw [N.context_centres, horizontalCentreProjection_vadd] at hContextFLC
  have hSourceFLC : HasFLC (horizontalCentreProjection
      (source.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) := by
    have htranslated := hContextFLC.vadd N.centreAnchor.re
    simpa [vadd_vadd, vadd_eq_add, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using htranslated
  exact hSource hSourceFLC

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.normalization_reflects_productRegion
proof:
:= by
  intro K source N hContextProduct
  rw [isProductRegion_iff_regularizedProjections] at hContextProduct ⊢
  have hRealProjection :
      interior (closure (Complex.re '' N.context.region.openCarrier)) =
        (-N.vertexAnchor).re +ᵥ
          interior (closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier)) := by
    rw [N.context_region, realProjection_vadd, closure_vadd, interior_vadd]
  have hImaginaryProjection :
      interior (closure (Complex.im '' N.context.region.openCarrier)) =
        (-N.vertexAnchor).im +ᵥ
          interior (closure (Complex.im '' K.openCarrier)) := by
    rw [N.context_region, imaginaryProjection_vadd, closure_vadd, interior_vadd]
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hz' : (-N.vertexAnchor) + z ∈ N.context.region.openCarrier := by
      rw [N.context_region]
      exact ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    rw [hContextProduct] at hz'
    rw [hRealProjection, hImaginaryProjection] at hz'
    have hzre : ((-N.vertexAnchor) + z).re ∈
        (-N.vertexAnchor).re +ᵥ
          interior (closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier)) := hz'.1
    have hzim : ((-N.vertexAnchor) + z).im ∈
        (-N.vertexAnchor).im +ᵥ
          interior (closure (Complex.im '' K.openCarrier)) := hz'.2
    constructor
    · simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using hzre
    · simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add] using hzim
  · intro hz
    have hz' : (-N.vertexAnchor) + z ∈
        {w : Tiling.Plane |
          w.re ∈ interior (closure (Complex.re '' N.context.region.openCarrier)) ∧
          w.im ∈ interior (closure (Complex.im '' N.context.region.openCarrier))} := by
      rw [hRealProjection, hImaginaryProjection]
      constructor
      · refine ⟨z.re, hz.1, ?_⟩
        simp [vadd_eq_add]
      · refine ⟨z.im, hz.2, ?_⟩
        simp [vadd_eq_add]
    have hz'' : (-N.vertexAnchor) + z ∈ N.context.region.openCarrier :=
      hContextProduct.symm ▸ hz'
    rw [N.context_region] at hz''
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hweq⟩ := hz''
    have hweq' : -N.vertexAnchor + w = -N.vertexAnchor + z := by
      simpa [vadd_eq_add] using hweq
    have : w = z := add_left_cancel hweq'
    exact this ▸ hw

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.approximationSequenceData_exists
statement:
private theorem approximationSequenceData_exists :
    ∀ (C : ApproximationContext.{u}),
      TilesOn C.region C.centres Set.univ →
        Nonempty (ApproximationSequenceData C)
proof:
:= by
  intro C hTiles
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀, hgood⟩ := isGoodApproximation_of_sufficientlyFine C
  let ε : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦ ε₀ / ((n : ℝ) + 1)
  have hεpos : ∀ n, 0 < ε n := by
    intro n
    dsimp [ε]
    exact div_pos hε₀ (by positivity)
  have hεzero : Tendsto ε atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hden : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) + 1) atTop atTop :=
      tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.atTop_add tendsto_const_nhds
    exact tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hden
  choose φ hφ using fun n ↦ exists_epsilonApproximation C (ε n) (hεpos n)
  have hle : ∀ n, ε n ≤ ε₀ := by
    intro n
    dsimp [ε]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).2
    nlinarith
  have hgoodφ : ∀ n, IsGoodApproximation C (φ n) := by
    intro n
    apply hgood (φ n)
    refine {
      epsilon_pos := lt_of_lt_of_le (hφ n |>.epsilon_pos) (hle n)
      fixesRational := (hφ n).fixesRational
      basis_close := fun j ↦ lt_of_lt_of_le ((hφ n).basis_close j) (hle n) }
  let D : (n : ℕ) → CoordinateDeformation C (φ n) := fun n ↦
    (exists_rationalPolygonDeformation C (φ n) (hgoodφ n)).some
  let P : (n : ℕ) → TwoStageDeformationSupportTransport C (φ n) (D n) :=
    fun n ↦ (exists_twoStageDeformationSupportTransport C (φ n) (D n) hTiles).some
  exact ⟨{
    epsilon := ε
    epsilon_pos := hεpos
    epsilon_zero := hεzero
    map := φ
    isApproximation := hφ
    deformation := D
    transport := P }⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.simultaneousColumns_force_deformedProducts
statement:
private theorem simultaneousColumns_force_deformedProducts :
    ∀ {K : Region} {source : TilingSpace K Set.univ}
      (N : NormalizedPersistentBranchData.{u} K source)
      (hNontrivial : NontrivialVerticalDecomposition
        N.context.region N.context.centres)
      (hInfinite : ¬ HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity N.context.centres)
      (A : ApproximationSequenceData N.context),
      ∀ n, IsProductRegion (A.deformation n).deformedRegion
proof:
:= by
  intro K source N hNontrivial hInfinite A n
  obtain ⟨O, hData⟩ :=
    exists_orbitLimit_withSimultaneousColumns
      N.fibre hNontrivial hInfinite (A.deformation n) (A.transport n)
  obtain ⟨M⟩ := hData
  exact productRegion_of_transverseColumns
    M.horizontal.limit.tilesOn
    M.verticalColumn M.verticalColumn_isColumn
    M.horizontal.horizontalColumn M.horizontal.horizontalColumn_isColumn

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.normalizedPersistentBranch_productRegion
proof:
:= by
  intro K source N hNontrivial hInfinite
  have hNNontrivial := normalization_preserves_nontrivial N hNontrivial
  have hNInfinite := normalization_preserves_infiniteHorizontal N hInfinite
  have hTiles : TilesOn N.context.region N.context.centres Set.univ := by
    rw [← N.normalizedSource_centres]
    exact N.normalizedSource.tilesOn
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := approximationSequenceData_exists N.context hTiles
  have hProducts :=
    simultaneousColumns_force_deformedProducts N hNNontrivial hNInfinite A
  have hContextProduct :=
    productRegion_of_deformations N.context A.epsilon A.epsilon_pos
      A.epsilon_zero A.map A.isApproximation A.deformation hProducts
  exact normalization_reflects_productRegion N hContextProduct

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.infiniteNontrivial_productRegion_false
statement:
private theorem infiniteNontrivial_productRegion_false :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T Set.univ →
      NontrivialVerticalDecomposition K T →
      (¬ HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity T) →
      IsProductRegion K → False
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTiles hNontrivial hInfinite hProduct
  have hAperiodic :=
    (infiniteHorizontalComplexity_iff_columnBaseAperiodic
      hTiles hNontrivial).1.mp hInfinite
  have hColumns : (Continuous.verticalColumnCentres K T).Nonempty := by
    by_contra hEmpty
    have hEmpty' : Continuous.verticalColumnCentres K T = ∅ :=
      Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hEmpty
    have hSupportEmpty :
        regularSupport K (Continuous.verticalColumnCentres K T) = ∅ := by
      simp [regularSupport, Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport,
        Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, hEmpty']
    exact Set.not_nonempty_empty (hSupportEmpty ▸ hAperiodic.1)
  obtain ⟨beta, hbeta, hperiod⟩ :=
    productRegion_columnUnion_horizontalPeriodic K hProduct
  exact hAperiodic.2 beta (ne_of_gt hbeta) (hperiod T hTiles hColumns)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.persistentCrossAxisAlternative_false
statement:
private theorem persistentCrossAxisAlternative_false :
    ∀ {K : Region} {source limit : TilingSpace K Set.univ}
      (hNontrivial : NontrivialVerticalDecomposition K
        (source.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
      (hInfinite : ¬ HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity
        (source.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
      (A : CrossAxisLimitAlternative K source limit),
      IsPersistentCrossAxisAlternative A → False
proof:
:= by
  intro K source limit hNontrivial hInfinite A hA
  obtain ⟨N⟩ := normalizedPersistentBranch_exists.{0} A hA
  have hProduct := normalizedPersistentBranch_productRegion N hNontrivial hInfinite
  exact infiniteNontrivial_productRegion_false
    source.tilesOn hNontrivial hInfinite hProduct

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.exists_finiteHorizontalComplexityTrichotomy
statement:
theorem exists_finiteHorizontalComplexityTrichotomy
    {K : Region} (T : TilingSpace K Set.univ)
    (hNotFLC : ¬ HasFLC (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) :
    Nonempty (FiniteHorizontalComplexityTrichotomyData K T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E⟩ := planeNontrivialEarthquake_exists T hNotFLC
  cases hOrientation : E.split.orientation with
  | vertical =>
      have hNontrivial := verticalEarthquakeSplit_nontrivial E hOrientation
      by_cases hFinite : HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity
          (E.limit.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
      · exact trichotomyData_vertical_of E.limit_mem_hull hFinite hNontrivial
      · obtain ⟨S, hHull, hSwapNontrivial, hAlternative⟩ :=
          exists_crossAxisOrbitLimit E.limit hNontrivial hFinite
        obtain ⟨A⟩ := hAlternative
        by_cases hPersistent : IsPersistentCrossAxisAlternative A
        · exact False.elim
            (persistentCrossAxisAlternative_false hNontrivial hFinite A hPersistent)
        · cases A with
          | finiteVerticalComplexity hFiniteSwapped =>
              obtain ⟨Sσ, hSσ⟩ := coordinateSwapTiling_exists S
              have hSwapNontrivial' :
                  NontrivialVerticalDecomposition K.coordinateSwap
                    (Sσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
                change ¬ ∃ P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K.coordinateSwap
                    (Sσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane),
                    ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧
                      P.centres = (Sσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
                rw [hSσ]
                exact hSwapNontrivial
              have hFiniteSwapped' :
                  HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity
                    (Sσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
                rw [hSσ]
                exact hFiniteSwapped
              exact trichotomyData_horizontal_of (K := K) (T := T) (S := S)
                Sσ hSσ (orbitHull_transitive E.limit_mem_hull hHull)
                hFiniteSwapped' hSwapNontrivial'
          | persistentHorizontalColumn anchor anchor_mem_source movingCentre
              movingCentre_mem translations translations_eq converges fibre
              fibre_eq anchor_mem_fibre horizontalPlate horizontalPlate_isColumn
              horizontalPlate_centres persistent_pullback =>
              exact False.elim (hPersistent trivial)
  | horizontal =>
      obtain ⟨Eσ, hEσ⟩ := coordinateSwapTiling_exists E.limit
      have hNontrivialσ := horizontalEarthquakeSplit_nontrivial
        E Eσ hEσ hOrientation
      by_cases hFinite : HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity
          (Eσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
      · exact trichotomyData_horizontal_of (K := K) (T := T) (S := E.limit)
          Eσ hEσ E.limit_mem_hull hFinite hNontrivialσ
      · obtain ⟨S₁, hS₁, hS₁Nontrivial, hAlternative⟩ :=
          exists_crossAxisOrbitLimit Eσ hNontrivialσ hFinite
        obtain ⟨A⟩ := hAlternative
        by_cases hPersistent : IsPersistentCrossAxisAlternative A
        · exact False.elim
            (persistentCrossAxisAlternative_false hNontrivialσ hFinite A hPersistent)
        · cases A with
          | finiteVerticalComplexity hFiniteSwapped =>
              obtain ⟨U, hUcentres, hUHull, hUNontrivial, hUFinite⟩ :=
                swappedCrossAxisFiniteBranch Eσ hEσ E.limit_mem_hull
                  S₁ hS₁ hS₁Nontrivial hFiniteSwapped
              exact trichotomyData_vertical_of hUHull hUFinite hUNontrivial
          | persistentHorizontalColumn anchor anchor_mem_source movingCentre
              movingCentre_mem translations translations_eq converges fibre
              fibre_eq anchor_mem_fibre horizontalPlate horizontalPlate_isColumn
              horizontalPlate_centres persistent_pullback =>
              exact False.elim (hPersistent trivial)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.exists_topologicallyMinimalOrbitPoint
statement:
theorem exists_topologicallyMinimalOrbitPoint
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region}
    (T : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ) :
    ∃ S : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ,
      S ∈ Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull T ∧
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.IsTopologicallyMinimal
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Y, hYHull, hYnonempty, _hYclosed, _hYinvariant, hYminimal⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.exists_minimalInvariantSubset T
  obtain ⟨S, hSY⟩ := hYnonempty
  refine ⟨S, hYHull hSY, ?_⟩
  rw [show Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull S = Y from
    hYminimal.2.2.2 S hSY]
  exact hYminimal

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.MinimalTilingStructureData.allColumns_iff
statement:
theorem MinimalTilingStructureData.allColumns_iff
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region}
    {T : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    (D : Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.MinimalTilingStructureData K T)
    (hNonFLC : ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC
      (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) :
    (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalColumnCentres
          D.selectedRegion
            (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) ↔
      D.columnPart = (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) ∧
        D.numberOfPieces = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcomponents := D.nonFLC_components hNonFLC
  constructor
  · intro hAll
    have hColumnPart : D.columnPart =
        (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) :=
      hcomponents.1.trans hAll.symm
    refine ⟨hColumnPart, ?_⟩
    apply Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos
    intro hpos
    let j : Fin D.numberOfPieces := ⟨0, hpos⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hxPiece⟩ := D.piece_nonempty j
    have hxCentres : x ∈ (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
      rw [← D.centres_partition]
      exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hxPiece⟩)
    have hxColumn : x ∈ D.columnPart := by
      rw [hColumnPart]
      exact hxCentres
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (D.column_disjoint_piece j) hxColumn hxPiece
  · rintro ⟨hColumnPart, _⟩
    rw [← hcomponents.1, hColumnPart]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.MinimalTilingStructureData.noColumns_iff
statement:
theorem MinimalTilingStructureData.noColumns_iff
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region}
    {T : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    (D : Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.MinimalTilingStructureData K T)
    (hNonFLC : ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC
      (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalColumnCentres
        D.selectedRegion
          (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) = ∅ ↔
      D.columnPart = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.nonFLC_components hNonFLC |>.1]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.MinimalTilingStructureData.finiteComplexityBranch
statement:
theorem MinimalTilingStructureData.finiteComplexityBranch
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region}
    {T : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    (D : Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.MinimalTilingStructureData K T)
    (hFLC : Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC
      (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) :
    D.columnPart = ∅ ∧ D.numberOfPieces = 1 ∧
      ∃ j : Fin D.numberOfPieces,
        D.piece j = (D.selectedTiling.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
proof:
:=
  D.finiteComplexity_normalForm hFLC

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.exists_coordinateSwapTiling
statement:
private theorem exists_coordinateSwapTiling :
    ∀ {K : Region} (T : TilingSpace K Set.univ),
      ∃ S : TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ,
        (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) = coordinateSwap ''
          (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T
  exact Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.exists_coordinateSwapTiling T

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.coordinateSwap_hullFacts
statement:
private theorem coordinateSwap_hullFacts :
    ∀ {K : Region} (T U : TilingSpace K Set.univ)
      (T' U' : TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ),
      (T'.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) = coordinateSwap ''
          (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) →
      (U'.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) = coordinateSwap ''
          (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) →
      U ∈ orbitHull T →
      (U' ∈ orbitHull T') ∧
      (IsTopologicallyMinimal (orbitHull T) →
        IsTopologicallyMinimal (orbitHull T'))
proof:
:= by
  intro K T U T' U' hT' hU' hU
  refine ⟨(Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.coordinateSwap_orbitHull_iff hT' hU').mp hU, ?_⟩
  intro hminimal
  exact (Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.coordinateSwap_minimal_iff hT').mp hminimal

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.exists_translateSequence_to_minimalHullPoint
statement:
private theorem exists_translateSequence_to_minimalHullPoint :
    ∀ {K : Region} (T U : TilingSpace K Set.univ),
      IsTopologicallyMinimal (orbitHull T) →
      U ∈ orbitHull T →
      ∃ g : ℕ → aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane),
        LocallyFellConverges
          (TilingSpace.centresSequence
            (TilingSpace.translateSequence g T))
          (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T U _hminimal hU
  change U ∈ closure (AddAction.orbit
    (aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane)) T) at hU
  obtain ⟨V, hVmem, hVlim⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp hU
  choose g hg using hVmem
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  have hseq : TilingSpace.translateSequence g T = V := by
    funext n
    exact hg n
  rw [← hseq] at hVlim
  exact (locallyFell_metrizable K Set.univ).2
    (TilingSpace.translateSequence g T) U |>.mp hVlim

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.finiteHorizontalComplexity_backToMinimalSource
statement:
private theorem finiteHorizontalComplexity_backToMinimalSource :
    ∀ {K : Region} (T U : TilingSpace K Set.univ),
      IsTopologicallyMinimal (orbitHull T) →
      U ∈ orbitHull T →
      HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) →
      HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T U hminimal hU hUFLC
  have hHull : orbitHull U = orbitHull T :=
    hminimal.2.2.2 U hU
  have hUminimal : IsTopologicallyMinimal (orbitHull U) := by
    rw [hHull]
    exact hminimal
  have hTmem : T ∈ orbitHull U := by
    rw [hHull]
    exact subset_closure (AddAction.mem_orbit_self T)
  obtain ⟨g, hconv⟩ :=
    exists_translateSequence_to_minimalHullPoint U T hUminimal hTmem
  exact finiteHorizontalComplexity_of_translateLimit U T hUFLC g hconv

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.residueValue_mem_Icc
statement:
private theorem residueValue_mem_Icc
    (g : ℕ → aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane))
    {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 < beta) :
    ∀ n, residueValue g beta n ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) beta
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  have hlo : (residueFloorIndex g beta n : ℝ) ≤
      (g n : Tiling.Plane).re / beta := by
    dsimp [residueFloorIndex]
    exact Int.floor_le _
  have hhi : (g n : Tiling.Plane).re / beta <
      (residueFloorIndex g beta n : ℝ) + 1 := by
    dsimp [residueFloorIndex]
    exact Int.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hlo' : (residueFloorIndex g beta n : ℝ) * beta ≤
      (g n : Tiling.Plane).re := (le_div_iff₀ hbeta).mp hlo
  have hhi' : (g n : Tiling.Plane).re <
      (residueFloorIndex g beta n : ℝ) * beta + beta := by
    have h := (div_lt_iff₀ hbeta).mp hhi
    simpa [add_mul, mul_add, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using h
  constructor <;> dsimp [residueValue] <;> linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.residue_subsequence_exists
statement:
private theorem residue_subsequence_exists
    (g : ℕ → aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane))
    {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 < beta) :
    ∃ alpha ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) beta, ∃ phi : ℕ → ℕ,
      StrictMono phi ∧
        Tendsto (residueValue g beta ∘ phi) atTop (nhds alpha)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨alpha, halpha, phi, hphi, hlim⟩ :=
    (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) beta)).tendsto_subseq
      (residueValue_mem_Icc g hbeta)
  exact ⟨alpha, halpha, phi, hphi, hlim⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.translate_action_tendsto_wip
proof:
:= by
  have hpair : Tendsto (fun n => (q n, X n)) atTop (nhds (qlim, U)) :=
    by
      rw [nhds_prod_eq]
      exact hq.prodMk hX
  exact (translationAction_continuous K Set.univ).tendsto
    (qlim, U) |>.comp hpair

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.exists_alignedResidueLimit
statement:
private theorem exists_alignedResidueLimit :
    ∀ {K : Region} (T U : TilingSpace K Set.univ),
      IsTopologicallyMinimal (orbitHull T) →
      U ∈ orbitHull T →
      ∀ {beta : ℝ}, 0 < beta →
      ∃ (alpha : ℝ) (V : TilingSpace K Set.univ)
        (g : ℕ → aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane)),
        0 ≤ alpha ∧ alpha < beta ∧
        (V.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) = ((-alpha : ℝ) : ℂ) +ᵥ
          (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) ∧
        (∀ n, ∃ m : ℤ, (g n : Tiling.Plane).re = (m : ℝ) * beta) ∧
        LocallyFellConverges
          (TilingSpace.centresSequence
            (TilingSpace.translateSequence g T))
          (V.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T U hminimal hU beta hbeta
  obtain ⟨g₀, hconv₀⟩ :=
    exists_translateSequence_to_minimalHullPoint T U hminimal hU
  have hOld : Tendsto (TilingSpace.translateSequence g₀ T) atTop (nhds U) :=
    ((locallyFell_metrizable K Set.univ).2
      (TilingSpace.translateSequence g₀ T) U).mpr hconv₀
  obtain ⟨alpha, halpha, phi, hphi, hres⟩ :=
    residue_subsequence_exists g₀ hbeta
  have hOld' : Tendsto
      (TilingSpace.translateSequence (g₀ ∘ phi) T) atTop (nhds U) := by
    change Tendsto (TilingSpace.translateSequence g₀ T ∘ phi) atTop (nhds U)
    exact hOld.comp hphi.tendsto_atTop
  by_cases halt : alpha < beta
  · let q : ℕ → aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane) := fun n =>
      ⟨-((residueValue g₀ beta (phi n) : ℝ) : Tiling.Plane), by
        simp [aePeriodGroup, Tiling.Polygonal.aePeriodGroup]
      ⟩
    let qlim : aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane) :=
      ⟨-alpha, by simp [aePeriodGroup, Tiling.Polygonal.aePeriodGroup]⟩
    have hq : Tendsto q atTop (nhds qlim) := by
      rw [tendsto_subtype_rng]
      have hplane : Tendsto (fun n =>
          -((residueValue g₀ beta (phi n) : ℝ) : Tiling.Plane)) atTop
          (nhds (-((alpha : ℝ) : Tiling.Plane))) := by
        convert (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto _).comp hres.neg using 1 <;>
          simp [Function.comp_def]
      simpa only [q, qlim] using hplane
    let V : TilingSpace K Set.univ := TilingSpace.translate qlim U
    let g : ℕ → aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane) := fun n =>
      ⟨(q n : Tiling.Plane) + (g₀ (phi n) : Tiling.Plane), by
        simp [aePeriodGroup, Tiling.Polygonal.aePeriodGroup]
      ⟩
    have hlim := translate_action_tendsto_wip hq hOld'
    have hseq :
        TilingSpace.translateSequence g T =
          (fun n => TilingSpace.translate (q n)
            (TilingSpace.translateSequence (g₀ ∘ phi) T n)) := by
      funext n
      change TilingSpace.translate (g n) T =
        TilingSpace.translate (q n)
          (TilingSpace.translate (g₀ (phi n)) T)
      have hg : g n = q n + g₀ (phi n) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      rw [hg]
      exact add_vadd (q n) (g₀ (phi n)) T
    have hVcent : (V.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
        ((-alpha : ℝ) : ℂ) +ᵥ (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
      ext z
      change z ∈ (fun x : Tiling.Plane => x + (qlim : Tiling.Plane)) ''
          (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) ↔ _
      rw [show (qlim : Tiling.Plane) = ((-alpha : ℝ) : ℂ) by
        simp [qlim]]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        exact Set.mem_vadd_set.mpr ⟨x, hx, by
          simp [vadd_eq_add, add_comm]
          ⟩
      · intro hz
        rcases Set.mem_vadd_set.mp hz with ⟨x, hx, hxz⟩
        exact ⟨x, hx, by simpa [vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hxz⟩
    have hconv : LocallyFellConverges
        (TilingSpace.centresSequence
          (TilingSpace.translateSequence g T))
        (V.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
      rw [hseq]
      exact ((locallyFell_metrizable K Set.univ).2 _ V).mp hlim
    refine ⟨alpha, V, g, halpha.1, halt, hVcent, ?_, hconv⟩
    intro n
    refine ⟨residueFloorIndex g₀ beta (phi n), ?_⟩
    dsimp [g, q, residueValue, residueFloorIndex]
    ring
  · have halpha_eq : alpha = beta :=
      le_antisymm halpha.2 (not_lt.mp halt)
    let q : ℕ → aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane) := fun n =>
      ⟨((beta - residueValue g₀ beta (phi n) : ℝ) : Tiling.Plane), by
        simp [aePeriodGroup, Tiling.Polygonal.aePeriodGroup]
      ⟩
    let qlim : aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane) :=
      ⟨0, by simp [aePeriodGroup, Tiling.Polygonal.aePeriodGroup]⟩
    have hq : Tendsto q atTop (nhds qlim) := by
      rw [tendsto_subtype_rng]
      dsimp [q, qlim]
      change Tendsto (fun n =>
        ((beta - residueValue g₀ beta (phi n) : ℝ) : Tiling.Plane)) atTop
        (nhds (0 : Tiling.Plane))
      have hreal : Tendsto
          (fun n => beta - residueValue g₀ beta (phi n)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
        have h := (tendsto_const_nhds :
          Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => beta) atTop (nhds beta)).sub hres
        simpa [halpha_eq] using h
      convert (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp hreal using 1 <;>
        simp [Function.comp_def]
    let V : TilingSpace K Set.univ := TilingSpace.translate qlim U
    let g : ℕ → aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane) := fun n =>
      ⟨(q n : Tiling.Plane) + (g₀ (phi n) : Tiling.Plane), by
        simp [aePeriodGroup, Tiling.Polygonal.aePeriodGroup]
      ⟩
    have hlim := translate_action_tendsto_wip hq hOld'
    have hseq :
        TilingSpace.translateSequence g T =
          (fun n => TilingSpace.translate (q n)
            (TilingSpace.translateSequence (g₀ ∘ phi) T n)) := by
      funext n
      change TilingSpace.translate (g n) T =
        TilingSpace.translate (q n)
          (TilingSpace.translate (g₀ (phi n)) T)
      have hg : g n = q n + g₀ (phi n) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      rw [hg]
      exact add_vadd (q n) (g₀ (phi n)) T
    have hVcent : (V.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
        ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) +ᵥ (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
      ext z
      change z ∈ (fun x : Tiling.Plane => x + (qlim : Tiling.Plane)) ''
          (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) ↔ _
      dsimp [qlim]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        exact Set.mem_vadd_set.mpr ⟨x, hx, by simp [vadd_eq_add]
          ⟩
      · intro hz
        rcases Set.mem_vadd_set.mp hz with ⟨x, hx, hxz⟩
        exact ⟨x, hx, by simpa [vadd_eq_add] using hxz⟩
    have hconv : LocallyFellConverges
        (TilingSpace.centresSequence
          (TilingSpace.translateSequence g T))
        (V.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
      rw [hseq]
      exact ((locallyFell_metrizable K Set.univ).2 _ V).mp hlim
    refine ⟨0, V, g, by norm_num, hbeta, ?_, ?_, hconv⟩
    · simpa using hVcent
    · intro n
      refine ⟨residueFloorIndex g₀ beta (phi n) + 1, ?_⟩
      dsimp [g, q, residueValue, residueFloorIndex]
      simp only [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one]
      ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.nontrivialVertical_translation_iff
statement:
private theorem nontrivialVertical_translation_iff :
    ∀ {K : Region} (T U : TilingSpace K Set.univ) (a : ℝ),
      (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) = ((a : ℝ) : ℂ) +ᵥ
        (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) →
      ((¬ ∃ P : VerticalPlate K (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane),
          ¬ IsVerticalColumn P ∧
            P.centres = (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) ↔
        ¬ ∃ P : VerticalPlate K (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane),
          ¬ IsVerticalColumn P ∧
            P.centres = (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
proof:
:= by
  intro K T U a hU
  have hcarrier : K.openCarrier =
      positiveSimilarity 1 0 '' K.openCarrier := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      exact ⟨z, hz, by simp [positiveSimilarity]
        ⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      simpa [positiveSimilarity] using hz
  have hsim (c : Tiling.Plane) (S : Set Tiling.Plane) :
      positiveSimilarity 1 c '' S = c +ᵥ S := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      exact Set.mem_vadd_set.mpr ⟨w, hw, by
        simp [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add, add_comm]
        ⟩
    · intro hz
      rcases Set.mem_vadd_set.mp hz with ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩
      refine ⟨w, hw, ?_⟩
      simpa [positiveSimilarity, vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hwz
  have hforward : ∀ {A B : TilingSpace K Set.univ} (c : Tiling.Plane),
      (B.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) = c +ᵥ (A.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) →
      (¬ ∃ P : VerticalPlate K (A.centres : Set Tiling.Plane),
          ¬ IsVerticalColumn P ∧
            P.centres = (A.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) →
      ¬ ∃ P : VerticalPlate K (B.centres : Set Tiling.Plane),
          ¬ IsVerticalColumn P ∧
            P.centres = (B.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
    intro A B c hB hA hBexists
    have hBimage : positiveSimilarity 1 c '' (A.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
        (B.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
      rw [hsim c, hB]
    rw [← hBimage] at hBexists
    rcases hBexists with ⟨Q, hQnotcol, hQcent⟩
    let e₀ := verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv
      (K := K) (R := K)
      (T := positiveSimilarity 1 c '' (A.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
      (s := 1) (r := 0) one_pos hcarrier (-c) Q
    have he₀cent : e₀.centres =
        positiveSimilarity 1 (-c) '' Q.centres :=
      verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_centres_image
        one_pos hcarrier (-c) Q
    have himage : positiveSimilarity 1 (-c) ''
        (positiveSimilarity 1 c '' (A.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) =
        (A.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
      calc
        positiveSimilarity 1 (-c) ''
            (positiveSimilarity 1 c '' (A.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) =
            (-c) +ᵥ (c +ᵥ (A.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) := by
          rw [hsim, hsim]
        _ = (A.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
          rw [← add_vadd]
          simp
    have he₀cent' : e₀.centres =
        positiveSimilarity 1 (-c) ''
          (positiveSimilarity 1 c '' (A.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) := by
      simpa only [hQcent] using he₀cent
    have hPexists : ∃ P : VerticalPlate K (positiveSimilarity 1 (-c) ''
        (positiveSimilarity 1 c '' (A.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))),
        ¬ IsVerticalColumn P ∧
          P.centres = positiveSimilarity 1 (-c) ''
            (positiveSimilarity 1 c '' (A.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) := by
      refine ⟨e₀, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro he₀col
        exact hQnotcol
          ((verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_isVerticalColumn
            one_pos hcarrier (-c) Q).mpr he₀col)
      · exact he₀cent'
    rw [himage] at hPexists
    exact hA hPexists
  constructor
  · exact hforward ((a : ℝ) : ℂ) hU
  · apply hforward ((-a : ℝ) : ℂ)
    rw [hU, ← add_vadd]
    simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.hasFLC_coordinateSwap_to_original
statement:
private theorem hasFLC_coordinateSwap_to_original
    (S : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    HasFLC (coordinateSwap '' S) → HasFLC S
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  constructor
  · intro Q hQ
    have hQ' : Bornology.IsBounded (coordinateSwap '' Q) :=
      coordinateSwapIsometry_local.lipschitz.isBounded_image hQ
    have hfinite := h.1 (coordinateSwap '' Q) hQ'
    refine Set.Finite.of_finite_image (s := S ∩ Q) (f := coordinateSwap) ?_
      coordinateSwap.injective.injOn
    rw [Set.image_inter coordinateSwap.injective]
    exact hfinite
  · intro R hR
    let A : Set Tiling.Plane :=
      (S - S) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 R
    refine Set.Finite.of_finite_image (s := A) (f := coordinateSwap) ?_
      coordinateSwap.injective.injOn
    apply (h.2 R hR).subset
    rintro d ⟨d₀, ⟨hd, hdR⟩, rfl⟩
    rcases hd with ⟨b, hb, a, ha, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨coordinateSwap b, ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩,
      coordinateSwap a, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · simp only [map_sub]
    · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      have hnorm : ‖coordinateSwap (b - a)‖ = ‖b - a‖ := by
        change ‖coordinateSwapIsometry_local (b - a)‖ = ‖b - a‖
        exact coordinateSwapIsometry_local.norm_map _
      rw [hnorm]
      simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hdR

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.hasFLC_coordinateSwap_iff
statement:
private theorem hasFLC_coordinateSwap_iff :
    ∀ (S : Set Tiling.Plane), HasFLC (coordinateSwap '' S) ↔ HasFLC S
proof:
:= by
  intro S
  constructor
  · exact hasFLC_coordinateSwap_to_original S
  · intro h
    have h' := hasFLC_coordinateSwap_to_original (coordinateSwap '' S)
      (by simpa [Set.image_image, coordinateSwap_apply_apply] using h)
    simpa [Set.image_image, coordinateSwap_apply_apply] using h'

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.exists_nonColumnPlateIndexing
statement:
private theorem exists_nonColumnPlateIndexing :
    ∀ {K : Region} (T : TilingSpace K Set.univ),
      Continuous.HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) →
      Nonempty (NonColumnPlateIndexing T)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hFiniteHorizontal
  have hFinite := (noncolumnVerticalPlates_finite T.tilesOn).1
  let S : Set (Continuous.VerticalPlate K (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) :=
    Continuous.nonColumnVerticalPlates K (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
  let _ : Fintype S := hFinite.fintype
  let e : Fin S.ncard ≃ S :=
    (Finite.equivFinOfCardEq (Nat.card_coe_set_eq S)).symm
  refine ⟨{
    numberOfPieces := S.ncard
    plate := fun j ↦ (e j).1
    plate_nonColumn := fun j ↦ (e j).2
    equiv := e
    plate_eq := fun j ↦ rfl }⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.columnPart_eq_verticalColumnCentres
statement:
private theorem columnPart_eq_verticalColumnCentres
    {K : Region} {T : TilingSpace K Set.univ} :
    (⋃ P : {P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) //
      Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P}, P.1.centres) =
      Continuous.verticalColumnCentres K (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Continuous.verticalColumnCentres_eq]
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.columnFamily_tiles
statement:
private theorem columnFamily_tiles
    {K : Region} {T : TilingSpace K Set.univ} :
    TilesOn K (Continuous.verticalColumnCentres K (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
      (regularSupport K (Continuous.verticalColumnCentres K
        (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)))
proof:
:= by
  apply tilesOn_regularSupport_of_subset
    (S := Continuous.verticalColumnCentres K (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
    (T := (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
  · intro z hz
    rw [Continuous.verticalColumnCentres_eq, Set.mem_iUnion] at hz
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hz
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hP
