name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.thinBase_centralStrip_empty
statement:
private theorem thinBase_centralStrip_empty :
      ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
    TilesOn K T Set.univ →
    ∀ (P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) (x : ℝ),
      (volume (P.base ∩ Ioo x (x + 8 * footprintDiameter K))).toReal ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (volume (horizontalFootprint K)).toReal →
      P.base ∩
        Ioo (x + 2 * footprintDiameter K) (x + 6 * footprintDiameter K) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile P x hThin
  by_contra hne
  have hMiddleNonempty :
      (P.base ∩ Ioo (x + 2 * footprintDiameter K)
        (x + 6 * footprintDiameter K)).Nonempty :=
    Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hne
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hMiddleNonempty
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hTranslateSubset⟩ :=
    centralBasePoint_hasFootprintWitness hTile P x z hz
  have hWindowBounded : Bornology.IsBounded
      (P.base ∩ Ioo x (x + 8 * footprintDiameter K)) :=
    (Metric.isBounded_Ioo x (x + 8 * footprintDiameter K)).subset inter_subset_right
  have hMeasureMono :
      volume (({t.re} : Set ℝ) + horizontalFootprint K) ≤
        volume (P.base ∩ Ioo x (x + 8 * footprintDiameter K)) :=
    measure_mono hTranslateSubset
  have hToRealMono :
      (volume (({t.re} : Set ℝ) + horizontalFootprint K)).toReal ≤
        (volume (P.base ∩ Ioo x (x + 8 * footprintDiameter K))).toReal :=
    ENNReal.toReal_mono
      (hWindowBounded.measure_lt_top (μ := volume)).ne hMeasureMono
  have hTranslateMeasure :
      volume (({t.re} : Set ℝ) + horizontalFootprint K) =
        volume (horizontalFootprint K) := by
    rw [singleton_add_eq_vadd, MeasureTheory.measure_vadd]
  rw [hTranslateMeasure] at hToRealMono
  have hFootprintPositive :
      0 < (volume (horizontalFootprint K)).toReal :=
    (horizontalFootprint_geometry K).2.2.2.2.1
  nlinarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.thinNoncolumnPlate_constructsProperSlabSplit
statement:
private theorem thinNoncolumnPlate_constructsProperSlabSplit
    (oneSidedColumn :
      ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
        TilesOn K T Set.univ →
        ∀ (P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T),
          (BddBelow P.base ∨ BddAbove P.base) →
            Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P) :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
    TilesOn K T Set.univ →
    ∀ (P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T),
      ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P →
      ∀ x : ℝ,
        (volume (P.base ∩ Ioo x (x + 8 * footprintDiameter K))).toReal ≤
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (volume (horizontalFootprint K)).toReal →
        Nonempty (ThinPlateSplit K T P x)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile P hNoncolumn x hThin
  let D : ℝ := footprintDiameter K
  let a : ℝ := x + 2 * D
  let b : ℝ := x + 6 * D
  let L : Set Tiling.Plane :=
    {t | t ∈ P.centres ∧
      (({t.re} : Set ℝ) + horizontalFootprint K) ⊆ Iic a}
  let R : Set Tiling.Plane :=
    {t | t ∈ P.centres ∧
      (({t.re} : Set ℝ) + horizontalFootprint K) ⊆ Ici b}
  obtain ⟨hFootprintOpen, -, hFootprintNonempty, -, -, hDPos, -, -⟩ :=
    horizontalFootprint_geometry K
  have hab : a < b := by
    simp only [a, b, D]
    nlinarith
  have hMiddleEmpty : P.base ∩ Ioo a b = ∅ := by
    simpa only [a, b, D] using
      thinBase_centralStrip_empty hTile P x hThin
  have hClassify (t : Tiling.Plane) (ht : t ∈ P.centres) :
      (({t.re} : Set ℝ) + horizontalFootprint K) ⊆ Iic a ∨
        (({t.re} : Set ℝ) + horizontalFootprint K) ⊆ Ici b := by
    have hTranslateBase := plateCentre_footprint_subset_base hTile P t ht
    have hAvoid :
        (t.re +ᵥ horizontalFootprint K) ∩ Ioo a b = ∅ := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · intro y hy
        have hyEmpty : y ∈ P.base ∩ Ioo a b := by
          refine ⟨hTranslateBase ?_, hy.2⟩
          rw [singleton_add_eq_vadd]
          exact hy.1
        rw [hMiddleEmpty] at hyEmpty
        exact hyEmpty
      · exact empty_subset _
    simpa only [singleton_add_eq_vadd, a, b, D] using
      footprint_translate_classified K t.re x hAvoid
  have hLSubset : L ⊆ P.centres := fun _ ht ↦ ht.1
  have hRSubset : R ⊆ P.centres := fun _ ht ↦ ht.1
  have hPartition : L ∪ R = P.centres := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact Set.union_subset hLSubset hRSubset
    · intro t ht
      rcases hClassify t ht with hLeft | hRight
      · exact Or.inl ⟨ht, hLeft⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨ht, hRight⟩
  have hDisjoint : Disjoint L R := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro t htL htR
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hFootprintNonempty
    have htu : t.re + u ∈ ({t.re} : Set ℝ) + horizontalFootprint K :=
      ⟨t.re, Set.mem_singleton _, u, hu, rfl⟩
    have hLeft := htL.2 htu
    have hRight := htR.2 htu
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hRight.trans hLeft)) hab
  have hProjectionOpen : IsOpen (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier) :=
    Complex.isOpenMap_re K.openCarrier isOpen_interior
  have hRawSide
      (S : Set Tiling.Plane) (hS : S ⊆ P.centres)
      (hSide : ∀ t ∈ S,
        (({t.re} : Set ℝ) + horizontalFootprint K) ⊆ Iic a) :
      openUnion K S ⊆ Complex.re ⁻¹' Iic a := by
    intro z hz
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion] at hz
    obtain ⟨t, hzt⟩ := hz
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hzt
    have hProjected : (-t.1 +ᵥ z).re ∈ Complex.re '' K.openCarrier :=
      ⟨-t.1 +ᵥ z, hzt, rfl⟩
    have hProjectedFootprint :
        (-t.1 +ᵥ z).re ∈ horizontalFootprint K := by
      exact hProjectionOpen.subset_interior_closure hProjected
    have hzTranslate :
        z.re ∈ ({t.1.re} : Set ℝ) + horizontalFootprint K := by
      rw [singleton_add_eq_vadd, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      simpa only [vadd_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub, Complex.sub_re] using
        hProjectedFootprint
    exact hSide t.1 t.2 hzTranslate
  have hLRaw : openUnion K L ⊆ Complex.re ⁻¹' Iic a :=
    hRawSide L hLSubset (fun _ ht ↦ ht.2)
  have hRRaw : openUnion K R ⊆ Complex.re ⁻¹' Ici b := by
    intro z hz
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion] at hz
    obtain ⟨t, hzt⟩ := hz
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hzt
    have hProjected : (-t.1 +ᵥ z).re ∈ Complex.re '' K.openCarrier :=
      ⟨-t.1 +ᵥ z, hzt, rfl⟩
    have hProjectedFootprint :
        (-t.1 +ᵥ z).re ∈ horizontalFootprint K :=
      hProjectionOpen.subset_interior_closure hProjected
    have hzTranslate :
        z.re ∈ ({t.1.re} : Set ℝ) + horizontalFootprint K := by
      rw [singleton_add_eq_vadd, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      simpa only [vadd_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub, Complex.sub_re] using
        hProjectedFootprint
    exact t.2.2 hzTranslate
  obtain ⟨hPRegular, hPSupport⟩ :=
    Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile P
  have hPBaseOpen : IsOpen P.base := by
    rw [hPRegular]
    exact isOpen_interior
  have hPSupport' : regularSupport K P.centres = Complex.re ⁻¹' P.base := by
    simpa only [Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_eq_regularSupport] using hPSupport
  obtain ⟨hLSupport, hRSupport⟩ :=
    regularSupport_partition_of_horizontal_gap K hPBaseOpen hPartition
      hPSupport' hLRaw hRRaw hab
  let leftBase : Set ℝ := P.base ∩ Iio a
  let rightBase : Set ℝ := P.base ∩ Ioi b
  have hLeftBaseOpen : IsOpen leftBase := hPBaseOpen.inter isOpen_Iio
  have hRightBaseOpen : IsOpen rightBase := hPBaseOpen.inter isOpen_Ioi
  have hLSupport' : regularSupport K L = Complex.re ⁻¹' leftBase := by
    simpa only [leftBase] using hLSupport
  have hRSupport' : regularSupport K R = Complex.re ⁻¹' rightBase := by
    simpa only [rightBase] using hRSupport
  have hLeftBaseRegular : interior (closure leftBase) = leftBase :=
    base_regular_of_regularSupport_eq_preimage K L leftBase hLSupport'
  have hRightBaseRegular : interior (closure rightBase) = rightBase :=
    base_regular_of_regularSupport_eq_preimage K R rightBase hRSupport'
  have hLNonempty : L.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hLNot
    have hLEmpty : L = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hLNot
    have hRP : R = P.centres := by
      have := hPartition
      rwa [hLEmpty, empty_union] at this
    have hBaseEq : P.base = rightBase := by
      apply (Set.preimage_injective.mpr ?_)
      · calc
          Complex.re ⁻¹' P.base = regularSupport K P.centres := hPSupport'.symm
          _ = regularSupport K R := by rw [hRP]
          _ = Complex.re ⁻¹' rightBase := hRSupport'
      · intro r
        exact ⟨(r : ℂ), by simp⟩
    have hBddBelow : BddBelow P.base := by
      refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      have hyRight : y ∈ rightBase := by rwa [← hBaseEq]
      exact hyRight.2.le
    exact hNoncolumn (oneSidedColumn hTile P (Or.inl hBddBelow))
  have hRNonempty : R.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hRNot
    have hREmpty : R = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hRNot
    have hLP : L = P.centres := by
      have := hPartition
      rwa [hREmpty, union_empty] at this
    have hBaseEq : P.base = leftBase := by
      apply (Set.preimage_injective.mpr ?_)
      · calc
          Complex.re ⁻¹' P.base = regularSupport K P.centres := hPSupport'.symm
          _ = regularSupport K L := by rw [hLP]
          _ = Complex.re ⁻¹' leftBase := hLSupport'
      · intro r
        exact ⟨(r : ℂ), by simp⟩
    have hBddAbove : BddAbove P.base := by
      refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      have hyLeft : y ∈ leftBase := by rwa [← hBaseEq]
      exact hyLeft.2.le
    exact hNoncolumn (oneSidedColumn hTile P (Or.inr hBddAbove))
  have hLProper : L ≠ P.centres := by
    intro hEq
    obtain ⟨t, htR⟩ := hRNonempty
    have htL : t ∈ L := by rw [hEq]; exact hRSubset htR
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hDisjoint htL htR
  have hRProper : R ≠ P.centres := by
    intro hEq
    obtain ⟨t, htL⟩ := hLNonempty
    have htR : t ∈ R := by rw [hEq]; exact hLSubset htL
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hDisjoint htL htR
  refine ⟨{
    leftCentres := L
    rightCentres := R
    left_spec := ?_
    right_spec := ?_
    left_subset := hLSubset
    right_subset := hRSubset
    partition := hPartition
    disjoint := hDisjoint
    left_nonempty := hLNonempty
    right_nonempty := hRNonempty
    left_proper := hLProper
    right_proper := hRProper
    leftBase := leftBase
    rightBase := rightBase
    leftBase_open := hLeftBaseOpen
    rightBase_open := hRightBaseOpen
    leftBase_regular := hLeftBaseRegular
    rightBase_regular := hRightBaseRegular
    left_support := hLSupport'
    right_support := hRSupport'
    leftBase_bound := ?_
    rightBase_bound := ?_ }⟩
  · intro t
    rfl
  · intro t
    rfl
  · intro y hy
    exact (show y < a from hy.2).le
  · intro y hy
    exact (show b < y from hy.2).le

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.thinPlateSplit_contradictsMinimality
statement:
private theorem thinPlateSplit_contradictsMinimality :
      ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
    TilesOn K T Set.univ →
    ∀ (P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) (x : ℝ),
      ThinPlateSplit K T P x → False
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile P x S
  have hMinimal := Continuous.VerticalPlate.minimal hTile P
  have hEq : S.leftCentres = P.centres :=
    hMinimal.2.2.2 S.leftCentres S.left_nonempty S.left_subset
      ⟨S.leftBase, S.leftBase_regular.symm, S.left_support⟩
  exact S.left_proper hEq

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.noncolumnPlate_thickness
statement:
theorem noncolumnPlate_thickness :
      ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
    TilesOn K T Set.univ →
    ∀ (P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T),
      ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P →
      ∀ x : ℝ,
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (volume (horizontalFootprint K)).toReal <
          (volume (P.base ∩ Ioo x (x + 8 * footprintDiameter K))).toReal
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile P hNoncolumn x
  by_contra hNot
  have hThin :
      (volume (P.base ∩ Ioo x (x + 8 * footprintDiameter K))).toReal ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (volume (horizontalFootprint K)).toReal :=
    le_of_not_gt hNot
  obtain ⟨split⟩ := thinNoncolumnPlate_constructsProperSlabSplit
    Continuous.VerticalPlate.isColumn_of_oneSidedBase hTile P hNoncolumn x hThin
  exact thinPlateSplit_contradictsMinimality hTile P x split

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.verticalPlateBases_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
private theorem verticalPlateBases_pairwiseDisjoint :
      ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
    TilesOn K T Set.univ →
    ∀ P Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
      P ≠ Q → Disjoint P.base Q.base
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile P Q hPQ
  let _ : Countable T := hTile.1.to_subtype
  let _ : Countable (Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) := by
    apply Function.Surjective.countable
      (f := fun t : T ↦ Continuous.VerticalPlate.ofCentre (K := K) t)
    intro R
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := R.nonempty_supp
    refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
    exact (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff R r).1 hr
  have hSupportDisjoint : Disjoint P.support Q.support := by
    have hPartition := regularSupport_pairwiseDisjoint
      (@Continuous.VerticalPlate.centres K T)
      (Continuous.verticalPlateCentres_pairwiseDisjoint K T)
      (Continuous.iUnion_verticalPlateCentres K T) hTile
    exact hPartition.1 (Set.mem_univ P) (Set.mem_univ Q) hPQ
  obtain ⟨-, hPSupport⟩ :=
    Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile P
  obtain ⟨-, hQSupport⟩ :=
    Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile Q
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro z hzP hzQ
  let q : Tiling.Plane := ⟨z, 0⟩
  have hqP : q ∈ P.support := by
    rw [hPSupport]
    exact hzP
  have hqQ : q ∈ Q.support := by
    rw [hQSupport]
    exact hzQ
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hSupportDisjoint hqP hqQ

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.finiteNoncolumnPlateFamily_card_bound
statement:
private theorem finiteNoncolumnPlateFamily_card_bound :
      ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
    TilesOn K T Set.univ →
    ∀ F : Finset (Continuous.VerticalPlate K T),
      (∀ P ∈ F, ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P) →
      (F.card : ℝ) * (volume (horizontalFootprint K)).toReal <
        16 * footprintDiameter K
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile F hNoncolumn
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hFootprintPos, hDiameterPos, -, hWindowMeasure⟩ :=
    horizontalFootprint_geometry K
  by_cases hFNonempty : F.Nonempty
  · let W : Set ℝ := Ioo 0 (0 + 8 * footprintDiameter K)
    let f : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T → Set ℝ := fun P ↦ P.base ∩ W
    have hPairwise : Set.Pairwise (↑F) (fun P Q ↦ Disjoint (f P) (f Q)) := by
      intro P hPF Q hQF hPQ
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro y hyP hyQ
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
        (verticalPlateBases_pairwiseDisjoint hTile P Q hPQ) hyP.1 hyQ.1
    have hMeasurable : ∀ P ∈ F, MeasurableSet (f P) := by
      intro P hPF
      obtain ⟨hPRegular, -⟩ :=
        Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile P
      have hPBaseOpen : IsOpen P.base := by
        rw [hPRegular]
        exact isOpen_interior
      exact (hPBaseOpen.inter isOpen_Ioo).measurableSet
    have hEachFinite : ∀ P ∈ F, volume (f P) ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro P hPF
      apply ne_of_lt
      apply lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono inter_subset_right)
      exact (Metric.isBounded_Ioo 0
        (0 + 8 * footprintDiameter K)).measure_lt_top
    have hMeasureEq :
        (volume (⋃ P ∈ F, f P)).toReal =
          ∑ P ∈ F, (volume (f P)).toReal := by
      simpa only [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def] using
        (MeasureTheory.measureReal_biUnion_finset (μ := volume)
          hPairwise hMeasurable hEachFinite)
    have hUnionSubset : (⋃ P ∈ F, f P) ⊆ W := by
      intro y hy
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hy
      obtain ⟨P, hy⟩ := hy
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hy
      obtain ⟨hPF, hy⟩ := hy
      exact hy.2
    have hWindowFinite : volume W ≠ ⊤ :=
      (Metric.isBounded_Ioo 0
        (0 + 8 * footprintDiameter K)).measure_lt_top.ne
    have hUnionLe :
        (volume (⋃ P ∈ F, f P)).toReal ≤ (volume W).toReal :=
      ENNReal.toReal_mono hWindowFinite (measure_mono hUnionSubset)
    have hEach (P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) (hPF : P ∈ F) :
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (volume (horizontalFootprint K)).toReal <
          (volume (f P)).toReal := by
      simpa only [f, W, zero_add] using
        noncolumnPlate_thickness hTile P (hNoncolumn P hPF) 0
    have hSumLower :
        ∑ P ∈ F,
            ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (volume (horizontalFootprint K)).toReal) <
          ∑ P ∈ F, (volume (f P)).toReal :=
      Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty hFNonempty hEach
    have hWindowEq : (volume W).toReal = 8 * footprintDiameter K := by
      simpa only [W, zero_add] using hWindowMeasure 0
    rw [← hMeasureEq] at hSumLower
    rw [hWindowEq] at hUnionLe
    have hCore :
        (F.card : ℝ) *
            ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (volume (horizontalFootprint K)).toReal) <
          8 * footprintDiameter K := by
      calc
        (F.card : ℝ) *
            ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (volume (horizontalFootprint K)).toReal) =
            ∑ _P ∈ F,
              ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (volume (horizontalFootprint K)).toReal) := by
                simp
        _ < (volume (⋃ P ∈ F, f P)).toReal := hSumLower
        _ ≤ 8 * footprintDiameter K := hUnionLe
    nlinarith
  · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hFNonempty]
    simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
    nlinarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.setFinite_of_finset_card_lt_real
statement:
private theorem setFinite_of_finset_card_lt_real :
      ∀ {α : Type*} (S : Set α) (B : ℝ),
    (∀ F : Finset α, (F : Set α) ⊆ S → (F.card : ℝ) < B) →
      S.Finite
proof:
:= by
  intro α S B hBound
  by_contra hInfinite
  have hSInfinite : S.Infinite := hInfinite
  obtain ⟨n : ℕ, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt B
  obtain ⟨F, hFS, hFcard⟩ := hSInfinite.exists_subset_card_eq n
  have hFB := hBound F hFS
  rw [hFcard] at hFB
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hn.le) hFB

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.noncolumnVerticalPlates_finite
statement:
theorem noncolumnVerticalPlates_finite :
      ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
    TilesOn K T Set.univ →
    (Continuous.nonColumnVerticalPlates K T).Finite ∧
      ((Continuous.nonColumnVerticalPlates K T).ncard : ℝ) *
          (volume (horizontalFootprint K)).toReal <
        16 * footprintDiameter K
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile
  let S : Set (Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) :=
    Continuous.nonColumnVerticalPlates K T
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hFootprintPos, -, -, -⟩ :=
    horizontalFootprint_geometry K
  have hFinite : S.Finite := by
    apply setFinite_of_finset_card_lt_real S
      (16 * footprintDiameter K /
        (volume (horizontalFootprint K)).toReal)
    intro F hFS
    have hNoncolumn : ∀ P ∈ F, ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P := by
      intro P hPF
      exact hFS hPF
    have hBound := finiteNoncolumnPlateFamily_card_bound hTile F hNoncolumn
    exact (lt_div_iff₀ hFootprintPos).2 (by
      simpa only [mul_comm] using hBound)
  refine ⟨hFinite, ?_⟩
  have hBound := finiteNoncolumnPlateFamily_card_bound hTile hFinite.toFinset
    (by
      intro P hP
      exact (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset hFinite).mp hP)
  change (S.ncard : ℝ) * (volume (horizontalFootprint K)).toReal <
    16 * footprintDiameter K
  rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card S hFinite]
  exact hBound

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.horizontalStepAlphabet_hasPositiveLowerBound
proof:
:= by
  intro K
  let rho : ℝ := K.horizontalStepAlphabet.min'
    (K.horizontalStepAlphabet_nonempty)
  refine ⟨rho, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact K.horizontalStepAlphabet_pos
      (K.horizontalStepAlphabet.min'_mem K.horizontalStepAlphabet_nonempty)
  · intro d hd
    exact K.horizontalStepAlphabet.min'_le d hd

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.boundedWindowFinite_isClosed
proof:
:= by
  intro S hLocal
  apply isClosed_of_closure_subset
  intro x hx
  let Q : Set ℝ := Metric.closedBall x 1
  have hQBounded : Bornology.IsBounded Q := Metric.isBounded_closedBall
  have hFinite : (S ∩ Q).Finite := hLocal Q hQBounded
  have hxLocalClosure : x ∈ closure (S ∩ Q) := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff]
    intro epsilon hEpsilon
    have hRadius : 0 < min epsilon (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
      lt_min hEpsilon (by norm_num)
    obtain ⟨y, hyS, hxy⟩ :=
      Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hx (min epsilon (1 / 2 : ℝ)) hRadius
    refine ⟨y, ⟨hyS, ?_⟩, hxy.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)⟩
    change y ∈ Metric.closedBall x 1
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
    rw [dist_comm]
    exact hxy.le.trans (by
      calc
        min epsilon (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_right _ _
        _ ≤ 1 := by norm_num)
  rw [hFinite.isClosed.closure_eq] at hxLocalClosure
  exact hxLocalClosure.1

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.trivialDecomposition_componentBoundarySet_empty
statement:
private theorem trivialDecomposition_componentBoundarySet_empty :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T Set.univ →
      (∃ P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
        ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧ P.centres = T) →
      componentBoundarySet K T = ∅
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile
  rintro ⟨P, -, hPT⟩
  have hWholeSupport : regularSupport K T = Set.univ :=
    regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) hTile
  have hPSupport : P.support = Set.univ := by
    rw [Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_eq_regularSupport, hPT, hWholeSupport]
  have hPBase : P.base = Set.univ := by
    rw [Continuous.VerticalPlate.base_eq, hPSupport]
    simpa only [Set.image_univ] using Complex.range_re
  have hAllPlates (Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) : Q = P := by
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Q.nonempty_supp
    have hqP : (q : Tiling.Plane) ∈ P.centres := by
      rw [hPT]
      exact q.2
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpq⟩ := hqP
    have hpqSubtype : p = q := Subtype.ext hpq
    subst p
    exact SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq_of_common_vertex hq hp
  rw [componentBoundarySet_eq]
  simp_rw [hAllPlates]
  simp only [hPBase, frontier_univ, iUnion_empty]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.segment_re_eq_of_mem
statement:
private theorem segment_re_eq_of_mem
    {a b z : Tiling.Plane} (hab : a.re = b.re)
    (hz : z ∈ segment ℝ a b) : z.re = a.re
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image] at hz
  obtain ⟨r, _hr, rfl⟩ := hz
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hab]
  ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.segment_im_eq_of_mem
statement:
private theorem segment_im_eq_of_mem
    {a b z : Tiling.Plane} (hab : a.im = b.im)
    (hz : z ∈ segment ℝ a b) : z.im = a.im
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image] at hz
  obtain ⟨r, _hr, rfl⟩ := hz
  simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hab]
  ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundary_hasTranslatedVerticalEdge
statement:
private theorem componentBoundary_hasTranslatedVerticalEdge :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T Set.univ →
      (¬ ∃ P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
        ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧ P.centres = T) →
      ∀ c ∈ componentBoundarySet K T,
        ∃ (P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) (t : ↥T)
          (v w : ↥K.vertices),
          c ∈ frontier P.base ∧
          (t.1 : Tiling.Plane) ∈ P.centres ∧
          v.1 ≠ w.1 ∧ v.1.re = w.1.re ∧
          c = v.1.re + t.1.re ∧
          openSegment ℝ (t.1 + v.1) (t.1 + w.1) ⊆
            frontier (t.1 +ᵥ K.support)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile _hNontrivial c hc
  rw [componentBoundarySet_eq] at hc
  obtain ⟨P, hcP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hc
  let _ : Countable T := hTile.1.to_subtype
  have hVerticesFinite : K.vertices.Finite := by
    simpa only [Region.vertices] using K.isPolygonal.vertexSet_finite
  let _ : Countable (↑K.vertices) :=
    hVerticesFinite.countable.to_subtype
  let forbidden : Set ℝ :=
    Set.range fun p : T × ↑K.vertices ↦ p.1.1.im + p.2.1.im
  have hForbiddenCountable : forbidden.Countable := Set.countable_range _
  have hForbiddenNe : forbidden ≠ Set.univ := by
    intro hEq
    apply Cardinal.not_countable_real
    rw [← hEq]
    exact hForbiddenCountable
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (Set.ne_univ_iff_exists_notMem forbidden).mp hForbiddenNe
  let q : Tiling.Plane := ⟨c, y⟩
  obtain ⟨-, hPSupport⟩ :=
    Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile P
  have hqFrontier : q ∈ frontier P.support := by
    rw [hPSupport]
    change q ∈ frontier ({z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ P.base} : Set Tiling.Plane)
    rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.frontier_verticalCylinder]
    exact hcP
  have hCentresSubset : P.centres ⊆ T := by
    rintro s ⟨t, -, rfl⟩
    exact t.2
  have hPacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements P.centres) := by
    apply (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K P.centres).mpr
    exact fun s hs t ht hst ↦
      (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K T).mp hTile.2.1
        (hCentresSubset hs) (hCentresSubset ht) hst
  have hqClosure : q ∈ closure (openUnion K P.centres) := by
    have hqSupportClosure : q ∈ closure P.support :=
      frontier_subset_closure hqFrontier
    rw [Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_eq_regularSupport,
      regularSupport] at hqSupportClosure
    simpa only [closure_closure] using
      closure_mono (interior_subset :
        interior (closure (openUnion K P.centres)) ⊆
          closure (openUnion K P.centres)) hqSupportClosure
  rw [closure_openUnion_eq_iUnion_support hPacking] at hqClosure
  obtain ⟨s, hqs⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hqClosure
  obtain ⟨t, htP, hts⟩ := s.2
  let p : Tiling.Plane := q - s.1
  have hqp : q = s.1 + p := by simp [p]
  have hpSupport : p ∈ K.support := by
    simpa [p, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, sub_eq_add_neg,
      add_comm] using hqs
  have hpNotInterior : p ∉ interior K.support := by
    intro hpInterior
    have hqOpen : q ∈ openUnion K P.centres := by
      rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
      refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      change -s.1 + q ∈ interior K.support
      simpa only [hqp, neg_add_cancel_left] using hpInterior
    have hOpenUnion : IsOpen (openUnion K P.centres) := by
      rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier]
      exact isOpen_iUnion fun r : P.centres ↦
        (Homeomorph.addLeft (r : Tiling.Plane)).isOpenMap _ isOpen_interior
    have hqPlateSupport : q ∈ P.support := by
      rw [Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_eq_regularSupport, regularSupport]
      exact hOpenUnion.subset_interior_closure hqOpen
    have hPSupportOpen : IsOpen P.support := by
      rw [Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_eq_regularSupport]
      exact isOpen_interior
    have hqInterior : q ∈ interior P.support := by
      rwa [hPSupportOpen.interior_eq]
    exact hqFrontier.2 hqInterior
  have hpFrontier : p ∈ frontier K.support := by
    rw [K.isPolygonal.isClosed.frontier_eq]
    exact ⟨hpSupport, hpNotInterior⟩
  have hpNotVertex : p ∉ K.vertices := by
    intro hpVertex
    apply hy
    refine ⟨(t, ⟨p, hpVertex⟩), ?_⟩
    have him := congrArg Complex.im hqp
    have htsIm := congrArg Complex.im hts
    simp only [q, Complex.add_im] at him
    linarith
  obtain ⟨axis, v, w, hvw, hTransverse, hpSegment, hEdge⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.nonvertexFrontier_mem_intrinsicEdge K p
      hpFrontier hpNotVertex
  cases axis with
  | horizontal =>
      have hvwIm : v.1.im = w.1.im := hTransverse
      have hpIm : p.im = v.1.im :=
        segment_im_eq_of_mem hvwIm
          (openSegment_subset_segment ℝ v.1 w.1 hpSegment)
      exfalso
      apply hy
      refine ⟨(t, v), ?_⟩
      have him := congrArg Complex.im hqp
      have htsIm := congrArg Complex.im hts
      simp only [q, Complex.add_im] at him
      linarith
  | vertical =>
      have hvwRe : v.1.re = w.1.re := hTransverse
      have hpRe : p.re = v.1.re :=
        segment_re_eq_of_mem hvwRe
          (openSegment_subset_segment ℝ v.1 w.1 hpSegment)
      have htCentre : (t.1 : Tiling.Plane) ∈ P.centres := ⟨t, htP, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨P, t, v, w, hcP, htCentre, hvw, hvwRe, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hre := congrArg Complex.re hqp
        have htsRe := congrArg Complex.re hts
        simp only [q, Complex.add_re] at hre
        linarith
      · rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.frontier_vadd_eq]
        change openSegment ℝ (t.1 +ᵥ v.1) (t.1 +ᵥ w.1) ⊆
          t.1 +ᵥ frontier K.support
        rw [← vadd_openSegment ℝ]
        rintro z ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨r, (hEdge hr).1, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.translatedVertexCoordinates_locallyFinite
statement:
private theorem translatedVertexCoordinates_locallyFinite :
    ∀ (K : Region) (T : Set Tiling.Plane),
      (∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q →
        (Complex.re '' T ∩ Q).Finite) →
      ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q →
        ({c : ℝ | ∃ v ∈ K.vertices, ∃ t ∈ T,
          c = v.re + t.re} ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hLocal Q hQBounded
  let A : ↑K.vertexFinset → Set ℝ := fun v ↦
    (fun r : ℝ ↦ v.1.re + r) ''
      ((Complex.re '' T) ∩ ((-v.1.re) +ᵥ Q))
  have hShiftBounded (v : ↑K.vertexFinset) :
      Bornology.IsBounded ((-v.1.re) +ᵥ Q) := hQBounded.vadd _
  have hAFinite (v : ↑K.vertexFinset) : (A v).Finite := by
    apply Set.Finite.image
    exact hLocal ((-v.1.re) +ᵥ Q) (hShiftBounded v)
  apply (Set.finite_iUnion hAFinite).subset
  rintro c ⟨⟨v, hv, t, ht, hct⟩, hcQ⟩
  have hvFinset : v ∈ K.vertexFinset := by
    change v ∈ (K.vertexFinset : Set Tiling.Plane)
    simpa only [K.coe_vertexFinset] using hv
  rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
  refine ⟨⟨v, hvFinset⟩, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨t.re, ⟨⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simp only [vadd_eq_add, neg_neg]
    convert hcQ using 1
    linarith [hct]
  · exact hct.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundarySet_locallyFinite
statement:
theorem componentBoundarySet_locallyFinite :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T Set.univ →
      ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q →
        (componentBoundarySet K T ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile Q hQBounded
  by_cases hTrivial : ∃ P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
      ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧ P.centres = T
  · rw [trivialDecomposition_componentBoundarySet_empty hTile hTrivial]
    simp only [empty_inter, Set.finite_empty]
  · have hProjectedLocal :=
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.projectedCentres_closedLocallyFinite hTile hTrivial).2
    have hOffsetLocal := translatedVertexCoordinates_locallyFinite K T
      hProjectedLocal Q hQBounded
    apply hOffsetLocal.subset
    rintro c ⟨hcBoundary, hcQ⟩
    obtain ⟨P, t, v, w, hcP, htP, hvw, hvwRe, hcEq, hEdge⟩ :=
      componentBoundary_hasTranslatedVerticalEdge hTile hTrivial c hcBoundary
    exact ⟨⟨v.1, v.2, t.1, t.2, hcEq⟩, hcQ⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundarySet_closed
statement:
theorem componentBoundarySet_closed :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T Set.univ →
      IsClosed (componentBoundarySet K T)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile
  exact boundedWindowFinite_isClosed _
    (componentBoundarySet_locallyFinite hTile)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase
statement:
theorem componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : c ∈ componentBoundarySet K T)
    (P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) : c ∉ P.base
proof:
:= by
  rw [componentBoundarySet_eq] at hc
  obtain ⟨Q, hcQ⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hc
  obtain ⟨hPRegular, -⟩ :=
    Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile P
  have hPBaseOpen : IsOpen P.base := by
    rw [hPRegular]
    exact isOpen_interior
  by_cases hPQ : P = Q
  · subst Q
    intro hcP
    exact hcQ.2 (by rwa [hPBaseOpen.interior_eq])
  · intro hcP
    have hMeet : (P.base ∩ Q.base).Nonempty :=
      (mem_closure_iff.mp (frontier_subset_closure hcQ))
        P.base hPBaseOpen hcP
    obtain ⟨z, hzP, hzQ⟩ := hMeet
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (verticalPlateBases_pairwiseDisjoint hTile P Q hPQ) hzP hzQ

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.genericHeight_near
statement:
private theorem genericHeight_near
    (K : Region) (y ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ y', y' ∈ Ioo (y - ε / 2) (y + ε / 2) ∧
      y' ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.im
proof:
:= by
  let J : Set ℝ := Ioo (y - ε / 2) (y + ε / 2)
  have hJNotCountable : ¬ J.Countable := by
    change ¬ (Ioo (y - ε / 2) (y + ε / 2)).Countable
    rw [Cardinal.Real.Ioo_countable_iff]
    linarith
  by_contra hNo
  push Not at hNo
  have hSubset : J ⊆ (K.vertexFinset.image Complex.im : Set ℝ) := by
    intro z hz
    exact hNo z hz
  exact hJNotCountable
    ((K.vertexFinset.image Complex.im).finite_toSet.countable.mono hSubset)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundaryGap_hasTileSliceWitness
statement:
private theorem componentBoundaryGap_hasTileSliceWitness :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T Set.univ →
      ∀ a b : ℝ,
        a ∈ componentBoundarySet K T →
        b ∈ componentBoundarySet K T →
        a < b →
        Ioo a b ∩ componentBoundarySet K T = ∅ →
        ∃ (t : ↥T) (v w : ↥K.vertices) (y : ℝ),
          y ∉ K.vertexFinset.image Complex.im ∧
          v.1.re < w.1.re ∧
          w.1.re - v.1.re ∈ K.horizontalStepAlphabet ∧
          Ioo v.1.re w.1.re ⊆ horizontalSlice K y ∧
          Ioo (v.1.re + t.1.re) (w.1.re + t.1.re) ⊆ Ioo a b
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile a b ha hb hab hGap
  let D : Set Tiling.Plane := Complex.re ⁻¹' Ioo a b
  let x : Tiling.Plane := ⟨(a + b) / 2, 0⟩
  have hDOpen : IsOpen D := isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.continuous_re
  have hxD : x ∈ D := by
    change (a + b) / 2 ∈ Ioo a b
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hRegularUniv : regularSupport K T = Set.univ :=
    regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) hTile
  have hxClosure : x ∈ closure (openUnion K T) := by
    have hxRegular : x ∈ regularSupport K T := by
      rw [hRegularUniv]
      exact Set.mem_univ x
    rw [regularSupport, Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport, ← openUnion] at hxRegular
    exact interior_subset hxRegular
  have hMeet : (D ∩ openUnion K T).Nonempty :=
    (mem_closure_iff.mp hxClosure) D hDOpen hxD
  obtain ⟨q, hqD, hqOpen⟩ := hMeet
  rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion] at hqOpen
  obtain ⟨t, hqt⟩ := hqOpen
  let p : Tiling.Plane := q - t.1
  have hqp : q = t.1 + p := by simp [p]
  have hpOpen : p ∈ K.openCarrier := by
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hqt
    simpa only [p, vadd_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub] using hqt
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hBall⟩ :=
    (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp isOpen_interior) p hpOpen
  obtain ⟨y, hyNear, hyGeneric⟩ := genericHeight_near K p.im ε hε
  let p' : Tiling.Plane := Complex.mk p.re y
  have hp'Ball : p' ∈ Metric.ball p ε := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_of_re_eq]
    · rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith [hyNear.1, hyNear.2]
    · rfl
  have hp'Open : p' ∈ K.openCarrier := hBall hp'Ball
  obtain ⟨H⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.horizontalGenericSlicePresentation_exists
      K hyGeneric
  have hp'Slice : p.re ∈
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.horizontalSlice K y := by
    change Complex.mk p.re y ∈ K.openCarrier
    exact hp'Open
  rw [H.union_eq, Set.mem_iUnion] at hp'Slice
  obtain ⟨i, hpi⟩ := hp'Slice
  let v : ↑K.vertices := H.leftVertex i
  let w : ↑K.vertices := H.rightVertex i
  have hvCoord : v.1.re = H.left i := H.leftVertex_coord i
  have hwCoord : w.1.re = H.right i := H.rightVertex_coord i
  have hvw : v.1.re < w.1.re := by
    rw [hvCoord, hwCoord]
    exact H.lt i
  have hStep : w.1.re - v.1.re ∈ K.horizontalStepAlphabet := by
    apply (K.mem_horizontalStepAlphabet_iff _).2
    exact ⟨v.1, v.2, w.1, w.2, rfl, sub_pos.mpr hvw⟩
  have hSlice : Ioo v.1.re w.1.re ⊆ horizontalSlice K y := by
    intro r hr
    have hr' : r ∈ Ioo (H.left i) (H.right i) := by
      rwa [← hvCoord, ← hwCoord]
    have : r ∈
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.horizontalSlice K y := by
      rw [H.union_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨i, hr'⟩
    simpa only [horizontalSlice,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.horizontalSlice,
      Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I] using this
  let P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T :=
    Continuous.VerticalPlate.ofCentre (K := K) t
  have htP : (t.1 : Tiling.Plane) ∈ P.centres :=
    Continuous.VerticalPlate.mem_centres_ofCentre t
  have hTranslatedSliceBase :
      Ioo (v.1.re + t.1.re) (w.1.re + t.1.re) ⊆ P.base := by
    intro r hr
    have hrSource : r - t.1.re ∈ Ioo v.1.re w.1.re := by
      constructor <;> linarith [hr.1, hr.2]
    have hrCarrier := hSlice hrSource
    have hrProjection : r - t.1.re ∈ Complex.re '' K.openCarrier := by
      refine ⟨Complex.mk (r - t.1.re) y, ?_, rfl⟩
      change ((r - t.1.re : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
        K.openCarrier at hrCarrier
      simpa only [Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I] using hrCarrier
    have hProjectionOpen : IsOpen (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier) :=
      Complex.isOpenMap_re K.openCarrier isOpen_interior
    have hrFootprint : r - t.1.re ∈ horizontalFootprint K := by
      exact hProjectionOpen.subset_interior_closure hrProjection
    apply plateCentre_footprint_subset_base hTile P t.1 htP
    refine ⟨t.1.re, Set.mem_singleton _, r - t.1.re, hrFootprint, ?_⟩
    ring
  have haNotBase : a ∉ P.base := componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase hTile ha P
  have hbNotBase : b ∉ P.base := componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase hTile hb P
  have hqReGap : q.re ∈ Ioo a b := hqD
  have hpReInterval : p.re ∈ Ioo v.1.re w.1.re := by
    rwa [hvCoord, hwCoord]
  have hqReInterval : q.re ∈
      Ioo (v.1.re + t.1.re) (w.1.re + t.1.re) := by
    have hqRe := congrArg Complex.re hqp
    simp only [Complex.add_re] at hqRe
    constructor <;> linarith [hpReInterval.1, hpReInterval.2]
  have hTranslatedInside :
      Ioo (v.1.re + t.1.re) (w.1.re + t.1.re) ⊆ Ioo a b := by
    intro r hr
    constructor
    · by_contra hra
      apply haNotBase
      apply hTranslatedSliceBase
      exact ⟨by linarith [hr.1], by linarith [hqReInterval.2, hqReGap.1]⟩
    · by_contra hrb
      apply hbNotBase
      apply hTranslatedSliceBase
      exact ⟨by linarith [hqReInterval.1, hqReGap.2], by linarith [hr.2]⟩
  exact ⟨t, v, w, y, hyGeneric, hvw, hStep, hSlice, hTranslatedInside⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundaryGaps_boundedBelow
statement:
theorem componentBoundaryGaps_boundedBelow :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T Set.univ →
      ∃ rho : ℝ, 0 < rho ∧
        ∀ a b : ℝ,
          a ∈ componentBoundarySet K T →
          b ∈ componentBoundarySet K T →
          a < b →
          Ioo a b ∩ componentBoundarySet K T = ∅ →
          rho ≤ b - a
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile
  obtain ⟨rho, hRho, hRhoLower⟩ := horizontalStepAlphabet_hasPositiveLowerBound K
  refine ⟨rho, hRho, ?_⟩
  intro a b ha hb hab hGap
  obtain ⟨t, v, w, y, hy, hvw, hStep, hSlice, hInside⟩ :=
    componentBoundaryGap_hasTileSliceWitness hTile a b ha hb hab hGap
  have hTranslatedLt : v.1.re + t.1.re < w.1.re + t.1.re := by
    linarith
  obtain ⟨hLeft, hRight⟩ :=
    (Set.Ioo_subset_Ioo_iff hTranslatedLt).mp hInside
  have hWidth : w.1.re - v.1.re ≤ b - a := by
    linarith
  exact (hRhoLower _ hStep).trans hWidth

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.deformation_preservesVerticalEdgeOrder
statement:
theorem deformation_preservesVerticalEdgeOrder
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (_D : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.CoordinateDeformation C phi)
    (P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.TwoStageDeformationSupportTransport
      C phi _D)
    (hHorizontalSign :
      ∀ v w : C.region.vertices, ∀ s t : C.centres,
        Real.sign ((w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re -
          (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re) =
        Real.sign
          ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
                (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) +
              Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
                (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)).re -
            (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
                (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) +
              Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
                (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2)).re))
    (v w : C.region.vertices)
    (s t : C.centres) :
    Real.sign ((w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re -
      (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re) =
    Real.sign
      ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
            (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) +
          P.firstCenters t).re -
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
            (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) +
          P.firstCenters s).re)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.firstCenters_apply t, P.firstCenters_apply s]
  simpa [Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapFirstPoint,
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint] using hHorizontalSign v w s t

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.mappedCentres_injective
statement:
theorem mappedCentres_injective
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (D : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.CoordinateDeformation C phi)
    (P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.TwoStageDeformationSupportTransport
      C phi D) :
    Function.Injective P.fullCenters
proof:
:=
  P.fullCenters.injective

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.deformation_verticalPlateEquiv_centres
statement:
theorem deformation_verticalPlateEquiv_centres
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (D : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.CoordinateDeformation C phi)
    (P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.TwoStageDeformationSupportTransport
      C phi D)
    (hContact : ∀ s t : C.centres,
      HorizontalProperContact C.region s t ↔
        HorizontalProperContact D.deformedRegion
          (P.fullCenters s) (P.fullCenters t))
    (Q : VerticalPlate C.region C.centres) :
    (deformation_verticalPlateEquiv C phi D P hContact Q).centres =
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.deformedCenterCarrierOn P.fullCenters
        {t : C.centres | (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Q.centres}
proof:
:= by
  let graphIso := deformation_verticalPlateGraphIso C phi D P hContact
  change Subtype.val '' (graphIso.connectedComponentEquiv Q).supp =
    P.fullCenters '' {t : C.centres | (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Q.centres}
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := a.2
    have hat : a = graphIso t := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact ht.symm
    subst a
    refine ⟨t, ?_, rfl⟩
    change (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Q.centres
    refine ⟨t, ?_, rfl⟩
    have ha' :
        @SimpleGraph.connectedComponentMk _
            (verticalPlateGraph D.deformedRegion
              (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.deformedCenterCarrier P.fullCenters))
            (graphIso t) =
          graphIso.connectedComponentEquiv Q := ha
    exact (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.iso_image_comp_eq_map_iff_eq_comp
      (φ := graphIso) (v := t) (C := Q)).mp ha'
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    let a : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.deformedCenterCarrier P.fullCenters := graphIso t
    refine ⟨a, ?_, rfl⟩
    change (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Q.centres at ht
    rcases ht with ⟨u, hu, hut⟩
    have htu : t = u := Subtype.ext hut.symm
    subst u
    have hu' :
        (verticalPlateGraph C.region C.centres).connectedComponentMk t = Q := hu
    have hout :=
      (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.iso_image_comp_eq_map_iff_eq_comp
        (φ := graphIso) (v := t) (C := Q)).mpr hu'
    exact hout

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.exists_mem_Ioo_of_ae
proof:
:= by
  have hmeasure : MeasureTheory.volume (Ioo u v) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Real.volume_Ioo]
    simp [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero, not_le.mpr (sub_pos.mpr huv)]
  exact MeasureTheory.Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hmeasure
    (hP.filter_mono MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_le)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.goodHorizontalSlice_exists
statement:
private theorem goodHorizontalSlice_exists
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    {lo hi : ℝ} (hlohi : lo < hi) :
    ∃ q ∈ Set.Ioo lo hi,
      q ∉ {y : ℝ | ∃ v : K.vertices, ∃ t : T,
        y = (v.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).im} ∧
      ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
        ∃ t : T, (x : ℂ) + (q : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
          (t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  let bad : Set ℝ := {y : ℝ | ∃ v : K.vertices, ∃ t : T,
    y = (v.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).im}
  have hTcountable : T.Countable :=
    (IsPacking.locallyFinite_centres hTile.2.1).2
  have hVcountable : K.vertices.Countable := by
    rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]
    exact K.vertexFinset.finite_toSet.countable
  let _ : Countable T := hTcountable.to_subtype
  let _ : Countable K.vertices := hVcountable.to_subtype
  have hbad : bad.Countable := by
    let f : K.vertices × T → ℝ := fun p ↦
      (p.1.1 + (p.2 : Tiling.Plane)).im
    apply (Set.countable_range f).mono
    rintro y ⟨v, t, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(v, t), rfl⟩
  have hplane : ∀ᵐ z : Tiling.Plane ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
      ∃ t : T, z ∈ (t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier := by
    filter_upwards [hTile.2.2] with z hz
    exact hz.mp (Set.mem_univ z)
  have hpull :=
    Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.symm.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hplane
  have hswap :=
    MeasureTheory.Measure.measurePreserving_swap.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hpull
  have hslices := MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod
    (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (ν := MeasureTheory.volume) hswap
  have hgood : ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
      q ∉ bad ∧ ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
        ∃ t : T, (x : ℂ) + (q : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
          (t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier := by
    filter_upwards [hbad.ae_notMem MeasureTheory.volume, hslices] with q hqbad hq
    refine ⟨hqbad, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hq] with x hx
    have heq : (x : ℂ) + (q : ℂ) * Complex.I =
        Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm (q, x).swap := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp
    rw [heq]
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨q, hqI, hqbad, hqcover⟩ :=
    exists_mem_Ioo_of_ae hlohi hgood
  exact ⟨q, hqI, hqbad, hqcover⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.eventually_goodHorizontalSlice
statement:
private theorem eventually_goodHorizontalSlice
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
      q ∉ {y : ℝ | ∃ v : K.vertices, ∃ t : T,
        y = (v.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).im} ∧
      ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
        ∃ t : T, (x : ℂ) + (q : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
          (t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  let bad : Set ℝ := {y : ℝ | ∃ v : K.vertices, ∃ t : T,
    y = (v.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).im}
  have hTcountable : T.Countable :=
    (IsPacking.locallyFinite_centres hTile.2.1).2
  have hVcountable : K.vertices.Countable := by
    rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]
    exact K.vertexFinset.finite_toSet.countable
  let _ : Countable T := hTcountable.to_subtype
  let _ : Countable K.vertices := hVcountable.to_subtype
  have hbad : bad.Countable := by
    let f : K.vertices × T → ℝ := fun p ↦
      (p.1.1 + (p.2 : Tiling.Plane)).im
    apply (Set.countable_range f).mono
    rintro y ⟨v, t, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(v, t), rfl⟩
  have hplane : ∀ᵐ z : Tiling.Plane ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
      ∃ t : T, z ∈ (t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier := by
    filter_upwards [hTile.2.2] with z hz
    exact hz.mp (Set.mem_univ z)
  have hpull :=
    Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.symm.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hplane
  have hswap :=
    MeasureTheory.Measure.measurePreserving_swap.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hpull
  have hslices := MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod
    (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (ν := MeasureTheory.volume) hswap
  filter_upwards [hbad.ae_notMem MeasureTheory.volume, hslices] with q hqbad hq
  refine ⟨hqbad, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hq] with x hx
  have heq : (x : ℂ) + (q : ℂ) * Complex.I =
      Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm (q, x).swap := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  rw [heq]
  exact hx

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.openSegment_eq_vertical
statement:
private theorem openSegment_eq_vertical
    (v w : Tiling.Plane) (h : v.re = w.re) :
    openSegment ℝ v w =
      (fun y : ℝ ↦ (v.re : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
        openSegment ℝ v.im w.im
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩
    refine ⟨z.im, ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hz]
      simp
    · rw [← hz]
      have hweighted (r : ℝ) : a * r + b * r = r := by
        rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [h, hweighted]
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hy⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, ?_⟩
    have hweighted (r : ℝ) : a * r + b * r = r := by
      rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp [h, hweighted]
    · simpa using hy

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalSide_sliceEndpoint
statement:
private theorem verticalSide_sliceEndpoint
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (v w : K.vertices) (s : T) {q : ℝ}
    (hvw : v.1 ≠ w.1) (hvertical : v.1.re = w.1.re)
    (hedge : openSegment ℝ (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane))
      (w.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)) ⊆
        frontier ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support) \
          ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.vertices))
    (hq : q ∈ translatedVerticalInterval v.1 w.1 s)
    (hcover : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
      ∃ t : T, (x : ℂ) + (q : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
        (t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) :
    (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re ∈
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.sliceEndpointSet
        K T Axis.horizontal q
proof:
:= by
  let x : ℝ := (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re
  let p : Tiling.Plane := (x : ℂ) + (q : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have himne : v.1.im ≠ w.1.im := by
    intro him
    apply hvw
    exact Complex.ext hvertical him
  have hpseg : p ∈ openSegment ℝ (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane))
      (w.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)) := by
    rw [openSegment_eq_vertical _ _ (by simp [hvertical])]
    refine ⟨q, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo' (by simpa using himne)]
      simpa [translatedVerticalInterval, Complex.add_im,
        min_add_add_right, max_add_add_right] using hq
    · apply Complex.ext <;> simp [p, x]
  have hpfront := (hedge hpseg).1
  have hpSupport : p ∈ (s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support := by
    have hclosed := K.isPolygonal.isClosed.vadd (s : Tiling.Plane)
    rw [← hclosed.closure_eq]
    exact frontier_subset_closure hpfront
  have hpclosure : p ∈ closure ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) := by
    rw [closure_vadd, show closure K.openCarrier = K.support by
      exact K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]
    exact hpSupport
  have hpnot : p ∉ openUnion K T := by
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
    rintro ⟨t, hpt⟩
    by_cases hts : t = s
    · subst t
      apply hpfront.2
      rw [interior_vadd]
      exact hpt
    · have hcent : (t : Tiling.Plane) ≠ (s : Tiling.Plane) := by
        intro h
        exact hts (Subtype.ext h)
      have hdisj : Disjoint
          ((t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
          ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) :=
        (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K T).mp hTile.2.1
          t.2 s.2 hcent
      have hmeet := mem_closure_iff.mp hpclosure
        ((t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
        (isOpen_interior.vadd _) hpt
      rw [Set.disjoint_left] at hdisj
      obtain ⟨z, hzt, hzs⟩ := hmeet
      exact hdisj hzt hzs
  let U : Set ℝ := {r : ℝ |
    (r : ℂ) + (q : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ openUnion K T}
  have hUae : ∀ᵐ r : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume, r ∈ U := by
    filter_upwards [hcover] with r hr
    change (r : ℂ) + (q : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ openUnion K T
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact hr
  have hUdense : Dense U :=
    (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ).dense_of_ae hUae
  have hxnotU : x ∉ U := by
    intro hxU
    exact hpnot hxU
  change x ∈ frontier U
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hUdense.closure_eq]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro hxint
    exact hxnotU (interior_subset hxint)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.sum_fin_succ_sub_castSucc
statement:
private theorem sum_fin_succ_sub_castSucc
    (n : ℕ) (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, (x i.succ - x i.castSucc) = x (Fin.last n) - x 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      let y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun i ↦ x i.succ
      have htail := ih y
      dsimp [y] at htail
      have htail' : ∑ i : Fin n,
          (x i.succ.succ - x i.succ.castSucc) =
            x (Fin.last (n + 1)) - x 1 := by
        rw [← htail]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _hi
        congr 2
      rw [htail']
      have hs0 : (Fin.succ 0 : Fin (n + 2)) = 1 := Fin.ext rfl
      have hc0 : (Fin.castSucc 0 : Fin (n + 2)) = 0 := Fin.ext rfl
      rw [hs0, hc0]
      ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.genericHorizontalSlice_finiteChain
statement:
private theorem genericHorizontalSlice_finiteChain
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (v v' w w' : K.vertices) (s t : T) {q : ℝ}
    (hvv' : v.1 ≠ v'.1) (hww' : w.1 ≠ w'.1)
    (hvVertical : v.1.re = v'.1.re) (hwVertical : w.1.re = w'.1.re)
    (hvEdge : openSegment ℝ (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane))
      (v'.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)) ⊆
        frontier ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support) \
          ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.vertices))
    (hwEdge : openSegment ℝ (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane))
      (w'.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)) ⊆
        frontier ((t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support) \
          ((t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.vertices))
    (hqv : q ∈ translatedVerticalInterval v.1 v'.1 s)
    (hqw : q ∈ translatedVerticalInterval w.1 w'.1 t)
    (hx : (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re <
      (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re)
    (_hq : q ∉ {y : ℝ | ∃ v : K.vertices, ∃ t : T,
      y = (v.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).im})
    (_hcover : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
      ∃ t : T, (x : ℂ) + (q : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
        (t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ a b : Fin n → K.vertices,
      (∀ i : Fin n, (a i).1.re < (b i).1.re) ∧
      (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re -
          (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re =
        ∑ i : Fin n, ((b i).1.re - (a i).1.re)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let lo : ℝ := max (min v.1.im v'.1.im + (s : Tiling.Plane).im)
    (min w.1.im w'.1.im + (t : Tiling.Plane).im)
  let hi : ℝ := min (max v.1.im v'.1.im + (s : Tiling.Plane).im)
    (max w.1.im w'.1.im + (t : Tiling.Plane).im)
  have hlohi : lo < hi := by
    have hloq : lo < q := max_lt hqv.1 hqw.1
    have hqhi : q < hi := lt_min hqv.2 hqw.2
    exact hloq.trans hqhi
  have hchainEvent :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints
      K T hTile Axis.horizontal
  obtain ⟨q', hq'I, hq'good, hchain'⟩ := exists_mem_Ioo_of_ae hlohi
    ((eventually_goodHorizontalSlice hTile).and hchainEvent)
  have hq'v : q' ∈ translatedVerticalInterval v.1 v'.1 s := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hq'I.1
    · exact hq'I.2.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hq'w : q' ∈ translatedVerticalInterval w.1 w'.1 t := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hq'I.1
    · exact hq'I.2.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have hleft := verticalSide_sliceEndpoint hTile v v' s hvv' hvVertical
    hvEdge hq'v hq'good.2
  have hright := verticalSide_sliceEndpoint hTile w w' t hww' hwVertical
    hwEdge hq'w hq'good.2
  obtain ⟨n, hn, x, owner, hx0, hxlast, hfilled⟩ :=
    hchain' _ hleft _ hright hx
  have hpiece : ∀ i : Fin n, ∃ a b : K.vertices,
      x i.castSucc = (a.1 + (owner i : Tiling.Plane)).re ∧
      x i.succ = (b.1 + (owner i : Tiling.Plane)).re ∧
      a.1.re < b.1.re := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hxa, hxb, hpos, _hinside⟩ := hfilled.2 i
    refine ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩, hxa, hxb, ?_⟩
    simpa [Axis.coord, Complex.sub_re] using hpos
  let a : Fin n → K.vertices := fun i ↦ (hpiece i).choose
  let b : Fin n → K.vertices := fun i ↦ (hpiece i).choose_spec.choose
  have hab (i : Fin n) :
      x i.castSucc = ((a i).1 + (owner i : Tiling.Plane)).re ∧
      x i.succ = ((b i).1 + (owner i : Tiling.Plane)).re ∧
      (a i).1.re < (b i).1.re :=
    (hpiece i).choose_spec.choose_spec
  refine ⟨n, hn, a, b, fun i ↦ (hab i).2.2, ?_⟩
  rw [← hx0, ← hxlast, ← sum_fin_succ_sub_castSucc]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _hi
  rw [(hab i).1, (hab i).2.1]
  simp only [Complex.add_re]
  ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.horizontalCrossSection_chain
statement:
theorem horizontalCrossSection_chain
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (v v' w w' : K.vertices) (s t : T)
    (hvv' : v.1 ≠ v'.1) (hww' : w.1 ≠ w'.1)
    (hvVertical : v.1.re = v'.1.re) (hwVertical : w.1.re = w'.1.re)
    (hvEdge : openSegment ℝ (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane))
      (v'.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)) ⊆
        frontier ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support) \
          ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.vertices))
    (hwEdge : openSegment ℝ (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane))
      (w'.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)) ⊆
        frontier ((t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support) \
          ((t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.vertices))
    (hOverlap :
      max (min v.1.im v'.1.im + (s : Tiling.Plane).im)
          (min w.1.im w'.1.im + (t : Tiling.Plane).im) <
        min (max v.1.im v'.1.im + (s : Tiling.Plane).im)
          (max w.1.im w'.1.im + (t : Tiling.Plane).im))
    (hOrder : (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re <
      (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ a b : Fin n → K.vertices,
      (∀ i : Fin n, (a i).1.re < (b i).1.re) ∧
      (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re -
          (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re =
        ∑ i : Fin n, ((b i).1.re - (a i).1.re)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hqI, hqbad, hqcover⟩ := goodHorizontalSlice_exists hTile hOverlap
  have hqv : q ∈ translatedVerticalInterval v.1 v'.1 s := by
    exact ⟨(le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hqI.1,
      hqI.2.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)⟩
  have hqw : q ∈ translatedVerticalInterval w.1 w'.1 t := by
    exact ⟨(le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hqI.1,
      hqI.2.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)⟩
  exact genericHorizontalSlice_finiteChain hTile v v' w w' s t
    hvv' hww' hvVertical hwVertical hvEdge hwEdge hqv hqw hOrder hqbad hqcover

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.eventually_goodVerticalSlice
statement:
private theorem eventually_goodVerticalSlice
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
      q ∉ {x : ℝ | ∃ v : K.vertices, ∃ t : T,
        x = (v.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re} ∧
      ∀ᵐ y : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
        ∃ t : T, (q : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
          (t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  let bad : Set ℝ := {x : ℝ | ∃ v : K.vertices, ∃ t : T,
    x = (v.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re}
  have hTcountable : T.Countable :=
    (IsPacking.locallyFinite_centres hTile.2.1).2
  have hVcountable : K.vertices.Countable := by
    rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]
    exact K.vertexFinset.finite_toSet.countable
  let _ : Countable T := hTcountable.to_subtype
  let _ : Countable K.vertices := hVcountable.to_subtype
  have hbad : bad.Countable := by
    let f : K.vertices × T → ℝ := fun p ↦
      (p.1.1 + (p.2 : Tiling.Plane)).re
    apply (Set.countable_range f).mono
    rintro x ⟨v, t, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(v, t), rfl⟩
  have hplane : ∀ᵐ z : Tiling.Plane ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
      ∃ t : T, z ∈ (t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier := by
    filter_upwards [hTile.2.2] with z hz
    exact hz.mp (Set.mem_univ z)
  have hpull :=
    Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.symm.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hplane
  have hslices := MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod
    (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (ν := MeasureTheory.volume) hpull
  filter_upwards [hbad.ae_notMem MeasureTheory.volume, hslices] with q hqbad hq
  refine ⟨hqbad, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hq] with y hy
  have heq : (q : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I =
      Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm (q, y) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  rw [heq]
  exact hy

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.openSegment_eq_horizontal
statement:
private theorem openSegment_eq_horizontal
    (v w : Tiling.Plane) (h : v.im = w.im) :
    openSegment ℝ v w =
      (fun x : ℝ ↦ (x : ℂ) + (v.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
        openSegment ℝ v.re w.re
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩
    refine ⟨z.re, ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hz]
      simp
    · rw [← hz]
      have hweighted (r : ℝ) : a * r + b * r = r := by
        rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [h, hweighted]
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, ?_⟩
    have hweighted (r : ℝ) : a * r + b * r = r := by
      rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
    apply Complex.ext
    · simpa using hx
    · simp [h, hweighted]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.horizontalSide_sliceEndpoint
statement:
private theorem horizontalSide_sliceEndpoint
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (v w : K.vertices) (s : T) {q : ℝ}
    (hvw : v.1 ≠ w.1) (hhorizontal : v.1.im = w.1.im)
    (hedge : openSegment ℝ (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane))
      (w.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)) ⊆
        frontier ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support) \
          ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.vertices))
    (hq : q ∈ translatedHorizontalInterval v.1 w.1 s)
    (hcover : ∀ᵐ y : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
      ∃ t : T, (q : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
        (t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) :
    (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).im ∈
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.sliceEndpointSet
        K T Axis.vertical q
proof:
:= by
  let y : ℝ := (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).im
  let p : Tiling.Plane := (q : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hrene : v.1.re ≠ w.1.re := by
    intro hre
    apply hvw
    exact Complex.ext hre hhorizontal
  have hpseg : p ∈ openSegment ℝ (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane))
      (w.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)) := by
    rw [openSegment_eq_horizontal _ _ (by simp [hhorizontal])]
    refine ⟨q, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo' (by simpa using hrene)]
      simpa [translatedHorizontalInterval, Complex.add_re,
        min_add_add_right, max_add_add_right] using hq
    · apply Complex.ext <;> simp [p, y]
  have hpfront := (hedge hpseg).1
  have hpSupport : p ∈ (s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support := by
    have hclosed := K.isPolygonal.isClosed.vadd (s : Tiling.Plane)
    rw [← hclosed.closure_eq]
    exact frontier_subset_closure hpfront
  have hpclosure : p ∈ closure ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) := by
    rw [closure_vadd, show closure K.openCarrier = K.support by
      exact K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]
    exact hpSupport
  have hpnot : p ∉ openUnion K T := by
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
    rintro ⟨t, hpt⟩
    by_cases hts : t = s
    · subst t
      apply hpfront.2
      rw [interior_vadd]
      exact hpt
    · have hcent : (t : Tiling.Plane) ≠ (s : Tiling.Plane) := by
        intro h
        exact hts (Subtype.ext h)
      have hdisj : Disjoint
          ((t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
          ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) :=
        (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K T).mp hTile.2.1
          t.2 s.2 hcent
      have hmeet := mem_closure_iff.mp hpclosure
        ((t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
        (isOpen_interior.vadd _) hpt
      rw [Set.disjoint_left] at hdisj
      obtain ⟨z, hzt, hzs⟩ := hmeet
      exact hdisj hzt hzs
  let U : Set ℝ := {r : ℝ |
    (q : ℂ) + (r : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ openUnion K T}
  have hUae : ∀ᵐ r : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume, r ∈ U := by
    filter_upwards [hcover] with r hr
    change (q : ℂ) + (r : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ openUnion K T
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact hr
  have hUdense : Dense U :=
    (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ).dense_of_ae hUae
  have hynotU : y ∉ U := by
    intro hyU
    exact hpnot hyU
  change y ∈ frontier U
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hUdense.closure_eq]
    exact Set.mem_univ y
  · intro hyint
    exact hynotU (interior_subset hyint)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalCrossSection_chain
statement:
private theorem verticalCrossSection_chain
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (v v' w w' : K.vertices) (s t : T)
    (hvv' : v.1 ≠ v'.1) (hww' : w.1 ≠ w'.1)
    (hvHorizontal : v.1.im = v'.1.im)
    (hwHorizontal : w.1.im = w'.1.im)
    (hvEdge : openSegment ℝ (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane))
      (v'.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)) ⊆
        frontier ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support) \
          ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.vertices))
    (hwEdge : openSegment ℝ (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane))
      (w'.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)) ⊆
        frontier ((t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support) \
          ((t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.vertices))
    (hOverlap :
      max (min v.1.re v'.1.re + (s : Tiling.Plane).re)
          (min w.1.re w'.1.re + (t : Tiling.Plane).re) <
        min (max v.1.re v'.1.re + (s : Tiling.Plane).re)
          (max w.1.re w'.1.re + (t : Tiling.Plane).re))
    (hOrder : (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).im <
      (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).im) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : Fin n → K.vertices,
      IsVerticalGapChain K (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).im
        (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).im n a b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hchainEvent :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.FilledSliceChains.genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints
      K T hTile Axis.vertical
  obtain ⟨q, hqI, hqgood, hchain⟩ := exists_mem_Ioo_of_ae hOverlap
    ((eventually_goodVerticalSlice hTile).and hchainEvent)
  have hqv : q ∈ translatedHorizontalInterval v.1 v'.1 s := by
    exact ⟨(le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hqI.1,
      hqI.2.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)⟩
  have hqw : q ∈ translatedHorizontalInterval w.1 w'.1 t := by
    exact ⟨(le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hqI.1,
      hqI.2.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)⟩
  have hbottom := horizontalSide_sliceEndpoint hTile v v' s hvv'
    hvHorizontal hvEdge hqv hqgood.2
  have htop := horizontalSide_sliceEndpoint hTile w w' t hww'
    hwHorizontal hwEdge hqw hqgood.2
  obtain ⟨n, hn, x, owner, hx0, hxlast, hfilled⟩ :=
    hchain _ hbottom _ htop hOrder
  have hpiece : ∀ i : Fin n, ∃ a b : K.vertices,
      x i.castSucc = (a.1 + (owner i : Tiling.Plane)).im ∧
      x i.succ = (b.1 + (owner i : Tiling.Plane)).im ∧
      a.1.im < b.1.im := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hxa, hxb, hpos, _hinside⟩ := hfilled.2 i
    refine ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩, hxa, hxb, ?_⟩
    simpa [Axis.coord, Complex.sub_im] using hpos
  let a : Fin n → K.vertices := fun i ↦ (hpiece i).choose
  let b : Fin n → K.vertices := fun i ↦ (hpiece i).choose_spec.choose
  have hab (i : Fin n) :
      x i.castSucc = ((a i).1 + (owner i : Tiling.Plane)).im ∧
      x i.succ = ((b i).1 + (owner i : Tiling.Plane)).im ∧
      (a i).1.im < (b i).1.im :=
    (hpiece i).choose_spec.choose_spec
  refine ⟨n, a, b, hn, fun i ↦ (hab i).2.2, ?_⟩
  rw [← hx0, ← hxlast, ← sum_fin_succ_sub_castSucc]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _hi
  rw [(hab i).1, (hab i).2.1]
  simp only [Complex.add_im]
  ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.goodApproximation_preservesVerticalGapChain
statement:
private theorem goodApproximation_preservesVerticalGapChain
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (D : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.CoordinateDeformation C phi)
    {bottom top : ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    {a b : Fin n → C.region.vertices}
    (hchain : IsVerticalGapChain C.region bottom top n a b) :
    0 < ∑ i : Fin n,
      ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
          (C.vertexPoint (b i).1 (b i).2)).im -
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
          (C.vertexPoint (a i).1 (a i).2)).im)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ i : Fin n, 0 <
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
          (C.vertexPoint (b i).1 (b i).2)).im -
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
          (C.vertexPoint (a i).1 (a i).2)).im := by
    intro i
    have hsource : 0 < (b i).1.im - (a i).1.im :=
      sub_pos.mpr (hchain.2.1 i)
    have hs := D.source_good.preservesVertexCoordinateSign Axis.vertical
      (b i).1 (a i).1 (b i).2 (a i).2
    simp only [Axis.coord, Complex.sub_im] at hs
    have hsMapped : Real.sign
        ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
            (C.vertexPoint (b i).1 (b i).2)).im -
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
            (C.vertexPoint (a i).1 (a i).2)).im) = 1 := by
      rw [hs, Real.sign_of_pos hsource]
    by_contra hnot
    have hnonpos :
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
            (C.vertexPoint (b i).1 (b i).2)).im -
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
            (C.vertexPoint (a i).1 (a i).2)).im ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt hnot
    rcases hnonpos.eq_or_lt with hzero | hneg
    · rw [hzero, Real.sign_zero] at hsMapped
      norm_num at hsMapped
    · rw [Real.sign_of_neg hneg] at hsMapped
      norm_num at hsMapped
  let _ : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, hchain.1⟩⟩
  exact Finset.sum_pos (fun i _hi ↦ hterm i) Finset.univ_nonempty

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.mappedVerticalDifference_eq_gapSum
statement:
private theorem mappedVerticalDifference_eq_gapSum
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (D : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.CoordinateDeformation C phi)
    (P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.TwoStageDeformationSupportTransport
      C phi D)
    (v w : C.region.vertices) (s t : C.centres)
    {n : ℕ} {a b : Fin n → C.region.vertices}
    (hchain : IsVerticalGapChain C.region
      (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).im
      (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).im n a b) :
    (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
          (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) + P.fullCenters t).im -
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
          (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) + P.fullCenters s).im =
    ∑ i : Fin n,
      ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
          (C.vertexPoint (b i).1 (b i).2)).im -
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
          (C.vertexPoint (a i).1 (a i).2)).im)
proof:
:= by
  have hlinear :
      (⟨w.1.im, C.vertex_im_mem w.1 w.2⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) +
          ⟨t.1.im, C.centre_im_mem t.1 t.2⟩ -
        (⟨v.1.im, C.vertex_im_mem v.1 v.2⟩ +
          ⟨s.1.im, C.centre_im_mem s.1 s.2⟩) =
      ∑ i : Fin n,
        ((⟨(b i).1.im, C.vertex_im_mem (b i).1 (b i).2⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) -
          ⟨(a i).1.im, C.vertex_im_mem (a i).1 (a i).2⟩) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change C.coordinateSpace.subtype
        ((⟨w.1.im, C.vertex_im_mem w.1 w.2⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) +
          ⟨t.1.im, C.centre_im_mem t.1 t.2⟩ -
          (⟨v.1.im, C.vertex_im_mem v.1 v.2⟩ +
            ⟨s.1.im, C.centre_im_mem s.1 s.2⟩)) =
      C.coordinateSpace.subtype
        (∑ i : Fin n,
          ((⟨(b i).1.im, C.vertex_im_mem (b i).1 (b i).2⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) -
            ⟨(a i).1.im, C.vertex_im_mem (a i).1 (a i).2⟩))
    rw [map_sub, map_add, map_add, map_sum]
    simp only [Submodule.subtype_apply, Submodule.coe_sub]
    simpa only [Complex.add_im] using hchain.2.2
  have hmap := congrArg phi hlinear
  have hmapReal := congrArg (fun q : ℚ ↦ (q : ℝ)) hmap
  rw [P.fullCenters_apply t, P.fullCenters_apply s]
  simpa only [map_sub, map_add, map_sum, Rat.cast_sub, Rat.cast_add,
    Rat.cast_sum, Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint,
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar, Complex.add_im,
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext.vertexPoint,
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext.centrePoint,
    Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_re,
    Complex.I_im, zero_mul, mul_one, zero_add, add_zero] using hmapReal

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.deformation_preservesHorizontalEdgeOrder
statement:
theorem deformation_preservesHorizontalEdgeOrder
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (D : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.CoordinateDeformation C phi)
    (P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.TwoStageDeformationSupportTransport
      C phi D)
    (v v' w w' : C.region.vertices) (s t : C.centres)
    (hvv' : v.1 ≠ v'.1) (hww' : w.1 ≠ w'.1)
    (hvHorizontal : v.1.im = v'.1.im)
    (hwHorizontal : w.1.im = w'.1.im)
    (hvEdge : openSegment ℝ (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane))
      (v'.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)) ⊆
        frontier ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ C.region.support) \
          ((s : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ C.region.vertices))
    (hwEdge : openSegment ℝ (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane))
      (w'.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)) ⊆
        frontier ((t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ C.region.support) \
          ((t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ C.region.vertices))
    (hOverlap :
      max (min v.1.re v'.1.re + (s : Tiling.Plane).re)
          (min w.1.re w'.1.re + (t : Tiling.Plane).re) <
        min (max v.1.re v'.1.re + (s : Tiling.Plane).re)
          (max w.1.re w'.1.re + (t : Tiling.Plane).re)) :
    Real.sign ((w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).im -
      (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).im) =
    Real.sign
      ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
          (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) + P.fullCenters t).im -
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
          (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) + P.fullCenters s).im)
proof:
:= by
  let sourceDifference : ℝ :=
    (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).im - (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).im
  let mappedDifference : ℝ :=
    (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
        (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) + P.fullCenters t).im -
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
        (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) + P.fullCenters s).im
  change Real.sign sourceDifference = Real.sign mappedDifference
  rcases lt_trichotomy sourceDifference 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
  · have hOrder : (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).im <
        (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).im := by
      change (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).im -
        (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).im < 0 at hneg
      exact sub_neg.mp hneg
    have hOverlap' :
        max (min w.1.re w'.1.re + (t : Tiling.Plane).re)
            (min v.1.re v'.1.re + (s : Tiling.Plane).re) <
          min (max w.1.re w'.1.re + (t : Tiling.Plane).re)
            (max v.1.re v'.1.re + (s : Tiling.Plane).re) := by
      simpa only [max_comm, min_comm] using hOverlap
    obtain ⟨n, a, b, hchain⟩ := verticalCrossSection_chain
      P.source_tilesOn w w' v v' t s hww' hvv' hwHorizontal hvHorizontal
        hwEdge hvEdge hOverlap' hOrder
    have hsumpos := goodApproximation_preservesVerticalGapChain C phi D hchain
    have heq := mappedVerticalDifference_eq_gapSum C phi D P w v t s hchain
    have hmappedneg : mappedDifference < 0 := by
      have hreverse : 0 <
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) + P.fullCenters s).im -
            (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) + P.fullCenters t).im := by
        rw [heq]
        exact hsumpos
      change
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
            (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) + P.fullCenters t).im -
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
            (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) + P.fullCenters s).im < 0
      exact sub_neg.mpr (sub_pos.mp hreverse)
    rw [Real.sign_of_neg hneg, Real.sign_of_neg hmappedneg]
  · have hcoord :
        (⟨w.1.im, C.vertex_im_mem w.1 w.2⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) +
            ⟨t.1.im, C.centre_im_mem t.1 t.2⟩ =
          ⟨v.1.im, C.vertex_im_mem v.1 v.2⟩ +
            ⟨s.1.im, C.centre_im_mem s.1 s.2⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (w.1.im + t.1.im) - (v.1.im + s.1.im) = 0 at hzero
      change w.1.im + t.1.im = v.1.im + s.1.im
      linarith
    have hmapcoord := congrArg phi hcoord
    have hmapcoordReal := congrArg (fun q : ℚ ↦ (q : ℝ)) hmapcoord
    simp only [map_add, Rat.cast_add] at hmapcoordReal
    have hmappedzero : mappedDifference = 0 := by
      dsimp [mappedDifference]
      rw [P.fullCenters_apply t, P.fullCenters_apply s]
      simp only [Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint,
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext.vertexPoint,
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext.centrePoint,
        Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
        Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_mul, mul_one, zero_add, add_zero]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hmapcoordReal
    rw [hzero, hmappedzero, Real.sign_zero]
  · have hOrder : (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).im <
        (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).im := by
      change 0 < (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).im -
        (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).im at hpos
      exact sub_pos.mp hpos
    obtain ⟨n, a, b, hchain⟩ := verticalCrossSection_chain
      P.source_tilesOn v v' w w' s t hvv' hww' hvHorizontal hwHorizontal
        hvEdge hwEdge hOverlap hOrder
    have hsumpos := goodApproximation_preservesVerticalGapChain C phi D hchain
    have heq := mappedVerticalDifference_eq_gapSum C phi D P v w s t hchain
    have hmappedpos : 0 < mappedDifference := by
      change 0 <
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
            (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) + P.fullCenters t).im -
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
            (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) + P.fullCenters s).im
      rw [heq]
      exact hsumpos
    rw [Real.sign_of_pos hpos, Real.sign_of_pos hmappedpos]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.re_eq_of_mem_openSegment_vertical
statement:
private theorem re_eq_of_mem_openSegment_vertical
    {a b p : Tiling.Plane} (hab : a.re = b.re)
    (hp : p ∈ openSegment ℝ a b) : p.re = a.re
proof:
:= by
  rw [openSegment_eq_image] at hp
  obtain ⟨r, _hr, rfl⟩ := hp
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hab]
  ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.mem_openSegment_sub_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_openSegment_sub_iff
    {a b t z : Tiling.Plane} :
    z ∈ openSegment ℝ (a - t) (b - t) ↔ z + t ∈ openSegment ℝ a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [show a = t +ᵥ (a - t) by simp [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg],
    show b = t +ᵥ (b - t) by simp [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg],
    ← vadd_openSegment ℝ]
  simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · simpa [add_assoc] using h
  · simpa [add_assoc] using h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.lt_iff_of_sign_sub_eq
proof:
:= by
  have forward {x y X Y : ℝ}
      (hsign : Real.sign (y - x) = Real.sign (Y - X))
      (hxy : x < y) : X < Y := by
    have hsource : Real.sign (y - x) = 1 :=
      Real.sign_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hxy)
    have htarget : Real.sign (Y - X) = 1 := hsign.symm.trans hsource
    by_contra hnot
    have hle : Y - X ≤ 0 := sub_nonpos.mpr (le_of_not_gt hnot)
    rcases hle.eq_or_lt with hzero | hneg
    · rw [hzero, Real.sign_zero] at htarget
      norm_num at htarget
    · rw [Real.sign_of_neg hneg] at htarget
      norm_num at htarget
  exact ⟨forward h, forward h.symm⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.horizontalIntervalOverlap_transport
statement:
private theorem horizontalIntervalOverlap_transport
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (P₁ : C.centres → Tiling.Plane)
    (hP₁ : ∀ s : C.centres,
      P₁ s = Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
        (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2))
    (hHorizontalSign :
      ∀ v w : C.region.vertices, ∀ s t : C.centres,
        Real.sign ((w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re -
          (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re) =
        Real.sign
          ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
                (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) +
              Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
                (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)).re -
            (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
                (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) +
              Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
                (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2)).re))
    (v v' w w' : C.region.vertices) (s t : C.centres) :
