  · rintro ⟨u, hu, hut⟩
    have hut' : (u : (positiveSimilarity s c '' T)) = e t := Subtype.ext hut
    have hmap : e t ∈ (e.connectedComponentEquiv P).supp := hut' ▸ hu
    have ht : t ∈ P.supp := h.mpr hmap
    exact ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_centres_image
statement:
theorem verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_centres_image
    {K R : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} {s : ℝ} {r : Tiling.Plane}
    (hs : 0 < s) (hcarrier : R.openCarrier = positiveSimilarity s r '' K.openCarrier)
    (c : Tiling.Plane) (P : VerticalPlate K T) :
    (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P).centres =
      positiveSimilarity s c '' P.centres
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    rcases hz with ⟨u, hu, huz⟩
    let t : T := (positiveSimilarityCentreEquiv hs c).symm u
    have htarget : u.1 ∈
        (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P).centres :=
      ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    have htarg : (positiveSimilarity s c t.1) ∈
        (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P).centres := by
      have hut := (positiveSimilarityCentreEquiv hs c).apply_symm_apply u
      have hut' : (positiveSimilarityCentreEquiv hs c t : Tiling.Plane) = u :=
        congrArg Subtype.val hut
      change (positiveSimilarityCentreEquiv hs c t : Tiling.Plane) ∈
        (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P).centres
      rw [hut']
      exact htarget
    have hsource : t.1 ∈ P.centres :=
      (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_mem_centres hs hcarrier c P t).mpr
        htarg
    refine ⟨t.1, hsource, ?_⟩
    have hut := (positiveSimilarityCentreEquiv hs c).apply_symm_apply u
    have hut' : (positiveSimilarityCentreEquiv hs c t : Tiling.Plane) = u :=
      congrArg Subtype.val hut
    have hF : positiveSimilarity s c t.1 = u.1 := by
      simpa [positiveSimilarityCentreEquiv_apply] using hut'
    exact hF.trans huz
  · rintro ⟨z₀, hz₀, rfl⟩
    rcases hz₀ with ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    have hP : t.1 ∈ P.centres := ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    exact (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_mem_centres
      hs hcarrier c P t).mp hP

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_support_image
statement:
theorem verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_support_image
    {K R : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} {s : ℝ} {r : Tiling.Plane}
    (hs : 0 < s) (hcarrier : R.openCarrier = positiveSimilarity s r '' K.openCarrier)
    (c : Tiling.Plane) (P : VerticalPlate K T) :
    (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P).support =
      positiveSimilarity s (r + c) '' P.support
proof:
:= by
  change regularSupport R
      (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P).centres =
    positiveSimilarity s (r + c) '' regularSupport K P.centres
  rw [verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_centres_image]
  exact positiveSimilarity_regularSupport_image hs hcarrier

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_base_affine_real_image
statement:
theorem verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_base_affine_real_image
    {K R : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} {s : ℝ} {r : Tiling.Plane}
    (hs : 0 < s) (hcarrier : R.openCarrier = positiveSimilarity s r '' K.openCarrier)
    (c : Tiling.Plane) (P : VerticalPlate K T) :
    (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P).base =
      (fun x : ℝ => s * x + (r + c).re) '' P.base
proof:
:= by
  change Complex.re ''
      (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P).support =
    (fun x : ℝ => s * x + (r + c).re) '' (Complex.re '' P.support)
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, hwy⟩
    have hw' : w ∈ positiveSimilarity s (r + c) '' P.support := by
      rw [← verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_support_image hs hcarrier c P]
      exact hw
    rcases hw' with ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨z.re, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa [positiveSimilarity] using hwy
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩, hy⟩
    have hFz : positiveSimilarity s (r + c) z ∈
        (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P).support := by
      rw [verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_support_image hs hcarrier c P]
      exact ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨positiveSimilarity s (r + c) z, hFz, ?_⟩
    simpa [positiveSimilarity, hzx] using hy

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_isVerticalColumn
statement:
theorem verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_isVerticalColumn
    {K R : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} {s : ℝ} {r : Tiling.Plane}
    (hs : 0 < s) (hcarrier : R.openCarrier = positiveSimilarity s r '' K.openCarrier)
    (c : Tiling.Plane) (P : VerticalPlate K T) :
    IsVerticalColumn P ↔
      IsVerticalColumn (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P)
proof:
:= by
  change (∃ x : ℝ, P.centres ⊆ {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = x}) ↔
    (∃ y : ℝ,
      (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P).centres ⊆
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = y})
  have hreal (z : Tiling.Plane) :
      (positiveSimilarity s c z).re = s * z.re + c.re := by
    simp [positiveSimilarity]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    refine ⟨s * x + c.re, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    rw [verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_centres_image hs hcarrier c P] at hz
    rcases hz with ⟨z₀, hz₀, hzz⟩
    rw [← hzz]
    change (positiveSimilarity s c z₀).re = s * x + c.re
    rw [hreal, hx hz₀]
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    refine ⟨(y - c.re) / s, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    rcases hz with ⟨t, ht, hzt⟩
    have hz' : positiveSimilarity s c t.1 ∈
        (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P).centres :=
      (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_mem_centres
        hs hcarrier c P t).mp ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    have hcoord := hy hz'
    change (positiveSimilarity s c t.1).re = y at hcoord
    rw [hreal] at hcoord
    rw [← hzt]
    change t.1.re = (y - c.re) / s
    apply (eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hs)).2
    nlinarith [hcoord]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalColumnCentres_positiveSimilarity_image
statement:
theorem verticalColumnCentres_positiveSimilarity_image
    {K R : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} {s : ℝ} {r : Tiling.Plane}
    (hs : 0 < s) (hcarrier : R.openCarrier = positiveSimilarity s r '' K.openCarrier)
    (c : Tiling.Plane) :
    verticalColumnCentres R (positiveSimilarity s c '' T) =
      positiveSimilarity s c '' verticalColumnCentres K T
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    change z ∈ ⋃ Q : {Q : VerticalPlate R (positiveSimilarity s c '' T) //
      IsVerticalColumn Q}, Q.1.centres at hz
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz with ⟨Q, hzQ⟩
    rcases hzQ with ⟨u, hu, huz⟩
    let e : verticalPlateGraph K T ≃g
        verticalPlateGraph R (positiveSimilarity s c '' T) :=
      verticalPlateGraph_positiveSimilarityIso hs hcarrier c
    let pe := e.connectedComponentEquiv
    let P : VerticalPlate K T := pe.symm Q.1
    let t : T := (positiveSimilarityCentreEquiv hs c).symm u
    have hQmem : u.1 ∈ Q.1.centres := ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    have hPcol : IsVerticalColumn P := by
      have hEq : pe P = Q.1 := pe.apply_symm_apply Q.1
      exact (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_isVerticalColumn
        hs hcarrier c P).mpr (hEq ▸ Q.2)
    have hPmem : t.1 ∈ P.centres :=
      (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_mem_centres
        hs hcarrier c P t).mpr (by
          have hut := (positiveSimilarityCentreEquiv hs c).apply_symm_apply u
          have hut' : (positiveSimilarityCentreEquiv hs c t : Tiling.Plane) = u :=
            congrArg Subtype.val hut
          have hEq : verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P = Q.1 := by
            exact pe.apply_symm_apply Q.1
          change (positiveSimilarityCentreEquiv hs c t : Tiling.Plane) ∈
            (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P).centres
          rw [hEq]
          rw [hut']
          exact hQmem)
    refine ⟨t.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change t.1 ∈ ⋃ P : {P : VerticalPlate K T // IsVerticalColumn P}, P.1.centres
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨⟨P, hPcol⟩, hPmem⟩
    · have hut := (positiveSimilarityCentreEquiv hs c).apply_symm_apply u
      have hut' : (positiveSimilarityCentreEquiv hs c t : Tiling.Plane) = u :=
        congrArg Subtype.val hut
      have hF : positiveSimilarity s c t.1 = u.1 := by
        simpa [positiveSimilarityCentreEquiv_apply] using hut'
      exact hF.trans huz
  · intro hz
    change z ∈ positiveSimilarity s c '' verticalColumnCentres K T at hz
    rcases hz with ⟨z₀, hz₀, hzEq⟩
    change z₀ ∈ ⋃ P : {P : VerticalPlate K T // IsVerticalColumn P}, P.1.centres at hz₀
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz₀ with ⟨P, htP⟩
    rcases htP with ⟨t, ht, hzt⟩
    have hQcol : IsVerticalColumn
        (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P.1) :=
      (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_isVerticalColumn
        hs hcarrier c P.1).mp P.2
    have htQ : positiveSimilarity s c t.1 ∈
        (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P.1).centres :=
      (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_mem_centres hs hcarrier c P.1 t).mp
        ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    have hzfinal : z = positiveSimilarity s c t.1 := by
      calc
        z = positiveSimilarity s c z₀ := hzEq.symm
        _ = positiveSimilarity s c t.1 := by rw [hzt]
    rw [hzfinal]
    change positiveSimilarity s c t.1 ∈
      ⋃ Q : {Q : VerticalPlate R (positiveSimilarity s c '' T) //
        IsVerticalColumn Q}, Q.1.centres
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨⟨verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv hs hcarrier c P.1, hQcol⟩, htQ⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalColumnSupport_positiveSimilarity_image
statement:
theorem verticalColumnSupport_positiveSimilarity_image
    {K R : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} {s : ℝ} {r : Tiling.Plane}
    (hs : 0 < s) (hcarrier : R.openCarrier = positiveSimilarity s r '' K.openCarrier)
    (c : Tiling.Plane) :
    regularSupport R (verticalColumnCentres R (positiveSimilarity s c '' T)) =
      positiveSimilarity s (r + c) '' regularSupport K (verticalColumnCentres K T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [verticalColumnCentres_positiveSimilarity_image hs hcarrier c]
  exact positiveSimilarity_regularSupport_image hs hcarrier

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.exists_coordinateSwapTiling
statement:
theorem exists_coordinateSwapTiling
    {K : Region} (T : TilingSpace K Set.univ) :
    ∃ Tσ : TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ,
      (Tσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
        coordinateSwap '' (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
proof:
:= by
  let c : TopologicalSpace.Closeds Tiling.Plane :=
    ⟨coordinateSwap '' (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane),
      coordinateSwap.toHomeomorph.isClosed_image.mpr T.centres.isClosed⟩
  have htiles :
      TilesOn K.coordinateSwap
        (coordinateSwap '' (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) Set.univ := by
    simpa only [Set.image_univ_of_surjective coordinateSwap.surjective] using
      (tilesOn_coordinateSwap (K := K) (S := (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
        (D := Set.univ) T.tilesOn)
  refine ⟨{ centres := c, tilesOn := htiles }, ?_⟩
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.coordinateSwapTiling_unique
statement:
private theorem coordinateSwapTiling_unique
    {K : Region} {T : TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    {Tσ Uσ : TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ} :
    IsCoordinateSwapTiling T Tσ → IsCoordinateSwapTiling T Uσ → Tσ = Uσ
proof:
:= by
  intro hTσ hUσ
  cases Tσ with
  | mk cσ hσ =>
    cases Uσ with
    | mk cυ hυ =>
      congr 1
      apply TopologicalSpace.Closeds.ext
      exact hTσ.trans hUσ.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.coordinateSwap_fellCompactification
statement:
private theorem coordinateSwap_fellCompactification
    {S : Set Tiling.Plane} (hS : IsClosed S) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification
        (coordinateSwap '' S)
        (coordinateSwap.toHomeomorph.isClosed_image.mpr hS) =
      TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.map
        coordinateSwap.toHomeomorph.onePointCongr
        coordinateSwap.toHomeomorph.onePointCongr.continuous
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification S hS)
proof:
:= by
  apply TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.ext
  change
    ((fun x : Tiling.Plane ↦ (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) ''
          (coordinateSwap '' S) ∪ {OnePoint.infty}) =
      (coordinateSwap.toHomeomorph.onePointCongr ''
        (((fun x : Tiling.Plane ↦ (x : OnePoint Tiling.Plane)) '' S) ∪
          {OnePoint.infty}))
  ext z
  induction z using OnePoint.rec with
  | infty => simp
  | coe x =>
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
        OnePoint.coe_ne_infty, or_false, Homeomorph.onePointCongr]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, hyx⟩
        refine ⟨(t : OnePoint Tiling.Plane), Or.inl ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        exact hyx
      · rintro ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩
        rcases hz with ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ | rfl
        · exact ⟨coordinateSwap t, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, hzx⟩
        · simp at hzx

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.coordinateSwapTilingMap_continuous
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_seqContinuous]
  intro U V hUV
  apply (locallyFell_metrizable K.coordinateSwap Set.univ).2
      (coordinateSwapTilingMap ∘ U) (coordinateSwapTilingMap V) |>.mpr
  obtain ⟨hUclosed, hVclosed, hFell⟩ :=
    (locallyFell_metrizable K Set.univ).2 U V |>.mp hUV
  let mapCompact := TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.map
    coordinateSwap.toHomeomorph.onePointCongr
    coordinateSwap.toHomeomorph.onePointCongr.continuous
  have hmap : Continuous mapCompact :=
    coordinateSwap.toHomeomorph.onePointCongr.continuous.nonemptyCompacts_map
  have hmapped := (hmap.tendsto
    (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification
      (V.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) hVclosed)).comp hFell
  refine ⟨fun n ↦ (coordinateSwapTilingMap (U n)).centres.isClosed,
    (coordinateSwapTilingMap V).centres.isClosed, ?_⟩
  convert hmapped using 1
  · funext n
    apply coordinateSwap_fellCompactification
  · congr 1
    apply coordinateSwap_fellCompactification

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.coordinateSwapTilingMap_translate
statement:
private theorem coordinateSwapTilingMap_translate
    {K : Region} (g : aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane))
    (T : TilingSpace K Set.univ) :
    coordinateSwapTilingMap (TilingSpace.translate g T) =
      TilingSpace.translate
        (⟨coordinateSwap g, by simp [aePeriodGroup, Tiling.Polygonal.aePeriodGroup]⟩ :
          aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane))
        (coordinateSwapTilingMap T)
proof:
:= by
  unfold coordinateSwapTilingMap TilingSpace.translate
  congr 1
  apply TopologicalSpace.Closeds.ext
  ext z
  change z ∈ coordinateSwap ''
      ((fun x : Tiling.Plane => x + (g : Tiling.Plane)) ''
        (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) ↔
    z ∈ (fun x : Tiling.Plane => x + coordinateSwap (g : Tiling.Plane)) ''
      (coordinateSwap '' (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨coordinateSwap x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, coordinateSwap.map_add x g⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rcases hx with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y + (g : Tiling.Plane), ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩,
      coordinateSwap.map_add y g⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.coordinateSwap_mem_orbitHull
statement:
private theorem coordinateSwap_mem_orbitHull
    {K : Region} {T S : TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    (hS : S ∈ orbitHull T) :
    coordinateSwapTilingMap S ∈
      orbitHull (coordinateSwapTilingMap T)
proof:
:= by
  let F : TilingSpace K Set.univ → TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ :=
    coordinateSwapTilingMap
  let H : Set (TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ) :=
    orbitHull (coordinateSwapTilingMap T)
  have hclosed : IsClosed (F ⁻¹' H) :=
    isClosed_closure.preimage coordinateSwapTilingMap_continuous
  have horbit : AddAction.orbit (aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane)) T ⊆
      F ⁻¹' H := by
    rintro V ⟨g, rfl⟩
    change coordinateSwapTilingMap (TilingSpace.translate g T) ∈ H
    rw [coordinateSwapTilingMap_translate]
    exact subset_closure (AddAction.mem_orbit (coordinateSwapTilingMap T)
      (⟨coordinateSwap g, by simp [aePeriodGroup, Tiling.Polygonal.aePeriodGroup]⟩ :
        aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane)))
  change F S ∈ H
  exact (closure_minimal horbit hclosed) hS

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.tilingSpace_eq_of_centres_eq
statement:
private theorem tilingSpace_eq_of_centres_eq
    {K : Region} {A B : TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    (h : (A.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) = (B.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) :
    A = B
proof:
:= by
  cases A with
  | mk ca ha =>
    cases B with
    | mk cb hb =>
      congr 1
      exact TopologicalSpace.Closeds.ext h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.coordinateSwapBackMap_continuous
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_seqContinuous]
  intro U V hUV
  apply (locallyFell_metrizable K Set.univ).2
      (coordinateSwapBackMap ∘ U) (coordinateSwapBackMap V) |>.mpr
  obtain ⟨hUclosed, hVclosed, hFell⟩ :=
    (locallyFell_metrizable K.coordinateSwap Set.univ).2 U V |>.mp hUV
  let mapCompact := TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts.map
    coordinateSwap.toHomeomorph.onePointCongr
    coordinateSwap.toHomeomorph.onePointCongr.continuous
  have hmap : Continuous mapCompact :=
    coordinateSwap.toHomeomorph.onePointCongr.continuous.nonemptyCompacts_map
  have hmapped := (hmap.tendsto
    (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification
      (V.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) hVclosed)).comp hFell
  refine ⟨fun n ↦ (coordinateSwapBackMap (U n)).centres.isClosed,
    (coordinateSwapBackMap V).centres.isClosed, ?_⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.coordinateSwapTilingMap_back_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply tilingSpace_eq_of_centres_eq
  change coordinateSwap '' (coordinateSwap '' (Tσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) =
    (Tσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    simpa using hu
  · intro hz
    exact ⟨coordinateSwap z, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, coordinateSwap_apply_apply z⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.coordinateSwapBackMap_translate
statement:
private theorem coordinateSwapBackMap_translate
    {K : Region} (g : aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane))
    (Tσ : TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ) :
    coordinateSwapBackMap (TilingSpace.translate g Tσ) =
      TilingSpace.translate
        (⟨coordinateSwap g, by simp [aePeriodGroup, Tiling.Polygonal.aePeriodGroup]⟩ :

        (coordinateSwapBackMap Tσ)
proof:
:= by

  ext z

      ((fun x : Tiling.Plane => x + (g : Tiling.Plane)) ''
        (Tσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) ↔
    z ∈ (fun x : Tiling.Plane => x + coordinateSwap (g : Tiling.Plane)) ''
      (coordinateSwap '' (Tσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
  constructor

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.coordinateSwapBack_mem_orbitHull
statement:
private theorem coordinateSwapBack_mem_orbitHull
    {K : Region} {Tσ Sσ : TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ}
    (hSσ : Sσ ∈ orbitHull Tσ) :
    coordinateSwapBackMap Sσ ∈ orbitHull (coordinateSwapBackMap Tσ)
proof:
:= by
  let F : TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ → TilingSpace K Set.univ :=
    coordinateSwapBackMap
  let H : Set (TilingSpace K Set.univ) := orbitHull (coordinateSwapBackMap Tσ)
  have hclosed : IsClosed (F ⁻¹' H) :=
    isClosed_closure.preimage coordinateSwapBackMap_continuous
  have horbit : AddAction.orbit
      (aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane)) Tσ ⊆ F ⁻¹' H := by
    rintro V ⟨g, rfl⟩
    change coordinateSwapBackMap (TilingSpace.translate g Tσ) ∈ H
    rw [coordinateSwapBackMap_translate]
    exact subset_closure (AddAction.mem_orbit (coordinateSwapBackMap Tσ)
      (⟨coordinateSwap g, by simp [aePeriodGroup, Tiling.Polygonal.aePeriodGroup]⟩ :
        aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane)))
  change F Sσ ∈ H
  exact (closure_minimal horbit hclosed) hSσ

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.coordinateSwap_orbitHull_iff
proof:
:= by
  have hmapT : coordinateSwapTilingMap T = Tσ := by
    apply coordinateSwapTiling_unique (T := T)
    · rfl
    · exact hTσ
  have hmapS : coordinateSwapTilingMap S = Sσ := by
    apply coordinateSwapTiling_unique (T := S)
    · rfl
    · exact hSσ
  constructor
  · intro hS
    rw [← hmapS, ← hmapT]
    exact coordinateSwap_mem_orbitHull hS
  · intro hSσmem
    have hback := coordinateSwapBack_mem_orbitHull
      (K := K) (Tσ := Tσ) (Sσ := Sσ) hSσmem
    have hbackT : coordinateSwapBackMap Tσ = T := by
      apply tilingSpace_eq_of_centres_eq
      change coordinateSwap '' (Tσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
        (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
      rw [hTσ]
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨w, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        simpa using hu
      · intro hz
        exact ⟨coordinateSwap z, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, coordinateSwap_apply_apply z⟩
    have hbackS : coordinateSwapBackMap Sσ = S := by
      apply tilingSpace_eq_of_centres_eq
      change coordinateSwap '' (Sσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
        (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)
      rw [hSσ]
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨w, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        simpa using hu
      · intro hz
        exact ⟨coordinateSwap z, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, coordinateSwap_apply_apply z⟩
    rw [hbackS, hbackT] at hback
    exact hback

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.orbitHull_isTopologicallyMinimal_iff
statement:
private theorem orbitHull_isTopologicallyMinimal_iff
    {K : Region} {T : TilingSpace K Set.univ} :
    IsTopologicallyMinimal (orbitHull T) ↔
      ∀ S ∈ orbitHull T, orbitHull S = orbitHull T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h S hS
    exact h.2.2.2 S hS
  · intro h
    refine ⟨(orbitHull_compact T).2.1, isClosed_closure, (orbitHull_compact T).2.2, ?_⟩
    intro S hS
    exact h S hS

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.coordinateSwap_minimal_iff
statement:
theorem coordinateSwap_minimal_iff
    {K : Region} {T : TilingSpace K Set.univ}
    {Tσ : TilingSpace K.coordinateSwap Set.univ}
    (hTσ : (Tσ.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) =
      coordinateSwap '' (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) :
    (IsTopologicallyMinimal (orbitHull T) ↔
      IsTopologicallyMinimal (orbitHull Tσ))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hT
    rw [orbitHull_isTopologicallyMinimal_iff] at hT ⊢
    refine fun Sσ hSσ ↦ ?_
    have hSmap : (coordinateSwapTilingMap
        (coordinateSwapBackMap Sσ)).centres =
        coordinateSwap '' ((coordinateSwapBackMap Sσ).centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
      rfl
    have hS : coordinateSwapBackMap Sσ ∈ orbitHull T := by
      apply (coordinateSwap_orbitHull_iff hTσ hSmap).mpr
      rw [coordinateSwapTilingMap_back_eq]
      exact hSσ
    have hHullS := hT (coordinateSwapBackMap Sσ) hS
    apply Set.ext
    intro Uσ
    have hUmap : (coordinateSwapTilingMap
        (coordinateSwapBackMap Uσ)).centres =
        coordinateSwap '' ((coordinateSwapBackMap Uσ).centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
      rfl
    constructor
    · intro hUSσ
      have hUS : coordinateSwapBackMap Uσ ∈
          orbitHull (coordinateSwapBackMap Sσ) := by
        apply (coordinateSwap_orbitHull_iff hSmap hUmap).mpr
        rw [coordinateSwapTilingMap_back_eq, coordinateSwapTilingMap_back_eq]
        exact hUSσ
      have hUT : coordinateSwapBackMap Uσ ∈ orbitHull T := by
        rw [hHullS] at hUS
        exact hUS
      have h := (coordinateSwap_orbitHull_iff hTσ hUmap).mp hUT
      rw [coordinateSwapTilingMap_back_eq] at h
      exact h
    · intro hUTσ
      have hUT : coordinateSwapBackMap Uσ ∈ orbitHull T := by
        apply (coordinateSwap_orbitHull_iff hTσ hUmap).mpr
        rw [coordinateSwapTilingMap_back_eq]
        exact hUTσ
      have hUS : coordinateSwapBackMap Uσ ∈
          orbitHull (coordinateSwapBackMap Sσ) := by
        rw [hHullS]
        exact hUT
      have h := (coordinateSwap_orbitHull_iff hSmap hUmap).mp hUS
      rw [coordinateSwapTilingMap_back_eq, coordinateSwapTilingMap_back_eq] at h
      exact h
  · intro hTσmin
    rw [orbitHull_isTopologicallyMinimal_iff] at hTσmin ⊢
    refine fun S hS ↦ ?_
    have hSmap : (coordinateSwapTilingMap S).centres =
        coordinateSwap '' (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
      rfl
    have hSσ : coordinateSwapTilingMap S ∈ orbitHull Tσ := by
      apply (coordinateSwap_orbitHull_iff hTσ hSmap).mp
      exact hS
    have hHullSσ := hTσmin (coordinateSwapTilingMap S) hSσ
    apply Set.ext
    intro U
    have hUmap : (coordinateSwapTilingMap U).centres =
        coordinateSwap '' (U.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
      rfl
    constructor
    · intro hUS
      have hUSσ : coordinateSwapTilingMap U ∈
          orbitHull (coordinateSwapTilingMap S) := by
        apply (coordinateSwap_orbitHull_iff hSmap hUmap).mp
        exact hUS
      have hUTσ : coordinateSwapTilingMap U ∈ orbitHull Tσ := by
        rw [hHullSσ] at hUSσ
        exact hUSσ
      exact (coordinateSwap_orbitHull_iff hTσ hUmap).mpr hUTσ
    · intro hUT
      have hUTσ : coordinateSwapTilingMap U ∈ orbitHull Tσ := by
        apply (coordinateSwap_orbitHull_iff hTσ hUmap).mp
        exact hUT
      have hUSσ : coordinateSwapTilingMap U ∈
          orbitHull (coordinateSwapTilingMap S) := by
        rw [hHullSσ]
        exact hUTσ
      exact (coordinateSwap_orbitHull_iff hSmap hUmap).mpr hUSσ
