name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.horizontalTranslatedVertices_eq_projection_add_vertices
statement:
theorem horizontalTranslatedVertices_eq_projection_add_vertices
    (K : Region) (T : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    horizontalTranslatedVertices K T =
      horizontalCentreProjection T +
        ((K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re : Finset ℝ) : Set ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, t, ht, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨t.re, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, v.re, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      refine ⟨v, ?_, rfl⟩
      have : v ∈ (K.vertexFinset : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
        rw [K.coe_vertexFinset]
        exact hv
      exact this
    · simp only [Complex.add_re]
      ring
  · rintro ⟨d, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, f, hf, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hf
    have hv' : v ∈ K.vertices := by
      rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]
      exact hv
    exact ⟨v, hv', t, ht, by simp [add_comm]⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.horizontalBoundedDifferences_finite
statement:
theorem horizontalBoundedDifferences_finite
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hFHC : HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity T)
    (R : ℝ) :
    (horizontalBoundedDifferences
      (horizontalTranslatedVertices K T) R).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : Finset ℝ := K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re
  have htranslated : HasFLC (horizontalTranslatedVertices K T) := by
    rw [horizontalTranslatedVertices_eq_projection_add_vertices]
    exact hFHC.add_finset F
  let R' : ℝ := max R 0 + 1
  have hR' : 0 < R' := by
    dsimp [R']
    linarith [le_max_right R 0]
  apply (htranslated.2 R' hR').subset
  rintro d ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl, hba⟩
  refine ⟨⟨b, hb, a, ha, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.dist_eq]
  have hRR' : R ≤ R' := by
    dsimp [R']
    linarith [le_max_left R 0]
  simpa only [sub_zero] using hba.trans hRR'

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.approximation_uniformOnHorizontalAlphabet
statement:
theorem approximation_uniformOnHorizontalAlphabet
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (G : Finset ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ g ∈ G, g ∈ C.coordinateSpace)
    {eta : ℝ} (heta : 0 < eta) :
    ∃ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon ∧
      ∀ phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.IsEpsilonApproximation
        C epsilon phi →
      ∀ (g : ℝ) (hg : g ∈ G),
      |Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi
          ⟨g, hG g hg⟩ - g| < eta
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let lift : {g : ℝ // g ∈ G} → C.coordinateSpace :=
    fun g ↦ ⟨(g : ℝ), hG (g : ℝ) g.property⟩
  let Z : Finset C.coordinateSpace := G.attach.image lift
  obtain ⟨epsilon, hepsilon, hcontrol⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.approximation_uniformOn_finset
      C Z eta heta
  refine ⟨epsilon, hepsilon, ?_⟩
  intro phi hphi g hg
  apply hcontrol phi hphi ⟨g, hG g hg⟩
  let g' : {x // x ∈ G} := ⟨g, hg⟩
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr
    ⟨g', Finset.mem_attach G g', Subtype.ext rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.approximation_separatesHorizontalAlphabet
statement:
theorem approximation_separatesHorizontalAlphabet
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (G : Finset ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ g ∈ G, g ∈ C.coordinateSpace) :
    ∃ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon ∧
      ∀ phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.IsEpsilonApproximation
        C epsilon phi →
      ∀ (g : ℝ) (hg : g ∈ G),
      ∀ (g' : ℝ) (hg' : g' ∈ G),
      g ≠ g' →
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi
          ⟨g, hG g hg⟩ ≠
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi
          ⟨g', hG g' hg'⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Z : Finset C.coordinateSpace :=
    (G.attach.product G.attach).image fun p ↦
      ⟨(p.1 : ℝ) - (p.2 : ℝ),
        C.coordinateSpace.sub_mem
          (hG (p.1 : ℝ) p.1.property) (hG (p.2 : ℝ) p.2.property)⟩
  obtain ⟨epsilon, hepsilon, hsign⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.approximation_preservesSign_finset C Z
  refine ⟨epsilon, hepsilon, ?_⟩
  intro phi hphi g hg g' hg' hgg' hEq
  let z : C.coordinateSpace :=
    ⟨g - g', C.coordinateSpace.sub_mem (hG g hg) (hG g' hg')⟩
  have hz : z ∈ Z := by
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨(⟨g, hg⟩, ⟨g', hg'⟩), ?_, rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨by simp, by simp⟩
  have hs := hsign phi hphi z hz
  have hmapZero : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi z = 0 := by
    change ((phi z : ℚ) : ℝ) = 0
    have hsub : phi z =
        phi ⟨g, hG g hg⟩ - phi ⟨g', hG g' hg'⟩ := by
      rw [← map_sub]
      rfl
    rw [hsub, Rat.cast_sub, sub_eq_zero]
    exact hEq
  rw [hmapZero, Real.sign_zero] at hs
  have hzval : (z : ℝ) = 0 := Real.sign_eq_zero_iff.mp hs.symm
  exact hgg' (sub_eq_zero.mp hzval)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.boundedGapSubset_alphabet_finite
statement:
theorem boundedGapSubset_alphabet_finite
    {A B : Set ℝ}
    (hBA : B ⊆ A)
    (hboundedDiff : ∀ R : ℝ,
      (horizontalBoundedDifferences A R).Finite)
    (order : HorizontalOrderData B)
    {R₀ : ℝ} (_hR₀ : 0 < R₀)
    (hgap : ∀ i : ℤ,
      order.point (i + 1) - order.point i ≤ R₀) :
    (horizontalGapSet order).Finite
proof:
:= by
  apply (hboundedDiff R₀).subset
  rintro g ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have hi : i < i + 1 := by omega
  have hpos : 0 < order.point (i + 1) - order.point i :=
    sub_pos.mpr (order.point_strictMono hi)
  refine ⟨order.point i, ?_, order.point (i + 1), ?_, rfl, ?_⟩
  · apply hBA
    exact Eq.mp
      (congrArg (fun S : Set ℝ ↦ order.point i ∈ S) order.point_range)
      (Set.mem_range_self i)
  · apply hBA
    exact Eq.mp
      (congrArg (fun S : Set ℝ ↦ order.point (i + 1) ∈ S) order.point_range)
      (Set.mem_range_self (i + 1))
  · rw [abs_of_pos hpos]
    exact hgap i

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.horizontalTranslatedVertices_hasFLC
statement:
private theorem horizontalTranslatedVertices_hasFLC
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hFHC : HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity T) :
    HasFLC (horizontalTranslatedVertices K T)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : Finset ℝ := K.vertexFinset.image Complex.re
  rw [horizontalTranslatedVertices_eq_projection_add_vertices]
  exact hFHC.add_finset F

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.projectedCentres_relativelyDense
statement:
private theorem projectedCentres_relativelyDense
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ ∀ x : ℝ,
      ∃ d ∈ horizontalCentreProjection T, |d - x| < L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ :=
    K.isPolygonal.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : Tiling.Plane)
  let L : ℝ := max D 0 + 1
  refine ⟨L, by dsimp [L]; linarith [le_max_right D 0], fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  let z : Tiling.Plane := (x : ℂ)
  have hcover : ∀ᵐ q ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
      ∃ t : ↥T, q ∈ ((t.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) := by
    filter_upwards [hTile.2.2] with q hq
    exact hq.mp (Set.mem_univ q)
  have hex : ∃ q ∈ Metric.ball z 1,
      ∃ t : ↥T, q ∈ ((t.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) := by
    by_contra hn
    push Not at hn
    have hballnull : MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball z 1) = 0 := by
      apply MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null
        (t := {q | ¬ ∃ t : ↥T,
          q ∈ ((t.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)})
      · intro q hq
        change ¬ ∃ t : ↥T,
          q ∈ ((t.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
        rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
        exact hn q hq t ht
      · exact MeasureTheory.ae_iff.mp hcover
    exact (Metric.measure_ball_pos MeasureTheory.volume z zero_lt_one).ne'
      hballnull
  obtain ⟨q, hqball, t, hqt⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨t.1.re, ⟨t.1, t.2, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [mem_vadd_set] at hqt
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hkq⟩ := hqt
  have hkclosed : k ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Tiling.Plane) D :=
    hD (interior_subset hk)
  have hkbound : ‖k‖ ≤ max D 0 := by
    have : ‖k‖ ≤ D := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hkclosed
    exact this.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hqbound : ‖q - z‖ < 1 := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hqball
  have hreal : |t.1.re - x| ≤ ‖(t.1 : Tiling.Plane) - z‖ := by
    simpa [z] using
      Complex.abs_re_le_norm ((t.1 : Tiling.Plane) - z)
  calc
    |t.1.re - x| ≤ ‖(t.1 : Tiling.Plane) - z‖ := hreal
    _ = ‖q - k - z‖ := by rw [← hkq]; simp
    _ ≤ ‖k‖ + ‖q - z‖ := by
      rw [show q - k - z = (q - z) - k by abel, norm_sub_rev]
      exact norm_sub_le _ _
    _ < max D 0 + 1 := add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt hkbound hqbound
    _ = L := rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.region_vertices_nonempty
statement:
private theorem region_vertices_nonempty (K : Region) :
    K.vertices.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, _w, _hw, _hmax, _hdiam⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.exists_intrinsicDiameterPair K
  exact ⟨v, hv⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.horizontalTranslatedVertices_relativelyDense
statement:
private theorem horizontalTranslatedVertices_relativelyDense
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ ∀ x : ℝ,
      ∃ a ∈ horizontalTranslatedVertices K T, |a - x| < L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := region_vertices_nonempty K
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hdense⟩ := projectedCentres_relativelyDense hTile
  refine ⟨L, hL, fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨d, ⟨t, ht, htd⟩, hd⟩ := hdense (x - v.re)
  refine ⟨(v + t).re, ⟨v, hv, t, ht, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [← htd] at hd
  rw [Complex.add_re]
  have heq : v.re + t.re - x = t.re - (x - v.re) := by ring
  rw [heq]
  exact hd

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.horizontalTranslatedVertices_delone
statement:
theorem horizontalTranslatedVertices_delone
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (hFHC : HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity T) :
    (∃ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta ∧
      ∀ x ∈ horizontalTranslatedVertices K T,
      ∀ y ∈ horizontalTranslatedVertices K T,
        x ≠ y → delta ≤ |x - y|) ∧
    (∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ a ∈ horizontalTranslatedVertices K T,
        |a - x| < L)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, horizontalTranslatedVertices_relativelyDense hTile⟩
  obtain ⟨delta, hdelta, hseparated⟩ :=
    (horizontalTranslatedVertices_hasFLC hFHC).uniformlyDiscrete
  refine ⟨delta, hdelta, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hseparated x hx y hy hxy

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.locallyFinite_twoSided_integerEnumeration
statement:
private theorem locallyFinite_twoSided_integerEnumeration
    {A : Set ℝ}
    (hLocal : ∀ a b : ℝ, (A ∩ Set.Icc a b).Finite)
    (hAbove : ¬ BddAbove A) (hBelow : ¬ BddBelow A) :
    ∃ point : ℤ → ℝ, StrictMono point ∧ Set.range point = A
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Nonempty A := (nonempty_of_not_bddAbove hAbove).to_subtype
  let _ : LocallyFiniteOrder A := LocallyFiniteOrder.ofFiniteIcc fun a b ↦ by
    have hFinite := hLocal a.1 b.1
    apply (Set.Finite.preimage Subtype.val_injective.injOn hFinite).subset
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨x.2, hx⟩
  let _ : SuccOrder A := LinearLocallyFiniteOrder.succOrder A
  let _ : PredOrder A := LinearLocallyFiniteOrder.predOrder A
  let _ : NoMaxOrder A := ⟨fun a ↦ by
    obtain ⟨x, hxA, hax⟩ := not_bddAbove_iff.mp hAbove a.1
    exact ⟨⟨x, hxA⟩, hax⟩⟩
  let _ : NoMinOrder A := ⟨fun a ↦ by
    obtain ⟨x, hxA, hxa⟩ := not_bddBelow_iff.mp hBelow a.1
    exact ⟨⟨x, hxA⟩, hxa⟩⟩
  let e : A ≃o ℤ := orderIsoIntOfLinearSuccPredArch
  let point : ℤ → ℝ := fun n ↦ (e.symm n).1
  refine ⟨point, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro m n hmn
    exact e.symm.strictMono hmn
  · ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact (e.symm n).2
    · intro hx
      refine ⟨e ⟨x, hx⟩, ?_⟩
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (e.symm_apply_apply ⟨x, hx⟩)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.adjacentGaps_bounded_of_relativeDense
statement:
private theorem adjacentGaps_bounded_of_relativeDense
    {A : Set ℝ} (point : ℤ → ℝ) (hmono : StrictMono point)
    (hrange : Set.range point = A) :
    ∀ {L : ℝ}, 0 < L →
      (∀ x : ℝ, ∃ a ∈ A, |a - x| < L) →
      ∀ i : ℤ, 0 < point (i + 1) - point i ∧
        point (i + 1) - point i < 2 * L
proof:
:= by
  intro L hL hdense i
  have hstep : point i < point (i + 1) := hmono (by omega)
  refine ⟨sub_pos.mpr hstep, ?_⟩
  by_contra hgap
  have hwide : 2 * L ≤ point (i + 1) - point i := le_of_not_gt hgap
  let midpoint : ℝ := (point i + point (i + 1)) / 2
  obtain ⟨a, haA, ha⟩ := hdense midpoint
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, point j = a := by
    exact hrange.symm.subset haA
  have ha' := abs_lt.mp ha
  have hij : point i < point j := by
    dsimp [midpoint] at ha'
    linarith
  have hji : point j < point (i + 1) := by
    dsimp [midpoint] at ha'
    linarith
  have hij' : i < j := hmono.lt_iff_lt.mp hij
  have hji' : j < i + 1 := hmono.lt_iff_lt.mp hji
  omega

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.delone_has_integerOrderData
statement:
theorem delone_has_integerOrderData
    {A : Set ℝ}
    (_hseparated : ∃ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta ∧
      ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, x ≠ y → delta ≤ |x - y|)
    (hdense : ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ a ∈ A, |a - x| < L)
    (hboundedDiff : ∀ R : ℝ,
      (horizontalBoundedDifferences A R).Finite) :
    Nonempty (HorizontalOrderData A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hdense⟩ := hdense
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀A, _ha₀⟩ := hdense 0
  have hLocal : ∀ a b : ℝ, (A ∩ Set.Icc a b).Finite := by
    intro a b
    let R : ℝ := max (b - a₀) (a₀ - a)
    have hpre : ((fun x : ℝ ↦ x - a₀) ⁻¹'
        horizontalBoundedDifferences A R).Finite :=
      (hboundedDiff R).preimage sub_left_injective.injOn
    apply hpre.subset
    intro x hx
    change x - a₀ ∈ horizontalBoundedDifferences A R
    refine ⟨a₀, ha₀A, x, hx.1, rfl, ?_⟩
    exact abs_sub_le_max_sub hx.2.1 hx.2.2 a₀
  have hAbove : ¬ BddAbove A := by
    rw [not_bddAbove_iff]
    intro b
    obtain ⟨a, haA, ha⟩ := hdense (b + L)
    refine ⟨a, haA, ?_⟩
    have := (abs_lt.mp ha).1
    linarith
  have hBelow : ¬ BddBelow A := by
    rw [not_bddBelow_iff]
    intro b
    obtain ⟨a, haA, ha⟩ := hdense (b - L)
    refine ⟨a, haA, ?_⟩
    have := (abs_lt.mp ha).2
    linarith
  obtain ⟨point, hmono, hrange⟩ :=
    locallyFinite_twoSided_integerEnumeration hLocal hAbove hBelow
  have hgap := adjacentGaps_bounded_of_relativeDense point hmono hrange hL hdense
  let G : Set ℝ :=
    {g : ℝ | ∃ i : ℤ, g = point (i + 1) - point i}
  have hGfinite : G.Finite := by
    apply (hboundedDiff (2 * L)).subset
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hg
    have hiA : point i ∈ A := by
      rw [← hrange]
      exact Set.mem_range_self i
    have hi1A : point (i + 1) ∈ A := by
      rw [← hrange]
      exact Set.mem_range_self (i + 1)
    refine ⟨point i, hiA, point (i + 1), hi1A, rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [abs_of_pos (hgap i).1]
    exact (hgap i).2.le
  let gapAlphabet : Finset ℝ := hGfinite.toFinset
  refine ⟨{
    point := point
    point_strictMono := hmono
    point_range := hrange
    gapAlphabet := gapAlphabet
    gap_mem := ?_
    gap_pos := ?_
    gap_complete := ?_ }⟩
  · intro i
    exact hGfinite.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · intro g hg
    have hgG : g ∈ G := hGfinite.mem_toFinset.mp hg
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hgG
    exact (hgap i).1
  · intro g hg
    have hgG : g ∈ G := hGfinite.mem_toFinset.mp hg
    exact hgG

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.horizontalGapAlphabet_finite
statement:
theorem horizontalGapAlphabet_finite
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (hFHC : HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity T) :
    Nonempty (HorizontalOrderData (horizontalTranslatedVertices K T))
proof:
:= by
  exact delone_has_integerOrderData
    (horizontalTranslatedVertices_delone hTile hFHC).1
    (horizontalTranslatedVertices_delone hTile hFHC).2
    (horizontalBoundedDifferences_finite hFHC)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.finitePositiveGaps_control_indexedDifferences
statement:
theorem finitePositiveGaps_control_indexedDifferences
    {A : Set ℝ} (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (order : HorizontalOrderData A)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (pointLift : ℤ → C.coordinateSpace)
    (hpointLift : ∀ i,
      ((pointLift i : C.coordinateSpace) : ℝ) = order.point i)
    (gapLift : ↑order.gapAlphabet → C.coordinateSpace)
    (hgapLift : ∀ g : ↑order.gapAlphabet,
      ((gapLift g : C.coordinateSpace) : ℝ) = (g : ℝ))
    (hlower : ∀ g : ↑order.gapAlphabet,
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (g : ℝ) <
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi (gapLift g))
    (hupper : ∀ g : ↑order.gapAlphabet,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi (gapLift g) <
        2 * (g : ℝ)) :
    ∀ i j : ℤ, i < j →
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (order.point j - order.point i) <
          Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi (pointLift j) -
            Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi (pointLift i) ∧
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi (pointLift j) -
            Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi (pointLift i) <
          2 * (order.point j - order.point i)
proof:
:= by
  let mapped : ℤ → ℝ := fun i ↦
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi (pointLift i)
  have hstep : ∀ i : ℤ,
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (order.point (i + 1) - order.point i) <
          mapped (i + 1) - mapped i ∧
        mapped (i + 1) - mapped i <
          2 * (order.point (i + 1) - order.point i) := by
    intro i
    let g : ↑order.gapAlphabet :=
      ⟨order.point (i + 1) - order.point i, order.gap_mem i⟩
    have hlift : pointLift (i + 1) - pointLift i = gapLift g := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [g, hpointLift, hgapLift]
    have hmapped : mapped (i + 1) - mapped i =
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi (gapLift g) := by
      dsimp [mapped, Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar]
      rw [← Rat.cast_sub, ← map_sub, hlift]
    rw [hmapped]
    exact ⟨hlower g, hupper g⟩
  have hnat : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∀ i : ℤ,
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
          (order.point (i + (n : ℤ)) - order.point i) <
            mapped (i + (n : ℤ)) - mapped i ∧
        mapped (i + (n : ℤ)) - mapped i <
          2 * (order.point (i + (n : ℤ)) - order.point i) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
        intro _hn i
        by_cases hn : n = 0
        · subst n
          simpa using hstep i
        · have hprev := ih (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) i
          have hnext := hstep (i + (n : ℤ))
          have hidx : i + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = i + (n : ℤ) + 1 := by
            push_cast
            ring
          rw [hidx]
          constructor <;> linarith
  intro i j hij
  let n : ℕ := (j - i).toNat
  have hn : 0 < n := by
    dsimp [n]
    omega
  have hncast : (n : ℤ) = j - i := by
    dsimp [n]
    exact Int.toNat_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hij.le)
  have h := hnat n hn i
  rw [hncast] at h
  simpa [mapped] using h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.approximation_preservesGlobalHorizontalOrder
statement:
theorem approximation_preservesGlobalHorizontalOrder
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (hTile : TilesOn C.region C.centres Set.univ)
    (hFHC : HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity C.centres) :
    ∃ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon ∧
      ∀ phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.IsEpsilonApproximation C epsilon phi →
      ∀ v w : C.region.vertices, ∀ s t : C.centres,
      (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re < (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re →
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re -
          (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re) <
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) +
            Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)).re -
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) +
            Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2)).re ∧
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) +
            Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)).re -
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) +
            Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2)).re <
        2 * ((w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re -
          (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A : Set ℝ := horizontalTranslatedVertices C.region C.centres
  let order : HorizontalOrderData A :=
    Classical.choice (horizontalGapAlphabet_finite hTile hFHC)
  have hpointMem : ∀ i : ℤ, order.point i ∈ C.coordinateSpace := by
    intro i
    have hiA : order.point i ∈ A := by
      exact Eq.mp
        (congrArg (fun S : Set ℝ ↦ order.point i ∈ S) order.point_range)
        (Set.mem_range_self i)
    obtain ⟨v, hv, t, ht, hit⟩ := hiA
    rw [hit, Complex.add_re]
    exact C.coordinateSpace.add_mem
      (C.vertex_re_mem v hv) (C.centre_re_mem t ht)
  let pointLift : ℤ → C.coordinateSpace :=
    fun i ↦ ⟨order.point i, hpointMem i⟩
  have hgapMem : ∀ g ∈ order.gapAlphabet, g ∈ C.coordinateSpace := by
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := order.gap_complete g hg
    rw [hi]
    exact C.coordinateSpace.sub_mem (hpointMem (i + 1)) (hpointMem i)
  let gapLift : ↑order.gapAlphabet → C.coordinateSpace :=
    fun g ↦ ⟨(g : ℝ), hgapMem g g.2⟩
  have hGnonempty : order.gapAlphabet.Nonempty :=
    ⟨order.point (0 + 1) - order.point 0, order.gap_mem 0⟩
  let gmin : ℝ := order.gapAlphabet.min' hGnonempty
  have hgmin_mem : gmin ∈ order.gapAlphabet := by
    exact order.gapAlphabet.min'_mem hGnonempty
  have hgmin_pos : 0 < gmin := order.gap_pos gmin hgmin_mem
  obtain ⟨epsilon, hepsilon, hcontrol⟩ :=
    approximation_uniformOnHorizontalAlphabet C order.gapAlphabet hgapMem
      (half_pos hgmin_pos)
  refine ⟨epsilon, hepsilon, ?_⟩
  intro phi hphi
  have hgapLower : ∀ g : ↑order.gapAlphabet,
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (g : ℝ) <
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi (gapLift g) := by
    intro g
    have herr := hcontrol phi hphi (g : ℝ) g.2
    have hminle : gmin ≤ (g : ℝ) :=
      order.gapAlphabet.min'_le (g : ℝ) g.2
    have hpos := order.gap_pos (g : ℝ) g.2
    dsimp [gapLift] at herr ⊢
    have herr' := (abs_lt.mp herr).1
    linarith
  have hgapUpper : ∀ g : ↑order.gapAlphabet,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi (gapLift g) <
        2 * (g : ℝ) := by
    intro g
    have herr := hcontrol phi hphi (g : ℝ) g.2
    have hminle : gmin ≤ (g : ℝ) :=
      order.gapAlphabet.min'_le (g : ℝ) g.2
    have hpos := order.gap_pos (g : ℝ) g.2
    dsimp [gapLift] at herr ⊢
    have herr' := (abs_lt.mp herr).2
    linarith
  have hindexed := finitePositiveGaps_control_indexedDifferences
    C order phi pointLift (fun _ ↦ rfl) gapLift (fun _ ↦ rfl)
      hgapLower hgapUpper
  intro v w s t hvw
  have hvA : (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re ∈ A :=
    ⟨v.1, v.2, s.1, s.2, rfl⟩
  have hwA : (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re ∈ A :=
    ⟨w.1, w.2, t.1, t.2, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, order.point i =
      (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re := by
    exact order.point_range.symm.subset hvA
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, order.point j =
      (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re := by
    exact order.point_range.symm.subset hwA
  have hij : i < j := order.point_strictMono.lt_iff_lt.mp
    (hi.trans_lt (hvw.trans_eq hj.symm))
  have hbounds := hindexed i j hij
  have hpointi : pointLift i =
      ⟨v.1.re, C.vertex_re_mem v.1 v.2⟩ +
        ⟨s.1.re, C.centre_re_mem s.1 s.2⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [pointLift, hi, Complex.add_re]
  have hpointj : pointLift j =
      ⟨w.1.re, C.vertex_re_mem w.1 w.2⟩ +
        ⟨t.1.re, C.centre_re_mem t.1 t.2⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [pointLift, hj, Complex.add_re]
  have hmapi : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi (pointLift i) =
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
            (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) +
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
            (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2)).re := by
    have hadd : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi
          (⟨v.1.re, C.vertex_re_mem v.1 v.2⟩ +
            ⟨s.1.re, C.centre_re_mem s.1 s.2⟩) =
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi
            ⟨v.1.re, C.vertex_re_mem v.1 v.2⟩ +
          Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi
            ⟨s.1.re, C.centre_re_mem s.1 s.2⟩ := by
      change ((↑(phi (_ + _)) : ℝ)) = (↑(phi _) : ℝ) + (↑(phi _) : ℝ)
      rw [map_add, Rat.cast_add]
    rw [hpointi]
    rw [hadd]
    simp [Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext.vertexPoint,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext.centrePoint]
  have hmapj : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi (pointLift j) =
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
            (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) +
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
            (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)).re := by
    have hadd : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi
          (⟨w.1.re, C.vertex_re_mem w.1 w.2⟩ +
            ⟨t.1.re, C.centre_re_mem t.1 t.2⟩) =
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi
            ⟨w.1.re, C.vertex_re_mem w.1 w.2⟩ +
          Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi
            ⟨t.1.re, C.centre_re_mem t.1 t.2⟩ := by
      change ((↑(phi (_ + _)) : ℝ)) = (↑(phi _) : ℝ) + (↑(phi _) : ℝ)
      rw [map_add, Rat.cast_add]
    rw [hpointj]
    rw [hadd]
    simp [Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext.vertexPoint,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext.centrePoint]
  rw [hi, hj, hmapi, hmapj] at hbounds
  exact hbounds

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.approximation_preservesGlobalHorizontalSign
statement:
theorem approximation_preservesGlobalHorizontalSign
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (hTile : TilesOn C.region C.centres Set.univ)
    (hFHC : HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity C.centres) :
    ∃ epsilon : ℝ, 0 < epsilon ∧
      ∀ phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.IsEpsilonApproximation C epsilon phi →
      ∀ v w : C.region.vertices, ∀ s t : C.centres,
      Real.sign ((w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re -
        (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re) =
      Real.sign
        ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) +
            Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)).re -
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) +
            Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2)).re)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨epsilon, hepsilon, horder⟩ :=
    approximation_preservesGlobalHorizontalOrder C hTile hFHC
  refine ⟨epsilon, hepsilon, ?_⟩
  intro phi hphi v w s t
  let originalDifference : ℝ :=
    (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re - (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re
  let mappedDifference : ℝ :=
    (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
          (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) +
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
          (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)).re -
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
          (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) +
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
          (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2)).re
  change Real.sign originalDifference = Real.sign mappedDifference
  rcases lt_trichotomy originalDifference 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
  · have hswapped :
        (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re <
          (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re := by
      change (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re -
        (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re < 0 at hneg
      exact sub_neg.mp hneg
    have hbounds := horder phi hphi w v t s hswapped
    have hmappedneg : mappedDifference < 0 := by
      have hsourcepos : 0 <
          (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re -
            (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re := sub_pos.mpr hswapped
      have hmapdiffpos : 0 <
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
                (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) +
              Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
                (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2)).re -
            (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
                (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) +
              Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
                (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)).re := by
        linarith [hbounds.1]
      change
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) +
            Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)).re -
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) +
            Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2)).re < 0
      linarith
    rw [Real.sign_of_neg hneg, Real.sign_of_neg hmappedneg]
  · have hcoord :
        (⟨w.1.re, C.vertex_re_mem w.1 w.2⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) +
            ⟨t.1.re, C.centre_re_mem t.1 t.2⟩ =
          ⟨v.1.re, C.vertex_re_mem v.1 v.2⟩ +
            ⟨s.1.re, C.centre_re_mem s.1 s.2⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (w.1.re + t.1.re) - (v.1.re + s.1.re) = 0 at hzero
      change w.1.re + t.1.re = v.1.re + s.1.re
      linarith
    have hmapcoord := congrArg phi hcoord
    have hmapcoordReal := congrArg (fun q : ℚ ↦ (q : ℝ)) hmapcoord
    simp only [map_add, Rat.cast_add] at hmapcoordReal
    have hmappedzero : mappedDifference = 0 := by
      dsimp [mappedDifference]
      simp only [Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint,
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext.vertexPoint,
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext.centrePoint,
        Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
        Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, mul_one, sub_zero, add_zero]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hmapcoordReal
    rw [hzero, hmappedzero, Real.sign_zero]
  · have horiginal :
        (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re <
          (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re := by
      change 0 < (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re -
        (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re at hpos
      exact sub_pos.mp hpos
    have hbounds := horder phi hphi v w s t horiginal
    have hmappedpos : 0 < mappedDifference := by
      have hsourcepos : 0 <
          (w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re -
            (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re := sub_pos.mpr horiginal
      change 0 <
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) +
            Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)).re -
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) +
            Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi
              (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2)).re
      linarith [hbounds.1]
    rw [Real.sign_of_pos hpos, Real.sign_of_pos hmappedpos]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.continuousDiscretePlateEquiv
statement:
theorem continuousDiscretePlateEquiv
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (I : PlateCompatibleIntegerization K T)
    (P : VerticalPlate K T) :
    I.centreEquiv ''
      {t : T | (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ P.centres} =
      {a : I.discreteCentres |
        (a : TranslationalTilings.Plane) ∈
          Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations (I.plateEquiv P)}
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    exact (I.centreEquiv_mem_plate P t).mp ht
  · intro ha
    refine ⟨I.centreEquiv.symm a, ?_, I.centreEquiv.apply_symm_apply a⟩
    apply (I.centreEquiv_mem_plate P (I.centreEquiv.symm a)).mpr
    simpa using ha

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.integralTileNormalization_exists
statement:
private theorem integralTileNormalization_exists :
    ∀ (K : Region),
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.IsRelativelyRational K.toPolygonalRegion →
        Nonempty (IntegralTileNormalization K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro K hrat
  obtain ⟨anchor, hanchor, hrat⟩ := hrat
  have hanchorK : anchor ∈ K.vertices := hanchor
  let V : Finset Tiling.Plane := K.vertexFinset
  let q : Tiling.Plane → ℚ × ℚ := fun v =>
    if hv : v ∈ K.vertices then
      let h := show ∃ x y : ℚ, (v - anchor).re = x ∧ (v - anchor).im = y
        from hrat v hv
      (Classical.choose h, Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec h))
    else (0, 0)
  have hq (v : Tiling.Plane) (hv : v ∈ K.vertices) :
      (v - anchor).re = (q v).1 ∧ (v - anchor).im = (q v).2 := by
    dsimp [q]
    rw [dif_pos hv]
    let h := show ∃ x y : ℚ, (v - anchor).re = x ∧ (v - anchor).im = y
      from hrat v hv
    exact Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec h)
  let d : ℕ := ∏ v ∈ V, (q v).1.den * (q v).2.den
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by
    dsimp [d]
    exact Finset.prod_pos (fun v hv ↦ Nat.mul_pos (Rat.den_pos _) (Rat.den_pos _))
  have hvV (v : Tiling.Plane) (hv : v ∈ K.vertices) : v ∈ V := by
    dsimp [V]
    change v ∈ (K.vertexFinset : Set Tiling.Plane)
    rw [K.coe_vertexFinset]
    exact hv
  have hden1 (v : Tiling.Plane) (hv : v ∈ K.vertices) :
      (q v).1.den ∣ d := by
    apply (dvd_mul_right ((q v).1.den) ((q v).2.den)).trans
    exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun w ↦ (q w).1.den * (q w).2.den) (hvV v hv)
  have hden2 (v : Tiling.Plane) (hv : v ∈ K.vertices) :
      (q v).2.den ∣ d := by
    apply (dvd_mul_right ((q v).2.den) ((q v).1.den)).trans
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using
      (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun w ↦ (q w).1.den * (q w).2.den) (hvV v hv))
  have hdne : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hdpos)
  have hInt (v : Tiling.Plane) (hv : v ∈ K.vertices) :
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.IsIntegerPoint
        ((d : ℝ) • (-anchor +ᵥ v)) := by
    obtain ⟨k₁, hk₁⟩ := hden1 v hv
    obtain ⟨k₂, hk₂⟩ := hden2 v hv
    rw [Tiling.RationalPolygonal.IsIntegerPoint]
    apply Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_integerLattice_iff.mpr
    let z : TranslationalTilings.Plane := fun i =>
      if i = 0 then (q v).1.num * k₁ else (q v).2.num * k₂
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp only [Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint_re, Fin.isValue, vadd_eq_add,
        smul_add, smul_neg, Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_natCast,
        Complex.add_re, Complex.neg_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.natCast_re,
        Complex.natCast_im, zero_mul, sub_zero, z]
      have hcoord := (hq v hv).1
      rw [Rat.cast_def] at hcoord
      rw [hk₁]
      field_simp [Rat.den_nz] at hcoord
      push_cast
      simp only [Complex.sub_re] at hcoord ⊢
      linear_combination -k₁ * hcoord
    · simp only [Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint_im, Fin.isValue, vadd_eq_add,
        smul_add, smul_neg, Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_natCast,
        Complex.add_im, Complex.neg_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.natCast_re,
        Complex.natCast_im, zero_mul, add_zero, z]
      have hcoord := (hq v hv).2
      rw [Rat.cast_def] at hcoord
      rw [hk₂]
      field_simp [Rat.den_nz] at hcoord
      push_cast
      simp only [Complex.sub_im] at hcoord ⊢
      linear_combination -k₂ * hcoord
  let dx : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ :=
    (Homeomorph.addLeft (-anchor.re)).trans
      (Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero (d : ℝ) hdne)
  let dy : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ :=
    (Homeomorph.addLeft (-anchor.im)).trans
      (Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero (d : ℝ) hdne)
  have hdx : StrictMono dx := by
    have hdposR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hdpos
    intro x y hxy
    change (d : ℝ) * (-anchor.re + x) < (d : ℝ) * (-anchor.re + y)
    nlinarith
  have hdy : StrictMono dy := by
    have hdposR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hdpos
    intro x y hxy
    change (d : ℝ) * (-anchor.im + x) < (d : ℝ) * (-anchor.im + y)
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨L, hLsupport, hLopen, hLvertices⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.exists_coordinateProductImageRegion K dx dy hdx hdy
  have hH (x : Tiling.Plane) :
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.coordinateProductHomeomorph dx dy x =
        (d : ℝ) • (-anchor +ᵥ x) := by
    rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.coordinateProductHomeomorph_apply]
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [dx, dy]
    · ring
    · ring
  refine ⟨⟨d, hdpos, anchor, hanchorK, L, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [hLopen]
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨-anchor +ᵥ y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, (hH y).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hxz⟩ := hy
      refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
      rw [hH]
      change (d : ℝ) • (-anchor +ᵥ z) = (d : ℝ) • y
      rw [← hxz]
  · intro v hv
    rw [hLvertices] at hv
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hvw⟩ := hv
    rw [← hvw, hH]
    exact hInt w hw

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.integerRegion_gridCells
statement:
private theorem integerRegion_gridCells :
    ∀ (K : Region),
    (∀ v ∈ K.vertices, Tiling.RationalPolygonal.IsIntegerPoint v) →
    ∃ F : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane, F.Nonempty ∧
      K.openCarrier =ᵐ[volume] ⋃ f : F,
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint
            (f : TranslationalTilings.Plane) +ᵥ
          interior (Complex.Rectangle 0 (1 + Complex.I))
proof:
:= by
  intro K hK
  have hmesh : OnRationalMesh 1 K.vertices := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := mem_integerLattice_iff.mp (hK v hv)
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    apply Complex.ext
    · simpa [rationalScale, integerPoint] using congrArg Complex.re hz
    · simpa [rationalScale, integerPoint] using congrArg Complex.im hz
  obtain ⟨F, hFne, hFraster, hae, _hreg⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.RationalMesh.exists_regionRaster (K := K) (d := 1)
      (by simp) hmesh
  refine ⟨F, hFne, ?_⟩
  have hcell (z : ZPlane) :
      meshCell 1 z = integerPoint z +ᵥ interior (Complex.Rectangle 0 (1 + Complex.I)) := by
    have hunit : interior (Complex.Rectangle 0 (1 + Complex.I)) =
        {w : Tiling.Plane | 0 < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 ∧ 0 < w.im ∧ w.im < 1} := by
      have hrect : Complex.Rectangle 0 (1 + Complex.I) = Icc 0 1 ×ℂ Icc 0 1 := by
        ext w
        simp [Complex.Rectangle]
      rw [hrect]
      rw [Complex.interior_reProdIm]
      ext w
      change (w.re ∈ interior (Icc 0 1) ∧ w.im ∈ interior (Icc 0 1)) ↔ _
      simp [interior_Icc]
      tauto
    ext x
    rw [hunit]
    simp [meshCell, rationalScale, integerPoint,
      Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  have hunion :
      (⋃ f : F, meshCell 1 (f : ZPlane)) =
        ⋃ f : F, integerPoint (f : ZPlane) +ᵥ
          interior (Complex.Rectangle 0 (1 + Complex.I)) := by
    apply iUnion_congr
    intro f
    exact hcell f
  rw [← hunion]
  exact hae

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.c04_verticalPlate_centres_nonempty
statement:
private theorem c04_verticalPlate_centres_nonempty
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (P : VerticalPlate K T) :
    P.centres.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := P.nonempty_supp
  exact ⟨t.1, t, ht, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.c04_verticalPlate_base_nonempty
statement:
private theorem c04_verticalPlate_base_nonempty
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (P : VerticalPlate K T) :
    P.base.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, htP⟩ := c04_verticalPlate_centres_nonempty P
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := K.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty K.nonempty
  refine ⟨(t + u).re, ?_⟩
  rw [VerticalPlate.base_eq]
  refine ⟨t + u, ?_, rfl⟩
  change t + u ∈ regularSupport K P.centres
  have hopen : IsOpen (openUnion K P.centres) := by
    apply isOpen_iUnion
    intro s
    exact isOpen_interior.vadd s.1
  apply interior_mono subset_closure
  rw [hopen.interior_eq]
  apply Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem ⟨t, htP⟩
  rw [mem_vadd_set]
  exact ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.c04_eventually_sliceFiber_ae_univ
statement:
private theorem c04_eventually_sliceFiber_ae_univ
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K S univ)
    (axis : Axis) :
    ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume,
      {x : ℝ | slicePoint axis q x ∈ openUnion K S} =ᵐ[volume] univ
proof:
:= by
  have hplane : ∀ᵐ z : Tiling.Plane ∂volume, z ∈ openUnion K S := by
    filter_upwards [hTile.2.2] with z hz
    change z ∈ (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane) ↔ ∃ s : S,
      z ∈ (s.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier at hz
    simpa only [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier.eq_def,
      Set.mem_iUnion] using hz.mp (Set.mem_univ z)
  have hpull :=
    Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.symm.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hplane
  cases axis with
  | vertical =>
      have hslices := MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod
        (μ := volume) (ν := volume) hpull
      filter_upwards [hslices] with q hq
      filter_upwards [hq] with x hx
      apply propext
      constructor
      · intro _
        exact Set.mem_univ x
      · intro _
        change slicePoint Axis.vertical q x ∈ openUnion K S
        have heq : slicePoint Axis.vertical q x =
            Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm (q, x) := by
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [slicePoint]
        rw [heq]
        exact hx
  | horizontal =>
      have hswap :=
        MeasureTheory.Measure.measurePreserving_swap.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hpull
      have hslices := MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod
        (μ := volume) (ν := volume) hswap
      filter_upwards [hslices] with q hq
      filter_upwards [hq] with x hx
      apply propext
      constructor
      · intro _
        exact Set.mem_univ x
      · intro _
        change slicePoint Axis.horizontal q x ∈ openUnion K S
        have heq : slicePoint Axis.horizontal q x =
            Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm (q, x).swap := by
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [slicePoint]
        rw [heq]
        exact hx

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.c04_mem_closure_of_ae_univ
statement:
private theorem c04_mem_closure_of_ae_univ
    {U : Set ℝ} (hU : U =ᵐ[volume] univ) (c : ℝ) :
    c ∈ closure U
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_closure_iff]
  intro V hVopen hcV
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hVball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hVopen.mem_nhds hcV)
  let I : Set ℝ := Ioo (c - r / 2) (c + r / 2)
  have hI : volume I ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Real.volume_Ioo]
    simp [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero]
    linarith
  have haeU : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ U :=
    hU.mono fun x hx ↦ hx.mpr (Set.mem_univ x)
  obtain ⟨x, hxI, hxU⟩ :=
    MeasureTheory.Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hI
      (haeU.filter_mono MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_le)
  refine ⟨x, hVball ?_, hxU⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
  rw [abs_lt]
  constructor <;> linarith [hxI.1, hxI.2]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.c04_eventually_avoids_translatedVertexLevels
statement:
private theorem c04_eventually_avoids_translatedVertexLevels
    {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hpacking : Tiling.IsPacking K.toPolygonalRegion.prototileFamily
      (K.toPolygonalRegion.placements S)) (axis : Axis) :
    ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume, q ∉ c04_translatedVertexLevels K S axis
proof:
:= by
  have hS : S.Countable := (IsPacking.locallyFinite_centres hpacking).2
  have hV : K.vertices.Countable := by
    rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]
    exact K.vertexFinset.finite_toSet.countable
  let _ : Countable S := hS.to_subtype
  let _ : Countable K.vertices := hV.to_subtype
  exact (Set.countable_range _).ae_notMem volume

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.c04_filledChain_difference_integer
proof:
:= by
  have hVertexRe : ∀ (v : K.vertices), ∃ z : ℤ, v.1.re = z := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_integerLattice_iff.mp
        (hInteger v.1 v.2)
    refine ⟨z 0, ?_⟩
    rw [← hz]
    exact Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint_re z
  obtain ⟨hmono, hsteps⟩ := hchain
  have hstep (i : Fin n) : ∃ z : ℤ,
      x i.succ - x i.castSucc = z := by
    obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, hleft, hright, _hpos, _hgap⟩ := hsteps i
    obtain ⟨zv, hzv⟩ := hVertexRe ⟨v, hv⟩
    obtain ⟨zw, hzw⟩ := hVertexRe ⟨w, hw⟩
    refine ⟨zw - zv, ?_⟩
    simp only [Axis.coord, Complex.add_re] at hleft hright
    rw [Int.cast_sub]
    linarith
  choose z hz using hstep
  have hsum : (∑ i : Fin n, (x i.succ - x i.castSucc)) =
      (∑ i : Fin n, (z i : ℝ)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _hi
    exact hz i
  have htel_aux : ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ),
      (∑ i : Fin m, (y i.succ - y i.castSucc)) =
        y (Fin.last m) - y 0 := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro y; simp
    | succ m ih =>
        intro y
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
        have htail := ih (fun i => y i.succ)
        have hlast : (Fin.last m).succ = Fin.last (m + 1) := by
          ext
          simp
        rw [hlast] at htail
        have htail' :
            (∑ i : Fin m, (y i.succ.succ - y i.succ.castSucc)) =
              y (Fin.last (m + 1)) - y 1 := by
          convert htail using 1 <;> simp
        simp only [Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one]
        rw [htail']
        ring
  have htel := htel_aux n x
  refine ⟨∑ i : Fin n, z i, ?_⟩
  rw [← htel, hsum, ← Int.cast_sum]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.c04_filledChain_owner_eq_of_mem
statement:
private theorem c04_filledChain_owner_eq_of_mem
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (hT : TilesOn K T univ)
    {q : ℝ} {n : ℕ} {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ} {owner : Fin n → ↥T}
    (hchain : IsFilledIndexedSliceChain K T Axis.horizontal q x owner)
    (i : Fin n) (t : ↥T) {z : Tiling.Plane}
    (hzi : z ∈ axisInterval Axis.horizontal (q : ℝ) (x i.castSucc) (x i.succ))
    (hzt : z ∈ (t : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) : owner i = t
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hd := (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K T).mp hT.2.1
    (owner i).2 t.2 (fun h => hne (Subtype.ext h))
  obtain ⟨v, w, hv, hw, hleft, hright, hpositive, hinside⟩ := hchain.2 i
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hd (hinside hzi) hzt

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.c04_strictMono_exists_gap
statement:
private theorem c04_strictMono_exists_gap {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hx : StrictMono x) {a : ℝ} (hleft : x 0 < a)
    (hright : a < x (Fin.last n)) (hne : ∀ k, a ≠ x k) :
    ∃ i : Fin n, a ∈ Ioo (x i.castSucc) (x i.succ)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exfalso; simpa using (lt_asymm hleft hright)
  | succ n ih =>
      rcases lt_trichotomy a (x 1) with ha | ha | ha
      · exact ⟨⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩, hleft, ha⟩
      · exact False.elim (hne 1 ha)
      · let y : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun k => x k.succ
        have hy : StrictMono y := by
          intro i j hij
          apply hx
          simpa using hij
        have hylast : a < y (Fin.last n) := by
          simpa [y] using hright
        have hyne : ∀ k, a ≠ y k := fun k => hne k.succ
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := ih y hy ha hylast hyne
        refine ⟨i.succ, ?_⟩
        simpa [y] using hi

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.totalPlateBoundary_nonempty
statement:
private theorem totalPlateBoundary_nonempty
    : ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T Set.univ →
      ¬ Subsingleton (VerticalPlate K T) →
      (⋃ P : VerticalPlate K T, frontier P.base).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile hNonSub
  have hcentres_subset (P : VerticalPlate K T) : P.centres ⊆ T := by
    rintro _ ⟨t, -, rfl⟩
    exact t.2
  have hcentres_eq_of_support_eq_univ (P : VerticalPlate K T)
      (hfull : P.support = Set.univ) : P.centres = T := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm (hcentres_subset P)
    intro t htT
    by_contra htP
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := K.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty K.nonempty
    have htuint : t + u ∈ interior (closure (openUnion K P.centres)) := by
      change t + u ∈ P.support
      rw [hfull]
      trivial
    have hopenTile : IsOpen (t +ᵥ K.openCarrier) := isOpen_interior.vadd t
    have hmeet :
        ((t +ᵥ K.openCarrier) ∩ openUnion K P.centres).Nonempty := by
      apply mem_closure_iff.mp (interior_subset htuint)
      · exact hopenTile
      · rw [mem_vadd_set]
        exact ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hqtile, hqraw⟩ := hmeet
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion] at hqraw
    obtain ⟨s, hqs⟩ := hqraw
    have hst : (s : Tiling.Plane) ≠ t := by
      intro heq
      exact htP (heq ▸ s.2)
    have hdis := (Tiling.AxisParallel.isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K T).mp
      hTile.2.1 (hcentres_subset P s.2) htT hst
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdis hqs hqtile
  have hslab (P : VerticalPlate K T) :
      P.base = interior (closure P.base) ∧
        P.support = Complex.re ⁻¹' P.base :=
    VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile P
  have hPQ : ∃ P Q : VerticalPlate K T, P ≠ Q := by
    by_contra h
    apply hNonSub
    constructor
    intro P Q
    by_contra hne
    exact h ⟨P, Q, hne⟩
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hPQ⟩ := hPQ
  have hproperP : P.base ≠ Set.univ := by
    intro hbase
    have hfull : P.support = Set.univ := by
      rw [hslab P |>.2, hbase]
      simp
    have hcentres : P.centres = T := hcentres_eq_of_support_eq_univ P hfull
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := c04_verticalPlate_centres_nonempty Q
    obtain ⟨qT, hqT, rfl⟩ := hq
    have hqP : (qT : Tiling.Plane) ∈ P.centres := hcentres.symm ▸ qT.2
    obtain ⟨pT, hpT, hpEq⟩ := hqP
    have hpEq' : pT = qT := Subtype.ext hpEq
    subst qT
    exact hPQ (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq_of_common_vertex hpT hqT)
  have hbaseNonempty := c04_verticalPlate_base_nonempty P
  have hfront : (frontier P.base).Nonempty := by
    exact nonempty_frontier_iff.mpr ⟨hbaseNonempty, hproperP⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hfront
  exact ⟨c, Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem P hc⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.plateBoundary_mem_horizontalSliceEndpoint
statement:
private theorem plateBoundary_mem_horizontalSliceEndpoint
    : ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}, TilesOn K T Set.univ →
      ∀ᵐ q : ℝ ∂volume, ∀ c : ℝ,
        c ∈ ⋃ P : VerticalPlate K T, frontier P.base →
          c ∈ sliceEndpointSet K T Axis.horizontal q
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile
  let _ : Countable T := hTile.1.to_subtype
  let _ : Countable (VerticalPlate K T) := by
    apply Function.Surjective.countable
      (f := fun t : T ↦ VerticalPlate.ofCentre (K := K) t)
    intro P
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := P.nonempty_supp
    refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
    exact (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff P p).1 hp
  have hslab (P : VerticalPlate K T) :
      P.base = interior (closure P.base) ∧
        P.support = Complex.re ⁻¹' P.base :=
    VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile P
  have hpartition := Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport_pairwiseDisjoint
    (@VerticalPlate.centres K T)
      (verticalPlateCentres_pairwiseDisjoint K T)
      (iUnion_verticalPlateCentres K T) hTile
  have hq := c04_eventually_sliceFiber_ae_univ hTile Axis.horizontal
  have hqAvoid := c04_eventually_avoids_translatedVertexLevels
    hTile.2.1 Axis.horizontal
  filter_upwards [hq, hqAvoid] with q hq _hqAvoid
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨P₀, hcP₀⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hc
  let U : Set ℝ := {x : ℝ | slicePoint Axis.horizontal q x ∈ openUnion K T}
  have hUae : U =ᵐ[volume] univ := by simpa [U] using hq
  have hcClosure : c ∈ closure U := c04_mem_closure_of_ae_univ hUae c
  have hcNot : slicePoint Axis.horizontal q c ∉ openUnion K T := by
    intro hcU
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion] at hcU
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hcU
    let Q : VerticalPlate K T := VerticalPlate.ofCentre s
    have hzQ : slicePoint Axis.horizontal q c ∈ Q.support := by
      change slicePoint Axis.horizontal q c ∈ regularSupport K Q.centres
      have hopen : IsOpen (openUnion K Q.centres) := by
        apply isOpen_iUnion
        intro t
        exact isOpen_interior.vadd t.1
      apply interior_mono subset_closure
      rw [hopen.interior_eq]
      rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
      refine ⟨⟨s.1, VerticalPlate.mem_centres_ofCentre s⟩, ?_⟩
      exact hs
    have hcQ : c ∈ Q.base := by
      have hzQ' : slicePoint Axis.horizontal q c ∈ Complex.re ⁻¹' Q.base := by
        rw [← hslab Q |>.2]
        exact hzQ
      simpa [slicePoint] using hzQ'
    by_cases hQP : Q = P₀
    · exact (by
        subst P₀
        have hInt : c ∈ interior Q.base := by
          have hQopen : IsOpen Q.base := by
            rw [(hslab Q).1]
            exact isOpen_interior
          rw [hQopen.interior_eq]
          exact hcQ
        exact disjoint_interior_frontier.le_bot ⟨hInt, hcP₀⟩)
    · have hdisj := hpartition.1 (Set.mem_univ Q)
        (Set.mem_univ P₀) hQP
      have hPclosure : c ∈ closure P₀.base := frontier_subset_closure hcP₀
      have hQopen : IsOpen Q.base := by
        rw [(hslab Q).1]
        exact isOpen_interior
      obtain ⟨x, hxP, hxQ⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hPclosure
        Q.base hQopen hcQ
      have hzP : slicePoint Axis.horizontal q x ∈
          P₀.support := by
        rw [(hslab P₀).2]
        simpa [slicePoint] using hxQ
      have hzQ' : slicePoint Axis.horizontal q x ∈ Q.support := by
        rw [(hslab Q).2]
        simpa [slicePoint] using hxP
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hzQ' hzP
  have hcEndpoint : c ∈ frontier U := by
    rw [frontier]
    refine ⟨hcClosure, ?_⟩
    intro hcInt
    exact hcNot (by simpa [U] using interior_subset hcInt)
  simpa [sliceEndpointSet, U] using hcEndpoint

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.plateBoundaryCoordinates_mem_intCoset
statement:
private theorem plateBoundaryCoordinates_mem_intCoset
    : ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}, TilesOn K T Set.univ →
      (∀ v ∈ K.vertices, Tiling.RationalPolygonal.IsIntegerPoint v) →
      ¬ Subsingleton (VerticalPlate K T) →
      ∃ x₀ : ℝ, x₀ ∈ ⋃ P : VerticalPlate K T, frontier P.base ∧
        ⋃ P : VerticalPlate K T, frontier P.base ⊆
          {x : ℝ | ∃ n : ℤ, x = x₀ + n}
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile hInteger hNonSub
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := totalPlateBoundary_nonempty hTile hNonSub
  have hBoundary := plateBoundary_mem_horizontalSliceEndpoint hTile
  have hChain :=
    genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints_with_endpoints K T hTile Axis.horizontal
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (hBoundary.and hChain).exists
  obtain ⟨hBoundary, hChain⟩ := hq
  refine ⟨x₀, hx₀, ?_⟩
  intro c hc
  have hx₀e := hBoundary x₀ hx₀
  have hce := hBoundary c hc
  rcases lt_trichotomy x₀ c with hlt | heq | hgt
  · obtain ⟨n, _hn, x, _owner, hxfirst, hxlast, hfilled, _hendpoints⟩ :=
      hChain x₀ hx₀e c hce hlt
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := c04_filledChain_difference_integer hInteger hfilled
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    rw [hxlast, hxfirst] at hz
    linarith
  · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rw [heq]
    ring
  · obtain ⟨n, _hn, x, _owner, hxfirst, hxlast, hfilled, _hendpoints⟩ :=
      hChain c hce x₀ hx₀e hgt
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := c04_filledChain_difference_integer hInteger hfilled
    refine ⟨-z, ?_⟩
    rw [hxlast, hxfirst] at hz
    rw [Int.cast_neg]
    linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.integralBoundaryDifference_of_filledChain
statement:
private theorem integralBoundaryDifference_of_filledChain
    : ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}, TilesOn K T Set.univ →
      (∀ v ∈ K.vertices, Tiling.RationalPolygonal.IsIntegerPoint v) →
      ∀ a b : ℝ,
        a ∈ ⋃ P : VerticalPlate K T, frontier P.base →
        b ∈ ⋃ P : VerticalPlate K T, frontier P.base →
        ∃ n : ℤ, b - a = n
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile hInteger a b ha hb
  have hBoundary := plateBoundary_mem_horizontalSliceEndpoint hTile
  have hChain :=
    genericSliceChain_betweenEndpoints_with_endpoints K T hTile Axis.horizontal
  obtain ⟨q, hBoundary, hChain⟩ := (hBoundary.and hChain).exists
  have hae := hBoundary a ha
  have hbe := hBoundary b hb
  rcases lt_trichotomy a b with hab | hab | hab
  · obtain ⟨n, _hn, x, _owner, hxfirst, hxlast, hfilled, _hendpoints⟩ :=
      hChain a hae b hbe hab
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := c04_filledChain_difference_integer hInteger hfilled
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    simpa [hxfirst, hxlast] using hz
  · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    simp [hab]
  · obtain ⟨n, _hn, x, _owner, hxfirst, hxlast, hfilled, _hendpoints⟩ :=
      hChain b hbe a hae hab
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := c04_filledChain_difference_integer hInteger hfilled
    refine ⟨-z, ?_⟩
    rw [Int.cast_neg]
    rw [hxlast, hxfirst] at hz
    linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.c04_im_eq_of_mem_openSegment_horizontal
statement:
private theorem c04_im_eq_of_mem_openSegment_horizontal
    {a b p : Tiling.Plane} (hab : a.im = b.im)
    (hp : p ∈ openSegment ℝ a b) : p.im = a.im
proof:
:= by
  rw [openSegment_eq_image] at hp
  obtain ⟨r, _hr, rfl⟩ := hp
  simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hab]
  ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.c04_mem_openSegment_sub_iff
statement:
private theorem c04_mem_openSegment_sub_iff
    {a b t z : Tiling.Plane} :
    z ∈ openSegment ℝ (a - t) (b - t) ↔ z + t ∈ openSegment ℝ a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [show a = t +ᵥ (a - t) by simp [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg],
    show b = t +ᵥ (b - t) by simp [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg],
    ← vadd_openSegment ℝ]
  simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · simpa [add_assoc] using h
  · simpa [add_assoc] using h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.c04_properHorizontalContact_imagDifference
statement:
private theorem c04_properHorizontalContact_imagDifference
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (t s : T)
    (_hts : t ≠ s) (hcontact : HorizontalProperContact K t.1 s.1) :
    ∃ a a' : K.vertices,
      ((s.1 : Tiling.Plane) - (t.1 : Tiling.Plane)).im = a.1.im - a'.1.im
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, d, hcd, hcdIm, hcontact⟩ := hcontact
  let p : Tiling.Plane := midpoint ℝ c d
  have hpCD : p ∈ openSegment ℝ c d := midpoint_mem_openSegment c d
  have hpContact := hcontact hpCD
  have hpTFrontier : p - t.1 ∈ frontier K.support :=
    by
      simpa only [frontier_vadd_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem,
        vadd_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub] using hpContact.1.1
  have hpTNotVertex : p - t.1 ∉ K.vertices := by
    intro hpVertex
    apply hpContact.2
    left
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simpa [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hpVertex
  have hpSFrontier : p - s.1 ∈ frontier K.support :=
    by
      simpa only [frontier_vadd_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem,
        vadd_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub] using hpContact.1.2
  have hpSNotVertex : p - s.1 ∉ K.vertices := by
    intro hpVertex
    apply hpContact.2
    right
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simpa [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hpVertex
  obtain ⟨axisT, a, b, hab, habCoord, hpAB, habEdge⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.nonvertexFrontier_mem_intrinsicEdge
      K (p - t.1) hpTFrontier hpTNotVertex
  have habIm : a.1.im = b.1.im := by
    cases axisT with
    | horizontal => simpa [Axis.transverseCoord] using habCoord
    | vertical =>
        exfalso
        apply hpTNotVertex
        apply K.isPolygonal.mem_vertexSet_of_perpendicular_openSegments
          (c := c - t.1) (d := d - t.1) (p := p - t.1)
          (v := a.1) (w := b.1)
        · exact fun h ↦ hcd (sub_left_inj.mp h)
        · simp only [Complex.sub_im]; linarith
        · intro z hz
          have hzPlaced := c04_mem_openSegment_sub_iff.mp hz
          simpa [frontier_vadd_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem,
            vadd_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub] using (hcontact hzPlaced).1.1
        · apply c04_mem_openSegment_sub_iff.mpr
          simpa using hpCD
        · exact hab
        · exact habCoord
        · exact hpAB
        · exact fun z hz ↦ (habEdge hz).1
  obtain ⟨axisS, a', b', ha'b', ha'b'Coord, hpA'B', ha'b'Edge⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.nonvertexFrontier_mem_intrinsicEdge
      K (p - s.1) hpSFrontier hpSNotVertex
  have ha'b'Im : a'.1.im = b'.1.im := by
    cases axisS with
    | horizontal => simpa [Axis.transverseCoord] using ha'b'Coord
    | vertical =>
        exfalso
        apply hpSNotVertex
        apply K.isPolygonal.mem_vertexSet_of_perpendicular_openSegments
          (c := c - s.1) (d := d - s.1) (p := p - s.1)
          (v := a'.1) (w := b'.1)
        · exact fun h ↦ hcd (sub_left_inj.mp h)
        · simp only [Complex.sub_im]; linarith
        · intro z hz
          have hzPlaced := c04_mem_openSegment_sub_iff.mp hz
          simpa [frontier_vadd_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem,
            vadd_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub] using (hcontact hzPlaced).1.2
        · apply c04_mem_openSegment_sub_iff.mpr
          simpa using hpCD
        · exact ha'b'
        · exact ha'b'Coord
        · exact hpA'B'
        · exact fun z hz ↦ (ha'b'Edge hz).1
  refine ⟨a, a', ?_⟩
  have hpIm := c04_im_eq_of_mem_openSegment_horizontal hcdIm hpCD
  have hpTIm := c04_im_eq_of_mem_openSegment_horizontal habIm hpAB
  have hpSIm := c04_im_eq_of_mem_openSegment_horizontal ha'b'Im hpA'B'
  simp only [Complex.sub_im] at hpTIm hpSIm ⊢
  linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.plateSecondCoordinates_mem_intCoset
statement:
private theorem plateSecondCoordinates_mem_intCoset :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      (∀ v ∈ K.vertices, Tiling.RationalPolygonal.IsIntegerPoint v) →
      ∀ P : VerticalPlate K T, ∃ theta : ℝ,
        ∀ t ∈ P.centres, ∃ n : ℤ, t.im = theta + n
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hInteger P
  have hVertexImag : ∀ (v : K.vertices), ∃ n : ℤ, v.1.im = n := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.mem_integerLattice_iff.mp
        (hInteger v.1 v.2)
    refine ⟨z 1, ?_⟩
    rw [← hz]
    exact Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint_im z
  have hAdj : ∀ {u v : T},
      (verticalPlateGraph K T).Adj u v →
        ∃ n : ℤ, v.1.im = u.1.im + n := by
    intro u v huv
    obtain ⟨huv_ne, hcontact⟩ := (verticalPlateGraph_adj_iff u v).mp huv
    obtain ⟨a, a', hdiff⟩ :=
      c04_properHorizontalContact_imagDifference u v huv_ne hcontact
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hVertexImag a
    obtain ⟨m', hm'⟩ := hVertexImag a'
    refine ⟨m - m', ?_⟩
    rw [Complex.sub_im] at hdiff
    rw [hm, hm'] at hdiff
    rw [Int.cast_sub]
    linarith
  have hWalk : ∀ {u v : T} (p : (verticalPlateGraph K T).Walk u v),
      ∃ n : ℤ, v.1.im = u.1.im + n := by
    intro u v p
    induction p with
    | nil => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    | @cons u v w huv p ih =>
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hAdj huv
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ih
        refine ⟨m + n, ?_⟩
        rw [hn, hm, Int.cast_add]
        ring
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := P.nonempty_supp
  refine ⟨u.1.im, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := ht
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := P.reachable_of_mem_supp hu hv
  exact hWalk p

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.exists_mem_open_of_ae_local
proof:
:= by
  have hμ : volume.restrict U ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hzero : volume U = 0 := by
      rw [← Measure.restrict_apply_univ U, hz]
      simp
    exact hU.measure_ne_zero volume hUne hzero
  let hne : (ae (volume.restrict U)).NeBot := ae_neBot.mpr hμ
  have hP' : ∀ᵐ z ∂volume.restrict U, P z := hP.filter_mono ae_restrict_le
  rcases @Filter.Eventually.exists Tiling.Plane _ (ae (volume.restrict U)) hne
      (hP'.and (ae_restrict_mem hU.measurableSet)) with ⟨z, hzP, hzU⟩
  exact ⟨z, hzU, hzP⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.meshCell_union_finset_eq_of_ae_eq
statement:
private theorem meshCell_union_finset_eq_of_ae_eq
    {F G : Finset TranslationalTilings.Plane}
    (hFG : (⋃ f : F, meshCell 1 (f : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) =ᵐ[volume]
      ⋃ g : G, meshCell 1 (g : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) :
    (F : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane) = G
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  constructor
  · intro hf
    have hopen : IsOpen (meshCell 1 (f : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) := by
      simp only [meshCell]
      exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
        ((isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const).inter
          ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
            (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)))
    have hne : (meshCell 1 (f : TranslationalTilings.Plane)).Nonempty :=
      meshCell_nonempty (by simp) _
    obtain ⟨x, hxf, hxgood⟩ := exists_mem_open_of_ae_local hopen hne hFG
    have hxG : x ∈ ⋃ g : G, meshCell 1 (g : TranslationalTilings.Plane) :=
      by
        change (⋃ g : G, meshCell 1 (g : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) x
        rw [← hxgood]
        exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem ⟨f, hf⟩ hxf
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxG with ⟨g, hxg⟩
    by_contra hnefg
    have hdisj : Disjoint (meshCell 1 (f : TranslationalTilings.Plane))
        (meshCell 1 (g : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) := by
      refine meshCell_pairwiseDisjoint (d := 1) (by simp)
        (Set.mem_univ f) (Set.mem_univ g) ?_
      intro hfg
      apply hnefg
      exact hfg ▸ g.property
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hxf hxg
  · intro hg
    have hopen : IsOpen (meshCell 1 (f : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) := by
      simp only [meshCell]
      exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
        ((isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const).inter
          ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
            (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)))
    have hne : (meshCell 1 (f : TranslationalTilings.Plane)).Nonempty :=
      meshCell_nonempty (by simp) _
    obtain ⟨x, hxf, hxgood⟩ := exists_mem_open_of_ae_local hopen hne hFG.symm
    have hxF : x ∈ ⋃ f : F, meshCell 1 (f : TranslationalTilings.Plane) :=
      by
        change (⋃ f : F, meshCell 1 (f : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) x
        rw [← hxgood]
        exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem ⟨f, hg⟩ hxf
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxF with ⟨f', hxf'⟩
    by_contra hnefg
    have hdisj : Disjoint (meshCell 1 (f : TranslationalTilings.Plane))
        (meshCell 1 (f' : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) := by
      refine meshCell_pairwiseDisjoint (d := 1) (by simp)
        (Set.mem_univ f) (Set.mem_univ f') ?_
      intro hfg
      apply hnefg
      exact hfg ▸ f'.property
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hxf hxf'

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.integerRegion_discreteTile_eq_raster
statement:
private theorem integerRegion_discreteTile_eq_raster
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (I : PlateCompatibleIntegerization K T) :
    (I.discreteTile : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane) =
      rasterCells 1 I.integerRegion.openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  have hmesh : OnRationalMesh 1 I.integerRegion.vertices := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := mem_integerLattice_iff.mp (I.integerVertices v hv)
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    apply Complex.ext
    · simpa [rationalScale, integerPoint] using congrArg Complex.re hz
    · simpa [rationalScale, integerPoint] using congrArg Complex.im hz
  obtain ⟨F, hFne, hFraster, hae, _hreg⟩ :=
    exists_regionRaster (K := I.integerRegion) (d := 1) (by simp) hmesh
  have hcell (z : TranslationalTilings.Plane) :
      meshCell 1 z = integerPoint z +ᵥ interior (Complex.Rectangle 0 (1 + Complex.I)) := by
    have hunit : interior (Complex.Rectangle 0 (1 + Complex.I)) =
        {w : Tiling.Plane | 0 < w.re ∧ w.re < 1 ∧ 0 < w.im ∧ w.im < 1} := by
      have hrect : Complex.Rectangle 0 (1 + Complex.I) = Icc 0 1 ×ℂ Icc 0 1 := by
        ext w
        simp [Complex.Rectangle]
      rw [hrect, Complex.interior_reProdIm]
      ext w
      change (w.re ∈ interior (Icc 0 1) ∧ w.im ∈ interior (Icc 0 1)) ↔ _
      simp [interior_Icc]
      tauto
    ext x
    rw [hunit]
    simp [meshCell, rationalScale, integerPoint,
      Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  have hIae : I.integerRegion.openCarrier =ᵐ[volume]
      ⋃ f : I.discreteTile, meshCell 1 (f : TranslationalTilings.Plane) := by
    have hunionI : (⋃ f : I.discreteTile, meshCell 1 (f : TranslationalTilings.Plane)) =
        ⋃ f : I.discreteTile,
          integerPoint (f : TranslationalTilings.Plane) +ᵥ
            interior (Complex.Rectangle 0 (1 + Complex.I)) := by
      apply iUnion_congr
      intro f
      exact hcell f
    filter_upwards [I.discreteTile_realizes_integerRegion] with x hx
    rw [hunionI]
    exact hx
  have hFae : I.integerRegion.openCarrier =ᵐ[volume]
      ⋃ f : F, meshCell 1 (f : TranslationalTilings.Plane) := by
    exact hae
  have hEq := meshCell_union_finset_eq_of_ae_eq (hIae.symm.trans hFae)
  rw [hEq, hFraster]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.regularSupport_eq_regularizedCellUnion
statement:
private theorem regularSupport_eq_regularizedCellUnion
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (I : PlateCompatibleIntegerization K T)
    {S : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} :
    regularSupport I.integerRegion (integerPoint '' S) =
      regularizedCellUnion 1 (discreteCarrier I.discreteTile S)
proof:
:= by
  have hmesh : OnRationalMesh 1 I.integerRegion.vertices := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := mem_integerLattice_iff.mp (I.integerVertices v hv)
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    apply Complex.ext
    · simpa [rationalScale, integerPoint] using congrArg Complex.re hz
    · simpa [rationalScale, integerPoint] using congrArg Complex.im hz
  obtain ⟨F, -, hFraster, -, -⟩ :=
    exists_regionRaster (K := I.integerRegion) (d := 1) (by simp) hmesh
  have hEq : (I.discreteTile : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane) = F := by
    exact (integerRegion_discreteTile_eq_raster I).trans hFraster.symm
  have himage : rationalScale 1 '' S = integerPoint '' S := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [rationalScale, integerPoint]
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [rationalScale, integerPoint]
  calc
    regularSupport I.integerRegion (integerPoint '' S) =
        regularSupport I.integerRegion (rationalScale 1 '' S) := by rw [himage]
    _ = regularizedCellUnion 1 (discreteCarrier F S) :=
      regularSupport_rationalScale_image (by simp) hmesh F hFraster S
    _ = regularizedCellUnion 1 (discreteCarrier I.discreteTile S) := by
      have hFin : I.discreteTile = F := Finset.coe_injective hEq
      subst F
      rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.discretePeriod_regularizedCellUnion
statement:
private theorem discretePeriod_regularizedCellUnion
    {A : Set TranslationalTilings.Plane} {L : ℕ}
    (hperiod : TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic L A) :
    SetPeriodicBy (regularizedCellUnion 1 A) (L : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  let e₀ : TranslationalTilings.Plane := ![1, 0]
  let U : Set Tiling.Plane := ⋃ q : A, meshCell 1 q.1
  have hUperiod (z : Tiling.Plane) : z + (L : ℂ) ∈ U ↔ z ∈ U := by
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz with ⟨q, hq⟩
      let q' : TranslationalTilings.Plane := q.1 - (L : ℤ) • e₀
      have hqshift : q' + (L : ℤ) • e₀ = q.1 := by
        dsimp [q', e₀]
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, Pi.add_apply]
      have hq'A : q' ∈ A := by
        apply (hperiod q' e₀).mp
        rw [hqshift]
        exact q.2
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨q', hq'A⟩, ?_⟩
      have hcell := meshCell_add (d := 1) (by simp)
        q' ((L : ℤ) • e₀)
      have hscalar : rationalScale 1 ((L : ℤ) • e₀) = (L : ℂ) := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [rationalScale, e₀]
      rw [← hqshift] at hq
      rw [hcell] at hq
      rw [hscalar] at hq
      change z ∈ meshCell 1 q'
      simpa [e₀, rationalScale, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
        add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hq
    · intro hz
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz with ⟨q, hq⟩
      let q' : TranslationalTilings.Plane := q.1 + (L : ℤ) • e₀
      have hqshift : q.1 + (L : ℤ) • e₀ = q' := by rfl
      have hq'A : q' ∈ A := by
        rw [← hqshift]
        exact (hperiod q.1 e₀).mpr q.2
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨q', hq'A⟩, ?_⟩
      have hcell := meshCell_add (d := 1) (by simp)
        q.1 ((L : ℤ) • e₀)
      have hscalar : rationalScale 1 ((L : ℤ) • e₀) = (L : ℂ) := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [rationalScale, e₀]
      change z + (L : ℂ) ∈ meshCell 1 q'
      rw [← hqshift, hcell]
      rw [hscalar]
      simpa [e₀, rationalScale, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
        add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hq
  have hUshift : ((L : ℂ) +ᵥ U) = U := by
    ext z
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simpa [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc]
      using (hUperiod (z - (L : ℂ))).symm
  have hRshift : ((L : ℂ) +ᵥ regularizedCellUnion 1 A) =
      regularizedCellUnion 1 A := by
    change ((L : ℂ) +ᵥ interior (closure U)) = interior (closure U)
    calc
      (L : ℂ) +ᵥ interior (closure U) = interior ((L : ℂ) +ᵥ closure U) := by
        rw [interior_vadd]
      _ = interior (closure ((L : ℂ) +ᵥ U)) := by rw [closure_vadd]
      _ = interior (closure U) := by rw [hUshift]
  intro z
  simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg,
    add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using
    (Set.ext_iff.mp hRshift (z + (L : ℂ))).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.affine_period_pullback
statement:
private theorem affine_period_pullback
    {R S : Set Tiling.Plane} {L : ℕ} {s c : ℝ}
    (hs : 0 < s)
    (hR : R = (s : ℝ) • (((c : ℝ) : ℂ) +ᵥ S))
    (hRperiod : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy R (L : ℂ)) :
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy S
      ((((L : ℝ) / s : ℝ) : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 : (s : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hs)
  have hmap (y : Tiling.Plane) :
      (s : ℝ) • (((c : ℝ) : ℂ) + y) ∈ R ↔ y ∈ S := by
    constructor
    · intro hy
      rw [hR] at hy
      rcases Set.mem_smul_set.mp hy with ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩
      have hzv : z = (((c : ℝ) : ℂ) + y) :=
        (smul_right_injective ℂ hs0) hzy
      rcases Set.mem_vadd_set.mp hz with ⟨y', hy', hyy'⟩
      have hyy : y' = y := by
        apply add_left_cancel
        calc
          ((c : ℝ) : ℂ) + y' = z := by simpa [vadd_eq_add] using hyy'
          _ = ((c : ℝ) : ℂ) + y := hzv
      simpa [hyy] using hy'
    · intro hy
      rw [hR]
      refine Set.mem_smul_set.mpr ⟨((c : ℝ) : ℂ) + y, ?_, rfl⟩
      exact Set.mem_vadd_set.mpr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  intro x
  have hp := hRperiod ((s : ℝ) • (((c : ℝ) : ℂ) + x))
  have hscalar :
      (s : ℝ) • ((((L : ℝ) / s : ℝ) : ℂ)) = (L : ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · norm_num [smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    · norm_num [smul_eq_mul]
  have hshift :
      (s : ℝ) • (((c : ℝ) : ℂ) +
          (x + ((((L : ℝ) / s : ℝ) : ℂ)))) =
        (s : ℝ) • (((c : ℝ) : ℂ) + x) + (L : ℂ) := by
    rw [← add_assoc, smul_add, hscalar]
  rw [← hshift] at hp
  rw [hmap, hmap] at hp
  exact hp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.discreteSupportPeriod_liftsContinuousSupportPeriod
statement:
theorem discreteSupportPeriod_liftsContinuousSupportPeriod
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (I : PlateCompatibleIntegerization K T) (P : VerticalPlate K T)
    {L : ℕ} : 0 < L →
    TranslationalTilings.SetScalarPeriodic L
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.discreteCarrier I.discreteTile
        (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations (I.plateEquiv P))) →
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy P.support
      ((((L : ℝ) / I.scale : ℝ) : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  intro hL hperiod
  have hs : (0 : ℝ) < (I.scale : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast I.scale_pos
  apply affine_period_pullback hs
    (I.carrier_eq P)
  have hreg := regularSupport_eq_regularizedCellUnion I
    (S := Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations (I.plateEquiv P))
  rw [hreg]
  exact discretePeriod_regularizedCellUnion hperiod

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.discreteColumnSupportPeriod_liftsContinuousColumnSupportPeriod
statement:
theorem discreteColumnSupportPeriod_liftsContinuousColumnSupportPeriod
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (I : PlateCompatibleIntegerization K T) {L : ℕ} : 0 < L →

        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Discrete.discreteColumnUnion
          I.discreteTile I.discreteCentres)) →
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy
      (regularSupport K (verticalColumnCentres K T))

proof:

  apply affine_period_pullback hs
    I.columnAggregate_carrier_eq
  have hreg := regularSupport_eq_regularizedCellUnion I

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.discreteCentrePeriod_liftsContinuousCentrePeriod
statement:
theorem discreteCentrePeriod_liftsContinuousCentrePeriod
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (I : PlateCompatibleIntegerization K T) (P : VerticalPlate K T)
    {L : ℕ} : 0 < L →
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.DiscretePeriodicBy
      (Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations (I.plateEquiv P))
      (![(L : ℤ), 0] : TranslationalTilings.Plane) →
    Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy P.centres
      ((((L : ℝ) / I.scale : ℝ) : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  intro hL hperiod x
  let w : TranslationalTilings.Plane := ![(L : ℤ), 0]
  have hw : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint w = (L : ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [w, Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint]
  have hscale : (I.scale : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt I.scale_pos)
  have hformula (t : T) :
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint (I.centreEquiv t) =
        (I.scale : ℝ) •
            ((t : Tiling.Plane) + I.tileAnchor +
              (((I.commonHorizontalShift : ℝ) : ℂ))) +
          (((I.plateVerticalShift (VerticalPlate.ofCentre t) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            Complex.I) :=
    I.centreEquiv_apply t
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨t', ht', htx⟩ := hx
    have ht'cent : (t' : Tiling.Plane) ∈ P.centres := ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩
    have hmem' :
        ((I.centreEquiv t' : I.discreteCentres) : TranslationalTilings.Plane) ∈
          Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations (I.plateEquiv P) :=
      (I.centreEquiv_mem_plate P t').mp ht'cent
    let a' : TranslationalTilings.Plane := I.centreEquiv t'
    let a : TranslationalTilings.Plane := a' - w
    have hmem : a ∈
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.quakePlateTranslations (I.plateEquiv P) := by
      apply (hperiod (a' - w)).mp
      change a' - w + w ∈ _
      simpa [a, a'] using hmem'
    obtain ⟨haT, haP⟩ := hmem
    let t : T := I.centreEquiv.symm ⟨a, haT⟩
    have hct : I.centreEquiv t = (⟨a, haT⟩ : I.discreteCentres) := by
      exact I.centreEquiv.apply_symm_apply _
    have htmem : (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ P.centres := by
      apply (I.centreEquiv_mem_plate P t).mpr
      rw [hct]
      exact ⟨haT, haP⟩
    have hplate_t : VerticalPlate.ofCentre t = P := by
      rcases htmem with ⟨u, hu, huv⟩
      have hut : u = t := Subtype.ext huv
      exact (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff P t).mp (by simpa [hut] using hu)
    have hplate_t' : VerticalPlate.ofCentre t' = P := by
      rcases ht'cent with ⟨u, hu, huv⟩
      have hut : u = t' := Subtype.ext huv
      exact (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff P t').mp (by simpa [hut] using hu)
    have haformula := hformula t
    have hapformula := hformula t'
    have hkey :
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint (I.centreEquiv t) =
          Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint (I.centreEquiv t') -
            Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint w := by
      rw [hct]
      dsimp [a, a']
      rw [Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint_sub]
    have hkeyformula :
        (I.scale : ℝ) •
            ((t : Tiling.Plane) + I.tileAnchor +
              (((I.commonHorizontalShift : ℝ) : ℂ))) +
          (((I.plateVerticalShift (VerticalPlate.ofCentre t) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            Complex.I) =
        ((I.scale : ℝ) •
            ((t' : Tiling.Plane) + I.tileAnchor +
              (((I.commonHorizontalShift : ℝ) : ℂ))) +
          (((I.plateVerticalShift (VerticalPlate.ofCentre t') : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            Complex.I)) - (L : ℂ) := by
      calc
        _ = Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint (I.centreEquiv t) := haformula.symm
        _ = Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint (I.centreEquiv t') -
              Tiling.RationalPolygonal.integerPoint w := hkey
        _ = _ := by rw [hapformula, hw]
    have hta : (t : Tiling.Plane) = x := by
      have hshift : I.plateVerticalShift (VerticalPlate.ofCentre t) =
          I.plateVerticalShift (VerticalPlate.ofCentre t') := by rw [hplate_t, hplate_t']
      apply Complex.ext
      · have hre := congrArg Complex.re hkeyformula
        have htx' := congrArg Complex.re htx
        norm_num [hshift, Complex.add_re, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul,
          Complex.sub_re] at hre htx' ⊢
        rw [htx'] at hre
        field_simp [hscale] at hre
        have hspos : 0 < (I.scale : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast I.scale_pos
        nlinarith
      · have him := congrArg Complex.im hkeyformula
