name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.nontrivialEarthquakeLimitData_of_localizedSequence
statement:
private theorem nontrivialEarthquakeLimitData_of_localizedSequence
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {X : Set ℝ}
    (hXnonempty : X.Nonempty) (hXopen : IsOpen X)
    (hXregular : interior (closure X) = X)
    (T : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X})
    (g : ℕ → Tiling.AxisParallel.aePeriodGroup {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X})
    (S : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X})
    (a z : Tiling.Plane) (zseq : ℕ → Tiling.Plane)
    (hHull : S ∈ Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull T)
    (hconv : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.centresSequence
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translateSequence g T))
      (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
    (haExact : ∀ n, a ∈
      ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate (g n) T).centres :
        Set Tiling.Plane))
    (haS : a ∈ (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
    (hzS : z ∈ (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) (haz : a ≠ z)
    (hzmem : ∀ n, zseq n ∈
      ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate (g n) T).centres :
        Set Tiling.Plane))
    (hzinj : Function.Injective zseq)
    (hzlim : Filter.Tendsto zseq Filter.atTop (nhds z))
    (hzneq : ∀ n, zseq n ≠ z)
    (hzabs : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, z ∉
      ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate (g n) T).centres :
        Set Tiling.Plane)) :
    Nonempty (NontrivialEarthquakeLimitData K X T)
proof:
:= by
  let U := Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translateSequence g T
  have hfront := T.tilesOn.verticalCylinder_frontier_locallyFinite hXopen hXregular
  obtain ⟨phi, D, hphi⟩ := exists_persistentTransientSplit
    hXnonempty hXopen hXregular hfront U S hconv
  have haP : a ∈ D.persistent := by
    have haUnion : a ∈ D.persistent ∪ D.transient := D.union_eq.symm ▸ haS
    rcases haUnion with ha | ha
    · exact ha
    · have he := D.transient_eventuallyNotMem a ha
      have : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, False := he.mono fun n hn => hn (haExact (phi n))
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := this.exists
      exact hn.elim
  have hzT : z ∈ D.transient := by
    have hzUnion : z ∈ D.persistent ∪ D.transient := D.union_eq.symm ▸ hzS
    rcases hzUnion with hz | hz
    · have he := D.persistent_eventuallyMem z hz
      have ha := hzabs.filter_mono hphi.tendsto_atTop
      have : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, False := he.and ha |>.mono fun n hn => hn.2 hn.1
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := this.exists
      exact hn.elim
    · exact hz
  refine ⟨{
    translations := g ∘ phi
    limit := S
    limit_mem_hull := hHull
    converges := ?_
    split := D
    persistent_nonempty := ⟨a, haP⟩
    transient_nonempty := ⟨z, hzT⟩
    fixedPoint := a
    movingLimitPoint := z
    movingCentres := zseq ∘ phi
    fixedPoint_mem_persistent := haP
    movingLimitPoint_mem_transient := hzT
    fixedPoint_ne_movingLimitPoint := haz
    fixedPoint_exact := fun n => haExact (phi n)
    movingCentres_mem := fun n => hzmem (phi n)
    movingCentres_injective := hzinj.comp hphi.injective
    movingCentres_tendsto := hzlim.comp hphi.tendsto_atTop
    movingCentres_ne_limit := fun n => hzneq (phi n)
    movingLimitPoint_eventuallyAbsent := hzabs.filter_mono hphi.tendsto_atTop }⟩
  apply ((locallyFell_metrizable K {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X}).2 _ S).mp
  change Filter.Tendsto (U ∘ phi) Filter.atTop (nhds S)
  exact (((locallyFell_metrizable K {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X}).2 U S).mpr hconv).comp
    hphi.tendsto_atTop

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.exists_planeLocalizedNonFLCOrbitLimit
statement:
private theorem exists_planeLocalizedNonFLCOrbitLimit
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region}
    (T : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ)
    (hTnonFLC : ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC
      (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) :
    ∃ (g : ℕ → Tiling.AxisParallel.aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane))
      (S : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ)
      (a z : Tiling.Plane) (zseq : ℕ → Tiling.Plane),
      S ∈ Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull T ∧
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.centresSequence
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translateSequence g T))
        (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, a ∈
        ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate (g n) T).centres :
          Set Tiling.Plane)) ∧
      a ∈ (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) ∧
      z ∈ (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) ∧ z ≠ a ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, zseq n ∈
        ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate (g n) T).centres :
          Set Tiling.Plane)) ∧
      Function.Injective zseq ∧ Filter.Tendsto zseq Filter.atTop (nhds z) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, zseq n ≠ z) ∧
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
        z ∉ ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate (g n) T).centres :
          Set Tiling.Plane)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨delta, hdelta, hsep⟩ := tilesOn_uniformlySeparated K
  have hloc : ∀ Q : Set Tiling.Plane, Bornology.IsBounded Q →
      ((T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) ∩ Q).Finite :=
    (Tiling.AxisParallel.IsPacking.locallyFinite_centres T.tilesOn.2.1).1
  obtain ⟨R, t, s, r, hR, hmem, hdist, hinj, hlim, hrne, hneq⟩ :=
    exists_varyingDisplacement_of_not_hasFLC hdelta
      (hsep _ _ T.tilesOn) hloc hTnonFLC
  let a : Tiling.Plane := 0
  let g₀ : ℕ → Tiling.AxisParallel.aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane) :=
    fun n ↦ ⟨a - t n, by
      simp [Tiling.AxisParallel.aePeriodGroup, Tiling.Polygonal.aePeriodGroup]⟩
  let U : ℕ → Set Tiling.Plane := fun n ↦
    ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate (g₀ n) T).centres :
      Set Tiling.Plane)
  have hUTiles (n : ℕ) : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K (U n) Set.univ :=
    (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate (g₀ n) T).tilesOn
  have haU (n : ℕ) : a ∈ U n := by
    refine ⟨t n, (hmem n).1, ?_⟩
    change t n + (a - t n) = a
    abel
  obtain ⟨phi, L, hphi, hLTiles, hLclosed, hconv, haLraw⟩ :=
    exists_tilesOn_locallyFellSubsequence U hUTiles
  let S : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K Set.univ :=
    ⟨⟨L, hLclosed⟩, hLTiles⟩
  let g : ℕ → Tiling.AxisParallel.aePeriodGroup (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane) := g₀ ∘ phi
  let zseq : ℕ → Tiling.Plane := fun n ↦ a + (s (phi n) - t (phi n))
  let z : Tiling.Plane := a + r
  have haTranslated (n : ℕ) : a ∈
      ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate (g n) T).centres :
        Set Tiling.Plane) := haU (phi n)
  have hzseqTranslated (n : ℕ) : zseq n ∈
      ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate (g n) T).centres :
        Set Tiling.Plane) := by
    refine ⟨s (phi n), (hmem (phi n)).2, ?_⟩
    change s (phi n) + (a - t (phi n)) = a + (s (phi n) - t (phi n))
    abel
  have hconv' : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.centresSequence
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translateSequence g T))
      (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
    change Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
      (fun n ↦ ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate (g₀ (phi n)) T).centres :
        Set Tiling.Plane)) L
    exact hconv
  have haS : a ∈ (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
    exact haLraw a haTranslated
  have hzlim : Filter.Tendsto zseq Filter.atTop (nhds z) := by
    exact tendsto_const_nhds.add (hlim.comp hphi.tendsto_atTop)
  have hzS : z ∈ (S.centres : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
    exact mem_of_locallyFellConverges_of_tendsto_mem hconv' hzseqTranslated hzlim
  have hzinj : Function.Injective zseq := by
    intro m n hmn
    apply hphi.injective
    apply hinj
    change a + (s (phi m) - t (phi m)) = a + (s (phi n) - t (phi n)) at hmn
    exact add_left_cancel hmn
  have hzneqa : z ≠ a := by
    intro hza
    apply hrne
    change a + r = a at hza
    exact add_left_cancel (hza.trans (add_zero a).symm)
  have hzneq (n : ℕ) : zseq n ≠ z := by
    intro hn
    apply hneq (phi n)
    change a + (s (phi n) - t (phi n)) = a + r at hn
    exact add_left_cancel hn
  have habsent : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
      z ∉ ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate (g n) T).centres :
        Set Tiling.Plane) :=
    eventually_absent_of_uniformlySeparated hdelta
      (fun n ↦ hsep _ _ (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate (g n) T).tilesOn)
      zseq z hzseqTranslated hzlim hzneq
  have htendstoS : Filter.Tendsto
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translateSequence g T)
      Filter.atTop (nhds S) :=
    ((locallyFell_metrizable K Set.univ).2 _ S).mpr hconv'
  have hShull : S ∈ Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull T := by
    apply mem_closure_of_tendsto htendstoS
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ by
      exact AddAction.mem_orbit _ (g n)
  exact ⟨g, S, a, z, zseq, hShull, hconv', haTranslated, haS, hzS, hzneqa,
    hzseqTranslated, hzinj, hzlim, hzneq, habsent⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.latticeAssembly_of_nontrivialEarthquakeLimitData
statement:
private theorem latticeAssembly_of_nontrivialEarthquakeLimitData
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {X : Set ℝ}
    {T : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X}}
    (D : NontrivialEarthquakeLimitData K X T)
    (hXopen : IsOpen X) (hXregular : interior (closure X) = X)
    (Lambda : Tiling.AxisParallel.PlanarLattice)
    (hLambda : Lambda.toAddSubgroup ≤
      Tiling.AxisParallel.aePeriodGroup {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X}) :
    ∃ (lambda : ℕ → Tiling.AxisParallel.aePeriodGroup
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X})
      (gamma : Tiling.AxisParallel.aePeriodGroup
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X})
      (D' : PersistentTransientSplit K X
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translateSequence
          (D.translations + Function.const ℕ gamma) T)
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate gamma D.limit)),
      (∀ n : ℕ, (lambda n : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Lambda.toAddSubgroup) ∧
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate gamma D.limit ∈
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull T ∧
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.centresSequence
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translateSequence lambda T))
        ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate gamma D.limit).centres :
          Set Tiling.Plane) ∧
      D'.persistent.Nonempty ∧ D'.transient.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  let E : Set Tiling.Plane := {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X}
  have hEopen : IsOpen E := hXopen.preimage Complex.continuous_re
  have hEregular : interior (closure E) = E := by
    change interior (closure (Complex.re ⁻¹' X)) = Complex.re ⁻¹' X
    rw [Complex.closure_preimage_re, Complex.interior_preimage_re, hXregular]
  obtain ⟨_phi, lambda, gamma, _hphi, hlambda, _hresidual, hconv⟩ :=
    roundTranslationsToLattice_regularOpen hEopen hEregular Lambda hLambda
      D.translations T D.limit D.converges
  have hseq : (fun n ↦ Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate gamma
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate (D.translations n) T)) =
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translateSequence
        (D.translations + Function.const ℕ gamma) T := by
    funext n
    change gamma +ᵥ (D.translations n +ᵥ T) = (D.translations n + gamma) +ᵥ T
    rw [← add_vadd]
    congr 1
    exact add_comm _ _
  let D0 := D.split.translate gamma
  let D' : PersistentTransientSplit K X
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translateSequence
        (D.translations + Function.const ℕ gamma) T)
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate gamma D.limit) := {
    persistent := D0.persistent
    transient := D0.transient
    persistent_subset := D0.persistent_subset
    transient_subset := D0.transient_subset
    disjoint := D0.disjoint
    union_eq := D0.union_eq
    persistent_eventuallyMem := by
      intro a ha
      filter_upwards [D0.persistent_eventuallyMem a ha] with n hn
      rw [← congrFun hseq n]
      exact hn
    transient_eventuallyNotMem := by
      intro b hb
      filter_upwards [D0.transient_eventuallyNotMem b hb] with n hn
      rw [← congrFun hseq n]
      exact hn
    orientation := D0.orientation
    persistentBase := D0.persistentBase
    transientBase := D0.transientBase
    persistentBase_open := D0.persistentBase_open
    transientBase_open := D0.transientBase_open
    persistentBase_regular := D0.persistentBase_regular
    transientBase_regular := D0.transientBase_regular
    persistentSupport_vertical := D0.persistentSupport_vertical
    transientSupport_vertical := D0.transientSupport_vertical
    persistentSupport_horizontal := D0.persistentSupport_horizontal
    transientSupport_horizontal := D0.transientSupport_horizontal
    horizontal_requires_plane := D0.horizontal_requires_plane
    verticalPersistent_plateSaturated := D0.verticalPersistent_plateSaturated
    verticalTransient_plateSaturated := D0.verticalTransient_plateSaturated
    horizontalPersistent_plateSaturated := D0.horizontalPersistent_plateSaturated
    horizontalTransient_plateSaturated := D0.horizontalTransient_plateSaturated }
  refine ⟨lambda, gamma, D', hlambda, ?_, hconv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← (orbitHull_compact T).2.2 gamma]
    exact ⟨D.limit, D.limit_mem_hull, rfl⟩
  · rcases D.persistent_nonempty with ⟨p, hp⟩
    have hp' : ((D.split.translate gamma).persistent).Nonempty :=
      ⟨(gamma : Tiling.Plane) + p, ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩⟩
    exact hp'
  · rcases D.transient_nonempty with ⟨p, hp⟩
    have hp' : ((D.split.translate gamma).transient).Nonempty :=
      ⟨(gamma : Tiling.Plane) + p, ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩⟩
    exact hp'

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.exists_nontrivialEarthquakeOrbitLimit
statement:
theorem exists_nontrivialEarthquakeOrbitLimit
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {X : Set ℝ}
    (hXnonempty : X.Nonempty) (hXopen : IsOpen X)
    (hXregular : interior (closure X) = X)
    {beta0 : ℝ} (hbeta0 : 0 < beta0)
    (hXperiod : ∀ x : ℝ, x + beta0 ∈ X ↔ x ∈ X)
    (T : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X})
    (hTnonFLC : ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC
      (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane)) :
    Nonempty (NontrivialEarthquakeLimitData K X T)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hXplane : X = Set.univ
  · subst X
    obtain ⟨g, S, a, z, zseq, hHull, hconv, haExact, haS, hzS, hza,
        hzmem, hzinj, hzlim, hzneq, hzabs⟩ :=
      exists_planeLocalizedNonFLCOrbitLimit T hTnonFLC
    exact nontrivialEarthquakeLimitData_of_localizedSequence
      Set.univ_nonempty hXopen hXregular T g S a z zseq hHull hconv haExact
      haS hzS hza.symm hzmem hzinj hzlim hzneq hzabs
  · obtain ⟨g, S, a, z, zseq, hHull, hconv, haExact, haS, hzS, hza,
        hzmem, hzinj, hzlim, hzneq, hzabs⟩ :=
      exists_localizedNonFLCOrbitLimit hXnonempty hXopen hXregular hXplane
        hbeta0 hXperiod T hTnonFLC
    exact nontrivialEarthquakeLimitData_of_localizedSequence
      hXnonempty hXopen hXregular T g S a z zseq hHull hconv haExact
      haS hzS hza.symm hzmem hzinj hzlim hzneq hzabs

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.exists_nontrivialEarthquakeOrbitLimit_latticeTranslations
statement:
theorem exists_nontrivialEarthquakeOrbitLimit_latticeTranslations
    {K : Tiling.AxisParallel.Region} {X : Set ℝ}
    (hXnonempty : X.Nonempty) (hXopen : IsOpen X)
    (hXregular : interior (closure X) = X)
    {beta0 : ℝ} (hbeta0 : 0 < beta0)
    (hXperiod : ∀ x : ℝ, x + beta0 ∈ X ↔ x ∈ X)
    (T : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace K {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X})
    (hTnonFLC : ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC
      (T.centres : Set Tiling.Plane))
    (Lambda : Tiling.AxisParallel.PlanarLattice)
    (hLambda : Lambda.toAddSubgroup ≤
      Tiling.AxisParallel.aePeriodGroup {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X}) :
    ∃ (D : NontrivialEarthquakeLimitData K X T)
      (lambda : ℕ → Tiling.AxisParallel.aePeriodGroup
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X})
      (gamma : Tiling.AxisParallel.aePeriodGroup
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X})
      (D' : PersistentTransientSplit K X
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translateSequence
          (D.translations + Function.const ℕ gamma) T)
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate gamma D.limit)),
      (∀ n : ℕ, (lambda n : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Lambda.toAddSubgroup) ∧
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate gamma D.limit ∈
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.orbitHull T ∧
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.centresSequence
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translateSequence lambda T))
        ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.TilingSpace.translate gamma D.limit).centres :
          Set Tiling.Plane) ∧
      D'.persistent.Nonempty ∧ D'.transient.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := exists_nontrivialEarthquakeOrbitLimit
    hXnonempty hXopen hXregular hbeta0 hXperiod T hTnonFLC
  obtain ⟨lambda, gamma, D', hlambda, hHull, hconv, hp, ht⟩ :=
    latticeAssembly_of_nontrivialEarthquakeLimitData
      D hXopen hXregular Lambda hLambda
  exact ⟨D, lambda, gamma, D', hlambda, hHull, hconv, hp, ht⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.labelledSides_giveHorizontalProperContact
statement:
theorem labelledSides_giveHorizontalProperContact
    {K : Region} {t s : Tiling.Plane}
    {a b a' b' : K.vertices}
    (_hab : a.1 ≠ b.1) (_habIm : a.1.im = b.1.im)
    (habEdge : openSegment ℝ a.1 b.1 ⊆ frontier K.support \ K.vertices)
    (_ha'b' : a'.1 ≠ b'.1) (_ha'b'Im : a'.1.im = b'.1.im)
    (ha'b'Edge : openSegment ℝ a'.1 b'.1 ⊆ frontier K.support \ K.vertices)
    (u v : Tiling.Plane) (huv : u ≠ v) (huvIm : u.im = v.im)
    (hoverlap : openSegment ℝ u v ⊆
      openSegment ℝ (a.1 + t) (b.1 + t) ∩
        openSegment ℝ (a'.1 + s) (b'.1 + s)) :
    HorizontalProperContact K t s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨u, v, huv, huvIm, fun z hz ↦ ?_⟩
  have hzBoth := hoverlap hz
  have hzFirst : z - t ∈ openSegment ℝ a.1 b.1 := by
    rw [show a.1 + t = t +ᵥ a.1 by simp [add_comm],
      show b.1 + t = t +ᵥ b.1 by simp [add_comm], ← vadd_openSegment ℝ] at hzBoth
    simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
      neg_add_eq_sub] using hzBoth.1
  have hzSecond : z - s ∈ openSegment ℝ a'.1 b'.1 := by
    rw [show a'.1 + s = s +ᵥ a'.1 by simp [add_comm],
      show b'.1 + s = s +ᵥ b'.1 by simp [add_comm], ← vadd_openSegment ℝ] at hzBoth
    simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
      neg_add_eq_sub] using hzBoth.2
  have hzFirstEdge := habEdge hzFirst
  have hzSecondEdge := ha'b'Edge hzSecond
  refine ⟨⟨by simpa only [Tiling.AxisParallel.frontier_vadd_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem,
      vadd_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub] using hzFirstEdge.1,
    by simpa only [Tiling.AxisParallel.frontier_vadd_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem,
      vadd_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub] using hzSecondEdge.1⟩, ?_⟩
  intro hzVertices
  rcases hzVertices with hzVertices | hzVertices
  · rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hzVertices
    exact hzFirstEdge.2 (by simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hzVertices)
  · rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hzVertices
    exact hzSecondEdge.2 (by simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hzVertices)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.im_eq_of_mem_openSegment_horizontal
statement:
private theorem im_eq_of_mem_openSegment_horizontal
    {a b p : Tiling.Plane} (hab : a.im = b.im)
    (hp : p ∈ openSegment ℝ a b) : p.im = a.im
proof:
:= by
  rw [openSegment_eq_image] at hp
  obtain ⟨r, _hr, rfl⟩ := hp
  simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hab]
  ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.re_mem_openSegment_of_mem
statement:
private theorem re_mem_openSegment_of_mem
    {a b p : Tiling.Plane} (hp : p ∈ openSegment ℝ a b) :
    p.re ∈ openSegment ℝ a.re b.re
proof:
:= by
  rw [openSegment_eq_image] at hp ⊢
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  simpa using congrArg Complex.re h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.properContact_lower
statement:
private theorem properContact_lower
    (K : Region) (s t : Tiling.Plane) :
    HorizontalProperContact K s t ↔
      ∃ v v' w w' : K.vertices,
        IsIntrinsicHorizontalSide K v v' ∧
        IsIntrinsicHorizontalSide K w w' ∧
        (v.1 + s).im = (w.1 + t).im ∧
        (Set.Ioo (min v.1.re v'.1.re + s.re)
            (max v.1.re v'.1.re + s.re) ∩
          Set.Ioo (min w.1.re w'.1.re + t.re)
            (max w.1.re w'.1.re + t.re)).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, d, hcd, hcdIm, hcontact⟩
    let p : Tiling.Plane := midpoint ℝ c d
    have hpCD : p ∈ openSegment ℝ c d := midpoint_mem_openSegment c d
    have hpContact := hcontact hpCD
    have hpSFrontier : p - s ∈ frontier K.support :=
      by simpa only [Tiling.AxisParallel.frontier_vadd_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem,
      vadd_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub] using hpContact.1.1
    have hpSNotVertex : p - s ∉ K.vertices := by
      intro hpVertex
      apply hpContact.2
      left
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      simpa [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hpVertex
    have hpTFrontier : p - t ∈ frontier K.support :=
      by simpa only [Tiling.AxisParallel.frontier_vadd_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem,
      vadd_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub] using hpContact.1.2
    have hpTNotVertex : p - t ∉ K.vertices := by
      intro hpVertex
      apply hpContact.2
      right
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      simpa [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hpVertex
    obtain ⟨axisS, v, v', hvv, hvvCoord, hpVV, hvvEdge⟩ :=
      Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.nonvertexFrontier_mem_intrinsicEdge
        K (p - s) hpSFrontier hpSNotVertex
    have hvvIm : v.1.im = v'.1.im := by
      cases axisS with
      | horizontal => exact hvvCoord
      | vertical =>
          exfalso
          apply hpSNotVertex
          exact K.isPolygonal.mem_vertexSet_of_perpendicular_openSegments
            (c := c - s) (d := d - s) (p := p - s)
            (v := v.1) (w := v'.1) (by intro h; exact hcd (sub_left_inj.mp h))
            (by simp only [Complex.sub_im]; linarith)
            (by
              intro z hz
              have hzPlaced := mem_openSegment_sub_iff.mp hz
              simpa [Tiling.AxisParallel.frontier_vadd_eq,
                Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
                neg_add_eq_sub] using (hcontact hzPlaced).1.1)
            (by apply mem_openSegment_sub_iff.mpr; simpa using hpCD)
            hvv hvvCoord hpVV (by intro z hz; exact (hvvEdge hz).1)
    obtain ⟨axisT, w, w', hww, hwwCoord, hpWW, hwwEdge⟩ :=
      Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.nonvertexFrontier_mem_intrinsicEdge
        K (p - t) hpTFrontier hpTNotVertex
    have hwwIm : w.1.im = w'.1.im := by
      cases axisT with
      | horizontal => exact hwwCoord
      | vertical =>
          exfalso
          apply hpTNotVertex
          exact K.isPolygonal.mem_vertexSet_of_perpendicular_openSegments
            (c := c - t) (d := d - t) (p := p - t)
            (v := w.1) (w := w'.1) (by intro h; exact hcd (sub_left_inj.mp h))
            (by simp only [Complex.sub_im]; linarith)
            (by
              intro z hz
              have hzPlaced := mem_openSegment_sub_iff.mp hz
              simpa [Tiling.AxisParallel.frontier_vadd_eq,
                Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
                neg_add_eq_sub] using (hcontact hzPlaced).1.2)
            (by apply mem_openSegment_sub_iff.mpr; simpa using hpCD)
            hww hwwCoord hpWW (by intro z hz; exact (hwwEdge hz).1)
    have hpVVPlaced : p ∈ openSegment ℝ (v.1 + s) (v'.1 + s) := by
      rw [show v.1 + s = s +ᵥ v.1 by simp [add_comm],
        show v'.1 + s = s +ᵥ v'.1 by simp [add_comm], ← vadd_openSegment ℝ]
      simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
        neg_add_eq_sub] using hpVV
    have hpWWPlaced : p ∈ openSegment ℝ (w.1 + t) (w'.1 + t) := by
      rw [show w.1 + t = t +ᵥ w.1 by simp [add_comm],
        show w'.1 + t = t +ᵥ w'.1 by simp [add_comm], ← vadd_openSegment ℝ]
      simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add,
        neg_add_eq_sub] using hpWW
    refine ⟨v, v', w, w', ⟨hvv, hvvIm, hvvEdge⟩,
      ⟨hww, hwwIm, hwwEdge⟩, ?_, ⟨p.re, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have hpSIm := im_eq_of_mem_openSegment_horizontal hvvIm hpVV
      have hpTIm := im_eq_of_mem_openSegment_horizontal hwwIm hpWW
      simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im] at hpSIm hpTIm ⊢
      linarith
    · have hreal := re_mem_openSegment_of_mem hpVVPlaced
      have hvvPlacedRe : (v.1 + s).re ≠ (v'.1 + s).re := by
        intro h
        apply hvv
        exact Complex.ext (add_right_cancel h) hvvIm
      rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo' hvvPlacedRe] at hreal
      simpa only [translatedHorizontalInterval, ← min_add_add_right,
        ← max_add_add_right, Complex.add_re] using hreal
    · have hreal := re_mem_openSegment_of_mem hpWWPlaced
      have hwwPlacedRe : (w.1 + t).re ≠ (w'.1 + t).re := by
        intro h
        apply hww
        exact Complex.ext (add_right_cancel h) hwwIm
      rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo' hwwPlacedRe] at hreal
      simpa only [translatedHorizontalInterval, ← min_add_add_right,
        ← max_add_add_right, Complex.add_re] using hreal
  · rintro ⟨v, v', w, w', ⟨hvv, hvvIm, hvvEdge⟩,
      ⟨hww, hwwIm, hwwEdge⟩, hheight, hoverlap⟩
    rw [Set.Ioo_inter_Ioo, Set.nonempty_Ioo] at hoverlap
    let lo := max (min v.1.re v'.1.re + s.re)
      (min w.1.re w'.1.re + t.re)
    let hi := min (max v.1.re v'.1.re + s.re)
      (max w.1.re w'.1.re + t.re)
    have hlohiLt : lo < hi := hoverlap
    let u : Tiling.Plane := (lo : ℂ) + (v.1 + s).im * Complex.I
    let z : Tiling.Plane := (hi : ℂ) + (v.1 + s).im * Complex.I
    have huz : u ≠ z := by
      intro h
      have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
      simp only [u, z, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, Complex.I_im, mul_one,
        zero_sub, neg_zero, add_zero] at hre
      exact hlohiLt.ne hre
    have huzIm : u.im = z.im := by simp [u, z]
    apply labelledSides_giveHorizontalProperContact hvv hvvIm hvvEdge
      hww hwwIm hwwEdge u z huz huzIm
    intro q hq
    have hqIm := im_eq_of_mem_openSegment_horizontal huzIm hq
    have hqRe : q.re ∈ openSegment ℝ lo hi := by
      simpa [u, z] using re_mem_openSegment_of_mem hq
    rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo' hlohiLt.ne] at hqRe
    simp only [min_eq_left hlohiLt.le, max_eq_right hlohiLt.le] at hqRe
    have hqFirstInterval : q.re ∈
        Set.Ioo (min v.1.re v'.1.re + s.re)
          (max v.1.re v'.1.re + s.re) := by
      exact ⟨(le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hqRe.1,
        hqRe.2.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)⟩
    have hqSecondInterval : q.re ∈
        Set.Ioo (min w.1.re w'.1.re + t.re)
          (max w.1.re w'.1.re + t.re) := by
      exact ⟨(le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hqRe.1,
        hqRe.2.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)⟩
    have hvvPlaced : v.1 + s ≠ v'.1 + s := by
      intro h
      exact hvv (add_right_cancel h)
    have hvvPlacedIm : (v.1 + s).im = (v'.1 + s).im := by
      simp only [Complex.add_im, hvvIm]
    have hqAsFirst : (q.re : ℂ) + (v.1 + s).im * Complex.I = q := by
      have huIm : u.im = (v.1 + s).im := by simp [u]
      have hqIm' : q.im = (v.1 + s).im := hqIm.trans huIm
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp
      · simpa only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_add,
          Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one,
          Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero] using hqIm'.symm
    have hqFirst : q ∈ openSegment ℝ (v.1 + s) (v'.1 + s) := by
      rw [← hqAsFirst, horizontal_point_mem_openSegment_iff hvvPlaced hvvPlacedIm]
      have hvvPlacedRe : (v.1 + s).re ≠ (v'.1 + s).re := by
        intro h
        apply hvv
        exact Complex.ext (add_right_cancel h) hvvIm
      rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo' hvvPlacedRe]
      simpa only [translatedHorizontalInterval, ← min_add_add_right,
        ← max_add_add_right, Complex.add_re] using hqFirstInterval
    have hwwPlaced : w.1 + t ≠ w'.1 + t := by
      intro h
      exact hww (add_right_cancel h)
    have hwwPlacedIm : (w.1 + t).im = (w'.1 + t).im := by
      simp only [Complex.add_im, hwwIm]
    have hqSecond : q ∈ openSegment ℝ (w.1 + t) (w'.1 + t) := by
      have hqAsSecond : (q.re : ℂ) + (w.1 + t).im * Complex.I = q := by
        rw [← hheight]
        exact hqAsFirst
      rw [← hqAsSecond, horizontal_point_mem_openSegment_iff hwwPlaced hwwPlacedIm]
      have hwwPlacedRe : (w.1 + t).re ≠ (w'.1 + t).re := by
        intro h
        apply hww
        exact Complex.ext (add_right_cancel h) hwwIm
      rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo' hwwPlacedRe]
      simpa only [translatedHorizontalInterval, ← min_add_add_right,
        ← max_add_add_right, Complex.add_re] using hqSecondInterval
    exact ⟨hqFirst, hqSecond⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.SlabBoundaryWord.gapSet_eq
proof:

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.SlabBoundaryWord.isPeriodic_iff
statement:
theorem SlabBoundaryWord.isPeriodic_iff
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (W : SlabBoundaryWord K T) (k : ℕ) (beta : ℝ) :
    W.IsPeriodic k beta ↔
      0 < k ∧ 0 < beta ∧
      ∀ i : ℤ,
        W.position (i + k) = W.position i + beta ∧
        W.label (i + k) = W.label i
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.mapScalar_sub
statement:
private theorem mapScalar_sub
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ C.coordinateSpace) (hy : y ∈ C.coordinateSpace) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi
        ⟨x - y, C.coordinateSpace.sub_mem hx hy⟩ =
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi ⟨x, hx⟩ -
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi ⟨y, hy⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hsub :
      (⟨x - y, C.coordinateSpace.sub_mem hx hy⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) =
        ⟨x, hx⟩ - ⟨y, hy⟩ := rfl
  simp only [Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar]
  rw [hsub, map_sub, Rat.cast_sub]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.secondApproximation_reflectsSlabBoundaryPeriod
statement:
theorem secondApproximation_reflectsSlabBoundaryPeriod
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (D : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.CoordinateDeformation C phi)
    (_P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.TwoStageDeformationSupportTransport
      C phi D)
    (_hFHC : HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity C.centres)
    (W : SlabBoundaryWord C.region C.centres)
    (hBoundaryMem : ∀ i : ℤ,
      W.position i ∈ C.coordinateSpace)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (hInjective : ∀ i j : ℤ,
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi
        ⟨W.position (i + 1) - W.position i,
          C.coordinateSpace.sub_mem
            (hBoundaryMem (i + 1)) (hBoundaryMem i)⟩ =
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi
          ⟨W.position (j + 1) - W.position j,
          C.coordinateSpace.sub_mem
            (hBoundaryMem (j + 1)) (hBoundaryMem j)⟩ →
      W.position (i + 1) - W.position i =
        W.position (j + 1) - W.position j)
    (hImagePeriod : ∃ b : ℝ, 0 < b ∧
      ∀ i : ℤ,
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi
            ⟨W.position i, hBoundaryMem i⟩ + b =
          Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi
            ⟨W.position (i + k), hBoundaryMem (i + k)⟩ ∧
        W.label (i + k) = W.label i) :
    ∃ beta : ℝ, 0 < beta ∧ W.IsPeriodic k beta
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, _hb, hperiod⟩ := hImagePeriod
  have hgap (i : ℤ) :
      W.position (i + 1) - W.position i =
        W.position ((i + k) + 1) - W.position (i + k) := by
    apply hInjective i (i + k)
    rw [mapScalar_sub C phi (hBoundaryMem (i + 1)) (hBoundaryMem i)]
    rw [mapScalar_sub C phi (hBoundaryMem ((i + k) + 1))
      (hBoundaryMem (i + k))]
    have hi := (hperiod i).1
    have hi1 := (hperiod (i + 1)).1
    have hindex : i + 1 + (k : ℤ) = (i + (k : ℤ)) + 1 := by omega
    rw [hindex] at hi1
    linarith
  let displacement : ℤ → ℝ :=
    fun i ↦ W.position (i + k) - W.position i
  have hdisplacement_succ (i : ℤ) :
      displacement (i + 1) = displacement i := by
    dsimp [displacement]
    have hindex : i + 1 + (k : ℤ) = (i + (k : ℤ)) + 1 := by omega
    rw [hindex]
    linarith [hgap i]
  have hdisplacement (i : ℤ) : displacement i = displacement 0 := by
    refine Int.inductionOn' i 0 rfl ?_ ?_
    · intro j _hj hj
      exact (hdisplacement_succ j).trans hj
    · intro j _hj hj
      calc
        displacement (j - 1) = displacement ((j - 1) + 1) :=
          (hdisplacement_succ (j - 1)).symm
        _ = displacement j := by congr 1; omega
        _ = displacement 0 := hj
  let beta : ℝ := W.position (k : ℤ) - W.position 0
  have hkInt : (0 : ℤ) < (k : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hbeta : 0 < beta := by
    exact sub_pos.mpr (W.position_strictMono hkInt)
  refine ⟨beta, hbeta, hk, hbeta, ?_⟩
  intro i
  constructor
  · have hi := hdisplacement i
    dsimp only [displacement] at hi
    simp only [zero_add] at hi
    dsimp only [beta]
    linarith
  · exact (hperiod i).2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.carrier_translation_image
statement:
private theorem carrier_translation_image
    {K : Region} (v₀ : Tiling.Plane) (C : Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (hcarrier : C.region.openCarrier = (-v₀) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) :
    K.openCarrier = positiveSimilarity 1 v₀ '' C.region.openCarrier
proof:
:= by

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.centres_translation_image
statement:
private theorem centres_translation_image
    {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (t₀ : Tiling.Plane)
    (C : Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (hcentres : C.centres = (-t₀) +ᵥ T) :

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalColumnSupport_verticalInvariant
statement:
private theorem verticalColumnSupport_verticalInvariant
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (y : ℝ) :
    (((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) +ᵥ
        regularSupport K (verticalColumnCentres K T)) =
      regularSupport K (verticalColumnCentres K T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [verticalColumnCentres_eq, regularSupport_iUnion]
  rw [← interior_vadd, ← closure_vadd]
  congr 2
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P, hzP⟩
    refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
    have hinv := (VerticalPlate.isCenterColumn_of_isVerticalColumn
      hTile P.1 P.2).2.2.2 y
    have hmem := Set.ext_iff.mp hinv z
    simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hmem
    exact hmem.mp hzP
  · rintro ⟨P, hzP⟩
    refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
    have hinv := (VerticalPlate.isCenterColumn_of_isVerticalColumn
      hTile P.1 P.2).2.2.2 y
    have hmem := Set.ext_iff.mp hinv z
    simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hmem
    exact hmem.mpr hzP

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalInvariant_realSection_vadd
statement:
private theorem verticalInvariant_realSection_vadd
    (D : Set Tiling.Plane)
    (hD : ∀ y : ℝ, (((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) +ᵥ D) = D)
    (g : Tiling.Plane) :
    {x : ℝ | (x : ℂ) ∈ g +ᵥ D} =
      g.re +ᵥ {x : ℝ | (x : ℂ) ∈ D}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  have mem_iff_real (z : Tiling.Plane) : z ∈ D ↔ (z.re : ℂ) ∈ D := by
    have hm := Set.ext_iff.mp (hD (-z.im)) (z.re : ℂ)
    simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hm
    have heq : -( ((-z.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) +ᵥ (z.re : ℂ) = z := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp
    rwa [heq] at hm
  rw [mem_iff_real]
  simp only [vadd_eq_add, Complex.add_re, Complex.neg_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
    add_comm]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.real_affine_image_eq_vadd
statement:
private theorem real_affine_image_eq_vadd (a : ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) :
    (fun x : ℝ ↦ x + a) '' S = a +ᵥ S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    simpa [add_comm] using hy
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨x - a, ?_, by ring⟩
    simpa [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hx

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.normalization_geometryTransport_core
statement:
private theorem normalization_geometryTransport_core
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (v₀ t₀ : Tiling.Plane)
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (hcarrier : C.region.openCarrier = (-v₀) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
    (hcentres : C.centres = (-t₀) +ᵥ T) (_hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    ∃ e : VerticalPlate C.region C.centres ≃ VerticalPlate K T,
      (∀ P, (e P).centres = t₀ +ᵥ P.centres) ∧
      (∀ P, IsVerticalColumn (e P) ↔ IsVerticalColumn P) ∧
      (∀ P, (e P).support = (v₀ + t₀) +ᵥ P.support) ∧
      verticalColumnCentres K T =
        t₀ +ᵥ verticalColumnCentres C.region C.centres ∧
      regularSupport K (verticalColumnCentres K T) =
        (v₀ + t₀) +ᵥ
          regularSupport C.region (verticalColumnCentres C.region C.centres)
proof:
:= by
  have hK := carrier_translation_image v₀ C hcarrier
  have hT := centres_translation_image t₀ C hcentres
  subst T
  let e : VerticalPlate C.region C.centres ≃
      VerticalPlate K (positiveSimilarity 1 t₀ '' C.centres) :=
    verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv (by norm_num) hK t₀
  refine ⟨e, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro P
    rw [verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_centres_image]
    rw [positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul, one_smul]
  · intro P
    exact (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_isVerticalColumn
      (by norm_num) hK t₀ P).symm
  · intro P
    rw [verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_support_image]
    rw [positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul, one_smul]
  · rw [verticalColumnCentres_positiveSimilarity_image (by norm_num) hK]
    rw [positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul, one_smul]
  · rw [verticalColumnSupport_positiveSimilarity_image (by norm_num) hK]
    rw [positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul, one_smul]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.normalization_geometryTransport
statement:
private theorem normalization_geometryTransport
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (v₀ t₀ : Tiling.Plane)
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (hcarrier : C.region.openCarrier = (-v₀) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
    (hcentres : C.centres = (-t₀) +ᵥ T) (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    ∃ e : VerticalPlate C.region C.centres ≃ VerticalPlate K T,
      (∀ P, (e P).centres = t₀ +ᵥ P.centres) ∧
      (∀ P, IsVerticalColumn (e P) ↔ IsVerticalColumn P) ∧
      (∀ P, (e P).support = (v₀ + t₀) +ᵥ P.support) ∧
      verticalColumnCentres K T =
        t₀ +ᵥ verticalColumnCentres C.region C.centres ∧
      regularSupport K (verticalColumnCentres K T) =
        (v₀ + t₀) +ᵥ
          regularSupport C.region (verticalColumnCentres C.region C.centres) ∧
      totalSlabBoundary K T =
        (v₀ + t₀).re +ᵥ totalSlabBoundary C.region C.centres
proof:
:= by
  have hK := carrier_translation_image v₀ C hcarrier
  have hT := centres_translation_image t₀ C hcentres
  subst T
  let e : VerticalPlate C.region C.centres ≃
      VerticalPlate K (positiveSimilarity 1 t₀ '' C.centres) :=
    verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv (by norm_num) hK t₀
  have heCentres (P : VerticalPlate C.region C.centres) :
      (e P).centres = t₀ +ᵥ P.centres := by
    rw [verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_centres_image]
    rw [positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul, one_smul]
  have heColumn (P : VerticalPlate C.region C.centres) :
      IsVerticalColumn (e P) ↔ IsVerticalColumn P :=
    (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_isVerticalColumn
      (by norm_num) hK t₀ P).symm
  have heSupport (P : VerticalPlate C.region C.centres) :
      (e P).support = (v₀ + t₀) +ᵥ P.support := by
    rw [verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_support_image]
    rw [positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul, one_smul]
  have hcolumns :
      verticalColumnCentres K (positiveSimilarity 1 t₀ '' C.centres) =
        t₀ +ᵥ verticalColumnCentres C.region C.centres := by
    rw [verticalColumnCentres_positiveSimilarity_image (by norm_num) hK]
    rw [positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul, one_smul]
  have hcolumnSupport :
      regularSupport K
          (verticalColumnCentres K (positiveSimilarity 1 t₀ '' C.centres)) =
        (v₀ + t₀) +ᵥ regularSupport C.region
          (verticalColumnCentres C.region C.centres) := by
    rw [verticalColumnSupport_positiveSimilarity_image (by norm_num) hK]
    rw [positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul, one_smul]
  refine ⟨e, heCentres, heColumn, heSupport, hcolumns, hcolumnSupport, ?_⟩
  have hCTile : TilesOn C.region C.centres Set.univ := by
    have himageTarget : positiveSimilarity 1 (v₀ + t₀) '' Set.univ =
        (Set.univ : Set Tiling.Plane) := by
      rw [positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul, one_smul]
      simp
    apply (tilesOn_positiveSimilarity_iff (by norm_num) hK).mp
    rw [himageTarget]
    exact hTile
  let a : ℝ := (v₀ + t₀).re
  have hcolumnBase :
      {x : ℝ | (x : ℂ) ∈ regularSupport K
        (verticalColumnCentres K (positiveSimilarity 1 t₀ '' C.centres))} =
        a +ᵥ {x : ℝ | (x : ℂ) ∈
          regularSupport C.region (verticalColumnCentres C.region C.centres)} := by
    rw [hcolumnSupport]
    exact verticalInvariant_realSection_vadd _
      (verticalColumnSupport_verticalInvariant hCTile) (v₀ + t₀)
  have hplateBase (P : VerticalPlate C.region C.centres) :
      (e P).base = a +ᵥ P.base := by
    change (verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv
      (by norm_num) hK t₀ P).base = _
    rw [verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_base_affine_real_image]
    have h := real_affine_image_eq_vadd a P.base
    simpa [a] using h
  have hnoncolumn :
      (⋃ Q : {Q : VerticalPlate K (positiveSimilarity 1 t₀ '' C.centres) |
        ¬ IsVerticalColumn Q}, frontier Q.1.base) =
        a +ᵥ (⋃ P : {P : VerticalPlate C.region C.centres |
          ¬ IsVerticalColumn P}, frontier P.1.base) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      rintro ⟨Q, hxQ⟩
      let P : VerticalPlate C.region C.centres := e.symm Q.1
      have hPnoncol : ¬ IsVerticalColumn P := by
        intro hP
        apply Q.2
        have : IsVerticalColumn (e P) := (heColumn P).mpr hP
        simpa [P] using this
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, Set.mem_iUnion]
      refine ⟨⟨P, hPnoncol⟩, ?_⟩
      have hb := hplateBase P
      have htranslate := (Homeomorph.addLeft a).image_frontier P.base
      simp only [Homeomorph.coe_addLeft, ← vadd_eq_add, Set.image_vadd] at htranslate
      rw [show Q.1 = e P by simp [P], hb, ← htranslate] at hxQ
      simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] using hxQ
    · rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, Set.mem_iUnion]
      rintro ⟨P, hxP⟩
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      have heNoncol : ¬ IsVerticalColumn (e P.1) := fun h ↦ P.2 ((heColumn P.1).mp h)
      refine ⟨⟨e P.1, heNoncol⟩, ?_⟩
      have htranslate := (Homeomorph.addLeft a).image_frontier P.1.base
      simp only [Homeomorph.coe_addLeft, ← vadd_eq_add, Set.image_vadd] at htranslate
      rw [hplateBase P.1, ← htranslate]
      simpa only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  unfold totalSlabBoundary
  have htranslate := (Homeomorph.addLeft a).image_frontier
    {x : ℝ | (x : ℂ) ∈ regularSupport C.region
      (verticalColumnCentres C.region C.centres)}
  simp only [Homeomorph.coe_addLeft, ← vadd_eq_add, Set.image_vadd] at htranslate
  rw [hcolumnBase, ← htranslate]
  rw [hnoncolumn]
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, a]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.normalizedContext_exists
statement:
private theorem normalizedContext_exists :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}, TilesOn K T Set.univ →
      HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity T →
      ∃ (v₀ t₀ : Tiling.Plane) (_hv₀ : v₀ ∈ K.vertices) (_ht₀ : t₀ ∈ T)
        (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext.{u}),
        C.region.openCarrier = (-v₀) +ᵥ K.openCarrier ∧
        C.centres = (-t₀) +ᵥ T ∧ C.target = Set.univ ∧
        TilesOn C.region C.centres Set.univ ∧
        HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity C.centres ∧
        ∀ beta : ℝ, SlabPeriodicityConclusion C.region C.centres beta →
          SlabPeriodicityConclusion K T beta
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile hFHC
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀, _w, _hw, _hmax, _hdiam⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.exists_intrinsicDiameterPair K
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hTile.2.2.exists
  obtain ⟨t₀, _hzt₀⟩ := hz.mp (Set.mem_univ z)
  obtain ⟨C, hCcarrier, hCcentres, hCtarget, hCtile⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.normalizeApproximationContext
      K T Set.univ v₀ hv₀ t₀.1 t₀.2
  have htarget : C.target = Set.univ := by
    rw [hCtarget]
    simp
  have hCTile : TilesOn C.region C.centres Set.univ := by
    rw [← htarget]
    exact hCtile.mp hTile
  have hprojection : horizontalCentreProjection C.centres =
      (-t₀.1.re) +ᵥ horizontalCentreProjection T := by
    ext x
    rw [horizontalCentreProjection, horizontalCentreProjection, hCcentres]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨s.re, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      simp
    · rintro ⟨r, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨-t₀.1 + s, ⟨s, hs, by simp⟩, ?_⟩
      simp
  have hCFHC : HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity C.centres := by
    unfold HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity
    rw [hprojection]
    exact hFHC.vadd (-t₀.1.re)
  refine ⟨v₀, t₀.1, hv₀, t₀.2, C, hCcarrier, hCcentres,
    htarget, hCTile, hCFHC, ?_⟩
  intro beta hperiod
  obtain ⟨e, _heCentres, heColumn, heSupport, _hcolumns, hcolumnSupport,
      _hboundary⟩ :=
    normalization_geometryTransport v₀ t₀.1 C hCcarrier hCcentres hTile
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcolumnSupport]
    exact Tiling.RationalPolygonal.setPeriodicBy_vadd (v₀ + t₀.1) hperiod.1
  · intro P hP
    let Q : VerticalPlate C.region C.centres := e.symm P
    have hQ : ¬ IsVerticalColumn Q := by
      intro h
      apply hP
      have : IsVerticalColumn (e Q) := (heColumn Q).mpr h
      simpa [Q] using this
    have hs := heSupport Q
    have hp := Tiling.RationalPolygonal.setPeriodicBy_vadd (v₀ + t₀.1)
      (hperiod.2 Q hQ)
    rw [show P = e Q by simp [Q], hs]
    exact hp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalColumnCentres_subset
statement:
theorem verticalColumnCentres_subset
    (K : Region) (T : Set Tiling.Plane) : verticalColumnCentres K T ⊆ T
proof:
:= by
  rw [verticalColumnCentres_eq]
  rintro x hx
  rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
  obtain ⟨P, t, _htP, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact t.2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.regularSupport_mono_local
statement:
private theorem regularSupport_mono_local
    (K : Region) {S U : Set Tiling.Plane} (hSU : S ⊆ U) :
    regularSupport K S ⊆ regularSupport K U
proof:
:= by
  unfold regularSupport Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport
  exact interior_mono (closure_mono (by
    intro x hx
    rw [Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion,
      ← Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion] at hx ⊢
    obtain ⟨s, hxs⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨⟨s.1, hSU s.2⟩, hxs⟩))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalColumnSupport_isVerticalSlab
statement:
private theorem verticalColumnSupport_isVerticalSlab
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    ∃ X : Set ℝ, X = interior (closure X) ∧
      regularSupport K (verticalColumnCentres K T) = Complex.re ⁻¹' X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := (verticalInvariant_iff_product
    (regularSupport K (verticalColumnCentres K T))).mp
      (verticalColumnSupport_verticalInvariant hTile)
  have hreg := (regularSupport_isRegularOpen K
    (verticalColumnCentres K T)).2
  change regularSupport K (verticalColumnCentres K T) = Complex.re ⁻¹' X at hX
  rw [hX, Complex.closure_preimage_re, Complex.interior_preimage_re] at hreg
  refine ⟨X, ?_, hX⟩
  ext x
  have hx := Set.ext_iff.mp hreg (x : ℂ)
  simpa using hx.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.slabComponents_partition
statement:
private theorem slabComponents_partition
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    (∀ S ∈ slabComponentFamily K T, S ⊆ T) ∧
    (∀ S ∈ slabComponentFamily K T,
      ∃ X : Set ℝ, X = interior (closure X) ∧
        regularSupport K S = Complex.re ⁻¹' X) ∧
    (∀ S ∈ slabComponentFamily K T,
      ∀ U ∈ slabComponentFamily K T, S ≠ U →
        Disjoint (regularSupport K S) (regularSupport K U)) ∧
    (⋃ S : slabComponentFamily K T,
      regularSupport K (S : Set Tiling.Plane)) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  have hplateSubset (P : VerticalPlate K T) : P.centres ⊆ T := by
    rintro x ⟨t, _ht, rfl⟩
    exact t.2
  let _ : Countable T := hTile.1.to_subtype
  let _ : Countable (VerticalPlate K T) := by
    apply Function.Surjective.countable
      (f := fun t : T ↦ VerticalPlate.ofCentre (K := K) t)
    intro P
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := P.nonempty_supp
    refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
    exact (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff P p).1 hp
  have hplatePartition := regularSupport_pairwiseDisjoint
    (@VerticalPlate.centres K T) (verticalPlateCentres_pairwiseDisjoint K T)
      (iUnion_verticalPlateCentres K T) hTile
  have hcolumnNoncolumn (P : VerticalPlate K T) (hP : ¬ IsVerticalColumn P) :
      Disjoint (regularSupport K (verticalColumnCentres K T)) P.support := by
    let parts : Bool → Set Tiling.Plane
      | false => verticalColumnCentres K T
      | true => T \ verticalColumnCentres K T
    have hparts : Set.PairwiseDisjoint Set.univ parts := by
      intro i _ j _ hij
      cases i <;> cases j
      · exact (hij rfl).elim
      · exact Set.disjoint_left.2 fun _ hx hy ↦ hy.2 hx
      · exact Set.disjoint_left.2 fun _ hx hy ↦ hx.2 hy
      · exact (hij rfl).elim
    have hunion : (⋃ i, parts i) = T := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        cases i
        · exact verticalColumnCentres_subset K T hi
        · exact hi.1
      · intro hx
        by_cases hc : x ∈ verticalColumnCentres K T
        · exact ⟨false, hc⟩
        · exact ⟨true, hx, hc⟩
    have hdisj := (regularSupport_pairwiseDisjoint parts hparts hunion hTile).1
      (Set.mem_univ false) (Set.mem_univ true) (by decide)
    have hPcomp : P.centres ⊆ T \ verticalColumnCentres K T := by
      intro x hx
      refine ⟨hplateSubset P hx, ?_⟩
      intro hxc
      rw [verticalColumnCentres_eq, Set.mem_iUnion] at hxc
      obtain ⟨Q, hxQ⟩ := hxc
      have hmeet : (P.centres ∩ Q.1.centres).Nonempty := ⟨x, hx, hxQ⟩
      have : P = Q.1 := by
        by_contra hne
        have hd := verticalPlateCentres_pairwiseDisjoint K T
          (Set.mem_univ P) (Set.mem_univ Q.1) hne
        exact Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mpr hd.inter_eq hmeet
      exact hP (this ▸ Q.2)
    exact hdisj.mono_right (regularSupport_mono_local K hPcomp)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro S hS
    rcases hS with ⟨rfl, _⟩ | ⟨P, _hP, rfl⟩
    · exact verticalColumnCentres_subset K T
    · exact hplateSubset P
  · intro S hS
    rcases hS with ⟨rfl, _⟩ | ⟨P, _hP, rfl⟩
    · exact verticalColumnSupport_isVerticalSlab hTile
    · exact ⟨P.base, (P.support_isVerticalSlab hTile).1,
        (P.support_isVerticalSlab hTile).2⟩
  · intro S hS U hU hSU
    rcases hS with ⟨rfl, _⟩ | ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩
    · rcases hU with ⟨hU, _⟩ | ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩
      · exact (hSU hU.symm).elim
      · exact hcolumnNoncolumn Q hQ
    · rcases hU with ⟨rfl, _⟩ | ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩
      · exact (hcolumnNoncolumn P hP).symm
      · have hPQ : P ≠ Q := by
          intro heq
          apply hSU
          rw [heq]
        exact hplatePartition.1 (Set.mem_univ P) (Set.mem_univ Q) hPQ
  · filter_upwards [hplatePartition.2] with x hx
    apply propext
    constructor
    · intro _
      exact Set.mem_univ x
    · intro _
      change x ∈ ⋃ S : slabComponentFamily K T,
        regularSupport K (S : Set Tiling.Plane)
      have hxmem : x ∈ ⋃ P : VerticalPlate K T,
          regularSupport K P.centres := by
        change (⋃ P : VerticalPlate K T, regularSupport K P.centres) x
        rw [hx]
        trivial
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxmem ⊢
      obtain ⟨P, hxP⟩ := hxmem
      by_cases hP : IsVerticalColumn P
      · have hcolNe : (verticalColumnCentres K T).Nonempty := by
          obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := P.nonempty_supp
          have hpCentres : p.1 ∈ P.centres := ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨p.1, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨P, hP⟩, hpCentres⟩⟩
        refine ⟨⟨verticalColumnCentres K T, Or.inl ⟨rfl, hcolNe⟩⟩, ?_⟩
        exact regularSupport_mono_local K (by
          intro z hz
          exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨P, hP⟩, hz⟩) hxP
      · exact ⟨⟨P.centres, Or.inr ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩⟩, hxP⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.boundaryPoint_excludedFromOpenUnion
statement:
private theorem boundaryPoint_excludedFromOpenUnion
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    ∀ S ∈ slabComponentFamily K T, ∀ x : ℝ,
      x ∈ frontier {r : ℝ | (r : ℂ) ∈ regularSupport K S} →
      ∀ y : ℝ, (x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∉ openUnion K T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro S hS x hx y hzOpen
  obtain ⟨X, hXreg, hSsupport⟩ := (slabComponents_partition hTile).2.1 S hS
  have hbase : {r : ℝ | (r : ℂ) ∈ regularSupport K S} = X := by
    rw [hSsupport]
    ext r
    simp
  have hxFront : x ∈ frontier X := hbase ▸ hx
  let z : Tiling.Plane := (x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hzClosureS : z ∈ closure (regularSupport K S) := by
    rw [hSsupport, Complex.closure_preimage_re]
    simpa [z] using frontier_subset_closure hxFront
  rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion,
    ← Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion] at hzOpen
  obtain ⟨t, hzt⟩ := hzOpen
  let P : VerticalPlate K T := VerticalPlate.ofCentre t
  have htP : (t.1 : Tiling.Plane) ∈ P.centres := VerticalPlate.mem_centres_ofCentre t
  let U : Set Tiling.Plane := if hP : IsVerticalColumn P then
      verticalColumnCentres K T else P.centres
  have hU : U ∈ slabComponentFamily K T := by
    dsimp [U]
    split_ifs with hP
    · left
      refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
      exact ⟨t.1, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨P, hP⟩, htP⟩⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩
  have htU : (t.1 : Tiling.Plane) ∈ U := by
    dsimp [U]
    split_ifs with hP
    · exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨P, hP⟩, htP⟩
    · exact htP
  have hzU : z ∈ regularSupport K U := by
    unfold regularSupport
    have hopen : IsOpen (openUnion K U) := by
      rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier]
      exact isOpen_iUnion fun r : U ↦
        (Homeomorph.addLeft (r : Tiling.Plane)).isOpenMap _ isOpen_interior
    apply hopen.subset_interior_closure
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion,
      ← Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨⟨t.1, htU⟩, hzt⟩
  by_cases hUS : U = S
  · rw [hUS, hSsupport] at hzU
    have hxX : x ∈ X := by simpa [z] using hzU
    have hXopen : IsOpen X := by rw [hXreg]; exact isOpen_interior
    exact hxFront.2 (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr (hXopen.mem_nhds hxX))
  · have hdisj := (slabComponents_partition hTile).2.2.1 U hU S hS hUS
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1
      (hdisj.closure_right (regularSupport_isRegularOpen K U).1)
      hzU hzClosureS

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.totalBoundary_mem_componentFrontier
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · have hne : (verticalColumnCentres K T).Nonempty := by
      by_contra hempty
      rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hempty] at hx
      have hsupp : regularSupport K (∅ : Set Tiling.Plane) = ∅ := by
        unfold regularSupport Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion
        simp
      rw [hsupp] at hx
      simp at hx
    exact ⟨verticalColumnCentres K T, Or.inl ⟨rfl, hne⟩, hx⟩
  · rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
    obtain ⟨P, hxP⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨P.1.centres, Or.inr ⟨P.1, P.2, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    have hbase : {r : ℝ | (r : ℂ) ∈ regularSupport K P.1.centres} = P.1.base := by
      change {r : ℝ | (r : ℂ) ∈ P.1.support} = P.1.base
      rw [(P.1.support_isVerticalSlab hTile).2]
      ext r
      simp
    rwa [hbase]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.boundaryPoint_hasPlacedFrontierWitness
statement:
private theorem boundaryPoint_hasPlacedFrontierWitness
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    ∀ x ∈ totalSlabBoundary K T, ∀ y : ℝ,
      ∃ t : T, (x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
        frontier ((t.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hxS⟩ := totalBoundary_mem_componentFrontier hTile hx
  have hzNotOpen := boundaryPoint_excludedFromOpenUnion hTile S hS x hxS y
  let z : Tiling.Plane := (x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hzClosure : z ∈ closure (openUnion K T) := by
    have hwhole : regularSupport K T = Set.univ :=
      regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) hTile
    rw [regularSupport, Tiling.Polygonal.regularSupport, ← openUnion] at hwhole
    exact interior_subset (hwhole.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ z)
  rw [closure_openUnion_eq_iUnion_support hTile.2.1] at hzClosure
  rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hzClosure
  obtain ⟨t, hzt⟩ := hzClosure
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  rw [(K.isPolygonal.vadd t.1).isClosed.frontier_eq]
  refine ⟨hzt, ?_⟩
  intro hzInterior
  apply hzNotOpen
  rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion,
    ← Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  rw [interior_vadd] at hzInterior
  exact hzInterior

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.segment_re_eq_local
statement:
private theorem segment_re_eq_local {a b z : Tiling.Plane}
    (hab : a.re = b.re) (hz : z ∈ segment ℝ a b) : z.re = a.re
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image] at hz
  obtain ⟨r, _hr, rfl⟩ := hz
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hab]
  ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.segment_im_eq_local
statement:
private theorem segment_im_eq_local {a b z : Tiling.Plane}
    (hab : a.im = b.im) (hz : z ∈ segment ℝ a b) : z.im = a.im
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image] at hz
  obtain ⟨r, _hr, rfl⟩ := hz
  simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hab]
  ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.exists_commonGenericBoundaryHeight
statement:
private theorem exists_commonGenericBoundaryHeight
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    ∃ y : ℝ, IsCommonBoundaryWitnessHeight K T y
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Countable T := hTile.1.to_subtype
  have hVfinite : K.vertices.Finite := by
    simpa only [Region.vertices] using K.isPolygonal.vertexSet_finite
  let _ : Countable K.vertices := hVfinite.countable.to_subtype
  let forbidden : Set ℝ := Set.range fun p : T × K.vertices ↦ p.1.1.im + p.2.1.im
  have hcount : forbidden.Countable := Set.countable_range _
  have hne : forbidden ≠ Set.univ := by
    intro h
    apply Cardinal.not_countable_real
    rw [← h]
    exact hcount
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (Set.ne_univ_iff_exists_notMem forbidden).mp hne
  refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t a b hab _hedge heq
    apply hy
    refine ⟨(t, a), ?_⟩
    simpa [Complex.add_im, add_comm] using heq.symm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨t, hztFront⟩ := boundaryPoint_hasPlacedFrontierWitness hTile x hx y
    let z : Tiling.Plane := (x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let p : Tiling.Plane := z - t.1
    have hpFront : p ∈ frontier K.support := by
      rw [frontier_vadd_eq] at hztFront
      simpa [p, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, sub_eq_add_neg,
        add_comm] using hztFront
    have hpNotVertex : p ∉ K.vertices := by
      intro hp
      apply hy
      refine ⟨(t, ⟨p, hp⟩), ?_⟩
      norm_num [p, z]
    obtain ⟨axis, a, b, hab, hcoord, hpseg, hedge⟩ :=
      Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.nonvertexFrontier_mem_intrinsicEdge
        K p hpFront hpNotVertex
    cases axis with
    | horizontal =>
        exfalso
        apply hy
        refine ⟨(t, a), ?_⟩
        have hpim := segment_im_eq_local hcoord
          (openSegment_subset_segment ℝ a.1 b.1 hpseg)
        norm_num [p, z] at hpim
        linarith
    | vertical =>
        have hpre := segment_re_eq_local hcoord
          (openSegment_subset_segment ℝ a.1 b.1 hpseg)
        refine ⟨t, a, b, hab, hcoord, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · norm_num [p, z] at hpre
          simp only [Complex.add_re]
          linarith
        · have hzseg : t.1 +ᵥ p ∈
              openSegment ℝ (t.1 +ᵥ a.1) (t.1 +ᵥ b.1) := by
            rw [← vadd_openSegment ℝ]
            exact ⟨p, hpseg, rfl⟩
          simpa [p, z, vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hzseg
        · rw [frontier_vadd_eq]
          rw [show a.1 + t.1 = t.1 +ᵥ a.1 by simp [vadd_eq_add, add_comm],
            show b.1 + t.1 = t.1 +ᵥ b.1 by simp [vadd_eq_add, add_comm],
            ← vadd_openSegment ℝ]
          rintro q ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
          refine ⟨⟨r, (hedge hr).1, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
          intro hv
          rcases hv with ⟨q, hq, heq⟩
          have : q = r := by
            simpa using add_left_cancel heq
          exact (hedge hr).2 (this ▸ hq)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.relevantTilesFinite
statement:
private theorem relevantTilesFinite
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (Q : Set Tiling.Plane) (hQ : Bornology.IsBounded Q) :
    {t : Tiling.Plane | t ∈ T ∧ ((t +ᵥ K.support) ∩ Q).Nonempty}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  let C : Set Tiling.Plane := Q - K.support
  have hC : Bornology.IsBounded C := hQ.sub K.isPolygonal.isBounded
  apply ((Tiling.AxisParallel.IsPacking.locallyFinite_centres hTile.2.1).1 C hC).subset
  rintro t ⟨ht, z, hzt, hzQ⟩
  refine ⟨ht, ?_⟩
  rw [Set.mem_sub]
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set] at hzt
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hzt
  exact ⟨t + k, hzQ, k, hk, by simp⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.compactBoundary_finite_of_commonHeight
statement:
private theorem compactBoundary_finite_of_commonHeight
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : IsCommonBoundaryWitnessHeight K T y) :
    ∀ a b : ℝ, (totalSlabBoundary K T ∩ Set.Icc a b).Finite
proof:
:= by
  intro a b
  let f : ℝ → Tiling.Plane := fun x ↦ (x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I
  let Q : Set Tiling.Plane := f '' Set.Icc a b
  have hf : Continuous f := by fun_prop
  have hQcompact : IsCompact Q := (isCompact_Icc.image hf)
  let F : Set Tiling.Plane :=
    {t : Tiling.Plane | t ∈ T ∧ ((t +ᵥ K.support) ∩ Q).Nonempty}
  have hF : F.Finite := relevantTilesFinite hTile Q hQcompact.isBounded
  have hV : K.vertices.Finite := by
    simpa only [Region.vertices] using K.isPolygonal.vertexSet_finite
  let coords : Set ℝ :=
    (fun p : Tiling.Plane × Tiling.Plane ↦ (p.1 + p.2).re) '' (K.vertices ×ˢ F)
  have hcoords : coords.Finite := (hV.prod hF).image _
  apply hcoords.subset
  rintro x ⟨hxB, hxIcc⟩
  obtain ⟨t, v, w, _hvw, _hre, hxcoord, hzseg, hedge⟩ := hy.2 x hxB
  have hztSupport : f x ∈ t.1 +ᵥ K.support := by
    exact (K.isPolygonal.vadd t.1).isClosed.frontier_subset (hedge hzseg).1
  have htF : t.1 ∈ F := by
    refine ⟨t.2, f x, hztSupport, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨x, hxIcc, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨(v.1, t.1), ⟨v.2, htF⟩, ?_⟩
  simpa [coords, add_comm] using hxcoord.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.totalSlabBoundary_horizontalTranslatedVertices
statement:
private theorem totalSlabBoundary_horizontalTranslatedVertices
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    totalSlabBoundary K T ⊆ horizontalTranslatedVertices K T
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_commonGenericBoundaryHeight hTile
  obtain ⟨t, a, _b, _hab, _hre, hxcoord, _hz, _hedge⟩ := hy.2 x hx
  exact ⟨a.1, a.2, t.1, t.2, hxcoord⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.totalSlabBoundary_coordinate
statement:
private theorem totalSlabBoundary_coordinate :
    (∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}, TilesOn K T Set.univ →
      totalSlabBoundary K T ⊆ horizontalTranslatedVertices K T) ∧
    (∀ (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext.{u}),
      TilesOn C.region C.centres Set.univ →
      totalSlabBoundary C.region C.centres ⊆ C.coordinateSpace)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun hTile ↦ totalSlabBoundary_horizontalTranslatedVertices hTile
  · intro C hTile x hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv, t, ht, hcoord⟩ :=
      (show totalSlabBoundary C.region C.centres ⊆
        horizontalTranslatedVertices C.region C.centres from
          (by
            intro q hq
            exact (show ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
              TilesOn K T Set.univ → totalSlabBoundary K T ⊆
                horizontalTranslatedVertices K T from by
                  intro K T hT
                  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_commonGenericBoundaryHeight hT
                  intro r hr
                  obtain ⟨s, a, _b, _hab, _hre, hc, _hz, _he⟩ := hy.2 r hr
                  exact ⟨a.1, a.2, s.1, s.2, hc⟩) hTile hq)) hx
    rw [hcoord]
    exact C.coordinateSpace.add_mem (C.vertex_re_mem v hv) (C.centre_re_mem t ht)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.totalSlabBoundary_locallyFinite
statement:
private theorem totalSlabBoundary_locallyFinite
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) :
    ∀ a b : ℝ, (totalSlabBoundary K T ∩ Set.Icc a b).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_commonGenericBoundaryHeight hTile
  exact compactBoundary_finite_of_commonHeight hTile hy

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.verticalPlate_base_nonempty_local
statement:
private theorem verticalPlate_base_nonempty_local
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (P : VerticalPlate K T) :
    P.base.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := P.nonempty_supp
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := K.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty K.nonempty
  refine ⟨(t.1 + u).re, t.1 + u, ?_, rfl⟩
  change t.1 + u ∈ regularSupport K P.centres
  unfold regularSupport
  have hopen : IsOpen (openUnion K P.centres) := by
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier]
    exact isOpen_iUnion fun s : P.centres ↦ isOpen_interior.vadd s.1
  apply hopen.subset_interior_closure
  rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion,
    ← Tiling.AxisParallel.Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
  refine ⟨⟨t.1, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  have hu' : u ∈ K.openCarrier := by
    rw [← K.openCarrier_regularOpen.2,
      show closure K.openCarrier = K.support from K.isPolygonal.closure_interior]
    exact hu
  simpa only [vadd_eq_add, neg_add_cancel_left] using hu'

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.totalSlabBoundary_nonempty
statement:
private theorem totalSlabBoundary_nonempty
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (hNoFull : ¬ ∃ P : VerticalPlate K T,
      ¬ IsVerticalColumn P ∧ P.centres = T)
    (hNotColumns : T ≠ verticalColumnCentres K T) :
    (totalSlabBoundary K T).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  have hcolSub := verticalColumnCentres_subset K T
  obtain ⟨t, htT, htCol⟩ : ∃ t, t ∈ T ∧ t ∉ verticalColumnCentres K T := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hNotColumns (Set.Subset.antisymm h hcolSub)
  let tT : T := ⟨t, htT⟩
  let P : VerticalPlate K T := VerticalPlate.ofCentre tT
  have htP : t ∈ P.centres := VerticalPlate.mem_centres_ofCentre tT
  have hPnoncol : ¬ IsVerticalColumn P := by
    intro hP
    apply htCol
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨P, hP⟩, htP⟩
  have hPproper : P.base ≠ Set.univ := by
    intro hbase
    have hfull : P.support = Set.univ := by
      rw [(P.support_isVerticalSlab hTile).2, hbase]
      simp
    exact hNoFull ⟨P, hPnoncol, plate_centres_eq_of_support_eq_univ hTile P hfull⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := nonempty_frontier_iff.mpr
    ⟨verticalPlate_base_nonempty_local P, hPproper⟩
  exact ⟨x, Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem ⟨P, hPnoncol⟩ hx)⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.normalization_wordTransport
statement:
private theorem normalization_wordTransport
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (v₀ t₀ : Tiling.Plane)
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (hcarrier : C.region.openCarrier = (-v₀) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
    (hcentres : C.centres = (-t₀) +ᵥ T) (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (W : SlabBoundaryWord C.region C.centres) :
    ∃ W₀ : SlabBoundaryWord K T,
      (∀ i : ℤ, W₀.position i = W.position i + (v₀ + t₀).re) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, W₀.label i = t₀ +ᵥ W.label i) ∧
      W₀.boundary = (v₀ + t₀).re +ᵥ W.boundary ∧
      W₀.gapSet = W.gapSet ∧
      ∀ R : ℝ, (∀ i : ℤ, W.position (i + 1) - W.position i < R) →
        ∀ i : ℤ, W₀.position (i + 1) - W₀.position i < R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, heCentres, heColumn, _heSupport, hcolumns, _hcolumnSupport,
      hboundary⟩ := normalization_geometryTransport v₀ t₀ C hcarrier hcentres hTile
  have hK := carrier_translation_image v₀ C hcarrier
  have hT := centres_translation_image t₀ C hcentres
  have hsupport (S : Set Tiling.Plane) :
      regularSupport K (t₀ +ᵥ S) =
        (v₀ + t₀) +ᵥ regularSupport C.region S := by
    simpa only [positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul, one_smul] using
      (positiveSimilarity_regularSupport_image (c := t₀) (S := S) (by norm_num) hK)
  let pos : ℤ → ℝ := fun i ↦ W.position i + (v₀ + t₀).re
  let lab : ℤ → Set Tiling.Plane := fun i ↦ t₀ +ᵥ W.label i
  let B : Set ℝ := (v₀ + t₀).re +ᵥ W.boundary
  have hmono : StrictMono pos := by
    intro i j hij
    dsimp [pos]
    linarith [W.position_strictMono hij]
  have hrange : Set.range pos = B := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      have hi : W.position i ∈ W.boundary := by
        rw [← W.position_range]
        exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨W.position i, hi, by simp [pos, add_comm]⟩
    · rintro ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := W.position_range ▸ hq
      exact ⟨i, by simp [pos, add_comm]⟩
  have hlabel (i : ℤ) :
      (lab i = verticalColumnCentres K T ∧
        (verticalColumnCentres K T).Nonempty) ∨
      ∃ P : VerticalPlate K T, ¬ IsVerticalColumn P ∧ lab i = P.centres := by
    rcases W.label_is_component i with ⟨h, hne⟩ | ⟨P, hP, h⟩
    · left
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · dsimp [lab]
        rw [h, ← hcolumns]
      · rw [hcolumns]
        obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hne
        exact ⟨t₀ + q, q, hq, rfl⟩
    · right
      refine ⟨e P, (heColumn P).not.mpr hP, ?_⟩
      dsimp [lab]
      rw [h]
      exact (heCentres P).symm
  have hstrip (i : ℤ) :
      Complex.re ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (pos i) (pos (i + 1)) ⊆ regularSupport K (lab i) := by
    rw [hsupport]
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    apply W.strip_in_labelSupport i
    change (-((v₀ + t₀).re) + z.re) ∈ Set.Ioo (W.position i) (W.position (i + 1))
    dsimp [pos] at hz
    norm_num at hz ⊢
    constructor <;> linarith
  let W₀ : SlabBoundaryWord K T :=
    { boundary := B
      position := pos
      position_strictMono := hmono
      position_range := hrange
      label := lab
      label_is_component := hlabel
      strip_in_labelSupport := hstrip
      boundary_exact := by
        change B = totalSlabBoundary K T
        rw [hboundary]
        exact congrArg ((v₀ + t₀).re +ᵥ ·) W.boundary_exact }
  refine ⟨W₀, fun _ ↦ rfl, fun _ ↦ rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext g
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i, by dsimp [W₀, pos]; ring⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i, by dsimp [W₀, pos]; ring⟩
  · intro R hR i
    simpa only [W₀, pos] using (show
      W.position (i + 1) + (v₀ + t₀).re -
        (W.position i + (v₀ + t₀).re) < R by linarith [hR i])

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.slabGapSet_subset_horizontalBoundedDifferences
statement:
private theorem slabGapSet_subset_horizontalBoundedDifferences
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (W : SlabBoundaryWord K T) {R₀ : ℝ}
    (hBoundary : W.boundary = totalSlabBoundary K T)
    (hGap : ∀ i : ℤ, 0 < W.position (i + 1) - W.position i ∧
      W.position (i + 1) - W.position i < R₀) :
    W.gapSet ⊆ horizontalBoundedDifferences
      (horizontalTranslatedVertices K T) R₀
proof:
:= by
  rintro g ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have hi : W.position i ∈ totalSlabBoundary K T := by
    rw [← hBoundary, ← W.position_range]
    exact Set.mem_range_self i
  have hi1 : W.position (i + 1) ∈ totalSlabBoundary K T := by
    rw [← hBoundary, ← W.position_range]
    exact Set.mem_range_self (i + 1)
  refine ⟨W.position i, totalSlabBoundary_horizontalTranslatedVertices hTile hi,
    W.position (i + 1),
    totalSlabBoundary_horizontalTranslatedVertices hTile hi1, rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [abs_of_pos (hGap i).1]
  exact (hGap i).2.le

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.slabBoundaryGapAlphabet_finite
statement:
theorem slabBoundaryGapAlphabet_finite
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ) (hFHC : HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity T)
    (W : SlabBoundaryWord K T) {R₀ : ℝ} (_hR₀ : 0 < R₀)
    (hGap : ∀ i : ℤ, W.position (i + 1) - W.position i < R₀) :
    W.gapSet.Finite
proof:
:= by
  apply (horizontalBoundedDifferences_finite hFHC R₀).subset
  apply slabGapSet_subset_horizontalBoundedDifferences hTile W W.boundary_exact
  intro i
  exact ⟨sub_pos.mpr (W.position_strictMono (by omega)), hGap i⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.baseFrontier_periodic_of_supportPeriodic
proof:
:= by
  let A : Set ℝ := {x : ℝ | (x : ℂ) ∈ S}
  have hshift : b +ᵥ A = A := by
    ext x
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simp only [vadd_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub]
    change x - b ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A
    change (((x - b : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ S) ↔ ((x : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ S
    have hp := hper (((x - b : ℝ) : ℂ))
    simpa using hp.symm
  have hfrontier : b +ᵥ frontier A = frontier A := by
    simpa only [Homeomorph.coe_addLeft, ← vadd_eq_add, Set.image_vadd, hshift]
      using (Homeomorph.addLeft b).image_frontier A
  intro y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have : b + y ∈ b +ᵥ frontier A := ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [hfrontier] at this
    simpa [A, add_comm] using this
  · intro hy
    have hy' : y + b ∈ b +ᵥ frontier A := by
      rw [hfrontier]
      simpa [A] using hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hbz⟩ := hy'
    have : z = y := by simpa [vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hbz
    simpa [A, this] using hz

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.iUnion_baseFrontier_periodic
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  constructor
  · simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    rintro ⟨S, hSf, hyS⟩
    exact ⟨S, hSf, (baseFrontier_periodic_of_supportPeriodic (hper S hSf) y).mp hyS⟩
  · simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    rintro ⟨S, hSf, hyS⟩
    exact ⟨S, hSf, (baseFrontier_periodic_of_supportPeriodic (hper S hSf) y).mpr hyS⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.deformedComponentSupport_periodic
statement:
private theorem deformedComponentSupport_periodic
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (D : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.CoordinateDeformation C phi)
    (P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.TwoStageDeformationSupportTransport C phi D)
    (hHorizontalSign :
      ∀ v w : C.region.vertices, ∀ s t : C.centres,
        Real.sign ((w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re -
          (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re) =
        Real.sign
          ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) +
                Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)).re -
            (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) +
                Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2)).re))
    {b : ℝ}
    (hperiod :
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy
          (regularSupport D.deformedRegion
            (verticalColumnCentres D.deformedRegion
              (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.deformedCenterCarrier P.fullCenters)))
          ((b : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        ∀ Q : VerticalPlate D.deformedRegion
            (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.deformedCenterCarrier P.fullCenters),
          ¬ IsVerticalColumn Q →
            Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy Q.support ((b : ℝ) : ℂ)) :
    ∀ S ∈ slabComponentFamily C.region C.centres,
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy
        (regularSupport D.deformedRegion
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.deformedCenterCarrierOn P.fullCenters
            {t : C.centres | (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ S})) ((b : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  let hContact := deformation_preservesProperHorizontalContact C phi D P hHorizontalSign
  let e := deformation_verticalPlateEquiv C phi D P hContact
  intro S hS
  rcases hS with ⟨rfl, _hcolne⟩ | ⟨Q, hQnoncol, rfl⟩
  · have hcarrier :
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.deformedCenterCarrierOn P.fullCenters
            {t : C.centres | (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈
              verticalColumnCentres C.region C.centres} =
          verticalColumnCentres D.deformedRegion
            (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.deformedCenterCarrier P.fullCenters) := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
        rw [verticalColumnCentres_eq] at ht ⊢
        obtain ⟨Q, htQ⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp ht
        let Q' := e Q.1
        have hQ' : IsVerticalColumn Q' :=
          (deformation_preservesColumns C phi D P hContact hHorizontalSign Q.1).mp Q.2
        refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨Q', hQ'⟩, ?_⟩
        rw [deformation_verticalPlateEquiv_centres C phi D P hContact Q.1]
        exact ⟨t, htQ, rfl⟩
      · intro hy
        rw [verticalColumnCentres_eq] at hy ⊢
        obtain ⟨Q', hyQ'⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
        let Q := e.symm Q'.1
        have hQ : IsVerticalColumn Q := by
          apply (deformation_preservesColumns C phi D P hContact hHorizontalSign Q).mpr
          have heq : e Q = Q'.1 := by simp [Q]
          rw [heq]
          exact Q'.2
        have hcentres := deformation_verticalPlateEquiv_centres C phi D P hContact Q
        have heq : e Q = Q'.1 := by simp [Q, e]
        rw [heq] at hcentres
        rw [hcentres] at hyQ'
        obtain ⟨t, htQ, rfl⟩ := hyQ'
        refine ⟨t, ?_, rfl⟩
        change (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ verticalColumnCentres C.region C.centres
        rw [verticalColumnCentres_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
        exact ⟨⟨Q, hQ⟩, htQ⟩
    rw [hcarrier]
    exact hperiod.1
  · have hcarrier := deformation_verticalPlateEquiv_centres C phi D P hContact Q
    rw [← hcarrier]
    rw [← VerticalPlate.support_eq_regularSupport]
    exact hperiod.2 (e Q)
      (fun hcol ↦ hQnoncol
        ((deformation_preservesColumns C phi D P hContact hHorizontalSign Q).mpr hcol))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.deformedTotalBoundary_periodic_core
statement:
private theorem deformedTotalBoundary_periodic_core
    (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext)
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (D : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.CoordinateDeformation C phi)
    (P : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.TwoStageDeformationSupportTransport C phi D)
    (hHorizontalSign :
      ∀ v w : C.region.vertices, ∀ s t : C.centres,
        Real.sign ((w.1 + (t : Tiling.Plane)).re -
          (v.1 + (s : Tiling.Plane)).re) =
        Real.sign
          ((Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi (C.vertexPoint w.1 w.2) +
                Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)).re -
            (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi (C.vertexPoint v.1 v.2) +
                Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapPoint phi (C.centrePoint s.1 s.2)).re))
    (families : Set (Set Tiling.Plane))
    (hFamiliesSub : ∀ S ∈ families, S ⊆ C.centres)
    (hFamiliesSlab : ∀ S ∈ families, ∃ X : Set ℝ,
      X = interior (closure X) ∧ regularSupport C.region S = Complex.re ⁻¹' X)
    (B : Set ℝ) (hBmem : ∀ x ∈ B, x ∈ C.coordinateSpace)
    (hB : B = ⋃ S ∈ families,
      frontier {x : ℝ | (x : ℂ) ∈ regularSupport C.region S})
    {b : ℝ} (_hb : 0 < b)
    (hTargetPeriodic : ∀ S ∈ families,
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy
        (regularSupport D.deformedRegion
          (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.deformedCenterCarrierOn P.fullCenters
            {t : C.centres | (t : Tiling.Plane) ∈ S})) ((b : ℝ) : ℂ)) :
    ∀ y : ℝ,
        y ∈ {y : ℝ | ∃ x : ℝ, ∃ hx : x ∈ B,
          y = Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi ⟨x, hBmem x hx⟩} ↔
        y + b ∈ {y : ℝ | ∃ x : ℝ, ∃ hx : x ∈ B,
          y = Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.mapScalar phi ⟨x, hBmem x hx⟩}
proof:
:= by
  have htransport := deformation_transportsOrderedBoundaryCode C phi D P
