        exact ⟨w, hboth.1, rfl⟩
      · rw [openSegment_commonTranslation]
        exact ⟨w, hboth.2, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.horizontalEdgeCondition_commonTranslation_iff
statement:
private theorem horizontalEdgeCondition_commonTranslation_iff
    (r a b : Tiling.Plane) (S V : Set Tiling.Plane) :
    (a ≠ b ∧ a.im = b.im ∧
      openSegment ℝ a b ⊆ frontier S \ V) ↔
    (r + a ≠ r + b ∧ (r + a).im = (r + b).im ∧
      openSegment ℝ (r + a) (r + b) ⊆
        frontier (r +ᵥ S) \ (r +ᵥ V))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hab, him, hedge⟩
    refine ⟨fun h ↦ hab (add_left_cancel h), ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Complex.add_im]
      linarith
    · intro z hz
      rw [openSegment_commonTranslation] at hz
      rcases hz with ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      rcases hedge hw with ⟨hwFrontier, hwNotVertex⟩
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [frontier_vadd_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
        simpa only [vadd_eq_add, neg_add_cancel_left] using hwFrontier
      · intro hwVertex
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hwVertex
        exact hwNotVertex (by simpa [vadd_eq_add] using hwVertex)
  · rintro ⟨hab, him, hedge⟩
    refine ⟨fun h ↦ hab (by simpa using congrArg (fun z : Tiling.Plane ↦ r + z) h), ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Complex.add_im] at him ⊢
      linarith
    · intro w hw
      have hz : r + w ∈ openSegment ℝ (r + a) (r + b) := by
        rw [openSegment_commonTranslation]
        exact ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      rcases hedge hz with ⟨hwFrontier, hwNotVertex⟩
      rw [frontier_vadd_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hwFrontier
      refine ⟨by simpa only [vadd_eq_add, neg_add_cancel_left] using hwFrontier, ?_⟩
      intro hwVertex
      have htranslated : r + w ∈ r +ᵥ V := by
        refine ⟨w, hwVertex, ?_⟩
        simp [vadd_eq_add]
      exact hwNotVertex htranslated

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.unitTranslation_horizontalContactDisplacements_eq
statement:
private theorem unitTranslation_horizontalContactDisplacements_eq
    {K R : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (r c : Tiling.Plane)
    (hcarrier : R.openCarrier = positiveSimilarity 1 r '' K.openCarrier)
    (a b a' b' : ↥K.vertices) :
    let eV : ↥K.vertices ≃ ↥R.vertices :=
      Equiv.Set.image (positiveSimilarity 1 r) K.vertices
        (positiveSimilarity_injective one_pos) |>.trans
          (Equiv.setCongr (positiveSimilarity_vertices_image one_pos hcarrier).symm)
    horizontalContactDisplacements R (positiveSimilarity 1 c '' T)
        (eV a) (eV b) (eV a') (eV b') =
      horizontalContactDisplacements K T a b a' b'
proof:
:= by
  let eV : ↥K.vertices ≃ ↥R.vertices :=
    Equiv.Set.image (positiveSimilarity 1 r) K.vertices
      (positiveSimilarity_injective one_pos) |>.trans
        (Equiv.setCongr (positiveSimilarity_vertices_image one_pos hcarrier).symm)
  have heV (x : ↥K.vertices) : (eV x).1 = x.1 + r := by
    change positiveSimilarity 1 r x.1 = x.1 + r
    simp only [positiveSimilarity, one_smul]
  have hSupport : R.support = r +ᵥ K.support := by
    rw [positiveSimilarity_support_image one_pos hcarrier,
      positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul, one_smul]
  have hVertices : R.vertices = r +ᵥ K.vertices := by
    rw [positiveSimilarity_vertices_image one_pos hcarrier,
      positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul, one_smul]
  have hEdge (x y : ↥K.vertices) :
      (x.1 ≠ y.1 ∧ x.1.im = y.1.im ∧
        openSegment ℝ x.1 y.1 ⊆ frontier K.support \ K.vertices) ↔
      ((eV x).1 ≠ (eV y).1 ∧ (eV x).1.im = (eV y).1.im ∧
        openSegment ℝ (eV x).1 (eV y).1 ⊆ frontier R.support \ R.vertices) := by
    simpa only [heV, hSupport, hVertices, add_comm] using
      horizontalEdgeCondition_commonTranslation_iff r x.1 y.1 K.support K.vertices
  have hEndpoint (x t : Tiling.Plane) :
      (x + r) + positiveSimilarity 1 c t = (r + c) + (x + t) := by
    simp only [positiveSimilarity, one_smul]
    abel
  change horizontalContactDisplacements R (positiveSimilarity 1 c '' T)
    (eV a) (eV b) (eV a') (eV b') = _
  ext delta
  rw [horizontalContactDisplacements_iff, horizontalContactDisplacements_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hab, himab, hsegab, hab', himab', hsegab', t, s,
      hdelta, u, v, huv, him, hsub⟩
    obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, htEq⟩ := t.2
    obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀, hsEq⟩ := s.2
    have hDelta : delta = (s₀ - t₀).re := by
      rw [← htEq, ← hsEq] at hdelta
      simpa only [positiveSimilarity, one_smul, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub] using hdelta
    have hOverlap : ∃ u v : Tiling.Plane, u ≠ v ∧ u.im = v.im ∧
        openSegment ℝ u v ⊆ openSegment ℝ (a.1 + t₀) (b.1 + t₀) ∩
          openSegment ℝ (a'.1 + s₀) (b'.1 + s₀) := by
      apply (horizontalOverlapWitness_commonTranslation_iff (r + c)
        a.1 b.1 a'.1 b'.1 t₀ s₀).mp
      refine ⟨u, v, huv, him, ?_⟩
      simpa only [heV, ← htEq, ← hsEq, hEndpoint] using hsub
    have hAB := (hEdge a b).mpr ⟨hab, himab, hsegab⟩
    have hAB' := (hEdge a' b').mpr ⟨hab', himab', hsegab'⟩
    exact ⟨hAB.1, hAB.2.1, hAB.2.2, hAB'.1, hAB'.2.1, hAB'.2.2,
      ⟨t₀, ht₀⟩, ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩, hDelta, hOverlap⟩
  · rintro ⟨hab, himab, hsegab, hab', himab', hsegab', t, s,
      hdelta, hOverlap⟩
    have hAB := (hEdge a b).mp ⟨hab, himab, hsegab⟩
    have hAB' := (hEdge a' b').mp ⟨hab', himab', hsegab'⟩
    refine ⟨hAB.1, hAB.2.1, hAB.2.2, hAB'.1, hAB'.2.1, hAB'.2.2,
      ⟨positiveSimilarity 1 c t.1, ⟨t.1, t.2, rfl⟩⟩,
      ⟨positiveSimilarity 1 c s.1, ⟨s.1, s.2, rfl⟩⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [positiveSimilarity, one_smul, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub] using hdelta
    · simpa only [heV, hEndpoint] using
        (horizontalOverlapWitness_commonTranslation_iff (r + c)
          a.1 b.1 a'.1 b'.1 t.1 s.1).mpr hOverlap

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.normalizedWidePlateData_exists
statement:
private theorem normalizedWidePlateData_exists :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T univ → NontrivialDecomposition K T →
      ∀ (P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T),
        ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P →
        (∀ Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
          ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn Q → Q = P) →
        (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
          ∃ a : ℝ, Ioo a (a + 2 * R) ⊆ P.base) →
        (∀ a b a' b' : ↥K.vertices,
          (horizontalContactDisplacements K T a b a' b').Finite) →
        Nonempty (NormalizedWidePlateData K T P)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile hNontrivial P hNoncolumn hUnique hWide hFinite
  classical
  obtain ⟨v, hv, _⟩ := IntrinsicVertices.exists_intrinsicDiameterPair K
  obtain ⟨t, _ht⟩ := P.nonempty_supp
  obtain ⟨C : ApproximationContext.{0}, hRegion, hCentres, hTarget, hTiles⟩ :=
    normalizeApproximationContext K T univ v hv t.1 t.2
  have hTarget' : C.target = univ := by simpa using hTarget
  have hCarrier : C.region.openCarrier =
      positiveSimilarity 1 (-v) '' K.openCarrier := by
    rw [positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul, one_smul]
    exact hRegion
  have hImage : positiveSimilarity 1 (-t.1) '' T = C.centres := by
    rw [positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul, one_smul]
    exact hCentres.symm
  let eC : T ≃ C.centres :=
    (Continuous.positiveSimilarityCentreEquiv one_pos (-t.1)).trans
      (Equiv.setCongr hImage)
  let eP : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T ≃
      Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region C.centres :=
    (Continuous.verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv one_pos hCarrier (-t.1)).trans
      (Equiv.cast (congrArg (Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region) hImage))
  have hCast (S U : Set Tiling.Plane) (h : S = U)
      (Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region S) :
      (Equiv.cast (congrArg (Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region) h) Q).centres = Q.centres ∧
      (Equiv.cast (congrArg (Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region) h) Q).base = Q.base ∧
      (Continuous.IsVerticalColumn Q ↔
        Continuous.IsVerticalColumn
          (Equiv.cast (congrArg (Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region) h) Q)) := by
    subst U
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl, Iff.rfl⟩
  have hCentresImage (Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) :
      (eP Q).centres = positiveSimilarity 1 (-t.1) '' Q.centres := by
    exact (hCast _ _ hImage _).1.trans
      (Continuous.verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_centres_image
        one_pos hCarrier (-t.1) Q)
  have hColumn (Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) :
      Continuous.IsVerticalColumn Q ↔ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn (eP Q) := by
    exact (Continuous.verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_isVerticalColumn
      one_pos hCarrier (-t.1) Q).trans (hCast _ _ hImage _).2.2
  have hBase : (eP P).base =
      (fun x : ℝ ↦ x - (v + t.1).re) '' P.base := by
    change (Equiv.cast (congrArg (Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region) hImage)
      (Continuous.verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv one_pos hCarrier (-t.1) P)).base = _
    rw [(hCast _ _ hImage _).2.1]
    convert Continuous.verticalPlate_positiveSimilarityEquiv_base_affine_real_image
      one_pos hCarrier (-t.1) P using 1
    congr 1
    funext x
    simp only [one_mul, Complex.add_re, Complex.neg_re]
    ring
  refine ⟨{
    vertexAnchor := ⟨v, hv⟩
    centerAnchor := t
    context := C
    region_openCarrier := hRegion
    centres := hCentres
    target := hTarget'
    normalized_tiles := by simpa only [hTarget'] using hTiles.mp hTile
    centreEquiv := eC
    centre_formula := ?_
    properContact_iff := ?_
    normalizedPlate := eP P
    normalized_centres := ?_
    normalized_base := ?_
    normalized_noncolumn := fun h ↦ hNoncolumn ((hColumn P).mpr h)
    normalized_unique := ?_
    normalized_wide := ?_
    normalized_nontrivial := ?_
    normalized_contact_finite := ?_ }⟩
  · intro u
    change positiveSimilarity 1 (-t.1) u.1 = -t.1 + u.1
    simp only [positiveSimilarity, one_smul, add_comm]
  · intro s u
    exact Continuous.horizontalProperContact_positiveSimilarity_iff
      one_pos hCarrier s.1 u.1
  · rw [hCentresImage, positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul, one_smul]
  · rw [hBase]
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
      exact ⟨y, hy, hxy.symm⟩
  · intro Q hQ
    have hPre : ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn (eP.symm Q) := by
      intro h
      exact hQ (eP.apply_symm_apply Q ▸ (hColumn (eP.symm Q)).mp h)
    rw [← eP.apply_symm_apply Q, hUnique (eP.symm Q) hPre]
  · intro R hR
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hWide R hR
    refine ⟨a - (v + t.1).re, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    rw [hBase]
    refine ⟨x + (v + t.1).re, ha ?_, by ring⟩
    rcases hx with ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩
    constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨Q, hQ, hQT⟩
    apply hNontrivial
    refine ⟨eP.symm Q, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro h
      exact hQ (eP.apply_symm_apply Q ▸ (hColumn (eP.symm Q)).mp h)
    · apply (Set.image_eq_image (positiveSimilarity_injective one_pos)).mp
      rw [← hCentresImage, eP.apply_symm_apply, hQT, hImage]
  · rw [← hImage]
    intro a b a' b'
    let eV : ↥K.vertices ≃ ↥C.region.vertices :=
      Equiv.Set.image (positiveSimilarity 1 (-v)) K.vertices
        (positiveSimilarity_injective one_pos) |>.trans
          (Equiv.setCongr (positiveSimilarity_vertices_image one_pos hCarrier).symm)
    have hEq := unitTranslation_horizontalContactDisplacements_eq (T := T) (-v) (-t.1)
      hCarrier (eV.symm a) (eV.symm b) (eV.symm a') (eV.symm b')
    change horizontalContactDisplacements C.region (positiveSimilarity 1 (-t.1) '' T)
      (eV (eV.symm a)) (eV (eV.symm b)) (eV (eV.symm a')) (eV (eV.symm b')) = _ at hEq
    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at hEq
    rw [hEq]
    exact hFinite (eV.symm a) (eV.symm b) (eV.symm a') (eV.symm b')

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.properPeriodicRegularOpen_components_bounded
statement:
private theorem properPeriodicRegularOpen_components_bounded :
    ∀ {X : Set ℝ} {p : ℝ}, IsOpen X → interior (closure X) = X →
      X.Nonempty → X ≠ univ → 0 < p →
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy (Complex.re ⁻¹' X) ((p : ℝ) : ℂ) →
      (∀ c : ℝ, ¬ Ioi c ⊆ X) ∧
      (∀ c : ℝ, ¬ Iio c ⊆ X) ∧
      ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ ∀ a b : ℝ,
        a < b → Ioo a b ⊆ X → Ioo a b ∩ frontier X = ∅ → b - a ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  intro X p hOpen hRegular hne hproper hp hperiod
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hdense⟩ := properPeriodicRegularOpen_frontierRelativelyDense
    hOpen hRegular hne hproper hp.ne' hperiod
  have hfront_not_mem {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ frontier X) : y ∉ X := by
    rw [frontier] at hy
    intro hyX
    apply hy.2
    rwa [hOpen.interior_eq]
  have hright : ∀ c : ℝ, ¬ Ioi c ⊆ X := by
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨y, hyF, hyI⟩ := hdense (c + 1)
    apply hfront_not_mem hyF
    apply hc
    change c < y
    linarith [hyI.1]
  have hleft : ∀ c : ℝ, ¬ Iio c ⊆ X := by
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨y, hyF, hyI⟩ := hdense (c - M - 1)
    apply hfront_not_mem hyF
    apply hc
    change y < c
    linarith [hyI.2, hM]
  refine ⟨hright, hleft, 2 * M, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro a b hab hsub hgap
  by_contra hnot
  have hlong : 2 * M < b - a := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  let x := (a + b - M) / 2
  obtain ⟨y, hyF, hyI⟩ := hdense x
  have hyab : y ∈ Ioo a b := by
    dsimp [x] at hyI
    constructor <;> linarith [hyI.1, hyI.2, hM]
  have : y ∈ Ioo a b ∩ frontier X := ⟨hyab, hyF⟩
  rw [hgap] at this
  exact this

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.transportedUniqueNoncolumnPlate_proper
statement:
private theorem transportedUniqueNoncolumnPlate_proper
    (C : ApproximationContext.{0})
    (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C phi)
    (R : TwoStageDeformationSupportTransport C phi D)
    (plateEquiv : Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region C.centres ≃
      Continuous.VerticalPlate D.deformedRegion (deformedCenterCarrier R.fullCenters))
    (centre_mem : ∀ (Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region C.centres)
      (t : ↥C.centres),
      (t.1 : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Q.centres ↔
        R.fullCenters t ∈ (plateEquiv Q).centres)
    (column_iff : ∀ Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region C.centres,
      Continuous.IsVerticalColumn Q ↔
        Continuous.IsVerticalColumn (plateEquiv Q))
    (Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region C.centres)
    (hNontrivial : NontrivialDecomposition C.region C.centres)
    (hQnoncolumn : ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn Q)
    (_hUnique : ∀ Q' : Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region C.centres,
      ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn Q' → Q' = Q) :
    ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn (plateEquiv Q) ∧
      (plateEquiv Q).base ≠ univ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hColumn
    exact hQnoncolumn ((column_iff Q).mpr hColumn)
  · intro hBase
    apply hNontrivial
    refine ⟨Q, hQnoncolumn, ?_⟩
    have hSupport : (plateEquiv Q).support = Set.univ := by
      have hSlab := (plateEquiv Q).support_isVerticalSlab R.full_tilesOn
      rw [hSlab.2, hBase]
      simp
    have hTargetCentres : (plateEquiv Q).centres = deformedCenterCarrier R.fullCenters :=
      Continuous.plate_centres_eq_of_support_eq_univ R.full_tilesOn (plateEquiv Q) hSupport
    ext t
    constructor
    · intro ht
      rcases ht with ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      exact s.2
    · intro ht
      have hTarget : R.fullCenters ⟨t, ht⟩ ∈ (plateEquiv Q).centres := by
        rw [hTargetCentres]
        exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, rfl⟩
      exact (centre_mem Q ⟨t, ht⟩).mpr hTarget

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.rationalTransportedPlate_periodicComponentBound
statement:
private theorem rationalTransportedPlate_periodicComponentBound :
    ∀ (C : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.ApproximationContext.{0})
      (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
      (D : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.CoordinateDeformation C phi)
      (R : Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.TwoStageDeformationSupportTransport
        C phi D)
      (Q : Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.VerticalPlate D.deformedRegion
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Approximation.deformedCenterCarrier R.fullCenters)),
      ¬ Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.IsVerticalColumn Q → Q.base ≠ univ →
      ∃ p L : ℝ, 0 < p ∧ 0 < L ∧
        Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy Q.support ((p : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        (∀ c : ℝ, ¬ Ioi c ⊆ Q.base) ∧
        (∀ c : ℝ, ¬ Iio c ⊆ Q.base) ∧
        ∀ a b : ℝ, a < b → Ioo a b ⊆ Q.base →
          Ioo a b ∩ frontier Q.base = ∅ → b - a ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  intro C phi D R Q hQnoncolumn hQproper
  have hRational : Tiling.RationalPolygonal.IsRelativelyRational
      D.deformedRegion.toPolygonalRegion := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv, _w, _hw, _hmax, _hdiam⟩ :=
      IntrinsicVertices.exists_intrinsicDiameterPair D.deformedRegion
    refine ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨wx, wy, hwre, hwim⟩ := D.rational_vertices w hw
    obtain ⟨vx, vy, hvre, hvim⟩ := D.rational_vertices v hv
    exact ⟨wx - vx, wy - vy,
      by simp only [Complex.sub_re, hwre, hvre, Rat.cast_sub],
      by simp only [Complex.sub_im, hwim, hvim, Rat.cast_sub]⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp, _hcolumnPeriod, hnoncolumnPeriod⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Continuous.rationalVerticalPlateSupport_periodic
      R.full_tilesOn hRational
  have hperiod := hnoncolumnPeriod Q hQnoncolumn
  have hslab := Q.support_isVerticalSlab R.full_tilesOn
  have hbaseOpen : IsOpen Q.base := by
    rw [hslab.1]
    exact isOpen_interior
  have hbaseRegular : interior (closure Q.base) = Q.base := hslab.1.symm
  have hbaseNonempty : Q.base.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Q.nonempty_supp
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := D.deformedRegion.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty
      D.deformedRegion.nonempty
    refine ⟨(t.1 + u).re, t.1 + u, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [Q.support_eq_regularSupport]
    change t.1 + u ∈
      Tiling.AxisParallel.regularSupport D.deformedRegion Q.centres
    have hopen : IsOpen (Tiling.AxisParallel.openUnion D.deformedRegion Q.centres) := by
      rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier]
      exact isOpen_iUnion fun s => isOpen_interior.vadd s.1
    apply hopen.subset_interior_closure
    rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion,
      ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
    refine ⟨⟨t.1, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
  have hpreimagePeriod :
      Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy (Complex.re ⁻¹' Q.base)
        ((p : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [← hslab.2]
    exact hperiod
  obtain ⟨hright, hleft, L, hL, hbound⟩ :=
    properPeriodicRegularOpen_components_bounded
      hbaseOpen hbaseRegular hbaseNonempty hQproper hp hpreimagePeriod
  exact ⟨p, L, hp, hL, hperiod, hright, hleft, hbound⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.iio_subset_plateBase_of_no_boundary_below
statement:
private theorem iio_subset_plateBase_of_no_boundary_below
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K T univ)
    (P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ P.base)
    (hno : ¬ ∃ c ∈ componentBoundarySet K T, c ≤ x) : Iio x ⊆ P.base
proof:
:= by
  have hfront : frontier P.base ⊆ componentBoundarySet K T := by
    intro c hc
    rw [componentBoundarySet_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨P, hc⟩
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Iio x) (frontier P.base) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro c hcx hc
    exact hno ⟨c, hfront hc, hcx.le⟩
  rcases Tiling.IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier
      isPreconnected_Iio hdisj with hin | hout
  · intro y hy
    exact interior_subset (hin hy)
  · exfalso
    have hopen : IsOpen P.base := by
      rw [(Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile P).1]
      exact isOpen_interior
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen x hx
    let y := x - ε / 2
    have hyIio : y ∈ Iio x := by change x - ε / 2 < x; linarith
    have hyBase : y ∈ P.base := hball (by
      rw [Real.ball_eq_Ioo]
      dsimp [y]
      constructor <;> linarith)
    exact (interior_subset (hout hyIio)) hyBase

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.ioi_subset_plateBase_of_no_boundary_above
statement:
private theorem ioi_subset_plateBase_of_no_boundary_above
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane} (hTile : TilesOn K T univ)
    (P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ P.base)
    (hno : ¬ ∃ c ∈ componentBoundarySet K T, x ≤ c) : Ioi x ⊆ P.base
proof:
:= by
  have hfront : frontier P.base ⊆ componentBoundarySet K T := by
    intro c hc
    rw [componentBoundarySet_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨P, hc⟩
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Ioi x) (frontier P.base) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro c hxc hc
    exact hno ⟨c, hfront hc, hxc.le⟩
  rcases Tiling.IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier
      isPreconnected_Ioi hdisj with hin | hout
  · intro y hy
    exact interior_subset (hin hy)
  · exfalso
    have hopen : IsOpen P.base := by
      rw [(Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile P).1]
      exact isOpen_interior
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen x hx
    let y := x + ε / 2
    have hyIoi : y ∈ Ioi x := by change x < x + ε / 2; linarith
    have hyBase : y ∈ P.base := hball (by
      rw [Real.ball_eq_Ioo]
      dsimp [y]
      constructor <;> linarith)
    exact (interior_subset (hout hyIoi)) hyBase

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.widePlate_hasLongBoundedComponent
statement:
private theorem widePlate_hasLongBoundedComponent :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T univ →
      ∀ (P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T),
      (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ a : ℝ, Ioo a (a + 2 * R) ⊆ P.base) →
      (∀ c : ℝ, ¬ (Ioi c ⊆ P.base ∧
        Ioi c ∩ componentBoundarySet K T = ∅)) →
      (∀ c : ℝ, ¬ (Iio c ⊆ P.base ∧
        Iio c ∩ componentBoundarySet K T = ∅)) →
      ∀ L : ℝ, 0 < L →
        ∃ c d : ↥(componentBoundarySet K T),
          c.1 < d.1 ∧ L < d.1 - c.1 ∧
          Ioo c.1 d.1 ⊆ P.base ∧
          Ioo c.1 d.1 ∩ componentBoundarySet K T = ∅
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile P hwide hnoright hnoleft L hL
  let R : ℝ := max (L + 1) 1
  have hR : 0 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right _ _)
  obtain ⟨a, haBase⟩ := hwide R hR
  let x : ℝ := a + R
  have hxWide : x ∈ Ioo a (a + 2 * R) := by
    dsimp [x]
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hxBase : x ∈ P.base := haBase hxWide
  have hbelow : ∃ c ∈ componentBoundarySet K T, c ≤ x := by
    by_contra hno
    have hfill := iio_subset_plateBase_of_no_boundary_below hTile P x hxBase hno
    apply hnoleft x
    refine ⟨hfill, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    rintro c ⟨hcx, hcE⟩
    exact hno ⟨c, hcE, hcx.le⟩
  have habove : ∃ d ∈ componentBoundarySet K T, x ≤ d := by
    by_contra hno
    have hfill := ioi_subset_plateBase_of_no_boundary_above hTile P x hxBase hno
    apply hnoright x
    refine ⟨hfill, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    rintro d ⟨hxd, hdE⟩
    exact hno ⟨d, hdE, hxd.le⟩
  have hlocal := componentBoundarySet_locallyFinite hTile
  obtain ⟨c, hcE, hcx, hcmax⟩ :=
    Approximation.exists_greatest_mem_le_of_boundedWindowFinite hlocal hbelow
  obtain ⟨d, hdE, hxd, hdmin⟩ :=
    Approximation.exists_least_mem_ge_of_boundedWindowFinite hlocal habove
  have hca : c ≤ a := by
    by_contra h
    have hca' : a < c := lt_of_not_ge h
    exact componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase hTile hcE P
      (haBase ⟨hca', lt_of_le_of_lt hcx hxWide.2⟩)
  have had : a + 2 * R ≤ d := by
    by_contra h
    have had' : d < a + 2 * R := lt_of_not_ge h
    exact componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase hTile hdE P
      (haBase ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hxWide.1 hxd, had'⟩)
  have hcx' : c < x := lt_of_le_of_ne hcx (by
    intro h
    apply componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase hTile hcE P
    rwa [h])
  have hxd' : x < d := lt_of_le_of_ne hxd (by
    intro h
    apply componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase hTile hdE P
    rwa [← h])
  have hcd : c < d := hcx'.trans hxd'
  have hgap : Ioo c d ∩ componentBoundarySet K T = ∅ := by
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    rintro z ⟨hz, hzE⟩
    rcases le_total z x with hzx | hxz
    · exact (not_le_of_gt hz.1) (hcmax z hzE hzx)
    · exact (not_le_of_gt hz.2) (hdmin z hzE hxz)
  have hfront : frontier P.base ⊆ componentBoundarySet K T := by
    intro z hz
    rw [componentBoundarySet_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨P, hz⟩
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Ioo c d) (frontier P.base) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro z hz hzfront
    have : z ∈ Ioo c d ∩ componentBoundarySet K T := ⟨hz, hfront hzfront⟩
    rw [hgap] at this
    exact this
  have hbase : Ioo c d ⊆ P.base := by
    rcases Tiling.IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier
        isPreconnected_Ioo hdisj with hin | hout
    · exact hin.trans interior_subset
    · exfalso
      exact (interior_subset (hout ⟨hcx', hxd'⟩)) hxBase
  refine ⟨⟨c, hcE⟩, ⟨d, hdE⟩, hcd, ?_, hbase, hgap⟩
  have hRL : L < 2 * R := by
    dsimp [R]
    have : L + 1 ≤ max (L + 1) 1 := le_max_left _ _
    linarith
  linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.mappedHorizontalStep_ge
statement:
private theorem mappedHorizontalStep_ge
    (C : ApproximationContext.{0}) (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C phi) {eta d : ℝ}
    (hEta : ∀ a b : ↥C.region.vertices, a.1.re < b.1.re →
      eta ≤ (D.planarHomeomorph b.1).re - (D.planarHomeomorph a.1).re)
    (hd : d ∈ C.region.horizontalStepAlphabet) :
    eta ≤ mapScalar phi ⟨d, horizontalStep_mem_coordinateSpace C hd⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hEq, hpos⟩ :=
    (Region.mem_horizontalStepAlphabet_iff C.region d).mp hd
  have hab : a.re < b.re := by rw [hEq] at hpos; exact sub_pos.mp hpos
  have hscalar : (⟨d, horizontalStep_mem_coordinateSpace C hd⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) =
      ⟨b.re, C.vertex_re_mem b hb⟩ - ⟨a.re, C.vertex_re_mem a ha⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hEq
  have hmapped : mapScalar phi ⟨d, horizontalStep_mem_coordinateSpace C hd⟩ =
      (D.planarHomeomorph b).re - (D.planarHomeomorph a).re := by
    rw [hscalar, D.vertex_agreement b hb, D.vertex_agreement a ha]
    simp only [mapScalar, map_sub, Rat.cast_sub, mapPoint,
      ApproximationContext.vertexPoint, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, add_zero]
  rw [hmapped]
  exact hEta ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ hab

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.mappedTranslatedVertex_eq
statement:
private theorem mappedTranslatedVertex_eq
    (C : ApproximationContext.{0}) (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
    (D : CoordinateDeformation C phi)
    (R : TwoStageDeformationSupportTransport C phi D)
    (v : ↥C.region.vertices) (t : ↥C.centres) :
    mapScalar phi ⟨(v.1 + t.1).re, by
      rw [Complex.add_re]
      exact C.coordinateSpace.add_mem (C.vertex_re_mem v.1 v.2)
        (C.centre_re_mem t.1 t.2)⟩ =
      (D.planarHomeomorph v.1 + R.fullCenters t).re
proof:
:= by
  have hscalar : (⟨(v.1 + t.1).re, by
      rw [Complex.add_re]
      exact C.coordinateSpace.add_mem (C.vertex_re_mem v.1 v.2)
        (C.centre_re_mem t.1 t.2)⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) =
      ⟨v.1.re, C.vertex_re_mem v.1 v.2⟩ +
        ⟨t.1.re, C.centre_re_mem t.1 t.2⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Complex.add_re _ _
  rw [hscalar, D.vertex_agreement v.1 v.2, R.fullCenters_apply t]
  simp only [mapScalar, map_add, Rat.cast_add, mapPoint,
    ApproximationContext.vertexPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint,
    Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
    Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, add_zero]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.rightRay_extends_to_boundary
statement:
private theorem rightRay_extends_to_boundary
    {E B : Set ℝ} (hE : E.Nonempty)
    (hlocal : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (E ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hfront : frontier B ⊆ E) (havoid : ∀ z ∈ E, z ∉ B)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : Ioi c ⊆ B) :
    ∃ a : ↥E, Ioi a.1 ⊆ B ∧ Ioi a.1 ∩ E = ∅
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hE
  let x : ℝ := max c z + 1
  have hcx : c < x := by dsimp [x]; linarith [le_max_left c z]
  have hzx : z ≤ x := by dsimp [x]; linarith [le_max_right c z]
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hax, hamax⟩ :=
    Approximation.exists_greatest_mem_le_of_boundedWindowFinite hlocal ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩
  have hax' : a < x := lt_of_le_of_ne hax (by
    intro h
    exact havoid a ha (h.symm ▸ hc hcx))
  have hgap : Ioi a ∩ E = ∅ := by
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    rintro y ⟨hay, hy⟩
    by_cases hyx : y ≤ x
    · exact (not_le_of_gt hay) (hamax y hy hyx)
    · exact havoid y hy (hc (hcx.trans (lt_of_not_ge hyx)))
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Ioi a) (frontier B) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro y hy hyF
    have hyGap : y ∈ Ioi a ∩ E := ⟨hy, hfront hyF⟩
    rw [hgap] at hyGap
    exact hyGap
  refine ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ?_, hgap⟩
  rcases Tiling.IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier
      isPreconnected_Ioi hdisj with hin | hout
  · exact hin.trans interior_subset
  · exact False.elim ((interior_subset (hout hax')) (hc hcx))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.leftRay_extends_to_boundary
statement:
private theorem leftRay_extends_to_boundary
    {E B : Set ℝ} (hE : E.Nonempty)
    (hlocal : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (E ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hfront : frontier B ⊆ E) (havoid : ∀ z ∈ E, z ∉ B)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : Iio c ⊆ B) :
    ∃ a : ↥E, Iio a.1 ⊆ B ∧ Iio a.1 ∩ E = ∅
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hE
  let x : ℝ := min c z - 1
  have hxc : x < c := by dsimp [x]; linarith [min_le_left c z]
  have hxz : x ≤ z := by dsimp [x]; linarith [min_le_right c z]
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hxa, hamin⟩ :=
    Approximation.exists_least_mem_ge_of_boundedWindowFinite hlocal ⟨z, hz, hxz⟩
  have hxa' : x < a := lt_of_le_of_ne hxa (by
    intro h
    exact havoid a ha (h ▸ hc hxc))
  have hgap : Iio a ∩ E = ∅ := by
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    rintro y ⟨hya, hy⟩
    by_cases hxy : x ≤ y
    · exact (not_le_of_gt hya) (hamin y hy hxy)
    · exact havoid y hy (hc ((lt_of_not_ge hxy).trans hxc))
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Iio a) (frontier B) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro y hy hyF
    have hyGap : y ∈ Iio a ∩ E := ⟨hy, hfront hyF⟩
    rw [hgap] at hyGap
    exact hyGap
  refine ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ?_, hgap⟩
  rcases Tiling.IsPreconnected.subset_interior_or_subset_interior_compl_of_disjoint_frontier
      isPreconnected_Iio hdisj with hin | hout
  · exact hin.trans interior_subset
  · exact False.elim ((interior_subset (hout hxa')) (hc hxc))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.uniqueWideNoncolumn_implies_infiniteContactDisplacement
statement:
private theorem uniqueWideNoncolumn_implies_infiniteContactDisplacement :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T univ → NontrivialDecomposition K T →
      (∃ P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
        ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧
        (∀ Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
          ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn Q → Q = P) ∧
        ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ a : ℝ,
          Ioo a (a + 2 * R) ⊆ P.base) →
      ∃ a b a' b' : ↥K.vertices,
        (horizontalContactDisplacements K T a b a' b').Infinite
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile hNontrivial hwide
  by_contra hfinite
  push Not at hfinite
  obtain ⟨P, hPnoncolumn, hUnique, hPwide⟩ := hwide
  obtain ⟨N⟩ := normalizedWidePlateData_exists
    hTile hNontrivial P hPnoncolumn hUnique hPwide hfinite
  let C := N.context
  obtain ⟨ef, hef, hFCT⟩ :=
    finiteContactWitnesses C N.normalized_tiles N.normalized_contact_finite
  obtain ⟨eg, heg, hgood⟩ := isGoodApproximation_of_sufficientlyFine C
  obtain ⟨phi, hphi⟩ := exists_epsilonApproximation C (min ef eg) (lt_min hef heg)
  have hphif : IsEpsilonApproximation C ef phi := by
    refine ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hphi.epsilon_pos (min_le_left _ _), hphi.fixesRational, ?_⟩
    intro j
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (hphi.basis_close j) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hphig : IsEpsilonApproximation C eg phi := by
    refine ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hphi.epsilon_pos (min_le_right _ _), hphi.fixesRational, ?_⟩
    intro j
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (hphi.basis_close j) (min_le_right _ _)
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := exists_rationalPolygonDeformation C phi (hgood phi hphig)
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := exists_twoStageDeformationSupportTransport C phi D N.normalized_tiles
  obtain ⟨_hcontact, plateEquiv, boundaryLift, boundaryEquiv,
    hlift, hboundary, hboundaryMono, hcentre, hcolumn,
    hchamber, hright, hleft, hside⟩ := hFCT phi hphif D R
  obtain ⟨hQnoncolumn, hQproper⟩ := transportedUniqueNoncolumnPlate_proper
    C phi D R plateEquiv hcentre hcolumn N.normalizedPlate
    N.normalized_nontrivial N.normalized_noncolumn N.normalized_unique
  obtain ⟨_p, L, _hp, hL, _hperiod, hnoright, hnoleft, hbound⟩ :=
    rationalTransportedPlate_periodicComponentBound C phi D R
      (plateEquiv N.normalizedPlate) hQnoncolumn hQproper
  have hSourceProper : N.normalizedPlate.base ≠ univ := by
    intro hbase
    apply N.normalized_nontrivial
    refine ⟨N.normalizedPlate, N.normalized_noncolumn, ?_⟩
    apply Continuous.plate_centres_eq_of_support_eq_univ N.normalized_tiles
    rw [(N.normalizedPlate.support_isVerticalSlab N.normalized_tiles).2, hbase]
    simp
  have hSourceBaseNe : N.normalizedPlate.base.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := N.normalized_wide 1 zero_lt_one
    exact ⟨a + 1, ha (by constructor <;> linarith)⟩
  have hSourceFrontNe : (frontier N.normalizedPlate.base).Nonempty := by
    by_contra hno
    rcases frontier_eq_empty_iff.mp (Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hno) with h | h
    · exact hSourceBaseNe.ne_empty h
    · exact hSourceProper h
  have hSourceFront : frontier N.normalizedPlate.base ⊆
      componentBoundarySet C.region C.centres := by
    intro c hc
    rw [componentBoundarySet_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨N.normalizedPlate, hc⟩
  have hSourceBoundaryNe := hSourceFrontNe.mono hSourceFront
  have hSourceAvoid : ∀ z ∈ componentBoundarySet C.region C.centres,
      z ∉ N.normalizedPlate.base := fun z hz ↦
    componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase (c := z)
      N.normalized_tiles hz N.normalizedPlate
  have hSourceLocal := componentBoundarySet_locallyFinite N.normalized_tiles
  have hSourceRight : ∀ c : ℝ, ¬ (Ioi c ⊆ N.normalizedPlate.base ∧
      Ioi c ∩ componentBoundarySet C.region C.centres = ∅) := by
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := rightRay_extends_to_boundary hSourceBoundaryNe
      hSourceLocal hSourceFront hSourceAvoid hc.1
    exact hnoright _ ((hright N.normalizedPlate a).mp ha).1
  have hSourceLeft : ∀ c : ℝ, ¬ (Iio c ⊆ N.normalizedPlate.base ∧
      Iio c ∩ componentBoundarySet C.region C.centres = ∅) := by
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := leftRay_extends_to_boundary hSourceBoundaryNe
      hSourceLocal hSourceFront hSourceAvoid hc.1
    exact hnoleft _ ((hleft N.normalizedPlate a).mp ha).1
  obtain ⟨eta, hEta, hStepLower⟩ := mappedHorizontalStep_min C phi D
  let Dmax := C.region.horizontalStepAlphabet.max'
    (Region.horizontalStepAlphabet_nonempty C.region)
  have hDmax : 0 < Dmax := Region.horizontalStepAlphabet_pos C.region
    (Finset.max'_mem _ _)
  let cutoff := Dmax * (L / eta + 1)
  have hCutoff : 0 < cutoff := by dsimp [cutoff]; positivity
  obtain ⟨c, d, hcd, hlong, hbase, hgap⟩ := widePlate_hasLongBoundedComponent
    N.normalized_tiles N.normalizedPlate N.normalized_wide hSourceRight hSourceLeft
      cutoff hCutoff
  obtain ⟨t, v, w, ht, hvw, hvwre, hsideSegment, hdeep, hsideLe⟩ :=
    wideComponent_hasDeepTranslatedVerticalSide N.normalized_tiles
      N.normalizedPlate c d hcd hbase hgap cutoff hCutoff hlong
  let endpoint : C.coordinateSpace := ⟨(v.1 + t.1).re, by
    rw [Complex.add_re]
    exact C.coordinateSpace.add_mem (C.vertex_re_mem v.1 v.2)
      (C.centre_re_mem t.1 t.2)⟩
  have hendpoint := mappedTranslatedVertex_eq C phi D R v t
  change mapScalar phi endpoint = _ at hendpoint
  have hsideGt : c.1 < (v.1 + t.1).re := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n, _hn, step, hstep, hstepSum⟩ := horizontalBoundaryDistance_eq_stepSum
    N.normalized_tiles (componentBoundaryLine_subset_translatedFrontiers
      N.normalized_tiles c.1 c.2) v t (ne_of_gt hsideGt)
  rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hsideGt)] at hstepSum
  let stepLift : Fin n → C.coordinateSpace :=
    fun i ↦ ⟨step i, horizontalStep_mem_coordinateSpace C (hstep i)⟩
  have hLiftSum : endpoint - boundaryLift c = ∑ i, stepLift i := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [Submodule.coe_sub, Submodule.coe_sum, hlift c]
    exact hstepSum
  have hMappedSum : mapScalar phi endpoint - mapScalar phi (boundaryLift c) =
      ∑ i, mapScalar phi (stepLift i) := by
    have hPhi := congrArg phi hLiftSum
    simp only [map_sub, map_sum] at hPhi
    change ((phi endpoint : ℚ) : ℝ) - ((phi (boundaryLift c) : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      ∑ i, ((phi (stepLift i) : ℚ) : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast hPhi
  have hMappedLong : L < ∑ i, mapScalar phi (stepLift i) := by
    apply longBoundaryWord_mappedLength step (fun i ↦ mapScalar phi (stepLift i))
      hDmax hEta hL.le
    · intro i
      exact ⟨Region.horizontalStepAlphabet_pos C.region (hstep i),
        Finset.le_max' _ _ (hstep i)⟩
    · intro i
      exact mappedHorizontalStep_ge C phi D hStepLower (hstep i)
    · rw [← hstepSum]
      exact (lt_sub_iff_add_lt').mpr hdeep
  have hsideTargetLe : (D.planarHomeomorph v.1 + R.fullCenters t).re ≤
      (boundaryEquiv d).1 := by
    rcases hsideLe.eq_or_lt with heq | hlt
    · have hLiftD : endpoint = boundaryLift d := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact heq.trans (hlift d).symm
      rw [← hendpoint, hLiftD, ← hboundary d]
    · exact (hside N.normalizedPlate t v w c d ht hvw hvwre hsideSegment
        hcd hgap hbase hsideGt hlt).2.le
  have htargetBase := (hchamber N.normalizedPlate c d hcd hgap).mp hbase
  have htargetGap : Ioo (boundaryEquiv c).1 (boundaryEquiv d).1 ∩
      frontier (plateEquiv N.normalizedPlate).base = ∅ := by
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    rintro x ⟨hx, hxF⟩
    have hopen : IsOpen (plateEquiv N.normalizedPlate).base := by
      rw [((plateEquiv N.normalizedPlate).support_isVerticalSlab R.full_tilesOn).1]
      exact isOpen_interior
    exact hxF.2 (by rw [hopen.interior_eq]; exact htargetBase hx)
  have hTargetBound := hbound _ _ (hboundaryMono hcd) htargetBase htargetGap
  rw [← hMappedSum, hendpoint, ← hboundary c] at hMappedLong
  linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.infiniteContactDisplacement_notFiniteComplexity
statement:
private theorem infiniteContactDisplacement_notFiniteComplexity :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      Continuous.HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity T →
      ∀ a b a' b' : ↥K.vertices,
        ¬ (horizontalContactDisplacements K T a b a' b').Infinite
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hFLC a b a' b'
  have hbounded := horizontalContactDisplacements_bounded K T a b a' b'
  rw [Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall 0] at hbounded
  obtain ⟨R, hsub⟩ := hbounded
  let R' := max R 1
  have hR' : 0 < R' := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right R 1)
  have hfinite :
      ((Continuous.horizontalCentreProjection T -
          Continuous.horizontalCentreProjection T) ∩
        Metric.closedBall 0 R').Finite := by
    exact hFLC.2 R' hR'
  have htarget : horizontalContactDisplacements K T a b a' b' ⊆
      (Continuous.horizontalCentreProjection T -
          Continuous.horizontalCentreProjection T) ∩
        Metric.closedBall 0 R' := by
    intro delta hdelta
    have hballR := hsub hdelta
    rw [horizontalContactDisplacements_iff] at hdelta
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, t, s, rfl, _⟩ := hdelta
    constructor
    · refine ⟨(s.1 : Tiling.Plane).re, ⟨s.1, s.2, rfl⟩,
        (t.1 : Tiling.Plane).re, ⟨t.1, t.2, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rfl
    · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hballR ⊢
      exact hballR.trans (le_max_left R 1)
  exact (hfinite.subset htarget).not_infinite

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.infiniteHorizontalComplexity_iff_columnBaseAperiodic
statement:
theorem infiniteHorizontalComplexity_iff_columnBaseAperiodic :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T univ →
      (¬ ∃ P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
        ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧ P.centres = T) →
      ((¬ Continuous.HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity T) ↔
        ((regularSupport K (Continuous.verticalColumnCentres K T)).Nonempty ∧
          ∀ beta : ℝ, beta ≠ 0 →
            ¬ Tiling.RationalPolygonal.SetPeriodicBy
              (regularSupport K (Continuous.verticalColumnCentres K T))
              ((beta : ℝ) : ℂ))) ∧
      ((¬ Continuous.HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity T) ↔
        ∃ P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
          ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧
          (∀ Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
            ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn Q → Q = P) ∧
          ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
            ∃ a : ℝ, Ioo a (a + 2 * R) ⊆ P.base) ∧
      ((¬ Continuous.HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity T) ↔
        ∃ a b a' b' : ↥K.vertices,
          (horizontalContactDisplacements K T a b a' b').Infinite)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile hNontrivial
  have aperiodic_of_notFinite :=
    notFiniteComplexity_implies_columnBaseAperiodic hTile hNontrivial
  have wide_of_aperiodic :=
    columnBaseAperiodic_implies_uniqueWideNoncolumn hTile hNontrivial
  have infinite_of_wide :=
    uniqueWideNoncolumn_implies_infiniteContactDisplacement
      hTile hNontrivial
  have notFinite_of_infinite :
      (∃ a b a' b' : ↥K.vertices,
        (horizontalContactDisplacements K T a b a' b').Infinite) →
      ¬ Continuous.HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity T := by
    rintro ⟨a, b, a', b', hInfinite⟩ hFinite
    exact infiniteContactDisplacement_notFiniteComplexity hFinite a b a' b' hInfinite
  refine ⟨⟨aperiodic_of_notFinite, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, notFinite_of_infinite⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨hne, haperiodic⟩
    exact notFinite_of_infinite (infinite_of_wide (wide_of_aperiodic hne haperiodic))
  · intro hnotFinite
    obtain ⟨hne, haperiodic⟩ := aperiodic_of_notFinite hnotFinite
    exact wide_of_aperiodic hne haperiodic
  · intro hwide
    exact notFinite_of_infinite (infinite_of_wide hwide)
  · intro hnotFinite
    obtain ⟨hne, haperiodic⟩ := aperiodic_of_notFinite hnotFinite
    exact infinite_of_wide (wide_of_aperiodic hne haperiodic)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.closedTranslatedSupports_cover
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile
  have hSupport : regularSupport K T = univ :=
    regularSupport_eq_of_tilesOn isOpen_univ (by simp) hTile
  have hClosure : closure (openUnion K T) = closedSupportUnion K T :=
    closure_openUnion_eq_iUnion_support hTile.2.1
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm (fun _ _ ↦ Set.mem_univ _)
  intro z _
  rw [← hClosure]
  apply interior_subset
  change z ∈ regularSupport K T
  rw [hSupport]
  exact Set.mem_univ z

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.fixedHorizontalLine_closedSupportCover
statement:
private theorem fixedHorizontalLine_closedSupportCover :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T univ → ∀ y : ℝ,
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.im = y} ⊆ closedSupportUnion K T
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile y z _
  rw [closedTranslatedSupports_cover hTile]
  exact Set.mem_univ z

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundaryLine_subset_translatedFrontiers
statement:
theorem componentBoundaryLine_subset_translatedFrontiers :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T univ →
      ∀ c ∈ componentBoundarySet K T,
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c} ⊆
          ⋃ t : ↥T, frontier ((t.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile c hc z hz
  rw [componentBoundarySet_eq] at hc
  obtain ⟨P, hcP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hc
  have hBaseDisjoint (Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) (hPQ : P ≠ Q) :
      Disjoint P.base Q.base := by
    let _ : Countable T := hTile.1.to_subtype
    let _ : Countable (Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) := by
      apply Function.Surjective.countable
        (f := fun t : T ↦ Continuous.VerticalPlate.ofCentre (K := K) t)
      intro R
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := R.nonempty_supp
      refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
      exact (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff R r).1 hr
    have hSupportDisjoint : Disjoint P.support Q.support := by
      have hPartition := regularSupport_pairwiseDisjoint
        (@Continuous.VerticalPlate.centres K T)
        (Continuous.verticalPlateCentres_pairwiseDisjoint K T)
        (Continuous.iUnion_verticalPlateCentres K T) hTile
      exact hPartition.1 (Set.mem_univ P) (Set.mem_univ Q) hPQ
    obtain ⟨-, hPSupport⟩ :=
      Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile P
    obtain ⟨-, hQSupport⟩ :=
      Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile Q
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro r hrP hrQ
    let q : Tiling.Plane := ⟨r, 0⟩
    have hqP : q ∈ P.support := by
      rw [hPSupport]
      exact hrP
    have hqQ : q ∈ Q.support := by
      rw [hQSupport]
      exact hrQ
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hSupportDisjoint hqP hqQ
  have hcNotBase (Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) : c ∉ Q.base := by
    obtain ⟨hPRegular, -⟩ :=
      Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile P
    have hPBaseOpen : IsOpen P.base := by
      rw [hPRegular]
      exact isOpen_interior
    by_cases hPQ : P = Q
    · subst Q
      intro hcBase
      exact hcP.2 (by rwa [hPBaseOpen.interior_eq])
    · intro hcQ
      obtain ⟨hQRegular, -⟩ :=
        Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile Q
      have hQBaseOpen : IsOpen Q.base := by
        rw [hQRegular]
        exact isOpen_interior
      have hMeet : (Q.base ∩ P.base).Nonempty :=
        (mem_closure_iff.mp (frontier_subset_closure hcP))
          Q.base hQBaseOpen hcQ
      obtain ⟨r, hrQ, hrP⟩ := hMeet
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hBaseDisjoint Q hPQ) hrP hrQ
  have hzCover : z ∈ closedSupportUnion K T := by
    rw [closedTranslatedSupports_cover hTile]
    exact Set.mem_univ z
  rw [closedSupportUnion, Set.mem_iUnion] at hzCover
  obtain ⟨t, hzt⟩ := hzCover
  rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  rw [frontier, (K.isPolygonal.isClosed.vadd (t.1 : Tiling.Plane)).closure_eq]
  refine ⟨hzt, ?_⟩
  intro hzInterior
  let Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T :=
    Continuous.VerticalPlate.ofCentre (K := K) t
  have htQ : (t.1 : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Q.centres :=
    Continuous.VerticalPlate.mem_centres_ofCentre t
  have hzOpen : z ∈ (t.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.openCarrier := by
    change z ∈ (t.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ interior K.support
    rw [← interior_vadd]
    exact hzInterior
  have hzUnion : z ∈ openUnion K Q.centres := by
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier, Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨⟨t.1, htQ⟩, hzOpen⟩
  have hUnionOpen : IsOpen (openUnion K Q.centres) := by
    rw [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier]
    exact isOpen_iUnion fun q : Q.centres ↦
      (Homeomorph.addLeft (q : Tiling.Plane)).isOpenMap _ isOpen_interior
  have hzSupport : z ∈ Q.support := by
    rw [Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_eq_regularSupport, regularSupport]
    exact interior_maximal subset_closure hUnionOpen hzUnion
  apply hcNotBase Q
  rw [Continuous.VerticalPlate.base_eq]
  exact ⟨z, hzSupport, hz⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundary_completeTranslatedBoundaryLine
statement:
private theorem componentBoundary_completeTranslatedBoundaryLine :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T univ → NontrivialDecomposition K T →
      ∀ c ∈ componentBoundarySet K T,
        {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re = c} ⊆
          ⋃ t : ↥T, frontier ((t.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ K.support)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile _hNontrivial
  exact componentBoundaryLine_subset_translatedFrontiers hTile

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.finiteSignedStepWordValues
statement:
private theorem finiteSignedStepWordValues :
    ∀ (G : Finset ℝ) (N : ℕ),
      {x : ℝ | ∃ (sgn : Fin 2) (n : Fin (N + 1)) (w : Fin n.1 → ℝ),
        (∀ i, w i ∈ G) ∧
        x = if sgn = 0 then ∑ i, w i else -∑ i, w i}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  intro G N
  let Code := Fin 2 × (Σ n : Fin (N + 1), Fin n.1 → ↥(G : Set ℝ))
  let value : Code → ℝ := fun code ↦
    if code.1 = 0 then ∑ i, (code.2.2 i : ℝ)
    else -∑ i, (code.2.2 i : ℝ)
  apply (Set.finite_range value).subset
  rintro x ⟨sgn, n, w, hw, rfl⟩
  let w' : Fin n.1 → ↥(G : Set ℝ) := fun i ↦ ⟨w i, hw i⟩
  refine ⟨(sgn, ⟨n, w'⟩), ?_⟩
  dsimp only [value, w']

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.adjacent_gap_lt_two_mul
statement:
private theorem adjacent_gap_lt_two_mul
    {Z : Set ℝ} (z : ℤ → ℝ) (hmono : StrictMono z)
    (hrange : Set.range z = Z)
    {M : ℝ} (hrel : ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ a ∈ Z, |a - x| < M)
    (i : ℤ) : z (i + 1) - z i < 2 * M
proof:
:= by
  have hstep : z i < z (i + 1) := hmono (by omega)
  obtain ⟨a, haZ, ha⟩ := hrel ((z i + z (i + 1)) / 2)
  rw [← hrange] at haZ
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := haZ
  rcases le_or_gt j i with hji | hij
  · have hzle : z j ≤ z i := hmono.monotone hji
    have hgap : (z (i + 1) - z i) / 2 ≤
        |z j - (z i + z (i + 1)) / 2| := by
      rw [abs_of_nonpos] <;> linarith
    linarith
  · have hij' : i + 1 ≤ j := by omega
    have hzle : z (i + 1) ≤ z j := hmono.monotone hij'
    have hgap : (z (i + 1) - z i) / 2 ≤
        |z j - (z i + z (i + 1)) / 2| := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg] <;> linarith
    linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.finite_adjacent_gaps_of_hasFLC
statement:
private theorem finite_adjacent_gaps_of_hasFLC
    {Z : Set ℝ} (z : ℤ → ℝ)
    (hmono : StrictMono z) (hrange : Set.range z = Z)
    (hrelDense : ∃ M : ℝ, 0 < M ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ a ∈ Z, |a - x| < M)
    (hflc : Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC Z) :
    {g : ℝ | ∃ i : ℤ, g = z (i + 1) - z i}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hrel⟩ := hrelDense
  apply (hflc.2 (2 * M) (by positivity)).subset
  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hg
  have hgap : 0 < z (i + 1) - z i := sub_pos.mpr (hmono (by omega))
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨z (i + 1), ?_, z i, ?_, rfl⟩
    · rw [← hrange]
      exact Set.mem_range_self _
    · rw [← hrange]
      exact Set.mem_range_self _
  · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hgap]
    exact (adjacent_gap_lt_two_mul z hmono hrange hrel i).le

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.sum_adjacent_gaps
statement:
private theorem sum_adjacent_gaps (z : ℤ → ℝ) (i : ℤ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      z (i + (n : ℤ)) - z i =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n,
          (z (i + (k + 1 : ℕ)) - z (i + (k : ℕ)))
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      calc
        z (i + ((n : ℤ) + 1)) - z i =
            (z (i + (n : ℤ)) - z i) +
              (z (i + ((n : ℤ) + 1)) - z (i + (n : ℤ))) := by ring
        _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n,
              (z (i + (k + 1 : ℕ)) - z (i + (k : ℕ))) +
              (z (i + ((n : ℤ) + 1)) - z (i + (n : ℤ))) := by rw [ih]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.nat_mul_le_difference
statement:
private theorem nat_mul_le_difference
    (z : ℤ → ℝ) {delta : ℝ}
    (hdelta : ∀ i : ℤ, delta ≤ z (i + 1) - z i)
    (i : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    (n : ℝ) * delta ≤ z (i + (n : ℤ)) - z i
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_adjacent_gaps]
  calc
    (n : ℝ) * delta = ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range n, delta := by simp
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n,
        (z (i + (k + 1 : ℕ)) - z (i + (k : ℕ))) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro k _hk
      have hcast : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (k : ℤ) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hcast, ← add_assoc]
      exact hdelta (i + (k : ℤ))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.bounded_differences_finite_of_finite_adjacent_gaps
statement:
private theorem bounded_differences_finite_of_finite_adjacent_gaps
    (z : ℤ → ℝ) (hmono : StrictMono z)
    (hG : {g : ℝ | ∃ i : ℤ, g = z (i + 1) - z i}.Finite)
    (R : ℝ) (_hR : 0 < R) :
    ((Set.range z - Set.range z) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 R).Finite
proof:
:= by
  let G : Set ℝ := {g : ℝ | ∃ i : ℤ, g = z (i + 1) - z i}
  have hGne : G.Nonempty := ⟨z (0 + 1) - z 0, 0, rfl⟩
  have hGfinne : hG.toFinset.Nonempty :=
    (Set.Finite.toFinset_nonempty hG).2 (by simpa [G] using hGne)
  let delta : ℝ := hG.toFinset.min' hGfinne
  have hdeltaMemFin : delta ∈ hG.toFinset :=
    Finset.min'_mem hG.toFinset hGfinne
  have hdeltaMem : delta ∈ G := by
    simpa [G] using (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset hG).mp hdeltaMemFin
  have hdeltaPos : 0 < delta := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hdeltaMem
    rw [hi]
    exact sub_pos.mpr (hmono (by omega))
  have hdeltaLe : ∀ i : ℤ, delta ≤ z (i + 1) - z i := by
    intro i
    apply Finset.min'_le
    exact (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset hG).mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (R / delta)
  have hG' : G.Finite := by simpa [G] using hG
  let _ : Fintype ↥G := hG'.fintype
  let Code := Fin 2 × (Σ n : Fin (N + 1), Fin n.1 → ↥G)
  let value : Code → ℝ := fun code ↦
    if code.1 = 0 then ∑ k, (code.2.2 k : ℝ)
    else -∑ k, (code.2.2 k : ℝ)
  apply (Set.finite_range value).subset
  intro d hd
  rcases hd.1 with ⟨x, ⟨j, rfl⟩, y, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have hball : |z j - z i| ≤ R := by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] using hd.2
  rcases le_total i j with hij | hji
  · let n : ℕ := (j - i).toNat
    have hncast : (n : ℤ) = j - i :=
      Int.toNat_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hij)
    have hijn : i + (n : ℤ) = j := by rw [hncast]; omega
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ z j - z i := sub_nonneg.mpr (hmono.monotone hij)
    have hmul : (n : ℝ) * delta ≤ R := by
      calc
        (n : ℝ) * delta ≤ z (i + (n : ℤ)) - z i :=
          nat_mul_le_difference z hdeltaLe i n
        _ = z j - z i := by rw [hijn]
        _ = |z j - z i| := (abs_of_nonneg hnonneg).symm
        _ ≤ R := hball
    have hnle : (n : ℝ) ≤ R / delta := (le_div_iff₀ hdeltaPos).2 (by
      simpa only [mul_comm] using hmul)
    have hnN : n < N := by exact_mod_cast hnle.trans_lt hN
    let n' : Fin (N + 1) := ⟨n, hnN.trans (Nat.lt_succ_self N)⟩
    let f : Fin n → ↥G := fun k ↦
      ⟨z (i + (k.1 + 1 : ℕ)) - z (i + (k.1 : ℕ)),
        ⟨i + (k.1 : ℤ), by congr 2; omega⟩⟩
    refine ⟨((0 : Fin 2), ⟨n', f⟩), ?_⟩
    change value ((0 : Fin 2), ⟨n', f⟩) = z j - z i
    simp only [value, ↓reduceIte, f]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (α := ℝ)
      (fun k : ℕ ↦ z (i + (k + 1 : ℕ)) - z (i + (k : ℕ))) n]
    calc
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n,
          (z (i + (k + 1 : ℕ)) - z (i + (k : ℕ))) =
          z (i + (n : ℤ)) - z i := (sum_adjacent_gaps z i n).symm
      _ = z j - z i := by rw [hijn]
  · let n : ℕ := (i - j).toNat
    have hncast : (n : ℤ) = i - j :=
      Int.toNat_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hji)
    have hjin : j + (n : ℤ) = i := by rw [hncast]; omega
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ z i - z j := sub_nonneg.mpr (hmono.monotone hji)
    have hmul : (n : ℝ) * delta ≤ R := by
      calc
        (n : ℝ) * delta ≤ z (j + (n : ℤ)) - z j :=
          nat_mul_le_difference z hdeltaLe j n
        _ = z i - z j := by rw [hjin]
        _ = |z j - z i| := by rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg hnonneg]
        _ ≤ R := hball
    have hnle : (n : ℝ) ≤ R / delta := (le_div_iff₀ hdeltaPos).2 (by
      simpa only [mul_comm] using hmul)
    have hnN : n < N := by exact_mod_cast hnle.trans_lt hN
    let n' : Fin (N + 1) := ⟨n, hnN.trans (Nat.lt_succ_self N)⟩
    let f : Fin n → ↥G := fun k ↦
      ⟨z (j + (k.1 + 1 : ℕ)) - z (j + (k.1 : ℕ)),
        ⟨j + (k.1 : ℤ), by congr 2; omega⟩⟩
    refine ⟨((1 : Fin 2), ⟨n', f⟩), ?_⟩
    change value ((1 : Fin 2), ⟨n', f⟩) = z j - z i
    simp only [value, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, f]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (α := ℝ)
      (fun k : ℕ ↦ z (j + (k + 1 : ℕ)) - z (j + (k : ℕ))) n]
    calc
      -∑ k ∈ Finset.range n,
          (z (j + (k + 1 : ℕ)) - z (j + (k : ℕ))) =
          -(z (j + (n : ℤ)) - z j) := by rw [sum_adjacent_gaps]
      _ = z j - z i := by rw [hjin]; ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.range_locallyFinite_of_bounded_differences
statement:
private theorem range_locallyFinite_of_bounded_differences
    (z : ℤ → ℝ)
    (hDiff : ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
      ((Set.range z - Set.range z) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 R).Finite) :
    ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (Set.range z ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQ
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall 0).mp hQ
  let R : ℝ := |r| + |z 0| + 1
  have hR : 0 < R := by dsimp [R]; positivity
  have hImage : ((fun x : ℝ ↦ x - z 0) '' (Set.range z ∩ Q)).Finite := by
    apply (hDiff R hR).subset
    rintro d ⟨x, ⟨hxZ, hxQ⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨x, hxZ, z 0, Set.mem_range_self 0, rfl⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero]
      have hxabs : |x| ≤ r := by
        have hxball := hr hxQ
        simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] using hxball
      have htri : |x - z 0| ≤ |x| + |z 0| := by
        simpa only [sub_zero, zero_sub, abs_neg] using (abs_sub_le x 0 (z 0))
      calc
        |x - z 0| ≤ |x| + |z 0| := htri
        _ ≤ |r| + |z 0| := add_le_add (hxabs.trans (le_abs_self r)) le_rfl
        _ ≤ R := by dsimp [R]; linarith
  exact hImage.of_finite_image fun x _ y _ hxy ↦ by linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.flc_iff_finiteAdjacentGaps
statement:
theorem flc_iff_finiteAdjacentGaps
    {Z : Set ℝ} (z : ℤ → ℝ)
    (hmono : StrictMono z) (hrange : Set.range z = Z)
    (hrelDense : ∃ M : ℝ, 0 < M ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ a ∈ Z, |a - x| < M) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.HasFLC Z ↔
      {g : ℝ | ∃ i : ℤ, g = z (i + 1) - z i}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact finite_adjacent_gaps_of_hasFLC z hmono hrange hrelDense
  · intro hG
    rw [← hrange]
    have hDiff : ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
        ((Set.range z - Set.range z) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 R).Finite :=
      bounded_differences_finite_of_finite_adjacent_gaps z hmono hG
    exact ⟨range_locallyFinite_of_bounded_differences z hDiff, hDiff⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.projectedCentres_tileRelativelyDense
statement:
private theorem projectedCentres_tileRelativelyDense :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T univ →
      ∃ H : ℝ, 0 < H ∧ ∀ x : ℝ,
        ∃ t ∈ T, |t.re - x| < H
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := K.isPolygonal.isBounded.subset_closedBall
    (0 : Tiling.Plane)
  let H : ℝ := max D 0 + 1
  refine ⟨H, by dsimp [H]; linarith [le_max_right D 0], ?_⟩
  intro x
  let z : Tiling.Plane := (x : ℂ)
  have hzCover : z ∈ closedSupportUnion K T := by
    rw [closedTranslatedSupports_cover hTile]
    exact Set.mem_univ z
  rw [closedSupportUnion, Set.mem_iUnion] at hzCover
  obtain ⟨t, hzt⟩ := hzCover
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hzt
  let k : Tiling.Plane := -(t.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ z
  have hk : k ∈ K.support := by simpa only [k] using hzt
  have hkClosed : k ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Tiling.Plane) D := hD hk
  have hkBound : ‖k‖ ≤ max D 0 := by
    have : ‖k‖ ≤ D := by
      simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero] using hkClosed
    exact this.trans (le_max_left D 0)
  refine ⟨t.1, t.2, ?_⟩
  have hRe : t.1.re - x = -k.re := by
    simp only [k, z, vadd_eq_add, Complex.neg_re, Complex.add_re,
      Complex.ofReal_re]
    ring
  calc
    |t.1.re - x| = |k.re| := by rw [hRe, abs_neg]
    _ ≤ ‖k‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm k
    _ ≤ max D 0 := hkBound
    _ < H := by dsimp [H]; linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.adjacentProjectedGap_hasBoundedBoundaryWords
statement:
private theorem adjacentProjectedGap_hasBoundedBoundaryWords :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T univ → NontrivialDecomposition K T →
      (∃ M : ℝ, 0 < M ∧ ∀ x : ℝ,
        (componentBoundarySet K T ∩ Icc x (x + M)).Nonempty) →
      ∀ z : ℤ → ℝ, StrictMono z →
        Set.range z = Continuous.horizontalCentreProjection T →
        ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ i : ℤ,
          ∃ (sgn₀ sgn₁ : Fin 2)
            (n₀ n₁ : Fin (N + 1))
            (w₀ : Fin n₀.1 → ℝ) (w₁ : Fin n₁.1 → ℝ),
            (∀ j, w₀ j ∈ K.horizontalStepAlphabet) ∧
            (∀ j, w₁ j ∈ K.horizontalStepAlphabet) ∧
            z (i + 1) - z i =
              (if sgn₁ = 0 then ∑ j, w₁ j else -∑ j, w₁ j) -
                (if sgn₀ = 0 then ∑ j, w₀ j else -∑ j, w₀ j)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile hNontrivial hDense z hmono hrange
  obtain ⟨H, hH, hProjectedDense⟩ :=
    projectedCentres_tileRelativelyDense hTile
  have hRel : ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ a ∈ Continuous.horizontalCentreProjection T,
      |a - x| < H := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨t, ht, htx⟩ := hProjectedDense x
    exact ⟨t.re, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, htx⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv, _w, _hw, _hmax, _hdiam⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.exists_intrinsicDiameterPair K
  let vK : ↥K.vertices := ⟨v, hv⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hBoundaryDense⟩ := hDense
  let delta : ℝ := K.horizontalStepAlphabet.min'
    K.horizontalStepAlphabet_nonempty
  have hdelta : 0 < delta := K.horizontalStepAlphabet_pos
    (K.horizontalStepAlphabet.min'_mem K.horizontalStepAlphabet_nonempty)
  have hdeltaLe : ∀ d ∈ K.horizontalStepAlphabet, delta ≤ d := by
    intro d hd
    exact K.horizontalStepAlphabet.min'_le d hd
  let R : ℝ := M + 2 * H
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (R / delta)
  have hWord (c : ℝ) (hcBoundary : c ∈ componentBoundarySet K T)
      (t : ↥T)
      (hbound : |(vK.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane)).re - c| ≤ R) :
      ∃ (sgn : Fin 2) (n : Fin (N + 1)) (word : Fin n.1 → ℝ),
        (∀ j, word j ∈ K.horizontalStepAlphabet) ∧
        (if sgn = 0 then ∑ j, word j else -∑ j, word j) =
          (vK.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane)).re - c := by
    by_cases heq : (vK.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane)).re = c
    · refine ⟨0, ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ N⟩, fun j ↦ Fin.elim0 j, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro j
        exact Fin.elim0 j
      · simp [heq]
    · obtain ⟨n, _hn, step, hstep, hsum, hnR⟩ :=
        horizontalBoundaryStepCount_le hTile
          (componentBoundary_completeTranslatedBoundaryLine
            hTile hNontrivial c hcBoundary)
          hdelta hdeltaLe vK t heq hbound
      have hnle : (n : ℝ) ≤ R / delta := by
        apply (le_div_iff₀ hdelta).2
        simpa only [mul_comm] using hnR
      have hnN : n < N := by
        exact_mod_cast hnle.trans_lt hN
      let n' : Fin (N + 1) :=
        ⟨n, hnN.trans (Nat.lt_succ_self N)⟩
      by_cases hlt : (vK.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane)).re < c
      · refine ⟨1, n', step, hstep, ?_⟩
        simp only [Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [abs_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr hlt)] at hsum
        linarith
      · have hgt : c < (vK.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane)).re :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hlt) (Ne.symm heq)
        refine ⟨0, n', step, hstep, ?_⟩
        simp only [↓reduceIte]
        rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hgt)] at hsum
        exact hsum.symm
  refine ⟨N, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  have hzi : z i ∈ Continuous.horizontalCentreProjection T := by
    rw [← hrange]
    exact Set.mem_range_self i
  have hzi1 : z (i + 1) ∈ Continuous.horizontalCentreProjection T := by
    rw [← hrange]
    exact Set.mem_range_self (i + 1)
  change z i ∈ Complex.re '' T at hzi
  change z (i + 1) ∈ Complex.re '' T at hzi1
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, ht₀re⟩ := hzi
  obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁, ht₁re⟩ := hzi1
  let t₀T : ↥T := ⟨t₀, ht₀⟩
  let t₁T : ↥T := ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hcBoundary, hcRange⟩ := hBoundaryDense (v.re + z i)
  have hgap : z (i + 1) - z i < 2 * H :=
    adjacent_gap_lt_two_mul z hmono hrange hRel i
  have hp₀ : (vK.1 + (t₀T.1 : Tiling.Plane)).re = v.re + z i := by
    simp only [vK, t₀T, Complex.add_re]
    rw [ht₀re]
  have hp₁ : (vK.1 + (t₁T.1 : Tiling.Plane)).re = v.re + z (i + 1) := by
    simp only [vK, t₁T, Complex.add_re]
    rw [ht₁re]
  have hbound₀ : |(vK.1 + (t₀T.1 : Tiling.Plane)).re - c| ≤ R := by
    rw [hp₀, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hcRange.1)]
    dsimp only [R]
    linarith [hcRange.2, hH]
  have hbound₁ : |(vK.1 + (t₁T.1 : Tiling.Plane)).re - c| ≤ R := by
    rw [hp₁, abs_le]
    dsimp only [R]
    constructor <;> linarith [hcRange.1, hcRange.2,
      hmono (show i < i + 1 by omega), hgap]
  obtain ⟨sgn₀, n₀, word₀, hword₀, hvalue₀⟩ :=
    hWord c hcBoundary t₀T hbound₀
  obtain ⟨sgn₁, n₁, word₁, hword₁, hvalue₁⟩ :=
    hWord c hcBoundary t₁T hbound₁
  refine ⟨sgn₀, sgn₁, n₀, n₁, word₀, word₁,
    hword₀, hword₁, ?_⟩
  calc
    z (i + 1) - z i =
        ((vK.1 + (t₁T.1 : Tiling.Plane)).re - c) -
          ((vK.1 + (t₀T.1 : Tiling.Plane)).re - c) := by
            rw [hp₀, hp₁]
            ring
    _ = (if sgn₁ = 0 then ∑ j, word₁ j else -∑ j, word₁ j) -
          (if sgn₀ = 0 then ∑ j, word₀ j else -∑ j, word₀ j) := by
            rw [hvalue₀, hvalue₁]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.adjacentProjectedGaps_finite_of_relativelyDenseBoundaries
statement:
private theorem adjacentProjectedGaps_finite_of_relativelyDenseBoundaries :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T univ → NontrivialDecomposition K T →
      (∃ M : ℝ, 0 < M ∧ ∀ x : ℝ,
        (componentBoundarySet K T ∩ Icc x (x + M)).Nonempty) →
      ∀ z : ℤ → ℝ, StrictMono z →
        Set.range z = Continuous.horizontalCentreProjection T →
        (adjacentGapSet z).Finite
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile hNontrivial hDense z hmono hrange
  obtain ⟨N, hWords⟩ := adjacentProjectedGap_hasBoundedBoundaryWords
    hTile hNontrivial hDense z hmono hrange
  let Values : Set ℝ :=
    {x : ℝ | ∃ (sgn : Fin 2) (n : Fin (N + 1))
      (word : Fin n.1 → ℝ),
      (∀ j, word j ∈ K.horizontalStepAlphabet) ∧
      x = if sgn = 0 then ∑ j, word j else -∑ j, word j}
  have hValues : Values.Finite := by
    simpa only [Values] using
      finiteSignedStepWordValues K.horizontalStepAlphabet N
  apply (hValues.sub hValues).subset
  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hg
  obtain ⟨sgn₀, sgn₁, n₀, n₁, word₀, word₁,
    hword₀, hword₁, hgap⟩ := hWords i
  refine ⟨_, ⟨sgn₁, n₁, word₁, hword₁, rfl⟩,
    _, ⟨sgn₀, n₀, word₀, hword₀, rfl⟩, hgap.symm⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.finiteHorizontalComplexity_of_relativelyDenseBoundaries
statement:
theorem finiteHorizontalComplexity_of_relativelyDenseBoundaries :
    ∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
      TilesOn K T univ →
      (¬ ∃ P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
        ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧ P.centres = T) →
      (∃ M : ℝ, 0 < M ∧ ∀ x : ℝ,
        (componentBoundarySet K T ∩ Icc x (x + M)).Nonempty) →
      Continuous.HasFiniteHorizontalComplexity T
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile hNontrivial hDense
  obtain ⟨z, hmono, hrange⟩ :=
    exists_increasingProjectedCentreEnumeration hTile hNontrivial
  obtain ⟨H, hH, hProjectedDense⟩ :=
    projectedCentres_tileRelativelyDense hTile
  have hRel : ∃ H : ℝ, 0 < H ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ a ∈ Continuous.horizontalCentreProjection T,
        |a - x| < H := by
    refine ⟨H, hH, ?_⟩
    intro x
    obtain ⟨t, ht, htx⟩ := hProjectedDense x
    exact ⟨t.re, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, htx⟩
  exact (flc_iff_finiteAdjacentGaps z hmono hrange hRel).2
    (adjacentProjectedGaps_finite_of_relativelyDenseBoundaries
      hTile hNontrivial hDense z hmono hrange)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.horizontalFootprint_pos_candidate
proof:
:= by
  let A : Set ℝ := interior (closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier))
  have hCarrierOpen : IsOpen K.openCarrier := isOpen_interior
  have hCarrierNonempty : K.openCarrier.Nonempty :=
    K.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty K.nonempty
  have hProjectionOpen : IsOpen (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier) :=
    Complex.isOpenMap_re K.openCarrier hCarrierOpen
  have hProjectionNonempty : (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier).Nonempty :=
    hCarrierNonempty.image Complex.re
  have hAOpen : IsOpen A := by
    simp only [A]
    exact isOpen_interior
  have hANonempty : A.Nonempty := by
    apply hProjectionNonempty.mono
    simpa only [A] using hProjectionOpen.subset_interior_closure
  have hCarrierBounded : Bornology.IsBounded K.openCarrier :=
    K.isPolygonal.isBounded.subset interior_subset
  have hProjectionBounded : Bornology.IsBounded
      (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier) :=
    RCLike.lipschitzWith_re.isBounded_image hCarrierBounded
  have hABounded : Bornology.IsBounded A := by
    apply hProjectionBounded.closure.subset
    simpa only [A] using
      (interior_subset :
        interior (closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier)) ⊆
          closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier))
  have hVolumePosENN : 0 < MeasureTheory.volume A :=
    hAOpen.measure_pos MeasureTheory.volume hANonempty
  have hVolumeNeTop : MeasureTheory.volume A ≠ ⊤ :=
    (hABounded.measure_lt_top (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)).ne
  have hVolumePos : 0 < (MeasureTheory.volume A).toReal :=
    ENNReal.toReal_pos hVolumePosENN.ne' hVolumeNeTop
  simpa only [A] using hVolumePos

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.verticalPlateBases_pairwiseDisjoint_candidate
statement:
private theorem verticalPlateBases_pairwiseDisjoint_candidate
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (P Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T)
    (hPQ : P ≠ Q) : Disjoint P.base Q.base
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Countable T := hTile.1.to_subtype
  let _ : Countable (Continuous.VerticalPlate K T) := by
    apply Function.Surjective.countable
      (f := fun t : T ↦ Continuous.VerticalPlate.ofCentre (K := K) t)
    intro R
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := R.nonempty_supp
    refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
    exact (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff R r).1 hr
  have hSupportDisjoint : Disjoint P.support Q.support := by
    have hPartition := regularSupport_pairwiseDisjoint
      (@Continuous.VerticalPlate.centres K T)
      (Continuous.verticalPlateCentres_pairwiseDisjoint K T)
      (Continuous.iUnion_verticalPlateCentres K T) hTile
    exact hPartition.1 (Set.mem_univ P) (Set.mem_univ Q) hPQ
  obtain ⟨-, hPSupport⟩ :=
    Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile P
  obtain ⟨-, hQSupport⟩ :=
    Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile Q
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro z hzP hzQ
  let q : Tiling.Plane := ⟨z, 0⟩
  have hqP : q ∈ P.support := by
    rw [hPSupport]
    exact hzP
  have hqQ : q ∈ Q.support := by
    rw [hQSupport]
    exact hzQ
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hSupportDisjoint hqP hqQ

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.base_window_nonempty_candidate
statement:
private theorem base_window_nonempty_candidate
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (P : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T)
    (hPnoncolumn : ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P)
    (x : ℝ) :
    (P.base ∩ Ioo x
      (x + 8 * Metric.diam
        (closure (interior (closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier)))))).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  have hThickness := noncolumnPlate_thickness hTile P hPnoncolumn x
  change (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
      (MeasureTheory.volume
        (interior (closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier)))).toReal <
    (MeasureTheory.volume
      (P.base ∩ Ioo x
        (x + 8 * Metric.diam
          (closure (interior (closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier))))))).toReal
    at hThickness
  have hHalf : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
      (MeasureTheory.volume
        (interior (closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier)))).toReal :=
    mul_pos (by norm_num) (horizontalFootprint_pos_candidate K)
  have hPositive := hHalf.trans hThickness
  by_contra hEmpty
  have hEq : P.base ∩ Ioo x
      (x + 8 * Metric.diam
        (closure (interior (closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier))))) =
      (∅ : Set ℝ) := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hEmpty
  rw [hEq, MeasureTheory.measure_empty] at hPositive
  exact (lt_irrefl 0 hPositive)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.frontier_between_disjoint_open_candidate
proof:
:= by
  have hqClosure : q ∉ closure P := by
    intro hqClosure
    obtain ⟨z, hzQ, hzP⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hqClosure Q hQopen hq
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hPQ hzP hzQ
  let lo := min p q
  let hi := max p q
  have hpIcc : p ∈ Icc lo hi := by
    exact ⟨min_le_left _ _, le_max_left _ _⟩
  have hqIcc : q ∈ Icc lo hi := by
    exact ⟨min_le_right _ _, le_max_right _ _⟩
  have hIccPre : IsPreconnected (Icc lo hi) := isPreconnected_Icc
  have hnotSubset : ¬ Icc lo hi ⊆ P := by
    intro hsubset
    have hqNotP : q ∉ P := by
      intro hqP
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hPQ hqP hq
    exact hqNotP (hsubset hqIcc)
  have hclosureNotSubset : ¬ closure P ∩ Icc lo hi ⊆ P := by
    intro hsubset
    apply hnotSubset
    exact hIccPre.subset_of_closure_inter_subset hPopen
      ⟨p, hpIcc, hp⟩ hsubset
  obtain ⟨z, hzClosureIcc, hzNotP⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hclosureNotSubset
  refine ⟨z, ?_, hzClosureIcc.2⟩
  change z ∈ closure P \ interior P
  refine ⟨hzClosureIcc.1, ?_⟩
  simpa only [hPopen.interior_eq] using hzNotP

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundarySet_relativelyDense_of_two_noncolumnPlates
statement:
theorem componentBoundarySet_relativelyDense_of_two_noncolumnPlates
    {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hTile : TilesOn K T Set.univ)
    (hTwo : ∃ P Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate K T,
      P ≠ Q ∧ ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn P ∧
        ¬ Continuous.IsVerticalColumn Q) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 < M ∧ ∀ x : ℝ,
      (componentBoundarySet K T ∩ Icc x (x + M)).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hPQ, hPnoncolumn, hQnoncolumn⟩ := hTwo
  let M : ℝ := 8 * Metric.diam
    (closure (interior (closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier))))
  have hM : 0 < M := by
    dsimp [M]
    have hD : 0 < Metric.diam
        (closure (interior (closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier)))) := by
      have hCarrierOpen : IsOpen K.openCarrier := isOpen_interior
      have hCarrierNonempty : K.openCarrier.Nonempty :=
        K.isPolygonal.interior_nonempty K.nonempty
      have hProjectionOpen : IsOpen (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier) :=
        Complex.isOpenMap_re K.openCarrier hCarrierOpen
      have hProjectionNonempty :
          (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier).Nonempty :=
        hCarrierNonempty.image Complex.re
      have hA : (interior (closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier))).Nonempty :=
        hProjectionNonempty.mono hProjectionOpen.subset_interior_closure
      have hAopen : IsOpen (interior (closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier))) :=
        isOpen_interior
      have hAreg : (interior (closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier))).Nontrivial := by
        rw [← Set.not_subsingleton_iff]
        intro hsub
        have hzero : MeasureTheory.volume
            (interior (closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier))) = 0 :=
          hsub.measure_zero MeasureTheory.volume
        exact (ne_of_gt (hAopen.measure_pos MeasureTheory.volume hA)) hzero
      have hCarrierBounded : Bornology.IsBounded K.openCarrier :=
        K.isPolygonal.isBounded.subset interior_subset
      have hProjectionBounded : Bornology.IsBounded
          (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier) :=
        RCLike.lipschitzWith_re.isBounded_image hCarrierBounded
      have hABounded : Bornology.IsBounded
          (interior (closure (Complex.re '' K.openCarrier))) := by
        apply hProjectionBounded.closure.subset
        exact interior_subset
      apply Metric.diam_pos
      · exact hAreg.mono subset_closure
      · exact hABounded.closure
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨M, hM, ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hPnonempty := base_window_nonempty_candidate hTile P hPnoncolumn x
  have hQnonempty := base_window_nonempty_candidate hTile Q hQnoncolumn x
  obtain ⟨p, hpP, hpI⟩ := hPnonempty
  obtain ⟨q, hqQ, hqI⟩ := hQnonempty
  change x < p ∧ p < x + M at hpI
  change x < q ∧ q < x + M at hqI
  have hPopen : IsOpen P.base := by
    obtain ⟨hRegular, -⟩ :=
      Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile P
    rw [hRegular]
    exact isOpen_interior
  have hQopen : IsOpen Q.base := by
    obtain ⟨hRegular, -⟩ :=
      Continuous.VerticalPlate.support_isVerticalSlab hTile Q
    rw [hRegular]
    exact isOpen_interior
  obtain ⟨z, hzFrontier, hzBetween⟩ :=
    frontier_between_disjoint_open_candidate hPopen hQopen
      (verticalPlateBases_pairwiseDisjoint_candidate hTile P Q hPQ)
      hpP hqQ
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [componentBoundarySet_eq]
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨P, hzFrontier⟩
  · have hpBounds : p ∈ Icc x (x + M) := by
      exact ⟨le_of_lt hpI.1, le_of_lt hpI.2⟩
    have hqBounds : q ∈ Icc x (x + M) := by
      exact ⟨le_of_lt hqI.1, le_of_lt hqI.2⟩
    exact ⟨(le_min hpBounds.1 hqBounds.1).trans hzBetween.1,
      hzBetween.2.trans (max_le hpBounds.2 hqBounds.2)⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.horizontalLineCutSet_locallyFinite
statement:
private theorem horizontalLineCutSet_locallyFinite :
    (∀ {K : Region} {T : Set Tiling.Plane},
    TilesOn K T univ → ∀ y : ℝ, ∀ Q : Set ℝ,
      Bornology.IsBounded Q →
      (horizontalLineCutSet K T y ∩ Q).Finite)
proof:
:= by
  intro K T hTile y Q hQ
  obtain ⟨R_Q, hQball⟩ := hQ.subset_closedBall (0 : ℝ)
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := K.isPolygonal.isBounded.subset_closedBall
    (0 : Tiling.Plane)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := K.nonempty
  have hDnonneg : 0 ≤ D := by
    have hkD := hD hk
    have hkD' : ‖k‖ ≤ D := by
      simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero] using hkD
    exact (norm_nonneg k).trans hkD'
  have hVnorm (v : ↥K.vertices) : ‖(v.1 : Tiling.Plane)‖ ≤ D := by
    have hvfront := IntrinsicVertices.region_vertices_subset_frontier K v.2
    rw [Region.frontier_openCarrier_eq_frontier_support] at hvfront
    have hvSupport : (v.1 : Tiling.Plane) ∈ K.support := by
      rw [← K.isPolygonal.isClosed.closure_eq]
      exact frontier_subset_closure hvfront
    have hvBall := hD hvSupport
    simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero] using hvBall
  let R : ℝ := max R_Q 0 + |y| + 4 * D + 1
  let S : Set Tiling.Plane := T ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 R
  have hSfinite : S.Finite := by
    exact (IsPacking.locallyFinite_centres hTile.2.1).1 _
      (Metric.isBounded_closedBall)
  have hVfinite : (K.vertices : Set Tiling.Plane).Finite := by
    rw [← K.coe_vertexFinset]
    exact K.vertexFinset.finite_toSet
  have hPairs : (S ×ˢ (K.vertices : Set Tiling.Plane)).Finite :=
    hSfinite.prod hVfinite
  let value : Tiling.Plane × Tiling.Plane → ℝ :=
    fun p ↦ (p.2 + p.1).re
  apply (hPairs.image value).subset
  rintro x ⟨hxCut, hxQ⟩
  obtain ⟨witness⟩ := hxCut
  rcases witness with ⟨t, v, w, hside, hcoord, hline⟩
  have hxBall : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℝ) R_Q := hQball hxQ
  have hxNorm : ‖linePoint y x‖ ≤ max R_Q 0 + |y| := by
    rw [Complex.norm_def]
    have hxabsQ : |x| ≤ R_Q := by
      simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] using hxBall
    have hxabs : |x| ≤ max R_Q 0 := hxabsQ.trans (le_max_left R_Q 0)
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) ≤ |x| + |y| := by
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 := by positivity
      have hsquare : (Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2)) ^ 2 = x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 :=
        Real.sq_sqrt hnonneg
      have hsum : 0 ≤ |x| + |y| := by positivity
      have hx_sq : |x| ^ 2 = x ^ 2 := sq_abs x
      have hy_sq : |y| ^ 2 = y ^ 2 := sq_abs y
      have hxy : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ (|x| + |y|) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← hx_sq, ← hy_sq]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg x) (abs_nonneg y)]
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2)]
    calc
      ‖linePoint y x‖ = Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) := by
        rw [Complex.norm_def, Complex.normSq_apply]
        simp [linePoint]
        ring_nf
      _ ≤ |x| + |y| := hsqrt
      _ ≤ max R_Q 0 + |y| := by linarith
  have hpSegment : ‖linePoint y x - (v.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane))‖ ≤
      ‖(w.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane)) - (v.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane))‖ := by
    exact norm_sub_le_of_mem_segment hline
  have htNorm : ‖(t.1 : Tiling.Plane)‖ ≤ R := by
    have hv := hVnorm v
    have hw := hVnorm w
    have hvw : ‖(w.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane)) -
        (v.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane))‖ ≤ 2 * D := by
      calc
        ‖(w.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane)) - (v.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane))‖ =
            ‖(w.1 : Tiling.Plane) - v.1‖ := by congr 1; ring
        _ ≤ ‖(w.1 : Tiling.Plane)‖ + ‖(v.1 : Tiling.Plane)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ 2 * D := by linarith
    have htri : ‖(t.1 : Tiling.Plane)‖ ≤
        ‖linePoint y x‖ +
          ‖linePoint y x - (v.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane))‖ +
          ‖(v.1 : Tiling.Plane)‖ := by
      calc
        ‖(t.1 : Tiling.Plane)‖ =
            ‖linePoint y x -
              (linePoint y x - (v.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane))) - v.1‖ := by
                congr 1; ring
        _ ≤ ‖linePoint y x -
              (linePoint y x - (v.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane)))‖ +
              ‖(v.1 : Tiling.Plane)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ (‖linePoint y x‖ +
              ‖linePoint y x - (v.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane))‖) +
              ‖(v.1 : Tiling.Plane)‖ := by
                gcongr
                exact norm_sub_le _ _
        _ = ‖linePoint y x‖ +
              ‖linePoint y x - (v.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane))‖ +
              ‖(v.1 : Tiling.Plane)‖ := by ring
    dsimp [R]
    linarith [hxNorm, hpSegment, hVnorm v, hVnorm w, hVnorm v, hvw, hDnonneg]
  have htS : (t.1 : Tiling.Plane) ∈ S := by
    exact ⟨t.2, by simpa [S, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero] using htNorm⟩
  rcases hcoord with hcoord | hcoord
  · refine ⟨((t.1 : Tiling.Plane), (v.1 : Tiling.Plane)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨htS, v.2⟩
    · simp [value, hcoord, add_comm]
