      simpa [xLift] using hsum'
    have hPhi := congrArg phi hLiftEq
    simp only [map_sub, map_sum] at hPhi
    change ((phi (lift c) : ℚ) : ℝ) - ((phi xLift : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      ∑ i, ((phi (⟨step i,
        horizontalStep_mem_coordinateSpace C (hstep i)⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) : ℚ) : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast hPhi
  have hsumPos : 0 < ∑ i, mapScalar phi
      ⟨step i, horizontalStep_mem_coordinateSpace C (hstep i)⟩ := by
    exact Finset.sum_pos (fun i _hi ↦ hpositive (step i) (hstep i)
      (horizontalStep_mem_coordinateSpace C (hstep i)))
      ⟨⟨0, hn⟩, by simp⟩
  have hmapLt : mapScalar phi xLift < mapScalar phi (lift c) := by
    rw [← sub_pos, hmapEq]
    exact hsumPos
  have hend := target9_mapScalar_endpoint_eq_firstHomeomorph_add_center
    D v.1 v.2 t (v.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane)).re xLift rfl rfl
  have hend' : mapScalar phi xLift =
      (D.planarHomeomorph v.1 + P.fullCenters t).re := by
    calc
      mapScalar phi xLift = D.firstHomeomorph v.1.re +
          (mapFirstPoint phi (C.centrePoint t.1 t.2)).re := hend
      _ = (D.planarHomeomorph v.1 + P.fullCenters t).re := by
        rw [D.planarHomeomorph_apply, P.fullCenters_apply]
        simp [mapPoint, mapFirstPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint]
  rw [← hend']
  exact hmapLt

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundaryTransport_exists
statement:
private theorem componentBoundaryTransport_exists :
    ∀ (C : ApproximationContext.{0})
      (_hTile : TilesOn C.region C.centres univ)
      (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)
      (D : CoordinateDeformation C phi)
      (P : TwoStageDeformationSupportTransport C phi D)
      (plates : PlateTransportData C phi D P),
      Nonempty (ComponentBoundaryTransportData C phi D P plates)
proof:
:= by
  intro C hTile phi D P plates
  obtain ⟨lift, hlift⟩ := componentBoundaryLift_exists C hTile phi D
  have hpositive : ∀ d : ℝ, d ∈ C.region.horizontalStepAlphabet →
      ∀ hd : d ∈ C.coordinateSpace,
        0 < mapScalar phi ⟨d, hd⟩ := by
    intro d hd hdC
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab, hpos⟩ :=
      (C.region.mem_horizontalStepAlphabet_iff d).mp hd
    have haC : a.re ∈ C.coordinateSpace := C.vertex_re_mem a ha
    have hbC : b.re ∈ C.coordinateSpace := C.vertex_re_mem b hb
    have hsign := D.source_good.preservesVertexCoordinateSign
      Axis.horizontal b a hb ha
    have hlin := congrArg (fun q : ℚ => (q : ℝ))
      (map_sub phi ⟨b.re, hbC⟩ ⟨a.re, haC⟩)
    have hsub :
        (⟨b.re, hbC⟩ - ⟨a.re, haC⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) =
          ⟨b.re - a.re, C.coordinateSpace.sub_mem hbC haC⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rfl
    rw [hsub] at hlin
    have hlin' : mapScalar phi ⟨b.re, hbC⟩ - mapScalar phi ⟨a.re, haC⟩ =
        mapScalar phi ⟨b.re - a.re, C.coordinateSpace.sub_mem hbC haC⟩ := by
      simpa only [mapScalar, Rat.cast_sub] using hlin.symm
    have hsign' : Real.sign (mapScalar phi ⟨b.re, hbC⟩ -
        mapScalar phi ⟨a.re, haC⟩) = Real.sign (b.re - a.re) := by
      simpa [mapPoint, mapScalar, ApproximationContext.vertexPoint,
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord] using hsign
    have hdiff : 0 < mapScalar phi ⟨b.re, hbC⟩ -
        mapScalar phi ⟨a.re, haC⟩ := by
      have hsignone : Real.sign (mapScalar phi ⟨b.re, hbC⟩ -
          mapScalar phi ⟨a.re, haC⟩) = 1 := by
        rw [hsign', Real.sign_of_pos (show 0 < b.re - a.re by
          simpa [hab] using hpos)]
      rcases lt_trichotomy
          (mapScalar phi ⟨b.re, hbC⟩ - mapScalar phi ⟨a.re, haC⟩) 0 with hn | hz | hp
      · rw [Real.sign_of_neg hn] at hsignone
        norm_num at hsignone
      · rw [hz, Real.sign_zero] at hsignone
        norm_num at hsignone
      · exact hp
    have hdiff' : 0 < mapScalar phi
        ⟨b.re - a.re, C.coordinateSpace.sub_mem hbC haC⟩ := by
      rw [← hlin']
      exact hdiff
    have heq : (⟨d, hdC⟩ : C.coordinateSpace) =
        ⟨b.re - a.re, C.coordinateSpace.sub_mem hbC haC⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hab
    rwa [← heq] at hdiff'
  have hmono : StrictMono (fun x ↦ mapScalar phi (lift x)) :=
    componentBoundaryMapped_strictMono C hTile phi lift hlift hpositive
  have hboundaryRange := componentBoundary_target_eq_mappedRange
    C hTile phi D P plates lift hlift
  let E : Set ℝ := componentBoundarySet C.region C.centres
  let E' : Set ℝ := componentBoundarySet D.deformedRegion
      (deformedCenterCarrier P.fullCenters)
  have hmem (x : ↥E) : mapScalar phi (lift x) ∈ E' := by
    change mapScalar phi (lift x) ∈
      componentBoundarySet D.deformedRegion
        (deformedCenterCarrier P.fullCenters)
    rw [hboundaryRange]
    exact ⟨lift x, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  let boundaryEquiv : ↥E ≃ ↥E' :=
    Equiv.ofBijective (fun x ↦ ⟨mapScalar phi (lift x), hmem x⟩) (by
      constructor
      · intro x y hxy
        apply hmono.injective
        exact congrArg Subtype.val hxy
      · intro y
        have hy : y.1 ∈ mapScalarSet phi (Set.range lift) := by
          rw [← hboundaryRange]
          exact y.2
        rcases hy with ⟨z, ⟨x, rfl⟩, hzx⟩
        refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hzx)
  have hfrontiff (Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region C.centres)
      (c : ↥E) :
      c.1 ∈ frontier Q.base ↔
        (boundaryEquiv c).1 ∈ frontier (plates.plateEquiv Q).base := by
    obtain ⟨RQ⟩ := plateBoundaryReconstruction_exists
      C hTile phi D P plates.plateEquiv plates.centre_mem Q
    have hLiftEq (x : ↥(frontier Q.base)) :
        lift ⟨x.1, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨Q, x.2⟩⟩ =
          RQ.boundaryLift x := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [hlift, RQ.lift_coe]
    constructor
    · intro hc
      let x : ↥(frontier Q.base) := ⟨c.1, hc⟩
      rw [RQ.target_frontier]
      refine ⟨RQ.boundaryLift x, ⟨x, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      change mapScalar phi (RQ.boundaryLift x) =
        mapScalar phi (lift c)
      rw [← hLiftEq x]
    · intro hc
      rw [RQ.target_frontier] at hc
      rcases hc with ⟨u, ⟨x, rfl⟩, hux⟩
      have hxE : x.1 ∈ E := Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨Q, x.2⟩
      have hEq : (⟨x.1, hxE⟩ : ↥E) = c := by
        apply hmono.injective
        change mapScalar phi (lift ⟨x.1, hxE⟩) =
          mapScalar phi (lift c)
        rw [show (⟨x.1, hxE⟩ : ↥E) =
          ⟨x.1, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨Q, x.2⟩⟩ by rfl, hLiftEq]
        exact hux
      have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hEq
      rw [← hval]
      exact x.2
  refine ⟨⟨lift, boundaryEquiv, hlift, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro x
    rfl
  · intro x y hxy
    exact hmono hxy
  · intro Q c d hcd hgap
    obtain ⟨RQ⟩ := plateBoundaryReconstruction_exists
      C hTile phi D P plates.plateEquiv plates.centre_mem Q
    have hEndpoint (x : ↥(frontier Q.base)) :
        (boundaryEquiv ⟨x.1, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨Q, x.2⟩⟩).1 =
          mapScalar phi (RQ.boundaryLift x) := by
      change mapScalar phi (lift ⟨x.1, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨Q, x.2⟩⟩) = _
      apply congrArg (mapScalar phi)
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [hlift, RQ.lift_coe]
    have hfront_of_subset (hsub : Ioo c.1 d.1 ⊆ Q.base) :
        c.1 ∈ frontier Q.base ∧ d.1 ∈ frontier Q.base := by
      have hccl : c.1 ∈ closure Q.base := by
        apply closure_mono hsub
        rw [closure_Ioo hcd.ne]
        exact ⟨le_rfl, hcd.le⟩
      have hdcl : d.1 ∈ closure Q.base := by
        apply closure_mono hsub
        rw [closure_Ioo hcd.ne]
        exact ⟨hcd.le, le_rfl⟩
      constructor
      · rw [frontier]
        exact ⟨hccl, fun hi ↦ componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase
          hTile c.2 Q (interior_subset hi)⟩
      · rw [frontier]
        exact ⟨hdcl, fun hi ↦ componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase
          hTile d.2 Q (interior_subset hi)⟩
    constructor
    · intro hsub
      obtain ⟨hcQ, hdQ⟩ := hfront_of_subset hsub
      let a : ↥(frontier Q.base) := ⟨c.1, hcQ⟩
      let b : ↥(frontier Q.base) := ⟨d.1, hdQ⟩
      have hgapQ : Ioo a.1 b.1 ∩ frontier Q.base = ∅ := by
        rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
        intro x hx
        have hx' : x ∈ Ioo c.1 d.1 ∩ componentBoundarySet C.region C.centres :=
          ⟨hx.1, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨Q, hx.2⟩⟩
        rw [hgap] at hx'
        exact hx'
      have hch := RQ.bounded_chamber a b hcd hgapQ
      have haEq := hEndpoint a
      have hbEq := hEndpoint b
      rw [← haEq, ← hbEq] at hch
      exact hch.1 hsub
    · intro htarget
      have hcT : (boundaryEquiv c).1 ∈
          frontier (plates.plateEquiv Q).base := by
        have hcd' : (boundaryEquiv c).1 < (boundaryEquiv d).1 := hmono hcd
        have hccl : (boundaryEquiv c).1 ∈
            closure (plates.plateEquiv Q).base := by
          apply closure_mono htarget
          rw [closure_Ioo hcd'.ne]
          exact ⟨le_rfl, hcd'.le⟩
        have hnot := componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase
          P.full_tilesOn (boundaryEquiv c).2 (plates.plateEquiv Q)
        rw [frontier]
        exact ⟨hccl, fun hi ↦ hnot (interior_subset hi)⟩
      have hdT : (boundaryEquiv d).1 ∈
          frontier (plates.plateEquiv Q).base := by
        have hcd' : (boundaryEquiv c).1 < (boundaryEquiv d).1 := hmono hcd
        have hdcl : (boundaryEquiv d).1 ∈
            closure (plates.plateEquiv Q).base := by
          apply closure_mono htarget
          rw [closure_Ioo hcd'.ne]
          exact ⟨hcd'.le, le_rfl⟩
        have hnot := componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase
          P.full_tilesOn (boundaryEquiv d).2 (plates.plateEquiv Q)
        rw [frontier]
        exact ⟨hdcl, fun hi ↦ hnot (interior_subset hi)⟩
      have hfrontc := (hfrontiff Q c).mpr hcT
      have hfrontd := (hfrontiff Q d).mpr hdT
      let a : ↥(frontier Q.base) := ⟨c.1, hfrontc⟩
      let b : ↥(frontier Q.base) := ⟨d.1, hfrontd⟩
      have hgapQ : Ioo a.1 b.1 ∩ frontier Q.base = ∅ := by
        rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
        intro x hx
        have hx' : x ∈ Ioo c.1 d.1 ∩ componentBoundarySet C.region C.centres :=
          ⟨hx.1, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨Q, hx.2⟩⟩
        rw [hgap] at hx'
        exact hx'
      have hch := RQ.bounded_chamber a b hcd hgapQ
      have haEq := hEndpoint a
      have hbEq := hEndpoint b
      rw [← haEq, ← hbEq] at hch
      exact hch.2 htarget
  · intro Q c
    obtain ⟨RQ⟩ := plateBoundaryReconstruction_exists
      C hTile phi D P plates.plateEquiv plates.centre_mem Q
    have endpoint_eq (hcQ : c.1 ∈ frontier Q.base) :
        RQ.homeomorph c.1 = (boundaryEquiv c).1 := by
      let x : ↥(frontier Q.base) := ⟨c.1, hcQ⟩
      calc
        RQ.homeomorph c.1 = mapScalar phi (RQ.boundaryLift x) :=
          RQ.boundary_formula x
        _ = mapScalar phi (lift c) := by
          apply congrArg (mapScalar phi)
          apply Subtype.ext
          rw [RQ.lift_coe, hlift]
        _ = (boundaryEquiv c).1 := rfl
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hsub, hgap⟩
      have hccl : c.1 ∈ closure Q.base := by
        apply closure_mono hsub
        rw [closure_Ioi]
        exact self_mem_Ici
      have hcQ : c.1 ∈ frontier Q.base := by
        rw [frontier]
        exact ⟨hccl, fun hi ↦ componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase
          hTile c.2 Q (interior_subset hi)⟩
      have hceq := endpoint_eq hcQ
      constructor
      · intro y hy
        rw [RQ.target_base]
        let x : ℝ := RQ.homeomorph.symm y
        refine ⟨x, hsub ?_, RQ.homeomorph.apply_symm_apply y⟩
        have hHlt : RQ.homeomorph c.1 < RQ.homeomorph x := by
          simpa [x, hceq] using hy
        exact RQ.homeomorph_strictMono.lt_iff_lt.mp hHlt
      · rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
        intro y hy
        let y' : ↥E' := ⟨y, hy.2⟩
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := boundaryEquiv.surjective y'
        have hcx : c.1 < x.1 := by
          apply hmono.lt_iff_lt.mp
          change (boundaryEquiv c).1 < (boundaryEquiv x).1
          rw [hx]
          exact hy.1
        have hxgap : x.1 ∈ Ioi c.1 ∩ componentBoundarySet C.region C.centres :=
          ⟨hcx, x.2⟩
        rw [hgap] at hxgap
        exact hxgap
    · rintro ⟨hsub, hgap⟩
      have hccl : (boundaryEquiv c).1 ∈
          closure (plates.plateEquiv Q).base := by
        apply closure_mono hsub
        rw [closure_Ioi]
        exact self_mem_Ici
      have hcT : (boundaryEquiv c).1 ∈
          frontier (plates.plateEquiv Q).base := by
        rw [frontier]
        exact ⟨hccl, fun hi ↦ componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase
          P.full_tilesOn (boundaryEquiv c).2 (plates.plateEquiv Q)
          (interior_subset hi)⟩
      have hcQ := (hfrontiff Q c).mpr hcT
      have hceq := endpoint_eq hcQ
      constructor
      · intro x hx
        have hHlt : (boundaryEquiv c).1 < RQ.homeomorph x := by
          rw [← hceq]
          exact RQ.homeomorph_strictMono hx
        have hmem := hsub hHlt
        rw [RQ.target_base] at hmem
        obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ := hmem
        have hzx' : z = x := RQ.homeomorph.injective hzx
        simpa [hzx'] using hz
      · rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
        intro x hx
        let x' : ↥E := ⟨x, hx.2⟩
        have htargetLt : (boundaryEquiv c).1 < (boundaryEquiv x').1 :=
          hmono hx.1
        have htargetGap : (boundaryEquiv x').1 ∈
            Ioi (boundaryEquiv c).1 ∩
              componentBoundarySet D.deformedRegion
                (deformedCenterCarrier P.fullCenters) :=
          ⟨htargetLt, (boundaryEquiv x').2⟩
        rw [hgap] at htargetGap
        exact htargetGap
  · intro Q c
    obtain ⟨RQ⟩ := plateBoundaryReconstruction_exists
      C hTile phi D P plates.plateEquiv plates.centre_mem Q
    have endpoint_eq (hcQ : c.1 ∈ frontier Q.base) :
        RQ.homeomorph c.1 = (boundaryEquiv c).1 := by
      let x : ↥(frontier Q.base) := ⟨c.1, hcQ⟩
      calc
        RQ.homeomorph c.1 = mapScalar phi (RQ.boundaryLift x) :=
          RQ.boundary_formula x
        _ = mapScalar phi (lift c) := by
          apply congrArg (mapScalar phi)
          apply Subtype.ext
          rw [RQ.lift_coe, hlift]
        _ = (boundaryEquiv c).1 := rfl
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hsub, hgap⟩
      have hccl : c.1 ∈ closure Q.base := by
        apply closure_mono hsub
        rw [closure_Iio]
        exact self_mem_Iic
      have hcQ : c.1 ∈ frontier Q.base := by
        rw [frontier]
        exact ⟨hccl, fun hi ↦ componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase
          hTile c.2 Q (interior_subset hi)⟩
      have hceq := endpoint_eq hcQ
      constructor
      · intro y hy
        rw [RQ.target_base]
        let x : ℝ := RQ.homeomorph.symm y
        refine ⟨x, hsub ?_, RQ.homeomorph.apply_symm_apply y⟩
        have hHlt : RQ.homeomorph x < RQ.homeomorph c.1 := by
          simpa [x, hceq] using hy
        exact RQ.homeomorph_strictMono.lt_iff_lt.mp hHlt
      · rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
        intro y hy
        let y' : ↥E' := ⟨y, hy.2⟩
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := boundaryEquiv.surjective y'
        have hxc : x.1 < c.1 := by
          apply hmono.lt_iff_lt.mp
          change (boundaryEquiv x).1 < (boundaryEquiv c).1
          rw [hx]
          exact hy.1
        have hxgap : x.1 ∈ Iio c.1 ∩ componentBoundarySet C.region C.centres :=
          ⟨hxc, x.2⟩
        rw [hgap] at hxgap
        exact hxgap
    · rintro ⟨hsub, hgap⟩
      have hccl : (boundaryEquiv c).1 ∈
          closure (plates.plateEquiv Q).base := by
        apply closure_mono hsub
        rw [closure_Iio]
        exact self_mem_Iic
      have hcT : (boundaryEquiv c).1 ∈
          frontier (plates.plateEquiv Q).base := by
        rw [frontier]
        exact ⟨hccl, fun hi ↦ componentBoundary_not_mem_plateBase
          P.full_tilesOn (boundaryEquiv c).2 (plates.plateEquiv Q)
          (interior_subset hi)⟩
      have hcQ := (hfrontiff Q c).mpr hcT
      have hceq := endpoint_eq hcQ
      constructor
      · intro x hx
        have hHlt : RQ.homeomorph x < (boundaryEquiv c).1 := by
          rw [← hceq]
          exact RQ.homeomorph_strictMono hx
        have hmem := hsub hHlt
        rw [RQ.target_base] at hmem
        obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ := hmem
        have hzx' : z = x := RQ.homeomorph.injective hzx
        simpa [hzx'] using hz
      · rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
        intro x hx
        let x' : ↥E := ⟨x, hx.2⟩
        have htargetLt : (boundaryEquiv x').1 < (boundaryEquiv c).1 :=
          hmono hx.1
        have htargetGap : (boundaryEquiv x').1 ∈
            Iio (boundaryEquiv c).1 ∩
              componentBoundarySet D.deformedRegion
                (deformedCenterCarrier P.fullCenters) :=
          ⟨htargetLt, (boundaryEquiv x').2⟩
        rw [hgap] at htargetGap
        exact htargetGap
  · intro Q t v w c d _htQ _hvw _hre _hside _hcd _hgap _hsub hc hx
    constructor
    · change mapScalar phi (lift c) <
        (D.planarHomeomorph v.1 + P.fullCenters t).re
      exact componentBoundary_map_endpoint_gt
        C hTile phi D P lift hlift hpositive c v t hc
    · change (D.planarHomeomorph v.1 + P.fullCenters t).re <
        mapScalar phi (lift d)
      exact componentBoundary_map_endpoint_lt
        C hTile phi D P lift hlift hpositive d v t hx

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.finiteContactTransportData_exists
statement:
private theorem finiteContactTransportData_exists :
    ∀ (C : ApproximationContext.{0})
      (_hTile : TilesOn C.region C.centres univ)
      (_hfinite : ∀ a b a' b' : ↥C.region.vertices,
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.horizontalContactDisplacements
          C.region C.centres a b a' b').Finite),
      ∃ epsilon₀ : ℝ, 0 < epsilon₀ ∧
        ∀ (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ),
          IsEpsilonApproximation C epsilon₀ phi →
        ∀ (D : CoordinateDeformation C phi)
          (P : TwoStageDeformationSupportTransport C phi D),
          Nonempty (FiniteContactTransportData C phi D P)
proof:
:= by
  intro C hTile hfinite
  obtain ⟨Acrit⟩ := finiteTransportCriticalAlphabet_exists C hfinite
  obtain ⟨epsilon₀, hepsilon₀, hsignThreshold⟩ :=
    finiteTransportCriticalAlphabet_signThreshold C Acrit
  refine ⟨epsilon₀, hepsilon₀, ?_⟩
  intro phi hphi D P
  have hsign := hsignThreshold phi hphi
  have hContact : ∀ s t : ↥C.centres,
      Continuous.HorizontalProperContact C.region s.1 t.1 ↔
        Continuous.HorizontalProperContact D.deformedRegion
          (P.fullCenters s) (P.fullCenters t) := by
    intro s t
    exact ⟨endpointAlignedSeamCode_preserved
      C hTile phi D P Acrit hsign s t,
      endpointAlignedSeamCode_reflected
        C hTile phi D P Acrit hsign s t⟩
  have hcol : ∀ s t : ↥C.centres,
      Continuous.HorizontalProperContact C.region s.1 t.1 →
      ((s.1 : Tiling.Plane).re = (t.1 : Tiling.Plane).re ↔
        (P.fullCenters s).re = (P.fullCenters t).re) := by
    intro s t hcontact
    constructor
    · intro hst
      rw [P.fullCenters_apply, P.fullCenters_apply]
      simp [mapPoint, mapScalar, ApproximationContext.centrePoint, hst]
    · intro htarget
      by_cases hst : s = t
      · simp [hst]
      · have hadj :
            (Continuous.verticalPlateGraph C.region C.centres).Adj s t :=
          (Continuous.verticalPlateGraph_adj_iff s t).2 ⟨hst, hcontact⟩
        obtain ⟨_, a, b, a', b', _, hdelta⟩ :=
          (verticalPlateGraph_adj_iff_exists_horizontalContactDisplacement
            C.region C.centres s t).1 hadj
        let delta : ℝ := (t.1 - s.1).re
        have hdelta' : delta ∈
            horizontalContactDisplacements C.region C.centres a b a' b' := by
          simpa [delta] using hdelta
        by_cases hdeltaZero : delta = 0
        · exact (sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa [delta] using hdeltaZero)).symm
        have hcritical : delta ∈ contactCriticalScalars C :=
          ⟨a, b, a', b', delta, hdelta', hdeltaZero, Or.inl rfl⟩
        have htransport : delta ∈ transportCriticalScalars C := Or.inl hcritical
        have hdeltaC : delta ∈ C.coordinateSpace := by
          dsimp only [delta, Complex.sub_re]
          exact C.coordinateSpace.sub_mem
            (C.centre_re_mem t.1 t.2) (C.centre_re_mem s.1 s.2)
        let deltaLift : C.coordinateSpace := ⟨delta, hdeltaC⟩
        have hlift : Acrit.lift ⟨delta, htransport⟩ = deltaLift := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          exact Acrit.lift_coe ⟨delta, htransport⟩
        have hsignDelta : Real.sign (mapScalar phi deltaLift) =
            Real.sign delta := by
          rw [← hlift]
          exact hsign ⟨delta, htransport⟩
        have hmapDelta : mapScalar phi deltaLift =
            (P.fullCenters t).re - (P.fullCenters s).re := by
          let tr : C.coordinateSpace :=
            ⟨t.1.re, C.centre_re_mem t.1 t.2⟩
          let sr : C.coordinateSpace :=
            ⟨s.1.re, C.centre_re_mem s.1 s.2⟩
          have hsub : deltaLift = tr - sr := by
            apply Subtype.ext
            simp [deltaLift, delta, tr, sr]
          rw [hsub, mapScalar, map_sub, Rat.cast_sub,
            P.fullCenters_apply, P.fullCenters_apply]
          simp only [tr, sr, mapPoint, ApproximationContext.centrePoint,
            Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
            Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero,
            mul_one, sub_zero, add_zero]
          rfl
        have hzero : (P.fullCenters t).re -
            (P.fullCenters s).re = 0 := by
          rw [htarget]
          ring
        have hsignZero : Real.sign delta = 0 := by
          rw [← hsignDelta, hmapDelta, hzero, Real.sign_zero]
        exact (hdeltaZero (Real.sign_eq_zero_iff.mp hsignZero)).elim
  obtain ⟨plates⟩ :=
    contactGraphIso_constructsPlateTransport C phi D P hContact hcol
  obtain ⟨boundaries⟩ := componentBoundaryTransport_exists
    C hTile phi D P plates
  exact ⟨⟨hContact, plates, boundaries⟩⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.finiteContactWitnesses
statement:
theorem finiteContactWitnesses :
    ∀ (C : ApproximationContext.{0})
      (_hTile : TilesOn C.region C.centres univ)
      (_hfinite : ∀ a b a' b' : ↥C.region.vertices,
        (Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.horizontalContactDisplacements
          C.region C.centres a b a' b').Finite),
      ∃ epsilon₀ : ℝ, 0 < epsilon₀ ∧
        ∀ (phi : C.coordinateSpace →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ),
          IsEpsilonApproximation C epsilon₀ phi →
        ∀ (D : CoordinateDeformation C phi),
        ∀ (P : TwoStageDeformationSupportTransport C phi D),
          (∀ s t : ↥C.centres,
            Continuous.HorizontalProperContact C.region s.1 t.1 ↔
              Continuous.HorizontalProperContact D.deformedRegion
                (P.fullCenters s) (P.fullCenters t)) ∧
          ∃ (plateEquiv : Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region C.centres ≃
                Continuous.VerticalPlate D.deformedRegion
                  (deformedCenterCarrier P.fullCenters))
            (boundaryLift : ↥(Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundarySet
                C.region C.centres) → C.coordinateSpace)
            (boundaryEquiv :
              ↥(Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundarySet
                  C.region C.centres) ≃
                ↥(Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundarySet
                  D.deformedRegion (deformedCenterCarrier P.fullCenters))),
            (∀ x, (boundaryLift x : ℝ) = x.1) ∧
            (∀ x, (boundaryEquiv x : ℝ) =
              mapScalar phi (boundaryLift x)) ∧
            StrictMono boundaryEquiv ∧
            (∀ (Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region C.centres)
                (t : ↥C.centres),
              (t.1 : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Q.centres ↔
                P.fullCenters t ∈ (plateEquiv Q).centres) ∧
            (∀ Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region C.centres,
              Continuous.IsVerticalColumn Q ↔
                Continuous.IsVerticalColumn (plateEquiv Q)) ∧
            (∀ (Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region C.centres)
                (c d : ↥(Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundarySet
                  C.region C.centres)),
              c.1 < d.1 →
              Ioo c.1 d.1 ∩
                  Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundarySet
                    C.region C.centres = ∅ →
              (Ioo c.1 d.1 ⊆ Q.base ↔
                Ioo (boundaryEquiv c).1 (boundaryEquiv d).1 ⊆
                  (plateEquiv Q).base)) ∧
            (∀ (Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region C.centres)
                (c : ↥(Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundarySet
                  C.region C.centres)),
              (Ioi c.1 ⊆ Q.base ∧
                  Ioi c.1 ∩
                    Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundarySet
                      C.region C.centres = ∅) ↔
                (Ioi (boundaryEquiv c).1 ⊆ (plateEquiv Q).base ∧
                  Ioi (boundaryEquiv c).1 ∩
                    Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundarySet
                      D.deformedRegion
                        (deformedCenterCarrier P.fullCenters) = ∅)) ∧
            (∀ (Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region C.centres)
                (c : ↥(Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundarySet
                  C.region C.centres)),
              (Iio c.1 ⊆ Q.base ∧
                  Iio c.1 ∩
                    Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundarySet
                      C.region C.centres = ∅) ↔
                (Iio (boundaryEquiv c).1 ⊆ (plateEquiv Q).base ∧
                  Iio (boundaryEquiv c).1 ∩
                    Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundarySet
                      D.deformedRegion
                        (deformedCenterCarrier P.fullCenters) = ∅)) ∧
            ∀ (Q : Continuous.VerticalPlate C.region C.centres)
                (t : ↥C.centres) (v w : ↥C.region.vertices)
                (c d : ↥(Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundarySet
                  C.region C.centres)),
              (t.1 : Tiling.Plane) ∈ Q.centres →
              v.1 ≠ w.1 → v.1.re = w.1.re →
              openSegment ℝ v.1 w.1 ⊆
                frontier C.region.support \ C.region.vertices →
              c.1 < d.1 →
              Ioo c.1 d.1 ∩
                  Tiling.AxisParallel.Structure.componentBoundarySet
                    C.region C.centres = ∅ →
              Ioo c.1 d.1 ⊆ Q.base →
              c.1 < (v.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane)).re →
              (v.1 + (t.1 : Tiling.Plane)).re < d.1 →
              (boundaryEquiv c).1 <
                  (D.planarHomeomorph v.1 + P.fullCenters t).re ∧
                (D.planarHomeomorph v.1 + P.fullCenters t).re <
                  (boundaryEquiv d).1
proof:
:= by
  intro C hTile hfinite
  obtain ⟨epsilon₀, hepsilon₀, htransport⟩ :=
    finiteContactTransportData_exists C hTile hfinite
  refine ⟨epsilon₀, hepsilon₀, ?_⟩
  intro phi hphi D P
  obtain ⟨data⟩ := htransport phi hphi D P
  refine ⟨data.contact_iff, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨data.plates.plateEquiv, data.boundaries.boundaryLift,
    data.boundaries.boundaryEquiv, data.boundaries.lift_coe,
    data.boundaries.boundary_formula, data.boundaries.strictMono,
    data.plates.centre_mem, data.plates.column_iff,
    data.boundaries.bounded_chamber_label,
    data.boundaries.rightRay_label, data.boundaries.leftRay_label,
    data.boundaries.translatedVerticalSide_between⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.NumericalPrefix.guarded_computable
proof:
:= by
  have hq : Computable₂ (fun x : (ℕ × List Bool) × List Bool => fun q : Query =>
      if code x.1.1 q < x.1.2.length then Sum.inr q else Sum.inl fallback) := by
    refine (Computable.cond
      ((Primrec.nat_lt.decide.to_comp.comp
        (hc.comp (Computable.fst.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst)) Computable.snd)
        (Computable.list_length.comp
          (Computable.snd.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst)))))
      (Computable.sumInr.comp Computable.snd) (Computable.const (.inl fallback))).of_eq ?_
    intro x
    simp only [Bool.cond_decide]
  refine (Computable.sumCasesOn
    (hp.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst) Computable.snd)
    (Computable.sumInl.comp Computable.snd).to₂ hq).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  unfold guarded
  dsimp only
  cases program x.1.1 x.2 <;> rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.NumericalPrefix.answer_computable
statement:
theorem answer_computable {code : ℕ → Query → ℕ} (hc : Computable₂ code) :
    Computable₂ (answer code)
proof:
:=
  (Primrec.list_getD false).to_comp.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst)
    (hc.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst) Computable.snd)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.NumericalPrefix.execute_computable
proof:
:=
  (OracleRun.run_from_empty_computable (guarded_computable hp hc fallback)
    (answer_computable hc)).comp Computable.id
      (Computable.list_length.comp Computable.snd)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.NumericalPrefix.decide_computable
statement:
theorem decide_computable {program : OracleCode} {code : ℕ → Query → ℕ}
    (hp : Computable₂ program) (hc : Computable₂ code) : Computable (decide program code)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.NumericalPrefix.guarded_sound
statement:
theorem guarded_sound (program : OracleCode) (code : ℕ → Query → ℕ)
    (input : ℕ × List Bool) (oracle : ℕ → Bool)
    (hprefix : ∀ j, j < input.2.length → input.2.getD j false = oracle j)
    (fuel : ℕ) : ∀ history b,
    run (guarded program code input false) (answer code input) fuel history = some b →
    run (guarded program code input true) (answer code input) fuel history = some b →
    run (program input.1) (fun q => oracle (code input.1 q)) fuel history = some b
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro history b h; simp [run] at h
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro history b hfalse htrue
    cases hstep : program input.1 history with
    | inl a => simpa [run, guarded, hstep] using hfalse
    | inr q =>
      by_cases hq : code input.1 q < input.2.length
      · have ha : answer code input q = oracle (code input.1 q) := hprefix _ hq
        simp only [run, guarded, hstep, if_pos hq] at hfalse htrue
        simp only [run, hstep]
        rw [ha] at hfalse htrue
        exact ih _ _ hfalse htrue
      · simp [run, guarded, hstep, hq] at hfalse htrue
        simp_all

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.NumericalPrefix.decide_sound
statement:
theorem decide_sound (program : OracleCode) (code : ℕ → Query → ℕ)
    (n : ℕ) (oracle : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ) (b : Bool)
    (h : decide program code (n, (List.range k).map oracle) = some b) :
    run (program n) (fun q => oracle (code n q)) k [] = some b
proof:
:= by
  unfold decide at h
  split at h
  next heq =>
    apply guarded_sound program code (n, (List.range k).map oracle) oracle
      (by intro j hj; simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range] at hj
          simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hj])
      k [] b
    · simpa [execute] using h
    · have hh : execute program code (n, (List.range k).map oracle) true = some b :=
        heq.symm.trans h
      simpa [execute] using hh
  next => simp at h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.NumericalPrefix.run_mono
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing larger history with
  | zero => simp [run] at h
  | succ fuel ih =>
    cases larger with
    | zero => omega
    | succ larger =>
      cases hs : step history with
      | inl a => simpa [run, hs] using h
      | inr q =>
        simp only [run, hs] at h ⊢
        exact ih (by omega) h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.NumericalPrefix.guarded_complete
statement:
theorem guarded_complete (program : OracleCode) (code : ℕ → Query → ℕ)
    (n : ℕ) (oracle : ℕ → Bool) (fuel : ℕ) : ∀ history b,
    run (program n) (fun q => oracle (code n q)) fuel history = some b →
    ∃ bound, ∀ k, bound ≤ k → ∀ fallback,
      run (guarded program code (n, (List.range k).map oracle) fallback)
        (answer code (n, (List.range k).map oracle)) fuel history = some b
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro history b h; simp [run] at h
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro history b h
    cases hs : program n history with
    | inl a => exact ⟨0, fun k _ fallback => by simpa [run, guarded, hs] using h⟩
    | inr q =>
      simp only [run, hs] at h
      obtain ⟨bound, hb⟩ := ih _ _ h
      refine ⟨max bound (code n q + 1), ?_⟩
      intro k hk fallback
      have hq : code n q < k := by omega
      have ha : answer code (n, (List.range k).map oracle) q = oracle (code n q) := by
        simp [answer, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hq]
      simp only [run, guarded, hs, List.length_map, List.length_range, if_pos hq]
      rw [ha]
      exact hb k (by omega) fallback

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.NumericalPrefix.decide_complete
statement:
theorem decide_complete (program : OracleCode) (code : ℕ → Query → ℕ)
    (n : ℕ) (oracle : ℕ → Bool) {fuel : ℕ} {b : Bool}
    (h : run (program n) (fun q => oracle (code n q)) fuel [] = some b) :
    ∃ bound, ∀ k, bound ≤ k →
      decide program code (n, (List.range k).map oracle) = some b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨bound, hb⟩ := guarded_complete program code n oracle fuel [] b h
  refine ⟨max bound fuel, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  have hf (fallback : Bool) :
      execute program code (n, (List.range k).map oracle) fallback = some b := by
    unfold execute
    simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range]
    exact run_mono _ _ (by omega) (hb k (by omega) fallback)
  simp only [decide, hf, ↓reduceIte]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.NumericalPrefix.returns_iff
statement:
theorem returns_iff (program : OracleCode) (code : ℕ → Query → ℕ)
    (n : ℕ) (oracle : ℕ → Bool) (b : Bool) :
    b ∈ Nat.rfindOpt (fun k => decide program code (n, (List.range k).map oracle)) ↔
      ∃ fuel, run (program n) (fun q => oracle (code n q)) fuel [] = some b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.rfindOpt_spec h
    exact ⟨k, decide_sound program code n oracle k b (by simpa using hk)⟩
  · rintro ⟨fuel, hf⟩
    obtain ⟨bound, hb⟩ := decide_complete program code n oracle hf
    have hdom : (Nat.rfindOpt (fun k => decide program code (n, (List.range k).map oracle))).Dom :=
      Nat.rfindOpt_dom.mpr ⟨bound, b, by simpa using hb bound le_rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.rfindOpt_spec ⟨hdom, rfl⟩
    have hr := decide_sound program code n oracle k _ (by simpa using hk)
    have hf' := run_mono _ _ (Nat.le_max_left fuel k) hf
    have hr' := run_mono _ _ (Nat.le_max_right fuel k) hr
    have heq := hf'.symm.trans hr'
    have heq' := Option.some.inj heq
    exact ⟨hdom, heq'.symm⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleCoefficients.count_computable
statement: theorem count_computable : Computable₂ (fun (xs : List ℕ) (j : ℕ) => xs.count j)
proof:
:= by
  have hf := (PrimrecRel.listFilter (Primrec.eq : PrimrecRel (fun a b : ℕ => a = b))).to_comp
  refine (Computable.list_length.comp hf).to₂.of_eq ?_
  intro xs
  simp only [List.count, List.countP_eq_length_filter]
  congr 2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleCoefficients.coefficients_computable
statement: theorem coefficients_computable (n : ℕ) : Computable (coefficients n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold coefficients
  apply map_computable 0 (Computable.const (List.range (2 * n)))
  exact (int_sub_computable.comp
    (int_ofNat_computable.comp (count_computable.comp
      (Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst)) Computable.snd))
    (int_ofNat_computable.comp (count_computable.comp
      (Computable.fst.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst)) Computable.snd))).to₂

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleCoefficients.encodeQuery_computable
statement: theorem encodeQuery_computable (n : ℕ) : Computable (encodeQuery n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold encodeQuery
  exact Primrec.encode.to_comp.comp
    (((Primrec.eq.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.const (0 : Fin 2))).not.decide.to_comp).pair
      (coefficients_computable n))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleCoefficients.coefficients_getD
statement:
theorem coefficients_getD (n : ℕ) (q : Query) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < 2 * n) :
    (coefficients n q).getD j 0 = (q.2.2.count j : ℤ) - (q.2.1.count j : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _
    (by simpa only [coefficients, List.length_map, List.length_range] using hj)]
  simp [coefficients]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleCoefficients.coefficients_computable₂
statement: theorem coefficients_computable₂ : Computable₂ coefficients
proof:
:= by
  unfold coefficients
  apply map_computable 0
    (Primrec.list_range.to_comp.comp (Primrec.nat_mul.to_comp.comp
      (Computable.const 2) Computable.fst))
  exact (int_sub_computable.comp
    (int_ofNat_computable.comp (count_computable.comp
      (Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst)))
      Computable.snd))
    (int_ofNat_computable.comp (count_computable.comp
      (Computable.fst.comp (Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst)))
      Computable.snd))).to₂

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleCoefficients.encodeQuery_computable₂
statement: theorem encodeQuery_computable₂ : Computable₂ encodeQuery
proof:
:= by
  unfold encodeQuery
  exact Primrec.encode.to_comp.comp
    (((Primrec.eq.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
      (Primrec.const (0 : Fin 2))).not.decide.to_comp).pair coefficients_computable₂)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleCoefficients.sum_count_coordinates
statement:
theorem sum_count_coordinates (V : List Plane) (axis : Fin 2) (indices : List ℕ)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : V.length = m) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (indices.count j : ℝ) * coordinate axis (V.getD j 0)) =
      coordinateSum V axis indices
proof:
:= by
  induction indices with
  | nil => simp [coordinateSum]
  | cons a xs ih =>
    simp only [List.count_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ite, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero,
      add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [ih]
    have hsingle : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range m,
        (if a == j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * coordinate axis (V.getD j 0)) =
        coordinate axis (V.getD a 0) := by
      by_cases ha : a < m
      · simp [beq_iff_eq, ha]
      · have hout : V.getD a 0 = 0 := List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by omega)
        rw [hout]
        simp [beq_iff_eq, ha, coordinate, p₁, p₂]
    rw [hsingle]
    simp [coordinateSum, add_comm]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleCoefficients.coefficient_sum_eq
statement:
theorem coefficient_sum_eq (V : List Plane) (n : ℕ) (q : Query)
    (hV : V.length = 2 * n) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * n),
      (((q.2.2.count j : ℤ) - (q.2.1.count j : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) *
        coordinate q.1 (V.getD j 0)) =
      coordinateSum V q.1 q.2.2 - coordinateSum V q.1 q.2.1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_natCast, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [sum_count_coordinates V q.1 q.2.2 _ hV,
    sum_count_coordinates V q.1 q.2.1 _ hV]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleCoefficients.coefficients_sum_eq
statement:
theorem coefficients_sum_eq (V : List Plane) (n : ℕ) (q : Query)
    (hV : V.length = 2 * n) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * n), ((coefficients n q).getD j 0 : ℝ) *
        coordinate q.1 (V.getD j 0)) =
      coordinateSum V q.1 q.2.2 - coordinateSum V q.1 q.2.1
proof:
:= by
  convert coefficient_sum_eq V n q hV using 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [coefficients_getD n q j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OraclePrefix.prefixProgram_computable
proof:
:= by
  have hqueries : Computable (fun x : α × List Bool => schedule x.1) :=
    hschedule.comp Computable.fst
  have hqueryLength : Computable (fun x : α × List Bool => (schedule x.1).length) :=
    Computable.comp Computable.list_length hqueries
  have hhistoryLength : Computable (fun x : α × List Bool => x.2.length) :=
    Computable.comp Computable.list_length Computable.snd
  have hmore : Computable (fun x : α × List Bool => decide (x.2.length < (schedule x.1).length)) :=
    (Primrec.nat_lt.decide.to_comp).comp hhistoryLength hqueryLength
  have hindexQuery : Computable (fun x : α × List Bool =>
      (schedule x.1).getD x.2.length defaultQuery) :=
    (Primrec.list_getD defaultQuery).to_comp.comp hqueries hhistoryLength
  have htake : Computable (fun x : α × List Bool => x.2.take (schedule x.1).length) :=
    Computable₂.comp Primrec.list_take.to_comp hqueryLength Computable.snd
  have hdrop : Computable (fun x : α × List Bool => x.2.drop (schedule x.1).length) :=
    Computable₂.comp Primrec.list_drop.to_comp hqueryLength Computable.snd
  have hbodyInput : Computable (fun x : α × List Bool =>
      (x.1, (x.2.take (schedule x.1).length, x.2.drop (schedule x.1).length))) :=
    Computable.fst.pair (htake.pair hdrop)
  have hbodyResult : Computable (fun x : α × List Bool =>
      body x.1 (x.2.take (schedule x.1).length) (x.2.drop (schedule x.1).length)) :=
    hbody.comp hbodyInput
  refine (Computable.cond hmore (Computable.sumInr.comp hindexQuery) hbodyResult).to₂.of_eq ?_
  intro x
  rcases x with ⟨input, history⟩
  by_cases h : history.length < (schedule input).length
  · simp [prefixProgram, prefixStep, h]
  · simp [prefixProgram, prefixStep, h]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OraclePrefix.prefixProgram_eq_body_of_length
statement:
theorem prefixProgram_eq_body_of_length {α : Type*}
    (schedule : α → List Query) (body : α → List Bool → List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query)
    (input : α) (history : List Bool)
    (h : (schedule input).length ≤ history.length) :
    prefixProgram schedule body input history =
      body input (history.take (schedule input).length) (history.drop (schedule input).length)
proof:
:= by
  simp [prefixProgram, prefixStep, Nat.not_lt.mpr h]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OraclePrefix.run_congr
statement:
private theorem run_congr {s t : List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query}
    (hstep : ∀ history, s history = t history) (answer : Query → Bool)
    (fuel : ℕ) (history : List Bool) :
    run s answer fuel history = run t answer fuel history
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing history with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
      rw [run, run, hstep history]
      split
      · rfl
      · rename_i query
        exact ih _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OraclePrefix.run_after_complete_prefix
statement:
theorem run_after_complete_prefix {α : Type*}
    (schedule : α → List Query) (body : α → List Bool → List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query)
    (input : α) (answer : Query → Bool) (frozen suffix : List Bool)
    (hfrozen : frozen.length = (schedule input).length) (fuel : ℕ) :
    run (prefixProgram schedule body input) answer fuel (frozen ++ suffix) =
      run (body input frozen) answer fuel suffix
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing suffix with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
      rw [run, run]
      have hlen : (schedule input).length ≤ (frozen ++ suffix).length := by
        rw [List.length_append, hfrozen]
        omega
      rw [prefixProgram_eq_body_of_length schedule body input (frozen ++ suffix) hlen]
      have htake : (frozen ++ suffix).take (schedule input).length = frozen := by
        rw [← hfrozen]
        exact List.take_left
      have hdrop : (frozen ++ suffix).drop (schedule input).length = suffix := by
        rw [← hfrozen]
        exact List.drop_left
      rw [htake, hdrop]
      cases hbody : body input frozen suffix with
      | inl b => rfl
      | inr q =>
          simpa [List.append_assoc] using ih (suffix ++ [answer q])

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OraclePrefix.run_after_scheduled_queries
statement:
private theorem run_after_scheduled_queries (queries : List Query)
    (body : List Bool → List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query) (answer : Query → Bool) :
    ∀ history remaining fuel,
      history.length + remaining = queries.length →
      history = (queries.take history.length).map answer →
      run (prefixStep queries body) answer (remaining + fuel) history =
        run (body (queries.map answer)) answer fuel []
proof:
:= by
  intro history remaining
  induction remaining generalizing history with
  | zero =>
      intro fuel hlength hhistory
      have hhistory' : history = queries.map answer := by
        calc
          history = (queries.take history.length).map answer := hhistory
          _ = queries.map answer := by
            have hlen : history.length = queries.length := by omega
            rw [hlen]
            simp
      subst history
      have hcomplete :=
        run_after_complete_prefix (fun _ : Unit => queries) (fun _ => body) () answer
          (queries.map answer) [] (by simp) fuel
      have hcomplete' :
          run (prefixProgram (fun _ : Unit => queries) (fun _ => body) ()) answer fuel
            (queries.map answer) =
          run (body (queries.map answer)) answer fuel [] := by
        simpa using hcomplete
      have hsteps : ∀ history, prefixStep queries body history =
          prefixProgram (fun _ : Unit => queries) (fun _ => body) () history :=
        fun _ => rfl
      have hrun := run_congr hsteps answer fuel (queries.map answer)
      simpa using hrun.trans hcomplete'
  | succ remaining ih =>
      intro fuel hlength hhistory
      have hlt : history.length < queries.length := by omega
      have hquery : queries.getD history.length defaultQuery = queries[history.length] :=
        List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hlt
      let q := queries[history.length]
      have hhistoryNext : history ++ [answer q] =
          (queries.take (history.length + 1)).map answer := by
        rw [hhistory, List.take_add_one, List.map_append]
        simp [q, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt,
          min_eq_left (Nat.le_of_lt hlt)]
      have hlengthNext : (history ++ [answer q]).length + remaining = queries.length := by
        simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton]
        omega
      rw [show Nat.succ remaining + fuel = Nat.succ (remaining + fuel) by omega]
      rw [run, prefixStep, if_pos hlt, hquery]
      have hstep :
          run (prefixStep queries body) answer (remaining + fuel)
            (history ++ [answer (queries[history.length])]) =
          run (body (queries.map answer)) answer fuel [] :=
        ih (history ++ [answer (queries[history.length])]) fuel hlengthNext ?_
      · exact hstep
      · simpa using hhistoryNext

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OraclePrefix.run_from_empty_after_schedule
statement:
theorem run_from_empty_after_schedule {α : Type*}
    (schedule : α → List Query) (body : α → List Bool → List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query)
    (input : α) (answer : Query → Bool) (fuel : ℕ) :
    run (prefixProgram schedule body input) answer ((schedule input).length + fuel) [] =
      run (body input ((schedule input).map answer)) answer fuel []
proof:
:= by
  let queries := schedule input
  have h := run_after_scheduled_queries queries (body input) answer [] queries.length fuel
    (by simp) (by simp)
  change run (prefixStep queries (body input)) answer (queries.length + fuel) [] = _
  simpa [queries] using h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OraclePrefix.run_none_before_schedule_finishes
statement:
private theorem run_none_before_schedule_finishes (queries : List Query)
    (body : List Bool → List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query) (answer : Query → Bool) :
    ∀ fuel history, history.length + fuel < queries.length →
      run (prefixStep queries body) answer fuel history = none
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
      intro history _
      rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
      intro history hlt
      have hquery : history.length < queries.length := by omega
      rw [run, prefixStep, if_pos hquery]
      change run (prefixStep queries body) answer fuel
        (history ++ [answer (queries.getD history.length defaultQuery)]) = none
      apply ih
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton]
      omega

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OraclePrefix.run_answer_after_schedule
statement:
theorem run_answer_after_schedule {α : Type*}
    (schedule : α → List Query) (body : α → List Bool → List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query)
    (input : α) (answer : Query → Bool) (fuel : ℕ) (b : Bool)
    (h : run (prefixProgram schedule body input) answer fuel [] = some b) :
    ∃ bodyFuel,
      run (body input ((schedule input).map answer)) answer bodyFuel [] = some b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlong : (schedule input).length ≤ fuel
  · obtain ⟨bodyFuel, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hlong
    exact ⟨bodyFuel, by simpa [run_from_empty_after_schedule] using h⟩
  · have hnone := run_none_before_schedule_finishes (schedule input) (body input) answer
      fuel [] (by simpa using Nat.not_le.mp hlong)
    rw [show prefixProgram schedule body input =
      prefixStep (schedule input) (body input) by rfl, hnone] at h
    cases h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleRun.advance_computable
statement:
private theorem advance_computable {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {program : α → List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query} {answer : α → Query → Bool}
    (hprogram : Computable₂ program) (hanswer : Computable₂ answer) :
    Computable₂ (advance program answer)
proof:
:= by
  have hhistory : Computable₂ (fun x : α × State => fun history : List Bool =>
      match program x.1 history with
      | .inl b => Sum.inl b
      | .inr q => Sum.inr (history ++ [answer x.1 q])) := by
    refine (Computable.sumCasesOn
      (hprogram.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst) Computable.snd)
      (Computable.sumInl.comp Computable.snd).to₂
      (Computable.sumInr.comp (Computable.list_concat.comp
        (Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst)
        (hanswer.comp (Computable.fst.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst))
          Computable.snd))).to₂).of_eq ?_
    intro x
    dsimp only
    cases program x.1.1 x.2 <;> rfl
  refine (Computable.sumCasesOn Computable.snd
    (Computable.sumInl.comp Computable.snd).to₂ hhistory).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  cases x.2 <;> rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleRun.trace_computable
statement:
private theorem trace_computable {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {program : α → List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query} {answer : α → Query → Bool}
    (hprogram : Computable₂ program) (hanswer : Computable₂ answer) :
    Computable (fun x : α × ℕ × List Bool => trace program answer x.1 x.2.2 x.2.1)
proof:
:= by
  have hrec := Computable.nat_rec
    (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd : Computable (fun x : α × ℕ × List Bool => x.2.1))
    (Computable.sumInr.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd))
    ((advance_computable hprogram hanswer).comp
      (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst) (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)).to₂
  refine hrec.of_eq ?_
  intro x
  induction x.2.1 with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [trace, ih]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleRun.result_computable
statement: private theorem result_computable : Computable result
proof:
:= by
  refine (Computable.sumCasesOn Computable.id
    (Computable.option_some.comp Computable.snd).to₂ (Computable.const none).to₂).of_eq ?_
  intro state
  cases state <;> rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleRun.trace_eq_iterate
statement:
private theorem trace_eq_iterate {α : Type*} (program : α → List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query)
    (answer : α → Query → Bool) (input : α) (history : List Bool) (fuel : ℕ) :
    trace program answer input history fuel =
      (advance program answer input)^[fuel] (.inr history)
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [trace, ih, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleRun.iterate_result_eq_run
statement:
private theorem iterate_result_eq_run {α : Type*}
    (program : α → List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query) (answer : α → Query → Bool)
    (input : α) (fuel : ℕ) : ∀ history,
    result ((advance program answer input)^[fuel] (.inr history)) =
      run (program input) (answer input) fuel history
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro history; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      intro history
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
      cases h : program input history with
      | inl b =>
          have hfixed : advance program answer input (.inl b) = .inl b := rfl
          simp only [advance, h, Function.iterate_fixed hfixed, result, run]
      | inr q =>
          simpa only [advance, h, run] using ih (history ++ [answer input q])

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleRun.run_computable
statement:
theorem run_computable {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {program : α → List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query} {answer : α → Query → Bool}
    (hprogram : Computable₂ program) (hanswer : Computable₂ answer) :
    Computable (fun x : α × ℕ × List Bool => run (program x.1) (answer x.1) x.2.1 x.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  refine (result_computable.comp (trace_computable hprogram hanswer)).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  rw [trace_eq_iterate]
  exact iterate_result_eq_run program answer x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleRun.run_from_empty_computable
statement:
theorem run_from_empty_computable {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {program : α → List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query} {answer : α → Query → Bool}
    (hprogram : Computable₂ program) (hanswer : Computable₂ answer) :
    Computable₂ (fun input fuel => run (program input) (answer input) fuel [])
proof:
:=
  (run_computable hprogram hanswer).comp
    (Computable.fst.pair (Computable.snd.pair (Computable.const [])))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleCoefficients.sum_range_pairs
statement:
theorem sum_range_pairs (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * n), f j) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (f (2 * i) + f (2 * i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.mul_succ, show 2 * n + 2 = (2 * n + 1) + 1 by omega,
      Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    simp only [add_assoc]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleCoefficients.corner_sum_eq
statement:
theorem corner_sum_eq (n : ℕ) (data : (Fin n → Plane) × (Fin n → Plane))
    (coeffs : List ℤ) (axis : Fin 2) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * n), (coeffs.getD j 0 : ℝ) *
      coordinate axis ((cornerList (List.ofFn fun i => (data.1 i, data.2 i))).getD j 0)) =
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((coeffs.getD (2 * i.val) 0 : ℤ) • coordinate axis (data.1 i) +
      (coeffs.getD (2 * i.val + 1) 0 : ℤ) • coordinate axis (data.2 i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_range_pairs]
  rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have hin : i.val < n := i.isLt
  rw [RectangleInput.cornerList_getD_left _ (by simpa only [List.length_ofFn] using hin),
    RectangleInput.cornerList_getD_right _ (by simpa only [List.length_ofFn] using hin)]
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem (List.ofFn fun i => (data.1 i, data.2 i)) (0, 0)
    (by simpa only [List.length_ofFn] using hin)]
  simp only [List.getElem_ofFn, zsmul_eq_mul]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.nodeAdvance_primrec
statement: private theorem nodeAdvance_primrec : Primrec₂ nodeAdvance
proof:
:= by
  have hleaf : Primrec₂ (fun x : State × Bool × ℕ => fun o : Option Bool =>
      match o with
      | none => (x.1.1 + 1, x.2.2)
      | some _ => x.1) := by
    refine (Primrec.option_casesOn Primrec.snd
      ((Primrec.nat_add.comp
        (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst)) (Primrec.const 1)).pair
        (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst)))
      (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst)).to₂).of_eq ?_
    intro x
    cases x.2 <;> rfl
  have hquery : Primrec₂ (fun x : State × Bool × ℕ =>
      fun y : Query × ℕ × ℕ => (x.1.1, cond x.2.1 y.2.2 y.2.1)) :=
    (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst)).pair
      (Primrec.cond (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst))
        (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))
        (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)))
  refine (Primrec.sumCasesOn Primrec.snd
    (hleaf.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd).to₂
    (hquery.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd).to₂).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  cases x.2 with
  | inl o => cases o <;> rfl
  | inr q => rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.nodeOutput_primrec
statement: private theorem nodeOutput_primrec : Primrec nodeOutput
proof:
:= by
  have hleaf : Primrec₂ (fun _ : Node => fun o : Option Bool =>
      match o with
      | none => Sum.inr tick
      | some b => Sum.inl b) := by
    refine (Primrec.option_casesOn Primrec.snd (Primrec.const (.inr tick))
      (Primrec.sumInl.comp Primrec.snd).to₂).of_eq ?_
    intro x
    cases x.2 <;> rfl
  refine (Primrec.sumCasesOn Primrec.id hleaf
    (Primrec.sumInr.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  cases x with
  | inl o => cases o <;> rfl
  | inr q => rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.root_primrec
statement: private theorem root_primrec : Primrec root
proof:
:=
  Primrec.nat_sub.comp Primrec.list_length (Primrec.const 1)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.node_primrec
statement: private theorem node_primrec : Primrec₂ node
proof: := Primrec.list_getD (Sum.inl none : Node)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.initial_computable
statement:
private theorem initial_computable {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {stages : α → ℕ → Code} (h : Computable₂ stages) : Computable (initial stages)
proof:
:=
  (Computable.const 0).pair (root_primrec.to_comp.comp
    (h.comp Computable.id (Computable.const 0)))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.advance_computable
statement:
private theorem advance_computable {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {stages : α → ℕ → Code} (h : Computable₂ stages) :
    Computable (fun x : α × State × Bool => advance stages x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hstage : Computable (fun x : α × State × Bool => x.2.1.1) :=
    Computable.fst.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd)
  have hindex : Computable (fun x : α × State × Bool => x.2.1.2) :=
    Computable.snd.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd)
  exact nodeAdvance_primrec.to_comp.comp
    ((Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd).pair
      ((Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd).pair
        (root_primrec.to_comp.comp (h.comp Computable.fst
          (Primrec.nat_add.to_comp.comp hstage (Computable.const 1))))))
    (node_primrec.to_comp.comp (h.comp Computable.fst hstage) hindex)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.replayBounded_computable
statement:
private theorem replayBounded_computable {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {stages : α → ℕ → Code} (h : Computable₂ stages) :
    Computable (fun x : α × List Bool × ℕ => replayBounded stages x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hrec := Computable.nat_rec
    (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd :
      Computable (fun x : α × List Bool × ℕ => x.2.2))
    ((initial_computable h).comp Computable.fst)
    ((advance_computable h).comp
      ((Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst).pair
        ((Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd).pair
          ((Primrec.list_getD false).to_comp.comp
            (Computable.fst.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst))
            (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd))))).to₂
  refine hrec.of_eq ?_
  intro x
  induction x.2.2 with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [replayBounded, ih]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.replayBounded_eq_fold
proof:
:= by
  have general : ∀ n, n ≤ history.length → replayBounded stages input history n =
      (history.take n).foldl (advance stages input) (initial stages input) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro _; rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      intro hn
      rw [replayBounded, ih (by omega)]
      rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem (by omega), List.foldl_append]
      simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
      congr 1
      exact List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ _
  simpa only [List.take_length, replay] using general history.length (by rfl)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.step_computable
statement:
theorem step_computable {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {stages : α → ℕ → Code} (h : Computable₂ stages) : Computable₂ (step stages)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Computable₂ (replay stages) := by
    refine ((replayBounded_computable h).comp
      (Computable.fst.pair (Computable.snd.pair
        (Computable.list_length.comp Computable.snd)))).of_eq ?_
    intro x
    exact replayBounded_eq_fold stages x.1 x.2
  exact nodeOutput_primrec.to_comp.comp
    (node_primrec.to_comp.comp
      (h.comp Computable.fst (Computable.fst.comp hr)) (Computable.snd.comp hr))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.replay_append
statement:
private theorem replay_append {α : Type*} (stages : α → ℕ → Code)
    (input : α) (history : List Bool) (bit : Bool) :
    replay stages input (history ++ [bit]) = advance stages input
      (replay stages input history) bit
proof:
:= by
  simp only [replay, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.run_eq_machine
statement:
private theorem run_eq_machine {α : Type*} (stages : α → ℕ → Code)
    (input : α) (answer : Query → Bool) (fuel : ℕ) : ∀ history,
    run (step stages input) answer (fuel + 1) history =
      machineResult stages input
        ((machineNext stages input answer)^[fuel] (replay stages input history))
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro history
    simp only [Function.iterate_zero, id_eq, run, step, machineResult]
    cases hn : node (stages input (replay stages input history).1)
      (replay stages input history).2 with
    | inl o => cases o <;> rfl
    | inr q => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro history
    cases hn : node (stages input (replay stages input history).1)
      (replay stages input history).2 with
    | inl o =>
      cases o with
      | none =>
        have hnext : machineNext stages input answer (replay stages input history) =
            replay stages input (history ++ [answer tick]) := by
          rw [replay_append]
          simp only [machineNext, advance, hn, nodeAdvance]
        simpa only [run, step, hn, nodeOutput, Function.iterate_succ_apply,
          hnext] using ih (history ++ [answer tick])
      | some b =>
        have hfixed : machineNext stages input answer (replay stages input history) =
            replay stages input history := by simp only [machineNext, hn]
        simp only [run, step, hn, nodeOutput, Function.iterate_fixed hfixed,
          machineResult, observation]
    | inr q =>
      rcases q with ⟨q, left, right⟩
      have hnext : machineNext stages input answer (replay stages input history) =
          replay stages input (history ++ [answer q]) := by
        rw [replay_append]
        simp only [machineNext, advance, hn, nodeAdvance]
      simpa only [run, step, hn, nodeOutput, Function.iterate_succ_apply,
        hnext] using ih (history ++ [answer q])

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.reachable_next
statement:
private theorem reachable_next {α : Type*} (stages : α → ℕ → Code)
    (input : α) (answer : Query → Bool) (state : State)
    (hp : Path answer (stages input state.1) (root (stages input state.1)) state.2) :
    let next := machineNext stages input answer state
    Path answer (stages input next.1) (root (stages input next.1)) next.2
proof:
:= by
  cases hn : node (stages input state.1) state.2 with
  | inl o =>
    cases o with
    | none => simpa only [machineNext, hn] using
        (Path.refl (answer := answer) (code := stages input (state.1 + 1))
          (root (stages input (state.1 + 1))))
    | some b => simpa only [machineNext, hn] using hp
  | inr q =>
    rcases q with ⟨q, left, right⟩
    simpa only [machineNext, hn] using Path.query hp hn

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.reachable_iterate
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel with
  | zero => exact Path.refl _
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    exact reachable_next stages input answer _ ih

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.run_answer_from_stage
statement:
theorem run_answer_from_stage {α : Type*} (stages : α → ℕ → Code)
    (input : α) (answer : Query → Bool) (fuel : ℕ) (b : Bool)
    (h : run (step stages input) answer fuel [] = some b) :
    ∃ stage, StageAnswer answer (stages input stage) b
proof:
:= by
  cases fuel with
  | zero => simp [run] at h
  | succ n =>
    rw [run_eq_machine] at h
    let state := (machineNext stages input answer)^[n] (initial stages input)
    have hp := reachable_iterate stages input answer n
    refine ⟨state.1, state.2, hp, ?_⟩
    change observation (node (stages input state.1) state.2) = some b at h
    cases hn : node (stages input state.1) state.2 with
    | inl o =>
      rw [hn] at h
      exact congrArg Sum.inl h
    | inr q => simp [hn, observation] at h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.path_machine_reaches
statement:
private theorem path_machine_reaches {α : Type*} (stages : α → ℕ → Code)
    (input : α) (answer : Query → Bool) (stage start index : ℕ)
    (hp : Path answer (stages input stage) start index) :
    ∃ fuel, (machineNext stages input answer)^[fuel] (stage, start) = (stage, index)
proof:
:= by
  induction hp with
  | refl => exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
  | @query index q left right path hn ih =>
    obtain ⟨fuel, hfuel⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨fuel + 1, ?_⟩
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hfuel]
    simp only [machineNext, hn]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.stage_reaches_leaf
statement:
private theorem stage_reaches_leaf {α : Type*} (stages : α → ℕ → Code)
    (input : α) (answer : Query → Bool) (stage : ℕ)
    (hw : WellFormed (stages input stage)) (index : ℕ) :
    ∃ fuel index' outcome,
      (machineNext stages input answer)^[fuel] (stage, index) = (stage, index') ∧
      node (stages input stage) index' = .inl outcome
proof:
:= by
  induction index using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h index ih =>
    cases hn : node (stages input stage) index with
    | inl o => exact ⟨0, index, o, rfl, hn⟩
    | inr q =>
      rcases q with ⟨q, left, right⟩
      have hless : cond (answer q) right left < index := by
        obtain ⟨hl, hr⟩ := hw index q left right hn
        cases answer q <;> assumption
      obtain ⟨fuel, index', outcome, hfuel, hleaf⟩ := ih _ hless
      refine ⟨fuel + 1, index', outcome, ?_, hleaf⟩
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
      simpa only [machineNext, hn] using hfuel

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.stage_reached_or_answer
statement:
private theorem stage_reached_or_answer {α : Type*} (stages : α → ℕ → Code)
    (input : α) (answer : Query → Bool) (hw : ∀ stage, WellFormed (stages input stage))
    (stage : ℕ) :
    (∃ fuel b, machineResult stages input
        ((machineNext stages input answer)^[fuel] (initial stages input)) = some b) ∨
      ∃ fuel, (machineNext stages input answer)^[fuel] (initial stages input) =
        (stage, root (stages input stage))
proof:
:= by
  induction stage with
  | zero => exact Or.inr ⟨0, rfl⟩
  | succ stage ih =>
    rcases ih with hanswer | ⟨fuel, hfuel⟩
    · exact Or.inl hanswer
    · obtain ⟨fuel', index, outcome, hstate, hleaf⟩ :=
        stage_reaches_leaf stages input answer stage (hw stage) (root (stages input stage))
      have hcombined : (machineNext stages input answer)^[fuel' + fuel]
          (initial stages input) = (stage, index) := by
        rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, hfuel]
        exact hstate
      cases outcome with
      | none =>
        refine Or.inr ⟨fuel' + fuel + 1, ?_⟩
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hcombined]
        simp only [machineNext, hleaf]
      | some b =>
        refine Or.inl ⟨fuel' + fuel, b, ?_⟩
        rw [hcombined]
        simp only [machineResult, hleaf, observation]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.run_eventually_answers
statement:
theorem run_eventually_answers {α : Type*} (stages : α → ℕ → Code)
    (input : α) (answer : Query → Bool) (hw : ∀ stage, WellFormed (stages input stage))
    (hsuccess : ∃ stage b, StageAnswer answer (stages input stage) b) :
    ∃ fuel b, run (step stages input) answer fuel [] = some b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨stage, b, index, hp, hn⟩ := hsuccess
  rcases stage_reached_or_answer stages input answer hw stage with
    ⟨fuel, b', hb'⟩ | ⟨fuel, hfuel⟩
  · refine ⟨fuel + 1, b', ?_⟩
    simpa only [run_eq_machine, replay, List.foldl_nil] using hb'
  · obtain ⟨fuel', hpath⟩ := path_machine_reaches stages input answer stage _ _ hp
    refine ⟨fuel' + fuel + 1, b, ?_⟩
    rw [run_eq_machine]
    change machineResult stages input ((machineNext stages input answer)^[fuel' + fuel]
      (initial stages input)) = some b
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, hfuel, hpath]
    simp only [machineResult, hn, observation]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.run_correct
statement:
theorem run_correct {α : Type*} (stages : α → ℕ → Code)
    (input : α) (answer : Query → Bool) (P : Bool → Prop)
    (hw : ∀ stage, WellFormed (stages input stage))
    (hcomplete : ∃ stage b, StageAnswer answer (stages input stage) b)
    (hsound : ∀ stage b, StageAnswer answer (stages input stage) b → P b) :
    (∃ fuel b, run (step stages input) answer fuel [] = some b) ∧
      ∀ fuel b, run (step stages input) answer fuel [] = some b → P b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨run_eventually_answers stages input answer hw hcomplete, ?_⟩
  intro fuel b h
  obtain ⟨stage, hstage⟩ := run_answer_from_stage stages input answer fuel b h
  exact hsound stage b hstage

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.Path.trans
proof:
:= by
  induction second with
  | refl => exact first
  | query path hn ih => exact Path.query ih hn

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.evalFuel_some_path
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing index with
  | zero => simp [evalFuel] at h
  | succ fuel ih =>
    cases hn : node code index with
    | inl o =>
      rw [evalFuel, hn] at h
      exact ⟨index, Path.refl index, hn.trans (congrArg Sum.inl h)⟩
    | inr q =>
      rcases q with ⟨q, left, right⟩
      rw [evalFuel, hn] at h
      obtain ⟨finish, hp, hfinish⟩ := ih _ h
      exact ⟨finish, (Path.query (Path.refl index) hn).trans hp, hfinish⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.path_evalFuel_exists
statement:
private theorem path_evalFuel_exists (answer : Query → Bool) (code : Code)
    {start finish : ℕ} (hp : Path answer code start finish) :
    ∀ fuel b, evalFuel answer code fuel finish = some b →
      ∃ fuel', evalFuel answer code fuel' start = some b
proof:
:= by
  induction hp with
  | refl => intro fuel b h; exact ⟨fuel, h⟩
  | query path hn ih =>
    intro fuel b h
    apply ih (fuel + 1) b
    simpa only [evalFuel, hn] using h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.stageAnswer_iff_evalFuel
statement:
theorem stageAnswer_iff_evalFuel (answer : Query → Bool) (code : Code) (b : Bool) :
    StageAnswer answer code b ↔
      ∃ fuel, evalFuel answer code fuel (root code) = some b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨finish, hp, hn⟩
    apply path_evalFuel_exists answer code hp 1 b
    simp only [evalFuel, hn]
  · rintro ⟨fuel, h⟩
    exact evalFuel_some_path answer code fuel (root code) b h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleReplay.run_correct_of_evalFuel
statement:
theorem run_correct_of_evalFuel {α : Type*} (stages : α → ℕ → Code)
    (input : α) (answer : Query → Bool) (P : Bool → Prop)
    (hw : ∀ stage, WellFormed (stages input stage))
    (hcomplete : ∃ stage fuel b,
      evalFuel answer (stages input stage) fuel (root (stages input stage)) = some b)
    (hsound : ∀ stage fuel b,
      evalFuel answer (stages input stage) fuel (root (stages input stage)) = some b → P b) :
    (∃ fuel b, run (step stages input) answer fuel [] = some b) ∧
      ∀ fuel b, run (step stages input) answer fuel [] = some b → P b
proof:
:= by
  apply run_correct stages input answer P hw
  · obtain ⟨stage, fuel, b, h⟩ := hcomplete
    exact ⟨stage, b, (stageAnswer_iff_evalFuel answer _ b).mpr ⟨fuel, h⟩⟩
  · intro stage b h
    obtain ⟨fuel, hfuel⟩ := (stageAnswer_iff_evalFuel answer _ b).mp h
    exact hsound stage fuel b hfuel

statement: theorem swapInstruction_primrec : Primrec swapInstruction
proof:
:= by

  have hatom : Primrec (fun i : Instruction => i.2.1) := Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd
  have hnot : Primrec (fun i : Instruction => !(i.2.1.1)) :=
    (Primrec.dom_bool _).comp (Primrec.fst.comp hatom)
  exact (Primrec.ite (Primrec.eq.comp htag (Primrec.const 6)) (Primrec.const 7)
    (Primrec.ite (Primrec.eq.comp htag (Primrec.const 7)) (Primrec.const 6) htag)).pair
    ((Primrec.ite (Primrec.eq.comp htag (Primrec.const 2))
      (hnot.pair (Primrec.snd.comp hatom)) hatom).pair (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.latticeIndices_computable
statement: theorem latticeIndices_computable : Computable latticeIndices
proof:
:= by
  have hr : PrimrecRel (fun (i : LatticeIndex) (c : RawLatticeCode) =>
      (Int.ofNat i.2.1 - Int.ofNat c.firstIndexBound).natAbs < c.firstIndexBound ∧
      (Int.ofNat i.2.2 - Int.ofNat c.secondIndexBound).natAbs < c.secondIndexBound) := by
    have hfirst : Primrec (fun p : LatticeIndex × RawLatticeCode => p.2.firstIndexBound) :=
      rawLattice_firstIndexBound_primrec.comp Primrec.snd
    have hsecond : Primrec (fun p : LatticeIndex × RawLatticeCode => p.2.secondIndexBound) :=
      rawLattice_secondIndexBound_primrec.comp Primrec.snd
    exact (Primrec.nat_lt.comp (int_natAbs_primrec.comp
      (int_sub_primrec.comp
        (int_ofNat_primrec.comp (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst)))
        (int_ofNat_primrec.comp hfirst))) hfirst).and
      (Primrec.nat_lt.comp (int_natAbs_primrec.comp
        (int_sub_primrec.comp
          (int_ofNat_primrec.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst)))
          (int_ofNat_primrec.comp hsecond))) hsecond)
  have hl : Computable (fun c : RawLatticeCode =>
      (List.range c.representativeCount).flatMap fun r =>
        (List.range (2 * c.firstIndexBound + 1)).flatMap fun n =>
          (List.range (2 * c.secondIndexBound + 1)).map fun m => (r, n, m)) := by fun_prop
  exact (hr.listFilter.to_comp.comp hl Computable.id).of_eq (fun _ => rfl)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.PositiveCoding.rawPositive_casesOn_computable
statement:
theorem rawPositive_casesOn_computable {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {triangular : RawTriangularCode → α} {lattice : RawLatticeCode → α}
    (ht : Computable triangular) (hl : Computable lattice) :
    Computable (fun c : RawPositiveCode =>
      match c with
      | .triangular t => triangular t
      | .lattice l => lattice l)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Computable.sumCasesOn
    (show Primrec positiveSum from Primrec.of_equiv).to_comp
    (ht.comp Computable.snd).to₂ (hl.comp Computable.snd).to₂).of_eq ?_
  intro c
  cases c <;> rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.PositiveCoding.rawPositive_casesOn_computable₂
statement:
theorem rawPositive_casesOn_computable₂ {α β : Type*} [Primcodable α] [Primcodable β]
    {triangular : α → RawTriangularCode → β} {lattice : α → RawLatticeCode → β}
    (ht : Computable₂ triangular) (hl : Computable₂ lattice) :
    Computable₂ (fun a (c : RawPositiveCode) =>
      match c with
      | .triangular t => triangular a t
      | .lattice l => lattice a l)
proof:
:= by
  have he : Computable (fun p : α × RawPositiveCode => positiveSum p.2) :=
    (show Primrec positiveSum from Primrec.of_equiv).to_comp.comp Computable.snd
  refine (Computable.sumCasesOn he
    (ht.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst) Computable.snd).to₂
    (hl.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst) Computable.snd).to₂).of_eq ?_
  rintro ⟨a, c⟩
  cases c <;> rfl

  cases c <;> rfl

private theorem optionFilter_primrec {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {p : α → Bool} (hp : Primrec p) : Primrec (Option.filter p)
proof:

  refine (Primrec.option_casesOn Primrec.id (Primrec.const none)
    (Primrec.cond (hp.comp Primrec.snd)
      (Primrec.option_some.comp Primrec.snd) (Primrec.const none)).to₂).of_eq ?_
  intro o
  cases o <;> simp [Option.filter]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.Native.latticeIndices_eq_native
statement:
theorem latticeIndices_eq_native (c : RawLatticeCode) :
    latticeIndices c = (PositiveVerification.latticeFiniteIndices c).map eraseLatticeIndex
proof:
:= by
  have he : ((List.range c.representativeCount).flatMap fun r =>
      (List.range (2 * c.firstIndexBound + 1)).flatMap fun n =>
        (List.range (2 * c.secondIndexBound + 1)).map fun m => (r, n, m)) =
      (((List.ofFn fun r : Fin c.representativeCount => r).flatMap fun r =>
        (List.ofFn fun n : PositiveVerification.LatticeBoundedInteger c.firstIndexBound => n)
          |>.flatMap fun n =>
          List.ofFn fun m : PositiveVerification.LatticeBoundedInteger c.secondIndexBound =>
            (r, n, m))).map eraseLatticeIndex := by
    simp only [range_eq_map_fin, List.flatMap_map, List.map_flatMap, List.map_map,
      Function.comp_def]
    simp only [List.map_ofFn, eraseLatticeIndex, Function.comp_def]
  rw [latticeIndices, he, List.filter_map]
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.Native.eraseInterval_inj
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have he : i.1 = j.1 := Fin.ext (congrArg Prod.fst h)
    cases i with
    | mk a b =>
      cases j with
      | mk d e =>
        dsimp at he
        subst d
        have he' : b = e := Fin.ext (congrArg Prod.snd h)
        subst e
        rfl
  · rintro rfl
    rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.Native.pack_triangularBaseOpen
statement:
@[simp] theorem pack_triangularBaseOpen (C : RegionCode) (c : RawTriangularCode)
    (shift : ℕ) (j : Fin (PositiveVerification.triangularPieceCount c)) {v : ℕ}
    (x : AffineExpr C (PositiveVerification.triangularHorizontalVariableCount c + shift)) :
    Affine.Native.packFormula
      (PositiveVerification.triangularBaseOpenFormula (v := v) C c shift j x) =
      triangularBaseOpenFormula (encodeRegion C) c shift j.val (packAffine x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PositiveVerification.triangularBaseOpenFormula, triangularBaseOpenFormula,
    pack_orList, List.map_flatMap, List.map_map, Function.comp_def,
    Affine.Native.packFormula_conjunction, pack_horizontalLt,
    pack_add, pack_triH_scale, pack_triH, triangularPiece_eq_native]
  rw [range_eq_map_fin]
  simp only [List.flatMap_map, PositiveVerification.triangularIntervalLeftId,
    PositiveVerification.triangularIntervalRightId, triangularIntervalLeftId,
    triangularIntervalRightId, PositiveVerification.triangularIntervalOrdinal,
    triangularIntervalOrdinal, PositiveVerification.triangularBetaId, triangularBetaId]

statement:
