    Affine.Native.packFormula_conjunction, pack_horizontalLe,
    pack_add, pack_triH_scale, pack_triH, triangularPiece_eq_native]
  rw [range_eq_map_fin]
  simp only [List.flatMap_map, PositiveVerification.triangularIntervalLeftId,
    PositiveVerification.triangularIntervalRightId, triangularIntervalLeftId,
    triangularIntervalRightId, PositiveVerification.triangularIntervalOrdinal,
    triangularIntervalOrdinal, PositiveVerification.triangularBetaId, triangularBetaId]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.Native.pack_triangularSingleInput
statement:
@[simp] theorem pack_triangularSingleInput (C : RegionCode) (n : ℕ) (a : Fin C.vertexCount) :
    packAffine (PositiveVerification.Expr.input n (Coeff.single a 1)) =
      affineInput n (basisArray C.vertexCount a.val 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pack_input, basisArray_eq_ofFn]
  congr 1
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext i
  simp [Coeff.single, Fin.ext_iff, eq_comm]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.Native.pack_diameterInput
statement:
@[simp] theorem pack_diameterInput (C : RegionCode) (n : ℕ) (a b : Fin C.vertexCount) :
    packAffine (PositiveVerification.Expr.input n
      (Coeff.sub (Coeff.single a 1) (Coeff.single b 1))) =
      diameterInput (encodeRegion C) n a.val b.val
proof:
:= by
  have he : PositiveVerification.Expr.input n (Coeff.sub (Coeff.single a 1)
      (Coeff.single b 1)) = PositiveVerification.Expr.sub
      (PositiveVerification.Expr.input n (Coeff.single a 1))
      (PositiveVerification.Expr.input n (Coeff.single b 1)) := by
    dsimp only [PositiveVerification.Expr.input, PositiveVerification.Expr.sub,
      PositiveVerification.Expr.add, PositiveVerification.Expr.neg,
      Coeff.sub, Coeff.add, Coeff.neg]
    congr 1
    funext i
    simp
  rw [he, pack_sub, pack_triangularSingleInput, pack_triangularSingleInput]
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.Native.triangularBody_eq_pack
statement:
theorem triangularBody_eq_pack (C : RegionCode) (c : RawTriangularCode) :
    triangularBody (encodeRegion C) c =
      Affine.Native.packFormula (PositiveVerification.triangularBody C c)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  dsimp only [PositiveVerification.triangularBody, triangularBody]
  simp only [pack_andList, pack_orList, pack_implication, pack_forallHorizontal,
    pack_forallVertical, pack_horizontalLt, pack_verticalLt, pack_horizontalLe, pack_verticalLe,
    Affine.Native.packFormula_conjunction,
    Affine.Native.packFormula_disjunction,
    Affine.Native.packFormula_truth,
    pack_sameCentre, pack_cellNonoverlap, pack_openCell, pack_closedCell,
    pack_triangularCentreX, pack_triangularCentreY, pack_diameterInput,
    pack_triH, pack_triV, pack_neg, pack_zero, pack_var,
    pack_intScale, pack_triangularBaseOpen, pack_triangularBaseClosed,
    triangularIntervalIndices_eq_native, triangularRepresentativeIndices_eq_native,
    encodeRegion_vertexCount, encodeRegion_cellCount,
    range_eq_map_fin, apply_ite,
    List.map_flatMap, List.flatMap_map, List.map_map, List.map_cons,
    List.map_nil, List.map_append, Function.comp_def, eraseInterval_inj]
  simp only [PositiveVerification.triangularHorizontalVariableCount,
    PositiveVerification.triangularVerticalVariableCount, triangularHorizontalVariableCount,
    triangularVerticalVariableCount, PositiveVerification.triangularTotalIntervalCount,
    PositiveVerification.triangularTotalRepresentativeCount, triangularTotalIntervalCount,
    triangularTotalRepresentativeCount, PositiveVerification.triangularPieceCount,
    triangularPieceCount, PositiveVerification.triangularBetaId, triangularBetaId,
    PositiveVerification.triangularAlphaId, triangularAlphaId,
    PositiveVerification.triangularIntervalLeftId, triangularIntervalLeftId,
    PositiveVerification.triangularIntervalRightId, triangularIntervalRightId,
    PositiveVerification.triangularRepresentativeXId, triangularRepresentativeXId,
    PositiveVerification.triangularRepresentativeYId, triangularRepresentativeYId,
    PositiveVerification.triangularIntervalOrdinal, triangularIntervalOrdinal,
    PositiveVerification.triangularRepresentativeOrdinal, triangularRepresentativeOrdinal,
    PositiveVerification.triangularShearId, triangularShearId, eraseInterval,
    eraseRepresentative]
  simp only [triangularFiniteIndices_eq_native, List.flatMap_map, List.map_map,
    Function.comp_def, eraseFinite_inj]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.Native.triangularSlab_eq_pack
statement:
theorem triangularSlab_eq_pack (C : RegionCode) (c : RawTriangularCode) :
    triangularSlabFormula (encodeRegion C) c =
      Affine.Native.packFormula
        (PositiveVerification.triangularSlabFormula C c)
proof:
:= by
  cases hw : c.wellFormed with
  | false => simp only [triangularSlabFormula, PositiveVerification.triangularSlabFormula,
      hw, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Affine.Native.packFormula_falsity]
  | true =>
    simp only [triangularSlabFormula, PositiveVerification.triangularSlabFormula, hw,
      if_true, triangularBody_eq_pack]
    exact (pack_close (PositiveVerification.triangularBody C c)).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.Native.pack_andList
statement:
@[simp] theorem pack_andList {C : RegionCode} {h v : ℕ} (fs : List (Formula C h v)) :
    Affine.Native.packFormula (PositiveVerification.Formula.andList fs) = andList
      (fs.map Affine.Native.packFormula)
proof:
:= by
  induction fs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons f fs ih => simp only [PositiveVerification.Formula.andList,
    Affine.Native.packFormula_conjunction, ih,
      List.map_cons, andList, List.foldr_cons]

statement:

      (PositiveVerification.Formula.horizontalEq a b : Formula C h v) =

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.NegativeFormulas.Native.range_map_eq_ofFn
statement:
theorem range_map_eq_ofFn {α : Type*} {n : ℕ} (f : ℕ → α) (g : Fin n → α)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin n, f i = g i) : (List.range n).map f = List.ofFn g
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intro i hi hi'
    simpa using h ⟨i, by simpa using hi⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.NegativeFormulas.Native.range_flatMap_eq_ofFn
statement:
theorem range_flatMap_eq_ofFn {α : Type*} {m n : ℕ} (f : ℕ → ℕ → α)
    (g : Fin m → Fin n → α) (h : ∀ (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n), f i j = g i j) :
    (List.range m).flatMap (fun i => (List.range n).map (f i)) =
      (List.ofFn fun i => List.ofFn (g i)).flatten
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.flatMap_def]
  congr 1
  apply range_map_eq_ofFn
  intro i
  exact range_map_eq_ofFn (f i) (g i) (h i)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.instructionNode_primrec
statement:
private theorem instructionNode_primrec : Primrec (fun p : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ =>
    ((p.1, dummy, p.2.1, p.2.2) : Instruction))
proof:
:=
  Primrec.fst.pair ((Primrec.const dummy).pair Primrec.snd)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.singleton_primrec
statement:
private theorem singleton_primrec {α : Type*} [Primcodable α] :
    Primrec (fun a : α => [a])
proof: := Primrec.list_cons.comp Primrec.id (Primrec.const [])

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.shiftInstruction_primrec
statement: theorem shiftInstruction_primrec : Primrec₂ shiftInstruction
proof:
:= by
  have htag : Primrec (fun p : ℕ × Instruction => p.2.1) := Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd
  have hatom : Primrec (fun p : ℕ × Instruction => p.2.2.1) :=
    Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)
  have hleft : Primrec (fun p : ℕ × Instruction => p.2.2.2.1) :=
    Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))
  have hright : Primrec (fun p : ℕ × Instruction => p.2.2.2.2) :=
    Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))
  have hbinary : PrimrecPred (fun p : ℕ × Instruction => p.2.1 = 3 ∨ p.2.1 = 4) :=
    (Primrec.eq.comp htag (Primrec.const 3)).or
      (Primrec.eq.comp htag (Primrec.const 4))
  have href : PrimrecPred (fun p : ℕ × Instruction =>
      p.2.1 = 3 ∨ p.2.1 = 4 ∨ p.2.1 = 5 ∨ p.2.1 = 6 ∨ p.2.1 = 7) :=
    (Primrec.eq.comp htag (Primrec.const 3)).or
      ((Primrec.eq.comp htag (Primrec.const 4)).or
        ((Primrec.eq.comp htag (Primrec.const 5)).or
          ((Primrec.eq.comp htag (Primrec.const 6)).or
            (Primrec.eq.comp htag (Primrec.const 7)))))
  exact htag.pair (hatom.pair
    ((Primrec.ite href (Primrec.nat_add.comp Primrec.fst hleft) hleft).pair
      (Primrec.ite hbinary (Primrec.nat_add.comp Primrec.fst hright) hright)))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.shiftCode_primrec
statement: theorem shiftCode_primrec : Primrec₂ shiftCode
proof:
:=
  Primrec.list_map Primrec.snd
    (shiftInstruction_primrec.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd).to₂

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.atomCode_primrec
statement:
theorem atomCode_primrec : Primrec (fun p : Bool × Bool × Expr =>
    atomCode p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
proof:
:=
  singleton_primrec.comp ((Primrec.const 2).pair
    (Primrec.id.pair ((Primrec.const 0).pair (Primrec.const 0))))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.unary_primrec
statement: theorem unary_primrec : Primrec₂ unary
proof:
:=
  Primrec.list_append.comp Primrec.snd
    (singleton_primrec.comp (instructionNode_primrec.comp
      (Primrec.fst.pair
        ((Primrec.nat_sub.comp (Primrec.list_length.comp Primrec.snd)
          (Primrec.const 1)).pair (Primrec.const 0)))))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.binary_primrec
statement: theorem binary_primrec : Primrec (fun p : ℕ × Code × Code => binary p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)

:= by
  have hleft : Primrec (fun p : ℕ × Code × Code => p.2.1) :=
    Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd
  have hright : Primrec (fun p : ℕ × Code × Code => p.2.2) :=
    Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd
  have hlenleft := Primrec.list_length.comp hleft
  have hlenright := Primrec.list_length.comp hright
  exact Primrec.list_append.comp
    (Primrec.list_append.comp hleft (shiftCode_primrec.comp hlenleft hright))
    (singleton_primrec.comp (instructionNode_primrec.comp
      (Primrec.fst.pair
        ((Primrec.nat_sub.comp hlenleft (Primrec.const 1)).pair
          (Primrec.nat_sub.comp (Primrec.nat_add.comp hlenleft hlenright)
            (Primrec.const 1))))))

proof:
:= by
  induction fs with
  | nil => simp [LocalCoverSearch.listAnd, Formula.Holds]
  | cons f fs ih =>
      change (f.Holds R x y ∧ (LocalCoverSearch.listAnd fs).Holds R x y) ↔ _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.NegativeFormulas.Native.certificateFormula_correct
statement:
theorem certificateFormula_correct {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C)
    (O : CorrectOracle C R) (B : LocalCoverSearch.LocalBoundCode C) (c : RawNegativeCode) :
    AffineCompiler.decideFormula O.toOracle (certificateFormula C B c) =
      LocalCoverSearch.negativeVerifier AffineCompiler.decideFormula O.toOracle B c
proof:
:= by
  apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
  rw [AffineCompiler.decideFormula_correct]
  have hwell : LocalCoverSearch.subdivisionWellFormed c = c.wellFormed := rfl
  by_cases hc : c.wellFormed = true
  · simp only [certificateFormula, if_pos hc, Formula.Holds, listAnd_holds,
      List.forall_mem_map, List.mem_range]
    simp only [LocalCoverSearch.negativeVerifier, LocalCoverSearch.checkSubdivision,
      hwell, hc,
      Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, LocalCoverSearch.allLocalCardinalitiesFail,
      List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range, LocalCoverSearch.localCardinalityBound,
      LocalCoverSearch.checkLocalCover, Bool.not_eq_true_eq_eq_false,
      Bool.eq_false_iff, ne_eq, AffineCompiler.decideFormula_correct]
  · simp only [certificateFormula, if_neg hc, Formula.Holds]
    have hfalse : c.wellFormed = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hc
    simp only [LocalCoverSearch.negativeVerifier, LocalCoverSearch.checkSubdivision,
      hwell, hfalse,
      Bool.false_and, Bool.false_eq_true]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.NegativeFormulas.Native.stageFormula_correct
statement:
theorem stageFormula_correct {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C)
    (O : CorrectOracle C R) (B : LocalCoverSearch.LocalBoundCode C) (stage : ℕ)
    (hB : LocalCoverSearch.buildLocalBound C O.toOracle = some B) :
    AffineCompiler.decideFormula O.toOracle (stageFormula C B stage) =
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.negativeStage C O.toOracle stage
proof:
:= by
  rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.negativeStage, hB]
  cases hstage : wellFormedNegativeStage stage with
  | none =>
      simp only [stageFormula, hstage]
      apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
      rw [ne_eq, AffineCompiler.decideFormula_correct]
      exact id
  | some c =>
      simpa only [stageFormula, hstage] using certificateFormula_correct R O B c

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.NegativeFormulas.Native.negativeCertificateFormula_eq_pack
statement:
theorem negativeCertificateFormula_eq_pack (C : RegionCode)
    (B : LocalCoverSearch.LocalBoundCode C) (c : RawNegativeCode) :
    negativeCertificateFormula (encodeRegion C) (encodeBound B) c =
      packFormula (certificateFormula C B c)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc : c.wellFormed = true
  · simp only [negativeCertificateFormula, certificateFormula, if_pos hc,
      packFormula_conjunction, positiveSubdivisionFormula_eq_pack, pack_listAnd,
      List.map_map, Function.comp_def, packFormula_negation, localCoverFormula_eq_pack]
  · simp only [negativeCertificateFormula, certificateFormula, if_neg hc, packFormula_falsity]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.NegativeFormulas.Native.negativeFormula_eq_pack
statement:
theorem negativeFormula_eq_pack (C : RegionCode)
    (B : LocalCoverSearch.LocalBoundCode C) (stage : ℕ) :
    negativeFormula (encodeRegion C) (encodeBound B) stage =
      packFormula (stageFormula C B stage)
proof:
:= by
  unfold negativeFormula stageFormula
  cases wellFormedNegativeStage stage with
  | none => rfl
  | some c => exact negativeCertificateFormula_eq_pack C B c

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.cellSelector_primrec
statement:
theorem cellSelector_primrec : Primrec (fun p : RegionInput × ℕ × ℕ =>
    cellSelector p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Primrec (fun p : RegionInput × ℕ × ℕ =>
      p.1.2.getD p.2.2 ((0, 0), (0, 0))) :=
    (Primrec.list_getD ((0, 0), (0, 0))).comp
      (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst) (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)
  have hs : Primrec (fun p : RegionInput × ℕ × ℕ => p.2.1) :=
    Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd
  exact Primrec.nat_mod.comp
    (Primrec.ite (Primrec.eq.comp hs (Primrec.const 0)) (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp hc))
      (Primrec.ite (Primrec.eq.comp hs (Primrec.const 1))
        (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.fst.comp hc))
        (Primrec.ite (Primrec.eq.comp hs (Primrec.const 2))
          (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp hc)) (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp hc)))))
    (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.cellInput_primrec
statement:
theorem cellInput_primrec : Primrec (fun p : RegionInput × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ =>
    cellInput p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2)
proof:
:=
  affineInput_primrec.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
    (basisArray_primrec.comp ((Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst).pair
      ((cellSelector_primrec.comp (Primrec.fst.pair (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))).pair
        (Primrec.const 1))))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CertificateFormulas.comparison_computable
statement:
theorem comparison_computable : Computable (fun p : Bool × Bool × Expr × Expr =>
    comparison p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Computable (fun p : Bool × Bool × Expr × Expr =>
      (p.1, p.2.1, exprSub p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2)) := Computable.fst.pair
    ((Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd).pair
      (exprSub_computable.comp (Computable.fst.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd))
        (Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd))))
  have h := atomCode_primrec.to_comp.comp hp
  exact h.of_eq (fun _ => rfl)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.addArray_ofFn
statement:
private theorem addArray_ofFn {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n → ℚ) :
    addArray (List.ofFn a) (List.ofFn b) = List.ofFn (fun i => a i + b i)
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp [addArray]
  · intro i hi hi'
    have hin : i < n := by simpa using hi'
    have ha : (List.ofFn a).getD i 0 = a ⟨i, hin⟩ := by
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa using hin)]
      simp only [List.getElem_ofFn]
    have hb : (List.ofFn b).getD i 0 = b ⟨i, hin⟩ := by
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa using hin)]
      simp only [List.getElem_ofFn]
    simp only [addArray, List.length_ofFn, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range,
      ha, hb, List.getElem_ofFn]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.packExpr_add

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.pack_negateClause

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.pack_negateDNF
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ∀ (p acc : AffineCompiler.DNF C h v),
      (packDNF p).foldl (fun acc c => dnfAnd acc (negateClause c)) (packDNF acc) =
        packDNF (p.foldl (fun acc c => AffineCompiler.dnfAnd acc
          (AffineCompiler.negateClause c)) acc) := by
    intro p
    induction p with
    | nil => intro acc; rfl
    | cons c rest ih =>
      intro acc
      change (c.map packSorted :: packDNF rest).foldl _ (packDNF acc) = _
      rw [List.foldl_cons, pack_negateClause, packDNF_and]
      exact ih (AffineCompiler.dnfAnd acc (AffineCompiler.negateClause c))
  exact hf p [[]]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.pack_eliminateClause_horizontal
statement:
@[simp] theorem pack_eliminateClause_horizontal {C : RegionCode} {n v : ℕ}

    eliminateClause false (c.map packSorted) =
      (AffineCompiler.eliminateHorizontalClause c).map packSorted
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (c.map packSorted).filterMap (zeroTail false) =
      (c.filterMap AffineCompiler.horizontalZeroTail).map packSorted := by
    simp only [List.filterMap_map, List.map_filterMap, Function.comp_def,
      packSorted_zeroTail_horizontal]
  have hp : (c.map packSorted).filterMap (positive false) =
      (c.filterMap AffineCompiler.positiveHorizontal).map packAtom := by
    simp only [List.filterMap_map, List.map_filterMap, Function.comp_def,
      packSorted_positive_horizontal]
  have hn : (c.map packSorted).filterMap (negative false) =
      (c.filterMap AffineCompiler.negativeHorizontal).map packAtom := by
    simp only [List.filterMap_map, List.map_filterMap, Function.comp_def,
      packSorted_negative_horizontal]
  simp only [eliminateClause, hz, hp, hn, AffineCompiler.eliminateHorizontalClause,
    List.map_append, List.map_flatMap, List.flatMap_map, List.map_map, Function.comp_def,
    packAtom_combineBounds, packSorted]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.node_append
statement:
private theorem node_append (initial ending : Tree) (index : ℕ)
    (h : index < initial.length) : node (initial ++ ending) index = node initial index
proof:
:=
  List.getD_append initial ending (.inl none) index h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.node_outside
statement:
private theorem node_outside (code : Tree) (index : ℕ) (h : code.length ≤ index) :
    node code index = .inl none
proof: := List.getD_eq_default code (.inl none) h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.node_at_end
statement:
private theorem node_at_end (initial : Tree) (n : Node) :
    node (initial ++ [n]) initial.length = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [node, List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ (by rfl)]
  simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.wf_append
proof:
:= by
  intro index q left right hnode
  by_cases hi : index < initial.length
  · exact h index q left right (by rwa [node_append _ _ _ hi] at hnode)
  · by_cases he : index = initial.length
    · subst index
      exact hn q left right (by rwa [node_at_end] at hnode)
    · rw [node_outside _ _ (by simp; omega)] at hnode
      contradiction

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.evalFuel_append
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing index with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    simp only [evalFuel, node_append _ _ _ hi]
    cases hn : node initial index with
    | inl o => rfl
    | inr q =>
      rcases q with ⟨q, left, right⟩
      have hchildren := h index q left right hn
      cases ha : answer q with
      | false => simp only [ha, cond_false]; exact ih left (by omega)
      | true => simp only [ha, cond_true]; exact ih right (by omega)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.clauseInto_prefix
proof:
:= by
  induction clause with
  | nil => exact ⟨[.inl (some true)], rfl⟩
  | cons a rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨ending, he⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨ending ++ [.inr (transport (atomQuery a),
      if a.2.1 then root (clauseInto transport bad initial rest) else bad,
      if a.2.1 then bad else root (clauseInto transport bad initial rest))],
      by
        change clauseInto transport bad initial rest ++ _ = initial ++ _
        simp only [clauseInto, appendAtom] at he ⊢
        rw [he, List.append_assoc]⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.clauseInto_length_pos
statement:
private theorem clauseInto_length_pos (transport : PackedQuery → Query) (bad : ℕ)
    (initial : Tree) (clause : Clause) : 0 < (clauseInto transport bad initial clause).length
proof:
:= by
  cases clause <;> simp [clauseInto, appendAtom]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.clauseInto_wf
proof:
:= by
  induction clause with
  | nil => exact wf_append initial _ h (by intros; contradiction)
  | cons a rest ih =>
    apply wf_append _ _ ih
    intro q left right he
    obtain ⟨ending, hprefix⟩ := clauseInto_prefix transport bad initial rest
    have hlength := clauseInto_length_pos transport bad initial rest
    have hbad : bad < (clauseInto transport bad initial rest).length := by
      rw [hprefix]
      simp only [List.length_append]
      omega
    simp only [Sum.inr.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at he
    rcases he with ⟨_, hl, hr⟩
    change (if a.2.1 then root (clauseInto transport bad initial rest) else bad) = left at hl
    change (if a.2.1 then bad else root (clauseInto transport bad initial rest)) = right at hr
    have hgood : root (clauseInto transport bad initial rest) <
        (clauseInto transport bad initial rest).length := by
      unfold root
      omega
    cases ha : a.2.1 <;> simp only [ha, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hl hr <;>
      constructor <;> omega

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.evalFuel_unique
statement:
private theorem evalFuel_unique (answer : Query → Bool) (code : Tree)
    (fuel fuel' index : ℕ) (b b' : Bool)
    (hb : evalFuel answer code fuel index = some b)
    (hb' : evalFuel answer code fuel' index = some b') : b = b'
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing fuel' index with
  | zero => simp [evalFuel] at hb
  | succ fuel ih =>
    cases fuel' with
    | zero => simp [evalFuel] at hb'
    | succ fuel' =>
      cases hn : node code index with
      | inl o =>
        simp only [evalFuel, hn] at hb hb'
        exact Option.some.inj (hb.symm.trans hb')
      | inr q =>
        exact ih fuel' _ (by simpa only [evalFuel, hn] using hb)
          (by simpa only [evalFuel, hn] using hb')

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.appendAtom_eval
statement:
private theorem appendAtom_eval (transport : PackedQuery → Query) (answer : Query → Bool)
    (initial : Tree) (bad good : ℕ) (a : SortedAtom) (b g : Bool)
    (h : WellFormed initial) (hbad : bad < initial.length) (hgood : good < initial.length)
    (hb : ∃ fuel, evalFuel answer initial fuel bad = some b)
    (hg : ∃ fuel, evalFuel answer initial fuel good = some g) :
    ∃ fuel, evalFuel answer (appendAtom transport bad good a initial) fuel
      (root (appendAtom transport bad good a initial)) =
        some (cond (evalAtom (answer ∘ transport) a) g b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨fb, hb⟩ := hb
  obtain ⟨fg, hg⟩ := hg
  have hbe : evalFuel answer (appendAtom transport bad good a initial) fb bad = some b := by
    rw [appendAtom, evalFuel_append answer initial _ h fb bad hbad, hb]
  have hge : evalFuel answer (appendAtom transport bad good a initial) fg good = some g := by
    rw [appendAtom, evalFuel_append answer initial _ h fg good hgood, hg]
  have hn : node (appendAtom transport bad good a initial)
      (root (appendAtom transport bad good a initial)) =
      .inr (transport (atomQuery a), if a.2.1 then good else bad,
        if a.2.1 then bad else good) := by
    simpa only [root, appendAtom, List.length_append, List.length_singleton,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel] using node_at_end initial _
  cases ha : a.2.1 <;> cases hq : answer (transport (atomQuery a))
  · refine ⟨fb + 1, ?_⟩
    simpa only [evalFuel, hn, ha, hq, evalAtom, Function.comp_apply, Bool.false_eq_true,
      ↓reduceIte, cond_false] using hbe
  · refine ⟨fg + 1, ?_⟩
    simpa only [evalFuel, hn, ha, hq, evalAtom, Function.comp_apply, Bool.false_eq_true,
      ↓reduceIte, cond_true] using hge
  · refine ⟨fg + 1, ?_⟩
    simpa only [evalFuel, hn, ha, hq, evalAtom, Function.comp_apply,
      ↓reduceIte, Bool.not_false, cond_false, cond_true] using hge
  · refine ⟨fb + 1, ?_⟩
    simpa only [evalFuel, hn, ha, hq, evalAtom, Function.comp_apply,
      ↓reduceIte, Bool.not_true, cond_true, cond_false] using hbe

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.clauseInto_eval
statement:
private theorem clauseInto_eval (transport : PackedQuery → Query) (answer : Query → Bool)
    (initial : Tree) (bad : ℕ) (clause : Clause) (b : Bool)
    (h : WellFormed initial) (hbad : bad < initial.length)
    (hb : ∃ fuel, evalFuel answer initial fuel bad = some b) :
    ∃ fuel, evalFuel answer (clauseInto transport bad initial clause) fuel
      (root (clauseInto transport bad initial clause)) =
        some (clause.all (evalAtom (answer ∘ transport)) || b)
proof:
:= by
  induction clause with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    have hn := node_at_end initial (.inl (some true))
    simp only [clauseInto, List.foldr_nil, root, List.length_append,
      List.length_singleton, Nat.add_sub_cancel, evalFuel, List.all_nil,
      Bool.true_or, hn]
  | cons a rest ih =>
    let code := clauseInto transport bad initial rest
    have hw : WellFormed code := clauseInto_wf transport bad initial rest h hbad
    obtain ⟨ending, he⟩ := clauseInto_prefix transport bad initial rest
    have hbad' : bad < code.length := by
      change bad < (clauseInto transport bad initial rest).length
      rw [he]; simp only [List.length_append]; omega
    have hbadEval : ∃ fuel, evalFuel answer code fuel bad = some b := by
      obtain ⟨fuel, hf⟩ := hb
      refine ⟨fuel, ?_⟩
      change evalFuel answer (clauseInto transport bad initial rest) fuel bad = some b
      rw [he, evalFuel_append answer initial ending h fuel bad hbad, hf]
    have hgood : root code < code.length := by
      have hp := clauseInto_length_pos transport bad initial rest
      change code.length - 1 < code.length
      omega
    obtain ⟨fuel, hf⟩ := appendAtom_eval transport answer code bad (root code) a b
      (rest.all (evalAtom (answer ∘ transport)) || b) hw hbad' hgood hbadEval ih
    refine ⟨fuel, ?_⟩
    change evalFuel answer (appendAtom transport bad (root code) a code) fuel
      (root (appendAtom transport bad (root code) a code)) = _
    rw [hf, List.all_cons]
    congr 1
    cases evalAtom (answer ∘ transport) a <;>
      cases rest.all (evalAtom (answer ∘ transport)) <;> cases b <;> rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.dnfInto_length_pos
statement:
private theorem dnfInto_length_pos (transport : PackedQuery → Query)
    (initial : Tree) (dnf : DNF) : 0 < (dnfInto transport initial dnf).length
proof:
:= by
  cases dnf with
  | nil => simp [dnfInto]
  | cons clause rest => exact clauseInto_length_pos _ _ _ _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.dnfInto_wf
proof:
:= by
  induction dnf with
  | nil => exact wf_append initial _ h (by intros; contradiction)
  | cons clause rest ih =>
    apply clauseInto_wf transport _ _ clause ih
    have hp := dnfInto_length_pos transport initial rest
    change (dnfInto transport initial rest).length - 1 < (dnfInto transport initial rest).length
    omega

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.dnfInto_eval
statement:
private theorem dnfInto_eval (transport : PackedQuery → Query) (answer : Query → Bool)
    (initial : Tree) (dnf : DNF) (h : WellFormed initial) :
    ∃ fuel, evalFuel answer (dnfInto transport initial dnf) fuel
      (root (dnfInto transport initial dnf)) = some (evalDNF (answer ∘ transport) dnf)
proof:
:= by
  induction dnf with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    have hn := node_at_end initial (.inl (some false))
    simp only [dnfInto, List.foldr_nil, root, List.length_append,
      List.length_singleton, Nat.add_sub_cancel, evalFuel, evalDNF, List.any_nil, hn]
  | cons clause rest ih =>
    have hw := dnfInto_wf transport initial rest h
    have hroot : root (dnfInto transport initial rest) <
        (dnfInto transport initial rest).length := by
      have hp := dnfInto_length_pos transport initial rest
      simp only [root]
      omega
    simpa only [dnfInto, List.foldr_cons, evalDNF, List.any_cons] using
      clauseInto_eval transport answer (dnfInto transport initial rest)
        (root (dnfInto transport initial rest)) clause (evalDNF (answer ∘ transport) rest)
        hw hroot ih

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.treeOfDNF_wellFormed
statement:
theorem treeOfDNF_wellFormed (transport : PackedQuery → Query) (dnf : DNF) :
    WellFormed (treeOfDNF transport dnf)
proof:
:=
  dnfInto_wf transport [] dnf (by intro index q left right hn; simp [node] at hn)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.treeOfDNF_eval
statement:
theorem treeOfDNF_eval (transport : PackedQuery → Query) (answer : Query → Bool) (dnf : DNF) :
    ∃ fuel, evalFuel answer (treeOfDNF transport dnf) fuel
      (root (treeOfDNF transport dnf)) = some (evalDNF (answer ∘ transport) dnf)
proof:
:=
  dnfInto_eval transport answer [] dnf (by intro index q left right hn; simp [node] at hn)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.treeOfDNF_stageAnswer
statement:
theorem treeOfDNF_stageAnswer (transport : PackedQuery → Query) (answer : Query → Bool)
    (dnf : DNF) (b : Bool) :
    StageAnswer answer (treeOfDNF transport dnf) b ↔ evalDNF (answer ∘ transport) dnf = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨fuel, hf⟩ := treeOfDNF_eval transport answer dnf
  rw [stageAnswer_iff_evalFuel]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨fuel', hf'⟩
    exact evalFuel_unique answer _ fuel fuel' _ _ b hf hf'
  · intro he
    exact ⟨fuel, by rwa [he] at hf⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.treeOfFormula_wellFormed
statement:
theorem treeOfFormula_wellFormed (transport : PackedQuery → Query) (code : Code) :
    WellFormed (treeOfFormula transport code)
proof: := treeOfDNF_wellFormed transport (compile code)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.treeOfFormula_stageAnswer
statement:
theorem treeOfFormula_stageAnswer (transport : PackedQuery → Query) (answer : Query → Bool)
    (code : Code) (b : Bool) :
    StageAnswer answer (treeOfFormula transport code) b ↔
      decidePackedFormula (answer ∘ transport) code = b
proof: := treeOfDNF_stageAnswer _ _ _ _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.foldr_computable
statement:
private theorem foldr_computable {α β σ : Type*}
    [Primcodable α] [Primcodable β] [Primcodable σ]
    {f : α → List β} {g : α → σ} {h : α → β × σ → σ} (default : β)
    (hf : Computable f) (hg : Computable g) (hh : Computable₂ h) :
    Computable (fun a => (f a).foldr (fun b state => h a (b, state)) (g a))
proof:
:= by
  refine (Tiling.Computability.List.foldl_computable default (Computable.list_reverse.comp hf) hg
    ((hh.comp Computable.fst
      ((Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd).pair
        (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd))).to₂)).of_eq ?_
  intro a
  simp [List.foldl_reverse]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.root_computable
statement: private theorem root_computable : Computable root
proof:
:=
  Primrec.nat_sub.to_comp.comp Computable.list_length (Computable.const 1)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.appendAtom_computable_of
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Computable (fun x => (a x).2.1) := Computable.fst.comp (Computable.snd.comp ha)
  have hquery := ht.comp Computable.id (atomQuery_computable.comp ha)
  have hn := (Computable.sumInr (α := Option Bool)).comp (hquery.pair
    ((Computable.cond hs hg hb).pair (Computable.cond hs hb hg)))
  refine (Computable.list_concat.comp hi hn).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  cases he : (a x).2.1 <;> simp only [appendAtom, he, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] <;> rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.clauseInto_computable_of
proof:
:= by
  exact foldr_computable (false, false, [], []) hc
    (Computable.list_concat.comp hi (Computable.const (.inl (some true))))
    (appendAtom_computable_of
      ((ht.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst) Computable.snd).to₂)
      (hb.comp Computable.fst)
      (root_computable.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd))
      (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd) (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)).to₂

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.dnfInto_computable_of
statement:
private theorem dnfInto_computable_of {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {transport : α → PackedQuery → Query} {initial : α → Tree} {dnf : α → DNF}
    (ht : Computable₂ transport) (hi : Computable initial) (hd : Computable dnf) :
    Computable (fun x => dnfInto (transport x) (initial x) (dnf x))
proof:
:= by
  exact foldr_computable [] hd
    (Computable.list_concat.comp hi (Computable.const (.inl (some false))))
    (clauseInto_computable_of
      ((ht.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst) Computable.snd).to₂)
      (root_computable.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd))
      (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd) (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd)).to₂

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.treeOfFormula_native_correct

    (R : Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Realization C)
    (O : Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.CorrectOracle C R)
    (transport : PackedQuery → Query) (answer : Query → Bool)
    (hanswer : ∀ q, answer (transport (Native.packQuery q)) = O.toOracle.answer q)
    (f : Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Formula C 0 0) :
    StageAnswer answer (treeOfFormula transport (Native.packFormula f)) true ↔
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Formula.Holds R f Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0

  exact Native.decidePackedFormula_correct R O (answer ∘ transport) hanswer f

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.labelNode_primrec
statement: private theorem labelNode_primrec : Primrec₂ labelNode
proof:
:= by
  have hleaf : Primrec₂ (fun result : Bool => fun o : Option Bool =>
      match o with
      | none => (Sum.inl none : Node)
      | some b => Sum.inl (if b then some result else none)) := by
    have hsome : Primrec (fun x : (Bool × Option Bool) × Bool => some x.1.1) :=
      Primrec.option_some.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst)
    refine (Primrec.option_casesOn Primrec.snd (Primrec.const (.inl none))
      (Primrec.sumInl.comp (Primrec.cond Primrec.snd
        hsome (Primrec.const none))).to₂).of_eq ?_
    intro x
    cases x.2 with
    | none => rfl
    | some b => cases b <;> rfl
  refine (Primrec.sumCasesOn Primrec.snd
    (hleaf.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd).to₂
    (Primrec.sumInr.comp Primrec.snd).to₂).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  cases x.2 with
  | inl o => cases o <;> rfl
  | inr q => rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.node_labelCode
statement:
private theorem node_labelCode (result : Bool) (code : Tree) (index : ℕ) :
    node (labelCode result code) index = labelNode result (node code index)
proof:
:= by
  exact List.getD_map code (.inl none) (labelNode result)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.labelCode_wellFormed
statement:
private theorem labelCode_wellFormed (result : Bool) (code : Tree) (h : WellFormed code) :
    WellFormed (labelCode result code)
proof:
:= by
  intro index q left right hn
  rw [node_labelCode] at hn
  cases he : node code index with
  | inl o =>
    cases o with
    | none => simp [he, labelNode] at hn
    | some b => cases b <;> simp [he, labelNode] at hn
  | inr qq =>
    simp only [he, labelNode, Sum.inr.injEq] at hn
    exact h index q left right (by rw [he, hn])

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.evalFuel_labelCode
statement:
private theorem evalFuel_labelCode (result : Bool) (answer : Query → Bool)
    (code : Tree) (fuel index : ℕ) :
    evalFuel answer (labelCode result code) fuel index =
      (evalFuel answer code fuel index).bind (fun b => if b then some result else none)
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing index with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    simp only [evalFuel, node_labelCode]
    cases hn : node code index with
    | inl o => cases o with
      | none => rfl
      | some b => cases b <;> rfl
    | inr qq => exact ih _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.labelCode_stageAnswer
proof:
:= by
  rw [stageAnswer_iff_evalFuel, stageAnswer_iff_evalFuel]
  have hroot : root (labelCode result code) = root code := by simp [root, labelCode]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨fuel, hf⟩
    rw [hroot, evalFuel_labelCode] at hf
    cases he : evalFuel answer code fuel (root code) with
    | none => simp [he] at hf
    | some value =>
      cases value with
      | false => simp [he] at hf
      | true => exact ⟨⟨fuel, he⟩, by simpa only [he, Option.bind_some, ↓reduceIte,
          Option.some.injEq] using hf⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨fuel, hf⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨fuel, ?_⟩
    rw [hroot, evalFuel_labelCode, hf]
    rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.certificateTree_native_correct
statement:

      Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Formula.Holds R f Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 ∧

statement:
theorem certificateStages_computable {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {transport : α → PackedQuery → Query} {results : α → ℕ → Bool}
    {formulas : α → ℕ → Code} (ht : Computable₂ transport)
    (hr : Computable₂ results) (hf : Computable₂ formulas) :
    Computable₂ (certificateStages transport results formulas)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.certificateSearch_computable
statement:
theorem certificateSearch_computable {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {transport : α → PackedQuery → Query} {results : α → ℕ → Bool}
    {formulas : α → ℕ → Code} (ht : Computable₂ transport)
    (hr : Computable₂ results) (hf : Computable₂ formulas) :
    Computable₂ (OracleReplay.step (certificateStages transport results formulas))
proof:
:=
  OracleReplay.step_computable (certificateStages_computable ht hr hf)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Trees.certificateSearch_correct
statement:
theorem certificateSearch_correct {α : Type*}
    (transport : α → PackedQuery → Query) (results : α → ℕ → Bool)
    (formulas : α → ℕ → Code) (input : α) (answer : Query → Bool) (P : Bool → Prop)
    (hcomplete : ∃ stage,
      decidePackedFormula (answer ∘ transport input) (formulas input stage) = true)
    (hsound : ∀ stage,
      decidePackedFormula (answer ∘ transport input) (formulas input stage) = true →
        P (results input stage)) :
    (∃ fuel b, run (OracleReplay.step (certificateStages transport results formulas) input)
      answer fuel [] = some b) ∧
    ∀ fuel b, run (OracleReplay.step (certificateStages transport results formulas) input)
      answer fuel [] = some b → P b
proof:
:= by
  apply OracleReplay.run_correct
    (certificateStages transport results formulas) input answer P
  · intro stage
    exact certificateTree_wellFormed _ _ _
  · obtain ⟨stage, hstage⟩ := hcomplete
    exact ⟨stage, results input stage,
      (certificateTree_stageAnswer _ _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨hstage, rfl⟩⟩
  · intro stage b hb
    obtain ⟨hformula, hresult⟩ := (certificateTree_stageAnswer _ _ _ _ _).mp hb
    rw [← hresult]
    exact hsound stage hformula

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.shiftCode_packFormulaAt
statement:
theorem shiftCode_packFormulaAt {C : RegionCode} {h v : ℕ} (f : Formula C h v)
    (offset delta : ℕ) :
    shiftCode delta (packFormulaAt offset f) = packFormulaAt (delta + offset) f
proof:
:= by
  induction f generalizing offset with
  | truth => rfl
  | falsity => rfl
  | horizontalLe a b => rfl
  | horizontalLt a b => rfl
  | verticalLe a b => rfl
  | verticalLt a b => rfl
  | conjunction p q ihp ihq =>
    have hp := compilationTrace_length_pos p
    have hq := compilationTrace_length_pos q
    simp only [packFormulaAt, shiftCode, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
    rw [show List.map (shiftInstruction delta) (packFormulaAt offset p) =
      packFormulaAt (delta + offset) p from ihp offset]
    rw [show List.map (shiftInstruction delta)
        (packFormulaAt (offset + (compilationTrace p).length) q) =
      packFormulaAt (delta + offset + (compilationTrace p).length) q by
        simpa only [shiftCode, Nat.add_assoc] using ihq (offset + (compilationTrace p).length)]
    simp only [shiftInstruction]
    dsimp
    congr <;> omega
  | disjunction p q ihp ihq =>
    have hp := compilationTrace_length_pos p
    have hq := compilationTrace_length_pos q
    simp only [packFormulaAt, shiftCode, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
    rw [show List.map (shiftInstruction delta) (packFormulaAt offset p) =
      packFormulaAt (delta + offset) p from ihp offset]
    rw [show List.map (shiftInstruction delta)
        (packFormulaAt (offset + (compilationTrace p).length) q) =
      packFormulaAt (delta + offset + (compilationTrace p).length) q by
        simpa only [shiftCode, Nat.add_assoc] using ihq (offset + (compilationTrace p).length)]
    simp only [shiftInstruction]
    dsimp
    congr <;> omega
  | negation p ih =>
    have hp := compilationTrace_length_pos p
    simp only [packFormulaAt, shiftCode, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
    rw [show List.map (shiftInstruction delta) (packFormulaAt offset p) =
      packFormulaAt (delta + offset) p from ih offset]
    simp only [shiftInstruction]
    dsimp
    congr
    omega
  | existsHorizontal p ih =>
    have hp := compilationTrace_length_pos p
    simp only [packFormulaAt, shiftCode, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
    rw [show List.map (shiftInstruction delta) (packFormulaAt offset p) =
      packFormulaAt (delta + offset) p from ih offset]
    simp only [shiftInstruction]
    dsimp
    congr
    omega
  | existsVertical p ih =>
    have hp := compilationTrace_length_pos p
    simp only [packFormulaAt, shiftCode, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
    rw [show List.map (shiftInstruction delta) (packFormulaAt offset p) =
      packFormulaAt (delta + offset) p from ih offset]
    simp only [shiftInstruction]
    dsimp
    congr
    omega

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.packFormulaAt_eq_shiftCode

proof:
:=
  ((Primrec.list_tail.to_comp).comp Computable.fst).pair Computable.snd

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.exprHead_computable
statement: private theorem exprHead_computable : Computable exprHead
proof:
:=
  (Primrec.list_getD (0 : ℚ)).to_comp.comp Computable.fst (Computable.const 0)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.atomNegate_computable_of
statement:
private theorem atomNegate_computable_of (hneg : Computable (Neg.neg : ℚ → ℚ)) :
    Computable atomNegate
proof:
:=
  (boolNot_computable.comp Computable.fst).pair
    ((exprNeg_computable_of hneg).comp Computable.snd)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.sortedNegate_computable_of
statement:
private theorem sortedNegate_computable_of (hneg : Computable (Neg.neg : ℚ → ℚ)) :
    Computable sortedNegate
proof:
:=
  Computable.fst.pair ((atomNegate_computable_of hneg).comp Computable.snd)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.dnfAnd_computable
statement: private theorem dnfAnd_computable : Computable₂ dnfAnd
proof:
:= by
  exact flatMap_computable ([] : Clause) Computable.fst
    (map_computable ([] : Clause)
      (Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst)
      ((Computable.list_append.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst)
        Computable.snd).to₂)).to₂

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.negateClause_computable_of
statement:
private theorem negateClause_computable_of (hneg : Computable (Neg.neg : ℚ → ℚ)) :
    Computable negateClause
proof:
:=
  map_computable (false, false, [], []) Computable.id
    ((Computable.list_cons.comp ((sortedNegate_computable_of hneg).comp Computable.snd)
      (Computable.const [])).to₂)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.negateDNF_computable_of
statement:
private theorem negateDNF_computable_of (hneg : Computable (Neg.neg : ℚ → ℚ)) :
    Computable negateDNF
proof:
:=
  foldl_computable ([] : Clause) Computable.id (Computable.const [[]])
    ((dnfAnd_computable.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd)
      ((negateClause_computable_of hneg).comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd))).to₂)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.combineBounds_computable_of
statement:
private theorem combineBounds_computable_of
    (hadd : Computable₂ ((· + ·) : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ))
    (hneg : Computable (Neg.neg : ℚ → ℚ))
    (hmul : Computable₂ ((· * ·) : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ)) : Computable₂ combineBounds
proof:
:= by
  have hu : Computable (fun x : Atom × Atom => x.1.2) :=
    Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst
  have hl : Computable (fun x : Atom × Atom => x.2.2) :=
    Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd
  exact (boolOr_computable.comp
      (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst) (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd)).pair
    ((exprSub_computable_of hadd hneg).comp
      ((exprScale_computable_of hmul).comp
        (exprHead_computable.comp hu) (exprTail_computable.comp hl))
      ((exprScale_computable_of hmul).comp
        (exprHead_computable.comp hl) (exprTail_computable.comp hu)))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.zeroTail_computable
statement: private theorem zeroTail_computable : Computable₂ zeroTail
proof:
:= by
  have hsort : Computable (fun x : Bool × SortedAtom => decide (x.2.1 = x.1)) :=
    (Primrec.eq.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd) Primrec.fst).decide.to_comp
  have hexpr : Computable (fun x : Bool × SortedAtom => x.2.2.2) :=
    Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)
  have hzero : Computable (fun x : Bool × SortedAtom => decide (exprHead x.2.2.2 = 0)) :=
    (Primrec.eq.decide.to_comp).comp
      (exprHead_computable.comp hexpr) (Computable.const (0 : ℚ))
  refine (Computable.cond hsort
    (Computable.cond hzero
      (Computable.option_some.comp (Computable.fst.pair
        ((Computable.fst.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)).pair
          (exprTail_computable.comp hexpr))))
      (Computable.const none))
    (Computable.option_some.comp Computable.snd)).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  by_cases hs : x.2.1 = x.1 <;> by_cases hz : exprHead x.2.2.2 = 0 <;>
    simp [zeroTail, hs, hz]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.positive_computable_of
statement:
private theorem positive_computable_of
    (hlt : Computable₂ (fun x y : ℚ => decide (x < y))) : Computable₂ positive
proof:
:= by
  have hsort : Computable (fun x : Bool × SortedAtom => decide (x.2.1 = x.1)) :=
    (Primrec.eq.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd) Primrec.fst).decide.to_comp
  have hexpr : Computable (fun x : Bool × SortedAtom => x.2.2.2) :=
    Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)
  have hpos := hlt.comp (Computable.const 0) (exprHead_computable.comp hexpr)
  refine (Computable.cond
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).to_comp.comp hsort hpos)
    (Computable.option_some.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd))
    (Computable.const none)).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  by_cases hs : x.2.1 = x.1 <;> by_cases hp : 0 < exprHead x.2.2.2 <;>
    simp [positive, hs, hp]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.negative_computable_of
statement:
private theorem negative_computable_of
    (hlt : Computable₂ (fun x y : ℚ => decide (x < y))) : Computable₂ negative
proof:
:= by
  have hsort : Computable (fun x : Bool × SortedAtom => decide (x.2.1 = x.1)) :=
    (Primrec.eq.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd) Primrec.fst).decide.to_comp
  have hexpr : Computable (fun x : Bool × SortedAtom => x.2.2.2) :=
    Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)
  have hneg := hlt.comp (exprHead_computable.comp hexpr) (Computable.const 0)
  refine (Computable.cond
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).to_comp.comp hsort hneg)
    (Computable.option_some.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd))
    (Computable.const none)).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  by_cases hs : x.2.1 = x.1 <;> by_cases hn : exprHead x.2.2.2 < 0 <;>
    simp [negative, hs, hn]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.eliminateClause_computable_of
statement:
private theorem eliminateClause_computable_of
    (hadd : Computable₂ ((· + ·) : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ))
    (hneg : Computable (Neg.neg : ℚ → ℚ))
    (hmul : Computable₂ ((· * ·) : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ))
    (hlt : Computable₂ (fun x y : ℚ => decide (x < y))) :
    Computable₂ eliminateClause
proof:
:= by
  have hfixed : Computable (fun x : Bool × Clause => x.2.filterMap (zeroTail x.1)) :=
    filterMap_computable (false, false, [], []) Computable.snd
      (zeroTail_computable.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst) Computable.snd).to₂
  have huppers : Computable (fun x : Bool × Clause => x.2.filterMap (positive x.1)) :=
    filterMap_computable (false, false, [], []) Computable.snd
      ((positive_computable_of hlt).comp
        (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst) Computable.snd).to₂
  have hlowers : Computable (fun x : Bool × Clause => x.2.filterMap (negative x.1)) :=
    filterMap_computable (false, false, [], []) Computable.snd
      ((negative_computable_of hlt).comp
        (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst) Computable.snd).to₂
  have hcombined : Computable₂ (fun x : (Bool × Clause) × Atom => fun lower : Atom =>
      (x.1.1, combineBounds x.2 lower)) :=
    (Computable.fst.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst)).pair
      ((combineBounds_computable_of hadd hneg hmul).comp
        (Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst) Computable.snd)
  exact Computable.list_append.comp hfixed
    (flatMap_computable (false, [], []) huppers
      (map_computable (false, [], []) (hlowers.comp Computable.fst) hcombined).to₂)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.eliminate_computable_of
statement:
private theorem eliminate_computable_of
    (hadd : Computable₂ ((· + ·) : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ))
    (hneg : Computable (Neg.neg : ℚ → ℚ))
    (hmul : Computable₂ ((· * ·) : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ))
    (hlt : Computable₂ (fun x y : ℚ => decide (x < y))) : Computable₂ eliminate
proof:
:=
  map_computable ([] : Clause) Computable.snd
    ((eliminateClause_computable_of hadd hneg hmul hlt).comp
      (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst) Computable.snd).to₂

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.chooseTag_computable
statement:
private theorem chooseTag_computable {α σ : Type*} [Primcodable α] [Primcodable σ]
    {tag : α → ℕ} {yes no : α → σ} (value : ℕ)
    (htag : Computable tag) (hyes : Computable yes) (hno : Computable no) :
    Computable (fun x => if tag x = value then yes x else no x)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Computable.cond
    (Primrec.eq.decide.to_comp.comp htag (Computable.const value)) hyes hno).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  by_cases h : tag x = value <;> simp [h]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.instruction_computable_of
statement:
private theorem instruction_computable_of
    (hadd : Computable₂ ((· + ·) : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ))
    (hneg : Computable (Neg.neg : ℚ → ℚ))
    (hmul : Computable₂ ((· * ·) : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ))
    (hlt : Computable₂ (fun x y : ℚ => decide (x < y))) : Computable₂ instruction
proof:
:= by
  have htag : Computable (fun x : List DNF × Instruction => x.2.1) :=
    Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd
  have hleft : Computable (fun x : List DNF × Instruction => x.1.getD x.2.2.2.1 []) :=
    (Primrec.list_getD ([] : DNF)).to_comp.comp Computable.fst
      (Computable.fst.comp (Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)))
  have hright : Computable (fun x : List DNF × Instruction => x.1.getD x.2.2.2.2 []) :=
    (Primrec.list_getD ([] : DNF)).to_comp.comp Computable.fst
      (Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)))
  have hatom : Computable (fun x : List DNF × Instruction => [[x.2.2.1]]) :=
    Computable.list_cons.comp
      (Computable.list_cons.comp
        (Computable.fst.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)) (Computable.const []))
      (Computable.const [])
  exact chooseTag_computable 0 htag (Computable.const [[]])
    (chooseTag_computable 1 htag (Computable.const [])
    (chooseTag_computable 2 htag hatom
    (chooseTag_computable 3 htag (dnfAnd_computable.comp hleft hright)
    (chooseTag_computable 4 htag (Computable.list_append.comp hleft hright)
    (chooseTag_computable 5 htag ((negateDNF_computable_of hneg).comp hleft)
    (chooseTag_computable 6 htag
      ((eliminate_computable_of hadd hneg hmul hlt).comp (Computable.const false) hleft)
    (chooseTag_computable 7 htag
      ((eliminate_computable_of hadd hneg hmul hlt).comp (Computable.const true) hleft)
      (Computable.const []))))))))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.exprAdd_computable
statement: theorem exprAdd_computable : Computable₂ exprAdd
proof:
:=

:=

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.exprScale_computable

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.instruction_computable

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.compileInto_computable
statement: theorem compileInto_computable : Computable₂ compileInto
proof:
:=
  foldl_computable (0, (false, false, [], []), 0, 0) Computable.snd Computable.fst
    ((Computable.list_concat.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd)
      (instruction_computable.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd)
        (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd))).to₂)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.compile_computable
statement: theorem compile_computable : Computable compile
proof:
:= by
  have hresults : Computable (fun code : Code => compileInto [] code) :=
    compileInto_computable.comp (Computable.const []) Computable.id
  refine (Computable.option_getD
    (Computable.list_getElem?.comp hresults
      (Primrec.nat_sub.to_comp.comp (Computable.list_length.comp hresults) (Computable.const 1)))
    (Computable.const [])).of_eq ?_
  intro code
  rw [compile, List.getLast?_eq_getElem?]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.compilationTrace_ends
statement:
private theorem compilationTrace_ends {C : RegionCode} {h v : ℕ} (f : Formula C h v) :
    ∃ initial, compilationTrace f = initial ++ [packDNF (AffineCompiler.compile f)]
proof:
:= by
  cases f <;> first | exact ⟨[], rfl⟩ | exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.compilationTrace_length_pos
statement:
theorem compilationTrace_length_pos {C : RegionCode} {h v : ℕ} (f : Formula C h v) :
    0 < (compilationTrace f).length
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨initial, h⟩ := compilationTrace_ends f
  rw [h]
  simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.packFormulaAt_length
statement:
theorem packFormulaAt_length {C : RegionCode} {h v : ℕ} (f : Formula C h v) (offset : ℕ) :
    (packFormulaAt offset f).length = (compilationTrace f).length
proof:
:= by
  induction f generalizing offset <;> simp [packFormulaAt, compilationTrace, *]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.packFormula_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem packFormula_length {C : RegionCode} {h v : ℕ} (f : Formula C h v) :
    (packFormula f).length = (compilationTrace f).length
proof: := packFormulaAt_length f 0

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.getD_middle
statement:
private theorem getD_middle (initial ending : List DNF) (value : DNF) :
    (initial ++ [value] ++ ending).getD initial.length [] = value
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.append_assoc, List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ (by rfl)]
  simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.compilationTrace_getD
statement:
private theorem compilationTrace_getD {C : RegionCode} {h v : ℕ} (f : Formula C h v)
    (initial ending : List DNF) :
    (initial ++ compilationTrace f ++ ending).getD
      (initial.length + (compilationTrace f).length - 1) [] =
        packDNF (AffineCompiler.compile f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨initial', htrace⟩ := compilationTrace_ends f
  rw [htrace]
  have hindex : initial.length + (initial' ++ [packDNF (AffineCompiler.compile f)]).length - 1 =
      (initial ++ initial').length := by simp
  rw [hindex]
  simpa only [List.append_assoc] using
    getD_middle (initial ++ initial') ending (packDNF (AffineCompiler.compile f))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.compileInto_append
statement:
private theorem compileInto_append (initial : List DNF) (left right : Code) :
    compileInto initial (left ++ right) = compileInto (compileInto initial left) right
proof:
:= by
  exact List.foldl_append

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.compileInto_packFormula
statement:
theorem compileInto_packFormula {C : RegionCode} {h v : ℕ} (f : Formula C h v)
    (initial : List DNF) :
    compileInto initial (packFormulaAt initial.length f) = initial ++ compilationTrace f
proof:
:= by
  induction f generalizing initial with
  | truth => simp [packFormulaAt, compileInto, compilationTrace, instruction, packDNF,
      AffineCompiler.compile, AffineCompiler.dnfTrue]
  | falsity => simp [packFormulaAt, compileInto, compilationTrace, instruction, packDNF,
      AffineCompiler.compile, AffineCompiler.dnfFalse]
  | horizontalLe a b => simp [packFormulaAt, compileInto, compilationTrace, instruction,
      packDNF, packSorted, AffineCompiler.compile, AffineCompiler.dnfAtom]
  | horizontalLt a b => simp [packFormulaAt, compileInto, compilationTrace, instruction,
      packDNF, packSorted, AffineCompiler.compile, AffineCompiler.dnfAtom]
  | verticalLe a b => simp [packFormulaAt, compileInto, compilationTrace, instruction,
      packDNF, packSorted, AffineCompiler.compile, AffineCompiler.dnfAtom]
  | verticalLt a b => simp [packFormulaAt, compileInto, compilationTrace, instruction,
      packDNF, packSorted, AffineCompiler.compile, AffineCompiler.dnfAtom]
  | conjunction p q ihp ihq =>
    rw [packFormulaAt, compileInto_append, compileInto_append, ihp]
    rw [show initial.length + (compilationTrace p).length =
      (initial ++ compilationTrace p).length by simp, ihq]
    simp only [compileInto, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, instruction,
      show (3 : ℕ) ≠ 0 by decide, show (3 : ℕ) ≠ 1 by decide,
      show (3 : ℕ) ≠ 2 by decide, ↓reduceIte]
    simp only [List.length_append]
    rw [compilationTrace_getD p initial (compilationTrace q)]
    have hright := compilationTrace_getD q (initial ++ compilationTrace p) []
    simp only [List.length_append, List.append_nil] at hright
    rw [hright]
    simp only [packDNF_and, compilationTrace, AffineCompiler.compile, List.append_assoc]
  | disjunction p q ihp ihq =>
    rw [packFormulaAt, compileInto_append, compileInto_append, ihp]
    rw [show initial.length + (compilationTrace p).length =
      (initial ++ compilationTrace p).length by simp, ihq]
    simp only [compileInto, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, instruction,
      show (4 : ℕ) ≠ 0 by decide, show (4 : ℕ) ≠ 1 by decide,
      show (4 : ℕ) ≠ 2 by decide, show (4 : ℕ) ≠ 3 by decide, ↓reduceIte]
    simp only [List.length_append]
    rw [compilationTrace_getD p initial (compilationTrace q)]
    have hright := compilationTrace_getD q (initial ++ compilationTrace p) []
    simp only [List.length_append, List.append_nil] at hright
    rw [hright]
    simp only [packDNF_or, compilationTrace, AffineCompiler.compile, List.append_assoc]
  | negation p ih =>
    rw [packFormulaAt, compileInto_append, ih]
    simp only [compileInto, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, instruction,
      show (5 : ℕ) ≠ 0 by decide, show (5 : ℕ) ≠ 1 by decide,
      show (5 : ℕ) ≠ 2 by decide, show (5 : ℕ) ≠ 3 by decide,
      show (5 : ℕ) ≠ 4 by decide, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [show (initial ++ compilationTrace p).getD
        (initial.length + (compilationTrace p).length - 1) [] =
      packDNF (AffineCompiler.compile p) by
        simpa using compilationTrace_getD p initial []]
    simp only [pack_negateDNF, compilationTrace, AffineCompiler.compile, List.append_assoc]
  | existsHorizontal p ih =>
    rw [packFormulaAt, compileInto_append, ih]
    simp only [compileInto, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, instruction,
      show (6 : ℕ) ≠ 0 by decide, show (6 : ℕ) ≠ 1 by decide,
      show (6 : ℕ) ≠ 2 by decide, show (6 : ℕ) ≠ 3 by decide,
      show (6 : ℕ) ≠ 4 by decide, show (6 : ℕ) ≠ 5 by decide, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [show (initial ++ compilationTrace p).getD
        (initial.length + (compilationTrace p).length - 1) [] =
      packDNF (AffineCompiler.compile p) by
        simpa using compilationTrace_getD p initial []]
    simp only [pack_eliminate_horizontal, compilationTrace, AffineCompiler.compile,
      List.append_assoc]
  | existsVertical p ih =>
    rw [packFormulaAt, compileInto_append, ih]
    simp only [compileInto, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, instruction,
      show (7 : ℕ) ≠ 0 by decide, show (7 : ℕ) ≠ 1 by decide,
      show (7 : ℕ) ≠ 2 by decide, show (7 : ℕ) ≠ 3 by decide,
      show (7 : ℕ) ≠ 4 by decide, show (7 : ℕ) ≠ 5 by decide,
      show (7 : ℕ) ≠ 6 by decide, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [show (initial ++ compilationTrace p).getD
        (initial.length + (compilationTrace p).length - 1) [] =
      packDNF (AffineCompiler.compile p) by
        simpa using compilationTrace_getD p initial []]
    simp only [pack_eliminate_vertical, compilationTrace, AffineCompiler.compile,
      List.append_assoc]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.compile_packFormula
statement:
theorem compile_packFormula {C : RegionCode} {h v : ℕ} (f : Formula C h v) :
    compile (packFormula f) = packDNF (AffineCompiler.compile f)
proof:
:= by
  have h := compileInto_packFormula f []
  obtain ⟨initial, htrace⟩ := compilationTrace_ends f
  simp only [List.length_nil, List.nil_append] at h
  rw [compile, packFormula, h, htrace]
  simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.commonDenominator_computable
statement: theorem commonDenominator_computable : Computable commonDenominator
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Computable (fun constants : List ℚ => constants.map Rat.den) :=
    Tiling.Computability.List.map_computable (0 : ℚ) Computable.id
      (rat_den_computable.comp Computable.snd).to₂
  have hp : Computable (fun xs : List ℕ => xs.prod) := by
    refine (Tiling.Computability.List.foldl_computable 0 Computable.id (Computable.const 1)
      (Primrec.nat_mul.to_comp.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd)
        (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)).to₂).of_eq ?_
    intro xs
    have hgeneral : ∀ (xs : List ℕ) (initial : ℕ),
        xs.foldl (fun acc x => acc * x) initial = initial * xs.prod := by
      intro xs
      induction xs with
      | nil => intro initial; simp
      | cons x rest ih => intro initial; simp [List.foldl_cons, ih, Nat.mul_assoc]
    simpa using hgeneral xs 1
  exact hp.comp hm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.clearCoefficients_computable
statement: theorem clearCoefficients_computable : Computable clearCoefficients
proof:
:=
  Tiling.Computability.List.map_computable (0 : ℚ) Computable.id
    (rat_num_computable.comp
      (rat_mul_computable.comp
        (nat_rat_computable.comp
          (commonDenominator_computable.comp Computable.fst)) Computable.snd)).to₂

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.replicate_primrec
statement: private theorem replicate_primrec : Primrec₂ (fun n : ℕ => fun x : ℤ => List.replicate n x)
proof:
:= by
  have hrec : Primrec₂ (fun x : ℤ => fun n : ℕ =>
      Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => List ℤ) [] (fun _ xs => x :: xs) n) :=
    Primrec.nat_rec (Primrec.const [])
      (Primrec.list_cons.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂
  refine (hrec.comp Primrec.snd Primrec.fst).of_eq ?_
  rintro ⟨n, x⟩
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp [List.replicate, ih]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.atomQuery_computable
statement: theorem atomQuery_computable : Computable atomQuery
proof:
:= by
  have hconstants : Computable (fun a : SortedAtom => a.2.2.2) :=
    Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)
  have hclear := clearCoefficients_computable.comp hconstants
  have hzeros := replicate_primrec.to_comp.comp
    (Computable.list_length.comp hconstants) (Computable.const 0)
  refine (Computable.cond (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd)
    (Computable.fst.pair (hzeros.pair hclear))
    (Computable.fst.pair (hclear.pair hzeros))).of_eq ?_
  intro a
  cases h : a.2.1 <;> simp only [atomQuery, h, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] <;> rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.unpackQuery_packQuery

proof:

  | mk sort lhs rhs =>
    cases sort <;> simp [unpackQuery, packQuery]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.commonDenominator_packExpr
proof:
:= by

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.clearCoefficients_packExpr
proof:
:= by
  change (List.ofFn e.constant).map _ = _
  rw [commonDenominator_packExpr]
  rw [List.map_ofFn]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.evalAtom_pack
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalAtom_pack {C : RegionCode} (O : Oracle C)
    (answer : PackedQuery → Bool) (hanswer : ∀ q, answer (packQuery q) = O.answer q)
    (s : CoordSort) (a : AffineCompiler.Atom C 0) :
    evalAtom answer (decide (s = .vertical), packAtom a) =
      AffineCompiler.evalClosedAtom O s a
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨comparison, e⟩
  have hz : List.ofFn (Coeff.zero C) = List.replicate C.vertexCount 0 := by
    change List.ofFn (fun _ : Fin C.vertexCount => (0 : ℤ)) = _
    simp
  cases comparison
  · have hquery : atomQuery (decide (s = .vertical), packAtom ⟨.weak, e⟩) =
        packQuery (AffineCompiler.closedAtomQuery s ⟨.weak, e⟩) := by
      simp [atomQuery, packAtom, packExpr, packQuery, AffineCompiler.closedAtomQuery,
        hz, ← clearCoefficients_packExpr e]
      rfl
    change answer (atomQuery (decide (s = .vertical), packAtom ⟨.weak, e⟩)) = _
    rw [hquery, hanswer]
    rfl
  · have hquery : atomQuery (decide (s = .vertical), packAtom ⟨.strict, e⟩) =
        packQuery ⟨s, Coeff.zero C, AffineCompiler.clearInput e⟩ := by
      simp [atomQuery, packAtom, packExpr, packQuery, hz,
        ← clearCoefficients_packExpr e]
    change Bool.not (answer (atomQuery (decide (s = .vertical), packAtom ⟨.strict, e⟩))) =
      Bool.not (O.answer ⟨s, Coeff.zero C, AffineCompiler.clearInput e⟩)
    rw [hquery, hanswer]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.evalDNF_pack
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalDNF_pack {C : RegionCode} (O : Oracle C)
    (answer : PackedQuery → Bool) (hanswer : ∀ q, answer (packQuery q) = O.answer q)
    (p : AffineCompiler.DNF C 0 0) :
    evalDNF answer (packDNF p) = AffineCompiler.evalClosedDNF O p
proof:
:= by
  have ha : ∀ a : AffineCompiler.SortedAtom C 0 0,
      evalAtom answer (packSorted a) = AffineCompiler.evalClosedSortedAtom O a := by
    intro a
    cases a with
    | horizontal a =>
      simpa [packSorted, AffineCompiler.evalClosedSortedAtom] using
        (evalAtom_pack O answer hanswer .horizontal a)
    | vertical a =>
      simpa [packSorted, AffineCompiler.evalClosedSortedAtom] using
        (evalAtom_pack O answer hanswer .vertical a)
  have hc : ∀ clause : AffineCompiler.Clause C 0 0,
      (clause.map packSorted).all (evalAtom answer) =
        AffineCompiler.evalClosedClause O clause := by
    intro clause
    simp only [List.all_map, AffineCompiler.evalClosedClause]
    congr 1
    funext a
    exact ha a
  simp only [evalDNF, packDNF, List.any_map, AffineCompiler.evalClosedDNF]
  congr 1
  funext clause
  exact hc clause

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.decidePackedFormula_eq_decideFormula
statement:
theorem decidePackedFormula_eq_decideFormula {C : RegionCode} (O : Oracle C)
    (answer : PackedQuery → Bool) (hanswer : ∀ q, answer (packQuery q) = O.answer q)
    (f : Formula C 0 0) :
    decidePackedFormula answer (packFormula f) = AffineCompiler.decideFormula O f
proof:
:= by
  rw [decidePackedFormula, compile_packFormula, evalDNF_pack O answer hanswer]
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.decidePackedFormula_correct
statement:
theorem decidePackedFormula_correct {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C)
    (O : CorrectOracle C R) (answer : PackedQuery → Bool)
    (hanswer : ∀ q, answer (packQuery q) = O.toOracle.answer q) (f : Formula C 0 0) :
    decidePackedFormula answer (packFormula f) = true ↔
      Formula.Holds R f (Fin.elim0) (Fin.elim0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [decidePackedFormula_eq_decideFormula O.toOracle answer hanswer]
  exact AffineCompiler.decideFormula_correct R O f

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.decidePackedFormula_native
statement:
theorem decidePackedFormula_native {C : RegionCode} (O : Oracle C) (f : Formula C 0 0) :
    decidePackedFormula (fun q => O.answer (unpackQuery C q)) (packFormula f) =
      AffineCompiler.decideFormula O f
proof:
:= by
  apply decidePackedFormula_eq_decideFormula
  intro q
  rw [unpackQuery_packQuery]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Affine.Native.decidePackedFormula_native_correct
statement:
theorem decidePackedFormula_native_correct {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C)
    (O : CorrectOracle C R) (f : Formula C 0 0) :
    decidePackedFormula (fun q => O.toOracle.answer (unpackQuery C q)) (packFormula f) = true ↔
      Formula.Holds R f Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0
proof:
:= by
  rw [decidePackedFormula_native]
  exact AffineCompiler.decideFormula_correct R O f

theorem withPrefixes_computable {body : RuntimeInput → List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query}
    (hb : Computable₂ body) : Computable₂ (withPrefixes body)
proof:
:= by

      (fun input boundHistory history => body (input, boundHistory) history)) :=
    OraclePrefix.prefixProgram_computable boundSchedule_computable
      (hb.comp (Computable.fst.pair (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd))
        (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleDecision.run_withPrefixes
statement:
theorem run_withPrefixes (body : RuntimeInput → List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query)
    (count : ℕ) (answer : Query → Bool) (fuel : ℕ) :
    run (withPrefixes body count) answer
      ((gridSchedule count).length +
        (boundSchedule (oracleInput count answer).1).length + fuel) [] =
      run (body (oracleInput count answer)) answer fuel []
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.add_assoc]
  rw [withPrefixes, OraclePrefix.run_from_empty_after_schedule]
  change run (OraclePrefix.prefixProgram boundSchedule
    (fun input boundHistory history => body (input, boundHistory) history)
    (count, comparisonHistory (2 * count) answer)) answer
    ((boundSchedule (count, comparisonHistory (2 * count) answer)).length + fuel) [] = _
  rw [OraclePrefix.run_from_empty_after_schedule]
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleDecision.run_withPrefixes_answer
statement:
theorem run_withPrefixes_answer (body : RuntimeInput → List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query)
    (count : ℕ) (answer : Query → Bool) (fuel : ℕ) (b : Bool)
    (h : run (withPrefixes body count) answer fuel [] = some b) :
    ∃ bodyFuel, run (body (oracleInput count answer)) answer bodyFuel [] = some b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gridFuel, hgrid⟩ := OraclePrefix.run_answer_after_schedule
    gridSchedule (afterGrid body) count answer fuel b h
  exact OraclePrefix.run_answer_after_schedule boundSchedule
    (fun input boundHistory history => body (input, boundHistory) history)
    (count, comparisonHistory (2 * count) answer) answer gridFuel b hgrid

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleDecision.withPrefixes_correct
statement:
theorem withPrefixes_correct (body : RuntimeInput → List Bool → Bool ⊕ Query)
    (count : ℕ) (answer : Query → Bool) (P : Bool → Prop)
    (hc : ∃ fuel b, run (body (oracleInput count answer)) answer fuel [] = some b)
    (hs : ∀ fuel b, run (body (oracleInput count answer)) answer fuel [] = some b → P b) :
    (∃ fuel b, run (withPrefixes body count) answer fuel [] = some b) ∧
      ∀ fuel b, run (withPrefixes body count) answer fuel [] = some b → P b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨fuel, b, hf⟩ := hc
    exact ⟨_, b, (run_withPrefixes body count answer fuel).trans hf⟩
  · intro fuel b hf
    obtain ⟨bodyFuel, hb⟩ := run_withPrefixes_answer body count answer fuel b hf
    exact hs bodyFuel b hb

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleDecision.optionalNegative_computable
statement:
private theorem optionalNegative_computable {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {negative : NegativeProducer} {region : α → CertificateFormulas.RegionInput}
    {bounds : α → Option LocalBound.Bounds} {stage : α → ℕ}
    (hn : Computable (fun x : CertificateFormulas.RegionInput ×
      LocalBound.Bounds × ℕ => negative x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2))
    (hr : Computable region) (hb : Computable bounds) (hs : Computable stage) :
    Computable (fun x => match bounds x with
      | none => CertificateFormulas.falsity
      | some b => negative (region x) b (stage x))
proof:
:= by
  have hsome : Computable₂ (fun x : α => fun b : LocalBound.Bounds =>
      negative (region x) b (stage x)) :=
    hn.comp ((hr.comp Computable.fst).pair (Computable.snd.pair (hs.comp Computable.fst)))
  refine (Computable.option_casesOn hb
    (Computable.const CertificateFormulas.falsity) hsome).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  cases bounds x <;> rfl

proof:
