name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleDecision.stageFormula_computable
statement:
theorem stageFormula_computable {positive : PositiveProducer} {negative : NegativeProducer}
    (hp : Computable₂ positive)
    (hn : Computable (fun x : CertificateFormulas.RegionInput ×
      LocalBound.Bounds × ℕ => negative x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)) :
    Computable₂ (stageFormula positive negative)
proof:
:= by
  have hindex : Computable (fun x : RuntimeInput × ℕ => x.2 / 2) :=
    Primrec.nat_div.to_comp.comp Computable.snd (Computable.const 2)
  have hpositive := hp.comp
    (formulaRegion_computable.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst)) hindex
  have hnegative := (negativeAt_computable hn).comp Computable.fst hindex
  refine (Computable.cond stageResult_computable hpositive hnegative).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  cases hs : stageResult x.1 x.2 <;> simp only [stageFormula, hs, Bool.false_eq_true,
    ↓reduceIte] <;> rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleDecision.decisionProgram_computable
statement:
theorem decisionProgram_computable {positive : PositiveProducer} {negative : NegativeProducer}
    (hp : Computable₂ positive)
    (hn : Computable (fun x : CertificateFormulas.RegionInput ×
      LocalBound.Bounds × ℕ => negative x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)) :
    Computable₂ (decisionProgram positive negative)
proof:
:=
  withPrefixes_computable (certificateSearch_computable runtimeTransport_computable
    stageResult_computable (stageFormula_computable hp hn))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleDecision.decisionProgram_correct
statement:
theorem decisionProgram_correct (positive : PositiveProducer) (negative : NegativeProducer)
    (count : ℕ) (answer : Query → Bool) (Q : Prop)
    (hps : ∀ stage, positiveValue positive count answer stage = true → Q)
    (hns : ∀ stage, negativeValue negative count answer stage = true → ¬Q)
    (hpc : Q → ∃ stage, positiveValue positive count answer stage = true)
    (hnc : ¬Q → ∃ stage, negativeValue negative count answer stage = true) :
    (∃ fuel b, run (decisionProgram positive negative count) answer fuel [] = some b) ∧
      ∀ fuel b, run (decisionProgram positive negative count) answer fuel [] = some b →
        (b = true ↔ Q)
proof:
:= by
  apply withPrefixes_correct (searchBody positive negative) count answer (fun b => b = true ↔ Q)
  · apply (certificateSearch_correct runtimeTransport stageResult
      (stageFormula positive negative) (oracleInput count answer) answer
      (fun b => b = true ↔ Q) ?_ ?_).1
    · by_cases hQ : Q
      · obtain ⟨stage, hs⟩ := hpc hQ
        refine ⟨2 * stage, ?_⟩
        simpa [stageFormula, stageResult, positiveValue] using hs
      · obtain ⟨stage, hs⟩ := hnc hQ
        refine ⟨2 * stage + 1, ?_⟩
        have hdiv : (2 * stage + 1) / 2 = stage := by omega
        simpa [stageFormula, stageResult, negativeValue, hdiv] using hs
    · intro stage hs
      by_cases he : stage % 2 = 0
      · have hQ := hps (stage / 2) (by
          simpa [stageFormula, stageResult, he, positiveValue] using hs)
        simp [stageResult, he, hQ]
      · have hQ := hns (stage / 2) (by
          simpa [stageFormula, stageResult, he, negativeValue] using hs)
        simp [stageResult, he, hQ]
  · intro fuel b hf
    obtain ⟨stage, hstage⟩ := OracleReplay.run_answer_from_stage
      (certificateStages runtimeTransport stageResult (stageFormula positive negative))
      (oracleInput count answer) answer fuel b hf
    obtain ⟨hformula, hresult⟩ := (certificateTree_stageAnswer _ _ _ _ _).mp hstage
    rw [← hresult]
    by_cases he : stage % 2 = 0
    · have hQ := hps (stage / 2) (by
        simpa [stageFormula, stageResult, he, positiveValue] using hformula)
      simp [stageResult, he, hQ]
    · have hQ := hns (stage / 2) (by
        simpa [stageFormula, stageResult, he, negativeValue] using hformula)
      simp [stageResult, he, hQ]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleDecision.positiveValue_eq_native
proof:
:= by
  let input : TableInput := (R.length, comparisonHistory (2 * R.length) answer)
  have hgrid : TableCorrect (cornerList R) input.2 := comparisonHistory_rectangles_correct hanswer
  have hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels input).length := vertexLabels_nonempty hR hgrid
  let C := inputCode input hinput
  let ON := oracle hR hgrid hinput hanswer
  have hquery : ∀ q, (answer ∘ transport input) (Native.packQuery q) = ON.toOracle.answer q := by
    intro q
    rw [Function.comp_apply, transport_packQuery]
    rfl
  change decidePackedFormula (answer ∘ transport input)
    (CertificateFormulas.positiveFormula (formulaRegion input) stage) =
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.positiveStage C ON.toOracle stage
  rw [formulaRegion_eq_encodeRegion input hinput]
  cases hc : wellFormedPositiveStage stage with
  | none =>
    rw [CertificateFormulas.Native.positiveFormula_none _ stage hc]
    simp only [Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.positiveStage,
      PositiveVerification.verifyPositiveStage, hc]
    rfl
  | some c =>
    have hw : c.wellFormed = true := (Option.filter_eq_some_iff.mp hc).2
    rw [CertificateFormulas.Native.positiveFormula_eq_pack C stage c hc,
      Native.decidePackedFormula_eq_decideFormula ON.toOracle (answer ∘ transport input) hquery]
    simp only [Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.positiveStage,
      PositiveVerification.verifyPositiveStage, hc, PositiveVerification.verifyPositive,
      hw, Bool.true_and]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleDecision.negativeValue_eq_native
proof:
:= by
  let input : TableInput := (R.length, comparisonHistory (2 * R.length) answer)
  have hgrid : TableCorrect (cornerList R) input.2 := comparisonHistory_rectangles_correct hanswer
  have hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels input).length := vertexLabels_nonempty hR hgrid
  let C := inputCode input hinput
  let RN := realization hR hgrid hinput
  let ON := oracle hR hgrid hinput hanswer
  have hc : 0 < C.cellCount := by
    simpa only [C, inputCode, regionCode, packedRegion, List.length_map] using
      coarseCells_nonempty hR hgrid
  have hex : ∃ B : LocalCoverSearch.LocalBoundCode C,
      LocalCoverSearch.buildLocalBound C ON.toOracle = some B := by
    simp only [LocalCoverSearch.buildLocalBound, dif_pos hc]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hex
  have hbounds : runtimeBounds (oracleInput R.length answer) =
      some (NegativeFormulas.Native.encodeBound B) := by
    change LocalBound.build (packedRegion input)
      (LocalBound.history (packedRegion input) answer) = _
    rw [LocalBound.build_eq_native hR hgrid hinput hanswer, hB]
    rfl
  change decidePackedFormula (answer ∘ transport input)
    (negativeAt NegativeFormulas.negativeFormula (oracleInput R.length answer) stage) =
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.negativeStage C ON.toOracle stage
  rw [negativeAt, hbounds]
  change decidePackedFormula (answer ∘ transport input)
    (NegativeFormulas.negativeFormula (formulaRegion input)
      (NegativeFormulas.Native.encodeBound B) stage) = _
  rw [formulaRegion_eq_encodeRegion input hinput,
    NegativeFormulas.Native.negativeFormula_eq_pack C B stage]
  have hquery : ∀ q, (answer ∘ transport input) (Native.packQuery q) = ON.toOracle.answer q := by
    intro q
    rw [Function.comp_apply, transport_packQuery]
    rfl
  rw [Native.decidePackedFormula_eq_decideFormula ON.toOracle (answer ∘ transport input) hquery]
  exact NegativeFormulas.Native.stageFormula_correct RN ON B stage hB

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleDecision.normalizedRegion_eq_encodeRegion
statement:
theorem normalizedRegion_eq_encodeRegion (P : PackedRegion) (hP : 0 < P.1.length) :
    normalizedRegion P = CertificateFormulas.Native.encodeRegion (regionCode P hP)
proof:
:= by
  change (P.1.length, P.2.map (normalizeCell P.1.length)) =
    (P.1.length, List.ofFn (fun i : Fin P.2.length =>
      normalizeCell P.1.length (P.2.getD i (0, 0))))
  congr 1
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intro i hi hj
    simp only [List.getElem_map, List.getElem_ofFn]
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem P.2 (0, 0) (by simpa only [List.length_map] using hi)]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleDecision.certificateTree_correct
statement:
theorem certificateTree_correct {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {history : List Bool} {answer : Query → Bool}
    (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω) (htable : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history)
    (hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels (R.length, history)).length)
    (hanswer : CorrectOracle (cornerList R) answer)
    (f : Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Formula (inputCode (R.length, history) hinput) 0 0)
    (result b : Bool) :
    OracleReplay.StageAnswer answer
      (Affine.Trees.certificateTree (transport (R.length, history)) result
        (Affine.Native.packFormula f)) b ↔
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.Executable.Formula.Holds (realization hR htable hinput)
        f Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 ∧ result = b
proof:
:= by
  apply Affine.Trees.certificateTree_native_correct
    (realization hR htable hinput) (oracle hR htable hinput hanswer)
  intro q
  rw [transport_packQuery]
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.OracleDecision.decisionProgram_correct_of_native
statement:
theorem decisionProgram_correct_of_native (positive : PositiveProducer)
    (negative : NegativeProducer) {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {answer : Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Query → Bool}
    (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (hanswer : Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CorrectOracle (cornerList R) answer)
    (hp : ∀ stage, positiveValue positive R.length answer stage =
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.positiveStage _ (frontendOracle hR hanswer).toOracle stage)
    (hn : ∀ stage, negativeValue negative R.length answer stage =
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.negativeStage _ (frontendOracle hR hanswer).toOracle stage) :
    (∃ fuel b, run (decisionProgram positive negative R.length) answer fuel [] = some b) ∧
      ∀ fuel b, run (decisionProgram positive negative R.length) answer fuel [] = some b →
        (b = true ↔ ∃ T, Tiles Ω T)
proof:
:= by
  let RN := realizationOfOracle hR hanswer
  let ON := frontendOracle hR hanswer
  have ht : PositiveVerification.realizationPlaneTileable RN ↔ ∃ T, Tiles Ω T :=
    realizationOfOracle_tileable_iff hR hanswer
  apply decisionProgram_correct positive negative R.length answer (∃ T, Tiles Ω T)
  · intro stage hs
    apply ht.mp
    apply PositiveVerification.verifyPositiveStage_sound RN ON stage
    exact (hp stage).symm.trans hs
  · intro stage hs htile
    apply Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.negativeStage_sound RN ON stage
      ((hn stage).symm.trans hs)
    exact ht.mpr htile
  · intro htile
    obtain ⟨stage, hs⟩ :=
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.PositiveCertificateCompleteness.positiveStage_complete
        RN ON (ht.mpr htile)
    exact ⟨stage, (hp stage).trans hs⟩
  · intro hnotile
    obtain ⟨stage, hs⟩ := Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.negativeStage_complete RN ON
      (fun htile => hnotile (ht.mp htile))
    exact ⟨stage, (hn stage).trans hs⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.Validity.rectangleUnion_cons
statement:
private theorem rectangleUnion_cons (r : Plane × Plane) (R : List (Plane × Plane)) :
    rectangleUnion (r :: R) = rectangle r.1 r.2 ∪ rectangleUnion R
proof:
:= by
  simp [rectangleUnion]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.Validity.rectangle_isClosed
statement: private theorem rectangle_isClosed (a b : Plane) : IsClosed (rectangle a b)
proof:
:=
  (isClosed_Icc.preimage Complex.continuous_re).inter
    (isClosed_Icc.preimage Complex.continuous_im)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.Validity.rectangleUnion_isClosed
statement:
private theorem rectangleUnion_isClosed (R : List (Plane × Plane)) :
    IsClosed (rectangleUnion R)
proof:
:= by
  induction R with
  | nil => simp [rectangleUnion]
  | cons r R ih => rw [rectangleUnion_cons]; exact (rectangle_isClosed r.1 r.2).union ih

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.Validity.interior_rectangle_nonempty
statement:
theorem interior_rectangle_nonempty (a b : Plane) :
    (interior (rectangle a b)).Nonempty ↔ p₁ a < p₁ b ∧ p₂ a < p₂ b
proof:
:= by
  change (interior (Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.box
    (a.re, b.re) (a.im, b.im))).Nonempty ↔ _
  rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.interior_box]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    exact ⟨hz.1.1.trans hz.1.2, hz.2.1.trans hz.2.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hax, hxb⟩ := exists_between hx
    obtain ⟨y, hay, hyb⟩ := exists_between hy
    exact ⟨⟨x, y⟩, ⟨hax, hxb⟩, hay, hyb⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.Validity.interior_rectangles_nonempty
statement:
theorem interior_rectangles_nonempty (R : List (Plane × Plane)) :
    (interior (⋃ r ∈ R, rectangle r.1 r.2)).Nonempty ↔
      ∃ r ∈ R, p₁ r.1 < p₁ r.2 ∧ p₂ r.1 < p₂ r.2
proof:
:= by
  change (interior (rectangleUnion R)).Nonempty ↔ _
  induction R with
  | nil => simp [rectangleUnion]
  | cons r R ih =>
      rw [rectangleUnion_cons]
      by_cases hr : (interior (rectangle r.1 r.2)).Nonempty
      · have hleft : (interior (rectangle r.1 r.2 ∪ rectangleUnion R)).Nonempty :=
          hr.mono (interior_mono subset_union_left)
        have hright : ∃ s ∈ r :: R, p₁ s.1 < p₁ s.2 ∧ p₂ s.1 < p₂ s.2 :=
          ⟨r, List.mem_cons_self, (interior_rectangle_nonempty r.1 r.2).mp hr⟩
        exact iff_of_true hleft hright
      · have he : interior (rectangle r.1 r.2) = ∅ := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hr
        rw [union_comm, interior_union_isClosed_of_interior_empty
          (rectangleUnion_isClosed R) he, ih]
        have hn : ¬(p₁ r.1 < p₁ r.2 ∧ p₂ r.1 < p₂ r.2) :=
          mt (interior_rectangle_nonempty r.1 r.2).mpr hr
        simp only [List.mem_cons, exists_eq_or_imp, hn, false_or]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.Validity.properRectangle_correct
statement:
theorem properRectangle_correct {answer : Query → Bool} {R : List (Plane × Plane)}
    (hanswer : CorrectOracle (cornerList R) answer)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k < R.length) :
    properRectangle answer k = true ↔
      p₁ (R.getD k (0, 0)).1 < p₁ (R.getD k (0, 0)).2 ∧
      p₂ (R.getD k (0, 0)).1 < p₂ (R.getD k (0, 0)).2
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [CorrectOracle] at hanswer
  simp only [properRectangle, Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true_eq_eq_false,
    Bool.eq_false_iff, ne_eq, hanswer]
  simp only [coordinateSum, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil,
    add_zero, RectangleInput.cornerList_getD_left R hk,
    RectangleInput.cornerList_getD_right R hk, coordinate]
  simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.mem_coarseLevels
statement:
theorem mem_coarseLevels {V : List Plane} {input : TableInput} {vertical : Bool} {x : ℝ} :
    x ∈ coarseLevels V input vertical ↔ ∃ p ∈ vertexLabels input,
      coordinate (axis vertical) (pointValue V p) = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [coarseLevels, Function.comp_apply]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.usedLevel_data
statement:
theorem usedLevel_data {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {history : List Bool}
    {vertical : Bool} {i : ℕ} (hi : usedLevel (R.length, history) vertical i = true) :
    i < 2 * R.length ∧ canonicalLevel (2 * R.length) history vertical i = true ∧
      coordinate (axis vertical) ((cornerList R).getD i 0) ∈
        coarseLevels (cornerList R) (R.length, history) vertical
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpi⟩ := usedLevel_eq_true.mp hi
  have hpm := mem_vertexLabels.mp hp
  have hpc := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hpm.2.2).1)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, mem_coarseLevels.mpr ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩⟩
  · cases vertical with
    | false => exact hpi ▸ hpm.1
    | true => exact hpi ▸ hpm.2.1
  · cases vertical with
    | false => exact hpi ▸ hpc.1
    | true => exact hpi ▸ hpc.2
  · rw [coordinate_pointValue, hpi]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coarseLevel_representative
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := mem_coarseLevels.mp hx
  let i := bif vertical then p.2 else p.1
  have hiused : usedLevel (R.length, history) vertical i = true :=
    usedLevel_eq_true.mpr ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨i, (usedLevel_data hiused).1, hiused,
    by simpa only [coordinate_pointValue] using hpx⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coarseAdjacent_correct
statement:
theorem coarseAdjacent_correct {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {history : List Bool}
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history) {vertical : Bool} {i j : ℕ}
    (hi : i < 2 * R.length) (hj : j < 2 * R.length) :
    coarseAdjacent (R.length, history) vertical i j = true ↔
      usedLevel (R.length, history) vertical i = true ∧
      usedLevel (R.length, history) vertical j = true ∧
      (coordinate (axis vertical) ((cornerList R).getD i 0),
        coordinate (axis vertical) ((cornerList R).getD j 0)) ∈
        Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.consecutiveLevelPairs
          (coarseLevels (cornerList R) (R.length, history) vertical)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hi' : i < (cornerList R).length := by simpa only [cornerList_length] using hi
  have hj' : j < (cornerList R).length := by simpa only [cornerList_length] using hj
  simp only [coarseAdjacent, Bool.and_eq_true]
  rw [← cornerList_length, strictLevel_correct h hi' hj' vertical]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨hui, huj⟩, hij⟩, hall⟩
    refine ⟨hui, huj, ?_⟩
    rw [Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.consecutiveLevelPairs,
      Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
    refine ⟨⟨(usedLevel_data hui).2.2, (usedLevel_data huj).2.2⟩, hij, ?_⟩
    intro x hx hbetween
    obtain ⟨k, hk, huk, hkx⟩ := coarseLevel_representative hx
    have hallk := allBelow_eq_true.mp hall k (by simpa only [cornerList_length] using hk)
    simp only [Bool.not_eq_true_eq_eq_false, Bool.eq_false_iff, ne_eq,
      Bool.and_eq_true] at hallk
    have hk' : k < (cornerList R).length := by simpa only [cornerList_length] using hk
    apply hallk
    exact ⟨⟨huk, (strictLevel_correct h hi' hk' vertical).2 (hkx ▸ hbetween.1)⟩,
      (strictLevel_correct h hk' hj' vertical).2 (hkx ▸ hbetween.2)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hui, huj, hp⟩
    have hpdata := Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_data hp
    have hnone := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.2
    refine ⟨⟨⟨hui, huj⟩, hpdata.2.2⟩, allBelow_eq_true.mpr ?_⟩
    intro k hk
    simp only [Bool.not_eq_true_eq_eq_false, Bool.eq_false_iff, ne_eq,
      Bool.and_eq_true]
    rintro ⟨⟨huk, hik⟩, hkj⟩
    exact hnone _ (usedLevel_data huk).2.2
      ⟨(strictLevel_correct h hi' hk vertical).1 hik,
        (strictLevel_correct h hk hj' vertical).1 hkj⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coarseAdjacent_representatives
statement:
theorem coarseAdjacent_representatives {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {history : List Bool}
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history) {vertical : Bool} {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.consecutiveLevelPairs
      (coarseLevels (cornerList R) (R.length, history) vertical)) :
    ∃ i j, i < 2 * R.length ∧ j < 2 * R.length ∧
      coordinate (axis vertical) ((cornerList R).getD i 0) = p.1 ∧
      coordinate (axis vertical) ((cornerList R).getD j 0) = p.2 ∧
      coarseAdjacent (R.length, history) vertical i j = true
proof:
:= by
  have hpdata := Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_data hp
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hui, hix⟩ := coarseLevel_representative hpdata.1
  obtain ⟨j, hj, huj, hjx⟩ := coarseLevel_representative hpdata.2.1
  refine ⟨i, j, hi, hj, hix, hjx, (coarseAdjacent_correct h hi hj).2 ?_⟩
  exact ⟨hui, huj, by rw [hix, hjx]; simpa only [Prod.eta] using hp⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coarseLevels_subset_fineLevels
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi, _, hix⟩ := coarseLevel_representative hx
  exact mem_levels.mpr ⟨i, by simpa only [cornerList_length] using hi, hix⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.cellContained_correct
statement:
theorem cellContained_correct {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {history : List Bool}
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history) {c d : Cell}
    (hc : c.1.1 < 2 * R.length ∧ c.1.2 < 2 * R.length ∧
      c.2.1 < 2 * R.length ∧ c.2.2 < 2 * R.length)
    (hd : d.1.1 < 2 * R.length ∧ d.1.2 < 2 * R.length ∧
      d.2.1 < 2 * R.length ∧ d.2.2 < 2 * R.length) :
    cellContained (R.length, history) c d = true ↔
      ((cornerList R).getD c.1.1 0).re ≤ ((cornerList R).getD d.1.1 0).re ∧
      ((cornerList R).getD d.1.2 0).re ≤ ((cornerList R).getD c.1.2 0).re ∧
      ((cornerList R).getD c.2.1 0).im ≤ ((cornerList R).getD d.2.1 0).im ∧
      ((cornerList R).getD d.2.2 0).im ≤ ((cornerList R).getD c.2.2 0).im
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cornerList_length] at hc hd
  simp only [cellContained, ← cornerList_length, Bool.and_eq_true]
  rw [h false _ _ hc.1 hd.1, h false _ _ hd.2.1 hc.2.1,
    h true _ _ hc.2.2.1 hd.2.2.1, h true _ _ hd.2.2.2 hc.2.2.2]
  simp [coordinate, axis, and_assoc]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.nativeAxis_coord
statement:
@[simp] theorem nativeAxis_coord (vertical : Bool) (z : Plane) :
    (nativeAxis vertical).coord z = coordinate (axis vertical) z
proof:
:= by
  cases vertical <;> rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.intrinsicLevels_eq_coarseLevels
statement:
theorem intrinsicLevels_eq_coarseLevels {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {history : List Bool} (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history) (vertical : Bool) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.intrinsicCoordinateLevels
      (regionOfTile Ω (RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile hR)) (nativeAxis vertical) =
      coarseLevels (cornerList R) (R.length, history) vertical
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := regionOfTile Ω (RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile hR)
  have hvertices : vertices Ω = K.vertices :=
    vertices_eq_native Ω (RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile hR)
  ext x
  simp only [Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.intrinsicCoordinateLevels,
    Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hvx⟩
    have hvnative : v ∈ K.vertices := by
      change v ∈ (↑K.vertexFinset : Set Plane) at hv
      rwa [K.coe_vertexFinset] at hv
    have hvpublic : v ∈ vertices Ω := hvertices.symm ▸ hvnative
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hvalue⟩ := (vertexLabels_exact hR h v).2 hvpublic
    exact mem_coarseLevels.mpr ⟨p, hp, by rw [hvalue, ← nativeAxis_coord]; exact hvx⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := mem_coarseLevels.mp hx
    have hv : pointValue (cornerList R) p ∈ K.vertices :=
      hvertices ▸ vertexLabels_sound hR h hp
    refine ⟨pointValue (cornerList R) p, ?_, nativeAxis_coord _ _⟩
    change pointValue (cornerList R) p ∈ (↑K.vertexFinset : Set Plane)
    rwa [K.coe_vertexFinset]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.frontier_coarse_axes
statement:
theorem frontier_coarse_axes {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {history : List Bool} (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history) :
    ∀ z ∈ frontier Ω,
      z.re ∈ coarseLevels (cornerList R) (R.length, history) false ∨
      z.im ∈ coarseLevels (cornerList R) (R.length, history) true
proof:
:= by
  let K := regionOfTile Ω (RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile hR)
  have hvertices : vertices Ω = K.vertices :=
    vertices_eq_native Ω (RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile hR)
  intro z hz
  have hfront : frontier Ω = frontier K.support := by
    rw [← regionOfTile_openCarrier Ω (RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile hR)]
    exact K.frontier_openCarrier_eq_frontier_support
  rcases Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.frontier_subset_vertexCoordinateGrid K
      (hfront ▸ hz) with ⟨v, hv, hvx⟩ | ⟨v, hv, hvy⟩
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, hvalue⟩ := (vertexLabels_exact hR h v).2 (hvertices.symm ▸ hv)
    exact Or.inl (mem_coarseLevels.mpr ⟨p, hp, by rw [hvalue]; exact hvx.symm⟩)
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, hvalue⟩ := (vertexLabels_exact hR h v).2 (hvertices.symm ▸ hv)
    exact Or.inr (mem_coarseLevels.mpr ⟨p, hp, by rw [hvalue]; exact hvy.symm⟩)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.cellSet_nonempty
proof:
:= by
  let z : Plane := ⟨((V.getD c.1.1 0).re + (V.getD c.1.2 0).re) / 2,
    ((V.getD c.2.1 0).im + (V.getD c.2.2 0).im) / 2⟩
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  change (_ < _ ∧ _ < _) ∧ (_ < _ ∧ _ < _)
  dsimp [z]
  constructor <;> constructor <;> linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.computed_cell_nonempty
proof:
:= by
  have hcm := mem_cells.mp hc
  have hadj := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hcm.2).1
  rw [← cornerList_length] at hcm hadj
  have hxp := (adjacentLevels_correct h hcm.1.1 hcm.1.2.1).1 hadj.1
  have hyp := (adjacentLevels_correct h hcm.1.2.2.1 hcm.1.2.2.2).1 hadj.2
  exact cellSet_nonempty (Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_data hxp.2.2).2.2
    (Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_data hyp.2.2).2.2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coarse_cell_subset
proof:
:= by
  have hcm := mem_coarseCells.mp hc
  have hca := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hcm.2
  have hcadj := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hca.1
  have hxp := (coarseAdjacent_correct h hcm.1.1 hcm.1.2.1).1 hcadj.1
  have hyp := (coarseAdjacent_correct h hcm.1.2.2.1 hcm.1.2.2.2).1 hcadj.2
  have hinside : (cellSet (cornerList R) c ∩ Ω).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hcontained⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp hca.2
    have hbounds := (cellContained_correct h hcm.1 (mem_cells.mp hd).1).1 hcontained
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := computed_cell_nonempty h hd
    refine ⟨z, ?_, computed_cell_subset hR h hd hz⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hbounds.1.trans_lt hz.1.1, hz.1.2.trans_le hbounds.2.1⟩,
      ⟨hbounds.2.2.1.trans_lt hz.2.1, hz.2.2.trans_le hbounds.2.2.2⟩⟩
  exact Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.cell_inside_of_meets
    (RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile hR).isOpen _ _ (frontier_coarse_axes hR h)
    hxp.2.2 hyp.2.2 hinside

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coarseAccepted_of_subset
statement:
theorem coarseAccepted_of_subset {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {history : List Bool} (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history) {c : Cell}
    (hc : c.1.1 < 2 * R.length ∧ c.1.2 < 2 * R.length ∧
      c.2.1 < 2 * R.length ∧ c.2.2 < 2 * R.length)
    (hcx : coarseAdjacent (R.length, history) false c.1.1 c.1.2 = true)
    (hcy : coarseAdjacent (R.length, history) true c.2.1 c.2.2 = true)
    (hinside : cellSet (cornerList R) c ⊆ Ω) : coarseAccepted (R.length, history) c = true
proof:
:= by
  have hxp := (coarseAdjacent_correct h hc.1 hc.2.1).1 hcx
  have hyp := (coarseAdjacent_correct h hc.2.2.1 hc.2.2.2).1 hcy
  have hxdata := Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_data hxp.2.2
  have hydata := Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_data hyp.2.2
  have hopen : IsOpen (cellSet (cornerList R) c) :=
    (isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.continuous_re).inter
      (isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.continuous_im)
  obtain ⟨z, hzoff, hzc⟩ := (Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.offGrid_dense
    (levels (cornerList R) false) (levels (cornerList R) true)).exists_mem_open
      hopen (cellSet_nonempty hxdata.2.2 hydata.2.2)
  have hzfine := mem_openCells_of_offGrid hR h (hinside hzc) hzoff.1 hzoff.2
  obtain ⟨d, hzfine⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hzfine
  obtain ⟨hd, hzd⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hzfine
  have hdm := mem_cells.mp hd
  have hdadj := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hdm.2).1
  rw [← cornerList_length] at hdm hdadj
  have hdpx := (adjacentLevels_correct h hdm.1.1 hdm.1.2.1).1 hdadj.1
  have hdpy := (adjacentLevels_correct h hdm.1.2.2.1 hdm.1.2.2.2).1 hdadj.2
  have hbx := consecutive_enclosed hdpx.2.2 hzd.1
    (coarseLevels_subset_fineLevels false hxdata.1)
    (coarseLevels_subset_fineLevels false hxdata.2.1) hzc.1.1.le hzc.1.2.le
  have hby := consecutive_enclosed hdpy.2.2 hzd.2
    (coarseLevels_subset_fineLevels true hydata.1)
    (coarseLevels_subset_fineLevels true hydata.2.1) hzc.2.1.le hzc.2.2.le
  simp only [coarseAccepted, Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true]
  refine ⟨⟨hcx, hcy⟩, d, hd, (cellContained_correct h hc (mem_cells.mp hd).1).2 ?_⟩
  exact ⟨hbx.1, hbx.2, hby.1, hby.2⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coarseOpenCells_subset
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨c, hz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
  obtain ⟨hc, hz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
  exact coarse_cell_subset hR h hc hz

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.mem_coarseOpenCells_of_offGrid
statement:
theorem mem_coarseOpenCells_of_offGrid {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {history : List Bool} (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history) {z : Plane} (hz : z ∈ Ω)
    (hxoff : z.re ∉ coarseLevels (cornerList R) (R.length, history) false)
    (hyoff : z.im ∉ coarseLevels (cornerList R) (R.length, history) true) :
    z ∈ coarseOpenCells R history
proof:
:= by
  let K := regionOfTile Ω (RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile hR)
  have hzK : z ∈ K.openCarrier := by simpa only [K, regionOfTile_openCarrier] using hz
  have hvertices : vertices Ω = K.vertices :=
    vertices_eq_native Ω (RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile hR)
  have hoffK : Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.OffVertexCoordinateGrid K z := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hvalue⟩ := (vertexLabels_exact hR h v).2 (hvertices.symm ▸ hv)
    constructor
    · intro heq
      exact hxoff (mem_coarseLevels.mpr ⟨p, hp, by rw [hvalue]; exact heq.symm⟩)
    · intro heq
      exact hyoff (mem_coarseLevels.mpr ⟨p, hp, by rw [hvalue]; exact heq.symm⟩)
  obtain ⟨xp, yp, hxp, hyp, hzbox⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.exists_intrinsicCell_around_offGrid K hzK hoffK
  have hlevelsx : Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.intrinsicCoordinateLevels K
      .horizontal = coarseLevels (cornerList R) (R.length, history) false :=
    intrinsicLevels_eq_coarseLevels hR h false
  have hlevelsy : Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.intrinsicCoordinateLevels K
      .vertical = coarseLevels (cornerList R) (R.length, history) true :=
    intrinsicLevels_eq_coarseLevels hR h true
  rw [hlevelsx] at hxp
  rw [hlevelsy] at hyp
  obtain ⟨i, j, hi, hj, hix, hjx, hcx⟩ := coarseAdjacent_representatives h hxp
  obtain ⟨b, t, hb, ht, hby, hty, hcy⟩ := coarseAdjacent_representatives h hyp
  change ((cornerList R).getD i 0).re = xp.1 at hix
  change ((cornerList R).getD j 0).re = xp.2 at hjx
  change ((cornerList R).getD b 0).im = yp.1 at hby
  change ((cornerList R).getD t 0).im = yp.2 at hty
  let c : Cell := ((i, j), (b, t))
  have hcBounds : c.1.1 < 2 * R.length ∧ c.1.2 < 2 * R.length ∧
      c.2.1 < 2 * R.length ∧ c.2.2 < 2 * R.length := ⟨hi, hj, hb, ht⟩
  have hzcell : z ∈ cellSet (cornerList R) c := by
    change z.re ∈ Ioo _ _ ∧ z.im ∈ Ioo _ _
    rw [hix, hjx, hby, hty]
    exact hzbox
  have hinside : cellSet (cornerList R) c ⊆ Ω :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.cell_inside_of_meets
      (RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile hR).isOpen
      _ _ (frontier_coarse_axes hR h)
      ((coarseAdjacent_correct h hi hj).1 hcx).2.2
      ((coarseAdjacent_correct h hb ht).1 hcy).2.2 ⟨z, hzcell, hz⟩
  refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨c, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨mem_coarseCells.mpr
    ⟨hcBounds, coarseAccepted_of_subset hR h hcBounds hcx hcy hinside⟩, hzcell⟩⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coarseOpenCells_ae_eq
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [coordinate_ae_off_levels (cornerList R) false,
    coordinate_ae_off_levels (cornerList R) true] with z hx hy
  apply propext
  constructor
  · exact fun hz => coarseOpenCells_subset hR h hz
  · intro hz
    apply mem_coarseOpenCells_of_offGrid hR h hz
    · exact fun hx' => hx (coarseLevels_subset_fineLevels false hx')
    · exact fun hy' => hy (coarseLevels_subset_fineLevels true hy')

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coarseCells_nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hzoff, hz⟩ := (Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.offGrid_dense
    (levels (cornerList R) false) (levels (cornerList R) true)).exists_mem_open
      (RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile hR).isOpen hR.1
  have hzcoarse := mem_coarseOpenCells_of_offGrid hR h hz
    (fun hx => hzoff.1 (coarseLevels_subset_fineLevels false hx))
    (fun hy => hzoff.2 (coarseLevels_subset_fineLevels true hy))
  obtain ⟨c, hzcoarse⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hzcoarse
  obtain ⟨hc, _⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hzcoarse
  exact List.length_pos_of_mem hc

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coarse_cells_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  have hcm := mem_coarseCells.mp hc
  have hdm := mem_coarseCells.mp hd
  have hac := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hcm.2).1
  have had := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hdm.2).1
  have hcx := (coarseAdjacent_correct h hcm.1.1 hcm.1.2.1).1 hac.1
  have hcy := (coarseAdjacent_correct h hcm.1.2.2.1 hcm.1.2.2.2).1 hac.2
  have hdx := (coarseAdjacent_correct h hdm.1.1 hdm.1.2.1).1 had.1
  have hdy := (coarseAdjacent_correct h hdm.1.2.2.1 hdm.1.2.2.2).1 had.2
  have hci := (usedLevel_data hcx.1).2.1
  have hcj := (usedLevel_data hcx.2.1).2.1
  have hcb := (usedLevel_data hcy.1).2.1
  have hct := (usedLevel_data hcy.2.1).2.1
  have hdi := (usedLevel_data hdx.1).2.1
  have hdj := (usedLevel_data hdx.2.1).2.1
  have hdb := (usedLevel_data hdy.1).2.1
  have hdt := (usedLevel_data hdy.2.1).2.1
  rw [← cornerList_length] at hcm hdm hci hcj hcb hct hdi hdj hdb hdt
  by_cases hxeq :
      (coordinate (axis false) ((cornerList R).getD c.1.1 0),
        coordinate (axis false) ((cornerList R).getD c.1.2 0)) =
      (coordinate (axis false) ((cornerList R).getD d.1.1 0),
        coordinate (axis false) ((cornerList R).getD d.1.2 0))
  · have hlabels : c.1 = d.1 := Prod.ext
      (canonical_injective h hcm.1.1 hdm.1.1 hci hdi (congrArg Prod.fst hxeq))
      (canonical_injective h hcm.1.2.1 hdm.1.2.1 hcj hdj (congrArg Prod.snd hxeq))
    have hyne :
        (coordinate (axis true) ((cornerList R).getD c.2.1 0),
          coordinate (axis true) ((cornerList R).getD c.2.2 0)) ≠
        (coordinate (axis true) ((cornerList R).getD d.2.1 0),
          coordinate (axis true) ((cornerList R).getD d.2.2 0)) := by
      intro heq
      apply hne
      exact Prod.ext hlabels (Prod.ext
        (canonical_injective h hcm.1.2.2.1 hdm.1.2.2.1 hcb hdb (congrArg Prod.fst heq))
        (canonical_injective h hcm.1.2.2.2 hdm.1.2.2.2 hct hdt (congrArg Prod.snd heq)))
    have hdisj := Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_intervals_disjoint hcy.2.2 hdy.2.2 hyne
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun z hzc hzd => Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hzc.2 hzd.2)
  · have hdisj := Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_intervals_disjoint hcx.2.2 hdx.2.2 hxeq
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun z hzc hzd => Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hzc.1 hzd.1)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.rectangle_vadd
statement:
theorem rectangle_vadd (a p q : Plane) :
    a +ᵥ rectangle p q = rectangle (a + p) (a + q)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, rectangle, Set.mem_inter_iff,
    Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Icc, vadd_eq_add, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
    Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im, p₁, p₂]
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨⟨h₁, h₂⟩, ⟨h₃, h₄⟩⟩ <;>
    constructor <;> constructor <;> linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.realizesRectangles_vadd
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hR.1
    exact ⟨a + z, Set.mem_vadd_set.mpr ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩⟩
  · rw [hR.2, ← interior_vadd]
    congr 1
    rw [Set.vadd_set_iUnion]
    simp only [Set.vadd_set_iUnion]
    ext z
    simp only [translatedRectangles, List.mem_map, Set.mem_iUnion,
      exists_prop, exists_exists_and_eq_and, rectangle_vadd]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.translatedRegion_openCarrier
proof:
:=
  regionOfTile_openCarrier _ _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.translatedRegion_support
statement:
theorem translatedRegion_support {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}

    (translatedRegion hR a).support =
      a +ᵥ (regionOfTile Ω (RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile hR)).support

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.translatedRegion_vertices

:= by
  rw [(translatedRegion hR a).vertices_eq_vertexSet, translatedRegion_support,
    Tiling.vertexSet_vadd, ← (regionOfTile Ω
      (RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile hR)).vertices_eq_vertexSet,

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.mem_vertexLabels
statement:
theorem mem_vertexLabels {input : TableInput} {p : PointLabel} :
    p ∈ vertexLabels input ↔
      p.1 < 2 * input.1 ∧ p.2 < 2 * input.1 ∧ vertexAccepted input p = true
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertexLabels, mem_pairs, and_assoc]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.vertexLabels_nodup
statement: theorem vertexLabels_nodup (input : TableInput) : (vertexLabels input).Nodup
proof:
:=
  (pairs_nodup (2 * input.1)).filter (vertexAccepted input)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.sideCovered_comp
statement:
theorem sideCovered_comp {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {n : α → ℕ} {h : α → List Bool} {v neg : α → Bool} {a b i : α → ℕ}
    (hn : Primrec n) (hh : Primrec h) (hv : Primrec v) (hneg : Primrec neg)
    (ha : Primrec a) (hb : Primrec b) (hi : Primrec i) :
    Primrec (fun x => sideCovered (n x) (h x) (v x) (neg x) (a x) (b x) (i x))
proof:
:=
  Primrec.cond hneg
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
      (strictLevel_comp hn hh hv ha hi) (compare_comp hn hh hv hi hb))
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
      (compare_comp hn hh hv ha hi) (strictLevel_comp hn hh hv hi hb))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.quadrantRectangle_primrec
statement:
theorem quadrantRectangle_primrec :
    Primrec (fun x : (TableInput × PointLabel × Bool × Bool) × ℕ =>
      quadrantRectangle x.1.1 x.1.2.1 x.1.2.2.1 x.1.2.2.2 x.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : Primrec (fun x : (TableInput × PointLabel × Bool × Bool) × ℕ =>
      2 * x.1.1.1) := Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2)
        (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst))
  have hh : Primrec (fun x : (TableInput × PointLabel × Bool × Bool) × ℕ => x.1.1.2) :=
    Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst)
  have ha : Primrec (fun x : (TableInput × PointLabel × Bool × Bool) × ℕ => 2 * x.2) :=
    Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2) Primrec.snd
  have hb : Primrec (fun x : (TableInput × PointLabel × Bool × Bool) × ℕ =>
      2 * x.2 + 1) := Primrec.nat_add.comp ha (Primrec.const 1)
  have hp : Primrec (fun x : (TableInput × PointLabel × Bool × Bool) × ℕ => x.1.2.1) :=
    Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst)
  have hw : Primrec (fun x : (TableInput × PointLabel × Bool × Bool) × ℕ => x.1.2.2.1) :=
    Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst))
  have hs : Primrec (fun x : (TableInput × PointLabel × Bool × Bool) × ℕ => x.1.2.2.2) :=
    Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst))
  exact (Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
    (sideCovered_comp hn hh (Primrec.const false) hw ha hb (Primrec.fst.comp hp))
    (sideCovered_comp hn hh (Primrec.const true) hs ha hb (Primrec.snd.comp hp))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.quadrantOccupiedBool_comp
statement:
theorem quadrantOccupiedBool_comp {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {input : α → TableInput} {p : α → PointLabel} {west south : α → Bool}
    (hi : Primrec input) (hp : Primrec p) (hw : Primrec west) (hs : Primrec south) :
    Primrec (fun x => quadrantOccupiedBool (input x) (p x) (west x) (south x))
proof:
:=
  anyBelow_primrec (Primrec.fst.comp hi)
    (quadrantRectangle_primrec.comp
      (((hi.comp Primrec.fst).pair ((hp.comp Primrec.fst).pair
        ((hw.comp Primrec.fst).pair (hs.comp Primrec.fst)))).pair Primrec.snd))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.vertexFlag_primrec
statement: theorem vertexFlag_primrec : Primrec₂ vertexFlag
proof:
:= by
  have hq (w s : Bool) :
      Primrec (fun x : TableInput × PointLabel => quadrantOccupiedBool x.1 x.2 w s) :=
    quadrantOccupiedBool_comp Primrec.fst Primrec.snd (Primrec.const w) (Primrec.const s)
  exact (Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.or).comp
      ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.xor).comp (hq true false) (hq true true))
      ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.xor).comp (hq false false) (hq false true)))
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.or).comp
      ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.xor).comp (hq true false) (hq false false))
      ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.xor).comp (hq true true) (hq false true)))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.vertexAccepted_primrec
statement: theorem vertexAccepted_primrec : Primrec₂ vertexAccepted
proof:
:= by
  have hn : Primrec (fun x : TableInput × PointLabel => 2 * x.1.1) :=
    Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2) (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst)
  have hh : Primrec (fun x : TableInput × PointLabel => x.1.2) :=
    Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst
  exact (Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
      (canonicalLevel_comp hn hh (Primrec.const false) (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))
      (canonicalLevel_comp hn hh (Primrec.const true) (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)))
    vertexFlag_primrec

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.vertexLabels_primrec
statement: theorem vertexLabels_primrec : Primrec vertexLabels
proof:
:= by
  refine (Primrec.list_foldr
    (pairs_primrec.comp (Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2) Primrec.fst))
    (Primrec.const [])
    (Primrec.cond
      (vertexAccepted_primrec.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.list_cons.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
        (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂).of_eq ?_
  intro input
  change (pairs (2 * input.1)).foldr
    (fun p ps => bif vertexAccepted input p then p :: ps else ps) [] =
      (pairs (2 * input.1)).filter (vertexAccepted input)
  induction pairs (2 * input.1) with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p ps ih => simp [List.filter_cons, ih]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coordinate_pointValue
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinate_pointValue (V : List Plane) (p : PointLabel) (vertical : Bool) :
    coordinate (axis vertical) (pointValue V p) =
      coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD (bif vertical then p.2 else p.1) 0)
proof:
:= by
  cases vertical <;> rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.sideCovered_correct
statement:
theorem sideCovered_correct {V : List Plane} {history : List Bool}
    (h : TableCorrect V history) {a b i : ℕ} (ha : a < V.length)
    (hb : b < V.length) (hi : i < V.length) (vertical negative : Bool) :
    sideCovered V.length history vertical negative a b i = true ↔
      (if negative then
        coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD a 0) < coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD i 0) ∧
          coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD i 0) ≤ coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD b 0)
      else
        coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD a 0) ≤ coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD i 0) ∧
          coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD i 0) < coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD b 0))
proof:
:= by
  cases negative <;>
    simp only [sideCovered, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true, Bool.and_eq_true,
      Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] <;>
    rw [h vertical _ _ (by assumption) (by assumption),
      strictLevel_correct h (by assumption) (by assumption) vertical]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.quadrantRectangle_correct
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 2 * k < (cornerList R).length := by rw [cornerList_length]; omega
  have hb : 2 * k + 1 < (cornerList R).length := by rw [cornerList_length]; omega
  have hi : p.1 < (cornerList R).length := by simpa only [cornerList_length] using hp.1
  have hj : p.2 < (cornerList R).length := by simpa only [cornerList_length] using hp.2
  simp only [quadrantRectangle, ← cornerList_length, Bool.and_eq_true]
  rw [sideCovered_correct h ha hb hi false west, sideCovered_correct h ha hb hj true south,
    cornerList_getD_left R hk, cornerList_getD_right R hk]
  cases west <;> cases south <;> rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.quadrantOccupiedBool_correct
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadrantOccupiedBool, anyBelow_eq_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk, hq⟩
    refine ⟨R.getD k (0, 0), ?_, (quadrantRectangle_correct h hp hk west south).1 hq⟩
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem R (0, 0) hk]
    exact List.getElem_mem hk
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, hq⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hr
    refine ⟨k, hk, (quadrantRectangle_correct h hp hk west south).2 ?_⟩
    rwa [List.getD_eq_getElem R (0, 0) hk, heq]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.xor_true_iff
statement:
private theorem xor_true_iff (a b : Bool) :
    Bool.xor a b = true ↔ quadrantDifferent (a = true) (b = true)
proof:
:= by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [quadrantDifferent]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.vertexFlag_correct
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_vertices_iff_quadrantChanges hR]
  simp only [vertexFlag, Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.or_eq_true, xor_true_iff,
    quadrantOccupiedBool_correct h hp, hasBothAxisQuadrantChanges]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.pointValue_injective_on_vertexLabels
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq heq
  have hpm := mem_vertexLabels.mp hp
  have hqm := mem_vertexLabels.mp hq
  have hpc := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hpm.2.2).1)
  have hqc := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hqm.2.2).1)
  rw [← cornerList_length] at hpm hqm hpc hqc
  apply Prod.ext
  · have hre := congrArg Complex.re heq
    exact canonical_injective h hpm.1 hqm.1 hpc.1 hqc.1 hre
  · have him := congrArg Complex.im heq
    exact canonical_injective h hpm.2.1 hqm.2.1 hpc.2 hqc.2 him

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.vertexLabels_sound
proof:
:= by
  have hpm := mem_vertexLabels.mp hp
  exact (vertexFlag_correct hR h ⟨hpm.1, hpm.2.1⟩).1
    ((Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hpm.2.2).2)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.vertexLabels_complete_of_levels
statement:
theorem vertexLabels_complete_of_levels {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {history : List Bool} (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history) {v : Plane} (hv : v ∈ vertices Ω)
    (hx : v.re ∈ levels (cornerList R) false)
    (hy : v.im ∈ levels (cornerList R) true) :
    ∃ p ∈ vertexLabels (R.length, history), pointValue (cornerList R) p = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hix, hci⟩ := canonical_representative h hx
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hjy, hcj⟩ := canonical_representative h hy
  let p : PointLabel := (i, j)
  have hvalue : pointValue (cornerList R) p = v := Complex.ext hix hjy
  have hbounds : p.1 < 2 * R.length ∧ p.2 < 2 * R.length := by
    simpa only [cornerList_length] using And.intro hi hj
  refine ⟨p, mem_vertexLabels.mpr ⟨hbounds.1, hbounds.2, ?_⟩, hvalue⟩
  simp only [vertexAccepted, Bool.and_eq_true]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, (vertexFlag_correct hR h hbounds).2 (hvalue.symm ▸ hv)⟩
  · simpa only [cornerList_length] using hci
  · simpa only [cornerList_length] using hcj

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.rectangleRealLevels_eq_levels
statement:
theorem rectangleRealLevels_eq_levels (R : List (Plane × Plane)) :
    rectangleRealLevels R = levels (cornerList R) false
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  simp only [rectangleRealLevels, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image,
    List.mem_toFinset, levels, cornerList, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_cons,
    coordinate, axis, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
  aesop

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.vertex_im_coordinate_mem_levels
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hnot
  have hneqLo (r : Plane × Plane) (hr : r ∈ R) : r.1.im ≠ v.im := by
    intro heq
    apply hnot
    rw [← heq]
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨r.1, List.mem_toFinset.mpr ?_, rfl⟩
    exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨r, hr, by simp⟩
  have hneqHi (r : Plane × Plane) (hr : r ∈ R) : r.2.im ≠ v.im := by
    intro heq
    apply hnot
    rw [← heq]
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨r.2, List.mem_toFinset.mpr ?_, rfl⟩
    exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨r, hr, by simp⟩
  have hsame (west : Bool) :
      quadrantOccupied R v west true = quadrantOccupied R v west false := by
    apply propext
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨r, hr, hreach⟩
      change (if west then r.1.re < v.re ∧ v.re ≤ r.2.re
        else r.1.re ≤ v.re ∧ v.re < r.2.re) ∧ (r.1.im < v.im ∧ v.im ≤ r.2.im) at hreach
      exact ⟨r, hr, hreach.1, hreach.2.1.le,
        lt_of_le_of_ne hreach.2.2 (hneqHi r hr).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨r, hr, hreach⟩
      change (if west then r.1.re < v.re ∧ v.re ≤ r.2.re
        else r.1.re ≤ v.re ∧ v.re < r.2.re) ∧ (r.1.im ≤ v.im ∧ v.im < r.2.im) at hreach
      exact ⟨r, hr, hreach.1, lt_of_le_of_ne hreach.2.1 (hneqLo r hr), hreach.2.2.le⟩
  have hchanges := (mem_vertices_iff_quadrantChanges hR v).1 hv
  rcases hchanges.1 with hwest | heast
  · simp only [quadrantDifferent, hsame true, and_not_self, not_and_self, or_self] at hwest
  · simp only [quadrantDifferent, hsame false, and_not_self, not_and_self, or_self] at heast

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.vertexLabels_exact
statement:
theorem vertexLabels_exact {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {history : List Bool} (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history) (v : Plane) :
    (∃ p ∈ vertexLabels (R.length, history), pointValue (cornerList R) p = v) ↔
      v ∈ vertices Ω
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    exact vertexLabels_sound hR h hp
  · intro hv
    exact vertexLabels_complete_of_levels hR h hv
      (rectangleRealLevels_eq_levels R ▸ vertex_real_coordinate_mem_rectangleLevels hR hv)
      (vertex_im_coordinate_mem_levels hR hv)

  have hv' : v ∈ vertices Ω := by
    rwa [vertices_eq_native Ω (RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile hR)]
  obtain ⟨p, hp, _⟩ := (vertexLabels_exact hR h v).2 hv'

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.originalVertex_range
statement:
theorem originalVertex_range {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {history : List Bool} (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history) :
    Set.range (originalVertex (cornerList R) (R.length, history)) = vertices Ω
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply vertexLabels_sound hR h
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ i.isLt]
    exact List.getElem_mem i.isLt
  · intro hv
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hvalue⟩ := (vertexLabels_exact hR h v).2 hv
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hget⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hp
    refine ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, ?_⟩
    change pointValue (cornerList R) ((vertexLabels _).getD i (0, 0)) = v
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hi, hget, hvalue]

    · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ j.isLt]; exact List.getElem_mem j.isLt

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.inputCode_left_coordinate
statement:
theorem inputCode_left_coordinate {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {history : List Bool}
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history)
    (hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels (R.length, history)).length)
    (e : Fin (inputCode (R.length, history) hinput).cellCount) :
    (originalVertex (cornerList R) (R.length, history)
      ((inputCode (R.length, history) hinput).leftVertex e)).re =
      ((cornerList R).getD (indexedCell (R.length, history) hinput e).1.1 0).re
proof:
:= by
  have hcm := mem_coarseCells.mp (indexedCell_mem (R.length, history) hinput e)
  have hca := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hcm.2).1).1
  have hui := ((coarseAdjacent_correct h hcm.1.1 hcm.1.2.1).1 hca).1
  have hidx : ((inputCode (R.length, history) hinput).leftVertex e).val =
      firstVertex (R.length, history) false (indexedCell (R.length, history) hinput e).1.1 := by
    change ((packedRegion _).2.getD e (0, 0)).1.1 % _ = _
    rw [packedCell_getD]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (firstVertex_spec hui).1
  have hv := firstVertex_coordinate hui
  change (pointValue (cornerList R) ((vertexLabels _).getD _ (0, 0))).re = _
  rw [hidx]
  exact hv

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.inputCode_top_coordinate

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.runtimeCell_eq_vadd
statement:
theorem runtimeCell_eq_vadd {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {history : List Bool}
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history)
    (hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels (R.length, history)).length)
    (e : Fin (inputCode (R.length, history) hinput).cellCount) :
    runtimeCell (cornerList R) (R.length, history) hinput e =
      (-anchor (cornerList R) (R.length, history) hinput) +ᵥ
        cellSet (cornerList R) (indexedCell (R.length, history) hinput e)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [runtimeCell, normalizedVertex, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im,
    inputCode_left_coordinate h hinput e, inputCode_right_coordinate h hinput e,
    inputCode_bottom_coordinate h hinput e, inputCode_top_coordinate h hinput e,
    Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, neg_neg, vadd_eq_add,
    cellSet, Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.cell, Complex.mem_reProdIm, Set.mem_Ioo,
    Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄⟩
    constructor <;> constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨⟨h₁, h₂⟩, ⟨h₃, h₄⟩⟩
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.indexedCell_union
statement:
theorem indexedCell_union (V : List Plane) (input : TableInput)
    (hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels input).length) :
    (⋃ e : Fin (inputCode input hinput).cellCount, cellSet V (indexedCell input hinput e)) =
      ⋃ c ∈ coarseCells input, cellSet V c
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨e, hz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨indexedCell input hinput e,
      mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨indexedCell_mem input hinput e, hz⟩⟩
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨c, hz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
    obtain ⟨hc, hz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hget⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hc
    have he : i < (inputCode input hinput).cellCount := by
      simpa only [inputCode, regionCode, packedRegion, List.length_map] using hi
    let e : Fin (inputCode input hinput).cellCount := ⟨i, he⟩
    have hce : indexedCell input hinput e = c := hget
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, hce.symm ▸ hz⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.runtimeCells_ae_eq
statement:
theorem runtimeCells_ae_eq {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {history : List Bool} (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history)
    (hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels (R.length, history)).length) :
    (⋃ e, runtimeCell (cornerList R) (R.length, history) hinput e) =ᵐ[volume]
      (translatedRegion hR (-anchor (cornerList R) (R.length, history) hinput)).openCarrier
proof:
:= by
  have hunion : (⋃ e, runtimeCell (cornerList R) (R.length, history) hinput e) =
      (-anchor (cornerList R) (R.length, history) hinput) +ᵥ coarseOpenCells R history := by
    simp only [runtimeCell_eq_vadd h hinput, ← Set.vadd_set_iUnion]
    rw [indexedCell_union]
    rfl
  rw [hunion, translatedRegion_openCarrier]
  have hae := (quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left volume
    (anchor (cornerList R) (R.length, history) hinput)).ae (coarseOpenCells_ae_eq hR h)
  filter_upwards [hae] with z hz
  apply propext
  change (z ∈ (-anchor (cornerList R) (R.length, history) hinput) +ᵥ
    coarseOpenCells R history) ↔ (z ∈ (-anchor (cornerList R) (R.length, history) hinput) +ᵥ Ω)
  simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, neg_neg, vadd_eq_add]
  exact Iff.of_eq hz

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.normalizedVertex_range
statement:
theorem normalizedVertex_range {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {history : List Bool} (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history)
    (hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels (R.length, history)).length) :
    Set.range (normalizedVertex (cornerList R) (R.length, history) hinput) =
      (translatedRegion hR (-anchor (cornerList R) (R.length, history) hinput)).vertices
proof:
:= by
  rw [translatedRegion_vertices, ← originalVertex_range hR h]
  have heq : normalizedVertex (cornerList R) (R.length, history) hinput =
      fun i => (-anchor (cornerList R) (R.length, history) hinput) +ᵥ
        originalVertex (cornerList R) (R.length, history) i := by
    funext i
    simp only [normalizedVertex, vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
  rw [heq, Set.range_vadd]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.realization_vertex
statement:
@[simp] theorem realization_vertex {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}

      originalVertex (cornerList R) (R.length, history) i -
        anchor (cornerList R) (R.length, history) hinput

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.realization_openCarrier
statement:

    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history)
    (hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels (R.length, history)).length) :
    (realization hR h hinput).region.openCarrier =
      (-anchor (cornerList R) (R.length, history) hinput) +ᵥ Ω
proof:
:=
  translatedRegion_openCarrier hR _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.realization_tilesOn_iff
statement:
theorem realization_tilesOn_iff {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {history : List Bool} (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history)
    (hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels (R.length, history)).length) (T : Set Plane) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn (realization hR h hinput).region T univ ↔ Tiles Ω T
proof:
:= by
  let K := regionOfTile Ω (RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile hR)
  let a := anchor (cornerList R) (R.length, history) hinput
  have hcarrier : (realization hR h hinput).region.openCarrier =
      Tiling.AxisParallel.positiveSimilarity 1 (-a) '' K.openCarrier := by
    rw [realization_openCarrier, Tiling.AxisParallel.positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul,
      regionOfTile_openCarrier, one_smul]
  have hnative := Tiling.AxisParallel.tilesOn_positiveSimilarity_iff
    (K := K) (R := (realization hR h hinput).region) (S := T) (D := univ)
    (s := 1) (r := -a) (c := 0) (by norm_num) hcarrier
  have htiles : Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn (realization hR h hinput).region T univ ↔
      Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn K T univ := by
    simpa only [Tiling.AxisParallel.positiveSimilarity_image_eq_vadd_smul,
      one_smul, zero_vadd, add_zero, Set.vadd_set_univ] using hnative
  exact htiles.trans (tilingOn_iff_native Ω (RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile hR)
    univ T).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.realization_tileable_iff
statement:
theorem realization_tileable_iff {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {history : List Bool} (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history)
    (hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels (R.length, history)).length) :
    (∃ T, Tiling.AxisParallel.TilesOn (realization hR h hinput).region T univ) ↔
      ∃ T, Tiles Ω T
proof:
:=
  exists_congr (fun T => realization_tilesOn_iff hR h hinput T)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.comparisonHistory_rectangles_correct

:= by

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.realizationOfOracle_tileable_iff
statement:
theorem realizationOfOracle_tileable_iff {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.firstVertex_spec
statement:
theorem firstVertex_spec {input : TableInput} {vertical : Bool} {i : ℕ}
    (hi : usedLevel input vertical i = true) :
    firstVertex input vertical i < (vertexLabels input).length ∧
      (bif vertical then
        ((vertexLabels input).getD (firstVertex input vertical i) (0, 0)).2
      else ((vertexLabels input).getD (firstVertex input vertical i) (0, 0)).1) = i
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ p ∈ vertexLabels input, (bif vertical then p.2 else p.1) == i := by
    simpa only [beq_iff_eq] using usedLevel_eq_true.mp hi
  have hlt : firstVertex input vertical i < (vertexLabels input).length :=
    List.findIdx_lt_length_of_exists hex
  refine ⟨hlt, ?_⟩
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hlt]
  exact of_decide_eq_true (List.findIdx_getElem (w := hlt))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.listFindIdx_comp
statement:
theorem listFindIdx_comp {α β : Type*} [Primcodable α] [Primcodable β]
    {xs : α → List β} {p : α → β → Bool} (hxs : Primrec xs) (hp : Primrec₂ p) :
    Primrec (fun x => (xs x).findIdx (p x))
proof:
:= by
  refine (Primrec.list_foldr hxs (Primrec.const 0)
    (Primrec.cond (hp.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.const 0) (Primrec.succ.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))).to₂).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  induction xs x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a as ih => simp [List.findIdx_cons, ih]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.firstVertex_comp
statement:
theorem firstVertex_comp {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {input : α → TableInput} {v : α → Bool} {i : α → ℕ}
    (hin : Primrec input) (hv : Primrec v) (hi : Primrec i) :
    Primrec (fun x => firstVertex (input x) (v x) (i x))
proof:
:=
  listFindIdx_comp (vertexLabels_primrec.comp hin)
    (Primrec.beq.comp
      (Primrec.cond (hv.comp Primrec.fst) (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)
        (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)) (hi.comp Primrec.fst))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.encodedCell_primrec
statement: theorem encodedCell_primrec : Primrec₂ encodedCell
proof:
:=
  Primrec.pair
    (Primrec.pair
      (firstVertex_comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.const false)
        (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)))
      (firstVertex_comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.const false)
        (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))))
    (Primrec.pair
      (firstVertex_comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.const true)
        (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)))
      (firstVertex_comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.const true)
        (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.packedRegion_primrec
statement: theorem packedRegion_primrec : Primrec packedRegion
proof:
:=
  vertexLabels_primrec.pair (Primrec.list_map coarseCells_primrec encodedCell_primrec)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.allBelow_eq_true
statement:
theorem allBelow_eq_true {n : ℕ} {p : ℕ → Bool} :
    allBelow n p = true ↔ ∀ i < n, p i = true
proof:
:= by
  simp [allBelow, List.all_eq_true]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.anyBelow_eq_true
statement:
theorem anyBelow_eq_true {n : ℕ} {p : ℕ → Bool} :
    anyBelow n p = true ↔ ∃ i < n, p i = true
proof:
:= by
  simp [anyBelow, List.any_eq_true]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.mem_pairs
statement:
theorem mem_pairs {n : ℕ} {p : ℕ × ℕ} :
    p ∈ pairs n ↔ p.1 < n ∧ p.2 < n
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨a, b⟩
  simp [pairs]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.mem_candidates
statement:
theorem mem_candidates {n : ℕ} {c : Cell} :
    c ∈ candidates n ↔
      c.1.1 < n ∧ c.1.2 < n ∧ c.2.1 < n ∧ c.2.2 < n
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨⟨a, b⟩, ⟨d, e⟩⟩
  simp [candidates, mem_pairs, and_assoc]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.mem_cells
statement:
theorem mem_cells {input : TableInput} {c : Cell} :
    c ∈ cells input ↔
      (c.1.1 < 2 * input.1 ∧ c.1.2 < 2 * input.1 ∧
        c.2.1 < 2 * input.1 ∧ c.2.2 < 2 * input.1) ∧ accepted input c = true
proof:
:= by
  simp [cells, mem_candidates]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.pairs_nodup
statement: theorem pairs_nodup (n : ℕ) : (pairs n).Nodup
proof:
:=
  List.nodup_range.product List.nodup_range

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.candidates_nodup
statement: theorem candidates_nodup (n : ℕ) : (candidates n).Nodup
proof:
:=
  (pairs_nodup n).product (pairs_nodup n)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.cells_nodup
statement: theorem cells_nodup (input : TableInput) : (cells input).Nodup
proof:
:=
  (candidates_nodup (2 * input.1)).filter (accepted input)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.compare_comp
statement:
theorem compare_comp {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {n : α → ℕ} {h : α → List Bool} {v : α → Bool} {i j : α → ℕ}
    (hn : Primrec n) (hh : Primrec h) (hv : Primrec v)
    (hi : Primrec i) (hj : Primrec j) :
    Primrec (fun x => compare (n x) (h x) (v x) (i x) (j x))
proof:
:=
  compare_primrec.comp ((hn.pair hh).pair (hv.pair (hi.pair hj)))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.allBelow_primrec
statement:
theorem allBelow_primrec {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {n : α → ℕ} {p : α → ℕ → Bool} (hn : Primrec n) (hp : Primrec₂ p) :
    Primrec (fun x => allBelow (n x) (p x))
proof:
:= by
  refine (Primrec.list_foldr (Primrec.list_range.comp hn) (Primrec.const true)
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
      (hp.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  simp only [allBelow]
  induction List.range (n x) with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a as ih => simp [ih]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.anyBelow_primrec
statement:
theorem anyBelow_primrec {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {n : α → ℕ} {p : α → ℕ → Bool} (hn : Primrec n) (hp : Primrec₂ p) :
    Primrec (fun x => anyBelow (n x) (p x))
proof:
:= by
  refine (Primrec.list_foldr (Primrec.list_range.comp hn) (Primrec.const false)
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.or).comp
      (hp.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  simp only [anyBelow]
  induction List.range (n x) with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a as ih => simp [ih]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.listAny_comp
statement:
theorem listAny_comp {α β : Type*} [Primcodable α] [Primcodable β]
    {xs : α → List β} {p : α → β → Bool} (hxs : Primrec xs) (hp : Primrec₂ p) :
    Primrec (fun x => (xs x).any (p x))
proof:
:= by
  refine (Primrec.list_foldr hxs (Primrec.const false)
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.or).comp
      (hp.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  induction xs x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a as ih => simp [ih]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.listFilter_comp
statement:
theorem listFilter_comp {α β : Type*} [Primcodable α] [Primcodable β]
    {xs : α → List β} {p : α → β → Bool} (hxs : Primrec xs) (hp : Primrec₂ p) :
    Primrec (fun x => (xs x).filter (p x))
proof:
:= by
  refine (Primrec.list_foldr hxs (Primrec.const [])
    (Primrec.cond (hp.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.list_cons.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
        (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  induction xs x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a as ih => simp [List.filter_cons, ih]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.equalLevel_comp
statement:
theorem equalLevel_comp {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {n : α → ℕ} {h : α → List Bool} {v : α → Bool} {i j : α → ℕ}
    (hn : Primrec n) (hh : Primrec h) (hv : Primrec v)
    (hi : Primrec i) (hj : Primrec j) :
    Primrec (fun x => equalLevel (n x) (h x) (v x) (i x) (j x))
proof:
:=
  (Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
    (compare_comp hn hh hv hi hj) (compare_comp hn hh hv hj hi)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.strictLevel_comp
statement:
theorem strictLevel_comp {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {n : α → ℕ} {h : α → List Bool} {v : α → Bool} {i j : α → ℕ}
    (hn : Primrec n) (hh : Primrec h) (hv : Primrec v)
    (hi : Primrec i) (hj : Primrec j) :
    Primrec (fun x => strictLevel (n x) (h x) (v x) (i x) (j x))
proof:
:=
  (Primrec.dom_bool Bool.not).comp (compare_comp hn hh hv hj hi)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.canonicalLevel_comp
statement:
theorem canonicalLevel_comp {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {n : α → ℕ} {h : α → List Bool} {v : α → Bool} {i : α → ℕ}
    (hn : Primrec n) (hh : Primrec h) (hv : Primrec v) (hi : Primrec i) :
    Primrec (fun x => canonicalLevel (n x) (h x) (v x) (i x))
proof:
:=
  allBelow_primrec hi ((Primrec.dom_bool Bool.not).comp
    (equalLevel_comp (hn.comp Primrec.fst) (hh.comp Primrec.fst)
      (hv.comp Primrec.fst) (hi.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.adjacentLevels_comp
statement:
theorem adjacentLevels_comp {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {n : α → ℕ} {h : α → List Bool} {v : α → Bool} {i j : α → ℕ}
    (hn : Primrec n) (hh : Primrec h) (hv : Primrec v)
    (hi : Primrec i) (hj : Primrec j) :
    Primrec (fun x => adjacentLevels (n x) (h x) (v x) (i x) (j x))
proof:
:= by
  exact (Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
      ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
        (canonicalLevel_comp hn hh hv hi) (canonicalLevel_comp hn hh hv hj))
      (strictLevel_comp hn hh hv hi hj))
    (allBelow_primrec hn ((Primrec.dom_bool Bool.not).comp
      ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
        (strictLevel_comp (hn.comp Primrec.fst) (hh.comp Primrec.fst)
          (hv.comp Primrec.fst) (hi.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd)
        (strictLevel_comp (hn.comp Primrec.fst) (hh.comp Primrec.fst)
          (hv.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd (hj.comp Primrec.fst)))))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.rectangleCovers_primrec
proof:
:= by
  have hn : Primrec (fun x : TableInput × Cell × ℕ => 2 * x.1.1) :=
    Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2) (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst)
  have hh : Primrec (fun x : TableInput × Cell × ℕ => x.1.2) :=
    Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst
  have ha : Primrec (fun x : TableInput × Cell × ℕ => 2 * x.2.2) :=
    Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2) (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)
  have hb : Primrec (fun x : TableInput × Cell × ℕ => 2 * x.2.2 + 1) :=
    Primrec.nat_add.comp ha (Primrec.const 1)
  have hc : Primrec (fun x : TableInput × Cell × ℕ => x.2.1) :=
    Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd
  exact (Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
      ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
        (compare_comp hn hh (Primrec.const false) ha
          (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp hc)))
        (compare_comp hn hh (Primrec.const false)
          (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.fst.comp hc)) hb))
      (compare_comp hn hh (Primrec.const true) ha
        (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp hc))))
    (compare_comp hn hh (Primrec.const true)
      (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp hc)) hb)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.accepted_primrec
statement: theorem accepted_primrec : Primrec₂ accepted
proof:
:= by
  have hn : Primrec (fun x : TableInput × Cell => 2 * x.1.1) :=
    Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2) (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst)
  have hh : Primrec (fun x : TableInput × Cell => x.1.2) :=
    Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst
  have hocc : Primrec (fun x : TableInput × Cell => occupied x.1.1 x.1.2 x.2) :=
    anyBelow_primrec (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst)
      (rectangleCovers_primrec.comp ((Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst).pair
        ((Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst).pair Primrec.snd)))
  exact (Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
      (adjacentLevels_comp hn hh (Primrec.const false)
        (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))
        (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)))
      (adjacentLevels_comp hn hh (Primrec.const true)
        (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))
        (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)))) hocc

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.pairs_primrec
statement: theorem pairs_primrec : Primrec pairs
proof:
:=
  Primrec.list_flatMap Primrec.list_range
    (Primrec.list_map (Primrec.list_range.comp Primrec.fst)
      (Primrec.pair (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.candidates_primrec
statement: theorem candidates_primrec : Primrec candidates
proof:
:=
  Primrec.list_flatMap pairs_primrec
    (Primrec.list_map (pairs_primrec.comp Primrec.fst)
      (Primrec.pair (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.cells_primrec
statement: theorem cells_primrec : Primrec cells
proof:
:= by
  refine (Primrec.list_foldr
    (candidates_primrec.comp (Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2) Primrec.fst))
    (Primrec.const [])
    (Primrec.cond (accepted_primrec.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.list_cons.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
        (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂).of_eq ?_
  intro input
  change (candidates (2 * input.1)).foldr
    (fun c cs => bif accepted input c then c :: cs else cs) [] =
    (candidates (2 * input.1)).filter (accepted input)
  induction candidates (2 * input.1) with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih => simp [List.filter_cons, ih]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.comparisonHistory_correct
proof:
:= by
  intro vertical i j hi hj
  exact compare_history_correct hanswer hi hj vertical

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.cornerList_length
statement:
theorem cornerList_length (R : List (Plane × Plane)) :
    (cornerList R).length = 2 * R.length
proof:
:= by
  induction R with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons r R ih => simp [cornerList, Nat.mul_comm]; omega

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.cornerList_getD_left
statement:
theorem cornerList_getD_left (R : List (Plane × Plane)) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < R.length) :
    (cornerList R).getD (2 * k) 0 = (R.getD k (0, 0)).1
proof:
:= by
  induction R generalizing k with
  | nil => simp at hk
  | cons r R ih =>
    cases k with
    | zero => simp [cornerList]
    | succ k =>
      simpa [cornerList, Nat.mul_succ] using ih (by simpa using hk)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.cornerList_getD_right
statement:
theorem cornerList_getD_right (R : List (Plane × Plane)) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < R.length) :
    (cornerList R).getD (2 * k + 1) 0 = (R.getD k (0, 0)).2
proof:
:= by
  induction R generalizing k with
  | nil => simp at hk
  | cons r R ih =>
    cases k with
    | zero => simp [cornerList]
    | succ k =>
      simpa [cornerList, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_assoc] using ih (by simpa using hk)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile
statement:
theorem RectanglePresentation.isAxisParallelTile {R : List (Plane × Plane)}
    {Ω : Set Plane} (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω) : IsRectangleTile Ω
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨hR.1, R.toFinset, ?_⟩
  simpa only [List.mem_toFinset] using hR.2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.strictLevel_correct
statement:
theorem strictLevel_correct {V : List Plane} {history : List Bool}
    (h : TableCorrect V history) {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < V.length) (hj : j < V.length)
    (vertical : Bool) :
    strictLevel V.length history vertical i j = true ↔
      coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD i 0) <
        coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD j 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [strictLevel, Bool.not_eq_true_eq_eq_false]
  simp only [Bool.eq_false_iff, ne_eq, h vertical j i hj hi, not_le]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.equalLevel_correct
statement:
theorem equalLevel_correct {V : List Plane} {history : List Bool}
    (h : TableCorrect V history) {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < V.length) (hj : j < V.length)
    (vertical : Bool) :
    equalLevel V.length history vertical i j = true ↔
      coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD i 0) =
        coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD j 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [equalLevel, Bool.and_eq_true]
  rw [h vertical i j hi hj, h vertical j i hj hi, le_antisymm_iff]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.canonicalLevel_correct
statement:
theorem canonicalLevel_correct {V : List Plane} {history : List Bool}
    (h : TableCorrect V history) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < V.length) (vertical : Bool) :
    canonicalLevel V.length history vertical i = true ↔
      ∀ j < i, coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD i 0) ≠
        coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD j 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [canonicalLevel, allBelow_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true_eq_eq_false, Bool.eq_false_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hc j hj heq
    exact hc j hj ((equalLevel_correct h hi (hj.trans hi) vertical).2 heq)
  · intro hc j hj heq
    exact hc j hj ((equalLevel_correct h hi (hj.trans hi) vertical).1 heq)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.mem_levels
statement:
theorem mem_levels {V : List Plane} {vertical : Bool} {x : ℝ} :
    x ∈ levels V vertical ↔ ∃ i < V.length,
      coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD i 0) = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [levels, Finset.mem_image, List.mem_toFinset]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hget⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hv
    exact ⟨i, hi, by rw [List.getD_eq_getElem V 0 hi, hget]⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨V.getD i 0, by rw [List.getD_eq_getElem V 0 hi]; exact List.getElem_mem hi, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.canonical_representative
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he := mem_levels.mp hx
  let i := Nat.find he
  have hi : i < V.length ∧ coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD i 0) = x := Nat.find_spec he
  refine ⟨i, hi.1, hi.2, (canonicalLevel_correct h hi.1 vertical).2 ?_⟩
  intro j hj heq
  have hjx : coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD j 0) = x := heq.symm.trans hi.2
  exact (not_le_of_gt hj) (Nat.find_min' he ⟨hj.trans hi.1, hjx⟩)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.canonical_injective
statement:
theorem canonical_injective {V : List Plane} {history : List Bool}
    (h : TableCorrect V history) {vertical : Bool} {i j : ℕ}
    (hi : i < V.length) (hj : j < V.length)
    (hci : canonicalLevel V.length history vertical i = true)
    (hcj : canonicalLevel V.length history vertical j = true)
    (heq : coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD i 0) =
      coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD j 0)) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy i j with hij | hij | hij
  · exact ((canonicalLevel_correct h hj vertical).1 hcj i hij heq.symm).elim
  · exact hij
  · exact ((canonicalLevel_correct h hi vertical).1 hci j hij heq).elim

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.adjacentLevels_correct
statement:
theorem adjacentLevels_correct {V : List Plane} {history : List Bool}
    (h : TableCorrect V history) {vertical : Bool} {i j : ℕ}
    (hi : i < V.length) (hj : j < V.length) :
    adjacentLevels V.length history vertical i j = true ↔
      canonicalLevel V.length history vertical i = true ∧
      canonicalLevel V.length history vertical j = true ∧
      (coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD i 0),
        coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD j 0)) ∈
          Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.consecutiveLevelPairs (levels V vertical)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [adjacentLevels, Bool.and_eq_true]
  rw [strictLevel_correct h hi hj vertical]
  simp only [Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.consecutiveLevelPairs,
    Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
  have hm₁ : coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD i 0) ∈ levels V vertical :=
    mem_levels.mpr ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
  have hm₂ : coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD j 0) ∈ levels V vertical :=
    mem_levels.mpr ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
  simp only [hm₁, hm₂, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨hci, hcj⟩, hij⟩, hall⟩
    refine ⟨hci, hcj, hij, ?_⟩
    intro x hx hbetween
    obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := mem_levels.mp hx
    have hallk := (allBelow_eq_true.mp hall) k hk
    simp only [Bool.not_eq_true_eq_eq_false, Bool.eq_false_iff, ne_eq,
      Bool.and_eq_true] at hallk
    exact hallk ⟨(strictLevel_correct h hi hk vertical).2 hbetween.1,
      (strictLevel_correct h hk hj vertical).2 hbetween.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hci, hcj, hij, hnone⟩
    refine ⟨⟨⟨hci, hcj⟩, hij⟩, allBelow_eq_true.mpr ?_⟩
    intro k hk
