    simp only [Bool.not_eq_true_eq_eq_false, Bool.eq_false_iff, ne_eq,
      Bool.and_eq_true]
    rintro ⟨hik, hkj⟩
    exact hnone _ (mem_levels.mpr ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩)
      ⟨(strictLevel_correct h hi hk vertical).1 hik,
        (strictLevel_correct h hk hj vertical).1 hkj⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.adjacent_representatives
statement:
theorem adjacent_representatives {V : List Plane} {history : List Bool}
    (h : TableCorrect V history) {vertical : Bool} {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.consecutiveLevelPairs
      (levels V vertical)) :
    ∃ i j, i < V.length ∧ j < V.length ∧
      coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD i 0) = p.1 ∧
      coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD j 0) = p.2 ∧
      adjacentLevels V.length history vertical i j = true
proof:
:= by
  have hpdata := Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_data hp
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hix, hci⟩ := canonical_representative h hpdata.1
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hjx, hcj⟩ := canonical_representative h hpdata.2.1
  refine ⟨i, j, hi, hj, hix, hjx, (adjacentLevels_correct h hi hj).2 ?_⟩
  exact ⟨hci, hcj, by rw [hix, hjx]; simpa only [Prod.eta] using hp⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.rectangleCovers_correct
statement:
theorem rectangleCovers_correct {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {history : List Bool}
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history) {c : Cell} {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k < R.length)
    (hc : c.1.1 < 2 * R.length ∧ c.1.2 < 2 * R.length ∧
      c.2.1 < 2 * R.length ∧ c.2.2 < 2 * R.length) :
    rectangleCovers R.length history c k = true ↔
      (R.getD k (0, 0)).1.re ≤ ((cornerList R).getD c.1.1 0).re ∧
      ((cornerList R).getD c.1.2 0).re ≤ (R.getD k (0, 0)).2.re ∧
      (R.getD k (0, 0)).1.im ≤ ((cornerList R).getD c.2.1 0).im ∧
      ((cornerList R).getD c.2.2 0).im ≤ (R.getD k (0, 0)).2.im
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : 2 * k < (cornerList R).length := by rw [cornerList_length]; omega
  have hright : 2 * k + 1 < (cornerList R).length := by rw [cornerList_length]; omega
  have h₁ : c.1.1 < (cornerList R).length := by simpa [cornerList_length] using hc.1
  have h₂ : c.1.2 < (cornerList R).length := by simpa [cornerList_length] using hc.2.1
  have h₃ : c.2.1 < (cornerList R).length := by simpa [cornerList_length] using hc.2.2.1
  have h₄ : c.2.2 < (cornerList R).length := by simpa [cornerList_length] using hc.2.2.2
  simp only [rectangleCovers, ← cornerList_length, Bool.and_eq_true]
  rw [h false _ _ hleft h₁, h false _ _ h₂ hright,
    h true _ _ hleft h₃, h true _ _ h₄ hright,
    cornerList_getD_left R hk, cornerList_getD_right R hk]
  simp [coordinate, axis, and_assoc]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.cell_subset_of_rectangleCovers
statement:
theorem cell_subset_of_rectangleCovers {R : List (Plane × Plane)}
    {history : List Bool} (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history)
    {c : Cell} {k : ℕ} (hk : k < R.length)
    (hc : c.1.1 < 2 * R.length ∧ c.1.2 < 2 * R.length ∧
      c.2.1 < 2 * R.length ∧ c.2.2 < 2 * R.length)
    (hcover : rectangleCovers R.length history c k = true) :
    cellSet (cornerList R) c ⊆ interior (rectangle (R.getD k (0, 0)).1
      (R.getD k (0, 0)).2)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (rectangleCovers_correct h hk hc).1 hcover
  intro z hz
  rw [rectangle_eq_orderedBox, Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.orderedBox,
    Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.interior_box]
  change z.re ∈ Ioo _ _ ∧ z.im ∈ Ioo _ _ at hz ⊢
  exact ⟨⟨hs.1.trans_lt hz.1.1, hz.1.2.trans_le hs.2.1⟩,
    ⟨hs.2.2.1.trans_lt hz.2.1, hz.2.2.trans_le hs.2.2.2⟩⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.computed_cell_subset
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hb, hcell⟩ := mem_cells.mp hc
  have hoc : occupied R.length history c = true := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hcell).2
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hcover⟩ := anyBelow_eq_true.mp hoc
  apply (cell_subset_of_rectangleCovers h hk hb hcover).trans
  rw [hR.2]
  apply interior_mono
  exact subset_iUnion_of_subset (R.getD k (0, 0))
    (subset_iUnion_of_subset
      (by rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hk]; exact List.getElem_mem hk) subset_rfl)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.consecutive_enclosed
statement:
theorem consecutive_enclosed {s : Finset ℝ} {p : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ Tiling.AxisParallel.IntrinsicVertices.consecutiveLevelPairs s)
    {x a b : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Ioo p.1 p.2) (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ s)
    (hax : a ≤ x) (hxb : x ≤ b) : a ≤ p.1 ∧ p.2 ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnone := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.2
  constructor
  · by_contra h
    exact hnone a ha ⟨lt_of_not_ge h, hax.trans_lt hx.2⟩
  · by_contra h
    exact hnone b hb ⟨hx.1.trans_le hxb, lt_of_not_ge h⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.openCells_subset
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨c, hz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
  obtain ⟨hc, hz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
  exact computed_cell_subset hR h hc hz

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.mem_openCells_of_offGrid
statement:
theorem mem_openCells_of_offGrid {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {history : List Bool} (hR : RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history) {z : Plane} (hz : z ∈ Ω)
    (hxoff : z.re ∉ levels (cornerList R) false)
    (hyoff : z.im ∉ levels (cornerList R) true) : z ∈ openCells R history
proof:
:= by
  have hzUnion : z ∈ ⋃ r ∈ R, rectangle r.1 r.2 := by
    exact interior_subset (hR.2 ▸ hz)
  obtain ⟨r, hzUnion⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hzUnion
  obtain ⟨hr, hzr⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hzUnion
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hget⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hr
  have hgetD : R.getD k (0, 0) = r := (List.getD_eq_getElem R (0, 0) hk).trans hget
  have hkleft : 2 * k < (cornerList R).length := by rw [cornerList_length]; omega
  have hkright : 2 * k + 1 < (cornerList R).length := by rw [cornerList_length]; omega
  have hleft : (cornerList R).getD (2 * k) 0 = r.1 := by
    rw [cornerList_getD_left R hk, hgetD]
  have hright : (cornerList R).getD (2 * k + 1) 0 = r.2 := by
    rw [cornerList_getD_right R hk, hgetD]
  have hal : r.1.re ∈ levels (cornerList R) false :=
    mem_levels.mpr ⟨2 * k, hkleft, by rw [hleft]; rfl⟩
  have har : r.2.re ∈ levels (cornerList R) false :=
    mem_levels.mpr ⟨2 * k + 1, hkright, by rw [hright]; rfl⟩
  have hbl : r.1.im ∈ levels (cornerList R) true :=
    mem_levels.mpr ⟨2 * k, hkleft, by rw [hleft]; rfl⟩
  have hbr : r.2.im ∈ levels (cornerList R) true :=
    mem_levels.mpr ⟨2 * k + 1, hkright, by rw [hright]; rfl⟩
  change (r.1.re ≤ z.re ∧ z.re ≤ r.2.re) ∧
    (r.1.im ≤ z.im ∧ z.im ≤ r.2.im) at hzr
  have hax : r.1.re < z.re := lt_of_le_of_ne hzr.1.1
    (fun heq => hxoff (heq ▸ hal))
  have hxb : z.re < r.2.re := lt_of_le_of_ne hzr.1.2
    (fun heq => hxoff (heq.symm ▸ har))
  have hay : r.1.im < z.im := lt_of_le_of_ne hzr.2.1
    (fun heq => hyoff (heq ▸ hbl))
  have hyb : z.im < r.2.im := lt_of_le_of_ne hzr.2.2
    (fun heq => hyoff (heq.symm ▸ hbr))
  obtain ⟨xl, xr, hxp, hx⟩ := Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_around hxoff
    ⟨r.1.re, hal, hax⟩ ⟨r.2.re, har, hxb⟩
  obtain ⟨yb, yt, hyp, hy⟩ := Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_around hyoff
    ⟨r.1.im, hbl, hay⟩ ⟨r.2.im, hbr, hyb⟩
  obtain ⟨i, j, hi, hj, hix, hjx, hadjx⟩ := adjacent_representatives h hxp
  obtain ⟨b, t, hb, ht, hby, hty, hadjy⟩ := adjacent_representatives h hyp
  change ((cornerList R).getD i 0).re = xl at hix
  change ((cornerList R).getD j 0).re = xr at hjx
  change ((cornerList R).getD b 0).im = yb at hby
  change ((cornerList R).getD t 0).im = yt at hty
  let c : Cell := ((i, j), (b, t))
  have hcBounds : c.1.1 < 2 * R.length ∧ c.1.2 < 2 * R.length ∧
      c.2.1 < 2 * R.length ∧ c.2.2 < 2 * R.length := by
    simpa only [cornerList_length] using And.intro hi (And.intro hj (And.intro hb ht))
  have hxbound := consecutive_enclosed hxp hx hal har hzr.1.1 hzr.1.2
  have hybound := consecutive_enclosed hyp hy hbl hbr hzr.2.1 hzr.2.2
  have hcover : rectangleCovers R.length history c k = true := by
    apply (rectangleCovers_correct h hk hcBounds).2
    rw [hgetD]
    rw [hix, hjx, hby, hty]
    exact ⟨hxbound.1, hxbound.2, hybound.1, hybound.2⟩
  have haccept : accepted (R.length, history) c = true := by
    simp only [accepted, Bool.and_eq_true, occupied, anyBelow_eq_true]
    exact ⟨⟨by simpa only [cornerList_length] using hadjx,
      by simpa only [cornerList_length] using hadjy⟩, k, hk, hcover⟩
  refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨c, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨mem_cells.mpr ⟨hcBounds, haccept⟩, ?_⟩⟩
  change z.re ∈ Ioo _ _ ∧ z.im ∈ Ioo _ _
  rw [hix, hjx, hby, hty]
  exact ⟨hx, hy⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.volume_coordinate_level
statement:
theorem volume_coordinate_level (vertical : Bool) (a : ℝ) :
    volume {z : Plane | coordinate (axis vertical) z = a} = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases vertical with
  | false =>
    have heq : {z : Plane | coordinate (axis false) z = a} =
        Complex.measurableEquivRealProd ⁻¹' ({a} ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := by
      ext z
      simp [coordinate, axis, Complex.measurableEquivRealProd]
    rw [heq, Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.measure_preimage
      ((measurableSet_singleton a).prod MeasurableSet.univ).nullMeasurableSet]
    change (volume.prod volume) ({a} ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) = 0
    simp [Measure.prod_prod]
  | true =>
    have heq : {z : Plane | coordinate (axis true) z = a} =
        Complex.measurableEquivRealProd ⁻¹' ((univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ {a}) := by
      ext z
      simp [coordinate, axis, Complex.measurableEquivRealProd]
    rw [heq, Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.measure_preimage
      (MeasurableSet.univ.prod (measurableSet_singleton a)).nullMeasurableSet]
    change (volume.prod volume) ((univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ {a}) = 0
    simp [Measure.prod_prod]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coordinate_ae_off_levels
statement:
theorem coordinate_ae_off_levels (V : List Plane) (vertical : Bool) :
    ∀ᵐ z : Plane ∂volume, coordinate (axis vertical) z ∉ levels V vertical
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [ae_iff]
  have heq : {z : Plane | ¬coordinate (axis vertical) z ∉ levels V vertical} =
      ⋃ a ∈ levels V vertical, {z : Plane | coordinate (axis vertical) z = a} := by
    ext z
    simp
  rw [heq]
  exact (measure_biUnion_null_iff (levels V vertical).countable_toSet).2
    (fun a _ => volume_coordinate_level vertical a)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.openCells_ae_eq
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [coordinate_ae_off_levels (cornerList R) false,
    coordinate_ae_off_levels (cornerList R) true] with z hx hy
  apply propext
  constructor
  · exact fun hz => openCells_subset hR h hz
  · intro hz
    exact mem_openCells_of_offGrid hR h hz hx hy

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.computed_cells_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  have hcm := mem_cells.mp hc
  have hdm := mem_cells.mp hd
  rw [← cornerList_length] at hcm hdm
  have hac := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hcm.2).1)
  have had := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hdm.2).1)
  rw [← cornerList_length] at hac had
  have hcx := (adjacentLevels_correct h hcm.1.1 hcm.1.2.1).1 hac.1
  have hcy := (adjacentLevels_correct h hcm.1.2.2.1 hcm.1.2.2.2).1 hac.2
  have hdx := (adjacentLevels_correct h hdm.1.1 hdm.1.2.1).1 had.1
  have hdy := (adjacentLevels_correct h hdm.1.2.2.1 hdm.1.2.2.2).1 had.2
  by_cases hxeq :
      (coordinate (axis false) ((cornerList R).getD c.1.1 0),
        coordinate (axis false) ((cornerList R).getD c.1.2 0)) =
      (coordinate (axis false) ((cornerList R).getD d.1.1 0),
        coordinate (axis false) ((cornerList R).getD d.1.2 0))
  · have hlabels : c.1 = d.1 := Prod.ext
      (canonical_injective h hcm.1.1 hdm.1.1 hcx.1 hdx.1 (congrArg Prod.fst hxeq))
      (canonical_injective h hcm.1.2.1 hdm.1.2.1 hcx.2.1 hdx.2.1
        (congrArg Prod.snd hxeq))
    have hyne :
        (coordinate (axis true) ((cornerList R).getD c.2.1 0),
          coordinate (axis true) ((cornerList R).getD c.2.2 0)) ≠
        (coordinate (axis true) ((cornerList R).getD d.2.1 0),
          coordinate (axis true) ((cornerList R).getD d.2.2 0)) := by
      intro heq
      apply hne
      exact Prod.ext hlabels (Prod.ext
        (canonical_injective h hcm.1.2.2.1 hdm.1.2.2.1 hcy.1 hdy.1
          (congrArg Prod.fst heq))
        (canonical_injective h hcm.1.2.2.2 hdm.1.2.2.2 hcy.2.1 hdy.2.1
          (congrArg Prod.snd heq)))
    have hdisj := Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_intervals_disjoint hcy.2.2 hdy.2.2 hyne
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzc hzd
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hzc.2 hzd.2
  · have hdisj := Tiling.AxisParallel.FiniteRectangles.pair_intervals_disjoint hcx.2.2 hdx.2.2 hxeq
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzc hzd
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hzc.1 hzd.1

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.pairCoeff_zero
statement: theorem pairCoeff_zero (C : RegionCode) : pairCoeff C (0, 0) = Coeff.zero C
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [pairCoeff, Coeff.zero]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.pairCoeff_eq_sub_single
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  by_cases h₁ : i.val = p.1 <;> by_cases h₂ : i.val = p.2 <;>
    simp [pairCoeff, Coeff.sub, Coeff.single, Fin.ext_iff, h₁, h₂, beq_iff_eq, Bool.cond_eq_ite]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.evalCoeff_pair
statement:
theorem evalCoeff_pair {C : RegionCode} (R : Realization C) (s : CoordSort)
    {p : ℕ × ℕ} (hp : p.1 < C.vertexCount ∧ p.2 < C.vertexCount) :
    evalCoeff R s (pairCoeff C p) =
      s.axis.coord (R.vertex ⟨p.1, hp.1⟩) - s.axis.coord (R.vertex ⟨p.2, hp.2⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairCoeff_eq_sub_single C hp]
  simp only [evalCoeff, Coeff.sub, Int.cast_sub, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Coeff.single, Int.cast_ite, Int.cast_one, Int.cast_zero, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]
  simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.table_correct
proof:
:= by
  rw [table_history ha hb]
  change answer (axis vertical, _, _) = true ↔ _
  rw [hanswer]
  simp only [coordinateSum, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil,
    add_zero]
  cases vertical <;> simp only [cornerLabel, coordinate, axis, pointValue,
    Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
    show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide]
  all_goals constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.table_matches_oracle
statement:
theorem table_matches_oracle {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {gridHistory : List Bool} {answer : Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Query → Bool}
    (hR : Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (hgrid : TableCorrect (cornerList R) gridHistory)
    (hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length)
    (hanswer : Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CorrectOracle (cornerList R) answer)
    (s : CoordSort) {a b : ℕ × ℕ}
    (ha : a.1 < (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length ∧
      a.2 < (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length)
    (hb : b.1 < (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length ∧
      b.2 < (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length) :
    table (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length
      (history (packedRegion (R.length, gridHistory)) answer) (sortBool s) a b =
      (oracle hR hgrid hinput hanswer).answer
        ⟨s, pairCoeff (inputCode (R.length, gridHistory) hinput) a,
          pairCoeff (inputCode (R.length, gridHistory) hinput) b⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
  change table (packedRegion (R.length, gridHistory)).1.length
    (history (packedRegion (R.length, gridHistory)) answer) (sortBool s) a b = true ↔ _
  rw [table_correct hanswer ha hb, (oracle hR hgrid hinput hanswer).correct,
    evalCoeff_pair _ s ha, evalCoeff_pair _ s hb]
  simp only [coordinate_sortBool, realization, normalizedVertex, originalVertex, packedRegion]
  cases s <;> simp only [CoordSort.axis, Tiling.AxisParallel.Axis.coord,
    Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
  all_goals constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.mem_differenceCandidates
statement:
theorem mem_differenceCandidates {n : ℕ} {p : ℕ × ℕ} :
    p ∈ differenceCandidates n ↔ p.1 < n ∧ p.2 < n
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨i, j⟩
  simp [differenceCandidates, mem_pairs, and_comm]
  aesop

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.map_range_eq_ofFn
statement:
theorem map_range_eq_ofFn {α : Type*} (f : ℕ → α) (n : ℕ) :
    (List.range n).map f = List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => f i)
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intro i hi hj
    simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.differenceCoeff_eq_ofFn_pairCoeff
statement:
theorem differenceCoeff_eq_ofFn_pairCoeff (C : RegionCode) (p : ℕ × ℕ) :
    differenceCoeff C.vertexCount p = List.ofFn (pairCoeff C p)
proof:
:=
  map_range_eq_ofFn _ _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.diameterCandidates_eq_map
statement:
theorem diameterCandidates_eq_map (C : RegionCode) :
    LocalCoverSearch.diameterCandidates C =
      (differenceCandidates C.vertexCount).map (pairCoeff C)
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : List.range C.vertexCount = List.ofFn (fun i : Fin C.vertexCount => i.val) :=
    by simpa using map_range_eq_ofFn id C.vertexCount
  simp only [LocalCoverSearch.diameterCandidates, differenceCandidates, pairs, hrange,
    List.flatMap, List.map_flatten, List.map_ofFn]
  congr 1
  apply congrArg List.flatten
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext i
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, List.map_ofFn]
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext j
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
  rw [pairCoeff_eq_sub_single C ⟨i.isLt, j.isLt⟩,
    pairCoeff_eq_sub_single C ⟨j.isLt, i.isLt⟩]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.fold_pairCoeff
statement:
theorem fold_pairCoeff {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {gridHistory : List Bool} {answer : Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Query → Bool}
    (hR : Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (hgrid : TableCorrect (cornerList R) gridHistory)
    (hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length)
    (hanswer : Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CorrectOracle (cornerList R) answer)
    (s : CoordSort) (xs : List (ℕ × ℕ))
    (hxs : ∀ p ∈ xs, p.1 < (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length ∧
      p.2 < (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length)
    (a : ℕ × ℕ)
    (ha : a.1 < (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length ∧
      a.2 < (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length) :
    pairCoeff (inputCode (R.length, gridHistory) hinput)
      (xs.foldl (fun a b => bif table (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length
        (history (packedRegion (R.length, gridHistory)) answer) (sortBool s) a b
        then b else a) a) =
    (xs.map (pairCoeff (inputCode (R.length, gridHistory) hinput))).foldl
      (LocalCoverSearch.chooseLargerCoeff (oracle hR hgrid hinput hanswer).toOracle s)
      (pairCoeff (inputCode (R.length, gridHistory) hinput) a)
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b xs ih =>
    have hb := hxs b (by simp)
    have htail : ∀ p ∈ xs, p.1 < (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length ∧
        p.2 < (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length :=
      fun p hp => hxs p (by simp [hp])
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.map_cons, LocalCoverSearch.chooseLargerCoeff]
    rw [table_matches_oracle hR hgrid hinput hanswer s ha hb]
    cases hresp : (oracle hR hgrid hinput hanswer).answer
        ⟨s, pairCoeff (inputCode (R.length, gridHistory) hinput) a,
          pairCoeff (inputCode (R.length, gridHistory) hinput) b⟩
    · simpa only [hresp, Bool.cond_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] using ih htail a ha
    · simpa only [hresp, Bool.cond_true, ↓reduceIte] using ih htail b hb

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.maximumPair_eq_native
statement:
theorem maximumPair_eq_native {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {gridHistory : List Bool} {answer : Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Query → Bool}
    (hR : Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (hgrid : TableCorrect (cornerList R) gridHistory)
    (hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length)
    (hanswer : Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CorrectOracle (cornerList R) answer)
    (s : CoordSort) :
    pairCoeff (inputCode (R.length, gridHistory) hinput)
      (maximumPair (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length
        (history (packedRegion (R.length, gridHistory)) answer) (sortBool s)) =
      LocalCoverSearch.maxCoeffList (oracle hR hgrid hinput hanswer).toOracle s
        (LocalCoverSearch.diameterCandidates (inputCode (R.length, gridHistory) hinput))
proof:
:= by
  rw [maximumPair, LocalCoverSearch.maxCoeffList, diameterCandidates_eq_map]
  rw [← pairCoeff_zero]
  exact fold_pairCoeff hR hgrid hinput hanswer s _
    (fun p hp => mem_differenceCandidates.mp hp) (0, 0) ⟨hinput, hinput⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.horizontalWidth_eq
statement:
theorem horizontalWidth_eq {P : PackedRegion} (hP : 0 < P.1.length)
    (hc : 0 < P.2.length) :
    differenceCoeff P.1.length
      ((P.2.getD 0 (0, 0)).1.2 % P.1.length,
        (P.2.getD 0 (0, 0)).1.1 % P.1.length) =
    List.ofFn (Coeff.sub (Coeff.cellRight (C := regionCode P hP) ⟨0, hc⟩)
      (Coeff.cellLeft ⟨0, hc⟩))
proof:
:= by
  exact (differenceCoeff_eq_ofFn_pairCoeff (regionCode P hP) _).trans
    (congrArg List.ofFn (pairCoeff_eq_sub_single (regionCode P hP)
      ⟨Nat.mod_lt _ hP, Nat.mod_lt _ hP⟩))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.verticalWidth_eq
statement:
theorem verticalWidth_eq {P : PackedRegion} (hP : 0 < P.1.length)
    (hc : 0 < P.2.length) :
    differenceCoeff P.1.length
      ((P.2.getD 0 (0, 0)).2.2 % P.1.length,
        (P.2.getD 0 (0, 0)).2.1 % P.1.length) =
    List.ofFn (Coeff.sub (Coeff.cellTop (C := regionCode P hP) ⟨0, hc⟩)
      (Coeff.cellBottom ⟨0, hc⟩))
proof:
:= by
  exact (differenceCoeff_eq_ofFn_pairCoeff (regionCode P hP) _).trans
    (congrArg List.ofFn (pairCoeff_eq_sub_single (regionCode P hP)
      ⟨Nat.mod_lt _ hP, Nat.mod_lt _ hP⟩))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.build_eq_native
statement:
theorem build_eq_native {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {gridHistory : List Bool} {answer : Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Query → Bool}
    (hR : Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (hgrid : TableCorrect (cornerList R) gridHistory)
    (hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels (R.length, gridHistory)).length)
    (hanswer : Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.CorrectOracle (cornerList R) answer) :
    build (packedRegion (R.length, gridHistory))
        (history (packedRegion (R.length, gridHistory)) answer) =
      (LocalCoverSearch.buildLocalBound (inputCode (R.length, gridHistory) hinput)
        (oracle hR hgrid hinput hanswer).toOracle).map encodeNativeBound
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 0 < (packedRegion (R.length, gridHistory)).2.length := by
    simpa only [packedRegion, List.length_map] using coarseCells_nonempty hR hgrid
  have hn : 0 < (inputCode (R.length, gridHistory) hinput).cellCount := hc
  simp only [build, if_pos hc, LocalCoverSearch.buildLocalBound, dif_pos hn,
    Option.map_some, encodeNativeBound]
  apply congrArg some
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact (differenceCoeff_eq_ofFn_pairCoeff (inputCode (R.length, gridHistory) hinput)
      _).trans (congrArg List.ofFn (maximumPair_eq_native hR hgrid hinput hanswer .horizontal))
  · apply Prod.ext
    · exact (differenceCoeff_eq_ofFn_pairCoeff (inputCode (R.length, gridHistory) hinput)
        _).trans (congrArg List.ofFn (maximumPair_eq_native hR hgrid hinput hanswer .vertical))
    · exact Prod.ext (horizontalWidth_eq hinput hc) (verticalWidth_eq hinput hc)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.mem_keys
statement:
theorem mem_keys {n : ℕ} {k : Key} :
    k ∈ keys n ↔ k.2.1.1 < n ∧ k.2.1.2 < n ∧ k.2.2.1 < n ∧ k.2.2.2 < n
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | mk v c => cases v <;> simp [keys, mem_candidates]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.table_history
statement:
theorem table_history {P : PackedRegion} {vertical : Bool} {a b : ℕ × ℕ}
    (ha : a.1 < P.1.length ∧ a.2 < P.1.length)
    (hb : b.1 < P.1.length ∧ b.2 < P.1.length)
    (answer : Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.Query → Bool) :
    table P.1.length (history P answer) vertical a b = answer (query P.1 (vertical, a, b))
proof:
:= by
  have hkey : (vertical, a, b) ∈ keys P.1.length := mem_keys.mpr ⟨ha.1, ha.2, hb.1, hb.2⟩
  have hex : ∃ k ∈ keys P.1.length, decide (k = (vertical, a, b)) = true :=
    ⟨_, hkey, by simp⟩
  have hlt := List.findIdx_lt_length_of_exists hex
  have hget := List.findIdx_getElem (w := hlt)
  have hgeteq : (keys P.1.length)[
      (keys P.1.length).findIdx (fun k => decide (k = (vertical, a, b)))] =
      (vertical, a, b) := by simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using hget
  simp only [table, history, queries, List.map_map]
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa only [List.length_map] using hlt)]
  simp only [List.getElem_map, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [hgeteq]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.keys_primrec
statement: theorem keys_primrec : Primrec keys
proof:
:=
  Primrec.list_flatMap candidates_primrec
    (Primrec.list_cons.comp (Primrec.pair (Primrec.const false) Primrec.snd)
      (Primrec.list_cons.comp (Primrec.pair (Primrec.const true) Primrec.snd)
        (Primrec.const [])))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.cornerLabel_comp
statement:
theorem cornerLabel_comp {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {labels : α → List PointLabel} {v : α → Bool} {i : α → ℕ}
    (hl : Primrec labels) (hv : Primrec v) (hi : Primrec i) :
    Primrec (fun x => cornerLabel (labels x) (v x) (i x))
proof:
:=
  Primrec.cond hv
    (Primrec.snd.comp ((Primrec.list_getD (0, 0)).comp hl hi))
    (Primrec.fst.comp ((Primrec.list_getD (0, 0)).comp hl hi))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.query_primrec
statement: theorem query_primrec : Primrec₂ query
proof:
:= by
  have hv : Primrec (fun x : List PointLabel × Key => x.2.1) := Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd
  have hc : Primrec (fun x : List PointLabel × Key => x.2.2) := Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd
  exact Primrec.pair ((Primrec.dom_bool axis).comp hv)
    (Primrec.pair
      (Primrec.list_cons.comp
        (cornerLabel_comp Primrec.fst hv (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp hc)))
        (Primrec.list_cons.comp
          (cornerLabel_comp Primrec.fst hv (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp hc)))
          (Primrec.const [])))
      (Primrec.list_cons.comp
        (cornerLabel_comp Primrec.fst hv (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp hc)))
        (Primrec.list_cons.comp
          (cornerLabel_comp Primrec.fst hv (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.fst.comp hc)))
          (Primrec.const []))))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.queries_primrec
statement: theorem queries_primrec : Primrec queries
proof:
:=
  Primrec.list_map (keys_primrec.comp (Primrec.list_length.comp Primrec.fst))
    (query_primrec.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.table_comp
statement:
theorem table_comp {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {n : α → ℕ} {answers : α → List Bool} {v : α → Bool}
    {a b : α → ℕ × ℕ} (hn : Primrec n) (hh : Primrec answers) (hv : Primrec v)
    (ha : Primrec a) (hb : Primrec b) :
    Primrec (fun x => table (n x) (answers x) (v x) (a x) (b x))
proof:
:=
  (Primrec.list_getD false).comp hh
    (listFindIdx_comp (keys_primrec.comp hn)
      ((Primrec.eq.comp Primrec.snd
        ((hv.comp Primrec.fst).pair ((ha.comp Primrec.fst).pair
          (hb.comp Primrec.fst)))).decide).to₂)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.differenceCandidates_primrec
statement: theorem differenceCandidates_primrec : Primrec differenceCandidates
proof:
:=
  Primrec.list_flatMap pairs_primrec
    (Primrec.list_cons.comp Primrec.snd
      (Primrec.list_cons.comp
        (Primrec.pair (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd) (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))
        (Primrec.const [])))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.maximumPair_comp
statement:
theorem maximumPair_comp {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {n : α → ℕ} {answers : α → List Bool} {v : α → Bool}
    (hn : Primrec n) (hh : Primrec answers) (hv : Primrec v) :
    Primrec (fun x => maximumPair (n x) (answers x) (v x))
proof:
:=
  Primrec.list_foldl (differenceCandidates_primrec.comp hn) (Primrec.const (0, 0))
    (Primrec.cond
      (table_comp (hn.comp Primrec.fst) (hh.comp Primrec.fst) (hv.comp Primrec.fst)
        (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd) (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd) (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.differenceCoeff_primrec
statement: theorem differenceCoeff_primrec : Primrec₂ differenceCoeff
proof:
:=
  Primrec.list_map (Primrec.list_range.comp Primrec.fst)
    (int_sub_primrec.comp
      (Primrec.cond (Primrec.beq.comp Primrec.snd
          (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst)))
        (Primrec.const (1 : ℤ)) (Primrec.const 0))
      (Primrec.cond (Primrec.beq.comp Primrec.snd
          (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst)))
        (Primrec.const (1 : ℤ)) (Primrec.const 0)))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.LocalBound.build_primrec
statement: theorem build_primrec : Primrec₂ build
proof:
:= by
  have hn : Primrec (fun x : PackedRegion × List Bool => x.1.1.length) :=
    Primrec.list_length.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst)
  have hc : Primrec (fun x : PackedRegion × List Bool => x.1.2.getD 0 (0, 0)) :=
    (Primrec.list_getD (0, 0)).comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst) (Primrec.const 0)
  have hw (vertical : Bool) : Primrec (fun x : PackedRegion × List Bool =>
      (bif vertical then (x.1.2.getD 0 (0, 0)).2.2 else (x.1.2.getD 0 (0, 0)).1.2) %
        x.1.1.length) := by
    cases vertical
    · exact Primrec.nat_mod.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.fst.comp hc)) hn
    · exact Primrec.nat_mod.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp hc)) hn
  have hl (vertical : Bool) : Primrec (fun x : PackedRegion × List Bool =>
      (bif vertical then (x.1.2.getD 0 (0, 0)).2.1 else (x.1.2.getD 0 (0, 0)).1.1) %
        x.1.1.length) := by
    cases vertical
    · exact Primrec.nat_mod.comp (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp hc)) hn
    · exact Primrec.nat_mod.comp (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp hc)) hn
  refine (Primrec.cond
    ((Primrec.nat_lt.comp (Primrec.const 0)
      (Primrec.list_length.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst))).decide)
    (Primrec.option_some.comp (Primrec.pair
      (differenceCoeff_primrec.comp hn (maximumPair_comp hn Primrec.snd (Primrec.const false)))
      (Primrec.pair
        (differenceCoeff_primrec.comp hn (maximumPair_comp hn Primrec.snd (Primrec.const true)))
        (Primrec.pair (differenceCoeff_primrec.comp hn ((hw false).pair (hl false)))
          (differenceCoeff_primrec.comp hn ((hw true).pair (hl true)))))))
    (Primrec.const none)).of_eq ?_
  intro x
  by_cases h : 0 < x.1.2.length <;> simp [build, h]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.usedLevel_eq_true
statement:
theorem usedLevel_eq_true {input : TableInput} {vertical : Bool} {i : ℕ} :
    usedLevel input vertical i = true ↔
      ∃ p ∈ vertexLabels input, (bif vertical then p.2 else p.1) = i
proof:
:= by
  simp [usedLevel, List.any_eq_true]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coarseCells_nodup
statement: theorem coarseCells_nodup (input : TableInput) : (coarseCells input).Nodup
proof:
:=
  (candidates_nodup (2 * input.1)).filter (coarseAccepted input)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.mem_coarseCells
statement:
theorem mem_coarseCells {input : TableInput} {c : Cell} :
    c ∈ coarseCells input ↔
      (c.1.1 < 2 * input.1 ∧ c.1.2 < 2 * input.1 ∧
        c.2.1 < 2 * input.1 ∧ c.2.2 < 2 * input.1) ∧ coarseAccepted input c = true
proof:
:= by
  simp [coarseCells, mem_candidates]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.usedLevel_comp
statement:
theorem usedLevel_comp {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {input : α → TableInput} {v : α → Bool} {i : α → ℕ}
    (hin : Primrec input) (hv : Primrec v) (hi : Primrec i) :
    Primrec (fun x => usedLevel (input x) (v x) (i x))
proof:
:=
  listAny_comp (vertexLabels_primrec.comp hin)
    (Primrec.beq.comp
      (Primrec.cond (hv.comp Primrec.fst) (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)
        (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)) (hi.comp Primrec.fst))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coarseAdjacent_comp
statement:
theorem coarseAdjacent_comp {α : Type*} [Primcodable α]
    {input : α → TableInput} {v : α → Bool} {i j : α → ℕ}
    (hin : Primrec input) (hv : Primrec v) (hi : Primrec i) (hj : Primrec j) :
    Primrec (fun x => coarseAdjacent (input x) (v x) (i x) (j x))
proof:
:= by
  have hn : Primrec (fun x => 2 * (input x).1) :=
    Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2) (Primrec.fst.comp hin)
  have hh : Primrec (fun x => (input x).2) := Primrec.snd.comp hin
  exact (Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
      ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
        (usedLevel_comp hin hv hi) (usedLevel_comp hin hv hj))
      (strictLevel_comp hn hh hv hi hj))
    (allBelow_primrec hn ((Primrec.dom_bool Bool.not).comp
      ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
        ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
          (usedLevel_comp (hin.comp Primrec.fst) (hv.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd)
          (strictLevel_comp (hn.comp Primrec.fst) (hh.comp Primrec.fst)
            (hv.comp Primrec.fst) (hi.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd))
        (strictLevel_comp (hn.comp Primrec.fst) (hh.comp Primrec.fst)
          (hv.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd (hj.comp Primrec.fst)))))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.cellContained_primrec
statement:
theorem cellContained_primrec :
    Primrec (fun x : TableInput × Cell × Cell => cellContained x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : Primrec (fun x : TableInput × Cell × Cell => 2 * x.1.1) :=
    Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2) (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst)
  have hh : Primrec (fun x : TableInput × Cell × Cell => x.1.2) :=
    Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst
  have ho : Primrec (fun x : TableInput × Cell × Cell => x.2.1) :=
    Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd
  have hi : Primrec (fun x : TableInput × Cell × Cell => x.2.2) :=
    Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd
  exact (Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
      ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
        (compare_comp hn hh (Primrec.const false)
          (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp ho))
          (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp hi)))
        (compare_comp hn hh (Primrec.const false)
          (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.fst.comp hi))
          (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.fst.comp ho))))
      (compare_comp hn hh (Primrec.const true)
        (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp ho))
        (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp hi))))
    (compare_comp hn hh (Primrec.const true)
      (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp hi))
      (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp ho)))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coarseAccepted_primrec
statement: theorem coarseAccepted_primrec : Primrec₂ coarseAccepted
proof:
:=
  (Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
    ((Primrec.dom_bool₂ Bool.and).comp
      (coarseAdjacent_comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.const false)
        (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))
        (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)))
      (coarseAdjacent_comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.const true)
        (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))
        (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))))
    (listAny_comp (cells_primrec.comp Primrec.fst)
      (cellContained_primrec.comp ((Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst).pair
        ((Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst).pair Primrec.snd))))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coarseCells_primrec
statement: theorem coarseCells_primrec : Primrec coarseCells
proof:
:=
  listFilter_comp
    (candidates_primrec.comp (Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2) Primrec.fst))
    coarseAccepted_primrec

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.packedAxis_sortBool
statement:
@[simp] theorem packedAxis_sortBool (s : CoordSort) :
    packedAxis (sortBool s) = axis (sortBool s)
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.coordinate_sortBool
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinate_sortBool (s : CoordSort) (z : Plane) :
    coordinate (axis (sortBool s)) z = s.axis.coord z
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.linearCoordinateSum_ofFn
statement:
theorem linearCoordinateSum_ofFn {n : ℕ} (V : List Plane) (a : Fin 2) (f : Fin n → ℤ) :
    linearCoordinateSum V a (List.ofFn f) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, (f i : ℝ) * coordinate a (V.getD i 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold linearCoordinateSum indexedCoefficients
  simp only [List.length_ofFn, List.map_map]
  rw [← List.sum_toFinset _ List.nodup_range, List.toFinset_range, Finset.sum_range]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  dsimp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem (List.ofFn f) 0
      (by simpa only [List.length_ofFn] using i.isLt),
    List.getElem_ofFn]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.normalizedVertices_getD
statement:
theorem normalizedVertices_getD {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {history : List Bool} (hR : Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history)
    (hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels (R.length, history)).length)
    (i : Fin (vertexLabels (R.length, history)).length) :
    (normalizedVertices (cornerList R) (vertexLabels (R.length, history)) 0).getD i 0 =
      (realization hR h hinput).vertex i
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa only [normalizedVertices, List.length_map] using i.isLt)]
  simp only [normalizedVertices, List.getElem_map, realization_vertex,
    originalVertex, anchor, List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ i.isLt]
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.linearCoordinateSum_eq_evalCoeff
statement:
theorem linearCoordinateSum_eq_evalCoeff {R : List (Plane × Plane)} {Ω : Set Plane}
    {history : List Bool} (hR : Tiling.AxisParallel.SetFormulation.RectanglePresentation R Ω)
    (h : TableCorrect (cornerList R) history)
    (hinput : 0 < (vertexLabels (R.length, history)).length)
    (s : CoordSort) (a : Coeff (inputCode (R.length, history) hinput)) :
    linearCoordinateSum
      (normalizedVertices (cornerList R) (vertexLabels (R.length, history)) 0)
      (packedAxis (sortBool s)) (List.ofFn a) = evalCoeff (realization hR h hinput) s a
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearCoordinateSum_ofFn]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [normalizedVertices_getD hR h hinput i, packedAxis_sortBool, coordinate_sortBool]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.comparisonQuery_index
statement:
theorem comparisonQuery_index {n i j : ℕ} (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n)
    (vertical : Bool) :
    comparisonQuery n (comparisonIndex n vertical i j) =
      (axis vertical, [i], [j])
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < n := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hi
  have hdiv : (i * n + j) / n = i := by
    rw [Nat.mul_comm i n, Nat.mul_add_div hn, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hj, Nat.add_zero]
  have hmod : (i * n + j) % n = j := by
    simp [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hj]
  cases vertical <;> simp [comparisonQuery, comparisonIndex, axis,
    Nat.add_div, hdiv, hmod]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.comparisonIndex_lt
statement:
theorem comparisonIndex_lt {n i j : ℕ} (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n)
    (vertical : Bool) : comparisonIndex n vertical i j < 2 * (n * n)
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : i * n + j < n * n := by
    calc
      i * n + j < i * n + n := Nat.add_lt_add_left hj _
      _ = (i + 1) * n := by simp [Nat.add_mul]
      _ ≤ n * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right n hi
  cases vertical <;> simp only [comparisonIndex, Bool.cond_false, Bool.cond_true] <;> omega

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.comparisonQueries_length
statement:
theorem comparisonQueries_length (n : ℕ) :
    (comparisonQueries n).length = 2 * (n * n)
proof:
:= by
  simp [comparisonQueries]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.comparisonHistory_length
statement:
theorem comparisonHistory_length (n : ℕ) (answer : Query → Bool) :
    (comparisonHistory n answer).length = 2 * (n * n)
proof:
:= by
  simp [comparisonHistory, comparisonQueries]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.compare_history
statement:
theorem compare_history {n i j : ℕ} (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n)
    (vertical : Bool) (answer : Query → Bool) :
    compare n (comparisonHistory n answer) vertical i j =
      answer (axis vertical, [i], [j])
proof:
:= by
  have hlt := comparisonIndex_lt hi hj vertical
  simp only [compare, comparisonHistory, comparisonQueries, List.map_map]
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa using hlt)]
  simp only [List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [comparisonQuery_index hi hj]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.compare_history_correct
statement:
theorem compare_history_correct {n i j : ℕ} {V : List Plane}
    {answer : Query → Bool} (hanswer : CorrectOracle V answer)
    (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n) (vertical : Bool) :
    compare n (comparisonHistory n answer) vertical i j = true ↔
      coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD i 0) ≤
        coordinate (axis vertical) (V.getD j 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [compare_history hi hj]
  simpa only [coordinateSum, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons,
    List.sum_nil, add_zero] using hanswer (axis vertical) [i] [j]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.axis_primrec
statement: private theorem axis_primrec : Primrec axis
proof:
:= by
  exact Primrec.dom_bool _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.comparisonIndex_primrec
statement:
theorem comparisonIndex_primrec :
    Primrec (fun x : ℕ × Bool × ℕ × ℕ =>
      comparisonIndex x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  exact Primrec.nat_add.comp
    (Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2)
      (Primrec.nat_add.comp
        (Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))
          Primrec.fst)
        (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))))
    (Primrec.cond (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd) (Primrec.const 1) (Primrec.const 0))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.comparisonQuery_primrec
statement: theorem comparisonQuery_primrec : Primrec₂ comparisonQuery
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : Primrec (fun x : ℕ × ℕ => x.2 / 2) :=
    Primrec.nat_div.comp Primrec.snd (Primrec.const 2)
  exact Primrec.pair
    (axis_primrec.comp (Primrec.beq.comp
      (Primrec.nat_mod.comp Primrec.snd (Primrec.const 2)) (Primrec.const 1)))
    (Primrec.pair
      (Primrec.list_cons.comp (Primrec.nat_div.comp hhalf Primrec.fst)
        (Primrec.const []))
      (Primrec.list_cons.comp (Primrec.nat_mod.comp hhalf Primrec.fst)
        (Primrec.const [])))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.comparisonQueries_primrec
statement: theorem comparisonQueries_primrec : Primrec comparisonQueries
proof:
:=
  Primrec.list_map
    (Primrec.list_range.comp (Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 2)
      (Primrec.nat_mul.comp Primrec.id Primrec.id))) comparisonQuery_primrec

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Decidability.RectangleInput.compare_primrec
statement:
theorem compare_primrec :
    Primrec (fun x : (ℕ × List Bool) × Bool × ℕ × ℕ =>
      compare x.1.1 x.1.2 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Primrec.list_getD false).comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst)
    (comparisonIndex_primrec.comp
      ((Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst).pair Primrec.snd))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.continuous_subtractRightMap
statement: private lemma continuous_subtractRightMap : Continuous subtractRightMap
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.continuous_of_continuous_uncurry
  exact continuous_snd.sub continuous_fst

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.preimage_subtractRightMap
statement:
private lemma preimage_subtractRightMap (t : ℝ) (B : Set ℝ) :
    subtractRightMap t ⁻¹' B = t +ᵥ B
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨x - t, hx, by simp⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    simpa [subtractRightMap] using hy

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.measurableSet_vadd
statement:
private lemma measurableSet_vadd (t : ℝ) {B : Set ℝ} (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
    MeasurableSet (t +ᵥ B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← preimage_subtractRightMap]
  exact hB.preimage (subtractRightMap t).measurable

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.continuous_measureReal_symmDiff_translate
statement:
private lemma continuous_measureReal_symmDiff_translate
    {B : Set ℝ} (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hBb : Bornology.IsBounded B) (t₀ : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (volume ((t +ᵥ B) ∆ (t₀ +ᵥ B))).toReal)
      (𝓝 t₀) (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hENN := tendsto_measure_symmDiff_preimage_nhds_zero
    (continuous_subtractRightMap.tendsto t₀)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => measurePreserving_add_right volume (-t))
    (measurePreserving_add_right volume (-t₀)) hB.nullMeasurableSet hBb.measure_lt_top.ne
  simp_rw [preimage_subtractRightMap] at hENN
  have hReal := (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal ENNReal.zero_ne_top).comp hENN
  change Filter.Tendsto
    (fun t : ℝ => ENNReal.toReal (volume ((t +ᵥ B) ∆ (t₀ +ᵥ B))))
      (𝓝 t₀) (𝓝 (ENNReal.toReal 0)) at hReal
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_zero] using hReal

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.continuous_bounded_overlap
statement:
private lemma continuous_bounded_overlap
    {A B : Set ℝ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : MeasurableSet B)
    (hAb : Bornology.IsBounded A) (hBb : Bornology.IsBounded B) :
    Continuous fun t : ℝ => (volume (A ∩ (t +ᵥ B))).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro t₀
  have hsym := (continuous_measureReal_symmDiff_translate hB hBb t₀)
  apply tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.2
  have habs : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun t : ℝ => |(volume (A ∩ (t +ᵥ B))).toReal -
        (volume (A ∩ (t₀ +ᵥ B))).toReal|) (𝓝 t₀) (𝓝 0) := by
    refine squeeze_zero (fun _ => abs_nonneg _) (fun t => ?_) hsym
    calc
      |(volume (A ∩ (t +ᵥ B))).toReal -
          (volume (A ∩ (t₀ +ᵥ B))).toReal|
          ≤ (volume ((A ∩ (t +ᵥ B)) ∆ (A ∩ (t₀ +ᵥ B)))).toReal :=
            abs_measureReal_sub_le_measureReal_symmDiff'
              (hA.inter (measurableSet_vadd t hB)).nullMeasurableSet
              (hA.inter (measurableSet_vadd t₀ hB)).nullMeasurableSet
              (ne_top_of_le_ne_top hAb.measure_lt_top.ne (measure_mono inter_subset_left))
              (ne_top_of_le_ne_top hAb.measure_lt_top.ne (measure_mono inter_subset_left))
      _ = (volume (A ∩ ((t +ᵥ B) ∆ (t₀ +ᵥ B)))).toReal := by
            rw [inter_symmDiff_distrib_left]
      _ ≤ (volume ((t +ᵥ B) ∆ (t₀ +ᵥ B))).toReal :=
            measureReal_mono inter_subset_right
              (ne_top_of_le_ne_top
                ((hBb.vadd t).union (hBb.vadd t₀)).measure_lt_top.ne
                (measure_mono symmDiff_subset_union))
  simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using habs

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.overlapCorrelation_continuous_of_left_bounded
statement:
theorem overlapCorrelation_continuous_of_left_bounded :
    ∀ {A Y : Set ℝ}, MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet Y →
      Bornology.IsBounded A →
      Continuous fun t : ℝ => (volume (A ∩ (t +ᵥ Y))).toReal
proof:
:= by
  intro A Y hA hY hAb
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro t₀
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_ball (0 : ℝ)).mp hAb
  let J : Set ℝ := Metric.closedBall (-t₀) (r + 1)
  have hJ : MeasurableSet J := measurableSet_closedBall
  have hJb : Bornology.IsBounded J := Metric.isBounded_closedBall
  have hlocal :
      (fun t : ℝ => (volume (A ∩ (t +ᵥ Y))).toReal) =ᶠ[𝓝 t₀]
        (fun t : ℝ => (volume (A ∩ (t +ᵥ (Y ∩ J)))).toReal) := by
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds t₀ zero_lt_one] with t ht
    congr 2
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxA, y, hyY, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨hxA, y, ⟨hyY, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      have hxy : |t + y| < r := by
        simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hr hxA
      have htt : |t - t₀| < 1 := by
        simpa [Real.dist_eq] using ht
      change dist y (-t₀) ≤ r + 1
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      calc
        |y - -t₀| = |(t + y) - (t - t₀)| := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ |t + y| + |t - t₀| := abs_sub _ _
        _ ≤ r + 1 := (add_lt_add hxy htt).le
    · rintro ⟨hxA, y, ⟨hyY, -⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨hxA, y, hyY, rfl⟩
  exact ((continuous_bounded_overlap hA (hY.inter hJ) hAb
    (Bornology.IsBounded.subset hJb inter_subset_right)).continuousAt).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    hlocal

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.aePeriod_add
proof:
:= by
  have htranslate :=
    (quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left volume (-a)).vadd_ae_eq_of_ae_eq a hc
  have hfirst : ((a + c) +ᵥ S) =ᵐ[volume] (a +ᵥ S) := by
    simpa only [add_vadd] using htranslate
  exact hfirst.trans ha

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.aePeriod_neg
statement:
private lemma aePeriod_neg {S : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ}
    (ha : (a +ᵥ S) =ᵐ[volume] S) : ((-a) +ᵥ S) =ᵐ[volume] S
proof:
:= by
  have hq : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving (fun x : ℝ => -(-a) + x) volume volume := by
    simpa using quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left volume a
  have htranslate :=
    hq.vadd_ae_eq_of_ae_eq (-a) ha
  have hfirst : S =ᵐ[volume] ((-a) +ᵥ S) := by
    have hset : (-a) +ᵥ (a +ᵥ S) = S := by
      rw [vadd_vadd]
      simp
    rw [hset] at htranslate
    exact htranslate
  exact hfirst.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.aePeriod_zsmul
proof:
:= by
  exact (aePeriodGroup S).zsmul_mem hb n

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.restrict_periodic_vaddInvariant
statement:
private lemma restrict_periodic_vaddInvariant
    {Y : Set ℝ} {b : ℝ} (_hY : MeasurableSet Y)
    (hbY : (b +ᵥ Y) =ᵐ[volume] Y) :
    VAddInvariantMeasure (AddSubgroup.zmultiples b) ℝ (volume.restrict Y)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rintro ⟨c, hc⟩ s hs
  rcases hc with ⟨n, hn⟩
  have hcY : (c +ᵥ Y) =ᵐ[volume] Y := by
    rw [← hn]
    exact aePeriod_zsmul hbY n
  have hpre :
      (fun x : ℝ => c + x) ⁻¹' s ∩ Y =
        (fun x : ℝ => c + x) ⁻¹' (s ∩ (c +ᵥ Y)) := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxs, hxY⟩
      exact ⟨hxs, ⟨x, hxY, rfl⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨hxs, y, hyY, hxy⟩
      have : x = y := add_left_cancel hxy.symm
      exact ⟨hxs, this ▸ hyY⟩
  change (volume.restrict Y) ((fun x : ℝ => c + x) ⁻¹' s) =
    (volume.restrict Y) s
  calc
    (volume.restrict Y) ((fun x : ℝ => c + x) ⁻¹' s) =
        volume ((fun x : ℝ => c + x) ⁻¹' s ∩ Y) :=
      Measure.restrict_apply (hs.preimage (measurable_const.add measurable_id))
    _ = volume ((fun x : ℝ => c + x) ⁻¹' (s ∩ (c +ᵥ Y))) := by rw [hpre]
    _ = volume (s ∩ (c +ᵥ Y)) := measure_preimage_add volume c _
    _ = volume (s ∩ Y) := measure_congr (ae_eq_set_inter (ae_eq_refl s) hcY)
    _ = (volume.restrict Y) s := (Measure.restrict_apply hs).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.periodic_cell_measure_eq
statement:
private lemma periodic_cell_measure_eq
    {Y : Set ℝ} {b : ℝ} (hY : MeasurableSet Y) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hbY : (b +ᵥ Y) =ᵐ[volume] Y) (x : ℝ) :
    volume (Y ∩ Ioc (x - b) x) = volume (Y ∩ Ioc 0 b)
proof:
:= by
  have : VAddInvariantMeasure (AddSubgroup.zmultiples b) ℝ (volume.restrict Y) :=
    restrict_periodic_vaddInvariant hY hbY
  have h0 := isAddFundamentalDomain_Ioc hb 0 (volume.restrict Y)
  have hx := isAddFundamentalDomain_Ioc hb (x - b) (volume.restrict Y)
  have heq := hx.measure_eq h0
  simp only [sub_add_cancel, zero_add, Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_Ioc] at heq
  simpa only [inter_comm] using heq

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.setIntegral_indicator_one
statement:
private lemma setIntegral_indicator_one
    {Y C : Set ℝ} (hY : MeasurableSet Y) :
    (∫ x in C, Y.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x) =
      (volume (Y ∩ C)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_indicator_one (μ := volume.restrict C) hY
  rw [Measure.real, Measure.restrict_apply hY] at h
  exact h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.overlap_measureReal_eq_integral
statement:
private lemma overlap_measureReal_eq_integral
    {A Y : Set ℝ} (_hA : MeasurableSet A) (hY : MeasurableSet Y) (t : ℝ) :
    (volume (A ∩ (t +ᵥ Y))).toReal =
      ∫ x, Y.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (x - t) ∂volume.restrict A
proof:
:= by
  have hpre : (fun x : ℝ => x - t) ⁻¹' Y = t +ᵥ Y :=
    preimage_subtractRightMap t Y
  have hm : MeasurableSet ((fun x : ℝ => x - t) ⁻¹' Y) :=
    hY.preimage (measurable_id.sub measurable_const)
  have h := integral_indicator_one (μ := volume.restrict A) hm
  rw [Measure.real, Measure.restrict_apply hm, hpre, inter_comm] at h
  have hfun : (t +ᵥ Y).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) =
      fun x => Y.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (x - t) := by
    funext x
    have hx : x ∈ t +ᵥ Y ↔ x - t ∈ Y := by
      rw [← hpre]
      rfl
    by_cases hxt : x ∈ t +ᵥ Y
    · simp [hxt, hx.mp hxt]
    · simp [hxt, mt hx.mpr hxt]
  change (∫ x in A, (t +ᵥ Y).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x) =
    (volume (A ∩ (t +ᵥ Y))).toReal at h
  rw [hfun] at h
  exact h.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.periodic_fiber_integral
statement:
private lemma periodic_fiber_integral
    {Y : Set ℝ} {b : ℝ} (hY : MeasurableSet Y) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hbY : (b +ᵥ Y) =ᵐ[volume] Y) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ t in Ioc 0 b, Y.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (x - t)) =
      (volume (Y ∩ Ioc 0 b)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∫ t in Ioc 0 b, Y.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (x - t)) =
        ∫ t in 0..b, Y.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (x - t) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hb.le]
    _ = ∫ t in x - b..x, Y.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left, sub_zero]
    _ = ∫ t in Ioc (x - b) x, Y.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (sub_le_self x hb.le)]
    _ = (volume (Y ∩ Ioc (x - b) x)).toReal := setIntegral_indicator_one hY
    _ = (volume (Y ∩ Ioc 0 b)).toReal := by
      rw [periodic_cell_measure_eq hY hb hbY x]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.periodic_overlap_average
statement:
theorem periodic_overlap_average :
    ∀ {A Y : Set ℝ} {b : ℝ},
      MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet Y → Bornology.IsBounded A →
      0 < b → (b +ᵥ Y) =ᵐ[volume] Y →
      ∫ t in Set.Ioc 0 b, (volume (A ∩ (t +ᵥ Y))).toReal =
        (volume A).toReal * (volume (Y ∩ Set.Ioc 0 b)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  intro A Y b hA hY hAb hb hbY
  let F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => Y.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (p.2 - p.1)
  have hFm : StronglyMeasurable F := by
    exact (measurable_const.indicator hY).comp
      (measurable_snd.sub measurable_fst) |>.stronglyMeasurable
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict A) :=
    isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr hAb.measure_lt_top.ne
  have hFint : Integrable F
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 b)).prod (volume.restrict A)) := by
    refine (integrable_const (μ :=
      (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 b)).prod (volume.restrict A)) (1 : ℝ)).mono'
      hFm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards with p
    by_cases hp : p.2 - p.1 ∈ Y <;> simp [F, hp]
  have hswap := integral_integral_swap (f := fun t x => F (t, x)) hFint
  have hleft :
      (∫ t in Ioc 0 b, (volume (A ∩ (t +ᵥ Y))).toReal) =
        ∫ t, ∫ x, F (t, x) ∂volume.restrict A ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 b) := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with t
    simpa only [F] using overlap_measureReal_eq_integral hA hY t
  have hright :
      (∫ x, ∫ t, F (t, x) ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 b) ∂volume.restrict A) =
        (volume A).toReal * (volume (Y ∩ Ioc 0 b)).toReal := by
    calc
      (∫ x, ∫ t, F (t, x) ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 b) ∂volume.restrict A) =
          ∫ x, (volume (Y ∩ Ioc 0 b)).toReal ∂volume.restrict A := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards with x
        simpa only [F] using periodic_fiber_integral hY hb hbY x
      _ = (volume A).toReal * (volume (Y ∩ Ioc 0 b)).toReal := by
        rw [integral_const, Measure.real, Measure.restrict_apply MeasurableSet.univ]
        simp
  exact hleft.trans (hswap.trans hright)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.overlap_zero_of_mem_pairClosure
statement:
private lemma overlap_zero_of_mem_pairClosure
    {A X Y : Set ℝ} {a b d : ℝ}
    (hAX : A ⊆ X) (hXY : AEDisjoint volume X Y)
    (haX : (a +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X) (hbY : (b +ᵥ Y) =ᵐ[volume] Y)
    (hd : d ∈ AddSubgroup.closure ({a, b} : Set ℝ)) :
    volume (A ∩ (d +ᵥ Y)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases AddSubgroup.mem_closure_pair.mp hd with ⟨m, n, hmn⟩
  have hmX : ((m • a) +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X := aePeriod_zsmul haX m
  have hnY : ((n • b) +ᵥ Y) =ᵐ[volume] Y := aePeriod_zsmul hbY n
  have hq : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving
      (fun x : ℝ => -(m • a) + x) volume volume :=
    quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left volume (-(m • a))
  have htranslated := hXY.preimage hq
  have hpre (S : Set ℝ) : (fun x : ℝ => -(m • a) + x) ⁻¹' S =
      (m • a) +ᵥ S := by
    rw [← preimage_subtractRightMap]
    congr 1
    funext x
    simp [subtractRightMap]
    ring
  have htranslated' : AEDisjoint volume ((m • a) +ᵥ X) ((m • a) +ᵥ Y) := by
    rw [← hpre X, ← hpre Y]
    exact htranslated
  have hXshiftY : AEDisjoint volume X ((m • a) +ᵥ Y) :=
    htranslated'.congr hmX.symm (ae_eq_refl _)
  have hAshifY : AEDisjoint volume A ((m • a) +ᵥ Y) :=
    hXshiftY.mono hAX Subset.rfl
  have hdY : (d +ᵥ Y) =ᵐ[volume] ((m • a) +ᵥ Y) := by
    have htranslate :=
      (quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left volume (-(m • a))).vadd_ae_eq_of_ae_eq
        (m • a) hnY
    have htranslate' : (((m • a) + (n • b)) +ᵥ Y) =ᵐ[volume]
        ((m • a) +ᵥ Y) := by
      simpa only [add_vadd] using htranslate
    rw [hmn] at htranslate'
    exact htranslate'
  exact (hAshifY.congr (ae_eq_refl _) hdY).eq

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.periodic_cell_measureReal_pos
statement:
private lemma periodic_cell_measureReal_pos
    {Y : Set ℝ} {b : ℝ} (hY : MeasurableSet Y) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hbY : (b +ᵥ Y) =ᵐ[volume] Y) (hYne : volume Y ≠ 0) :
    0 < (volume (Y ∩ Ioc 0 b)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have hcellne : volume (Y ∩ Ioc 0 b) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hcell
    have : VAddInvariantMeasure (AddSubgroup.zmultiples b) ℝ (volume.restrict Y) :=
      restrict_periodic_vaddInvariant hY hbY
    have hfd := isAddFundamentalDomain_Ioc hb 0 (volume.restrict Y)
    have hsum := hfd.measure_eq_tsum (Set.univ : Set ℝ)
    simp only [zero_add] at hsum
    have hcell' : (volume.restrict Y) (Ioc 0 b) = 0 := by
      rw [Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_Ioc, inter_comm, hcell]
    have hterms :
        (fun g : AddSubgroup.zmultiples b =>
          (volume.restrict Y) ((g +ᵥ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) ∩ Ioc 0 b)) =
        fun _ => 0 := by
      funext g
      have hguniv : g +ᵥ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) = Set.univ := by
        apply eq_univ_of_forall
        intro x
        refine ⟨x - (g : ℝ), Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        change (g : ℝ) + (x - (g : ℝ)) = x
        ring
      calc
        (volume.restrict Y) ((g +ᵥ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) ∩ Ioc 0 b) =
            (volume.restrict Y) (Set.univ ∩ Ioc 0 b) := by rw [hguniv]
        _ = (volume.restrict Y) (Ioc 0 b) := by rw [univ_inter]
        _ = 0 := hcell'
    have hrhs : (∑' g : AddSubgroup.zmultiples b,
        (volume.restrict Y) ((g +ᵥ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) ∩ Ioc 0 b)) = 0 := by
      rw [hterms, tsum_zero]
    rw [hrhs] at hsum
    apply hYne
    simpa [Measure.restrict_apply MeasurableSet.univ] using hsum
  have hCb : Bornology.IsBounded (Ioc 0 b) := by
    rw [Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_ball (0 : ℝ)]
    refine ⟨b + 1, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hx.1.le]
    linarith [hx.2]
  exact ENNReal.toReal_pos hcellne
    (Bornology.IsBounded.subset hCb inter_subset_right).measure_lt_top.ne

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.disjointPeriodicLineSets_periods_commensurable
statement:
theorem disjointPeriodicLineSets_periods_commensurable :
    ∀ {X Y : Set ℝ} {a b : ℝ},
      MeasurableSet X → MeasurableSet Y →
      (∃ I : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded I ∧
        0 < (volume (X ∩ I)).toReal) →
      (∃ I : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded I ∧
        0 < (volume (Y ∩ I)).toReal) →
      MeasureTheory.AEDisjoint volume X Y →
      0 < a → 0 < b →
      (a +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X →
      (b +ᵥ Y) =ᵐ[volume] Y →
      ∃ q : ℚ, a = (q : ℝ) * b
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y a b hX hY hXpos hYpos hXY ha hb haX hbY
  rcases hXpos with ⟨IX, -, hIXpos⟩
  rcases hYpos with ⟨IY, -, hIYpos⟩
  have hXne : volume X ≠ 0 := volume_ne_zero_of_positive_inter hIXpos
  have hYne : volume Y ≠ 0 := volume_ne_zero_of_positive_inter hIYpos
  obtain ⟨A, hAm, hAb, hAX, hApos⟩ :=
    exists_boundedPositive_measurable_subset hX hXne
  by_contra hrat
  have hirr : Irrational (a / b) := by
    rw [Irrational]
    rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    apply hrat
    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    calc
      a = (a / b) * b := (div_mul_cancel₀ a hb.ne').symm
      _ = (q : ℝ) * b := by rw [← hq]
  have hdense : Dense (AddSubgroup.closure ({a, b} : Set ℝ) : Set ℝ) :=
    dense_addSubgroupClosure_pair_iff.mpr hirr
  let H : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (volume (A ∩ (t +ᵥ Y))).toReal
  have hHcont : Continuous H := overlapCorrelation_continuous_of_left_bounded hAm hY hAb
  have hzeroD :
      (AddSubgroup.closure ({a, b} : Set ℝ) : Set ℝ) ⊆ {t : ℝ | H t = 0} := by
    intro d hd
    change (volume (A ∩ (d +ᵥ Y))).toReal = 0
    rw [overlap_zero_of_mem_pairClosure hAX hXY haX hbY hd, ENNReal.toReal_zero]
  have hclosed : IsClosed {t : ℝ | H t = 0} :=
    isClosed_eq hHcont continuous_const
  have hall : ∀ t : ℝ, H t = 0 := by
    intro t
    exact (closure_minimal hzeroD hclosed) (hdense t)
  have havg := periodic_overlap_average hAm hY hAb hb hbY
  change (∫ t in Ioc 0 b, H t) =
    (volume A).toReal * (volume (Y ∩ Ioc 0 b)).toReal at havg
  have hleftzero : (∫ t in Ioc 0 b, H t) = 0 := by
    apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
    filter_upwards with t
    exact hall t
  have hcellpos := periodic_cell_measureReal_pos hY hb hbY hYne
  rw [hleftzero] at havg
  nlinarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.prod_univ_ae_eq_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hh := MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod h
    filter_upwards [hh] with x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Filter.Eventually.exists hx
    change (x ∈ A ∧ y ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) = (x ∈ B ∧ y ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) at hy
    change (x ∈ A) = (x ∈ B)
    exact propext (by simpa using hy)
  · intro h
    exact MeasureTheory.Measure.set_prod_ae_eq h Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.slab_aePeriod_iff_re_aePeriod
statement:
theorem slab_aePeriod_iff_re_aePeriod :
    ∀ {X : Set ℝ} {v : Tiling.Plane},
    v ∈ aePeriodGroup {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X} ↔
      (v.re +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X
proof:
:= by
  intro X v
  change (v +ᵥ {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X}) =ᵐ[volume]
      {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X} ↔ _
  have heq :
      (v +ᵥ {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X}) =
        Complex.measurableEquivRealProd ⁻¹' ((v.re +ᵥ X) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) := by
    ext z
    simp [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  rw [heq]
  have heq0 : {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X} =
      Complex.measurableEquivRealProd ⁻¹' (X ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) := by ext z; simp
  rw [heq0]
  change (Complex.measurableEquivRealProd ⁻¹' ((v.re +ᵥ X) ×ˢ Set.univ))
      =ᵐ[volume] (Complex.measurableEquivRealProd ⁻¹' (X ×ˢ Set.univ)) ↔ _
  rw [← prod_univ_ae_eq_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.symm.quasiMeasurePreserving).preimage_ae_eq h
  · intro h
    exact Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.quasiMeasurePreserving.preimage_ae_eq h

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.planarLattice_has_nonvertical_vector
statement:
theorem planarLattice_has_nonvertical_vector :
    ∀ (Lambda : PlanarLattice),
    ∃ v ∈ Lambda.toAddSubgroup, v.re ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro Lambda
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  have h0 : (Lambda.basis 0).re = 0 :=
    hn _ (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self 0))
  have h1 : (Lambda.basis 1).re = 0 :=
    hn _ (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self 1))
  have hlin := linearIndependent_fin2.mp Lambda.independent
  have him1 : (Lambda.basis 1).im ≠ 0 := by
    intro hi
    apply hlin.1
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [h1, hi]
  apply hlin.2 ((Lambda.basis 0).im / (Lambda.basis 1).im)
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp [h0, h1]
  · simp [him1]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.lattice_triangular_of_cyclic_projection
statement:
theorem lattice_triangular_of_cyclic_projection :
    ∀ (Lambda : PlanarLattice) {c : ℝ},
    0 < c →
    (∀ v ∈ Lambda.toAddSubgroup, ∃ n : ℤ, v.re = n • c) →
    ∃ alpha beta shear : ℝ,
      0 < alpha ∧ 0 < beta ∧
      Lambda.toAddSubgroup = triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear
proof:
:= by
  intro Lambda c hc hproj
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hproj (Lambda.basis 0)
    (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self 0))
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hproj (Lambda.basis 1)
    (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self 1))
  let d : ℕ := a.gcd b
  have hab : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    push Not at hn
    have hr0 : (Lambda.basis 0).re = 0 := by simpa [hn.1] using ha
    have hr1 : (Lambda.basis 1).re = 0 := by simpa [hn.2] using hb
    have hnv := planarLattice_has_nonvertical_vector Lambda
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxr⟩ := hnv
    rw [← Lambda.span_realBasis_toAddSubgroup] at hx
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℤ).mp hx
    apply hxr
    rw [← hk]
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, Lambda.realBasis_apply, hr0, hr1]
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by
    rcases hab with ha0 | hb0
    · exact Int.gcd_pos_of_ne_zero_left b ha0
    · exact Int.gcd_pos_of_ne_zero_right a hb0
  let p : ℤ := a / (d : ℤ)
  let q : ℤ := b / (d : ℤ)
  let u : ℤ := a.gcdA b
  let w : ℤ := a.gcdB b
  have hda : (d : ℤ) ∣ a := Int.gcd_dvd_left _ _
  have hdb : (d : ℤ) ∣ b := Int.gcd_dvd_right _ _
  have hpa : p * (d : ℤ) = a := Int.ediv_mul_cancel hda
  have hqb : q * (d : ℤ) = b := Int.ediv_mul_cancel hdb
  have hbez : a * u + b * w = (d : ℤ) := by
    simpa [d, u, w] using (Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab a b).symm
  have hdet : p * u + q * w = 1 := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ (show (d : ℤ) ≠ 0 by exact_mod_cast hdpos.ne')
    calc
      (p * u + q * w) * (d : ℤ) = (p * d) * u + (q * d) * w := by ring
      _ = a * u + b * w := by rw [hpa, hqb]
      _ = d := hbez
      _ = 1 * d := by simp
  have hdetR : (p : ℝ) * u + (q : ℝ) * w = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hdet
  let vert : Tiling.Plane := q • Lambda.basis 0 - p • Lambda.basis 1
  let skew : Tiling.Plane := u • Lambda.basis 0 + w • Lambda.basis 1
  have hvertre : vert.re = 0 := by
    have hpaR : (p : ℝ) * d = a := by exact_mod_cast hpa
    have hqbR : (q : ℝ) * d = b := by exact_mod_cast hqb
    simp only [Fin.isValue, zsmul_eq_mul, Complex.sub_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.intCast_re,
      ha, Complex.intCast_im, zero_mul, sub_zero, hb, vert]
    rw [← hpaR, ← hqbR]
    ring
  have hskewre : skew.re = (d : ℝ) * c := by
    have hbezR : (a : ℝ) * u + (b : ℝ) * w = d := by exact_mod_cast hbez
    simp [skew, ha, hb]
    nlinarith
  have hvertne : vert ≠ 0 := by
    intro hv
    have hlin := linearIndependent_fin2.mp Lambda.independent
    by_cases hq : q = 0
    · have hp : p ≠ 0 := by
        intro hp
        simp [hq, hp] at hdet
      have hv' : (p : ℝ) • Lambda.basis 1 = 0 := by
        simpa [vert, hq] using hv.symm
      exact hlin.1 ((smul_eq_zero.mp hv').resolve_left (by exact_mod_cast hp))
    · apply hlin.2 ((q : ℝ)⁻¹ * (p : ℝ))
      have hv' : (q : ℝ) • Lambda.basis 0 = (p : ℝ) • Lambda.basis 1 := by
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa [vert] using hv)
      calc
        ((q : ℝ)⁻¹ * (p : ℝ)) • Lambda.basis 1 =
            (q : ℝ)⁻¹ • ((p : ℝ) • Lambda.basis 1) := by rw [smul_smul]
        _ = (q : ℝ)⁻¹ • ((q : ℝ) • Lambda.basis 0) := by rw [hv']
        _ = Lambda.basis 0 := by simp [hq]
  have hvertim : vert.im ≠ 0 := by
    intro hi
    apply hvertne
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hvertre, hi]
  refine ⟨|vert.im|, (d : ℝ) * c, skew.im, abs_pos.mpr hvertim,
    mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hdpos) hc, ?_⟩
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [← Lambda.span_realBasis_toAddSubgroup] at hx
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℤ).mp hx
    let r : ℤ := w * k 0 - u * k 1
    let s : ℤ := p * k 0 + q * k 1
    change ∃ m n : ℤ, x = m • verticalPeriodVector |vert.im| +
      n • skewPeriodVector ((d : ℝ) * c) skew.im
    have hsum : (∑ i, k i • Lambda.realBasis i) =
        (k 0 : ℝ) • Lambda.basis 0 + (k 1 : ℝ) • Lambda.basis 1 := by
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, Lambda.realBasis_apply]
    have hcomb : (k 0 : ℝ) • Lambda.basis 0 + (k 1 : ℝ) • Lambda.basis 1 =
        (r : ℝ) • vert + (s : ℝ) • skew := by
      have hdetR' : (q : ℝ) * w + (p : ℝ) * u = 1 := by nlinarith [hdetR]
      have he : (r : ℝ) • vert + (s : ℝ) • skew =
          (((q : ℝ) * w + (p : ℝ) * u) * k 0) • Lambda.basis 0 +
            (((q : ℝ) * w + (p : ℝ) * u) * k 1) • Lambda.basis 1 := by
        simp [r, s, vert, skew]
        ring_nf
      rw [he, hdetR']
      simp
    by_cases hvpos : 0 < vert.im
    · refine ⟨r, s, ?_⟩
      have hvform : verticalPeriodVector |vert.im| = vert := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [verticalPeriodVector, hvertre, abs_of_pos hvpos]
      have hsform : skewPeriodVector ((d : ℝ) * c) skew.im = skew := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [skewPeriodVector, hskewre]
      rw [← hk, hsum, hcomb, hvform, hsform]
      norm_cast
    · refine ⟨-r, s, ?_⟩
      have hvneg : vert.im < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hvpos) hvertim
      have hvform : verticalPeriodVector |vert.im| = -vert := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [verticalPeriodVector, hvertre, abs_of_neg hvneg]
      have hsform : skewPeriodVector ((d : ℝ) * c) skew.im = skew := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [skewPeriodVector, hskewre]
      rw [← hk, hsum, hcomb, hvform, hsform]
      simp
  · change (∃ m n : ℤ, x = m • verticalPeriodVector |vert.im| +
      n • skewPeriodVector ((d : ℝ) * c) skew.im) → _
    rintro ⟨r, s, rfl⟩
    rw [← Lambda.span_realBasis_toAddSubgroup]
    have hbmem (i : Fin 2) : Lambda.basis i ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range Lambda.realBasis) := by
      rw [← Lambda.realBasis_apply]
      exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self i)
    apply Submodule.add_mem
    · by_cases hvpos : 0 < vert.im
      · have heq : verticalPeriodVector |vert.im| = vert := by
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [verticalPeriodVector, hvertre, abs_of_pos hvpos]
        rw [heq]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.sub_mem _
          (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hbmem 0))
          (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hbmem 1)))
      · have hvneg : vert.im < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hvpos) hvertim
        have heq : verticalPeriodVector |vert.im| = -vert := by
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [verticalPeriodVector, hvertre, abs_of_neg hvneg]
        rw [heq]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.neg_mem _ (Submodule.sub_mem _
          (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hbmem 0))
          (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hbmem 1))))
    · have heq : skewPeriodVector ((d : ℝ) * c) skew.im = skew := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [skewPeriodVector, hskewre]
      rw [heq]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.add_mem _
        (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hbmem 0))
        (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hbmem 1)))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_verticalSlabNormalForm
statement:
theorem exists_verticalSlabNormalForm
    :
    ∀ {Lambda : PlanarLattice} {X : Set ℝ},
    MeasurableSet X →
    volume X ≠ 0 →
    volume Xᶜ ≠ 0 →
    Lambda.toAddSubgroup ≤
      aePeriodGroup {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X} →
    Nonempty (VerticalSlabLatticeForm Lambda)
proof:
:= by
  intro Lambda X hX hXne hXcne hsub
  obtain ⟨v, hvL, hvre⟩ := planarLattice_has_nonvertical_vector Lambda
  have hvperiod : (v.re +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X :=
    slab_aePeriod_iff_re_aePeriod.mp (hsub hvL)
  obtain ⟨c, hcprop, _⟩ := properPeriodicLine_periodGroup_cyclic
    hX hXne hXcne ⟨v.re, hvre, hvperiod⟩
  obtain ⟨hc, hcperiod⟩ := hcprop
  obtain ⟨alpha, beta, shear, halpha, hbeta, hgroup⟩ :=
    lattice_triangular_of_cyclic_projection Lambda hc (by
      intro w hw
      have hwperiod : (w.re +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X :=
        slab_aePeriod_iff_re_aePeriod.mp (hsub hw)
      exact (hcperiod w.re).mp hwperiod)
  exact ⟨{
    verticalPeriod := alpha
    horizontalPeriod := beta
    shear := shear
    verticalPeriod_pos := halpha
    horizontalPeriod_pos := hbeta
    subgroup_eq := hgroup
  }⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.volume_ne_zero_of_positive_inter
statement:
theorem volume_ne_zero_of_positive_inter :
    ∀ {X I : Set ℝ}, 0 < (volume (X ∩ I)).toReal → volume X ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro X I hpos hzero
  have hsub : X ∩ I ⊆ X := inter_subset_left
  have : volume (X ∩ I) = 0 := measure_mono_null hsub hzero
  simp [this] at hpos

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_boundedPositive_measurable_subset
statement:
theorem exists_boundedPositive_measurable_subset :
    ∀ {X : Set ℝ}, MeasurableSet X → volume X ≠ 0 →
      ∃ A : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet A ∧ Bornology.IsBounded A ∧
        A ⊆ X ∧ 0 < (volume A).toReal
proof:
:= by
  intro X hX hX0
  have hcover : X = ⋃ n : ℕ, X ∩ Set.Icc (-(n : ℝ)) n := by
    apply Set.ext
    intro x
    simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_inter_iff, mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt |x|
      refine ⟨n, hx, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (abs_lt.mp hn).1.le
      · exact (abs_lt.mp hn).2.le
    · rintro ⟨n, hx, -, -⟩
      exact hx
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, volume (X ∩ Set.Icc (-(n : ℝ)) n) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hX0
    rw [hcover]
    exact measure_iUnion_null h
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hex
  have hbdd : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.Icc (-(n : ℝ)) n) := by
    rw [Metric.isBounded_iff]
    refine ⟨2 * n, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    rcases hx with ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩
    rcases hy with ⟨hy₁, hy₂⟩
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> norm_num at * <;> linarith
  refine ⟨X ∩ Set.Icc (-(n : ℝ)) n, hX.inter measurableSet_Icc,
    hbdd.subset inter_subset_right, inter_subset_left, ?_⟩
  apply ENNReal.toReal_pos hn
  exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by rw [Real.volume_Icc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)
    (measure_mono inter_subset_right)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.positive_cyclic_generator_unique_aux
statement:
private theorem positive_cyclic_generator_unique_aux
    {c d : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hcd : ∃ n : ℤ, c = n • d) (hdc : ∃ m : ℤ, d = m • c) :
    c = d
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcd with ⟨n, hn⟩
  rcases hdc with ⟨m, hm⟩
  rw [zsmul_eq_mul] at hn hm
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by
    have hnreal : 0 < (n : ℝ) :=
      (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right hd).mp (hn ▸ hc)
    exact_mod_cast hnreal
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by
    have hmreal : 0 < (m : ℝ) :=
      (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right hc).mp (hm ▸ hd)
    exact_mod_cast hmreal
  have hprodReal : (((n * m : ℤ) : ℝ)) = 1 := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hc.ne'
    calc
      (((n * m : ℤ) : ℝ)) * c = (n : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) * c) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      _ = (n : ℝ) * d := by rw [← hm]
      _ = c := by rw [← hn]
      _ = 1 * c := by ring
  have hprod : n * m = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hprodReal
  have hn_one : n = 1 := by nlinarith [hprod]
  subst n
  simpa using hn

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.positive_cyclic_generator_unique
statement:
theorem positive_cyclic_generator_unique :
    ∀ {c d : ℝ}, 0 < c → 0 < d →
    (∀ a : ℝ, ((∃ n : ℤ, a = n • c) ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, a = n • d)) →
    c = d
proof:
:= by
  intro c d hc hd h
  apply positive_cyclic_generator_unique_aux hc hd
  · exact (h c).mp ⟨1, by simp⟩
  · exact (h d).mpr ⟨1, by simp⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.continuous_subtractTranslation
statement: private lemma continuous_subtractTranslation : Continuous subtractTranslation
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.continuous_of_continuous_uncurry
  change Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ p.2 - p.1
  fun_prop

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.measurePreserving_subtractTranslation
statement:
private lemma measurePreserving_subtractTranslation (a : ℝ) :
    MeasurePreserving (subtractTranslation a) volume volume
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [subtractTranslation, ContinuousMap.coe_mk, sub_eq_add_neg] using
    measurePreserving_add_right volume (-a)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.preimage_truncation_inter_Icc
statement:
private lemma preimage_truncation_inter_Icc
    {X : Set ℝ} {a M r : ℝ} (ha : |a| ≤ M) :
    (subtractTranslation a ⁻¹' (X ∩ Set.Icc (-(r + M)) (r + M))) ∩
        Set.Icc (-r) r =
      (a +ᵥ X) ∩ Set.Icc (-r) r
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, mem_Icc]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hxX, -, -⟩, hxI⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hxI⟩
    simpa [subtractTranslation, mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, sub_eq_add_neg,
      add_comm] using hxX
  · rintro ⟨hxX, hxlo, hxhi⟩
    have hxX' : x - a ∈ X := by
      simpa [subtractTranslation, mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, sub_eq_add_neg,
        add_comm] using hxX
    have ha' := abs_le.mp ha
    refine ⟨⟨hxX', ?_, ?_⟩, hxlo, hxhi⟩
    · change -(r + M) ≤ x - a
      linarith
    · change x - a ≤ r + M
      linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.lineAEPeriodSet_isClosed
statement:
theorem lineAEPeriodSet_isClosed : ∀ {X : Set ℝ}, MeasurableSet X →
    IsClosed {a : ℝ | (a +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X}
proof:
:= by
  intro X hX
  apply IsSeqClosed.isClosed
  intro u a hperiod hu
  change ∀ n, (u n +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X at hperiod
  change (a +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X
  rw [← measure_symmDiff_eq_zero_iff]
  have hcover : ((a +ᵥ X) ∆ X) =
      ⋃ m : ℕ, ((a +ᵥ X) ∆ X) ∩ Set.Icc (-(m : ℝ)) m := by
    apply Set.ext
    intro x
    simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_inter_iff, mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_gt |x|
      exact ⟨m, hx, (abs_lt.mp hm).1.le, (abs_lt.mp hm).2.le⟩
    · rintro ⟨m, hx, -, -⟩
      exact hx
  rw [hcover]
  apply measure_iUnion_null
  intro m
  have hub : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, |u n| ≤ |a| + 1 := by
    have hnear : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, dist (u n) a < 1 :=
      (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hu) 1 zero_lt_one
    filter_upwards [hnear] with n hn
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hn
    calc
      |u n| = |(u n - a) + a| := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ |u n - a| + |a| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ |a| + 1 := by linarith
  let I : Set ℝ := Set.Icc (-(m : ℝ)) m
  let J : Set ℝ :=
    Set.Icc (-((m : ℝ) + (|a| + 1))) ((m : ℝ) + (|a| + 1))
  let q : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun n ↦
    volume (((subtractTranslation (u n)) ⁻¹' (X ∩ J)) ∆
      ((subtractTranslation a) ⁻¹' (X ∩ J)))
  have hJm : NullMeasurableSet (X ∩ J) volume :=
    (hX.inter measurableSet_Icc).nullMeasurableSet
  have hJfin : volume (X ∩ J) ≠ ∞ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by rw [Real.volume_Icc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)
      (measure_mono inter_subset_right)
  have hq : Tendsto q atTop (nhds 0) := by
    apply MeasureTheory.tendsto_measure_symmDiff_preimage_nhds_zero
      (X := ℝ) (Y := ℝ) (μ := volume) (ν := volume)
    · exact continuous_subtractTranslation.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hu
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall
        (fun n ↦ measurePreserving_subtractTranslation (u n))
    · exact measurePreserving_subtractTranslation a
    · exact hJm
    · exact hJfin
  have hqbound : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      volume ((((a +ᵥ X) ∆ X) ∩ I)) ≤ q n := by
    filter_upwards [hub] with n hn
    have hun := preimage_truncation_inter_Icc (X := X) (r := (m : ℝ)) hn
    have ha_le : |a| ≤ |a| + 1 := by linarith
    have ha' := preimage_truncation_inter_Icc (X := X) (r := (m : ℝ)) ha_le
    have hpI : (((u n +ᵥ X) ∩ I : Set ℝ) : ℝ → Prop) =ᵐ[volume]
