        (((X ∩ I : Set ℝ) : ℝ → Prop)) :=
      (hperiod n).inter (Filter.EventuallyEq.refl (ae volume) (I : ℝ → Prop))
    have hsymmI : (((a +ᵥ X) ∆ X) ∩ I) =
        (((a +ᵥ X) ∩ I) ∆ (X ∩ I)) := by
      ext x
      simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_symmDiff]
      tauto
    calc
      volume (((a +ᵥ X) ∆ X) ∩ I) =
          volume (((a +ᵥ X) ∩ I) ∆ (X ∩ I)) := congrArg volume hsymmI
      _ = volume (((a +ᵥ X) ∩ I) ∆ ((u n +ᵥ X) ∩ I)) :=
        measure_congr
          ((Filter.EventuallyEq.refl (ae volume)
            ((((a +ᵥ X) ∩ I : Set ℝ) : ℝ → Prop))).symmDiff hpI.symm)
      _ = volume (((u n +ᵥ X) ∩ I) ∆ ((a +ᵥ X) ∩ I)) := by
        rw [symmDiff_comm]
      _ = volume (((((subtractTranslation (u n)) ⁻¹' (X ∩ J)) ∆
          ((subtractTranslation a) ⁻¹' (X ∩ J))) ∩ I)) := by
        rw [inter_symmDiff_distrib_right, hun, ha']
      _ ≤ q n := measure_mono inter_subset_left
  exact bot_unique (ge_of_tendsto hq hqbound)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.integrable_setIndicator
proof:
:= by
  rw [setIndicator, integrable_indicator_iff hA]
  exact integrableOn_const hAbdd.measure_lt_top.ne

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.convolution_setIndicator_eq_overlap
statement:
private lemma convolution_setIndicator_eq_overlap
    {A B : Set ℝ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : MeasurableSet B)
    (_hAbdd : Bornology.IsBounded A) (_hBbdd : Bornology.IsBounded B) (t : ℝ) :
    MeasureTheory.convolution (setIndicator A) (setIndicator (-B))
        (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) volume t =
      (volume (A ∩ (t +ᵥ B))).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [MeasureTheory.convolution]
  change _ = volume.real (A ∩ (t +ᵥ B))
  rw [← integral_indicator_one (hA.inter (hB.const_vadd t))]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with x
  by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
  · by_cases hxB : x ∈ t +ᵥ B
    · have hneg : t - x ∈ -B := by
        simpa [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hxB
      simp [setIndicator, hxA, hxB, hneg]
    · have hneg : t - x ∉ -B := by
        contrapose! hxB
        simpa [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hxB
      simp [setIndicator, hxA, hxB, hneg]
  · simp [setIndicator, hxA]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.translateOverlap_integral
statement:
theorem translateOverlap_integral : ∀ {A B : Set ℝ},
    MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B →
    Bornology.IsBounded A → Bornology.IsBounded B →
    ∫ t : ℝ, (volume (A ∩ (t +ᵥ B))).toReal =
      (volume A).toReal * (volume B).toReal
proof:
:= by
  intro A B hA hB hAbdd hBbdd
  have hiA : Integrable (setIndicator A) := integrable_setIndicator hA hAbdd
  have hiB : Integrable (setIndicator (-B)) :=
    integrable_setIndicator hB.neg hBbdd.neg
  calc
    ∫ t : ℝ, (volume (A ∩ (t +ᵥ B))).toReal =
        ∫ t : ℝ, MeasureTheory.convolution (setIndicator A) (setIndicator (-B))
          (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) volume t := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with t
      exact (convolution_setIndicator_eq_overlap hA hB hAbdd hBbdd t).symm
    _ = (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) (∫ x, setIndicator A x)
          (∫ x, setIndicator (-B) x) :=
      MeasureTheory.integral_convolution (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) hiA hiB
    _ = (volume A).toReal * (volume B).toReal := by
      simp only [setIndicator]
      rw [integral_indicator_const (1 : ℝ) hA,
        integral_indicator_const (1 : ℝ) hB.neg]
      simp [measureReal_def, volume.measure_neg]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.all_lineAEPeriods_null_or_conull
statement:
theorem all_lineAEPeriods_null_or_conull :
    ∀ {X : Set ℝ}, MeasurableSet X →
    (∀ a : ℝ, (a +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X) →
    volume X = 0 ∨ volume Xᶜ = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro X hX hperiod
  by_contra hproper
  push Not at hproper
  obtain ⟨A, hAm, hAbdd, hAX, hApos⟩ := exists_boundedPositive_measurable_subset hX hproper.1
  obtain ⟨B, hBm, hBbdd, hBX, hBpos⟩ := exists_boundedPositive_measurable_subset hX.compl hproper.2
  have hzero : ∀ t : ℝ, volume (A ∩ (t +ᵥ B)) = 0 := by
    intro t
    have hcomp : (t +ᵥ Xᶜ) =ᵐ[volume] Xᶜ := by
      have hset : t +ᵥ Xᶜ = (t +ᵥ X)ᶜ := by
        ext x
        simp [mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      rw [hset]
      exact (hperiod t).compl
    have hnull : volume (X ∩ (t +ᵥ Xᶜ)) = 0 := by
      calc
        volume (X ∩ (t +ᵥ Xᶜ)) = volume (X ∩ Xᶜ) :=
          measure_congr
            (Filter.EventuallyEq.inter (Filter.EventuallyEq.refl (ae volume) X) hcomp)
        _ = 0 := by simp
    apply measure_mono_null _ hnull
    rintro x ⟨hxA, hxB⟩
    refine ⟨hAX hxA, ?_⟩
    exact Set.image_mono hBX hxB
  have hint := translateOverlap_integral hAm hBm hAbdd hBbdd
  have hintzero : ∫ t : ℝ, (volume (A ∩ (t +ᵥ B))).toReal = 0 := by
    apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
    filter_upwards with t
    simp [hzero t]
  rw [hintzero] at hint
  nlinarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.dense_lineAEPeriods_null_or_conull
statement:
theorem dense_lineAEPeriods_null_or_conull :
    ∀ {X : Set ℝ}, MeasurableSet X →
    Dense {a : ℝ | (a +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X} →
    volume X = 0 ∨ volume Xᶜ = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro X hX hdense
  apply all_lineAEPeriods_null_or_conull hX
  have hclosed := lineAEPeriodSet_isClosed hX
  have huniv : {a : ℝ | (a +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X} = Set.univ := by
    calc
      {a : ℝ | (a +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X} =
          closure {a : ℝ | (a +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X} := hclosed.closure_eq.symm
      _ = Set.univ := dense_iff_closure_eq.mp hdense
  intro a
  have ha : a ∈ {a : ℝ | (a +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X} := by
    rw [huniv]
    exact Set.mem_univ a
  exact ha

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.properPeriodicLine_periodGroup_cyclic
statement:
theorem properPeriodicLine_periodGroup_cyclic :
    ∀ {X : Set ℝ},
    MeasurableSet X →
    volume X ≠ 0 →
    volume Xᶜ ≠ 0 →
    (∃ a : ℝ, a ≠ 0 ∧ (a +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X) →
    ∃! c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧
      ∀ a : ℝ, ((a +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, a = n • c)
proof:
:= by
  intro X hX hX0 hXc0 hnonzero
  let G : AddSubgroup ℝ := AddAction.aestabilizer ℝ volume X
  have hmem (a : ℝ) : a ∈ G ↔ (a +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X := Iff.rfl
  rcases AddSubgroup.dense_or_cyclic G with hdense | ⟨d, hd⟩
  · change Dense {a : ℝ | (a +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X} at hdense
    have hnull := dense_lineAEPeriods_null_or_conull hX hdense
    exact (hnull.elim hX0 hXc0).elim
  · obtain ⟨p, hp0, hp⟩ := hnonzero
    have hpG : p ∈ G := (hmem p).mpr hp
    have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := by
      intro hd0
      subst d
      rw [hd, AddSubgroup.mem_closure_singleton] at hpG
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hpG
      apply hp0
      simpa using hn.symm
    have hGabs : G = AddSubgroup.zmultiples |d| := by
      calc
        G = AddSubgroup.closure {d} := hd
        _ = AddSubgroup.zmultiples d := (AddSubgroup.zmultiples_eq_closure d).symm
        _ = AddSubgroup.zmultiples |d| := by
          rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hd0 with hneg | hpos
          · rw [abs_of_neg hneg, AddSubgroup.zmultiples_neg]
          · rw [abs_of_pos hpos]
    have hcharacterization (a : ℝ) :
        ((a +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, a = n • |d|) := by
      rw [← hmem, hGabs, AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff]
      exact exists_congr fun n ↦ eq_comm
    refine ⟨|d|, ⟨abs_pos.mpr hd0, hcharacterization⟩, ?_⟩
    intro c hc
    rcases hc with ⟨hcpos, hcchar⟩
    exact (positive_cyclic_generator_unique (abs_pos.mpr hd0) hcpos fun a ↦
      (hcharacterization a).symm.trans (hcchar a)).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.triangularLattice_subgroup
statement:
private theorem triangularLattice_subgroup
    (alpha beta shear : ℝ) (hα : 0 < alpha) (hβ : 0 < beta) :
    (triangularLattice alpha beta shear hα hβ).toAddSubgroup =
      triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [PlanarLattice.toAddSubgroup, Tiling.Polygonal.PlanarLattice.toAddSubgroup,
      AddSubgroup.closure_le]
    rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change ![verticalPeriodVector alpha, skewPeriodVector beta shear] i ∈
      triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear
    fin_cases i
    · exact ⟨1, 0, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨0, 1, by simp⟩
  · rintro x ⟨m, n, rfl⟩
    apply add_mem
    · apply AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ?_) m
      exact ⟨0, by simp [triangularLattice]⟩
    · apply AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ?_) n
      exact ⟨1, by simp [triangularLattice]⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.triangular_subgroup_le_periodGroup
statement:
private theorem triangular_subgroup_le_periodGroup
    {S : Set Tiling.Plane} {alpha beta shear : ℝ}
    (hvertical : verticalPeriodVector alpha ∈ periodGroup S)
    (hskew : skewPeriodVector beta shear ∈ periodGroup S) :
    triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear ≤ periodGroup S
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨m, n, rfl⟩
  exact add_mem ((periodGroup S).zsmul_mem hvertical m)
    ((periodGroup S).zsmul_mem hskew n)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.exists_finiteOrbitRepresentatives
statement:
theorem exists_finiteOrbitRepresentatives :
    ∀ {K : Region} {S D : Set Tiling.Plane} {alpha beta shear : ℝ},
      0 < alpha → 0 < beta → TilesOn K S D →
      verticalPeriodVector alpha ∈ periodGroup S →
      skewPeriodVector beta shear ∈ periodGroup S →
      ∃ R : Finset Tiling.Plane,
        (R : Set Tiling.Plane) ⊆ S ∧
        QuotientAddGroup.mk' (triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear) ''
            (R : Set Tiling.Plane) =
          QuotientAddGroup.mk' (triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear) '' S ∧
        Set.InjOn
          (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear))
          (R : Set Tiling.Plane)
proof:
:= by
  intro K S D alpha beta shear hα hβ hTile hvertical hskew
  let L := triangularLattice alpha beta shear hα hβ
  have hLF := (IsPacking.locallyFinite_centres hTile.2.1).1
  have hlocal : ∀ Q, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (S ∩ Q).Finite := by
    intro Q hQ
    exact hLF Q hQ
  have hLH : L.toAddSubgroup = triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear :=
    triangularLattice_subgroup alpha beta shear hα hβ
  have hperiod : L.toAddSubgroup ≤ periodGroup S := by
    rw [hLH]
    exact triangular_subgroup_le_periodGroup hvertical hskew
  obtain ⟨R, hsub, hsurj, hinj⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.exists_finiteOrbitRepresentatives_of_planarLattice
      L hlocal hperiod
  refine ⟨R, hsub, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hLH]
    exact hsurj
  · rw [← hLH]
    exact hinj

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.tsum_tsum_indicator_of_subsingleton
statement:
private lemma tsum_tsum_indicator_of_subsingleton
    {A B : Type*} (U : A → B → Set Tiling.Plane) (x : Tiling.Plane)
    (hsub : {p : A × B | x ∈ U p.1 p.2}.Subsingleton) :
    (∑' a : A, ∑' b : B, Set.indicator (U a b) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x) =
      Set.indicator {x | ∃ p : A × B, x ∈ U p.1 p.2} (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hex : ∃ p : A × B, x ∈ U p.1 p.2
  · obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab⟩ := hex
    have hinner : ∀ a' : A,
        (∑' b' : B, Set.indicator (U a' b') (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x) =
          if a' = a then 1 else 0 := by
      intro a'
      by_cases haa : a' = a
      · subst a'
        rw [if_pos rfl, tsum_eq_single b]
        · simp [hab]
        · intro b' hba
          have hn : x ∉ U a b' := by
            intro hb'
            have he : (a, b') = (a, b) := hsub hb' hab
            exact hba (congrArg Prod.snd he)
          simp [hn]
      · rw [if_neg haa]
        have hz : (fun b' : B ↦
            Set.indicator (U a' b') (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x) = fun _ ↦ 0 := by
          funext b'
          have hn : x ∉ U a' b' := by
            intro hb'
            have he : (a', b') = (a, b) := hsub hb' hab
            exact haa (congrArg Prod.fst he)
          simp [hn]
        rw [hz, tsum_zero]
    simp_rw [hinner]
    rw [tsum_ite_eq a]
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem]
    exact ⟨(a, b), hab⟩
  · have hall : ∀ a b, x ∉ U a b := by
      intro a b hx
      exact hex ⟨(a, b), hx⟩
    have hmem : x ∉ {x | ∃ p : A × B, x ∈ U p.1 p.2} := hex
    simp only [Set.indicator, hmem, if_false]
    simp [hall]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.periodizedTileMultiplicity_ae_eq_slabIndicator
statement:
theorem periodizedTileMultiplicity_ae_eq_slabIndicator :
    ∀ {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane} {X : Set ℝ}
      {alpha beta shear : ℝ} (R : Finset Tiling.Plane),
      0 < alpha → 0 < beta → MeasurableSet X →
      TilesOn K S {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X} →
      verticalPeriodVector alpha ∈ periodGroup S →
      skewPeriodVector beta shear ∈ periodGroup S →
      (R : Set Tiling.Plane) ⊆ S →
      QuotientAddGroup.mk' (triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear) ''
          (R : Set Tiling.Plane) =
        QuotientAddGroup.mk' (triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear) '' S →
      Set.InjOn
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear))
        (R : Set Tiling.Plane) →
      ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (triangularFundamentalDomain alpha beta shear),
        periodizedTileMultiplicity K R alpha beta shear x =
          Set.indicator {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X}
            (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x
proof:
:= by
  intro K S X alpha beta shear R hα hβ hX hTile hvertical hskew hRS hQ hinj
  let H := triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear
  let e : (↑R × ↑H) ≃ ↑S :=
    orbitCentreEquiv R hvertical hskew hRS hQ hinj
  let U : ↑R → ↑H → Set Tiling.Plane := fun r l ↦
    (l.1 + r.1) +ᵥ K.openCarrier
  have hsingle (x : Tiling.Plane) :
      {p : ↑R × ↑H | x ∈ U p.1 p.2}.Subsingleton := by
    intro p hp q hq
    apply e.injective
    apply Subtype.ext
    by_contra hne
    have hd := (isPacking_iff_openCarrier_disjoint K S).mp hTile.2.1
      (e p).2 (e q).2 hne
    apply Set.disjoint_left.1 hd hp hq
  have hex (x : Tiling.Plane) :
      (∃ p : ↑R × ↑H, x ∈ U p.1 p.2) ↔
        ∃ s : S, x ∈ (s.1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier) := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
      exact ⟨e p, hp⟩
    · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
      refine ⟨e.symm s, ?_⟩
      change x ∈ (e (e.symm s)).1 +ᵥ K.openCarrier
      rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hs
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae hTile.2.2] with x hx
  rw [show periodizedTileMultiplicity K R alpha beta shear x =
      ∑' r : ↑R, ∑' l : ↑H,
        Set.indicator (U r l) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x by rfl]
  rw [tsum_tsum_indicator_of_subsingleton U x (hsingle x)]
  by_cases hD : x.re ∈ X
  · have hp : x ∈ {x | ∃ p : ↑R × ↑H, x ∈ U p.1 p.2} :=
      (hex x).2 (hx.mp hD)
    have hD' : x ∈ {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X} := hD
    simp only [Set.indicator, hp, hD', if_true]
  · have hn : x ∉ {x | ∃ p : ↑R × ↑H, x ∈ U p.1 p.2} := by
      intro hp
      exact hD (hx.mpr ((hex x).1 hp))
    have hD' : x ∉ {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X} := hD
    simp only [Set.indicator, hn, hD', if_false]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.mem_triangularFundamentalDomain_mk_iff
statement:
private lemma mem_triangularFundamentalDomain_mk_iff
    {alpha beta shear x y : ℝ} (hα : 0 < alpha) (hβ : 0 < beta) :
    Complex.mk x y ∈ triangularFundamentalDomain alpha beta shear ↔
      x ∈ Set.Ico 0 beta ∧
        y ∈ Set.Ico (shear * (x / beta)) (shear * (x / beta) + alpha)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, ⟨hu0, hu1⟩, v, ⟨hv0, hv1⟩, heq⟩
    have hx : x = beta * u := congrArg Complex.re heq
    have hy : y = shear * u + alpha * v := congrArg Complex.im heq
    have hu : x / beta = u := by
      rw [hx, mul_div_cancel_left₀ u hβ.ne']
    constructor
    · constructor <;> nlinarith
    · rw [hu, hy]
      constructor <;> nlinarith
  · rintro ⟨⟨hx0, hxβ⟩, hy0, hyα⟩
    let u := x / beta
    let v := (y - shear * u) / alpha
    have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := div_nonneg hx0 hβ.le
    have hu1 : u < 1 := (div_lt_one hβ).2 hxβ
    have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := div_nonneg (by simpa [u] using hy0) hα.le
    have hv1 : v < 1 := by
      rw [div_lt_one hα]
      dsimp only [u]
      linarith
    refine ⟨u, ⟨hu0, hu1⟩, v, ⟨hv0, hv1⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Complex.ext
    · dsimp only [u]
      field_simp
    · change y = shear * u + alpha * v
      dsimp only [v]
      field_simp
      ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.integral_slabIndicator_triangularFundamentalDomain
statement:
theorem integral_slabIndicator_triangularFundamentalDomain :
    ∀ {X : Set ℝ} {alpha beta shear : ℝ},
      0 < alpha → 0 < beta → MeasurableSet X →
      (beta +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X →
      ∫ x in triangularFundamentalDomain alpha beta shear,
          Set.indicator {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X}
            (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x =
        alpha * (volume (X ∩ Set.Ico 0 beta)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  intro X alpha beta shear hα hβ hX _hXperiod
  let C : Set Tiling.Plane := {z | z.re ∈ X}
  let P : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {p |
    p.1 ∈ X ∩ Set.Ico 0 beta ∧
      p.2 ∈ Set.Ico (shear * (p.1 / beta))
        (shear * (p.1 / beta) + alpha)}
  have hPm : MeasurableSet P := by
    have hx : Measurable fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ p.1 := measurable_fst
    have hy : Measurable fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ p.2 := measurable_snd
    exact ((hX.inter measurableSet_Ico).preimage hx).inter
      ((measurableSet_le (measurable_const.mul (hx.div_const beta)) hy).inter
        (measurableSet_lt hy
          ((measurable_const.mul (hx.div_const beta)).add measurable_const)))
  have hpre : Complex.measurableEquivRealProd ⁻¹' P =
      C ∩ triangularFundamentalDomain alpha beta shear := by
    ext z
    simp only [mem_preimage, Complex.measurableEquivRealProd_apply, P, C,
      mem_inter_iff, mem_ofPred_eq]
    rw [mem_triangularFundamentalDomain_mk_iff hα hβ]
    tauto
  have hmeasure : volume (C ∩ triangularFundamentalDomain alpha beta shear) =
      volume P := by
    rw [← hpre]
    exact Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.measure_preimage
      hPm.nullMeasurableSet
  have hPvolume : volume P = ENNReal.ofReal alpha * volume (X ∩ Set.Ico 0 beta) := by
    change (volume.prod volume) P = _
    rw [Measure.prod_apply hPm]
    have hfiber (x : ℝ) : volume (Prod.mk x ⁻¹' P) =
        Set.indicator (X ∩ Set.Ico 0 beta)
          (fun _ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal alpha) x := by
      by_cases hx : x ∈ X ∩ Set.Ico 0 beta
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
        have heq : Prod.mk x ⁻¹' P =
            Set.Ico (shear * (x / beta)) (shear * (x / beta) + alpha) := by
          ext y
          change (x ∈ X ∩ Set.Ico 0 beta ∧
            y ∈ Set.Ico (shear * (x / beta))
              (shear * (x / beta) + alpha)) ↔ _
          exact and_iff_right hx
        rw [heq, Real.volume_Ico]
        simp
      · simp only [Set.indicator, hx, if_false]
        have heq : Prod.mk x ⁻¹' P = ∅ := by
          ext y
          change (x ∈ X ∩ Set.Ico 0 beta ∧
            y ∈ Set.Ico (shear * (x / beta))
              (shear * (x / beta) + alpha)) ↔ False
          simp [hx]
        simp [heq]
    simp_rw [hfiber]
    rw [lintegral_indicator (hX.inter measurableSet_Ico)]
    simp
  have hCm : MeasurableSet C := hX.preimage Complex.measurable_re
  change ∫ x in triangularFundamentalDomain alpha beta shear,
    C.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x = _
  change ∫ x, C.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x
      ∂volume.restrict (triangularFundamentalDomain alpha beta shear) = _
  rw [integral_indicator hCm, integral_const]
  rw [Measure.real, Measure.restrict_apply MeasurableSet.univ, univ_inter,
    Measure.restrict_apply hCm]
  rw [hmeasure, hPvolume]
  simp [ENNReal.toReal_mul, hα.le]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.triangularFundamentalDomain_eq_zspan
statement:
private lemma triangularFundamentalDomain_eq_zspan
    (alpha beta shear : ℝ) (hα : 0 < alpha) (hβ : 0 < beta) :
    triangularFundamentalDomain alpha beta shear =
      ZSpan.fundamentalDomain
        (triangularLattice alpha beta shear hα hβ).realBasis
proof:
:= by
  let L := triangularLattice alpha beta shear hα hβ
  let b := L.realBasis
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, v, hv, rfl⟩
    rw [ZSpan.mem_fundamentalDomain]
    intro i
    have heq : Complex.mk (beta * u) (shear * u + alpha * v) =
        v • b 0 + u • b 1 := by
      apply Complex.ext <;>
        simp [b, L, triangularLattice, verticalPeriodVector, skewPeriodVector] <;> ring
    rw [heq]
    change b.repr (v • b 0 + u • b 1) i ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1
    rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
    fin_cases i
    · simpa using hv
    · simpa using hu
  · intro hz
    rw [ZSpan.mem_fundamentalDomain] at hz
    let v := b.repr z 0
    let u := b.repr z 1
    refine ⟨u, hz 1, v, hz 0, ?_⟩
    have hsum := b.sum_repr z
    have heq : z = v • b 0 + u • b 1 := by
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two, v, u] using hsum.symm
    rw [heq]
    apply Complex.ext <;>
      simp [b, L, triangularLattice, verticalPeriodVector, skewPeriodVector] <;> ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.periodization_norm_tsum_ne_top
statement:
private lemma periodization_norm_tsum_ne_top
    {H : AddSubgroup Tiling.Plane} [Countable ↑H] {F T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hfd : IsAddFundamentalDomain H F volume) (hTm : MeasurableSet T)
    (hTtop : volume T ≠ ∞) :
    (∑' l : ↑H, ∫⁻ x,
      ‖Set.indicator ((l.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ T) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x‖ₑ
        ∂volume.restrict F) ≠ ∞
proof:
:= by
  have hmeasure := hfd.measure_eq_tsum T
  have hterm (l : ↑H) :
      ∫⁻ x, ‖Set.indicator ((l.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ T)
          (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x‖ₑ ∂volume.restrict F =
        volume (((l.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ T) ∩ F) := by
    rw [show (fun x ↦ ‖Set.indicator ((l.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ T)
        (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x‖ₑ) =
        Set.indicator ((l.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ T) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞)) by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ (l.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ T <;> simp [hx]]
    rw [lintegral_indicator (hTm.const_vadd l.1), setLIntegral_one,
      Measure.restrict_apply (hTm.const_vadd l.1), inter_comm]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  exact hmeasure ▸ hTtop

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.tsum_integral_periodized_indicators
statement:
private lemma tsum_integral_periodized_indicators
    {H : AddSubgroup Tiling.Plane} [Countable ↑H] {F T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hfd : IsAddFundamentalDomain H F volume) (hTm : MeasurableSet T)
    (hTtop : volume T ≠ ∞) :
    (∑' l : ↑H, ∫ x in F,
      Set.indicator ((l.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ T) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x) =
      (volume T).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have hmeasure := hfd.measure_eq_tsum T
  simp_rw [integral_indicator_const (1 : ℝ) (hTm.const_vadd _)]
  simp_rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Measure.real,
    Measure.restrict_apply (hTm.const_vadd _)]
  have htranslateTop (l : ↑H) : volume ((l.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ T) ≠ ∞ := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.measure_vadd volume]
    exact hTtop
  rw [← ENNReal.tsum_toReal_eq (f := fun l : ↑H ↦
    volume (((l.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ T) ∩ F)) (fun _ ↦
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (htranslateTop _) (measure_mono inter_subset_left))]
  exact congrArg ENNReal.toReal hmeasure.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.integral_periodization_over_fundamentalDomain
statement:
private lemma integral_periodization_over_fundamentalDomain
    {H : AddSubgroup Tiling.Plane} [Countable ↑H] {F T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hfd : IsAddFundamentalDomain H F volume) (hTm : MeasurableSet T)
    (hTtop : volume T ≠ ∞) :
    (∫ x in F, ∑' l : ↑H,
      Set.indicator ((l.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ T) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x) =
      (volume T).toReal
proof:
:= by
  let f : ↑H → Tiling.Plane → ℝ := fun l x ↦
    Set.indicator ((l.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ T) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x
  have hsumtop : (∑' l : ↑H, ∫⁻ x, ‖f l x‖ₑ ∂volume.restrict F) ≠ ∞ := by
    exact periodization_norm_tsum_ne_top hfd hTm hTtop
  have hswap := integral_tsum
    (fun (l : ↑H) ↦
      (measurable_const.indicator (hTm.const_vadd l.1)).aestronglyMeasurable)
    hsumtop
  change (∫ x in F, ∑' l : ↑H, f l x) = _
  rw [hswap]
  exact tsum_integral_periodized_indicators hfd hTm hTtop

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.integrable_periodization_over_fundamentalDomain
statement:
private lemma integrable_periodization_over_fundamentalDomain
    {H : AddSubgroup Tiling.Plane} [Countable ↑H] {F T : Set Tiling.Plane}
    (hfd : IsAddFundamentalDomain H F volume) (hTm : MeasurableSet T)
    (hTtop : volume T ≠ ∞) :
    Integrable (fun x ↦ ∑' l : ↑H,
      Set.indicator ((l.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ T) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x)
      (volume.restrict F)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ↑H → Tiling.Plane → ℝ := fun l x ↦
    Set.indicator ((l.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ T) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x
  have hmeas (l : ↑H) : Measurable (f l) :=
    measurable_const.indicator (hTm.const_vadd l.1)
  have hsumtop := periodization_norm_tsum_ne_top hfd hTm hTtop
  refine ⟨(Measurable.tsum hmeas).aestronglyMeasurable, ?_⟩
  rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_enorm]
  apply lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr
  apply ne_top_of_le_ne_top hsumtop
  calc
    ∫⁻ x, ‖∑' l : ↑H, f l x‖ₑ ∂volume.restrict F ≤
        ∫⁻ x, ∑' l : ↑H, ‖f l x‖ₑ ∂volume.restrict F :=
      lintegral_mono fun x ↦ enorm_tsum_le_tsum_enorm
    _ = ∑' l : ↑H, ∫⁻ x, ‖f l x‖ₑ ∂volume.restrict F := by
      rw [lintegral_tsum]
      exact fun l ↦ (hmeas l).enorm.aemeasurable

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.integral_lattice_periodized_indicator
statement:
private lemma integral_lattice_periodized_indicator
    (K : Region) (r : Tiling.Plane) {alpha beta shear : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < alpha) (hβ : 0 < beta) :
    (∫ x in triangularFundamentalDomain alpha beta shear,
        ∑' l : ↑(triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear),
          Set.indicator ((l.1 + r) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
            (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x) =
      (volume K.openCarrier).toReal
proof:
:= by
  let L := triangularLattice alpha beta shear hα hβ
  let b := L.realBasis
  let H := triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear
  let F := triangularFundamentalDomain alpha beta shear
  have hLH : L.toAddSubgroup = H :=
    triangularLattice_subgroup alpha beta shear hα hβ
  have hspan : (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range b)).toAddSubgroup = H := by
    rw [L.span_realBasis_toAddSubgroup, hLH]
  have hF : F = ZSpan.fundamentalDomain b :=
    triangularFundamentalDomain_eq_zspan alpha beta shear hα hβ
  have hfd : IsAddFundamentalDomain H F volume := by
    rw [hF, ← hspan]
    exact ZSpan.isAddFundamentalDomain' b volume
  have hHcountable : (H : Set Tiling.Plane).Countable := by
    apply (Set.countable_range fun p : ℤ × ℤ ↦
      p.1 • verticalPeriodVector alpha + p.2 • skewPeriodVector beta shear).mono
    rintro x ⟨m, n, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(m, n), rfl⟩
  have hHinst : Countable ↑H := hHcountable.to_subtype
  let T : Set Tiling.Plane := r +ᵥ K.openCarrier
  have hTm : MeasurableSet T := (isOpen_interior.vadd r).measurableSet
  have hTtop : volume T ≠ ∞ := by
    exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top
      ((K.isPolygonal.isBounded.vadd r).measure_lt_top (μ := volume)).ne
      (measure_mono (by
        rintro x ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨y, interior_subset hy, rfl⟩))
  have hcore := integral_periodization_over_fundamentalDomain hfd hTm hTtop
  calc
    (∫ x in triangularFundamentalDomain alpha beta shear,
        ∑' l : ↑(triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear),
          Set.indicator ((l.1 + r) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
            (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x) =
        ∫ x in F, ∑' l : ↑H,
          Set.indicator ((l.1 : Tiling.Plane) +ᵥ T) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with x
      apply tsum_congr
      intro l
      congr 1
      rw [vadd_vadd]
    _ = (volume T).toReal := hcore
    _ = (volume K.openCarrier).toReal := by
      dsimp only [T]
      rw [MeasureTheory.measure_vadd volume]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.integrable_lattice_periodized_indicator
statement:
private lemma integrable_lattice_periodized_indicator
    (K : Region) (r : Tiling.Plane) {alpha beta shear : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < alpha) (hβ : 0 < beta) :
    Integrable (fun x ↦
      ∑' l : ↑(triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear),
        Set.indicator ((l.1 + r) +ᵥ K.openCarrier) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x)
      (volume.restrict (triangularFundamentalDomain alpha beta shear))
proof:
:= by
  let L := triangularLattice alpha beta shear hα hβ
  let b := L.realBasis
  let H := triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear
  let F := triangularFundamentalDomain alpha beta shear
  have hspan : (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range b)).toAddSubgroup = H := by
    rw [L.span_realBasis_toAddSubgroup,
      triangularLattice_subgroup alpha beta shear hα hβ]
  have hF : F = ZSpan.fundamentalDomain b :=
    triangularFundamentalDomain_eq_zspan alpha beta shear hα hβ
  have hfd : IsAddFundamentalDomain H F volume := by
    rw [hF, ← hspan]
    exact ZSpan.isAddFundamentalDomain' b volume
  have hHcountable : (H : Set Tiling.Plane).Countable := by
    apply (Set.countable_range fun p : ℤ × ℤ ↦
      p.1 • verticalPeriodVector alpha + p.2 • skewPeriodVector beta shear).mono
    rintro x ⟨m, n, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(m, n), rfl⟩
  have hHinst : Countable ↑H := hHcountable.to_subtype
  let T : Set Tiling.Plane := r +ᵥ K.openCarrier
  have hTm : MeasurableSet T := (isOpen_interior.vadd r).measurableSet
  have hTtop : volume T ≠ ∞ := by
    exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top
      ((K.isPolygonal.isBounded.vadd r).measure_lt_top (μ := volume)).ne
      (measure_mono (by
        rintro x ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨y, interior_subset hy, rfl⟩))
  have hc := integrable_periodization_over_fundamentalDomain hfd hTm hTtop
  apply hc.congr
  filter_upwards with x
  apply tsum_congr
  intro l
  congr 1
  rw [vadd_vadd]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.integral_periodizedTileMultiplicity
statement:
theorem integral_periodizedTileMultiplicity :
    ∀ {K : Region} (R : Finset Tiling.Plane) {alpha beta shear : ℝ},
      0 < alpha → 0 < beta →
      ∫ x in triangularFundamentalDomain alpha beta shear,
          periodizedTileMultiplicity K R alpha beta shear x =
        (R.card : ℝ) * (volume K.openCarrier).toReal
proof:
:= by
  intro K R alpha beta shear hα hβ
  rw [show (∫ x in triangularFundamentalDomain alpha beta shear,
      periodizedTileMultiplicity K R alpha beta shear x) =
      ∫ x in triangularFundamentalDomain alpha beta shear,
        ∑ r : ↑R, ∑' l : ↑(triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear),
          Set.indicator ((l.1 + r.1) +ᵥ K.openCarrier)
            (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) x by
    congr 1
    funext x
    rw [periodizedTileMultiplicity, tsum_fintype]]
  rw [integral_finsetSum]
  · simp_rw [integral_lattice_periodized_indicator K _ hα hβ]
    simp
  · intro i hi
    exact integrable_lattice_periodized_indicator K i.1 hα hβ

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.support_aePeriod_of_centrePeriod
statement:
theorem support_aePeriod_of_centrePeriod :
    ∀ {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane} {X : Set ℝ} {v : Tiling.Plane},
      MeasurableSet X → TilesOn K S {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X} →
      v ∈ periodGroup S → (v.re +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X
proof:
:= by
  intro K S X v hX hTile hv
  let D : Set Tiling.Plane := {z | z.re ∈ X}
  have hDU : D =ᵐ[volume] openUnion K S := by
    filter_upwards [hTile.2.2] with z hz
    change (z.re ∈ X) = (z ∈ openUnion K S)
    simpa only [openUnion, Tiling.Polygonal.openUnion, ← Region.openCarrier.eq_def,
      Set.mem_iUnion] using propext hz
  have hDR : D =ᵐ[volume] regularSupport K S :=
    hDU.trans (openUnion_aeEq_regularSupport hTile.2.1)
  have hRperiod : v +ᵥ regularSupport K S = regularSupport K S := by
    rw [← regularSupport_vadd, (periodGroup_isAddSubgroup S v).mp hv]
  have htranslated :=
    (quasiMeasurePreserving_add_left volume (-v)).vadd_ae_eq_of_ae_eq v hDR
  have hRperiodAE :
      (v +ᵥ regularSupport K S) =ᵐ[volume] regularSupport K S :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z ↦ by
      change (z ∈ v +ᵥ regularSupport K S) = (z ∈ regularSupport K S)
      rw [hRperiod]
  have hplanar :
      (v +ᵥ D) =ᵐ[volume] D := by
    exact htranslated.trans (hRperiodAE.trans hDR.symm)
  have hcyl : v +ᵥ D = {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ v.re +ᵥ X} := by
    ext z
    simp only [D, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, mem_ofPred_eq,
      Complex.add_re, Complex.neg_re, vadd_eq_add]
  rw [hcyl] at hplanar
  have hpull :=
    Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.symm.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hplanar
  have hprod : ∀ᵐ p : ℝ × ℝ ∂volume.prod volume,
      (p.1 ∈ v.re +ᵥ X) = (p.1 ∈ X) := by
    filter_upwards [hpull] with p hp
    change (p.1 ∈ v.re +ᵥ X) = (p.1 ∈ X) at hp
    exact hp
  have hslices := MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod hprod
  filter_upwards [hslices] with x hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx.exists
  exact hy

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.periodicTiling_torusArea_from_explicitDomain
statement:
theorem periodicTiling_torusArea_from_explicitDomain :
    ∀ {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane} {X : Set ℝ}
      {alpha beta shear : ℝ},
      0 < alpha → 0 < beta → MeasurableSet X →
      TilesOn K S {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X} →
      verticalPeriodVector alpha ∈ periodGroup S →
      skewPeriodVector beta shear ∈ periodGroup S →
      (beta +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X →
      ∃ R : Finset Tiling.Plane,
        QuotientAddGroup.mk' (triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear) ''
            (R : Set Tiling.Plane) =
          QuotientAddGroup.mk' (triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear) '' S ∧
        Set.InjOn
          (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear))
          (R : Set Tiling.Plane) ∧
        R.card = Set.ncard
          (QuotientAddGroup.mk'
            (triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear) '' S) ∧
        (R.card : ℝ) * (volume K.openCarrier).toReal =
          alpha * (volume (X ∩ Set.Ico 0 beta)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  intro K S X alpha beta shear hα hβ hX hTile hvertical hskew hXperiod
  obtain ⟨R, hRS, hQ, hinj⟩ :=
    exists_finiteOrbitRepresentatives hα hβ hTile hvertical hskew
  refine ⟨R, hQ, hinj, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hQ]
    simpa using hinj.ncard_image.symm
  · rw [← integral_periodizedTileMultiplicity R hα hβ,
      ← integral_slabIndicator_triangularFundamentalDomain hα hβ hX hXperiod]
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae
      (periodizedTileMultiplicity_ae_eq_slabIndicator
        R hα hβ hX hTile hvertical hskew hRS hQ hinj)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.periodicTiling_torusArea
statement:
theorem periodicTiling_torusArea :
    ∀ {K : Region} {S : Set Tiling.Plane} {X : Set ℝ}
      {alpha beta shear : ℝ},
    0 < alpha → 0 < beta → MeasurableSet X →
    TilesOn K S {z : Tiling.Plane | z.re ∈ X} →
    verticalPeriodVector alpha ∈ periodGroup S →
    skewPeriodVector beta shear ∈ periodGroup S →
    (beta +ᵥ X) =ᵐ[volume] X →
    ∃ r : ℕ,
      Set.Finite
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk'
          (triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear) '' S) ∧
      r = Set.ncard
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk'
          (triangularPeriodSubgroup alpha beta shear) '' S) ∧
      (r : ℝ) * (volume K.openCarrier).toReal =
        alpha * (volume (X ∩ Set.Ico 0 beta)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  intro K S X alpha beta shear hα hβ hX hTile hvertical hskew hXperiod
  obtain ⟨R, hQ, hinj, hcard, harea⟩ :=
    periodicTiling_torusArea_from_explicitDomain
      hα hβ hX hTile hvertical hskew hXperiod
  refine ⟨R.card, ?_, hcard, harea⟩
  rw [← hQ]
  exact R.finite_toSet.image _

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Terminal.verticalPeriods_commensurable_of_rationalMasses
statement:
theorem verticalPeriods_commensurable_of_rationalMasses :
    ∀ {alpha alphaColumn sourceCommonPeriod : ℝ},
      MixedRationalizationDatum alpha alphaColumn sourceCommonPeriod →
      0 < alpha → 0 < alphaColumn →
      ∃ q : ℚ, alpha = (q : ℝ) * alphaColumn
proof:
:= by
  intro alpha alphaColumn sourceCommonPeriod M hα hαc
  have hperiodN := support_aePeriod_of_centrePeriod
    M.nonColumnBase_measurable M.nonColumnTiles
    M.nonColumnHorizontalPeriod
  have hperiodC := support_aePeriod_of_centrePeriod
    M.columnBase_measurable M.columnTiles
    M.columnHorizontalPeriod
  have hperiodN' : M.rationalHorizontalPeriod +ᵥ M.nonColumnBase =ᵐ[volume]
      M.nonColumnBase := by
    simpa [skewPeriodVector] using hperiodN
  have hperiodC' : M.rationalHorizontalPeriod +ᵥ M.columnBase =ᵐ[volume]
      M.columnBase := by
    simpa [skewPeriodVector] using hperiodC
  obtain ⟨rN, -, -, hmassN⟩ := periodicTiling_torusArea
    hα M.rationalHorizontalPeriod_pos
    M.nonColumnBase_measurable M.nonColumnTiles M.nonColumnVerticalPeriod
    M.nonColumnHorizontalPeriod hperiodN'
  obtain ⟨rC, -, -, hmassC⟩ := periodicTiling_torusArea
    hαc M.rationalHorizontalPeriod_pos
    M.columnBase_measurable M.columnTiles M.columnVerticalPeriod
    M.columnHorizontalPeriod hperiodC'
  rw [M.nonColumnMass_eq] at hmassN
  rw [M.columnMass_eq] at hmassC
  have hmN : (0 : ℝ) < M.nonColumnMass := by exact_mod_cast M.nonColumnMass_pos
  have hmC : (0 : ℝ) < M.columnMass := by exact_mod_cast M.columnMass_pos
  have hrN : rN ≠ 0 := by
    intro hr
    subst rN
    have hz : alpha * (M.nonColumnMass : ℝ) = 0 := by
      simpa using hmassN.symm
    exact (mul_pos hα hmN).ne' hz
  have hrC : rC ≠ 0 := by
    intro hr
    subst rC
    have hz : alphaColumn * (M.columnMass : ℝ) = 0 := by
      simpa using hmassC.symm
    exact (mul_pos hαc hmC).ne' hz
  let q : ℚ := (rN : ℚ) * M.columnMass /
    ((rC : ℚ) * M.nonColumnMass)
  refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
  have hden : ((rC : ℝ) * (M.nonColumnMass : ℝ)) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hrC) hmN.ne'
  change alpha =
    (((rN : ℚ) * M.columnMass / ((rC : ℚ) * M.nonColumnMass) : ℚ) : ℝ) *
      alphaColumn
  push_cast
  field_simp
  nlinarith [hmassN, hmassC]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.exists_right_interval_disjoint_of_locallyFinite
statement:
private theorem exists_right_interval_disjoint_of_locallyFinite
    {S : Set ℝ} {h : ℝ}
    (hloc : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (S ∩ Q).Finite) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ Ioo h (h + ε) ∩ S = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (S ∩ Icc h (h + 1)).Finite := hloc _ (Metric.isBounded_Icc _ _)
  let F := hf.toFinset
  let ds : Finset ℝ := F.filter (h < ·)
  by_cases hd : ds.Nonempty
  · let m := ds.min' hd
    have hm : h < m := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (ds.min'_mem hd)).2
    refine ⟨(m - h) / 2, by linarith, ?_⟩
    ext x
    simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_Ioo, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    rintro ⟨hhx, hxS⟩
    have hxI : x ∈ Icc h (h + 1) := by
      constructor
      · exact hhx.1.le
      · have hmF : m ∈ S ∩ Icc h (h + 1) := by
          have hmF' : m ∈ F := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (ds.min'_mem hd)).1
          change m ∈ hf.toFinset at hmF'
          simpa only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] using hmF'
        linarith [hmF.2.2, hhx.2]
    have hxds : x ∈ ds := Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨(by simpa [F] using (show x ∈ S ∩ Icc h (h+1) from ⟨hxS,hxI⟩)), hhx.1⟩
    have := ds.min'_le x hxds
    linarith
  · refine ⟨1, by norm_num, ?_⟩
    ext x
    simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_Ioo, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    rintro ⟨⟨hhx, hxh⟩, hxS⟩
    apply hd
    refine ⟨x, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, hhx⟩⟩
    simpa [F] using
      (show x ∈ S ∩ Icc h (h + 1) from ⟨hxS, ⟨hhx.le, hxh.le⟩⟩)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.exists_left_interval_disjoint_of_locallyFinite
statement:
private theorem exists_left_interval_disjoint_of_locallyFinite
    {S : Set ℝ} {h : ℝ}
    (hloc : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (S ∩ Q).Finite) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ Ioo (h - ε) h ∩ S = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (S ∩ Icc (h - 1) h).Finite := hloc _ (Metric.isBounded_Icc _ _)
  let F := hf.toFinset
  let ds : Finset ℝ := F.filter (· < h)
  by_cases hd : ds.Nonempty
  · let m := ds.max' hd
    have hm : m < h := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (ds.max'_mem hd)).2
    refine ⟨(h - m) / 2, by linarith, ?_⟩
    ext x
    simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_Ioo, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    rintro ⟨⟨hmx, hxh⟩, hxS⟩
    have hxI : x ∈ Icc (h - 1) h := by
      constructor
      · have hmF : m ∈ S ∩ Icc (h - 1) h :=
          by
            have hmF' : m ∈ F := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (ds.max'_mem hd)).1
            change m ∈ hf.toFinset at hmF'
            simpa only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] using hmF'
        exact le_trans hmF.2.1 (by linarith)
      · exact hxh.le
    have hxds : x ∈ ds := Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨(by simpa [F] using (show x ∈ S ∩ Icc (h-1) h from ⟨hxS,hxI⟩)), hxh⟩
    have := ds.le_max' x hxds
    linarith
  · refine ⟨1, by norm_num, ?_⟩
    ext x
    simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_Ioo, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    rintro ⟨⟨hhx, hxh⟩, hxS⟩
    apply hd
    refine ⟨x, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, hxh⟩⟩
    simpa [F] using
      (show x ∈ S ∩ Icc (h - 1) h from ⟨hxS, ⟨hhx.le, hxh.le⟩⟩)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.exists_least_right_discrepancy
statement:
private theorem exists_least_right_discrepancy
    {H H' : Set ℝ} {d : ℝ}
    (hH : ∀ Q, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (H ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hH' : ∀ Q, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (H' ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hne : (((H \ H') ∪ (H' \ H)) ∩ Ioi d).Nonempty) :
    ∃ h ∈ ((H \ H') ∪ (H' \ H)) ∩ Ioi d,
      ∀ k ∈ ((H \ H') ∪ (H' \ H)) ∩ Ioi d, h ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  rcases hne with ⟨s, hsD, hds⟩
  let D := (H \ H') ∪ (H' \ H)
  have hf : (D ∩ Ioc d s).Finite := by
    refine Set.Finite.subset
      ((hH (Icc d s) (Metric.isBounded_Icc d s)).union
        (hH' (Icc d s) (Metric.isBounded_Icc d s))) ?_
    intro x hx
    rcases hx.1 with hbranch | hbranch
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hbranch.1, ⟨hx.2.1.le, hx.2.2⟩⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hbranch.1, ⟨hx.2.1.le, hx.2.2⟩⟩
  have hn : (D ∩ Ioc d s).Nonempty := ⟨s, hsD, hds, le_rfl⟩
  let F := hf.toFinset
  have hFn : F.Nonempty := by simpa [F] using hn
  let m := F.min' hFn
  have mmem : m ∈ D ∩ Ioc d s := by
    simpa only [F, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] using F.min'_mem hFn
  refine ⟨m, ⟨mmem.1, mmem.2.1⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro k ⟨hkD, hdk⟩
    by_cases hks : k ≤ s
    · apply F.min'_le k
      simpa only [F, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] using
        (show k ∈ D ∩ Ioc d s from ⟨hkD, hdk, hks⟩)
    · exact le_trans mmem.2.2 (le_of_not_ge hks)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.exists_greatest_left_discrepancy
statement:
private theorem exists_greatest_left_discrepancy
    {H H' : Set ℝ} {d : ℝ}
    (hH : ∀ Q, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (H ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hH' : ∀ Q, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (H' ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hne : (((H \ H') ∪ (H' \ H)) ∩ Iio d).Nonempty) :
    ∃ h ∈ ((H \ H') ∪ (H' \ H)) ∩ Iio d,
      ∀ k ∈ ((H \ H') ∪ (H' \ H)) ∩ Iio d, k ≤ h
proof:
:= by
  rcases hne with ⟨s, hsD, hsd⟩
  let D := (H \ H') ∪ (H' \ H)
  have hf : (D ∩ Ico s d).Finite := by
    refine Set.Finite.subset
      ((hH (Icc s d) (Metric.isBounded_Icc s d)).union
        (hH' (Icc s d) (Metric.isBounded_Icc s d))) ?_
    intro x hx
    rcases hx.1 with hbranch | hbranch
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hbranch.1, ⟨hx.2.1, hx.2.2.le⟩⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hbranch.1, ⟨hx.2.1, hx.2.2.le⟩⟩
  have hn : (D ∩ Ico s d).Nonempty := ⟨s, hsD, le_rfl, hsd⟩
  let F := hf.toFinset
  have hFn : F.Nonempty := by simpa [F] using hn
  let m := F.max' hFn
  have mmem : m ∈ D ∩ Ico s d := by
    simpa only [F, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] using F.max'_mem hFn
  refine ⟨m, ⟨mmem.1, mmem.2.2⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro k ⟨hkD, hkd⟩
    by_cases hsk : s ≤ k
    · apply F.le_max' k
      simpa only [F, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] using
        (show k ∈ D ∩ Ico s d from ⟨hkD, hsk, hkd⟩)
    · exact le_trans (le_of_not_ge hsk) mmem.2.1

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.exists_mem_Ioo_of_ae
statement:
private theorem exists_mem_Ioo_of_ae {P : ℝ → Prop} {u v : ℝ} (huv : u < v)
    (hP : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, P x) : ∃ x ∈ Ioo u v, P x
proof:
:= by
  have hμ : volume.restrict (Ioo u v) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have : volume (Ioo u v) = 0 := by
      rw [← Measure.restrict_apply_univ (Ioo u v), hz]
      simp
    rw [Real.volume_Ioo] at this
    simp [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero, not_le.mpr (sub_pos.mpr huv)] at this
  let hne : (ae (volume.restrict (Ioo u v))).NeBot := ae_neBot.mpr hμ
  have hp' : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (Ioo u v), P x := hP.filter_mono ae_restrict_le
  rcases @Filter.Eventually.exists ℝ _ (ae (volume.restrict (Ioo u v))) hne
      (hp'.and (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo)) with ⟨x,hp,hx⟩
  exact ⟨x,hx,hp⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.no_right_discrepancy
statement:
private theorem no_right_discrepancy
    {B H H' X : Set ℝ} {a b η c R : ℝ}
    (_hab : a < b) (hη : 0 < η) (hBsub : B ⊆ Icc a b)
    (hleft : Ioo a (a + η) ⊆ B) (hBopen : IsOpen B) (hR : b - a ≤ R)
    (hTile : LineTilesOn B H X) (hTile' : LineTilesOn B H' X)
    (hHlocal : ∀ Q, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (H ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hH'local : ∀ Q, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (H' ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hagree : H ∩ Icc (c - R) (c + R) = H' ∩ Icc (c - R) (c + R)) :
    ((H \ H') ∪ (H' \ H)) ∩ Ioi (c + R) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have hne : (((H \ H') ∪ (H' \ H)) ∩ Ioi (c + R)).Nonempty := nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hn
  rcases exists_least_right_discrepancy hHlocal hH'local hne with ⟨h, ⟨hhD, hhgt⟩, hmin⟩
  change c + R < h at hhgt
  wlog hcase : h ∈ H' \ H generalizing H H'
  · have hh : h ∈ H \ H' := hhD.resolve_right hcase
    have hn' : ¬ ((H' \ H) ∪ (H \ H')) ∩ Ioi (c + R) = ∅ := by simpa [union_comm] using hn
    have hne' : (((H' \ H) ∪ (H \ H')) ∩ Ioi (c + R)).Nonempty := nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hn'
    exact this hTile' hTile hH'local hHlocal hagree.symm
      hn' hne' (by simpa [union_comm] using hmin) (by simpa [union_comm] using hhD) hh
  have hh := hcase
  have hhH' : h ∈ H' := hh.1
  have hhnotH : h ∉ H := hh.2
  rcases exists_right_interval_disjoint_of_locallyFinite (h := h) hHlocal with ⟨ε0, hε0, hgap⟩
  let ε := min ε0 η
  have hε : 0 < ε := lt_min hε0 hη
  have hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume,
      (x ∈ X ↔ ∃ l : H, x ∈ (l : ℝ) +ᵥ B) ∧
      (x ∈ X ↔ ∃ l : H', x ∈ (l : ℝ) +ᵥ B) := hTile.2.2.2.2.and hTile'.2.2.2.2
  rcases exists_mem_Ioo_of_ae (by linarith : h + a < h + a + ε) hae with ⟨x, hxI, hx, hx'⟩
  rcases hxI with ⟨hxlo, hxhi⟩
  have hxTile' : x ∈ (h : ℝ) +ᵥ B := by
    rw [mem_vadd_set]
    refine ⟨x-h, hleft ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · dsimp [ε] at *
      linarith [min_le_right ε0 η]
    · simp [vadd_eq_add]
  have hxX : x ∈ X := hx'.mpr ⟨⟨h, hhH'⟩, hxTile'⟩
  rcases hx.mp hxX with ⟨k, hxk⟩
  have hkH : (k : ℝ) ∈ H := k.property
  rcases mem_vadd_set.mp hxk with ⟨y, hyB, hyx⟩
  change (k : ℝ) + y = x at hyx
  have hxb : x - b ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
    have := hBsub hyB
    linarith [this.2]
  have hka : (k : ℝ) ≤ x - a := by
    have := hBsub hyB
    linarith [this.1]
  have hklt : (k : ℝ) < h := by
    have hkupper : (k : ℝ) < h + ε0 := by dsimp [ε] at *; linarith [min_le_left ε0 η]
    by_contra hnot
    have hle : h ≤ (k : ℝ) := le_of_not_gt hnot
    rcases hle.eq_or_lt with rfl | hlt
    · exact hhnotH hkH
    · have hkbad : (k : ℝ) ∈ Ioo h (h + ε0) ∩ H := ⟨⟨hlt, hkupper⟩, hkH⟩
      rw [hgap] at hkbad
      exact hkbad
  have hklower : h - R < (k : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hkH' : (k : ℝ) ∈ H' := by
    by_cases hk : (k : ℝ) ≤ c + R
    · have kwin : (k : ℝ) ∈ Icc (c - R) (c + R) := ⟨by linarith [hhgt], hk⟩
      have : (k : ℝ) ∈ H' ∩ Icc (c - R) (c + R) := by rw [← hagree]; exact ⟨hkH, kwin⟩
      exact this.1
    · by_contra hk'
      have kd : (k : ℝ) ∈ (H \ H') ∪ (H' \ H) := Or.inl ⟨hkH, hk'⟩
      exact (not_le_of_gt hklt) (hmin _ ⟨kd, lt_of_not_ge hk⟩)
  have hdis : AEDisjoint volume ((h : ℝ) +ᵥ B) ((k : ℝ) +ᵥ B) :=
    hTile'.2.2.2.1 hhH' hkH' (by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hklt)
  have hopen : IsOpen (((h : ℝ) +ᵥ B) ∩ ((k : ℝ) +ᵥ B)) :=
    (hBopen.vadd _).inter (hBopen.vadd _)
  have hnon : (((h : ℝ) +ᵥ B) ∩ ((k : ℝ) +ᵥ B)).Nonempty := ⟨x, hxTile', hxk⟩
  exact (ne_of_gt (hopen.measure_pos volume hnon)) hdis

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.no_left_discrepancy
statement:
private theorem no_left_discrepancy
    {B H H' X : Set ℝ} {a b η c R : ℝ}
    (_hab : a < b) (hη : 0 < η) (hBsub : B ⊆ Icc a b)
    (hright : Ioo (b - η) b ⊆ B) (hBopen : IsOpen B) (hR : b - a ≤ R)
    (hTile : LineTilesOn B H X) (hTile' : LineTilesOn B H' X)
    (hHlocal : ∀ Q, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (H ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hH'local : ∀ Q, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (H' ∩ Q).Finite)
    (hagree : H ∩ Icc (c - R) (c + R) = H' ∩ Icc (c - R) (c + R)) :
    ((H \ H') ∪ (H' \ H)) ∩ Iio (c - R) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have hne := nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hn
  rcases exists_greatest_left_discrepancy hHlocal hH'local hne with ⟨h, ⟨hhD, hhlt⟩, hmax⟩
  change h < c - R at hhlt
  wlog hcase : h ∈ H' \ H generalizing H H'
  · have hh : h ∈ H \ H' := hhD.resolve_right hcase
    have hn' : ¬ ((H' \ H) ∪ (H \ H')) ∩ Iio (c - R) = ∅ := by simpa [union_comm] using hn
    have hne' : (((H' \ H) ∪ (H \ H')) ∩ Iio (c - R)).Nonempty := nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hn'
    exact this hTile' hTile hH'local hHlocal hagree.symm
      hn' hne' (by simpa [union_comm] using hmax) (by simpa [union_comm] using hhD) hh
  have hh := hcase
  have hhH' : h ∈ H' := hh.1
  have hhnotH : h ∉ H := hh.2
  rcases exists_left_interval_disjoint_of_locallyFinite (h := h) hHlocal with ⟨ε0, hε0, hgap⟩
  let ε := min ε0 η
  have hε : 0 < ε := lt_min hε0 hη
  have hae := hTile.2.2.2.2.and hTile'.2.2.2.2
  rcases exists_mem_Ioo_of_ae (by linarith : h + b - ε < h + b) hae with ⟨x, hxI, hx, hx'⟩
  rcases hxI with ⟨hxlo, hxhi⟩
  have hxTile' : x ∈ (h : ℝ) +ᵥ B := by
    rw [mem_vadd_set]
    refine ⟨x-h, hright ⟨?_, by linarith⟩, ?_⟩
    · dsimp [ε] at *
      linarith [min_le_right ε0 η]
    · simp [vadd_eq_add]
  have hxX : x ∈ X := hx'.mpr ⟨⟨h, hhH'⟩, hxTile'⟩
  rcases hx.mp hxX with ⟨k, hxk⟩
  have hkH : (k : ℝ) ∈ H := k.property
  rcases mem_vadd_set.mp hxk with ⟨y, hyB, hyx⟩
  change (k : ℝ) + y = x at hyx
  have hbds := hBsub hyB
  have hklower : h - ε0 < (k : ℝ) := by dsimp [ε] at *; linarith [min_le_left ε0 η, hbds.2]
  have hkupper : (k : ℝ) < h + R := by linarith [hbds.1]
  have hkgt : h < (k : ℝ) := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hle : (k : ℝ) ≤ h := le_of_not_gt hnot
    rcases hle.eq_or_lt with rfl | hlt
    · exact hhnotH hkH
    · have hkbad : (k : ℝ) ∈ Ioo (h - ε0) h ∩ H := ⟨⟨hklower, hlt⟩, hkH⟩
      rw [hgap] at hkbad
      exact hkbad
  have hkH' : (k : ℝ) ∈ H' := by
    by_cases hk : c - R ≤ (k : ℝ)
    · have kwin : (k : ℝ) ∈ Icc (c - R) (c + R) := ⟨hk, by linarith [hhlt]⟩
      have : (k : ℝ) ∈ H' ∩ Icc (c - R) (c + R) := by rw [← hagree]; exact ⟨hkH, kwin⟩
      exact this.1
    · by_contra hk'
      have kd : (k : ℝ) ∈ (H \ H') ∪ (H' \ H) := Or.inl ⟨hkH, hk'⟩
      exact (not_le_of_gt hkgt) (hmax _ ⟨kd, lt_of_not_ge hk⟩)
  have hdis : AEDisjoint volume ((h : ℝ) +ᵥ B) ((k : ℝ) +ᵥ B) :=
    hTile'.2.2.2.1 hhH' hkH' (by exact_mod_cast ne_of_lt hkgt)
  have hopen : IsOpen (((h : ℝ) +ᵥ B) ∩ ((k : ℝ) +ᵥ B)) :=
    (hBopen.vadd _).inter (hBopen.vadd _)
  have hnon : (((h : ℝ) +ᵥ B) ∩ ((k : ℝ) +ᵥ B)).Nonempty := ⟨x, hxTile', hxk⟩
  exact (ne_of_gt (hopen.measure_pos volume hnon)) hdis

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.finiteInterval_lineTilingsOn_localRigidity
statement:
theorem finiteInterval_lineTilingsOn_localRigidity
    {B : Set ℝ}
    (hB : Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.IsFiniteIntervalRegion B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (MeasureTheory.volume B).toReal) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧
      ∀ (H H' X : Set ℝ) (c : ℝ),
        Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.LineTilesOn B H X →
        Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.LineTilesOn B H' X →
        H ∩ Set.Icc (c - R) (c + R) =
          H' ∩ Set.Icc (c - R) (c + R) →
        H = H'
proof:
:= by
      rcases IsFiniteIntervalRegion.extremeCollars hB hBpositive with
        ⟨a,b,ηL,ηR,hab,hηL,hηR,hsub,hleft,hright⟩
      refine ⟨b-a, sub_pos.mpr hab, ?_⟩
      intro H H' X c ht ht' hagree
      have hloc := finiteInterval_lineTilesOn_centres_locallyFinite hB hBpositive ht
      have hloc' := finiteInterval_lineTilesOn_centres_locallyFinite hB hBpositive ht'
      have hr := no_right_discrepancy hab hηL hsub hleft (IsFiniteIntervalRegion.isOpen hB)
        (le_rfl) ht ht' hloc hloc' hagree
      have hl := no_left_discrepancy hab hηR hsub hright (IsFiniteIntervalRegion.isOpen hB)
        (le_rfl) ht ht' hloc hloc' hagree
      ext x
      constructor <;> intro hx
      · by_contra hx'
        have hd : x ∈ (H \ H') ∪ (H' \ H) := Or.inl ⟨hx,hx'⟩
        by_cases hxl : x < c-(b-a)
        · have hempty : x ∈ (∅ : Set ℝ) := hl ▸ ⟨hd,hxl⟩
          exact hempty
        by_cases hxr : c+(b-a) < x
        · have hempty : x ∈ (∅ : Set ℝ) := hr ▸ ⟨hd,hxr⟩
          exact hempty
        have : x ∈ H' ∩ Icc (c-(b-a)) (c+(b-a)) := by
          rw [← hagree]
          exact ⟨hx, le_of_not_gt hxl, le_of_not_gt hxr⟩
        exact hx' this.1
      · by_contra hx'
        have hd : x ∈ (H \ H') ∪ (H' \ H) := Or.inr ⟨hx,hx'⟩
        by_cases hxl : x < c-(b-a)
        · have hempty : x ∈ (∅ : Set ℝ) := hl ▸ ⟨hd,hxl⟩
          exact hempty
        by_cases hxr : c+(b-a) < x
        · have hempty : x ∈ (∅ : Set ℝ) := hr ▸ ⟨hd,hxr⟩
          exact hempty
        have : x ∈ H ∩ Icc (c-(b-a)) (c+(b-a)) := by
          rw [hagree]
          exact ⟨hx, le_of_not_gt hxl, le_of_not_gt hxr⟩
        exact hx' this.1

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.periodRepresentative_mem_Ico
statement:
private theorem periodRepresentative_mem_Ico {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (x : ℝ) :
    periodRepresentative p x ∈ Ico 0 p
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_Ico]
  constructor
  · have h := Int.floor_le (x / p)
    dsimp [periodRepresentative]
    have := (le_div_iff₀ hp).mp h
    linarith
  · have h := Int.lt_floor_add_one (x / p)
    dsimp [periodRepresentative]
    have := (div_lt_iff₀ hp).mp h
    linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.periodRepresentative_mem
statement:
private theorem periodRepresentative_mem {L : Set ℝ} {p : ℝ} (_hp : 0 < p)
    (hperiod : p +ᵥ L = L) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ L) : periodRepresentative p x ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  have hper : (((-Int.floor (x / p) : ℤ) : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ L = L := by
    simpa only [Tiling.AxisParallel.periodGroup_isAddSubgroup, zsmul_eq_mul] using
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.periodGroup L).zsmul_mem hperiod (-Int.floor (x / p))
  rw [← hper]
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  simpa [periodRepresentative] using hx

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.periodDecode_mem
statement:
private theorem periodDecode_mem {L : Set ℝ} {p : ℝ} (hperiod : p +ᵥ L = L)
    (u : ↥(L ∩ Ico 0 p) × ℤ) : periodDecode L p u ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  have hper : ((u.2 : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ L = L := by
    simpa only [Tiling.AxisParallel.periodGroup_isAddSubgroup, zsmul_eq_mul] using
      (Tiling.AxisParallel.periodGroup L).zsmul_mem hperiod u.2
  have hm : periodDecode L p u ∈ ((u.2 : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ L := by
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    simpa [periodDecode] using u.1.2.1
  simpa only [hper] using hm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.periodDecode_injective
statement:
private theorem periodDecode_injective {L : Set ℝ} {p : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hperiod : p +ᵥ L = L) :
    Injective (fun u : ↥(L ∩ Ico 0 p) × ℤ =>
      (⟨periodDecode L p u, periodDecode_mem hperiod u⟩ : L))
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  have heq : periodDecode L p u = periodDecode L p v := congrArg Subtype.val huv
  have hu0 := u.1.2.2.1
  have hup := u.1.2.2.2
  have hv0 := v.1.2.2.1
  have hvp := v.1.2.2.2
  have hm : u.2 = v.2 := by
    by_contra hne
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
    · have hi : (u.2 : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (v.2 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hlt
      have hip : ((u.2 : ℝ) + 1) * p ≤ (v.2 : ℝ) * p :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi hp.le
      dsimp [periodDecode] at heq
      nlinarith
    · have hi : (v.2 : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (u.2 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hgt
      have hip : ((v.2 : ℝ) + 1) * p ≤ (u.2 : ℝ) * p :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi hp.le
      dsimp [periodDecode] at heq
      nlinarith
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Subtype.ext
    dsimp [periodDecode] at heq
    rw [hm] at heq
    linarith
  · exact hm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.periodDecode_surjective
statement:
private theorem periodDecode_surjective {L : Set ℝ} {p : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hperiod : p +ᵥ L = L) :
    Surjective (fun u : ↥(L ∩ Ico 0 p) × ℤ =>
      (⟨periodDecode L p u, periodDecode_mem hperiod u⟩ : L))
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  let f := periodRepresentative p x.1
  let q := Int.floor (x.1 / p)
  have hfL : f ∈ L := periodRepresentative_mem hp hperiod x.2
  have hfI : f ∈ Ico 0 p := periodRepresentative_mem_Ico hp x.1
  let u : ↥(L ∩ Ico 0 p) × ℤ := ⟨⟨f, hfL, hfI⟩, q⟩
  refine ⟨u, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  dsimp [u, f, q, periodDecode, periodRepresentative]
  ring

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.exists_periodResidueEquiv
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun u : ↥(L ∩ Ico 0 p) × ℤ =>
    (⟨periodDecode L p u, periodDecode_mem hperiod u⟩ : L)
  refine ⟨Equiv.ofBijective f ⟨periodDecode_injective hp hperiod,
    periodDecode_surjective hp hperiod⟩, ?_⟩
  intro u
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.linePeriod_representatives_finite
statement:
private theorem linePeriod_representatives_finite {B L : Set ℝ}
    (hTile : LineTiles B L) (hBfinite : volume B ≠ ⊤)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) {p : ℝ} (_hp : 0 < p) :
    (L ∩ Ico 0 p).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hlocal, _⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.linePacking_uniformlySeparated hTile hBfinite hBpositive
  exact hlocal (Ico 0 p) (Metric.isBounded_Ico 0 p)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.lineTiles_centres_nonempty_of_coverage
statement:
private theorem lineTiles_centres_nonempty_of_coverage {B L : Set ℝ}
    (hTile : LineTiles B L) : L.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hTile.2.2.2.2.exists
  have hx' := hx.mp (Set.mem_univ x)
  exact ⟨hx'.choose, hx'.choose.property⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.linePeriod_representatives_nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := lineTiles_centres_nonempty_of_coverage hTile
  exact ⟨periodRepresentative p x,
    periodRepresentative_mem hp hperiod hx, periodRepresentative_mem_Ico hp x⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.periodCells_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
private theorem periodCells_pairwiseDisjoint (f : ℝ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    Pairwise (Disjoint on periodCell f p)
proof:
:= by
  intro m n hmn
  change Disjoint (periodCell f p m) (periodCell f p n)
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxm hxn
  simp only [periodCell, mem_Ico] at hxm hxn
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hmn with hlt | hgt
  · have hi : (m : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hlt
    have hip : ((m : ℝ) + 1) * p ≤ (n : ℝ) * p :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi hp.le
    linarith
  · have hi : (n : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hgt
    have hip : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * p ≤ (m : ℝ) * p :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi hp.le
    linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.iUnion_periodCells
statement:
private theorem iUnion_periodCells (f : ℝ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    (⋃ m : ℤ, periodCell f p m) = univ
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_univ_iff_forall.mpr
  intro x
  let q := Int.floor ((x + f) / p)
  refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨-q, ?_⟩
  simp only [periodCell, mem_Ico]
  have hlo := Int.floor_le ((x + f) / p)
  have hhi := Int.lt_floor_add_one ((x + f) / p)
  have hlo' := (le_div_iff₀ hp).mp hlo
  have hhi' := (div_lt_iff₀ hp).mp hhi
  dsimp [q]
  push_cast
  constructor <;> linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.translate_inter_cell
statement:
private theorem translate_inter_cell (B : Set ℝ) (f p : ℝ) (m : ℤ) :
    (-(f + (m : ℝ) * p)) +ᵥ
      ((((f + (m : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ B) ∩ Ico 0 p)) =
        B ∩ periodCell f p m
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, mem_inter_iff, mem_Ico, periodCell,
    vadd_eq_add]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxB, hx0, hxp⟩
    constructor
    · convert hxB using 1
      all_goals ring_nf
    · constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨hxB, hx0, hxp⟩
    constructor
    · convert hxB using 1
      all_goals ring_nf
    · constructor <;> linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.lintegral_translate_indicator_cell
statement:
private theorem lintegral_translate_indicator_cell {B : Set ℝ} (hBmeas : MeasurableSet B)
    {p : ℝ} (f : ℝ) (m : ℤ) :
    (∫⁻ x in Ico 0 p,
      ((f + (m : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ B).indicator (1 : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) x ∂volume) =
      volume (B ∩ periodCell f p m)
proof:
:= by
  have hA : MeasurableSet ((f + (m : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ B) := by
    have hm := hBmeas.preimage
      (show Measurable (fun x : ℝ => x - (f + (m : ℝ) * p)) from
        measurable_id.sub measurable_const)
    convert hm using 1
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
    ring_nf
  rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator_one hA]
  rw [Measure.restrict_apply hA]
  rw [← MeasureTheory.measure_vadd volume (-(f + (m : ℝ) * p))]
  rw [translate_inter_cell]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.inter_periodCells_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
private theorem inter_periodCells_pairwiseDisjoint (B : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ) {p : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) : Pairwise (Disjoint on fun m : ℤ => B ∩ periodCell f p m)
proof:
:= by
  intro m n hmn
  exact (periodCells_pairwiseDisjoint f hp hmn).mono inter_subset_right inter_subset_right

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.iUnion_inter_periodCells
statement:
private theorem iUnion_inter_periodCells (B : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    (⋃ m : ℤ, B ∩ periodCell f p m) = B
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inter_iUnion]
  rw [iUnion_periodCells f hp, inter_univ]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.sum_int_translates_setLIntegral_Ico
statement:
private theorem sum_int_translates_setLIntegral_Ico {B : Set ℝ}
    (hBmeas : MeasurableSet B) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (f : ℝ) :
    (∫⁻ x in Ico 0 p, ∑' m : ℤ,
      ((f + (m : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ B).indicator (1 : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) x ∂volume) = volume B
proof:
:= by
  rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_tsum]
  · simp_rw [lintegral_translate_indicator_cell hBmeas]
    rw [← MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion (inter_periodCells_pairwiseDisjoint B f hp)]
    · rw [iUnion_inter_periodCells B f hp]
    · intro m
      exact hBmeas.inter measurableSet_Ico
  · intro m
    have hA : MeasurableSet ((f + (m : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ B) := by
      have hm := hBmeas.preimage
        (show Measurable (fun x : ℝ => x - (f + (m : ℝ) * p)) from
          measurable_id.sub measurable_const)
      convert hm using 1
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
      ring_nf
    exact (measurable_const.indicator hA).aemeasurable.restrict

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.lineTiles_lintegralMultiplicity_ae
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Countable L := hTile.2.2.1
  have hover : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ∀ l m : L, l ≠ m →
      ¬(x ∈ l.1 +ᵥ B ∧ x ∈ m.1 +ᵥ B) := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro l
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro m
    by_cases hlm : l = m
    · filter_upwards [] with x
      simp [hlm]
    · have hz : volume ((l.1 +ᵥ B) ∩ (m.1 +ᵥ B)) = 0 :=
        hTile.2.2.2.1 l.2 m.2 (fun h => hlm (Subtype.ext h))
      filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hz] with x hx
      intro _
      simpa only [mem_inter_iff, not_and] using hx
  filter_upwards [hTile.2.2.2.2, hover] with x hcover hdisj
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hcover.mp (mem_univ x)
  rw [tsum_eq_single l]
  · simp [hl]
  · intro m hml
    have hm : x ∉ m.1 +ᵥ B := fun hm => hdisj l m (Ne.symm hml) ⟨hl, hm⟩
    simp [hm]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.periodicMultiplicity_cellIntegral
statement:
theorem periodicMultiplicity_cellIntegral
    {B L : Set ℝ} {p : ℝ}
    (hBmeas : MeasurableSet B) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hperiod : p +ᵥ L = L) (hfinite : (L ∩ Ico 0 p).Finite) :
    (∫⁻ x in Ico 0 p,
        ∑' l : L, (l.1 +ᵥ B).indicator (1 : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) x ∂volume) =
      (Set.ncard (L ∩ Ico 0 p) : ℝ≥0∞) * volume B
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Fintype ↥(L ∩ Ico 0 p) := hfinite.fintype
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_periodResidueEquiv hp hperiod
  have hreindex (x : ℝ) :
      (∑' l : L, (l.1 +ᵥ B).indicator (1 : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) x) =
        ∑' u : ↥(L ∩ Ico 0 p) × ℤ,
          ((u.1.1 + (u.2 : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ B).indicator (1 : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) x := by
    rw [← e.tsum_eq]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro u
    rw [he u]
    rfl
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ x in Ico 0 p, ∑' u : ↥(L ∩ Ico 0 p) × ℤ,
        ((u.1.1 + (u.2 : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ B).indicator (1 : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) x ∂volume :=
      setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ico (fun x _ ↦ hreindex x)
    _ = ∫⁻ x in Ico 0 p, ∑' f : ↥(L ∩ Ico 0 p), ∑' m : ℤ,
        ((f.1 + (m : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ B).indicator (1 : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) x ∂volume := by
      congr 1
      funext x
      exact ENNReal.tsum_prod'
    _ = ∑' f : ↥(L ∩ Ico 0 p), ∫⁻ x in Ico 0 p, ∑' m : ℤ,
        ((f.1 + (m : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ B).indicator (1 : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) x ∂volume := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_tsum]
      intro f
      apply AEMeasurable.restrict
      apply AEMeasurable.tsum
      intro m
      have hA : MeasurableSet ((f.1 + (m : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ B) := by
        have hm := hBmeas.preimage
          (show Measurable (fun x : ℝ ↦ x - (f.1 + (m : ℝ) * p)) from
            measurable_id.sub measurable_const)
        convert hm using 1
        ext x
        simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
        ring_nf
      exact (measurable_const.indicator hA).aemeasurable
    _ = ∑' _f : ↥(L ∩ Ico 0 p), volume B := by
      apply tsum_congr
      intro f
      exact sum_int_translates_setLIntegral_Ico hBmeas hp f.1
    _ = (Set.ncard (L ∩ Ico 0 p) : ℝ≥0∞) * volume B := by
      rw [tsum_fintype]
      simp

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.linePeriod_mass
statement:
theorem _root_.Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.linePeriod_mass
    {B L : Set ℝ} (hBbounded : Bornology.IsBounded B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) (hTile : LineTiles B L)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hperiod : p +ᵥ L = L) :
    (L ∩ Ico 0 p).Finite ∧ (L ∩ Ico 0 p).Nonempty ∧
      p = (volume B).toReal * Set.ncard (L ∩ Ico 0 p)
proof:
:= by
  have hBfinite : volume B ≠ ⊤ := hBbounded.measure_lt_top.ne
  have hF := linePeriod_representatives_finite hTile hBfinite hBpositive hp
  have hFne := linePeriod_representatives_nonempty hTile hp hperiod
  refine ⟨hF, hFne, ?_⟩
  let _ : Fintype ↥(L ∩ Ico 0 p) := hF.fintype
  have hmeasure := periodicMultiplicity_cellIntegral hTile.1 hp hperiod hF
  have hmeasure' :
      (∫⁻ x in Ico 0 p,
        ∑' l : L, (l.1 +ᵥ B).indicator (1 : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) x ∂volume) =
        (Fintype.card ↥(L ∩ Ico 0 p) : ℕ) * volume B := by
    rw [Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard]
    exact hmeasure
  have hone :
      (∫⁻ _x in Ico 0 p, (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ∂volume) = ENNReal.ofReal p := by
    simp [Real.volume_Ico]
  have hmassENN : ENNReal.ofReal p =
      (Fintype.card ↥(L ∩ Ico 0 p) : ℕ) * volume B := by
    rw [← hone, ← hmeasure']
    apply setLIntegral_congr_fun_ae measurableSet_Ico
    filter_upwards [lineTiles_lintegralMultiplicity_ae hTile] with x hx
    intro _
    exact hx.symm
  have hreal := congrArg ENNReal.toReal hmassENN
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp.le] at hreal
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul] at hreal
  simp at hreal
  simpa only [mul_comm] using hreal

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IntervalPresentation.isOpen
statement: theorem IntervalPresentation.isOpen {B : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) : IsOpen B
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.union_eq]
  exact isOpen_iUnion fun i ↦ isOpen_Ioo

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IntervalPresentation.isFiniteIntervalRegion
statement:
theorem IntervalPresentation.isFiniteIntervalRegion {B : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) :
    IsFiniteIntervalRegion B
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨P.n, P.left, P.right, P.lt, P.union_eq⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IntervalPresentation.isBounded
statement:
theorem IntervalPresentation.isBounded {B : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) :
    Bornology.IsBounded B
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.union_eq]
  exact (Bornology.isBounded_iUnion).2 fun i ↦ Metric.isBounded_Ioo (P.left i) (P.right i)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IntervalPresentation.measurableSet
statement:
theorem IntervalPresentation.measurableSet {B : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) :
    MeasurableSet B
proof:
:=
  (IntervalPresentation.isOpen P).measurableSet

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IntervalPresentation.volume_ne_top
statement:
theorem IntervalPresentation.volume_ne_top {B : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) :
    volume B ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  (IntervalPresentation.isBounded P).measure_lt_top.ne

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IntervalPresentation.closure_eq_iUnion_Icc
statement:
theorem IntervalPresentation.closure_eq_iUnion_Icc {B : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) :
    closure B = ⋃ i, Set.Icc (P.left i) (P.right i)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    closure B = closure (⋃ i, Set.Ioo (P.left i) (P.right i)) :=
      congrArg closure P.union_eq
    _ = ⋃ i, closure (Set.Ioo (P.left i) (P.right i)) := by
      exact closure_iUnion_of_finite (fun i : Fin P.n ↦
        Set.Ioo (P.left i) (P.right i))
    _ = ⋃ i, Set.Icc (P.left i) (P.right i) := by
      congr 1
      funext i
      exact closure_Ioo (ne_of_lt (P.lt i))

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IntervalPresentation.endpoint_subset_closure
statement:
theorem IntervalPresentation.endpoint_subset_closure {B : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) :
    (P.endpoints : Set ℝ) ⊆ closure B
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  simp only [IntervalPresentation.endpoints, Finset.coe_union, Finset.coe_image,
    Set.mem_union, Set.mem_image] at hx
  rw [IntervalPresentation.closure_eq_iUnion_Icc P, Set.mem_iUnion]
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨i, ⟨le_rfl, (P.lt i).le⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨i, ⟨(P.lt i).le, le_rfl⟩⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IntervalPresentation.closure_diff_subset_endpoints
statement:
theorem IntervalPresentation.closure_diff_subset_endpoints {B : Set ℝ}
    (P : IntervalPresentation B) : closure B \ B ⊆ (P.endpoints : Set ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨hxcl, hxB⟩
  rw [IntervalPresentation.closure_eq_iUnion_Icc P, Set.mem_iUnion] at hxcl
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxcl
  have hnotIoo : x ∉ Set.Ioo (P.left i) (P.right i) := by
    intro hx
    apply hxB
    rw [P.union_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨i, hx⟩
  have hxEq : x = P.left i ∨ x = P.right i := by
    rcases hxi with ⟨hl, hr⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_Ioo, not_and_or] at hnotIoo
    rcases hnotIoo with hnl | hnr
    · exact Or.inl (le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hnl) hl)
    · exact Or.inr (le_antisymm hr (le_of_not_gt hnr))
  simp only [IntervalPresentation.endpoints, Finset.coe_union, Finset.coe_image,
    Set.mem_union, Set.mem_image]
  rcases hxEq with rfl | rfl
  · exact Or.inl ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IntervalPresentation.frontier_subset_endpoints
statement:
theorem IntervalPresentation.frontier_subset_endpoints {B : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) :
    frontier B ⊆ (P.endpoints : Set ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frontier, (IntervalPresentation.isOpen P).interior_eq]
  exact IntervalPresentation.closure_diff_subset_endpoints P

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IntervalPresentation.gapLengths_finite
statement:
theorem IntervalPresentation.gapLengths_finite {B : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) :
    P.gapLengths.Finite
proof:
:= by
  let E : Set ℝ := P.endpoints
  have hE : E.Finite := P.endpoints.finite_toSet
  let D : Set ℝ := (fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ q.2 - q.1) '' (E ×ˢ E)
  have hD : D.Finite := (hE.prod hE).image _
  apply hD.subset
  rintro d ⟨e₁, he₁, e₂, he₂, -, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨(e₁, e₂), ⟨he₁, he₂⟩, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IntervalPresentation.gapLengths_pos
statement:
theorem IntervalPresentation.gapLengths_pos {B : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    {d : ℝ} (hd : d ∈ P.gapLengths) : 0 < d
proof:
:= by
  rcases hd with ⟨e₁, -, e₂, -, hlt, rfl⟩
  linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IntervalPresentation.gapLengths_nonempty
statement:
theorem IntervalPresentation.gapLengths_nonempty {B : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hB : B.Nonempty) : P.gapLengths.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hB
  rw [P.union_eq, Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨P.right i - P.left i, P.left i, ?_, P.right i, ?_, P.lt i, rfl⟩
  · rw [IntervalPresentation.endpoints, Finset.mem_union]
    exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
  · rw [IntervalPresentation.endpoints, Finset.mem_union]
    exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IntervalPresentation.endpoints_nonempty
statement:
theorem IntervalPresentation.endpoints_nonempty {B : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hB : B.Nonempty) : P.endpoints.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hB
  rw [P.union_eq, Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
  obtain ⟨i, -⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨P.left i, by
    rw [IntervalPresentation.endpoints, Finset.mem_union]
    exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.mem_translatedEndpointSet_iff
statement:
theorem mem_translatedEndpointSet_iff {B L : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) {x : ℝ} :
    x ∈ translatedEndpointSet P L ↔ ∃ l ∈ L, ∃ e ∈ P.endpoints, x = l + e
proof:
:= by
  rw [translatedEndpointSet]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨l, hl, e, he, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨l, hl, e, he, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨l, hl, e, he, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨l, hl, e, he, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.translatedEndpointSet_boundedWindowFinite
statement:
theorem translatedEndpointSet_boundedWindowFinite {B L : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hLlocal : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (L ∩ Q).Finite) :
    ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (translatedEndpointSet P L ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQ
  let E : Set ℝ := P.endpoints
  have hE : E.Finite := P.endpoints.finite_toSet
  have hprod : (L ∩ (Q - E)) ×ˢ E |>.Finite := by
    exact (hLlocal _ (isBounded_sub hQ hE.isBounded)).prod hE
  let add : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun q ↦ q.1 + q.2
  apply (hprod.image add).subset
  rintro x ⟨hxtrans, hxQ⟩
  rw [mem_translatedEndpointSet_iff P] at hxtrans
  obtain ⟨l, hl, e, he, rfl⟩ := hxtrans
  refine ⟨(l, e), ⟨⟨hl, ?_⟩, he⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨l + e, hxQ, e, he, by simp⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.endpoint_not_mem_other_openTile
statement:
theorem endpoint_not_mem_other_openTile {B L : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hpack : Set.Pairwise L (AEDisjoint volume on ((· +ᵥ B) : ℝ → Set ℝ)))
    {l m e : ℝ} (hl : l ∈ L) (hm : m ∈ L) (hlm : l ≠ m) (he : e ∈ P.endpoints) :
    l + e ∉ m +ᵥ B
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hecl : e ∈ closure B := IntervalPresentation.endpoint_subset_closure P he
  have hcl : l + e ∈ closure (l +ᵥ B) := by
    rw [closure_vadd]
    exact ⟨e, hecl, by simp⟩
  have hopenB : IsOpen B := IntervalPresentation.isOpen P
  have hne : ((m +ᵥ B) ∩ (l +ᵥ B)).Nonempty :=
    (mem_closure_iff.mp hcl) (m +ᵥ B) (hopenB.vadd m) hmem
  have hpos : 0 < volume ((m +ᵥ B) ∩ (l +ᵥ B)) :=
    ((hopenB.vadd m).inter (hopenB.vadd l)).measure_pos volume hne
  have hzero := hpack hm hl hlm.symm
  exact hpos.ne' hzero

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IsFiniteIntervalRegion.isOpen
statement: theorem IsFiniteIntervalRegion.isOpen {B : Set ℝ} (hB : IsFiniteIntervalRegion B) : IsOpen B
proof:
:=
  IntervalPresentation.isOpen (IntervalPresentation.ofIsFiniteIntervalRegion hB)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IsFiniteIntervalRegion.measure_ne_top
statement:
theorem IsFiniteIntervalRegion.measure_ne_top {B : Set ℝ} (hB : IsFiniteIntervalRegion B) :
    volume B ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  IntervalPresentation.volume_ne_top (IntervalPresentation.ofIsFiniteIntervalRegion hB)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.IsFiniteIntervalRegion.extremeCollars
statement:
theorem IsFiniteIntervalRegion.extremeCollars {B : Set ℝ} (hB : IsFiniteIntervalRegion B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) :
    ∃ a b etaLeft etaRight : ℝ, a < b ∧ 0 < etaLeft ∧ 0 < etaRight ∧
      B ⊆ Set.Icc a b ∧ Set.Ioo a (a + etaLeft) ⊆ B ∧
      Set.Ioo (b - etaRight) b ⊆ B
proof:
:= by
  let P := IntervalPresentation.ofIsFiniteIntervalRegion hB
  have hBne : B.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hn
    have hEmpty : B = ∅ := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hn
    rw [hEmpty] at hBpositive
    simp at hBpositive
  have hE : P.endpoints.Nonempty := IntervalPresentation.endpoints_nonempty P hBne
  let a : ℝ := P.endpoints.min' hE
  let b : ℝ := P.endpoints.max' hE
  have hleft_mem (i : Fin P.n) : P.left i ∈ P.endpoints := by
    rw [IntervalPresentation.endpoints, Finset.mem_union]
    exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
  have hright_mem (i : Fin P.n) : P.right i ∈ P.endpoints := by
    rw [IntervalPresentation.endpoints, Finset.mem_union]
    exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
  have ha_left : ∃ i, a = P.left i := by
    have ha_mem : a ∈ P.endpoints := Finset.min'_mem _ hE
    rw [IntervalPresentation.endpoints, Finset.mem_union] at ha_mem
    rcases ha_mem with ha | ha
    · obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
      exact ⟨i, hi.symm⟩
    · obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
      exfalso
      have hmin := Finset.min'_le P.endpoints (P.left i) (hleft_mem i)
      dsimp only [a] at hi hmin
      rw [← hi] at hmin
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hmin) (P.lt i)
  have hb_right : ∃ i, b = P.right i := by
    have hb_mem : b ∈ P.endpoints := Finset.max'_mem _ hE
    rw [IntervalPresentation.endpoints, Finset.mem_union] at hb_mem
    rcases hb_mem with hb | hb
    · obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
      exfalso
      have hmax := Finset.le_max' P.endpoints (P.right i) (hright_mem i)
      dsimp only [b] at hi hmax
      rw [← hi] at hmax
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hmax) (P.lt i)
    · obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
      exact ⟨i, hi.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨iLeft, ha⟩ := ha_left
  obtain ⟨iRight, hb⟩ := hb_right
  have hab : a < b := by
    have hbmax := Finset.le_max' P.endpoints (P.right iLeft) (hright_mem iLeft)
    calc
      a = P.left iLeft := ha
      _ < P.right iLeft := P.lt iLeft
      _ ≤ b := hbmax
  let etaLeft := P.right iLeft - a
  let etaRight := b - P.left iRight
  have hetaLeft : 0 < etaLeft := by
    dsimp only [etaLeft]
    rw [ha]
    exact sub_pos.mpr (P.lt iLeft)
  have hetaRight : 0 < etaRight := by
    dsimp only [etaRight]
    rw [hb]
    exact sub_pos.mpr (P.lt iRight)
  refine ⟨a, b, etaLeft, etaRight, hab, hetaLeft, hetaRight, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    rw [P.union_eq, Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hx
    have hamin := Finset.min'_le P.endpoints (P.left i) (hleft_mem i)
    have hbmax := Finset.le_max' P.endpoints (P.right i) (hright_mem i)
    exact ⟨le_trans hamin hxi.1.le, le_trans hxi.2.le hbmax⟩
  · have hsum : a + etaLeft = P.right iLeft := by
      dsimp only [etaLeft]
      ring
    rw [hsum]
    intro x hx
    rw [P.union_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨iLeft, by simpa [ha] using hx⟩
  · have hsub : b - etaRight = P.left iRight := by
      dsimp only [etaRight]
      ring
    rw [hsub]
    intro x hx
    rw [P.union_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨iRight, by simpa [hb] using hx⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.finiteInterval_lineTilesOn_centres_locallyFinite
statement:
theorem finiteInterval_lineTilesOn_centres_locallyFinite {B H X : Set ℝ}
    (hB : IsFiniteIntervalRegion B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) (hTile : LineTilesOn B H X) :
    ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (H ∩ Q).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hlocal, _⟩ :=
    linePacking_uniformlySeparated hTile
      (IsFiniteIntervalRegion.measure_ne_top hB) hBpositive
  exact hlocal

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.eqvGen_to_reflTransGen_of_symm
statement:
private theorem eqvGen_to_reflTransGen_of_symm
    {α : Type*} {r : α → α → Prop} (hsymm : Std.Symm r)
    {a b : α} (h : Relation.EqvGen r a b) : Relation.ReflTransGen r a b
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel x y hxy => exact .tail .refl hxy
  | refl x => exact .refl
  | symm x y _ ih =>
      let _ : Std.Symm r := hsymm
      exact symm_of (Relation.ReflTransGen r) ih
  | trans x y z _ _ ihxy ihyz => exact ihxy.trans ihyz

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.reflTransGen_to_eqvGen
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl _
