  | tail hxy hyz ih => exact .trans _ _ _ ih (.rel _ _ hyz)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.restrict_touching_path
statement:
private theorem restrict_touching_path
    {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n → ℝ) (i : ValidIntervalIndex a b)
    {j k : ValidIntervalIndex a b}
    (hj : SameIntervalRun a b i j)
    (hjk : Relation.ReflTransGen (IntervalsTouch a b) j k) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun p q => IntervalsTouch a b p q ∧ SameIntervalRun a b i p) j k
proof:
:= by
  induction hjk with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | tail hpq hqr ih =>
      apply Relation.ReflTransGen.tail ih
      refine ⟨hqr, ?_⟩
      exact Relation.EqvGen.trans _ j _ hj (reflTransGen_to_eqvGen hpq)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.finiteIntervalRun_union_eq_hull_proof
statement:
private theorem finiteIntervalRun_union_eq_hull_proof :
    (∀ {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n → ℝ) (i : ValidIntervalIndex a b),
    ∃ l r : ℝ, l ≤ r ∧
      (⋃ j : {j : ValidIntervalIndex a b // SameIntervalRun a b i j},
          closedIntervalOf a b j.1) = Icc l r ∧
      (∀ j : ValidIntervalIndex a b, SameIntervalRun a b i j →
        l ≤ a j.1 ∧ b j.1 ≤ r) ∧
      (∃ j : ValidIntervalIndex a b,
          SameIntervalRun a b i j ∧ a j.1 = l) ∧
      ∃ j : ValidIntervalIndex a b,
          SameIntervalRun a b i j ∧ b j.1 = r)
proof:
:= by
  intro n a b i
  let t : Set (ValidIntervalIndex a b) := {j | SameIntervalRun a b i j}
  let U : Set ℝ := ⋃ j ∈ t, closedIntervalOf a b j
  let _ : Finite (ValidIntervalIndex a b) :=
    Finite.of_injective (fun j => j.1) Subtype.val_injective
  let _ : Finite ↑t := Finite.of_injective (fun j => j.1) Subtype.val_injective
  have htfinite : t.Finite := t.toFinite
  have hcompact : IsCompact U := by
    exact htfinite.isCompact_biUnion (fun _ _ => isCompact_Icc)
  have hnonempty : U.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨a i.1, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨Relation.EqvGen.refl i, ?_⟩⟩⟩
    exact ⟨le_rfl, i.2⟩
  have hpre : IsPreconnected U := by
    apply IsPreconnected.biUnion_of_reflTransGen
    · intro j _
      exact isPreconnected_Icc
    · intro j hj k hk
      apply restrict_touching_path a b i hj
      apply eqvGen_to_reflTransGen_of_symm
      · exact ⟨by
          intro p q hpq
          simpa only [IntervalsTouch, inter_comm] using hpq⟩
      exact Relation.EqvGen.trans _ i _ (Relation.EqvGen.symm _ _ hj) hk
  have hconnected : IsConnected U := ⟨hnonempty, hpre⟩
  let l := sInf U
  let r := sSup U
  have hUeq : U = Icc l r := eq_Icc_of_connected_compact hconnected hcompact
  have hlU : l ∈ U := hcompact.sInf_mem hnonempty
  have hrU : r ∈ U := hcompact.sSup_mem hnonempty
  have hlleast : IsLeast U l := hcompact.isLeast_sInf hnonempty
  have hrgreatest : IsGreatest U r := hcompact.isGreatest_sSup hnonempty
  have hlr : l ≤ r := hlleast.2 hrU
  refine ⟨l, r, hlr, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hUeq]
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro hx
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨j, hxj⟩
      exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j.1, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j.2, hxj⟩⟩
    · rintro hx
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨j, hxj⟩
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hxj with ⟨hji, hxj⟩
      exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨j, hji⟩, hxj⟩
  · intro j hj
    have hjsub : closedIntervalOf a b j ⊆ U := by
      intro x hx
      exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨hj, hx⟩⟩
    exact ⟨hlleast.2 (hjsub ⟨le_rfl, j.2⟩),
      hrgreatest.2 (hjsub ⟨j.2, le_rfl⟩)⟩
  · rcases mem_iUnion.1 hlU with ⟨j, hj⟩
    rcases mem_iUnion.1 hj with ⟨hji, hjl⟩
    refine ⟨j, hji, le_antisymm hjl.1 ?_⟩
    exact hlleast.2 (mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨hji, ⟨le_rfl, j.2⟩⟩⟩)
  · rcases mem_iUnion.1 hrU with ⟨j, hj⟩
    rcases mem_iUnion.1 hj with ⟨hji, hjr⟩
    refine ⟨j, hji, le_antisymm ?_ hjr.2⟩
    exact hrgreatest.2 (mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨hji, ⟨j.2, le_rfl⟩⟩⟩)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.distinctIntervalRuns_strictGap_proof
statement:
private theorem distinctIntervalRuns_strictGap_proof :
    (∀ {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n → ℝ)
      (i j : ValidIntervalIndex a b),
    ¬ SameIntervalRun a b i j →
    ∀ {li ri lj rj : ℝ},
      (⋃ k : {k : ValidIntervalIndex a b // SameIntervalRun a b i k},
          closedIntervalOf a b k.1) = Icc li ri →
      (⋃ k : {k : ValidIntervalIndex a b // SameIntervalRun a b j k},
          closedIntervalOf a b k.1) = Icc lj rj →
      ri < lj ∨ rj < li)
proof:
:= by
  intro n a b i j hij li ri lj rj hi hj
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Icc li ri) (Icc lj rj) := by
    rw [← hi, ← hj]
    apply Set.disjoint_left.2
    intro x hxi hxj
    rcases mem_iUnion.1 hxi with ⟨k, hxk⟩
    rcases mem_iUnion.1 hxj with ⟨l, hxl⟩
    have htouch : IntervalsTouch a b k.1 l.1 := ⟨x, hxk, hxl⟩
    apply hij
    exact Relation.EqvGen.trans _ k.1 _ k.2
      (Relation.EqvGen.trans _ l.1 _ (.rel _ _ htouch)
        (Relation.EqvGen.symm _ _ l.2))
  have hiri : li ≤ ri := by
    have hx : a i.1 ∈ ⋃ k : {k : ValidIntervalIndex a b //
        SameIntervalRun a b i k}, closedIntervalOf a b k.1 := by
      exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨i, .refl i⟩, ⟨le_rfl, i.2⟩⟩
    rw [hi] at hx
    exact hx.1.trans hx.2
  have hjrj : lj ≤ rj := by
    have hx : a j.1 ∈ ⋃ k : {k : ValidIntervalIndex a b //
        SameIntervalRun a b j k}, closedIntervalOf a b k.1 := by
      exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨j, .refl j⟩, ⟨le_rfl, j.2⟩⟩
    rw [hj] at hx
    exact hx.1.trans hx.2
  by_contra hgap
  push Not at hgap
  have hx1 : max li lj ∈ Icc li ri := by
    constructor
    · exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact max_le hiri hgap.1
  have hx2 : max li lj ∈ Icc lj rj := by
    constructor
    · exact le_max_right _ _
    · exact max_le hgap.2 hjrj
  exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hx1 hx2

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.separatedIntervals_interior_closure
statement:
private theorem separatedIntervals_interior_closure
    (s : Finset (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hlt : ∀ p ∈ s, p.1 < p.2)
    (hgap : ∀ p ∈ s, ∀ q ∈ s, p ≠ q →
      p.2 < q.1 ∨ q.2 < p.1) :
    interior (⋃ p ∈ s, Icc p.1 p.2) = ⋃ p ∈ s, Ioo p.1 p.2 ∧
      closure (⋃ p ∈ s, Ioo p.1 p.2) = ⋃ p ∈ s, Icc p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert p s hp ih =>
      have hltp : p.1 < p.2 := hlt p (Finset.mem_insert_self ..)
      have hlts : ∀ q ∈ s, q.1 < q.2 := by
        intro q hq
        exact hlt q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq)
      have hgaps : ∀ q ∈ s, ∀ r ∈ s, q ≠ r →
          q.2 < r.1 ∨ r.2 < q.1 := by
        intro q hq r hr hqr
        exact hgap q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq) r
          (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hr) hqr
      obtain ⟨hinterior, hclosure⟩ := ih hlts hgaps
      have hclosedSubtype : IsClosed (⋃ q : ↑s, Icc q.1.1 q.1.2) :=
        isClosed_iUnion_of_finite fun _ => isClosed_Icc
      have hclosedRest : IsClosed (⋃ q ∈ s, Icc q.1 q.2) := by
        convert hclosedSubtype using 1
        ext x
        simp
      have hpdisj : Disjoint (Icc p.1 p.2) (⋃ q ∈ s, Icc q.1 q.2) := by
        rw [Set.disjoint_iUnion_right]
        intro q
        rw [Set.disjoint_iUnion_right]
        intro hq
        apply Set.disjoint_left.2
        intro x hxp hxq
        have hpq := hgap p (Finset.mem_insert_self ..) q
          (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq) (fun hpq => hp (hpq ▸ hq))
        rcases hpq with hpq | hqp
        · exact (not_lt_of_ge hxq.1) (hxp.2.trans_lt hpq)
        · exact (not_lt_of_ge hxp.1) (hxq.2.trans_lt hqp)
      constructor
      · rw [Finset.set_biUnion_insert, Finset.set_biUnion_insert]
        rw [interior_union_of_disjoint_closure]
        · rw [interior_Icc, hinterior]
        · simpa only [isClosed_Icc.closure_eq, hclosedRest.closure_eq] using hpdisj
      · rw [Finset.set_biUnion_insert, Finset.set_biUnion_insert]
        rw [closure_union, closure_Ioo (ne_of_lt hltp), hclosure]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.separatedIntervals_interior
statement:
private theorem separatedIntervals_interior
    (s : Finset (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hle : ∀ p ∈ s, p.1 ≤ p.2)
    (hgap : ∀ p ∈ s, ∀ q ∈ s, p ≠ q →
      p.2 < q.1 ∨ q.2 < p.1) :
    interior (⋃ p ∈ s, Icc p.1 p.2) = ⋃ p ∈ s, Ioo p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert p s hp ih =>
      have hlep := hle p (Finset.mem_insert_self ..)
      have hles : ∀ q ∈ s, q.1 ≤ q.2 := fun q hq =>
        hle q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq)
      have hgaps : ∀ q ∈ s, ∀ r ∈ s, q ≠ r →
          q.2 < r.1 ∨ r.2 < q.1 := fun q hq r hr hqr =>
        hgap q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq) r
          (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hr) hqr
      have hclosedSubtype : IsClosed (⋃ q : ↑s, Icc q.1.1 q.1.2) :=
        isClosed_iUnion_of_finite fun _ => isClosed_Icc
      have hclosedRest : IsClosed (⋃ q ∈ s, Icc q.1 q.2) := by
        convert hclosedSubtype using 1
        ext x
        simp
      have hpdisj : Disjoint (Icc p.1 p.2) (⋃ q ∈ s, Icc q.1 q.2) := by
        rw [Set.disjoint_iUnion_right]
        intro q
        rw [Set.disjoint_iUnion_right]
        intro hq
        apply Set.disjoint_left.2
        intro x hxp hxq
        rcases hgap p (Finset.mem_insert_self ..) q
          (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq) (fun hpq => hp (hpq ▸ hq)) with hpq | hqp
        · exact (not_lt_of_ge hxq.1) (hxp.2.trans_lt hpq)
        · exact (not_lt_of_ge hxp.1) (hxq.2.trans_lt hqp)
      rw [Finset.set_biUnion_insert, Finset.set_biUnion_insert,
        interior_union_of_disjoint_closure]
      · rw [interior_Icc, ih hles hgaps]
      · simpa only [isClosed_Icc.closure_eq, hclosedRest.closure_eq] using hpdisj

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.finiteClosedIntervals_merge_proof
statement:
private theorem finiteClosedIntervals_merge_proof :
    (∀ {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n → ℝ),
    Nonempty (MaximalIntervalPresentation
      (interior (⋃ i, Icc (a i) (b i)))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro n a b
  let V := ValidIntervalIndex a b
  let _ : Finite V := Finite.of_injective (fun j : V => j.1) Subtype.val_injective
  let _ : Fintype V := Fintype.ofFinite V
  choose l r hlr hrun hbounds hleft hright using
    fun i : V => finiteIntervalRun_union_eq_hull_proof a b i
  let hull : V → ℝ × ℝ := fun i => (l i, r i)
  let allPairs : Finset (ℝ × ℝ) := Finset.univ.image hull
  let goodPairs : Finset (ℝ × ℝ) := allPairs.filter fun p => p.1 < p.2
  have hull_eq_of_run {i j : V} (hij : SameIntervalRun a b i j) : hull i = hull j := by
    have hclasses :
        (⋃ k : {k : V // SameIntervalRun a b i k}, closedIntervalOf a b k.1) =
          ⋃ k : {k : V // SameIntervalRun a b j k}, closedIntervalOf a b k.1 := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro hx
        rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨k, hxk⟩
        exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨k.1,
          Relation.EqvGen.trans _ i _ (Relation.EqvGen.symm _ _ hij) k.2⟩, hxk⟩
      · rintro hx
        rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨k, hxk⟩
        exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨k.1, Relation.EqvGen.trans _ j _ hij k.2⟩, hxk⟩
    have hIcc : Icc (l i) (r i) = Icc (l j) (r j) := by
      rw [← hrun i, ← hrun j]
      exact hclasses
    have hli_mem : l i ∈ Icc (l j) (r j) := by
      rw [← hIcc]
      exact ⟨le_rfl, hlr i⟩
    have hlj_mem : l j ∈ Icc (l i) (r i) := by
      rw [hIcc]
      exact ⟨le_rfl, hlr j⟩
    have hri_mem : r i ∈ Icc (l j) (r j) := by
      rw [← hIcc]
      exact ⟨hlr i, le_rfl⟩
    have hrj_mem : r j ∈ Icc (l i) (r i) := by
      rw [hIcc]
      exact ⟨hlr j, le_rfl⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · change l i = l j
      exact le_antisymm hlj_mem.1 hli_mem.1
    · change r i = r j
      exact le_antisymm hri_mem.2 hrj_mem.2
  have hall_le : ∀ p ∈ allPairs, p.1 ≤ p.2 := by
    intro p hp
    rcases Finset.mem_image.1 hp with ⟨i, _, rfl⟩
    exact hlr i
  have hall_gap : ∀ p ∈ allPairs, ∀ q ∈ allPairs, p ≠ q →
      p.2 < q.1 ∨ q.2 < p.1 := by
    intro p hp q hq hpq
    rcases Finset.mem_image.1 hp with ⟨i, _, rfl⟩
    rcases Finset.mem_image.1 hq with ⟨j, _, rfl⟩
    apply distinctIntervalRuns_strictGap_proof a b i j
    · intro hij
      exact hpq (hull_eq_of_run hij)
    · exact hrun i
    · exact hrun j
  have hunion : (⋃ i, Icc (a i) (b i)) = ⋃ p ∈ allPairs, Icc p.1 p.2 := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro hx
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨i, hxi⟩
      let vi : V := ⟨i, hxi.1.trans hxi.2⟩
      apply mem_iUnion.2
      refine ⟨hull vi, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨vi, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩, ?_⟩⟩
      rw [← hrun vi]
      exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨vi, .refl vi⟩, hxi⟩
    · rintro hx
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨p, hxp⟩
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hxp with ⟨hp, hxp⟩
      rcases Finset.mem_image.1 hp with ⟨i, _, rfl⟩
      rw [← hrun i] at hxp
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hxp with ⟨j, hxj⟩
      exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j.1.1, hxj⟩
  have hinteriorAll := separatedIntervals_interior allPairs hall_le hall_gap
  have hgood_lt : ∀ p ∈ goodPairs, p.1 < p.2 := by
    intro p hp
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.1 hp).2
  have hgood_gap : ∀ p ∈ goodPairs, ∀ q ∈ goodPairs, p ≠ q →
      p.2 < q.1 ∨ q.2 < p.1 := by
    intro p hp q hq hpq
    exact hall_gap p (Finset.mem_filter.1 hp).1 q (Finset.mem_filter.1 hq).1 hpq
  obtain ⟨hinteriorGood, hclosureGood⟩ :=
    separatedIntervals_interior_closure goodPairs hgood_lt hgood_gap
  have hopenUnion :
      (⋃ p ∈ allPairs, Ioo p.1 p.2) = ⋃ p ∈ goodPairs, Ioo p.1 p.2 := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro hx
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨p, hxp⟩
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hxp with ⟨hp, hxp⟩
      exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨p, mem_iUnion.2
        ⟨Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hp, hxp.1.trans hxp.2⟩, hxp⟩⟩
    · rintro hx
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨p, hxp⟩
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hxp with ⟨hp, hxp⟩
      exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨p, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.1 hp).1, hxp⟩⟩
  let G := ↑goodPairs
  let e : G ≃ Fin (Fintype.card G) := Fintype.equivFin G
  let pick : Fin (Fintype.card G) → G := e.symm
  refine ⟨{
    n := Fintype.card G
    left := fun i => (pick i).1.1
    right := fun i => (pick i).1.2
    lt := fun i => hgood_lt (pick i) (pick i).2
    pairwise_gap := ?_
    union_eq := ?_
    closure_eq := ?_ }⟩
  · intro i j hij
    apply hgood_gap (pick i) (pick i).2 (pick j) (pick j).2
    intro hpick
    exact hij (e.symm.injective (Subtype.ext hpick))
  · calc
      interior (⋃ i, Icc (a i) (b i)) =
          interior (⋃ p ∈ allPairs, Icc p.1 p.2) := congrArg interior hunion
      _ = ⋃ p ∈ allPairs, Ioo p.1 p.2 := hinteriorAll
      _ = ⋃ p ∈ goodPairs, Ioo p.1 p.2 := hopenUnion
      _ = ⋃ i, Ioo (pick i).1.1 (pick i).1.2 := by
        ext x
        constructor
        · rintro hx
          rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨p, hxp⟩
          rcases mem_iUnion.1 hxp with ⟨hp, hxp⟩
          let gp : G := ⟨p, hp⟩
          exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨e gp, by simpa [pick, gp] using hxp⟩
        · rintro hx
          rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨i, hxi⟩
          exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨pick i, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨(pick i).2, hxi⟩⟩
  · have hbase : interior (⋃ i, Icc (a i) (b i)) =
        ⋃ p ∈ goodPairs, Ioo p.1 p.2 := by
      calc
        _ = interior (⋃ p ∈ allPairs, Icc p.1 p.2) := congrArg interior hunion
        _ = ⋃ p ∈ allPairs, Ioo p.1 p.2 := hinteriorAll
        _ = _ := hopenUnion
    rw [hbase, hclosureGood]
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro hx
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨p, hxp⟩
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hxp with ⟨hp, hxp⟩
      let gp : G := ⟨p, hp⟩
      exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨e gp, by simpa [pick, gp] using hxp⟩
    · rintro hx
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨i, hxi⟩
      exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨pick i, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨(pick i).2, hxi⟩⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.finiteClosedIntervals_merge
statement:
theorem finiteClosedIntervals_merge :
    (∀ {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n → ℝ),
    Nonempty (MaximalIntervalPresentation
      (interior (⋃ i, Icc (a i) (b i)))))
proof:
:=
  finiteClosedIntervals_merge_proof

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.finiteIntervalRun_union_eq_hull
statement:
theorem finiteIntervalRun_union_eq_hull :
    (∀ {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n → ℝ) (i : ValidIntervalIndex a b),
    ∃ l r : ℝ, l ≤ r ∧
      (⋃ j : {j : ValidIntervalIndex a b // SameIntervalRun a b i j},
          closedIntervalOf a b j.1) = Icc l r ∧
      (∀ j : ValidIntervalIndex a b, SameIntervalRun a b i j →
        l ≤ a j.1 ∧ b j.1 ≤ r) ∧
      (∃ j : ValidIntervalIndex a b,
          SameIntervalRun a b i j ∧ a j.1 = l) ∧
      ∃ j : ValidIntervalIndex a b,
          SameIntervalRun a b i j ∧ b j.1 = r)
proof:
:=
  finiteIntervalRun_union_eq_hull_proof

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.GenericSlices.distinctIntervalRuns_strictGap
statement:
theorem distinctIntervalRuns_strictGap :
    (∀ {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n → ℝ)
      (i j : ValidIntervalIndex a b),
    ¬ SameIntervalRun a b i j →
    ∀ {li ri lj rj : ℝ},
      (⋃ k : {k : ValidIntervalIndex a b // SameIntervalRun a b i k},
          closedIntervalOf a b k.1) = Icc li ri →
      (⋃ k : {k : ValidIntervalIndex a b // SameIntervalRun a b j k},
          closedIntervalOf a b k.1) = Icc lj rj →
      ri < lj ∨ rj < li)
proof:
:=
  distinctIntervalRuns_strictGap_proof

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.periodIndex_pos_mass
statement:
private theorem periodIndex_pos_mass {B : Set ℝ}
    (hBbounded : Bornology.IsBounded B) (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal)
    (N : NormalizedLineTiling B) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hperiod : p +ᵥ N.centres = N.centres) :
    0 < periodIndex N.centres p ∧
      p = (volume B).toReal * periodIndex N.centres p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hfinite, hnonempty, hmass⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.linePeriod_mass
      hBbounded hBpositive N.tiles hp hperiod
  exact ⟨(Set.ncard_pos hfinite).2 hnonempty, hmass⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.commonIndex_pos
statement:
private theorem commonIndex_pos {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (n : ι → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) : 0 < commonIndex n
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ ↦ hn i)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.dvd_commonIndex
statement:
private theorem dvd_commonIndex {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (n : ι → ℕ) (i : ι) : n i ∣ commonIndex n
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem n (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.nsmul_linePeriod
statement:
private theorem nsmul_linePeriod {L : Set ℝ} {p : ℝ}
    (hperiod : p +ᵥ L = L) (k : ℕ) : ((k : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ L = L
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
      calc
        (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ L =
            (((k : ℕ) : ℝ) * p + p) +ᵥ L := by
              congr 1
              push_cast
              ring
        _ = (((k : ℕ) : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ (p +ᵥ L) := by
              rw [← add_vadd]
        _ = (((k : ℕ) : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ L := by rw [hperiod]
        _ = L := ih

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.lineTiles_centres_nonempty
statement:
private theorem lineTiles_centres_nonempty {B L : Set ℝ}
    (hTile : LineTiles B L) : L.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  have hcover : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ∃ l : L, x ∈ ((l : ℝ) +ᵥ B) := by
    filter_upwards [hTile.2.2.2.2] with x hx
    exact hx.mp (Set.mem_univ x)
  obtain ⟨x, l, hl⟩ := hcover.exists
  exact ⟨l, l.property⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.exists_commonLinePeriod_of_finite_normalized
statement:
theorem exists_commonLinePeriod_of_finite_normalized
    {B : Set ℝ} (hBbounded : Bornology.IsBounded B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal)
    (hfinite : Finite (NormalizedLineTiling B)) :
    ∃ P : ℝ, 0 < P ∧
      (∃ M : ℕ, 0 < M ∧ P = M * (volume B).toReal) ∧
      ∀ L : Set ℝ, LineTiles B L → P +ᵥ L = L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : Finite (NormalizedLineTiling B) := hfinite
  let _ : Fintype (NormalizedLineTiling B) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hexistsPeriod : ∀ N : NormalizedLineTiling B,
      ∃ p : ℝ, 0 < p ∧ p +ᵥ N.centres = N.centres := fun N ↦
    exists_positiveLinePeriod_of_finite_normalized hBbounded N.tiles hfinite
  choose p hp hperiod using hexistsPeriod
  let n : NormalizedLineTiling B → ℕ := fun N ↦ periodIndex N.centres (p N)
  have hn : ∀ N, 0 < n N := fun N ↦
    (periodIndex_pos_mass hBbounded hBpositive N (hp N) (hperiod N)).1
  have hmass : ∀ N, p N = (volume B).toReal * n N := fun N ↦
    (periodIndex_pos_mass hBbounded hBpositive N (hp N) (hperiod N)).2
  let M : ℕ := commonIndex n
  have hM : 0 < M := commonIndex_pos n hn
  let P : ℝ := M * (volume B).toReal
  have hP : 0 < P := mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.2 hM) hBpositive
  refine ⟨P, hP, ⟨M, hM, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  intro L hTile
  obtain ⟨l₀, hl₀⟩ := lineTiles_centres_nonempty hTile
  obtain ⟨N, hNcentres, hNperiod⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.normalizeLineTiling_spec hTile hl₀
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := dvd_commonIndex n N
  have hP_eq : P = (k : ℝ) * p N := by
    dsimp [P, M]
    rw [hk, hmass N]
    push_cast
    ring
  apply (hNperiod P).mp
  rw [hP_eq]
  exact nsmul_linePeriod (hperiod N) k

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.exists_commonLinePeriod
statement:
theorem exists_commonLinePeriod
    {B : Set ℝ} (hB : IsFiniteIntervalRegion B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) :
    ∃ P : ℝ, 0 < P ∧
      (∃ M : ℕ, 0 < M ∧ P = M * (volume B).toReal) ∧
      ∀ L : Set ℝ, LineTiles B L → P +ᵥ L = L
proof:
:= by
  let presentation := IntervalPresentation.ofIsFiniteIntervalRegion hB
  exact exists_commonLinePeriod_of_finite_normalized
    presentation.isBounded hBpositive
    (finite_normalizedLineTilings hB hBpositive)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.fellCompactification_injective
statement:
private theorem fellCompactification_injective {A L : Set ℝ}
    (hA : IsClosed A) (hL : IsClosed L)
    (heq : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification A hA =
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification L hL) : A = L
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have hx := congrArg
    (fun K : TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts (OnePoint ℝ) ↦
      (x : OnePoint ℝ) ∈ (K : Set (OnePoint ℝ))) heq
  simpa [Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification,
    Tiling.Topology.fellCompactification] using hx

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.fellCompactification_congr
statement:
private theorem fellCompactification_congr {A L : Set ℝ}
    (hA : IsClosed A) (hL : IsClosed L) (h : A = L) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification A hA =
      Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification L hL
proof:
:= by
  subst L
  rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.locallyFellConverges_const_iff
statement:
private theorem locallyFellConverges_const_iff {A L : Set ℝ}
    (hA : IsClosed A) (hL : IsClosed L) :
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
      (fun _ : ℕ ↦ A) L ↔ A = L
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hseq, hL', hlim⟩
    have heq : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification A hA =
        Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification L hL := by
      have hlim' : Tendsto
          (fun _ : ℕ ↦ Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification A hA)
          atTop
          (nhds (Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.fellCompactification L hL)) := by
        exact hlim
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique (l := atTop) tendsto_const_nhds hlim'
    exact fellCompactification_injective hA hL heq
  · intro h
    subst L
    exact ⟨fun _ ↦ hA, hA, tendsto_const_nhds⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.normalizedLineTilings_eventuallyEq_of_finite
statement:
theorem normalizedLineTilings_eventuallyEq_of_finite {B : Set ℝ}
    (hfinite : Finite (NormalizedLineTiling B))
    (N : ℕ → NormalizedLineTiling B) (L : Set ℝ) (hclosed : IsClosed L)
    (hconv : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
      (NormalizedLineTiling.centres ∘ N) L) :
    LineTiles B L ∧ 0 ∈ L ∧
      ∃ n0 : ℕ, ∀ n, n0 ≤ n → (N n).centres = L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : Finite (NormalizedLineTiling B) := hfinite
  let _ : Fintype (NormalizedLineTiling B) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  obtain ⟨hseqClosed, hLclosed, hlim⟩ := hconv
  have hAvoid : ∀ M : NormalizedLineTiling B, M.centres ≠ L →
      ∀ᶠ n in atTop, N n ≠ M := by
    intro M hML
    by_contra hnot
    have hfreq : ∃ᶠ n in atTop, N n = M := by
      simpa using (Filter.not_eventually.mp hnot)
    obtain ⟨φ, hφmono, hφ⟩ := extraction_of_frequently_atTop hfreq
    have hMclosed : IsClosed M.centres := by
      simpa [Function.comp_apply, hφ 0] using hseqClosed (φ 0)
    have hsub := hlim.comp hφmono.tendsto_atTop
    have hconstConv : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
        (fun _ : ℕ ↦ M.centres) L := by
      refine ⟨fun _ ↦ hMclosed, hclosed, ?_⟩
      convert hsub using 1
      funext i
      exact fellCompactification_congr hMclosed (hseqClosed (φ i))
        (congrArg NormalizedLineTiling.centres (hφ i)).symm
    exact hML ((locallyFellConverges_const_iff hMclosed hclosed).mp hconstConv)
  let U : Set (NormalizedLineTiling B) := Set.univ
  have hAll : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ M ∈ U, M.centres ≠ L → N n ≠ M := by
    apply (Filter.eventually_all_finite (Set.toFinite U)).2
    intro M hMU
    by_cases hML : M.centres = L
    · filter_upwards [] with n
      exact fun hneq ↦ (hneq hML).elim
    · exact (hAvoid M hML).mono (fun n hn _ ↦ hn)
  have hEventually : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (N n).centres = L := by
    filter_upwards [hAll] with n hn
    by_contra hneq
    exact hn (N n) (Set.mem_univ _) hneq rfl
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hEventually.exists
  have hTile : LineTiles B L := by
    rw [← hn]
    exact (N n).tiles
  have hzero : 0 ∈ L := by
    rw [← hn]
    exact (N n).zero_mem
  exact ⟨hTile, hzero, Filter.eventually_atTop.1 hEventually⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.normalizedLineTilings_eventuallyEq
statement:
theorem normalizedLineTilings_eventuallyEq
    {B : Set ℝ} (hB : IsFiniteIntervalRegion B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal)
    (N : ℕ → NormalizedLineTiling B) (L : Set ℝ) (hclosed : IsClosed L)
    (hconv : Tiling.AxisParallel.Topology.LocallyFellConverges
      (NormalizedLineTiling.centres ∘ N) L) :
    LineTiles B L ∧ 0 ∈ L ∧
      ∃ n0 : ℕ, ∀ n, n0 ≤ n → (N n).centres = L
proof:
:= by
  exact normalizedLineTilings_eventuallyEq_of_finite
    (finite_normalizedLineTilings hB hBpositive) N L hclosed hconv

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.lineOpenUnion_isOpen
statement:
theorem lineOpenUnion_isOpen {B H : Set ℝ}
    (P : IntervalPresentation B) : IsOpen (lineOpenUnion B H)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineOpenUnion]
  exact isOpen_iUnion fun h : H => (P.isOpen).vadd (h : ℝ)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.locallyFinite_closedTranslates_of_boundedWindowFinite
statement:
theorem locallyFinite_closedTranslates_of_boundedWindowFinite {B H : Set ℝ}
    (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hHlocal : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (H ∩ Q).Finite) :
    LocallyFinite (fun h : H => (h : ℝ) +ᵥ closure B)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  let t : Set ℝ := Metric.ball x 1
  let Q : Set ℝ := t - closure B
  have ht : t ∈ 𝓝 x := Metric.ball_mem_nhds x zero_lt_one
  have hQbounded : Bornology.IsBounded Q :=
    Metric.isBounded_ball.sub (P.isBounded).closure
  have hfinVal : (H ∩ Q).Finite := hHlocal Q hQbounded
  have hfin : {h : H | (h : ℝ) ∈ H ∩ Q}.Finite :=
    hfinVal.preimage Subtype.val_injective.injOn
  refine ⟨t, ht, hfin.subset ?_⟩
  intro h hh
  obtain ⟨y, hyTranslate, hyt⟩ := hh
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hy⟩ := hyTranslate
  constructor
  · exact h.2
  · change (h : ℝ) ∈ t - closure B
    refine ⟨y, hyt, b, hb, ?_⟩
    dsimp only at hy ⊢
    rw [vadd_eq_add] at hy
    linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.lineClosedUnion_isClosed
statement:
theorem lineClosedUnion_isClosed {B H : Set ℝ}
    (_P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hlocal : LocallyFinite (fun h : H => (h : ℝ) +ᵥ closure B)) :
    IsClosed (lineClosedUnion B H)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineClosedUnion]
  exact hlocal.isClosed_iUnion fun h => isClosed_closure.vadd (h : ℝ)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.closure_lineOpenUnion
statement:
theorem closure_lineOpenUnion {B H : Set ℝ}
    (_P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hlocal : LocallyFinite (fun h : H => (h : ℝ) +ᵥ closure B)) :
    closure (lineOpenUnion B H) = lineClosedUnion B H
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineOpenUnion, lineClosedUnion]
  have hopenlocal : LocallyFinite (fun h : H => (h : ℝ) +ᵥ B) :=
    hlocal.subset fun h x hx => by
      obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact ⟨b, subset_closure hb, rfl⟩
  rw [hopenlocal.closure_iUnion]
  simp only [closure_vadd]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget_isRegularOpen
statement:
theorem regularizedTarget_isRegularOpen (B H : Set ℝ) :
    IsOpen (FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H) ∧
      interior (closure (FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H)) =
        FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isOpen_interior, ?_⟩
  simp only [regularizedTarget]
  exact interior_closure_idem

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.lineOpenUnion_subset_regularizedTarget
statement:
theorem lineOpenUnion_subset_regularizedTarget
    {B H : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) :
    lineOpenUnion B H ⊆ FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H
proof:
:= by
  exact (lineOpenUnion_isOpen P).subset_interior_closure

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.closure_regularizedTarget_subset_lineClosedUnion
statement:
theorem closure_regularizedTarget_subset_lineClosedUnion {B H : Set ℝ}
    (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hlocal : LocallyFinite (fun h : H => (h : ℝ) +ᵥ closure B)) :
    closure (FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H) ⊆ lineClosedUnion B H
proof:
:= by
  rw [regularizedTarget, ← closure_lineOpenUnion P hlocal]
  exact isClosed_closure.closure_interior_subset

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.closure_regularizedTarget_eq_lineClosedUnion
statement:
theorem closure_regularizedTarget_eq_lineClosedUnion {B H : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hlocal : LocallyFinite (fun h : H => (h : ℝ) +ᵥ closure B)) :
    closure (FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H) = lineClosedUnion B H
proof:
:= by
  apply Subset.antisymm (closure_regularizedTarget_subset_lineClosedUnion P hlocal)
  rw [← closure_lineOpenUnion P hlocal]
  exact closure_mono (lineOpenUnion_subset_regularizedTarget P)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.lineClosedUnion_diff_lineOpenUnion_subset_translatedEndpointSet
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxC := hx.1
  rw [lineClosedUnion, mem_iUnion] at hxC
  obtain ⟨h, hxh⟩ := hxC
  have hxnot : x ∉ (h : ℝ) +ᵥ B := by
    intro hxB
    apply hx.2
    rw [lineOpenUnion, mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨h, hxB⟩
  have hcl : x - (h : ℝ) ∈ closure B := by
    simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hxh
  have hnB : x - (h : ℝ) ∉ B := by
    simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hxnot
  apply (mem_translatedEndpointSet_iff P).2
  exact ⟨h, h.2, x - (h : ℝ), P.closure_diff_subset_endpoints ⟨hcl, hnB⟩, by ring⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.frontier_regularizedTarget_subset_translatedEndpointSet
statement:
theorem frontier_regularizedTarget_subset_translatedEndpointSet {B H : Set ℝ}
    (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hlocal : LocallyFinite (fun h : H => (h : ℝ) +ᵥ closure B)) :
    frontier (FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H) ⊆ translatedEndpointSet P H
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  apply lineClosedUnion_diff_lineOpenUnion_subset_translatedEndpointSet P
  rw [frontier, (regularizedTarget_isRegularOpen B H).1.interior_eq] at hx
  exact ⟨closure_regularizedTarget_subset_lineClosedUnion P hlocal hx.1,
    fun hxU => hx.2 (lineOpenUnion_subset_regularizedTarget P hxU)⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget_diff_lineOpenUnion_subset_translatedEndpointSet
statement:
theorem regularizedTarget_diff_lineOpenUnion_subset_translatedEndpointSet {B H : Set ℝ}
    (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hlocal : LocallyFinite (fun h : H => (h : ℝ) +ᵥ closure B)) :
    FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H \ lineOpenUnion B H ⊆ translatedEndpointSet P H
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  apply lineClosedUnion_diff_lineOpenUnion_subset_translatedEndpointSet P
  exact ⟨closure_regularizedTarget_subset_lineClosedUnion P hlocal (subset_closure hx.1), hx.2⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.translatedEndpointSet_countable
statement:
theorem translatedEndpointSet_countable
    {B H : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) (hHcountable : H.Countable) :
    (translatedEndpointSet P H).Countable
proof:
:= by
  rw [translatedEndpointSet]
  exact hHcountable.image2 P.endpoints.finite_toSet.countable (· + ·)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.volume_translatedEndpointSet_eq_zero
statement:
theorem volume_translatedEndpointSet_eq_zero
    {B H : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) (hHcountable : H.Countable) :
    volume (translatedEndpointSet P H) = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact (translatedEndpointSet_countable P hHcountable).measure_zero volume

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.lineOpenUnion_ae_regularizedTarget
statement:
theorem lineOpenUnion_ae_regularizedTarget
    {B H : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) (hHcountable : H.Countable)
    (hlocal : LocallyFinite (fun h : H => (h : ℝ) +ᵥ closure B)) :
    lineOpenUnion B H =ᵐ[volume] FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H
proof:
:= by
  apply ae_eq_set.2
  constructor
  · rw [sdiff_eq_empty.mpr (lineOpenUnion_subset_regularizedTarget P), measure_empty]
  · apply measure_mono_null
      (regularizedTarget_diff_lineOpenUnion_subset_translatedEndpointSet P hlocal)
      (volume_translatedEndpointSet_eq_zero P hHcountable)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.LineTilesOn.lineOpenUnion_ae
statement:
theorem LineTilesOn.lineOpenUnion_ae {B H X : Set ℝ} (hTile : LineTilesOn B H X) :
    lineOpenUnion B H =ᵐ[volume] X
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hTile.2.2.2.2] with x hx
  apply propext
  change x ∈ (⋃ h : H, (h : ℝ) +ᵥ B) ↔ x ∈ X
  rw [mem_iUnion]
  exact hx.symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.regularOpen_real_eq_of_aeEq
statement:
theorem regularOpen_real_eq_of_aeEq {U V : Set ℝ}
    (hUopen : IsOpen U) (hUregular : interior (closure U) = U)
    (hVopen : IsOpen V) (hVregular : interior (closure V) = V)
    (hUV : U =ᵐ[volume] V) : U = V
proof:
:= by
  have closure_mono_of_ae {A B : Set ℝ} (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B)
      (hAB : A =ᵐ[volume] B) : A ⊆ closure B := by
    intro x hxA
    by_contra hxB
    let W := A ∩ (closure B)ᶜ
    have hWopen : IsOpen W := hA.inter isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl
    have hxW : x ∈ W := ⟨hxA, hxB⟩
    have hWzero : volume W = 0 :=
      measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr (hAB.mono fun y hy hyW => by
        have hyB : y ∈ B := Eq.mp hy hyW.1
        exact hyW.2 (subset_closure hyB))
    exact hWopen.measure_ne_zero volume ⟨x, hxW⟩ hWzero
  have hclosure : closure U = closure V := Subset.antisymm
    (closure_minimal (closure_mono_of_ae hUopen hVopen hUV) isClosed_closure)
    (closure_minimal (closure_mono_of_ae hVopen hUopen hUV.symm) isClosed_closure)
  calc
    U = interior (closure U) := hUregular.symm
    _ = interior (closure V) := congrArg interior hclosure
    _ = V := hVregular

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget
statement:
theorem LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget
    {B H X : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) (hTile : LineTilesOn B H X)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) :
    let R := FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H
    IsOpen R ∧ interior (closure R) = R ∧ lineOpenUnion B H =ᵐ[volume] R ∧
      R =ᵐ[volume] X ∧ LineTilesOn B H R ∧
      (∀ C : Set ℝ, IsCompact C → (C ∩ frontier R).Finite)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  have hHlocal := finiteInterval_lineTilesOn_centres_locallyFinite
    P.isFiniteIntervalRegion hBpositive hTile
  have hlocal := locallyFinite_closedTranslates_of_boundedWindowFinite P hHlocal
  have hUaeR := lineOpenUnion_ae_regularizedTarget P hTile.2.2.1 hlocal
  have hUaeX := LineTilesOn.lineOpenUnion_ae hTile
  have hRaeX := hUaeR.symm.trans hUaeX
  have hR := regularizedTarget_isRegularOpen B H
  refine ⟨hR.1, hR.2, hUaeR, hRaeX, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨hTile.1, hR.1.measurableSet, hTile.2.2.1, hTile.2.2.2.1, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hUaeR] with x hx
    change x ∈ FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H ↔ ∃ h : H, x ∈ (h : ℝ) +ᵥ B
    have hx' : x ∈ lineOpenUnion B H ↔ x ∈ FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H :=
      Iff.of_eq hx
    rw [lineOpenUnion, mem_iUnion] at hx'
    exact hx'.symm
  · intro C hC
    have hE := translatedEndpointSet_boundedWindowFinite P hHlocal C hC.isBounded
    apply hE.subset
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨frontier_regularizedTarget_subset_translatedEndpointSet P hlocal hx.2, hx.1⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget_eq
statement:
theorem LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget_eq
    {B H R : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) (hTile : LineTilesOn B H R)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) (hRopen : IsOpen R)
    (hRregular : interior (closure R) = R) : FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H = R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hO, hreg, _, hae, _, _⟩ := LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget P hTile hBpositive
  exact regularOpen_real_eq_of_aeEq hO hreg hRopen hRregular hae

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.LineTilesOn.lineClosedUnion_eq_closure_target
statement:
theorem LineTilesOn.lineClosedUnion_eq_closure_target
    {B H R : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) (hTile : LineTilesOn B H R)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) (hRopen : IsOpen R)
    (hRregular : interior (closure R) = R) : lineClosedUnion B H = closure R
proof:
:= by
  have hHlocal := finiteInterval_lineTilesOn_centres_locallyFinite
    P.isFiniteIntervalRegion hBpositive hTile
  have hlocal := locallyFinite_closedTranslates_of_boundedWindowFinite P hHlocal
  rw [← closure_regularizedTarget_eq_lineClosedUnion P hlocal,
    LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget_eq P hTile hBpositive hRopen hRregular]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.LineTilesOn.frontier_target_subset_translatedEndpointSet
statement:
theorem LineTilesOn.frontier_target_subset_translatedEndpointSet
    {B H R : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) (hTile : LineTilesOn B H R)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) (hRopen : IsOpen R)
    (hRregular : interior (closure R) = R) :
    frontier R ⊆ translatedEndpointSet P H
proof:
:= by
  have hHlocal := finiteInterval_lineTilesOn_centres_locallyFinite
    P.isFiniteIntervalRegion hBpositive hTile
  have hlocal := locallyFinite_closedTranslates_of_boundedWindowFinite P hHlocal
  rw [← LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget_eq P hTile hBpositive hRopen hRregular]
  exact frontier_regularizedTarget_subset_translatedEndpointSet P hlocal

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.LineTilesOn.translatedEndpointSet_subset_closure_target
statement:
theorem LineTilesOn.translatedEndpointSet_subset_closure_target
    {B H R : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) (hTile : LineTilesOn B H R)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) (hRopen : IsOpen R)
    (hRregular : interior (closure R) = R) :
    translatedEndpointSet P H ⊆ closure R
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨h, hh, e, he, rfl⟩ := (mem_translatedEndpointSet_iff P).1 hx
  rw [← LineTilesOn.lineClosedUnion_eq_closure_target P hTile hBpositive hRopen hRregular]
  rw [lineClosedUnion, mem_iUnion]
  refine ⟨⟨h, hh⟩, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨e, P.endpoint_subset_closure he, by simp [vadd_eq_add]⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget_periodic_of_target_ae
statement:
theorem LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget_periodic_of_target_ae
    {B H X : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) (hTile : LineTilesOn B H X)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) {p : ℝ}
    (hXperiod : p +ᵥ X =ᵐ[volume] X) :
    p +ᵥ FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H =
      FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hRopen, hRregular, _, hRaeX, _, _⟩ :=
    LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget P hTile hBpositive
  have hae : p +ᵥ FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H =ᵐ[volume]
      FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H :=
    ((MeasureTheory.vadd_set_ae_eq p).2 hRaeX).trans (hXperiod.trans hRaeX.symm)
  apply regularOpen_real_eq_of_aeEq (hRopen.vadd p) _ hRopen hRregular hae
  rw [closure_vadd, interior_vadd, hRregular]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget_periodic
statement:
theorem LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget_periodic
    {B H X : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) (hTile : LineTilesOn B H X)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) {p : ℝ}
    (hXperiod : ∀ x, x + p ∈ X ↔ x ∈ X) :
    p +ᵥ FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H = FiniteInterval.regularizedTarget B H
proof:
:= by
  apply LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget_periodic_of_target_ae P hTile hBpositive
  filter_upwards [] with x
  apply propext
  change x ∈ p +ᵥ X ↔ x ∈ X
  simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
  simpa [add_comm, sub_eq_add_neg] using (hXperiod (x - p)).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.frontier_periodic_function_of_vadd_eq
statement:
private theorem frontier_periodic_function_of_vadd_eq {R : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ}
    (h : a +ᵥ R = R) : Function.Periodic (fun x => x ∈ frontier R) a
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have hi := (Homeomorph.vaddConst a).image_frontier R
  have himage (S : Set ℝ) : (Homeomorph.vaddConst a : ℝ → ℝ) '' S = a +ᵥ S := by
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem,
      Homeomorph.vaddConst_apply, vadd_eq_add]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      simpa [add_comm] using hz
    · intro hy
      exact ⟨y - a, by simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm,
        add_assoc] using hy, by simp⟩
  rw [himage, himage] at hi
  rw [h] at hi
  apply propext
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hx' : a + x ∈ frontier R := by simpa [add_comm] using hx
    rw [← hi] at hx'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hay⟩ := hx'
    have : y = x := by simpa using hay
    simpa [this] using hy
  · intro hx
    have hx' : a + x ∈ a +ᵥ frontier R := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [hi] at hx'
    simpa [add_comm] using hx'

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.frontier_periodic
statement:
theorem frontier_periodic {R : Set ℝ} {p : ℝ} (hperiod : p +ᵥ R = R) :
    p +ᵥ frontier R = frontier R
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  have hfun := frontier_periodic_function_of_vadd_eq hperiod
  simpa [Function.Periodic, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using (hfun (-p + x)).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.frontier_periodic_zsmul
statement:
theorem frontier_periodic_zsmul {R : Set ℝ} {p : ℝ} (hperiod : p +ᵥ R = R)
    (m : ℤ) : ((m : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ frontier R = frontier R
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
  have hfun := (frontier_periodic_function_of_vadd_eq hperiod).zsmul m
  simpa [Function.Periodic, zsmul_eq_mul, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using
    (hfun (-((m : ℝ) * p) + x)).symm

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.periods_commensurable_of_finite_frontier_residues
statement:
theorem periods_commensurable_of_finite_frontier_residues
    {R : Set ℝ} {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hpperiod : p +ᵥ R = R) (hqperiod : q +ᵥ R = R)
    (hfinite : (frontier R ∩ Set.Ico 0 p).Finite) (hne : (frontier R).Nonempty) :
    ∃ r : ℚ, p = (r : ℝ) * q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
  have hpfront := frontier_periodic_function_of_vadd_eq hpperiod
  have hqfront := frontier_periodic_function_of_vadd_eq hqperiod
  let residue : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => p * Int.fract ((x + (n : ℝ) * q) / p)
  have hres_mem (n : ℕ) : residue n ∈ frontier R ∩ Set.Ico 0 p := by
    have hxn : x + (n : ℝ) * q ∈ frontier R := by
      have hn := hqfront.nat_mul n x
      simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using hn.mpr hx
    let z : ℤ := -Int.floor ((x + (n : ℝ) * q) / p)
    have hzmem : (z : ℝ) * p + (x + (n : ℝ) * q) ∈ frontier R := by
      have hz := hpfront.zsmul z (x + (n : ℝ) * q)
      have := hz.mpr hxn
      simpa [zsmul_eq_mul, add_comm] using this
    have heq : residue n = (z : ℝ) * p + (x + (n : ℝ) * q) := by
      change p * (((x + (n : ℝ) * q) / p) -
        (Int.floor ((x + (n : ℝ) * q) / p) : ℝ)) =
        (z : ℝ) * p + (x + (n : ℝ) * q)
      have hzcast : (z : ℝ) =
          -(Int.floor ((x + (n : ℝ) * q) / p) : ℝ) := by simp [z]
      rw [hzcast]
      field_simp [hp.ne']; ring
    refine ⟨heq ▸ hzmem, ?_⟩
    constructor
    · exact mul_nonneg hp.le (Int.fract_nonneg _)
    · nlinarith [Int.fract_lt_one ((x + (n : ℝ) * q) / p)]
  let f : ℕ → {y : ℝ // y ∈ frontier R ∩ Set.Ico 0 p} :=
    fun n => ⟨residue n, hres_mem n⟩
  let _ : Fintype {y : ℝ // y ∈ frontier R ∩ Set.Ico 0 p} := hfinite.fintype
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq⟩ := Finite.exists_ne_map_eq_of_infinite f
  have hfract : Int.fract ((x + (i : ℝ) * q) / p) =
      Int.fract ((x + (j : ℝ) * q) / p) := by
    have heq' := congrArg Subtype.val heq
    dsimp [f, residue] at heq'
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hp.ne' heq'
  have hlin : ((i : ℝ) - (j : ℝ)) * q =
      ((Int.floor ((x + (i : ℝ) * q) / p) : ℝ) -
        (Int.floor ((x + (j : ℝ) * q) / p) : ℝ)) * p := by
    rw [Int.fract, Int.fract] at hfract
    field_simp at hfract
    have hjarg : x + q * (j : ℝ) = x + (j : ℝ) * q := by ring
    rw [hjarg] at hfract
    linear_combination hfract
  let a : ℤ := Int.ofNat i - Int.ofNat j
  let b : ℤ := Int.floor ((x + (i : ℝ) * q) / p) -
    Int.floor ((x + (j : ℝ) * q) / p)
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro ha0
    apply hij
    exact Int.ofNat_inj.mp (Int.sub_eq_zero.mp ha0)
  have hab : (a : ℝ) * q = (b : ℝ) * p := by simpa [a, b] using hlin
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hb0
    have haz : (a : ℝ) * q = 0 := by simpa [hb0] using hab
    have hacast : (a : ℝ) = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp haz).resolve_right hq.ne'
    exact ha (by exact_mod_cast hacast)
  refine ⟨(a / b : ℚ), ?_⟩
  rw [Rat.cast_div]
  push_cast
  field_simp [hb]
  nlinarith [hab]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.frontier_nonempty_of_nonempty_proper_regularOpen
statement:
theorem frontier_nonempty_of_nonempty_proper_regularOpen {R : Set ℝ}
    (hRnonempty : R.Nonempty) (_hRopen : IsOpen R)
    (_hRregular : interior (closure R) = R) (hRproper : R ≠ Set.univ) :
    (frontier R).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hempty : frontier R = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne
  rcases frontier_eq_empty_iff.mp hempty with hRempty | hRuniv
  · exact hRnonempty.ne_empty hRempty
  · exact hRproper hRuniv

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.periodic_mem_of_vadd_eq
statement:
private theorem periodic_mem_of_vadd_eq {S : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ} (h : a +ᵥ S = S) :
    Function.Periodic (fun x => x ∈ S) a
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  apply propext
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hx' : a + x ∈ S := by simpa [add_comm] using hx
    rw [← h] at hx'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hay⟩ := hx'
    have : y = x := by simpa using hay
    simpa [this] using hy
  · intro hx
    have hx' : a + x ∈ a +ᵥ S := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [h] at hx'
    simpa [add_comm] using hx'

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.targetGapLength_le_period
statement:
theorem targetGapLength_le_period {R : Set ℝ} {p d : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hperiod : p +ᵥ R = R) (hd : d ∈ targetGapLengths R) : d ≤ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxy, hgap, rfl⟩ := hd
  by_contra hnot
  have hxp : x + p ∈ Ioo x y := by constructor <;> linarith
  have hxpfront : x + p ∈ frontier R := by
    have hm : p + x ∈ p +ᵥ frontier R := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [frontier_periodic hperiod] at hm
    simpa [add_comm] using hm
  exact hgap hxp (frontier_subset_closure hxpfront)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.targetGapLength_witness_in_twoPeriodWindow
statement:
theorem targetGapLength_witness_in_twoPeriodWindow {R : Set ℝ} {p d : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hperiod : p +ᵥ R = R) (hd : d ∈ targetGapLengths R) :
    ∃ x y : ℝ, x ∈ frontier R ∩ Set.Ico 0 p ∧
      y ∈ frontier R ∩ Set.Ioc 0 (2 * p) ∧ x < y ∧
      Set.Ioo x y ⊆ (closure R)ᶜ ∧ d = y - x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hgap, hdab⟩ := hd
  let m : ℤ := Int.floor (a / p)
  let x : ℝ := a - (m : ℝ) * p
  let y : ℝ := b - (m : ℝ) * p
  have hxfract : x = p * Int.fract (a / p) := by
    dsimp [x, m]
    rw [Int.fract]
    field_simp [hp.ne']
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by rw [hxfract]; exact mul_nonneg hp.le (Int.fract_nonneg _)
  have hxp : x < p := by
    rw [hxfract]
    nlinarith [Int.fract_lt_one (a / p)]
  have hxy : x < y := by dsimp [x, y]; linarith
  have hdiff : y - x = b - a := by dsimp [x, y]; ring
  have hyle : y ≤ 2 * p := by
    have hdle := targetGapLength_le_period hp hperiod
      ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hgap, hdab⟩
    rw [hdab, ← hdiff] at hdle
    linarith
  have hy0 : 0 < y := lt_of_le_of_lt hx0 hxy
  have hfrontfun := (frontier_periodic_function_of_vadd_eq hperiod).zsmul (-m)
  have hxfront : x ∈ frontier R := by
    have := (hfrontfun a).mpr ha
    simpa [x, zsmul_eq_mul, sub_eq_add_neg] using this
  have hyfront : y ∈ frontier R := by
    have := (hfrontfun b).mpr hb
    simpa [y, zsmul_eq_mul, sub_eq_add_neg] using this
  have hclosurePeriod : p +ᵥ closure R = closure R := by
    rw [← closure_vadd, hperiod]
  have hclosureFun := (periodic_mem_of_vadd_eq hclosurePeriod).zsmul m
  have hgap' : Ioo x y ⊆ (closure R)ᶜ := by
    intro z hz hzcl
    have hzshift : z + (m : ℝ) * p ∈ closure R := by
      have := (hclosureFun z).mpr hzcl
      simpa [zsmul_eq_mul] using this
    have hz1 := hz.1
    have hz2 := hz.2
    dsimp [x, y] at hz1 hz2
    apply hgap (show z + (m : ℝ) * p ∈ Ioo a b by
      constructor <;> linarith)
    exact hzshift
  refine ⟨x, y, ⟨hxfront, hx0, hxp⟩, ⟨hyfront, hy0, hyle⟩,
    hxy, hgap', ?_⟩
  rw [hdab, hdiff]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.targetGapLengths_finite
statement:
theorem targetGapLengths_finite {R : Set ℝ} {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hperiod : p +ᵥ R = R)
    (hfrontierLocal : ∀ C : Set ℝ, IsCompact C → (C ∩ frontier R).Finite) :
    (targetGapLengths R).Finite
proof:
:= by
  let F : Set ℝ := Icc 0 (2 * p) ∩ frontier R
  have hF : F.Finite := hfrontierLocal (Icc 0 (2 * p)) isCompact_Icc
  apply ((hF.prod hF).image fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.2 - q.1).subset
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hxy, hgap, hdiff⟩ :=
    targetGapLength_witness_in_twoPeriodWindow hp hperiod hd
  refine ⟨(x, y), ?_, hdiff.symm⟩
  constructor
  · exact ⟨⟨hx.2.1, (le_of_lt hx.2.2).trans (by linarith [hp])⟩, hx.1⟩
  · exact ⟨⟨hy.2.1.le, hy.2.2⟩, hy.1⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.targetGapLengths_pos
statement:
theorem targetGapLengths_pos {R : Set ℝ} {d : ℝ}
    (hd : d ∈ targetGapLengths R) : 0 < d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, _, _, hxy, _, rfl⟩ := hd
  linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.consecutive_translatedEndpoint_gap_of_covered_midpoint
statement:
theorem consecutive_translatedEndpoint_gap_of_covered_midpoint
    {B L : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hpack : Set.Pairwise L
      (AEDisjoint volume on ((· +ᵥ B) : ℝ → Set ℝ)))
    {x y : ℝ}
    (hxy : ConsecutiveIn (translatedEndpointSet P L) x y)
    (hmid : ∃ l ∈ L, (x + y) / 2 ∈ l +ᵥ closure B) :
    y - x ∈ P.gapLengths
proof:
:= by
  let z : ℝ := (x + y) / 2
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hzcl⟩ := hmid
  have hxz : x < z := by dsimp [z]; linarith [hxy.2.2.1]
  have hzy : z < y := by dsimp [z]; linarith [hxy.2.2.1]
  have hzcl' : z - l ∈ closure B := by
    dsimp [z]
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hzcl
    simpa only [vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using hzcl
  have hzB : z - l ∈ B := by
    by_contra hzB
    have he : z - l ∈ (P.endpoints : Set ℝ) :=
      P.closure_diff_subset_endpoints ⟨hzcl', hzB⟩
    have hzE : z ∈ translatedEndpointSet P L :=
      (mem_translatedEndpointSet_iff P).2
        ⟨l, hl, z - l, he, by ring⟩
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hxy.2.2.2 hzE ⟨hxz, hzy⟩
  rw [P.union_eq, Set.mem_iUnion] at hzB
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hzB
  have hleftEnd : P.left i ∈ P.endpoints := by
    rw [IntervalPresentation.endpoints, Finset.mem_union]
    exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
  have hrightEnd : P.right i ∈ P.endpoints := by
    rw [IntervalPresentation.endpoints, Finset.mem_union]
    exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
  have hleftE : l + P.left i ∈ translatedEndpointSet P L :=
    (mem_translatedEndpointSet_iff P).2
      ⟨l, hl, P.left i, hleftEnd, rfl⟩
  have hrightE : l + P.right i ∈ translatedEndpointSet P L :=
    (mem_translatedEndpointSet_iff P).2
      ⟨l, hl, P.right i, hrightEnd, rfl⟩
  have hleft_lt_z : l + P.left i < z := by linarith [hi.1]
  have hz_lt_right : z < l + P.right i := by linarith [hi.2]
  have hleft_le_x : l + P.left i ≤ x := by
    by_contra h
    have hxleft : x < l + P.left i := lt_of_not_ge h
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hxy.2.2.2 hleftE
      ⟨hxleft, lt_trans hleft_lt_z hzy⟩
  have hy_le_right : y ≤ l + P.right i := by
    by_contra h
    have hrighty : l + P.right i < y := lt_of_not_ge h
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hxy.2.2.2 hrightE
      ⟨lt_trans hxz hz_lt_right, hrighty⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm, ex, hex, hxeq⟩ :=
    (mem_translatedEndpointSet_iff P).1 hxy.1
  obtain ⟨n, hn, ey, hey, hyeq⟩ :=
    (mem_translatedEndpointSet_iff P).1 hxy.2.1
  have hxOwned : ∃ ex ∈ P.endpoints, x = l + ex := by
    by_cases hxleft : x = l + P.left i
    · exact ⟨P.left i, hleftEnd, hxleft⟩
    · have hleft_lt_x : l + P.left i < x :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne hleft_le_x (Ne.symm hxleft)
      have hxOpen : x ∈ l +ᵥ B := by
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, P.union_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
        refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
        simp only [vadd_eq_add]
        constructor <;> linarith
      have hm_eq_l : m = l := by
        by_contra hml
        have hxNot := endpoint_not_mem_other_openTile P hpack hm hl hml hex
        exact hxNot (hxeq ▸ hxOpen)
      exact ⟨ex, hex, by simpa [hm_eq_l] using hxeq⟩
  have hyOwned : ∃ ey ∈ P.endpoints, y = l + ey := by
    by_cases hyright : y = l + P.right i
    · exact ⟨P.right i, hrightEnd, hyright⟩
    · have hy_lt_right : y < l + P.right i :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne hy_le_right hyright
      have hyOpen : y ∈ l +ᵥ B := by
        rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, P.union_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
        refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
        simp only [vadd_eq_add]
        constructor <;> linarith
      have hn_eq_l : n = l := by
        by_contra hnl
        have hyNot := endpoint_not_mem_other_openTile P hpack hn hl hnl hey
        exact hyNot (hyeq ▸ hyOpen)
      exact ⟨ey, hey, by simpa [hn_eq_l] using hyeq⟩
  obtain ⟨ex', hex', hxeq'⟩ := hxOwned
  obtain ⟨ey', hey', hyeq'⟩ := hyOwned
  refine ⟨ex', hex', ey', hey', ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hxy.2.2.1]
  · linarith

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.consecutive_translatedEndpoint_gap
statement:
theorem consecutive_translatedEndpoint_gap
    {B L : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) (hTile : LineTiles B L)
    {x y : ℝ} (hxy : ConsecutiveIn (translatedEndpointSet P L) x y) :
    y - x ∈ P.gapLengths
proof:
:= by
  have hsource :=
    (finiteOpenIntervals_source_iff_ae P.isFiniteIntervalRegion hBpositive).1 hTile
  have hmid : ∃ l ∈ L, (x + y) / 2 ∈ l +ᵥ closure B := by
    have hm : (x + y) / 2 ∈ ⋃ l : L, l.1 +ᵥ closure B := by
      rw [hsource.2.2]
      exact Set.mem_univ _
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hm
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hm
    exact ⟨l.1, l.2, hl⟩
  exact consecutive_translatedEndpoint_gap_of_covered_midpoint
    P hTile.2.2.2.1 hxy hmid

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.finite_centerCandidates
statement:
theorem finite_centerCandidates
    {B : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal)
    (radius : ℝ) (hradius : 0 ≤ radius) :
    ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∀ (L : Set ℝ),
      LineTiles B L → 0 ∈ L →
      L ∩ Set.Icc (-radius) radius ⊆ (F : Set ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hBne : B.Nonempty := by
    rw [Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    intro hBempty
    rw [hBempty, measure_empty, ENNReal.toReal_zero] at hBpositive
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hBpositive
  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀⟩ := P.endpoints_nonempty hBne
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := finite_candidates_of_gapAlphabet
    P.gapLengths_finite (fun a ha ↦ P.gapLengths_pos ha)
    e₀ radius hradius
  let F : Finset ℝ := E.image (fun e ↦ e - e₀)
  refine ⟨F, ?_⟩
  intro L hTile hzero l hl
  have hlocal : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q →
      (translatedEndpointSet P L ∩ Q).Finite := by
    apply translatedEndpointSet_boundedWindowFinite P
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hcentres, _⟩ := linePacking_uniformlySeparated
      hTile P.volume_ne_top hBpositive
    exact hcentres
  have heAnchor : e₀ ∈ translatedEndpointSet P L :=
    (mem_translatedEndpointSet_iff P).2 ⟨0, hzero, e₀, he₀, by simp⟩
  have hgap : ∀ x y, ConsecutiveIn (translatedEndpointSet P L) x y →
      y - x ∈ P.gapLengths := fun x y hxy ↦
    consecutive_translatedEndpoint_gap P hBpositive hTile hxy
  have hle : l ∈ Set.Icc (-radius) radius := hl.2
  have hendpoint : l + e₀ ∈ translatedEndpointSet P L :=
    (mem_translatedEndpointSet_iff P).2 ⟨l, hl.1, e₀, he₀, rfl⟩
  have hwindow : l + e₀ ∈ Set.Icc (e₀ - radius) (e₀ + radius) := by
    constructor <;> linarith [hle.1, hle.2]
  have hmemE : l + e₀ ∈ E := hE _ hlocal heAnchor hgap ⟨hendpoint, hwindow⟩
  rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_image]
  exact ⟨l + e₀, hmemE, by ring⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.finite_normalized_localPatterns
statement:
theorem finite_normalized_localPatterns
    {B : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal)
    (radius : ℝ) (hradius : 0 ≤ radius) :
    {S : Set ℝ | ∃ L : Set ℝ,
      LineTiles B L ∧ 0 ∈ L ∧ S = L ∩ Set.Icc (-radius) radius}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := finite_centerCandidates P hBpositive radius hradius
  let G : Set (Set ℝ) := ((fun s : Finset ℝ ↦ (s : Set ℝ)) ''
    (F.powerset : Set (Finset ℝ)))
  have hG : G.Finite := F.powerset.finite_toSet.image _
  apply hG.subset
  rintro S ⟨L, hTile, hzero, rfl⟩
  have hsub := hF L hTile hzero
  have hfin : (L ∩ Set.Icc (-radius) radius).Finite :=
    F.finite_toSet.subset hsub
  refine ⟨hfin.toFinset, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powerset]
    intro x hx
    apply hsub
    simpa using hx
  · exact Set.Finite.coe_toFinset hfin

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.finite_normalizedCentreSets_aux
statement:
private theorem finite_normalizedCentreSets_aux
    {B : Set ℝ} (hB : IsFiniteIntervalRegion B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) :
    {L : Set ℝ | LineTiles B L ∧ 0 ∈ L}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  let P := IntervalPresentation.ofIsFiniteIntervalRegion hB
  obtain ⟨R, hRpos, hrigid⟩ :=
    finiteInterval_lineTilingsOn_localRigidity hB hBpositive
  let D : Set (Set ℝ) := {L : Set ℝ | LineTiles B L ∧ 0 ∈ L}
  let restrict : Set ℝ → Set ℝ := fun L ↦ L ∩ Set.Icc (-R) R
  have himage : (restrict '' D).Finite := by
    apply (finite_normalized_localPatterns P hBpositive R hRpos.le).subset
    rintro S ⟨L, hLD, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨L, hLD.1, hLD.2, rfl⟩
  apply Set.Finite.of_finite_image himage
  intro H hH H' hH' heq
  apply hrigid H H' Set.univ 0 hH.1 hH'.1
  simpa only [zero_sub, zero_add] using heq

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.finite_normalizedLineTilings
statement:
theorem finite_normalizedLineTilings
    {B : Set ℝ} (hB : IsFiniteIntervalRegion B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) :
    Finite (NormalizedLineTiling B)
proof:
:= by
  have hcentres := finite_normalizedCentreSets_aux hB hBpositive
  let C := {L : Set ℝ | LineTiles B L ∧ 0 ∈ L}
  let _ : Finite C := Set.finite_coe_iff.mpr hcentres
  let f : NormalizedLineTiling B → C := fun N ↦
    ⟨N.centres, N.tiles, N.zero_mem⟩
  apply Finite.of_injective f
  intro N N' heq
  cases N with
  | mk centres tiles zero_mem =>
    cases N' with
    | mk centres' tiles' zero_mem' =>
      have hcentresEq : centres = centres' := congrArg Subtype.val heq
      subst centres'
      rfl

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.finite_normalizedCentreSets
statement:
theorem finite_normalizedCentreSets
    {B : Set ℝ} (hB : IsFiniteIntervalRegion B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) :
    {L : Set ℝ | LineTiles B L ∧ 0 ∈ L}.Finite
proof:
:=
  finite_normalizedCentreSets_aux hB hBpositive

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.not_ae_univ_of_isBounded
statement:
private theorem not_ae_univ_of_isBounded {A : Set ℝ}
    (hA : Bornology.IsBounded A) : ¬ A =ᵐ[volume] Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  intro hae
  have hmeasure : volume A = volume Set.univ := measure_congr hae
  exact hA.measure_lt_top.ne (by simpa using hmeasure)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.lineTiles_centres_infinite
statement:
theorem lineTiles_centres_infinite {B L : Set ℝ}
    (hBbounded : Bornology.IsBounded B) (hTile : LineTiles B L) : L.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  intro hL
  have hLbounded : Bornology.IsBounded L := hL.isBounded
  have hsumBounded : Bornology.IsBounded (L + B) :=
    isBounded_add hLbounded hBbounded
  apply not_ae_univ_of_isBounded hsumBounded
  filter_upwards [hTile.2.2.2.2] with x hx
  apply propext
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hx.mp (Set.mem_univ x)
    rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hl
    exact ⟨l.1, l.2, -l.1 + x, hl, by ring⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.period_of_equal_normalizations
proof:
:= by
  have hcentres : normalizeLineTiling L l₁.1 = normalizeLineTiling L l₂.1 := by
    rw [← hN₁, ← hN₂, heq]
  have h := congrArg (fun S : Set ℝ ↦ l₂.1 +ᵥ S) hcentres
  rw [normalizeLineTiling, normalizeLineTiling] at h
  calc
    (l₂.1 - l₁.1) +ᵥ L = l₂.1 +ᵥ ((-l₁.1) +ᵥ L) := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
      ring_nf
    _ = l₂.1 +ᵥ ((-l₂.1) +ᵥ L) := h
    _ = L := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add]
      ring_nf

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.exists_positiveLinePeriod_of_finite_normalized
statement:
theorem exists_positiveLinePeriod_of_finite_normalized
    {B L : Set ℝ} (hBbounded : Bornology.IsBounded B)
    (hTile : LineTiles B L) (hfinite : Finite (NormalizedLineTiling B)) :
    ∃ p : ℝ, 0 < p ∧ p +ᵥ L = L
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Finite (NormalizedLineTiling B) := hfinite
  have hLinfinite : L.Infinite := lineTiles_centres_infinite hBbounded hTile
  let _ : Infinite L := hLinfinite.to_subtype
  let N : L → NormalizedLineTiling B := fun l ↦
    Classical.choose (normalizeLineTiling_spec hTile l.2)
  have hN (l : L) : (N l).centres = normalizeLineTiling L l.1 :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (normalizeLineTiling_spec hTile l.2)).1
  have hninj : ¬ Function.Injective N := not_injective_infinite_finite N
  rw [Function.Injective] at hninj
  push Not at hninj
  obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, heq, hne⟩ := hninj
  have hperiod : (l₂.1 - l₁.1) +ᵥ L = L :=
    period_of_equal_normalizations (hN l₁) (hN l₂) heq
  have hvalsne : l₂.1 ≠ l₁.1 := by
    intro hvals
    apply hne
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hvals.symm
  have hdiffne : l₂.1 - l₁.1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hvalsne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hdiffne with hneg | hpos
  · refine ⟨-(l₂.1 - l₁.1), neg_pos.mpr hneg, ?_⟩
    exact (Tiling.AxisParallel.periodGroup L).neg_mem hperiod
  · exact ⟨l₂.1 - l₁.1, hpos, hperiod⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.exists_positiveLinePeriod
proof:
:= by
  let P := IntervalPresentation.ofIsFiniteIntervalRegion hB
  exact exists_positiveLinePeriod_of_finite_normalized P.isBounded hTile
    (finite_normalizedLineTilings hB hBpositive)

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.consecutive_translatedEndpoint_gap_on_regularTarget
statement:
theorem consecutive_translatedEndpoint_gap_on_regularTarget
    {B H R : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hTile : LineTilesOn B H R) (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal)
    (hRopen : IsOpen R) (hRregular : interior (closure R) = R)
    {x y : ℝ} (hxy : ConsecutiveIn (translatedEndpointSet P H) x y) :
    y - x ∈ P.gapLengths ∪ targetGapLengths R
proof:
:= by
  let z : ℝ := (x + y) / 2
  have hzIoo : z ∈ Ioo x y := by
    dsimp [z]
    constructor <;> linarith [hxy.2.2.1]
  have hclosed := LineTilesOn.lineClosedUnion_eq_closure_target P hTile hBpositive
    hRopen hRregular
  by_cases hz : z ∈ lineClosedUnion B H
  · left
    rw [lineClosedUnion, Set.mem_iUnion] at hz
    obtain ⟨⟨l, hl⟩, hzl⟩ := hz
    exact consecutive_translatedEndpoint_gap_of_covered_midpoint P hTile.2.2.2.1
      hxy ⟨l, hl, hzl⟩
  · right
    have hgap : Ioo x y ⊆ (closure R)ᶜ := by
      intro w hw hwR
      rw [← hclosed, lineClosedUnion, Set.mem_iUnion] at hwR
      obtain ⟨⟨l, hl⟩, hwl⟩ := hwR
      have hwb : w - l ∈ closure B := by
        simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg,
          add_comm] using hwl
      have hwbOpen : w - l ∈ B := by
        by_contra hn
        have he : w - l ∈ P.endpoints :=
          P.closure_diff_subset_endpoints ⟨hwb, hn⟩
        have hwE : w ∈ translatedEndpointSet P H :=
          (mem_translatedEndpointSet_iff P).2 ⟨l, hl, w - l, he, by ring⟩
        exact (Set.disjoint_left.1 hxy.2.2.2 hwE hw)
      rw [P.union_eq, Set.mem_iUnion] at hwbOpen
      obtain ⟨i, hwi⟩ := hwbOpen
      have hleftE : l + P.left i ∈ translatedEndpointSet P H :=
        (mem_translatedEndpointSet_iff P).2 ⟨l, hl, P.left i, by
          simp [IntervalPresentation.endpoints], rfl⟩
      have hrightE : l + P.right i ∈ translatedEndpointSet P H :=
        (mem_translatedEndpointSet_iff P).2 ⟨l, hl, P.right i, by
          simp [IntervalPresentation.endpoints], rfl⟩
      have hleft : l + P.left i ≤ x := by
        by_contra hn
        have : l + P.left i ∈ Ioo x y := by
          constructor
          · exact lt_of_not_ge hn
          · linarith [hwi.1, hw.2]
        exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hxy.2.2.2 hleftE this
      have hright : y ≤ l + P.right i := by
        by_contra hn
        have : l + P.right i ∈ Ioo x y := by
          constructor
          · linarith [hw.1, hwi.2]
          · exact lt_of_not_ge hn
        exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hxy.2.2.2 hrightE this
      apply hz
      rw [lineClosedUnion, Set.mem_iUnion]
      refine ⟨⟨l, hl⟩, ?_⟩
      have hzclosed : z - l ∈ Set.Icc (P.left i) (P.right i) := by
        constructor <;> linarith [hzIoo.1, hzIoo.2]
      have : z - l ∈ closure B := by
        rw [P.closure_eq_iUnion_Icc, Set.mem_iUnion]
        exact ⟨i, hzclosed⟩
      simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem, vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg,
        add_comm] using this
    have hxclosure := LineTilesOn.translatedEndpointSet_subset_closure_target P hTile
      hBpositive hRopen hRregular hxy.1
    have hyclosure := LineTilesOn.translatedEndpointSet_subset_closure_target P hTile
      hBpositive hRopen hRregular hxy.2.1
    have hxnot : x ∉ R := by
      intro hxR
      obtain ⟨a, b, ⟨hax, hxb⟩, hab⟩ :=
        mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset.mp (hRopen.mem_nhds hxR)
      let u := (x + min b y) / 2
      have hxmin : x < min b y := lt_min hxb hxy.2.2.1
      have huI : u ∈ Ioo x y := by
        dsimp [u]
        constructor <;> linarith [min_le_right b y, hxmin]
      have huR : u ∈ R := hab ⟨by dsimp [u]; linarith [hax, hxmin],
        by dsimp [u]; linarith [min_le_left b y, hxb]⟩
      exact hgap huI (subset_closure huR)
    have hynot : y ∉ R := by
      intro hyR
      obtain ⟨a, b, ⟨hay, hyb⟩, hab⟩ :=
        mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset.mp (hRopen.mem_nhds hyR)
      let u := (max a x + y) / 2
      have hmaxy : max a x < y := max_lt hay hxy.2.2.1
      have huI : u ∈ Ioo x y := by
        dsimp [u]
        constructor <;> linarith [le_max_right a x, hmaxy]
      have huR : u ∈ R := hab ⟨by dsimp [u]; linarith [le_max_left a x, hay],
        by dsimp [u]; linarith [hmaxy, hyb]⟩
      exact hgap huI (subset_closure huR)
    have hxfront : x ∈ frontier R := by
      rw [frontier, hRopen.interior_eq]
      exact ⟨hxclosure, hxnot⟩
    have hyfront : y ∈ frontier R := by
      rw [frontier, hRopen.interior_eq]
      exact ⟨hyclosure, hynot⟩
    exact ⟨x, y, hxfront, hyfront, hxy.2.2.1, hgap, rfl⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.finite_centerCandidates_on_properPeriodicTarget
statement:
theorem finite_centerCandidates_on_properPeriodicTarget
    {B R : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal)
    (hRnonempty : R.Nonempty) (hRopen : IsOpen R)
    (hRregular : interior (closure R) = R) (hRproper : R ≠ Set.univ)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hperiod : p +ᵥ R = R)
    (hfrontierLocal : ∀ C : Set ℝ, IsCompact C → (C ∩ frontier R).Finite)
    (radius : ℝ) (hradius : 0 ≤ radius) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∀ H : Set ℝ, LineTilesOn B H R →
      H ∩ Icc (c - radius) (c + radius) ⊆ (F : Set ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0⟩ :=
    frontier_nonempty_of_nonempty_proper_regularOpen hRnonempty hRopen hRregular hRproper
  have hBnonempty : B.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hn
    simp only [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hn
    rw [hn, measure_empty, ENNReal.toReal_zero] at hBpositive
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hBpositive
  obtain ⟨e0, he0⟩ := P.endpoints_nonempty hBnonempty
  let A : Set ℝ := P.gapLengths ∪ targetGapLengths R
  have hAfinite : A.Finite :=
    P.gapLengths_finite.union (targetGapLengths_finite hp hperiod hfrontierLocal)
  have hApositive : ∀ d ∈ A, 0 < d := by
    intro d hd
    rcases hd with hd | hd
    · exact P.gapLengths_pos hd
    · exact targetGapLengths_pos hd
  obtain ⟨FE, hFE⟩ := finite_candidates_of_gapAlphabet hAfinite hApositive
    x0 radius hradius
  refine ⟨x0 - e0, FE.image (fun z => z - e0), ?_⟩
  intro H hTile h hh
  have hHlocal := finiteInterval_lineTilesOn_centres_locallyFinite
    P.isFiniteIntervalRegion hBpositive hTile
  have hElocal := translatedEndpointSet_boundedWindowFinite P hHlocal
  have hx0E := LineTilesOn.frontier_target_subset_translatedEndpointSet P hTile
    hBpositive hRopen hRregular hx0
  have hEwindow : h + e0 ∈ translatedEndpointSet P H ∩ Icc (x0 - radius) (x0 + radius) := by
    refine ⟨(mem_translatedEndpointSet_iff P).2 ⟨h, hh.1, e0, he0, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    constructor <;> linarith [hh.2.1, hh.2.2]
  have hmem := hFE (translatedEndpointSet P H) hElocal hx0E
    (fun x y hxy => consecutive_translatedEndpoint_gap_on_regularTarget P hTile
      hBpositive hRopen hRregular hxy)
    hEwindow
  rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_image]
  exact ⟨h + e0, hmem, by ring⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.finite_lineTilingsOn_properPeriodicTarget
statement:
theorem finite_lineTilingsOn_properPeriodicTarget
    {B R : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) (hRnonempty : R.Nonempty)
    (hRopen : IsOpen R) (hRregular : interior (closure R) = R)
    (hRproper : R ≠ Set.univ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hperiod : p +ᵥ R = R)
    (hfrontierLocal : ∀ C : Set ℝ, IsCompact C → (C ∩ frontier R).Finite) :
    {H : Set ℝ | LineTilesOn B H R}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨radius, hradius, hrigid⟩ :=
    finiteInterval_lineTilingsOn_localRigidity P.isFiniteIntervalRegion hBpositive
  obtain ⟨c, F, hF⟩ := finite_centerCandidates_on_properPeriodicTarget P hBpositive hRnonempty
    hRopen hRregular hRproper hp hperiod hfrontierLocal radius hradius.le
  let A : Set (Set ℝ) := {H : Set ℝ | LineTilesOn B H R}
  let restrict : Set ℝ → Set ℝ := fun H => H ∩ Icc (c - radius) (c + radius)
  have himage : (restrict '' A).Finite := by
    apply (F.finite_toSet.finite_subsets).subset
    rintro S ⟨H, hHA, rfl⟩
    exact hF H hHA
  apply Set.Finite.of_finite_image himage
  intro H hHA H' hH'A heq
  exact hrigid H H' R c hHA hH'A heq

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.exists_nsmul_targetPeriod_vadd_centres_eq
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_targetPeriod_vadd_centres_eq
    {B H R : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) (hTile : LineTilesOn B H R)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) (hRnonempty : R.Nonempty)
    (hRopen : IsOpen R) (hRregular : interior (closure R) = R)
    (hRproper : R ≠ Set.univ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hperiod : p +ᵥ R = R)
    (hfrontierLocal : ∀ C : Set ℝ, IsCompact C → (C ∩ frontier R).Finite) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ((n : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ H = H
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite := finite_lineTilingsOn_properPeriodicTarget P hBpositive hRnonempty
    hRopen hRregular hRproper hp hperiod hfrontierLocal
  obtain ⟨n, hn, _, hfix⟩ :=
    Tiling.AxisParallel.Foundations.lineTilesOn_periodic_of_finiteOrbit
      hp hperiod.symm.eventuallyEq hfinite hTile
  exact ⟨n, hn, hfix⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.pt_regularizedTarget_vadd_centres
statement:
private theorem pt_regularizedTarget_vadd_centres (B H : Set ℝ) (q : ℝ) :
    regularizedTarget B (q +ᵥ H) = q +ᵥ regularizedTarget B H
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : lineOpenUnion B (q +ᵥ H) = q +ᵥ lineOpenUnion B H := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rw [lineOpenUnion, Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
      obtain ⟨k, hxk⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨h, hh, hkh⟩ := k.property
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      rw [lineOpenUnion, Set.mem_iUnion]
      refine ⟨⟨h, hh⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hxk
      rw [← hkh] at hxk
      convert hxk using 1
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      ring
    · intro hx
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hx
      rw [lineOpenUnion, Set.mem_iUnion] at hx ⊢
      obtain ⟨⟨h, hh⟩, hxh⟩ := hx
      refine ⟨⟨q + h, ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
      rw [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] at hxh
      convert hxh using 1
      simp only [vadd_eq_add]
      ring
  unfold regularizedTarget
  rw [hopen, closure_vadd, interior_vadd]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.lineTilesOn_measurableTarget_full_or_periodic
statement:
theorem lineTilesOn_measurableTarget_full_or_periodic
    {B H X : Set ℝ} (P : IntervalPresentation B) (hTile : LineTilesOn B H X)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hXperiod : p +ᵥ X =ᵐ[volume] X) :
    (regularizedTarget B H = Set.univ ∧ LineTiles B H) ∨
      (regularizedTarget B H ≠ Set.univ ∧
        ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ((n : ℝ) * p) +ᵥ H = H)
proof:
:= by
  let R := regularizedTarget B H
  obtain ⟨hRopen, hRregular, _, _, hTileR, hfrontierLocal⟩ :=
    LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget P hTile hBpositive
  have hRperiod : p +ᵥ R = R :=
    LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget_periodic_of_target_ae P hTile hBpositive hXperiod
  by_cases hfull : R = Set.univ
  · left
    refine ⟨hfull, ?_⟩
    change LineTilesOn B H R at hTileR
    rw [hfull] at hTileR
    exact hTileR
  · right
    refine ⟨hfull, ?_⟩
    by_cases hH : H.Nonempty
    · have hBnonempty : B.Nonempty := by
        by_contra hn
        simp only [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hn
        rw [hn, measure_empty, ENNReal.toReal_zero] at hBpositive
        exact lt_irrefl 0 hBpositive
      obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hH
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hBnonempty
      have hRnonempty : R.Nonempty := by
        refine ⟨h + b, ?_⟩
        apply lineOpenUnion_subset_regularizedTarget P
        rw [lineOpenUnion, Set.mem_iUnion]
        exact ⟨⟨h, hh⟩, ⟨b, hb, by simp⟩⟩
      exact exists_nsmul_targetPeriod_vadd_centres_eq P hTileR hBpositive hRnonempty
        hRopen hRregular hfull hp hRperiod hfrontierLocal
    · have hHempty : H = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hH
      refine ⟨1, by omega, ?_⟩
      simp [hHempty]

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.periodicTarget_lineTiling_finiteIntervals
statement:
theorem periodicTarget_lineTiling_finiteIntervals
    {B H X : Set ℝ} (hB : IsFiniteIntervalRegion B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) (hTile : LineTilesOn B H X)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hXperiod : p +ᵥ X =ᵐ[volume] X) :
    ∃ q : ℝ, 0 < q ∧ q +ᵥ H = H
proof:
:= by
  let P := IntervalPresentation.ofIsFiniteIntervalRegion hB
  rcases lineTilesOn_measurableTarget_full_or_periodic P hTile hBpositive hp hXperiod with
    hfull | hproper
  · exact exists_positiveLinePeriod hB hBpositive hfull.2
  · obtain ⟨n, hn, hfix⟩ := hproper.2
    refine ⟨(n : ℝ) * p, mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hn) hp, hfix⟩

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.properPeriodicTarget_periods_commensurable
statement:
theorem properPeriodicTarget_periods_commensurable
    {R : Set ℝ}
    (hRnonempty : R.Nonempty) (hRopen : IsOpen R)
    (hRregular : interior (closure R) = R) (hRproper : R ≠ Set.univ)
    {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hpperiod : p +ᵥ R = R) (hqperiod : q +ᵥ R = R)
    (hfrontierLocal : ∀ C : Set ℝ, IsCompact C → (C ∩ frontier R).Finite) :
    ∃ r : ℚ, p = (r : ℝ) * q
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite : (frontier R ∩ Ico 0 p).Finite := by
    apply (hfrontierLocal (Icc 0 p) isCompact_Icc).subset
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨⟨hx.2.1, hx.2.2.le⟩, hx.1⟩
  have hne := frontier_nonempty_of_nonempty_proper_regularOpen
    hRnonempty hRopen hRregular hRproper
  exact periods_commensurable_of_finite_frontier_residues hp hq hpperiod
    hqperiod hfinite hne

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.properPeriodicTarget_periods_commensurable_finiteIntervals
statement:
theorem properPeriodicTarget_periods_commensurable_finiteIntervals
    {B H X : Set ℝ} (hB : IsFiniteIntervalRegion B)
    (hBpositive : 0 < (volume B).toReal) (hTile : LineTilesOn B H X)
    {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hXperiod : p +ᵥ X =ᵐ[volume] X) (hHperiod : q +ᵥ H = H)
    (hXcell : 0 < (volume (X ∩ Ico 0 p)).toReal)
    (hXcomplement : ∃ I : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded I ∧
      0 < (volume (I \ X)).toReal) : ∃ r : ℚ, p = (r : ℝ) * q
proof:
:= by
  let P := IntervalPresentation.ofIsFiniteIntervalRegion hB
  let R := regularizedTarget B H
  obtain ⟨hRopen, hRregular, _, hRX, hTileR, hfrontierLocal⟩ :=
    LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget P hTile hBpositive
  have hpR : p +ᵥ R = R :=
    LineTilesOn.regularizedTarget_periodic_of_target_ae P hTile hBpositive hXperiod
  have hRnonempty : R.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hne
    have hRempty : R = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne
    have hcellAE : (· ∈ R ∩ Ico 0 p) =ᵐ[volume] (· ∈ X ∩ Ico 0 p) := by
      filter_upwards [hRX] with x hx
      exact propext (and_congr (eq_iff_iff.mp hx) Iff.rfl)
    have hmeasure : volume (R ∩ Ico 0 p) = volume (X ∩ Ico 0 p) :=
      measure_congr hcellAE
    rw [hRempty, empty_inter, measure_empty] at hmeasure
    rw [← hmeasure, ENNReal.toReal_zero] at hXcell
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hXcell
  have hRproper : R ≠ Set.univ := by
    intro hfull
    obtain ⟨I, _, hIpositive⟩ := hXcomplement
    have hdiffAE : (· ∈ I \ R) =ᵐ[volume] (· ∈ I \ X) := by
      filter_upwards [hRX] with x hx
      exact propext (and_congr Iff.rfl (not_congr (eq_iff_iff.mp hx)))
    have hmeasure : volume (I \ R) = volume (I \ X) := measure_congr hdiffAE
    simp only [hfull, sdiff_univ, measure_empty] at hmeasure
    rw [← hmeasure, ENNReal.toReal_zero] at hIpositive
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hIpositive
  have hqR : q +ᵥ R = R := by
    change q +ᵥ regularizedTarget B H = regularizedTarget B H
    rw [← pt_regularizedTarget_vadd_centres]
    exact congrArg (regularizedTarget B) hHperiod
  exact properPeriodicTarget_periods_commensurable
    hRnonempty hRopen hRregular hRproper hp hq hpR hqR hfrontierLocal

name: Tiling.AxisParallel.OneDimensional.FiniteInterval.endpointChain_nonempty
statement:
theorem endpointChain_nonempty
    {E : Set ℝ}
    (hlocal : ∀ Q : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded Q → (E ∩ Q).Finite)
    {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ E) (hy : y ∈ E) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    Nonempty (EndpointChain E x y)
proof:
:= by
  let S : Finset ℝ := (hlocal (Icc x y) (Metric.isBounded_Icc x y)).toFinset
  have hxS : x ∈ S := by simp [S, hx, hxy]
  have hyS : y ∈ S := by simp [S, hy, hxy]
  have hcard : 0 < S.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨x, hxS⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, S.card = k + 1 := by
    exact ⟨S.card - 1, (Nat.sub_add_cancel hcard).symm⟩
